title: Dingle Vodka – 700 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Dingle Vodka is an artisanal craft spirit produced by the Dingle Distillery in Dingle, County Kerry, located on the picturesque Dingle Peninsula along Ireland's Wild Atlantic Way. Founded in 2012 by Oliver Hughes, Liam LaHart, and Peter Mosley, Dingle was one of the pioneering independent craft distilleries in the modern Irish spirits revival. While renowned for its Irish whiskey and award-winning gin, Dingle Vodka stands out as a pure, meticulous expression of Irish craft distilling, celebrated for its smooth, slightly sweet grain character and pristine texture.

Spirit Description

Dingle Vodka is crafted using a 100% grain neutral spirit base that undergoes a rigorous multi-distillation process. The spirit is distilled five times in a custom-built 500-liter copper pot still nicknamed "Oisín." Following distillation, the high-proof vodka is blended with pure, mineral-rich water drawn from the distillery's own 240-foot well located beneath the Kerry countryside. The combination of copper pot distillation and pure local spring water yields a vodka of exceptional clarity, subtle sweetness, and a soft, velvety texture.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and pristine with clean legs in the glass.

  • Aroma: Clean, soft, and subtle, opening with delicate notes of sweet grain, fresh cream, a touch of citrus zest, and a light aniseed minerality.

  • Palate: Exceptionally smooth, rounded, and clean on the entry. Upfront flavors of sweet cereal grain, light marshmallow, and vanilla bean give way to subtle crack of white pepper and a gentle, refreshing stone minerality.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a remarkably soft, creamy, and velvety mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Crisp, long, and clean, trailing off with lingering grain sweetness, subtle creaminess, and a warm, refreshing pepper finish without harsh heat.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Jackson Triggs Merlot Reserve Winemaker Series - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley, specifically within the Okanagan Valley VQA appellation, Jackson Triggs Reserve Select Winemaker Series Merlot represents an approachable, generous, and fruit-forward expression of Canadian red winemaking. Founded in 1993 by Allan Jackson and Don Triggs, the winery has grown to become one of the cornerstone estates of Canadian viticulture, celebrated for producing accessible, varietally expressive VQA wines. The grapes for the Reserve Select series are sourced from prime sun-exposed benchlands across the South and Central Okanagan, where well-draining glaciolacustrine sandy loam and gravelly soils allow Merlot vines to thrive under high sunshine hours. In the cellar, the winemaking philosophy centres on gentle de-stemming, stainless steel fermentation with temperature-controlled skin contact to extract vibrant color and soft tannins, followed by maturation in a combination of French and American oak casks for 8 to 12 months. The result is a round, smooth, and crowd-pleasing red wine that balances plush dark fruit generosity, subtle sweet baking spices, and balanced cool-climate freshness.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear medium-to-deep ruby red colour with garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe black plum, dark cherry, blackberry jam, and blueberry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of dried herbs, cocoa powder, vanilla bean, subtle tobacco leaf, and warm oak pastry spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of dark stone fruits, ripe boysenberry, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by supple, rounded tannins and a soft, approachable mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering plum, milk chocolate, and subtle toasted oak spice. Composed predominantly of Merlot, this release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2 to 5 years from release. Stylistically, it combines Okanagan sun-ripened fruit richness, velvety mouthfeel, and everyday food friendliness.

title: La Crema Chardonnay Sonoma - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This bold and graceful white wine originates from the United States, specifically within the California region and the premier cool-climate Sonoma Coast subregion. Established in 1979 as La Crema Viñera, meaning 'best of the vine', the winery has spent over 40 years exploring the finest cool-climate regions to craft elegant, Burgundian-style wines. The winemaking philosophy centres on small-lot production and gentle handling, utilizing time-intensive techniques to ensure consistently distinct and naturally balanced bottles.

Wine Description

La Crema Sonoma Coast Chardonnay 2024 presents a brilliant appearance. The sensory profile is layered and complex, featuring an aromatic nose of Meyer lemon, pear, and white flowers, which are supported by subtle hints of oak. On the palate, the wine is fleshy, vibrant, and concentrated, showcasing flavours of crisp apple, golden peach, and pineapple, while notes of graham cracker pie crust add a distinctive vein of richness. It is a medium-bodied wine defined by juicy yet balanced acidity that drives a lingering finish. This 100% Chardonnay typically reaches an ABV of approximately 13.5%. As a leader in sustainable viticulture, La Crema's estate vineyards are CCSW (Certified California Sustainable Winegrowing) and SIP (Sustainability In Practice) certified, though this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Treana Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 (Austin Hope Winery) - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Treana is your quintessential Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon.  From the depth of color and intense nose, this wine is made with structure and purpose.  On the palate, flavors of beautiful rich blackberry, warm vanilla, toasted coffee and black cherry are finished with firm but refined tannins.

title: Luce Della Vite 2020 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Toscana IGT in Montalcino, Tenuta Luce Luce 2020 Magnum 1500 ml represents a pioneering, prestigious, and internationally celebrated Super Tuscan blend presented in an age-worthy large format. Conceived in the early 1990s as a historic collaborative venture between Vittorio Frescobaldi and Robert Mondavi, Tenuta Luce was established to combine the structural elegance of Montalcino Sangiovese with the plush, rounded generosity of French Merlot. Located southwest of Montalcino, the estate spans elevated, sun-drenched slopes ranging between 350 and 420 metres above sea level. The terroir features a diverse geological mosaic: higher parcels are rich in schistose galestro and well-drained sandstone where Sangiovese thrives, while lower, clay-rich sections provide the ideal moisture and nutrient retention for Merlot. Under the direction of the Frescobaldi family and winemaker Alessandro Marini, the fruit is harvested manually parcel by parcel, optically sorted, and fermented in temperature-controlled concrete vats with indigenous yeasts. Maturation takes place over 24 months in French oak barriques (approximately 80% to 85% new oak). Bottled in a 1.5-litre magnum format, this cuvée offers exceptional cellar potential, allowing its deep core of dark fruit and supple structural tannins to mature gracefully over decades.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, deep ruby red colour with intense violet and garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe black cherry, wild blackberry, dark plum compote, and cassis, interwoven with sophisticated notes of dried Mediterranean scrub, crushed violet petals, dark cocoa, tobacco leaf, graphite minerality, and warm French oak cedar spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of black stone fruits, dark berries, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by muscular, fine-grained structural tannins and a dense, seamlessly layered mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark fruit, roasted espresso bean, and a clean, stony mineral grip. Composed of an almost equal blend of Merlot and Sangiovese, this 2020 magnum release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2026–2045+. Stylistically, it combines Tuscan sun-ripened warmth, opulent modern texture, and aristocratic Montalcino structure.

title: Tomatin 36 Year Old
bodyHtml:
This rare Highland single malt Scotch whisky originates from the Monadhliath Mountains just south of Inverness, produced at the Tomatin Distillery (established in 1897). First introduced to the distillery's core Prestige range in 2015, Tomatin 36 Year Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky is crafted from unpeated Scottish barley and soft Highland spring water drawn from the Alt-na-Frith burn. The whisky is drawn from an assemblage of spirits aged for well over three and a half decades in a balanced combination of charred American oak ex-bourbon casks and traditional Spanish first-fill Oloroso sherry butts. Released in strictly limited, numbered small batches (typically around 800 to 1,200 bottles per batch worldwide), it is bottled in a premium bespoke bottle housed in a wooden presentation case, completely free of chill-filtration or added caramel coloring.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a deep, radiant polished-copper and golden-amber hue, forming thick, slow-creeping tears along the glass. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic, complex, and layered with antique warehouse character: vibrant aromas of tropical fruits, dried apricots, ripe passionfruit, and candied citrus peel emerge first, followed by rich layers of raw heather honey, ginger snaps, butterscotch, and warm Oloroso walnut cake. On the palate, it delivers a remarkably silky, unctuous, and coating mouthfeel. Waves of sweet poached pears, dried mango, and Seville orange marmalade glide across the tongue, counterbalanced by mid-palate notes of dark chocolate, roasted chestnuts, warm clove, cardamom, and gentle antique cedar wood spice. The finish is exceptionally long, elegant, and warming, trailing off with impressions of dried stone fruits, beeswax, dark cocoa, soft licorice, and a delicate, lingering winter oak spice.

Accolades Tomatin 36 Year Old stands among the most decorated ultra-aged single malts in modern Scotch whisky competitions. It reached global acclaim at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition, where it was awarded Double Gold and crowned Best in Show / Best Single Malt Scotch (as well as Best Scotch overall). Critics and judges across Whisky Advocate and international tasting panels routinely rate it 94+ points, commending its exceptional balance: while many whiskies aged beyond 35 years become overly tannic or oak-dominant, this release preserves Tomatin's signature bright, tropical ester fruit profile alongside the nutty depth of first-fill sherry wood.

title: Tignanello 2023 (by Tenuta Tignanello) - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Tignanello originates from Italy, within the Tuscany region and the heart of the Chianti Classico zone between the Greve and Pesa river valleys. Produced by the historic Marchesi Antinori family, Tignanello is celebrated as the pioneer of the "Super Tuscan" revolution. First created in 1970 as a single-vineyard Chianti Classico Riserva, Piero Antinori and legendary oenologist Giacomo Tachis redefined Italian winemaking in 1971 by removing white grape varieties, incorporating non-indigenous Bordeaux grapes (Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc), and aging the wine in small French oak barrels (barriques). Harvested from a 57-hectare southwest-facing single vineyard characterized by limestone and marl soils (albarese and galestro), Tignanello’s philosophy centers on bridging Tuscan Sangiovese typicity with modern French structure and refined elegance.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep, intense ruby-purple appearance in the glass, developing subtle garnet reflections near the rim as it matures. It possesses a full-bodied, complex, and muscular structure defined by a silky, mouth-coating, and supple texture balanced by a firm mineral backbone. The sensory profile is highly expressive and multi-layered, opening with a bold bouquet of ripe black cherries, red currants, and dark plums, seamlessly integrated with notes of dried violets, tobacco leaf, espresso beans, dark chocolate, graphite, and subtle sweet baking spices. On the expansive palate, it delivers a concentrated core of red and dark berry fruit, supported by fine-grained, noble tannins and a vibrant thread of natural acidity. The finish is remarkably long, structured, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of cocoa, licorice, and savory herbs.

title: Gaja Etna Bianco 'Idda' 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Sicily region, specifically within the Sicilia DOC appellation on the slopes of Mount Etna, Gaja Etna Bianco 'Idda' 2025 represents an extraordinary, mineral driven joint venture between Piedmont’s iconic Gaja family and renowned Sicilian winemaker Alberto Graci. The name 'Idda' means 'She' in the Sicilian dialect, paying local homage to Mount Etna itself. Sourced from high-altitude volcanic vineyards situated at 600 to 800 metres above sea level in Belpasso and Biancavilla on the southern slopes of the volcano, the vines grow on basaltic, ash-rich volcanic soils. The winemaking philosophy combines gentle whole-cluster pressing, temperature-controlled fermentation, and maturation in a combination of oak casks and stainless steel tanks for approximately 12 months. The result is a refined white wine that seamlessly highlights the intense volcanic minerality and crisp salinity of indigenous Sicilian varietals.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale straw yellow colour with bright greenish-gold reflections along the rim. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with enticing aromas of ripe Meyer lemon, white peach, crushed flint, and grapefruit zest, interwoven with noble notes of orange blossom, dried Mediterranean herbs, sea spray, and a subtle touch of toasted almond. On the palate, it is medium bodied, precise, and taut, delivering concentrated flavours of citrus curd, green apple, and volcanic ash, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a textured, satiny mid-palate derived from fine lees contact, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon peel, savory salinity, and a clean mineral grip. Composed primarily of Carricante blended with a small proportion of Riesling, this 2025 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2037. Stylistically, it combines high-altitude freshness and laser-like precision with Gaja's hallmark weight, elegance, and balance.h, citrus peel, honey, lime juice and white flowers to be found, ending with a gentle stoniness.

title: Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Rosso di Montalcino 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Rosso di Montalcino DOCG appellation, Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Rosso di Montalcino 2024 represents a vibrant, elegant, and approachable expression of Sangiovese. Acquired by the historic Gaja family in 1994, the Pieve Santa Restituta estate spans 27 hectares in the southwestern sub-zone of Montalcino, an area renowned for its gentle breezes, sunny exposures, and rocky clay-limestone soils. While celebrated for its flagship Brunellos, the estate crafts this Rosso di Montalcino from younger vines and select parcels to offer immediate pleasure and varietal purity. Under fifth-generation family leadership, the winemaking philosophy incorporates careful temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel followed by 12 months of maturation in neutral oak casks and concrete vats. The result is a luminous, pure Sangiovese that marries Tuscan sunshine, bright mineral drive, and Gaja's signature winemaking refinement.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear ruby red colour with soft garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of fresh red cherry, wild raspberry, red plum, and cranberry, interwoven with delicate notes of dried rose petals, wild thyme, orange peel, leather, and subtle Mediterranean scrub. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of bright red fruit, blood orange zest, and chalky mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine-grained, supple tannins and a sleek mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red berries, subtle spice, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed of 100% Sangiovese, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2032. Stylistically, it combines fresh Tuscan charm, youthful energy, and effortless food friendliness.

title: Gaja Idda Etna Rosso 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Sicily region, specifically within the Etna Rosso DOC appellation in eastern Sicily, Gaja Idda Etna Rosso 2024 represents an elegant, mineral-driven, and distinctive expression of volcanic winemaking. Idda—meaning 'she' in the Sicilian dialect, referring to Mount Etna itself—is a joint venture established in 2016 between two legendary winemaking families: Angelo Gaja of Piedmont and Alberto Graci of Etna. The estate's vineyards are located on the southern slopes of Mount Etna in the villages of Biancavilla and Belpasso, situated at high elevations between 600 and 800 metres above sea level. The vines grow in complex volcanic soils composed of ancient lava flows, basalt gravel, and ash. Under the joint direction of the Gaja and Graci families, the winemaking philosophy incorporates gentle temperature-controlled fermentation in oak vats and concrete, followed by 12 to 15 months of maturation in large oak casks (botti) and concrete. The result is a luminous, perfumed red wine that combines Mount Etna's signature volcanic minerality with Gaja's trademark polish and structural elegance.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous translucent ruby red colour with soft wild-rose highlights along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of wild red cherry, wild strawberry, red currant, and pomegranate, interwoven with sophisticated notes of Mediterranean scrub, dried thyme, blood orange peel, crushed volcanic rock, and subtle smoke. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of crisp red fruit, citrus zest, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural high-elevation acidity. Framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins and a seamless mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red berries, savory herbs, and a clean basaltic mineral grip. Composed primarily of Nerello Mascalese with a small proportion of Nerello Cappuccio, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2036. Stylistically, it effortlessly marries volcanic tension, refined red fruit aromatics, and Burgundian-like elegance.

title: Gaja Rossj Bass Langhe Bianco 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Piedmont region, specifically within the Langhe DOC appellation, Gaja 'Rossj Bass' Langhe Bianco 2025 represents an elegant, aromatic, and refined expression of Italian white winemaking. Crafted by the iconic Gaja family, 'Rossj Bass' takes its name from Angelo Gaja’s youngest daughter, Rossana (Rossj), and the lower elevation vineyard plot (bass) in Barbaresco where the original parcel was cultivated. Sourced from choice estate vineyards in Barbaresco and Serralunga d'Alba planted on steep limestone and clay-marl soils, the winemaking philosophy combines whole-cluster pressing, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel, and a brief maturation in oak barriques for approximately 6 to 7 months. The result is a vibrant, sophisticated white wine that bridges the rich texture of Chardonnay with the aromatic lift of Sauvignon Blanc and distinct Piedmontese mineral precision.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale straw yellow colour with bright greenish-gold reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with inviting aromas of ripe citrus, green apple, white peach, and nectarine, interwoven with sophisticated notes of white blossoms, lemongrass, wild herbs, crushed limestone, and a subtle touch of toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silky, and crisp, delivering generous flavours of citrus zest, orchard fruit, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a smooth, satiny texture derived from controlled lees contact and a dynamic mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon peel, fresh floral notes, and a clean mineral grip. Composed primarily of Chardonnay blended with a small proportion of Sauvignon Blanc, this 2025 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2036. Stylistically, it combines brilliant freshness and floral aromatics with Gaja's benchmark weight, purity, and balance.

title: Glenmorangie Signet Reserve
bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie Signet Reserve is an ultra-prestige single malt Scotch whisky produced by The Glenmorangie Distillery in Tain, Ross-shire, Northern Highlands (Moët Hennessy). Building on the iconic legacy of the original Glenmorangie Signet celebrated for its revolutionary use of heavily roasted "chocolate malt" Signet Reserve represents a heightened, deeper, and more mature evolution of this pioneering recipe. Created under the direction of Glenmorangie’s Director of Whisky Creation, Dr. Bill Lumsden, Signet Reserve spends extended time finishing in specially selected Pedro Ximénez (PX) sherry casks, layering luscious dark sweetness, espresso complexity, and intense dark chocolate depth over the signature malt profile.

Spirit Description

Signet Reserve’s mash bill features Glenmorangie’s proprietary high-roast chocolate malted barley, malted once a year to unlock roasted coffee and rich cacao aromatics. Distilled in Glenmorangie’s famous 16-foot-tall copper pot stills (the tallest in Scotland), the delicate, ester-rich spirit matures in bespoke toasted American virgin oak barrels alongside aged ex-bourbon casks. For the Reserve release, Dr. Lumsden selected parcels of this aged liquid for an extended secondary maturation in rich Pedro Ximénez sherry casks, imparting an unctuous, syrupy dark-fruit richness.

  • Colour: Deep burnished copper and dark amber with rich mahogany reflections.

  • Aroma: Intensely aromatic, opulent, and dessert-like. Opens with bold roasted espresso, tiramisu, and 85% dark chocolate, layered with candied orange peel, PX sherry-soaked raisins, roasted hazelnuts, and warm baking spices (cinnamon, clove, and nutmeg).

  • Palate: Luxuriously rich, velvety, and multi-dimensional on the entry. Deep mocha and bitter dark cocoa meld into sweet black cherries, dried figs, and toffee, followed by gentle leather, toasted oak, and sweet tobacco notes.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a heavy, coating, and viscous mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long, warm, and decadent, trailing off with persistent roasted coffee bean, dark chocolate truffles, dried fruit sweetness, and lingering oak spices.

  • ABV: Bottled at 46% ABV, non-chill filtered.

title: Casa Ferreirinha Papa Figos Douro 2022
bodyHtml: Nice blackberry-blueberry notes with spicy black fruits, pepper; Juicy, medium body with good grip and tart acidity. Cool little wine with pure fruit.

title: Mate Brunello di Montalcino 2020
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Brilliant, flint ruby red. Earthy hints initially on the nose, carried by fine tea, plus resinous tones, again candied raspberry and rosehip, very seductive. On the palate polished and with a creamy fruit core, spreads excitingly, beautiful harmony, balanced, drinks very well, excellent success.

title: La Crema Chardonnay Sonoma 2024
bodyHtml:
This bold and graceful white wine originates from the United States, specifically within the California region and the premier cool-climate Sonoma Coast subregion. Established in 1979 as La Crema Viñera, meaning 'best of the vine', the winery has spent over 40 years exploring the finest cool-climate regions to craft elegant, Burgundian-style wines. The winemaking philosophy centres on small-lot production and gentle handling, utilizing time-intensive techniques to ensure consistently distinct and naturally balanced bottles.

Wine Description

La Crema Sonoma Coast Chardonnay presents a brilliant appearance. The sensory profile is layered and complex, featuring an aromatic nose of Meyer lemon, pear, and white flowers, which are supported by subtle hints of oak. On the palate, the wine is fleshy, vibrant, and concentrated, showcasing flavours of crisp apple, golden peach, and pineapple, while notes of graham cracker pie crust add a distinctive vein of richness. It is a medium-bodied wine defined by juicy yet balanced acidity that drives a lingering finish.

title: Monsanto Chianti Classico 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Italy, within Tuscany's Chianti Classico region and the subregion of San Donato in Poggio. Castello di Monsanto was acquired by Aldo Bianchi in 1961, and the winery quickly became a pioneer in the region by creating one of Chianti Classico's first single-vineyard bottlings. Led by the Bianchi family, the winery's philosophy emphasizes a strong belief in Sangiovese, using traditional vinification and aging techniques to express the rich galestro soils of the estate.

Wine Description

This bright ruby red wine opens with classic aromas of wild red cherry, dark plum, and violet, complemented by hints of cedar, tobacco leaf, and subtle spice. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with savory complexity, fine-grained tannins, and a crisp, mouthwatering acidity. The finish is long, dry, and mineral-driven. The varietal composition is a traditional blend of 90% Sangiovese with 10% Canaiolo and Colorino. It has an alcohol content of 14% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: El Tequileno Gift Pack - 2 Bottles
bodyHtml:
The El Tequileno dual pack is the perfect combination for those that wish to have a choice when it comes to enjoying their tequila. Sip and savour or enjoy in your favourite cocktails. These tequilas suit every occasion.  

Includes: One 375 mL Bottle of El Tequileno Platinum Blanco and One 375 mL Bottle of El Tequileno Reposado Gran Reserva.

title: Mezcal de Leyendas Tobala
bodyHtml:
Mezcal de Leyendas Tobala from mezcalero Aarón Robles is produced using 100% Maguey Tobala (Agave potatorum) in San Pedro Totolapam, Oaxaca.

This limited release has aromas of honey and light smoke; on the palate are complex notes with sweet undertones.

title: Domaine Seguin Manuel Beaune 'Champimonts' Premier Cru 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Beaune Premier Cru appellation in the Cote de Beaune, Domaine Seguin Manuel Beaune Champimonts Premier Cru represents a refined, expressive, and deeply historic expression of Pinot Noir. Founded in 1824, Domaine Seguin Manuel underwent a major resurgence under Thibaut Marion, who restored the estate's commitment to organic viticulture and traditional Burgundian winemaking. Sourced from the acclaimed Premier Cru vineyard Champimonts—situated on steep, east-facing mid-slopes with rich limestone and gravel soils—the winemaking philosophy focuses on certified organic farming, hand harvesting, minimal intervention, native yeast fermentation, and barrel aging in French oak (approximately 25% to 30% new) to craft a wine of energetic mineral tension, supple structure, and long cellaring capability.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, deep ruby red colour with vibrant garnet highlights in the glass. An inviting, highly aromatic bouquet opens with generous notes of red cherry, wild raspberry, and ripe red plum, interwoven with delicate nuances of violet, damp forest floor, sweet spices, and fine limestone minerality. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silky, and well balanced, delivering vibrant flavours of red berries and dark cherries anchored by a fresh, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine-grained, velvety Premier Cru tannins and an elegant mid-palate, it concludes with a long, harmonious finish marked by lingering notes of sweet red fruit and subtle earthy spice. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it effortlessly marries classic Beaune generosity and floral charm with Premier Cru finesse and age-worthy elegance.

title: Cesar Marquez Perez 'Parajes' 2023
bodyHtml:
Cesar Marquez Perez, a rising star in the Bierzo wine region of Spain, comes from a family with deep roots in winemaking dating back to 1752. Focusing on micro-vinifications of old-vine Mencia and Godello from small plots known as "parajes," he emphasizes the unique terroir of each vineyard.

  • Tasting Notes: This red wine offers aromas of fresh red and black fruits, complemented by subtle floral and spicy notes. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with balanced acidity, presenting flavors of ripe berries, hints of herbs, and a touch of minerality, leading to a smooth, elegant finish.

  • Serving Suggestions: Pairs well with grilled meats, roasted vegetables, and aged cheeses.

  • Winemaking: 'Parajes' is crafted from a blend of 85% Mencia, 7% Alicante Bouschet, and 8% other local white and red varieties. The grapes are hand-harvested from vines over 100 years old, situated at altitudes between 460 and 750 meters across seven villages in Bierzo. Fermentation occurs spontaneously with native yeasts, incorporating approximately 50% whole clusters. The wine is then aged for 12 months in a combination of 225 and 500-liter barrels before bottling.

This wine reflects the authenticity and complexity of the Bierzo region, showcasing Cesar Marquez Perez's dedication to traditional winemaking techniques and terroir expression.

title: CVNE Monopole Blanco Seco 2023
bodyHtml: A super crisp, fresh and unoaked style of white Rioja from on of the leading producers.

title: Margaux du Chateau Margaux 2018
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Bordeaux, France, Margaux du Château Margaux is produced in the esteemed Margaux appellation within the Médoc region. Château Margaux, a Premier Grand Cru Classé estate, has been owned by the Mentzelopoulos family since 1977. The winery is renowned for its commitment to elegance and excellence, crafting wines that honour centuries of viticultural heritage and innovation.

Wine Description
The 2018 Margaux du Château Margaux reveals a deep ruby hue, opening with a generous bouquet of ripe red fruits, warm spice, and subtle floral notes. On the palate, it is silky and supple, with polished tannins supporting flavours of raspberry, plum, and a touch of sweet oak. This wine displays medium to full body, balanced freshness, and a harmonious finish that lingers with finesse. It is composed primarily of Cabernet Sauvignon, complemented by Merlot and other Bordeaux varietals. While immediately appealing in its youth, this wine will continue to evolve gracefully over the next 5 to 10 years.

Accolades
Vinous – 91 points.

Food Pairing
Ideal pairings include roast lamb with herbs, grilled beef tenderloin, or duck breast with a red wine reduction. These dishes bring out the wine’s refined texture and layered complexity. A perfect match to enhance the wine's depth and elegance.

title: Domaine des Garriguettes Cotes Du Rhone Blanc 'Fleur De Lune'
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

In the glass, the Fleur de Lune Blanc displays a brilliant, pale golden-straw hue. On the nose, it offers a fragrant, highly expressive bouquet featuring ripe yellow pear, white peach, sliced pineapple, and white floral blossoms, accompanied by subtle hints of honeycomb and fennel.

On the palate, this blend typically consists of 50% Clairette, 30–40% Grenache Blanc, and 10–20% Viognier. The palate strikes an extraordinary balance between fleshy stone fruit and crisp, mouthwatering acidity. Natural low-temperature vinification without synthetic inputs preserves pure varietal fruit, while maturation on fine lees in concrete tanks (90%) and large neutral demi-muid oak casks (10%) provides subtle weight and texture without heavy wood notes. The finish is clean, saline, and refreshing.

title: Borgo Paglianetto Terravignata Verdicchio di Matelica 2024
bodyHtml:
Pagliano Vineyard located in the heart of the winery, it is a 20-years-old vineyard covering almost 20h at an average altitude of 350 meters above sea-level, facing south west. Soils are mainly clay-calcareous.

Pale straw-yellow with delicate floral and apple aromas and a hint of almond and herbs. Fresh and crisp on the palate with exceptional balance.

title: Tool Shed House Lager - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Produced in Canada, Tool Shed House Lager originates from Calgary, Alberta. The story of Tool Shed Brewing Company began in 2012 in a backyard tool shed, driven by co-founders Graham Sherman and Jeff Wood, whose IT and military communications backgrounds fueled a passion for precision craft brewing. After successfully lobbying to rewrite Alberta's outdated liquor laws, they helped ignite the province's craft beer revolution, scaling from their humble backyard beginnings to a massive 22,000-square-foot commercial brewing operation.

Beer Description

This crisp American-style lager features an alcohol by volume (ABV) of 4.7%. Visually, it pours a pale gold with a clean, frothy white head. The aromatic profile is light and approachable, showing subtle aromas of grain and faint malt sweetness. On the palate, this medium to light bodied brew delivers a highly refreshing, clean fermentation profile with very low bitterness and a crisp, snappy finish. Formatted as a hefty 50 Litre keg, this format is engineered for high volume freshness and structural delivery, containing roughly 140 standard pints of clean-drinking draft beer.

title: Cardinale Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California, specifically within the Napa Valley AVA, Cardinale Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 represents a monumental, mountain-driven, and masterfully blended prestige cuvée. Produced by Jackson Family Wines and situated along the Oakville Cross Road, Cardinale is dedicated to crafting a singular Cabernet Sauvignon that captures the essence of Napa Valley’s high-altitude appellations. The wine is sourced from premier mountain parcels across Diamond Mountain, Howell Mountain, Mount Veeder, and Spring Mountain, supplemented by a touch of valley-floor fruit from Stags Leap District and Oakville to provide seamless flesh and textural harmony. These steep, rugged hillside vineyards feature shallow, gravelly, and volcanic soils that naturally restrict yields and produce intensely concentrated berries. Under the helm of veteran winemaker Christopher Carpenter, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes gentle manual harvesting, parcel-by-parcel berry sorting, and lot-specific fermentation in open-top stainless steel and French oak fermenters. Maturation occurs over 20 to 22 months in fine-grained French oak barrels (approximately 80% to 85% new oak). The result is a profound, multifaceted Napa Cabernet Sauvignon celebrated for its architectural structure, brooding mineral tension, and multi-decade cellar stamina.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, deep opaque ruby-purple colour with vibrant violet and garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of crème de cassis, wild blackberry, dark boysenberry, and ripe black plum, interwoven with sophisticated notes of graphite, crushed volcanic rock minerality, espresso roast, dark cocoa, subtle dried sage, and warm French oak cedar spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of black fruits, licorice, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate mountain acidity. Framed by muscular, fine-grained structural tannins and a dense, multidimensional mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark berries, unsweetened chocolate, and a clean, graphite-like mineral grip. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon alongside a small proportion of Merlot, this 2021 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2027–2050+. Stylistically, it combines high-elevation mountain power, seamless textural luxury, and sovereign cellar endurance.

title: Casanova Di Neri Brunello 'Tenuta Nuova' 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This concentrated and 'monumental' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation in Tuscany. Founded in 1971 by Giovanni Neri, the estate was born from a vision to produce exceptional Sangiovese in the then-remote region of Montalcino. Today, Giacomo Neri and his sons continue this legacy, managing approximately 63 hectares across seven distinct sites. The 'Tenuta Nuova' label is a modern legend, specifically conceived by Giacomo Neri to find a southern terroir in Castelnuovo dell'Abate that could yield a uniquely powerful and complex expression of Brunello.

Wine Description

The 2021 Casanova di Neri Tenuta Nuova presents a deep, brilliant appearance and a full-bodied sensory profile defined by its 'seductive energy'. The nose is an intense spice box featuring aromas of crushed roses, incense, and spiced orange peels, layered with notes of blackberry, rosemary, and herbal tea. On the palate, the wine is massive yet remarkably 'weightless', showcasing a dense and saline core of dark fruit flavours paired with a subtle vein of salt. It is characterized by its velvety, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity that creates a 'saturating tension'. The finish is exceptionally long and fragrant, lingering with vivid sour cherry and savory spices. This 100% Sangiovese reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and was aged for 30 months in oak tonneaux followed by at least six months in the bottle. While the winery utilizes natural processes and low-impact design, this bottling is not certified organic.

Accolades

Vinous 96 Points - "The 2021 Brunello di Montalcino Giovanni Neri is a total spice box on the nose, with crushed roses, spiced orange peels, incense, raspberry, herbal tea leaves and hints of mint. More lifted and energetic than expected, it displays grace and youthful poise with mineral-inflected wild berry fruits. Vivid sour cherry lingers incredibly long through the finish as fine-grained tannins frame the experience and a bump of residual acidity keeps the mouth watering for more."

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Montalcino is regarded as a potential 'modern classic', awarded a five-star rating for its exceptional harmony and vibrant acidity. While spring frosts initially reduced yields, a remarkably even growing season allowed for a slow ripening that produced fruit with immense concentration and 'verticality'. Winemakers successfully adapted to the season's warmth by utilizing the estate's high-quality vineyard management, resulting in wines that capture the hedonistic depth of the site while maintaining a fresh, lively counterpoint.

title: Misc Cabernet Sauvignon Oakville
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, M. Étain is a distinguished Cabernet Sauvignon from the Rutherford appellation within the Napa Valley. The wine is crafted by the renowned Scarecrow winery at the historic J.J. Cohn Estate, a property with a fabled past dating back to 1945 when J.J. Cohn, a legendary MGM executive, was convinced to plant Cabernet vines. Today, the estate is celebrated for its 'Old Men' vines—some of the oldest in the valley—and a winemaking philosophy led by Celia Welch that emphasizes the pure, unadulterated expression of this exceptional terroir.

Wine Description

M. Étain displays a deep ruby appearance and opens with a complex, pronounced aromatic profile of black cherry, blueberry, and sage, layered with notes of lavender, tobacco, and a hint of caramel. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and luxurious, featuring a fresh, juicy core of bright fruit flavors like raspberry and cassis that dominate the entry.

title: Le Vieux Pin Red Blend 'Retouche'
bodyHtml:
Le Vieux Pin is situated in Oliver, within the Okanagan Valley of Canada. This winery is dedicated to capturing the essence of traditional French winemaking while embracing the unique fruit character of the New World. Their philosophy focuses on producing elegant, focused, and intense wines that pay homage to the great wine personalities of France.

Wine Description

'Retouche' pays homage to the 19th-century Bordeaux practice of ‘Hermitaging’, where winemakers added Syrah to their blends to provide warmth and roundness. This wine is typically a blend of Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Syrah.

The sensory profile is complex and powerful, featuring a deep garnet colour. On the nose, it offers a melange of dark fruits such as blackberry, cassis, and plum, interwoven with savory notes of cigar box, grilled bell pepper, and earthy undertones.

title: Le Vieux Pin White Blend 'Petit Blanc' 2025
bodyHtml:
Le Vieux Pin is situated on the famed Black Sage Bench in Oliver, within the south Okanagan Valley, British Columbia. Named after a solitary old-growth pine on their estate, the winery draws inspiration from traditional French winemaking while respecting the unique 'pocket desert' terroir of Canada. Under the guidance of winemaker Severine Pinte, the estate focuses on creating elegant, terroir-driven wines that balance New World fruit with Old World structure and finesse.

Wine Description

The 'Petit Blanc' is a vibrant white blend typically composed of Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Gris, and Muscat. In the glass, it presents a clear, pale straw colour. The aromatic profile is intense and fragrant, offering notes of green citrus fruit, gooseberries, and stone fruit, complemented by a touch of tropical fruit and floral undertones.

title: Chateau Carbonnieux Pessac-Leognan Bordeaux Blanc
bodyHtml:
This distinguished white wine hails from the Pessac Leognan appellation in France. Founded in the 13th century by Benedictine monks, Chateau Carbonnieux is one of the oldest estates in Bordeaux and was notably visited by Thomas Jefferson in the late 1700s. Today, the property is owned by the Perrin family, who have maintained its status as a Grand Cru Classé while focusing on a winemaking philosophy that emphasizes the unique gravelly terroir to produce what many consider the benchmark for dry white Bordeaux.

Wine Description

The Chateau Carbonnieux Blanc presents a bright, shimmering appearance with green highlights. The aromatic profile is intense and elegant, featuring a complex bouquet of lemon oil, grapefruit, white peach, and jasmine, accented by subtle hints of honeysuckle and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with a satiny texture, offering a vibrant core of citrus and pear flavors balanced by a zesty, mineral-driven acidity. The finish is long and refreshing, often revealing a distinctive saline or 'fleur de sel' edge.

title: Domaine Dujac Fils & Pere Morey Saint Denis 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Morey Saint Denis AOC appellation in the Côte de Nuits, Dujac Fils et Père Morey Saint Denis 2023 represents an elegant, perfumed, and masterfully crafted expression of village-level Pinot Noir. Established in 2000 by the Seysses family of the iconic Domaine Dujac, the Dujac Fils et Père négociant label was created to source premium fruit from trusted grower partners while applying the exact same artisanal viticultural standards and cellar methodology as the domaine holdings. Situated in the heart of the Côte de Nuits between Gevrey Chambertin and Chambolle Musigny, the vineyards of Morey Saint Denis occupy well-drained, mid-slope terroirs characterized by Jurassic limestone bedrock overlaid with brown clay, marl, and fossil-rich scree. Led by Jeremy, Alec, and Diana Seysses, the winemaking philosophy embraces whole-cluster fermentation (typically around 65% to 85% stems depending on vintage conditions) with indigenous ambient yeasts, gentle punch-downs, and aging for 12 to 14 months in fine French oak casks (approximately 20% to 30% new oak) with minimal racking and no fining or filtration. The result is a vibrant, seamless red Burgundy that captures Morey's signature blend of structural depth, savory spice, and lifted floral aromatics.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear medium ruby red colour with vivid crimson-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe red cherry, wild strawberry, dark raspberry, and red currant compote, interwoven with sophisticated notes of fresh rose petal, crushed limestone minerality, forest floor, whole-cluster stem spice, orange peel, and warm French oak cedar spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of crisp red fruits, tart dark plum, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins and an elegantly chiseled mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red berries, dried wild herbs, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2023 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2026–2038+. Stylistically, it combines Dujac's benchmark whole-bunch aromatic complexity, pure fruit transparency, and authentic Côte de Nuits mineral poise.

title: Ippolito 160 Anni Rosso 2021
bodyHtml:
Ippolito 160 Anni Rosso originates from the sun-drenched region of Calabria in southern Italy. Founded in 1845, Ippolito 1845 stands as Calabria's oldest active winery and is currently managed by its fifth generation. The estate is deeply committed to preserving the region's viticultural heritage, blending modern cellar technologies with sustainable practices to champion native grape varieties.

Wine Description

Crafted from 100% Gaglioppo, this wine is produced using air-dried grapes that undergo an extended maceration on the skins to enhance its concentration and structural depth. It presents a vibrant ruby colour in the glass, unfolding with fragrant aromas of ripe berries, violets, raisins, and sweet kitchen spices. The palate is full-bodied, complex, and beautifully structured, showing an intriguing roundness, soft tannins, and a pleasantly persistent finish.

title: Dr. H Thanisch Pinot Noir Grosses Gewachs 2018
bodyHtml:
This Grosses Gewächs (Great Growth) Pinot Noir hails from Germany, specifically the Mosel region, from the steep, slate-rich hillsides around the village of Lieser.

The history of the Thanisch family's winemaking tradition is traceable back to 1636. The estate, officially named Weingut Wwe. Dr. H. Thanisch – Erben Müller-Burggraef, owes its distinguished name to Dr. Hugo Thanisch, who greatly raised the winery's international profile in the mid-19th century, and his widow (Witwe), who took the helm after his untimely passing. The winery’s philosophy is deeply rooted in sustainability and ecological work, focusing on careful cultivation of low-yield, top-quality grapes to achieve physiological ripeness that guarantees fully mature, complex aromas in the wine.

Wine Description

  • Colour: A bright, translucent garnet with subtle, evolving brown reflections on the rim, indicating a degree of elegant maturity.

  • Aroma: The nose is complex and ripe, offering layers of cherry, wild berries, rose petals, sweet cherry, and a savoury, ethereal mix of sage and juniper berries, complemented by notes of damp earth and underbrush.

  • Palate: The palate is dry and elegant, with finely melted tannins that are powerful yet integrated. Flavours of red and dark fruit carry through, balanced by a distinct balsamic savouriness and a vivid, carrying acidity. The structure is elegant with a deep, persistent length.

  • Body & Finish: Voluminous body, yet retaining freshness and a linear tension. The finish is long, complex, and driven by the interplay of fruit, acid, and fine tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: Spätburgunder (Pinot Noir).

  • Optimal Drinking Window: While mature and expressive now, this wine possesses the structure and acid to evolve beautifully through 2045.

  • Stylistic Notes: This is a profoundly individual and balanced dry German red, achieving an impressive tension between the warmth of the vintage and the cool-climate-driven structure.

  • Organic: Conventional production methods are used, but the winery is committed to sustainable and ecological viticulture.

title: Rowen Sonoma County Red Blend 2017
bodyHtml:
This red blend originates from the United States, specifically from Sonoma County, California. The ROWEN Wine Company's philosophy is a study in Sonoma County terroir, creating wines that are unbound by tradition yet grounded in the history of the land. The wine is sourced from the Cooley Ranch Vineyard in northeastern Sonoma County, a high-elevation site with volcanic-based soil and elevations ranging from 500 to 2,040 feet.

Wine Description

The aroma profile offers dark cherries, blackberries, and sweet toasted oak. Other aromatic notes include black raspberries, cocoa, black pepper, pencil shavings, dried herbs, blackcurrants, charcuterie, and tobacco leaf with red fruit touches. On the palate, you will find notes of juicy cassis, sweet vanilla, light floral elements, nutmeg, and layers of cherry and cola. 

Food Pairing

This rich, full-bodied red blend pairs beautifully with sharp cheeses and charcuterie. For main courses, suggested pairings include grilled filet mignon, braised lamb shanks, beef, lamb, veal, or poultry.

title: Poli Grappa Sassicaia - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Poli Grappa Sassicaia is a prestigious artisanal spirit from Italy, representing a unique collaboration between the Poli Distillerie in the Veneto region and the renowned Tenuta San Guido estate in Bolgheri, Tuscany. The distillery was founded in 1898 by GioBatta Poli in Schiavon and remains a family-run enterprise dedicated to traditional batch-style distillation in copper pot stills. This specific grappa was born in 1993 from a meeting between Jacopo Poli and Marchese Incisa della Rocchetta, the producer of the legendary Super-Tuscan wine, Sassicaia.

Spirit Description

This majestic grappa is distilled from the fresh pomace of Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon grapes used to make Sassicaia wine. It undergoes a meticulous double maturation process, aging first for four years in French oak barriques and then finishing for an additional six months in barrels that previously held Sassicaia wine.

  • Colour: It displays a bright, glowing amber hue with golden reflections.

  • Aroma: The nose is complex and fragrant, featuring scents of toasted hazelnuts, peanuts, and dark chocolate, accented by notes of coffee, vanilla, and a hint of liquorice.

  • Palate: It offers a dry, layered, and harmonious palate with deep flavours of cocoa, mocha, honey, and processed fruits, alongside notes of toasted nuts and eucalyptus.

  • Body: This spirit is full-bodied, majestic, and characterized by great structural complexity.

  • Finish: It concludes with an exceptionally long and persistent finish dominated by the sweet character of vanilla and lingering honey notes.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at 40%.

Food Pairing

The intense fruit and toasted nuances of this aged grappa make it an ideal digestif or a companion to rich, flavourful treats.

  • Sweet: It pairs elegantly with rich dark chocolate, almond-based biscuits, and hazelnut desserts.

  • Savoury: For a traditional experience, it can be served alongside a fine espresso as a 'Caffè Corretto'.

  • Indulgence: The spirit's wood and spice profile also complements the smoking of a good cigar.

  • Serving: To fully experience its layered aromas, it is best enjoyed neat at a room temperature of 18°C to 20°C in a tulip-shaped glass.

title: Domaine Seguin Manuel Savigny Les Beaune 'Lavieres' Premier Cru 2022
bodyHtml:
Seguin-Manuel has undergone a major rejuvenation since its acquisition by Thibaut Marion in 2004, 180 years after its foundation in 1824. Coming from a ten-generation family of winegrowers, Chanson Père & Fils, Thibaut started his career and honed his skills for seven years at the family winery in Beaune. Today, he puts his experience, passion and energy at the service of the great wines of Burgundy. Seguin-Manuel's vineyards are grown organically with no use of chemicals, certified since 2015.

The "Lavieres" has a dark ruby colour. It combines the nose red fruit and floral aromas with a hint of vanilla coming from the oak cask. It is concentrated on the palate with a lovely balance and very pure aromas of ripe fruit. Very clean. Tannins are silky and very well integrated into the wine. Long and nice finish with mineral nuances.  At its best after 5 to 7 years, and over 10 years for the good vintages.

title: Alonso & Pedrajo La Pequenita Blanco 2017
bodyHtml:
Alonso & Pedrajo La Pequenita Blanco is an authentic expression of Spain's renowned Rioja region, specifically crafted within the Rioja Alta subregion. Founded by two families who share a deep passion for minimal-intervention viticulture, the winery began its journey in 2011 in the town of Villalba de Rioja. The estate focuses on capturing the true essence of its unique terroir at Finca La Cala, utilizing sustainable practices and traditional methods to create highly original, low-intervention wines.

Wine Description

This unique white skin-contact wine displays a brilliant golden-amber colour in the glass. The nose unfolds with an expressive bouquet of ripe tree fruits like orchard quince, pear, and melon, elegantly mixed with green herbal notes of fennel and a subtle hint of pastry. On the palate, it delivers a complex, medium-to-full body with an enveloping, creamy texture from extended lees contact, beautifully balanced by a solid, vibrant acidity and a light, fluid tannic structure. The finish is long, deep, and remarkably fresh, accented by a distinct mineral nuance.

Food Pairing

The complex structure and rich texture of this macerated white wine make it a wonderful match for rich seafood dishes like pan-seared fish in a white cream sauce, soft cheeses, cured meats, or savoury vegetarian appetizers.

title: Saint Nicolas De Bourgueil 2022
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine originates from France, within the Middle Loire Valley's historical Touraine region, specifically under the dedicated Saint Nicolas de Bourgueil appellation. Anchored by centuries of viticultural tradition along the Loire River, local family estates and historic domains have long championed the region's unique terroirs. Driven by a winemaking philosophy that respects nature and authentic expression, producers here focus on coaxing elegant structure and bright, pure fruit profiles from vines deeply rooted in the area's distinct sand, gravel, and limestone soils.

Wine Description

Crafted from 100% Cabernet Franc, this wine displays an intense, brilliant ruby-red colour in the glass. The nose is highly expressive and harmonious, bursting with vibrant aromas of fresh raspberry, cherry, and blackberry, subtly layered with complexity like red bell pepper, graphite, and light undergrowth. On the palate, it delivers a medium body defined by crisp freshness, fine-grained yet firm tannins, and a beautifully balanced, lean structure. Notes of crunchy red berries and light spice lead into a lively, refreshing finish.

title: Moraza Las Tasugueras Blanco 2024
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Spain, Moraza Las Tasugueras Blanco is rooted in the high-altitude subregion of Rioja Alta within the broader Rioja territory. Bodegas Moraza has been operated by six generations of the same family, with Janire Moraza currently leading the estate alongside a commitment to certified organic and biodynamic viticulture. Their winemaking philosophy completely rejects the use of oak in favour of early harvesting, allowing them to capture lower alcohol levels and a fresh, pure expression of their unique calcareous clay terroir.

Wine Description

This wine is crafted entirely from 100% Tempranillo Blanco, a rare genetic mutation of the red Tempranillo grape grown in the single vineyard parcel of Las Tasugueras. In the glass, it reveals a medium yellow colour with bright clarity. The aroma is highly expressive, offering layers of white flowers, ripe pears, Meyer lemon, and a delicate hint of beeswax. On the palate, it balances a bold, medium to full body with a crisp, dry profile and striking freshness driven by a vibrant high acidity. Complex flavours of baked apple, lemon pith, and a touch of salted hazelnut evolve seamlessly alongside a creamy texture derived from stainless steel lees contact. The finish is remarkably long, precise, and defined by a distinctive mineral salinity.

title: L'Astemia Barolo Cannubi 2019
bodyHtml:
L'Astemia Pentita Barolo Cannubi hails from Italy, specifically from the prestigious Cannubi crucial subregion within the Barolo DOCG of Piedmont. Established on the historic Cannubi ridge by Sandra Vezza, the winery famously channels a pop-art visual aesthetic while focusing heavily on deep respect for terroir and natural winemaking philosophies. Winemakers Donato Lanati and Mauro Daniele craft expressive wines that emphasize the pristine nature of their 30 hectares of carefully farmed vines.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo expression pours a classic, clear ruby red with shifting garnet highlights. The nose reveals a harmonious mix of fresh wild strawberries, ripe red cherries, and dried floral notes, gently complemented by underlying layers of savory cedar and warm baking spices. On the palate, it exhibits a medium body balanced by a lively acidity and a tight, velvety tannic structure that offers a pleasantly firm grip.

title: Fantini OPI Montepulciano d'Abruzzo Colline Teramane Riserva 2016
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Italy, specifically the renowned Abruzzo region and the prestigious Colline Teramane subregion, this exceptional red wine represents the peak of local winemaking. Fantini, an acclaimed producer under the Farnese Vini umbrella, is dedicated to crafting wines of superb quality and value that appeal to all wine lovers. Their winemaking philosophy centres on highlighting the unique characteristics of premium estate vineyards, such as Tenuta Cantalupo in Notaresco, where the grapes for this flagship bottling are meticulously cultivated.

Wine Description

The Fantini OPI Montepulciano d'Abruzzo Colline Teramane Riserva showcases a deep garnet red colour in the glass. The nose delivers an intense, persistent, and complex bouquet filled with aromas of crushed ripe berries, tobacco, and liquorice, seamlessly integrated with hints of balsamic and dark chocolate. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is remarkably soft, well balanced, and dense, revealing a plush layer of lightly chewy tannins and a vibrant core of freshness. It concludes with a long, spicy finish layered with notes of vanilla and cocoa.

title: Vietti Colli Tortonesi Derthona Timorasso 2021
bodyHtml:
Vietti Colli Tortonesi Derthona Timorasso represents a bold expansion for the iconic Barolo producer into Southeastern Piedmont.

Timorasso is an ancient, indigenous white grape that nearly went extinct before its "renaissance" in the late 1980s. It is often referred to as the "Barolo Bianco" (White Barolo) because of its powerful structure, high acidity, and remarkable ability to age for 10–15 years or more. Vietti's entry into the Colli Tortonesi region highlights the variety's growing status as one of Italy's most prestigious white wines.

Wine Description

This wine is a 100% Timorasso, sourced from calcareous (limestone) and clay hillside vineyards in and around Monleale.

  • Appearance: Intense yellow with vibrant green hues.

  • Aromas: Youthful notes of pear, peach, acacia, and hawthorn. As it ages (2–3+ years), it develops complex "ethereal" notes of honey and hydrocarbons (similar to aged Riesling).

  • Palate: Dry, warm, and broad. It is known for a "saline" backbone and high mineral tension that balances its powerful alcohol and textural weight.

title: Eagle Rare 10 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States, produced in the Kentucky region. Crafted at the historic Buffalo Trace Distillery in Frankfort, Kentucky—under the ownership of the Sazerac Company—Eagle Rare was originally created in 1975 by legendary Master Distiller Charles L. Beam. Aged for a minimum of 10 years in oak barrels selected from Buffalo Trace’s famous Low-Rye Mash Bill #1, this expression is carefully matured to balance deep wood tannins with sweet corn and fruit characteristics before being bottled.

Spirit Description

This bourbon presents a rich, dark amber-golden hue in the glass. The nose is complex and sweet, opening with prominent aromas of toffee, toasted oak, and ripe red apples, accompanied by subtle nuances of leather, honey, and orange peel. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied with a dry, oak-forward mouthfeel, delivering flavours of dark chocolate, candied almonds, sweet vanilla cream, and cherries, balanced by seasoned wood spice and a touch of herbal rye. The finish is long, dry, and lingering, leaving a trailing impression of charred oak, cocoa, and subtle black pepper. Bottled at a strength of 45% ABV (90 Proof), it delivers an exceptionally refined, age-stated Kentucky bourbon profile.

title: Captain Morgan Dark Rum - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: This Captain doesn't go unnoticed. With a rich taste and unique depth of flavour, Captain Morgan Dark Rum is the adventurers' delight. Deep amber brown this aromatic rum offers notes of molasses and light spice with toasted oak flavour and light sweetness that is balanced by a dry finish.

title: Absolut Vodka - 1.75 Litre - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Clear and colourless; soft grain aroma; warmth of alcohol with hint of sweetness smooth and clean.

title: Captain Morgan Gold Rum - 1.14 Litre Bottle - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Notes of sweet wood and hazelnut come together to create a perfectly balanced spirit with a smooth finish. With a medium weight palate and restrained sweetness, this is ideal in a rum and cola.

title: Ciroc Peach Vodka - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Diddy, songwriter, rapper, record producer, and entrepreneur got behind the Ciroc Vodka brand and the rest is history! Clear water white with aromas and flavours of ripe peach and candied peach with a sweet finish.

title: Smirnoff Vodka - 1.75 Litre (Plastic Bottle) - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Smirnoff Vodka is the largest vodka brand in the world. It is an ultra smooth vodka with a classic taste that has inspired other varieties of vodkas worldwide.

title: Domaine Henri et Gilles Buisson Pommard 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Pommard AOC appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Domaine Henri et Gilles Buisson Pommard 2024 represents a pure, organic, and traditionally structured expression of village-level Pinot Noir. Tracing their family winemaking lineage in Saint-Romain back to 1758, Domaine Henri et Gilles Buisson is celebrated as an early champion of certified organic and biodynamic farming across the Côte d'Or. The estate's Pommard holdings benefit from the village's classic terroir, situated on gentle east- and southeast-facing slopes featuring deep, iron-rich reddish clay, marl, and limestone scree that naturally encourage deep root penetration. Under the stewardship of brothers Franck and Frédérick Buisson, the viticultural and cellar philosophy centres on rigorous hand-harvesting in small bins, parcel-by-parcel sorting, native yeast fermentation with a balanced inclusion of whole clusters, and maturation for 12 to 14 months in fine French oak casks (approximately 15% to 20% new oak) without fining or filtration. The result is an energetic, muscular red Burgundy that harmonizes Pommard's classic terrestrial power with the Buisson signature of floral freshness and pure fruit definition.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear medium ruby red colour with vibrant garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe dark cherry, black raspberry, wild plum, and red currant compote, interwoven with sophisticated notes of violet petal, iron-rich earth, forest floor, subtle game, crushed stone minerality, and warm French oak cedar spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, sour cherry, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by firm, fine-grained structural tannins and a dense, well-proportioned mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, dried herbs, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2027–2038+. Stylistically, it combines biodynamic vitality, authentic Pommard muscle, and vibrant Côte de Beaune mineral precision.

title: Smirnoff Vodka - 750 ml (Glass Bottle)
bodyHtml: Founded in 1864 by Pyotr Arsenievich Smirnov, what we now call Smirnoff was the first vodka to use charcoal filtration in the distillation process. This charcoal filtration produces a spirit that is ideal for mixing because of its smooth and clean palate, perfect in a variety of cocktails or straight.

title: Domaine Henri et Gilles Buisson Meursault 'Les Vignes de Marguerite' 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Meursault AOC appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Domaine Henri et Gilles Buisson Meursault 'Les Vignes de Marguerite' 2024 represents a pure, certified biodynamic, and finely sculpted expression of village-level Chardonnay. Tracing their family winemaking roots in the nearby high-elevation village of Saint-Romain back to 1758, Domaine Henri et Gilles Buisson stands among Burgundy's foremost pioneers of ecological viticulture. This cuvée, named in loving tribute to their grandmother Marguerite, is sourced from venerable old vines situated on the gentle lower slopes of Meursault where deep clay-limestone soils contain an ideal balance of marly silt and limestone scree. Under the direct stewardship of brothers Franck and Frédérick Buisson, the philosophy emphasizes hand harvesting in small bins, pneumatic pressing of whole clusters, spontaneous alcoholic fermentation using indigenous ambient yeasts, and maturation for 12 to 14 months in carefully selected French oak casks (approximately 15% to 20% new oak) with light lees contact and no fining or filtration. The result is a vibrant, deeply mineral white Burgundy that combines Meursault's quintessential nutty breadth and textural generosity with the domaine's hallmark purity, tension, and crystalline focus.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear pale straw-gold colour with brilliant platinum and emerald reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe Meyer lemon, crisp Bosc pear, yellow apple, and white peach, interwoven with sophisticated notes of acacia flower, toasted hazelnut, crushed limestone minerality, beeswax, lemon verbena, and subtle French oak pastry spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of citrus oil, orchard fruits, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by a rich, delicately rounded mid-palate structure and seamless phenolic grip, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus zest, toasted brioche, and a clean, saline chalky drive. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2026–2036+. Stylistically, it combines biodynamic vitality, classic Meursault textural opulence, and laser-sharp mineral poise.

title: Joseph Drouhin Cote de Beaune Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Côte de Beaune AOC appellation in the Côte d'Or, Maison Joseph Drouhin Côte de Beaune Rouge 2022 represents an elegant, vibrant, and classically structured expression of village-level Pinot Noir. Founded in 1880, Maison Joseph Drouhin is one of Beaune's most historic family houses, celebrated for their terroir-driven winemaking and longstanding commitment to organic and biodynamic principles across their vineyards. The Côte de Beaune appellation represents a distinct, localized village cru situated on the slopes directly overlooking and adjoining the town of Beaune, perched immediately above the Premier Cru belt. The vines thrive on limestone-marl soils intermixed with clay, gravel, and scree, benefiting from full eastern and south-eastern exposure that ensures optimal sun capture throughout the day. Under the direction of the Drouhin family and veteran head winemaker Jérôme Faure-Brac, the fruit is harvested manually in small crates, sorted meticulously, and fermented with indigenous yeasts in open wooden and stainless steel vats with gentle extraction. Maturation for 12 to 14 months in French oak barrels (approximately 15% to 20% new oak) produces an open, silken, and perfumed red Burgundy with quintessential Côte de Beaune finesse.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear medium ruby red colour with brilliant crimson and subtle garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe red cherry, wild raspberry, red currant, and fresh dark plum, interwoven with sophisticated notes of violet petal, subtle forest floor, crushed limestone minerality, dried herbs, and warm French oak cedar spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of crisp red berries, tart cherry, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by supple, fine-grained tannins and a balanced, harmonious mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, dried wild thyme, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2025–2034+. Stylistically, it combines Drouhin's signature aromatic purity, supple fruit charm, and refined Burgundian balance.

title: Joseph Drouhin Clos des Mouches Blanc Premier Cru 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Beaune Premier Cru AOC appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Maison Joseph Drouhin Beaune Premier Cru 'Clos des Mouches' Blanc 2024 represents one of the most legendary, iconic, and historically celebrated expressions of Premier Cru Chardonnay in Burgundy. Acquired parcel by parcel by Maurice Drouhin in the 1920s, this historic vineyard sits on the southern boundary of Beaune bordering Pommard, named after the sunlit beehives historically kept on the slopes (mouches à miel, the Old French term for honeybees). Maurice Drouhin daringly replanted half of the hillside to Chardonnay in 1928, creating what has become the flagship white jewel of the domaine. The vineyard features an ideal mid-slope, amphitheatre-like southeastern exposition with shallow, stony clay-limestone soils strewn with fractured Jurassic limestone that provides exceptional natural drainage and radiant heat. Under head winemaker Jérôme Faure-Brac and the Drouhin family, the estate applies strict organic and biodynamic viticulture: manual harvesting in small crates, gentle pneumatic whole-cluster pressing, spontaneous native yeast fermentation, and maturation for 12 to 15 months in French oak barrels (approximately 25% new oak). The result is an aristocratic white Burgundy renowned for its unctuous texture, floral perfume, and Grand Cru-calibre cellar stamina.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear pale straw-gold colour with brilliant platinum and green reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe Meyer lemon, yellow peach, poached pear, and candied citrus peel, interwoven with sophisticated notes of white lilac, acacia blossom, crushed limestone minerality, beeswax, toasted almond, lemon verbena, and warm French oak pastry spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of citrus oil, orchard fruits, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by a rich, multidimensional mid-palate structure and seamless phenolic grip, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus zest, toasted brioche, and a clean, aristocratic flinty mineral drive. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2027–2040+. Stylistically, it combines lavish stone fruit generosity, lifted floral precision, and authentic Côte de Beaune mineral nobility.

title: Domaine Drouhin Vaudon Chablis 'Bougros' Grand Cru 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Chablis Grand Cru AOC appellation in northern Burgundy, Domaine Drouhin Vaudon Chablis Grand Cru 'Bougros' 2024 represents a powerful, concentrated, and intensely mineral expression of Grand Cru Chardonnay. Domaine Drouhin Vaudon is the historic Chablis estate of Maison Joseph Drouhin, centred around the historic 18th-century watermill Moulin de Vaudon on the Serein River. Bougros occupies the far northwestern flank of the Grand Cru hill, featuring steep slopes oriented southwest that capture intense afternoon sunlight. The soils here consist of deep, fossil-rich Kimmeridgian limestone marl intermixed with compact clay and dense deposits of prehistoric oyster shells (Exogyra virgula), which impart both generous textural flesh and profound saline cut. Under head winemaker Jérôme Faure-Brac and the Drouhin family, the fruit is farmed according to strict organic and biodynamic principles, harvested by hand in small baskets, gently pressed with whole clusters, and fermented primarily in seasoned French oak barrels (with less than 10% new oak) to preserve terroir transparency. Maturation on fine lees for 12 to 14 months yields a Chablis Grand Cru of sovereign breadth, chiseled marine salinity, and multi-decade cellar stamina.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear pale straw-gold colour with brilliant platinum and green reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe Meyer lemon, green orchard pear, white peach, and crisp Granny Smith apple, interwoven with sophisticated notes of oyster shell minerality, crushed limestone, white hawthorn blossom, lemon verbena, fresh pastry dough, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of citrus oil, tart orchard fruits, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by a rich, chalky mid-palate structure and seamless phenolic grip, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus zest, iodized sea spray, and a clean, laser-sharp stony drive. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2028–2042+. Stylistically, it combines Bougros's characteristic solar generosity, crystalline marine tension, and authentic Chablis Grand Cru majesty.

title: Joseph Drouhin Corton Charlemagne Grand Cru 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Corton Charlemagne Grand Cru AOC appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Maison Joseph Drouhin Corton Charlemagne Grand Cru 2024 represents a monumental, aristocratic, and fiercely mineral expression of Grand Cru Chardonnay. Perched high on the iconic Montagne de Corton spanning the communes of Aloxe Corton, Pernand Vergelesses, and Ladoix Serrigny, this revered hillside vineyard was historically associated with Emperor Charlemagne. The vines occupy steep, high-elevation parcels situated on the upper brow of the hill, facing south to south-west. The terroir is defined by its distinct light-coloured, marly limestone soils (marnes blanches) layered over Oxfordian limestone, offering optimal solar exposure tempered by cooling woodland breezes from the summit. Under the guidance of the Drouhin family and veteran head winemaker Jérôme Faure-Brac, the fruit is harvested manually in small bins, gently pressed with whole clusters, and fermented with indigenous ambient yeasts in French oak barrels (approximately 25% to 30% new oak). Aged on fine lees for 12 to 15 months, the resulting Grand Cru white Burgundy combines sovereign structural power, crystalline marine tension, and multi-decade cellar longevity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear pale gold colour with brilliant platinum and emerald reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe Meyer lemon, crisp green apple, white peach, and poached quince, interwoven with sophisticated notes of crushed flint minerality, wet stone, white blossom, toasted hazelnut, lemon curd, and warm French oak cedar spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of citrus oil, tart orchard fruits, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by a rich, chalky mid-palate structure and seamless phenolic grip, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus zest, toasted brioche, and a clean, laser-sharp stony mineral drive. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2029–2050+. Stylistically, it combines monumental power, high-altitude alpine tension, and authentic Grand Cru majesty.

title: Joseph Drouhin Montrachet 'Marquis de Laguiche' Grand Cru 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Montrachet Grand Cru AOC appellation spanning Puligny Montrachet and Chassagne Montrachet in the Côte de Beaune, Maison Joseph Drouhin Montrachet Grand Cru 'Marquis de Laguiche' 2024 represents the pinnacle of dry white Burgundy and one of the most revered expressions of Chardonnay in the world. The Laguiche family has owned this remarkable parcel since 1363, holding over two hectares on the gentler, morning-sun-drenched Puligny side of the slope—the largest single contiguous holding in Le Montrachet. Since 1947, viticulture, vinification, and aging have been exclusively entrusted to Maison Joseph Drouhin, farmed entirely with biodynamic principles.
