The terroir features exceptional geological balance: pure Bathonian limestone scree interwoven with reddish clay and marl that delivers extraordinary drainage and deep mineral nutrition. Under head winemaker Jérôme Faure-Brac and the Drouhin family, the fruit undergoes gentle pneumatic whole-cluster pressing and long, spontaneous alcoholic and malolactic fermentation entirely in French oak barrels (approximately 25% to 30% new oak), followed by aging on fine lees for 15 to 18 months. The result is a monumental, multifaceted Grand Cru that marries regal density, soaring aromatic complexity, and supreme cellar longevity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear pale straw-gold colour with brilliant platinum and emerald reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe Meyer lemon, white peach, poached Bartlett pear, and candied citrus peel, interwoven with sophisticated notes of orange blossom, honeysuckle, crushed limestone minerality, beeswax, toasted brioche, and warm French oak cedar spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and expansive, delivering concentrated flavours of orchard fruits, hazelnut praline, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by a rich, multidimensional mid-palate structure and seamless phenolic grip, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus oil, dried white flowers, and a clean, aristocratic gravelly mineral drive. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2030–2055+. Stylistically, it combines monumental textural richness, effortless poise, and sovereign Grand Cru power.

title: Silver Oak Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the prestigious Napa Valley region in California, USA. Silver Oak was founded in 1972 by Ray Duncan and Justin Meyer with a singular, dedicated focus on crafting Cabernet Sauvignon that is aged extensively in American oak. The winery remains under the multi-generation stewardship of the Duncan family, who maintain a winemaking philosophy of creating wines that are approachable upon release yet possess the structural integrity to age for decades.

Wine Description

This Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep, concentrated profile with a panoply of blackberry, black cherry, and warm cassis aromas, interwoven with notes of smoked paprika, tobacco, and loamy earth. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and polished, showing generous black fruit, cocoa, and graphite minerality supported by a firm spine of juicy acidity and lengthy, fine grained tannins.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling - 97 points."

Food Pairing

This powerful and structured Cabernet Sauvignon is an ideal match for hearty dishes such as ribeye steak with herb butter, wine braised short ribs, or slow cooked lamb shanks. It also pairs excellently with aged, sharp cheeses like cheddar or smoked gouda, which help to soften the wine's firm tannins.

title: Domaine Henri et Gilles Buisson Volnay Premier Cru 'Les Chanlins' 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Volnay Premier Cru AOC appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Domaine Henri et Gilles Buisson Volnay Premier Cru 'Les Chanlins' 2024 represents a pure, organic, and powerfully mineral expression of Premier Cru Pinot Noir. Based in the high-elevation village of Saint-Romain with family winemaking heritage dating back to 1758, Domaine Henri et Gilles Buisson is a pioneer of certified organic and biodynamic viticulture in the Côte d'Or. The Premier Cru vineyard of 'Les Chanlins' is exceptionally situated on the upper, steep southern slopes of Volnay directly bordering the Pommard Premier Cru 'Les Rugiens', characterized by stony, iron-rich reddish clay over hard Bathonian limestone bedrock. Under brothers Franck and Frédérick Buisson, the viticultural philosophy centres on hand harvesting in small crates, rigorous sorting, spontaneous fermentation with indigenous yeasts using a high proportion of whole clusters, and aging for 12 to 14 months in carefully selected French oak barrels (approximately 20% new oak) with minimal sulphur and no fining or filtration. The result is a vibrant, structured red Burgundy that unites the perfumed silkiness of Volnay with the muscle, earthy depth, and longevity of its Pommard neighbour.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear medium ruby red colour with vivid crimson-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild strawberry, black raspberry, and red currant compote, interwoven with sophisticated notes of fresh violet petals, dried rose hips, crushed limestone minerality, forest floor, orange zest, and warm French oak cedar spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of crisp red berries, tart plum, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins and an elegantly chiseled mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, dried wild thyme, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2028–2040+. Stylistically, it combines Buisson's biodynamic purity, lifted floral aromatics, and focused Côte de Beaune tension.

title: Joseph Drouhin Chassagne Montrachet Premier Cru 'Embazees' 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Chassagne Montrachet Premier Cru AOC appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Maison Joseph Drouhin Chassagne Montrachet Premier Cru 'Embazées' 2024 represents a refined, expressive, and classically balanced expression of Premier Cru Chardonnay. Founded in 1880, Maison Joseph Drouhin is one of Beaune's most historic and respected family estates, renowned internationally for their pure, terroir-driven style and early adoption of organic and biodynamic viticulture across their domaine parcels. The Premier Cru climat of 'Embazées' (often grouped within the broader Morgeot sector) is situated on the southern border of the village adjoining Santenay, where the gentle east-facing slope features deep, marly clay-limestone soils strewn with small stones. Under the guidance of the Drouhin family and veteran head winemaker Jérôme Faure-Brac, the grapes are harvested manually in small crates, gently pressed with whole clusters, and fermented with indigenous yeasts entirely in French oak barrels (approximately 20% to 25% new oak). The wine undergoes light stirring on the lees and matures for 12 to 14 months, producing a generous, floral, and deeply mineral white Burgundy of outstanding textural elegance.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear pale gold colour with bright green and silvery highlights along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe yellow apple, white peach, Bartlett pear, and fresh lemon curd, interwoven with sophisticated notes of white hawthorn blossom, crushed limestone minerality, toasted hazelnut, lemon thyme, and warm French oak cedar spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of crisp orchard fruits, candied citrus peel, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by a rich, chalky mid-palate structure and seamless phenolic grip, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus oil, subtle toasted brioche, and a clean flinty mineral drive. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2027–2038+. Stylistically, it combines Drouhin's signature aristocratic restraint, lavish stone fruit concentration, and authentic Côte de Beaune freshness.

title: Hearst Ranch Bunkhouse Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from the United States, within California's Central Coast in the Paso Robles AVA of San Luis Obispo County. Hearst Ranch Winery was established through a collaboration between Steve Hearst, a great-grandson of media mogul William Randolph Hearst, and veteran Central Coast winemaker Jim Saunders. The "Bunkhouse" label pays tribute to the historic ranch bunkhouse originally constructed for cowboys and ranch hands on the expansive Hearst Ranch in San Simeon. The winery's philosophy emphasizes highlighting the generous, sun-drenched terroir of Paso Robles, balancing classic California fruit ripeness with structured tannins and barrel-aged nuance.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep, vibrant ruby color in the glass. The nose opens with aromas of blackcurrant, boysenberry, and ripe plum, mingled with savory cracked black pepper, graphite, dried oregano, and subtle toasted oak. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a plush, steady, and finely textured mouthfeel. Ripe red and dark fruit flavors are supported by firm, velvety tannins and balanced acidity. The finish is smooth and lingering, carrying notes of dark chocolate, warm spices, and faint earthiness. The varietal composition is predominantly Cabernet Sauvignon (around 91%), rounded out with small additions of Petit Verdot, Malbec, and Cabernet Franc. It has an alcohol content of approximately 14.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Quevedo Colheita 2008 Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
This single-harvest fortified wine originates from the steep, schist terraces of the Cima Corgo and Douro Superior sub-regions within Portugal's Douro Valley, produced by family-run Quevedo Port Wine (Vinhos Oscar Quevedo). A Colheita represents a vintage-dated tawny port aged exclusively in seasoned wooden casks for a minimum of seven years prior to bottling. Hand-harvested from estate parcels planted with classic indigenous Douro field varieties—chiefly Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz (Tempranillo), Touriga Nacional, Tinta Barroca, and Tinto Cão—the grapes underwent partial fermentation in traditional stainless steel vats before the process was arrested with neutral grape spirit (aguardente) to lock in natural grape sweetness.

Spirit Description

This Colheita pours a luminous, deep tawny-amber core with burnished copper-mahogany rim highlights and thick, slow-running tears along the glass. On the nose, it is intensely nutty, warm, and oxidative, greeting the senses with aromas of toasted walnuts, roasted hazelnuts, and pecan pie, underpinned by layers of dried Smyrna figs, Medjool dates, prune paste, and caramelized orange peel. On the palate, it delivers a silky, unctuous, and full-bodied texture. Rich flavors of burnt toffee, butterscotch, and candied citrus marmalade wash over the tongue, counterbalanced by a firm, refreshing spine of natural acidity that prevents the high residual sugar from feeling cloying. The mid-palate introduces refined notes of cinnamon stick, nutmeg, cocoa dust, and seasoned antique oak tannins. The finish is remarkably long, clean, and persistent, trailing off with impressions of roasted nuts, dried apricot leather, and a lingering citrus-oil warmth.

Accolades

Quevedo's aged Colheitas consistently garner high praise and 90+ point scores from international publications such as Wine Enthusiast, Decanter, and Wine Spectator. Spirits and wine judges regularly commend Oscar and Cláudia Quevedo for their balanced, terroir-driven approach to single-harvest tawnies. Reviewers frequently emphasize the 2008 vintage’s harmonious evolution in oak, praising its ability to deliver rich, oxidative rancio and roasted-nut depth while maintaining the trademark freshness and vibrant acidity characteristic of high-elevation Douro vineyards.

title: Distillerie Garnier 6 Year Old Calvados - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This single-estate artisan French apple brandy originates from the Bocage Ornais region in southern Normandy, crafted by Distillerie Garnier. Founded and operated with a steadfast focus on traditional agricultural methods, the Garnier family oversees estate orchards planted with standard tall-stem (haute-tige) cider apple trees, utilizing unsprayed, sustainably farmed fruit. Distillerie Garnier 6 Year Old Calvados is produced from a carefully measured blend of traditional bittersweet, bitter, acidic, and sweet cider apple varieties harvested from local groves. Following a natural, slow wild-yeast fermentation of pure apple cider, the cider is distilled in a traditional copper column still before resting for a minimum of 6 years in seasoned French oak casks.

Spirit Description

This Calvados pours a bright, warm amber hue with golden-copper reflections and slender, elegant legs along the glass. On the nose, it strikes an enticing equilibrium between crisp orchard vitality and early wood evolution, leading with aromas of caramelized apple slices, tarte tatin, and baked red apples, followed by delicate notes of dried orange peel, vanilla pod, floral apple blossom, and toasted hazelnut. On the palate, an initial rush of juicy stewed orchard fruit, poached pear, and golden raisins unfolds into mid-palate notes of sweet baking spices (cinnamon stick, nutmeg, and a hint of clove), gentle wood tannins, and a crisp, mouthwatering cider acidity. The oak influence adds depth and structure while allowing the fresh apple core to shine. The finish is medium-to-long, clean, and warming, trailing off with impressions of apple compote, roasted walnut, light oak spice, and a dry, refreshing fruit warmth.

Accolades

Distillerie Garnier has earned steady acclaim among European spirits writers, craft spirits competitions, and sommeliers for its transparent, grower-producer philosophy. The 6 Year Old expression is frequently praised as an exemplary benchmark of mid-aged Calvados, showcasing the hallmark character of tall-stem orchard fruit. Critics and judges routinely commend the distillery for preserving an authentic, crisp apple acidity across six years of wood aging, noting that the absence of artificial additives yields a far cleaner, more expressive palate than commercially sweetened mass-market brandies.

title: Paul Giraud Vieille Reserve Cognac - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This premier single-estate French grape brandy originates from the chalk-rich soils of Bouteville in the Grande Champagne premier cru, crafted by the historic family house Domaine Paul Giraud. Representing roughly 25 years of patient aging, Paul Giraud Vieille Réserve marks the critical threshold where long cellar maturation transitions youthful stone fruits into complex, tertiary cellar notes. Distilled exclusively from estate-grown Ugni Blanc grapes harvested by hand, the wine underwent double distillation in traditional copper Charentais pot stills before entering a quiet, undisturbed maturation in Giraud’s naturally humid cellars. Bottled at 80 proof (40.0% ABV) in a classic 700 ml bottle (or 750 ml in North America), it remains completely free of chill-filtration, artificial caramel coloring (E150a), added sugar, or oak extracts (boisé).

Spirit Description

This Cognac pours a rich, luminous amber-gold hue with deep copper reflections and slow, unctuous legs along the glass. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic, refined, and layered, displaying the classic onset of premier cru rancio. Aromas open with candied orange peel, dried apricots, Smyrna figs, and golden raisins, seamlessly interwoven with warm beeswax, honeysuckle, toasted almonds, and subtle pipe tobacco. On the palate, the 40.0% ABV delivery feels remarkably supple, velvety, and harmonious. An initial wave of sweet dried fruits, prune preserves, and poached orchard fruit glides into mid-palate nuances of baking spices (cinnamon stick, nutmeg, and vanilla bean), polished cedar, and light cocoa powder. The oak tannins are soft and completely melted into the fruit, framed by a delicate, chalky limestone freshness that preserves vibrancy across its quarter-century in wood. The finish is long, gentle, and expansive, lingering with notes of candied citrus zest, dried fruit leather, antique wood oils, and soft hazelnut warmth.

Accolades

Paul Giraud Vieille Réserve holds elite standing among sommeliers, cellar masters, and fine spirits connoisseurs, regularly scoring 93–95 points in specialized spirits reviews. Critics frequently cite it as one of the quintessential reference points for true 25-year-old Grande Champagne, celebrating Giraud's refusal to use boisé or sugar syrup to artificially accelerate maturity. Reviewers commend its structural balance, pointing out that humid cellar conditions allowed the spirit to soften its alcohol naturally while preserving exquisite fruit purity alongside early, authentic rancio development.

title: Paul Giraud 1999 Cognac - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This rare vintage single-estate French grape brandy originates from the chalk-dense soils of Bouteville in the Grande Champagne premier cru, crafted by the historic family house Domaine Paul Giraud. Unlike traditional multi-vintage Cognac blends, a true vintage expression (Millésime) is subject to strict official oversight by the BNIC (Bureau National Interprofessionnel du Cognac), requiring the aging casks to be sealed under wax and certified under lock and key. Distilled exclusively from the estate's 1999 harvest of 100% Ugni Blanc grapes, the wine underwent double distillation in traditional Charentais copper pot stills. It then spent over two decades aging peacefully in Giraud's humid cellars in seasoned French oak casks. Bottled at 80 proof (40.0% ABV) in a classic 700 ml bottle, it is produced without chill-filtration, artificial caramel coloring, sugar, or oak extracts (boisé).

Spirit Description

This vintage Cognac pours a warm, luminous golden-amber hue with bright topaz reflections and delicate, slow-forming tears along the glass. On the nose, it displays remarkable freshness and aromatic precision, leading with ripe orchard fruit, candied apricot, Mirabelle plum, and fresh orange marmalade, followed by layers of acacia honey, white spring flowers, fresh vanilla pod, and subtle toasted hazelnut. On the palate, the 40.0% ABV delivery is supple, graceful, and remarkably elegant. An initial rush of juicy stone fruits, poached pear, and dried citrus zest transitions into mid-palate nuances of mild baking spices (nutmeg and light cinnamon), grated cocoa, beeswax, and a touch of delicate, early-stage rancio. The oak is thoroughly integrated and silky, framing the fruit rather than dominating it, and underscored by a clean, chalky mineral freshness typical of premier cru terroir. The finish is long, crisp, and refined, trailing off with dried apricot, delicate wood spice, and lingering floral honey.

Accolades

Paul Giraud’s single-harvest vintage bottlings are celebrated among fine spirits collectors, master sommeliers, and Cognac purists as rare snapshots of specific growing seasons. Spirits reviewers routinely award Giraud’s vintage bottlings 93+ points, commending the house for resisting the heavy extraction, wood additives, and sugar additions common across larger commercial houses. Critics specifically praise the 1999 Millésime for showcasing the delicate balance between secondary oak maturity and the pristine, vibrant white fruit character native to Grande Champagne.

title: Delamain 1999 Single Cask Cognac - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This rare vintage single-cask French grape brandy originates from the premier cru chalk slopes of Grande Champagne, produced by the historic house Delamain (established 1759 in Jarnac). Part of Delamain’s prestigious Collection Pléiade (specifically within the Apogée / Vintage tier), Delamain 1999 Single Cask Cognac was distilled exclusively from the 1999 harvest of 100% Ugni Blanc grapes. In accordance with strict BNIC regulations, the single seasoned 350-liter fût roux (red oak cask crafted from Tronçais forest oak) was officially certified, sealed under wax, and aged undisturbed in Delamain's vintage cellar along the humid banks of the Charente River. Bottled straight from that specific cask at its natural strength of 87.6 proof (43.8% ABV) in a standard 700 ml bottle, it is non-chill filtered and completely unadulterated—crafted with zero added sugar, zero caramel coloring (E150a), and zero boisé.

Spirit Description

This vintage Cognac displays a luminous, golden-topaz amber hue with deep copper reflections and slow, unctuous legs coating the glass. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic, pure, and refined, leading with lush dried apricots, white peach compote, candied orange zest, and baked yellow plums, followed by delicate floral accents of iris, dried honeysuckle, fresh vanilla pod, and seasoned cedar wood. On the palate, the 43.8% ABV natural cask strength delivers a vibrant, velvety, and mouth-coating texture with notable persistence and focus. Flavors of poached orchard fruits, golden raisins, and quince paste roll across the tongue before revealing mid-palate complexities of raw hazelnut, delicate early-stage rancio, sweet pipe tobacco, and gentle baking spices (nutmeg and light cinnamon). A subtle chalky mineral vein keeps the spirit remarkably fresh and structured across its two-plus decades in wood. The finish is exceptionally long, dry, and clean, lingering with impressions of dried stone fruit leather, citrus peel, toasted oak oils, and soft wildflower honey.

title: Delamain Malaville Single Cask Cognac - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This ultra-rare single-cask French grape brandy originates from the village of Malaville in the heart of the Grande Champagne premier cru, crafted by the historic, purist house Delamain (established in 1759 in Jarnac). Part of Delamain's acclaimed "Pléiade" collection of single-terroir, single-cask releases, Delamain Malaville Single Cask Cognac showcases the distinct microclimate and chalk-heavy soils of the Malaville commune. Distilled exclusively from 100% Ugni Blanc grapes, the spirit was matured in a single, ancient seasoned "roux" oak cask (crafted from fine-grained French Tronçais oak) in Delamain’s cellars along the Charente River.

Spirit Description

This single-cask Cognac pours a brilliant, shimmering amber-topaz hue with luminous golden-copper highlights and thick, slow-creeping tears along the glass. On the nose, it is extraordinarily fresh, floral, and aromatic, opening with vibrant white peach, ripe apricot, dried fig, and candied orange peel, seamlessly interlaced with delicate notes of acacia blossom, linden tea, fresh vanilla bean, and polished antique cedar. On the palate, the 44.1% ABV cask strength provides an unctuous, rich, and mouth-coating texture with exceptional vitality. An initial wave of sweet stone fruit compote, poached pear, and citrus marmalade gives way to sophisticated mid-palate nuances of roasted almond, delicate rancio, grated cocoa, and warm baking spices (cinnamon and nutmeg). A distinct line of chalky limestone minerality anchors the mid-palate, keeping the finish remarkably lively. The finish is exceptionally long, crisp, and elevated, trailing off with impressions of dried orchard fruits, subtle wood spice, and lingering floral honey.

title: Armand de Brignac Brut Gold (Ace of Spades) - 6 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Champagne region, specifically within the Montagne de Reims, Armand De Brignac Brut Gold 6L represents an opulent, prestigious, and masterfully blended prestige cuvée presented in a rare Methuselah format. Produced by the historic Champagne Cattier family—independent winegrowers based in Rilly-la-Montagne since 1763—Armand De Brignac (famously known as "Ace of Spades") embodies an uncompromising commitment to artisanal craftsmanship. Sourced from premier and grand cru parcels spanning chalky terroirs across the Montagne de Reims and Côte des Blancs, the fruit is selected exclusively from the initial, freshest portion of the gentle traditional basket press (la cuvée). Under father-and-son winemakers Jean-Jacques and Alexandre Cattier, the house crafts this cuvée by blending three distinct vintages to achieve stylistic consistency and layered depth, followed by maturation for years in deep chalk cellars over thirty metres underground. Finished with a bespoke liqueur de dosage aged for one full year in French oak barrels, this colossal six-litre format delivers extraordinary textural richness, creaminess, and extended cellar longevity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear pale gold colour with warm amber reflections and an exceedingly fine, persistent mousse. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe peach, candied lemon peel, apricot, and crisp green apple, interwoven with sophisticated notes of warm brioche, toasted almond, acacia blossom, honeyed ginger, and subtle French oak vanilla. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and expansive, delivering concentrated flavours of citrus oil, baked orchard fruits, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate Champagne acidity. Framed by a rich, creamy mid-palate structure and seamless effervescence, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon curd, toasted brioche, and a clean chalky mineral grip. Composed of a classic blend of Pinot Noir (40%), Chardonnay (40%), and Pinot Meunier (20%), this multi-vintage release offers immediate celebratory appeal along with cellaring potential over 8 to 15 years in large format. Stylistically, it combines opulent texture, vibrant dosage integration, and celebratory luxury.

title: Ruinart Blanc De Blancs
bodyHtml: The wine shows a superb, golden yellow colour with a beautiful luminosity and a fine and persistent mousse. The nose is clean and intense with warm, rich notes of brioche, French toast and roasted almonds. On the palate the wine is very supple and harmonious, with notes of honey and minerals on the long, sustained finish. Ruinart Blanc de Blancs is produced from a blend of 100% premiers crus Chardonnay grapes from the best of recent vintages. Grapes from the estate vineyards in Sillery and Brimont (ancestral home of the Ruinart family) are joined by carefully selected grapes from other premiers crus vineyards in the Côte de Blancs and the Montagne de Reims.

title: Crystal Head Vodka Bone Bottle Edition
bodyHtml:
Crystal Head uses the highest quality grain and pristine water from Newfoundland, Canada to craft an additive-free and gluten-free vodka. Crystal Head is quadruple distilled and filtered seven times. Three of the filtration pass through layers of Herkimer diamonds as final distinctive touch. The detailed integrity of the skull-shaped bottle was proudly designed with a pure spirit in mind.

A clean, clear and colourless spirit. On the nose – neutral grain aromas with a delicate touch of citrus. Silky smooth with a hint of sweetness and vanilla. A sweet, creamy finish.

The special-edition Bone Bottle features a pallid finish made to mimic the appearance of actual human bones. And, like its transparent brethren, no two bottles are alike.

title: Absolut Vodka - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Clear and colourless with a soft grain aroma combined with the warmth of alcohol and a hint of sweetness. Smooth and clean.

title: Apothic Red Blend - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Hailing from California, United States, this wine is a bold and innovative red blend that has become a staple of modern Californian winemaking. The winery takes its name from 'Apotheca', a mysterious 13th-century European cellar where early vintners blended and stored their most prized wines. Apothic's philosophy centers on crafting daring, smooth blends that prioritize intense fruit expression and a captivating sensory experience through the meticulous combination of diverse grape varieties.

Wine Description

This wine presents a very dark garnet colour in the glass, indicating its rich and concentrated nature. The bouquet is highly aromatic, leading with black cherry and dark red fruits, complemented by enticing layers of vanilla and mocha. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and velvety, featuring a silky-smooth texture and plush flavours of boysenberry and blackcurrant. Hints of black pepper and spice add a subtle complexity, while very soft tannins ensure an approachable mouthfeel. The finish is long and satisfying, dominated by lingering notes of toasted oak and dark fruit. Typically crafted as an off-dry wine, it offers a distinct hint of sweetness that balances its robust profile. While designed for immediate enjoyment, it is best consumed within three to four years of its vintage date.

title: Chateau Leoville Las Cases 2003
bodyHtml:
Chateau Leoville Las Cases is one of the largest and oldest classified growths in the Medoc region of France. Originally the other two Leovilles, Leoville Poyferre and Leoville Barton were part of the large estate. Today Leoville Las Cases comprises over 209 acres and has been run since 1950 by the Delon Family. Currently, the estate is run by the well-known Michel Delon.

Chateau Leoville Las Cases is one of the largest and oldest classified growths in the Medoc region of France. The fruit is harvested by hand. The fermentation vessels include a fascinating mix of wooden, cement and stainless steel vats. When finished the wine is pumped to the barrel cellar. Here it is transferred into oak barrique, between 50% and 100% new for the grand vin, depending on the vintage.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Incredible nose of crushed berry, licorice, violets and lightly toasted oak. Pure crème de cassis. Full-bodied, with big, velvety tannins and a long, long finish.

97 Points - James Suckling

This is more exotic and monstrous than the 2000. It is like a muscle builder, with lots of round and rich tannins and a core of dark fruits like black cherries and blueberries. 

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

An incredibly fresh, lively 2003 (the pH is only 3.6 and the alcohol is 13.1%), this wine offers a dense ruby/purple color along with full body and a remarkable nose of black currants, kirsch, lead pencil shavings and vanilla. Opulent, full-bodied and close to full maturity, it is a seamless classic that will age for 15-20 more years. Kudos to the Delon family for such a brilliant achievement in a tricky vintage.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is massive, hugely concentrated, topped with wood and intense tannins. Flavors of bitter chocolate are dominant, heavy fruits, blackberries and texture that fills the mouth with dark, dense flavors. Big in all senses.

title: Bushmills 25 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
This pinnacle ultra-aged Irish whiskey originates from the north coast of County Antrim, Northern Ireland, crafted at the historic Old Bushmills Distillery—the world’s oldest licensed whiskey distillery (granted grant to distil in 1608). Bushmills 25 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey is a permanent ultra-premium flagship release, distilled from 100% unpeated malted barley using water drawn from Saint Columb’s Rill and triple-distilled in copper pot stills. The spirit begins its maturation in a combination of charred American oak ex-bourbon barrels and Spanish Oloroso sherry butts for four to six years, before undergoing an unprecedented, monumental 21-year finishing period in first-fill ruby port pipes. Hand-bottled at 92 proof (46.0% ABV) in a bespoke heavy-weight decanter bottle, it is non-chill filtered and bottled at natural color.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a deep, radiant mahogany hue with rich copper and garnet reflections, leaving thick, slow-running legs along the glass. On the nose, it is remarkably deep, complex, and intensely perfumed, leading with lush red fruit compote, dark black cherries, damson plums, and ripe figs, before opening into layers of dark honey, sweet pipe tobacco, toasted almond, polished cedar, and warm vanilla bean. On the palate, the 46.0% ABV delivery feels opulent, velvety, and mouth-coating, bringing an immediate wave of juicy blackberries, candied orange peel, and dark chocolate ganache. The mid-palate introduces rich roasted walnuts, sweet baking spices (cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice), and integrated, gentle oak tannins without any wood bitterness. The finish is exceptionally long, warm, and elegant, lingering with dried dark fruit leather, cocoa powder, sweet oak spice, and a trailing whisper of warming ruby port sweetness.

title: Campagnola Pinot Grigio - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Campagnola Pinot Grigio is a beautiful Italian white wine that showcases the unique character of the Pinot Grigio grape. The wine's straw-yellow color with greenish reflections is stunning and inviting, giving a hint of the fresh and vibrant flavors that are to come.

On the nose, this wine offers an intense bouquet of juicy pear, crisp apple, and zesty citrus fruit, with delicate floral and mineral notes adding complexity and depth. These aromas are beautifully expressed on the palate, where the wine's fresh and fruity taste is complemented by a well-balanced acidity that makes it a perfect companion for a variety of dishes.

With its light to medium body and smooth finish, Campagnola Pinot Grigio is an incredibly versatile wine that pairs well with many different foods, including seafood, salads, white meats, and vegetarian cuisine. It is also a delightful wine to enjoy on its own, whether as a refreshing aperitif or a perfect companion to a warm summer day.

title: Nino Franco Prosecco Rustico - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Nino Franco's non-vintage sparkling Rustico Prosecco is unquestionably the world's finest value in a high quality, Champagne look-alike. The non-vintage, light-bodied Prosecco di Valdobiaddene Rustico offers gorgeously elegant, fresh, lively fruit, notes of bread dough and citrus and persistent effervescence.

title: Villa Teresa Organic Prosecco - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Organic, delicious and a fantastic value. A family business, Vini Tonon was founded in 1936 in the Veneto wine region of northeastern Italy. Only organic agriculture was used in the production of this wine. This Prosecco is Italy's answer to a well made sparkling wine at a reasonable price. Light straw in colour with small bubbles and a crisp clean taste.

title: Villa Teresa Organic Rose Frizzante - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the delle Venezie IGT appellation, Villa Teresa Organic Rosé Sparkling Frizzante represents a light, effervescent, and eco-friendly expression of Italian sparkling rosé. Crafted by the historic Dinami family estate, the Villa Teresa line is a pioneer in certified organic and vegan viticulture in northeastern Italy. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyards situated across the plains and rolling hills of the Veneto, the vines thrive in alluvial soils rich in limestone and clay. The winemaking philosophy focuses on environmental sustainability and minimal intervention, utilizing gentle pressing with brief skin contact to achieve a delicate pink blush, followed by secondary natural fermentation in pressurized stainless steel tanks (Charmat method) to produce a gentle, soft pressure (frizzante) bubble.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous pale salmon pink colour with delicate peach highlights and a lively, persistent bead of fine gentle bubbles. An expressive, fruit-forward bouquet opens with fresh aromas of wild strawberry, red raspberry, pink grapefruit, and white peach, interwoven with subtle notes of acacia flowers, orange blossom, and a touch of rose petal. On the palate, it is light bodied, crisp, and delightfully spritzy, delivering charming flavours of tart red berries, citrus zest, and sweet watermelon, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a delicate mousse and a soft, refreshing mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, uplifting finish marked by lingering red berries, fresh floral notes, and a crisp mineral lift. Composed of an organic blend featuring Raboso and Glera, it offers an approachable, energetic profile with immediate drinking appeal. Stylistically, it combines Venetian spritz, organic purity, and effortless sparkling refreshment.

title: Bottega Gold Brut - 200 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Bottega Gold Brut originates from Italy, within the northeastern Veneto region and the Prosecco DOC. The winery, widely recognized for its iconic and eye-catching mirrored gold-plated bottle, has built a global reputation for blending Italian style with high-quality viticulture. The brand's philosophy focuses on capturing the true aromatic potential of the region's terroirs, selecting grapes from hillside vineyards in the province of Treviso where mild climates and significant day-to-night temperature shifts enhance the aromatic complexity of the fruit.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine presents a bright, straw yellow colour in the glass, enlivened by a fine and persistent perlage. The sensory profile is refined and expressive, featuring an aromatic nose of green apples, pears, and citrus fruits, layered with delicate floral notes of white flowers, acacia, wisteria, and lily of the valley, finishing with hints of sage and soft spices. On the palate, it is soft, harmonious, and elegant, delivering a slim body with a lively yet balanced acidity that complements its clean fruit character. The finish is crisp and persistent, leaving a refreshing, dry impression.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Glera.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is crafted using the Charmat (tank) method, where fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks to safeguard the natural freshness and vibrant, fruity brightness of the grape variety.

  • ABV: 11%.

  • Organic Status: While Bottega emphasizes environmental sustainability across its operations, this specific commercial bottling is not certified organic.

title: Superflux Colour & Shape IPA - 50 Litre Keg
vendor: 300772 - Copper And Theory Artisan Beer Supply
bodyHtml:
Colour & Shape is the iconic flagship India Pale Ale from Vancouver, British Columbia’s Superflux Beer Company. Born during their early days as a nomadic brewing project before anchoring their cult-favorite brewery and hot dog lounge in East Van’s "Yeast Van" district, this beer helped define the New England IPA landscape in Western Canada. Known for their uncompromising obsession with hop quality, freshness, and striking minimalist can aesthetics, Superflux built Colour & Shape as the ultimate expression of a Hazy / New England IPA (NEIPA): deeply saturated with tropical hop oils, velvety in texture, and virtually devoid of harsh, palate-scraping bitterness.

Beer Description

Colour & Shape pours a luminous, completely opaque, turbid pastel yellow-orange, resembling fresh-squeezed multivitamin juice, capped with a creamy, dense white foam that laces in thick, sticky sheets down the glass.

Aroma: The nose is an intense, room-filling aromatic punch of saturated tropical juice. It erupts with dominant notes of candied pineapple, ripe mango, and sweet passion fruit, accompanied by bright layers of crushed citrus zest, peach gummy rings, and a subtle damp, dank cannabis undertone.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-to-full bodied with a plush, pillow-soft, and creamy mouthfeel driven by low, gentle carbonation. The sip opens with a massive wash of sweet tropical citrus, guava, and pulpy orange juice, supported by a doughy, cereal-grain sweetness. The mid-palate remains smooth and round, entirely bypassing sharp alcohol or astringent hop burn, gliding into a soft, semi-dry finish with just a whisper of clean, grassy citrus-pith bitterness to prevent it from feeling cloying.

Profile: It sits at a classic 6.5% ABV with a deliberately low perceived bitterness (approx. 30–35 IBU), ensuring the focus stays squarely on pure hop aroma and velvety texture.

Technical Notes: The pillowy mouthfeel and milky turbidity of Colour & Shape are achieved through a grain bill packed with high-protein flaked oats and malted wheat, paired with a specialized chloride-heavy water profile to enhance softness and suppress sharp bitterness. Superflux leans heavily on massive charges of Citra hops (alongside supporting Pacific Northwest varieties) applied almost exclusively during the whirlpool and through intensive multi-stage dry-hopping during and post-fermentation. An expressive English ale yeast strain contributes stone-fruit esters while helping keep hop polyphenol compounds in colloidal suspension.

title: Phillips Solaris Citrus - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Solaris White Peach Ale is a warm-weather, patio-defining staple from Victoria, British Columbia’s Phillips Brewing & Malting Co. Renowned across Western Canada for their boundary-pushing brewing culture, in-house malting facility, and eye-catching comic-book-style art, Phillips created Solaris to capture pure summer sunshine in a glass. While originally known under the "White Peach Ale" banner, it delivers a deeply refreshing hybrid experience: blending the crisp, effervescent, and wheaty foundation of a Belgian-Style Witbier with real fruit puree and vibrant citrus aromatics.

Beer Description

Solaris pours a radiant, hazy golden-straw color with pale peach highlights, topped by a lively, frothy white foam head that holds a persistent ring and leaves soft, delicate lacing.

Aroma: The nose is extraordinarily bright, fresh, and fruit-forward. It opens with an immediate burst of sweet white peach flesh and fuzzy peach nectar, quickly followed by bright top notes of lemon-lime zest, crushed coriander, and sweet orange peel, resting over a clean, doughy wheat grain base.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a brisk, spritzy, and thirst-quenching carbonation. It leads with an authentic splash of succulent white peach and tart citrus, offering a subtle fruit sweetness that never crosses into syrupy territory. The mid-palate reveals the classic witbier backbone; notes of cracked wheat, faint herbal spice, and light yeast esters before finishing clean, dry, and exceptionally crisp with a mouth-watering fruit acidity.

Profile: It sits at a friendly, highly sessionable 4.3% ABV and a very low bitterness of approx. 10–12 IBU, prioritizing fruit-forward aromatics, refreshing acidity, and high drinkability over hop bite.

Technical Notes: Solaris is built on a base of Canadian two-row barley malted in Phillips’ own proprietary malt house, blended with a generous proportion of malted and unmalted wheat to provide body, haze, and a silky mouthfeel. It is fermented with a clean Belgian ale yeast strain that contributes subtle clove and citrus esters. The beer is infused with natural white peach puree and citrus peel, which integrate smoothly on the cold side to preserve delicate aromatic volatiles without adding artificial, cloying sweetness.

title: Driftwood Raised by Wolves IPA - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Raised by Wolves IPA is a benchmark modern India Pale Ale from Victoria, British Columbia’s acclaimed Driftwood Brewery. Known across Western Canada for their fiercely independent spirit and pioneering hop-forward beers. Driftwood introduced Raised by Wolves to champion a distinctly fruit-forward, stone-fruit profile. While classic West Coast IPAs lean heavily into aggressive pine and palate-scraping bitterness, Raised by Wolves is a juicy, expressive Hazy/Contemporary IPA that pushes intense tropical aromatics to the forefront while retaining just enough Northwest structure to keep it razor-sharp and drinkable.

Beer Description

Raised by Wolves pours a glowing, lightly hazy golden-tangerine hue, crowned by a thick, frothy off-white head that leaves dense, sticky curtains of lacing clinging to the glass.

Aroma: The nose is an absolute hop explosion, intensely aromatic and juicy. It leads with dominant notes of fresh mango flesh, ripe yellow peach, and candied papaya, layered over bright top notes of tangerine zest, lime peel, and a subtle undertone of damp Northwest pine needles.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a lush, soft, yet lively effervescent mouthfeel. It opens with a wave of tropical stone fruit, juicy nectarine, and sweet citrus pulp, grounded by a clean, crackery malt base. The mid-palate introduces a brisk, resinous hop character that reins in the fruit sweetness, transitioning into a crisp, semi-dry finish marked by a clean, lingering grapefruit-pith bitterness.

Profile: It sits at an approachable, punchy 7.0% ABV and a balanced, firm bitterness of approx. 50–55 IBU, delivering saturated hop flavor without the punishing bite of traditional old-school IPAs.

Technical Notes: The defining character of Raised by Wolves comes from a focused hop bill headlined by Equinox (now known as Ekuanot) alongside complementary modern Pacific Northwest varieties like Citra. Driftwood utilizes a grist incorporating malted wheat alongside standard pale two-row to create a supple, pillowy body that suspends hop oils. Heavy whirlpool additions and massive cold-side dry hopping preserve the delicate terpenes and myrcene oils responsible for its signature green pepper, papaya, and citrus aromatics, while keeping astringent tannins at bay.

title: Blindman Ichorous Imperial Stout - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Ichorous Imperial Stout is an unapologetically massive, high-gravity offering from Lacombe, Alberta’s renowned Blindman Brewing. Named after ichor the ethereal fluid said to flow in the veins of Greek gods this beer lives up to its mythical moniker with sheer weight, viscosity, and depth. Blindman, celebrated for their scientific precision, barrel-aging prowess, and commitment to local prairie grains, built Ichorous to showcase the absolute upper limits of roasted malt complexity without relying on pasty dessert-sweet adjuncts. It stands as an authentic, powerhouse Russian Imperial Stout that balances rich malt decadence with structured bitterness.

Beer Description

Ichorous pours an opaque, midnight black (SRM 46) into the glass with motor-oil thickness, producing a dense, velvety, mocha-brown head that settles slowly into a thick collar and leaves sticky curtains of lacing.

Aroma: The nose is intense, complex, and intoxicatingly dark. It leads with prominent waves of dark roast espresso beans, baker’s bittersweet chocolate, and black strap molasses, layered over deeper accents of charred oak, dried figs, dark raisins, and subtle warming alcohol fumes.

Palate: On the tongue, it is exceptionally full-bodied with a dense, chewy, and coating mouthfeel balanced by fine, soft carbonation. The initial sip delivers an avalanche of fudge, cacao nibs, and toasted rye bread, quickly met by a sturdy mid-palate of black licorice, dark fruit, and roasty ash. The massive malt base is checked by an assertive, resinous hop bite and roasted malt bitterness, finishing with a pleasant, lingering warmth and a semi-dry, dark chocolate finish.

Profile: It packs a heavyweight 11.0% ABV and a robust bitterness of 80 IBU (Original Gravity: 1.110, Final Gravity: 1.024), creating a classic, assertive imperial stout profile where high residual sweetness is kept in check by substantial bitterness.

Technical Notes: Blindman crafts Ichorous from an enormous grist of Alberta two-row pale malt paired with an array of specialty roasted grains, including roasted barley, chocolate malt, and dark crystal malts. Fermented thoroughly to reach its 11% threshold, it receives a heavy charge of kettle hops to reach 80 IBU, providing the necessary backbone to prevent a brew with a 1.110 starting gravity from turning cloying. It also serves as the prime canvas for Blindman’s coveted barrel-aged reserve programs.

title: Segura Viudas Heredad Cava - 200 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Pale yellow colour. On the nose, there is plenty of intense and harmonious aromas with hints of citrus fruits and green apples. On the palate, carefully selected organic grapes have resulted in a higher quality cava. Very intense and fresh, the fine and well-integrated bubbles blend with a fruity character and a few pastry notes. Really pleasant finish.

title: Tito's Handmade Vodka - 200 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Tito's uses old-fashioned pot stills and taste-test every batch. Their process, similar to that used to make fine single malt scotches and high-end French cognacs, requires more skill and effort, but they think it’s well worth it!

Tito’s Handmade Vodka is America’s Original Craft Vodka. In 1995, Bert “Tito” Beveridge obtained the first legal permit to distill in Texas and created Tito’s Handmade Vodka. They batch distill their corn-based vodka using old-fashioned pot stills and the vodka is naturally gluten-free. Tito’s Handmade Vodka is distilled and bottled by Fifth Generation Inc. in Austin, Texas on the very same land where the whole venture started.

title: Quevedo Colheita 2010 Tawny Port - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
This single-harvest fortified wine originates from the rugged, terraced hillsides of the Cima Corgo and Douro Superior sub-regions in northern Portugal's Douro Valley, crafted by family-owned Quevedo Port Wine (Vinhos Oscar Quevedo). A Colheita is a single-vintage tawny port aged in seasoned wooden casks for a minimum of seven years—though Quevedo typically matures their Colheitas well beyond the statutory minimum before bottling. Blended from estate vineyards planted with traditional indigenous Portuguese grape varieties—predominantly Touriga Franca, Touriga Nacional, Tinta Roriz (Tempranillo), Tinta Barroca, and Tinto Cão—the fermentation is halted midway by the addition of neutral grape spirit (aguardente) to preserve natural residual grape sweetness. After aging patiently in seasoned French and Portuguese oak pipas (550-to-600-liter casks), this 2010 vintage was bottled at 39 proof (19.5% ABV) in a standard 750 ml format, fully stabilized and ready to drink upon release.

Spirit Description

This Colheita displays a luminous tawny-amber hue with copper-brick reflections and slow, unctuous legs in the glass. On the nose, it is expressive, warm, and nut-forward, opening with concentrated aromas of dried figs, Medjool dates, sultanas, and orange peel marmalade, layered over toasted hazelnuts, roasted almonds, butterscotch, and warm vanilla bean. On the palate, it delivers a medium-to-full-bodied, velvety, and silky mouthfeel, balancing its rich residual sugar with a lively seam of natural grape acidity. Flavors of caramelized orchard fruit, toffee, and candied walnut flood the front palate before giving way to delicate mid-palate notes of sweet baking spices (cinnamon stick and nutmeg), cocoa dust, and seasoned oak tannins. The finish is remarkably long, clean, and persistent, trailing off with toasted wood spice, dried apricot, and a lingering citrus-peel warmth.

Accolades

Quevedo's Colheita releases hold high acclaim among Port critics, sommeliers, and fortified wine publications, routinely earning 90+ point scores from outlets like Wine Spectator, Decanter, and Wine Enthusiast. Reviewers consistently commend Oscar and Cláudia Quevedo for their hands-on, modern approach to single-vintage tawny aging. Critics specifically praise Quevedo Colheitas for preserving vibrant core fruit freshness alongside oxidative tertiary nuttiness, avoiding the heavy, syrupy over-concentration found in less balanced aged tawnies.

title: Heineken - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Heineken Lager Beer is a global powerhouse and the definitive face of the International Pale Lager. Founded in 1864 by Gerard Adriaan Heineken in Amsterdam, it became the first premium Dutch lager to conquer the world stage. Recognized by its iconic green bottle and red star, it is designed to be a consistent, high-quality "world beer" that tastes the same whether you are in a bar in Amsterdam, a stadium in London, or a patio in Calgary. It is a beer that prioritizes crispness and a specific "skunky" hop character that has become its global signature.

Beer Description

Heineken pours a bright, crystal-clear straw gold with a lively, effervescent carbonation and a frothy white head that maintains decent persistence.

Aroma: The nose is distinct and instantly recognizable. It leads with a slightly skunky, herbal hop aroma, followed by a clean, sweet scent of pale malt and corn-like grain. Because it is famously bottled in green glass, the light-strike provides a "dank" herbal quality that fans of the brand have come to expect as part of its profile.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and highly refreshing. It leads with a crisp grainy sweetness and notes of cracker, which is quickly followed by a moderate, grassy bitterness. The mouthfeel is "zippy" due to high carbonation, and the finish is exceptionally clean and dry with a lingering herbal snap.

Profile: It sits at a standard 5.0% ABV and a balanced bitterness of approx. 19–23 IBU, providing more "bite" than many American-style light lagers.

Technical Notes: The heart of Heineken’s flavor is their proprietary "A-Yeast." Developed in the 19th century, this specific strain provides the subtle fruity notes and the crisp, clean finish that distinguishes it from other mass-market lagers. It is brewed with 100% natural ingredients—barley malt, water, hops, and yeast—and is fermented in horizontal tanks to provide the yeast with the ideal pressure to develop its signature flavor profile.

title: Lamarca Prosecco - 187 ml Bottle - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the Prosecco DOC appellation, Lamarca Prosecco represents a quintessential, sparkling, and refreshing expression of Italian Glera. Produced by La Marca Trevigiana, a highly respected cooperative of growers in northeastern Italy founded in 1968, the brand has become a global standard for premium Prosecco. Sourced from sun-drenched vineyards across the rolling hills of Treviso, the winemaking philosophy focuses on gentle pressing of the grapes followed by a controlled secondary fermentation in stainless steel pressure tanks using the Charmat method. This process preserves the grape's delicate aromatic compounds, bright fruit acidity, and vibrant natural effervescence, creating a clean, crisp, and refreshing sparkling wine suitable for any celebration.

Wine Description

The wine presents a pale straw yellow colour with delicate greenish reflections and a fine, persistent stream of lively bubbles. An inviting, highly aromatic bouquet opens with fresh notes of green apple, white peach, and juicy Meyer lemon, interwoven with delicate nuances of white flowers, honey, and subtle citrus blossom. On the palate, it is light bodied, crisp, and lively, delivering refreshing flavours of crisp orchard fruit and lemon zest supported by a vibrant, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Finishing clean, dry, and invigorating, it leaves a pleasant, lingering impression of sweet apple and subtle mineral freshness. Composed predominantly of Glera, it offers an exceptionally versatile, food-friendly, and uplifting sparkling wine profile with broad global appeal.

title: Martini & Rossi Asti (NV) - 200 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Crafted from 100% handpicked Moscato Bianco grapes, grown in Northern Italy. It is ranked DOCG, the highest classification granted to Italian wines.

title: Bottega Rose Gold Extra Brut - 200 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s Veneto region, Bottega Rose Gold is a sparkling rosé Prosecco crafted entirely from Pinot Noir grapes. Presented in a striking rose gold-tone 200 ml bottle, it combines style, elegance, and flavour in a size perfect for parties, weddings, and special occasions.

Wine Description
This sparkling rosé displays a delicate salmon-pink colour with lively, persistent bubbles. The nose reveals fresh strawberry, raspberry, and subtle floral aromas, layered with hints of cream and vanilla. On the palate, it is fruit-forward and refreshing, made in a slightly off-dry style that balances juicy red berry flavours with bright acidity. The finish is smooth, light, and celebratory

Food Pairing
A natural partner to cakes, berry tarts, and fruit-based desserts, this sparkling rosé also pairs beautifully with vanilla sponge or cream-filled pastries. These combinations highlight the wine’s red fruit character and its touch of sweetness.

title: Grey Goose La Poire Vodka - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Grey Goose La Poire Vodka originates from France, crafted in the renowned Cognac region. The brand was created by Francois Thibault, a Maître de Chais, who used his expertise to pioneer a super premium French vodka. It is owned by Bacardi, which continues to produce the spirit using traditional French ingredients and methods.

Spirit Description

This flavoured vodka presents a brilliant, crystal clear appearance. The aroma opens with sweet, ripe Anjou pear layered with subtle floral notes and fresh fruit orchard accents. On the palate, it offers a smooth, medium body with a refined balance of natural fruit sweetness and crisp grain character. The finish is long, clean, and refreshing with enduring notes of juicy pear. It features an ABV of 40%.

title: Ole Smoky Hunch Punch Moonshine - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Ole Smoky Hunch Punch Lightnin' Moonshine is produced in the United States, within the region of Tennessee and the subregion of Gatlinburg. Founded in 2010 by Joe Baker, Ole Smoky Distillery was the first federally licensed distillery in the history of East Tennessee. The company operates four experiential distilleries in Tennessee and remains a pioneer in the legal moonshine industry, with the founders continuing as significant shareholders following an acquisition by Apax Partners in 2022.

Spirit Description

This potent spirit is a hearty yet refined version of traditional party punch, crafted from a century-old family recipe. It presents a radiant clarity and features a summery blend of natural juices including orange, pineapple, and cherry. The nose explodes with tropical fruit aromas and a hint of sweet citrus, while the palate offers a juicy medley of fruit flavours tempered by clean mineral undertones and a warm, peppery kick. It possesses a smooth, medium-sweet body and a lingering finish that captures the essence of Southern tradition.

title: Ole Smoky Apple Pie Moonshine - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Ole Smoky Apple Pie Mini Moonshine is produced in the United States, within the region of Tennessee and the subregion of Gatlinburg. Founded in 2010 by Joe Baker, Ole Smoky Distillery was the first federally licensed distillery in the history of East Tennessee. While the company was acquired by the private equity firm Apax Partners in 2022, the founders remain significant shareholders in what has become the most visited distillery in the world.

This flavoured moonshine is crafted from an authentic Appalachian recipe using a corn whiskey base blended with pure apple juice, ground cinnamon, and other spices. It presents a clear appearance with a golden hue. The nose is warm and inviting, offering aromatic notes of freshly baked apple pie and sweet cinnamon. On the palate, it is smooth and comforting with the taste of crisp, juicy apples harmonized by subtle baking spices. It possesses a medium body and a long, warm finish that leaves a delightful lingering sweetness.

title: Copper Moon Cabernet Sauvignon - 1.5 Litre Bottle - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Medium-bodied with flavours of plum, blueberry and cherry. Notes of berries and a touch of spice linger on the finish. Pairs well with pizza, red sauce pastas, vegetarian stews and mild cheddar.

title: Copper Moon Pinot Grigio - 1.5 Litre Bottle - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Clear straw colour. Light floral with apple, pear and citrus aromas. Dry, light body. Soft peach and lemon flavours with a crisp finish.

title: Copper Moon Cabernet Sauvignon - 4 Litre Box - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Medium-bodied with flavours of plum, blueberry and cherry. Notes of berries and a touch of spice linger on the finish. Pairs well with pizza, red sauce pastas, vegetarian stews and mild cheddar.

title: Copper Moon Sauvignon Blanc - 4 Litre Box - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Light and Fresh. Notes of citrus, passion fruit and gooseberry. Pairs well with grilled pork, chicken with fresh herbs and mixed salads with light vinaigrette.

title: Elijah Craig Toasted Barrel 94 Proof
bodyHtml:
This finished Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey originates from Bardstown, Kentucky, produced by the family-owned Heaven Hill Distillery. Elijah Craig Toasted Barrel builds upon the legacy of the Reverend Elijah Craig, credited in bourbon lore with pioneering the charred oak aging process. Crafted from Heaven Hill’s traditional bourbon mash bill—78% corn, 10% rye, and 12% malted barley—this release begins with fully matured Elijah Craig Small Batch (aged roughly 8 to 12 years). It then undergoes a secondary finishing period in custom toasted new American oak barrels crafted in partnership with Independent Stave Company. These finishing casks are constructed from 18-month air-dried wood, subjected to a moderate toast level followed by a flash char. Bottled at the brand's classic 94 proof (47.0% ABV) in a 750 ml bottle, it introduces dense wood sugars and confectionery oak complexity to the traditional bourbon profile.

Spirit Description

This bourbon pours a rich, deep mahogany-amber hue with burnished copper highlights and thick, slow-running tears along the glass. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic, decadent, and dessert-like, leading with rich vanilla bean, toasted marshmallow, dark caramel, and molten brown sugar, underlaid by roasted pecans, charred coconut, dark cocoa, and sweet seasoned oak. On the palate, the 94 proof delivery is remarkably creamy, viscous, and full-bodied. An initial wave of sweet milk chocolate, crème brûlée crust, and butterscotch coats the tongue before transitioning into mid-palate notes of toasted graham cracker, campfire smoke, sweet baking spices (cinnamon stick and nutmeg), and polished cedar tannins. The secondary toasted wood adds concentrated sweetness and pastry notes without introducing bitter astringency. The finish is long, warm, and lingering, leaving trailing impressions of charred marshmallow, sweet oak spice, vanilla cream, and lingering dark chocolate.

title: Whitley Neill Distiller’s Cut London Dry Gin
bodyHtml:
This handcrafted English spirit originates from London, England, distilled at the historic City of London Distillery—the first operating gin distillery inside the Square Mile in nearly two centuries. Created by eighth-generation distiller Johnny Neill, Whitley Neill Distiller’s Cut London Dry Gin serves as the brand's classic, juniper-forward tribute to traditional English distilling heritage. Distilled in traditional copper pot stills using 100% grain neutral spirit, it is vapor-infused and macerated with a classic botanical bill featuring Macedonian juniper berries, coriander seed, angelica root, liquorice, and orris root, balanced by an elevated addition of dried sweet orange peel and candied citrus zest. Bottled at an elevated export strength of 86 proof (43.0% ABV) in a standard 700 ml (or 750 ml) cobalt-blue bottle, it adheres strictly to the rigorous London Dry standard, containing no artificial flavors, colorings, or sweeteners added after distillation.

Spirit Description This gin exhibits crystal-clear, diamond-bright transparency with quick, crisp legs along the glass. On the nose, it is assertive, fresh, and pine-forward, opening with a bold burst of fresh green juniper and aromatic pine needles, instantly countered by vibrant, zesty sweet orange, candied lemon peel, and crushed coriander spice. Beneath the citrus and evergreen core lie grounding earthy accents of angelica root, woody liquorice, and gentle floral orris. On the palate, the 43.0% ABV base provides a silky, structured, and mouth-filling texture. An initial wave of sharp resinous juniper and bright sweet orange oil rolls across the tongue before giving way to complex mid-palate notes of cracked white pepper, warm cardamomic coriander, and subtle earthy root sweetness. The profile remains bone-dry with exceptional clarity of flavor. The finish is crisp, clean, and persistent, drying out with lingering impressions of pine resin, bitter orange marmalade, and a delicate peppery warmth.

title: Aalborg Taffel Aquavit – 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This definitive Scandinavian botanical spirit originates from Denmark, produced under the historic Aalborg brand (dating back to 1846 and created by Isidor Henius). Affectionately known in Denmark as "Rød Aalborg" (Red Aalborg) due to its iconic red label, Aalborg Taffel Aquavit is the benchmark standard for classic Danish Taffel (table) akvavit. Distilled from grain-neutral spirit, it is redistilled with whole dried caraway seeds (Carum carvi) and amber distillate to yield an assertive, clear, savory botanical profile. Unaged and uncolored, it is bottled at traditional export strength of 90 proof (45.0% ABV) in a 700 ml bottle, adhering strictly to EU Appellation rules requiring caraway or dill as the dominant botanical flavor.

Spirit Description

This aquavit presents brilliant, crystalline water-white clarity with clean, brisk legs running along the glass. On the nose, it is pungent, savory, and unmistakably aromatic, driven by bold cracked caraway seed, rye bread crust, and fresh fennel, supported by secondary undertones of dried orange peel, anise, and a light pine-like herbaceous freshness. On the palate, the 45.0% ABV backbone delivers an assertive, punchy, and warming mouthfeel. An immediate burst of intense, spicy caraway and sweet licorice coats the tongue before opening into mid-palate nuances of citrus oil, crushed coriander seed, and cracked black pepper. Being completely unaged in oak, the spirit is crisp, dry, and razor-sharp with no residual sweetness or wood tannins. The finish is long, dry, and intensely warming, leaving persistent impressions of toasted caraway, rye grain spice, and a clean, refreshing herbal coolness.

title: Paul Giraud Tres Rare Cognac - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This pinnacle single-estate French grape brandy originates from Bouteville in the heart of the Grande Champagne premier cru, produced by Domaine Paul Giraud. Tending vines continuously since 1650, the Giraud family crafts Très Rare as their benchmark ancient cuvée. Distilled exclusively from Ugni Blanc grapes harvested from the estate's chalk soils, the wine underwent double distillation in traditional copper Charentais pot stills before entering a natural, patient maturation in damp family cellars. Matured for roughly 40 years in seasoned French oak casks, it is bottled at 80 proof (40.0% ABV) in a 700 ml bespoke crystal-style decanter. In keeping with Giraud's estate ethos, it is completely free of chill-filtration, artificial caramel coloring, sugar, or oak extracts (boisé).

Spirit Description

This ultra-aged Cognac displays a luminous, deep amber-mahogany hue with polished copper reflections and thick, slow-creeping tears in the glass. On the nose, it delivers an extraordinary display of mature, textbook rancio, opening with dried Smyrna figs, prune preserves, candied orange peel, and dark apricot, layered over polished antique cedar, old saddle leather, beeswax, pipe tobacco, and dried yellow flowers. On the palate, it feels exceptionally velvety, supple, and weightless, gliding across the tongue without a hint of wood astringency. Concentrated flavors of roasted walnuts, dark chocolate, and orange marmalade unfold into delicate mid-palate notes of nutmeg, grated cinnamon, sandalwood, and a lingering, chalky mineral freshness unique to old Grande Champagne terroir. The finish is remarkably long, gentle, and ethereal, trailing off with dried stone fruits, antique wood oils, gentle cocoa, and soft, warm spice.

title: Cabin Brewing Winter Saturation - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Winter Saturation is an intentional detour from conventional seasonal brewing by Calgary’s haze masters at Cabin Brewing Company. While the craft beer industry often retreats into heavy, high-gravity stouts and spiced holiday warmers as temperatures plummet, Cabin’s Fruited Hazy Pale Ale takes the contrarian approach: it fights the bleak, freezing Calgary winter by delivering a bright, tropical, and luminous burst of sunshine in a glass. As part of Cabin’s acclaimed "Saturation" line (anchored by their flagship Super Saturation), Winter Saturation builds upon an oil-rich hop base with seasonal, tart winter fruits to create an uncharacteristically vibrant and crushable cool-weather pour.

Beer Description

Winter Saturation pours a radiant, glowing peach-to-sunset ruby hue with an opaque, hazy suspension, capped by a frothy, off-white foam head that holds a steady collar and laces delicately down the glass.

Aroma: The nose is an assertive, punchy wave of bright red fruit and juicy citrus zest. It leads with dominant aromas of tart cranberry and pomegranate seed, backed by sweet top notes of fleshy Cara Cara orange, ruby red grapefruit, and tropical passion fruit. Beneath the bright fruit layer sits a gentle, doughy foundation of sweet oats and cracked wheat.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-light bodied with a plush, velvety, yet briskly effervescent mouthfeel. It opens with an immediate, mouth-watering splash of tangy cranberry and sweet Cara Cara orange juice, seamlessly merging with the tropical stone-fruit notes of the underlying hop bill. The mid-palate introduces a refreshing, thirst-quenching fruit acidity that keeps the beer lively, before trailing off into a soft, mildly tart, and clean finish with minimal hop bite.

Profile: It sits at an approachable, session-friendly 5.0% ABV and features a low perceived bitterness, prioritizing vibrant fruit acidity and hop saturation over lingering IBUs.

Technical Notes: Cabin constructs the grain bill with heavy additions of flaked oats and malted wheat to establish the pillowy base typical of their hazy series. The foundational dry-hop dosing uses the classic pairing of Citra and Mosaic hops to unleash layers of citrus oils and tropical aromas. The defining layer is the cold-side infusion of real fruit: cranberry, pomegranate, and Cara Cara orange. This trio introduces natural citric and malic acidity alongside berry pigmentation, transforming the classic hazy profile into a tart, fruit-integrated pale ale without driving up residual sugars.

title: Domaine Joseph Roty Gevrey Chambertin 'Cuvee de Clos Prieur Bas' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Gevrey Chambertin AOC appellation in the Côte de Nuits, Domaine Joseph Roty Gevrey Chambertin 'Cuvée de Clos Prieur Bas' represents an authentic, old-vine, and classically structured expression of village-level Pinot Noir. Domaine Joseph Roty is among the most historic, revered family domaines in Gevrey-Chambertin, tracing continuous wine production back to 1710. Sourced from the lieu-dit 'Clos Prieur Bas'—situated immediately downslope from the premier cru section of Clos Prieur—the vineyard blocks feature venerable old vines planted predominantly in the 1960s on deep, limestone-rich clay soils with exceptional drainage. Under the direction of Pierre-Jean Roty and the winemaking team, the cellar adheres strictly to traditional Burgundian methods: hand harvesting, rigorous sorting, destemming, cool pre-fermentation maceration, ambient yeast fermentation in concrete vats, and maturation for 15 to 16 months in French oak barrels (approximately 30% to 50% new oak) without fining or filtration. The result is a concentrated, velvety red Burgundy that regularly challenges Premier Cru benchmarks in complexity, textural depth, and cellaring power.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous medium ruby-garnet colour with vibrant crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, black raspberry, and dark plum compote, interwoven with sophisticated notes of violet blossom, game, forest floor, crushed limestone minerality, and warm French oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, sour plum, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained tannins and a dense, well-proportioned mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, dried herbs, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it combines Roty's signature old-vine concentration, rustic elegance, and quintessential Gevrey-Chambertin mineral muscle.

title: Domaine Joseph Roty Cote de Nuits Villages 'La Croix Violette' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Côte de Nuits Villages AOC appellation, Domaine Joseph Roty Côte de Nuits Villages 'La Croix Violette' represents an authentic, old-vine, and classically structured expression of Pinot Noir. Domaine Joseph Roty is one of the historic, traditional domaines of Gevrey-Chambertin, tracing its family winemaking roots in the Côte de Nuits back to 1710. The estate is celebrated for possessing some of the oldest average vine age in Burgundy. Sourced from the single lieu-dit 'La Croix Violette' situated in the commune of Brochon just north of Fixin and adjacent to Gevrey-Chambertin, the vineyard blocks contain ancient vines planted between 1881 and 1950 in deep clay-limestone soils. Under the direction of Pierre-Jean Roty and the winemaking team, the philosophy adheres strictly to traditional methods: hand harvesting, destemming, cool pre-fermentation maceration, fermentation in cement vats with ambient yeasts, and maturation for 15 to 16 months in French oak barrels (approximately 20% to 30% new oak) without fining or filtration. The result is a concentrated, muscular red Burgundy that punches far above its appellation level with dark fruit richness, savory spice, and ageworthy tension.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous medium ruby-garnet colour with vibrant crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, black raspberry, and red currant, interwoven with sophisticated notes of violet blossom, game, forest floor, crushed limestone minerality, and warm French oak cedar spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, sour plum, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by firm, fine-grained tannins and a dense, well-proportioned mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, dried herbs, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it combines Roty's signature old-vine depth, rustic power, and quintessential Côte de Nuits mineral purity.

title: Padre Azul Anejo Tequila - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Padre Azul Anejo Tequila is matured in hand-selected oak bourbon barrels for at least 18 months. The additional oak influence gives this premium tequila complex flavours such as cinnamon, chocolate and caramelized nuts.

title: Jack Daniel's - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Set up in 1866, Jack Daniel's became the US's first registered distillery, it soon became a legendary American whiskey. Shows aromas and flavours of caramel, vanilla, nut and oak with smoky tones. The palate is smooth and sweet with light spicy finish. Serve neat or use in a cocktail.

title: Copper Moon Shiraz - 4 Litre Box - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada, produced by the major Canadian wine producer Andrew Peller Limited, Copper Moon Shiraz represents an approachable, smooth, and fruit-forward expression of everyday red winemaking. Sourced from a blend of domestic and international grapes cellared in Canada, the Copper Moon brand is designed to deliver accessible, crowd-pleasing wines for casual occasions. The winemaking philosophy focuses on soft pressing, temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation, and gentle oak contact to showcase bright varietal fruit sweetness, soft tannins, and easy-drinking charm.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, deep ruby purple colour with dark garnet highlights in the glass. An inviting and fruit-driven bouquet opens with aromas of ripe blackberry, wild plum, and dark cherry, interwoven with characteristic notes of black pepper, subtle cocoa, and gentle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, smooth, and supple, delivering generous flavours of dark berries, ripe plum, and subtle sweet spice supported by a balanced streak of fresh natural acidity. Framed by soft, rounded tannins and a clean texture, it concludes with a warm, velvety finish marked by lingering notes of dark fruit and soft baking spice.

title: Captain Morgan Private Stock Rum - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Made from the finest reserves, this amber beauty is aged for at least 2 years.
