title: Chateau Potensac 2012
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Bordeaux region, specifically within the Médoc AOC appellation, Château Potensac 2012 represents a classic, refined, and structured expression of Left Bank winemaking. Owned by the Delon family—the esteemed proprietors of Château Léoville Las Cases in Saint-Julien—Château Potensac has long been regarded as the reference point for high-calibre northern Médoc viticulture, historically distinguished as a Cru Bourgeois Exceptionnel. Located on a prominent gravel mound near Ordonnac, the estate's vineyard blocks benefit from a unique geological terroir comprising ancient Quaternary gravel, limestone-clay subsoils, and sandy loam. Under the direct supervision of Jean-Hubert Delon and the Léoville Las Cases winemaking team, the estate shares the same technical rigor and cellar discipline as its classified Saint-Julien sibling: parcel-by-parcel temperature-controlled fermentation in concrete and stainless steel vats, followed by maturation for 14 to 16 months in French oak barrels (approximately 30% new oak). The result is an aristocratic red wine that balances savoury cedar elegance, vibrant dark fruit, and classic Médoc mineral grip.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark garnet red colour with subtle brick-crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe black currant, dark plum compote, wild blackberry, and black cherry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of graphite, crushed gravel minerality, dried tobacco leaf, forest floor, cedar chest, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, sour cherry, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by fine-grained, well-resolved tannins and a taut, classical mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, wild herbs, and a clean gravelly mineral grip. Composed predominantly of Merlot (48%), Cabernet Sauvignon (34%), Cabernet Franc (17%), and Petit Verdot (1%), this 2012 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2022–2032. Stylistically, it combines classic Delon precision, gravelly freshness, and timeless Médoc poise.

title: Chateau Potensac 2016
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Bordeaux region, specifically within the Médoc AOC appellation, Château Potensac 2016 represents a classic, aristocratic, and long-lived expression of northern Left Bank winemaking. Owned by the Delon family—the esteemed proprietors of Château Léoville Las Cases in Saint-Julien—Château Potensac has long been recognized as the benchmark estate of the northern Médoc, historically classified as a Cru Bourgeois Exceptionnel. Situated on a high gravel mound near Ordonnac, the vineyard parcels benefit from a unique geological terroir comprising ancient Quaternary gravel, limestone subsoils, and clay loam. Under the direct management of Jean-Hubert Delon and the Léoville Las Cases winemaking team, the estate shares the same technical rigor and cellar philosophy as its Saint-Julien sibling: parcel-by-parcel temperature-controlled fermentation in temperature-regulated concrete and stainless steel vats, followed by maturation for 14 to 16 months in French oak barrels (approximately 30% new oak). The result is a refined, structured red wine that delivers the power, mineral precision, and cellaring capability traditionally expected of classified growths.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark garnet red colour with vibrant ruby and purple reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe black currant, wild blackberry, dark cherry, and cassis compote, interwoven with sophisticated notes of graphite, crushed gravel minerality, dried tobacco leaf, cedar chest, dark chocolate, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, sour plum, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate Left Bank acidity. Framed by fine-grained, classic Médoc tannins and a taut, well-structured mid-palate, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, wild herbs, and a clean gravelly mineral grip. Composed predominantly of Merlot (39%), Cabernet Sauvignon (36%), Cabernet Franc (23%), and Petit Verdot (2%), this 2016 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2038+. Stylistically, it combines classic Delon precision, gravelly freshness, and timeless Left Bank elegance.

title: Chateau Haut Brion Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Bordeaux region, specifically within the Pessac Léognan AOC appellation in the Graves, Château Haut Brion Blanc 2024 represents one of the world's most legendary, rare, and aristocratic expressions of dry white wine. While Château Haut Brion earned historic renown as a Premier Grand Cru Classé in the 1855 Classification for its red wine, its tiny production of white wine has long commanded equal or greater reverence among fine wine collectors. Sourced from less than three hectares of estate vineyards situated on high gravel terraces containing deep Günzian gravel, quartz pebbles, and clay-sand subsoils, the vines benefit from an ideal microclimate on the southwestern outskirts of Bordeaux. Under the stewardship of Prince Robert of Luxembourg, managing director Jean-Philippe Delmas, and the technical winemaking team, the grapes undergo meticulous manual harvesting in successive tries, gentle pneumatic pressing, and fermentation entirely in French oak barrels (approximately 45% to 50% new oak), followed by extended lees aging with regular stirring (bâtonnage). The result is a luminous, uncommonly textured white Bordeaux that balances opulent aromatic depth, electric tension, and monumental cellaring capacity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear pale gold colour with vibrant emerald and silvery reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe white peach, lemon curd, poached pear, and pink grapefruit, interwoven with sophisticated notes of orange blossom, honeysuckle, crushed flint minerality, beeswax, toasted brioche, and warm French oak cedar spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of orchard fruits, candied citrus peel, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by a rich, waxy mid-palate structure and seamless phenolic grip, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus zest, roasted hazelnut, and a clean gravelly mineral drive. Composed of a classic blend of Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2028–2050+. Stylistically, it combines monumental textural richness, crystalline mineral purity, and peerless Graves elegance.

title: Warre's 2024 Vintage Port
bodyHtml:
Originating from Portugal in the Douro region, specifically within the Porto DOC appellation, Warre's 2024 Vintage Port represents a monumental, historically revered, and intensely floral expression of classic Vintage Port. Established in 1670, Warre's holds the distinction of being the first British Port company established in Portugal, pioneered by John Clark and later joined by William Warre. Today, as a jewel in the portfolio of Symington Family Estates, Warre's remains renowned for its feminine, highly perfumed, and elegant house style. Sourced predominantly from the historic Quinta da Cavadinha in the cooler Pinhão Valley, as well as Quinta do Retiro and Quinta da Telhada in the Douro Superior, the vines grow on steep schist terraces at varying elevations. Under head winemaker Charles Symington, the winemaking philosophy combines traditional foot-treading in modern robotic lagares, brief temperature-controlled fermentation, and fortification with high-purity neutral grape spirit (aguardente), followed by approximately 18 months of maturation in seasoned oak vats before bottling unfiltered. The result is a vibrant, long-lived Vintage Port celebrated for its lifted violet aromatics, fresh fruit clarity, and seamless structural refinement.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep inky purple-black colour with luminous magenta reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe wild blackberry, dark plum compote, cassis, and black cherry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of rockrose (esteva), fresh violet blossom, eucalyptus, dark chocolate, graphite, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and explosive, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, licorice, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate Douro acidity. Framed by fine-grained, muscular tannins and an extraordinarily dense, well-proportioned mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering floral spice, dark fruit, and a clean schistose mineral grip. Composed primarily of Touriga Nacional and Touriga Franca with small proportions of old mixed-vineyard field blends (vinhas velhas), this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2034–2070+. Stylistically, it combines Warre's signature aromatic elegance, exceptional purity of fruit, and multi-decade cellaring nobility.

title: Berta Distillery - Di Anise Sambuca - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This artisanal Italian anise liqueur originates from Mombaruzzo in the Asti province of Piedmont, northern France/Italy border foothills, crafted by the historic Distillerie Berta. Renowned globally for their cellar-aged, single-varietal grappas, the Berta family created DiAnisè as an elevated interpretation of traditional Italian Sambuca. Produced through the slow hydro-alcoholic maceration and redistillation of high-grade star anise (Illicium verum) alongside a proprietary selection of Mediterranean botanicals, elderflowers, and citrus peels, the spirit is carefully blended with refined sugar syrup and Piedmontese mountain water. It is bottled clear at 80 proof (40.0% ABV) in Berta's signature heavy-bottomed, embossed square glass decanter (typically 700 ml), serving as a benchmark for artisan-distilled anise liqueurs.

Spirit Description

This liqueur displays brilliant, crystalline water-white transparency with exceptional viscosity, forming thick, slow-dropping tears along the walls of the glass. When diluted with cold water or poured over ice, it undergoes the classic ouzo effect (spontaneous louching), transforming into a milky, opalescent haze. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic, pungent, and pure, dominated by fresh cracked star anise, black licorice, and sweet fennel, layered over delicate herbal hints of elderflower, candied lemon peel, and fresh mint. On the palate, the 40.0% ABV base provides a thick, velvety, and syrupy mouthfeel that balances the sweetness. It delivers a rush of pure licorice and warm essential oils across the tongue before giving way to crisp mid-palate accents of elderberry blossom, gentle citrus zest, and an herbal herbal freshness that prevents cloying heaviness. The finish is long, cooling, and aromatic, leaving a persistent halo of sweet licorice, menthol coolness, and clean anise warmth.

title: Castiglion Del Bosco Rosso di Montalcino Gauggiole 2023
bodyHtml: Castiglion del Bosco's Rosso di Montalcino is a ruby red color. The nose is delicate and full of typical varietal aromas. In the mouth it is pleasant and harmonious. Its unique versatility makes it suitable for everyday drinking. This is a pleasant, modern wine, that represents a fresh and well-rounded expression of the Sangiovese grape. Its intense varietal aromas are the result of a combination of traditional and modern techniques in the cellar.

title: Chateau La Mission Haut Brion Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Bordeaux region, specifically within the Pessac Léognan AOC appellation in the Graves, Château La Mission Haut Brion Blanc 2024 represents one of the most prestigious, opulent, and historically celebrated dry white wines in the world. Directly facing its sibling estate Château Haut Brion across the road, Château La Mission Haut Brion shares the elite viticultural stewardship of Domaine Clarence Dillon under the direction of Prince Robert of Luxembourg and managing director Jean-Philippe Delmas. Historically produced under the famed Château Laville Haut Brion label (an official Cru Classé de Graves for white wine classified in 1953/1959), the wine was reunited under the iconic La Mission Haut Brion name beginning with the 2009 vintage. Sourced from tiny, prized vineyard plots on deep Günzian gravel beds over clay and sand subsoils, the estate practices meticulous manual harvesting in successive selective passes. The winemaking philosophy employs whole-cluster gentle pressing and fermentation entirely in French oak barrels (approximately 45% to 55% new oak), followed by aging on fine lees with regular stirring (bâtonnage). The result is an uncommonly concentrated, textured white Bordeaux that marries rich Sémillon waxiness, vibrant Sauvignon Blanc tension, and immense longevity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear pale gold colour with brilliant green and platinum reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe white peach, Meyer lemon, poached pear, and honeydew melon, interwoven with sophisticated notes of white floral blossom, beeswax, crushed flint minerality, lime leaf, toasted almond, and subtle French oak vanilla spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and remarkably viscous, delivering concentrated flavours of citrus oil, ripe stone fruits, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by an unctuous, broad mid-palate structure and seamless phenolic grip, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon curd, hazelnut brioche, and a clean gravelly mineral drive. Composed of a traditional Graves blend predominantly led by Sémillon alongside Sauvignon Blanc, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2028–2050+. Stylistically, it combines lavish textural depth, pure mineral tension, and aristocratic cellar endurance.

title: Bunnahabhain 12 Year Old Cask Strength 55.8 %
bodyHtml:
This unpeated Islay single malt Scotch whisky originates from the northeastern shore of the Isle of Islay, produced by Bunnahabhain Distillery overlooking the Sound of Islay. As part of the distillery's acclaimed annual limited-edition cask strength program, the Bunnahabhain 12 Year Old Cask Strength offers an undiluted, un-chillfiltered look at their classic flagship malt. Distilled from unpeated malted barley using pure spring water piped directly from the Margadale Spring, this expression matures for a full 12 years primarily in first-fill and second-fill Oloroso sherry casks, complemented by a small proportion of bourbon casks. Bottled at its exact natural batch cask strength of 111.6 proof (55.8% ABV) in a 700 ml bottle with zero added caramel coloring (E150a), it presents an intense, sherry-heavy profile anchored by maritime coastal air.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a deep, burnished copper-mahogany hue with polished bronze reflections and thick, slow-running tears in the glass. On the nose, it is dense, rich, and heavily aromatic, opening with dominant waves of dark dried fruits—Medjool dates, sultanas, prune compote, and candied orange peel—underlaid by roasted walnuts, dark cocoa powder, toffee, and a faint saline sea-spray breeze. On the palate, the 55.8% ABV cask strength provides an oily, chewy, and mouth-coating texture. An initial burst of sweet Demerara sugar, sherry-soaked cherries, and rich dark chocolate transitions into vibrant mid-palate layers of warm baking spices (clove, nutmeg, and cinnamon bark), toasted oak tannins, roasted hazelnuts, and a distinct touch of coastal salinity. The finish is long, warming, and robust, drying out with lingering impressions of dried fruit leather, espresso beans, warming ginger spice, and lingering seaside brine.

Accolades

Bunnahabhain's annual 12 Year Old Cask Strength releases have quickly established themselves as cult favorites among Scotch whisky connoisseurs, master distillers, and spirits critics. Consistently securing 90+ point scores from publications like Whisky Advocate, WhiskyFun, and the San Francisco World Spirits Competition, reviewers praise the distillery's decision to present their signature sherried profile without chill-filtration or dilution. Critics routinely emphasize that by eschewing the heavy peat smoke typical of southern Islay distilleries, Bunnahabhain's cask strength 12-year allows the dense interaction between maritime-aged distillate and Spanish Oloroso oak to take center stage.

title: Chateau Lafite Rothschild 1982
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Bordeaux region, specifically within the Pauillac AOC appellation in the Médoc, Château Lafite Rothschild 1982 represents a legendary, monumental, and historically transformative expression of Premier Grand Cru Classé Left Bank winemaking. Ranked at the very pinnacle of the historic 1855 Bordeaux Classification, Château Lafite Rothschild has long epitomized quintessential aristocratic finesse, aromatic complexity, and supreme longevity. Situated on the northern boundary of Pauillac bordering Saint-Estèphe, the estate's vineyard occupies high gravel plateaus composed of deep, well-draining Quaternary gravel mixed with aeolian sand on a bed of tertiary limestone. Under the stewardship of Baron Éric de Rothschild and technical director Jean Delmas, the winemaking philosophy adhered to traditional parcel-by-parcel fermentation in large oak vats, followed by maturation for 20 to 24 months in 100% new French oak barrels crafted at the estate's own cooperage. The 1982 vintage is widely heralded as the watershed year of the modern fine wine era, delivering an iconic Lafite that marries ethereal perfume, effortless power, and multi-decade cellar grandeur.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark garnet red colour with luminous mahogany and warm brick reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe black currant, dark plum compote, wild blackberry, and dried cherries, interwoven with sophisticated notes of lead pencil graphite, cigar box, crushed gravel minerality, dried violet petals, cedarwood, truffle, and subtle sweet leather. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and expansive, delivering concentrated flavours of dark fruits, licorice, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate Left Bank acidity. Framed by supremely refined, velvety tannins and an exceptionally dense, seamless mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, cedar spice, and a clean gravelly mineral grip. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon (approximately 65%) blended with Merlot (29%), Cabernet Franc (5%), and Petit Verdot (1%), this legendary 1982 release is in its peak drinking window spanning 2005–2050+. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Lafite's signature haunting perfume, aristocratic restraint, and historic cellaring majesty.

title: Beringer Cabernet Sauvignon Main & Vine
bodyHtml: Rich deep, ruby colour with moderate dark plum, chocolate, cedar and spice aromas. Flavours of juicy plum fruit, vanilla and cedar; dry, medium-bodied with silky tannins.

title: Absolut Vodka - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml:
Absolut Vodka is known as one of the world's best Swedish vodkas. Made exclusively from natural ingredients with no added sugar, it showcases subtle flavours of grain and dried fruit. On the palate, it is full, rich and as smooth as vodka can be.

Enjoy straight or in one of your favourite cocktails, like the Vodka Soda.

title: Teremana Reposado - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml:
Teremana Reposado is a small batch, ultra premium tequila from Mexico, crafted in the Jalisco Highlands. The brand, meaning 'spirit of the earth' (from the Latin 'terra' and Polynesian 'mana'), was co-founded by Dwayne Johnson with the goal of creating a high-quality, responsibly sourced spirit that is accessible to all. The tequila is produced at Destilería Teremana de Agave, a unique home built solely for the brand, where they meticulously follow traditional, small batch methods.

This ageing imparts a light honey colour and a complex, rich sensory profile. On the nose, one finds roasted agave, oak, and vanilla. The palate is smooth and well balanced, featuring flavours of cooked agave, vanilla, cinnamon, and a subtle oak influence. There are also notes of stone fruit, tropical fruit, and a hint of spice. The finish is medium in length and warm, with lingering notes of vanilla and toasted oak. The complexity and smoothness make it an excellent choice for sipping.

title: Smirnoff Vodka - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: Founded in 1864 by Pyotr Arsenievich Smirnov, what we now call Smirnoff was the first vodka to use charcoal filtration in the distillation process. This charcoal filtration produces a spirit that is ideal for mixing because of its smooth and clean palate; perfect in a Moscow Mule.

title: D1 London Gin - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml:
D1 London Gin encapsulates quintessential British flavours and aromas, with orange and fruit tea expressions around a confidently balanced juniper backbone.

The distillation in copper brings in fresh blackcurrant aromas that marry with the prominent nettle notes to deliver the smoothest and most versatile gin you will ever enjoy.

title: Bacardi White Rum - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: Bacardi Superior Rum is the original Bacardi rum, dating back to 1862 when Don Facundo Bacardi Massó purchased his first rum distillery in Cuba. 150 years later, Bacardi Superior is now manufactured in Puerto Rico, but the recipe remains largely the same. A unique strain of yeast discovered in the Cuban sugarcane fields is used to produce Bacardi Superior rum. The rum is filtered through charcoal, a process pioneered by Bacardi, before and after it is aged in oak barrels for at least one year.

title: Canadian Club - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: The legend of Canadian Club began in 1858 and grew to become one of the world's most iconic whiskies. Pouring a medium gold you will find aromas of roasted almond, vanilla and pepper; with spicy vanilla, cornflakes and a faint nutty flavour on a medium weight palate with a long finish.

title: Disaronno Amaretto - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: Deep brown colour; almond and maraschino cherry aroma; very sweet cherry flavour, alcohol shows in the finish.

title: Baileys - Mini 50 ml

title: Naked Grape Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml: Medium ruby red colour, quite forward aromas and flavours of ripe plum, currant and black cherry with hints of herb and spicy oak. Dry, medium-bodied, with rounded tannins, a sweet fruit centre and moderate length on the finish. Try with grilled sandwiches, braised beef dishes, grilled white meats or pizza.

title: The 2024 Vintage Declaration: Port, Cheese & Chocolate Masterclass with Cynthia Opsal
bodyHtml:
In the storied history of Portugal’s Douro Valley, nothing commands attention quite like the Declaration of a Vintage Year. Unlike standard wine regions that bottle a vintage annually, a classic Port Vintage is declared only two or three times a decade, and only when growing conditions produce fruit of extraordinary depth, balance, and cellaring potential.

Join us in the ZYN Loft on Thursday, November 19 at 6:00 PM as we spotlight the monumental 2024 Vintage Declaration. Guided by Cynthia Opsal, an inducted member of the elite La Confraria do Vinho do Porto (The Brotherhood of Port Wine), guests will taste the newly declared 2024 Vintage Ports side-by-side from the region’s three premier houses: Taylor Fladgate, Croft, and Fonseca.

To provide ultimate context to the longevity and evolution of these historic wines, the flight also journeys backward across decades, culminating in a pour of the rare, nearly 50-year-old Taylor Fladgate 1976 Very Old Single Harvest Port.

The Tasting Lineup
Over $1,000 in collective retail bottle value poured throughout the evening:

  • Croft Vintage Port 2024: Seductive, aromatic, and layered with pure black fruit and floral complexity.
  • Taylor Fladgate Vintage Port 2024: The benchmark of classical Douro architecture, commanding power, and mineral precision.
  • Fonseca Vintage Port 2024: Sensuous, lush, and deeply concentrated, a classic Fonseca declaration.
  • Taylor Fladgate 1976 Very Old Single Harvest Port: A half-century of barrel aging yielding rich walnut, dried fig, leather, and toffee notes.
  • Taylor Fladgate Historic Reserve Tawny – The Globe: A masterclass in wood-aged blending.
  • Taylor Fladgate Late Bottled Vintage 2020: Structured, fruit-forward ruby depth.

      Curated Accoutrement:

      • Artisan Cheese: Piquant blue cheeses, aged Gouda's and Cheddars
      • Chocolates: Bittersweet dark chocolates matched to elevate the cocoa, dark currant, and spice notes in both young declarations and aged tawnies.

title: Dom Perignon Brut Rose 2010 - Damien Hirst Artist Series
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Champagne region, specifically within the Champagne AOC appellation, Dom Pérignon Rosé 'Damien Hirst represents a transcendent, artistic, and prestige cuvée expression of vintage Champagne. Produced by the historic House of Dom Pérignon under Chef de Cave Vincent Chaperon, this special edition celebrates a creative collaboration with renowned British contemporary artist Damien Hirst, whose bold aesthetic adorns the iconic shield label. Sourced exclusively from Grand Cru vineyards alongside the historic Premier Cru plot at the Abbey of Hautvillers, the vines grow on classic chalk and limestone soils. Aged in the cellars for at least 12 years prior to disgorgement—compared to approximately 8 years for the Brut Vintage—the winemaking philosophy emphasizes extended lees contact to achieve profound depth, structural harmony, and Pinot Noir intensity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, deep salmon pink colour with copper highlights and a fine, persistent effervescence along the rim. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with vibrant aromas of ripe raspberry, red cherry, and wild strawberry, interwoven with noble notes of rosemary, dried lavender, liquorice, and warm toasted brioche spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, smooth, and round, delivering intense red fruit flavours and savory mineral complexity, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a luxurious, velvety mid-palate texture and vibrant fine bubbles, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering red berries, subtle citrus peel, and a clean mineral grip. Composed of 56% Pinot Noir and 44% Chardonnay, this 2010 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2024–2045+. Stylistically, it combines Pinot Noir-driven richness, fruit intensity, and texture with the creative, avant-garde spirit of Damien Hirst's artistic vision.

title: Dom Perignon Brut 2018 Damien Hirst Artist Series
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Champagne region, specifically within the Champagne AOC appellation, Dom Pérignon Brut 'Damien Hirst' 2018 represents a transcendent, artistic, and prestige cuvée expression of vintage Champagne. Produced by the historic House of Dom Pérignon under Chef de Cave Vincent Chaperon, this limited edition celebrates a landmark creative collaboration with world-renowned British contemporary artist Damien Hirst, whose signature kaleidoscopic butterfly motif transforms the iconic shield label. Sourced exclusively from Grand Cru vineyards alongside the historic Premier Cru plot at the Abbey of Hautvillers, the vines grow on classic chalk and limestone soils. Aged in the cellars for over eight years on the lees prior to disgorgement, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes tension, precision, and complete harmony between Chardonnay elegance and Pinot Noir structure.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous pale gold colour with bright straw reflections and a fine, persistent effervescence along the rim. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of candied lemon, yellow peach, fresh nectarine, and green apple, interwoven with sophisticated notes of toasted brioche, crushed limestone, white blossom, subtle smoky flint, and warm spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, vibrant, and tactile, delivering concentrated flavours of stone fruit, citrus curd, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a creamy, satiny mid-palate texture and lively fine bubbles, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon peel, toasted hazelnut, and a signature chalky mineral grip. Composed of a proprietary blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, this 2018 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2045+. Stylistically, it combines the sunny warmth, precision, and fruit generosity of the 2018 harvest with the avant-garde spirit of Damien Hirst's artistic vision.

bodyHtml:
When it comes to making your night legendary, the Captain knows that there are no mistakes. His Original Spiced Rum is certainly no exception. This versatile blend works well in any scenario. Is tonight your time to try it?

Mixed spices, special fruit flavours and heavy vanilla notes come together with a slight spiciness and heavy body to create a perfectly balanced spirit with a smooth finish.

title: Heaven Hill Bottled in Bond 7 Year Old Bourbon
bodyHtml:
This American whiskey originates from Bardstown, Kentucky, produced by the historic, family-owned Heaven Hill Distillery. Heaven Hill Bottled-in-Bond 7 Year Old pays homage to the seminal Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897, adhering strictly to its rigorous standards: distilled during a single distillation season at a single distillery, aged in a federally bonded warehouse for at least four years, and bottled at exactly 100 proof (50.0% ABV). Crafted from Heaven Hill's signature traditional bourbon mash bill—78% corn, 10% rye, and 12% malted barley—this release carries a state-certified 7-year age statement, aging three years beyond the legal requirement in new charred American white oak barrels.

Spirit Description

This bourbon presents a deep golden-amber hue with rich copper highlights and thick, slow-moving legs in the glass. On the nose, it is warm, inviting, and classic, opening with dominant aromas of rich vanilla bean, dark caramel, toasted oak, and sweet corn, quickly followed by sub-layer notes of baking spice, dark honey, dried cherry, and soft leather. On the palate, the 100 proof strength provides a full-bodied, chewy, and oily mouthfeel. It delivers an immediate wave of brown sugar, butterscotch, and warm rye spice (cinnamon and nutmeg) before transitioning into mid-palate layers of charred oak tannins, toasted dark chocolate, and a touch of black pepper. The finish is long, warming, and drying, leaving trailing impressions of sweet oak, charred caramel, vanilla, and lingering baking spices.

Accolades

Heaven Hill Bottled-in-Bond 7 Year Old holds massive critical acclaim across the spirits industry, celebrated as a benchmark standard for classic Kentucky straight bourbon. It earned a spot on Wine Enthusiast's Top 100 Spirits lists, secured Double Gold medals at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition, and received consistent 92+ point scores from publications like Whisky Advocate and Distiller. Critics consistently praise Heaven Hill for delivering a high-proof, well-aged bourbon that preserves traditional high-corn sweetness while showcasing structural oak depth and spicy rye balance.

title: Jean Luc Pasquet Tribot Family L.96 Limited Edition 1.1 - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This rare, single-distiller French grape brandy originates from Charente in southwestern France, bottled by Maison Jean-Luc Pasquet as part of their limited-edition collaborative series highlighting exceptional smallholder stocks. Sourced from the cellars of the Tribot family, long-time grape growers and distillers in the Fins Bois sub-region, Lot 96 (Batch 1.1) represents a hyper-specific snapshot of 1996 vintage distillation. Distilled primarily from Ugni Blanc grapes grown in the clay-limestone soils (groies) characteristic of Fins Bois, the spirit matured in French oak casks for roughly 25 years before being selected and hand-bottled by Jean and Amy Pasquet. Bottled at its natural, un-reduced cask strength of 96.2 proof (48.1% ABV) in a 700 ml bottle, this release is non-chill filtered and crafted without added sugar, caramel, or oak extracts (boisé).

Spirit Description

This limited release displays a warm topaz-amber color with copper reflections and slow, elegant legs clinging to the glass. On the nose, it is remarkably lifted, aromatic, and fruit-driven—a classic signature of long-aged Fins Bois—opening with notes of candied orange peel, fresh apricot, poached yellow plum, and floral honey, underlaid by soft rancio accents of toasted almond, vanilla bean, cedar wood, and light tobacco leaf. On the palate, the natural 48.1% ABV strength delivers a supple, round, and oily mouthfeel, flooding the palate with bright orchard fruit, citrus marmalade, and dark honey before developing mid-palate layers of warm baking spices (cinnamon and light ginger), gentle oak tannins, and a soft, earthy mineral baseline. The higher proof carries the fruit-forward 1996 vintage with remarkable balance and freshness without wood bitterness. The finish is long, warm, and clean, leaving trailing impressions of dried stone fruit, candied citrus, toasted hazelnut, and a gentle wood spice.

Accolades

Jean-Luc Pasquet’s independent collaborative series—including the Tribot Family releases—holds top-tier critical praise among Cognac connoisseurs, master sommeliers, and spirits journalists. Earning high marks across independent platforms like WhiskyFun and Distiller, critics routinely praise the Pasquet family for spotlighting single-distiller Fins Bois eaux-de-vie. Reviewers emphasize that bottling 25-year-old Fins Bois at natural strength (48.1% ABV) without cold filtration or boisé proves that the sub-region can produce Cognacs of extraordinary complexity, fruit purity, and elegance rivaling the Champagne crus.

title: Jean Luc Pasquet Rateau Family Batch R20.11 Limited Edition - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This rare, single-distiller French grape brandy originates from Charente in southwestern France, bottled by Maison Jean-Luc Pasquet as part of their limited-edition collaborative release series. Sourced from the cellars of the Rateau family, long-time grape growers and distillers in the Petite Champagne sub-region (Second Cru de Cognac), Batch R20.11 represents a hyper-specific snapshot of smallholder distillation. Composed of mature eaux-de-vie harvested and distilled by the Rateau family, the spirit rested in French oak casks before being selected and hand-bottled by Jean and Amy Pasquet. Bottled at its natural, un-reduced cask strength of 99.2 proof (49.6% ABV) in a limited allocation run, this release is non-chill filtered and crafted without added sugar, caramel, or oak extracts (boisé).

Spirit Description

This limited release presents a warm amber-topaz color with copper reflections and slow, heavy legs in the glass. On the nose, it is expressive, rich, and deeply aromatic, opening with lifted aromas of dried apricot, yellow plum, candied orange peel, and fresh honey, underlaid by classic rancio accents of soft leather, toasted hazelnuts, cedar wood, and light tobacco leaf. On the palate, the 49.6% ABV natural cask strength provides a full-bodied, rich, and oily mouthfeel. It delivers an immediate wave of dark caramel, poached pear, and orange marmalade before shifting into vibrant mid-palate notes of sweet baking spices (cinnamon and nutmeg), gentle oak tannins, and the characteristic chalky mineral backbone of the Petite Champagne terroir. The higher proof carries the mature fruit and wood interaction with remarkable weight and clarity. The finish is long, warm, and lingering, leaving trailing impressions of dark cocoa, toasted almonds, dried stone fruit, and a soft wood spice.

Accolades

Jean-Luc Pasquet’s independent bottling series—including the Rateau Family collaborations—holds exceptional acclaim among Cognac purists, spirits journalists, and master sommeliers. Frequently earning top marks on specialist platforms like WhiskyFun and Distiller, critics consistently praise the Pasquet family for shining a light on single-estate growers in Petite Champagne whose stocks rarely see single-cask recognition. Reviewers highlight how bottling the Rateau distillate at natural barrel strength (49.6% ABV) preserves the unvarnished texture and authentic fruit purity often stripped away by industrial-scale blending houses.

title: Maker's Mark - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The base aroma is buttered corn-on-the-cob with aeration bringing additional scents of vanilla and cinnamon. The palate entry showcases sweet breakfast cereal grain; at midpalate the corn dominates so thoroughly that you know that this could only be one of the best straight bourbons from Kentucky. Ends spirity and heated. One of America's benchmark spirits.

Full-flavored, yet remarkably easy to drink, Maker's Mark has a taste that took years to perfect. Then, they spent the next 50 years making sure that taste never changed.

title: D1 London Gin - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
D1 London Gin encapsulates quintessential British flavours and aromas, with orange and fruit tea expressions around a confidently balanced juniper backbone.

The distillation in copper brings in fresh blackcurrant aromas that marry with the prominent nettle notes to deliver the smoothest and most versatile gin you will ever enjoy.

title: Bacardi White Rum - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Bacardi Superior Rum is the original Bacardi rum, dating back to 1862 when Don Facundo Bacardi Massó purchased his first rum distillery in Cuba. 150 years later, Bacardi Superior is now manufactured in Puerto Rico, but the recipe remains largely the same. A unique strain of yeast discovered in the Cuban sugarcane fields is used to produce Bacardi Superior rum. The rum is filtered through charcoal, a process pioneered by Bacardi, before and after it is aged in oak barrels for at least one year.

title: Baileys - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: World-renowned Baileys is a natural marriage of fresh Irish dairy cream and Irish Whiskey. Fragrant and flavourful with fresh coffee, hazelnut and chocolate notes; sweet, creamy and thick yet well-balanced by a smooth whiskey note for a smooth, lingering finish.

title: Absolut Vodka - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Absolut Vodka is known as one of the world's best Swedish vodkas. Made exclusively from natural ingredients with no added sugar, it showcases subtle flavours of grain and dried fruit. On the palate, it is full, rich and as smooth as vodka can be.

Enjoy straight or in one of your favourite cocktails, like the Vodka Soda.

title: Big Bill Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: A bold, larger-than-life Cabernet Sauvignon with upfront raspberry, violets and spicy aromas with hints of English toffee on the nose. The plush and juicy tannin structure is complemented by a savoury finish. Who doesn't love a good juicy steak when sipping on a glass of South African Cabernet?

title: Malfy con Arancia Gin - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Infused with Italian oranges and select Sicilian blood oranges, this gin offers a uniquely flavourful taste experience that will inspire thoughts of the sunny Italian coast.

It has vibrant citrus notes, with a kiss of juniper, capped by a rich palate. Serve over ice with tonic water and pair with orange chicken salad.

title: Naked Grape Merlot
bodyHtml:
The Naked Grape Merlot is a smooth, fruit-driven red wine primarily originating from the sun-drenched vineyards of California (under the Grape Valley Wine Company) and carefully selected regions in Canada (via Arterra Wines). True to the brand's "bare it all" philosophy, this Merlot is crafted to emphasize the natural, unadulterated flavors of the grape rather than heavy oak or tannin. The winery’s goal is to produce a "rich and oh-so-smooth" wine that offers an accessible, unpretentious drinking experience, making it a reliable staple for those who value soft texture and vivid fruit character above all else.

Wine Description

Naked Grape Merlot displays a deep, brilliant ruby color in the glass. The nose is highly aromatic and inviting, dominated by a bouquet of ripe dark cherry and redcurrant, layered with rich notes of raspberry and a subtle hint of caramel. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and velvety, featuring a luscious mouthfeel where sweet black plum and berry flavors are balanced just slightly more sweet than sour. It is characterized by its exceptionally soft tannins and a rounded, easy-going structure that leads to a clean, lingering fruit finish. This wine typically has an ABV ranging from 12.5% to 13.5%.

title: Gaja Sito Moresco Langhe 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Piedmont region, specifically within the Langhe DOC appellation, Gaja 'Sito Moresco' Langhe 2024 represents an elegant, modern, and harmonious expression of Piedmontese terroir. The name translates to 'Moresco's Site', paying homage to the former owner of the historic vineyard parcel in Barbaresco where the blend originated. Sourced from choice estate vineyards in Barbaresco, Treiso, and Serralunga d'Alba planted on steep limestone, clay, and marl soils, the winemaking philosophy under the Gaja family involves separate parcel fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats, followed by 12 months of maturation in oak barriques and neutral oak casks. The result is a sophisticated red wine that seamlessly bridges the vibrant aromatic lift of Nebbiolo with the plush fruit and velvety texture of international varietals.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear ruby red colour with bright purple-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with inviting aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, red plum, and black currant, interwoven with noble notes of crushed dried rose petals, subtle cocoa powder, tobacco leaf, and warm cedar spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, smooth, and supple, delivering generous flavours of juicy dark fruit, tart red berry curd, and mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine, velvety tannins and a harmonious mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red berries, savory Mediterranean herbs, and a subtle mineral lift. Composed of a blend of Nebbiolo, Barbera, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Merlot, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2038. Stylistically, it combines Gaja's hallmark finesse and high-altitude freshness with immediate accessibility and polished elegance.

title: Cantina Terlan Pinot Noir 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Trentino-Alto Adige region, specifically within the Alto Adige DOC appellation, Cantina Terlan Pinot Noir 2025 represents a refined, alpine, and highly mineral expression of cool-climate Italian viticulture. Founded in 1893, Cantina Terlan (Kellerei Terlan) is globally recognized as one of the world's premier cooperative wine estates, situated along the sun-drenched Tschöggl mountain slopes of the Adige Valley. The estate's vineyards for Pinot Noir (locally known as Blauburgunder) are planted between 400 and 600 metres above sea level on steep, south- to southwest-facing slopes comprised of quartz-porphyry volcanic bedrock and sandy-loam soils. Under head winemaker Rudi Kofler, the winemaking philosophy focuses on manual harvesting, gentle destemming, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats with gentle cap management, and maturation for seven to ten months in large oak casks (botti) and concrete vats. The result is a vibrant, elegant red wine that balances alpine berry freshness, fine savory spice, and distinct volcanic minerality.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear medium ruby red colour with delicate garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe wild strawberry, sour red cherry, raspberry, and red currant, interwoven with sophisticated notes of dried rose petal, violet blossom, forest floor, subtle clove spice, and crushed volcanic stone minerality. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of crisp red berries, tart cranberry, and savoury mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural alpine acidity. Framed by smooth, fine-grained tannins and a supple, finely balanced mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, alpine herbs, and a clean flinty grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2025 release offers an optimal drinking window spanning 2026–2032. Stylistically, it combines Alto Adige precision, energetic acidity, and delicate varietal polish.

title: Chateau Beychevelle 2023
bodyHtml:
Ever since it was first produced, and down through the various vintages, Château Beychevelle has reflected the elegance and finesse of Saint Julien's finest terroirs. Graceful and complex, with a tremendous aromatic richness, Château Beychevelle is made from the best plots in the vineyard and undergoes a rigorous selection process .It reveals its character after about ten years, and can be kept for several decades, depending on the vintage.

Blend: 54% Cabernet Sauvignon, 40% Merlot, 6% Petit Verdot

94+ Points - Vinous

The 2023 Beychevelle is fabulous. As always, Beychevelle includes quite a bit more Merlot than most wines in the appellation, but the Cabernet is especially high here. Inky dark fruit, crème de cassis, mocha, licorice and lavender build in the glass. This juicy, extroverted Saint-Julien has a ton to offer. The combination of fruit intensity, acid and supporting structure is superb. The 2023 is showy, but not at all overdone. Beychevelle remains one of the most distinctive wines in all of Bordeaux. It is especially classy in this edition. Tasted two times.–Neal Martin

93+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

From a château that seems to have hit another gear over the past five to seven years, the 2023 Château Beychevelle is based on 54% Cabernet Sauvignon, 40% Merlot and 6% Petit Verdot, pulled from 60% of the total production, and will see 18 months in 70% new French oak. Its deep purple hue is followed by a deep, rich, medium to full-bodied Saint-Julien loaded with ripe red and blue fruits, leafy herbs, truffle, iron, and spring flowers. It's medium to full-bodied, has a remarkable sense of freshness and purity, velvety tannins, and outstanding length. The 2023 hit 13.3% alcohol with a rock-solid pH of 3.67.

94+ Points - James Suckling

Pure fruit to this, with blueberries, hazelnuts, walnut and blackcurrants. Just like eating grapes at this stage. It has a full body, juicy tannins and a savory finish. Remains vivid and energetic.

93+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2023 Beychevelle has turned out especially well this year, exhibiting a more integrated, seductive style than recent vintages that were constructed in a punchier, more extracted register. Offering up aromas of cassis and plums mingled with notions of pen ink, violets and pencil shavings, it's medium to full-bodied, broad and fleshy, with a deep core of fruit and a classy, suave profile that foregrounds the estate's prime vineyard holdings on the plateau around Ducru-Beaucaillou. It's a blend of 54% Cabernet Sauvignon, 40% Merlot and 6% Petit Verdot that represents 50% of the estate's production.

title: Chateau Ducru Beaucaillou 2023
bodyHtml:
A soft, fruity attack on the palate, a voluptuousness underscored by perfectly integrated, silky tannins that culminate in an exceptionally lengthy finish. The aromas dance, flatter the nose, seduce the soul and penetrate the memory. A muse that arrives on tiptoe and leave a lasting, infinite souvenir.

Blend: 83% Cabernet Sauvignon, 17% Merlot

96+ Points - James Suckling

This has aromas of blackberries and blackcurrant, as well as graphite and flint. Some gunpowder. It’s full-bodied with extremely refined tannins, a creamy character and al-dente fruit at the finish. Crunchy, succulent and linear. Mineral edge to it, like licking a stone. Energetic. 83% cabernet sauvignon and 17% merlot.

95+ Points - Vinous

The 2023 Ducru-Beaucaillou is a heady, sumptuous Saint-Julien. The aromatics alone are captivating. Truffle, rose petal, blood orange, pomegranate, spice and menthol build in a creamy, lavish Ducru. The 2023 is a classic Bruno Borie wine that emphasizes textural opulence. Time in the glass brings out gorgeous floral and spice-driven top notes. The balance of opulence and vibrancy is compelling. –Antonio Galloni

97 Points - Decanter

Lovely vibrant purple colour in the glass. Smells fragrant and lifted, a combination of sweet and ripe and fresh blackcurrant and black cherries on the nose with a touch of dark chocolate. Smooth and so silky, but rich too, there’s depth and weight but not too much. I love the texture - grippy and filling no doubt, it coats the mouth with a crushed velvet texture, you feel the ripeness but there’s such lift and effortless purity of fruit that it feels fresh too. No extra fat, but equally it’s not too lean, not strict at all, where many are. Not hollow, not light, there’s no let up. Juicy cherry, blackcurrant and blueberry with lots of liquorice on the finish. Feels well crafted. Maybe not as immediately moreish as some, but this is really well made. Feels elegant and stylish.

95+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

As to the Grand Vin, the 2023 Château Ducru-Beaucaillou brings everything up a level, offering a gorgeous perfume of crème de cassis, spring flowers, graphite, and crushed stone. This gives way to a medium to full-bodied, pure, incredibly elegant Ducru that has ample mid-palate depth, building tannins, and a great spine of acidity. It’s another gorgeous wine from this chateau that plays in the style of the 2010, 2016, and 2020. The 2023 is 85% Cabernet Sauvignon and 15% Merlot, again in new barrels, and it hit 13% alcohol, a pH of 3.7, and an IPT of 89. It will have 50+ years of longevity.

title: Bodacious Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Bodacious Cabernet Sauvignon is a product of Canada, with fruit often sourced from the Niagara Peninsula in Ontario and international regions to create a consistent 'Cellared in Canada' blend. The brand is part of the Arterra Wines Canada portfolio, which focuses on producing bold, smooth, and unconventional wines designed to appeal to a wide audience. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes a 'no fear, no apologies' mindset, prioritizing easy drinking and fruit forward profiles over traditional conventions.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon presents a bright ruby red colour in the glass. The nose is defined by sweet aromas of red berry fruit, vanilla, and subtle hints of blackberry jam or coffee beans. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and off dry, featuring lively flavours of strawberry, cranberry, and plum. It is characterized by a soft, silky finish with approachable tannins that enhance its smooth texture.

title: Gaja 'Alteni di Brassica' Langhe 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Piedmont region, specifically within the Langhe DOC appellation, Gaja 'Alteni di Brassica' Langhe 2024 represents a world-class, aristocratic, and age-worthy expression of Italian Sauvignon Blanc. Crafted by the legendary Gaja family in Barbaresco, this wine takes its name from alteni—small stone walls that historically surrounded vineyard plots in Piedmont—and brassica, the yellow wildflower that blooms in the vineyards during springtime. Sourced from choice estate parcels in Barbaresco and Serralunga d'Alba planted on steep limestone and clay-marl soils, the winemaking philosophy combines whole-cluster pressing, temperature-controlled fermentation, and refined aging in oak barrels (a blend of new and neutral oak) for approximately six months followed by extended bottle refinement. The result is a profound, structured white wine that seamlessly marries classic varietal lift with Piedmontese mineral power and Gaja's benchmark elegance.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale golden yellow colour with bright greenish reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of pink grapefruit, Meyer lemon curd, ripe white peach, and passion fruit, interwoven with sophisticated notes of lemongrass, wild herbs, elderflower, crushed flint, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, satiny, and intensely concentrated, delivering laser-focused flavours of citrus zest, orchard fruit, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a rich, coat-the-mouth texture derived from oak contact and a driving mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering grapefruit peel, savory herbs, and a distinct chalky limestone grip. Composed of 100% Sauvignon Blanc, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2038+. Stylistically, it combines European elegance and aromatic intensity with remarkable depth, complexity, and cellaring capability.

title: Leaning Post Merlot Cabernet Franc 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada in the Ontario region, specifically within the Niagara Peninsula VQA appellation, Leaning Post Merlot Cabernet Franc represents an artisanal, low-intervention, and cool-climate expression of Niagara red winemaking. Founded by husband-and-wife team Ilya and Nadia Senchuk, Leaning Post is an acclaimed boutique producer dedicated to expressing the distinct terroirs of the Niagara Benchlands and Lincoln Lakeshore sub-appellations. Sourced from select vineyard blocks planted on deep clay loam and limestone-rich soils, the vines benefit from the moderating climatic influence of Lake Ontario and the nearby Niagara Escarpment. Under the direction of winemaker Ilya Senchuk, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes small-batch wild yeast fermentation, gentle hand-plunging of the cap, minimal intervention, and un-fined, un-filtered maturation for 16 to 18 months in neutral and second-use French oak barrels. The result is an authentic, structured red wine that marries dark plum fruit richness, herbal cabernet franc freshness, and distinct Niagara earthiness.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous deep ruby red colour with soft crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, black plum, and cassis, interwoven with subtle notes of fresh raspberry, tobacco leaf, dried sage, crushed limestone minerality, and warm cedar oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of red and dark berries, savory plum curd, and mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by smooth, fine-grained tannins and a supple, well-balanced mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, dried herbs, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed of a masterfully proportioned blend of Merlot and Cabernet Franc, it combines Niagara coolness, low-intervention purity, and food-friendly elegance.

title: Paul Giraud 'Napoleon' Cognac - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This premier cru French grape brandy originates from the heart of Charente in southwestern France, produced by Domaine Paul Giraud in Bouteville, located in the prestigious Grande Champagne sub-region (Premier Cru de Cognac). Single-estate family-owned since 1650, Paul Giraud crafts this expression exclusively from Ugni Blanc grapes harvested from the estate's chalky vineyards. The wine undergoes double distillation in traditional copper Charentais pot stills before maturing in French oak barrels for approximately 15 years—well exceeding the official 6-year minimum required for the Napoleon designation. Bottled at 80 proof (40.0% ABV) in the 700 ml format, it is crafted entirely without artificial coloring, added sugar, or oak extracts (boisé).

Spirit Description

This Napoleon Cognac presents a rich amber-topaz hue with deep golden-copper highlights in the glass. On the nose, it is expressive, warm, and elegant, opening with aromas of dried apricots, candied orange peel, and yellow plum, underlaid by soft vanilla bean, toasted hazelnuts, and an emerging whisper of early rancio (polished oak and light leather). On the palate, it feels medium-to-full-bodied, velvety, and supple, delivering an immediate wave of dried stone fruits, orange marmalade, and light honey before developing complex mid-palate notes of sweet spice, cinnamon, integrated oak tannins, and toasted almonds. The prolonged maturation brings out a deeper wood structure while preserving the signature fresh-fruit clarity of the Grande Champagne chalky terroir. The finish is long, warm, and drying, leaving lingering impressions of dried fruit, cocoa powder, refined oak, and a soft spice.

Accolades

Paul Giraud 'Napoleon' holds high praise among spirits journalists, master sommeliers, and cognac connoisseurs for its unadulterated purity and exceptional age-to-price ratio. Earning top ratings across independent review platforms such as Wine Enthusiast and Difford's Guide, critics frequently note that Giraud's 15-year Napoleon rivals the XO offerings of larger commercial houses. Spirits judges praise the estate's restraint in avoiding boisé or caramel coloring, allowing the natural interaction between Grande Champagne eaux-de-vie and French oak to showcase authentic, unforced maturity.

title: Jean Luc Pasquet Jean Pierre L.75 Cognac - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
This single-cask French grape brandy originates from the premier cru of Charente, France, released under Maison Jean-Luc Pasquet's acclaimed Trésors de Famille ("Family Treasures") line. This independent negociant series curates hyper-limited, long-aged casks sourced directly from smallholder artisan distillers in the Grande Champagne region. "Le Cognac de Jean-Pierre L.75" highlights the cellar of local grower Jean-Pierre, featuring eaux-de-vie harvested and distilled during the 1975 vintage (Lot 75). After resting undisturbed in French oak barrels for over four decades, it was hand-bottled at its natural, undiluted cask strength of 99.6 proof (49.8% ABV) in the series' signature 500 ml format. Un-chillfiltered and completely free of additives, sugar, or caramel coloring (boisé), it serves as an uncompromised time capsule of mid-1970s Grande Champagne distillation.

Spirit Description

This Cognac displays a deep, burnished mahogany-topaz color with dark copper reflections and thick, slow-creeping legs clinging to the glass. On the nose, it is profound, aromatic, and heavily oxidized, opening with concentrated notes of dried black figs, dark raisins, prune jam, and orange marmalade, quickly evolving into classic multi-decade rancio accents of polished mahogany wood, antique leather, pipe tobacco, espresso bean, and dark cacao. On the palate, the higher 49.8% ABV natural cask strength offers a noticeably punchy, full-bodied, and mouth-coating texture. It floods the palate with intense dark caramel, candied citrus peel, and dark chocolate before shifting into deep mid-palate layers of nutmeg, clove, integrated oak tannins, and a persistent chalky mineral backbone. The extra proof carries the ancient ester profile with incredible weight without burn. The finish is remarkably long, warm, and drying, leaving trailing impressions of sweet pipe tobacco, toasted walnuts, dark cocoa, and a gentle wood spice.

Accolades

Jean-Luc Pasquet’s Trésors de Famille releases are highly sought after by Cognac purists, collectors, and master sommeliers, routinely earning 90+ point ratings from independent review outlets like WhiskyFun and Distiller. Reviewers consistently praise Jean and Amy Pasquet for championing hyper-local small-scale distillers like Jean-Pierre. Critics emphasize that bottling single-vintage 1975 casks at full natural barrel strength (~49.8% ABV) without cold filtration or boisé yields an uncompromising depth of fruit and rancio complexity that mass-market commercial XO or XXO Cognacs cannot match.

title: Jean Luc Pasquet Le Cognac De Joel - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
This ultra-rare single-cask Cognac originates from the premier cru of Charente, France, bottled under Maison Jean-Luc Pasquet's prestigious Trésors de Famille ("Family Treasures") series. This series highlights exceptional, forgotten casks sourced directly from neighboring smallholder grape growers in the Grande Champagne region. "Le Cognac de Joël" is a single-distiller selection crafted by local grower Joël in the village of Malaville. Composed of eaux-de-vie distilled during the 1988 and 1982 harvests (Lot 88/82), the spirit matured undisturbed in French oak casks for over 30 years before being hand-bottled at a natural cask strength of 98.4 proof (49.2% ABV) in the series' signature 500 ml format. Bottled un-chillfiltered, with zero additives, sugar, or caramel coloring (boisé), it offers an unvarnished snapshot of micro-terroir Grande Champagne distillation.

Spirit Description

title: Cockburn's 10 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
Originating from Portugal in the Douro region, specifically within the Porto DOC appellation, Cockburn's 10 Year Old Tawny Port represents a rich, mellow, and expertly blended expression of traditional wood-aged Port. Founded in 1815 by Scottish brothers Robert and John Cockburn, Cockburn's is one of the historic Port houses that shaped the Douro trade, famous for its pioneering viticulture and iconic estate vineyards like Quinta dos Canais in the Upper Corgo. Now owned and managed by Symington Family Estates, Cockburn's retains its distinct style through dedicated barrel aging managed by the house's master cooperage team in Vila Nova de Gaia. The grapes are harvested from steep, terraced schist vineyards along the Douro River, followed by brief temperature-controlled fermentation in traditional lagares and fortification with neutral grape spirit (aguardente). Aged for an average of 10 years in seasoned oak casks (pipas), the wine undergoes gradual oxidation, developing its signature tawny hue, nutty complexity, and silky smooth palate.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear medium tawny-amber colour with warm brick and copper highlights along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of dried fig, raisin, date, and orange peel, interwoven with sophisticated notes of toasted walnut, hazelnut, caramel, pipe tobacco, dried plum, and subtle cinnamon spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and mouth-filling, delivering concentrated flavours of dried fruits, butterscotch, and warm spicy oak, all supported by a bright, refreshing spine of balanced acidity that cuts through the natural sweetness. Framed by a smooth, velvety mid-palate structure and seamless warmth, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering roasted nuts, orange marmalade, and a clean caramel grip. Composed of a traditional blend of indigenous Douro varieties including Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz, and Tinta Barroca, it offers immediate drinking appeal upon release. Stylistically, it combines classic Symington barrel-aged richness, vibrant dried fruit complexity, and luscious dessert appeal.

title: Hugh Hamilton Jim Jim Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Hugh Hamilton "The Jim Jim" Cabernet Sauvignon originates from Australia, within the South Australia region and the maritime McLaren Vale AVA. Produced by Hugh Hamilton Wines—a family whose viticultural roots in South Australia date back to 1837 with Richard Hamilton—the winery proudly styles itself as the "Black Sheep" of Australia's oldest wine family. The wine's namesake holds a legendary place in estate lore: Jim Jim was Hugh’s faithful Labrador/Kelpie cross, nicknamed the "Down-Underdog." Sourced from vineyards where Jim Jim would roam, the dog possessed a uncanny viticultural talent—waving through the rows each harvest and eating grapes only when they reached peak ripeness. Impressed by the dog's grape-tasting palate, Hugh dedicated this line in his honor. Although Jim Jim passed away in 2010, his lively, eager-to-please spirit continues to define this fruit-forward, approachable Cabernet.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, vibrant crimson-garnet appearance in the glass with bright purple highlights near the rim. It possesses a full-bodied, generous structure defined by a smooth, mouth-filling, and supple texture. The sensory profile is highly expressive and fruit-driven, opening with an inviting bouquet of dark blackcurrants, ripe cassis, and wild blackberries, seamlessly layered with subtle notes of herbal mint, bell pepper, smoked oak, and toasted vanilla. On the palate, it delivers a rich, crunchy core of dark and blue berry fruit, held together by fine-grained, lip-smacking tannins and a crisp line of natural acidity. The finish is clean, warm, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of dark plum, subtle spices, and savory tobacco leaf.

title: Castello di Verduno Verduno Pelaverga 'Basadone' 2024
bodyHtml:
This rare and indigenous light-bodied dry red wine originates from Italy, produced in the tiny Verduno DOC appellation within the Langhe region of Piedmont. Castello di Verduno is a legendary, historical estate headquartered in a 16th-century castle in the village of Verduno, where King Carlo Alberto of Savoy once crafted wine. Managed today by the Burlotto and Blanco families, the estate is famous both for its high-elevation Barolo and as the absolute pioneer for Pelaverga Piccolo an obscure, ancient local grape variety grown almost exclusively around the village of Verduno. The wine's sub-name, Basadone, translates to "little kiss" in Piedmontese dialect, referencing the wine's centuries-old reputation across the Langhe as a subtle aphrodisiac.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2024 vintage presents a luminous, translucent pale ruby color with bright pinkish reflections. The highly lifted, aromatic nose is unmistakable and vibrant, bursting with a signature perfume of freshly cracked white and black pepper, wild red berries, tart strawberry, pomegranate, and cranberry, accompanied by delicate hints of red rose petals and mountain herbs. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, lively, and incredibly energetic. A core of crisp, crunchy red fruit is framed by fine, soft tannins and a sharp, refreshing beam of natural acidity that drives through to a clean, peppery, and mineral-laden finish. Crafted from 100% Pelaverga Piccolo, the hand-harvested grapes undergo gentle temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats. To preserve its delicate spicy aromatics and vibrant freshness, the wine is aged exclusively in stainless steel and neutral lined tanks for several months prior to bottling without oak contact. The alcohol by volume sits at a refreshing 12.5% to 13.0%.

Food Pairing

The light structure, low tannin, vibrant pepper spice, and bright acidity of Verduno Pelaverga make it one of Piedmont's most versatile food wines, particularly when served slightly chilled. It pairs exceptionally well with traditional Italian antipasti, prosciutto di Parma, salame, beef carpaccio, and vitello tonnato. It is also an ideal companion for wood-fired pizzas, lighter pasta dishes like agnolotti del plin with sage butter or tomato ragù, grilled salmon, pan-seared trout, roasted chicken, and young semi-soft cheeses such as Toma Piemontese, Fontina, or fresh Goat Cheese.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 growing season in the northern Langhe provided cool nights and steady ripening conditions that favored delicate, aromatic grape varieties like Pelaverga. The vineyard team's careful hand-harvesting preserved the variety's signature white pepper terpene compounds and high natural acidity. The 2024 Castello di Verduno Verduno Pelaverga 'Basadone' offers pure, vibrant immediate enjoyment, showcasing bright spice and refreshing fruit tension best enjoyed in its youth over the next 2 to 4 years.

title: Beluga Gold Vodka
bodyHtml:
This ultra-luxury vodka represents the absolute pinnacle of the Beluga portfolio, officially known as Beluga Gold Line Vodka. Positioned above the flagship Beluga Noble, this limited-edition release is crafted using pure artesian spring water and a refined malted grain spirit base. The liquid undergoes five rigorous filtration stages before receiving small infusions of natural rice extract and rhodiola rosea (golden root) extract. Unlike standard vodkas, Beluga Gold Line undergoes an extended 90-day "resting" (maturation) period, allowing the spirit’s molecular structure to harmonize for extraordinary softness. Bottled at 80 proof (40.0% ABV) in a heavy glass bottle, each bottle features an individually numbered metal label, a gold-embossed sturgeon emblem, and a wax-sealed cork closure accompanied by a small wooden hammer and brush to break and clean the wax ritualistically.

Spirit Description

This vodka presents brilliant, diamond-like clarity with heavy, viscous legs clinging to the glass. On the nose, it is exceptionally soft, pure, and refined, offering delicate wafts of sweet cream, white pepper, fresh wheat, and subtle floral honey, completely devoid of ethanol sting or sharpness. On the palate, it exhibits an ultra-plush, velvety, and mouth-coating texture—a direct benefit of the 90-day resting process—delivering subtle notes of toasted grain, sweet corn, vanilla cream, and a gentle herbal undertone. The finish is remarkably long, clean, and smooth, leaving a luxurious warmth, a faint mineral salinity, and a lingering impression of sweet whipped grain.

title: Innocent Bystander Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Australia in the Victoria region, specifically within the Yarra Valley GI appellation, Innocent Bystander Chardonnay represents a fresh, textured, and modern expression of cool-climate Australian white winemaking. Founded in 2003, Innocent Bystander is celebrated for producing vibrant, varietally pure wines that showcase the distinctive microclimates and gravelly loam soils of Victoria's Yarra Valley. Under head winemaker Geoff Alexander and the winemaking team, the philosophy emphasizes gentle whole-bunch pressing, wild yeast fermentation in a combination of temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks and French oak puncheons (approximately 15% to 20% new), followed by partial malolactic fermentation and seven months of maturation on fine lees with regular stirring (bâtonnage). The result is a refined, aromatic Chardonnay that balances ripe citrus fruit generosity, subtle creamy oak texture, and electric cool-climate acidity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear light straw yellow colour with pale greenish-gold highlights along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of white peach, nectarine, lemon curd, and crisp green apple, interwoven with subtle notes of white jasmine, roasted cashew, flinty minerality, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of stone fruit, citrus zest, and chalky mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by a textured, subtly creamy mid-palate structure and seamless oak integration, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering grapefruit, subtle nougat, and a clean mineral grip. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, it offers immediate drinking appeal along with short-term cellaring potential over 3 to 5 years. Stylistically, it combines Yarra Valley elegance, vibrant fruit purity, and versatile food friendliness.

title: Innocent Bystander Pinot Noir 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Australia in the Victoria region, specifically within the Yarra Valley GI appellation, Innocent Bystander Pinot Noir represents a fresh, highly expressive, and modern expression of cool-climate Australian winemaking. Established in 2003, Innocent Bystander is celebrated for crafting approachable, varietally pure wines that capture the distinct microclimates of Victoria's Yarra Valley. The grapes are sourced from cool-climate, high-elevation vineyard sites where gravelly loam and alluvial clay soils provide optimal drainage. Under head winemaker Geoff Alexander and the winemaking team, the philosophy incorporates gentle de-stemming, 100% whole berry inclusion, small open-vat ambient yeast fermentation, and short maturation on fine lees in seasoned French oak barriques and puncheons (100% older oak) for 9 to 10 months. The result is a vibrant, aromatic Pinot Noir that balances bright Yarra Valley fruit generosity, delicate floral spice, and effortless food friendliness.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale ruby red colour with soft cherry highlights along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of wild strawberry, ripe red cherry, red currant, and fresh cranberry, interwoven with subtle notes of orange peel, dried rose petal, subtle forest floor, and toasted cedar spice. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of fresh red berries, dark plum curd, and chalky mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by smooth, fine-grained tannins and a sleek, supple mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, subtle savory spice, and a clean mineral grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it offers immediate drinking appeal along with short-term cellaring potential over 3 to 5 years. Stylistically, it combines Yarra Valley elegance, vibrant whole-berry aromatics, and versatile food friendliness.

title: Inama Vin Soave Classico 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the Soave Classico DOC appellation, Inama Vin Soave Classico represents a benchmark, highly authentic, and terroir-driven expression of Garganega. Founded in 1965 by Giuseppe Inama, the estate was among the first in Soave to recognize the extraordinary potential of the historic hillside Classico zone, focusing exclusively on volcanic soils. Sourced from estate vineyards across the dark basaltic slopes of Mount Foscarino and the Fittà hills, the vines grow in ancient volcanic basalt and clay soils. Under winemaking director Stefano Inama and his sons, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes short cold maceration on skins, gentle pneumatic pressing, and temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats followed by eight months of maturation on fine lees without oak aging or malolactic fermentation. The result is a luminous, textured white wine that captures Garganega's natural richness, almond complexity, and saline volcanic drive.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear light straw yellow colour with pale greenish-gold highlights along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of white peach, crisp pear, lemon curd, and golden apple, interwoven with delicate notes of chamomile blossom, wild field flowers, roasted almond, and distinct basaltic wet stone minerality. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of stone fruit, citrus zest, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural volcanic acidity. Framed by a sleek, textured mid-palate structure and a subtle almond skin grip, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering white fruits, subtle herbal notes, and a clean mineral snap. Composed of 100% Garganega, it offers immediate drinking appeal along with cellaring potential over 3 to 6 years. Stylistically, it combines volcanic tension, floral aromatics, and authentic Italian food friendliness.

title: Chateau Pontet Canet 2017
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Bordeaux region, specifically within the Pauillac AOC appellation in the Médoc, Château Pontet Canet 2017 represents a biodynamic, iconic, and deeply authentic expression of Left Bank winemaking. Classified as a Fifth Growth in the historic 1855 Classification, Château Pontet Canet has achieved renown for outperforming its classification and operating at First Growth quality levels. Under the visionary stewardship of owner Alfred Tesseron and estate director Jean-Michel Comme, the estate became a pioneer in Pauillac by achieving full organic and biodynamic certifications. Situated adjacent to Château Mouton Rothschild, the vineyard's deep Quaternary gravel soils over a clay-limestone substrate are farmed using horses instead of heavy machinery to preserve soil health. The winemaking philosophy incorporates hand sorting, optical selection, gravity-fed whole-berry optical vatting, and a unique maturation aging program using 50% new French oak barrels, 35% custom-built concrete amphorae (dolia) crafted using soil from the estate vineyard, and 15% second-use barrels for 16 to 18 months. The result is a luminous, pure, and muscular Pauillac that balances deep dark fruit, floral elegance, and gravelly mineral drive.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark garnet red colour with vibrant violet and crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe wild blackberry, black currant, dark cherry, and cassis compote, interwoven with sophisticated notes of violet, fresh mint, graphite, crushed gravel minerality, espresso bean, dark chocolate, pipe tobacco, and subtle cedar spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, licorice, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, velvety tannins and an extraordinarily dense, polished mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, floral spice, and a clean gravelly mineral grip. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon (64%) blended with Merlot (31%), Cabernet Franc (4%), and Petit Verdot (1%), this 2017 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2048+. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Pauillac power, biodynamic purity, and refined aristocratic structure.

title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label Festive Blend Limited Edition Design 2027
bodyHtml:
