This luxury limited-edition blended Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, crafted under the direction of Johnnie Walker Master Blender Emma Walker. Released as part of Diageo’s seasonal luxury collection, the Johnnie Walker Blue Label Festive Blend features bespoke packaging designed to celebrate global winter holidays and cultural festivities. Blended using rare whiskies drawn from Diageo’s premier reserves—including ghost distillery stocks alongside mature Speyside, Highland, and Islay single malts—only 1 in 10,000 casks are selected for its composition. Bottled in an elongated, blue-tinted glass decanter adorned with vibrant seasonal artwork, it offers a luxurious collector's presentation of Johnnie Walker's signature flagship blend.

Spirit Description

This blended Scotch displays a deep amber-gold color with warm copper reflections in the glass. On the nose, it is rich, balanced, and inviting, releasing aromas of dried plums, honeyed barley, and candied orange peel, supported by toasted hazelnuts, dark chocolate, and a faint thread of sweet peat smoke. On the palate, it feels extraordinarily smooth, velvety, and mouth-coating, delivering initial notes of poached pears, vanilla cream, and dried figs, before opening up into baking spices, dark cocoa, and charred oak. The finish is remarkably long, rounded, and warming, trailing off with lingering dried fruit, sweet malt, a touch of coastal brine, and a soft, lingering wisp of smoke.

Accolades

Johnnie Walker Blue Label's limited-edition seasonal bottles are highly prized by whisky collectors and luxury gift-givers alike. The core Blue Label liquid routinely earns top industry honors, including Double Gold Medals at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition and 90+ point ratings across review outlets such as Whisky Advocate and Distiller. Reviewers frequently praise these special festive editions for combining world-class blending artistry with intricate, eye-catching bottle craft.

title: Vina El Principal Memorias 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Chile in the Maipo Valley region, specifically within the Pirque sub-zone in the Andean foothills, Viña El Principal 'Memorias' 2024 represents a sophisticated, expressive, and terroir-driven Chilean red blend. Founded in 1992 as a partnership between French winemaking icon Jean-Paul Valette (former owner of Château Pavie) and Chilean Jorge Pérez Cruz, Viña El Principal is celebrated for its gravelly alluvial soils situated at 750 to 800 metres above sea level along the majestic Andes Mountains. Crafted as the bridge between the accessible 'Calicanto' and the flagship 'El Principal', 'Memorias' is harvested from select hillside vineyard blocks that yield exceptional aromatic concentration. Under technical director Gonzalo Guzmán, the winemaking philosophy incorporates hand harvesting, parcel-by-parcel temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats, and maturation for 14 to 16 months in French oak barrels (approximately 30% to 50% new). The result is a seamless red wine that balances vibrant mountain fruit intensity, elegant savory spice, and classic French structural refinement.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense crimson-violet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe wild blackberry, black currant, dark plum compote, and cassis, interwoven with sophisticated notes of Andean eucalyptus, fresh mint, crushed granite minerality, pipe tobacco, dark chocolate, and toasted cedar spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of black fruit, licorice, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural high-altitude acidity. Framed by fine-grained, velvety tannins and a dense, well-proportioned mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark berries, wild herbal spice, and a clean gravelly mineral grip. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon blended with Syrah, Carmenère, Petit Verdot, and Cabernet Franc, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2040. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Andean mountain freshness, rich fruit depth, and aristocratic structural polish.

title: Prats & Symington 'Chryseia' Douro 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from Portugal in the Douro region, specifically within the Douro DOC appellation, Prats & Symington 'Chryseia' Douro represents a historic, benchmark, and internationally acclaimed flagship expression of Portuguese red winemaking. Created in 1999, Prats & Symington is a celebrated joint venture uniting two of the world's most distinguished winemaking families: Bruno Prats, former owner of Château Cos d'Estournel in Bordeaux, and the Symington family, renowned port producers in the Douro Valley. The name 'Chryseia'—derived from the Ancient Greek word for 'golden'—reflects the golden river terroir of the Douro Valley. The grapes are sourced from the finest plots within Quinta de Roriz and Quinta da Perdiz in the Cima Corgo sub-region, where steep, sun-drenched schistous terraces dominate. Under the direction of head winemaker Charles Symington and consultant Bruno Prats, the winemaking philosophy incorporates parcel-by-parcel temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats, gentle extraction, and maturation for 15 months in 400-litre French oak barrels (approximately 50% to 60% new). The result is a monumental red wine that marries Douro power, intense floral aromatics, and classic Bordeaux structural elegance.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense purple reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe wild blackberry, dark plum compote, cassis, and black cherry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of rockrose (esteva), fresh eucalyptus, dark chocolate, graphite, espresso bean, and toasted cedar spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and expansive, delivering concentrated flavours of black fruit, licorice, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, muscular tannins and an extraordinarily dense mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark berries, floral spice, and a clean schistose mineral grip. Composed primarily of Touriga Nacional and Touriga Franca, it offers immediate drinking appeal along with extended cellaring potential over 15 to 25 years. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Douro warmth, high-elevation freshness, and aristocratic French polish.

title: Prats & Symington 'Post Scriptum de Chryseia' 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from Portugal in the Douro region, specifically within the Douro DOC appellation, Prats & Symington 'Post Scriptum de Chryseia' 2023 represents an elegant, modern, and highly acclaimed expression of Portuguese red winemaking. Formed in 1999, Prats & Symington is a historic joint venture uniting two of the world's most distinguished winemaking families: Bruno Prats, former owner of Château Cos d'Estournel in Bordeaux, and the Symington family, renowned port producers in the Douro Valley. Sourced primarily from the prized estate vineyards of Quinta de Roriz and Quinta da Perdiz in the Cima Corgo sub-region, the vines grow on steep, sun-drenched schistous slopes along the Douro River. Under the direction of head winemaker Charles Symington and consultant Bruno Prats, the winemaking philosophy incorporates careful temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats with gentle extraction, followed by 12 months of maturation in 400-litre French oak barrels. The result is a refined red wine that balances Douro fruit intensity, mineral gravel grip, and classic Bordeaux structural polish.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with vivid purple reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of wild blackberry, dark plum, ripe cassis, and black cherry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of rockrose (esteva), floral violet, fresh eucalyptus, dark chocolate, graphite, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, plum curd, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine-grained, smooth tannins and a supple, well-proportioned mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, floral spice, and a clean schistose mineral grip. Composed predominantly of Touriga Franca and Touriga Nacional blended with small proportions of Tinta Roriz and Tinta Barroca, this 2023 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2036. Stylistically, it combines Douro heat and floral aromatics with seamless, elegant French balance.

title: Vina El Principal El Principal 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from Chile in the Maipo Valley region, specifically within the Pirque sub-zone in the Andean foothills, Viña El Principal 'El Principal' 2022 represents a iconic, powerful, and world-class expression of South American terroir. Founded in 1992 as a partnership between French winemaking legend Jean-Paul Valette (former owner of Château Pavie) and Chilean Jorge Pérez Cruz, Viña El Principal is situated at 750 to 800 metres above sea level along the majestic Andes Mountains. Named in honor of the Picunche chief Andetelmo—known locally as 'El Principal'—this flagship icon wine is harvested from the estate's oldest high-density vineyard blocks, planted on gravelly alluvial soils over rocky subsoils. Under technical director Gonzalo Guzmán and consulting oenologist Patrick Léon, the winemaking philosophy incorporates meticulous hand harvesting, parcel-by-parcel fermentation in small stainless steel vats, and maturation for 18 to 20 months in French oak barrels (approximately 80% to 100% new). The result is a monumental red wine that marries Andean mountain altitude, extraordinary fruit concentration, and classic Bordeaux cellaring nobility.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense violet-crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe wild blackberry, black currant, dark plum compote, and cassis, interwoven with sophisticated notes of Andean cedar, graphite, wild mint, eucalyptus, pipe tobacco, dark cocoa, and toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, expansive, and seamless, delivering concentrated flavours of black fruit, licorice, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural high-altitude acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, muscular tannins and an exceptionally dense mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark berries, balsamic spice, and a clean gravelly mineral grip. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon blended with Cabernet Franc and Syrah, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2048+. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Andean mountain power, intense aromatic precision, and world-class cellaring potential.

title: Kilchoman Single Cask Batch 15/768
bodyHtml:
This heavily peated single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, handcrafted on Islay at Kilchoman Distillery. Kilchoman Single Cask Batch 15/768 is an exclusive single-barrel release distilled in 2015 from Cask #768 (specifically selected for Western Canadian retailers and the Canadian Prairies market). Matured in a single fresh American oak ex-bourbon barrel, this expression was bottled non-chill filtered and natural in color at a cask-strength punch of 117 proof (58.5% ABV). By focusing on a single, un-vatted bourbon cask, it delivers an unadulterated, high-proof look into Kilchoman's farm-distillery character without sherry or wine cask finishing.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a pale straw to light golden amber hue in the glass. On the nose, it opens with vibrant, un-cut Islay peat smoke, bonfire ash, and medicinal reek, quickly balancing into sweet vanilla bean, lemon zest, green apple, and fresh malt. On the palate, the 58.5% ABV cask strength provides a thick, oily, and mouth-coating texture. Initial notes of sweet caramel, toasted coconut, and tropical fruit give way to an explosive mid-palate of earthy peat smoke, cracked black pepper, and salty maritime brine. The finish is exceptionally long, warm, and drying, leaving lingering impressions of charred oak, citrus peel, and persistent coastal peat smoke.

Accolades

Kilchoman single cask releases—particularly full-proof bourbon cask selections—hold a stellar reputation among Islay whisky enthusiasts and independent reviewers. Independent review outlets and platforms like Whiskybase routinely score Kilchoman single bourbon barrels in the 88–92 point range, praising their raw, ester-rich citrus brightness, clean peat smoke, and lack of chill filtration.

title: Tequila Lost Lore Reposado High Proof
bodyHtml:
This additive-free, high-proof reposado tequila originates from Mexico, produced at NOM 1414 (Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados) in Arandas, within the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco. Crafted using 100% Blue Weber agave harvested at peak maturity, the agave piñas are slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens (hornos) and roller-mill crushed. The juice undergoes open-air fermentation using a proprietary cultured yeast strain before double distillation in small copper pot stills. This High Proof expression is aged for approximately 3 months in medium-toast American oak barrels before being bottled at a formidable strength of 96 proof (48.0% ABV)—delivering an unadulterated, agave-forward profile framed by subtle wood influence.

Spirit Description

This reposado displays a pale, straw-gold color with brilliant clarity and thick, slow-running legs in the glass. On the nose, it is vibrant, punchy, and aromatic, opening with dominant aromas of cooked agave, bright citrus (grapefruit and lime zest), and fresh cracked white pepper, followed by soft undertones of vanilla bean, toasted cinnamon, and light cedar. On the palate, it feels oily, full-bodied, and energetic, delivering an initial explosion of rich, caramelized agave sweetness and baking spices, which quickly shifts into bright minerality, lemongrass, and gentle toasted oak. The elevated 48% ABV strength provides a bold structural backbone that amplifies the cooked agave without harsh alcohol burn. The finish is long, crisp, and warming, trailing off with persistent notes of cooked agave, white pepper spice, subtle oak tannins, and a cleansing citrus zest.

Accolades

Lost Lore Reposado High Proof has achieved high acclaim among tequila purists, master bartenders, and additive-free spirit enthusiasts. Produced at the renowned NOM 1414 distillery—famous for traditional production standards—it routinely earns outstanding ratings on platforms like Tequila Matchmaker. Critics applaud it for defying the common trend of over-oaked reposados, praising its ability to let the high-proof Highland agave character shine front and center while using short barrel maturation merely to round out the mouthfeel.

title: Tequila Lost Lore Elvira Blanco Limited
bodyHtml:
This additive-free, unaged silver tequila originates from Mexico, produced at NOM 1414 (Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados) in Arandas, within the High-Altitude Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco. Named Elvira in homage to a legendary figure within the brand's lore, this special limited-edition release is crafted using 100% mature Blue Weber agave grown in iron-rich red clay soil. Following traditional brick oven (horno) roasting and roller-mill extraction, the agave juice undergoes open-air fermentation using proprietary cultured yeast strains (including wine-yeast influences typical of Master Distiller Sergio Cruz). Distilled in small copper pot stills, this small-batch blanco is bottled unaged at a robust, higher-than-standard strength of 92 proof (46.0% ABV)—delivering a pure, unadulterated, and terroir-driven expression of Highland agave.

Spirit Description

This blanco tequila presents crystal clarity with bright silver flashes and heavy, slow legs clinging to the glass. On the nose, it is remarkably aromatic and lifted, opening with concentrated notes of sweet oven-roasted agave, bright Meyer lemon peel, and crushed mint, underlaid by wet stone minerality, floral orange blossom, and fresh white pepper spice. On the palate, it feels rich, oily, and mouth-coating, delivering an immediate wave of natural agave sweetness, tropical fruit brightness (guava and green apple), and lemongrass. As it flows across the palate, the elevated 46% ABV strength provides structure and warmth without aggressive burn, developing into crisp mineral salt, herbal anise, and a prickle of jalapeño pepper. The finish is exceptionally long, warm, and clean, trailing off with lingering roasted agave sweetness, citrus zest, and a persistent, dry mineral spice.

Accolades

Lost Lore Elvira Blanco has earned high acclaim among tequila purists, additive-free aficionados, and craft spirits collectors. Produced at the esteemed NOM 1414 distillery—famed for traditional, non-industrialized techniques—it routinely scores top marks on platforms like Tequila Matchmaker. Spirits critics applaud the bottling for showcasing Master Distiller Sergio Cruz's signature ester-driven fermentation profile, celebrating how the 46% ABV proof amplifies the natural sweetness and mineral complexity of Highland agave without masking it behind wood or additives.

title: Kilchoman Rockside
bodyHtml:
This heavily peated single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, handcrafted on the rugged western coast of Islay at Kilchoman Distillery. Founded in 2005 as Islay’s first new distillery in 124 years, Kilchoman operates as a true traditional farm distillery. Named in honor of the historical Rockside Farm—where the distillery is situated and where a portion of their barley is grown, harvested, and floor-malted on site—this release celebrates Kilchoman’s signature farm-to-glass philosophy. Crafted using heavy Islay peat smoke (50 PPM), the spirit is aged in a combination of first-fill American oak ex-bourbon barrels and Spanish Oloroso sherry casks before being bottled non-chill filtered and natural in color at 92 proof (46.0% ABV).

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a bright pale straw to light amber hue with clean clarity in the glass. On the nose, it is bold, maritime, and intensely aromatic, opening with vibrant wafts of medicinal peat smoke, bonfire ash, and damp coastal moss, quickly revealing sweet lemon oil, green apple peel, vanilla sponge cake, and a touch of brine. On the palate, it feels oily, lively, and medium-bodied, delivering an initial rush of sweet malt, honeyed citrus, and tropical fruits (pineapple and lime), which rapidly transitions into a dense mid-palate of earthy peat smoke, cracked black pepper, and charred oak wood. The finish is long, warm, and lingeringly smoky, leaving trailing impressions of ash, salted caramel, citrus zest, and a persistent coastal peat heat.

Accolades

Kilchoman releases—including those honoring Rockside Farm—hold an elite reputation among Islay whisky enthusiasts and spirits purists. Earning top scores on independent platforms like Whiskybase, Distiller, and Whisky Advocate, critics consistently praise Kilchoman for its expressive farm-distillery character. Reviewers highlight how their 46% ABV bottling strength and reliance on top-tier ex-bourbon casks allow the vibrant, ester-rich citrus profile and pungent Islay peat smoke to sing in perfect harmony without heavy wood over-extraction.

title: Vina El Principal Calicanto 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Chile in the Maipo Valley region, specifically within the Pirque sub-zone in the Andean foothills, Viña El Principal 'Calicanto' 2024 represents a refined, expressive, and terroir-driven Chilean red blend. Founded in 1992 as a partnership between French winemaking icon Jean-Paul Valette (former owner of Château Pavie) and Chilean Jorge Pérez Cruz, Viña El Principal is celebrated for its gravelly alluvial soils situated at 750 to 800 metres above sea level along the Andes Mountains. Named after the historic Calicanto bridge built over the Mapocho River in Santiago during the 18th century, this bottling is designed as an accessible, elegant counterpart to the estate's flagship icon wine. Under technical director Gonzalo Guzmán, the winemaking philosophy incorporates hand harvesting, parcel-by-parcel temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats, and maturation for 12 to 14 months in French oak barrels (a combination of new and second-use oak). The result is a vibrant red wine that balances mountain fresh fruit, savory Andean herb complexity, and classic French structural balance.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with vivid crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of wild blackberry, dark cherry, cassis, and black plum compote, interwoven with sophisticated notes of eucalyptus, fresh mint, crushed granite minerality, pipe tobacco, cedar, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, dark chocolate, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural high-altitude acidity. Framed by fine-grained, velvety tannins and a supple mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, wild herbal spice, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon blended with Carmenère, Syrah, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2036. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Andean mountain freshness, lush fruit depth, and refined French elegance.

title: Vina El Principal Kine Verdejo 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Chile in the Maipo Valley region, specifically within the Pirque sub-zone in the Andean foothills, Viña El Principal 'Kinē' Verdejo 2025 represents an innovative, high-altitude, and distinctive expression of South American white winemaking. Founded in 1992 as a joint partnership between French winemaking legend Jean-Paul Valette (former owner of Château Pavie) and Chilean Jorge Pérez Cruz, Viña El Principal is renowned for its gravelly alluvial soils situated at 750 to 800 metres above sea level along the Andes Mountains. Named after the Mapudungun word kinē—meaning 'one' or 'unique'—this bottling is a rare Chilean expression of the Spanish Verdejo grape. Under technical director Gonzalo Guzmán, the winemaking philosophy incorporates hand harvesting from high-density mountain plots, gentle pneumatic pressing, cool temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation, and four to six months of maturation on fine lees with periodic stirring (bâtonnage). The result is a vibrant white wine that marries Andean structural tension, broad lees texture, and intensely aromatic citrus purity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear light straw yellow colour with luminous pale greenish highlights along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of pink grapefruit, crisp green apple, white peach, and lemongrass, interwoven with sophisticated notes of white blossom, fresh fennel, lemon verbena, crushed mountain stone minerality, and subtle saline sea breeze. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of citrus fruit, white stone fruit, and chalky mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural high-altitude acidity. Framed by a textured, subtly creamy mid-palate structure and a sleek mineral grip, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering grapefruit zest, wild herbal spice, and a clean gravelly snap. Composed of 100% Verdejo, this 2025 release offers immediate drinking appeal along with cellaring potential over 3 to 5 years. Stylistically, it combines high-elevation Chilean freshness, aromatic herbal complexity, and exceptional food friendliness.

title: Tromba Blanco Tequila - 1 Litre
bodyHtml:
This additive-free blanco tequila originates from Mexico, produced in the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco at NOM 1548 (Destiladora del Valle de Tequila). Founded by former Don Julio Master Distiller Marco Cedano and his son Rodrigo, Tromba takes its name from the heavy highland rains that nourish the region's Blue Weber agaves. Crafted using 100% estate-grown agaves harvested at peak maturity (around 7 years), the piñas are cooked in traditional brick ovens (hornos), roller-mill crushed, and fermented using proprietary wild yeast. Following double distillation in small copper pot stills, this blanco is bottled unaged at 80 proof (40.0% ABV). The 1-Litre format is a bartender favorite, delivering a clean, agave-forward highland spirit built specifically for high-volume, craft-cocktail execution.

Spirit Description

This blanco displays crystal clarity with bright silver flashes and medium, clean legs in the glass. On the nose, it is fresh, crisp, and aromatic, opening with vibrant sweet cooked agave, bright lime zest, and green apple, followed by subtle undertones of fresh mint, white pepper spice, and damp highland earth. On the palate, it feels medium-bodied, soft, and silky—a signature of Marco Cedano's distillation style—delivering an initial wave of natural agave sweetness, grapefruit oil, and floral orange blossom. As it flows across the tongue, a gentle prickle of white pepper and light mineral salt emerges without any harsh ethanol burn. The finish is crisp, clean, and refreshing, leaving trailing impressions of sweet cooked agave, lemon peel, and a soft, dry pepper warmth.

Accolades

Tromba Blanco holds strong critical acclaim among industry bartenders, mixologists, and additive-free tequila purists. Earning high ratings across platforms like Tequila Matchmaker and securing Gold Medals at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition, reviewers consistently applaud it for its exceptional value-to-quality ratio. Critics highlight its clean Highland terroir profile, noting that its smooth mouthfeel and absence of artificial additives make it one of the most reliable workhorse blancos on the market.

title: Effen Vodka - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
What makes EFFEN Original Vodka so smooth?

The answer lies in balance and quality. At every stage of production at our expert Dutch distillery we use only the finest ingredients to create a premium, ultra-smooth vodka. EFFEN Original always delivers, whether you’re partying at home or turning up the heat on the dancefloor.

The water we use is the purest in Holland. The distillation technique is the most meticulously innovative. And the wheat grain we distill is of superior quality. This attention to details elevates our drinks, setting us not just alongside the best premium vodka brands but giving us the edge. Once you’ve tasted EFFEN you’ll never look back.

title: Le Paradou Grenache - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Dark ruby colour. The nose has black and red berries with spicy notes. In the mouth, good concentration, roundness and freshness at the same time. Cherry and blackcurrant aromas with hints of pepper. Very easy to drink!

title: Orin Swift Mercury Head 2023 - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Orin Swift Mercury Head 2023 originates from the United States, within California’s renowned Napa Valley AVA. Created by winemaking visionary Dave Phinney, Orin Swift is famous for crafting bold, full-throated wines wrapped in distinctive packaging—most notably the Mercury Head, which features a genuine Liberty Head "Mercury" dime embedded directly into the glass of each bottle. Sourced from premier vineyard blocks across Napa Valley, including top benchland and hillside sites in Rutherford, Oakville, and St. Helena, the wine is built on a philosophy of uncompromising extraction, seamless oak integration, and opulent fruit expression. The 2023 release continues this tradition, delivering a dense, iconic Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon of power and concentration.

Wine Description

This red wine displays an opaque, deep dark ruby-purple appearance in the glass with an inky core and vibrant violet highlights at the rim. It possesses a full-bodied, rich, and mouth-filling structure defined by a plush, velvety texture and immense structural weight. The sensory profile is explosive, aromatic, and decadent, opening with an intense bouquet of crème de cassis, ripe black cherries, wild blackberries, and dark plum preserves, seamlessly layered with rich secondary notes of dark chocolate, espresso, cigar box, toasted vanilla bean, sweet cedar, and a hint of graphite. On the palate, it delivers a massive core of dark berry fruit held together by ripe, fine-grained tannins and a surprising thread of natural freshness that keeps the wine balanced. The finish is exceptionally long, warm, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of dark cocoa, toasted oak spice, and sweet dark fruit.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes are hand-harvested from select micro-lots across Napa Valley and sorted with extreme precision. Fermentation takes place in stainless steel vats with extended cap management to maximize color and tannic extraction. The wine undergoes aging for approximately 15 to 18 months in French oak barrels (with a high proportion of new French oak), adding signature notes of vanilla, toasted wood, and sweet spice without masking the dark fruit purity.

  • ABV: 15.5%.

  • Organic Status: While Orin Swift partners with growers practicing sustainable viticulture and precision water management across Napa Valley, this bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The immense structural weight, plush fruit intensity, and rich oak profile of Mercury Head make it a decadent companion to bold, savory gastronomy.

  • Fine Meats: Pairs magnificently with grilled prime ribeye steaks, dry-aged New York strip, slow-braised beef short ribs, or tenderloin of beef served with a rich espresso or dark chocolate jus.

  • Game & Rich Poultry: Ideal alongside pan-roasted duck breast with blackberry reduction, venison tenderloin, or braised lamb shanks with rosemary.

  • Earthy Specialties: Complements dishes featuring braised wild mushrooms, truffle-infused pastas, and roasted root vegetables.

  • Cheeses: Matches gracefully with strong, aged cheeses such as sharp cheddar, smoked Gouda, 24-month Comté, or Gorgonzola Piccante.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in Napa Valley is widely regarded as an exceptional, long-running vintage. Marked by a cool, wet winter and spring that replenished soil water reserves, summer brought steady, moderate heat without extreme heatwaves. This allowed Cabernet Sauvignon grapes an extended hanging time on the vine, achieving optimal phenolic ripeness, thick skins, and deep color while retaining vibrant natural acidity. Sourced from premier micro-sites during this extended harvest, the 2023 Mercury Head stands out for its structural density, polished tannins, and pure fruit concentration. Highly enjoyable in its youth following decanting, it possesses the structural integrity to cellar gracefully over 15 to 25 years.

title: Luigi Bosca 'Filos' Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This vibrant, high-altitude dry white wine originates from Argentina, crafted in the prestigious Uco Valley of Mendoza. Founded in 1901 by the Arizu family, Bodega Luigi Bosca is one of Argentina's most historic and respected family-owned wineries, led today by the fourth generation alongside CEO and head winemaker Pablo Cúneo. The name Filos (meaning "edges" or "blades" in Spanish) pays homage to the sharp, slate-like stones and mineral-rich soils found in their high-elevation estate plots across subregions like Gualtallary and San Pablo in the Uco Valley (situated between 1,200 and 1,400 meters above sea level). Filos represents a modern, cool-climate expression of Argentine Chardonnay focused on high natural acidity, saline chalkiness, and precise fruit elegance rather than heavy oak influence.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2024 vintage presents a brilliant pale yellow color with bright greenish-gold reflections. The expressive, highly focused nose opens with soaring aromas of white peach, crisp green apple, and Meyer lemon curd, interwoven with delicate nuances of white flowers, lemon verbena, hazelnut, and a prominent streak of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, energetic, and precise. A razor-sharp beam of high mountain acidity drives the entry, giving way to a textured, slightly creamy mid-palate and a long, saline, mineral-tinged finish. Crafted from 100% Chardonnay, the hand-harvested grapes undergo careful sorting, whole-cluster pressing, and cool fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats and concrete eggs, with a small portion aged in large neutral French oak barrels on fine lees to add subtle textural complexity without masking pure site character. The alcohol by volume sits at 13.5%.

Food Pairing

The piercing acidity, mineral tension, and bright citrus-and-stone-fruit profile of this high-altitude Chardonnay make it an ideal partner for fresh seafood and delicate cuisine. It pairs exceptionally well with pan-seared sea bass, grilled langoustines, butter-poached lobster, king crab legs, and trout amandine. It also complements roasted poultry, wild mushroom or asparagus risotto, goat cheese crostini, and soft French cheeses like Brie or Camembert.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 growing season in the Uco Valley was defined by cool night breezes off the Andes Mountains and steady, moderate summer temperatures, yielding white grapes with exceptional aromatic purity, elevated natural acidity, and low sugar accumulation. These ideal conditions allowed Chardonnay grown on high-elevation limestone soils to retain pristine freshness and mineral tension. The 2024 Luigi Bosca Filos Chardonnay offers immediate charm, energy, and mouthwatering focus upon release, while possessing the structural balance to evolve smoothly over the next 3 to 6 years.

title: Tua Rita Perlato Del Bosco 2022
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Tuscany region of Italy, Perlato del Bosco is a distinguished offering from the renowned Suvereto subregion. The estate was founded by Rita Tua and Virgilio Rossi in 1984, growing from a small family project into a world class winery celebrated for its meticulous attention to detail and commitment to expressing the unique Metalliferous Hills terroir. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on minimal intervention and gravity-led processes to preserve the authentic character of the coastal Tuscan landscape.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese displays a deep ruby red hue with subtle violet highlights. The nose is fragrant and inviting, revealing a bouquet of cherries, raspberries, and wild berries, alongside secondary notes of leather, earth, and a distinct mineral hint of iron and slate. On the palate, the wine is rich and full bodied yet remains remarkably fresh, featuring fine grained tannins and a silky texture.

title: Chandon Cava Brut Hyatt Cuvee
bodyHtml:
The Chandon Spain Cava Hyatt Cuvee Brut is a refined sparkling wine from Spain, specifically crafted in the historic Penedès region of Catalonia. While Domaine Chandon is widely known for its California and Argentine estates, it maintained a notable historical presence in Spain under the 'Chandon Spain' label to produce traditional method sparkling wines. This particular cuvée was developed as an exclusive private label for Hyatt Hotels, combining the house's global winemaking expertise with the traditional heritage of Spanish Cava production.

Wine Description

This Cava presents a bright straw yellow colour with a persistent and fine bead. The sensory profile is elegant and complex, featuring aromas of white peach, citrus zest, and floral notes, balanced by the classic toasted brioche and almond characters derived from its time on lees. On the palate, it is crisp and lively, offering a refreshing acidity with flavours of green apple, pear, and a subtle hint of honey. Following the Cava tradition, the blend typically utilizes indigenous Spanish varieties such as Macabeo, Xarel lo, and Parellada, sometimes enhanced with Chardonnay for additional finesse. It is balanced and medium bodied, finishing with a clean, dry, and mineral length.

title: Passalacqua Chardonnay
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California’s Sonoma County region, specifically within the cool Russian River Valley subregion, Passalacqua Chardonnay represents a small lot expression of single vineyard winemaking. Passalacqua Winery is a family owned estate led by Jason Passalacqua, whose family roots in Sonoma County winemaking stretch back over a century. The estate’s winemaking philosophy centers on sourcing fruit from exceptional site specific vineyards, relying on gentle hand harvesting, whole cluster pressing, and barrel lees stirring to highlight pure fruit elegance and regional character.

Wine Description

The wine displays a brilliant pale gold colour in the glass. An inviting, aromatic bouquet opens with notes of mandarin orange, lime zest, and white peach, underpinned by subtle hints of wet stone minerality, vanilla, and warm brioche. On the palate, it is medium bodied and silky, delivering a textured mouthfeel rich in citrus flavors, yellow apple, and toasted oak spice. Balanced by a streak of bright natural acidity and periodic barrel stirring that adds weight to the mid-palate, it concludes with a long, fresh finish.

title: 19 Crimes Shiraz - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
19 Crimes Shiraz originates from Australia, sourced broadly across the warm, sun-drenched vineyards of South Eastern Australia. Owned by Treasury Wine Estates, the brand pays homage to the 19 infractions that carried the sentence of "punishment by transportation" to Australia during the late 18th and 19th centuries. Operating with a consumer-focused philosophy centered on accessibility, consistency, and technological innovation (such as their pioneer augmented reality labels), 19 Crimes crafts a crowd-pleasing, bold Australian Shiraz that emphasizes fruit sweetness, plush textures, and rich oak influence.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep, saturated ruby-garnet appearance in the glass with bright purple highlights. It possesses a full-bodied, generous, and round structure defined by a plush, velvety, and fruit-forward texture. The sensory profile is fragrant and upfront, opening with bold aromas of ripe dark plums, black cherries, and raspberry jam, interwoven with prominent secondary notes of sweet vanilla oak, dark chocolate, mocha, toasted coconut, and gentle baking spices. On the palate, it delivers an approachable, jammy core of dark berry fruit balanced by low-to-medium natural acidity and soft, completely rounded tannins. The finish is smooth, warm, and lingering, characterized by a sweet impression of dark fruit, vanilla, and cocoa.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Shiraz (Syrah).

  • Stylistic Notes: Fermented in stainless steel tanks to extract generous fruit and color, the wine undergoes aging on American oak staves and chips to impart its signature rich vanilla, chocolate, and spice profile. A small touch of residual sugar is deliberately maintained to enhance its soft, mouth-filling sweetness and early approachability.

  • ABV: 13.5% to 14.1% (varies slightly by market/bottling).

title: 19 Crimes "Convict Collection" Bundled by ZYN
bodyHtml:
Uncork the unexpected with the 19 Crimes "Convict Collection" Bundled by ZYN. Inspired by the British rogues exiled to Australia for breaking the law, this 6-bottle line-up delivers bold, rebellious wines that demand a full trial. From rich, velvety reds to crisp, unapologetic whites, every bottle carries a story worth getting caught for.

The Suspects:

  • Cabernet Sauvignon: Firm, dark, and uncompromisingly rich with layered notes of blackberry, vanilla, and oak.

  • Hard Chardonnay: Bold and brazen with a rich, buttery body, baked apple, and toasted oak warmth.

  • Pinot Noir: Subtle, slick, and surprisingly refined—packed with juicy red cherry, plum, and light spice.

  • Sauvignon Blanc: Bright, crisp, and refreshing with sharp citrus, tropical fruit, and a clean finish.

  • Shiraz Durif: Heavy-hitting and dark, blending intense blackberry and plum with muscular tannins.

  • Shiraz Mataro: Rich and savory, pairing deep dark fruit with earthy spice and a smooth, lingering finish.

title: Domaine Dujardin Monthelie Premier Cru 'Les Barbieres' 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Monthelie Premier Cru appellation in the Cote de Beaune, Domaine Dujardin Monthelie Premier Cru Les Barbières represents a structured, intense, and age-worthy expression of Pinot Noir. Crafted by Domaine Dujardin, Les Barbières is a famed Premier Cru vineyard bordering Meursault and Volnay, renowned for producing wines of exceptional depth and tannic framework. The winemaking process incorporates traditional hand harvesting, partial whole-cluster fermentation, native yeasts, and aging in fine French oak barrels to deliver a powerful, terroir-driven wine with exceptional cellaring capacity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, dark ruby purple colour with magenta highlights along the rim. A rich, earthy bouquet opens with intense aromas of dark black cherry, wild blackberry, and plum, interwoven with distinct notes of damp earth, leather, crushed stone minerality, and toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, firm, and muscular, delivering deep layers of dark red berries and savory herbs supported by a vibrant, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Structured by sturdy, fine-grained tannins, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark fruit and earthy complexity. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it pairs the muscular power of neighboring Volnay with Monthelie's vibrant fruit purity.

title: Evolve Pink Effervescence
bodyHtml: Originating from Canada in the British Columbia region, specifically within the Okanagan Valley VQA appellation, Evolve Cellars 'Pink Effervescence' represents a vibrant, approachable, and celebratory expression of Okanagan sparkling rosé. Evolve Cellars, part of the Chronos Cellars umbrella, was established to produce fresh, aromatic, and fruit-forward wines that capture the sun-drenched microclimates of the Okanagan Valley. The grapes are harvested from prime vineyard sites situated along the benches of the Okanagan basin, where gravelly loam soils and cool lake breezes preserve crisp natural acidity. Under the direction of the winemaking team, the winemaking philosophy utilizes gentle pneumatic pressing, short skin contact to achieve its signature blush tone, and secondary Charmat method fermentation in stainless steel pressure tanks. The result is a lively, fruit-driven sparkling rosé that balances bright orchard fruit notes, delicate bubbles, and effortless charm.

title: Samuel Smith Nut Brown Ale Beer 550 ml - Single Bottle
bodyHtml:
This ale is from the United Kingdom, specifically Yorkshire, England. Samuel Smith Old Brewery is one of the oldest independent breweries in Britain, established in 1758. It is known for its traditional brewing methods, including using the original yeast strain since 1900 and brewing water from its own deep well. The brewery is one of the few in the world to still own and operate its own coopers, ensuring the perfect maintenance of its oak casks for maturation.

Beer Description

Samuel Smith's Nut Brown Ale pours a deep, lustrous copper-brown colour with ruby highlights. The aroma is rich and complex, offering distinct notes of hazelnut, almond, and cocoa, backed by a subtle earthy hop character. On the palate, the beer is smooth and well-balanced, delivering flavours of toasted nuts, caramel, and a gentle roasted malt sweetness. It has a medium body and a soft, velvety mouthfeel, which leads to a clean, nutty finish with a slight, balancing bitterness. This ale is styled as an authentic English Brown Ale, showcasing a masterful balance between malt complexity and traditional character. The ABV is typically 5.0%.

title: Modelo Especial 355 ml - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Modelo Especial is Mexico’s premier pilsner-style lager and one of the most remarkable success stories in the modern beverage world. First brewed in 1925 in Mexico City by Grupo Modelo, it was crafted to prove that Mexican lager could stand toe-to-toe with classic European models. An authentic International Pale Lager, it has grown to become the top-selling beer in the United States and a staple export globally. Housed in its iconic, squat, foil-wrapped glass bottle, Modelo Especial balances a rich, golden grain backbone with a crisp, refreshing finish that elevates it well above standard light lagers.

Beer Description

Modelo Especial pours a rich, glowing golden-straw color with bright clarity, a steady stream of fine carbonation, and a fluffy white head that leaves light, thin lacing behind.

Aroma: The nose is clean, sweet, and surprisingly rich for a macro lager. It leads with dominant notes of sweet corn husks, toasted grain, and honeyed pilsner malt, accompanied by a faint, herbal whisper of European noble hops. There are no heavy fruity esters, presenting an aroma that is crisp, bright, and inviting.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a velvety yet snappy carbonation. It opens with a distinct wave of sweet corn and biscuit malt, giving it a heavier, more satisfying mouthfeel than lighter Mexican lagers. The mid-palate introduces a subtle hint of citrus zest and faint spice, concluding with a clean, dry, and balanced finish marked by a very mild, refreshing hop bitterness.

Profile: It sits at an approachable 4.4% ABV and a gentle bitterness of approx. 18 IBU, offering a richer grain character while maintaining high crushability.

Technical Notes: The unique body and color of Modelo Especial come from its blend of filtered water, two-row malted barley, and corn/cereal adjuncts. The use of corn lightens the finish while adding a characteristic sweet grain note. It is fermented cold with a clean bottom-fermenting lager yeast and hopped delicately with Galena and Saaz hop varieties, giving it just enough structural bitterness to balance the residual malt sweetness without dominating the palate.

title: Castellare Di Castellina 'I Sodi di San Niccolo' 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Toscana IGT appellation in Castellina in Chianti, Castellare di Castellina 'I Sodi di San Niccolò' 2022 1.5 Litre Bottle represents a iconic, historic, and highly collectible Super Tuscan expression bottled in the prestigious Magnum format. First released in 1977 by Paolo Panerai, 'I Sodi di San Niccolò' made history as the very first Super Tuscan to be crafted exclusively from native Tuscan grape varieties without international blending. Sourced from two exceptional, high-elevation estate vineyards (sodi referring to hard-to-till stony soils) in Castellina in Chianti planted at 350 to 400 metres elevation, the vines grow on rich galestro and clay-limestone soils. The winemaking philosophy under renowned enologist Alessandro Cellai involves hand harvesting, ambient yeast fermentation in stainless steel vats, and maturation in fine French oak barriques (approximately 50% new) for 24 to 30 months. Bottled in a 1.5 Litre format, the larger liquid volume slows oxidation and extends bottle maturation, resulting in superior long-term cellaring stability, freshness, and structural integration.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with bright purple-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, red plum, and blood orange, interwoven with sophisticated notes of crushed dried rose petals, pipe tobacco, graphite, leather, liquorice, and subtle French oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, multi-layered, and taut, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berry fruit jam, tart cherry curd, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, firm galestro tannins and a deep, coat-the-mouth mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, dried Mediterranean herbs, and a clean chalky mineral grip. Composed of 85% Sangioveto (the historic local clone of Sangiovese) blended with 15% Malvasia Nera, this 2022 1.5 Litre release offers an optimal drinking window of 2030–2055+. Stylistically, it combines Castellina's high-altitude elegance and high-toned acidity with powerful structure, enhanced cellaring potential, and timeless complexity.

title: Castellare Di Castellina 'I Sodi di San Niccolo' 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Toscana IGT appellation in Castellina in Chianti, Castellare di Castellina 'I Sodi di San Niccolò' 2022 represents a pioneering, historic, and iconic Super Tuscan expression of indigenous Tuscan varieties. First released in 1977 by Paolo Panerai, 'I Sodi di San Niccolò' made history as the very first Super Tuscan to be crafted exclusively from native grape varieties without international blending. Sourced from two exceptional, high-elevation estate vineyards (sodi referring to hard-to-till stony soils) in Castellina in Chianti planted at 350 to 400 metres elevation, the vines grow on rich galestro and clay-limestone soils. The winemaking philosophy under renowned enologist Alessandro Cellai involves hand harvesting, ambient yeast fermentation in stainless steel vats, and maturation in fine French oak barriques (approximately 50% new) for 24 to 30 months, followed by 12 months of bottle refinement. The result is a wine of majestic structure, deep red fruit purity, and monumental aging potential.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with bright purple-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, red plum, and blood orange, interwoven with sophisticated notes of crushed dried rose petals, pipe tobacco, graphite, leather, liquorice, and subtle French oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, multi-layered, and taut, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berry fruit jam, tart cherry curd, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, firm galestro tannins and a deep, coat-the-mouth mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, dried Mediterranean herbs, and a clean chalky mineral grip. Composed of 85% Sangioveto (the historic local clone of Sangiovese) blended with 15% Malvasia Nera, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2028–2050+. Stylistically, it combines Castellina's high-altitude elegance and high-toned acidity with powerful structure, complexity, and timeless cellaring capability.

title: Castello di Ama Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'Bellavista' 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Chianti Classico Gran Selezione DOCG appellation in Gaiole in Chianti, Castello di Ama Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'Bellavista' 2022 represents an historic, majestic, and legendary single-vineyard expression of Tuscan Sangiovese. First produced in 1978, Vigneto Bellavista is recognized as one of the very first single-vineyard cru bottlings in Chianti Classico history. Sourced from a renowned 5.56 hectare parcel situated at nearly 500 metres elevation with stony clay-limestone and galestro soils, the winemaking philosophy under winemaker Marco Pallanti combines meticulous hand harvesting, co-fermentation of varieties in ambient temperature-controlled vats with native yeasts, and aging in fine French oak barriques (approximately 40% new) for around 15 months. The result is a Gran Selezione of monumental depth, aristocratically structured tannins, and profound high-altitude elegance.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, black plum, and blood orange, interwoven with sophisticated notes of crushed dried rose petals, forest floor, pipe tobacco, graphite, leather, and refined French oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, multi-layered, and dense, delivering concentrated flavours of dark red berry fruit jam, tart cherry curd, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, firm galestro tannins and a deep, coat-the-mouth mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, dried Mediterranean herbs, and a chalky mineral grip. Composed primarily of Sangiovese co-fermented with Malvasia Nera, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2028–2050+. Stylistically, it combines Gaiole's classic floral finesse and high-elevation tension with powerful Gran Selezione structure and extraordinary cellaring capability.

title: Castello di Ama Chianti Classico 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Chianti Classico DOCG appellation, Castello di Ama Chianti Classico 2023 represents an aristocratic, refined, and terroir driven expression of Tuscan Sangiovese. Located in Gaiole in Chianti, Castello di Ama was founded in the 1970s and is internationally celebrated under the leadership of Lorenza Sebasti and winemaker Marco Pallanti for elevating Chianti Classico to world-class heights. Sourced from high-elevation estate vineyards averaging 450 to 500 metres above sea level planted on stony clay-limestone and galestro soils, the winemaking philosophy combines careful hand harvesting, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats with native yeasts, and aging in second-passage French oak barriques for approximately 12 months. The result is a Chianti Classico of exceptional elegance, vibrant red fruit purity, and trademark Tuscan acidity and structure.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear ruby red colour with bright garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with enticing aromas of ripe red cherry, dark plum, wild raspberry, and crushed red currant, interwoven with noble notes of dried violet petals, forest floor, leather, tobacco leaf, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silky, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of red fruit, tart cherry curd, and mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine, chalky tannins and a harmonious mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, savory Mediterranean herbs, and a clean galestro mineral grip. Composed primarily of Sangiovese blended with small amounts of Merlot, this 2023 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2036. Stylistically, it combines Gaiole's high-altitude freshness and floral finesse with classic Chianti Classico balance and depth.

title: Castello di Ama Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'La Casuccia' 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Chianti Classico Gran Selezione DOCG appellation in Gaiole in Chianti, Castello di Ama Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'La Casuccia' 2022 represents an historic, opulent, and majestic single-vineyard expression of Tuscan terroir. First produced in 1985 alongside 'L'Apparita', Vigneto La Casuccia is a benchmark cru vineyard spanning 12.58 hectares at approximately 480 metres elevation, featuring nine distinct sub-parcels planted on stony clay-limestone soils. The winemaking philosophy under winemaker Marco Pallanti involves meticulous hand harvesting, co-fermentation of varieties in ambient temperature-controlled vats with native yeasts, and aging in fine French oak barriques (approximately 40% new) for around 15 months. Produced only in exceptional vintages and in strictly limited quantities, 'La Casuccia' delivers a Gran Selezione of profound, fleshy dark fruit depth, velvety texture, and high-altitude refinement.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense purple-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with opulent aromas of ripe black cherry, wild blackberry, dark plum, and cassis, interwoven with sophisticated notes of dark chocolate, pipe tobacco, crushed dried violet petals, forest floor, graphite, and sweet French oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, fleshy, and velvety, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berry fruit jam, tart cherry curd, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, rounded tannins and a deep, coat-the-mouth mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, cocoa powder, and a refined chalky limestone grip. Composed primarily of Sangiovese blended with a small proportion of Merlot, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2028–2050+. Stylistically, it combines Merlot-driven mid-palate richness and sensuality with Gaiole's high-elevation tension, Gran Selezione structure, and long-term aging potential.

title: Castello di Ama L'Apparita 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Toscana IGT appellation in Gaiole in Chianti, Castello di Ama 'L'Apparita' 2022 1.5 Litre Bottle represents a legendary, world-class, and iconic expression of Italian Merlot presented in the prestigious Magnum format. First crafted in 1985 as Tuscany's very first pure Merlot bottling, 'L'Apparita' is celebrated globally as one of the greatest cult wines of Italy. Sourced from a tiny 3.84 hectare parcel situated at the highest crown of the Vigneto Bellavista vineyard at nearly 500 metres elevation, the vines grow on rich clay and galestro soils. The winemaking philosophy under winemaker Marco Pallanti involves manual harvesting, meticulous sorting, ambient yeast fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats, and maturation in French oak barriques (approximately 50% new) for 15 to 18 months. Bottled in a 1.5 Litre format, the increased volume slows oxidation and extends bottle maturation, resulting in enhanced freshness, seamless structure, and superior long-term cellaring capacity.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense purple-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe black plum, wild blackberry, dark cherry, and cassis, interwoven with sophisticated notes of dark chocolate, espresso bean, dried violet petals, pipe tobacco, graphite, and sweet French oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, velvety, and mouth-filling, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berry fruit jam, red fruit curd, and mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, seamless tannins and a deep, coat-the-mouth mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, savory cocoa, and a refined chalky mineral grip. Composed of 100% Merlot, this 2022 1.5 Litre release offers an optimal drinking window of 2029–2055+. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Pomerol-like richness and flesh with Chianti Classico's signature high-altitude freshness, enhanced cellaring potential, and timeless structure.

title: Castello Di Ama Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'San Lorenzo' 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Chianti Classico Gran Selezione DOCG appellation in Gaiole in Chianti, Castello di Ama Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'San Lorenzo' 2022 represents an historic, benchmark estate expression of Tuscan terroir. Named after the picturesque valley where the historic 18th century estate villas stand, 'San Lorenzo' is crafted from a rigorous selection of fruit sourced from the estate’s four premier historic vineyard sites: Bellavista, Casuccia, San Lorenzo, and Montebuoni. Situated at high elevations between 460 and 525 metres above sea level on gravel-rich clay-limestone soils, the vines benefit from exceptional diurnal temperature variations. The winemaking philosophy under technical director Marco Pallanti involves parcel-by-parcel manual harvesting, ambient yeast fermentation in stainless steel vats, and maturation in fine French oak barriques (approximately 22% new) for around 10 to 12 months. The result is a Gran Selezione of extraordinary harmony, vibrant red and black fruit concentration, and sublime Gaiole freshness.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with bright purple-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe black cherry, wild strawberry, dark plum, and elderberry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of crushed violet petals, sandalwood, dried lavender, cinnamon spice, graphite, and leather. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, ample, and dense, delivering concentrated flavours of dark fruit, cassis, and mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by taut, supple, finely knit tannins and a driving mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering red berries, savory herbs, and a clean chalky mineral grip. Composed of 80% Sangiovese blended with 13% Merlot and 7% Malvasia Nera, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2027–2045. Stylistically, it combines grand cru-like refinement and aromatic complexity with impressive vintage depth, structure, and cellaring capability.

title: Castello di Ama Chianti Classico Riserva Montebuoni 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Chianti Classico Riserva DOCG appellation in Gaiole in Chianti, Castello di Ama Chianti Classico Riserva Montebuoni 2022 represents a distinguished, single-vineyard expression of Tuscan Sangiovese. First produced in 2018, Montebuoni is sourced from a historic 15 hectare vineyard parcel acquired by the estate in 1997, situated on a picturesque hill opposite the main estate at approximately 420 to 500 metres elevation. The vines grow on stony clay-limestone and galestro soils, benefiting from excellent sun exposure and cool night breezes. The winemaking philosophy under winemaker Marco Pallanti involves hand harvesting, ambient yeast fermentation in stainless steel vats, and aging in French oak barriques (approximately 20% new) for around 12 to 14 months. The result is a Riserva of remarkable elegance, bright red fruit concentration, and distinct Gaiole terroir expression.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear ruby red colour with bright garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with enticing aromas of ripe red cherry, wild raspberry, red plum, and blood orange, interwoven with noble notes of dried rose petals, forest floor, leather, graphite, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, silky, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of tart red berries, dark cherry curd, and mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine, chalky galestro tannins and a harmonious mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, savory Mediterranean herbs, and a clean limestone grip. Composed primarily of Sangiovese blended with a small proportion of Merlot, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2040. Stylistically, it combines Gaiole's signature high-altitude freshness and floral finesse with Riserva level depth and structure.

title: Charles Smith Pinot Noir Wines of Substance - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in the Washington region, specifically within the Columbia Valley AVA appellation, Wines of Substance 'Pn' Pinot Noir represents a distinctive, highly expressive, and modern approach to Pacific Northwest winemaking. Created by visionary winemaker Charles Smith, the Wines of Substance project aims to deliver single-varietal wines crafted with traditional small-batch techniques at exceptional value. The grapes are sourced from cool climate, high elevation vineyard sites across Washington State where gravelly, well draining soils allow Pinot Noir to flourish. Under the winemaking direction of Charles Smith and Brennan Leighton, the winemaking philosophy utilizes native yeast fermentation, 100% whole berry inclusion, gentle hand punch-downs, and maturation on fine lees in French oak barrels (approximately 25% new) for 12 months without fining or filtration. The result is an aromatic, fruit forward Pinot Noir that captures both cool climate tension and Washington fruit intensity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear translucent ruby red colour with soft garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe red cherry, wild raspberry, pomegranate, and red plum, interwoven with subtle notes of orange peel, dried rose petal, subtle forest floor, white pepper, and toasted cedar spice. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of fresh red berries, dark cherry curd, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool climate acidity. Framed by velvety, fine-grained tannins and a supple, seamless mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruits, subtle savory spices, and a clean mineral grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it offers immediate drinking appeal along with cellaring potential over 3 to 6 years. Stylistically, it combines Washington fruit generosity, elegant whole-berry aromatics, and effortless food friendliness.

title: Two Hands Cabernet Sauvignon Sexy Beast - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Founded in 1999 by Michael Twelftree and Richard Mintz, Two Hands Wines has earned an international reputation for crafting bold, expressive wines that showcase regional diversity. Based in Barossa Valley but sourcing grapes from across Australia's premium regions, the winery’s philosophy revolves around minimal intervention and highlighting varietal and site character. ‘Sexy Beast’ is part of their Picture Series, known for its approachable yet high-quality offerings.

title: Charles Smith Cabernet Sauvignon Wines of Substance - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This Cab is from Charles Smith, the dynamic, self-taught guru of Washington wines. He turned from a life as a rock band manager to rock the world of wine. The Wines of Substance Cabernet Sauvignon is loaded with blueberries, cassis, scorched earth and spice in a rich, full-bodied, balanced package.

"Dark chocolate, nutmeg, sage and blackcurrants on the nose, followed by a full-bodied, focused and juicy palate. Firm yet ripe tannins. Drink or hold."

title: Louis Latour Aloxe Corton Premier Cru 'Les Chaillots' 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from France, within the Côte de Beaune region of Burgundy and the Aloxe-Corton Premier Cru appellation. Founded in 1797, Maison Louis Latour is one of Burgundy's most historic family-owned estates, owning over 90% of the Les Chaillots vineyard surrounding their famous Château Corton Grancey. The vineyard's name derives from "caillou" (pebble), reflecting its stony, gravel-rich soils. The winery's philosophy emphasizes traditional open-vat fermentation and aging in medium-toasted French oak barrels crafted in their own cooperage to capture site power and classic ageability.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep ruby color. On the nose, it opens with intense aromas of blackcurrant, dark cherry, and summer florals, layered with subtle oak spices and earthy undergrowth notes. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a fresh, supple mouthfeel, structured by velvety, powdery tannins and a touch of liquorice. The finish is long, elegant, and persistent. The varietal composition is 100% Pinot Noir. It has an alcohol content of approximately 13.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: La Rioja Alta 904 Gran Reserva 2016
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Spain, within the Rioja Alta subregion of DOCa Rioja. Produced by La Rioja Alta S.A., a historic family-owned winery founded in 1890 in Haro's Station District, the "904" bottling commemorates the 1904 merger with Bodegas Arana. The winemaking philosophy represents the pinnacle of traditional, long-aged Rioja, relying on estate-grown fruit from old vines in Briñas, Villalba, and Rodezno, extended barrel aging in custom American oak made in-house, and manual rackings by candlelight every six months.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep garnet-red color with a bright, vibrant ruby rim. On the nose, it opens with intense, highly complex aromas of wild red cherry, strawberry, and dried berry fruit, layered with signature tertiary notes of cigar box, tobacco leaf, vanilla, leather, cedar, and subtle balsamic undertones. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full body with a silky, seamless, and creamy texture, supported by supple, ultra-polished tannins and remarkable natural acidity. The finish is exceptionally long, savory, and refined, lingering with notes of dark fruit, delicate oak spice, and dried herbs. The varietal composition is a traditional blend of 90% Tempranillo and 10% Graciano. It has an alcohol content of 14.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

Vintage Quality

The 2016 growing season in Rioja was characterized by excellent weather and a long, extended ripening period, delivering fruit with exceptional balance, aromatic intensity, and structural maturity. Aged for four years in American oak barrels followed by extended cellaring in the bottle before release, the 2016 vintage is widely recognized as a spectacular, textbook example of traditional Rioja with immense longevity.

title: Latour Villages Nuits Saint-Georges 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Nuits Saint Georges AOC Village appellation in the Côte de Nuits, Maison Louis Latour Nuits Saint Georges Villages 2023 represents a classic, robust, and earth-driven expression of Pinot Noir. Founded in 1797, Maison Louis Latour is one of Burgundy's most iconic historic negociant houses. The town of Nuits Saint Georges gives its name to the famous Côte de Nuits sub-region, with vines planted on east-facing slopes composed of deep limestone, marl, and silt-rich clay soils. Under the direction of the winemaking team in Beaune, the winemaking philosophy incorporates traditional open-vat temperature-controlled fermentation, partial whole-cluster inclusion, and maturation for 10 to 12 months in medium-toasted French oak barrels crafted at Latour's own cooperage. The result is a deeply structured village wine that bridges wild dark fruit power, earthy complexity, and classic Burgundian polish.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, luminous garnet red colour with dark crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of black cherry, wild blackberry, black plum, and cassis, interwoven with sophisticated notes of forest floor, game, liquorice, smoked meats, crushed limestone, and warm cedar spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, firm, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, dark chocolate, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, muscular tannins and a dense mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red and dark fruits, leather, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2023 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2036. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Nuits Saint Georges structure, wild savory aromatics, and the lush, pure fruit character of the 2023 vintage.

title: Veuve Clicquot La Grande Dame 2018
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Champagne region, specifically within the Champagne AOC appellation, Veuve Clicquot La Grande Dame 2018 represents a prestigious, world-class, and highly refined prestige cuvée. First created in 1972 to honor Madame Clicquot—the visionary 'Grande Dame of Champagne' who revolutionized modern sparkling winemaking in the 19th century—this flagship bottling showcases the pinnacle of Pinot Noir excellence. Sourced from historic Grand Cru vineyards including Verzenay, Verzy, Ambonnay, Bouzy, and Aÿ, the vines grow in shallow, chalk-dominated soils that impart intense mineral structure. Under cellar master Didier Mariotti, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes Pinot Noir dominance, stainless steel fermentation to preserve vineyard purity, low dosage (approximately 6 g/L), and extensive aging on fine lees for over six years in the historic chalk cellars (crayères) of Reims. The result is a monumental Champagne that marries pinot depth, silken effervescence, and extraordinary aging capacity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale gold colour with bright green-gold reflections and an ultra-fine, persistent bead rising steadily to a delicate mousse along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of mirabelle plum, white peach, poached pear, and candied lemon peel, interwoven with sophisticated notes of acacia blossom, fresh brioche, toasted almond, hazelnut, honeysuckle, and crushed chalk minerality. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of stone fruit, citrus oil, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool-climate acidity. Framed by a rich, velvety mid-palate texture and seamless perlage, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon zest, warm pastry, and a clean chalky grip. Composed of a Pinot Noir dominant blend (90% Pinot Noir and 10% Chardonnay), this 2018 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2024–2042+. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Pinot Noir power, vinous complexity, and supreme Champagne elegance.

title: Grey Goose Altius - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Grey Goose Altius is an ultra-premium luxury vodka produced by Grey Goose in the Cognac region of France (owned by Bacardi Limited). Introduced in 2024, Altius was created to capture the rare purity and atmosphere of the high-altitude French Alps. Positioned as an elite release designed for high-end nightlife, luxury hospitality, and discerning spirits collectors, Altius utilizes a specialized sub-zero filtration process that mimics the extreme natural cold of high alpine environments.

Spirit Description

Grey Goose Altius is crafted using 100% single-origin French soft winter wheat sourced from the Picardie region. After continuous column distillation in Picardie, the high-proof spirit is combined with pure spring water sourced from natural alpine wells in the French Alps. The key differentiator for Altius is its bespoke production process: the liquid undergoes a specialized crystallization and filtration at -24°C (-11°F). This glacial temperature filtration locks in a remarkably smooth, soft texture while preserving subtle mineral nuances.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, luminous, and brilliantly transparent.

  • Aroma: Exceptionally clean, crisp, and subtle. Opens with delicate alpine minerality, soft white pepper, and light hints of sweet wheat and almond blossom.

  • Palate: Unusually smooth, velvety, and soft on the entry. Clean flavors of fresh mountain air minerality give way to a light, natural wheat sweetness and subtle creaminess.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a icy, silky, and coating mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Ultra-clean, crisp, and smooth, trailing off with a gentle mineral snap and zero harsh burn.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Castello di Ama 'Vigneto Bellavista' 2022 - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Chianti Classico Gran Selezione DOCG appellation in Gaiole in Chianti, Castello di Ama 'Vigneto Bellavista' 2022 represents a historic, legendary, and benchmark expression of single-vineyard Sangiovese. Founded in 1972, Castello di Ama is recognized as a pioneer of single-vineyard (vigneto) site selection in Chianti Classico, with 'Vigneto Bellavista' first produced in 1978. Situated at 490 metres above sea level on stony, clay-limestone soils rich in galestro and alberese, this 5.6-hectare vineyard is planted predominantly to Sangiovese alongside a small proportion of Malvasia Nera. Under CEO and winemaking director Marco Pallanti, the winemaking philosophy incorporates parcel-by-parcel ambient yeast fermentation in stainless steel, followed by 15 to 18 months of maturation in fine-grained French oak barriques (approximately 40% new). The result is a monumental Gran Selezione that balances intense structural power, dark fruit depth, and aristocratic cellaring potential.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense crimson-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, black plum compote, and cassis, interwoven with sophisticated notes of Mediterranean scrub, dried violets, crushed stone minerality, pipe tobacco, leather, and warm cedar spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, expansive, and seamless, delivering concentrated flavours of black fruit, licorice, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural high-elevation acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, muscular tannins and an extraordinarily dense mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark berries, balsamic nuances, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed of approximately 80% Sangiovese and 20% Malvasia Nera, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2048. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Gaiole altitude, single-vineyard focus, and seamless structural depth.

title: Crystal Head Vodka Gold
bodyHtml:
This luxury, additive-free vodka originates from Newfoundland, Canada, produced by Crystal Head Vodka—co-founded in 2008 by actor Dan Aykroyd and artist John Alexander.
