The Gold Edition (often associated with their pride celebrations or special metallic-finished releases) features the brand's iconic bespoke skull-shaped bottle crafted by Bruni Glass, finished in a striking metallic gold plating. The spirit within is distilled seven times from high-quality Canadian corn and blended with pristine water from St. John's, Newfoundland. True to the brand's signature process, the liquid undergoes seven filtration steps, three of which pass through semi-precious quartz crystals known as Herkimer diamonds. Bottled at 80 proof (40.0% ABV) with zero additives—no glycerol, citrus oils, or added sugar—it delivers a smooth, clean, and unadulterated neutral spirit profile.

Spirit Description

This vodka presents absolute crystal clarity with bright luminescence in the glass. On the nose, it is neutral, crisp, and subtle, opening with soft aromas of sweet corn, vanilla bean, and a faint mineral brightness, completely devoid of harsh medicinal or ethanol notes. On the palate, it feels medium-bodied, silky, and extraordinarily smooth, delivering delicate sweetness from the corn base alongside subtle notes of toasted grain, light citrus zest, and cream. The Herkimer diamond filtration imparts a distinct, velvety mouthfeel and a pristine mineral texture. The finish is short, clean, and crisp, leaving a soft warmth, subtle grain sweetness, and zero lingering burn.

Accolades

Crystal Head Vodka holds widespread acclaim across international spirits competitions, earning a Double Gold Medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition and high ratings from publications such as Wine Enthusiast. Spirits judges and vodka purists routinely praise the expression for its commitment to zero additives, highlighting how its ultra-pure filtration process results in a exceptionally smooth, velvety mouthfeel without relying on artificial sweetening agents.

title: Orin Swift Mercury Head Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Orin Swift Mercury Head 2023 originates from the United States, within California’s renowned Napa Valley AVA. Created by winemaking visionary Dave Phinney, Orin Swift is famous for crafting bold, full-throated wines wrapped in distinctive packaging—most notably the Mercury Head, which features a genuine Liberty Head "Mercury" dime embedded directly into the glass of each bottle. Sourced from premier vineyard blocks across Napa Valley, including top benchland and hillside sites in Rutherford, Oakville, and St. Helena, the wine is built on a philosophy of uncompromising extraction, seamless oak integration, and opulent fruit expression. The 2023 release continues this tradition, delivering a dense, iconic Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon of power and concentration.

Wine Description

This red wine displays an opaque, deep dark ruby-purple appearance in the glass with an inky core and vibrant violet highlights at the rim. It possesses a full-bodied, rich, and mouth-filling structure defined by a plush, velvety texture and immense structural weight. The sensory profile is explosive, aromatic, and decadent, opening with an intense bouquet of crème de cassis, ripe black cherries, wild blackberries, and dark plum preserves, seamlessly layered with rich secondary notes of dark chocolate, espresso, cigar box, toasted vanilla bean, sweet cedar, and a hint of graphite. On the palate, it delivers a massive core of dark berry fruit held together by ripe, fine-grained tannins and a surprising thread of natural freshness that keeps the wine balanced. The finish is exceptionally long, warm, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of dark cocoa, toasted oak spice, and sweet dark fruit.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes are hand-harvested from select micro-lots across Napa Valley and sorted with extreme precision. Fermentation takes place in stainless steel vats with extended cap management to maximize color and tannic extraction. The wine undergoes aging for approximately 15 to 18 months in French oak barrels (with a high proportion of new French oak), adding signature notes of vanilla, toasted wood, and sweet spice without masking the dark fruit purity.

  • ABV: 15.5%.

  • Organic Status: While Orin Swift partners with growers practicing sustainable viticulture and precision water management across Napa Valley, this bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The immense structural weight, plush fruit intensity, and rich oak profile of Mercury Head make it a decadent companion to bold, savory gastronomy.

  • Fine Meats: Pairs magnificently with grilled prime ribeye steaks, dry-aged New York strip, slow-braised beef short ribs, or tenderloin of beef served with a rich espresso or dark chocolate jus.

  • Game & Rich Poultry: Ideal alongside pan-roasted duck breast with blackberry reduction, venison tenderloin, or braised lamb shanks with rosemary.

  • Earthy Specialties: Complements dishes featuring braised wild mushrooms, truffle-infused pastas, and roasted root vegetables.

  • Cheeses: Matches gracefully with strong, aged cheeses such as sharp cheddar, smoked Gouda, 24-month Comté, or Gorgonzola Piccante.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in Napa Valley is widely regarded as an exceptional, long-running vintage. Marked by a cool, wet winter and spring that replenished soil water reserves, summer brought steady, moderate heat without extreme heatwaves. This allowed Cabernet Sauvignon grapes an extended hanging time on the vine, achieving optimal phenolic ripeness, thick skins, and deep color while retaining vibrant natural acidity. Sourced from premier micro-sites during this extended harvest, the 2023 Mercury Head stands out for its structural density, polished tannins, and pure fruit concentration. Highly enjoyable in its youth following decanting, it possesses the structural integrity to cellar gracefully over 15 to 25 years.

title: Luigi Bosca 'Filos' Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant, high-altitude dry white wine originates from Argentina, crafted in the prestigious Uco Valley of Mendoza. Founded in 1901 by the Arizu family, Bodega Luigi Bosca is one of Argentina's most historic and respected family-owned wineries, led today by the fourth generation alongside CEO and head winemaker Pablo Cúneo. The name Filos (meaning "edges" or "blades" in Spanish) pays homage to the sharp, slate-like stones and mineral-rich soils found in their high-elevation estate plots across subregions like Gualtallary and San Pablo in the Uco Valley (situated between 1,200 and 1,400 meters above sea level). Filos represents a modern, cool-climate expression of Argentine Chardonnay focused on high natural acidity, saline chalkiness, and precise fruit elegance rather than heavy oak influence.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2024 vintage presents a brilliant pale yellow color with bright greenish-gold reflections. The expressive, highly focused nose opens with soaring aromas of white peach, crisp green apple, and Meyer lemon curd, interwoven with delicate nuances of white flowers, lemon verbena, hazelnut, and a prominent streak of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, energetic, and precise. A razor-sharp beam of high mountain acidity drives the entry, giving way to a textured, slightly creamy mid-palate and a long, saline, mineral-tinged finish. Crafted from 100% Chardonnay, the hand-harvested grapes undergo careful sorting, whole-cluster pressing, and cool fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats and concrete eggs, with a small portion aged in large neutral French oak barrels on fine lees to add subtle textural complexity without masking pure site character. The alcohol by volume sits at 13.5%.

Food Pairing

The piercing acidity, mineral tension, and bright citrus-and-stone-fruit profile of this high-altitude Chardonnay make it an ideal partner for fresh seafood and delicate cuisine. It pairs exceptionally well with pan-seared sea bass, grilled langoustines, butter-poached lobster, king crab legs, and trout amandine. It also complements roasted poultry, wild mushroom or asparagus risotto, goat cheese crostini, and soft French cheeses like Brie or Camembert.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 growing season in the Uco Valley was defined by cool night breezes off the Andes Mountains and steady, moderate summer temperatures, yielding white grapes with exceptional aromatic purity, elevated natural acidity, and low sugar accumulation. These ideal conditions allowed Chardonnay grown on high-elevation limestone soils to retain pristine freshness and mineral tension. The 2024 Luigi Bosca Filos Chardonnay offers immediate charm, energy, and mouthwatering focus upon release, while possessing the structural balance to evolve smoothly over the next 3 to 6 years.

title: Vina Cobos Felino Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Viña Cobos Felino Cabernet Sauvignon is a red wine from Argentina, produced in the Mendoza region. The wine is made by Viña Cobos, a winery co-founded by American winemaker Paul Hobbs in 1999. Paul Hobbs is a pioneering winemaker who has been instrumental in elevating Malbec and Argentine wines onto the international stage. The winery's philosophy is rooted in meticulous vineyard management and respect for terroir, creating complex, elegant, and authentic wines. The 'Felino' line is intended to be an introduction to the authenticity and varietal purity of the Mendoza terroir.

Wine Description

The wine is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. It has a deep ruby red colour with black tones. The aromatic profile is intense, offering scents of red pepper and fresh red fruit. Further notes include tobacco, cocoa, and spices like nutmeg.

It is a medium bodied wine. The palate is juicy and concentrated, with supple red fruit flavours. It is round and smooth, with juicy, sinewy tannins that are plush and well balanced. Stylistically, it is a well balanced and impressively delicious wine from Paul Hobbs and his team. The grapes are sourced from both Luján de Cuyo and Valle de Uco, combining the warm and cool, lower and higher elevations of Mendoza. The wine is aged for nine months in American oak barrels, with roughly 10% new oak. The finish is smooth, fairly long, and resonates with fresh red fruit. The ABV is 14.5%. The optimal drinking window is now through 2034. The winery employs sustainable farming methods and uses organic principles in its viticulture.

title: Zenato Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Amarone della Valpolicella has exploded in the wine world as wine lovers are falling head-over-heals for this opulent, flavourful, high alcohol red wine. Canadians are at the top of that list, importing more Amarone than anywhere else in the world!

The Zenato winery possesses a strong link to the richness of its local history and culture, and continues to develop this connection today. The estate is based in a territory that surrounds Lake Garda, with an extraordinary microclimate that allows for an optimal growing season. Cherishing a ‘frank and simple’ approach to life, Zenato is committed to producing affordable wine of exceptional quality. 

From a quality-focused family winery, this is big and powerful, even for an Amarone. Rich and plush-textured with luscious chocolate, liquorice, prune, nutty and floral flavours. Demands a hearty meal such as barbecued back ribs, rack of lamb or steak.

title: Vina Cobos Felino Malbec - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
From Argentina’s renowned Mendoza region, this Malbec is crafted by Viña Cobos, a winery co-founded by Paul Hobbs together with Andrea Marchiori and Luis Barraud. Known for its focus on terroir expression, Viña Cobos sources grapes from high-altitude vineyards in Luján de Cuyo and the Uco Valley, producing wines of elegance and character.

Wine Description
Deep red-purple in the glass with violet reflections, Felino Malbec reveals expressive aromas of blackberry, blueberry, and plum, layered with hints of violet, spice, and graphite. The palate is medium-bodied, juicy, and fresh, with flavours of boysenberry, black cherry, and savoury spice.

Food Pairing
This Malbec pairs beautifully with grilled beef, roasted lamb, sausages, or hearty stews. Its fresh fruit character and savoury spice also complement bison burgers or charcuterie. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Vina Cobos Felino Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Argentina in the South American region, specifically within the high-altitude Valle de Uco appellation in Mendoza, Viña Cobos 'Felino' Chardonnay represents an aromatic, precise, and fresh expression of New World Chardonnay crafted with European restraint. Founded in 1999 by visionary American winemaker Paul Hobbs alongside Argentine partners, Viña Cobos is celebrated for elevating Mendoza terroirs to global acclaim through meticulous vineyard management and non-interventionalist winemaking. Sourced from select high-elevation vineyards situated between 990 and 1,200 metres above sea level on gravelly, limestone-rich alluvial soils, the winemaking philosophy combines hand harvesting, cold whole-cluster pressing, native yeast fermentation, and partial barrel aging in French oak (approximately 15% to 20% new) alongside stainless steel tanks. The result is a vibrant Chardonnay that highlights pure white stone fruit, bright citrus tension, and delicate mineral energy.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear straw yellow colour with luminous pale green reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly fragrant bouquet opens with inviting aromas of green apple, white peach, fresh pear, and lemon curd, interwoven with subtle notes of jasmine, white flowers, crushed limestone, brioche, and delicate toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, crisp, and beautifully balanced, delivering concentrated flavours of crisp orchard fruit, citrus zest, and tropical mango, all anchored by a bright, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by a satiny texture derived from gentle lees stirring and a focused mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, persistent finish marked by lingering white fruit, citrus peel, and a refreshing mineral grip. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, it effortlessly marries Mendoza's high-altitude sunshine and fruit purity with Paul Hobbs' signature precision, balance, and elegance.

title: Veuve Clicquot Brut - Puffy Bottle Jacket - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Veuve Clicquot Brut Yellow Label originates from France, within the iconic Champagne region. Founded in 1772 by Philippe Clicquot and later famously driven to global renown by Madame Clicquot (the "Grande Dame of Champagne"), the house pioneered fundamental winemaking innovations, including the invention of the riddling table. This special edition pairs the flagship Yellow Label Brut with an insulated, limited-edition "Puffy" jacket sleeve—a functional, stylish accessory designed to keep a pre-chilled bottle cold for up to two hours on the go.

Wine Description

This non-vintage Champagne displays a bright, golden-yellow colour with fine, persistent bubbles. The nose is highly expressive and fragrant, opening with initial aromas of ripe yellow apple, white peach, and golden pear, evolving into notes of lemon curd, toasted brioche, vanilla, and subtle roasted nuts. On the palate, it exhibits a medium body with a crisp, lively structure, offering a harmonious balance between Pinot Noir power, Chardonnay finesse, and Meunier fruitiness. Stylistically, it is a classic, rich, and mouthwatering Champagne with a long, elegant, and mineral-accented finish.

title: Trapiche Malbec Medalla - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: A full-bodied, flavoured red wine offering intense aromas of red and black fruits. A smooth, velvety texture and round, velvety tannins. This exquisite red wine from Argentina's Trapiche winery boasts intense aromas of ripe red and black fruit. Its full-bodied texture is marked by velvety tannins, creating a smooth, velvety finish. Perfectly balanced, this bottle will be sure to delight.

title: The Prisoner Wine Co. - Prisoner Red Blend - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: The Prisoner Red Blend was inspired by the wines first made by the Italian immigrants who originally settled in Napa Valley. The Prisoner is now the most recognized red blend, leading the resurgence of interesting blends by incorporating Zinfandel with the unlikely mix of Cabernet Sauvignon, Petite Sirah, Syrah, and Charbono. Bright aromas of ripe raspberry, vanilla, and coconut give way to flavors of fresh and dried blackberry, pomegranate, and vanilla, which linger harmoniously for a smooth and luscious finish.

title: Ridge Vineyards Lytton Springs Estate - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
#3 Wine Spectator Top 100 2025

The 2023 Ridge Vineyards Lytton Springs Estate has achieved significant critical acclaim, most notably being named the #3 Wine of the Year for 2025 by Wine Spectator. This prestigious ranking makes it the highest-rated Zinfandel ever in the history of the publication's annual Top 100 list.

Ridge Vineyards Lytton Springs Estate 2023 originates from the United States, specifically from the Dry Creek Valley region and the Sonoma County subregion in California. The vineyard’s history began in 1972 when Ridge made its first Lytton Springs wine from vines planted at the turn of the century; the estate was officially purchased by the winery in 1991. Ridge Vineyards follows a 'pre-industrial' winemaking philosophy, relying on natural primary and secondary fermentations with native yeasts and minimal intervention to preserve the fruit's distinctive character and site expression.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a dark crimson or deep garnet colour and a medium to full body with a structured, elegant frame. The sensory profile features a powerfully aromatic nose of raspberry, black pepper, licorice, and subtle vanilla, often accented by notes of potpourri and sandalwood. On the palate, it delivers a core of black cherry, plum, and marionberry fruit supported by supple tannins, bright acidity, and a stony minerality. The finish is remarkably long and layered, revealing complex notes of garrigue, dried herbs, and black tea.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional field blend of 76% Zinfandel, 14% Petite Sirah, 7% Carignane, 2% Alicante Bouschet, and 1% Mataro.

  • Stylistic Notes: The 2023 vintage is noted for its refined mouthfeel, poise, and exceptional length, presenting a more nuanced and restrained expression compared to previous years.

  • ABV: Recorded at 14.4%.

  • Organic Status: This wine is produced from 100% organically grown estate grapes and is fermented without added industrial yeasts or enzymes.

Food Pairing

The structured elegance and peppery fruit profile of Lytton Springs make it an excellent companion for rich and savoury dishes. Suggested pairings include lamb tacos served with a sweet mole sauce or roasted lamb chops to complement the wine's earthy undertones. It also pairs effectively with hot Italian sausage sandwiches featuring roasted peppers, smoked brisket, or smash burgers. For a more casual pairing, it works well with mushroom based dishes or heavier salads that can stand up to its medium body.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in Dry Creek Valley was defined by a cool, wet winter and a mild summer that allowed for slow, even ripening. This remarkably cool season delayed the start of the harvest by approximately one month, resulting in a vintage characterized by greater restraint, vibrant acidity, and more refined fruit intensity than previous warmer years.

title: Tantalus Syrah - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
A deep maroon in colour, this wine displays wonderful spiced and nuanced aromatics. Blueberry and blackberry compote with dusty white pepper and a touch of nutmeg. There is a buoyant floral quality to the wine with a hint of classic charcuterie notes in the background. 

The palate is fruity and structured with rich black and blue fruits carrying through the palate. Long and velvety with a plush round mouth feel this wines shows cardamom and pepper with orange peel and a touch of pomegranate and red licorice, adding intrigue. The finish is long and lifted with great clarity and minerality. The tannins are fine grained and very well integrated.

title: Produttori del Barbaresco - Langhe Nebbiolo - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The Produttori del Barbaresco Langhe Nebbiolo originates from the Langhe DOC in the Piedmont region of Northern Italy. Founded in 1958, this historic cooperative is composed of 54 families who collectively tend 100 hectares of premium vineyards to produce exclusively Nebbiolo based wines. Their winemaking philosophy centers on a dedication to the heritage of the Barbaresco commune, ensuring that even their entry level Langhe Nebbiolo offers an immediate and authentic expression of the grape's personality and the unique terroir.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo presents a ruby red colour with a medium body. The aromatic profile is defined by intense red fruits, specifically strawberries and ripe cherries, accented by spicy notes of white pepper, anise, and tea leaves. On the palate, the wine is balanced and fresh, featuring bright fruit flavours supported by medium tannins and a lingering, spicy finish.

title: Pirramimma Heritage Limited Edition GSM - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Pirramimma Heritage GSM is a masterfully crafted Rhone style blend from the McLaren Vale region in South Australia. Established in 1892, Pirramimma is one of Australia's oldest family-owned wineries and is currently under the guidance of third generation winemaker Geoff Johnston. The winery is dedicated to its 'estate grown' philosophy, utilizing the unique red loam, limestone, and ironstone soils of their historic vineyards to produce wines known for their depth and regional integrity.

Wine Description

This deep mauve-hued red blend showcases the modern Australian interpretation of the classic Grenache, Shiraz, and Mourvèdre (GSM) style. The nose is lifted and expressive, revealing complex aromas of raspberries, plums, and cassis, nuanced by notes of smoked meats, mushrooms, and subtle spices. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with an intense delivery of juicy red cherry, Christmas cake, and pomegranate flavours, balanced by pomegranate and anise. It is characterized by sleek, fine-grained tannins and a light touch of spicy oak that leads to a persistent, harmonious finish.

title: Mollydooker Gigglepot Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Mollydooker is a family owned and operated winery based in a charming part of the world that is McLaren Vale, South Australia. The dedicated team make a portfolio of wines that beautifully represent the warm, coastal climate of the region, but with the uniqueness that results from their trademarked winemaking techniques.

Gigglepot Cabernet is vibrant yet elegant, with a nose full of juicy red berries and subtle hints of exotic spice. The palate takes you through an array of fruit flavours and mocha notes with a toasty, savoury aftertaste. Beautifully balanced, the Gigglepot’s delicate tannins show restraint allowing the fruit spectrum to shine.

title: Santa Rita Pehuen - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Santa Rita Pehuén originates from Chile, within the prestigious Apalta subregion of the Colchagua Valley. Produced by Viña Santa Rita—one of Chile’s oldest and most historically significant wineries, founded in 1880—Pehuén represents the estate's pinnacle expression of Carmenère. Named after the ancient Pehuén (Araucaria or Monkey Puzzle tree) native to the Chilean Andes, the wine is sourced from a single, historic vineyard block planted in 1938 on deep granite-and-clay soils. Operating with a ultra-premium philosophy, Santa Rita combines meticulous hand-sorting, micro-fermentation, and extended oak maturation to elevate Carmenère into a world-class, age-worthy luxury wine.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, opaque purple-violet appearance in the glass with an inky dark core. It possesses a full-bodied, dense, and velvety structure defined by a plush, mouth-coating, and expansive texture. The sensory profile is rich, seductive, and highly complex, opening with an intense bouquet of black plum preserves, dark cherries, and wild blackberries, seamlessly layered with signature Carmenère notes of dark chocolate, roasted coffee beans, dried herbs, sweet tobacco leaf, graphite, and subtle red paprika spice. On the palate, it delivers a massive, fruit-concentrated core supported by fine-grained, ripe, and polished tannins and a balanced thread of acidity that keeps the palate lively. The finish is remarkably long, lingering, and opulent, leaving persistent echoes of cocoa, sweet cedar, and dark berry fruits.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically 90% to 95% Carmenère, blended with small proportions of Cabernet Sauvignon or Syrah for structural framing.

  • Stylistic Notes: Hand-harvested from low-yielding 80+ year-old vines in Apalta. The grapes undergo cold maceration prior to fermentation in small stainless steel tanks and concrete vats. The wine undergoes malolactic fermentation and ages for approximately 18 to 20 months in French oak barrels (with a high percentage of new oak), followed by extended bottle aging prior to release.

  • ABV: Typically 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The opulent weight, dense fruit core, and distinct savory-spice profile of Pehuén Carmenère make it a magnificent companion to rich, high-end gastronomy.

  • Fine Meats: Pairs exceptionally well with grilled prime ribeye, roasted rack of lamb with garlic and herbs, slow-braised beef short ribs, or char-broiled steaks with chimichurri sauce.

  • Game & Poultry: Ideal when served alongside pan-roasted duck breast with a plum or blackberry reduction, wild boar ragù, or venison loin.

  • Earthy Dishes: Complements dishes featuring dark mole sauce, roasted root vegetables, truffle-infused risottos, and dishes with roasted bell peppers or cocoa-nib rubs.

  • Cheeses: Matches gracefully with mature, firm cheeses such as aged Manchego, 24-month Comté, sharp cheddar, or smoked Gouda.

title: Mer Soleil Chardonnay Reserve - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This rich and 'dramatic' white wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Santa Lucia Highlands subregion of Monterey County in California. Founded in 1988 by Chuck Wagner of Caymus Vineyards, Mer Soleil was one of the pioneering estates in a region previously dedicated to cattle grazing and row crops. Since 2001, the winery has been led by Chuck's son, winemaker Charlie Wagner, whose philosophy focuses on utilizing the area's extreme coastal conditions, intense sunlight and cooling Pacific breezes, to foster a longer growing season and greater varietal complexity.

Wine Description

The Mer Soleil Chardonnay Reserve presents a clear and golden yellow colour. The sensory profile is highly expressive, featuring a nose of Meyer lemon curd, honeysuckle, and lemon blossoms infused with the warmth of vanilla and a hint of sea breeze. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, round, and 'lush', showcasing flavours of ripe peach, lemon meringue pie, Anjou pear, and tropical notes of mango and pineapple. It is characterized by a creamy, silky texture and integrated medium acidity that balances its rich mouthfeel. The finish is dry and refreshing, with lingering impressions of toasted almonds, custard, and a subtle touch of oak. This 100% Chardonnay reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and was matured for 12 to 15 months in French oak barrels to achieve its signature unctuosity. While the Wagner family emphasizes sustainable vineyard practices, this wine is not officially certified organic.

title: Mendel Semillon  - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Produced in Argentina within the high-altitude Paraje Altamira appellation in the Uco Valley, Mendoza, Mendel Sémillon represents a rare, textured, and cellaring grade expression of old-vine white wine. Managed under the technical direction of legendary Argentine winemaker Roberto de la Mota alongside the Sielecki family, Mendel Wines is dedicated to preserving Argentina's historic viticultural treasures through artisanal precision. Sourced from a ungrafted, historic vineyard planted in 1942 at over 1,100 metres above sea level on stony, chalky limestone and alluvial soils, the winemaking philosophy combines hand harvesting, careful whole-cluster pressing, cold fermentation, and partial barrel aging in French oak (approximately 15% new) for six months with periodic lees stirring. The result is a luminous Sémillon that showcases the profound depth, vibrant acidity, and remarkable cellaring capacity of Mendoza's ancient white vine heritage.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear bright straw yellow colour with pale greenish-gold reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with subtle aromas of green apple, white peach, conference pear, and lemon zest, interwoven with delicate notes of white flowers, honeyed beeswax, crushed stone, fresh almond, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, satiny, and precise, delivering concentrated flavours of citrus curd, orchard fruit, and mineral chalk, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a silky, coat-the-mouth texture derived from old-vine concentration and fine lees aging, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus, savory herb, and a crisp limestone grip. Composed of 100% Sémillon, it combines the sun-ripened purity and high-altitude freshness of the Uco Valley with Sémillon's classic structural weight, complexity, and ageability.

title: Mendel Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Mendel Winery embodies the union of Roberto de la Mota, one of Argentina's most respected and experienced winemakers. with a nearly century-old Argentine family, whose sole objective is to produce wine of unquestionable, superior quality that expresses the character of their very old Malbec and Cabernet vineyards in Lujan de Cuyo, Mendoza, Argentina.

Mendel is the first name of the owner's father, a man who came to Argentina with nothing and ended up a successful businessman in different industries. He was also a man that loved the finest things that life had to offer, particularly wine. His daughter, Anabelle, honours her father by seeking perfection in her and Roberto's wines with his name on the label.

title: Louis Jadot Pinot Noir Bourgogne - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This classic and elegant red wine originates from France, specifically within the Burgundy region. Founded in 1859, Maison Louis Jadot is one of the most prestigious names in the Côte d'Or, maintaining a reputation for consistency across its vast portfolio of vineyards. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a 'terroir-driven' approach, utilizing traditional Burgundian winemaking techniques and long macerations to ensure the wine captures the authentic character of the diverse soils found throughout the region.

Wine Description

Louis Jadot Bourgogne Pinot Noir presents a bright ruby red colour. The sensory profile is highly aromatic, featuring a nose of fresh red berries, such as strawberries and raspberries, layered with sophisticated notes of cherries and a hint of earthiness. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and 'silky', showcasing a harmonious balance of fruit and soft, well-integrated tannins. It is characterized by its graceful structure and a refreshing acidity that leads to a clean, lingering finish with subtle spicy undertones.

title: La Posta Tinto Red Blend - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Argentina in the South American region, specifically within the high-altitude Uco Valley appellation in Mendoza, La Posta 'Tinto' Red Blend represents an energetic, fruit-forward, and accessible expression of classic Argentine red varieties. Created by pioneer Dr. Laura Catena alongside winemaker Estela Perinetti, La Posta celebrates small-scale artisanal grape growers across Mendoza, with each bottling named in honour of local vineyard families and their traditions. Sourced from high-elevation vineyards situated along the alluvial foothills of the Andes Mountains on well-drained gravelly clay and limestone soils, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes sustainable viticulture, hand harvesting, temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation, and gentle barrel aging in French oak (approximately 10% to 15% new) for eight months. The result is a vibrant red blend that highlights pure dark fruit character, supple texture, and effortless everyday drinkability.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear dark ruby purple colour with bright violet reflections along the rim. An expressive, fruit-driven bouquet opens with generous aromas of wild blackberry, dark plum, red cherry, and crushed blueberry, interwoven with subtle notes of cocoa powder, violet petals, sweet baking spices, and light toasted oak. On the palate, it is medium bodied, smooth, and lush, delivering ripe flavours of dark berries, red fruit jam, and subtle mineral earth, all balanced by a bright, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by soft, fine-grained tannins and a rounded mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, persistent finish marked by lingering berry fruit, gentle spice, and a hint of dark chocolate. Composed primarily of Malbec blended with Bonarda and Syrah, it showcases Mendoza's high-altitude sunshine and fruit purity with approachable charm, balance, and versatility.

title: La Posta Malbec Angel Paulucci - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Argentina’s Mendoza region, specifically Luján de Cuyo, is renowned for producing some of the country’s most expressive Malbecs. La Posta is a project created to highlight small, family-owned vineyards, showcasing the character of growers like Angel Paulucci, whose vines were planted in 1972. The winery philosophy is rooted in authenticity, letting each grower’s parcel reflect its unique terroir.

Wine Description
This Malbec displays a deep ruby colour in the glass. The nose opens with aromas of fresh raspberries, red cherries, and plums, layered with violet florals and subtle toasty oak. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, showing lively berry fruit with hints of vanilla, spice, and caramel from partial oak ageing. The tannins are firm yet approachable, lending structure without overwhelming. A balanced acidity keeps the wine vibrant, finishing with lingering notes of fruit and gentle oak spice.

title: Giant Steps Circle of Fifths Pinot Noir - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This fragrant and light to medium bodied red wine originates from Australia, within the cool climate Yarra Valley region of Victoria. Giant Steps was established by Phil Sexton, who named the winery after a John Coltrane album to signify his 'giant step' from Western Australia to the Yarra Valley to pursue ideal sites for Pinot Noir. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes minimal intervention and gravity flow processes to highlight site specific transparency. While the estate's single vineyard wines focus on individual plots, the Circle of Fifths is a harmonious blend or 'chord' of batches from all five of the winery's single site vineyards in the Yarra Valley.

Wine Description

The Giant Steps Circle of Fifths Pinot Noir presents a bright, medium crimson red appearance. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and complex:

  • Aroma: Features a 'perfumed' bouquet of maraschino cherries, wild raspberries, and rose petals, layered with fennel seed spice, lavender, and star anise.

  • Palate: Mid weighted and textured, showcasing pure flavours of red summer berries, blueberries, and cranberry underpinned by bright acidity and 'fuzzy' herbal notes.

  • Finish: Long and elegant with a mineral edge and persistent notes of licorice and dried sage.

This 100% Pinot Noir is crafted using a portion of whole bunch parcels (approximately 20% to 42% depending on the vintage) to add structural perfume and tannin. The wine is matured in French oak barriques (with 15% to 22% new oak) and reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 13.8% for the 2025 release. It is bottled by gravity without fining or filtration and is not certified organic.

title: Giant Steps Circle of Fifths Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from Australia, within the cool-climate Yarra Valley region of Victoria. Giant Steps was established in 1997 by wine industry pioneer Phil Sexton, who named the winery after John Coltrane's iconic jazz album as a metaphor for his 'giant step' from Margaret River to the Yarra Valley to find the ideal site for Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. The winemaking philosophy, currently led by Head of Winemaking and Viticulture Melanie Chester, focuses on 'tight and transparent' expressions of individual vineyard sites. The Circle of Fifths series represents a 'chord' a harmonious blend of all the winery's single-vineyard parcels into one cohesive wine.

Wine Description

The Giant Steps Circle of Fifths Chardonnay presents a refined and 'taut' sensory profile with a pale straw appearance. The nose is highly aromatic, featuring scents of white nectarine, lemon verbena, and citrus blossom, layered with subtle notes of confit lemon, grilled nuts, and a touch of struck match. On the palate, the wine is concentrated and linear, showcasing flavours of grapefruit pith, white peach, and Meyer lemon underpinned by a 'zingy' acidity and savoury saline minerality. It is characterized by its chalky, tensile structure and an elegant finish that balances fruit energy with a whisper of toasty oak. This 100% Chardonnay is whole-bunch pressed directly to French oak puncheons (approximately 15% to 20% new) and fermented naturally with indigenous yeasts. It typically undergoes a small amount of malolactic fermentation around 10% depending on the season and rests on lees for approximately seven to ten months with minimal stirring to preserve tension.

title: El Enemigo Malbec - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
El Enemigo Malbec originates from the high-altitude vineyards of Mendoza, Argentina, specifically sourced from the prestigious Adrianna Vineyard in the Uco Valley. Established in 2008, the winery is a joint venture between Alejandro Vigil, chief winemaker at Bodega Catena Zapata, and Adrianna Catena, daughter of Nicolás Catena. Their winemaking philosophy centers on capturing the era when European immigrants first settled in Argentina, aiming to create wines with exceptional refinement and a profound sense of place.

Wine Description

It presents a deep ruby-red colour with violet glints. The nose offers an inviting and complex bouquet of ripe black fruits, plum, and fresh cherry, interwoven with floral notes of lavender and violet, alongside subtle hints of asphalt and toasted wood. On the palate, the wine is full bodied yet precise, featuring a rich and fluid texture with flavours of blackberry, black cherry, pepper, and spice. It is well balanced with refreshing acidity and firm, grippy tannins that lead into an intensely savoury, earth-tinged finish.

title: El Enemigo Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
El Enemigo Chardonnay is a white wine from the Gualtallary region in Mendoza, Argentina. Crafted by winemakers Alejandro Vigil and Adrianna Catena, this Chardonnay exemplifies the unique terroir of high-altitude vineyards and innovative winemaking techniques.

Vineyard and Production

Sourced from vineyards situated at approximately 1,400 meters above sea level in Gualtallary, the vines are over 20 years old and thrive in calcareous soils. The grapes are hand-harvested and fermented using wild yeasts in 500-liter French oak barrels, 35% of which are new. The wine undergoes a 12-month aging process under a veil of flor, a technique reminiscent of Fino Sherry production, imparting distinctive saline and nutty characteristics.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Bright green-gold hue.

  • Aroma: Aromas of peaches and pears with a hint of cashew and a slightly oaky backdrop.

  • Palate: Dry and lean, the palate lingers with a chalky mouthfeel.

title: Oyster Bay Sauvignon Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Oyster Bay Sauvignon Blanc originates from New Zealand, within the Marlborough region. Established in 1990 by Delaware North and now owned by Delegat Group, Oyster Bay gained international acclaim after its inaugural 1990 vintage won the Marquis de Goulaine Trophy for Best Sauvignon Blanc at the International Wine & Spirit Competition in London. The winery focuses on sustainable viticulture, sourcing grapes from cool-climate sites across the Wairau and Awatere Valleys, where abundant sunshine and free-draining alluvial soils produce quintessential New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a pale straw-yellow colour with subtle greenish reflections. The nose is intense and aromatically lifted, delivering vibrant notes of passion fruit, pink grapefruit, and fresh gooseberry alongside hints of lemongrass, dried herbs, and white peach. On the palate, it exhibits a light to medium body with a crisp, mouthwatering acidity and a clean, zesty texture. Stylistically, it offers an easy-drinking, punchy fruit profile that finishes dry and refreshing with lingering citrus and tropical fruit accents.

title: Tantalus Cabernet Franc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Tantalus Vineyards, located in the Okanagan Valley of British Columbia, Canada, has a storied history dating back to 1927, making it one of the oldest continuously producing vineyards in the region. The winery is renowned for its commitment to crafting exceptional wines that authentically express their terroir.

The Cabernet Franc from Tantalus' Further Afield Series is a notable addition to their portfolio. This wine presents a bright ruby hue and offers a complex bouquet featuring notes of tomato leaf, cardamom, fresh tobacco, and crushed rocks, complemented by juicy raspberry and pomegranate aromas. The palate mirrors these aromas, delivering flavors of plum and raspberry, with additional hints of tobacco and pomegranate. The wine is characterized by its great length and a core mineral line, reflecting the high-quality vineyard from which it originates.

Crafted from 100% Cabernet Franc sourced from a certified-organic vineyard in Osoyoos, this wine underwent fermentation in separate batches at varying temperatures, utilizing both wild and inoculated yeasts. Stem inclusion involved up to 40% whole clusters, depending on the batch.

title: Copper Moon Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada, produced by the major Canadian wine producer Andrew Peller Limited, Copper Moon Chardonnay represents an approachable, smooth, and fruit-forward expression of everyday white winemaking. Sourced from a blend of domestic and international grapes cellared in Canada, the Copper Moon brand is designed to deliver accessible, crowd-pleasing wines for casual occasions. The winemaking philosophy focuses on soft pressing, temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation, and minimal oak contact to preserve vibrant fruit characteristics, balanced acidity, and easy-drinking charm.

Wine Description

The wine presents a bright, vibrant lemon yellow colour with soft green highlights in the glass. An inviting and fresh bouquet opens with aromas of ripe green apple, juicy pear, and sweet pineapple, interwoven with subtle floral notes and a gentle hint of toasted vanilla. On the palate, it is medium bodied, soft, and balanced, delivering rich flavours of ripe stone fruit, yellow orchard fruit, and subtle tropical melon, supported by a refreshing touch of natural acidity. Finishing clean, smooth, and crisp, it leaves a pleasant, lingering impression of citrus zest and soft fruit sweetness. Composed predominantly of Chardonnay, it combines refreshing orchard fruit freshness with a smooth, easy-drinking palate structure for versatile everyday appeal.

title: Can Sumoi 'Pure Catalonia' Natural Wine - Bundled by ZYN
bodyHtml:
Pure, high-altitude biodynamic winemaking meets Mediterranean freshness in the Can Sumoi Natural Wine Bundled by ZYN. Created by Pepe Raventós in the rugged, 600-meter-high Montmell mountains of Penedès, Can Sumoi produces zero-sulfite, minimal-intervention natural wines that are wild, electric, and deeply expressive of their land.

What’s Inside the Bundle:

  • 2x Can Sumoi Perfum: A ridiculously vibrant, aromatic white blend combining Macabeo, Garnacha Blanca, and Parellada. Intensely fragrant with notes of jasmine, white peach, green apple, and crisp citrus.

  • 2x Can Sumoi Xarel-lo: A masterclass in Catalonia's signature white grape. Crisp, stony, and bone-dry, featuring layers of yellow apple, fresh herbs, citrus peel, and a distinct salty, mineral finish.

  • 2x Can Sumoi Rosé 'La Rosa': A stunning pale rosé crafted from native Sumoll and Xarel-lo grapes. Delicate and lively, packed with wild strawberry, pomegranate, blossom aromatics, and a zesty Mediterranean acidity.

title: Barefoot Red Moscato - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California, sourced from sun-drenched vineyards across the state's prime growing regions, Barefoot Red Moscato represents a sweet, refreshing, and fruit-forward expression of modern American winemaking. Founded in 1986 by Michael Houlihan and Bonnie Harvey, Barefoot Wine & Bubbly has grown into one of the world's most recognized wine brands, owned today by E. & J. Gallo Winery. The winery's philosophy focuses on crafting fun, accessible wines designed for casual enjoyment, utilizing temperature-controlled cold stainless steel fermentations to retain natural sweetness, bright varietal fruit, and delicate effervescence.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, bright ruby red colour with cheerful cherry reflections in the glass. An expressive and sweet bouquet opens with enticing aromas of juicy red cherry, ripe raspberry, and sweet strawberry jam, interwoven with fragrant notes of honeysuckle, citrus zest, and subtle orange blossom. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, sweet, and lively, delivering luscious flavours of dark berries, sweet peach, and red plum, all balanced by a soft touch of natural acidity and a light, playful spritz. Finishing smooth and refreshingly sweet, it leaves a clean impression of ripe red fruit and floral nectar.

title: Bramare Cabernet Sauvignon 'Lujan de Cuyo' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Viña Cobos, established in 1999 by renowned winemaker Paul Hobbs, is acclaimed for producing exceptional wines that reflect the unique terroirs of Argentina's Mendoza region. Bramare Cabernet Sauvignon 'Luján de Cuyo' exemplifies this dedication, offering a harmonious blend of richness and elegance.

Colour: Bright red with dark tones, indicating its concentration and aging potential.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring hints of pink pepper, black fruits, and sandalwood, offering a complex and inviting profile.

Palate: Angular with tight tannins, the palate presents flavors consistent with the nose, complemented by a balanced acidity and a long, satisfying finish. 

Body: Full-bodied with a rich and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

title: Martin Ray Santa Cruz Pinot Noir - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This terroir-driven red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the premier Santa Cruz Mountains AVA in California. Martin Ray was a pivotal figure in California winemaking, modeling his practices after Burgundy and becoming the first American vintner to designate Pinot Noir on his label. The winery's heritage is deeply rooted in these mountains, and the winemaking philosophy for this label emphasizes a "hands-off" approach, utilizing small-lot fermentation and French oak to ensure the rugged mountain character shines through.

Wine Description

Martin Ray Santa Cruz Mountains Pinot Noir presents a vibrant and expressive profile. Sourced primarily from high-altitude sites like the Coast Grade Vineyard situated at 1,100 feet near a limestone quarry the sensory profile features a nose of deep wild cherry, pomegranate, and black raspberry. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "silky," showcasing layers of earthy sage, nutmeg, and a hint of red chili powder. It is characterized by its focused acidity, refined tannins, and a persistent minerality that reflects the complex schist and limestone soils of the region. This 100% Pinot Noir is typically matured in French oak and bottled with minimal intervention. While the winery manages some heritage sites organically, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

93 Points - James Suckling: “Full-bodied and very structured pinot with iron, bark, mushroom and forest f lowers. Tannins flow across the palate. One for the cellar. Try after 2025.”

title: Kim Crawford Sauvignon Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Kim Crawford produces one of Marlborough’s benchmark Sauvignon Blancs and has been named in the "Wine Spectator Top 100” four times. The secret to Kim Crawford’s success is serious attention to detail in the vineyards and winery, with a special focus on sustainable practices, individual vineyard block harvesting, and small lot fermentation.

Very pale yellow in colour, this is a classic Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc with aromas of lifted citrus, tropical fruit, and crushed herbs.  A fresh, juicy wine with vibrant acidity and plenty of weight and length on the palate. Ripe, tropical fruit flavour with passion fruit, melon, and grapefruit.  Pairs brilliantly with fresh oysters, asparagus, lobster, or summer salads.

title: Joel Gott Cabernet Sauvignon '815' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon typically displays a dark, deep colour with aromas of bright red fruit, black cherry, and blackberry, complemented by notes of clove, vanilla, and brown sugar. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it opens with concentrated dark fruit flavours followed by velvety, well-structured tannins and hints of cedar, mocha, and toasted spice. The finish is long and textured, often revealing lingering notes of vanilla and coffee. The varietal composition is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, aged for approximately 18 months in American oak (with roughly 25% to 30% new oak) to enhance tannin development. It has an ABV of 13.9% to 14.3%.

title: Gaja Grappas - Bundled by ZYN
bodyHtml: Celebrate the artistry of Gaja with this luxurious grappa bundle, featuring three iconic selections: Gaja Grappa di Barolo, Gaja Grappa di Brunello, and Gaja Grappa Gaia & Rey. Each bottle captures the essence of Gaja's legendary winemaking regions, distilled into a rich and refined spirit. This collection is perfect for connoisseurs or as a sophisticated gift for grappa enthusiasts.

title: Gaia de Chateau Puybarbe - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
From France’s Bordeaux region, in the Côtes de Bourg appellation, Château Puybarbe is a family-owned estate with a long tradition of quality winemaking. The vineyard is committed to sustainable practices, holding High Environmental Value and ISO 14001 certifications, and has been progressing through organic conversion. The philosophy at the estate emphasizes balance, respect for the environment, and producing approachable, terroir-driven wines.

Wine Description

Gaïa de Château Puybarbe is a Merlot-dominant red blend that captures the elegance of Right Bank Bordeaux. It presents a deep ruby colour and opens with aromas of ripe blackberries, dark cherries, and delicate hints of roasted coffee and cacao. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, with juicy fruit, supple tannins, and subtle spice. The wine offers balance, freshness, and a savoury finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile Bordeaux red complements a wide range of dishes, including roast chicken, grilled pork tenderloin, game sausages, and hearty stews. It also pairs beautifully with mushroom risotto or roasted vegetable dishes.

title: Il Bruciato by Antinori - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Il Bruciato 2023 is a red wine from Italy, produced in the Tuscany region and the Bolgheri D.O.C. appellation. The wine is made by Marchesi Antinori, one of Italy's most historic and innovative wine producers, with a history spanning 26 generations. Il Bruciato is the second wine of the renowned Guado al Tasso estate in Bolgheri. The estate's philosophy is centred on the exploration of Bordeaux varietals, which thrive in Bolgheri's unique coastal terroir, expressing an elegant, modern, and powerful style.

Wine Description

The wine has an intense ruby red colour. The aromatic profile is noted for its beautiful freshness and fragrance, offering notes of ripe red fruits, especially cherry and plum, along with subtle hints of liquorice and mint. Further aromatic notes include vanilla, coffee, toast, and spicy cedar.

The varietal composition is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Syrah. Specifically, it is 65% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Merlot, and 15% Syrah. It is a medium bodied wine. The palate is harmonious and well balanced, with a velvety and smooth texture. Flavours are fruity and fresh, echoing the nose with red berries and plum, supported by soft, integrated tannins. Stylistically, it is a pleasant, balanced, and approachable wine, designed to be drunk young while still possessing the elegance of the Bolgheri terroir. The wine is aged for eight months in barriques and then for a further four months in the bottle. The finish is long and pleasant. The ABV is 13.5%. The optimal drinking window is to drink now. Information on the organic status of the wine is not available in the sources.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 92 points

  • Vinous - 91 points

  • The Wine Advocate - 90 points

Food Pairing

This wine is versatile and pairs well with rich, savoury dishes. Suggested pairings include roasted and grilled red meats, game, and aged cheeses.

title: Don Melchor Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes
The wine presents a deep purple colour and offers complex aromas of red fruits, berries, and floral notes of violets. On the palate, it is full-bodied with fine, delicate tannins, showcasing a balance between elegance and intensity.

Accolades
The 2021 vintage has received significant acclaim:

  • Wine Spectator: Ranked #1 in the Top 100 Wines of 2024

  • James Suckling: 99 points

  • Vinous: 97 points

title: El Tocador Old Vines Tempranillo - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
El Tocador Old Vines Tempranillo originates from Spain, crafted under the Tierra de Castilla IGP appellation. Created by Hammeken Cellars, modern producers known for crafting fruit forward and approachable Spanish wines, this bottling highlights low yielding, old Tempranillo vines. By utilizing grapes grown on mature vines planted in arid Spanish terroirs, the estate achieves enhanced flavor concentration and depth while respecting traditional Spanish varietal character.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep violet red to ruby purple colour. The nose opens with clean, refined aromas of dark fruit, dark chocolate, and rose petal, accompanied by hints of black cherry, blueberry jam, and warming sweet spices. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with assertive fruit juiciness that is softened by smooth, velvety tannins. Stylistically, the wine balances rich concentration with warmth, delivering lingering notes of milk chocolate, vanilla, coffee bean, and subtle cherry cola through a lengthy finish.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Tempranillo

  • Alcohol by volume: 14.0%

title: Caymus Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 - 50th Anniversary - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The 2022 Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon marks the 50th anniversary of Caymus Vineyards, a family-owned winery established in 1972 in Napa Valley, California. This special release celebrates five decades of winemaking excellence, showcasing the Wagner family's dedication to producing high-quality Cabernet Sauvignon.

Colour: Deep, opaque ruby red, indicating its concentration and youthfulness.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring notes of ripe blackberries, cassis, and dark cherries, complemented by hints of vanilla, tobacco, and dark chocolate.

Palate: Full-bodied and well-structured, offering flavors of dark plum, blackberry, and savory spices, complemented by a rich, fleshy texture.

Body: Full-bodied with a rich and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and persistent, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

Accolades:

  • 95 Points - Natalie MacLean

  • 91 Points - Wine Spectator

  • 90 Points - CellarTracker Community Ratings

title: Bread & Butter Pinot Noir - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the diverse vineyards of California, Bread & Butter Pinot Noir is a cornerstone of the WX Brands portfolio. The winery operates under a clear philosophy: "good things in life should be honest and uncomplicated," focusing on creating classically styled wines meant for simple enjoyment without overthinking. Under the guidance of award-winning veteran winemaker Linda Trotta, the estate has become one of the fastest-growing wine brands in North America, celebrated for its approachable and fruit-forward style.

Wine Description

The Bread & Butter Pinot Noir displays a translucent ruby colour and opens with an undeniably juicy bouquet. The nose is bursting with aromas of ripe cherries, raspberries, and a touch of cassis, delicately balanced by hints of cedar, bay leaf, and sweet vanilla. On the palate, this medium-bodied wine is characterized by an unctuous, silky texture and a rich mouthfeel. Flavours of lush red fruit are joined by soft oak and subtle savoury notes of wood and cured meat. The finish is beautifully long and smooth, leaving a lingering impression of sweet toasted oak.

title: Bread & Butter Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Bread & Butter Chardonnay originates from the United States, within the California region. The brand operates under the guiding belief that good things do not need to be complicated, focusing on creating honest, simple, and delicious selections meant to be easily enjoyed. The winemaking process is led by veteran winemaker Linda Trotta, who uses her decades of domestic and international experience to shape an unapologetically classic and approachable style.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a vibrant golden appearance in the glass and possesses a heavy, full-bodied structure with a lush, creamy, and silky mouthfeel. The sensory profile is highly expressive, rich, and decadent, opening with an intense nose of ripe yellow peaches, baked apples, and tropical mango, beautifully framed by rich aromas of warm vanilla bean, sweet cream, and toasted brioche. On the indulgent palate, it delivers deep flavours of Meyer lemon, stone fruit, and lemon curd, merging effortlessly into a mid-palate reminiscent of crème brûlée, caramel, and pie crust. The finish is long, smooth, and persistent, leaving a lingering, sweet impression of butterscotch, vanilla, and toasted oak presence.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its crowd-pleasing familiarity and bold flavor delivery, balancing its rich oak-driven notes with a structured, soft acidity. To achieve its signature round and creamy framework, the wine undergoes a partial malolactic fermentation followed by careful aging in a combination of American and French oak barrels.

  • ABV: 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery prioritizes clean, straightforward fruit selection to capture the familiar profile consumers crave, this commercial release is not certified organic.

title: Bread & Butter Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: California has a world-class reputation for outstanding Cabernet Sauvignon. This rich example shows why. It brims with aromas of toast, nuts, dark fruit and chocolate that lead to flavours of ripe dark fruit and chocolate-covered plums and ends in a smooth finish with a hint of spice. Enjoy with grilled steak or on its own.

title: Spottswoode Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Spottswoode is a historic, family-owned estate vineyard and winery on the western edge of St. Helena in Napa Valley. To ensure the highest quality, Spottswoode is dedicated to producing a handful of wines in very limited quantities: Spottswoode Estate Cabernet Sauvignon, Sauvignon Blanc, Lyndenhurst, and Field Book. The winery aims to produce exceptional, well-balanced, structured wines that exhibit texture, elegance, consistency and the ability to age well.

The 40-acre Spottswoode Estate Vineyard is an ideal terroir for growing wine grapes. Situated on the apex of the Sulphur Creek fan, the alluvial soils comprised primarily of sandy clay loam provide superb drainage. The gap between the Mayacamas Range and Spring Mountain admits cooling maritime breezes that temper the sun's heat, creating an ideal microclimate for wine growing.

98 Points -  Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The gorgeous 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon is already drinking beautifully, with incredible waves of black cherry and cassis fruit that have completely absorbed roughly two-thirds of new oak. On this occasion, the wine came across as rather forward and supple, with lush tannins framing ample fruit on the medium to full-bodied palate. Impeccably balanced, with tremendous length on the cool, refreshing finish, it manages to showcase the warmth and generous nature of the site and vintage without going over the top.

title: Orin Swift Machete - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

This red blend is nearly opaque with a deep aubergine and inky purple core. The nose is immediate and complex, offering a diverse array of aromas ranging from ripe plum, cassis, and lilac to more savoury notes of espresso bean, new leather, and wet concrete. On the full bodied palate, the wine reveals intense layers of blackberry compote, dark chocolate, and black cherry, balanced by a touch of blood orange zest. Its structure is defined by firm, puckering tannins and a lingering acidity that leads into a long, velvety finish with traces of minerality.

Machete is as famous for its exterior as its interior. Shifting away from traditional vineyard sketches, Phinney treated the bottle like a film poster.

  • 12 Unique Labels: Each case of Machete features 12 different high-contrast, cinematic photographs.

  • The Aesthetic: The images—featuring a white police car and a model with a machete in the desert—evoke a "grindhouse cinema" vibe that turned the wine into an instant collectible.

  • Scarcity & Hype: By using 12 different labels, Phinney created a "set-collecting" culture among wine enthusiasts, making every bottle a conversation starter.

title: Daou Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
From the sun-drenched hills of Paso Robles, California, Daou Family Estates stands out as a premier winery in the Adelaida District. Founded by brothers Georges and Daniel Daou, the estate is known for its dedication to producing Bordeaux-style wines with precision and passion. The estate's unique terroir, set atop calcareous clay soils at high elevation, contributes to its exceptional winemaking reputation.

Wine Description
Daou Chardonnay displays a brilliant pale gold hue in the glass. Aromas are layered and expressive, with notes of Fuji apple, ripe pear, citrus blossom, and toasted almond. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and silky, showcasing flavours of pineapple, vanilla cream, and Meyer lemon, supported by a subtle minerality and refreshing acidity. The mouthfeel is lush yet balanced, with a lingering, elegant finish.

title: Chloe Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from the United States, within the prized San Lucas A.V.A. situated at the southern end of Monterey County along California's Central Coast. Produced by the Chloe Wine Collection under the artistic direction of head winemaker Georgetta Dane, the brand is celebrated for crafting elegant, classic European and American wines with a focus on modern aesthetic presentation and varietal expression. Sourced from high-altitude, sun-drenched vineyards in San Lucas, the vines are rooted in deep alluvial soils composed of sandy loam and gravelly clay. The warm inland daytime temperatures allow the Cabernet Sauvignon grapes to achieve thorough phenolic maturity and deep concentration, while chilly nightly breezes sweeping in from the nearby Pacific Ocean lock in a vibrant natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Chloe Cabernet Sauvignon presents an opaque, deep ruby-purple color in the glass with dark magenta highlights at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, deep, and high-toned, offering a lush, multi-faceted expression of warm-climate California Cabernet. The bouquet opens with a generous display of black cherries, ripe plum compote, and cassis, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of dark chocolate, cocoa powder, roasted coffee bean, and cinnamon bark. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of dark stone fruits, boysenberry, and mocha. It is characterized by its outstanding fruit purity and a balanced backbone of natural acidity that keeps the rich mid-palate extract fresh and lively. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and plush, driven by sturdy, fine-grained tannins that glide into a long, satisfying finish accented by notes of toasted cedar, vanilla cream, and sweet spice.

title: Chloe Prosecco - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Chloe Prosecco is an elegant sparkling wine from the Prosecco DOC in the Veneto region of Northern Italy. The Chloe Wine Collection, named after the Greek word for 'blooming', is a portfolio of award-winning wines crafted to showcase fragrant aromas and captivating layers. The collection has been developed under the expertise of experienced female winemakers like Georgetta Dane and Andrea Brambila, who focus on sourcing premium fruit from the world's most prized vineyards.

Wine Description

This wine is light straw yellow in colour with greenish hues and features a fine, silky mousse. The sensory profile is defined by an inviting nose of white flowers, apple blossom, and citrus, alongside notes of peach, green apple, and white guava. On the palate, it is light-bodied and refreshing, offering flavours of pears and tangerines balanced by an opulent yet elegant acidity. The finish is crisp and clean, revealing a hint of minerality that reflects the calcareous soils and mountain proximity of the vineyards. Crafted from 100% Glera grapes, this sparkling wine has an ABV of 11%.

title: Chloe Pinot Grigio - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Italy, within the prized Valdadige D.O.C. appellation spanning the alpine valleys of Trentino-Alto Adige and Veneto. Produced by the Chloe Wine Collection under the direction of head winemaker Georgetta Dane, the brand is celebrated for crafting elegant, classic European and American wines with a focus on modern aesthetic presentation and timeless varietal typicity. Sourced from high-altitude, cool-climate vineyards situated along the Adige River valley, the vines are rooted in alluvial soils rich in gravel, silt, and limestone deposits. The intense alpine sunshine combined with crisp nightly winds off the surrounding mountain peaks allows the Pinot Grigio grapes to ripen slowly, developing lush fruit intensity while locking in a vibrant, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Chloe Pinot Grigio presents a luminous, pale straw-yellow appearance in the glass with bright silver and greenish highlights. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, elegant, and high-toned, offering a masterfully clean and fragrant expression of northern Italian white wine. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of juicy white peaches, green apples, and crisp Bartlett pears, seamlessly layered with delicate floral undertones of honeysuckle, citrus blossoms, and a subtle touch of crushed minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a refreshing core of juicy orchard fruits and bright lemon-lime zest. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is supple and smooth, carrying into a clean, dry, and invigorating finish accented by lingering notes of white peach and cool stone minerality.

title: The Prisoner Wine Co. Unshackled Red Blend - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from the United States, crafted from choice vineyard sites across premier California wine regions, including the North Coast and Central Coast. Produced by the rebellious and iconic Prisoner Wine Company, "Unshackled" was created to break free from traditional winemaking constraints and deliver a bold, modern, and fruit-forward expression. The Prisoner Wine Company operates under an innovative, blend-focused winemaking philosophy that prioritizes structural opulence, lush fruit intensity, and immediate crowd-pleasing accessibility. Sourced from diverse microclimates featuring gravelly loam and clay-rich alluvial soils, the vines experience warm, sun-filled California days balanced by evening coastal breezes, enabling the multi-varietal grapes to achieve full phenolic maturity, rich concentration, and smooth, velvety tannins.

Wine Description

The Prisoner Wine Co. Unshackled Red Blend presents an opaque, deep ruby-purple appearance in the glass with rich violet glints at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, deep, and high-toned, offering a plush, aromatic symphony of ripe black fruits and warm bakery spices. The bouquet opens with a generous display of crushed blackberries, blueberry compote, and dark plum reduction, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of sweet vanilla bean, milk chocolate, toasted oak, dried lavender, and a subtle touch of black pepper. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, round, and texturally luxurious, showcasing a dense, succulent core of dark orchard fruits, cassis, and cocoa nibs. It is characterized by its outstanding fruit purity and a balanced, supple acidity that prevents the rich mid-palate extract from feeling heavy. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and approachable, framed by smooth, polished tannins that glide into a long, satisfying finish accented by lingering notes of toasted cedar, baking spice, and sweet dark berry jam.

title: Oyster Bay Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from New Zealand, within the world-renowned Marlborough region situated on the northern tip of the South Island. Oyster Bay, owned by Delegat Limited, is one of New Zealand’s most iconic and globally recognized wineries, instrumental in bringing Marlborough's unique maritime terroir to the world stage. Operating under a precision-focused winemaking philosophy that prioritizes varietal purity, brilliant fruit clarity, and refreshing cool-climate energy, the estate cultivates its Chardonnay across select blocks in the Wairau Valley and Awatere Valley. Rooted in free-draining alluvial soils comprising river stones, gravel, and sandy loam, these vines thrive under Marlborough’s hallmark combination of bright sun-drenched days and cool ocean breezes, which naturally preserves a crisp, mouthwatering acidity while developing deep, expressive tropical and citrus flavors.

Wine Description

The Oyster Bay Chardonnay presents a brilliant, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with vibrant green and silver highlights. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, elegant, and high-toned, masterfully balancing bright cool-climate fruit intensity with a subtle, creamy oak accent. The bouquet opens with an inviting, fragrant display of ripe nectarines, white peaches, and juicy yellow plums, seamlessly layered with delicate undertones of fresh lemon curd, citrus blossoms, toasted hazelnut, and a light touch of dynamic vanilla. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, supple, and precisely focused, showcasing a generous core of stone fruits and bright grapefruit oils. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is surprisingly creamy yet transparent, driven by a fine mineral tension that carries into a long, crisp, and refreshing finish accented by lingering notes of toasted oak, lime zest, and white peach.

title: Leonardo Da Vinci Chianti 2020 - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The Cantine Leonardo da Vinci Chianti hails from Italy, originating from the historic vineyards of the Chianti region in Tuscany. Cantine Leonardo da Vinci is a highly regarded cooperative winery founded in Vinci, deeply rooted in historical winemaking tradition and excellence. Embodying a philosophy that honors its namesake, the winery focuses on an meticulous selection of local grapes combined with modern, innovative oenological practices to deliver authentic expressions of Tuscan terroir year after year.

Wine Description

This wine displays an intense, deep crimson and purple red colour in the glass. On the nose, it delivers a highly aromatic and persistent bouquet featuring bright perfumes of ripe cherries, plums, and red fruits intertwined with gentle spicy hints of black pepper and dried herbs. The palate is medium bodied, firm, and structured, mirroring the dark cherry fruit profile with an added layer of savory earthiness. Well balanced with classic, vibrant Tuscan acidity and soft, velvety tannins, it culminates in a long, pleasantly dry, and peppery finish.

title: La Posta Pizzella Malbec - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This expressive red wine originates from Argentina, specifically from the Paraje Altamira district within the La Consulta region of the Uco Valley in Mendoza. The highly regarded La Posta Pizzella Malbec was created by wine pioneer Laura Catena in collaboration with esteemed winemaker Luis Reginato to celebrate the local small-family growers who serve as the true backbone of the Mendoza wine industry. The wine takes its name from Paula and Pablo Pizzella, two former physical education teachers who moved from Buenos Aires to Mendoza in 2000 to passionately cultivate a meticulous, high-altitude 10-hectare vineyard focused on generating ultimate uniformity and varietal balance.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Beautiful and intense red and purple color in the glass.

  • Aroma: A fragrant and buoyant nose displaying vibrant aromas of black cherries, dark fruits, raspberries, dark chocolate, and warm baker's spice, accented by lovely floral and smoky tones.

  • Palate: Elegant, nuanced, and generously textured on the palate, presenting dense, rich flavors of dark berries, elderberries, mulberries, and ripe plum.

  • Body: Full-bodied and well-structured with round, velvety tannins that frame the fruit profile beautifully.

  • Finish: A solid, sturdy, and lingering finish driven by a mineral focus and a distinct hint of violets.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Malbec sourced entirely from the Pizzella family's single vineyard situated at an average elevation of 3,600 feet, where the vines average 23 to 25 years of age.

  • Stylistic Notes: The vineyard thrives on a soil base of sandy loam, sand, silt, and clay mixed with 20% stones covered by limestone. To achieve a perfectly balanced profile, the wine is typically aged for 8 to 10 months, with 50% resting in French oak barrels (10% new, 40% second and third use) and the remaining 50% held in stainless steel tanks.

  • Alcohol by Volume: 13.5%

  • Organic Status: Not certified organic, though the grapes are sustainably farmed with a deep love and respect for nature.

Food Pairing

  • Rich meat dishes, open-flame backyard barbecues, and smoky ribs.

  • Premium cuts of beef tenderloin, prime rib, or grilled lamb cutlets.

  • Hearty vegetarian alternatives such as a wild mushroom risotto or grilled polenta topped with a mushroom ragout.

title: Louis Jadot Chablis - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This pristine and bright white wine originates from France, specifically within the northern Burgundy region and the world-renowned Chablis subregion. Founded in 1859 by Louis Henry Denis Jadot, the house has grown into one of Burgundy's most respected names, now stewarding over 528 acres of vineyards. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a non-interventionist approach, utilizing a 'lightest possible hand' in winemaking to ensure that each bottle serves as the purest expression of its unique terroir.

Wine Description

Louis Jadot Chablis presents a bright and fresh appearance with a polished character. The sensory profile is defined by citrus and mineral aromas, featuring exotic notes of tangerine alongside green apple and fresh pear. On the palate, the wine is tight, precise, and 'racy', showcasing a wealth of high acidity and a briny mineral streak. To preserve its complex structure and the distinct minerality of the Kimmeridgian limestone soils, the wine is aged in stainless steel tanks with very light fining and filtration. This 100% Chardonnay reached an ABV of 13%. While the house follows sustainable principles and uses natural yeasts when possible, this wine is not certified organic.

title: Ruffino Alauda - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This red wine is from Italy, specifically from the Toscana IGT region in Tuscany. Ruffino was established in 1877 and has grown into a renowned winery with a rich history of blending traditional and modern techniques. Alauda, first introduced in 2011, represents the pinnacle of the estate's artisanal style and is produced in limited quantities from the Poggio Casciano and Montemasso estates.

Wine Description

The Ruffino Alauda is an inscrutable, dense red with scarlet highlights. The aroma is sumptuous, featuring ripe red fruits, blackberry jam tart, and Mediterranean botanicals, followed by complex notes of vanilla, toasted cedar, and burnt spices. On the palate, it is full bodied and opulent with embroidered tannins and a rich core of succulent berry fruit, plum, and dark chocolate. The wine exhibits a firm tannin frame and a long, brackish finish with an intriguing umami touch. This blend consists of 47% Cabernet Franc, 41% Merlot, and 12% Colorino. It was aged for 24 months in French barriques followed by four months in stainless steel. 

Food Pairing

This full bodied wine pairs excellently with elegant Italian dishes and hearty, spice rich sauces. Specific recommendations include Bistecca Fiorentina, tortelli with duck sauce, risotto with sausage, and lamb shoulder. It also complements rich aged or peppered cheeses.

title: Millebuis Pinot Noir - Gamay Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This wine is a blend of Pinot Noir and Gamay grapes, with a typical composition being 50% of each varietal. It has a deep red colour with an attractive bouquet and purple highlights. On the palate, it has a crunchy texture with notes of ripe, red berries, such as raspberry and redcurrant. It's described as a supple, elegant wine with fine, delicate tannins. The wine should be served between 16–18°C.

Food Pairing

This wine's flavor profile and structure make it a great match for a variety of dishes. It pairs well with light meats or poultry, such as chicken, turkey, and duck. It can also be paired with dishes like pasta with tomato sauce, steamed vegetables, and even some fish dishes for red wine enthusiasts.
