A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Chateau Livran - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Château Livran is located in Saint Germain d'Esteuil, in the Médoc subregion of Bordeaux, France. The estate has a history that spans more than 700 years, with its origins tracing back to 1280 when it was founded by brothers Arnaud and Béraud de Goth. In 2013, the property was acquired by Olivier Michon and his wife, Edwige Lurton-Michon, who is the daughter of Lucien Lurton. The Michon family has undertaken significant restructuring of the estate, including replanting the vineyards and building a new cellar in 2016 to better express the terroir's diversity.

Wine Description

The Château Livran 2018 is a blend of grape varietals, with some sources listing Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, and Merlot, while others specify 65% Merlot and 35% Cabernet Sauvignon or 60% Merlot and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon. The wine is described as having a deep and shining ruby colour. It presents a sleek nose with subtle notes of sweet vanilla oak, ripe red fruits, and a spice profile that includes cumin. On the palate, the wine is braced with bright, fresh raspberry notes and is described as being expressive and elegant, with a nice tannic structure. It is considered a well-balanced wine. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is listed as 2021-2028.

Food Pairing

Suggested food pairings for the Château Livran 2018 include beef, lamb, poultry, and game. The wine is also noted to pair well with charcuterie, cheese, white meat, and red meat. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Circus Malbec Rose - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Argentina in the famous Mendoza region, specifically from high altitude vineyards nestled along the foothills of the Andes Mountains, Circus Malbec Rose represents a fresh, vibrant expression of modern South American rose winemaking. Sourced from estate vineyards benefiting from intense Andean sunshine and cool mountain air, Circus is crafted to showcase the fruit-forward charm and refreshing vitality of Argentina's signature red grape. The winemaking philosophy focuses on sustainable viticulture, short skin contact to capture delicate color and aromas, and cool temperature stainless steel fermentation without oak contact to produce a crisp, easy-drinking wine designed for versatile everyday enjoyment.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, pale salmon pink colour with vibrant coral reflections in the glass. An expressive and attractive bouquet opens with fresh aromas of wild strawberry, red cherry, and pink grapefruit, layered with subtle floral notes of rose petal, orange blossom, and watermelon. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, crisp, and refreshing, delivering lively flavours of fresh red currant, pomegranate, and citrus zest, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Finishing clean and vibrant, it leaves a pleasant, dry impression of fresh berry fruit and delicate mineral lift. Composed of 100% Malbec, it combines the juicy red berry fruit signature of Mendoza Malbec with light, crisp Provencal-style rose freshness.

title: Circus Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Argentina in the famous Mendoza region, specifically from high-altitude vineyards along the foothills of the Andes Mountains, Circus Cabernet Sauvignon represents a lively, fruit-driven expression of South American red winemaking. Sourced from estate vineyards benefit from intense solar radiation and cool mountain nights, Circus is crafted to showcase the vibrant varietal purity and accessible structure of Argentine Cabernet Sauvignon. The winemaking philosophy focuses on sustainable viticulture, temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation, and gentle oak contact to produce a smooth, food-friendly wine designed for everyday enjoyment.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, vibrant ruby red colour with dark garnet edges in the glass. An inviting and fruit-forward bouquet opens with aromas of ripe cassis, dark plum, and black cherry, layered with subtle notes of green bell pepper, cedar wood, cocoa, and sweet baking spice. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied, rich, and smooth, delivering generous flavours of juicy blackberry, red currant, and dark chocolate supported by a balanced streak of fresh natural acidity. Framed by soft, rounded tannins and a clean texture, it concludes with a warm, supple finish marked by lingering notes of dark berry fruit and subtle oak spice. Composed of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, it combines expressive Argentine black fruit generosity with an easy-drinking, approachable structure.

title: Emiliana Adobe Carmenere Reserva - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: The aroma reflects ripe fruit perfectly balanced with sweet and toasted notes given by wood and a touch of spices, the main characteristic of the Carmenere. This wine has soft and well balanced volume with ripe tannins that leave a delightful flavour and persistence.

title: Xijiu Jiaocang 1988 (1 Litre Bottle) - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Xiju is one of the most famous alcoholic drinks in China. Vodka "Xijiu" Jiaocang 1988 is made from pure drinking water and alcohol obtained from sorghum and wheat. The long-term production process of vodka, in which the aging of the distillates lasts at least 5 years, contributes to the acquisition of the drink with a thick, characteristic aroma and soft elegant taste. Vodka has a high strength, which is perfectly balanced by dense Chinese dishes and grilled meats.

Xijiu was founded in 1952. In 1998, it became a subsidiary of the largest Chinese holding company Moutai Group.

Xijiu products have won numerous prestigious awards and medals at international competitions.

title: Emiliana Adobe Sauvignon Blanc Reserva - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Brilliant pale yellow with a green hue. Pronounced aromas of herbs, citrus, minerals, bell pepper and spice. On the palate, it is light to medium-bodied and fresh, with flavours of herbs, zesty lime and bell pepper on a clean and refreshing finish.

title: Blue Nun Riesling - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Blue Nun Riesling originates from Germany, within the Rhine region and the Rheinhessen subregion. The brand was originally introduced in 1923 by H. Sichel Söhne and became a defining global icon for German white wine throughout the 20th century. Today, under the ownership of F.W. Langguth Erben, the winery operates with a modern philosophy centered on crafting approachable, fruit forward wines that offer an easy to understand alternative to traditional, complex German labeling.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a pale straw yellow appearance with light greenish reflections and possesses a light to medium body. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and vibrant, opening with an intense nose of green apples, fresh peaches, and citrus fruits, layered with a delicate bouquet of white flowers and tropical pineapple. On the palate, it delivers a refreshing and lively experience where crisp flavors of lime and pear are balanced by a distinct fruit acidity and a gentle mineral touch. The finish is clean, soft, and cool, leaving a characterful impression of lingering fruit.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Riesling.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its modern, fruit forward balance, utilizing gentle pressing and temperature controlled fermentation to maintain an elegant harmony between its racy acidity and slight residual sweetness.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 9.5% and 11%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery prioritizes precise quality management and modern cellar standards, this specific commercial bottling is not certified organic.

title: Santa Carolina Sauvignon Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Lemon yellow colour with green reflections. Melon and pineapple nose with citrus overtones of lime and grapefruit. The palate is soft and fruity, with a medium body and balanced acidity. Pairs well with fish and pizza.

title: Two Oceans Sauvignon Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This popular white wine hails from South Africa, with fruit primarily sourced from the Western Cape province. The brand takes its name from the Indian and Atlantic oceans that converge at the Cape, creating a temperate climate cooled by daytime maritime breezes that allow grapes to ripen slowly. All vineyards supplying Two Oceans subscribe to the progressive Integrated Production of Wine (IPW) system, a sustainability initiative focused on environmentally sound farming and cellar practices.

Wine Description

Two Oceans Sauvignon Blanc presents a pale straw colour and is celebrated for its elegant and crisp character. The sensory profile features a vibrant bouquet of fresh citrus, gooseberry, and stony minerals, complemented by a hint of green fig and grassiness. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and refreshing, showcasing ripe tropical fruit flavours like passion fruit, grapefruit, and lemon.

title: Famille Perrin Rascal Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the southern Rhone Valley, specifically within the Ventoux region, Famille Perrin Rascal Blanc represents a vibrant, easy-drinking expression of classic Rhone white blending. Owned and operated by the famed Perrin family of Chateau de Beaucastel, Famille Perrin is renowned for pioneering organic and sustainable viticulture across southern France. The winery's philosophy focuses on capturing the pure, aromatic expression of traditional Rhone grape varieties through cool-temperature stainless steel fermentations without oak influence, yielding fresh, food-friendly, and terroir-driven wines.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, pale straw colour with delicate green reflections in the glass. An inviting and fresh bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of white peach, green apple, and juicy pear, layered with subtle floral notes of jasmine, citrus blossom, and lemongrass. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, crisp, and well balanced, delivering lively flavours of white stone fruit, lemon zest, and crisp melon, all supported by a clean spine of refreshing natural acidity. Concluding with a crisp, mineral-tinged finish, it leaves a refreshing impression of orchard fruit and subtle herbal lift. Composed of a classic southern Rhone blend featuring Viognier, Grenache Blanc, Marsanne, and Roussanne, it combines expressive floral and stone fruit aromatics with effortless, bright everyday freshness.

title: Pirramimma Heritage Limited Edition Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Pirramimma Heritage Chardonnay is an elegant white wine from the historic McLaren Vale region of South Australia. Established in 1892 by Alexander Campbell Johnston, Pirramimma remains a family-owned estate currently managed by fourth-generation winemakers who prioritize sustainable practices and 'estate grown' fruit. The winery's name, an Aboriginal phrase meaning 'the moon and the stars', reflects a deep connection to the land and a winemaking philosophy that balances century-old traditions with modern, clean techniques.

Wine Description

The Heritage Chardonnay presents a gleaming yellow colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is complex and inviting, featuring a bouquet of honeydew melon, ripe peach, and apple, accented by subtle notes of toasted French oak. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and well-textured, delivering vibrant fruit intensity of passion fruit and pineapple balanced by a pleasing creamy texture from lees stirring. Fine acidity provides structure and freshness, leading to a long, satisfying finish with hints of cashew and nutty spice. This wine is crafted for immediate enjoyment but will continue to improve over the next four to five years.

title: Domaine Remi Jobard Meursault Les Narvaux - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Domaine Rémi Jobard Meursault Les Narvaux is a highly regarded village-level white wine from Burgundy, France. Produced in the Meursault appellation of the Côte de Beaune, Les Narvaux is a prestigious "lieu-dit" (named vineyard) situated high on the hillside above the Premier Cru Genevrières. This elevated position on rocky, limestone soils typically produces wines with greater tension and mineral drive than standard village wines. Rémi Jobard is known for his organic viticulture and a precise, low-intervention winemaking style that utilizes Stockinger barrels to emphasize terroir transparency.

Wine Description

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay from vines approximately 30 years old.

  • Aromatic Profile: The nose is fruity and floral, featuring aromas of deep, slightly dark fruit accompanied by notes of roasted almonds.

  • Palate and Body: It is a rich, complex, and balanced wine with an enveloping mouthfeel. Les Narvaux is known for being more powerful and assertive than many village wines, offering a dense texture and a salty mineral undertow.

  • Structure: The wine possesses a solid acidic backbone and a finish that returns to notes of fresh butter and sweet spices.

  • Winemaking and Aging: The estate has been certified organic since 2011. The wine is fermented and aged in Austrian demi-muids (Stockinger barrels), with approximately 20% to 25% new oak used to provide a discrete but firm wooden backbone.

  • Alcohol Content: Typically 13.5% or 13.0% depending on the specific bottling.

title: Domaine Remi Jobard Meursault Premier Cru Le Porusot Dessus - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Domaine Rémi Jobard Meursault 1er Cru Le Porusot Dessus is a prestigious white wine from Burgundy, France, produced in the Meursault appellation within the Côte de Beaune. Rémi Jobard, who took over from his father Charles in 1996, is celebrated for his precise, non-interventionist winemaking style that emphasizes transparency of terroir. The Le Porusot Dessus vineyard is a premier cru site located mid-slope on the Meursault hillside, known for producing some of the most powerful and structured wines in the village, often blending the elegance of Goutte d'Or with the density of Les Charmes.

Wine Description

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Aromatic Profile: The nose is chiselled and multi-layered, featuring ripe lemon, peach, and baked apple, intertwined with white flowers, roasted almonds, and hazelnut. Distinct mineral notes of wet chalk, flint, and a subtle smokiness add complexity.

  • Palate and Body: This is a full-bodied, dense, and structured Meursault. It offers a generous, almost creamy texture that is immediately lifted by brilliant mineral tension and racy freshness. Flavours of candied citrus, white orchard fruits, and brioche lead to a finish marked by fine bitters and lemony lift.

  • Winemaking and Aging: The estate has been certified organic since the 2011 vintage and uses no fertilisers. The wine is fermented with indigenous yeasts and aged for approximately 18 months in oak barrels, including stockinger barrels known for their discrete but firm influence. Only a moderate amount of new oak is used to ensure the fruit's purity remains unobscured.

  • Alcohol Content: 13.5%.

title: Copper Moon Shiraz 1.5 Litre - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Light oak and vanilla spice notes mingle with sweet cherry and strawberry. The finish is sweet and short lingering.

title: Copper Moon Sauvignon Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Copper Moon Sauvignon Blanc is produced in Canada, with grapes primarily sourced from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. The brand is part of the Andrew Peller Limited portfolio, a major Canadian wine producer that oversees several award winning premium and popular labels. Copper Moon's winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing 'the magic of the night', with grapes harvested under a moonlit sky to create smooth and approachable wines for any occasion.

Wine Description

This wine features a pale yellow or lemon yellow colour and is crafted to retain the pure fruit characteristics of the grape. The sensory profile offers fresh aromas of green apple, citrus, grass, and gooseberry, occasionally accompanied by subtle hints of passion fruit or green herbs. On the palate, it is light bodied and crisp, delivering refreshing flavours of ripe apple, peach, and zesty citrus. The finish is clean and bright with lingering fruit notes. This Sauvignon Blanc is typically cool fermented and aged in stainless steel to preserve its vibrant, fruity character. It has an ABV of 12.5% and is not classified as organic.

title: Barefoot Pinot Grigio - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Pale lemon colour with floral notes and citrus, green apple, peach and pear aromas. On the palate, this is off-dry, crisp and light-bodied with flavours of white peach, lemon/lime and melon with hints of almond and spice. The finish is long with refreshing fruity tones.

title: Barefoot Pinot Grigio - 1.5 Litre Bottle - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Extremely versatile, food-friendly and enjoyable. Pale lemon colour with floral notes and citrus, green apple, peach and pear aromas. On the palate, this is off-dry, crisp and light-bodied with flavours of white peach, lemon/lime and melon with hints of almond and spice. The finish is long with refreshing fruity tones.

title: Barefoot White Zinfandel - 1.5 Litre Bottle - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Made in the United States, Barefoot White Zinfandel hails from California, one of the world’s most iconic wine-producing regions. Barefoot Cellars, founded in the 1960s and now part of the E&J Gallo portfolio, is known for its approachable, fruit-forward wines and playful branding. The winery emphasizes accessibility and fun, aiming to make wine enjoyable for all occasions.

Wine Description
Barefoot White Zinfandel pours a delicate pink hue with subtle coral highlights. On the nose, it offers inviting aromas of ripe strawberries, juicy melon, and floral notes. The palate delivers flavours of sweet red berries, tropical pineapple, and a hint of citrus zest, all wrapped in a light-bodied and refreshing structure. The finish is clean and mildly sweet, leaving a lingering impression of summer fruit.

Food Pairing
Pair this White Zinfandel with light salads, grilled shrimp, or spicy Asian cuisine. It also complements fruit-based desserts and soft cheeses like Brie. A perfect match to enhance the wine's playfulness and charm.

title: Barefoot Pink Pinot Grigio - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: This Rosé's fruit-forward character is consistent with Barefoot's fun and casual approach to wine and entertaining. Enjoy this extra dry style of Rosé with flavours of nuts, watermelon, herbs, red fruit and a touch of smoke. Pair with appetizers, salads or your favourite light cuisine.

title: Barefoot Fruitscato Peach - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: This deliciously sweet blend is made with rose wine and bursts with the aromas of delicious peaches. Barefoot Peach Fruitscato wine makes every day a little sweeter!

title: Barefoot Pink Moscato - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Barefoot Pink Moscato is packed with the full flavours of juicy cherries, tart raspberries, and sweet pomegranates and finished with hints of jasmine and Mandarin oranges.

title: Barefoot Sauvignon Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Their driest white wine, Barefoot Sauvignon Blanc is bursting with summer fruit flavours like honeydew melon, nectarine and peach. Pear and lime notes meld into a soft, delicious finish.

title: Barefoot Merlot - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: A consistently good, award-winning merlot from California. Valued priced and made in a crowd-pleasing style. Ruby red in colour, the nose reveals upfront toast, prune and cassis aromas with notes of spiced chocolate. Dry, light to medium-bodied and rounded, with balanced silky tannins on the long lively berry fruit finish.

title: Barefoot Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: This is a delightful wine with tempting flavours of green apples and peaches. Hints of honey and vanilla enhance the rich, buttery finish. Another good value wine from Barefoot.

title: Barefoot Moscato - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Barefoot Moscato combines the crisp, refreshing fruity aromas of juicy peaches and sweet apricots. Finished with a tantalizing twist of lemon and citrus.

title: Guado Al Tasso Vermentino - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the famous Tuscany region, specifically within the coastal Bolgheri DOC subregion, Guado Al Tasso Vermentino represents a classic, ocean-influenced expression of premium white winemaking. Located in the amphitheatre-like plain of Bolgheri, the estate belongs to the historic Marchesi Antinori family, whose winemaking heritage spans over six hundred years. The winery's philosophy focuses on capturing the coastal Mediterranean microclimate, utilizing night harvesting and cool stainless steel fermentation to produce expressive, crisp, and mineral-driven white wines that highlight the unique terroirs of the Upper Maremma.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, pale straw yellow colour with subtle greenish highlights in the glass. An inviting and vibrant bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of yellow peach, Meyer lemon, and green apple, interwoven with delicate nuances of white flowers, crushed herbs, and sea salt minerality. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, crisp, and energetic, delivering refreshing flavours of juicy citrus, pear, and tropical fruits supported by a mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by a subtle textural richness gained from brief lees contact, it concludes with a clean, persistent finish marked by a distinct saline trail. Composed of 100% Vermentino, it combines sunny coastal Mediterranean fruit purity with vibrant mountain freshness and refined mineral precision.

title: Lucente Toscana - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the famous Tuscany region, specifically within the historic Montalcino subregion, Lucente Toscana represents the second wine of the iconic Tenuta Luce estate. Founded in the 1990s as a visionary collaboration between Vittorio Frescobaldi and Robert Mondavi, Tenuta Luce was established to combine traditional Tuscan heritage with pioneering global winemaking techniques. The estate’s philosophy centers on meticulous vineyard management and small parcel fermentations to craft expressive, harmonious wines that reflect the high elevation marl and sandstone soils of southern Montalcino.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, luminous ruby red colour with dark purple reflections in the glass. An expressive and fragrant bouquet opens with lush aromas of ripe black cherry, wild blackberry, and plum, complemented by fragrant accents of violet, sweet vanilla, cocoa powder, and toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, plush, and generous, offering rich layers of juicy dark fruit, chocolate, and dried herbs supported by a fine streak of balanced natural acidity. Framed by smooth, velvety tannins and an undercurrent of fine mineral depth, it glides into a long, satisfying finish. Composed of a seamless blend of Merlot and Sangiovese aged in French oak barrels, it effortlessly combines the lush, rounded fruit texture of Merlot with the vibrant structure and food-friendly acidity of Sangiovese.

title: Tenuta Sette Ponti 'Crognolo' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the famous Tuscany region, specifically within the Valdarno di Sopra subregion, Tenuta Sette Ponti Crognolo represents a pioneering Super Tuscan expression rooted in historic winemaking traditions. Acquired in the 1950s by the Moretti C privacy family, Tenuta Sette Ponti takes its name from the seven historic bridges spanning the Arno River between Florence and Arezzo. The estate’s winemaking philosophy combines high density organic viticulture, strict cluster selection, and traditional cellar techniques to produce rich, site driven wines that showcase the distinct clay and gravel soils of the estate.

Wine Description

The wine presents an intense, dark ruby red colour with violet reflections in the glass. An expressive and layered bouquet opens with vibrant aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, and red plum, accompanied by delicate hints of dried violet, espresso bean, cedar, and warm sweet spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, generous, and well structured, delivering concentrated flavours of black cherry, cassis, and cocoa, balanced by a core of energetic natural acidity. Framed by smooth, polished tannins and an undercurrent of fine stone minerality, it glides into a long, lingering finish. Composed predominantly of Sangiovese blended with a small portion of Merlot and aged in French oak barriques, it combines classic Tuscan Sangiovese acidity and elegance with modern fruit richness and velvety texture.

title: Seghesio Zinfandel - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California’s Sonoma County region, specifically drawing from premier sites within the Alexander Valley and Dry Creek Valley subregions, Seghesio Sonoma Zinfandel represents a landmark expression of heritage Californian winemaking. Founded in 1895 by Italian immigrants Edoardo and Angela Seghesio, the estate has played a pivotal role in shaping Sonoma County’s viticultural history for over a century. The winery’s philosophy focuses on sustainable vineyard management, dry farming where possible, and preserving century-old vine stocks to craft Zinfandels of exceptional depth, balance, and regional authenticity.

Wine Description

The wine displays a deep, dark ruby purple colour in the glass. An intense and fragrant bouquet opens with lush aromas of ripe wild blackberry, dark plum, and raspberry jam, integrated with spicy accents of white pepper, sweet cinnamon, cocoa powder, and toasted oak. On the palate, it is full bodied, plush, and generous, offering rich layers of dark cherry, boysenberry, and baking spice, balanced by a fine streak of lively natural acidity. Framed by smooth, supple tannins and a well-integrated alcohol structure, it finishes long and warm with lingering notes of dark chocolate and crushed stone minerality. Composed predominantly of Zinfandel blended with small portions of Petite Sirah, Alicante Bouschet, and Carignan to enhance depth and structure, it combines classic Zinfandel fruit intensity with refined structure, vibrancy, and polished elegance.

title: Frescobaldi Nipozzano Chianti Riserva - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from France or Italy, specifically within the historic Chianti Rufina DOCG subregion of Tuscany, Frescobaldi Nipozzano Chianti Riserva represents the emblematic flagship wine of the ancient Castello Nipozzano estate. Owned by the noble Frescobaldi family, whose winemaking heritage in Florence spans over 700 years, the property is situated on the rugged, wind-swept hills northeast of Florence. The estate's philosophy focuses on capturing the distinct microclimate of higher elevation Rufina terroirs, combining tradition with precision viticulture to produce highly structured, vibrant, and long-lived expressions of Sangiovese.

Wine Description

The wine presents an intense, luminous ruby red colour in the glass. An expressive and complex nose opens with aromas of dark cherry, wild blackberry, and plum, interwoven with fragrant accents of violet, blood orange, leather, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied and well balanced, delivering rich flavours of red currant, dark cherry, and forest floor supported by a core of vibrant natural acidity. Framed by a dense, silky tannic structure and fine mineral grip, it finishes long and fresh with lingering notes of tobacco, cocoa, and dried herbs. Composed predominantly of Sangiovese alongside small complementary additions of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Malvasia Nera, it effortlessly balances high altitude freshness, firm Tuscan structure, and polished fruit elegance.

title: Luca Malbec Old Vine - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Luca Winery was founded by Dr. Laura Catena in 1999, who is dedicated to preserving Mendoza's old vines and highlighting the region's viticultural heritage. The winery's philosophy focuses on artisan quality, small quantities, and expressing individual terroirs by working with small-scale family growers who maintain traditional practices.

Wine Description

This 100% Malbec displays an incredible deep purple-red colour. The sensory profile is complex, with aromas of spice, black and red cherry, and notes of chocolate or cocoa. On the palate, vibrant berry fruit flavours pop, alongside plum, violet, and sage, complemented by underlying mocha and espresso notes. The wine is full-bodied, yet balanced by lively, vibrant acidity, resulting in a flexible and concentrated style. It presents ripe, approachable, and silky tannins that lead to an incredibly long finish.

Food Pairing

This Malbec pairs well with a variety of rich foods, including grilled red meats such as steak and lamb. It is also an excellent match for venison, wild game, pork, and quail, as well as medium-strong cheeses.

title: Mollydooker Shiraz The Boxer - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Mollydooker The Boxer Shiraz is an exceptional red wine hailing from Australia, specifically sourced from twelve premium vineyards across the renowned regions of McLaren Vale and Langhorne Creek. Established by Sarah and Sparky Marquis, Mollydooker is celebrated for its unique winemaking philosophy, particularly its emphasis on the 'Marquis Fruit Weight' system, which measures the percentage of the palate covered by velvety fruit flavours.

Wine Description

This 100% Shiraz displays a deep, opaque red color in the glass. The aromatic profile is incredibly vibrant, leaping forward with a plethora of fresh plum, blackberry, and black cherry, beautifully complemented by undertones of mocha, licorice, and toasted oak. On the palate, it is full bodied and richly fruited, delivering an elegant yet powerful mouthfeel with layers of summer pudding, dark chocolate, clove spice, and a hint of vanilla cream. The wine maintains an impressive freshness and complexity, supported by well-measured, balanced tannins that guide it toward a smooth, beautifully extended finish.

title: Rodney Strong Cabernet Sauvignon Sonoma County - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California’s Sonoma County region, Rodney Strong Cabernet Sauvignon Sonoma County represents a classic, landmark expression of cool-climate coastal winemaking. Founded in 1959 by dancer and wine pioneer Rod Strong, Rodney Strong Vineyards was one of the first modern wineries established in Sonoma County. Guided today by a commitment to sustainable farming and carbon-neutral operations, the winery’s philosophy focuses on blending fruit from distinct sub-appellations—including Alexander Valley, Chalk Hill, and Dry Creek Valley—to craft structured, approachable wines with regional character.

Wine Description

The wine displays a deep, dark ruby purple colour in the glass. An inviting bouquet opens with classic aromas of rich black plum, cassis, and wild blackberry, complemented by nuances of dark chocolate, cocoa powder, crushed herbs, and warm toasted oak. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, offering a lush, rounded mouthfeel filled with vibrant flavours of dark cherry, boysenberry, and espresso bean. Supported by a fine structure of ripe, velvety tannins and balanced acidity, it glides into a smooth, lingering finish with lingering spice notes. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon blended with small portions of Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot, it combines sunny fruit concentration with balanced structure, polished tannins, and food-friendly elegance.

title: Coppola Cabernet Sauvignon Diamond Collection - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Diamond Collection Cabernet Sauvignon is a distinguished red wine from California, primarily sourced from the Paso Robles appellation within the Central Coast. Founded by acclaimed filmmaker Francis Ford Coppola, the winery established its current home in Geyserville during the late 2000s, though the family’s winemaking traditions date back generations. The Diamond Collection is a collaborative effort under Delicato Family Wines, focusing on a philosophy of appellation-specific sourcing and meticulous fruit selection to create approachable, high-quality wines.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon presents a bold sensory profile, opening with a dark ruby colour and purple reflections. The nose is expressive, featuring delightful notes of black cherry, peppercorn, blackberry, and subtle hints of vanilla and tobacco. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and intense, revealing concentrated flavours of plum, boysenberry, and baking spices. It maintains an opulent body with supple tannins and a long, sophisticated finish.

title: Coppola Chardonnay Diamond Collection - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California, sourced from top coastal and inland vineyards across Monterey County and Santa Barbara County, Coppola Diamond Collection Chardonnay represents a classic, highly popular expression of Golden State white winemaking. Founded by acclaimed filmmaker Francis Ford Coppola, Francis Ford Coppola Winery is rooted in a tradition of family, celebration, and accessible luxury. The estate’s winemaking philosophy focuses on sourcing grapes from distinct microclimates to craft consistent, fruit-forward wines that offer exceptional balance, rich mouthfeel, and varietal purity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, golden straw colour with bright yellow highlights in the glass. An inviting and fragrant bouquet opens with ripe aromas of juicy yellow apple, pear, and sweet pineapple, accompanied by delicate hints of Meyer lemon, toasted brioche, and warm vanilla. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied, delivering a rich, creamy mouthfeel packed with vibrant flavours of green apple, tropical melon, and butterscotch, balanced by a fine streak of crisp citrus acidity. Fermented and aged in a combination of stainless steel tanks and French oak barrels, it combines sunny tropical fruit intensity with velvety texture and smooth, integrated oak richness.

title: The Show Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California, sourced from premier coastal and inland vineyards across regions like Mendocino, Lodi, and Paso Robles, The Show Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold, approachable expression of classic Golden State winemaking. Created through a collaboration between Joel Gott Wines and Three Thieves, the brand celebrates the vibrant spirit and larger-than-life character of California wine country. The winemaking philosophy focuses on blending fruit from distinct microclimates to craft a rich, expressive Cabernet Sauvignon that offers maximum flavor, smooth texture, and outstanding value.

Wine Description

The wine displays a deep, dark ruby purple colour in the glass. An expressive and dark-fruit-driven bouquet opens with lush aromas of black cherry, wild blackberry, and crushed plum, layered with sweet accents of vanilla bean, cocoa powder, toasted oak, and a touch of brown spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied and round, delivering generous flavours of ripe dark berries, dark chocolate, and roasted espresso, supported by soft, velvety tannins and gentle acidity. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon blended with small portions of Petite Sirah and Merlot to enhance color and structure, it combines ripe, sunny California fruit power with plush, easy-drinking drinkability and subtle oak warmth.

title: Caymus Cabernet Sauvignon 'California' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This dark and rich red wine originates from United States, bearing a broad California appellation. Founded in 1972 by the Wagner family, Caymus Vineyards is one of Napa Valley's most iconic names, now celebrating over 50 years of winemaking. While world-renowned for their Napa Valley bottlings, this 'California' Cabernet Sauvignon was introduced with the 2021 vintage to explore the state’s diverse vineyard land beyond the Napa borders. The Wagner family's philosophy focuses on 'signature hallmarks'—sourcing fruit from hidden pockets across the state with ideal stony soils and maritime influences to produce a wine that is consistently supple and approachable.

Wine Description

Caymus 'California' Cabernet Sauvignon presents a saturated, dark ruby colour. The aromatic profile is intense and layered, featuring hallmark notes of ripe blackberry, cassis, and dark plum, accented by cocoa powder, sweet spice, and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and luxurious, revealing a rich texture with flavours of chocolate-dusted berries, mocha, and black cherry.

This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon is crafted in a bold, opulent style with fine-grained, velvety tannins that provide immediate drinkability. The finish is long and polished, lingering with notes of baking spice and warm, ripe fruit. While it is designed to be seductive and 'effortlessly drinkable' upon release, its concentrated fruit and structure allow it to soften beautifully with age.

Food Pairing

The wine's rich fruit and supple tannins make it a perfect match for hearty, fire-grilled dishes such as ribeye steak with herb butter or BBQ brisket. It also pairs elegantly with short rib ragu, beef bourguignon, or aged cheeses like Gouda and Comté. This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Wente Chardonnay Morning Fog - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, Wente Chardonnay Morning Fog hails from California’s Central Coast, specifically the Livermore Valley. Founded in 1883, Wente Vineyards is recognized as America's longest continuously operated, family owned winery, now managed by the fourth and fifth generations of the Wente family. The family is credited with pioneering California Chardonnay; approximately 80% of all Chardonnay currently planted in the United States can be traced back to the historic Wente Clone.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a bright sensory profile featuring aromas of crisp Gala apple, fresh cut pear, and lemon curd, seamlessly integrated with subtle oak nuances of sweet cream and vanilla. On the palate, it offers a medium body with hallmark weight and depth, balanced by a refined acidity and a lithe finish that reveals a soupçon of almond.

title: Tom Gore Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California's expansive North Coast and Central Coast wine regions, Tom Gore Cabernet Sauvignon is an approachable, fruit-driven expression of everyday Californian winemaking. Named after second-generation grape farmer Tom Gore, the brand puts a spotlight on the viticulturist's role in the vineyard. Guided by a philosophy that great wine is made in the vineyard through thoughtful farming, Tom Gore Vineyards focuses on crafting smooth, accessible, and balanced wines designed for immediate enjoyment.

Wine Description

The wine presents a dark ruby red colour in the glass. An inviting and sweet-scented bouquet opens with bold aromas of black cherry, plum, and cassis, complemented by warm accents of milk chocolate, vanilla, and roasted coffee bean. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied and velvety smooth, delivering ripe fruit flavours of blackberry, damson plum, and cherry cola underpinned by gentle oak spice. Supported by soft, rounded tannins and modest acidity, it concludes with a warm, easygoing finish marked by notes of mocha and toasted oak. Blended with small percentages of Merlot, Malbec, and Petit Verdot, it delivers a classic, fruit-forward California profile with plush texture and low astringency.

title: Liberty School Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Varietally on target, reliable year after year, Liberty School consistently over-deliver value wines of outstanding quality. Liberty School wines are made in a traditional style. Fruit-driven, they are crafted to reflect true varietal character. The wines are barrel-aged, employing very little new oak. Oak is used as a building component rather than a flavouring agent.

A big brand, made by a small, close family, Liberty School is the home of delicious wines that are easy to enjoy.

This storied wine has been a staple on dinner tables for more than 40 years. With a beautiful deep ruby hue and brackish edge, aromas of fresh vanilla, cedar and black currants fill the glass. On the palate, a touch of wet leather, black pepper, savoury herbs, black cherry and sweet oak are framed by approachable silky tannins making this wine very food friendly.

title: Clos De Los Siete - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: The Clos de los Siete displays a deep ruby red colour with purple tints. The nose is expressive and complex, offering intense aromas of ripe blackberry, black plum, and dark cherry, layered with floral notes of violet, wild herbs, and spicy hints of vanilla and dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and well structured, featuring a fleshy, round texture with flavours of blackcurrant, minerals, and cocoa. It is characterized by its polished, silky tannins, vibrant acidity, and a long, elegant finish. The varietal composition is Malbec dominated, typically including around 55% to 59% Malbec, complemented by Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Petit Verdot, and Cabernet Franc. The ABV is approximately 14.5%.

title: La Crema Chardonnay Monterey - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and coastal-inspired white wine originates from the United States, specifically from the California region and the Monterey AVA subregion. Established in 1979, La Crema Winery is a family-owned estate that initially gained its reputation in the Russian River Valley before expanding its focus to other premier cool-climate sites. The winery's philosophy is centred on handcrafted, Burgundian-style winemaking that highlights the unique marine-based soils and windy climates of California's coast.

Wine Description

La Crema Chardonnay Monterey presents a brilliant straw yellow colour. The sensory profile features an expressive nose of baked apple, brioche, and pineapple, layered with sophisticated notes of citrus blossom and oak spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and 'rich yet refreshing', showcasing flavours of Asian pear, lemon curd, and Meyer lemon concentrated alongside hints of toasted vanilla and smoky spice. It is characterized by its balanced acidity and an elegantly long, zesty finish with notes of minerality. This 100% Chardonnay typically reaches an ABV of 13.5%. While the estate has supported sustainable farming since 1999 and is a certified 'green business', select retail listings also describe this specific bottling as organic.

title: Crossbarn Cabernet Sauvignon (by Paul Hobbs) - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Capturing the diversity and complexity from the region, this vintage displays a dark ruby hue with aromas of crushed violets, boysenberry, and blackberry compote. A burst of dark black fruits is revealed on the palate carried along by dried herbs, graphite, and cacao. Enveloping fine-grained tannins complement the soft textured body along with a lively acidity that gives the wine a clean, lingering finish.

title: J Lohr Chardonnay Riverstone - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California’s Central Coast region, specifically within the cool climate Arroyo Seco subregion of Monterey County, J Lohr Chardonnay Riverstone represents one of America’s most classic expressions of barrel fermented Chardonnay. Founded in the 1970s by Jerry Lohr, J Lohr Vineyards and Wines was a pioneer in identifying Monterey County's potential for world class viticulture. The estate’s winemaking philosophy relies on sustainable farming, night harvesting, and traditional small oak barrel fermentation with weekly lees stirring to craft balanced, terroir driven wines.

Wine Description

The wine presents a light straw yellow colour with youthful green highlights in the glass. An inviting and complex bouquet opens with aromas of ripe orange, nectarine, white peach, and Meyer lemon, complemented by subtle accents of baking spices, toasted hazelnut, and vanilla. On the palate, it delivers a rich, round, and generous mouthfeel packed with vibrant flavours of pear, apricot, citrus cream, and butterscotch, supported by an undercurrent of cool climate acidity and stony minerality. Composed of 100% Chardonnay aged sur lie in American and Hungarian oak barrels, it effortlessly balances creamy, toasted oak complexity with bright citrus freshness and tropical fruit charm.

title: Josh Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Josh Cellars was created in 2007 by vintner Joseph Carr as a tribute to his dad, Josh. The brand started with one varietal, Cabernet Sauvignon, and today features a diverse portfolio of well-balanced and delicious wines made to exacting standards. Sourced from across California's great wine-growing regions, every vintage represents a labour of love, a commitment to quality, and a personal promise to make great wine in honour of Josh.

This red wine has the fruit sourced throughout California's Mendocino, Napa and Sonoma counties. It is ruby red in colour with ripe aromas and flavours of plum, floral notes, jam, candied fruit and baking spices. The palate is rich and round, with velvety tannins and flavours of plum jam and licorice on a long finish.

title: Frank Family Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Take a trip back in time at the Frank Family Vineyards. First constructed as the Larkmead Winery in 1884, the building was refinished with native sandstone from the nearby hills in 1906 and still stands tall today. The massive stone edifice is considered an archetype of California’s wine country; it appears on the National Register of Historical Places and is listed as a Point of Historical Interest in the state of California.

This is a quintessential Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon with pronounced aromas of blackberry, cassis, and vanilla that welcome you into the glass. Flavors of black plums, nutmeg, dark chocolate, and a touch of espresso enhance the wine's complex and full-bodied structure, with a core of elegant acidity from start to finish.

title: J Lohr Cabernet Sauvignon Hilltop - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
J. Lohr Vineyards & Wines was founded by Jerry Lohr, who, drawing on his agricultural roots, began an extensive search for ideal California grape-growing regions in the late 1960s. He pioneered premium winegrowing on the Central Coast, first planting in Monterey County in the early 1970s before recognizing Paso Robles' potential for Bordeaux varieties like Cabernet Sauvignon in the 1980s. The winery's philosophy centres on crafting vineyard-driven wines that are the finest examples of quality and flavour from their given appellations, utilizing sustainably farmed estate fruit.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon blend is deep in colour and offers a sensory profile of complex dark fruit and spice. The aroma displays 'blackberry and blueberry compote aromas garnished with crushed violet, cracked pepper, and black tea'. On the palate, expect 'plump fruit' and 'juicy layers of black and red currants'. It is full-bodied and has 'fine-grained tannins' which lead to a bright finish accented by pastry notes from the 16 months of aging in French oak.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include 'rosemary-seasoned ribeye, and garlic roasted potatoes with parsnips and fennel'. Other excellent matches are grilled steak, roasted lamb, and game meats. Aged, hard cheeses like aged cheddar or Gouda also pair well, as do Portobello mushrooms.

title: Kistler Chardonnay 'Les Noisetiers' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Kistler Chardonnay "Les Noisetiers" 2023 is a highly sophisticated, benchmark white wine from the Russian River Valley in Sonoma County, California.

Founded in 1978, Kistler Vineyards is celebrated for its Burgundian approach to California fruit, relying on a proprietary heritage Chardonnay clone imported from Burgundy in the early 20th century. This specialized clone produces low yields and small berries with high natural acidity and immense flavor concentration. The "Les Noisetiers" bottling (named after the French word for hazelnuts) serves as the winery's iconic regional blend, meticulously combining fruit from prized estate vineyards—including Vine Hill, Dutton Ranch, and Trenton Roadhouse.

Wine Description

  • Aromas: The nose opens with lifted notes of lemon confit, tangerine oil, honeysuckle, and wet stone, with the classic nutty and buttery vanilla notes remaining more subtle and integrated in the background.

  • Palate: Full-bodied yet beautifully refined, the palate balances a juicy core of stone and tropical fruits—such as peach, apricot, pear, and pineapple—with a powerful streak of coastal acidity.

  • Finish: It concludes with an understated, resonant, and remarkably long finish marked by saline precision and a light chalky texture.

The wine is crafted from 100% Chardonnay grown in sandy Goldridge soils, which naturally impart finesse and mineral tension to the fruit. The grapes are harvested by hand in the cool of the night and whole-cluster pressed before undergoing barrel fermentation using indigenous yeasts. The wine is aged for 10 months on its fine lees in French oak cooperage and is bottled unfined and unfiltered to preserve its structural integrity. It features an ABV of 14.3%.

Food Pairing

The striking combination of rich fruit weight and high, linear acidity makes this Chardonnay incredibly food-friendly:

  • Seafood: Outstanding with rich seafood, particularly grilled lobster with tarragon butter, garlic prawns, or seared scallops.

  • Poultry: Pairs beautifully with traditional roasted chicken with lemon and thyme or an elegant stuffed chicken breast.

  • Cheese: A spectacular match for nutty, aged hard cheeses like Comté or Gruyrère, which complement the wine's subtle lees character.

title: Castello Di Ama Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'San Lorenzo' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
#9 Wine Spectator Top 100 of 2025

The 2021 Castello di Ama 'San Lorenzo' Chianti Classico Gran Selezione is a red wine from the Chianti Classico region in Tuscany, Italy. Named after the picturesque San Lorenzo valley, this wine exemplifies the estate's commitment to quality, tradition, and the expression of Sangiovese in its purest form.

Vineyard and Production

  • Grape Composition: Predominantly Sangiovese, with small amounts of Merlot and Malvasia Nera.

  • Vineyards: Sourced from the estate’s historic vineyards—Bellavista, Casuccia, San Lorenzo, and Montebuoni—located at elevations between 460 and 525 meters above sea level.

  • Soil: Clay and calcareous composition, providing excellent drainage and a distinctive mineral profile.

  • Vinification: Fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks, followed by aging in oak barrels to enhance complexity, texture, and depth.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Bright medium ruby red with a luminous rim.

  • Aroma: Elegant and refined, featuring vibrant notes of cherry, cranberry, dried flowers, cedar, and a touch of smokiness.

  • Palate: Juicy and structured, with fine-grained tannins and impressive length. Layers of dark red fruit, licorice, spice, leather, and graphite lead to a clean, mineral-driven finish.

Critical Acclaim

  • James Suckling: 99 points – 'This is really perfumed and gorgeous, with black cherries, blackcurrants and violets. Full-bodied with totally integrated tannins and a palate presence that is pretty spectacular. Wonderful finish. Give this three or four years. Try after 2027. '

  • Vinous (Antonio Galloni): 94 points – Praised for its power, depth, and dark red fruit character, with a structured profile and a long aging potential.

Serving and Pairing

Decant for at least one hour before serving at 16-18°C (61-64°F) to allow the wine’s aromas and structure to fully develop. This Chianti Classico Gran Selezione pairs beautifully with bistecca alla fiorentina, wild boar ragù, aged pecorino cheese, and truffle-infused dishes. Its balance of acidity and tannins makes it a great match for rich pasta dishes and roasted game meats.

title: Cleto Chiarli Vecchia Modena Lambrusco - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' sparkling red wine originates from Italy, within the esteemed Lambrusco di Sorbara D.O.C. appellation of Emilia-Romagna in Northern Italy. Produced by Cleto Chiarli the historic winery established in 1860 and celebrated as the oldest producer of Lambrusco the 'Vecchia Modena' premium cuvée is widely regarded as an benchmark gold standard for traditional, high-quality Lambrusco. Sourced from choice estate vineyards situated in the fertile alluvial plains of the Secchia and Panaro river valleys near Modena, the vines are rooted in deep, gravelly clay and silt soils. The continental microclimate features warm, sun-drenched summers and cool, foggy autumn nights, allowing the high-acid Sorbara grape to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining its signature mouthwatering freshness and delicate floral aromatics.

Wine Description

The Cleto Chiarli Vecchia Modena Lambrusco presents a luminous, pale ruby-pink color in the glass with bright garnet highlights, propelled by an exceptionally fine, persistent, and energetic stream of delicate bubbles (mousse). Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an elegant, chiseled, and precise portrait of traditional Lambrusco di Sorbara. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of fresh wild strawberries, sour red cherries, and pomegranate seeds, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of dried rose petals, violets, pink grapefruit zest, and a subtle line of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy red berry fruits, blood orange peel, and subtle herbal nuances. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate texture. The mouthfeel is weightless, supple, and creamy, carrying into a long, bone-dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of cherry skin, red currant, and flint.

title: Sonoma Cutrer Chardonnay Russian River - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Sonoma-Cutrer Chardonnay Russian River originates from the United States, within the California region and the Sonoma County subregion, incorporating prestigious fruit from the cool-climate Russian River Valley. Founded in 1981, the winery has established itself as a benchmark producer with an exclusive focus on crafting world-class Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. Their winemaking philosophy centers on marrying traditional Burgundian methods with northern California precision, relying on cooling maritime breezes and morning fog to preserve the natural structure of the grapes.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a beautiful pale straw appearance with a slight greenish hue and possesses a medium-to-full body with a creamy, mouth-coating texture. The sensory profile is elegant and fruit-forward, opening with an aromatic nose of lime zest, Meyer lemon, green apple, and Bosc pear, accented by delicate notes of white flowers, toasted almonds, and white pepper. On the crisp and juicy palate, it delivers vibrant citrus brightness mixed with flavours of pineapple, lemon curd, and a touch of green melon. The finish is remarkably long, balanced, and velvety, leaving subtle trails of barrel spice, mineral tension, and light vanilla toast.

title: Far Niente Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Far Niente Chardonnay is a benchmark luxury white wine from the Napa Valley AVA in California, United States. Since producing its first vintage of this variety in 1979, Far Niente has established itself as one of California’s absolute icons for premium Chardonnay. Sourced primarily from the cool, rolling hills of the Coombsville region—where the microclimate is heavily influenced by the morning fog of the San Pablo Bay—the estate aims to craft an elegant, complex wine that balances California richness with crisp structural length.

Wine Description

In the glass, it showcases a bright, straw-gold color. The nose is highly expressive and layered, opening with intense aromas of lemon confit, white peach blossom, and green apple, beautifully integrated with elegant hints of vanilla, oak spice, and warm pastry. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rounded, and phenolic, offering a creamy, luxurious texture layered with flavors of grilled citrus, pear, and melon. Stylistically, it epitomizes "American Chardonnay done right," skillfully avoiding a heavy, overly buttery profile by maintaining a striking, bright line of acidity and a mineral hint of wet stone that extends through a long, polished finish.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Winemaking: Notably, Far Niente famously does not undergo malolactic fermentation. This allows the estate to age the wine in high-quality French oak barrels to achieve a rich, creamy mouthfeel while perfectly preserving the grape's natural, racy acidity.

Food Pairing

The wine’s harmonious balance of opulent texture and clean acidity makes it an exceptionally versatile companion at the dining table. It pairs flawlessly with high-end seafood dishes such as seared sea scallops in lemon-butter sauce, pan-fried trout, or a rich crab-stuffed corn chowder. It also pairs exquisitely with roasted poultry like tarragon chicken breast, or creamy seafood pasta. For a cheese course, its structure beautifully complements premium hard cheeses like aged Parmesan or Manchego. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Far Niente Cabernet Sauvignon 'Post & Beam' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Post & Beam Cabernet Sauvignon is a premium red wine that represents the more approachable, pure-expression sister label of the iconic Far Niente family of wineries. Named after the classic timber frames used to build traditional American barns, the Post & Beam label was launched to create artisanal, site-specific wines that require less cellaring than Far Niente’s flagship bottles. The winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the immediate fruit purity and structural balance of selection parcels across the Napa Valley.

Wine Description

In the glass, it displays a rich, vibrant ruby-purple color. The nose is highly expressive and forward, exuding an effusive perfume of wild raspberry preserves, black cherry, and black plum, wrapped in warm hints of clove and confectionery baking spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, broad, and ripe, featuring an easy, plush texture laced with soft, well-integrated tannins. Layers of cassis and bright red cherries are supported by fine leather, subtle botanical accents, and a lingering, satisfying finish carrying notes of toasted espresso beans.

  • Varietal Composition: A classic Napa blend consisting of 91% to 92% Cabernet Sauvignon, augmented by small percentages of Merlot, Malbec, and Petit Verdot.

  • Optimal Drinking Window: Designed intentionally for immediate accessibility, this wine is spectacular to drink now or can easily be kept in the cellar for the next 3 to 7 years.

title: Argiano Brunello di Montalcino - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation situated in southern Tuscany. Argiano is one of Montalcino’s most revered and historic estates, with origins dating back to 1580. Operating under a precision-driven viticultural philosophy led by CEO Bernardino Sani and consulting oenologist Alberto Antonini, the estate has undergone an organic conversion and a soil-mapping revolution that highlights distinct micro-terroirs across its 57 hectares of vineyards. Situated on a magnificent plateau at 300 meters above sea level in the southwest quadrant of Montalcino, the vines are rooted in ancient marl, limestone, and clay soils (galestro and alberese). The estate enjoys warm, Mediterranean-influenced daylight tempered by cooling night breezes off the nearby Mount Amiata and Tyrrhenian Sea, yielding Sangiovese of extraordinary structural finesse, aromatic lift, and longevity.

Wine Description

Argiano Brunello di Montalcino presents a brilliant, ruby-garnet color in the glass with light orange-terracotta reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a quintessential expression of southwest Montalcino terroir. The bouquet opens with a captivating display of wild sour cherries, red plums, and crushed dried cranberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of sweet tobacco leaf, leather, dried lavender, crushed chalk, and a signature Tuscan note of wild rosemary and forest floor. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, taut, and precisely focused, showcasing a core of bright red stone fruits, blood orange zest, and licorice. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and linear, framed by silky, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into a long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of iron, spice, and dried Mediterranean herbs.

title: Justin Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Justin Cabernet Sauvignon is a widely acclaimed red wine from the Paso Robles subregion of the Central Coast in California, United States. Founded in 1981 by Justin Baldwin, the winery was a pioneer in the region, established with the goal of creating world-class Bordeaux style blends in a then-unproven territory. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes the unique limestone rich soils and dramatic diurnal temperature shifts of the estate, utilizing hand harvesting and small barrel aging to ensure high quality and varietal expression.

Wine Description

This wine typically displays a bright ruby red colour with moderate concentration. The nose is expressive and aromatic, offering notes of ripe red raspberry and black cherry layered with vanilla, toasted oak, and hints of dried herbs like oregano. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and dry, featuring a supple texture with flavours of juicy red plum, blackcurrant, and spicy nuances of cinnamon and cocoa. It is characterized by its balanced structure, well integrated tannins, and a clean, savoury finish with a touch of cedar. The varietal composition is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, and it typically features an ABV of 14.5%. While not certified organic, the estate employs sustainable farming practices. The optimal drinking window is generally within 1 to 5 years of the vintage to capture its vibrant fruit character.

title: Trapiche Malbec Reserve - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Trapiche Reserve Malbec originates from Argentina, within the Mendoza region and the Uco Valley subregion. Founded in 1883 by Tiburcio Benegas, Bodega Trapiche is one of Argentina's oldest and most renowned wineries, playing a pioneering role in introducing French grape varieties and modern winemaking to the region. Sourced from high-altitude vineyards at the foothills of the Andes Mountains, this bottling showcases how Mendoza's warm days, cool mountain nights, and alluvial soils yield intensely fruit-forward and structured Malbec.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep purple-red colour with bright violet reflections. The nose opens with intense, fruit-focused aromas of ripe plum, black cherry, and blackberry compote, accompanied by delicate floral notes of violet, alongside subtle hints of vanilla, sweet tobacco, and milk chocolate from oak aging. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full body with a smooth, velvety texture, supported by soft tannins and well-balanced acidity. Stylistically, it offers a rich, approachable, and generous profile that finishes smooth with lingering dark berry fruit and subtle oak spice.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Malbec

title: Donatella Cinelli Colombini Brunello di Montalcino - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Donatella Cinelli Colombini Brunello di Montalcino originates from Italy, within the Tuscany region and the Montalcino subregion. The winery is situated at the historic Casato Prime Donne estate, which has belonged to the ancestors of Donatella Cinelli Colombini since the late 16th century. The winery operates with a unique and pioneering philosophy, establishing itself as the first winery in Italy with an all-female staff and developing selections dedicated to showcasing female talent in the wine world.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, rich ruby appearance in the glass and possesses a medium-to-full body with an enveloping texture. The sensory profile is elegant, traditional, and rustic, opening with a complex and spicy nose of sliced cherries, fresh strawberries, and orange peel, complemented by deep aromas of nutmeg, black pepper, and ripe plums. On the balanced palate, it delivers a harmonious and succulent combination of sour cherries, dark berries, and wild herbs, intertwined with hints of marzipan and savory wood notes. The finish is long and well-structured, characterized by an architectural persistence, firm, high-quality tannins, and a lightly astringent, satisfying closing edge.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Sangiovese.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its incredible structural frame, balance, and classical poise, utilizing careful skin maceration alongside aging for at least two years in French oak and traditional Slavonian barrels to ensure excellent complexity and cellaring potential.

  • ABV: Typically 14%.

  • Organic Status: Crafted entirely from hand-harvested vineyards farmed under strict eco-conscious guidelines, this estate bottling is certified organic.

Food Pairing

The firm tannic grip, vibrant red fruit profile, and refreshing acidity of this Brunello make it a magnificent companion for hearty and rich gastronomy.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with premium cuts of grilled beef, classic Tuscan roast meats, slow-braised pork in tomato sauce, or a traditional beef stew.

  • Game: Suggested pairings include wild game options such as a rich venison shank braised in red wine.

  • Savoury: Complements full-flavored Italian dishes like orecchiette pasta cooked with spicy 'nduja sausage, Tropea onions, and tomatoes.

  • Cheese: Matches exceptionally well with structured artisanal platters of mature, hard aged cheeses.

title: Chateau Fuisse Pouilly Fuisse Tete De Cuvee - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the iconic Burgundy region, specifically within the prestigious Pouilly Fuisse subregion of the Maconnais, Chateau Fuisse Pouilly Fuisse Tete De Cuvee represents a flagship benchmark for white Burgundy. Owned and operated by the Vincent family for five generations since 1852, the historic estate is situated in the shadow of the Solutre and Vergisson rocks. The winery's winemaking philosophy relies on sustainable viticulture, parcel-by-parcel harvesting, and meticulous oak management to express the rich limestone and clay soils of the appellation.

Wine Description

The wine displays a brilliant golden yellow colour with bright greenish reflections in the glass. An expressive and refined bouquet opens with white peach, ripe Meyer lemon, and green apple aromas, interwoven with delicate nuances of toasted almonds, acacia blossom, crushed limestone, and subtle oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, rich, and well structured, offering generous flavours of citrus curd, yellow plum, and fresh butter, balanced by a vibrant core of natural acidity. Framed by a textured mouthfeel derived from extended lees contact, it glides into a long, mineral-driven finish marked by fine salinity. Composed of 100% Chardonnay sourced from over forty individual estate vineyard plots, it combines opulent Maconnais fruit richness with classical Burgundian precision, elegance, and age-worthy complexity.

title: Cantillon Beer Collection - Bundled by ZYN
bodyHtml:
About the Brewery:
Founded in 1900 in Brussels, Belgium, Cantillon Brewery is a legendary producer of traditional lambic beers. Renowned worldwide, it remains a family-run establishment dedicated to preserving the ancient brewing techniques of spontaneous fermentation.

The Brewing Process:
Cantillon exclusively uses natural, wild yeast strains found in the Brussels air to ferment their beers, a process unique to lambics. Aged in oak barrels, the beers develop their complex, tart character over years, reflecting the artistry and patience of traditional Belgian brewing.

Included Beers:

  1. Kriek

  2. Gueuze

  3. Rosé de Gambrinus

  4. Cru Bruocsella

title: Chateau D'Armailhac 2015 - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Owned by the prestigious Baron Philippe de Rothschild family, Château d'Armailhac is a renowned Fifth Growth estate located in the Pauillac appellation of Bordeaux. With a history dating back to the 18th century, the estate is known for its commitment to quality and tradition, producing wines that express the unique terroir of its vineyards.

The 2015 Château d'Armailhac is a harmonious blend of 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 29% Merlot, 9% Cabernet Franc, and 2% Petit Verdot. It pours a deep garnet red with a crimson tint, indicating concentration and potential for aging. On the nose, this wine displays an expressive bouquet of blackcurrant, blackberry, and fresh red fruits, with subtle notes of cedarwood. The palate is rich and fruit-forward, balanced by fine tannins and lively acidity, offering flavors of cassis, blackberry, and raspberry that evolve with elegance into a long, fresh finish.

Food Pairing Suggestions: This Bordeaux pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, roasted duck, or mushroom risotto, enhancing the wine's depth and complexity.

title: Castellare Chianti Classico - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Castellare di Castellina Chianti Classico originates from Italy, within the Tuscany region and the heart of the Chianti Classico DOCG zone near the village of Castellina in Chianti. Founded in 1977 through the merger of four estates by Paolo Panerai, Castellare is renowned for its steadfast commitment to native Tuscan grape varieties and environmental conservation. The vineyard plots sit at high altitudes (around 350 to 400 meters) on natural amphitheater slopes featuring limestone-marl (albarese) soils. Instantly recognizable by its iconic label featuring rare native birds—symbolizing the estate's strict prohibition of synthetic chemicals—Castellare’s winemaking philosophy fuses organic integrity, high-elevation freshness, and classical Tuscan Sangiovese character.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a luminous, translucent ruby-red appearance in the glass with subtle garnet highlights toward the rim. It possesses a medium-bodied, linear, and elegantly structured profile defined by a silky, fluid, and mouth-refreshing texture. The sensory profile is fragrant, precise, and classic, opening with an inviting bouquet of fresh red cherries, wild raspberries, and tart red plums, interwoven with delicate secondary aromas of dried violets, wild thyme, leather, cedar, and crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it delivers a focused, energetic core of crunchy red fruit balanced by a bright, mouthwatering thread of natural acidity and fine-grained, firm tannins. The finish is remarkably clean, dry, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of licorice, savory herbs, and sour cherry.

  • Varietal Composition: 90% Sangioveto (the traditional local name for Sangiovese) and 10% Canaiolo. Notably, Castellare strictly excludes international varieties like Cabernet Sauvignon or Merlot from its Chianti Classico.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes are hand-harvested from high-altitude hillside plots. Fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats with traditional maceration on the skins. The wine undergoes aging for approximately 7 to 12 months in used French oak barrels (barriques and tonneaux) to soften tannins while preserving pure varietal aromatics and vibrant freshness, followed by several months of bottle maturation.

  • ABV: Typically 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: Produced using organic and eco-friendly viticultural methods with zero synthetic pesticides, herbicides, or systemic fungicides to protect local bird species, though this standard bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant natural acidity, firm tannic structure, and bright red fruit profile of Castellare Chianti Classico make it a quintessential partner for classic Tuscan and Italian cuisine.

  • Meats & Pasta: Pairs magnificently with traditional Tuscan dishes like Tagliatelle al Ragù di Chianina, herb-crusted grilled pork chops, pan-seared veal cutlets, or roasted chicken with rosemary.

  • Italian Classics: Ideal alongside stone-baked margherita or prosciutto pizza, eggplant parmesan, and charcuterie boards with Prosciutto di Parma and Finocchiona salami.

  • Earthy Dishes: Complements mushroom risottos, pasta with porcini sauce, and Tuscan white bean stews with sage and olive oil.

  • Cheeses: Matches gracefully with medium-aged Italian cheeses such as Pecorino Toscano, young Parmigiano-Reggiano, or Fontina.

title: Carpineto Cabernet Sauvignon Farnito - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the famous Tuscany region, specifically drawing from high elevation estate vineyards in the Chianti Classico and Montepulciano subregions, Carpineto Cabernet Sauvignon Farnito represents a pioneering Super Tuscan expression of single varietal winemaking. Founded in 1967 by Giovanni Carlo Sacchet and Antonio Mario Zaccheo, Carpineto was established with a mission to produce world class Tuscan wines using advanced, quality driven viticulture. The estate's philosophy focuses on sustainable vineyard management, extended wood aging, and long bottle maturation to produce powerful, age worthy wines that combine international flair with authentic Tuscan character.

Wine Description

The wine displays an intense, dark ruby red colour with garnet reflections along the rim. A rich and complex bouquet opens with bold aromas of ripe black currant, dark cherry, and plum, complemented by sophisticated notes of eucalyptus, cedar box, dark chocolate, tobacco, and leather. On the palate, it is full bodied, dense, and tightly structured, delivering concentrated flavours of blackberry, cassis, and cocoa bean, supported by a firm spine of natural acidity. Framed by robust, well integrated tannins and a subtle mineral undercurrent, it finishes long, persistent, and warm. Composed of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon aged in French and American oak barrels, it combines classic Cabernet power and structural intensity with a distinctly Tuscan elegance and vibrant acidity.

title: Bodegas Lan Gran Reserva - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Bodegas LAN Gran Reserva 2017 is an esteemed red wine from the Rioja Alta subregion of Rioja, Spain. Founded in 1972, the winery takes its name from the initials of the three provinces that form the Rioja Designation of Origin: Logroño, Álava, and Navarra. The estate's winemaking philosophy focuses on a deep respect for the land and the use of artisan oak barrels, maintaining a legacy of precision and elegance that defines the classic Rioja style.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep black cherry colour with a garnet rim. The nose is intense and elegant, offering aromas of ripe red and black fruits, such as plum and blackberry, integrated with notes of sweet spice, pastry, and roasted coffee from its extensive oak aging. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and well structured, featuring layers of dark fruit, liquorice, and tertiary notes of vanilla and cedar. It is characterized by its remarkable balance, fine grained tannins, and a long, persistent finish that highlights its complexity and freshness. The blend consists of 95% Tempranillo and 5% Mazuelo, with an ABV of 14%. It was aged for 24 months in French and American oak barrels followed by 36 months in the bottle. The optimal drinking window is from 2024 to 2037.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 93 points.

  • James Suckling - 92 points.

  • Decanter - 91 points.

  • Vinous - 91 points.

Food Pairing

The structured and complex nature of this Gran Reserva makes it a perfect match for rich and savoury dishes. It pairs beautifully with grilled red meats, roasted lamb, and feathered game such as pheasant or partridge. Its spicy and earthy undertones also complement hearty stews, legume based dishes, and matured cheeses like Manchego or Idiazabal.

Vintage Quality

The 2017 vintage in Rioja was one of the most challenging on record due to a severe late April frost that significantly reduced yields across the region. However, the remaining grapes benefited from a hot, dry summer, allowing the fruit to achieve exceptional concentration and phenolic ripeness. This resulted in wines of great character and intensity, showcasing the resilience of the vines and the skill of the winemaking team.

title: Barefoot White Zinfandel - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Loaded with the refreshing, fruity flavors of sun-kissed strawberries, succulent pears, sweet pineapple, and Georgia peaches, Barefoot White Zinfandel will always leave you asking for one more sip. Even better over ice, our White Zinfandel is the perfect pairing for fresh fruits, smooth cheeses, and seafood feasts.

title: Arboleda Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Arboleda Cabernet Sauvignon is a red wine from the Aconcagua Valley region of Chile. Viña Arboleda was founded in 1999 by Eduardo Chadwick, a fifth-generation winemaker from the family behind Viña Errázuriz and the creator of iconic Chilean icon wines like Seña. The estate’s name, meaning 'grove of trees', is a tribute to the more than 1,450 hectares of native forest that surround and protect the biodiversity of its sustainably managed vineyards.

Wine Description

This wine displays a bright and deep ruby-red colour with violet shimmers. The sensory profile features a complex aromatic bouquet of cherries, plums, strawberries, and blackcurrant, accompanied by spicy balsamic notes and hints of tobacco, cloves, and nutmeg. On the palate, it is full-bodied and well-structured, offering flavours of red fruits, raspberries, and bitter chocolate with soft touches of vanilla and pastry. The structure is defined by firm yet polished, fine-grained tannins and a juicy, fresh acidity that contributes to an elegant texture and a long, persistent finish.

title: Apothic Crush Red Blend - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California, sourced from premier sun-drenched vineyards across the state, Apothic Crush Red Blend represents a soft, luscious, and modern expression of American winemaking. Launched in 2010 by E. & J. Gallo Winery, the Apothic brand was created to offer bold, expressive blends named after the historic apotheca, a mysterious place where wine was blended and stored in 13th-century Europe. The winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing ripe fruit intensity, rich chocolate notes, and a velvety smooth texture through cool stainless steel fermentation followed by oak aging to create an approachable, decadent profile.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, dark ruby red colour with vivid crimson edges in the glass. An expressive and indulgent bouquet opens with rich aromas of ripe black cherry, wild blackberry, and raspberry jam, interwoven with irresistible notes of dark chocolate, sweet vanilla bean, caramel, and subtle brown spice.
