On the palate, it is full bodied, plush, and remarkably smooth, delivering generous flavours of dark berries, cocoa, and subtle mocha supported by soft, velvety tannins. Balanced by a gentle streak of natural acidity and a touch of residual sweetness, it concludes with a warm, lingering finish marked by notes of ripe red fruit and smooth oak spice.

title: Austin Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Austin Hope Cabernet Sauvignon is a distinguished red wine from Paso Robles, California, crafted by Austin Hope Winery, renowned for producing expressive and robust Cabernet Sauvignons that reflect the unique terroir of the region.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Deep ruby hue.

  • Aroma: Enticing aromas of fresh black cherry, burnt sugar, and a slight smokiness.

  • Palate: Flavors evolve with vanilla foam, ripe dark fruit, roasted coffee, and nuances of spice. This full-bodied wine is rounded out with smooth, supple tannins, brightened by a touch of acidity, leading to a balanced finish.

Serving Suggestions

  • Temperature: Serve at 15-18°C (59-64°F).

  • Decanting: Decanting for about an hour before serving can enhance the wine's aromatic profile and complexity.

  • Food Pairings: Complements well with grilled steaks, roasted lamb, or dark chocolate desserts.

title: Babich Sauvignon Blanc Black Label - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Babich Black Label Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc was first produced in 2005. The Black Label Sauvignon Blanc showcases the perfumed and crisp characteristics that set Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc apart, combined with unique depth and complexity on the palate.

Wine Description

Black currant and boxwood. Lime, gooseberry and smoky herbals are also apparent. Fleshy and fruit-sweet entry heavy with passionfruit and a little blackcurrant. Underling this we have complex herbal and citrus notes. Mineral and spice on the finish. Nice breadth and length.

title: Barbi Brunello Di Montalcino - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Fattoria dei Barbi is a historic estate with family winemaking roots in Montalcino that span back to 1352. The estate has been producing classic expressions of Brunello since 1892, maintaining an extensive archive of almost every vintage in their cellars. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on honouring tradition and showcasing the authentic, terroir-driven identity of the region.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a brilliant ruby red colour with subtle garnet highlights. The intense aroma features notes of sour cherry, blue flower, wild herbs, and a touch of toasted spice and cedar shavings. On the palate, it is full bodied, dense, and well structured, displaying tart red berry fruits, savoury minerality, and fine, tightly woven tannins. The finish is long and polished, lingering with hints of balsamic and crushed herbs.

title: Barefoot Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Bright ruby colour. Cherry and red berry fruit with spice aromas. Dry, medium body. Soft, round plum and berry flavours with a hint of oak.

title: Copper Moon Rose - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Crafted by Arterra Wines Canada, Copper Moon Rosé is a vibrant and stylish expression of modern winemaking. Inspired by the soft, glowing light of a lunar eclipse, the brand focuses on producing "smooth as the moon" wines that offer high drinkability and immediate appeal. This Rosé is designed to capture the playful and refreshing side of the vineyard, utilizing a blend of red grape varieties to achieve a perfect balance between fruit sweetness and crisp acidity. It stands as a versatile, food-friendly staple within the Copper Moon portfolio, celebrated for its accessible and charming personality.

Wine Description

Copper Moon Rosé displays a brilliant, pale coral-pink color in the glass. The nose is highly aromatic and inviting, offering a fragrant bouquet of fresh strawberries, raspberries, and wild cherries layered with subtle floral notes of rose petals. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied and refreshingly crisp, featuring a smooth, "velvety" texture that carries flavors of ripe red berries and a hint of watermelon. It is characterized by its bright acidity and a clean, off-dry finish that balances juicy fruit sweetness with a refreshing snap. This blend typically has an ABV of 12% to 12.5%.

title: Copper Moon Pinot Grigio - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Produced in Canada by Arterra Wines, Copper Moon Pinot Grigio is a refreshing white wine inspired by the luminous beauty of a copper moon. The brand’s philosophy centers on creating smooth, easy-drinking wines that capture the essence of the grape in a contemporary, accessible style. Sourced from premium vineyards, this Pinot Grigio is designed to be a versatile "any-occasion" wine, emphasizing the bright, clean fruit character that has made this varietal a global favorite.

Wine Description

Copper Moon Pinot Grigio displays a pale, brilliant straw color with clear, silvery reflections. The nose is light and aromatic, offering an elegant bouquet of ripe pear, green apple, and white peach accented by subtle floral notes and a touch of citrus zest. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied and crisp, showcasing a "crunchy" acidity and a smooth, clean texture. It is characterized by its refreshing fruit flavors and a zesty, dry finish that leaves the palate revitalized. This 100% Pinot Grigio has an ABV of 12% to 12.5%.

title: Copper Moon Malbec - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Copper Moon Malbec is a smooth and approachable red wine crafted in Canada, known for its ripe fruit character and easy-drinking style that makes it perfect for both casual sipping and shared occasions.

Wine Description
Copper Moon Malbec pours a deep ruby colour with inviting aromas of blackberry, plum, and dark cherry. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with juicy black fruit flavours layered with hints of spice and soft vanilla. Gentle tannins and a smooth texture lead to a balanced, lingering finish, making it an accessible yet flavourful red.

Food Pairing
This Malbec pairs beautifully with grilled meats, barbecue ribs, or hearty stews. It also complements mushroom risotto, pasta with tomato-based sauces, or aged cheddar. These pairings highlight the wine’s ripe fruit and smooth structure.

title: Copper Moon Merlot - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Copper Moon Merlot is a smooth, approachable red wine crafted in Canada, celebrated for its soft fruit character and easy-drinking style that makes it perfect for everyday enjoyment.

Wine Description
Copper Moon Merlot pours a medium ruby colour with aromas of ripe plum, black cherry, and a touch of mocha. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with flavours of juicy red berries, subtle spice, and hints of vanilla. Soft tannins and a silky texture lead to a smooth, balanced finish that is both comforting and versatile.

Food Pairing
This Merlot pairs beautifully with roast chicken, pasta in tomato-based sauces, or grilled pork tenderloin. It also complements vegetarian dishes such as mushroom stroganoff or lentil stew. These pairings enhance the wine’s ripe fruit and velvety texture.

title: Gallo Sauvignon Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

Gallo Sauvignon Blanc is crafted entirely from the Sauvignon Blanc varietal. The wine presents a sensory profile with fresh notes of honeydew melon, citrus, and ripe apple. On the palate, it offers a bright balance of these fruit flavours. It is light-bodied, crisp, and refreshing, with a clean and short lingering finish that has a pleasant sweetness. The wine is a semi-dry, approachable, and value-oriented style. The provided sources do not indicate that this specific wine is organic. The optimal drinking window is while the wine is young and fresh. 

Food Pairing

This light, crisp, and refreshing wine pairs excellently with a variety of dishes. Suggested pairings include tangy tomato sauce, pesto, seafood dishes, or salads. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Gallo Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Enjoy this dry, medium-bodied and woody red featuring light acidity. On the palate, it showcases smooth tannins and a broad mouthfeel that leads into a medium finish.

title: Gallo Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Medium-bodied Chardonnay with a pleasing range of unexpected flavour, including citrus notes, hints of vanilla and a dash of oak.

title: Gallo White Zinfandel - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: This White Zinfandel features flavours of jammy strawberry and citrus aromatics. Fresh, juicy red fruit on the palate lends the wine a crisp, refreshing finish. This wine is great complement to salads, chicken and seafood dishes.

title: Beringer Cabernet Sauvignon Founders' Estate
bodyHtml: Made with fruit grown in Lodi and the California Delta, the climate is ideal for ripening Cabernet Sauvignon. Dry and medium-bodied with a supple texture, forward dark fruit, spice, and chocolate flavours. The finish is long, with notes of vanilla, smoky oak and herbs. Pair with lamb sausages combined with spiced couscous.

title: Beringer Pinot Noir Founders' Estate - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Opening with red fruit and black tea, the wine has exceptional red fruit notes that exude from the glass. Red cherry, strawberry and cranberry deliver on the palate and round out the bright acidity common in Carneros Pinot Noir. Barrel aging gives some light oxidized notes and vanilla flavour.

title: Greywacke Sauvignon Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from New Zealand, within the world-renowned Marlborough region at the northeastern tip of the South Island. Produced by Greywacke the prestigious boutique estate founded in 2009 by Kevin Judd, the legendary founding winemaker of Cloudy Bay this wine stands as a benchmark global standard for artisanal Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc. Sourced from choice, sustainably managed vineyards across the prime sub-regions of the Wairau Valley and the Awatere Valley, the vines are rooted in deep, well-draining gravelly silt loams and stony alluvial soils rich in greywacke (the native grey sedimentary rock after which the winery is named). Marlborough’s maritime climate features abundant sunshine hours balanced by cool ocean breezes and drastic diurnal temperature swings, allowing Sauvignon Blanc to develop intense tropical and mineral aromatics while locking in a razor-sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Greywacke Sauvignon Blanc presents a luminous, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with bright chartreuse and lime-green reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and sophisticated portrayal of Marlborough terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring, multi-layered display of yellow nectarines, ripe white peaches, and passionfruit pulp, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of crushed lemongrass, pink grapefruit zest, elderflower, candied lime, and a distinct line of flinty crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of crunchy citrus, passionfruit, and white orchard stone fruit. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, supple, and weightless, framed by subtle textural weight gained from lees contact, gliding into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of lime peel, lemongrass, and flint.

title: Beringer Merlot Founders' Estate - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: The Beringer Founders Estate Merlot is immediately approachable with lush flavours of blueberry, blackberry and plum complemented by dark chocolate and spice. It's well-balanced, soft tannins make this wine a perfect accompaniment to various foods, such as beef tenderloin, spaghetti bolognese or aged gouda.

title: Naked Grape Shiraz - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The Naked Grape Shiraz is a bold and expressive red wine sourced from the premier, sun-drenched vineyards of California and the high-quality growing regions of Canada. Guided by the brand's "bare it all" philosophy, this wine is crafted to showcase the natural, robust intensity of the Shiraz grape without the heavy influence of oak barrels. The winery’s goal is to deliver a "big and juicy" profile that emphasizes the variety’s signature dark fruit and subtle spice, resulting in a wine that is both impactful and remarkably easy to drink.

Wine Description

Naked Grape Shiraz displays a deep, intense purple color with a vibrant magenta rim. The nose is highly aromatic and spicy, offering a concentrated bouquet of jammy blackberry, blueberry, and dark plum layered with notes of cracked black pepper and a hint of sweet licorice. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and incredibly smooth, featuring a rich, velvety texture and well-integrated tannins. It is characterized by its "crunchy" dark fruit flavors and a lingering finish that balances sweet fruit notes with a subtle, savory warmth. This wine typically has an ABV of 13% to 13.5%.

title: E. Guigal Chateauneuf du Pape - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from France, within the world-renowned Châteauneuf-du-Pape A.O.C. appellation of the Southern Rhône Valley. Produced by Maison E. Guigal; the legendary winemaking house established in 1946 by Étienne Guigal in Ampuis this cuvée captures the majestic diversity of Châteauneuf-du-Pape’s unique terroirs. Sourced from choice, low-yielding parcel selections across famous lieux-dits, the vines average 45 to 50 years of age and are planted in the region's classic soil profiles: quartz heat-retaining rolled pebbles (galets roulés), sandy red clay, and crushed limestone scree. The Mediterranean microclimate features intense solar exposure balanced by the cooling, cleansing effects of the fierce Mistral wind, allowing traditional Rhône varieties to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining a vibrant, age-worthy natural acidity and an imposing structural frame.

Wine Description

The E. Guigal Châteauneuf-du-Pape presents a luminous, deep ruby-garnet color in the glass with brick and crimson reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and deeply expressive portrait of Southern Rhône terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring, multi-layered display of ripe black cherry compote, kirsch, and dark plum, seamlessly integrated with complex underlays of dried garrigue herbs (thyme, rosemary, lavender), sweet tobacco leaf, cured meat, licorice, black pepper, and a subtle line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, muscular, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of dark berry compote, blood orange peel, dark cocoa nibs, and savory spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its rich mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and linear, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of black pepper, iron, and forest floor.

title: E. Guigal Gigondas Rouge - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This structured red wine originates from France, within the prestigious Gigondas A.O.C. appellation of the Southern Rhône Valley. Produced by Maison E. Guigal one of the most iconic and celebrated winemaking families in the Rhône Valley, founded in 1946 by Étienne Guigal in Ampuis this cuvée showcases the powerful, sun-drenched terroir of Gigondas. The vines, averaging 40 years of age, are situated at the foot of the dramatic Dentelles de Montmirail mountain range, rooted in nutrient-poor red clay, limestone scree, and gravelly alluvial soils. The region's Mediterranean microclimate features intense daytime sunshine tempered by cool mountain air currents and the drying influence of the Mistral wind, allowing Grenache, Syrah, and Mourvèdre to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining a vibrant, age-worthy natural acidity and noble structural frame.

Wine Description

E. Guigal Gigondas Rouge presents a deep, luminous garnet-purple color in the glass with vivid crimson highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and rustic-yet-refined portrayal of Southern Rhône terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe kirsch, dark blackberry jam, and crushed plum, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of dried garrigue herbs (thyme, rosemary, lavender), cured meat, black pepper, liquorice, and a distinct line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, muscular, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of dark stone fruits, blood orange peel, and dark cocoa nibs. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its rich mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and linear, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of black pepper, crushed stone, and wild herbs.

title: E. Guigal Cotes du Rhone Rouge - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
E. Guigal Cotes du Rhone Rouge is a prestigious red wine from the Cotes du Rhone region in the Southern Rhone Valley of France. Founded in 1946 by Etienne Guigal in the village of Ampuis, the estate has risen to global prominence under three generations of family leadership. The winery's philosophy is rooted in the motto 'Nul bien sans la peine' (no good without pain), reflecting an obsessive dedication to quality, low-yield farming, and exceptionally long barrel aging.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a deep, dark red colour with a shiny appearance. The aromatic profile is intense and fresh, featuring notes of black raspberry, blackberry, and dark cherry layered with spices like black pepper and liquorice. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and racy, displaying a rich core of fruit balanced by rounded, smooth tannins and a touch of earthiness or black olive. It is characterized by its remarkable consistency, power, and elegance, leading into a long, self-confidently dry finish. The varietal composition is typically 50% Syrah, 40% Grenache, and 10% Mourvedre. The ABV is approximately 14.5% to 15%, and while not certified organic, the family avoids pesticides and chemicals in their vineyards. The optimal drinking window is from release to approximately 8 years after the vintage.

title: Naked Grape Sauvignon Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The Naked Grape Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant, crisp white wine primarily sourced from the premium coastal and valley vineyards of California and Canada. Staying true to the brand’s core "bare it all" philosophy, this wine is designed to showcase the pure, high-energy character of the Sauvignon Blanc grape without the distraction of oak. The winery focuses on capturing the "zesty" side of the varietal, aiming for a clean, refreshing profile that emphasizes bright citrus and tropical notes. It is crafted for those who enjoy a lively, straightforward wine that delivers immediate palate-cleansing freshness.

Wine Description

Naked Grape Sauvignon Blanc displays a pale, translucent straw color with youthful greenish highlights. The nose is highly aromatic and punchy, offering a bright bouquet of citrus zest, lime, and pink grapefruit layered with tropical hints of starfruit and a touch of fresh-cut grass. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied and refreshingly crisp, featuring a "crunchy" acidity that highlights flavors of lemon curd and green apple. It is characterized by its lean structure and a clean, zippy finish that leaves the palate feeling refreshed. This wine typically has an ABV of 11.5% to 12.5%.

title: Naked Grape Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The Naked Grape Chardonnay is a approachable, contemporary white wine produced by the Grape Valley Wine Company, based in Modesto, California (under the E. & J. Gallo umbrella), with regional iterations also expertly crafted by Arterra Wines Canada. The brand’s philosophy is rooted in the "bare it all" concept focusing on the true, unadorned character of the fruit rather than heavy oak influence. This "original classic" is designed to be a versatile, easy-drinking staple that prioritizes varietal purity and smooth drinkability, making it a favorite for those who prefer a cleaner, more fruit-forward expression of Chardonnay.

Wine Description

Naked Grape Chardonnay presents a pale, bright lemon color in the glass. The nose is highly aromatic and inviting, offering the essence of baked apple, ripe pear, and golden peach, often accented by subtle tropical notes of pineapple. On the palate, the wine is mid-bodied and remarkably smooth, delivering a silky, creamy texture that balances its crisp orchard fruit flavors with a hint of sweet caramel and vanilla. Characterized by its soft acidity and "un-oaked" freshness, it leaves a rounded, lingering fruit finish. This wine typically features an ABV of 12.5% to 13%.

title: Naked Grape Malbec - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This approachable and 'dual-icious' red wine originates from Canada. The Naked Grape is a brand under Arterra Wines Canada Inc., a leading producer with roots dating back to the late 19th century. The winery's philosophy is centred on the belief that wine should not be 'stuffy' or reserved only for special occasions; instead, they focus on creating smooth, fruit-forward wines designed for everyday enjoyment. The brand is known for its 'naked' approach, focusing on the pure expression of the fruit without heavy oak influence.

Wine Description

The Naked Grape Malbec presents a deep purple hue and a medium to full body. The sensory profile is highly fruit-driven, featuring a nose of peppery spice, dried sour cherry, and hints of gherkin. On the palate, the wine is 'deliciously fruity', showcasing luscious black cherry, bright blackberry, and ripe plum flavours. It is characterized by a silky texture and a 'zippy' personality, concluding with a tangy, berry-cobbler-and-cream finish that carries a distinct kick of spice. This Malbec typically has an ABV of 13% to 13.5% and is produced in an unoaked style to preserve its bright fruit character. While the brand emphasizes a clean and simple winemaking style, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Beringer White Zinfandel Main & Vine 1.5 Litre - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Nestled at the end of Main Street America, where the shops fade into the California vineyards, you will find Beringer Main & Vine. It's a wine where time-honoured values blend seamlessly with generations of winemaking craftsmanship to create one of America's favourite wine brands. But Main & Vine is more than a wine. It's any place friends and family gather for the simple joy of being together to cherish life's moments, and nothing brings us together like creating shared memories over a glass of wine.

In making Main & Vine White Zinfandel, the focus is to highlight the fresh red berry, citrus and melon aromas and flavours and round them out with subtle hints of nutmeg and clove. This wine has a youthful exuberance that is enjoyable as a sipper on its own or with a variety of dishes.

title: Beringer Pinot Grigio Main & Vine - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: This Pinot Grigio has a pale lemon colour with aromas and flavours of pastry, and fresh pear, with a touch of minerality and floral, honeyed notes; extra dry, medium-bodied with gentle acidity. Perfect for the hot days and warm nights of summer. Makes for a great pre-dinner sipper or as an accompaniment to fresh salads and grilled chicken.

title: Beringer White Zinfandel Main & Vine - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: In making Main & Vine White Zinfandel, the focus is to highlight the fresh red berry, citrus and melon aromas and flavours and round them out with subtle hints of nutmeg and clove. This wine has a youthful exuberance that is enjoyable as a sipper on its own or with various dishes.

title: Clarendelle Medoc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Clarendelle is the premium brand wine of Clarence Dillon Wines, established in 2005 by Prince Robert of Luxembourg, the great-grandson of Clarence Dillon who purchased Château Haut-Brion in 1935. The brand’s mission is to continue the legacy of perfection left by Clarence Dillon. Clarendelle benefits from the blending expertise and know-how of the First Growth winemaking team at Domaine Clarence Dillon.

Wine Description

The Clarendelle Médoc is a Bordeaux Médoc style red blend. Ruby in colour with a well-rounded palate, exhibiting notes of cassis, cherries, and earth, with firm tannins.

Food Pairing

Pair with grilled steak or full-flavoured cheeses like sharp cheddar or comté.

title: Chateau Le Bernet 2015 - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'savoury' red wine originates from France, within the Graves appellation of the Bordeaux region. Château Roquetaillade Le Bernet is part of the Vignobles Guignard portfolio, a family-run estate that has been cultivating vines in the South of Bordeaux for generations. The winery's philosophy focuses on traditional Bordeaux craftsmanship, utilizing the region's characteristic gravelly soils to produce 'classic' expressions that highlight the natural elegance of the terroir.

Wine Description

The 2015 Château Le Bernet presents a deep purple colour and a medium-to-full-bodied sensory profile. The nose is complex and intriguing, featuring aromas of black fruits, plums, and bilberries, layered with distinct notes of tobacco, cedar, and pencil shavings. On the palate, the wine is 'very smooth' and balanced, showcasing flavours of ripe black cherry and blueberry jam underpinned by silky tannins. It is characterized by its vibrancy and 'energy', often described as having a savory character with hints of chocolate and vanilla from its maturation. This Red Bordeaux Blend typically consists of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, reaching an alcohol content of approximately 13%. While the Guignard family emphasizes environmental respect in their vineyards, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Gaia de Chateau Puybarbe - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
From France’s Bordeaux region, in the Côtes de Bourg appellation, Château Puybarbe is a family-owned estate with a long tradition of quality winemaking. The vineyard is committed to sustainable practices, holding High Environmental Value and ISO 14001 certifications, and has been progressing through organic conversion. The philosophy at the estate emphasizes balance, respect for the environment, and producing approachable, terroir-driven wines.

Wine Description

Gaïa de Château Puybarbe is a Merlot-dominant red blend that captures the elegance of Right Bank Bordeaux. It presents a deep ruby colour and opens with aromas of ripe blackberries, dark cherries, and delicate hints of roasted coffee and cacao. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, with juicy fruit, supple tannins, and subtle spice. The wine offers balance, freshness, and a savoury finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile Bordeaux red complements a wide range of dishes, including roast chicken, grilled pork tenderloin, game sausages, and hearty stews. It also pairs beautifully with mushroom risotto or roasted vegetable dishes.

title: Altesino Rosso Toscana - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Altesino Rosso Toscana is a red wine from Italy, produced in the Tuscany region and the Montalcino subregion. Altesino is one of Montalcino's most famous Brunello producers. The winery was a pioneer in the region, being the first to introduce the 'Cru' concept in 1975, the first to experiment with barriques in 1979, and the first to release Brunello futures in 1985. The winery's philosophy combines an essential respect for tradition with a forward-looking perspective, resulting in wines that retain the unique and high quality reputation of Brunello.

Wine Description

The wine presents itself in a lively ruby red or purple red colour. The aromatic profile is fresh and very fragrant, with hints of violets and wild berries. Specific aromas include ripe red and blue fruit, touches of black olives, and notes of minerals and stones.

The varietal composition is predominantly Sangiovese, blended with Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. Sources indicate the blend is 80% Sangiovese, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 10% Merlot. It is a medium bodied wine. The flavour is dry, spicy, sapid, and decisive, with persuasive drinkability. The palate is smooth and juicy, with lively fruit in the middle. Stylistically, it is balanced and focused, crafted for accessibility and ready to be enjoyed upon release. The wine is matured for six to eight months in stainless steel tanks. The ABV is 13.0%. The optimal drinking window extends past 2029. Information on the organic status of the wine is not available in the sources.

Food Pairing

This Rosso Toscana is a wonderful everyday wine that is perfect for pasta dishes with meat sauces. It is also recommended with roasted white meats, poultry, or barbecued chorizo and other sausages.

title: Zenato Valpolicella - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Zenato Valpolicella Superiore originates from Italy, within the Veneto region and the historic Valpolicella Classico zone situated in the hills north of Verona. Founded in 1960 by Sergio Zenato, the family estate—now directed by his children, Alberto and Nadia—controls roughly 95 hectares across top terroirs in both Lugana and Valpolicella. Operating with a philosophy rooted in the expression of indigenous Venetian grape varieties, Zenato crafts its Valpolicella Superiore from select hillside plots near Sant'Ambrogio. The winemaking approach balances the bright, vibrant fruit character of Corvina with traditional oak maturation, yielding a wine renowned for its structural harmony, versatility, and classical Venetian charm.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a luminous, deep ruby-red appearance in the glass with vivid purple and garnet reflections. It possesses a medium-bodied, supple, and well-balanced structure framed by a silky, mouth-coating texture. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and fruit-driven, opening with an inviting bouquet of fresh red cherries, wild raspberries, and red plums, seamlessly interwoven with subtle notes of crushed violet blossoms, black pepper, tobacco leaf, and toasted almond. On the palate, it delivers a lively, concentrated core of bright red fruits, supported by a line of refreshing natural acidity and fine-grained, smooth tannins. The finish is clean, harmonious, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of red berry fruit, cocoa, and gentle oak spice.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically 80% Corvina, 10% Rondinella, and 10% Oseleta.

  • Stylistic Notes: Hand-harvested from select hillside vineyards in the Valpolicella Classica zone. Following temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats with systematic pumping over to extract color and soft tannins, the wine undergoes aging for approximately 12 months in large traditional Slavonian oak casks (botti), followed by bottle maturation prior to release.

  • ABV: Typically 13.5%.

title: Antinori Brunello di Montalcino 'Pian delle Vigne' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Pian delle Vigne Brunello di Montalcino originates from Italy, within the Tuscany region and the historic Brunello di Montalcino DOCG appellation. Acquired by the Marchesi Antinori family in 1995, the property takes its name from a historic 19th-century railway station located on the grounds. Situated six kilometers south of the town of Montalcino, the estate spans 184 hectares, with roughly 65 hectares dedicated to vineyards situated on south-facing, clay-limestone soils rich in small stones (scheletro). Antinori’s operational philosophy at Pian delle Vigne centers on interpreting traditional Sangiovese character through a modern lens of supple elegance, utilizing large, neutral oak casks to emphasize purity of fruit, vibrant freshness, and polished, accessible tannins.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep, brilliant ruby-garnet appearance in the glass, with soft terracotta highlights developing near the rim as it ages. It possesses a full-bodied, supple, and well-balanced structure defined by a smooth, velvety, and mouth-coating texture. The sensory profile is highly expressive, complex, and harmonious, opening with an inviting nose of ripe red cherries, wild raspberries, and red plums, layered over nuances of dried roses, violet flowers, tobacco leaf, cocoa, sweet spice, and a touch of balsamic eucalyptus. On the palate, it delivers a generous core of juicy red fruits held together by fine-grained, polished tannins and a vibrant thread of natural acidity. The finish is remarkably long, clean, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of licorice, savory herbs, and toasted oak.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Sangiovese (locally known as Brunello).

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes are carefully harvested and destemmed before undergoing temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks. To preserve Sangiovese's delicate fruit purity and avoid harsh extraction, the wine is aged for approximately 2 years in large oak casks (botti ranging from 30 to 80 hectoliters) rather than small barriques, followed by an extended period of bottle maturation before release.

  • ABV: Typically 14.0% to 14.5%.

title: Argiano Solengo - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This prestigious Super Tuscan red wine originates from Italy, crafted in the southern district of Montalcino in Tuscany. Founded in 1580, Argiano is one of Montalcino's most historic and respected estates. In 1995, legendary winemaker Giacomo Tachis (the mastermind behind Sassicaia, Tignanello, and Solaia) collaborated with Argiano to create Solengo, which means "solitary wild boar" in local Tuscan dialect. While Argiano is world-famous for its traditional Brunello di Montalcino, Solengo represents the estate’s modern, internationally acclaimed expression, combining French grape varieties grown in the warm, Mediterranean-influenced clay and limestone soils of southern Montalcino.

Wine Description

In the glass, Solengo presents an opaque, deep purple-ruby color. The expressive and layered nose opens with dark fruit aromas of black currant, black cherry, and plum, interwoven with savory notes of cedar, sweet tobacco, crushed gravel minerality, dark chocolate, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, opulent, and dense, offering a lush mid-palate balanced by fine-grained, velvety tannins and a vibrant streak of natural acidity. The blend typically consists of Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Merlot, and Sangiovese. The hand-harvested grapes are vinified separately in temperature-controlled stainless steel before aging for roughly 18 months in French oak barrels (a high percentage of which are new). The alcohol by volume sits at approximately 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The deep fruit concentration, firm tannic backbone, and complex savory notes of Solengo make it an ideal partner for rich, structured cuisine. It pairs magnificently with prime cuts of grilled beef, such as Florentine steak (bistecca alla Fiorentina), roasted rack of lamb with herbs, slow-braised beef short ribs, and roasted wild boar or venison. It also pairs exceptionally well with rich pasta dishes featuring wild mushroom or truffle ragù, as well as mature hard cheeses like aged Pecorino Toscano, Parmigiano-Reggiano, or sharp Gouda.

title: Altesino Brunello di Montalcino - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Altesino Brunello di Montalcino originates from Italy, within the Tuscany region and the prestigious Brunello di Montalcino DOCG appellation. Housed in the historic 14th-century Palazzo Altesi, the estate has long been recognized as an innovator in Montalcino, famous for pioneering the single-vineyard concept in the region (cru Montosoli) in 1975. The estate controls approximately 50 hectares of prime vineyards spread across varied microclimates in the northern, eastern, and southern sectors of Montalcino. Altesino’s winemaking philosophy blends respect for traditional Sangiovese purity with modern refinement, utilizing a combination of large Slavonian oak barrels (botti) and French oak to craft a flagship Brunello lauded for its aromatic elegance, structural finesse, and long-term aging potential.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, luminous ruby-garnet appearance in the glass, developing subtle amber reflections near the rim as it ages. It possesses a full-bodied, highly refined, and well-proportioned structure defined by a silky, mouth-coating, and supple texture. The sensory profile is classic, fragrant, and multi-layered, opening with an inviting bouquet of wild red cherries, crushed plums, and ripe raspberries, interwoven with complex secondary notes of dried violets, tobacco leaf, leather, Mediterranean herbs, sweet spices, and crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it delivers an energetic core of vibrant red fruit supported by a fine thread of natural acidity and polished, fine-grained tannins. The finish is long, clean, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of licorice, dark cocoa, and savory herbs.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Sangiovese (locally known as Brunello).

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes are hand-harvested from several estate vineyards to create a complete and balanced regional expression. Fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats. Per DOCG regulations, the wine ages for a minimum of two years in oak casks—utilizing traditional 50-to-100-hectoliter Slavonian oak botti alongside smaller French oak barrels—followed by at least four months of bottle aging prior to release.

  • ABV: Typically 14.0% to 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The vibrant natural acidity, firm tannic structure, and complex savory-fruit profile of Altesino Brunello di Montalcino make it an exceptional match for rich, savory Italian and classic global gastronomy.

  • Fine Meats: Pairs magnificently with Bistecca alla Fiorentina (grilled T-bone steak), roasted rack of lamb with rosemary, pan-seared duck breast, or braised beef short ribs.

  • Game: Ideal when served alongside wild boar ragù (ragù di cinghiale), venison tenderloin, or roasted pheasant.

  • Earthy Specialties: Complements mushroom risottos, pasta tossed with fresh black truffles, and hearty Tuscan bean or vegetable stews cooked with herbs.

  • Aged Cheeses: Matches gracefully with mature, firm cheeses such as Pecorino Toscano, Parmigiano-Reggiano, or 24-month Comté.

title: Caparzo Brunello di Montalcino - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from Italy, in the celebrated Tuscany region, specifically the Montalcino area within Siena. Caparzo, founded in the late 1960s, is one of the pioneering estates of Montalcino and has played a key role in elevating Brunello di Montalcino’s global reputation. Under the ownership of Elisabetta Gnudi Angelini since 1998, Caparzo combines traditional Tuscan winemaking with modern techniques, emphasizing vineyard diversity across different microclimates to achieve complexity and balance.

Wine Description

Caparzo Brunello di Montalcino displays a brilliant ruby red colour with garnet reflections. On the nose, it reveals an enticing bouquet of red cherries, wild berries, dried rose petals, and subtle hints of spice and underbrush. The palate is full-bodied yet elegant, featuring flavours of ripe plum, cherry liqueur, licorice, and a touch of leather, supported by well-integrated tannins and lively acidity. The finish is long and refined, with lingering notes of balsamic and earthy minerality.

Food Pairing

Pair this Brunello with classic Tuscan fare such as bistecca alla fiorentina, aged pecorino, or wild boar ragù over pappardelle. The wine’s firm structure and savoury complexity also complement hearty stews and roasted game. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Beringer Cabernet Sauvignon Private Reserve - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This flagship red wine is produced in the Napa Valley region of California, sourced from several premium estate vineyards including the St. Helena Home Vineyard and Chabot Vineyard. Established in 1876 by brothers Jacob and Frederick Beringer, the estate is California's oldest continuously operating winery. The winemaking philosophy for the Private Reserve label, which was first created in 1977, centres on a minimalist approach to highlight the unique terroir of Napa Valley's finest vineyard lots.

Wine Description

The Beringer Cabernet Sauvignon Private Reserve is a black-opaque wine with a deep and alluring appearance. The sensory profile features an exuberant bouquet of fresh violets, blackberry, and blackcurrant, underpinned by complex notes of graphite, dusty cocoa, and espresso. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and super-polished, offering a lush, creamy mid-palate with flavours of black plum and warm baking spices such as clove and cedar. It is characterized by structured, velvety tannins and a bright line of fresh acidity that leads to a long, sumptuous finish. This blend is composed of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, 12% Cabernet Franc, 6% Merlot, and 2% Malbec, with an ABV of 15.1%. While the estate vineyards are third-party certified sustainable, this wine is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The bold structure and rich fruit profile of this Cabernet Sauvignon make it an ideal companion for hearty red meat dishes such as tenderloin steak, beef brisket, or short ribs. It also pairs excellently with roasted lamb or savoury vegetarian options like grilled portobello mushrooms and eggplant parmesan. For a cheese course, hard varieties such as aged cheddar or gouda are recommended.

title: Beringer Chardonnay Luminus - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Beringer Luminus Chardonnay originates from the United States, within California’s distinguished Napa Valley AVA, specifically sourced from the cool-climate Oak Knoll District sub-appellation. Introduced as a focused exploration of single-terroir Chardonnay, "Luminus"—derived from the Latin for "light"—was created to showcase a brighter, more linear, and mineral-driven counterpart to Beringer’s classic, opulent Private Reserve style. Situated in the southern portion of Napa Valley, the Big Ranch Vineyard in Oak Knoll benefits from cool ocean breezes and morning fog off San Pablo Bay. Operating under the winemaking leadership of Ryan Rech, the estate’s philosophy for Luminus centers on preserving natural acidity, highlighting crisp orchard fruit, and utilizing seasoned oak to craft an elegant, fresh, and modern expression of Napa Valley Chardonnay.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a pale, bright straw-gold appearance in the glass with shimmering green reflections. It possesses a medium-bodied, sleek, and lively structure defined by a crisp, silky, and clean texture. The sensory profile is energetic, aromatic, and refined, opening with an inviting bouquet of green apples, crisp Anjou pears, lemon zest, and white peach, interwoven with delicate floral notes of white jasmine, wet stone minerality, and subtle toasted almond. On the palate, it delivers a focused, mouthwatering core of citrus oil and stone fruit, balanced by a bright, vibrant acidity that drives the wine into a crisp, refreshing finish touched by light oak spice and a clean mineral trail.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: Hand-harvested in the cool early morning, the whole clusters are gently pressed before undergoing fermentation. To balance freshness with textural complexity, approximately 80% to 90% of the wine undergoes malolactic fermentation. It is aged for 9 to 10 months in French oak barrels, with a low proportion of new oak (typically 20% to 25%), accompanied by periodic lees stirring (bâtonnage) to build subtle mid-palate weight without masking its crisp acidity.

  • ABV: 14.1% to 14.3%.

title: Beringer Chardonnay Private Reserve - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Beringer Private Reserve Chardonnay originates from the United States, within California’s world-renowned Napa Valley AVA. First crafted in 1977 by legendary winemaker Myron Nightingale, this bottling was created to demonstrate that Napa Valley could produce a world-class, age-worthy Chardonnay capable of standing alongside the finest White Burgundies. The fruit is sourced primarily from prime, cool-climate vineyard sites in the Gamble Ranch in Yountville and select plots in Carneros. Operating with a commitment to parcel-by-parcel selection, Beringer’s philosophy for the Private Reserve Chardonnay focuses on barrel fermentation, lees stirring, and full malolactic conversion to create a benchmark expression of classic, decadent Napa Valley Chardonnay.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a brilliant, deep golden-yellow appearance in the glass with bright yellow-green highlights. It possesses a full-bodied, rich, and voluptuous structure defined by a creamy, mouth-coating, and supple texture. The sensory profile is opulent, fragrant, and layered, opening with a bold bouquet of ripe yellow peaches, baked red apples, Meyer lemon curd, and tropical pineapple, interwoven with rich secondary notes of toasted brioche, melted butter, vanilla bean, roasted hazelnuts, and warm baking spices. On the broad palate, it delivers a dense core of stone fruit and citrus oil, balanced by a fine thread of natural acidity that keeps the wine vibrant and fresh despite its weight. The finish is remarkably long, warm, and luxurious, leaving lingering echoes of toasted oak, crème brûlée, and sweet spice.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes are hand-harvested at night to preserve freshness, gently whole-cluster pressed, and transferred directly to French oak barrels for fermentation using selected yeast strains. The wine undergoes 100% malolactic fermentation along with regular bâtonnage (lees stirring) over 8 to 10 months of barrel aging in approximately 75% to 80% new French oak, enhancing its rich texture and complex spice profile.

  • ABV: 14.5% to 14.8%.

title: Beringer Chardonnay Napa Valley Vineyards - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Beringer Vineyards is located in the Napa Valley region of California, United States. Founded in 1876 by brothers Jacob and Frederick Beringer, it is the oldest continuously operating winery in Napa Valley and is recognized as a historic landmark. Currently owned by Treasury Wine Estates, the winery maintains a philosophy of blending traditional methods with modern innovation, focusing on crafting wines that express the unique terroir of their extensive estate holdings.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a vibrant golden hue and opens with perfumed aromas of lemon confit, yellow apples, and grilled pineapple, accented by notes of white flower blossom and subtle baking spices. The palate is full bodied with a creamy, lush texture balanced by bright, mouthwatering acidity that carries flavors of grapefruit, Asian pear, and lemon meringue. Complex undertones of toasted brioche, vanilla, and a hint of mineral lanolin emerge on the long, focused finish.

Food Pairing

The wine's rich character and vibrant acidity make it a natural companion for succulent dishes such as buttered lobster, grilled halibut, or roast chicken served in a creamy mushroom sauce. It also pairs elegantly with autumn-inspired sides like roasted butternut squash or a rich parmesan risotto.

title: Beringer Chardonnay Founders' Estate - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Beringer Founders' Estate Chardonnay originates from the diverse vineyards of California. The fruit is sourced from a combination of cool coastal sites in the Central and North Coasts and warmer interior vineyards in the California Delta. Established in 1876 by brothers Jacob and Frederick Beringer, Beringer Vineyards is one of the oldest continually operating wineries in Napa Valley.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a bright gold colour in the glass. The aromatics are inviting, featuring ripe pear, apple, and tropical fruit notes accented by hints of spicy, toasty vanilla and toasted almond. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with a lush, rounded mouthfeel and forward flavours of apple, citrus, and ripe fig. The structure is well balanced, offering a creamy texture from four months of aging on seasoned French oak, leading into a long finish with lingering notes of vanilla and smoke.

title: Beringer Chardonnay Main & Vine - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: The Main & Vine Chardonnay is brimming with aromas of nuts, pears, vanilla and tropical fruit; those notes replay on the palate, along with notes of melon and fresh fig.

title: Jacob's Creek Shiraz - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Spicy red berry with subtle mocha and vanilla oak influence. Soft red berry and rich plum with a spicy cedar finish. This wine is a great example of the approachable style of Jacob’s Creek Classic wines.

Enjoy on its own or with roast leg of lamb or hard cheeses such as Cheddar.

title: Barefoot Zinfandel - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California, sourced from sun-drenched vineyards across the state's prime inland and coastal growing regions, Barefoot Zinfandel represents an approachable, widely popular expression of classic American winemaking. Founded in 1986 by Michael Houlihan and Bonnie Harvey, Barefoot Wine & Bubbly has grown into one of the world's most recognized wine brands, owned today by E. & J. Gallo Winery. The winery's philosophy focuses on crafting fun, fruit-forward, and easy-drinking wines designed to be enjoyed by all, using temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentations and gentle oak contact to showcase bright varietal fruit sweetness and soft textures.

Wine Description

The wine presents a bright, deep ruby red colour with soft purple edges in the glass. An expressive and fruit-driven bouquet opens with lush aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, and juicy red plum, interwoven with warm notes of sweet vanilla bean, toasted oak, and a touch of black pepper spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, plush, and remarkably smooth, delivering generous flavours of jammy blackberry, raspberry, and subtle cocoa supported by gentle, low-astringency tannins. Balanced by a soft streak of natural acidity and a touch of residual sweetness, it concludes with a warm, velvety finish marked by lingering notes of dark berry fruit and baking spice.

title: Famille Perrin Rascal Rouge - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'approachable' red wine originates from France, within the sunny, wind-swept growing regions of the Southern Rhône Valley. Produced by Famille Perrin; the world-renowned winemaking family behind the legendary Château de Beaucastel in Châteauneuf-du-Pape, 'Rascal' (often produced under the Les Christins or Nature regional range depending on market allocation) is a playful, high-value cuvée designed to showcase pure Southern Rhône character. Sourced from sustainably farmed vineyard parcels rooted in gravelly alluvial soils, clay, and limestone, the vines thrive under the classic Mediterranean climate. Intense daytime sunshine is tempered by cool nighttime air and the drying influence of the Mistral wind, allowing traditional Rhône grapes to accumulate generous fruit depth while preserving a bright, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Famille Perrin Rascal Rouge presents a deep, luminous garnet-ruby color in the glass with bright crimson and magenta highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and fruit-forward, delivering an energetic, juicy, and expressive portrait of Southern Rhône terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe crushed blackberries, wild red cherries, and black plums, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of dried garrigue herbs (thyme, rosemary), sweet baking spices, black pepper, and a clean line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, supple, and smooth, showcasing a succulent core of dark berry compote, blood orange zest, and cocoa powder. It is characterized by its balanced energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that maintains freshness across the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is broad, silky, and weightless, framed by soft, rounded tannins that glide into a long, dry, and pleasingly spicy finish accented by notes of cherry skin, black pepper, and Mediterranean herbs.

title: Frontera Merlot - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: The color of the wine is a deep red with great intensity. On the nose, the wine shows delicious hints of plums and herbs. This Merlot reveals hints of chocolate and spice, while integrating perfectly with the dark fruit flavors. The wine is smooth with great structure. Frontera Merlot is a delightful accompaniment to white meats, cheeses, and pasta dishes. Serve at room temperature.

title: Two Oceans Pinot Grigio - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Brilliant with green flecks. Upfront fruit flavours including dried peach and apricot as well as a hint of lychee. A crisp wine with a touch of fruit and a fresh, lingering finish. An ideal sipping wine for a warm day, also excellent served with light salads and cold meats.

title: Casillero Del Diablo Carmenere - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Expressive and fruity, featuring luscious berries and plum aromas, alongside hints of coffee and spice, with polished tannins that lead towards a long, satisfying finish. Medium-bodied with natural acidity, Carmenere pairs beautifully with game meats, roasted or grilled vegetables, and bean dishes.

title: Casillero Del Diablo Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Dark, ruby red with aromas of cherries, black currant, and dark plums. This Cabernet Sauvignon is very concentrated, rich in flavour, perfectly balanced, and boasts a satisfying and lingering finish.

title: Cono Sur Cabernet Sauvignon Bicicleta Reserva - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Cono Sur is a leader in sustainable wine production. Bicicleta Cabernet Sauvignon is deep ruby in the glass, with aromas of cassis, black cherry and raspberry. You will taste cassis, plum and ripe berry fruit. Barrel ageing adds the toasty and spicy notes of oak. Serve with grilled meats, pasta or a selection of cheeses.

title: Woodbridge Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: The colour is a bright pale lemon with aromas of ripe apple, pear and citrus, which are joined by hints of spicy vanilla oak. The wine is dry and medium-bodied with lively acidity framing notes of ripe apple, citrus, toast and vanilla. A medium-length finish with sweet apple and toasted oak notes balanced by lemony acidity.

title: Woodbridge Merlot - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: This Merlot displays rich aromas of cherry, chocolate and red berries with enticing flavours of cherry cola and toasty mocha oak. This full-bodied wine possesses well-balanced acidity and beautifully integrated tannins, creating complexity and structure. Its soft, versatile style complements grilled meats, especially steak, lamb, pork chops and hamburgers. Enjoy this savoury wine with hearty pasta with Bolognese sauce.

title: Pelee Island Lola Sparkling Rose - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: This blush sparkling wine has hints of strawberry and blood orange flavours, serve chilled. Pair with: beet risotto, puff pastry tomato torte, cranberry brie bites or strawberry tarts.  95% Vidal Blanc/ 5% Chambourcin. Charmat Method.

title: Pelee Island Pinot Grigio - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Medium yellow colour; aromas of green pear and fresh herb; dry, light bodied, with citrus flavours; crisp finish.

title: Pelee Island Gewurztraminer - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Pale straw/yellow colour; floral, ripe peach, honey and lychee fruit aromas; off-dry, light to medium bodied, softly structured with balanced acidity, flavours of honeysuckle, rose water, pear, citrus and lychee; hints of spice on the finish.

title: Pelee Island Shiraz - Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada in Ontario's historic Pelee Island region, situated within the Lake Erie North Shore appellation, Pelee Island Shiraz - Cabernet Sauvignon represents a unique, island-grown expression of Canadian red winemaking. As Canada's southernmost inhabited territory, Pelee Island benefits from a long, sun-drenched growing season surrounded by the moderating waters of Lake Erie. Founded in 1979, Pelee Island Winery leverages this warmer microclimate to ripen late-season red grape varieties, employing sustainable viticulture, stainless steel fermentations, and judicious oak aging to craft approachable, fruit-driven, and food-friendly red blends.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear ruby purple colour with bright garnet highlights in the glass. An expressive and dark-fruited bouquet opens with ripe aromas of black cherry, wild blackberry, and juicy red plum, layered with characteristic accents of crushed black pepper, dark cocoa, sweet vanilla, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied, supple, and fruit-forward, delivering generous flavours of dark berries, cassis, and subtle espresso supported by a core of fresh, balanced natural acidity. Framed by smooth, rounded tannins and a clean structure, it finishes pleasantly with lingering notes of dark fruit, baking spice, and subtle pepper. Composed of a classic blend of Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2028. Stylistically, it combines the spicy, juicy blackberry character of Shiraz with the firm, structured blackcurrant profile of Cabernet Sauvignon.

title: Gallo Merlot - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This smooth red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the California region. Gallo Family Vineyards was founded in 1933 by brothers Ernest and Julio Gallo in Modesto, California, following the repeal of Prohibition. Over more than 80 years of family ownership, the winery has grown into the largest family-owned winery in the United States and the largest wine producer in the world by volume. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a family promise to provide approachable, quality wines for every occasion, ensuring that every bottle is a reflection of their long-standing heritage and commitment to easy enjoyment.

Wine Description

Gallo Family Vineyards Merlot presents a rich ruby red colour in the glass. The sensory profile is fruit-forward and inviting, with a bouquet that features aromas of ripe plum, black cherry, and blackberry, complemented by subtle hints of mocha, vanilla, and sweet wood. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is soft and medium-dry, offering juicy flavours of dark berries and red cherry supported by gentle spice and a whisper of oak.

Stylistically, it is celebrated for its balanced mouthfeel and velvety richness. The finish is smooth and lingering, with pleasant notes of ripe fruit and a touch of warm vanilla. While crafted for immediate and easy drinking, its consistent style ensures it remains a reliable choice for casual sipping or social gatherings.

title: Jackson Triggs Merlot Proprietor's Selection 1.5 Litre - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada in the famous Niagara Peninsula region of Ontario, Jackson Triggs Merlot - 1.5 Litre Bottle represents a generous, large-format expression of everyday Canadian winemaking. Founded in 1993 by Allan Jackson and Don Triggs, Jackson Triggs is one of Canada's most celebrated and recognizable winery brands. Sourced from estate vineyards and select grower sites across Ontario, the winery's philosophy focuses on capturing pure fruit characteristics, soft textures, and reliable, food-friendly structure through temperature controlled stainless steel fermentation and judicious oak contact, bottled in a convenient 1.5-litre magnum format ideal for entertaining.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, bright ruby red colour with garnet reflections in the glass. An expressive, fruit-forward bouquet opens with aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild plum, and red currant, interwoven with subtle notes of cocoa, vanilla, and gentle toasted oak. On the palate, it is medium bodied, smooth, and supple, delivering ripe flavours of black cherry, dark berry jam, and subtle milk chocolate supported by a spine of fresh, balanced natural acidity. Framed by soft, approachable tannins and a clean texture, it concludes with a smooth, lingering finish marked by notes of dark fruit and soft baking spice. Composed of 100% Merlot bottled in a 1.5-litre format, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2028. Stylistically, it offers an easy-drinking, harmonious balance of supple fruit texture, value, and versatile everyday appeal.

title: Jackson Triggs Sauvignon Blanc Proprietors' Selection - 1.5 Litre - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada in the famous Niagara Peninsula region of Ontario, Jackson Triggs Sauvignon Blanc represents a crisp, vibrant expression of cool-climate white winemaking. Founded in 1993 by Allan Jackson and Don Triggs, Jackson Triggs is one of Canada's most celebrated and recognizable winery brands. Sourced from estate vineyards and partner grower sites across Ontario, the winery's philosophy focuses on capturing maximum aromatic freshness, bright acidity, and pure varietal character through cool stainless steel fermentation without oak intervention.

Wine Description

The wine presents a pale straw colour with clear, greenish reflections in the glass. An inviting and intensely aromatic bouquet opens with fresh aromas of pink grapefruit, passion fruit, and lime zest, interwoven with herbal nuances of lemongrass, fresh cut grass, and green pepper. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, zesty, and refreshing, delivering vibrant flavours of citrus fruit, green apple, and subtle tropical guava, all driven by a lively, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Finishing clean and crisp, it leaves a lingering impression of citrus and subtle flinty minerality. Composed of 100% Sauvignon Blanc, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2028. Stylistically, it combines Niagara cool-climate brightness and zesty citrus aromatics with effortless, food-friendly freshness.

title: Jackson Triggs Chardonnay Proprietors' Selection - 1.5 Litre - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This wine is poised and well-balanced with aromas of apricots, nectarines, Niagara peaches, cloves, and an abundance of stone fruit and vanilla custard. Well-integrated on the palate with hints of oak, vanilla bean, apricot, baking spice and clove.

The Chardonnay was aged in French oak for four months to develop creaminess and vanilla notes, balanced with citrus and tropical flavours for a wine of the finest quality.

title: Jackson Triggs Chardonnay Proprietors' Selection - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This wine is poised and well-balanced with aromas of apricots, nectarines, Niagara peaches, cloves, and an abundance of stone fruit and vanilla custard. Well-integrated on the palate with hints of oak, vanilla bean, apricot, baking spice and clove.

The Chardonnay was aged in French oak for four months to develop creaminess and vanilla notes, balanced with citrus and tropical flavours for a wine of the finest quality.

title: Dolin Creme de Violette 350 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: If you’re a fan of floral liqueurs like St-Germain but you haven’t yet experienced the flowery delight of Dolin crème de violette, stop what you’re doing right now and go buy a bottle. Made with violet buds and blossoms, crème de violette is one of the oldest and most unique tasting liqueurs. Best of all, once you procure a bottle of the purple-hued spirit, you can make one of the most underrated cocktails of all time: the Aviation.

title: Dominio Imperfetto Perfectly Imperfect Rose - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Produced along the picturesque Adriatic Coast of Italy, this contemporary rosé originates from the Abruzzo region. Dominio Imperfetto is a boutique project founded by the De Cerchio family, who sought to challenge the traditional red-dominated viticulture of the region by creating high quality, modern white and rosé wines. The winery’s philosophy is captured in its name celebrating the beauty of natural "imperfections" and the authentic, non-homogenized character of the land. Sourced from organic vineyards along the Trabocchi Coast, the wine benefits from a unique maritime microclimate where mild breezes and calcareous, sandy soils impart a signature freshness and mineral tension.

Wine Description

Dominio Imperfetto "Perfectly Imperfect" R (Rosé) presents a pale, luminous pink hue reminiscent of a Mediterranean sunset. The nose is delicate and highly expressive, offering an elegant bouquet of ripe strawberries, cherries, and citrus fruits, accented by floral hints of rose petals and violet. On the palate, the wine is vibrant and well-balanced, showcasing a crisp acidity and a savory, mineral core that reflects its coastal origins. It is characterized by its "crunchy" red fruit flavors, redcurrant, wild strawberry and a persistent, harmonious finish. This organic blend of Merlot (60%), Montepulciano (20%), and Sangiovese (20%) has an ABV of 12.5%.

title: Stoneleigh Sauvignon Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine is a quintessential expression of New Zealand, specifically from the Marlborough region. The Stoneleigh story began in 1980, and the winery owes its unique character to the ancient, stone-studded Rapaura soils deposited by the Wairau River thousands of years ago. These 'sunstones' capture heat during the day and release it into the vines at night, fostering the development of intense, rich flavours. Stoneleigh’s winemaking philosophy centres on minimal intervention, ensuring the natural, exuberant fruit profiles of the vineyard are captured authentically in every bottle.

Wine Description

The Stoneleigh Sauvignon Blanc is light straw in colour with subtle green highlights. It features a fresh and exuberant sensory profile, with a bouquet dominated by lifted aromas of passion fruit, lime zest, and grapefruit, accented by hints of lemongrass and garden herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and packed with tension and texture, delivering layered flavours of tropical fruit, guava, and pink grapefruit.

This 100% Sauvignon Blanc demonstrates mouth-watering acidity and a distinct mineral edge that leads to a long, lingering finish. Stylistically, it is celebrated for its vibrancy and crisp, clean structure. The wine is designed for immediate enjoyment and has an optimal drinking window of 0–3 years from the vintage date.

title: Gigglewater Prosecco 200 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This sparkling wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Veneto region. Produced by Genuine Classics Wine Company under the Gigglewater label, the brand was founded by Catherine Monahan and inspired by a 1920s Prohibition-era slang term for alcoholic beverages. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a 'living life in balance' ethos, focusing on approachable, lifestyle-led wines that donate a portion of profits to ecological and sustainable projects through its G.L.O.W. Foundation.

Wine Description

Gigglewater Prosecco displays a pale straw yellow colour with persistent, aggressive bubbles. The nose is fragrant and playful, offering a bouquet of acacia flowers, crunchy Bartlett pears, and apricot layered with a generous spritz of tangerine and lemon. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied and juicy, featuring flavours of crisp green apple, white peach, and honeydew melon balanced by a touch of honeyed sweetness and a little minerality. It is characterized by its moussy texture, fine-boned structure, and a clean, dry finish with a hint of almond. This 100% Glera wine is produced using the traditional tank method and typically has an ABV of 11%. While the estate manages its own vineyards using organic methods, this specific DOC bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window for this young, fresh sparkler is from release through two years.

title: Gigglewater Prosecco Rose 200 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This sparkling rosé originates from Italy, specifically from the lush vineyards of the Veneto region. Produced by Genuine Classics Wine Company under the Gigglewater label, the brand is inspired by the 1920s Prohibition era slang term for a spirited alcoholic beverage. The winery's philosophy focuses on creating fun yet elegant sparkling wines that offer effortless enjoyment and a festive flair for modern gatherings.

Wine Description

Gigglewater Prosecco Rosé displays a vibrant and eye catching appearance with a delicate pink hue. The nose is fragrant and playful, offering a bouquet that bursts with ripe strawberry, juicy peach, and delicate rose petals, accented by hints of citrus zest. On the palate, the wine is bright and refreshing, featuring a medley of red berries and stone fruit balanced by a creamy, almond like finish and fine, lively bubbles. It is characterized by its medium sweet style and crisp acidity. This sparkling wine is crafted from a blend of Glera and Pinot Noir grapes, which undergoes a cool secondary fermentation in stainless steel tanks to preserve its fresh, fruity character. The ABV is typically 11%. While the brand emphasizes a light and modern style, this specific bottling is not certified organic, though it is noted as being both vegan and gluten free. The optimal drinking window is generally from release through two to three years to preserve its youthful effervescence.

title: Zuccardi Piedra Infinita Gravascal - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Zuccardi Piedra Infinita Gravascal hails from the Paraje Altamira subregion of the Uco Valley in Mendoza, Argentina. The winery is led by third generation winemaker Sebastián Zuccardi, whose philosophy focuses on 'terroir-focussed' wines that express the unique limestone-rich soils of the Andes foothills. This specific parcel, Gravascal, represents a meticulous selection from a 0.73-hectare plot characterized by large granite rocks covered in calcium carbonate.

Wine Description

This 100% Malbec displays a profound ruby red colour with violet undertones. The aromatic profile is intense and precise, dominated by notes of red fruits, wild herbs, and a distinct mineral 'wet stone' character. On the palate, the wine is full bodied yet remarkably elegant, defined by its chalky texture and vibrant acidity. The finish is exceptionally long and saline, reflecting the high lime content of the vineyard soil. While beautiful now, this wine has an optimal drinking window extending through 2040 due to its impeccable balance and structure.

title: Fundador Brandy - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Fundador Brandy is a Spanish brandy produced by Bodegas Fundador, the oldest winery in Jerez de la Frontera, Spain, established in 1730. Introduced in 1874, Fundador holds the distinction of being the first Spanish brandy to be marketed under the designation "Brandy de Jerez." This brandy is crafted from Airén and Palomino grapes, distilled in Tomelloso, and aged using the traditional solera system in sherry-seasoned oak casks, imparting its unique character.

Colour: Deep amber with golden highlights, reflecting its extended aging process.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring notes of vanilla, toasted almonds, and dried fruits, complemented by subtle hints of oak and caramel.

Palate: Smooth and well-balanced, offering flavors of rich toffee, dried figs, and a touch of spice, leading to a warm, lingering finish.

Body: Medium-bodied with a velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both depth and elegance.

Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

Accolades:

  • Gold Medal - International Wine & Spirit Competition

  • Silver Medal - San Francisco World Spirits Competition

  • 90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

title: Italo Cescon Pinot Noir 'Il Tralcetto' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Pinot nero, also known as Pinot noir, is one of the most difficult red-berried grapes to grow and vinify, as it requires particular climatic conditions in order to best express itself in the vineyard, but is capable of producing wines of great class and elegance. It has a red colour that is never too pronounced and a characteristic scent of small red fruits.

The Pinot Noir Veneto “Il Tralcetto” is found in the clayey and medium-textured soils of our vineyards of Basalghelle and Fontanelle, with the ideal microclimate for its ripening, revealing itself as fine and elegant, savoury and full-bodied.

title: El Enemigo Cabernet Franc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
El Enemigo Cabernet Franc originates from Argentina, within the Mendoza region and the high-altitude Gualtallary subregion of the Uco Valley. The winery was founded in 2009 by Alejandro Vigil, the chief winemaker at Catena Zapata and a soils engineer, alongside historian Adrianna Catena. Their partnership is built on a shared passion for history and a philosophy of 'irreverence' toward the status quo, aiming to produce wines that confront the 'enemy within' through minimal human intervention. The estate is inspired by traditional European styles, particularly the cool-climate expressions of Bordeaux's Pomerol region.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep purple colour with dark intensity and soft violet tones. The sensory profile is complex and layered, featuring an aromatic nose of blackcurrants, ripe plums, and cassis, interwoven with notes of violet, black pepper, and tobacco leaves. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it delivers a fresh impact and excellent structure, with flavours of ripe red fruits and hints of eucalyptus and cedar. The wine is characterized by a sturdy, mineral-driven core and firm yet polished tannins, leading to an explosive and persistent finish.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend of 90% Cabernet Franc and 10% Malbec.

  • ABV: Recorded at 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery utilizes certified sustainable and eco-friendly practices, including spontaneous fermentation with wild yeasts, this specific wine is not typically certified organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine underwent a 60-day maceration and was aged for 15 to 16 months in a combination of ancient oak foudres, barriques, and concrete tanks to preserve terroir clarity.

title: Terrunyo Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
While the Peumo Vineyard Carmenère achieved iconic status for the label, Terrunyo Cabernet Sauvignon represents Concha y Toro’s focused exploration of high-altitude Chilean Cabernet Sauvignon. Sourced from the prestigious Pirque Vineyard in the Maipo Valley—one of the world's premier terroirs for the variety—this wine showcases the signature Chilean Cabernet character: vibrant red fruit, intense structural elegance, and distinct cool-climate herbal complexity.

Guided by the legendary Ignacio Recabarren and the modern technical team, Terrunyo Cabernet Sauvignon isolates the finest blocks of Andean-influenced alluvial soils to craft a single-vineyard bottling that balances Old World structure with New World fruit purity.

Wine Description

The Terrunyo Pirque Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon pours a deep, radiant ruby-garnet color with dark purple undertones. The aromatics are intensely expressive and refined, opening with classic Maipo aromas of cassis, black cherry, red currant, and cedar, wrapped in subtle notes of menthol, fresh mint, dried herbs, pencil lead, and a touch of roasted coffee bean from its oak aging.

On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied with incredible linear tension. Brilliant natural acidity cuts through layers of bright red berry fruit and dark plums, while ultra-fine, gravelly tannins provide a solid, structured backbone. Accents of dark chocolate, tobacco leaf, and crushed stone emerge on the mid-palate, leading to a long, precise, and savory finish.

Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon (often rounded out with a small percentage of Cabernet Franc), the wine undergoes gentle fermentation in stainless steel followed by approximately 16 to 18 months of aging in French oak barrels (around 30–40% new).

title: Terrunyo Block 27 Carmenere - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Produced by Concha y Toro under the guidance of visionary winemaker Ignacio Recabarren, Terrunyo (derived from the Spanish word terruño, meaning terroir) represents a watershed moment in South American viticulture. The Terrunyo line was created to isolate and highlight single vineyard blocks capable of expressing pure varietal character and world-class quality.

The Terrunyo Carmenère from Block 27 of the historic Peumo Vineyard is widely recognized as the benchmark expression of Carmenère globally. It was this specific plot in the Cachapoal Valley that proved Carmenère—long misidentified in Chile as Merlot—was not only distinct, but capable of producing profound, age-worthy wines that rival the finest Bordeaux varietals.

Wine Description

The Terrunyo Peumo Vineyard Carmenère pours a deep, opaque violet-plum color. On the nose, it offers an expressive and complex bouquet of ripe black plum, dark chocolate, sweet spice, and tobacco leaf, beautifully integrated with subtle savory green pepper, crushed graphite, and cedar notes.

On the palate, the wine is rich, plush, and voluptuously textured, yet kept impeccably balanced by vibrant acidity and fine-grained, velvety tannins. Flavors of blackberry jam, fig, and dark cherry fold into nuances of espresso, mocha, black pepper, and dried herbs.

Food Pairing

The luxurious texture and herbal-spicy complexity of this Carmenère make it a brilliant match for rich, savory, and spice-infused dishes. Excellent pairings include slow-braised short ribs, grilled lamb chops with rosemary, roasted duck breast, or Chilean empanadas de pino. It also handles roasted venison, pork tenderloin with a plum reduction, and dishes featuring caramelized onions, roasted bell peppers, or aged cheeses like Gouda and Manchego.

title: Orin Swift 8 Years In The Desert - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Orin Swift 8 Years In The Desert originates from California, United States, and is typically sourced from diverse vineyard sites across the state, including the North Coast and Napa County. The winery was founded in 1998 by Dave Phinney, who named the venture by combining his father's middle name, Orin, with his mother's maiden name, Swift. The brand is currently owned by E. & J. Gallo, though Phinney remains the creative force behind its innovative labels and winemaking philosophy. The name of this particular wine refers to the eight year period during which Phinney was legally barred from producing Zinfandel blends after selling his previous brand, The Prisoner.

Wine Description

This red blend presents a dark, nearly opaque crimson colour with an amethyst or purple rim. The sensory profile is intense and exuberant, opening with aromas of ripe blueberry, black plum, wild raspberry, and espresso bean, accented by notes of allspice, cedar, and sweet oak. On the full bodied palate, it is unctuous and concentrated, delivering flavours of blackberry jam, black plum preserves, and morning bun, alongside hints of dark chocolate and dried tarragon. The structure is defined by soft, textured tannins and a bright acidity that helps balance the wine's powerful fruit core.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically a blend of Zinfandel, Petite Sirah, and Syrah .
