  • Ageing: Matured for approximately seven to eight months in French oak, with roughly 32% to 35% new oak.

title: Campagnola Amarone della Valpolicella - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Veneto region, specifically within the Amarone della Valpolicella DOCG appellation in northeastern Italy, Campagnola Amarone della Valpolicella represents a rich, prestigious, and deeply concentrated expression of classic Italian winemaking. Produced by Giuseppe Campagnola, a historic family-owned winery established in 1886 and now managed by its fifth generation, the estate combines century-old traditions with modern ecological viticulture. Sourced from selected hillside vineyards situated on clay-limestone soils across the Valpolicella zone, the winemaking philosophy centers on the traditional appassimento method, where hand-harvested grapes undergo natural drying in wooden crates for up to four months to concentrate sugars, flavours, and extracts. Following a slow winter fermentation, the wine is aged for over two years in large Slavonian oak casks to develop exceptional complexity, structural richness, and cellaring power.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear dark ruby garnet colour with rich crimson and terracotta highlights along the rim. An intense, intoxicating bouquet opens with opulent aromas of dried cherry, raisin, and dark plum jam, interwoven with sophisticated notes of dark chocolate, sweet tobacco, espresso bean, dried violet, and toasted cinnamon oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, velvety, and expansive, delivering luxurious layers of sweet dark berries, fig, and cocoa powder, all supported by a firm, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by smooth, fine-grained tannins and a rich, warming mid-palate, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering notes of dried fruit, licorice, and savory earthiness. Composed of a traditional blend of Corvina, Corvinone, and Rondinella, it combines the iconic power and dried-fruit richness of Amarone with refined balance and timeless elegance.

title: Gray Monk Latitude 50 Red - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada in the British Columbia region, specifically within the Okanagan Valley appellation, Gray Monk Latitude 50 Red 2022 represents a iconic, approachable, and fruit-forward West Coast red blend. Produced by Gray Monk Estate Winery, one of the Okanagan Valley's pioneering estates founded in 1972 by George and Trudy Heiss, the winery is celebrated for creating some of British Columbia's most popular and enduring wines. Sourced from sun-drenched vineyard plots situated along the 50th parallel overlooking Okanagan Lake, the winemaking philosophy focuses on sustainable viticulture, gentle destemming, and temperature-controlled stainless steel tank fermentation with modest oak contact to highlight pure red fruit aromatics, smooth tannins, and easy-drinking balance.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, vibrant ruby red colour with soft violet reflections in the glass. An inviting, fruity bouquet opens with generous aromas of fresh red cherry, ripe raspberry, and dark plum, interwoven with subtle notes of sweet vanilla, dried herbs, and gentle oak spice. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, smooth, and rounded, delivering refreshing flavours of juicy red berries, sour cherry, and subtle spice supported by a vibrant, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by soft, supple tannins and an easygoing mid-palate, it concludes with a clean, fruit-driven finish marked by lingering berry notes. Composed of a proprietary blend of classic red varieties including Baco Noir, Gamay Noir, and Merlot, it offers an exceptionally versatile, food-friendly, and crowd-pleasing Okanagan red wine profile designed for immediate enjoyment.

title: Gato Negro Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Chile in the Central Valley region, Gato Negro Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot represents a classic, approachable, and fruit-forward South American red blend. Crafted by San Pedro, one of Chile's most historic and renowned wineries established in 1865, the Gato Negro line is celebrated globally for its consistent quality and easy-drinking style. Sourced from well-situated vineyards across the sun-drenched plains of the Central Valley, the winemaking philosophy focuses on sustainable viticulture, temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation, and gentle extraction to highlight the natural fruit characteristics of both grape varieties without overpowering oak influence, producing a smooth, balanced everyday red wine.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear ruby red colour with soft violet highlights near the edge of the glass. An inviting, fragrant bouquet opens with ripe aromas of black currant, dark plum, and juicy cherry, interwoven with subtle notes of sweet spice, dried herbs, and a touch of roasted coffee bean. On the palate, it is medium bodied, smooth, and rounded, delivering generous flavours of dark berries, red plum, and cocoa, all supported by a gentle, well-integrated core of natural acidity. Framed by soft, supple tannins and an easygoing mid-palate, it finishes clean and smooth with lingering fruit notes. Composed of a balanced blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, it offers a harmonious, versatile, and crowd-pleasing red wine profile designed for immediate enjoyment.

title: Lamarca Prosecco - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the Prosecco DOC appellation, Lamarca Prosecco represents a quintessential, sparkling, and refreshing expression of Italian Glera. Produced by La Marca Trevigiana, a highly respected cooperative of growers in northeastern Italy founded in 1968, the brand has become a global standard for premium Prosecco. Sourced from sun-drenched vineyards across the rolling hills of Treviso, the winemaking philosophy focuses on gentle pressing of the grapes followed by a controlled secondary fermentation in stainless steel pressure tanks using the Charmat method. This process preserves the grape's delicate aromatic compounds, bright fruit acidity, and vibrant natural effervescence, creating a clean, crisp, and refreshing sparkling wine suitable for any celebration.

Wine Description

The wine presents a pale straw yellow colour with delicate greenish reflections and a fine, persistent stream of lively bubbles. An inviting, highly aromatic bouquet opens with fresh notes of green apple, white peach, and juicy Meyer lemon, interwoven with delicate nuances of white flowers, honey, and subtle citrus blossom. On the palate, it is light bodied, crisp, and lively, delivering refreshing flavours of crisp orchard fruit and lemon zest supported by a vibrant, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Finishing clean, dry, and invigorating, it leaves a pleasant, lingering impression of sweet apple and subtle mineral freshness. Composed predominantly of Glera, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2028. Stylistically, it offers an exceptionally versatile, food-friendly, and uplifting sparkling wine profile with broad global appeal.

title: Black Tower Riesling - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Black Tower is Germany's most widely exported branded wine. With its fresh appealing style it meets the needs of today's ever more discerning consumer. A combination of selected grapes from prime wine-growing areas and careful vinification ensure Black Tower wines are always enjoyable. Riesling is Germany's most well known grape variety all over the world. Its exotic fruit flavours and crisp acidity is unprecedented within the wine world.

title: Frontera Sauvignon Blanc 1.5 Litre Bottle - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Bright, greenish yellow in color, the Frontera Sauvignon Blanc shows true varietal character with notes of peaches and fresh citrus. On the palate, the wine is light and fresh with a balanced palate and an attractive, crisp acidity.

title: Frontera Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Deep ruby colour. Light cassis, plum, cherry, currant, raspberry, chocolate, earth and mint aroma. Dry, medium-bodied, with good berry flavour, through to a pleasant fruity finish.

title: Moet & Chandon Brut Imperial - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Moët Impérial is the House’s iconic champagne. Created in 1869, it embodies Moët & Chandon’s unique style, a style distinguished by its bright fruitiness, its seductive palate and its elegant maturity.

Golden straw yellow with green highlights. A sparkling bouquet. The vibrant intensity of green apple and citrus fruit. The freshness of mineral nuances and white flowers.

title: Beringer Moscato Main & Vine - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California, Beringer Moscato Main & Vine represents an approachable, sweet, and highly aromatic expression of everyday white winemaking. Produced by Beringer Vineyards, Napa Valley's oldest continuously operating winery founded in 1876 by brothers Jacob and Frederick Beringer, the Main & Vine collection is crafted to celebrate accessible, fruit-forward wines for casual occasions. Sourced from sun-drenched vineyards across California's prime growing regions, the winemaking philosophy focuses on early harvesting to preserve natural acidity, gentle pressing, and slow, cool-temperature stainless steel tank fermentation. Fermentation is arrested early to maintain natural grape sugars, resulting in a low-alcohol, deliciously sweet, and fruit-driven profile.

Wine Description

The wine presents a pale straw yellow colour with bright platinum highlights in the glass. An inviting and sweet bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of juicy white peach, ripe honeydew melon, and candied apricot, interwoven with delicate notes of orange blossom, honeysuckle, and fresh citrus zest. On the palate, it is light bodied, smooth, and pleasantly sweet, delivering generous flavours of sweet nectarine, yellow plum, and tropical fruit balanced by a subtle, refreshing streak of natural acidity. Finishing clean, smooth, and aromatic, it leaves a lingering, delicious impression of sweet orchard fruit and honeyed floral blossom. Composed of 100% Muscat, it offers an effortless, sweet, and crowd-pleasing white wine profile with broad everyday appeal.

title: Bottega Il Vino Dei Poeti Prosecco 200 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the Prosecco DOC appellation, Bottega Il Vino Dei Poeti Prosecco represents a classic, refined expression of northern Italian sparkling winemaking. Produced by Bottega SpA, a family-owned winery established by Aldo Bottega in 1977 and situated in Bibano di Godega, this cuvée pays tribute to the historic hills of Treviso, long celebrated as a haven for poets and artists. The winemaking philosophy focuses on sustainable viticulture, gentle pressing of estate and contract fruit, and cool-temperature soft pressing, followed by secondary fermentation in pressurized stainless steel tanks using the Italian Martinotti-Charmat method to preserve delicate floral aromatics and vibrant freshness.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, pale straw yellow colour with luminous greenish highlights and a fine, persistent perlage in the glass. An expressive and delicate bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of golden apple, juicy white peach, and Bartlett pear, interwoven with subtle notes of acacia flower, lily of the valley, and fresh citrus zest. On the palate, it is light-bodied, soft, and refreshingly effervescent, delivering crisp flavours of green apple, yellow plum, and lemon curd, all supported by a balanced, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Finishing clean, dry, and elegantly creamy, it leaves a pleasant impression of fresh orchard fruit and delicate floral blossom. Composed of 100% Glera, it effortlessly combines fragrant alpine-mediterranean aromatics with a bright, lively, and versatile sparkling profile.

title: Copper Moon Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada, produced by the major Canadian wine producer Andrew Peller Limited, Copper Moon Cabernet Sauvignon represents an approachable, smooth, and fruit-forward expression of everyday red winemaking. Sourced from a blend of domestic and international grapes cellared in Canada, the Copper Moon brand is designed to deliver accessible, crowd-pleasing wines for casual occasions. The winemaking philosophy focuses on soft pressing, temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation, and gentle oak contact to showcase bright varietal fruit sweetness, soft tannins, and easy-drinking charm.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear ruby red colour with garnet highlights in the glass. An inviting and fruit-driven bouquet opens with aromas of ripe cassis, dark plum, and black cherry, interwoven with subtle notes of cedar wood, sweet vanilla, and gentle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, smooth, and supple, delivering generous flavours of dark berries, blackcurrant, and subtle cocoa supported by a balanced streak of fresh natural acidity. Framed by soft, rounded tannins and a clean texture, it concludes with a warm, velvety finish marked by lingering notes of dark fruit and soft baking spice.

title: Copper Moon Shiraz - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada, produced by the major Canadian wine producer Andrew Peller Limited, Copper Moon Shiraz represents an approachable, smooth, and fruit-forward expression of everyday red winemaking. Sourced from a blend of domestic and international grapes cellared in Canada, the Copper Moon brand is designed to deliver accessible, crowd-pleasing wines for casual occasions. The winemaking philosophy focuses on soft pressing, temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation, and gentle oak contact to showcase bright varietal fruit sweetness, soft tannins, and easy-drinking charm.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, deep ruby purple colour with dark garnet highlights in the glass. An inviting and fruit-driven bouquet opens with aromas of ripe blackberry, wild plum, and dark cherry, interwoven with characteristic notes of black pepper, subtle cocoa, and gentle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, smooth, and supple, delivering generous flavours of dark berries, ripe plum, and subtle sweet spice supported by a balanced streak of fresh natural acidity. Framed by soft, rounded tannins and a clean texture, it concludes with a warm, velvety finish marked by lingering notes of dark fruit and soft baking spice.

title: La Fiole 'Maison Brotte' Discovery Bundled by ZYN
bodyHtml:
Embark on a sensory journey through Southern France with the La Fiole 'Maison Brotte' Discovery Bundle.

Featuring the iconic twisted bottles that pay homage to the gnarly vines of the Rhône Valley, this curated 4-pack delivers one bottle of each signature style:

  • 1x La Fiole du Pape Châteauneuf-du-Pape: The crown jewel—a rich, complex red featuring dark berry fruit, garrigue spice, and a smooth, velvety finish.

  • 1x La Fiole Côtés du Rhône: A versatile, approachable red blend brimming with ripe red fruit and subtle pepper accents.

  • 1x La Fiole Viognier Pays d’Oc: An aromatic white offering expressive notes of fresh peach, apricot, and delicate floral highlights.

  • 1x La Fiole 'Père Anselme' Côtés du Rhône Rosé: A crisp, bright rosé packed with fresh strawberry, red berry, and citrus notes.

title: Yellow Tail Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: A blend of selected parcels of fruit from some of Australia's best growing areas, this wine reveals citrus and honeydew flavours nuanced by subtle oak aromas. The palate is soft yet fresh, with balanced acidity and a smooth, creamy finish. A great party wine!

title: Montes Chardonnay Alpha - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: The intense, complex nose offers tropical fruit aromas such as pineapple, banana, and ripe mango, while pleasing notes of peaches and pears round out the fruity profile. The coastal climate is very much present in the subtle notes of grapefruit and white asparagus. Smooth attack on the palate with perfectly balanced acidity, resulting in a very fresh wine that also has generous volume. This Alpha Chardonnay ends with a long and elegant finish that invites another glass.

title: Montes Syrah Alpha - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Montes Alpha Syrah originates from Chile, specifically from the Apalta and Marchigüe zones of the Colchagua Valley within the larger Rapel Valley region. Founded in 1988 by Aurelio Montes and Douglas Murray, Viña Montes was a pioneer in Chilean viticulture, famously introducing the Syrah variety to the country in 1993. The winery's philosophy emphasizes high quality through precision viticulture, such as the Water Saving Winegrowing system which reduces irrigation by 65% while concentrating fruit quality.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep ruby-red to violet colour in the glass. The sensory profile is intense and expressive, featuring a nose of ripe blackberries, figs, and crème de cassis, layered with notes of leather, dark chocolate, and subtle hints of graphite or black pepper. On the full-bodied palate, it is well-balanced and smooth, delivering flavours of dark cherries and plums complemented by sweet oak-driven aromas of vanilla, cinnamon, and dulce de leche. The finish is long, complex, and elegant, characterized by silky, fine-grained tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically a blend of 90% Syrah, 7% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 3% Viognier.

  • ABV: Generally ranges between 13.8% and 14.5% depending on the vintage.

  • Ageing: Approximately 55% of the wine is aged for 12 months in first-, second-, and third-use French oak barrels.

  • Organic Status: While not typically certified organic, the winery is a B Corporation member and utilizes sustainable water management practices.

title: Jackson Triggs Pinot Grigio Proprietor's Reserve - 1.5 Litre  - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada in the famous Niagara Peninsula region of Ontario, Jackson Triggs Sauvignon Blanc represents a crisp, vibrant expression of cool-climate white winemaking. Founded in 1993 by Allan Jackson and Don Triggs, Jackson Triggs is one of Canada's most celebrated and recognizable winery brands. Sourced from estate vineyards and partner grower sites across Ontario, the winery's philosophy focuses on capturing maximum aromatic freshness, bright acidity, and pure varietal character through cool stainless steel fermentation without oak intervention.

Wine Description

The wine presents a pale straw colour with clear, greenish reflections in the glass. An inviting and intensely aromatic bouquet opens with fresh aromas of pink grapefruit, passion fruit, and lime zest, interwoven with herbal nuances of lemongrass, fresh cut grass, and green pepper. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, zesty, and refreshing, delivering vibrant flavours of citrus fruit, green apple, and subtle tropical guava, all driven by a lively, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Finishing clean and crisp, it leaves a lingering impression of citrus and subtle flinty minerality. Composed of 100% Sauvignon Blanc, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2028. Stylistically, it combines Niagara cool-climate brightness and zesty citrus aromatics with effortless, food-friendly freshness.

title: Gato Negro Cabernet Sauvignon - 1.5 Litre - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the fertile sun-drenched valleys of Chile, Gato Negro is one of the most recognized and successful Chilean wine brands in the world. Produced by Viña San Pedro, a winery with a history dating back to 1865, the label was officially born in 1960. The brand’s name Spanish for "black cat"—is a tribute to a mysterious feline companion that purportedly accompanied the first winemaker during the development of his early blends, acting as a "lucky charm" for the estate. Today, Gato Negro is an international bestseller, present in over 80 countries, and is celebrated for its approachable, fruit-forward philosophy that emphasizes "meow-nificent" flavors and incredible value for money.

Wine Description

Gato Negro Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep, intense ruby-red color. The nose is highly aromatic and punchy, bursting with primary fruit notes of red berries, ripe cherries, and cassis, subtly complemented by hints of sweet vanilla, chocolate, and a touch of coconut. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and remarkably smooth, showcasing a fresh sensation with a silky mouthfeel. It is characterized by its soft, fine-grained tannins and a well-balanced structure that leads to a long, pleasing finish with a gentle savory edge.

title: Masi Modello della Venezie Rosso - 3 Litre Box - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: The Modello is a medium-bodied red made from Refosco and Raboso, two intriguing local varietals. Fresh aromas of liquorice and fruity blackberries and raspberries. Similar, well-balanced flavours are supported by lively acidity in this easy-to-drink wine. This versatile wine pairs with various dishes such as soups, pasta, and risottos, as well as simple and substantial red-meat dishes or fresh cheeses.

title: Bask Pinot Grigio - 3 Litre Box - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
BASK Pinot Grigio originates from Canada, with production spanning key regions in Ontario and British Columbia. The brand was developed with a modern winemaking philosophy focused on lifestyle and wellness, specifically crafting 'low sugar' wines that allow consumers to enjoy a full-flavoured experience with zero grams of sugar per serving. This focus on transparency and 'guilt free' enjoyment has made it a popular choice for those seeking a lighter, contemporary alternative to traditional varietals.

Wine Description

This Pinot Grigio presents as a bright and clear white wine, often showing pale straw hues in the glass. The sensory profile is led by fresh, vibrant aromas of green pear and lime zest. On the palate, the wine is light bodied and brisk, featuring consistent flavours of crisp pear, citrus, and hints of fresh green apple. It is stylistically dry and balanced, offering a clean, polished finish with a refreshing acidity that cleanses the palate. Made from 100% Pinot Grigio grapes, this wine is best enjoyed fresh and chilled; the 3 litre box format is designed for convenience, keeping the wine fresh for several weeks after opening.

title: Franzia Rose White Zinfandel - 3 Litre Box - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: A crisp and refreshing blush wine with delicate strawberry aromas. Serve chilled. Complements cheeses, salads and simple pasta.

title: Franzia Chillable Red (NV) - 3 Litre Box - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: A light-bodied red that is made to be served chilled. More body and flavour than blush wine, softer than traditional red wines. Pairs well with lighter foods.

title: Franzia Crisp White - 3 Litre Box - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: A medium-bodied white wine with floral aromas and fruit flavours. Enjoy with fresh vegetables and light pasta plates.

title: Garzon Tannat Single Vineyard - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Uruguay, this exceptional Tannat comes from the Garzón region in Maldonado, situated just a few kilometres from the Atlantic coast. Bodega Garzón, owned by Argentine businessman Alejandro Bulgheroni, is celebrated for pioneering sustainable viticulture in Uruguay, with its impressive hillside vineyards and state-of-the-art, LEED-certified winery. The estate is a beacon for precision viticulture, producing expressive wines that reflect the unique coastal terroir.

Wine Description

This single-vineyard Tannat showcases a deep ruby colour with vibrant purple hues. The nose offers an alluring bouquet of blackberries, plums, and violets, underpinned by subtle notes of graphite, spice, and freshly ground coffee. On the palate, it is full-bodied yet remarkably refined, with layers of dark fruit, liquorice, and mineral nuances wrapped in polished tannins. The wine carries impressive structure and balance, culminating in a long, savoury finish with echoes of dark chocolate and crushed stones.

Food Pairing

Pair this robust Tannat with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, or aged Manchego cheese. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character, creating a memorable dining experience.

title: Garzon Single Vineyard Albarino - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This exceptional white wine originates from the Maldonado region of Uruguay, situated just 11 miles from the Atlantic Ocean. Bodega Garzón is a pioneer in South American viticulture, led by the renowned Italian consultant winemaker Alberto Antonini, whose philosophy focuses on minimalist intervention and pure terroir expression. The "Single Vineyard" series is a step above their Reserva line, sourced from specific south-facing blocks with rocky, granite-rich soils that impart a signature salinity to the wine.

Wine Description

The Garzón Single Vineyard Albariño presents an elegant pale yellow colour with greenish reflections. The sensory profile is vibrant and precise, featuring an intense nose of mango, pineapple, and stone fruits (yellow plum), layered with sophisticated notes of citrus zest and white floral blossoms. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "round," showcasing a juicy acidity and a distinct saline minerality that reflects its coastal origin. It is characterized by its purity and "glassy" texture, leading to a long, refreshing finish with hints of ripe apricot and sea salt. This 100% Albariño has an ABV of 14% and was fermented and aged for 8 months in 80-hectoliter cement tanks to preserve its aromatic integrity and enhance mouthfeel without the influence of oak.

title: Rust En Vrede Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Rust en Vrede, founded in 1694, is proud to be a part of a three-hundred-year-old wine tradition. The Engelbrecht family has focused on the production of red wine exclusively since 1977, with an emphasis on Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Merlot. Rust en Vrede has worked hard to establish itself as one of South Africa's premier red wine estates, producing full-bodied, nuanced wines that represent the terroir's individuality.

Opaque in colour with prominent aromas of cassis, blackberry, bramble and mulberry. The dark fruit is layered with savoury notes of cured meat and dried herbs. Rich fruit follows on the palate, sustained by fresh acidity and fine, mouth-coating tannins. Flavours of sandalwood, allspice, worn leather and pencil shavings add complexity and depth to this classically styled Stellenbosch Cabernet Sauvignon.

title: Chateau Perron Lalande de Pomerol - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Rich, powerful and many-layered nose of red fruits, dark spice, fresh oak and cocoa. Supple, velvety palate with fine, crisply elegant tannins. Fresh lingering finish with menthol flavours. A charming, easy-to-drink wine which will go down well with any fine food.

title: Protea Dry Rose - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Protea Dry Rose originates from the Western Cape of South Africa, specifically sourced from vineyards in the Swartland and Franschhoek Valley. Originally owned by the late Anthonij Rupert, the estate was taken over by his brother Johann Rupert in 2003, who constructed a state of the art facility that modernized their production. The winery is committed to sustainability and the conservation of its terroir, producing the Protea range as a tribute to South Africa's national flower and the unique floral diversity of the region.

Wine Description

This elegant rose presents a pale pink to subtle blush hue in the glass. The bouquet is impressively fruity, offering vibrant aromas of strawberry, raspberry, and peach, complemented by nuances of apple blossom and grapefruit pith. On the palate, the wine is juicy and fresh, displaying flavors of ripe berries, citrus peel, and a hint of Turkish Delight. It is medium bodied with a creamy texture and a lively acidity that leads into a clean, spiced finish with notes of orange peel and pink peppercorns.

Food Pairing

This dry rose is an excellent accompaniment to seafood dishes such as braised salmon, white fish, or grilled shrimp with lemon. It also pairs beautifully with soft cheeses like Brie or Camembert and light summer salads.

title: Pauillac de Latour - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Bordeaux region, specifically within the Pauillac appellation on the Left Bank, Pauillac de Latour represents a refined, aristocratic, and highly accessible expression of the esteemed Château Latour terroir. First introduced in 1989, Pauillac de Latour serves as the third wine of First Growth legend Château Latour, crafted primarily from younger estate vines and parcels surrounding the historic Enclos vineyard. Sourced from deep gravel beds over clay subsoils overlooking the Gironde estuary, the vines benefit from ideal drainage and maritime microclimates. The winemaking philosophy under estate director Hélène Génin mirrors the rigorous standards of the Grand Vin, involving plot-by-plot manual harvesting, strict double sorting, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats, and maturation in French oak barriques (approximately 20% new) for 12 to 14 months. The result is a third wine that embodies classic Pauillac noble structure and cassis intensity with immediate charm.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark garnet red colour with bright ruby reflections along the rim. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe black currant, dark plum, wild blackberry, and black cherry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of pencil shavings, graphite, cedar box, cigar wrapper, crushed violets, and subtle toasted French oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, structured, and focused, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berry fruit jam, cassis curd, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine, chalky, fine-grained tannins and a driving mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruits, dried herbs, and a signature Pauillac graphite grip. Composed of 56.6% Cabernet Sauvignon, 37.8% Merlot, and 5.6% Petit Verdot, it effortlessly combines Left Bank Cabernet gravel power and precision with supple mid-palate fruit and approachable elegance.

title: Michael David Freakshow Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in the California region, specifically within the Lodi AVA appellation, Michael David Freakshow Chardonnay represents a fun-loving, opulent, and fruit forward expression of California white winemaking. Produced by the historic Michael David Winery, owned and operated by the Phillips family since six generations of farming in Lodi, the 'Freakshow' range is celebrated globally for its bold, eye-catching circus themed labels and crowd-pleasing, accessible style. Sourced from sustainably farmed estate and contract vineyards across the Lodi appellation, the grapes benefit from warm Mediterranean days balanced by cool evening breezes arriving from the Sacramento River Delta. The winemaking philosophy under winemakers Adam Mettler and Derek Devries involves temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats combined with partial oak barrel maturation to strike a balance between bright varietal acidity and rich, creamy complexity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous golden straw colour with bright yellow reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly fragrant bouquet opens with alluring aromas of ripe nectarine, yellow apple, juicy mango, and honeydew melon, interwoven with pleasant notes of butterscotch, honey, toasted almonds, lemon curd, and warm baking spices. On the palate, it is full bodied, luscious, and smooth, delivering mouthwatering flavours of cantaloupe, ripe stone fruit, and tropical curd, all supported by a crisp spine of natural acidity. Framed by a rich, satiny texture derived from controlled lees contact and subtle oak integration, it concludes with a refreshing, long finish marked by lingering citrus zest, sweet vanilla, and a clean mineral lift. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2024–2028. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Lodi's sun-drenched fruit generosity and approachable creaminess with a lively, balanced finish.

title: Michael David Freakshow Red - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Known for taking the road less travelled, Michael David Winery has always stood apart from the crowd. Whether it be their outlandish brands and packaging or their quirky personalities, Michael and David are definitely on a stage of their own and this wine showcases just that. The fruit for this wine comes from the original “super freak” himself, Michael Phillips’ vineyard located only a medicine ball toss away from the winery.  

Step right up for an experience like no other, the amazing brawn and finesse of the Strongest Man on Earth! The first star in their Freakshow series, this Cabernet Sauvignon opens the show with black cherry, strawberry and toasted hazelnut aromas. He is larger-than-life, medium in body and showcases flavours of plum, chocolate truffle and butterscotch with an oak-inspired finish that will surely have you coming back for the second act.

title: Protea Merlot - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The Protea Merlot originates from the Western Cape region of South Africa. This range is produced by the prestigious Anthonij Rupert Wyne, an estate committed to the spirit of sustainability and the conservation of its terroir. The winery prioritizes high-quality winemaking while ensuring environmental impact is reduced through upcycling initiatives, such as their distinctive, reusable bottle patterns.

Wine Description

This wine presents a vibrant sensory profile with deep aromas of black cherry, plum, and subtle hints of dark chocolate and tomato plant. On the palate, it is soft and succulent, featuring flavors of mulberry, Agen prune, and light spice highlights like cinnamon and nutmeg. It is a medium-bodied wine with a velvety smooth texture, well-integrated tannins, and a rewarding finish that displays notes of cocoa and earth.

title: Protea Chenin Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Aromas of fresh apricot and nectarine mingle with ripe quince notes. Juicy and bright, the palate offers up succulent nectarine, melon and vibrant lemon. Approachable, light and succulent, there is great harmony between the fruit and acidity. The appeal continues with satisfying length and gentle pear drop nuance on the finish.

title: Protea Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The Protea Cabernet Sauvignon is a vibrant red wine from the Western Cape of South Africa, with grapes primarily sourced from the Groenekloof ward in the Darling region. Produced by Anthonij Rupert Wyne, the estate was originally owned by the late Anthonij Rupert before being taken over by his brother, Johann Rupert, in 2003. The winery is dedicated to combining high-quality viticulture with a philosophy of sustainability and conservation, often highlighted by their iconic floral-inspired packaging.

Wine Description

This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep ruby colour with youthful purple highlights. On the nose, it offers inviting aromas of blackcurrant, ripe plum, and blackberry, layered with complex notes of dark cocoa, tobacco leaf, and subtle spice. The palate is medium to full-bodied and supple, featuring juicy dark fruit flavours of cherry and cassis complemented by nuances of cedar and graphite. It is well-integrated with a firm backbone and fine tannins that lead to a long, harmonious finish.

Food Pairing

This wine's robust structure and dark fruit profile make it an excellent companion for grilled red meats, such as beef steak, lamb chops, or burgers. It also pairs exceptionally well with hearty comfort foods like beef lasagne or aged cheddar cheese.

title: Protea Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Protea Chardonnay is a vibrant and accessible white wine produced by Anthonij Rupert Wyne in the Western Cape of South Africa.

The Protea range is named after South Africa's national flower and is celebrated for its distinctive bespoke bottle patterns, designed to be upcycled and repurposed as decorative pieces or water carafes. The winery follows a philosophy of sustainability and accessibility, sourcing fruit from diverse regions such as Robertson, Paarl, Wellington, and Swartland to ensure a consistent, fruit-forward style that reflects the natural character of the Cape.

Wine Description

The 2025 vintage is characterized by its youthful energy and "perky" refreshment. It presents a bright pale straw color with subtle green tints. On the nose, it offers inviting aromas of orange blossom and citrus, accompanied by crisp green apple, ripe pear, and a light touch of white peach and melon. The palate is light-to-medium-bodied and vivacious, featuring a "juicy tang" of orange and nectarine flavors balanced by a lively acidity. It is noted for its clean, modern style that prioritizes fruit purity and drinkability over heavy oak influence.

The wine is 100% Chardonnay and typically features an ABV of 13%. The 2025 vintage benefited from favorable climatic conditions and good rainfall during the growing season, leading to a spread-out ripening period and healthy fruit with clear varietal expression.

title: Faiveley Bourgogne Pinot  - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Domaine Faiveley, established in 1825, is a family-owned winery located in the heart of Burgundy, France. Now in its seventh generation under the leadership of Erwan and Eve Faiveley, the domaine has grown to become one of the largest vineyard owners in Burgundy, with holdings spanning from the Côte de Nuits to the Côte Chalonnaise. Their commitment to sustainable viticulture and respect for terroir is evident in their wines, which are celebrated for their elegance and depth.

Wine Description

Faiveley Bourgogne Pinot Noir displays a beautiful ruby color. On the nose, it offers pleasant, fresh red-fruit aromas, notably cherry and raspberry, complemented by subtle earthy notes. The palate mirrors these red-fruit flavors, presenting a rich and ripe substance with fine, round tannins.

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir pairs wonderfully with a variety of dishes, including:

  • Roasted poultry, such as duck or chicken, which highlights the wine's red-fruit character.

  • Grilled salmon or tuna, where the wine's acidity complements the richness of the fish.

  • Mushroom risotto, enhancing the earthy nuances in both the dish and the wine.

title: Joseph Drouhin Chardonnay Bourgogne - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the regional Bourgogne Blanc appellation, Joseph Drouhin Chardonnay Bourgogne represents a classic, pure, and elegant expression of Burgundian Chardonnay. Established in 1880, Maison Joseph Drouhin is one of Burgundy's most revered historic houses, currently managed by the fourth generation of the Drouhin family and globally acclaimed for its commitment to organic and biodynamic viticulture. Sourced from choice estate parcels and long-standing partner vineyards situated across the Côte de Beaune, Côte Chalonnaise, and the Auxerrois, the vines sit on classic limestone and clay soils. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes gentle whole-cluster pressing, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats and neutral oak barrels, and aging on fine lees for 7 to 8 months to preserve pristine varietal fruit aromatics, crisp minerality, and authentic Burgundian terroir precision.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale straw yellow colour with bright greenish reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with delicate aromas of fresh green apple, ripe Williams pear, white peach, and lemon curd, interwoven with subtle notes of white acacia flowers, fresh hazelnut, crushed limestone, and a hint of warm brioche. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, crisp, and refreshing, delivering generous flavours of citrus zest, white orchard fruit, and mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by a smooth, satiny texture derived from gentle lees contact and a balanced mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon peel, subtle nuttiness, and a fresh mineral lift. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, it combines Burgundian elegance and freshness with effortless drinkability and charm.

title: Petit Vega '8 Meses En Barrica' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from Spain, within the prestigious Ribera del Duero D.O. appellation situated on the elevated high-altitude plateau (Meseta Norte) of Castile and León. Produced under the Petit Vega label by Bodegas y Viñedos Vega de Yuso, this cuvée offers a vibrant, fruit-forward, yet beautifully structured expression of modern Ribera del Duero winemaking. Sourced from estate vineyards in Quintanilla de Onésimo and surrounding valleys at altitudes ranging between 750 and 850 meters above sea level, the vines are rooted in limestone-rich clay and gravelly alluvial soils. The region’s harsh continental climate defined by blistering summer days and dramatically cool nights (diurnal shift) allows the grapes to achieve optimal phenolic maturity while locking in a bright, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Petit Vega '8 Meses en Barrica' presents a brilliant, deep ruby-purple color in the glass with vivid magenta highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and expressive, delivering a fruit-driven yet structured portrait of high-altitude Tempranillo. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of ripe wild blackberries, fresh red plums, and black cherries, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of vanilla bean, cocoa powder, sweet tobacco, ground spice, and a subtle touch of toasted oak wood. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of dark stone fruits, licorice, and red berry compote. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessy lifts the mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is energetic, smooth, and supple, framed by fine-grained, approachable tannins that carry into a clean, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of dark berry skin and toasted oak spice.

title: Pascal Jolivet Sauvignon Blanc 'Attitude' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Pascal Jolivet is one of the most respected names in the Loire Valley, celebrated for his dedication to natural winemaking and precise expression of terroir. Founded in 1987, his domaine focuses on producing pure, elegant wines that showcase the character of Sauvignon Blanc. The ‘Attitude’ range reflects Jolivet’s philosophy of minimal intervention and precision viticulture, emphasizing freshness and balance.

title: Domaine Drouhin Pinot Noir 'Laurene' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Domaine Drouhin Oregon, established in 1987 by the Drouhin family of Burgundy, France, is situated in the Dundee Hills of Oregon's Willamette Valley. The estate is renowned for its commitment to sustainable viticulture and crafting wines that reflect the unique and distinguished terroir of the region.

The Pinot Noir Laurène is the pinnacle of the estate's selection, a cuvée named after Véronique Drouhin's daughter. It represents the finest expression of the estate's barrels.

Wine Description

This signature Pinot Noir consistently showcases a beautiful medium color, offering an expressive aromatic profile of red and dark berries (like cherry and raspberry), complemented by complex notes of dried rose petals, wild herbs, and subtle baking spices derived from meticulous oak aging.

On the palate, it is always medium-bodied and graceful, delivering layers of concentrated fruit, refined acidity, and a silky texture. The Laurène is celebrated for its exceptional richness, complexity, and structural elegance, making it a wine that is both immediately approachable and built for long-term cellaring.

title: Josh Cellars Sauvignon Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: The Josh Cellars Sauvignon Blanc presents a luminous, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with bright chartreuse and silver reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and fruit-driven, delivering an energetic, crisp, and vibrant portrait of California Sauvignon Blanc. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of bright lemon zest, green apple, and juicy white peach, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of pink grapefruit, lemongrass, passionfruit, and a clean line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard fruit, lemon curd, and melon. It is characterized by its balanced energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly across the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is broad, supple, and weightless, carrying into a clean, dry, and refreshing finish accented by persistent notes of citrus peel and green apple.

title: Saint Cosme Blanc 'Les Deux Albion' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the southern Rhône Valley region, specifically within the Principauté d'Orange IGP and surrounding Côtes du Rhône terroirs, Saint Cosme 'Les Deux Albions' Blanc represents an aromatic, textured, and deeply mineral white Rhône cuvée. Crafted by Louis Barruol at Château de Saint Cosme—an historic estate with winemaking roots dating back to Roman times in 1410—this white bottling extends the legacy of the acclaimed 'Les Deux Albions' range. Sourced from high-elevation, cool-climate vineyards planted on limestone, clay, and gravelly alluvial soils, the winemaking philosophy utilizes direct whole-cluster pressing, natural yeast fermentation in wooden vats, and aging on fine lees without oak over-extraction. The result is a vibrant, gastronomy-minded white wine characterized by stone-fruit purity, floral complexity, and fine limestone tension.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale straw yellow colour with bright greenish-gold reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with seductive aromas of fresh white peach, ripe apricot, green apple, and melon, interwoven with elegant notes of white jasmine blossom, honeysuckle, crushed limestone, wild fennel, and toasted almond. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, satiny, and rounded, delivering generous flavours of orchard fruit, lemon curd, and white nectarine, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a rich, coat-the-mouth texture derived from fine lees contact and a driving mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus peel, savory herbs, and a clean mineral grip. Composed of a classic white Rhône blend featuring Viognier, Picpoul, Marsanne, Roussanne, and Clairette, it combines southern Rhône warmth and aromatic richness with crisp, refreshing balance and precision.

title: Saint Cosme 'Les Deux Albion' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the southern Rhône Valley region, specifically within the Côtes du Rhône Gigondas zone, Saint Cosme 'Les Deux Albions' represents a historic, benchmark expression of southern Rhône Syrah and Grenache. Crafted by Louis Barruol at Château de Saint Cosme—an estate with winemaking roots dating back to Roman times in 1410—'Les Deux Albions' takes its name from two historic family estates merged by the Barruol family. Sourced from high-elevation vineyards in Gigondas and surrounding terroirs planted on limestone, clay, and stony alluvial soils, the winemaking philosophy utilizes whole-cluster fermentation with native yeasts in concrete vats, followed by aging in concrete vats and wooden casks without heavy oak interference. The result is a deeply expressive, authentic wine characterized by dark fruit density, savory Mediterranean garrigue, and fine limestone structure.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense purple-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with opulent aromas of ripe dark plum, black cherry, wild blackberry, and cassis, interwoven with seductive notes of black pepper, crushed violet, tapenade, dried lavender, liquorice, and roasted coffee bean. On the palate, it is full bodied, dense, and mouth-filling, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, red fruit jam, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained limestone tannins and a deep mid-palate structure, it concludes with a remarkably long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, wild herbs, and a chalky mineral grip. Composed primarily of Syrah blended with Grenache, Carignan, Mourvèdre, and Clairette, it combines Gigondas-level structure and density with pure southern Rhône generosity and charm.

title: Clarendelle Bordeaux Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Clarendelle Bordeaux Blanc is a clear and brilliant pale-yellow color. On the nose, there is a complex array of aromas dominated by floral notes of hawthorn, lime blossom and honeysuckle. Tropical fruit and citrus flavors come to the fore on the palate. Notes of lemon, pineapple and grapefruit emerge, mingled with nuances of fleshy fruit such as pear and lychee. Very delicious, round and opulent, with wonderful minerality. The incredibly long aftertaste showcases the complexity of this wine, with ripe fruit flavors balanced out by a lovely vivaciousness. All in all, this Clarendelle Bordeaux Blanc is a gourmet, refined wine with a great deal of tension and elegance.

title: Domaine Gautheron Chablis Vieilles Vignes - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Chablis appellation in the Yonne district, Domaine Gautheron Chablis 'Vieilles Vignes' represents an authentic, pristine, and mineral driven expression of old-vine Chardonnay. Family owned for over five generations and currently directed by Cyril Gautheron, the estate is situated in Fleys, east of the town of Chablis, and is widely acclaimed for its sustainable viticulture and traditional Burgundian focus. Sourced from estate vineyards with vines averaging 45 to 70 years of age planted on steep, north-east and south-east facing slopes, the vines root deeply into classic Kimmeridgian limestone subsoils packed with fossilized oyster shells (Exogyra virgula). The winemaking philosophy combines gentle whole-cluster pneumatic pressing, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats (with a tiny portion fermented in aged oak barrels), and extended fine lees aging for 10 to 12 months, yielding a wine of extraordinary depth, concentrated fruit purity, and trademark oyster-shell minerality.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale straw yellow colour with subtle greenish-gold highlights along the rim. An expressive, highly focused bouquet opens with intense aromas of green apple, juicy lemon, white peach, and fresh pear, interwoven with subtle notes of white spring flowers, wet chalk, crushed oyster shell, and a hint of blanched almond. On the palate, it is medium bodied, chiseled, and mouth-filling, delivering concentrated flavours of citrus zest, green orchard fruit, and flinty mineral iron, all anchored by a piercing, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a satiny texture derived from extended lees contact and a driving mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon peel, saline minerality, and a crisp limestone grip. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, it effortlessly combines old-vine concentration and weight with Chablis' hallmark freshness, tension, and razor-sharp precision.

title: Petit Vega '18 Meses En Barrica' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from Spain, within the prestigious Ribera del Duero D.O. appellation situated along the elevated high-altitude plateau (Meseta Norte) of Castile and León. Produced under the Petit Vega label by Bodegas y Viñedos Vega de Yuso, this cuvée represents a quintessential expression of modern yet deeply rooted Ribera del Duero winemaking. Sourced from choice old-vine plots in Quintanilla de Onésimo and surrounding valleys, the vines sit at elevations between 750 and 850 meters above sea level, rooted in nutrient-poor soils composed of limestone, clay, and gravelly alluvial deposits. The harsh extreme-continental climate features blistering summer days and dramatically cold nights (diurnal shift), extending the ripening season and allowing Tempranillo to build deep dark-fruit pigments, firm structural tannins, and an exceptionally vibrant natural acidity.

Wine Description

Petit Vega '18 Meses en Barrica' presents an opaque, intense cherry-black color in the glass with vivid violet-garnet shimmers along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, complex, and high-toned, offering a concentrated and sophisticated portrait of high-altitude Ribera del Duero. The bouquet opens with a lavish display of crushed cassis, dark plum compote, and wild blackberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of roasted espresso bean, dark cocoa, sweet pipe tobacco, graphite, vanilla pod, and subtle toasted cedarwood spice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and powerfully focused, showcasing a succulent, mouth-coating core of black stone fruits, licorice, and baking spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly balances its rich mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is broad, muscular, and athletic, driven by firm, ripe, and fine-grained tannins that carry into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of dark chocolate, mineral gravel, and toasted oak.

This high-definition Spanish expression is 100% Tinto Fino (Tempranillo), harvested meticulously by hand in small crates from low-yielding vineyards aged 30 to 50+ years. Following rigorous sorting, the fruit underwent cold maceration and temperature-controlled alcoholic fermentation in stainless steel vats to extract deep color and fine phenolics. As designated by its name, the wine completed malolactic conversion and was matured for a full 18 months in a curated combination of French and American oak barrels (a mix of new and second-use casks), followed by additional bottle aging prior to release. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, bold alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% to 15.0% and is finished bone-dry.

title: Petit Vega '28 Meses En Barrica' - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This powerful and elegant red wine originates from Spain, specifically from the Ribera del Duero appellation within the Castilla y León region. Petit Vega is a personal project by Isaac Fernández Montaño, one of Spain's most renowned oenologists. His wines have consistently achieved great recognition, with several having scored over 95 points by Robert Parker.

Wine Description

Petit Vega '28 Meses En Barrica' is crafted exclusively from 100% Tempranillo grapes. It offers a nose of blackberry and cassis liqueur, accented with touches of balsamic and minerals. The palate is powerful and flavourful, marked by mature fruit flavours intertwined with hints of coffee, cocoa, and licorice. It possesses a velvety texture and structure, showcasing depth and is an elegant and structured red wine. The finish is long and elegant.

Food Pairing

This robust Tempranillo pairs excellently with beef, lamb, and game dishes, such as deer or venison. Its mature and complex profile also complements aged cheeses like Manchego.

title: Domaine Jean Claude Ramonet Corton Charlemagne Grand Cru - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This rare Grand Cru dry white wine originates from France, within the prestigious Corton-Charlemagne appellation straddling the Montagne de Corton in the Côte de Beaune subregion of Burgundy. Founded in the late 1920s by Pierre Ramonet, Domaine Ramonet is widely considered one of Burgundy’s most revered producers of Chardonnay, historically anchored in Chassagne-Montrachet. Managed today by Jean-Claude Ramonet, the estate's Corton-Charlemagne cuvée expands their reach to the steep, south-and-southwest-facing limestone slopes of Pernand-Vergelesses and Aloxe-Corton. Grown on high-elevation marl and white Jurassic limestone soils, this wine stands as a monument to power, precision, and monumental aging potential.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2023 vintage presents a pale, luminous golden color with emerald reflections. The complex and intense nose opens with soaring aromas of white peach, crisp green pear, and Meyer lemon, interwoven with Ramonet’s signature notes of spearmint, crushed flint, gunsmoke, white flowers, and subtle toasted hazelnut. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and electric, displaying immense structural weight seamlessly balanced by a razor-sharp beam of chalky mineral tension and vibrant acidity. Crafted from 100% Chardonnay, the hand-harvested fruit undergoes gentle pressing and natural fermentation in French oak barrels (approximately 30% to 33% new). The wine is aged on its fine lees for roughly 18 months, resulting in an extraordinarily long, saline, and aristocratically persistent finish. The alcohol by volume sits at 13.5%.

Food Pairing

The profound textural concentration, high mineral intensity, and structural drive of this Grand Cru Chardonnay call for rich, high-end gastronomy. It pairs magnificently with butter-poached lobster, pan-seared sea scallops in black truffle cream, roasted turbot with beurre blanc, and seared langoustines. It also complements rich white meat dishes like roasted poulet de Bresse with wild moril mushrooms, sweetbreads, and aged Burgundian cheeses like mature Comté or Époisses.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage across the Côte de Beaune yielded white wines of exceptional generosity, aromatic purity, and structural balance. A warm summer enabled uniform phenolic maturity without sacrificing natural acidity, particularly on high-altitude, limestone-rich Grand Cru sites like Corton-Charlemagne. The 2023 Domaine Ramonet Corton-Charlemagne is a collector’s dream, combining immediate aromatic charm and muscular volume with the tight mineral backbone required to evolve gracefully in cellars for 15 to 25+ years.

title: Bottega Gold Brut - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Bottega Gold Brut originates from Italy, within the northeastern Veneto region and the Prosecco DOC. The winery, widely recognized for its iconic and eye-catching mirrored gold-plated bottle, has built a global reputation for blending Italian style with high-quality viticulture. The brand's philosophy focuses on capturing the true aromatic potential of the region's terroirs, selecting grapes from hillside vineyards in the province of Treviso where mild climates and significant day-to-night temperature shifts enhance the aromatic complexity of the fruit.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine presents a bright, straw yellow colour in the glass, enlivened by a fine and persistent perlage. The sensory profile is refined and expressive, featuring an aromatic nose of green apples, pears, and citrus fruits, layered with delicate floral notes of white flowers, acacia, wisteria, and lily of the valley, finishing with hints of sage and soft spices. On the palate, it is soft, harmonious, and elegant, delivering a slim body with a lively yet balanced acidity that complements its clean fruit character. The finish is crisp and persistent, leaving a refreshing, dry impression.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Glera.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is crafted using the Charmat (tank) method, where fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks to safeguard the natural freshness and vibrant, fruity brightness of the grape variety.

  • ABV: 11%.

  • Organic Status: While Bottega emphasizes environmental sustainability across its operations, this specific commercial bottling is not certified organic.

title: Louis Martini Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the United States, specifically the prestigious Napa Valley of California, this wine represents a nearly 90-year legacy of superior craftsmanship. Founded in 1933, Louis M. Martini was one of the first wineries to open in the region following Prohibition, driven by a pioneering vision that Napa Valley held the potential to produce world-class Cabernet Sauvignon.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep burgundy colour and a complex sensory profile that opens with aromas of black plum, blackberry, and blackcurrant, accented by wisps of fennel, sage, and smoky cedar. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and concentrated, revealing layers of dark cherry, cassis, and chocolate-covered cherry, underscored by hints of black licorice, cocoa, and a gravelly earthiness.

title: Padre Azul Reposado Tequila - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: This Reposado tequila is aged in French oak barrels for a minimum of 8 months after distillation. Complex notes of dried orange, smoked agave and caramel fill the velvety yet powerful palate. An exceptional spirit housed in a strikingly presented handcrafted bottle.

title: Kraken Black Spiced Rum - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: One of the fastest growing rum brands, The Kraken is the world’s first black spiced rum, housed in an iconic bottle. This black rum from the Caribbean is blended with more than 13 secret spices to create this mythical beast of a spiced rum. Intense molasses, spice and brown sugar aromas on the nose and rich coffee, chocolate, vanilla bean, spice, molasses and clove flavours on the palate make this ideal in mixed drinks.

title: Padre Azul Silver Tequila - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Padre Azul Silver is bottled straight after its double distillation. This gives it its clear, transparent colour and its incomparable taste of fresh agave. This young tequila is perfect for mixing high-quality cocktails.

title: Map Maker Sauvignon Blanc - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Map Maker Sauvignon Blanc is a perfect example of classic Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc. Intensely aromatic with attractive herbs and stony notes. Dry, tangy sauvignon blanc with green capsicum, lime zest, gooseberry and subtle tropical fruit and passion fruit flavours. A light, fresh wine with good purity and energy.

title: Three Finger Jack Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in the California region, specifically within the Lodi AVA appellation, Three Finger Jack Cabernet Sauvignon 'East Side Ridge' represents a bold, concentrated, and rustic expression of California winemaking. Produced by Delicato Family Wines, the brand pays tribute to the legendary Gold Rush outlaw Three Finger Jack, who roamed the rugged Sierra Foothills and East Side Ridge of Lodi. The grapes are sourced from select vineyards along the gravelly, well draining soils of Lodi's eastern ridges, where warm, sun-drenched days are balanced by cool breezes sweeping in from the San Joaquin Delta. Under winemaker James Ewart, the winemaking philosophy incorporates extended skin contact, warm temperature controlled fermentation, and maturation in French and American oak barrels for 9 to 12 months. The result is a full throttled, opulent Cabernet Sauvignon that marries rich dark fruit power with smooth, oak-kissed complexity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, opaque dark ruby red colour with intense purple reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly fragrant bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry preserves, blackcurrant curd, and cassis, interwoven with bold notes of toasted oak, vanilla bean, dark chocolate, espresso, pipe tobacco, and warm baking spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, plush, and mouth-filling, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, sweet spice, and subtle mineral earth, all supported by a balanced, refreshing spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, velvety, fine-grained tannins and a dense, coat-the-mouth mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, mocha, and toasted cedar. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon blended with small amounts of Petite Sirah and Malbec, it effortlessly combines Lodi fruit generosity, plush oak integration, and muscular crowd-pleasing structure.

title: Crystal Head Vodka - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The original Crystal Head Vodka is crafted from locally sourced, Canadian corn. It is distilled four times into a neutral grain spirit and blended with pristine water from Newfoundland, Canada. The vodka is filtered seven times, of which three are through layers of semi-precious crystals known as Herkimer diamonds. 

Crystal Head Vodka offers a clean, clear and colourless spirit. On the nose are neutral grain aromas with a delicate touch of citrus. The palate is silky smooth with a hint of sweetness and vanilla, ending with a sweet, creamy finish.

title: Van Gogh Espresso Vodka - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Van Gogh Espresso Vodka is created with nothing but the best Colombian beans, giving this premium vodka a bittersweet coffee taste. With just a hint of citrus and a silky cocoa finish, Van Gogh Espresso is the perfect blank canvas for any coffee-inspired creation.

title: Fireball Cinnamon Whisky - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The blending of smooth Canadian whisky and intense cinnamon flavour result in a bold shot that is fragrant with pronounced aromas of cinnamon and spice; on the palate the spicy flavours of cinnamon intermingle with caramel notes on a long, hot finish.

Serve well chilled. Great on its own, use in cocktails or apple desserts.

title: Grey Goose Vodka Aluminum - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Using only the finest ingredients, Grey Goose is renowned for its smooth and silky character. Expect subtle aromas of sweet citrus and white flowers; the palate is soft with a gentle and subtle sweetness that envelops your mouth; warm and spicy on the finish. Perfect in a classic martini.

title: Luxardo Sambuca - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: This classic Italian liqueur has been family owned for generations. The use of essential oils from the star anise seed provide intense aromatics and concentrated flavours that are balanced by light bitterness and velvety smooth texture on the palate.

title: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Bright topaz, brilliant with gold and amber tints. Attractive orange notes with nuances of candied zests; vanilla flavours from the cognac. Full and ample; bitter oranges aromas balanced by cognac notes of hazelnuts and toffee. The finish is long and harmonious.

title: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Honey - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: This whiskey-based liqueur is a sweet take on a classic. Blending Jack Daniel's whiskey with real honey, for a one-of-a-kind flavour experience. Smooth texture with naturally sweet flavours are discovered on the palate along with a pleasant warming sensation. Enjoy on its own, over ice, add to coffee or use in cocktails.

title: Disaronno Amaretto - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Deep brown colour; almond and maraschino cherry aroma; very sweet cherry flavour, alcohol shows in the finish.

title: Wayne Gretzky Red Cask Whiskey - Mini 50ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: A remarkable blend produced from locally sourced grains and finished in red wine casks from the winery which impart a pale amber colour. Expect a smooth and refined flavour profile that includes notes of marzipan, light citrus, vanilla, oak and spice; the finish is long, warming and balanced.

title: Teremana Reposado - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Teremana Reposado is a small batch, ultra premium tequila from Mexico, crafted in the Jalisco Highlands. The brand, meaning 'spirit of the earth' (from the Latin 'terra' and Polynesian 'mana'), was co-founded by Dwayne Johnson with the goal of creating a high-quality, responsibly sourced spirit that is accessible to all. The tequila is produced at Destilería Teremana de Agave, a unique home built solely for the brand, where they meticulously follow traditional, small batch methods.

This ageing imparts a light honey colour and a complex, rich sensory profile. On the nose, one finds roasted agave, oak, and vanilla. The palate is smooth and well balanced, featuring flavours of cooked agave, vanilla, cinnamon, and a subtle oak influence. There are also notes of stone fruit, tropical fruit, and a hint of spice. The finish is medium in length and warm, with lingering notes of vanilla and toasted oak. The complexity and smoothness make it an excellent choice for sipping.

title: Teremana Blanco Tequila - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Teremana Blanco Tequila is produced in Mexico, within the highlands of the Jalisco region and the subregion of Jesús María. Launched in March 2020, the brand was founded by global superstar Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson alongside co-founders Dany Garcia, Jenna Fagnan, and Ken Austin. The tequila is crafted at Destilería Teremana de Agave in partnership with the Lopez family, who are third generation agave growers and second generation tequila makers. The name combines the Latin 'terra', meaning earth, and the Polynesian word 'mana', which translates to spirit.

Description

This unaged blanco tequila is crafted from 100% mature Blue Weber agave that is slow roasted in small, traditional brick ovens and distilled in handmade copper pot stills. It presents a clear and brilliant appearance in the glass. The nose offers fresh aromas of bright citrus zest, sweet roasted agave, and subtle herbal notes with a touch of pepper. On the palate, the spirit is crisp and lively, featuring flavours of lime, roasted agave, and a hint of vanilla spice. It possesses a smooth, medium body and concludes with a clean, refreshing finish characterized by a gentle peppery warmth.

title: Don Julio Blanco Tequila - Mini 50 ml - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Using the finest blue agave plant and a time honored distillation process, Don Julio Blanco Tequila is tequila in its truest form.

Don Julio Blanco Tequila is the base from which all of our other variants are derived. Commonly referred to as “silver” tequila, its crisp agave flavor and hints of citrus make it an essential component to a variety of innovative drinks including margaritas. It can also be enjoyed neat or on the rocks. 100% blue agave plant.

title: Maculan Cabernet Sauvignon Palazzotto Di Breganze - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: "Palazzotto" by Maculan is an intense and full-bodied red wine coming from the Breganze area, in the Veneto province of Vicenza. Aged for 12 months in new and used barriques and expresses aromas of licorice, blackberries and ripe fruit well ripe, revealing a full and balanced mouthfeel, supported by dense tannins.

title: Fontanafredda Barolo Serralunga D'Alba - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: The colour is garnet-red with ruby highlights that take on a slightly orange tone over time. It has a clear-cut, intense nose with overtones of vanilla, spices, withered roses and underbrush. The taste is dry, but soft, full-bodied, velvety and well balanced and is very long-lasting. Ideal with big red meat dishes and medium or mature cheeses, it can also make for pleasant after-dinner company.

title: Livio Felluga Vertigo Rosso - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Livio Felluga Vertigo Rosso is a red wine from the Friuli Venezia Giulia region in northeastern Italy, produced by the esteemed Livio Felluga winery. This wine embodies the region's diversity by blending traditional and international grape varieties.

Blend Composition:

  • Merlot

  • Cabernet Sauvignon

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Bright, clear ruby red.

  • Aroma: Generous and refined, with upfront notes of dog rose and red fruits like currants, raspberries, and wild blackberries, mingling with citrus hints of blood orange and tangerine zest. Distinctive yellow pepper peel and spicy pink pepper intertwine with the sweetness of cinnamon, cloves, and licorice root.

  • Palate: Dynamic and intuitive, featuring refreshing waves of citrus, small wild berries, and black cherries. A delightfully mouthfilling, close-knit tannic texture with top notes of dark spice, tobacco leaves, and Criollo cocoa beans. The finish is lingering, with a bitterish hint reminiscent of freshly toasted Arabica beans.

title: Chateau de Beaucastel Chateauneuf du Pape 2023 - Bundle & Save
Feudi Di San Gregorio Fiano Di Avellino - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Delicate, yet fresh floral notes of chamomile are layered with peach and candied orange aromas. The soft palate is enveloped with a lovely freshness through to a vibrant spicy and mineral finish.

title: Villa Teresa Organic Merlot - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the delle Venezie IGT appellation, Villa Teresa Organic Merlot represents a smooth, eco-conscious, and fruit-forward expression of Italian red winemaking. Produced by the historic Dinami family estate of Vintners Dinami / Fratelli Di Maria, the Villa Teresa line has been a pioneer in certified organic and vegan viticulture in northeastern Italy since the late 1980s. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyards situated across the flat alluvial plains and gentle rolling hills of Venetia, the vines grow on clay, silt, and gravel soils. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes sustainable practices and minimal intervention, utilizing gentle destemming, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats, and maturation without heavy oak influence to preserve pure red fruit character, soft tannins, and natural freshness.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, dark ruby red colour with bright garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly fragrant bouquet opens with inviting aromas of ripe black plum, dark cherry, wild blackberry, and raspberry jam, interwoven with subtle notes of dried herbs, cocoa, sweet spice, and a touch of earthiness. On the palate, it is medium bodied, smooth, and approachable, delivering delicious flavours of plum curd, red berry jam, and subtle mineral earth, all supported by a balanced, refreshing spine of natural acidity. Framed by soft, velvety tannins and a supple mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, satisfying finish marked by lingering dark fruit, sweet herbs, and a gentle mineral lift. Composed of 100% Merlot, it offers a pure, unvarnished profile with immediate drinking appeal. Stylistically, it combines Venetian elegance and certified organic purity with supple, easy-drinking fruit richness.

title: Villa Teresa Organic Pinot Grigio - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The Villa Teresa brand was established more than 40 years ago. It was one of the first producers to focus on organic wines, foreseeing a shift toward sustainable practices. The winery's philosophy centres on minimising pollution, eliminating the use of pesticides in the vineyard, and conducting the entire harvest manually.

Wine Description

This lovely organic Pinot Grigio is a pale straw colour and has a ripe apple nose that carries through on the palate. It has flavours of cooked pear, lemon citrus and mineral with hints of orange and melon fruit. Perfect first sip on the patio!

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include fresh seafood, such as oysters, smoked salmon, and ceviche, as well as lighter fish appetizers, fish soup, or baked white fish in butter sauce.

title: Villa Teresa Organic Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the delle Venezie IGT appellation, Villa Teresa Organic Chardonnay represents a fresh, eco-conscious, and vibrant expression of Northern Italian white winemaking. Produced by the historic Dinami family estate of Vintners Dinami / Fratelli Di Maria, the Villa Teresa range has been a pioneer in certified organic and vegan viticulture in northeastern Italy since the late 1980s. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyards situated across the flat alluvial plains and gentle rolling hills of Venetia, the vines grow on mineral-rich limestone, clay, and gravel soils. The winemaking philosophy focuses on environmental sustainability and purity of fruit, utilizing gentle pneumatic pressing and temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats to preserve bright fruit aromatics, crisp natural acidity, and clean varietal balance without oak influence.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale straw yellow colour with bright greenish-gold reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly fragrant bouquet opens with inviting aromas of crisp green apple, ripe yellow pear, white peach, and lemon zest, interwoven with subtle notes of white spring blossoms, acacia, and a touch of crushed limestone. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, crisp, and refreshing, delivering delicious flavours of orchard fruit, citrus curd, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a smooth, clean texture and a supple mid-palate structure, it concludes with a lively, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon peel, fresh apple, and a crisp mineral lift. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, it offers an approachable, unvarnished profile with immediate drinking appeal. Stylistically, it combines Italian freshness and certified organic purity with pure, un-oaked Chardonnay character.

title: Massolino Langhe Chardonnay - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Piedmont region, specifically within the Langhe DOC appellation, Massolino Langhe Chardonnay represents a fresh, mineral driven, and sophisticated expression of white winemaking from a house renowned for its benchmark Barolos. Established in 1896 by Giovanni Massolino in Serralunga d'Alba, the family estate applies its uncompromising attention to detail to international white varietals. Sourced from high-altitude vineyard plots in Serralunga d'Alba, Monforte d'Alba, and Alba planted on chalky limestone and clay-marl soils, the vines benefit from cool diurnal breezes that preserve vibrant acidity and intense aromatics. The winemaking philosophy under winemakers Franco and Roberto Massolino involves protective pressing under inert gas, followed by maturation in a combination of stainless steel vats, large oak casks, French barriques, and concrete vessels for approximately 6 to 9 months with gentle lees stirring. The result is a refined Chardonnay that strikes a harmony between creamy texture, bright citrus fruit, and distinct Piedmontese limestone minerality.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale straw yellow colour with bright greenish-gold reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with fresh aromas of golden apple, crisp nectarine, lime zest, and white peach, interwoven with subtle notes of citrus blossom, hazelnut, vanilla bean, coffee cream, and crushed limestone. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silky, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of green apple, grapefruit curd, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity.
