Framed by a textured, satiny mid-palate derived from fine lees contact and subtle oak integration, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus peel, toasted almond, and a clean chalky mineral grip. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, it offers a refined profile with impressive aging capability over several years. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Burgundy-like precision and aromatic tension with the rich structure, warmth, and mineral depth of the Langhe terroir.

title: Massolino Langhe Nebbiolo - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Piedmont region, specifically within the Langhe DOC appellation, Massolino Langhe Nebbiolo represents an exceptionally pure, elegant, and aristocratic expression of Nebbiolo. Founded in 1896 by Giovanni Massolino in Serralunga d'Alba, the estate is renowned for its benchmark Barolos. This Langhe Nebbiolo is crafted from a thoughtful blend of estate fruit in Serralunga d'Alba, combined with parcels in Monforte d'Alba and Alba planted on chalky limestone and sandy-clay soils. The winemaking philosophy involves gentle extraction, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats, and maturation in large traditional Slavonian oak casks for over a year. The result is a wine that bridges the structural elegance of Barolo with early-drinking charm and vibrant red fruit freshness.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale ruby red colour with bright garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of wild strawberry, tart red cherry, raspberry coulis, and blood orange, interwoven with subtle notes of crushed rose petals, pipe tobacco, cedar, dried anise, and sweet spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silky, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of fresh red berries, cherry curd, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine, chalky, seamlessly integrated tannins and a harmonious mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, subtle graphite minerality, and a clean limestone grip. Composed of 100% Nebbiolo, it offers a refined profile with impressive aging capability over several years. Stylistically, it combines Serralunga's structural nobility with high-altitude floral aromatics and effortless drinking pleasure.

title: Villa Sparina Barbera Piemonte - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: A red wine full of dark berries and slate aromas. Full-bodied, loads of fruit and a long, flavourful finish. A refined and transparent style.

title: Prunotto Barolo - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the esteemed Barolo D.O.C.G. appellation of Piedmont's Langhe district. Prunotto, a historic estate dating back to 1904, has been managed under the stewardship of the renowned Antinori family since 1989. Combining century-old Langhe winemaking traditions with refined precision, Prunotto focuses on preserving varietal authenticity and showcasing the nuanced terroirs of Piedmont. Sourced from choice vineyard plots across key Barolo communes including Monforte d'Alba, Serralunga d'Alba, and Castiglione Falletto the vines are rooted in ancient Helvetian and Tortonian soils composed of calcareous clay, marl, and sandstone. The region's cool continental climate, characterized by warm autumn days and crisp fog-laden nights (nebbia), allows the Nebbiolo grapes to ripen slowly, developing intense aromatic complexity and a formidable tannic architecture.

Wine Description

Prunotto Barolo presents a luminous, pale garnet-ruby color in the glass with light orange and brick reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a quintessential, textbook expression of classic Langhe Nebbiolo. The bouquet opens with a captivating, multi-faceted display of dried red roses, wild sour cherries, and tart cranberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of sweet tobacco leaf, leather, anise, crushed limestone, and a signature line of tar, licorice, and forest floor. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, taut, and precisely focused, showcasing a bright core of red stone fruits, blood orange peel, and dried spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts through the mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is linear and athletic, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky Nebbiolo tannins that carry into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of iron, dried herbs, and earth.

This high-definition regional expression is 100% Nebbiolo, hand-harvested at optimal physiological ripeness. The grapes underwent careful destemming and crushing followed by temperature-controlled skin contact and fermentation in stainless steel tanks for approximately 8 to 12 days. To polish its firm Nebbiolo tannins while honoring pure varietal expression, the wine completed malolactic conversion and was matured for approximately 18 to 24 months in large, traditional French and Slavonian oak casks (botti grandi), followed by additional bottle aging prior to release. It reaches an effortlessly balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 14.0% to 14.5% and is finished bone-dry.

title: Vajra Langhe Rosso - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
The Langhe Rosso is a hug from Piedmont. It’s an invitation to explore its different varieties and to get to know its personality. From young vineyards, it is a fruity delicately complex wine: an ideal companion at the table. Predominately Nebbiolo, Barbera, and Dolcetto and smaller quantities of Freisa, Albarossa, Pinot noir. Each vineyard is harvested when it reaches the perfect ripeness. The varieties are vinified one by one, to express their personality and uniqueness.

Red colour with violet hues refers to the sweetness of dark fruit with refined elegance. Intense and rich on the nose, it is both concentrated and harmonious: flowers and fruits give way to hay, tobacco, spices. Bright summer berries on the palate with graphite veins lead to the discovery of a series of sensations.

title: Batasiolo Barolo - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Garnet red colour with rye bread, lifted, spicy red plum and cherry aromas and flavours. Tar, licorice, savoury and spicy. Extra dry, medium to full-bodied, excellent balance of fruit and plentiful tannins with a long, complex finish.

title: Vajra Langhe Nebbiolo - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Piedmont region of Italy, this wine is a pure expression of the Langhe DOC, with fruit sourced from high-elevation vineyards in Barolo, Novello, and Sinio. The G.D. Vajra estate was revitalized in 1972 by Aldo Vaira, who became a pioneer of organic viticulture in the region. Today, the winery remains a family affair, guided by a philosophy of 'recipe-free' attention and a deep commitment to biodiversity and the authentic preservation of Piedmontese traditions.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo is celebrated for its 'varietal truth', displaying a lively light garnet colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is expressive and ethereal, featuring a bouquet of dried rose petals, crushed violets, and mountain raspberries intertwined with notes of lavender, mint, and citrus peel. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and energetic, offering a 'pulpy' texture with flavours of sour cherry, strawberry, and cranberry balanced by a chalky minerality. It is defined by its silky, well-integrated tannins and a lifted, savory finish. While designed to be enjoyed young for its freshness, it possesses the structure for a graceful evolution over the next decade.

title: Roserock Chardonnay by Domaine Drouhin Oregon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Drouhin Oregon Roserock continues a four-generation story that began in 1880 when Joseph Drouhin moved from Chablis to Beaune in the heart of Burgundy. In Oregon, as in Burgundy, the Drouhin Family farms singular, expressive parcels of land. The Roserock Vineyard sits at the southern tip of the Eola-Amity Hills in Oregon's Willamette Valley and is marked by volcanic soils, cooler temperatures and an ideal elevation range. Farmed by Phillipe Drouhin, Roserock is certified sustainable.

title: Roserock Pinot Noir by Domaine Drouhin Oregon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, this Pinot Noir originates from the Eola Amity Hills subregion of Oregon's Willamette Valley. Domaine Drouhin Oregon was established in 1987 by the Drouhin family of Burgundy, seeking to combine French winemaking soul with Oregon soil. The family expanded their legacy in 2013 by purchasing the Roserock vineyard, a site renowned for its ancient volcanic soils and cool climate influence from the Van Duzer Corridor.

Wine Description

This wine presents a vibrant and poised sensory profile, capturing the characteristic purity and tension of the Eola Amity Hills estate. On the nose, the wine reveals complex aromas of lavender, violet, and cherry pie, underscored by warm baking spices and an earthy undertone. The palate is supple yet firmly structured, offering bright flavours of strawberry, plum, and marionberry complemented by exotic notes of cassis and cardamom.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs exceptionally well with roasted duck breast, where the bright red fruit and crisp acidity cut through the richness of the meat. It is also a sophisticated companion for a sausage cassoulet or a herb crusted rack of lamb.

title: Yellow Tail Shiraz - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: While some Shiraz can be over the top, this wine offers some seriously easy drinking, even when the wine is young. Red fruits dominate the nose and mouth, but subtle spice and a hint of dusty tannins join in for good measure.

title: Yellow Tail Cabernet Sauvignon - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml: Cabernet Sauvignon is known for its elegance, soft, fruit driven in style and with feathery tannins. Cassis, violets, crushed herbs and a long, soft finish is what you will find with this wine.

title: Ao Yun 2022 Gift Box
bodyHtml:
Originating from China in the Yunnan region, specifically within the Shangri-La AOC appellation in the foothills of the Himalayas, Ao Yun 2022 Gift Box represents a luxury, groundbreaking, and high-altitude expression of fine winemaking. Created by the luxury group LVMH (Moët Hennessy), Ao Yun—meaning 'flying above the clouds'—is produced from remote estate vineyards situated between 2,200 and 2,600 metres above sea level near the sacred Meili Snow Mountain along the banks of the Mekong River. The vines are farmed organically across four distinct Tibetan villages (Adong, Shuori, Xidang, and Sinong), where unique clay-gravel and alluvial soils predominate. Under estate director and winemaker Maxence Dulou, the winemaking philosophy incorporates hand harvesting, micro-parcel fermentation in traditional wooden vats and clay jars (amphorae), and maturation for 18 to 20 months in French oak barrels (30% to 40% new). Presented in a luxury gift box, this release captures both Himalayan terroir intensity and pristine French winemaking craftsmanship.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense violet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of wild blackberry, dark cherry, cassis, and black plum compote, interwoven with sophisticated notes of mountain herbs, wild mint, crushed stone minerality, pipe tobacco, graphite, fresh coffee bean, and toasted cedar spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, silken, and mouth-filling, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, cocoa powder, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, energetic spine of high-altitude natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, velvety tannins and a dense mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruits, subtle spice, and a clean gravelly mineral grip. Composed of a masterfully blended cabernet-dominant blend (predominantly Cabernet Sauvignon blended with Cabernet Franc, Syrah, Petit Verdot, and Merlot), this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2048+. Stylistically, it combines high-elevation tension, refined mountain complexity, and iconic collectors' appeal.

title: La Rioja Alta Gran Reserva 890 2011
bodyHtml:
Originating from Spain in the La Rioja region, specifically within the Rioja Alta DOCa sub-zone, La Rioja Alta Gran Reserva 890 2011 represents the pinnacle of traditional, long-aged Spanish winemaking. Founded in 1890, La Rioja Alta S.A. is one of the region's historic benchmark estates, and Gran Reserva 890—named in honor of the winery's founding year—is produced only in exceptional vintages. Sourced from the oldest estate vineyards in Briñas, Labastida, and Villalba, the vines grow in clay-limestone soils at high elevations along the foothills of the Sierra de Cantabria. Under technical director Julio Sáenz, the winemaking philosophy incorporates traditional manual harvesting, meticulous berry selection, ambient yeast fermentation in oak vats, and extraordinary barrel aging for six full years in neutral American oak barrels crafted at the winery's own cooperage, racked manually by candlelight ten times. The result is a profound, silky Gran Reserva that marries classic Rioja oxidative complexity with vibrant freshness and decades-long cellaring capacity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous medium ruby red colour with distinct brick and amber-garnet reflections along the wide rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of dried red cherry, wild strawberry, black plum, and dried fig, interwoven with sophisticated notes of cigar box cedar, vanilla bean, coconut, cured leather, dried rose petals, pipe tobacco, truffle, and warm clove spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of dried fruit, savory minerals, and dark tea leaves, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine-grained, polished, velvety tannins and an exceptionally harmonious mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red berries, toasted oak, sweet spices, and a clean mineral grip. Composed of 95% Tempranillo blended with 3% Graciano and 2% Mazuelo, this 2011 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2024–2050+. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines traditional Rioja elegance, aristocratic leather-and-spice complexity, and supreme structural polish.

title: Lolo Albarino 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Spain in the Galicia region, specifically within the Rías Baixas DO appellation in the Val do Salnés sub-zone, Paco & Lola 'Lolo' Albariño 2025 represents a youthful, playful, and aromatic expression of coastal Spanish white wine. Produced by Adega e Viñedos Paco & Lola, one of the most dynamic modern cooperatives in Galicia, this cuvée is designed to highlight the accessible, fruit forward side of the Albariño grape. The vines grow in granite-rich sandy clay soils on granite bedrock near the Atlantic coast, benefiting from cool maritime breezes and high natural humidity. Under winemaking director Nuria de la Torre, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes temperature controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats for 21 days, followed by short maturation on fine lees without oak aging. The result is a crisp, refreshing, and highly aromatic white wine that captures classic Galician freshness and saline ocean charm.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear straw yellow colour with luminous pale greenish highlights along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of green apple, crisp pear, lemon peel, and white peach, interwoven with subtle notes of white flowers, lemongrass, wet granite minerality, and subtle saline sea spray. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, crisp, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of citrus fruit, stone fruit, and chalky mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural Atlantic acidity. Framed by a sleek, clean mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon zest, green plum, and a crisp, saline mineral grip. Composed of 100% Albariño, this 2025 release offers immediate drinking appeal and vibrant food friendliness. Stylistically, it combines youthful Spanish vibrancy, electric citrus acidity, and authentic Atlantic minerality.

title: Chateau Rieussec 2021
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Bordeaux region, specifically within the Sauternes AOC appellation, Château Rieussec Premier Grand Cru Classé Sauternes 2021 represents a luxurious, world-class, and iconic sweet white wine. Ranked as a Premier Grand Cru Classé in the historic 1855 Classification, Château Rieussec is owned and managed by Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite). Neighboring Château d'Yquem, the estate's vineyards span 93 hectares situated on one of the highest elevations in Sauternes, planted on gravelly soil overlaying clay and limestone subsoils. Under technical director Saskia de Rothschild and team, the winemaking philosophy incorporates strict, manual plot-by-plot harvesting in successive passes (tries) to select grapes affected by noble rot (Botrytis cinerea). Vinification takes place in oak barrels (approximately 50% to 70% new) produced at the Rothschilds' own cooperage, where the wine matures for 18 to 24 months. The result is a opulent Sauternes that balances golden fruit richness, honeyed botrytis complexity, and electric natural acidity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear luminous light gold colour with warm amber reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of candied apricot, orange marmalade, dried yellow peach, and poached quince, interwoven with sophisticated notes of acacia honey, beeswax, candied ginger, white jasmine, toasted brioche, and subtle vanilla bean. On the palate, it is full bodied, rich, and mouth-coating, delivering concentrated flavours of honeyed stone fruit, citrus curd, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, energetic spine of natural acidity. Framed by a velvety, viscous mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering orange peel, toasted almond, subtle botrytis spice, and a clean mineral grip. Composed primarily of Sémillon blended with small proportions of Sauvignon Blanc and Muscadelle, this 2021 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2055+. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Sauternes richness, vibrant acidity, and Domaines Barons de Rothschild refinement.

title: Tignanello 2022 (by Tenuta Tignanello) - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This landmark wine presents an intense ruby red colour enhanced by purple highlights. The aromatic profile is complex and heady, offering a bouquet of red and black cherries, pomegranate, and violets, balanced by balsamic hints and suggestions of sweet pipe tobacco, vanilla, and loamy earth. On the palate, the wine is powerful and supple, delivering a dense core of blackcurrant and crème de violette fruit that is supported by velvety tannins and a vibrant mineral freshness. It finishes long and echoing with floral and fruity notes. The 2022 vintage is a blend composed of 78% Sangiovese, 18% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 4% Cabernet Franc. It has an alcohol content of 14% ABV and an optimal drinking window extending from 2026 through 2046.

Accolades

Wine Advocate - 98 points

James Suckling - 96 points

Kerin O'Keefe - 96 points

Vinous - 95 points

title: Tignanello 2023 (by Tenuta Tignanello) - Bundle & Save
bodyHtml:
This structured and aristocratic red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Toscana I.G.T. appellation in Central Italy. Produced at Tenuta Tignanello by Marchesi Antinori the legendary Tuscan winemaking dynasty with a history spanning over six centuries this historic bottling fundamentally revolutionized Italian viticulture as the first Sangiovese aged in barriques, the first modern red blend with non traditional varietals, and one of the original Super Tuscans. Sourced exclusively from the 57 hectare single vineyard plot on the Tenuta Tignanello estate, situated between the Greve and Pesa river valleys in the Chianti Classico zone, the vines sit at 350 to 400 metres above sea level on limestone and marl rich soils known locally as albarese and galestro. The Mediterranean climate delivers warm daylight balanced by cool breezes descending from the Apennines, allowing the grapes to reach complete phenolic maturity while retaining high natural acidity and chiseled mineral drive.

Wine Description

The 2023 Tenuta Tignanello presents an intense ruby red colour in the glass with bright crimson and violet reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and sophisticated portrait of high altitude Tuscan limestone terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe sour cherries, dark plums, pomegranates, and blood orange peel, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh violets, sweet cocoa, pencil lead, white pepper, tobacco leaf, and a distinct line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of tart red stone fruits, wild berries, and licorice. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid palate fruit concentration. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by firm, fine grained tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of roasted hazelnut, graphite, and cedar.

This high definition Tuscan expression is a classical, Sangiovese led assemblage:

  • Sangiovese (~80%): Formulates the primary architectural core, contributing vibrant red cherry acidity, floral perfume, structural volume, and chalky tannic tension.

  • Cabernet Sauvignon (~15%): Supplies dark berry weight, cassis depth, graphite focus, and age worthy tannic grip.

  • Cabernet Franc (~5%): Imparts high toned herbal perfume, wild violet lift, and refined structural finesse.

The hand harvested fruit underwent meticulous sorting followed by separate temperature controlled fermentations in truncated oak tanks to preserve varietal purity and extract noble phenolics gently. The wine completed full malolactic conversion and was matured for approximately 15 months in French and Hungarian oak barriques before master blending and bottle aging. It reaches an effortlessly integrated alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and is finished bone dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in the heart of Chianti Classico was marked by moderate conditions, timely rainfall, and optimal late summer temperature shifts between day and night. Antinori's precise vineyard management enabled Sangiovese and the Cabernet varieties to attain optimal phenolic ripeness while retaining vibrant acidity. The 2023 Tenuta Tignanello offers immediate elegance and high energy drinking pleasure today, holding the structural integrity to cellar gracefully for 20 to 30 years.

title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label Lunar New Year - Year of the Goat 2027
bodyHtml:
This blended Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, crafted under the direction of Johnnie Walker Master Blender Emma Walker. Created as a collector's release celebrating the Lunar New Year 2027 (Year of the Goat/Sheep), this limited edition showcases the classic Johnnie Walker Blue Label blend within custom, four-panel bespoke artwork. Blended using rare whiskies drawn from Diageo's vast inventory—including ghost distillery stocks like Port Ellen and Brora along with mature Speyside and Highland malts—only 1 in 10,000 casks are selected for its construction. Bottled in an elongated blue-tinted glass decanter, it marries luxury Scotch whisky blending with traditional East Asian zodiac iconography.

Spirit Description

This blended Scotch displays a deep amber-gold hue with bright copper highlights in the glass. On the nose, it is smooth, complex, and harmonious, opening with aromas of dried apricots, honeyed malt, and candied orange peel, underlaid by toasted hazelnuts, dark chocolate, and a delicate whisper of aromatic peat smoke. On the palate, it feels extraordinarily silky, velvety, and well-rounded, delivering initial layers of kumquat, sweet vanilla, and poached pears, which seamlessly expand into dark raisins, baking spices, and charred oak. The finish is remarkably long, smooth, and warming, trailing off with lingering notes of dried fruit, soft cocoa, gentle sea salt, and a subtle, trailing wisp of peat smoke.

Accolades

Johnnie Walker Blue Label's Lunar New Year series remains one of the most sought-after annual releases among luxury spirits collectors and gift-givers worldwide. The underlying Blue Label liquid routinely receives top honors, including multiple Double Gold Medals at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition and high 90+ point ratings across platforms like Distiller and Whisky Advocate. Collectors particularly value the 2027 Year of the Goat edition for its bespoke bottle artwork, which depicts the goat leaping across celestial clouds alongside blooming peonies—symbolizing prosperity, elegance, and peace.

title: Banfi Superiore Chianti 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Italy, within Tuscany's Chianti region. Castello Banfi was founded in 1978 by the Mariani family in collaboration with renowned enologist Ezio Rivella, establishing a pioneering estate recognized for clonal research and sustainable viticulture. The "Superiore" designation reflects stricter production criteria, including lower vineyard yields and additional aging. The winery's philosophy combines classic Tuscan tradition with modern cellar techniques to create approachable, fruit-forward expressions of Sangiovese.

Wine Description

This intense ruby red wine opens with vibrant aromas of fresh wild cherry, red plum, and violet, complemented by subtle undertones of earth, leather, and gentle oak spice. On the palate, it is round and soft with a balanced core of dark berries and red fruits, framed by supple tannins and refreshing acidity. It features a medium body with a clean, smooth, and savory finish. The varietal composition is predominantly Sangiovese blended with Cabernet Sauvignon and Canaiolo. It has an alcohol content of 13% ABV and is not certified organic (though the winery holds sustainability certifications).

title: Balvenie 16 Year Old French Oak Pineau 47.6 %
bodyHtml:
This unpeated single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, produced in Dufftown within the Speyside region. Crafted at The Balvenie Distillery under the direction of long-serving Malt Master David C. Stewart MBE (and Kelsey McKechnie), this release marks the first time in the distillery's 130-year history that French oak barrels were integrated into their core lineup. After spending 16 years maturing in traditional American oak ex-bourbon casks, the whisky underwent a secondary finishing period in rare French oak barrels that previously held Pineau des Charentes—a fortified aperitivo wine from Charentes, France, made by blending unfermented grape juice with Cognac eau-de-vie. Bottled at a signature strength of 95.2 proof (47.6% ABV), it delivers a bright, vinous, and floral variation on Balvenie’s classic honeyed profile.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a bright golden amber color with warm honeyed reflections in the glass. On the nose, it is floral, sweet, and lively, opening with initial aromas of lotus blossom, geranium, and fresh green apple, quickly yielding to sweet honey, glazed grapefruit zest, and delicate vanilla sponge cake. On the palate, it feels light, silky, and elegant, delivering a sweet arrival of candied lemon peel, poached pear, and honeysuckle. As it warms, the French oak influence brings forward a gentle spice prickle—white pepper, ginger, and subtle wood tannins—harmonized by the grape-forward, sweet-wine notes of the Pineau finish. The finish is clean, medium-to-long, and refreshing, leaving trailing impressions of dried citrus zest, soft oak spice, sweet malty barley, and a lingering floral dryness. The 47.6% ABV proof gives the delicate fruit and floral layers excellent structure without overpowering the palate.

Accolades

The Balvenie 16 Year Old French Oak Pineau Cask Finish has earned high praise across spirit competitions and whisky review outlets since joining the core lineup. Securing a Gold Medal at the International Spirits Challenge alongside 90+ point ratings from Distiller and Whisky Advocate, critics frequently applaud the bottling for its innovative cask selection. Reviewers highlight how the French oak Pineau casks inject a crisp, citrusy, and floral brightness into Balvenie’s rich, honey-dominated DNA, offering a distinctly different wood-finish narrative compared to their classic Caribbean Cask (Rum) or PortWood releases.

title: GlenAllachie 11 Year Old Palo Cortado Sherry Cask Finish - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This unpeated single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, produced in Aberlour within the Speyside region. Handcrafted at The GlenAllachie Distillery under the direction of industry icon Billy Walker, this expression forms part of their prized Wood Collection series. After maturing for over 9 years in premium American oak ex-bourbon barrels, the whisky underwent an intensive secondary maturation period of over 2 years in hand-selected Palo Cortado sherry puncheons. Palo Cortado—the rarest style of sherry, which begins its life naturally aging under flor like an Amontillado before unexpectedly developing the rich, full-bodied structure of an Oloroso—imparts a refined bridge between bright nuttiness and dark fruit. Non-chill filtered, natural in color, and bottled at a robust strength of 96 proof (48.0% ABV), it delivers a complex, dry, and aromatic presentation of GlenAllachie's heavy distillate.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a deep copper to rich mahogany hue in the glass. On the nose, it is highly aromatic, layered, and complex, opening with initial wafts of roasted almonds, dark honeycomb, and espresso beans, followed by stewed plums, dried apricots, orange zest, and a touch of pipe tobacco. On the palate, it feels rich, oily, and mouth-coating, delivering an immediate wave of dark treacle tart, mocha, and candied ginger, before revealing mid-palate notes of dried figs, marzipan, and cinnamon sticks. The Palo Cortado wood influence introduces a distinct, savory nuttiness and structured dryness that balances GlenAllachie’s signature heather-honey sweetness. The finish is long, warm, and drying, leaving trailing impressions of charred oak, cocoa powder, roasted walnuts, and lingering baking spices.

Accolades

The GlenAllachie 11 Year Old Palo Cortado Sherry Cask Finish has received high acclaim across independent whisky review platforms and international spirits competitions. Earning 88–90+ point ratings on outlets like Whiskybase, Dramface, and Words of Whisky, critics routinely praise Billy Walker's cask management, noting how the rare Palo Cortado casks offer a drier, more sophisticated nut-and-spice complexity compared to standard, sweeter Oloroso or Pedro Ximénez wood finishes.

title: Glenallachie 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch #13
bodyHtml:
This unpeated single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, produced in Aberlour within the Speyside region. Handcrafted at The GlenAllachie Distillery under the master management of Billy Walker, Batch 13 stands as a landmark release in their iconic 10-Year-Old Cask Strength series. Distilled from heavy Speyside malted barley and aged for a decade in a rich multi-cask recipe, Batch 13 incorporates a intricate maturation blend of Pedro Ximénez sherry puncheons, Oloroso sherry puncheons, red wine casks, and virgin oak barrels. Bottled non-chill filtered and natural in color at a punchy strength of 119.6 proof (59.8% ABV), it delivers an explosive, dark-chocolate-and-berry-forward expression of GlenAllachie's muscular distillate.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a deep mahogany-ruby color in the glass. On the nose, it is dense, dark, and highly aromatic, bursting with aromas of dark black cherries, sticky date pudding, roasted walnuts, and espresso beans, underlaid by a strong streak of stem ginger, toasted oak, and heather honey. On the palate, it feels thick, oily, and mouth-coating, delivering an immediate rush of dark cocoa powder, plum jam, and marzipan from the PX and Oloroso wood, which quickly develops into red berry tannins, cinnamon bark, and charred oak from the red wine and virgin oak casks. The finish is long, warm, and drying, leaving trailing impressions of dark chocolate, orange oil, cracked black pepper, and lingering wood spice. The high 59.8% ABV proof supports the intense cask weight exceptionally well, benefiting from a few drops of water to open up floral honey and berry pie notes.

Accolades

GlenAllachie's 10 Year Old Cask Strength series holds legendary standing in the whisky community (notably kickstarted when Batch 4 won World's Best Single Malt at the World Whiskies Awards). Batch 13 maintains this elite reputation, earning 89–91+ point scores on independent outlets like Whiskybase, Dramface, and Words of Whisky. Reviewers praise Billy Walker’s skill in integrating virgin oak and red wine wood alongside dark sherry puncheons, achieving a vibrant balance of wood spice, red fruit, and dense dark-chocolate sweetness at cask strength.

title: Charles Smith Pinot Noir Wines of Substance 2021
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in the Washington region, specifically within the Columbia Valley AVA appellation, Wines of Substance 'Pn' Pinot Noir represents a distinctive, highly expressive, and modern approach to Pacific Northwest winemaking. Created by visionary winemaker Charles Smith, the Wines of Substance project aims to deliver single-varietal wines crafted with traditional small-batch techniques at exceptional value. The grapes are sourced from cool climate, high elevation vineyard sites across Washington State where gravelly, well draining soils allow Pinot Noir to flourish. Under the winemaking direction of Charles Smith and Brennan Leighton, the winemaking philosophy utilizes native yeast fermentation, 100% whole berry inclusion, gentle hand punch-downs, and maturation on fine lees in French oak barrels (approximately 25% new) for 12 months without fining or filtration. The result is an aromatic, fruit forward Pinot Noir that captures both cool climate tension and Washington fruit intensity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear translucent ruby red colour with soft garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe red cherry, wild raspberry, pomegranate, and red plum, interwoven with subtle notes of orange peel, dried rose petal, subtle forest floor, white pepper, and toasted cedar spice. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, silken, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of fresh red berries, dark cherry curd, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural cool climate acidity. Framed by velvety, fine-grained tannins and a supple, seamless mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruits, subtle savory spices, and a clean mineral grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it offers immediate drinking appeal along with cellaring potential over 3 to 6 years. Stylistically, it combines Washington fruit generosity, elegant whole-berry aromatics, and effortless food friendliness.

title: Heineken 330 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: Brewed to be the best since 1873. For over 150 years, a ceaseless commitment to purity and quality has made Heineken the most iconic beer brand in the world. When you see the red-star on the green bottle, you know every ice-cold, crisp sip will deliver that richly satisfying flavour with subtle fruity notes. A tradition of taste that his lived on for over a century and a half thanks to the simplicity and quality of the ingredients and the meticulous attention to the brewing process.

title: Coors Light 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Coors Light affectionately known as the "Silver Bullet" is a pillar of the global beer industry and one of the best-selling light lagers in history. Reintroduced by the Coors Brewing Company in 1978 to meet the rising demand for low-calorie lagers, it built its entire brand around extreme cold refreshment and its Rocky Mountain heritage. It is an ultra-light American Light Lager designed to strip away palate-coating malts and aggressive hop bitterness in favor of a crisp, clean, and effortlessly drinkable profile.

Beer Description

Coors Light pours a pale, sparkling straw-gold with crystal-clear clarity and a lively carbonation that supports a bright white foam head that fades rapidly.

Aroma: The nose is minimalist, clean, and cold-focused. It leads with dominant notes of sweet corn husks and faint cereal grain, followed by a nearly unnoticeable, herbal hop whisper. It is completely free of heavy yeast esters or deep malt scents.

Palate: On the tongue, it is very light-bodied with a snappy, effervescent, and watery mouthfeel. It opens with a quick flash of cracker sweetness, which is immediately washed away by its signature crispness. Bitterness is virtually non-existent, leaving an exceptionally short, dry, and clean finish that leaves zero aftertaste.

Profile: It sits at 4.2% ABV in the US (4.0% ABV in Canada) and a negligible bitterness of 10 IBU, containing just 102 calories per serving.

Technical Notes: Coors Light relies heavily on its signature process: it is lagered, filtered, and packaged cold ("Cold-Certified"). It uses two-row Moravian barley alongside corn as an adjunct. The corn provides fermentable sugars that lighten the body and reduce heavy proteins, allowing the beer to finish crisp without feeling dense.

title: Louis Latour Montagny Premier Cru ' La Grande Roche' 2024
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from France, within the Côte Chalonnaise subregion of Burgundy and the Montagny Premier Cru appellation. Founded in 1797, Maison Louis Latour is one of Burgundy's most iconic family-owned producers. La Grande Roche is a vineyard situated on steep, limestone-rich slopes at the highest elevations of Montagny. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation and aging without oak, preserving the site's intense mineral tension, pure fruit, and high-altitude freshness.

Wine Description

This wine displays a brilliant pale yellow hue with subtle green highlights. On the nose, it opens with crisp and expressive aromas of green apple, lemon zest, and white peach, accompanied by white acacia blossom and a distinctive stony minerality. On the palate, it exhibits a medium body with a rich yet linear structure, driven by a vibrant, mouthwatering acidity and a smooth, round mouthfeel. The finish is clean, dry, and persistent with lingering mineral notes.

title: Kilkerran Heavily Peated Batch 14
bodyHtml:
This heavily peated single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, produced in the Campbeltown region. Distilled from heavily peated malted barley (peated to approximately 50+ ppm) and matured in coastal dunnage warehouses, it is bottled uncut at a potent natural cask strength of 58.3% ABV without chill-filtration or color additives and it offers a raw, industrial, and deeply coastal expression of Campbeltown smoke.

Spirit Description

This single malt presents a pale straw to bright gold color in the glass. On the nose, it is immediate, pungent, and farmy, opening with dense waves of smoldering bonfire ash, creosote, and engine oil, quickly balanced by notes of sharp lemon curd, green apple skin, malted biscuits, and damp dunnage earth. The palate is full-bodied, thick, and aggressively oily, delivering an explosive arrival of soot, salted caramel, and cracked black pepper, before opening up into sweet vanilla cream, grapefruit zest, and charred pineapple. The finish is exceptionally long, warm, and drying, trailing off with lingering impressions of coastal sea spray, medicinal peat, citrus pith, and a lingering, smoky sootiness. The bourbon-forward maturation allows the bright citrus, raw grain, and industrial smoke of Glengyle's heavily peated distillate to take center stage.

Accolades Kilkerran Heavily Peated Batch 14 continues the stellar reputation of the Peat Progress lineup among Campbeltown enthusiasts and peat aficionados alike. Earning 88–91+ point ratings across independent platforms such as Whiskybase, Dramface, and Words of Whisky, reviewers frequently praise Batch 14 for its vibrant energy and precise cask balance, highlighting how the minor 10% sherry component adds a subtle layer of rounded complexity without sweetening or obscuring the intense, waxy peat profile.

title: Chateau Haut Brion 2009
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the Pessac Leognan appellation. Chateau Haut Brion is one of the most prestigious estates in the world, recognized as a First Growth (Premier Grand Cru Classe) in the historic 1855 Classification. The winery's philosophy focuses on expressing the ultimate character of its unique deep gravel soils, combining centuries of tradition with viticulture precision to craft wines of unmatched elegance and complexity.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep ruby red color with garnet highlights. On the nose, it offers an exceptionally complex bouquet of cassis, blackberry, tobacco leaf, cigar box, leather, graphite, and truffle, complemented by the estate's signature smoky nuances. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a powerful yet velvety texture, supported by densely woven, silky tannins, balanced freshness, and remarkable fruit concentration. The finish is extraordinarily long, persistent, and refined.

Vintage Quality

The 2009 vintage is widely regarded as one of the greatest in Bordeaux history. Exceptional weather conditions featuring a warm, sun-drenched summer paired with cool nights; allowed for optimal grape ripening, enabling the winemaker to craft a wine of monumental richness, balance, and aging potential.

title: Silver Oak Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in the California region, specifically within the Napa Valley AVA appellation, Silver Oak Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 represents an iconic, benchmark, and world-renowned expression of American winemaking. Founded in 1972 by Raymond Twomey Duncan and Justin Meyer, Silver Oak is famous for its singular focus on producing exclusively Cabernet Sauvignon aged in American oak. Sourced from prime vineyard sites across Oakville, Rutherford, Calistoga, and Atlas Peak, the vines grow on diverse gravelly loam and volcanic soils. Under winemaker Nate Weis, the winemaking philosophy incorporates meticulous berry sorting, plot-by-plot vinification, and extensive maturation for 24 months in 100% new American oak barrels crafted at the winery's own Missouri cooperage, followed by 15 months of bottle aging prior to release. Formatted here in a 1.5 Litre Magnum bottle, this large format allows for a slower rate of oxygen exchange, extending the wine's cellaring trajectory and enhancing structural complexity.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark garnet red colour with vibrant ruby reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of cassis, black cherry preserves, dark plum compote, and wild blackberry, interwoven with iconic notes of toasted American oak, vanilla bean, coconut, freshly ground coffee, dill spice, and cigar box cedar. On the palate, it is full bodied, velvety, and expansive, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, cocoa powder, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained tannins and a supple, coat-the-mouth mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruits, sweet spice, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon blended with small amounts of Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot, and Malbec, this 2017 1.5 Litre Magnum release offers an optimal drinking window of 2024–2045+. Stylistically, it combines classic Silver Oak plushness, seamless oak integration, and long term cellaring potential.

title: Louis Latour Volnay Premier Cru 'En Chevret' 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from France, within the Côte de Beaune region of Burgundy and the Volnay Premier Cru appellation. Founded in 1797, Maison Louis Latour is one of Burgundy's most historic family-owned negociant-growers. The En Chevret vineyard sits at the base of the slope bordering Meursault, where clay and limestone soils produce supple, perfume-driven expressions of Pinot Noir. The winery's philosophy emphasizes traditional open-vat fermentations and short aging in medium-toasted French oak barrels to preserve site-specific aromatics, elegance, and balance.

Wine Description

This wine displays a dark ruby color. On the nose, it opens with lifted, expressive aromas of blackcurrant, dark cherry, and liquorice, complemented by nuances of dried herbs, potpourri, and subtle spice. On the palate, it exhibits a full, round body with fine-tuned, grippy tannins and energetic natural acidity framing a pure core of dark berry fruit. The finish is long, structured, and refreshing with lingering mineral and spice accents. The varietal composition is 100% Pinot Noir. It has an alcohol content of 13% ABV and is not certified organic.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in Burgundy was marked by warm summer conditions and a generous harvest, permitting grapes to achieve ideal ripeness. For En Chevret, these conditions resulted in a rich, fruit-forward profile balanced by vibrant acidity and well-integrated structural tannins, offering both immediate appeal and excellent cellaring potential.

title: La Rioja Alta Finca Martelo Reserva 2021
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Spain, within the Rioja Alavesa subregion of DOCa Rioja. Produced at the Torre de Oña estate, which is owned by the renowned La Rioja Alta S.A. group, Finca Martelo represents a modern, terroir-driven expression of historic 60+-year-old vines grown at high altitude. The winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing site specificity through plot-by-plot selection, initial cold maceration, and aging in a combination of American and French oak barrels to balance vibrant fruit freshness with structured elegance.

Wine Description

This wine displays an intense ruby red color with dark garnet highlights. On the nose, it opens with an expressive bouquet of fresh dark cherry, ripe plum, and red berries, interwoven with notes of sweet vanilla, cocoa, clove, dried herbs, and subtle balsamic undertones. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full body with a silky, balanced texture, supported by fine, chalky tannins and vibrant natural acidity. The finish is long, complex, and persistent with lingering dark fruit, spice, and mineral notes. The varietal composition is a traditional field blend featuring 95% Tempranillo complemented by 5% Mazuelo, Garnacha, and Viura. It has an alcohol content of 14.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Cimarron Tequila Blanco
bodyHtml:
Cimarron Tequila Blanco is an acclaimed, bartender-favorite 100% Blue Weber agave tequila produced at the historic Enrique Fonseca distillery (DPO / NOM 1146 Tequila Scagliotti) in Atotonilco el Alto, Jalisco, Mexico. Created through a partnership between Master Distiller Enrique Fonseca and Haas Brothers, Cimarron was specifically engineered to deliver an uncompromised, additive-free artisanal Highland (Los Altos) tequila at a high-value, accessible price point. Named after the wild, unbridled "Cimarron" horses, it has earned a cult following among professional mixologists as one of the best speed-rail and cocktail-foundational Blancos in the industry.

Spirit Description

Cimarron Blanco is crafted using 100% estate-grown Highland Blue Weber agaves harvested at high sugar maturity (brix) from fields situated over 4,600 feet above sea level. The agaves are slow-cooked using a combination of traditional brick ovens (hornos) and low-pressure autoclaves to preserve the bright, sweet character of the plant. A defining feature of Cimarron’s production is its unique fermentation: it uses a propriety blend of wine yeasts and undergoes an unusually long, slow, low-temperature fermentation process in stainless steel tanks, resulting in a rich, ester-driven flavor profile. It is double-distilled in a combination of copper pot stills and column stills, then bottled directly without aging.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and transparent with medium legs in the glass.

  • Aroma: Bright, vibrant, and agave-forward. Opens with rich roasted agave, fresh-cut grass, crisp lime zest, and white pepper, followed by subtle mineral notes, green apple, and a touch of tropical fruitiness.

  • Palate: Crisp, clean, and full of flavor on the entry. Upfront sweet cooked agave and bright citrus (lemon and lime peel) blend seamlessly with wet-stone minerality, black pepper, and subtle herbal undertones.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, bright, and surprisingly oily mouthfeel for an unaged spirit.

  • Finish: Crisp, dry, and warm, leaving a long, pleasant trail of sweet roasted agave, citrus oil, and a snappy peppery kick.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Dolin Bitter De Chambery
bodyHtml:
This sweet vermouth displays a clear, garnet-red hue with warm copper-amber highlights in the glass. On the nose, it is floral, aromatic, and lifted, opening with initial aromas of dried rose petals, stewed strawberries, and orange peel, underlaid by a strong streak of alpine herbs, chamomile, forest floor, and soft cinnamon spice. On the palate, it feels light-to-medium-bodied, silky, and crisp, delivering a gentle, fruit-forward sweetness of stewed plums, candied citrus zest, and brown sugar, before transitioning into a dry, refreshing mid-palate driven by pine needle, wormwood bitterness, and clove. The finish is clean, medium-length, and refreshing, leaving trailing impressions of citrus oil, alpine botanicals, and a crisp, herbal dryness that avoids any cloying coat on the tongue.

Accolades

Dolin Rouge is universally celebrated by craft bartenders, sommeliers, and cocktail historians as an essential, foundational modifier in classic mixology. Garnering 90+ point ratings across platforms like Difford's Guide and Distiller, critics routinely laud Dolin for its elegance and botanical restraint, noting that its lighter French style allows underlying base spirits (such as craft gin, rye whiskey, or mezcal) to shine through without being smothered by heavy caramel or sugar syrup.

title: Dolin Genepy le Chamois Liqueur
bodyHtml:
This liqueur displays a clear, natural pale yellow-green hue with chartreuse highlights in the glass. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic, piney, and lifted, opening with bold wafts of crushed mint, alpine pine needles, and fresh wormwood blossoms, underlaid by lemon verbena, chamomile, and subtle baking spice (cardamom and clove). On the palate, it feels oily, medium-bodied, and vibrant, delivering a bright surge of peppermint, candied citrus peel, and herbal honey. The 45.0% ABV proof gives it a warm, firm structure that cuts through the sugar content, transitioning mid-palate into a crisp, refreshing, and resinous bitterness reminiscent of mountain herbs and dried eucalyptus. The finish is long, clean, and herbal, leaving trailing impressions of pine sap, cooling peppermint, citrus zest, and a gentle, warming botanical dryness.

Accolades

Dolin Génépy le Chamois is widely celebrated by craft bartenders and spirits connoisseurs as the definitive benchmark for classic Génépy liqueurs. Earning 90+ point ratings on platforms like Difford's Guide and Distiller, critics routinely praise it as an essential cocktail modifier and digestif. Reviewers frequently highlight its ability to deliver the complex herbaceousness and proofs of classic monastic herbal liqueurs at a far more approachable price point and with a lighter, less syrupy sugar balance.

title: Banfi Rosso Di Montalcino 2024
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Italy, within Tuscany's renowned Montalcino region. Castello Banfi was founded in 1978 by the Mariani family in collaboration with legendary enologist Ezio Rivella, establishing a pioneering estate dedicated to advanced clonal research and sustainable viticulture. The winery's philosophy centers on state-of-the-art winemaking techniques that honor traditional Tuscan heritage, crafting accessible expressions of Sangiovese alongside long-aging Brunello.

Wine Description

This bright ruby red wine opens with intense, fresh aromas of red cherry, plum, and red currant, accompanied by delicate hints of violet, sweet spices, and subtle oak. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full body with a supple, round mouthfeel, supple tannins, and a vibrant, mouthwatering acidity. The finish is clean, harmonious, and persistent with lingering notes of dark berry and dried herbs. The varietal composition is 100% Sangiovese (locally known as Sangiovese Grosso). It has an alcohol content of 14% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Dolin Vermouth de Chambery Blanc - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
The Dolin Vermouth de Chambéry Blanc is a refined, slightly sweeter vermouth from the only vermouth-producing region with an official AOC designation in France—Chambéry. Known for its floral and balanced profile, this vermouth is crafted from a base of white wine, fortified with sugar, and infused with a blend of more than 50 herbs and botanicals native to the Alpine region.

Colour: Clear, with a subtle golden tint.
Aroma: Delicate notes of elderflower, citrus peel, and alpine herbs, with hints of honey and white flowers.
Palate: Lightly sweet and floral, with flavors of candied fruit, lemon balm, and subtle herbs. It has a smooth texture, offering a gentle sweetness balanced by mild bitterness.
Body: Medium-bodied, with a soft, elegant mouthfeel.
Finish: Refreshing, with lingering notes of citrus and herbs.

The Dolin Blanc is often enjoyed as an aperitif on its own, served chilled or over ice with a twist of lemon. It also pairs well in cocktails that call for a sweeter vermouth, such as a reverse martini or with sparkling water for a simple spritz

title: Chateau Lagrange 2014
bodyHtml:
This red wine is from France, produced in the Bordeaux region within the Saint Julien subregion. Chateau Lagrange is a historic Third Growth estate that was originally planted in the early 16th century and became the largest wine-producing estate in the Médoc after the unification of two domains. The Japanese group Suntory acquired the property in 1983, initiating a complete restructuring of the vineyard and a modernization of the winemaking facilities to emphasize precision and uncompromised quality. The winery's philosophy is rooted in expressing its unique terroir composed of 17 different soil types by vinifying over 100 individual plots separately before blending.

Wine Description

The 2014 Chateau Lagrange presents a dark red colour with purple hues. The nose is intense and aromatic, featuring scents of black cherry, blackcurrant, and raspberry mingled with notes of rose, cedar, sandalwood, and tobacco. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with an elegant, fleshy attack and a core of intense red fruit, pomegranate, and smoke. It is characterized by its refined balance, vibrant acidity, and firm, grainy tannins that lead into a long, sophisticated finish. This red Bordeaux blend consists of 76% Cabernet Sauvignon, 18% Merlot, and 6% Petit Verdot. It has an ABV of 13.5% and is best enjoyed from 2024 through 2045.

Vintage Quality

The 2014 vintage in Saint Julien is considered a great success for Chateau Lagrange, resulting in a wine with more precision than the 2006 or 2008 vintages. Harvest occurred from September 25 until October 17, and the year featured a particularly high concentration of Cabernet Sauvignon, which provided the wine with a powerful structure and long-term aging potential.

title: Plessis Duval Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from France, within the Loire Valley region. Plessis Duval is a long-established Loire producer dedicated to showcasing the classic terroirs of the region through sustainable vineyard management. The winery's philosophy emphasizes highlighting authentic grape character, crafting wines that reflect the cool climate and diverse mineral soils of the Loire Valley with crisp purity and freshness.

Wine Description

This pale straw green wine opens with vibrant aromas of pink grapefruit, lime zest, and white flowers, accompanied by notes of gooseberry, fresh-cut grass, and a subtle flinty minerality. On the palate, it is crisp and light-bodied with a lively, mouthwatering acidity that drives the flavors of citrus and green apple. The finish is clean, refreshing, and persistent with lingering mineral notes.

title: Road 13 Sparkling Chenin Blanc 2019
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Canada, within British Columbia's South Okanagan Valley in the Golden Mile Bench region. Road 13 Vineyards is known for working with some of the oldest Chenin Blanc vines in North America, planted on glacial gravel soils. The winery's philosophy focuses on traditional-method sparkling production, low intervention, and harvesting at optimal acidity to preserve the vineyard's rich heritage and site-specific purity.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine displays a brilliant pale straw hue with a delicate, fine-beaded mousse. On the nose, it opens with bright aromas of green apple, ripe pear, citrus zest, and honeysuckle, accompanied by subtle nuances of toasty brioche and yeast from extended lees aging. On the palate, it exhibits a light to medium body with a lively, mouthwatering acidity and a creamy texture. Vibrant tree fruit and lemon flavors lead into a long, clean finish with a pronounced stony minerality.

title: Dolin Vermouth De Chambery Dry
bodyHtml:
The Dolin Vermouth de Chambéry Dry is a classic French vermouth known for its light and herbal style, originating from the Chambéry region, which holds the only protected designation of origin (AOC) for vermouth in France.

Colour: Pale yellow with a clear and bright appearance.
Aroma: Aromatic notes of alpine herbs, citrus peel, and subtle florals, including chamomile and elderflower.
Palate: Delicate and dry, featuring flavors of fresh herbs, lemon verbena, and green apple, with a gentle bitterness from wormwood.
Body: Light-bodied with a refreshing texture.
Finish: Crisp, with lingering herbal and citrus notes.

Dolin Dry Vermouth is made using a base of Ugni Blanc wine, fortified with a blend of more than 50 botanicals such as rose petals, chamomile, and gentian. This vermouth is celebrated for its balance of subtle sweetness and bitterness, making it an essential ingredient in classic cocktails like the Martini, where it allows the gin to shine through without overpowering the drink.

With an ABV of 17.5%, it is versatile for use in both cocktails and as an aperitif on its own, served over ice with a twist of lemon. Dolin’s dedication to using natural infusions rather than extracts contributes to the complexity and elegance of this vermouth, distinguishing it from many other commercial vermouths on the market.

title: Dolin Vermouth De Chambery Rouge - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
This historic sweet red vermouth originates from France, produced in Chambéry within the French Alps (Savoy). Crafted by Maison Dolin—founded in 1821 by Joseph Chavasse and later named after Ferdinand Dolin—this expression remains the benchmark for Vermouth de Chambéry, the only protected Appellation d'Origine (AOC) for vermouth in France. Built upon a base of neutral white wine (sourced primarily from regional Ugni Blanc and Clairette grapes), it is infused with a proprietary recipe of over 50 alpine herbs, flowers, and spices, including wormwood, hyssop, mountain thyme, and cinchona bark. Sweetened naturally and colored with caramel, it is bottled at 32 proof (16.0% ABV), standing out as a distinctly lighter, drier, and more botanical alternative to heavy Italian sweet vermouths.

Spirit Description

This sweet vermouth displays a clear, garnet-red hue with warm copper-amber highlights in the glass. On the nose, it is floral, aromatic, and lifted, opening with initial aromas of dried rose petals, stewed strawberries, and orange peel, underlaid by a strong streak of alpine herbs, chamomile, forest floor, and soft cinnamon spice. On the palate, it feels light-to-medium-bodied, silky, and crisp, delivering a gentle, fruit-forward sweetness of stewed plums, candied citrus zest, and brown sugar, before transitioning into a dry, refreshing mid-palate driven by pine needle, wormwood bitterness, and clove. The finish is clean, medium-length, and refreshing, leaving trailing impressions of citrus oil, alpine botanicals, and a crisp, herbal dryness that avoids any cloying coat on the tongue.

Accolades

Dolin Rouge is universally celebrated by craft bartenders, sommeliers, and cocktail historians as an essential, foundational modifier in classic mixology. Garnering 90+ point ratings across platforms like Difford's Guide and Distiller, critics routinely laud Dolin for its elegance and botanical restraint, noting that its lighter French style allows underlying base spirits (such as craft gin, rye whiskey, or mezcal) to shine through without being smothered by heavy caramel or sugar syrup.

title: Dolin Creme de Violette - 350 ml
bodyHtml: If you’re a fan of floral liqueurs like St-Germain but you haven’t yet experienced the flowery delight of Dolin crème de violette, stop what you’re doing right now and go buy a bottle. Made with violet buds and blossoms, crème de violette is one of the oldest and most unique tasting liqueurs. Best of all, once you procure a bottle of the purple-hued spirit, you can make one of the most underrated cocktails of all time: the Aviation.

title: Amatitena Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Amatiteña Extra Añejo Tequila is a flagship, ultra-aged artisanal expression produced in Amatitán, Jalisco, Mexico (NOM 1477 Tequila Selecto de Amatitán) under Master Distiller Alberto Partida. Rooted in ancestral Lowland (Valles) craftsmanship, Amatiteña is distinguished by its dedication to traditional, wood-fired production methods that predate modern industrial tequila making. Aged well beyond the three-year legal minimum for the Extra Añejo designation, this additive-free spirit marries the bold, wood-cooked agave character of Amatitán with profound barrel depth, oak complexity, and dried fruit richness.

Spirit Description

Amatiteña Extra Añejo begins with mature, estate-grown 100% Blue Weber agaves harvested from the Lowlands. In keeping with ancient traditions, the agave piñas are cooked in mesquite and oak-fired brick ovens (hornos), imparting a signature whisper of natural wood smoke. The cooked agaves are crushed entirely using a volcanic stone tahona wheel and fermented with airborne wild yeasts in open wooden vats alongside the agave fibers (bagazo). Distilled in small copper pot stills, the spirit enters select oak barrels often ex-bourbon and charred American white oak—where it rests undisturbed for a minimum of 3 to 5 years. Unfiltered and completely additive-free, it bridges Lowland agave intensity with mature wood elegance.

  • Colour: Deep amber-mahogany with warm copper and dark gold reflections, forming thick, slow-moving legs in the glass.

  • Aroma: Deeply complex, warm, and inviting. Opens with rich roasted agave, mesquite wood smoke, and dark caramel, giving way to dried figs, dark chocolate, toasted oak, vanilla bean, and soft baking spices (cinnamon and nutmeg).

  • Palate: Rich, full-bodied, and multi-layered on the entry. Upfront flavors of sweet cooked agave, dark honey, and gentle wood smoke seamlessly merge with butterscotch, toasted nuts, dark cocoa, leather, and subtle dried citrus peel.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a luxurious, velvety, and viscous mouth-coating texture.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long, warm, and satisfying, trailing off with persistent roasted oak tannins, sweet cooked agave, dark chocolate, and a delicate mineral-and-smoke snap.

  • ABV: Typically bottled between 42% and 45% ABV (84 to 90 Proof).

title: Chateau Calet 2019
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from France, within the Right Bank of the Bordeaux region and the Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux appellation. Château Calet is situated on clay-limestone soils overlooking the Gironde estuary. The winery practices sustainable viticulture that respects the soil, focusing on minimal-intervention methods to capture the authentic, fruit-forward charm and earthy structure characteristic of the Côtes de Bordeaux.

Wine Description

This deep ruby red wine displays dense aromas of ripe dark plum, blackberry, and dark cherry, accompanied by smoky nuances, subtle herbal accents, and delicate baking spice. On the palate, it exhibits a fleshy, medium-to-full body with a rich core of ripe black fruits, framed by firm, chalky tannins and a balanced, mouthwatering acidity. The finish is savory, dry, and persistent with lingering notes of dark fruit, leather, and smoke. The varietal composition is a Merlot-dominant Right Bank blend consisting of 90% Merlot and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon (with small proportions of Cabernet Franc in select parcels). It has an alcohol content of 13.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Chateau de Beaucastel Chateauneuf du Pape 2019
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Southern Rhône region, specifically within the Châteauneuf du Pape AOC appellation, Château de Beaucastel Châteauneuf du Pape 2019 represents a monumental, historic, and benchmark expression of Southern Rhône winemaking. Owned and managed by the Perrin family across five generations, Beaucastel is widely revered as one of the iconic estates of France, pioneering organic farming since 1950 and biodynamic viticulture since 1974. Uniquely among producers in the appellation, Beaucastel incorporates all 13 authorized grape varieties into its blend, sourced from an estate vineyard characterized by rolled marine pebbles (galets roulés), molasse, and limestone-rich clay soils. Under the direction of the Perrin family, the winemaking philosophy utilizes rapid flash heating of skins to preserve aromatics, separate vinification for each variety, ambient yeast fermentation in temperature controlled oak vats, and maturation in large neutral oak foudres for 12 months. The result is a deeply complex red blend that marries Mourvèdre-driven power with lush vintage richness and legendary cellaring capacity.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, multidimensional bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, fig compote, and cassis, interwoven with sophisticated notes of garrigue herbs, dried lavender, game, cured leather, crushed stone, black truffle, and warm cedar spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, opulent, and mouth-filling, delivering concentrated flavours of black fruit, licorice, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, muscular tannins and an extraordinarily dense mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark berries, wild thyme, black pepper, and a clean gravelly mineral grip. Composed of a masterfully balanced blend dominated by Mourvèdre and Grenache alongside Syrah, Cinsault, and all other traditional appellation varieties, this 2019 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2050+. Stylistically, it combines classic Beaucastel structure, rustic complexity, and the opulent fruit intensity of the warm 2019 growing season.

title: Chateau de Beaucastel Chateauneuf du Pape 2020
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Southern Rhône region, specifically within the Châteauneuf du Pape AOC appellation, Château de Beaucastel Châteauneuf du Pape 2020 represents a monumental, historic, and benchmark expression of Southern Rhône winemaking. Owned and managed by the Perrin family across five generations, Beaucastel is widely revered as one of the iconic estates of France, pioneering organic farming since 1950 and biodynamic viticulture since 1974. The result is a deeply complex red blend that marries Mouvèdre-driven structure with pristine fruit concentration and legendary cellaring capacity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, dark ruby red colour with intense violet reflections along the rim. An expressive, multidimensional bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe blackberry, dark cherry, cassis, and poached black plum, interwoven with sophisticated notes of garrigue herbs, lavender, game, cured leather, crushed stone, black pepper, and subtle pipe tobacco. On the palate, it is full bodied, velvety, and expansive, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, fig curd, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained, muscular tannins and an extraordinarily dense mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruits, licorice, wild thyme, and a clean gravelly mineral grip. Composed of a masterfully balanced blend dominated by Mourvèdre and Grenache alongside Syrah, Cinsault, and all other traditional appellation varieties, this 2020 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2050+. Stylistically, it combines classic Beaucastel power, rustic complexity, and the exceptionally fresh, harmonious balance of the 2020 vintage.

title: Chateau Bel Air 2018
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from France, within the Bordeaux region. Multiple estates carry the "Bel Air" name across the region, most notably Château de Bel-Air in Lalande-de-Pomerol as well as classic Bordeaux and Bordeaux Supérieur châteaux. The winemaking approach emphasizes classic Left and Right Bank traditions, blending traditional red varieties with time spent aging in French oak to highlight pure dark fruit expression and regional balance.

Wine Description

This deep ruby wine opens with expressive aromas of ripe blackberry, cassis, and dark plum, complemented by savory notes of tobacco leaf, subtle spice, and gentle oak. On the palate, it exhibits a medium body with a rich core of dark fruit flavors, well-integrated tannins, and a fresh, bright acidity. The finish is clean, smooth, and dry with subtle minerality and lingering spice. The varietal composition is a classic Bordeaux blend, typically dominated by Merlot alongside Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc.

title: Paul Mas Cote Mas White 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from France, within the Languedoc-Roussillon region under the IGP Pays d'Oc / Vin de France designation. Domaines Paul Mas was pioneered in 2000 by Jean-Claude Mas, who champions the philosophy of "Le Luxe Rural" delivering everyday luxury through accessible, modern wines rooted in traditional Mediterranean terroir. The Côté Mas range highlights sustainable viticulture across the sunny clay-limestone hillsides of southern France, crafting crisp, fruit-forward white blends designed for immediate enjoyment and exceptional value.

Wine Description

This wine presents a brilliant, light straw-yellow color with greenish highlights. It opens with an expressive, aromatic nose of white peach, pear, and green apple, layered with notes of citrus blossom, grapefruit, and tropical fruit. On the palate, it exhibits a medium body with a rich yet lively mouthfeel, balanced by crisp, mouthwatering acidity and pure stone fruit flavors. The finish is clean, dry, and refreshing with subtle mineral and herbal accents. The varietal composition is a traditional Mediterranean white blend featuring Grenache Blanc, Vermentino, Sauvignon Blanc, and Viognier.

title: Luigi Bosca Leon Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Argentina, within the Mendoza region and the high-altitude terroirs of the Uco Valley and Luján de Cuyo. Bodega Luigi Bosca, founded in 1901 by Leoncio Arizu, is one of Argentina's most historic family-owned wineries. The "León" bottling, part of the winery's flagship collection, pays tribute to founder Leoncio Arizu's vision and legacy. The winemaking philosophy focuses on low-intervention viticulture, high-altitude precision, and traditional barrel maturation to highlight the concentration, elegance, and aging capacity of Mendoza Cabernet Sauvignon.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep, dark ruby red color. On the nose, it opens with intense, pure aromas of dark fruits like blackberry, cassis, and blueberry, complemented by peppery, herbal nuances of black pepper and rosemary alongside subtle roasted oak notes. On the palate, it is compact, markedly structured, and full-bodied, framed by fine, ripe tannins and balanced acidity that delivers a smooth mouthfeel and an elegant, persistent finish.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in Mendoza benefited from cool night temperatures and bright high-altitude sunshine, promoting steady grape development and excellent concentration. These optimal conditions allowed the Cabernet Sauvignon fruit to achieve full phenolic maturity and refined tannin structure while preserving the bright natural acidity essential for long-term aging.

title: Paul Mas Cote Mas Red 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from France, within the Languedoc-Roussillon region under the Pays d'Oc IGP designation. Domaines Paul Mas was pioneered in 2000 by Jean-Claude Mas, who champions the philosophy of "Le Luxe Rural" delivering everyday luxury through accessible, modern wines rooted in traditional Mediterranean terroir. The Côté Mas range highlights sustainable viticulture across the sunny, gravelly clay-limestone soils of southern France, crafting fruit-forward wines that offer remarkable value and immediate charm.

Wine Description

This wine displays a garnet-red color with purplish glints. It opens with an intense, fruity nose of ripe black fruits, dark cherry, and wild raspberry, complemented by notes of garrigue herbs, liquorice, and soft spice. On the palate, it exhibits a medium body with a supple, rounded mouthfeel, juicy berry flavors, and soft, well-integrated tannins. The finish is smooth, clean, and balanced with hints of fresh liquorice. The varietal composition is a classic Mediterranean blend of Grenache, Syrah, Carignan, Merlot, and Cinsault.

title: Giffard Caramel Toffee
bodyHtml:
Giffard Caramel Toffee (often featured as Crème de Caramel au Beurre Salé or Caramel Toffee Liqueur) is a specialty French liqueur produced by Giffard in Angers, Loire Valley, France. Founded in 1885 by Emile Giffard, the family-owned company is globally renowned for crafting premium liqueurs and syrups using natural ingredients and traditional maceration techniques. The Caramel Toffee expression offers a luxurious blend of caramelized sugar, rich butter, and a touch of sea salt, creating a rich, indulgent profile designed for elevated mixology and dessert pairings.

2. Liqueur Description

Giffard Caramel Toffee is crafted using pure sugar beet caramel, fresh cream, butter, and natural flavorings, balanced with a subtle hint of sea salt (referencing classic Breton salted butter caramel). The ingredients are blended into a stable, velvety liqueur base without artificial preservatives. The result is an intensely flavorful, dessert-like spirit that delivers the warmth of cooked sugar alongside creamy, buttery richness and a balancing savory edge.

  • Colour: Deep golden amber with rich copper and caramel highlights.

  • Aroma: Intensely aromatic and rich, opening with warm caramelized sugar, butterscotch, and melted toffee, followed by hints of cooked cream, vanilla, and sweet roasted nuts.

  • Palate: Luxurious, sweet, and coating on the entry. Upfront flavors of dark caramel, buttery toffee, and dulce de leche yield to a subtle hint of sea salt, vanilla cream, and toasted sugar.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a rich, velvety, and mouth-coating viscosity.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and decadent, trailing off with persistent notes of sweet butterscotch, salted caramel, and a gentle creaminess.

  • ABV: Bottled at 18% ABV (36 Proof).

title: Canadian Club Classic 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Canadian Club Classic 12 Year Old Small Batch Canadian Whisky is a flagship aged expression produced at the historic Canadian Club Distillery in Windsor, Ontario, Canada (owned by Beam Suntory). Established in 1858 by Hiram Walker, Canadian Club is one of the most storied names in North American distilling history. Unlike many whiskies that blend spirits after aging, Canadian Club employs a signature "blending before aging" technique marrying select grain distillates before placing them into oak barrels to mature together for a full decade and a two-year bonus. The 12-year expression represents an elevated, rich, and wood-influenced evolution of the brand's classic profile.

Spirit Description

Canadian Club Classic 12 Year Old is crafted from a precise grain bill of rye, rye malt, corn, and barley malt. Distilled in continuous column stills for smoothness, the spirits are blended together prior to entering charred white American oak barrels. The whisky then matures for 12 full years in Windsor’s climate-controlled rackhouses. This extended aging allows the corn spirit to develop a deep, creamy vanilla foundation while the rye and barley components absorb rich oak tannins and warm spice from the wood.

  • Colour: Deep golden amber with bronze glints.

  • Aroma: Soft, warm, and inviting, opening with rich vanilla, butterscotch, and sweet corn, followed by toasted oak, dried fruit, and a pleasant rye baking spice.

  • Palate: Full, smooth, and well-rounded on the entry. Upfront sweet flavors of caramel, honey, and vanilla bean blend with toasted oak, gentle rye spice, and a hint of dark nuttiness.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a smooth, velvety, and creamy mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and comforting, trailing off with persistent sweet oak, dark sugar, vanilla, and a soft peppery spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Hennessy Premium XXO - 1 Litre
bodyHtml:
This extra-extra-old Cognac originates from France, produced in the prestigious Cognac region. Crafted by the historic House of Hennessy (founded in 1765), Hennessy XXO was first introduced in 1872 by 4th generation Master Blender Maurice Hennessy and re-released in 2017 to reinvigorate this rare, official Cognac category designation. Created under the supervision of 8th generation Master Blender Renaud Fillioux de Gironde, it is blended exclusively from extra-aged eaux-de-vie sourced primarily from Cognac's most prestigious cru, Grande Champagne.
