To meet the strict official XXO designation established in 2018, every eau-de-vie in the blend must be aged for a minimum of 14 years in French oak barrels, though many component spirits in Hennessy XXO are matured far longer. Bottled at a signature drinking strength of 80 proof (40.0% ABV) in an oversized, faceted 1-Litre decanter, it represents the apex of structural elegance and oak maturation within Hennessy's core lineup, bridging the gap between XO and Paradis.

Spirit Description

This Cognac displays a deep amber, mahogany hue with rich copper-red reflections in the glass. The nose is extraordinarily rich, dense, and expressive, opening with intense notes of dried figs, candied orange peel, and dark raisins, backed by delicate floral aromas of dried roses, nutmeg, fresh grated cinnamon, and a pronounced streak of aged rancio (leather, polished mahogany, and forest floor). On the palate, it is full-bodied, velvety, and exceptionally round, delivering a luxurious wave of dark chocolate, bitter orange marmalade, and roasted hazelnut, counterbalanced by sweet vanilla bean, clove, and fine French oak tannins. The finish is remarkably long, warm, and lingering, trailing off with soft notes of dried fruit, delicate spices, old oak, and a lingering floral elegance.

Accolades

Hennessy XXO is widely praised by spirits connoisseurs and Cognac purists as a triumph of master blending. It earned a prestigious Double Gold Medal and 98 Points at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition (where it was awarded Best Cognac Extra-Old), alongside glowing ratings across independent luxury platforms such as Robb Report and Cognac Expert. Critics routinely laud it for its seamless integration of heavy rancio and delicate spice, highlighting its ability to showcase the aging potential of Grande Champagne eaux-de-vie without becoming overly dry or wood-tannic.

title: Michter's US*1 Barrel Strength Rye (Limited Release)
bodyHtml:
Michter's US1 Barrel Strength Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey is a highly acclaimed, limited-allocation single barrel release from Michter’s Distillery in Louisville, Kentucky. Unlike their core US1 Single Barrel Rye (bottled at 84.8 proof), this expression is drawn directly from individual barrels at full cask strength. A signature aspect of Michter's process is entering the spirit into fire-charred new American white oak barrels at an exceptionally low barrel-entry proof of 103. This allows more water-soluble oak sugars to dissolve into the distillate during maturation, resulting in a rich, viscous mouthfeel and an approachable heat profile despite its cask strength.

Spirit Description

Because it is a single barrel product bottled at barrel strength, exact proofs vary slightly by barrel and release batch (typically hovering between 108 and 115 proof).

  • Colour: Dark copper amber with rich mahogany highlights.

  • Aroma: A forceful, complex nose brimming with butterscotch, sharp cinnamon, burnt orange peel, graham cracker, leather, and dark cherry.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and remarkably oily; layers of blackstrap molasses, toasted rye spice, rich vanilla, and dark cocoa give way to burnt sugar and subtle baking spices.

  • Body: Heavy, velvety, and mouth-coating with a remarkably low alcohol burn due to the low barrel-entry proof.

  • Finish: Long, warming, and punchy, ending with lingering notes of gingerbread, dry oak tannins, peppery rye, and dark caramel.

  • ABV: Varies by barrel; typically ranges between 54% and 57.5% ABV (108 to 115 Proof).

title: Duckhorn Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and elegant red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the premier Napa Valley region in California. Founded in 1976 by Dan and Margaret Duckhorn, Duckhorn Vineyards is an iconic Napa institution that originally gained fame for its pioneering work with Merlot before becoming equally renowned for its classic, balanced Cabernet Sauvignon. The winemaking philosophy, led by winemaker Renée Ary, focuses on site-specific expression, blending fruit from both estate vineyards and independent growers to capture the "soul" of the valley floor and mountain fruit.

Wine Description

Duckhorn Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep ruby colour with a complex sensory profile. The nose is aromatic and expressive, featuring notes of dark red berries, boysenberry pie, and cardamom, alongside hints of blueberry, blackcurrant, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and polished, showcasing a "seamless blend of elegance and strength" with flavours of fig jam, boysenberry, and cocoa. It is characterized by its dusty, firm tannins and dynamic acidity, leading to a long, focused finish.

title: Vecchio Magazzino Doganale 'Bergamotto Fantastico' Liquore - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This artisanal citrus liqueur originates from Italy, produced in Montalto Uffugo in northern Calabria. Handcrafted by Vecchio Magazzino Doganale—the famed rural distillery behind Jefferson Amaro Importante led by Ivano Trombino—this release celebrates Calabria’s native citrus jewel, the Calabrian Bergamot (Citrus bergamia). Crafted using natural infusions of fresh bergamot orange peels harvested between November and February, the recipe is complemented by subtle botanical extractions of native bitter herbs and flowers. Bottled at a substantial strength of 64 proof (32.0% ABV)—significantly higher than typical commercial citrus liqueurs—it offers a farm-to-bottle, rustic, and essential oil-driven representation of Calabrian terroir.

Spirit Description

This liqueur presents a pale greenish-yellow, natural citrus-clouded hue in the glass. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic, pungent, and lifted, exploding with fresh bergamot essential oils, crushed citrus leaves, and Earl Grey tea notes, backed by subtle undertones of pine needle, dried chamomile, and lemongrass. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, silky, and strikingly vibrant, delivering a bright surge of candied citrus peel, tart bergamot juice, and lemon blossom sweetness. The higher 32% ABV content provides a firm alcohol backbone that carries the intense citrus oils across the palate without feeling overly syrupy, while a gentle herbal bitterness from the botanical infusion emerges mid-palate. The finish is crisp, long, and zesty, leaving trailing notes of citrus zest, essential oil dryness, subtle salinity, and a clean, refreshing herbal bitterness.

Accolades

Bergamotto Fantastico holds elite critical standing among top European sommeliers, mixologists, and spirits purists. Produced by Vecchio Magazzino Doganale (winners of World's Best Liqueur at the World Liqueur Awards for their Jefferson Amaro), it routinely receives top ratings across independent industry outlets like Difford's Guide and Gambero Rosso. Reviewers praise it for avoiding the overly sweet, artificial profile of commercial citrus modifiers, celebrating instead its authentic essential oil extraction, farm-driven integrity, and powerful 32% ABV structure.

title: Bepi Tosolini Fragola Liqueur - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This artisanal wild strawberry liqueur (Liquore alle Fragoline di Bosco) originates from Italy, produced in Povoletto near Udine, Friuli-Venezia Giulia. Handcrafted by the prestigious Bepi Tosolini distillery—founded in 1943 and renowned for its premium grappas and fruit distillates—this expression belongs to their celebrated Spezieria collection. It is made by infusing tiny, intensely aromatic wild mountain strawberries (fragoline di bosco) in a blend of neutral spirit and clear strawberry distillate for at least four months. Strikingly presented, each bottle contains dozens of whole miniature wild strawberries left floating inside the liquid. Bottled at 48 proof (24.0% ABV) with no artificial flavorings or colors, it offers an authentic, fruit-forward benchmark for natural Italian liqueurs.

Spirit Description

This liqueur displays a vivid, natural ruby-red hue in the glass, accompanied by the tiny dark-red wild berries that pour out alongside the liquid. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic, pure, and fruit-driven, releasing wafts of freshly picked wild strawberries, strawberry jam, candied cherry, and delicate floral hints of rose hip. On the palate, it feels rich, velvety, and mouth-coating, delivering a burst of concentrated wild strawberry sweetness and berry preserve, balanced by a refreshing citric acidity and a gentle, warming undertone of black pepper spice from the grappa/distillate base. The finish is clean, long, and satisfyingly fruity, trailing off with lingering crushed berry notes, soft citrus zest, and a subtle alcohol warmth.

Accolades

Bepi Tosolini Fragola holds top critical standing among master bartenders and spirits judges as the definitive gold standard in strawberry liqueurs. Earning top ratings on platforms such as Difford's Guide and high honors across global spirit competitions, reviewers consistently praise it for avoiding the cloying, synthetic taste of commercial crème de fraise. Critics frequently highlight the textural joy of the whole macerated berries and the spirit's crisp balance of natural fruit acidity.

title: Louis Latour Pouilly Fuisse Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Pouilly Fuissé Premier Cru AOC appellation in the Mâconnais, Maison Louis Latour Pouilly Fuissé Premier Cru 2023 represents a landmark elevation in southern Burgundy white winemaking. Founded in 1797, Maison Louis Latour is one of Burgundy's most iconic historic negociant houses. Following the historic 2020 official classification of Premier Cru status in Pouilly Fuissé, this cuvée is sourced from select Premier Cru climats characterized by steep slopes and clay-limestone soils rich in Jurassic chalk. Under the direction of head winemaker Jean-Charles Thomas, the winemaking philosophy incorporates traditional temperature controlled stainless steel fermentation followed by 8 to 10 months of maturation in medium toasted French oak barrels (approximately 15% new) crafted at Latour's own cooperage in Beaune. The result is an opulent, rich Chardonnay that strikes a delicate balance between sunny Mâconnais generosity, refined oak complexity, and vivid limestone minerality.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear pale gold colour with bright greenish reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe yellow peach, poached pear, lemon curd, and white nectarine, interwoven with subtle notes of acacia flower, toasted hazelnut, vanilla bean, fresh butter, and crushed limestone. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, satiny, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of stone fruit, citrus oil, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a creamy, coat-the-mouth mid-palate texture and seamless oak integration, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon peel, toasted almond, and a clean chalky mineral grip. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this 2023 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2033. Stylistically, it combines Premier Cru prestige, luxurious texture, and the lush, ripe elegance of the 2023 Burgundian vintage.

title: Map Maker Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: Map Maker Sauvignon Blanc is a perfect example of classic Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc. Intensely aromatic with attractive herbs and stony notes. Dry, tangy sauvignon blanc with green capsicum, lime zest, gooseberry and subtle tropical fruit and passion fruit flavours. A light, fresh wine with good purity and energy.

title: Three Finger Jack Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in the California region, specifically within the Lodi AVA appellation, Three Finger Jack Cabernet Sauvignon 'East Side Ridge' 2022 represents a bold, concentrated, and rustic expression of California winemaking. Produced by Delicato Family Wines, the brand pays tribute to the legendary Gold Rush outlaw Three Finger Jack, who roamed the rugged Sierra Foothills and East Side Ridge of Lodi. The grapes are sourced from select vineyards along the gravelly, well draining soils of Lodi's eastern ridges, where warm, sun-drenched days are balanced by cool breezes sweeping in from the San Joaquin Delta. Under winemaker James Ewart, the winemaking philosophy incorporates extended skin contact, warm temperature controlled fermentation, and maturation in French and American oak barrels for 9 to 12 months. The result is a full throttled, opulent Cabernet Sauvignon that marries rich dark fruit power with smooth, oak-kissed complexity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, opaque dark ruby red colour with intense purple reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly fragrant bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry preserves, blackcurrant curd, and cassis, interwoven with bold notes of toasted oak, vanilla bean, dark chocolate, espresso, pipe tobacco, and warm baking spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, plush, and mouth-filling, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, sweet spice, and subtle mineral earth, all supported by a balanced, refreshing spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, velvety, fine-grained tannins and a dense, coat-the-mouth mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, mocha, and toasted cedar. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon blended with small amounts of Petite Sirah and Malbec, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2024–2031. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Lodi fruit generosity, plush oak integration, and muscular crowd-pleasing structure.

title: Giant Steps Chardonnay Sexton Vineyard 2023
bodyHtml: Matured for ten months in 20% new and 80% older French oak barrels. Brilliant, very pale straw colour with distinctive highlights of green around the outskirts and a watery hue. Aromas of white peaches and dried honey are married to biscuity oak, light cashew and citrusy nougat notes. Medium weight with an elegant fresh feel, fleshy white peach and nectarine fruits are underpinned by subtle dried honey characters, citrus and a dash of flinty minerality. Finishes dry with lively acidity and a medium to long aftertaste.

title: Corviano Montepulciano D'Abruzzo
bodyHtml: From select vineyards located near the village of Loreto Aprutino, in the Montepulciano d'Abruzzo DOC area, 300 meters above sea level. An intense ruby-red colour, violet undertones, and a bouquet of ripe red fruit. Flavours rich in fruit, lively, elegantly framed by oak spices. This juicy Montepulciano matches superbly with lamb, pork, and seasoned cheeses.

title: Escudo Rojo Reserva Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Chile, within the Casablanca Valley. Escudo Rojo was created in 1999 by Baron Philippe de Rothschild Chile, bridging French winemaking expertise with premium Chilean terroirs. The winery's philosophy combines traditional Bordeaux winemaking techniques with low-intervention viticulture to express the distinct maritime influence, cool breezes, and granite soils of the coastal Casablanca Valley.

Wine Description

This bright ruby red wine opens with alluring aromas of fresh red cherry, wild raspberry, and strawberry, complemented by delicate notes of black pepper, subtle vanilla, and earthy forest floor. On the palate, it displays a medium body with a soft, silky texture, balanced by refined tannins and a lively natural acidity. The finish is clean, smooth, and elegant with lingering hints of red fruit and gentle oak spice. The varietal composition is 100% Pinot Noir. It has an alcohol content of 14% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Giant Steps Pinot Noir 'Applejack Vineyard' 2023
bodyHtml: An expertly crafted Aussie Pinot Noir that's among the best to be found from Down Under. The aromas are dazzlingly bright and fresh with sour cherries and cranberry notes before a warm, soft spiciness takes over. The acidity and moderate tannins are in good balance and allow the dark cherry and dark coffee flavours to show themselves nicely.

title: Gordon & Macphail Glenrothes Single Malt 11 Year Old 'Discovery'
bodyHtml:
This unpeated single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, produced in Rothes within the Speyside region. Distilled at Glenrothes Distillery and bottled by legendary independent bottler Gordon & MacPhail, this release forms part of their color-coded Discovery range—specifically classified under the purple-labeled Sherry Cask profile (alongside Bourbon/Ex-Bourbon green labels and Smoky red labels). Matured for 11 years exclusively in first-fill and refill Oloroso sherry casks, it is bottled at a classic drinking strength of 86 proof (43.0% ABV) without artificial coloring, presenting an accessible, heavily sherried interpretation of Glenrothes' naturally thick, fruit-forward distillate.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a rich mahogany-amber hue in the glass. On the nose, it is dense, sweet, and comforting, opening with wafts of warm cinnamon rolls, stewed raisins, and dark cherry jam, underlaid by milk chocolate, toasted almonds, and sweet oak. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, velvety, and mouth-coating, delivering an initial hit of sticky dates, orange marmalade, and butterscotch, before developing into baking spices, dark cocoa powder, and charred oak tannins. The finish is long, warm, and pleasantly dry, leaving trailing notes of dried fruits, candied ginger, soft leather, and lingering sherry wood spice. The 43.0% ABV proof offers a smooth, approachable mouthfeel that showcases the rich Oloroso influence without aggressive ethanol heat.

Accolades

The Gordon & MacPhail Discovery Glenrothes 11 Year Old has earned strong praise across independent whisky review outlets like Whiskybase, Dramface, and Words of Whisky. Reviewers frequently celebrate it as one of the best value-for-money sherry-matured Speysiders on the market, noting that Gordon & MacPhail's exceptional cask management often yields a richer, more integrated Oloroso profile than standard distillery-bottled entry levels.

title: Louis Latour Marsannay Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
In the glass, the 2023 vintage presents a pale gold-yellow color with luminous straw reflections. The nose opens with an inviting and aromatic bouquet of crisp yellow apple, white peach, and citrus blossom, interwoven with subtle hints of fresh hazelnut, brioche, and crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, rounded, and elegant, striking a harmonious balance between soft fruit weight and crisp natural acidity. Flavors of ripe pear, lemon curd, and a delicate touch of buttery oak carry through to a clean, mouthwatering, and mineral-tinged finish. Crafted from 100% Chardonnay (from vines averaging 30 years of age), the hand-harvested grapes undergo traditional fermentation in stainless steel tanks, followed by partial malolactic fermentation and maturation in stainless steel and a small percentage of medium-toasted French oak barrels to preserve pristine fruit character. The alcohol by volume sits at 13.0%.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season across the Côte d'Or produced white Burgundies defined by generous fruit expression, excellent aromatic balance, and smooth textural integration. Warm summer conditions enabled complete, uniform ripening while cool night breezes off the limestone slopes allowed Chardonnay to preserve its lively acidity and precise structure. The 2023 Louis Latour Marsannay Blanc offers delightful immediate charm and freshness upon release, while possessing the balance to develop smoothly over the next 3 to 6 years.

title: The Icon Rock Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Argentina, within the Mendoza region. The Icon Rock is produced by Bodega Santa Ana, a historic winery founded in 1891 by Italian winemaking pioneer Luis Tirasso. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes harvesting grapes from high-altitude Andean vineyards, combining desert sunshine and snowmelt irrigation to produce approachable, fruit-forward wines with vibrant character and smooth structure.

Wine Description

This deep ruby red wine displays ripe aromas of dark plum, blackberry, and cassis, layered with notes of green bell pepper, subtle vanilla, and cocoa. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full body with a rich fruit core, approachable tannins, and balanced acidity. The finish is smooth and lingering with hints of dark spice and dark berry flavors. The varietal composition is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. It has an alcohol content of 13.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Domaine Parent Corton 'Les Renardes' Grand Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Corton Grand Cru AOC appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Domaine Parent Corton 'Les Renardes' Grand Cru 2023 represents an exceptionally powerful, prestigious, and legendary expression of Pinot Noir. Founded in 1787 and managed by sisters Anne and Catherine Parent, Domaine Parent is one of the most revered historic estates in the Côte de Beaune. Sourced from choice parcels within the famous Les Renardes Grand Cru vineyard on the steep mid-slopes of the Hill of Corton, the vines grow in reddish, iron-rich limestone clay soils studded with gravel. Under the direction of winemaker Anne Parent, the winemaking philosophy incorporates certified organic farming, meticulous hand harvesting, native yeast fermentation with partial whole-cluster inclusion, and maturation in French oak barrels (approximately 40% to 50% new) for 16 to 18 months. The result is a profound, deeply structured Grand Cru that balances wild aromatic complexity, muscular tannins, and profound cellaring potential.

Wine Description

The wine presents a dark, luminous garnet red colour with deep crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, multidimensional bouquet opens with noble aromas of black cherry preserves, wild blackberry, and dark plum compote, interwoven with sophisticated notes of forest floor, game, leather, pipe tobacco, crushed limestone minerality, and warm cedar spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, commanding, and seamless, delivering concentrated flavours of dark fruits, licorice, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by firm, fine-grained, muscular tannins and an exceptionally opulent mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark fruits, iron notes, and a clean gravelly grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2023 release offers extraordinary cellaring potential spanning 2028–2048+. Stylistically, it combines the undeniable power and wild earthy complexity of Corton 'Les Renardes' with the aromatic purity and fine polish of the 2023 vintage.

title: Domaine Parent Pommard Les Noizons 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Pommard AOC appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Domaine Parent Pommard 2023 represents a classically styled, structured, and muscular expression of Pinot Noir. Founded in 1787 and now run by sisters Anne and Catherine Parent, Domaine Parent is recognized as one of the benchmark estate producers in Pommard. The grapes are sourced from family-owned plots across the appellation, growing on classic clay and limestone soils rich in iron content. Under the direction of winemaker Anne Parent, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes organic farming practices, hand harvesting, partial whole-cluster inclusion, and aging in French oak barrels (approximately 25% to 30% new). The result is a quintessential Pommard that harmonizes dense structure, earthy minerality, and vibrant red fruit purity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear ruby red colour with dark magenta reflections along the rim. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of dark cherry, ripe raspberry, and poached plum, interwoven with sophisticated notes of wet earth, forest floor, subtle game, crushed limestone, and warm baking spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, structured, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of red berries, black cherry, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by firm, fine-grained tannins and a coat-the-mouth mid-palate texture, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark fruit, iron minerality, and a clean chalky grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2023 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2038. Stylistically, it combines Pommard's signature muscle and depth with the aromatic freshness of the 2023 growing season.

title: Ramey Chardonnay Russian River Valley 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from the United States, within California's Sonoma County and the Russian River Valley appellation. Ramey Wine Cellars was founded in 1996 by David Ramey, a pioneering California winemaker renowned for introducing classical Old World Burgundian techniques to West Coast winemaking. The winery's philosophy centers on traditional methods, including native yeast fermentation, barrel fermentation, full malolactic fermentation, and extended lees contact to craft site-expressive wines with texture, balance, and longevity.

Wine Description

This bright straw gold wine opens with inviting aromas of yellow apple, Meyer lemon, and white peach, intertwined with notes of toasted brioche, subtle hazelnut, and flinty minerality. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a rich, creamy mouthfeel balanced by vibrant, mouthwatering acidity. Flavors of citrus zest, subtle baking spices, and crushed stone carry through to a long, polished, and persistent finish. The varietal composition is 100% Chardonnay. It has an alcohol content of 14.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in the Russian River Valley was cool and long, pushing harvest dates later into the autumn months. These conditions allowed Chardonnay grapes to develop complex flavor profiles and preserve bright natural acidity, enabling the winemaker to craft a wine of exceptional structure, energy, and balance.

title: The Icon Rock Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Argentina, within the Mendoza region and the Uco Valley. The Icon Rock is crafted by Bodega Santa Ana, a historic winery founded in 1891 by Italian winemaking pioneer Luis Tirasso. The winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the mountain sunshine and cool high-altitude conditions of the Andes, producing fruit-forward wines that emphasize fresh fruit character and smooth structure.

Wine Description

This bright straw yellow wine with greenish highlights opens with inviting aromas of fresh tropical fruits, including pineapple, passion fruit, and banana, balanced by notes of green apple and citrus zest. On the palate, it is crisp, juicy, and well balanced, featuring flavors of ripe citrus and stone fruits supported by a refreshing acidity and a smooth, clean texture. It displays a medium body with a clean, persistent finish. The varietal composition is 100% Chardonnay.

title: Vincent Latour Volnay 'Les Serpens' Cuvee Elegance 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Volnay AOC appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Domaine Vincent Latour Volnay 'Les Serpens' Cuvée Élégance 2022 represents a graceful, silken, and classic expression of Pinot Noir. Domaine Vincent Latour, based in Meursault, is a revered family estate that traces its winemaking origins back to 1792. The grapes for this cuvée are sourced from the Les Serpens lieu-dit in Volnay, where vines grow on steep, east-facing slopes composed of limestone-rich clay soils. Under winemaker Vincent Latour, the estate employs sustainable viticulture, hand harvesting, and a combination of ambient yeast fermentation, whole cluster inclusion, and slow aging in demi-muids and French oak barrels (approximately 20% to 25% new). The result is an aromatic, perfumed Volnay that captures the finesse, purity, and silky structural texture characteristic of the appellation.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous translucent ruby red colour with delicate garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of red cherry, wild raspberry, pomegranate, and wild strawberry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of fresh violets, rose petals, subtle forest floor, white pepper, and light baking spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, supple, and refined, delivering concentrated flavours of red fruit, orange zest, and chalky mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by silky, fine-grained tannins and a seamless, coat-the-mouth mid-palate texture, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red berries, floral hints, and a clean limestone grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2037. Stylistically, it effortlessly balances Volnay elegance with pure red fruit aromatics, sunny vintage generosity, and delicate mineral drive.

title: Santa Rita Cabernet Sauvignon Casa Real 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Chile, within the Maipo Valley and the subregion of Alto Jahuel. Viña Santa Rita was founded in 1880, anchoring its legacy in the historical Alto Maipo terroir where its original ungrafted vines continue to thrive. Winemaker Sebastián Labbé guides the estate's vision, maintaining a philosophy centered on elegance, balance, and pure terroir expression.

Wine Description

This deep ruby wine opens with pure aromas of blackcurrant, ripe cherries, and plum, intertwined with complex notes of sweet tobacco, cedar, graphite, and subtle spices. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a refined, silky tannin structure, vibrant acidity, and remarkable concentration. The finish is long and persistent, carrying lingering accents of licorice, cocoa, and dried herbs. The varietal composition is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. It has an alcohol content of 14% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Mac Forbes Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Australia, within Victoria's cool-climate Yarra Valley region. Founded in 2004 by winemaker Mac Forbes, the winery is renowned for its site-specific approach and dedication to exploring the subregions of the Yarra Valley. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes minimal intervention, early picking, and wild yeast fermentations in old oak to craft wines defined by high natural acidity, tension, and site purity.

Wine Description

This pale straw yellow wine opens with vibrant aromas of lemon zest, green apple, and white peach, intertwined with white florals, flinty minerality, and subtle nutty accents. On the palate, it is lean and focused, delivering crisp citrus and stone fruit flavors supported by a tight mineral core and a fine, textured mouthfeel. It presents a medium body with driving natural acidity that leads into a long, clean, and persistent finish. The varietal composition is 100% Chardonnay. It has an alcohol content of 12% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Mac Forbes Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Australia, within Victoria's cool-climate Yarra Valley region. Founded in 2004 by winemaker Mac Forbes, the winery focuses on subregional expressions that highlight the distinct microclimates and soils across the Yarra Valley. The winemaking philosophy centers on sustainable viticulture, minimal intervention, wild fermentations, and early harvesting to showcase freshness, elegance, and pure site character.

Wine Description

This light to medium dark cherry hued wine opens with a bright and expressive nose of red cherry, cranberry, and raspberry, accompanied by subtle spice, floral lavender, and gentle earthy notes. The palate displays a lively interplay of crunchy red fruits, dark cherry, and red candy accents, framed by fine, chalky clay tannins and a vibrant natural acidity. It presents a light to medium body with a clean, savoury structure and a long, refreshing finish. The varietal composition is 100% Pinot Noir. It has an alcohol content of 12.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Mac Forbes Syrah 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Australia, within Victoria's cool-climate Yarra Valley region. Founded in 2004 by winemaker Mac Forbes, the winery focuses on subregional expressions that highlight the distinct microclimates and soils across the Yarra Valley. The winemaking philosophy centers on sustainable viticulture, wild fermentations, minimal intervention, and early harvesting to showcase freshness, structure, and site purity.

Wine Description

This vibrant, dark red-cherry hued wine opens with expressive aromas of red plum, graphite, florals, and freshly cracked red and black peppercorns. The palate delivers a medium body featuring flavors of poached red plums, cherries, and savory spices, anchored by firm, chalky clay tannins and a lively natural acidity. The finish is long, energetic, and fine, highlighted by lifted notes of white pepper and dried herbs. The varietal composition is 100% Syrah, vinified with 10% whole bunches and aged in large and small old oak barrels. It has an alcohol content of 12% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Phantom Creek Estates 'Kobau Vineyard' Syrah 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Canada, within British Columbia's Okanagan Valley and the Golden Mile Bench subregion. Phantom Creek Estates is a premier gravity-fed winery located on Oliver's Black Sage Bench, collaborating with renowned international winemaking experts. The Kobau Vineyard, situated on the gravelly alluvial soils of the Golden Mile Bench, benefits from morning sun and cool evening shadows, allowing the winemaker to craft a Syrah with intense concentration, savory complexity, and elegance.

Wine Description

This deep, dark purple wine reveals complex aromas of dark plum, wild blackberry, and crushed blueberry, layered with signature notes of cracked black pepper, smoked meat, violet, and subtle toasted oak. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a lush, velvety texture, supported by firm, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant vein of natural acidity. The finish is long, persistent, and savory, featuring lingering notes of dark cocoa and dried herbs. The varietal composition is 100% Syrah. It has an alcohol content of 14.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Phantom Creek Estates Petite Cuvée 2021
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Canada, within British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Phantom Creek Estates is an estate winery situated on Oliver's Black Sage Bench, operating with a commitment to sustainable, organic, and biodynamic viticulture. The winery's philosophy emphasizes small-lot vinifications and minimal intervention to express the pure character and concentration of classic Bordeaux varieties grown on its estate vineyard sites.

Wine Description

This deep garnet-red wine opens with aromas of dark cherry, ripe blackberry, and cassis, complemented by notes of dried herbs, cocoa, and subtle oak spices. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a smooth, approachable texture, structured tannins, and fresh acidity. The finish is persistent with clean fruit and savory spice highlights. The varietal composition is a Bordeaux-style blend primarily composed of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Cabernet Franc. It has an alcohol content of 14.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Phantom Creek Estates Becker Cuvée 2020
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Canada, within British Columbia's Okanagan Valley and the Oliver subregion. Phantom Creek Estates is a state of the art winery established on the Black Sage Bench, collaborating with legendary Bordeaux winemaking consultant Eric Boissenot. The winery's philosophy focuses on sustainable and organic farming techniques, crafting precision-driven, single-vineyard red blends that reflect the distinct sandy, alluvial soils of the southern Okanagan.

Wine Description

This deep ruby red wine reveals complex aromas of dark plum, blackberry, and cassis, interwoven with notes of sweet tobacco, graphite, dried sage, and warm baking spices. On the palate, it displays a full body with rich fruit concentration, framed by structured, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant line of natural acidity. The finish is long and persistent, with lingering savory elements and dark cocoa accents. The varietal composition is a Bordeaux-style blend dominated by Cabernet Sauvignon, rounded out with Cabernet Franc and Merlot. It has an alcohol content of 14.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Phantom Creek Estates Small Lot Pinot Gris 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Canada, within British Columbia's Similkameen Valley. Phantom Creek Estates is a state of the art winery based on Oliver's Black Sage Bench, collaborating with renowned Alsatian winemaking consultant Olivier Humbrecht MW. The estate's philosophy centers on organic and biodynamic farming, capturing the distinct, mineral-driven terroir of British Columbia's premier vineyard sites through precise, small-lot vinifications.

Wine Description

This rich, golden-hued white wine opens with an expressive bouquet of orange blossom, honeysuckle, and white rose, layered with ripe nectarine, apricot, white sesame, and candied citrus peel. On the palate, it delivers a full body with a creamy, textural mouthfeel balanced by fine natural acidity, mineral highlights, and subtle toasty oak undertones. The finish is long, complex, and persistent. The varietal composition is 100% Pinot Gris. It has an alcohol content of 13.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Prima Pietra Costa Toscana 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Costa Toscana IGT appellation in Riparbella, Prima Pietra Costa Toscana 2022 represents an ambitious, modern, and highly acclaimed Super Tuscan red blend. Owned by Massimo Ferragamo, the estate perches on one of the highest coastal hilltops in Tuscany at 450 metres above sea level overlooking the Tyrrhenian Sea. The vines grow on rich iron-clay, rocky gravel, and sandy soils that benefit from marine breezes and abundant Mediterranean sunshine. Under general manager and winemaker Cecilia Leoneschi, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes plot-by-plot vinification, utilizing small stainless steel tanks, ambient yeast fermentation, and maturation for 18 to 20 months in French oak barrels (approximately 50% new). The result is a opulent, seamless blend that combines Super Tuscan power with coastal freshness and refined structural length.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark garnet red colour with rich crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe blackcurrant, wild blackberry preserves, dark cherry, and plum curd, interwoven with sophisticated notes of Mediterranean scrub, dried rosemary, espresso, dark chocolate, tobacco leaf, and warm cedar spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, velvety, and mouth-filling, delivering concentrated flavours of black fruit, licorice, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity provided by the high coastal elevation. Framed by rich, fine-grained, seamless tannins and a deep, coat-the-mouth mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark berries, sweet baking spices, and a clean gravelly mineral grip. Composed of a blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2040. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines coastal Tuscan elegance, rich berry concentration, and polished Bordeaux-style complexity.

title: Penelope Toasted Series Bourbon 50 %
bodyHtml:
This finished straight bourbon whiskey originates from the United States, produced by Penelope Bourbon in Bardstown, Kentucky (distilled using their signature four-grain recipe in partnership with MGP in Lawrenceburg, Indiana). Part of Penelope's popular Toasted Series, this expression undergoes a secondary maturation in custom heavy-toast, light-char new American oak barrels. Combining four grains—corn (75%), rye (21%), wheat, and malted barley (4%)—the base bourbon is fully aged for 4 to 5 years before finishing in the toasted oak barrels. Non-chill filtered and bottled at an even 100 proof (50.0% ABV), it delivers a caramelized, campfire-dessert twist on Penelope's core profile.

Spirit Description

This finished bourbon displays a deep mahogany-copper color in the glass. On the nose, it is rich, sweet, and warm, opening with enticing aromas of brown sugar, cinnamon breakfast pastry, and toasted graham cracker, underlaid by vanilla bean and scorched honey. On the palate, it feels medium-to-full-bodied and round, delivering initial flavors of dark caramel sauce, candied cherry, and butterscotch, which quickly open into toasted marshmallow, baking spices, and charred oak. The finish is long, warm, and savory, trailing off with lingering roasted oak, dark cocoa powder, sweet cinnamon spice, and a gentle barrel heat. The toasted barrel finishing amplifies the oak sugars and dark caramel notes while softening the edges of the 50% ABV proof.

Accolades

Penelope Toasted Series Bourbon (100 Proof) has gained significant critical praise, establishing itself as one of the hallmark releases in the modern toasted-wood category. Securing Double Gold and Gold Medals at prestigious competitions—including the San Francisco World Spirits Competition and SIP Awards—critics routinely praise the expression for its decadent marshmallow and dark pastry notes, highlighting how the secondary toasted finish complements the four-grain blend without becoming astringent or tannic.

title: Penelope Wheated Straight Bourbon 95 Proof
bodyHtml:
This approachable Four Grain straight bourbon whiskey originates from the United States, produced by Penelope Bourbon in Bardstown, Kentucky (and originally distilled in partnership with MGP in Lawrenceburg, Indiana). Part of Penelope's foundational Four Grain series, this expression is crafted using a unique blend of three distinct mash bills—combining corn, wheat, rye, and malted barley—with a signature high-wheat emphasis that softens the spirit's overall structure. Aged for a minimum of 4 to 5 years in new charred American oak barrels, it is bottled at an easy-drinking 95 proof (47.5% ABV). It represents a sweet, round, and versatile entry point into modern wheated bourbon profiles.

Spirit Description

This straight bourbon displays a warm gold to light amber hue in the glass. The nose is soft, sweet, and inviting, opening with initial scents of marshmallow, vanilla bean, and sweet cornmeal, underpinned by candied apple, honey graham cracker, and a light touch of toasted oak. On the palate, it is smooth, round, and approachable, delivering flavors of butterscotch, poached pears, and light caramel sauce, counterbalanced by a subtle rye prickle, baking spices, and soft oak char. The finish is clean, medium-length, and delicate, trailing off with lingering notes of sweet wheat grain, vanilla, cinnamon, and a gentle, warming spice. The wheat-forward grain recipe keeps the mouthfeel soft and cream-like, taming any harsh ethanol sting at 47.5% ABV.

Accolades

Penelope Four Grain Bourbon (95 Proof) has secured strong acclaim across national spirits competitions and review outlets, serving as a pillar for the brand's rapid growth. Securing a Double Gold Medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition alongside high 90+ point ratings from SIP Awards and Whisky Advocate, critics frequently laud the bottling for its balance of sweet wheat creaminess and subtle rye spice, praising its versatility as both a neat pour and a high-end cocktail base.

title: Blood Oath Pact No. 12 Bourbon
bodyHtml:
This high-end finished straight bourbon whiskey originates from the United States, produced in St. Louis, Missouri by Lux Row Distillers. Created by Remus / Lux Row Master Distiller John Rempe, this 2026 release represents Pact No. 12 in the acclaimed, highly coveted Blood Oath series. Built upon a signature tri-blend formula that marries distinct aged straight bourbons—a well-aged high-rye bourbon, a mature wheated bourbon, and an extra-aged straight bourbon—Pact 12 elevates the series' tradition of exotic wood finishes by undergoing a secondary maturation in rare Cognac casks. Bottled at the signature Blood Oath series strength of 98.6 proof (49.3% ABV)—a nod to human body temperature—it offers an intricate, velvety fusion of mature Kentucky oak, baking spices, and dark French grape elegance.

Spirit Description

This straight bourbon displays a rich mahogany-amber hue with deep copper reflections in the glass. On the nose, it is dense, sophisticated, and deeply aromatic, opening with wafts of dark raisins, caramelized fig, and toasted oak, underlaid by vanilla bean, dark chocolate truffles, and a soft streak of aged French rancio (polished leather and dried prune). On the palate, it feels round, oily, and mouth-coating, delivering an initial surge of sweet brown sugar, candied orange peel, and marzipan from the wheated mash bill, before expanding into punchy cinnamon bark, black pepper, and toasted rye spice. The Cognac finishing adds a silky mid-palate layer of dark plum, roasted hazelnut, and refined grape tannins. The finish is long, warm, and elegant, trailing off with lingering dried fruits, sweet oak char, baking spices, and a soothing, velvety heat.

Accolades

Blood Oath Pact No. 12 continues the celebrated tradition of Lux Row's annual allocated series, securing top praise among bourbon collectors and spirit critics upon its 2026 release. Reviewers across independent outlets like Breaking Bourbon, The Bourbon Culture, and Whiskey Advocate highlight Pact 12 for its seamless wood integration, commending John Rempe's ability to let the dark fruit and subtle floral nuances of the Cognac finish enhance—rather than overpower—the rich, complex foundation of the underlying extra-aged bourbons.

title: Matsu La Moza Blanco 2025
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Spain, within the Castilla y Leon region and the Denominacion de Origen Toro. Bodega Matsu, created under the umbrella of the Vintae wine company, is famous for its collection of wines featuring evocative portraits representing different generations. The winery focuses on low-intervention viticulture, honoring local traditions while crafting modern, fresh expressions that capture the distinct character of Toro's dry climate and sandy soils.

Wine Description

This bright straw yellow wine opens with expressive aromas of ripe pear, white peach, and green apple, complemented by subtle notes of citrus zest, honey, and delicate floral herbs. The palate displays a smooth, rounded mouthfeel framed by crisp, refreshing acidity and vibrant fruitiness. It presents a light to medium body with a clean, juicy finish. The varietal composition is predominantly a blend of 85% Verdejo and 13% Malvasia Castellana, with small percentages of Godello, Albillo, and Palomino. It has an alcohol content of 12.5% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: See Ya Later Ranch Nelly Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada in the British Columbia region, specifically within the Okanagan Valley VQA appellation, See Ya Later Ranch 'Nelly' Rosé represents a vibrant, fruit forward, and iconic expression of Pacific Northwest winemaking. Perched high on Hawthorne Mountain near Okanagan Falls, See Ya Later Ranch is one of the highest elevation estate vineyards in the valley, named in honor of Major Hugh Fraser and his beloved dog Nelly. The vines grow on well draining glacial till, gravel, and sandy loam soils that benefit from hot summer days and cool mountain air. The winemaking philosophy employs a cool, temperature controlled stainless steel fermentation following short skin contact to preserve pure aromatic freshness and vivid colour. The result is a crowd pleasing, refreshing rosé crafted with perfectly balanced natural acidity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous medium salmon pink colour with bright coral reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly fragrant bouquet opens with inviting aromas of fresh wild strawberry, tart rhubarb, red cherry, and cranberry, interwoven with subtle notes of orange blossom, citrus zest, and a touch of red apple skin. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, crisp, and refreshing, delivering delicious flavours of juicy strawberry jam, red cherry curd, and subtle mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural citrusy acidity. Framed by a smooth, rounded mid-palate structure and clean tension, it concludes with a crisp, satisfying finish marked by lingering red berries, rhubarb, and a clean citrus lift. Composed of a proprietary blend including Pinot Noir, Gamay, and Merlot, it offers immediate drinking appeal. Stylistically, it combines Okanagan freshness, plush fruit charm, and effortless patio drinkability.

title: Hennessy XO - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Hennessy XO (Extra Old) is a prestigious cognac originating from the Cognac region of France. The House of Hennessy was founded in 1765 by Richard Hennessy, an Irish officer who served in the army of King Louis XV. Created in 1870 by Maurice Hennessy and Master Blender Emile Fillioux, Hennessy XO was the first cognac in the industry to bear the XO label, originally intended as a private blend for family and friends. Today, the Maison is part of the LVMH luxury group and remains the world's largest manufacturer of cognac.

Spirit Description

Hennessy XO is a complex masterpiece composed of a blend of up to 100 different eaux de vie, some aged for as long as 30 years in young oak barrels to achieve a balance of power and roundness.

  • Colour: It possesses an intense and deep amber hue, which is a visual sign of its strength and long maturation.

  • Aroma: The nose is rich and fragrant with notes of candied fruit, orange rind, butterscotch, and dried plums, underscored by subtle spices and vanilla.

  • Palate: The palate experience is described as a seven-part odyssey, beginning with sweet candied fruit followed by a sensation of rising heat and a spicy edge of black pepper and chocolate.

  • Body: It is full-bodied, robust, and voluptuous, offering a smooth yet powerful mouthfeel.

  • Finish: The finish, referred to as the 'Infinite Echo', is exceptionally long and persistent, echoing omnipresent notes of oak, vanilla, and warm spice.

  • ABV: Hennessy XO is bottled at 40%.

title: La Spinetta 'Il Rose di Casanova' Toscana IGT 2025
bodyHtml:
This bone-dry, highly refined rosé originates from Italy, produced in the rolling hills of Terricciola within the Toscana IGT zone of coastal Tuscany. Renowned for their pioneering work in Piedmont, the Rivetti family of La Spinetta expanded into Tuscany in 2001, founding their Casanova estate. Giorgio Rivetti set out to craft a serious, food-friendly rosé modeled after the precision and complexity of Provençal whites, yet distinctly rooted in Tuscan soil. Instantly recognizable by the famous Albrecht Dürer rhinoceros drawing on the label, Il Rosé di Casanova is sourced entirely from estate-grown vines planted on sandy, marine-fossil-rich soils, yielding a rosé globally celebrated for its elegance, chalky minerality, and gastronomic versatility.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2025 vintage displays a delicate, pale salmon-pink hue with shimmering peach highlights. The highly aromatic nose opens with a fresh bouquet of wild strawberry, tart pomegranate, white peach, and orange blossom, interwoven with herbal hints of thyme, crushed sea salt, and wet stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, crisp, and bone-dry. A razor-sharp beam of energetic natural acidity drives the entry, giving way to a smooth, textured mid-palate and a long, saline, chalky mineral finish. Crafted from an equal split of 50% Sangiovese and 50% Sangiovesino/Prugnolo Gentile (or local clones), the hand-harvested grapes undergo brief skin contact (around one hour) in pneumatic presses to extract subtle color without aggressive tannins. The juice is fermented with indigenous yeasts in stainless steel tanks at controlled temperatures and aged on fine lees for roughly 3 months prior to bottling. The alcohol by volume sits at 12.5%.

Food Pairing

The crisp acidity, bone-dry profile, and mineral persistence of this Tuscan rosé make it an extraordinary partner for Mediterranean cuisine, seafood, and summer meals. It pairs seamlessly with fresh oysters, grilled prawns, seared ahi tuna, salmon carpaccio, and crab cakes. It also excels alongside Tuscan prosciutto and melon, wood-fired Margherita pizza, caprese salad with buffalo mozzarella, roasted chicken with herbs, and creamy goat cheeses like Sainte-Maure de Touraine or fresh Feta.

title: Naked Grape Pinot Grigio
bodyHtml: Brilliant pale straw colour; delicate aromas of citrus, pineapple and baked apples with mineral nuances; dry and medium-bodied with crisp acidity; flavours of apples, pears, citrus and melon.

title: Joseph Drouhin Cote de Beaune Rouge 2021
bodyHtml:
This elegant dry red wine originates from France, produced in the Côte de Beaune subregion of Burgundy. Founded in 1880, Maison Joseph Drouhin is one of Burgundy’s most prestigious and historic négociant-eleveurs, managed today by the fourth generation—Philippe, Véronique, Laurent, and Frédéric Drouhin. The estate has been committed to organic and biodynamic viticulture across its vineyards since the 1990s. While often confused with regional Côte de Beaune-Villages, this specific bottling carries the distinct Côte de Beaune appellation (a tiny village-level AVA located on the upper slopes above the town of Beaune). Sourced primarily from young vines of Drouhin’s renowned Beaune Premier Cru sites (such as Clos des Mouches and Grèves) combined with estate plots, this cuvée offers exceptional Premier Cru pedigree and terroir complexity at an accessible village level.

Wine Description

In the glass, the wine presents a brilliant, bright ruby red color with violet reflections near the rim. The expressive nose opens with an inviting bouquet of fresh red cherry, wild raspberry, and red currant, interwoven with subtle floral notes of peony and violet, sweet spice, and a hint of forest floor. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, silky, and balanced. A core of juicy red fruit is supported by fine-grained, supple tannins and a refreshing beam of natural acidity that carries through to a polished, chalky mineral finish.

Food Pairing

The supple tannins, vibrant red fruit purity, and bright acidity of this classic Beaune Pinot Noir make it an extraordinarily versatile partner at the dining table. It pairs beautifully with roasted poultry, such as roast chicken with herbs, pan-seared duck breast with cherry glaze, and roasted turkey. It also complements lighter red meat dishes like veal chops, pork tenderloin, braised rabbit, and mushroom risotto. For cheese pairings, opt for soft to semi-soft French cheeses like Brie de Meaux, Camembert, Delice de Bourgogne, or mild Comté.

title: Ferrari Brut
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Trentino-Alto Adige region, specifically within the Trentodoc DOC appellation, Ferrari Brut represents the benchmark, historic, and defining expression of Italian Metodo Classico sparkling wine. Founded in 1902 by Giulio Ferrari in Trento, the house pioneered Chardonnay cultivation in Italy with the vision of producing sparkling wines capable of competing with fine Champagne. Managed by the Lunelli family since 1952, the estate sources hand-harvested grapes from high-altitude mountain vineyards situated between 300 and 700 metres above sea level across the Trentino slopes, where chalky limestone and gravelly alluvial soils dominate. The winemaking philosophy strictly adheres to the traditional method (Metodo Classico), utilizing gentle pneumatic pressing of base wines followed by secondary bottle fermentation and a minimum of 20 months of extended lees aging in the underground cellars. The result is a crisp, highly sophisticated Blanc de Blancs that balances mountain freshness, precise minerality, and fine autolytic complexity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous pale straw yellow colour with subtle greenish reflections and a fine, lively, and persistent bead of delicate bubbles. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with fresh aromas of ripe Golden Delicious apple, yellow pear, lemon curd, and white peach, interwoven with delicate notes of acacia blossom, crushed stone, fresh brioche, and toasted bread crust. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, crisp, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of orchard fruit, Mandarin orange, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural mountain acidity. Framed by a creamy, satiny mousse and a refined mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus peel, almond, and a clean chalky mineral grip. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, it offers an approachable yet deeply layered profile with immediate drinking appeal. Stylistically, it combines Alpine elevation, Italian elegance, and classical traditional method tension.

title: Giffard Watermelon
bodyHtml:
This vibrant fruit liqueur (Liqueur de Pastèque) originates from France, produced in Angers in the Loire Valley. Crafted by Giffard, a historic family-owned distillery founded in 1885 by pharmacist Émile Giffard, this expression is part of their renowned Specialité line of premium cocktail liqueurs. Produced by macerating concentrated watermelon juice and natural botanical extracts in a pure neutral beet grain spirit, it captures the fresh, juicy essence of summer fruit.

Spirit Description

This liqueur presents a bright, translucent ruby-pink hue in the glass. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic, sweet, and uplifting, releasing vibrant wafts of freshly cut watermelon flesh, cucumber water, and subtle green rind freshness, backed by a light hint of candied red berries. On the palate, it feels light, silky, and crisp, delivering an immediate rush of sweet melon juice, red cherry, and subtle honeydew melon, perfectly counterbalanced by a refreshing, tart acidity that keeps the mouthfeel clean and lively. The finish is crisp, medium-length, and fruit-forward, leaving a trailing impression of sweet watermelon sugar, cucumber peel, and a clean, thirst-quenching dryness.

title: Dominio Imperfetto Perfectly Imperfect Rose
bodyHtml:
Produced along the picturesque Adriatic Coast of Italy, this contemporary rosé originates from the Abruzzo region. Dominio Imperfetto is a boutique project founded by the De Cerchio family, who sought to challenge the traditional red-dominated viticulture of the region by creating high quality, modern white and rosé wines. The winery’s philosophy is captured in its name celebrating the beauty of natural "imperfections" and the authentic, non-homogenized character of the land. Sourced from organic vineyards along the Trabocchi Coast, the wine benefits from a unique maritime microclimate where mild breezes and calcareous, sandy soils impart a signature freshness and mineral tension.

Wine Description

Dominio Imperfetto "Perfectly Imperfect" R (Rosé) presents a pale, luminous pink hue reminiscent of a Mediterranean sunset. The nose is delicate and highly expressive, offering an elegant bouquet of ripe strawberries, cherries, and citrus fruits, accented by floral hints of rose petals and violet. On the palate, the wine is vibrant and well-balanced, showcasing a crisp acidity and a savory, mineral core that reflects its coastal origins. It is characterized by its "crunchy" red fruit flavors, redcurrant, wild strawberry and a persistent, harmonious finish. This organic blend of Merlot (60%), Montepulciano (20%), and Sangiovese (20%) has an ABV of 12.5%.

title: Tignanello 2023 (by Tenuta Tignanello)
bodyHtml:
This structured and aristocratic red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Toscana I.G.T. appellation in Central Italy. Produced at Tenuta Tignanello by Marchesi Antinori the legendary Tuscan winemaking dynasty with a history spanning over six centuries this historic bottling fundamentally revolutionized Italian viticulture as the first Sangiovese aged in barriques, the first modern red blend with non traditional varietals, and one of the original Super Tuscans. Sourced exclusively from the 57 hectare single vineyard plot on the Tenuta Tignanello estate, situated between the Greve and Pesa river valleys in the Chianti Classico zone, the vines sit at 350 to 400 metres above sea level on limestone and marl rich soils known locally as albarese and galestro. The Mediterranean climate delivers warm daylight balanced by cool breezes descending from the Apennines, allowing the grapes to reach complete phenolic maturity while retaining high natural acidity and chiseled mineral drive.

Wine Description

The 2023 Tenuta Tignanello presents an intense ruby red colour in the glass with bright crimson and violet reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and sophisticated portrait of high altitude Tuscan limestone terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe sour cherries, dark plums, pomegranates, and blood orange peel, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh violets, sweet cocoa, pencil lead, white pepper, tobacco leaf, and a distinct line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of tart red stone fruits, wild berries, and licorice. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid palate fruit concentration. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by firm, fine grained tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of roasted hazelnut, graphite, and cedar.

This high definition Tuscan expression is a classical, Sangiovese led assemblage:

  • Sangiovese (~80%): Formulates the primary architectural core, contributing vibrant red cherry acidity, floral perfume, structural volume, and chalky tannic tension.

  • Cabernet Sauvignon (~15%): Supplies dark berry weight, cassis depth, graphite focus, and age worthy tannic grip.

  • Cabernet Franc (~5%): Imparts high toned herbal perfume, wild violet lift, and refined structural finesse.

The hand harvested fruit underwent meticulous sorting followed by separate temperature controlled fermentations in truncated oak tanks to preserve varietal purity and extract noble phenolics gently. The wine completed full malolactic conversion and was matured for approximately 15 months in French and Hungarian oak barriques before master blending and bottle aging. It reaches an effortlessly integrated alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and is finished bone dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in the heart of Chianti Classico was marked by moderate conditions, timely rainfall, and optimal late summer temperature shifts between day and night. Antinori's precise vineyard management enabled Sangiovese and the Cabernet varieties to attain optimal phenolic ripeness while retaining vibrant acidity. The 2023 Tenuta Tignanello offers immediate elegance and high energy drinking pleasure today, holding the structural integrity to cellar gracefully for 20 to 30 years.

title: Glengoyne Highland Single Malt 21 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Glengoyne 21 Year Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a flagship aged expression produced by the Glengoyne Distillery, located at Dumgoyne near Loch Lomond, just north of Glasgow, Scotland. Sitting directly on the Highland Line, Glengoyne holds a unique position in Scottish distilling: its copper pot stills sit in the Highlands, while its maturation warehouses sit across the road in the Lowlands. Renowned for its unpeated house style, Glengoyne dries its malted barley entirely using warm air rather than peat smoke, allowing pure grain and rich sherry wood characteristics to shine without smoky interference.

Spirit Description

Glengoyne 21 Year Old is crafted using 100% unpeated malted barley and pure water from the Glengoyne Burn. The spirit undergoes a notoriously slow distillation process in Glengoyne’s tall copper pot stills often cited as the slowest distillation rate in Scotland which maximizes copper contact to create a sweet, fruity, and refined spirit. The whisky matures for a full 21 years almost exclusively in hand-selected 100% European oak ex-sherry casks (primarily first-fill Oloroso). Over two decades of sherry wood maturation infuses the spirit with deep dried fruit sweetness, Christmas cake spices, and dark chocolate undertones.

  • Colour: Deep amber-copper with rich mahogany highlights.

  • Aroma: Intensely rich, fruity, and oak-forward. Opens with red apples, sherry-soaked raisins, sultanas, and dried figs, followed by dark honey, toasted hazelnut, baking spices (clove and cinnamon), and warm sponge cake.

  • Palate: Full-bodied, velvety, and luxurious on the entry. Upfront flavors of dark ripe fruit, candied orange peel, and Christmas cake give way to clove spice, dark chocolate, stewed plums, and rich oak tannins.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a heavy, mouth-coating, and rich viscosity.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long, warm, and dry, trailing off with lingering sherry oak, dark cocoa, dried fruit sweetness, and a soft cinnamon snap.

  • ABV: Bottled at 43% ABV (86 Proof).

title: Erdinger Weissbier 500 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Erdinger Weissbier (often called Erdinger Weißbier mit feiner Hefe) is the flagship wheat beer from Erdinger Weißbräu, the largest family-owned wheat beer brewery in the world. Brewed in Erding, Bavaria since 1886, it is an international benchmark for the classic Bavarian Hefeweizen style. Renowned for its gentle, elegant balance, Erdinger crafts a slightly milder, more refined wheat beer profile compared to some of its punchier, clove-heavy Bavarian neighbors, making it one of the most widely enjoyed and approachable German wheat beers globally.

Beer Description

Erdinger Weissbier pours a luminous, glowing golden-amber color with a characteristic cloudy haze from suspended fine yeast, crowned by a massive, towering, snow-white foam head that boasts incredible retention.

Aroma: The nose is soft, fresh, and inviting. It opens with gentle notes of ripe banana and sweet wheat malt, accompanied by top notes of fresh bread dough, subtle clove spice, and a light floral citrus whisper.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a velvety, smooth, and gently effervescent mouthfeel. It leads with a delicate wave of bananas and cream, crackered wheat, and subtle honey, shifting into a balanced mid-palate marked by a mild clove bite. The finish is clean, crisp, and harmonious, leaving a refreshing grain character and soft yeast texture without any lingering bitterness.

Profile: It sits at an authentic 5.3% ABV and a mild bitterness of approx. 13 IBU, prioritizing wheat smoothness and delicate fermentation esters over aggressive hop presence.

Technical Notes: Brewed according to the Bavarian Reinheitsgebot, Erdinger Weissbier utilizes fine wheat and barley malts, soft local well water, and Hallertau hops. What distinguishes Erdinger technically is its traditional Bayerische Edelreifung (double maturity process). After primary fermentation, the beer is bottle- and keg-conditioned with fresh wort and fine yeast, allowing a secondary fermentation to occur directly inside the package over three to four weeks for maximum natural carbonation and depth.

title: Erdinger Weissbier Dunkel 500 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Erdinger Weissbier Dunkel is a dark wheat beer classic from Erdinger Weißbräu, the world’s largest wheat beer brewery located in Erding, Bavaria. Originally created in 1989 as a birthday gift for owner Werner Brombach by his master brewers, it was so exceptionally well-received that it was quickly brought to full production. A textbook example of a traditional Dunkles Weissbier (Dunkelweizen), it marries the signature fruity, top-fermented yeast esters of a classic Bavarian wheat beer with the rich, chocolatey depth of roasted dark malts.

Beer Description

Erdinger Dunkel pours an opulent, cloudy dark chestnut brown with deep ruby highlights, crowned by a massive, towering tan foam head that lingers throughout the glass.

Aroma: The nose is rich, aromatic, and comforting. It opens with dominant notes of dark banana bread, roasted nuts, and chocolate malt, supported by top notes of ripe plum, dried fig, and a gentle whisper of spicy clove.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-to-full bodied with a velvety, creamy, and lively effervescence. It leads with a warm wave of caramelized wheat, cocoa, and toasted crust, transitioning into a balanced mid-palate of sweet dark fruit and subtle clove spice. The finish is remarkably smooth, clean, and refreshing, leaving a delicate sweetness lingering alongside roasted malt richness.

Profile: It sits at a traditional 5.3% ABV and a gentle bitterness of approx. 14 IBU, focusing entirely on yeast esters and roasted grain harmony over hop bitterness.

Technical Notes: Erdinger Dunkel is brewed using fine wheat and barley malts, including heavily toasted dark specialty malts that impart its signature ruby-brown color and roasted flavor complexity. It is top-fermented using Erdinger's proprietary house yeast strain. Following primary fermentation, it undergoes the traditional Bayerische Edelreifung (double maturity process), being bottle and keg conditioned with fresh wort to ensure natural carbonation, a thick velvety head, and complex flavor development.

title: Duchesse de Bourgogne 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Duchesse de Bourgogne is widely considered the world’s benchmark example of a traditional Flemish Red Ale (Flanders Red Ale). Brewed by Brouwerij Verhaeghe in Vichte, Belgium, this iconic beer is named in honor of Duchess Mary of Burgundy, the 15th-century ruler born in Brussels. Known as the "Burgundy of Belgium," it bridges the gap between craft beer and fine wine. Through a painstaking long-term oak-aging process, it develops an extraordinarily complex, tart, and fruity profile that defies traditional expectations of what a beer can be.

Beer Description

Duchesse de Bourgogne pours a deep, ruby-tinted chestnut mahogany with clear copper highlights, topped by a dense, tan-to-off-white head that leaves delicate rings of lace on the glass.

Aroma: The nose is extraordinarily rich, complex, and wine-like. It opens with an immediate burst of tart sour cherries, dark plums, and balsamico, followed by undertones of oak wood, brown sugar, and dried raisins. There is a distinct, pleasant acetic sharpness that immediately signals its sour structure.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a silky, lively, and mouth-watering effervescence. It leads with a sharp, puckering wave of tart red berries, green apple, and sour cherry juice, which quickly yields to a sweet middle of caramelized malt, fig, and dark sugar. The finish is long, complex, and bone-dry, ending with a soft oak tannic grip and a lingering, balsamic-style tartness.

Profile: It sits at a balanced 6.2% ABV and a very low bitterness of approx. 11 IBU, relying almost entirely on natural oak tannins and lactic/acetic acidity for its structural balance.

Technical Notes: The unique flavor profile of Duchesse de Bourgogne is a product of traditional mixed-fermentation brewing and patient wood-aging. After primary and secondary fermentation, the beer is transferred to massive oak foeders (casks), where it matures for up to 18 months. During this time, wild microflora and Lactobacillus present in the wood introduce complex acids and tannins. The final product is a precise blend of 8-month-old and 18-month-old oak-aged batches, balancing the vibrant fruitiness of the younger beer with the deep oak, acetic acidity, and maturity of the older liquid.

title: Deinhard Green Label Riesling Zero (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
This beverage originates from Germany. It is crafted by Deinhard, a historic wine producer established in Koblenz in 1794 by Johann Friedrich Deinhard. With over two centuries of winemaking heritage, the producer continues to innovate by developing high quality alcohol free offerings to meet modern lifestyle trends.

Spirit Description

The wine presents a light straw yellow colour with subtle citrus reflections in the glass. The nose features crisp, clean aromatics of green apple, rhubarb, and citrus peel. On the palate, it delivers a light and elegant structure with flavours of lemongrass, yellow apple, quince, pear, and delicate hints of freshly baked brioche. The body is light and refreshing, balancing subtle acidity with natural grape sweetness over a persistent mineral base. The finish is long lasting, crisp, and clean. The alcohol by volume is 0.0%.

title: Devil's Corner Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Australia, within the island state of Tasmania and the Tamar Valley region. Devil's Corner, part of the Brown Family Wine Group, is situated on the wild East Coast of Tasmania where maritime breezes create a unique cool-climate microclimate. The winery's philosophy centres on capturing the raw, vibrant energy of the Tasmanian landscape, using sustainable viticulture and minimal intervention to produce wines of great purity and fresh acidity.

Wine Description

This pale straw green wine displays vibrant aromas of fresh green apple, white peach, and bright citrus, complemented by subtle flinty minerality and delicate creamy notes. On the palate, it delivers crisp, refreshing flavors of nectarine, lemon zest, and subtle melon. It features a medium body with a lively, balanced acid structure and a clean, persistent finish. The varietal composition is 100% Chardonnay. It has an alcohol content of 13% ABV and is not certified organic.

title: Benjamin Bridge Ruby Piquette Zero (Non Alcoholic) 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This beverage originates from Canada. It is crafted in Nova Scotia's Gaspereau Valley by Benjamin Bridge, a renowned producer that has spent over twenty years developing artisanal wines from unique tidal ecosystems. The winery launched its Piquette Zero line as a creative, low intervention option to provide complex sensory experiences without relying on industrial dealcoholization.

Non Alcoholic Description

The wine style spritzer presents a bright ruby colour with a distinct magenta hue. The nose offers an inviting bouquet of red and black fruit, complemented by floral notes of lavender and a touch of spice. On the palate, it delivers a rich core of fruit backed by tangy acidity and lingering suggestions of blackcurrant. The body is light and effervescent with a refreshing, clean mouthfeel. It is characterized by its balanced dryness and fruit forward character. The alcohol by volume is 0.0%.

title: Asahi Super Dry 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Asahi Super Dry is Japan's best-selling beer and a revolutionary icon in the international brewing industry. Introduced in 1987 by Asahi Breweries, it single-handedly created the Japanese Rice Lager (Karakuchi) category and transformed the global market. The Japanese term Karakuchi translates to "dry," but in the context of beer, it signifies a precise brewing philosophy: a liquid that is crisp, ultra-clean, and leaves zero lingering sweetness or heavy aftertaste. Engineered using advanced yeast strains and high-ratio rice brewing, it offers a masterclass in palate precision designed to complement delicate food rather than overpower it.

Beer Description

Asahi Super Dry pours a brilliant, pale golden-straw color with crystal-clear brilliance and a fast-rising stream of microscopic bubbles that support a firm, tight white foam head.

Aroma: The nose is extraordinarily clean, faint, and focused. It leads with subtle top notes of puffed rice, soda cracker, and sweet barley grain, followed by a delicate, herbaceous whisper of fine continental hops. There are no heavy fruity esters or heavy malty scents.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a strikingly brisk, high-octane carbonation. It opens with a brief, light wave of toasted grain and bready malt, which instantly snaps into a sharp, dry mid-palate. The finish is remarkably fast and clean disappearing from the tongue almost instantly with a tight, mineral-like snap and zero sticky residue.

Profile: It sits at a standard 5.0% ABV and a mild, balanced bitterness of approx. 16–20 IBU, using high attenuation and low residual sugar to deliver its signature dry bite.

Technical Notes: The signature "Super Dry" profile relies on a specialized, highly controlled brewing technique. It utilizes a high percentage of malted barley alongside select rice and corn adjuncts to keep the grain bill light. The heart of the process is Asahi’s proprietary No. 318 yeast strain, a super-attenuating yeast capable of fermenting out almost all sugars. Combined with late-stage micro-filtration and precise hopping, the resulting liquid achieves a bone-dry finish with near-zero residual sugar.

title: Devil's Corner Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Australia, within the island state of Tasmania and the East Coast region. Devil's Corner, part of the Brown Family Wine Group, overlooks the rugged Hazards Ridge and Moulting Lagoon, where wild maritime elements shape a distinct cool-climate microclimate. The winemaking approach reflects a reverence for the untamed landscape, focusing on crafting accessible, fruit-driven wines with minimal intervention and high structural purity.

Wine Description

This brightly coloured wine displays youthful ruby and purple tones. It opens with a strongly perfumed nose of ripe black cherry, wild strawberry, and dark plum, interwoven with subtle baking spices, forest floor, and savory herbal accents. On the palate, it delivers a juicy, sweet-fruit core filled with flavors of fresh raspberries and dark fruits, framed by soft, supple tannins and crisp natural acidity. It presents a light to medium body with a clean, lively, and persistent finish.

title: Louis Jadot Beaune 'Les Greves' Premier Cru Blanc 2019
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Beaune Premier Cru AOC appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Louis Jadot Beaune 'Les Grèves' Premier Cru Blanc represents a rare, prestigious, and highly refined expression of Premier Cru white Burgundy. Founded in 1859 by Louis Henry Denis Jadot, Maison Louis Jadot is one of Burgundy’s most revered producers. While 'Les Grèves' is world-famous for its structured red Pinot Noir, this white expression comes from select limestone-rich parcels within the vineyard, whose name (grèves) refers to the gravelly, sandy limestone soils that offer exceptional drainage. Under head winemaker Frédéric Barnier, the winemaking philosophy focuses on gentle pneumatic pressing, native yeast fermentation, and maturation in French oak barrels (approximately 30% new) for 12 to 15 months on fine lees. The result is an opulent yet precise Chardonnay that combines rich texture with brilliant mineral tension.
