Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale gold colour with bright greenish reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of yellow apple, poached pear, lemon curd, and white peach, interwoven with sophisticated notes of toasted hazelnut, orange blossom, subtle brioche, crushed limestone, and warm baking spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, satiny, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of stone fruit, citrus oil, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a rich, coat-the-mouth mid-palate texture and seamless oak integration, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon peel, toasted almond, and a clean limestone grip. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, it offers an elegant profile with impressive cellar aging potential over many years. Stylistically, it combines Beaune's signature weight and generosity with Premier Cru mineral precision and structural balance.

bodyHtml:

title: Ornellaia 2023
bodyHtml:
This legendary red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the prestigious Bolgheri Superiore DOC within the Tuscan coast. Founded in 1981 by Marquis Lodovico Antinori and currently owned by the historic Marchesi de' Frescobaldi family, Tenuta dell'Ornellaia stands as an iconic pioneer of the Super Tuscan movement. The estate's winemaking philosophy focuses on a Bordeaux-inspired approach, meticulously managing a complex mosaic of marine, alluvial, and volcanic soils to craft a Grand Vin that beautifully mirrors the power, elegance, and Mediterranean soul of its unique coastal terroir.

Wine Description

The 2023 Ornellaia displays an intense, deep, and brilliant ruby red colour with a vibrant appearance in the glass. On the nose, it unveils a highly expressive, botanical, and complex bouquet filled with ripe blueberry and blackberry aromas, beautifully accented by hints of toasted almonds, cocoa, and fragrant Mediterranean shrubs like thyme and rosemary. The palate is generous, full bodied, and deeply concentrated, yet it surprises with a remarkably plush, velvety, and delicate texture. Flavours of dark cherry, plum, mocha, and subtle savory spices are underscored by a striking energy and a vibrant streak of acidity, showing a masterfully finessed through line that avoids any excess over ripeness. The finish is exceptionally enduring and sustained by silky, finely chiseled tannins that provide great structural elegance. Composed of 55% Cabernet Sauvignon, 26% Merlot, 12% Cabernet Franc, and 7% Petit Verdot, this vintage represents the debut of ex-Bordeaux technical director Marco Balsimelli. Each parcel was vinified separately before undergoing a double-barrel aging regime in French oak (65% new) for a total of 15 months, creating a harmonious and seamless profile built to evolve beautifully in the cellar from 2027 through 2050.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in Bolgheri was demanding but ultimately highly successful, marked by an exceptionally rainy spring that filled vital underground water reserves. A warm summer followed, and while a lower daytime average temperature in August slowed maturation, perfect conditions arrived in September with dry days and cool nights, allowing winemakers to harvest beautifully balanced fruit at optimum phenolic maturity.

Accolades

100 Points - Jane Anson: Moreish, confident and well judged, this is smoky yet ethereal, muscular yet light, wonderfully juicy and fragrant, with a perfectly judged blend of lightness of touch set against an unmistakable punch of damson, loganberry and red cherry fruits. Liquorice, tapenade and slate ensure the texture is slow and steady, and this is just a fabulous wine. Marco Balsimelli director, 65% new oak for ageing.

98 Points - Wine Advocate: The Ornellaia 2023 Bolgheri Superiore Ornellaia is a blend of 55% Cabernet Sauvignon, 26% Merlot, 12% Cabernet Franc and 7% Petit Verdot, and it is worth noting that Merlot remains present at nearly the same percentage as previous years, despite the greater challenges faced by early-ripening varieties in this mildew-prone vintage. Careful fruit selection made the difference. The wine shows impressive richness and concentration with a bouquet that leans botanical and complex, marked by dark fruit, Mediterranean thyme and rosemary. The nose was slightly closed when I tasted the wine, but it will open. The texture is velvety and polished, delivering beautiful richness with a sense of succulence that feels expansive on the palate. According to proprietor Lamberto Frescobaldi, the goal is to establish a clear through line focused on freshness and balancing fruit and spice while avoiding excess ripeness. This is a meticulously made Ornellaia that captures the vintage with remarkable elegance. The wine was bottled in July 2025 and is scheduled for release in March 2026.

title: Zuccardi Piedra Infinita Gravascal 2021
bodyHtml:
Zuccardi Piedra Infinita Gravascal hails from the Paraje Altamira subregion of the Uco Valley in Mendoza, Argentina. The winery is led by third generation winemaker Sebastián Zuccardi, whose philosophy focuses on 'terroir-focussed' wines that express the unique limestone-rich soils of the Andes foothills. This specific parcel, Gravascal, represents a meticulous selection from a 0.73-hectare plot characterized by large granite rocks covered in calcium carbonate.

Wine Description

This 100% Malbec displays a profound ruby red colour with violet undertones. The aromatic profile is intense and precise, dominated by notes of red fruits, wild herbs, and a distinct mineral 'wet stone' character. On the palate, the wine is full bodied yet remarkably elegant, defined by its chalky texture and vibrant acidity. The finish is exceptionally long and saline, reflecting the high lime content of the vineyard soil. While beautiful now, this wine has an optimal drinking window extending through 2040 due to its impeccable balance and structure.

title: Santa Rita Cabernet Sauvignon Casa Real 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Chile, within the Maipo Valley and the subregion of Alto Jahuel. Viña Santa Rita was founded in 1880, anchoring its legacy in the historical Alto Maipo terroir where its original ungrafted vines continue to thrive. Winemaker Sebastián Labbé guides the estate's vision, maintaining a philosophy centered on elegance, balance, and pure terroir expression.

Wine Description

This deep ruby wine opens with pure aromas of blackcurrant, ripe cherries, and plum, intertwined with complex notes of sweet tobacco, cedar, graphite, and subtle spices. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a refined, silky tannin structure, vibrant acidity, and remarkable concentration. The finish is long and persistent, carrying lingering accents of licorice, cocoa, and dried herbs. The varietal composition is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. It has an alcohol content of 14% ABV and is not certified organic.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 growing season in Alto Jahuel was notably cool and dry, allowing for extended, slow grape ripening. These conditions required careful management in the vineyard, enabling the winemaker to produce a precision-focused vintage defined by fresh acidity, firm tannins, and extraordinary aging potential.

title: Sadi Malot Les 2 Cepages Champagne Grand Cru
bodyHtml:
This structured sparkling wine originates from France, within the prestigious Champagne A.O.C. appellation. Produced by Champagne Sadi Malot a boutique, family-owned grower estate based in the premier cru village of Villers-Marmery in the Montagne de Reims this bottling represents a quintessential expression of grower Champagne craftsmanship. Sourced from family-owned, low-yielding vineyard parcels rooted in ancient, deep chalk soils, the vines benefit from Champagne's cool northern microclimate. These cold maritime conditions allow the grapes to build phenolic complexity while retaining high natural acidity and sharp limestone minerality.

Wine Description

The Sadi Malot Les Deux Cépages Champagne presents a pale straw gold colour in the glass with bright platinum highlights and a delicate, persistent stream of fine bubbles. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, precise, and sophisticated portrait of chalk terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crisp green apple, white peach, lemon zest, and sliced Anjou pear, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of white flowers, crushed chalk, wet stone, fresh brioche, and toasted almonds. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of tart orchard fruit, citrus peel, and salted melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid palate density. The mouthfeel is weightless, silky, and creamy, carrying into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral driven finish accented by persistent notes of limestone chalk and lemon oil

title: Tenuta Le Colonne Costa Toscana Vermentino 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured white wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Costa Toscana I.G.T. appellation in the Tuscany region. Produced by Tenuta Le Colonne, an exceptional estate situated along the Tyrrhenian coast near Bolgheri, this bottling perfectly embodies the maritime and mineral expression of great coastal Tuscan terroirs. The vines thrive on sandy and pebbly alluvial soils, benefiting from a sunny Mediterranean microclimate refreshed by constant sea breezes. These ideal conditions allow Vermentino to achieve optimal phenolic maturity while retaining a high natural freshness and chiseled mineral drive.

Wine Description

Tenuta Le Colonne Costa Toscana Vermentino presents a luminous, pale straw yellow colour in the glass with silver and greenish highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, vibrant, and complex, delivering a pure and elegant portrait of coastal Tuscan terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of white flowers, fresh citrus, white peach, and Mediterranean aromatic herbs, enhanced by subtle notes of lemon zest, green apple, and a distinct imprint of sea salt. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied, lively, and balanced, showcasing a succulent fruit core supported by a refreshing natural acidity. The texture is fluid and silky, stretching into a long, clean, and mineral finish that marks the palate with persistent notes of sea stone and citrus.

This high definition Tuscan expression is 100% Vermentino, carefully hand harvested to preserve fruit integrity. Following gentle pressing, the juice fermented in temperature controlled stainless steel tanks to preserve the varietal's pure aromatic character. The wine aged on fine lees for several months prior to bottling. It reaches an effortlessly integrated alcohol content (ABV) of 13.0% and is finished bone dry.

title: Wolfberger Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
This structured sparkling wine originates from France, within the Creamant d'Alsace A.O.C. appellation in the Alsace region. Produced by Wolfberger, an iconic winemaking cooperative established in 1902 that has grown into one of Alsatian viticulture's premier pioneers, this bottling reflects centuries of traditional method sparkling winemaking. Sourced from choice vineyard plots situated on the eastern slopes of the Vosges Mountains, the vines benefit from a unique dry and sunny continental microclimate. The complex soils, rich in limestone, marl, and granite, allow Pinot Noir grapes to achieve ideal phenolic maturity while locking in a vibrant, age worthy natural acidity and distinct mineral focus.

Wine Description

The Wolfberger Brut Ros'e9 Cr'e9mant d'Alsace presents a delicate salmon pink colour in the glass with bright copper reflections and a fine, persistent stream of delicate bubbles. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high toned, and precise, delivering an energetic, pure, and elegant portrait of Alsatian terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of fresh wild strawberries, tart raspberries, watermelon, and red cherries, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of white flowers, lemon zest, wet stone, and a faint hint of toasted brioche. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of red berry fruit and blood orange zest. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its mid palate weight. The mouthfeel is weightless and creamy, framed by a delicate mousse that carries into a long, dry, and clean finish accented by persistent notes of mineral chalk and lingering berry skin.

title: New York Distilling Dorothy Parker Rose Gin
bodyHtml:
This contemporary floral gin originates from the United States, crafted in Brooklyn, New York. Produced by the New York Distilling Company, this release represents a vibrant, rose-infused variation of their flagship Dorothy Parker American Gin. Building upon the core botanical base—which includes juniper, elderberries, hibiscus, cinnamon bark, green cardamom, and citrus peel—this expression is steeped with an infusion of fresh red and pink rose petals. Bottled at a strength of 88 proof (44.0% ABV), it gives a modern, aromatic twist to traditional American craft gin while honoring its namesake's sharp, legendary New York wit.

Spirit Description

This gin presents a luminous, blush-pink to light rose-amber hue in the glass. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic, floral, and bright, releasing wafts of red rose petals, honeysuckle, and candied hibiscus, underlaid by a tart berry burst of crushed elderberry, crushed cardamom, and sweet lemon zest. The palate is creamy, medium-bodied, and silky, delivering initial notes of sweet cherry, redcurrant jam, and rosewater, which balance against piney juniper berries, warm cinnamon, and citrus oils. The finish is clean, dry, and pleasantly grippy, trailing off with lingering dried rose hips, pepper spice, pink grapefruit peel, and a soft, warming botanical glow.

Accolades

Since its debut, Dorothy Parker Rose Petal Gin has earned wide acclaim among craft cocktail bartenders and gin enthusiasts as a standout example of contemporary American distilling. Critics across independent platforms like Bevvy and The Gin is In routinely praise the release for avoiding the artificial, overly sugary pitfall of commercial pink gins, celebrating instead how the real rose petal infusion marries seamlessly with the spicy, elderberry-heavy profile of the base gin.

title: New York Distilling Dorothy Parker American Gin
bodyHtml:
This contemporary American gin originates from the United States, produced in Brooklyn, New York. Crafted by the New York Distilling Company, this original flagship expression is distilled from a neutral spirit base of 100% New York-grown grain. Named in honor of the famed razor-witted Brooklyn-born writer, poet, and gin connoisseur Dorothy Parker, it balances classic botanical traditions with distinct modern craft influences. The botanical selection marries traditional juniper berries and citrus peel with elderberries, cinnamon bark, green cardamom, and dried hibiscus petals. Bottled at a signature strength of 88 proof (44.0% ABV), it provides an aromatic, fruit-and-floral-forward presentation of contemporary American craft distillation.

Spirit Description

This gin presents crystal clear and luminous in the glass. On the nose, it is strikingly fragrant, vibrant, and expressive, releasing wafts of bright hibiscus, elderberry blossom, and sweet dried citrus peel, anchored by a delicate backbone of piney juniper, warm cinnamon, and subtle cardamom spice. On the palate, it feels round, smooth, and medium-to-full-bodied, opening with initial flavors of candied tangerine, redcurrant, and blackberry jam. As it moves across the palate, rich mid-palate berry sweetness integrates cleanly with cracked black pepper, earthy coriander, and resinous juniper. The finish is long, crisp, and pleasantly dry, leaving lingering notes of dried rose hips, citrus zest, warming cassia, and a clean botanical heat.

Accolades

Dorothy Parker American Gin is widely celebrated as one of the pioneering, benchmark expressions of the early 2010s New American craft gin revolution. Earning high praise across spirit publications and review outlets like Distiller, The Gin is In, and Gin Foundry, critics frequently laud the bottling for maintaining genuine juniper presence while elevating dark berry and floral elements like elderberry and hibiscus into main roles.

title: Clase Azul Guerrero Mezcal
bodyHtml:
This luxury artisanal mezcal originates from Mexico, produced in the state of Guerrero in southwestern Mexico. Handcrafted by Clase Azul Mexico, this expression celebrates the rich terroir and rare botanical biodiversity of Guerrero's mountain regions. Unlike traditional mezcals made from Agave Espadín, Clase Azul Guerrero is distilled exclusively from 100% wild Papalote Agave (Agave cupreata), a rare agave species that grows natively on the high-altitude slopes of the Sierra Madre del Sur mountain range, taking up to 12 to 15 years to fully mature. Bottled at a strength of 84 proof (42.0% ABV) in a handcrafted, sea-green ceramic decanter with a hand-painted brass cap inspired by traditional Guerrero lacquerware, it presents a floral, herbal, and refined vision of wild agave spirit.

Spirit Description This unaged mezcal presents completely crystal clear with brilliant silver highlights in the glass. On the nose, it is delicate, green, and extraordinarily aromatic, opening with vibrant scents of grapefruit zest, fresh rosemary, and green pepper, underlaid by mossy forest floor, damp earth, and a soft, ethereal whisper of sweet wood smoke. On the palate, it feels soft, silky, and medium-bodied, delivering an elegant entry of cooked agave sweetness, lemon blossom, and fresh seaweed, which quickly opens into layers of tobacco leaf, dried oregano, and subtle tropical fruit sweetness like green papaya. The finish is long, clean, and herbal, leaving a trailing impression of mineral slate, dried herbs, white pepper spice, and a very gentle, refined smoke. The wild Papalote agave produces a markedly lighter, more floral and herbal profile compared to the deeper, smokier Espadín or Durangensis varieties.

Accolades Clase Azul Guerrero Mezcal stands as one of the flagship releases within Clase Azul's high-end agave portfolio. Earning acclaim across luxury lifestyle and spirit review platforms such as Robb Report, Tequila Matchmaker, and Distiller, critics frequently praise the bottling for showcasing the rare, aromatic nuances of Agave cupreata. Commentators note that it skillfully avoids the heavy, overpowering creosote smoke of commercial mezcals, prioritizing herbal complexity, bright citrus, and mineral elegance instead.

title: Italicus Rosolio Di Bergamotto Liquer
bodyHtml:
This luxury Italian aperitivo liqueur originates from Italy, produced in the historic Moncalieri distillery in Turin. Created by renowned spirits authority Giuseppe Gallo in 2016, Italicus revives the forgotten Italian tradition of Rosolio—an ancient aperitivo category traditionally known as the "liqueur of kings." Built upon a recipe dating back to the 1850s, the heart of the spirit features IGP-certified Calabrian bergamot oranges (Citrus bergamia) and Sicilian cedro lemons. These citrus peels are cold-pressed via sfumatura (a traditional extraction process) before being infused with a neutral grain spirit alongside chamomile, lavender, yellow rose, melissa balm, and gentian root. Bottled at an approachable strength of 40 proof (20.0% ABV) in an aquamarine glass bottle inspired by Roman architecture and the waters of the Amalfi Coast, it offers a bright, aromatic, and balanced citrus profile.

Spirit Description This liqueur presents a clear, pale straw to luminous light-gold color in the glass. On the nose, it is strikingly aromatic, vibrant, and fragrant, opening with an intense burst of fresh bergamot orange, citrus oils, and Earl Grey tea notes, supported by delicate floral undertones of lavender, dried chamomile, and yellow rose petals. On the palate, it feels silky, round, and delicately syrupy without feeling overly cloying, delivering a bright, bitter-sweet balance of candied lemon peel, fragrant zesty bergamot, and floral honey. The mid-palate transitions into a subtle, earthy herbal complexity driven by gentian and melissa balm. The finish is crisp, medium-length, and refreshing, leaving a trailing impression of citrus zest, dried flowers, subtle salinity, and a clean herbal dryness.

Accolades Since its debut, Italicus Rosolio di Bergamotto has achieved widespread acclaim across the global bar community, quickly becoming an indispensable modern staple on cocktail menus worldwide. Earning prestigious industry honors—including Best New European Spirit at Tales of the Cocktail Spirited Awards, Best New Spirit at the International Bartender Awards, and top honors at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition—critics and master mixologists praise the release for reviving the Rosolio category with an authentic, versatile, and natural citrus profile.

title: Checkmate End Game Merlot 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Canada, within British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. CheckMate Artisanal Winery was established by Anthony von Mandl on the Golden Mile Bench, dedicated exclusively to crafting world-class Expressions of Chardonnay and Merlot. The winemaking philosophy focuses on minimal intervention, utilizing wild yeast fermentations and precise oak aging to showcase the distinct microclimates and mineral-rich soils of the region's benchlands.

Wine Description

This deep red wine opens with a complex, expressive nose featuring notes of dark plum puree, orange peel, and dark chocolate, complemented by delicate floral undertones and baking spices. On the palate, it is rich, dark, and refined, delivering concentrated flavors of dark cherry, red currant, licorice, and peppercorn. It exhibits a full body with a structured, silky tannic backbone and vibrant natural acidity that leads into a long, vibrant finish. The varietal composition is 100% Merlot. It has an alcohol content of 14.6% ABV and is not certified organic.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 growing season in the Okanagan Valley started with a cool, delayed spring that lowered overall crop yields. Warm late-summer temperatures and ideal harvest conditions allowed the fruit to catch up and reach optimal ripeness, enabling the winemaker to produce a wine with remarkable balance, fresh acidity, and impressive depth.

title: Antinori Villa Cigliano Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Italy, within Tuscany's Chianti Classico region and the subregion of San Casciano in Val di Pesa. Villa Cigliano is the historical estate of the Montecchi family, where winemaking traditions have been preserved for centuries on soil rich in clay and limestone. The estate's philosophy focuses on crafting authentic, site specific expressions that showcase the purity and structure of traditional Sangiovese.

Wine Description

This deep ruby red wine reveals complex aromas of ripe sour cherry, red plum, and violet, balanced by savory notes of leather, pipe tobacco, dried herbs, and subtle oak spices. The palate displays a full body with a firm, refined tannic structure and a vibrant, crisp acidity typical of the region. The finish is long and persistent, carrying lingering notes of dark cocoa and crushed stone. The varietal composition is 100% Sangiovese. It has an alcohol content of 14% ABV and is certified organic.

title: Martin's Lane Pinot Noir 'Dehart Vineyard' 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Canada, within British Columbia's Okanagan Valley and the East Kelowna Slopes subregion. Martin's Lane Winery operates a state of the art, six level gravity-fed facility designed to process grapes with zero mechanical pumping, preserving maximum fruit integrity. Headed by winemaker Shane Munn, the estate focuses exclusively on Pinot Noir and Riesling, adhering to a philosophy of minimal intervention, wild fermentations, and precise single-vineyard expressions.

Wine Description

This bright ruby red wine opens with alluring aromas of fresh red cherry, wild strawberry, and raspberry, interwoven with warm baking spices, earthiness, and subtle savory herbs. The palate is graceful and textured, delivering vibrant red fruit flavors balanced by crisp, mouthwatering acidity and silky, fine-grained tannins. It presents a medium body with a fresh, persistent finish accented by delicate spice and mineral notes. The varietal composition is 100% Pinot Noir, co-fermented in concrete tanks with a high proportion of whole clusters.

title: Bouchard Pere & Fils Meursault 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and aristocratic white wine originates from France, within the prestigious Meursault A.O.C. appellation in the Cote de Beaune subregion of Burgundy. Produced by Bouchard Pere & Fils, an iconic Burgundian maison founded in 1731 with nearly three centuries of winemaking heritage, this bottling represents an exceptional benchmark for village tier Meursault. Sourced from choice estate and partner vineyard plots planted on eastern and southeastern facing slopes, the vines thrive in deep, limestone rich soils composed of Jurassic marl, clay, and hard chalk. Burgundy's continental microclimate allows Chardonnay grapes to achieve complete phenolic maturity while preserving a razor sharp natural acidity and intense mineral drive.

Wine Description

Bouchard Pere & Fils Meursault presents a luminous, pale straw gold colour in the glass with bright platinum reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and sophisticated portrait of C'f4te de Beaune limestone terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of sliced green apples, Anjou pears, white peaches, and lemon curd, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of toasted hazelnuts, white flowers, wet stone minerality, and a subtle touch of buttery brioche. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of tart orchard fruit, citrus oil, and ripe melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly cuts across its rich mid palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by a tactile, creamy texture gained from traditional lees contact that carries into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral driven finish.

This high definition French expression is 100% Chardonnay, hand harvested at optimal ripeness. Following gentle whole cluster pressing, the juice was transferred into French oak barrels for temperature controlled primary fermentation. The wine underwent controlled malolactic conversion and was matured in select French oak barrels (approximately 15% to 25% new wood) for 8 to 12 months with periodic lees stirring to build seamless mid palate volume. It reaches an effortlessly integrated alcohol content (ABV) of 13.0% to 13.5% and is finished bone dry.

title: Kaiken Indomito Cabernet Franc 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and aristocratic red wine originates from Argentina, within the prestigious Agrelo sub-appellation of Luj'e1n de Cuyo in Mendoza. Produced by Kaiken, an estate established in 2002 by legendary Chilean winemaker 'c1ureo Montes to explore the exceptional terroir across the Andes, the 'Indomito' series highlights an adventurous, fresh, and uninhibited expression of high altitude Argentine varietals. Sourced from estate vineyards rooted in deep alluvial soils with gravel and limestone deposits, the vines benefit from a intense mountain climate. Hot, sun-drenched days are balanced by cold night winds descending off the Andes, enabling Cabernet Franc to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining high natural acidity and vibrant aromatic clarity.

Wine Description

The Kaiken Indomito Cabernet Franc presents a deep ruby red colour in the glass with vivid purple and violet reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high toned, and fruit forward, delivering an energetic, precise, and approachable portrait of Agrelo terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crushed tart black cherries, fresh red plums, and cassis, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh red paprika, roasted red pepper, dried violets, graphite, and a subtle line of herbal freshness. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, sleek, and supple, showcasing a succulent core of dark berry fruit, blood orange zest, and sweet spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its mid palate weight. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by soft, rounded tannins that glide into a long, dry, and clean finish accented by persistent notes of crushed stone, herbal spice, and dark cocoa.

title: Chateau de Beaucastel Chateauneuf du Pape 2023
bodyHtml:
Château de Beaucastel Châteauneuf-du-Pape 2023 originates from France, within the southern Rhône Valley and the renowned Châteauneuf-du-Pape appellation. Managed by the Perrin family (Famille Perrin) across multiple generations, Beaucastel is one of the most celebrated and historically significant estates in the region. Located in the northernmost sector of the appellation near Coudoulet, the 110-hectare estate features distinctive soils of rolled pebbles (galets roulés) over limestone, sand, and clay. Beaucastel's operational philosophy stands apart through its commitment to organic and biodynamic viticulture, as well as its traditional practice of vinifying all 13 official grape varieties authorized in the appellation. The winemaking approach emphasizes balance, aromatic precision, and age-worthiness over sheer alcohol or heavy extraction.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a luminous, deep ruby-purple appearance in the glass with bright magenta highlights at the rim. It possesses a full-bodied, supple, and beautifully articulated structure defined by a silky, mouth-coating, and balanced texture. The sensory profile is highly expressive, layered, and complex, opening with a classic bouquet of dark cherries, wild blackberries, and red plum preserves, seamlessly interwoven with signature Beaucastel nuances of garrigue herbs (thyme, rosemary, lavender), gamey cured meats, black pepper, licorice, leather, and crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it delivers a generous core of juicy dark and red fruit held together by fine-grained, polished tannins and a remarkable thread of natural freshness given the warm southern climate. The finish is long, clean, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of sweet spice, dark cocoa, and dried flowers.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically dominated by Mourvèdre (30%) and Grenache (30%), complemented by Syrah (10%), Counoise (10%), Cinsault (5%), and smaller proportions of the remaining authorized Châteauneuf-du-Pape varieties (Vaccarèse, Terret Noir, Muscardin, Clairette, Picpoul, Picardan, and Bourboulenc).

  • Stylistic Notes: Hand-harvested with strict sorting in the vineyard and cellar. Each variety is vinified separately in temperature-controlled vats, with a high proportion of Mourvèdre giving the blend its signature structure, gamey complexity, and ageability. Following blending, the wine aged for approximately 12 to 14 months in large oak casks (foudres) before bottling, preserving pure fruit expression without heavy oak influence.

  • ABV: 14.5%.

  • Organic Status: Fully Certified Organic and Biodynamic (certified by Ecocert / Demeter), continuing the estate's long tradition of chemical-free farming since the 1950s.

title: Elijah Craig Toasted Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml:
This Kentucky straight rye whiskey originates from the United States, produced in the Kentucky region. Crafted at Heaven Hill Distillery in Bardstown, Kentucky, Elijah Craig Toasted Barrel Rye expands the brand's popular toasted finishing program into their rye portfolio. Built on Heaven Hill's traditional barely-legal rye mash bill (51% rye, 35% corn, and 14% malted barley), fully matured straight rye whiskey is dumped and transferred into a secondary, custom-toasted new oak barrel produced in partnership with Independent Stave Company. This specialized toast profile softens the sharp edges of the rye grain while imparting deep, caramelized oak sugars.

Spirit Description

This finished rye presents a rich, burnished copper hue in the glass. The nose is warm, sweet, and dessert-forward, opening with inviting aromas of toasted oak, crème brûlée, toasted almonds, and roasted hazelnuts, backed by soft hints of cinnamon-dusted marshmallow and vanilla. On the palate, it exhibits a remarkably soft, creamy mouthfeel, delivering luscious flavours of milk chocolate, butterscotch, and sweet graham cracker, beautifully balanced by subtle rye baking spices, nutmeg, and gentle oak tannins. The finish is smooth, warm, and lingering, leaving a comforting trail of sweet oak, milk chocolate, and drawn-out rye spice. Bottled at 94 Proof (47% ABV), it offers a uniquely approachable, creamy, and low-astringency take on Kentucky-style rye.

Accolades

Elijah Craig Toasted Barrel Rye has been widely praised by spirits writers and rye enthusiasts as a standout addition to Heaven Hill's line. Lauded by outlets such as Breaking Bourbon, Whisky Advocate, and The Spirits Business, the release is acclaimed for using secondary toasted wood to elevate standard Kentucky rye into a complex, sweet, and dessert-like sipping experience.

title: Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Batch #B523
bodyHtml:
This straight bourbon whiskey originates from the United States, produced in the Kentucky region. Crafted at Heaven Hill Distillery in Bardstown, Kentucky, Elijah Craig Barrel Proof is an uncut, non-chill filtered small-batch bourbon released three times annually. The batch code "B523" indicates the second release ("B") of May ("5") in the year 2023. This specific batch holds historic significance in the Elijah Craig Barrel Proof series, as it was the first release to move away from the rigid 12-year minimum age statement, coming in at 11 years and 5 months of age while maintaining its signature cask-strength bottling.

Spirit Description

This bourbon presents a deep amber-mahogany hue in the glass. The nose is rich, sweet, and inviting, opening with aromas of butterscotch, toasted oak, roasted nuts, and sweet vanilla, accompanied by subtle nuances of red fruit, brown sugar, and baking spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied and chewy, delivering a vibrant hit of cinnamon spice, caramel, charred oak, and dark cocoa, balanced by sweet citrus oil and vanilla cream. The finish is long, warm, and satisfying, leaving a trailing impression of sweet oak, black pepper, and toasted brown sugar. Bottled at a cask strength of 62.1% ABV (124.2 Proof), it offers an accessible, remarkably well-balanced, and highly flavor-dense profile.

Accolades

Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Batch B523 garnered high praise from whiskey reviewers for its exceptional drinkability and balance despite the high proof and minor adjustment in age. The Elijah Craig Barrel Proof line is a multi-time winner of "Whisky of the Year" from Whisky Advocate and regularly secures Double Gold medals at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

title: Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Batch #A124
bodyHtml:
This straight bourbon whiskey originates from the United States, produced in the Kentucky region. Crafted at Heaven Hill Distillery in Bardstown, Kentucky, Elijah Craig Barrel Proof is a small-batch, uncut, and non-chill-filtered expression released three times a year. The batch code "A124" indicates the first release ("A") of January ("1") in the year 2024. Following Heaven Hill's updated age policy for the series, Batch A124 comes in with an age statement of 10 years and 9 months, offering a slightly younger, brighter oak profile compared to historic 12-year releases while maintaining its signature cask-strength presentation.

Spirit Description

This bourbon presents a rich, polished copper to dark amber hue in the glass. On the nose, it is warm and aromatic, opening with enticing scents of toasted caramel, vanilla bean, and sweet corn, layered over charred oak, nutmeg, and a touch of ripe stone fruit. The palate is full-bodied and lively, delivering robust flavours of butterscotch, cinnamon-dusted graham cracker, milk chocolate, and roasted pecans, balanced by pepper spice and seasoned wood tannins. The finish is long, warm, and comforting, leaving lingering notes of dark brown sugar, sweet oak, and drying baking spices. Bottled at a natural cask strength of 59.5% ABV (119 Proof)—a relatively approachable proof point for the Barrel Proof series—it offers outstanding richness with remarkably soft heat integration.

Accolades

Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Batch A124 received glowing reviews from bourbon critics for its exceptional balance and lower, highly sipable proof point. Celebrated across major platforms like Breaking Bourbon, Whisky Advocate, and The Spirits Business, it was praised for delivering classic Heaven Hill caramel and baking spice complexity without overpowering alcohol burn.

title: Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Batch #A120
bodyHtml:
This straight bourbon whiskey originates from the United States, produced in the Kentucky region. Crafted at Heaven Hill Distillery in Bardstown, Kentucky, Elijah Craig Barrel Proof is a highly anticipated, small-batch release produced three times a year (designated by batches A, B, and C, where "A120" signifies the first batch of January 2020). Adhering to the classic Elijah Craig profile, this bourbon is aged for a minimum of 12 years in oak barrels and bottled straight from the barrel without chill-filtration or dilution, yielding a massive, uncompromised cask strength expression.

Spirit Description

This bourbon presents a deep, dark garnet-mahogany hue in the glass. The nose is bold, punchy, and intensely rich, opening with aromas of dark brown sugar, charred oak, toasted caramel, and vanilla bean, complemented by notes of dried cherries, dark chocolate, and heavy baking spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied, thick, and oily, delivering an explosive burst of spicy cinnamon, black pepper, molasses, and roasted nuts, balanced by deep oak tannins, leather, and dark berry sweetness. The finish is exceptionally long, warm, and lingering, leaving a deep trail of charred oak, cocoa, dark sugar, and peppery heat. Bottled at a high cask strength of 68.3% ABV (136.6 Proof), it delivers raw power, dense texture, and exceptional 12-year depth.

title: Villa Teresa Organic Merlot 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the delle Venezie IGT appellation, Villa Teresa Organic Merlot represents a smooth, eco-conscious, and fruit-forward expression of Italian red winemaking. Produced by the historic Dinami family estate of Vintners Dinami / Fratelli Di Maria, the Villa Teresa line has been a pioneer in certified organic and vegan viticulture in northeastern Italy since the late 1980s. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyards situated across the flat alluvial plains and gentle rolling hills of Venetia, the vines grow on clay, silt, and gravel soils. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes sustainable practices and minimal intervention, utilizing gentle destemming, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats, and maturation without heavy oak influence to preserve pure red fruit character, soft tannins, and natural freshness.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, dark ruby red colour with bright garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly fragrant bouquet opens with inviting aromas of ripe black plum, dark cherry, wild blackberry, and raspberry jam, interwoven with subtle notes of dried herbs, cocoa, sweet spice, and a touch of earthiness. On the palate, it is medium bodied, smooth, and approachable, delivering delicious flavours of plum curd, red berry jam, and subtle mineral earth, all supported by a balanced, refreshing spine of natural acidity. Framed by soft, velvety tannins and a supple mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, satisfying finish marked by lingering dark fruit, sweet herbs, and a gentle mineral lift. Composed of 100% Merlot, it offers a pure, unvarnished profile with immediate drinking appeal. Stylistically, it combines Venetian elegance and certified organic purity with supple, easy-drinking fruit richness.

title: Villa Teresa Organic Chardonnay
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the delle Venezie IGT appellation, Villa Teresa Organic Chardonnay represents a fresh, eco-conscious, and vibrant expression of Northern Italian white winemaking. Produced by the historic Dinami family estate of Vintners Dinami / Fratelli Di Maria, the Villa Teresa range has been a pioneer in certified organic and vegan viticulture in northeastern Italy since the late 1980s. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyards situated across the flat alluvial plains and gentle rolling hills of Venetia, the vines grow on mineral-rich limestone, clay, and gravel soils. The winemaking philosophy focuses on environmental sustainability and purity of fruit, utilizing gentle pneumatic pressing and temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats to preserve bright fruit aromatics, crisp natural acidity, and clean varietal balance without oak influence.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale straw yellow colour with bright greenish-gold reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly fragrant bouquet opens with inviting aromas of crisp green apple, ripe yellow pear, white peach, and lemon zest, interwoven with subtle notes of white spring blossoms, acacia, and a touch of crushed limestone. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, crisp, and refreshing, delivering delicious flavours of orchard fruit, citrus curd, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a smooth, clean texture and a supple mid-palate structure, it concludes with a lively, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon peel, fresh apple, and a crisp mineral lift. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, it offers an approachable, unvarnished profile with immediate drinking appeal. Stylistically, it combines Italian freshness and certified organic purity with pure, un-oaked Chardonnay character.

title: Villa Teresa Organic Rose Frizzante
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the delle Venezie IGT appellation, Villa Teresa Organic Rosé Sparkling Frizzante represents a light, effervescent, and eco-friendly expression of Italian sparkling rosé. Crafted by the historic Dinami family estate, the Villa Teresa line is a pioneer in certified organic and vegan viticulture in northeastern Italy. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyards situated across the plains and rolling hills of the Veneto, the vines thrive in alluvial soils rich in limestone and clay. The winemaking philosophy focuses on environmental sustainability and minimal intervention, utilizing gentle pressing with brief skin contact to achieve a delicate pink blush, followed by secondary natural fermentation in pressurized stainless steel tanks (Charmat method) to produce a gentle, soft pressure (frizzante) bubble.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous pale salmon pink colour with delicate peach highlights and a lively, persistent bead of fine gentle bubbles. An expressive, fruit-forward bouquet opens with fresh aromas of wild strawberry, red raspberry, pink grapefruit, and white peach, interwoven with subtle notes of acacia flowers, orange blossom, and a touch of rose petal. On the palate, it is light bodied, crisp, and delightfully spritzy, delivering charming flavours of tart red berries, citrus zest, and sweet watermelon, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a delicate mousse and a soft, refreshing mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, uplifting finish marked by lingering red berries, fresh floral notes, and a crisp mineral lift. Composed of an organic blend featuring Raboso and Glera, it offers an approachable, energetic profile with immediate drinking appeal. Stylistically, it combines Venetian spritz, organic purity, and effortless sparkling refreshment.

title: Villa Teresa Organic Rose
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the delle Venezie IGT appellation, Villa Teresa Organic Rosé represents a fresh, eco-conscious, and vibrant expression of Italian organic rosé. Produced by the historic Dinami family estate of Vintners Dinami / Fratelli Di Maria, the Villa Teresa line has been a pioneer in certified organic viticulture in northeastern Italy since the late 1980s. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyards situated across the flat alluvial plains and gentle rolling hills of Venetia, the vines grow on limestone, clay, and gravel soils. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes sustainable practices and minimal intervention, utilizing gentle pressing, short skin contact to extract a delicate pink hue, and low-temperature fermentation in stainless steel vats to preserve bright fruit aromatics and crisp natural acidity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, pale coral pink colour with delicate peach reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly fragrant bouquet opens with charming aromas of wild strawberry, fresh raspberry, pink grapefruit, and watermelon, interwoven with subtle notes of white blossoms, orange peel, and dried herbs. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, crisp, and refreshing, delivering delicious flavours of red berry fruit, citrus zest, and mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a clean, balanced texture and a supple mid-palate structure, it concludes with a lively, persistent finish marked by lingering strawberry, pomegranate, and a subtle saline mineral grip. Composed of a blend of traditional regional red grape varieties, it offers an approachable, pure profile with immediate drinking appeal. Stylistically, it combines Venetian elegance and certified organic purity with bright, sun-kissed fruit freshness.

title: Sonoma Cutrer 'The Cutrer' Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and aristocratic white wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Russian River Valley appellation of Sonoma County in California. Produced by Sonoma Cutrer, an iconic estate established in 1981 and celebrated worldwide for its single minded focus on Burgundian style Chardonnay, 'The Cutrer' serves as one of the winery's premier single vineyard expressions. Sourced exclusively from The Cutrer Vineyard's low yielding, gravelly clay loam soils and ancient alluvial river terraces, the vines benefit from a cool maritime microclimate marked by intense morning fog and warm afternoon sun.

Wine Description

Sonoma Cutrer 'The Cutrer' Chardonnay presents a luminous, pale straw gold colour in the glass with bright platinum and subtle greenish reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high toned, and complex, delivering a precise, vibrant, and elegant portrait of Russian River Valley terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of sliced green apple, yellow pear, lemon curd, and white peach, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of roasted hazelnut, toasted brioche, orange blossom, and a distinct line of wet stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of tart orchard fruit, citrus oil, and melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly cuts across its mid palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by a tactile, creamy texture gained from traditional lees contact that carries into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral driven finish.

title: Vajra Langhe Nebbiolo 2024 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Piedmont region of Italy, this wine is a pure expression of the Langhe DOC, with fruit sourced from high-elevation vineyards in Barolo, Novello, and Sinio. The G.D. Vajra estate was revitalized in 1972 by Aldo Vaira, who became a pioneer of organic viticulture in the region. Today, the winery remains a family affair, guided by a philosophy of 'recipe-free' attention and a deep commitment to biodiversity and the authentic preservation of Piedmontese traditions.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo is celebrated for its 'varietal truth', displaying a lively light garnet colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is expressive and ethereal, featuring a bouquet of dried rose petals, crushed violets, and mountain raspberries intertwined with notes of lavender, mint, and citrus peel. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and energetic, offering a 'pulpy' texture with flavours of sour cherry, strawberry, and cranberry balanced by a chalky minerality. It is defined by its silky, well-integrated tannins and a lifted, savory finish. While designed to be enjoyed young for its freshness, it possesses the structure for a graceful evolution over the next decade.

title: Chateau de La Gardine Cotes du Rhone Villages 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured red wine originates from France, within the Côtes du Rhône Villages A.O.C. appellation in the Southern Rhône Valley. Produced by Château de La Gardine a historic estate in Châteauneuf-du-Pape owned by the Brunel family since 1945, renowned for its famous asymmetrical, hand-blown molded bottle (flacon La Gardine) this bottling represents an exceptionally high benchmark for village-tier Rhône expressions. Sourced from estate-managed vineyard parcels planted on limestone-clay terraces and quartzite river pebbles (galets roulés), the vines thrive under a Mediterranean microclimate. Generous summer sunshine is tempered by the cooling, drying influence of the Mistral wind, allowing traditional Rhône varieties to reach complete phenolic maturity while maintaining a vibrant natural acidity and aromatic detail.

Wine Description

The Château de La Gardine Côtes du Rhône Villages presents a deep garnet-ruby color in the glass with bright magenta reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, precise, and rustic-elegant portrait of Southern Rhône terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crushed wild blackberries, ripe black cherries, and dark plums, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh lavender, garrigue herbs, black pepper, cured meat, tapenade, and a subtle line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and supple, showcasing a succulent core of dark fruits, blood orange zest, and sweet licorice. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that lifts its mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and velvety, framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins that glide into a long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of wild thyme, dark cocoa, and lingering spice.

title: Glenlivet 12 Year Old Provence Cask
bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 12 Year Old Provence Cask Finish is a travel-retail and regional limited-edition single malt Scotch whisky produced by The Glenlivet Distillery in Ballindalloch, Speyside, Scotland. Owned by Chivas Brothers (Pernod Ricard), The Glenlivet is renowned for pioneering Speyside's classic, floral, and orchard-fruit-driven single malt style. Building upon their signature 12-year-old malt foundation, the Provence Cask Finish introduces an artisanal cask finish using oak casks previously holding rosé or fortified wines from the sun-drenched Provence region in Southern France, blending Scottish single malt heritage with Mediterranean floral and stone-fruit nuances.

Spirit Description

The Glenlivet 12 Year Old Provence Cask starts with classic Speyside single malt distillate made from 100% malted barley and pure water from Josie's Well, distilled in tall, lantern-shaped copper pot stills that encourage light, ester-rich aromatics. The whisky undergoes its primary maturation for 12 years in traditional European and American oak casks before being finished for a select period in French oak casks sourced from the Provence region. This secondary aging imparts delicate pink floral notes, bright red berry brightness, and soft lavender-herbal undertones to the whisky's signature apple and pear core.

  • Colour: Pale copper-gold with soft rosé pink reflections.

  • Aroma: Bright, elegant, and floral. Opens with white peach, fresh strawberries, and redcurrant, layered with delicate lavender, lavender honey, fresh vanilla bean, and toasted brioche.

  • Palate: Smooth, silky, and fruit-forward on the entry. Upfront flavors of summer berries, ripe nectarine, and candied citrus peel give way to blossom honey, soft oak tannins, and a gentle herbal complexity.

  • Body: Light-to-medium-bodied with a soft, rounded, and elegant mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Crisp, clean, and medium in length, trailing off with lingering red berry brightness, subtle floral perfume, sweet vanilla, and a dry, refreshing oak snap.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Zuccardi Finca Piedra Infinita Supercal Malbec 2019
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Argentina, within the prestigious Paraje Altamira sub-appellation of the Uco Valley in Mendoza. Produced by Zuccardi Valle de Uco—a pioneering family estate led by visionary winemaker Sebastián Zuccardi and named 'World’s Best Vineyard' three consecutive years—this parcel-specific micro-bottling represents the absolute pinnacle of high-altitude, limestone-driven Malbec. Sourced from a tiny, 0.93-hectare plot within the historic Finca Piedra Infinita vineyard situated at 1,100 meters (3,600 feet) above sea level, "Supercal" is named after the extraordinarily high concentration of active calcium carbonate (calcaria) coating the alluvial granite stones at shallow depths. Paraje Altamira’s extreme mountain desert microclimate features intense UV daylight balanced by cold night winds descending off the Andes, enabling Malbec grapes to achieve complete phenolic maturity while preserving a chiseled, age-worthy natural acidity and an electric chalky minerality.

Wine Description

Zuccardi Finca Piedra Infinita Supercal Malbec presents an opaque, deep black-purple color in the glass with vivid violet and magenta reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and laser-focused, delivering an energetic, precise, and chalk-driven portrait of extreme limestone terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crushed tart blueberries, wild black plum, and fresh blackberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of dried violets, lavender, mountain thyme, crushed chalk, graphite, and an intense line of wet stone minerality, completely unmasked by new oak. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, athletic, and linear, showcasing a succulent core of dark berries, blood orange zest, and savory herbs. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its mid-palate fruit concentration. The mouthfeel is weightless, velvety, and chiseled, framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of crushed stone, iron, and dark cocoa.

This high-definition Argentine expression is 100% Malbec, hand-harvested meticulously in small bins to safeguard pristine fruit condition. Following rigorous manual cluster sorting, the whole berries were fermented using indigenous natural yeasts in unlined, truncated concrete vats. To preserve raw site-specific expression and pure chalky texture, the winemaking team strictly avoided barrel aging in small new oak barrels.

title: Blandy's Malmsey 1991
bodyHtml:
This structured fortified wine originates from Portugal, within the prestigious Madeira D.O.P. appellation on the volcanic island of Madeira in the North Atlantic. Produced by Blandy’s an iconic founding family of the Madeira Wine Company with a winemaking lineage dating back to 1811 this single-harvest Colheita / Frasqueira expression represents a benchmark for long-aged, highly complex fortified wines. Sourced exclusively from low-yielding Malmsey (Malvasia) vines cultivated on steep, terraced volcanic hillside plots (vinhas de enforcado) along the sun-drenched southern coast of the island (predominantly around Calheta and Campanário), the vines thrive in basaltic, iron-rich, and highly acidic volcanic soils. The subtropical maritime microclimate features constant Atlantic breezes and high humidity, allowing Malmsey grapes to achieve exceptionally high natural sugar levels while retaining a razor-sharp, age-worthy natural acidity.

Wine Description

The 1991 Blandy’s Malmsey presents a rich, deep mahogany-amber color in the glass with bright topaz, burnished copper, and greenish-gold reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and opulent portrait of aged volcanic terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of dried figs, Medjool dates, dark raisins, and orange marmalade, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of roasted walnuts, toasted pecans, pipe tobacco, dark molasses, dark cocoa, beeswax, and a distinct line of volatilized citrus peel and singe-wood spice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rich, and unctuous, showcasing a succulent core of caramelized sugar, dark honey, and brandied fruits. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of vibrant natural acidity that cuts cleanly through its inherent sweetness, preventing any sense of heaviness. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and mouth-coating, gliding into an extraordinarily long, dry-skewing, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of salted caramel, toasted oak, espresso, and dried citrus zest.

This high-definition Madeira expression is 100% Malmsey (Malvasia), hand-harvested meticulously on steep slopes. Following gentle pressing, the juice underwent partial fermentation on the skins in stainless steel vats before being fortified with neutral grape spirit (96% ABV) to arrest fermentation and preserve the grape's natural rich sugars. The wine was then matured using the traditional, slow Canteiro method, aging for decades in seasoned American oak casks placed in the warm upper floors of Blandy’s historic lodges in Funchal. This gentle, passive heating and oxidation over 20+ years concentrated its flavors and structural acidity into an virtually indestructible, timeless nectar. It reaches a generous alcohol content (ABV) of 19.0% to 20.0% and is finished in a classic rich (sweet) style, flawlessly balanced by extreme natural acidity.

Vintage Quality

The 1991 harvest on Madeira produced exceptionally balanced Malmsey grapes with outstanding sugar concentration and vibrant acidity. Blandy’s patient, decades-long Canteiro oak maturation allowed the 1991 vintage to achieve breathtaking tertiary complexity, balance, and concentration. The 1991 Blandy’s Malmsey stands at a magnificent peak of maturity today, offering an indestructible, high-energy drinking experience that will hold effortlessly in bottle for decades to come.

title: Castello Nibbio Della Sala 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Umbria I.G.T. appellation in Central Italy. Produced at Castello della Sala the legendary, historic estate near Orvieto owned by the Antinori family since 1940 and famed for crafting world-class benchmark wines this single-vineyard micro-bottling represents the absolute pinnacle of Italian Pinot Nero. Sourced from the tiny, high-altitude Nibbio parcel planted on steep, east-facing slopes of ancient marine origin, the vines thrive in well-draining soils composed of calcium-rich clay and fossil-bearing limestone marl. The unique microclimate features warm, sunny daylight tempered by cool morning fogs and sharp nighttime breezes descending from the Apennine foothills, allowing Pinot Nero grapes to achieve optimal phenolic ripeness while preserving an electric, age-worthy natural acidity and delicate aromatic lift.

Wine Description

The 2021 Castello della Sala 'Nibbio' Pinot Nero presents a brilliant, translucent ruby color in the glass with bright garnet and crimson highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, precise, and silk-textured portrait of high-altitude Umbrian limestone terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of fresh wild cherries, cranberries, and wild raspberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh violets, dried rose petals, forest floor (sous-bois), subtle baking spices, orange zest, and a clean line of chalky limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a vibrant core of tart red stone fruits, blood orange peel, and pomegranate. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly across the mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by ultra-fine, chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of cherry skin, wild strawberry, and subtle French oak spice.

This high-definition Italian expression is 100% Pinot Nero, meticulously hand-harvested from low-yielding vineyard blocks. Following rigorous cluster sorting, the fruit underwent traditional temperature-controlled fermentation in conical stainless steel vats with gentle extraction techniques to draw out vivid color and noble phenolics without harshness. The wine completed full malolactic conversion and was matured sur lie in select French oak barriques for 10 to 12 months before master blending and bottle aging in the historic medieval cellars of the estate. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5% to 14.0% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 growing season in Umbria was outstanding, defined by a cool spring followed by a warm, sun-drenched summer with significant diurnal temperature variations that preserved pristine natural acidity and bright primary aromatics. Antinori’s precision viticulture at Castello della Sala captured the fruit in peak condition. The resulting 2021 Castello della Sala 'Nibbio' Pinot Nero offers immediate, high-energy drinking pleasure upon release and possesses the structural frame to cellar and evolve gracefully over the next 10 to 15 years.

title: Buiano Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Chianti Classico Gran Selezione D.O.C.G. appellation in the heart of Tuscany. Produced at Villa Buiano (often associated with the historic winemaking tradition of Castellani) an estate dedicated to elevating single-estate expression in the Chianti Classico zone this bottling represents the absolute pinnacle of the region's quality hierarchy. Sourced exclusively from choice, high-altitude estate vineyard parcels rooted in ancient Galestro (schistose clay) and Alberese (limestone) soils, the vines benefit from a Mediterranean microclimate marked by warm, sun-drenched days and sharp nighttime cooling. These diurnal temperature shifts enable Sangiovese to reach full phenolic maturity while preserving a razor-sharp natural acidity and intense mineral drive.

Wine Description

Buiano Chianti Classico Gran Selezione presents an opaque, deep ruby-garnet color in the glass with bright crimson highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and authoritative portrait of Tuscan terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe dark cherries, crushed red plums, and dried cranberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh violets, dried rose petals, leather, pipe tobacco, dark cocoa, espresso bean, and a distinct line of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, athletic, and linear, showcasing a succulent core of tart red stone fruits, blood orange zest, and savory Mediterranean herbs. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of graphite, dried thyme, and toasted cedar.

title: Michter's Whiskey Tasting Event: Hosted by Karina Mair
bodyHtml:
Rooted in a rich legacy tracing back to America’s first whiskey company founded in 1753, Michter’s embodies a "cost-be-damned" approach to craft distilling. Operating out of Louisville, Kentucky, Michter's is renowned for its uncompromising quality—pioneering techniques such as air-drying wood for up to 36 months, entering barrel at a lower proof for richer flavor, and heat-cycling barrels to enhance aging. Each bottle reflects a commitment to producing exceptional, rich, and truly distinct American whiskeys.

title: Los Siete Misterios Mezcal Tasting Event: Hosted by Karina Mair
bodyHtml:
Founded in 2010, Los Siete Misterios was born from a passion to revive the traditional craft of mezcal making and honor Mexican heritage. Rooted in the rich terroir of Oaxaca, the brand collaborates with local Master Mezcalalers using micro-batch production methods. From copper pot stills to rare clay pot distillations, every bottle reflects the unique characteristics of hand-harvested agave, capturing the authentic, unadulterated spirit of Mexico.
