title: Pauillac de Latour 2019
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Bordeaux region, specifically within the Pauillac appellation on the Left Bank, Pauillac de Latour 2019 represents a refined, aristocratic, and highly accessible expression of the esteemed Château Latour terroir. First introduced in 1989, Pauillac de Latour serves as the third wine of First Growth legend Château Latour, crafted primarily from younger estate vines and parcels surrounding the historic Enclos vineyard. Sourced from deep gravel beds over clay subsoils overlooking the Gironde estuary, the vines benefit from ideal drainage and maritime microclimates. The winemaking philosophy under estate director Hélène Génin mirrors the rigorous standards of the Grand Vin, involving plot-by-plot manual harvesting, strict double sorting, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats, and maturation in French oak barriques (approximately 20% new) for 12 to 14 months. The result is a third wine that embodies classic Pauillac noble structure and cassis intensity with immediate charm.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark garnet red colour with bright ruby reflections along the rim. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe black currant, dark plum, wild blackberry, and black cherry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of pencil shavings, graphite, cedar box, cigar wrapper, crushed violets, and subtle toasted French oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, structured, and focused, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berry fruit jam, cassis curd, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine, chalky, fine-grained tannins and a driving mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruits, dried herbs, and a signature Pauillac graphite grip. Composed of 56.6% Cabernet Sauvignon, 37.8% Merlot, and 5.6% Petit Verdot, this 2019 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2040. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Left Bank Cabernet gravel power and precision with supple mid-palate fruit and approachable elegance.

title: Blanton's Gold Edition
bodyHtml: Blanton's Gold Edition Single Barrel Bourbon is a premium, highly sought-after Kentucky straight bourbon produced at the Buffalo Trace Distillery in Frankfort, Kentucky. Created in 1992, it was initially released exclusively for international markets (predominantly Europe and Japan) before making its official debut in the United States in 2020. The brand honors Colonel Albert B. Blanton, a pioneer who began aging hand-selected single barrels in the famous metal-clad Warehouse H back in the early 20th century.

title: Michael David Freakshow Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in the California region, specifically within the Lodi AVA appellation, Michael David Freakshow Chardonnay represents a fun-loving, opulent, and fruit forward expression of California white winemaking. Produced by the historic Michael David Winery, owned and operated by the Phillips family since six generations of farming in Lodi, the 'Freakshow' range is celebrated globally for its bold, eye-catching circus themed labels and crowd-pleasing, accessible style. Sourced from sustainably farmed estate and contract vineyards across the Lodi appellation, the grapes benefit from warm Mediterranean days balanced by cool evening breezes arriving from the Sacramento River Delta. The winemaking philosophy under winemakers Adam Mettler and Derek Devries involves temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats combined with partial oak barrel maturation to strike a balance between bright varietal acidity and rich, creamy complexity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous golden straw colour with bright yellow reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly fragrant bouquet opens with alluring aromas of ripe nectarine, yellow apple, juicy mango, and honeydew melon, interwoven with pleasant notes of butterscotch, honey, toasted almonds, lemon curd, and warm baking spices. On the palate, it is full bodied, luscious, and smooth, delivering mouthwatering flavours of cantaloupe, ripe stone fruit, and tropical curd, all supported by a crisp spine of natural acidity. Framed by a rich, satiny texture derived from controlled lees contact and subtle oak integration, it concludes with a refreshing, long finish marked by lingering citrus zest, sweet vanilla, and a clean mineral lift. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2024–2028. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Lodi's sun-drenched fruit generosity and approachable creaminess with a lively, balanced finish.

title: Kistler Chardonnay 'Les Noisetiers' 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' white wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Sonoma Coast A.O.C. appellation in Northern California. Produced by Kistler Vineyards—a benchmark estate founded in 1978 and universally celebrated as one of California's iconic pioneers of terroir-driven, Burgundian-style Chardonnay—"Les Noisetiers" represents the winery's masterfully assembled coastal expression. Sourced from native heritage clones planted across cool-climate estate plots in the Western Sonoma Coast, Russian River Valley, and Carneros, the vines thrive in well-draining Goldridge yellow apple-wood soils, gravelly loam, and eroded marine sandstones. The maritime microclimate features intense coastal morning fog and afternoon Pacific breezes, allowing Chardonnay grapes to undergo extended hang time, building intense phenolic flavor and aromatic complexity while preserving a razor-sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity and chiseled mineral drive.

Wine Description

The 2024 Kistler Chardonnay 'Les Noisetiers' presents a luminous, pale straw-gold color in the glass with bright platinum and subtle chartreuse reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and sophisticated portrait of coastal California Chardonnay. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of sliced fresh green apples, Anjou pears, lemon curd, and white peach, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of roasted hazelnuts (from which the cuvée derives its name), white flowers, wet stone, lemon verbena, and a distinct line of crushed chalk minerality balanced by faint toasted brioche. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of tart orchard fruit, citrus peel, and salted melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly across the mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by a tactile, creamy texture gained from traditional lees contact that carries into an extraordinarily long, bone-dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of hazelnut, lemon oil, and crushed sea salt.

This high-definition Sonoma expression is 100% Chardonnay, hand-harvested meticulously at night to preserve natural acidity and pure fruit precursors. Following gentle whole-cluster pressing, the unclarified juice was transferred directly into barrels for primary fermentation using indigenous wild yeasts. Embracing classical Burgundian techniques, the wine underwent full malolactic conversion in barrel alongside regular, gentle lees stirring (bâtonnage). It matured for 11 to 12 months in select French oak barrels (approximately 25% to 30% new wood, crafted exclusively by Francois Frères) before master blending and bottling without aggressive fining or filtration. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5% to 14.1% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 growing season along the Sonoma Coast was exceptional, defined by moderate summer temperatures, steady maritime fog patterns, and cool harvest conditions that allowed grapes to ripen slowly with pristine acid balance and full phenolic maturity. Kistler's legendary focus on wild-yeast fermentation and barrel aging on the fine lees captures the pure essence of the vintage. The 2024 Kistler Chardonnay 'Les Noisetiers' offers immediate, high-energy drinking pleasure upon release and possesses the structural frame to evolve gracefully in a cellar over the next 8 to 12 years.

title: Vega Sicilia Unico 2016
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Spain, within the legendary Ribera del Duero D.O. appellation in the heart of Castile and León. Produced by Bodegas Vega Sicilia Spain's most prestigious and iconic estate, founded in 1864 by Eloy Lecanda and stewarded with aristocratic rigor by the Álvarez family since 1982. Unico represents the ultimate pinnacle of global fine wine longevity. Sourced from the estate’s historic 210-hectare vineyard in Valbuena de Duero, the low-yielding old vines average over 35 years of age and are planted on a complex mosaic of 19 soil types across high-altitude limestone terraces, alluvial gravel, and chalky clay deposits. The harsh, high-elevation continental microclimate experiences extreme diurnal temperature shifts, where scorching summer days are followed by sharp nighttime cooling, allowing Tempranillo and Cabernet Sauvignon to reach complete phenolic maturity while retaining a razor-sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity and noble structural poise.

Wine Description

The 2016 Vega Sicilia Unico presents an opaque, deep black-ruby color in the glass with vivid purple and garnet reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and regal portrait of high-altitude limestone terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe black plums, wild blackberries, and cassis, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of dried violets, cigar box, pipe tobacco, cured leather, dark chocolate, espresso bean, pencil lead, and a distinct line of crushed chalk minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of dark fruit compote, blood orange peel, and exotic sweet spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its immense mid-palate concentration. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by firm, fine-grained, and muscular tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of iron, black truffle, cedar, and subtle oak spice.

The meticulously hand-harvested fruit underwent rigorous optical sorting followed by temperature-controlled fermentation in oak vats using native yeasts. Following Vega Sicilia's legendary, uncompromising maturation regime, the wine completed malolactic conversion and aged for nearly a decade prior to release. The 2016 vintage spent approximately six years undergoing continuous refinement in a combination of 225-liter French and American oak barrels (both new and second-use) and large wood vats, followed by extensive bottle aging in the estate's deep cellars. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, generous alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2016 growing season in Ribera del Duero was a benchmark vintage, characterized by a mild winter, steady spring rainfall, and a warm, perfectly balanced summer with cool nighttime temperatures. Vega Sicilia’s ancient, deep-rooted vines produced pristine fruit with ideal sugar-acid balance, mature seed phenolics, and exceptional structural purity. Technical director Gonzalo Iturriaga de Castro executed a masterclass in patient wood aging and blending. The resulting 2016 Vega Sicilia Unico is a timeless masterpiece that drinks with breathtaking elegance today and possesses the structural frame to cellar gracefully for 30 to 50 years.

title: Patron Silver Tequila - Limited Edition Rain Water Tin
bodyHtml:
Patrón Silver "Rainwater" Limited Edition Tin is a special collectible release from Hacienda Patrón (NOM 1492) in Atotonilco el Alto, Jalisco, Mexico. Created in collaboration with global music icon Becky G, this release celebrates sustainability and water conservation efforts in Mexico—specifically supporting rainwater harvesting initiatives for local communities in Jalisco. The release pairs Patrón’s iconic, ultra-premium 100% Blue Weber agave Blanco tequila with an artistically designed metallic green-and-blue tin inspired by the ripples and movement of pure rainwater.

2. Spirit Description

Inside the custom collector's tin is Patrón's flagship Silver tequila, crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves harvested in the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco. The agaves are slow-cooked in small brick ovens before being crushed using a combination of a traditional volcanic stone tahona wheel and modern roller mills. Following fermentation in open-air oak vats, the spirit is double-distilled in small copper pot stills and bottled unaged to highlight its signature smooth, agave-forward character.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and transparent.

  • Aroma: Fresh, clean, and inviting, opening with sweet roasted agave, bright lime zest, and grapefruit peel, complemented by light floral notes and gentle white pepper spice.

  • Palate: Smooth, soft, and balanced on the entry. Upfront flavors of fresh roasted agave and crisp citrus yield to light pineapple notes, white pepper, and a clean mineral quality.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, velvety, and light mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Crisp, clean, and smooth, trailing off with lingering sweet agave, subtle citrus peel, and a warm peppery snap.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Cotarella Poggio dei Gelsi 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced by Famiglia Cotarella (formerly Falesco) the renowned family estate founded in 1979 by legendary winemaking brothers Riccardo and Renzo Cotarella "Poggio dei Gelsi" serves as the flagship historical white that elevated the region's ancient heritage. Sourced from selected vineyard parcels planted on crumbly, skeletal volcanic soils surrounding the volcanic basin of Lake Bolsena, the vines benefit from a unique microclimate moderated by deep lake waters and fresh breezes. The volcanic, mineral-rich terroir enables local varieties to build juicy citrus-fruit volume while preserving a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity and delicate, savory minerality.

Wine Description

Famiglia Cotarella "Poggio dei Gelsi" presents a luminous, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with bright platinum and subtle greenish reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and aromatic, delivering a vibrant, precise, and expressive portrait of volcanic Lazio terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of fresh lime zest, green apple, white peach, and nectarine, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of orange blossom, acacia, white almond, and a clean line of crushed volcanic stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of tart orchard fruit, citrus curd, and salted melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly across the palate. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and supple, carrying into a refreshing, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of citrus peel, subtle spice, and a classic, pleasant bitter-almond hint.

title: Cotarella Trentanni Rosso 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the expansive Umbria I.G.T. appellation in the green heart of Central Italy. Produced by Famiglia Cotarella (formerly Falesco) the legendary family estate led by world-renowned winemakers Riccardo and Renzo Cotarella, alongside the second generation, Dominga, Marta, and Enrica Cotarella "Trentanni" was created to commemorate the 30th anniversary of the winery's founding. Sourced from choice, hill-sloped vineyard parcels in Montecchio, near Orvieto, the vines are rooted in deep, well-draining soils composed of clay, limestone, and ancient volcanic deposits. Umbria's continental microclimate brings warm, sun-drenched summer days balanced by cool night winds descending from the Apennine Mountains, enabling both native and international red varieties to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining a vibrant, mouthwatering natural acidity and noble structural balance.

Wine Description

Famiglia Cotarella Trentanni Rosso presents an opaque, deep black-ruby color in the glass with vivid crimson and purple reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and opulent portrait of Umbrian terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe black plums, wild blackberries, and dark dark cherries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of sweet Madagascar vanilla, dark cocoa nibs, tobacco leaf, dried lavender, espresso bean, and a subtle line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rich, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of dark berry compote, licorice, and savory herbs. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and mouth-coating, framed by firm, fine-grained, and polished tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of dark chocolate, cedar, and toasted oak spice.

title: Mollydooker Euphoria Sparkling Verdelho 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Australia in the South Australian region, specifically within the McLaren Vale appellation, Mollydooker Euphoria Sparkling Verdelho represents an exuberant, unique, and creamy expression of sparkling Verdelho. Founded by Sarah and Sparky Marquis, Mollydooker is globally renowned for its bold winemaking philosophy, trademark Marquis Vineyard Watering Programme, and distinctively intense fruit profiles. Sourced from estate vineyards in McLaren Vale planted on sandy soils over clay subsoils, the winemaking philosophy combines late-harvest fruit selection, temperature-controlled primary fermentation, and secondary sparkling production designed to capture vibrant tropical aromatics, mouth-filling richness, and fine effervescence.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, bright pale golden straw colour with persistent, fine effervescence and a delicate white mousse. An expressive, highly aromatic bouquet opens with exuberant notes of passion fruit, ripe mango, pineapple, and green apple, interwoven with subtle hints of white peach, citrus blossom, candied ginger, and fresh lime zest. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, lush, and creamy, delivering concentrated flavours of tropical fruit salad, lemon curd, and melon, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a rich, effervescent mid-palate and a velvety texture, it concludes with a clean, persistent finish marked by lingering passion fruit, crisp citrus, and a refreshing mineral lift. Composed of 100% Verdelho, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 1–3 years from release. Stylistically, it combines McLaren Vale's sunshine intensity and tropical fruit generosity with uplifting sparkling vitality.

title: Patron 100
bodyHtml:
This high-proof 100% Weber Blue Agave tequila originates from Mexico, produced in the Los Altos (Highlands) region of Jalisco at the Hacienda Patrón distillery. While Patrón's flagship expressions are standardly bottled at 80 proof (40% ABV), their 100-proof (50% ABV) releases—most notably seen in specialized lines like the Patrón Gran Burdeos (finished in Bordeaux wine casks) or limited-edition distillery-exclusive overproof bottlings—are crafted to showcase the uncompromised power, agave intensity, and full textural weight of Highland agave before dilution. The agave is slow-roasted in traditional brick ovens, crushed using a mix of tahona stone wheels and roller mills, and distilled in small copper pot stills.

Spirit Description

This high-proof tequila presents a crystal-clear to light straw appearance depending on the expression's aging profile. On the nose, it is intensely vibrant and punchy, opening with a burst of sweet cooked agave, crushed green pepper, and bright lime zest, complemented by underlying notes of earthy minerality, white pepper, and soft floral herbs. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and viscous, delivering a robust punch of peppery agave sweetness, baked citrus, and light vegetal oils, balanced by warming baking spices and structural oak tannins if aged. The finish is long, warm, and highly persistent, leaving a crisp, drying trail of lingering agave sugar, sea salt, and peppery heat. Bottled at 50% ABV (100 Proof), it offers an uncommonly bold, expressive, and spirit-forward agave experience.

title: Allegrini Oasi San Giacomo Soave 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Italy, within the traditional Soave D.O.C. appellation in the Veneto region of Northeastern Italy. Produced by Allegrini, one of Valpolicella’s most historic and revered winemaking dynasties, founded in 1854 and globally renowned for its pioneering focus on single-vineyard Cru expressions. This bottling highlights the estate’s dedication to fresh, terroir-driven white viticulture. Sourced from choice estate parcels planted on rolling volcanic basalt, limestone, and gravelly clay soils across the Soave production zone, the vines thrive under a moderate sub-alpine Mediterranean microclimate. Warm, sun-filled days are balanced by cool evening breezes descending from the Lessini Mountains, allowing native and international white varieties to achieve ideal phenolic maturity while locking in a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity and vibrant mineral drive.

Wine Description

The Allegrini "Oasi San Giacomo" Soave presents a brilliant, pale straw-gold color in the glass with bright platinum and subtle emerald reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and aromatic, delivering a vibrant, precise, and expressive portrait of classic Soave terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of elderflower, white peach, pink grapefruit, and yellow apple, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of honeydew melon, citrus zest, white almond, and a distinct line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of crunchy orchard fruit, lemon oil, and salted pear. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly across the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is supple, linear, and weightless, carrying into a dry, refreshing, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of white flowers, grapefruit peel, and fresh almond.

title: 19 Crimes Sauvignon Blanc
bodyHtml:
Originating from Australia in the South Eastern Australia wine region, 19 Crimes Sauvignon Blanc represents a crisp, vibrant, and approachable expression of Australian white wine. Inspired by the rebellious history of British convicts banished to Australia in the 18th and 19th centuries, the 19 Crimes brand honors those who breached 19 specific crimes with exile, forging a distinct new culture down under. Sourced from choice vineyard sites across South Eastern Australia, the winemaking philosophy focuses on gentle direct pressing, cold temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks, and early bottling without oak aging to preserve bright tropical fruit aromatics, crisp acidity, and signature refreshing style.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale straw colour with bright greenish reflections along the rim. An expressive, fruit-forward bouquet opens with appealing aromas of passion fruit, ripe guava, passionfruit curd, and pink grapefruit, interwoven with fresh notes of lemongrass, green apple, gooseberry, and subtle white peach blossom. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, lively, and crisp, delivering generous flavours of juicy tropical fruit, citrus zest, and green apple, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by a smooth, clean mid-palate and a refreshing finish, it concludes with lingering passion fruit, grapefruit peel, and a subtle herbal lift. Composed primarily of Sauvignon Blanc, it combines tropical fruit generosity with crisp, effortless drinkability.

title: 19 Crimes Pinot Noir
bodyHtml:
Originating from Australia in the South Eastern Australia wine region, 19 Crimes Pinot Noir represents an accessible, fruit-driven, and bold expression of classic Australian Pinot Noir. Inspired by the rebellious history of British convicts banished to Australia in the 18th and 19th centuries, the 19 Crimes brand celebrates those who breached 19 specific crimes with exile rather than death, forging a new culture and legacy down under. Sourced from choice vineyard sites planted across South Eastern Australia, the winemaking philosophy focuses on gentle temperature-controlled fermentation, partial oak contact, and careful blending to achieve soft tannins, generous red berry fruit, and signature approachable style.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, bright dark ruby red colour with soft crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, fruit-forward bouquet opens with appealing aromas of ripe red cherry, wild strawberry, red plum, and raspberry jam, interwoven with warm notes of sweet vanilla, dark chocolate, toasted oak spice, and subtle clove. On the palate, it is medium bodied, smooth, and supple, delivering generous flavours of juicy red berries, cherry pie, and sweet oak spices, all supported by a gentle, soft core of natural acidity. Framed by smooth, velvety tannins and a rounded mid-palate, it concludes with a warm, lingering finish marked by sweet red fruit, vanilla, and gentle toasted spice. Composed primarily of Pinot Noir, it combines rich fruit warmth and lush accessibility with effortless, easy-drinking charm.

title: Donnafugata Sherazade Nero d'Avola
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy within the island region of Sicily, specifically from the Contessa Entellina estate in southwestern Sicily, Donnafugata 'Sherazade' Nero d'Avola represents an aromatic, fruit-driven, and supple expression of Sicily's signature red variety. Crafted by the Rallo family of Donnafugata, the wine draws its name from the legendary female storyteller of the One Thousand and One Nights, reflecting the wine's captivating, seductive character and soft oriental spice notes. Sourced from estate vineyards planted on clay-limestone soils at elevations between 200 and 400 metres, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes gentle handling, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks, complete avoidance of oak aging, and short bottle refinement to preserve pure primary red fruit aromatics, smooth tannins, and bright Mediterranean freshness.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear dark ruby purple colour with bright violet reflections along the rim. An expressive, fruit-forward bouquet opens with enticing aromas of ripe red cherry, wild plum, crushed raspberry, and red currant, interwoven with subtle notes of violet petals, black pepper, liquorice, and sweet Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silky, and rounded, delivering generous flavours of juicy dark fruit, red berry jam, and subtle mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by soft, fine-grained tannins and a supple, fluid mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, persistent finish marked by lingering cherry fruit, mild spice, and a fresh mineral lift. Composed of 100% Nero d'Avola, it combines Sicilian sunshine warmth with effortless elegance, freshness, and versatility.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Donnafugata 'Tancredi' 2021
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy within the island region of Sicily, specifically from the Contessa Entellina estate and surrounding territories in southwestern Sicily, Dolce & Gabbana Donnafugata 'Tancredi' 2021 represents an iconic, luxurious, and artistic collaboration between high fashion and historic Sicilian winemaking. Crafted by the Rallo family of Donnafugata in partnership with the luxury house Dolce & Gabbana, 'Tancredi' draws its name from one of the central noble characters in Giuseppe Tomasi di Lampedusa's famous novel The Leopard. Sourced from estate vineyards planted on clay-limestone soils at elevations up to 400 metres, the winemaking philosophy combines temperature-controlled fermentation on the skins, extensive maceration, and aging in French oak barrels (a combination of new and second-passage barrels) for over 12 months followed by extended bottle aging. The result is a prestigious Sicilian red of profound depth, Mediterranean elegance, and exceptional cellaring capability.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense purple-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with opulent aromas of ripe black plum, dark cherry, wild blackberry, and blueberry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of dark chocolate, sweet tobacco leaf, liquorice, Mediterranean garrigue herbs, balsam, and refined French oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, velvety, and dense, delivering concentrated flavours of dark fruit jam, cassis, and earthy cocoa, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained tannins and a deep, coat-the-mouth mid-palate, it concludes with a remarkably long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, savory spices, and a subtle mineral grip. Composed primarily of Cabernet Sauvignon, Nero d'Avola, and Tannat, this 2021 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2040+. Stylistically, it combines Sicilian warmth and berry intensity with European structure and haute-couture elegance.

title: Bellenda Fratelli Cosmo Prosecco
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the Prosecco Superiore Prosecco DOCG and DOC zone, Bellenda Fratelli Cosmo Prosecco represents a refined, aromatic, and artisanal expression of Italian sparkling wine. Produced by the Cosmo family at Bellenda in Carpesica, the estate is renowned for its commitment to high-elevation hill viticultural precision, hand farming, and gentle winemaking. Sourced from choice Glera vineyards planted on clay, limestone, and stony glacial moraine soils, the winemaking philosophy utilizes gentle whole-cluster pressing, temperature-controlled primary fermentation, and secondary Charmat method tank fermentation with extended autolysis. The result is a vibrant, elegant Prosecco that highlights pure white fruit, delicate floral nuances, and persistent, creamy effervescence.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear pale straw yellow colour with persistent, ultrafine effervescence and a delicate white mousse. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with fresh aromas of green apple, Williams pear, white peach, and citrus blossom, interwoven with subtle notes of acacia flowers, lemon verbena, crushed limestone, and fresh brioche. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, crisp, and refreshing, delivering precise flavours of orchard fruit, lemon curd, and white nectarine, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by a creamy, gentle palate texture and a driving mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, persistent finish marked by lingering pear, citrus zest, and a subtle mineral lift. Composed primarily of Glera, it combines Veneto's sunshine purity and fruit generosity with Bellenda's trademark balance, finesse, and artisanal precision.

title: De Martino Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from Chile in the South American region, specifically within the Maipo Valley appellation, De Martino Estate Cabernet Sauvignon represents a fresh, classic, and terroir driven expression of Chilean Cabernet Sauvignon. Founded in 1934 by Pietro De Martino, the estate has remained family owned for over four generations and is recognized globally as a pioneer in sustainable, non-interventionalist, and organic viticulture. Sourced from choice vineyard blocks situated on deep alluvial terraces along the Maipo River with gravelly, well-drained soils, the winemaking philosophy combines hand harvesting, traditional temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation with native yeasts, and gentle aging in neutral oak foudres and concrete vats to avoid oak over-extraction. The result is a vibrant Cabernet Sauvignon that highlights pure cassis fruit, fine-grained tannins, and authentic Chilean herbal complexity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear dark ruby purple colour with bright violet reflections along the rim. An expressive, fruit-forward bouquet opens with enticing aromas of cassis, dark plum, ripe black cherry, and red currant, interwoven with subtle notes of eucalyptus, cedarwood, dried tobacco leaf, bell pepper, and sweet baking spices. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, smooth, and balanced, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, red fruit curd, and mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by fine, velvety tannins and a harmonious mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, graphite, and savory herbs. Composed of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 3–6 years from release. Stylistically, it combines Maipo's hallmark varietal typicity and sunshine purity with European elegance, balance, and drinkability.

title: Domaine Siblas Nuits Saint Georges 'Les Plantes au Baron' 2019
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Nuits Saint Georges appellation in the Côte de Nuits, Domaine Siblas Nuits Saint Georges 'Les Plantes au Baron' 2019 represents a structured, classic, and age-worthy expression of village level red Burgundy. Closely linked with the historical winemaking heritage of Domaine Maume and Domaine Moron-Garcia, the wines under the Domaine Siblas label emphasize traditional, terroir driven viticulture in benchmark Côte de Nuits climates. Sourced exclusively from 'Les Plantes au Baron', a renowned vineyard parcel situated on gentle, east-facing slopes near the southern boundary of Nuits Saint Georges characterized by gravelly clay-limestone soils over hard bedrock, the winemaking philosophy combines careful hand harvesting, partial whole-cluster fermentation, native yeast fermentation, and extended barrel aging in French oak (approximately 20% to 30% new). The result is a Pinot Noir of great aromatic precision, firm structure, and cellaring capacity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear ruby garnet colour with rich dark magenta reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with dark, seductive aromas of ripe black cherry, wild raspberry, cassis, and black plum, interwoven with savory notes of dried violet petals, forest floor, iron filings, game, and subtle toasted French oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, firm, and concentrated, delivering robust flavours of dark fruit jam, red currants, and mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by well-integrated, muscular Nuits Saint Georges tannins and a deep mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, savory herbs, and a chalky limestone grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2019 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2038. Stylistically, it combines the sunlit warmth and exceptional fruit concentration of the 2019 vintage with classic Burgundian tension, earthiness, and power.

title: Metaxa Gold Label 7 Stars Brandy
bodyHtml:
Metaxa 7 Stars (often historically referred to as Metaxa Gold Label 7 Stars) is a iconic Greek spirit produced by the House of Metaxa in Kifissia, near Athens, Greece. Created in 1888 by founder Spyros Metaxa, Metaxa is a distinct spirit category unto itself a master blend of aged wine distillates (brandy) and aromatic Muscat wines from the Aegean islands of Samos and Lemnos, infused with a secret bouquet of Mediterranean botanicals and May rose petals. The "7 Stars" designation signifies that the core wine distillates in the blend have matured in oak casks for a minimum of seven years.

2. Spirit Description

Metaxa 7 Stars is crafted through a unique multi-step production process overseen by Metaxa Master Constantinos Raptis. Fine wine distillates made from indigenous Greek grape varieties (Savatiano, Sultanina, and Black Corinth) are aged in hand-crafted French Limousin oak barrels for at least seven years. Separately, sweet Muscat wines are aged and blended with a proprietary infusion of Mediterranean herbs, spices, and rose petals. The aged brandy, botanical-infused Muscat wine, and pure spring water are then married together and aged further in oak casks to allow the complex flavors to harmonize.

  • Colour: Deep amber-gold with rich bronze and copper highlights.

  • Aroma: Intensely aromatic, floral, and warm. Opens with dried fruits (raisins, figs, and dates), sweet honey, and ripe peach, followed by subtle rose petals, nutmeg, cinnamon, and soft toasted oak.

  • Palate: Full, round, and pleasantly sweet on the entry. Upfront flavors of ripe apricot, raisin, and orange zest blend seamlessly with sweet honey, vanilla, nutmeg, and delicate floral notes.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a soft, silky, and coating mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and velvety, trailing off with persistent sweet Muscat wine notes, dried fruit, gentle oak tannins, and a touch of herbal spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Domaine Parent Pommard Premier Cru 'Les Chaponnieres' 2020 - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the premier tier of the Pommard appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Domaine Parent Pommard Premier Cru 'Les Chaponnières' 2020 1.5 Litre represents a supple, expressive, and age-worthy expression of Premier Cru Pinot Noir presented in a magnum bottle format. Owned and managed by sisters Anne and Catherine Parent, Domaine Parent traces its winemaking legacy back to 1753 and is internationally acclaimed for its certified organic viticulture, biodynamic practices, and classic Burgundian precision. Sourced from 'Les Chaponnières', a highly regarded Premier Cru site situated directly below 'Les Rugiens' on rich alluvial clay, deep gravel, and limestone soils, this parcel produces Pinot Noir characterized by dark fruit generosity, elegant tannic structure, and vibrant mineral drive. The winemaking philosophy combines hand harvesting, careful sorting, native yeast fermentation with partial whole clusters, and barrel aging in French oak (approximately 30% to 40% new) for up to 18 months, crafting a wine of exceptional structural depth and longevity expanded by the 1.5 Litre format.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear dark ruby garnet colour with rich crimson-purple reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with seductive aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, black plum, and red currant, interwoven with fragrant notes of violet petals, dried earth, forest floor, subtle game, and toasted French oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, satiny, and generously structured, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berry fruit, red fruit curd, and mineral iron, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine-grained, chalky Premier Cru tannins and a velvety mid-palate, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering black cherry, savory herbs, and a clean limestone grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2020 magnum release offers an optimal drinking window of 2027–2048+. Stylistically, it combines the exceptional concentration and cool-toned acid-tannin balance of the 2020 vintage with 'Les Chaponnières' signature floral elegance and suppleness.

title: Domaine Parent Pommard Premier Cru 'Les Rugiens' 2020 - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the premier tier of the Pommard appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Domaine Parent Pommard Premier Cru 'Les Rugiens' 2020 1.5 Litre represents a powerful, muscular, and exceptionally cellar-worthy expression of Premier Cru Pinot Noir presented in a magnum bottle format. Owned and operated by sisters Anne and Catherine Parent, Domaine Parent traces its winemaking roots back to 1753 and is widely acclaimed for its certified organic viticulture, biodynamic principles, and classic, age-worthy style. Sourced from 'Les Rugiens', universally regarded as Pommard's most revered Premier Cru vineyard and a candidate for Grand Cru elevation, the vines sit on steep, iron-rich reddish clay and limestone soils. The winemaking philosophy combines hand harvesting, careful sorting, native yeast fermentation with partial whole clusters, and barrel aging in French oak (approximately 40% to 50% new) for up to 18 months, yielding a wine of profound structural depth, dark berry intensity, and enduring longevity amplified by the 1.5 Litre format.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense purple-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with dark, brooding aromas of black plum, dark cherry, cassis, and wild blackberry, interwoven with seductive notes of iron filings, forest floor, dried rose petals, dark chocolate, leather, and sweet toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, dense, and powerfully structured, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, red fruit curd, and mineral earth, all anchored by a firm, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by muscular, fine-grained tannins and a deep, multi-layered mid-palate, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, savory spices, and a stony limestone grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2020 magnum release offers an optimal drinking window of 2028–2050+. Stylistically, it combines the exceptional concentration and cool-toned acid-tannin structure of the 2020 vintage with 'Les Rugiens' iconic power, earthiness, and ageability.

title: Vincent Latour Meursault 'Perrieres' Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the premier tier of the Meursault appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Domaine Vincent Latour Meursault Premier Cru 'Perrières' 2023 represents an aristocratic, electric, and cellaring grade expression of Premier Cru Chardonnay. Managed under the dedicated stewardship of Vincent Latour and Cécile Latour, the estate traces its roots back through centuries of Burgundian viticulture, undergoing a complete quality-focused transformation that incorporates organic principles, longer lees aging, and flexible barrel shapes including demi-muids and foudres. Sourced from 'Perrières', widely revered as Meursault's finest and most Grand Cru-adjacent climate, the vines sit on steep, stony terraces featuring thin topsoils over hard bathonian limestone subsoils and gravelly scree. The winemaking philosophy combines hand harvesting, long whole-cluster pneumatic pressing, native yeast fermentation, and barrel aging in French oak (approximately 20% to 25% new) with extended lees contact without heavy lees stirring, yielding a white Burgundy of laser-like precision, profound minerality, and immense aging potential.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale gold colour with brilliant greenish-yellow reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of Meyer lemon curd, green orchard apple, white peach, and fresh pear, interwoven with subtle notes of crushed chalk, wet flint, white acacia blossoms, toasted hazelnut, and delicate French oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, chiseled, and intensely concentrated, delivering laser-focused flavours of lemon zest, white stone fruit, and saline mineral iron, all anchored by a piercing, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a satiny yet taut texture derived from subtle lees contact and a driving mid-palate structure, it concludes with an exceptionally long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus, roasted almond, and a distinct, lingering limestone grip. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this 2023 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2027–2040+. Stylistically, it combines the sunlit purity and freshness of the 2023 vintage with 'Perrières' benchmark tension, depth, and structural authority.

title: Domaine Francois Feuillet Nuits St Georges 'Aux Thorey' Premier Cru Library (2018, 2019, 2020) - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the premier tier of the Nuits-Saint-Georges appellation in the Cote de Nuits, the Domaine François Feuillet Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Cru 'Aux Thorey' Library Pack (2018, 2019, 2020) represents a rare, six bottle collection containing two bottles of each featured vintage. Owned by François Feuillet and vinified under the expert stewardship of David Duband, Domaine François Feuillet shares identical organic viticultural practices, parcel management, and minimalist winemaking philosophies as Domaine David Duband. Sourced from Aux Thorey, a prestigious Premier Cru site situated on steep, limestone-rich soils near Vosne-Romanée, this parcel yields Pinot Noir renowned for its floral elegance, fine tannin structure, and refined mineral tension. The winemaking combines hand harvesting, significant whole-cluster fermentation (approximately 40% to 50%), native yeast fermentation, and barrel aging in French oak (approximately 30% new) to craft wines of remarkable aging potential, providing an extraordinary vertical study across three consecutive, high-calibre Burgundian vintages.

Wine Description

2018

Presents a deep ruby garnet colour, opening with expressive aromas of ripe black cherry, cassis, violet, and sweet baking spice. On the palate, it is full bodied and velvety, framed by plush tannins and a long, warm, dark-fruited finish.

Allen Meadows - Burghound - 91 points

Neal Martin - Vinous - 91 points

Decanter - 92 points

2019

This vintage displays a vibrant crimson ruby hue, offering a perfume of wild raspberry, red cherry, peony, crushed stone, and subtle oak. On the palate, it is satiny and precise, balancing concentrated red fruit with vibrant natural acidity and fine-grained tannins through a long, mineral driven finish.

Allen Meadows - Burghound - 92 points

Neal Martin - Vinous - 92 points

Decanter - 93 points

2020

Features an opaque dark ruby purple colour, characterized by intense notes of black plum, dark raspberry, iron filings, and forest floor. On the palate, it is taut, concentrated, and structural, boasting chiseled Premier Cru tannins, bright natural tension, and exceptional cellaring capacity.

Allen Meadows - Burghound - 92 points

Neal Martin - Vinous - 93 points

Decanter - 94 points

title: Bodegas Arzuaga Crianza 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Spain, within the prestigious Ribera del Duero D.O. appellation in the heart of Castile and León. Produced by Bodegas Arzuaga Navarro; an iconic estate founded in the early 1990s by Florentino Arzuaga, this bottling is a benchmark for high-elevation, barrel-aged Spanish Tempranillo. Sourced primarily from the historic "La Planta" estate in Quintanilla de Onésimo (situated at an altitude of nearly 900 meters) alongside select grower plots in the Golden Mile of Ribera del Duero, the vines are rooted in deep chalky-limestone, clay, and alluvial gravel soils. The severe continental microclimate experiences extreme diurnal temperature swings, where scorching summer days are followed by sharp nighttime cooling, allowing Tempranillo grapes to achieve intense phenolic maturity and rich skin color while locking in a razor-sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Bodegas Arzuaga Crianza presents an opaque, deep black-ruby color in the glass with vivid purple and violet highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and opulent portrait of high-altitude Ribera del Duero terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe black cherries, wild blackberries, and plum compote, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of sweet Madagascar vanilla, toasted cocoa, pipe tobacco, cedar, roasted coffee bean, and a subtle line of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rich, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of dark berry liqueur, dark chocolate, and savory spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate fruit concentration. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and mouth-coating, framed by firm, ripe, and fine-grained tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of espresso, toasted oak, and dark plum skin.

title: Domaine Parent Pommard Premier Cru 'Les Epenots' 2020 - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Pommard Premier Cru appellation in the Cote de Beaune, Domaine Parent Pommard Premier Cru 'Les Epenots' 2020 Magnum represents a monumental, cellaring grade expression of classic Pinot Noir in a 1.5-litre format. Managed by sisters Anne and Catherine Parent, Domaine Parent is an historic estate with winemaking roots dating back to 1753, recognized for producing deeply concentrated, age-worthy red Burgundies under certified organic viticulture. Sourced from Les Epenots, Pommard's most revered Premier Cru parcel situated on gentle, well-drained slopes of deep iron-rich clay and limestone marl, the winemaking philosophy combines careful hand harvesting, native yeast fermentation, and extended barrel aging in French oak (approximately 40% to 50% new). Presented in a large format magnum bottle, this release offers superior aging potential, ensuring slow, graceful maturation and exceptional preservation of fruit density and aromatic complexity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear dark garnet ruby purple colour with intense crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with rich aromas of dark red cherry, wild blackberry, black plum, and crushed cassis, interwoven with savory notes of violet, leather, forest floor, damp earth, sweet spices, and dark toasted oak. On the palate, it is full bodied, muscular, and concentrated, delivering generous flavours of black fruits, dark cherry, and mineral iron, all anchored by a vibrant, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by Les Epenots' characteristic broad, fine-grained Premier Cru tannins and an expansive mid-palate structure, it concludes with an exceptionally long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark fruit, spice, and stony mineral grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2020 magnum release offers an optimal drinking window of 2030–2050+. Stylistically, it effortlessly marries the opulent concentration of the 2020 vintage with Pommard's classic power, longevity, and grand structural presence.

title: Domaine Tollot Beaut Grand Cru 'Corton Bressandes' 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Corton Grand Cru appellation in the northern Cote de Beaune, Domaine Tollot Beaut Grand Cru 'Corton Bressandes' 2022 represents a voluptuous, deeply structured, and cellaring grade expression of classic Pinot Noir. Managed by fifth generation winemakers Nathalie, Jean Paul, and Olivier Tollot, Domaine Tollot Beaut is an historic estate celebrated for bottling its entire production at the domain since the 1920s. Sourced from the prestigious Corton Bressandes climat (often referred to as Bressandes) situated on the east-facing mid-slope of the Corton hill on warm, limestone-rich clay soils, the winemaking philosophy combines high-density planting, complete destemming, and native yeast fermentation. Aged in French oak barrels (approximately 50% to 60% new) for up to 18 months, the wine showcases the opulent fruit depth, seductive texture, and grand structural longevity of one of Corton's most complete Grand Cru lieux-dits alongside Tollot Beaut's signature polish and generosity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear dark ruby purple colour with intense crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of dark red cherry, wild blackberry, black plum, and crushed cassis, interwoven with delicate nuances of violet petals, forest floor, damp earth, sweet baking spices, and rich toasted oak. On the palate, it is full bodied, fleshy, and deeply concentrated, delivering generous flavours of black cherry, dark berry fruit, and mineral iron, all supported by a vibrant, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by smooth, broad-shouldered Grand Cru tannins and a velvety mid-palate structure, it concludes with an exceptionally long, lingering finish marked by dark fruit, spice, and stony mineral grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2028–2045+. Stylistically, it effortlessly marries the sunny concentration and plush texture of the 2022 vintage with Corton Bressandes' characteristic aromatic complexity and regal structural presence.

title: Domaine Parent Pommard Premier Cru 'Les Argilieres' 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Pommard Premier Cru appellation in the Cote de Beaune, Domaine Parent Pommard Premier Cru 'Les Argillières' 2022 represents a powerful, structured, and cellaring grade expression of classic Pinot Noir. Managed by sisters Anne and Catherine Parent, Domaine Parent is an historic estate with winemaking roots dating back to 1753, recognized for producing deeply concentrated, age-worthy red Burgundies under certified organic viticulture. Sourced from Les Argillières, a prized Premier Cru parcel characterized by steep slopes and deep, clay-rich limestone soils, the winemaking philosophy combines careful hand harvesting, native yeast fermentation, and extended barrel aging in French oak (approximately 30% to 40% new) to craft a wine marked by dark berry intensity, firm tannic backbone, and authentic terroir complexity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear dark garnet ruby colour with vivid crimson reflections along the rim. title: Domaine Seguin Manuel Grand Cru 'Clos de Vougeot' 2020
bodyHtml:

The result is a Grand Cru red Burgundy that showcases the massive structural presence, concentrated fruit, and long-term aging capacity of this legendary walled enclosure.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear dark ruby purple colour with bright crimson reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of dark red cherry, wild blackberry, black plum, and crushed cassis, interwoven with savory notes of game, leather, forest floor, damp earth, sweet spices, and dark toasted oak. On the palate, it is full bodied, muscular, and dense, delivering concentrated flavours of black fruits, sour cherry, and mineral iron, all supported by a vibrant, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by fine-grained, firm Grand Cru tannins and a broad, expansive mid-palate structure, it concludes with an exceptionally long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark fruit, savory spice, and stony mineral grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2020 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2028–2045+. Stylistically, it combines the sun-ripened warmth and dense concentration of the 2020 vintage with Clos de Vougeot's signature muscle, weight, and grand structural longevity.

title: Domaine Parent Corton Grand Cru Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:

title: Domaine Francois Feuillet Gevrey Chambertin Library (2018, 2019, 2020) - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:

title: Domaine Parent Pommard Premier Cru 'Les Chaponnieres' 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from France, within the prestigious Pommard Premier Cru A.O.C. appellation in the Côte de Beaune region of Burgundy. Produced by Domaine Parent a historic estate in Pommard founded in 1753 and today expertly steered by sisters Anne and Catherine Parent this single-vineyard bottling represents an exceptional expression of Premier Cru red Burgundy. Sourced from the historic, east-facing Les Chaponnières vineyard block (situated on gentle slopes directly adjacent to the famous Rugiens), the old vines are rooted in deep, iron-rich reddish clay, limestone, and gravel soils. The semi-continental microclimate features generous morning sun exposure balanced by cool hill breezes, allowing Pinot Noir to achieve complete phenolic skin maturity while locking in an age-worthy natural acidity and powerful, structured tannins.

Wine Description

The 2020 Domaine Parent Pommard Les Chaponnières Premier Cru presents a deep, luminous garnet-ruby color in the glass with bright magenta and crimson highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and muscular portrayal of Pommard terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crushed dark cherries, black raspberries, and ripe damson plums, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh violets, forest floor (sous-bois), pipe tobacco, dark cocoa, game, and a distinct line of iron-rich minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, athletic, and structured, showcasing a succulent core of dark berry compote, blood orange peel, and savory spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its rich mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and linear, framed by firm, muscular, and fine-grained tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of licorice, black tea, and crushed limestone.

This high-definition Burgundian expression is 100% Pinot Noir, meticulously hand-harvested from low-yielding old vines. Following rigorous cluster sorting, a portion of whole clusters (typically 30% to 50%) was retained during fermentation in open-top wooden vats using indigenous natural yeasts. The winemaking team utilized gentle daily pigeage (punch-downs) and remontage (pump-overs) to extract deep color and noble phenolics. The wine completed full malolactic conversion and was matured sur lie for 16 to 18 months in select French oak barrels (approximately 40% to 50% new wood) before master blending and bottling without fining or filtration. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5% to 14.0% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 growing season in Burgundy was a legendary, solar vintage defined by hot, dry conditions balanced by cool nights that yielded small, concentrated berries with remarkably high natural acidity and dark color phenolics. Domaine Parent's deep-rooted old vines in Les Chaponnières handled the summer drought with ease, producing immaculate fruit at optimal structural balance. Anne and Catherine Parent executed a masterclass in gentle extraction and barrel aging. The resulting 2020 Pommard Les Chaponnières combines monumental depth and rich fruit volume with chiseled tannic drive, built to evolve and improve gracefully in a cellar over the next 15 to 25 years.

title: Albert Grivault Bourgogne Chardonnay 'Clos du Murger' 2022

Wine Description

title: Domaine Parent Pommard Premier Cru ‘Les Croix Noires’ 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from France, within the prestigious Pommard Premier Cru A.O.C. appellation in the Côte de Beaune region of Burgundy. Produced by Domaine Parent a historic estate in Pommard founded in 1753 and today expertly steered by sisters Anne and Catherine Parent this single-vineyard bottling represents an exceptional, deeply expressive profile of Premier Cru red Burgundy. Sourced from the historic, east-facing Les Croix Noires vineyard block (situated on gentle, well-draining slopes in the mid-slope heart of the appellation, adjacent to Les Rugiens and Les Chaponnières), the old vines are rooted in deep, iron-rich reddish clay, limestone, and broken gravelly scree. The semi-continental microclimate features generous morning sun exposure balanced by cool hill breezes, allowing Pinot Noir to achieve complete phenolic skin maturity while locking in an age-worthy natural acidity and powerful, structured tannins.

Wine Description

The 2020 Domaine Parent Pommard Les Croix Noires Premier Cru presents a deep, luminous garnet-ruby color in the glass with bright magenta and crimson highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and muscular portrayal of Pommard terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crushed dark cherries, black raspberries, and ripe damson plums, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh violets, forest floor (sous-bois), pipe tobacco, dark cocoa, game, and a distinct line of iron-rich minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, athletic, and structured, showcasing a succulent core of dark berry compote, blood orange peel, and savory spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its rich mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and linear, framed by firm, muscular, and fine-grained tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of licorice, black tea, and crushed limestone.

This high-definition Burgundian expression is 100% Pinot Noir, meticulously hand-harvested from low-yielding old vines. Following rigorous cluster sorting, a portion of whole clusters (typically 30% to 50%) was retained during fermentation in open-top wooden vats using indigenous natural yeasts. The winemaking team utilized gentle daily pigeage (punch-downs) and remontage (pump-overs) to extract deep color and noble phenolics. The wine completed full malolactic conversion and was matured sur lie for 16 to 18 months in select French oak barrels (approximately 40% to 50% new wood) before master blending and bottling without fining or filtration. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5% to 14.0% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 growing season in Burgundy was a legendary, solar vintage defined by hot, dry conditions balanced by cool nights that yielded small, concentrated berries with remarkably high natural acidity and dark color phenolics. Domaine Parent's deep-rooted old vines in Les Croix Noires handled the summer drought with ease, producing immaculate fruit at optimal structural balance. Anne and Catherine Parent executed a masterclass in gentle extraction and barrel aging. The resulting 2020 Pommard Les Croix Noires combines monumental depth and rich fruit volume with chiseled tannic drive, built to evolve and improve gracefully in a cellar over the next 15 to 25 years.

title: Domaine Francois Feuillet Nuits St Georges Premier Cru 'Aux Thorey' 2022
bodyHtml:

Produced by Domaine David Duband a benchmark estate in Chevannes led by master winemaker David Duband, renowned for his refined whole-cluster fermentation technique this single-vineyard bottling hails from the famed Premier Cru Aux Thorey (often rendered as 'Aux Thorey'). Sourced from organically farmed old vines situated on the northern, Vosne-adjacent side of Nuits-Saint-Georges, the vineyard sits on east-facing mid-slopes rooted in deep limestone, clay, and gravelly scree soils. The semi-continental microclimate features ideal morning sun exposure balanced by cool, descending valley winds, enabling Pinot Noir to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining a chiseled natural acidity and perfumed, elegant structural depth.

Wine Description

The 2022 Domaine David Duband Feuillet Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Cru 'Aux Thorey' presents a deep, luminous garnet-ruby color in the glass with bright magenta and violet highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and noble portrait of northern Nuits-Saint-Georges terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crushed wild raspberries, black cherries, and dark plums, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh violets, rose petals, forest floor (sous-bois), pipe tobacco, and a clean line of chalky, iron-rich minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of crunchy red stone fruits, blood orange peel, and subtle exotic spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly across the mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, silky, and weightless, framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of licorice, black tea, and crushed limestone.

This high-definition Burgundian expression is 100% Pinot Noir, meticulously hand-harvested from low-yielding old vines. Embracing David Duband’s acclaimed winemaking philosophy, approximately 60% to 80% whole clusters were retained during fermentation in open-top wooden vats using native yeasts. Gentle foot-treading (pigeage) was employed to ensure delicate extraction without harshness. The wine completed full malolactic conversion and was matured sur lie for 14 to 16 months in select French oak barrels (approximately 30% to 40% new wood, with the balance neutral) and concrete tanks before master blending and bottling without aggressive fining or filtration. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of 13.0% to 13.5% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 growing season in Burgundy was a triumph, marked by warm, sunny summer weather balanced by timely rains that allowed grapes to achieve complete phenolic skin maturity with pristine, vibrant acid levels. David Duband’s organic viticulture and masterful whole-cluster winemaking ensure that 'Aux Thorey' delivers site-specific purity and noble ageability. The 2022 Domaine David Duband Feuillet Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Cru 'Aux Thorey' offers high-energy drinking pleasure upon release and possesses the structural frame to evolve gracefully in a cellar over the next 15 to 25 years.

title: La Fiole Cotes du Rhone 2023
