On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, smooth, and rounded, delivering generous flavours of dark berries, red fruit curd, and earthy spice, all anchored by a gentle, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by soft, fine-grained tannins and a supple mid-palate, it concludes with a warm, persistent finish marked by lingering red berry fruit, savory herbs, and subtle toasted oak. Composed of a classic southern Rhône blend dominated by Grenache and Syrah, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 3–5 years from release. Stylistically, it combines approachable fruit warmth with authentic Rhône spice and effortless drinkability.

title: Palmer & Co. Champagne Blanc De Blancs 1985
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' Champagne originates from France, within the prestigious Champagne A.O.C. appellation, specifically sourced from premier and grand cru vineyards in the Montagne de Reims and Côte des Blancs sub-regions. Produced by Champagne Palmer & Co a historic house founded in 1947 by seven grower families, renowned for its mastery of Chardonnay and its exceptional collection of library vintages—this rare late-disgorged library release (Collection Vintage) represents a monumental milestone in sparkling wine longevity. Sourced from high-latitude, chalk-rich vineyard parcels, the old vines are rooted in deep, porous Belemnite and Micraster chalk soils. Champagne’s cool, marginal northern climate allows Chardonnay to undergo an exceptionally long, gradual ripening season, accumulating complex aromatic precursors while preserving a razor-sharp, age-worthy natural acidity and intense mineral drive.

Wine Description

The 1985 Palmer & Co. Champagne Blanc de Blancs presents a mesmerizing, deep gold-amber color in the glass with bright brass and burnished platinum highlights along the rim, framed by an extraordinarily fine, delicate, and persistent bead. Its sensory profile is exceptionally mature, high-toned, and profound, delivering an energetic, laser-focused, and tertiary-driven portrait of aged Grand and Premier Cru Chardonnay. The bouquet opens with a soaring, ethereal display of dried apricots, candied lemon peel, and hazelnut praline, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of white truffle, toasted brioche, honeycomb, beeswax, dried flowers, and a distinct line of crushed chalk minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of tarte Tatin, roasted almonds, and orange marmalade. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its rich, creamy mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, carrying into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of salted butter, caramelized citrus zest, and toasted brioche.

This high-definition Champagne expression is 100% Chardonnay, hand-harvested meticulously during cool morning hours. Following gentle pressing in traditional vertical basket presses, the primary fermentation took place in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats to preserve pure varietal and terroir expression. The wine completed full malolactic conversion to soften its formidable structural acidity before undergoing secondary fermentation in the bottle (Méthode Champenoise). Following decades of extended aging on its fine lees in the house's deep chalk cellars (crayères) in Reims, the bottle underwent delicate disgorgement with a minimal, perfectly balanced low dosage (Extra Brut / Brut style, ~6–7 g/L) to preserve its pure, mature tension. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of 12.0% to 12.5% and is finished dry.

Vintage Quality

The 1985 vintage in Champagne is legendary, remembered as one of the finest of the 20th century despite severe winter frosts that reduced yields. A glorious, sun-drenched summer and idyllic autumn allowed the surviving Chardonnay grapes to reach extraordinary phenolic concentration, perfect sugar levels, and high natural acidity. Palmer & Co.’s extended decades of lees aging in cool chalk cellars protected the wine’s vibrant core, allowing it to acquire breathtaking tertiary complexity while retaining its structural backbone. The 1985 Palmer & Co. Champagne Blanc de Blancs stands at a majestic peak of maturity today, offering a rare, high-energy drinking experience for collectors.

title: Prieure de Montezargues Cote De Rhone 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' rosé wine originates from France, within the regional Côtes du Rhône A.O.C. appellation in the sun-drenched Southern Rhône Valley. Produced by Château de Prieuré de Montezargues a historic estate nestled near Tavel with winemaking traditions dating back to the 12th-century monastic orders, now expertly managed by the Richard family with guidance from the winemaking team of Château La Nerthe this bottling captures the noble heritage of Southern Rhône rosé. Sourced from estate vineyard parcels rooted in deep sandy-gravelly soils enriched with quartzite river stones (galets roulés), the vines thrive under an ideal Mediterranean microclimate. Abundant sunshine is tempered by the cooling, drying effects of the Mistral wind, allowing traditional Rhône varieties to achieve complete phenolic maturity while preserving a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity and delicate aromatic detail.

Wine Description

Prieuré de Montezargues Côtes du Rhône Rosé presents a luminous, pale coral-salmon color in the glass with bright peach and pink reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, precise, and expressive portrait of Southern Rhône terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of fresh wild red berries, crushed strawberries, and pomegranate seeds, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of orange blossom, white peach, fresh garrigue herbs, lavender, and a clean line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of tart red fruits, citrus zest, and melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly balances its subtle mid-palate textural weight. The mouthfeel is broad, supple, and weightless, framed by gentle fine-lees contact that carries into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of pink grapefruit peel, ginger spice, and Mediterranean herbs.

title: Traveller Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Traveller Whiskey (officially Traveller Whiskey Blend No. 40) is a collaborative premium blended American whiskey created by Buffalo Trace Distillery in Frankfort, Kentucky, and 10-time Grammy Award-winning country musician Chris Stapleton. Crafted under the supervision of Buffalo Trace Master Distiller Harlen Wheatley, the expression represents a unique fusion of artist storytelling and world-class Kentucky distillation expertise. Named after Stapleton's acclaimed debut solo album Traveller, the spirit was released after testing over 50 experimental blends, with iteration No. 40 selected as the definitive recipe.

Spirit Description

Traveller Whiskey is a carefully constructed blend of hand-selected whiskeys sourced from Sazerac’s award-winning distilleries, including Kentucky straight bourbon and high-rye whiskeys. Designed to offer an easy-drinking, approachable profile without sacrificing richness or character, it bridges the gap between classic smooth Canadian-style blends and traditional bold Kentucky bourbons.

  • Colour: Golden amber with polished copper and warm bronze reflections.

  • Aroma: Soft, sweet, and inviting, opening with sweet vanilla, dark caramel, butterscotch, and toasted oak, followed by hints of red apple, dried fruit, and soft baking spices.

  • Palate: Exceptionally smooth, light, and approachable on the entry. Upfront sweet notes of vanilla cream, dark honey, and toasted corn yield to subtle oak spice, sweet fruitiness, and a gentle touch of rye warmth.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a soft, round, and silky mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Medium length, clean, and warm, trailing off with lingering vanilla, sweet oak, and a delicate touch of spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 45% ABV (90 Proof).

title: Michter's Bomberger's PFG™ (Precision Fine Grain) Bourbon - 2025 Release
bodyHtml:
Michter's Bomberger's PFG™ (Precision Fine Grain) Bourbon is a new, limited release Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey from the country of the United States. It is a part of Michter's 'Legacy Series,' which honours the heritage of the historic Bomberger's Distillery in Pennsylvania. The name 'PFG' stands for Precision Fine Grain, which refers to the meticulous secondary cask aging process the whiskey undergoes. The first release of this expression was the 2025 batch, which launched in early 2025.

Spirit Description

This bourbon is bottled without an age statement. It begins its maturation journey in a new toasted and charred American oak barrel. After full maturation, the bourbon is transferred for a secondary aging period in a new, custom, proprietary toasted and charred French fine grain oak barrel. This secondary cask is crafted from wood sourced from various revered French forests, including Tronçais, Allier, Nevers, and Vosges. The staves for these barrels are naturally air-dried outdoors for a minimum of 40 months to enhance the wood's unique characteristics before construction.

The colour is described as a dark amber, and in some cases, a garnet or mahogany red. The nose features a medley of engaging aromas, ranging from confectionary notes like burnt sugar, brown butter, and crème brûlée to spicy and floral notes. The palate is full-bodied, beautifully integrated, and complex, with flavours of exquisite fruit (like cherry and mixed berry compote) and spice, surrounded by toasty, sweet notes. It often exhibits a syrupy mouthfeel and a balance of dark chocolate, cocoa, and rich oak. The finish is full-bodied, luxurious, and creamy, with lingering soft spice and chocolate. It is bottled at 100.2 proof, or 50.1% ABV.

Accolades

This inaugural release of the Bomberger's PFG Bourbon has received high praise from reviewers, indicating a successful and intentional use of the French oak finishing.

  • It earned a score of 94/100 from VinePair.

  • It received a score of 90/100 from Whisky Saga.

  • It is considered by some to be a masterful execution of French oak influence that elevates the bourbon without masking it.

Food Pairing

The complex, rich, and wood-forward profile of this bourbon is designed for sipping and complements bold flavours.

  • Savoury: Pair it with smoked brisket, grilled steak, or a charcuterie board featuring aged cheeses and cured meats.

  • Dessert: The creamy, sweet, and chocolate notes pair exceptionally well with rich desserts such as pecan pie or a dark chocolate torte.

  • Serving: Due to its elegance and balance, it is highly recommended for sipping neat to fully appreciate its nuanced transformation from the custom French oak barrels.

title: La Fiole 'Pere Anselme' Cotes Du Rhone Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'approachable' rosé wine originates from France, within the regional Côtes du Rhône A.O.C. appellation in the sun-drenched Southern Rhône Valley. Produced by Maison Brotte a historic family-owned estate founded in Châteauneuf-du-Pape in 1931 by Charles Brotte this bottling highlights the estate's deep mastery of Mediterranean varieties and regional terroirs. Sourced from choice vineyard parcels planted on gravelly alluvial terraces, clay, and limestone soils along the banks of the Rhône River, the vines thrive under the warm Mediterranean climate. Abundant sunshine is tempered by cool night breezes and the drying influence of the Mistral wind, allowing traditional Rhône grapes to build generous fruit depth while preserving a vibrant, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Brotte Côtes du Rhône Rosé presents a brilliant, pale salmon-pink color in the glass with bright coral and peach highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and fruit-forward, delivering an energetic, juicy, and expressive portrait of Southern Rhône rosé. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crushed wild strawberries, fresh red raspberries, and red currants, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of pink grapefruit, white peach, orange blossom, fresh garrigue herbs, and a clean line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and supple, showcasing a succulent core of tart red berries, citrus zest, and melon. It is characterized by its balanced energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that maintains freshness across the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by soft structural balance that glides into a long, dry, and invigorating finish accented by notes of strawberry hull, lime peel, and Mediterranean herbs.

title: Cavit Collection Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'approachable' rosé wine originates from Italy, within the expansive Delle Venezie D.O.C. (or Provincial I.G.T.) appellation spanning the picturesque northeastern regions of Trentino-Alto Adige, Veneto, and Friuli-Venezia Giulia. Produced by Cavit (Cantina Viticoltori del Trentino) a leading cooperative union established in 1950 that unites thousands of local family growers across Northern Italy this bottling highlights the estate's mastery of crisp, high-altitude and alpine-influenced viticulture. Sourced from choice vineyard parcels planted on gravelly alluvial terraces, limestone slopes, and glacial tills near the foothills of the Italian Alps, the vines thrive under an ideal sub-alpine microclimate. Sun-drenched daytime warmth is balanced by cool winds sweeping down from the Alpine peaks and off Lake Garda, enabling native and international red varieties to build gentle fruit depth while preserving a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Cavit Collection Rosé presents a luminous, delicate pale coral-pink color in the glass with bright peach and salmon highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and fruit-forward, delivering an energetic, airy, and expressive portrait of Northern Italian rosé. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of fresh red cherries, wild strawberries, and tart raspberries, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of pink grapefruit, watermelons, white flowers, and a clean line of crushed alpine stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, sleek, and supple, showcasing a succulent core of bright red berries, citrus zest, and honeydew melon. It is characterized by its balanced energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that maintains effortless drinkability across the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is weightless, silky, and clean, gliding into a refreshing, bone-dry finish accented by lingering notes of cherry skin, red apple peel, and subtle floral lift.

title: Ledaig Bordeaux Red Wine Cask Matured Whisky 9 Year Old
bodyHtml:
This single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, produced in the Island region on the Isle of Mull. Crafted at the historic Tobermory Distillery—founded in 1798 in the picturesque port town of Tobermory—the "Ledaig" name is used specifically for the distillery's heavily peated single malt expressions. Distilled in 2012 and aged for 9 years, this limited release underwent full maturation in hand-selected French Bordeaux red wine casks, combining the distillery's signature maritime smoke with rich, fruity red wine cask influence.

Spirit Description

This single malt presents a deep copper-rose hue in the glass. The nose is bold, aromatic, and smoky, opening with intense wafts of bonfire peat, smoldering ash, and medicinal sea air, balanced by sweet red berry compote, dark cherries, and subtle oak tannins. On the palate, it is full-bodied with a rich, oily texture, delivering robust flavours of smoked meats, earthy peat, and charred wood, beautifully contrasted by juicy plum, blackcurrant, dark chocolate, and warming baking spices. The finish is long, complex, and lingering, leaving a dry, savory impression of peat smoke, red wine spice, and salty sea spray. Bottled at a high strength of 56.8% ABV without chill-filtration or artificial coloring, it offers a dramatic, rich, and heavily peated profile.

title: Lingua Franca 'The Plow' Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in inspiration but produced in the United States within the Eola Amity Hills appellation of the Willamette Valley in Oregon, Lingua Franca 'The Plow' Pinot Noir 2023 represents an energetic, aromatic, and cellaring grade expression of New World Pinot Noir crafted in a classic European paradigm. Founded by Master Sommelier Larry Stone alongside legendary Burgundian consulting winemaker Dominique Lafon and winemaker Thomas Savre, Lingua Franca has established itself as one of Oregon's benchmark producers. Sourced exclusively from an east-facing block of the estate vineyard defined by volcanic Jory and Nekia soils over basalt bedrock, 'The Plow' derives its name from the horse-drawn plow used to cultivate this prized parcel. The winemaking philosophy combines organic and biodynamic viticulture, hand harvesting, partial whole-cluster native yeast fermentation, and aging in French oak barrels (approximately 20% to 25% new) to craft a wine marked by bright floral aromatics, spicy complexity, and remarkable tension.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear medium ruby red colour with soft magenta reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with inviting aromas of Bing cherries, red cranberry, wild strawberry, and orange zest, interwoven with savory notes of Damascus rose, cardamom, black tea, flint, and subtle toasted French oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, pure, and vibrant, delivering concentrated flavours of spicy red fruit, wild berries, and mineral iron, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins and a juicy mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, linear finish marked by lingering red fruit, savory spice, and a persistent volcanic mineral grip. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this 2023 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2038. Stylistically, it effortlessly marries Willamette Valley fruit purity with European restraint, freshness, and structural precision.

title: The Macallan 'The Harmony Collection' Coconut
bodyHtml:
This single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, produced in the Speyside region. Crafted at The Macallan Distillery in Craigellachie, "The Harmony Collection" is an annual, limited-release series dedicated to innovative, sustainable packaging and distinctive flavor exploration. For the 2024 release created in collaboration with Cirque du Soleil, The Macallan released Vibrant Oak and Guardian Oak, featuring organic packaging derived from oak tree byproducts. A prominent expression in this release focuses on tropical oak influences, highlighting coconut, vanilla, and sweet toasted wood notes derived from a combination of first-fill American oak sherry-seasoned casks and ex-bourbon barrels.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a bright, warm honey-gold hue in the glass. The nose opens with rich, inviting aromas of toasted coconut, creamy vanilla custard, and toasted oak, followed by subtle fruit undertones of sweet banana, green apple, and bright citrus peel. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied with a silky, coating mouthfeel, delivering luscious flavours of desiccated coconut, toasted almond, butterscotch, and sweet malt, balanced by delicate cinnamon spice and soft oak tannin. The finish is long, smooth, and sweet, leaving a lingering trail of warm coconut, sweet oak, and gentle vanilla spice. Bottled at an ABV of 44.2%, it exhibits an exceptionally harmonious, tropical, and wood-forward profile.

title: The Macallan Sherry Oak 12 Year Old 110 Proof
bodyHtml:
This single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, produced in the Speyside region. Crafted at The Macallan Distillery in Craigellachie, the Sherry Oak range is legendary for its exclusive maturation in hand-selected Oloroso sherry-seasoned oak casks from Jerez, Spain. While the core 12-Year-Old Sherry Oak is traditionally bottled at 40% or 43% ABV, high-proof and barrel-strength releases (such as distillery-exclusive cask strength bottlings and the iconic Cask Strength series) showcase this classic 12-year sherry maturation profile at a commanding 110 Proof (55% ABV).

Spirit Description

This single malt presents a deep, dark walnut and rich mahogany hue in the glass. The nose is intense, rich, and full-bodied, opening with concentrated aromas of dried fruits, dark raisins, sultanas, and polished oak, layered with notes of dark chocolate, clove, and ginger spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied and viscous, delivering a powerful burst of rich fruitcake, dark molasses, dried figs, and orange oil, balanced by firm oak tannins, espresso, and warming nutmeg. The finish is long, intense, and robust, leaving a lingering warmth of dried fruit, spicy oak, and dark cocoa. Bottled at 55% ABV (110 Proof) without dilution, it exhibits raw intensity, deep concentration, and uncompromised sherry cask depth.

title: Old Grand Dad 7 Year Old Bottled in Bond Bourbon
bodyHtml:
This straight bourbon whiskey originates from the United States, produced in the Kentucky region. Crafted at the Jim Beam Distillery in Clermont, Kentucky, under Beam Suntory (now Suntory Global Spirits), Old Grand-Dad is a historic brand named in honor of Master Distiller Basil Hayden. The 7 Year Old Bottled-in-Bond expression marks a return to a classic age statement for the brand, adhering strictly to the Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897: distilled in a single distilling season at one distillery, aged for at least 7 years in a federally bonded warehouse, and bottled at exactly 100 proof (50% ABV). It is made using the famous high-rye mash bill (27% rye).

Spirit Description

This bourbon presents a deep reddish-amber hue in the glass. The nose is bold, spicy, and inviting, opening with pronounced aromas of rye spice, black pepper, and toasted oak, followed by sweet undertones of brown sugar, vanilla bean, and dark fruit. On the palate, it is full-bodied with a rich, chewy mouthfeel, delivering robust flavours of charred oak, caramel, spicy cinnamon, and orange peel, balanced by a distinct high-rye punch of baking spices and dark cocoa. The finish is long, warm, and lingering, leaving a dry, satisfying trail of sweet oak spice, leather, and rye grain. Bottled at 50% ABV (100 Proof), it delivers exceptional balance, spicy complexity, and traditional Kentucky character.

title: Laphroaig Cairdeas French Oak 2026
bodyHtml:
This single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, produced in the Islay region. Crafted at the historic Laphroaig Distillery on the southern coast of Islay, the annual "Càirdeas" release (Gaelic for "friendship") is created specially for the Friends of Laphroaig community by the distillery's master team. Each annual iteration explores unique cask finishes, maturations, or blending techniques, showcasing Laphroaig's signature heavily peated maritime malt through a distinct maturation lens.

Spirit Description

This single malt presents a warm amber to deep gold hue in the glass. The nose is bold, aromatic, and smoky, opening with signature Laphroaig aromas of medicinal peat smoke, iodine, smoldering campfire, and salty sea spray, complemented by rich fruit nuances, toasted oak, and sweet vanilla. On the palate, it is full-bodied and oily, delivering a powerful punch of medicinal peat, medicinal ash, and seaweed, balanced by sweet fruit compote, warm oak spice, and subtle coastal brine. The finish is long, warming, and drying, leaving a lingering impression of lingering peat smoke, charred wood, and maritime sea salt. Bottled at a higher strength or cask strength without chill-filtration, it offers an uncompromised, intense, and deeply expressive Islay character.

title: Zuccardi Botanico Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Argentina, within the prestigious Gualtallary sub-appellation of the Tupungato region in the high-altitude Uco Valley of Mendoza. Produced by Zuccardi Valle de Uco a pioneering family estate led by visionary winemaker Sebastián Zuccardi and named 'World’s Best Vineyard' three consecutive years this bottling represents a benchmark for extreme-altitude, terroir-driven South American Chardonnay. Sourced exclusively from single-vineyard plots situated at a dizzying elevation of over 1,300 meters (nearly 4,300 feet) above sea level, the vines thrive in ancient, highly calcareous soils composed of gravels covered with a thick mantle of calcium carbonate (chalk/limestone). Gualtallary’s extreme alpine desert microclimate features intense UV daylight balanced by cold mountain winds descending off the Andes, enabling Chardonnay grapes to achieve phenolic maturity while preserving an electric, age-worthy natural acidity and intense saline minerality.

Wine Description

Zuccardi Botánico Chardonnay presents a luminous, pale straw-gold color in the glass with brilliant platinum and chartreuse reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, laser-focused, and chalk-driven portrait of high-altitude Gualtallary terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of fresh lime zest, green apple, and white peach, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of white flowers, lemongrass, wet stone, crushed chalk, and a distinct line of saline minerality, virtually untouched by sweet oak influence. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, sleek, and electric, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard fruit, lemon oil, and salted melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly across the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is weightless, supple, and linear, framed by a tactile, chalky texture gained from concrete aging, carrying into an extraordinarily long, bone-dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of lime peel, flint, and sea salt.

title: Zuccardi Aluvional Paraje Altamira 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Argentina, within the prestigious Paraje Altamira sub-appellation of the Uco Valley in Mendoza. Produced by Zuccardi Valle de Uco a pioneering family estate led by visionary winemaker Sebastián Zuccardi and named 'World’s Best Vineyard' three consecutive years this single-terroir bottling represents a benchmark for high-altitude, limestone-driven Malbec. Sourced from choice estate vineyard blocks situated at an elevation of 1,100 meters (3,600 feet) above sea level, the vines thrive in complex alluvial soils composed of large granite stones heavily encrusted with white calcium carbonate (chalk/limestone). Paraje Altamira’s extreme mountain desert microclimate features intense UV daylight balanced by cold winds descending off the Andes, enabling Malbec grapes to achieve complete phenolic maturity while preserving an electric, age-worthy natural acidity and intense chalky minerality.

Wine Description

Zuccardi Aluvional Paraje Altamira presents an opaque, deep black-purple color in the glass with vivid violet and magenta highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, precise, and chalk-driven portrait of high-altitude Uco Valley terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of fresh blueberries, dark plum compote, and wild blackberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh violets, dried lavender, mountain thyme, crushed chalk, graphite, and a distinct line of iron-stone minerality, virtually untouched by sweet oak influence. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, athletic, and linear, showcasing a succulent core of dark berries, blood orange peel, and savory spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and weightless, framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of crushed stone, black pepper, and dark cocoa.

title: Domaine Dujardin Monthelie Premier Cru 'Les Vignes Rondes' 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Monthelie Premier Cru appellation in the Cote de Beaune, Domaine Dujardin Monthelie Premier Cru Les Vignes Rondes represents an elevated, deeply refined expression of Pinot Noir. Produced by Domaine Dujardin, this release showcases one of Monthelie's most acclaimed Premier Cru sites, situated along the upper slope with optimal southern exposure. The winemaking philosophy combines hand harvesting, careful sorting, native yeast fermentation, and extended aging in French oak barrels (approximately 20% to 30% new) to extract rich fruit concentration, silky structural depth, and long cellaring potential.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep ruby red colour with luminous crimson highlights in the glass. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with rich aromas of ripe black cherry, red plum, and wild raspberry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of violet, forest floor, sweet spice, and crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silky, and harmonious, delivering generous flavours of dark red fruit and subtle earthiness balanced by a vibrant streak of natural acidity. Framed by fine-grained, elegant Premier Cru tannins, it finishes long and smooth with lingering notes of red berries and sweet oak spice. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it combines Monthelie charm with Premier Cru weight and complexity.

title: Domaine Dujardin Monthelie Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Monthelie appellation in the Cote de Beaune, Domaine Dujardin Monthelie Rouge represents a classic, terroir-driven village expression of Pinot Noir. Produced by Domaine Dujardin, a historic family-owned estate dedicated to traditional Burgundian viticulture, the winery focuses on sustainable farming, manual harvesting, and minimal intervention in the cellar. Sourced from village-level vineyard plots planted on steep limestone and clay slopes, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes gentle destemming, temperature-controlled fermentation with native yeasts, and aging in French oak barrels to preserve pristine red fruit character and authentic regional identity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, bright ruby red colour with soft garnet highlights along the rim. An inviting and fresh bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of red cherry, wild raspberry, and red currant, interwoven with subtle notes of crushed stone minerality, dried herbs, and gentle oak spice. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, elegant, and supple, delivering crisp flavours of red berries and sour cherry supported by a vibrant, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Finishing clean and dry, it leaves a pleasant, refreshing impression of forest berries and delicate spice. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it offers an approachable, graceful, and food-friendly village Burgundy profile.

title: Domaine Maume Siblas Gevrey Chambertin 'En Pallud' 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Gevrey Chambertin appellation in the northern Cote de Nuits, Domaine Maume Siblas Gevrey Chambertin En Pallud represents a distinct, single-vineyard village expression of classic Pinot Noir. Steeped in the historic winemaking tradition of Domaine Maume under winemaker Bertrand Maume and the Siblas family, this estate bottling highlights one of the most favorably situated lieu-dit parcels in the village. Sourced from En Pallud, an east-facing vineyard site located just below the renowned Premier Cru Les Corbeaux and bordering Grand Cru holdings, the winemaking philosophy focuses on organic farming practices, low yields, gentle destemming, native yeasts, and aging in French oak barrels (approximately 20% to 30% new) to craft a wine of profound concentration, dark fruit purity, and cellaring capability.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear dark ruby purple colour with vibrant crimson highlights along the rim. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with alluring aromas of ripe black cherry, wild blackberry, and crushed cassis, interwoven with delicate notes of violet, crushed limestone minerality, damp forest floor, sweet tobacco, and toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, dense, and structured, delivering concentrated flavours of dark red berries, black plum, and savory herbs, all supported by a firm, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by fine-grained, muscular tannins and a rich mid-palate, it concludes with a long, energetic finish marked by lingering notes of dark fruit and earthy minerality. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it combines the iconic power and structure of Gevrey Chambertin with the refined aromatic elegance of a top lieu-dit site.

title: Domaine Maume Siblas Gevrey Chambertin 2021
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the world renowned Gevrey Chambertin appellation in the northern Cote de Nuits, Domaine Maume Siblas Gevrey Chambertin represents an iconic, deeply structured, and classic expression of Pinot Noir. Steeped in the rich history of the original Domaine Maume—famous for its unvarnished, age-worthy, and rustic style—the estate under winemaker Bertrand Maume and the Siblas family continues to focus on exceptional vineyard holdings across the village. Sourced from old vine parcels rooted in well-drained limestone and iron-rich clay soils, the winemaking philosophy centers on organic farming, low yields, partial whole-cluster fermentation, native yeasts, and aging in French oak barrels (approximately 20% to 30% new) to deliver a wine of deep concentration, earthy complexity, and traditional Burgundian character.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, dark ruby purple colour with vibrant crimson highlights along the rim. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with classic Gevrey aromas of dark black cherry, wild blackberry, and crushed cassis, interwoven with fragrant notes of violet, gamey earthiness, damp forest floor, leather, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, firm, and muscular, delivering rich layers of dark red berries, black fruit, and savory herbs, all supported by a vibrant, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by Gevrey Chambertin's signature sturdy, structured tannins and a dense mid-palate, it concludes with a long, powerful finish marked by lingering notes of dark fruit, sweet spice, and gravelly minerality. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it combines classic Cote de Nuits muscularity and earthy depth with refined, pure fruit intensity.

title: Domaine Maume Siblas Nuits Saint Georges 'Les Plantes au Baron' 2017
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Nuits Saint Georges appellation in the Cote de Nuits, Domaine Maume Siblas Nuits Saint Georges Les Plantes au Baron represents a terroir focused, deeply structured expression of classic Pinot Noir. Helmed by Patricia Siblas and her son Thomas Maume, the estate carries forward the celebrated winemaking legacy of the historic Domaine Maume of Gevrey Chambertin. Sourced from Les Plantes au Baron, a well situated village level lieu-dit vineyard resting at the foot of the hillside slope on limestone and clay rich soils, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes sustainable viticulture, hand harvesting, minimal intervention, gentle destemming, and modest use of French oak barrels to preserve natural balance, pure fruit clarity, and authentic Côte de Nuits character.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, bright dark ruby red colour with vibrant crimson highlights along the rim. An expressive and terroir driven bouquet opens with intense aromas of ripe red cherry, wild black cherry, and dark plum, interwoven with sophisticated notes of red rose petal, damp forest floor, crushed limestone minerality, and gentle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, vibrant, and deep, delivering rich flavours of red berries, sour cherry, and subtle earthiness, all supported by a mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by fine, silky tannins and an energetic mid-palate, it concludes with a clean, persistent finish marked by lingering notes of dark fruit, savory spice, and earthy minerality. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it combines the earthy depth and structural presence of Nuits Saint Georges with pure fruit expression, harmony, and age-worthy elegance.

title: Domaine Tollot Beaut Bourgogne Cote d’Or Blanc 2023
Domaine Lignier Michelot Savigny les Beaune 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Savigny les Beaune appellation in the northern Cote de Beaune, Domaine Lignier Michelot Savigny les Beaune represents a precise, terroir-driven expression of classic Pinot Noir. Based in Morey Saint Denis and helmed by winemaker Virgile Lignier since 1992, the domain has achieved widespread critical acclaim for its meticulous vineyard management and non-interventionalist cellar practices. Although renowned for their Morey Saint Denis and Clos de la Roche holdings, Virgile's expansion into Savigny les Beaune showcases his signature touch on Cote de Beaune fruit. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes organic farming practices, partial whole-cluster fermentations, native yeasts, minimal sulfur additions, and aging in French oak barrels (approximately 20% to 30% new) to preserve freshness, structural purity, and elegant fruit expression.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear dark ruby red colour with vibrant magenta highlights along the rim. An expressive and perfumed bouquet opens with seductive aromas of wild dark cherry, ripe red plum, and black raspberry, interwoven with fragrant notes of dried violet, damp forest floor, subtle gamey earthiness, and delicate French oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, supple, and textured, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, sour cherry, and subtle crushed stone minerality, all supported by a firm, refreshing core of natural acidity. Framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins and a smooth mid-palate, it concludes with a long, energetic finish marked by lingering notes of dark red fruit and earthy spice. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, it effortlessly marries Morey Saint Denis power and precision with the charming, earth-inflected elegance of Savigny les Beaune.

title: Chateau d'Yquem 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Bordeaux region, specifically within the Sauternes appellation on the Left Bank of the Garonne river, Château d'Yquem Premier Cru Supérieur 2023 375ml represents a transcendent, opulent, and legendary expression of classic noble rot sweet wine in a half bottle format. Managed under the stewardship of Pierre Lurton and estate manager Lorenzo Pasquini, Château d'Yquem stands alone as the sole estate awarded Premier Cru Supérieur status in the historic 1855 Sauternes Classification. Sourced from the château's high-altitude gravelly clay and limestone slopes, where unique microclimatic morning mists generated by the Ciron stream promote the development of Botrytis cinerea (noble rot), the winemaking philosophy demands painstaking hand harvesting in multiple selective passes (tries) to gather only fully botrytized grapes. Barrel fermented and aged in 100% new French oak for up to 30 months, this 375ml half bottle release offers an ideal format for intimate dining while ensuring extraordinary concentration, electric acidity, and infinite cellaring longevity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, luminous pale golden yellow colour with intense amber and greenish-gold reflections along the rim. An exquisite, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of orange marmalade, candied apricot, dried mango, and yellow peach, interwoven with seductive notes of acacia honey, white truffle, toasted brioche, candied ginger, saffron, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, unctuous, and profoundly concentrated, delivering rich flavours of dried stone fruit, citrus curd, and honeyed spice, all perfectly counterbalanced by a piercing, mouthwatering core of natural acidity that prevents any sense of heaviness. Framed by a satiny, coat-the-mouth texture and vibrant mid-palate energy, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering orange peel, exotic spice, and a clean mineral lift. Composed of a blend dominated by Sémillon alongside Sauvignon Blanc, this 2023 half bottle release offers an optimal drinking window of 2028–2075+. Stylistically, it combines the aromatic brightness and freshness of the 2023 vintage with Château d'Yquem's unrivaled power, complexity, and botrytis purity.

title: Prunotto Barolo | Hosted by Emanuele Baldi Estate Director
bodyHtml:
Experience Piedmont Excellence: An Exclusive Evening with Prunotto

Nestled in the heart of Italy's famous Langhe and Monferrato regions, Prunotto has been crafting world-class wines for over a century. Known for its perfect balance between respecting centuries-old winemaking traditions and embracing modern technique, the estate is renowned for producing expressive, high-elevation expressions of Nebbiolo and Barbera that capture the true terroir of Piedmont.

Event Details

title: Chateau Margaux 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Bordeaux region, specifically within the Margaux appellation on the Left Bank of the Gironde estuary, Château Margaux Premier Grand Cru Classé 2023 represents a majestic, ethereal, and cellaring grade expression of classic Bordeaux red. Managed under the leadership of Alexis Leven-Mentzelopoulos and technical director Philippe Bascaules, Château Margaux is one of only five coveted First Growth estates established in the 1855 Bordeaux Classification. Sourced from the estate's historic gravel mounds featuring deep quartz gravel over limestone and clay subsoils, the winemaking philosophy combines rigorous parcel selection, organic viticulture, traditional oak-vat fermentation, and barrel aging in 100% new French oak crafted in the château's on-site cooperage. The result is a legendary wine celebrated globally for its sublime balance of aromatic perfume, velvety concentration, and effortless power.

Wine Description

The wine presents an intense, deep dark garnet purple colour with brilliant crimson highlights along the rim. An exquisite, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of crushed cassis, wild blackberry, black plum, and dark cherry, interwoven with intoxicating notes of fresh violet petals, dried rose, graphite, cedarwood, pipe tobacco, and subtle toasted French oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied yet extraordinarily weightless, delivering concentrated flavours of black currant, dark stone fruit, and mineral crushed stone, all anchored by a vibrant, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by ultra-fine, seamless Premier Grand Cru Classé tannins that coat the palate like silk, it concludes with an exceptionally long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark berry fruit, sweet floral nuances, and a refined mineral grip. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon blended with small proportions of Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot, this 2023 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2033–2065+. Stylistically, it combines the aromatic precision and freshness of the 2023 vintage with Château Margaux's hallmark aristocracy, depth, and structural finesse.

title: Amelia Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' white wine originates from Chile, within the cool-climate Limarí Valley A.O.C. appellation in the northern Coquimbo region. Produced by Concha y Toro under its icon tier and led by chief winemaker Marcelo Papa, Amelia represents a groundbreaking milestone for ultra-premium Chilean white wine. Sourced exclusively from the historic Quebrada Seca Vineyard, located just 22 kilometers from the Pacific Ocean, the vines are rooted in ancient red clay soils over a deep, calcareous limestone bed. Limarí’s extreme coastal desert microclimate features persistent morning coastal fog (camanchaca) and cool ocean breezes that temper the bright equatorial sunshine, enabling Chardonnay grapes to achieve complete phenolic maturity during an extraordinarily long ripening period while preserving a chiseled, age-worthy natural acidity and intense saline minerality.

Wine Description

Amelia Chardonnay presents a luminous, pale straw-gold color in the glass with bright platinum and chartreuse reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, laser-focused, and mineral-driven portrayal of cool-climate Limarí terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of fresh lime zest, green apple, and white peach, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of orange blossom, toasted hazelnut, pastry crust, flint, and a distinct line of crushed limestone and saline minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard fruit, lemon curd, and salted melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly cuts through the mid-palate fruit volume. The mouthfeel is broad, supple, and linear, framed by seamless French oak integration gained from gentle fine-lees stirring (bâtonnage), carrying into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of lime peel, toasted almond, and sea salt.

title: Dal Forno Romano Valpolicella Superiore 2017
bodyHtml:
The Dal Forno family has been making wine since 1983. Located in Val D’Illasi, the estate consists of 65 acres of vines planted with traditional indigenous varieties of Corvina, Corvinone, Rondinella, Oseleta and Croatina. Their loose, alluvial soils, meticulous pruning and scrupulous viticultural techniques ensure remarkable-quality grapes. The Dal Fornos use traditional methods to grow the finest fruit, and then employ modern techniques to produce the best wines, classic in expression and modern in purity.

Dense, sweet and floral gargantuan. Super concentrated, rich and sweet, with notes of charred red pepper, oak and spice. An approachable wine, due to the extraordinary summer climate.  

95 Points - James Suckling

Pungent nose of violets, amarena cherries, dried figs and lightly charred oak. Some toffee notes emerge with air, together with more pressed flowers. Not so much full-bodied as full-flavored, with silky, fine and polished tannins.

title: Salon Le Mesnil Champagne 2015
bodyHtml:
Produced by Champagne Salon; arguably the most iconic, uncompromisingly rigorous house in Champagne, founded by Eugène-Aimé Salon in 1905 this bottling represents the singular benchmark for monocru, monovarietal Blanc de Blancs longevity. Salon is produced only in exceptionally great vintages (fewer than 40 during its entire century-plus history). Sourced from a tiny 1-hectare estate parcel, "Le Jardin de Salon," alongside 19 old-vine plots across Le Mesnil-sur-Oger, the vines are rooted in deep, porous Belemnite chalk soils. Champagne’s cool northern marginal microclimate enables Chardonnay to ripen with intense phenolic complexity while retaining a razor-sharp, age-worthy natural acidity and an electric mineral drive.

Wine Description

The 2015 Champagne Salon Le Mesnil presents a luminous, pale straw-gold color in the glass with brilliant chartreuse highlights along the rim, animated by an extraordinarily fine, persistent, and laser-like bead. Its sensory profile is exceptionally high-toned, precise, and complex, delivering an energetic, laser-guided portrait of pure Mesnil chalk. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of sliced green apple, lemon curd, candied lime zest, and white peach, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of white flowers, crushed chalk, wet stone, lemon verbena, brioche, and roasted hazelnut, virtually untouched by heavy autolytic oxidation. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, athletic, and linear, showcasing a vibrant core of tart orchard fruit, citrus oil, and salted melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its mid-palate fruit concentration. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by a tactile, chalky texture that carries into an extraordinarily long, bone-dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of sea salt, lemon peel, and crushed flint.

This high-definition Champagne expression is 100% Chardonnay, meticulously hand-harvested from old vines. Following gentle whole-cluster pressing in traditional vertical presses, the primary fermentation took place entirely in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks to preserve raw varietal and site-specific purity. Salon strictly avoids oak barrel fermentation. Uniquely, the house strictly blocks malolactic conversion to preserve maximum natural acidity and age-worthy structural tension. Following secondary fermentation in the bottle (Méthode Champenoise), the 2015 vintage underwent nearly a decade of patient aging on its fine lees in the deep, cool chalk cellars of Le Mesnil-sur-Oger. It was finished with a minimal, perfectly balanced low dosage (Extra Brut style) to preserve its pure chalky core. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of 12.0% to 12.5% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2015 vintage in Champagne was marked by a warm, dry summer followed by timely late-August rains that allowed Chardonnay in Le Mesnil-sur-Oger to achieve optimal phenolic maturity with rich sugar accumulation and pristine structural balance. Salon's uncompromising blocking of malolactic conversion ensured that the natural warmth of 2015 was framed by razor-sharp acidity and chiseled limestone grip. The 2015 Salon Le Mesnil stands as a monumental masterpiece that offers high-energy drinking pleasure today and possesses the structural frame to cellar gracefully for 30 to 50 years.

title: Don Melchor Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from Chile in the South American region, specifically within the Puente Alto appellation in the northern Maipo Valley, Don Melchor Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 represents an iconic, powerful, and cellaring grade expression of New World Cabernet Sauvignon crafted in a classic European style. Produced by Viña Don Melchor under the meticulous direction of winemaker Enrique Tirado, Don Melchor is widely recognized as Chile's premier flagship wine, consistently demonstrating the world-class potential of the Puente Alto terroir. Sourced from the historic Don Melchor vineyard situated on the stony alluvial terraces of the northern bank of the Maipo River at the foot of the Andes Mountains, the vineyard is divided into 151 distinct parcels to optimize parcel-by-parcel harvesting. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes small-lot native yeast fermentation, precise barrel selection, and extended aging in French oak barrels (approximately 60% to 70% new) for 15 months, creating a wine celebrated for its profound density, ripe velvety tannins, and extraordinary longevity.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby violet colour with brilliant magenta highlights along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with regal aromas of cassis, dark black cherry, wild blackberry, and ripe blueberry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of graphite, cedar, tobacco leaf, violet petals, mocha, and subtle toasted French oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, rich, and seamlessly balanced, delivering concentrated flavours of black currant, dark plum, and mineral graphite, all anchored by a vibrant, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine-grained, polished, and structural tannins that reflect Puente Alto's gravelly soils, it concludes with an exceptionally long, persistent finish marked by lingering dark berry fruit, sweet spice, and a noble savory elegance. Composed primarily of Cabernet Sauvignon with small blending additions of Cabernet Franc, Merlot, and Petit Verdot, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2027–2045+. Stylistically, it combines the sun-ripened depth and freshness of the 2022 Maipo vintage with Don Melchor's signature elegance and structural complexity.

Accolades:

99 Points - James Suckling: "Blackcurrants, cassis and graphite on the nose. Pure and fragrant. Full-bodied with superb density and tannins that are so polished. The texture is like touching a silk ball. Its finish is very long and compact with slightly chewy tannins, but it will come together beautifully with time in the bottle. Try after 2028."

title: Vincent Latour Meursault 'Les Narvaux' 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Meursault appellation in the Cote de Beaune, Domaine Vincent Latour Meursault 'Les Narvaux' 2022 represents a chiseled, mineral-driven, and cellaring grade expression of classic Chardonnay. Produced by Domaine Vincent Latour under the direction of Vincent Latour, who took over his family estate in 1998, the domain is celebrated for combining traditional Burgundian technique with modern cellaring precision. Sourced from Les Narvaux, arguably Meursault's most iconic village lieu-dit parcel situated high on the slope above Genevrieres and Poruzots on thin, rocky limestone soils, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes gentle pneumatic pressing, native yeast fermentation, aging on fine lees in French oak barrels (approximately 20% to 25% new) and large foudres, and no batonnage (lees stirring) to guarantee razor-sharp acidity, crystalline purity, and authentic terroir expression.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, clear pale straw yellow colour with brilliant greenish-gold highlights along the rim. An expressive, highly energetic bouquet opens with noble aromas of lemon oil, crispy green apple, white peach, and lime blossom, interwoven with subtle notes of crushed chalk, wet flint, toasted hazelnut, and delicate white flowers. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, tense, and focused, delivering concentrated flavours of lemon curd, stone fruits, and intense mineral drive, all anchored by a vibrant, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a satiny yet linear texture and a powerful mid-palate, it concludes with a long, energetic finish marked by lingering citrus zest, flinty reduction, and persistent limestone grip. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2027–2036+. Stylistically, it combines the sunny depth of the 2022 vintage with the raciness, vertical tension, and near-Premier Cru quality characteristic of Les Narvaux.

title: Caymus Cabernet Sauvignon 'Napa Valley' 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from the United States, within the premier Napa Valley A.V.A. in coastal Northern California. Produced by Caymus Vineyards one of Napa Valley’s most legendary winemaking dynasties, founded in 1972 by Charlie Wagner, his wife Lorna Belle Glos Wagner, and their son Chuck Wagner this bottling represents the quintessential, world-famous benchmark for opulent, fruit-forward California Cabernet Sauvignon. Sourced from choice vineyard parcels across multiple diverse sub-appellations of the valley floor and benchlands (including Rutherford, Oakville, Yountville, and Calistoga), the vines thrive in well-draining alluvial gravel, loam, and volcanic soils. Napa Valley’s warm Mediterranean climate brings intense solar exposure during the day, tempered by cool morning fog and evening marine breezes from San Pablo Bay, allowing Cabernet Sauvignon grapes to achieve signature phenolic ripeness, plush fruit concentration, and velvety structural tannins.

Wine Description

Caymus Vineyards Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon presents an opaque, deep purple-black color in the glass with vivid magenta and ruby-violet highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, opulent, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and luxurious portrayal of classical Caymus styling. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe cassis, black cherry jam, and wild blackberry liqueur, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of dark chocolate, sweet Madagascar vanilla bean, espresso, pipe tobacco, toasted oak, and a subtle line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rich, and supple, showcasing a succulent core of dark berry compote, cocoa nibs, sweet baking spices, and cassis. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an integrated, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly balances its lavish mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and mouth-coating, framed by plush, ultra-soft, and fine-grained tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, rich finish accented by persistent notes of vanilla, toasted cedar, and dark plum.

title: Beringer Merlot Main & Vine
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California, Beringer Main & Vine Merlot represents an approachable, smooth, and fruit-forward expression of classic red winemaking. Produced by Beringer Vineyards, Napa Valley's oldest continuously operating winery founded in 1876 by brothers Jacob and Frederick Beringer, the Main & Vine collection is crafted to showcase reliable, crowd-pleasing wines for casual everyday enjoyment. Sourced from warm, sunny vineyards across California's top growing regions, the winemaking philosophy focuses on gentle destemming, temperature-controlled stainless steel tank fermentation, and short aging on toasted American oak to enhance sweet fruit flavours, soften tannins, and deliver a rounded, approachable palate.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear ruby purple colour with vibrant magenta highlights along the rim. An inviting and fruit-driven bouquet opens with generous aromas of ripe black cherry, juicy red plum, and blackberry jam, interwoven with cozy notes of milk chocolate, toasted oak spice, vanilla bean, and a hint of sweet tobacco. On the palate, it is medium bodied, plush, and wonderfully smooth, delivering soft flavours of ripe dark berries, cocoa, and baking spice, all supported by gentle, rounded tannins and balanced natural acidity. Finishing clean, soft, and easy-drinking, it leaves a pleasant, lingering impression of sweet plum and toasted vanilla. Composed predominantly of Merlot blended with complementary California red varieties, it offers an exceptionally smooth, accessible, and versatile red wine profile with broad appeal.

title: Gemma Di Luna Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the famous Delle Venezie DOC region of northeastern Italy, Gemma Di Luna Pinot Grigio represents a stylish, fresh, and modern expression of classic Italian white winemaking. Produced under the Enoitalia / Enartis portfolio, the Gemma Di Luna brand—meaning Gem of the Moon—is celebrated for its iconic, signature teal blue bottle design and luxury-inspired packaging. Sourced from premium vineyards across the sun-drenched hills of Veneto and Friuli, the winemaking philosophy focuses on gentle pneumatic pressing, cool-temperature stainless steel tank fermentation, and short lees contact to craft a vibrant, crisp, and fruit-forward wine that embodies Italian elegance and casual luxury.

Wine Description

The wine presents a pale straw yellow colour with luminous platinum and greenish highlights in the glass. An inviting and delicate bouquet opens with crisp aromas of green apple, Bartlett pear, and white peach, interwoven with fragrant notes of white spring flowers, lemon blossom, and subtle crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, smooth, and refreshingly crisp, delivering bright flavours of yellow plum, nectarine, and citrus zest, all supported by a mouthwatering, energetic spine of natural acidity. Finishing clean, dry, and pleasantly persistent, it leaves a long, refreshing impression of fresh orchard fruit and delicate floral blossom. Composed of 100% Pinot Grigio, it combines quintessential Italian freshness with smooth drinkability and chic, contemporary appeal.

title: Cusumano Lucido 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy on the island of Sicily, specifically within the Terre Siciliane IGT / Sicilia DOC appellation from the Ficuzza estate in Piana degli Albanesi near Palermo, Cusumano Lucido represents a vibrant, modern, and mineral-driven expression of indigenous Sicilian white winemaking. Founded in 2001 by brothers Alberto and Diego Cusumano, the winery has become a benchmark for high-altitude, terroir-specific Sicilian viticulture. Named after Lucido, the historic local clone of the Catarratto grape variety known for its bright skin and elevated acidity, the winemaking philosophy focuses on sustainable mountain farming, early morning hand harvesting, cold maceration on the skins, and stainless steel fermentation with four months of lees aging to preserve pure varietal fruit, aromatic clarity, and distinctive Mediterranean minerality.

Wine Description

The wine presents a pale straw yellow colour with luminous greenish highlights in the glass. An inviting and fresh bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of yellow apple, white peach, and ripe lemon, interwoven with delicate floral notes of jasmine, fresh mountain herbs, and a distinct touch of crushed sea salt minerality. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, crisp, and vibrant, delivering juicy flavours of green orchard fruit, grapefruit zest, and subtle tropical melon, all supported by a mouthwatering, zesty spine of natural acidity. Finishing clean, dry, and pleasantly persistent, it leaves a long, refreshing impression of citrus zest and saline minerality. Composed of 100% Catarratto (Lucido clone), it combines sunny Mediterranean fruit generosity with high-altitude alpine freshness and crisp, easy-drinking versatility.

title: Martin's Lane Riesling 'Simes Vineyard' 2025
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Canada, within the prestigious East Kelowna Bench sub-G.I. of British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Produced by Martin's Lane Winery an exclusive, gravity-fed estate designed by architect Tom Kundig and led by winemaker Shane Munn, dedicated solely to Pinot Noir and Riesling this single-vineyard bottling is a benchmark for high-latitude, cool-climate Riesling. Sourced from the historic, north-facing Simes Vineyard, the vines sit on a steep, cool slope rooted in complex granite-rich glacial till, silt, and clay soils. The northern orientation protects the grapes from scorching afternoon heat, allowing for an exceptionally long, gradual ripening season. Intense UV daylight is balanced by cool mountain air currents coming off Okanagan Lake, enabling Riesling grapes to accumulate detailed aromatic phenolics while locking in a razor-sharp, age-worthy natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Martin's Lane Riesling 'Simes Vineyard' presents a brilliant, pale straw-gold color in the glass with bright platinum and chartreuse highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, laser-focused, and mineral-driven portrait of East Kelowna terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of lime zest, green apple, and white peach, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of lemongrass, orange blossom, wet slate, crushed granite, and a subtle line of petrol and lime leaf. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and electric, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard fruit, lemon curd, and salted melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly across the mid-palate, seamlessly balancing a touch of delicate residual sugar. The mouthfeel is weightless, supple, and linear, carrying into an extraordinarily long, dry-tasting, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of lime peel, wet stone, and saline minerality.

title: Bottega Lemon Spritz
bodyHtml:
Bottega Lemon Spritz is a ready-to-drink (RTD) sparkling cocktail produced in the Veneto region of Italy. It is crafted by Bottega S.p.a., a family-owned company founded in 1977 by master distiller Aldo Bottega and currently managed by his children Sandro, Barbara, and Stefano. Inspired by the traditional Italian spritz, which dates back to the Habsburg domination in the Lombardo-Veneto Kingdom, this modern version was designed to offer a refreshing, low-alcohol alternative to the classic Bottega Spritz by using a pure lemon infusion instead of limoncello liqueur.

Spirit Description

The cocktail is a blend of Italian white sparkling wine, an infusion of mint, and Sicilian lemons grown using organic farming methods.

  • Colour: The liquid presents a slightly cloudy yellow appearance.

  • Aroma: It features an intense lemon bouquet combined with fresh mint and the fruity notes characteristic of white sparkling wine.

  • Palate: The taste is fresh and full-bodied, delivering citrus fruit and wine flavours with a distinct bitter-sweet balance on the palate.

  • Body: It is characterized by lively, natural bubbles derived directly from the sparkling wine rather than added carbon dioxide.

  • Finish: The experience concludes with a clean, zesty freshness and herbal lift from the mint infusion.

  • ABV: This beverage is bottled at a low alcohol content of 5.4%.

title: Josh Cellars Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from the United States, within the expansive California A.V.A. appellation. Produced by Josh Cellars the widely acclaimed winery established in 2007 by Joseph Carr as a tribute to his father (Josh) this bottling delivers a crisp, bright, and refreshing expression of California Sauvignon Blanc. Sourced from choice vineyard sites across key coastal and interior valley growing regions in California (including the North Coast and Central Coast), the vines thrive in well-draining sandy loam and gravelly alluvial soils. The sunny Mediterranean-style microclimate features warm daytime sunshine tempered by cool evening ocean breezes, allowing Sauvignon Blanc grapes to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Josh Cellars Sauvignon Blanc presents a luminous, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with bright chartreuse and silver reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and fruit-driven, delivering an energetic, crisp, and vibrant portrait of California Sauvignon Blanc. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of bright lemon zest, green apple, and juicy white peach, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of pink grapefruit, lemongrass, passionfruit, and a clean line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard fruit, lemon curd, and melon. It is characterized by its balanced energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly across the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is broad, supple, and weightless, carrying into a clean, dry, and refreshing finish accented by persistent notes of citrus peel and green apple.

title: Josh Cellars Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'approachable' red wine originates from the United States, within the expansive California A.V.A. appellation. Crafted by Josh Cellars the widely acclaimed winery established in 2007 by Joseph Carr as a tribute to his father, Josh this bottling delivers a plush, fruit-forward, and accessible expression of California Pinot Noir. Sourced from choice, cool-climate vineyard sites across key coastal and valley growing regions in California (including the Central Coast and Monterey), the vines thrive in well-draining sandy loam and clay-gravelly soils. The region’s cool maritime breezes and morning fog moderate daytime sunshine, allowing the delicate Pinot Noir grapes to achieve complete phenolic maturity while preserving a bright, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Josh Cellars Pinot Noir presents a luminous, brilliant ruby color in the glass with bright garnet and magenta reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and fruit-driven, delivering an expressive, supple, and inviting portrait of coastal California Pinot Noir. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of dark cherries, ripe strawberries, and red plums, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of sweet vanilla bean, toasted oak, crushed herbs, and a faint touch of warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and smooth, showcasing a succulent core of bright red stone fruits, blood orange peel, and subtle cocoa. It is characterized by its balanced energy and a soft, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that maintains freshness across the palate. The mouthfeel is broad, silky, and supple, framed by fine-grained, gentle tannins that glide into a smooth, dry, and pleasingly lingering finish accented by notes of cherry skin, cinnamon, and toasted oak.

title: Josh Cellars Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from the United States, within the expansive California A.V.A. appellation. Produced by Josh Cellars the widely acclaimed winery established in 2007 by Joseph Carr as a tribute to his father, Josh this bottling reflects a crisp, vibrant, and approachable Golden State expression of Pinot Grigio. Sourced from choice, cool-climate vineyard sites across key coastal and valley growing regions in California, the vines thrive in well-draining sandy loam and alluvial soils. The warm daytime sun balanced by refreshing evening coastal breezes allows the grapes to achieve optimal phenolic ripeness while retaining a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Josh Cellars Pinot Grigio presents a luminous, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with bright greenish-silver highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and fruit-driven, delivering an energetic, crisp, and inviting portrait of California Pinot Grigio. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of green apple, juicy pear, and lemon zest, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of white peach, orange blossom, and a clean line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard fruit, lemon curd, and melon. It is characterized by its balanced energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of acidity that maintains crispness across the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is broad, supple, and weightless, carrying into a clean, dry, and refreshing finish accented by persistent notes of citrus peel and green apple.

title: Josh Cellars Merlot 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'approachable' red wine originates from the United States, within the expansive California A.V.A. appellation. Crafted by Josh Cellars a highly popular American winery founded in 2007 by Joseph Carr as a tribute to his father, Josh this bottling reflects a classic, crowd-pleasing expression of Golden State Merlot. Sourced from choice vineyard sites across key warm-growing regions in California (including the North Coast and Central Coast), the vines thrive in well-draining sandy loam and clay-gravelly soils. The sunny Mediterranean-style microclimate brings warm daytime sunshine and temperate evening cooling, allowing the Merlot grapes to achieve complete phenolic ripeness, plush fruit concentration, and gentle, soft natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Josh Cellars Merlot presents a deep, luminous ruby-garnet color in the glass with vivid magenta reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and fruit-forward, delivering an expressive, round, and approachable portrait of California Merlot. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of ripe black cherry, dark plum, and sweet blackberry, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of toasted oak, cocoa powder, vanilla bean, and a subtle touch of dried herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, supple, and smooth, showcasing a succulent core of dark stone fruits, candied cherry, and mocha. It is characterized by its balanced energy and a soft, supple backbone of acidity that maintains freshness across the palate. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and gentle, framed by soft, rounded tannins that glide into a smooth, dry, and pleasingly warm finish accented by notes of cocoa, dark berry jam, and gentle oak spice.

title: Chateau Latour Premier Grand Cru Classe 2019
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the famous Bordeaux region, specifically within the premier Pauillac appellation, Chateau Latour 2019 represents a benchmark expression of First Growth winemaking. Ranked as a Premier Grand Cru Classe in the historic 1855 Classification, Chateau Latour is renowned for its unyielding commitment to precision and longevity. Under the stewardship of the Pinault family (Artemis Domaines) and technical director Helene Genin, the estate transitioned to 100% certified organic farming in 2018. The winemaking philosophy centers on meticulous parcel selection from the famed Enclos vineyard surrounding the chateau, temperature controlled stainless steel fermentation, and aging in 100% new French oak barrels to produce wines of immense concentration, mineral tension, and age-worthy grace.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark garnet purple colour with vivid crimson edges in the glass. A powerful, deeply complex, and tightly coiled bouquet opens with primary aromas of ripe cassis, dark plum, and wild blackberry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of graphite, pencil shavings, cedar wood, crushed stone, espresso, and dried violets. On the palate, it is full bodied, architectural, and profoundly concentrated, delivering rich layers of black fruit, dark cocoa, and savory herbs, all anchored by a firm core of fresh, mouthwatering natural acidity. Framed by Latour's hallmark muscular, fine-grained, and seamless tannins along with an undercurrent of intense gravelly minerality, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, precise, and persistent finish. Composed of a classic Pauillac blend dominated by Cabernet Sauvignon with Merlot and small additions of Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2030–2070+. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines the heat-derived fruit generosity of the 2019 vintage with Latour's legendary structural grip, focus, and classicism.

title: Laphroaig 30 Year Old
bodyHtml:
From Scotland’s famed Isle of Islay comes Laphroaig, a distillery established in 1815 on the island’s southern coast. Known for its powerful and uncompromisingly peated style, Laphroaig has earned a place among the world’s most distinctive single malts. Over its two centuries of production, the distillery has remained committed to traditional methods, crafting whiskies that embody the maritime climate, rugged landscape, and the bold spirit of Islay. The 30 Year Old expression represents the pinnacle of Laphroaig’s artistry, the result of three decades of patient maturation in carefully selected casks.

Wine Description
The Laphroaig 30 Year Old displays a glowing amber colour, developed over decades in American oak barrels and European oak sherry casks. The nose opens with a refined complexity, interlacing rich dried fruits, honeyed malt, and citrus zest with the distillery’s hallmark medicinal peat and delicate iodine. Subtle layers of cedarwood, tobacco, and sea spray add further intrigue. On the palate, the whisky is silken yet robust, offering flavours of orchard fruit, dark chocolate, and savoury cured meats, all wrapped in smoky, herbal depth. The body is exceptionally balanced, with sweetness, spice, and peat in perfect harmony. The finish is long and graceful, carrying sweet spice, maritime salinity, and a fading wisp of warm peat smoke.

Food Pairing
Ideal alongside smoked venison, seared scallops, or rich duck confit, where the dish’s savoury richness complements the whisky’s deep complexity and subtle sweetness. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Merryvale Profile Mixed Pack (2013, 2014, 2015) - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Established in 1983 as the first winery built in Napa Valley following the repeal of Prohibition, Merryvale Vineyards occupies a central position in modern California winemaking history. Located in St. Helena, the estate was purchased in 1996 by the Schlatter family, who invested heavily in establishing their flagship crown jewel: the Profile Estate Vineyard. Planted in 1997 with guidance from legendary viticulturist David Abreu and consulting oenologist Michel Rolland, this 25-acre ridge vineyard sits at 800 feet elevation on steep volcanic and clay soils. Under winemaker Andrew Wright, Merryvale focuses on small-lot, parcel-by-parcel fermentations, native yeasts, and extensive French oak maturation to produce cellar-worthy Cabernet Sauvignon blends defined by concentration, mineral tension, and hillside power.

2013 :

Marked by ideal warm conditions and dry weather, 2013 produced an opaque, tightly wound wine packed with brooding cassis, crushed graphite, and dense, structured tannins built for long-term cellaring.

  • Wine Advocate: 92+ Points

  • James Suckling: 93 Points

  • Vinous: 93 Points

  • Wine Spectator: 91 Points

  • Wine Enthusiast: 93 Points

2014 :

A steady, temperate season yielded an expressive, harmonious profile featuring plush plum, sweet cacao, violet aromatics, and seamless, velvety tannins.

  • Wine Advocate: 94 Points

  • James Suckling: 93 Points

  • Vinous: 92 Points

  • Wine Spectator: 93 Points

  • Wine Enthusiast: 92 Points

2015 :

Low yields from a cool bloom resulted in small, intense berries. The resulting wine is rich, fruit-forward, and expansive, bursting with dark cherry jam, mocha, and toasted oak spice.

  • Wine Advocate: 93 Points

  • James Suckling: 93 Points

  • Vinous: 92 Points

  • Wine Spectator: 90 Points

  • Wine Enthusiast: 92 Points

title: Cedar Creek Crafted In BC Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
CedarCreek Crafted In BC Chardonnay is a unique white wine from the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia, Canada, produced under a special regulatory exemption.
