Owned and operated by Symington Family Estates, the winery's philosophy focuses on capturing the distinct microclimate of this flagship property, utilizing traditional stone lagar foot treading and meticulous barrel maturation to craft concentrated, rich, and age-worthy Vintage Ports.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, opaque dark ruby garnet colour with brilliant violet reflections along the rim. An expressive and complex bouquet opens with signature aromas of eucalyptus, fresh mint, and wild blackberry, interwoven with rich notes of dark chocolate, candied orange zest, licorice, and dark cherry. On the palate, it is full bodied, dense, and powerfully structured, delivering opulent flavours of ripe cassis, dark plum, and cacao, all supported by a vibrant core of natural freshness. Framed by muscular, chewy tannins and an undercurrent of slatey minerality, it concludes with a remarkably long, velvety, and generous finish. Composed of a traditional blend of Touriga Franca, Touriga Nacional, and Sousao, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2055+. Stylistically, it combines classic Graham's hallmark richness and sweet black fruit depth with polished structure and vibrant herbaceous freshness.

title: Graham's Vintage Port 1994
bodyHtml:
Originating from Portugal in the famous Douro region, specifically within the rugged Cima Corgo subregion, Graham's Vintage Port 1994 represents an iconic, legendary expression from one of the greatest Vintage Port declarations of the twentieth century. Founded in 1820 by brothers William and John Graham, the house of Graham's has long been celebrated for producing rich, generous, and long-lived Vintage Ports. Owned and operated by Symington Family Estates, the estate’s winemaking philosophy relies on hand-harvesting old vine plots from flagship properties including Quinta dos Malvedos and Quinta das Lages, utilizing traditional stone lagar foot treading to produce muscular, deeply concentrated wines built for decades of bottle maturation.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, dark ruby garnet colour with subtle tawny orange reflections along the rim. An extraordinary and complex bouquet opens with rich aromas of dark plum, cassis, and dried fig, interwoven with sophisticated notes of dark chocolate, eucalyptus, roasted coffee, pipe tobacco, and exotic baking spices. On the palate, it is full bodied, opulent, and deeply layered, delivering a velvety, mouth-coating texture packed with concentrated flavours of black cherry, prune, and dark cocoa supported by a spine of vibrant natural acidity. Framed by mature, smooth, yet powerful tannins and a firm mineral backbone, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, rich, and harmonious finish. Composed of a classic Douro blend of Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Barroca, and Tinta Roriz, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2024–2050+. Stylistically, it combines Graham’s signature opulent sweetness and dark fruit concentration with magnificent structural elegance and mature tertiary complexity.

title: Graham's Vintage Port 'Library Release' 2003
bodyHtml:
Originating from Portugal in the famous Douro region, specifically within the rugged Cima Corgo subregion, Graham's Vintage Port 'Library Release' 2003 represents a classic, cellared expression from an iconic, heat-driven vintage. Founded in 1820 by brothers William and John Graham, the house is owned and operated by Symington Family Estates. The winery's philosophy centers on sourcing fruit from flagship estates including Quinta dos Malvedos, Quinta das Lages, and Quinta do Tua, utilizing stone lagar foot treading to produce lush, powerful Vintage Ports that are held in optimal cellar conditions for late 'Library' releases to showcase mature tertiary complexity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a dark ruby garnet colour with subtle tawny reflections along the rim. An expressive and concentrated bouquet opens with rich aromas of baked black cherry, dark plum, and fig paste, interwoven with sophisticated notes of dark chocolate, licorice, eucalyptus, roasted coffee, and warm baking spices. On the palate, it is full bodied, voluptuous, and deeply layered, delivering a mouth-coating texture packed with sweet black fruit, cocoa bean, and molasses, all supported by a underlying core of natural acidity. Framed by mature, smooth, yet powerful tannins and a firm schist backbone, it concludes with a long, warm, and persistent finish. Composed of a classic Douro blend of Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Barroca, and Tinta Roriz, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2024–2045+. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Graham's signature opulent sweetness and dark fruit concentration with mature, seamless balance.

title: Vilmos Pear Brandy - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This pear spirit originates from Hungary, produced in the Kecskemét region by Zwack, Hungary's historic producer famous for Unicum. Launched in the late 20th century to offer an approachable, fruit-forward alternative to classic pálinka, Vilmos is crafted by blending authentic Williams pear distillate (Vilmoskörte pálinka) with high-quality neutral spirit and natural pear aromas, resulting in a smooth, accessible pear-flavoured spirit.

Spirit Description

This spirit presents a bright, golden straw color with subtle warm highlights in the glass. The nose is intense and immediately aromatic, opening with a burst of ripe Williams pear, fresh orchard fruit blossoms, and sweet honeyed notes. On the palate, it is light to medium-bodied with a soft, rounded mouthfeel, offering luscious flavors of juicy Williams pear flesh, poached fruit sweetness, and delicate floral accents, balanced by a gentle warmth. The finish is clean, smooth, and pleasantly sweet, leaving a lingering trail of fresh pear skin and light fruit spice. Bottled at an approachable strength of 37.5% ABV, it delivers a vibrant, smooth, and highly aromatic profile.

Accolades

Vilmos is one of Hungary's most popular commercial spirits, widely celebrated throughout Central and Eastern Europe for its consistent quality and approachable flavor profile. Produced by the legendary Zwack distillery, it holds a beloved position in Hungarian hospitality and casual dining culture as a staple fruit-forward digestive spirit.

title: Ol' Beautiful Brass Mokey Blood Orange Blonde Ale  - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Brass Monkey is the ultimate patio-slayer from Calgary’s Ol’ Beautiful Brewing Co. Known for their gritty, community-first taproom vibe in historic Inglewood and a knack for brewing effortlessly cool beers, Ol' Beautiful created this Fruit-Infused Blonde Ale as a direct ode to laid-back social drinking. Combining a light, crisp craft beer structure with real fruit integration, Brass Monkey completely skips the artificial syrupiness of commercial fruit beers, landing a perfect balance of zesty citrus acidity and crisp malt refreshment.

Beer Description

Brass Monkey pours a brilliant, glowing golden-amber color with a distinct, soft ruby-pink haze, topped with a frothy, light-pinkish foam head that leaves a delicate ring around the glass.

Aroma: The nose is extraordinarily bright, zesty, and inviting. It opens with an immediate burst of fresh blood orange flesh and tart grapefruit zest, supported by a clean, subtle base of light pilsner malt. The hop profile introduces a subtle, complementary note of Mandarina Bavaria citrus.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a brisk, effervescent, and tongue-tingling carbonation. It leads with a splash of tangy, organic blood orange puree, delivering an authentic orange-juice tartness rather than cloying sweetness. The middle reveals a clean cracker-malt backbone that grounds the fruit, finishing fast, dry, and crisp with a subtle citrus pith bitterness.

Profile: It sits at an ultra-sessionable 4.0% ABV and a low bitterness of approx. 12–15 IBU, prioritizing fruit-forward brightness and ultimate crushability.

Technical Notes: The execution of Brass Monkey relies on pairing a traditional American Blonde Ale base with high-quality ingredients. It is brewed with 100% Alberta pale malts and dry-hopped with Mandarina Bavaria hops a variety famous for its distinct tangerine aromatics. During secondary processing, a generous addition of organic blood orange puree is blended into the liquid. The yeast ferments out clean, leaving the tart acidity and natural crimson pigments of the fruit intact without piling on heavy residual sugars.

title: Beaux Freres Pinot Noir 'The Beaux Freres Vineyard' 2021
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in Oregon’s Willamette Valley, specifically within the prestigious Ribbon Ridge AVA, Beaux Freres Pinot Noir 'The Beaux Freres Vineyard' 2021 represents a benchmark expression of estate-grown Oregonian winemaking. Founded in 1988 by Michael Etzel and his brother-in-law, critic Robert Parker Jr., Beaux Freres is renowned for its early adoption of biodynamic farming and minimal intervention principles. The estate’s winemaking philosophy relies on un-grafted, high-density vineyard plantings, indigenous yeast fermentations, and meticulous French oak barrel aging to produce deep, site-specific Pinot Noirs of power, complexity, and age-worthy grace.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, medium ruby garnet colour with subtle violet reflections in the glass. An expressive and multifaceted bouquet opens with vibrant aromas of dark raspberry, wild red plum, and black cherry, interwoven with alluring notes of forest floor, damp earth, crushed violet, pipe tobacco, and subtle exotic oak spice. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied, silky, and deeply layered, delivering concentrated flavours of black raspberry, pomegranate, and dark cocoa supported by a spine of lively, refreshing natural acidity. Framed by fine-grained, velvety tannins and an undercurrent of fine stone minerality, it concludes with a long, harmonious, and persistent finish. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir sourced entirely from the estate's original 1988 plantings on Willakenzie marine sedimentary soils, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2024–2038. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Oregonian fruit intensity and texture with classical Burgundian earthiness and structural elegance.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include pan-seared duck breast with cherry reduction, roasted rack of lamb, wild mushroom risotto, or cedar-plank grilled salmon. 'Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.'

title: Ancnoc 16 Year Old Single Malt Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, produced in the Highland region. Crafted at the historic Knockdhu Distillery—established in 1894 in the village of Knock, Banffshire—the brand rebranded its whiskies as "anCnoc" to avoid confusion with the neighboring Knockando distillery. This expression is aged for a minimum of 16 years exclusively in American oak ex-bourbon casks, allowing the distillery's light, fresh, and floral spirit character to interact deeply with vanilla and oak influences.

Spirit Description

This single malt presents a bright, golden straw color in the glass. The nose is fresh, inviting, and complex, opening with vibrant notes of crisp green apples, lemon zest, and sweet floral heather, balanced by warm vanilla, coconut, and gentle honeyed malt. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with a soft, silky mouthfeel that delivers flavours of orchard fruits, candied citrus peel, sweet cream, and vanilla fudge, underscored by subtle oak spice and a hint of white pepper. The finish is long, smooth, and dry, leaving a lingering impression of sweet malt, citrus oil, and warm wood spice. Bottled at an elevated strength of 46% ABV without chill-filtration or added caramel coloring, it displays outstanding natural purity, texture, and spirit balance.

title: Akvavit Traditions 1855 Bornholmer - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This traditional aquavit originates from Denmark, produced on the Baltic island of Bornholm by De Bornholmske Spritfabrikker. The distillery honors recipes dating back to 1855, capturing the rich heritage of Danish snaps production. Crafted from neutral grain spirit infused with classic Scandinavian botanicals, this expression reflects the historic style of island distillation that has been enjoyed across Nordic tables for over a century and a half.

Spirit Description

This aquavit displays a pale straw gold to bright amber tint in the glass. The nose opens with a sharp, highly aromatic blast of intense caraway seed and aromatic dill, followed by subtle undertones of anise, dried citrus peel, and gentle earthiness. On the palate, it is light to medium-bodied with a crisp, dry texture. Dominant flavours of warm caraway and herbaceous dill take center stage, supported by soft hints of lemon zest, fennel, and light pepper spice. The finish is clean, warm, and lingering, leaving a dry, refreshing trail of savory spice and herbal oils. Bottled at an ABV of 42%, it offers a robust, traditional, and palate-cleansing profile.

Accolades

Akvavit Traditions 1855 Bornholmer is widely regarded across Scandinavia as a classic benchmark of traditional Danish snaps production. Celebrated by spirit enthusiasts and culinary traditionalists alike, it frequently receives high ratings in Nordic spirit guides for its authentic botanical balance and historical craft integrity.

title: Copper In The Clouds Marmalade Gin - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This craft distilled gin originates from England, produced in the Hertfordshire region. Handcrafted by Master Distiller James Glen at the independent, eco-conscious Copper In The Clouds distillery—housed inside a converted grain store surrounded by farmland—this spirit is created using small-batch copper pot distillation. The expression is made by infusing traditional London dry gin botanicals with fresh citrus and real Seville orange marmalade.

Spirit Description

This gin presents a soft, luminous golden amber hue in the glass. The nose is vibrant and highly aromatic, opening with rich aromas of bittersweet Seville orange, orange blossom, and fresh marmalade, supported by piney juniper and warm coriander. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with a smooth, slightly rounded texture, delivering flavours of tangy citrus zest, caramelized orange peel, and subtle baking spices balanced by dry juniper and earthy angelica root. The finish is crisp, warming, and clean, leaving a lingering trail of bittersweet citrus oils and gentle botanical spice. Bottled at an ABV of 40%, it offers a balanced, aromatic, and citrus-forward profile.

title: Satvrnal Gin N.4
bodyHtml:
This artisanal New Western-style gin originates from Mexico, produced in the Jalisco region. Crafted by the independent distillery Satvrnal—founded by Jorge Nájera and Pedro Andrés—in Zapopan (Guadalajara), the brand bridges Mexican distilling craft with modern botanical experimentation. Distilled in small batches, Expression N.4 combines traditional juniper with Mexican herbs, citrus, and spices to highlight local terroir.

Spirit Description

This gin presents a crystal-clear, bright appearance in the glass. The nose opens with direct, spicy notes of piney juniper, green pepper, fresh-cut grass, and floral undertones of lavender, balanced by bright citrus. On the palate, it is clean and refreshing, featuring a burst of fresh floral notes, cracked black pepper, bright citrus zest, and resinous juniper. The finish is striking, dry, and lively, leaving lingering citrus oils and warm botanical spice. Bottled at a higher strength of 47% ABV, it offers a bold, crisp, and well-balanced profile.

Accolades

Satvrnal Gin releases have earned widespread appreciation among craft spirit enthusiasts and agave collectors for their distinctive Mexican botanical profiles and innovative single-cask rests (including tequila barrel finishes). The brand is celebrated as a leading pioneer in the rising Mexican craft gin movement.

title: Cava Murviedro Brut Nature
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' sparkling wine originates from Spain, within the esteemed Cava D.O. appellation in the Requena sub-region (Valencia). Produced by Bodegas Murviedro a historic estate established in 1927 as the Spanish subsidiary of the Swiss Schenk Group Cava Murviedro Brut Nature highlights the unique high-altitude terroir of inland Valencia. Sourced from choice, sustainably farmed vineyards situated between 600 and 900 meters above sea level, the vines are rooted in nutrient-poor limestone, gravelly clay, and sandy soils. The region's continental-Mediterranean microclimate features intense daytime sunshine balanced by cool nightly mountain breezes, enabling classic white grape varieties to achieve full phenolic maturity while retaining a sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Cava Murviedro Brut Nature presents a luminous, pale straw-gold color in the glass with bright greenish-silver highlights and an exceptionally fine, persistent stream of energetic bubbles (mousse). Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an elegant, bone-dry, and precisely focused portrait of high-altitude Spanish sparkling wine. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of green apple, yellow lemon zest, and crisp white peach, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of freshly baked bread, toasted almond, orange blossom, and a distinct line of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard fruit, lemon peel, and creamy autolytic warmth. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate texture. The mouthfeel is weightless, supple, and creamy, carrying into an extraordinarily long, bone-dry, and mineral-driven finish free of added dosage sugars.

title: Amatitena Barrancas Tequila Blanco - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Amatiteña Barrancas Tequila Blanco is an ultra-traditional, artisanal 100% Blue Weber agave spirit produced in Amatitán, within the Lowlands (Valles) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at NOM 1477 (Tequila Selecto de Amatitán) under the guidance of Master Distiller Alberto Partida, Amatiteña is dedicated to preserving ancestral tequila-making techniques that predate industrialization. The "Barrancas" release celebrates the unique microclimate and mineral-rich soils of the ravines (barrancas) surrounding Amatitán, delivering an unadulterated, high-proof, and deeply smoky Lowland agave experience.

Spirit Description

Amatiteña Barrancas Blanco is crafted from fully mature, estate-grown agave piñas harvested from the low-lying ravine areas of Amatitán. In stark contrast to modern industrial tequilas, the agaves are cooked in traditional wood-fired brick ovens (hornos) using mesquite and oak wood, imparting a distinct, subtle smoky character. The cooked agaves are crushed entirely using a heavy volcanic stone tahona wheel pulled by a tractor. Fermentation takes place in open-air wooden vats using wild airborne yeasts with agave fibers (bagazo) included in the wash, followed by double distillation in small copper pot stills. Unaged and bottled additive-free, it bridges classic Lowland earthiness with artisanal wood-smoke complexity.

  • Colour: Crystal clear with luminous silver reflections and thick, slow legs in the glass.

  • Aroma: Intensely aromatic, earthy, and rustic. Opens with sweet cooked agave, damp earth, and mesquite wood smoke, followed by green pepper, lime zest, black pepper, and a subtle herbal brine.

  • Palate: Bold, rich, and full-flavored on the entry. Strong upfront notes of sweet roasted agave, soft wood smoke, and olive brine give way to mineral-rich earth, crushed black pepper, and bright citrus peel.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a viscous, rich, and mouth-coating texture.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and lingering, trailing off with persistent roasted agave, dry mesquite smoke, cracked pepper, and a clean mineral snap.

  • ABV: Typically bottled at a higher strength (around 42% to 49% ABV / 84 to 98 Proof, depending on the specific batch release).

title: Louis Latour Mercurey 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from France, within the prestigious Mercurey A.O.C. appellation of the Côte Chalonnaise sub-region in southern Burgundy. Maison Louis Latour, one of Burgundy's most iconic and historic négociant-éleveurs founded in 1797, has long championed the exceptional terroir of the Côte Chalonnaise. Mercurey, the largest producing appellation in the region, is famous for yielding robust, red-fruit-driven Pinot Noir with excellent structural frame and aging potential. Sourced from choice vineyard plots situated on limestone-rich slopes at elevations between 230 and 300 meters above sea level, the vines are rooted in deep Oxfordian clay-limestone and iron-rich gravel soils. The continental microclimate features warm, sunny days balanced by cool evening breezes, allowing Pinot Noir to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining a sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Louis Latour Mercurey presents a luminous, ruby-garnet color in the glass with vivid crimson highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an elegant, expressive, and fruit-driven portrait of Côte Chalonnaise terroir. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh red cherries, wild forest strawberries, and ripe red plums, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of dried rose petals, subtle earthy brushwood, white pepper, and a subtle line of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy red stone fruits, blood orange peel, and subtle earthy spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is supple, broad, and weightless, framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins that glide into a clean, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of cherry skin, forest floor, and subtle oak.

title: Domaine Anne F. Gros Vosne Romanee 'Les Chalandins' 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from France, within the esteemed Vosne-Romanée A.O.C. appellation of the Côte de Nuits sub-region in northern Burgundy. Domaine Anne F. Gros, led by Anne Gros and her children (Julie, Anne-Lise, and Paul Tremblay), is celebrated worldwide for producing Burgundies of supreme aromatic finesse, pure fruit expression, and terroir transparency. Sourced from the single lieu-dit 'Les Chalandins' situated on the lower slope directly below the famous Clos de Vougeot and Grand Rue Grand Crus the old vines are rooted in deep, clay-limestone soils rich in alluvial gravel and iron-rich silt. The continental microclimate features warm summer sunshine balanced by cooling breezes flowing down from the Combe de Concois, allowing Pinot Noir to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining a sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The 2024 Domaine Anne F. Gros Vosne-Romanée 'Les Chalandins' presents a luminous, deep crimson-ruby color in the glass with vivid magenta highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an elegant, floral, and precisely focused portrait of Vosne-Romanée terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of wild forest strawberries, dark raspberries, and black cherries, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of dried rose petals, violets, subtle exotic spices, damp earth, and a distinct line of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of crunchy red stone fruits, blood orange peel, and subtle earthy spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, silky, and weightless, framed by ultra-fine, chalky tannins that glide into a long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of cherry skin, forest floor, and delicate French oak.

This high-definition Burgundian expression is 100% Pinot Noir, harvested meticulously by hand from low-yielding, old-vine blocks with rigorous cluster sorting in both vineyard and cellar. Following 100% destemming to preserve pure silkiness, the fruit underwent cold pre-fermentation maceration in temperature-controlled vats, followed by traditional fermentation with daily gentle punch-downs (pigeage) and pump-overs. To polish its structural frame while framing its pristine fruit purity, the wine completed malolactic conversion and was matured for 16 to 18 months in French oak barrels (approximately 30% to 50% new oak). It reaches an effortlessly integrated, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of 13.0% to 13.5% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 growing season across Burgundy and the Côte de Nuits featured a cool, wet spring followed by a warm, sun-drenched late summer and crisp, dry autumn days. This late-season extended ripening window allowed Pinot Noir grapes to achieve ideal phenolic maturity, accumulating rich skin flavor while locking in vibrant natural malic and tartaric acids. Domaine Anne F. Gros harvested pristine, healthy fruit at peak balance. The resulting 2024 Vosne-Romanée 'Les Chalandins' combines high-energy fruit purity with classic Burgundian structural restraint, built to evolve and improve gracefully in a cellar over the next 10 to 20 years.

title: Cometesse De Malet Roquefort Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from France, within the prestigious Bordeaux Blanc A.O.C. appellation. Produced by the historic Malet Roquefort family celebrated owners of Premier Grand Cru Classé Château La Gaffelière in Saint-Émilion the Comtesse de Malet Roquefort Blanc reflects centuries of winemaking tradition applied to classic white Bordeaux varieties. Sourced from choice vineyard plots across the right bank and broader Bordeaux region, the vines are rooted in clay-limestone and gravelly alluvial soils. The maritime-influenced microclimate features warm, sun-drenched summer days moderated by Atlantic breezes, allowing Sauvignon Blanc and Semillon to achieve ideal phenolic ripeness while retaining a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Comtesse de Malet Roquefort Blanc presents a luminous, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with vivid chartreuse and silver reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, fruit-driven, and precisely focused portrayal of modern Bordeaux Blanc. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of pink grapefruit, lemongrass, and green gooseberry, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of white peach, passionfruit, crushed chalk minerality, and a delicate touch of fresh boxwood. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy citrus, lemon curd, and white nectarine. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate fruit extract. The mouthfeel is broad yet linear and supple, gliding into a long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of lime zest and flint.

title: Upperhand Gin
bodyHtml:
This distilled gin originates from Ireland, produced in the Tipperary region. Created by Alberto Borin and crafted at the historic Ballykeefe Distillery, the brand was inspired by the determination and rebellious spirit of early 20th-century icon Mario Borin. The spirit is produced using traditional copper pot distillation, blending fine Irish grain spirit with a select combination of four key botanicals.

Spirit Description

This gin displays a crystal-clear, brilliant appearance in the glass. The nose is fresh and intensely aromatic, opening with vibrant notes of Italian Tuscan juniper, zesty lemon peel, and fresh basil, supported by a gentle warmth of dill. On the palate, it is light to medium-bodied with a smooth, crisp texture, offering prominent flavours of piney juniper and bright citrus zest balanced by savoury herbal notes of sweet basil and aromatic dill. The finish is clean, dry, and refreshing, leaving a lingering impression of citrus oils and fresh herbs. Bottled at an ABV of 40%, it delivers an exceptionally well-balanced, crisp, and herbaceous profile.

Accolades

Upperhand Gin has received high recognition in international spirits competitions, including a Gold Medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition and a Gold Medal at the World Gin Awards. It is widely celebrated for its minimalist four-botanical recipe and smooth distillation quality.

title: J.Rose London Dry Gin - Manara - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This London dry gin originates from Italy, produced in the Apulia region. J.Rose Gin is crafted using traditional copper pot stills and a selection of nine botanicals, featuring wild oak bark, bergamot, and cardamom. Celebrated for its unique packaging, the bottle is wrapped in a handcrafted, eco-sustainable canvas label designed by renowned Italian artist Milo Manara, with the 'Venera' expression showcasing an alluring artistic illustration.

Spirit Description

This gin presents a crystal-clear, luminous appearance in the glass. The nose opens with a vibrant citrus bouquet of fresh bergamot and mandarin peel, followed by piney juniper, warm cardamom, and subtle herbal nuances of wild oak. On the palate, it is light to medium-bodied with a crisp, well-structured mouthfeel, delivering dry flavours of juniper, coriander, citrus zest, and delicate warm spice. The finish is clean, dry, and persistent, leaving a refreshing trail of Mediterranean citrus oils and gentle botanical warmth. Bottled at an ABV of 43%, it offers a balanced, aromatic, and refined profile.

Accolades

J.Rose London Dry Gin has gained high international acclaim, including a Gold Medal at the World Gin Awards and notable recognition at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition. The brand is celebrated globally for combining artisanal Italian distilling standards with fine art aesthetics.

Food Pairing

The dry juniper structure and vibrant bergamot notes of this Italian gin make it a fantastic match for fresh seafood and light Mediterranean fare. Excellent food pairings include fresh oysters with a lemon squeeze, sea bass ceviche, prosciutto wrapped melon, goat cheese crostini, or salted Marcona almonds.
