title: Mission Hill Quatrain 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from Canada, within the prestigious Okanagan Valley A.O.C. in British Columbia. Crafted by Mission Hill Family Estate a historic benchmark producer founded in 1981 by Anthony von Mandl Quatrain represents one of the crown jewels of the estate's elite Legacy Collection. Sourced from choice, organic estate vineyard blocks situated in the south Okanagan sub-regions of Osoyoos and Oliver, the vines are rooted in nutrient-poor, gravelly, and sandy alluvial soils over deep glacial till. The microclimate features intense summer heat and high solar radiation balanced by cool evening mountain breezes, allowing late-ripening red Bordeaux varieties and Syrah to achieve complete phenolic maturity while locking in a vibrant, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The 2021 Mission Hill Quatrain presents a deep, opaque garnet-purple color in the glass with vivid crimson highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an elegant, intense, and precisely focused expression of south Okanagan terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crème de cassis, wild dark plums, crushed blackberries, and dark cherries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of black pepper, dried violet, dark chocolate, tobacco leaf, graphite, and a subtle line of toasted French oak spice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, muscular, and athletic, showcasing a succulent, power-packed core of black stone fruits, blood orange peel, and cocoa nibs. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the rich mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and linear, driven by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of cassis, iron, and subtle spice.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 growing season in the Okanagan Valley was a warm, historic vintage marked by a dry spring and intense summer heat, followed by warm, sunny autumn days and cool nighttime temperature drops. This allowed fruit to accumulate high flavor concentration and deep skin phenolics while preserving vital natural malic and tartaric acids. Mission Hill harvested pristine, low-yielding fruit at peak physiological balance. The resulting 2021 Legacy Quatrain combines generous Okanagan fruit density with classical structural restraint, built to evolve and improve gracefully in a cellar over the next 10 to 18+ years.

title: Cavit Collection Cloud 90 Pinot Grigio
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Italy, within the high-altitude, cool-climate foothills of Trentino, Veneto, and Friuli in Northern Italy. Produced by Cavit a celebrated cooperative winery founded in 1950 representing thousands of heritage family growers the 'Cloud 90' Pinot Grigio is a naturally low-calorie, low-alcohol expression designed for mindful drinking without sacrificing flavor. Sourced from choice hillside plots in the Vallagarina Valley and surrounding alpine regions, the vines are rooted in nutrient-poor gravelly, limestone, and sandy alluvial soils. The region's unique mesoclimate defined by intense high-elevation solar radiation during the day and cooling alpine breezes sweeping down from the Dolomites at night allows Pinot Grigio to develop crisp varietal aromatics while locking in a razor-sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Cavit Collection Cloud 90 Pinot Grigio presents a luminous, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with bright greenish-silver highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a crisp, light, and vibrant portrait of alpine Northern Italian white wine. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh green apple, crisp Williams pear, and Meyer lemon zest, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of white floral blossoms, citrus peel, and a subtle line of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard fruit, lemon-lime citrus, and subtle herbal nuances. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is weightless, athletic, and supple, carrying into a clean, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of lime peel, green apple skin, and flint.

title: Cavit Roscato Rose
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' sparkling wine originates from Italy, within the esteemed Lombardia region of Northern Italy. Produced by Cavit—a celebrated cooperative winery founded in 1950 in Trentino that represents thousands of smallholder viticulturists—the Roscato line has gained widespread international acclaim for its approachable, fruit-driven, and delightfully refreshing style. Sourced from choice, low-yielding vineyard plots planted along the gentle hillsides and alluvial river valleys of Northern Italy, the vines are rooted in nutrient-rich, gravelly clay and limestone soils. The region's cool alpine-influenced microclimate features bright, sunny days balanced by cold night breezes sweeping down from the nearby Dolomites and Alps. This strong diurnal temperature variation allows red grape varieties to build expressive wild berry aromatics while retaining a sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Cavit Roscato Rosé presents a luminous, pale coral-pink color in the glass with vivid peach and rose-gold highlights, propelled by a fine, persistent, and energetic stream of delicate bubbles (mousse). Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an inviting, aromatic, and fruit-forward portrait of Northern Italian sparkling wine. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of fresh wild strawberries, pink raspberries, and candied red cherries, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of orange blossom, white peach, pink grapefruit zest, and a subtle line of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy red berry fruits, citrus peel, and gentle sweetness. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly balances its delicate residual sugar. The mouthfeel is supple, creamy, and weightless, carrying into a clean, crisp finish accented by lingering notes of strawberry skin, watermelon, and lime zest.

title: Engine Organic Gin
bodyHtml:
This organic distilled gin originates from Italy, produced in the Piedmont region. Founded by fashion and motor sport entrepreneur Paolo Dalla Mora, the brand is famous for its unique motor oil tin packaging that pays tribute to 1980s automotive culture. Crafted at the Speakeasy Organic Distillery, the spirit is produced using 100% organic, handpicked Italian botanicals sourced from small farms across the country.

Spirit Description

This gin displays a bright, crystal clear appearance in the glass. The aroma is highly aromatic and fresh, opening with bold notes of sage, lemon peel, and Damask rose, supported by piney juniper and warm licorice root. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied with a crisp and remarkably clean mouthfeel. Dominant flavours of zesty lemon and mountain sage take center stage, balanced by classic juniper, soft floral rose notes, and a touch of sweet licorice spice. The finish is crisp, dry, and refreshing, leaving a lingering trail of citrus oils and savoury sage. Bottled at an ABV of 40%, it offers an exceptionally well balanced, herbaceous, and vibrant profile.

Accolades

Engine Gin Organic has achieved widespread international recognition, including a Gold Medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition and a Gold Medal at the World Gin Awards. It was also named Organic Gin of the Year by the Spirits Business Gin Masters, earning praise for both its sustainable organic distillation and striking industrial design.

title: Buffalo Trace Bourbon
bodyHtml:
This straight bourbon whiskey originates from the United States, produced in the Kentucky region. The historic Buffalo Trace Distillery in Frankfort, Kentucky, is one of the oldest continuously operating distilleries in America, surviving both Prohibition and major historical events. Owned by the Sazerac Company, the distillery crafts its flagship expression using a proprietary low-rye mash bill before aging the spirit in new, deeply charred oak barrels within traditional brick rackhouses.

Spirit Description

This bourbon presents a rich amber bronze colour in the glass. The nose is complex and inviting, opening with aromas of sweet vanilla, mint, and rich molasses, accompanied by subtle undertones of brown sugar, candied fruit, and warm oak spice. On the palate, it delivers a full body with a smooth, viscous texture, offering flavours of dark caramel, toasted oak, toffee, and ripe dark berries balanced by cinnamon and white pepper spice. The finish is long, warm, and dry, leaving a lingering trail of sweet oak, vanilla, and gentle baking spices. Bottled at an ABV of 45%, it exhibits exceptional balance, richness, and classic Kentucky bourbon character.

title: Chateau des Annereaux Les Annereaux Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This certified organic dry white wine originates from France, produced by the historic Château des Annereaux on the Right Bank of the Bordeaux region. Situated in the Lalande-de-Pomerol area, the estate has belonged to the same family for over six centuries, dating back to the 14th century. Managed today by Benjamin Hessel, the property converted fully to certified organic agriculture (Ecocert) in 2007. While the château is primarily famed for its red Lalande-de-Pomerol wines, their small-production Bordeaux Blanc cuvée (L'L's des Annereaux / Les Annereaux) reflects a commitment to biodiverse farming and low-intervention winemaking, harnessing the gravelly alluvial soils near the Isle River to create a vibrant, expressive white wine.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2024 vintage presents a bright pale yellow color with sparkling greenish highlights. The expressive nose opens with lively aromas of citrus zest, crisp green apple, white peach, and grapefruit, accompanied by herbal nuances of crushed boxwood leaves, lemongrass, and subtle wet stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, precise, and crisp. A vibrant streak of high natural acidity drives the entry, giving way to a smooth mid-palate and a clean, refreshing, saline-tinged finish. Typically crafted from a blend dominated by Sauvignon Blanc with a smaller proportion of Semillon (and occasionally Sauvignon Gris), the hand-harvested organic grapes undergo gentle pneumatic pressing and cool fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats. The wine is aged on its fine lees without oak influence to maintain its energetic fruit purity. The alcohol by volume typically sits around 12.5% to 13.0%.

Food Pairing

The crisp citrus drive, bright acidity, and refreshing energy of this organic white Bordeaux make it a versatile pairing for seafood, goat cheese, and light summer dishes. Excellent culinary partners include fresh oysters on the half shell, grilled sea bass with lemon-herb butter, shrimp ceviche, tuna carpaccio, and seared scallops. It also pairs wonderfully with classic goat milk cheeses like Crottin de Chavignol, fresh salads with lemon vinaigrette, and asparagus risotto.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 growing season in Bordeaux yielded classic cool-climate proportions for dry white wines, characterized by moderate temperatures and balanced rainfall that preserved elevated natural acidity and vivid fruit aromatics. Grown in organically managed soils, the grapes achieved balanced maturity while maintaining exceptional freshness and tension. The 2024 Château des Annereaux Blanc offers immediate charm, bright citrus intensity, and mouthwatering refreshment, best enjoyed in its youth over the next 2 to 4 years.

title: Blue Grouse Rose Charme De L'Ile
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada in the British Columbia region, specifically within the Vancouver Island subregion, Blue Grouse Rose Charme de l'Ile represents a refreshing expression of coastal sparkling rose. Situated in the Cowichan Valley, Blue Grouse Estate Winery is one of Vancouver Island’s pioneering vineyards, committed to organic farming and eco-friendly winemaking. The estate’s philosophy centers on crafting pure, site-driven wines that celebrate the unique maritime climate and gravelly glacial soils of the region.

Wine Description

The wine displays a delicate salmon pink colour with an energetic, fine mousse. An aromatic and inviting nose reveals vibrant aromas of wild strawberry, fresh cranberry, and pink grapefruit, layered with subtle notes of watermelon, rose petal, and wet stone minerality. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, dry, and crisp, offering juicy flavours of red berries and tart rhubarb balanced by a lively core of natural acidity.

title: Blue Grouse White Blend Charme De L'Ile
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada in the British Columbia region, specifically within the Vancouver Island subregion, Blue Grouse Charme de l'Ile White represents an authentic expression of cool-climate coastal sparkling winemaking. Located in the warm Cowichan Valley, Blue Grouse Estate Winery is one of Vancouver Island’s founding wine properties, dedicated to sustainable viticulture and stewardship of the land. The winery’s philosophy focuses on crafting expressive, fresh wines that reflect the unique marine climate and glacial soils of the island.

Wine Description

The wine presents a pale straw yellow colour in the glass with a lively, fine-bubbled effervescence. An enticing bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of green apple, juicy pear, and lemon curd, accompanied by delicate nuances of white flowers and sea spray minerality. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, crisp, and refreshing, delivering vibrant flavours of citrus, white peach, and green fruit supported by a mouthwatering streak of natural acidity.

title: Kourtaki Mavrodaphni of Patra
bodyHtml:
Originating from Greece in the Peloponnese region, specifically within the historic Patras PDO subregion, Kourtaki Mavrodaphne of Patras PDO is a classic fortified sweet red wine produced by Greek Wine Cellars. Founded in 1895 by Vassilis Kourtakis, the family-run enterprise played a pioneering role in modernizing Greek winemaking. The estate's philosophy centers on producing authentic, accessible expressions of indigenous Greek grape varieties using a combination of long-standing tradition and modern cellar techniques.

Wine Description

The wine shows a deep ruby red colour with slight tawny amber highlights. An intense and fragrant nose offers rich aromas of dried raisins, black currants, and dried figs, interwoven with hints of prune, brown sugar, leather, and subtle spice notes. On the palate, it is full bodied, unctuous, and rounded, showcasing luscious sweetness balanced by a velvety texture and an undercurrent of tart red fruit acidity. Aged in large oak casks using a solera method, this blend of Mavrodaphne and Black Corinth grapes delivers a long, sweet finish marked by notes of caramel and dried fruit. Stylistically, it combines sweet, raisin-driven intensity with smooth, oxidative complexity and rich warmth.

title: Dog Nose Peperoncino Liquore - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
This chili liqueur originates from Italy, produced in the Piedmont region. Crafted by the innovative Italian distillery Dog Nose, the brand is known for creating bold, botanical-driven spirits that blend traditional Italian herbal craft with modern mixology. This expression is produced by infusing fine neutral alcohol with crushed Italian hot red peppers ('peperoncino') alongside a blend of aromatic herbs and spices.

Spirit Description

This liqueur displays a vibrant, translucent fiery red colour in the glass. The nose is intense and spicy, opening with dominant aromas of fresh red chili pepper, roasted capsicum, and dried red pepper flakes, accompanied by subtle undertones of sweet herbal citrus and light cinnamon. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied with an initial wave of honeyed, syrupy sweetness that quickly gives way to a warming, sharp, and persistent chili spice. The vibrant heat of the peperoncino coats the mouth, balanced by underlying hints of citrus peel and subtle botanical sweetness. The finish is long, dry, and distinctly hot, leaving a lasting, tingling warmth on the palate.

title: Blackbull 18 Year Old Nick Faldo Collection
bodyHtml:
This blended scotch whisky originates from Scotland. First created in 1864, the Black Bull brand is produced by independent bottler Duncan Taylor, based in Huntly, Aberdeenshire. This special expression was developed in collaboration with legendary English professional golfer Sir Nick Faldo as part of the Sir Nick Faldo Signature Collection. It features a high malt-to-grain ratio of 50% single malt and 50% single grain whiskies, all aged for a minimum of 18 years in selected oak casks.

Spirit Description

This expression presents a rich, polished amber colour in the glass. The nose is lush and inviting, opening with fragrant notes of ripe dark cherries, dried fruit, fruitcake, and vanilla, accompanied by underlying hints of toasted oak, orange peel, and gentle baking spices. On the palate, it delivers a full body with a smooth, velvety texture, offering flavours of caramelized apples, dried raisins, dark chocolate, and sweet honey, balanced by oak tannins and soft pepper spice. The finish is long, warm, and satisfying, leaving a lingering trail of dried fruit, sweet malt, and gentle wood spice. Bottled at a robust strength of 50% ABV without chill filtration, it exhibits impressive depth, complexity, and spirit balance.

Accolades

The Black Bull Nick Faldo Collection 18 Year Old has earned significant recognition, including a Gold Medal at the World Whiskies Awards. Furthermore, Duncan Taylor is internationally celebrated, having won Independent Bottler of the Year multiple times at the Icons of Whisky awards.

title: Almaviva 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from Chile in the renowned Maipo Valley region, specifically within the high elevation Puente Alto subregion, Almaviva 2023 represents a benchmark icon born of a historic joint venture. Established in 1997 through a groundbreaking partnership between Baron Philippe de Rothschild of Chateau Mouton Rothschild and Vina Concha y Toro, the estate was created to bring French winemaking savoir-faire to exceptional Chilean terroir. Under the direction of winemaker Michel Friou, Almaviva's philosophy centers on producing a single grand vin that harmonizes power, elegance, and distinct expression of place.

Wine Description

The wine displays an intense, deep, and opaque ruby red colour in the glass. A broad and complex nose opens with aromas of ripe cassis, wild strawberry, and blackberry, interwoven with subtle accents of dried herbs, tobacco, cedar, graphite, and exotic spices. On the palate, it exhibits outstanding amplitude and balance, delivering a lush, velvety mouthfeel packed with dark berry fruit, sweet cocoa, and mineral undertones supported by a lively, tensile spine of natural acidity. Full bodied yet remarkably refined, it finishes long and smooth with polished, well-integrated tannins and lingering spice notes. Composed of 74% Cabernet Sauvignon, 19% Carmenere, 5% Cabernet Franc, and 2% Petit Verdot, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2046. Stylistically, it combines generous fruit concentration and approachable roundness with traditional balance, freshness, and structural finesse.

title: Don Adriano Chocolate Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
This infused reposado tequila originates from Mexico, produced in the Jalisco region. Don Adriano was established to combine traditional Mexican agave crafting with rich, indulgent flavor infusions. The expression starts with aged reposado tequila made from 100% Blue Weber agave cooked in brick ovens, fermented, distilled, and aged in oak barrels before being infused with natural dark chocolate essence.

Spirit Description

This infused reposado presents a deep mahogany brown colour with warm copper highlights. The nose is rich and fragrant, opening with bold aromas of dark cocoa, roasted espresso beans, and sweet milk chocolate, layered over subtle notes of warm oak, vanilla, and sweet cooked agave. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied with a velvety, dessert-like mouthfeel, offering indulgent flavours of rich dark chocolate, toasted cocoa nibs, and caramel balanced by light oak spice and a hint of peppery agave. The finish is smooth, sweet, and lingering, leaving a comforting warmth of cocoa and light spice. Bottled at an ABV of 40%, it delivers an approachable, rich, and dessert-forward profile.

title: Kinross Gin - Pink - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This distilled gin originates from Spain, produced in the Catalonia region. Crafted by Teichenné Liquors, a family-owned distillery established in 1956 by Joan Teichenné, the Kinross range was created to offer a modern, fruit-forward interpretation of traditional gin. The spirit is produced using triple-distilled neutral grain alcohol, infused with classic botanicals alongside sweet strawberry and raspberry extracts to create a vibrant pink expression.

Spirit Description

This gin presents a delicate, light rose pink colour in the glass. The nose is soft and sweetly aromatic, opening with dominant notes of ripe strawberries, wild raspberries, and sweet candy fruit, supported by subtle underlying hints of piney juniper, coriander, and zesty citrus peel. On the palate, it is light-bodied with a smooth, approachable sweetness that delivers juicy flavours of fresh red berries, wild strawberry jam, and soft herbal accents. The finish is short, clean, and sweet, leaving behind a lingering taste of fresh strawberries and gentle spice. Bottled at an ABV of 37.5%, it offers a refreshing, easy-drinking, and highly aromatic profile.

Accolades

Kinross Gin - Pink has earned international appreciation among flavored gin enthusiasts and spirits reviewers for its approachable fruit profile. Teichenné Liquors continues to hold a strong reputation across Europe for its dedication to quality distillation, versatility in mixology, and flavored spirit innovation.

title: Kinross Gin - Citric & Dry - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This distilled gin originates from Spain, produced in the Catalonia region. Crafted by Teichenné Liquors, a family-owned distillery established in 1956 by Joan Teichenné, the Kinross lineup was created to offer a modern, botanical-focused interpretation of traditional gin. The spirit is produced using triple-distilled neutral grain alcohol, infused with classic botanicals alongside a distinct selection of zesty Mediterranean citrus fruits.

Spirit Description

This gin displays a bright, crystal-clear appearance in the glass. The aroma is crisp and vibrant, dominated by pronounced notes of zesty lemon, bitter orange peel, and fresh grapefruit, supported by piney juniper, coriander, and subtle floral undertones. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied with a dry, palate-cleansing texture that brings forward flavours of fresh citrus zest, tart lime, coriander, and earthy angelica root. The finish is crisp, long, and dry, leaving a refreshing trail of lingering citrus rind and delicate juniper spice. Bottled at an ABV of 40%, it delivers an exceptionally fresh, crisp, and well-balanced profile.

Accolades

Kinross Gin - Citric and Dry has earned recognition in international spirits competitions for its clean structure and classic citrus balance, including a Gold Medal at the World Gin Awards. Teichenné Liquors continues to receive high praise across Europe for its dedication to quality distillation and flavor innovation.

title: Kinross Gin - Wild Berry Fruits - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This distilled gin originates from Spain, produced in the Catalonia region. Crafted by Teichenné Liquors, a family-owned distillery established in 1956 by Joan Teichenné, the Kinross range was created to offer a modern, fruit-forward interpretation of traditional gin. The spirit is produced using triple-distilled neutral grain alcohol, infused with classic botanicals alongside a vibrant selection of red forest berries.

Spirit Description

This gin presents a striking, deep ruby pink colour in the glass. The aroma is rich and highly aromatic, dominated by sweet notes of fresh raspberries, wild strawberries, blackberries, and blueberries, balanced by underlying hints of piney juniper and citrus zest. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied with an approachable sweetness that highlights flavours of ripe red berries, juicy currants, coriander, and subtle floral notes. The finish is smooth, sweet, and fruity, leaving a lingering impression of fresh berry preserves and gentle juniper spice. Bottled at an ABV of 40%, it offers an easy-drinking, vibrant, and well-balanced profile.

Accolades

Kinross Gin - Wild Berry Fruits has earned international recognition for its berry-forward profile, including medals at prestigious events such as the International Spirits Challenge. Teichenné Liquors is widely recognized across Europe for its excellence in craft liqueur and flavoured spirit innovation.

title: Kinross Gin - Tropical & Exotic Fruits - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This distilled gin originates from Spain, produced in the Catalonia region. Crafted by Teichenné Liquors, a family-owned distillery established in 1956 by Joan Teichenné, the Kinross range was created to offer a modern, fruit-forward interpretation of traditional gin. The spirit is produced using triple-distilled neutral grain alcohol infused with classic botanicals alongside a vibrant selection of tropical fruits.

Spirit Description

This gin presents a bright, vibrant amber-orange colour in the glass. The aroma is soft and intensely aromatic, dominated by sweet tropical notes of ripe mango, passion fruit, pineapple, and juicy maracuja, alongside fresh citrus peel and subtle undertones of piney juniper. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied with a smooth, approachable sweetness that highlights luscious tropical fruit flavours balanced by zesty grapefruit, coriander, and gentle spice. The finish is clean, fruity, and refreshing, leaving a lingering trail of citrus rind and exotic fruit essence.

Accolades

Kinross Gin - Tropical and Exotic Fruits has earned international recognition for its expressive flavor innovation, including a Silver Medal at the prestigious San Francisco World Spirits Competition. Furthermore, Teichenné Liquors is widely recognized across Europe for its excellence in craft liqueur and flavored spirit production.

title: Carruades De Lafite 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the iconic Bordeaux region, specifically within the prestigious Pauillac subregion, Carruades De Lafite 2023 is the renowned second wine of First Growth legend Chateau Lafite Rothschild. Dating back to the late 19th century, the wine takes its name from the Carruades plateau, a group of historic vineyard plots adjacent to the estate’s core holdings. Managed by Saskia de Rothschild and crafted by technical director Eric Kohler, the winemaking philosophy combines centuries of Medoc tradition with rigorous parcel selection, resulting in a expression that mirrors the refinement and aristocratically silky texture of the grand vin.

Wine Description

The wine shows a deep crimson ruby colour in the glass with bright purple glints. An ethereal, expressive bouquet opens with refined aromas of red and black currants, wild raspberries, and crushed blackberries, laced with nuances of pencil shavings, fresh violets, cedar box, and subtle graphite minerality. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, offering a seamless and energetic mouthfeel packed with fresh pit fruit, black tea, and discreet spice notes. Supported by a core of vibrant, mouthwatering acidity and framed by finely woven, polished tannins, it glides into a long, fragrant finish. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon blended with Merlot and small portions of Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2028–2048. Stylistically, it effortlessly displays classic Pauillac structure while emphasizing aromatic elegance, pure red fruit focus, and silky balance.

title: Poema Cava Brut
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' sparkling wine originates from Spain, within the esteemed Cava D.O. appellation in the heart of Catalonia. Crafted in the Penedès region the historic epicenter of Spanish sparkling winemaking Poema Cava Brut is produced using traditional method secondary fermentation in the bottle (Método Tradicional). Sourced from choice, sustainably farmed vineyards situated across the rolling chalk and limestone hills of Penedès, the vines are rooted in limestone-rich, gravelly clay soils. The Mediterranean microclimate features bright, sun-drenched days tempered by cool breezes from the Balearic Sea and nighttime air currents flowing down from the Montserrat mountains. This diurnal temperature shift enables classic local white varieties to reach complete phenolic maturity while retaining a sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Poema Cava Brut presents a luminous, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with shimmering greenish-silver highlights and a fine, persistent, energetic stream of delicate bubbles (mousse). Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expressive, fruit-forward, yet elegant portrait of traditional Spanish sparkling wine. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh Green Delicious apples, crisp Bosc pear, and Meyer lemon zest, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of white floral blossoms, freshly baked bread, toasted almond, and a subtle line of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard fruit, citrus peel, and creamy autolytic warmth. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is supple, creamy, and weightless, carrying into a long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of lime peel, green apple skin, and chalk.

title: Redbreast PX Edition
bodyHtml:
Redbreast Pedro Ximénez (PX) Edition is a single pot still Irish whiskey produced by Irish Distillers at the historic Midleton Distillery in County Cork, Ireland. As part of the acclaimed Redbreast Iberian Series, this expression celebrates the long-standing connection between Midleton and prestigious Spanish bodegas. Building upon Redbreast's iconic sherry-influenced foundation, the PX Edition takes the signature single pot still liquid and adds a finishing period in rare Pedro Ximénez sherry casks, introducing a dark, decadent fruitiness to the classic spice and cream profile.

Spirit Description

Redbreast PX Edition is crafted from a mash bill of malted and unmalted barley, triple-distilled in traditional copper pot stills at Midleton. The whiskey undergoes its initial maturation in a combination of ex-bourbon and ex-Oloroso sherry casks. It is then re-casked into hand-selected Pedro Ximénez hogsheads sourced from Antonio Páez Lobato in Jerez, Spain, for a finishing period. The intense sweetness and concentration of the PX casks infuse the whiskey with deep dark fruit, chocolate, and sticky fig notes, complementing the robust pot still spice.

  • Colour: Deep mahogany with rich ruby and amber highlights.

  • Aroma: Rich, sweet, and complex, opening with dried figs, raisins, sultanas, and candied orange peel, backed by toasted nuts, dark chocolate, sweet oak, and warming pot still spices like nutmeg and cinnamon.

  • Palate: Luxurious, syrupy, and full-bodied on the entry. Upfront flavors of dark berry compote, sticky dates, and plum yield to toasted wood, roasted walnuts, dark chocolate-covered espresso beans, and vibrant pot still spice.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a heavy, velvety, and mouth-coating viscosity.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long and warm, trailing off with persistent notes of dried fruit, caramelized sugar, sweet oak tannins, and a dry, lingering spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 46% ABV (92 Proof) and non-chill filtered.

title: Kopke Colheita Port 1978
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' fortified wine originates from Portugal, within the historic Douro D.O.C. appellation. Founded in 1638 by Nicolau Kopke, C.N. Kopke is universally recognized as the oldest Port house in existence and the undisputed benchmark master of single-harvest tawny Ports (Colheita). Sourced from steep, terraced, schist-laden vineyards in the Cima Corgo sub-region where ancient vines are carved into rugged hillsides along the Douro River the grapes are rooted in nutrient-poor, rocky schist subsoils. The region's extreme continental climate features scorching, sun-drenched summers and freezing winters, forcing vine roots deep into rock fissures to absorb water and minerals. This harsh environment yields low quantities of highly concentrated fruit with intense phenolic depth and a remarkably resilient, age-worthy natural acidity.

Wine Description

The 1978 Kopke Colheita Port presents a deep, luminous amber-mahogany hue in the glass with shimmering topaz and greenish-olive reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an opulent, intricate, and deeply expansive portrait of long-matured single-harvest Tawny Port. The bouquet opens with a soaring, multi-layered display of dried figs, medjool dates, toasted walnuts, and orange marmalade, seamlessly integrated with complex underlays of pipe tobacco, mahogany wood, clear honey, butterscotch, dried apricots, crushed clove, cardamom, and a subtle line of saline minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, viscous, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent, mouth-coating core of liquid caramel, dark chocolate, and candied citrus peel. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly cuts through its residual sweetness and mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and weightless, carrying into an extraordinarily long, dry-edged, and lingering finish accented by notes of roasted coffee, toasted almonds, and polished wood.

Vintage Quality

The 1978 vintage in the Douro Valley produced small quantities of exceptionally balanced, concentrated grapes characterized by high sugar levels and vibrant natural acidity. While not widely declared as a general Vintage Port year, it proved to be a magnificent, legendary year for Tawny Ports destined for long cask aging. Kopke selected its finest casks from 1978 for long-term cellaring. The resulting 1978 Colheita Port balances decades of cask-matured walnut and wood-spice complexity with a lively structural frame, drinking magnificently today and holding indefinitely in the bottle.

title: Antinori Brunello di Montalcino 'Pian delle Vigne' 2020 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the esteemed Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation of southern Tuscany. Produced by the historic Marchesi Antinori family winemakers since 1385 across 26 generations the Pian delle Vigne estate was acquired in 1995 and takes its name from a characteristic 19th-century railway station still standing on the property. Located six kilometers southwest of the historic town of Montalcino, the 184-hectare estate features approximately 65 hectares of vineyards exposed to the southwest at an elevation of 130 meters above sea level. The vines are rooted in clay-limestone soils rich in fine gravel (scheletro) and calcareous silt. The warm, sun-drenched microclimate of Montalcino's southwestern sector is moderated by gentle maritime breezes off the Tyrrhenian Sea, allowing Sangiovese Grosso (Brunello) to achieve complete phenolic skin maturity while retaining a vibrant, age-worthy natural acidity and an elegant structural frame.

Wine Description

The 2020 Antinori Pian delle Vigne Brunello di Montalcino presents a luminous, deep ruby-garnet color in the glass with subtle brick and terracotta reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and energetic portrayal of southwestern Montalcino Sangiovese. The bouquet opens with a soaring, multi-layered display of dried black cherries, ripe plums, and candied blood orange peel, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of balsamic sage, wild violet, eucalyptus, tomato leaf, cocoa nibs, and a distinct trace of cast iron minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, spry, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of red berry compote, tart raspberries, and candied citrus peel. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and supple, framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of licorice, spice, and crushed stone.

title: Alberta Premium Cask Strength 10 Year Old 2025 Release
bodyHtml:
Alberta Premium Cask Strength 10 Year Old (2025 Release) is a limited-edition, cask-strength 100% rye whisky produced by Alberta Distillers Limited in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Owned by Beam Suntory, Alberta Distillers is globally recognized as a powerhouse producer of 100% rye whisky, supplying high-grade rye distillates across North America for decades. Building on the massive success of their earlier Cask Strength Rye iterations, the 2025 Release pairs a defined 10-year age statement with un-cut, un-chilled cask strength proof, delivering an intense, complex, and unadulterated showcase of Canadian prairie rye.

Spirit Description

Alberta Premium Cask Strength 10 Year Old is distilled from a 100% rye mash bill using locally sourced Alberta fall rye, renowned for its hardy character and deep spice. The distillate is aged for a minimum of 10 full years in charred American white oak barrels in the dry, high-altitude climate of Calgary, Alberta. Bottled straight from the cask without cold filtration or water dilution, it balances aggressive rye heat and peppery spice with rich oak tannins, dark fruit, and deep caramel sweetness.

  • Colour: Dark copper amber with rich polished bronze glints and thick, heavy legs in the glass.

  • Aroma: Bold, fragrant, and wood-forward. Opens with intense rye spice, cracked black pepper, and clove, followed by dark caramel, vanilla bean, dried cherries, toasted oak, and a subtle trace of mint and dill.

  • Palate: Massive, rich, and spice-accented on the entry. Strong upfront flavors of baking spice, dark chocolate, and brown sugar give way to toasted oak, pipe tobacco, dried plum, and a punchy, warm rye heat.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a heavy, coating, and viscous mouthfeel that easily handles its high ABV.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long, warm, and lingering, trailing off with persistent toasted oak tannins, cracked pepper, dark molasses, and a dry, refreshing mint snap.

  • ABV: Bottled at Cask Strength, typically ranging between 67.

title: Codigo 1530 Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Código 1530 Añejo Tequila is a luxury aged spirit produced in Amatitán, within the Lowlands (Valles) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Distilled at Industrializadora de Agave San Isidro (NOM 1580), the brand operates under a recipe that was privately enjoyed for generations by a prominent Los Bajos family before its commercial debut in 2016 (backed notably by country music icon George Strait). Named "1530" after the year Amatitán was officially recognized as a city, Código 1530 Añejo is celebrated for its artisanal production and its signature use of un-charred French oak wine barrels for maturation.

Spirit Description

Código 1530 Añejo is crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves harvested at full maturity in the mineral-rich soils of Amatitán. The agaves are slow-cooked in traditional stainless steel ovens and crushed using a mechanical roller mill. Fermentation takes place in open-air vats utilizing organic baker's yeast from a local family bakery in Amatitán. Double-distilled in copper pot stills, the spirit is matured for 18 months in hand-selected Napa Valley Cabernet French White Oak wine barrels. The use of un-charred wine casks allows the natural agave character to harmonize with soft wood, subtle tannins, and red fruit elegance.

  • Colour: Warm golden amber with soft copper and reddish reflections.

  • Aroma: Complex, rich, and inviting, opening with cooked agave, toasted oak, and dark vanilla bean, complemented by dried fruit, subtle figs, cocoa powder, and gentle baking spices.

  • Palate: Smooth, rich, and well-structured on the entry. Upfront flavors of roasted agave, butterscotch, and sweet vanilla give way to toasted oak, subtle dark berry notes, toasted almonds, cinnamon spice, and a hint of dark chocolate.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a velvety, elegant, and mouth-coating texture.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and refined, trailing off with persistent sweet oak tannins, dried fruit, gentle black pepper, and a soft mineral dryness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Milagro Silver Tequila
bodyHtml:
Milagro Silver Tequila is a popular, 100% Blue Weber agave spirit produced in the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. Founded in 1998 by two young Mexican entrepreneurs, Danny Schneeweiss and Moy Guindi, Milagro (NOM 1558) was created with the vision of bridging traditional tequila production with modern, vibrant Mexican culture. Famous for its tall, sleek blue bottle, Milagro Silver is celebrated by bartenders and consumers worldwide for its fresh agave-forward profile, bright citrus brightness, and exceptional smoothness.

Spirit Description

Milagro Silver is crafted using 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves harvested in the mineral-rich red clay soil of Los Altos. The agave piñas are slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens for 36 hours to convert starches into fermentable sugars. Extraction combines both a roller mill and modern techniques, followed by open-air vat fermentation. The key to Milagro's distinct smoothness is its dual distillation process: first distilled in traditional copper pot stills to retain rich agave flavor, and then distilled a second time in stainless steel column stills to achieve an unusually clean, crisp finish.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and transparent with luminous silver highlights.

  • Aroma: Crisp, fresh, and agave-forward, opening with bright lime zest, sweet cooked agave, and fresh green vegetable notes, backed by subtle white pepper and a clean mineral quality.

  • Palate: Crisp, smooth, and vibrant on the entry. Upfront flavors of fresh roasted agave, lemon-lime citrus, and vegetal agave nectar yield to crisp green apple, white pepper spice, and subtle floral undertones.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a light, smooth, and clean mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Crisp, clean, and refreshing, leaving trailing notes of citrus peel, sweet agave, and a gentle peppery warmth.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Patron Cristalino Tequila
bodyHtml:
Patrón Cristalino Tequila is a luxury aged tequila produced in Atotonilco el Alto, within the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the Hacienda Patrón distillery (NOM 1492), the expression represents Patrón's entrance into the rapidly growing Cristalino category. Combining traditional, additive-free Highland tequila production with meticulous wood aging and charcoal filtration, Patrón Cristalino is engineered to offer the rich, oak-derived complexity of an Añejo with the crystal-clear appearance and bright agave notes of a Blanco.

Spirit Description

Patrón Cristalino is crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens. The agaves are crushed using a combination of a traditional volcanic stone tahona wheel and a modern roller mill, followed by open-air fermentation and double distillation in small copper pot stills. The distillate is aged for up to 12 to 15 months in a combination of four distinct wood casks; including American oak, French oak, and seasoned wine barrels to create an exceptionally rich Añejo base. Master Distiller David Rodriguez then filters the aged spirit through a proprietary wood charcoal filtration process to gently remove the color while preserving the oak-aged character.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, luminous, and brilliant with long, slow legs.

  • Aroma: Soft, sweet, and inviting, opening with cooked agave, sweet vanilla, and toasted oak, followed by dried fruit, butterscotch, light floral notes, and a hint of lime zest.

  • Palate: Silky, smooth, and refined on the entry. Upfront notes of rich roasted agave, creamy vanilla bean, and light caramel give way to toasted almonds, subtle oak spice, and a touch of citrus oil.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a velvety, rounded, and mouth-coating texture.

  • Finish: Clean, crisp, and long, trailing off with persistent sweet agave, gentle oak tannins, and a soft mineral dryness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Telmont Blanc De Noirs 2014
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' sparkling wine originates from France, within the prestigious Champagne A.O.C. appellation. Produced by Champagne Telmont (formerly J. de Telmont) a historic house established in 1912 in Damery, near Épernay, and now pioneering organic viticulture alongside eco-conscious partners this 2014 vintage Blanc de Noirs represents a celebration of black-skinned grapes. Sourced primarily from choice plots across Damery, Aÿ, Cumières, and the Côte des Bar, the vines are rooted in deep chalk, clay-limestone, and gravelly alluvial subsoils. The 2014 growing season featured a warm spring followed by a cool, damp summer and a sunny, dry September, allowing Pinot Noir and Meunier to build rich phenolic fruit concentration while maintaining an electric, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The 2014 Telmont Blanc de Noirs presents a luminous, pure golden hue in the glass with subtle copper-pink reflections and an exceptionally fine, persistent stream of delicate, energetic bubbles (mousse). Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an opulent, dark-toned, and precise portrayal of vintage Champagne. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh red berries, wild raspberries, tart red cherries, and kirsch, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of meringue, toasted brioche, dragée almonds, cardamon spice, and a subtle line of crushed chalk minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of red stone fruits, blood orange peel, and dark spice. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, supple, and weightless, framed by fine-grained phenolic grip that carries into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of vanilla, salty minerality, and toasted nuts.

title: Valdicava Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 'Madonna del Piano' 2019
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation of southern Tuscany. Produced by Valdicava a legendary estate led by Vincenzo Abbruzzese the single-vineyard Madonna del Piano Riserva represents one of Italy's most iconic and sought-after red wines. First created in 1977 as one of Montalcino's pioneering single-vineyard Riservas, the eight-hectare Madonna del Piano plot sits at the foot of the Montosoli hill on the valley floor of northern Montalcino. Rooted in deep, mineral-dense soils of galestro (schistose clay), albarese (limestone), and crushed gravel, the vineyard benefits from a unique mesoclimate marked by warm daytime sun and sharp evening temperature drops. This thermal variation allows Sangiovese Grosso (Brunello) to undergo an extended ripening cycle, building profound phenolic density, dark-fruit concentration, and an imposing, age-worthy structural frame.

Wine Description

The 2019 Valdicava Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 'Madonna del Piano' presents a deep, luminous garnet-ruby color in the glass with rich brick and terracotta reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering a monumentally structured, intense, and noble portrait of northern Montalcino Sangiovese. The bouquet opens with a soaring, multi-layered display of black cherries, wild dark plums, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with complex underlays of dried violets, sweet pipe tobacco, cured leather, damp earth, truffle, crushed stone minerality, and a subtle touch of cedarwood and dark cocoa. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, muscular, and athletic, showcasing a succulent, power-packed core of dark stone fruits, blood orange peel, and dried Mediterranean herbs. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its immense mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is broad, linear, and velvety, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky Sangiovese tannins that carry into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of iron, graphite, and dried spices.

This high-definition Tuscan expression is 100% Sangiovese Grosso, sourced exclusively from the oldest, lowest-yielding vines in the historic Madonna del Piano plot. Hand-harvested with rigorous cluster-by-cluster sorting in both vineyard and cellar, the fruit underwent temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats with extended maceration on the skins to extract noble phenolics and deep color. To polish its formidable structural tannins while honoring pure varietal and single-vineyard character, the wine completed malolactic conversion and was matured for over 30 months in large, neutral Slavonian oak casks (botti grandi), followed by extended bottle resting to meet the stringent six-year aging requirement for Riserva release. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, bold alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% to 15.0% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 vintage across Montalcino is universally hailed as a legendary, historic growing season. A classic spring followed by a warm, sun-drenched summer was tempered by cool nightly breezes from Mount Amiata and timely rainfall, allowing Sangiovese to achieve complete, perfect phenolic maturity with ideal skin-to-juice ratios and vibrant natural acidity. Vincenzo Abbruzzese harvested pristine, low-yielding fruit at peak structural balance. The resulting 2019 'Madonna del Piano' Riserva combines immense Tuscan power and dark berry density with noble structural restraint, built to evolve and improve gracefully in a cellar over the next 20 to 35+ years.

title: Valdicava Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the esteemed Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation of southern Tuscany. Produced by Valdicava a legendary estate led by Vincenzo Abbruzzese this wine captures the distinctive terroir of the Montosoli hill on the northern slope of Montalcino. Sourced from organically farmed estate vineyards situated between 300 and 350 meters above sea level, the vines are rooted in mineral-rich soils composed of galestro (schistose clay), albarese (limestone), and sandstone. The vineyard's northern microclimate benefits from cooler temperatures, generous sun exposure, and steady thermal air currents, allowing Sangiovese Grosso (Brunello) to undergo an extended ripening process that yields intense dark-fruit complexity, remarkable aromatic lift, and a firm, age-worthy tannic backbone.

Wine Description

The 2020 Valdicava Brunello di Montalcino presents a luminous, deep garnet-ruby color in the glass with brick and terracotta highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, highly focused, and noble portrayal of northern Montalcino Sangiovese. The bouquet opens with a captivating, multi-layered display of wild dark cherries, black plums, and dried red currants, seamlessly integrated with complex underlays of dried violets, sweet tobacco leaf, leather, damp earth, crushed stone minerality, dark cocoa, and a subtle trace of cedarwood. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, muscular, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of dark stone fruits, blood orange peel, and dried Mediterranean herbs. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is broad, linear, and supple, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky Sangiovese tannins that carry into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of iron, spices, and forest floor.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 growing season across Montalcino was characterized by a warm, sunny summer balanced by cool nightly breezes from Mount Amiata and timely late-summer rains. This allowed Sangiovese clusters to achieve complete, balanced phenolic maturity while preserving bright natural acidity and vibrant floral-fruit precursors. Valdicava harvested healthy, perfectly balanced fruit with ideal skin-to-juice ratios. The resulting 2020 Brunello di Montalcino combines rich Tuscan warmth and dark berry density with noble structural restraint, built to evolve and improve gracefully in a cellar over the next 15 to 25+ years.

title: Kosta Browne Santa Lucia Highlands Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from the United States, within the cool-climate Santa Lucia Highlands A.V.A. of Monterey County, California. Produced by Kosta Browne a benchmark luxury producer founded in 1997 and led by Winemaker Julien Howsepian the Santa Lucia Highlands Pinot Noir forms a cornerstone of the estate's highly coveted Appellation Series. Sourced from legendary single-vineyard sites including Pisoni, Garys', Rosella's, Sierra Mar, and Soberanes, the vines are rooted in Arroyo Seco and Chualar fine sandy loam soils. Positioned along the eastern slopes of the Santa Lucia Mountains, the vineyards are swept daily by cool fog and marine winds drawn from the deep submarine canyon of Monterey Bay. This constant airflow creates a long, gradual growing season, allowing Pinot Noir to achieve intense phenolic depth, rich fruit concentration, and crisp natural acidity.

Wine Description

Kosta Browne Santa Lucia Highlands Pinot Noir presents a luminous, deep ruby color in the glass with bright magenta shimmers at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expressive, layered, and precisely focused expression of coastal Monterey terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of wild strawberries, fresh red cherries, and cranberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of rose petals, fresh blueberry, sweet baking spices, tea leaf, and a line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a vibrant, succulent core of pomegranate, dark cherry reduction, and blood orange zest. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate fruit extract. The mouthfeel is broad, silky, and supple, framed by fine-grained tannins and a savory mid-palate that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and graceful finish accented by lingering notes of spice and dark forest floor.

title: J Lohr October Night Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from the United States, within the cool-climate Arroyo Seco A.V.A. of Monterey County, California. Produced by J. Lohr Vineyards & Wines a family-owned pioneer in sustainable California viticulture founded in 1974 by Jerry Lohr the 'October Night' Chardonnay represents the summit of the winery's single-vineyard white wine portfolio. Sourced from choice blocks planted predominantly to the highly aromatic Dijon clone 809, the vines are rooted in deep, well-draining, gravelly loam soils rich in granite cobblestones (locally referred to as "Arroyo Seco stones"). The vineyard sits directly in the path of the relentless, cool marine winds and fog that sweep inland daily from Monterey Bay. This extreme maritime exposure causes an extended growing season often lasting into late October allowing the grapes to develop exotic floral and citrus-peel aromatics while maintaining a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

J. Lohr 'October Night' Chardonnay presents a luminous, pale straw-gold color in the glass with vivid chartreuse and greenish-gold reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an intensely aromatic and refined expression of Monterey coastal terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring, highly distinctive display of orange blossom, gardenia, Meyer lemon curd, and ripe white peach, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of roasted hazelnut, toasted brioche, lemon verbena, vanilla bean, and a line of crushed granite minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, supple, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of nectarine, candied citrus peel, and creamy autolytic warmth. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its opulent mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is broad, silky, and weightless, framed by fine oak integration that glides into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of lime zest, flint, and toasted brioche.

title: Coors Light - 59 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Coors Light affectionately known as the "Silver Bullet" is a pillar of the global beer industry and one of the best-selling light lagers in history. Reintroduced by the Coors Brewing Company in 1978 to meet the rising demand for low-calorie lagers, it built its entire brand around extreme cold refreshment and its Rocky Mountain heritage. It is an ultra-light American Light Lager designed to strip away palate-coating malts and aggressive hop bitterness in favor of a crisp, clean, and effortlessly drinkable profile.

Beer Description

Coors Light pours a pale, sparkling straw-gold with crystal-clear clarity and a lively carbonation that supports a bright white foam head that fades rapidly.

Aroma: The nose is minimalist, clean, and cold-focused. It leads with dominant notes of sweet corn husks and faint cereal grain, followed by a nearly unnoticeable, herbal hop whisper. It is completely free of heavy yeast esters or deep malt scents.

Palate: On the tongue, it is very light-bodied with a snappy, effervescent, and watery mouthfeel. It opens with a quick flash of cracker sweetness, which is immediately washed away by its signature crispness. Bitterness is virtually non-existent, leaving an exceptionally short, dry, and clean finish that leaves zero aftertaste.

Profile: It sits at 4.2% ABV in the US (4.0% ABV in Canada) and a negligible bitterness of 10 IBU, containing just 102 calories per serving.

Technical Notes: Coors Light relies heavily on its signature process: it is lagered, filtered, and packaged cold ("Cold-Certified"). It uses two-row Moravian barley alongside corn as an adjunct. The corn provides fermentable sugars that lighten the body and reduce heavy proteins, allowing the beer to finish crisp without feeling dense.

title: Molson Canadian - 59 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
The 59 Litre Keg of Molson Canadian (commonly known in the industry as a "Full-Size," "Half-Barrel," or "50L/59L Commercial Keg") is the undisputed backbone of Canadian taproom culture. First brewed in 1959 in Montreal, Molson Canadian was created as a homage to the vast, cold landscapes of the country. This flagship North American Pale Lager is built on pure, unpretentious refreshment.

Beer Description

When poured fresh from the tap, Molson Canadian fills the pint glass with a brilliant, crystal-clear golden-yellow hue, crowned by a dense, frothy white head that holds a steady collar.

Aroma: The nose is clean, subtle, and classic. It leads with dominant notes of sweet cereal grain and pale malted barley, followed by a very faint, herbal hint of Canadian hops. It has zero heavy yeast esters, smelling cold, crisp, and pure.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a snappy, effervescent draught mouthfeel. It opens with a gentle wave of bready cracker sweetness, which rapidly resolves into a smooth, clean middle. The finish is short, crisp, and dry, leaving almost no residual bitterness on the tongue.

Profile: It sits at a standard 5.0% ABV and an ultra-approachable bitterness of 15 IBU, engineered for maximum drinkability.

Technical Notes: Molson Canadian is brewed using 100% Canadian-grown two-row malted barley and water sourced from local Canadian aquifers. The recipe incorporates select hop varieties to achieve its light balance. The keg format is the gold standard for draft stability; kept under constant carbon dioxide pressure and cold temperatures, the beer avoids oxidation, preserving the clean, unpasteurized draft character that makes it noticeably smoother on tap than in packaged formats.

title: Lake Breeze Syrah 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from Canada, within the prestigious Naramata Bench sub-A.O.C. of the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. Lake Breeze Vineyards, one of the region's historic and benchmark estates established in 1995, benefits from elevated benchland vineyards overlooking Okanagan Lake. Rooted in glacial silt, gravelly loam, and clay-rich soils, the vines experience intense summer sunlight and warm daytime temperatures moderated by the cooling thermal mass of the lake. This unique microclimate allows Syrah to achieve generous fruit concentration and ripe skin phenolics while preserving an electric, mouthwatering natural acidity and an aromatic, savory character.

Wine Description

Lake Breeze Syrah presents a deep, luminous garnet-ruby color in the glass with bright magenta shimmers along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an elegant and precisely focused Northern Rhône-style expression of Okanagan terroir. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of wild blackberries, dark plums, and red cherries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of dried violets, cracked black pepper, smoked meat, cured olives, and a subtle line of toasted French oak spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of dark stone fruits, blood orange zest, and cocoa nibs. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is linear, athletic, and supple, framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins that glide into a long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of graphite, baking spices, and forest floor.

title: Domaine Tempier Bandol Cuvee Classique
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the sun drenched Provence region, specifically within the prestigious Bandol subregion, Domaine Tempier Cuvee Classique represents the benchmark for Mediterranean red winemaking. The historic farm has been active since 1834, but its modern legacy began in 1936 when it was gifted to Lucie 'Lulu' Tempier and Lucien Peyraud. Driven by Lucien’s passion for reviving the noble Mourvedre grape and establishing the Bandol appellation, Domaine Tempier crafted a reputation for producing terroir-driven, organic wines from diverse clay-limestone parcels across the region.

Wine Description

The wine displays a deep ruby red colour with dark purple undertones. The bouquet reveals complex aromas of dark blackberry, Marasca cherry, and plum, interwoven with distinct Provencal garrigue, olive tapenade, leather, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, it is full bodied, showing rich flavours of black currant, cocoa, cracked black pepper, and crushed stone supported by a core of fresh natural acidity. Composed predominantly of Mourvedre blended with Grenache, Cinsault, Carignan, and Syrah, this structured release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2042. Stylistically, it combines intense concentration and dark fruit depth with rustic minerality, structural power, and remarkable finesse.

title: Cazadores Cristalino Tequila
bodyHtml:
Cazadores Cristalino Tequila is a premium clear aged spirit produced in Arandas, within the Highlands (Los Altos) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the historic Tequila Cazadores distillery (NOM 1128), founded in 1922 by Don José María Bañuelos, the brand is famous for its iconic stag logo symbolizing the search for the perfect agave. Cazadores Cristalino represents a modern evolution of their traditional lineup, taking fully aged tequila and charcoal-filtering it to produce an expression with the rich, complex wood notes of an Añejo and the pristine clarity and crisp agave brightness of a Blanco.

Spirit Description

Cazadores Cristalino begins with 100% Blue Weber agaves harvested in the mineral-rich soils of Los Altos. The agaves are slow-cooked in small stainless steel autoclaves, crushed, and fermented in a seven-day open-air process accompanied by classical music to encourage yeast activity. Following double distillation in copper pot stills, the spirit is aged in virgin American oak barrels for over two years, reaching full Añejo maturity. Master Distiller Jesus Susunaga then passes the aged liquid through a specialized activated carbon filtration process. This removes the amber color and harsh wood tannins while locking in the smooth vanilla, caramel, and oak flavors integrated during maturation.

  • Colour: Luminous, crystal clear with brilliant silver highlights and slow, elegant legs.

  • Aroma: Inviting and sweet, opening with cooked agave, fresh vanilla bean, and toasted oak, followed by green apple, sweet citrus peel, toasted almonds, and subtle floral undertones.

  • Palate: Exceptionally smooth, silky, and balanced on the entry. Upfront flavors of sweet roasted agave, creamy vanilla, and butterscotch give way to toasted coconut, subtle citrus zest, light black pepper spice, and a gentle wood warmth.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a soft, velvety, and rounded mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Clean, crisp, and medium-long, trailing off with lingering sweet vanilla, gentle oak spice, and a refreshing mineral dryness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Olmeca Altos Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Olmeca Altos Añejo Tequila is a high-quality, artisanal aged tequila produced in Los Altos (the Highlands) of Jalisco, Mexico. Created through a collaboration between Master Distiller Jesús Hernández and the late internationally renowned UK bartenders Henry Besant and Andrés Masso, Altos was designed to bring authentic, traditional 100% agave tequila to world-class bar programs. Matured in small oak casks, the Añejo expression blends the rich, mineral-driven agave character of the Highlands with smooth, sweet wood notes gained from extended barrel maturation.

Spirit Description

Olmeca Altos Añejo is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agaves grown in the high-altitude, iron-rich red soils of Los Altos. The agaves are slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens for 36 hours. A key distinction of the production process is the extraction, which utilizes both a traditional 500-year-old volcanic stone Tahona wheel and a modern roller mill. The juice is fermented in open vats using cultivated yeast and double-distilled in small copper pot stills. The spirit is then aged for a minimum of 14 to 18 months in 200-liter ex-bourbon American white oak barrels.

  • Colour: Warm golden amber with bright bronze highlights.

  • Aroma: Rich, soft, and inviting, featuring prominent notes of cooked agave, vanilla, and sweet caramel, accompanied by toasted oak, dried fruits, nuttiness, and subtle baking spices like nutmeg and cinnamon.

  • Palate: Smooth, velvety, and complex on the entry. Upfront sweet notes of butterscotch, vanilla bean, and dark honey yield to rich roasted agave, toasted almonds, dark chocolate, and a touch of black pepper spice.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a well-rounded, silky, and mouth-coating mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and satisfying, trailing off with persistent sweet oak, brown sugar, gentle spice, and a dry, lingering agave note.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Black Stallion Gaspare Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California’s Napa Valley, specifically within the cooler Oak Knoll District subregion, Black Stallion Gaspare Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon represents one of the estate's single-vineyard bottlings. Located on the historic site of the former Silverado Horseman’s Center, Black Stallion Estate Winery was established by the Indelicato family to highlight the distinct terroir variations across Napa Valley. The Gaspare Vineyard, named in honor of family founder Gaspare Indelicato, sits in an ideal location where morning coastal fogs and gravelly clay soils allow Cabernet Sauvignon to ripen slowly while retaining natural acidity and refined elegance.

Wine Description

The wine displays a dark, opaque purple ruby colour with deep garnet highlights. The nose opens with an enticing bouquet of ripe black currant, plum, and dark cherry, accented by nuanced layers of dried lavender, graphite, dark chocolate, and toasted oak spice. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied experience rich in concentrated dark berry fruit, sweet tobacco, and crushed stone minerality. Supported by a lively streak of natural acidity and framed by firm, velvety tannins, it leads to a long, polished finish with lingering spice and cocoa notes.

title: Malfy Con Limone Gin
bodyHtml:
Malfy Con Limone Gin is a vibrant, citrus-forward contemporary craft gin produced by Torino Distillati in Moncalieri, outside Turin in northwestern Italy. Owned by Pernod Ricard, Malfy draws inspiration from the sun-drenched Amalfi Coast and Italian coastal lifestyle. Created by Master Distillers Beppe Ronco and Denis Muni, Malfy Con Limone celebrates Italy's rich citrus-growing tradition by combining classic gin botanicals with handpicked coastal lemons, yielding an expressive, sun-ripened citrus profile.

Spirit Description

Malfy Con Limone is distilled using a combination of vacuum (cold) distillation and traditional pot distillation to preserve the fresh aromatics of its delicate citrus peel. The botanical bill features sun-ripened Italian lemons and protected Amalfi Coast lemon peels, alongside handpicked Italian juniper, coriander seed, angelica root, orris root, cassia bark, grapefruit zest, and bitter orange peel. Blended with pure alpine spring water from Mount Monviso, it delivers an intensely refreshing, lemon-rich profile that avoids syrupy sweetness while preserving authentic citrus oils.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and pristine.

  • Aroma: Intensely aromatic, opening with vibrant lemon zest, lemon curd, and essential citrus oils, backed by subtle piney juniper, coriander, and delicate white floral notes.

  • Palate: Crisp, lively, and burstingly citrus-forward on the entry. Dominant flavors of sun-ripened lemon peel and tangy lemon juice blend seamlessly with subtle piney juniper, warm coriander spice, and a faint hint of licorice.

  • Body: Light-to-medium-bodied with a smooth, slightly silky, and mouth-coating texture from essential lemon oils.

  • Finish: Clean, crisp, and long, leaving trailing notes of refreshing lemon zest, light herbal tones, and a dry, piney gin snap.

  • ABV: Bottled at 41% ABV (82 Proof).

title: D'Arenberg The Olive Grove Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Australia, within the world-famous McLaren Vale and Adelaide Hills regions of South Australia. Crafted by d'Arenberg a historic family-owned winery established in 1912 and led by fourth-generation chief winemaker Chester Osborn The Olive Grove Chardonnay takes its name from the olive trees that flourish alongside the estate's old-vine Chardonnay blocks. Sourced from choice, sustainably farmed vineyards across the warm valley floor of McLaren Vale and the cooler elevations of the Adelaide Hills, the vines are rooted in ancient soils consisting of sandy loam, gravelly limestone, and ironstone-rich clay. The maritime influence from the nearby Gulf St Vincent brings cooling afternoon breezes that temper summer warmth, allowing Chardonnay grapes to achieve generous stone-fruit concentration while preserving an electric, razor-sharp natural acidity.

Wine Description

D'Arenberg The Olive Grove Chardonnay presents a luminous, pale straw-gold appearance in the glass with bright greenish-gold reflections at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a masterfully balanced portrait of modern South Australian Chardonnay that bridges rich fruit depth with crisp, mineral-driven tension. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh white peach, nectarine, and crisp green apple, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of lemon curd, white cashew nut, toasted brioche, subtle vanilla pod, and a distinct line of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of stone fruit, citrus peel, and creamy autolytic warmth. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate texture. The mouthfeel is supple, broad, and weightless, framed by subtle oak integration that glides into a long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of lime zest, flint, and toasted almond.

title: D'Arenberg Stump Jump Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Australia, within the legendary McLaren Vale region of South Australia. Produced by d'Arenberg a historic family-owned winery founded in 1912 and led by fourth-generation chief winemaker Chester Osborn The Stump Jump series pays homage to the iconic South Australian invention of the stump jump plough. Sourced from choice, sustainably farmed vineyard blocks across McLaren Vale and Adelaide Hills, the vines are rooted in diverse soils ranging from sandy loam over red clay to gravelly limestone. The maritime microclimate, tempered by cooling breezes off the Gulf St Vincent, allows the late-ripening Sauvignon Blanc grapes to undergo a gradual ripening process, accumulating intense tropical citrus concentration while retaining a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

D'Arenberg The Stump Jump Sauvignon Blanc presents a brilliant, pale straw-yellow appearance in the glass with vivid greenish-silver highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an intensely aromatic and electric portrait of South Australian Sauvignon Blanc.
