title: Dom Perignon Rose 2009
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' sparkling wine originates from France, within the prestigious Champagne A.O.C. appellation. Produced by the legendary Champagne House Moët & Chandon under its prestige brand, Dom Pérignon Rosé represents the absolute zenith of luxury sparkling winemaking. The 2008 vintage, crafted by long-time Chef de Cave Richard Geoffroy, spent nearly twelve years resting quietly in the deep chalk cellars of Épernay. Sourced exclusively from choice Grand Cru and Premier Cru parcels across Hautvillers, Cramant, Avize, Bouzy, and Aÿ, the vines are rooted in deep, chalk-rich limestone subsoils (craie). The 2008 growing season was defined by a cool, overcast summer followed by a miraculous, dry, and sun-filled September. This unique climatic sequence allowed Pinot Noir and Chardonnay to achieve incredible phenolic maturity alongside an electric, razor-sharp natural acidity, resulting in a Rosé of exceptional power, precision, and age-worthy tension.

Wine Description

Dom Pérignon Rosé presents a luminous, deep copper-pink color in the glass with vivid amber and coral highlights, propelled by an extraordinarily fine, persistent, and energetic stream of microscopic bubbles (mousse). Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an intense, dramatic, and dark-toned expression of vintage Champagne. The bouquet opens with a captivating, multi-layered display of wild raspberries, red currants, blood orange peel, and dried dark cherries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of smoked paprika, saffron, cocoa nibs, toasted brioche, dried roses, and a distinct line of crushed chalk minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, taut, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of dark stone fruits, bitter citrus zest, and savory spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is muscular, athletic, and supple, framed by fine-grained Pinot Noir tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of smoke, red berry skin, and chalk.

title: Luxardo Espresso Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Luxardo Espresso is a premium Italian coffee liqueur produced by Girolamo Luxardo S.p.A. in Torreglia, located in the Veneto region of northeastern Italy. Founded in 1821 in Zara (now Zadar, Croatia) and famous worldwide for its iconic Maraschino liqueur and Maraschino cherries, the family-owned company brings over two centuries of distillation expertise to this classic digestif. Crafted to deliver the authentic, unadulterated flavor of a freshly pulled Italian espresso shot, it stands as a gold standard for classic cocktails and post-dinner sipping.

Spirit Description

Luxardo Espresso is produced using a concentrated hot infusion of carefully selected coffee beans sourced from three continents: Brazil, Colombia, and Kenya. The dark-roasted Arabica coffee infusion is blended with neutral spirit, pure sugar, and a touch of natural vanilla to balance the natural bitterness of the coffee beans. Unlike lower-tier coffee liqueurs that rely on cold brew extracts or artificial colorings and flavorings, Luxardo uses traditional espresso extraction principles to yield a rich, dark, and intensely aromatic coffee liqueur.

  • Colour: Deep, impenetrable dark brown with rich mahogany reflections.

  • Aroma: Intensely aromatic and bold, opening with freshly ground dark-roast espresso beans, dark cocoa powder, and roasted nuts, backed by a subtle hint of warm vanilla and caramelized sugar.

  • Palate: Rich, full-flavored, and balanced on the entry. Upfront flavors of bittersweet dark espresso, roasted cocoa nibs, and dark chocolate blend seamlessly into subtle notes of toasted hazelnut, vanilla bean, and dark caramel.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a smooth, velvety, and syrupy texture without feeling cloying.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and lingering, trailing off with a pleasing bittersweet coffee dryness, dark chocolate, and a faint roasted bean bitterness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 27% ABV (54 Proof).

title: Planteray Land Selection 12 Year Old Moscatel Cask Rum
bodyHtml:
Planteray Land Selection 12 Year Old Moscatel Cask Rum is an ultra-premium, limited-edition aged rum produced by Maison Ferrand under the Planteray Rum brand (formerly known as Plantation Rum). Rebranded in 2024 to honor the sugar cane terroir ("Plant") and the sun ("Ray"), Planteray continues the signature double-maturation technique perfected by Master Blender Alexandre Gabriel. This expression showcases aged rum from the historic West Indies Rum Distillery in Barbados, finished in rare Moscatel wine casks to merge rich Caribbean rum heritage with lush Spanish fortified wine complexity.

Spirit Description

Planteray Land Selection 12 Year Old begins with a blend of column and traditional copper pot-still rums crafted from sugarcane molasses in Barbados. The liquid undergoes an initial primary maturation of 10 years in tropical American oak ex-bourbon casks in the Caribbean heat. The barrels are then shipped to France to Chateau de Bonbonnet, where the rum spends an additional 2 years resting in continental oak casks that previously held sweet Moscatel wine. This second maturation infuses the spirit with rich dried fruit, floral honey, and refined grape tannins while maintaining its foundation of tropical oak and vanilla.

  • Colour: Deep mahogany amber with glowing copper and bronze highlights.

  • Aroma: Complex, rich, and aromatic, opening with dried figs, raisins, candied orange peel, and floral honey, backed by toasted coconut, vanilla bean, charred oak, and subtle nutmeg spice.

  • Palate: Luxurious, velvety, and well-structured on the entry. Upfront flavors of sweet Moscatel grape, ripe plum, and butterscotch give way to toasted almonds, dark chocolate, tobacco, baking spices, and balanced oak tannins.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a rich, silky, and mouth-coating viscosity.

  • Finish: Long, warming, and elegant, trailing off with persistent notes of dried fruit, candied citrus, dark honey, and dry wood spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 45% ABV (90 Proof).

title: Lugny Cremant De Bourgogne Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' sparkling wine originates from France, within the Crémant de Bourgogne A.O.C. appellation of Burgundy. Cave de Lugny, an iconic cooperative founded in 1927 in the heart of the Mâconnais, is renowned for its deep commitment to Burgundian viticulture and high-elevation terroir. Sourced from choice hillside vineyards across the southern Côte d'Or and Mâconnais, the vines are rooted in limestone-rich clay soils and Jurassic chalk subsoils. The region's temperate semi-continental climate featuring sunny, warm days balanced by cool evening breezes allows red and white Burgundian grape varieties to reach ideal phenolic ripeness while retaining an electric, razor-sharp natural acidity necessary for world-class sparkling winemaking.

Wine Description

The Cave de Lugny Crémant de Bourgogne Rosé presents a luminous, pale coral-pink color in the glass with shimmering salmon reflections and an exceptionally fine, persistent, and energetic stream of delicate bubbles (mousse). Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a refined and expressive portrait of cool-climate Burgundian sparkling rosé. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh wild pink raspberries, red currants, and tart red cherries, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of white floral blossoms, crushed limestone minerality, citrus peel, and a touch of freshly baked brioche. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard red fruits, blood orange zest, and subtle autolytic warmth. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the palate. The mouthfeel is supple, creamy, and weightless, carrying into a long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of lime zest, red berry skin, and chalk.

title: Giant Steps Coal River Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from Australia, within the cool-climate Coal River Valley region of southern Tasmania. Crafted by Giant Steps a benchmark producer led by Head Winemaker Melanie Chester. This bottling demonstrates the estate's single-vineyard dedication to capturing Australia's finest Pinot Noir sites. Sourced from the esteemed Nocton Vineyard (planted in 1999 on northeast-facing slopes), the vines are rooted in ancient, triassic sandstone and calcareous clay soils. Although southern Tasmania features a cool maritime atmosphere, the Coal River Valley receives intense, long sunlight hours during the growing season. This unique microclimate allows Pinot Noir grapes to build exceptional dark-berry density and complex structural tannins while preserving an electric, razor-sharp natural acidity.

Wine Description

Giant Steps Coal River Pinot Noir presents a deep, luminous crimson-ruby color in the glass with bright purple glints along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an intense, exotic, and precisely focused expression of Tasmanian terroir. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of wild dark cherries, black raspberries, and ripe boysenberry, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of crushed violets, dried herbs, woodsmoke, chinotto, damp forest floor, and a subtle touch of exotic five-spice and cedarwood. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, muscular, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent, power-packed core of dark stone fruits, blood orange zest, and pomegranate molasses. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is linear, athletic, and supple, framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of graphite, iron, and subtle spice.

title: John Duval Compono Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:

Produced under the guidance of master winemaker John Duval; former Penfolds Chief Winemaker who crafted the iconic Grange for 16 years, the Compono label highlights the exceptional quality of cool-climate Cabernet Sauvignon grown across select sub-regions of the Barossa. Sourced from old-vine vineyard blocks in the higher-altitude Eden Valley and northern Barossa Valley, the vines are rooted in ancient, well-draining soils composed of ironstone, gravelly loam, and clay over limestone subsoils. The microclimate combines warm, sun-drenched daytime heat with crisp, cooling evening winds off the Mount Lofty Ranges, allowing Cabernet Sauvignon to achieve complete phenolic maturity while preserving an energetic, mouthwatering natural acidity and an imposing structural frame.

title: John Duval Concilio Shiraz 2024

title: Bacardi Caribbean Spiced – 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Bacardí Caribbean Spiced is a premium spiced rum spirit specialty produced by Bacardí Limited, the renowned family-owned spirits company originally founded in Santiago de Cuba in 1862. Engineered to capture the vibrant, tropical flavors of the West Indies, this expression combines smooth aged Caribbean rum with authentic coconut and pineapple natural flavors, along with warm baking spices. Positioned as Bacardí’s first high-tier, premium spiced rum release, it offers a sweet, tropical, and highly approachable profile designed for contemporary mixology and casual sipping.

Spirit Description

Bacardí Caribbean Spiced begins with a blend of light and heavy aged Caribbean rums distilled from sugarcane molasses. The underlying rums are aged in charred American white oak barrels in tropical climates to develop underlying notes of vanilla, toasted wood, and caramelized sugar. Real coconut blossom nectar, natural coconut, and pineapple fruit essences are then infused into the aged spirit, alongside warm baking spices such as cinnamon and nutmeg.

  • Colour: Bright amber-gold with warm mahogany and copper highlights.

  • Aroma: Inviting, sweet, and tropical, leading with toasted coconut, ripe juicy pineapple, and caramelized banana, backed by warm cinnamon spice, vanilla bean, and soft oak.

  • Palate: Smooth, sweet, and tropical on the entry. Upfront flavors of toasted coconut cream, sweet pineapple, and brown sugar give way to warm baking spices (cinnamon, clove, and nutmeg), toasted almonds, and subtle charred oak.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, velvety, and mouth-coating texture.

  • Finish: Medium in length, warm, and sweet, leaving trailing notes of toasted coconut, pineapple tartness, and gentle wood spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Gruet Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' sparkling wine originates from the United States, within the high-altitude, cool-climate microclimates of New Mexico. Founded in 1889 in Champagne, France, the Gruet family relocated their sparkling winemaking operations to New Mexico in 1984, recognizing the region's exceptional potential for traditional method sparkling production. Sourced from choice high-elevation vineyards situated between 1,300 and 1,700 meters (4,300 to 5,500 feet) above sea level in the Middle Rio Grande Valley and Elephant Butte regions, the vines are rooted in sandy-loam, gravelly, and calcium-rich alluvial soils. The extreme high-altitude environment features intense solar radiation by day balanced by drastic night-time temperature drops (diurnal shift), allowing Pinot Noir to achieve complete phenolic maturity while locking in a razor-sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Gruet Brut Rosé presents a luminous, pale garnet-pink color in the glass with vivid coral reflections and a fine, persistent, and energetic stream of delicate bubbles (mousse). Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expressive, fruit-forward, yet elegant portrait of American high-altitude traditional method sparkling wine. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh wild pink raspberries, wild strawberries, and tart red cherries, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of orange zest, white floral blossoms, freshly baked brioche, and a subtle line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy red stone fruits, citrus peel, and autolytic warmth. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate fruit density. title: Mumm Napa Prestige Cuvee
bodyHtml:

Mumm and local California viticulturists, combining centuries-old French Méthode Traditionnelle winemaking heritage with Napa Valley's sun-drenched, world-class fruit. Sourced from over 50 select vineyard sites across Napa Valley; including cool-climate sub-appellations such as Los Carneros, Rutherford, and Oak Knoll District, the vines are rooted in gravelly loam, clay, and volcanic alluvial soils. The region's Mediterranean microclimate features warm daytime sun tempered by cool maritime fog rolling off San Pablo Bay, allowing classic sparkling varieties to achieve rich fruit maturity while retaining an electric, razor-sharp natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Mumm Napa Brut Prestige Cuvée presents a luminous, pale straw-gold appearance in the glass with shimmering chartreuse highlights and a fine, persistent, and energetic stream of delicate bubbles (mousse). Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a refined, balanced, and highly expressive portrait of California traditional method sparkling wine. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh green apple, ripe Golden Delicious, crisp Asian pear, and Meyer lemon zest, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of freshly baked brioche, toasted almond, honeyed citrus, orange blossom, and a subtle line of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard stone fruits, citrus oils, and autolytic warmth. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is creamy, fine-textured, and supple, carrying into a long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of lime peel, toasted hazelnut, and chalk.

title: Jim Beam Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Jim Beam Single Barrel is a premium Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey produced by Beam Suntory at the historic James B. Beam Distilling Co. in Clermont, Kentucky. Representing an elevated tier of the classic Jim Beam lineup, each bottle is drawn from an individual, hand-selected barrel chosen by the Master Distiller for its unique depth and complexity. Because no two barrels are identical, each bottling offers a distinct variation on the iconic Beam flavor profile, delivered at a higher proof for a richer, more robust bourbon experience.

Spirit Description

Jim Beam Single Barrel is crafted from the brand's classic mash bill of 77% corn, 13% rye, and 10% malted barley, fermented using the proprietary Beam family yeast strain that dates back to the post-Prohibition era. Distilled in column stills, the spirit is matured in new, heavily charred (Level 4 "Alligator Char") American white oak barrels stored in the upper floors of Beam's multi-story rickhouses. Less than 1% of all barrels are selected for this expression, capturing optimal maturation where heat and airflow produce exceptional wood interaction and rich vanilla-caramel notes.

  • Colour: Deep golden amber with polished copper highlights.

  • Aroma: Warm, inviting, and wood-forward, featuring prominent notes of toasted oak, rich caramel, vanilla bean, and toasted nuts, accompanied by subtle baking spices, dried fruit, and a touch of leather.

  • Palate: Full-bodied, rich, and spice-accented on the entry. Strong upfront flavors of dark caramel, butterscotch, and sweet corn give way to toasted oak, roasted peanuts, baking spices (cinnamon and nutmeg), and a hint of dark chocolate.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a warm, viscous, and mouth-coating texture.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and lingering, trailing off with persistent toasted oak, dark brown sugar, rye spice, and Beam's signature nutty warmth.

  • ABV: Bottled at 54% ABV (108 Proof)

title: Nardini Mandorla Liqueur - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Nardini Mandorla originates from Italy, within the northern region of Veneto in the subregion of Bassano del Grappa. Founded in 1779 by Bortolo Nardini, Ditta Bortolo Nardini is Italy's oldest distillery and remains family owned to this day. The historic house continues to operate along the banks of the Brenta River, combining its traditional grappa base with a delicate infusion of bitter almond distillate to craft this signature liqueur.

Spirit Description

This traditional almond spirit presents a pale straw appearance in the glass. The sensory profile opens with an aromatic, intense nose dominated by warm bitter almond, marzipan, and subtle sweet vanilla, underpinned by gentle grappa notes. On the palate, the body is smooth, velvety, and exceptionally well balanced, bringing a harmonious contrast between rich nut sweetness, gentle warmth, and a clean herbal undertone. The finish is long, dry, and elegant, leaving a lingering trail of toasted almond and soft grape pomace. This spirit is traditionally bottled at an alcohol by volume of 50%.

Accolades

As an iconic expression from Italy's oldest distillery, this almond spirit has earned widespread admiration among spirits judges and mixologists. It is celebrated globally for its refined balance of real almond distillate and premium grappa, serving as a classic benchmark for high end Italian nut liqueurs.

Food Pairing

The intense almond aromatics and warming grappa structure make this spirit an outstanding digestif and dessert companion. It pairs magnificently with dark chocolate tarts, almond biscotti, or vanilla panna cotta. For a savoury match, it can be served alongside aged cheeses or enjoyed neat as a classic after dinner dram.

title: Forzza Chianti Fiasco 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from Italy, within the historic Chianti D.O.C.G. appellation situated in the rolling hills of sunny Tuscany. Produced under the Forzza label, this cuvée pays homage to one of the most iconic symbols of Italian winemaking heritage the traditional straw-wrapped glass bottle known as the fiasco. Originally designed by Florentine glassmakers to protect hand-blown glass during transport, the fiasco remains a beloved cultural icon representing rustic authenticity and convivial table sharing. Sourced from choice vineyard plots across the Chianti region, the vines are rooted in classic Tuscan soils rich in clay-limestone and stony marl (galestro). The sun-drenched Mediterranean climate, balanced by cool nightly breezes rolling off the Apennine Mountains, allows the Sangiovese grapes to achieve generous fruit concentration while locking in a vibrant, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Forzza Chianti Fiasco presents a brilliant, bright ruby-red color in the glass with lively garnet shimmers at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and expressive, offering an inviting, fruit-forward, and traditional expression of central Tuscan red wine. The bouquet opens with a generous display of ripe sour cherries, wild red plums, and tart cranberries, seamlessly layered with delicate floral undertones of violet petals, dried oregano, sweet tobacco leaf, and a subtle touch of crushed terra cotta earth. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy red stone fruits, blood orange zest, and herbal nuances. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that keeps the palate refreshed and lively. The mouthfeel is energetic, smooth, and supple, framed by fine-grained, approachable tannins that carry into a clean, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of cherry skin and Tuscan herbs.

title: Amaro dell'Etna
bodyHtml:
Amaro dell'Etna originates from Italy, within the island region of Sicily in the subregion of Mount Etna. Crafted since 1901, the historic spirit was created from an authentic recipe featuring a blend of wild herbs and aromatic plants grown in the rich volcanic soil surrounding the volcano. Today, the house continues to preserve its regional heritage, utilizing traditional maceration and distillation methods to produce its flagship Sicilian digestif.

Spirit Description

This artisanal amaro presents a deep mahogany, amber appearance in the glass. The complex sensory profile opens with an aromatic nose dominated by bright bitter orange peel, licorice root, spice, and subtle floral nuances, laced with notes of vanilla. On the palate, the body is rich, smooth, and remarkably well balanced, delivering a harmonious contrast between initial sweet citrus notes and a structured, herbal bitterness. The finish is exceptionally long, dry, and warming, leaving trailing undertones of dark spice, persistent herbs, and a delicate mineral edge. This traditional digestif is bottled at an alcohol by volume of 29%.

Accolades

As an iconic emblem of Sicilian distilling, this expression has earned tremendous critical acclaim in international competitions. Highlights include a Gold Medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition and top honors across major European spirits reviews, where it is celebrated for its authentic volcanic terroir and balanced complexity.

Food Pairing

The complex citrus sweetness and structured bitterness of this amaro make it an outstanding digestif after a rich meal. It pairs brilliantly with dark chocolate desserts, espresso infused tarts, or traditional Sicilian cannoli. For a savoury match, it serves as an excellent partner to a cheese board featuring aged pecorino or blue cheeses alongside roasted nuts.

title: Henriot Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' sparkling wine originates from France, within the prestigious Champagne A.O.C. appellation. Champagne Henriot, an independent, family-owned Maison founded in Reims in 1808, represents over two centuries of refined craftsmanship and deep devotion to Chardonnay. The Brut Rosé is crafted through a precise, high-artistry approach that incorporates a small percentage of still Pinot Noir red wine (vin rouge) into a classic assemblage. Sourced from over 25 premier and grand cru villages across the Côte des Blancs and Montagne de Reims including Le Mesnil-sur-Oger, Avize, Chouilly, and Mailly-Champagne the vines are rooted in deep, chalk-rich limestone soils (craie). The cool, marginal northern climate creates an ideal environment for building delicate red fruit aromatics, razor-sharp natural acidity, and intense mineral tension.

Wine Description

The Champagne Henriot Brut Rosé presents a luminous, pale salmon-pink appearance in the glass with delicate coral shimmers and an extraordinarily fine, persistent, and energetic stream of tiny bubbles (mousse). Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an elegant and deeply sophisticated expression of Rosé Champagne. The bouquet opens with a captivating display of wild pink raspberries, red currants, and wild strawberries, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of pink grapefruit zest, orange blossom, freshly baked brioche, toasted almonds, and a distinct line of crushed chalk minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy red stone fruits, citrus peel, and autolytic warmth. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that drives a weightless, deep development. The mouthfeel is silky, fine-textured, and supple, carrying into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of red berry skin, white pepper, and chalk.

title: Sheringham Fresh Rhubarb Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Sheringham Fresh Rhubarb Liqueur originates from Canada, on the West Coast of Vancouver Island in the province of British Columbia. Founded in 2015, Sheringham Distillery was established by Alayne and Jason MacIsaac with a commitment to crafting sustainable, small-batch spirits using locally sourced ingredients. Today, operating out of Langford, British Columbia, the distillery continues to highlight regional flavours by utilizing real, fresh Vancouver Island rhubarb in its fruit liqueur production.

Spirit Description

This craft liqueur presents a vibrant, delicate pink appearance in the glass. The sensory profile opens with an inviting, aromatic nose filled with fresh, tart rhubarb, bright lemon zest, and subtle floral undertones. On the palate, the body is light, silky, and beautifully balanced, bringing together a crisp wave of sweet orchard fruit and the authentic, lip-smacking tang of freshly harvested rhubarb. The finish is clean, smooth, and refreshing, leaving a lingering trail of natural fruit tartness and gentle sweetness. This artisanal liqueur is bottled at a approachable alcohol by volume of 20%.

Food Pairing

The vibrant tartness and delicate sweetness of this rhubarb liqueur make it an exceptional pairing partner for light desserts and brunch fare. It pairs magnificently with a classic lemon tart, vanilla bean panna cotta, or fresh pavlova topped with berries. For a savoury match, it serves as a wonderful companion to a goat cheese crostini or a summer salad with toasted walnuts and feta. It also acts as an extraordinary addition to a glass of sparkling wine or a refreshing Spritz.

title: Gray Monk Odyssey White Brut Sparkling
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' sparkling wine originates from Canada, within the esteemed Okanagan Valley A.V.A. of British Columbia. Crafted by Gray Monk Estate Winery a pioneer in British Columbia viticulture founded in 1972 by George and Trudy Heiss the Odyssey series represents the winery’s reserve tier focused on traditional method sparkling and small-lot winemaking. Sourced from choice vineyard blocks in the Central and Northern Okanagan Valley, the vines are rooted in glacial till, gravelly silt-loam, and calcium-rich limestone subsoils. The region’s unique northern marginal climate combines intense summer sunlight and long daylight hours with crisp, cooling breezes off Okanagan Lake, allowing white and red sparkling varieties to develop rich fruit concentration while retaining an electric, razor-sharp natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Gray Monk Odyssey Sparkling presents a brilliant, pale lemon-gold color in the glass with a fine, persistent, and energetic stream of delicate bubbles (mousse). Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a classical and sophisticated portrait of cool-climate traditional method sparkling wine. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of green apple, crisp Asian pear, and Meyer lemon zest, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of freshly baked brioche, toasted almond, lemon curd, crushed limestone, and a subtle trace of white floral blossoms. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of orchard stone fruits, citrus peel, and autolytic warmth. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that drives a weightless, deep development. The mouthfeel is creamy, fine-textured, and supple, carrying into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of lime peel, toasted hazelnut, and chalk.

title: Luxardo Sangue Morlacco Cherry Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Luxardo Sangue Morlacco Cherry Liqueur originates from Italy, within the northern region of Veneto in the subregion of Torreglia. Established in 1821 by Girolamo Luxardo in Zara, the historic company was relocated to Veneto following the devastation of the Second World War. Today, the legendary family owned enterprise is managed by the sixth generation of the Luxardo family, preserving centuries old traditions in the production of fine cherry liqueurs and maraschino.

Spirit Description

This fruit liqueur exhibits a deep, dark ruby red appearance with dense garnet reflections in the glass. The sensory profile presents a rich, aromatic nose driven by ripe Marasca cherry juice, dark plum, and sweet almond, accompanied by subtle hints of baking spices. On the palate, the body is full, syrupy, and luscious, delivering a vibrant balance of intense sweet cherry fruit, light tart acidity, and underlying dark chocolate notes. The finish is remarkably long, warm, and velvety, leaving a trailing sweetness accented by persistent red fruit and delicate oak spice. This expression is matured in oak vats and is traditionally bottled at an alcohol by volume of 30%.

Food Pairing

The intense Marasca cherry concentration and balanced acidity of this liqueur make it a versatile pairing partner for rich desserts and savoury dishes alike. It pairs magnificently with dark chocolate tarts, vanilla bean ice cream, or classic cherry cheesecake where the rich fruit cuts through creaminess. For a savoury match, it serves as a wonderful glaze for roasted duck breast, pork tenderloin, or alongside a platter of blue cheeses and aged Gouda.

title: Edinburgh Raspberry Gin – 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Edinburgh Raspberry Gin Liqueur is a popular fruit-infused spirit crafted by the Edinburgh Distillery in Edinburgh, Scotland. Founded in 2010 and now operating under Ian Macleod Distillers, the distillery is famous for its pioneering role in the modern gin revival and fruit liqueur category. Created by infusing classic Edinburgh Gin with natural Perthshire raspberries, this expression captures the legendary fruit-growing heritage of Scotland's East Coast, delivering a sweet, vibrant, and tart berry profile.

Spirit Description

Edinburgh Raspberry Gin Liqueur begins with the brand's core London Dry gin base—distilled in traditional copper pot stills using classic botanicals including juniper, coriander seed, angelica root, and native Scottish milk thistle. Fresh, locally harvested Perthshire raspberries and sugar are added, allowing the natural juices and deep fruit flavors to infuse into the spirit over several weeks. The result is a lush, berry-forward liqueur that maintains a crisp juniper backbone beneath its vibrant fruit sweetness.

  • Colour: Deep ruby red to vibrant dark magenta.

  • Aroma: Intensely aromatic and fruity, opening with fresh crushed raspberries, raspberry jam, and tart redcurrants, underlaid by subtle piney juniper and citrus zest.

  • Palate: Rich, sweet, and bursting with fresh fruit on the entry. Upfront flavors of ripe summer raspberries and raspberry tart blend seamlessly into subtle notes of crisp juniper, orange peel, and gentle baking spice.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, velvety, and syrupy mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Smooth, sweet, and lingering, trailing off with persistent notes of natural raspberry pulp, balanced by a clean, crisp botanical dryness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 20% ABV (40 Proof).

title: Gordon's Premium Pink Gin
bodyHtml:
Gordon's Premium Pink Distilled Gin is a popular fruit-forward gin produced by Alexander Gordon & Co., a brand owned by global spirits giant Diageo. Inspired by an original 1880s recipe created by Alexander Gordon, the expression was launched in 2017 to cater to the growing global demand for flavored, lower-ABV, and berry-infused spirits. Combining the classic juniper-heavy foundation of Gordon's London Dry Gin with the natural flavors of red fruits, it offers a accessible, sweet, and vibrant alternative to traditional gins.

Spirit Description

Gordon's Premium Pink Gin is crafted starting with the core Gordon's London Dry spirit base, which utilizes a grain neutral spirit distilled with a classic botanical blend featuring Tuscan juniper berries, coriander seed, angelica root, and liquorice. Natural fruit flavorings derived from real raspberries, strawberries, and redcurrants are then infused into the gin, along with a delicate touch of sweetness. The resulting spirit offers a berry-heavy profile backed by subtle piney juniper.

  • Colour: Soft translucent blush pink.

  • Aroma: Bright, sweet, and highly aromatic, leading with sweet strawberry jams, ripe raspberries, and tangy redcurrants, underlaid by a subtle hint of piney juniper and citrus.

  • Palate: Smooth, sweet, and fruit-driven on the entry. Dominant flavors of fresh strawberry and tart raspberry fill the palate, followed by light redcurrant crispness and a gentle, soft juniper warmth.

  • Body: Light-to-medium-bodied with a smooth, approachable, and slightly sweet mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Medium in length, clean, and refreshing, leaving trailing notes of sweet berry pulp, subtle tart citrus, and a mild botanical dry snap.

  • ABV: Bottled at 37.5% ABV (75 Proof)

title: Wild Life Blackberry Gin
bodyHtml:
Wild Life Blackberry Gin is a craft botanical spirit produced by Wild Life Distillery in Canmore, Alberta, Canada. Located in the heart of the Canadian Rockies, the distillery was founded by local enthusiasts Keith Robinson and Matt Widmer with a philosophy centered on 100% local grain sourcing and authentic craft production. This seasonal release infuses Wild Life's signature Alberta-distilled gin with real fruit, offering a rich, tart, and berry-forward spirit inspired by mountain landscapes and wild harvests.

Spirit Description

Wild Life Blackberry Gin begins with a base gin crafted from 100% Alberta-grown wheat and malted barley, copper pot-distilled on-site with classic gin botanicals including juniper, coriander, angelica, citrus peel, and mountain flora. Whole blackberries are then steeped into the finished gin, allowing the natural sugars, vibrant fruit juices, and dark berry colors to integrate into the spirit. Bottled without cloying artificial syrups, it delivers an authentic balance of piney juniper structure and ripe berry tartness.

  • Colour: Deep ruby red to rich garnet with dark violet hues.

  • Aroma: Vibrant and fruit-forward, opening with fresh crushed blackberries, ripe plum, and jammy dark berries, grounded by crisp piney juniper, citrus zest, and subtle earthy botanicals.

  • Palate: Rich, tart, and juicy on the entry. Upfront flavors of dark blackberry, sweet tartness, and wild berries give way to resinous juniper, subtle coriander spice, and clean grain structure without sticky sweetness.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, velvety, and fruit-rich texture.

  • Finish: Crisp, medium-long, and refreshing, leaving lingering notes of dark berry skin, subtle citrus, and a dry, piney gin snap.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40%

title: Anohka Timeless Gin
bodyHtml:
Anohka Timeless Dry Gin is an award-winning craft gin produced by Anohka West-Indian Small Batch Distilling in Parkland County, Alberta, Canada (near Edmonton). Founded by Gurpreet Ranu, a former intellectual property lawyer turned master distiller, Anohka merges science with traditional distillation techniques. Named "Timeless" to reflect its classic London Dry inspiration, this expression is distilled on-site from grain to glass using locally sourced Alberta malted barley, earning international acclaim for its exceptional purity and robust botanical harmony.

Spirit Description

Anohka Timeless Dry Gin is crafted from a base spirit distilled in-house from 100% Alberta barley. The spirit is infused with a precise blend of 10 botanicals using traditional copper pot distillation. The botanical bill features Tuscan juniper, coriander seed, angelica root, orris root, cassia bark, chamomile, fresh lemon peel, and fresh lime peel. Because it uses a rich malted barley base distillate, it carries a unique depth, weight, and silky mouthfeel compared to gins made with standard commercial neutral grain spirits.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and pristine.

  • Aroma: Bold, classic, and fragrant, opening with crisp, resinous Tuscan juniper, followed by bright fresh lemon and lime citrus, delicate chamomile floral notes, and a warm baking spice backbone from cassia bark.

  • Palate: Rich, oily, and exceptionally smooth on the entry. Dominant piney juniper and zesty citrus yield to subtle sweet malt notes, earthy roots, and a warm, delicate spice from coriander and cassia.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a remarkably smooth, viscous, and mouth-coating texture derived from its malted barley base.

  • Finish: Crisp, long, and dry, leaving lingering pine, bright citrus oils, gentle pepper warmth, and a subtle earthiness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 47% ABV (94 Proof).

title: Meukow XO Ice Panther Cognac
bodyHtml:
This Cognac originates from France, produced in the prestigious Cognac region. Founded in 1862 by two Silesian brothers, Auguste-Christophe and Gustav Meukow, the House of Meukow is currently owned by the independent family enterprise Compagnie de Bruyère (CDG Group). Celebrated for its signature panther motif on the bottle, the brand blends tradition and contemporary design, utilizing eaux-de-vie sourced primarily from the top crus of Grande Champagne and Petite Champagne.

Spirit Description

This expression displays a deep mahogany colour with rich amber highlights in the glass. The nose is lush and complex, opening with fragrant notes of candied orange, dried fruit, walnut, and floral jasmine, leading into deeper aromas of vanilla, warm leather, cocoa, and toasted oak. On the palate, it is full-bodied and velvety, delivering a rich texture filled with flavours of dried fig, prune, warm spices, and cinnamon, perfectly balanced by elegant rancio and balanced oak structure. The finish is remarkably long, smooth, and warming, carrying subtle notes of dark chocolate, spice, and aged wood. Bottled at an ABV of 40%, it offers outstanding harmony, depth, and spirit balance.

title: Larbre Mediterranean Gin – 700 ml
bodyHtml:
L'Arbre Mediterranean Gin is a craft gin produced by Teichenné Liquors in Bellvei del Penedès (Tarragona), Spain. Drawing inspiration from the Mediterranean coastline, the expression is named "L'Arbre" (Catalan for "The Tree") to symbolize the brand's family roots and deep connection to the land. Formulated to capture the essence of coastal Mediterranean botany, it balances traditional juniper with fresh citrus, aromatic herbs, and local flora.

Spirit Description

L'Arbre Mediterranean Gin is distilled in copper pot stills using high-grade grain neutral spirit infused with Mediterranean botanicals. The blend includes juniper berries, coriander, lemon peel, sweet orange peel, rosemary, thyme, lavender, and angelica root. The result is a bright, highly aromatic gin where herbaceous green notes and sun-ripened citrus harmoniously complement the piney juniper core.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and transparent.

  • Aroma: Fresh, herbaceous, and aromatic, opening with vibrant juniper, sweet orange blossom, and fresh lemon zest, underpinned by fragrant wild rosemary, thyme, and delicate lavender.

  • Palate: Smooth, balanced, and fresh on the entry. Crisp juniper and sweet citrus yield to savory herbal undertones of rosemary and thyme, with a soft floral touch from lavender and a subtle earthy grounding from angelica.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a clean, smooth, and rounded mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Crisp, dry, and medium-long, leaving trailing notes of Mediterranean herbs, citrus peel, and a soft peppery spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 41% ABV (82 Proof).

title: Gunderloch Fritz's Dry Riesling 2025
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Germany, within the legendary Roter Hang ("Red Slope") sector of the Rheinhessen region along the Rhine River. Crafted by Weingut Gunderloch, a historic estate managed by Johannes Hasselbach, this bottling is dedicated to the legacy of his late father, the world-renowned winemaker Fritz Hasselbach. Sourced from steep, south-east facing hillside vineyards situated between Nackenheim and Nierstein, the vines are rooted in iconic red slate and sandstone soils (Rotliegend). The proximity to the river, intense solar reflection, and heat-retaining red slate create an ideal microclimate, enabling Riesling to develop lush stone-fruit flavors while retaining an electric, mineral-driven backbone of natural acidity.

Wine Description

Gunderloch Fritz's Dry Riesling presents a brilliant, pale straw-gold color in the glass with striking greenish-silver highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a crisp, energetic, and highly expressive portrait of red-slate Riesling. The bouquet opens with a captivating display of juicy white peaches, green apples, and pink grapefruit, seamlessly layered with delicate floral undertones of orange blossom, lemongrass, wild herbs, and a signature line of crushed red slate minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard stone fruits, citrus peel, and subtle tropical nuances. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is weightless, athletic, and supple, carrying into a long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of lime zest, flint, and a touch of savory slate drive.

title: Deinhard Green Label Riesling 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Germany, within the world-famous Mosel (and Pfalz) wine regions celebrated for producing some of the most vibrant white wines on Earth. Deinhard, a historic producer founded in Koblenz in 1794 by Johann Friedrich Deinhard, represents over two centuries of German winemaking tradition and global renown. Sourced from choice vineyard slopes characterized by steep, slate-rich soils (Schiefer) along river valleys, the vines thrive in a cool continental climate. Long, gradual growing seasons with sunny daytime exposure balanced by cool nightly breezes allow the late-ripening Riesling grape to develop complex, aromatic citrus-oil and stone-fruit precursors while retaining a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity and a distinct slate-minerality.

Wine Description

Deinhard Riesling presents a brilliant, pale straw-yellow appearance in the glass with vivid chartreuse and greenish-silver shimmers at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and expressive, delivering a classic, highly energetic portrait of German Riesling. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh green apple, white peach, and ripe juicy pear, seamlessly layered with delicate floral undertones of jasmine, lemongrass, orange blossom, and a signature line of crushed slate and wet stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard fruits, lemon zest, and subtle apricot. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the palate, creating an off-dry to dry textural dynamic with a perfectly balanced, barely perceptible touch of residual fruit sweetness. The mouthfeel is weightless, athletic, and supple, carrying into a long, clean, and refreshing finish accented by lingering notes of lime peel and mineral drive.

title: Saxum Broken Stones 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California’s Paso Robles region, specifically within the Willow Creek District subregion, Saxum Broken Stones 2022 represents one of Central Coast’s most coveted cult wines. Founded by Justin Smith in 2002, Saxum Vineyards is renowned for producing exceptionally pure, block-selected Rhone style blends with organic and biodynamic farming practices. The philosophy centers on minimal cellar intervention to showcase the steep, lime rich shale soils and unique microclimates of the Willow Creek District.

Wine Description

The wine shows an opaque, deep purple black colour with vibrant violet highlights. A broad and expressive bouquet reveals aromas of ripe blackberry, dark plum, crushed rocks, liquid smoke, and dried herbs, framed by hints of lavender, cracked black pepper, and subtle toasted oak. On the palate, it delivers a rich, voluptuous, and layered profile brimming with concentrated dark berry fruit, sweet cocoa, and savoury garrigue supported by a core of vibrant natural acidity. Full bodied in structure, it flows into an extraordinarily long, broad finish anchored by fine, chalky, fine-grained tannins. Composed primarily of Syrah blended with small components of Mataro, Graciano, Grenache, and Petite Sirah, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2040. Stylistically, it combines profound fruit intensity and concentration with remarkable freshness and mineral nuance.

title: Carter Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon Beckstoffer Las Piedras Vineyard ‘La Verdad’ 2021
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California’s Napa Valley, specifically within the St. Helena subregion, Carter Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon Beckstoffer Las Piedras Vineyard 'La Verdad' 2021 represents a benchmark expression of single-vineyard Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon. Founded by Mark Carter and crafted in collaboration with acclaimed winemaker Russell Bevan, Carter Cellars is dedicated to producing small-lot, highly concentrated wines from premier vineyard blocks. The historic Beckstoffer Las Piedras Vineyard, renowned as the first vineyard planted in St. Helena, features well-draining gravelly soils that stress the vines to yield fruit of extraordinary depth, power, and mineral purity.

Wine Description

The wine displays an inky, dark purple-black colour in the glass. An expressive and seductive nose reveals aromas of ripe dark currants, black cherries, and blueberries, interwoven with notes of fresh violet, crushed stone, graphite, dark chocolate, and subtle dried tobacco. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied, multi-layered experience packed with concentrated black and blue fruit, scorched earth undertones, and remarkable structural depth. Muscular yet finely integrated, ultra-fine tannins lift the mid-palate, carrying through to a long, velvety, and opulent finish. Composed of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2027–2050. Stylistically, it effortlessly balances immense fruit concentration and power with elegance, precision, and gravelly minerality.

title: Dunn Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon Howell Mountain 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California’s Napa Valley, specifically within the high-altitude Howell Mountain subregion, Dunn Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon Howell Mountain is a landmark expression of mountain-grown Cabernet. Founded in 1979 by Randy Dunn and now co-managed alongside his son Mike Dunn, the winery has earned iconic status for producing unapologetically age-worthy, structured wines. The estate vineyards sit high above the fog line on red volcanic soils, benefiting from intense sunlight and dramatic day-to-night temperature shifts that yield small berries packed with flavor, acidity, and tannin.

Wine Description

The wine shows a deep, opaque purple-black colour in the glass. The nose is brooding, complex, and distinctively mountain-driven, offering classic aromas of creme de cassis, wild blackberry, and crushed stone, intertwined with hints of bay leaf, cedar, menthol, and graphite. On the palate, it delivers an intense, full-bodied experience packed with concentrated dark fruit, savory mountain herbs, and a firm mineral core. Broad and muscular, its powerful structure is anchored by dense, firm-grained tannins and bright, refreshing acidity that carries through to an extraordinarily long, earth-toned finish. Composed of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2028–2055. Stylistically, it epitomizes classical Howell Mountain power, combining immense concentration and tannic architecture with precision, longevity, and freshness.

title: Annex Force Majeure 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Force Majeure is the flagship New England IPA from Calgary’s Annex Ale Project, widely regarded as one of the defining beers of the Alberta craft scene. Crafted as an uncompromised showcase of modern hop saturation, the name a legal term describing an unpredictable, unavoidable event nods to the sheer, unstoppable burst of hop flavor packed into every can. Annex built its reputation on technical precision and bold flavor profiles, and Force Majeure stands as their gold standard for the NEIPA / Hazy IPA style: thick, juicy, and intensely aromatic without relying on harsh bitterness.

Beer Description

Force Majeure pours a thick, luminous, opaque pastel-yellow with a dense, persistent white foam head that leaves heavy rings of lace as it drops.

Aroma: The nose is an immediate, room-filling explosion of ripe tropical fruit. It leads with dominant notes of sweet mango, passion fruit, and fleshy papaya, complemented by bright top notes of tangerine peel and pink grapefruit. Beneath the fruit, there is a distinct, soft graininess reminiscent of sweet flaked oats.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-to-full bodied with a strikingly silky, "pillowy" texture. It opens with a wave of lush tropical stone fruit, candied orange, and guava, flowing into a soft, velvety mid-palate. Bitterness is kept extremely low and rounded, finishing clean, smooth, and fruit-forward with zero hop burn.

Profile: It sits at a substantial 6.9% ABV with a low, restrained IBUs profile that prioritizes hop flavor and aroma saturation over tongue-scraping bitterness.

Technical Notes: The signature heavy haze and luxurious body stem from a grain bill loaded with flaked oats and malted wheat alongside standard pale malt. Annex utilizes a aggressive double dry-hopping (DDH) regimen centered on oil-rich Pacific Northwest hops, predominantly Citra and Mosaic. By timing dry-hop additions during active fermentation, the brewery takes advantage of yeast biotransformation unlocking deep, complex ester-hop synergies while keeping bitter resins out of the final liquid.

title: Faiveley Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from France, within the prestigious Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru A.O.C. appellation of Burgundy's Côte de Nuits. Domaine Faiveley, one of Burgundy's most legendary and historic family-owned estates founded in 1825, holds three choice parcels within this famous 50-hectare walled Grand Cru enclosure. Totaling over 1.2 hectares, Faiveley’s plots are situated in the upper and mid-slopes of the Clos resting on deep limestone beds mixed with gravelly, iron-rich clay and marl. This prized position ensures excellent drainage and optimal sun exposure, allowing Pinot Noir to achieve intense phenolic maturity, deep structural density, and remarkable age-worthy power.

Wine Description

The 2022 Domaine Faiveley Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru presents a deep, luminous garnet-ruby color in the glass with bright violet shimmers at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering a textbook expression of Grand Cru Côte de Nuits muscle and refinement with the generous, solar touch of the 2022 vintage. The bouquet opens with a captivating, multi-layered display of wild black cherries, dark forest berries, and ripe red plums, seamlessly integrated with complex underlays of dried violets, sweet pipe tobacco, damp earth, truffle, crushed limestone, and a subtle touch of toasted French cedarwood. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, muscular, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent, mouth-coating core of dark stone fruits, blood orange peel, and dark cocoa. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that drives a vertical, deep development. The mouthfeel is broad, athletic, and linear, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that carry into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of iron, spices, and forest floor.

This high-definition Burgundian expression is 100% Pinot Noir, harvested meticulously by hand at peak physiological maturity. Following rigorous double sorting at the winery, the fruit was partially destemmed and underwent cold pre-fermentation maceration in custom wooden vats. Alcoholic fermentation took place with native yeasts, utilizing gentle daily punch-downs (pigeage) to extract fine phenolics and deep color without harsh extraction. To polish its formidable structural tannins while respecting pure Grand Cru elegance, the wine completed malolactic conversion and was matured for 16 to 18 months in French oak barriques (around 50% to 60% new wood selected from top coopers). It reaches an effortlessly balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5% to 14.0% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage across Burgundy is celebrated as a stellar, rich, and beautifully balanced growing season characterized by abundant sunshine and warm summer conditions. High daytime temperatures enabled Pinot Noir to achieve ideal sugar development and deep skin phenolics, while cool nights and timely late-summer rains preserved crucial natural acidity and energetic aromatic precursors. Domaine Faiveley harvested healthy, perfectly ripe fruit with excellent skin-to-juice ratios. The resulting 2022 Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru combines plush solar richness and velvety mid-palate density with noble structural grip, built to evolve and improve in a cellar over the next 15 to 25+ years.

title: Domaine Faiveley Corton Clos des Cortons Grand Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
This prestigious Monopole Grand Cru red wine originates from France, within the Corton appellation in the Côte de Beaune subregion of Burgundy. Founded in 1825, Domaine Faiveley is one of Burgundy's largest and most historic family-owned estates, managed today by seventh-generation siblings Erwan and Eve Faiveley. Clos des Cortons Faiveley holds a unique status in French wine law: it is one of only two Grand Crus in Burgundy that bears the name of its proprietor alongside the vineyard designation. Situated on steep, east-facing mid-slopes rich in iron-dense red clay and Oxfordian limestone in Ladoix-Serrigny, this 2.76-hectare walled vineyard (clos) produces a powerful, highly structured expression of Pinot Noir.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2023 vintage displays a deep, luminous garnet-ruby color with violet highlights. The nose is intense, complex, and noble, opening with layered aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, and cassis, interwoven with notes of crushed rose petals, forest floor, game, crushed limestone minerality, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, concentrated, and muscular, showcasing the signature power of Corton balanced by Faiveley’s modern refinement. Dense, fine-grained tannins build across the palate, supported by vibrant natural acidity and a long, saline, mineral-driven finish. Crafted from 100% Pinot Noir (sourced from vines planted as early as 1936), the hand-harvested grapes undergo meticulous sorting and partial whole-cluster fermentation in custom wooden vats. The wine is aged for 16 to 18 months in French oak barrels (approximately 50% new) in the estate’s 19th-century cellars in Nuits-Saint-Georges. The alcohol by volume sits at 13.5%.

Food Pairing

The impressive structural depth, firm tannic backbone, and complex savory aromatics of this Grand Cru Pinot Noir call for rich, sophisticated game and meat dishes. It pairs magnificently with roasted rack of venison, slow-braised beef bourguignon, pan-seared duck breast with cherry reduction, roasted rack of lamb, and wild boar stew. For cheese pairings, opt for traditional washed-rind or aged Burgundian cheeses such as Époisses, Ami du Chambertin, Cîteaux, or mature Comté.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage across the Côte de Beaune produced Pinot Noirs defined by generous fruit expression, vibrant freshness, and smooth structural integration. A warm summer permitted complete, uniform phenolic ripening without severe water stress, allowing iron-rich terroirs like Clos des Cortons to develop deep aromatic weight while preserving precise acidity. The 2023 Domaine Faiveley Corton Clos des Cortons Faiveley combines immediate aromatic charm with immense concentration, making it a benchmark cellar-worthy Grand Cru that will evolve and improve gracefully over 15 to 25+ years.

title: Antinori Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 'Pian delle Vigne Vignaferrovia' 2018
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the esteemed Brunello di Montalcino Riserva D.O.C.G. appellation of southern Tuscany. Produced under the historic Marchesi Antinori mantle at their Pian delle Vigne estate, this single-vineyard Riserva represents the pinnacle of the property’s production. The six-hectare Vignaferrovia plot sits adjacent to an old 19th-century railway station, characterized by well-draining soils rich in clay, limestone, and small stones (galestro and albarese). Positioned on gentle slopes south of Montalcino, the site benefits from generous Mediterranean warmth balanced by cool nightly air currents from the Mount Amiata region. This unique microclimate enables Sangiovese Grosso (Brunello) to undergo an extended, balanced ripening cycle, accumulating intense phenolic complexity while building a formidable, age-worthy tannic structure.

Wine Description

The 2018 Antinori Pian delle Vigne 'Vignaferrovia' Brunello di Montalcino Riserva presents a luminous, deep garnet-ruby color in the glass with brick and terracotta highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an elegant, nuanced portrayal of high-tier Montalcino Sangiovese. The bouquet opens with a captivating, multi-layered display of dried sour cherries, wild red plums, and tart cranberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of sweet tobacco leaf, leather, star anise, crushed terra cotta earth, orange zest, and a subtle trace of dark cocoa and sweet cedarwood. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, taut, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of red stone fruits, blood orange peel, and warm baking spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is linear, athletic, and supple, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky Sangiovese tannins that carry into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of iron, dried herbs, and truffle.

This high-definition Tuscan expression is 100% Sangiovese Grosso, harvested meticulously by hand in small crates with strict double sorting. Following gentle destemming and crushing, the fruit underwent temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks with maceration on the skins extending for over three weeks to extract fine phenolics. To polish its firm structural frame while respecting varietal purity, the wine completed malolactic conversion and was matured for over two years in traditional French oak casks (botti) and small barrels, followed by extended bottle resting to meet the stringent five-year aging requirement for Riserva release. It reaches an effortlessly balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 14.0% to 14.5% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2018 vintage in Montalcino was a classic, cooler-toned year that favored elegance, aromatic precision, and fresh acidity over sheer heat-driven weight. Spring and summer brought balanced temperatures with timely rainfall, followed by warm, dry weather during late August and September with pronounced day-to-night temperature drops. This enabled Sangiovese grapes to achieve complete phenolic maturity while preserving bright natural acidity and vibrant floral-fruit precursors. Marchesi Antinori harvested healthy, low-yielding fruit at peak balance. The resulting 2018 'Vignaferrovia' Riserva combines classical structural length and savory tension with polished depth, built to evolve and improve gracefully in a cellar over the next 15 to 25+ years.

title: Overture By Opus One 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California’s prestigious Napa Valley, specifically within the Oakville subregion, Overture by Opus One 2022 is an iconic second wine from one of Napa’s most celebrated estates. Opus One was born in 1979 from a historic partnership between Baron Philippe de Rothschild of Château Mouton Rothschild and Napa Valley winemaking pioneer Robert Mondavi. Crafted under the direction of winemaker Michael Silacci, the estate’s winemaking philosophy focuses on combining French winemaking tradition with prime Oakville terroir to produce wines of exceptional precision, balance, and grace.

Wine Description

The wine presents a vibrant, deep ruby colour with purple reflections. The nose opens with a complex, crystalline bouquet featuring bright cherry, wild blueberry, and cut rose stems, accented by hints of violet, toasted almond, anise, and subtle cinnamon bark. On the palate, it delivers a voluptuous yet refined structure showing lush blackberry, wild cherry, and blackcurrant supported by a tangy, refreshing acidity and fine-grained, powdery tannins. Full bodied in profile, it glides into a long, finessed finish highlighted by lingering notes of mocha and black tea. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon alongside small portions of Cabernet Franc, Merlot, and Petit Verdot, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2038. Stylistically, it strikes a seamless balance between classic Napa power and vibrant, fresh-fruit elegance.

title: Cascina Penna Currado Nebbiolo D'Alba Superiore 'San Sebastiano' 2023
bodyHtml:
Cascina Penna-Currado Nebbiolo d'Alba Superiore 'San Sebastiano' 2023 originates from Italy, within the Piedmont region and the Nebbiolo d'Alba DOC subregion. Founded by Luca Currado Vietti and Elena Penna following their departure from the historic Vietti estate, this artisanal project is headquartered in Monforte d'Alba. The 'San Sebastiano' bottling is sourced from older vines (ranging from 15 to 65 years old) surrounding the San Sebastiano Chapel in Monforte d'Alba. Benefiting from the cooler microclimate and longer maturation period required by the Superiore designation, the wine spends 12 months aging in oak casks, essentially serving as a "Baby Barolo" in structure and longevity.

Wine Description

This red wine displays an intense garnet red colour. The nose opens with expressive aromas of red cherry, wild raspberry, and wild strawberry, complemented by ethereal floral notes of rose petals and violets alongside accents of lavender, sage, and graphite minerality. On the palate, it exhibits a medium body with an elegant, streamlined texture, where dark varietal fruit and bright citrus notes are supported by firm, silky tannins and vibrant acidity. Stylistically, the 2023 vintage balances the structural seriousness of Monforte d'Alba with fruit purity, finishing long and persistent with lingering savory spice and crushed stone minerality.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Nebbiolo

  • Alcohol by volume: 14.0%

title: Cascina Penna Currado Langhe Nebbiolo 'Bricco Lago' 2023
bodyHtml:
Cascina Penna-Currado Langhe Nebbiolo 'Bricco Lago' 2023 originates from Italy, within the Piedmont region and the Langhe DOC subregion. The estate represents a venture founded by Luca Currado Vietti and Elena Penna (formerly of the iconic Vietti winery), establishing their boutique family project in Monforte d'Alba. Sourced from vines in the San Sebastiano hamlet that range from 15 to 65 years of age, the 'Bricco Lago' site cascades down toward the only natural lake in the Langhe, characterized by clay and limestone soils that yield wines of classic Monforte structure and elegance.

Wine Description

This red wine displays an intense, translucent garnet colour. The nose opens with aromatic notes of wild raspberry, tart cherry, and wild strawberry, accompanied by floral accents of rose petal and violet alongside subtle nuances of blood orange, crushed stone, and baking spice. On the palate, it exhibits a medium body with a bright, linear texture, supported by chalky, high-quality tannins and energetic, mouthwatering acidity. Stylistically, the 2023 vintage combines the structural seriousness typical of Monforte d'Alba with fresh, crunchy red fruit purity, concluding with a persistent, savory finish carrying notes of citrus zest and earthy spice.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Nebbiolo

  • Alcohol by volume: 14.0%

title: Bruno Rocca Barbaresco 'Rabaja' Riserva 2019
bodyHtml:
Bruno Rocca Barbaresco 'Rabajà' Riserva 2019 originates from Italy, within the Piedmont region and the Barbaresco DOCG subregion. Sourced from the estate's oldest vines (planted in the 1950s) within the legendary Rabajà cru, this bottling represents the pinnacle of the Bruno Rocca portfolio. Produced only in exceptional vintages, the Riserva undergoes extended oak aging—spending 24 to 36 months maturing in large French oak casks followed by additional bottle aging prior to release—to achieve extraordinary structural depth, longevity, and site expressiveness.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep, brilliant ruby-garnet colour. The nose is remarkably complex and captivating, delivering layered aromas of dark plum, wild raspberry, pomegranate, and blood orange, accompanied by notes of pipe tobacco, graphite, ashy minerals, dried roses, and subtle cedar spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied and tightly wound, showing remarkable focus, tension, and power. A core of red fruit and mineral salinity is framed by vibrant, crystalline acidity and firm, fine-meshed, dusty tannins. Stylistically, this standout 2019 Riserva offers extraordinary drive, structure, and length, built for decades of aging.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Nebbiolo

  • Alcohol by volume: 14.0%

title: Brovia Barolo 2019
bodyHtml:
Brovia Barolo originates from Italy, within the Piedmont region and the Barolo DOCG subregion, specifically sourced from historic vineyards in Castiglione Falletto and Serralunga d'Alba. Founded in 1863 by Giacinto Brovia, the estate remains a benchmark producer of classical, unmanipulated Barolo under the stewardship of the Brovia family. Practicing organic farming and low-intervention winemaking, Brovia ages its traditional Barolo in large neutral Slavonian oak casks (botte), producing deeply site-expressive wines renowned for their balance, elegance, and incredible aging potential.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a bright, translucent ruby-garnet colour with characteristic brick orange reflections. The nose is highly complex, lifted, and traditional, offering expressive aromas of tart red cherry, crushed cranberry, and dried rose petals, layered with savory notes of forest floor, tar, white truffle, leather, and orange peel. On the palate, it features a medium body with a taut, energetic texture, underpinned by vibrant acidity and firm, fine-grained, chalky Nebbiolo tannins. Stylistically, the wine emphasizes elegance, transparency, and structural precision over extraction, finishing long, dry, and mineral-driven with lingering red fruit and earthy spice.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Nebbiolo

  • Alcohol by volume: 14.5%

  • Organic status: Certified Organic

title: La Crema Russian River Valley Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This classic California white wine originates from the United States, within the premier Russian River Valley AVA in Sonoma County. Established in 1979, La Crema has long been recognized as a trailblazer for cool-climate Chardonnay and Pinot Noir in California. The Russian River Valley is uniquely influenced by marine fog pulling in daily from the Pacific Ocean through the Petaluma Gap, allowing for extended hang-time where grapes achieve full phenolic maturity while preserving precise natural acidity. Sourced from various estate and partner vineyards across the AVA's famous Goldridge sandy loam soils, this bottling serves as a benchmark for the region's hallmark rich yet balanced style.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2024 vintage presents a brilliant medium-gold hue with pale straw reflections. The nose opens with an inviting and classic bouquet of ripe Gala apple, Meyer lemon curd, and white peach, layered alongside fragrant jasmine, toasted hazelnut, brioche, and sweet vanilla spice from oak maturation. On the palate, it is full-bodied, opulent, and creamy, yet maintained by a core of bright, refreshing acidity that keeps the lushness in harmony. Flavors of tropical fruit, lemon oil, and baking spices carry through to a long, supple, and buttery finish. Crafted as a 100% Chardonnay varietal expression, the hand-harvested grapes are gently whole-cluster pressed and barrel-fermented in French oak (roughly 30% to 35% new). The wine undergoes complete malolactic fermentation and is aged on its lees with regular stirring (bâtonnage) for 8 to 10 months to enhance mouthfeel and textural richness. The alcohol by volume sits at approximately 14.2%.

Food Pairing

The creamy texture, vibrant citrus profile, and warm oak spices of this Russian River Chardonnay make it a versatile and decadent match for rich culinary dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with butter-poached lobster, pan-seared sea scallops, Dungeness crab cakes, and grilled halibut with lemon-herb butter sauce. Structurally, its weight and acidity also complement roasted chicken or turkey with creamy pan gravy, wild mushroom risotto, pork chops with apples, and soft cheeses like Brie, Camembert, or creamy Fontina.

title: Ken Wright Pinot Noir Carter Vineyard 2024
bodyHtml:
Ken Wright Pinot Noir Carter Vineyard originates from the United States, within Oregon's Willamette Valley region and the Eola-Amity Hills AVA subregion. Founded in 1994 by winemaking pioneer Ken Wright, the estate focuses on single-vineyard expressions that showcase the distinct soil and climatic profiles of northern Oregon. Planted in 1983 on shallow, volcanic Jory and Nekia soils with basalt mother rock, Carter Vineyard sits at an elevation of 325 feet facing south-southwest. The site benefits from cool marine breezes entering through the Van Duzer Corridor, producing a darker, highly concentrated, and earth-driven expression of Pinot Noir.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep, translucent ruby-garnet colour. The nose is expressive and dark-fruit driven, opening with aromas of ripe blackberry, black cherry, cassis, and blueberry, accompanied by floral accents of violets, a hint of vanilla, cola, and subtle sweet baking spices. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full body with a broad, generous texture supported by firm, moderate tannins and lively, refreshing acidity. Stylistically, the wine delivers a harmonious balance between intense blue and black berry fruit, savory earthiness, and structured tension, leading into a long, polished finish carrying notes of dark cherry and subtle cocoa.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Pinot Noir

  • Alcohol by volume: 13.5%

title: Lost Lore FTR AEW (All Elite Wrestling) Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
This additive free, high proof reposado tequila originates from Mexico, produced in the Los Altos region of Jalisco. Created as a collaborative release between Lost Lore founder Arturo Lamas III and the All Elite Wrestling (AEW) tag team FTR (Dax Harwood and Cash Wheeler), this expression is crafted by Master Distiller Sergio Cruz at the celebrated Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados distillery (NOM 1414) in Arandas. The tequila is made from 100% estate grown Blue Weber agave that is slow cooked in traditional stone brick ovens, fermented in stainless steel vats with champagne yeast, double distilled in copper pot stills, aged in charred American white oak whiskey barrels, and finished with Japanese Mizunara oak chips.

Spirit Description

This high proof reposado presents a pale straw gold appearance with a rich, oily texture that coats the glass. The aroma is complex and aromatic, opening with vibrant sweet cooked agave and fresh cucumber, balanced by wet stone minerality, gentle sandalwood incense, and soft floral undertones. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied and bold arrival where the higher proof carries flavours of sweet roasted agave, baking spices, and a bright burst of sharp white pepper, supported by exotic notes of sandalwood, gentle oak warmth, and light vanilla. The finish is long, warm, and lingering, carrying notes of spicy pepper, sweet agave, and subtle toasted wood. Bottled at a high proof strength of 49% ABV (98 proof), this limited release offers exceptional character, intensity, and spirit balance.

title: Lost Lore SOS (Southern Ontario Sippers) Cask 004 Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
This additive free, higher proof blanco tequila originates from Mexico, produced in the Los Altos region of Jalisco. Founded by Arturo Lamas III to honour his family's agave heritage, the spirit is crafted under Master Distiller Sergio Cruz at the renowned Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados distillery (NOM 1414) in Arandas. Selected as a special single cask release for the Southern Ontario Sippers (SOS) community group, this expression is made from mature Highland Blue Weber agave cooked in traditional stone and brick ovens, open air fermented with champagne yeast, and double distilled in copper pot stills.

Spirit Description

This unaged single cask tequila presents a crystal clear, luminous appearance with rich viscosity in the glass. The nose opens with expressive notes of sweet cooked agave, vibrant lime peel, and garden herbs, supported by wet stone minerality, subtle olive brine, and cracked black pepper. On the palate, it delivers a full, slightly oily mouthfeel that balances intense roasted agave sweetness with citrus zest, spearmint, and earthy minerality, underscored by concentrated pepper spice. The finish is long, warming, and savoury, leaving a lingering impression of sweet agave, herbal freshness, subtle salinity, and pepper spice. Bottled at a higher strength of 46% ABV, this Cask 004 release offers exceptional intensity, texture, and spirit balance.

title: Mission Hill Compendium 2017
bodyHtml:
Mission Hill Compendium 2017 originates from Canada, within the British Columbia region and the Okanagan Valley subregion. Founded by Anthony von Mandl, Mission Hill Family Estate has established itself as an iconic producer showcasing the unique microclimates and porous, nutrient poor soils of the valley. The winery focuses on sustainable farming and precision viticulture, selecting fruit for its Legacy Collection from designated vineyard blocks in Osoyoos to craft cellar worthy wines.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, dark ruby colour. The nose offers concentrated aromas of cassis, black cherry, licorice, and bramble fruit framed by subtle oak spice and earthy accents. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a harmonious attack, structured by dense, sweet, and elegant tannins. Stylistically, the wine displays remarkable balance and fruit intensity despite a warm growing season, balancing its rich dark fruit profile with fresh acidity and long term complexity. The finish is sleek, persistent, and well balanced.

  • Varietal composition: 62% Cabernet Sauvignon, 29% Merlot, 9% Cabernet Franc

  • Alcohol by volume: 14.6%

title: Mission Hill Compendium 2013
bodyHtml:
Mission Hill Compendium 2013 originates from Canada, within the British Columbia region and the Okanagan Valley subregion. Founded by Anthony von Mandl, Mission Hill Family Estate has established itself as an iconic producer showcasing the unique microclimates and porous, nutrient poor soils of the valley. The winery focuses on sustainable farming and precision viticulture, selecting fruit for its Legacy Collection from designated vineyard blocks in Osoyoos and Oliver to craft cellar worthy wines.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, concentrated ruby colour. The nose offers complex, upfront aromas of red currant, black currant, Italian plum, star anise, cassis, and wild blueberry framed by hints of dried herbs and subtle oak. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a refined, supple texture supported by firm structure and polished tannins. Stylistically, the wine displays remarkable balance, concentration, and fresh acidity, finishing with persistent length and elegant fruit and oak integration.

  • Varietal composition: 44% Cabernet Sauvignon, 41% Merlot, 14% Cabernet Franc, 1% Petit Verdot

  • Alcohol by volume: 14.5%

title: Chateau Lafite Rothschild 2011
bodyHtml:
