Château Lafite Rothschild 2011 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the Pauillac AOC subregion. As one of the five First Growth (Premier Grand Cru Classé) estates from the historic 1855 Classification, Lafite Rothschild is renowned globally for producing Cabernet Sauvignon-dominant wines of unmatched elegance, balance, and aging potential. Following the iconic, warm 2009 and 2010 vintages, 2011 was a classic, cooler year in Bordeaux characterized by an exceptionally dry spring, a erratic summer, and a hot late August, requiring meticulous selection to yield a wine defined by precision and structure.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep ruby-garnet colour with a dark core. The nose is complex and classic, opening with noble aromas of dark cassis, black cherry, and plum, intertwined with signature Pauillac accents of pencil lead, cedar, tobacco leaf, crushed violets, and subtle earthy graphite. On the palate, it exhibits a medium-to-full body with a tightly woven, polished texture, supported by firm, fine-grained tannins and bright, fresh acidity. Stylistically, the 2011 vintage presents a classic, linear, and aristocratic Lafite profile—less plush than 2009/2010, but showing extraordinary focus, refined minerality, and a long, classic finish.

  • Varietal composition: 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Merlot

  • Alcohol by volume: 12.5%

title: Chateau Lafite Rothschild 2013
bodyHtml:
Château Lafite Rothschild 2013 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the Pauillac AOC subregion. As one of the five First Growth (Premier Grand Cru Classé) estates from the historic 1855 Classification, Lafite Rothschild is renowned globally for producing Cabernet Sauvignon-dominant wines of unmatched elegance, balance, and aging potential. The 2013 vintage posed significant challenges across Bordeaux due to a cool spring and wet harvesting conditions, prompting rigorous sorting and a higher proportion of Cabernet Sauvignon to maintain the estate's signature finesse and structure.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a translucent, dark ruby colour with garnet reflections at the rim. The nose is refined and subtle, opening with aromas of fresh red currant, dark cherry, and cassis, intertwined with signature Pauillac notes of cedar wood, graphite, pencil shavings, tobacco leaf, and crushed violets. On the palate, it exhibits a light-to-medium body with a streamlined, precise texture, supported by delicate, fine-grained tannins and bright, lively acidity. Stylistically, the 2013 vintage favors classic restraint, transparency, and balance over power, offering a mid-weight, linear finish marked by persistent red fruit, cedar, and mineral salinity.

  • Varietal composition: 98% Cabernet Sauvignon, 2% Merlot

  • Alcohol by volume: 12.5%

title: Black Hills Estate Winery Hiatus Collection 'Ipso Facto' 2024
bodyHtml:
This intriguing small-lot red wine originates from Canada, crafted in the prestigious Black Sage Bench sub-appellation of the South Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. Founded in 1996, Black Hills Estate Winery is renowned as a benchmark producer of classic Bordeaux-style blends, famously led by their iconic flagship red, Nota Bene. The "Hiatus Collection" represents an experimental line of limited-production wines where the winemaking team steps outside traditional estate boundaries to explore creative cellaring techniques and unique varietal co-ferments. Ipso Facto (meaning "by the fact itself") was created to showcase an unconventional, harmony-driven blend that challenges conventional regional rules while remaining rooted in the warm, desert-like microclimate of Oliver and Osoyoos.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2024 Ipso Facto presents a dark ruby-garnet color with vibrant purple highlights near the rim. The nose opens with an expressive, aromatic bouquet of dark plum, ripe black cherry, and cassis, interwoven with notes of crushed sage, sweet tobacco, cocoa powder, and subtle baking spices from French oak aging. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, showing a lush, supple entry balanced by fine-grained tannins and a streak of fresh Okanagan natural acidity. Flavors of dark mountain berries, black olive, and subtle espresso grounds lead into a smooth, savory, and well-rounded finish. Blended primarily from Syrah and Cabernet Sauvignon (with small proportions of Merlot or Cabernet Franc depending on lot selection), the hand-harvested grapes undergo careful small-batch fermentation before aging in French oak barrels (combining neutral and second-use wood to preserve pure fruit character). The alcohol by volume sits at 14.2%.

Food Pairing

The supple fruit depth, savory herbal notes, and polished structure of this South Okanagan red blend make it a versatile pairing for hearty, flavorful cuisine. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb with herbs de Provence, duck breast with a plum reduction, and slow-braised beef short ribs. It also harmonizes beautifully with wild mushroom risotto, grilled venison, and aged hard cheeses such as sharp Cheddar, Gouda, or Gruyère.

title: La Stella Cabernet Sauvignon 'La Sophia'  2022
bodyHtml:
This rare, small-lot red wine originates from Canada, crafted in the Osoyoos and South Okanagan Valley regions of British Columbia. LaStella Winery, situated along Osoyoos Lake, blends Tuscan passion with Italianate winemaking philosophies to produce structured, food-friendly wines. Cabernet Sauvignon is notoriously difficult to ripen consistently in the northern latitude of the Okanagan Valley, making La Sophia an exclusive release produced only in vintages where heat accumulation permits full phenolic maturity. Stylistically, LaStella fashions La Sophia after the refined, structured Cabernet Sauvignons of coastal Tuscany (Bolgheri) and Washington State rather than the ultra-plush styles of Napa Valley.

Wine Description

In the glass, La Sophia exhibits a deep dark ruby-purple color with intense opacity. The expressive bouquet opens with classic Cabernet aromas of cassis, black cherry, and blackberry, layered with savory notes of dried sage, rosemary, cigar box tobacco, roasted coffee, and subtle vanilla spice from oak aging. On the palate, it is full-bodied, structured, and muscular, balancing dense dark fruit with a firm, chalky tannic backbone and vibrant natural acidity. Crafted as a 100% Cabernet Sauvignon varietal expression, the hand-selected grapes undergo small-lot fermentation followed by extended aging in French oak barrels (combining new and seasoned oak).

Food Pairing

The muscular structure, firm tannins, and savory herbal profile of this Okanagan Cabernet make it a natural pairing for prime red meats and rich, savory dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb with rosemary and garlic, braised beef short ribs, or venison loin with a dark fruit reduction. For vegetarian options, opt for hearty dishes like roasted portobello mushroom steaks or wild mushroom risotto, alongside aged hard cheeses like sharp Cheddar, Gouda, or aged Pecorino.

title: Manfredi Amaro - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Manfredi Amaro originates from Italy, within the southern region of Calabria. Produced by the renowned rural distillery Vecchio Magazzino Doganale, the spirit is crafted as a homage to historical recipes and regional botanical traditions. The house utilizes carefully selected indigenous herbs, roots, and citrus varieties harvested directly from the surrounding countryside to create its expressive Italian digestifs.

Spirit Description

This artisanal digestif displays a deep amber appearance with warm mahogany reflections in the glass. The aromatic nose opens with a complex, inviting bouquet of wild Calabrian herbs, bitter orange peel, licorice root, and subtle floral nuances, laced with gentle baking spices. On the palate, the body is rich, smooth, and remarkably well balanced, delivering a harmonious contrast between initial botanical sweetness and a deep, structured herbal bitterness. The finish is exceptionally long, dry, and warming, leaving trailing notes of citrus zest, dark spices, and persistent earthiness. This craft amaro is traditionally bottled at an alcohol by volume ranging between 25% and 30%.

Food Pairing

The complex bitterness and vibrant citrus structure of this amaro make it an ideal digestif after a rich meal. It pairs magnificently with dark chocolate desserts, espresso-infused tarts, or traditional almond biscotti that mirror its roasted spice notes. For a savoury pairing, it serves as an excellent companion to a cheese board featuring sharp, aged pecorino or blue cheeses alongside cured meats.

title: Hugel Classic Pinot Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from France, within the historic Alsace A.O.C. appellation tucked between the Vosges Mountains and the Rhine River. Famille Hugel, established in Riquewihr in 1639, is one of Alsace’s most revered winemaking dynasties, boasting over twelve generations of unbroken family ownership. Operating under a low-intervention, terroir-focused winemaking philosophy, Hugel is renowned for crafting dry, pure, and aromatic white wines that champion varietal typicity. Sourced from estate and contracted grower vineyards surrounding Riquewihr, the vines are rooted in a complex soil mosaic of clay-limestone, marl, and sandstone. Protected by the Vosges Mountains from ocean rain clouds, Alsace enjoys one of the driest, sunniest microclimates in France, allowing the Pinot Blanc and Auxerrois grapes to ripen slowly while retaining a vibrant, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Famille Hugel 'Classic' Pinot Blanc presents a brilliant, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with bright greenish-silver reflections. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a remarkably clean, fragrant, and energetic expression of classic Alsatian white wine. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh green apples, crunchy Bartlett pears, and juicy white peaches, seamlessly layered with delicate floral undertones of white blossom, lemongrass, fresh pastry dough, and a touch of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a refreshing core of orchard fruits, yellow plum, and citrus zest. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is supple, smooth, and supple, carrying into a clean, bone-dry, and quenching finish accented by lingering notes of green pear and cool stone minerality.

title: Sandeman 20 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
Sandeman 20 Year Old Tawny Port originates from Portugal, within the Douro region and the Porto subregion. Founded in 1790 by George Sandeman, the historic port house is famous for its iconic "Don" figure logo and operates today under the Sogrape portfolio under the stewardship of head winemaker Luís Sottomayor. The winery is celebrated for its mastery of barrel aging, selecting exceptional port wines to mature in traditional 600-litre oak casks at its centuries-old lodges in Vila Nova de Gaia to achieve ideal harmony between fruit and oak complexity.

Wine Description

This fortified wine displays an intense tawny-amber colour with warm copper highlights. The nose opens with an expansive bouquet of dried apricots, figs, toasted hazelnuts, candied orange peel, and honey, accompanied by subtle nuances of vanilla, brown sugar, and sweet baking spices. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a rich, silky texture balanced by a vibrant thread of acidity that lifts the sweetness. Stylistically, the wine combines power and refined elegance, seamlessly blending the freshness of younger component ports with the complex, nutty, and oxidative character of old oak-aged wines through a long, luxurious finish.

  • Varietal composition: Blend of traditional Douro grape varieties including Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz, Tinta Barroca, Touriga Nacional, and Tinta Cão

  • Alcohol by volume: 20.0%

title: Sandeman 30 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
Sandeman 30 Year Old Tawny Port originates from Portugal, within the Douro region and the Porto subregion. Founded in 1790 by George Sandeman, the historic port house is famous for its iconic 'Don' figure logo and operates today under the Sogrape portfolio under the stewardship of head winemaker Luís Sottomayor. The winery is celebrated for its mastery of barrel aging, selecting exceptional port wines to mature in traditional 600-litre oak casks at its centuries-old lodges in Vila Nova de Gaia to achieve ideal harmony between fruit and intense oak complexity.

Wine Description

This fortified wine displays an intense, deep tawny-amber colour with warm mahogany and golden highlights. The nose opens with an expansive bouquet of dried figs, dates, toasted walnuts, candied orange peel, and dark chocolate, accompanied by subtle nuances of cedar wood, roasted coffee, dried spices, and honey. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a rich, silky texture balanced by a vibrant thread of acidity that lifts the sweetness. Stylistically, the wine combines power and exceptional concentration, seamlessly blending the freshness of long-matured component ports with a complex, nutty, and oxidative character through a long, luxurious finish.

  • Varietal composition: Blend of traditional Douro grape varieties including Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz, Tinta Barroca, Touriga Nacional, and Tinta Cão

  • Alcohol by volume: 20.0%

title: Ken Wright Pinot Noir Savoya 2024
bodyHtml:
Ken Wright Pinot Noir Savoya 2024 originates from the United States, within Oregon's Willamette Valley region and the Yamhill Carlton AVA subregion. Founded in 1994 by winemaking pioneer Ken Wright, the winery focuses on single vineyard bottlings that highlight the distinct soil profiles across northern Oregon. Savoya Vineyard, planted on shallow marine sedimentary soils (Willakenzie series), is known for producing Pinot Noir with great structural integrity, dark fruit intensity, and expressive floral and spice aromatics.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a translucent, deep ruby colour. The nose is expressive and complex, presenting aromas of black cherry, dark plum, and blueberry compote, accompanied by notes of violet blossoms, forest floor, black tea, and sweet baking spices. On the palate, it features a medium to full body with a rich, satiny texture, underpinned by fine grained, firm tannins and balancing acidity. Stylistically, the wine delivers a harmonious balance between dark berry purity, savory earthiness, and refined structure, concluding with a long, elegant finish marked by lingering fruit and spice.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Pinot Noir

  • Alcohol by volume: 13.5%

title: Ken Wright Chardonnay Williamette Valley 2024
bodyHtml:
Ken Wright Chardonnay Willamette Valley 2024 originates from the United States, within Oregon's Willamette Valley region. Founded in 1994 by winemaking pioneer Ken Wright, the winery is globally recognized for its site-specific Pinot Noir and small-lot Chardonnay. Drawing fruit from selected estate sites across the valley's premier sub-AVAs, this regional bottling highlights the unique combination of volcanic and marine sedimentary soils, cooled by Pacific ocean breezes to produce a balanced, expressive cool-climate Chardonnay.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a bright, pale straw-yellow colour with greenish reflections. The nose opens with inviting aromas of fresh green apple, crisp d'Anjou pear, and white peach, layered with floral white blossoms, lemon curd, and a touch of subtle toasted oak and crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it exhibits a medium body with a supple, lightly creamy texture balanced by crisp, mouthwatering acidity. Stylistically, the wine focuses on fruit purity and freshness, offering a long, clean finish accented by citrus zest and subtle mineral undertones.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Chardonnay

  • Alcohol by volume: 13.0%

title: Le Manzane Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore Brut
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' sparkling wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore D.O.C.G. appellation situated in the Veneto region. Produced by Le Manzane a revered family-run estate located in San Pietro di Feletto the winery operates under a precision-focused, eco-sustainable philosophy that showcases the steep, sun-drenched hillsides of the Prosecco heartland. Sourced exclusively from hillside vineyards (colline) featuring clay-limestone and sandstone soils, the vines experience warm daylight tempered by cool alpine breezes descending from the nearby Dolomites. This dramatic diurnal temperature variation allows the Glera grapes to develop rich aromatic precursors while retaining a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Le Manzane Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore Brut presents a luminous, pale straw-yellow appearance in the glass with bright greenish highlights and a fine, persistent perlage of delicate bubbles. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a masterfully clean and fragrant expression of top-tier DOCG Prosecco. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh Renetta apples, crisp Williams pears, and white peach, seamlessly layered with delicate floral undertones of wisteria, acacia blossom, lemon verbena, and a touch of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of orchard fruits, lime zest, and subtle green almond. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the delicate mid-palate mousse. The mouthfeel is creamy, weightless, and supple, carrying into a dry, refreshing, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of green apple and white flowers.

title: La Pranda Nebbiolo D'Alba 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from Italy, within the esteemed Nebbiolo d'Alba D.O.C. appellation of Piedmont's Langhe and Roero regions. Crafted under the La Pranda label, this cuvée represents an authentic, high-toned expression of Nebbiolo grown on the sandy, limestone-rich soils flanking both sides of the Tanaro River. The vines benefit from a temperate continental climate characterized by warm daytime temperatures and cool autumn evening breezes descending from the Alps. This distinct diurnal shift allows the late-ripening Nebbiolo grapes to achieve complete phenolic maturity while preserving bright, mouthwatering natural acidity and delicate floral aromatics.

Wine Description

La Pranda Nebbiolo d'Alba presents a bright, translucent garnet-ruby color in the glass with light orange shimmers at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and expressive, delivering a classic and approachable portrait of Piedmont's noble grape. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh wild strawberries, tart cherries, and crushed cranberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of dried rose petals, orange peel, anise, crushed limestone, and a subtle trace of forest floor. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of red fruits, pomegranate seeds, and white pepper. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that illuminates the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is energetic and linear, framed by fine-grained, youthful Nebbiolo tannins that carry into a clean, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by notes of dried herbs and wild flowers.

title: Gian Luca Colombo Segni Di Langa Barbera D'alba 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from Italy, within the esteemed Barbera d'Alba D.O.C. appellation of Piedmont's Langhe district. Gian Luca Colombo, awarded the prestigious Premio Gambelli in 2014 as Italy's best young winemaker, crafts this exceptional wine under his Segni di Langa project based in Roddi. Operating under an uncompromising, low-intervention, and organic-leaning philosophy, Colombo is celebrated for capturing pure varietal identity and terroir expression without heavy-handed oak intervention. Sourced from high-elevation, low-yielding old vineyards in the communes of Roddi and Verduno, the vines are rooted in Tortonian soils rich in calcareous marl and sand. The unique microclimate characterized by warm, sun-drenched summer days balanced by cool evening breezes off the Maritime Alps allows Barbera to achieve full phenolic maturity while preserving its signature, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Gian Luca Colombo-Segni di Langa Barbera d'Alba presents an intense, luminous ruby-purple color in the glass with vivid violet reflections at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an artisanal, highly energetic expression of top-tier Barbera. The bouquet opens with a vibrant, perfumed display of crushed dark plums, wild blackberries, and tart red cherries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of dried violets, crushed limestone, black pepper, graphite, and a subtle touch of Mediterranean scrub and orange zest. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of dark orchard fruits, pomegranate, and cocoa nibs. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, electric backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad yet weightless and supple, framed by fine-grained, silk-textured tannins that glide into a long, lip-smacking, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of dark berry compote and spice.

title: La Pranda Barolo 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Barolo D.O.C.G. appellation of Piedmont's Langhe district. Crafted under the La Pranda label, this cuvée embodies traditional Barolo winemaking, sourcing Nebbiolo from choice hillside vineyards across the classic communes of the zone. The vines are rooted in ancient Tortonian and Serravallian soils composed of calcareous marl, clay, and sandstone (calces, arenaria). Protected by the Alps and influenced by the thermal currents of the Tanaro River valley, the vineyards experience warm summer days and crisp, fog-covered autumn nights (nebbia). This dramatic diurnal shift enables the Nebbiolo grapes to undergo an extended ripening cycle, accumulating intense phenolic complexity while building a formidable, age-worthy tannic architecture.

Wine Description

La Pranda Barolo presents a luminous, pale garnet-ruby color in the glass with brick and orange shimmers along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a textbook expression of classic Langhe Nebbiolo. The bouquet opens with a captivating display of dried red roses, wild sour cherries, and tart cranberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of sweet tobacco leaf, leather, star anise, crushed limestone, and a signature line of tar, licorice, and damp forest floor. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, taut, and precisely focused, showcasing a bright core of red stone fruits, blood orange peel, and warm baking spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts through the mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is linear, muscular, and athletic, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky Nebbiolo tannins that carry into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of iron, dried herbs, and truffle.

title: Gian Luca Colombo Segni Di Langa Langhe Nebbiolo 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from Italy, within the esteemed Langhe D.O.C. appellation of Piedmont's iconic hills. Gian Luca Colombo, recipient of the prestigious Premio Gambelli in 2014 as Italy's best young winemaker, crafts this exceptional wine under his Segni di Langa project based in Roddi. Operating under a low-intervention, artisanal, and organic-leaning winemaking philosophy, Colombo is celebrated for capturing pure varietal identity and terroir expression with his personal touch (each bottle bearing his fingerprint on the label). Sourced from old Nebbiolo vineyards situated across the rolling hills of the Langhe, the vines are rooted in Tortonian soils rich in calcareous marl, sand, and limestone. The distinct microclimate characterized by warm, sun-drenched summer days balanced by cool evening breezes descending from the Alps allows Nebbiolo to achieve complete phenolic maturity while preserving bright, mouthwatering natural acidity and fine, silky tannins.

Wine Description

Gian Luca Colombo-Segni di Langa Langhe Nebbiolo presents a luminous, pale ruby-red color in the glass with bright garnet shimmers at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an artisanal, highly energetic expression of Piedmont's noble grape. The bouquet opens with a captivating, perfumed display of wild berries, tart red cherries, and crushed cranberries, seamlessly layered with delicate floral undertones of wilted rose petals, violet lift, forest floor, and subtle hints of sweet cinnamon bark and crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant, succulent core of pure stone fruits, blood orange zest, and herbal nuances. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that drives a vertical, deep development. The mouthfeel is weightless, athletic, and supple, framed by fine-grained, silky Nebbiolo tannins that glide smoothly across the palate into a long, dry, and mineral-accented finish.

title: Gian Luca Colombo Segni Di Langa Barolo 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Barolo D.O.C.G. appellation of Piedmont's Langhe district. Gian Luca Colombo, recipient of the prestigious Premio Gambelli in 2014 as Italy's best young winemaker, crafts this signature flagship bottling under his Segni di Langa project based in Roddi. Operating under an uncompromising, low-intervention, and organic-leaning philosophy, Colombo is celebrated for capturing raw terroir expression and varietal identity without heavy extraction or maskings of new oak. Sourced from choice, low-yielding old vineyards in the communes of Roddi and Verduno, the vines are rooted in Tortonian soils composed of calcareous marl, limestone, and sand. The site benefits from warm daytime sun tempered by dramatic evening breezes descending from the Maritime Alps, allowing Nebbiolo to undergo an extended ripening window that builds deep phenolic complexity and a formidable, age-worthy tannic structure.

Wine Description

Gian Luca Colombo-Segni di Langa Barolo presents a luminous, pale garnet-ruby color in the glass with light brick and terracotta highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an artisanal, highly transparent expression of classic Langhe Nebbiolo. The bouquet opens with a captivating, multi-faceted display of wild sour cherries, fresh cranberries, and crushed raspberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of dried rose petals, violet perfume, orange peel, sweet pipe tobacco, star anise, crushed limestone, and a signature line of tar and forest floor. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, taut, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of red stone fruits, blood orange zest, and cocoa. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts through the mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and athletic, framed by fine-grained, chalky Nebbiolo tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of iron, dried herbs, and truffle.

title: Napier Red Medallion 2018
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from South Africa, within the prized Wellington district of the Western Cape. Produced by Napier Single Vineyard Wines a estate founded in 1993 and named in honor of Sir George Napier, a historic Governor of the Cape of Good Hope this flagship bottling is modeled after the iconic, long-lived Bordeaux blends of the Left Bank. Operating under a terroir-driven, precision winemaking philosophy, Napier focuses on low yields, careful hand selection, and traditional aging techniques. Sourced from estate vineyards situated on the lower slopes of the Hawequa Mountains, the vines are rooted in deep, gravelly clay soils over decomposed granite. The unique microclimate features hot summer days tempered by cool afternoon breezes blowing off the Atlantic Ocean, allowing Cabernet Sauvignon and its classic blending partners to achieve complete phenolic maturity, rich concentration, and firm structural depth.

Wine Description

The 2018 Napier Red Medallion presents an opaque, deep garnet-purple appearance in the glass with rich ruby shimmers along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, deep, and high-toned, delivering a complex, full-bodied expression of Western Cape terroir. The bouquet opens with a generous display of crushed cassis, ripe black plums, and wild blackberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of cigar box, dark chocolate, graphite, sweet tobacco leaf, dried fynbos scrub, and a subtle touch of toasted cedar wood. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of black stone fruits, cocoa nibs, and savory spices. It is characterized by its outstanding fruit concentration and a balanced, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that lifts the rich mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and athletic, framed by sturdy, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that carry into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of iron, baking spice, and lingering dark berry compote.

title: Vina Otano Rioja 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from Spain, within the prestigious Rioja appellation (specifically the Rioja Alta sub-zone). Viña Otano is a historic family-owned estate with roots dating back to 1882 in Fuenmayor. Operating under a balance of traditional Riojan winemaking and modern precision viticulture, the estate focuses on low yields and old-vine purity. Sourced from estate vineyards situated in the rolling hills of Fuenmayor and Entrena, the vines are rooted in clay-limestone and iron-rich alluvial soils. The site enjoys a temperate microclimate where Atlantic maritime influences meet warm Mediterranean breezes, allowing Tempranillo and its traditional blending partners to achieve complete phenolic maturity while maintaining vibrant, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Viña Otano Rioja Crianza/Tinto presents a luminous, deep cherry-red color in the glass with bright ruby-violet shimmers along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and expressive, delivering a classic, fruit-forward, and well-structured portrait of Rioja Alta. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of fresh red plums, wild blackberries, and juicy red cherries, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of dried lavender, vanilla bean, sweet tobacco leaf, cocoa, and a touch of toasted cedarwood. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of red and black stone fruits, licorice, and subtle baking spice. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is energetic, smooth, and supple, framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins that glide into a clean, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of dark berry compote and subtle oak spice.

title: Primo 1861 Tequila Blanco
bodyHtml:
Primo 1861 Tequila Blanco is a highly sought-after, artisanal unaged tequila crafted in Arandas, within the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. Distilled at the renowned Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados distillery (NOM 1414), Primo 1861 was created by Felipe Camarena’s nephew, Pedro Camarena Jr., as a tribute to the family’s deep historical roots in agave cultivation dating back to 1861. Celebrated by tequila purists worldwide, it is an unadulterated, additive-free expression that showcases traditional production methods and pure Highland terroir.

Spirit Description

Primo 1861 is made from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves harvested at peak maturity in the iron-rich red clay soils of Los Altos. The agave piñas are slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens before being crushed using a combination of a roller mill and a traditional tahona wheel. Fermentation occurs in open-top pine wood vats using native wild yeast, after which the liquid undergoes double distillation in traditional copper pot stills. Unaged and free from any additives, it is bottled directly after distillation to preserve its bright, authentic agave profile.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and transparent with long, slow legs in the glass.

  • Aroma: Pungent and intensely aromatic, opening with rich cooked agave, fresh mint, bright lime zest, and grapefruit peel, backed by damp earth, white pepper, and a wet-stone mineral quality.

  • Palate: Full, vibrant, and oily on the entry. Upfront flavors of sweet roasted agave, citrus oil, and fresh herbal notes give way to black pepper, green olive brine, crisp minerality, and subtle floral undertones.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a rich, silky, and mouth-coating viscosity.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and clean, trailing off with lingering cooked agave sweetness, crisp black pepper spice, and a refreshing mineral dryness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 43% ABV (86 Proof).

title: Primo 1861 Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
Primo 1861 Tequila Reposado is an ultra-premium, artisanal aged spirit produced in Arandas, within the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the revered Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados distillery (NOM 1414) by Pedro Camarena Jr., this expression expands upon the brand's celebrated Blanco foundation. Designed for traditional agave purists, Primo 1861 Reposado bridges the gap between vibrant, raw agave character and delicate oak maturation, yielding an additive-free aged tequila of remarkable balance and nuance.

Spirit Description

Primo 1861 Reposado is made from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves harvested at peak maturity from the iron-rich soils of Los Altos. The agaves are slow-cooked in traditional stone brick ovens, crushed using a combination of a roller mill and a traditional tahona wheel, and fermented in open pine wood vats with natural yeasts. Following double distillation in copper pot stills, the distillate is aged for several months in hand-selected American white oak barrels—just long enough to introduce soft oak tannins and warm spice without obscuring the core Highland agave notes.

  • Colour: Pale straw to light golden amber with luminous golden reflections.

  • Aroma: Inviting and harmonious, opening with sweet cooked agave, soft vanilla, and subtle toasted oak, accompanied by bright citrus peel, baking spices, light floral notes, and a gentle earthy minerality.

  • Palate: Smooth, rich, and oily on the entry. Upfront flavors of roasted agave and buttery vanilla blend into light cinnamon, toasted almonds, citrus oil, and a touch of oak spice.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a velvety, coating mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and clean, trailing off with persistent sweet agave, soft oak tannins, gentle black pepper, and a subtle mineral dryness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 43% ABV (86 Proof).

title: Montagave Blanco Las Rocas Tequila
bodyHtml:
Montagave Blanco "Las Rocas" Tequila is a luxury, small-batch unaged spirit crafted in Amatitán, within the Lowlands (Valles) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Produced at the renowned Tequila Cascahuín distillery (NOM 1123) by Master Distiller Salvador "Chava" Rosales Trejo in collaboration with the Montagave brand founders, this expression represents an innovative fusion of traditional Mexican distillation and European winemaking heritage. Rested briefly in rare French oak casks that previously held Grand Cru red wine from Bordeaux, France, "Las Rocas" delivers a remarkably refined, additive-free blanco profile.

Spirit Description

Montagave Blanco Las Rocas is made from 100% Blue Weber agaves harvested at peak maturity in the Valles region. The agaves are slow-cooked in traditional masonry brick ovens, crushed using a combination of a traditional stone tahona wheel and a roller mill, and fermented in open-air vats. Following double distillation in copper pot stills, the unaged blanco distillate is rested for a short period (under 60 days, maintaining its Blanco classification) in hand-selected French oak Bordeaux wine barrels. This subtle barrel rest introduces delicate red fruit, floral, and soft oak nuances without altering the spirit's clear appearance or masking its vibrant Lowland agave core.

  • Colour: Crystal clear with faint, luminous straw-silver flashes and slow, elegant legs.

  • Aroma: Complex, floral, and highly aromatic. The nose opens with sweet cooked agave, fresh lime zest, and wet-stone minerality, backed by delicate aromas of red berries, dried rose petals, subtle French oak, and white pepper.

  • Palate: Silky, vibrant, and elegant on the entry. Upfront flavors of rich roasted agave and bright citrus yield to subtle dark cherry, red currant, soft vanilla, and a gentle oak tannin structure balanced by Lowland earthy minerality.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a soft, rounded, and velvety texture.

  • Finish: Long, crisp, and clean, trailing off with lingering sweet agave, red fruit undertones, mild pepper spice, and a dry, refreshing mineral snap.

  • ABV: Bottled at 41% ABV (82 Proof)

title: Los Siete Misterios Espadin Mexicanito Mezcal
bodyHtml:
This mezcal originates from Mexico, produced in the Sola de Vega region of Oaxaca. The brand Los Siete Misterios was founded in 2010 by brothers Eduardo and Julio Reséndiz to preserve traditional mezcal making methods. Crafted by artisanal mezcaleros, this expression features a rare co-fermentation and co-distillation of cultivated Espadín and wild Mexicanito agaves. The agaves are cooked in underground stone pits, hand milled using wooden mallets, natural open air fermented in wooden vats, and double distilled in traditional clay pot stills.

Spirit Description

This unaged mezcal presents a crystal clear appearance with rich viscosity. The aroma is complex and expressive, opening with notes of roasted agave, subtle earthiness, wet clay, and soft campfire smoke, complimented by bright herbal tones, citrus, and wild greenery. On the palate, it offers a medium to full body with a smooth, velvety mouthfeel. Sweet agave, herbal green pepper, and tropical fruit flavours are balanced by delicate mineral nuances, subtle ash, and spicy cracked black pepper. The finish is long, warm, and persistent, leaving behind lingering notes of sweet cooked agave, earth, and delicate smoke.

title: Montagave Blanco Heritage Rose Tequila
bodyHtml:
Montagave Blanco Heritage Rosé Tequila is an artisanal, small-batch spirit produced in Amatitán, within the Lowlands (Valles) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Distilled at the acclaimed Tequila Cascahuín distillery (NOM 1123) by Master Distiller Salvador "Chava" Rosales Trejo in partnership with the Montagave founders, this expression builds upon the brand's signature wine-cask maturation style. Rested in hand-selected French oak casks previously used to age fine Bordeaux red wine, this additive-free expression retains its Blanco classification while displaying a delicate naturally tinted hue and complex fruit-forward aromatics.

Spirit Description

Montagave Blanco Heritage Rosé begins with 100% Blue Weber agaves harvested in the Lowlands. The agaves are slow-cooked in traditional masonry brick ovens, crushed using a combination of a traditional stone tahona wheel and roller mill, and fermented in open-air vats. Following double distillation in copper pot stills, the unaged spirit is rested for a short duration (under 60 days) in French oak Grand Cru red wine barrels from Bordeaux. This resting period infuses the spirit with a subtle blush tone and complex layers of red fruit, floral elegance, and soft wood tannins while maintaining the underlying Lowland agave character.

  • Colour: Delicate pale blush pink with soft rose-gold reflections and thick, slow-moving legs.

  • Aroma: Elegant and aromatic, opening with sweet cooked agave, fresh strawberries, and red cherries, backed by citrus peel, soft rose petals, subtle vanilla, and wet-stone minerality.

  • Palate: Silky, supple, and refined on the entry. Upfront flavors of rich roasted agave and bright lime zest give way to fresh raspberries, red currants, subtle oak tannin, and a gentle white pepper warmth.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a soft, rounded, and velvety mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Crisp, long, and clean, tapering off with lingering sweet agave, subtle red wine notes, gentle spice, and a dry mineral snap.

  • ABV: Bottled at 41% ABV (82 Proof).

title: Montagave Reposado 'Canadian Edition' Tequila
bodyHtml:
Montagave Reposado "Canadian Edition" Tequila is a highly exclusive, small-batch aged spirit produced in Amatitán, within the Lowlands (Valles) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the revered Tequila Cascahuín distillery (NOM 1123) by Master Distiller Salvador "Chava" Rosales Trejo in collaboration with the Montagave brand founders, this expression is a specialized variation of their award-winning barrel-aged line. Tailored specifically for the Canadian market and craft spirits collectors, it combines traditional Lowland agave distillation with bespoke wine-and-spirit cask finishing.

Spirit Description

Montagave Reposado "Canadian Edition" is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agaves harvested at peak maturity in the mineral-rich soils of the Lowlands. The agaves are slow-cooked in traditional masonry brick ovens and crushed using a combination of a traditional stone tahona wheel and a roller mill. Following open-air vat fermentation and double distillation in copper pot stills, the spirit undergoes a multi-month maturation process in hand-selected French oak casks previously holding fine red wine, often finished or accented with select rye or spirit cask influence for the Canadian release. Unadulterated and additive-free, it bridges Lowland agave earthiness with soft oak tannins and warm spice.

  • Colour: Warm honeyed amber with soft rose-gold and copper highlights.

  • Aroma: Rich and aromatic, opening with sweet cooked agave, ripe red berries, and dried plums, complemented by toasted oak, soft vanilla, nutmeg, and a gentle Lowland mineral backdrop.

  • Palate: Velvety, rich, and well-structured on the entry. Upfront flavors of roasted agave and butterscotch blend into dark cherry, subtle rye baking spice, toasted oak, and vanilla bean.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a supple, coating, and elegant mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and refined, trailing off with lingering sweet agave, soft wood tannins, baking spices, and a clean, dry mineral snap.

  • ABV: Bottled at 41% ABV (82 Proof).

title: Los Siete Misterios Espadin Cuishe Mezcal
bodyHtml:
This mezcal originates from Mexico, produced in the region of Oaxaca. The brand Los Siete Misterios was founded in 2010 by brothers Eduardo and Julio Reséndiz to celebrate traditional Mexican mezcal heritage. This ensamble expression is crafted in San Dionisio Ocotepec by blending cultivated Espadín agave with wild Cuishe agave, a tall tree like variety from the Agave karwinskii species. The agaves are slow roasted in underground earth ovens with wood and river stones, crushed using a traditional tahona mill, fermented in wooden tanks, and double distilled in copper pot stills.

Spirit Description

This unaged spirit displays a clear, luminous appearance in the glass. The aroma is complex and expressive, opening with notes of smoked cooked agave, sweet herbs, and subtle brine, layered with dry earth, wild greenery, and citrus peel. On the palate, it delivers a rich, smooth mouthfeel with excellent harmony between the two agaves. Sweet, smoky Espadín notes mingle with the savoury, mineral, and woody herbal character of the Cuishe, supported by underlying flavours of citrus zest and black pepper spice. The finish is long, warm, and evolving, leaving a lingering impression of sweet cooked agave, delicate smoke, and earth.

title: Los Siete Misterios Espadin Tepeztate Mezcal
bodyHtml:
This mezcal originates from Mexico, produced in the region of Oaxaca. The brand Los Siete Misterios was founded in 2010 by brothers Eduardo and Julio Reséndiz with a mission to preserve and celebrate traditional Oaxacan mezcal heritage. This ensamble expression combines cultivated Espadín agave with wild Tepeztate agave, a rare variety harvested from steep rocky cliffs that can take up to 25 to 35 years to mature. The agaves are slow roasted in underground stone pits, crushed using a traditional tahona, natural open air fermented in wooden vats, and double distilled in copper pot stills.

Spirit Description

This crystal clear unaged mezcal presents a clean and luminous appearance. The aroma is highly complex and distinctively aromatic, driven by the pungent, green, and floral characteristics of wild Tepeztate, combined with notes of sweet cooked agave, damp earth, jalapeno pepper, and a subtle veil of wood smoke. On the palate, it offers a medium to full body with a smooth, velvety mouthfeel. Flavours of sweet agave, wet stone, and wild tropical herbs are accented by bright lime zest, jalapeño pepper, and a touch of brine. The finish is long, warm, and lingering, carrying accents of fresh bell pepper, mineral earth, and delicate smoke. Bottled at an ABV of approximately 45%, this ensamble displays remarkable depth, herbal freshness, and spirit balance.

title: Iconoclast Chardonnay 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Napa Valley A.V.A. (specifically incorporating high-elevation and cool-climate sub-appellations such as Mount Veeder and Los Carneros). Produced under the exclusive Iconoclast label crafted by Chimney Rock's acclaimed winemaking team this bottling was created to challenge conventional style norms by balancing modern California richness with European structural tension. Sourced from choice vineyard blocks featuring well-draining volcanic tufa, gravelly loam, and clay soils, the vines benefit from sunny, high-altitude exposure tempered by cool maritime fog rolling off San Pablo Bay. This unique microclimate allows the Chardonnay grapes to undergo a long, gradual ripening season, accumulating intense tropical citrus concentration while locking in a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Iconoclast Chardonnay presents a luminous, bright straw-gold color in the glass with shimmering chartreuse reflections. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a refined, balanced, and precise expression of Napa Valley Chardonnay. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of green apple, crisp Golden Delicious, Meyer lemon, and white peach, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of toasted hazelnut, lemon curd, orange blossom, warm brioche, and a touch of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of orchard stone fruits, citrus oils, and subtle vanilla spice. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is creamy yet weightless and supple, carrying into a long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of lemon peel, roasted nuts, and subtle French oak spice.

title: Iconoclast Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Napa Valley A.V.A. (specifically utilizing fruit from benchland and mountain sites across the valley, crafted under the supervision of Chimney Rock's acclaimed winemaking team). Produced under the exclusive Iconoclast label, this bottling was created to challenge conventional style norms by balancing modern California power and velvety black-fruit intensity with classical European structural restraint and balance. Sourced from choice vineyard blocks featuring well-draining volcanic tufa, gravelly loam, and iron-rich soils, the vines benefit from warm, sun-drenched days tempered by cool afternoon breezes and morning fog off San Pablo Bay. This microclimate allows Cabernet Sauvignon and its classic Bordeaux blending partners to achieve complete phenolic maturity, building dense fruit concentration and a firm structural frame.

Wine Description

Iconoclast Cabernet Sauvignon presents an intense, opaque purple-black color in the glass with bright ruby-garnet highlights at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, deep, and high-toned, offering a concentrated, complex, and precisely focused expression of Napa Valley Cabernet. The bouquet opens with a lavish display of crème de cassis, wild blackberries, and dark plum compote, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of cigar box, dark chocolate, graphite, sweet pipe tobacco, dried sage, and a subtle touch of toasted oak wood. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and powerfully structured, showcasing a succulent, mouth-coating core of black stone fruits, cocoa nibs, and savory spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its rich mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is broad, muscular, and athletic, driven by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of dark berry compote, iron, and toasted cedar.

title: Domaine Michel Gros Nuits Saint Georges Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from France, within the prestigious Nuits-Saint-Georges 1er Cru A.O.C. appellation of Burgundy's Côte de Nuits. Domaine Michel Gros, a historic estate headquartered in Vosne-Romanée, represents six generations of Burgundian winemaking excellence. Sourced from the estate's prized Premier Cru parcels within Nuits-Saint-Georges including notable holdings like Les Chaliots and Les Vignerondes the vines are rooted in clay-limestone soils mixed with bajocian limestone scree and iron-rich marl. Positioned on east-facing slopes that capture optimal morning sunlight while benefiting from cool airflow off the Hautes-Côtes, this singular terroir yields Pinot Noir of exceptional structural stamina, mineral depth, and refined aromatic precision.

Wine Description

The 2023 Domaine Michel Gros Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Cru presents a brilliant, deep garnet-ruby color in the glass with vivid magenta reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a masterfully focused and noble portrayal of Côte de Nuits terroir. The bouquet opens with a captivating display of wild black cherries, tart red currants, and dark forest raspberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of crushed violets, sweet tobacco leaf, game, damp forest floor, dark cocoa, and a distinctive line of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, muscular, and precisely focused, showcasing a dense, succulent core of dark stone fruits, blood orange zest, and sweet spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is linear, athletic, and supple, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of iron, truffle, and toasted French oak spice.

This high-definition Burgundian expression is 100% Pinot Noir, harvested meticulously by hand at peak physiological maturity. Following rigorous double sorting, the fruit was destemmed and underwent cold pre-fermentation maceration in temperature-controlled vats. Alcoholic fermentation took place using native and selected yeasts with gentle punch-downs (pigeage) and pump-overs (remontage) to extract fine phenolics without harshness. To polish its firm structural tannins while honoring pure varietal identity, the wine completed malolactic conversion and was matured for approximately 16 to 18 months in French oak barrels (around 30% to 50% new wood from top cooperages). It reaches an effortlessly balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 13.0% to 13.5% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage across Burgundy delivered a generous, high-quality crop defined by a warm summer and ideal harvest conditions in September. Cool night breezes preserved crucial natural acidity and fine floral-fruit aromas, while sun-filled days ensured complete phenolic maturity in Pinot Noir skins. Michel Gros harvested pristine, healthy fruit with excellent juice-to-skin ratios. The resulting 2023 Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Cru combines classical Burgundian freshness and elegance with powerful mid-palate structure, built to age and evolve gracefully in a cellar over the next 12 to 20+ years.

title: Domaine Michel Gros Chambolle Musigny 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from France, within the celebrated Chambolle-Musigny A.O.C. appellation of Burgundy's Côte de Nuits. Domaine Michel Gros, a historic estate headquartered in Vosne-Romanée, represents six generations of winemaking heritage. Renowned for capturing the ultimate expression of delicacy and aromatic elegance, the estate’s holdings in Chambolle-Musigny are situated on steep, east-facing slopes where thin, rocky topsoils rest directly upon hard Jurassic limestone and active marl. This highly specific terroir provides natural drainage and reflects ambient heat, allowing Pinot Noir to achieve effortless phenolic maturity while retaining a laser-focused, mouthwatering natural acidity and an unmistakably ethereal floral perfume.

Wine Description

The 2023 Domaine Michel Gros Chambolle-Musigny presents a luminous, brilliant ruby-red color in the glass with shimmering magenta highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering the signature "iron fist in a velvet glove" archetype for which Chambolle is famous. The bouquet opens with a captivating, perfumed display of fresh red raspberries, wild strawberries, and tart red cherries, seamlessly layered with delicate floral undertones of crushed violets, dried rose petals, sweet cinnamon, damp forest floor, and a distinct touch of crushed limestone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent, silky core of red stone fruits, blood orange zest, and subtle exotic spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that drives a weightless, deep development. The mouthfeel is athletic, supple, and gliding, framed by ultrafine, chalky Nebbiolo-like or Pinot Noir tannins that carry into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish.

This high-definition Burgundian expression is 100% Pinot Noir, harvested meticulously by hand at peak physiological maturity. Following double sorting at the winery, the fruit was destemmed and underwent a cold pre-fermentation maceration in temperature-controlled vats to extract delicate floral and fruit aromatics. Fermentation proceeded with indigenous and selected yeasts, utilizing gentle pump-overs to preserve purity of fruit. To polish its structural frame while respecting varietal finesse, the wine completed malolactic conversion and was matured for approximately 16 months in French oak barrels (around 30% new wood from renowned coopers). It reaches an effortlessly balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 13.0% to 13.5% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage across the Côte de Nuits delivered a classic, high-energy profile for Pinot Noir. Generous sunshine throughout August ensured complete phenolic skin maturation, while cool, clear night winds preserved vital natural acidity and intense floral precursors in the berries. Domaine Michel Gros harvested pristine, healthy fruit with outstanding skin-to-juice balance. The resulting 2023 Chambolle-Musigny combines immediate, perfume-driven charm with a chiseled structural frame, built for delicious drinking upon release or cellaring over the next 8 to 15 years.

title: Cascahuin Reposado Siete Veces Diez Limited Edition
bodyHtml:
This limited edition reposado tequila originates from Mexico, produced in the El Arenal region of Jalisco. The spirit was created to commemorate the second generation of the Cascahuín family, specifically honouring General Director Engineer Salvador Rosales Torres on his 70th birthday. Crafted at the historic Cascahuín distillery (NOM 1123), this expression is composed of a unique blend of three distinct blanco tequilas made at the facility, each aged separately in American oak casks for 190 days before being blended together.

Spirit Description

This tequila displays a delicate light gold hue with bright silver nuances. The aroma is rich and inviting, offering dominant sweet cooked agave alongside notes of tropical fruit, citrus zest, cinnamon, nutmeg, and subtle oak woodiness. On the palate, it delivers a full, silky, and buttery mouthfeel that balances sweet and savoury elements, bringing flavours of roasted agave, pralines, honey, caramel, and baked fruit alongside a kick of black pepper, clove, and warm baking spices. The finish is long, clean, and warm, leaving a gentle trail of lingering sweet agave, light oak, and peppery spice. Bottled at an ABV of 45%, this cask aged release offers exceptional harmony, complexity, and spirit balance.

title: Lost Lore Port Cask Strength Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
This cask strength reposado tequila originates from Mexico, produced in the Los Altos region of Jalisco. Conceived by brand founder Arturo Lamas III and crafted by Master Distiller Sergio Cruz at the renowned Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados distillery (NOM 1414) in Arandas, the additive free spirit honours traditional family distilling heritage. Made from estate grown Highland Blue Weber agave cooked in stone brick ovens, open air fermented, and double distilled in copper pot stills, it is aged in American white oak barrels before undergoing a finishing period in hand selected Spanish port wine casks.

Spirit Description

This expression presents a brilliant amber rose gold colour with a rich, oily texture. The aroma opens with sweet cooked agave, jammy red berries, and ripe plums from the port barrel, complemented by soft cinnamon, dark honey, toasted almonds, and a dry hint of black pepper. On the palate, it is full bodied and well structured, offering rich flavours of roasted agave, juicy berry jam, dark fruit, and baking spices balanced by citrus notes and warm oak spice. The finish is long, smooth, and warm, leaving lingering notes of red fruit, peppery spice, and sweet agave. Bottled at a cask strength ABV of 48%, this unadulterated tequila delivers remarkable depth, vibrant balance, and refined complexity.

title: Lost Lore Hasta La Raiz Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
This additive free blanco tequila originates from Mexico, produced in the Los Altos region of Jalisco. Conceived by founder Arturo Lamas III to honour his family's lost distilling heritage, the expression is crafted by Master Distiller Sergio Cruz at the esteemed Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados distillery (NOM 1414) in Arandas. Translated as 'to the roots', the spirit is made from 100% estate grown Blue Weber agave that is cooked in traditional stone brick ovens, open air fermented with champagne yeast, and double distilled in copper pot stills.

Spirit Description

This unaged tequila presents a crystal clear, shimmering appearance in the glass. The nose opens with vibrant cooked agave, bright lime, and grapefruit zest, supported by notes of wet stone minerality, fresh herbs, mint, and cracked black pepper. On the palate, it delivers a medium body with a silky and rounded mouthfeel. Dominant sweet agave flavours take center stage alongside vegetal accents, zesty tropical citrus, and a warming dose of black pepper spice. The finish is crisp, clean, and lingering, leaving behind a pleasant peppery tingle and lasting agave sweetness. Bottled at an ABV of 40%, it offers an authentic, mineral driven profile with superb balance and freshness.

title: Petit Vega '18 Meses En Barrica' 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from Spain, within the prestigious Ribera del Duero D.O. appellation situated along the elevated high-altitude plateau (Meseta Norte) of Castile and León. Produced under the Petit Vega label by Bodegas y Viñedos Vega de Yuso, this cuvée represents a quintessential expression of modern yet deeply rooted Ribera del Duero winemaking. Sourced from choice old-vine plots in Quintanilla de Onésimo and surrounding valleys, the vines sit at elevations between 750 and 850 meters above sea level, rooted in nutrient-poor soils composed of limestone, clay, and gravelly alluvial deposits. The harsh extreme-continental climate features blistering summer days and dramatically cold nights (diurnal shift), extending the ripening season and allowing Tempranillo to build deep dark-fruit pigments, firm structural tannins, and an exceptionally vibrant natural acidity.

Wine Description

Petit Vega '18 Meses en Barrica' presents an opaque, intense cherry-black color in the glass with vivid violet-garnet shimmers along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, complex, and high-toned, offering a concentrated and sophisticated portrait of high-altitude Ribera del Duero. The bouquet opens with a lavish display of crushed cassis, dark plum compote, and wild blackberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of roasted espresso bean, dark cocoa, sweet pipe tobacco, graphite, vanilla pod, and subtle toasted cedarwood spice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and powerfully focused, showcasing a succulent, mouth-coating core of black stone fruits, licorice, and baking spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly balances its rich mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is broad, muscular, and athletic, driven by firm, ripe, and fine-grained tannins that carry into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of dark chocolate, mineral gravel, and toasted oak.

This high-definition Spanish expression is 100% Tinto Fino (Tempranillo), harvested meticulously by hand in small crates from low-yielding vineyards aged 30 to 50+ years. Following rigorous sorting, the fruit underwent cold maceration and temperature-controlled alcoholic fermentation in stainless steel vats to extract deep color and fine phenolics. As designated by its name, the wine completed malolactic conversion and was matured for a full 18 months in a curated combination of French and American oak barrels (a mix of new and second-use casks), followed by additional bottle aging prior to release. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, bold alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% to 15.0% and is finished bone-dry.

title: Nuestro Verdejo Rueda 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Spain, within the esteemed Rueda D.O. appellation situated on the high-altitude plateau (Meseta Norte) of Castile and León. Produced under the Nuestro label, this cuvée is a benchmark expression of Verdejo, Spain's premier indigenous white grape variety. Sourced from high-elevation vineyards sitting between 700 and 800 meters above sea level, the vines are rooted in gravelly, iron-rich alluvial soils (cascajosos) over limestone subsoils along the Duero River basin. The region experiences a harsh continental climate characterized by extreme diurnal temperature swings—scalding daytime sun balanced by freezing night breezes off the surrounding mountain ranges. This dramatic daily cooling slows grape ripening, allowing Verdejo to develop rich herbal-citrus oil concentrations while locking in a razor-sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Nuestro Verdejo Rueda presents a luminous, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with striking greenish-gold shimmers along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an intensely aromatic and electric portrait of high-altitude Spanish white winemaking. The bouquet opens with a captivating display of fresh pink grapefruit, green apple, and white peach, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of wild fennel, lemongrass, freshly cut grass, white blossoms, and a distinct touch of wet stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a vibrant core of citrus peel, passion fruit, and crunchy orchard stone fruits. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the palate. The mouthfeel is supple, weightless, and linear, carrying into a long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of lime zest, subtle anise, and Verdejo’s signature, delightfully refreshing touch of pleasant herbal bitterness on the very end.

title: Petit Vega '8 Meses En Barrica' 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from Spain, within the prestigious Ribera del Duero D.O. appellation situated on the elevated high-altitude plateau (Meseta Norte) of Castile and León. Produced under the Petit Vega label by Bodegas y Viñedos Vega de Yuso, this cuvée offers a vibrant, fruit-forward, yet beautifully structured expression of modern Ribera del Duero winemaking. Sourced from estate vineyards in Quintanilla de Onésimo and surrounding valleys at altitudes ranging between 750 and 850 meters above sea level, the vines are rooted in limestone-rich clay and gravelly alluvial soils. The region’s harsh continental climate defined by blistering summer days and dramatically cool nights (diurnal shift) allows the grapes to achieve optimal phenolic maturity while locking in a bright, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Petit Vega '8 Meses en Barrica' presents a brilliant, deep ruby-purple color in the glass with vivid magenta highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and expressive, delivering a fruit-driven yet structured portrait of high-altitude Tempranillo. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of ripe wild blackberries, fresh red plums, and black cherries, seamlessly layered with delicate underlays of vanilla bean, cocoa powder, sweet tobacco, ground spice, and a subtle touch of toasted oak wood. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of dark stone fruits, licorice, and red berry compote. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessy lifts the mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is energetic, smooth, and supple, framed by fine-grained, approachable tannins that carry into a clean, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of dark berry skin and toasted oak spice.

This high-definition Spanish expression is 100% Tinto Fino (Tempranillo), harvested by hand in small crates from estate vineyards aged 15 to 30 years. Following careful sorting and temperature-controlled alcoholic fermentation in stainless steel vats to preserve pure primary aromatics, the wine completed malolactic conversion. As indicated by its name, the wine was matured for 8 months in a balanced selection of French and American oak barrels (a mix of new and second-use casks) to gently frame its vibrant fruit character with supple oak tannins before bottling. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of 14.0% to 14.5% and is finished bone-dry.

title: Marques de Tomares J3 Rioja 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from Spain, within the prestigious Rioja appellation (specifically the highly regarded Rioja Alta sub-zone). Marqués de Tomares is a historic, family-run estate founded in 1910 by Don Román Montaña in Fuenmayor, now managed by the family's third and fourth generations. Operating under a balance of time-honored Riojan tradition and hyper-precise modern viticulture, the estate focuses on low-yielding old vines that showcase the finesse of their terroir. Sourced from choice estate vineyards in Fuenmayor and surrounding areas, the vines are rooted in clay-limestone and iron-rich gravel soils. Positioned where cool Atlantic maritime currents meet warm Mediterranean breezes, this site allows Tempranillo and its traditional blending partners to achieve complete phenolic maturity while locking in a vibrant, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Marqués de Tomares 'J3' Rioja presents a brilliant, deep ruby-violet appearance in the glass with vivid magenta highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and expressive, delivering an inviting, fruit-forward, and highly energetic portrayal of modern Rioja Alta. The bouquet opens with a generous display of crushed red cherries, wild blackberries, and ripe red plums, seamlessly layered with delicate undertones of violet petals, sweet tobacco leaf, cocoa powder, vanilla bean, and a subtle trace of toasted cedarwood. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of red stone fruits, licorice, and red berry compote. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is energetic, smooth, and supple, framed by fine-grained, chalky tannins that glide into a clean, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of cherry skin and subtle oak spice.

title: Sylvain Cathiard Vosne Romanee Aux Malconsorts 2017 - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from France, specifically from the prestigious village of Vosne-Romanée within the Côte de Nuits subregion of Burgundy. Domaine Sylvain Cathiard et Fils is a highly regarded family-owned estate currently managed by Sébastien Cathiard, who took over from his father, Sylvain, in 2011. The domaine was established in the 1930s by Sylvain's grandfather, a former worker at the legendary Domaine de la Romanée-Conti. Sébastien's winemaking philosophy focuses on meticulous vineyard management and a 'less is more' approach in the cellar, aiming to produce terroir-driven wines with exceptional energy and purity.

Wine Description

Sylvain Cathiard Vosne-Romanee Aux Malconsorts 2017 displays a noble imperial purple colour. The nose is expressive and multifaceted, offering a detailed bouquet of blackberries, briar, cherries, and crushed stone, accented by notes of peony, liquorice, grilled game, and spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, deep, and fleshy, featuring vibrant fruit concentration—more red than black—supported by a broad-shouldered chassis of velvety tannins and excellent fresh acidity. It is characterized by its remarkable grip, backbone, and immense potential, leading into a long, expansive finish with a chiselled edge. This 100% Pinot Noir has an ABV of 13.5% and was matured in approximately 62% new oak barrels. The estate follows organic principles in the vineyard, though it does not hold official certification. The optimal drinking window is estimated from 2024 through 2048.

Food Pairing

The complex structure and savoury, gamey undertones of this Premier Cru Pinot Noir make it an ideal companion for rich, well-prepared meat dishes. It pairs perfectly with roasted or stewed meats such as duck breast, goose, game birds, or beef tournedos Rossini. Its elegant tannic structure and aromatic depth also complement venison, roasted lamb, or medium-aged cheeses.

Vintage Quality

The 2017 vintage in Burgundy is regarded as a 'classic' year, characterized by a hot, dry summer and an early, plentiful harvest that yielded terroir-expressive wines with high aromatic intensity. While the season was meteorologically unconventional, the resulting reds and whites are noted for their vibrancy, finesse, and surprising levels of natural acidity.

title: Laurent Perrier Heritage Brut
bodyHtml:
Laurent Perrier Heritage Brut originates from France, within the iconic Champagne region. Established in 1812 by Andre Michel Pierlot, the house entered its modern golden age under visionary Bernard de Nonancourt, who established the winery's identity focused on Chardonnay-led elegance and multi-vintage blending. Conceived as a tribute to the winemaking philosophy of the house's prestige cuvee Grand Siecle, Heritage is crafted entirely from aged reserve wines sourced across forty distinguished crus to combine maturity, purity, and freshness.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine presents a pale golden-yellow colour with silver highlights and a fine, persistent effervescence. The nose opens with expressive aromas of lemon oil, white peach, and spring flowers, evolving into notes of blanched almonds, toasted brioche, and a subtle, smoky mineral reduction. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full body with a supple, enveloping texture balanced by crisp acidity and citrus zest brightness. Stylistically, the wine delivers refined harmony and complexity, ending with a long, mineral-driven finish carrying hints of floral honey and light nougat.

  • Varietal composition: 55% Chardonnay, 45% Pinot Noir

  • Alcohol by volume: 12.0%

title: Aperol Spritz Ready to Serve - 4 Pack
bodyHtml:
Aperol Spritz Ready to Serve originates from Italy, within the northern region of Veneto. Originally created in 1919 by the Barbieri brothers in Padua, Aperol became an iconic Italian aperitivo before joining the Campari Group portfolio. Today, this convenient pre-mixed expression captures the authentic taste of the world-famous Aperol Spritz cocktail, combining Aperol, sparkling wine, and soda into a ready-to-serve format.

Spirit Description

This premixed cocktail presents a vibrant, bright orange appearance with lively effervescence in the glass. The sensory profile opens with an inviting, bittersweet nose featuring aromas of zesty orange peel, subtle herbal notes, and a touch of sweet vanilla. On the palate, the body is crisp, light, and refreshing, delivering a harmonious balance of citrus sweetness, sparkling wine acidity, and gentle herbal bitterness. The finish is clean, bright, and effervescent, leaving a trailing hint of bittersweet orange and refreshing bubbles. This ready-to-drink cocktail is traditionally bottled at an alcohol by volume of 9%.

title: Ridge Vineyards Lytton Springs Estate 2022
bodyHtml:
Ridge Vineyards Lytton Springs Estate 2022 originates from the United States, within California's Sonoma County region and the Dry Creek Valley subregion. The iconic Lytton Springs vineyard was first harvested by Ridge in 1972, with this release marking the 50th bottling of the historic field blend. Ridge Vineyards is celebrated for its commitment to pre-industrial winemaking practices, native yeast fermentation, and organic vineyard stewardship, crafting site-specific wines from century-old heritage vines grown in gravelly clay soils.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep ruby colour with purple reflections. The nose is complex and highly expressive, delivering aromas of crushed blackberry, boysenberry, black plum, and violet, alongside notes of anise, cigar box, toasty oak, and mint. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a rich, seamless texture and generous dark fruit concentration. Stylistically, the wine delivers a harmonious balance between intense berry fruit, lively acidity, and firm, powdery tannins, finishing with lingering layers of dark chocolate, pepper, and dried herbs.

  • Varietal composition: 67% Zinfandel, 19% Petite Sirah, 11% Carignane, 3% Alicante Bouschet

  • Alcohol by volume: 14.4%

title: Los Siete Misterios Ensamble 4 Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Los Siete Misterios Ensamble 4 Mezcal originates from Mexico, in the southern region within the subregion of Oaxaca. Founded in 2010 by brothers Julio and Eduardo Mestre, the brand was established to support local master distillers and preserve time-honoured artisanal mezcal making traditions. This special expression is an ensamble, crafted by co-fermenting and co-distilling four distinct agave varieties together in small batches using traditional clay pot stills.

Spirit Description

This artisanal mezcal presents a crystal clear appearance with bright silvery reflections in the glass. The rich and multi-layered nose reveals an complex aromatic profile of roasted agave, fresh herbs, earthy clay, and wild flowers, balanced by subtle fruitiness and a gentle wave of woodsmoke. On the palate, the body is full, smooth, and well balanced, delivering harmonious flavours of cooked agave, sweet citrus, minerals, and dark pepper. The finish is remarkably long, dry, and elegant, leaving trailing notes of earthy smoke, sweet spices, and lingering herbal brightness. This artisanal spirit is traditionally bottled at an alcohol by volume of 47% to 48%.

Accolades

As part of the highly sought-after clay pot distilled lineup from Los Siete Misterios, this ensamble release has garnered intense admiration among mezcal connoisseurs and agave critics. It is widely praised for demonstrating the complex synergy of co-distilling multiple wild and cultivated agave species under traditional techniques.

title: Glenfiddich Gran Reserva 21 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich Gran Reserva 21 Year Old is a luxury single malt Scotch whisky produced at the iconic Glenfiddich Distillery in Dufftown, Speyside, Scotland. Founded in 1887 by William Grant, Glenfiddich is one of the world's most renowned single malt distilleries. Positioned as a anchor expression within Glenfiddich's luxury Grand Series, the Gran Reserva is distinguished by its unique finishing process in hand-selected Caribbean rum casks, combining traditional Speyside single malt character with warm tropical sweetness.

Spirit Description
