In the glass, this Blanc de Noirs displays a brilliant golden-yellow hue with persistent, fine effervescence. The nose offers an expressive bouquet of stone fruits, red apple, and fresh pear, interwoven with refined autolytic aromas of warm butter, toasted almond, and freshly baked brioche. On the palate, it is broad, round, and creamy, yet maintained by vibrant acidity. Flavours of crisp yellow orchard fruit, ripe plum, and citrus zest lead into a long, focused finish marked by delicate toasted nut and mineral undertones. Crafted entirely from 100% Pinot Noir, it undergoes temperature-controlled vinification in stainless steel followed by full malolactic fermentation. It is aged on its lees for a generous 36 months before receiving a classic Brut dosage of approximately 10 g/L.

Food Pairing

The vinous weight, rich fruit profile, and creamy texture of this 100% Pinot Noir Champagne make it a remarkably versatile partner at the dining table. Beyond acting as an elegant aperitif, it pairs beautifully with rich seafood such as seared scallops, butter-poached lobster, or roasted turbot. Its structural depth allows it to easily complement roasted poultry, veal chops in mushroom sauce, charcuterie boards, or delicate game birds. For cheese pairings, it pairs exceptionally well with aged Comté, Chaource, or Brie de Meaux.

title: The Glenturret Aberturret London Dry Gin
bodyHtml:
The Aberturret London Dry Gin originates from Scotland, in the Highland region within the Perthshire subregion. Produced at Glenturret, Scotland's oldest working distillery established in 1763, the gin marks a modern expansion of the estate's historic distillation legacy. Today, the distillery is co-owned by the Lalique Group and Swiss entrepreneur Hansjörg Wyss, who continue to emphasize traditional hand-crafted techniques in their copper pot stills.

Spirit Description

This craft gin presents a crystal clear, luminous appearance in the glass. The sensory profile features a classic and vibrant nose dominated by piney juniper, crisp citrus peel, and gentle floral notes, underscored by delicate earthiness. On the palate, the body is smooth and well balanced, delivering a harmonious blend of citrus, clean botanical spices, and traditional juniper. The finish is remarkably dry, clean, and refreshing, leaving a lingering warmth with subtle trailing notes of lemon zest and coriander. This gin is traditionally bottled at an alcohol by volume of 45%

title: Mattei Corsica Distilled Dry Gin
bodyHtml:
Mattei Corsica Distilled Dry Gin originates from France, on the island of Corsica in the northern subregion of Bastia. Established in 1872 by Louis Napoleon Mattei, the historic distillery originally built its reputation on traditional aperitifs and liqueurs crafted from local island botanicals. Today, the house continues to celebrate the unique Corsican terroir under modern ownership, expanding its portfolio to include distilled dry gin alongside its iconic aperitif wines.

Spirit Description

This distilled dry gin presents a crystal clear, bright appearance in the glass. The aromatic nose opens with intense piney juniper, accompanied by herbal undertones of bay leaf, marjoram, and everlasting flower, along with vibrant citrus zest. On the palate, the body is light, fresh, and exceptionally smooth, revealing a harmonious balance of Corsican citron, crisp lemon, and delicate Mediterranean forest herbs. The finish is remarkably clean, dry, and balanced, leaving a trailing citrus brightness and lingering herbal perfume. This craft spirit is bottled at an alcohol by volume of 40%.

title: Sheringham Raincoast Gin
bodyHtml:
Sheringham Raincoast Gin originates from Canada, on the West Coast of Vancouver Island in the province of British Columbia. Founded in 2015 in Shirley, British Columbia, Sheringham Distillery was established by Alayne and Jason MacIsaac with a focus on crafting sustainable, small-batch spirits using local botanicals. Today, the distillery operates out of Langford, British Columbia, continuing to capture the spirit of the Pacific Northwest through thoughtful distillation.

Spirit Description

This craft gin presents a crystal clear, pristine appearance in the glass. The aromatic nose opens with bright, inviting notes of fresh citrus zest, piney juniper, and subtle floral elderflower, underpinned by a distinct earthy, forest floor undertone. On the palate, the body is light to medium, smooth, and exceptionally well balanced, delivering crisp flavours of sweet orange peel, soft herbs, and a subtle touch of marine salinity from locally harvested bull kelp. The finish is remarkably clean, dry, and refreshing, leaving a lingering trail of citrus peel and delicate oak spice. This expression is bottled at an alcohol by volume of 43%.

title: Champagne Gardet Brut Tradition
bodyHtml:
This classic non-vintage Champagne originates from France, within the Montagne de Reims subregion of Champagne. Founded in 1895 by Charles Gardet in Epernay, Maison Gardet relocated in the 1930s to the village of Chigny-les-Roses. Today, the estate is owned by the Prieux family, who continue to preserve the house's traditional winemaking philosophy: crafting structured, long-aged Champagnes rooted in high-quality fruit sourced primarily from Premier Cru and Grand Cru vineyards across the Montagne de Reims and Côte des Blancs. The Brut Tradition is the quintessential flagship cuvée of Maison Gardet, reflecting the house style of richness, elegance, and exceptional lees maturity.

Wine Description

In the glass, this wine exhibits a pale golden hue with steady, fine-beaded effervescence. The nose opens with an inviting array of white peach, yellow apple, and dried apricot, balanced by delicate floral notes, toasted brioche, fresh almond, and a touch of honeyed citrus. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious balance of roundness and vibrant freshness. The mouthfeel is broad and structured, showing flavours of juicy orchard fruit, lemon curd, and crushed chalk minerality, concluding with a crisp, dry finish. The blend consists of approximately 45% Pinot Noir, 45% Pinot Meunier, and 10% Chardonnay, incorporating around 30% reserve wines to maintain character consistency. The wine is aged on its lees for a minimum of three years prior to disgorgement, finished with a Brut dosage of approximately 8 to 9 g/L.

Food Pairing

The structured body, bright acidity, and rich autolytic character of this Pinot-dominant Champagne make it an ideal choice both as an aperitif and as a versatile companion for food. It pairs brilliantly with fresh oysters, smoked salmon blinis, pan-seared sea bass, and tempura prawns. It also complements roasted chicken with tarragon cream, pan-roasted pork tenderloin, or wild mushroom tartlets. For cheese pairings, it sits wonderfully alongside soft, bloomy rind cheeses like Brie de Meaux, Chaource, or medium-aged Gouda.

title: Laurent Perrier 'La Cuvee' Brut
bodyHtml:
This iconic non-vintage Champagne originates from France, within the heart of the Champagne region in Tours-sur-Marne. Founded in 1812 by André Michel Pierlot and later named when Eugène Laurent married Mathilde Emilie Perrier, the house took on its modern prominence under the visionary leadership of Bernard de Nonancourt following WWII. Today, Maison Laurent-Perrier is family-managed by Alexandra Pereyre de Nonancourt and Stéphanie Meneux de Nonancourt. Renowned for pioneering a freshness-focused, Chardonnay-dominant style, the house replaced its historic "LP" Brut with "La Cuvée," highlighting an increased proportion of high-quality Chardonnay and extended cellar maturation.

Wine Description

In the glass, this Champagne exhibits a pale gold color with a persistent stream of ultrafine bubbles. The nose is refined and aromatic, offering lifted notes of fresh citrus blossom, green apple, white peach, and lemon zest, underpinned by subtle notes of fresh brioche, toasted grain, and wet chalk. On the palate, it delivers marked freshness, elegance, and balance. The entry is crisp and clean, dominated by bright orchard fruit and mineral drive, giving way to a rounded, supple mid-palate texture. The blend features over 50% Chardonnay (often 50–55%), complemented by 30–35% Pinot Noir and 10–15% Pinot Meunier, sourced from over 100 Crus, with up to 85% of the fruit coming from Premier and Grand Cru villages. Only the purest grape juice—the first pressing (la cuvée)—is retained. The wine is vinified exclusively in stainless steel tanks to preserve maximum purity, undergoes full malolactic fermentation, and ages on its lees for a minimum of 4 years before receiving a balanced Brut dosage of around 8 to 9 g/L. The alcohol by volume is 12%.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, citrus freshness, and light, aperitif-driven structure of La Cuvée make it exceptionally versatile with lighter culinary creations. It serves as an ideal welcome glass and pairs seamlessly with fresh oysters, shellfish platters, tuna tartare, sea bass ceviche, or delicate sashimi. The subtle autolytic richness also accommodates white meat dishes such as pan-seared poultry with lemon-herb butter, mild creamy pasta dishes, or crisp vegetable tempura. For cheese pairings, opt for fresh goat cheese (such as Crottin de Chavignol), young Chaource, or mildly aged Comté.

Vintage Quality

As a non-vintage cuvée, consistency and house identity are maintained by blending base wines from a single main harvest with 20% to 30% high-quality reserve wines spanning several prior years. Sourcing heavily from Grand Cru and Premier Cru sites across the Côte des Blancs and Montagne de Reims provides natural fruit intensity, precise structural acidity, and mineral tension. The generous 4-year lees aging period—well beyond the legal 15-month minimum for non-vintage Champagne—allows the prominent Chardonnay profile to integrate seamlessly, creating a wine that is vibrant and ready to drink upon release while capable of cellaring gracefully for 3 to 5 years.

title: Domaine William Fevre Chablis 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine William Fevre Chablis 2022 originates from France, located within the famous Burgundy region and the Chablis subregion. Founded in 1959 by William Fevre, the estate expanded from seven initial hectares into one of the premier producers in the appellation, and joined the Domaines Barons de Rothschild Lafite portfolio in 2024. The estate is celebrated for its environmental stewardship and terroir focused winemaking, managing old vine holdings across Kimmeridgian soils to capture the authentic, mineral driven expression of the region.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a clear, luminous yellow colour with subtle green glints. The nose is bursting with vibrant aromas of fresh lemon, green apple, peach, white flowers, and flinty mineral notes. On the palate, it offers a medium body with a supple, satiny texture balanced by crisp acidity and intense freshness. Stylistically, the wine shows refined complexity and harmony, blending rich orchard fruit flavours with a characteristic saline minerality. The finish is dry, clean, and sleek with excellent length.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Chardonnay

  • Alcohol by volume: 12.5%

  • Organic status: Produced from organic estate vineyards grown using organic farming practices

title: Chateau Petrus 1994 - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Château Pétrus 1994 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the prestigious Pomerol subregion. Owned by the Moueix family (Établissements Jean-Pierre Moueix), Pétrus sits atop the highest elevation of the Pomerol plateau, distinguished by its unique 11.4-hectare vineyard composed entirely of rare 40-million-year-old blue clay (argile bleue). This unique terroir retains moisture during dry spells and imparts a legendary richness, density, and velvety tannic architecture to the wine. Under the direction of Christian Moueix and renowned winemaking director Jean-Claude Berrouet, the estate's operational philosophy centers on meticulous hand-harvesting, low yields, and minimal intervention to produce the purest, most profound expression of Pomerol Merlot.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, mature garnet-brick appearance in the glass with subtle mahogany reflections extending to the rim. It possesses a full-bodied, dense, and remarkably cohesive structure defined by a plush, velvety, and mouth-filling texture. The sensory profile is highly complex, fully evolved, and fragrant, opening with an alluring bouquet of dried plums, dark cherry preserve, and cassis, seamlessly intertwined with rich tertiary aromas of fresh black truffles, damp forest floor, cigar box, leather, espresso, and sweet Asian spices. On the broad palate, it delivers a deeply concentrated layer of sweet dark fruit balanced by completely resolved, fine-grained tannins and a subtle, vibrant line of natural acidity. The finish is exceptionally long, expansive, and noble, leaving a lingering impression of dark cocoa, dried flowers, and savory mineral earthiness.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Merlot.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes were hand-picked after the morning dew cleared and sorted with extreme precision. Fermentation took place in temperature-controlled concrete vats, followed by 18 to 20 months of aging in 100% new French oak barrels. The wine was bottled unfiltered to maintain its natural depth and textural weight.

title: Chateau Petrus 2007 - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Château Pétrus 2007 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the iconic Pomerol subregion. Owned by the Moueix family (Établissements Jean-Pierre Moueix), Pétrus stands on an extraordinary 11.4-hectare plateau characterized by an exclusive mound of blue clay (argile bleue) that dates back over 40 million years. This unique soil retain moisture during dry spells and imparts an unmistakable richness and velvety tannic structure to the wine. Operating without a grand "château" structure, the estate's philosophy focuses entirely on hyper-rigorous vineyard management, hand-sorting, and low-yield precision to express the purest, most profound incarnation of Pomerol Merlot.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a rich, mature deep garnet appearance with dark ruby undertones and subtle amber reflections near the rim. It possesses a full-bodied, opulent, and broad-shouldered structure framed by a remarkably smooth, seamless, and mouth-filling texture. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and deep, opening with a seductive bouquet of black cherry jam, black plum, cassis, and mulberries, interwoven with intricate secondary nuances of dark truffle, black tea, mocha, damp earth, cigar box, and sweet spice. On the palate, it delivers a dense, concentrated core of sweet dark fruit held together by soft, velvety tannins and a supple, balanced freshness. The finish is extraordinarily long, expansive, and noble, leaving a persistent impression of dark cocoa, dried flowers, and savory mineral earthiness.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Merlot.

  • Stylistic Notes: Destemmed and hand-sorted with extreme care, the grapes undergo fermentation in temperature-controlled concrete vats. The wine ages for approximately 18 to 20 months in French oak barrels (traditionally 50% new oak in cooler vintages like 2007 to avoid overwhelming the delicate fruit) before being bottled without filtration.

title: Chateau Le Pin 2007 (1.5 Litre) - 3 Magnum Bottles
bodyHtml:
Château Le Pin 2007 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the prestigious Pomerol subregion. Owned and managed by the Thienpont family since 1979, the estate spans a tiny 2.7-hectare parcel on a sunny, gravel-and-clay plateau near Château Trotanoy. Famed for its microscopic yields and ultra-exclusive production, Le Pin is celebrated as one of the world's premier expressions of Merlot. The estate's operational philosophy centers on rigorous fruit selection, gentle extractions, and minimal intervention. In 2007—a vintage requiring precise vineyard management—Le Pin produced a supple, highly charming, and early-accessible wine that displays the estate's signature aromatic elegance and textural finesse.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a mature, brilliant ruby-garnet hue in the glass with soft amber reflections at the rim. It possesses a medium-to-full-bodied, silky, and harmonious structure defined by a supple, velvety, and open-knit texture. The sensory profile is fragrant and alluring, opening with an expressive nose of ripe red cherries, wild plum preserves, and raspberries, layered with tertiary nuances of tobacco leaf, cedar, truffle, dried flowers, mocha, and subtle toasted spice. On the palate, it delivers a smooth, succulent core of red berry fruit balanced by fully resolved, cashmere-soft tannins and a gentle thread of refreshing natural acidity. The finish is remarkably long, graceful, and persistent, leaving a clean, savory aftertaste of dark cocoa and forest floor.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Merlot.

  • Stylistic Notes: Hand-harvested with painstaking block-by-block selection, the grapes underwent fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats. The wine completed malolactic fermentation in 100% new French oak barrels and aged for approximately 18 to 20 months. It was bottled unfiltered to preserve its velvety weight and pure aromatics.

title: Chateau Le Pin 2004
bodyHtml:
Château Le Pin 2004 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the prestigious Pomerol subregion. Owned and operated by the Thienpont family since 1979, the estate spans a tiny 2.7-hectare parcel situated on a well-drained, sunny gravel-and-clay plateau near Château Trotanoy. Celebrated globally as a pioneer of boutique, low-yield winemaking, Le Pin produces extraordinarily limited quantities each year. The estate's operational philosophy prioritizes meticulous hand-craftsmanship, extreme vineyard selection, and minimal cellar intervention. In 2004, a classic and cooler vintage in Bordeaux, Le Pin produced a wine of remarkable elegance, aromatic complexity, and structural harmony.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a mature, deep ruby-garnet appearance with soft brick-red reflections toward the rim. It possesses a full-bodied, suave, and well-integrated structure defined by a silky, fluid, and mouth-coating texture. The sensory profile is beautifully aged and fragrant, opening with an inviting bouquet of ripe red currants, dried plums, and dark cherries, interwoven with complex tertiary notes of damp forest floor, truffle, leather, cigar box, espresso, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious balance of sweet, evolved fruit and fine, fully resolved tannins, supported by a gentle line of lingering natural acidity. The finish is long, graceful, and refined, leaving a clean, savory impression of cedar, dark cocoa, and dried herbs.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Merlot.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes were hand-picked and carefully sorted before undergoing fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats. The wine underwent malolactic fermentation directly in 100% new French oak barrels and aged for approximately 18 to 20 months prior to being bottled unfiltered to preserve its textural depth.

title: Chateau Le Pin 2017
bodyHtml:
Château Le Pin 2017 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the prestigious Pomerol subregion. Owned and managed by Jacques Thienpont and his family since 1979, the estate spans just 2.7 hectares of gravel-and-clay soils over a limestone bed near Château Trotanoy. Operating on a micro-scale, Le Pin is widely recognized as one of the world's most sought-after and exclusive wines. The estate's philosophy centers on extreme vineyard selection, low yields, and minimal intervention in the cellar. In 2017, despite regional weather challenges, Le Pin’s unique microclimate and meticulous vineyard management yielded a wine celebrated for its profound concentration, aromatic purity, and silky refinement.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep, vibrant ruby-purple hue in the glass. It possesses a full-bodied, opulent, and impeccably balanced structure supported by a seamless, velvety texture. The sensory profile is captivating and complex, opening with an intense bouquet of black raspberries, dark cherries, plum preserves, and cassis, layered with delicate nuances of crushed violets, dark chocolate, tobacco leaf, exotic spices, and graphite minerality. On the palate, it delivers a lavish, fruit-forward core balanced by a vibrant thread of natural acidity and exceptionally refined, polished tannins. The finish is remarkably long, resonant, and seductive, leaving lingering echoes of black fruit, floral blossoms, and subtle savory oak.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Merlot.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes were hand-picked at optimal maturity and rigorously sorted. Fermentation took place in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats, followed by malolactic fermentation and aging for approximately 18 months in 100% new French oak barrels. The wine was bottled unfiltered to preserve its textural weight and pure fruit expression.

title: Chateau Le Pin 2021
bodyHtml:
Château Le Pin 2021 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the prestigious Pomerol subregion. Owned by the Thienpont family since 1979, this microscopic estate—spanning just 2.7 hectares on a well-drained gravel-and-clay plateau near Château Trotanoy—is widely regarded as the ultimate expression of artisanal, boutique winemaking. The operational philosophy focuses on extreme attention to detail, tiny yields, and minimal intervention. In a challenging vintage like 2021, Jacques Thienpont and winemaker Alexandre Thienpont utilized rigorous selection and modern cellar precision to showcase the unique purity, aromatic elegance, and silkiness that define this iconic Right Bank estate.

Wine Description

This red wine exhibits a bright, deep ruby-purple appearance in the glass. It possesses a medium-to-full-bodied structure characterized by remarkable finesse, energy, and a seamless, satin-like texture. The sensory profile is incredibly perfumed and precise, opening with an expressive nose of fresh red cherries, wild raspberries, cassis, and crushed plums, interwoven with delicate nuances of violet flowers, fresh mint, graphite, pencil shavings, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it delivers a pure, focused core of vibrant red and dark fruits balanced by a bright, refreshing natural acidity and ultra-refined, fine-grained tannins. The finish is remarkably long, airy, and persistent, culminating in a clean, mineral, and sophisticated aftertaste.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Merlot.

  • Stylistic Notes: In 2021, the estate adjusted its oak program to match the cooler, more linear nature of the vintage, aging the wine in approximately 70% to 80% new French oak barrels (a departure from the usual 100% new oak). The wine underwent malolactic fermentation in oak and was aged with minimal intervention to preserve its pristine, fresh fruit profile and floral aromatics.

title: Phillips Dinosour Stone Fruit - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml: Dinosour Stone Fruit Sour packs a delightfully tart bite. Soured with our house-cultured lacto strain, apricot juice, peach juice and nectarine flavours mingle pre and post fermentaceous period, balancing sour flavours with light stone fruit sweetness.

title: Domaines Ott 'Etoile' Rose 2023
bodyHtml:
Domaines Ott 'Etoile' Rose originates from France, within the Provence region and is classified under the Vin de France appellation. The domain was founded in 1896 by Alsatian agriculturalist Marcel Ott, who worked to restore vineyards following the phylloxera crisis. Today, the family legacy is integrated with the Louis Roederer House. The winemaking philosophy behind this prestige 'tête de cuvée' relies on a free composition that unifies and expresses the finest distinct attributes of the family's three properties: Chateau de Selle, Clos Mireille, and Chateau Romassan.

Wine Description

This rose wine presents a bright, pale pink or peach appearance with silver highlights and golden tints, possessing a sleek, medium-bodied, and all-enveloping structure. The sensory profile is highly complex, elegant, and intense, opening with a fresh nose of elderflowers, mango, peach, and raspberry, complemented by subtle nuances of vanilla and toasted almonds. On the smooth, broad, and polished palate, it delivers an iodized and pristine experience filled with grapefruit zest, exotic fruit, and white raspberry notes over a bed of crushed stone. The finish is long and well-balanced, leaving trailing memories of chalky minerality, sweet spice, and a fine hint of licorice.

Food Pairing

The complex salinity, powerful structure, and refreshing acidity of this luxury rose make it an outstanding companion for high-end Mediterranean gastronomy.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with fresh oysters, salmon crudo, grilled lobster, and tuna steaks, which beautifully elevate the wine's saline texture.

  • Hearty Fare: Suggested pairings include a rich coconut and lime fish curry or a classic spinach gratin.

  • Light Fare: An exceptional match for sautéed summer vegetables or delicate starters served during upscale occasions.

title: Chateau Montifaud Vintage
bodyHtml:
The young Augustin, the family’s first generation of winemakers, established the Chateau Montifaud winery in 1837 and today, Laurent, the sixth generation, is the one running it. The vineyards are located in two well-known Cognac regions, on an area covering 130 hectares of vines.

This cognac has a golden yellow color. It is dry, well balanced, with a nice structure. On the nose you'll find aromas of leather, clove and undergrowth as well as notes of licorice. On the palate, this cognac expresses itself through aromas of vanilla and cocoa. Its great finesse and its dried flower scents give it a very interesting length.

title: Elevacion 1250 Tequila Anejo Rosa Fuerte
bodyHtml:
Elevación 1250 Tequila Añejo Rosa Fuerte is a highly unique, ultra-premium expression within the additive-free tequila landscape. The brand was founded by Todd Hummel and is named after the exact elevation of the distillery where it is produced: 1,250 meters above sea level in Amatitán, Jalisco. It is crafted at the renowned NOM 1522 (La Hacienda de Oro) under the precise direction of celebrated third-generation female Master Distiller Iliana Partida.

The "Rosa Fuerte" designation represents a rare crossover: a high-proof, aged tequila finished in premium wine barrels to inherit an incredibly distinct color and flavor profile.

Spirit Description

True to Iliana Partida’s traditional standards, the production starts with sustainably grown 100% Blue Weber agave from the lowlands (Valle). The agaves are cooked in high-pressure autoclaves to extract pure, intensely concentrated sugars, crushed using a roller mill, and subjected to natural, open-air fermentation.

Following double distillation, the tequila undergoes a beautiful metamorphosis: it is aged for 14 months in premier, first-fill French Oak Cabernet Sauvignon wine barrels sourced from Napa Valley. It is bottled Fuerte (high proof) rather than diluted down to standard proof.

  • Appearance: A gorgeous, natural ruby-crimson or deep rosé hue drawn entirely from the Napa red wine wood.

  • Aroma: A powerful combination of caramelized cooked agave, bright red berries (raspberries, cherries), a touch of dry red wine tannins, black pepper, and warm vanilla bean.

  • Palate: Intense and chewy. The higher ABV carries a robust wave of roasted agave sweetness alongside complex orchard fruits, redcurrants, and a velvety, buttery texture. Dark chocolate and light oak spice build across the mid-palate.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and remarkably clean, balancing a lingering, spicy pepper kick with the natural sweetness of cooked agave.

  • ABV: Typically bottled at a high-proof "Fuerte" range (around 45% to 50% ABV).

Accolades

While Elevación 1250’s core lines (the Blanco and Reposado) are widely celebrated as hidden gems in Canada and select US markets for their traditional, additive-free profiles, the Añejo Rosa Fuerte has achieved cult-tier status among tequila connoisseurs. It is highly lauded by tequila educational platforms and review channels (such as Tasting Tequila with Brad) as a masterclass in how to use red wine cask finishes without smothering the natural agave character.

Food Pairing

The marriage of rich, high-proof agave and French oak wine tannins makes this bottle an elite companion for rich food pairings:

  • Savoury: Its robust body pairs wonderfully with a grilled ribeye steak with a berry-reduction glaze, slow-braised duck carnitas, or barbecued pork ribs.

  • Cheese: Match it against aged gouda, Manchego, or creamy blue cheeses where the spirit's bright acidity and proof can slice beautifully through the fat.

  • Dessert: Absolutely spectacular alongside a dark chocolate lava cake, artisan raspberry tarts, or premium vanilla bean panna cotta.

title: Balblair 17 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Balblair 17 Year Old is an elegant, richly layered single malt Scotch whisky that originates from Edderton in the Northern Highlands. While Balblair historically categorized its whiskies strictly by vintage years (such as their old 1999 or 2000 expressions), the distillery underwent a massive rebrand to traditional age statements.

The 17-year-old expression was introduced as an exclusive anchor for The Travel Collection (Travel Retail/Duty Free). It acts as a bridge between the core range's 15 and 18-year-old expressions, purposefully dialed in to capture Balblair’s signature ester-driven, fruity spirit style paired with deep European oak influence.

Spirit Description

Balblair utilizes an exceptionally slow distillation process and captures their spirit cut intentionally to draw out intense orchard fruit notes alongside heavy, leathery oils. For the 17-year-old, the liquid is initially matured in American oak ex-bourbon barrels before being transferred into first-fill Spanish oak Oloroso sherry butts for its final finish.

  • Appearance: Dark bronze to warm amber.

  • Aroma: Deeply expressive. It opens with rich notes of dark chocolate cocoa, juicy raisins, and prune juice, shifting into sweet stewed fruits, walnut oil, and warm festive spices like nutmeg and clove.

  • Palate: Luxuriously thick, oily, and velvety. An initial wave of heather honey, blood orange zest, and toffee apples moves into a complex mid-palate of chocolate muffins, hazelnut crunch, and dark bramble berries.

  • Finish: Long, warming, and brilliantly structured, showcasing residual baking spices, old leather, dry oak tannins, and bitter dark chocolate.

  • ABV: 46% (Natural color, non-chill filtered)

Accolades

The Balblair 17-year-old is highly decorated within the premium travel retail circuit. It holds a Gold Outstanding medal from the International Wine & Spirit Competition (IWSC) and a Gold from the New York International Spirits Competition. Major editorial platforms like Whisky Advocate have awarded it an exceptional score of 93/100, calling it "a great find" where the sherry wood has truly worked its magic.

Food Pairing

The combination of bright, ester-heavy Highland distillate and first-fill Spanish oak gives this 17-year-old a robust flavor profile that pairs spectacularly with food:

  • Savoury: The leather and dark fruit notes make it an incredible companion to duck breast with a cherry reduction or slow-cooked venison stew.

  • Cheese: Pair it with aged, crystalline Gouda or a sharp, crumbly blue cheese. The whisky's honeyed sweetness and baking spices contrast beautifully with the intense, salty dairy notes.

  • Dessert: It pairs flawlessly with bonfire-night toffee apples, dark chocolate pralines, or a traditional pecan pie where the nuttiness of the dram can really sing.

title: Joseph Drouhin Meursault 2024
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1880, Maison Joseph Drouhin has been family owned for four generations and remains dedicated to expressing the authentic terroir of Burgundy. Guided by an organic and biodynamic viticultural philosophy, the winery emphasizes balance, elegance, and minimal intervention to allow each vineyard's unique character to shine.

Wine Description

Joseph Drouhin Meursault displays a bright, beautiful golden colour in the glass. The aromatic profile offers a complex bouquet of lime blossom, honey, hazelnut butter, and hawthorn flower. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied 100% Chardonnay exhibits a silky roundness balanced by vibrant freshness, leading into a lingering finish marked by delicate notes of yellow plum and subtle spice.

title: Loch Lomond Oloroso Sherry Cask Single Malt Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Loch Lomond The Original Oloroso Sherry Cask Single Malt Whisky originates from Scotland, in the celebrated Highland region. The Loch Lomond distillery, situated near the shores of the famous loch, stands out as one of the most innovative and versatile distilleries in the country. Operating with its own on site cooperage and utilizing a unique combination of traditional Swan Neck and innovative straight neck stills, the distillery is highly regarded for its distinctive ability to masterfully craft and shape distinct flavour profiles.

Spirit Description

This unpeated single malt displays an appealing amber color with warm golden reflections in the glass. The sensory profile opens with a welcoming nose driven by rich notes of sweet honey, creamy vanilla, and plump raisins, followed by a delicate caramel undertone. On the palate, the liquid is smooth and harmonious, revealing a rich development of toffee sweetness alongside vibrant notes of peach, orange citrus, and brown sugar. The finish is medium in length, rounded, and smooth, carrying through a gentle oak spice and lingering dried fruits. This expression is bottled at a standard alcohol by volume of 40%.

title: Dom Ruinart Blanc De Blanc 2013
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' prestige champagne originates from France, within the world-renowned Champagne A.O.C. region based in Reims. First created in 1959 to honor Dom Thierry Ruinart—the visionary Benedictine monk who inspired his nephew Nicolas Ruinart to found the oldest established Champagne house in 1729 Dom Ruinart Blanc de Blancs represents the absolute pinnacle of Chardonnay winemaking. Operating under a precision-focused philosophy that champions purity, tension, and extraordinary cellar aging potential, the House crafts this rare vintage cuvée exclusively from Grand Cru vineyards. The fruit is sourced primarily from the chalk-rich slopes of the Côte des Blancs (Chouilly, Avize, Oger, Le Mesnil-sur-Oger) complemented by noble Grand Cru sites in the Montagne de Reims (Sillery, Taissy). Rooted in deep, porous Cretaceous chalk beds (crayères), these heritage vines yield grapes infused with intense chalky minerality, high-toned floral aromatics, and a razor-sharp structural line.

Wine Description

The Dom Ruinart Blanc de Blancs presents a luminous, pale gold color in the glass with shimmering greenish-yellow reflections and a ultrafine, persistent bead of delicate bubbles. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, offering a masterfully transparent and chiseled expression of top-tier Grand Cru Chardonnay. The bouquet opens with a captivating display of lemon blossom, fresh lime zest, and crispy green apples, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of white peach, candied ginger, crushed flint, toasted brioche, and a distinctive whiff of smoky reduction and cold chalk. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, precise, and intensely focused, delivering a concentrated core of citrus oils, juicy orchard fruits, and subtle hazelnut cream. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad yet weightless and athletic, framed by a silky mousse that glides into an extraordinarily long, dry, and chalky-salty finish accented by lingering notes of lemon curd, roasted almonds, and white pepper.

This high-definition Blanc de Blancs expression is 100% Chardonnay sourced exclusively from Grand Cru plots. Hand-harvested at peak maturity, the juice underwent gentle pressing followed by temperature-controlled primary fermentation in stainless steel vats to preserve pure varietal aromatics. The wine completed full malolactic conversion before being aged on its fine lees in Ruinart's historic UNESCO-listed underground chalk cellars (crayères) for over 10 years (aging under natural cork, or tirage sous liège, for recent benchmark vintages to build textural depth and complex reduction). Finished with an exceptionally low Extra Brut dosage, it reaches a perfectly integrated alcohol content (ABV) of 12.5% and is finished bone-dry.

title: Dominus Estate 2018
bodyHtml:
WINE OF THE YEAR (2021)

#1 Wine Spectator Top 100 of 2021

This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Yountville A.V.A. of California's Napa Valley. Dominus Estate was established in 1983 by Christian Moueix, the legendary proprietor of Château Pétrus in Pomerol, who recognized the historical Napanook Vineyard as a benchmark terroir for world-class Cabernet Sauvignon. Operating under an uncompromising, classic European winemaking philosophy, Moueix and his team blend French winemaking precision with Napa Valley's sun-drenched power. Sourced entirely from the dry-farmed Napanook estate, the vines are rooted in deep gravelly loam and clay-rich volcanic soils at the foot of the Mayacamas Mountains. The site captures abundant California sunshine tempered by cool afternoon breezes and morning fogs sweeping in from San Pablo Bay, naturally producing low yields with extraordinary tannic structure, energy, and linear finesse.

Wine Description

The 2018 Dominus Estate presents a deep, opaque garnet-purple appearance in the glass with bright ruby highlights at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, deep, and high-toned, offering a masterfully complex and harmonious expression of dry-farmed Napa Valley terroir. The bouquet opens with a mesmerizing, multi-faceted display of fresh cassis, dark plum reduction, and wild blueberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of crushed violets, cigar box, graphite, damp earth, sweet tobacco leaf, and subtle bay leaf. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and precisely focused, showcasing a powerful core of dark orchard fruits, cocoa nibs, and crushed stones. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and athletic, driven by seamless, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of iron, cedar, and wild mountain herbs.

Vintage Quality

The 2018 vintage across Napa Valley is universally acclaimed as a legendary, near-perfect growing season. Ideal weather conditions with steady summer temperatures and no significant heatwaves allowed dry-farmed vineyards like Napanook to achieve slow, complete phenolic maturity. Christian Moueix described 2018 as one of the most exceptional vintages of his long career. The resulting wine balances immense structural power with supreme elegance, freshness, and precision. Built with an internal matrix to evolve gracefully in a cellar over 30 to 40+ years, it will reach its prime drinking window between 2026 and 2060.

title: Crystal Head Vodka Camo
bodyHtml:
Crystal Head Vodka Camo originates from Canada, crafted in St. John's, Newfoundland. Co-founded by iconic actor Dan Aykroyd and renowned artist John Alexander, Crystal Head Vodka was built on a philosophy of pure, uncompromised craftsmanship and creative self-expression. Soused in pristine natural waters and housed in the brand's signature skull bottle—reimagined for this limited edition with a matte woodland camouflage motif—the spirit celebrates individuality and character while remaining free from sugar and artificial additives.

Spirits Description

This ultra-premium vodka presents an extraordinarily clear, sparkling appearance in the glass. The nose offers crisp, neutral grain aromas complemented by subtle hints of sweetness and a delicate touch of citrus zest. On the palate, it delivers a remarkably silky and smooth mouthfeel, featuring soft vanilla nuances and a subtle, creamy warmth. Distilled four times from locally sourced Canadian corn and filtered seven times—including three passes through Herkimer diamond crystals—it finishes clean, crisp, and exceptionally smooth. Bottled at 40% ABV, it stands out for its balance, purity, and versatility.

title: Joseph Drouhin Chambolle Musigny Premier Cru 2024
bodyHtml:
Maison Joseph Drouhin is a historic Burgundian producer founded in 1880 in Beaune, France, and remains family owned across four generations. Located in the Côte de Nuits subregion of Burgundy, the estate is renowned for its pioneering commitment to organic and biodynamic viticulture. Sourced from prestigious Premier Cru vineyard plots in Chambolle Musigny, this wine reflects the family's philosophy of purity, finesse, and authentic terroir expression.

Wine Description

The 2024 Drouhin Chambolle Musigny Premier Cru displays a bright ruby colour with glowing crimson reflections. The nose offers an enchanting perfume of dark cherry, fresh raspberry, and crushed violet petals, intertwined with subtle hints of spice and forest floor. On the palate, it is medium bodied with a velvety texture, framed by fine-grained tannins and a vibrant core of red fruit. The finish is remarkably long, clean, and lacy, underscored by a refreshing acidity that gives the wine its signature elegance. Crafted entirely from 100% Pinot Noir, this Premier Cru balances ethereal silkiness with structural depth. Its optimal drinking window spans from 2027 to 2040.

Food Pairing

This delicate yet structured Pinot Noir pairs superbly with roasted duck breast, pan-seared veal chops, or roasted pheasant with herbs. It also pairs wonderfully with earthy mushroom dishes or soft cheeses such as Époisses and Camembert.

Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Joseph Drouhin Corton Grand Cru 2024
bodyHtml:
Maison Joseph Drouhin is a historic Burgundian producer founded in 1880 in Beaune, France, and remains family owned across four generations. Located in the Côte de Beaune subregion of Burgundy, the estate is renowned for its steadfast commitment to organic and biodynamic viticulture and authentic 'terroir' expression. Sourced from the legendary Grand Cru hill of Corton—the only red Grand Cru vineyard site in the Côte de Beaune—this wine exemplifies the family's winemaking philosophy of balance, elegance, and structural power.

Wine Description

The 2024 Drouhin Corton presents a deep ruby colour with vibrant violet reflections. The expressive bouquet opens with captivating aromas of ripe dark cherry, wild blackberry, and crushed violet, seamlessly integrated with nuanced hints of delicate oak spice and sweet licorice. On the palate, this full-bodied wine reveals an imposing yet refined structure, characterized by silky, finely woven tannins and a dense core of dark fruit. Its lively acidity provides exceptional balance and freshness, leading to a complex, persistent finish with subtle mineral undertones. Crafted entirely from 100% Pinot Noir, this Grand Cru possesses remarkable depth and tension. Its optimal drinking window extends from 2030 through 2050.

Food Pairing

The power and depth of this Pinot Noir pair wonderfully with rich red meat dishes, such as a prime rib roast, braised beef bourguignon, or roasted venison loin. It also provides an outstanding accompaniment to wild mushroom risotto or aged French cheeses like Époisses.

Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Castiglion Del Bosco Brunello di Montalcino 2015
bodyHtml:
This iconic, highly acclaimed dry red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Brunello di Montalcino DOCG appellation in southern Tuscany. Castiglion del Bosco is a massive, historic estate covering over 2,000 hectares in the northwestern quadrant of Montalcino, with winemaking heritage stretching back over 800 years. As one of the founding members of the Consorzio del Vino Brunello di Montalcino in 1967, the estate combines pristine natural forestry with organically farmed, high-elevation vineyards (ranging from 300 to 450 meters above sea level). The estate's flagship Brunello draws primarily from Capanna, a south-facing vineyard rich in galestro (rocky schistose clay) and clay loam soils, producing a traditional yet impeccably polished expression of Sangiovese.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2015 vintage displays a deep ruby-garnet color with delicate orange-tinged amber reflections near the rim. The nose is expansive, aromatic, and deeply layered, opening with aromas of dried red cherry, wild strawberry, and dark plum, seamlessly woven with complex secondary notes of pipe tobacco, leather, crushed dry roses, forest floor, cedar, and subtle espresso grounds. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, structured, and muscular, yet remarkably balanced by a vibrant beam of Sangiovese acidity. Dense, fine-grained, firm tannins build across the palate, carrying concentrated dark fruit and savory spice through to an extraordinarily long, chalky mineral finish. Crafted from 100% Sangiovese (Sangiovese Grosso), the hand-harvested organic grapes undergo temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks, followed by approximately 24 to 36 months of aging in French oak casks (botti) and barriques, with extensive additional bottle aging before release. The alcohol by volume sits at 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The muscular tannic frame, rich fruit concentration, and savory earthiness of this 2015 Brunello make it a supreme match for robust Tuscan meats and aged hard cheeses. Excellent culinary pairings include bistecca alla Fiorentina (grilled T-bone steak), roasted rack of lamb with herbs, slow-braised wild boar (cinghiale) ragù over pappardelle, roasted venison loin, and braised beef short ribs. For cheese pairings, opt for mature Pecorino Toscano, Parmigiano-Reggiano, or sharp aged Gouda.

Vintage Quality

The 2015 vintage in Montalcino is widely celebrated as a historic, benchmark 5-star vintage for the appellation. A ideal growing season featuring a warm, sunny summer complemented by cool nights allowed Sangiovese to achieve complete phenolic maturity while maintaining brilliant natural acidity and structural balance. The 2015 Castiglion del Bosco Brunello di Montalcino is currently entering its prime drinking window after decanting, showcasing magnificent harmony and power, while holding the concentration and structure to age gracefully in proper cellars for 15 to 20+ years.

Brunello di Montalcino 2015 shows an intense ruby red colour with garnet reflections, the classic Brunello aromas are clear and bursting, including notes of undergrowth, small red berries and hints of violet. On the palate it develops in an infinite progression, with velvety tannins, it is characterized by excellent persistence and an elegant finish.

97 Points - James Suckling

Wonderful aromas of flowers, plums, terracotta and white pepper. Intense, yet ever so subtle. Medium to full body, firm and silky tannins and a long and intense finish. Shows excellent length.

94 Points - Vinous

Good deep red. Complex aromas of redcurrant, raspberry, graphite, mocha, and mint. It is focused and sophisticated with lovely sweetness and standout purity in its flavours of red berries and candied flowers. It finishes with polished tannins and excellent length.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Castiglion del Bosco is the Montalcino estate owned by Massimo Ferragamo of the Ferragamo shoe and fashion dynasty. This pretty wine shows precision and focus with a rich, fruit-forward style. The 2015 Brunello di Montalcino is a shapely Tuscan red with softness and velvety intensity to pair with a winter meat dish by an open fireplace. The wine glides smoothly over the palate, imparting aromas of black cherry, dried blackberry, plum, toasted spice and crushed flower. This harvest, which came about a week earlier than expected, resulting in a measured and carefully balanced Sangiovese from a generous vintage.

title: Rumblers Soda Mixer 355 ml – 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Bring the bar experience home with Rumblers Soda Mixer! Designed to enhance—never mask—the taste of your favorite liquors, Rumblers provides ultra-crisp, long-lasting carbonation for unbeatable cocktails and mocktails.

  • Pack Size: 24 x 355 ml cans

  • Best Served: Ice-cold, mixed with your liquor of choice or enjoyed solo over ice!

  • Great For: Parties, game nights, events, and well-stocked home bars.

title: Lucano 1894 Amaro - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Amaro Lucano 1894 is a historic, herbal Italian digestif originating from Pisticci, a small town in the Basilicata region (formerly known as Lucania) in Southern Italy. The spirit was created in 1894 by pastry chef Cavalier Pasquale Vena in the back room of his bakery, blending his passion for pastry with traditional herbology. The brand remains family-owned to this day, operated under the stewardship of the fourth generation of the Vena family.

Spirit Description

Amaro Lucano is crafted using a secret, century-old recipe that infuses more than 30 botanicals; including holy thistle, gentian, absinthe wormwood, clary sage, musk yarrow, and citrus peel into a neutral base spirit. The extract undergoes natural aging before being blended with essential oils, pure sugar, and water to achieve its balanced, bittersweet harmony.

  • Colour: Deep, dark mahogany brown with warm reddish amber highlights.

  • Aroma: Highly aromatic and complex, opening with bitter orange peel, cinchona, cola, pine, and sweet baking spices like cinnamon, backed by subtle hints of mint and floral herbs.

  • Palate: Smooth, rich, and balanced on the entry. Upfront caramel sweetness and dark fruit notes of dried fig and raisin yield to a pleasantly bitter mid-palate driven by gentian, bitter orange, dark chocolate, and warm baking spices.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a pleasantly round, silky, and viscous mouthfeel that coats the palate cleanly without being cloying.

  • Finish: Long, warming, and bittersweet, trailing off with lingering notes of herbal gentian, dried orange zest, soft cinnamon spice, and a cool touch of mint.

  • ABV: Bottled at 28% (56 Proof).

title: Cazadores Pineapple Tequila
bodyHtml:
Cazadores Pineapple Infused Tequila is a vibrant, fruit-infused expression originating from the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the historic Tequila Cazadores distillery in Arandas, the brand was established in 1922 and operates under Bacardi Limited. Master Distiller José Miguel Escobar created this expression to combine the brand's traditional 100% Blue Weber Agave Blanco foundation with refreshing pineapple sweetness for versatile, tropical cocktail making.

Spirit Description

Cazadores Pineapple is built upon a 100% estate-grown Blue Weber Agave Blanco base that undergoes a seven-day fermentation process accompanied by classical music to soothe the yeast. The spirit is infused with natural ripe pineapple flavor to create a balance between sweet fruit and crisp agave.

  • Colour: Light gold with luminous pale straw highlights.

  • Aroma: Tropical and fresh, opening with aromas of juicy ripe pineapple, sweet cooked agave, and bright citrus zest.

  • Palate: Smooth and approachable on the entry, balancing sweet tropical fruit and natural pineapple juice against classic roasted agave, light herbal notes, and soft black pepper spice.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a light, silky texture that coats the palate smoothly.

  • Finish: Clean and refreshing, closing with lingering tropical pineapple sweetness and a delicate touch of agave warmth.

  • ABV: Bottled at 35% (70 Proof).

title: Avion Reserva Cristalino Tequila
bodyHtml:
Avion Reserva Cristalino Tequila is an ultra-premium, aged Mexican spirit produced in the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. The brand was founded in 2010 by Ken Austin (notably featured in HBO's Entourage) and acquired by spirits giant Pernod Ricard in 2018. Crafted at the Productos Finos de Agave distillery (NOM 1416) in Jesús María under the direction of Master Distiller Alejandro Lopez, this expression represents the pinnacle of Avion's barrel-aging and filtration techniques.

Spirit Description

Avion Reserva Cristalino is created by taking hand-harvested 100% Blue Weber Agave grown at high elevations (over 7,000 feet) and slow-roasting the piñas in traditional brick ovens for 72 hours. After double-distillation, the master blender constructs a base using fine Añejo tequila aged for 12 months in American oak barrels, elevated with a subtle touch of long-aged Extra Añejo. The aged dark spirit then undergoes a proprietary double-charcoal filtration process that strips away the amber color while preserving the oak-derived complexity and silky body.

  • Colour: Perfectly crystal clear, brilliant, and transparent.

  • Aroma: Complex and inviting, opening with warm oak wood, vanilla, milk chocolate, and sweet cinnamon, complemented by underlying mineral notes, lime zest, and cooked agave.

  • Palate: Creamy, smooth, and texturized. Upfront flavors of honeyed agave, butterscotch, and brown sugar blend into chocolate, warm cinnamon spice, and a peppery oak backbone.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a round, silky, and velvety mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Crisp, dry, and exceptionally smooth, leaving a trailing warmth of sweet oak, cinnamon, and black pepper.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Domaine Pierre Andre Dumas Cremant de Bourgogne Blanc de Blancs
bodyHtml:
This sparkling wine originates from the Burgundy region of France, where the fruit is sourced from vineyards situated at the foot of the Brouilly hill. Domaine Pierre Andre Dumas is a family estate spanning 15 hectares of vines, currently managed by Pierre André, a third generation winemaker who blends modern ideas with deep respect for terroir and traditions. The winery focuses heavily on sustainable viticulture and is converting towards certified organic farming practices to let the vineyards speak honestly.

Wine Description

This Crémant de Bourgogne displays green tints on a limpid robe, driven by a brilliance of fine, persistent bubbles. The nose presents a fine, expressive profile highlighted by green apple, yellow fruits, peach, and apricot. On the palate, it is supple, airy, and beautifully balanced, offering a soft and pleasant texture backed by vibrant fruit, fine bubbles, and good length. This medium bodied sparkling wine shows excellent freshness and crispness, leading to a clean, lively finish. Crafted as a Blanc de Blancs, it consists entirely of 100% Chardonnay grapes. The wine features an alcohol by volume of 12.50% and is actively in conversion toward organic agriculture.

Food Pairing

This dry, fresh sparkling wine serves as a perfect before dinner drink on its own or mixed into a traditional fruit crème cocktail. Structurally, its crisp acidity and fine bubbles complement fresh fish, seafood platters, and lightly smoked fish. It also pairs wonderfully with cured meats, soft cheeses, and light pasta dishes.

Vintage Quality

Recent growing seasons in the region required winemakers to navigate fluctuating weather conditions and yield variations, demanding careful management in the vineyards. The estate successfully maintained excellent fruit density and acidity through precise harvest timing and controlled fermentations, showcasing the winemaker's skill in preserving freshness.

title: Capel Pisco Reservado Moai - 1000 ml
bodyHtml:
Capel Pisco Reservado Moai originates from Chile, within the designated North region in the subregion of the Elqui Valley. The producer, Cooperativa Agricola Pisquera Elqui Limitada, was established in 1938 as a collaborative effort by small scale grape growers to overcome economic hardships. Today, the cooperative has grown into a major entity, preserving traditional distillation methods while utilising high altitude vineyards irrigated by pure Andean snowmelt.

Spirit Description

This premium spirit displays a glistening straw, amber appearance with soft golden reflections in the glass. The sensory profile features an intense and fruity nose rich with floral Muscat notes, white flowers, fresh grape aromas, and citrus freshness. On the palate, the body is smooth, satiny, and exceptionally well balanced, delivering an aromatic combination of fresh grapes, delicate herbs, and warm spices. The finish is remarkably long, dry, and refined, leaving a trailing warmth complemented by soft peppery fruit and elegant oak tones. This reservado pisco is matured for four to six months in American oak barrels and is bottled at an alcohol by volume of 40%.

Accolades

This special edition expression is globally celebrated for its iconic structural packaging, which pays homage to the culture of Easter Island. While individual spirit competition scores fluctuate between batches, the flagship liquid has maintained a steady reputation for quality, representing the cooperative craftsmanship that has earned Capel a dominant share in the competitive South American spirits market.

title: Avion Reserva 44 Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Avión Reserva 44 Extra Añejo is the pinnacle expression produced in the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. The brand was founded in 2010 by Ken Austin and acquired by Pernod Ricard in 2018. Distilled at the Productos Finos de Agave distillery (NOM 1416) in Jesús María, this flagship small-batch release takes its name directly from its meticulous 44-month aging process.

Spirit Description

Avión Reserva 44 is produced from hand-harvested 100% Blue Weber agave grown at high elevations. After slow-roasting in traditional brick ovens and double distillation, the liquid undergoes a total of 44 months of aging. The spirit rests for 43 months in large American oak barrels before spending its final month in smaller "petite" oak casks that are physically rotated daily to maximize wood contact and draw out deep, concentrated barrel flavors.

  • Colour: Deep warm amber with rich golden copper glints.

  • Aroma: Intensely aromatic, opening with warm oak, vanilla bean, butterscotch, and toasted caramel, layered alongside roasted agave, cinnamon sugar, and subtle notes of dried fruit and marzipan.

  • Palate: Lush, silky, and decadent on the entry. It delivers rich layers of dark chocolate, butterscotch, tres leches creaminess, and vanilla, balanced by warm oak spice, black pepper, and cooked agave sweetness.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a round, velvety, and mouth-coating viscosity.

  • Finish: Long, gentle, and warming, tapering off with lingering notes of sweet vanilla, subtle cinnamon spice, toasted oak, and a hint of dark cacao.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof) in a crystal decanter, individually numbered and signed by founder Ken Austin.

title: Alvear Brandy Gran Reserva 25 Year Old - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Alvear Brandy Gran Reserva 25 Year Old originates from Spain, in the South region within the subregion of Montilla Moriles. Founded in 1729, Bodegas Alvear is one of the oldest family owned wineries in the country and has maintained its rich heritage for generations. The historic estate is globally celebrated for its exceptional expression of local varieties and masterfully crafted traditional spirits.

Spirit Description

This premium Spanish brandy displays a bright mahogany color with an ancient gold and reddish hue in the glass. The powerful, deep, and complex sensory profile features an appealing nose driven by distinct aromas of old wood, baked spices, and notes of pastry. On the palate, the liquid is elegant and delicate, showcasing a satiny texture and a muted sweet note that reminiscently honors a very old Pedro Ximenez. Flavors of nuts and spirited wood coat the mouth, leading into an incredibly long, persistent, and warm finish. This carefully crafted spirit is aged through a traditional solera system in ancient American oak casks and is bottled at an alcohol by volume of 40%.

title: Le Volte Dell' Ornellaia 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from Italy, within the prized Toscana IGT appellation along the sun-drenched coast of upper Tuscany. First introduced in 1991, Le Volte dell'Ornellaia serves as the approachable, fruit-driven entry point into the world of Tenuta dell'Ornellaia. Crafted by the same team that produces the estate's legendary Super Tuscans; Ornellaia and Le Serre Nuove, Le Volte is designed for early drinking and everyday enjoyment without sacrificing structural precision. Sourced from selected vineyards across Bolgheri and surrounding Tuscan plots, the vines are rooted in a complex soil mosaic of marine sediments, alluvial clays, and gravelly volcanic deposits. The warm maritime climate, tempered by cooling breezes from the nearby Tyrrhenian Sea, allows the grapes to achieve optimal ripeness, vibrant fruit concentration, and supple tannins.

Wine Description

Le Volte dell'Ornellaia presents a vibrant, deep ruby-purple appearance in the glass with bright violet highlights at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and expressive, offering an inviting symphony of bright Mediterranean red and dark fruits. The bouquet opens with a generous display of ripe black cherries, wild raspberries, and juicy blackberries, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of fresh red plums, dried lavender, sweet tobacco leaf, dried herbs, and a subtle touch of black pepper and cocoa. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, succulent, and beautifully balanced, delivering a plush core of crunchy stone fruits and dark berries. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a lively, mouthwatering vein of natural acidity that keeps the mid-palate light and refreshing. The mouthfeel is broad yet sleek, framed by smooth, fine-grained, and velvety tannins that glide into a long, clean finish accented by subtle balsamic nuances, spice, and mineral salinity.

title: Giacomo Borgogno e Figli Vermouth di Torino Bianco Superiore
bodyHtml:
This premium aromatized wine comes from the Piedmont region of northern Italy, with the historic producer rooted in the prestigious Barolo area. Casa Borgogno established the roots of this aromatized wine back in the 1920s, crafting it according to an ancient family recipe. As one of the oldest historical wineries in Barolo, the estate blends centuries of heritage with a forward-looking vision that includes a strong commitment to organic farming.

Wine Description

This Vermouth di Torino Bianco Superiore shows a limpid, light golden profile in the glass. The nose is highly expressive and complex, defined by an intricate infusion of 37 to 46 different roots, flowers, seeds, and fruits that are macerated in alcohol for at least two months. Vibrant citrus notes of orange, lemon, and grapefruit take center stage, underpinned by a secret botanical blend featuring mugwort, vanilla, cloves, gentian, rhubarb, sandalwood, cardamom, mace, and a distinct presence of quinine bark. On the palate, it is beautifully structured, supple, and harmonious, striking an elegant balance between sweet citrus fruitiness and a sophisticated herbal bitterness. It has a rich, medium to full body with a warm, beautifully persistent finish. Crafted using a base wine made from Cortese grapes, the final blend incorporates sugar, pure alcohol, and the botanical infusion before resting in traditional concrete tanks. The product features an alcohol by volume of 17%.

title: Loch Lomond 12 Year Old – 50 ml
bodyHtml:
The Loch Lomond Twelve Aged Years is a premium single malt Scotch whisky originating from Alexandria, in the Dunbartonshire region of the Scottish Highlands. The spirit is crafted at the Loch Lomond Distillery, an exceptionally versatile facility founded in 1965 by the Littlemill Distillery Company. Now managed by the Loch Lomond Group, the site stands as one of the most innovative distilleries in Scotland, famously operating a combination of traditional swan neck pot stills alongside unique, straight neck pot stills that feature internal distillation trays.

Spirit Description

Loch Lomond 12 Year Old is created by marrying distinct unpeated and peated distillates pulled from both the straight neck and swan neck still configurations. To build its signature character, Master Blender Michael Henry utilizes a three cask maturation framework, aging the liquid for over a decade in a combination of first fill bourbon barrels, refill casks, and re-charred American oak barrels.

  • Colour: Deep gold with warm amber glints.

  • Aroma: Crisp and sweet. The nose opens with an aromatic burst of orchard fruits, fresh green apple, and ripe pear, before shifting into lemon meringue, buckwheat honey, and golden grains, with a subtle background hint of wood smoke.

  • Palate: Creamy and luscious on the entry. It delivers structured layers of ripe peach, baked apples, and vanilla fudge, intricately woven with light biscuit sweetness, brown sugar, nutmeg, and a greener, approachable touch of soft peat smoke.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a pleasantly rich, oily texture that fully coats the mouth.

  • Finish: Medium in length and dry, closing with a distinct tingle of wood spice, cinnamon, warming oak, and a lingering tang of gentle peat embers.

  • ABV: Bottled at 46% and kept non-chill filtered.

title: Far Niente Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Far Niente, established in Oakville in 1885 and restored by Gil and Beth Nickel in 1979, stands as one of Napa Valley's most iconic benchmark producers. Renowned as the "House of Chardonnay," the estate has maintained an uncompromising commitment to producing world-class, house-style Chardonnay and Cabernet Sauvignon for over four decades.

A defining signature of Far Niente Chardonnay is its strict no-malolactic fermentation philosophy. First established with the 1979 vintage, this house style preserves the grape's natural, bright acidity and vibrant fruit character, resulting in a Chardonnay that balances rich, house-style decadence with electric precision and remarkable ageability.

Wine Description

The Far Niente Napa Valley Chardonnay 2023 displays a brilliant pale gold color with green highlights. On the nose, it opens with vibrant aromas of lemon curd, green apple, peach, and citrus blossom, intertwined with underlying notes of toasted brioche, flinty minerality, and subtle vanilla spice.

On the palate, the wine delivers the signature Far Niente contrast: a rich, silky texture paired with clean, mouthwatering acidity. Layers of tropical papaya, crisp pear, and roasted hazelnut unfold across a focused, medium-to-full-bodied frame. The absence of malolactic fermentation keeps the fruit profile pure and bright, preventing any heaviness and carrying the wine into a long, crisp, and elegant finish accented by refined oak spice.

Crafted primarily from estate fruit in Coombsville—complemented by select sites in Carneros and Napa Valley—the wine was fermented and aged for approximately 8–10 months in French oak barrels (roughly 50% new, 50% neutral).

Food Pairing

The bright, non-malolactic acidity combined with rich French oak integration makes this Chardonnay exceptionally versatile at the table. It pairs brilliantly with rich seafood such as pan-seared sea scallops with lemon-butter sauce, butter-poached lobster, crab cakes, and roasted halibut. It is equally adept at complementing roasted chicken with herbs, pork tenderloin with apple reduction, wild mushroom risotto, and creamy cheeses like Delice de Bourgogne, Brie, or Gruyère.

title: Loch Lomond Peated Rioja Cask Single Malt Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Loch Lomond Peated Rioja Cask Single Malt Whisky originates from Scotland, within the renowned Highland region. The Loch Lomond distillery, situated near the dramatic banks of its namesake loch, stands out as one of the most innovative and versatile distilleries in the country. Operating with an on site cooperage and a unique combination of traditional Swan Neck and straight neck stills, the distillery has the rare ability to sculpt vastly different spirit styles under one roof.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays an appealing amber appearance with warm golden reflections in the glass. The sensory profile opens with an aromatic nose featuring woodsmoke, malted biscuit, and redcurrant fruit, accompanied by a delicate wine sweetness and forest berries. On the palate, the body is harmonious and beautifully balanced, bringing together sweet honey, soft orchard fruits like peach and pear, dark chocolate, and a touch of orange citrus against a fine tannic structure. The finish is medium in length, offering a gentle richness with dry, spicy undertones and a persistent, lingering smoke. This expression is bottled at an alcohol by volume of 40%.

title: Chateau Fredignac Coince ta Bulle Cremant de Bordeaux
bodyHtml:
This sparkling wine comes from France, inside the renowned Bordeaux region and the specific subregion of Blaye. The story of the estate began in 1919 when a sailor from Brittany discovered the exceptional terroir of Blaye and abandoned his maritime career to plant the first vines. Today, the family vineyard spans 20 hectares and is managed by Ludivine and Vincent L'Amouller, who operate entirely under certified organic farming practices to protect environmental biodiversity.

Wine Description

This Crémant de Bordeaux presents a beautiful pale profile defined by fine, delicate bubbles. The nose offers an expressive bouquet of bright, fresh fruits, leading into a palate that is notably vibrant, tonic, and beautifully structured with a touch of pepperiness. It features a medium body balanced by a crisp mineral tension and an incredibly refreshing, clean finish. The wine is a varietal expression crafted from 100% Semillon grapes grown on clay limestone soils. Reflecting the winemaking philosophy of the estate, it is fully certified organic and vinified naturally with minimal intervention. The alcohol by volume for this bottling sits at 12.0%.

Food Pairing

The lively acidity and crisp texture of this sparkling wine make it highly versatile for food pairings. It serves as an excellent option for spontaneous before dinner drinks among friends. Structurally, it beautifully balances rich seafood platters, fresh fish, and cured appetizers. It is also an ideal companion for mature, well aged cheeses and lightly spiced dishes that benefit from a burst of palate cleansing freshness.

title: Powers Merlot 2020
bodyHtml:
This rich dry red wine originates from the United States, within Washington State and the expansive Columbia Valley appellation. Powers Winery was established by Washington wine pioneer Bill Powers, who helped lead sustainable and organic viticulture efforts in the Pacific Northwest. Sourced from dedicated estate and partner vineyard blocks—including the certified organic Badger Mountain Estate Vineyard as well as sites across the Wahluke Slope and Columbia Valley—the winery emphasizes environmentally responsible winemaking. The estate's viticultural approach balances low environmental impact with careful vineyard management to express the deep fruit character and natural structure of the region.

Wine Description

This 2020 vintage displays a deep garnet ruby colour in the glass. The nose opens with expressive aromatics of ripe pomegranate, dark plum, and red cherry, interwoven with savoury notes of rosemary, dried fennel, a touch of wet slate, and subtle smoked tobacco. On the palate, it exhibits a full bodied, supple, and rich mouthfeel filled with layered flavours of black licorice, cassis, and dark fruit, balanced by a distinct underlying minerality and fresh natural acidity. Well structured tannins frame the wine, leading to a long, focused, and polished finish. Crafted from 100% organic Merlot grapes, the fruit was fermented in stainless steel tanks and aged to enhance texture while preserving bright fruit intensity. It carries an alcohol by volume of 13.5%.

title: Cultivar North Coast Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
This vibrant dry red wine originates from the United States, within California and the expansive North Coast AVA. Cultivar Wine was founded by siblings Ginger and Jody LeMoine, who set out to create expressive, terroir driven wines sourced from premier California vineyards. Emphasizing sustainable viticulture and meticulous grape selection, the winery blends fruit from distinct growing sites across the North Coast to showcase balanced, fruit forward expressions with real complexity and sense of place.

Wine Description

This 2022 vintage presents a deep garnet to dark cherry red colour in the glass. The nose offers an inviting and aromatic bouquet of rose petals, dark cassis, and subtle leather, accented by a delicate touch of toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is juicy and approachable, delivering a ripe core of blackberry, black cherry, and fresh raspberry. Well integrated tannins provide structure and balance, complemented by subtle underlying notes of graphite and minerals that carry through to a long, clean finish. Crafted primarily from Cabernet Sauvignon, the wine carries an alcohol by volume of 13.9%.

title: 75 Wine Company Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
This rich dry red wine originates from the United States, within California and prominent Northern California grape growing regions including Mendocino, Lake County, and Napa Valley. 75 Wine Company was founded by Tuck Beckstoffer, whose family moved to Napa Valley in 1975 and became one of California's most renowned viticultural families. Created with the mission to deliver exceptional quality and vineyard driven character at an accessible price point, the winery sources grapes from top vineyard sites—such as the Amber Knolls Vineyard in Lake County's Red Hills—focusing on sustainable farming practices and thoughtful winemaking that highlight California's unique sun and soils.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep ruby to garnet colour in the glass. The nose offers an inviting and aromatic bouquet of fresh cherry, strawberry jam, and dark plum, accented by notes of cinnamon, cedar, and subtle cocoa. On the palate, it is smooth, supple, and well balanced, delivering rich flavours of blackberry, black currant, and red cherry layered with delicate hints of dark chocolate, toffee, and subtle earthy spice. Aging for approximately 12 months in French oak provides a polished, silky mouthfeel and soft, approachable tannins that extend into a long, lingering finish. The wine typically carries an alcohol by volume of 13.9%.

title: Domaine des Fontaines Bonnezeaux Les Brunettes 2018
bodyHtml:
This sweet, full bodied white dessert wine originates from France, within the Anjou region of the Loire Valley and the prestigious Bonnezeaux appellation. Domaine des Fontaines is a long standing family run estate situated in Thouarcé, operating in the heart of the Coteaux du Layon. Managed with sustainable viticultural techniques, the estate focuses on showcasing the unique character of its slate and schist soils. The Les Brunettes cuvée is one of the property's benchmark offerings, celebrated for its luscious complexity and vibrant concentration achieved through careful hand harvesting.

Wine Description

This fine sweet wine presents an intense, gleaming golden yellow colour in the glass. The nose is deeply aromatic and complex, offering a expressive bouquet of very ripe quince, stewed apricot, honey, exotic fruits, and subtle hints of caramel. On the palate, it reveals a rich, voluptuous volume and a coat of generous sweetness, expertly balanced by the grape's signature natural freshness and an underlying mineral tension from the local schist terrain. Flavours of candied fruits, dried apricot, and citrus peel linger effortlessly through a long, luxurious finish. Crafted entirely from 100% Chenin Blanc, the grapes are selectively picked in successive passes to harvest fruit concentrated by noble rot.

Food Pairing

The opulent sweetness, rich texture, and elevated natural acidity of this sweet Chenin Blanc make it an exquisite match for rich and savoury delicacies. It pairs spectacularly with pan seared foie gras, terrines, roasted sea scallops, and strong blue cheeses such as Roquefort or Fourme d'Ambert. It is equally exceptional alongside regional goat cheeses or fruit desserts such as pear and almond tarts, baked apple galettes, and fruit clafoutis.

title: Mi Familia Extra Anejo (Aged 5 Years)
bodyHtml:
Mi Familia Extra Anejo Aged 5 Years originates from Mexico, produced in the renowned tequila region of Jalisco. Mi Familia is a family driven producer rooted in Jalisco, dedicated to honoring traditional production methods while crafting expressive, premium spirits.

  • Colour: Deep amber with luminous golden sparkles.

  • Aroma: Sweet agave leads with prominent notes of vanilla, caramel, dried fruits, and toasted oak.

  • Palate & Body: Full bodied with a rich, smooth, and creamy texture. It offers decadent flavours of dark chocolate, coffee, fudge, hazelnut, and warm oak spice.

  • Finish: Long and warming finish with lingering caramel, soft agave sweetness, and gentle oak spice.

title: Bodegas Lan Edicion Limitada 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from Spain, within the renowned Rioja appellation of the Rioja Alta sub-region. Founded in 1972, Bodegas LAN is named as an acronym for the three provinces spanning the Rioja region: Logroño, Álava, and Navarra. Operating under an innovative, technical winemaking philosophy led by technical director and oak-aging expert María Barúa, LAN stands as a pioneer of modern, high-expression Riojas. The "Edición Limitada" cuvée represents the pinnacle of craftsmanship from their legendary 72-hectare estate, Viña Lanciano, specifically sourced from "Pago El Rincón"—an elevated, 40-year-old bush-vine plot enclosed by a majestic meander of the Ebro River. Rooted in poor, pebble-strewn alluvial soils (cantos rodados), these heritage vines yield ultra-concentrated fruit infused with the estate's signature mineral streak.

Wine Description

The 2022 Bodegas LAN Edición Limitada presents an intense, opaque cherry-red hue in the glass with dark garnet highlights. Its sensory profile is exceptionally deep, complex, and high-toned, offering a bold, modern expression of old-vine Rioja Alta terroir. The bouquet opens with an expressive and generous display of candied black plums, wild blackberries, and cassis, seamlessly layered with rich nuances of dark cocoa, roasted espresso, pipe tobacco, clove, cinnamon, and a distinct line of chalky, iron-rich minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, warm, and remarkably broad, showcasing a dense, velvety core of dark stone fruits and dark chocolate. It is characterized by its outstanding structural power and a balanced, lively acidity that keeps the massive mid-palate extract fresh and focused. The mouthfeel is muscular yet polished, framed by firm, fine-grained tannins that carry into an extraordinarily long, harmonious finish accented by toasted wood, graphite, and sweet spice.
