title: Le Serre Nuove Dell' Ornellaia 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s coastal region of Tuscany, in the renowned Bolgheri DOC, comes Le Serre Nuove Dell Ornellaia 2022. Produced by Tenuta dell Ornellaia, one of Italy’s most prestigious estates founded in 1981, the winery is celebrated for its Bordeaux-inspired blends crafted with Tuscan elegance. Now under the ownership of the Frescobaldi family, Ornellaia remains a benchmark for quality and terroir expression in Bolgheri.

Wine Description
This deep ruby-red wine opens with aromas of ripe blackcurrants, blackberries, violets, and hints of Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied with plush fruit and refined tannins, showing layers of dark cherries, figs, and a touch of cocoa. Notes of cedar and sweet spice from barrique ageing (15 months, one-third new oak) add complexity without overpowering the fruit.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 95 points.

    Wine Spectator – 93 points.

  • Vinous – 92 points.

  • Decanter – 90 points.

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled lamb, braised beef short ribs, or prime rib, this wine also pairs beautifully with aged cheeses and game dishes.

title: Powers Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
This rich dry red wine originates from the United States, within Washington State and the expansive Columbia Valley appellation. Powers Winery was founded in the early 1990s by Washington wine pioneer Bill Powers, who helped establish sustainable viticulture and organic farming practices in the region. Today, winemaker Greg Powers continues the family tradition, sourcing fruit from high quality vineyard sites across the valley to craft expressive wines with strong regional identity. The winery is known for producing full bodied, well structured wines that reflect the warm days, cool desert nights, and volcanic soils of eastern Washington.

Wine Description

This 2022 vintage presents a deep ruby garnet colour in the glass. The nose delivers an alluring array of dark fruits and herbal complexity, opening with aromas of mountain blackberry, black raspberry, and cassis, accompanied by savoury notes of dried sage, fennel, and a hint of wet limestone. On the palate, it exhibits a bold and structured body filled with flavours of ripe plum, black currant, and black cherry, seamlessly layered with notes of anise, dark chocolate, and subtle cedar. Firm, well integrated tannins provide structure and balance, guiding the wine into a long finish characterized by lingering dark berry fruit and toasted oak spice. Crafted primarily from Cabernet Sauvignon, the wine underwent barrel aging to enhance its texture and palate weight while preserving its bright varietal focus.

Food Pairing

The firm structure, rich fruit profile, and savoury notes of this Cabernet Sauvignon make it a classic partner for hearty meals. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled sirloin steak, roasted ribeye, braised beef short ribs, and roasted lamb. It also complements mushroom risotto, shepherd's pie, and aged sharp cheddar cheeses.

title: Peter Zemmer Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Alto Adige D.O.C. (Südtirol) appellation of the far northern alpine region. Cantina Tramin (historically and colloquially associated with the historic winegrowing traditions of the area) is one of the most celebrated cooperative wineries in the region, based in the village of Termeno (Tramin). Operating under a precision-focused winemaking philosophy that champions varietal purity, crisp alpine freshness, and site transparency, the estate works closely with local growers to cultivate low-yielding heritage vines. Rooted in complex soils of mineral-rich limestone, gravelly morainic debris, and sandy clay deposits, these high-altitude hillside blocks benefit from intense daytime alpine sunlight paired with dramatic nighttime temperature drops, allowing the Pinot Grigio grapes to build exceptional aromatic clarity alongside a chiseled, mineral-driven backbone.

Wine Description

The Zemmer Pinot Grigio presents a brilliant, pale straw-yellow appearance in the glass with shimmering green reflections. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, elegant, and high-toned, offering a masterfully vibrant expression of cool-climate white wine. The bouquet opens with an inviting, crisp display of green pears, yellow apples, and fresh lime zest, seamlessly layered with delicate floral undertones of white acacia blossoms, crushed stones, and a hint of fresh herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a juicy, refreshing core of orchard fruits and citrus oils. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is remarkably clean, supple, and textured, driven by a fine mineral tension that carries into a long, dry, and refreshing finish accented by lingering notes of white peach and cool slate.

title: Sam Jasper Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Sam Jasper is the flagship Cabernet Sauvignon crown jewel of the Indelicato family's Prestige Collection. The wine’s name pays homage to Gaspare "Jasper" Indelicato—who arrived in California from Sicily in 1911—and his brother-in-law "Sam," with whom he founded the original Sam Jasper Winery in 1935.

To craft a modern ultra-premium benchmark honoring their family legacy, the family partnered Black Stallion Estate Director of Winemaking Ralf Holdenried with legendary Napa Valley consulting winemaker Thomas Rivers Brown. Released as a 100% Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon, Sam Jasper sits alongside Transcendent and Bucephalus at the absolute peak of the estate's hierarchy.

Wine Description

The Sam Jasper Cabernet Sauvignon pours an inky, pitch-purple color. On the nose, it releases fragrant, brooding aromas of ripe, brambly blackberries, black cherries, and wild plums, laced with notes of crushed walnut husk, cedar chest, graphite, and toasted French oak.

On the palate, the wine delivers Thomas Rivers Brown's hallmark combination of power, precision, and broad, silky weightlessness. Flavors of dark cherry, redcurrant, and blueberry fan out across a lush, mouth-filling frame, underlaid by accents of dark cocoa, licorice, espresso roast, and subtle dried floral spice. Despite its full-bodied power and rich concentration, the wine is lifted by vibrant natural acidity and structured by fine-grained, integrated tannins, leading into a long, mouthwatering finish.

Food Pairing

The plush fruit concentration, dark cocoa notes, and structured palate of this flagship Cabernet match best with rich, savory protein dishes. Ideal pairings include dry-aged ribeye or Prime New York strip steak, slow-braised short ribs with polenta, pan-roasted duck breast with a cherry reduction, or roasted venison loin. It also complements earthy dishes like wild mushroom risottos, truffle-infused dishes, and long-aged hard cheeses like Comté or dark clothbound cheddar.

title: Diatom Santa Barbara Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from the United States, within California and the cool climate maritime region of Santa Barbara County. Diatom is a focused project created by acclaimed winemaker Greg Brewer, dedicated exclusively to capturing the pure, unvarnished essence of Chardonnay. The brand takes its name from diatomaceous earth, the fossilized plankton subsoil characteristic of Santa Barbara County's ancient oceanic landscape. Brewer employs a minimalist winemaking philosophy aimed at transparency, avoiding oak contact and malolactic fermentation to deliver an energetic, terroir driven wine.

Wine Description

This 2023 Chardonnay displays a vivid medium gold colour in the glass. The nose opens with an expressive and highly aromatic bouquet of lemon curd, citrus blossom, jasmine, and white peach, underpinned by hints of wet sand and subtle sea salt spice. On the palate, it delivers a striking balance between fruit concentration and electric tension. Flavours of tangerine, green apple, quince, and poached pear mingle with a distinct crunchy saline minerality. The body is medium to full, providing a rounded and supple texture held firm by mouthwatering natural acidity. It finishes clean, precise, and persistent with notes of lemon verbena and lingering ocean air freshness. Crafted as a 100% Chardonnay varietal, the fruit is sourced primarily from the Mission Hills Vineyard in Los Alamos. The wine is fermented entirely in stainless steel tanks at low temperatures and bottled early to preserve maximum purity. The alcohol by volume sits at 14.5%, produced under sustainable viticultural practices.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, saline drive, and pure fruit concentration of this unoaked Chardonnay make it exceptionally versatile at the dining table. It pairs brilliantly with fresh raw oysters, ceviche, pan seared sea scallops, grilled prawns, and Dungeness crab. Structurally, its crisp energy and texture also complement roasted chicken, delicate white fish such as halibut, sushi and sashimi, and fresh goat cheese salads.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Santa Barbara County was a standout growing season characterized by cool temperatures and extended hang times. This allowed Greg Brewer to harvest Chardonnay fruit at peak aromatic development and depth while retaining brilliant natural acidity, resulting in one of the most balanced and highly acclaimed releases for the estate.

title: Mt Brave Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Mt. Veeder A.V.A. of California's Napa Valley. Mt. Brave is a high-altitude mountain estate established in 2007 by Jackson Family Wines on the rugged, western slopes of the Mayacamas Mountain Range. Operating under the master winemaking direction of legendary mountain Cabernet specialist Chris Carpenter (also renowned for Lokoya and Cardinale), the winery pays homage to the native Wappo tribe that first inhabited these high peaks. The estate vines are rooted in thin, rocky volcanic and sedimentary seabed soils at high elevations up to 1,800 feet. Perched above the fog line, these steep, low-yielding mountain blocks receive intense daily sunlight tempered by cool maritime breezes from San Pablo Bay, naturally forcing the vines to yield concentrated berries with immense tannic structure and electric natural acidity.

Wine Description

The 2021 Mt. Brave Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep, near-opaque garnet-purple appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, deep, and high-toned, perfectly capturing the wild, high-altitude character of Mount Veeder. The bouquet opens with a captivating, multi-faceted display of fresh cassis, wild blueberries, and black cherry liqueur, beautifully layered with complex undertones of crushed violets, graphite minerality, tobacco leaf, bay leaf, and fresh sage. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and remarkably focused, showcasing a generous core of dark fruits, cocoa nibs, and crushed stones. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a vibrant, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through its mountain concentration. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and supple, driven by chalky, fine-grained, yet firm tannins that carry into an exceptionally long, savory finish accented by blue fruit, wild chaparral, and toasted cedar wood.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage across Napa Valley is widely celebrated by international critics as an absolute benchmark, legendary year characterized by extraordinary concentration, vibrant acidity, and profound aging potential. A dry winter and cool spring led into a warm, uniform summer, resulting in small grape berries with an ultra-high skin-to-juice ratio. On Mount Veeder, the high elevation and wide diurnal temperature shifts allowed the fruit to achieve full phenolic maturity while preserving essential natural acidity and fresh herbal precursors. Chris Carpenter and his team harvested small, pristine berry clusters with thick, beautifully ripe skins, yielding a wine that combines mountain power with sleek, polished elegance. Built with an internal matrix to cellar gracefully for decades, it will reach its primary drinking window between 2026 and 2045+.

title: Phantom Creek Estates Riesling 2022
bodyHtml:
This balanced dry white wine originates from Canada, within British Columbia, the Okanagan Valley, and the Black Sage Bench subregion. Phantom Creek Estates is a landmark, state of the art winery located near Oliver, dedicated to producing terroir driven estate wines through organic and biodynamic viticulture. Crafted with guidance from Alsace master winemaker Olivier Humbrecht MW, the estate's Riesling program showcases depth, richness, and pristine minerality. Sourced from well exposed, gravelly vineyard sites on the Black Sage Bench, multiple harvest passes ensure maximum complexity and acidity retention in every bottle.

Wine Description

This 2022 vintage reveals a brilliant pale straw colour with greenish reflections in the glass. The nose is highly aromatic and perfume forward, opening with scents of fresh white blossom, crisp green apple, white peach, and vibrant lime zest. On the palate, it delivers an energetic tension between ripe fruit weight and electric, world class natural acidity. Concentrated flavours of yellow citrus, lemongrass, fresh lime, and orchard fruit unfold alongside a delicate flinty and chalky mineral edge. Crafted as a 100% Riesling single varietal expression, the wine was matured for 5 months in traditional large Austrian oak casks to add weight and mouthfeel, followed by finishing in stainless steel to preserve pristine freshness.

Food Pairing

The vibrant, mouthwatering acidity and mineral tension of this dry Riesling make it an exceptional pairing at the table. It shines alongside delicate seafood like pan seared scallops, fresh oysters, Dungeness crab, and sushi or sashimi. Structurally, its bright citrus character and subtle palate weight make it an outstanding match for lightly spiced Asian cuisine, curry dishes, roast pork tenderloin with apple chutney, and fresh goat cheese.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 growing season in the South Okanagan began with a cold, wet spring that delayed budburst. However, conditions shifted dramatically during the summer and early autumn, bringing warm, dry days coupled with cool desert nights. This ideal diurnal temperature swing permitted steady, complete fruit ripening while preserving optimal natural acidity and berry weight, resulting in a vibrant vintage characterized by stunning purity and aromatic focus.

title: Phantom Creek Estates Organic Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This elegant dry rosé originates from Canada, within British Columbia and the famous Okanagan Valley appellation. Phantom Creek Estates is a state of the art winery founded by Richter Bai on the upper terrace of the Black Sage Bench near Oliver. Sourced from dedicated organic blocks across the estate's terroirs—including Becker, Ryegrass, Richter, and Evernden Spring Vineyards in the Okanagan and Similkameen Valleys—the property operates under strict organic farming principles. The estate's viticultural philosophy focuses on low yield precision and sustainable farming to reflect the true purity and character of the region's unique gravelly soils.

Wine Description

This 2025 vintage exhibits a brilliant, delicate pale salmon colour in the glass. The nose opens with an expressive bouquet of wild strawberries, raspberries, and delicate rose petals, complemented by subtle hints of wild white strawberry and light spice. On the palate, it delivers a bright, refreshing, and beautifully balanced experience. The mouthfeel is smooth and supple, underpinned by lively natural acidity that carries through to a clean, polished finish. Crafted as an organic rosé blend from early harvested fruit to preserve vibrancy and freshness, the wine carries an alcohol by volume of 13.5%. It is certified organic.

Food Pairing

The crisp acidity and delicate red berry fruit profile make this rosé exceptionally food friendly. It pairs wonderfully with spinach salad featuring grilled chicken and fresh strawberries, a grilled chicken burger, or a goat cheese tart with sun dried tomatoes. Structurally, its bright freshness also complements grilled salmon, tuna niçoise, mixed bean salads, antipasto platters, and fresh olives.

title: Gini Soave Classico 2025
bodyHtml:
This 2025 vintage shows a brilliant straw yellow colour with green gold reflections in the glass. The nose opens with an expressive bouquet of fresh white flowers such as elderflower and hawthorn, combined with white peach, crisp green apple, and subtle mineral undertones. On the palate, the wine delivers a fine, harmonious balance of vibrant acidity and smooth texture, showcasing flavours of citrus fruit, pear, and a signature hint of bitter almond on the long, dry finish. Crafted as a 100% Garganega single varietal from old vines, the fruit is harvested by hand and fermented using indigenous yeasts in temperature controlled stainless steel tanks. The wine ages on its lees in stainless steel for six months prior to bottling, maintaining pristine freshness without oak contact. The alcohol by volume sits at 12%.

Food Pairing

The crisp acidity and refined mineral structure of this Soave Classico make it a versatile partner at the dinner table. It pairs exceptionally well with fresh seafood, shrimp, pan seared scallops, grilled white fish, and octopus. It also complements lighter pasta dishes, risotto, white meat, and fresh goat cheese or soft cheeses.

title: Domaine Billaud Simon Chablis Grand Cru Vaudesir 2023
bodyHtml:
This prestigious Grand Cru white wine originates from France, inside the northern Burgundy region and the iconic Chablis subregion. Domaine Billaud Simon was established in 1815 and manages roughly 17 hectares of exceptional vineyards along the banks of the Serein River. Sourced from the warm, amphitheatre shaped Vaudesir climat, the estate focuses on sustainable viticulture and gentle winemaking to capture the rich Kimmeridgian limestone soils.

Wine Description

This 2023 Grand Cru displays a pale gold hue highlighted by delicate green reflections. The nose offers an expressive and complex aromatic bouquet filled with white flowers like linden and acacia, combined with ripe white peach, fresh citrus, and an intense flinty minerality. On the palate, it is rich, supple, and beautifully structured, showing a wonderful harmony between concentrated fruit volume and bright, racy acidity. The body is medium to full, providing a round texture alongside chalky mineral tension that carries through to an exceptionally long, persistent, and clean finish. Crafted as a 100% Chardonnay varietal expression, the wine undergoes careful fermentation and aging in stainless steel and French oak barrels. The alcohol by volume for this bottling sits at 13.0%, produced under sustainable farming practices.

Food Pairing

The concentration, refined structure, and vibrant mineral core of this Grand Cru make it an outstanding match for fine gastronomy. It pairs exceptionally well with fresh oysters, royal seafood platters, pan seared sea scallops, and lobster. Structurally, its crisp acidity and broad depth also complement white fish served in delicate butter or cream sauces, roasted poultry, and well aged cheeses.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in Chablis delivered high quality, generous fruit with superb structural balance. The winemakers at Billaud Simon demonstrated great skill in managing harvest timing to preserve the crisp, limestone driven acidity while allowing the Vaudesir fruit to achieve optimal ripeness and depth.

title: Hundred Acre Cabernet Sauvignon 'Ark Vineyard' 2022
bodyHtml:
Founded by enigmatic vintner Jayson Woodbridge, Hundred Acre is synonymous with uncompromising luxury, micro-lot precision, and ultra-rated Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon. Woodbridge approaches winemaking as a pursuit of absolute perfection, farming ruthlessly for low yields and fermenting single-block parcels with near-obsessive detail.

The Ark Vineyard, located on the slopes of Howell Mountain in the St. Helena AVA, sits on an ancient, volcanic ring of glass, obsidian, and red clay soils. Planted across nine distinct micro-blocks, this vineyard yields Cabernet Sauvignon renowned for its brooding, glass-staining density, extraordinary minerality, and seamless, infinite finish.

Wine Description

The Hundred Acre Cabernet Sauvignon 'Ark Vineyard' 2022 pours an opaque, pitch-black purple with a vibrant violet rim. The aromatics are explosive and deeply layered, unleashing a powerful bouquet of crème de cassis, wild blueberry liqueur, black cherries, and espresso roast, intertwined with crushed obsidian, graphite, warm iron ore, licorice, and fragrant violet notes.

On the palate, the 2022 Ark is full-bodied, multi-dimensional, and towering in structure, yet possesses the signature Hundred Acre silkiness. Layers of opulent dark fruit and sweet cocoa powder are framed by ultra-fine, pixelated tannins and remarkable underlying energy. Aged in 100% new French oak for approximately 30 months, the wood is entirely absorbed into the fruit weight, resulting in a seamless, weightless mouthfeel that coat the palate endlessly.

While approachable in its youth due to its plush tannin management, the 2022 Ark is built to age gracefully in the cellar for 30 to 40+ years.

Food Pairing

A wine of this magnitude, power, and structural concentration demands the richest, most savory cuts of meat. Ideal pairings include dry-aged Tomahawk ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs with black truffle reduction, roasted venison loin, or grilled Wagyu beef. It also pairs exceptionally well with rich, earthy dishes featuring porcini mushrooms, bone marrow, or long-aged hard cheeses like 36-month Comté.

title: My Favorite Neighbor Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
My Favorite Neighbor was created by winemaking pioneer Eric Jensen, the founder of the acclaimed Booker Vineyard in Paso Robles, California. Inspired by his close friendship and collaboration with neighbor Stephan Asseo of L’Aventure Winery, the project pays tribute to the collaborative spirit of Westside Paso Robles and the neighboring growers who cultivate exceptional fruit across the region.

While rooted in Paso Robles, the Cabernet Sauvignon is intentionally crafted as a high-end, mid-coast California blend. It combines estate fruit with carefully selected parcels from neighboring sites in Paso Robles, San Luis Obispo, and Santa Ynez, delivering a Napa-rivaling, opulent Cabernet expression at an accessible luxury price point.

Wine Description

The My Favorite Neighbor Cabernet Sauvignon pours an opaque, inky purple-black color. On the nose, it explodes with opulent, highly expressive aromas of crème de cassis, wild blackberry cobbler, and dark plum, interwoven with sweet tobacco, espresso bean, cocoa powder, crushed granite, and toasted French oak spice.

On the palate, this wine is full-bodied, lush, and undeniably generous. It coats the mouth with a velvety texture and a rich core of ripe black fruits, dark chocolate, and graphite. Despite its lavish scale and high fruit intensity, it maintains surprising freshness and balance thanks to fine-grained, chalky tannins and vibrant acidity that lift the long, opulent finish.

Composed primarily of Cabernet Sauvignon blended with small percentages of Petite Sirah, Syrah, Malbec, and Petit Verdot, the wine is aged for roughly 18 to 20 months in high-quality French oak barrels (around 50%–60% new).

Food Pairing

The opulent fruit profile, full body, and lush structure of this Cabernet call for bold, savory protein dishes. Excellent pairings include wood-fired ribeye steak, slow-braised beef short ribs with polenta, grilled lamb chops, or a rich venison stew. It also pairs exceptionally well with gourmet bacon cheeseburgers, barbecued brisket, or sharp, aged cheeses like dark clothbound cheddar or blue cheese.

title: Castello Di Montepo Jet Rose 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Located in the rugged, wild hills of the Maremma in southern Tuscany, Castello di Montepò is the crown jewel estate of Jacopo Biondi Santi and his son, Tancredi. Carrying forward the legendary legacy of the Biondi Santi family who famously created Brunello di Montalcino at Tenuta Greppo—Jacopo set out to forge modern, terroir-driven expressions using the family's proprietary Sangiovese clone, Sangiovese Grosso BBS11 (Biondi Santi 11).

Jet is an innovative, high-end Tuscan Rosato that showcases the versatility of the BBS11 clone. Named after Jacopo Biondi Santi's beloved thoroughbred racehorse, this wine reflects speed, elegance, and power, standing as one of Tuscany’s most sophisticated pink wines.

Wine Description

The Castello di Montepò Jet Rosato displays a bright, translucent peach-pink or soft coral hue reminiscent of classic Provençal rosé. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic and refined, bursting with aromas of fresh pink grapefruit, wild strawberries, white peach, and orange blossom, complemented by subtle nuances of Mediterranean scrub (macchia), crushed stone, and fresh herbs.

On the palate, the wine is sleek, crisp, and energetic. The naturally high acidity of the Sangiovese Grosso clone provides a vibrant, mouthwatering spine that cuts through a plush, silky texture. Flavors of red currant, pomegranate, and citrus zest dominate the palate, leading into a clean, mineral-driven, and slightly savory finish.

Crafted from 100% Sangiovese Grosso BBS11, the fruit undergoes a very brief skin contact (cold maceration) to gently extract color and delicate aromatics before soft pressing and temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel, preserving ultimate freshness and precision.

title: Penelope Straight Bourbon Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Penelope Four Grain Straight Bourbon Whiskey originates from the United States, distilled in Lawrenceburg, Indiana, and aged and bottled in Bardstown, Kentucky. The brand was created by co-founders Michael Paladini and Danny Polise, naming the flagship bottle after Paladini's daughter. Penelope Bourbon operates under the ownership of Luxco, a subsidiary of MGP Ingredients, which officially acquired the acclaimed non-distilling producer in 2023.

Spirit Description

Penelope Four Grain is crafted from a unique blend of three distinct bourbon mash bills combining corn, wheat, rye, and malted barley. Aged in new charred American oak barrels, the spirit is left non-chill filtered to preserve its natural texture.

  • Colour: Warm honey gold.

  • Aroma: Soft and inviting. The nose opens with corn grain sweetness, maple syrup, orange oils, and fresh vanilla, accented by light oak and mild baking spices like cinnamon and nutmeg.

  • Palate: Smooth, sweet, and approachable on the entry. It delivers creamy caramel, butterscotch, and honeyed cereal notes, balanced by sweet fruit, subtle berry, and gentle rye spice.

  • Body: Light-to-medium-bodied with a soft, rounded mouthfeel and low ethanol bite.

  • Finish: Gentle and easygoing, trailing off with sweet cornbread, vanilla icing spice, and light toasted oak.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Adictivo Blanco Tequila Craft Edition
bodyHtml:
Adictivo Blanco Tequila Craft Edition is an unaged artisanal spirit originating from the Lowland region of El Arenal in Jalisco, Mexico. The expression is distilled at El Castillo de Tequila (NOM 1653) under the direction of Master Tequilero Gildardo Partida, whose family boasts over a century of traditional tequila-making heritage. This special release is presented in a handcrafted ceramic vessel designed to mimic the rugged texture of the region's rich volcanic soil.

Spirit Description

Adictivo Blanco Craft Edition is produced from 100% blue Weber agave grown in the volcanic earth of the Valles Region. The cooked agave pinas are crushed, fermented, and double-distilled to capture the raw terroir of the land.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and clean.

  • Aroma: Fresh, aromatic, and welcoming. The nose opens with cooked agave, wet earth, and citrus zest, layered alongside sweet honey and subtle herbaceous notes.

  • Palate: Remarkably smooth, rich, and rounded on the entry. It delivers a sweet agave-forward profile balanced by light notes of tropical fruit, vanilla, and gentle white pepper spice.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a soft, silky texture that coats the mouth smoothly without harsh alcohol burn.

  • Finish: Clean, warming, and gentle, leaving a lingering sweetness of cooked agave, soft mint, and mild spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Angel's Envy Finished Rye
bodyHtml:
Angel's Envy Finished Rye is a premium finished rye whiskey originating from Louisville, Kentucky, in the United States. The brand was created by legendary Master Distiller Lincoln Henderson; a Kentucky Bourbon Hall of Fame inductee alongside his family, and operates under the ownership of Bacardi. The historic distillery is situated on Main Street in downtown Louisville, where it crafts innovative finished American whiskeys.

Spirit Description

Angel's Envy Finished Rye is crafted from a mash bill consisting of 95% rye and 5% malted barley. After aging in new charred American oak barrels, the liquid spends up to 18 additional months finishing in hand-selected Caribbean rum casks, which previously held dark rum.

  • Colour: Rich, glowing amber with warm copper hues.

  • Aroma: Intensely sweet and enticing. The nose opens with a dessert-like bouquet of maple syrup, vanilla, caramel candy, and toasted hazelnut, accented by citrus peel and subtle oak wood spice.

  • Palate: Velvety, smooth, and richly layered on the entry. It delivers a seamless fusion of sweet dark rum, maple sugar, and ripe tropical fruits, which interact beautifully against underlying notes of toasted oak, sherry wood, and cracked black pepper.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a luxurious, mouth-coating viscosity that softens the traditional edge of high-rye whiskey.

  • Finish: Sweet, warm, and lingering, trailing off with lingering notes of maple syrup, sweet rum, soft oak, and a delicate kiss of dry spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 50% (100 Proof).

title: Bower Hill Barrel Strength Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Bower Hill Barrel Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey originates from Louisville, Kentucky, in the United States. The brand pays homage to the historic Battle of Bower Hill in 1794, which marked the first bloodshed of the American Whiskey Rebellion. Produced in very small batches, this premium non-chill filtered whiskey captures the uncut, unadulterated spirit directly from the cask.

Spirit Description

Bower Hill Barrel Strength is crafted using a high-rye mash bill and aged for at least four years in new charred American oak barrels with a number three char level. Bottled at full cask strength without any dilution, it retains all of the natural fatty acids and barrel compounds to offer a rich, mouth-coating profile.

  • Colour: Dark golden amber with rich copper hues.

  • Aroma: Sweet and inviting, opening with rich crème brûlée, toasted pecans, sweet corn, vanilla spice, and charred oak.

  • Palate: Bold, lush, and sweet on the entry. The high-proof delivery unleashes prominent notes of vanilla, toasted nuts, and caramel, complemented by spicy oak tannins, wheat toast, and subtle dried fruit.

  • Body: Full-bodied and viscous with a rich, tongue-coating mouthfeel that carries an authentic barrel-strength warmth.

  • Finish: Very long, refined, and spicy, closing with lingering warmth, balanced baking spices, caramel, and a touch of sweet popcorn.

  • ABV: Bottled at full barrel proof, typically around 59.4% (118.8 Proof).

title: Citadelle Gin Rouge
bodyHtml:
Citadelle Gin Rouge is an artisanal fruit-infused dry gin originating from the Cognac region in Southwest France. The spirit is produced by the renowned Maison Ferrand at Château de Bonbonnet in Ars, France. Alexandre Gabriel, Master Distiller and founder of Maison Ferrand, launched Citadelle in 1996 as France's first craft gin, pioneering the use of traditional open-flame cognac copper pot stills to distill small-batch spirits.

Spirit Description

Citadelle Gin Rouge is built upon the brand's signature foundation of a triple-distilled French wheat base spirit and 19 classic botanicals. Using a patented progressive infusion process, the distillery integrates five 100% natural red fruits and plants; cranberry, raspberry, blueberry, blackcurrant, and rhubarb and distilling the ingredients directly rather than macerating them. This technique extracts vivid fruit aromas while leaving the liquid completely transparent.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and completely colorless.

  • Aroma: Highly aromatic and fresh, driven by bright red berries, blackcurrant, and fresh cranberry. This fruit-forward profile rests on a delicate foundation of piney juniper, citrus peel, and soft floral notes.

  • Palate: Crisp, juicy, and expressive on the entry. Upfront notes of tart raspberry, cranberry, and sweet blueberry yield to a complex mid-palate of earthy rhubarb, lemon zest, warm baking spices, and a hint of Sichuan pepper.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, surprisingly round, and slightly oily texture that coats the mouth evenly.

  • Finish: Long, clean, and dry, leaving lingering hints of red berry sweetness, light juniper, and a refreshing, subtle rhubarb tang without any cloying residue.

  • ABV: Bottled at 41.7% (83.4 Proof).

title: Eau Claire Cherry Gin
bodyHtml:
Eau Claire Cherry Gin is an artisanal fruit-infused spirit originating from Diamond Valley (formerly Turner Valley), Alberta, in the foothills southwest of Calgary. The spirit is produced by Eau Claire Distillery, which was founded in 2014 as Alberta's first independent craft distillery. The farm-to-glass producer is celebrated for using traditional agricultural methods, locally grown Alberta grains, and pure mountain runoff to handcraft award-winning Canadian spirits.

Spirit Description

Eau Claire Cherry Gin is crafted from a 100% Alberta barley base spirit distilled in a London dry style, infused with sour cherries and over 12 unique botanicals.

  • Colour: Deep ruby red with warm purple undertones.

  • Aroma: Highly aromatic and inviting, opening with vibrant sour cherry, subtle dark berry notes, and piney juniper, backed by fresh citrus zest and warm botanical spice.

  • Palate: Subtly tart, balanced, and expressive on the entry. Bright notes of ripe sour cherry and natural fruit sweetness yield to a structured mid-palate of classic juniper berries, citrus peel, and mild herbal complexity.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a uniquely smooth, silky, and rich mouthfeel derived from its local barley foundation.

  • Finish: Pleasant, long, and dry, trailing off with lingering tart cherry notes and a clean, refreshing botanical spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Kohinoor Reserve Indian Dark Rum
bodyHtml:
Kohinoor Reserve Indian Dark Rum originates from India, produced at the historic Rampur Distillery. Established in 1943, the distillery is operated by Radico Khaitan, one of India's oldest and most prestigious spirits companies. Drawing inspiration from India's ancient sugarcane distillation traditions and named after the world famous Kohinoor diamond, the brand's production philosophy revolves around small batch craftsmanship, triple cask maturation, and quiet luxury.

Spirits Description

In the glass, this dark rum exhibits a deep amber colour with rich ruby highlights. The nose is opulent and inviting, opening with sweet caramel, vanilla, toffee, and toasted oak, followed by subtle botanical whispers, nutmeg, and dried fruits like raisins and plum. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and velvety with a silky, oily texture. Flavours of brown sugar, dark chocolate, sweet spiced fruit, and roasted nuts are beautifully balanced by gentle oak tannin and warm spice. Crafted from fresh winter sugarcane juice distilled in small batches and aged through a triple cask process—American oak, Cognac XO, and Vermouth casks—and bottled at 43% ABV, it delivers remarkable complexity, harmony, and a long, warming finish.

title: Domaine Francois Chidaine Chenin d'Ici 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from France, within the celebrated Loire Valley. Domaine Francois Chidaine was founded in 1989 in Montlouis sur Loire and has grown into a benchmark estate for Loire Valley Chenin Blanc. Recognized as an early champion of organic and biodynamic viticulture, François Chidaine farms over 30 hectares across Montlouis, Vouvray, and Touraine. Sourced from parcels with clay, flint, and limestone soils, the Chenin dIci cuvée is bottled as a Vin de France. This classification allows Chidaine to combine high quality fruit across appellations to create a pure, expressive, and accessible style of Chenin Blanc.

Wine Description

This 2024 vintage showcases a clear, bright pale yellow colour. The nose delivers an inviting and aromatic bouquet of green apple, fresh pear, quince, and lemon peel, accompanied by white flowers and subtle hints of beeswax. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, dry, and balanced, showing a supple texture combined with nervy, bright acidity. Crisp orchard fruit flavours mingle with a clean, flinty, and chalky mineral edge that provides energy and length through to a dry, persistent finish. Crafted as a 100% Chenin Blanc varietal expression, it undergoes natural fermentation with indigenous yeasts and aging on fine lees in large neutral casks and tanks with minimal handling. The alcohol by volume sits at 13.0%, produced from biodynamically farmed vines.

Food Pairing

The bright acidity, mineral energy, and fresh orchard fruit notes of this Chenin Blanc make it an extremely versatile choice at the table. It pairs exceptionally well with fresh raw oysters, grilled prawns with lemon, ceviche, and pan seared white fish. Structurally, its crisp profile cuts cleanly through goats cheese, fresh green salads with chèvre, tomato and herb tarts, and roast pork served with apples.

title: Domaine des Peregrins Eleonore Moreau Chablis 2022
bodyHtml:
This classic white wine originates from France, within the northern Burgundy region and the renowned Chablis subregion. Domaine des Pérégrins (Domaine Moreau et Fille) is an artisan estate based in the small village of Poilly sur Serein, where Eléonore Moreau represents the single independent winemaker bottling and commercializing her own wines. Embracing a patient, small scale approach to viticulture, the estate operates under certified organic farming practices to protect soil health and express the purest identity of the region.

Wine Description

This 2022 Chablis displays a brilliant yellow hue in the glass. The nose presents an expressive, refined aromatic profile defined by yellow apple, fresh lemon, and white flowers accompanied by subtle spice and an unmistakable flinty mineral edge. On the palate, it is remarkably pure, supple, and beautifully structured, showing a powerful core of chalky minerality balanced by lively fruit intensity. The body is medium and clean, offering a round, elegant texture that leads to a long, precise finish. Crafted entirely as a 100% Chardonnay varietal expression, the grapes undergo long aging for 15 months on fine lees in temperature controlled stainless steel tanks with minimal intervention. The wine features an alcohol by volume of around 12.5% and is produced from certified organic vineyards.

Food Pairing

The pure mineral drive, bright citrus core, and crisp structure of this Chablis make it a fantastic match for fine dining. It pairs exceptionally well with fresh oysters, delicate shellfish, halibut, and pan seared white fish. Structurally, its vibrant acidity and clean profile also complement puff pastry mushroom dishes, roasted poultry, goat cheese, and fresh cucumber salads.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Burgundy delivered excellent quality, yielding ripe, generous fruit balanced by classic structural freshness. Eléonore Moreau demonstrated outstanding skill throughout the growing season and harvest, utilizing low intervention winemaking and extended lees contact to preserve the vibrant, terroir driven minerality while allowing the fruit to achieve sublime texture and length.

title: Domaine Billaud Simon Chablis 2023
bodyHtml:
This classic white wine originates from France, within the northern Burgundy region and the world famous Chablis subregion. Domaine Billaud Simon was established in 1815 by Jean Billaud and has grown into a pillar of the region, today managing roughly 17 hectares of exceptional vineyards. Situated along the banks of the Serein River, the estate focuses on sustainable viticulture and minimal cellar intervention, utilizing gravity-fed systems to capture the pure, precise, and flinty identity of Kimmeridgian limestone soils.

Wine Description

This Chablis displays a brilliant pale straw hue enhanced by light green reflections. The nose offers a crisp and expressive bouquet loaded with fresh citrus, green apple, lemon blossom, and subtle white peach, all underscored by an unmistakable flinty, sea breeze mineral edge. On the palate, it is airy, supple, and finely structured, showing a wonderful balance of racy acidity, bright citrus intensity, and a creamy texture from sur-lie maturation. The body is medium and clean, carrying through to a long, refreshing, and chalky finish. Crafted as a 100% Chardonnay varietal expression, this white wine typically features an alcohol by volume of around 12.5% to 13.0% and is produced under sustainable farming practices.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, crisp structure, and stony minerality of this Chablis make it an ideal choice for seafood pairings. It pairs exceptionally well with fresh oysters, shellfish platters, crab, lobster, and grilled white fish. Structurally, its clean, cutting profile also complements goat cheese, sushi, light poultry dishes, and creamy pasta sauces that benefit from a burst of palate cleansing freshness.

Vintage Quality

Growing seasons in Chablis frequently test winemakers with spring frosts and variable summer weather, requiring careful vineyard management and precise picking schedules. The winemaking team displays exceptional skill in preserving the signature mineral tension and pure fruit character of the region across both cool and warm vintages through temperature controlled stainless steel fermentations.

title: Gordon & Macphail Spirit of Scotland Glendullan Cask #303309 2010
bodyHtml:
The Gordon & MacPhail Spirit of Scotland Glendullan 2010 (Cask #303309) originates from the Speyside region of Scotland, distilled at the historic Glendullan Distillery in Dufftown. Glendullan's spirit is primarily destined for major blended Scotch whiskies, making single cask releases at natural strength quite rare. Independent bottler Gordon & MacPhail selected and matured this single cask under their revived Spirit of Scotland label, celebrating single-cask integrity without chill filtration or added coloring.

Spirit Description

In the glass, this single malt displays a pale golden hue, reflecting its pure, ex-bourbon maturation. The nose presents rich honeyed aromas accompanied by notes of ripe peach and fresh mint. On the palate, it delivers a creamy, luxurious mouthfeel filled with vibrant tropical fruit flavors, including fresh banana and juicy pineapple. Bottled at a natural cask strength of 58.1% ABV, the finish is pleasantly long, warm, and spicy, concluding with a zesty, refreshing burst of lime peel.

Accolades

  • "Highly sought-after, micro-yield single cask release (Outturn of just 192 bottles worldwide)."

title: Buffalo Trace Bourbon - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Buffalo Trace Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey originates from the United States, in the state of Kentucky within the subregion of Frankfort along the Kentucky River. The historic Buffalo Trace Distillery, owned by the Sazerac Company, boasts a distilling legacy spanning over 200 years on grounds where ancient migratory herds once carved paths through the wilderness. Operating continuously as a designated National Historic Landmark, the distillery crafts flagship spirits aged in new charred oak barrels within century old brick warehouses.

Spirit Description

This flagship bourbon exhibits a deep amber colour with rich bronze reflections in the glass. The aromatic nose opens with a complex bouquet of sweet vanilla, mint, molasses, and dark fruit, accentuated by notes of brown sugar, subtle leather, and gentle baking spices. On the palate, the liquid is pleasantly sweet and medium to full in body, delivering balanced flavours of caramel, toffee, candied orange peel, and toasted oak with hints of anise. The finish is long, smooth, and warming, carrying lingering depth marked by dark chocolate, gentle rye spice, and persistent charred oak undertones. This Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey is bottled at an alcohol by volume of 45%.

title: Pra di Bosso Lambrusco Secco
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
This vibrant, sparkling red wine originates from Italy, crafted in the Reggiano DOP appellation within the historic Emilia Romagna region. Produced by Casali Viticultori, a benchmark winery founded in 1900, Prà di Bosso was originally introduced in the early 1980s as the first single vineyard cru in the area, a bold move that completely redefined regional quality expectations. The winery operates under a philosophy that honors authentic Emilian food and wine traditions, utilizing mindful craftsmanship to let the natural character of native grape varieties show directly in the glass.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Deep, intense ruby red crowned by a dense and lively purple froth.

  • Aroma: Crisp, young, and highly fragrant on the nose, bursting with aromas of wild violet and fresh roses alongside crunchy red and black berries like raspberry, blueberry, and cherry.

  • Palate: Fresh, dynamic, and mineral-driven on the palate, presenting a beautifully balanced and velvety texture layered with juicy forest fruits and a subtle hint of raw almond.

  • Body: Full-bodied sparkling red wine with a pleasantly robust framework.

  • Finish: Clean, persistent, and lingering with a dry, fruit forward finish.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional regional blend consisting of 40% Lambrusco Marani, 40% Lambrusco Montericco, and 20% Lambrusco Salamino. The grapes are hand harvested in mid September from clayey-calcareous hillsides around Scandiano.

  • Stylistic Notes: Strikingly balanced, crisp, and bone dry, this wine contains just 9 grams per litre of residual sugar. It undergoes soft pressing and temperature controlled primary fermentation in stainless steel, followed by natural refermentation in pressurized steel autoclaves to capture its signature sparkle.

  • Alcohol by Volume: 11%

  • Organic Status: Not certified organic, though minded with a deep respect for natural vineyard ecosystems.

Food Pairing

  • Rich Emilian pasta dishes, especially pasta dressed with savory meat ragù or classic lasagna.

  • Traditional platters of rich cured meats, prosciutto, mortadella, and chunks of Parmigiano Reggiano cheese.

  • Savory boiled meats or regional baked rice specialties.

title: SpearHead Pinot Gris 2025
bodyHtml:
This exceptional white wine is produced by SpearHead Winery, an acclaimed estate nestled on the benchlands of South East Kelowna within the East Kelowna Slopes Sub-GI of British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Recognized as Canada's 'Winery of the Year' and 'Best Performing Small Winery' at the 2024 National Wine Awards, the estate focuses intensely on premium quality and distinct regional expressions under the expert direction of winemaker Grant Stanley. The newly released SpearHead Pinot Gris 2025 highlights the winery's philosophy of showcasing specific terroirs of the Central Okanagan Valley through careful lot selection and minimal intervention.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Pale lemon in the glass.

  • Aroma: The nose is fresh and bursting with fragrant notes of baked pear, pink grapefruit, and a distinct hint of orange marmalade, occasionally showing a subtle flinty or slightly reductive edge.

  • Palate: Bright, steely, and wonderfully precise on the palate, layering rich flavours of poached pear, cantaloupe, and just-ripe nectarine.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a beautifully plush and enhanced texture.

  • Finish: Juicy and vibrant with a clean finish driven by crisp, crunchy acidity and a perfectly balanced interplay of subtle sweetness.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Gris.

  • Stylistic Notes: Hand-harvested and gently pressed, 90% of the juice was cold-fermented in stainless steel to maintain crispness, while 10% was fermented in neutral French puncheons to build mouthfeel and complexity. It represents an incredibly drinkable style that was bottled in February 2026, with only 826 cases produced.

  • Alcohol by Volume: 13.0%

  • Organic Status: Not certified organic, but farmed with deep respect for sustainable agricultural practices.

Food Pairing

  • Seared scallops served with a citrus-infused beurre blanc.

  • Mild to medium-spiced Thai green curry.

  • Creamy, indulgent cheeses like Triple-cream Brie.

Vintage Quality

The 2025 growing season in the Central Okanagan marked an incredibly strong, emotional rebound for local vineyards following severe winter challenges in preceding years. Consistently warm and highly favourable weather conditions supported steady flavour development and uniform ripening without the strain of extreme heat spikes. Yields beautifully bounced back to surpass historical averages, delivering fruit of impressive expression, natural balance, and crisp acid retention.

title: Giacomo Conterno Monfortino Barolo Riserva 2019
bodyHtml:
The Giacomo Conterno Monfortino Barolo Riserva 2019 represents the absolute pinnacle of traditional Italian winemaking. Originating from Serralunga d'Alba in the Barolo DOCG zone of Piedmont, Monfortino is widely regarded as one of the world's most iconic and age-worthy red wines. Crafted by Roberto Conterno, the 2019 vintage marks a historic return—the first Monfortino produced since 2015. In an extraordinarily rare move, Conterno opted not to release a standard Barolo Francia in 2019, blending the entirety of the estate's premier holdings into this single monumental Riserva release.

Wine Description

In the glass, the wine displays a luminous, deep ruby-garnet hue with subtle orange reflections at the rim. The nose is profoundly layered and ethereal, unveiling high-toned aromas of tart wild cherry, red plum, and dried violet, followed by underlying notes of black tea, crushed granite, savory black truffle, leather, and smoky earth. On the palate, it exhibits immense power wrapped in remarkable finesse. A concentrated fruit core is structured by dense, fine-grained tannins and razor-sharp, salivating acidity that provides vibrant tension. The finish is exceptionally long and resonant, echoing minerals, dried herbs, and dark spice.

title: Nervi Conterno Gattinara Vigna Molsino 2020
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1906, Azienda Vitivinicola Nervi is the oldest documented estate in Gattinara, an historic sub-appellation of Northern Piedmont (Alto Piemonte) situated along the foothills of the Alps. A monumental shift occurred in 2018 when Roberto Conterno—the legendary proprietor of Barolo’s iconic Giacomo Conterno estate—purchased the historic winery, elevating the region's profile on the international stage.

Vigna Molsino is considered one of Alto Piemonte’s crown jewels. It is a stunning, south-facing natural amphitheater sitting at 240 to 420 meters above sea level. The vineyard's volcanic, iron-rich porphyry soils and dramatic diurnal temperature shifts yield Nebbiolo (locally known as Spanna) of exceptional power, mineral depth, and longevity.

Wine Description

The Nervi Conterno Gattinara Vigna Molsino 2020 pours a brilliant garnet-ruby with soft brick highlights. Darker and more somber than its sibling Vigna Valferana, the 2020 Molsino exhibits a rich, brooding nose of dark black cherry, plum, crushed dried roses, star anise, and lavender, layered over crushed volcanic rocks, leather, and fresh tobacco leaf.

On the palate, this 100% Nebbiolo delivers remarkable presence, verticality, and drive. Dark forest fruit, licorice, and iron-like mineral notes are framed by dense, fine-grained tannins and radiant Alpine acidity. Vinified with temperature-controlled fermentation in large oak vats, the wine is aged for roughly 3–4 years in large Slavonian oak botti. This non-interventional aging preserves transparency and structure, allowing the 2020 vintage to showcase both generous immediacy and a cellar-worthy lifespan extending from 2028 through 2050.

title: Henri de Villamont Pinot Noir Prestige Bourgogne 2022
bodyHtml:
The Henri de Villamont Prestige Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2022 originates from the Burgundy region of France, classified under the regional Bourgogne AOC. Domaine Henri de Villamont is based in Savigny-lès-Beaune, operating out of historic 19th-century cellars. The estate's "Prestige" regional release is designed as an elevated introduction to the house style, benefiting from fruit sourced across prime Burgundian subregions—including parcels in the Côte de Beaune and Vosne-Romanée—to deliver true Côte-d'Or sophistication at an approachable regional tier.

Wine Description

In the glass, the wine exhibits a luminous, bright ruby-red colour with subtle violet reflections. The nose is fragrant and expressive, opening with aromas of ripe red raspberries, wild strawberries, and red cherries, layered alongside delicate floral violet notes, subtle cedar, and light cinnamon spice. On the palate, it is light to medium-bodied with a fine, silky texture and a fruit-forward core. Balanced by fresh, vibrant acidity and smooth, gentle tannins, it transitions into a clean finish marked by lingering red berries, soft forest floor, and a touch of light oak warmth.

title: Chateau Clerc Milon 2023
bodyHtml:
Château Clerc Milon is an 1855 5th Growth (Cinquième Grand Cru Classé) estate occupying a unique location in Pauillac, directly neighboring two premier First Growths. Its 41 hectares (100 acres) of vines stretch in a single continuous plot, largely situated on the beautiful Mousset outcrop that overlooks the Gironde estuary.

The 2023 release highlights the exceptional Cabernet Sauvignon of this unique microclimate, delivering a precise, concentrated, and beautifully balanced Pauillac expression.

Wine Description

The Château Clerc Milon 2023 presents a deep red color with a refined garnet hue. The nose opens with a precocious, flamboyant bouquet of bilberry, blackcurrant, and fresh blackberry, beautifully accented by sweet floral notes, cedarwood, subtle pepper, pencil shavings, and new oak.

On the palate, this wine showcases a seamless, creamy smoothness and a layered, fleshy core. Medium to full-bodied, its dense and concentrated texture—so typical of top Cabernet Sauvignon—is lifted by an attractive burst of vibrant fruit and refreshing acidity. Stylish, sweet, and well-structured tannins frame the mid-palate along with distinct chalky mineral, salty, and savory notes. The finish is exceptionally long and harmonious, lingering with persistent freshness, cocoa bean, hazelnut, and licorice.

title: Chateau D'Armailhac 2023
bodyHtml:
Château d’Armailhac is a 5th Growth (Cinquième Grand Cru Classé) estate in Pauillac, bordered directly to the north by Château Mouton Rothschild. Managed under the same meticulous viticultural direction as Mouton, the estate comprises 76 hectares (187 acres) of south-facing vines. The vines average 40 years of age and extend across three distinct gravel ridges that capture the core character of the Pauillac appellation.

The 2023 release is particularly notable for featuring the highest percentage of Cabernet Sauvignon in the history of the Grand Vin.

Wine Description

The Château d’Armailhac 2023 displays a dark, intense red hue accented by a bright crimson edge. On the nose, it opens with vibrant red fruit aromas wild raspberry and sweet black cherry complemented by delicate floral nuances of violet, subtle hints of candy, licorice, and classy notes of tobacco leaf, cigar box, and cedar pencil shavings.

On the palate, the wine is smooth, precise, and layered with a weightless, powdery texture. Medium to full-bodied, it balances a juicy core of cassis, blueberry, and dark cherry against lively acidity and sweet, refined tannins. As it develops, impressions of pleasant spice, pepper, and subtle orange rind emerge, leading into a long, fresh, and persistent finish.

The 2023 blend consists of 70% Cabernet Sauvignon, 15% Merlot, 13% Cabernet Franc, and 2% Petit Verdot. Harvested between September 7 and September 30, the wine aged in French oak barrels (50% new).

title: Chateau Duhart Milon 2023
bodyHtml:
Château Duhart-Milon is a prestigious 4th Growth (Quatrième Grand Cru Classé) estate located in the heart of the Pauillac appellation. Situated directly adjacent to its legendary sister estate, Château Lafite Rothschild, Duhart-Milon shares the exact same elite winemaking and viticultural team managed by Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite).

Historically known for a stricter, firmer style, the estate has undergone significant modernization in recent years, including a state-of-the-art vat house completed in 2020. The 2023 release highlights this evolution, delivering classic Pauillac power and lead-pencil elegance with newfound precision and finesse.

Wine Description

The Château Duhart-Milon 2023 presents a dense, dark ruby to inky-plum hue in the glass. The bouquet is classic Pauillac—cool, refined, and aromatic—opening with vibrant notes of blackcurrant, cassis, and dark plums interwoven with signature undertones of lead pencil graphite, cedar, cocoa powder, tobacco leaf, and subtle crushed mint.

On the palate, the wine is medium- to full-bodied, deeply layered, and structured with exceptional purity. A core of ripe dark fruits is framed by fine, chiseled, and saturated tannins that give the wine real backbone without heavy weight.

Composed of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon and 20% Merlot (with an alcohol level around 13.1%), the fruit was harvested late between September 7 and October 3 and aged in French oak barrels (50% new) with 15% press wine added for structural resonance. Balanced by a vibrant acidity (pH 3.8), this highly focused vintage promises tremendous longevity and will benefit from cellaring through 2030 to 2050.

Food Pairing

The firm graphite backbone, dark fruit core, and savory nuances of this classic Left Bank blend make it a natural match for rich, savory meats. It pairs magnificently with a roasted rack of lamb with garlic and herbs, dry-aged prime ribeye, or roasted venison tenderloin. It also pairs wonderfully with braised duck, wild mushroom and truffle dishes, or matured hard cheeses like 24-month Comté.

title: Chateau Leoville Barton 2023
bodyHtml:
Château Léoville Barton is a historic 2nd Growth (Deuxième Grand Cru Classé) estate in the Saint-Julien appellation of Bordeaux. Known for its unwavering commitment to classicism, the Barton family has maintained a reputation for producing long-lived, deeply structured, and classic Left Bank expressions.

The 2023 vintage marks an exciting milestone for the estate: it is the third year utilizing their state-of-the-art new gravity-flow winery. Additionally, it represents the very first vintage where Cabernet Franc has officially been incorporated into the Grand Vin blend.

Wine Description

The Château Léoville Barton 2023 unfurls with a deep, dark garnet-purple core. On the nose, it is highly expressive and perfumed, wafting with aromas of cassis, fresh blackberry, and redcurrant jelly, accompanied by classic Saint-Julien signature notes of graphite, pencil shavings, ripe tobacco, licorice, and floral violet accents.

On the palate, this wine is medium to full-bodied, offering remarkable concentration, focus, and energy. What sets the 2023 apart is its seamless interplay between classicism and textural richness. The tannins are cashmere-like and refined—giving weightless elegance while maintaining an imposing, cellar-worthy structure underneath. Lifted by vibrant acidity, it finishes long, mineral-driven, and penetrating.

The blend consists of 87% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Merlot, and 3% Cabernet Franc. Harvested between September 12 and October 2, the wine was aged in French oak barrels (60% new). Built for the long haul, it will reward cellaring through 2030 to 2060+.

title: Chateau Mouton Rothschild 2023
bodyHtml:
Château Mouton Rothschild is one of Bordeaux’s most iconic First Growth (Premier Grand Cru Classé) estates, elevated in 1973 under the leadership of Baron Philippe de Rothschild. Located on the gravel ridges of Pauillac, Mouton is famed worldwide for its exotic opulence, immense power, and the celebrated artistic labels that grace every vintage.

The 2023 release is particularly notable for its viticultural precision under Technical Director Jean-Emmanuel Danjoy. It features one of the highest proportions of Cabernet Sauvignon in the history of the Grand Vin, producing a classic yet vibrant expression of this world-class terroir.

Wine Description

The Château Mouton Rothschild 2023 displays an intense, deep garnet-purple color. On the nose, it is strikingly expressive and complex, unveiling a concentrated core of cassis, fresh blackcurrant, wild blueberry, and damson, layered with exotic notes of cocoa bean, pencil graphite, cigar box, crushed mint, and sweet spices.

On the palate, the wine balances opulent fruit with a steely, vertical structure. Medium- to full-bodied, it delivers remarkable purity, depth, and energy. The broad, velvety tannins build seamlessly across the palate, carrying cool blue and black fruits alongside a refined mineral tension.

The blend consists of 93% Cabernet Sauvignon and 7% Merlot (with an alcohol level of 13.3%). Aged entirely in 100% new French oak barrels, this long-lived vintage offers a harmonious balance of richness and freshness. Built to age effortlessly, it will benefit from cellaring through 2033 to 2065+.

Accolades

100 Points - Jane Anson

This was one of my 100 point potentials when tasting En Primeur, and it's fully delivering. It has closed down in the way that Petit Mouton has opened up, and here I really feel the full power of the tannic grip, one of the highest amounts of Cabernet Sauvignon on record, coiled and still-concealing a ton of graphite, cocoa bean, cool blue fruits set against creamy damson, cigar box, crayon, sandalwood, incense, promise. A long lived Mouton, with depth, power and balance at just over 13%, the magic of these soils.

98+ Points - Vinous

The 2023 Mouton Rothschild is bright and explosive in the glass. Vibrant, rich, deep and so beautifully expressive, the 2023 Mouton is one of my early candidates for wine of the vintage. Cabernet Sauvignon is bumped up to 93% (the highest ever, just behind the 2010), with 7% Merlot and no Cabernet Franc or Petit Verdot in the blend. Time in the glass brings out darker shades of fruit along the wine's complex, dynamic personality. This is a magnificent Grand Vin.

99 Points - James Suckling

A deep and generous red with red and black currants, black truffles and blue fruit. Full-bodied and spicy but still in balance. Luscious and flamboyant, then it tightens at the end. The fruit is very transparent and verges on exotic. but then it holds back with the tannins. It's so velvety and integrated. It changes all the time in the glass.

100 Points - Decanter

Gorgeous red and black fruit on the nose, really fruit-forward and expressive, not so much on the mineral or floral side. Smooth and supple, this has great movement: a sense of life, depth and richness, so suave. The fruit and tannins fill the mouth, but with delightful coolness – blueberry and crisp cherry. Liquorice and wet stones also come through; graphite, chalk, mint, a touch of toast on the finish. Flashes of exoticism, as well as finesse. Structure and seriousness but with bounce, full of texture and nuance. Stylish and characterful, a wonderful Mouton

title: Hugh Hamilton 'The Black Sheep' Fiano 2024
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from Australia, within the South Australia region and the celebrated McLaren Vale subregion. Hugh Hamilton Wines represents Australia's oldest wine family, boasting a rich heritage that spans over 185 years across six generations. Self described as the black sheep of the family, Hugh Hamilton and his daughter Mary embrace a spirited winemaking philosophy that takes the wine seriously while maintaining an adventurous, playful approach to eclectic grape varieties.

Wine Description

This Fiano displays a brilliant straw hue in the glass. The nose delivers an expressive, dew fresh meadow bouquet characterized by honeysuckle, lemon blossom, and thyme alongside hints of honeyed stone fruit and subtle herbal nuances. On the palate, it is supple, crisp, and beautifully structured, offering a light to medium body that layers succulent citrus sorbet and vibrant apple freshness with soft hints of brioche and custard powder. The wine exhibits wonderful balance, freshness, and light textual grip that provides a clean, taut, and refreshing finish. Crafted as a 100% Fiano varietal expression, it matured on fine lees in stainless steel tanks for three months. The wine features an alcohol by volume of 12.8% and is vegan friendly.

Food Pairing

The crisp citrus acidity, subtle stone fruit texture, and bright herbal undertones make this white wine an incredible companion for light, fresh dishes. It pairs wonderfully with fresh seafood, grilled prawns, and pan seared white fish. Structurally, it complements light Italian fare such as an artichoke and potato torta salata, pasta with fresh herbs, and soft or nutty cheeses.

title: Hugh Hamilton Pure Black 2018
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
This prestigious red wine originates from Australia, within the South Australia region and the acclaimed McLaren Vale subregion. Hugh Hamilton Wines represents Australia's oldest wine family dynasty, tracing its viticultural roots back to 1837 when the family planted the colony's first grape vines. Led by fifth and sixth generation winemakers Hugh and Mary Hamilton, the winery embraces a rebellious spirit while producing exceptionally crafted wines, sealing this flagship icon in black wax to commemorate their heritage.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep black plum hue in the glass. The nose presents an extraordinarily complex and brooding bouquet showing dark rose florals, cold black tea, wet clay, roasted coffee, tar, and charred rosemary alongside hints of ripe plum, mudcake, and sweet tobacco. On the palate, it is dense, intense, and thunderously rolling, showing a powerful structure driven by mulberry, blackberry, black olive, and gravel minerality. The full body exhibits a wonderful balance of earthy depth and vibrant acidity, carrying through to a generous, lingering finish. The blend consists of 85% Shiraz and 15% Saperavi, aged for 19 months in French oak barrels. The wine features an alcohol by volume of 14.9% and is vegan friendly.

Food Pairing

The intense concentration, rich fruit, and dense structure of this wine make it a perfect match for hearty red meat dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with a seared Tomahawk steak or slow cooked cranberry glazed lamb shanks. For a vegetarian pairing, its subtle complexity and earthy notes complement a savory cranberry and pistachio nut roast.

Vintage Quality

The 2018 vintage in McLaren Vale yielded exceptional fruit concentration with impressive depth and length. Selected from over 400 individual barrels, only five were chosen to create this bottling, demonstrating the winemakers' commitment to extreme quality control and aging potential.

Accolades

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

As the name implies, this inky beast of a wine—an unusual Shiraz-Saperavi blend—takes plenty of aeration before it squeaks out its blackberry, pepper, violet and Indian spice charm. It's tightly wound with fine-grained, muscular tannins. Despite its heft, it's balanced, set for the very long haul. You could open now with a decanter at hand, but if you've the patience, it should evolve intriguingly over the decades.

title: Spearhead White Pinot Noir 2025
bodyHtml:
This intriguing white wine is crafted by SpearHead Winery, a highly acclaimed estate located on the benchlands of South East Kelowna in the Okanagan Valley of British Columbia, Canada. Recognized as Canada's Number 1 Winery of the Year in 2024, the estate operates under a philosophy dedicated to premium quality and true cool climate regional expression under the guidance of winemaker Grant Stanley. Following severe winter freezes that impacted local vineyards, the winery showcased outstanding adaptability by sourcing pristine fruit from premier Pacific Northwest partners, creating their innovative 'Dual Citizen' series to continue offering remarkable bottlings.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Bright, very pale pastel pink with crystal clarity.

  • Aroma: A lifted and aromatic nose delivering vibrant scents of lemon zest, tangerine, pink grapefruit, and elderflower, complemented by hints of sweet floral blossoms and candied strawberry.

  • Palate: Smooth, rounded, and plush on the mid palate, offering refreshing flavours of peach, pear, gooseberry, and red apple, subtly accented by notes of white cherry and orange blossom.

  • Body: Light to medium body with a highly pleasing and textured mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Very good length on a clean, crisp finish characterized by a touch of sea salt and a strong, stony mineral backbone.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir sourced from the De Vries Vineyard situated in the Yakima Valley within Washington State.

  • Stylistic Notes: Strikingly balanced, crisp, and slightly off-dry, the SpearHead White Pinot Noir is produced using a gentle whole bunch press with minimal skin contact—only two hours—to prevent colour bleeding. The juice undergoes a cool temperature fermentation in stainless steel below 10°C, which is intentionally stopped via refrigeration to retain a touch of natural, genuine fruit sweetness before spending crucial time on its fine lees.

  • Alcohol by Volume: 13.0%

  • Organic Status: Not certified organic, though minded with highly sustainable vineyard management practices.

Food Pairing

  • Refreshing cucumber salad or fresh grilled vegetables.

  • Grilled shrimp with lemon and fresh herbs, or light seafood selections.

  • Soft, creamy artisanal cheeses such as Camembert.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 vintage required exceptional innovation due to severe winter frost conditions across the Okanagan Valley. By collaborating with growers in the Yakima Valley, the winemaking team successfully secured pristine Pinot Noir grapes that achieved excellent flavour concentration and ideal structural balance, ensuring a highly successful and vibrant release.

title: L.N. Mattei Cap Corse Cuvee Louis Napoleon Quinquina Blanc Aperitif
bodyHtml:
This historic aperitif wine comes from the French island of Corsica, deeply rooted in the distinct maritime terroir of the Cap Corse peninsula. The distinguished house was originally established in 1872 by the local merchant Louis Napoleon Mattei, who invented the unique formula and named it after his native peninsula. The winery remains family owned to this day, carefully executing all macerations, aging, and bottling procedures in house according to original traditions.

Wine Description

This Quinquina Blanc shows a beautiful light golden profile in the glass. The nose delivers a highly unique, expressive citrus aroma anchored by fresh local citron and lemon peel, alongside subtle floral and earthy undertones. On the palate, it is beautifully balanced, supple, and airy, offering a silky texture driven by an explosion of fresh citrus fruitiness and vibrant lime notes. The body is texturally medium and crisp, leading into a refreshing, slightly acidic finish defined by a long, pleasant dryness and the characteristic bitterness of quinine. This aromatized beverage relies on an all mistelle foundation made entirely from regional Vermentinu and Muscat Petit Grains grapes, which inject superb minerality, acidity, and floral tones into the blend. This base is then infused with local Corsican citron fruit, quinine bark, and a selection of local and exotic plants, fruits, and spices. The alcohol by volume for this bottling sits at 17%.

title: Domaine Alain Chavy Puligny Montrachet Les 8 Climats 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from France, within the historic Puligny-Montrachet A.O.C. appellation of the Côte de Beaune region in Burgundy. Domaine Alain Chavy was established in 2003 following the division of the historic Domaine Gérard Chavy estate between brothers Alain and Jean-Louis. Operating under a precision-focused winemaking philosophy that respects the chiseled, mineral-driven purity of classic Burgundy, Alain Chavy crafts this village-level bottling from several choice, low-yielding plots totaling roughly 3.5 hectares. The heritage vines are rooted in the village's signature limestone-dominant soils mixed with marl and gravelly scree. This classic geological matrix naturally forces the roots deep into the rock, yielding a Chardonnay that perfectly captures the intense structural tension, precision, and noble chalky minerality that makes Puligny-Montrachet a global benchmark for white wine.

Wine Description

The Alain Chavy Puligny-Montrachet presents a brilliant, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with youthful green and silvery reflections. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, deep, and high-toned, striking a beautiful balance between mineral restraint and understated citrus flesh. The bouquet opens with a captivating, multi-faceted display of crisp white peaches, green apples, and lemon oil, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of crushed flint, white blossoms, hazelnuts, and a light touch of dynamic pastry dough. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, tightly wound, and precisely focused, showcasing a chiseled core of lime zest, orchard fruits, and clear salinity. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that drives straight through the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is transparent and aristocratically broad yet athletic, driven by a fine, chalky mineral tension that carries into a long, dry, and clean finish accented by lingering notes of toasted almonds, cold stones, and white pepper.

title: Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Brunello di Montalcino 'Rennina' 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation of southern Tuscany. Pieve Santa Restituta is an estate steeped in history, featuring a 12th-century parish church (pieve) at its heart, situated in the southwestern subzone of Montalcino. In 1994, the historic property was acquired by the legendary Angelo Gaja family of Piedmont fame, marking their grand entry into Tuscany. Operating under Gaja's signature philosophy of blending traditional site expression with uncompromising modern technical precision, the estate crafts its benchmark "Rennina" cuvée. The wine is a harmonious synthesis of three distinct vineyard plots: Pian dei Cerri (sandy soils providing tannic frame), Castagno Vecchio (deep soils providing perfumed elegance), and Santo Pietro (clay and fossil-rich limestone delivering mineral drive). This deliberate multi-site composition naturally yields a Brunello known for its lifted aromatic finesse, silky texture, and supple structural poise.

Wine Description

The 2021 Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta 'Rennina' Brunello di Montalcino presents a brilliant ruby appearance in the glass with a light garnet rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, deep, and high-toned, offering a masterfully transparent and graceful expression of its mixed clay-limestone terroir. The bouquet opens with a captivating display of sweet red cherries, wild strawberries, and blood orange, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of sweet violets, graphite, dried Mediterranean scrub, cardamom, and a hint of white pepper. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, tense, and precisely focused, showcasing a dense and succulent core of tart wild berries and dark plum extracts. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a lively, lifted backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the fruit weight. The mouthfeel is broad and velvety, driven by firm, crumbly-sandy tannins that frame its athletic frame before gliding into a long, dry, and salty finish accented by clear juice, licorice, and subtle gamy undertones.

This high-definition regional expression is 100% Sangiovese (locally known as Brunello). The fruit was hand-harvested at optimal physiological readiness across the three estate parcels. Following temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats, the wine underwent a meticulously calibrated aging regimen under the Gaja family's supervision. It spent approximately 24 months maturing in a combination of traditional oak casks (botti) and French oak barrels, followed by concrete vat and bottle refinement to polish its structural edges. It reaches a perfectly integrated, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and is finished bone-dry.

title: Domaine Michel Gros Bourgogne Hautes Cotes De Nuits 'Fontaine Saint Martin' Rouge 2023
bodyHtml:
The Domaine Michel Gros Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Nuits "Fontaine Saint-Martin" Monopole Rouge 2023 is the red counterpart to the estate's acclaimed white monopole. Located in the commune of Arcenant—just a few kilometers above Vosne-Romanée—this 7-hectare amphitheater vineyard sits at an elevation between 350 and 390 meters. Replanted by the Gros family in the late 1970s and 1980s, the estate's high-altitude site sits on steep, southeast-facing slopes of Jurassic limestone and marl. This unique microclimate preserves vital acidity while allowing the vines to reach ideal phenolic maturity, creating a red Burgundy that punches well above its regional classification.

Wine Description

In the glass, "Fontaine Saint-Martin" Rouge exhibits a bright, luminous ruby color with violet reflections. On the nose, it offers a fresh, aromatic bouquet of dark cherry, wild raspberry, and red plum, layered with subtle notes of clove spice, forest floor, and delicate rose petals.

On the palate, this 100% Pinot Noir is medium-bodied and structured. The palate opens with a juicy core of red and black berries supported by a refined, mineral chalkiness and integrated tannins. Vinified using traditional Burgundian methods and aged primarily in French oak barrels (with a small proportion of new oak), the wood influence is subtly integrated to highlight fruit purity and site specificity. It is approachable with brief decanting now, yet possesses the tannic backbone to evolve nicely through 2032.
