title: Domaine Michel Gros Bourgogne Hautes 'Fontaine Saint Martin' Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Domaine Michel Gros, based in Vosne-Romanée, is one of the most distinguished family estates in the Côte de Nuits. Managed alongside his son Pierre, Michel Gros represents the sixth generation of winemakers dedicated to translating elite Burgundy terroirs into polished, expressive wines.

The Fontaine Saint-Martin is a prized monopole (a vineyard under single ownership) located in the village of Arcenant, sitting just above Vosne-Romanée in the Hautes-Côtes de Nuits. Replanted by the family in the late 1970s, this 7-hectare amphitheater site features steep, south-facing slopes composed of "Pernand marls" and marly limestone—a soil structure nearly identical to the grand white terroirs of Corton-Charlemagne.

Wine Description

The Domaine Michel Gros Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Nuits "Fontaine Saint-Martin" Monopole Blanc 2023 displays a pale gold hue with shimmering yellow highlights. On the nose, it opens with an energetic, fruit-forward bouquet of citrus peel, ripe peach, fresh white orchard fruits, and orange blossom, gently wrapped in subtle hints of toasted brioche, fresh butter, and light vanilla.

On the palate, this 100% Chardonnay delivers wonderful fleshiness, balance, and tension. The warmer 2023 vintage gives the fruit a generous, rounded core, which is immediately lifted by crisp satsuma and lemon peel acidity. Fermentation finishes slowly in oak barrels before aging in French oak (roughly 20% new) with regular lees stirring. This barrel treatment adds a subtle, creamy texture without overpowering the vineyard's distinct, mouthwatering mineral streak. It is accessible, pure, and ready to enjoy young or over the next 5 to 7 years.

title: Familia Torres Reserva Real 2009
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine hails from Spain, within the distinguished Penedès region. Familia Torres is an iconic family owned winery established in 1870 with roots in winegrowing that extend back to the 16th century. Created as one of Spain's most exclusive, limited production wines, Reserva Real pays homage to the small single vineyard in Les Arnes, where rare slate soils elevate classic winemaking to its highest expression.

Wine Description

This matured 2009 bottling shows a dense, dark red profile with rich garnet nuances. The nose is intense, layered, and complex, displaying vibrant aromas of dark berry jam, blackberry, and plum alongside notes of toasted oak, pencil lead graphite, spices, and roasted coffee. On the palate, it is powerful, fleshy, and deeply concentrated, balanced by delicate acidity and fine, silky tannins. It features a full body that unfolds rich layers of dark fruits, cocoa, licorice, and leather, concluding with a long, elegant, and persistent finish. The wine is a classic Bordeaux style blend composed primarily of Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, and Merlot. Aged for 18 months in French oak barrels, this bottling features an alcohol by volume of 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The deep concentration, firm structure, and fine tannins of this aged red blend make it a fantastic match for rich, savory dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled prime beef, roasted rack of lamb, and slow cooked game meats or rich stews. Structurally, its subtle mineral notes and lingering spice also complement mature hard cheeses and earthy wild mushroom dishes.

Vintage Quality

The 2009 growing season provided excellent conditions in the region, allowing the low yield vineyards to achieve remarkable fruit maturity and structural harmony. The winemakers utilized precise sorting and oak aging techniques to ensure optimal balance between ripe, concentrated fruit and the distinct slate minerality of the estate.

title: WhistlePig "The Beholden" 21 Year Old Single Malt Whiskey
bodyHtml:
WhistlePig "The Béhôlden" 21 Year Old Single Malt Whiskey represents a historic milestone in North American distilling. Released in Spring 2023 as an ultra-limited allocation of just 18 barrels, it holds the distinction of being the first-ever super-aged single malt produced in North America—matured more than twice as long as any other single malt on the continent.

The spirit was originally copper-pot distilled from 100% malted barley at the historic Glenora Distillery in Nova Scotia, Canada, before being transported to WhistlePig Farm in Shoreham, Vermont, where it underwent its signature barrel finishing and bottling.

Whiskey Description

In the glass, The Béhôlden presents a rich, deep amber-caramel tone. On the nose, it delivers an inviting bouquet of baked red apples, golden raisins, candied citrus, and sweet cherry, interwoven with rich maple syrup, cinnamon bark, vanilla, and toasted oak char.

On the palate, this 100% malted barley expression is bottled at 46% ABV (92 Proof). The entry is remarkably smooth and buttery, featuring flavors of butterscotch custard, graham cracker, black cherry juice, and apricot. As it develops across the mid-palate, the 21 years of primary aging in ex-bourbon oak barrels merge seamlessly with savory rye spice, dark cocoa, and nutmeg imparted by its final finish in WhistlePig rye casks. The finish is long, dry, and balanced, lingering with notes of charred oak, maple praline, subtle clove, and a delicate touch of smoke.

title: Old Pulteney 23 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Old Pulteney 23 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky originates from Scotland, in the northern Highland region within the subregion of Caithness. Established in 1826 in the coastal town of Wick, the historic distillery was founded during the height of the local herring fishing boom. Today, the distillery is owned by International Beverage Holdings, a subsidiary of ThaiBev, which continues to preserve its traditional maritime production methods.

Spirit Description

This expression exhibits a warm gold appearance in the glass. The nose presents a layered, complex bouquet filled with orchard fruit, red berries, and sweet honey, balanced perfectly by fresh vanilla, lemon zest, and a soft, waxy coastal air. On the palate, the body is luscious and silky soft, offering an elegant balance of yellow raisins, toasted toffee, and a distinct maritime salinity reminiscent of salted orange. The finish is remarkably long, dry, and spicy, leaving trailing notes of oak, white pepper, and a refreshing hint of coastal brine. This single malt Scotch whisky is bottled at an alcohol by volume of 43%.

Food Pairing

The complex salinity and rich fruit profile of this single malt make it a spectacular companion for premium seafood. It pairs exceptionally well with a platter of freshly shucked oysters or slices of artisanal smoked salmon, which complement the maritime structure of the dram. For a sweeter alternative, it can be served alongside dark chocolate truffles or orange infused desserts.

title: Cap Corse Mattei Quinquina Rouge Aperitif
bodyHtml:
This iconic aperitif wine hails from the French island of Corsica, specifically tied to the unique terroir of the Cap Corse peninsula. The legendary brand was created in 1872 by local merchant Louis Napoleon Mattei, who named the unique formula after his native peninsula. During his historical voyages to the Caribbean, Mattei discovered the beneficial properties of cinchona tree bark and decided to bring it back to blend with the distinct local grape varieties of his homeland.

Wine Description

This Quinquina Rouge presents a rich, deep red profile in the glass. The nose offers an impressively complex and expressive bouquet loaded with aromas of native herbs, fresh cut grass, dried fruits, and vibrant citrus undertones. On the palate, it is beautifully structured, supple, and harmonious, offering a sun infused island character driven by a deep layer of elderflower, rosemary, and smooth caramel. The body is rich and texturally balanced, showing an intensified bitterness compared to its white counterpart that melts seamlessly into a short, warm finish loaded with pepper spice and persistent quinine dryness. The structural foundation of this aperitif is entirely an all mistelle base crafted from Corsican Muscat and Vermentinu grapes. The grape juice is fortified early to retain its natural residual sugars before being infused with cinchona bark, Corsican citron, walnut, and a secret selection of local and exotic plants, fruits, and spices. Depending on the specific bottling or reserve release, the alcohol by volume is typically 15% or 17%.

title: Alberelli Di Giodo Rosso 2022
bodyHtml:
Alberelli di Giodo Rosso originates from the island of Sicily, Italy, falling under the Sicilia DOC / Terre Siciliane IGT classification. Serving as the red counterpart to the Carricante, this wine is master winemaker Carlo Ferrini's flagship volcanic red expression, capturing the raw energy of Mount Etna through the lens of Tuscan refinement. Sourced from a tiny 1.5-hectare parcel of century-old bush-trained vines (alberelli) perched at a dramatic altitude of 950 meters on the volcano's northern slopes, production is extremely limited.

Wine Description

In the glass, the wine exhibits a luminous, translucent ruby red hue with subtle garnet reflections. The nose is ethereal and high-toned, offering delicate aromas of wild strawberries, sour cherries, and cassis, seamlessly intertwined with dried floral notes, wild rose, tea leaves, and distinctive volcanic hints of ash, white pepper, and wet stone. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, supple, and refined—often compared to fine Pinot Noir or Nebbiolo for its weightless structure. A translucent red fruit core is supported by polished, fine-grained tannins and a bright, citrus-driven acidity that provides stunning tension. It finishes exceptionally long, focused, and savory, leaving a lingering impression of volcanic mineral crunch and crushed lava.

title: Chateau de Montfaucon 'Cuvee Bimard' Chateauneuf du Pape
bodyHtml:
Château de Montfaucon Châteauneuf-du-Pape 'Cuvée Bimard' originates from the Southern Rhône Valley in France, produced under the prestigious Châteauneuf-du-Pape AOC. While the estate’s historic castle and primary vineyards sit across the river in Montfaucon, proprietor and winemaker Rodolphe "Rudi" de Pins crafts this targeted cuvée from a select 3.5-hectare parcel of old vines situated directly on the renowned terraces of Châteauneuf-du-Pape. The estate is widely admired for its Burgundian-inspired approach, prioritizing finesse, purity, and floral elegance over heavy extraction.

Wine Description

In the glass, Cuvée Bimard exhibits a bright, luminous ruby colour with subtle garnet highlights. The nose opens with an inviting bouquet of wild raspberries, red cherries, and dried cranberries, accented by fragrant violet floral notes, garrigue herbs, hints of cured leather, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, distinguished by its silky texture and fine, chalky tannins. The vibrant acidity breathes exceptional freshness into layers of ripe plum, kirsch, and cocoa notes, leading to a balanced, savory finish marked by hints of graphite and peppery spice.

title: Alberelli di Giodo Carricante 2023
bodyHtml:
Alberelli di Giodo Carricante originates from the island of Sicily, Italy, produced under the Sicilia DOC / Terre Siciliane IGT. This exceptional white wine represents master winemaker Carlo Ferrini's expanded vision beyond Tuscany (where he crafts his iconic Giodo Brunello di Montalcino). Nestled on the high-altitude slopes of Mount Etna, the project sources grapes from a tiny, dedicated parcel of bush-trained vines (alberelli) planted in volcanic soils. Production is extraordinarily small—often limited to just a few thousand bottles per vintage—making it a boutique jewel of Sicilian winemaking.

Wine Description

In the glass, the wine exhibits a luminous, pale straw yellow hue with subtle green highlights. The nose is remarkably fragrant, bursting with aromas of jasmine, honeysuckle, fresh citrus, green apple, and white peach, underpinned by a distinct flinty, smoky minerality and a hint of sea salt. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with dynamic energy and tension. Concentrated fruit flavors of lemons, juicy nectarines, and candied citrus peel are balanced by a chiseled, mouthwatering acidity and a savory, volcanic salinity. It concludes with a crisp, extremely long finish that reveals delicate herbal and crushed-stone undertones.

title: Gaja Ca'Marcanda Vistamare 2025
bodyHtml:
Gaja Ca'Marcanda 'Vistamare' originates from the Tuscan coast in Italy, within the prestigious Toscana IGT appellation in Bolgheri. Crafted by the iconic Gaja family—famed for revolutionizing modern winemaking in Piedmont—this wine showcases their mastery on Tuscan soil. The name Vistamare translates to "sea view," paying tribute to the high-altitude vineyard sites overlooking the Mediterranean Coast, where constant cooling breezes and saline air shape the grapes. It stands as one of Italy’s most prestigious, multi-layered white wines.

Wine Description

In the glass, Vistamare presents a bright straw yellow colour with luminous silver and pale green highlights. The nose is extraordinarily aromatic and atmospheric, opening with fresh white peach, ripe nectarine, candied citrus, and tropical hints of pineapple, seamlessly layered over dried sage, jasmine, and a delicate, signature ocean-breeze salinity. On the palate, it exhibits medium-to-full body with a remarkably round, textural mid-palate balanced by a laser-sharp, mouthwatering acidity. The wine finishes exceptionally long and savory, leaving lingering notes of stone fruit, candied lime, and crushed volcanic minerals.

title: Poli Gran Bassano Vermouth Bianco
bodyHtml:
This premium white vermouth originates from the Veneto region of northern Italy, specifically tied to the territory surrounding the historic city of Bassano del Grappa. The product is crafted by Poli Distillerie, a renowned family run estate founded in 1898 that is deeply rooted in Italian artisanal tradition. The distillery combines generations of historical expertise with local heritage to capture the lively and joyful spirit of the Bassano region.

Wine Description

This vermouth showcases a burnished gold hue in the glass. The nose delivers a highly expressive, aromatic bouquet weaving together white flowers, lavender, and dried herbs, predominantly highlighted by the aroma of grapefruit. On the palate, it is sweet, soft, and remarkably rich, displaying a beautifully balanced harmony between natural sweetness and vibrant acidity. The medium to full body opens with layers of grapefruit peel, coriander, and mellow golden raisin brushed with honey, leading to a long, clean finish with a mild dried herb note and a sophisticated, slightly bitter aftertaste. The unique structural foundation relies entirely on Vespaiolo, a native white wine from the Breganze DOC that is famous for its natural floral scents that attract wasps. This wine base is naturally infused with 39 aromatic botanicals, including hawthorn, elderflower, galangal, myrtle, and both sweet and bitter orange. The final beverage has an alcohol by volume of 18%.

title: Salvioni Rosso di Montalcino 'La Cerbaiola' 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Rosso di Montalcino D.O.C. appellation of southern Tuscany. Azienda Agricola Salvioni (La Cerbaiola) is a legendary, tiny cult estate situated on the high-altitude hills southeast of the town of Montalcino, legendary for crafting some of the most sought-after and soulful Sangiovese in all of Italy. Operating under an uncompromising, traditional winemaking philosophy led by the Salvioni family, the estate treats its low-yielding heritage vines with minimal intervention and profound respect for terroir. Salvioni’s Rosso di Montalcino is uniquely famous: it is made with the exact same artisanal rigor, meticulous vineyard care, and noble fruit as their world-renowned Brunello di Montalcino. Rooted in Galestro (chalky, limestone-rich schist) and pebbly clay-maris at 420–440 meters elevation, the vines benefit from constant aeration and extreme day-night temperature shifts, yielding a wine that effortlessly bridges the gap between youthful, high-toned vibrancy and aristocratic cellar depth.

Wine Description

The 2024 Salvioni 'La Cerbaiola' Rosso di Montalcino presents a radiant, luminous ruby-red appearance in the glass with clear garnet highlights. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, deep, and high-toned, offering a masterfully transparent and classic expression of high-altitude Sangiovese. The bouquet opens with an enticing, multi-faceted display of fresh sour cherries, wild red plums, and crushed cranberries, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of dried violets, sweet tobacco leaf, damp forest floor, camphor, and a touch of crushed almonds. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, taut, and precisely focused, showcasing a concentrated core of crunchy red orchard fruits and orange peel. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its weight. The mouthfeel is broad yet athletic, driven by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that grip the palate before gliding into a remarkably long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of sweet cedar, iron-rich earth, and wild herbs.

title: Albert Bichot Chardonnay Bourgogne Cote d'Or Secret de Famille
bodyHtml:
Albert Bichot Chardonnay Bourgogne Cote d'Or Secret de Famille originates from France, produced in the Burgundy region within the prestigious Cote d'Or subregion. Founded in 1831, Maison Albert Bichot is an iconic family-owned wine house that has passed down winemaking mastery through six generations. The philosophy behind the 'Secret de Famille' bottling relies on sourcing Chardonnay grapes from renowned village-level vineyards—including Meursault, Puligny-Montrachet, and Saint-Aubin—and treating the fruit with the same meticulous care as grander regional appellations.

Wine Description

This wine displays a bright, pale yellow colour with golden reflections. The nose is refined and expressive, showcasing dominant notes of citrus fruit, yellow apple, and white flowers, which evolve into subtle nuances of honey, hazelnut, and toasted brioche. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with a smooth, rounded texture supported by vibrant, fresh acidity. Flavours of lemon curd, ripe mirabelle plum, and delicate oak spice lead to a long, clean finish with an appealing mineral saltiness. Crafted from 100% Chardonnay and aged on fine lees in stainless steel tanks and oak barrels (20% new oak) for 10 to 12 months, this wine delivers exceptional balance, elegance, and freshness, with an optimal drinking window from release through 4 years.

title: G4 Blanco High Proof Tequila (108 Proof)
bodyHtml:
G4 Blanco High Proof Tequila originates from Mexico, produced in the town of Jesús María within the renowned Los Altos de Jalisco (Highlands of Jalisco) region. The brand is crafted at El Pandillo Distillery by master distiller Felipe Camarena, representing a century-long, four-generation legacy of family tequila production. Dedicated to additive-free craftsmanship and sustainability, the distillery utilizes estate-grown Blue Weber agave cooked in traditional stone ovens, crushed by a custom-built mechanical tahona, and proofed using a unique 50/50 blend of harvested rainwater and natural spring water.

Wine Description

This unaged spirit displays a crystal clear, bright, and luminescent appearance. The nose is highly expressive and aromatic, featuring concentrated cooked agave, petrichor, wet stones, bright lime zest, starfruit, and sharp white pepper. On the palate, it delivers an immediate and rich flood of sweet roasted agave balanced by cracked black pepper, cinnamon bark, jalapeño spice, and fresh dried herbs such as oregano and thyme. The spirit possesses a medium to full body with a natural oiliness that coats the palate cleanly. The finish is long, warming, and slightly dry, leaving behind lingering citrus minerality and peppery heat. Crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave and bottled at 108 proof (54% ABV), this tequila offers exceptional freshness, balance, and unadulterated agave complexity.

title: Chateau Pontet Canet 2023
bodyHtml:
Château Pontet-Canet 2023 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the esteemed Pauillac subregion. Classified as a Fifth Growth (5ème Cru Classé) in the 1855 Bordeaux Classification, the estate sits on gravel terraces over limestone bedrock directly adjacent to Château Mouton Rothschild. Under the stewardship of the Tesseron family—led by Alfred Tesseron and technical director Mathieu Bessonnet—the château's operational philosophy centers on pioneering sustainable viticulture. Pontet-Canet famously became the first major Médoc estate to embrace certified organic and biodynamic viticulture, utilizing horses rather than heavy machinery to work the soils and preserving the pure expression of its 81-hectare vineyard.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, vibrant purple hue in the glass and possesses a medium-to-full-bodied, seamless, and multidimensional structure. The sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, precise, and aromatic, opening with an expressive bouquet of fresh cassis, mulberries, blueberries, and black cherry, interwoven with delicate nuances of violets, menthol, licorice, squid ink, and graphite minerality. On the palate, it delivers a pure core of dark berry fruit balanced by an energetic natural acidity and a saline, wet-stone tension. The finish is remarkably long, vibrant, and structured, framed by ultra-refined, silky tannins and lingering accents of black tea, dried herbs, and fine spices.

  • Varietal Composition: A classic Pauillac blend consisting of 52% Cabernet Sauvignon, 39% Merlot, 6% Cabernet Franc, and 3% Petit Verdot.

  • Stylistic Notes: The 2023 vintage represents a milestone in precision for the estate, marked by earlier Merlot picking to preserve fresh fruit and an extended Cabernet harvest to refine tannic structure. To achieve its pure fruit definition and discreet oak profile, the wine was aged for 16–18 months in a mix of 50% new French oak barrels, 35% custom concrete/clay amphorae (partly sunken qvevri style), and 15% once-used oak barrels.

  • ABV: 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: Certified Organic and Certified Biodynamic.

Accolades

99 Points - Jane Anson

One of the wines of the vintage. Slow and steady unrolling of spice, capsicum, fresh acidities, crushed oyster shell and peony, cassis, squid ink and blueberry. Elegant and finessed, capturing the heart of Cabernet Sauvignon in a way that makes me think of Zuccardi and Malbec. Bright unrolling through the palate, great precision and quality with a ton of freshly cut herbs, black tea and fennel, giving life and focus. This was blended before ageing for the first time for at least a decade. Vinified in egg-shaped wooden vats and sunken qvevri-style clay vats. 50% new oak for ageing, with 35% amphora and 15% one year old barrels. New lighter bottle as of the 2022 around 490g, down from 815g in the past, 30 tonnes of CO2 saved just in terms of production.

98 Points - James Suckling

A crunchy and vivid Pontet Canet with aromas of blueberries, blackberries, roses, violets and some sandalwood and graphite. Medium-bodied with ultra-fine tannins that are long and caressing. Creamy texture, with crushed stones and light cement. Lots of energy at the end. Very approachable and long. Turns chewy and silky, with a bright and vivid finish. From biodynamically grown grapes.

title: Tres Vieille Reserve Lafite Rothschild Cognac
bodyHtml:
The Tres Vieille Reserve Lafite Rothschild is a prestigious spirit from the Cognac region of France, specifically sourced from the Borderies subregion. Originally produced exclusively for the private enjoyment of the Rothschild family, this rare distillate reflects the legacy of Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite), an estate that has been under the family's stewardship since Baron James de Rothschild acquired the storied Château Lafite in 1868.

Cognac Description

This exceptional cognac presents a rich and complex sensory profile, crafted from a 100% Borderies blend of distillates dating from 1900 to 1920. On the nose, it offers very pleasant and lovely aromas, while the palate is remarkably smooth, revealing a harmonious balance of sweetness and oak. The body is full and sophisticated, culminating in a perfect, long lasting finish.

title: Sanford Santa Rita Hills Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Sta. Rita Hills A.V.A. of Santa Barbara County, California. As a foundational pioneer of cool-climate viticulture, Sanford Winery holds a legendary legacy tracing back to 1971, when Richard Sanford and Michael Benedict identified this unique geographic maritime corridor. Operating under a precision-focused winemaking philosophy, the estate crafts its estate-grown Chardonnay from two iconic heritage properties: the legendary Sanford & Benedict Vineyard and the adjacent Rinconada Vineyard. Rooted in complex soils of maritime alluvial silt, gravel, and calcium-rich shale, these blocks sit directly in the path of a rare, east-west mountain orientation. This opening channels cold Pacific fog and brisk ocean winds directly across the vines, naturally preserving a stunning, chiseled natural acidity while allowing the fruit to build profound structural concentration.

Wine Description

The Sanford Sta. Rita Hills Chardonnay presents a brilliant, light straw-gold appearance in the glass with youthful silvery glints. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, deep, and high-toned, striking a masterful balance between California generosity and old-world mineral focus. The bouquet opens with an expressive display of crisp green apples, Meyer lemon curd, and white peach, beautifully layered with complex autolytic notes of roasted hazelnuts, freshly baked brioche, light vanilla bean, and a striking line of crushed-shell salinity. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, tense, and texturally complex, showcasing a concentrated core of golden orchard fruits and bright citrus oils. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly slices through the mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is sleek yet pleasingly creamy, driven by a fine, chalky mineral tension that carries into a remarkably long, savory finish accented by a touch of baking spice and lingering marine salinity.

title: Sanford Santa Rita Hills Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'vibrant' red wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Sta. Rita Hills A.V.A. of Santa Barbara County, California. As a foundational pioneer of cool-climate viticulture, Sanford Winery holds a legendary legacy tracing back to 1971, when Richard Sanford and Michael Benedict identified this unique geographic maritime corridor. Operating under a precision-focused winemaking philosophy, the estate crafts its estate-grown Pinot Noir from two iconic heritage properties: the legendary Sanford & Benedict Vineyard and the adjacent Rinconada Vineyard. Rooted in complex soils of maritime alluvial silt, gravel, and calcium-rich shale, these blocks sit directly in the path of a rare, east-west mountain orientation. This opening channels cold Pacific fog and brisk ocean winds directly across the vines, naturally preserving an uncommonly vibrant, linear natural acidity while allowing the fruit to build intense aromatics and beautiful structural tension.

Wine Description

The Sanford Sta. Rita Hills Pinot Noir presents a brilliant, translucent ruby hue in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, fragrant, and high-toned, opening with a precise and expressive bouquet of wild raspberries, sour cherries, and fresh cranberries, beautifully layered with savory nuances of rose petals, white sandalwood, white pepper, and a hint of fresh herbal pine. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, linear, and remarkably focused, displaying a crunchy core of tart red summer berries balanced by a mouthwatering natural acidity. The mouthfeel is transparent, sleek, and nimble, framed by soft, finely pixelated tannins that carry into a long, clean finish highlighted by a refreshing mineral crunch, delicate woodsmoke, and a lingering touch of marine salinity.

title: Domaine Rostaing Cote Rotie Cote 'Brune' 2023
bodyHtml:
The Domaine Rostaing Côte Rôtie Côte Brune 2023 originates from the legendary Côte Rôtie appellation in the Northern Rhône region of France. Pioneered by René Rostaing and now masterfully directed by his son Pierre Rostaing, this iconic estate is revered for producing wines of immense sophistication and terroir authenticity. The majestic Côte Brune bottling is an exceptional piece of winemaking history, crafted as a direct homage to René's great-uncle, the legendary Marius Gentaz, utilizing prized old vines replanted in 1999 on a vertiginous, iron-rich micaschist slope.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a dark, deep grenat colour with intense purple highlights. The complex nose unfurls gracefully to reveal aromas of wild blackberries, fresh cassis, and black cherries accented by notes of violet, dried herbs, orange peel, and cracked black pepper. On the palate, it is full-bodied, concentrated, and beautifully structured, showing a dense, velvety mouthfeel framed by fine, grippy tannins and a distinctive line of mineral acidity. Composed entirely of 100% Syrah, this benchmark bottling possesses tremendous freshness and an ethereal, saline finish heavily laced with dark chocolate and spice. It offers an optimal drinking window that easily spans from 2029 to 2058.

title: Hakushu 12 Year Old Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
The Hakushu 12 Year Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky originates from the Yamanashi prefecture in Japan. Nestled deep within the mountain forests of the Japanese Southern Alps at the foot of Mount Kaikomagatake, Hakushu is famously known as Suntory's 'mountain forest distillery'. Founded in 1973 by Keizo Saji, the second master blender of House of Suntory, the distillery's winemaking-like philosophy focuses on using soft, crisp alpine waters and a unique cool climate to mature whiskies more slowly, creating a signature green and fresh character.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a bright champagne gold colour. The nose is remarkably fresh and lively, revealing vibrant aromas of green apple, pear, and basil, underscored by pine needles, fresh mint, and a delicate touch of vanilla. On the palate, it is medium bodied and creamy, featuring a sweet entry of kiwi, sweet pear, and candied herbs transitioning smoothly into malty grain and gentle oak spice. Bottled at 43% ABV, this 100% malted barley expression concludes with a clean, dry, and crisp finish accented by green tea and a very subtle hint of smoke.

title: Yamazaki 18 Year Old Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
The Yamazaki 18 Year Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky originates from the Osaka prefecture in Japan. Established in 1923 by Shinjiro Torii, Yamazaki is revered as the birthplace of Japanese whisky. Nestled in a misty vale where the Katsura, Uji, and Kizu rivers converge, the distillery's production philosophy heavily emphasizes multi-layered maturation, utilizing unique local soft water and a diverse array of cask shapes and sizes to achieve an unrivaled complexity.

Spirit Description

This legendary single malt presents a deep bronze and amber colour. The nose offers an immediate, captivating wall of dark fruitiness—evoking dates, prunes, and blueberry—balanced by dark honey, bitter marmalade, and vanilla. On the palate, the whisky delivers a rich, velvety entry of manuka honey, caramelized peaches, and plum wine, followed by complex mid-palate notes of walnut, cinnamon, and black pepper. Composed of 100% malted barley, it features a masterfully blended profile consisting of roughly 80% sherry-cask aged spirits, with the remainder matured in American and rare Mizunara oak. Bottled at 43% ABV, it concludes with a long, dry, and refreshing finish dominated by lingering citrus peel and a cooling touch of mint.

title: Kavalan 15 Years Old Four-Cask 2025 Edition
bodyHtml:
Kavalan's 15 Years Old Single Malt Whisky won a Gold Medal at the 2026 World Whiskies Awards (WWA). This milestone release marks the Taiwanese distillery's landmark first-ever age statement, celebrated broadly for handling its intense subtropical maturation climate without losing structural balance

Kavalan's 15 Years Old is an ultra premium single malt whisky originating from Yilan County, Taiwan. Crafted at the Kavalan Distillery, which was founded in 2005 by parent company King Car Group, this bottle marks a momentous milestone as the distillery's first ever age-statement whisky. Launched as part of the Time Exploration series, the release is a direct tribute to March 11, 2006, the historic day when the very first drops of new-make spirit trickled from the Kavalan stills and officially commenced Taiwanese whisky production.

Spirit Description

Kavalan 15 Years Old 2025 Edition is made from 100% malted barley and represents rare stock that has endured fifteen years of accelerated maturation inside Taiwan's hot, intensely humid subtropical climate. The defining element of this expression is its complex four-cask maturation strategy. To maximize depth and balance, CEO YT Lee masterfully blended individual small-batch reserves aged in hand-selected ex-bourbon barrels, Oloroso sherry casks, Ruby port barrels, and traditional large puncheons.

  • Colour: Golden caramel.

  • Aroma: Captivating and multi-layered. The nose opens with a dessert-like profile of caramel apple mousse, fresh chocolate, walnut cinnamon rolls, and creamy popcorn, intricately interwoven with underlying notes of dried tangerine peel and sweet plum.

  • Palate: Velvety, lush, and deeply expressive on the entry. Bright citrus flavors of bergamot, lemon, orange, and grapefruit dance alongside sweet dried cranberries, raisins, and tropical longan, before developing into darker layers of dark chocolate gelato and a rich caramel walnut coffee mousse.

  • Body: Full-bodied and robust, carrying Kavalan's signature oily creaminess that coats the throat beautifully.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long and smooth, trailing off with a comforting warmth of woody cinnamon spice, lingering toffee, and the rich sweetness of black date fruit.

  • ABV: Bottled at 43%.

title: Chateau Lafite Rothschild 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from France, within the historic Pauillac A.O.C. appellation on Bordeaux’s Left Bank. Universally revered as a Premier Cru Classé (First Growth) according to the legendary 1855 Classification, Château Lafite Rothschild stands as an global pinnacle of viticultural refinement and aristocratic poise. The estate operates under a timeless, precision-focused winemaking philosophy directed by Saskia de Rothschild and technical director Eric Kohler, which favors unmatched aromatic verticality, intellectual complexity, and long-term evolutionary capability over simple power. Rooted in deep, gravelly terraces layered over limestone bedrock, the estate's choice terroir allows the noble vines to establish deep roots, naturally capturing the iconic graphite-led minerality and breezy maritime freshness that defines this legendary Left Bank icon.

Wine Description

The 2023 Château Lafite Rothschild presents a deep, luminous dark ruby-purple appearance in the glass, radiating rich violet reflections. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, deep, and high-toned, offering a stunningly pure and direct expression of its classic marine terroir. The bouquet opens with an enticing, multi-faceted display of cool blackcurrants, wild raspberries, and black cherries, seamlessly layered with Lafite’s unmistakable signatures of freshly sharpened lead pencil, cedarwood, cigar wrapper, and exotic incense, followed by subtle top notes of lilac and fresh mint. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, athletic, and beautifully focused, showcasing a concentrated yet ethereal core of dark orchard fruits and crunchy cassis berries. It is characterized by an impressive sense of weightlessness and agility, driven by a vibrant, linear backbone of natural acidity that keeps the mid-palate exceptionally lively. The mouthfeel is broad and aristocratic, featuring remarkably silky, powdery, and fine-grained tannins that wrap smoothly around the core before expanding into an explosive, never-ending finish accented by savory tobacco leaf, graphite, and a touch of mineral salinity.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season across the Médoc heavily rewarded viticulturists who prioritized meticulous, adaptive vineyard management to manage a dynamic maritime calendar. Early summer brought warm, humid conditions that demanded intensive canopy work, but a glorious, sunny late August and September delivered warm daytime hours paired with cool nightly downslope winds. This wide diurnal shift allowed the Cabernet Sauvignon grapes to ripen slowly and uniformly, locking in an uncommonly vibrant, linear core of natural malic acidity while building thick, phenolically mature skins with extraordinarily fine tannins. By executing a highly selective harvest, the winemaking team successfully crafted a wonderfully classical, fresh, and deeply aromatic vintage reminiscent of old-school legendary years but with far superior modern precision. It represents an exceptional cellar specimen built to evolve gracefully over the next 40 to 50 years, reaching its prime drinking window after 2033.

title: Coravin Timeless Six+ Wine Access System Black - Each
bodyHtml:
The Science of Pouring Wine Without Removing the Cork

The Coravin Timeless system lets you pour wine without pulling the cork. The rest of the bottle stays as fresh as the day you bought it – for weeks, months, or even 20+ years later.

What's Included:

  • Timeless Six Wine By-the-Glass System

  • Timeless Aerator

  • Coravin Pure™ Argon Capsules 3-Pack

  • Timeless Standard Screw Caps 6-Pack

  • Timeless Carry Case

  • Needle Clearing Tool

  • Bottle Sleeve

title: Coravin Timeless Three+ Wine Access System Black - Each
bodyHtml:
Coravin Timeless Three + Wine Preservation System

Unlock your cellar one glass at a time. The Timeless Three + lets you pour any still wine without ever pulling the cork, using a fine, surgical-grade needle and a blanket of pure argon to keep the remaining liquid untouched by oxygen. Every pour tastes as vibrant and aromatic as the first, even months or years after the bottle was first accessed—perfect for tasting flights, weeknight pairings, or simply spreading a prized vintage over many memorable moments.

This “Freedom Kit” arrives ready for discovery, pairing Coravin’s all-black Timeless Three device with a 2-pack of Pure™ Argon Capsules, a micro-splash-free Aerator that mimics an hour of decanting, two reusable Timeless Screw Caps for wines sealed without cork, and essential maintenance tools. No wonder Oprah named it one of her Favorite Things for 2022.

title: Coravin Timeless Standard Replacement Needle - Each
bodyHtml:
Direct replacement Needle for Timeless Systems

Coravin Timeless Needles are specially designed to pierce through natural or agglomerated cork and allow you to pour wine without opening the bottle. The Coravin Timeless Standard Needle is the direct replacement Needle for all Timeless Systems except the Timeless Eleven. All Coravin Timeless Needles are made of stainless steel with a non-stick coating, providing durability and easy insertion for hundreds of pours.

title: Coravin Argon Capsules 21 ml - 6 Pack
bodyHtml:
Replenishment Pure Argon Gas Capsules - 6 Pack

Coravin Pure™ Argon Capsules power Coravin Timeless and Pivot™ Wine Preservation Systems. They are filled with pure Argon gas that pressurizes the bottle to allow wine to flow out the spout, then blankets the remaining wine once the System is removed.

Argon Capsules are NOT compatible with Coravin Sparkling™ - they are specifically made to be used on still wines.

title: Remus Repeal Reserve Series VII Bourbon 2023 Edition
bodyHtml:
The Remus Repeal Reserve Series VII Bourbon is a straight bourbon whiskey from the United States, produced in Lawrenceburg, Indiana. It is crafted at the Ross & Squibb Distillery, formerly known as MGP, which is the oldest distillery in Indiana. The brand's namesake, George Remus, was a Prohibition era figure who acquired W.P. Squibb & Co. due to its high-quality reputation, a tradition that the distillery aims to continue.

Whiskey Description

The nose leads with notes of caramelized pecans, candied cherry, and maple syrup, with secondary hints of rye-forward spice, rich caramel, vanilla, and dusty oak. The taste delivers rich caramel, maple, candied raisin, and candied cherry, leading to a body of barrel char and rich cinnamon. The mouthfeel is often described as thick or buttery, though sometimes thin. It is round, perfectly balanced, and warming.

title: Poli Gran Bassano Vermouth Rosso
bodyHtml:
This premium red vermouth originates from the Veneto region of northern Italy, uniquely tied to the territory surrounding the historical city of Bassano del Grappa. The product is crafted by Poli Distillerie, a renowned family run estate established in 1898 that carries four generations of artisanal distillation tradition. The modern formulation honors a historic recipe handwritten in the 1930s by great grandfather GioBatta Poli, blending deep regional roots with contemporary style.

Wine Description

This red vermouth displays a vibrant ruby red core with deep amber undertones in the glass. The nose delivers a highly expressive and unique aromatic profile reminiscent of a fresh grape cluster beautifully wrapped in aromatic herbs and spices. On the palate, it is dry, spicy, and wonderfully structured, revealing a delicate bittersweet balance that avoids excessive sweetness. The body is rich, smooth, and texturally harmonious, layering notes of cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, and caramel alongside a sophisticated herbal undertone. It culminates in a clean, invigorating, and pleasantly persistent finish marked by a light touch of spice and dryness. The unique structural foundation relies entirely on Merlot, a red wine variety cultivated in the local DOC area since the late 19th century. This wine base undergoes a natural infusion with 33 aromatic botanicals, showcasing characteristic regional plants like holy thistle and musky yarrow alongside rhubarb, vanilla, pimento, ginger, and liquorice. The product features an alcohol by volume of 18%.

title: Giodo Brunello di Montalcino 2021
bodyHtml:
The Giodo Brunello di Montalcino 2021 originates from the esteemed Tuscany region within the iconic Brunello di Montalcino DOCG subregion of Italy. The estate is the personal project of the legendary and globally revered winemaker Carlo Ferrini, who selected this small pocket of land to realize his ultimate winemaking philosophy. His vision centres on showcasing the absolute purity of the Sangiovese grape, handling only the healthiest, perfect clusters from organically grown vines to celebrate the authentic identity of the Montalcino terroir.

Wine Description

This masterpiece presents a deep, bright ruby red colour in the glass. The exceptional nose reveals beautifully perfumed and ethereal aromas of ripe wild raspberries, dark cherries, and blackberries, gracefully layered with hints of cedar, blood orange, violets, and sweet spices. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied with ultra-fine, velvety tannins and a zippy, mouthwatering acidity that lends a diamond-sharp structure and incredible freshness. Composed of 100% Sangiovese, this modern classic offers a sleekly textured profile balanced by great energy and long-term tension. It finishes with immense length and a savory mineral snap, indicating an optimal drinking window that begins in 2028 and comfortably evolves for decades.

title: Antigal Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
This rich red wine comes from Argentina, originating from the premier high altitude vineyards of the Mendoza region. Antigal Winery & Estates was established on the site of a historic property in Maipú first constructed in 1897. Following a complete restoration starting in 2000, the estate focuses on producing high quality wines using a gravity-fed gravity-flow system to preserve the absolute freshness and natural acidity of the fruit.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Medium intensity ruby red with flashes of black.

  • Aroma: A classic bouquet showing sweet cherries, dried currants, and plums, beautifully accented by hints of white pepper, olives, tobacco, and cocoa.

  • Palate: Juicy, simple, and chewy on the palate, with robust yet rounded tannins that deliver flavours of dark berries alongside a touch of sawdust and spices.

  • Body: Well-balanced medium body.

  • Finish: A clean and slightly lean finish of medium length.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, hand-harvested from meticulously managed vines planted in the mid-2000s.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is aged in oak barrels for 10 months, lending a precise perspective of the variety with spices and soft wood tones that are integrated with the wine's vibrant fruit energy.

  • Alcohol by Volume: 13.9%

  • Organic Status: Not certified organic, though minded with sustainable, nature-friendly winemaking practices.

Food Pairing

  • Grilled meats such as ribeye steak or grilled lamb chops.

  • Rich, hearty stews.

  • Hard, aged cheeses.

title: Fratelli Barolo Gramolere 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Barolo D.O.C.G. appellation of the northern Piedmont region. Fratelli Alessandria is a historic and deeply respected family estate located in the village of Verduno, tracing its commercial winemaking roots all the way back to 1830. Under the current, precision-focused stewardship of Vittore Alessandria, the family operates under a classic, low-intervention winemaking philosophy to highlight site-specific clarity. The "Gramolere" vineyard located in the neighboring commune of Monforte d'Alba holds a special place in the estate's lineup as their lone single-vineyard plot outside of Verduno. The vineyard came to the family through the matriarch, Flavia Manzone, who was born in the village. Rooted in dark, limestone-and-clay-heavy soils mixed with steep sandstone veins, these 60-year-old heritage vines yield a classic, hulking expression that represents the traditionally structured, dark-toned counterpoint to Verduno's lighter, floral styles.

Wine Description

The 2021 Fratelli Alessandria 'Gramolere' Barolo presents a moderately deep garnet-red appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally deep, complex, and high-toned, masterfully capturing the naturally brooding, savory character of Monforte d'Alba. The bouquet opens with a bold, multi-faceted display of ripe black cherries, dark plum, and cherry liqueur, beautifully layered with distinct undertones of iron-rich earth, new leather, licorice, fresh mint, and balsamic tobacco leaf. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and beautifully focused, showcasing a powerful, concentrated core of black fruits, crushed rocks, and peppery spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a vibrant backbone of mineral acidity that gives life to its massive, tightly knit frame. The mouthfeel is broad, textured, and deeply sapid, driven by firm, fine-grained, yet assertive tannins that carry into a remarkably long, dry finish highlighted by darker mineral accents, tar, and lingering savory spices.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 growing season across the Langhe is celebrated by international critics as an absolute benchmark, legendary vintage characterized by massive structural stuffing, intense aromatics, and profound cellaring longevity. Following a mild winter and a steady spring, a warm, dry summer brought sun-drenched daytime hours that optimized sugar accumulation and phenolic ripeness. Crucially, sharp nighttime temperature drops locked in vital, energetic natural acidity. Because the Gramolere parcel sits at a high elevation, it benefited from cooler microclimates that allowed for a slower, progressive ripening window. Harvesting nearly a week after their Verduno plots, the family brought in small, perfectly healthy berry clusters with thick, beautifully ripe skins. This pristine climate synergy yielded a remarkably balanced, deep, and age-worthy Barolo built with an internal matrix to cellar gracefully for decades (ideally peaking between 2028 and 2056).

title: Ridge Vineyards "Monte Bello" Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Ridge Vineyards 'Monte Bello' Cabernet Sauvignon is a legendary prestige red originating from the rugged Santa Cruz Mountains appellation in California, United States. Established in the late 19th century and revitalized in 1959, the historic winery achieved global icon status under the guidance of legendary winemaker Paul Draper. Ridge's winemaking philosophy focuses on 'preindustrial' minimal intervention, organic farming, and meticulous vineyard-site expression to craft single-vineyard wines of exceptional character and balance.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon dominant blend, presented in an elegant 1.5-litre magnum bottle, displays a deep, inky ruby-purple color. The nose is incredibly expressive and high-toned, bursting with vibrant aromas of red and black currants, mulberry, and rose petals, seamlessly layered with notes of fresh sage, graphite, sweet American oak, and pipe tobacco. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, demonstrating 'weightless intensity' where concentrated, opulent dark fruit flavors are supported by a lively, refreshing acidity and a powerful, tight structure of building, chalky tannins. The blend is composed of 82% Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Merlot, 8% Petit Verdot, and 1% Cabernet Franc. Thanks to the larger 1.5-litre format, which slows down the aging process and promotes more graceful development, this landmark vintage boasts an exceptionally long optimal drinking window stretching from 2029 through 2060.

title: Dom Perignon P2 Plenitude Brut Rose 2002
bodyHtml:
Dom Perignon P2 Rose is an extraordinary prestige cuvee originating from the historic Champagne region of France. The house traces its spiritual legacy back to the 17th century Benedictine monk Pierre Perignon, who pioneered revolutionary standards of excellence at the Abbey of Hautvillers. Guided today by Chef de Caves Vincent Chaperon, the maison remains strictly dedicated to vintage-only champagnes, striving to capture the radical expression of a single harvest through a harmonious blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir.

Wine Description

This champagne displays a deep, luminous rose colour that reflects both superb maturation and remarkable concentration. The nose is complex and evolving, unfurling with expressive aromas of wild strawberry, blood orange, and raspberry, layered with rose petals, warm nutmeg, cocoa powder, and a signature hint of smoky minerality. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and vinous, showing a broad yet precise mouthfeel where rich red berry fruit and citrus zest are supported by a fine, boisterous mousse and a firm, mineral-driven structure. Crafted from a blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, this prestige cuvee has been patiently aged on its lees for roughly fifteen years to reach its second 'Plenitude' stage, yielding incredible freshness, tension, and savoury depth. This bottle is currently showing magnificently and has an optimal drinking window extending through 2040.

title: Les Fiefs De Lagrange 2019
bodyHtml:
Les Fiefs de Lagrange is the highly regarded second wine of Château Lagrange, a historic Third Growth estate situated in the Saint-Julien appellation of Bordeaux's Left Bank. First created in 1983, Les Fiefs de Lagrange is crafted from vines averaging 30 years of age with the exact same meticulous technical discipline as the estate’s Grand Vin. The winemaking philosophy centers on precision viticulture and expressing the distinct gravel-rich terroirs of Saint-Julien, resulting in a refined wine designed to offer estate pedigree with earlier accessibility.

Wine Description

The 2019 Les Fiefs de Lagrange displays a deep ruby color with youthful purple reflections. The nose is clean and focused, opening with expressive aromas of ripe blackcurrants, dark cherries, and red plums, beautifully layered with notes of cedar, graphite, sandalwood, and sweet spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, supple, and exceptionally harmonious, offering a creamy, smooth texture balanced by a refreshing mineral acidity. Polished, fine-grained tannins structure the dark fruit and savory undertones, leading to a long, clean, and elegant finish.

This vintage is a classic Left Bank blend composed of 53% Cabernet Sauvignon, 44% Merlot, and 3% Petit Verdot. It was matured for 13 months in French oak barrels (20% new). Already drinking beautifully now, it possesses the structural integrity to cellar gracefully through 2040.

title: Clos du Soleil WS Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant rosé wine is crafted in Canada within the Similkameen Valley of British Columbia, utilizing premium grapes sourced from the Yakima Valley in Washington State. Founded on a commitment to producing Bordeaux style wines, Clos du Soleil operates with an artisanal philosophy that emphasizes minimal intervention and a deep respect for nature. In response to extreme winter freezes in British Columbia, the winery innovatively partnered with Washington growers to create their special Washington Series, allowing winemaker Michael Clark to continue producing exceptional wines from shared Pacific Northwest terroirs.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Delicate pale salmon pink in the glass.

  • Aroma: Highly expressive on the nose, opening with an elegant bouquet of rose buds, strawberries, lavender, and stone fruit.

  • Palate: Bright and lively on the dry palate, dancing with flavours of fresh peach, white nectarine, strawberry, and cherry.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a beautifully juicy mid palate and a structured, lively tension.

  • Finish: Crisp, dry, and exceptionally long, accented by subtle touches of spice and sea salt.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Sangiovese.

  • Stylistic Notes: Strikingly balanced, this wine focuses on delicate and gentle juice handling. After destemming and light crushing, the grapes are pressed almost immediately to preserve their delicacy, followed by a cool fermentation in stainless steel tanks while avoiding all oxygen contact to maintain pristine freshness.

  • Alcohol by Volume: 12.9%

  • Organic Status: Not certified organic, though made with minimal winery intervention and a light filtration just prior to bottling.

Food Pairing

  • Perfect partner for fresh grilled salmon or roasted chicken dishes.

  • Complements a wide selection of soft cheeses.

  • Ideal for a sunny day and a picnic blanket.

title: Fratelli Alessandria 'Gramolere' Barolo 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Barolo D.O.C.G. appellation of the northern Piedmont region. Fratelli Alessandria is a historic and deeply respected family estate located in the village of Verduno, tracing its commercial winemaking roots all the way back to 1830. Under the current, precision-focused stewardship of Vittore Alessandria, the family operates under a classic, low-intervention winemaking philosophy to highlight site-specific clarity. The "Gramolere" vineyard located in the neighboring commune of Monforte d'Alba holds a special place in the estate's lineup as their lone single-vineyard plot outside of Verduno. The vineyard came to the family through the matriarch, Flavia Manzone, who was born in the village. Rooted in dark, limestone-and-clay-heavy soils mixed with steep sandstone veins, these 60-year-old heritage vines yield a classic, hulking expression that represents the traditionally structured, dark-toned counterpoint to Verduno's lighter, floral styles.

Wine Description

The 2021 Fratelli Alessandria 'Gramolere' Barolo presents a moderately deep garnet-red appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally deep, complex, and high-toned, masterfully capturing the naturally brooding, savory character of Monforte d'Alba. The bouquet opens with a bold, multi-faceted display of ripe black cherries, dark plum, and cherry liqueur, beautifully layered with distinct undertones of iron-rich earth, new leather, licorice, fresh mint, and balsamic tobacco leaf. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and beautifully focused, showcasing a powerful, concentrated core of black fruits, crushed rocks, and peppery spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a vibrant backbone of mineral acidity that gives life to its massive, tightly knit frame. The mouthfeel is broad, textured, and deeply sapid, driven by firm, fine-grained, yet assertive tannins that carry into a remarkably long, dry finish highlighted by darker mineral accents, tar, and lingering savory spices.

title: Jack Daniel's Cinnamon Spice Tennessee Fire
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Tennessee Fire is a premium flavored whiskey liqueur originating from Lynchburg, Tennessee, in the United States. It is crafted by the Jack Daniel Distillery, which was officially registered in 1866 by Jack Daniel and stands as the oldest registered distillery in the country. The historic distillery has been owned and operated by the Brown-Forman Corporation since 1956.

Spirit Description

Jack Daniel's Tennessee Fire is made by blending the distillery's signature Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey with a proprietary, naturally infused red hot cinnamon liqueur. The base whiskey is produced using iron-free cave spring water and undergoes the historic 'Lincoln County Process', where it is charcoal mellowed drop by drop through ten feet of sugar maple charcoal before maturing in handcrafted American white oak barrels.

  • Colour: Warm rich amber with copper highlights.

  • Aroma: Intense and enticingly sweet. The nose is dominated by candy-like aromas of red hot cinnamon, atomic fireballs, and hot honey, underpinned by subtle notes of vanilla, sugar, and toasted oak.

  • Palate: Sweet, smooth, and highly spirited on the entry. It delivers a punchy wave of candied cinnamon, sugar syrup, and nutmeg, which gradually gives way to vanilla, dark chocolate, and the familiar, mellow wood-char character of the base Tennessee whiskey.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a viscous, velvety mouth-coating sweetness that masks any harsh alcohol bite.

  • Finish: Long, sweet, and comforting, trailing off with a slow, warming kick of spicy cinnamon and a clean, lingering confectionery heat.

  • ABV: Bottled at 35% (70 Proof).

title: Henri de Villamont Savigny Les Beaunes Monopole Rouge 2021
bodyHtml:
Henri de Villamont's Savigny-lès-Beaune "Le Village" Monopole is a distinguished red wine from the renowned Burgundy region of France. The Henri de Villamont estate, with roots dating back to 1880, is celebrated for its commitment to producing wines that authentically express the terroir of Savigny-lès-Beaune. This particular wine is crafted exclusively from a 4.5-hectare vineyard surrounding the estate's cellars, making it a monopole, or single-owner vineyard.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir wine presents a bright crimson hue with garnet-red reflections. The nose is inviting, offering a bouquet of ripe red fruits such as cherries and raspberries, complemented by subtle peppery notes. On the palate, it is delicate and fleshy, characterized by silky, generous tannins, balanced acidity, and a rounded mouthfeel. The wine undergoes vinification in vats for 25 days, followed by maturation in oak barrels for 11 months and an additional 6 months in vats, enhancing its complexity and depth.

Food Pairing

This Savigny-lès-Beaune pairs excellently with poultry, red meats, and mildly flavored cheeses. Such combinations highlight the wine's depth and character, creating a harmonious dining experience,

title: Dalmore Principal King Alexander III
bodyHtml:
The Dalmore Principal King Alexander III is a luxury single malt Scotch whisky originating from the Highland region of Scotland. The distillery is situated in Alness, north of Inverness, and has been crafting spirit since 1839. This specific expression commemorates an event in 1263 when Colin of Kintail, Chieftain of Clan Mackenzie, saved King Alexander III of Scotland from a charging stag. The act earned the clan the right to use the twelve-point Royal Stag emblem, which proudly adorns every bottle of the distillery's whisky today.

Spirit Description

The Dalmore King Alexander III is made from 100% malted barley and represents a pioneering maturation achievement originally envisioned by legendary Master Distiller Richard Paterson. The defining element of this expression is its unique assemblage of six distinct cask finishes: small-batch ex-bourbon barrels, Matusalem Oloroso sherry butts, Madeira drums, Sicilian Marsala barrels, Port pipes, and French Cabernet Sauvignon wine barriques.

  • Colour: Deep amber with warm auburn highlights, showing the influence of the diverse wine and fortified wine casks.

  • Aroma: Rich, complex, and intensely fruity. The nose presents a bouquet of Seville orange zest, tangerine, creamy vanilla fudge, red berries, and sweet malty cereal, backed by hints of plum, leather, and passion fruit.

  • Palate: Velvety, smooth, and layered on the entry. The palate delivers an elegant combination of crème caramel, toasted almonds, vanilla pod, and citrus zest, which evolve into notes of Christmas cake, ginger, and a warm blend of mixed spices.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a round, smooth, and delicate mouthfeel that emphasizes lightness and approachability rather than heavy viscosity.

  • Finish: Moderately long and warming, closing with notes of cinnamon, nutmeg, and ginger, alongside dry oak and trailing hints of cranberry, cocoa dust, and vanilla.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40%.

title: Monte Creek Living Land Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'vibrant' rosé wine originates from Canada, within the pioneering British Columbia V.Q.A. designation. Sourced from the unique terroirs of the Thompson Valley and the Okanagan Valley, this bottling is an estate highlight from Monte Creek Winery. Operating under a deep winemaking philosophy of regenerative agriculture, soil health, and absolute site transparency, the winery treats its estate vineyards as holistically balanced ecosystems under their "Living Land" series. Rooted in ancient, nutrient-rich glacial silt and gravelly soils carved by the South Thompson River, the vines endure desert-like, sun-drenched daytime hours balanced by sudden, chilly alpine nights, naturally yielding fruit with an exceptional harmony of intense fruit concentration and laser-focused structural tension.

Wine Description

The Monte Creek 'Living Land' Rosé presents a brilliant, elegant pale salmon-pink and coral appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, energetic, and high-toned, opening with a bold, expressive bouquet of fresh strawberries, red currants, and crunchy rhubarb, beautifully layered with fragrant underlays of rose petals, white peach, and a distinct touch of damp stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, round, and beautifully focused, showcasing a juicy, mouth-filling core of sour red cherries, pink grapefruit zest, and wild summer berries. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that perfectly elevates the wine's texturing fruit volume. The mouthfeel is sleek yet pleasingly supple, driven by a fine mineral grip that carries into a crisp, bone-dry, and highly persistent finish highlighted by a refreshing wave of citrus pith.

title: Tobermory Ledaig Castaway - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Ledaig Castaway is a limited edition, heavily peated single malt Scotch whisky originating from the Isle of Mull in the Island region of Scotland. The spirit is produced at Tobermory Distillery, which was founded in 1798 by John Sinclair and remains the only operational whisky distillery on the island. The historic distillery is currently owned by Burn Stewart Distillers, a subsidiary of Heineken Beverages, and is renowned for crafting two distinct styles of single malt: the unpeated Tobermory and the robust, peated Ledaig.

Spirit Description

Launched in May 2026, Ledaig Castaway represents a rare, experimental maturation feat for the distillery, marking the first time they have aged a spirit using a dual combination of Caribbean rum casks and Mexican tequila casks with no ex-bourbon wood influence. The non-aged statement liquid is crafted from heavily peated malted barley, left non-chill filtered, and kept completely free of artificial colouring to preserve its natural texture. The distillery capped this unique global release at a limited run of 6,428 bottles worldwide.

  • Colour: Light straw gold, naturally derived from its exclusive dual cask maturation.

  • Aroma: Expressive and maritime, opening with distinct coastal peat smoke, caramelised banana, lime zest, and sweet vanilla, layered alongside green apple, white pepper, and a subtle hint of sea spray.

  • Palate: Dynamic and complex, featuring an initial lead of bold smoky spice that balances beautifully against sweet grilled pineapple, salty brine, and herbal agave, which develops into black pepper, charred citrus, and rich toffee.

  • Body: Rich, viscous, and full-bodied with a heavily peated, oily mouthfeel that coats the palate cleanly.

  • Finish: Long and warming, trailing off with the taste of smouldering peat embers, demerara sugar sweetness, persistent chilli heat, and a final crisp twist of lime.

  • ABV: Bottled at a powerful cask strength of 61.1%.

title: Fratelli Barolo Monvigliero 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'ethereal' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Barolo D.O.C.G. appellation of the northern Piedmont region. Fratelli Alessandria is a historic, deeply respected family estate located in the village of Verduno, tracing its commercial winemaking roots all the way back to 1830. Under the current, precision-focused stewardship of Vittore Alessandria, the family operates under a classic, low-intervention winemaking philosophy to highlight site-specific clarity. The "Monvigliero" vineyard is universally revered as the absolute crown jewel, undisputed Grand Cru of Verduno, and one of the most distinctive terroirs in the entire Barolo zone. The heritage vines are rooted in a unique geological matrix of limestone-heavy, chalky white marls (Marnes di Sant'Agata) mixed with veins of silt, where the vineyard’s distinct amphitheater shape acts as a sun trap while capturing cooling alpine breezes to focus an unmatched aromatic verticality.

Wine Description

The 2021 Fratelli Alessandria 'Monvigliero' Barolo presents a translucent, luminous ruby-garnet appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, complex, and high-toned, opening with an intense, beautifully layered bouquet of fresh-crushed wild cherries, strawberry preserves, and orange peel, seamlessly woven with Monvigliero's signature aromatic markers of white pepper, alpine herbs, dried rose petals, and sweet tobacco leaf. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, tense, and beautifully balanced, showcasing a concentrated and fleshy core of crunchy red fruits, dark plum extracts, and black cardamom. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a vibrant backbone of limestone-driven acidity. The mouthfeel is wonderfully sleek and transparent, driven by firm, fine-grained, and silky tannins that frame its ethereal texture before gliding into a remarkably long, savory, and chalky finish highlighted by a distinct salty streak and lingering notes of cedar wood spice.

title: Pio Cesare Barbaresco 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Barbaresco D.O.C.G. appellation of the northern Piedmont region. Pio Cesare is an iconic, family-owned winery founded in 1881, based in the ancient city center of Alba. Under the dedicated steering of the fifth generation of the Pio family, the estate operates under a historic, classic winemaking philosophy that values regional authenticity, structural concentration, and minimal intervention. Unlike many modern single-vineyard expressions, this flagship Barbaresco is crafted using the traditional multi-parcel blending technique. The Nebbiolo grapes are sourced exclusively from the family’s premium estate vineyards: the renowned "Il Bricco" estate and the great hill of "San Stefanetto," both situated in the cooler, high-altitude village of Treiso. This deliberate combination captures a beautifully complete, classic expression of Barbaresco characterized by complex, earthy aromatics, exceptional finesse, and immense ageability.

Wine Description

The 2022 Pio Cesare Barbaresco presents a brilliant, moderately intense garnet-red appearance in the glass with bright orange-tinted highlights shimmering at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, complex, and high-toned, offering a beautiful harmony of primary red fruits and savory, traditional Nebbiolo characteristics. The bouquet opens with a captivating display of sweet red cherries, fresh wild strawberries, and plum skins, seamlessly woven with complex underlays of white pepper, mint, dried rose petals, and a distinct touch of damp forest floor, anise, and iodine. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, structured, and remarkably polished, showcasing a focused, concentrated core of ripe red berries, pomegranate, and red currants. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a balanced, refreshing backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the fruit's natural extract. The mouthfeel is sleek and velvety on the entry before giving way to fine, firm, and ultra-fine tannins that carry into a long, beautifully poised finish highlighted by savory wood spice, cedar, and a lingering touch of dark cocoa.

title: Pio Cesare Barolo 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Barolo D.O.C.G. appellation of the northern Piedmont region. Pio Cesare is an iconic, family-owned winery founded in 1881, based in the ancient city center of Alba. Under the dedicated steering of the fifth generation represented by Federica Boffa Pio and Cesare Benvenuto the estate operates under a historic winemaking philosophy that champions the classic regional art of multi-parcel blending. Rather than bottling single-cru expressions exclusively, Pio Cesare crafts its classic Barolo by combining the unique characteristics of several prestigious, family-owned vineyard sites situated across the appellation's distinct communes. This traditional formula weaves together the muscular structure of Serralunga with the perfumed elegance of La Morra, yielding a complete, harmonious, and highly age-worthy masterpiece.

Wine Description

The 2022 Pio Cesare Barolo presents an intense ruby-red color in the glass with beautiful, classic garnet reflections shimmering at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, complex, and high-toned, perfectly capturing the vibrant primary fruit and savory earthiness of a traditional vintage. The bouquet opens with an inviting, multi-faceted display of ripe red cherries, wild strawberries, and pomegranate, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of fresh mint, crushed violet petals, sweet tobacco leaf, and an exotic trace of bergamot. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, juicy, and beautifully balanced, showcasing a concentrated core of wild forest berries, sour plum skins, and a touch of savory cocoa. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a balanced, refreshing backbone of natural acidity. The mouthfeel is remarkably polished yet firm, driven by tight, grainy tannins that carry into a long, persistent finish highlighted by a delicious note of black licorice, savory herb-infused cedar, and a touch of smoky, mineral-driven umami.

title: Bruichladdich 30 Year Old - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
The Bruichladdich Thirty Aged Years is an ultra premium, unpeated single malt Scotch whisky originating from the Rhinns of the Isle of Islay in the Island region of Scotland. Released in early 2024 as part of the distillery's Luxury Redefined series, this expression is a tribute to the resurrection of the Victorian era distillery. Following a period of turbulence in the late twentieth century, the distillery was mothballed in 1994, with only two remaining staff members safeguarding these silent, slowly maturing casks until the site was fully restored in 2001.

Spirit Description

The Bruichladdich Thirty is crafted entirely from unpeated, pre-renaissance malted barley distilled before the 2001 reopening of the distillery. The liquid was matured entirely in hand-selected ex-bourbon casks, with half of the spirit spending its full term in refill hogsheads, and the remaining half re-casked from refill hogsheads into fresh bourbon barrels after twenty years of aging.

  • Colour: Pale gold, indicating a gentle and elegant maturation profile.

  • Aroma: Soft and complex, opening with the aroma of coconut, wild gorse flowers, Brazil nuts, and sweet vanilla, paired with floral notes of geranium, rose, candied lemons, and soft spices.

  • Palate: Sweet, delicate, and layered, delivering flavours of toasted oak, light fruits, honey, and fudge, balanced by a hint of leather and Bruichladdich's signature salty tang of fresh Islay sea air.

  • Body: Rounded and exceptionally soft, utilizing the American oak components to build deep texture without any aggressive alcohol heat.

  • Finish: Extremely long and lingering, showing a vibrant tang of sea salt, warm oak, soft vanilla, and sweet toasted coconut.

  • ABV: Bottled at 43%.

title: Henri de Villamont Grands Echezeaux Grand Cru 2021
bodyHtml:
Henri de Villamont's Grands-Echezeaux Grand Cru is a distinguished red wine from the renowned Grands-Échezeaux Grand Cru vineyard in the Côte de Nuits subregion of Burgundy, France. The winery, Henri de Villamont, is celebrated for its commitment to producing high-quality wines that reflect the rich heritage and terroir of Burgundy.

Tasting Notes

This Grand Cru Pinot Noir exhibits a deep purple-blue to garnet-red hue. The bouquet is rich with aromas of blackberry, cherry, and soft spices. On the palate, it is elegant and smooth, showcasing the refined characteristics typical of the Grands-Échezeaux terroir.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs exceptionally well with dishes such as roasted duck, grilled lamb, and mushroom risotto. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Louis Latour Chambertin Grand Cru "Cuvee Heritiers Latour" 2011
bodyHtml:
Chambertin Grand Cru "Cuvée Héritiers Latour" 2011 is a monumental red wine from the Côte de Nuits, representing the pinnacle of Pinot Noir from one of the world's most famous vineyards.

The "Héritiers Latour" designation refers to the specific parcels owned by the Latour family within the Chambertin Grand Cru appellation since the late 19th century. Maison Louis Latour, founded in 1797, is one of Burgundy's most traditional and respected "negociant-eleveurs". Their winemaking philosophy for this cuvée is to honor the "King of Wines," utilizing fruit from 30-year-old vines planted in the iconic iron-rich, brown limestone soils that give Chambertin its legendary power and longevity.

Wine Description

The 2011 vintage presents a deep, dark ruby color with incredible aromatic intensity. The nose is complex and evolving, offering a mix of dark cherries and blackcurrants layered with savory notes of leather, licorice, and undergrowth. On the palate, the wine is powerful and full-bodied, showing a massive structure that is characteristic of this site. It is defined by its firm, elegant tannins and a persistent, earthy finish that lingers with hints of spice and concentrated fruit.

The wine is 100% Pinot Noir, hand-harvested and fermented in traditional open oak vats. It was aged for 10 to 12 months in 100% new French oak barrels sourced from Louis Latour's own cooperage. This 2011 release has an ABV of 13.5% and is recognized as a wine with exceptional cellaring potential, often requiring a decade or more to reach its peak.

Accolades

  • 94 Points – Wine Spectator: "A powerhouse, with a foundation of dense, grainy tannins supporting cherry, black currant, iron, and earth flavors... Best from 2018 through 2035."

  • 93 Points – James Suckling: Noted for its balance of fruit intensity and traditional Burgundian structure.

  • 18/20 – Jancis Robinson: Praised for its aromatic depth and "serious" character.

Food Pairing

This Grand Cru requires rich, flavorful dishes that can match its intensity:

  • Meats: Ideal with roasted venison, wild boar, or a classic Boeuf Bourguignon made with high-quality wine.

  • Game: Pairs perfectly with feathered game, such as pheasant or woodcock, served with a mushroom sauce.

  • Cheese: Complements mature and pungent cheeses like Epoisses or Soumaintrain.

Vintage Quality

The 2011 vintage in Burgundy was "the year of the vigneron," requiring significant work in the vineyard due to an early spring and a variable summer. While not as universally powerful as 2009 or 2010, the 2011 reds are noted for their freshness, transparency of terroir, and aromatic charm. In the top sites like Chambertin, the low yields resulted in wines with surprising concentration. Now with over a decade of age, the 2011 Chambertin is entering its prime drinking window, as the initially firm tannins have softened to reveal the wine's complex, earthy secondary characters.

title: Antinori Brunello di Montalcino 'Pian delle Vigne' 2007 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation of southern Tuscany. Acquired by the historic Marchesi Antinori family in 1995, the Tenuta Pian delle Vigne estate is named after a characteristic 19th-century railway station located on the property, situated roughly six kilometers southwest of the town of Montalcino. Operating under a winemaking philosophy that respects the traditional typicity of the Sangiovese grape while utilizing the family's centuries-old blending expertise, the estate benefits from a unique microclimate. The low-lying heritage vines are rooted in clay-rich soils layered over limestone and riddled with small, heat-retaining stones, which naturally yield a Brunello known for its remarkable aromatic complexity and silky, accessible structure.

Wine Description
