The 2007 Antinori 'Pian delle Vigne' Brunello di Montalcino presents a clear, dark ruby-red appearance in the glass, now showing an elegant brick-red and amber rim that reflects its beautiful maturity. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, savory, and complex, opening with a bold, expressive bouquet of sweet red cherries, wild cranberries, and dried plum preserves, beautifully layered with mature, high-toned notes of sweet tobacco leaf, bresaola, dried forest floor, black tea, and a tangy hint of balsamic. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, harmonious, and remarkably supple, showcasing a velvety core of red liquorice, black cherries, and dark chocolate orange peel. It is characterized by its outstanding structural balance, maintaining a vibrant, refreshing backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mature fruit weight. The mouthfeel is soft, rounded, and fully resolved, driven by thoroughly melted, fine-grained tannins that glide into a long, dry, and savory finish highlighted by lingering notes of sweet cedar, graphite, and a touch of roasted espresso bean.

This authentic expression of the region is crafted from 100% Sangiovese (locally known as Brunello). The fruit was harvested at perfect maturity following a warm, generous growing season. In the cellar, the grapes underwent careful fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks. To encourage slow micro-oxygenation and preserve the natural freshness of the single variety, the wine was matured for over two years in large traditional oak casks (botti ranging from 3,000 to 8,000 liters) rather than small barriques, avoiding heavy wood extraction. The wine reached a well-integrated alcohol content (ABV) of 14.0% and was matured for an additional period in bottle prior to its commercial release.

title: Rodney's Spicy Caesar 458 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Spicy Caesar (frequently designated as their Hot & Spicy variant) is the high-heat counterpart to the legendary flagship drink from Rodney’s Oyster House. While the Original sets the baseline for a premium, seafood-forward cocktail, the Spicy expression is engineered specifically for those who believe a Caesar isn't complete without a serious, clear-your-sinuses kick. It retains the pristine vodka base and rich, ocean-brined umami structure of the original oyster house recipe but steps up the intensity by introducing a sharper heat profile. It is a bold, uncompromising canned cocktail that refuses to play it safe.

RTD Description

Rodney's Spicy Caesar pours a thick, opaque, deep crimson-red with noticeable particulate suspension from the heavy spices and a soft, quiet effervescence that rests quickly.

Aroma: The nose is intensely sharp, aromatic, and aggressively savory. It leads with dominant notes of pungent, freshly grated horseradish and fiery scotch bonnet peppers, immediately followed by a base of savory tomato paste and celery salt. There is a vibrant, bright splash of fresh lime juice that pierces through the heavy, peppery aroma.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-to-full bodied with a thick, dense, and chewable mouthfeel. It leads with a split second of juicy tomato and briny clam sweetness, which is instantly overtaken by an intense, creeping wave of black pepper and chili heat. The mid-palate is deeply savory, highlighted by a sharp horseradish punch that builds at the back of the throat, leading to a long, bone-dry finish with a lingering, fiery spice.

Profile: It sits at an authentic, bar-strength 5.9% ABV and contains 0 IBU, using natural capsaicin heat, robust spices, and citrus acidity to construct its framework. It is naturally gluten-free.

Technical Notes: The punchy backbone of this beverage is built using a clean, multi-distilled premium vodka base that lets the ingredients speak for themselves. The increased heat profile relies on a dual-pronged approach: a massive increase in the brewery's proprietary horseradish blend combined with the targeted addition of hot pepper extracts (including scotch bonnet). By balancing these elements against a thick, high-quality clam broth and tomato foundation, the cocktail delivers a clean, sharp burn that avoids the artificial, chemical-tasting heat found in lesser macro seltzers.

title: Rodney's Original Caesar 458 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Original Caesar from Rodney’s Oyster House represents the ultimate "tribute to the coast" within Canada’s canned Ready-to-Drink (RTD) cocktail market. Born directly within the salty, high-energy walls of the iconic Rodney’s Oyster House with locations stretching from Vancouver to Toronto and Calgary this beverage wasn't engineered in a corporate boardroom. Instead, it was perfected over the shucking of a million oysters. Designed to offer a premium, bar-strength alternative to watery mass-market canned Caesars, it captures the signature, savory, seafood-forward profile of a scratch-built restaurant cocktail in a highly portable format.

RTD Description

Rodney's Original Caesar pours a deep, opaque, brick-red color with a textured appearance, showing a healthy suspension of fine spices and a gentle, soft effervescence that quickly settles.

Aroma: The nose is robust, complex, and instantly savory. It leads with dominant notes of crisp, seasoned tomato juice and heavy, fresh-grated horseradish, followed by a bright citrus splash of fresh lemon juice. There is a distinct, deeply appetizing undertone of briny ocean air and savory celery salt that sets it apart from standard canned mixes.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-to-full bodied with a thick, rich, and mouth-coating texture that mimics a hand-built cocktail. It leads with a savory wave of umami-rich clam broth and crisp tomato, which is immediately punched open by a spicy middle of horseradish heat and black pepper. The finish is long, complex, and sharply dry, leaving behind a lingering, pleasant citrus tang and a distinct, savory spice that begs for another sip.

Profile: It sits at a punchy, bar-strength 5.9% ABV and contains 0 IBU, using robust savory spices and natural citrus acidity to structure the drink rather than hop bitterness. It is naturally gluten-free.

Technical Notes: The unmatched depth of Rodney's Original Caesar relies on its deliberate premium ingredient bill, bypassing cheap neutral spirits in favor of a clean, multi-distilled premium vodka base. Instead of using ordinary, highly sweetened commercial tomato juice, the blend incorporates high-quality, all-natural tomato paste and clam broth. It is heavily seasoned with a proprietary spice blend that includes a heavy hand of real horseradish and a dash of bright citrus oils, ensuring that the heavy umami flavor profile remains tightly balanced and never finishes cloying or syrupy.

title: Rumblers Cola Soda 355 ml – 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Originating from Alberta, Canada, Rumblers Cola Soda is a modern expression of classic beverage craftsmanship. Produced by Gradient Beverages Corporation, the brand is dedicated to crafting boldly flavoured, ready to drink cocktails that break traditional spirits stereotypes.

This beverage presents a deep, classic cola colour with a lively, effervescent rim. The nose is highly aromatic, bursting with familiar notes of sweet cola spice, warm molasses, and a distinct, vibrant lift of fresh zesty lime. On the palate, it exhibits a medium body with a crisp and classic style, offering a harmonious and smooth balance where the warmth of premium rum meets gently sweetened cola.

title: Planeta Rose 2025 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Planeta Rose is a vibrant expression of Sicily, Italy, crafted within the renowned Menfi DOC. Established in 1995, Planeta is a family owned winery deeply rooted in agricultural heritage, spanning 17 generations. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on sustainably channeling the island's diverse terroirs through both indigenous and international grape varieties.

Wine Description

This organic rosé displays a delicate pearl pink color, reminiscent of a summer sunset. The nose is highly expressive, greeting the senses with fresh aromas of Sicilian wild strawberries, currants, and hibiscus, underscored by subtle tropical hints of melon and pineapple. On the palate, the wine is light to medium bodied, lively, and incredibly supple, beautifully balancing a smooth, soft texture with a crisp, refreshing acidity. Flavors recalling meringue and the pale flesh of peaches lead into a clean, dry finish marked by a subtle, delicate mineral edge.

title: Bread & Butter Prosecco
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'vibrant' sparkling wine originates from Italy, within the expansive, premium Prosecco D.O.C. designation of the country's northeast Veneto region. Bread & Butter Wines originally born in California and celebrated across North America for its highly accessible, fruit-forward style strategically ventured to the historic hillsides of northern Italy to craft this lifestyle-focused cuvée. Operating under a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes immediate, uncomplicated pleasure and crowd-pleasing balance, the brand works closely with trusted local Italian growers. The vineyards are exposed to sun-drenched daytime hours balanced by refreshing evening winds, yielding grapes that perfectly preserve their delicate primary aromatics and crisp, thirst-quenching structural definition.

Wine Description

The Bread & Butter Prosecco presents a brilliant, pale straw-yellow appearance in the glass with light, youthful greenish reflections and a lively, persistent stream of delicate bubbles. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, expressive, and high-toned, opening with an inviting, fruit-forward bouquet of bright green apples, fresh pear slices, and white peach, beautifully layered with fragrant underlays of honeysuckle and soft floral blossoms. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, fluid, and beautifully balanced, showcasing a juicy core of crisp orchard fruits and zesty citrus oils. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy, a refreshing backbone of natural acidity, and a creamy, approachable effervescence. The mouthfeel is soft, clean, and remarkably supple, driving into a crisp, off-dry finish that leaves a lingering, mouthwatering impression of sweet citrus pith and clean minerality.

title: Gerard Raphet Charmes Chambertin 2014 - 1.5 Litre - 3 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from France, specifically from the Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru appellation within the village of Gevrey-Chambertin in the Côte de Nuits region of Burgundy. Domaine Gérard Raphet is a small, family-run estate based in Morey-Saint-Denis, now in its fourth generation with Gérard's daughter, Marion, taking an active role in winemaking. The winery's philosophy is rooted in traditional, low-intervention methods, letting their exceptionally old vines—some over 100 years old—express the unique limestone-rich terroir of each parcel.

Wine Description

Gérard Raphet Charmes-Chambertin 2014 displays a delicate, translucent ruby colour in the glass. The nose is aromatic and surprising in its intensity, offering a complex bouquet of red berries, wild strawberry, and cranberry jam layered with warm baking spices and subtle floral notes. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, supple, and suave, featuring red cherry and cinnamon flavours that carry a deceptively forceful intensity. It is characterized by its elegant, almost creamy texture and a refined finish supported by fine-grained tannins. This 100% Pinot Noir typically has an ABV of 13.5% and was fermented with indigenous yeasts before ageing for 18 months in older French oak barrels, with no more than 15% new wood. The vineyards are predominantly managed according to organic principles, though they are not formally certified. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is generally through 2028-2034.

Food Pairing

The refined tannins and vibrant fruit profile of this Grand Cru make it a sophisticated partner for traditional French and delicately spiced dishes. It pairs perfectly with roast pork, poultry such as chicken or roast pheasant, and feathered game in wine-based sauces. Its spicy undertones also complement roast lamb with gravy, rib steak, and earthy dishes like rabbit stew or mushroom-based recipes. For cheese, it pairs well with soft-centred varieties like Epoisses or Camembert.

Vintage Quality

The 2014 vintage in the Côte de Nuits is noted for its classical Burgundian profile, characterized by even ripening conditions that allowed for vibrant fruit expression and balanced acidity. While a hailstorm in June affected yields in some areas, the surviving fruit produced wines with great aromatic precision and a refined structure that emphasizes terroir over power.

title: Robert Mondavi Cabernet Sauvignon 'The Reserve' To Kalon Vineyard 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'authoritative' red wine originates from the United States, within the highly celebrated Oakville AVA of the central Napa Valley floor. As the historic flagship of the estate, "The Reserve" honors the pioneering vision of Robert Mondavi, who founded his namesake winery in 1966 with the explicit dream of creating Napa Valley wines that would stand proudly alongside first-growth Bordeaux. Sourced exclusively from the grand cru-caliber To Kalon Vineyard situated on the prime alluvial benchland of west Oakville the property operates under a philosophy of strict terroir precision. The vineyard's low-fertility, well-drained gravel soils force the deeply rooted vines to naturally restrict their yields, resulting in fruit of uncommon depth, density, and structural longevity.

Wine Description

The 2022 Robert Mondavi 'The Reserve' To Kalon Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon presents an opaque, deep ruby appearance with a dark, concentrated core in the glass. Its sensory profile is layered and classic, opening with an expressive bouquet of ripe black cherries, fresh wild berries, cassis, and sweet plum, beautifully interwoven with dried sage, tarragon, violet petals, and loam. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, concentrated, and relaxed at first sip, seamlessly expanding to showcase rich flavors of black currant compote, cinnamon, and dark chocolate. It is characterized by an outstanding structural balance, showing a surprisingly crisp natural acidity (pH 3.67) that imparts vital freshness and lift against the wine's rich power. The mouthfeel is substantial yet velvety, driven by pronounced, fine-grained tannins that resolve into a lengthy, persistent finish detailed by lingering notes of sweet vanilla, forest floor, cedar, and smoky tobacco leaf.

title: Robert Mondavi Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 - 60th Anniversary Limited Edition
bodyHtml:
This structured and commemorative red wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Napa Valley region of California. Officially released as the "Maestro - 60th Anniversary Limited Edition," this special, one-off wine celebrates six decades since Robert Mondavi founded his iconic estate in 1966. The 2023 vintage coincides with the winery's grand reopening following a major multi-year transformation and the unveiling of their state-of-the-art, gravity-flow To Kalon Cellar. The winery operates under Mondavi's original founding philosophy—positioning Napa Valley on the global stage by marrying old-world precision with new-world innovation. To honor this legacy, the winemaking team created this singular expression by blending fruit from the estate's two original, historic vineyard blocks: To Kalon in Oakville and Wappo Hill in the Stags Leap District.

Wine Description

The 2023 Robert Mondavi 60th Anniversary Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep and inviting dark crimson appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is plush and aromatic, opening with an expressive bouquet of ripe raspberries, black cherries, blueberries, and crème de cassis, layered with complex undertones of dried herbs, sweet graham cracker, and a distinct line of minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and concentrated, seamlessly showcasing savory depth alongside juicy red berry and cranberry flavors. It is characterized by an outstanding freshness and a vibrant backbone of acidity that balances the wine's natural power, driving into a lengthy finish supported by rich, finely grained, and beautifully polished tannins.

This collectible bottling is made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, utilizing the exact same heritage clones that have been cultivated on the estate plots since its inception. The wine draws structure, textural richness, and dark fruit depth from the alluvial soils of the To Kalon vineyard, while the Wappo Hill component lends brightness, elegance, and a lifted red-fruit perfume. It reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 15%. Vinification took place in the estate's advanced cellar, allowing for meticulous, small-lot fermentations before the wine was matured in premium French oak barrels. While the property practices precision agricultural management across its celebrated blocks, this specific commemorative bottling is not certified organic.

title: Giodo Rosso di Montalcino 2024
bodyHtml:
Giodo Rosso di Montalcino is an exceptional red wine from Italy, produced within the renowned region of Tuscany and the specific subregion of Montalcino. Podere Giodo was founded by the celebrated oenologist Carlo Ferrini, who established the estate as a personal tribute to his parents, Giovanna and Donatello.

Wine Description

This wine displays a brilliant ruby red colour in the glass. On the nose, it delivers a fine, highly fragrant bouquet of mature cherry, raspberry, and wild strawberry, layered with elegant floral hints of violet, sweet spices, and delicate earthy undertones. The medium-bodied palate is wonderfully smooth and free flowing, showcasing a vibrant freshness and seamlessly integrated tannins that provide superb balance and drinkability. It culminates in a clean, savoury finish that echoes persistent notes of red fruits and spice.

title: Barbi Brunello Di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
Fattoria dei Barbi is a historic estate with family winemaking roots in Montalcino that span back to 1352. The estate has been producing classic expressions of Brunello since 1892, maintaining an extensive archive of almost every vintage in their cellars. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on honouring tradition and showcasing the authentic, terroir-driven identity of the region.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a brilliant ruby red colour with subtle garnet highlights. The intense aroma features notes of sour cherry, blue flower, wild herbs, and a touch of toasted spice and cedar shavings. On the palate, it is full bodied, dense, and well structured, displaying tart red berry fruits, savoury minerality, and fine, tightly woven tannins. The finish is long and polished, lingering with hints of balsamic and crushed herbs.

title: Checkmate Chardonnay 'Attack' 2021
bodyHtml:
This exceptional wine originates from Canada, specifically from the premier Okanagan Valley region in British Columbia. CheckMate Artisanal Winery, part of Anthony von Mandl's Iconic Wineries of British Columbia, was built on the bold ambition to craft New World Chardonnay and Merlot capable of standing alongside the best in the world. Located on the prestigious Golden Mile Bench, the winery’s philosophy centres on precision, patience, and place, combining meticulously managed estate vineyards with Old World Burgundian techniques to let the distinct Okanagan terroir shine through.

Wine Description

In the glass, Attack Chardonnay presents a pale gold colour, offering an alluring nose of freshly sliced peach, golden apple, and mandarin orange intertwined with an offbeat combination of lemon curd, toasted fennel seeds, and an underlying marine sea salt aroma. Sourced from fruit across four south Okanagan vineyards—including the Jagged Rock and Border Vista vineyards—this 100% Chardonnay is uniquely cofermented and aged for 16 months in two large French oak foudres. This restrained oak exposure crafts a disciplined, full-bodied palate that balances concentrated stone fruit and citrus flavours with a vibrant mineral tension and a textured, creamy mouthfeel.

title: San Guglielmo Brunello Di Montalcino 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'artisanal' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation of Tuscany. Cantina San Guglielmo is a highly regarded, boutique micro-estate operating under a strict winemaking philosophy that prioritizes small-scale precision, deep environmental respect, and site transparency. Boasting a minuscule footprint of just one hectare dedicated exclusively to Brunello production, the winery embodies the proud, minimalist spirit of artisanal craftsmanship. The vines are rooted in a premium, sun-drenched collinare (hillside) terroir, where the natural interplay of maritime winds and well-exposed slope orientations yields a Sangiovese of exceptional stylistic clarity, unaffected by high-volume industrial intervention.

Wine Description

The 2019 San Guglielmo Brunello di Montalcino presents a brilliant, intense ruby red color in the glass with luminous garnet reflections shimmering at the rim. Its sensory profile is remarkably pure, elegant, and high-toned, opening with a beautifully traditional and multi-faceted bouquet of violets, fresh iris blossoms, and wild red berries, layered with delicate undertones of sweet spices, cedar shavings, and small red fruits preserved sotto spirito (in alcohol). On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, linear, and meticulously focused, showcasing an incredibly sincere, fruit-forward core of sour red cherries, mandarin juice, and under-ripe wild strawberries. It is characterized by its outstanding acid-to-tannin balance and an incisive backbone of vertical freshness. The mouthfeel is sleek and relaxed rather than over-extracted, driven by fine-grained, grainy tannins that glide effortlessly into a clean, well-balanced finish highlighted by an invitingly dry fruit presence and savory spice tones.

This authentic, dry red expression is crafted entirely from 100% Sangiovese (specifically selected clones of Sangiovese Grosso). Hand-harvested with extreme precision on October 9th to maximize phenolic development, the fruit underwent a careful, traditional skin maceration and temperature-controlled fermentation in the cellar. Following a complete malolactic conversion to soften its mineral edges, the wine was aged according to the region's strict disciplinary codes for multiple years in a combination of traditional wood formats to seamlessly knit its structural components together, followed by extensive bottle refinement. It reaches a classic, well-contained alcohol content (ABV) of 14.0%. True to the estate's hands-on, micro-boutique values, the blocks are managed with a deep conviction that the land must be listened to, prioritizing low-intervention, environmentally respectful viticulture.

title: Domaine Michel Gros Hautes Cotes De Nuits Au Vallon 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'vibrant' red wine originates from France, within the Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Nuits A.O.C. appellation of Burgundy. Produced by the legendary Domaine Michel Gros a historic and highly revered estate based in Vosne-Romanée this cuvée represents a masterclass in capturing the cool-climate freshness of Burgundy’s high-altitude hillsides. The Gros family has been cultivating vines in the Côte de Nuits since 1830. Operating under a winemaking philosophy of classic purity and meticulous parcel selection, Michel Gros and his son Pierre craft "Au Vallon" from a unique, southeast-facing amphitheater vineyard site (lieu-dit) near the village of Marey-lès-Fussey. Here, the vines are rooted in a rocky, limestone-heavy terroir that shields them from harsh northern winds, allowing the fruit to develop exceptional aromatic definition.

Wine Description

The 2023 Domaine Michel Gros Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Nuits "Au Vallon" presents a brilliant, clear, and pale ruby appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, perfumed, and high-toned, opening with a captivating bouquet of wild strawberries, sour red cherries, and fresh cranberries, beautifully layered with distinct undertones of potpourri, crushed rose petals, and a delicate touch of wood spice. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, vibrant, and beautifully focused, showcasing a crunchy core of sweet and tart red summer fruits. It is characterized by its outstanding, mouthwatering natural acidity and a chalky, mineral drive. The mouthfeel is sleek and neatly structured, driven by fine-grained, well-integrated tannins from used oak that carry into a long, clean finish highlighted by an acidic crunch of red fruit and a touch of savory earth.

This classic, dry red expression is crafted from 100% Pinot Noir. The fruit was entirely hand-harvested at optimal maturity and underwent a gentle destemming followed by traditional temperature-controlled fermentation in the cellar to protect the primary fruit integrity. To round out its structural matrix while preserving its signature high-toned freshness, the wine completed malolactic fermentation and was matured for several months in a combination of used French oak barriques and neutral vessels, avoiding heavy new oak extraction. It reaches a balanced, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of approximately 13.0%. Reflecting the producer's environmental commitment, the estate manages its vineyard blocks under precise sustainable viticultural standards.

title: Instant Becot Bordeaux Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and 'modern' red wine originates from France, within the regional Bordeaux AOC appellation. "Instant Bécot" is the highly dynamic, approachable lifestyle cuvée produced by the legendary Bécot family, the prestigious owners of the iconic Saint-Émilion Premier Grand Cru Classé "Château Beau-Séjour Bécot." Operating under a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes immediate pleasure, juicy fruit freshness, and site transparency, the family crafts this wine as an inviting introduction to the right-bank style. The grapes are carefully sourced from select, quality-driven clay-limestone and silty-clay parcels across the right bank of the Dordogne, offering an elegant snapshot of Bordeaux craftsmanship without requiring years of patient cellaring.

Wine Description

Instant Bécot Bordeaux Rouge presents a bright, deep ruby appearance in the glass with shimmering violet glints at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, expressive, and fruit-forward, opening with an inviting bouquet of ripe red cherries, wild strawberries, and black plums, beautifully layered with fragrant underlays of fresh violets, a touch of licorice, and a delicate hint of sweet spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, fluid, and beautifully balanced, showcasing a succulent, juicy core of crunchy summer berries and dark plums. It is characterized by its outstanding freshness and a vibrant backbone of natural acidity that cuts through the fruit's natural generosity. The mouthfeel is remarkably supple and rounded, driven by silky, well-integrated tannins that carry into a clean, smooth, and dry finish highlighted by lingering notes of red currant zest and a subtle hint of savory earth.

title: Domaine Michel Gros Gevrey Chambertin 'La Platiere' 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'refined' red wine originates from France, within the world-renowned Gevrey-Chambertin A.O.C. appellation of Burgundy's prestigious Côte de Nuits. While Domaine Michel Gros is historically anchored and most famous for its iconic monopolies in Vosne-Romanée, the family has expanded its mastery to the more muscular northern terroirs of Gevrey-Chambertin. Under the current direction of Pierre Gros, who operates with ready counsel from his legendary father Michel, the estate follows a winemaking philosophy that values classic site transparency, sleek fruit elegance, and long-term structural balance. The "La Platière" cuvée is sourced from a single, distinct vineyard block located on the lower slopes of the appellation, where the vines grow in well-drained, limestone-heavy marls and stony soils that naturally yield a Pinot Noir combining Gevrey’s traditional burliness with the domain’s signature silky finesse.

Wine Description

The 2023 Domaine Michel Gros Gevrey-Chambertin "La Platière" presents a deep, clear ruby-red appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is wonderfully elegant, complex, and high-toned, opening with an expressive bouquet of ripe black cherries, red raspberries, and wild bramble berries, beautifully layered with fragrant underlays of fresh violets, lilac, sweet spices, and a gently savory, peaty earthiness. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, deep, and precisely focused, showcasing a sappy and succulent core of dark summer fruits and sweet blueberries. It is characterized by its outstanding structural balance, showing excellent freshness and a lively backbone of racy, mineral acidity that highlights its classic regional typicity. The mouthfeel is sleek and satin-smooth on the entry before revealing a fine, muscular grip, driven by powdery, dusty tannins that carry into a long, dusty, and youthfully austere finish accented by toasty French oak barrel spices and a lingering hint of licorice.

This authentic, dry red expression is crafted from 100% Pinot Noir and reached a well-balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 14.0%. The grapes were entirely hand-harvested at optimal physiological maturity in mid-September. In the cellar, the fruit underwent a meticulous sort followed by a gentle, traditional fermentation using native yeasts in temperature-controlled vats to preserve primary fruit intensity. After completing malolactic fermentation, the wine was matured for several months in premium French oak barrels, carefully utilizing a measured proportion of new wood to subtly enhance the structural matrix and add a toasty framework without overshadowing the terroir or raw varietal character of the single plot.

title: Fratelli Alessandria 'Monvigliero' Barolo 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'ethereal' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Barolo D.O.C.G. appellation of the northern Piedmont region. Fratelli Alessandria is a historic, deeply respected family estate located in the village of Verduno, tracing its commercial winemaking roots all the way back to 1830. Under the current, precision-focused stewardship of Vittore Alessandria, the family operates under a classic, low-intervention winemaking philosophy to highlight site-specific clarity. The "Monvigliero" vineyard is universally revered as the absolute crown jewel, undisputed Grand Cru of Verduno, and one of the most distinctive terroirs in the entire Barolo zone. The heritage vines are rooted in a unique geological matrix of limestone-heavy, chalky white marls (Marnes di Sant'Agata) mixed with veins of silt, where the vineyard’s distinct amphitheater shape acts as a sun trap while capturing cooling alpine breezes to focus an unmatched aromatic verticality.

Wine Description

The 2021 Fratelli Alessandria 'Monvigliero' Barolo presents a translucent, luminous ruby-garnet appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, complex, and high-toned, opening with an intense, beautifully layered bouquet of fresh-crushed wild cherries, strawberry preserves, and orange peel, seamlessly woven with Monvigliero's signature aromatic markers of white pepper, alpine herbs, dried rose petals, and sweet tobacco leaf. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, tense, and beautifully balanced, showcasing a concentrated and fleshy core of crunchy red fruits, dark plum extracts, and black cardamom. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a vibrant backbone of limestone-driven acidity. The mouthfeel is wonderfully sleek and transparent, driven by firm, fine-grained, and silky tannins that frame its ethereal texture before gliding into a remarkably long, savory, and chalky finish highlighted by a distinct salty streak and lingering notes of cedar wood spice.

This pristine, high-definition expression is crafted from 100% Nebbiolo sourced entirely from the family's 1.4-hectare holding within the iconic Monvigliero cru. Following a meticulous manual harvest in October, the fruit underwent traditional, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks with extended skin contact to extract fine tannins. To preserve the raw purity of the site and allow for slow micro-oxygenation, the wine completed malolactic conversion and was matured for approximately 3 years in traditional, large 20-to-40 hectoliter Slavonian and French oak casks (botti). It rested for an additional 2 months in stainless steel and a minimum of 6 months in horizontally laid bottles prior to commercial release, reaching a well-balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 14.0%. Reflecting the estate's artisanal values, the blocks are sustainably managed using certified organic farming practices.

title: Armand Heitz Mersault 'Porusots' Premier Cru 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from France, within the prestigious Meursault Premier Cru A.O.C. appellation of Burgundy's famed Côte de Beaune. Armand Heitz who initially turned heads under the family's historic "Heitz-Lochardet" label before transitioning to his eponymous domain is one of the most dynamic and revolutionary vignerons of the modern era. Operating under a deep winemaking philosophy of agroecology and absolute terroir transparency, Heitz treats the vineyard as a holistically balanced ecosystem, implementing polyculture, livestock integration, and strict biodynamic practices across his parcels. The "Les Porusots" (often simply called Porusots) Premier Cru sits on the mid-slope of Meursault, nestled between Les Bouchères and Les Genevrières. Here, the fractured Jurassic limestone and heavy, clay-rich topsoils naturally yield a Chardonnay that seamlessly balances the classic opulent richness of the village with a pulsing, chiseled mineral drive.

Wine Description

The 2020 Armand Heitz Meursault "Porusots" Premier Cru presents a brilliant, deep straw-gold appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, deep, and high-toned, masterfully capturing the intense solar concentration of the legendary 2020 white Burgundy vintage. The bouquet opens with a captivating, multi-faceted display of confit lemons, ripe yellow orchard fruits, and fresh white peach, beautifully layered with classic autolytic notes of warm brioche, roasted hazelnuts, liquid honey, and an underlying streak of wet-stone flintiness. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, compact, and texturally rich, showcasing a deep, concentrated core of citrus curd and fleshy stone fruits. It is characterized by an outstanding structural balance, maintaining an uncommonly fresh, vibrant backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly slices through its decadent texture. The mouthfeel is broad and expansive, showing a subtle, creamy weight from lees contact before driving into a remarkably long, savory, and dry finish highlighted by an intense limestone-driven salinity and beautifully integrated French oak barrel spices.

title: Pio Cesare Chardonnay 'Piodilei' 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Italy, within the Langhe D.O.C. appellation of the premium Piedmont region. Pioneered by the legendary Pio Cesare estate a historic benchmark house founded in 1881 in the city of Alba this bottling represents a revolutionary milestone in Italian white viticulture. First conceived by the visionary Pio Boffa and released with the 1985 vintage, "Piodilei" (translating to "Pio for her") was crafted as a dedicated tribute to the strong-willed, resolute women of the family. At a time when Piedmont was almost exclusively dedicated to historic red Nebbiolo production, the estate boldy sought to prove that the high-elevation, limestone-heavy terroirs of the Langhe could produce a world-class white wine with the body, complexity, and profound structural longevity of a great Grand Cru Burgundy.

Wine Description

The 2023 Pio Cesare 'Piodilei' Chardonnay presents a brilliant, intense straw-yellow color in the glass detailed by youthful greenish reflections. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, deep, and high-toned, opening with a bold, multi-faceted bouquet of baked orchard fruits, honeysuckle, and lemon zest, seamlessly layered with fragrant notes of roasted hazelnut, vanilla bean, warm brioche, and a distinct line of flinty mineral smoke. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, compact, and texturally rich, showcasing a solid, concentrated core of juicy golden apples, lemon curd, and cream. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a vibrant backbone of crisp natural acidity that perfectly defines the wine's rich, buttery phenolic stuffing. The mouthfeel is sleek, expansive, and slightly oily, driven by a light, chalky mineral tension that carries into a remarkably long, savory finish highlighted by a saline crunch, delicate baking spices, and beautifully integrated French oak wood.

This precise white expression is crafted from 100% Chardonnay, sourced from low-yielding, heritage estate plots occupying the coolest, highest exposures in the Langhe:

  • Il Bricco Vineyard (Treiso): Located in the heart of the Barbaresco zone, where the family's oldest Chardonnay blocks were originally planted in 1981, bringing deep minerality and chiseled definition.

  • Mosconi Vineyard (Monforte d'Alba): A prestigious, high-elevation Barolo location introduced to the blend in 2019 to provide muscle, golden fruit weight, and texturing pressure.

The fully ripened grapes were hand-harvested at optimal physiological maturity. Following a gentle pneumatic pressing, the juice initiated alcoholic fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats before being transferred to finish fermentation inside French oak barriques (one-third brand new with a delicate, light toast). The wine completed a full malolactic conversion to soften its alpine edges and was matured sur lies with extensive lees contact for 8 months in the barrels to develop its signature creamy roundness. Bypassing any heavy, oxidative over-extraction, the wine reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5% and was finished bone-dry with a minimal residual sugar content of 1.11 g/L. It was matured for an additional 9 months in horizontally laid bottles prior to commercial release.

title: Gaja Ca Marcanda 'Camarcanda' 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Bolgheri D.O.C. appellation on the sun-drenched Tuscan coast. The legendary Gaja family the ultimate masters of Piedmontese Barbaresco ventured south in 1996 when patriarch Angelo Gaja established the Ca'Marcanda estate in Castagneto Carducci. The property's name translates in Piedmontese dialect to the "house of endless negotiations," a humorous nod to the exhausting, years-long meetings required to purchase the land from its previous owners. Operating under a winemaking philosophy that strives for strict "Italian-ity" emphasizing absolute precision, clarity, and minimalist oak masking—this eponymous flagship cuvée represents the absolute quality pinnacle of the estate. The old heritage vines are rooted in a complex terroir matrix split between terre bianche (calcareous white soils rich in limestone, marl, and stones) and terre brune (darker, iron-and-clay-rich deposits), which work together to infuse the international grapes with a distinctly Italian, saline mineral depth.

Wine Description

The 2023 Ca'Marcanda 'Camarcanda' Bolgheri Rosso presents a vibrant, youthful medium ruby-red appearance with bright glints illuminating the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, layered, and high-toned, offering a beautiful departure from hotter, more monolithic years toward a style defined by sheer finesse. The bouquet opens with a captivating display of fresh redcurrants, sour cherries, and crunchy rhubarb, seamlessly woven with complex underlays of liquid violets, juniper berry, sandalwood, and fresh wild herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, harmonious, and remarkably plush, showcasing a juicy, perfectly balanced core of pure red fruit and subtle baking spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an even, refreshing backbone of natural acidity that lends underlying tension without ever letting the fruit feel heavy. The mouthfeel is soft, velvety, and seamlessly textured, driven by fine, remarkably well-integrated tannins that carry into a long, precise finish marked by a distinctive, salty volcanic mineral backbone typical of premium Bolgheri maritime clay.

title: Pepperwood Grove Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'approachable' red wine originates from the United States, representing a highly successful "internationally styled" value tier managed under the California-based Don Sebastiani & Sons portfolio. Operating under a winemaking philosophy focused on creating true crowd-pleasing, immediate-pleasure everyday bottles, Pepperwood Grove scours premier growing regions to secure expressive, ripe fruit. While headquartered in Sonoma, California, the sourcing strategy for this popular Cabernet Sauvignon is dynamic and multi-regional frequently blending excellent fruit from California’s sun-drenched Central Valley sub-appellations, such as Lodi and Clarksburg, alongside meticulously contracted parcels from Chile’s prestigious Valle Central. This deliberate geographical cross-blending ensures a dependable flavor profile combining California’s signature plush, fruit-forward opulence with South America's bright varietal acidity.

Wine Description

The Pepperwood Grove Cabernet Sauvignon presents a clear, dark ruby and garnet color in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, fruit-forward, and inviting, opening with a bold, fragrant bouquet of ripe blackberries, black plums, and red currants, beautifully layered with comforting undertones of dark chocolate, sweet mocha, and toasted coconut. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, smooth, and easily approachable, showcasing a juicy core of sweet black cherries, raspberry jam, and a touch of fresh fig. It is characterized by its outstanding drinkability, featuring moderate, mouth-friendly natural acidity that lends a refreshing lift to the fruit. The mouthfeel is soft, rounded, and remarkably supple, driven by light, completely un-astringent tannins that flow gently into a clean, smooth finish highlighted by a delicate hint of sweet leather, vanilla, and a pinch of dried savory herbs like sage.

title: G4 Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
G4 Tequila Reposado is an aged artisanal spirit originating from the Highland region of Los Altos in Jalisco, Mexico. The brand is produced at the renowned El Pandillo distillery (NOM 1579) under the ownership of the Camarena family, who represent a century-long, fourth-generation legacy of traditional tequila fabrication. Master Distiller Felipe Camarena is celebrated for combining deeply traditional methods with custom-engineered, eco-friendly distillery innovations.

Spirit Description

G4 Reposado is made from 100% estate-grown blue Weber agave cooked in traditional stone ovens for at least 22 hours. Instead of using a traditional volcanic stone wheel, the agave is crushed by a custom-built mechanical shredder nicknamed 'Felipestein'. The defining element of G4 is its water source: it is proofed using a unique 50/50 blend of collected rainwater and natural spring water, capturing a pure Highland terroir.

  • Colour: Beautiful, bright golden hue, indicating gentle aging in oak barrels.

  • Aroma: Complex and beautifully balanced. The nose reveals aromas of cooked agave, vanilla, citrus, and light oak, alongside delicate herbal notes and a touch of baking spice.

  • Palate: Rich, velvety, and smooth on the entry. It delivers a harmonious balance of sweet cooked agave and peppery warmth, complemented by toasted nuts, light butterscotch, grapefruit, and a whisper of cinnamon.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a soft, rounded mouthfeel that provides an approachable viscosity without masking the underlying spirit architecture.

  • Finish: Light yet lingering and smooth, closing with a pleasant warmth of gentle oak, trailing agave sweetness, and lingering spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Chateau Calon Segur 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'authoritative' red wine originates from France, within the historic Saint-Estèphe A.O.C. appellation on Bordeaux’s Left Bank. Classified as a Troisième Cru (Third Growth) in the iconic 1855 Classification, Château Calon Ségur is the northernmost classified growth in the Médoc. The estate holds a uniquely romantic legacy rooted in the 18th-century declaration of its historic owner, Nicolas-Alexandre, the Marquis de Ségur: "I make wine at Laffite and Latour, but my heart belongs to Calon." This sentiment is permanently captured by the iconic heart design on its front label. Under the modern technical direction of Vincent Millet, the estate continues its classic winemaking philosophy that respects the naturally muscular, deep architectural framework of Saint-Estèphe, coaxing profound aromatic verticality and precise structural longevity from its entirely walled-in (enclos) vineyard block.

Wine Description

The 2021 Château Calon Ségur presents a deep, intense garnet-purple color in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, classical, and high-toned, offering a beautiful look back toward a traditional Left Bank paradigm. The bouquet opens with a captivating, multi-faceted display of fresh black currants, dark plums, and wild blackberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of crushed violets, pencil shavings, licorice, and a light touch of dark cocoa. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, compact, and precisely focused, showcasing a chiseled core of crunchy black and red orchard fruits.

title: G4 Tequila Blanco de Madera (90 Proof)
bodyHtml:
G4 Tequila Blanco Madera is a limited-edition, unaged artisanal spirit originating from the Highland region of Los Altos in Jalisco, Mexico. The brand is produced at the highly esteemed El Pandillo distillery (NOM 1579) in Jesús María under the stewardship of the Camarena family, who possess a fourth-generation legacy of traditional tequila production. Master Distiller Felipe Camarena created this groundbreaking expression to push the boundaries of texture and complexity by reintroducing ancestral production techniques.

Spirit Description

G4 Blanco Madera is made from 100% estate-grown blue Weber agave cooked in traditional stone ovens for at least 22 hours. Instead of using a traditional volcanic stone wheel, the agave is crushed by a custom-built mechanical shredder nicknamed 'Felipestein'. The defining element of G4 Madera is its unique fermentation process, which takes place entirely in 100% pine wood tanks rather than stainless steel. Additionally, it relies heavily on natural deep well water rather than the traditional rainwater blend used in standard G4 expressions.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and brilliantly clean.

  • Aroma: Fruity, rich, and intensely aromatic. The bouquet explodes with sweet cooked agave, crushed black pepper, and earthiness, beautifully woven into tropical fruits like pineapple and mango, fresh cut grass, mint, and lime zest.

  • Palate: Full, complex, and extraordinarily lively. The entry delivers concentrated bursts of sweet roasted agave, anise, and rich citrus fruit before transitioning into raw green pepper, wintergreen, jalapeño, and a subtle, rustic olive brine.

  • Body: Heavy-bodied, silky, and thick with an incredible natural oiliness from the pine wood fermentation that fully coats the mouth.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long, warming, and persistent, closing with a robust wave of cracked black pepper, deep mineral earthiness, and a lingering, clean agave sweetness.

  • ABV: Bottled at a bold and punchy 45% (90 Proof).

title: Golden Pheasant 500 ml - 20 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Golden Pheasant, known in its homeland as Zlatý Bažant, is Slovakia’s premier brewing ambassador and the country's most exported beer. Founded in 1969 in Hurbanovo, a southern Slovakian town chosen specifically for having the warmest climate and the best barley-growing soil in the region, the brewery was built to showcase the pinnacle of Eastern European lagering. Exported to North America under the literal English translation of its name, it is a premium Czech-style Bohemian Pilsner. Unlike Western macro-lagers that dilute their recipes with cheap adjunct grains, Golden Pheasant is a celebration of pure, old-world ingredients, resulting in a lager with exceptional depth, color, and European pedigree.

Beer Description

Golden Pheasant pours a brilliant, deep golden-yellow with bright flaxen highlights and a frothy, enduring white head that leaves tight webbing and intricate lacing on the glass.

Aroma: The nose is rich, classic, and heavily centered around raw ingredients. It leads with dominant notes of buttery, toasted bread and sweet pilsner malt, followed by a prominent, rustic bouquet of spicy, herbaceous noble hops. There is a nostalgic, slightly damp "dried autumn leaf" complexity in the background that is characteristic of traditional continental cellars.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a remarkably smooth, velvety, and rounded mouthfeel. It leads with a distinct wave of honeyed cracker and bready malt sweetness, which provides a much heavier backbone than standard commercial lagers. This sweetness is quickly cut by a firm, refreshing middle of lemon citrus zest, ending with a long, dry, and clean finish marked by a pleasant, fading hop bite.

Profile: It sits at a balanced 4.7% to 5.0% ABV (depending on regional export variances) and a structured bitterness of approx. 24 IBU, offering a robust, full-flavored harmony.

Technical Notes: The brewery pridefully adheres to a 100% local barley malt philosophy, sourcing all grains from their own Hurbanovo malthouse—the largest and most advanced facility of its kind in Central Europe. It is brewed using pure local artesian water and authentic European noble hops. Following primary fermentation with a specialized bottom-fermenting lager yeast, the beer undergoes a strict 20 to 30-day cold maturation phase (lagering) at near-freezing temperatures. This long rest allows the yeast to drop out entirely, clarifying the beer naturally and smoothing out any harsh tannins to deliver its signature clean profile.

title: Mollydooker Velvet Glove Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'unapologetically opulent' red wine originates from Australia, within the highly celebrated McLaren Vale region of South Australia. Mollydooker a colloquial Australian term for a left-handed person was founded in 2005 by the dynamic winemaking duo Sarah and Sparky Marquis. Operating under a bold winemaking philosophy that prioritizes maximum flavor concentration and absolute structural density, Velvet Glove serves as the ultimate pinnacle of the estate's entire portfolio. The winery is famous for its proprietary "Marquis Fruit Weight" system, which measures the percentage of the palate covered by velvety fruit juices, and only grapes achieving a massive 95% to 100% score are selected for this luxury bottling. Rooted in the region's ancient, low-yielding soils, the old vines are exposed to warm daytime sun and cooling evening gully breezes from the nearby Mount Lofty Ranges, naturally concentrating the berries into a state of decadent intensity.

Wine Description

The Mollydooker Velvet Glove Shiraz presents an opaque, ink-black appearance in the glass with concentrated, deep purple shades clinging to the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally deep, complex, and highly expressive, opening with a bold bouquet of crème de cassis, dark plum liqueur, and black currant preserves, seamlessly layered with fragrant notes of sweet vanilla bean, espresso, licorice, and a distinct hint of dark cocoa. On the palate, the wine is massively full-bodied, concentrated, and texturally rich, showcasing a luxurious, mouth-coating core of chocolate-covered cherries, blackberry purée, and spicy plum compote. It is characterized by an outstanding structural balance, maintaining an uncommonly fresh, vibrant backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its immense weight and stops it from feeling heavy. The mouthfeel is broad and velvety perfectly matching its namesake driven by remarkably soft, fine-grained, and supple tannins that glide into a near-endless, sweet-toned finish accented by lingering notes of toasted American oak barrel spices, anise, and a touch of savory earth.

title: Millebuis Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Millebuis Pinot Noir is a red wine from France, produced in the Côte Chalonnaise subregion of Burgundy. The wine is created by La Cave des Vignerons de Buxy, a cooperative winery established in 1931 by 98 pioneering winegrowers. Today, the cooperative represents 120 winegrowing families. The 'Millebuis' collection, which began in 2014, is made from individual vineyard plots to express the true essence and excellence of the Côte Chalonnaise terroirs. The vineyards are found in the form of small ‘islands’ between Chagny in the north and Saint-Gengoux-le-National in the south, featuring stony, shallow chalky-clay soil rich in limestone.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir has a deep purple or dark red core with black shaded edges. The aromatic profile is lifted, featuring dark cherry, redcurrant, strawberry, and dried herb notes. Other aromas mentioned across vintages include Morello cherry, liquorice, earth, spicy cedar, and a touch of vanilla.

The wine is medium-bodied to full in the mouth. The palate is full, rich, and well-balanced, with a juicy core of dark cherry and strawberry fruits. It is described as a delectable and expressive wine. The tannins are silky and well-balanced, though sometimes presenting as a touch rustic or chewy with a sturdy structure. The finish is earthy, with notes of vanilla, cedar, and spice. The wine is matured in a combination of new and 5-year-old barrels for 12 months. The ABV is 13.5%. This wine is suitable for drinking now but can be cellared for the next two to four years.

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir is a versatile red wine. Its fruit-driven and earthy profile makes it a good match for pizza, pasta, and roasted poultry like chicken or duck. Other suggested pairings include charcuterie, terrines, beef tartare, and fondue bourguignonne. For a more elevated match, consider serving it with chicken or pork in a cherry and port wine pan sauce.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Burgundy was considered a 'gift' for winemakers. The favourable weather conditions allowed for a straightforward growing season, enabling winemakers to produce wines of great quality and concentration. The resulting wines are often described as having a good balance of fruit and acidity.

title: Garzon Single Vineyard Albarino 2024
bodyHtml:
This exceptional white wine originates from the Maldonado region of Uruguay, situated just 11 miles from the Atlantic Ocean. Bodega Garzón is a pioneer in South American viticulture, led by the renowned Italian consultant winemaker Alberto Antonini, whose philosophy focuses on minimalist intervention and pure terroir expression. The "Single Vineyard" series is a step above their Reserva line, sourced from specific south-facing blocks with rocky, granite-rich soils that impart a signature salinity to the wine.

Wine Description

The Garzón Single Vineyard Albariño presents an elegant pale yellow colour with greenish reflections. The sensory profile is vibrant and precise, featuring an intense nose of mango, pineapple, and stone fruits (yellow plum), layered with sophisticated notes of citrus zest and white floral blossoms. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "round," showcasing a juicy acidity and a distinct saline minerality that reflects its coastal origin. It is characterized by its purity and "glassy" texture, leading to a long, refreshing finish with hints of ripe apricot and sea salt. This 100% Albariño has an ABV of 14% and was fermented and aged for 8 months in 80-hectoliter cement tanks to preserve its aromatic integrity and enhance mouthfeel without the influence of oak.

title: Gaja Ca'Marcanda Magari 2024
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine originates from Italy, within the renowned region of Tuscany and the prestigious subregion of Bolgheri. Ca Marcanda was founded in 1996 by the iconic Piedmontese vintner Angelo Gaja, who sought to apply his uncompromising standards to the unique coastal terroir of western Tuscany.

Wine Description

The Gaja Ca Marcanda Magari pours a youthful, saturated purple and red colour. The nose opens with a vibrant, layered bouquet featuring intense aromas of blackcurrant, graphite, blackberry, and violet, accented by a cooling mineral note. On the palate, it delivers a velvety texture and impressive concentration, showcasing complex flavours of dark berries, integrated oak, and a touch of savoury richness on the close. This full-bodied red leans beautifully into elegance and finesse rather than heavy weight, supported by well-defined tannins and a long, expressive finish.

title: Glenfarclas 21 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas 21 Year Old Single Malt is a prestigious expression originating from Scotland's famed Speyside region, specifically crafted in the heart of Ballindalloch. The Glenfarclas Distillery was established in 1836 and subsequently purchased by John Grant in 1865, beginning a legacy of independent, family-owned heritage that has spanned six generations. Adhering strictly to a philosophy of traditional Highland style craftsmanship, the distillery relies on direct-fired copper pot stills—some of the largest in Speyside—and an uncompromising commitment to long-term dunnage warehouse maturation primarily in European oak ex-Oloroso sherry casks.

Whisky Description

This single malt possesses a deep, amber gold appearance. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic and elegant, showing a rich tapestry of sherried fruit, tropical fruits, nutmeg, and almonds, alongside subtle undercurrents of citrus, fresh honey, and soft leather. The palate is full-bodied, round, and exceptionally balanced, gradually unfolding into deep flavours of toffee, dark fruits, warming baking spices, and a hint of vanilla cream. Made from 100% malted barley, it features a silky, substantive mouthfeel with zero sharp alcohol bite. The finish is remarkably long, smooth, and pleasant, offering a gentle, lingering dryness mixed with chocolate notes and trailing spice.

title: Domaine Michel Gros Hautes Cotes De Nuits 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'vibrant' red wine originates from France, within the Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Nuits A.O.C. appellation of Burgundy. Produced by the legendary Domaine Michel Gros a historic and highly revered estate based in Vosne-Romanée this cuvée represents a masterclass in capturing the cool-climate freshness of Burgundy’s high-altitude hillsides. The Gros family has been cultivating vines in the Côte de Nuits since 1830. Operating under a winemaking philosophy of classic purity and meticulous parcel selection, Michel Gros and his son Pierre craft this wine from a unique, southeast-facing amphitheater vineyard site (lieu-dit) named "Au Vallon" near the village of Marey-lès-Fussey. Here, the vines are rooted in a rocky, limestone-heavy terroir that shields them from harsh northern winds, allowing the fruit to develop exceptional aromatic definition.

Wine Description

The 2023 Domaine Michel Gros Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Nuits "Au Vallon" presents a brilliant, clear, and pale ruby appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, perfumed, and high-toned, opening with a captivating bouquet of wild strawberries, sour red cherries, and fresh cranberries, beautifully layered with distinct undertones of potpourri, crushed rose petals, and a delicate touch of wood spice. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, vibrant, and beautifully focused, showcasing a crunchy core of sweet and tart red summer fruits. It is characterized by its outstanding, mouthwatering natural acidity and a chalky, mineral drive. The mouthfeel is sleek and neatly structured, driven by fine-grained, well-integrated tannins from used oak that carry into a long, clean finish highlighted by an acidic crunch of red fruit and a touch of savory earth.

This classic, dry red expression is crafted from 100% Pinot Noir. The fruit was entirely hand-harvested at optimal maturity and underwent a gentle destemming followed by traditional temperature-controlled fermentation in the cellar to protect the primary fruit integrity. To round out its structural matrix while preserving its signature high-toned freshness, the wine completed malolactic fermentation and was matured for several months in a combination of used French oak barriques and neutral vessels, avoiding heavy new oak extraction. It reaches a balanced, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of approximately 13.0%. Reflecting the producer's environmental commitment, the estate manages its vineyard blocks under precise sustainable viticultural standards.

title: Hendricks Oasium Gin
bodyHtml:
Hendrick's Oasium is a premium, contemporary-style gin produced at the Hendrick's Gin Palace in Girvan, Scotland. Released in early 2025 as the 8th global expression from the brand's highly acclaimed Cabinet of Curiosities series, this limited-edition release was created by Master Distiller Lesley Gracie. The concept was inspired by a trek into a desert oasis (replete with a game of camel polo), motivating Gracie to translate the unexpected, refreshing lushness of desert-dwelling flora, cooling herbs, and sun-ripened fruits into a gin format.

Spirit Description

Oasium uses the traditional Hendrick's base—with its foundational distillation on Bennett and Carter-Head stills and core cucumber and rose infusion—and layers it with a secret, desert-inspired botanical matrix.

  • Colour: Clear and transparent.

  • Aroma: Highly aromatic, lush, and fruit-forward. It bursts open with tropical fruits like papaya, mango, and sweet peach, backed by orange marmalade, dusty elderflower, and an underlying piney juniper austerity.

  • Palate: Remarkably bold, juicy, and complex. Upfront flavors of guava nectar, pineapple, and lemon curd dominate the entry, followed by a mid-palate of prickly pear, dried dates, and coriander seed that provides a soft, white pepper-like note.

  • Body: Medium-bodied, texturized, and luscious, carrying an intensity that pushes the boundaries of standard gin profiles into a jammy, nectar-like category.

  • Finish: Moderately long and dry, tapering off with a distinctly green, savory character of tarragon and sagebrush paired with a bright burst of ruby red grapefruit.

  • ABV: Bottled at 43.4%

title: Kavalan Peatist Oloroso Sherry Cask Finish
bodyHtml:
Kavalan Peatist Oloroso Sherry Cask Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky is an exceptional world whisky produced in Yilan County in northeastern Taiwan. The distillery was built by Taiwan's King Car Group and released its first whisky in 2008, with its house style shaped in the early years by the late Dr. Jim Swan. The Peatist series was introduced to explore peated styles and unique character alongside the distillery's usual floral and fruity house character, adapted to the warm, humid subtropical climate that accelerates maturation.

Spirit Description

This single malt is distilled from premium European peated malt, adjusting the distillation cut points to preserve the smoke without losing the core fruit profile, and is matured entirely in select Oloroso sherry casks from Spain's Sherry Triangle. It is drawn from a single cask and bottled at natural cask strength without chill filtration or artificial colouring.

  • Colour: Mahogany dusk.

  • Aroma: Smoky peat weaves through tropical fruit, as pineapple and mango meld with buttery toffee, charcoal roasted plums, dark dried fruits, a hint of fresh herbs, ripe raisins, and figs. Alternatively, the nose has been noted for oily leather, an earthy tea blend, anise, grilled mango, light ash, and white pepper.

  • Palate: Citrus and buttery toffee open on the palate, layered with dried pineapple and mango, alongside savoury sweet black dates and candied plums that enrich the peat. Hints of wood, cinnamon, cloves, chocolate-covered raisins, chewy figs, and a delicate smoky barbecue tang add depth.

  • Body: Profoundly complex and harmonious, presenting a delicate tannic texture where the smoke supports rather than dominates the sherry driven core.

  • Finish: The finish is long and lingering, offering notes of chocolate, coffee, nuts, dark leather, juicy cassis, and lightly roasted cocoa nibs.

  • ABV: Typically ranges between 50% and 59.9% depending on the specific single cask bottling.

Accolades

The expression has achieved legendary status at major global blind tasting competitions.

  • Whisky of the Year: Earning the top score of 96.97 points, it was crowned 'Whisky of the Year' and won the Golden Barrel Trophy at the International Whisky Competition in 2026.

  • Consecutive Victory: This victory marked a rare feat for Kavalan, securing the prestigious top honour two years in a row following its 2025 win with the Solist Fino Sherry expression.

  • Critical Acclaim: The competition directors praised the expression for distinguishing itself with exceptional depth, balance, and complexity.

Food Pairing

The intense fusion of light smoke, rich Oloroso sherry influence, and tropical fruit notes enables excellent versatility for pairing with food.

  • Savoury: The delicate smoky barbecue tang and earthy peat smoke of the spirit pair wonderfully with rich meats, cured charcuterie, or grilled duck breast.

  • Seafood: Its subtle ash and peat character make it an interesting companion for grilled scallops or smoked salmon, cutting through the richness of the seafood.

  • Cheese: Strong, salty cheeses like blue cheese or aged Gouda create a sophisticated balance against the sweet black dates, toffee, and dark chocolate elements of the dram.

  • Sweet: The rich flavours of candied plums, figs, raisins, and roasted cocoa nibs perfectly complement dark chocolate truffles, coffee infused desserts, or a warm fruit pudding.

  • Serving: It is best appreciated neat in a tulip or Glencairn glass at room temperature to experience its pure, unrestrained character, though a few drops of water can be added to ease the high cask strength and unlock hidden layers of spice and tropical fruit.

title: Cantina Tramin Gewurztraminer 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'exuberantly aromatic' white wine originates from Italy, within the mountainous Alto Adige D.O.C. (Südtirol) appellation of the northern Trentino-Alto Adige region. Cantina Tramin (Kellerei Tramin) a highly celebrated grower cooperative established in 1889 in the alpine village of Tramin (Termeno) is universally revered as the spiritual global benchmark for Gewürztraminer. In fact, the village of Tramin is the historic namesake birthright birthplace of the variety itself ("Traminer aromatico"). Under the visionary direction of long-time master winemaker Willi Stürz, the estate operates under a winemaking philosophy that marries intense mountain power with laser-focused alpine elegance, transforming a variety known for being heavy or unctuous into a masterclass of structural transparency and balance.

Wine Description

The Cantina Tramin Gewürztraminer presents a brilliant, intense straw-yellow color in the glass adorned with golden reflections. Its sensory profile is exceptionally expressive, perfumed, and high-toned, unfolding a signature, high-definition bouquet of freshly cut red roses, lychee, and ripe tropical fruits like mango and passion fruit, beautifully layered with fragrant underlays of sweet cloves, nutmeg, ginger, and a touch of wild honey. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, weighty, and texturally rich, showcasing a luxurious and fleshy core of yellow orchard fruits and citrus zest.

title: Far Niente Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Far Niente Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a luxury red wine from the heart of the Napa Valley AVA in California, United States. Established in 1885 by John Benson and beautifully restored in 1979 by Gil Nickel, Far Niente is a cornerstone of classic Napa excellence. The winery’s overarching philosophy emphasizes precision, house-style consistency, and a classic structural elegance modeled after the fine châteaux of Bordeaux. While the estate is historically celebrated for its estate-grown Oakville fruit, this regional Napa Valley bottling incorporates a seamless selection of premier fruit from Oakville, Rutherford, Calistoga, and St. Helena.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2023 vintage displays a deep, dark ruby-purple color. The nose is incredibly vibrant and polished, bursting with aromas of black cherry, cassis, and dark plum, underscored by sophisticated hints of graphite, potpourri, wet river stones, and toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, expansive, and generously textured. It unfolds in multi-layered waves of dark chocolate-dipped blackberries, spiced cherry, and a touch of bay leaf. Stylistically, it captures the signature Napa combination of rich power and striking tension, driven by juicy acidity and fine-grained, velvety tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: A precise blend of 92.6% Cabernet Sauvignon and 7.4% Petit Verdot.

  • Aging: Matured for 17 months in high-quality French oak barrels.

  • Optimal Drinking Window: Remarkably approachable upon release due to its supple nature, it is projected to drink beautifully through 2025 to 2045.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 96 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck – 95 points

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate – 94 points

Food Pairing

The wine's rich texture and vibrant acidity make it a natural match for premium cuts of grilled beef, such as a bone-in ribeye or filet mignon with black pepper butter. It also pairs exquisitely with roasted lamb shoulder with rosemary, duck breast with a dark cherry reduction, or a hearty wild mushroom risotto. For a classic finish, enjoy it alongside a charcuterie board featuring extra-aged Gouda or sharp, mature clothbound cheddar. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Napa Valley is widely heralded by critics as an absolute blockbuster and modern classic year. Following a rainy winter that replenished dry soils, the region experienced a remarkably cool, steady summer with virtually no extreme heat waves. This allowed for extended hang-time, allowing the fruit to build immense structural depth, complexity, and concentrated flavors while preserving an exceptionally bright, refreshing natural acidity. Far Niente utilized this text-book season to craft a Cabernet that balances immense concentration with stunning, refined detail.

title: Far Niente Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Far Niente Chardonnay 2024 is a benchmark luxury white wine from the Napa Valley AVA in California, United States. Since producing its first vintage of this variety in 1979, Far Niente has established itself as one of California’s absolute icons for premium Chardonnay. Sourced primarily from the cool, rolling hills of the Coombsville region—where the microclimate is heavily influenced by the morning fog of the San Pablo Bay—the estate aims to craft an elegant, complex wine that balances California richness with crisp structural length.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2024 vintage showcases a bright, straw-gold color. The nose is highly expressive and layered, opening with intense aromas of lemon confit, white peach blossom, and green apple, beautifully integrated with elegant hints of vanilla, oak spice, and warm pastry. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rounded, and phenolic, offering a creamy, luxurious texture layered with flavors of grilled citrus, pear, and melon. Stylistically, it epitomizes "American Chardonnay done right," skillfully avoiding a heavy, overly buttery profile by maintaining a striking, bright line of acidity and a mineral hint of wet stone that extends through a long, polished finish.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Winemaking: Notably, Far Niente famously does not undergo malolactic fermentation. This allows the estate to age the wine in high-quality French oak barrels to achieve a rich, creamy mouthfeel while perfectly preserving the grape's natural, racy acidity.

  • Optimal Drinking Window: Delightful and vibrant upon release, this structural vintage possesses the underlying power to evolve and soften gracefully in the cellar through 2026 to 2034.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 93 points

  • Wine Advocate – 92–94 points

  • Vinous – 92–33 points

  • Decanter – 92–93 points

Food Pairing

The wine’s harmonious balance of opulent texture and clean acidity makes it an exceptionally versatile companion at the dining table. It pairs flawlessly with high-end seafood dishes such as seared sea scallops in lemon-butter sauce, pan-fried trout, or a rich crab-stuffed corn chowder. It also pairs exquisitely with roasted poultry like tarragon chicken breast, or creamy seafood pasta. For a cheese course, its structure beautifully complements premium hard cheeses like aged Parmesan or Manchego. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 growing season in Napa Valley is considered highly promising and text-book for white varieties. A remarkably wet winter fully replenished the water tables, giving the vines an energetic start to the season. Although the spring was cooler than average, a warm and steady summer allowed for magnificent flavor accumulation and phenolic ripeness in the grapes. Coombsville's unique terroir protected the fruit from extreme afternoon heat spikes, allowing Far Niente to harvest Chardonnay boasting a spectacular core of rich fruit matched by a vibrant, life-giving freshness.

title: Far Niente Cabernet Sauvignon 'Post & Beam' 2023
bodyHtml:
Post & Beam Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a premium red wine that represents the more approachable, pure-expression sister label of the iconic Far Niente family of wineries. Named after the classic timber frames used to build traditional American barns, the Post & Beam label was launched to create artisanal, site-specific wines that require less cellaring than Far Niente’s flagship bottles. The winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the immediate fruit purity and structural balance of selection parcels across the Napa Valley.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2023 vintage displays a rich, vibrant ruby-purple color. The nose is highly expressive and forward, exuding an effusive perfume of wild raspberry preserves, black cherry, and black plum, wrapped in warm hints of clove and confectionery baking spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, broad, and ripe, featuring an easy, plush texture laced with soft, well-integrated tannins. Layers of cassis and bright red cherries are supported by fine leather, subtle botanical accents, and a lingering, satisfying finish carrying notes of toasted espresso beans.

  • Varietal Composition: A classic Napa blend consisting of 91% to 92% Cabernet Sauvignon, augmented by small percentages of Merlot, Malbec, and Petit Verdot.

  • Optimal Drinking Window: Designed intentionally for immediate accessibility, this wine is spectacular to drink now or can easily be kept in the cellar for the next 3 to 7 years.

title: Fondo Antico 'Bello Mio' Zibibbo 2024
bodyHtml:
This fragrant white wine originates from Italy, crafted in the Terre Siciliane appellation within the sun-drenched island region of Sicily. Produced by the Fondo Antico winery located near Trapani, the estate treats their vineyards with exceptional craftsmanship to showcase the unique qualities of native varieties. The winery focuses on a winemaking philosophy that captures the true essence of Sicily, aiming to offer an accessible and captivating glass of wine suitable for any occasion and every season.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Pale straw yellow adorned with clear, delicate greenish reflections.

  • Aroma: Highly expressive and aromatic on the nose, delivering vibrant scents of bitter orange, bergamot, and cedar, beautifully laced with floral notes of orange blossom, jasmine, and rosehip.

  • Palate: The palate mirrors its aromatic profile with accuracy, offering a flavorful and full sip that balances its distinct citrus notes with a deep, maritime sapidity and hints of green apple and fresh mint.

  • Body: Well-structured medium body with a highly pleasing presence.

  • Finish: A crisp, clean, and elegant finish driven by its inherent floral charm and balanced acidity.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Zibibbo, an indigenous aromatic grape variety grown at an altitude of 70 metres above sea level in clay-loam soils.

  • Stylistic Notes: Strikingly fresh and balanced, this wine undergoes gentle pressing and oxygen-free cryomaceration in stainless steel tanks, followed by four to five months of aging on the fine lees with regular bâtonnage to acquire its sophisticated texture.

  • Alcohol by Volume: 12.5%

  • Organic Status: Not certified organic, though some vintages are grown utilizing organic farming practices in the vineyard.

Food Pairing

  • Excellent as an informal aperitif alongside toasted almonds, potato crisps, or rich salads.

  • Ideal partner for raw seafood selections, including fresh sushi and sashimi.

  • Pairs wonderfully with grilled shellfish, cold plates, and delicate fish dishes.

title: Fondo Antico 'Per Te' Perricone 2023
bodyHtml:
This intriguing red wine hails from Italy, produced within the IGT Terre Siciliane appellation on the sun-drenched island region of Sicily. Crafted by the Fondo Antico winery based in the Trapani area, the estate dedicates this specific bottling to Sicily and its rich viticultural heritage. The family operates under a winemaking philosophy that seeks to revive and celebrate historic indigenous varieties, positioning this wine as a versatile, everyday companion meant to bring people together in any occasion.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Beautiful ruby red colour.

  • Aroma: The nose opens gracefully with fine notes of Mediterranean herbs, wild red berries, and ripe cherries, punctuated by subtle hints of spice, black pepper, and a touch of wild smokiness.

  • Palate: Soft, smooth, and enveloping on the palate, showing an approachable core of red fruit flavours integrated with a delicate balsamic touch and a light, earthy grip.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a pleasantly supple, well-rounded structure.

  • Finish: A balanced and persistent finish that carries a distinct streak of maritime sapidity.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Perricone, an ancient and historically overlooked native Sicilian grape variety that has been joyfully rediscovered by the estate.
