  • Stylistic Notes: Strikingly fresh and balanced, the wine undergoes controlled-temperature maceration on the skins for 10 to 12 days in stainless steel vats. It is subsequently aged entirely in stainless steel tanks and bottle to preserve its vibrant fruit profile and territorial character.

  • Alcohol by Volume: 13.5%

  • Organic Status: Not certified organic, but farmed with a deep respect for local agricultural traditions.

Food Pairing

  • Game dishes and assorted roasted or grilled meats.

  • Traditional Mediterranean cuisine featuring cooked vegetables or savory baked pasta.

  • Surprisingly versatile, it can also accompany rich, oily fish preparations seasoned with regional herbs.

title: Cabin Beer Everyday Lager 355 ml - 6 Cans
bodyHtml:
Everyday Lager is Cabin Brewing Company’s intentional step back from complex flavor wheels and resinous hop profiles. Marketed with the cheeky tagline "craft beer without the craft beer attitude," this American-style Lager was added to the Calgary brewery's lineup as the ultimate antidote to palate fatigue. While Cabin is legendary for its dense, fruit-forward haze bombs, Everyday Lager is built entirely for simplicity and approachable execution. It is unpretentious, highly refreshing, and designed to be the beer you reach for whether you are sitting on a lakeside dock or cleaning out your garage.

Beer Description

Everyday Lager pours an exceptionally pale, brilliant straw-yellow with crystal clarity and a lively, fast-moving carbonation that supports a clean, crisp white head.

Aroma: The nose is minimalist, clean, and gently grainy. It leads with dominant notes of sweet biscuit and pale malted barley, followed by a very faint, nostalgic hint of brewer's yeast. There are no heavy fruit esters or intense hop aromas; it smells exactly like a traditional, well-crafted cellar beer.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and incredibly refreshing with a snappy, effervescent mouthfeel. It leads with a mild bready sweetness, which is quickly balanced by a subtle, clean note of lemon citrus on the back end. The bitterness is kept remarkably low, allowing the flavor to vanish quickly from the tongue, leaving a dry, crisp finish.

Profile: It sits at a highly crushable 4.4% ABV and a gentle bitterness of 17 IBU, keeping things light and endlessly drinkable at just 121 calories per can.

Technical Notes: Unlike industrial macro-lagers that rely heavily on rice or corn to cut production costs, Cabin executes this with craft precision using high-quality pale malts and traditional lager yeast. It undergoes a standard cold-fermentation and patient lagering process to completely clean up any rough edges. The result is a highly attenuated, light lager that retains just enough cracker-like malt structure to satisfy a craft enthusiast while remaining entirely accessible to everyone.

title: Gergenti Frappato Organic Terre Siciliane 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and 'joyful' red wine originates from Italy, within the sun-drenched Terre Siciliane I.G.T. designation of Sicily. Produced under the Gergenti label by the Schenk Wine Group, this bottling serves as an approachable, highly authentic tribute to the island's unique native viticulture. Operating under a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes pure fruit expression and immediate charm, Gergenti utilizes low-intervention, certified organic farming techniques. The Frappato grape, historically treated as a minor blending component to add fragrance to bolder varieties like Nero d'Avola, is given center stage here to showcase the refreshing, cooler-climate verticality that can be achieved on the Mediterranean's largest island.

Wine Description

The Gergenti Organic Frappato presents a bright, translucent ruby-red color in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, aromatic, and perfumed, opening with an inviting bouquet of wild strawberries, cranberries, and fresh blueberries, beautifully layered with fragrant underlays of rose petals, red licorice, and a light touch of crushed black pepper. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, harmonious, and smooth, showcasing a juicy core of crunchy red summer fruits. It is characterized by its outstanding, mouthwatering natural acidity and low, soft tannin profile that mirrors the structure of a cool-climate Pinot Noir. The mouthfeel is sleek, fluid, and highly energetic, driving into a clean, fruit-driven finish highlighted by a delicate hint of savory spice and citrus rind.

This 100% Frappato wine reaches a well-balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 13.0%, preserving an elegant, approachable structure. To protect the grape's volatile, aromatic essential oils from the intense Sicilian sun, the clusters are carefully hand-harvested early in the season during the first weeks of August. The fruit undergoes a gentle, short maceration on the skins for 6 days in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats to extract its vibrant color without pulling bitter seed tannins. Following a complete malolactic fermentation in stainless steel to soften the palate, the wine is bottled fresh and aged for an additional month before commercial release, completely bypassing oak contact to maintain its pristine fruit transparency. Reflecting the estate's strict environmental standards, the fruit is 100% certified organic.

title: Kokanee 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml:
Kokanee is the quintessential "Glacier Fresh" lager of Western Canada. Launched in 1959 by the Columbia Brewery in Creston, British Columbia, it was named after the Kokanee Glacier that overlooks the Kootenay region. Known affectionately by locals as the "Sasquatch beer" due to its legendary advertising campaigns, Kokanee is a North American Pale Lager that leans heavily into mountain lifestyle culture. It is designed to be the ultimate crisp, thirst-quenching reward after a day on the slopes or by the lake engineered for maximum drinkability while retaining a distinct, smooth profile that sets it apart from its domestic macro-competitors.

Beer Description

Kokanee pours a brilliant, crystal-clear golden-straw color with an active, fast-rising stream of carbonation and a frothy white head that dissipates cleanly into a light collar.

Aroma: The nose is clean, light, and gently sweet. It leads with dominant notes of sweet corn husks and pale malted grain, followed by a faint, herbal whisper of Pacific Northwest hops. It has a notably fresh, "dewy" aroma with zero heavy yeast attributes or fruity esters.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a brisk, snappy, and highly refreshing mouthfeel. It leads with a distinct flash of bready cracker sweetness, which is quickly balanced by an ultra-low, smooth bitterness. The finish is remarkably clean and brief, vanishing from the tongue with a crisp, mineral-like dryness that mimics cold mountain water.

Profile: It sits at a standard, sessionable 5.0% ABV and a very mild bitterness of approx. 10–13 IBU, prioritizing smooth drinkability over hop intensity.

Technical Notes: The hallmark smoothness of Kokanee is achieved by brewing with a blend of malted barley and cereal adjuncts (such as corn) to lighten the body and crisp up the finish. Crucially, the brewery utilizes a blend of three different hop varieties harvested from the Pacific Northwest, adding just enough structural balance to cut through the malt sweetness without leaving a lingering bitter bite. The beer undergoes cold-filtration to ensure its signature clarity and pristine, unblemished flavor profile.

title: Bud Light 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml:
Bud Light is the undisputed titan of the global beer market and the world’s best-selling light lager. Introduced nationally in 1982 as a response to the growing demand for lower-calorie options, it was engineered with one goal in mind: maximum, effortless drinkability. It is a highly stabilized American Light Lager that strips away heavy malt richness and assertively bitter hop profiles in favor of a clean, cold, and entirely neutral refreshment.

Beer Description

Bud Light pours a brilliant, crystal-clear, ultra-pale straw-yellow with a vigorous stream of carbonation and a light white head that quickly settles into a thin rim.

Aroma: The nose is exceptionally clean, subtle, and minimalist. It leads with dominant notes of pale malted grain and sweet puffed rice, followed by a nearly imperceptible, faint trace of herbal hops. There are no fruity esters or heavy yeast characteristics; it smells entirely light, cold, and neutral.

Palate: On the tongue, it is very light-bodied with a highly effervescent, snappy, and watery mouthfeel. It leads with a delicate, brief flash of grainy cracker sweetness, which vanishes almost immediately. There is virtually zero perceived bitterness, leading to an incredibly short, clean, and fast finish that leaves no lingering aftertaste on the palate.

Profile: It sits at a highly sessionable 4.2% ABV and an ultra-low bitterness of just 6 IBU, keeping things extraordinarily light at 110 calories per 355 ml serving.

Technical Notes: The unmatched consistency and lightness of Bud Light rely on a highly calculated brewing process. It is brewed using a combination of two-row and six-row malted barley alongside rice as an adjunct. The rice is the secret weapon; it provides fermentable sugars to reach the desired alcohol content while keeping the body thin and removing the heavy, bready proteins inherent to pure barley. It undergoes a cold-aging process with beechwood chips; a signature Anheuser-Busch technique, which gives the yeast more surface area to settle out, yielding an ultra-attenuated, bright, and flawless final product.

title: Giodo Brunello Di Montalcino 'Pretto' 2021
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine originates from Italy, within the renowned region of Tuscany and the esteemed subregion of Montalcino. Podere Giodo is the creation of legendary winemaker Carlo Ferrini, and this specific 'Prètto' bottling represents a collaborative expression alongside his daughter, Bianca.

Wine Description

The Giodo Pretto Brunello di Montalcino displays a deep, brilliant ruby red colour in the glass. The nose is highly articulate and fragrant, unfurling expressive aromas of fresh roses, red cherries, blood orange, hibiscus, and crushed stones, complemented by fine Mediterranean herbs and a subtle touch of cedar. On the palate, the wine enters with a juicy, lively energy, showcasing a vibrant cascade of ripe red and blue fruits balanced by an ultra-fine, round tannic structure. It possesses a medium body that achieves superb depth without feeling heavy, offering a seamless harmony between freshness and complexity.

title: Merryvale XXXVI Napa Valley Red Wine
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red blend originates from the United States, specifically the renowned Napa Valley region in California. Founded in 1983, Merryvale Vineyards is inspired by the European sensibilities of its owners, René and Laurence Schlatter, who focus on capturing the power and concentration of Napa hillside vineyards. The winery's philosophy emphasizes managing tannins for approachability while ensuring the wines retain the elegance, bright acidity, and texture required to age gracefully.

Wine Description

Merryvale Profile XXXVI boasts a deep, rich red colour in the glass. The complex aroma offers a fascinating mixture of oak spice, balsam, cedar, nutmeg, roasted cherry, and dried raspberry, alongside savory sage. On the palate, this full bodied and concentrated blend reveals luscious layers of blackberry, cassis, blueberry, plum, licorice, and dark chocolate. The wine shows incredible structural balance, marrying its plush, refined texture with a refreshing acidity and fine-grained tannins that lead to a remarkably long, sophisticated finish.

title: Glenmorangie Harrison Ford Limited Edition
bodyHtml:
The Glenmorangie Distillery, located in Tain, has been crafting exceptional single malt scotch whisky since 1843. Renowned for possessing the tallest copper pot stills in Scotland, the distillery focuses on creating uniquely delicate and fruit-forward spirits. Under the innovative guidance of Director of Whisky Creation Dr Bill Lumsden, Glenmorangie continuously pushes boundaries by marrying traditional craftsmanship with pioneering cask experimentation.

Whisky Description

Glenmorangie Harrison Ford Limited Edition displays a vibrant sunset orange colour. The aroma is brim full of tangy, zesty citrus fruits and thick orange breakfast marmalade, beautifully lifted by perfumed floral notes of honeysuckle, jasmine, and a subtle hint of beeswax. On the palate, a lively and chewy mouthfeel delivers a distinctive, spirited kick with notes of Seville orange, grapefruit, apricot, muscovado sugar, and warm baking spices. The finish is medium to long, characterized by a curious, cooling mentholic note alongside lingering flavours of orange oil, leather, and dry oak tannin.

title: Kilchoman Maury Cask Matured
bodyHtml:
This exceptional single malt Scotch whisky originates from the rugged shores of Islay, Scotland. Established by the Wills family in 2005, Kilchoman is celebrated as a traditional farm distillery that manages the entire production process from growing barley to bottling on a single site. Their core philosophy relies on an uncompromising full term maturation process rather than short cask finishes, allowing the spirit to develop a deeply integrated and authentic character.

Whisky Description

Kilchoman Maury Cask Matured exhibits an incredible crimson red hue, a striking visual testament to its full maturation in ex Maury fortified wine casks from southern France. The nose opens with an aromatic bouquet of rich figs, raisins, and dates layered seamlessly alongside salted caramel, orange peel, and a gentle thread of peat smoke. On the palate, this full bodied spirit reveals sophisticated layers of dark chocolate, treacle, pipe smoke, and a warming complexity of black pepper and paprika spices. The finish is remarkably long and earthy, lingering with notes of dried fruits, cacao, and a beautifully balanced, drying wood spice.

title: Kilchoman 10 Years Old Loch Gorm Limited Edition 2026
bodyHtml:
Kilchoman is an independently owned farm distillery founded by Anthony Wills on Rockside Farm, located on the remote west coast of Islay. Operating as a true farm-to-bottle pioneer, it remains one of the few traditional distilleries in Scotland to grow its own barley and maintain traditional floor maltings. This dedicated philosophy ensures full craft control and gives their spirit an authentic, deeply localized character.

  • Colour: Deep coppery gold.

  • Aroma: The nose is bold, sweet, and smoky, revealing complex layers of caramelised custard tart, freshly roasted coffee, and candied ginger. These sweet notes are underpinned by a rich, savoury wave of damp earth, coastal salinity, and a meaty barbecue edge.

  • Palate: Full-bodied, rich, and remarkably oily on the palate. It delivers an intense interplay of honey-roasted figs, cloves, and sticky toffee pudding, balanced alongside robust charcoal smoke, salted caramel, and toasted walnuts.

  • Finish: Long, ashy, and deeply warming, where the initial sweet and nutty elements slowly fade to allow bonfire embers to smoulder with a sophisticated, drying complexity.

title: Chateau Ollieux Romanis Racine Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Chateau Ollieux Romanis Racine originates from France, within the rugged Languedoc region and the specific Corbières appellation. The estate's modern history began in 1868 when it was established in its current form, and it has remained tied to the passionate Bories family since Jacqueline and Francois Bories took over in 1978. Nestled in the heart of the Boutenac cru, the winery is highly regarded as a regional benchmark for its deep commitment to organic agriculture—certified since 2006—and its philosophy of using indigenous yeasts and minimal sulphur to craft deeply expressive, authentic wines.

Wine Description

The nose opens with a vibrant, complex bouquet dominated by ripe peach, melon, crisp apple, and juicy pineapple, accented gracefully by delicate notes of white flowers and a subtle hint of flint. On the palate, a lively attack delivers beautiful tension and freshness, highlighting an ample and rounded body. The finish is remarkably long, refreshing, and salty, showing great depth and an elegant, subtly textured finish.

title: Leonardo Da Vinci Chianti 2020
bodyHtml:
The Cantine Leonardo da Vinci Chianti hails from Italy, originating from the historic vineyards of the Chianti region in Tuscany. Cantine Leonardo da Vinci is a highly regarded cooperative winery founded in Vinci, deeply rooted in historical winemaking tradition and excellence. Embodying a philosophy that honors its namesake, the winery focuses on an meticulous selection of local grapes combined with modern, innovative oenological practices to deliver authentic expressions of Tuscan terroir year after year.

Wine Description

This wine displays an intense, deep crimson and purple red colour in the glass. On the nose, it delivers a highly aromatic and persistent bouquet featuring bright perfumes of ripe cherries, plums, and red fruits intertwined with gentle spicy hints of black pepper and dried herbs. The palate is medium bodied, firm, and structured, mirroring the dark cherry fruit profile with an added layer of savory earthiness. Well balanced with classic, vibrant Tuscan acidity and soft, velvety tannins, it culminates in a long, pleasantly dry, and peppery finish.

title: Banfi Brunello Di Montalcino 'Vigna Marrucheto' 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'vibrant' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation of Tuscany. Castello Banfi established in 1978 by the Italian-American Mariani brothers is a historic benchmark estate that completely revolutionized the modern winemaking landscape of Montalcino through its pioneering, decades-long scientific clonal research on the Sangiovese grape. The "Vigna Marrucheto" single-vineyard bottling represents the estate's forward-looking philosophy, sourced from three unique, low-fertility parcels totaling 10 hectares planted in 2009. The vines are rooted in a complex soil structure of marine clay, silt, and calcareous stones, where the southern Tuscan sun interacts with refreshing maritime breezes to focus exceptional structural clarity and inner energy within the fruit.

Wine Description

The 2020 Banfi 'Vigna Marrucheto' Brunello di Montalcino presents an intense, deep ruby red color in the glass with brilliant garnet reflections. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, expressive, and high-toned, opening with a complex bouquet of sour cherries, ripe red plums, and blackcurrants, beautifully layered with distinct balsam notes, medicinal herbs, sweet tobacco, and crushed red roses. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, compact, and remarkably taut, showcasing a rich and flavorful core of wild strawberries, sour dark cherries, and dark cacao. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a vibrant backbone of mineral acidity that perfectly balances its natural power. The mouthfeel is tightly woven yet sleek, driven by firm, silky, and powdery tannins that carry into an expansive, long, and dry finish detailed by lingering notes of licorice, blood orange pith, and savory wood spice.

This 100% Sangiovese (specifically the premium Sangiovese Grosso biotype) reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 15.0%. The grapes were fermented at controlled temperatures (25-30°C) inside Banfi’s hybrid Horizon tanks—custom-built combining stainless steel and French oak panels to allow for soft, micro-oxygenated extraction. To round out the bold structural matrix without over-extracting oak flavors, the wine was aged for 30 months primarily in large French oak casks (60 and 90 hl) alongside a minor portion in 350-litre French oak barriques, followed by an additional period of extensive bottle refinement before commercial release. Reflecting the estate's contemporary values, the property is managed under precise sustainable viticultural standards.

title: Chappellet Mountain Cuvee 2024
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and 'expressive' red wine originates from the United States, within the highly celebrated mountain terrain of Napa Valley, California. The "Mountain Cuvée" Proprietor's Blend builds on nearly six decades of experience at Chappellet, a historic estate founded in 1967 by Donn and Molly Chappellet on Pritchard Hill under the direct guidance of legendary winemaker André Tchelistcheff. Operating under a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes balance, freshness, and immediate pleasure, this entry-level cuvée is specifically crafted for near-term enjoyment. The fruit is meticulously sourced from premium hillside parcels across Napa Valley including select estate blocks on Pritchard Hill alongside premier vineyard sites like Stagecoach, Broken Rock, and Sugarloaf where rocky, volcanic soils naturally yield fruit with excellent varietal character and approachability.

Wine Description

Chappellet Mountain Cuvée presents a bright, deep ruby-garnet appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is wonderfully inviting, aromatic, and fruit-forward, opening with an expressive bouquet of sweet red cherries, cassis, and black plums, beautifully layered with fragrant underlays of lavender, wild rhubarb, shaved cedarwood, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, lively, and smoothly textured, showcasing a polished core of juicy red and black mountain fruits. It is characterized by its outstanding structural balance, striking a fine harmony between ripe fruit extraction and a bright, refreshing natural acidity. The mouthfeel is remarkably supple and rounded compared to the estate's more monolithic single-vineyard bottlings, driven by well-integrated, velvety tannins that glide into a long, clean finish highlighted by lingering notes of sweet vanilla, tobacco, and cocoa powder.

title: Jean Louis Chave Saint Joseph Blanc 'Circa' 2020
bodyHtml:
This exceptional white wine comes from France, located within the historic Saint Joseph appellation in the Northern Rhône subregion of the Rhône Valley. The Chave family possesses a legendary grape growing history dating back to 1481, with 25 generations meticulously farming some of the finest parcels in the region. Under the current guidance of Jean Louis Chave, the estate adheres to a winemaking philosophy of traditional farming, low yields, and minimal manipulation to achieve the purest expression of terroir.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Beautiful golden colour.

  • Aroma: Highly aromatic, exuding complex notes of peach nectar, citrus oils, almonds, acacia flowers, and honey.

  • Palate: Soft, supple, and highly textural on the palate, showing rich flavours of white stone fruit layered with a distinctive smoky mineral flourish.

  • Body: Medium plus body with a well structured profile.

  • Finish: Long and elegant finish.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Roussanne sourced from old vines grown on the granitic slopes of Mauves.

  • Stylistic Notes: The unique granite soils lend remarkable freshness, balance, and vivacity to the wine, contrasting beautifully with its softer textural elements.

  • Alcohol by Volume: 13.5%

  • Organic Status: Certified organic.

Food Pairing

  • Delicate white fish dishes that complement the wine's mineral freshness.

  • Selections of mature and hard cheeses.

  • Artisanal cured meats.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 vintage in the Rhône Valley is regarded as excellent and highly successful. The growing season commenced with a mild winter followed by an unusually dry, balmy, and frost-free spring that prompted an early budburst.

title: Mary Taylor Agenais Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'vibrant' rosé wine originates from France, within the lesser-known, premium IGP Agenais designation of the Southwest France wine region. Sourced from the family-operated estate of vigneron Christophe Avi in the village of Laplume, this bottling is part of the curated Mary Taylor Wine portfolio. Mary Taylor operates under a strict winemaking philosophy of European regional typicity and site transparency, celebrating small, independent family growers who eschew high-volume industrial shortcuts. Rooted in the sandy and clay-limestone soils directly south of the Garonne River benefiting from the protective proximity of the vast Landes Forest the vineyard blocks yield fruit with an exceptional balance of sunny ripeness and maritime-driven structural tension.

Wine Description

The Mary Taylor 'Christophe Avi' Agenais Rosé presents a brilliant, bright salmon-pink and coral appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally aromatic, energetic, and expressive, opening with a high-toned bouquet of honeyed floral blossoms, ripe wild cherries, and crushed nectarines, beautifully layered with distinct undertones of wet stone, lime leaf, and exotic baking spices. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, round, and surprisingly pliant, showcasing a juicy, mouth-filling core of fresh red berries, green strawberries, and pickled watermelon rinds. It is characterized by its outstanding, palate-cleansing natural acidity and a firm, persistent mineral grip. The mouthfeel is almost oily and texturally rich, driving into a crisp, bone-dry, and highly persistent finish highlighted by an intense wave of cascading inner flowers and citrus zest.

title: Jasper Brewing Babe Tangerine Dream - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Babe Tangerine Dream is a beloved staple from Jasper Brewing Company, Canada's first National Park brewpub. Part of their ultra-approachable "Babe" series (alongside the popular Babe Blueberry Vanilla), this Fruit Lager is famously marketed with a direct premise: it is a crushable fruit bomb that tastes a little like a weekend brunch mimosa and a lot like your new favorite beer. It is explicitly crafted for those who want to completely escape aggressive hop bitterness and heavy grain bills, acting as a vibrant, carbonated splash of pure citrus sunshine.

Beer Description

Babe Tangerine Dream pours a hazy, bright golden-orange color mimicking a glass of fresh, pulp-free juice topped with a frothy white head that crackles down quickly.

Aroma: The nose is unapologetically punchy and fruit-forward. It leads with dominant notes of fresh-squeezed tangerine, candied orange slices, and bright citrus zest, backed by a very faint, clean whisper of pale malt. It smells incredibly refreshing, akin to cracking open a premium Italian orange soda.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a highly refreshing, effervescent "zing." It leads with a burst of sweet tangerine juice and tangy citrus flesh, which entirely takes center stage over any traditional beer flavors. The mid-palate has a soft, delicate malt backbone that provides structure, ending with an exceptionally clean, slightly sweet, and crisp finish.

Profile: It sits at a standard 4.8% ABV and a very low bitterness of 12 IBU, completely prioritizing juicy refreshment over hop presence.

Technical Notes: To achieve its highly specific profile, Jasper Brewing starts with a classic, ultra-clean Lager base brewed with 100% Albertan malted barley. The magic happens through the infusion of natural tangerine extract and zest. By utilizing a neutral lager yeast and fermenting it clean, the brewers ensure there are no competing yeast esters or heavy phenols, allowing the natural, bright acidity and sweetness of the citrus to be the absolute star of the show.

title: Baudry & Dutour 3 Coteaux Chenin Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from France, within the rare Chinon Blanc A.O.P. appellation of the central Loire Valley. While Chinon is universally famous for its Cabernet Franc reds, white wines account for less than 5% of the region's total production, making this a highly prized and distinctive find. Baudry & Dutour is a dynamic alliance of vigneron-partners operating under a philosophy of strict terroir expression and low-intervention viticulture. The "3 Coteaux" cuvée represents an intentional multi-terroir masterclass, carefully assembling fruit from three distinct, exceptional hillsides including the siliceous and clay-limestone slopes of Chénaies and Chenanceaux where the old Chenin Blanc vines naturally focus deep mineral power.

Wine Description

The 2024 Baudry & Dutour '3 Coteaux' Chinon Blanc presents a brilliant, pale straw-yellow appearance in the glass with light gold and youthful greenish highlights. Its sensory profile is incredibly elegant, precise, and high-toned, opening with a refined bouquet of white floral blossoms, crisp green apples, and ripe citrus fruits, beautifully layered with distinct undertones of honey, exotic white peach, and a light buttery complexity. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, racy, and beautifully focused, showcasing a chiseled core of lemon zest and crunchy stone fruits. It is characterized by its outstanding, laser-sharp mineral tension and a refreshing backbone of natural acidity. The mouthfeel is sleek yet texturally complex, developing a fine, creamy weight sur lies before driving into a lengthy, bone-dry finish defined by a tactile salinity and a flinty, stone-flecked edge.

This 100% Chenin Blanc wine reached a well-balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 12.0%. Adhering to a naturalistic, low-intervention approach in the cellar, the hand-harvested grapes underwent immediate direct pneumatic pressing followed by an exceptionally slow primary fermentation at cool temperatures inside stainless steel vats to protect the delicate fruit aromatics. Following the estate's strict signature protocol, the wine completely bypassed malolactic fermentation to lock in its raw varietal crispness, and was vinified without any added sulfites. It was matured for several months on its fine lees in stainless steel to develop mid-palate volume, entirely eliminating wood contact to protect its pristine mineral transparency. Reflected by the estate's strict environmental standards, the vineyard plots are certified under the High Environmental Value (HVE) sustainable development framework.

title: Jost Tidal Bay White Blend 2025
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and 'coastal' white wine originates from Canada, within the unique, cool-climate landscape of Nova Scotia. Produced by Jost Vineyards the pioneer of the local industry and Nova Scotia’s largest and longest-running winery, founded in 1983 on the Malagash Peninsula this bottling is an authentic champion of the province's signature white appellation. Officially established in 2012, "Tidal Bay" is a unique appellation defined not by a narrow geographic boundary, but by a strict, collective stylistic framework that captures Nova Scotia's maritime terroir. Operating under a winemaking philosophy focused on absolute crispness and terroir transparency, every vintage must pass an independent, blind tasting panel to earn the designation, ensuring it delivers the refreshing, sea-breeze identity native to the edge of the Atlantic.

Wine Description

The Jost Vineyards Tidal Bay presents a brilliant, pale straw-yellow appearance in the glass with light, youthful greenish highlights. Its sensory profile is wonderfully fresh, aromatic, and expressive, opening with a high-toned bouquet of crisp green apples, ripe pear, and lemon peel, beautifully layered with distinct undertones of golden kiwi, white peach, and wild mountain blossoms. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, lively, and highly refreshing, showcasing a juicy core of stone fruits and bright citrus oils.

title: Pra Soave Otto 2025
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Italy, within the historical Soave Classico D.O.C. zone of the Veneto region near Verona. Graziano Prà, who founded the estate in the early 1980s, is widely celebrated as one of the elite, benchmark producers responsible for completely redefining the international quality movement of the appellation. Named affectionately after the family's beloved border collie, "Otto," this flagship cuvée operates under a winemaking philosophy of absolute varietal purity and strict environmental respect. The mature heritage vines (planted between 1957 and 1987) are rooted in the steep, south-east facing hillsides of Monteforte d’Alpone at an elevation of 150 to 200 metres, where ancient, black volcanic soils naturally restrict yields to infuse the fruit with exceptional mineral energy.

Wine Description

The Prà 'Otto' Soave Classico presents a brilliant, pale straw-yellow appearance in the glass with light, youthful greenish reflections. Its sensory profile is remarkably fresh, elegant, and high-toned, opening with a fragrant, blossom-driven bouquet of hawthorn, jasmine, and elderflower, beautifully layered with crisp green apples, ripe white peaches, and wild apricots. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, juicy, and beautifully focused, showcasing an attractively textured core of pink grapefruit granita, lime zest, and yellow plum. It is characterized by its outstanding, mouthwatering natural acidity and an incisive backbone of stony, volcanic minerality. The mouthfeel is sleek and linear, showing a relaxed, pillowy fruit weight before driving into a clean, bone-dry, and highly persistent finish highlighted by a distinctive, bitter-edged crunch of raw green almonds and a hint of salinity.

title: Attems Ribolla Gialla 2025
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Italy, within the Venezia Giulia I.G.T. designation of the premium Friuli-Venezia Giulia region in the country's northeast corner. The historic Attems estate is a cornerstone of Friulian viticulture, with family records documenting land ownership and grape cultivation in Collio dating as far back as 1106. In 2000, the estate entered an exciting modern chapter when it was acquired by the legendary Marchesi Frescobaldi family, who successfully elevated its international profile while preserving local traditions. Operating under a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes purity, energy, and absolute site transparency, the winery uses sustainable viticultural practices to showcase Ribolla Gialla a noble, ancient native variety that has thrived on the region's hillside sandstones and marls since the Roman era.

Wine Description

Attems Ribolla Gialla presents a brilliant, clear straw-yellow appearance in the glass with light, youthful greenish reflections. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, delicate, and high-toned, opening with an airy, floral bouquet of white blossoms, jasmine, and elderflower, beautifully layered with distinct aromas of green apples, fresh pear slices, and lemon oil. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, vibrant, and beautifully focused, showcasing a chiseled core of crisp orchard fruits and refreshing citrus zest. It is characterized by its outstanding, mouthwatering natural acidity and an incisive backbone of flinty, saline minerality. The mouthfeel is sleek and fluid, building a subtle textural depth from light contact sur lies before driving into a clean, bone-dry, and highly persistent finish highlighted by a touch of citrus pith and Mediterranean herbs.

title: Luce della Vite 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'authoritative' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Toscana I.G.T. designation of Montalcino, Tuscany. Tenuta Luce was born in 1995 as a historic, visionary joint venture between Marchese Vittorio Frescobaldi and Robert Mondavi, who sought to challenge regional conventions by creating the first-ever premium blend of Sangiovese and Merlot in the cradle of Brunello. Today, the estate is wholly directed by Lamberto Frescobaldi, operating under a winemaking philosophy that values uncompromised fruit concentration, opulent textures, and profound aging capability. The estate’s high-elevation vineyards reach up to 420 metres on the southwest-facing slopes of Montalcino, where well-drained galestro (schistous clay) and sandstone topographies yield small, concentrated berries with excellent natural acid balance and structural longevity.

Wine Description

Tenuta Luce presents an incredibly deep, intense ruby-red appearance with highly concentrated violet hues shimmering at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally layered, complex, and expressive, opening with a seductive, high-toned bouquet of wild blackberries, mulberries, and crushed blueberries, beautifully woven with fragrant notes of dried rose petals, incense, sandalwood, and a light touch of mocha. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and remarkably plush, showcasing a voluptuous core of dark berry preserves, black cherry purée, and sweet licorice. The mouthfeel is broad and velvety, driven by exceptionally polished, silk-smooth tannins that glide into a near-endless, spice-infused finish accented by lingering undertones of tobacco leaf, dried Mediterranean shrub, and toasted oak.

title: Luce 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'authoritative' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Toscana I.G.T. designation of Montalcino, Tuscany. Tenuta Luce was born in 1995 as a historic, visionary joint venture between Marchese Vittorio Frescobaldi and Robert Mondavi, who sought to challenge regional conventions by creating the first-ever premium blend of Sangiovese and Merlot in the cradle of Brunello. Today, the estate is wholly directed by Lamberto Frescobaldi. The 2022 vintage carries immense historic weight for the property as it officially marks the 30th anniversary edition of this legendary cuvée. Operating under a winemaking philosophy that values deep fruit concentration, opulent textures, and structural longevity, the estate’s high-elevation vineyards reach up to 420 metres on the southwest-facing slopes of Montalcino, where well-drained galestro (schistous clay) and sandstone topographies yield small, concentrated berries with excellent natural acid balance.

Wine Description

The 2022 Tenuta Luce presents an incredibly deep, intense ruby-red appearance with concentrated garnet shades shimmering at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally layered, complex, and highly expressive, opening with a seductive, high-toned bouquet of crisp red and black berries; such as wild blackberries, red currants, and pomegranate beautifully woven with fragrant underlays of dried rose petals, violets, menthol, and a distinct hint of Tuscan cigar tobacco. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and remarkably enfolding, showcasing a powerful core of dark bramble fruit, black cherry, and dark cocoa.

title: Bollinger Champagne PN TX20
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Champagne, France, this exceptional Blanc de Noirs is rooted in the premier cru village of Tauxières within the Montagne de Reims. Founded in 1829, Maison Bollinger remains one of the region's most historic family-owned houses, celebrated for its uncompromising dedication to craftsmanship.

Wine Description

Bollinger Champagne PN TX20 presents a striking golden yellow hue flecked with gold in the glass. The complex nose bursts with precise aromas of fresh citrus, white peach, and quince, layered alongside subtle flinty minerals and a gentle hint of shortcrust pastry. On the palate, it reveals a beautiful richness, tension, and vinosity, where initial notes of redcurrant and stewed fruits give way to an ultra-fine mousse and a remarkably long, saline finish.

title: Pabst Blue Ribbon - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Pabst Blue Ribbon, originally established in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, United States, is produced under license in Canada by Sleeman Breweries in Guelph, Ontario. The brewery was founded in 1844 by Jacob Best and was later significantly expanded by Frederick Pabst, who helped it become one of the largest brewing companies in the nation. In Canada, the brand continues its long history as a flagship premium lager known for its classic blue ribbon branding.

Beer Description

This American style lager is pale golden in colour and topped with a delicate white foam. The aroma is characterized by gentle malt scents featuring notes of banana and pear fruit alongside a subtle hop fragrance. On the palate, it offers a light, crisp taste with a hint of malt sweetness and a clean flavour profile including notes of cereal. The body is medium to light and finishes smoothly without a bitter aftertaste, resulting in a refreshing and easy drinking experience. The brew is crafted using a combination of six row barley, 100% Copeland malt, and a blend of North American hops with European varieties. It has an ABV of 4.9%.

Food Pairing

The crisp and refreshing nature of this lager makes it an ideal companion for a variety of casual and savoury dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with classic pub fare such as burgers, hot dogs, and buffalo wings, where its clean finish helps balance rich or fried flavours. Its light profile also complements spicy foods, including Mexican street tacos or spicy noodles, by providing a cooling sensation. Additionally, it can be served alongside lighter meals like garden salads or fresh seafood, particularly fried fish.

title: Salentein Cuvee Expectionelle Brut
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
This sophisticated sparkling wine originates from Argentina, crafted in the high-altitude terrains of the Uco Valley within the Mendoza region. Bodegas Salentein was founded in 1997 by Dutch visionary Mijndert Pon, who set out to transform Argentinian winemaking by producing first class estate wines. The winery's philosophy deeply respects the local ecosystem while utilizing innovative European techniques and modern technology to showcase the unique terroir of the Andes foothills.

Wine Description

The Salentein Cuvée Exceptionnelle Brut showcases a bright, golden yellow colour with subtle greenish sparks. The nose reveals a fresh and highly expressive bouquet dominated by aromas of green apple, crisp citrus fruits, and pineapple, beautifully underscored by a delicate note of toasted bread from its time on the lees. On the palate, this medium bodied sparkling wine is smooth and fruity, delivering vibrant orchard fruit flavours balanced by a crisp acidity and a fine, lingering effervescence. Crafted from a blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir harvested from the El Oasis Estate at 1,100 metres above sea level, the wine undergoes its secondary fermentation using the Charmat method followed by six months of 'sur lie' aging. The optimal drinking window for this non-vintage sparkling wine is best enjoyed fresh over the next three to four years.

Food Pairing

This elegant sparkling wine makes a fantastic aperitif and pairs wonderfully with lean fish, calamari, fresh oysters, and refined seafood starters. This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Ridge Grenache Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from the United States, crafted in the Paso Robles appellation situated within the Central Coast region of California. Established in 1962, Ridge Vineyards has long been celebrated for its commitment to single vineyard winemaking and pre-industrial practices. The estate operates under a philosophy of minimal intervention and total ingredient transparency, prioritizing native yeast fermentations and mindful craftsmanship to showcase the purest expression of unique vineyard sites.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Pale yellow with crystal clear clarity and a hint of gold highlights.

  • Aroma: A highly aromatic nose featuring complex scents of pear peel, green orchard fruit, apricot, and citrus blossoms, subtly intertwined with accents of fresh herbs, jasmine, chamomile, and a distinct flinty, smoky reduction.

  • Palate: Rich, viscous, and beautifully textured on the palate, where flavors of golden mango, white peach, raw almond, and orange oil are cut by a palpable wave of saline minerality and serious verve.

  • Body: Full bodied with a mid-weighted, well padded breadth that never feels soft or flabby.

  • Finish: A lengthy, focused finish carrying a sharp mineral grip and lingering citrus notes.

  • Varietal Composition: A thoughtful blend composed of 85% Grenache Blanc, 12% Picpoul, and 3% Roussanne. Grapes are meticulously sourced from three notable west side sites: the Adelaida, Fossil Creek, and Halter Ranch vineyards.

  • Stylistic Notes: Impressively balanced, bright, and precise, the wine masterfully balances its sunlit California generosity with a taut freshness driven by the limestone soils of the region. It is carefully aged for eight months using a combination of stainless steel, neutral oak, concrete, and amphora.

  • Alcohol by Volume: 13.4%

  • Organic Status: Produced using organic and sustainable vineyard management practices, featuring 100% natural primary and malolactic fermentations.

Food Pairing

  • Rich seafood preparations, such as seared scallops, grilled shrimp, or a creamy seafood pasta.

  • Herb roasted chicken or smoky grilled poultry.

  • Mediterranean-inspired cuisine served alongside soft, artisanal cheeses.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 vintage in Paso Robles was characterized by a highly successful growing season that allowed grapes to achieve superb phenolic ripeness while retaining exceptional acidity. September harvest conditions were optimal, yielding fruit with a strong core of flavor and an abundance of the snappy, tangy energy perennially sought by the winemakers.

title: Chappellet Pritchard Hill Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'monumental' red wine originates from the United States, within the highly celebrated mountain terrain of Napa Valley, California. Sourced exclusively from Chappellet's legendary, high-elevation estate blocks on Pritchard Hill, this limited-production flagship bottling represents the absolute pinnacle of the estate's winemaking portfolio. Donn and Molly Chappellet first settled on these rugged slopes in 1967, becoming the first winery to cultivate the rocky, volcanic, and iron-rich soils of the hill. Operating under a philosophy of strict mountain precision, the estate manages its dry, rocky, and low-fertility parcels with intense viticultural focus, naturally restricting vine yields to pack the small berries with immense depth, structural focus, and extraordinary cellar longevity.

Wine Description

The 2022 Chappellet 'Pritchard Hill' Cabernet Sauvignon presents an opaque, midnight purple-black appearance with concentrated garnet shades shimmering at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally deep, complex, and highly expressive, opening with a bold bouquet of dark black currants, cassis, and juicy wild blueberries, seamlessly layered with fragrant underlays of liquid violets, lead pencil shavings, unsmoked cigars, and fresh mountain sage. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, concentrated, and beautifully textured, showcasing a pure core of blackberry preserves, dark chocolate, and roasted coffee beans. It is characterized by an outstanding structural balance, maintaining an uncommonly fresh, vibrant backbone of natural acidity (pH 3.71) that effortlessly frames the rich mountain extraction. The mouthfeel is surprisingly supple and velvety for a young mountain wine, driven by firm, polished, and mouth-coating tannins that glide into a remarkably long, radiant finish accented by lingering notes of wood smoke, anise, and toasted French oak barrel spices.

This precise, high-definition Bordeaux-style blend is carefully tailored from select, high-performing estate parcels:

  • 94% Cabernet Sauvignon: Dominates the core blend to deliver intense dark fruit density and cellar-worthy muscle.

  • 6% Petit Verdot: Elevates the deep color profile and sharpens the tannic architecture.

Following a meticulous block-by-block harvest, the select lots underwent separate, controlled vinifications before completing malolactic fermentation. The wine reached a well-balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 14.8%. To seamlessly knit the components together and craft its premium frame, the wine was matured for 22 months entirely in 100% new French oak barrels before being bottled in July 2024. While the estate champions natural biodiversity and sustainable agricultural management across its high-altitude slopes, this bottling is conventionally farmed and not certified organic.

Accolades

98 Points Robert Parker - A terrific effort from a challenging vintage, Chappellet's 2022 Cabernet Sauvignon Pritchard Hill—94% Cabernet Sauvignon and 6% Petit Verdot—boasts expressive scents of cassis, blackberries, vanilla and caramel. It's full-bodied, supple, generous, deep and round, expansive on the palate and framed by soft, fully ripe tannins and hints of mocha on the lingering, velvety finish. Showy, impressive and delicious, it should drink well for a couple of decades.

title: Chappellet Signature Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'authoritative' red wine originates from the United States, within the highly celebrated mountain terrain of Napa Valley, California. Sourced predominantly from Chappellet’s legendary, high-elevation estate blocks on Pritchard Hill, the "Signature" bottling has served as the foundational flagship and defining benchmark for premium hillside Napa Cabernet Sauvignon for over three decades. Donn and Molly Chappellet first established the winery in 1967 under the direct advice of legendary winemaker André Tchelistcheff, who recognized that the rugged, volcanic slopes would produce world-class wines. Operating under a philosophy of strict mountain precision, the estate manages its dry, rocky, and low-fertility iron-rich soils with aggressive crop thinning, naturally restricting vine yields to pack the small berries with immense structural longevity.

Wine Description

The 2022 Chappellet Signature Cabernet Sauvignon presents a beautifully dark, opaque garnet-purple appearance with concentrated violet shades at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally deep, complex, and expressive, opening with a bold, high-toned bouquet of crème de cassis, black cherries, and ripe plum preserves, seamlessly layered with fragrant notes of mountain sage, lead pencil shavings, sappy spring flowers, and aged tobacco leaf. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, concentrated, and texturally rich, showcasing a luxurious, mouth-coating core of black currant compote, dark chocolate, and roasted espresso bean. It is characterized by an outstanding structural balance, maintaining an uncommonly fresh, vibrant backbone of natural acidity (pH 3.72) that keeps the rich hillside extraction beautifully focused and fluid. The mouthfeel is seamless and silky, driven by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into a remarkably persistent, savory finish accented by lingering notes of smoked cedar, anise, and toasted French oak barrel spices.

title: Larceny Straight Kentucky Bourbon Barrel Proof
bodyHtml:
Larceny Straight Bourbon Barrel Proof is an allocated, uncut, and non-chill filtered wheated bourbon produced by Heaven Hill Distillery in Bardstown, Kentucky. First introduced in January 2020, it serves as the barrel-strength counterpart to the standard Larceny Small Batch. The brand pays homage to the legendary John E. Fitzgerald, a treasury agent who used his keys to steal prime barrels of wheated bourbon from government bonded warehouses. Larceny shares the historic, soft "Old Fitzgerald Distillate" (O.F.D.) mash bill with Heaven Hill’s ultra-premium Old Fitzgerald Bottled-in-Bond decanter series.

Spirit Description

Larceny Barrel Proof is pulled from barrels aged between 6 and 8 years. Because it is bottled directly from the cask without water dilution, the alcohol volume and specific flavour profiles vary noticeably by release. Heaven Hill issues three distinct small-batch versions every year (in January, May, and September) using an explicit batch code system (e.g., A125 represents the first batch of January 2025; C924 signifies the third batch of September 2024).

  • Colour: Polished oak to deep copper-amber.

  • Aroma: Intensely rich and sweet. The nose opens with a classic combination of caramel apple, maple-glazed French toast, hard butterscotch candy, and rich cocoa powder, underscored by toasted sourdough bread and a sharp hit of ethanol heat.

  • Palate: Viscous, dense, and mouth-coating. Dark chocolate, burnt caramels, honey-roasted nuts, and baking spices mingle with pockets of dried dark fruits, tart red raspberries, and bready vanilla extract.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with an oily richness that allows the bold wheated sweetness to stand up directly against the fiery alcohol content.

  • Finish: Long, warming, and progressively drying. It tapers off with a lingering wave of cinnamon spice, espresso bean, barrel char, leather, and dry oak wood.

  • ABV: Varies by batch, typically hovering between 60% and 63.3% (120 to 126.6 Proof).

title: Death Whistle Tequila Blanco
bodyHtml:
Death Whistle Tequila Blanco is a premium, craft-oriented silver tequila produced in Jalisco, Mexico. The brand is named after the ehecachichtli, the ancient Aztec "death whistle" shaped like a skull, historically used in sacred rituals dedicated to the underworld and the night winds. Mirroring its hauntingly distinctive namesake, the tequila is distilled at NOM 1439 (Agabe Tequilana Productores y Comercializadores) in the Los Valles (Tequila Valley) region of Jalisco, a facility known for blending modern precision with estate-grown highland and lowland agaves.

Spirit Description

Death Whistle Blanco is made from 100% blue Weber agave and bottled directly after distillation to lock in the unadulterated flavors of the plant.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, brilliant, and transparent.

  • Aroma: Highly expressive and crisp. The nose is dominated by cooked agave sweetness, herbal notes, fresh-cut grass, and a bright overlay of citrus zest and wet limestone.

  • Palate: Smooth but punchy, delivering a strong mid-palate matrix of sweet roasted agave, vegetal undertones, anise, and lime peel.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a clean, lively viscosity that strikes a balance between rustic valley minerality and soft texture.

  • Finish: Clean and sharp, closing with a distinct pop of cracked black pepper, mineral earthiness, and a lingering herbal freshness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Death Whistle Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Death Whistle Tequila Reposado is a premium, craft aged spirit produced in Jalisco, Mexico, within the Los Valles (Tequila Valley) region. Drawing its identity from the ancient Aztec ehecachichtli—the sacred ceramic skull whistles used to invoke the night winds and honor the underworld—the brand merges cultural history with artisanal distillation. It is meticulously crafted at NOM 1439 (Agabe Tequilana Productores y Comercializadores), a boutique distillery respected for utilizing high-quality blue Weber agaves and clean, low-intervention processing methods.

Spirit Description

Death Whistle Reposado is made from 100% estate-grown blue Weber agave. After being cooked and extracted, the juice undergoes slow fermentation and is double-distilled in traditional pot stills. It is then rested in premium charred oak barrels for several months, softening the sharp, rustic edges of the valley distillate while infusing structural wood components.

  • Colour: Pale straw to warm light gold, naturally reflecting its restful contact with oak timber.

  • Aroma: Complex and beautifully balanced. The nose bridges the raw, herbal freshness of the valley floor with the warmth of the barrel, offering upfront notes of cooked agave, dry oak, soft vanilla, and caramelized honey, highlighted by citrus oils and wet stones.

  • Palate: Round, smooth, and texturized. Flavour profiles of sweet roasted squash and honey-drizzled almonds give way to mid-palate layers of light baking spices, cinnamon, and a pleasant, earthy minerality.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, enveloping texture that masks alcohol bite while maintaining excellent agave character.

  • Finish: Clean and moderately long, leaving a trailing memory of oak tannins, sweet vanilla bean, and a lingering, peppery warmth.

  • ABV: Bottled at a standard 40% (80 Proof).

title: Southern Right Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine hails from South Africa, primarily located within the scenic Walker Bay district on the Cape South Coast of the Western Cape. Founded by Anthony Hamilton Russell in 1994, the estate is situated in the cool climate Hemel en Aarde Valley, just a few kilometres from the South Atlantic Ocean. The winery is driven by a philosophy of expressing unique site terroir and soil personality over simple varietal intensity, and it proudly contributes a portion of its proceeds to conserving the rare Southern Right whales that frequent the nearby bay.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Brilliant straw yellow with distinctive greenish highlights.

  • Aroma: A complex, non-pungent nose displaying lively aromas of passion fruit, guava, and citrus zest, balanced by subtle hints of white pepper, dried ginger, and fresh herbs.

  • Palate: Crisp, textural, and beautifully layered, featuring ripe flavors of white peach, melon, and citrus oil, all underscored by a deep sense of flinty, saline minerality.

  • Body: Light to medium body with a well-covered and structured mid-palate.

  • Finish: Clean, bright, and remarkably long with a rapier finish that echoes with lingering freshness.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Sauvignon Blanc, sourced from 27 different parcels grown across a complex mix of clay-rich shale, decomposed granite, and Table Mountain sandstone soils.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is highly unique and complex, achieving a beautiful balance between Old World minerality and New World palate coverage, leaning into individual character rather than simple, pungent fruit aromas. A small 7% portion was fermented in neutral barrels to enhance its complex texture.

  • Alcohol by Volume: 13.31%

  • Organic Status: Crafted using grapes grown under mindful farming practices with a focus on organic and endemic area yeasts.

Food Pairing

  • Fresh spring salads dressed with vinaigrette or pickled fish dishes.

  • Artisanal young white cheeses such as goat cheese and feta.

  • Fresh seafood, including stone bass tartare or raw oysters.

Vintage Quality

The 2025 growing season is considered one of the top South African vintages on record, benefiting from excellent late winter cold units and highly benign weather conditions. Mild disease pressure and lower-than-average rainfall during ripening resulted in an early February harvest with beautifully high acids and exceptional wine texture.

title: Ridge Lytton Springs Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'elegant' rosé wine originates from the United States, within the highly celebrated Dry Creek Valley AVA of Sonoma County, California. Sourced from Ridge Vineyards' historic Lytton Springs estate (originally acquired in 1972), this small-lot bottling is officially designated as the "Lytton Estate Rosé." The winery operates under a winemaking philosophy of "pre-industrial" low intervention and site transparency, famously championed by pioneer Paul Draper and carried forward by head winemaker Shauna Rosenblum. Rooted in ancient, well-drained volcanic and gravelly clay loam benchland soils, the blocks feature interplanted heritage vines. For this extemporaneous rosé, fruit is carefully selected across the estate to capture a precise, savory balance of California sun and cool coastal-valley nights.

Wine Description

Ridge 'Lytton Estate' Rosé presents a remarkably pale coral-pink appearance in the glass, leaning almost toward a white wine in its delicacy of color. Its sensory profile is fresh, intricately layered, and expressive, opening with a high-toned, delicate bouquet of honeysuckle water, rose petals, and white peach, beautifully woven with vibrant notes of red raspberry, Yakima cherry, and fresh strawberry. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, clean, and beautifully textured, showcasing an exuberant core of fresh orchard and summer berry fruit. The mouthfeel is surprisingly supple and substantial for its pale hue, benefiting from a unique malolactic roundness that drives into a lengthy, bone-dry finish defined by a distinctive flinty minerality, cool stone notes, and a whisper of dried savory herbs.

title: Arniston Bay Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and 'coastal' white wine originates from South Africa, within the expansive and diverse Coastal Region of the Western Cape. Established in 1996, the brand was directly inspired by the rugged charm of Arniston, a historic, 200-year-old fishing village situated near the southernmost tip of the African continent. Expertly shaped by the father-and-son winemaking team of Francois and Abraham de Villiers, Arniston Bay operates under a philosophy of coastal purity and environmental purpose. The grapes are sourced from south-facing, ocean-cooled vineyard blocks rooted in deep red soils, where persistent maritime breezes from the Atlantic and Indian Oceans naturally regulate vine growth to preserve a striking varietal freshness.

Wine Description

The Arniston Bay Sauvignon Blanc presents a brilliant, light pale-green appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is remarkably bright, classic, and expressive, opening with a high-toned bouquet of passion fruit, ripe white peach, and vibrant lime zest, beautifully layered with distinct undertones of green guava and fresh herbaceous garden notes. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, racy, and incredibly easy-drinking, showcasing a juicy core of tropical melon, citrus oils, and crisp orchard fruits. It is characterized by its outstanding, thirst-quenching natural acidity and clear maritime energy. The mouthfeel is clean and fluid, driving into a crisp, bone-dry finish detailed by a lingering aftertaste of citrus peel and subtle vegetative crunch.

title: Argiolas Costera 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'expressive' red wine originates from Italy, within the Cannonau di Sardegna D.O.C. appellation of the Mediterranean island of Sardinia. Sourced from the prestigious Argiolas estate, founded in 1938 by Antonio Argiolas, the property is universally recognized as the pioneering force that first shifted the island's winemaking focus from bulk quantity to world-class quality. Today, the estate is expertly managed by the third generation of the family: Valentina, Francesca, and Antonio. Operating under a philosophy of strict respect for native Sardinian varieties and site precision, the estate sources this bottling from their 88-acre Costera vineyard, located in the rolling hills of Serdiana in southern Sardinia. Here, the vines are rooted in a pebbly terroir of calcareous clay-loam, where intense Mediterranean sunlight and cooling marine winds naturally limit yields to pack the fruit with genuine island character.

Wine Description

Argiolas Costera Cannonau di Sardegna presents an intense ruby-red appearance with brilliant garnet reflections shimmering at the rim. Its sensory profile is wonderfully warm, classic, and deeply reflective of its landscape, opening with a high-toned, intensely vinous bouquet of wild cherries, very ripe strawberries, and dark plums, beautifully layered with fragrant underlays of new leather, eucalyptus, cracked black pepper, and Mediterranean wild herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, soft, and juicy, showcasing a sweet-fruited core of black cherries and crushed mountain berries. It is characterized by an outstanding structural balance, maintaining a pleasing natural freshness (pH 3.6) that effortlessly offsets the southern sun's heat. The mouthfeel is sleek and polished, driven by velvety, well-rounded tannins that transition gracefully into a long, satisfying finish accented by lingering notes of sweet vanilla, tobacco leaf, and savory baking spices.

title: Junmaishu Tsushima Genshu 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Junmaishu Tsushima Genshu is an authentic Japanese sake crafted in the Aichi Prefecture of Japan. The regional sake tradition in Tsushima City dates back centuries, developing rapidly due to its historic spiritual significance and the abundance of pristine natural water sources like the Kiso River. Local producers in this water village area emphasize small batch, traditional manufacturing methods to preserve handcrafted quality and deliver rich profiles that showcase the true character of the rice.

Description

This sake displays a rich, slightly golden hue in the glass, characteristic of a traditional undiluted brew. The aromatic profile is robust and earthy, featuring notes of steamed rice, toasted nuts, and a subtle touch of dried fruit. On the palate, it delivers a full bodied and intense flavour experience owing to its genshu status, showcasing a deep umami core and a well rounded structure. It balances this richness with a vibrant, clean acidity that prevents it from feeling heavy, leading into a long, warming finish. The alcohol content by volume for this powerful expression is 17%.

title: Gerard Bertrand 'Gris Blanc' Rose 2024 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This exceptionally crisp dry rosé originates from France, grown in the sunny Mediterranean area of Tautavel within the IGP Pays d’Oc designation of the Languedoc-Roussillon region. Crafted by Gérard Bertrand—a former international rugby player who has built a biodynamic wine empire in the South of France—this cuvée is celebrated for its highly original profile. Rather than a deep pink, it is designed as a "Gris" style, celebrating the unique attributes of the Grenache Gris grape to deliver an incredibly airy, mineral, and thirst-quenching summer wine.

Wine Description

The Gérard Bertrand Gris Blanc Rosé 2024 is an elegant, vibrant, and light-footed rosé noted for its striking freshness and unique, crystalline color profile.

  • Appearance: Extremely pale pink with distinct shades of grey and white highlights in the glass.

  • Nose: Delicate, fresh, and inviting. The bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of wild strawberry, cranberry, and pink grapefruit, layered with soft undertones of white pear, stone fruit, and fine herbal savouriness.

  • Palate: Crisp, airy, and beautifully clean. The entry brings immediate flavors of ripe red berries, citrus zest, and peach. A defining feature of this wine is a very slight, natural pearl (effervescence) on the palate, which gives it an extra pop of physical vitality and highlights the fruit before drawing to an elegant finish defined by an enticing saline and briny minerality.

  • Technical Details: A focused blend consisting primarily of Grenache Gris and Grenache Noir. The grapes are handpicked mostly from the Tautavel region, which sits between the Pyrenees Mountains and the Mediterranean Sea. To guarantee immaculate color and protect the delicate fruit aromatics, handling is carried out entirely in a carbon dioxide atmosphere before a cold-temperature fermentation. The wine is matured on its fine lees for several weeks in stainless steel before bottling under a screw cap. It sits at a refreshing 12.5% to 13.0% ABV and is completely dry.

Food Pairing

Because of its lightweight agility, crisp citrus core, and distinct saline touch, this rosé is an exceptional food companion. It is a fantastic match for shellfish and crustaceans, pairing beautifully with chili-lime prawns, raw oysters, or a classic seafood salad. Its structural vitality also allows it to effortlessly balance spicy and highly flavorful dishes, making it an excellent partner for sushi with wasabi, light Thai red curries, baked Mediterranean fish, or a savory vegetable tajine.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 growing season in the South of France benefited from a classic Mediterranean climate, balanced by cool northern winds that locked in high natural acidities. This allowed Bertrand's viticultural team to preserve the pure, crunchy "Gris" characteristics of the Grenache grapes. It is showing beautifully right now and is best enjoyed well-chilled for immediate, youthful enjoyment over the next year.

title: Gerard Bertrand Chateau L’Hospitalet 'Grand Vin' Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
This prestigious, full-bodied red wine originates from France, within the strictly defined, coastal La Clape AOP in the Languedoc-Roussillon region. Château L’Hospitalet is the flagship crown jewel of Gérard Bertrand's extensive estate portfolio. Perched a hundred meters above the Mediterranean Sea on a majestic limestone cliff near Narbonne, the vineyard basks in intense southern sunshine balanced by cooling maritime breezes.

The winery is globally acclaimed for its large-scale conversion to sustainable agriculture. The 2022 Grand Vin is officially certified Organic and Biodynamic (Demeter). This label carries immense historical cachet—the 2017 vintage of this exact bottling was famously crowned the "Best Red Wine in the World" at the International Wine Challenge.

Wine Description

The Château L’Hospitalet Grand Vin Rouge 2022 is a powerful, rich, and beautifully polished Mediterranean red that brilliantly balances dense black fruit with a refreshing, saline freshness.

  • Appearance: A brilliant, deeply concentrated ruby red with intense garnet flashes.

  • Nose: Highly expressive, complex, and deeply layered. It opens with an explosion of ripe wild berries, stewed plums, and sweet strawberries, closely followed by classic Southern French garrigue aromas—wild thyme, rosemary, juniper, and lavender. Underneath, hints of black pepper, anise, dark chocolate, and a whiff of wood ash provide excellent depth.

  • Palate: Full-bodied, textured, and impeccably compact. The palate entry is velvety and ample, showcasing flavors of rich dark cherries, cassis, and sweet baking spices (cinnamon and licorice). Despite its robust weight and high natural alcohol, a core of seaside limestone minerality cuts cleanly through the density. The frame is supported by fine, firm, and incredibly silky tannins that lead into a long, peppery, and savory finish.

  • Technical Details: A masterfully curated Mediterranean blend consisting of 68% Syrah, 22% Grenache Noir, and 10% Mourvèdre. The grapes are entirely hand-harvested at peak polyphenolic maturity. Each varietal is vinified separately, with a portion of the Syrah undergoing whole-cluster fermentation to enhance aromatic lift. Following maceration (20 to 25 days), 100% of the wine is transferred into new 225-liter French oak barrels for 12 to 16 months of aging, with periodic lees stirring. Only the absolute finest barrels are selected for the final blend. The alcohol content sits at a powerful 15.0% ABV.

Food Pairing

This wine's muscular structure, rich oak depth, and herbal notes demand equally robust culinary partners. It is an elite match for a roasted rack of lamb with rosemary crust, slow-cooked wild boar ragout, or prime ribeye steak grilled over open flames. It pairs exceptionally well with feathered game birds (like roasted duck or pheasant) and stands up gracefully to a platter of highly mature, hard artisanal cheeses like aged Comté, Manchego, or Pecorino.

Serving & Cellaring

Due to its youthful density and full-throttle style, it is highly recommended to decant this wine for 1 to 2 hours prior to serving to allow the complex oak spices and wild herb aromatics to fully unwind. Serve at a cool room temperature of 16°C to 18°C. While it is incredibly harmonious and rewarding to drink right now, the 2022 Grand Vin possesses an exceptional structural architecture that will allow it to cellar and beautifully evolve over the next 10 to 12 years (through 2034+).

title: Chateau La Sauvageonne 'Grand Vin' Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
This full-bodied, organic red wine originates from France, within the highly celebrated Terrasses du Larzac AOP in the northern Languedoc region. Nestled at the foot of the Larzac plateau, Château La Sauvageonne is a spectacular volcanic estate owned by Gérard Bertrand. The vineyard features an extraordinary combination of red volcanic soils (known as Ruffes), sandstone, and schist. The unique high-altitude microclimate brings dramatic shifts between hot summer days and chilly mountain nights, allowing the fruit to achieve optimum ripeness alongside a distinct freshness. The estate is fully certified Organic and Biodynamic (Demeter).

Wine Description

The Château La Sauvageonne Grand Vin Rouge 2022 is a rich, intense, and deeply complex southern red characterized by a striking balance of jammy dark fruit and savory, wild mountain herbs.

  • Appearance: Intense, deep ruby red with subtle tile-red glints at the rim.

  • Nose: Highly expressive and distinctively regional. It bursts with aromas of dark plums, spiced cherries, and blueberry jam, closely followed by dense undertones of Mediterranean scrubland (garrigue), peppercorns, dark chocolate, and a faint hint of gingerbread.

  • Palate: Medium- to full-bodied, textured, and deeply generous. The entry brings a concentrated core of sweet berries, wild blackberries, and baking pastries. The mid-palate features beautifully integrated, powdery, and fine-grained tannins backed by an energetic freshness that elegantly carries the high alcohol. The finish is focused, long, and smooth with a kiss of smoky, roasted oak.

  • Technical Details: A classic Terrasses du Larzac blend primarily featuring Syrah and Grenache Noir, balanced with Mourvèdre and Carignan. The grapes are hand-harvested parcellarly, fully destemmed, and undergo a 20- to 25-day maceration. The wine is aged for 12 to 16 months in new 225-liter French oak barrels before final blending. The alcohol content is a robust 15.0% to 15.5% ABV.

title: Black Stallion Los Carneros Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'classic' red wine originates from the United States, within the cool-climate Los Carneros AVA, which straddles the southern boundaries of both Napa and Sonoma valleys in California. Black Stallion Estate Winery; situated along the historic Silverado Trail in Napa Valley, is named in honor of the equestrian center that once stood on the property. The winery operates under a winemaking philosophy that values regional authenticity and precise lot selection, leveraging the unique maritime conditions of the region to bring balance to the fruit. Rooted in the thin clay loam soils of the rolling Carneros hillsides, the vines are exposed to daily cooling blanket fogs and sweeping breezes from the nearby San Pablo Bay, naturally slowing the ripening cycle to capture elegant complexity.

Wine Description

The Black Stallion Estate Heritage Los Carneros Pinot Noir presents a beautiful, translucent ruby-plum color in the glass. Its sensory profile is highly expressive, inviting, and fruit-forward, opening with a lush bouquet of ripe strawberries, Bing cherries, and dark plums, beautifully layered with fragrant notes of dried violets, cloves, and mocha, along with a delicate touch of toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, soft, and velvety, showcasing a plump core of sweet black cherries, pomegranate, and warm baking spices. It is characterized by its outstanding balance of ripe fruit and a pleasingly fresh acidity that gives it excellent definition. The mouthfeel is smooth and open-knit, driven by round, black tea-like tannins that carry into a long, spicy finish highlighted by lingering notes of earth, nutmeg, and cola spice.

This 100% Pinot Noir reaches a well-balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5%. Following a traditional temperature-controlled fermentation, the wine undergoes complete malolactic fermentation to develop its signature supple, mellow texture. The wine is typically aged for several months in premium French oak barrels (utilizing roughly 39% new wood depending on the vintage) to integrate its fine structural framework while maintaining the cool-climate fruit character. While the estate champions natural biodiversity and sustainable viticulture across its vineyard selections, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Rose Gold Cotes de Provence Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This classic, elegant dry rosé originates from the heart of France’s premier rosé destination: the Côtes de Provence AOP. Rose Gold is a highly popular boutique label founded by wine entrepreneur Casey Barber, who set out to bottle the quintessential "Saint-Tropez lifestyle."

Rather than sourcing fruit from a single plot, the wine is crafted in partnership with a historic, multi-generational winery located just outside of Saint-Tropez. This collaboration leverages high-quality, sustainably farmed estate vineyards to deliver the pale color, electric freshness, and mineral snap that defines world-class Provence rosé.

Wine Description

The Rose Gold Provence Rosé is an exceptionally crisp, airy, and sophisticated wine that delivers classic French Riviera elegance with remarkable consistency.

  • Appearance: An incredibly pale, luminous coppery-pink or "onion-skin" hue with brilliant platinum glints.

  • Nose: Highly lifted, fresh, and expressive. The bouquet opens with delicate, bright aromas of white flowers and fresh-picked strawberries, layered beautifully with pink grapefruit zest, white peach, and a subtle undercurrent of crushed limestone.

  • Palate: Bone-dry, light-footed, and remarkably refreshing. The palate entry treats you to a juicy wave of red currants and citrus peel, which transitions seamlessly into a clean, vertical mid-palate. It boasts a beautifully crisp, mouthwatering acidity and concludes on a dry, snappy finish marked by an enticing saline and wet-stone minerality.

  • Technical Details: A traditional Provençal blend dominated by Grenache and Cinsault. The grapes are harvested by hand early in the morning to lock in high natural acidity and prevent oxidation. The fruit undergoes a gentle, immediate direct-pressing with very minimal skin contact to ensure its signature pale color. Fermentation is carried out completely cold in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats, and the wine is bottled early under a screw cap to preserve its vibrant, youthful energy. It sits at a refreshing 12.5% ABV.

Food Pairing

Because of its bright citrus drive, bone-dry profile, and distinct mineral finish, Rose Gold is an elite lifestyle and dining wine. It is a fantastic match for fresh seafood and Mediterranean fare, pairing beautifully with grilled sea bass, chilled shrimp cocktails, tuna tartare, or a classic Salade Niçoise. Its high acidity allows it to cut cleanly through the rich fats of a charcuterie board featuring soft cheeses like Brie, goat cheese, or prosciutto, and it stands up gracefully to light, garlic-heavy tapas like gambas al ajillo.

title: Bijou Le Chic Rose Bag - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml:
Bijou Le Chic Rose Bag is crafted in France, originating from the expansive Pays d'Oc region. Bijou Wine was founded with a clear focus on celebrating the unique terroirs of southern France while actively prioritizing environmental sustainability. The winery places a strong emphasis on producing approachable, premium wines in innovative packaging alternatives, driven by an eco-conscious philosophy to dramatically reduce the traditional carbon footprint of wine transport.

Wine Description
