This French rose displays an extremely pale pink colour in the glass. The bouquet opens with vibrant, fresh aromas of wild strawberry, redcurrant, and delicate hints of cherry blossom. On the palate, it is crisp, dry, and beautifully balanced, offering a surprisingly rich, round texture that outpaces typical regional profiles. Bright notes of watermelon and red berries lead into a clean, fruit-led finish.

title: Antinori Badia A Passignano Chianti Classico 2005 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'historic' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Chianti Classico D.O.C.G. appellation of Tuscany. Sourced entirely from the historic Badia a Passignano estate in the heart of the region, the vineyards surround a magnificent 10th-century Vallombrosian monastery renowned for viticulture since the year 1000. Acquired entirely by the Marchesi Antinori family in 1987, the property features parcels planted at roughly 300 metres above sea level on soils rich in limestone and clay. The winery operates under a traditional philosophy that celebrates the purity of its single-estate clones, aging the wines within the abbey’s ancient cellars to balance old-world nobility with modern precision.

Wine Description

The 2005 Antinori Badia a Passignano presents an intense, deep ruby red colour that gracefully hints at its age while maintaining unexpected visual integrity. Released originally under the Riserva classification, this label represents a selection of the estate's top fruit that retroactively satisfies the strict requirements of the prestigious Gran Selezione tier introduced years later. Its sensory profile is open, complex, and highly evolved, revealing an expansive bouquet of ripe blackberries, blackcurrants, and dried cherries layered with sophisticated tertiary notes of licorice, saddle leather, sweet oregano, sage, and a dash of balsamic vinegar. On the palate, the wine is wonderfully balanced, refined, and round, showcasing an ample fruit core supported by a moderately strong, vibrant acidity and firm, well-integrated tannins that carry a slight, classically drying textural edge. The taste profile finishes with an elegant, medium-to-long persistence highlighted by herbs, leather, and dark fruit.

This 100% Sangiovese wine reached a well-balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5%. The manually selected grapes underwent a 15-day alcoholic fermentation and maceration on the skins in stainless steel vats before naturally completing malolactic fermentation. The wine was aged for 14 months primarily in new Hungarian oak barriques (300L and 225L), with a minor portion resting in new French oak barrels, followed by 12 months of bottle refinement prior to commercial release. While the estate fosters environmental harmony and traditional agricultural care across its grounds, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Undurraga T.H. (Terroir Hunter) Carmenere 2024
bodyHtml:
The T.H. (Terroir Hunter) project, spearheaded by visionary head winemaker Rafael Urrejola, is an innovative initiative designed to break away from commercial, high-volume blending. The philosophy centers on hunting down small, specific micro-plots across Chile where particular grape varieties can thrive in their absolute ideal soil and microclimate. For their Carmenere, Undurraga sources fruit exclusively from the Peumo subregion within the Cachapoal Valley. Peumo is universally recognized by critics as the ultimate "Grand Cru" terroir for Chilean Carmenere.

Wine Description

This wine typically pours with a deep, concentrated ruby color.

  • Aromas: The nose is extraordinarily vibrant and varietally pure, displaying a complex bouquet of blackberries, blueberries, and red plums. This fruit profile is balanced by the classic savory markers of Carmenere: white peppercorn, bay leaf, fresh tobacco, and a subtle hint of red bell pepper.

  • Palate: On the palate, the wine has "broad shoulders" but carries immense freshness. It is full-bodied and voluptuous, offering a plush, sweet core of dark fruits beautifully framed by vibrant acidity and smooth, velvety tannins.

  • Finish: The finish is remarkably long and elegant, wrapping up with a lingering flourish of mocha, graphite, and baking spices.

The wine is crafted from 100% Carmenere sourced from a low-yielding plot of ungrafted vines planted in 1998. The vines sit on clay-heavy slopes mixed with decomposed granite beside the Cachapoal River. This unique clay holds water efficiently, allowing the late-ripening Carmenere grape to mature slowly and completely without losing its crucial acidity.

title: Chateau d'Estoublon Roseblood Rose 2025
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'elegant' rosé wine originates from France, within the Coteaux Varois en Provence A.O.P. appellation of the iconic Provence region. Roseblood is the highly dynamic, flagship lifestyle cuvée of Château d'Estoublon, a historic estate founded in 1489 in the heart of the Alpilles mountains. In 2020, the property was acquired by an extraordinary, hands-on ownership group consisting of former wine executive Jean-Guillaume Prats (ex-Lafite Rothschild and Cos d'Estournel), entrepreneur Stéphane Courbit, and musician/model Carla Bruni alongside her husband, former French President Nicolas Sarkozy. The estate operates under a philosophy of Mediterranean "Art of Living," using a gravity-fed, low-intervention approach to highlight pure site transparency. The grapes are sourced from high-altitude hillside vineyards sitting between 350 and 500 metres above sea level, where clay-limestone terrains, red earth soils, and pockets of gravel and flint give the fruit a distinct structural tension.

Wine Description

Roseblood Rosé presents a luminous, pale eau-de-rose appearance in the glass with soft peach and melon reflections. Its sensory profile is airy, precise, and highly expressive, opening with a delicate bouquet of linden and jasmine blossoms, wild raspberries, and pink strawberries, layered with fresh undertones of vineyard peach, cut watermelon, and wild Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, fluid, and beautifully balanced, showcasing a succulent, fruit-forward core of crunchy nectarines, citrus zest, and tangy red fruits. It is characterized by its outstanding, cool-climate freshness and a vibrant backbone of tonic acidity that cuts through the fruit's natural generosity. The mouthfeel is supple yet finely chiseled, driving into a lengthy, bone-dry, and highly persistent finish highlighted by a distinctive saline minerality and crisp grapefruit tones.

title: Selbach-Oster 'Alte Reben' Zeltinger Riesling Trocken 2022
bodyHtml:
This exceptional dry white wine originates from Germany, grown along the famously steep, sun-drenched banks of the Mosel valley in the village of Zeltingen. Weingut Selbach-Oster is a legendary, multi-generational estate whose winemaking heritage dates back to 1600. Currently guided by Johannes Selbach, the estate is an iconic benchmark for traditional Mosel winemaking.

The "Alte Reben" (Old Vines) designation indicates that this cuvée is sourced entirely from historic, rootstock-native vines averaging 45 to 60 years of age. This bottling serves as a leading example of Germany's modern dry (trocken) revolution, proving that the Mosel can craft dry Rieslings that marry incredible flavor density with ethereal weightlessness.

Wine Description

The Selbach-Oster Alte Reben Riesling Trocken 2022 is a deeply complex, savory, and powerfully mineral wine that trades typical entry-level sweetness for a textured, multi-layered structural core.

  • Appearance: Clear, pale straw-yellow with subtle greenish-gold flashes.

  • Nose: Strikingly deep, flinty, and elegant. The bouquet opens with delicate aromas of juicy yellow melon, green apple, and kumquat, intricately woven with savory nuances of sun tea, dried green herbs, acacia blossoms, and a pronounced slatey, petrol-tinged minerality.

  • Palate: Pure, crunchy, and beautifully stimulating. The entry delivers a refreshing, clean wave of tart tree fruit and white peach flavors. The mid-palate shows great concentration and density from the old vines, framed by a tight, mouthwatering, and wonderfully astringent vertical acidity. It concludes on a highly persistent, savory-saline finish driven by crushed wet stone and grapefruit zest.

  • Technical Details: 100% Riesling. The fruit was hand-harvested primarily from old-vine parcels in the southwest-facing Zeltinger Himmelreich vineyard, alongside select old plots in the Zeltinger Sonnenuhr, characterized by blue Devonian slate soils. The juice was fermented naturally using native yeasts and matured entirely in traditional, large neutral oak casks (Mosel Fuder). It sits at a highly drinkable, modest 11.5% ABV and is bone-dry.

Food Pairing

Because of its piercing acidity, bone-dry profile, and intense mineral spine, this old-vine Riesling is a champion at the dining table. It acts as a flawless counterpart to spicy or highly seasoned dishes, making it a spectacular match for Thai green curries, spicy seafood hotpots, Vietnamese pho, or sushi with fresh wasabi. It is equally brilliant alongside classic, brine-forward seafood dishes like ceviche, gravlax, and oysters on the half shell, or served with rich, creamy cheeses.

title: Chateau Turcaud Entre-Deux-Mers Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This exceptional dry white wine originates from France, specifically the Entre-Deux-Mers AOC within the broader Bordeaux region. Located on a gravelly plateau between the Garonne and Dordogne rivers, Château Turcaud has been operated since 2009 by Isabelle Robert (the daughter of the estate’s founders) and her husband, Stéphane Le May.

Long considered a holy grail for "Quality-to-Price Ratio" (QPR) by sommeliers, this entry-level white has frequently graced the wine lists of Michelin-starred institutions in Paris due to its impeccable cleanliness, striking varietal definition, and consistency year after year.

Wine Description

The Château Turcaud Entre-Deux-Mers Blanc 2024 is a crisp, beautifully balanced, and high-toned dry white that balances green, flinty elements with a surprisingly lush mid-palate texture.

  • Appearance: Brilliant, pale straw-yellow with youthful green highlights.

  • Nose: Highly intense, aromatic, and layered. The nose pops with lemon oil, lime zest, and green apple, underscored by punchy aromas of gooseberry, lychee, citrus blossom, and a distinct herbal whisper of lemongrass and mint.

  • Palate: Immediately juicy, crisp, and ripping with energy. Flavors of green apples, quince, and fresh-squeezed grapefruit dominate the entry. Thanks to dedicated aging techniques, the wine transitions into a medium body with a slightly unctuous, fat mid-palate before snapping shut on a long, mineral, and saline finish.

  • Technical Details: A traditional white Bordeaux blend containing 50% Sauvignon (including a portion of rare, highly aromatic Sauvignon Gris), 45% Sémillon, and 5% Muscadelle. The grapes are entirely estate-grown across 50 hectares of silty, gravel-and-clay soils. It is fermented completely cold in stainless steel and matured carefully on its fine lees with regular stirring to develop textural weight without the masking flavors of oak wood. The alcohol level sits at a refreshing 12.5% to 13.0% ABV and is bone-dry.

Food Pairing

Because of its piercing acidity and stony minerality, this wine is highly versatile at the dining table. It acts as an elite foil for lean and oily seafood, matching beautifully with fresh oysters on the half shell, garlic-butter prawns, pan-seared swordfish, or Coquilles Saint-Jacques. Its crispness effortlessly cuts through the fat of a classic charcuterie board featuring rich salami and rillettes, and it balances gracefully with fresh goat, ewe, or hard cheeses.

title: Clase Azul Mezcal San Luis Potosi
bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Mezcal San Luis Potosi is a spirit crafted in the culturally rich state of San Luis Potosí, Mexico. The brand is known for its beautiful, handcrafted decanters, which are seen as a celebration of Mexican culture and a tribute to the country's artistry and tradition.

Description

The mezcal is crystal clear with silver highlights. It has a full body and offers a complex bouquet of aromas. On the nose, you'll find cooked agave, caramel, green chile, sweet fruit, freshly cut grass, and subtle wildflowers. The palate is introduced with an herbal front, which then evolves into notes of caramel, lime zest, and clove. The finish is mineral and spiced, with a lingering warmth.

Accolades

  • Double Gold Medal, World Spirits Competition 2023

title: Billecart Salmon Brut Rose - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' sparkling wine originates from France, within the world-renowned Champagne AOC. Maison Billecart-Salmon, based in the Grand Cru village of Mareuil-sur-Aÿ, is a legendary family-owned house founded in 1818 by the marriage of Nicolas François Billecart and Elisabeth Salmon. Universally celebrated as the global benchmark for rosé Champagne, the estate pioneered this delicate, precise style back in 1954. Operating under a winemaking philosophy of absolute elegance, finesse, and longevity, the house combines cool, long fermentations with meticulous block selection to craft a cuvée that serves as a reference point for sparkling rosés worldwide.

Wine Description

The Billecart-Salmon Brut Rosé presents a signature pale, radiant salmon-pink color in the glass, beautifully adorned with warm glints of gold and a persistent, fine-bubbled mousse. Its sensory profile is exceptionally subtle, delicate, and high-toned, unfolding a precise bouquet of fresh red berries; such as wild strawberries, raspberries, and red currants interwoven with citrus zest, orange rind, and a delicate floral lift. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, pillowy, and beautifully focused, showcasing a creamy, harmonious smoothness balanced by an outstanding, chalky mineral tension. It is characterized by its remarkable racy acidity and a pinpoint effervescence that drives into a crisp, bone-dry, and lingering finish highlighted by an acidic crunch of red fruit and refreshing tangerine notes.

This non-vintage (NV) Champagne is an expert masterclass in the traditional assemblage (blending) method, typically composed of:

  • 40% to 45% Chardonnay: Sourced from premium Grand Crus, providing the wine’s chiseled structure, longevity, and elegant citrus core.

  • 30% to 35% Pinot Noir: Drawn from the Montagne de Reims, adding structural muscle and red fruit depth, which includes roughly 7% vinified as a still red wine.

  • 20% to 30% Pinot Meunier: Sourced from the Vallée de la Marne, infusing the blend with roundness and immediate aromatic charm.

The wine undergoes a protective, low-temperature vinification in stainless steel vats and naturally completes malolactic fermentation to soften the texture. Incorporating an expansive 40% of aged reserve wines to maintain impeccable year-over-year consistency, the bottling is matured on its fine lees in the house’s chalk cellars for a lengthy 36 months. It is finished with a precise, modest dosage of roughly 7 to 9 grams per litre, keeping it dry and vibrant, and reaches an alcohol content (ABV) of 12.0%. While the estate champions natural biodiversity and sustainable agricultural practices across its vineyards, this cuvée is not certified organic.

title: Billecart Salmon Blanc de Blancs Brut - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' sparkling wine originates from France, within the world-renowned Champagne AOC. Maison Billecart-Salmon, situated in the Grand Cru village of Mareuil-sur-Aÿ, is an iconic family-owned house founded in 1818 by the marriage of Nicolas François Billecart and Elisabeth Salmon. This cuvée is an absolute celebration of Chardonnay, sourced exclusively from the prestigious Grand Cru villages of the Côte des Blancs: Avize, Chouilly, Cramant, and Le Mesnil-sur-Oger. Operating under a winemaking philosophy of precision, purity, and strict site transparency, the house masterfully leverages these distinct limestone terroirs to construct a Blanc de Blancs that marries intense mineral drive with an ethereal, weightless elegance.

Wine Description

The Billecart-Salmon Le Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru presents a stunning, luminous yellow-gold appearance in the glass, enlivened by delicate greenish reflections and an ultra-fine, persistent stream of elegant bubbles. Its sensory profile displays a pure and high-toned mineral intensity, unfolding a sophisticated bouquet of fresh lemons, confit citrus oil, white orchard fruits, and white flowers, beautifully layered with rich nuances of warm brioche, fresh butter, and fresh almonds. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, pillowy, and remarkably incisive, showcasing a creamy meringue-like texture balanced by a razor-sharp, flinty tang. It is characterized by its outstanding, laser-focused natural acidity and a high-definition chalky structure. The finish is exceptionally chiseled, long, and persistent, culminating in a pristine wave of citrus zest and a distinctive, mouthwatering saline minerality.

This 100% Chardonnay is vinified at strictly controlled low temperatures in stainless steel tanks to safeguard the pristine fruit definition and protect it from premature oxidation. The non-vintage blend incorporates a generous 30% to 40% of aged reserve wines to ensure a flawless signature continuity. Following secondary fermentation, the bottling undergoes an extended maturation on its fine lees in the house's deep chalk cellars for 4 to 5 years—far exceeding the legal requirement. It is finished with a precise, low dosage (ranging from 1.7 to 3.9 grams per litre depending on the base disgorgement), keeping its profile piercingly fresh and dry, and reaches an alcohol content (ABV) of 12.0%. Guided by a strict respect for nature, the house incorporates sustainable agricultural practices across its grand cru holdings.

title: Billecart Salmon Brut Reserve - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'symmetrical' sparkling wine originates from France, within the world-renowned Champagne AOC. Maison Billecart-Salmon, situated in the Grand Cru village of Mareuil-sur-Aÿ, is an iconic family-owned house founded in 1818 by the marriage of Nicolas François Billecart and Elisabeth Salmon. The Brut Réserve serves as the definitive signature cuvée of the house, representing an absolute masterclass in traditional blending. Operating under a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes finesse, freshness, and crystalline elegance, the house utilizes specialized low-temperature fermentations and extended aging to deliver a harmonious Champagne that has defined the family's meticulous standard for over two centuries.

Wine Description

The Billecart-Salmon Brut Réserve presents a beautiful, radiant pale gold appearance in the glass, enlivened by delicate greenish reflections and a persistent, slow-rising stream of ultra-fine bubbles. Its sensory profile is remarkably precise, fresh, and expressive, opening with a high-toned bouquet of fresh green apples, ripe Bosc pears, and citrus zest, beautifully layered with complex underlays of white floral blossom, fresh butter, and warm brioche. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, pillowy, and beautifully focused, showcasing a creamy, harmonious texture balanced by a razor-sharp, chalky mineral tension. It is characterized by its outstanding natural acidity and a pinpoint effervescence that drives into a crisp, bone-dry, and lingering finish highlighted by an acidic crunch of fresh orchard fruit and a light touch of biscuit complexity.

This non-vintage (NV) Champagne is a harmonious, classic multi-varietal blend composed of three distinct grape varieties sourced from the region's finest terroirs:

  • 40% Pinot Meunier: Sourced primarily from the Vallée de la Marne, infusing the blend with juicy roundness and immediate aromatic fruit charm.

  • 30% Pinot Noir: Sourced from the Montagne de Reims and the Grande Vallée de la Marne, adding structural muscle, depth, and red-fruit power.

  • 30% Chardonnay: Sourced from the premium crus of the Côte des Blancs, providing the wine’s chiseled structure, laser focus, and vibrant citrus core.

The grapes were gently pressed and underwent a protective, low-temperature vinification in stainless steel vats to safeguard the pristine fruit definition. Naturally completing malolactic fermentation to soften the texture, the final blend incorporates an expansive 50% to 60% of aged reserve wines to ensure a flawless signature continuity from year to year. Following secondary fermentation, the bottling was matured on its fine lees in the house's deep chalk cellars for a lengthy 30 months—more than double the legal requirement. It is finished with a precise, low dosage of roughly 7 grams per litre, keeping its profile piercingly fresh and dry, and reaches an alcohol content (ABV) of 12.0%. Reflecting the producer's environmental commitment, the house incorporates sustainable agricultural management across its vineyard blocks.

title: Tenuta di Arceno Arcanum Toscana Vertical Collectors - 3 Bottle Pack (2012/2014/2016)
bodyHtml:
This Collectors pack includes 1 bottle of 2012, 1 bottle of 2014, and 1 bottle of 2016.

Arcanum is the pinnacle of Tenuta di Arceno’s portfolio, a true "Super Tuscan" that captures the essence of the estate’s coolest-climate Cabernet Franc. This vertical showcases the evolution of a Bordeaux-style blend born from the rugged hills of Castelnuovo Berardenga. On the nose, expect deep, concentrated aromas of black violet, cedar, and sandalwood. The palate is characterized by its signature structure, bold yet supple featuring layers of blackcurrant, dark chocolate, and the distinct earthy minerality of the Tuscan terroir. With a powerful backbone of refined tannins and a persistent, spice-laden finish, these wines represent the height of sophistication and aging potential.

2012 Vintage

The 2012 growing season in Tuscany was characterized by a warm, dry summer, resulting in a wine of incredible concentration and opulence. This vintage is remarkably expressive, leading with savory aromas of sandalwood, roasted coffee, and ripe black cherries. On the palate, it is full-bodied and generous, showing a "sun-drenched" character with supple, integrated tannins. Now entering its prime drinking window, the 2012 displays a seamless harmony between its rich fruit core and the tertiary notes of tobacco and forest floor that have developed with age.

2014 Vintage

The 2014 vintage is a testament to the winemaker's skill during a cooler, more temperate year. This bottle represents the "elegant" side of Arcanum, emphasizing finesse, acidity, and aromatic complexity over raw power. It opens with vibrant notes of red currant, crushed violets, and the classic herbal lift of Cabernet Franc—think dried sage and mint. The palate is medium-bodied and bright, featuring a precise structure and a refreshing minerality that makes it an exceptional partner for food. It is a sophisticated, "intellectual" wine that remains incredibly fresh.

2016 Vintage

Often hailed as a "benchmark" or "legendary" year for Tuscany, 2016 provided near-perfect conditions, resulting in a wine of immense power and crystalline purity. This vintage is defined by its extraordinary balance and "vertical" structure. The aromatics are deep and brooding, featuring layers of cassis, graphite, and lavender. On the palate, it possesses a massive backbone of firm, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity that suggests a decades-long life ahead. It is tight, racy, and incredibly deep—the ultimate expression of the Arcanum estate.

title: The Abandonment Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'artisonic' red wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Napa Valley region of California. Sourced from choice hillside parcels, this boutique label is crafted under a winemaking philosophy that embraces low-intervention viticulture and site transparency. The name "The Abandonment" represents a conceptual nod to leaving behind rigid, commercial winemaking formulas in favor of raw, unmanipulated terroir expression. Rooted in well-drained, low-fertility soils, the vines naturally experience moderate hydric stress, forcing root systems deep to yield small, intensely concentrated berries.

Wine Description

The Abandonment Cabernet Sauvignon presents an opaque, deep purple appearance with dark crimson shades shimmering at the rim. Its sensory profile is bold, deep, and heavily extroverted, unfolding a pronounced bouquet of dark black fruits including crème de cassis, fresh blackberries, and black plums layered with fragrant notes of dried sage, espresso bean, dark chocolate, and a classic hint of graphite. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, concentrated, and richly textured, showcasing an expansive core of blackberry preserve, blueberry, and savory spice. It is characterized by its outstanding structural balance, driven by a vibrant backbone of acidity that keeps the heavy extraction perfectly focused and fluid. The mouthfeel is substantial and well-knit, supported by grippy, fine-grained tannins that glide into a lengthy finish highlighted by lingering tones of cedar, wood smoke, and dried tobacco leaf.

This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon was fermented in small, temperature-controlled lots with gentle punch-overs to maximize flavor extraction while avoiding aggressive seed bitterness. The wine reached a robust alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and was matured for roughly 18 to 22 months in premium French oak barrels (utilizing a generous percentage of new oak) to naturally frame the muscular structure before bottling. While the estate implements precise agricultural management across its vineyard blocks, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Chionetti 'La Chiusa' Langhe Nebbiolo 2023
bodyHtml:
This traditional red wine originates from Piedmont, Italy, within the Langhe DOC. It is crafted by Chionetti, a legendary, historic estate founded in 1912 in the San Luigi zone of Dogliani. While the Chionetti family spent over a century building a reputation as the absolute masters of the Dolcetto grape, their modern era—now led by Nicola Chionetti—includes highly acclaimed expansions into Nebbiolo, including prized vineyards in Barolo.

The "La Chiusa" cuvée is an artisanal, small-production hidden gem (typically producing just 1,500 bottles a year). It positions itself as a serious, traditionalist "Barolo Light"—trading the juicy, simple fruit of entry-level Langhe wines for deep, structural complexity.

Wine Description

The Chionetti "La Chiusa" Langhe Nebbiolo is a savory, beautifully structured, and unmanipulated red wine defined by its old-school Piedmontese gravitas and rustic elegance.

  • Appearance: A classic, pale translucent ruby red with an orange-brick tint at the rim. Because it is bottled completely unfiltered, it may show a natural, slight opalescence and sediment in the bottle.

  • Nose: Strikingly complex and perfume-driven. It leaps from the glass with textbook Nebbiolo aromas of tar and dried red roses, seamlessly interwoven with tart red cherries, blackberries, leather, pipe tobacco, and minty, balsamic undertones.

  • Palate: Elegant, broad, and fiercely traditional. The palate features a savory core of sour cherry and wild raspberry flesh, quickly framed by a powerful frame of chewy, fine-grained tannins and a vital, refreshing acidity. It completely avoids any sweet or jammy fruit, culminating in a long, dry finish rich with iron, dried herbs, and earth.

  • Technical Details: 100% Nebbiolo. The majority of the fruit is grown on 20-year-old vines in the San Luigi zone of Dogliani, with the remaining portion sourced from the family's estate plots in Monforte d’Alba (one of Barolo's top communes). The grapes are hand-harvested in October and undergo an extended 21-day skin-contact fermentation in stainless steel using native yeasts. To protect the pure varietal aromatics from harsh oak flavors, the wine is aged for 12 months in large, untoasted French oak casks (botti grandi) and refined for 6 months in the bottle before release. It sits at a robust 13.5% to 14.0% ABV and is bone-dry.

Food Pairing

Because of its assertive tannin structure and stellar acidity, this wine requires food to truly sing. It is a textbook match for fatty, savory meats and earthy dishes. Pair it alongside roasted duck breast, braised veal chops, or a rich beef stew (osso buco). It is an absolute standout with truffle-infused pastas, wild mushroom risottos, or a rustic charcuterie board featuring sharp, salty cheeses like Pecorino Romano and Parmigiano-Reggiano.

title: Chateau d'Esclans Whispering Angel Rose - 6 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This Provence rosé is made from Grenache, Cinsault, and Rolle (Vermentino) grapes. It exhibits a beautifully pale pink color. The aroma includes fresh red berry fruit characteristics with floral notes. On the palate, it has a ripe and fleshy feel, and is bone dry. Stylistically, 'Whispering Angel' is considered today's worldwide reference for Provence rosé, offering charm, style, and pleasure. It is known for being extremely easy drinking, versatile, and possessing a great concentration. The finish is described as smooth and round, with great concentration and no astringent aftertaste. The wine is fermented and aged in stainless steel with temperature control and undergoes bâtonnage (stirring of the yeast lees).

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings are tailored to this wine's dry, fresh profile:

  • Light salads and starters, such as a Niçoise salad or a watermelon and feta salad.

  • Seafood sensations like grilled prawns or seared scallops.

  • Mediterranean cuisine, charcuterie, Middle Eastern, and Asian/Thai/sushi/Vietnamese dishes.

  • A cheese platter featuring creamy goat cheese or tangy brie.

    This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Perrier Jouet Belle Epoque Rose 2013 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Perrier-Jouet Belle Epoque Rose is a fascinating cuvee – subtle and delicate, yet also warm and embracing, as if it were wrapping you in silk. A shimmering, pastel-toned, salmon-pink with luminous orange highlights. Aromas of strawberry and peony with the tartness of kumquat and white currant. Notes of pink grapefruit and mandarin combined with the generosity of brioche.

96 Points - James Suckling

Very pretty aromas with peach and crabapple character, as well as cotton candy and light nutmeg. Medium- to full-bodied with very fine bubbles that run the length of the wine and persist. Really fine and beautiful. Ultra-complex and refined. 

92 Points - Decanter

Pale onion skin colour, refreshing, with stewed red fruits, tangy citrus and autolytic notes. Vibrant and savoury, well judged ageing, classic style.

title: Chateau Saint Hilaire Medoc Cru Bourgeois 2018
bodyHtml:
Chateau Saint Hilaire is located in the Médoc region of Bordeaux, France. The estate was founded in 1982 by Adrien Uijttewaal, a Dutchman who settled in Jau Dignac Loirac on gravel ridges overlooking the Gironde estuary. Today, the winery is managed by Adrien's daughter, Elise Uijttewaal, who continues the family philosophy of creating elegant, balanced wines that reflect the finesse of the Médoc terroir.

Wine Description

This deeply coloured red wine features a complex aromatic profile with notes of blackcurrant, cherry, and plum, complemented by hints of cedar, graphite, and toasted oak. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied with a supple attack that gives way to a dense yet silky texture and fine grained tannins. The finish is long and graceful, often revealing touches of spice and earthy minerality.

Food Pairing

The wine’s structured tannins and dark fruit profile make it an excellent companion for roast beef with Dauphinois gratin, grilled lamb chops with rosemary, or a hearty mushroom and chestnut wellington. It also pairs well with aged cheddar or rich meat stews, which complement its earthy undertones.

title: Teremana Blanco Tequila - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml:
Teremana Blanco Tequila is produced in Mexico, within the highlands of the Jalisco region and the subregion of Jesús María. Launched in March 2020, the brand was founded by global superstar Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson alongside co-founders Dany Garcia, Jenna Fagnan, and Ken Austin. The tequila is crafted at Destilería Teremana de Agave in partnership with the Lopez family, who are third generation agave growers and second generation tequila makers. The name combines the Latin 'terra', meaning earth, and the Polynesian word 'mana', which translates to spirit.

Description

This unaged blanco tequila is crafted from 100% mature Blue Weber agave that is slow roasted in small, traditional brick ovens and distilled in handmade copper pot stills. It presents a clear and brilliant appearance in the glass. The nose offers fresh aromas of bright citrus zest, sweet roasted agave, and subtle herbal notes with a touch of pepper. On the palate, the spirit is crisp and lively, featuring flavours of lime, roasted agave, and a hint of vanilla spice. It possesses a smooth, medium body and concludes with a clean, refreshing finish characterized by a gentle peppery warmth.

title: Leaning Post Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Leaning Post Chardonnay 2024 is a premium, artisanal white wine from the Lincoln Lakeshore sub-appellation of the Niagara Peninsula in Ontario, Canada.

The winery was founded by Ilya and Nadia Senchuk with a philosophy of minimal intervention and a focus on translating unique Niagara terroirs into liquid. Ilya Senchuk believes that cool-climate Chardonnay offers a perfect balance of richness and power with focus and grace. The 2024 vintage is a blend sourced from four distinct vineyards: Grimsby Hillside (85%), Senchuk Vineyard (15%), as well as portions from the Bock and Hemeris vineyards.

Wine Description

The 2024 vintage was characterized by a warm, steady growing season and a long, dry fall, allowing the grapes to ripen slowly while maintaining excellent acidity.

  • Aromas: The nose features an immediate wave of pineapple, lemon curd, and peach pith, accented by sea spray and wet-stone minerality.

  • Palate: It offers a beautiful richness balanced by flavours of grilled Niagara peaches, cumin, and lemon meringue, mingling with crème fraîche and roasted almond.

  • Finish: The wine is silky smooth and exceptionally long, eventually yielding to a persistent wet-stone minerality and crisp acidity.

The wine is 100% Chardonnay, whole-cluster pressed and fermented in French oak barrels using indigenous yeasts and malolactic bacteria. It was aged in barrel for 10 months and bottled in September 2025. The 2024 release has an ABV of 13%, a pH of 3.15, and a very low residual sugar of 3 g/L (Extra Dry).

Food Pairing

The richness and mineral tension of this Chardonnay make it a versatile partner for structured seafood and white meats:

  • Seafood: Excellent with meaty fish such as halibut or cod, as well as shellfish like lobster, shrimp, crab, and scallops.

  • Poultry: Pairs beautifully with roasted chicken or turkey tournedos.

  • Vegetarian: Complements savory vegetable dishes like onion tarte or quiche.

Winemaking Philosophy

Leaning Post treats each vineyard parcel separately from picking through fermentation to ensure individual terroir expression. The wines are crafted with spontaneous primary and malolactic fermentations and are released with low sulfite additions. Often, the wines undergo only a rough filtration or no filtration at all to maintain their natural texture and character.

title: KinGlassie Double Matured 8 Year Old Single Malt Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
KinGlassie Double Matured originates from the Kingdom of Fife in the Lowland region of Scotland. It is produced at the InchDairnie Distillery, an innovative facility founded in 2012 by Ian Palmer under John Fergus & Co. Known for its 'flavour-led' engineering approach, the distillery utilizes a hammer mill and a mash filter rather than a traditional mash tun, and it only distils this heavily peated spirit for one week each year during the winter.

Spirit Description

This heavily peated single malt, measured at approximately 50 ppm, is aged for a total of eight years. It undergoes a double maturation process, spending five years in first fill ex-bourbon American oak casks followed by three years in Amontillado sherry casks from Montilla, Spain. The resulting spirit features an almond brown colour and a medium to full body. The aroma is characterized by 'velvet smoke', tobacco, and rich layers of almonds and nuts. On the palate, it offers a creamy and earthy texture with flavours of honey, oranges, toffee, and chocolate raisins. The finish is long and spicy, marked by a 'char-filled' chewiness and lingering notes of raspberry and peat. It is bottled at 46.3% ABV.

Accolades

KinGlassie Double Matured has quickly gained critical acclaim, notably securing a Gold Medal at the 2026 World Whiskies Awards. The distillery itself has also been recognized for its modern aesthetic and sustainable practices, winning 'Best Bottle Design' at the World Whiskies Awards for its collaboration with the French design house Chic.

title: Tornatore Pietrarizzo Etna Bianco 2023
bodyHtml:
This prestigious and "focused" white wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Pietrarizzo vineyard on the northern slopes of Mount Etna in Sicily. Pietrarizzo is one of Tornatore’s most prized "Crus," located at an elevation of approximately 700 meters above sea level, one of the highest plots farmed by the estate. The winery's philosophy for this label is to showcase a more refined and age-worthy expression of the volcano, utilizing older vines and a sophisticated aging process that sets it apart from the entry-level Etna Bianco.

Wine Description

Tornatore Pietrarizzo Etna Bianco presents an intense straw-yellow color with light green reflections. The sensory profile is highly complex and more "focused" than previous years, featuring an aromatic nose of fresh white peach, honeyed lemon, and grapefruit, layered with sophisticated accents of petrol, floral perfume, and smoky flint. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "sapid," showcasing fantastic tension and a distinct saline minerality. It is characterized by a "crunchy" fruit quality and a creamy profile derived from its unique maturation process: fermented in 50 hl oak barrels and aged on the lees for five months. This blend is primarily 97% Carricante and 3% Catarratto, reaching an ABV of 13% to 13.5%.

title: Tornatore Etna Rosso 2022
bodyHtml:
This elegant and mineral-etched red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the northern slopes of the Mount Etna volcano in Sicily. The Tornatore family, established in the village of Castiglione di Sicilia since 1865, is one of the region’s most significant landowners. The winery's philosophy emphasizes the unique "mountain" character of the Nerello Mascalese grape, which is often compared to fine Burgundy or Barbaresco for its aromatic complexity and pale, translucent hue. The estate is notably committed to sustainability, holding VIVA and SOStain certifications to protect the delicate volcanic ecosystem.

Wine Description

Tornatore Etna Rosso 2022 presents a light ruby red color with faint purple reflections. The sensory profile is bright and fresh, featuring an aromatic nose of pristine red cherries, wild strawberry, and lavender, layered with sophisticated notes of wet stone, licorice, and a "whiff of smoky aromas". On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "crunchy," showcasing a beautiful balance of ripe red fruit and steely minerality. It is characterized by crisp acidity and "chalky" tannins that lead to a dry, savory finish with a delicate saltiness. This blend typically consists of 95% Nerello Mascalese and 5% Nerello Cappuccio, reaching an ABV of 14% to 14.5%. The 2022 vintage was matured in a mix of large wooden barrels and stainless steel to preserve its "scented freshness".

title: Founder's Original Tequila Paloma 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Tequila Paloma from Toronto’s Founder’s Original represents the premiumization of the Ready-to-Drink (RTD) cocktail market. While the canned cocktail sector was historically flooded with overly sweet, malt-based coolers using artificial flavorings, Founder's Original launched with a strict "bar-quality" mandate. Their Paloma mimics a scratch-made cocktail poured by a professional bartender. It bypasses cheap neutral spirits in favor of genuine Mexican tequila, real juices, and custom bitters. The result is a vibrant, sophisticated canned cocktail that balances authentic tequila funk with sharp citrus refreshment.

RTD Description

Founder's Original Tequila Paloma pours a pale, hazy pinkish-white color with a light, sparkling effervescence that forms a brief halo of bubbles before settling cleanly.

Aroma: The nose is extraordinarily bright, authentic, and zesty. It leads with dominant notes of fresh-squeezed pink grapefruit and lime peel, immediately followed by the distinct, earthy, and peppery aroma of blanco tequila. There is a soft, natural honey-like scent of agve nectar in the background, entirely free of synthetic candy notes.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a crisp, clean carbonation that mimics a club soda pour. It leads with a tart punch of grapefruit pulp and lime juice, which is quickly supported by the robust, savory flavor of agave. Unlike mass-market seltzers, it features a complex herbal bitterness from Aztec citrus bitters that cuts through the fruit, leading to an exceptionally dry, refreshing, and crisp finish.

Profile: It sits at a punchy 7.0% ABV and, as a spirit-based cocktail, has 0 IBU (though the citrus bitters provide a sophisticated, structural bitterness). It is naturally gluten-free and vegan-friendly.

Technical Notes: The integrity of this cocktail relies on its small-batch execution and lack of added preservatives. It is built using premium 100% Blue Agave Blanco Tequila as its spirit base. Instead of cane sugar or high-fructose corn syrup, the drink is lightly sweetened with agave nectar, ensuring the sugars feel integrated with the spirit. The formulation is rounded out with real grapefruit and lime juices, alongside a proprietary dash of Aztec citrus bitters to add depth to the mid-palate.

title: St Innocent Cuvee Village Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and beautifully balanced red wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Willamette Valley AVA of Oregon. St. Innocent was founded in 1988 by winemaker Mark Vlossak, who spent decades cementing the estate's reputation as a benchmark producer of terroir-driven Oregon Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. Today, the winery operates under a winemaking philosophy that values restraint, balance, and site transparency. The "Cuvée Village" bottling is intentionally crafted as a regional masterclass, blending fruit from select, sustainably farmed estate parcels and partner vineyards to deliver an authentic, approachable expression of the valley’s unique volcanic and sedimentary soils.

Wine Description

The 2022 St. Innocent Cuvée Village Pinot Noir presents a bright, translucent ruby appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is high-toned, elegant, and classic, opening with an expressive bouquet of ripe red cherries, wild strawberries, and redcurrants, layered with complex undertones of black tea, forest floor, dried chanterelle mushrooms, and a touch of sweet baking spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and fluid, showcasing a juicy core of bright red fruits. It is characterized by its outstanding, cool-climate freshness and a vibrant backbone of acidity that keeps the palate lively and precise. The mouthfeel is silkier and more rounded than many of the single-vineyard bottlings, supported by fine-grained, supple tannins that glide into a long, clean, and savory finish detailed by lingering notes of earth and spice.

This 100% Pinot Noir reached a well-balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5%. Following a meticulous manual harvest, the grapes were destemmed and fermented in small, temperature-controlled open-top fermenters using native yeasts. To build textural depth and harmonize the structure without overwhelming the delicate Pinot Noir aromatics, the wine was matured for several months in French oak barrels (utilizing a very low percentage of new wood). Reflecting Mark Vlossak's core principles, the fruit is sourced from certified sustainable vineyards that prioritize natural soil health and biodiversity.

title: Altos Las Hormigas Malbec Clasico Organico 2023
bodyHtml:
While Altos Las Hormigas was founded in 1995 by Tuscan winemaking giants Alberto Antonini and Antonio Morescalchi to champion Malbec, the estate has undergone a profound modern evolution. Driven by world-renowned terroir expert Pedro Parra, the winery shifted completely away from heavy oak extraction and over-ripe fruit.

The Clásico Orgánico represents the pinnacle of this "new wave" style—a certified organic, entry-level powerhouse fermented entirely with native yeasts and aged without wood to preserve the honest, pure personality of Mendoza’s soils.

Wine Description

The Altos Las Hormigas Clásico is a highly vibrant, fresh, and energetic red wine that trades heavy oak and sweet jam for an authentic, fluid, and mineral-lined texture.

  • Appearance: A concentrated, bright ruby red with vivid violet hues at the rim.

  • Nose: Intensely aromatic and characterful. Rather than smelling of vanilla or wood, it bursts with fresh red plums, black cherries, and raspberries, intricately lifted by savory complex top notes of anise, cardamom, black pepper, and eucalyptus. It also showcases a distinct hint of jarilla (a native wild shrub found in Mendoza's high deserts).

  • Palate: Fluid, sleek, and exceptionally juicy. The palate entry is remarkably clean and medium-bodied, delivering a fresh, primary core of dark stone fruit and a hint of dark chocolate. It features a loose, lightly grippy texture with fine, supple tannins and a vertical, linear acidity that completely cleanses the palate on a lingering, thirst-quenching finish.

  • Technical Details: 100% Malbec. The fruit is a strategic blend sourced from organically grown vineyards in Luján de Cuyo (70%), which provides rich texture, and Paraje Altamira in the Uco Valley (30%), which injects limestone minerality and vertical acidity. The grapes were hand-harvested and fermented cold in stainless steel tanks for 10 days with 5% whole clusters and native yeasts. Extraction was kept to an absolute minimum. To guarantee fruit purity, the wine was aged for 9 months entirely in concrete vats with zero oak influence. Alcohol sits at 13.9% ABV with a bone-dry residual sugar of 2.7 g/L.

Food Pairing

Because this Malbec is unoaked and highly fresh, it avoids the heavy, palate-fatiguing weight of old-school styles, making it exceptionally versatile with food. It is an elite match for classic Argentine empanadas, grilled choripán (sausage), and barbecued skirt steak. It is equally delicious paired with everyday family fare, including hearty tomato-based pasta dishes, breaded veal cutlets (milanesa), or roasted root vegetables tossed in rosemary and olive oil.

title: Altos Las Hormigas Blanco 2025
bodyHtml:
This vibrant, heritage-focused white wine originates from Argentina, specifically the high-altitude Uco Valley in Mendoza. Altos Las Hormigas—founded in 1995 by renowned Tuscan winemaker Alberto Antonini and entrepreneur Antonio Morescalchi—is globally famous as a premier terroir specialist for red Malbec.

However, this bottling represents a highly innovative and exciting white program for the estate. Instead of turning to typical international grapes like Chardonnay or Sauvignon Blanc, they chose to champion three historic, traditional white varieties of Mendoza, sourcing the fruit from incredibly old, 80-year-old pergola-trained (parral) vines.

Wine Description

The Altos Las Hormigas Blanco is an incredibly fresh, texturally intriguing, and mineral-lined white wine crafted "without makeup" to let its native soil shine.

  • Appearance: A bright, greenish-yellow hue with clean, steel-colored reflections.

  • Nose: Highly complex, expressive, and unique. It opens with an eclectic mix of kumquat, white peach, and pineapple, layered with sophisticated undertones of white pepper, wild desert shrubs (jarilla), fresh jalapeño, and a gentle touch of honey and wet wool.

  • Palate: Highly juicy and beautifully structured. The mouthfeel is surprisingly tactile and weighted, yet driven aggressively by a sharp, linear natural acidity. Flavors of citrus and orchard fruits give way to a genuinely distinctive, thirst-quenching saline and floral finish.

  • Technical Details: A traditional blend of 80% Chenin Blanc, 15% Pedro Giménez, and 5% Semillón. The fruit was harvested early from 80-year-old vines in deep, silty-limestone soils across San Carlos and Paraje Altamira. To build texture without adding oak weight, winemaker Federico Gambetta fermented the grapes separately using native yeasts in concrete vats—a portion was treated traditionally, a section was fermented with skin contact, and another part included up to 40% grape stems (escobajo). The wine was aged for 6 months entirely in concrete. It sits at a low, highly drinkable 12.0% ABV and is bone-dry (1.80 g/L residual sugar).

Food Pairing

Because of its distinct salinity, herbal top notes, and cutting acidity, this blend is an absolute powerhouse at the dining table. It acts as an ideal starter wine or aperitif alongside fresh seafood salads, raw oysters, and ceviche. It also pairs effortlessly with lighter white meats, chicken salad sandwiches, baked river fish in a light herb butter sauce, or soft-ripened cheeses like Brie and fresh goat cheese.

title: Massimago Amarone Della Valpolicella 2018
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Amarone della Valpolicella D.O.C.G. appellation of the Veneto region. Massimago is a historic estate dating back to 1883, completely revitalized in 2003 by Camilla Rossi Chauvenet, who transformed the property into a modern, dynamic, and fashion-forward benchmark for the region. The estate operates under a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes elegance, freshness, and organic purity, intentionally moving away from the overly heavy, sweet, or jammy styles historically associated with the region. Sourced from a hidden valley in Mezzane di Sotto, the vines are rooted in clay-limestone soils at elevations up to 350 metres above sea level, benefiting from constant breezes that preserve crucial fruit acidity.

Wine Description

The 2018 Massimago Amarone della Valpolicella presents an intense, deep ruby appearance with brilliant garnet reflections at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant and complex, opening with an expansive bouquet of dried cherries, wild blackberries, and red plums, beautifully layered with sophisticated undertones of dehydrated rose petals, dark chocolate, tobacco leaf, and a distinct hint of black pepper. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, enveloping, and remarkably fresh, showcasing a rich, savory fruit core that avoids any cloying weight. It is characterized by its outstanding structural drive, supported by a vibrant backbone of mineral acidity that perfectly lifts the high alcohol. The mouthfeel is velvety and fluid, driven by firm, fine-grained tannins that carry into an incredibly long, dry finish highlighted by lingering notes of espresso bean, liquorice, and balsamic herbs.

title: Terravista Vineyards Fandango 'Proyecto Terruno' 2024
bodyHtml:
Terravista Vineyards is a boutique winery located on the prestigious Naramata Bench in the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia. Founded with a unique focus on Spanish white varietals, Terravista famously pioneered planting Albariño and Verdejo in Canada.

The 2024 Fandango represents a highly historic, unique chapter for the winery. Following a catastrophic winter freeze in early 2024 that decimated grapevines across British Columbia, the provincial government temporarily permitted wineries to import fruit to survive. Terravista launched the "Proyecto Terruño" (Terroir Project), utilizing their winemaking expertise to craft their signature blend using premium Pacific Northwest and California fruit.

Wine Description

The Terravista Fandango 2024 is a vibrant, highly aromatic, and beautifully structured white wine that mimics the estate's classic Naramata style with a broader textural lens.

  • Appearance: Brilliant, clear pale straw with greenish reflections.

  • Nose: Expressive and perfumed. The bouquet opens with intense notes of jasmine, honeysuckle, and orange blossom, mingling seamlessly with ripe white peach, Bartlett pear, and fresh lemon zest.

  • Palate: Smartly composed and highly tactile. The entry is creamy and padded, delivering succulent flavors of fragrant apricot, pomelo, and lemons dipped in honey. Albariño provides a racy, electric, and mouthwatering acidity, while the Verdejo grounds the blend with a subtle kiss of melon and green herbal notes. The finish is snappy, clean, and accented by a persistent saline minerality.

  • Technical Details: A dry blend of 51% Albariño and 49% Verdejo. The Albariño was sourced from the acclaimed Evergreen Vineyard (Ancient Lakes AVA, Washington) and Grand Island Vineyard (Clarksburg, California). The Verdejo was sourced from Sheep Ranch Vineyard (Dunnigan Hills, California). Winemaker Nadine Kinvig fermented the bulk in stainless steel to retain zesty freshness, while a portion of the Albariño was fermented in concrete eggs to build mid-palate weight and a creamy texture. Alcohol content sits at 13.0% ABV with 0.0 g/L residual sugar (bone-dry).

Food Pairing

Fandango's signature combination of intense aromatics, structural weight, and crisp acidity makes it a textbook "chameleon" at the dining table. It is an absolute standout alongside seafood dishes, particularly moules au vin blanc (mussels in white wine), garlic-butter prawns, or grilled halibut. It balances effortlessly with fresh Mediterranean tapas, herb-crusted goat cheese, or a zesty arugula and feta salad.

title: Frog's Leap Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'classic' red wine originates from the United States, within the Napa Valley region of California and the specific appellation of Rutherford. Sourced entirely from the historic Rutherford bench, Frog's Leap was founded in 1981 by John Williams and has spent decades acquiring highly sought-after land to perfect its craft. Today, the estate is guided by John and Rory Williams alongside vineyardist Frank Leeds. The winemaking team operates under a strict philosophy of balance, restraint, and deep respect for the natural expression of the vine, utilizing minimal cellar intervention to capture the true essence of its unique ten-square-mile terroir.

Wine Description

Frog's Leap Estate Cabernet Sauvignon presents an opaque ruby appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is wonderfully deep and aromatic, opening with cassis-currant aromas and the classic notes of 'Rutherford Dust', layered with earthen flavours of cedar, black olive, tobacco, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and beautifully balanced, showcasing a velvety, plush mouthfeel with suppleness to the mid-palate and lightly tactile, powdery tannins. It is characterized by its signature restraint and a seriously savoury streak that gives the wine tremendous freshness and lift, concluding with a long, elegant finish accented by lingering spices and mouthwatering acidity.

This expression is a traditional blend consisting of 91% Cabernet Sauvignon and 9% Cabernet Franc, sourced across the Chavez-Leeds, Williams-Rossi, and Red Barn estate vineyards. The fruit was completely destemmed and fermented on its native yeasts over 10 to 15 days before undergoing natural malolactic fermentation. The wine reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.0% and was matured in French oak barrels (25% new) for 20 months before being bottled unfined and unfiltered. Reflecting the core values of the estate, the vines average 20 years of age and are 100% certified organic and dry-farmed in gravelly loam soils.

title: Chateau Lassegue Vertical Collectors - 3 Bottle Pack (2019/2020/2021)
bodyHtml:
Chateau Lassegue Vertical Collectors 3 Bottle Pack (2019/2020/2021) offers an exceptional journey through the premier terroir of France, situated in the renowned Saint Emilion Grand Cru appellation of Bordeaux. This historic estate, adorned with an elegant 18th-century chateau, is co-owned by the Jackson and Seillan families, who combined Californian vision with deep-rooted French tradition. Driven by the philosophy of legendary vigneron Pierre Seillan, the winery focuses on micro-terroir management to craft complex, age-worthy wines that authentically reflect the unique clay and limestone hillside soils.

Wine Description

This collectors pack showcases a fascinating progression of deep ruby and violet-hued red blends that evolve beautifully from one year to the next. Across the vertical, the aromatic profile is intensely expressive, greeting the nose with dark plums, black cherry liqueur, and cassis, seamlessly interwoven with delicate notes of rose petals, licorice, and toasted spices. On the palate, these medium- to full-bodied wines display remarkable freshness, depth, and structural precision. The velvety, Merlot-driven mid-palate reveals layers of red fruit, truffle, and an iron-rich minerality, all framed by fine-grained, powdery tannins and a long, elegant finish. Featuring a traditional varietal composition of Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Cabernet Sauvignon, this collection boasts incredible balance and complexity, with an optimal drinking window that extends effortlessly through 2038.

Accolades

  • 'James Suckling - 96 points.' (2019 Vintage)

  • 'James Suckling - 95 points.' (2020 Vintage)

  • 'James Suckling - 94 points.' (2021 Vintage)

  • 'Decanter - 93 points.' (2021 Vintage)

Food Pairing

The structural sophistication and vibrant acidity of these right bank blends make them a perfect accompaniment to slow-roasted pork, prime rib eye steaks, or rich duck confit. They also pair wonderfully with earthy mushroom risottos and aged, creamy cheeses like Camembert.

title: Crush-It Hard Iced Tea 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Crush-It Hard Iced Tea represents a modern, craft-conscious shift in the rapidly growing hard tea category across Western Canada. Produced by Radouga Distilleries in Saskatchewan the artisanal team behind the award-winning Provincial Vodka Crush-It was designed to disrupt a market saturated with hyper-sweet, syrupy macro-coolers. Positioned as a cleaner, more adult alternative to mass-market giants, this vodka-based iced tea utilizes real, natural ingredients to mimic the experience of an authentic, home-brewed southern sweet tea.

Ready to Drink Description

Crush-It Hard Iced Tea pours a completely clear, rich amber-bronze color, looking identical to a freshly steeped batch of black tea with soft, minimal effervescence.

Aroma: The nose is clean, deep, and beautifully authentic. It leads with dominant notes of earthy, freshly brewed black tea leaves, followed by a bright, refreshing hint of citrus lemon zest. There are zero synthetic or chemical candy aromas; it smells entirely natural, crisp, and clean.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a remarkably smooth, uncarbonated mouthfeel that mimics traditional iced tea. It leads with a delicate flavor of steeped orange pekoe tea and a touch of real lemon juice, which is anchored by a mild, natural sweetness. Unlike its competitors, it finishes exceptionally crisp and dry, highlighting a pleasant tannic tea-leaf bitterness that cleanses the palate completely.

Profile: It sits at an approachable 5.0% ABV and, as a spirit-based beverage, contains 0 IBU, relying on tea tannins rather than hops for structure. It is naturally gluten-free and off-dry.

Technical Notes: The exceptional smoothness of Crush-It stems from its premium spirit base: Radouga Distilleries' own Provincial Vodka, which is multiple-times distilled from locally grown prairie grains. Instead of masking cheap alcohol with heavy high-fructose corn syrup, the liquid is blended using filtered water, all-natural black tea extracts, and just enough real sugar to balance the citrus components. This low-sugar, additive-free philosophy ensures that the vodka remains completely transparent, leaving no heavy, cloying residual sugar behind.

title: Domaine Laroche Chablis Premier Cru Les Beauroys 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'symmetrical' white wine originates from France, within the prestigious Chablis Premier Cru AOC of the northern Burgundy region. Domaine Laroche is an absolute pillar of the Chablis scene, tracing its historic roots back to the 9th century when the Canons of Saint-Martin of Tours first built the Obédiencerie monastery in Chablis to cultivate vineyards. Today, the house is part of the Advini group and continues to age its finest selections inside these millennial vaults. The estate operates under a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes purity of place, capturing the distinct geological nuances of Chablis' multi-faceted terroirs. Located on the left bank of the Serein River, the "Les Beauroys" vineyard plot sits on a steep, south-facing hillside that is frequently swept by drying east winds, making it one of the most characteristically warm, sun-kissed Premier Crus in the appellation.

Wine Description

The Domaine Laroche Premier Cru Les Beauroys presents a bright, pale straw-yellow appearance in the glass with subtle greenish reflections. Its sensory profile is wonderfully expressive, charming, and solar, unfolding a crisp bouquet of fresh green apples, ripe nectarines, lemon rind, and dried orange peel layered with highly distinct notes of star anise, sweet pastry, and warm spices. On the palate, the wine is mid-bodied, supple, and beautifully balanced, seamlessly coating the mouth with flavors of yellow orchard fruits, stone fruits, and sun-warmed river stones. It is characterized by an outstanding, finely tuned mineral freshness and a chiseled, tensile acidity that keeps the generous texture vibrant and precise. The finish is remarkably elegant and clean, culminating in a lingering, subtley saline quality mixed with hints of chalk and crushed sea shells.

This 100% Chardonnay typically reaches an alcohol content (ABV) of 12.5%. Vinification takes place under strict temperature control, and the wine is matured for roughly 9 months on its fine lees, with a minor portion (around 30%) resting in neutral French oak barrels to introduce texture and aromatic complexity without masking the fruit. Reflecting the domain's dedicated environmental commitment, the vineyard blocks are certified under the strict Haute Valeur Environnementale (HVE 3A) sustainable agricultural standards.

title: Compass Box Crimson Casks Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
bodyHtml:
Compass Box Crimson Casks originates from Scotland and was introduced as an essential pillar of the brand's permanent "Core Four" lineup, alongside Nectarosity, The Peat Monster, and Orchard House. Master Whiskymaker James Saxon designed this expression to celebrate the "magic of metamorphosis" that occurs when rich spirit interacts with heavily seasoned wood. It acts as an unapologetically bold, dessert-forward homage to the house's "Cask is King" philosophy.

Spirit Description

This expression is a Blended Malt Scotch Whisky matured heavily in first-fill Oloroso sherry-seasoned butts and red wine casks, with supporting elements from ex-bourbon and custom French oak barrels. It presents a deep, burnt burgundy or crimson-tinted amber appearance with a rich, oily body.

  • The Component Blend: Composed of single malt parcels from distilleries including Glen Moray, Benrinnes, and Teaninich. It also features a significant portion (around 35%) of single malt from a distillery "near the town of Aberlour," and a small percentage of a Highland malt blend finished in toasted French oak.

  • Aroma: Powerful and intense. It opens with sweet, fizzy dark cherries, pomegranate, molasses, and dark chocolate brownie, accented by deep notes of spicy oak, clove, and cardamom.

  • Palate: Rich, creamy, and velvety. The entry delivers a punchy wave of chili dark chocolate, plum jam, and redcurrant jelly. This builds into a complex mid-palate of stewed fruits, hoisin sweetness, and a buttery, savory crunch.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long, warm, and highly satisfying. It leaves lingering notes of rooibos tea, honey-roasted cashews, brown sugar, and a comforting, dry cinnamon spice.

  • ABV: 46% (Natural colour, non-chill filtered)

Accolades

Crimson Casks has been widely praised by enthusiasts and critics alike for successfully taking over the mantle from some of the brand's historical sherried favorites (like The Story of the Spaniard or Spice Tree). Industry panels, including reviewers at The Whiskey Wash and WhiskyNotes, have lauded the blend for its unapologetic intensity, rich mouthfeel, and excellent value within the craft blended malt category.

Food Pairing

Because Crimson Casks is blended for sheer abundance and bold flavor rather than quiet subtlety, it performs spectacularly alongside intense food profiles:

  • Cheese: It is practically screaming for a food pairing—specifically heavy, pungent options like an artisanal blue cheese or a sharp, crystalline aged cheddar.

  • Dessert: The distillery explicitly recommends drizzling a splash of Crimson Casks directly over premium vanilla bean ice cream to unlock hidden flavors of fig and cinnamon. It also perfectly matches a dense slice of chocolate fudge cake or dark cherry tarts.

  • Savoury: Its unique savory undertones allow it to stand up beautifully next to rich, umami dishes like slow-roasted pork belly or duck legs glazed in plum sauce.

title: Punset Barbaresco Campo Quadro Riserva 2016
bodyHtml:
This profound and 'monumental' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Barbaresco Riserva D.O.C.G. appellation of the Piedmont region. Punset, located in Neive, is a historic estate led by the visionary Marina Marcarino, who famously converted the entire property to organic farming in 1987 making Punset one of the absolute pioneers of organic viticulture in Langhe long before it was fashionable. The name "Punset" stems from a Piedmontese legend describing how the counts of Neive would look down from their castle at the mist-shrouded valley and call the view punset, or a beautiful point. Sourced exclusively from a tiny, steeply sloped single vineyard within the renowned San Cristoforo cru, the estate operates under a strict philosophy of zero compromise, allowing the Nebbiolo grape to express its raw terroir with minimal cellar manipulation.

Wine Description

The 2016 Punset 'Campo Quadro' Barbaresco Riserva presents an elegant garnet red appearance with classic orange-tawny highlights at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally deep, complex, and intellectual, opening with an ethereal bouquet of dried red roses, tar, and sour cherries, layered with sophisticated tertiary notes of leather, truffles, damp forest floor, and dark tobacco leaf. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, structural, and fiercely traditional, showcasing a concentrated core of red currants, dried cranberries, and iron-like mineral depths. It is characterized by its outstanding, mouthwatering acidity and an unyielding, tight-knit structural framework driven by robust, chalky tannins. The finish is remarkably persistent and austere, culminating in an elegant, bone-dry wave of wild herbs, orange peel, and crushed stones.

This 100% Nebbiolo wine reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5%. Following Marina's traditionalist philosophy, the grapes underwent a lengthy maceration and spontaneous fermentation on native yeasts in concrete vats without temperature control. To honor the strict aging laws of the Riserva classification and let the wine naturally soften, it was aged for several years in large, neutral Slavonian oak casks (botti grandi) before being bottled unfined and unfiltered, followed by extensive bottle cellarage. True to the estate's heritage, the old vines are 100% certified organic and farmed using biodynamic principles.

title: Compass Box Nectarosity
bodyHtml:
Compass Box Nectarosity originates from Scotland and was introduced in late 2024 as part of a major core portfolio relaunch by the acclaimed independent blending house. It was created by Lead Whiskymaker James Saxon, who drew inspiration from the vibrant, inventive energy of London’s contemporary patisserie and pop-up baking scene. Nectarosity was designed to stand alongside staples like The Peat Monster and Orchard House, anchoring the brand's new permanent "Core Four" lineup.

Spirit Description

True to the "whisky meets patisserie" concept, Nectarosity is a brilliantly engineered Blended Scotch with a high single malt content (around 65%). The structural core relies on a fascinating, dual-use cask process: virgin American oak barrels are first used to age grain spirit for a year to temper the wood, and are then reused to age malt whisky.

  • The Component Blend: Built from 11 different parcels spanning 5 distilleries, combining grain whiskies from Girvan and Cameronbridge with single malts from Clynelish, Linkwood, and Balmenach. Maturation also incorporates first-fill bourbon barrels and Palo Cortado sherry-seasoned casks.

  • Aroma: Highly decadent and sweet. It opens like a warm banana-walnut loaf slathered in salted butter, evolving into vanilla custard biscuits, tinned peaches, orange zest, and a subtle hint of honeysuckle.

  • Palate: Velvety and thick on the tongue. It delivers a rich, tropical wave of poached pears, lychee, juicy apricot jam, and pineapple chunk sweetness, evoking the mouthfeel of vanilla ice cream.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and comforting, with the sugary brightness giving way to a rich, lasting note of freshly baked cinnamon buns and sweet wood polish.

  • ABV: 46% (Natural colour, non-chill filtered)

Accolades

Nectarosity was met with immediate critical acclaim upon its debut, widely praised for bringing a modern, accessible dynamism back to the blended Scotch category. It earned a stellar 91 Point Score from Whisky Advocate, with reviewers highly impressing upon its balanced complexity and spectacular value.

Food Pairing

Because it was literally designed to mimic the qualities of high-end baking, Nectarosity pairs beautifully with pastries and rich, buttery desserts:

  • Dessert & Pastry: Match it with a flaky, buttery croissant, a classic fruit-forward Peach Melba, or a rich crème brûlée, where the whisky's vanilla and orchard-fruit notes cut right through the dairy.

  • Savoury & Craft Beer: Compass Box officially recommends pairing Nectarosity as a "boilermaker" alongside a dry, crisp Pilsner; the beer’s sharp carbonation acts as a beautiful palate cleanser against the whisky's thick, syrupy caramel weight.

  • Cocktail Use: Its juicy, fruit-forward backbone makes it an exceptional base for a modified Whisky Sour enhanced with a small splash of apricot liqueur.

title: Terravista Vineyards Albarino 'Proyecto TerruNo' Grand Island 2024
bodyHtml:
Terravista Vineyards, located on the acclaimed Naramata Bench in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley, is widely recognized as a Canadian pioneer for Iberian grape varieties. Following a severe winter freeze in early 2024 that devastated local crop yields across British Columbia, the winery launched its "Proyecto Terruño" (Terroir Project). This initiative allowed the estate to sustain its production by sourcing premium fruit from select Pacific Northwest and California vineyards.

This specific single-vineyard bottling features Albariño sourced from the family-owned Grand Island Vineyard, located in the Clarksburg AVA of California's Sacramento Delta. This site is celebrated for its maritime-influenced microclimate, which mirrors the grape's native European conditions.

Wine Description

The Terravista Albariño "Proyecto Terruño" Grand Island 2024 is a crisp, highly energetic, and mineral-driven white wine that beautifully translates California fruit through a precise Okanagan winemaking lens.

  • Appearance: Brilliant, clear pale straw-yellow with subtle platinum glints.

  • Nose: Highly expressive and aromatic. The bouquet bursts with primary scents of lime zest, green apple, and white peach, accented by delicate top notes of jasmine and wild white blossoms.

  • Palate: The wine enters with a focused, linear precision. It offers vibrant flavors of pink grapefruit, sea salt, and lemon pith, supported by a mouthwatering, "crunchy" acidity. Thanks to specialized cellar techniques, the palate transitions into a textured, smooth mid-palate before culminating in a long, refreshing, and clean saline finish.

  • Technical Details: 100% Albariño. The fruit was hand-harvested from the Grand Island Vineyard in Clarksburg, California. To preserve the pure varietal character, winemaker Nadine Kinvig fermented the wine primarily in stainless steel tanks. However, a portion was fermented and aged in concrete eggs, a method that introduces gentle oxygenation and lees contact to build a creamy textural weight without masking the fruit. The wine is bone-dry (0.0 g/L residual sugar) with an alcohol content of 13.0% ABV.

Food Pairing

This wine’s distinct saline character and zesty, refreshing acidity make it a perfect match for fresh seafood. It pairs exceptionally well with raw oysters on the half shell, ceviche, and grilled sardines. It is also a wonderful companion for light summer fare, such as a citrusy arugula salad with goat cheese, fish tacos with lime crema, or traditional Spanish tapas like gambas al ajillo (garlic prawns).

title: Domaine des Garriguettes Châteauneuf du Pape La Borne 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and incredibly pure red wine originates from France, within the prestigious Châteauneuf-du-Pape AOC of the Southern Rhône valley. The estate is based in Châteauneuf-de-Gadagne (affectionately dubbed 'the other Châteauneuf') and is guided by Sébastien Clément, a talented young winemaker with a fast-growing global reputation. Sébastien infuses a modern lightness of touch into his ancestral estate, managing the vineyards with a deep respect for natural rhythms. Sourced from old vines rooted in traditional clay-limestone soils strewn with galets roulés (rounded river stones), the rare "La Borne" bottling represents a highly focused expression designed to mirror the structural depth and mineral freshness of the region.

Wine Description

The 2023 Domaine des Garriguettes Châteauneuf-du-Pape "La Borne" presents a beautiful crimson colour. The nose opens with an explosive bouquet of juicy black cherries and wild blackberries, layered with hints of wild strawberries, thyme, and smooth chocolate. On the palate, the wine is supple and beautifully balanced, showcasing a core of stone-flecked fruit held together by fine, velvety tannins. It is characterized by an outstanding, mineral-driven freshness that carries into a remarkably long finish of warm stones and savory spices. This organic and biodynamic blend consists of 95% Grenache and 5% Mourvèdre. Sourced from old vines, the fruit underwent 95% whole-bunch fermentation to preserve structural lift before aging for 18 months in large, neutral 600-litre oak barrels. The wine is bottled unfined and unfiltered with an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5%.

title: Templ Golden Lager (Non Alcoholic) 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This beverage originates from Canada. It is produced by Templ Brewing, a Calgary based brand that focuses on crafting traditional style non alcoholic beers for the Canadian market. The brewery aims to pay homage to time honoured classics while providing a satisfying and easy drinking alternative to standard lagers.

Non Alcoholic Description

The beer pours clean and bright, displaying a familiar golden hue in the glass. The aroma is characterized by clean, traditional lager notes with a fresh and satisfying profile. On the palate, it delivers a smooth and well balanced flavour with a substantial but easy drinking full body and perfect carbonation levels. The finish is clean with a great length, offering a crisp and refreshing experience. It is noted for being a dependable craft option with significantly fewer calories than average beer.

title: Sadler's Peaky Blinder Irish Whiskey - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Sadler's Peaky Blinder Irish Whiskey originates from Ireland, specifically sourced from the renowned West Cork Distillers in Skibbereen, County Cork. The brand was developed by Sadler’s Ales, a historic craft brewery founded in 1861 in the Black Country region of the West Midlands, England, and is currently owned by Halewood Artisanal Spirits. Named after the infamous late 19th and early 20th-century street gang, the bottle features an authentic police archive mugshot of real-life gang member Stephen McHickie, paying homage to the prominent Anglo-Irish community in Birmingham during that era.

Spirit Description

This expression is a small-batch, triple-distilled blended Irish whiskey that has been finished in ex-bourbon and Oloroso sherry casks. It presents a deep amber-gold hue with a light to medium body.

  • Aroma: An inviting and sweet nose leading with blackcurrants, toffee-covered apples, banana bread, and dark honey, backed by a faint grain mash undertone.

  • Palate: Highly approachable and smooth, opening with fresh green pears and vanilla extract. It quickly transitions into a spicier profile featuring cracked black pepper, dried orange peel, and warm cinnamon.

  • Finish: Crisp and of medium length, leaving lingering hints of burnt fruitcake, ginger, and a light, dry woodiness.

  • ABV: 40%

Food Pairing

The fruit and spice characteristics of this sherry-finished blend make it a fantastic, easy-drinking partner for everyday pub-style fare and sweet treats:

  • Savoury: Complements classic pub dishes like a rich steak and ale pie, glazed pork belly, or a traditional Irish beef stew, where the grain sweetness balances the rich gravy.

  • Cheese: Pairs beautifully with mild, nutty cheeses such as an un-aged Gouda or a creamy white cheddar.

  • Dessert: An excellent accompaniment to autumn-inspired desserts like apple crumble with vanilla custard, warm gingerbread, or bread pudding, which mirror the whiskey's baking spice and toffee notes.

title: Terravista Vineyards Terrior Project Syrah 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and 'expressive' red wine originates from Canada, within the celebrated Naramata Bench sub-region of British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Terravista Vineyards was originally founded in 2008 by industry veterans Bob and Senka Tennant before being acquired by Dallas and Eric Thor in 2019. The estate operates under a winemaking philosophy that heavily honors micro-terroir precision, utilizing a site-specific strategy to capture the distinct environmental signatures of the bench. Sourced for their "Terroir Project," this small-lot Syrah highlights a dedication to tracking how Rhône varieties adapt to the cool-climate, glacio-fluvial gravelly soils and unique lake-moderated topography of the Okanagan.

Wine Description
