Terravista Vineyards Terroir Project Syrah presents a deep ruby-purple appearance with an opaque core in the glass. Its sensory profile is remarkably fragrant, high-toned, and classic, opening with an expressive bouquet of fresh wild blackberries, dark plums, and cracked black pepper, beautifully layered with complex hints of violets, dried savory herbs, and a touch of cured meat. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and texturally rich, showcasing a pure core of dark mountain berries and stone fruits. It is characterized by an outstanding, cool-climate freshness and a vibrant backbone of acidity that perfectly balances its natural fruit weight. The mouthfeel is held together by fine, well-integrated tannins that carry into a long, clean finish highlighted by lingering notes of graphite, spice, and savory earth.

This 100% Syrah was carefully vinified in small batches to ensure a precise and gentle extraction of flavors. To protect the absolute purity of the fruit and its Naramata origin, the winemakers utilized a restrained barrel program featuring neutral oak barrels, allowing the wine to develop a supple mid-palate texture without being masked by heavy wood influence. The wine reaches a well-balanced alcohol content (ABV) of approximately 13.5%. Reflecting the estate's core values, the vineyard blocks are managed under strict sustainable agricultural practices.

title: Dacapo Majoli Di Castagnole Monferrato 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and highly expressive red wine originates from Italy, within the Ruchè di Castagnole Monferrato D.O.C.G. appellation of Piedmont. Dacapo is a specialized, boutique estate that operates under a winemaking philosophy deeply rooted in the preservation of rare, indigenous grape varieties and site-specific precision. Sourced entirely from the historic "Majoli" vineyard plot where the vines are nestled on sun-drenched, south-facing slopes rich in limestone and sand the estate focuses on low intervention to let the distinctive, highly aromatic character of Monferrato's local terroir shine through with absolute transparency.

Wine Description

The 2024 Dacapo 'Majoli' Ruchè di Castagnole Monferrato presents a bright ruby-red appearance with brilliant purple highlights in the glass. Its sensory profile is incredibly fragrant and unmistakable, opening with an explosive, high-toned bouquet dominated by wild red roses, fresh violets, and ripe red cherries, seamlessly layered with complex undertones of wild strawberries, white pepper, and aromatic culinary herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, racy, and light on its feet, showcasing a juicy core of red berry fruits and wild spices. It is characterized by its outstanding, mouthwatering acidity and a surprisingly gentle, soft tannin structure that keeps the wine incredibly approachable and fluid. The finish is clean, energetic, and persistent, concluding with a signature aromatic lift of floral notes and crushed stones.

This 100% Ruchè wine reached a well-balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5%. Following a strict manual harvest, the grapes were fermented in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks to protect the pristine, delicate aromatics of the variety. To maintain its explosive fruit purity and crispness, the wine was aged entirely in stainless steel before being bottled, completely bypassing any wood contact. While the estate champions natural biodiversity and sustainable agricultural management across its plots, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Jean Pabiot Pouilly Fume 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and 'flinty' white wine originates from France, within the highly celebrated Pouilly-Fumé AOC of the Central Loire Valley. Domaine Jean Pabiot et Fils is a historic family estate rooted in the village of Loges, where five generations of the Pabiot family have dedicated themselves to mastering the terroir. Today, the domain is expertly guided by Alain and Jérôme Pabiot. The estate operates under a strict winemaking philosophy focused on site transparency, working diligently across their 30-hectare footprint to protect the pure, chiseled varietal expression of the Sauvignon Blanc grape.

Wine Description

Jean Pabiot Pouilly-Fumé presents a bright, pale straw-yellow appearance in the glass with brilliant greenish reflections. Its sensory profile is incredibly precise, fresh, and expressive, opening with a high-toned bouquet of citrus zest, white peach, white currants, and fresh lemongrass, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of gunflint, white flowers, and chalky minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, racy, and beautifully focused, showcasing a juicy core of gooseberry, grapefruit, and stone fruit. It is characterized by an outstanding, mouthwatering acidity and a highly distinct, smoky silex (flint) signature native to the Loire's premium slopes. The mouthfeel is energetic and direct, driving into a lengthy, refreshing finish defined by a lingering, tactile salinity and citrus peel.

This 100% Sauvignon Blanc wine reached a well-balanced alcohol content (ABV) of approximately 13%. Sourced from old vines averaging 30 years of age, the fruit is grown on a unique multi-terroir matrix composed of Kimmeridgian marl, limestone blocks (caillottes), and flint-rich soils. The grapes were gently pressed and fermented using native yeasts in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks. To maximize its natural depth and texture, the wine was matured on its fine lees for several months in stainless steel before bottling, completely bypassing oak contact to safeguard its pristine freshness. Reflecting the domain's strict environmental standards, the property is certified under the strict Haute Valeur Environnementale (HVE 3) sustainable agricultural guidelines.

title: Tantalus Blanc de Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
This premium sparkling wine originates from Canada, specifically the east-facing slopes of the Okanagan Valley in Kelowna, British Columbia. Tantalus Vineyards is highly celebrated for its strict focus on terroir-driven, single-vineyard wines made from some of the oldest vinifera plantings in the country. While they are globally renowned for their electric Rieslings, their traditional-method sparkling program is a benchmark for the region. The Blanc de Noir is crafted exclusively from estate Pinot Noir, showcasing the depth and structural capacity of the variety under cool-climate conditions.

Wine Description

The Tantalus Blanc de Noir 2023 is a deeply complex, generous, yet heavily focused sparkling wine that beautifully pairs lively red-fruit attributes with serious autolytic depth.

  • Appearance: A delicate sunset pink or rose-gold in the glass with an incredibly fine, persistent bead and a velvety mousse.

  • Nose: Highly expressive and inviting. It opens with bright aromas of red apple and raspberry coulis, layered with more complex, secondary notes of roasted cashew, fresh-baked brioche, toasted sourdough, and a hint of early-season strawberry.

  • Palate: Unctuous, structured, and expansive on the palate, yet kept strictly in check by a driving, linear focus. Flavors of Gala apple, pomelo, and pomegranate dominant the entry. The finish is extended and beautifully defined by a subtle mineral edge, a whisper of sea breeze, and a touch of savory, chalky oyster-shell character.

  • Technical Details: 100% Pinot Noir. The fruit was hand-picked early in the season to maintain low sugars and elevated acidity. It was fermented in old oak puncheons and barriques using a Champagne-specific yeast strain, spending 6 months on fermentation lees in barrel. The wine then spent 22 months aging en tirage (on bottle lees) before being disgorged with a small dosage of Pinot Noir to elevate its aromatic profile. Technical stats include an alcohol level of 12.7% ABV, a sharp total acidity of 8.33 g/L, and a well-integrated residual sweetness of 6.34 g/L (Brut style).

Food Pairing

Because this is a Blanc de Noir (made entirely from red grapes), it carries a natural richness and structural gravitas that makes it highly versatile at the dining table. It is an extraordinary match for richer seafood like BC wild salmon, Dungeness crab cakes, or a plate of fresh, brine-forward oysters. Its combination of sharp acidity and creamy yeast character allows it to cut cleanly through fried dishes like tempura, as well as savory charcuterie boards featuring roasted nuts and earthy, semi-firm cheeses like Comte or aged Gouda.

Vintage Quality & Resilience

The 2023 growing season in the Okanagan Valley was a true agricultural rollercoaster. Following an extreme, record-breaking winter cold snap in late December 2022, the vines were very slow to awaken, delaying bud break until early May. Summer brought rapid, accelerated heat alongside the added complexity of regional wildfires, causing a significantly reduced crop yield.

However, the smaller crop resulted in grapes of remarkable flavor concentration. Thanks to meticulous, proactive vineyard management, the fruit stayed pristine and healthy. This allowed Tantalus to harvest early, capturing the bright acidity and delicate finesse required to craft an incredibly polished, vibrant sparkling vintage that will cellar beautifully over the next 5 to 7 years.

title: Altos las Hormigas Cloud Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
While Altos Las Hormigas is universally acclaimed for redefining Argentine Malbec, their experimental "Cloud" lineup features a fascinating exploration of traditional varieties made in an ancestral, light-extraction style.

Historically crafted as a "Clarete" (a medieval-style light, fluid red), the 2024 Cloud Cabernet Sauvignon marks an important evolution for the label. For this specific vintage, the winemaking team shifted their focus away from Luján de Cuyo, moving the entire project to the cooler, high-altitude sub-regions of the Uco Valley to capture a brighter, more vertical, and mineral-lined expression of the variety.

Wine Description

The Altos Las Hormigas Cloud Cabernet Sauvignon 2024 completely subverts the traditional expectation of heavy, over-extracted, oaky Argentine Cabernet, instead delivering a highly fluid tinto built on texture rather than weight.

  • Appearance: A brilliant, translucent light ruby red in the glass.

  • Nose: Highly expressive and distinctly savory. It opens with vibrant primary notes of white pepper, green bell pepper, and fresh jalapeño, before giving way to complex layers of wild plums, blackcurrant (cassis), fresh thyme, bay leaf, and a cooling hint of eucalyptus.

  • Palate: Remarkably agile, fluid, and packed with drinkability. The entry is lively and fruit-forward, moving into a texturally complex mid-palate defined by crunchy stone fruit and juicy, well-polished tannins. Despite its light-footed mouthfeel, the wine has an assertive physical "grip" on the palate, concluding with a long, fresh, and deeply fruity finish.

  • Technical Details: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. The fruit was sourced entirely from 50-year-old, traditional pergola-trained (parral) vines planted in the deep, silty-limestone soils of Casas Viejas (San Carlos, Uco Valley). The grapes were hand-harvested early to preserve natural acidity and fermented cold at 22°C in concrete vats with 30% whole clusters and native yeasts. To emphasize pure fruit identity, it was pressed off early to finish fermentation off the skins, then matured for 6 months entirely in concrete. It sits at 13.5% ABV and is bone-dry (2.5 g/L residual sugar).

Food Pairing

Because the Cloud Cabernet is styled for refreshing fluid agility rather than heavy density, it functions beautifully where heavier red wines fail. It is a spectacular match for stuffed bell peppers, wild boar or game terrines, and flame-grilled lamb chops. Its bright pyrazinic (herbal) and peppery notes also allow it to cut cleanly through roasted rabbit, grilled vegetables, or mild, soft-cured artisanal cheeses.

title: Cakebread Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This crisp white wine originates from the United States, harvested from premier vineyards across California's multi-appellation North Coast, including select estate ranches within Napa Valley. Founded in 1973 by Jack and Dolores Cakebread, Cakebread Cellars has spent over five decades dedicating itself to creating beautifully balanced wines designed to be enjoyed with good food and great company. The family-run winery is an industry leader in environmental stewardship, operating as one of the earliest certified Napa Green wineries while prioritizing regenerative, sustainable farming practices to protect the land for future generations.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc presents a bright, clear appearance, opening with surpassingly fresh and vivid aromas of white flowers, ripe melon, and zesty citrus fruit. On the palate, it reveals a rich yet remarkably crisp body balanced by lively acidity and mineral tones, layers of pink grapefruit, guava, and green apple, and a hint of flinty minerality.

Food Pairing

This zesty, mineral-driven white wine makes a wonderful companion to fresh seafood such as steamed crab legs, pink hopper prawns with yuzu aioli, or grilled seasonal vegetables.

title: Tantalus "Bear" Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from Canada, specifically the cool-climate, east-facing slopes of East Kelowna in British Columbia’s Okanagan Valley. Crafted by Tantalus Vineyards—one of the nation’s premier destination estates for pristine, high-acid vinifera varieties—the "Bear" Chardonnay is named as an affectionate nod to proprietor Eric Savics' eldest son, Eric Jr.

While the estate’s flagship Chardonnay leans into deep structure and extended barrel aging, the "Bear" bottling is purposely envisioned as a highly approachable, energetic, and fruit-driven expression. It highlights the pure, crisp, and mineral-lined personality of the grape without heavy, masking wood influences.

Wine Description

The Tantalus Bear Chardonnay 2025 is a beautifully focused, linear, and texturally engaging cool-climate white wine that seamlessly balances zesty citrus energy with a delicate, fine-lees creaminess.

  • Appearance: Pours a beautiful, luminous pale gold with bright straw reflections.

  • Nose: Highly lifted and instantly aromatic. The bouquet opens with refreshing top notes of lemon pith, fresh sea breeze, and crisp Granny Smith apple, followed closely by subtle, complex layers of orange zest and white rose.

  • Palate: Bright, precise, and layered. The entry delivers a juicy wave of fresh peach, lemon cream, and orchard fruit, intertwined with a distinct, mouthwatering mineral salinity. The mid-palate possesses an incredibly pleasing, slightly chalky yet rounded texture that balances the wine's vibrant, cool-climate energy.

  • Technical Details: 100% Chardonnay. For the 2025 vintage, the wine returned to its roots as a 100% estate-grown blend utilizing premium clones 76, 95, and 548. Harvested between September 20 and October 3, the grapes were gently whole-bunch pressed and fermented completely wild (using ambient yeasts). Winemaker David Paterson utilized a thoughtful combination of neutral French oak barriques (29%), puncheons (37%), and stainless steel tanks (33%) to preserve maximum freshness. The wine spent several months aging on its fermentation lees, undergoing a partial malolactic fermentation (approximately 50–60%) to soften the edge. It sits at a refreshing 12.9% ABV and is bone-dry with just 0.21 g/L of residual sugar.

Food Pairing

Because of its crisp, linear focus and delicate mineral finish, this Chardonnay is incredibly versatile at the dinner table. It is an elite match for fresh seafood and shellfish, pairing beautifully with Dungeness crab dipped in butter, pan-seared halibut, or fresh oysters on the half-shell. Its lively acidity easily cuts through rich, comforting textures like a warm chicken pot pie, mushroom risotto, or pasta tossed in a light lemon-cream sauce. For a cheese course, pour it alongside mild, soft options like a creamy Brie or goat cheese.

Vintage & Cellaring

The 2025 growing season allowed Tantalus to capture an incredibly clean, expressive "first flavor window" of their estate vines, locking in gorgeous aromatics and signature Okanagan acidity. While it has the balance and structural integrity to hold or develop light nuttiness in the cellar over the next 2 to 3 years, the Bear Chardonnay is consciously crafted for pure, immediate, youthful enjoyment.

title: Tantalus Riesling 2025
bodyHtml:
This iconic white wine originates from Canada, grown on the spectacular eastern slopes of the Okanagan Valley overlooking Lake Okanagan in East Kelowna, British Columbia. Tantalus Vineyards is widely regarded as one of the country's absolute benchmark Riesling producers. They operate on a historic site first planted to table grapes in 1927, making it one of the oldest continuously producing vineyards in Western Canada.

While the estate has deep roots with its legendary 1978 "Old Vines" block, this flagship bottling relies heavily on their younger estate blocks planted in 2005, yielding a style renowned for its laser-focused precision, vibrant fruit energy, and electric tension.

Wine Description

The Tantalus Riesling 2025 is a beautifully expressive, energetic, and heavily structured white wine that showcases high-acid purity balanced flawlessly by a touch of natural residual sugar.

  • Appearance: A pale, luminous yellow with clean platinum highlights.

  • Nose: Highly aromatic and instantly captivating. The bouquet bursts with bright aromas of lemon and lime zest, yellow peach, and mandarin orange, layered with hints of grapefruit oil and orange blossom. Deeper nuances of wet stone and green spruce tip add a compelling, earthy intrigue.

  • Palate: Tense, crisp, and incredibly juicy. The palate delivers an absolute wave of mandarin and white grapefruit flavors, evolving into candied lime peel, pineapple, and a distinctive "crunchy" green apple note right through the mid-palate. The finish is extended, mouthwatering, and defined by a signature, chalky dry minerality.

  • Technical Details: 100% Riesling. The fruit was harvested between late September and early October, using a blend of clones 21B (75%) and 49 (25%) from their 2005 estate blocks and a select neighboring East Kelowna Slopes vineyard. The grapes were gently whole-bunch pressed and fermented cold in stainless steel. The wine was kept resting on its fine lees for 3.5 months to build subtle texture. Structurally, it sits at 12.2% ABV with a soaring, electric total acidity of 9.45 g/L, balanced by 14.9 g/L of residual sweetness (making it a textbook off-dry style that drinks like a dry wine due to the massive acid).

Food Pairing

Thanks to its powerful, structural acidity and tiny whisper of residual sugar, this Riesling is an elite food wine. It acts as a perfect foil to spicy Asian cuisine, matching flawlessly with Thai green curry, spicy pork potstickers, or sushi with wasabi. It is equally fantastic paired with fresh seafood salads, ceviche, gravlax, or roasted pork belly with an apple glaze. For a cheese course, pour it alongside a fresh, tangy goat cheese.

title: Westons Cider Stowford Press Apple Cider 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Stowford Press is the flagship medium-dry cider from H. Westons & Sons, a deeply historic cider maker that has been fermenting apples in Much Marcle, Herefordshire, England since 1880. First created in the late 1970s specifically to meet the high-volume demand of British pubs, Stowford Press bridges the gap between ancient, rustic farm ciders and modern, hyper-refreshing draughts. It is designed to be highly approachable, clean, and endlessly sessionable. By applying Westons’ generations of expertise to a lighter, brighter format, it has become one of the most popular draught ciders across the United Kingdom.

Beer Description

Stowford Press pours a brilliant, pale straw-gold color with crystal-clear clarity and a lively, fast-rising carbonation that creates a bubbly white collar that quickly clears.

Aroma: The nose is bright, crisp, and fresh. It leads with dominant notes of ripe red dessert apples and sweet apple juice, followed by a subtle, woody undertone of traditional oak vats. It lacks the pungent, wild "farmyard" funk of traditional ciders, smelling entirely clean, light, and fruit-forward.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a brisk, refreshing effervescence. It leads with a gentle wave of juicy apple sweetness, which is quickly balanced by a mild, refreshing acidity. The finish is remarkably clean and medium-dry, leaving behind a subtle, pleasing hint of tannic apple skin that prevents the drink from feeling cloying.

Profile: It sits at a highly sessionable 4.5% ABV (though bottled versions can occasionally be found at 5.0%) and has 0 IBU. It is naturally gluten-free.

Technical Notes: The consistent quality of Stowford Press relies on Westons' access to premium fruit. It is brewed using 100% local bittersweet cider apples grown within a 50-mile radius of the Herefordshire mill. The juice is fermented in temperature-controlled vessels and, unique to Westons, a portion of their cider is traditionally matured in massive, century-old oak vats. This brief oak contact rounds out the sharpest malic acids and imparts a subtle depth of character before the cider is filtered and carbonated for packaging.

title: Robert Mondavi Cabernet Sauvignon Oakville 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'authoritative' red wine originates from the United States, within the highly celebrated Oakville AVA of the central Napa Valley floor. Released under "The Estates" tier, this expression honors the pioneering vision of Robert Mondavi, who established his iconic winery in 1966 as the first major estate built in Napa Valley following Prohibition. Sourced almost exclusively from the legendary, grand cru-caliber To Kalon Vineyard a name translating from ancient Greek as the highest beauty the estate operates under a philosophy of site transparency.

The deep, well-drained gravelly alluvium soils of the Oakville bench naturally restrict vine vigor, forcing root systems deep into the ground to concentrate rich varietal complexity within the berries.

title: Strega Limoncello di Sorrento - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Limoncello di Sorrento Strega originates from the Campania region of southwestern Italy. It is produced by the historic Alberti Benvenuto distillery in Benevento, famous worldwide for its iconic yellow herbal liqueur, Liquore Strega, which dates back to 1860. This premium limoncello is crafted using strict traditional methods and carries the I.G.P. (Indicazione Geografica Protetta) designation, guaranteeing that only authentic, legally protected lemons from the Sorrento peninsula are used.

Spirit Description

This natural liqueur is made by infusing the aromatic peels of hand-picked Sorrento Oval lemons (Massese variety) in premium pure alcohol. It presents a vibrant, bright yellow colour with a rich, velvety body.

  • Aroma: Intensely aromatic, bursting with fresh citrus oils, lemon zest, and a hint of Mediterranean floral sweetness.

  • Palate: Perfectly balanced and sweet, avoiding any harsh sharpness. It coats the palate with a rich, juicy lemon flavour, followed by a bright, refreshing tartness that cuts through the sugar.

  • Finish: Long, crisp, and clean, leaving a lingering essence of sun-ripened citrus peel.

  • ABV: 30%

title: J De Villebois Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This exceptional white wine originates from France, crafted within the renowned Loire Valley region. Founded over 20 years ago by Joost and Miguela de Willebois in the village of Seigy in Touraine, J de Villebois has established itself as a leading specialist in Loire Valley Sauvignon Blanc.

Wine Description

The J de Villebois Sauvignon Blanc presents a beautiful pale yellow colour accented by silver and green highlights. On the nose, it delivers an intense and vibrant aromatic profile featuring green gooseberries, pears, Meyer lemon, and white pepper, elegantly underscored by notes of elderflower and cut grass. The palate is crisp, round, and juicy, combining a medium body with a tense mineral and saline complexity that beautifully mimics the crunch of ripe grapes. Striking a masterful balance between fruitiness and a distinct, simmering acidity, it culminates in a long, flavorful finish with a bright, refreshing touch of bitterness.

Food Pairing

This versatile Sauvignon Blanc pairs magnificently with fresh seafood salad, pan seared scallops, smoked salmon, and baked white fish drizzled in butter sauce.

title: Kir Yianni Paranga White 2025
bodyHtml:
This fresh and 'Mediterranean' white wine originates from Greece, within the P.G.I. Macedonia appellation of Northern Greece. Kir-Yianni was founded in 1997 by Yiannis Boutaris a legendary figure in the Greek wine industry and is currently managed by his son, Stellios Boutaris. The "Paranga" line (meaning the shack in Greek) was named after the nickname affectionately given to the original, modest winery facility in Amyndeon. The estate operates under a philosophy that balances native traditions with an innovative mindset, sourcing grapes from collaborating growers in cool, high-altitude vineyards situated between 600 and 700 metres above sea level where the surrounding regional lakes temper the microclimate.

Wine Description

The Kir-Yianni Paranga White presents a bright, pale lemon appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is highly expressive and charmingly aromatic, opening with an enticing bouquet of jasmine, honeysuckle, and lemon blossom, layered with vibrant notes of white peach, apricot, green apple, and citrus zest. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, crisp, and energetic, showcasing an easy-drinking texture with juicy stone-fruit and mandarin orange layers. It is characterized by its outstanding, mountainous freshness and a zesty, mineral-tinged acidity that guides into a clean, well-rounded, and refreshing finish.

This dry white is a classic indigenous blend composed of 80% Roditis and 20% Malagousia. The late-ripening, pink-skinned Roditis variety provides the structural backbone, lemony crispness, and mineral notes, while the Malagousia grape infuses the blend with its signature floral richness and complex fruit profile. The varieties are hand-picked and vinified separately in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks.

title: El Gran Legado de Vida Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
El Gran Legado de Vida Tequila Reposado is an artisanal, additive-free tequila produced in Jalisco, Mexico. The spirit has generated significant acclaim among enthusiasts for its unique approach to sourcing and production. Rather than using local estate agave, El Gran Legado de Vida sources single-estate blue Weber agave from Michoacán that is harvested at peak maturity (typically around 7 years old). It is distilled at the highly renowned Cascahuín distillery (NOM 1123) in El Arenal, Jalisco, under the watchful eyes of a facility celebrated for its traditional, low-intervention practices.

Spirit Description

The production process is strictly traditional. The Michoacán agaves are cooked via steam injection in Cascahuín’s traditional masonry stone ovens for three days, followed by an extra day to naturally cool down. After being crushed on a roller mill, the juice undergoes natural fermentation in stainless steel tanks. It is double-distilled—first in a stainless steel alembic still with a copper coil, and secondly in a 100% copper alembic still—bringing the distillate off the still at 55% ABV. It is proofed using Cascahuín’s deep well water, stabilized for 15 to 30 days, and aged for roughly 120 days across a masterful blend of three distinct wood formats: American white oak ex-bourbon barrels, Sherry casks, and French oak ex-Martell VSOP Cognac barrels.

  • Colour: Pale straw yellow or light gold, reflecting its short and careful time in wood.

  • Aroma: Highly complex and welcoming. The nose opens with dominant rich cooked agave and baking spices like cinnamon, layered over soft vanilla, butterscotch, leather, and a grounding petrichor or mineral edge.

  • Palate: Velvet-smooth and round on the entry. It balances a natural sweet agave core with the multi-barrel spice complexity, showcasing notes of light anise, black pepper, honey, clementines, green melon, and just a hint of salty brine.

  • Body: Well-balanced, maintaining a medium viscosity that carries excellent grip and structure without feeling heavy or overly oaky.

  • Finish: Long-lasting and cleanly drying, fading out with lingering sweet squash, melon, black pepper, and tame barrel tannins.

  • ABV: Varied by target bottling profile, standard expressions are typically proofed to 40% or 43% (80 or 86 Proof).

title: Peroni 330 ml - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Peroni Nastro Azzurro is Italy’s premier ambassador to the global beer world. Launched in Rome in 1963 by Birra Peroni, its name ("Blue Ribbon") honors the SS Rex, an Italian ocean liner that won the prestigious international Blue Riband trophy in 1933. Engineered to embody the effortlessly chic, Mediterranean lifestyle of the 1960s, this International Pale Lager is a sharp departure from heavy, earthy European lagers. It is defined by its crisp, effervescent profile and a unique ingredient choice that makes it one of the most recognizable and widely exported premium lagers in the world.

Beer Description

Peroni Nastro Azzurro pours a brilliant, crystal-clear, pale prosecco-gold with a lively, fast-moving stream of carbonation and a tight, clean white head.

Aroma: The nose is minimalist, clean, and notably bright. It leads with dominant notes of sweet corn and fresh grain, followed by a delicate, snappy bouquet of subtle citrus peel and earthy noble hops. There are no heavy fruity esters; it smells remarkably crisp, clean, and refreshing.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a highly effervescent, "tingly" mouthfeel. It leads with a flash of delicate cracker sweetness, which is quickly sliced away by a dry, mineral-like crispness. Flavors of light citrus and a subtle, clean bitterness dominate the mid-palate, ending with a short, dry, and exceptionally refreshing finish.

Profile: It sits at a standard 5.1% ABV and a moderate bitterness of 24 IBU, offering a touch more structure and snap than standard domestic mass-market lagers.

Technical Notes: The signature dryness and pale clarity of Peroni come from the inclusion of a proprietary adjunct: Nostrano dell’Isola maize (corn). This specific variety of non-GMO corn is grown exclusively for the brewery in the fertile plains of Lombardy, irrigated by alpine snowmelt. The corn provides fermentable sugars that lighten the beer's body and strip away residual heaviness without masking the crisp profile of the two-row spring barley. It is bittered and aromatized using premium European hops (Saaz and Hallertau Magnum) to anchor the clean finish.

title: CalCario3 Do Principal Reserva Tinto 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and expressive red wine originates from Portugal, within the Bairrada region of Central Portugal. Sourced from the Colinas de São Lourenço estate, the vineyards span 151 acres of gentle, rolling hills dominated by distinctive clay-limestone soils. The entire estate is dry-farmed and operates under an exclusive gravity-flow winemaking philosophy. By using the base of their most iconic red wine ('Principal'), the winemakers intentionally craft this expression to mirror the mineral depth and unique geological footprint of their limestone-rich terroir.

Wine Description

Calcário do Principal Reserva Tinto presents a ruby coloration with deep, opaque nuances. On the nose, it displays an intense and complex aromatic profile highlighting black fruits, dark-earth funk, crushed violets, and lavender, layered with refined undertones of cedar, leather, tea leaves, and graphite. The full-bodied palate is concentrated yet remarkably silky and velvety, wrapping around the mouth with deep flavors of wild mulberries, sweet plum, and blueberries. It is characterized by an outstanding, vibrant acidity and firm, nicely chewy tannins that provide polished edges and exceptional structure. This dry red blend possesses a long, persistent, and highly mineral finish.

title: Antinori Brunello di Montalcino 'Pian delle Vigne' 2009 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'historic' red wine originates from Italy, within the Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation of southern Tuscany. Sourced from the Pian delle Vigne estate, located six kilometers southwest of Montalcino, the property spans 460 total acres with 160 acres dedicated to southwest-facing vineyard plots. Acquired by the Marchesi Antinori family in 1995, the estate draws its name from a characteristic 19th-century railway station situated on the grounds. The winery operates under a traditional philosophy focused on using large oak casks, which elegantly shields the absolute purity of the fruit while maximizing the aging potential of the land.

Wine Description

The 2009 Antinori Brunello di Montalcino 'Pian delle Vigne' presents a deep ruby red colour accented by brilliant garnet highlights. Its sensory profile is rich and exotic, unfolding an expressive bouquet of intense violets, plums, and blackberries layered with complex notes of saddle leather, underbrush, balsam herbs, licorice, and tobacco leaf. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and velvety, showcasing an ample, fruit-forward core of bold red cherries, spice, and dried ginger. It is characterized by its soft, silky tannins, well-integrated oak, and a vibrant backbone of mineral acidity that drives into an exceptionally long, persistent finish defined by hints of espresso, cocoa powder, and candied orange peel.

This 100% Sangiovese wine reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.0%. The harvested grapes were completely destemmed and gently crushed before undergoing alcoholic fermentation and maceration on the skins in stainless steel vats for approximately 12 days at a controlled temperature of 28°C. Following the completion of malolactic fermentation, the wine was transferred into traditional large oak barrels ranging in capacity from 30 hL to 80 hL, where it aged for over two years before being bottled in January 2013. While the estate champions natural biodiversity and sustainable agricultural management across its plains, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Giant Steps Circle of Fifths Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from Australia, within the cool-climate Yarra Valley region of Victoria. Giant Steps was established in 1997 by wine industry pioneer Phil Sexton, who named the winery after John Coltrane's iconic jazz album as a metaphor for his 'giant step' from Margaret River to the Yarra Valley to find the ideal site for Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. The winemaking philosophy, currently led by Head of Winemaking and Viticulture Melanie Chester, focuses on 'tight and transparent' expressions of individual vineyard sites. The Circle of Fifths series represents a 'chord' a harmonious blend of all the winery's single-vineyard parcels into one cohesive wine.

Wine Description

The Giant Steps Circle of Fifths Chardonnay presents a refined and 'taut' sensory profile with a pale straw appearance. The nose is highly aromatic, featuring scents of white nectarine, lemon verbena, and citrus blossom, layered with subtle notes of confit lemon, grilled nuts, and a touch of struck match. On the palate, the wine is concentrated and linear, showcasing flavours of grapefruit pith, white peach, and Meyer lemon underpinned by a 'zingy' acidity and savoury saline minerality. It is characterized by its chalky, tensile structure and an elegant finish that balances fruit energy with a whisper of toasty oak. This 100% Chardonnay is whole-bunch pressed directly to French oak puncheons (approximately 15% to 20% new) and fermented naturally with indigenous yeasts. It typically undergoes a small amount of malolactic fermentation around 10% depending on the season and rests on lees for approximately seven to ten months with minimal stirring to preserve tension.

title: Quinta Da Pedra Milagres Alvarinho 2021
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and structured white wine originates from Portugal, within the Vinho Verde D.O.C. appellation and the prestigious subregion of Monção e Melgaço. Quinta da Pedra is one of the most historical properties in the Alto Minho region, with roots dating back to the 17th century. The estate features 53 hectares of entirely dry-farmed vineyards planted on pure granite soils, managed under a philosophy that values perfect solar exposure and optimal drainage to let the native variety truly excel.

Wine Description

Quinta da Pedra Milagres Alvarinho exhibits a bright lemon-yellow colour in the glass. On the nose, it reveals an expressive and pronounced aromatic profile of fresh stone fruit, citrus, and yellow flowers, layered with notes of stone fruit preserve and wet rocks. The medium-to-full-bodied palate is concentrated yet remarkably fresh, showing a polished, silky texture balanced by a refreshing acidity that cuts beautifully through the mouth.

title: Prunotto Barolo 'Serra' 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'historic' red wine originates from Italy, within the Barolo D.O.C.G. appellation of the Piedmont region. The Prunotto estate, located in Alba, was originally founded as a cooperative in 1904 before being renamed by Alfredo Prunotto in 1923; it has been owned by the Antinori family since 1994. The winery's philosophy balances tradition and innovation, utilizing state of the art technology to interpret the territorial identity of its 65 hectares of vineyards in the Langhe and Monferrato. Serra is an exceptional, prized vineyard located in the southern part of the Serralunga d'Alba commune, and the 2020 vintage represents the first time Prunotto has produced this specific cru in limited quantities.

Wine Description

The 2020 Prunotto Serra Barolo presents a dark garnet red colour in the glass. Its sensory profile is refined and fresh, featuring a bouquet of red fruits, sage, and undergrowth, layered with delicate floral sensations of roses and violets and spicy aromas of pink pepper and ginger. On the palate, the wine is elegant and well balanced, showcasing intense red fruit flavours underpinned by an outstanding freshness and savory, balanced tannins. It is characterized by its silky texture and persistent aftertaste that echoes the fruity notes perceived on the nose. This 100% Nebbiolo reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14% and was aged in large 50 hL oak barrels for at least 18 months. While the estate gives particular attention to sustainable agriculture and manual techniques, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Lagg Small Batch Manzanilla Sherry Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Lagg Single Malt Manzanilla Sherry Finish is a highly limited, cask-strength island single malt Scotch whisky produced at the Lagg Distillery on the southern tip of the Isle of Arran, Scotland. Opened in 2019 by Isle of Arran Distillers, Lagg represents a return to traditional, heavily peated whisky production on the island, deliberately contrasting with the unpeated, fruit-forward style of its northern sister facility, Lochranza Distillery. Launched globally on March 23, 2026, this expression represents the distillery's second exploration into rare and unusual sherry finishes, following their previous Palo Cortado small batch.

Spirit Description

The release bridges Lagg's robust, smoky distillate with rare casks from Sanlúcar de Barrameda—the coastal Andalusian town in Spain where Manzanilla sherry develops its uniquely crisp, saline profile under a layer of flor yeast. The spirit was initially matured in a combination of first- and second-fill ex-bourbon barrels before being transferred into first-fill Manzanilla casks for a secondary finishing period of over one year.

  • Colour: Clear and completely natural gold, bottled without any added colour.

  • Aroma: The nose opens with a maritime wave of bonfire smoke, sea breeze, and coastal sea spray, balanced by delicate green olives, dry sherry spice, lemon peel, green apple, and toasted almonds.

  • Palate: Rich, viscous, and oily. It begins with an initial layer of hot honey sweetness, spiced red fruits, and cherry syrup before transitioning into a heavy mid-palate of ashen bonfire smoke, black pepper, and vanilla cream, anchored by a distinctive salted minerality.

  • Body: Robust and intensely coastal, showing an elegant equilibrium between heavily peated island malt and dry, savory wine architecture.

  • Finish: Long, warming, and progressively drying. It emphasizes a briny, maritime character alongside cracked pepper, citrus oils, toasted oak, and a lingering nuttiness that fades into soft peat embers.

  • ABV: Bottled at a powerful cask strength of 57.6% and produced entirely without chill-filtration.

title: Benromach 15 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Benromach 15 Year Old single malt Scotch whisky originates from the town of Forres within the western bounds of the world renowned Speyside region of Scotland. The distillery is owned and operated by the historic independent bottler Gordon & MacPhail, who purchased and meticulously revived the site in 1993 with a vision to bring back a lost style of whisky. Moving away from the contemporary trends of modern Speyside, the winemakers and distillers deliberately recreate the lightly peated, earthy character that defined the region's classic malts prior to the 1960s.

This expression pours a beautiful, natural dark amber colour, a direct visual testament to its extended interaction with quality oak. The nose offers a dense, wonderfully complex bouquet where sweet toffee and caramel seamlessly intertwine with rich forest fruits, baked cherry tart, and dried banana, all grounded by a distinct thread of cracked black pepper and soft barbecue smoke. On the palate, the mouthfeel is creamy and beautifully rounded, delivering an initial sweetness of ripe apples, stewed plums, and honeyed fudge before evolving into darker notes of orange peel, charred oak, and toasted malt.

title: Chateau Pichon Baron 2015 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Chateau Pichon Baron is an exceptional red wine produced in France, specifically within the Pauillac subregion of the broader Bordeaux area. Classified as a Second Growth in the historic 1855 Bordeaux Classification, the estate is celebrated for its commitment to expressing its unique gravel terroir. Under the dedicated management of AXA Millésimes, the winery prioritizes meticulous vineyard selection and a philosophy of combining classic Pauillac power with modern precision and grace.

Wine Description

In the glass, this wine exhibits an intense, deep garnet red colour with opaque ruby purple reflections. The nose is remarkably expressive and delicate, offering a complex bouquet of summer berries, blackcurrants, and blueberries layered with nuances of graphite, cedarwood, tobacco, and subtle toasted spices. On the palate, the attack is mellow, unfolding into a full bodied and concentrated structure marked by dense, velvety tannins and seamless integration of oak. It balances rich, generous dark fruits with a startling mineral core and vibrant freshness, leading to a juicy, precise, and remarkably persistent finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 94 points

  • Vinous - 97 points

  • Decanter - 99 points

title: Flor de Pingus 2023
bodyHtml:
Flor de Pingus hails from Spain, specifically from the high-altitude subregion of La Horra within the renowned Ribera del Duero region. Dominio de Pingus was founded in 1995 by the legendary Danish oenologist Peter Sisseck, who quickly established the estate as a global icon of Spanish viticulture. Driven by a strict biodynamic philosophy, Sisseck focuses on unlocking the ultimate potential of the region's ancient, low-yielding plots.

Wine Description

This powerful red displays a deep and brilliant purple hue in the glass. The nose boasts exceptional aromatic intensity, leading with crushed blackberries, fresh plums, and seductive violet top notes, all underscored by hints of ginger spice and a delicate touch of integrated oak. On the palate, it is remarkably juicy and ripe yet balanced, revealing layers of black cherry, dark fruit, and savory nuances. The body is elegantly structured with succulent, fine-grained reactive tannins and a vibrant freshness, concluding in a long, harmonious, and chalky mineral finish.

title: Ca dei Frati Lugana 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from Italy, within the Lugana D.O.C. appellation spanning the Lombardy region along the southern shores of Lake Garda. The historic Ca dei Frati estate has deep roots, with records of the house dating back to 1782, though the modern winery truly took form under Domenico Dal Cero and later his son Pietro, who bottled the first house label in 1969. Currently managed by Pietro's wife and children, the family guides the estate with an innovative vision that remains deeply respectful of their ancestral viticultural traditions. The grapes are sourced from beautifully situated family vineyard parcels on the calcareous clay soils surrounding Sirmione, which lend a distinct mineral depth to the fruit.

Wine Description

Ca dei Frati I Frati Lugana presents a clear, pale yellow colour with subtle greenish reflections. The sensory profile is highly elegant, displaying a concentrated and fresh bouquet of white flowers, honeysuckle, apricot, and peach, layered with undertones of balsamic notes, ripe lemon, and a hint of wild mint. On the palate, the wine is fresh and linear, wrapping completely around the mouth with excellent balance, mid-palate depth, and a trademark richness. It is characterized by an exuberant, crisp acidity and a strong savoury essence that drives into a persistent, lively, and saline finish. This 100% Turbiana white wine reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 13% and was aged for six months in stainless steel tanks on its fine lees, followed by two additional months of refinement in the bottle. While the family employs traditional estate practices, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Les Petites Jamelles Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Les Petites Jamelles Blanc is an easy-drinking, modern white wine produced by Les Jamelles in the sun-drenched Languedoc region of Southern France.

Created by Catherine and Laurent Delaunay, master winemakers from Burgundy, the brand was established with the vision of crafting fresh, accessible, and high-quality wines meant for casual, every-day sharing. Sourced under the IGP Terres du Midi classification, this white blend breaks away from the traditionally heavy, over-concentrated whites of the Mediterranean coast, opting instead for a vibrant, crisp, and fruity style.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a brilliant pale yellow color with green and gold reflections.

  • Aromas: The nose is fresh and highly inviting, driven by lively aromas of citrus fruit (lime and grapefruit) and juicy mango, accented by soft floral tones and a touch of bergamot.

  • Palate: On the palate, it is light, playful, and elegant, striking a lovely harmony between zesty freshness and fruit roundness.

  • Finish: It concludes with a clean, satisfyingly crisp finish that features lingering tropical fruit and a subtle mineral edge.

The wine is an artful, multi-varietal blend composed of Colombard, Grenache Blanc, Terret, Roussanne, and Muscat. Colombard and Terret provide the zesty lime and mineral backbone, Grenache Blanc and Roussanne give the body weight and structure, while Muscat gives the wine its striking exotic fruit lift. To preserve maximum freshness, the grapes are harvested at dawn, directly pressed, and fermented slowly at a cool 15°C. The wine is then aged for 6 months on its fine lees to add a layer of texture and balance. It is bottled under a convenient screwcap and holds an ABV of 12.5%.

Sustainability

True to the Delaunay family values, Les Petites Jamelles is HVE3-certified (High Environmental Value). This means the estate operates under strict French regulations supporting local biodiversity and sustainable agricultural practices, packaged in eco-designed bottles.

title: Les Petites Jamelles Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Les Petites Jamelles Rosé is a delightfully fresh and contemporary rosé wine produced by Les Jamelles under the IGP Terres du Midi classification in Southern France.

Crafted by the esteemed winemaking duo Catherine and Laurent Delaunay, this wine captures the joyful, sun-drenched "joie de vivre" of the Mediterranean coast. Sourced across the varied landscapes of the Gard, Hérault, Aude, and Pyrénées-Orientales departments, the grapes experience a mix of hot plains and cool high plateaus. Rather than matching the heavy, overly dense reds historically tied to the region, this range pivots to an elegant, highly refreshing, and modern style.

Wine Description

The 2024 vintage showcases a classic, brilliant pale pink or apricot hue in the glass.

  • Aromas: The nose is highly expressive and delicate, bursting with fresh red fruit scents like redcurrant, cherry, and strawberry, accented by a playful touch of grenadine, crunchy apple, rose petals, and violet.

  • Palate: On the palate, the wine is bright, crisp, and beautifully linear. It seamlessly contrasts a round, plush texture with fine fruit tannins and a striking, mouthwatering acidity.

  • Finish: It concludes with a satisfyingly dry, long finish characterized by a touch of tropical fruit, soft white pepper, and a clean mineral edge.

The wine is an unconventional multi-varietal blend composed of Caladoc, Carignan, Grenache, Cinsault, and Merlot. To achieve its delicate color and pristine fruit definition, the winemaking team utilizes direct pressing, generating incredibly clear juices. After a rigorous settling process, the juice undergoes a cool, temperature-controlled fermentation capped at 15°C. It sees no malolactic fermentation and is bottled relatively early to lock in its youthful zip. The wine typically holds an ABV of 12.5% to 13%.

title: Les Petites Jamelles Rouge 2024
bodyHtml:
Les Petites Jamelles Rouge 2024 is a light, intensely fruity red wine produced by Les Jamelles under the IGP Terres du Midi classification in Southern France.

Crafted by master winemakers Catherine and Laurent Delaunay, the wine captures the warm, welcoming spirit and "joie de vivre" of the Mediterranean. The Terres du Midi landscape spans across the diverse soils of the Gard, Hérault, Aude, and Pyrénées-Orientales regions—ranging from cool high-altitude plateaus to sun-baked coastal plains. Rather than adhering to the region's historic tradition of heavy, rich, and high-alcohol reds, this modern bottling values vibrant freshness, crisp textures, and pure fruit crushability.

Wine Description

The 2024 vintage catches the eye with an elegant, vibrant cherry-red color featuring lively highlights.

  • Aromas: The nose is luscious and highly inviting, driven by dominant fruit scents of crisp cherry, raspberry, and pomegranate.

  • Palate: On the palate, the attack is soft, supple, and immediate. It presents a beautifully balanced, delicate medium-to-light body that meshes a rounded mouthfeel with an animating freshness.

  • Finish: The palate shows soft, melted, and distinctly "crunchy" fruit tannins that dissolve into a clean, fresh, and remarkably long fruit-forward finish.

The wine is primarily a blend of Grenache Noir and Caladoc. To prioritize primary fruit over heavy structure, the grapes undergo full destemming followed by a short, low-temperature maceration lasting just a few days. This deliberate winemaking technique prevents heavy tannin extraction, resulting in a lively, easy-drinking profile. The wine features an ABV of 13% and is sealed under a screwcap to maintain its youthful energy.

title: Pol Roger Brut Vintage 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This rich and 'classy' vintage Champagne originates from France, within the prestigious Champagne AOC, sourced from 20 Grand and Premier Cru vineyards across the Montagne de Reims and the Côte des Blancs. Founded in 1849, Pol Roger remains one of the few fiercely independent, family-owned Champagne houses. The house's philosophy is anchored in a traditional approach to craftsmanship, famously maintaining deep chalk cellars 33 metres below street level in Épernay where every single vintage bottle is still meticulously riddled by hand. Offered in a 1.5 litre magnum format, this bottling benefits from a slower maturation curve that naturally enhances aromatic complexity and textural finesse over time.

Wine Description

The 2018 Pol Roger Brut Vintage presents a beautiful pale yellow colour with bright silver highlights and an alluring, fine persistent mousse. Its sensory profile is generous and expressive, opening with a seductive nose of lemon peel, yellow fruits like Mirabelle plum, fresh brioche, and roasted hazelnuts, layered with deeper nuances of dried fruit, almond, and cocoa. On the palate, the Champagne is full-bodied and textural, showcasing a muscular core of rich, sweet orchard fruit, apricot, and pastry cream. It is balanced by a remarkably fresh backbone of crisp, zesty citrus acidity that carries seamlessly into a long, enveloping finish defined by a chalky minerality and notes of candied orange peel. This traditional house vintage blend consists of 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay. Sourced entirely from pristine cru parcels, each variety and village lot was kept separate during a cool stainless steel fermentation to retain maximum varietal clarity. The wine underwent a full malolactic fermentation before aging for over four years on its fine lees in the estate's cool cellars, eventually being disgorged with a precise dosage of 7 grams per litre. It reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 12.5% and is not certified organic.

title: The Arran Barley 10 Year Old
bodyHtml:
“Due to limited availability, purchases are restricted to 2 bottles per customer.”

Arran 10 Year Old 'Arran Barley' is a limited-edition terroir-driven single malt Scotch whisky produced at the Lochranza Distillery on the Isle of Arran, Scotland. Released as the debut expression of the distillery's "Arran Barley" series, this bottling focuses on the concept of local agriculture and provenance, mirroring popular industry movements toward heritage grains and regional terroir. The whisky was first distilled in 2012 using 100% locally grown barley and matured for a full decade on the island itself.

Spirit Description

This limited edition is a unique variation of the core 10-year-old profile, relying on Optic and Concerto barley grown exclusively at local island sites, including Bellevue Farm by the Currie family. It is matured in a classic combination of first-fill bourbon barrels and second-fill sherry hogsheads.

  • Color: Clear and natural gold with no added coloring.

  • Aroma: Fresh and inviting, featuring the distillery's signature green apple and ripe pear orchard fruits layered with lemon peel, vanilla custard, fresh barley sugar, and mild oak tannins.

  • Palate: Rich, textured, and significantly more grain-forward than the standard bottling. It features malted biscuits, heather honey, candied peaches, and lemon curd, balanced by a sharp kick of white pepper, ginger, and a bittersweet edge of grapefruit and gooseberries.

  • Body: It offers a thicker, drier, and more full-bodied mouthfeel than the flagship release, driven by a profound and pure grainy core.

  • Finish: Medium to long and warming, leaving a distinct impression of dry cider, anise, breakfast cereals, and lingering oak spices.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at a robust 50% (non-chill filtered).

title: Tenuta Di Trinoro 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This rich and 'opulent' red wine originates from Italy, within the isolated Val d'Orcia region of southern Tuscany, classified under the Toscana I.G.T. designation. Tenuta di Trinoro was established in the 1980s by the visionary viticulturist Andrea Franchetti, who planted high-density vineyards on rocky, high-elevation limestone and clay soils between 450 and 600 metres above sea level. The estate's winemaking philosophy relies on an exhaustive parcel-by-parcel strategy to mirror the unique challenges of each growing season. In 2021, the estate micro-vinified 45 separate vineyard blocks to precisely select only the components that reached absolute harmony.

Wine Description

The 2021 Tenuta di Trinoro presents an inky dark appearance with a dense crimson core in the glass. Its sensory profile is extraordinarily elegant and deep, opening with an explosive, high-altitude bouquet of dark berries, blackberry confit, plum, and sweet violet, layered with complex undertones of rhubarb, toasted cardamom, sweet earth, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, showing an authoritative fullness and a remarkably silky, creamy texture that beautifully carries concentrated blue and black fruits. It is characterized by an outstanding structural drive balanced by fresh, crisp acidity, fine-grained balsamic notes, and suave, integrated tannins. The finish is exceptionally long and vibrant, leaving lingering impressions of sweet tobacco, damp earth, and savory spices.

This 2021 proprietary blend is composed of 60% Merlot sourced from 5 select parcels and 40% Cabernet Franc from 4 distinct blocks, omitting Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot which lacked the balance desired for the flagship label. The wine reached a robust alcohol content (ABV) of 15.5%. After an initial stainless steel fermentation, it was aged for 8 months in French oak barriques before undergoing an additional 12 months of maturation in concrete vats. While the estate utilizes traditional viticulture and respects biodynamic principles through natural vineyard treatments, this bottling is not explicitly certified organic.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Val d'Orcia was defined by notable seasonal extremes, beginning with an early spring frost followed by an intensely hot and dry summer drought. To counter these conditions, the vineyard team conducted a thorough green harvest to reduce yields, while intentionally leaving the leaf canopy intact to shade the grapes from intense sun exposure. Much-needed relief arrived via providential rain showers in mid-September, which cooled the estate and restored a vital aromatic complexity and crisp freshness to the fruit before a meticulous harvest in October.

title: Marcel Lapierre Morgon 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and historic red wine originates from France, within the celebrated Morgon cru of the Beaujolais region. The estate gained legendary status under the late Marcel Lapierre, an icon who pioneered radical natural winemaking techniques in the 1970s, such as organic viticulture, wild yeast fermentations, and omitting chemical interventions under the mentorship of biochemist Jules Chauvet. Today, the 18-hectare domaine is managed by his children, Mathieu and Camille Lapierre, who carry forward their father's revolutionary philosophy by adding biodynamic practices to ensure the land's pure expression.

Wine Description

Marcel Lapierre Morgon presents a beautiful crimson profile packed with a stimulating, juicy energy. Its sensory profile is incredibly pure and expressive, offering an alluring bouquet of ripe cherries, wild raspberries, and violets layered with subtle hints of licorice, sweet spices, and deep earthy tones. On the palate, the wine is mid-to-full-bodied and texturally rich, showcasing a complex core of dark berries, stone fruits, and minerals. It is characterized by an outstanding freshness, taut acidity, and fine, well-integrated tannins that carry into a long, clean, and salivating finish. This 100% Gamay wine reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5% and was vinified using traditional semi-carbonic maceration before aging on its fine lees in old Burgundy barrels for nine months. Consistent with the estate's natural philosophy, it is bottled without fining or sterile filtration, and the estate is certified organic.

title: Luce Brunello Di Montalcino 2020 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'seductive' red wine originates from Italy, within the renowned Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation of Tuscany. Sourced primarily from the prized, 11-hectare 'Madonnino' vineyard plot, Tenuta Luce was originally born out of a visionary meeting between Vittorio Frescobaldi and Robert Mondavi to transcend traditional boundaries. The estate operates under a philosophy that honors the unique southwestern quadrant of Montalcino, where distinct galestro (schistose) soils impart a perfect harmony of power and elegance.

Wine Description

The 2020 Luce Brunello di Montalcino presents a shimmering, radiant ruby-red colour. Its sensory profile is multifaceted and deeply elegant, unfolding an inviting bouquet of fresh raspberries, strawberries, and dried black cherries layered with sweet violets, white smoke, cedar shavings, and smooth spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and vibrant, showcasing concentrated pure cherry and plum flavours beautifully balanced by a brisk, mouthwatering acidity and firm, chewy tannins. This dry, 100% Sangiovese blend possesses exceptional tension and focus, leading into a long, satisfying finish accented by lingering notes of citrus zest, savory herbs, and a subtle edge of wood spice. The wine reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 15% and was vinified in concrete vessels with indigenous yeasts before undergoing 24 months of maturation in large Slavonian oak barrels. While the estate manages its parcels with strict respect for the integrity of the land, this bottling is not certified organic.

Accolades

97 Points - James Suckling - "Beautifully perfumed aromas of violets, cedar and fresh raspberries with some strawberries, too. Full-bodied with firm, chewy tannins that add tension and focus, as well as a crunchy undertone. Needs three or four years to soften. Best after 2028."

title: Meiomi Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
This energetic and 'approachable' white wine originates from the United States, within the coastal regions of California. Meiomi was originally established in 2006 by fifth-generation winemaker Joseph Wagner and has built a prominent reputation for creating fruit-forward wines that capture the distinct character of the state's diverse coast. Led by winemaker Jason Becker, the brand follows a philosophy of blending grapes from top cool-climate coastal AVAs; including Sonoma, Monterey, and Santa Barbara to achieve a signature style defined by balance, depth, and bold character.

Wine Description

Meiomi Sauvignon Blanc presents a bright and lively appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is highly aromatic and fresh, opening with an energetic bouquet of zesty citrus, lime zest, stone fruit, and dew-kissed grass, beautifully layered with tropical notes of mango, guava, and pineapple. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied and beautifully balanced, showcasing vibrant flavors of lemon and ripe fruit supported by a crisp, refreshing acidity. It is characterized by an elegant profile that carries a subtle, moderate weight and richness to round it out, concluding with a crisp yet wonderfully rounded finish. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5%. The grapes were carefully monitored and harvested across California's multi-appellation microclimates to ensure ideal maturity and flavor concentration before cool-temperature vinification. While the winery implements precision agricultural management, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Yellowstone American Single Malt Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Yellowstone American Single Malt Whiskey is a permanent line extension under the historic Yellowstone brand umbrella, initially launched in March 2023. The brand is operated by Limestone Branch Distillery in Lebanon, Kentucky, which was founded by seventh-generation distillers Stephen and Paul Beam. While the Beam brothers are celebrated for their traditional Kentucky bourbons, this expression represents their foray into the rapidly growing American Single Malt (ASM) category. To pull it off, the spirit is contract-distilled and aged in Indiana (commonly sourced from the MGP facility) before being blended and bottled in Kentucky.

2. Spirit Description

Unlike Scottish single malts, which traditionally age in used cooperage, this expression adapts to the American palate by using brand-new, deep-charred American oak barrels.

  • Colour: A rich, medium golden amber hue with subtle reddish highlights.

  • Aroma: The nose opens with a prominent bouquet of fresh bread, cereal malt, and toasted grains. It is layered with sweet baking spices, honey, a light touch of peach blossom, and a distinct nuttiness.

  • Palate: It features an oily, viscous texture. Rather than mimicking a traditional Scotch, it leans into a bourbon-adjacent profile; notes of sweet honey, spiced pear, and stone fruits mingle with unique hints of banana nut bread, toffee, and dark dates.

  • Body: Medium-bodied, rich, and dense, offering a full mouthfeel that effectively balances sweet grain character with robust wood components.

  • Finish: Long and warming, presenting a hefty wave of neutral American oak tannins, sharp cinnamon spice, and English walnuts.

  • ABV: Bottled at a bold and punchy 54% (108 Proof).

title: Paolo Conterno 'A Val' Langhe Arneis 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from Piedmont, Italy, within the Langhe DOC. Paolo Conterno is a highly revered, historic estate established in 1886 in Monforte d’Alba, famously located in the "Ginestra" cru. While the estate has built its multi-generational reputation on powerful, long-lived Barolos, this bottling—named "A Val"—highlights their prowess with Piedmont's signature white grape. The fruit is sourced from 30-year-old vines in the nearby Roero area, where the calcareous, sandy soils provide the perfect playground for producing an aromatic, structurally sound Arneis.

Wine Description

The Paolo Conterno "A Val" Langhe Arneis 2024 is celebrated for its "crunchy" energy, precision, and layered stone-fruit complexity.

  • Appearance: Brilliant platinum or straw-yellow with subtle greenish reflections.

  • Nose: Expressive and fragrant, it leads with primary notes of green apple, white peach, and lime zest. Beneath the fruit, it reveals delicate floral undertones of chamomile, jasmine, and wild violet, rounded out by a hint of crushed limestone and mediterranean herbs.

  • Palate: Medium-bodied, balanced, and remarkably driven. The texture is dense yet exceptionally fresh, carrying flavors of crisp orchard fruit and lemon pith. It has a bone-dry finish (vinified with a very low residual sugar of about 2.2 g/L) highlighted by a salty, stony minerality and a touch of bitter almond.

  • Technical Details: 100% Arneis. The grapes undergo a soft pressing followed by a natural cold static decantation for 24 hours without the use of enzymes or clarifiers. It is fermented at a controlled temperature of 18°C for 10–15 days and aged for 5 to 6 months entirely in stainless steel tanks to preserve its vertical, crisp personality. The alcohol content is roughly 13% to 13.5% ABV.

Food Pairing

This wine's distinct saline finish and zesty acidity make it an exceptional partner for seafood. It pairs magnificently with clams, raw oysters, and seafood risotto, as well as fish smoked with aromatic herbs. It is equally delicious alongside light antipasti, vegetable tarts, or roasted white meats like capon and lemon-thyme poultry.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 growing season in the Langhe allowed for beautiful aromatic development in early-ripening white varieties. Because the grapes were harvested by hand in early September with optimal balance, the 2024 "A Val" avoids any heavy or overly tropical notes, retaining a gorgeous, vibrant fruit core. It is showing beautifully right now and is best enjoyed fresh over the next two years.

title: Armand de Brignac Blanc de Blancs (Ace of Spades)
bodyHtml:
Armand de Brignac Blanc de Blancs originates from France, within the historic Champagne region. The luxury brand is crafted by the Cattier family, who have operated as viticulturists since 1763 and bring multi-generational expertise to their cellars in Chigny-les-Roses. The winemaking philosophy behind this cuvée relies on showcasing the unique dual terroir of the region, sourcing fruit from both the traditional Chardonnay territory of the Côte des Blancs and the Montagne de Reims. Every bottle is encased in a striking, platinum-silver metallic bottle that is individually finished and fitted with pewter labels by hand.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine presents a brilliant silver-yellow appearance in the glass and possesses a rich, medium-to-full body with a soft, chalky, and enveloping texture. The sensory profile is elegant, vibrant, and highly complex, opening with a sophisticated nose of lightly buttered baked pastry, green apple, hazelnut, gingerbread, and freshly cut lilies. On the rich and energetic palate, it delivers deep flavours of pear, guava, gooseberry, and peach, layered with sweet spice notes of cinnamon and vanilla. The finish is remarkably fresh, clean, and persistent, driven by a powerful natural acidity and a distinct vein of mineral tension.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay, picked from premier plots including famed Grand Cru villages.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its incredible structural focus and harmony, balancing crisp stone fruit traits with a supple roundness. It incorporates a signature multi-vintage approach and benefits from a unique dosage aged for one year in French oak barrels to build a creamy, pastry-like layer.

  • ABV: 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate vineyards are farmed under the high-level HVE (Haute Valeur Environnementale) sustainable agriculture protocol to safeguard the terrain, this commercial release is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, fine mousse, and rich fruit profile of this Blanc de Blancs make it a magnificent companion for high-end seafood and delicate appetizers.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with carpaccio of shellfish, pan-seared scallops, fresh sashimi, or grilled sea bass.

  • Light Fare: Suggested pairings include fresh raw fish dishes or light gourmet appetizers.

  • Cheese: Matches gracefully with artisanal platters of mild, light cheeses.

title: Zenato Rose San Benedetto 2024
bodyHtml:
This rose originates from Italy, specifically the Veneto region near the southern shores of Lake Garda. Crafted by the renowned Zenato family estate, which was founded in 1960 by Sergio Zenato, this wine comes from their historic San Benedetto property. While the family is globally famous for their rich Amarone and crisp white Lugana, this bottling showcases their ability to make a modern, high-quality pink wine from an unusual and clever blend of local and international grape varieties.

Wine Description

The Zenato Rose San Benedetto is a vibrant, clean, and highly expressive rose designed for pure drinking pleasure.

  • Appearance: A beautiful, clear pale pink with brilliant reflections in the glass.

  • Nose: Wonderfully fresh and lively, it opens with a fragrant bouquet of wild berries, sweet meadow flowers, and ripe red apples. Subtle herbal undertones like kitchen herbs and sage add a sophisticated layer.

  • Palate: On the palate, the wine is juicy, round, and remarkably harmonious. It features a pronounced core of fresh red fruits, specifically ripe strawberries, raspberries, and juicy watermelon. It strikes a great balance between a soft, smooth texture and a vital, crisp fruit acidity that keeps the mouthfeel incredibly lively, leading to a clean, thirst-quenching finish.

  • Technical Details: An interesting and unique blend of Rondinella, Pinot Nero (Pinot Noir), and Cabernet Franc. It is vinified entirely in stainless steel to capture the maximum freshness of the fruit. The alcohol content is a well-balanced 12.5% ABV.

Food Pairing

The natural weight from the Rondinella and Cabernet Franc gives this rose the structure to pair beautifully with a variety of light summer meals. It is a fantastic match for spinach salads topped with sliced strawberries and goat cheese, grilled white fish, or chicken skewers. Thanks to its lively acidity, it also pairs excellently with fried appetizers like vegetable tempura, cured Italian meats like prosciutto, or soft cheeses like Brie and Camembert.

title: Armand de Brignac Blanc de Noirs
bodyHtml:
Armand de Brignac Blanc de Noirs originates from France, within the historic Champagne region. The ultra-prestige brand is produced by the Cattier family, multi-generational viticulturists who rely on deep regional roots to guide their boutique winemaking operations. The winery's current operational philosophy centers on crafting a highly exclusive and powerful expression of its unique terroir, selecting prime fruit exclusively from the premier and Grand Cru Pinot Noir producing villages of the Montagne de Reims and the Aube.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine presents a rich golden or elegant white appearance in the glass and possesses a heavy, full-bodied structure with an intense, persistent, and mouth-capturing mousse. The sensory profile is incredibly complex, lively, and gourmet, opening with an intense and mineral-driven nose of blackberry, fig, plum, and apricot, beautifully layered with suggestions of honeysuckle, maraschino cherry, orange blossom, and gingerbread. On the succulent, rich, and dry palate, it delivers a deeply concentrated stream of sweet confit strawberry, blackcurrant, peach, and mango, harmoniously balanced by a flinty mid-palate minerality, warm vanilla cream, and a refreshing touch of fresh mint. The finish is remarkably long, crisp, and persistent, leaving lingering memories of refined licorice, honey, nutmeg, walnut, and a sophisticated trail of roasted coffee beans and pepper.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its masterful integration, structural focus, and a precise balance between aromatic intensity and lightweight freshness. Each iteration represents a highly restricted multi-vintage masterclass, such as Assemblage Number 4 which unifies the 2013, 2014, and 2015 harvests after a minimum of seven years of slow maturation in the deep chalk cellars. Every metallic bottle is individually numbered and finished by hand, showcasing extreme rarity and collectability.

  • ABV: 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate relies on meticulous hand sorting, low-yield agriculture, and sustainable vineyard tracking to capture pure site transparency, this commercial release is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The intense structural layers, savory depth, and bright natural acidity of this Blanc de Noirs make it a spectacular match for full-flavored luxury gastronomy and dishes with character.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with smoked salmon, pan-seared trout, or an ultra-luxurious pairing of fresh caviar.

  • Poultry & Meats: Suggested pairings include a rich tagine of lamb cooked with spices and apricots, glazed duck breast, roasted duck, or a roasted pork tenderloin.

  • Savoury & Heavy Fare: Complements rich truffle risottos, dishes that strike a balance between sweet and salty elements, or an elegant starter of foie gras.

title: Borgogno No Name Langhe Nebbiolo 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'rebellious' red wine originates from Italy, within the Langhe region of Piedmont and is sourced from vineyards within the Barolo zone. Borgogno is a historic wine institution with roots dating back to 1761, making it one of the oldest wineries in the Langhe. The 'No Name' label was born as a protest against Italian wine bureaucracy after one of their Barolo casks was declassified by authorities; it has since become a popular 'protest wine' that combines traditional methods with a touch of creative rebellion. The estate manages 39 hectares of land and follows a winemaking philosophy that respects tradition through natural fermentation and long maturation in massive Slavonian oak barrels.

Wine Description

Borgogno 'No Name' Langhe Nebbiolo presents a ruby red colour enriched with violet hues and purple highlights. Its sensory profile is intense and multifaceted, featuring an ethereal bouquet of violets, roses, and fresh fruits layered with spicy accents and notes of aromatic herbs. On the palate, the wine is dry, full-bodied, and 'harmonious', showcasing a bold yet velvety character with smooth tannins and a generous austerity. It is characterized by a savoury freshness and a long taste experience that reflects its calcareous and clay marl terroir. This 100% Nebbiolo blend typically reaches an alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5% to 14%. The vinification involves spontaneous fermentation in large concrete tanks for about 15 days, followed by refined maturation in Slavonian oak barrels for just over two years. While the estate is organically farmed, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Chateau Pichon Baron 2014 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Chateau Pichon Baron originates from France, within the Left Bank Bordeaux region and the prestigious subregion of Pauillac. Officially classified as a Second Growth in the historic 1855 Bordeaux Classification, the estate is celebrated for its majestic neo-classical chateau and unparalleled vineyard placement near the Gironde estuary.

Wine Description

In the glass, this wine exhibits a deep, intense purple colour that borders on opaque black. The bouquet is classic and aristocratic, slowly unfurling to reveal scents of blackberries, cassis, and dark plums, seamlessly interlaced with signatures of pencil lead, graphite, cedar, and subtle tobacco leaf. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied with a remarkably pure and concentrated core of black fruits backed by a structured, laser guided backbone of fine grained tannins.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points

  • Vinous - 94 points

  • Decanter - 95 points

title: Osoyoos Larose Grand Vin 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This prestigious red wine originates from Canada, within the Okanagan Valley region of British Columbia. Osoyoos Larose was established in 1998 as an iconic joint venture between Vincor International and Groupe Taillan, a celebrated French wine conglomerate. The winery operates under a philosophy that mirrors classic Bordeaux estates, focusing its production entirely on two wines, a premier vin and a second label, crafted from a single block vineyard overlooking Osoyoos Lake. This dedicated approach aims to marry old world French winemaking sensibilities with the unique, sun-drenched terroir of the southern Okanagan.

Wine Description

The 2019 Osoyoos Larose Le Grand Vin exhibits a clear mulberry and purple-tinted colour. On the nose, it delivers a rich and expressive aromatic profile highlighting cassis, cherry, currant, and blueberry, layered with hints of violet, cracked peppercorn, espresso, and toasty caramel vanilla oak. The full-bodied palate is intensely robust yet balanced, showing a velvety mouthfeel with chalky and tobacco textures underpinned by a well-rounded, firm tannin structure and well-placed acidity. This dry Bordeaux-inspired blend possesses a persistent, fruit-driven finish accompanied by savoury notes of smoked meat and cedar.
