This vintage is composed primarily of 62.5% Merlot, complemented by 12.5% Cabernet Sauvignon, 11.8% Petit Verdot, 7.7% Cabernet Franc, and 5.5% Malbec. The wine typically reaches an alcohol content (ABV) of 14% and was matured for 16 months in a combination of new and used French oak barriques before undergoing extended bottle refinement. While the winery employs careful estate intervention, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Stag's Leap Wine Cellars Aveta Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Stags Leap Wine Cellars Aveta Sauvignon Blanc originates from the United States, within the California region and the Napa Valley subregion. The winery initially began producing its Napa Valley white wines in the early 1980s, but it was not until the 2013 harvest that this special bottling officially assumed the name 'Aveta'. The estate winemaking philosophy centers on capturing site transparency, naming the wine after a water goddess often depicted carrying fruit to highlight its bright energy and mineral structure.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a pale straw or pale yellow appearance with brilliant reflections in the glass and possesses a medium-bodied structure with a plump, smooth, and rounded mouthfeel. The sensory profile is highly inviting, expressive, and crisp, opening with an aromatic nose of mango, gooseberries, white peach, pineapple, and green apple, beautifully balanced by undertones of orange blossoms, wild grasses, fresh herbs, and wet straw. On the refreshing and vibrant palate, it delivers deep flavours of guava, lemongrass, melon, and fig, seamlessly cut through with a cleansing natural acidity and citrus-driven highlights. The finish is remarkably long, clean, and persistent, leaving a lasting trail of fresh grass, yuzu, pomelo, and a salty mineral edge.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically a characterful white blend consisting of 68% to 76% Sauvignon Blanc, 19% to 27% Sauvignon Musque, 1% to 4% Semillon, and 1% to 4% Muscat Canelli depending on the specific vintage.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its precise balance between texture and zip, utilizing fruit grown in the alluvial soils of key vineyards like Danika Ranch, Rancho Chimiles, Bravo Zulu, and Ryan's Vineyard. To build complexity while maintaining fruit clarity, the juice is fermented at cool temperatures in a mix of stainless steel tanks and older French oak barrels, followed by six to seven months of sur lie aging with bi-monthly stirring.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 13.5% and 14%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate relies on meticulous, non-interventional viticulture to capture pure site transparency, this commercial release is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, sleek mineral core, and deeply concentrated texture of this premium Sauvignon Blanc make it a versatile partner for fresh, savory, and herb-driven gastronomy.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with fresh fish ceviche, baked cod fillets, steamed shellfish, crab cakes, or grilled oysters finished with mignonette sauce.

  • Poultry & Meats: Suggested pairings include chicken and sage skewers, light poultry preparations, or pork belly accompanied by confit octopus and fennel ceviche.

  • Savoury & Light Fare: Complements fresh tomato and basil salads, pasta Primavera, an asparagus starter course served with mousseline sauce, or a morel and white asparagus risotto.

  • Cheese: Matches gracefully with mild, soft cheeses or artisanal French sheep milk selections.

title: Chateau Mouton Rothschild 1999
bodyHtml:
Château Mouton Rothschild, located in the Pauillac appellation of Bordeaux, France, is renowned for producing some of the world’s most exceptional wines. Elevated to Premier Cru Classé status in 1973, the estate has been under the stewardship of the Rothschild family since 1853, reflecting their unwavering commitment to quality and innovation.

Wine Description
The 1999 vintage exhibits an evolved color with a slightly orange, brickish tint at the rim. The nose is deep and complex, offering aromas of stewed black fruit, tobacco, cloves, and subtle peppery spice. On the palate, the attack is fresh, with ripe fruit and a refined mineral edge. The balanced acidity enhances the wine’s precision, while the tannic structure remains smooth and well-integrated, leading into a long, elegant finish. This vintage comprises 78% Cabernet Sauvignon, 18% Merlot, and 4% Cabernet Franc. It has matured gracefully and is expected to continue evolving for a few more years.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker’s Wine Advocate: 93 points
  • Wine Spectator: 93 points
  • James Suckling: 93 points
  • Vinous (Neal Martin): 92 points
  • Decanter: 91 points
  • Wine Enthusiast: 92 points
  • Jancis Robinson: 17.5/20

Food Pairing
This wine pairs exquisitely with:

  • Herb-crusted rack of lamb
  • Grilled ribeye steak
  • Wild mushroom risotto
  • Aged hard cheeses like Comté or Manchego

These pairings enhance the wine’s depth and complexity, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

Vintage Quality
The 1999 vintage in Bordeaux experienced a warm spring and summer, with above-average temperatures. While July and August saw some rainstorms, fine weather returned in late August, allowing the grapes to ripen fully. The harvest yielded fruit with high potential alcohol and a perfect balance of sugar and acidity. Anthocyan levels in some Merlot parcels were notably high, contributing to the deep color and longevity of the wine. The result is a structured and refined vintage that has aged with elegance.

title: Donatella Cinelli Colombini Brunello di Montalcino 2019
bodyHtml:
Donatella Cinelli Colombini Brunello di Montalcino originates from Italy, within the Tuscany region and the Montalcino subregion. The winery is situated at the historic Casato Prime Donne estate, which has belonged to the ancestors of Donatella Cinelli Colombini since the late 16th century. The winery operates with a unique and pioneering philosophy, establishing itself as the first winery in Italy with an all-female staff and developing selections dedicated to showcasing female talent in the wine world.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, rich ruby appearance in the glass and possesses a medium-to-full body with an enveloping texture. The sensory profile is elegant, traditional, and rustic, opening with a complex and spicy nose of sliced cherries, fresh strawberries, and orange peel, complemented by deep aromas of nutmeg, black pepper, and ripe plums. On the balanced palate, it delivers a harmonious and succulent combination of sour cherries, dark berries, and wild herbs, intertwined with hints of marzipan and savory wood notes. The finish is long and well-structured, characterized by an architectural persistence, firm, high-quality tannins, and a lightly astringent, satisfying closing edge.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Sangiovese.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its incredible structural frame, balance, and classical poise, utilizing careful skin maceration alongside aging for at least two years in French oak and traditional Slavonian barrels to ensure excellent complexity and cellaring potential.

  • ABV: Typically 14%.

  • Organic Status: Crafted entirely from hand-harvested vineyards farmed under strict eco-conscious guidelines, this estate bottling is certified organic.

Food Pairing

The firm tannic grip, vibrant red fruit profile, and refreshing acidity of this Brunello make it a magnificent companion for hearty and rich gastronomy.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with premium cuts of grilled beef, classic Tuscan roast meats, slow-braised pork in tomato sauce, or a traditional beef stew.

  • Game: Suggested pairings include wild game options such as a rich venison shank braised in red wine.

  • Savoury: Complements full-flavored Italian dishes like orecchiette pasta cooked with spicy 'nduja sausage, Tropea onions, and tomatoes.

  • Cheese: Matches exceptionally well with structured artisanal platters of mature, hard aged cheeses.

title: Domaine des Garriguettes Cotes du Rhone Villages Gadagne L'Amista 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Châteauneuf de Gadagne subregion of the Southern Rhône Valley in France, this wine is the work of Sébastien Clément, a fourth generation vigneron. Domaine des Garriguettes is a family owned estate that pioneered organic viticulture in the village and now strictly follows Demeter certified biodynamic and regenerative farming practices.

Wine Description

L'Amista is a single vineyard, 100% Grenache bottling from old clones planted in 1954 on a site featuring 'galet rouge ferreux' (iron rich rounded stones) over clay subsoil. This red wine typically displays a polished and firm profile, with deep aromas of black berries and cherry complemented by nutty, herbal, and allspice notes. The palate is ripe and juicy, showing powerful yet mellow tannins with a touch of chocolate and ethereal spice. It is a well balanced and complex wine that maintains a certain freshness through its long, spicy finish.

title: Arcanum Il Fauno 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine originates from Tuscany, Italy, a region renowned for its rich winemaking heritage. It is crafted by Tenuta di Arceno, an estate steeped in history where the iconic faun statue on the property serves as the inspiration for the wine's name and label.

Wine Description

In the glass, the wine pours a deep, dense ruby colour. The nose is layered and highly aromatic, revealing dominant notes of violets, ripe plums, and a hint of eucalyptus, alongside subtle undertones of fresh herbs and potting soil. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied, presenting a harmonious balance of power and elegance. Initial sips unfold with rich flavors of candied black cherry, sweet mint, licorice, and balsamic. This Merlot-led Bordeaux-style blend boasts a juicy core of succulent dark berries framed by firm, chewy, yet well-polished tannins.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points

  • James Suckling - 93 points

  • Decanter - 93 points

Food Pairing

The robust structure, elegant mouthfeel, and rich fruit profile of this blend make it a spectacular companion for full-flavoured meat dishes. Consider pairing it alongside grilled ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb, or a hearty, slow-cooked beef Bolognese.

title: Casale del Giglio 'Anthium' Bellone 2024
bodyHtml:
Casale del Giglio "Anthium" Bellone is a remarkable, heritage-driven white wine produced in the Lazio region of Central Italy.

The wine represents a fascinating archaeological and viticultural rescue project. It is made entirely from Bellone, an ancient native grape praised by Pliny the Elder in Roman times as Uva Pantastica. The fruit for Anthium is sourced from a tiny, historic 2.4-hectare vineyard situated just behind the coastal town of Anzio, south of Rome. These vines are over 60 years old and uniquely ungrafted (franco di piede); they survived the global phylloxera epidemic because the destructive insect cannot travel through the loose, coastal beach sands in which they are planted.

Wine Description

This wine pours a deep, luminous yellow flecked with brilliant golden reflections.

  • Aromas: The nose is intensely sunny and tropical, opening with rich aromas of ripe mango, papaya, white peach, and Williams pear, complexed by undertones of hawthorn blossom, chamomile, and a hint of beeswax.

  • Palate: On the palate, the wine is rich, ample, and surprisingly broad, offering a luxurious, silken texture. It balances its ripe tropical fruit center with a robust, "zingy" acidity and a powerful streak of salty, iodine-like coastal minerality.

  • Finish: It concludes with an exceptionally long, savory finish featuring persistent fruit notes and a pleasant, traditional touch of bitter almond.

The winemaking process utilizes a 48-hour cold skin-maceration at 8°C to deeply extract the aromatics locked in the grape's thick skins. Following a gentle press, it undergoes a spontaneous fermentation using only indigenous yeasts in stainless steel tanks. To protect its pure varietal definition, the wine is aged entirely in stainless steel on its fine lees for six months, followed by two months of bottle refinement before commercial release. It typically carries a robust ABV of 13.5% to 14%.

Food Pairing

Thanks to its combination of full-bodied weight and brisk acidity, Anthium functions as an incredible gastronomic wine that pairs easily with both seafood and rich, savory dishes:

  • Seafood: Superb with traditional Roman seafood dishes, pan-fried fish (fritto misto), crab cakes, or rich seafood risottos.

  • Pasta: A brilliant, unconventional match for classic Roman pasta dishes like Pasta alla Gricia or Cacio e Pepe, where the wine's sharp acidity cuts beautifully through the richness of the guanciale and pecorino cheese.

  • White Meats & Vegetables: Complements herb-roasted chicken, savory mushroom tarts, and grilled asparagus.

title: Poderi Aldo Conterno Barbera D'Alba 'Conca Tre Pile' 2021
bodyHtml:
Poderi Aldo Conterno Barbera d'Alba 'Conca Tre Pile' 2021 originates from Italy, within the Piedmont region and the Barbera d'Alba DOC subregion. The winery is situated in Monforte d'Alba at the historic Bussia Soprana estate, which represents a pinnacle of traditional Langhe winemaking. The family's philosophy bridges absolute quality standards with deep respect for local terroir, choosing to cultivate the local hillsides where old vines with a maximum age of 45 years produce low yields of highly concentrated fruit.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a mid-dense, deep ruby appearance in the glass and possesses a heavy, full-bodied structure with an enveloping, compact texture. The sensory profile is highly elegant, layered, and intense, opening with an aromatic nose of fresh red cherries, wild blackberries, black plums, and citrus peel, accented by complex trails of cinnamon, sweet tobacco, licorice, wood smoke, and graphite. On the opulent and chiseled palate, it delivers deep flavours of dark summer fruits, black pepper, and balsam, beautifully supported by a dense core of velvety tannins and crisp, precise acidity. The finish is remarkably long, structured, and warm, leaving lingering trails of mocha, dark cocoa powder, and a balanced touch of chocolate.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Barbera.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its phenomenal balance, tension, and structural focus. The hand-picked grapes undergo an 8-to-10-day skin contact maceration and temperature-controlled fermentation before spending a few months in stainless steel vats, followed by 12 months of maturation in barriques to polish the structural elements.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 14.5% and 15.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the domain is managed using sustainable, non-interventional viticulture to capture pure site transparency, this specific release is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant natural acidity, dense mid-palate, and building tannic architecture of this premium Barbera d'Alba make it an exceptional match for savory, protein-rich gastronomy.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with classic roasted beef, slow-braised pork loin, or herb-crusted lamb chops.

  • Poultry & Game: Suggested pairings include traditional roasted duck, wild goose, or roasted game birds, which seamlessly mirror the wine's deep spice and earth profiles.

  • Savoury & Italian Staples: Complements rich tomato-based pasta dishes, wild mushroom risotto, or pizzas covered in peppery meats.

  • Cheese: Matches gracefully with structured artisanal platters of mature, hard aged cheeses.

title: Dom Perignon P2 2003 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originating from France, specifically within the historic Champagne region and its revered Grand Cru vineyards, Dom Perignon P2 represents the pinnacle of late disgorged luxury champagne. The house traces its spiritual roots back to Pierre Perignon, the legendary Benedictine monk of Hautvillers Abbey who pioneered early winemaking standards in the seventeenth century.

Wine Description

In the glass, this exceptional champagne displays an intense, medium deep golden hue with a remarkably fine and persistent mousse. The bouquet opens in a spiral of complex scents, introducing aromas of dried apricot, candied white peach, and marmalade, beautifully framed by nuances of roasted pine nuts, brioche, white truffle, and a distinctive smoky, ashy minerality. On the palate, the wine is full bodied, tactile, and incredibly dense, revealing rich layers of yellow orchard fruits, nougat, and liquorice root.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 98 points

  • Wine Spectator - 96 points

  • Decanter - 96 points

  • Vinous - 96 points

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 94 points

Food Pairing

The intense density and vinous structure of this late disgorged champagne demand pairings with equally rich, flavorful, and textured dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with charcoal grilled lobster or pan seared duck breast served with a citrus glaze, which cuts through the champagne's richness while mirroring its fruit profile.

title: Giant Steps Circle of Fifths Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
This fragrant and light to medium bodied red wine originates from Australia, within the cool climate Yarra Valley region of Victoria. Giant Steps was established by Phil Sexton, who named the winery after a John Coltrane album to signify his 'giant step' from Western Australia to the Yarra Valley to pursue ideal sites for Pinot Noir. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes minimal intervention and gravity flow processes to highlight site specific transparency. While the estate's single vineyard wines focus on individual plots, the Circle of Fifths is a harmonious blend or 'chord' of batches from all five of the winery's single site vineyards in the Yarra Valley.

Wine Description

The Giant Steps Circle of Fifths Pinot Noir presents a bright, medium crimson red appearance. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and complex:

  • Aroma: Features a 'perfumed' bouquet of maraschino cherries, wild raspberries, and rose petals, layered with fennel seed spice, lavender, and star anise.

  • Palate: Mid weighted and textured, showcasing pure flavours of red summer berries, blueberries, and cranberry underpinned by bright acidity and 'fuzzy' herbal notes.

  • Finish: Long and elegant with a mineral edge and persistent notes of licorice and dried sage.

This 100% Pinot Noir is crafted using a portion of whole bunch parcels (approximately 20% to 42% depending on the vintage) to add structural perfume and tannin. The wine is matured in French oak barriques (with 15% to 22% new oak) and reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 13.8% for the 2025 release. It is bottled by gravity without fining or filtration and is not certified organic.

title: Arcanum Il Fauno 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Arcanum Il Fauno is an exceptional Bordeaux style red blend from Tuscany, Italy, specifically hailing from the Toscana IGT appellation within the southern edge of the Chianti Classico region. Established in 1994 and now part of the Jackson Family Wines collection, the historic Tenuta di Arceno estate boasts winemaking traditions dating back thousands of years. Legendary winemaster Pierre Seillan guides the estate's philosophy, utilizing micro-cru cultivation across diverse elevations and clay rich soils to capture the true power and elegance of international varieties.

Wine Description

In the glass, this wine displays a deep, dark ruby color. The nose is highly expressive, revealing layered aromas of ripe plums, black cherries, and violets, beautifully complemented by subtle hints of eucalyptus, sweet spices, and earthy cedar. On the palate, it is full bodied, dense, and voluptuous, delivering rich flavors of candied black cherry, blackberry, licorice, and dark chocolate.

Food Pairing

This robust, full bodied blend pairs beautifully with rich, savory dishes such as grilled ribeye steak, slow braised lamb shanks, or classic Italian osso buco. It is also an excellent match for hard, aged cheeses like sharp cheddar or Parmigiano Reggiano.

title: Louis Latour Pouilly Fuisse Premier Cru 2022
bodyHtml:
Hailing from France, this exceptional white wine is produced within the Pouilly Fuissé premier cru appellation, situated in the southern Burgundian subregion of the Mâconnais. Maison Louis Latour, a historic family-run estate founded in 1797, brings over two centuries of winemaking tradition to this bottling, maintaining a philosophy that marries deep respect for terroir with meticulous craftsmanship. The estate's commitment to quality is beautifully showcased in this selection, which masterfully blends grapes from premier cru sites to capture the true, mineral-rich essence of the region.

Wine Description

The Louis Latour Pouilly Fuissé Premier Cru displays a brilliant pale gold colour in the glass. On the nose, it is intensely perfumed and complex, revealing expressive notes of acacia, lime blossom, and wild white flowers, complemented by hints of vanilla, apricot, and a delicate touch of stone. The palate is full bodied, smooth, and concentrated, delivering a generous, creamy texture balanced beautifully by a vibrant thread of bright acidity and an elegant, chalky minerality. Rich flavours of yellow fruits, honey, and fresh hazelnut unfold effortlessly before giving way to a long, sophisticated, and biscuity finish.

title: Mission Hill Compendium 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured red wine originates from Canada, specifically within the Okanagan Valley of British Columbia. Produced by Mission Hill Family Estate, the winery was founded by Anthony von Mandl, who put down roots in the valley with the conviction that it could produce sophisticated wines for an international audience. Mission Hill's driving philosophy is to be considered among the very best in the world, a guide that has led to significant investments in grape growing and winemaking within the region. Compendium is a compilation of soil, climate, and clone selection, with fruit hand-harvested from specifically designated blocks in the Osoyoos (92%) and Black Sage Bench (8%) vineyard estates.

Wine Description

The 2021 Mission Hill Compendium is a full-bodied red blend that presents a structured yet polished character. The sensory profile features aromas of black and red currant, layered with bright red fruit and subtle hints of baking spice. On the palate, the wine is balanced and expressive, showcasing integrated oak and silky tannins that lead to a long, elegant finish. Following fermentation and extended maceration, this wine was aged for 19 months in French oak barrels. The wine reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and is optimal for cellaring until 2034. While Mission Hill practices sustainable viticulture, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The structured tannins and bold fruit profile of this Cabernet-dominant blend make it a versatile partner for hearty dishes. Suggested pairings include:

  • Meats: Grilled or aged beef, lamb, and venison.

  • Vegetarian: Earthy dishes featuring mushrooms.

  • Hardy Menus: The wine's youthful tannins and savoury undercurrent complement robust, flavourful menus that can match its intensity.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in the Okanagan Valley was a one-of-a-kind growing season characterized by an extremely warm and dry start followed by an unprecedented mid-summer 'heat dome'. While these conditions led to lower yields, they resulted in intensely flavoured fruit with remarkable character, concentrated flavours, and balanced acidity. Winemakers noted that red varieties from this vintage show nice full ripe tannins and vibrant fruit, benefiting from a harvest that was the earliest on record due to high growing degree days.

title: Louis Latour Macon Lugny 'Les Genievres' 2024 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This exceptional white wine originates from France, crafted within the Maconnais subregion of Burgundy. Maison Louis Latour, a historic family owned producer founded in 1797, is celebrated for its deep rooted traditions and commitment to demonstrating Burgundy's unique terroirs. For this specific cuvee, the winery selects grapes from 'Les Genievres', a highly regarded vineyard block in Lugny renowned for its limestone heavy soils that impart a signature depth and complexity to the fruit.

Wine Description

The Louis Latour Macon-Lugny 'Les Genievres' reveals a brilliant pale gold colour in the glass. The floral, expressive nose opens with beautiful aromas of acacia and honeysuckle, enhanced by delicate notes of vanilla. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, the palate is round and generous, revealing delightful flavours of yellow orchard fruit and a well balanced weight. Showing excellent freshness and an elegant finish with good length, this unoaked white wine delivers a beautiful harmony between fruit and complexity.

title: Solaia 2022 (by Tenuta Tignanello)
bodyHtml:
This prestigious red wine originates from Italy, within the Toscana I.G.T. designation and the heart of the Chianti Classico region. Produced by Marchesi Antinori, a family with a winemaking history spanning 26 generations since 1385, Solaia is sourced from a 50 acre (20 hectare) vineyard at the Tignanello estate. The vineyard is situated at elevations of 350 to 400 metres on stony 'alberese' (limestone) and 'galestro' (calcareous clay) soils with a sun drenched southwestern exposure. The Antinori philosophy balances deep rooted tradition with continuous innovation, first producing Solaia in 1978 only during exceptional vintages.

Wine Description

The 2022 Solaia presents an intense ruby red colour with bright purple hues. The sensory profile is profoundly complex and aromatic, featuring a bouquet of dark fruits including blackcurrants, blueberries, plums, and figs, layered with floral hints of sweet violets. Secondary notes of Gianduja, powdered sugar, white pepper, tobacco, and quinine provide significant depth to the nose. On the palate, the wine is rich and creamy, sustained by 'extraordinary' freshness and energy. It is characterized by silky, mouth filling tannins that create a refined, tight knit texture leading to an intense and persistent finish with exceptional depth. This blend consists of 75% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Sangiovese, and 5% Cabernet Franc. The wine was aged for approximately 15 to 18 months in new French oak barriques and reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5% to 14%. While the estate emphasizes sustainable viticulture and meticulous berry selection, this bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The powerful structure and spicy complexity of the 2022 Solaia make it an ideal companion for 'bold and savoury' flavours. It pairs perfectly with:

  • Roasted and Grilled Meats: Grilled ribeye with herb butter, oven baked leg of lamb with rosemary and garlic, or classic Florentine steak.

  • Game and Pasta: Rich game stews, venison, or first courses served with hearty meat sauces.

  • Cheese: Mature and aged cheeses such as Pecorino Toscano or Parmigiano Reggiano. For the best expression, serve at 18°C to 20°C.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Chianti Classico was marked by hot and dry conditions throughout June and July. However, timely mid August rain showers and cooler nights provided 'much needed relief', allowing the vines to reach an ideal ripening phase. Winemakers successfully utilized the resilience of the vines and excellent autumn weather to harvest fruit of 'outstanding quality', resulting in a wine that balances the warmth of the season with a signature fresh acidity.

title: Bib & Tucker Bourbon Double Char 6 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Crafted in the United States, bib & tucker bourbon double char 6 yo originates from the rolling hills of Columbia, Tennessee. The brand takes its inspiration from the turn of the 20th century, an era of unprecedented progress and adventure when all bourbon was meticulously crafted in small batches.

Whisky Description

This expression displays a deep, medium amber colour accented by striking copper highlights. On the nose, it offers an aromatic birth of toasted caramel, sweet dulce de leche, and baking spices like cinnamon and clove, all enrobed in a gentle blanket of campfire smoke and roasted corn. The palate is burly yet rounded, greeting the drinker with an initial sweetness of vanilla, sugar maple, and caramelized sugar before evolving into savory notes of white pepper, toasted nuts, and barbecue seasoning.

title: Hickinbotham Revivalist Merlot 2021
bodyHtml:
This concentrated and 'soulful' red wine originates from Australia, within the McLaren Vale region and the high-elevation subregion of Clarendon. The Hickinbotham Clarendon Vineyard was established in 1971 by Alan David Hickinbotham, whose father was a pioneer of wine science in Australia. While the vineyard historically supplied fruit for some of the country’s most iconic wines, it was not bottled under its own label until 2012 following the acquisition of the estate by Jackson Family Wines. Today, the winery is led by winemakers Christopher Carpenter and Peter Fraser, who follow a philosophy of showcasing the innate power and freshness provided by the site's ancient soils and cooling breezes.

Wine Description

The 2021 Hickinbotham Revivalist Merlot presents a full-bodied sensory profile with a deep and seductive character. The nose features an intense perfume of violets and red flowers, layered with soulful earthy aromas and notes of mocha, coffee bean, and damson plum. On the palate, the wine is 'ebulliently' ripe, showcasing fresh plum, vanilla, olive paste, and huckleberry. It is characterized by suave, fleshy tannins and a refreshing herbal touch, leading to a lush and persistent finish with hints of orange rind and spice. This blend is composed primarily of 93% Merlot and 7% Cabernet Sauvignon. The wine was fermented with wild yeast over 16 days on skins, then aged for 15 months in French barriques (60% new) before further refinement in old foudres. While the vineyard has been managed using organic and biodynamic practices since 2019, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Donum Carneros Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
This exceptional white wine hails from the United States, specifically from the rolling hills of the Carneros subregion within Sonoma County, California. Established in 2001, The Donum Estate has crafted its reputation on an uncompromising commitment to land stewardship, low yields, and meticulous precision.

Wine Description

The Donum Carneros Chardonnay is a medium straw colour in the glass. The bouquet opens with a sophisticated interplay of lime, orange blossom, and honeydew melon, subtly grounded by a hint of freshly split wood, matchstick, and flinty river stones. On the palate, classic regional notes of Golden Delicious apple and peach seamlessly layer with vibrant kiwi, pear, and wildflower honey.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 95 points.

  • Vinous - 92 points.

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 91 points.

Food Pairing

The pure, focused acidity and rich yet elegant structure of this Carneros Chardonnay make it a magnificent accompaniment to pan-seared sea scallops served with a lemon-herb butter sauce, or a wild mushroom risotto.

title: Donum Carneros Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
This exceptional single variety wine originates from the United States, specifically from the rolling hills of the Carneros subregion spanning Napa and Sonoma counties. Established in 2001, Donum Estate has focused its winemaking philosophy on an unwavering respect for the land and meticulous, low yield organic farming. Under the guidance of winemaker Dan Fishman, the estate strives to capture the purest, site driven expression of its estate vineyards, blending ultimate craftsmanship with a sense of place that makes their flagship wines truly memorable.

Wine Description

Carneros Pinot Noir displays a striking medium to deep ruby color in the glass. On the nose, it opens with a signature Carneros profile of sassafras, complemented by complex aromas of raspberry, black cherry, five spice, and a delicate touch of purple flowers. The palate is rich, weighty, and lush, layering vibrant red and dark fruits with nuanced hints of toasted oak, plum, licorice, and black sesame paste. Exhibiting a powerful yet elegant body, the wine is framed by hearty, well structured tannins and bright natural acidity that provide remarkable freshness, balance, and complexity.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 95 points.

  • Wine Enthusiast - 93 points.

Food Pairing

The savory depth and vibrant fruit architecture of this Pinot Noir make it a classic partner for roasted game birds, such as pan seared duck breast with a cherry reduction or slow roasted goose. It also pairs beautifully with earthy mushroom risotto or a lightly spiced rack of lamb, where the wine's acidity cuts through the richness while its fine tannins complement the texture of the dish.

title: Marolo Ulrich Rosso Vermouth
bodyHtml:
This artisanal red vermouth originates from Italy, within the Piedmont region, and is classified under the Vermouth di Torino D.O.C. standards. The brand Domenico Ulrich was established in 1854 by botanist Domenico Ulrich and became a leader in processing aromatic herbs in Italy. In 2016, the Marolo Distillery in Alba revived the historic brand by carefully recovering and studying ancient family recipes. The distillery’s philosophy for this line is to rediscover the flavours of the Belle Époque using only Piedmontese and Italian grown raw materials.

Wine Description

The Marolo Ulrich Rosso Vermouth presents a deep amber colour. Its sensory profile is described as fresh, delicately spiced, and balsamic. The nose reveals a complex blend of over 30 alpine herbs and spices, with layers of wormwood, orange peel, clove, and dried herbs accented by subtle floral notes. On the palate, the vermouth is velvety and full-bodied, showcasing a balanced interplay of sweet red fruit, bitter roots, baking spices, and a touch of cocoa. It is characterized by its use of 100% Cortese wine as a base and browned or 'burnt' sugar instead of caramel, which enhances the natural notes of bitter orange, gentian, and Piedmont lemon balm.

title: Chateau Gassier Pas du Moine Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and 'expressive' rosé originates from France, within the prestigious Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire appellation. Located at the foot of the Montagne Sainte-Victoire near Puyloubier, Château Gassier has been a family-run property since 1982. The estate is currently led by Georges Gassier, representing the fifth generation of artisans, in partnership with the Jeanjean family (Advini). Their winemaking philosophy is deeply rooted in an artisanal approach that emphasizes environmental respect and the pure expression of their unique terroir.

Wine Description

Château Gassier Pas du Moine '350' Rosé exhibits a remarkably pale, clear, and luminous rosé hue with subtle lychee highlights. On the nose, it reveals a beautiful aromatic complexity dominated by red fruits like raspberry, enriched by exotic notes of mango, passion fruit, and vine peach. The palate is ample and generous, showing a pleasing roundness and flavours of redcurrant and vine peach. It is characterized by a mineral tension derived from its clay-limestone soil, leading to a long, persistent finish.

title: Bardstown Goose Island Stout Cask Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Bardstown Bourbon Company Goose Island Bourbon County Stout Finish is a premium expression from the distillery's celebrated Collaborative Series. Released in September 2023, it represents a partnership between the modern Bardstown Bourbon Company in Kentucky and the legendary Chicago-based Goose Island Beer Company, known for creating the first bourbon barrel-aged stout. This limited-release bourbon is crafted by finishing a bespoke blend of Kentucky straight bourbons in freshly emptied Goose Island Bourbon County Stout barrels for an additional 12 months.

2. Spirit Description

The bourbon is a complex blend of 6, 7, and 9-year-old Kentucky straight bourbons, specifically selected to complement the dark, roasted characteristics of the stout barrels.

  • Colour: Deep amber with a rich, oily appearance.

  • Aroma: The nose leads with dark chocolate and honey, followed by toasted almond, vanilla cream, and a distinct layer of roasted grain. Deeper notes of caramel and cocoa emerge with subtle toasted oak.

  • Palate: The entry is rich with brown sugar and toffee, quickly giving way to dark chocolate, roasted malt, and cacao. Mid-palate coffee undertones appear alongside allspice, reflecting the deep influence of the stout barrel.

  • Body: It features a moderate heft and a lightly slick, enveloping body.

  • Finish: Long and warming, anchored by lingering roasted malt, oak spice, and echoes of coffee and chocolate that fade into a dry, malty close.

  • ABV: Bottled at 50% (100 proof).

title: Prunotto Cerretta Barolo 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'historic' red wine originates from Italy, within the Barolo D.O.C.G. appellation of the Piedmont region. Sourced from the prestigious Cerretta vineyard in the Serralunga area, this wine was first produced by the Prunotto estate in the 2017 vintage. The estate, founded in 1904 and currently owned by the Antinori family, follows a winemaking philosophy that interprets the territorial identity of the Langhe through a balance of tradition and modern precision. The Cerretta vineyard is celebrated for its distinctive soils that shape Nebbiolo into a wine of firm structure, architecture, and remarkable aging potential.

Wine Description

The 2020 Prunotto Cerretta Barolo presents a bright and lively ruby red colour with garnet reflections. Its sensory profile is elegant and refined, featuring a 'pleasant' bouquet characterized by floral notes of rose and violet, layered with intense notes of small red fruit and spicy hints of pink pepper and cloves. On the palate, the wine is intense and well balanced, showcasing sweet and silky tannins alongside a remarkable freshness. This 100% Nebbiolo blend is characterized by a long, harmonious, and persistent finish that echoes the fruity notes perceived on the nose. The wine reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and was aged in oak barrels of varying capacities for at least 18 months to enhance its balance and complexity. While the estate emphasizes meticulous vineyard management, this bottling is not explicitly certified organic.

title: Livia Fontana Villero Barolo 2020
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Italy's prestigious Piedmont region, the Livia Fontana Villero Barolo 2020 is a profound expression of the Castiglione Falletto subregion. Established in 1820, the family-run Livia Fontana estate reflects a two-century winemaking legacy currently managed by Livia Fontana and her children. The winery emphasizes an artisanal approach, utilizing integrated pest management and meticulous manual work in the vineyards to produce authentic, terroir-driven wines.

Wine Description

Crafted from 100% Nebbiolo grapes, this wine displays a deep garnet red color with classic orange reflections developing near the rim. The complex and layered bouquet reveals aromas of ripe red fruits, dried flowers, and savory spices, alongside deeper notes of tobacco, leather, and a subtle balsamic touch. On the palate, it exhibits a powerful yet balanced structure where fine, well-integrated tannins support a rich, complex body. The vibrant acidity characteristic of the varietal keeps the palate dynamic and fresh, leading into a long, persistent finish filled with returning fruit and spice.

title: Kistler Chardonnay 'Hyde Vineyards' 2023
bodyHtml:
Kistler Chardonnay Carneros Hyde Vineyard originates from the United States, within the California region and the Carneros subregion. Kistler Vineyards has been crafting this highly coveted, site specific bottling since 1994. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes the distinct character of the famous Hyde Vineyard, situated in the heart of Carneros, where vines are rooted in a marine loam soil set that grows leaner as the block travels up the hillside slopes.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a green tinged, pale yellow appearance with excellent clarity and possesses a medium to full, perfectly balanced body. The sensory profile is highly elegant, multi layered, and exotic, opening with a focused nose of ripe orchard fruit, apricot, flint, and lemon zest, seamlessly layered with subtle scents of white pepper, beeswax, and roasted grains. On the silky and viscous palate, it delivers powerful concentrations of fresh golden apples, citrus fruits, honey, and apricot tart, beautifully integrated with hints of savory spices, butterscotch, and toasted bread. The finish is exceptionally long, racy, and persistent, driven by a firm natural acid spine and a poignant, saline marine tone of crushed oyster shells.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its remarkable structural poise, tension, and texture, presenting a beautifully framed phenolics profile that brings great depth and old world aromatic class without ever feeling heavy.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 14.1% and 14.2%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery employs meticulous, manual estate vineyard monitoring to showcase the pure transparency of the block, this commercial release is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, sleek mineral core, and deeply concentrated texture of this premium Chardonnay make it a versatile partner for rich seafood and savory courses.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with fatty pan seared salmon fillets with lemon dill sauce, grilled lobster, or a traditional western clam, leek, and bacon chowder.

  • Poultry & Meats: Complements elegant meat dishes such as poulet de Bresse with truffles, roasted stuffed pork loin, or seasoned pork chops finished with cheese.

  • Savoury: Suggested pairings include rich wild mushroom risotto, which balances the wine's natural butter, spice, and flint notes.

James Suckling: 100 Points

A brilliantly fresh and balanced wine with a marked mineral streak that only adds to its distinctive personality. Aromas of flint, white pepper and lemon zest lead to subtle lemon, lime, chalk, sea breeze, saline and grilled apple flavors. It's a unique interpretation of the famous Hyde Vineyard that keeps you coming back for more. Drink now or hold.

Wine Spectator: 97 Points

This remarkable wine leaps out of the glass with its complexity. Offers cardamom cake, grilled pineapple, peach preserves and apple pastry, plus a note of papaya that’s fleshy and juicy. The fresh thread of acidity is complemented by a mineral streak of crushed rock, lemon salt, white pepper, lemon balm and toasted sesame seed. There’s plenty of momentum on the long, expressive finish.

title: Saint Emilion de Quintus 2021
bodyHtml:
An accessible and charming introduction to the prestigious world of Château Quintus. The 2021 St Émilion de Quintus captures the elegance of the estate’s limestone terroir in a fresh, Merlot-forward style designed for earlier enjoyment. Crafted by the legendary team behind Château Haut-Brion, this wine offers Right Bank pedigree without the wait.

The Vintage: A Return to Classic Elegance

The 2021 vintage in Bordeaux marked a departure from the "solar" vintages of previous years, offering a return to a classic, fresh, and refined style. After a mild winter and a challenging spring, a warm and sunny September saved the harvest, allowing the grapes to reach optimal maturity while retaining vibrant acidity.

For St Émilion de Quintus, this translates into a wine that prioritizes finesse over power. It is a "restaurant-ready" vintage that shines with bright fruit and lower alcohol, making it an incredibly versatile partner for food.

title: Vinedo Chadwick 2022
bodyHtml:
Viñedo Chadwick originates from the prestigious Puente Alto subregion within the Maipo Valley of Chile. Crafted as a heartfelt tribute by Eduardo Chadwick to honour the memory of his late father, Don Alfonso Chadwick Errázuriz, the estate's vineyard sits on land that was once Don Alfonso's personal polo field.

Wine Description

This exceptional red displays a bright, deep purple hue in the glass. The nose opens with an intense, multidimensional bouquet of cassis, blackcurrants, and dark cherries, accented by subtle hints of fresh violets, ash, tobacco leaves, and cedar. On the palate, the wine delivers a finessed, medium to full-bodied flow characterized by a structured yet graceful density. It seamlessly balances freshness and vibrant acidity with ultra-fine, plush, and cashmere-like tannins typical of the finest Maipo reds.

Accolades

  • Wine Advocate - 98 points.

  • James Suckling - 98 points.

  • Vinous - 98 points.

  • Decanter - 95 points.

Food Pairing

The structured elegance and deep fruit profile of this wine make it a superb match for roasted prime rib, grilled rack of lamb with rosemary, or a rich wild mushroom risotto.

title: Vinedo Chadwick 2021
bodyHtml:
Viñedo Chadwick is located in Chile, within the Maipo Valley and the specific subregion of Alto Maipo. Founded by Eduardo Chadwick to honour his father, Alfonso Chadwick Errázuriz, the winery occupies a historic family polo field in Puente Alto that was converted into a vineyard in 1992. Winemaker Francisco Baettig guides the estate with a philosophy focused on capturing the pure, nuanced expression of their exceptional terroir through a commitment to precision, tension, and organic conversion.

Wine Description

The wine exhibits a deep dark ruby color with vibrant purple reflections at the edge. On the nose, it delivers an endlessly fascinating, complex aromatic profile of cassis, black cherry, and red berries layered with crushed roses, graphite, mocha, and a hint of cigar box. The full bodied palate is super concentrated yet remarkably fresh, showing a silky, velvety texture balanced by an iron fist of fine grained, chalky tannins and refreshing acidity. This red blend possesses exceptional balance, complexity, and a lingering, mineral salty finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Advocate - 100 points.

  • James Suckling - 100 points.

  • Decanter - 98 points.

  • Vinous - 98 points.

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points.

Food Pairing

This structured and refined red blend pairs beautifully with prime cuts of roasted or grilled meats, such as a rosemary encrusted rack of lamb or a slow roasted prime rib. The wine's juicy acidity cuts through richer textures perfectly, while its fine grained tannins harmonize beautifully with the savory, charred elements of the dish.

title: Chateau Leoville Las Cases 2016
bodyHtml:
Chateau Leoville Las Cases hails from France, specifically the Saint Julien appellation within the Left Bank of the Bordeaux region. As one of the oldest and most prestigious estates in the Medoc, the winery's philosophy focuses on expressing its exceptional terroir, which sits directly adjacent to First Growth powerhouse Chateau Latour.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a very deep, saturated purple-black colour with violet flashes around the rim. On the nose, it explodes with complex, multi-layered aromas of crème de cassis, wild black cherries, fresh tobacco, iris flowers, and graphite. The palate displays massive power and concentration, yet delivers an incredible, flawless polish. A classic 'iron fist in a velvet glove', the wine is medium to full-bodied, structured around fine-grained, silt-like tannins and a vibrant, mineral freshness that culminates in an epically long finish.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 100 points.

  • James Suckling - 100 points.

  • Decanter - 100 points.

  • Wine Spectator - 98 points.

Food Pairing

The profound structure and intense dark fruit of this Left Bank blend call for rich, savory dishes such as pan-seared duck breast with a cassis reduction, slow-roasted rack of lamb with rosemary, or a prime cut of dry-aged ribeye steak.

title: Ornellaia 2023 - 375 ml Bottle
bodyHtml:
This legendary red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the prestigious Bolgheri Superiore DOC within the Tuscan coast. Founded in 1981 by Marquis Lodovico Antinori and currently owned by the historic Marchesi de' Frescobaldi family, Tenuta dell'Ornellaia stands as an iconic pioneer of the Super Tuscan movement. The estate's winemaking philosophy focuses on a Bordeaux-inspired approach, meticulously managing a complex mosaic of marine, alluvial, and volcanic soils to craft a Grand Vin that beautifully mirrors the power, elegance, and Mediterranean soul of its unique coastal terroir.

Wine Description

The 2023 Ornellaia displays an intense, deep, and brilliant ruby red colour with a vibrant appearance in the glass. On the nose, it unveils a highly expressive, botanical, and complex bouquet filled with ripe blueberry and blackberry aromas, beautifully accented by hints of toasted almonds, cocoa, and fragrant Mediterranean shrubs like thyme and rosemary. The palate is generous, full bodied, and deeply concentrated, yet it surprises with a remarkably plush, velvety, and delicate texture. Flavours of dark cherry, plum, mocha, and subtle savory spices are underscored by a striking energy and a vibrant streak of acidity, showing a masterfully finessed through line that avoids any excess over ripeness. The finish is exceptionally enduring and sustained by silky, finely chiseled tannins that provide great structural elegance. Composed of 55% Cabernet Sauvignon, 26% Merlot, 12% Cabernet Franc, and 7% Petit Verdot, this vintage represents the debut of ex-Bordeaux technical director Marco Balsimelli. Each parcel was vinified separately before undergoing a double-barrel aging regime in French oak (65% new) for a total of 15 months, creating a harmonious and seamless profile built to evolve beautifully in the cellar from 2027 through 2050.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in Bolgheri was demanding but ultimately highly successful, marked by an exceptionally rainy spring that filled vital underground water reserves. A warm summer followed, and while a lower daytime average temperature in August slowed maturation, perfect conditions arrived in September with dry days and cool nights, allowing winemakers to harvest beautifully balanced fruit at optimum phenolic maturity.
