title: Somersby Pear Cider 473 ml - 4 Cans
bodyHtml:
Somersby Pear Cider is a massively popular, wonderfully refreshing flavored cider produced by the Danish brewing giant Carlsberg Group.

First launched in 2008 alongside the flagship apple version, Somersby has grown into a leading international cider brand available in over 50 countries. The brand's philosophy is centered on creating joyful, easy-drinking beverages that offer a lighter, more fruit-forward alternative to beer or wine. Somersby Pear is widely recognized for its vibrant carbonation and sweet, crowd-pleasing profile.

Flavor Profile

Somersby Pear Cider is characterized by its intense fruitiness and a distinct dual-play of sweetness and subtle tang.

  • Aroma: Highly aromatic and dominantly pear-forward, accented by delicate notes of white flowers, green orchard fields, and fresh garden air.

  • Palate: Smooth, sweet, and incredibly easy to drink. It delivers a rich, authentic pear flavor that is softer and less sharp than traditional apple ciders.

  • Finish: Crisp and clean, featuring a well-balanced lingering sweetness and a refreshing, mild acidity that prevents the drink from feeling cloying.

The beverage is made using carbonated water, fermented pear wine, and natural pear juice concentrate. It is naturally gluten-free, typically features an ABV of 4.5%, and is designed to be served over a generous amount of ice for ultimate refreshment.

title: Chateau Leoville Las Cases 2002
bodyHtml:
Produced in France, specifically within the Saint Julien appellation of the Left Bank, this wine is the Grand Vin of the historic Château Leoville Las Cases. One of the oldest estates in the Médoc, it was once part of a much larger domaine that was divided in the mid-19th century, resulting in its status as a Second Classified Growth in 1855. Under the long-standing stewardship of the Delon family, the winery follows a philosophy of constant excellence, treating its 98-hectare vineyard—particularly the 'Clos Léoville Las Cases'—with the precision and care typically reserved for First Growth estates.

Wine Description

The 2002 vintage presents a deep ruby-purple or nearly black color in the glass. The sensory profile is remarkably intense, featuring a nose of pure blackcurrant, blackberry, and plum, accented by notes of licorice, graphite, mint leaf, and loamy soil. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and powerful, showing considerable density and a viscous mid-palate framed by firm, solid, and chewy tannins. Stylistically, it is a classically structured wine known for its 'medicinal austerity' in its youth, which has evolved into a graceful elegance with subtle mineral and smoky truffled notes. Composed of 66.7% Cabernet Sauvignon, 14.5% Merlot, 13.9% Cabernet Franc, and 4.9% Petit Verdot, this vintage is currently in an excellent drinking window through 2042.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 95 points

  • Wine Spectator - 94 points

  • Decanter - 94 points

  • Vinous - 93+ points

title: Chateau Angelus 2004
bodyHtml:
Produced in France, specifically within the Saint Emilion Grand Cru region, Chateau Angelus is a distinguished estate that has been under the dedicated care of the Boüard de Laforest family since 1782. The property is famous for its location on a natural amphitheatre, where the sound of the Angelus bells from three local churches can be heard, inspiring both the name and the iconic golden bell on its label. The winery's philosophy combines traditional craftsmanship with a constant drive for technical excellence, a strategy that cemented its reputation as a global leader in fine wine.

Wine Description

The 2004 vintage reveals a deep purple or ruby colour with subtle garnet edges. A highly expressive nose offers an array of scents, including crushed blackcurrants, plums, and violets, layered with secondary notes of smoke, liquorice, and cedar. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, showcasing a refined structure with silky, well-integrated tannins and a vibrant acidity that provides excellent lift. The varietal composition for this year is a blend of 62% Merlot and 38% Cabernet Franc. This vintage is currently in a beautiful state of maturity, offering a long, mineral-inflected finish and an optimal drinking window that extends through 2030.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 95 points

  • Robert Parker - 93 points

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points

  • James Suckling - 92 points

  • Vinous - 92 points

title: Chateau Haut Brion 2005
bodyHtml:
The color is so dense that the wine seems almost black. The nose has an intensity of aromas that are mind-blowing. It can never disavow its origins as we find all the complexity that is so well known for characterizing Haut-Brion: its notes of smoke, of cigar and roasted coffee grains. The whiff of fresh fruit is also present: currants and cherries. From the first approach this wine startles one with its density. It is long in the mouth plus creamy, big, powerful and fresh. It takes a hold of you and penetrates your senses. Power and harmony are the distinctive traits of this vintage. The aromatic persistence is incredibly long. This perfectly balanced wine will without a doubt become one of the biggest successes of our Domaine.

100 Points - Wine Spectator

This is incredible on the nose, showing coffee cake, blackberry, floral, coffee bean and vanilla bean, with Chinese spices. A very complex, full-bodied red, with seamless, hyperpolished tannins that caress every millimeter of the palate. Lasts for minutes. So beautifully balanced, I'm left speechless. Is it even better than the 1989? Best after 2017.

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The mineral-laced 2005 Haut Brion (56% Cabernet Sauvignon, 39% Merlot and 5% Cabernet Franc) is exquisite. With its elegance and finesse, it is not as powerful as La Mission, but the nobility and complexity of the aromatics, incredible fragrance (subtle smoke and blue, red, and black fruits) that persists in the glass, full-bodied mouthfeel (though very light and delicate on its feet), and incredible length characterize this great Haut-Brion. It is just starting to drink well, and should continue to do so for at least another three decades. It is a tour de force in winemaking, but only 9,000 cases were produced.

100 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2005 Haut Brion is out of this world and certainly one of the finest wines I’ve ever tasted. Deeper, richer, and more concentrated than the 2000, it offers as pure an expression of this terroir as I could image with huge notes of blackcurrants, roasted herbs, scorched earth, tobacco, and earth all literally soaring from the glass. Full-bodied, powerful, concentrated, and layered, it still holds onto the hallmark elegance and purity of the estate. Wine doesn’t get any better and this tour de force can be drunk anytime over the coming three decades or more.

99 Points - James Suckling

This is very rich and layered for La Mission with ultra-polished tannins yet velvety and beautiful in texture. It's fully-bodied and full of character that shows plums, berries, wet earth and oyster shell flavors that are so unique to reds from this estate. Superb quality. Better to drink this in 2020 but try now to feel the greatness.

98 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A big, virile wine, dominated by dark and firm tannins. The structure comes from powerful black fruits, the wood only showing as dry edge to the tannins. It’s firm, obviously destined for long aging, with initial blackberry fruits powering through the density. A stupendous wine that will last many decades.

title: Chateau Mouton Rothschild 2003
bodyHtml:
Chateau Mouton Rothschild is a prestigious wine estate located in Pauillac, within the Bordeaux region of France. Established in 1853 by Baron Nathaniel de Rothschild, it has a rich history of producing exceptional wines and is renowned for its innovative practices, including the annual commissioning of renowned artists to design its labels.

Wine Description

The 2003 vintage of Chateau Mouton Rothschild is a blend of 76% Cabernet Sauvignon, 14% Merlot, 8% Cabernet Franc, and 2% Petit Verdot. In the glass, it exhibits a deep, dark ruby-red hue. The nose is characterized by intense aromas of ripe cassis, complemented by notes of cedarwood, caramel, and stewed fruit. On the palate, the wine is lush and rich, displaying stylish, well-rounded tannins with flavors of blackcurrant, spice, Havana cigar, and eucalyptus. The finish is expressive, long, and powerful, harmoniously blending silkiness with lingering fruit and spice notes.

Accolades

  • Vinous: 95 points.

  • Wine Enthusiast: 94 points.

  • Wine Spectator: 94 points.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with rich dishes such as roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, or venison stew. The robust flavors and firm tannins complement the depth and character of hearty meats, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Chateau Pontet Canet 2007
bodyHtml:
Chateau Pontet Canet, situated in the heart of Pauillac, is a historic Fifth Growth estate renowned for its pioneering biodynamic practices. Under the stewardship of the Tesseron family since 1975, the estate has focused on natural harmony within the vineyard, producing wines that reflect the purity of their terroir. With deep gravel soils and meticulous vineyard care, Pontet Canet has become a reference point for quality in Bordeaux.

Wine Description

The 2007 vintage of Chateau Pontet Canet presents a deep garnet colour, with slight evolution at the rim. The nose opens with aromas of ripe red cherries, cassis, and plums, accompanied by notes of cedar, graphite, and dried herbs. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with silky tannins and a refined texture, offering flavours of red and black fruit, tobacco leaf, and subtle spice. Balanced and elegant, the wine finishes with lingering notes of earth and minerality. Composed primarily of Cabernet Sauvignon, with Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot, this vintage is approachable now, with an optimal drinking window through the late 2020s.

Accolades

  • "Wine Spectator - 91 points."
  • "Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 92 points."
  • "Decanter - 90 points."

Food Pairing

This graceful Pauillac pairs wonderfully with roasted poultry, herb-crusted pork tenderloin, or mushroom risotto. Hard cheeses such as Gruyère or Tomme de Savoie also complement its finesse.
This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Wild Life Barrel Aged Gin
bodyHtml:
Wild Life Barrel Aged Gin originates from the heart of the Canadian Rockies in Canmore, Alberta. Founded in 2017 by Keith Robinson and Matt Widmer, Wild Life Distillery is an artisanal producer dedicated to the 'mountain lifestyle', using Rocky Mountain water and Alberta prairie grains. The distillery underwent a significant expansion in 2023 to increase its production capacity while maintaining its focus on handcrafted, small batch spirits.

Spirit Description

This expression begins as the distillery's classic gin, which is distilled from Alberta spring wheat and malted barley before being aged in charred American oak ex-bourbon barrels. It presents a warm, amber hue and a medium to full body with a smooth, 'whisky-like' mouthfeel. The aroma features sweet, soft bourbon notes of vanilla and oak dancing with traditional juniper and bright citrus. On the palate, layers of candied orange and warming spice emerge, complemented by the mellow influence of the wood. The finish is long and persistent, leaving lingering notes of cassia, black pepper, and toasted oak. It is bottled at 47.2% ABV.

title: Proprieta Sperino Cabernet Franc
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

This 100% Cabernet Franc presents a deep red to purple colour with beautiful reflections in the glass. The nose opens with classic varietal aromas of cassis, cedar, tobacco, and exotic spices, accompanied by a distinct whiff of bell pepper and cool earth. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied, juicy, and concentrated, delivering flavours of ripe black cherry, blackcurrant, ground pepper, and star anise. It is characterized by excellent balance, fresh acidity, and a smooth structure framed by velvety, supple tannins that give it an almost weightless texture. Fermented with natural yeasts in open-topped wooden fermenters and aged for 18 months in French oak barriques, it has an optimal drinking window extending up to 15 years from its vintage date.

Food Pairing

The wine's savory profile and structured tannins make it a perfect companion for roasted duck, goose, or game birds. It also pairs wonderfully with hearty meat dishes such as venison, veal, and grilled lamb chops, or savory tomato-based pasta dishes that complement its herbal acidity.

A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Les Amis Syrah 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml: The 'Les Amis' cuvée is a pure expression of the Syrah grape, making up 100 per cent of its varietal composition. It displays an unmistakable deep purple hue. The nose is aromatic and fresh, featuring bright blackberry and ripe plum fruit underscored by savory, 'garrigue'-driven notes of rosemary and lavender. On the palate, the wine is energetic and invigorating, showing a purity of fruit with hints of earthiness and spice that add depth. It is characterized by fully integrated tannins and a slightly tart, clean finish. Stylistically, this is a fresh, natural red wine known for its effortless drinkability and 'wild' edge.

title: Enira Trilogie Bessa Valley - Mixed 6-Pack
bodyHtml:
This trilogy contains 6 bottles -  2 bottles of each wine listed below.

2 x Enira Bessa Valley Syrah 2016

Bessa Valley Winery is based in Bulgaria’s top locations, producing red wines according to the highest Bordeaux standard. The Syrah 2016has been cultivated with great care in French barriques and fascinates with spicy character, density and depth. Experience this wine as a great accompaniment to all meat dishes, pasta with spicy sauces and mild cheese. Limited edition form the best Syrah parcels with only 3176 bottles.

2 x Enira Bessa Valley Petit Verdot 2018

This deep purple dry wine has an eccentric astringent taste of black berries with unique herbal aromas, such as violet, lavender, sage and lilac notes.

2 x Enira Bessa Valley Grand Cuvee 2016

Grande Cuvee 2016 is a strictly limited wine from the best Merlot barriques of the estate, rounded off with a touch of Petit Verdot, the fruitiness of Cabernet Sauvignon, and the added elegance of Syrah. Discover here a deep, multi-layered and uncommonly Bulgarian growth of great radiance and finesse. A masterpiece to be aged and enjoyed!

title: Ornellaia Bianco 2022
bodyHtml:
This rare and 'opulent' white wine originates from Italy, within the Bolgheri Bianco D.O.C. appellation of Tuscany. Established in 1981 by Marchese Lodovico Antinori and owned by the Frescobaldi family since 2005, Tenuta Ornellaia is one of Italy's most prestigious estates. The winemaking philosophy focuses on translating the 'essence of the estate's terroir' into a light-filled interpretation of the Bolgheri coastline, emphasizing a close bond between humans and nature. Sourced primarily from rocky limestone and clay soils in the Bellaria vineyard, Ornellaia Bianco is crafted as a sophisticated white counterpart to the estate's legendary red flagship.

Wine Description

The 2022 Ornellaia Bianco presents a straw-yellow hue in the glass. The sensory profile is complex and alluring, featuring a bouquet of ripe orchard fruits like juicy pear, golden apple, and peach, layered with tropical scents of mango, pineapple, and lychee. Elegant undertones of almond blossom, white flowers, and a hint of toast or vanilla add depth to the nose. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied with a rich, textural mouthfeel and a 'viscous' profile reflecting the warmer vintage. It is characterized by an impeccable harmony between its zesty citrus acidity and lush fruit, finishing on a savory, mineral, and upbeat note. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5% and was aged for 10 months on the lees in oak barrels (25% new) followed by two months in steel. While the estate follows sustainable practices, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Brunello Di Montalcino 'Sugarille' 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy, Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Brunello di Montalcino 'Sugarille' 2021 originates from the acclaimed Montalcino region in Tuscany. The historic Pieve Santa Restituta estate has been part of the Gaja family portfolio since 1994, marking their iconic venture into Tuscan winemaking. The 'Sugarille' label is a highly sought-after single vineyard expression, with roots and an official estate inventory dating back to 1547. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes the distinct character of its specific plot, where the Sangiovese Grosso vines thrive on south facing hills rich in galestro limestone and white clay.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese displays a deep red, almost impenetrable ruby colour. The aromatics burst from the glass, delivering an expressive bouquet of wild strawberries, raspberries, and dark red cherries, layered with complex notes of Parma violets, thyme, rosemary, and incense. On the palate, the wine is full bodied, opulent, and dense. It showcases a deep plummy core alongside a precise mineral line, framed by powerful yet finely polished, velvety tannins. The finish is remarkably long and chewy, highlighted by lingering notes of bitter licorice and a savory mineral complexity. This vintage balances subtle sweet-edged richness with vibrant freshness, displaying an optimal drinking window spanning from 2027 through 2048.

title: Luce Lux Vitis 2022
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy, Luce Lux Vitis 2022 originates from the Montalcino region within the Toscana IGT appellation. The wine is crafted by Tenuta Luce, an estate southwest of Montalcino founded as a collaborative project in the early 1990s by Vittorio Frescobaldi and Robert Mondavi, and now fully under the direction of Lamberto Frescobaldi. The winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing a unique individual style from the estate's pristine, biodiverse environment, utilizing a small three hectare parcel of Cabernet Sauvignon planted on mixed sandy soils to deliver an exclusive, terroir driven wine.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a deep ruby red colour. The bouquet opens with complex and stylishly refined aromas of ripe black fruits, intertwined with elegant sensations of sweet spices, licorice root, thyme, and delicate hints of crushed currants and rose bush. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, displaying a striking balance between freshness and density alongside a structured yet polished framework. It showcases a seamless, velvety texture with a vertical finish that highlights notes of mocha, chocolate nibs, licorice, and graphite. Composed primarily of Cabernet Sauvignon with a small amount of Sangiovese added to enrich its character, the wine was aged for 24 months in 100% new French oak barrels. It possesses a limited annual production of only 10,000 bottles and features an optimal drinking window extending from 2026 through 2040.

title: Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Brunello Di Montalcino 'Sugarille' 2021
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy, Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Brunello di Montalcino 'Sugarille' 2021 originates from the acclaimed Montalcino region in Tuscany. The historic Pieve Santa Restituta estate has been part of the Gaja family portfolio since 1994, marking their iconic venture into Tuscan winemaking. The 'Sugarille' label is a highly sought-after single vineyard expression, with roots and an official estate inventory dating back to 1547. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes the distinct character of its specific plot, where the Sangiovese Grosso vines thrive on south facing hills rich in galestro limestone and white clay.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese displays a deep red, almost impenetrable ruby colour. The aromatics burst from the glass, delivering an expressive bouquet of wild strawberries, raspberries, and dark red cherries, layered with complex notes of Parma violets, thyme, rosemary, and incense. On the palate, the wine is full bodied, opulent, and dense. It showcases a deep plummy core alongside a precise mineral line, framed by powerful yet finely polished, velvety tannins. The finish is remarkably long and chewy, highlighted by lingering notes of bitter licorice and a savory mineral complexity. This vintage balances subtle sweet-edged richness with vibrant freshness, displaying an optimal drinking window spanning from 2027 through 2048.

title: Barbi Brunello di Montalcino “Vigna Fiore” 2021
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy, Barbi Brunello di Montalcino 'Vigna del Fiore' 2021 originates from the historic Montalcino region in Tuscany. The Fattoria dei Barbi estate has been owned by the Colombini family, who have documented ties to the land dating back to 1352. Vigna del Fiore is a unique, single vineyard spanning a narrow valley with shale, marl, and alberese soils. The winery operates under a philosophy that balances long standing local traditions with single vineyard precision, crafting this particular cru since its first bottling in 1981 to showcase an elegant, high-toned nervous system distinct from their classic blend.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese wine possesses an intense and lively ruby red colour. The aromatics are soaring and complex, offering a perfume of pressed rose petals, lavender, and wild mint layered with fragrances of ripe cherry, blackcurrant, red plum, and subtle hints of unsweetened cocoa and iron. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, presenting an enveloping texture with a vibrant, electric energy and a juicy, tense finish. It displays highly polished yet grippy, well structured tannins and a lively acidity. The persistent finish beautifully recalls flavors of dark plum and liquorice. This vintage offers immense concentration while maintaining a weightless feel, with a magnificent cellaring potential spanning 20 to 60 years.

title: Castello Romitorio Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2019
bodyHtml:
This extraordinary red wine comes from Italy, originating from the prestigious Brunello di Montalcino DOCG in the northern sector of the Tuscany region. Acquired in 1984 by the celebrated Italian trans-avant-garde artist Sandro Chia, the historic Castello Romitorio estate is managed today alongside his son, Filippo Chia. The winery functions on a winemaking philosophy that bridges classic structural purity with artistic expression, using a white artist label for this particular bottling to distinguish its unique personality. The Riserva designation represents the pinnacle of the estate's production, crafted from a meticulous selection of the finest Sangiovese grapes that undergo extended cellar maturation before release.

Wine Description

The 2019 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva exhibits a brilliant ruby red colour with a sparkling, dark core in the glass. On the nose, it unveils an unexpected and inviting cornucopia of aromas, showcasing powerful cherry fruit, macerated blueberries, and sugared blackberries, seamlessly interwoven with complex layers of damp earth, cured tobacco, barbecue smoke, and grilled herbs. The palate is full bodied, seamless, and silky to the touch, carrying a classic and deep profile of dried strawberry, dark cherry, and wild plum accented by nutmeg, clove, and toasted almond. It balances a dense, texturally rich fruit core against a graceful, vibrant acidity and a towering framework of sweet, fine grained tannins. Delicate undertones of lavender sachet, dusty rose, and blue flowers emerge on the back palate, culminating in a soft, glossy, and almost endless finish that leaves persistent savory accents. Crafted from 100% Sangiovese, this elite wine is highly elegant rather than overly muscular. Poised for magnificent long term aging, its optimal drinking window extends well through 2050.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 vintage is widely celebrated as an absolute triumph and a benchmark year for Montalcino, yielding radiant fruit defined by an ideal balance of phenolic ripeness and natural freshness. Balanced weather conditions allowed the late-ripening Sangiovese grapes to develop slowly and steadily, giving winemakers the perfect raw material to craft wines with deep aromatic clarity, exceptional depth, and long term cellaring potential.

title: Romitorio Brunello di Montalcino 'Filo di Seta' 2019
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine comes from Italy, originating from the prestigious Brunello di Montalcino DOCG in the northern sector of the Tuscany region. Acquired in 1984 by the celebrated Italian trans-avant-garde artist Sandro Chia, the historic Castello Romitorio estate is managed today alongside his son, Filippo Chia. The winery functions on a winemaking philosophy that bridges classic structural purity with artistic expression, highlighting the unique microclimates of their cooler, high-altitude vineyards surrounded by dense Mediterranean forest. The 'Filo di Seta' (meaning 'silk thread') is a single-vineyard bottling sourced from a specific, limestone-rich schistous clay parcel nestled at 250 metres above sea level, crafted to express a cooler, intensely vibrant, and finely drawn profile of the estate's terroir.

Wine Description

The 2019 Filo di Seta exhibits a brilliant, intense ruby red colour in the glass. On the nose, it delivers an incredibly etched, lively, and flamboyant bouquet dominated by aromas of dark berry fruit, blackberry, black cherry, and blood orange, layered with alluring scents of eucalyptus, tobacco, mint, dark chocolate, and damp earth. The palate is amply weighted, complex, and structural, revealing an energetic core of crisp cherry fruit, pomegranate, and spice notes like cinnamon and clove, all framed against a distinct mineral-like texture of petrichor, gravel, and wet slate. It displays a gorgeous harmony of powerful fruit concentration, vibrant, citrus-like acidity, and polished, fine-grained tannins that glide seamlessly across the tongue. Complex floral tones of purple flowers and iris root soften the back palette, culminating in an ultra-long, dramatic, and resonant finish. Composed of 100% Sangiovese, the wine spent 30 months maturing in French oak barrels followed by 12 months of refinement in the bottle before release. While highly rewarding soon after opening, this cellar keeper features an optimal drinking window spanning from 2025 through 2048.

title: Gaja Pieve Santa Restituta Brunello di Montalcino 'Rennina' 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This exceptional single-vineyard red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the prestigious Brunello di Montalcino DOCG within the southwest hillsides of the Tuscany region. In 1994, the legendary Piedmontese winemaking family led by Angelo Gaja acquired the historic Pieve Santa Restituta estate, expanding outside their native home for the first time. The 'Rennina' bottling takes its name from the ancient Roman state that once oversaw the site, reflecting an estate philosophy focused on celebrating historical roots and crafting highly structural, elegant expressions of Sangiovese.

Wine Description

The 2021 Brunello di Montalcino Rennina presents a dark, jeweled ruby hue in the glass. On the nose, it delivers a complex and fragrant bouquet marked by aromas of red cherries, crushed blackberries, and sweet violets, beautifully intertwined with earthy notes of crushed stones, graphite, dusty sage, and a lift of orange zest. The palate is full bodied, tense, and crisp, driven by an open frame of ripe wild berry fruits, licorice, and aromatic herbs. It reveals magnificent volume and a velvety, polished texture balanced by a racy, bright acidity and a heroic structure of grippy, expansive tannins. The finish is long, intense, and distinctively juicy, trailing off with gamy accents and inner floral notes. Crafted from 100% Sangiovese, the fruit is sourced across three distinct sub-plots—Santo Pietro, Castagno, and Pian dei Cerri—before undergoing fermentation and a long, carefully calibrated oak maturation process. Its noble structure indicates an optimal drinking window between 2028 and 2048.

Vintage Quality

Despite facing early spring frost and a dry summer, the 2021 growing season in Montalcino is considered a triumph, saved by late-season cooling trends that slowed ripening. This allowed the grapes to achieve optimal phenolic maturity and a balanced fruit concentration without excessive alcohol, imbuing the vintage with elegant tannins, high acidity, and a striking, noble structure.

title: Domaine Ponsot Morey Saint Denis Premier Cru Cuvee des Alouettes 2014 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This rare and exceptional red wine originates from France, specifically from the Morey-Saint-Denis Premier Cru appellation within the star-studded Côte de Nuits region of Burgundy. Established in 1872, Domaine Ponsot is one of Burgundy's most legendary portfolios, globally celebrated for its historic holdings and deeply non-interventionist winemaking philosophy. The 'Cuvée des Alouettes' is a single-vineyard premier cru sourced entirely from a tiny, one-hectare plot inside the 'Monts-Luisants' lieu-dit, sitting uniquely just one metre away from the prestigious Grand Cru Clos de la Roche.

Wine Description

The Cuvée des Alouettes presents a striking, deep ruby red colour in the glass. On the nose, it unfolds a highly expressive and layered bouquet rich in dark berries, plums, and baking chocolate, intermingled with subtler notes of orange zest, warm spices, and wet stone. The palate is dense, powerful, and beautifully concentrated, balancing an impressive weight of black fruit with a lively, saline core. It exhibits a seamless synergy of richness and freshness, structured by fine but noticeably firmer tannins and a refreshing acidity that carries into an ultra-pure, long-lasting finish. Crafted from 100% Pinot Noir, the wine is entirely destemmed and fermented in traditional wooden vats before maturing for 18 to 20 months in seasoned French oak casks. True to the estate's strict hands-off philosophy, the wine is never fined or filtered, and absolutely no new oak barrels are used, letting the raw terroir shine through gracefully. This bottle offers a generous drinking window, structurally built to evolve beautifully for 20 years or more.

title: Solaia 2004 (by Tenuta Tignanello)
bodyHtml:
The 2004 Solaia by Antinori is a celebrated Super Tuscan blend, composed of 75% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Sangiovese, and 5% Cabernet Franc. Known for its power and elegance, this vintage embodies the essence of the Tuscan terroir, showcasing a harmonious mix of ripe fruit, spice, and structure. The wine underwent meticulous aging, which has enhanced its complexity and longevity.

  • Colour: Deep ruby red with garnet highlights.
  • Aroma: Aromatic layers of blackberries, cassis, chocolate, and mint, with hints of leather and graphite.
  • Palate: Rich and concentrated with flavors of dark fruits, licorice, and mocha, supported by fine tannins.
  • Body: Full-bodied with a velvety texture.
  • Finish: Long and persistent, leaving notes of spice and menthol.

Accolades:

  • 97 Points - Vinous
  • 96 Points - Robert Parker’s Wine Advocate
  • 96 Points - Wine Spectator
  • 96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The 2004 Solaia is suitable for aging until 2034, but it can also be enjoyed now with decanting. It pairs beautifully with beef dishes, venison, or aged cheeses, offering both immediate pleasure and long-term potential for collectors. This vintage stands out as a prime example of Antinori's craftsmanship, balancing power with elegance.

title: Roland Lavantureux Chablis Vieilles Vignes - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This expressive white wine comes from France, originating from the historic subregion of Chablis within northern Burgundy. Following the completion of his wine education in Beaune, Roland Lavantureux established the estate in 1978 in the village of Lignorelles. Today, the domain is driven by his two sons, Arnaud and David, who maintain a winemaking philosophy focused on sustainable farming and protecting local biodiversity to craft intensely mineral wines that directly reflect their unique vineyard sites. The 'Vieilles Vignes' bottling is sourced from three distinct parcels of old vines planted between the 1960s and 1970s, which tunnel deep into the classic Kimmeridgian subsoil to capture maximum terroir pedigree.

Wine Description

Housed in an impressive 1.5 litre magnum bottle, the Chablis Vieilles Vignes displays a fresh, pale yellow colour with brilliant clarity. The nose is expressive and opulent, revealing an aromatic bouquet of ripe pears, yellow plums, and crisp citrus zest, seamlessly woven with layers of white flowers, lemon blossom, and smoky mineral salts. On the palate, the wine delivers an initial sensation of generous fruit density and texture due to naturally low old-vine yields, which smoothly transitions into a precise, tightly wound mid palate. It displays electric, crunchy acidity and a textbook 'Kimmeridgian hum' that evokes chalk, slate, and a briny ocean breeze. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, the wine was fermented in temperature controlled stainless steel vats before undergoing an aging regime where approximately 60% of the juice rested on its fine lees in steel and 40% matured in older French oak barrels. This larger 1.5 litre format acts as an optimal shield against oxidation, slowing maturation to grant this structured, classy Chablis an extended drinking window that easily spans 5 to 10 years from release.

title: Domaine De Chevalier Rouge 2000
bodyHtml:
Domaine de Chevalier is located in the Pessac Leognan subregion of Bordeaux, France. Since 1983, the estate has been owned by the Bernard family and managed by Olivier Bernard, who maintains a philosophy of perfection and balance. The vineyard is considered a jewel of the Graves region, emphasizing a commitment to terroir where ninety percent of the quality is achieved through meticulous vineyard work.

Wine Description

Domaine de Chevalier Rouge presents a deep ruby red colour with an expressive and complex nose featuring sweet tobacco, plums, and smoky mineral notes. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and juicy, offering a sophisticated blend of redcurrant, blackberry, and cedar complemented by silky, well resolved tannins. It displays a harmonious structure with fresh acidity and a long, persistent finish that reveals hints of spice and pencil lead.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 94 points

  • James Suckling - 93 points

  • Robert Parker - 93 points

  • Vinous - 93 points

  • Decanter - 90 points

Food Pairing

This wine pairs exceptionally well with roasted lamb seasoned with rosemary, grilled entrecote, or wild mushroom risotto to complement its earthy and tobacco notes. It also serves as an excellent companion to aged cheeses such as Comté or Mimolette.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Speymalt Single Malt from Macallan 2004 #22606603
bodyHtml:
This exceptional single malt Scotch whisky comes from the legendary Macallan Distillery in the Speyside region of Scotland. Part of the highly acclaimed 'Speymalt' range, it was independently matured and bottled by Gordon & MacPhail. Established in 1895, Gordon & MacPhail is a historic family firm that possesses a long standing, unique relationship with Macallan, famously selecting their own high quality oak casks to be filled with new-make spirit directly from the distillery. This single cask expression, marked as Cask #22606603, was bottled exclusively for the Alberta, Canada market.

Whisky Description

In the glass, this Speymalt single cask presents a deep, rich bronze colour with faint ruby hues. The nose is incredibly flamboyant and seductive, opening with stewed plums, sour cherries, dates, and sticky figs, beautifully intertwined with ginger spice, dark chocolate, and a hint of fine cigar tobacco. On the palate, the whisky is powerful, full bodied, and decadent. It displays an old school edge with a rich concentration of dried fruits, apricot jam, and orange zest, balanced by toasted hazelnuts, white pepper, and undertones of leather and cocoa powder. The texture is remarkably smooth and creamy, masking its high alcoholic volume with absolute elegance. The finish is long, warming, and multi-layered, leaving a lingering trace of sultanas, dry walnut, and sweet mature oak. Distilled in 2004, this expression rested for nearly two decades in a single first-fill American oak barrel that was sherry-seasoned, before being bottled in 2024 at a robust cask strength of 59.1% ABV. It is best enjoyed neat or with a few drops of water to fully unlock its aromatic density.

title: Blue Mountain Gamay Noir
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada, specifically from the Okanagan Falls subregion. Founded in 1971 by the Mavety family, Blue Mountain Vineyard and Cellars is a pioneer of the region, emphasizing a philosophy of minimal intervention and sustainable viticulture to showcase the unique terroir of their estate. The family focuses on producing complex, estate grown wines that reflect the potential of individual vineyard sites.

Wine Description

The Blue Mountain Gamay Noir presents a medium ruby colour and an aromatic profile of cherry, black raspberry, and fleshy plum mingled with white pepper and spice. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and juicy, offering a core of red and black fruits seasoned with desert scrubby herbs and a flinty, savoury undercurrent. It is characterized by its bright acidity and soft, downy tannins, leading to a long, spicy finish. This varietal Gamay Noir is crafted with natural yeasts and aged in neutral French oak to maintain a balance of freshness and complexity.

Food Pairing

This versatile red wine is an excellent match for roast chicken with herbs, grilled pork chops, or planked salmon with a soy glaze. It also pairs beautifully with autumnal dishes such as mushroom tart or roast butternut squash.

title: Casanova Di Neri Brunello di Montalcino 'Tenuta Nuova' 2021
bodyHtml:
This concentrated and 'monumental' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation in Tuscany. Founded in 1971 by Giovanni Neri, the estate was born from a vision to produce exceptional Sangiovese in the then-remote region of Montalcino. Today, Giacomo Neri and his sons continue this legacy, managing approximately 63 hectares across seven distinct sites. The 'Tenuta Nuova' label is a modern legend, specifically conceived by Giacomo Neri to find a southern terroir in Castelnuovo dell'Abate that could yield a uniquely powerful and complex expression of Brunello.

Wine Description

The 2021 Casanova di Neri Tenuta Nuova presents a deep, brilliant appearance and a full-bodied sensory profile defined by its 'seductive energy'. The nose is an intense spice box featuring aromas of crushed roses, incense, and spiced orange peels, layered with notes of blackberry, rosemary, and herbal tea. On the palate, the wine is massive yet remarkably 'weightless', showcasing a dense and saline core of dark fruit flavours paired with a subtle vein of salt. It is characterized by its velvety, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity that creates a 'saturating tension'. The finish is exceptionally long and fragrant, lingering with vivid sour cherry and savory spices. This 100% Sangiovese reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and was aged for 30 months in oak tonneaux followed by at least six months in the bottle. While the winery utilizes natural processes and low-impact design, this bottling is not certified organic.

Accolades

Vinous 96 Points - "The 2021 Brunello di Montalcino Giovanni Neri is a total spice box on the nose, with crushed roses, spiced orange peels, incense, raspberry, herbal tea leaves and hints of mint. More lifted and energetic than expected, it displays grace and youthful poise with mineral-inflected wild berry fruits. Vivid sour cherry lingers incredibly long through the finish as fine-grained tannins frame the experience and a bump of residual acidity keeps the mouth watering for more."

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Montalcino is regarded as a potential 'modern classic', awarded a five-star rating for its exceptional harmony and vibrant acidity. While spring frosts initially reduced yields, a remarkably even growing season allowed for a slow ripening that produced fruit with immense concentration and 'verticality'. Winemakers successfully adapted to the season's warmth by utilizing the estate's high-quality vineyard management, resulting in wines that capture the hedonistic depth of the site while maintaining a fresh, lively counterpoint.

title: Cadenhead Mannochmore 12 Years Old Single Malt Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Cadenhead Mannochmore 12 Years Old originates from the Speyside region of Scotland, near Elgin. The Mannochmore Distillery was established in 1971 by John Haig & Co. and is currently owned by Diageo, frequently operating as a 'sister' site to the neighbouring Glenlossie Distillery. This specific bottling is released by William Cadenhead Limited, Scotland's oldest independent bottler, which was founded in 1842 and has been owned by J & A Mitchell & Co. Ltd since 1972.

Spirit Description

This single malt is a light and vibrant expression, typically matured in bourbon hogshead casks and bottled at a robust cask strength of 60.4% ABV. It presents a pale straw colour with a medium body and a notably clean, oily texture. The aroma is highly aromatic, featuring notes of parma violet sweets, bourbon cream biscuits, and a distinct floral freshness. On the palate, it delivers a complex array of flavours including kiwi fruit, gooseberries, and treacle toffee, balanced by a touch of balsa wood. The finish is long and refreshing, marked by lingering notes of white pepper, oregano, and dried grass.

Food Pairing

The crisp acidity and tropical fruit notes of this 12-year-old whisky make it an excellent partner for light seafood dishes such as lemon butter scallops or a fresh sea bass ceviche. It also pairs effectively with creamy desserts like vanilla bean panna cotta or a fruit based pavlova topped with kiwi and gooseberries. For a savoury alternative, consider serving it alongside mild goat cheese or a salad of arugula and toasted almonds, which complements the spirit's herbal and peppery finish.

title: Casanova Di Neri Brunello 'Giovanni Neri' 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This prestigious and 'intellectual' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation in Tuscany. Founded in 1971 by Giovanni Neri, the estate is now managed by his son Giacomo and grandsons Giovanni and Gianlorenzo. The 'Giovanni Neri' bottling is the estate's newest flagship, created as a tribute to the founder and sourced from a unique vineyard in the Sesta zone with vines that are over 50 years old. The winery's philosophy focuses on a 'modern' yet terroir-driven approach, utilizing a gravity-fed cellar built into a hillside to ensure natural humidity and temperature control.

Wine Description

The 2021 Casanova di Neri Giovanni Neri presents a bright, brilliant, and intense red colour. Its sensory profile is a complex 'symphony' of high-toned aromatics, featuring a nose of dark cherries, blueberries, and plums, layered with scents of blood orange, wild strawberry, mint, and sandalwood. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and muscular yet remarkably elegant, showcasing tactile mineral tones and fine-grained, creamy tannins. It is characterized by its vertical structure and a vibrant, chiseled finish that is both deep and persistent. This 100% Sangiovese was vinified with 20% whole clusters and reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5%. The wine was aged for 30 months in barrel followed by 18 months in the bottle, and while the estate follows rigorous and low-impact grape-growing, this bottling is not officially certified organic.

Accolades

James Suckling 98 Points - " A muscular single-vineyard Brunello. Intense aromas of dark cherries, spearmint, lilacs and sandalwood. Full-bodied with a tight and compacted palate, chewy tannins and a fresh and tense finish. Needs time to soften and come together. Best after 2028."

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Montalcino is hailed as a potential 'modern classic', awarded a five-star rating for its exceptional harmony and precision. Despite a severe April frost that significantly reduced yields across the region, a remarkably even growing season with warm but not excessive summer heat allowed for optimal phenolic complexity. Winemakers at Casanova di Neri benefited from late August showers that refreshed the vines, resulting in fruit with a 'nervy energy' and perfectly integrated acidity that ensures a longevity of 15 to 25 years.

title: Chateau de Sancerre Terre de Silex 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in France, Chateau de Sancerre Terre de Silex originates from the Upper Loire Valley within the prestigious Sancerre appellation. The estate is historically significant, featuring a castle that overlooks the town of Sancerre, and was notably owned for decades by the Marnier-Lapostolle family (of Grand Marnier fame) before being acquired by the Bollinger family. The vineyard operates with a level 4 High Environmental Value (HVE) certification, following a winemaking philosophy that emphasizes sustainable viticulture and a deep respect for the region's diverse flint and limestone terroirs.

Wine Description

This 100% Sauvignon Blanc presents a fresh and mineral expression of the famous 'silex' (flint) soils. On the nose, it reveals zesty aromas of lemons and white fleshed fruit, often accompanied by complex notes of peach pits, almonds, and distinct flinty undertones. The palate is medium to full bodied and textured, characterized by a crisp acidity and a vibrant, mineral core. Stylistically, the wine is praised for its balance and sleek, long finish, with a structure designed for both immediate freshness and moderate longevity. While exhilarating to drink now, it has a recommended drinking window extending through the next few years to preserve its zesty fruit profile.

title: Castello Romitorio Brunello di Montalcino 2021
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and 'captivating' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation in Tuscany. Castello Romitorio is a landmark estate housed in a restored 12th-century fortress, revived in 1984 by the internationally renowned artist Sandro Chia. The winery's philosophy is a 'living dialogue' between art and viticulture, focusing on purity, precision, and the unique expression of Sangiovese grown in some of the region's coolest and most elevated parcels. Today, the estate continues this artistic legacy under the direction of Sandro's son, Filippo Chia, emphasizing a style defined by restraint and mineral-driven elegance.

Wine Description

The 2021 Castello Romitorio Brunello di Montalcino presents a brilliant ruby red colour with a flint core. The sensory profile is rich and assertive, featuring a complex nose of black cherries, red plums, and wild strawberries, layered with nuanced notes of blood orange, sandalwood, incense, and liquorice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and 'impeccably structured', showcasing remarkable purity of red fruit and crunchy mineral tones underpinned by vibrant acidity. It is characterized by silky, tightly-knit tannins and a salty finish that trails off with notes of savoury herbs and dark chocolate. This 100% Sangiovese (Brunello) reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5%. The wine was aged for 24 months in oak followed by extensive refinement in the bottle, and while the estate works 'in harmony with nature', this bottling is not officially certified organic.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Montalcino is regarded as 'memorable' and potentially among the best in recent history, awarded a five-star rating. The season benefited from a dry summer and ideal conditions in September, with cool nights that allowed for optimal ripening and high natural acidity. Winemakers at the Romitorio estate utilized their high-altitude, cool clay soils to preserve freshness despite the summer heat, resulting in a vintage noted for its 'seamless mouthfeel' and exceptional aging potential through 2045.

title: Romitorio Brunello di Montalcino 'Filo di Seta' 2021
bodyHtml:
This concentrated and 'captivating' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation in Tuscany. Filo di Seta (meaning 'silk thread') is a single-vineyard selection from Castello Romitorio, sourced from a specific high-altitude parcel near the castle. The estate, led by artist Sandro Chia and his son Filippo, follows a winemaking philosophy that treats each vintage as a 'dialogue' between art and nature, focusing on the cooler, northwest-facing slopes of Montalcino to produce wines of exceptional precision and mineral tension.

Wine Description

The 2021 Filo di Seta presents a bright, brilliant ruby red colour. The sensory profile is remarkably complex and refined, featuring an intense nose of dark cherries, wild strawberries, and red plums, layered with nuanced notes of blood orange, crushed stones, incense, and a hint of sandalwood. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and 'impeccably structured', showcasing a core of vibrant red fruit and a distinct salty minerality underpinned by a refreshing acid line. It is characterized by its signature silky texture, living up to its name and tightly-knit, fine-grained tannins that lead to a long, persistent finish of spice and dried herbs. This 100% Sangiovese reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and was matured for approximately 30 months in oak. While the estate manages the land with a holistic approach to biodiversity, this bottling is not officially certified organic.

Accolades

Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "Castello Romitorio’s 2021 Brunello di Montalcino Filo di Seta is a striking expression of the vintage, sourced from a site at 270 meters in elevation on bluish galestro schist that lends power, focus and a distinct mineral edge. Planted in 1995 to old Sangiovese clones that produce naturally small clusters, the vineyard yields compact, dark fruit accented by mint and rosemary, echoing the surrounding forested landscape. A barrel selection from the 2.5-hectare site, this wine shows greater definition and density than the village Brunello, with vertical structure, poised acidity and a glossy, tightly knit texture. Fresh and bright yet richly layered, it closes on a beautifully balanced, sweet finish, gaining volume with air. Production is limited to 6,500 bottles."

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Montalcino has been hailed as 'memorable' and potentially legendary, receiving a five-star rating for its ideal balance of power and freshness. A dry summer followed by cool September nights allowed the grapes to achieve perfect phenolic ripeness while maintaining high natural acidity. Winemakers at Romitorio utilized their high-elevation, northwest-facing vineyards to full advantage, capturing a level of 'crunchy' fruit and mineral depth that distinguishes this vintage as one with exceptional long-term aging potential through 2045.

title: Casanova Di Neri 'Giovanni' Rosso Di Montalcino 2022
bodyHtml:
This concentrated and 'dreamy' red wine originates from Italy, within the Rosso di Montalcino D.O.C. appellation of Tuscany. Founded in 1971 by Giovanni Neri, Casanova di Neri is a family owned estate now led by Giacomo Neri and his sons, Giovanni and Gianlorenzo. The winery's philosophy treats the Rosso di Montalcino as a paramount wine, sourcing grapes from dedicated vineyards including 50 year old Brunello vines for the Giovanni Neri cuvée and applying the same meticulous care and attention to detail reserved for their top Brunello bottlings.

Wine Description

Casanova di Neri Rosso di Montalcino presents a beautiful, young, and lively ruby red colour. The sensory profile is highly expressive and fruit focused, featuring a nose of cherries, raspberries, and blackberries layered with floral hints of rose petals, lavender, and sweet spices. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and refined, showcasing a core of pure strawberries and cherries underpinned by tactile mineral tones and crisp acidity. It is characterized by its soft, fine grained tannins and a juicy, velvety finish that is more Brunello-like in its concentration and persistent floral perfume.

title: Casanova Di Neri Brunello 'Giovanni Neri' 2021
