title: Strongbow Cider - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Strongbow Apple Ciders is arguably the most famous cider brand in the world, serving as the global benchmark for the English Dry Cider style. Originating in Hereford, England, in 1960, it was named after the Cambro-Norman knight Richard de Clare, nicknamed "Strongbow." While many modern North American ciders have leaned into extreme sweetness or "cloudy" textures, Strongbow has built its legacy on consistency, high carbonation, and a distinct, tannin-driven dryness. It is designed to be the ultimate thirst-quencher refreshing, sharp, and unmistakably "apple."

Cider Description

Strongbow pours a brilliant, crystal-clear pale gold with a vigorous, champagne-like effervescence and a thin white head that dissipates rapidly.

Aroma: The nose is clean, sharp, and focused. It leads with dominant notes of tart green apples and bruised apple skin, followed by a subtle, earthy undertone of English orchard floor. There are no heavy floral or candy-like scents; it smells purely of fermented juice and natural acidity.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a crisp, "prickly" carbonation that cuts across the palate. It leads with a flash of natural apple sweetness, which is almost immediately balanced by a signature bittersweet tannic dryness. The finish is remarkably short and clean, leaving a faint, puckering tartness that encourages another sip.

Profile: It typically sits at 5.0% ABV (though this can vary slightly by region) and, as a cider, has 0 IBU. It is naturally gluten-free.

Technical Notes: The unique flavor profile of Strongbow comes from a specific blend of bittersweet cider apples grown in England and France. These apples are much higher in tannins and acid than the "dessert" apples (like Gala or Fuji) used in sweeter ciders. The juice is fermented with a highly attenuative yeast strain to ensure most of the sugars are converted to alcohol, resulting in its famous dry finish.

title: Cousino Macul Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'classic' red wine originates from Chile, specifically from the historic vineyards of the Maipo Valley. Founded in 1856, Cousiño Macul is the only winery in Chile established in the 19th century that remains 100% owned and operated by its original founding family, now in its sixth and seventh generations. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a 'world-class' Chilean identity by combining traditional Bordeaux-style winemaking with sustainable agriculture and minimal intervention to protect the natural character of the Maipo terroir.

Wine Description

Cabernet Sauvignon (specifically the renowned Antiguas Reservas bottling) presents a dark ruby colour with intense fruit aromas. The sensory profile features a nose of blackcurrant, cherries, and strawberries, layered with spicy notes of black pepper, liquorice, and a soft menthol aroma. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and generous, showcasing harmonious flavours of ripe black plums and blackberry fruit underpinned by firm, ripe tannins. It is characterized by its balanced wood influence, featuring delicate cocoa and light toast notes from French oak maturation, leading to a persistent and complex finish. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14% and a sugar content of 2.6 g/L. While the estate follows sustainable viticulture and reduces the use of agrochemicals, this specific vintage is not certified organic.

title: Appleton Estate Hearts Collection 1998
bodyHtml:
Appleton Estate Hearts Collection 1998 is a rare, 25-year-old single-marque Jamaican rum representing the eighth edition of the prestigious Hearts Collection. The spirit is a collaborative project between Appleton Estate Master Blender Dr. Joy Spence and renowned rum expert Luca Gargano of Velier. Founded in 1749 in the Nassau Valley, St. Elizabeth, Appleton Estate is the oldest distillery in Jamaica. The estate is currently owned by the Italian Campari Group, which acquired it through the purchase of J. Wray & Nephew in 2012.

Spirit Description

This limited edition consists of only 2,706 bottles worldwide, blended from a selection of nineteen casks. It is distilled in 100% Forsyth copper pot stills from molasses and aged for 25 tropical years on the estate in ex-bourbon barrels.

  • Colour: The rum possesses a beautiful amber-orange to deep copper appearance.

  • Aroma: Intense and ester-forward, it features overripe tropical fruits, sharp citrus peel, and herbal notes alongside coffee, molasses, and holiday-spiced vanilla syrup.

  • Palate: Powerful and muscular with a smooth texture, offering deep flavours of orange peel, ginger, espresso, and dark chocolate layered with vanilla, toasted nuts, and butterscotch.

  • Body: It is highly concentrated and heavy with congeners, providing immense complexity and a smouldering warmth.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long and dry, dominated by toasted oak, molasses, and lingering spice.

  • ABV: This rum is bottled at a high strength of 63%.

title: Momokawa Pearl Creamy Junmai  Ginjo Nigori
bodyHtml:
Momokawa Pearl Nigori Junmai is a premium 'cloudy' sake originating from Forest Grove, Oregon, in the United States. It is produced by SakéOne, a craft brewery founded in 1992 that helped pioneer the American sake movement. The brewery utilizes ancient Japanese techniques, learned with guidance from the Murai family of Momokawa Brewing in Japan, combined with local Oregon spring water and California-grown Calrose rice.

Description

This sake is a 'nigori' (less filtered) style that is undiluted and features a richly thick, milky appearance. It offers a bright and creamy sensory profile with bold tropical aromas of coconut, pineapple, and vanilla. On the palate, it provides lush flavours of banana and coconut with a smooth, velvety mouthfeel. Brewed with rice polished to 58%, it is a well-balanced brew that highlights a natural, subtle sweetness. It has an alcohol by volume of 14.8% and is best enjoyed well-chilled.

Food Pairing

The creamy texture and tropical fruit notes of Momokawa Pearl make it a champion for pairing with heat and spice. It is a classic match for spicy tuna rolls, Thai green curry, and blackened salmon. Its rich profile also complements savory dishes like butter chicken, cambozola cheese, and barbecue. For a sweet pairing, it can be served alongside fruity desserts or coconut-based treats to echo its natural aromatics.

title: Tignanello 2022 (by Tenuta Tignanello) - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This legendary red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the heart of the Chianti Classico zone in the Tuscany region. Produced by the historic Marchesi Antinori family—a winemaking dynasty spanning over 26 generations—the wine is grown exclusively at the Tenuta Tignanello estate on a 57-hectare southwest-facing hillside rich in limestone and marl soils. Renowned as the pioneer that ushered Italy into modern winemaking, Tignanello was historically groundbreaking as the first Sangiovese-dominant red to be aged in small oak barriques and one of the first to incorporate non-indigenous French grape varieties into the blend.

Wine Description

The 2022 Tignanello displays an intense ruby red colour with vibrant purple highlights. The bouquet is exceptionally expressive and lifted, opening with striking aromas of red and black cherries, pomegranate seeds, and wild strawberries, layered with fragrant purple flowers, fresh balsamic hints, mint, and a touch of sweet vanilla. On the palate, this medium to full-bodied wine is poised and complex, showcasing a core of succulent black cherry, plum, and cassis neatly balanced by a distinct graphite minerality. It strikes a gorgeous harmony between fresh, brisk acidity and dense fruit weight, all supported by velvety, fine-grained tannins. The finish is remarkably long, polished, and precise, echoing persistent notes of tobacco, bitter cocoa, and sweet herbs. Composed of 78% Sangiovese, 18% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 4% Cabernet Franc, the wine was aged for 15 months in French and Hungarian oak barrels before undergoing an additional 12 months of refinement in the bottle. It enters its optimal drinking window in 2026 and will cellar beautifully through 2040.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 growing season in Tuscany was defined by intense summer heat, which naturally yielded a more concentrated and fruit-forward wine. Late-season rain events challenged the region, but Tenuta Tignanello's steep, well-draining hillside vineyards proved to be a major advantage, allowing the grapes to reach an optimal and healthy phenolic maturity.

title: Gaja Gaia & Rey Bass Langhe Bianco Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Piedmont region, specifically within the Langhe DOC appellation, Gaja 'Gaia & Rey' Langhe 2024 represents a landmark, aristocratic, and legendary expression of Italian Chardonnay. First planted in 1979 in Treiso by Angelo Gaja, 'Gaia & Rey' was the very first cultivate Chardonnay planted in Piedmont and is named in honour of Angelo’s eldest daughter, Gaia Gaja, and his grandmother, Clotilde Rey. Sourced from high-elevation estate vineyards in Treiso and Serralunga d'Alba planted on steep limestone and clay-marl soils, the winemaking philosophy combines whole-cluster pressing, temperature-controlled fermentation, and refined maturation in French oak barriques (a mixture of new and neutral oak) for approximately 12 months followed by extended bottle aging. The result is a monumental white wine that effortlessly bridges Burgundian complexity and weight with distinct Piedmontese mineral authority.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous deep golden yellow colour with bright greenish reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe Meyer lemon, yellow apple, poached pear, and white peach, interwoven with sophisticated notes of acacia honey, toasted hazelnut, crushed flint, lemon curd, and subtle vanilla spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, rich, and satiny, delivering concentrated flavours of stone fruit, orchard fruit, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a luxurious, coat-the-mouth texture derived from oak maturation and a driving mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus peel, savory toasted nuts, and a clean, chalky limestone grip. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this 2024 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2042+. Stylistically, it combines opulent texture and aromatic power with laser-like focus, high-altitude freshness, and extraordinary cellaring capability.

title: La Rioja Alta Finca San Martin Crianza 2020
bodyHtml:
This modern and approachable red wine originates from the Rioja Alavesa sub-region in Spain. Finca San Martín is the estate-grown Crianza from Torre de Oña, a boutique winery acquired by the legendary La Rioja Alta, S.A. group in 1995. While the parent company is famous for its classical, long-aged styles, the philosophy at Torre de Oña is to produce "single-estate" wines that highlight the specific terroir of their 65 hectares of vineyards in Páganos. This Crianza is designed to be fresher and more fruit-driven than the traditional Gran Reservas of the group.

Wine Description

The La Rioja Alta Finca San Martin Crianza 2021 (the current release as of 2026) presents a vivid cherry-red colour with an intense ruby hue at the rim. The sensory profile is highly aromatic, featuring a primary nose of blackberry, raspberry, and red cranberry, layered with sophisticated notes of clove, vanilla, roasted coffee, and sweet licorice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and exceptionally balanced, showcasing soft, approachable tannins and a crisp, refreshing acidity. It is characterized by its "Atlantic" freshness and mineral focus, leading to a long, fruit-forward finish with hints of cocoa and caramel. This 100% Tempranillo has an ABV of 14.5% and was aged for 16 months in oak barrels (60% new American oak and 40% second-use French oak), followed by manual racking by candlelight to preserve its delicate fruit character.

title: Bergstrom Pinot Noir 'La Spirale' 2022
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Ribbon Ridge AVA, a highly regarded subregion within Oregon's Willamette Valley. Founded by John and Karen Bergström in 1999, Bergström Wines is a family-led estate dedicated to artisan winemaking, now directed by their son, Josh Bergström, who trained in Burgundy. The 'La Spirale' estate vineyard, acquired by the family in 2018, is a beautifully positioned 22 acre southwest facing slope featuring a complex patchwork of more than 14 distinct marine sedimentary soil types. The winery treats this land with deep respect, following a philosophy of non-certified biodynamic and regenerative-ecological farming to coax a pure, ethereal expression of the local terroir.

Wine Description

The 2022 La Spirale Vineyard Pinot Noir displays a jeweled ruby, deep garnet colour in the glass. On the nose, it unveils an alluring and highly fragrant bouquet of dark red raspberries, wild strawberries, and pomegranates, beautifully interlaced with notes of fresh roses, violet candies, Genmaicha tea, and green peppercorn spice. The palate is medium bodied, silky, and precise, delivering an elegant inner sweetness and a crunchy, succulent wave of red fruit flavours wrapped around a savory core of grape-stalk herbs, forest floor, and earthy loam. It possesses a sinewy and terroir-driven texture, balanced by a lively, mouthwatering acidity and fine, edgy tannins that build a detailed, focused structure. The finish is long and energetic, leaving a distinctive trace of sandstone and saline minerality. Crafted from 100% Pinot Noir, the grapes were fermented with indigenous yeast and 100% whole clusters before the wine was aged in 228 L French oak barrels, utilizing only 10% to 15% new oak to preserve fruit clarity. Its optimal drinking window spans from mid-2025 through 2036.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Ribbon Ridge concluded with a beautiful ripening window that granted the grapes excellent balance, structural freshness, and intense aromatic complexity. Despite early seasonal variations, the fruit achieved superb phenolic ripeness, enabling the creation of remarkably precise, lively, and focused wines with fine-grained tannins.

title: Louis Latour Batard Montrachet Grand Cru 'Clos Poirier' 2023
bodyHtml:
This prestigious white wine originates from France, within the legendary Bâtard Montrachet Grand Cru appellation situated between the picturesque villages of Puligny Montrachet and Chassagne Montrachet in the Côte de Beaune region of Burgundy. Founded in 1797, Maison Louis Latour is one of Burgundy’s most historic and revered family run houses, now managed by the eleventh generation of the family. The 'Clos Poirier' is a single, distinct parcel of 0.85 hectares positioned directly below the iconic Montrachet vineyard. It is easily recognizable as the only plot in this specific vineyard site with north-south facing vines, of which Maison Louis Latour owns and meticulously works the eastern 0.43 hectare portion to produce a white wine of maximum pedigree and terroir expression.

Wine Description

The 2023 Bâtard Montrachet Grand Cru Clos Poirier exhibits a brilliant, pale yellow golden colour in the glass. On the nose, it offers an intense and complex bouquet characterized by aromas of toasted hazelnut, vanilla, and coconut, accompanied by ripe apple, melon, and hints of sweet spice. The palate is full, opulent, and fleshy, showing a rich, creamy, and slightly fat texture balanced beautifully by a lively and vibrant acidity. Flavours of white peach, pineapple, and lemongrass unfold across the mid palate, transitioning into a long, focused, and racy finish marked by fresh almond, toasted oak, and a flinty, energized minerality. Crafted from 100% Chardonnay, the grapes were pressed slowly as whole clusters, traditional fermentation concluded in oak casks, and the wine was aged for 8 to 10 months in 100% new French oak barrels from the Louis Latour cooperage. This powerful Grand Cru is drinking beautifully now but possesses an optimal cellaring and drinking window of 10 to 15 years.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in the Côte de Beaune required careful management to navigate a warm summer and high potential yields. Ultimately, the season delivered beautifully ripe Chardonnay fruit that maintained excellent structural balance, allowing winemakers to craft white Burgundies defined by open, generous fruit profiles, underlying mineral drive, and superb aromatic clarity.

title: Louis Latour Romanee St. Vivant Grand Cru 'Les Quatre Journaux' 2023
bodyHtml:
This prestigious red wine comes from France, specifically originating from the iconic Romanée Saint Vivant Grand Cru appellation within the Vosne Romanée village of the Côte de Nuits region in Burgundy. Founded in 1797, Maison Louis Latour is one of Burgundy's most historic and revered family run négociant éleveurs, now under the stewardship of Florent Latour and the eleventh generation of the family. The 'Les Quatre Journaux' parcel is an exceptional plot located adjacent to the legendary Romanée-Conti vineyard, and its name references an old Burgundian measurement—a 'journal' representing the area of land a single winemaker could work in one day.

Wine Description

The 2023 Romanée Saint Vivant Grand Cru Les Quatre Journaux exhibits a beautiful ruby colour in the glass. The nose is spectacularly flamboyant and elegant, developing intricate aromas of blackcurrant, cherry, and raspberry, accented by delicate floral notes, vanilla, and toasty oak spice. On the palate, this full bodied Pinot Noir is luscious, harmonious, and mouth filling, revealing fresh flavours of morello cherry, blackberry, and subtle underlying hints of iron. It is built on an open frame of velvety, finely integrated tannins and a lively acidity that perfectly balances its rich fruit concentration. The wine concludes with a complex, persistent, and silky aftertaste. Crafted from 100% Pinot Noir, the wine underwent traditional vinification before being aged for 10 to 12 months in 100% new French oak barrels. While highly expressive in its youth, its exceptional structure ensures a long drinking window, optimal for enjoyment between 2028 and 2045.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in the Côte de Nuits required careful vineyard management to balance high potential yields with aromatic concentration. A warm summer helped the Pinot Noir grapes reach superb phenolic ripeness, allowing winemakers to craft wines defined by generous fruit expression, vibrant acidity, and remarkably supple tannin structures.

title: Louis Latour Montrachet Grand Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
Louis Latour Montrachet Grand Cru 2023 originates from France, within the Burgundy region and the Côte de Beaune subregion. Maison Louis Latour, independent and family owned since 1797, is famed for managing a vast portfolio of prestigious Grand Cru plots across the Côte d'Or. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes capturing the legendary identity of the bare, stony Montrachet hillside, a unique terroir whose brown soils exceptionably transform white grapes into one of the greatest wines in the world.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a brilliant pale yellow appearance and possesses a powerful, full-bodied structure. The sensory profile is exceptionally concentrated, complex, and muscular, opening with an intense nose of pineapple, brioche, fresh almond, lemon blossom, and cloves, accented by a distinct mineral edge of crushed stone, chalk, and flint. On the seductive, densely textured palate, it delivers deep flavours of peach, dried apple, ginger, and toasty oak, layered with butterscotch, macadamia nut, and sappy dry extract. The finish is youthfully austere, impressively long, and energetic, culminating in a clean, saline exit.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its poise and beautiful integration; it undergoes traditional fermentation in oak barrels with complete malolactic fermentation before aging for 10 to 12 months in 100% new, medium-toasted French oak barrels from the house's own cooperage.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 13.5% and 14% vol.

  • Organic Status: While the domain relies on meticulous viticulture and low yields to protect grape quality, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The immense richness, power, and vibrant mineral core of this Grand Cru make it a spectacular match for high-end gastronomy.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with large shellfish, including poached lobster, grilled crab, and rich preparations of white fish.

  • Savoury & Rich: Suggested pairings include pan-seared foie gras or delicate preparations of sushi and sashimi that appreciate the wine's acidity.

  • Poultry: Complements classic roasted chicken or turkey served with a rich, buttery sauce.

  • Cheese: Matches gracefully with rich, creamy cheeses such as Brie or Camembert.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 Burgundy vintage is highly regarded, with growing expectations pointing to a brilliant year characterized by remarkable fruit purity. The season started with a benign winter before a tumultuous spring that fluctuated between unseasonably warm and chilly periods, requiring careful vineyard management. The winemaker's skill in managing the estate's central parcel allowed the grapes to achieve optimal phenolic ripeness, yielding an ultra-impressive Montrachet release that earned near-perfect critical scores and possesses cellaring potential up to 2039.

title: Louis Latour Aloxe Corton 'Domaine Latour' 2023
bodyHtml:
Louis Latour Aloxe Corton 'Domaine Latour' originates from France, within the Burgundy region and the Côte de Beaune subregion. The village of Aloxe Corton has served as the historic home of the Latour family and the core of the estate for centuries. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a deep respect for individual terroirs, managing vineyards that surround the famous village to craft an authentic expression of the local stony hillsides.

Wine Description

This red wine presents an attractive deep ruby red appearance and possesses a medium body. The sensory profile is classic and terroir driven, opening with a delicate nose of fresh cherries, raspberries, and redcurrants, seamlessly interwoven with light spices and earthy forest undergrowth. On the ample palate, it delivers structured, velvety tannins and a juicy stream of red berry fruits, layered with complex hints of liquorice and cherry pit. The finish is long, elegant, and balanced, showing a slightly savoury character with lingering fruit purity and soft oak nuances.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its excellent balance and freshness; it undergoes traditional fermentation in open vats with 100% malolactic fermentation before ageing for 10 to 12 months in French oak barrels, 15% of which are new.

  • ABV: 13%.

  • Organic Status: The estate is managed under agriculture raisonnée (sustainable viticulture) principles, though this bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The savory character and structured frame of this Pinot Noir make it an exceptional match for hearty poultry and red meat preparations.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with classic coq au vin, fondue bourguignonne, flash fried steak, and roasted red meats.

  • Game: Complements game birds such as roasted duck or goose.

  • Cheese: Matches exceptionally well with a selection of mature, well affined cheeses.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 Burgundy vintage is regarded as a highly successful year that produced wines with magnificent fruit purity and structural depth. Following a relatively benign winter, the growing season encountered a tumultuous spring that fluctuated between unseasonably warm and chilly periods, which demanded careful management in the vineyards. The winemaker's skill in handling these climatic shifts allowed the 30 year old vines to achieve ideal ripening, creating an Aloxe Corton release noted for its balance between firm structure and beautiful red fruit complexity.

title: Louis Latour Echezeaux Grand Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
Louis Latour Echezeaux Grand Cru 2023 originates from France, within the Burgundy region and the Côte de Nuits subregion. Established in 1797 in Aloxe-Corton, Maison Louis Latour has remained an independent, family-owned property for eleven generations. The family manages roughly 120 hectares of vines, making them the largest owner of Grand Cru parcels in the region. Their winemaking philosophy preserves ancient traditions, sourcing this specific cuvée from an exceptional plot located above Clos de Vougeot that historically belonged to the Cîteaux Abbey.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, brilliant ruby appearance and possesses a full, concentrated body. The sensory profile is intense and exceptionally complex, opening with a bouquet of ripe strawberries, cherries, licorice, and rose stems, layered with underlying notes of undergrowth and dried flower petals. On the palate, the experience is ample and fresh, delivering compact red fruit flavours intertwined with subtle hints of nutmeg, cinnamon, mocha, and chocolate. The finish is remarkably long and persistent, characterized by a highly sophisticated texture and polished, mineral-driven tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine achieves a masterful balance between power and freshness, undergoing 100% malolactic fermentation before maturing for 10 to 12 months in 100% new French oak barrels from the house's own cooperage.

  • ABV: 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the domain is celebrated for its precise viticulture across its exceptional estates, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and elegant complexity of this Grand Cru make it an outstanding partner for rich, savory dishes.

  • Meats: Pairs perfectly with roasted lamb, grilled rib-eye steak, or prime cuts of beef.

  • Game: Complements classic game bird dishes such as roasted duck with cherries, goose, or Anjou pigeon.

  • Savoury: Suggested pairings include chicken poached with wild mushrooms, or rustic pasta dishes featuring earthy truffles.

  • Cheese: Matches beautifully with platters of mature, well-affined cheeses like French Comté.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 Burgundy vintage is highly regarded, with growing conditions yielding grapes of exceptional fruit purity and structural harmony. A relatively benign winter led into a tumultuous spring that fluctuated between unseasonably warm and chilly periods, which required careful vineyard management. The winemaker's skill in managing these shifts allowed the fruit to ripen slowly and achieve perfect phenolic maturity, resulting in an Echezeaux release that earned a perfect 100-point score from top critics and displays magnificent aging potential up to 2038.

title: La Grande Bleue Mediterranee Organic White 2025
bodyHtml:
This expressive organic white wine originates from France, classified under the IGP Méditerranée designation. It is produced by Gérard Bertrand, a visionary vintner renowned for his deep commitment to environmental stewardship and sustainable viticulture across the South of France. The 'La Grande Bleue' cuvée is crafted to embody the spirit and natural beauty of the Mediterranean Sea, highlighting a winemaking philosophy that captures the unique synergy between generous regional sunshine and the refreshing, mineral-rich influence of the marine coast.

Wine Description

In the glass, La Grande Bleue displays a luminous, pale yellow colour enhanced by light green reflections. The nose is highly expressive, opening with bright aromas of white-fleshed fruits like pear and peach, mingled with zesty citrus notes of lemon and grapefruit and delicate white floral touches of hawthorn. On the palate, the wine is lively, airy, and remarkably refreshing, driven by a beautiful minerality that mirrors its coastal origins. The initial taste is round and fruit-forward, while the finish is long, elegant, and distinctly saline, evoking a subtle hint of sea spray. This organic blend is artfully composed of Rolle, Grenache Blanc, Viognier, Chardonnay, and Sauvignon Blanc. To preserve its vibrant fruit purity and aromatic intensity, the grapes are harvested during the coolest hours of the day, vinified separately at low temperatures in stainless steel vats, and completely spared from oak ageing. It is best enjoyed fresh within one to three years of release.

title: Gerard Bertrand Esprit De Cote Des Roses Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
This sophisticated sparkling wine comes from France, carrying the Vin de France designation. Crafted by acclaimed winegrower Gérard Bertrand, the cuvée represents an extension of the well known Cote des Roses series, which celebrates the Mediterranean 'art de vivre'. Rooted in the South of France, the brand emphasizes a winemaking philosophy that captures a sense of celebration and conviviality, with fruit sourced from premium vineyards influenced by warm southern sunshine and cooling sea breezes.

Wine Description

The Esprit de Cote des Roses Brut Rosé features a crystal clear, pale pink colour in the glass. On the nose, it is highly elegant, revealing subtle aromas of fresh red berries, small red fruits, and delicate white flowers. The palate is lively and rich, driven by fine bubbles that carry a soft, creamy mousse. It strikes an ideal balance between vibrant freshness and roundness, finishing with a silky, slightly toasted texture. This non-vintage sparkling wine is crafted from a precise blend of Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, and Grenache Noir. To achieve its signature depth and complexity, the still base wines are blended with reserve rosé wines aged in barrels before undergoing secondary fermentation and ageing on the lees.

title: Casanova Di Neri Brunello Di Montalcino 2021
bodyHtml:
This prestigious red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation in Tuscany. Founded in 1971 by Giovanni Neri, the estate is now managed by Giacomo Neri and his sons, Giovanni and Gianlorenzo. Casanova di Neri has produced its 'White Label' Brunello since 1978, a classic expression designed to balance regional typicity with finesse and high aging potential. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a natural approach with a gravity-fed cellar built into the hillside to maintain constant, naturally regulated temperature and humidity.

Wine Description

The 2021 Casanova di Neri Brunello di Montalcino presents a deep ruby red hue with a brilliant sensory profile. Its sensory profile is multi-layered, featuring a complex nose of black raspberries, cherries, and blood orange shavings, layered with floral notes of lavender, dusty rose, and rosemary. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and 'energetic', showcasing flavors of dark plum, soft berry fruit, and light chocolate underpinned by a bright spine of acidity. It is characterized by a glossy texture and fine, open-grained tannins that provide a long, focused finish with hints of licorice and clove. This 100% Sangiovese reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and was aged for approximately 42 months in large oak casks before resting in the bottle. While the estate follows meticulous, low-impact viticulture, this bottling is not officially certified organic.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Montalcino is regarded as 'memorable' and potentially legendary, receiving a five-star rating for its precision and aging potential. A mild, wet winter trundled into an icy spring, but a subsequent warm growing season with timely rains allowed for a normal harvest window. Winemakers successfully captured a 'nervy energy' and ripe, enveloping tannins that differentiate this vintage from the more immediate 2020 releases.

title: Casanova Di Neri Cabernet Sauvignon 'Pietradonice' 2022
bodyHtml:
This rare and 'extraordinary' red wine originates from Italy, within the Toscana I.G.P. designation. Produced by the legendary Casanova di Neri estate in Montalcino, Pietradonice is the result of Giacomo Neri’s vision to plant Cabernet Sauvignon in a unique vineyard site characterized by soil rich in 'onyx stones'. The winery's philosophy centres on the belief that this specific terroir in the southeastern part of Montalcino is as perfectly suited for Cabernet Sauvignon as other areas are for Sangiovese, creating a wine that balances international varietal character with a distinct Tuscan soul.

Wine Description

The 2022 Casanova di Neri Pietradonice presents an intense, deep, and brilliant red colour. The sensory profile is exceptionally complex, featuring a nose of blackcurrant, blackberry, and dark plum layered with spicy notes of tobacco, cedar, and a hint of balsamic. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and 'powerful', showcasing a massive concentration of dark fruit underpinned by a distinct mineral edge derived from its stony soils. It is characterized by its broad, velvety tannins and a dense texture that leads to a persistent and deeply elegant finish. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and was matured for approximately 18 months in French oak barrels before a further period of refinement in the bottle. While the estate manages its land with a deep respect for natural balance, this bottling is not officially certified organic.

title: Chateau Le Bernet 2015
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'savoury' red wine originates from France, within the Graves appellation of the Bordeaux region. Château Roquetaillade Le Bernet is part of the Vignobles Guignard portfolio, a family-run estate that has been cultivating vines in the South of Bordeaux for generations. The winery's philosophy focuses on traditional Bordeaux craftsmanship, utilizing the region's characteristic gravelly soils to produce 'classic' expressions that highlight the natural elegance of the terroir.

Wine Description

The 2015 Château Le Bernet presents a deep purple colour and a medium-to-full-bodied sensory profile. The nose is complex and intriguing, featuring aromas of black fruits, plums, and bilberries, layered with distinct notes of tobacco, cedar, and pencil shavings. On the palate, the wine is 'very smooth' and balanced, showcasing flavours of ripe black cherry and blueberry jam underpinned by silky tannins. It is characterized by its vibrancy and 'energy', often described as having a savory character with hints of chocolate and vanilla from its maturation. This Red Bordeaux Blend typically consists of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, reaching an alcohol content of approximately 13%. While the Guignard family emphasizes environmental respect in their vineyards, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Chateau Petrus 2000 - 3 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Château Petrus 2000 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the prestigious Pomerol appellation. Situated on the famed clay plateau of eastern Pomerol, the historic estate has long been managed by the Moueix family, who established it as an undisputed icon of the global wine world. The winery's philosophy emphasizes small scale, uncompromising craftsmanship, utilizing low yields and meticulous block management to achieve an incomparable expression of its unique terroir.

Wine Description

This red wine displays an intense, inky plum and deep ruby colour and possesses an exceptionally full, muscular body. The sensory profile is monumental and slow to reveal itself, opening with a powerful, roaring nose of ripe black cherries, mulberries, and wild strawberries, layered with waves of rose petals, violets, smoke, and an unmistakable black truffle underbrush element. On the unctuous, velvet textured palate, it delivers a dense core of blackberry, plum, and boysenberry confiture seamlessly integrated with hints of spiced chocolate shavings, black pepper, and licorice. The finish is colossal and incredibly persistent, lasting over a minute with a robust tobacco and charcoal edge pinned in by welcoming, fine grained tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Merlot.

  • Stylistic Notes: The 2000 vintage represents a structured, masculine masterpiece, showing a dramatic combination of immense power, fruit purity, and a weightless sense of poise achieved through a 21 month maturation using 50% new French oak.

  • ABV: 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: The estate follows precision, low intervention viticulture to safeguard the health of its ancient soils, though this millenary release is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The enormous concentration, broad structural frame, and evolving tertiary complexity of this mature Pomerol make it a magnificent match for rich, protein driven gastronomy.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with a premium slow roasted leg of lamb, a thick grilled chateaubriand steak with marrow sauce, or roasted venison loin.

  • Savoury and Rich: Suggested pairings include dishes featuring fresh black truffles, chanterelle mushrooms, or a rich wild boar ragù, which mirror the wine's earthy complexity.

  • Cheese: Complements a fine selection of mature, hard cow's milk cheeses that match the depth of the wine's cocoa and spice nuances.

Vintage Quality

The turn of the millennium brought an legendary growing season to Bordeaux, characterized by an even keeled summer and a warm, dry September that provided optimal conditions for the early ripening Merlot grape. These beautiful weather patterns yielded berries with fantastic phenolic ripeness and dense, dark skins. The resulting wine is a structured classic with an extraordinary cellaring trajectory, with experts predicting this monumental vintage will continue to evolve gracefully well past the 2050s.

title: Chateau Petrus 1998 - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Château Pétrus 1998 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the prestigious Pomerol appellation. Located on the highest point of the Pomerol plateau, the estate is managed by the Moueix family, who helped elevate the property to global icon status during the 20th century. The winemaking philosophy centers on allowing the unique terroir to speak for itself, relying on meticulous vineyard monitoring and gentle handling to produce a wine that defines the pinnacle of Right Bank elegance.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a dense, dark plum and purple colour with a light brick-red evolution on the rim, possessing an immensely full and seamless body. The sensory profile is incredibly complex and deeply resonant, offering a broad, aromatic nose of black cherry, plum, and dark berries interwoven with notes of black truffle, licorice, caramel, and espresso. On the opulent and velvet-drenched palate, it delivers a super-concentrated stream of sweet black fruits, cocoa, and dried cherries, balanced perfectly by a silver bead of bright acidity. The finish is breathtaking and exceptionally persistent, lasting nearly a minute with a pulsating energy and a structural frame of filigree tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Merlot.

  • Stylistic Notes: The 1998 vintage is celebrated for its masterful control and breathtaking purity, striking an ideal balance between decadent opulence and precision. It was matured for 18 to 20 months in 100% new French oak barrels to achieve its legendary structure.

  • ABV: 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate avoids synthetic interventions wherever possible and relies on precision viticulture, this bottle is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The immense concentration, velvety depth, and mature tertiary elements of this Pomerol make it a perfect companion for grand, protein-rich culinary creations.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with a premium cut of beef fillet with a rich red wine reduction, a grilled rack of lamb, or roasted venison.

  • Savoury & Rich: Suggested pairings include dishes highlighted by wild mushrooms, black truffles, or dry black olives, which perfectly echo the wine's natural earthy development.

  • Cheese: Complements mature, hard cow's milk cheeses that bridge the wine's rich walnut and chocolate undertones.

Vintage Quality

The 1998 vintage on the Right Bank of Bordeaux is widely recognized as a legendary, near-perfect year, uniquely favoring the early-ripening Merlot grape. A damp spring was rescued by a radiant, dry, and exceptionally sunny September, allowing the grapes to reach flawless polyphenolic maturity before late autumn rains impacted other parts of the region. Due to meticulous green harvesting, the yields were low, leading to an extremely concentrated and muscular harvest. The winemaker's precision in managing this harvest resulted in what critics regard as the definitive pinnacle of the decade for the estate, showing a spectacular lifespan that is projected to age gracefully into the 2050s.

title: Cascahuin Special Edition 55-25 Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Cascahuín Special Edition 55-25 is a rare, limited-edition commemorative tequila released by the Cascahuín Distillery (NOM 1123) to celebrate its 70th anniversary. Located in El Arenal, Jalisco—known as the 'Gateway to Tequila Country'—this family-owned distillery is currently managed by the fourth generation of the Rosales family. The distillery's name, meaning 'mountain of light', reflects its deep connection to the local geography and its commitment to traditional, artisanal winemaking philosophies.

Tequila Description

This añejo tequila presents a deep amber colour with bright mahogany hues. The aromatic profile is elegant and complex, featuring cooked agave layered with dried fruits, raisins, and almonds, alongside delicate sherry sweetness and stone fruit. On the palate, it is silky and structured, offering rich flavours of caramel, toasted nuts, dark chocolate, and soft oak, balanced by a hint of black pepper and the distillery's signature earthy minerality. The finish is long and elegant, leaving lingering notes of sweet agave and warm wood. Aged for approximately 12 months, this 44% ABV expression is a unique blend of 90% tequila matured in ex-sherry casks and 10% Cascahuín 48 Añejo.

title: Mezzacorona Castel Firmian Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from Italy, within the Trentino D.O.C. appellation of the Trentino Alto Adige region. Founded in 1904, Mezzacorona is one of Italy's oldest growers' associations and operates as a highly respected cooperative. The winery's philosophy centres on meticulous viticulture and utilizing a spectrum of Alpine microclimates to produce wines that are true expressions of Trentino's history and winemaking tradition.

Wine Description

Castel Firmian Pinot Grigio presents a straw yellow colour, occasionally described as deep straw. Its sensory profile features an aromatic nose of pears, crisp apples, and chamomile, layered with notes of herbs, florals, and stone fruits such as apricots and yellow plums. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied and 'refreshing', showcasing juicy flavours of lemon, honeysuckle, and nectarine underpinned by a delicate acidity. It is characterized by its clean, dry, and subtly mineral texture, leading to an elegant finish that is soft yet vibrant. This 100% Pinot Grigio reached an alcohol content of 12.5%. While the cooperative emphasizes sustainable viticulture across its 2,400 hectares of vineyards, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Penner Ash Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
Penner Ash Pinot Noir originates from the United States, within the Oregon region and the renowned Willamette Valley subregion. The winery was established in 1998 by founding winemaker Lynn Penner Ash, who built the estate's reputation by developing long standing relationships with local grower neighbours and friends. Under the current direction of winemaker Kate Ayres, the estate continues its philosophy of crafting deeply textured, vineyard driven wines that explore multiple distinct sub-AVAs to capture the true essence of the valley.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a bright ruby appearance and possesses a medium body with a beautifully plush, round, and polished texture. The sensory profile is highly expressive, opening with an aromatic nose of blackberries, fresh plums, and sweet red berries, gracefully accented by undertones of orange peel, floral tea, and warm vanilla oak. On the palate, it delivers a juicy wave of crushed raspberries, cherries, and wild blueberries, layered with complex notes of sarsaparilla, clove, and a subtle cocoa sweetness. The finish is long, fresh, and elegant, driven by balanced acidity and firmly framed, finely tuned tannins.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, smooth body, and nuanced fruit and spice profile of this Pinot Noir make it an incredibly food friendly and versatile selection.

  • Meats and Poultry: Pairs beautifully with classic roasted chicken with herbs, duck breast served with a cherry reduction, or lean cuts like filet mignon and herb crusted lamb chops.

  • Seafood: Suggested pairings include meaty fish options that complement the wine's acidity without being overpowered, such as grilled or pan seared salmon and seared rare tuna steak.

  • Savoury and Earthy: Complements wild mushroom risotto, caramelized onion and thyme tartlets, or a roasted beet salad with goat cheese.

title: Corte Pavone Brunello Di Montalcino 2019
bodyHtml:
This distinguished red wine hails from the Montalcino region of Tuscany, Italy. Owned by the Loacker family since 1979, Tenuta Corte Pavone is a pioneer in organic and biodynamic viticulture. The winery is celebrated for its '7 Dynamic Brunello Crus' system, which utilizes infrared sensors to monitor vine growth and adapt winemaking to the unique heartbeat of each vineyard parcel every year.

Wine Description

The Corte Pavone Brunello di Montalcino presents a deep red hue, often showing a brownish or garnet tint with age. The aromatic profile is complex and vivid, featuring layered notes of black cherry, raspberry, and plum, accented by earthy undertones of pine cone, lavender, and fine leather. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and structured, characterized by ultra-fine, muscular tannins and a polished texture. Flavours of dark berries, liquorice, and savoury herbs lead into a long, mineral-inflected finish.

title: La Chablisienne La Pierrelee Chablis 2022
bodyHtml:
La Chablisienne Chablis La Pierrelee originates from the Chablis region in Burgundy, France. Established in 1923, La Chablisienne began when a group of visionary winegrowers joined forces under the leadership of Abbé Balitrand to navigate economic challenges. The cooperative is renowned for its unique philosophy of receiving harvests as musts rather than grapes, a trademark approach that allows the house total control over the winemaking process and ensures a consistent style of precision and purity.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a brilliant golden colour accented by silver highlights. The expressive nose opens with characteristic mineral and gunflint aromas, which evolve into notes of lemon, white peach, and delicate jasmine. On the palate, the wine is well balanced and fresh, displaying a slick texture and a slight sweetness that provides a pleasing roundness. It is a medium bodied white with a firm saline edge and a persistent, zesty finish that highlights its classic Kimmeridgian limestone origins.

title: Mauro Vannucci Piaggia Riserva 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'classic' red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the heart of the Carmignano DOCG appellation in Tuscany. Piaggia was founded in the 1970s by Mauro Vannucci, whose daughter, Silvia Vannucci, now manages the estate with a philosophy focused on authenticity and minimal technological intervention. The vineyard, situated halfway between Florence and Pisa at an altitude of 250 metres, is planted on medium-textured clay and galestro soils that are steeped in history.

Wine Description

The 2021 Piaggia Riserva presents a deep, almost impenetrable ruby red colour. The sensory profile is highly aromatic, featuring a nose of dried violets, ripe cassis, and raspberries, embellished with elegant hints of tobacco, chocolate, and autumnal spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and 'velvety', showcasing a powerful structure where ripe red and black fruits are balanced by a core of mineral-inflected acidity. It is characterized by its dramatic depth and high-quality, 'edgy' tannins that suggest a long aging potential. The finish is long and concentrated, leaving a bitter blackberry resonance and a refreshing hint of blood orange. This blend typically consists of 70% Sangiovese, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc, and 10% Merlot. The wine reached an ABV of approximately 14.5% and was matured in French oak barriques for 18 months. Piaggia is a practicing organic winery that avoids herbicides and insecticides.

title: Henri & Gilles Buisson Bourgogne Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in the heart of France, specifically within the Burgundy region, this Chardonnay represents a blend of high-quality fruit from Saint-Romain and Pouilly-Fuissé. The Buisson family has been cultivating vines in Saint-Romain since 1758, with Henri Buisson establishing the modern vineyard in 1947. Today, brothers Franck and Frédérick Buisson continue this legacy, managing nearly 20 hectares with a steadfast commitment to organic and biodynamic viticulture.

Wine Description

This Bourgogne Blanc presents a brilliant, intense straw yellow colour in the glass. The aromatics are expressive, opening with floral notes and white-fleshed fruits, particularly white peach and pear, which evolve toward almond and subtle toasted notes with age. On the palate, the wine is well-rounded and medium-bodied, offering a fresh, juicy structure defined by vivid acidity and lemon citrus. It maintains a beautiful balance between a light creaminess and a saline, mineral finish.

title: Mazzolino Pinot Nero 'Terrazze' 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Lombardy region of Italy, specifically within the Provincia di Pavia IGT in the Oltrepò Pavese subregion, this wine is a vibrant example of the area's dedication to the Pinot Nero variety. Tenuta Mazzolino, established in the early 1980s by Enrico Braggiotti and currently managed by his granddaughter Francesca Seralvo, operates as a 'small Burgundy' in Italy. The estate's philosophy emphasizes organic practices, low yields, and a meticulous plot-by-plot management of its 20 hectares of vineyards to highlight the region's clay and limestone soils.

Wine Description

The Terrazze Pinot Nero presents a bright and luminous ruby red colour. The nose is fragrant and perfumed, leading with aromas of redcurrant, pomegranate, and wild strawberry, accompanied by delicate notes of violet and a hint of white pepper. On the palate, the wine is fresh and 'crunchy' with a silky texture and well-matured acidity that invites a second glass. Flavours of black cherry and raspberry dominate a medium-bodied profile, supported by refined tannins and a persistent, slightly spicy finish.

title: Chateau d'Yquem 2001 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Château d'Yquem, established in 1593, stands as the sole estate in Sauternes to hold the esteemed Premier Cru Supérieur classification. Renowned for its meticulous production methods, the winery employs selective harvesting of botrytized grapes to craft wines of unparalleled depth and longevity.

Wine Description:

The 2001 vintage of Château d'Yquem is celebrated for its exceptional balance and complexity. Displaying a radiant golden hue, the wine exudes aromas of honey, apricot, pineapple, and exotic spices. On the palate, it offers a rich tapestry of flavours, including crème brûlée, mandarin, and dried fruits, all harmonized by vibrant acidity. Comprising primarily Sémillon with a portion of Sauvignon Blanc, this full-bodied wine boasts a finish that lingers gracefully.

Accolades:

  • Wine Advocate – 100 points

  • James Suckling – 100 points

  • Vinous – 100 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck – 100 points

Food Pairing:

This exquisite Sauternes pairs beautifully with foie gras, enhancing its richness. It also complements blue cheeses like Roquefort, fruit-based desserts such as tarte tatin, and savoury dishes like lobster or roast chicken. These pairings accentuate the wine's depth and character.

title: Livia Fontana Barolo "Fontanin" 2020
bodyHtml:
Livia Fontana Barolo "Fontanin" 2020 is an elegant and expressive red wine from the heart of the Langhe in Piedmont, Italy.

The Fontana family has deep roots in the region, having lived and worked in Castiglione Falletto for over 200 years. Managed today by Livia Fontana and her sons, Michele and Lorenzo, the winery follows a philosophy of "integrated pest management" and manual processing to ensure the wines are in harmony with the earth. The "Fontanin" bottling is a tribute to the family name and is crafted using grapes from two high-quality vineyard sites: Villero and Mariondino.

Wine Description

The 2020 vintage displays a deep red color with shades ranging from intense ruby to garnet. The nose is remarkably complex and seductive, featuring floral notes of macerated violet alongside balsamic nuances and spices such as licorice root and nutmeg. On the palate, the wine is clean and well-structured, showcasing the "decisive" backbone typical of Barolo. It is characterized by its fine, "dusty yet velvety" tannins and a refreshing liveliness contributed by the marbled sandstone and sandy soils of the vineyards.

The wine is 100% Nebbiolo, hand-harvested in mid-October. Following a gentle fermentation and long maceration in stainless steel, it is aged for approximately 32 to 40 months in traditional large oak barrels to refine its structure and "soul". This 2020 release has an ABV of 14% to 14.5% and is produced in limited quantities of fewer than 7,000 bottles per year.

title: Tequila Chisme Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tequila Chisme Blanco originates from the Highland region of Jalisco, Mexico. It is produced at the 'La Arandina' distillery (NOM 1610), which is overseen by the Camarena family, a name synonymous with high quality tequila production for generations. The brand is known for its commitment to traditional, artisanal methods and its focus on the natural expression of the agave plant.

Spirit Description

This premium blanco tequila is clear and bright with a medium body and a smooth, silky mouthfeel. The aroma is highly expressive, featuring prominent notes of cooked agave, citrus zest, and floral undertones, complemented by a hint of fresh herbs and earthiness. On the palate, it delivers a balanced profile of sweet agave, lime, and tropical fruits, followed by a characteristic spark of white pepper and minerals. The finish is long and refreshing, marked by a persistent agave sweetness and a clean, crisp exit. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

title: KinGlassie Raw Single Malt Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
KinGlassie Raw originates from the Kingdom of Fife in the Lowland region of Scotland. It is produced by the InchDairnie Distillery, an innovative facility founded in 2012 by Ian Palmer under John Fergus & Co., which recently merged into InchDairnie Whisky Ltd. The distillery is known for its 'flavour-forward' engineering, utilizing a hammer mill and mash filter to extract specific profiles, and it distils this heavily peated spirit for only one week each year during the winter.

Spirit Description

This heavily peated single malt is produced from 100% Fife-grown barley peated to 50 ppm and is matured for eight years exclusively in first-fill ex-bourbon American oak casks. It presents a golden straw appearance with a medium, creamy body. The aroma is a bold combination of bonfire smoke and campfire embers, layered with sweet malt and faint vanilla. On the palate, it delivers punchy peat and pepper alongside roasted marshmallows, salted caramel, and honey. The finish is long and dry, characterized by lingering smoke, lime zest, ash, and roasted nuts. It is bottled at 46.3% ABV.

Accolades

KinGlassie Raw has been highly recognized for its quality, earning a 'Master' award at The Spirits Business Global Scotch Whisky Masters 2025. Additionally, the InchDairnie Distillery has been honoured for its sustainable practices, receiving the 'Renewable Energy Implementation Award' from the Drinks Business Green Awards in 2025.

Food Pairing

The intense peat smoke and creamy vanilla notes of this spirit make it an ideal companion for bold, savoury dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with smoked seafood, such as oily mackerel or charred octopus, which complements its ashy profile. For a meat pairing, consider grilled lamb chops with a rosemary crust or barbecued pork ribs. It also serves as a sophisticated match for desserts like salted caramel tart or roasted peaches with vanilla cream, which echo the sweet and smoky elements of the whisky.

title: Peter Zemmer Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml:
Peter Zemmer Chardonnay is a crisp and elegant white wine from the Alto Adige region in Northern Italy, a territory famous for producing some of the country's most refined and mineral-driven white wines.

The Zemmer family has been producing wine in the village of Cortina (Kurtinig an der Weinstraße) since 1928. Their winemaking philosophy for this bottling emphasizes the unique alpine terroir, sourcing grapes from vineyards planted in calcareous clay and gravel soils located between 240 and 500 metres in altitude. This Chardonnay is crafted to be a "purist" expression, focusing on fresh fruit and mountain mineral tension rather than heavy oak influence.

Wine Description

The wine presents a pale straw yellow color with brilliant greenish reflections. The nose is clear and inviting, featuring a broad palette of fruit aromas including pineapple, banana, and melon, accented by delicate hints of dandelion flowers and a touch of white pepper. On the palate, the wine is dry and medium-bodied, offering a "pleasing fullness" balanced by an animating acidity. It is characterized by its fresh, lively mouthfeel and a medium-long finish that maintains a spicy, mineral edge.

title: Solaia 2017 (by Tenuta Tignanello)
bodyHtml:
The Antinori family, one of the most historic names in Italian wine with a lineage tracing back to 1385, owns Tenuta Tignanello in the heart of Chianti Classico. Within this estate lies the celebrated Solaia vineyard, a southwest-facing slope known for producing powerful, elegant wines. First released in 1978, 'Solaia' is crafted only in exceptional vintages and reflects the family's commitment to innovation and excellence.

Solaia 2017 is composed of 72% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Sangiovese, and 8% Cabernet Franc. Deep ruby in colour, it opens with rich aromas of blackberries, currants, and dark cherries, layered with balsamic hints of mint and myrtle. Subtle notes of white pepper, cocoa, and toasted spice enhance its aromatic complexity. The palate is full-bodied and refined, with velvety tannins and great depth. The long finish echoes with dark fruit and savoury spice, showcasing the wine’s balance and elegance.

Accolades
James Suckling – 97 points
Wine Enthusiast – 96 points
Decanter – 97 points

Food Pairing
An ideal match for grilled ribeye steak, wild boar ragu with pappardelle, or aged pecorino cheese. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

Vintage Quality
The 2017 growing season in Tuscany was marked by warmth and low yields. Despite the challenges, expert vineyard management and precise winemaking produced a wine of remarkable intensity, structure, and finesse.

title: Attems Cicinis Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This refined and 'intense' white wine originates from Italy, within the Collio D.O.C. appellation of the Friuli-Venezia Giulia region. Cicinis is considered the flagship of the Attems estate, sourced from a single five-acre vineyard parcel on a terraced hillside at the foot of Monte Calvario. The estate has a long-standing history in the region, with the Attems family having been involved in viticulture since the end of the 19th century; the property is currently owned and managed by the Frescobaldi family. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a deep respect for biodiversity and the unique 'Ponca' soil, a mix of marl and sandstone, which contributes significant structure and minerality to their wines.

Wine Description

Presents an intense and vibrant shade of straw yellow. The sensory profile is highly elegant and refined, featuring a broad bouquet that opens with lively hints of boxwood, bergamot, grapefruit, and sage, intermingled with complex notes of toasted almond and flint. On the palate, the wine makes a 'decisive' entrance, showcasing a vertical and enveloping structure supported by fresh acidity and integrated sapidity. It is characterized by its layering and persistent finish, with aromatics of citrus, papaya, and jasmine. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc typically reaches an ABV of 13% to 13.5% and undergoes a unique maturation process: 40% in egg-shaped cement tanks and 50% in second and third passage oak barrels for seven to nine months to enrich its aromatic bouquet without malolactic fermentation. While the estate operates in an 'unspoiled' natural environment rich in biodiversity, this bottling is not officially certified organic.

title: Greenwing Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and 'approachable' white wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Willamette Valley in Oregon. Greenwing began its journey with Cabernet Sauvignon in Washington's Columbia Valley before expanding into the premier cool-climate vineyards of Oregon. The winery's philosophy focuses on capturing the 'untamed beauty' and natural elegance of the Pacific Northwest through craftsmanship and expressive character. Notably, the label features an original illustration of a green-winged teal duck feather by New York artist Nicolas V. Sanchez.

Wine Description

Greenwing Pinot Grigio presents a vivid and bright appearance, characteristic of cool-climate Oregon fruit. The sensory profile features a refreshing nose with 'layered notes of citrus' and bright fruit aromas. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, showcasing a harmonious balance of fresh citrus and a clean, 'mineral finish'. It is defined by its crisp acidity and a texture that is both substantial and invigorating, reflecting the volcanic soils and marine winds of its origin. This 100% Pinot Grigio reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5%. While the winery emphasizes sustainable viticulture and site-specific expression, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Bodegas El Nido 'Clio' 2023
bodyHtml:
This powerful and structured red wine originates from Spain, specifically from the Jumilla D.O. appellation in the Levante region. Bodegas El Nido is a joint project between the Gil family, famed importer Jorge Ordóñez, and renowned Australian winemaker Chris Ringland. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a vision established over a century ago: to showcase the exceptional quality of Jumilla by balancing the bold, sweet fruit of old-vine Monastrell with the structure of Cabernet Sauvignon. Sourced from the Valle de la Aragona, the vineyard's high altitude and long growing season contribute significant freshness and bright fruit energy to their flagship labels.

Wine Description

The Bodegas El Nido Clio presents a beautiful cherry red colour with elegant garnet edges. The sensory profile is intense and complex, featuring a nose of plum, blackberry, and blueberries, complemented by savory notes of thyme, black pepper, and mint. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and creamy, showcasing rich fruit complexity, licorice, and cocoa underpinned by delicate tannins. It is characterized by an 'impetuous' yet elegant style, with a finish currently dominated by spicy oak flavours that will continue to integrate with time. This blend is composed of 70% Monastrell from very old vines and 30% Cabernet Sauvignon planted in 1986. Matured for 23 months in new French and American oak barrels, the wine reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 15%. This vintage is certified organic, made with grapes certified by the Consejo de Agricultura Ecológica de la Región de Murcia.

title: Livia Fontana Langhe Nebbiolo 2023
bodyHtml:
Livia Fontana Langhe Nebbiolo hails from Italy, specifically the Langhe region within Piedmont. The winery is a historic family estate that has maintained nearly 200 years of winemaking tradition over eight generations. Currently managed by Livia Fontana and her sons, Michele and Lorenzo, the winery focuses on an indissoluble synergy between traditional methods and modern quality standards. Their philosophy emphasizes the natural balance of the land and a completely manual process from pruning to harvest.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo displays an intense, luminous ruby red colour that can shift toward garnet with age. The aromatic profile is fine and elegant, featuring fresh notes of red cherries, raspberries, and strawberries, intertwined with floral scents of violet and hints of balsamic spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and well structured, offering silky, velvety tannins and a crisp acidity that provides savory depth. The finish is elegant and persistent, leaving traces of sweet spices and a slight mineral aftertaste.

title: Vecchio Amaro Del Capo Peperocino – 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Vecchio Amaro del Capo Peperoncino (often referred to as the 'Red Hot Edition') is a premium spicy liqueur produced in the Calabria region of Italy. It is crafted by Distilleria F.lli Caffo, a family business with roots dating back to the end of the 19th century when Master Distiller Giuseppe Caffo began distilling on the slopes of Mt. Etna. Formally founded in 1915, the distillery is currently part of the Gruppo Caffo 1915, led by President Pippo Caffo and CEO Nuccio Caffo. This expression is a vibrant variation of the classic Del Capo, specifically formulated to highlight the heat of Calabrian chilli peppers.

Spirit Description

This liqueur is created using a secret recipe that includes 29 different local herbs, flowers, fruits, and roots, with the addition of a 'perfectly calibrated' level of spicy chilli.

  • Colour: The spirit presents a medium orange to amber appearance.

  • Aroma: The nose is intense and aromatic, featuring notes of orange peel, anise, and cinnamon, alongside gingerbread and eucalyptus.

  • Palate: It offers a silky texture with a complex flavour profile. Initial notes of candied ginger, gentian, and citrus transition into a dominating core of spicy cinnamon, floral bergamot, and cacao, all underscored by a persistent chilli heat.

  • Body: Medium-bodied and well-balanced, the amaro melds sweetness and bitterness into a 'downright moreish' experience.

  • Finish: The finish is long and lingering, leaving a warm memory of baking spices and spicy pepper.

  • ABV: This spirit is bottled at 35%.

title: Annex Lorem Ipsum Amber Ale - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml: Lorem Ipsum was made using light and dark malts as well as roasted barley to give it depth of colour. Despite its darker character, it surprises with its light and refreshing qualities, thanks to the Citra hops. These American-variety hops infuse the amber ale with captivating notes of citrus, fruit, and pine, balancing the sweetness of the malt.

title: Chateau Leoville Barton 2006
bodyHtml:
This wine is the flagship red of the historic Château Léoville Barton. Classified as a Second Growth in the 1855 Classification, the estate boasts the longest continuous family legacy in Bordeaux, having been in the Barton family since Thomas Barton arrived from Ireland in 1725. Today, the property is run by the eighth generation of the family, maintaining a philosophy of traditional, quality-driven winemaking that prioritizes elegance and distinction.

Wine Description

The 2006 vintage presents a deep, dense ruby-purple hue with a dark crimson core that lightens toward the rim. The sensory profile is rich and complex, opening with opulent aromas of blackcurrant and black cherry, followed by secondary notes of tobacco leaf, cedar, and spice box. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and structured, characterized by its "masculine" and "beefy" style with powerful, firm tannins and a core of ripe dark fruits like cassis and elderberry. Stylistically, it is known for its purity and poise, leading to a long, mouthwatering finish with mineral and graphite nuances. Composed of 74% Cabernet Sauvignon, 23% Merlot, and 3% Cabernet Franc, this wine has entered its plateau of maturity and is expected to evolve favourably until 2040.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 94 points

  • Wine Spectator - 94 points

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 92 points

title: Chateau Mouton Rothschild 1995
bodyHtml:
Château Mouton Rothschild, located in the Pauillac appellation of Bordeaux, France, is renowned for its exceptional wines and rich history. Elevated to Premier Cru Classé status in 1973, the estate has been under the stewardship of the Rothschild family since 1853. Their dedication to quality and innovation has cemented Mouton Rothschild’s place among the world’s most esteemed wineries.

Wine Description
The 1995 vintage presents a deep, dark ruby-red color, bordering on opaque. The nose is intense, offering aromas of ripe black fruits reminiscent of a Napa Cabernet, complemented by fresh cassis notes. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied with a vibrant core of concentrated fruit, powdery tannins, and a long, resonant finish. This vintage is a blend of 72% Cabernet Sauvignon, 19% Merlot, and 9% Cabernet Franc. While it has begun to soften, it remains remarkably youthful and is expected to evolve gracefully over the next decade.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker’s Wine Advocate: 94 points
  • Wine Spectator: 94 points
  • James Suckling: 95 points

Food Pairing
This wine pairs exquisitely with:

  • Roasted lamb with herbs
  • Grilled ribeye steak
  • Wild game dishes
  • Aged hard cheeses

These pairings enhance the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

Vintage Quality
The 1995 vintage in Bordeaux experienced favorable weather conditions, leading to wines of excellent structure and aging potential. Château Mouton Rothschild’s meticulous vineyard management and winemaking expertise are evident in this remarkable wine.

title: Chateau Lafite Rothschild 2005
bodyHtml:
Situated in the Pauillac appellation of the Medoc, France, Chateau Lafite Rothschild is a globally iconic First Growth estate. The property has been under the stewardship of the Rothschild family since 1868, maintaining a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes elegance and finesse over raw power. The vineyard’s unique terroir, characterized by deep gravel and aeolian sands on a limestone subsoil, provides the ideal foundation for creating some of the most sought after wines in the world.

Wine Description

The 2005 vintage displays an opaque ruby and purple colour of immense depth. On the nose, it offers an incredibly complex and refined bouquet of graphite, blackcurrant, and lead pencil shavings, layered with subtle notes of cedar, violets, and earth. The palate is medium to full bodied, delivering an extraordinary balance of concentrated fruit and high-quality, velvety tannins that lead to a finish lasting nearly a minute. This wine is a blend of 89% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Merlot, and 1% Cabernet Franc. While it is beginning to enter its prime drinking window, its structural integrity ensures it will continue to evolve through 2050 or beyond.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker - 96+ points

  • James Suckling - 98 points

  • Wine Spectator - 98 points

  • Decanter - 98 points

  • Vinous - 97 points

title: Chateau Leoville Las Cases 2004
bodyHtml:
Produced in France, specifically within the Saint Julien appellation of the Médoc region in Bordeaux, this wine is the Grand Vin of the historic Château Leoville Las Cases. One of the oldest and largest estates in the Médoc, it was once the heart of a vast domaine that was divided in the 19th century, leading to its 1855 classification as a Second Growth. Under the dedicated ownership of the Delon family, the winery is managed with a philosophy that treats its unique terroir—situated adjacent to the First Growth Château Latour—with the same rigour and precision as the region's top-tier estates.

Wine Description

The 2004 vintage displays a deep ruby-red hue with purple highlights, maintaining a remarkable youthfulness as it nears its third decade. The nose is aromatic and complex, offering layers of blackcurrant, black cherry, and blackberry intertwined with sophisticated notes of cedar, tobacco, graphite, and wet stone. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied with a round, velvety texture and firm, granular tannins that reflect its masculine structure. It is celebrated for its balanced acidity and fresh, poised style, leading to a long finish characterized by mineral and peppery notes. Composed of 76% Cabernet Sauvignon, 13% Merlot, and 11% Cabernet Franc, this wine has entered its secondary stage of maturity and is expected to drink beautifully through 2040.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 95 points

  • Wine Enthusiast - 95 points

  • Decanter - 95 points

  • Vinous - 93 points

title: Chateau Margaux 2009
bodyHtml:
Hailing from France, this legendary wine is produced in the Margaux appellation of the Médoc region in Bordeaux. Château Margaux, a Premier Grand Cru Classé since the 1855 Bordeaux Classification, is currently under the dedicated ownership of the Mentzelopoulos family, who have overseen the estate’s pursuit of excellence since 1977. The winery’s philosophy emphasizes a deep respect for its unique terroir, utilizing precise winemaking techniques and rigorous selection—only 36% of the 2009 harvest was used for the 'Grand Vin'—to achieve a signature balance of power and finesse.

Wine Description

The 2009 vintage displays a deep ruby to garnet colour and a complex, 'Burgundian' aromatic profile featuring abundant blueberry, cassis, and acacia flowers, with subtle layers of charcoal, graphite, and lilac. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and opulent, delivering a concentrated core of black fruits, savory leather, and sandalwood. It is characterized by remarkable tannic power that remains silky and well integrated, leading to a long, mineral laced finish with surprising freshness. The varietal composition is a blend of 87% Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Merlot, 2% Cabernet Franc, and 2% Petit Verdot, aged for approximately 20 months in 100% new French oak. While remarkably approachable now, this wine possesses an exceptional drinking window that extends to 2055 and beyond.

Accolades

  • Vinous - 100 points

  • Decanter - 100 points

  • James Suckling - 99 points

  • Wine Advocate - 99 points

  • Wine Spectator - 97 points

title: Chateau Latour Premier Grand Cru Classe 2004
bodyHtml:
Produced in France, within the southern part of the prestigious Pauillac appellation in the Médoc, this wine is the Grand Vin of the historic Château Latour. Recognized as a First Growth in the 1855 Classification, the estate’s history dates back to the 14th century and is currently owned by François Pinault. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes a profound respect for the unique gravelly terroir of the 'L’Enclos' vineyard, combining traditional hand-harvesting with pioneering innovations like temperature-controlled stainless steel vats to produce wines of unrivaled power and longevity.

Wine Description

This 2004 vintage exhibits a dark ruby-purple hue and offers a sophisticated sensory profile. The nose is woodsy and developed, featuring captivating aromas of blackcurrant, cedar, and truffle intermixed with notes of graphite, tobacco leaf, and crushed rocks. On the medium to full-bodied palate, the wine is concentrated and racy, displaying flavors of ripe cherries, blackberry, and sweet cassis supported by fine, well-integrated tannins. Stylistically, it is celebrated for its classic Latour grandeur, marrying a powerful, energetic structure with surprising elegance and silkiness. Composed of 89% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Merlot, and 1% Cabernet Franc, this wine is currently drinking beautifully but possesses the depth to age through 2045.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 97 points

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 95 points

  • Wine Spectator - 95 points

  • Decanter - 94 points

  • Vinous (Neal Martin) - 93 points

title: Chateau Lafite Rothschild 1999
bodyHtml:
This first growth reveals a remarkably complex nose with subtle new oak. The palate starts supple but finishes with great intensity. Although delicious now, this top rated wine has the structure to last.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 1999 Lafite Rothschild sports an engraved "1999" on the bottle along with an eclipse to mark that significant historical event of August, 1999. It is a quintessential offering from Lafite Rothschild. This prodigious wine is both elegant and intensely flavored, and almost diaphanous in its layers that unfold with no heaviness. An opaque ruby/purple color is accompanied by a complex bouquet of lead pencil, graphite, cedar, creme de cassis, toast, and vanilla. It is medium-bodied, with extravagant layers of richness yet little weight, and a finish that is all sweetness, ripeness, and harmony. This extraordinary Lafite increasingly appears to be a modern day clone of the majestic 1953. A mere one-third of the crop made it into the grand vin! Anticipated maturity: 2007-2030.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Delivers wonderful dark chocolate, with raspberry and currant undertones. Full-bodied, featuring soft, silky tannins and a long finish. Very tight still. Needs time. Very layered and holding back.

title: Chateau Leoville Las Cases 2021
bodyHtml:
se of cassis, dark berries, and plums, mingled with hints of spring flowers like violet, lilac, and rose, alongside nuances of cigar wrapper, loamy soil, pencil shavings, and cedar. On the poised and tightly wound palate, it delivers deep flavours of black fruit and minerals, seamlessly supported by refined, velvety tannins and lively acids. The finish is long, serious, and penetrating, leaving a lingering trail of blue fruit, lavender, mint, and a touch of spice.

  • Varietal Composition: A structured Left Bank blend of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, 15% Cabernet Franc, and 5% Merlot.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its purity and balance, trading the legendary historical austerity of the estate for a finessed, modern, and pretty character that shows incredible precision.

  • ABV: 13.2%.

  • Organic Status: While the domain is managed using sustainable and organic vineyard practices, this bottling is not formally certified organic.

Food Pairing

The firm tannic core and structural concentration of this Saint Julien make it an exceptional match for savory, protein-rich cuisine.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with a premium côte de boeuf, as the fat softens the wine's texture, or with grilled lamb chops and roasted beef.

  • Poultry & Game: Complements rich wild game dishes such as roasted duck breast served with a fruit reduction.

  • Cheese: Matches gracefully with mature, hard cheeses like aged Comté or a salty Roquefort, which balance the intensity of the wine.

Vintage Quality
