  • Organic Status: The domaine practices lutte raisonnée (reasoned struggle) and employs organic methods in its viticulture, though it is not typically certified organic.

Food Pairing

The profound structure and energetic fruit profile of Bonnes Mares make it a versatile partner for rich, savoury dishes. Suggested pairings include:

  • Meats: Duck breast with dried fruit, rare lamb chops seasoned with herbs, or roasted squab.

  • Classic French: Oeufs en meurette (eggs poached in red wine sauce) or a simple roast chicken.

  • Cheese: Pairs exceptionally well with aged Comté or other mature, nutty cheeses.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Burgundy is characterized by a large quantity of fruit and an aromatic, approachable style. In Chambolle-Musigny and Morey-Saint-Denis, the limestone-rich soils provided a lively sapidity and salinity that helped balance the ripeness of the season. Despite being a high-yield year, the winemaker's skill in early harvesting—often starting on the first day of the window—was crucial to preserving freshness and preventing over-ripeness, resulting in wines with 'wonderful structure and tension'.

title: Fontodi Flaccianello della Pieve 2022
bodyHtml:
The Fontodi estate has belonged to the Manetti family since 1968. Located in the renowned Conca d’Oro ('Golden Shell') amphitheatre in Panzano, Fontodi has transformed into a leading, certified organic estate under the guidance of Giovanni Manetti. The winery's philosophy centres on authentic terroir expression, sustainability, and respect for nature, employing meticulous vineyard management.

Wine Description

This rich, full-bodied red displays huge complexity and a well-tamed structure. Aromas feature plums, black cherries, fresh violets, and licorice, with touches of leather and graphite. On the palate, it is described as silky smooth, exuding finesse and harmony, with flavours of cherry, blackberry, black currant, violet, and toasty oak. The wine exhibits firm, fruit-coated tannins and chewy, vibrant acidity that keeps the finish fresh and in balance. The finish is long and expansive, picking up earth and mineral elements.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 97 points

  • Wine Spectator – 96 points

  • Vinous – 94+ points

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for this powerful yet elegant Sangiovese include rich, structured dishes such as red meats, like T-bone steak, or traditional Italian preparations like wild boar ragù with braised white beans.

title: Masi Amarone Mazzano 2015
bodyHtml: Impenetrable, deep ruby red colour. Intense and complex aromas of baked fruit and spices on the nose with hints of spices such as cloves and cinnamon with coffee beans. Remarkable on the palate for its imposing structure and soft, silky tannins. Warming alcohol is well balanced with pleasing acidity. Long finish dominated by marasca cherries. Good with red meats and other full flavoured foods. Excellent with strong cheeses such as parmesan and pecorino.

title: Bouchard Pere & Fils Meursault 'Genevrieres' Premier Cru 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine Bouchard Père et Fils Meursault 1er Cru 'Genevrières' 2022 is a prestigious white Burgundy sourced from the historic Côte de Beaune region in France.

The name 'Genevrières' is derived from the juniper trees (genévriers) that historically surrounded this specific vineyard site. Bouchard Père et Fils holds a significant presence here, owning roughly 1.85 to 2.65 hectares across two distinct parcels—one situated on the steep, thin soils of the upper slope and another in the deeper soils below. The estate's winemaking philosophy combines meticulous manual harvesting with gravity-flow production and aging in the natural, constant environment of the Bastions cellars at the former Château de Beaune.

Wine Description

This 2022 Premier Cru is a vibrant, medium- to full-bodied Chardonnay that balances characteristic Meursault richness with remarkable precision. It unfurls with a complex bouquet of pear, white flowers, fresh hazelnuts, and ripe citrus. On the palate, the wine is satiny and fleshy, exhibiting a core of concentrated fruit balanced by a lively acidity. It is notably racy and round, featuring a fine woody finish and a distinct, persistent minerality.

The wine is crafted from 100% Chardonnay grapes that are organically grown and hand-harvested in small crates. The vinification process involves whole-bunch pressing and aging for 16 to 20 months in French oak casks, with approximately 25% to 30% new oak depending on the specific vintage requirements. The 2022 vintage typically reaches an ABV of approximately 13% to 14.5% and possesses an aging potential of 8 to 10 years.

Accolades

  • 96 James Suckling: 'Beautiful nose of white flowers and lemon jelly. The creamy-dreamy front of the medium- to full-bodied palate doesn't let you move on, but when you do the interplay of chalky minerality with richness is stunning. And right at the end the wine's stony side and an exciting touch of grapefruit bitterness show themselves beautifully. From two blocks that are 2.6 hectares in total. From organically grown grapes. Drink or hold.'

  • 95 Tim Atkin: 'This is the first Premier Cru in the Bouchard stable to ripen in Meursault. There are two parcels—one above and one below the fault line, and there is usually a two-day difference in their harvest dates. This is beautifully ripe and delectable juice with a smooth and creamy texture covering the mid-weight palate. The flavors range from lemon oil, Granny Smith apples and tapioca to tree blooms and celery seed.'

  • 94 Decanter: 'This classic expression of Genevrières has all the richness and buttery notes that a traditional Meursault lover will appreciate. Still, there is a complexity to the fruit aromas as well, with notes of grapefruit, passionfruit, and citrus peel. Despite the broad density on the palate, a lively acidity brings everything into balance and finishes very long on the palate. The grapes are from two parcels in Genevrières, and another in Dessous; more than a hectare of the Bouchard vines here had to be grubbed up due to issues with the 161-49 rootstock.'

Food Pairing

The richness and sophisticated structure of this Premier Cru make it an ideal accompaniment for fine fish dishes served in creamy sauces or prepared 'en papillote'. It pairs elegantly with shellfish, smoked salmon, snail puff pastry, and foie gras. For a cheese course, it perfectly complements fresh cow's milk cheeses or a well-aged piece of Comté.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Burgundy is regarded as excellent, characterized by a growing season that achieved full phenolic ripeness despite searing summer heat and drought conditions. Cool nights throughout the season helped retain essential acidity, preventing high alcohol levels from overwhelming the fruit. The resulting white wines are described as balanced, honest, and high-quality, with healthy yields that provided a welcome relief to the region.

title: Chateau Angelus 2012
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Saint Emilion region of Bordeaux, France, Chateau Angelus 2012 marks a historic milestone as the vintage that saw the estate promoted to Premier Grand Cru Classé (A). The property has been managed by the Boüard de Laforest family for eight generations, with Hubert de Boüard de Laforest and his daughter Stéphanie Boüard-Rivoal currently overseeing a philosophy centered on precision, integrity, and a deep-seated passion for the unique terroir of the south-facing slopes.

Wine Description

This vintage displays a dense, opaque purple-blue colour and a complex aromatic profile featuring black cherry, mulberry, and blackberry intertwined with sophisticated notes of graphite, barbecue smoke, truffle, and sweet spicy oak. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and powerful yet maintains a silky texture, offering a multidimensional mouthfeel with flavors of ripe plums, cassis, and dark chocolate.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 94 points

  • Vinous - 93 points

  • Robert Parker - 94 points

  • James Suckling - 94 points

Food Pairing

The structured body and rich fruit profile of this Saint Emilion make it an ideal companion for classic meat dishes such as roasted leg of lamb with herbs de Provence, grilled ribeye, or roasted duck. Its earthy undertones also pair exceptionally well with mushroom-based recipes, such as a truffle risotto or wild mushroom pasta.

title: Valdicava Brunello di Montalcino Montosoli 2019
bodyHtml:
This rare and monumental red wine originates from the Tuscany region of Italy, specifically from the historic Montosoli hill in the northern sector of the Montalcino appellation. Valdicava was established in 1953 by Bramante Abbruzzese, but the modern era of the estate began in 1987 under the direction of his grandson, Vincenzo Abbruzzese, who focused on producing benchmark Brunellos exclusively from estate vineyards. The Vigna Montosoli is a specific 1.3-hectare cru that the family reacquired in 2008, and its wines are celebrated for capturing the unique, high-altitude terroir of one of Montalcino's most prestigious sites.

Wine Description

The 2019 Valdicava Brunello di Montalcino Vigna Montosoli displays intense ruby depths with a virile and sophistically ethereal personality. The complex sensory profile opens with dark, dusty aromas of dried violets, cedar, and clove, eventually revealing hints of spiced oranges, lavender, and wild strawberries. On the palate, the wine offers a medium to full body with a texture of pure silk, providing a dense wave of tart wild berry fruits underscored by salty mineral tones, iron, and liquorice. The finish is exceptionally persistent, marked by a bitter tinge of boysenberry, cocoa, and youthfully gripping, fine-grained tannins. This 100% Sangiovese has an ABV of 14% and is aged for several years in large Slavonian oak casks. The estate completely dispenses with chemicals and follows biodynamic cultivation practices, ensuring all grapes are organically grown.

Food Pairing

This robust and structured Brunello pairs perfectly with rich, savory dishes such as wild boar ragù served with pappardelle or a classic Tuscan bistecca alla fiorentina. Its earthy complexity and firm tannins also complement game dishes like venison or duck breast in a Brunello reduction, as well as deeply seasoned mushroom-based risottos. For a local cheese pairing, a barrique-aged Pecorino di Pienza is an excellent choice.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 vintage in Montalcino is considered a masterpiece, characterized by a long and even growing season that allowed for perfect phenolic and technological maturity. Abundant water reserves from a mild winter and a lack of extreme summer heat resulted in a slow, homogenous ripening process, producing wines noted for their exceptional balance, vibrant acidity, and refined structure.

title: Aile d'Argent by Chateau Mouton Rothschild 2022
bodyHtml:
From France’s Bordeaux region, Aile d’Argent is the white wine of the prestigious Château Mouton Rothschild in Pauillac. Created in the early 1980s under Philippine de Rothschild, the wine reflects the estate’s dedication to producing world-class wines not only in red but also in rare white Bordeaux blends. The château’s legacy combines tradition and innovation, consistently striving for excellence in winemaking.

Wine Description

The 2022 vintage presents a bright silvery-yellow hue. The nose opens with citrus aromas, white peach, verbena, and acacia honey, followed by exotic tropical notes of mango, pineapple, and melon. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with a rich yet elegant texture, layered with flavours of pear, lime zest, elderflower, and subtle oak spice. Crisp acidity underpins its balance, giving freshness and length to the mineral-driven finish.

Accolades

  • 97 Points - James Suckling: So vibrant and minerally with salt and dried apple, peach and pears. Medium to full body. Creamy texture. Some phenolics. Dried fruit skin. Vivid acidity. Barrel Sample: 96-97

  • 95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck: Another impressive Bordeaux Blanc from the Médoc, the 2022 Château Mouton Rothschild Aile D'Argent Blanc is based on 52% Sauvignon Blanc, 39% Sémillon, 8% Sauvignon Gris, and the rest Muscadelle. Still aging in 45% new oak, it has a ripe, tropical nose of minty herbs, exotic flowers, and assorted citrus and melon-like fruits. It's clean, vibrant, and medium-bodied, with bright acidity and a great finish.
    Barrel Sample: 93-95

  • 94 Points - Decanter: Gorgeous tropical notes on the nose, pineapple, mango, lemon, fresh but ripe and lively with elderflower, acacia flowers, green apple and citrus fruits. Nicely weighted on the palate. A shot of bright mango and apple with flecks of lime and a creamy lemon yoghurt type texture, thick but enjoyable. Keeps its coolness, not so tense or necessarily streamlined but generous flavour all the way through. A citrus kick and lift at the end brings the freshness and tang back, with a salinity that is moreish. Joyful and really quite approachable still with weight and texture. Will be bottled in the first week of June. Very moreish. Harvest 22-31st August. A yield of 16.7hl/ha. 1% Muscadelle completes the blend. 3.18 PH. 3.8 g/l total acidity. Aged 45% in new barrels. Barrel Sample

Food Pairing

Ideal pairings include seared scallops with lemon butter, roast chicken with tarragon, or a creamy mushroom risotto.

title: Chateau Montelena Zinfandel 2023
bodyHtml:
An old-school Zinfandel, its colour as transparent as the thin skin of the grapes, this has the richness of a warm-climate wine, plus supple, dusty tannins to keep all the black-fruit flavour in focus. There’s a gamey, meaty edge to it, some eucalyptus and sour plum notes that add to the wine’s charm. Pour it with grilled lamb. 

Wine Description

Aromas of cinnamon and allspice quickly yield to ripe cherry and a torrent of red fruit along with a characteristic hint of tobacco. Dark and lush, the initial perception of tart raspberry is overwhelmed by blackberry jam, red licorice, and a supple earthiness that leans toward black pepper and anise. Intriguing in its contrast to the palate, the finish is driven primarily by the briar and spice character of the old vines: layered and dense, with just enough tannin to balance the mocha and barrel toast character from time in the cellar.

title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Vigna Paganelli 2019
bodyHtml:
#52 on Wine Spectator’s Top 100 Wines of 2025

This monumental and profound red wine originates from the Montalcino region of Tuscany, Italy. Il Poggione is one of the "founding fathers" of the Brunello appellation, known for its unwavering commitment to traditional methods and powerful, long-lived wines. The "Vigna Paganelli" is the estate's crown jewel— single-vineyard Riserva sourced from their oldest vines, planted in 1964. This wine is only produced in the most exceptional years, and the 2019 release is being hailed by critics as a legendary "dark stallion" of a wine.

Wine Description

The Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Vigna Paganelli 2019 presents an intense, deep ruby red colour. The sensory profile is brooding and complex, featuring an explosive nose of black cherries, wild plums, and blackberries, layered with sophisticated notes of tobacco leaf, black truffles, incense, and sweet baking spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and "racy," showcasing a massive concentration of dark fruit balanced by a core of zesty acidity and a "web" of finely chiseled, "chewy" tannins. It is characterized by its incredible mineral tension and "spiritual" depth, leading to an exceptionally long, persistent finish with hints of orange zest, cloves, and graphite. This 100% Sangiovese has an ABV of 14.5% and was aged for four years in large French oak casks (botti) followed by extensive refinement in the bottle.

Food Pairing

The immense structure and savory complexity of this Riserva make it a natural partner for the richest and most robust dishes of the Tuscan countryside. It pairs perfectly with braised wild boar (Cinghiale), Bistecca alla Fiorentina, or a hearty stew featuring porcini mushrooms and truffles. Its dark fruit and balsamic notes also complement aged, pungent cheeses like Pecorino Toscano or Castelmagno. Decanting for at least 3 to 4 hours is highly recommended if enjoying in its youth.

Vintage Quality & Aging Potential

The 2019 vintage is widely considered a perfect, 5-star year for Montalcino, defined by a long, balanced growing season that resulted in grapes with extraordinary phenolic ripeness and natural acidity. Critics have noted that this is the best Vigna Paganelli since the historic 2016, offering a "drop-dead gorgeous" profile that stands at the pinnacle of the appellation. While enticing now for those who love power, it is built for the long haul, with a drinking window estimated to extend from 2028 through 2050+.

title: Eisele Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 'Altagracia' 2018
bodyHtml:
Eisele Vineyard is built on the spirit of stewardship that defines its past. Their journey here is an exploration, a quest to understand this vineyard more deeply, its geologic construct, the variations in terroir, and the nature of its ancient soils. Changes, when considered, are only in service to letting the terroir speak more clearly. To this work, their experienced team brings creativity, curiosity, and an unflagging passion for excellence.

The 2018 Altagracia Cabernet Sauvignon unfolds with a nose of intense black fruit, wild blueberries and fresh black currants with a whiff of dried violets and tobacco. The mouthfeel is ample but firm with mineral notes of volcanic rock, forest humus and hints of dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine shows great depth thanks to extended maceration, with a refined texture of tight-knit tannins supporting the energetic black and blue fruits. As the wine opens, layers of floral notes, peppercorn and cardamom add to the complexity. The long finish lingers with a touch of licorice. This is a very pure and elegant Altagracia.

97 Points James Suckling... Intense aromas of black fruit, cocoa powder, black olives, dried violets, tar and cigar box. Some black peppercorn, too. It’s full-bodied with firm, chalky tannins. Incredible intensity and purity of fruit with gorgeous breadth and depth. Superb, new-wave Napa red. 80% cabernet sauvignon, the rest mostly cabernet franc with a hit of Petit Verdot. 

95 Points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate... Deep purple-black in colour, the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Altagracia slowly grows on the nose, developing into profound scents of black currant cordial, baked plums and wild blueberries with suggestions of bouquet garni, black pepper, pencil lead and fertile loam plus a touch of beef drippings. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is delicately played with beautiful definition and lots of red berry and earthy accents intertwined with the black fruits. Supported by velvety tannins and just enough freshness, it finishes long and mineral laced. 

93 Points Wine Spectator... Shows a fresh edge, with dark plum and blackberry puree flavours stitched with a hint of alder and backed by subtle floral and earth accents, carrying through the structured but accessible finish. Sneaky long too, so there's no rush. Drink now through 2032.

title: Devevey Volnay Cuvee Lopins
bodyHtml:
This red wine, a Village classification, is made entirely from the Pinot Noir grape variety. Volnay wines typically exhibit a colour that ranges from bright ruby to a light garnet. Characteristic aromas include violet, gooseberry, and cherry, which can evolve to include spices, game, and cooked prune with age. The palate is admired for its delicacy, sap, and bouquet, offering a velvety finesse and great aromatic intensity. Tasting notes for the 2020 vintage describe heady whole-bunch aromas in the bouquet, with a palate that is rich, rounded, and plush. Generally, Volnay is a medium bodied wine known for its finesse and elegance among the red wines of the Côte de Beaune. 

Food Pairing 

  • The wine's velvety finesse and aromatic intensity make it an ideal partner for sophisticated poultry dishes, such as those patiently roasted and glazed.

  • The intensity of Volnay also allows it to pair well with distinctly flavoured cheeses, or dishes like roast lamb shoulder.

  • Consider feathered game, either stewed, slowly braised, or roasted, to complement the wine's opulence and meaty texture.

    A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Chateau Haut Brion 2018
bodyHtml:
Chateau Haut Brion is located in France, within the Pessac Leognan subregion of the broader Bordeaux region. Founded in 1525, it is the only First Growth estate situated outside the Médoc and has been owned by the American Dillon family since 1935. The winery’s philosophy focuses on sustainable agriculture and the production of powerful, smoky red wines known for their incredible longevity and silky tannins.

Wine Description

Chateau Haut Brion displays a deep garnet purple colour and opens with a complex melody of tilled earth, licorice, crushed rocks, and preserved plums. On the palate, this medium to full bodied wine reveals tightly wound layers of black fruit, crème de cassis, and wild blueberries, framed by seamless freshness and a solid, plush texture. The finish is exceptionally long, underscored by mineral sparks and exotic spices.

Accolades

  • Wine Advocate - 100 points

  • James Suckling - 99 points

  • Wine Spectator - 98 points

  • Decanter - 98 points

  • Vinous - 97 points

Food Pairing

The wine’s firm structure and earthy profile pair beautifully with classic Bordeaux fare such as grilled ribeye steak or a rack of lamb with rosemary and roasted potatoes. It also complements rich, hearty stews, dishes featuring truffles, or aged hard cheeses like Comté and Parmesan.

title: Bodegas Y Vinedos Pintia 2021
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine originates from Spain, crafted in the Castilla y Leon region within the Toro subregion. Bodegas y Vinedos Pintia is a modern, highly expressive project established by the legendary Tempos Vega Sicilia group. The winery operates on a philosophy of capturing the extreme, rugged terroir of Toro while imparting the signature elegance, precision, and balance for which the Vega Sicilia family is globally renowned.

Wine Description

In the glass, this wine showcases an intensely deep purple colour with a brilliant sheen. The nose is precise and complex, unfurling pure aromas of blackberry, raspberry, and dark plum alongside nuanced layers of mint, cedar, cocoa, and roasted spices. On the palate, it delivers a full bodied and opulent structure balanced by a striking, lively freshness and a compact, layered texture.

title: Matt Taylor Komorebi Pinot Noir 2017
bodyHtml:
Coastal pine sap and sweet tobacco leaf are the first indications that this is not your typical Cali Pinot. Whole cluster fermentation produced an elegant and light middleweight wine with vivid flavors of bright red cherries and cranberries with earthy and botanical ubedrpinnigs. .

Fine-grain, slightly andy tannins are beautifully balanced with an arrow of acidity keeping everything fresh fresh and a piquant mineral sterka through the finish. Gains a bit of weight and plushnessas in your glass.

title: Domaine De Chevalier Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine de Chevalier, located in the Pessac-Léognan appellation of Bordeaux, is a renowned Grand Cru Classé estate with a legacy of excellence. Owned by the Bernard family since 1983, the estate is celebrated for its meticulous vineyard management and commitment to quality, producing both red and white wines of great distinction.

Wine Description
The 2022 Domaine de Chevalier Rouge displays a deep ruby colour with violet reflections. On the nose, it reveals an aromatic bouquet of ripe blackcurrants, blueberries, graphite, crushed stones, violets, and subtle toasted spices. The palate is rich and vibrant, with a medium to full body and a refined texture that balances freshness with depth. The tannins are polished, supporting layers of dark fruit, cedar, and hints of mocha. The finish is long, mineral-driven, and beautifully structured.

Accolades
● James Suckling – 98–99 points.
● Vinous – 96–98 points.
● Wine Advocate – 95–97 points.

Food Pairing
Pair this elegant red with grilled lamb chops, roasted duck breast, or wild mushroom risotto. The savoury depth of these dishes complements the wine's complexity and structured tannins. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Fratelli Alessandria 'Monvigliero' Barolo 2018
bodyHtml: Absolutely pristine on the nose, with ruby royal red fruits, so deep and profound, yet effortless at the same time. A model of elegant power, layered spices and velvety aromatic fruits, so controlled and long and expansive in its complexity and stature, but vertical in its acids, such an uplifting, impressive Barolo. Stunning. A steep, chalk south/southwest facing vineyard sitting at 280 metres above sea level, above San Lorenzo. After a month of gentle maceration, the wine is then aged for 3 years in large wooden vats.

title: Alter Ego de Palmer 2019 (by Chateau Palmer) - 6 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Produced in France, Alter Ego de Palmer 2019 is a distinguished expression of the Margaux appellation in Bordeaux. Produced by Chateau Palmer, a historic Third Growth estate, this wine is not considered a traditional 'second wine' but rather a separate label created from its own distinct vineyard plots. The estate is managed by Thomas Duroux and operates under a 100% biodynamic winemaking philosophy that views the vineyard as a holistic ecosystem.

Wine Description

This 2019 vintage displays a dense garnet purple colour and a profound, explosive aromatic profile. The nose features intense aromas of blackcurrants, crème de cassis, and ripe black cherries, layered with floral notes of violets, lavender, and field spring flowers, alongside subtle hints of cedar, tobacco, and star anise. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and fleshy, showcasing a lush, mouth filling texture and extremely refined, melting tannins. It is characterized by precision, harmony, and a vibrant, long finish. The varietal composition is typically a blend of approximately 51% Merlot, 40% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 9% Petit Verdot. This wine is designed to be approachable in its youth while maintaining an optimal drinking window from 2024 through 2038.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling – 96 points."

  • "Decanter – 95 points."

  • "Jeb Dunnuck – 94 points."

  • "Wine Enthusiast – 94 points."

  • "Robert Parker's Wine Advocate – 91 points."

title: Jinro Plum Soju - 360 ml
bodyHtml:
Jinro Plum Soju is a flavoured spirit originating from South Korea. The brand is produced by HiteJinro, a multinational distilling company founded in 1924 that has grown to become the world's leading producer of soju. In 2006, the original Jinro company was acquired by Hite, a prominent Korean beverage firm primarily known for its beer production.

Description

This spirit is a clear, distilled beverage that maintains a neutral base while incorporating the rich essence of ripe plums. It features expressive floral and fruity aromas dominated by sweet plum notes. On the palate, the texture is soft and silky, offering a balanced sweetness paired with a subtle tang. The body is light and refreshing, leading into a smooth, clean finish. Jinro Plum Soju typically contains an alcohol content of 13%.

title: Senensis London Dry Gin - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Senensis London Dry Gin originates from the Tuscany region of Italy, specifically from the historic city of Siena. It is produced by the Senensis Distillery, an artisanal producer that focuses on capturing the 'spirit of Siena' by utilizing botanicals synonymous with the local landscape and the famous Palio di Siena. The distillery emphasizes small batch production and traditional copper pot distillation to maintain the integrity of its Mediterranean ingredients.

Spirit Description

This gin is a refined and aromatic London Dry style, presenting a crystal clear appearance and a medium, well structured body. The aroma is highly evocative of the Tuscan countryside, leading with sharp juniper and a bouquet of Mediterranean herbs such as rosemary and thyme, balanced by bright citrus zest. On the palate, it is crisp and dry, offering a complex interplay of spicy coriander, earthy angelica root, and floral notes of lavender and iris. The finish is long and elegant, marked by a refreshing herbal persistence and a clean, peppery warmth. It is bottled at 43% ABV.

title: Conde de Caralt Cava Brut
bodyHtml:
Conde de Caralt Cava Brut is a classic sparkling wine from Spain, produced in the renowned Penedès region of Catalonia. Founded in 1964, the brand represents over sixty years of winemaking tradition with a steadfast commitment to authenticity and stylistic consistency. Now part of the Ferrer Wines group, the winery continues to honour its Mediterranean roots by crafting balanced, elegant Cavas that highlight the unique character of the local terrain.

Wine Description

This Cava displays a bright straw yellow colour and a lively, medium sized perlage. The nose is clean and refined, offering aromas of green apple, pear, and lemon, complemented by subtle, elegant ageing notes of brioche and white flowers. On the palate, it is smooth, balanced, and fresh, featuring bright acidity with flavours of citrus fruit and grassy nuances. A blend of the traditional Cava varieties Macabeo, Xarel lo, and Parellada, it is produced using the traditional method and aged on its lees for 9 to 15 months to develop complexity.

title: Brother's Bond Blended American Rye
bodyHtml:
Brother's Bond Blended American Rye originates from the United States, distilled and aged in Lawrenceburg, Indiana. The brand was co-founded by actors Ian Somerhalder and Paul Wesley, famously known for their roles in 'The Vampire Diaries', along with CEO Vincent Hanna. Launched in 2021, the company is built on a foundation of sustainability, committing a portion of its proceeds to support regenerative farming practices.

Spirit Description

This small batch spirit is a four grain blend dominated by a 77% rye mash bill, with the remainder consisting of 16% corn and 7% wheat and barley. It presents a rich golden amber colour with a full bodied, creamy mouthfeel. The aroma is highly expressive, featuring toasted cereal grains, dried apricot, and a hint of white pepper, complemented by delicate notes of rose petals and mint. On the palate, bold rye spice takes the lead, beautifully balanced by flavours of honey, stone fruit, and soft oak. The finish is dry, warming, and extra long, with lingering notes of ginger snap, citrus peel, and a touch of beeswax. It is bottled at 47.5% ABV (95 proof).

Accolades

Brother's Bond has quickly become a highly decorated brand, with its expressions earning Double Gold medals at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition in 2022, 2023, and 2024. The American Blended Rye specifically was recognized with a Bronze Medal at the 2025 Bartender Spirits Awards. The brand is also celebrated for its environmental impact, having been one of the first bourbon brands to integrate regenerative grains into its production.

Food Pairing

The assertive and spicy profile of this rye whiskey makes it an ideal partner for bold and savoury dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled meats like pepper crusted steak or 'jerk' seasoned pork, where the rye spice complements the heat. For a cheese course, it stands up to sharp cheddar, aged Gouda, or creamy blue cheese. For dessert, it serves as a sophisticated match for gingerbread, dark chocolate truffles, or pecan pie, which echo the spirit's notes of ginger and caramel.

title: Glenmorangie Lasanta 15 Year Old  Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie Lasanta 15 Years Old originates from the Highland region of Scotland, specifically near Tain in Ross-shire. The Glenmorangie Distillery was founded in 1843 by William Matheson and is renowned for having the tallest stills in Scotland, which are as tall as an adult male giraffe. Currently owned by Louis Vuitton Moët Hennessy (LVMH), the distillery transitioned its core 'Lasanta' expression from a 12 year old to a 15 year old age statement in 2025 under the direction of Dr. Bill Lumsden.

Spirit Description

This single malt features a deep coppery gold appearance and is matured in a combination of ex-bourbon and Oloroso sherry casks. The aroma is a warm bouquet of salted caramel, dark chocolate, and dried fruits like raisins and apricots, underpinned by sweet spices such as cinnamon and nutmeg. On the palate, it offers a silky and viscous mouthfeel with flavours of runny honey, apricot jam, and juicy orange segments, evolving into toasted hazelnuts and milk chocolate. The finish is long, comforting, and decadent, leaving lingering notes of candied citrus zest, molasses, and a rich plum jam sweetness. It is bottled at 43% ABV.

Accolades

Glenmorangie Lasanta has a long history of critical success, and the 15 year old upgrade has been highly praised by enthusiasts for its added depth and complexity. It received a score of 95/100 from Whisky Advocate, where it was noted for its elegant and spicy profile. The distillery itself has previously been honoured with multiple 'Distiller of the Year' awards and remains a pioneer in the art of wood finishing.

title: Brother's Bond Cask Strength Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Brother's Bond Cask Strength Straight Bourbon originates from the United States, specifically distilled in Indiana and aged in Fort Smith, Arkansas. The brand was founded in 2021 by Ian Somerhalder and Paul Wesley, known for their roles as the Salvatore brothers in 'The Vampire Diaries'. The duo spent years experimenting with mash bills to create a spirit that focuses on sustainability, with a portion of proceeds supporting regenerative farming practices to combat climate change.

Spirit Description

This high rye, four grain bourbon is unfiltered, uncut, and bottled at barrel proof, which typically sits around 57.2% ABV. It presents a deep 'old gold' appearance with a big, zesty body. The aroma is a complex layering of ripe banana, walnut, and leather, underscored by a hint of subtle smoke. On the palate, it delivers bold and indulgent notes of caramel, honey, and warm rye bread, transitioning into dried fruit and orange marmalade. The finish is exceptionally long and warming, marked by lingering rye spices and a touch of beeswax.

Accolades

Brother's Bond Cask Strength has received significant industry recognition, including being named one of the '5 Best Bourbons and Ryes' by the San Francisco World Spirits Competition. It has earned a Double Gold medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition and was a 'Best in Show Finalist' at the 2023 New York World Spirits Competition. Furthermore, it secured a Platinum medal and 'Best in Show' at the 2023 TAG Global Spirits Awards.

Food Pairing

The intense proof and rich sweetness of this cask strength bourbon make it a robust companion for hearty, flavourful dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with smoked beef brisket or a charred ribeye steak, where the spirit's caramel notes complement the Maillard reaction of the meat. For a cheese course, opt for aged Gouda or sharp cheddar, which provide the salt and fat necessary to balance the high alcohol content. For dessert, it serves as a sophisticated match for crème brûlée, dark chocolate truffles, or a warm bread pudding topped with walnuts.

title: Alois Lageder Misto Mare 2025
bodyHtml:
This innovative and "dynamic" white blend originates from Italy, specifically from the Vigneti delle Dolomiti IGT in the Alto Adige region. Misto Mare (meaning "Mixed Sea") serves a unique purpose: it is a "gateway" wine created for the winery's new partners who are currently in the three-year process of transitioning to organic and biodynamic certification.

Wine Description

Alois Lageder Misto Mare is a unique field blend of over 14 to 20 different grape varieties, including both white and red grapes, co-fermented and vinified as a white wine. The wine presents a straw-yellow hue, sometimes with a delicate blush. Its sensory profile is multi-faceted and "animating," featuring a nose of fuzzy peach, jasmine, and citrus zest, layered with floral notes and a subtle saline minerality. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and fresh, showcasing a "silky texture" and a moderate, integrated acidity that leads to a juicy, long finish. Matured primarily in stainless steel, with a portion resting on the lees for three months to add depth without masking its energetic mountain fruit.

title: Tornatore Etna Bianco 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and mineral-driven white wine originates from Italy, specifically from the northern slopes of the Mount Etna volcano in Sicily. The Tornatore family has deep roots in the region, farming in the village of Castiglione di Sicilia since 1865. As one of the largest and most respected estates in the Etna DOC, Tornatore is celebrated for its commitment to sustainability; adhering to VIVA and SOStain certifications and for producing wines that transparently reflect the volcano’s unique "high-altitude" character.

Wine Description

Tornatore Etna Bianco 2024 presents a pale straw-yellow color with intense greenish reflections. The sensory profile is remarkably fresh and "seaworthy," featuring a fragrant nose of green apple, white peach, and grapefruit, layered with sophisticated notes of Mediterranean herbs and a signature "gunflint" smoke. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "sapid," showcasing a striking saline minerality and racy acidity. This 100% Carricante reached an ABV of 12.5%. To preserve its "volcanic energy," the fruit was fermented in concrete tanks and aged on its lees for three months, avoiding oak to emphasize the purity of the variety.

title: Tornatore Pietrarizzo Etna Rosso 2021
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and "muscular" single-vineyard red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Pietrarizzo vineyard on the northern slopes of Mount Etna in Sicily. Sourced from a basaltic site at 650 to 700 meters in elevation, this "Cru" is renowned for producing grapes with limited yields and high concentration. The Tornatore family, winemaking pioneers on the volcano since 1865, utilizes sustainable practices to ensure the wine reflects the raw energy of Etna's ashy, mineral-rich soils.

Wine Description

Tornatore Pietrarizzo Etna Rosso 2021 presents a bright ruby red color and a "tense, chewy" profile. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and balanced, featuring a nose of ripe raspberries, strawberries, and cranberry, layered with sophisticated notes of cinnamon, blood orange, and fresh Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and juicy, showcasing a surprising "crunchy" freshness and snappy acidity. It is characterized by its firm, chalky tannins and a long, stony mineral finish that reflects its volcanic origin. This 100% Nerello Mascalese typically reaches an ABV of 14.5%. The wine was matured for 12 months in a combination of large French oak barrels and concrete vats, followed by three months in the bottle.

title: Ole Tequila Variety Pack - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: Olé Tequila Variety Pack is a collection of premium, ready to drink cocktails originating from British Columbia, Canada. These craft beverages are produced by Olé Cocktail Co., a Canadian owned brand that uses authentic Blanco tequila imported from Jalisco, Mexico, as its base. The company focuses on using real fruit juices and organic agave nectar, avoiding artificial colours, flavours, or sweeteners in their recipes.

title: Langmeil Three Gardens VMR 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and "contemporary" white blend originates from Australia, specifically from the premier Barossa Valley in South Australia. Historically, Barossa vignerons referred to their vineyards as "gardens," a tradition Langmeil honors with this Southern Rhône-style blend of Viognier, Marsanne, and Roussanne (VMR). The winery's philosophy for the Three Gardens series is to create harmonious, balanced wines that capture the intensity of the warm Barossa climate while maintaining a refreshing energy.

Wine Description

Langmeil Three Gardens VMR 2024 presents a pale gold color with a sparkling clarity. The sensory profile is aromatic and "inviting," featuring a nose of apricot, jasmine, and almond, layered with sophisticated notes of fresh lime and custard tart. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "waxy," showcasing a rich, silky texture derived from five months of maturation on the lees. It is characterized by soft acidity and flavors of peach, ripe pear, and light spices, leading to a round, floral finish with a hint of mineral tension. This blend typically reaches an ABV of 13.5%.

title: Santa Rita Medalla Real Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
This elegant white wine originates from Chile, specifically from the Limarí Valley subregion in the Coquimbo region. Founded in 1880, Santa Rita is a pioneer of Chilean viticulture and the first wine group in the country to be certified under the National Sustainability Code in 2011. The Medalla Real label was established in 1983 to honour Francisco García Huidobro, an ancestor of the founding family and the founder of the first Mint in Chile. The winery's philosophy focuses on producing single vineyard wines that express a distinct sense of place through sustainable practices.

Wine Description

The Medalla Real Gran Reserva Chardonnay presents a bright, goldish yellow colour. The sensory profile features an intense and complex bouquet that combines mineral notes with citrus, nectarines, white peach, and flowers. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with a refreshing acidity that balances its fruitiness and creamy, silky texture. It often reveals toasty, nutty aromas and a saline, chalky finish characteristic of the Limarí terroir. While Santa Rita is heavily invested in sustainable viticulture and Ecocert audits, this specific wine is not labelled as organic.

title: Maker's Mark - 1.14 Litre
bodyHtml:
Maker's Mark is a quintessential American bourbon hailing from Loretto, Kentucky, within the heart of the iconic Bluegrass region. The distillery's modern legacy began in 1953 when Bill Samuels Sr. purchased the historic Burks' Distillery, famously burning his family's 170-year-old rye-heavy recipe to pioneer a smoother, 'wheated' bourbon.

Wine Description

This Kentucky Straight Bourbon displays a light golden amber hue in the glass. The nose is inviting and sweet, offering aromas of sweet oak, vanilla, and bright fruit, underscored by the scent of freshly baked wheat bread and kettlecorn. On the palate, it is full-flavored yet remarkably smooth, featuring a balanced profile of caramel, honey, and red apple with nuances of vanilla nougat and toasted malt. The body is velvety and vibrant, leading into a creamy, medium-length finish with a pleasant soft spice and clean notes of mint chocolate chip.

Food Pairing

The soft, wheated profile of Maker's Mark pairs exceptionally well with rich, fatty meats such as glazed ham or slow-roasted pork belly, which highlight the spirit's inherent sweetness. For a classic experience, enjoy it alongside a warm apple pie or dark chocolate truffles to complement the vanilla and baking spice notes.

title: Prunotto Barbaresco 'Bric Turot' 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'classic' red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Barbaresco D.O.C.G. appellation in the Piedmont region. The Bric Turot vineyard is a historic five-hectare estate plot in Treiso, featuring magnesium-rich 'Tortoniano' soils with a unique bluish hue. Founded in 1922 by Alfredo Prunotto, the winery became a pioneer of single-vineyard bottlings under Beppe Colla in the 1960s and has been owned by the Antinori family of Tuscany since the 1990s. The winery's philosophy combines traditional Piedmontese viticulture with modern technology to express the specific territorial aromas of their Langhe hill sites.

Wine Description

A beautiful, intense, and bright ruby red colour. The complex sensory profile features an expressive nose of wild fruits, cherry stones, and strawberries, layered with savory notes of walnuts, tobacco, white pepper, and aromatic herbs such as pine and mint. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and 'velvety', showcasing a core of dark red fruit, cloves, and leather with clean mineral notes. It is characterized by its harmony and finesse, supported by fine, lightly chalky tannins and a persistent finish. This 100% Nebbiolo was aged for 12 months in oak barrels of varying capacities followed by an additional year in the bottle, typically reaching an alcohol content of approximately 14%. While the estate follows modern sustainable practices, this bottling is not labelled as organic.

title: Simonnet Febvre Chablis 2023
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from France, within the Chablis subregion of Burgundy and the Chablis A.O.C. appellation. Established in 1840 by barrel maker Jean Febvre, Maison Simonnet-Febvre is one of the oldest wineries in Chablis and is currently under the ownership of Maison Louis Latour. The house is notable for being the only one in Chablis to produce Crémant de Bourgogne, reflecting a winemaking philosophy that values both traditional sparkling methods and the expression of distinct Kimmeridgian limestone terroirs.

Wine Description

Presents a pretty golden colour with greenish reflections and a lovely shimmer. The sensory profile features a spritely nose of sweet lemon rind, crunchy young peach, and green apple, layered with delicate floral notes and a marine minerality reminiscent of oyster shells. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and bone-dry, showcasing a soft yet precise mouthfeel driven by taut, saline acidity. It offers delineated fruit core of pear and citrus, underpinned by a chalky, sea-spray energy. Characterized by its cool-climate linearity and excellent aromatic persistence, the wine concludes with a brisk and saline finish. While the house produces some organically certified Premier Cru cuvées, the standard village Chablis is generally produced using sustainable viticulture.

title: River Retreat Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
River Retreat Sauvignon Blanc is a fresh, tropical white wine produced by Trentham Estate in the Murray Darling region of New South Wales, Australia.

The River Retreat range is built on a strong environmental initiative dedicated to the preservation of the Murray Darling Basin's fragile wetlands. For every bottle sold, the winery makes a donation to the Murray Darling Wetlands Working Group to help maintain these vital inland ecosystems. The Trentham Estate winemaking philosophy focuses on producing high-quality varietal wines that emphasize full fruit flavor while remaining accessible and eco-conscious.

Wine Description

This wine presents a pale green color and a "zesty" profile designed for immediate enjoyment. The nose is greeted by lifted aromas of tropical fruit, including lychee, passionfruit, and sweet pineapple, often accented by notes of citrus and fresh lemongrass. On the palate, the wine is bright and zippy, showcasing a balance of crisp acidity and flavors of kiwi, soft pawpaw, and green basil. It is characterized by its steely, flinty finish and a richer mouthfeel than its counterparts from New Zealand.

The wine is 100% Sauvignon Blanc, sourced from vineyards featuring red loam over limestone soils. To preserve its vibrant fruit characters, the grapes are harvested in the cool of the night. Only the best quality free-run juice is used, fermented with selected yeasts at cold temperatures to enhance varietal purity. This 2025 release has an ABV of 12.5% and is both vegetarian and vegan-friendly.

title: Trentham Estate Reserve Coonawarra Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Trentham Estate Reserve Coonawarra Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a highly awarded, classically structured red wine from one of Australia's most famous cool-climate regions.

The Reserve range represents the pinnacle of Trentham Estate’s production, where chief winemaker Anthony Murphy selects specific parcels of fruit from iconic regions that best express a variety's natural character. While the family-owned winery is based along the Murray River in New South Wales, they source these specific grapes from the terra rossa (red clay over limestone) soils of Coonawarra to capture the region’s signature "mint and cassis" profile.

Wine Description

The 2021 vintage presents a vibrant red-purple colour with a deep, rich core. The nose is quintessentially Coonawarra, offering lifted aromas of violet and mint alongside intense cassis fruit, bay leaf, and subtle notes of coffee-cream and malt. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and firm, showing great length and a "weight of flavour". It is characterized by its excellent structure, featuring dark chocolate undertones and ripe, soft tannins that ensure the wine is approachable now while possessing significant cellaring potential.

The wine is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, matured for 12 months in French oak barrels to integrate the tannins and add complexity. This 2021 release has an ABV of 14.5% and is both vegetarian and vegan-friendly.

Food Pairing

The firm tannins and cool-climate aromatics of this Cabernet Sauvignon make it a classic partner for savory red meats.

  • Meats: Ideally paired with roasted lamb seasoned with rosemary and garlic, grilled rib-eye steak, or braised beef cheeks.

  • Vegetarian: Complements hearty dishes like mushroom ragù or lentil-based stews with savory herbs.

  • Cheese: Best matched with aged hard cheeses such as sharp Cheddar or Pecorino.

title: Azelia Dolcetto d'Alba "Bricco dell'Oriolo" 2024
bodyHtml:
Azelia Dolcetto d'Alba "Bricco dell'Oriolo" 2024 is a premium single-vineyard red wine from the Montelupo Albese commune in Piedmont, Italy.

The Azelia estate, managed by Luigi Scavino alongside his wife Lorella and son Lorenzo, is highly regarded for its precision and respect for local varieties. While the family is famous for their Barolo Crus, they treat their Dolcetto with exceptional care, sourcing it from the Bricco dell'Oriolo vineyard. This site is considered one of the finest in the region for this specific variety, characterized by its high altitude and optimal southern exposure.

Wine Description

The 2024 vintage presents an intense, deep ruby color with violet reflections. The nose is remarkably expressive—often described as an "explosion of flowers and fruits"—featuring prominent aromas of blackberry, blueberry, and rose, accented by sweet spices. On the palate, the wine is aromatic and mineral-driven with deep fruity flavors that persist for a long duration. It is characterized by its attractive freshness and complex mouthfeel, which sets it apart from more simple, regional Dolcettos.

The wine is 100% Dolcetto sourced from 2.1 hectares of vines with an average age of 55 years. These old vines are planted at 600 metres above sea level in calcareous soil tending toward sandy, which enhances the wine's floral and mineral notes. To preserve the primary fruit and freshness, the wine is aged exclusively in stainless steel tanks for approximately 6 to 9 months.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and robust fruit profile of this Dolcetto make it a highly versatile gastronomic partner:

  • Antipasti: Ideal with traditional Piedmontese starters like Vitello Tonnato or a selection of cured meats and salumi.

  • Pasta and Risotto: Pairs beautifully with mushroom risottos, lasagna, or pasta dishes served with savory meat ragù.

  • Main Courses: Complements roasted poultry, grilled pork sausages, or light beef dishes.

  • Cheese: Best matched with medium-aged cheeses like Toma or Fontina.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 vintage in the Langhe was generally successful for Dolcetto, benefiting from a growing season that allowed for good sugar concentration and preserved freshness. While this wine is ideal to drink while young and vibrant to capture its "crunchy" fruit characters, its high-altitude origins and old-vine complexity allow it to be cellared and enjoyed for several years after release.

title: Heineken Lager 500 ml - Single Can
bodyHtml:
Heineken Lager is an iconic European pale lager originating from Amsterdam, Netherlands. It is produced by Heineken N.V., a global brewing giant founded in 1864 by Gerard Adriaan Heineken, who purchased the 'De Hooiberg' brewery to create a premium 'gentleman's beer'. For over 150 years, the brand has remained under the guardianship of the Heineken family, maintaining a reputation for quality and innovation, including the development of its signature 'A-yeast' in the late 19th century.

Description

This premium lager presents a bright golden colour and is brewed using only three natural ingredients: water, malted barley, and hops. It features a crisp, clean, and richly satisfying sensory profile with subtle fruity notes derived from the unique A-yeast strain. On the palate, it offers a well-balanced malty sweetness and a mild bitterness, leading to a smooth and refreshing finish. It has an alcohol by volume of 5% and is best served ice-cold, ideally at approximately 5°C.

title: Planteray O.F.T.D. (Old Fashioned Traditional Dark)
bodyHtml:
Planteray O.F.T.D. (Old Fashioned Traditional Dark) is a bold, high proof rum expertly crafted through a collaboration of seven rum aficionados, including cellar master Alexandre Gabriel. As a tribute to the revered Navy rum style, this expression is a robust blend sourced from the West Indies Rum Distillery in Barbados, the Long Pond Distillery in Jamaica, and Demerara Distillers in Guyana. The brand rebranded from 'Plantation' to 'Planteray' in 2024 while maintaining its artisanal production methods and ownership by the French company Maison Ferrand.

Spirit Description

This molasses based overproof rum is produced using both pot and column stills and undergoes a double maturation process: first in tropical climates and then in temperate French oak barrels.

  • Colour: It possesses a deep toffee amber hue, described as dark and sultry.

  • Aroma: The nose is intense and precise, featuring a complex bouquet of orange peel, coffee, plum, and jam, with undertones of smoked wood, truffles, and molasses.

  • Palate: It delivers a burst of caramel cream, dark chocolate, and vanilla fudge, layered with warming notes of cinnamon, nutmeg, raisins, and banana bread.

  • Body: Despite its high proof, it maintains a surprisingly soft, velvety, and creamy mouthfeel with a rich and oily structure.

  • Finish: The finish is long and lingering, characterised by persistent accents of clove, smoky dark chocolate, burnt vanilla, and hot baking spices.

  • ABV: Planteray O.F.T.D. is bottled at a potent 69% (138 proof).

title: Planteray Original Dark Rum
bodyHtml:
Planteray Original Dark Rum is a rich and intense spirit that serves as the evolved identity of the well known Plantation Original Dark Rum. The brand rebranded to Planteray in 2024 to respect the ongoing global conversation regarding the historical connotations of the previous name, while maintaining its 25 year legacy. Produced by Maison Ferrand, this rum is a masterful blend of traditional styles from Barbados and Jamaica.

Description

The rum is defined by a signature double maturation process: it is first aged in its tropical country of origin and then further matured in ex-Ferrand cognac barrels in the continental climate of southwest France.

  • Colour: Clear amber or deep mahogany.

  • Aroma: A vibrant nose featuring tropical fruits like plum, banana, and pineapple, layered with spice, molasses, and a hint of vanilla.

  • Palate: A concentrated and smooth structure highlighting notes of caramel, chocolate, and earthy Jamaican 'funk', with additional spices like cinnamon and clove.

  • Body: Medium to full bodied with a creamy, profound structure that provides significant texture.

  • Finish: A warming and medium-long finish with persistent accents of chocolate cherries and baking spices.

  • ABV: Typically bottled at 40%.

title: Martin Ray Santa Cruz Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
This terroir-driven red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the premier Santa Cruz Mountains AVA in California. Martin Ray was a pivotal figure in California winemaking, modeling his practices after Burgundy and becoming the first American vintner to designate Pinot Noir on his label. The winery's heritage is deeply rooted in these mountains, and the winemaking philosophy for this label emphasizes a "hands-off" approach, utilizing small-lot fermentation and French oak to ensure the rugged mountain character shines through.

Wine Description

Martin Ray Santa Cruz Mountains Pinot Noir presents a vibrant and expressive profile. Sourced primarily from high-altitude sites like the Coast Grade Vineyard situated at 1,100 feet near a limestone quarry the sensory profile features a nose of deep wild cherry, pomegranate, and black raspberry. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "silky," showcasing layers of earthy sage, nutmeg, and a hint of red chili powder. It is characterized by its focused acidity, refined tannins, and a persistent minerality that reflects the complex schist and limestone soils of the region. This 100% Pinot Noir is typically matured in French oak and bottled with minimal intervention. While the winery manages some heritage sites organically, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

93 Points - James Suckling: “Full-bodied and very structured pinot with iron, bark, mushroom and forest f lowers. Tannins flow across the palate. One for the cellar. Try after 2025.”

title: Kilkerran 8 Year Old Single Malt - Cask Strength, Bourbon Cask Matured**
bodyHtml:
Kilkerran 8 Year Old Cask Strength Bourbon Cask Matured is a robust single malt Scotch whisky from the Glengyle Distillery in Campbeltown, Scotland. Produced by the Mitchell's Glengyle Ltd., the brand takes its name from the Gaelic 'Ceann Loch Cille Chiarain', which refers to the original settlement where Campbeltown stands today. The distillery was rebuilt and resumed production in 2004, and this specific 55.8% ABV expression (Batch #8) is part of a limited annual series released to showcase the maturing stocks of the distillery.

Spirit Description

This expression is matured exclusively in hand-selected ex-bourbon casks for eight years and is bottled at a natural cask strength without chill filtration or added colouring.

  • Colour: The spirit presents a natural gold to golden amber appearance.

  • Aroma: The nose is vibrant and floral, featuring sweet notes of vanilla, coconut, and banana, balanced by light peat smoke and a subtle maritime influence.

  • Palate: It offers a creamy mouthfeel with rich flavours of tropical fruits, honey, and panna cotta, contrasted by earthy peat smoke and savoury notes of Iberico ham.

  • Body: The whisky is full-bodied and robust, intensifying the typical Campbeltown characteristics through its high alcohol concentration.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, smooth finish where lingering peat smoke is complemented by notes of digestive biscuit and a hint of sea salt.

  • ABV: This specific release is bottled at 55.8%.

title: Henri de Villamont Gevrey Chambertin 2023
bodyHtml:
Henri de Villamont's Gevrey-Chambertin originates from the esteemed Côte de Nuits region in Burgundy, France. The winery, known for its commitment to tradition and quality, meticulously selects parcels within Gevrey-Chambertin to craft wines that reflect the terroir's unique characteristics.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir wine presents a ruby hue with initial woody notes that gracefully give way to vibrant blackberry aromas. On the palate, it offers an elegant structure, showcasing fine tannins and a harmonious balance between fruit and oak influences. The wine undergoes meticulous vinification, with the harvest being entirely destemmed and matured in barrels for 13 to 14 months, resulting in a refined and sophisticated profile.

Food Pairing

This Gevrey-Chambertin pairs exceptionally well with game dishes such as quail and venison.

title: Yoshi No Gawa Minamo Black Nosan - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Yoshi No Gawa Minamo Black Nousan is an ultra-premium, rare sake originating from the Niigata prefecture of Japan. It is produced by Yoshi No Gawa, the oldest brewery in Niigata, founded in 1548. Currently managed by the 20th generation of the Kawakami family, the brewery is celebrated for its 'Minamo' (water's surface) series, which utilizes legendary local rice and subterranean water from the Shinano River to create a profile that reflects the lush agricultural landscape of the region.

Description

This sake is a highly refined expression that presents a clear and elegant sensory profile. It features a sophisticated aromatic bouquet with notes of tropical sweet fruits, including banana and guava, alongside delicate floral hints. On the palate, it offers a clean, fresh texture with gentle acidity and deep umami richness, a characteristic achieved through the brewery's centuries-old 'kimoto' or traditional techniques. The body is remarkably well balanced, leading to a long and incredibly clean finish. It typically has an alcohol by volume of approximately 16%.

Food Pairing

Yoshi No Gawa Minamo Black Nousan is a sophisticated partner for both high end Japanese and contemporary Western dishes. Its rich umami and clean fruitiness pair exceptionally well with premium seafood like fatty tuna (otoro), sea urchin (uni), and butter poached lobster. It also complements rich and creamy textures such as burrata cheese, chicken alfredo, or dishes featuring a white wine cream sauce. For a unique pairing, try it alongside lamb chops or a savory meat sauce pasta to balance its elegant acidity.

title: Mucchietto Primitivo Puglia 2022
bodyHtml:
This bold and sun-drenched red wine originates from the Puglia region in the "heel" of Italy's boot. Mucchietto is a label that celebrates the rustic charm and intensity of Southern Italian viticulture. The winery's philosophy focuses on highlighting the Primitivo grape, enetically identical to Zinfandel, which thrives in Puglia's hot, dry climate and red, iron-rich soils. The name "Mucchietto" (meaning "little heap") often refers to the traditional alberello (bush-vines) pruning method used to protect the grapes from the intense Mediterranean sun.

Wine Description

The Mucchietto Primitivo Puglia presents an intense, deep ruby red colour with violet reflections. The sensory profile is remarkably ripe and "jammy," featuring a powerful nose of blackberry, plum, and Marasca cherry, layered with warm notes of vanilla, cocoa, and sweet tobacco. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and velvety, showcasing soft, rounded tannins and a balanced acidity that masks its significant alcohol content. It is characterized by its warmth and Mediterranean generosity, leading to a long, persistent finish with hints of dried figs and balsamic spices.

title: Bacio Della Luna Valdobbiadene Brut 2020
bodyHtml:
Bacio della Luna Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore is a premium sparkling wine from Italy, specifically from the Veneto region within the prestigious Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore DOCG. Located in Vidor, the heart of the superior prosecco vineyards, the winery has been part of the Schenk Wine Group since 2011. The winery's philosophy, whose name translates to 'kiss of the moon', focuses on 'heroic viticulture' by collaborating with renowned local growers to secure high quality fruit from steep, hand harvested hillsides.

Wine Description

The 2020 Millesimato presents a vibrant lemon green colour with hints of silver and a delicate, persistent mousse. The sensory profile is elegant and fresh, featuring a fragrant bouquet of jasmine flowers, ripe yellow apple, and pear, alongside subtle notes of acacia and wisteria. On the palate, it is round and supple, offering a harmonious balance of white stone fruit flavours and a refined minerality. Composed of 100% Glera, this Prosecco is crafted using the Charmat method with fermentation in temperature controlled stainless steel tanks to preserve its lively freshness. It is best enjoyed within one to two years of release to fully appreciate its youthful fruit character.

title: Champy Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru 2013
bodyHtml:
Champy Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru 2013 is a prestigious red wine from the Côte de Nuits region in Burgundy, France.

The wine is produced by Maison Champy, Burgundy's oldest wine merchant founded in 1720. Sourced from the iconic 51-hectare walled Clos de Vougeot vineyard—the largest Grand Cru in Burgundy—this wine reflects a terroir first identified by Cistercian monks nine centuries ago. The estate manages its parcels with a commitment to traditional Burgundian expertise, emphasizing the exploration of the vineyard's complex mosaic of clay, chalk, and gravel soils.

Wine Description

This 2013 vintage presents a deep ruby colour and a powerful sensory profile. The nose reveals a complex bouquet of blackcurrant and wild red berries, complemented by floral notes of rose and violet alongside woody aromas of mocha and undergrowth. On the palate, the wine is well-structured and full-bodied, offering an elegant texture with powerful tannins and notes of liquorice. It is characterized by its significant length and a balanced, masculine structure typical of this renowned site.

The wine is 100% Pinot Noir, hand-harvested from vines with an average age of approximately 40 years. The vinification process includes a cold pre-fermentation maceration and 10 to 12 months of aging in oak barrels. To preserve the wine's character, Maison Champy typically uses a measured proportion of new oak, often around 30%. The 2013 vintage typically reaches an ABV of 13.5% and possesses a cellaring potential of 15 to 20 years.

Food Pairing

The robust structure of this Grand Cru makes it an excellent partner for rich meat dishes and roasted game, such as duck breast with mushrooms or rib-eye steak. It also pairs effectively with veal served with morels and savory roasted lamb. For a cheese course, it complements full-flavoured options like Epoisses, soft cheeses, or creamy Brillat-Savarin.

title: Ruffino Alauda 2021
bodyHtml:
This red wine is from Italy, specifically from the Toscana IGT region in Tuscany. Ruffino was established in 1877 and has grown into a renowned winery with a rich history of blending traditional and modern techniques. Alauda, first introduced in 2011, represents the pinnacle of the estate's artisanal style and is produced in limited quantities from the Poggio Casciano and Montemasso estates.

Wine Description

The 2021 Ruffino Alauda is an inscrutable, dense red with scarlet highlights. The aroma is sumptuous, featuring ripe red fruits, blackberry jam tart, and Mediterranean botanicals, followed by complex notes of vanilla, toasted cedar, and burnt spices. On the palate, it is full bodied and opulent with embroidered tannins and a rich core of succulent berry fruit, plum, and dark chocolate. The wine exhibits a firm tannin frame and a long, brackish finish with an intriguing umami touch. This blend consists of 47% Cabernet Franc, 41% Merlot, and 12% Colorino. It was aged for 24 months in French barriques followed by four months in stainless steel. The ABV is 15.5%, and the optimal drinking window is between 2026 and 2035.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points.

  • Decanter World Wine Awards - 92 points.

  • Luca Maroni - 97 points.

Food Pairing

This full bodied wine pairs excellently with elegant Italian dishes and hearty, spice rich sauces. Specific recommendations include Bistecca Fiorentina, tortelli with duck sauce, risotto with sausage, and lamb shoulder. It also complements rich aged or peppered cheeses.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Tuscany began with a mild and wet winter, leading into a growing season that is generally considered very high in quality. Early assessments highlight the vintage's precision and consistency, with many producers successfully achieving deep fruit concentration and balanced acidity.

title: Guenoc Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml:
This accessible and terroir-driven red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Guenoc Valley AVA in California’s Lake County. Established in 1981, the Guenoc Valley was the first American Viticultural Area to be granted to a region with just a single winery a distinction it still holds today under the Langtry Estate name. The winery's heritage is deeply tied to the Victorian actress and socialite Lillie Langtry, who purchased the 4,000-acre estate in 1888 to forge her own path in the wine world. The winemaking philosophy focuses on the unique volcanic soils and high-elevation vineyards, which naturally limit vine vigor to concentrate flavors in the fruit.

Wine Description

Guenoc Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep ruby colour with a bold and fruit-forward profile. The sensory profile features expressive aromas of black cherry, blackberry, and red raspberry, layered with sophisticated notes of toasty vanilla, cedar, and a hint of rhubarb-like tartness. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and "supple," showcasing generous flavours of cassis, dark chocolate, and espresso. It is characterized by its rounded tannin structure and a smooth, moderately long finish with whispers of baking spice and caramel. While the estate champions its unique geological history and high-altitude air, this bottling is produced using conventional methods and is not certified organic.

title: Guenoc Pinot Noir
bodyHtml:
This smooth and approachable red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the California region, often sourcing fruit from cool and moderate climate vineyards across the state. Guenoc is a historic label associated with the Langtry Estate, which is famous for being the first single-winery AVA (Guenoc Valley) in the U.S. and for its connection to the Victorian actress Lillie Langtry. The winemaking philosophy for this Pinot Noir is to craft an easy-drinking, fruit-forward style that highlights the varietal's natural elegance without the heavy tannic structure of mountain-grown grapes.

Wine Description

Guenoc Pinot Noir presents a bright ruby red colour with youthful highlights. The sensory profile is highly aromatic, featuring a nose of ripe raspberry, Bing cherry, and fresh strawberry, layered with sophisticated notes of white pepper, soft spices, and delicate rose petals. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium bodied and "alluring," showcasing vibrant flavours of red berries, plum, and cranberry underpinned by a subtle hint of toasty vanilla and "mulled spice" from gentle oak influence. It is characterized by its smooth, supple tannins and a bright acidity that leads to a fresh, silky finish.

title: Checkmate Fool's Mate Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
This complex and multi-layered white wine originates from Canada, specifically from the premier Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. CheckMate Artisanal Winery was founded with the goal of creating world-class Chardonnays that rival the best in Burgundy and Napa. "Fool's Mate" is unique as the winery’s only multi-vineyard Chardonnay, meticulously blended from four distinct estate sites in 2022: Dekleva-Combret (Golden Mile Bench), Sunset (Black Sage Bench), Jagged Rock (Black Sage Bench), and Border Vista (Osoyoos East Bench). The winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the complexity of these diverse terroirs through a mix of wild and inoculated fermentations.

Wine Description

CheckMate Fool's Mate Chardonnay 2022 presents a bright appearance with a sophisticated sensory profile. The nose is "intoxicating," featuring aromas of orchard fruits, citrus, and melon, layered with subtle notes of minerals and a "wet stone" undercurrent. On the palate, the wine is rich and textural, showcasing flavours of pears and apricots mixed with stone fruit and a hint of vanilla. It is characterized by a "tightening" fresh acidity and a long, persistent finish that develops into "early morning bakery notes" such as brioche and toasted nuts. The 2022 blend was matured in a combination of French oak barriques (66%, half of which were new) and larger foudres (34%), resulting in an ABV of approximately 13.6% to 14%. All estate vineyards are certified organic as of 2021.

title: Marques de Murrieta Capellania 2019
bodyHtml:
Marqués de Murrieta Capellanía 2019 is a rare and prestigious single-vineyard white Rioja that is often described as having the "soul of a red wine".

Produced by the historic Marqués de Murrieta estate in Rioja Alta, this wine is made exclusively from the Viura (synonymous with Macabeo) grape variety. The fruit is sourced from the centennial Capellanía vineyard, a 6-hectare plot planted in 1945 at the highest point of the famous Ygay Estate (485 metres altitude). The winery's philosophy for this bottling is to create a white wine with immense structure and longevity, updating the traditional "long-aging" white Rioja style for the modern era.

Wine Description

The 2019 vintage presents a bright yellow hue with a golden sheen. The nose is intense and multifaceted, offering aromas of white nuts (macadamias), star fruit, and green pineapple, layered with complex notes of toasted almond, crystallized honey, and beeswax. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and round, yet driven by a "racy burst" of acidity that provides a linear and vibrant structure. It is characterized by its creamy texture, subtle chalky grip, and a long, saline-inflected finish.

The wine is crafted from 100% Viura grapes picked in early September. The must is fermented in concrete vats and then matured for 23 months in new French oak barrels, followed by another 13 months in concrete to refine its balance and elegance. This vintage notably skipped malolactic fermentation to preserve its lively, zesty acids. It has an ABV of 14%

96 Points - James Suckling: "Steely and floral nose of white nuts like macadamias, meringue, star fruit and a touch of green pineapple. Round and full-bodied but surprisingly bright and lively, with vibrant acidity providing the backbone. Really long and pure, while there is also suppleness and fleshiness. From the five-hectare Capellania vineyard, where most of the vines are over 100 years old. One of the best viuras out there. Lovely now, but you should seriously consider aging this."

title: Chateau Guiraud 2022 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
This luscious and vibrant sweet wine originates from France, specifically within the Sauternes appellation of Bordeaux. Château Guiraud, a Premier Grand Cru Classé in the 1855 classification, has a historic legacy dating back to 1766. The 2022 vintage marks a significant milestone for the estate as the first release under the leadership of Sandrine Garbay, the esteemed former cellar master of Château d'Yquem. The winery's philosophy is deeply committed to biodiversity; it was the first Premier Grand Cru Classé to receive organic certification in 2011, and the 2022 vintage continues this legacy of "bio-organic" viticulture.

Wine Description

Château Guiraud 2022 presents a concentrated golden appearance, often with amber highlights. The sensory profile is intense and layered, featuring an aromatic nose of honeyed pineapples, candied orange rind, and yellow apricot, accented by hints of clove and white pepper. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and "viscous," yet it maintains a remarkable fresh-fruit character and a "nice seam of acidity" that provides lift. Flavours of marmalade, mango, and vanilla bean are slathered in honey, leading to a long, spicy, and racy finish. This blend consists of 65% Sémillon and 35% Sauvignon Blanc, with a residual sugar level of approximately 134 g/L and an ABV of 13.5%. The high proportion of Sauvignon Blanc in this vintage is noted for contributing a particular vibrant energy and redefined precision.

title: Marques de Murrieta Gran Reserva 2016
bodyHtml:
Marqués de Murrieta Gran Reserva 2016 is a definitive example of high-altitude traditional Rioja, produced exclusively from the Ygay Estate in Rioja Alta.

This estate is one of the oldest in Spain, having been founded in 1852 by Luciano de Murrieta. The winery's philosophy centers on a deep respect for its 300-hectare Ygay Estate, where vineyards are situated between 320 and 485 metres in altitude. The Gran Reserva is only produced in exceptional years, representing a meticulous selection of fruit designed for extraordinary longevity. This 2016 vintage marks a milestone for the estate as it was crafted during a period of significant modernization, including the completion of a new gravity-fed winery facility.

Wine Description

The 2016 vintage presents a deep ruby-red hue with garnet highlights. The sensory profile is remarkably complex and focused, offering a layered bouquet of black cherries, plums, black olives, and autumn leaves, alongside refined hints of Earl Grey tea, graphite, and cocoa powder. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and harmonious, exhibiting a "sleek" texture with fine-grained, chalky tannins. It is characterized by its vibrant freshness, savory depth, and a long, fragrant finish featuring nuances of red licorice and dried lavender.

The blend for 2016 consists of 82% Tempranillo, 10% Graciano, and 8% Mazuelo. To achieve its "Gran Reserva" status, the wine underwent a patient maturation process: it was aged for 26 months in 225-liter American oak barrels, followed by an additional three years in the bottle before its commercial release. This wine has an ABV of 14% and possesses the structural integrity to age gracefully through 2036 and beyond.

96 Points – James Suckling: "Aromas of black berries, black olives, black truffles, autumn leaves and earth... Medium-bodied with very fine tannins and a complex and complete finish."

Food Pairing

This Gran Reserva is a classic partner for robust and savory cuisine. It pairs ideally with roasted lamb, braised beef short ribs, and feathered game. The wine’s bright acidity and integrated tannins also make it a superb match for refined Iberian charcuterie and aged hard cheeses like sharp cheddar or Manchego.

Vintage Quality

The 2016 vintage in Rioja is regarded as a "finesse-driven" year due to cooler growing conditions compared to the preceding 2015. While the season produced a larger crop, the grapes for the Gran Reserva were harvested in mid-October at optimal phenolic ripeness. This resulted in wines with higher aromatic precision and a more elegant, subtle character, widely considered by critics as a vintage that favors balance and longevity over raw power

title: Jayson Cabernet Sauvignon By Pahlmeyer 2022
bodyHtml:
This luxurious and expressive red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the premier Napa Valley region in California. Jayson is the "approachable" second label from the iconic Pahlmeyer estate, designed to offer the same pedigree and intensity as the flagship wines but with a more supple texture for earlier enjoyment. The winemaking philosophy, led by Katie Vogt, focuses on a meticulous "mountain-meets-valley" blend: utilizing concentrated fruit from high-elevation sites like Atlas Peak for structural grip and blending it with plush, round fruit from the Rutherford valley floor for a "seamless" and opulent mouthfeel.

Wine Description

Jayson Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep ruby hue and a sophisticated sensory profile.
