The nose is aromatic and layered, featuring raspberry compote, red licorice, and warm caramel, underscored by savory hints of black pepper and sage. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and "lush," showcasing rich flavours of ripe red and black fruits that merge into lingering notes of vanilla and dark chocolate. It is characterized by its "firm yet melting" tannins and a silky texture that provides a vibrant energy and driving tension.

title: Don Fulano Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Don Fulano Reposado is a premium tequila produced in Mexico, originating from the Highland region of Los Altos in Jalisco. It is crafted by the Fonseca family, whose heritage in agave cultivation dates back 140 years. The spirit is distilled at 'La Tequileña' (NOM 1146) in Tequila town, one of the most highly rated distilleries in the industry. Under the direction of Master Distiller Enrique Fonseca and Sergio Mendoza, the brand utilizes estate-grown agave and remains family-owned and operated.

2. Spirit Description

This reposado is aged for eight to eleven months in used French oak wine casks, creating a marriage between mature highland agave and refined wood influences.

  • Colour: The tequila presents a light caramel or straw yellow hue with reddish flashes.

  • Aroma: The nose opens with French oak, vanilla bean, dark chocolate, and baking spices such as nutmeg and cinnamon, balanced by delicate herbal notes, grass, and lime zest.

  • Palate: It is round and smooth on the entry, featuring notes of coconut, macadamia, and brown butter. The mid-palate reveals sweet prune, cooked agave, and mature fruit compote.

  • Body: The spirit is known for a buttery, rounded texture that is simultaneously delicate and ethereal.

  • Finish: It concludes with a rich and buttery finish where the cooked agave fully expresses itself, trailing off slowly with hints of dark chocolate and herbal sweetness.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at 40%.

title: Delamain Pale & Dry XO Cognac - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
This iconic and exceptionally elegant spirit originates from France, specifically from the Grande Champagne region, the premier cru of Cognac. First created in 1920 by Jacques and Robert Delamain, Pale & Dry XO is the flagship of the House of Delamain, one of the oldest family-run houses in the region. The winery's philosophy is unique: they only produce XO-level spirits and above, using exclusively Grande Champagne fruit. The "Pale & Dry" name refers to its naturally light color and the absence of added sugar or caramel, showcasing a commitment to purity and the true character of the terroir.

Spirit Description

Delamain Pale & Dry XO presents a pale amber-gold appearance, a result of long aging in "seasoned" old Limousin oak barrels that impart less wood tannin and color than new casks. The sensory profile is powerful yet remarkably delicate, featuring an aromatic nose of apricot, citrus, and vanilla, layered with sophisticated floral notes of jasmine, lilac, and a hint of ginger. On the palate, the spirit is silky and "light," showcasing a progression of ripe fruit and nuts (almond and hazelnut) underpinned by a distinct, powdery dryness. It is characterized by its remarkable balance and a long, elegant finish with whispers of licorice and orange marmalade. This XO is aged significantly longer than the legal minimum, typically between 20 to 25 years, and is reduced to a precise 42% ABV.

Serving & Pairing

To fully appreciate its "finesse," this Cognac is best enjoyed neat at room temperature in a tulip-shaped glass, which concentrates its delicate floral bouquet. It is a quintessential "contemplative" spirit that pairs perfectly with a piece of high-quality dark chocolate or a fine cigar. Its dry and aromatic profile also makes it a surprising but excellent companion for savory appetizers like foie gras, aged Parmesan, or even Roquefort cheese. For a more modern approach, it can be served with salted nuts or dried fruits like figs to highlight its natural fruitiness.

title: Driftwood Fat Tug 473 ml - 4 Cans
bodyHtml:
Fat Tug IPA is a heavyweight champion of the Pacific Northwest and the legendary flagship of Victoria’s Driftwood Brewing. Often cited as one of the best IPAs in Canada, it has won more gold medals than almost any other domestic craft beer. It is the definitive Northwest-style IPA: a high-octane, uncompromising brew that balances a massive hop profile with a sturdy malt backbone. It is designed for the "hop aficionado," offering an intense, multi-layered experience that has made it a benchmark for the style across the country.

Beer Description

Fat Tug pours a slightly hazy, deep golden-orange with a thick, creamy white head and exceptional "lacing"—the sticky foam rings that cling to the glass as you drink.

Aroma: The nose is an absolute powerhouse of Pacific Northwest aromatics. It leads with dominant notes of pungent pine resin and grapefruit peel, followed by an exotic medley of mango, melon, and passion fruit. There is a subtle, biscuity sweetness from the malt that provides a necessary counterpoint to the aggressive hop scent.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-to-full bodied with a firm, resinous mouthfeel. It leads with a brief flash of caramel sweetness and tropical fruit, which is rapidly overtaken by an intense, assertive bitterness. Flavors of tangerine and spruce dominate the mid-palate, leading to a long, dry, and lingering bitter finish that is the hallmark of the style.

Profile: It sits at a robust 7.0% ABV and a staggering 80+ IBU, delivering a profound "bite" that remains surprisingly balanced.

Technical Notes: The complexity of Fat Tug is achieved through a diverse hop bill featuring Cascade, Columbus, Centennial, Amarillo, and Citra. These are layered over a base of Pilsner, Crystal, and Carapils malts. The brewery utilizes heavy kettle additions for that famous bitterness and significant dry-hopping to capture the volatile tropical oils. Despite its high IBU, the "slick" mouthfeel and malt support prevent it from feeling thin or overly astringent.

title: Delamotte Blanc De Blancs
bodyHtml:
This elegant and mineral-driven Champagne originates from France, specifically from the legendary Côte des Blancs subregion. Founded in 1760, Delamotte is one of the five oldest houses in Champagne and is the "sister house" to the prestigious Salon; in years when Salon does not declare a vintage, its prized fruit is often declassified into Delamotte’s blends. The winemaking philosophy centers on "absolute purity," using only Grand Cru Chardonnay from the villages of Le Mesnil-sur-Oger, Avize, and Oger. To preserve its fresh, chalky character, the wine is fermented entirely in stainless steel tanks, avoiding oak to let the terroir shine.

Wine Description

Delamotte Blanc de Blancs NV presents a pale gold colour with a fine, persistent mousse. The sensory profile is high-toned and "racy," featuring an aromatic nose of citrus zest, green apple, and white flowers, layered with sophisticated notes of freshly baked bread, brioche, and flinty minerals. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied showcasing a fleshy core of fruit; lemon and pear underpinned by a sharp, saline acidity. It is characterized by its remarkable "chalky" texture, a result of the vines growing in pure limestone soil and an extended maturation on the lees for four to five years. This 100% Chardonnay typically reaches an ABV of 12% with a modest dosage (around 7 g/L) to maintain its dry, "incisive" finish.

title: Cavicchioli Tre Medaglie Lambrusco Semi Sweet
bodyHtml:
This deep and "enveloping" sparkling red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Grasparossa di Castelvetro DOC subregion in the province of Modena, Emilia-Romagna. The Tre Medaglie (Three Medals) line is the house’s most faithful and representative testimony to the family’s winemaking tradition, which began in 1928. The Grasparossa grape is naturally the most structured and tannic of the Lambrusco family; in this "Amabile" (semi-sweet) style, it is crafted to balance that inherent power with a lush, approachable sweetness.

Wine Description

Cavicchioli Tre Medaglie Lambrusco Grasparossa Amabile presents an intense ruby red colour with a thick, violet-tinted mousse. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and "vinous," featuring an inviting nose of black cherry (specifically Vignola cherry), raspberry, and small black fruits, layered with delicate floral notes. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and "polposo" (pulpy), showcasing rich flavours of blackberry, blackcurrant, and pomegranate. It is characterized by its pronounced sweetness, measured at 47 g/L residual sugar, which is expertly balanced by a fresh acidity and a subtle, elegantly tannic finish. This wine typically reaches a light ABV of 8%.

title: Angel's Envy Port Finished - 2026 Cask Strength
bodyHtml:
The Angel's Envy 2026 Cask Strength Bourbon (15th Edition) is a premium, limited-release Kentucky Straight Bourbon produced in Louisville, Kentucky. Marking a significant shift in the distillery's tradition, the 2026 release was moved from its usual autumn debut to a springtime launch on April 17, 2026, to align with the Kentucky Derby season. Under the direction of Master Distiller Owen Martin, this edition moves away from a standard age statement to focus on a Solera-inspired process, where portions of previous years' cask-strength releases are blended with newer distillate to create a continuous 'evolution' of flavour.

Spirit Description

The 2026 edition is a complex blend of bourbons distilled between 2014 and 2019, including 'mother liquid' from the 2023, 2024, and 2025 releases. Approximately 37% of the total blend consists of these re-casked prior releases, which were double-matured for up to 3.5 years in hand-selected Ruby Port barrels.

  • Colour: Rich amber with ruby reflections.

  • Aroma: Opens with evocative notes of cherry cordial, strawberry cheesecake, and salted caramel, transitioning into spiced oak, vanilla crème, and toasted nuts.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and velvety, featuring layers of apple cider, red wine, and creamy chocolate ganache, underscored by nutmeg, barrel spice, and gingerbread.

  • Body: Robust and viscous with a pronounced mid-palate that balances decadent fruit with structured oak tannins.

  • Finish: Long and elegant, carrying notes of citrus preserves, jammy dark chocolate, and blackberry jam, with a pleasantly dry and tannic exit.

  • ABV: Bottled at 58.9% (117.8 proof).

title: Protea Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml:
Protea Chardonnay is a vibrant and accessible white wine produced by Anthonij Rupert Wyne in the Western Cape of South Africa.

The Protea range is named after South Africa's national flower and is celebrated for its distinctive bespoke bottle patterns, designed to be upcycled and repurposed as decorative pieces or water carafes. The winery follows a philosophy of sustainability and accessibility, sourcing fruit from diverse regions such as Robertson, Paarl, Wellington, and Swartland to ensure a consistent, fruit-forward style that reflects the natural character of the Cape.

Wine Description

The 2025 vintage is characterized by its youthful energy and "perky" refreshment. It presents a bright pale straw color with subtle green tints. On the nose, it offers inviting aromas of orange blossom and citrus, accompanied by crisp green apple, ripe pear, and a light touch of white peach and melon. The palate is light-to-medium-bodied and vivacious, featuring a "juicy tang" of orange and nectarine flavors balanced by a lively acidity. It is noted for its clean, modern style that prioritizes fruit purity and drinkability over heavy oak influence.

The wine is 100% Chardonnay and typically features an ABV of 13%. The 2025 vintage benefited from favorable climatic conditions and good rainfall during the growing season, leading to a spread-out ripening period and healthy fruit with clear varietal expression.

title: The Speyside Distillery (Master of Malt) Single Malt 8 Year Old 2014
bodyHtml:
The Speyside Distillery 8 Year Old 2014 is a single malt Scotch whisky from Scotland, specifically crafted at the Speyside Distillery located near Kingussie in the Speyside region. While the distillery was founded in 1956, production only commenced in 1990 under the vision of George Christie. Since 2012, the distillery has been under the ownership of Harvey's of Edinburgh, led by CEO John Harvey McDonough, whose family heritage in the whisky industry dates back to the 1770s. The distillery is known for its artisanal scale, utilizing traditional methods and soft water from the nearby River Tromie to produce a spirit noted for its sweet and approachable character.

Whisky Description

This 8 year old expression typically presents a light golden or white wine colour. The nose is sweet and zesty, featuring aromas of lemon curd, floral honeysuckle, and buttered shortbread, followed by soft caramel and vanilla pod. On the palate, it offers elegant layers of custard cream biscuits and white chocolate with hazelnuts, joined by hints of honeyed fig and vanilla tablet. The body is described as malty and fruity with a perfect strength that balances its youthful vibrancy. It concludes with a medium finish of gentle spice, creamy oak, and biscuity malt, leaving lingering notes of fresh orchard fruits and milky tea.

title: Glen Elgin (Master of Malt) Single Malt 16 Year Old 2009
bodyHtml:
Glen Elgin 16 Year Old is a single malt Scotch whisky from the Speyside region of Scotland, specifically hailing from the often-overlooked Glen Elgin distillery near the town of Elgin. Established in 1898 and designed by the famous distillery architect Charles Doig, the distillery is currently owned by Diageo. Glen Elgin is celebrated for its traditional winemaking-style attention to detail, utilizing long fermentations and slow distillation to produce a distinctively lush, fruity character that has long been a core component of White Horse blends.

Whisky Description

This 16 year old expression, independently bottled by Master of Malt, presents a rich and balanced sensory profile resulting from its maturation in a refill hogshead. The nose offers a sweet welcome of toffee pennies, warm caramel, and buttery shortbread, evolving into notes of creamy oak and green banana. On the palate, the whisky is soft and supple, featuring luscious layers of fudge, grilled pineapple, and a gentle ginger warmth, alongside hints of chocolate-dipped berries and condensed milk. The body is characteristically fruity and waxy, leading to a finish marked by cherry chocolate, butterscotch, and a lingering, characterful spice. Bottled at 51% ABV without chill filtration or added colour, it maintains the distillery's signature honeyed and citrus-forward style.

title: A Secret Islay Distillery (Master of Malt) Single Malt 31 Year Old 1990
bodyHtml:
A Secret Islay Distillery 31 Year Old 1990 is a rare, single cask single malt Scotch whisky from the Islay region of Scotland. Distilled in November 1990 at an undisclosed distillery—often speculated by enthusiasts to be one of the island's 'peated beasts' like Laphroaig—it was matured for over three decades before being bottled in 2022. This expression is part of the Master of Malt exclusive Single Cask collection, highlighting the independent bottler's philosophy of sourcing exceptional, well-aged spirits that showcase the unique coastal and smoky identity of Islay.

Whisky Description

This deeply aged whisky presents a rich, polished mahogany or dark amber hue, resulting from its significant time in wood. The nose is complex and layered, opening with sooty smoke, burnt biscuits, and earthy roasted coffee, which give way to sweeter notes of sticky toffee, dates, and candied bacon. On the palate, the body is dense and unctuous, featuring an intense 'Isla' welcome of pungent peat smoke, oily tar, and salted caramel. These robust elements are balanced by sophisticated flavors of balsamic poached fruits, dark chocolate raisins, and leathery old oak. The finish is remarkably long and drying, characterized by lingering notes of ashen charcoal, cigar box spice, and a final wave of coastal salinity.

title: Bruichladdich Octomore 16.2 Super Heavily Peated Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Bruichladdich Octomore 16.2 is a super-heavily peated single malt Scotch whisky from Islay, Scotland. Distilled at the Bruichladdich Distillery, which was revived in 2001 and is now owned by Rémy Cointreau, this expression is part of the experimental 'Octomore' series known for pushing the boundaries of peat levels. The distillery’s philosophy, often described as 'The Impossible Equation', focuses on the interplay between extreme phenol levels, youthful maturation, and complex cask management to achieve a surprising and elegant balance.

Whisky Description

This expression presents an antique copper or old copper hue. The nose is a complex bouquet of soft dried fruits and sunbaked tropical fruits intertwined with Octomore’s signature sweet campfire smoke. Delicate floral notes of honeysuckle and orange blossom emerge alongside toasted oak, roasted nuts, and a fresh maritime breeze. On the palate, the whisky is rich and sweet, featuring layers of caramelized sugar, fudge, and crème brûlée followed by candied peel and warming spices. The underlying peat, measured at 101.4 PPM, adds significant depth without overpowering the nuanced sweetness. It is bottled at a cask strength of 58.1% ABV and matured in a sophisticated combination of Oloroso and Bordeaux casks before being finished in Madeira and Portuguese Moscatel casks. The finish is long, sweet, and smoky, concluding with crisp sea salt and lingering wood spices.

title: Bruichladdich Octomore 16.1 Super Heavily Peated Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Bruichladdich Octomore 16.1 is a super heavily peated single malt Scotch whisky produced at the Bruichladdich Distillery on the island of Islay, Scotland. As the 'reference point' for the 16th edition of this experimental series, it represents the backbone of the collection, designed to showcase the pure character of the heavily peated spirit. The distillery, currently owned by Rémy Cointreau, follows a philosophy of 'The Impossible Equation', focusing on the complex interplay between terroir, extreme phenol levels, and artisanal distillation entirely on Islay.

Whisky Description

This expression features a bright 'spun gold' or honey hue, maintained without chill filtration or added colouring. The nose is an intriguing blend of sea spray, orchard fruits, and dried heather, layered over Octomore’s signature delicate yet immediate peat smoke. On the palate, it reveals a robust yet nuanced profile of salted caramel, honeyed melon, and apricot, which intermingle with sweet malt sugars and earthy minerality. The body is rich and textured at 59.3% ABV, featuring a malted barley phenol level of 101.4 PPM. It concludes with a long, satisfying finish of black pepper, toffee, and lingering campfire smoke.

title: Kilkerran 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Produced at the Glengyle Distillery in Campbeltown, on the west coast of Scotland. Originally founded in 1872, the distillery lay dormant for nearly 80 years until it was revived in 2004 by J & A Mitchell, owners of the renowned Springbank distillery. The name 'Kilkerran' is derived from the Gaelic 'Ceann Loch Cille Chiarain', referring to the original settlement where Campbeltown stands today. The distillery follows a hands-on winemaking—or rather, distilling—philosophy, eschewing computers in favour of traditional methods like long fermentations in wooden washbacks to produce a spirit with high ester content and a complex, oily character.

Whisky Description

This lightly peated single malt (approximately 15ppm) displays a deep gold to light amber colour and a noticeably rich, oily texture. On the nose, it is bright and zesty with initial notes of lemon cheesecake, pear drops, and marzipan, followed by deeper scents of leather, clotted cream, and a gentle waft of campfire smoke. The palate is full-bodied and textured, offering a balanced mix of honeyed sweetness, tart green apples, and spicy clove, alongside a characteristic 'industrial' oily funk and coastal salinity. It consists of a varietal-like blend of 70% ex-bourbon casks and 30% ex-sherry casks, providing a measured depth of red fruit and oak. The finish is medium to long, shifting from sweet butterscotch and pecan pie into a lingering, earthy peat smoke with a light peppery lift.

title: La Rioja Alta Vina Arana Gran Reserva 2017
bodyHtml:
This structured and modern red wine originates from the Ribera del Duero region in Spain. Áster is the dedicated Ribera del Duero estate of the legendary La Rioja Alta, S.A. group, established to apply their century of winemaking expertise to the Tinta del País (Tempranillo) grape. The winery's philosophy for the Crianza is to create a wine that balances the natural power and dark fruit of Ribera del Duero with the elegance and refined oak integration for which the parent company is famous.

Wine Description

The La Rioja Alta Áster Crianza presents an intense black-cherry colour with a bright garnet rim. The sensory profile is complex and well-defined, featuring an aromatic nose of ripe blackcurrants and raspberries, layered with sophisticated notes of clove, roasted coffee beans, and sweet liquorice. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and balanced, showcasing creamy tannins and a refreshing acidity that provides excellent structure. It is characterized by its "Atlantic" freshness a signature of the estate's high-altitude vineyards leading to a long, balsamic finish with hints of dark chocolate and mineral earth.

title: Trolley 5 Turntable Lager - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml: Remember a time before MP3’s, iPods and Spotify? Remember a time before Milkshakes and Hazy beers? Let’s take it back. The DJ hauling crates of vinyl. The Brewmaster using only the four fundamental ingredients to craft their signature beer. This lager is Brewmaster and DJ approved. Some may say there are 1200 reasons to enjoy it!

title: La Rioja Alta Aster Crianza 2019
bodyHtml:
This structured and modern red wine originates from the Ribera del Duero region in Spain. Áster is the dedicated Ribera del Duero estate of the legendary La Rioja Alta, S.A. group, established in the village of Anguix (Burgos) to apply their century of expertise to the Tinta del País (Tempranillo) grape. The winery's philosophy for the Crianza is to balance the natural power and dark fruit of the region with the elegance and refined oak integration for which the parent company is famous.

Wine Description

The La Rioja Alta Áster Crianza 2020 presents a deep crimson colour with a bright garnet rim. The sensory profile is complex and well-defined, featuring an aromatic nose of blackcurrants, blackberries, and ripe plums, layered with sophisticated notes of sweet spices, fine herbs, mocha, and liquorice. On the palate, the wine is powerful and vibrant, showcasing smooth fruit expression with hints of spice and a balanced acidity. It is characterized by the mineral notes of its terroir, leading to a structured and persistent finish. This 100% Tinta del País has an ABV of 14.5% and was aged for 16 months in French oak barrels (75% new), following malolactic fermentation in barrels with weekly lees stirring for two months.

title: Il Polpo Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
This unique and refreshing white wine originates from the Terre di Chieti IGT in the Abruzzo region of Central Italy. Produced by Collecorviano, a winery known for blending modern techniques with traditional roots, "Il Polpo" (The Octopus) is part of a playful series of wines designed to be approachable, food-friendly, and expressive of the Adriatic coast's influence. The winery's philosophy focuses on sustainability and highlighting the purity of the fruit grown in the rolling hills between the Gran Sasso mountains and the sea.

Wine Description

The Collecorviano Il Polpo Pinot Grigio presents a bright, pale straw yellow colour. The sensory profile is vibrant and crisp, featuring an aromatic nose of green apple, honeydew melon, and citrus zest, underpinned by delicate notes of white flowers and a hint of saline minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied and zesty, showcasing a refreshing acidity and a clean, dry finish. It is characterized by its "maritime" freshness a common trait in Abruzzo whites making it incredibly easy to drink. This 100% Pinot Grigio typically has an ABV of 12% to 12.5% and is fermented entirely in stainless steel tanks to preserve its bright primary fruit flavours and racy vitality.

title: Bottega Vinai Pinot Nero 2023
bodyHtml:
This delicate and "Atlantic-style" red wine originates from the Trentino DOC in Northern Italy. Produced by the Cavit group; a leading cooperative in the region the Bottega Vinai (sometimes labeled as Bottega Vinaia) line is their premium "estate-style" selection, focused on highlighting the specific alpine terroir of the Calavino hills. The winery's philosophy leverages the high-altitude, well-ventilated morainal soils at 300 to 450m above sea level to produce a Pinot Nero (Pinot Noir) that prioritizes varietal purity and cool-climate elegance over sheer power.

Wine Description

The Bottega Vinai Pinot Nero presents a classic ruby red colour, which develops subtle brick-red highlights as it matures in the bottle. The sensory profile is notably aromatic and "nuanced," featuring a primary nose of redcurrants, cherries, and wild raspberries, layered with sophisticated notes of almonds, vanilla, and sweet spices. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-light-bodied and "velvety," showcasing soft tannins and a vibrant, balanced acidity that provides a juicy red fruit finish. It is characterized by its savory and slightly earthy undertones, leading to a fresh and harmonious finish. This 100% Pinot Nero was aged for 10 to 12 months in a combination of barriques and larger oak casks to enhance its structural complexity without overwhelming its delicate floral character. It typically has an ABV of 13%.

title: Bottega Vinai Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and aromatic red wine originates from Italy, specifically within the northern region of Trentino and the Trentino DOC subregion. Bottega Vinai is a premium range from the Cavit winery, which was founded in 1957 and operates as a large cooperative of heritage family growers. The winemaking philosophy for this line is centred on a craftsman's approach, where grapes are specially selected from the top 3% of the most suitable vineyard plots and vinified in small batches to express the authentic character of the terroir.

Wine Description

The Bottega Vinai Cabernet Sauvignon presents a very intense ruby red colour. The sensory profile features a powerful nose of woodland fruits, particularly blueberry and blackberry, which are layered with hints of toasted vanilla and spicy notes such as cloves. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and juicy, showcasing a velvety texture and a sensation of fullness due to the presence of substantial soft tannins. It is characterized by perfect harmony and balance, leading to a persistent finish with lingering savory spice. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon typically has an ABV of 13.5%. While the winery employs rigorous vineyard management, this wine is not indicated as organic.

title: Callabriga Douro Rouge 2021
bodyHtml:
This modern and elegant red wine originates from Portugal, specifically within the Douro region and the Douro Superior subregion. Produced by Casa Ferreirinha, the estate pioneered the quality revolution of Douro still wines in 1952 and was the first in the region dedicated to this style rather than Port. The winery's philosophy is rooted in the visionary legacy of Fernando Nicolau de Almeida and Dona Antónia Adelaide Ferreira, focusing on restraining the natural exuberance of the Douro to produce wines with vibrant freshness, beautiful texture, and significant depth.

Wine Description

Callabriga Douro Red presents a deep ruby colour that is almost opaque. The sensory profile features an intense and complex nose of ripe red and black fruits; such as blackberries, cherries, and strawberries layered with floral nuances and sophisticated notes of tobacco, cocoa, pepper, and pine needles. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and 'vibrant', showcasing firm but velvety tannins and a lively acidity. It is characterized by its modern style and structural harmony, leading to a long, elegant finish with lingering spicy and black fruit notes.

title: King's Ginger Liqueur – 500 ml
bodyHtml:
The King's Ginger Liqueur is a historic English spirit produced by Berry Bros. & Rudd, Britain's oldest wine and spirit merchant. It was originally formulated in 1903 at the request of King Edward VII's physician, who sought a 'fortifying beverage' to warm and revivify the monarch during cold morning rides in his horseless carriage. After being exclusive to the Royal Family and aristocracy for over a century, a standardized version was made available to the public in 2011. While production was briefly based in Holland, it was moved back to the United Kingdom in 2020 following a significant relaunch and reformulation.

Spirit Description

The modern iteration of the liqueur blends pot distilled ginger and lemon oil with a single malt Scotch whisky finish.

  • Colour: The spirit presents a rich, golden appearance.

  • Aroma: A pronounced wave of fresh natural ginger leads the bouquet, followed by crystallized ginger sweetness and a faint aura of zesty lemon peel.

  • Palate: The entry is characterized by a ginger syrup sweetness that gives way to a mellow, rounded mid palate featuring honey notes and a tingle of fresh ginger root.

  • Body: It possesses an unexpected weight for its proof, supported by a subtle malty undertone from the Scotch whisky.

  • Finish: The exit is long, spicy, and warming, with lingering ginger heat and a citrus brightness that fades slowly.

  • ABV: The liqueur was reformulated in 2020 to 29.9% ABV, reduced from its previous strength of 41%.

title: Checkmate Fool's Mate Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
This sophisticated and textured white wine originates from Canada, specifically from the premier Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. Established in 2013 by Anthony von Mandl, CheckMate Artisanal Winery was created with the "outrageous dream" of producing world-class Chardonnay and Merlot in the high-altitude, glacial-fed landscapes of the Okanagan. The name "Fool's Mate" refers to the quickest possible checkmate in chess, symbolizing a bold and decisive move; it is the winery’s only multi-vineyard Chardonnay, meticulously blended from five distinct estate sites across the Golden Mile Bench, Black Sage Bench, and Osoyoos East Bench.

Wine Description

CheckMate Fool's Mate Chardonnay 2021 presents a complex and inviting sensory profile. The nose is highly aromatic, featuring notes of brioche, Meyer lemon, orange blossoms, and flint, layered with hints of Asian pear and peach. On the palate, the wine has a rich, "voluptuous" entry with flavours of crème fraîche, nectarine, and freshly baked bread. It is characterized by a "tension" across the mid-palate and a long, marine sea-salt finish that reflects its mineral-driven undercurrent. This wine typically reaches an ABV of 13.6% to 14.3%. To achieve its signature texture, the 2021 vintage was matured for 16 months in a sophisticated mix of French oak barriques (42% to 68% new), large foudres, and concrete eggs. Notably, the estate vineyards achieved organic certification in 2021.

title: Vesselle Saignee Rose Brut – 375 ml
bodyHtml:
This deep and vinous sparkling wine originates from France, specifically within the Champagne region and the Grand Cru subregion of Bouzy in the Montagne de Reims. Jean Vesselle is a traditional 'récoltant-manipulant' (grower) house that has been tilling the chalky soils of Bouzy for nearly 300 years. The winery's philosophy is centred on championing Pinot Noir, and they have been HVE (High Environmental Value) certified since 2019, reflecting a commitment to sustainable viticulture and the elimination of weedkillers in their 15 hectares of vines.

Wine Description

Jean Vesselle Rosé de Saignée Brut presents a striking, deep cherry or ruby pink colour that is achieved through a short maceration process where the must 'bleeds' colour from the skins. The sensory profile is intense and fruity, featuring an aromatic nose of wild raspberries, black cherries, and spiced orange peel, layered with sophisticated notes of rhubarb, red poppy, and wet stones. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and 'frothy', showcasing excellent concentration and a juicy mouthfeel balanced by a lively acidity. It is characterized by its remarkable harmony and silky texture, leading to a long finish with mineral undercurrents and hints of white pepper. This 100% Pinot Noir wine typically has an ABV of 12% and a dosage of approximately 8 to 9 grams per litre. While the estate follows sustainable practices, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Checkmate Little Pawn Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Produced in Canada, this exceptional Chardonnay originates from the Jagged Rock Vineyard nestled on the Black Sage Bench within the Okanagan Valley. Established in 2013 by visionary Anthony von Mandl, Checkmate Artisanal Winery was created with the bold ambition of producing world class wines that showcase the unique glacial terroir of British Columbia. The winemaking philosophy, led by winemaker Spencer Kelly, focuses on small batch production and minimal intervention to allow the natural elegance and mineral driven profile of the fruit to shine through.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a pale straw colour in the glass. The nose is intricate and vibrant, revealing a captivating bouquet of rosewater, peach blossoms, and melon, layered with delicate notes of pear, lemon curd, and a fine hint of struck match reductivity. On the palate, the wine is fresh and elegant, offering a delicious combination of citrus, peach, and lime rind, complemented by nuances of green tea, vanilla, and a distinct mineral salinity. It possesses a full body and a firm, slightly phenolic mouthfeel, leading to a simple, clean, yet remarkably lengthy finish dusted with fennel.

Food Pairing

The wine's rich texture and bright acidity make it an ideal companion for roasted chicken or turkey. It also pairs beautifully with seafood dishes that feature creamy sauces or buttery components to complement its oak integration and stone fruit flavours.

title: Mission Hill Chardonnay Perpetua 2022
bodyHtml:
Mission Hill Chardonnay Perpetua 2022 is a flagship white wine from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. Established in 1981 by proprietor Anthony von Mandl, Mission Hill Family Estate is a pioneer of upscale winemaking in the region and is world-renowned for its architectural landmark bell tower and commitment to international excellence. The winemaking philosophy is rooted in a relentless pursuit of distinctive, terroir-driven expressions that showcase the unique potential of the Okanagan's diverse vineyard sites.

Wine Description

This wine is crafted from historic French Burgundian Dijon clones harvested from four individual blocks at the Border Vista Vineyard in Osoyoos. It presents a bright and elegant sensory profile, opening with aromas of citrus, stone fruit, and a characteristic subtle flint or 'struck match' note. On the palate, it is fresh and nimble, featuring seductive textures and fine lemon acidity that are beautifully integrated with gentle oak influence. The wine was fermented and aged sur lie for 16 months in a combination of French oak barriques, puncheons, and concrete eggs to achieve a harmonious balance of fruit and texture.

title: Borgogno Barolo Chinato – 500 ml
bodyHtml:
This aromatic and historical digestif originates from Italy, specifically within the Piedmont region and the renowned Barolo DOCG area. Giacomo Borgogno e Figli, established in 1761, is one of the oldest and most traditional wineries in the Langhe. The winery's philosophy is deeply rooted in the preservation of local customs, and this Barolo Chinato is produced according to a secret family recipe that has been handed down for generations, utilizing the estate's high quality Barolo as the foundation.

Description

Borgogno Barolo Chinato presents a deep garnet red colour with amber reflections. The sensory profile is exceptionally intense and multifaceted, featuring a dominant nose of cinchona bark (china), cinnamon, and cloves, which are layered with sophisticated notes of mountain herbs, cardamom, and dried orange peel. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and velvety, showcasing a perfect balance between the initial sweetness and the characteristic bitter finish of the medicinal herbs. It is characterized by its remarkable warmth and persistence, leaving a long, aromatic trail of cocoa and spices. This wine is composed of 100% Nebbiolo from the Barolo DOCG, fortified and aromatized with a cold infusion of herbs and spices. It has an ABV of 16.5%. While produced with traditional integrity, it is not certified as organic.

title: Vietti Roero Arneis 2025
bodyHtml:
Vietti Roero Arneis is a benchmark white wine from the Roero hills in Piedmont, Italy.

The Roero region, located across the Tanaro River from Barolo, is the spiritual home of the Arneis grape—a variety that was nearly extinct in the 1960s before being championed by a handful of producers, including the Vietti family. Vietti's philosophy for this wine is to showcase the "little rascal's" (the local translation of Arneis) vibrant and aromatic nature through meticulous winemaking that avoids oak to maintain purity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant pale straw yellow color with lively silvery reflections. The nose is highly aromatic and fresh, offering a complex bouquet of green melon, citrus blossoms, and white-fleshed fruits like pear, accented by hints of almond, chamomile, and wild mint. On the palate, the wine is dry and medium-bodied with a spritely, "crunchy" acidity. It is characterized by its precise minerality, a saline "wet stone" grip, and a lingering finish that balances zesty citrus with subtle herbal notes.

The wine is 100% Arneis, processed with a gentle cold maceration followed by a slow fermentation in stainless steel tanks at low temperatures. To preserve its "sparkle" and freshness, a small amount of natural CO2 is often reabsorbed during fermentation, and the wine is aged on its fine lees without malolactic fermentation.

Food Pairing

This wine's high acidity and aromatic profile make it an exceptionally versatile food partner:

  • Aperitif & Starters: Ideal with light hors d'oeuvres, crudités, and the classic Piedmontese Vitello Tonnato.

  • Seafood: Pairs beautifully with grilled gilthead bream, seared scallops with herbs, or light shrimp risotto with peas and mint.

  • Main Courses: Excellent with simply prepared white meats (veal, pork, chicken), fresh summer pastas with pesto, or sage-stuffed pasta in a brown butter sauce.

  • Cheese: Complements creamy and soft cheeses.

title: Vietti Dolcetto d'Alba 'Tre Vigne' 2023
bodyHtml:
Vietti Dolcetto d'Alba "Tre Vigne" 2023 is a quintessential expression of one of Piedmont's most beloved everyday red wines.

The name "Tre Vigne" (Three Vineyards) refers to the historic practice of sourcing grapes from three specific vineyard sites to achieve a balanced and consistent house style. Vietti, a world-renowned producer based in Castiglione Falletto, is celebrated for its commitment to biodiversity and artisanal craftsmanship. While the estate is famous for its "Crus" of Barolo and Barbaresco, their Dolcetto is treated with similar reverence, representing a "purist" approach that emphasizes the grape’s natural fruitiness and freshness.

Wine Description

The 2023 vintage presents a vibrant purplish-red color with youthful violet hues. The nose is remarkably expressive, featuring a bouquet of dark fruits—blackberry, raspberry, and ripe cherry—accented by subtle floral notes of violet and a hint of mineral wet stone. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "gourmand," offering a juicy fruit core balanced by soft, integrated tannins and a refreshing acidity. It is characterized by its smooth texture and a clean, dry finish that often carries a delicate herbal or almond note.

The wine is 100% Dolcetto, sourced from vines with an average age of 30 years. To preserve its primary fruit character, the wine is typically fermented and aged for approximately six months in stainless steel or cement tanks, avoiding any significant oak influence. This 2023 release has an ABV of 13% and is designed to be enjoyed while young and fresh.

Food Pairing

Dolcetto d'Alba is widely considered one of the most versatile food wines in the world. It pairs exceptionally well with:

  • Antipasti: Cured meats like salami, vitello tonnato, or vegetable-based appetizers.

  • Pasta and Pizza: Classic tomato-based pasta dishes, lasagna, or wood-fired pizzas.

  • White Meats: Roasted chicken with herbs or grilled pork sausages.

  • Regional Specialties: It is a traditional match for dishes featuring Alba's famous truffles or aged mountain cheeses.

title: Vietti Barbera d'Alba 'Trevie' 2023
bodyHtml:
Vietti Barbera d'Alba "Tre Vigne" 2023 is a signature red wine that emphasizes the "everyday elegance" and juicy character of the Barbera grape grown in the heart of the Langhe.

The name "Tre Vigne" (or Trevìe in local dialect) refers to the selection of grapes from three historic vineyard sites: Castiglione Falletto, Monforte d'Alba, and La Morra. Sourced from vines aged between 28 and 43 years, this cuvée is designed to be a more structured and rounded expression compared to its sibling, the Barbera d'Asti Tre Vigne. Vietti’s philosophy for this label is to provide a wine that is both accessible in its youth and capable of short-to-medium-term cellar aging.

Wine Description

The 2023 vintage presents a deep ruby-red color with youthful purple edges. The nose is packed with high-toned aromas of ripe red cherries, violets, and vanilla, layered with darker notes of licorice, cloves, and baking spices. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and plush, featuring a vibrant "crunchy" fruit core. It is characterized by Barbera’s signature bright acidity, which provides lift and tension, balanced by sweet, integrated tannins and a long, fruity finish with hints of mocha and chocolate.

The wine is 100% Barbera grown in limestone and clay-rich soils. Following a two-week fermentation in stainless steel with daily pumping-over to extract color and flavor, the wine undergoes malolactic fermentation. It is aged for approximately one year in a combination of stainless steel tanks, French barriques, and large oak casks to achieve a balanced presence of wood that enhances rather than masks the fruit. The 2023 release has an ABV of 14.5%.

Food Pairing

This wine's high acidity and moderate tannins make it an exceptionally versatile partner for "fatty" or savory foods:

  • Classic Italian: Tomato-based pasta dishes like Amatriciana or Bolognese, lasagna, and wood-fired pizzas.

  • Meats: Grilled red meats, roasted pork, breaded veal, and traditional Piedmontese game dishes.

  • Casual Fare: Cured meats (salumi), rich salads, and hearty vegetable stews or bean soups.

  • Cheese: Best with medium-aged cheeses like Fontina, Taleggio, or Pecorino.

title: Poggio Landi Brunello di Montalcino 2019
bodyHtml:
Poggio Landi Brunello di Montalcino is a distinguished red wine from the Montalcino region in Tuscany, Italy.

The estate comprises 75 hectares of vineyards situated at various altitudes—ranging from 175 to 500 metres above sea level—and featuring diverse soil types. This geographical diversity is central to the winery's philosophy, as it allows for the blending of fruit with different characteristics to achieve a balanced and complex final wine. Owned by Alejandro Bulgheroni and managed under the guidance of oenologist Alberto Antonini, the estate emphasizes a low-intervention approach, utilizing natural yeasts and large neutral oak to allow the Sangiovese grape to express its true varietal character.

Wine Description

This wine presents a classic ruby red colour. The aromatic profile is intense and refined, featuring scents of ripe red fruit, black cherry, and blackberries, layered with complex notes of black pepper, liquorice, and tobacco. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and elegant, offering a persistent freshness and a dense, concentrated fruit core. It is characterized by ripe, well-integrated tannins and a long, savory finish that reflects its traditional aging process.

The wine is 100% Sangiovese, hand-harvested from organically grown vines. Following fermentation with indigenous yeasts in stainless steel, the wine was aged for 38 months in large untoasted French oak barrels, followed by a minimum of six months in the bottle. This 2017 release has an ABV of 14.5% and is certified organic.

Food Pairing

The structured tannins and savory acidity of this Brunello make it an excellent partner for rich, traditional Tuscan cuisine. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled red meats, such as a Bistecca alla Fiorentina, and roasted game like wild boar or venison. It also complements hearty pasta dishes with meat ragù, mushroom-based risottos, and aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano or seasoned Parmesan.

title: Dievole Gran Selezione Vigna Sessina 2019
bodyHtml:
Dievole Gran Selezione Vigna Sessina 2019 is a prestigious red wine from the Castelnuovo Berardenga subregion of Chianti Classico in Tuscany, Italy.

The estate's name, which literally translates to 'God wills it,' has symbolized a deep connection between man and nature in this corner of Tuscany for over nine centuries. Dievole operates with a philosophy focused on authenticity, biodiversity, and the unmistakable expression of terroir, currently under the oenological direction of Alberto Antonini. The Vigna Sessina is a specific 'cru' site characterized by an abundance of stones and low-growth vines, which are cultivated sustainably to produce a lush and expressive wine.

Wine Description

This 2019 vintage presents an intense ruby red colour with subtle garnet highlights. The aromatic profile is polished and complex, featuring distinct notes of ripe strawberry, cherry, and dried violet, complemented by spiced fragrances of cloves, mocha, and chocolate orange. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and elegant, offering a vibrant freshness paired with mature, tight-grained tannins. It is characterized by its energetic and brooding personality, showing great depth and a lengthy, persistent finish.

The wine is composed of 100% Sangiovese, hand-harvested from organically grown grapes. The production process includes fermentation in cement tanks to preserve primary fruit flavours, followed by 17 months of aging in oak barrels before bottling. This Gran Selezione has an ABV of 14% and is certified as an organic product.

Food Pairing

The savory and classic style of this Sangiovese makes it an excellent partner for various meat-centric dishes, particularly lamb. It pairs beautifully with traditional Tuscan recipes such as wild boar ham, venison bresaola, and aged Pecorino cheese. Additionally, it complements 'Gnudi' with ricotta and chard, or more robust mains like roast guinea fowl with potatoes served in a Chianti Classico sauce.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 vintage in Tuscany is regarded as legendary and exceptional, offering wines with legendary balance and character. After a temperate spring, balmy conditions continued through September, allowing for a successful harvest that resulted in Chianti Classico wines noted for their complexity and acidity. Critics highlight 2019 as a vintage worth cellaring, as the wines possess the structural acidity and tannin necessary to age gracefully for many decades.

title: Unsworth Vineyards Rose 2022
bodyHtml:
This elegant and award-winning rosé originates from Canada, specifically within the British Columbia region and the Cowichan Valley subregion on Vancouver Island. Unsworth Vineyards is a family owned estate founded in 2009 by the Turyk family, who were drawn to the area's unique coastal climate. The winery's philosophy is centred on creating wines with a distinct 'sense of place', utilizing sustainable viticulture to highlight the bright acidity and mineral character typical of Vancouver Island's cool-climate terroir.

Wine Description

Unsworth Vineyards Rosé 2022 presents a beautiful, pale wild-salmon pink colour. The sensory profile is delicate and complex, featuring an aromatic nose of wild strawberries, cranberries, and red currants, layered with sophisticated notes of rhubarb, rose petals, and a hint of orange zest. On the palate, the wine is light to medium bodied and 'bone dry', showcasing a crisp texture and a vibrant, mouth-watering acidity. It is characterized by its remarkable freshness and savory mineral backbone, leading to a long, clean finish with lingering notes of tart red fruit. This 100% Pinot Noir wine reached an ABV of 12%. While the estate follows sustainable practices and minimal intervention, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Unsworth Charme De L'ile Sparkling Rose
bodyHtml:
This sparkling Rosé originates from Canada, specifically the Cowichan Valley subregion of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. Founded in 2009 by Tim and Colleen Turyk, Unsworth Vineyards was born from the family's deep-rooted connection to the valley and a vision to create a community destination centered on food and wine. The winery's philosophy emphasizes sustainable stewardship and an 'old-world' approach to cool-climate viticulture, striving to capture the authentic essence of their coastal terroir with elegance and clarity.

Wine Description

The Unsworth Charme de l'Ile Rosé is a vibrant, salmon-hued sparkling wine crafted using the Charmat method to preserve its fresh, fruit-forward character. On the nose, it offers delicate aromas of cranberry, wild strawberry, and rhubarb, accented by subtle notes of cream and yeast from light lees contact. The palate is refreshingly dry and structured, featuring a soft but generous mousse with flavours of red currants, raspberry, and a hint of crisp red apple. Made from 100% Pinot Noir (though some seasonal blends may include a touch of Pinot Gris or Sauvignette), this wine is defined by its brisk coastal acidity and a balanced, chalky finish. It is best enjoyed in its youth to appreciate its lively effervescence and bright fruit profile.

title: Bunnahabhain 12 Year Cask Strength Whisky 2025 Edition- 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Bunnahabhain 12 Year Old Cask Strength is an unpeated single malt Scotch whisky from Islay, Scotland. Established in 1881 near Port Askaig, Bunnahabhain is Islay's most northerly distillery and is currently owned by Distell Group Limited, a subsidiary of Heineken N.V.. The 'Cask Strength' series is an annual limited edition release that provides enthusiasts with an undiluted, non-chill filtered version of the distillery's flagship 12-year-old expression. The 2025 Edition, released late in the previous year, continues the tradition of maturing the spirit in coastal warehouses to integrate the rugged essence of the Islay bay.

Spirit Description

The 2025 Edition was matured in a combination of first-fill, second-fill, and refill Oloroso sherry casks to provide a layered, complex profile rather than overwhelming intensity.

  • Colour: It retains a natural deep gold appearance with no added colouring.

  • Aroma: The nose features golden raisins and apricots balanced by toasted nuts and a light floral note.

  • Palate: It offers a malty sweetness where soft oak and dried fruit intertwine with sultanas, hazelnuts, and gentle spices.

  • Body: The spirit is robust and oily, an unmistakably Bunnahabhain character that allows the unpeated spirit to express itself fully alongside delicate sherry influences.

  • Finish: The exit is defined by oak spice and light tobacco, finished with a gentle touch of sea salt and cocoa powder.

  • ABV: The 2025 Edition is bottled at a cask strength of 56.4%

title: Bottega Sparkling Life Zero White (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
This beverage originates from Italy. It is produced by Bottega S.p.A., a third generation family business located in Bibano, Treviso, approximately 45 km north of Venice. The family has been involved in the wine business since 1635, and the company is currently led by Barbara, Sandro, and Stefano Bottega.

Wine Description

The wine presents a golden and bright appearance in the glass. The aroma is characterized by fresh notes of apple, pear, and citrus. On the palate, it delivers fine bubbles and a refreshing profile that mirrors its fruit forward bouquet. The finish is clean, crisp, and dry. It is designed to evoke the charm and liveliness of traditional sparkling wines while remaining entirely alcohol free. The alcohol by volume is 0.0%.

title: Bottega Sparkling Life Zero Rose (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
This beverage originates from Italy. It is produced by Bottega S.p.A., a family owned winery and distillery located in Bibano di Godega, within the Prosecco region, which has been operated by the Bottega family for three generations. The company is renowned for its commitment to sustainability and its 'Vino dei Poeti' heritage, blending traditional craftsmanship with modern innovation.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant pink colour with fine and persistent bubbles. The aroma is intense and elegant, featuring a bouquet of floral notes such as rose and violet alongside fruity scents of raspberry and wild strawberry. On the palate, it is fresh and delicately sweet, offering a balanced structure with a pleasant acidity that mirrors its berry aromatics. The finish is clean and lingering, characterized by its lightness and complexity. The alcohol by volume is 0.0%.

title: Bottega 'Il Vino dei Poeti' Prosecco Superiore Valdobbiadene Brut
bodyHtml:
This premium sparkling wine originates from Italy, specifically within the Veneto region and the high quality subregion of Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore DOCG. Bottega is a family run winery with a history dating back to the 17th century, though the modern company was formally established in 1977. The winery's philosophy is rooted in sustainability and the 'Il Vino dei Poeti' range celebrates the prestige of the Valdobbiadene hills, where grapes are grown on steep, hand harvested slopes to ensure maximum aromatic concentration.

Wine Description

The Bottega Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore presents a brilliant straw yellow colour with a fine and persistent perlage. The aroma is refined and complex, featuring primary notes of green apple, pear, and citrus fruits, layered with sophisticated floral scents of acacia, wisteria, and lily of the valley. On the palate, the wine is elegant and harmonious, offering a soft mouthfeel in the Extra Dry style or a crisp, mineral driven texture in the Brut expression. It is a light to medium bodied wine with a fresh, balanced finish that echoes the floral and fruity notes found on the nose. This 100% Glera wine typically has an ABV of 11.5%. While Bottega adheres to many eco friendly practices, this specific bottling is not certified as organic.

title: Borgogno Langhe Bompe Barbera 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and vertical red wine originates from Italy, specifically within the northern Piedmont region and the Langhe DOC subregion. Established in 1761, Giacomo Borgogno e Figli is one of the oldest and most historic names in the Langhe, known for supplying wine for the 1861 Italian Unification banquet. The winery's philosophy under the leadership of Andrea Farinetti focuses on a return to traditional methods, including spontaneous fermentations in cement vats and long ageing in large oak casks, while adhering to sustainable practices that earned the estate organic certification starting with the 2019 harvest.

Wine Description

Borgogno Langhe Bompè Barbera presents a ruby red colour with distinct violet nuances. The sensory profile is characterized by an intense concentration of red fruits and berries, layered with important smoky notes derived from its oak ageing. On the palate, the wine is fresh yet full flavoured, showcasing a marked salinity attributed to the white rock and chalky soils of the Bompè vineyard. It is defined by its great clarity, verticality, and juicy acidity. This 100% Barbera wine is sourced from a 9 hectare plot in Madonna di Como at altitudes of 410 to 425 metres. It undergoes fermentation in cement tanks followed by one year of ageing in large, lightly toasted French oak barrels. The wine typically reaches an ABV of approximately 14.5% and is certified organic.

title: Domaine Jean Fery Hautes Cotes de Beaune 'La Come des Amoureuses' 2023
bodyHtml:
Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Beaune 'La Come des Amoureuses' 2023 is a rare, single-parcel white wine from the elevated vineyards connecting the villages of Pernand-Vergelesses and Échevronne in the Côte de Beaune.

Produced by Domaine Jean Féry & Fils, this cuvée is a small-production 'hidden gem', with only 5,468 bottles produced for the 2023 vintage. The estate, led by Jean-Louis Féry since the late 1980s, has deep roots in Burgundy dating back to the 18th century. The winery's philosophy is centred on artisanal, minimal-intervention viticulture, having achieved official organic certification in 2011 and incorporating biodynamic practices guided by the lunar calendar.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay presents a pale, lively yellow colour. The aromatic profile is fresh and complex, featuring notes of green apple, fresh peach, and citrus, underpinned by a subtle toasted background and a dominant flinty or 'wet stone' minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and expressive, offering a refined interplay of creamy citrus and a light chalky grip. It is characterized by its tension, purity, and a long finish that suggests a delicate touch of oak spice.

The 2023 vintage is an assemblage of three distinct high-altitude climates: 'La Petite Heulée' and 'Les Pins' provide tension and depth, while 'Les Larrets' adds structure and finesse. The grapes were hand-harvested and placed in small crates to preserve fruit integrity. Following pneumatic pressing, the juice was fermented with indigenous yeasts and aged for 13 to 18 months in a combination of 228L and 400L French oak barrels (20% new), oak foudres from Stockinger, and ceramic amphorae. This wine has an ABV of 13.3%.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and textured profile of this Hautes Côtes de Beaune make it an excellent gastronimic partner for roast chicken and a variety of poultry dishes. It also pairs elegantly with white fish, dishes served in creamy sauces, and seafood.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Burgundy is recognized for favourable weather conditions that allowed for excellent concentration of the grapes. The season resulted in wines that maintain a high degree of freshness and liveliness, showing great potential for the regional Hautes Côtes de Beaune appellation.

title: Domaine Jean Fery & Fils Savigny les Beaune 'La Cabotte Aimande' 2023
bodyHtml:
Jean Féry Savigny-lès-Beaune 'La Cabotte Aimande' is a complex and mineral white wine produced from the Côte de Beaune region in Burgundy, France.

The wine is crafted by Domaine Jean Féry & Fils, a family-run winery based in Échevronne that has been certified organic by ECOCERT since 2011. The 'La Cabotte Aimande' cuvée is a blend of Chardonnay grapes from two specific parcels, Ez Connardises and Planchots, where the vines average 50 years of age. The winery's philosophy emphasizes precise, plot-by-plot vinification and minimal intervention to preserve the freshness and purity of the fruit.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay displays a pale gold colour with light green reflections. The initial aroma is marked by peony and wet limestone, evolving as it opens to reveal more ripe and fleshy scents of vineyard peach, almond, verbena, acacia, and honey, alongside citrus notes of grapefruit zest. On the palate, the attack is frank and fresh, offering generous fruit—including yellow apple, mandarin, and ripe lemon—supported by a creamy texture and well-integrated oak tones. It is characterized by its superb mineral expression, a hint of spicy complexity, and a long, saline finish.

The grapes are hand-harvested and transported in small crates to avoid damage. The vinification process is highly technical, involving the separate treatment of free-run and press juices. The wine is aged for a total of 14 months, with 10 months in oak barrels (25% new) followed by 4 months in stainless steel vats on fine lees to preserve freshness. The 2022 vintage typically has an ABV of approximately 13%.

Food Pairing

This white Burgundy is tailor-made for gastronomy. It pairs excellently with grilled fish, seafood, and light meat dishes. It also complements various types of goat cheese, creamy mushroom risotto, or roasted poultry.

title: Bouchard Pere et Fils Beaune Premier Cru Les Teurons  2022
bodyHtml:
Bouchard Père et Fils Beaune 1er Cru Les Teurons 2022 is a premier red wine from the heart of the Côte de Beaune in Burgundy, France.

The estate, Bouchard Père et Fils, has been based at the Château de Beaune for over two centuries and manages a prestigious mosaic of terroirs across Burgundy. The winery's philosophy balances tradition with modern innovation, utilizing a custom gravity-flow vat room located five metres underground to ensure the natural handling of fruit and must. This specific wine is a 'Domaine' bottling, meaning it is produced entirely from grapes grown on the house's own 2.4 hectare estate block within the chalky, steep sections of the Les Teurons vineyard.

Wine Description

This 2022 vintage displays a dark purple to garnet colour with a paler core. The nose is extroverted and complex, offering a 'berry explosion' of wild strawberries, black cherries, and ripe plum, accented by enchanting top notes of rose petals, kirsch, liquorice, and incense. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and surprisingly powerful, featuring a super-sleek texture and layers of raspberry compote and dark cherry. It is characterized by its terrific stony minerality, firm but fully ripe tannins, and an elegant, precise finish.

The wine is 100% Pinot Noir, sourced from east-facing vines grown in thin soils over limestone bedrock. To preserve its purity and freshness, the wine is matured in the estate's subterranean barrel cellars, which provide ideal natural conditions for a long maturation process. This 2022 release has an ABV of 15.0% and is crafted from organically grown grapes.

Food Pairing

The refined structure and savory profile of this Pinot Noir make it an ideal companion for game birds such as roasted duck or goose. It also pairs exceptionally well with grilled red meats, lamb with rosemary, and earthy dishes like wild mushroom risotto. For a cheese course, it complements soft and medium-aged French cheeses, including Brie or Epoisses.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in the Côte de Beaune is hailed as an outstanding benchmark, characterized by the warmest and driest conditions on record. Despite the heat, the wines maintained remarkable purity, freshness, and perfectly ripe tannins. Producers reported healthy yields and high-quality fruit, resulting in a balanced vintage that Jasper Morris MW suggests is a year to 'buy broadly' due to the consistent quality across all levels of production.

title: Domaine Jean Fery Gevrey Chambertin 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine Jean Féry Gevrey-Chambertin 2022 is a robust and elegant red wine from the Côte de Nuits region in Burgundy, France.

The wine is produced by Domaine Jean Féry & Fils, a family-run winery based in Échevronne that manages approximately 14 hectares of vineyards across a diverse 'mosaic' of Burgundy climats. The estate has been committed to organic viticulture and holds ECOCERT certification since 2011, reflecting a philosophy of hard work and dedication to the land. Winemaking for the 2022 vintage was overseen by Laurence Danel, utilizing gravity-settling for juice and indigenous yeast fermentation in oak barrels.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir displays an intense and shiny vermilion red colour. The nose is expressive and complex, featuring an ample violet scent alongside aromas of small red berry fruits, ripe plum, and black fruits that are slightly jammy. On the palate, the wine offers a seamless balance between a strong structure and refined elegance, with red and black fruit flavours supported by a 'right amount' of ripe lemon acidity. It is characterized by its silky texture, firm yet fine tannins, and a finish of medium length that showcases its stony mineral origins.

The wine is produced from vines grown in very stony soils that are notably poor in clay, contributing to its complex mouthfeel. Following fermentation, the red wines of the domain are neither fined nor filtered to maintain their natural character. This 2022 release typically has an ABV of 12.5% to 12.6% and is noted for a charming, well-integrated woodiness.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Burgundy is celebrated for its excellent quality and high yields for both red and white wines. The growing season was marked by beautifully healthy grapes with varying degrees of ripeness depending on exposure. The 2022 reds from the Côte de Nuits are particularly noted for their concentrated fruit profiles and silky tannic structures, offering a vintage that is enjoyable after 3 years of cellaring but possesses the depth for further aging.

title: Domaine Jean Fery Vosne Romanee 'Les Cinq Terres' 2022
bodyHtml:
Vosne-Romanée 'Les Cinq Terres' 2022 is a radiant red wine from the prestigious Côte de Nuits region in Burgundy, France.

The wine is produced by Domaine Jean Féry & Fils, a family estate with a four-generation history in Burgundy. The 'Les Cinq Terres' cuvée (translated as 'The Five Lands') is a communal-level wine named for the five distinct parcels within the Vosne-Romanée appellation from which the fruit is sourced. The winery operates with a philosophy of minimal intervention, often employing night-harvesting to preserve the vibrant energy and aromatic purity of the Pinot Noir grapes.

Wine Description

This 2022 vintage presents an intense, pure violet-red colour. The sensory profile is highly elegant, featuring a nose of small red fruits—specifically cherry and red berries—interwoven with warm, piquant notes of pepper and spice. On the palate, the wine captivates with a full, velvety texture and a harmonious blend of floral hints, such as violet, and subtle woody undertones from oak aging. It is characterized by its delectable depth, silky tannins, and a long, refined finish.

The wine is 100% Pinot Noir and was produced using sustainable viticultural practices. To maintain its complex mouthfeel and generous matter, the domain typically uses traditional Burgundian vinification methods. The 2022 release has an ABV of 13%.

Food Pairing

The refined intensity and spice notes of this Vosne-Romanée make it a sophisticated partner for various cuisines. It pairs excellently with roast pigeon or peking duck, where the wine's floral hints complement gamey and smoky flavours. For more adventurous pairings, it can elevate peppery dishes such as dim sum beef tripe. It is also an ideal match for soft, aged cheeses during an intimate evening.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Burgundy is recognized as a year of high concentration and excellent ripeness. Despite the warmth of the season, the red wines of the Côte de Nuits achieved Questionable phenolic maturity with healthy, high-quality grapes. The resulting wines are often noted for their easy extraction of colour and silky tannic structures, providing a balance of power and fresh acidity that makes them suitable for both early enjoyment and long-term cellaring.

title: Domaine Jean Fery Meursault 2023
bodyHtml:
Meursault Domaine Jean Féry 2023 is an exceptional white wine crafted from Chardonnay grapes grown on the iconic argilo-calcaire (clay-limestone) soils of the Côte de Beaune in Burgundy, France.

Domaine Jean Féry & Fils is a family-run estate based in Échevronne, managed by Jean-Louis Féry since 1988. The winery manages approximately 14 hectares of vineyards and has been certified organic by ECOCERT since 2011, reflecting a dedication to sustainable viticulture and minimal intervention. The estate is currently transitioning to the next generation, with Jean-Louis's sons, Frédéric and Laurent, continuing the family's passion for producing honest, terroir-driven Burgundy.

Wine Description

This 2022 vintage displays a light golden colour with a dense, concentrated texture. The aromatic profile is complex and multifaceted, featuring enticing scents of citrus, white flowers, and toasted almond, followed by notes of pear, vanilla, and a slight nutty touch. On the palate, the wine is powerful and well-balanced, associating a creamy, buttery texture with high precision and linear acidity. It is characterized by its chalky minerality, density of expression, and a long, dry finish that remains elegant and refreshing.

The wine is 100% Chardonnay, hand-harvested to ensure fruit integrity. To preserve freshness and avoid oxidation, the grapes are immediately pressed with a pneumatic press upon arrival at the winery. The juice is settled for 24 hours before being fermented in oak barrels—typically with 50% new oak—where it undergoes twice-monthly stirring of the lees (bâtonnage) until the completion of malolactic fermentation. This 2022 release reflects a refined use of wood that frames the wine without overpowering its natural fruit and terroir character.

Food Pairing

The rich and full-bodied nature of this Meursault makes it an ideal companion for high-quality seafood and creamy dishes. It pairs excellently with lobster, crab, or seared scallops served with a brown-butter sauce. It is also a magnificent match for roasted poultry, pork or veal in a mushroom cream sauce, and creamy pastas or mushroom risottos. For a cheese course, it complements soft, mild cheeses such as Brie or Camembert.

title: Domaine Jean Fery Chassagne Montrachet Premier Cru 'Abbaye de Morgeot' 2023
bodyHtml:
Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru 'Abbaye de Morgeot' 2023 is a distinguished white Burgundy from the southern part of the Chassagne-Montrachet appellation in the Côte de Beaune.

The wine is produced by Domaine Jean Féry & Fils, a family-run estate based in Échevronne that manages approximately 14 hectares of vineyards. The estate has been certified organic since 2011, reflecting a winemaking philosophy focused on preserving the love of the terroir through minimal intervention. The 'Abbaye de Morgeot' climat is highly regarded for its clay-limestone soils rich in marl, which historically belonged to the Abbey of Saint-Bénigne in Dijon and are known for producing Chardonnays of remarkable intensity.

Wine Description

This 2023 Premier Cru presents a bright, pale gold appearance with silver reflections. The aromatic profile is complex and layered, featuring intense notes of white flowers—such as acacia and honeysuckle—alongside ripe citrus fruits, fine honey, and a core of ripe stone fruits like peach and pear. On the palate, the wine is ample and powerful, associating a creamy, rich texture with a racy, vibrant acidity. It is characterized by its tension, a profound flinty minerality, and a long, saline finish that persists with flavours of citrus and wet stone.

The wine is 100% Chardonnay, hand-harvested and subjected to a gentle pressing. It is fermented in French oak barrels and aged for 12 to 14 months on fine lees, utilizing approximately 25% to 30% new oak to integrate subtle toasted almond and spice tones. The 2023 release typically reaches an ABV of 13.5% and possesses a structural depth that suggests it will evolve beautifully over the next 8 to 12 years.

Food Pairing

The magnitude and mineral freshness of this wine make it a perfect match for high-quality seafood and poultry. It pairs exquisitely with lobster, fine fish, or Bresse poultry served in a cream sauce with girolle mushrooms. Additionally, it complements freshwater crayfish gratin, pan-fried spicy langoustines, and mature cheeses such as Comté or Beaufort.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Chassagne-Montrachet is described as happy and expressive, benefiting from a growing season that allowed for generous yields and excellent ripeness. While the season was noted for periods of intense heat, the resulting white wines maintain a bright freshness and inviting, super-juicy fruit profiles. This vintage has produced Chardonnays with a balanced volume and impressive concentration, often showcasing a savory, salty finish.

title: Miller Lite 355 - 15 Cans
bodyHtml: Brewed with choice hops, a blend of American-grown barley malts, pure, soft water to deliver the great taste of a true pilsner; it is distinctive due to its thirst-quenching, fresh drinkable flavour, achieved with the use of all-natural ingredients and a proprietary brewing process. A bright golden liquid with a soft white crown of dense bubbles reveals a fresh, fruity, clean nose with hints of sweet caramel. A perfect blend of malt and hops opens the palate to reveal a clean, crisp smooth beer.

title: Champagne Jacquesson Cuvee N749
bodyHtml:
The Jacquesson Cuvée N°748 is the latest release in the acclaimed "700 Series" from one of Champagne's most intellectual and quality-driven houses. Eschewing the traditional Non-Vintage (NV) concept of a consistent "house style," Jacquesson’s 700 Series aims to showcase the unique personality of a specific harvest, bolstered by reserve wines to add depth.

Wine Description

  • Style: Extra Brut (Low dosage of 2 g/L).

  • Sensory Profile: Shimmering golden appearance with a nose of fresh pear, citrus zest, and wild berries, evolving into complex notes of brioche, toasted nuts, and ginger.

  • Palate: Remarkable structure with "High Tension." It is savory and vinous, displaying a chalky minerality and a saline finish that is characteristic of Jacquesson’s unfiltered, cask-aged approach.

  • Technical Detail: Vinified in large oak foudres (tuns) without filtration or fining to preserve the authenticity of the terroir.

title: Benromach 21 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
bodyHtml:
Benromach 21 Years Old originates from the Speyside region of Scotland, specifically the town of Forres in Moray. Founded in 1898, the distillery experienced a turbulent history of closures and changes in ownership until it was acquired by the renowned independent bottler Gordon & MacPhail in 1993. After a meticulous five year restoration, the distillery was officially reopened in 1998 by King Charles III (then Prince of Wales), with the 21 Years Old expression representing the pinnacle of its core range.

Spirit Description

This single malt is matured exclusively in first fill bourbon and sherry casks, resulting in a dark amber appearance and a medium to full body. The aroma is a sophisticated layers of sweet sherry, roasted almonds, and intense red apple, underpinned by subtle notes of ginger, oak, and a suggestion of wood smoke. On the palate, it delivers a smooth and creamy texture with initial notes of honeycomb, toffee, and cracked black pepper, followed by Seville orange, raspberry, and Medjool dates. The finish is long and elegant, characterized by charred oak, roasted chestnuts, and a lingering, soft peat smoke. It is bottled at 43% ABV and features natural colour.

Food Pairing

The complex interplay of fruit, spice, and smoke in this 21-year-old whisky makes it an exceptional companion for rich and savoury dishes. It pairs beautifully with roasted duck or foie gras, where the sherry influence complements the gamey flavours. For a cheese course, it stands up well to mature blue cheeses or aged cheddar. It also serves as a refined accompaniment to decadent desserts such as a rich chocolate torte, gingerbread, or a raspberry tart, which echoes the berry notes found in the spirit.

title: Astral Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Astral Reposado originates from the Tequila Valley in the Jalisco region of Mexico. Produced at the 'La Cofradia' distillery (NOM 1137), the brand was founded by Master Sommelier Richard Betts and is currently owned by Diageo. The distillery is notable for its sustainable practices, including a partnership with Habitat for Humanity Mexico to upcycle leftover agave fibres into adobe bricks for local housing projects.

Spirit Description

This premium reposado is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave and aged for up to nine months in single-use American oak barrels. It maintains a bright, golden appearance with a medium body and a smooth, refined texture. The aroma is a sophisticated blend of cooked agave, toasted oak, and a hint of vanilla. On the palate, it delivers a balanced profile of rich agave sweetness, caramel, and warm spices, followed by subtle notes of butterscotch. The finish is long and warming, marked by a lingering touch of oak and light pepper. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Road 13 Honest John's Washington State Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and fruit-forward rosé originates from British Columbia, Canada. Road 13 Vineyards, located on the Golden Mile Bench in Oliver, is one of the Okanagan’s most celebrated wineries. The "Honest John’s" label is named after John Oliver, the 19th-century BC Premier known for his straightforwardness.

Wine Description

The Road 13 Honest John’s Rosé presents a pale pink color with bright floral aromatics. The sensory profile is fresh and delicate, featuring a nose of candied strawberry, white blossom, and grapefruit. On the palate, the wine is light and juicy, showcasing flavors of watermelon, peaches, and red cherries, balanced by a "sherbet-like" acidity and a crisp, dry finish. It is characterized by its refreshing "Atlantic-style" vitality, leading to a clean and aromatic conclusion. This complex blend is primarily Cabernet Sauvignon (45%) and Merlot (22%), with smaller portions of Cabernet Franc, Syrah, and Grenache. It was aged for six months in stainless steel to maintain its primary fruit intensity. It typically has an ABV of 12.5% to 13%.

title: Rodney Strong Alexander Valley Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and expressive white wine originates from the Alexander Valley in Sonoma County, California. A brand-new "Fumé-style" addition to the estate's portfolio, marking their first Sauvignon Blanc specifically focused on this warmer sub-region. The winery's philosophy for this bottling is to create an elevated, richer expression by utilizing the Sauvignon Musqué clone, which is prized for its intense floral aromatics and tropical fruit profile.

Wine Description

This wine presents a glistening beauty with a vibrant white hue. The sensory profile is exceptionally aromatic and complex, featuring an intense nose of orange blossom, grapefruit, lemon balm, and river stones. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied with a generous, soft texture the result of aging on the lees (sur lie). It showcases juicy flavors of kiwi, yellow peach, and passionfruit, balanced by a striking, Sancerre-like acidity.
