It is characterized by its "California sun" ripeness and mineral complexity, leading to a long finish with subtle notes of sweet almond and vanilla panna cotta. This complex blend is primarily Sauvignon Blanc enhanced with 6% Viognier and Semillon to add volume. It was aged in a combination of stainless steel, 40% French oak, and a unique "sideways concrete egg" tank. It typically has an ABV of 13.5%.

title: Glenmorangie Single Malt "A Tale of Spices"
bodyHtml:
Glenmorangie 'A Tale of Spices' is a limited-edition single malt Scotch whisky produced in the Highland town of Tain, Scotland. Released in late 2025 as the sixth entry in the distillery's annual 'A Tale of...' series, it follows previous themed expressions such as 'A Tale of Tokyo' and 'A Tale of Ice Cream'. The spirit was envisioned by Director of Whisky Creation Dr. Bill Lumsden and Master Blender Gillian Macdonald, who sought to capture the sensory experience of global spice markets. Founded in 1843, Glenmorangie is noted for having the tallest copper stills in Scotland and is currently owned by the luxury group Louis Vuitton Moët Hennessy.

Spirit Description

This non-age-statement whisky features a unique four-cask finish combination never previously utilized at the distillery. After initial maturation in ex-bourbon barrels, the spirit is finished in Moroccan red wine casks (French oak), new charred oak casks, shaved and toasted ex-red wine casks, and Pedro Ximénez sherry casks.

  • Colour: The whisky presents a deep coppery gold.

  • Aroma: The nose is perfumed and sweet, offering floral notes of rose, jasmine, and lilac alongside complex spices like cumin, saffron, nutmeg, and ginger.

  • Palate: It has a viscous, almost waxy mouthfeel that bursts with 'sizzling' spices including black pepper and mustard seed, balanced by demerara sugar, mint toffee, and orange marmalade.

  • Body: The profile is described as uniquely complex, balancing a 'chewy' texture with a distinct eucalyptus lift.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, drying finish characterized by an elegant peppery warmth and lingering oak tannins.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at 46%.

title: Hofbrau Oktoberfestbier - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Hofbräu Oktoberfestbier is the liquid heart of the world’s most famous beer festival. While many North American "Oktoberfest" beers are dark, malty Märzen-style lagers, the beer actually served in the tents of Munich, including the legendary Hofbräuhaus is a Festbier. This style evolved in the late 20th century to be lighter in color and more "drinkable" than its predecessors, allowing festival-goers to enjoy several liters over a long afternoon. It is a premium, bottom-fermented lager that embodies the spirit of Bavarian hospitality: strong, sophisticated, and incredibly smooth.

Beer Description

Hofbräu Oktoberfestbier pours a brilliant, saturated golden-straw color with a thick, frothy, snow-white head that leaves a dense "Brussels lace" on the glass as it recedes.

Aroma: The nose is clean, elegant, and deeply malt-forward. It leads with dominant notes of fresh-baked biscuits and sweet honey, followed by a subtle floral and herbal spicy scent from noble hops. There is a distinct "clean" lager quality, with no fruity esters, smelling purely of premium Bavarian grain and field flowers.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a supple, velvety mouthfeel. It leads with a rich toasted malt sweetness and hints of caramel, which is almost immediately balanced by a crisp, moderate bitterness. The finish is remarkably smooth and dry, with a lingering warmth from the slightly elevated alcohol content and a clean, noble hop snap.

Profile: It sits at a sturdy 6.3% ABV and a moderate bitterness of 26 IBU, making it more substantial than a standard Helles but lighter than a traditional Märzen.

Technical Notes: This beer is brewed according to the Reinheitsgebot (German Purity Law), using only water, malt, hops, and yeast. It utilizes a blend of Munich and Pilsner malts to achieve its deep golden hue and bready backbone. It is fermented with a traditional Bavarian lager yeast and undergoes a long, cold conditioning period to ensure its signature clarity and exceptionally clean flavor profile.

title: Vajra Barolo Bricco Delle Viole 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from the Barolo denomination in the Piedmont region of Italy, specifically from the historic Bricco delle Viole vineyard. Established in the village of Vergne, the Vaira family has been a pioneer of organic viticulture since Aldo Vaira began revitalizing the family farm in the late 1960s. Their winemaking philosophy is guided by patience and a deep respect for the high-altitude terroir, aiming to produce wines that are both graceful and capable of profound ageing.

Wine Description

Bricco delle Viole is a medium to full bodied red wine of exceptional stature and breed. On the nose, it offers an ethereal and beautifully layered bouquet of violets, dark red fruits, and crushed flowers, accented by notes of incense, balsamic, and a hint of eucalyptus. The palate is incisive and rich, revealing flavours of cherry, raspberry, and plum alongside complex savoury edges of leather, liquorice, and ashy stone. It is characterized by polished, fine-meshed tannins and a vibrant, mineral acidity that leads to a long, persistent, and flavourful finish.

Accolades

  • "Wine Advocate - 97 points."

  • "Wine Spectator - 97 points."

  • "James Suckling - 97 points."

  • "Vinous - 96 points."

  • "Decanter - 95 points."

Food Pairing

This Barolo is a perfect companion for roasted meats, herb crusted lamb, or truffle infused dishes. It also pairs beautifully with aged hard cheeses and roasted mushrooms, which complement its earthy and mineral undertones.

title: Baron De Lestac Les Hauts De Lestac 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and approachable red wine originates from the Bordeaux AOP in France. Baron de Lestac is one of the most popular Bordeaux brands globally, known for its consistent quality and traditional winemaking techniques. The "Les Hauts de Lestac" bottling represents a more premium selection within the portfolio, emphasizing the harmony between rich fruit and the influence of oak. The winery's philosophy is centered on making the elegance of a barrel-aged Bordeaux accessible for everyday enjoyment.

Wine Description

The Baron de Lestac Les Hauts de Lestac 2021 presents a clear, deep garnet colour. The sensory profile is classic and well-defined, featuring an aromatic nose of red and black currants, layered with sophisticated notes of vanilla, toasted oak, and a hint of spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and balanced, showcasing supple tannins and a fresh acidity that provides a clean structure. It is characterized by its smooth texture and a lingering finish with subtle notes of tobacco and dark fruit. This traditional Bordeaux blend is primarily composed of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon and has been aged in oak barrels to enhance its complexity and soften its tannins.

title: Comtesse De Malet Roquefort Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
This elegant and refined red wine originates from the Bordeaux AOP in France. It is produced by the Malet Roquefort family, the historic owners of the Premier Grand Cru Classé Château La Gaffelière in Saint-Émilion. The family's philosophy for this "Comtesse" label is to provide a "gateway" to the prestige of their top estates, offering a wine that reflects their centuries of expertise in a more approachable and immediate style.

Wine Description

The Comtesse de Malet Roquefort Rouge presents a brilliant ruby red colour. The sensory profile is remarkably fresh and fruit-forward, featuring an aromatic nose of ripe strawberry, raspberry, and red currant, accented by subtle floral notes and a touch of sweet spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and supple, showcasing velvety tannins and a bright acidity that balances the richness of the fruit. It is characterized by its charm and "drinkability," leading to a clean, fruity finish with a hint of graphite. This traditional Right Bank-style blend is dominated by Merlot (typically around 80%) with a smaller portion of Cabernet Franc, and is fermented in stainless steel to preserve its pure primary fruit character.

title: Chateau Armens 2019
bodyHtml:
This sophisticated red wine originates from the Saint-Émilion Grand Cru appellation on the Right Bank of Bordeaux, France. Produced by the Malet Roquefort family the historic owners of the Premier Grand Cru Classé Château La Gaffelière, Château Armens represents their commitment to making refined, terroir-driven wines accessible. The estate spans 25 hectares of clay-limestone and silty-clay soils, which the winery’s philosophy leverages to produce a "taut and always very fruity" identity.

Wine Description

The Château Armens Saint-Émilion Grand Cru 2019 presents a deep, intense red colour. The sensory profile is rich and aromatic, featuring a primary nose of blackberry, plum, and blackcurrant, layered with sophisticated notes of clove, nutmeg, and licorice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and well-balanced, showcasing a velvety texture with grippy medium tannins and a vibrant, "tummy-warming" fruit core. It is characterized by its elegance and depth, leading to a long, sophisticated finish with subtle hints of mocha, vanilla, and toasted oak from 12 months of aging in French oak barrels. This Merlot-dominant blend typically has an ABV of 14.5% and is currently in its prime maturity phase.

title: Vajra Barolo Coste Di Rose 2022
bodyHtml:
This elegant and ethereal red wine originates from the Comune di Barolo in the Piedmont region of Northern Italy. G.D. Vajra, a benchmark family estate led by Aldo and Milena Vajra alongside their children, is renowned for its traditionalist approach and commitment to organic farming since 1971. Coste di Rose is a unique MGA (single vineyard) situated on a steep, east-facing slope between the famous Cannubi and Bussia hills. The vineyard's defining feature is its high concentration of Arenaria di Diano (sandstone), which produces a lighter-framed, more aromatic Barolo compared to the heavier clay-based sites in the region.

Wine Description

The G.D. Vajra Barolo Coste di Rose (the most current release) presents a clear ruby colour with a bright, translucent rim. The sensory profile is remarkably floral and lifted, featuring an expressive nose of rose petals, wild strawberry, and candied cherry, layered with sophisticated notes of mint, sweet spices, and white pepper. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied but graceful, showcasing "chiseled," silky tannins and a vibrant acidity. It is characterized by its saline, mineral energy, leading to a long, iodine-tinged finish that is a hallmark of its sandstone terroir. This 100% Nebbiolo was aged for 26 months in large Slavonian oak casks to allow the pure fruit character to shine without the heavy influence of new wood.

title: Alexander Keith's India Pale Ale 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml: Brewed without compromise, taste our heritage in this crisp golden ale with distinct drinkability. Subtle spice and herb notes from the hops and yeast come together over a light cereal grain foundation to provide a fresh easy drinking ale.

title: Taylor Fladgate 1976 Single Harvest Port
bodyHtml:
Taylor Fladgate Single Harvest Vintage Port originates from Portugal, specifically from the Douro Valley region. Founded in 1692, Taylor Fladgate is the only British Port house never to have been bought or sold, and it is known for holding one of the largest reserves of long-aged, cask-matured Port of any producer. The winery's philosophy is defined by slow maturation and long-term craftsmanship, with its Single Harvest series—started with the 1964 vintage—only releasing wines from years judged to have reached exceptional maturity and balance.

Wine Description

Taylor Fladgate 1976 Single Harvest Port displays a lustrous copper-amber colour fading to a soft amber rim. The aroma is complex and beautifully perfumed, featuring notes of gingerbread, honeysuckle, Seville orange, marzipan, and soft caramel, underscored by cedary cigar box, wild rosemary, and a hint of fresh mint. On the palate, the wine is deep and refined, delivering flavours of blood orange marmalade, dried figs, rum and raisin, and tropical hints of guava and grilled pineapple. It possesses a luscious body lifted by fresh acidity, concluding with a long, elegant, and harmonious finish.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional blend of native Portuguese grapes such as Touriga Nacional, Tinta Amarela, and Tinto Cão.

  • Stylistic Notes: This Port is aged for half a century in seasoned oak casks, resulting in a wine shaped by decades of slow maturation that combines aromatic complexity with freshness and poise.

  • ABV: 20%.

Food Pairing

The sumptuous and velvety nature of this Single Harvest Port makes it a perfect companion for rich desserts and intense savoury starters.

  • Desserts: Pairs beautifully with dishes featuring figs, almonds, and caramel, such as crème brûlée, honey and almond cake, or apple tart.

  • Savoury & Rich: An excellent match for foie gras with brioche, where the Port's acidity cuts through the richness of the pâté.

  • Cheese: Complements hard, nutty cheeses such as Parmesan and Manchego.

title: Anselmo Bitter Italiano - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Anselmo Bitter Italiano originates from the Piedmont region of Italy, specifically the city of Turin. It is produced by Anselmo Torino, a historic brand with roots dating back to 1854 when Carlo Anselmo first began experimenting with aromatic herbs and Muscat wine. The company remains dedicated to the recovery of ancient family recipes while maintaining the traditional craftsmanship of the 'Piemontese' liqueur heritage.

Description

This spirit is a contemporary interpretation of the classic 'Bitter di Milano' style, featuring a vibrant, clear ruby red appearance. The aroma is a sophisticated combination of herbal, citrus, and spice infusions, with prominent notes of gentian root and aromatic orange peel. On the palate, it is medium bodied and well balanced, offering a complex interplay of sweet and bitter flavours, including hints of rhubarb, cinchona bark, and a subtle floral undertone. The finish is long and refreshing, marked by a lingering bitterness and a touch of zesty citrus. It is bottled at 25% ABV.

Accolades

Anselmo Torino's portfolio is highly regarded for its balance and complexity, continuing a legacy that has been celebrated since the late 19th century. While specific recent competition medals for the 'Bitter Italiano' expression are frequently grouped with the brand's award winning vermouths, the distillery is recognized globally for its 'Historic Recipe' series, which honours over 100 years of authentic Italian liqueur production.

Food Pairing

The intense herbal and bitter profile of this spirit makes it an ideal accompaniment for salty and umami rich appetizers. It pairs exceptionally well with classic Italian antipasti, such as green Castelvetrano olives, aged Pecorino cheese, and thin slices of prosciutto di Parma. For a more substantial pairing, it complements spicy tomato based pasta dishes or grilled seafood seasoned with lemon and mediterranean herbs, where the bitterness helps to cut through richness and heat.

title: Astral Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Astral Blanco originates from the Tequila Valley in Jalisco, Mexico. Founded by Master Sommelier Richard Betts and now owned by Diageo, the brand is produced at the historic 'La Cofradia' distillery (NOM 1137). The distillery is known for its commitment to sustainability, specifically through its partnership with Habitat for Humanity Mexico to upcycle leftover agave fibres into adobe bricks for local housing.

Description

This premium blanco tequila is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave and utilizes traditional production methods, including the use of a 'tahona' wheel and fermenting with 'bagazo' (agave fibres) to enhance its agave forward profile. It presents a clear, bright appearance with a medium body. The aroma is highly expressive, featuring notes of crisp citrus, clover honey, and bright white pepper. On the palate, it offers a smooth yet complex profile with tropical fruit sweetness, vibrant agave, and a characteristic peppery spice. The finish is clean and refreshing with a lingering touch of citrus. It is typically bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

Food Pairing

The bright acidity and citrus notes of this blanco tequila make it an ideal partner for fresh seafood dishes such as ceviche, shrimp tacos with lime, or grilled scallops. It also pairs effectively with zesty appetizers like fresh guacamole or spicy salsa. For a more unique combination, it can be served alongside fresh fruits such as grapes or crisp apples, which complement its floral and honeyed undertones.

title: Lagar De Cervera Albarino 2022
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and expressive white wine originates from the Rías Baixas region in Galicia, Northwest Spain. Lagar de Cervera is a key property of the prestigious La Rioja Alta, S.A. group, which expanded into Galicia specifically to craft world-class Albariño. The winery's philosophy is centered on artisanal precision, utilizing only estate-grown fruit from their vineyards in O Rosal and Cambados to ensure a signature profile of elegance and mineral depth.

Wine Description

The Lagar de Cervera Albariño 2022 presents a brilliant, pale straw yellow colour with greenish reflections. The sensory profile is remarkably aromatic and fresh, featuring a complex nose of white fruit (pear and Golden Delicious apple), layered with sophisticated notes of apricot, lychee, and citrus zest. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "voluminous," showcasing a silky texture and a vibrant, well-integrated acidity. It is characterized by its long, persistent finish that reveals hints of salty minerality and white flowers. This 100% Albariño underwent extended aging on the lees with regular battonage to enhance its creamy mouthfeel and structural complexity.

title: Borgogno Langhe Ancum Dolcetto 2023
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and expressive red wine originates from the Langhe DOC in the Piedmont region of Northern Italy. Giacomo Borgogno & Figli, established in 1761, is one of the oldest and most historic houses in Barolo. The "Ancum" is a specialized "Cru" Dolcetto sourced from a single organic plot in Madonna di Como, an area renowned for producing the region’s most elegant expressions of this grape. The winery's philosophy for this bottling is to create a "sincere" wine that prioritizes high aromatic concentration and mineral purity.

Wine Description

The Borgogno Langhe Ancum Dolcetto 2023 presents a bright ruby red colour with distinct violet hues. The sensory profile is energetic and fresh, featuring an explosive nose of crisp red fruit, specifically wild cherry and strawberry, layered with sophisticated notes of balsamic herbs and white pepper emerging from the fermentation. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "compact," showcasing a refined tannic texture and a refreshing acidity. It is characterized by its savory and mineral sensation, leading to an elegant, dry finish. This 100% organic Dolcetto has an ABV of 13% and was aged for 6 months in concrete tanks followed by 3 months in the bottle to preserve its vibrant primary fruit and "terroir" identity.

title: Berta Distillery Bric del Gaian Grappa di Moscato - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Bric del Gaian is a premium aged grappa produced in Italy, within the Monferrato area of the Piedmont region. It is crafted by Distillerie Berta, a family owned business founded in 1947 by Paolo Berta, whose family history in viticulture dates back to 1866. The spirit is dedicated to 'Mr Galliano', a kind man who once owned the Moscato vineyard adjacent to the Berta farmhouse, a hill locally known as 'Bric del Gaian'. Today, the distillery is managed by the second generation, Enrico and Gianfranco Berta, who maintain artisanal traditions while exporting to over 60 countries.

Description

This vintage grappa is made exclusively from selected Moscato grape pomace sourced from the best producers in typical Piedmontese production zones. It is distilled using a discontinuous copper steam boiler system and aged for at least eight years in various wooden barrels to refine its character.

  • Colour: The spirit presents a fine amber appearance.

  • Aroma: The bouquet is complex and enveloping, featuring notes of clary sage, wild berries, grapefruit, and vanilla, with some vintages displaying floral hints of white roses and apricot.

  • Palate: It offers a rich, silky texture that is both velvety and enveloping on the tongue.

  • Body: The profile is described as compact and dense with an outstanding personality.

  • Finish: The experience concludes with a long lasting and persistent finish that lingers gracefully.

  • ABV: This grappa is typically bottled at 43%.

title: Anselmo Fernet - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Anselmo Fernet originates from the Piedmont region of Italy, specifically from the historic city of Turin. It is produced by Anselmo Torino, a company with a legacy dating back to 1854 when Carlo Anselmo established the brand to showcase traditional subalpine liqueur craftsmanship. The distillery is dedicated to preserving over a century of history, often featuring original 20th-century texts on its labels to honour its founding heritage.

Spirit Description

This spirit is a bold and authentic amaro, presenting a dark, opaque ebony colour with a full body and an oily texture. The aroma is intense and medicinal, dominated by cooling peppermint, myrrh, and a complex array of earthy roots and bitter herbs. On the palate, it delivers a powerful and bracing bitterness balanced by subtle notes of dark chocolate, liquorice, and a distinct herbal spiciness. The finish is exceptionally long and refreshing, leaving a persistent cooling sensation of menthol and deep botanical bitterness. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

Food Pairing

The intense bitterness and herbal complexity of this Fernet make it a classic digestif, best enjoyed after a heavy meal. It pairs exceptionally well with rich, dark chocolate desserts or a bitter chocolate tart, which can stand up to its medicinal profile. For a savoury match, it complements strong, pungent cheeses like Gorgonzola or aged Pecorino. In a more casual setting, it is traditionally paired with a small cup of espresso or used as a 'corretto' to add depth to morning coffee.

title: Banfi Principessa Gavia Gavi 2023
bodyHtml:
This fresh and elegant white wine originates from the Gavi DOCG in the Piedmont region of Northwest Italy. Produced by the renowned Castello Banfi, this bottling is a tribute to local legend: Principessa Gavia, the daughter of a 6th-century Frankish king, who allegedly fled to the village of Gavi to marry her forbidden love. The winery’s philosophy for this label is to showcase the "eminent drinkability" and crisp, mineral character of the Cortese grape, which has been grown in the area since the 11th century.

Wine Description

The Banfi Principessa Gavia Gavi presents a pale yellow colour with delicate green reflections. The sensory profile is light and breezy, featuring an aromatic nose of green apple, melon, and white peach, layered with sophisticated floral notes of jasmine and boxwood. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and sleek, showcasing a "pleasant sapidity" (savory minerality) balanced by juicy acidity. It is characterized by its refreshing and clean fragrance, leading to a dry, harmonious finish with a touch of citrus rind. This 100% Cortese has an ABV of 12.5% and was fermented in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks (16–18°C) to preserve its pure fruit identity and crispness.

title: Banfi La Pettegola Vermentino 2023
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and coastal white wine originates from the Toscana IGT in the Maremma region of Southern Tuscany. Produced by the legendary Castello Banfi, "La Pettegola" (meaning "The Gossip") refers to a small, talkative shorebird found on the Mediterranean coast. The winery's philosophy for this bottling is to capture the "Atlantic" influence of the nearby sea, utilizing the Vermentino grape to create a wine defined by its aromatic intensity and salty freshness.

Wine Description

The Banfi La Pettegola Vermentino presents a brilliant, pale yellow colour. The sensory profile is remarkably expressive, featuring an intense nose of exotic fruits, lemongrass, and yellow peach, layered with sophisticated notes of sage, lemon blossom, and a hint of spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "sleek," showcasing a juicy texture balanced by a vibrant structure and zesty acidity. It is characterized by its crispness and Mediterranean character, leading to a long, persistent finish with a clean mineral edge. This 100% Vermentino was fermented in temperature-controlled stainless steel (13–15°C) followed by three months of aging on the lees to enhance its volume and aromatic complexity.

title: Banfi Fonte alla Selva Gran Selezioni Chianti Classico 2022
bodyHtml:
This distinguished and structured red wine originates from the Castellina in Chianti sub-zone of the Chianti Classico DOCG in Tuscany. Fonte alla Selva is a specific estate owned by Castello Banfi, where the winery's philosophy focuses on highlighting the elegance of Sangiovese grown in shallow, sandy-clay soils. The "Gran Selezione" designation represents the highest tier of the Chianti Classico quality pyramid, requiring the wine to be produced exclusively from estate-grown grapes and aged for a minimum of 30 months before release.

Wine Description

The Banfi Fonte alla Selva Gran Selezione presents a deep ruby red colour with mauve undertones. The sensory profile is "composed and balanced," featuring an aromatic nose of red berries, spiced cherries, and plums, layered with sophisticated notes of dried herbs, bark, and dried mushrooms. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and lively, showcasing fine, well-integrated tannins and a distinct acidity that provides excellent structure. It is characterized by its "attractive and well-built" texture, leading to a long, focused, and flavorful finish marked by a sweet spiciness.

title: Giffard Apricot Du Roussillon – 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Giffard Abricot du Roussillon is a premium fruit liqueur produced in France, specifically within the Loire Valley. The spirit is crafted by Giffard, an independent family distillery founded in 1885 by Emile Giffard, a pharmacist from Angers who first gained renown for his Menthe Pastille. Five generations later, the company remains family owned and operated, continuing its tradition of macerating high quality local fruits and botanicals. This particular expression features the 'Rouges du Roussillon' apricot variety, sourced from orchards not far from the Giffard facility.

Description

The liqueur is produced through the slow maceration of the firm, sweet, and aromatic pink flesh and skin of Roussillon apricots in neutral spirit.

  • Colour: It presents a brilliant golden yellow with fine orange shades.

  • Aroma: The bouquet reveals itself in stages, starting with the sweetness of very ripe apricot, followed by a slight vegetal touch, and finishing with sweet spices like vanilla and caramel.

  • Palate: The taste is exceptionally round, smooth, and sweet, reminiscent of caramelized apricot compote.

  • Body: It offers a rich, juicy mouthfeel with a natural, true to fruit balance of tartness and jammy intensity.

  • Finish: The exit is clean and mouth watering, carrying persistent notes of almond and stewed fruit.

  • ABV: This liqueur is bottled at 25%.

title: Anselmo Vermouth Rosso
bodyHtml:
This historic and refined aromatized wine originates from Turin, Italy, the birthplace of modern vermouth. Anselmo Vermouth di Torino Rosso is a revival of an ancient family recipe dating back to 1854, originally crafted by Carlo Anselmo. The brand’s philosophy bridges 19th-century Piedmontese tradition with a contemporary edge, focusing on artisanal production and the use of high-quality base wines, such as Muscat from Canelli, to ensure a rich and authentic profile.

Wine Description

The Anselmo Vermouth di Torino Rosso presents a deep amber-red colour. The sensory profile is exceptionally aromatic and complex, featuring an intense nose of candied orange, lemon peel, and a signature touch of grapefruit. These citrus layers are supported by a spicy bouquet where liquorice, vanilla, and rhubarb stand out. On the palate, the vermouth is perfectly balanced, offering a harmonious interplay between its natural sweetness and a delicate acidity. It is characterized by a "fresh and slightly bitter" finish, with the persistent herbal notes of gentian, quassia, and wormwood (Artemisia). It typically has an ABV of 18% and follows the strict Vermouth di Torino PGI regulations, ensuring that at least 75% of the base is Italian wine.

title: Rothschild Pinot Noir Rimapere 2020
bodyHtml:
Rothschild Pinot Noir Rimapere originates from New Zealand, within the Marlborough region and the prestigious Rapaura sector of the Wairau Valley. The estate was acquired in 2012 by Baron Benjamin de Rothschild in a partnership with Terry Peabody, the owner of Craggy Range. The winery's name, 'Rimapere', means 'five arrows' in Māori, a title that simultaneously honours the Rothschild family coat of arms and traditional New Zealand culture. Since 2020, the vineyard has been managed with regenerative and organic practices, achieving official Biogro certification in 2024.

Wine Description

This red wine is fruit driven and typically displays a vibrant ruby colour. The sensory profile features an aromatic nose often characterized by red fruit notes, while the palate is defined by a backbone of acidity and a silky mouthfeel. Its structure is noted for both finesse and complexity, concluding with a long and balanced finish.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is crafted for elegance and precision, with a textural complexity derived from its exceptional stony terroir.

  • ABV: 13%.

  • Organic Status: Managed with regenerative and organic practices since 2020; Biogro certified as of 2024.

title: Garzon Balasto 2020
bodyHtml:
Garzón Balasto originates from Uruguay, specifically from the Maldonado region on the Atlantic coast. Bodega Garzón is a family-owned winery founded by Alejandro P. Bulgheroni, who pioneered viticulture in this area and gained global recognition as the Wine Enthusiast 'New World Winery of the Year' in 2018. The winemaking philosophy, led by consultant Alberto Antonini and winemaker Germán Bruzzone, focuses on expressing the unique spirit of the Uruguayan terroir. The wine is named after 'balasto,' the decomposed granite soil of the estate that is billions of years old and provides the excellent drainage and minerality essential to the wine’s character.

Wine Description

This iconic red blend presents a complex sensory profile with notable energy and vitality. The aromatics are impressive, featuring fresh red and black fruit notes alongside elegant spices, orange blossoms, and hints of minerals and tar. On the medium-bodied palate, the wine displays juicy, polished tannins that provide a refined texture and a long, persistent finish. Its structure is defined by a complex dynamic between musky dark cherry fruit and subtle oak influences.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend typically dominated by Tannat, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot, often including Marselan in certain vintages. For example, the 2020 vintage comprises 42% Tannat, 39% Cabernet Franc, and 19% Petit Verdot.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine undergoes fermentation in cement tanks before aging for 20 months in large, untoasted French oak barrels to preserve its fresh fruit profile and mineral tension.

  • ABV: 14%.

  • Organic and Sustainable Status: Bodega Garzón is a leader in sustainability, being the first winery outside North America to pursue LEED certification; the wine is also classified as vegetarian and vegan.

Food Pairing

The robust tannins and vibrant acidity of Balasto make it a versatile partner for rich and flavourful dishes.

  • Grilled Meats: Pairs excellently with traditional Uruguayan barbecue (asado), grilled ribeye, or roasted lamb.

  • Savoury Dishes: Complements wild boar stews, hearty beef casseroles, or dishes seasoned with fresh mountain herbs.

  • Hard Cheeses: Matches well with aged, nutty cheeses such as Manchego or mature Parmesan.

title: Chateau de Beaucastel Chateauneuf du Pape 2022
bodyHtml:
This iconic red wine hails from the Châteauneuf du Pape appellation in the southern Rhône Valley, France. The estate has been owned by the Perrin family since 1909, though its history dates back to 1549 when Pierre de Beaucastel first purchased the property. Known for their pioneering spirit, the Perrins have practiced organic and biodynamic viticulture since the 1950s, emphasizing a philosophy that respects the terroir and the unique character of all thirteen permitted grape varieties.

Wine Description

This wine presents a magnificent, shiny red colour with distinct carmine undertones. On the nose, it is powerful and complex, revealing a superb bouquet of very ripe red and black fruits, blackberries, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with notes of chocolate, tobacco, lavender, and undergrowth. The palate is generous and silky with a soft, round attack that leads into an elegant, well-balanced tannic structure and a rich finish featuring meaty and mineral notes.

Food Pairing

This structured red is an ideal match for rich, savoury dishes such as roasted leg of lamb with Mediterranean herbs, grilled rib of beef, or venison stew. It also pairs beautifully with earthy flavours like wild mushrooms, hearty pasta, or mature cheeses like Comté and Parmesan.

title: Giusti Umberto I Rosso del Veneto 2015
bodyHtml:
Giusti Wine’s most iconic product, this wine is elegant, rich and enveloping, a masterful Bordeaux blend that has close ties with the land where international varieties were introduced by Napoleon Bonaparte.

Wine Description

Very intense ruby ​​red with slightly garnet reflections. Intense with notes of red fruit, spices, vanilla and pepper. Very full-bodied, round, persistent with soft and elegant tannins.

title: Le Potazzine Rosso Di Montalcino 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in the heart of Tuscany, Italy, this refined red wine comes from the prestigious Montalcino region. The Le Potazzine estate, owned by Gigliola Giannetti and her daughters Viola and Sofia, is named after the colourful, vivacious birds of the Tuscan countryside—a term of endearment used for the daughters by their grandmother. The winery is celebrated for its traditionalist philosophy, utilizing high-altitude vineyards (400–500m) and spontaneous fermentations with indigenous yeasts to produce wines of exceptional elegance and personality.

Wine Description

The 2024 Rosso di Montalcino is an elegant, early-drinking expression that exhibits a bright ruby red colour. On the nose, it offers a fresh bouquet of red berries, wild herbs, and subtle floral hints. The palate is supple and well-balanced, featuring fine tannins, juicy acidity, and a persistent, savoury finish. This 100% certified organic Sangiovese is fermented spontaneously for 30–40 days without temperature control and aged for 10–12 months in large, mostly old Slavonian oak casks. While approachable in its youth, its structure and depth allow for further development in the bottle, reflecting the estate's focused terroir expression.

title: Chateau Cap De Faugeres Bordeaux 2020
bodyHtml:
Chateau Cap De Faugeres originates from the Castillon Cotes de Bordeaux appellation in France. Purchased in 2005 by Silvio Denz, owner of Vignobles Silvio Denz and Chairman of Lalique, the estate is managed by the same expert team responsible for the renowned Chateau Faugeres. The winery’s philosophy focuses on expressing its unique clay-limestone terroir through sustainable practices, recently achieving High Environmental Value (HVE) level 3 certification.

Wine Description

This Bordeaux blend typically features a deep purple colour with ruby-red highlights. The nose is expressive and harmonious, offering a bouquet of black cherries, wild berries, and plums, often accompanied by subtle notes of violet, licorice, and elegant toasting. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and fleshy, characterized by a smooth, supple texture and well-integrated tannins. It displays a sophisticated balance of freshness and complexity, leading to a persistent finish with hints of blackcurrant, dark chocolate, and a distinctive saline touch.

title: Big Rock Grasshopper - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Grasshopper Wheat Ale is an undisputed legend in the Canadian craft beer landscape. Launched in 1994 by Calgary’s Big Rock Brewery, it was one of the first "alternative" beers to gain massive mainstream success in Alberta. While the market at the time was dominated by heavy lagers and ales, Grasshopper introduced drinkers to the soft, breezy world of Kristallweizen (clear wheat beer). It was designed to be the ultimate "summer in a glass"—light, approachable, and famously clear for a wheat ale. For decades, it has been the go-to pint on every Calgary patio.

Beer Description

Grasshopper pours a brilliant, crystal-clear pale gold with a bright white head and a steady stream of lively carbonation. Unlike its cloudy Belgian or German cousins, it is filtered to a sparkling "diamond" clarity.

Aroma: The nose is clean, subtle, and incredibly fresh. It leads with a delicate scent of fresh-cracked wheat and sweet honeyed malt, followed by a very faint, fruity ester—think light pear or apple. There is a soft, herbal hop presence in the background that keeps the bouquet crisp.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a crisp, "zippy" mouthfeel. It leads with a gentle, bready sweetness from the wheat, followed by a mild, floral bitterness. The finish is remarkably clean and "short," meaning it refreshes the palate instantly without any lingering heaviness or spice.

Profile: It sits at a very sessionable 5.0% ABV and a low bitterness of 16 IBU, prioritizing maximum refreshment.

Technical Notes: Grasshopper is brewed using a blend of malted wheat and two-row Alberta barley. The high wheat content provides a signature soft texture, even after filtration. It is fermented with a neutral ale yeast at cooler temperatures to prevent the heavy "clove and banana" flavors found in traditional Hefeweizens. The beer is then finely filtered, which removes the yeast haze and creates its famous, sparkling appearance while retaining the delicate grain flavors.

title: Charles Baker Picone Vineyard Riesling 2021
bodyHtml:
Charles Baker Picone Vineyard Riesling 2021 is a single vineyard expression from the Vinemount Ridge sub appellation of the Niagara Peninsula in Ontario.

The Charles Baker project is a collaboration with Stratus Vineyards, where Baker serves as the director of marketing and sales while producing his namesake Rieslings. The winemaking philosophy focuses exclusively on Riesling, seeking to highlight the unique terroir of specific Niagara sites through minimal intervention and a commitment to dry and off dry styles. The Picone Vineyard, owned by Mark Picone, is considered one of the most significant sites in the region, featuring 40 year old vines planted on a high altitude limestone bench.

Wine Description

This 2021 Riesling presents a brilliant, pale straw colour. The aromatic profile is classic and intense, offering a bouquet of lime zest, green apple, and white peach, underpinned by distinctive flinty and petrol notes. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied with high, bracing acidity that is expertly balanced by a touch of residual sugar. It features concentrated flavours of citrus and slate-like minerality, leading to a crisp and exceptionally long finish.

The wine is 100% Riesling, sourced entirely from the Picone Vineyard. It was fermented using cool temperatures in stainless steel to preserve the purity of the fruit and the site's mineral character. This vintage has an ABV of 11% and reflects the producer's dedication to sustainable viticulture.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and mineral backbone of this Riesling make it a perfect partner for spicy Asian cuisines, such as Thai green curry or Szechuan peppercorn chicken. It also pairs beautifully with fresh Ontario trout, pan seared scallops with lemon butter, or a classic Wiener Schnitzel. For a cheese course, it complements soft, creamy options like Camembert or tangy goat cheese.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Niagara was a season of resilience, characterized by a wet and humid summer that demanded meticulous vineyard management to prevent disease. However, a warm and dry autumn allowed the Riesling grapes to reach optimal ripeness while retaining the high natural acidity that defines the region's best white wines.

title: Stratus Blanc de Blancs 2017
bodyHtml:
Stratus Blanc de Blancs 2017 is a premium sparkling wine from the Niagara on the Lake region in Ontario, Canada.

The wine is produced by Stratus Vineyards, a 55 acre estate situated in the Niagara Lakeshore sub appellation. Established with a deep commitment to sustainability, Stratus became the world's first winery to achieve full LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification in 2005. The winemaking team, led by J-L Groux and Dean Stoyka, follows a philosophy of 'low intervention' and 'gravity flow' production, utilizing a 1000 barrel geothermal cellar to craft wines that reflect the unique glacial till soils of their 44 individual vineyard blocks.

Wine Description

This Méthode Traditionnelle sparkling wine is characterized by its precision and elegance. It presents a light to medium body with remarkably vibrant aromas of orchard fresh green apple, Bosc pear, grapefruit, and lime zest, accented by delicate floral notes of acacia. On the palate, the wine is bright and energetic, offering flavours of citrus, quince, and honeysuckle, supported by a creamy texture and secondary notes of biscuit and brioche. The finish is crisp, bubbly, and persistent.

The 2017 vintage is a varietal composition of 100% estate grown Chardonnay. Following traditional practices, the wine was aged on its lees for six years prior to disgorgement to develop its signature complexity and fine mousse. It has an ABV of approximately 13.5% and is produced from grapes that are farmed according to certified sustainable standards.

Food Pairing

The high acidity and creamy citrus profile of this Blanc de Blancs make it an excellent pairing for classic appetizers such as gougères or fresh oysters. It complements seafood dishes including butter poached lobster rolls, seared tuna with ponzu, and steamed mussels with garlic sauce. For more diverse pairings, consider chicken Milanese, truffle risotto, or savory snacks like popcorn and fried wild mushrooms.

Vintage Quality

The 2017 vintage in Niagara was marked by a wet spring and summer that initially slowed vine development, but was redeemed by an exceptionally warm and sunny autumn. This prolonged 'Indian Summer' through September and October provided ideal conditions for the grapes to reach full phenolic ripeness while maintaining the essential coolness and acidity required for high quality sparkling wine.

title: Pierre Troupel Chateauneuf du Pape 2022
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Pierre Troupel Châteauneuf du Pape 2022 is an elegant red wine from the Southern Rhône Valley in France.

The wine is produced by Domaine Clef de Saint Thomas, an estate located in the heart of the Châteauneuf du Pape village. The Pierre Troupel cuvée serves as a tribute to the grandfather of the current owner, Sophie Kessler-Matières, who was known for his piercing blue eyes reflected in the wine's distinctive blue label. The winery's philosophy emphasizes traditional methods and site-specific expression, sourcing fruit from high-quality plots in the 'Charbonnières' and 'Cansaud' lieux-dits, where vines are grown on a mix of sand and calcareous soils.

Wine Description

This 2022 vintage presents a clear, medium garnet-red colour. The aromatic profile is intense and fruit-forward, featuring a 'berry explosion' of blackberries, raspberries, and red cherries, layered with floral notes of violets, dried orange peel, and warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and well-rounded, displaying a silky core of bright red fruit, liquorice, and grilled herbs. It is characterized by its lovely liveliness, fine tannins, and a fresh, ethereal finish.

The varietal composition for this vintage is an equal blend of 50% Grenache and 50% Syrah. The grapes are 100% hand-harvested in mid-September, totally destemmed, and fermented at 25°C. Traditional maturation takes place in stainless steel tanks to preserve the wine's primary fruit and mineral character. The wine has an ABV of 14.5% and the estate holds HVE (High Environmental Value) Level 3 certification for its sustainable agricultural practices.

Food Pairing

The fresh acidity and spicy fruit profile of this Châteauneuf du Pape make it an ideal companion for traditional French dishes and grilled meats such as herb-crusted lamb or beef entrecôte. It also pairs effectively with roasted duck, charcuterie boards, and vegetarian dishes featuring earthy mushrooms. For a cheese course, it complements a variety of options ranging from aged Comté to creamy Bleu d'Auvergne.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in the southern Rhône was defined by fierce heat and significant drought conditions throughout much of the growing season. These challenging conditions resulted in lower yields but high-quality, healthy fruit with thick skins, producing reds that are deeply coloured, concentrated, and potent with ripe, 'baked' fruit profiles. Winemakers were credited with successfully managing water stress to maintain a surprising level of freshness and balance in the final wines.

title: Glenlivet 12 Year Old - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 12 Year Old is produced in the Speyside region of Scotland, within the Livet Valley. Founded in 1824 by George Smith, it was the first distillery in the region to be granted a legal license. To celebrate its 200th anniversary in 2024, the distillery launched a series of "bold and original" innovations that have continued into 2026, including the 200 Year Anniversary Limited Edition 12 Year Old and the new "Beyond Speyside" series.

Spirit Description

The core 12 Year Old, known as the "Double Oak," represents the distillery’s signature smooth and fruity style.

  • Maturation: It is aged for 12 years in a combination of traditional European oak and American oak casks, which impart vanilla notes and a distinct smoothness.

  • Appearance: Bright, vibrant gold.

  • Nose: Fruity and summery, with aromas of fresh pineapple, apricot, citrus blossom, and honeyed malt.

  • Palate: Well-balanced and buttery with a silky texture. Dominant flavours include ripe pear, green apple, and strong pineapple, layered with vanilla and hazelnut.

  • Finish: Long and creamy with a soft crackle of oaky spice.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Stratus Cabernet Franc 2023
bodyHtml:
Stratus Cabernet Franc 2023 is a premium red wine from the Niagara Lakeshore sub-appellation of the Niagara Peninsula in Ontario.

The wine is produced by Stratus Vineyards, a 62 acre estate renowned for its 'gravity flow' winemaking process and deep-rooted commitment to environmental sustainability. In 2005, the winery achieved global recognition as the first to be fully LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certified. The winemaking philosophy, led by Dean Stoyka, emphasizes a 'low intervention' approach, utilizing the estate's 44 distinct vineyard blocks to showcase the diverse complexities of the regional limestone and clay soils.

Wine Description

This 2023 red wine presents a deep, vibrant ruby colour. The sensory profile is defined by an aromatic bouquet of dark cherries, raspberries, and signature herbal notes of dried sage and crushed peppercorn. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied with a refined structure, offering flavours of ripe plum, red currant, and a hint of cocoa. It is characterized by its elegant balance, fine-grained tannins, and a fresh, persistent finish that reflects the cool-climate origins of the Niagara Peninsula.

The varietal composition is 100% Cabernet Franc, sourced from hand-harvested estate fruit. To enhance its complexity while maintaining fruit purity, the wine is aged in French oak barrels for approximately 18 to 20 months. It has an ABV of 13.5% and is produced under the Sustainable Winegrowing Ontario certification.

Food Pairing

The structured tannins and savory profile of this Cabernet Franc make it a versatile companion for many dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with herb-crusted lamb, roasted duck breast, or a classic steak frites. For vegetarian options, it complements earthy flavours such as roasted root vegetables, lentil stews, or dishes featuring grilled portobello mushrooms and rosemary.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Ontario provided excellent conditions for late-ripening red varieties like Cabernet Franc. A warm and dry autumn followed a humid summer, allowing the grapes to achieve full phenolic ripeness and concentrated flavours. This extended hang time resulted in a vintage noted for its textural depth and sophisticated tannin structure, while the region's natural coolness ensured the wine retained its essential acidity and freshness.

title: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 12 Year Old, also known as "Our Original Twelve," is the cornerstone of the world’s best-selling single malt range and is produced in Dufftown, Speyside. In February 2026, the brand unveiled a significant global visual identity refresh, its first major redesign in years, which began rolling out to markets in April 2026. This new look balances 139 years of heritage with "timeless modernity," drawing inspiration from the pioneering bottlings of the 1960s that first established the single malt category globally.

Spirit Description

The liquid remains unchanged despite the 2026 packaging update, maintaining the classic "house style" that has defined the distillery for generations.

  • Maturation: Matured for at least 12 years in a combination of American bourbon and Spanish Oloroso sherry oak casks before being married in oak tuns for complete harmony.

  • Appearance: Bright golden yellow.

  • Nose: Distinctively fresh and fruity with a prominent hint of pear, green apple, and honeyed malt, accompanied by delicate floral notes of elderflower.

  • Palate: Soft and approachable with characteristic sweet fruit notes that develop into butterscotch, cream, and malt, balanced by subtle oak and a touch of white pepper.

  • Finish: Long, smooth, and mellow, leaving a clean exit of apple and vanilla.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Pol Roger Brut Reserve 'White Foil' - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This prestigious and world-renowned sparkling wine originates from the Champagne region of France. Founded in 1849, Pol Roger remains one of the few elite Champagne houses that is still family owned and independent. The winery's philosophy is defined by a commitment to style and consistency, famously earning the loyalty of Sir Winston Churchill, who famously remarked that 'my tastes are simple: I am easily satisfied with the best'. The Brut Reserve, affectionately known as 'White Foil' due to its iconic capsule, is the definitive house cuvée, representing the perfect balance of power and finesse.

Wine Description

The Pol Roger Brut Reserve 'White Foil' presents a beautiful straw-yellow colour with a fine, persistent stream of bubbles. The sensory profile is elegant and complex, featuring an expressive nose of pear, mango, and honeysuckle, layered with rich notes of brioche, vanilla, and jasmine. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and remarkably balanced, showcasing flavours of cooked fruit, quince jelly, and apricot jam. It is characterized by its refreshing acidity and a long, firm finish that reveals hints of beeswax and acacia honey. This cuvée is an equal blend of 33% Chardonnay, 33% Pinot Noir, and 33% Pinot Meunier, with an ABV of 12.5%. The wine typically includes 25% reserve wines and is aged for a minimum of four years in the house’s deep, cool cellars, the deepest in Epernay, to develop its signature creamy texture.

title: Clonakilty Distillery Bordeaux Cask Irish Single Malt
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Bordeaux Cask Irish Single Malt originates from the West Cork region of Ireland, specifically the coastal town of Clonakilty. It is produced by the Clonakilty Distillery, a family owned operation founded by the Scully family, who have farmed the same coastal land for nine generations. The distillery is situated on the Wild Atlantic Way and is known for its commitment to sustainability and its unique maritime maturing warehouse where the ocean air influences the aging process.

Spirit Description

This premium whiskey is a double distilled single malt that has been finished in red wine casks from the Château La Cardonne estate in the Bordeaux region of France. It presents a deep golden to tawny appearance with a medium to full body. The aroma is a complex bouquet of soft oak, honey, and floral plum, accented by notes of fresh berries. On the palate, it delivers a rich array of flavours including oak spice, cinnamon, and clove, balanced by sweet vanilla and nutmeg. The finish is long and warming, characterized by drying spices, vanilla cream, and lingering hints of blackcurrants and raspberries. It is bottled at 46% ABV and is non chill filtered to preserve its natural character.

Food Pairing

The spiced fruit profile and oak influence of this single malt make it a sophisticated partner for a variety of dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with creamy, soft cheeses such as Brie or Camembert, which complement its vanilla notes. For a savoury pairing, roasted poultry or a classic steak sandwich with a hint of horseradish will stand up to the whiskey's spicy character. It also serves as a delightful accompaniment to fruit based desserts, particularly strawberry shortcake or a raspberry tart, which echo the red fruit notes from the Bordeaux cask finish.

title: Barone Valforte Montepulciano d'Abruzzo 2024
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Barone Valforte Montepulciano d'Abruzzo 2023 is a classic red wine from the Abruzzo region of Central Italy.

The estate is owned by the Sorricchio di Valforte family, who have held lands in the Teramo province since the 14th century. The winery's philosophy combines centuries of tradition with modern technology, focusing on the unique coastal-mountain microclimate between the Adriatic Sea and the Gran Sasso mountain range. This positioning allows the vineyards to benefit from significant temperature shifts, which the family believes is essential for developing the aromatic complexity and structure of the Montepulciano grape.

Wine Description

It presents an intense ruby red colour with subtle violet undertones. The aroma is rich and inviting, dominated by scents of Marasca cherry, wild plums, and red berries, alongside delicate notes of dried herbs and violet. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and well-structured, offering juicy flavours of dark fruit, liquorice, and a hint of spice. It is characterized by its balanced acidity, supple tannins, and a smooth, dry finish.

The wine is 100% Montepulciano, sourced from vineyards situated at an altitude of approximately 300 metres. The grapes undergo fermentation in stainless steel tanks with a long maceration on the skins to extract colour and tannin, followed by a short period of aging in neutral oak or stainless steel to preserve fruit freshness. This wine has an ABV of 13.5% and is produced following sustainable viticultural practices.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and fruit-forward nature of this Montepulciano make it an excellent partner for hearty Italian fare. It pairs perfectly with grilled red meats, lamb skewers (arrosticini), and pasta dishes featuring rich ragù or tomato-based sauces. It also complements savory appetizers like bruschetta with olive tapenade, aged Pecorino cheese, and cured meats such as salami or bresaola.

title: Highwood White Rum – 1.14 Litre
bodyHtml:
Highwood White Rum is produced in Canada, within the region of Alberta and the subregion of High River. It is crafted by Highwood Distillers, an independently owned family distillery nestled in the foothills of the Canadian Rockies. The spirit is a "Canadian-Caribbean" fusion; it is distilled from sugarcane molasses in Guyana (predominantly a Demerara blend) and imported as high-proof neutral alcohol. Upon arrival in Alberta, it is aged, blended with pure Rocky Mountain water, and filtered to achieve its clear appearance.

Spirit Description

Highwood White Rum is designed primarily as a smooth, approachable mixer rather than a sipping rum.

  • Aging & Filtration: It is aged for at least one year (and up to three years, according to some reports) in ex-bourbon oak barrels. A specialized filtration process then removes the colour while retaining subtle barrel characteristics.

  • Nose: Light and fragrant, featuring notes of cotton candy, brown sugar, and faint tropical fruit, with underlying hints of coconut and a slight medicinal edge.

  • Palate: Soft and lightly oily with a mild sweetness. It displays flavours of caramel, vanilla, and light candy, along with flashes of mint and a gentle alcohol tingle.

  • Finish: Smooth, clean, and relatively short, leaving a sweetened palate with a touch of vanilla and oak.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

title: Pol Roger Brut Vintage 2018
bodyHtml:
This prestigious vintage Champagne originates from the Épernay sub-region of France. Pol Roger is one of the few remaining family-owned Grand Marques, famously celebrated as the favorite Champagne house of Sir Winston Churchill. Unlike the non-vintage Brut Réserve, the Pol Roger Brut Vintage 2018 is only produced in years where the harvest achieves exceptional ripeness and structural balance, reflecting the unique character of a single growing season.

Wine Description

The Pol Roger Brut Vintage 2018 presents a brilliant gold colour with a persistent, fine bead. The sensory profile is remarkably deep and gourmand, featuring an aromatic nose of ripe apricot, peach, and citrus zest, layered with sophisticated notes of fresh pastry, acacia honey, and toasted almonds. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and vinous, showcasing a firm structural backbone and a creamy texture that reflects its extended time on the lees. It is characterized by its powerful yet elegant presence, leading to a long, mineral-driven finish with hints of brioche and dried fruits. This traditional blend consists of 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay, sourced from 20 Grands and Premiers Crus in the Montagne de Reims and the Côte des Blancs. It has an ABV of 12.5% and was aged for over six years in the house's deep, cool cellars, the deepest in Épernay, before release.

title: Trediberri Barbera d'Alba 2025
bodyHtml:
The Trediberri Barbera d'Alba is produced in the Piedmont region of Italy, specifically sourced from vineyards in the Roero and the Torriglione hamlet near La Morra. Established in 2007 by Federico Oberto, his son Nicola, and Vladimiro Rambaldi, the winery began with five hectares in the Berri Cru. The estate operates with a philosophy of 'upstart' energy, focusing on creating wines that are 'bare and raw', prioritizing fruit expression and drinkability over traditional oak influence.

Wine Description

This 100% Barbera presents a lively purple-red hue with a slightly brightening rim. The nose is bright and inviting, offering intense aromas of ripe black cherry, plum, and redcurrants, complemented by floral hints of violet and subtle savory spices. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and incredibly energetic, featuring a rush of mouthwatering acidity that balances rich dark fruit flavors of strawberry and blackcurrant. The texture is defined by velvety tannins and a clean, fresh, and persistent finish.

The sensory profile is elegant and complex, featuring an expressive nose of pear, mango, and honeysuckle, layered with rich notes of brioche, vanilla, and jasmine. title: Trolley Light Czech Pilsner - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Trolley 5 Czech Pilsner (often referred to as their Trolley Light) is a staple lager from Calgary’s Trolley 5 Brewpub on 17th Avenue. While the brewery is known for its "Beltline" vibes and approachable lineup, this beer is a nod to the traditional pilsners of the Czech Republic. It is designed to be a "clean, crisp, and classic" lager that offers more character and a more structured bitterness than a standard North American light beer, while still being the most sessionable option on their tap list.

Beer Description

Trolley Light pours a brilliant, crystal-clear pale straw color with a bright white head and a steady stream of lively carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is clean and refreshing. It leads with a delicate scent of freshly cracked grain and honeyed biscuit, followed by the unmistakable "noble" aroma of Saaz hops providing a soft, floral, and slightly spicy perfume that is the hallmark of the style.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a crisp, "snappy" mouthfeel. It leads with a subtle malt sweetness, which is quickly balanced by a firm, refreshing bitterness. The finish is remarkably dry and clean, with a tiny hint of herbal spice that lingers just long enough to invite another sip.

Profile: It sits at a very approachable 4.0% ABV (depending on the specific batch/seasonal tweak) and a moderate bitterness of approx. 20–25 IBU.

Technical Notes: True to the Czech style, this beer utilizes Pilsner malt for its light color and bready flavor. It is hopped exclusively with Czech Saaz hops, which are famous for their earthy, spicy complexity. The beer undergoes a traditional cold-lagering process to ensure a "polished" finish and exceptional clarity, removing the fruity esters typically found in the brewery's IPAs.

title: Eau Claire Rupert's Exceptional Whisky
bodyHtml:
Eau Claire Rupert's Canadian Whisky is a premium spirit produced in Turner Valley, Alberta, Canada. Established in 2014, Eau Claire Distillery was Alberta's first craft distillery and is currently owned by founder David Farran. The whisky is named after 'Rupert's Land', a historical territory that once covered one third of Canada and included the distillery's home in southern Alberta. The label features 'Rupert', a dapper moose that has served as the distillery's main social animal since its inception.

Spirit Description

Rupert's Whisky is a carefully crafted blend consisting of approximately 20% Eau Claire single malt whiskies mixed with 80% high-quality Alberta base whisky. It is non-chill filtered and contains no artificial caramel colouring.

  • Colour: The liquid presents a pale straw to light-to-medium gold appearance.

  • Aroma: The nose is sweet and spicy, featuring notes of vanilla, toffee, butterscotch, and fine oak spices, with hints of candied apricot, orange peel, and almond.

  • Palate: It delivers a smooth and full-bodied mouthfeel with initial notes of honey, dried fruit, and toasted grain. These are layered with chocolate, nutmeg, and candied citrus peel.

  • Body: The spirit is well-balanced and approachable, characterized by a refreshing complexity.

  • Finish: It concludes with a warm, clean finish marked by lingering touches of oak, caramel, malt, and a slightly nutty aftertaste.

  • ABV: Rupert's Exceptional Canadian Whisky is bottled at 40%.

title: Blindman Dream Machine Mexican Lager 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml:
Dream Machine Mexican Lager is a seasonal standout from Lacombe’s Blindman Brewing, one of Alberta’s most respected and innovative craft breweries. While many "Mexican-style" lagers are associated with thin, mass-market imports, Blindman approaches this style with a focus on artisanal quality and regional ingredients. It is designed to be the ultimate "crushable" lager inspired by the sun-drenched beaches of Mexico but rooted in the high-quality barley of the Canadian prairies. It is a beer that prioritizes clean fermentation and a specific, refreshing "snap."

Beer Description

Dream Machine pours a brilliant, crystal-clear pale straw with a light, frothy white head and fine, lively carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is clean, bright, and inviting. It leads with dominant notes of sweet flaked corn and fresh-cracked grain, followed by a subtle, floral hop scent. There is a faint, lime-like citrus quality in the background that suggests a refreshing "zing" even before the first sip.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a crisp, effervescent mouthfeel. It leads with a delicate corn-chip sweetness and bready malt, which is quickly balanced by a very mild, herbal bitterness. The finish is exceptionally clean and dry, with a refreshing mineral quality that scrubs the palate.

Profile: It sits at a highly sessionable 4.5% ABV and a low bitterness of 15 IBU, ensuring maximum drinkability without palate fatigue.

Technical Notes: The "Mexican" character of Dream Machine comes from the addition of flaked corn (maize) to the mash. This adjunct lightens the body of the beer and provides a characteristic sweetness that distinguishes it from a traditional European Pilsner. Blindman utilizes a clean-fermenting lager yeast and an extended cold-conditioning period to ensure the beer is "bright" (clear) and free of any heavy esters or off-flavors.

title: Reserva Huizar Cristalino Tequila
bodyHtml:
Reserva Huizar is a premium tequila producer based in Mexico, specifically within the renowned agave-growing region of Jalisco. The brand is rooted in a family tradition that emphasizes Mexican customs and values, with distribution hubs extending into the United States and Canada. Reserva Huizar focuses on traditional transformation processes intended to preserve the purity of the agave while utilizing American oak barrels to provide refined flavour nuances.

Spirit Description

The Cristalino expression from Reserva Huizar is a 'reposado cristalino' that undergoes a filtration process to achieve a diamond-like clarity while maintaining the complexity of aged spirit.

  • Colour: This tequila is transparent and brilliant with a crystal clear appearance.

  • Aroma: The nose features raw agave notes interlaced with the scent of cooked agave and delicate hints of vanilla.

  • Palate: On the palate, it offers a combination of sweet agave and olive notes alongside herbal highlights such as peppermint.

  • Body: It possesses a smooth and delicate mouthfeel that masks the robust nature of the agave.

  • Finish: The finish is clean and brings forward flavours of caramel and cinnamon that awaken the senses.

  • ABV: This spirit is typically bottled at 40%.

title: Casey Jones Amburana Finished Barrel Cut Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Casey Jones Amburana Finished Barrel Cut is a bold and adventurous limited-edition spirit produced in the United States, specifically in Hopkinsville, Kentucky. It is crafted by Casey Jones Distillery, founded by Master Distiller Arlon "AJ" Casey Jones, who uses his grandfather’s iconic square pot still design a relic from the prohibition era designed to fit discreetly in the back of a truck. This expression is a standout in the distillery’s "Bottle Your Own" experience and selective retail releases, representing a fusion of Kentucky moonshining heritage and exotic Brazilian aging techniques.

Description

This spirit is technically a "Barrel Aged American Spirit" rather than a traditional bourbon because it is crafted from a unique 50/50 mash of corn and cane sugar. This hybrid mash bill creates a profile that bridges the gap between high-proof bourbon and a sophisticated sipping rum.

  • Maturation: The spirit is first aged traditionally in Kelvin Cooperage charred white oak barrels. It is then re-barreled in rare Brazilian Amburana oak casks, a hardwood known for its intense aromatic properties. Some batches are even "Triple Casked," spending a final period mellowing in a high-rye bourbon cask.

  • Appearance: Dark gold to burnished copper with oily, syrupy legs.

  • Nose: Incredibly aromatic and sweet. Rich waves of cinnamon, t balaoasted oak, and warm baking spices arenced by notes of crème brûlée and barrel char.

  • Palate: A decadent, full-bodied experience often described as an "oatmeal raisin cookie" in a glass. It features layers of butterscotch, spiced brown sugar, vanilla bean, and a unique "woodsy" depth.

  • Finish: Long and velvety, with a distinct shift from bourbon-like caramel to rum-like vanilla on the exit, finished with a touch of ginger-like heat.

  • Technical Details: Typically bottled as a Barrel Cut (uncut and unfiltered) at approximately 112.8 proof (56.4% ABV).

title: Casey Jones Barrel Cut Blue Label
bodyHtml:
Casey Jones Barrel Cut "Blue" Bourbon (specifically the Blue Hole or Blue Corn variants) is a premium, craft spirit produced in Hopkinsville, Kentucky. It is crafted at Casey Jones Distillery, which is famous for its use of a unique square copper pot still—a design legacy of the founder's grandfather, a prolific Prohibition-era still maker. The "Blue" designation typically refers to the distillery's specialized Finished Barrel Series, such as the Blue Hole release, or their expressions featuring locally grown heirloom blue corn, which provides a nuttier and oilier profile than standard yellow corn.

Description

The "Barrel Cut" line is characterized by being bottled at Cask Strength (uncut and unfiltered), offering a more intense and concentrated flavor profile.

  • The "Blue Hole" Edition: This specific 2024–2026 release is a "Barrel Finished" spirit aged for 4 years. It uses a unique 50/50 mash bill of corn and cane sugar, initially matured in new oak and then finished for 17 days in Used Amburana Casks.

  • Aroma: A complex nose of rich red cherry, spiced oak, and "muddled green fruit," with the Amburana finish adding a distinct "tannic twist".

  • Palate: A velvety, full-bodied mouthfeel. It features notes of semi-sweet dark cherry, apple fruit, and toasted brown sugar, evolving into a "malt caramel" body with hints of sweet tobacco.

  • Finish: A long, satisfying finish that is "delightfully dry" with a lingering peppery kick and a distinct rye-like spice.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at Cask Strength, typically ranging between 98.8 and 110 proof (49.4%–55% ABV).

title: Casey Jones White Label Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Casey Jones Barrel Strength "White Label" Bourbon is a high-proof, small-batch spirit produced in Hopkinsville, Kentucky. It is the uncut and unfiltered version of the distillery's flagship "Mash Bill 1" bourbon. Produced by Casey Jones Distillery, the spirit is distilled in a unique square copper pot still a design pioneered by the founder's grandfather, a legendary Prohibition-era still maker known for his "coffin" stills. The "White Label" refers specifically to their high-corn, original recipe, which pays homage to the traditional moonshine roots of the region while adhering to strict bourbon standards.

2. Spirit Description

This expression is a corn-forward bourbon, known for its buttery sweetness and heavy mouthfeel.

  • Mash Bill: Typically follows the distillery's "Mash Bill 1," consisting of 96% corn, 3% rye, and 1% malted barley.

  • Maturation: Aged for a minimum of 2 to 5 years in new, charred American white oak barrels.

  • Appearance: A deep golden amber with thick, oily "legs".

  • Nose: An inviting "party" of aromas including creamed corn, vanilla bean ice cream, and subtle floral notes, followed by hints of almond and crisp pear.

  • Palate: Exceptionally viscous and velvety. It features dominant flavors of toasted brown sugar, caramel corn, and juicy plums, balanced by a comforting spice of cinnamon toast and molasses.

  • Finish: Long and warming; it begins with a rush of spicy cinnamon (reminiscent of Big Red gum) and white pepper, before trailing off into a lingering caramel sauce and orange zest.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at Barrel Strength (uncut), typically ranging between 105 and 115 proof (52.5%–57.5% ABV).

title: Casey Jones Total Eclipse Four Grain Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Casey Jones Total Eclipse Four Grain Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a commemorative craft spirit produced in Hopkinsville, Kentucky. It was launched in February 2024 as the "Official Bourbon of the 2024 Total Solar Eclipse," marking the second time the distillery was positioned directly in the path of totality (the first being in 2017). Unlike the distillery's flagship high-corn recipes, this expression utilizes their modern Mash Bill #4, designed to provide a more balanced and complex profile that appeals to a wide range of whiskey enthusiasts.

Description

This four-grain bourbon is distilled in small batches using the distillery's signature square copper pot still and aged for a minimum of two to four years.

  • Mash Bill: A perfectly balanced four-grain blend consisting of 75% Yellow Dent Corn, 10% Wheat, 10% Rye, and 5% Malted Barley.

  • Appearance: Bright copper with a rich, luminous glow.

  • Nose: Highly aromatic and "perfumy." It features a mix of baking spices, butterscotch, and graham crackers, with unique hints of spicy green pepper and persimmon.

  • Palate: A warm, creamy texture that reveals layers of funky cherry, orange zest, and dried tropical fruits (like mango and papaya). It is balanced by toasted pecans, Szechuan peppercorn, and honeyed malt.

  • Finish: Smooth and persistent. The experience ends with notes of buttered kettle corn, toasted nuts, and lingering oak tannins, often described as having a "Suns-out" brightness.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at 100 proof (50% ABV).

title: Casey Jones Kentucky Straight Black Label Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Casey Jones Kentucky Straight Black Label Bourbon (often simply "Black Label") is a small-batch, spicy craft spirit produced in Hopkinsville, Kentucky. It is distilled at Casey Jones Distillery, where Master Distiller Arlon "AJ" Jones utilizes a unique square copper pot still a design legacy from his grandfather, a prolific Prohibition-era still maker. While the distillery's "White Label" is known for its high-corn moonshine profile, the Black Label represents their shift toward a more traditional, rye-forward Kentucky Straight Bourbon.

2. Spirit Description

The Black Label is defined by its "Mash Bill 2," which introduces a significant rye component to provide a spicier, more structured character.

  • Mash Bill: Consists of 80% corn, 16% rye, and 4% malted barley.

  • Maturation: Aged for a minimum of three years in new, charred American white oak barrels.

  • Appearance: Deep amber and gold with slow-moving, oily legs.

  • Nose: A bold, spicy aroma of toasted oak and delicate corn, layered with hints of caramel, vanilla, and dried fruit.

  • Palate: Lively and smooth with a creamy texture. It opens with honey and toasted corn, followed by darker notes of spice, dark berries, and tobacco.

  • Finish: Long and sweet with a persistent heat and a lingering mouthfeel of maple and nutmeg.

  • Technical Details: Typically bottled at 90 proof (54% ABV) to maintain approachability while showcasing its complex small-batch flavors.

title: Reserva Huizar Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Reserva Huizar Anejo Tequila is a premium spirit from Mexico, originating from the traditional agave-growing regions of Jalisco. The brand was established in 2021 by Liliana Huizar as a tribute to her late father, reflecting a commitment to Mexican customs and family values. Production involves hand-harvesting high-quality blue agave and employing traditional transformation methods designed to preserve the purity of the plant.

Spirit Description

This expression is aged for a minimum of 13 months in American oak barrels to achieve a refined balance between agave and wood.

  • Colour: The liquid presents a straw-yellow hue with distinct reddish flashes.

  • Aroma: The nose features perceivable notes of cooked agave framed by intense wood, vanilla, almond, caramel, and cinnamon.

  • Palate: It offers a sensational experience where sweet notes of great intensity confirm the presence of cooked agave, delicately blended with hazelnut and chocolate.

  • Body: The spirit is noted for its smooth texture and harmonious sweet tones.

  • Finish: It concludes with a brilliant confirmation of aromas in the mouth that awaken the senses.

  • ABV: This tequila is typically bottled at 40%.

title: Tommasi Amarone 2021
bodyHtml:
Tommasi Viticoltori, established in 1902, is a family-owned winery located in the heart of Valpolicella Classico. Spanning over four generations, the Tommasi family has been dedicated to producing wines that reflect the tradition and terroir of the region. Their commitment to quality and innovation has positioned them as one of the leading producers in the area.

Wine Description
Tommasi Amarone della Valpolicella Classico presents a deep ruby red hue with garnet reflections. On the nose, it offers an intricate bouquet of ripe cherries, dried figs, and subtle notes of thyme, pomegranate, and espresso. The palate is full-bodied and velvety, showcasing flavours of cherry, plum, and a touch of spice, balanced by well-integrated tannins and a fresh acidity. The finish is long and elegant, leaving a lasting impression of dried fruit and sweet spices.

title: Cabin Super Saturation NEPA 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml:
Super Saturation is the crown jewel of Calgary’s Cabin Brewing Company and arguably the beer that defined the New England style for the Alberta market. Categorized as a New England Pale Ale (NEPA), it is designed to deliver the massive, tropical hop experience of a hazy IPA but with a lower, more sessionable alcohol content. Since its release, it has become a cult favorite, known for its uncompromising "juiciness" and its signature soft, velvety texture. It is a beer that prioritizes aromatic intensity over bitterness, making it a "hop-head" favorite that remains incredibly approachable.

Beer Description

Super Saturation pours a thick, opaque, glowing orange-yellow often compared to a glass of fresh mango or orange juice with a dense, creamy white head.

Aroma: The nose is an absolute "punch" of tropical fruit. It leads with dominant notes of ripe mango, passion fruit, and candied pineapple, followed by a bright, citrusy scent of tangerine and lime zest. There is a distinct "sweetness" to the aroma that suggests a lush, fruit-heavy profile without any harsh pine or resin.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a remarkably soft, "pillowy" mouthfeel. It leads with an explosion of tropical fruit flavors and citrus juice, backed by a gentle, bready malt sweetness. The bitterness is kept exceptionally low, resulting in a smooth, juice-like finish that feels silky rather than sharp.

Profile: It sits at a balanced 6.0% ABV and a very low perceived bitterness, emphasizing hop "flavor" rather than "bite."
