Technical Notes: The signature "haze" and soft texture are the result of a grain bill heavy in flaked oats and wheat, which provide the proteins necessary for that opaque look and creamy mouthfeel. It is heavily double dry-hopped (DDH) with a powerhouse trio of hops: Citra, Simcoe, and Mosaic. By adding these hops during and after fermentation, Cabin extracts the essential oils and fruit aromatics while bypassing the traditional bitterness associated with boiling hops.

title: Ichiro's Malt & Grain World Whisky - 700 ml
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Ichiro's Malt & Grain World Whisky originates from the Chichibu region in the Saitama Prefecture of Japan. It was created by Ichiro Akuto, the founder of the Chichibu Distillery and Venture Whisky Ltd., whose family has been brewing sake since 1625. Established in 2008, Chichibu was the first new distillery in Japan in over three decades and is renowned for its traditional 'craft' approach, including on site floor malting and an in house cooperage.

Spirit Description

Known as the 'white label' expression, this spirit is a unique 'World Blended Whisky' that harmonizes young whiskies from the world's five major whisky producing regions: Scotland, Ireland, Canada, the USA, and Japan. It presents a pale gold colour with a medium body and a smooth, oily texture. The aroma is fresh and floral, featuring notes of apricot, Meyer lemon zest, vanilla cream, and a hint of toffee. On the palate, it is well balanced and approachable, delivering flavours of roasted chestnut, gingerbread, and malted barley with a subtle citrus sweetness. The finish is clean and persistent, marked by a gentle peppery spice and lingering honeyed fruit. It is bottled at 46.5% ABV, non chill filtered, and contains no artificial colouring.

title: Chateau Ste Michelle Eroica Riesling 2024
bodyHtml:
This high-altitude and expressive white wine originates from the Columbia Valley in Washington State, USA. Eroica is a groundbreaking collaboration between two of the world’s most renowned Riesling producers: Château Ste. Michelle and Germany's Dr. Loosen (Erni Loosen). Since its debut in 1999, the winery's philosophy has been to "shatter the myth" that Riesling must be sweet, instead focusing on an Old World-style dry complexity combined with Washington’s vibrant New World fruit.

Wine Description

The Chateau Ste. Michelle & Dr. Loosen Eroica Riesling presents a bright, pale straw colour. The sensory profile is exceptionally fresh and aromatic, featuring a bouquet of white peach, lime zest, and mandarin orange, layered with delicate notes of sweet clover and orange blossom. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied and crisp, showcasing a "racy" acidity and a distinct mineral energy that reflects the region's volcanic soils. It is characterized by its remarkable balance and a clean, refreshing finish with subtle hints of wet stone and slate. This 100% Riesling has an ABV of 12% and a low residual sugar level (approx. 1.3%), placing it in the medium-dry category. The wine is fermented in stainless steel at cool temperatures to preserve its pure fruit character.

title: Jagermeister - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
Jägermeister is a globally renowned herbal liqueur produced in Wolfenbüttel, Germany. Developed in 1934 by Curt Mast, the son of a vinegar manufacturer and an avid hunter, the name translates to "Master Hunter". The brand is owned by the family-run company Mast-Jägermeister SE and is instantly recognizable by its iconic green bottle and the stag emblem, which references the legend of Saint Hubertus.

2. Spirit Description

The production of Jägermeister is a meticulous process that takes roughly a year from start to finish. It is crafted from a secret recipe of 56 botanicals, including star anise, cinnamon, ginger roots, galangal, and orange peel.

  • Maceration: The raw ingredients are ground and steeped in a mixture of alcohol and water for several weeks to extract their essential oils.

  • Aging: The resulting "base" matures for about one year in one of 400 mighty oak barrels, some over a century old, allowing the complex flavours to "breathe" and harmonize.

  • Final Blend: Before bottling, the matured base is filtered and enriched with pure water, alcohol, caramel, and liquid sugar.

  • Profile: It has a thick, syrupy texture with a bold, multi-layered flavour. The experience begins with intense anise and licorice, followed by warm baking spices, a gentle herbal bitterness from roots (like gentian), and a zesty citrus lift.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at 35% ABV (70 proof).

title: Sortilege Canadian Rye Whisky Maple Wood
bodyHtml:
Sortilege Canadian Rye Whisky Maple Wood originates from Montreal, Quebec, Canada. The brand is rooted in an authentic recipe from Quebec's first settlers, who flavoured their spirits with local maple syrup to balance the bold character of rye whisky. This tradition is maintained by Station 22, which focuses on blending the ruggedness of Canadian grains with the natural terroir of the region.

Whisky Description

This whisky presents a rich golden colour reminiscent of deep maple syrup. The aroma is a complex interplay of maple and fruity rye spice, layered with notes of sandalwood, oak, and glimpses of cinnamon and ginger. On the palate, it offers a medium to full body with a slightly syrupy texture, featuring flavours of sweet maple, butterscotch, and vanilla balanced by the heat of rye spice. The finish is long and warming, leaving a subtly smoky and woody impression. Made from high quality Canadian grains, the spirit undergoes three years of ageing in oak barrels before a unique maceration with roasted maple wood chips.

title: Argiano Brunello di Montalcino 2021 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This elegant red wine originates from the Brunello di Montalcino DOCG in the Tuscany region of Italy. Argiano is one of the oldest and most prestigious estates in Montalcino, with a history dating back to 1580 and serving as a founding member of the local wine consortium in 1967. Since 2013, the estate has been owned by André Esteves, who entrusted winemaking to Bernardino Sani; together, they have shifted the philosophy toward terroir-driven, minimal-intervention wines that prioritize elegance and aromatic purity over power.

Wine Description

The Argiano Brunello di Montalcino presents a vivid ruby red colour with important garnet reflections. The sensory profile is broad and sophisticated, featuring expressive aromas of ripe cherry, raspberry, and plum, layered with notes of violets, dried herbs, tobacco, and subtle balsamic hints. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied yet silky, showcasing a rich concentration of wild berries and blood orange balanced by a racy acidity. It is characterized by its fine-grained tannins and a persistent, refined finish that reveals nuances of leather, spice, and earth.

title: Tool Shed People Skills 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml:
People Skills is the beloved flagship "Patio Ale" from Calgary’s Tool Shed Brewing Company. When it launched, it was designed to be the ultimate "gateway" beer a brew that could bridge the gap between the mass-market lagers of the past and the bold, flavorful world of craft. It is a Cream Ale, a traditional North American style known for its smooth, mild, and highly approachable character. True to its name, this beer is built for social settings; it’s unpretentious, technically clean, and engineered to be a "crowd-pleaser" at any backyard BBQ or taproom session.

Beer Description

People Skills pours a brilliant, crystal-clear straw gold with a frothy white head and a lively, effervescent carbonation that looks exceptionally refreshing in the glass.

Aroma: The nose is clean, delicate, and "sunny." It leads with dominant notes of sweet corn and honeyed crackers, followed by a very subtle floral hop scent. There is a faint, fruity ester reminiscent of white grape or pear that gives it a slightly more sophisticated bouquet than a standard pale lager.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a remarkably smooth, "creamy" mouthfeel. It leads with a soft bready sweetness and toasted grain, which is quickly balanced by a very low, herbal bitterness. The finish is crisp and dry, leaving the palate clean and ready for the next sip.

Profile: It sits at a highly sessionable 5.2% ABV and a very low bitterness of 18 IBU, prioritizing "drinkability" over hop intensity.

Technical Notes: Although it is an Ale (top-fermented), People Skills borrows techniques from the lager world. It is brewed with a blend of malted barley and flaked corn, the latter of which provides that signature "cream ale" sweetness and a lighter body. Tool Shed utilizes a specific cool-fermentation process and an extended cold-aging period to ensure the beer is as crisp and clean as a lager while maintaining the subtle fruity complexity of an ale.

title: Blindman Five of Diamonds 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml:
Five of Diamonds is the cornerstone Pilsner from Lacombe’s Blindman Brewing, widely considered one of the finest examples of the style in Western Canada. While many craft breweries chase the latest trends, Blindman used this beer to prove their technical mastery of the "simplest" and most difficult style to brew. It is a Pilsner that honors the traditions of the Old World specifically the crispness of a German Pilsner and the bready soul of a Czech Budvar while utilizing the world-class barley grown right in Blindman's backyard. It is designed to be the "everyday" beer for the discerning drinker.

Beer Description

Five of Diamonds pours a brilliant, sparkling straw-gold with a dense, snow-white head that persists with remarkable "meringue-like" stability.

Aroma: The nose is clean, elegant, and "bright." It leads with dominant notes of freshly baked bread and honeyed cracker, followed by a sophisticated floral and herbal spicy scent from noble hops. There is a distinct "lager-clean" quality, free of any fruity esters, smelling purely of high-quality grain and field flowers.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a crisp, high-carbonation "snap." It leads with a delicate malty sweetness and toasted grain, which is almost immediately balanced by a firm, refreshing bitterness. The finish is exceptionally dry and "short," meaning the flavor cleanses from the tongue quickly, leaving only a faint, pleasant herbal tea note.

Profile: It sits at a perfectly balanced 4.8% ABV and a moderate bitterness of approx. 30–35 IBU, providing a much more structured "bite" than a standard domestic lager.

Technical Notes: This beer is a showcase of Alberta Heritage Select malt, a premium base malt that provides a richer, more complex grain character than standard 2-row. It is brewed using traditional European Noble Hops (likely Loral or Hallertau Tradition) and undergoes a long, cold lagering period. This patient maturation process allows the yeast to drop out completely, resulting in its signature diamond-like clarity and ultra-clean fermentation profile.

title: Reserva Huizar Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Reserva Huizar Extra Anejo is an ultra premium tequila produced in Mexico, specifically within the renowned agave growing region of Jalisco. The brand was established in 2021 by Liliana Huizar, who developed the spirit as a tribute to her late father and to preserve Mexican family traditions and values. Each expression is crafted from hand harvested blue agave and produced using traditional transformation methods designed to maintain the pure essence of the plant.

Spirit Description

This Extra Anejo expression represents the pinnacle of the Huizar portfolio, characterized by an extended maturation process in American oak barrels.

  • Colour: The liquid presents a deep, rich amber tone with golden reflections acquired from its long rest in wood.

  • Aroma: The nose is highly aromatic, featuring intense notes of cooked agave balanced by prominent scents of toasted oak, vanilla, and dark chocolate.

  • Palate: It offers a sophisticated and complex flavour profile, with sweet notes of great intensity that recall 'agave cousu' (cooked agave) alongside layers of almond, caramel, and hazelnut.

  • Body: The spirit is notably smooth and full bodied, providing a velvety mouthfeel that reflects its superior age.

  • Finish: The experience concludes with a long, elegant finish that lingers with warm baking spices such as cinnamon and a refined woody character.

  • ABV: This tequila is typically bottled at 35% - 40%.

title: Morris Single Malt Signature Whisky – 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Morris Single Malt Signature Whisky is produced in Australia, specifically in the Rutherglen region of North East Victoria. While the Morris family has been renowned for producing world class fortified wines since 1859, they expanded into whisky production in 2016 following a union with the Casella family to form the Cooper & Grain Distilling Co.. The distillery utilizes a fully restored hybrid copper pot and column still, originally installed at the winery in 1941, to create spirits that reflect the local terroir and a century of family craftsmanship.

Spirit Description

Crafted from 100% Australian malted barley and water from the Snowy Mountains, this signature expression is matured in local ex red wine barrels before a final finish in the distillery's own fortified wine casks.

  • Colour: The whisky presents a medium gold appearance with bright topaz hues.

  • Aroma: The nose is a balance of sweet orchard fruits, macerated black cherries, and fine biscuit notes, complemented by floral accents.

  • Palate: It offers an extremely well rounded mouthfeel featuring zesty marmalade jam, rich dark chocolate, and persistent dark berry flavours such as blackberry.

  • Body: The spirit is described as wonderfully well rounded with a pleasantly delicate and silky texture.

  • Finish: A long and refreshing finish delivers an intense depth of dried fruit character that lingers on the palate.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at 40% or 44% depending on the specific market release.

title: Graham's 20 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
#57 on Wine Spectator’s Top 100 Wines of 2025

This Tawny Port achieved significant global recognition after being named #57 on Wine Spectator’s Top 100 Wines of 2025, a prestigious list released in late 2024.

Graham's 20 Year Old Tawny Port originates from Portugal, specifically from the Douro Valley region and the Porto subregion. Founded in 1820 by brothers William and John Graham, the house has spent over two centuries building a reputation as one of the most prestigious names in Port. The estate is currently owned by the Symington family, who oversee five iconic vineyards—Quinta dos Malvedos, Quinta do Tua, Quinta das Lages, Quinta da Vila Velha, and Quinta do Vale de Malhadas—to source the finest grapes. The winemaking philosophy is defined by three 'unique arts': the art of blending, the art of cooperage, and the art of ageing, aimed at achieving the perfect balance between the vibrancy of young wines and the complexity of aged ones.

Wine Description

This fortified wine presents a brilliant amber, golden tawny colour and a rich, medium-to-full body. The sensory profile is deeply complex, featuring an excellent bouquet with a characteristic nutty aroma alongside mature fruit notes of raisin, dried apricot, and orange peel. On the palate, it is softly sweet and smooth, delivering flavours of toffee, caramel, honey, and dried figs, balanced by a fresh acidity and hints of toasted almonds. The finish is remarkably long and elegant, showcasing a persistent 'caramel-goodness' and a subtle touch of spice.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional field blend typically consisting of Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Amarela, and Alicante Bouschet.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is a blend of selected lots that have aged for an average of 20 years in seasoned oak casks, resulting in a 'mellowed' character and extraordinary complexity.

  • ABV: Recorded at 20%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery follows sustainable and traditional production methods, this specific Tawny Port is produced through conventional viticulture.

title: Barons de Rothschild Brut - 6 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This refined and complex non-vintage sparkling wine originates from the Champagne region of France. The Maison de Champagne Barons de Rothschild was established in 2005, representing a historic and unprecedented alliance between the three branches of the Rothschild family: Baron Philippe Sereys de Rothschild (Château Mouton Rothschild), Baron Eric de Rothschild (Château Lafite Rothschild), and Baroness Ariane de Rothschild (Edmond de Rothschild Group). The house's philosophy is rooted in five pillars; Chardonnay, Grands and Premiers Crus, reserve wines, purity of dosage, and time aiming to create a 'Grand Vin de Champagne' that reflects the family's shared values of 'Unity, Integrity, and Industry'.

Wine Description

The Barons de Rothschild Brut presents a brilliant, pale golden colour with fine bubbles and a persistent mousse. The sensory profile is exceptionally fine, featuring an aromatic nose of pear, nuts (almonds and fresh hazelnuts), white flowers, and delicate toasty notes. On the palate, the wine is powerful yet contained, opening with an assertive energy that gives way to a well-rounded and harmonious structure. It is characterized by its elegance and precision, showcasing flavours of ripe orchard fruits, lemon zest, and subtle hints of brioche. This cuvée is a blend of 60% Chardonnay and 40% Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier, with an ABV of 12%. The wine is produced using sustainable viticulture and features a low dosage of approximately 6 g/L, followed by at least four years of bottle aging and six months of rest after disgorgement.

title: Antech Cremant De Limoux Emotion Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
This elegant sparkling wine originates from the Limoux region in Languedoc, France, which is historically recognized as the birthplace of sparkling wine (dating back to 1531). Maison Antech is a family owned estate now led by Françoise Antech, who represents the sixth generation of winemakers dedicated to the traditional method. The "Émotion" cuvée is crafted to reflect femininity and elegance, sourcing fruit from the estate's high-altitude vineyards where the Mediterranean and Atlantic climates meet.

Wine Description

The Antech Crémant de Limoux Émotion Rosé presents a delicate pale pink colour with a fine, persistent bead. The sensory profile is fresh and refined, featuring a bouquet of red berries (wild strawberry and raspberry) and white spring flowers. On the palate, the wine is crisp and harmonious, showcasing a balanced acidity and a creamy texture from 15 months of aging on the lees. It is characterized by its vivacity and a clean, fruity finish. This blend consists of Chardonnay, Chenin Blanc, and Mauzac, with a small percentage of Pinot Noir added for its signature rosé hue and structure. It typically has an ABV of 12% and is finished with a Brut dosage of approximately 8-10 g/L.

title: Chateau Marquis de Terme 2018
bodyHtml:
This acclaimed French red achieved significant global recognition after being named #30 on Wine Spectator’s Top 100 Wines of 2025, a prestigious list released in late 2024.

Chateau Marquis de Terme originates from France, specifically from the Bordeaux region and the prestigious Margaux appellation. The estate's modern history began in 1762 as a wedding dowry for François de Peguilhan, Marquis de Terme, whose name it still bears. In 1935, Pierre Seneclauze acquired the property, and it remains a family owned estate today, managed by his three sons. The winery follows a philosophy of precision and low intervention, utilizing sustainable practices that led to official organic certification in 2017.

Wine Description

This Grand Cru Classé presents a deep and intense ruby or purple red colour and a medium to full body. The sensory profile is complex, featuring a nose of blackcurrant, blueberry, and pomegranate, accented by notes of violet, cedar, menthol, and black chocolate. On the elegant palate, it delivers flavours of sweet fresh blackberries, cocoa, and fleshy black cherry, given restraint by hints of slate, graphite, and pink peppercorn. The finish is long and fresh, showcasing silky, delicate tannins and a touch of liquorice.

title: Michter's Toasted Barrel Finish Sour Mash (Limited Release)
bodyHtml:
Michter's US1 Toasted Barrel Finish Sour Mash is a limited-release American whiskey that builds upon the distillery's acclaimed US1 Sour Mash Whiskey. This expression undergoes a unique finishing process, enhancing its flavor profile and complexity.

Production Process

The journey begins with Michter's US*1 Sour Mash Whiskey, which is fully matured in charred new American white oak barrels. After this initial aging, the whiskey is transferred to a second custom-made barrel crafted from 18-month air-dried wood. This secondary barrel is toasted but not charred, a process that imparts additional nuanced flavors to the whiskey.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: Aromas of toffee and buttery vanilla emerge prominently, accompanied by fragrant honey, milk chocolate, and a subtle hint of orange peel.

  • Palate: The entry is smooth, presenting flavors of caramel and sweet vanilla. Mid-palate, toasty campfire notes intensify, complementing undertones of cherry and spice, leading to an elegant and balanced finish.

Serving Suggestions

To fully appreciate its intricate flavors, it's recommended to enjoy Michter's US*1 Toasted Barrel Finish Sour Mash neat or with a few drops of water. This approach allows the whiskey's complexity to unfold, offering a rich and rewarding tasting experience.

title: Ridge Vineyards Lytton Springs Estate 2023
bodyHtml:
#3 Wine Spectator Top 100 2025

The 2023 Ridge Vineyards Lytton Springs Estate has achieved significant critical acclaim, most notably being named the #3 Wine of the Year for 2025 by Wine Spectator. This prestigious ranking makes it the highest-rated Zinfandel ever in the history of the publication's annual Top 100 list.

Ridge Vineyards Lytton Springs Estate 2023 originates from the United States, specifically from the Dry Creek Valley region and the Sonoma County subregion in California. The vineyard’s history began in 1972 when Ridge made its first Lytton Springs wine from vines planted at the turn of the century; the estate was officially purchased by the winery in 1991. Ridge Vineyards follows a 'pre-industrial' winemaking philosophy, relying on natural primary and secondary fermentations with native yeasts and minimal intervention to preserve the fruit's distinctive character and site expression.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a dark crimson or deep garnet colour and a medium to full body with a structured, elegant frame. The sensory profile features a powerfully aromatic nose of raspberry, black pepper, licorice, and subtle vanilla, often accented by notes of potpourri and sandalwood. On the palate, it delivers a core of black cherry, plum, and marionberry fruit supported by supple tannins, bright acidity, and a stony minerality. The finish is remarkably long and layered, revealing complex notes of garrigue, dried herbs, and black tea.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional field blend of 76% Zinfandel, 14% Petite Sirah, 7% Carignane, 2% Alicante Bouschet, and 1% Mataro.

  • Stylistic Notes: The 2023 vintage is noted for its refined mouthfeel, poise, and exceptional length, presenting a more nuanced and restrained expression compared to previous years.

  • ABV: Recorded at 14.4%.

  • Organic Status: This wine is produced from 100% organically grown estate grapes and is fermented without added industrial yeasts or enzymes.

Food Pairing

The structured elegance and peppery fruit profile of Lytton Springs make it an excellent companion for rich and savoury dishes. Suggested pairings include lamb tacos served with a sweet mole sauce or roasted lamb chops to complement the wine's earthy undertones. It also pairs effectively with hot Italian sausage sandwiches featuring roasted peppers, smoked brisket, or smash burgers. For a more casual pairing, it works well with mushroom based dishes or heavier salads that can stand up to its medium body.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in Dry Creek Valley was defined by a cool, wet winter and a mild summer that allowed for slow, even ripening. This remarkably cool season delayed the start of the harvest by approximately one month, resulting in a vintage characterized by greater restraint, vibrant acidity, and more refined fruit intensity than previous warmer years.

title: The Glenlivet 55 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 55 Year Old is the oldest single malt whisky ever released by the Speyside distillery. It is the inaugural release in the Eternal Collection, a sequence of five annual limited editions intended to celebrate the distillery's 200th anniversary in 2024. Founded in 1824 by George Smith, The Glenlivet was the first legal distillery in the parish and has grown to become the top selling single malt in the United States and the second largest globally. Today, the distillery is owned by the Chivas Brothers subsidiary of the French spirits group Pernod Ricard.

Spirit Description

This precious expression was crafted from a seasoned sherry cask and matured for more than half a century. It is presented at a natural cask strength of 42.2% ABV.

  • Colour: Information not explicitly provided, though its long sherry cask maturation typically imparts deep, rich amber tones.

  • Aroma: The nose opens with a gentle sweetness of poached pears and autumn fruits harmonised with zesty Seville oranges and sticky dates. These notes are grounded by toasted hazelnut, dark chocolate, cinnamon, and nutmeg.

  • Palate: It delivers deep flavours of homemade blackcurrant jam, vanilla fudge, and dark chocolate, balanced with zesty orange and crystallised ginger. A touch of warming clove spice provides a complex finish to the palate.

  • Body: The spirit is described as deep, warming, and meticulously balanced, transcending generations through its complexity.

  • Finish: The finish is exceptionally long and evolves through distinct layers of fruit and spice before culminating in a subtle, dry, and spicy warmth.

Accolades

As an ultra rare release limited to only 100 bottles globally, The Glenlivet 55 Year Old is primarily recognized for its historical significance and unique artistic presentation.

  • Artist Collaboration: The spherical decanter is housed in a hand sculpted jesmonite sculpture with rose gold plating, designed by computational architect Michael Hansmeyer.

  • Charity Milestone: An inaugural bottle of this series sold for £63,000 at auction, with proceeds benefiting the National Trust for Scotland.

  • Heritage Tribute: The expression has been lauded as a meticulously crafted tribute to the distillery's 200 year legacy of tradition and innovation.

title: The Glent Grant 65 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The Glen Grant 65 Year Old is a rare and prestigious single malt Scotch whisky from the Speyside region of Scotland. It marks the inaugural release of the Splendours Collection, a series designed to showcase the most exceptional casks maturing at the distillery. The Glen Grant was founded in 1840 by brothers John and James Grant and was later famously expanded by James 'The Major' Grant, who introduced the tall, slender stills and water cooling purifiers that define the brand's elegant style. Today, the distillery is owned by the Italian company Campari Group.

Spirit Description

This extraordinary whisky was distilled in 1958 and matured for six and a half decades in a single French oak butt within Warehouse No. 4, the distillery's oldest traditional stone dunnage warehouse. It is bottled at a natural cask strength of 55.5% ABV.

  • Colour: It possesses deep and captivating hues of mahogany.

  • Aroma: The nose is abundantly sweet with notes of syrupy treacle, balanced by the juiciness of ripe blackberries and subtle hints of sandalwood.

  • Palate: It delivers vibrant bursts of orange complemented by ripe black cherries, rich fruit cake, and sweet, sticky dates.

  • Body: The spirit is complex and viscous, retaining the signature Glen Grant DNA while exhibiting the profound influence of ultra high age.

  • Finish: It concludes with a smooth crescendo of citrus, light spice, and oak, featuring a delicate hint of smoke that reflects the historical use of peat in the distillery's 1950s production.

Accolades

As a highly limited release of only 151 decanters worldwide, the Glen Grant 65 Year Old is presented in a handcrafted masterpiece designed by artist John Galvin and Glasstorm.

  • Design Concept: The decanter is shaped as a Mobius strip seed pod, symbolising the timelessness of nature and the life cycle of the rare Himalayan Blue Poppy.

  • Market Standing: It is positioned in the ultra luxury whisky segment alongside other esteemed high age releases like the Macallan 65 Year Old and The Dalmore 60 Year Old.

  • Heritage Tribute: The expression serves as a tribute to the legacy of the Grant forefathers and the meticulous stewardship of the distillery's rare inventory.

title: The Bard Distillery Muhlenberg Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Bard Muhlenberg Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey is a hand-crafted, small-batch spirit produced in Graham, Kentucky. It is the flagship wheated expression from The Bard Distillery, which was founded in 2019 by Thomas and Kim Bard. The distillery is located in a historic 1920s school building on a hill overlooking the coal-mining town of Graham in Muhlenberg County. This specific bourbon is intended as a "heartfelt tribute" to the hard-working miners of the region and is often referred to as the "Spirit of Muhlenberg".

Spirit Description

Unlike the distillery's Cinder & Smoke line, which typically uses a rye-forward mash bill, the Muhlenberg Bourbon is a wheated bourbon. It is distilled, aged, and bottled onsite at the distillery.

  • Mash Bill: A combination of corn, wheat, and malted barley.

  • Appearance: A warm, rich amber hue.

  • Nose: Inviting and sweet, featuring prominent aromas of warm caramel, vanilla bean, and toasted oak, with subtle hints of dried fruits and baking spices.

  • Palate: Known for a smooth, velvety, and full-bodied mouthfeel. It is dominated by flavours of sweet butterscotch, toffee, and dark chocolate, beautifully balanced by notes of ripe cherry and cinnamon.

  • Finish: Long and highly satisfying, leaving a lingering sensation of sweet caramel and gentle oak.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at a robust 105 proof (52.5% ABV), though it is noted for being "surprisingly smooth" for its high alcohol content.

title: The Bard Distillery Muhlenberg John Prine 2025 Edition Bourbon - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
The Bard Distillery John Prine 2025 Edition is a limited-run Kentucky Straight Bourbon produced in Graham, Kentucky. Released in October 2025, this expression is a high-profile collaboration between The Bard Distillery, Oh Boy Records, and The Hello In There Foundation. It was created to commemorate the final year of "You Got Gold," a week-long celebration of the life and songs of the legendary singer-songwriter John Prine. All proceeds from the sales benefit Prine's family-founded non-profit, which supports marginalized and forgotten communities.

Spirit Description

The 2025 Edition is a significant departure from the distillery's first John Prine release in 2022, which was a wheated bourbon.

  • Maturation: This is a 5-year-old straight bourbon matured in the distillery's historic 1920s schoolhouse-turned-rickhouse.

  • Mash Bill: A rye-forward recipe consisting of corn, rye, and malted barley.

  • Aroma & Palate: Described as a "caramel bomb," the nose features black tea, toffee, and brown sugar. The palate is layered and austere, offering unique notes of black tea, crème brûlée, almond, and pecan, balanced by a spicy rye kick of cinnamon and pepper.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at 101 proof (50.5% ABV) as a tribute to John Prine's birthday on October 10th.

  • Availability: Limited to only 7,000 bottles worldwide.

title: The Bard Distillery Cinder and Smoke Bourbon Oloroso
bodyHtml:
Cinder & Smoke Oloroso Cask Bourbon is a limited-edition craft spirit produced in the United States, specifically in Graham, Muhlenberg County, Kentucky. It is produced by The Bard Distillery, which was founded in 2019 by Thomas and Kim Bard. Thomas Bard is the 4th-great-grandson of one of the two brothers who founded Bardstown, KY, the "Bourbon Capital of the World". The distillery is uniquely housed in a restored 1920s Art Deco school building, where the whiskey matures in former classrooms with original cinder block walls and no climate control.

Spirit Description

This expression is a Kentucky Straight Bourbon that has been hand-blended in very small batches and finished in Spanish Oloroso Sherry Casks.

  • Maturation: While the exact age of the Oloroso finish varies by batch, the series typically utilizes well-aged sourced barrels that are then finished at the distillery to integrate the dark fruit notes of the sherry.

  • Appearance: Deep amber with reddish mahogany reflections.

  • Nose: A complex and evocative bouquet featuring toffee, toasting marshmallows, and dried fruits (raisins and dark cherries), balanced by a hint of soft smoke and toasted oak.

  • Palate: Rich and layered, offering a "bold, smoke-influenced" profile where sherry-soaked fruit and caramel meet cocoa and warming baking spices.

  • Finish: Long and warming, characterized by a distinct "smoky, drying finish" with lingering notes of dark chocolate and oak.

  • Technical Details: Typically bottled at 100 proof (50% ABV) or 101 proof (50.5% ABV).

title: The Bard Distillery Cinder & Smoke Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Bard Cinder & Smoke 13 Year Old is a premium, limited-edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon produced in Graham, Muhlenberg County. It is the crown jewel of the Cinder & Smoke series from The Bard Distillery, which was founded in 2019 by Thomas and Kim Bard. Thomas is the 4th-great-grandson of the brothers who founded Bardstown, the "Bourbon Capital of the World". This expression is hand-blended in extremely small batches from a limited collection of "well-seasoned" mature barrels.

Spirit Description

This 13-year-old bourbon is bottled at cask strength, ensuring the full essence and depth of the long aging process are preserved.

  • Maturation: The "Cinder & Smoke" profile is achieved by selecting barrels that exhibit a natural interplay between sweet char and deep oak.

  • Appearance: Deep chestnut with oily, slow-moving "legs" on the glass.

  • Nose: Delicate yet impressively deep; it opens with iconic bourbon notes of vanilla and butterscotch, layered with wet oak, leather, and hints of holiday spices.

  • Palate: It features a buttery, creamy mouthfeel and a "unique" flavour profile where mild cinder and smoke are noticeable but not overpowering. Dominant notes include rich treacle, dark fruit, and a beautiful floral, perfume-like quality.

  • Finish: Long, smooth, and sophisticated; the floral notes linger as spices soften into a salted caramel exit.

  • Technical Details: While batches vary, it is typically found around 97.8 to 99.3 proof (48.9%–49.65% ABV).

title: Cirro Wines Sauvignon Blanc 2023
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Cirro Wines Sauvignon Blanc 2023 is a vibrant expression of the Wairau Valley subregion within Marlborough, New Zealand.

Founded by winemakers David Tyney and Richard Green, Cirro Wines is named after the high-altitude cirrus clouds that soar above the Southern Alps. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a 'hands-on' approach, with both founders spending significant time in the vineyards to determine the optimum harvest time and implement organic viticultural techniques. Drawing on their extensive global experience, Tyney and Green focus on small-scale production from four single vineyards where vines average at least 20 years in age, aiming to create wines that capture the distinctively fresh and mineral character of the region.

Wine Description

This 2023 Sauvignon Blanc presents a pristine and bright appearance in the glass. The inviting bouquet reveals a complex array of aromas, including green rockmelon, feijoa, white flowers, and citrus notes of lemon and grapefruit, occasionally lifted by a hint of flint or white pepper. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium bodied with a juicy fruit intensity featuring flavours of pear, nettles, and tropical fruit. It is characterized by its integrated, crisp acidity and a textured, savoury finish with a notable mineral or 'wet stone' quality.

The wine is 100% Sauvignon Blanc, sourced from premium vineyards close to Renwick in the middle of the Wairau Valley. It is crafted using traditional cool-climate winemaking techniques, including cool fermentation in stainless steel to preserve its aromatic purity. The 2023 vintage has an ABV of 12.5%. While the 'home block' is farmed organically, this specific label represents a consistent Marlborough style that emphasizes the region's natural vibrancy.

Food Pairing

The tangy and refreshing profile of this Sauvignon Blanc makes it an ideal match for various seafood dishes, particularly fresh oysters with a squeeze of lime, grilled prawns, or pan-seared scallops. It also pairs effectively with herbal and vegetable-forward cuisine, such as Thai larb, green goddess hummus, or salads featuring peppery arugula and spring vegetables. For a classic cheese pairing, consider young, tangy options like goat cheese or feta.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Marlborough was defined by a warm growing season and regular rainfall, which led to above-average yields and high bunch numbers. A settled period in March and April allowed the fruit to ripen fully, developing higher brix levels than the previous year and desirable flavour characteristics. Winemakers adapted to the wetter conditions by implementing rigorous canopy management and additional spray rounds to ensure the health and quality of the crop.

title: Double Diamond Proprietary Red 2021 (by Schrader Cellars)
bodyHtml:
Schrader Cellars, established by Fred Schrader in 1998, has garnered acclaim for producing exceptional Napa Valley wines. In 2000, Schrader expanded his vision by launching Double Diamond, aiming to craft exquisite Cabernet Sauvignon that embodies Napa Valley's finest qualities. Renowned winemaker Thomas Rivers Brown, who has been instrumental in Schrader's success, oversees the Double Diamond portfolio, ensuring each wine reflects the winery's dedication to excellence.

Wine Description

Double Diamond Napa Valley Proprietary Red Wine is a meticulously crafted Bordeaux-style blend comprising 52% Cabernet Sauvignon, 24% Merlot, and 24% Cabernet Franc. This wine presents a fragrant bouquet of mixed berry compote, crushed ivy, iron, and vanilla bean. On the palate, it is full-bodied and generously concentrated, offering notes of ripe black fruits, spice, dark chocolate, and espresso. The wine is framed with silky tannins, balanced acidity, and a lingering finish, making it approachable upon release while possessing the structure to cellar gracefully for years to come.

title: J Lohr Cabernet Sauvignon 'Seven Oaks' 2022
bodyHtml:
The ‘Seven Oaks’ Cabernet Sauvignon showcases a deep ruby colour with a garnet hue at the rim. On the nose, it bursts with ripe black cherry, blueberry, and plum, interwoven with notes of vanilla, mocha, and toasted oak. The palate is plush and full-bodied, offering layers of dark berry fruit, dark chocolate, and subtle spice, supported by velvety tannins and balanced acidity. The finish is smooth and lingering, leaving impressions of blackberry and sweet oak. Composed primarily of Cabernet Sauvignon, it may also include small portions of Merlot, Petit Verdot, and other Bordeaux varietals typical of the Seven Oaks blend. Enjoy this wine optimally over the next 5–7 years to appreciate its vibrant fruit and integrated oak.

Food Pairing

Try pairing this rich Cabernet with grilled ribeye steak, herb-crusted lamb chops, or a hearty mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Ol' Beautiful Brass Monkey Blood Orange Blonde  355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Ol' Beautiful Brass Monkey is a refreshing, fruit-forward twist on the classic blonde ale from Calgary’s Ol' Beautiful Brewing Co. This beer is designed to be the ultimate easy-drinking companion, taking the clean foundations of a traditional blonde ale and infusing it with a bold, citrusy personality. It has quickly become a local favorite for its bright character and high "crushability" factor.

Beer Description

This Blood Orange Blonde pours a beautiful, slightly hazy golden-orange hue with a frothy, white head that lingers.

Aroma: The nose is immediately greeted by a burst of fresh, zesty blood orange. This dominant citrus note is backed by subtle hints of sweet cracker malt and a very faint floral hop presence.

Palate: It offers a crisp and light-bodied mouthfeel with a gentle malt sweetness. The blood orange provides a tangy, juicy fruit character that is bright but not overpowering, finishing clean and dry with almost no bitterness.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% and a very low IBU, making it an incredibly smooth, refreshing, and accessible choice for those who enjoy fruit-integrated beers.

Technical Notes: Brewed as a clean American Blonde Ale and infused with natural blood orange to achieve its signature flavor profile. The focus is on balancing the tartness of the fruit with a mellow malt backbone to ensure it remains a beer-first beverage.

title: Canvasback 'Grand Passage Red Mountain' Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
This ultra-premium red wine originates from the Red Mountain AVA in Washington State, USA. Canvasback, established by the famed Duckhorn Portfolio, created the "Grand Passage" as their pinnacle expression of the region. The winery's philosophy focuses on capturing the "power without weight" that defines Red Mountain, specifically sourcing from the most elite blocks of their estate Longwinds Vineyard and other top-tier sites like Klipsun and Quintessence. The 2022 vintage represents a commitment to the intense, structured, and age-worthy profile that has made this sub-appellation world-famous.

Wine Description

The Canvasback Grand Passage Red Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 presents an opaque, deep purple colour. The sensory profile is remarkably concentrated and complex, opening with a dense bouquet of black plum, huckleberry, and marionberry, layered with sophisticated notes of anise, graphite, crushed stones, and sandalwood. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and monumental, showcasing a core of dark fruit balanced by Red Mountain's signature firm, "mountain-grown" tannins and a refreshing mineral lift. It is characterized by its seamless integration of power and finesse, leading to an epic finish with hints of dark cocoa, espresso, and savory dried herbs. This blend is typically composed of nearly 100% Cabernet Sauvignon and was matured for approximately 20 months in 100% French oak (approx. 80-100% new) to support its massive structure.

Food Pairing

The significant structure and concentrated fruit of this Cabernet make it a natural partner for the richest and most savory proteins. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled wagyu ribeye, roasted venison with a huckleberry reduction, or slow-braised lamb shanks. Its earthy and toasty undertones also complement dishes featuring black truffles, wild mushroom ragù, and intensely flavored reductions. For a cheese course, it is a classic match for aged, salty hard cheeses like 24-month aged Gouda or Mimolette.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Red Mountain is being hailed for its purity and structural balance. Following a cool spring that delayed budding, a warm and consistent summer allowed the fruit to develop deep colour and phenolic complexity without excessive sugar levels. A glorious October "Indian Summer" provided the final polish to the tannins while preserving a vibrant natural acidity. Critics note that the 2022 Grand Passage displays a particular elegance and "racy" vitality that will allow it to age beautifully for two decades or more.

title: Migration Keefer Ranch Chardonay 2022
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and textural white wine originates from the Sonoma Coast in California, United States. As part of the Duckhorn Portfolio, Migration is dedicated to crafting wines from the finest cool-climate regions. The winery's philosophy is centred on highlighting the tension and balance of top-tier sites, with this specific bottling sourced from the legendary Keefer Ranch Vineyard. Planted by Marcy Keefer in 1996 and situated on an eastern-facing slope with Goldridge soil, this "grand cru-caliber" vineyard produces fruit with soaring aromatics and a unique mineral energy.

Wine Description

The Migration Sonoma Coast Chardonnay Keefer Ranch 2022 presents a luminous, pale straw colour. The sensory profile is tantalizing and complex, featuring an expressive nose of stone fruit, Fuji apple, and lemon curd, layered with sophisticated notes of white floral blossoms, brioche, and orange blossom. On the palate, the wine is impressively structured and medium-bodied, showcasing a lush, textural mouthfeel balanced by a racy, cool-climate acidity. It is characterized by its seamless harmony, leading to a long finish with hints of vanilla, custard, and sweet baking spices. This 100% estate Chardonnay has an ABV of 14.2% and was aged for 10 months in 100% French oak (39% new and 61% neutral) with 75% malolactic fermentation.

Food Pairing

The bright acidity and balanced oak influence of this Chardonnay make it a versatile partner for elevated seafood and poultry dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with sauteed chicken with butternut squash ravioli or a creamy sage sauce. Its citrus and stone fruit notes also complement scrumptious seafood, such as lobster tails, grilled sea bass, or a savory fish stew. For a unique pairing, try it with caramelized pear filled with cheese fondue or chanterelle mushroom stuffed chicken breast.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 growing season in the Sonoma Coast was compact and eventful, yet it produced fruit with spectacular quality and concentrated flavours. Following a warm summer, a significant heat event near Labor Day provided the final push for the grapes to reach ideal ripeness, resulting in Chardonnays with lush fruit profiles and lively natural acidity. Critics have noted that the 2022 Keefer Ranch bottling successfully captures the vineyard's signature tension, offering a "beautifully textural" experience with opulent layers.

title: Sonoma Cutrer 'Owsley Vineyard' Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
This elegant and refined red wine originates from the Russian River Valley in Sonoma County, California. Sonoma-Cutrer, founded in 1973, is legendary for its focus on Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, with the Owsley Vineyard serving as one of its most prized estate sites. The winery's philosophy is rooted in "Grand Cru" standards, utilizing high-density planting and cooling maritime influences to produce fruit with exceptional concentration. The Owsley Vineyard is unique for its dramatic temperature swings and sandy Goldridge soils, which impart a signature brightness and "forest floor" complexity to the Pinot Noir.

Wine Description

The Sonoma-Cutrer Owsley Pinot Noir 2022 presents a beautiful, deep ruby colour. The sensory profile is classic and expressive, featuring an aromatic nose of blackberry, dark cherry, and wild strawberry, layered with sophisticated notes of rhubarb, black tea, and sweet baking spices. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and silky, showcasing a refined structure with supple tannins and a vibrant, crisp acidity. It is characterized by its balance and "racy" vitality, leading to a long, graceful finish with hints of toasty oak and earthy minerals. This 100% Pinot Noir typically has an ABV of 14.2% and was aged for approximately 11 to 14 months in French oak (approx. 30-35% new) to enhance its textural depth without overpowering the delicate fruit.

Food Pairing

The elegant structure and bright acidity of this Pinot Noir make it an exceptionally food-friendly wine. It pairs perfectly with roasted poultry, such as a herb-crusted chicken or duck breast with a cherry reduction. Its earthy undertones also complement mushroom-based dishes like wild mushroom risotto or truffle-infused pasta. For a more substantial pairing, consider grilled salmon or a lean cut of lamb with rosemary. For cheese, it is a classic match for creamy, earthy varieties like Brie, Camembert, or mild Gruyère.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in the Russian River Valley was a compact and eventful growing season that produced fruit with exceptional aromatic purity. Following a warm summer, a significant heat event in early September accelerated the final ripening process, resulting in fruit with concentrated flavours and deep colour. Winemakers at Sonoma-Cutrer utilized precise harvest timing to ensure the grapes maintained the refreshing acidity and elegance that are hallmarks of the Owsley Vineyard style. Critics have noted that the 2022 release shows a particular "vibrancy and poise," making it accessible now while possessing the structure to age gracefully for several years.

title: Migration 'Dutton Ranch Jewell Vineyard' Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and radiant white wine originates from the Russian River Valley in Sonoma County, California. Migration, a member of the prestigious Duckhorn Portfolio, is dedicated to crafting wines from the finest cool-climate regions. The winery's philosophy is rooted in exploring the limits of cool-climate viticulture, with this specific bottling sourced from the legendary Dutton Ranch-Jewell Vineyard. Farmed by the iconic Dutton family for over a decade, the Jewell Vineyard is situated in one of the coolest pockets of the appellation, where sandy soils and coastal fog create a bright, captivated expression of Chardonnay with remarkable depth and texture.

Wine Description

The Migration Russian River Valley Chardonnay Dutton Ranch Jewell Vineyard 2022 presents a lush and luminous profile. The sensory profile is expressive and multi-layered, featuring a sophisticated bouquet of Fuji apple, stone fruit, summer melon, and white flowers, accented by bright notes of lemon zest and honeysuckle. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and energetic, showcasing lively layers of fresh citrus and orchard fruit framed by a refreshing acidity. It is characterized by its broad texture and integrated phenolics, culminating in a long, vibrant finish with subtle hints of minerality and vanilla. This 100% Chardonnay has an ABV of 14.2% and was aged for 10 months in 100% French oak (37% new and 63% neutral), with 75% undergoing malolactic fermentation to balance its creamy richness with zesty freshness.

title: Goldeneye Ten Degrees Anderson Valley Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
This flagship red wine originates from the Anderson Valley in Mendocino County, California. Goldeneye, founded by Dan and Margaret Duckhorn in 1996, was established to create a world-class Pinot Noir that could rival the great wines of Burgundy. The "Ten Degrees" bottling is the pinnacle of the estate's portfolio, named after the unique ten-degree temperature variation typically found between the cooler "Deep End" of the valley and the slightly warmer gardens of the upper valley. The winery's philosophy for this cuvée is to create a "best of the best" blend, selecting only the most exceptional barrels from their estate vineyards to showcase the ultimate complexity of the region.

Wine Description

The Goldeneye Anderson Valley Pinot Noir Ten Degrees 2021 presents a deep and radiant ruby colour. The sensory profile is remarkably sophisticated and multi-layered, featuring an expressive nose of blackberry, dark cherry, and wild strawberry, underpinned by elegant notes of pennyroyal, star anise, leather, and toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and velvet-textured, showcasing a seamless balance between lush fruit and a refined structural core. It is characterized by its profound depth and "mountain-fruit" intensity, leading to a long, majestic finish with hints of baking spice, black tea, and a subtle salinity. This 100% Pinot Noir has an ABV of 14.5% and was aged for 16 months in 100% French oak, of which 60% was new, providing a sturdy yet integrated frame for the vibrant fruit.

Food Pairing

The immense elegance and structural complexity of the Ten Degrees make it a natural partner for high-end gastronomy. It pairs exceptionally well with roasted duck breast with a cherry reduction, herb-crusted rack of lamb, or wild mushroom risotto. Its savory and spicy undertones also complement dishes featuring truffles, braised quail, or seared ahi tuna with a soy-ginger glaze. For a cheese course, it is a classic match for creamy, earthy varieties like Epoisses, aged Camembert, or Taleggio.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in the Anderson Valley is widely regarded as a classic and exceptional year. Following a dry winter, the growing season was characterized by moderate temperatures and the valley's signature coastal fog, which allowed for a slow and steady ripening process. This extended hang-time resulted in fruit with incredible phenolic ripeness and aromatic complexity while maintaining a racy natural acidity. Winemakers have noted that the 2021 Ten Degrees is particularly "complete," offering a perfect marriage of the power found in the 2018 vintage and the crystalline purity of 2019.

95 Points - James Suckling

Exceptionally supple and infused with black fruit, this full-bodied wine goes deep in flavor and broad in texture. Blueberries, creme de cassis, vanilla bean, coconut flakes and cinnamon mingle on the palate, leading to a lingering finish. Full but soft tannins give a gentle feel despite the wine's power.

title: Canvasback Cabernet Sauvignon 'Walla Walla' 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and expressive red wine originates from the Walla Walla Valley AVA, which straddles the border of Washington and Oregon. Canvasback, established in 2012 as part of the Duckhorn Portfolio, is dedicated to crafting luxury Cabernet Sauvignon from the Pacific Northwest. The winery's philosophy focuses on capturing the power and elegance of Washington State's terroir, specifically sourcing from the rugged, wind-swept slopes of Red Mountain and the historically significant vineyards of Walla Walla.

Wine Description

The Canvasback Walla Walla Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 presents a deep, dark ruby colour. The sensory profile is rich and complex, featuring an aromatic nose of blackberry, black cherry, and red currant, layered with sophisticated notes of espresso, cocoa powder, and savory dried herbs. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and robust, showcasing a velvety texture with firm, ripe tannins and a balanced acidity. It is characterized by its structural depth and a long, persistent finish that reveals hints of toasty oak and mineral-rich earth. This blend is primarily Cabernet Sauvignon with small percentages of Merlot and Petit Verdot, typically aged for 20 months in 100% French oak (approx. 40% new).

Food Pairing

The significant structure and concentrated fruit of this Cabernet make it a natural partner for rich, savory proteins. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled or roasted red meats, such as a pepper-crusted ribeye steak, rack of lamb with rosemary, or braised beef short ribs. Its earthy and toasty undertones also complement dishes featuring wild mushrooms, truffle-infused sauces, and hearty stews. For a cheese course, it is a classic match for aged hard cheeses like extra-sharp white cheddar or dry Jack.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Eastern Washington was characterized by a long, steady growing season that allowed for exceptional flavor development. A relatively cool spring was followed by a warm, consistent summer without extreme heat spikes, leading into a beautiful "Indian Summer" in October. These conditions allowed the grapes to achieve full phenolic ripeness while maintaining a racy natural acidity, resulting in wines noted for their aromatic purity and incredible aging potential.

title: Rotari Blanc De Blanc 2021
bodyHtml:
This elegant sparkling wine originates from the Trento DOC region in the Trentino-Alto Adige region of northern Italy, nestled within the Dolomites. Rotari is a prestigious producer that exclusively utilizes the metodo classico (traditional method), with all wines classified under the strict 'Trentodoc' designation. The winery is named after the 7th-century Lombard King Rotari and is celebrated for its striking modern architecture that mimics the jagged Alpine peaks and traditional pergola vine-training systems. Rotari’s philosophy focuses on sustainability and highlighting the region's unique Alpine terroir, characterized by dramatic diurnal temperature variations that preserve natural acidity in the grapes.

Wine Description

The Rotari Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut presents a bright, light yellow colour with delicate straw highlights and a persistent, fine perlage. As a 'white from whites' style, it is crafted from 100% Chardonnay. The sensory profile is complex and refined, featuring an intense bouquet of ripe golden apples, pineapple, and citrus, layered with elegant notes of bread crust, toasted nuts, and white flowers. On the palate, the wine is bone-dry and well-balanced, showcasing a crisp minerality and a creamy texture derived from 48 months of aging on the lees. It is characterized by its linear acidity and a long, persistent finish with hints of hazelnut and dried fruit.

title: Rotari Arte Italiana Brut
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and refined sparkling wine originates from the Trento DOC region in the Trentino-Alto Adige region of northern Italy. Rotari is a leading producer of metodo classico (traditional method) sparkling wines, with its state-of-the-art winery located in the heart of the Dolomites. The winery's philosophy is rooted in its Alpine terroir, where high-altitude vineyards and significant diurnal temperature shifts produce grapes with intense aromatics and a naturally crisp acidity. The 'Arte Italiana' (Italian Art) series represents the estate's commitment to the elegance and lifestyle associated with premium Italian sparkling wine.

Wine Description

The Rotari Arte Italiana Brut presents a bright straw-yellow colour with a fine and persistent perlage. The sensory profile is elegant and fresh, featuring a bouquet of yellow apple, pear, and white flowers, accented by delicate notes of yeast and toasted bread. On the palate, the wine is dry and harmonious, showcasing a creamy texture and a lively acidity that mirrors its mountain origins. It is characterized by its balance and a clean, refreshing finish with subtle mineral undertones. This cuvée is a blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, typically aged for at least 24 months on the lees to develop its characteristic complexity and 'traditional method' structure. The wine generally has an ABV of 12.5%.

title: Bodegas Venta la Vega 'Adaras Lluvia' White Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
Adaras Lluvia White Blend 2022 is produced in the Almansa region of southeastern Spain.

The wine is crafted by Bodegas Venta la Vega, an estate comprising over 850 hectares of ecological farmland situated at the foothills of the El Mugrón mountains. The winery operates with a philosophy of minimal intervention and sustainability, utilizing the unique microclimates found at altitudes reaching 1,200 metres above sea level to farm without chemical treatments. Owned by MG Wines, the estate is known for holding the largest continuous plot of organic agricultural property in the European Union.

Wine Description

This organic white blend displays a pale straw yellow colour that is notably clean and bright. The aromatic profile is intense and fresh, featuring tropical fruit notes such as passion fruit and pineapple, alongside scents of citrus, green apple, and white flowers. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and balanced, offering flavours of stone fruit, lime, and kiwi. It is defined by a steely minerality and a long, fresh finish.

The 2022 vintage is a blend of 50% Sauvignon Blanc and 50% Verdejo, though some bottlings may vary slightly in composition. The grapes are harvested at night to preserve acidity and undergo a cool fermentation followed by 4 to 5 months of aging on the lees to enhance texture. This wine has an ABV of 12.5% and is certified both organic and vegan.

Food Pairing

The crisp acidity and tropical profile of this blend make it a versatile partner for seafood dishes, including fish tacos, grilled prawns, or seafood crudités. It also pairs effectively with Mexican cuisine, such as chicken enchiladas, and light vegetarian fare like seasonal salads or vegetable frittatas. Additionally, it complements tangy cheeses such as goat cheese or feta.

title: Bodegas Venta la Vega 'Adaras Aldea' Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
Adaras Aldea Red Blend 2021 is an organic red wine from the Almansa region in the Castilla-La Mancha area of southeastern Spain.

The wine is produced by Bodegas Venta la Vega, an estate located in a mountainous territory featuring limestone and clay soils. The winery manages over 850 hectares of ecological farmland with vineyards situated at altitudes up to 1,200 metres, creating distinct microclimates that facilitate sustainable and low-intervention viticulture. Under the direction of oenologist Jose Angel Martinez, the estate focuses on championing native grape varieties that have adapted to the region's extreme heat and dry conditions.

Wine Description

This 2021 vintage presents a deep cherry red colour often characterized by violet highlights. On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of ripe and pulpy red fruits, black cherry, and floral aromatics, balanced by hints of liquorice and kirsch. The palate is medium bodied and juicy, featuring concentrated red fruit flavours underpinned by a stony minerality and smooth tannins. It is defined by its freshness and a dry, persistent finish.

The blend is composed of 80% Garnacha Tintorera (also known as Alicante Bouschet) and 20% Syrah. To maintain natural acidity, the grapes are harvested at night and undergo fermentation in stainless steel tanks. The wine is aged for three months in oak barrels, which adds structure while keeping the fruit profile forward. It has an ABV of 14% and is certified both organic and vegan.

Food Pairing

This juicy red blend is highly versatile and pairs well with leaner red meats, roasted poultry, and various BBQ dishes. It is an excellent accompaniment to rich stews, pasta with red sauce, and vegetable tagine. For a lighter experience during summer months, it can be served slightly chilled alongside roast pork or aged cheeses.

title: Telmont Reserve Rose Extra Brut Champagne
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and eco-conscious rosé originates from the Champagne region of France, produced by the house of Telmont in Damery. Founded in 1912, Telmont has recently gained global recognition for its radical commitment to sustainability under the project "In the Name of Mother Nature," attracting investors like Leonardo DiCaprio. The house's philosophy is rooted in "de-luxury" eliminating gift boxes, transparent bottles, and air freight to minimize its environmental footprint. Telmont aims for 100% organic viticulture across its estate and partner vineyards by 2031.

Wine Description

The Telmont Réserve Rosé Brut presents a beautiful raspberry pink colour with glints of sunset. The sensory profile is elegant and full-bodied, featuring an aromatic nose of fresh red fruits and buttered brioche. On the palate, the wine is powerful yet subtle, showcasing flavours reminiscent of biting into a perfectly ripe Morello cherry, complemented by a creamy texture and a fine, persistent bead. It is characterized by its remarkable harmony and an extraordinarily long-lasting finish. This blend typically consists of approximately 87% Chardonnay and 13% Meunier (sourced from multiple harvests), has an ABV of 12%, and a dosage of 8.4 g/L. The wine is aged for five years in underground cellars to develop its complex autolytic character.

title: Annex Radler Grapefruit - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Annex Grapefruit Radler is a perennial summer favorite from Calgary’s Annex Ale Project. While many commercial radlers can feel like sugary sodas, Annex known for its uncompromising commitment to bold flavors and high-quality ingredients approaches the style with a "craft-first" mentality. This radler is designed to be the ultimate urban refreshment: a precise blend of their crisp, clean beer base and their own handcrafted grapefruit soda. It is a low-alcohol, high-impact beverage that balances the sharp tartness of citrus with the structural integrity of a well-made ale.

Beer Description

Annex Radler pours a hazy, pale pinkish-orange (reminiscent of fresh grapefruit juice) with a lively, frothy white head and energetic carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is an absolute explosion of citrus. It leads with a dominant scent of zesty pink grapefruit and crushed citrus oils, followed by a subtle, earthy undertone of fresh-peeled rind. There is a clean, bready malt scent in the background that reminds you this is, indeed, a beer-based beverage.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a prickly, refreshing carbonation. It leads with a bright acidic snap and tart grapefruit juice, which is immediately balanced by a delicate sweetness. Unlike many competitors, it possesses a sophisticated bitterness from the grapefruit pith that mimics hop bitterness, leading to a remarkably clean and dry finish.

Profile: 2.5% ABV and a very low approx. 5–8 IBU, prioritizing fruit-forward zing over hop intensity.

Technical Notes: The success of this radler lies in Annex’s dual identity as both a brewery and a premium soda maker. They blend a neutral, light-bodied ale base with their own house-made grapefruit soda, which utilizes real fruit juice and zest rather than artificial flavorings. This "real food" approach ensures that the citrus notes taste authentic and vibrant, while the low alcohol content makes it the perfect "all-day" refresher.

title: Domaine Thibert Beaune Premier Cru 'Les Teurons' 2022
bodyHtml:
The Domaine Pierre Thibert Beaune Premier Cru 'Les Teurons' is a distinguished red wine from the heart of the Côte de Beaune in Burgundy, France. Founded in 1989 by Pierre Thibert, a first-generation 'garagiste' who built the estate through passion and perseverance, the domaine is now a family affair with his son, Arthur, joining the business in 2018. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes a 'lutte raisonnée' approach, focusing on meticulous vineyard work and minimal intervention to produce pure, authentic expressions of the terroir.

Wine Description

This Premier Cru Pinot Noir displays a bright ruby colour with excellent depth. The sensory profile is defined by intense aromas of ripe red berries, including raspberry and cherry, complemented by fragrances of violet, subtle spicy notes, and earthy undertones. On the palate, the wine is powerful yet racy, featuring a tight, granular texture with notes of blackcurrant, blueberry, and a hint of toasted almond. It is well-structured with a long, spicy finish that reveals a distinct mineral core.

title: Mission Hill Reserve Pinot Gris 2025
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. Mission Hill Family Estate was founded by Anthony von Mandl in 1981 and was recently named 'Winery of the Year' for a record sixth time at the 2025 WineAlign National Wine Awards of Canada. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a deep commitment to terroir-driven expressions and sustainable farming, utilizing the diverse microclimates of the valley's ancient glacial soils to produce wines of significant depth and character.

Wine Description

The Mission Hill Reserve Pinot Gris presents a crisp and clean profile typical of the estate's high-altitude and benchland vineyards. The sensory profile is aromatic and bright, featuring a nose of white peach, melon, and citrus complemented by subtle notes of almond and soft baking spices. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and structured, showcasing juicy flavours of green apple, pear, and stone fruit balanced by a refreshing, zesty acidity. It is characterized by a smooth, creamy texture derived from a small portion of the wine undergoing delicate aging on its lees in French oak. This 100% Pinot Gris typically has an ABV of 13.5% and is produced as a certified organic product.

title: Bols Blue 1575 - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Bols Blue 1575 originates from Amsterdam, Netherlands. It is produced by Lucas Bols, the world's oldest distilled spirits brand, which traces its history back to 1575 when the Bols family opened their first distillery, 't Lootsje'. The company remains a prominent independent distiller in Amsterdam, recently celebrating its 450th anniversary with the launch of this premium expression.

Spirit Description

Bols Blue 1575 is a super premium version of the classic blue liqueur, featuring a clear, deep cobalt blue appearance. The aroma is complex, leading with vanilla and cardamom alongside delicate black pepper and a bright twist of orange zest. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied with a creamy texture, offering flavours of vanilla and cardamom that give way to 'cream of soda' orange and a warm, peppery spice. The finish is long and persistent, dominated by cardamom and earthy botanical notes. It is bottled at 29.5% ABV.

title: Conde Forli Sangiovese Rosato 2024
bodyHtml:
Conde Forli Sangiovese Rosato originates from the hills of Predappio within the Forli-Cesena province of the Emilia Romagna region in Italy.

The winery was established in 2001 by Francesco Condello, who left a career in finance to restore the tradition of authentic Sangiovese di Predappio. Managing the estate alongside his daughter Chiara since 2012, the family operates with a philosophy that great wine is born in the vineyard through manual labor and a deep respect for the land's 700 year viticultural history. The estate emphasizes sustainability and biodiversity, treating the vineyard as a balanced ecosystem where nature dictates the rhythm of production.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese rosato presents a pale and clear pink colour often highlighted by orange reflections. The aroma is fresh and intense, featuring scents of fruit and flowers such as ripe strawberry, tart cranberry, and acacia blossom. On the palate, the wine is light bodied and incredibly fresh, showing vibrant notes of pomegranate, zesty tangerine, and red berries. It is characterized by a crisp, balanced structure and a persistent mineral finish.

With an ABV of approximately 12.5%, the wine is crafted from grapes grown in calcareous and clayey soils, which contribute to its marked acidity and elegance. The production process includes low temperature fermentation in stainless steel and 4 to 5 months of aging on the lees to add texture without malolactic fermentation. This wine is certified organic and produced without chemical herbicides or pesticides.

Food Pairing

The high acidity and fresh profile of this rosato make it an excellent choice for fish-based starters, seafood crudités, and light fresh fish dishes. It pairs beautifully with Italian charcuterie, such as prosciutto and cured meats, as well as hard cheeses like Parmesan or Pecorino. For a more casual pairing, it complements Margherita pizza, roasted red pepper hummus, or seasonal watermelon salad with feta.

title: Cakebread Cellars Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
The Cakebread Cellars Chardonnay is a hallmark white wine from the renowned Napa Valley region in California, United States. Founded in 1973 by Jack and Dolores Cakebread, the winery has spent five decades perfecting its winemaking philosophy, which emphasizes quality, sustainability, and the belief that good food and wine elevate life's occasions. This flagship bottling is primarily sourced from the cool Carneros subregion at the southern edge of Napa Valley, where the morning Pacific fog and silty Haire loam soils allow for slow ripening and the retention of signature fresh acidity.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay presents a light golden colour in the glass. The sensory profile opens with vibrant aromas of green and golden apple, fresh white peach, and citrus, accented by floral notes of orange blossom and subtle hints of baking spice and light oak. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and silken in texture, offering a harmonious blend of ripe melon, lemon curd, pear, and crème brûlée. A portion of the wine (9.5%) undergoes malolactic fermentation and is aged for eight months in French oak barrels with occasional lees stirring to achieve a creamy, weighty mouthfeel without sacrificing its crisp, mineral-driven finish.

title: Wolf’s Head Cabernet Sauvignon Argentina 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
This Argentinian Cabernet Sauvignon represents a modern, refined approach to the variety, moving away from the heavy, over-extracted styles sometimes associated with high-altitude reds. The wine is crafted to emphasize elegance and complexity, utilizing a specific aging regimen to integrate its structural components before it even reaches the consumer.

Wine Description

  • Appearance: The wine shows a beautiful cherry red color, notably accented by youthful violet tints on the rim.

  • Aroma: It features intense aromas of spice, with a core of black and red fruit seasoned with distinct notes of pepper.

  • Palate: On the palate, the experience is layered; dark fruit flavors are interwoven with spice. It possesses a persistent tannin structure that is expertly balanced by a plush, refreshing acidity.

  • Finish: The wine concludes with a beautiful, long finish that highlights its refined and well-balanced nature.

  • Technical Details: This offering is aged for 10 months in oak barrels, followed by an additional 6 months of bottle aging before its commercial release to ensure maximum smoothness and complexity.

Food Pairing

The elegant structure and spicy undertones of this Cabernet make it a versatile partner for a variety of savory dishes:

  • Grilled Meats: Traditional Argentinian asado, specifically lean cuts like flank steak (entraña) or sirloin, will complement the wine's peppery notes.

  • Earthier Flavors: Roast lamb with rosemary or a rich mushroom risotto provides an excellent savory counterpoint to the dark fruit layers.

  • Hard Cheeses: Mature cheeses like Manchego or aged Gouda pair well with the wine's persistent tannins.

title: Filidrose Pinot Grigio Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
This elegant and refreshing rosé originates from the Vigneti delle Dolomiti IGT in the Trentino-Alto Adige region of northern Italy. Produced by Cantina Mezzacorona under the Fildirose selection, this wine is crafted from Pinot Grigio grapes grown at the foot of the Dolomites. The winery's philosophy emphasizes the unique Alpine terroir, where mineral-rich soils and a cool climate allow for optimal aromatic ripening while preserving the grape's natural acidity and freshness. The name 'Fildirose' evokes an Alpine garden where wild rose bushes adorn the Dolomite landscape.

Wine Description

The Fildirose Pinot Grigio Rosé presents a delicate pink hue, achieved by leaving the juice in contact with the dark-skinned Pinot Grigio grapes for over eight hours. The sensory profile is very fresh and elegant, featuring an aromatic nose of red fruits, pink grapefruit, and delicate floral notes. On the palate, the wine is supple and lively, showcasing a vibrant acidity and a pleasant salinity that reflects its mountainous origin. It is characterized by its crisp, clean structure and subtle mineral undertones.

title: El Tequileno Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
El Tequileño Blanco originates from the Highland region of Jalisco, Mexico. Founded in 1959 by Don Jorge Salles Cuervo, the distillery remains family owned and operated, focusing on traditional production methods. It is highly regarded for its commitment to quality and is produced at the historic 'La Guarreña' distillery.

Spirit Description

This tequila is a 'Mixto' composed of 71% agave and 29% piloncillo, which results in a clear, bright appearance with medium body. The aroma is characterized by cooked agave, herbal notes, and a hint of anise. On the palate, it offers a sweet and spicy profile with prominent agave flavours and a smooth, clean finish. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

Accolades

El Tequileño Blanco has received recognition for its quality and traditional profile within the industry. It is frequently cited by enthusiasts as a premier choice for crafting authentic Mexican cocktails.

Food Pairing

This blanco tequila pairs exceptionally well with fresh seafood dishes such as ceviche or fish tacos. It also complements spicy appetizers like aguachile or traditional guacamole topped with pomegranate seeds.

title: Greenwing Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant red wine originates from the Willamette Valley in Oregon, United States. Historically known for its Washington State Cabernet Sauvignon, Greenwing; part of the prestigious Duckhorn Portfolio launched this Pinot Noir as its inaugural release from Oregon in late 2025. The winery's philosophy focuses on "overdelivering" on quality at an accessible price point, sourcing fruit from premier sub-appellations including Eola-Amity Hills, Chehalem Mountains, Yamhill-Carlton, and Ribbon Ridge to capture the diverse terroir of the valley.

Wine Description

The Greenwing Pinot Noir 2024 presents a clear, dark ruby colour. The sensory profile is expressive and aromatic, featuring a nose of dark cherry and spiced cranberry, layered with earthy undertones and sophisticated notes of baking spice, cinnamon, and black raspberry. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and well-balanced, showcasing a silky texture with polished tannins and a bright natural acidity that provides a refreshing lift. It is characterized by its "classic Willamette" harmony, culminating in a lingering finish of ripe raspberry and a trace of espresso. This 100% Pinot Noir has an ABV of 13.9% and was aged for 10 months in 30% new French oak.

title: Coffele Valpolicella 2024
bodyHtml:
Coffele Valpolicella is a refined, organic red wine produced by Azienda Agricola Coffele Alberto, a historic family-run winery based in the medieval center of Soave, Italy. While primarily famous for their white Soave Classico, the family expanded into the Valpolicella DOC in 2003 with the purchase of a 6-hectare estate in the hamlet of Campiano.

The winery is led by siblings Alberto and Chiara Coffele, who emphasize "traditionalist" winemaking and environmental sustainability. They are notable for being the first organic certified winery in the Soave Classico area, a philosophy they extend to their Valpolicella production by avoiding chemical herbicides and fertilizers.

Wine Description

  • Grape Varieties: A traditional blend typically consisting of 75% Corvina, 15% Corvinone, 5% Rondinella, and 5% Molinara.

  • Aroma: The nose is intense and full of fruit, characterized by sour black cherries, blackberries, and ripe red cherries, with subtle hints of balsam, spice, and a light herbaceousness.
