  • Palate: Described as highly structured yet delicate and harmonious. It features refreshing acidity that balances the alcohol, with dense yet fine tannins.

  • Finish: The wine is noted for having a long, persistent, and "salty" finish.

  • Technical Details: The grapes are exclusively hand-harvested in October. Fermentation occurs in steel barrels for 10-12 days, followed by approximately four months of aging in steel to preserve the wine's fresh, fruity character. It typically has an alcohol content of 12.5% ABV.

Food Pairing

The fresh acidity and moderate structure of Coffele Valpolicella make it a highly versatile "food wine":

  • First Courses: It pairs perfectly with "important" first dishes such as pasta with meat sauce or traditional Italian rice dishes and vegetable soups.

  • Meats: Complements a variety of white and red meats, including roast chicken, burgers, and game.

  • Local Specialties: Ideal with Venetian cured meats, salami, and traditional dishes like liver alla veneziana.

  • Seafood: Due to its balanced structure, it can even pair well with certain fish dishes like cod or pike in sauce.

title: Grizzly Paw Lemon Shandy 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Lemon Shandy is a quintessential seasonal favorite from Canmore’s Grizzly Paw Brewing Company. While the "Shandy" (or Radler in German) is a centuries-old tradition of mixing beer with sparkling lemonade, Grizzly Paw’s version is a craft-brewed homage to the Rocky Mountain summer. It is designed to be the ultimate "thirst-quencher" combining a crisp, light beer base with their own world-famous Grizzly Paw Lemonade. It is a low-alcohol, high-refreshment beverage built specifically for those long, hot Alberta afternoons when you want something colder and "zingier" than a standard lager.

Beer Description

Grizzly Paw Lemon Shandy pours a cloudy, pale lemon-yellow with a soft, frothy white head and a steady stream of energetic carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is bright, zesty, and incredibly uplifting. It leads with a dominant scent of freshly squeezed lemons and sweet citrus oils, followed by a subtle, bready grain aroma from the malt base. It smells remarkably "real" like a kitchen-made lemonade rather than an artificial candy.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a zippy, effervescent mouthfeel. It leads with a burst of tart lemon juice and a hint of sweetness, which is quickly balanced by the crisp, clean finish of the base lager. The bitterness is non-existent, replaced instead by a refreshing acidity that makes the mouth water.

Profile: It sits at a very sessionable 2.5% to 3.0% ABV and a negligible approx. 5–8 IBU, making it one of the most accessible drinks in their lineup.

Technical Notes: The brilliance of this Shandy lies in the brewery’s dual expertise; Grizzly Paw is just as famous for its handcrafted sodas as it is for its beer. They take a clean-fermented, light Wheat Ale or Lager base and blend it with their proprietary Lemonade, which is made with real cane sugar and natural lemon oils. This blend ensures the beverage remains "beer-forward" enough to satisfy a traditional drinker while being sweet and tart enough to appeal to non-beer fans.

title: Montgermont Cremant de Bourgogne Brut
bodyHtml:
This refined sparkling wine comes from the historic Burgundy region of France. Maison Montgermont, founded in 1822, has a legacy of crafting traditional method sparkling wines for over two centuries. Their philosophy focuses on capturing the 'patchwork' of the Burgundian terroir by carefully blending grapes from across the region to create a consistent and elegant house style.

Wine Description

The Montgermont Brut presents a luminous pale gold colour with a fine and persistent mousse. The aromatic profile is bright and complex, featuring notes of citrus zest, crisp apple, and white flowers, layered with sophisticated hints of toasted almond, brioche, and marzipan from delicate aging on the lees. On the palate, the wine is lively and well balanced, offering a creamy texture and stable acidity. It finishes with a clean, chalky mineral precision. This non vintage blend typically highlights Chardonnay for its freshness and Pinot Noir for structure.

title: Amatitena Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
Amatiteña Tequila Reposado is an ultra-premium, additive-free spirit produced in the town of Amatitán, Jalisco. Crafted at Cava de Oro (NOM 1477) by third-generation Master Distiller Alberto Partida, the brand is celebrated for reviving "ancestral" techniques in a region often called the "Cradle of Tequila". It is currently one of the few brands on the market to exclusively employ 19th-century artisanal methods, such as using mesquite-wood-fired stone ovens, which bridge the flavor gap between traditional tequila and smoky mezcal.

Spirit Description

This reposado is unique for its "minimalist" aging process, resting for only 2 to 3 months in either American White Oak ex-bourbon barrels or large-format French Limousin oak pipones. This brief contact with wood is designed to soften the spirit's "wild" edges while allowing the bold, smoky agave to remain the primary focus.

  • Appearance: Bright straw or golden sunflower yellow.

  • Nose: A complex and evolving bouquet of cooked agave and mesquite smoke, giving way to orange zest, cinnamon, and soft vanilla with a hint of green pea shoots.

  • Palate: Rich and oily with a buttery mouthfeel. It features a "spirited" entrance of pepper and baking spices, followed by flavors of roasted carrot, salted honey-butter, and raisin.

  • Finish: Medium to long, characterized by lingering smoke, black pepper, and a sweet "crème brûlée" note.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at a robust 42% ABV (84 proof), which contributes to its thick, large body.

title: Amatitena Tequila Anejo
bodyHtml:
Amatiteña Tequila Añejo is an ultra-premium, additive-free spirit produced in the town of Amatitán, Jalisco a region recently designated as a UNESCO World Heritage site for its deep-rooted agave history. It is produced at Cava de Oro (NOM 1477) under the guidance of 5th-generation Master Tequilero Alberto Partida. The brand is distinguished by its commitment to "ancestral" methods, including the rare use of mesquite-wood-fired stone ovens, which imparts a unique smoky profile more commonly found in mezcal than modern tequila.

Spirit Description

Amatiteña Añejo is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave and aged for 12 months specifically in American oak barrels previously used for Napa Valley red wine. This choice of cask creates a sophisticated balance between agave terroir and vinous barrel influence.

  • Aroma: A rich and indulgent bouquet featuring fresh glazed donuts, smoked apricots, dried cherries, and caramelized agave, with subtle hints of tobacco leaf and cacao.

  • Palate: Bold and confectionary yet lean. It offers flavors of vanilla, caramel cream, and black walnut, layered with dried fruits like candied plum and cherry.

  • Body & Texture: Smooth as silk and decadent, with a viscous, "chewy" mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Long and satisfying, marked by sweet agave, oak tannins, and a lingering trail of baking spices like cinnamon and clove.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at a slightly higher-than-average 42% ABV (84 proof).

title: Holzer Cacao Fernet Robust Bitter – 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Holzer Original Cacao (formerly Fernet Hunter Cacao) is a robust aromatic bitter produced in the Brunnwald Forest of Upper Austria. This expression is a unique collaboration between founder Raphael Holzer and Bar Leone (Hong Kong), merging Austrian distilling traditions with specialty ingredients from Southeast Asia. The spirit features a distinctive "farm-to-bottle" narrative, utilizing upcycled cacao husks that are fermented in Vietnam, roasted in Hong Kong, and finally infused in Austria.

Spirit Description

This "Robust Bitter" takes the complex herbal foundation of the original Holzer Fernet and layers it with deep, dark chocolate notes.

  • Production: The spirit uses a low-temperature infusion method to extract the delicate essences of forest botanicals without the harshness of traditional boiling.

  • Core Ingredients: The signature blend of Arnica, Orris Root, and Lavender is enhanced by roasted Vietnamese cacao husks from "Conspiracy Chocolate".

  • Nose: A beautiful marriage of dry, earthy bitterness and rich, roasted cacao. It features a revitalizing herbal freshness followed by deep, chocolatey undertones.

  • Palate: Bold yet balanced and silky. The initial entry is herbal and refreshing, which quickly rounds out into a decadent dark chocolate profile with hints of "roasted nuttiness" and light spice.

  • Finish: Smooth and persistent, leaving a lingering, sophisticated bitter-cocoa aftertaste.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at 29% ABV with no added caramel or artificial colouring.

title: Holzer Granit Fernet Bitter – 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Holzer Granit Fernet Bitter (formerly Fernet Hunter Granit) is the second-generation expression from the Holzer family, produced in the Brunnwald Forest of northern Austria. Created by Raphael Holzer in collaboration with his father, Gilbert, this "true bitter" was designed to capture the dry, stoic essence of the granite rocks found in the Mühlviertel region. It represents a deeper dive into the family’s century-old distilling archive, stripping away the sugar to highlight the raw, herbal intensity of the Austrian Alpine landscape.

Spirit Description

What distinguishes "Granit" from the original Holzer Fernet is its significantly lower sugar content and a reinforced bitter profile.

  • Production: The spirit uses a base of local sugar beet, barley, and corn spirits. Botanicals are dried and macerated for 24 hours before a two-week slow-drip extraction process in a percolator, which preserves their medicinal properties.

  • Botanicals: In addition to the core "Hunter" blend of Arnica, Orris Root, and Lavender, Granit adds Roman Chamomile for enhanced aromatic complexity. The recipe foundation is further altered by increasing the ratio of bitter roots.

  • Nose: Mellow and warm, featuring soft chamomile, cooked lemon, and orange jam, accented by notes of limestone and "hot granite".

  • Palate: Very dry and robust. Coating flavours of bitter flowers and chili spice are balanced by a distinct mineral texture derived from the distillery’s own soft-water wells.

  • Finish: Lingering and evolving, with earthy spiced sweetness and a clean, aromatic exit.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at 29% ABV with all colour derived naturally from the 15 botanicals.

title: Holzer Original Fernet Bitter – 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Holzer Original Fernet Bitter (formerly known as Fernet Hunter) is a premium aromatic spirit produced in Austria, within the region of Upper Austria and the subregion of the Brunnwald Forest. The brand was co-founded by Raphael Holzer and Neville Kotewall, a partnership that bridges Raphael's four-generation family legacy of Austrian distilling with the modern cocktail culture of Hong Kong. The recipe dates back to the early 1900s and was originally developed by Raphael’s great-grandfather, Oskar Holzer, who was a key figure at the famed Stock Fernet Company in Trieste.

Spirit Description

This "fresh take" on a classic Italian bitter is crafted using a low-temperature infusion method to extract the delicate essence of handpicked botanicals found in the Alpine forests.

  • Botanicals: A core blend of Arnica, Orris Root, and Lavender, which are harvested and dried during the hunting season, the inspiration for its original name.

  • Appearance: A deep, vibrant amber hue derived entirely from natural botanical infusion, with no added caramel or artificial colouring.

  • Nose: Highly aromatic and floral, dominated by lavender, zesty citrus, and ginger, with a "spa-like" freshness.

  • Palate: Round and silky with a balanced profile of wildflower honey, black tea, and a hint of lime zest. Unlike traditional Italian fernets, it is less aggressive and medicinal, offering a more harmonious "sake-like" balance of sweet and bitter.

  • Finish: Pleasant and evolving bitter notes that linger with a clean, floral exit.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at 29% ABV.

title: 1921 Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
1921 Reposado Tequila is produced in the United States' neighbour, Mexico, specifically within the Jalisco Highlands (Los Altos). Named to commemorate the final year of the Mexican Revolution, the brand was established in 1996 with the discovery of a "lost" recipe in an old hacienda. While it was originally crafted at the legendary NOM 1079 (Agabe Tequilana), production has shifted over the years to more modern facilities, including Destilería Morales (NOM 1535) and Casa Tequilera de Arandas (NOM 1499). Despite these shifts, it remains a hallmark of highland tequila, known for its "refined" rather than "rustic" profile.

Description

This 100% Blue Weber Agave tequila is "rested" for 4 to 6 months in new American white oak barrels, which are often delicately charred to impart specific spice notes.

  • Appearance: A toasted honey or "medium old gold" colour with luminous transparency and elegant "tears" on the glass.

  • Nose: Sweet and comforting, with aromas of cooked agave, plum, and vanilla, accented by unique "pickling spice," hazelnut, and herbal hints of mint or grass.

  • Palate: Exceptionally smooth and creamy with a "silky" mouthfeel. It features a complex array of flavours, including walnuts, oatmeal raisin cookies, and saltwater taffy, balanced by citrus and stewed agave.

  • Finish: A medium-bodied exit that is notably smooth and refined, often leaving a delicate white oak aftertaste with a "whisper" of highland pepper.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof) and traditionally presented in a wax-sealed, squat square bottle adorned with a hand-painted clay medallion.

title: G.H Mumm Grand Cordon Rose
bodyHtml:
This vibrant rosé champagne is the premium evolution of the house's classic style, produced by Maison Mumm in Reims. Released as part of the innovative "Grand Cordon" collection, it features the iconic red sash, the Cordon Rouge, engraved directly into the glass of its avant-garde, long-necked bottle. The winemaking philosophy for this cuvée focuses on the "passionate personality" of Pinot Noir, utilizing a complex blending process to achieve a balance of power, structure, and intense fruitiness.

Wine Description

G.H. Mumm Grand Cordon Rosé presents a luminous salmon-pink robe with bright orange glints and a steady stream of fine bubbles. The sensory profile is an explosion of red fruit, opening with intense aromas of wild strawberry, fresh redcurrants, and cherries, accented by a subtle hint of red-berry coulis and sweet spice. On the palate, the wine is energetic and fresh, showcasing a creamy texture and flavors of fragrant summer fruits supported by the characteristic Pinot Noir structure. It is characterized by a long, bright finish that balances fruity ripeness with a racy, mouth-watering acidity. This Brut blend typically consists of 60% Pinot Noir, 22% Chardonnay, and 18% Pinot Meunier, with approximately 12% to 15% still red wine added to provide color and forest-fruit intensity. It has an ABV of 12% to 12.5% and a precise dosage of approximately 6 g/L.

title: G.H Mumm Cordon Rouge
bodyHtml:
This iconic champagne is the flagship cuvée of Maison Mumm, located in Reims, France. Founded in 1827, the house achieved global fame under Georges Hermann Mumm, who in 1876 decided to decorate the bottles with a red silk ribbon. This "Cordon Rouge" was a tribute to the Grand Cordon de la Légion d’Honneur, France’s highest civilian distinction, and has since become an enduring symbol of the house's motto: "Nec plus ultra" (Only the best). Today, Mumm is one of the largest champagne producers in the world and a leader in sustainable viticulture, having implemented a zero-herbicide policy across its estate in 2020.

Wine Description

G.H. Mumm Cordon Rouge is a Pinot Noir-forward champagne, typically blended from over 100 different crus to ensure a consistent house style. It presents a clear, pale golden-yellow hue with jade reflections and a delicate stream of fine bubbles. The nose is fresh and complex, featuring aromas of ripe peach, apricot, and tropical notes (pineapple and lychee), layered with rich autolytic scents of brioche, toasted bread, and praline. On the palate, the wine is vibrant and well-balanced, showcasing a powerful fruit structure and a creamy texture. It is characterized by a "nerve" or tension from cleansing grapefruit acidity and a long, savory finish with hints of caramel and honey. This non-vintage Brut typically consists of 45% Pinot Noir, 30% Chardonnay, and 25% Pinot Meunier, with an ABV of 12.5%.

title: 818 Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
818 Añejo Tequila is produced in Mexico, within the Los Valles region of Jalisco, at the Grupo Solave distillery (NOM 1607). Founded by Kendall Jenner, the brand takes its name from the 818 area code of the San Fernando Valley. The distillery is a Certified B Corporation, utilizing sustainable practices such as biomass and solar power, and repurposing agave waste into adobe bricks for local community projects.

Spirit Description

This 100% Blue Weber Agave tequila is aged for over one year (typically 12 months) in a combination of French and American oak barrels.

  • Appearance: Light amber with shiny golden reflections and bronze hues.

  • Nose: Highly aromatic and sweet, featuring caramel, toasted nuts, orange peel, chocolate, and toffee, with a notable "Christmas cookie" or "caramel corn" scent.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and velvety with a distinct "confectionary" sweetness. It offers layers of vanilla bean, sweet cooked agave, and toasted pecans, balanced by crisp herbal notes and a hint of cinnamon.

  • Finish: Very long, silky, and rich, leaving a smooth aftertaste of pecan pie and soft oak.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

title: La Spinetta Vermentino 2025
bodyHtml:
La Spinetta Vermentino originates from Italy, specifically within the Tuscany region and the Maremma subregion. The winery was founded in 1977 by Giuseppe 'Pin' Rivetti and his wife Lidia, with their children Giorgio, Bruno, Carlo, and Giovanna subsequently taking over operations. Following their success in Piedmont, the Rivetti family expanded into Tuscany in 2001, establishing the Casanova della Spinetta estate in the village of Terricciola. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes a profound respect for the land, low yields, and the cultivation of indigenous varietals to produce wines that authentically reflect their unique microclimate and terroir.

Wine Description

This white wine typically presents a light straw yellow or pale yellow colour, often featuring subtle green reflections. The sensory profile is fragrant and fresh, offering an aromatic bouquet of citrus, chamomile flowers, and ripe pineapple, alongside hints of Mediterranean herbs like rosemary, thyme, and marjoram. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it is refined and decisive, delivering vibrant energy and a mineral undertone balanced by bright acidity. The finish is clean, crisp, and persistent.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Vermentino.

  • ABV: Generally ranges between 12.5% and 13% by volume.

  • Organic Status: The winery utilizes organic farming and biological methods to maintain the health and identity of the soil.

  • Stylistic Notes: To preserve its fresh fruit character and aromatic precision, the wine is fermented with natural yeasts in stainless steel tanks and aged on its lees for approximately three to four months before bottling.

Food Pairing

The fresh acidity and herbal notes of La Spinetta Vermentino make it an excellent partner for a variety of light and savoury dishes. Suggested pairings include:

  • Seafood: Grilled scallops with lemon dressing, shellfish, and light fish dishes.

  • Poultry: Roasted or grilled chicken seasoned with herbs.

  • Vegetarian: White pizza with vegetables, fresh Caprese salad, and grilled zucchini with mint.

  • Pasta: Savoury pasta dishes featuring pesto or herbal sauces.

title: Volcan de Mi Tierra X.A. Tequila
bodyHtml:
Volcan X.A. is an ultra-premium tequila produced in Mexico, within the region of Jalisco and the subregion of El Arenal. Launched in 2022, the brand is a collaboration between the Gallardo family, who have roots in the region dating back to 1774, and the luxury goods group Moët Hennessy (LVMH). The spirit is crafted at its own dedicated facility, Distillería Agrotequilera de Jalisco (NOM 1523), located at the foot of the Tequila Volcano. The "X.A." designation stands for "Extra Ages," representing a commitment to the "art of blending" rarely seen in the tequila category.

Spirit Description

Volcan X.A. is an innovative, additive-free blend of three distinct aging stages: Reposado, Añejo, and Extra Añejo, all made from 100% Blue Weber agave. The blend uses a proprietary "Grace Cask" system American oak barrels that have been lightly toasted to enhance aromatic elegance without overpowering the agave.

  • Appearance: A bright, golden amber hue, presented in a handcrafted "luminous" bottle with a light-up base that reflects the volcano's energy.

  • Nose: A sophisticated bouquet of cooked agave, rich vanilla, and caramel, layered with dried red fruits, dark chocolate, and a hint of toasted oak.

  • Palate: Exceptionally smooth and full-bodied. The Reposado base provides sweetness and a silky mouthfeel, while the Añejo and Extra Añejo components add complexity with notes of sweet spice, honey, and roasted agave.

  • Finish: A long, buttery finish marked by subtle bits of cinnamon sugar and a clean, peppery warmth.

  • Technical Details: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

title: Daftmill Single Malt Scotch - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Bos Daftmill is a rare single malt Scotch whisky produced in the Lowlands of Scotland, within the region of Fife. The distillery is a "true farm distillery" owned and operated by the Cuthbert family, who have farmed the land for six generations. Founded in 2005, Daftmill is famous for its seasonal production: Francis Cuthbert distils only during the farm's quiet windows midsummer and winter producing as few as 100 casks per year. The name "Daftmill" originates from the Daft Burn, a local stream that appears to run uphill due to a topographical quirk.

2. Spirit Description

The "Bos Daftmill" expression (often associated with the "BOS" series or specific retail exclusives) is characterized by the distillery's signature light, elegant Lowland style.

  • Production: Distilled from Publican barley grown in the farm's "43ac" field and harvested in August 2009. The spirit was matured in first-fill ex-bourbon barrels sourced from the Clermont Springs distillery in Kentucky.

  • Aroma: Soft and grain-driven, with notes of buttered cinnamon toast, banana bread, and fresh-cut spring flowers, alongside a "lovely cheesy funk" typical of long fermentations.

  • Palate: Silky and oily with a bright acidity. It features layers of Golden Delicious apple, custard, and lemon curd, balanced by honeyed malt and a flinty minerality.

  • Finish: Medium in length and refreshing, with a balance of sweet cereal and spicy, buttery oak.

  • Technical Details: Typically bottled at 46% ABV, un-chill filtered, and natural in colour.

title: Lost Lore Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Lost Lore Blanco is the foundational expression of the Lost Lore portfolio, crafted at the esteemed Destilería Feliciano Vivanco & Associates (NOM 1414) in Arandas, Jalisco. Under the expertise of Master Distiller Sergio Cruz, this blanco is a "pure terroir" play, designed to showcase the bright, floral, and mineral characteristics of Highland (Los Altos) agave. It is famous among aficionados for the "Mozart Method," a fermentation process where classical music is played to the open-air tanks to influence yeast activity, alongside its unwavering commitment to additive-free production.

Spirit Description

The Blanco is unaged and bottled immediately after double distillation to preserve the raw energy of the agave. It presents a crystal-clear appearance with a noticeably silky viscosity.

  • Nose: It opens with a punch of sweet cooked agave and bright citrus (lime and grapefruit zest). These are layered with an airy minerality—often described as "wet stone" or "cement"—and a floral hint of springtime grass and mint.

  • Palate: The texture is clean and slightly oily. The entry is sweet and agave-forward, transitioning into a complex mid-palate of white pepper, herbal undertones, and a touch of tropical fruit like melon or pineapple.

  • Finish: Crisp, smooth, and refreshing. It leaves a lingering peppery warmth and a subtle "salted agave brine" echo that encourages another sip without being overly aggressive. It is bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof) and is certified additive-free by Tequila Matchmaker.

title: Lost Lore Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Lost Lore Reposado is a meticulously crafted, small-batch tequila produced at the celebrated Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados (NOM 1414) in Arandas, Jalisco. Under the guidance of Master Distiller Sergio Cruz, this expression is designed to bridge the gap between the vibrant energy of their Highland blanco and the deep wood influence of their añejo. Like the rest of the portfolio, it utilizes the "Mozart Method," where classical music is played during the fermentation process to optimize yeast activity, resulting in a remarkably balanced and "honest" profile.

Spirit Description

The Reposado is aged for up to 12 months in used American white oak whiskey barrels. This extensive resting period—near the legal limit for a reposado—results in a light amber liquid that remains agave-forward while gaining a sophisticated "whiskey-adjacent" creaminess.

  • Nose: Inviting and complex. It opens with sweet cooked agave and bright citrus, layered with vanilla bean, warm caramel, and a touch of toasted almond. Hints of cinnamon and light baking spices weave through a subtle earthy minerality.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and satiny. The entry is dominated by roasted agave sweetness, followed by a mid-palate of butterscotch, honey, and black pepper. The whiskey barrel influence provides gentle notes of oak and chocolate without masking the spirit’s Highland roots.

  • Finish: Long and warming. It leaves a clean impression of oak tannin and spice that gradually recedes into a soft vanilla echo and a final whisper of mint. It is bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof) and is certified additive-free by Tequila Matchmaker (2024-2026).

title: Lost Lore Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Lost Lore Añejo is a high-altitude, single-estate tequila produced at the renowned Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados (NOM 1414) in Arandas, Jalisco. Created by Master Distiller Sergio Cruz, the brand was born from founder Arturo Lamas III’s desire to rediscover his family’s lost heritage in spirits. It is widely recognized by enthusiasts for its commitment to traditional craftsmanship, including the famous "Mozart Method"—where classical music is played during the fermentation process to influence the activity of the yeast.

Spirit Description

The Añejo is aged for up to 36 months in used American White Oak whiskey barrels, giving it a profile that appeals strongly to both tequila purists and whiskey drinkers.

  • Nose: Rich and luxuriously inviting, dominated by aromas of caramel, warm vanilla, and toasted oak. Beneath the barrel influence, there are sweet hints of baking spices (cinnamon and nutmeg) and a subtle note of dried cherry.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and silky. It opens with the comforting sweetness of cooked agave and butterscotch, which transitions into deeper oak-derived flavors of vanilla bean and cinnamon. A pleasant black pepper spice provides structure.

  • Finish: Long and exceptionally smooth, featuring lingering notes of oak, spice, and a final, clean touch of agave-mint and banana. It is bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof) and is officially certified additive-free by Tequila Matchmaker (2023–2026).

title: Pirramimma Heritage Limited Edition Cabernet Petit Verdot 2022
bodyHtml:
Pirramimma Heritage Cabernet Petit Verdot is a distinguished red blend from the McLaren Vale region of South Australia. Founded in 1892 by Alexander Campbell Johnston, Pirramimma remains a family owned and operated estate, currently led by grandson and chief winemaker Geoff Johnston. The winery is a celebrated pioneer of the Petit Verdot variety in Australia, having researched the grape for over a decade before releasing the country's first single varietal expression in 1994.

Wine Description

This full bodied blend presents a deep, dense maroon colour. The bouquet is complex, exhibiting intense aromas of blackcurrant, blueberry, and spicy pepper, interwoven with secondary notes of mocha, cedar, and tobacco leaf. On the palate, the wine is rich and structured, where the 'spice rack' nature of the Petit Verdot adds significant grip and density to the elegant Cabernet Sauvignon base. Flavours of dark chocolate, cherry, and forest herbs are supported by firm, velvety tannins and balanced acidity. Maturation in French oak provides a sleek finish with hints of toasted almond and nutmeg.

title: Pirramimma Heritage Limited Edition GSM 2021
bodyHtml:
Pirramimma Heritage GSM is a masterfully crafted Rhone style blend from the McLaren Vale region in South Australia. Established in 1892, Pirramimma is one of Australia's oldest family-owned wineries and is currently under the guidance of third generation winemaker Geoff Johnston. The winery is dedicated to its 'estate grown' philosophy, utilizing the unique red loam, limestone, and ironstone soils of their historic vineyards to produce wines known for their depth and regional integrity.

Wine Description

This deep mauve-hued red blend showcases the modern Australian interpretation of the classic Grenache, Shiraz, and Mourvèdre (GSM) style. The nose is lifted and expressive, revealing complex aromas of raspberries, plums, and cassis, nuanced by notes of smoked meats, mushrooms, and subtle spices. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with an intense delivery of juicy red cherry, Christmas cake, and pomegranate flavours, balanced by pomegranate and anise. It is characterized by sleek, fine-grained tannins and a light touch of spicy oak that leads to a persistent, harmonious finish.

title: Chalk Hill 'Luna' Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Chalk Hill Luna Chardonnay is a vibrant expression of the McLaren Vale region in South Australia. The winery is family owned and estate grown, with a grape-growing heritage that dates back six generations to the arrival of John Harvey in 1839. Under the stewardship of the Harvey family, Chalk Hill focuses on small-batch, hand-crafted wines that reflect the unique characters of their six distinct vineyards spread across the region.

Wine Description

This fruit-driven Chardonnay displays a brilliant, very pale straw colour with light green highlights. The aromatics are bright and concentrated, featuring ripe peach, tropical fruit, and melon, followed by delicate notes of vanillin spice. On the palate, the wine is beautifully fleshed and textural, delivering juicy flavours of citrus and light stone fruits complemented by hints of spicy oak and a subtle minerality. It is characterized by fresh acidity and a long, fruit-forward finish.

title: Chalk Hill 'Luna' Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Chalk Hill Luna Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold and expressive red wine from the renowned McLaren Vale region of South Australia. The Harvey family established Chalk Hill in 1964, bringing a viticultural legacy that spans six generations and over 185 years. The winery is dedicated to small-batch, hand-crafted production, utilizing organic farming practices across their six distinct estate vineyards to showcase the unique terroir and varietal purity of the region.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep garnet red with purple hues. The nose is highly perfumed and concentrated, featuring aromas of blackcurrant, blueberry, and red plum, layered with notes of dark chocolate, violets, and tobacco leaf. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and vibrant, delivering rich flavours of blackberry and cassis complemented by leafy herbaceous notes such as thyme and dried mint. It is well structured with firm, velvety tannins and a balanced acidity that leads to a long, lingering finish with hints of spice and mocha. While drinking beautifully now, it has the potential to cellar for 5 to 7 years.

title: Chalk Hill Luna Shiraz 2022
bodyHtml:
Chalk Hill Luna Shiraz is a vibrant red wine from the McLaren Vale region of South Australia. The Harvey family's grape-growing legacy began in 1839, and today the sixth generation continues this heritage by producing estate-grown, small-batch wines that reflect the unique story of their origin. The Luna series is specifically crafted to embody the warm climate and rich fruit character of the region, emphasizing a plush and approachable winemaking philosophy.

Wine Description

This Shiraz presents a dark ruby appearance with vibrant purple highlights. The bouquet is perfumed and expressive, featuring lifted aromatics of red plum, mulberry, and blueberry combined with notes of violets, white pepper, and heady spice. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied, delivering juicy flavours of blackcurrant, dark cherry preserves, and chocolate. The wine is expertly textured with fine, velvety tannins and a refreshing acidity, finishing with lingering notes of vanilla bean and toasted hazelnuts. To add complexity and fresh acidity, a small volume of Barbera is often included in the blend. It is drinking well now but will reward cellaring for 5 to 7 years.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '23' Hayata Junmai Daiginjo - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Dassai 23 Hayata Junmai Daiginjo is an ultra-premium, limited-edition sake from the Yamaguchi prefecture of Japan. It is crafted by Asahi Shuzo, a brewery founded in 1948 that is globally recognized for its 'Dassai' brand and its commitment to brewing only the highest level of Junmai Daiginjo. This specific expression is named after the late Professor Eiji Hayata, who collaborated with the brewery to develop a revolutionary preservation method using micro-bubbled carbon dioxide. This technique allows for minimal heat pasteurization, stabilizing the sake while preserving the vibrant, 'fresh-pressed' qualities typically lost in traditional processing.

Description

This sake presents a clear appearance and a stunningly complex sensory profile. The nose is filled with elegant aromas of Williams pear, white pepper, grape, and blueberry, accented by tropical notes of pineapple and floral hints. On the palate, it is silkier and lighter than the standard Dassai 23, offering a 'quiet liveliness' and a subtle natural sparkle. Flavours of melon, peach, cotton candy, and papaya float elegantly across the palate, balanced by a mellow sweetness and a refined, clean finish. It is brewed with Yamada Nishiki rice polished to an exacting 23% and has an alcohol by volume of 16%. To best appreciate its delicate aromatics and technical mastery, it should be served well-chilled.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '23' Centrifuge Junmai Dai Ginjo - 720ml
bodyHtml:
Dassai 23 Centrifuge (also known as 'Centrifugal Separation') is an ultra-premium Junmai Daiginjo from the Yamaguchi prefecture of Japan. It is produced by Asahi Shuzo, a brewery founded in 1948 and currently led by the fourth-generation President, Kazuhiro Sakurai. This expression is a technological marvel; while most sake is extracted by mechanical pressing, this version uses a high-speed centrifuge to separate the liquid from the rice solids without applying external pressure. This "gimmick-turned-masterpiece" was first introduced to the industry on a commercial basis by Dassai to capture the purest essence of the brew.

Description

This sake presents a refined transparency and a gorgeous, delicate sensory profile. It features an elegant and subtle aromatic bouquet with notes of grapes, strawberries, and fresh spring blossoms. On the palate, the centrifuge method results in a "quality without any unpleasantness," offering layers of honey, ripe stone fruits, and a silky, seamless texture. The body is remarkably pure and well-balanced, leading to a long, fine, and lingering finish. It is crafted from Yamada Nishiki rice polished down to 23% and is bottled at an alcohol by volume of 16%. It is best served chilled, ideally in a wine glass to fully appreciate its complex aromatics.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai Mirai 'Future with Farmers' - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Dassai Mirai 'Future with Farmers' is a pioneering specialty sake from the Yamaguchi prefecture of Japan. It is produced by Asahi Shuzo, a brewery founded in 1948 that is led by Chairman Hiroshi Sakurai and President Kazuhiro Sakurai. This unique expression was created to support local farmers by utilizing 'Togai' rice—out of grade Yamada Nishiki grains that are typically discarded because they do not meet strict size or shape requirements. By super polishing these 'oddly shaped' grains to an astounding 8%, the brewery transformed a source of economic burden for farmers into a luscious, high end sake.

Description

This sake presents a colorless and transparent appearance but possesses a powerful and concentrated sensory profile. The nose is vivid and aromatic, featuring a complex collection of cantaloupe, white peach, green grape, pear, apricot, and strawberry, with a hint of powdered sugar and rice bran. On the palate, it offers a velvety, soft, and viscous mouthfeel with deep layers of blueberry, lychee, stewed apple, and mochi. While its use of ungraded rice prevents it from being formally classified as a Junmai Daiginjo, it drinks with the density and refinement of a top tier brew. It has an alcohol by volume of 15% and is best enjoyed chilled in a wine glass that widens at the rim to maximize its fragrance.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '23' Bisui 'Elegantly Tipsy' Junmai Daiginjo - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Dassai 23 Bisui 'Elegantly Tipsy' is an ultra-premium, limited-release Junmai Daiginjo sake originating from the Yamaguchi prefecture in Japan. It is crafted by Asahi Shuzo, a brewery renowned for its focus on the 'Yamada Nishiki' rice variety and its mastery of extreme rice polishing. The 'Bisui' expression is part of the brewery's avant-garde series, designed to offer a 'slightly intoxicating' experience through a lower alcohol content achieved strictly through fermentation control rather than dilution.

Description

This sake presents a clear, refined appearance and is polished to an exacting 21% or 23% ratio, depending on the specific release. It features a gorgeous and dense aromatic profile with notes of white peach, green melon, and a delicate flowery bouquet. On the palate, it is characterized by a honey-like sweetness and a silky, well-balanced texture that is less bitter and acidic than the standard Dassai 23. The finish is remarkably clean and subtle, leaving a refreshing sweet-umami aftertaste. It has a low alcohol by volume of 10% to 12% and is best served well-chilled to highlight its clear and refreshing character.

title: Louis Latour Pouilly Fuisse 2023
bodyHtml:
This distinguished white wine originates from the Pouilly Fuisse AOC in the Maconnais subregion of Burgundy, France. Maison Louis Latour, a historic family-run estate founded in 1797, is one of Burgundy’s most respected 'négociant-éleveurs' and has remained independent for over two centuries. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a deep respect for terroir and nature, having actively practiced sustainable viticulture since the early 1990s to preserve vineyard ecosystems and biodiversity.

Wine Description

The Louis Latour Pouilly Fuisse presents a bright and pale yellow colour. The sensory profile is elegant and floral, featuring a nose of acacia, honeysuckle, and lime blossom, with additional complex aromas of white fruits and honey. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, round, and generous, showcasing honeysuckle flavours associated with notes of fresh almond and brioche. It is characterized by its opulent texture and a long, persistent finish that reveals a subtle spiciness. This 100% Chardonnay typically has an ABV of 13.5% and was fermented and aged for 8 to 10 months in stainless steel vats to maintain its fruit-driven freshness.

title: Louis Latour Morgon 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured red wine originates from the Morgon AOC in the Beaujolais region of France. Maison Louis Latour, a historic family-run company founded in 1797, is one of Burgundy's most respected 'negociant-eleveurs'. The winery's philosophy in Beaujolais emphasizes traditional Burgundian vinification methods including hand-picking and fermentation in open vats without carbonic maceration to produce elegant wines that express the unique characteristics of the Gamay grape and its specific terroir.

Wine Description

The Louis Latour Morgon reveals a bright garnet-red colour. The sensory profile is intense and complex, featuring a nose of blackberry, blueberry, and wild strawberry. On the palate, the wine is round and fresh, showcasing juicy flavours of black cherry and clove. It is characterized by its ample substance, fine-grained tannins, and a touch of wet-stone minerality that balances its medium-bodied structure. The finish is long, harmonious, and velvety. This 100% Gamay typically has an ABV of 13% and is aged for 8 to 10 months in stainless steel vats to maintain its fruit purity.

title: Taylor Fladgate 10 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
This superb example of aged tawny Porto originates from the Douro Valley in Portugal, specifically sourced from the prestigious vineyards of the Cima Corgo and Douro Superior subregions. Established in 1692, Taylor Fladgate is one of the oldest and most respected Port houses, remaining independent throughout its three-hundred-year history. The winery is a leader in winemaking technology, pioneering techniques such as piston fermenters often called 'Port Toes' to extract greater flavour and aroma than conventional methods. Their 10 Year Old Tawny is a masterfully crafted blend of tawnies with an average age of ten years, matured in seasoned oak casks in the firm's tranquil cellars in Oporto.

Wine Description

The Taylor Fladgate 10 Year Old Tawny Port presents a deep brick colour with a characteristic amber rim. The sensory profile is rich and elegant, featuring a nose that combines ripe berry fruit with a delicate nuttiness and subtle notes of chocolate, butterscotch, and fine oak. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, smooth, and silky, showcasing concentrated flavours of ripe figs and jammy fruit. It is characterized by its mellow complexity and a long, persistent finish that reveals hints of toffee and caramel. This fortified blend is composed of traditional Port varieties, including Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Barroca, Tinta Roriz, Tinto Cão, and Tinta Amarela. The wine has an ABV of 20% and a high residual sugar content of approximately 105 g/L.

title: Giusti Merlot IGT Veneto 2023
bodyHtml:
Giusti Merlot Veneto IGT is produced in the Veneto region of Northern Italy, with grapes selected from vineyards in the Marca Trevigiana and Nervesa della Battaglia. The winery was founded by Ermenegildo 'Joe' Giusti, a successful businessman who returned to his Italian roots to restore his family's viticultural tradition dating back to the 17th century. Giusti's winemaking philosophy centers on a deep link with the territory and sustainability, highlighted by their cutting-edge underground cellar designed to have a minimal environmental impact while preserving the historical significance of the land.

Wine Description

This Merlot presents an intense ruby red color with distinct violet reflections. The bouquet is intense and fruity, characterized by notes of red fruits such as plum, cherry, and raspberry, often accompanied by subtle hints of tomato leaf and light spices. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied, full, and harmonious, offering a persistent taste with sweet, well-balanced tannins and a clean finish. It is a versatile 'new style' Merlot vinified in stainless steel tanks to maintain its fresh, primary fruit character. This approachable red is best enjoyed within 4 to 5 years of the vintage to capture its vibrancy.

title: Leitz 'Eins Zwei Zero' Sparkling Riesling (Non Alcoholic) 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Leitz 'Eins Zwei Zero' Sparkling Riesling originates from the renowned Rheingau region of Germany, specifically from the steep, sun-drenched vineyards of Rüdesheim. Johannes Leitz took over the family estate in 1985 with just 2.9 hectares and has since transformed it into a globally recognized winery celebrated for its commitment to sustainability and high-quality Riesling. The 'Eins Zwei Zero' line was launched in 2007 at the request of a Norwegian chef seeking a sophisticated non-alcoholic pairing, reflecting the winery's philosophy that quality raw materials are essential for exceptional de-alcoholized wine.

Wine Description

This alcohol-free sparkling wine presents a pale, transparent appearance with fine, persistent bubbles. The aromatic profile is delicate yet vibrant, offering notes of lime, citrus, and fresh green apples with subtle hints of white blossoms and a faint mineral undertone. On the palate, it is light-bodied and refreshing, featuring a harmonious blend of yellow stone fruits, rhubarb, and crisp orchard fruit balanced by a lively acidity that prevents it from feeling cloying. The finish is clean and citrus-driven, maintaining a graceful freshness that mirrors a traditional dry Riesling. Produced using a gentle low-temperature vacuum distillation process at approximately 30°C, the wine retains its original terroir-driven character and complex aromas. It is best enjoyed well-chilled between 6°C and 8°C.

title: Pierre Huet Cidre Pays d'Auge Cider - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Pierre Huet Cidre Pays d'Auge is a classic, artisan cider produced at the Manoir la Brière des Fontaines in Cambremer, Normandy. The Huet family has been perfecting their craft since 1865, and their estate is a cornerstone of the famous "Route du Cidre." Holding the prestigious AOP (Appellation d'Origine Protégée) status, this cider is made exclusively from apples grown on the estate’s 30 hectares of traditional high-stem and low-stem orchards. It is a "pure juice" cider, meaning it is naturally fermented without added water, sugar, or carbonation, relying on the ancestral "ancestral method" of bottle fermentation to create its bubbles.

Description

This cider is typically a demi-sec (semi-dry) expression with a moderate alcohol content of 4.5% ABV. It presents a brilliant golden-orange hue with fine, persistent effervescence.

  • Nose: Intense and complex, leading with aromas of ripe "loft apples," fresh butter, and a hint of honey. As it breathes, it reveals secondary notes of dried apricot and a subtle vegetal freshness.

  • Palate: The entry is round and generous, offering a perfect balance between fruity sweetness and a sophisticated, well-integrated bitterness. The texture is often described as "fluffy" or creamy due to the natural bottle fermentation.

  • Finish: Long and clean, characterized by a refreshing touch of astringency and a lingering hint of caramelized apple.

title: Lulu Spritz 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Lulu Spritz is a premium, ready-to-drink (RTD) "Aperol-style" wine spritzer that brings the Italian aperitivo tradition into a convenient canned format. Produced by Station 22 in Quebec, it was specifically designed to capture the refreshing, bittersweet profile of a classic spritz without the need for multiple bottles and mixing. It is marketed as a sophisticated "summer quencher" that balances professional mixology standards with the portability of a 355ml can.

Description

The drink is characterized by its vibrant, deep orange color and a "frizzante" (lightly sparkling) texture.

  • Nose: It leads with a bright, aromatic bouquet of zesty Sicilian citrus and a complex herbal undertone.

  • Palate: The entry is light and refreshing, featuring the crisp acidity of Italian Pinot Grigio. This is immediately followed by a "sublime bittersweet" middle, where the botanicals from the orange bitters provide a sophisticated, slightly medicinal edge typical of Italian aperitifs.

  • Finish: Clean and drying, with a lingering herbal complexity that encourages the next sip.

  • Strength: It is bottled at 7% ABV, making it a "sessionable" choice for long afternoons or pre-dinner drinks.

title: Sunrise Hotel 'Welcome' Margarita 355 ml - 24 Cans
vendor: 300772 - Copper And Theory Artisan Beer Supply
bodyHtml:
The Sunrise Hotel Welcome Margarita is a premium ready-to-drink (RTD) cocktail from the Sunrise Hotel line, a tequila-focused brand produced by the NiceLife Cocktail Co. in Port Coquitlam, British Columbia. Marketed with a playful, retro-vacation aesthetic, the brand is built around a fictional hotel theme where every guest is greeted with this signature "Welcome Margarita." Unlike many malt-based "margarita" beverages, this is a legitimate tequila cocktail made with real spirits and juices, designed to offer a bar-quality experience in a portable format.

The Welcome Margarita is crafted to be a crisp, balanced, and highly sessionable version of the classic cocktail.

  • Base: Authentic Blanco Tequila from Mexico.

  • Flavor Profile: It is described as a citrus-forward blend featuring zesty lime and a subtle touch of orange for sweetness. A distinctive "briny whisper" of sea salt is integrated into the liquid to mimic a salted rim.

  • Mouthfeel: Bright and refreshing with a smooth finish, avoiding the cloying or artificial sweetness found in lower-tier canned margaritas.

  • Strength: It is bottled/canned at 6.9% ABV, placing it in the "easy-drinking" category compared to high-proof bottled cocktails.

title: Hidden Bench Estate Fume Blanc Rosomel Vineyard 2023
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from the Beamsville Bench sub-appellation of the Niagara Peninsula in Ontario, Canada. Founded in 2003 by Harald Thiel and his family, Hidden Bench Estate Winery is an artisanal operation dedicated to producing premium wines exclusively from its own certified organic vineyards. The winery's philosophy is centred on a non-interventionist approach, utilizing traditional techniques and sustainable practices; such as geothermal technology and low-yield farming to craft wines that serve as a benchmark for the region's unique limestone-rich terroir.

Wine Description

The Hidden Bench Rosomel Vineyard Fumé Blanc presents as a concentrated and creamy white wine. The sensory profile is highly aromatic, opening with classic notes of fresh grass, hay, and green herbs alongside delicate oak spices. These are layered with fruit aromas of green pear, passion fruit, starfruit, and yellow pomelo. On the palate, the wine is rich yet balanced, showcasing vibrant flavours of grapefruit, tangerine, and gooseberry framed by a distinct flinty and saline minerality. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc has an ABV of 13% and was aged for approximately eight months in French oak barrels, with 12% being new wood. The wine is certified organic by Pro-Cert and produced using indigenous yeasts.

title: Bruichladdich Octomore 15.3
bodyHtml:
Bruichladdich Octomore 15.3 is the heavyweight "super-heavily peated" release of the 2024/2025 Octomore series. It represents a landmark moment for the distillery, clocking in at a staggering 307.2 PPM (phenol parts per million)—making it the second most heavily peated whisky ever released, surpassed only by the legendary Octomore 8.3 (309.1 PPM). Distilled from 100% Islay-grown Concerto barley harvested from Octomore Farm (located just two miles from the distillery), this 5-year-old single malt is a study in "The Impossible Equation": balancing extreme smoke with the delicate, honeyed sweetness of local barley.

Spirit Description

Despite its astronomical peat levels, the liquid is noted for its "patient distillation," which preserves the characteristic fruitiness of the Bruichladdich spirit. It is bottled at a powerful cask strength of 61.3% ABV, yet maintains a remarkably soft and unctuous texture.

  • Nose: Smoked cinder toffee, rich malted barley sugar, and honey lead the way. These are balanced by fresh citrus, crushed seashells, toasted nuts, and a hint of coconut that adds depth to the heady peat smoke.

  • Palate: Exceptionally rounded and viscous. It features a creamy "vanilla custard" and butterscotch profile, punctuated by dried fruits, sweet orange zest, and toasted oak. The massive peat influence is present but integrated, feeling more like "earthy malt" than a simple smokebomb.

  • Finish: Long and atmospheric. Notes of burnt sugar and coconut linger alongside a delicate sea spray, leaving a lasting impression of dry, earthy peat smoke.

Technicals & Production

  • Barley: 100% Islay-grown Concerto barley (Octomore Farm).

  • Distillation: Distilled in 2018 from the 2017 harvest.

  • Age: 5 years old.

  • Maturation Profile: Full-term maturation in a combination of first-fill bourbon casks (approx. 69%) and first-fill Oloroso hogsheads (approx. 31%) from Fernando de Castilla, Spain.

  • Purity: Non-chill filtered and natural color.

title: Poggio alle Gazze dell'Ornellaia 2022
bodyHtml:
This innovative white wine originates from the Toscana IGT appellation in the Tuscany region of Italy. Established in 1981 by Marchese Lodovico Antinori, the Ornellaia estate has been under the full ownership of the historic Frescobaldi family since 2005. The winery's philosophy is rooted in an obsession with excellence and a deep respect for Bolgheri's unique Mediterranean terroir, utilizing meticulous plot-by-plot vinification to express both the power and finesse of the coastal landscape.

Wine Description

The Poggio alle Gazze dell'Ornellaia 2022 displays an intense straw-yellow colour. The sensory profile is complex and vibrant, leading with aromas of citrus, white flowers, and elderflower, followed by notes of passion fruit, gooseberry, and a hint of freshly cut grass or mint. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and silk-textured, showcasing an exceptional balance between juicy exotic fruit flavours and a racy acidity. It is characterized by its aromatic freshness and a long, persistent finish marked by mineral and saline undertones. This blend consists of 53% Sauvignon Blanc, 37% Vermentino, 6% Viognier, 2% Verdicchio, and 2% Semillon. The wine has an ABV of 13% and matured on fine lees for six months with regular bâtonnage to enhance its richness.

title: Prunotto Occhetti Langhe Nebbiolo 2023
bodyHtml:
This expressive red wine originates from the Nebbiolo d'Alba DOC, though it is also classified under the Langhe DOC, within the Piedmont region of Italy. Prunotto is a historic estate founded as a winemaking co-operative in 1904 and later renamed by Alfredo Prunotto in 1923. Owned by the Antinori family since 1994, the winery was the first in the region to establish the 'cru' concept, identifying specific vineyards of excellence for single vineyard vinification. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes a balance between tradition and innovation, utilizing sustainable agriculture and manual techniques to express the finest potential of each unique terroir.

Wine Description

The Prunotto Occhetti Nebbiolo d'Alba displays a garnet-tinged ruby red colour. The sensory profile is elegant and classic, featuring a nose of red cherry, raspberry, and rose petal complemented by hints of licorice, plums, and a touch of earth. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and harmonious, showcasing juicy red fruit and subtle savoury notes framed by silky tannins and bright acidity. It is characterized by a refined structure and a persistent, lengthy finish with lingering floral and mineral tones.

title: Schloss Johannisberg Gelblack Riesling 2024
bodyHtml:
This expressive white wine originates from the prestigious Rheingau region of Germany, specifically from the historic single vineyard of Schloss Johannisberg. As the world’s first Riesling estate, Schloss Johannisberg has been producing 100% Riesling since 1720. The estate uses a traditional color-coded capsule system; Gelblack (Yellow Seal) serves as their inviting "entry-level" wine, representing a classic and aromatic introduction to the estate’s terroir-driven style.

Wine Description

The Schloss Johannisberg Gelblack Riesling presents a brilliant, pale lemon-yellow colour. The sensory profile is exceptionally vibrant and fresh, featuring a bouquet of yellow peach, apricot, and grapefruit, accented by delicate notes of orange blossom, rosemary, and cool mint. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "energetic," showcasing a fabulous concentration of fruit balanced by a racy, wet-stone acidity. It is characterized by its crisp, linear structure and a persistent finish that echoes with citrus freshness and mineral clarity.

title: Schloss Johannisberg Bronzelack Riesling 2025
bodyHtml:
This dry white wine originates from the Rheingau region of Germany, specifically from the single vineyard (Einzellage) of Schloss Johannisberg. With a history spanning over 1,200 years, Schloss Johannisberg is the world’s first Riesling estate and is credited with the discovery of Spätlese (late harvest) wine in 1775. The winery's philosophy utilizes a unique color-coded capsule system initiated in 1820 to categorize quality; Bronzelack (Bronze Seal) identifies their high-quality Trocken (dry) estate wine.

Wine Description

The Schloss Johannisberg Bronzelack Riesling presents a lemon-yellow colour in the glass. The sensory profile is elegant and precise, featuring an expressive nose of peach, pear peel, and Amalfi lemon zest, layered with delicate nuances of orange, nutmeg, and chamomile. On the palate, the wine is sleek and racy, showcasing a "huge wave" of wet stone minerality balanced by a sharp, linear acidity of approximately 8.0 g/l.

title: Magners Original Irish Cider 500 ml - 4 Cans
bodyHtml:
Magners Original Irish Cider is the international flagship of the Bulmers Ireland company, produced at the historic Annerville cidery in Clonmel, County Tipperary. Since its inception in 1935, the brand has remained committed to traditional methods, using a specific blend of 17 varieties of Irish cider apples. Known as "Bulmers" within the Republic of Ireland and "Magners" everywhere else, it is famously associated with the "over ice" serving ritual, which revolutionized the global cider market in the early 2000s by repositioning cider as a refreshing, year-round alternative to beer.

Description

The cider presents a bright, polished amber-gold color with a lively, consistent effervescence.

  • Nose: Highly recognizable and "appley," leading with the scent of sun-ripened orchard fruit, a touch of honey, and a subtle earthy musk from the traditional fermentation process.

  • Palate: It strikes a deliberate balance between sweetness and crisp acidity. The flavor is dominated by juicy, red-apple sweetness that is quickly tempered by the drying tannins of the bittersweet cider apples.

  • Finish: Clean, refreshing, and moderately dry. It lacks the syrupy aftertaste found in many modern "alcopop" ciders, finishing with a faint, pleasant astringency.

  • Strength: It is typically bottled at 4.5% ABV.

title: The Hamilton Russell Vineyards Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
The Hamilton Russell Vineyards Pinot Noir is widely considered one of the finest expressions of the varietal in the Southern Hemisphere. Produced in the Hemel-en-Aarde Valley of South Africa, this vintage is defined by its elegance and stony minerality rather than overt fruitiness.

  • Aroma: A complex bouquet of dark cherry, wild strawberry, and violet, balanced by savory notes of forest floor and soft spice.

  • Palate: Tight and vibrant on the entry, leading to a structured mid-palate with fine-grained tannins and a distinct iron-like mineral core.

  • Technical Details: This wine aged for 10 months in French oak barrels.

Food Pairing Suggestions

This Pinot Noir performs best alongside dishes that mirror its earthy, savory profile:

  • Poultry: Roast duck with a cherry reduction or herb-crusted quail.

  • Vegetarian: Wild mushroom risotto or truffle-infused pasta.

  • Seafood: Its high acidity makes it an excellent partner for grilled salmon or seared tuna.

title: Vina Marichalar Tempranillo 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Viña Marichalar Tempranillo is a modern, fruit-driven red wine from the Rioja region of Spain. It is produced by Bodegas Manzanos, a family winery founded in 1890 that is currently run by the sixth generation of the Fernández de Manzanos family. The wine is crafted with a focus on youthful flair while respecting the long heritage of the estate's very old bush vines located in the La Muga and Los Poyatos vineyards.

Wine Description

This is a vibrant "fruit bomb" designed for easy drinking but with enough structure to remain serious.

  • Appearance: A deep cherry-red hue with purplish glints.

  • Aroma: The nose is intense and pure, dominated by juicy red fruits like cherry and redcurrant, complemented by subtle notes of liquorice, spices, and chocolate.

  • Palate: It is pleasantly full-bodied and round, featuring ripe tannins and uninhibited fruit flavours.

  • Technical Details: The blend typically consists of 95% Tempranillo and 5% Garnacha. Following a slow fermentation at controlled temperatures, the wine is aged for 6 months in a mixture of French and American oak barrels (mostly 2nd and 3rd year) to add roundness without overwhelming the fruit. It has an alcohol content of 13.5% ABV and is certified vegan.

title: Green River Full Proof Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Green River Full Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon is produced in the United States, within the region of Kentucky and the subregion of Owensboro. It is crafted at the historic Green River Distilling Co., the 10th oldest licensed distillery in Kentucky, which was relaunched in 2022 and is now part of the Bardstown Bourbon Company. This expression is a small-batch offering composed of select barrels that are blended and bottled at their actual barrel strength to provide a robust, undiluted experience of the distillery’s high-rye mash bill.

Spirit Description

This full-proof bourbon is aged for five to seven years in Green River’s signature clay tile and traditional rickhouses. It is made from a mash bill of 70% Kentucky-grown corn, 21% rye, and 9% malted barley. In the glass, it presents a deep golden amber hue. The nose is rich and warming, featuring aromas of mulling spices, fresh cider, thick caramel sauce, and toasted vanilla, with deeper notes of cocoa powder and leather. On the palate, the high proof delivers an intense but balanced experience of warming spice, vanilla, and chocolate-coated peppermints, alongside dried cherry and s'mores. It possesses a lingering, rich mouthfeel and concludes with a long finish marked by tobacco leaf, honey grahams, and balanced toasted oak. Green River Full Proof is typically bottled at approximately 117.3 proof (58.65% ABV), though specific batches may vary slightly.

title: Green River Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Green River Bourbon is produced in the United States, within the region of Kentucky and the subregion of Owensboro. Founded in 1885 by J.W. McCulloch, the Green River Distillery is the 10th oldest licensed distillery in Kentucky and was once world-renowned for "The Whiskey Without Regrets". After decades of silence following Prohibition and a major fire, the brand was officially relaunched in 2022 and subsequently acquired by the Bardstown Bourbon Company. It remains a major anchor of western Kentucky's bourbon heritage as the westernmost stop on the Kentucky Bourbon Trail.

Spirit Description

The flagship Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a high-rye expression aged for a minimum of five years in traditional rickhouses. It is crafted from a mash bill of 70% locally grown corn, 21% winter rye, and 9% malted barley. In the glass, it presents a burnished copper or honey-gold appearance. The nose is refined and floral, offering aromas of rich caramel, toffee, and vanilla, accented by hints of wood shavings and freshly ground coffee. On the palate, it is smooth and sweet with a prominent apple character reminiscent of apple coffee cake, balanced by warming rye spices like cinnamon, allspice, and orange zest. The finish is long and clean, leaving a trail of spiced honey and apple-flavored cereal. It is bottled at a classic 45% ABV (90 proof).

title: Lake Breeze Albarino 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Lake Breeze Albariño 2024 is a refreshing white wine from the Naramata Bench in the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia. Lake Breeze Vineyards, established in 1995, is one of the pioneers of the Naramata Bench and is currently led by winemaker Garron Elmes. The winery is known for its focus on clean, fruit-driven wines that capture the unique microclimate of the lakeside slopes. Albariño is a relatively new and exciting variety for the Okanagan, thriving in the region's warm days and cool desert nights.

Wine Description

  • Colour: The wine displays a pale straw colour with greenish highlights.

  • Aroma: The nose is highly aromatic and "spring-like," featuring bright notes of lime zest, green apple, and white peach, often accompanied by a distinct floral jasmine or honeysuckle scent.

  • Palate: On the palate, it is crisp and light-bodied, delivering a burst of citrus and stone fruit flavours.

  • Structure: It is characterized by its zesty, high acidity and a minerality that provides a clean, bracing finish.

  • Technical Details: The 2024 vintage was fermented entirely in stainless steel at cool temperatures to preserve the delicate aromatics. It typically has a moderate ABV of approximately 12.5% to 13%.

  • Style: This Albariño follows the classic Galician style—dry, lean, and focused on purity and tension rather than oak influence.

title: Gerard Bertrand Clos du Temple Rose 2023 - 3 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand Clos du Temple Rosé 2023 is the flagship "prestige" rosé from the Cabrières terroir in Languedoc, famously marketed as the most expensive and arguably the finest rosé in the world. Produced at a state-of-the-art gravity-fed cellar, this wine is a tribute to the historic birthplace of French rosé. It is crafted from a unique blend of four red grapes and one white grape, grown on 11 specific plots of schist and limestone soil. The estate follows strict biodynamic principles (Demeter certified), using mules and horses for vineyard work to maintain soil health. The 2023 vintage continues the tradition of fermenting and aging the wine for six months in new French oak barrels, resulting in a "gastronomic" rosé built for longevity.

Wine Description

The 2023 vintage is exceptionally pale with a glittering, translucent pink hue and copper reflections.

  • Nose: It offers a highly sophisticated and multi-layered bouquet. Primary notes of ripe apricot and white peach are intertwined with floral scents of rose petals and violets. Complex secondary aromas of green pepper, blond tobacco, and "addictive" oak influences—like marzipan, nougat, and nut butter—emerge as it breathes.

  • Palate: The mouthfeel is ample, silky, and perfectly balanced. It mirrors the nose with juicy stone fruit and wild berries, supported by a distinct mineral saltiness and brilliant acidity. The oak is masterfully integrated, providing structure without overwhelming the fruit.

  • Finish: Remarkably long and persistent, characterized by a clean, mineral finish with lingering notes of white pepper and spice. It is bottled at 14% ABV

Food Pairing

Clos du Temple is designed to be served at 10°C and paired with the same level of cuisine as a Grand Cru Burgundy.

  • Seafood: It is a superlative match for lobster, seared scallops, or tuna tataki, where the wine's minerality and weight complement the rich textures of the shellfish.

  • Poultry & Meats: Pairs elegantly with roast chicken, veal, or smoked meats. The spice and tobacco notes in the finish make it one of the few rosés that can handle savory meat dishes.

  • Exotic Cuisine: The Viognier-infusion and fresh acidity allow it to stand up to refined Asian dishes or spicy Mediterranean fare like saffron-infused bouillabaisse.

  • Cheese: Try it with matured Comté or Brillat-Savarin; the wine’s creamy oak and nut-butter notes harmonize beautifully with high-fat, high-umami cheeses.

title: Gerard Bertrand Domaine de l'Aigle Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand Domaine de l'Aigle Pinot Noir is a premium, high-altitude expression from one of the most respected estates in the Languedoc’s Haute Vallée de l'Aude. Located near the village of Roquetaillade at the foothills of the Pyrenees, this estate sits between 250 and 500 meters above sea level, making it one of the highest vineyard sites in the region. The cool, oceanic-influenced climate mimics the conditions of Burgundy, allowing Pinot Noir to ripen slowly while retaining its signature acidity.

Wine Description

It presents a brilliant ruby-red color with delicate copper highlights. On the nose, it is highly expressive and fragrant, leading with intense aromas of wild strawberries, raspberries, and redcurrants, layered with subtle notes of toasted oak and violets. The palate is medium-bodied and elegant, offering a juicy attack of cool-climate plums and cherries dusted with white pepper and wild herbs. The texture is silky and refined, featuring fine-grained tannins and a well-integrated structure from nine months of aging in French oak barrels. The finish is long, fresh, and slightly mineral, with a savory touch of grilled meat and spice. It typically contains around 14% to 14.5% ABV.

title: Plantation Land Series Panama 2010
bodyHtml:
Plantation Land Series Panama 2010 (also known as the Terravera Collection) is a vintage limited edition produced by Maison Ferrand at the Don José Distillery in Panama. This release is a tribute to Panamanian terroir, utilizing 100% locally grown sugarcane molasses and a modern multi-column still distillation. It undergoes Plantation’s signature "double aging" process: it matured for 8 years in ex-bourbon casks in the tropical humidity of Central America before traveling to Javrezac, France, for an additional 5 years of continental aging in 350L French oak Ferrand casks.

Spirit Description

The rum is bottled at a bold 51.4% ABV (102.8 proof) and presents a warm amber hue. It is noted for being surprisingly fruity and structured for a column-still rum.

  • Nose: Highly fragrant and aromatic. It opens with fresh coconut, dill, and vanilla, followed by a lush fruit basket of plum, nectarine, and apricot. Subtle notes of honey, almond, and sesame add a nutty complexity.

  • Palate: The entry is fresh and spicy. It delivers vibrant flavors of pear, berries, and orange zest, grounded by rich butterscotch, milk chocolate, and hints of roasted coffee. The high proof provides a "zingy" intensity that carries the spice.

  • Finish: Long and dry. It leaves a lingering impression of tobacco, licorice, and allspice, with a final tropical touch of banana and coconut.

title: Bardstown Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Bardstown Bourbon Company is produced in the United States, in the heart of the "Bourbon Capital of the World," Bardstown, Kentucky. Founded in 2014 by Peter Loftin, David Mandell, Daniel Linde, and David Luckett, the distillery has quickly become one of the most sophisticated and technologically advanced operations in the country. It operates as a "Napa Valley-style" destination, combining a state-of-the-art distillery with a transparent, collaborative approach to whiskey-making that includes glass-walled rickhouses and a full-service kitchen and bar.

Spirit Description

The distillery is unique for its ability to produce over 60 different mash bills for both its own brands and collaborative partners. Its portfolio is divided into several distinct series:

  • Origin Series: This core line features 100% estate-distilled whiskies. The flagship Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a 6-year-old high-rye expression (36% rye) bottled at 96 proof. It offers aromas of apricot, orange blossom, and mint, with a palate of caramel, nutmeg, and rich oak. The series also includes a Wheated Bottled-in-Bond (100 proof) and a High Wheat Bourbon (106 proof).

  • Discovery Series: This series focuses on the "Art of Blending," combining rare, aged whiskies sourced from across the country to create complex, high-proof profiles.

  • Collaborative Series: These limited releases feature bourbons finished in unique secondary casks, such as those previously used for beer (e.g., Founders Brewing), wine, or other spirits like Foursquare Rum or Ferrand Cognac.

title: Bardstown Bottled In Bond Wheated Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Bardstown Origin Series Bottled-in-Bond (BIB) is produced in the United States, in the heart of Bardstown, Kentucky. This expression is a milestone for the Bardstown Bourbon Company, as it is part of the "Origin Series"—the first line of whiskies to be entirely estate-distilled, aged, and bottled at their high-tech distillery rather than being sourced or blended from other producers. Following the strict federal "Bottled-in-Bond" Act of 1897, it is the product of a single distilling season, aged for at least four years in a federally bonded warehouse, and bottled at exactly 100 proof.

Spirit Description

This expression is a wheated bourbon, utilizing wheat as the secondary grain instead of the more traditional rye. It is aged for 6 years and crafted from a mash bill of 68% corn, 20% wheat, and 12% malted barley. In the glass, it presents a deep golden to chestnut mahogany colour. The nose is elegant and complex, opening with baked peach, cocoa, and lemon zest, alongside aromas of warm cinnamon rolls, honey, and a hint of toasted coconut. On the palate, the wheat provides a rich, creamy, and decadent mouthfeel. It features indulgent layers of stone fruit, toffee, and vanilla cream, balanced by a "whisper" of barrel char and light oak. The finish is long and slightly drying, characterized by lingering orange rind, baking spices, and a touch of dusty cocoa. Bardstown BIB is bottled at 50% ABV (100 proof).

title: Bardstown 'Collaborative Series' Ferrand Finish II Cognac Cask Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Bardstown Collaborative Series Maison Ferrand Finish II is produced in the United States, within the region of Kentucky and the subregion of Bardstown. Released in late 2025 as part of the esteemed Collaborative Series, this expression marks the second partnership between the Bardstown Bourbon Company and the prestigious French Cognac house, Maison Ferrand. The release follows the distillery's philosophy of "never standing still," merging high-aged American whiskies with the refined, fruit-driven elegance of French Cognac cask maturation.

Spirit Description

This limited-edition spirit is legally classified as a "Blend of Straight Whiskies" due to the inclusion of a straight rye component alongside three aged Kentucky bourbons. The specific blend consists of:

  • 73%: 9-year-old Kentucky Bourbon (74/18/8 mash bill).

  • 10%: 11-year-old Kentucky Bourbon (78/13/9 mash bill).

  • 10%: 12-year-old Kentucky Bourbon (75/13/12 mash bill).

  • 7%: 6-year-old Bardstown Bourbon Co. Rye (95/5 mash bill).

The whiskey was finished for 15 months in Maison Ferrand Cognac barrels. It presents a dark amber colour and an intricate nose of French vanilla, black cherry, and sandalwood, accented by white chocolate and roasted almond. On the palate, it is full-bodied and viscous, offering layers of baked apple, pecan praline, and raisin that transition into "pastry shop" flavours and manuka honey. The finish is exceptionally long and complex, featuring oak-laden tannins, dark chocolate, and a final refreshing "kiss of mint". It is bottled at a robust cask strength of 111.8 proof (55.9% ABV).

title: Bardstown 'Collaborative Series' Silver Oak Cabernet Cask Finish Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Bardstown Collaborative Series Silver Oak Finish is produced in the United States, within the region of Kentucky and the subregion of Bardstown. Released in September 2024 to celebrate Bourbon Heritage Month, this expression is a high-profile collaboration between the Bardstown Bourbon Company and Napa Valley’s legendary Silver Oak Cellars. For over 50 years, Silver Oak has been a trailblazer in California Cabernet Sauvignon, and this partnership marks a rare fusion of two American luxury icons.

Spirit Description

This limited release is a masterfully crafted blend of six straight bourbons sourced from four different states, ranging in age from 9 to 14 years. The specific composition of the blend includes:

  • 25%: 14-year-old Kentucky Bourbon (75/13/12 mash bill).

  • 23%: 12-year-old Tennessee Bourbon (84/8/8 mash bill).

  • 22%: 10-year-old Kentucky Bourbon (78/13/9 mash bill).

  • 15%: 9-year-old Indiana Bourbon (75/21/4 mash bill).

  • 10%: 10-year-old Kentucky Bourbon (78/10/12 mash bill).

  • 5%: 12-year-old Georgia Bourbon (80/10/5/5 mash bill).

The blend was finished for 17 months in Silver Oak Cabernet barrels, a remarkably long finishing period that imparts a deep vinous character. It presents a dark amber colour with a nose of baked strawberry, plum, and roasted nuts, highlighted by cinnamon and cocoa. On the palate, the whiskey is full-bodied and velvety, offering layers of caramel candies, chocolate-covered strawberries, and raspberry jam. The finish is long and elegant, balancing jammy fruit and caramel cream with sweet oak spice and a light tannic dryness. It is bottled at 108 proof (54% ABV).

title: Jerome Choblet Chenin Blanc 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from the Loire Valley in France, specifically within the IGP Val de Loire. Produced by Jerome Choblet, a fifth generation winemaker at Domaine des Herbauges, the winery is located near the Lake of Grandlieu. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes the preservation of aromatic freshness through sustainable viticulture, and the estate is certified by both Terra Vitis and HVE Level 3.

Wine Description

The Jerome Choblet Chenin Blanc presents a pale gold colour with greenish glints. The sensory profile is intense and refreshing, featuring a bouquet of white flowers, honey, and ripe orchard fruits like pear and quince. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and supple, showcasing a characteristic 'crunchy' acidity and a mineral backbone that balances its subtle fruity sweetness. It is characterized by an unoaked style, aged on its fine lees in underground vats to maintain its zesty liveliness and varietal purity.

title: Cono Sur Pinot Noir 'Ocio' 2021
bodyHtml:
Cono Sur Pinot Noir 'Ocio' originates from Chile, specifically within the San Antonio Valley, with grapes sourced from select vineyards in Leyda and Santo Domingo. Founded in 1993, Cono Sur is a pioneer in sustainable winemaking and was the first winery in the world to be certified carbon neutral for delivery. The 'Ocio' project began in 1999 as a collaboration with Burgundian winemaker Martín Prieur to create Chile's first icon Pinot Noir, utilizing traditional French techniques like manual grape crushing by foot and aging in premium French oak.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir displays a deep, brilliant ruby garnet hue.
