The aromatic profile is complex and remarkably fresh, leading with scents of wild berries, cherries, and raspberries layered over notes of spices, tobacco, and forest floor. On the palate, the wine is full bodied for the varietal, characterized by intense fruit concentration, firm acidity, and sharp, fine grained tannins.

title: Zyra Coco Mist Vodka
bodyHtml:
Zyra Coco Mist is a premium flavoured vodka produced in Canada, within the region of Alberta and the subregion of Edmonton. The spirit is crafted in small batches at Hansen Distillery, an award-winning facility known for its high-quality artisanal production. Launched as part of the Zyra "digital-first" spirit line, Coco Mist is designed to capture a tropical, "sun-soaked" aesthetic, often appearing at vibrant lifestyle and nightlife events across the province.

Spirit Description

This expression is a triticale-based vodka that undergoes a cold-infusion process using real pineapple essence and creamy coconut. Like the brand's flagship Gold vodka, the base spirit is distilled thirty times for exceptional purity and smoothness. It presents a clear appearance with an inviting, lush tropical aroma. On the palate, it offers a silky mouthfeel with a prominent balance of sweet pineapple and rich coconut, leading to a crisp and clean finish. Zyra Coco Mist is bottled at an ABV of 23%, positioning it as a lighter, more approachable alternative to standard full-strength vodkas.

title: El Dorado PM/DHE High Ester Blend Rum
bodyHtml:
El Dorado PM/DHE High Ester Blend is the second limited edition in a specialized series from Demerara Distillers Ltd. (DDL) in Guyana. Released in late 2024 and expanding globally through 2025 and 2026, this expression is a "double double" pot still blend. It marries the historic, heavy character of the Port Mourant (PM) double wooden pot still—which dates back to 1732—with the rarely seen Diamond High Ester (DHE) marque produced on a small John Dore double retort copper pot still. This series represents El Dorado’s answer to the high-ester "funk" movement, though it maintains the signature richness and structure for which Demerara rums are famous.

Spirit Description

The rum is aged for 10 years in ex-bourbon casks and bottled at a robust cask strength of 51.7% ABV.

  • Nose: It presents a complex and punchy aroma, leading with green apple and flambéed banana. These fruity notes are layered with the classic Port Mourant scent of old leather, cigar tobacco, and a subtle hint of peat or campfire smoke.

  • Palate: The entry is bold and concentrated. Initial flavors of rich toffee and stewed red fruits are quickly followed by an explosion of baking spices—clove, cinnamon, and nutmeg. The "high ester" component adds a vibrant tropical acidity that prevents the heavy wood notes from becoming too dominant.

  • Finish: Long, warming, and slightly tannic. It leaves a lingering impression of dark chocolate, coffee grounds, and a refined, spicy tobacco dryness.

title: Bira! Venezuela Rum 15 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Bira! Venezuela Rum 15 Year Old is a high-octane, unadulterated release from the Canadian independent bottler Bira! Rum. Distilled in February 2008 at the Destileria Sofa (part of the Corporación Alcoholes del Caribe) in Venezuela, it is a 100% column-still molasses rum. Unlike many mainstream Venezuelan rums that are heavily sweetened or diluted, this expression is a "pure" representation of the region. It was aged entirely in the tropics in ex-bourbon casks before being bottled at a formidable cask strength. It arrived as a highly exclusive release in 2025, primarily targeting the Canadian craft spirits market.

Spirit Description

This rum is bottled at a powerful 62% ABV, yet it is noted for being surprisingly approachable.

  • Nose: Mild and inviting, featuring prominent aromas of apricot, stone fruits, and a playful hint of juicy fruit gum. The high alcohol content is evident through the slow, oily "pearls" that form on the glass.

  • Palate: Rich and viscous. It delivers a concentrated burst of ripe apricot and mango, followed by layers of cocoa, treacle, and sweet caramel. Subtle notes of anise and spearmint provide a refreshing counterpoint to the heat.

  • Finish: Long and warming, dominated by wood spice and lingering caramel. Despite the 62% proof, the finish is smooth rather than harsh, reflecting the quality of its 15-year tropical maturation.

title: Rum Agricole 970 Reserva 6 Years - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Rum Agricole 970 Reserva 6 Years (often simply called Rum 970) is a quintessential example of Madeiran rum excellence. Produced by Engenhos do Norte (North Mills) in Porto da Cruz, Madeira, it is crafted using the traditional agricole method from 100% fresh sugarcane juice rather than molasses. This distillery, operating since 1927, is one of the last in Europe to use steam-powered machinery. The "970" label pays homage to the year the brand was first registered (1970). This specific expression is matured for at least six years in French oak barrels within the island’s unique subtropical climate, which accelerates the interaction between the spirit and the wood.

Spirit Description

The rum presents a bright amber to dark copper color with an oily, rich texture. On the nose, it is highly aromatic and "vinous," reflecting the island's wine-making heritage. It leads with scents of candied fruit, vanilla, and blond tobacco, underpinned by the grassy, vegetal freshness typical of agricole rum. The palate is velvety and well-balanced, featuring a "symphony" of flavors including apricot, peach jam, and dried figs, followed by deeper notes of toasted cereals, bitter cocoa, and a hint of gunflint. The finish is long, dry, and elegant, characterized by soft woody tannins, sweet pepper, and a lingering herbal note unique to Madeira. It is typically bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Querciabella Camartina Igt Toscana
bodyHtml:
Produced in the heart of Chianti Classico in Greve in Chianti, Italy, the Querciabella Camartina is a premier Toscana IGT. Since its first vintage in 1981, this 'Super Tuscan' has been crafted from high altitude vineyards in Ruffoli, where the estate has practiced organic viticulture since 1988 and plant-based biodynamics since 2000. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes sustainability and a vegan approach, ensuring each limited bottling reflects the unique galestro and sandstone soils of the Greve hillside.

Wine Description

This structured red typically presents an intense ruby red colour with violet reflections. The complex sensory profile features a broad bouquet of black currant, blackberry, and plum, layered with Mediterranean herbs, leather, and floral notes of dried violet. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and polished, showcasing pithy, well-integrated tannins, a lively acidity, and a long finish marked by notes of graphite and sweet tobacco. Composed of approximately 70% Cabernet Sauvignon and 30% Sangiovese, it is matured for 18 months in French oak barrels followed by 12 months in the bottle before release. While approachable after 6–7 years, it has an extraordinary aging potential of 20 years or more.

title: Voerzio Martini - Derthona
bodyHtml:
Voerzio Martini Derthona is a sophisticated white wine produced in the Colli Tortonesi region of Piedmont, Italy. The winery is led by the 'Barolo twins', Mirko and Federica Martini, who continue the terroir-driven traditions of the Gianni Voerzio estate in La Morra. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on careful vineyard management and a deep respect for the environment, balancing traditional knowledge with innovative techniques to create wines that highlight the unique characteristics of the soil.

Wine Description

Crafted from 100% Timorasso, an ancient grape variety native to the hills of Tortona, this wine displays an intense straw yellow colour. The aromatic profile is rich and complex, featuring notes of peach, pear, and acacia flowers with a distinct hint of honey. On the palate, the wine is warm, soft, and well structured, delivering a full bodied experience with mineral undertones and a saline finish. It is often compared to Riesling due to its ability to develop hydrocarbon or 'kerosene' notes as it ages. This wine can be enjoyed fresh for its vibrant fruit or cellared for a long time to experience its evolution into more balsamic and nutty flavours.

title: JL Denois Brut Rose Pinot Noir
bodyHtml:
The JL Denois Brut Rose Pinot Noir is crafted in the Limoux region of Languedoc, France, specifically from high-altitude organic parcels in Roquetaillade. Jean-Louis Denois, a sixth-generation winemaker from a Champenois family, founded the estate in the 1980s and was a pioneer in introducing Pinot Noir to this specific terroir. His philosophy focuses on minimal intervention and 'methode traditionelle' techniques to produce world-class sparkling wines that rival those of Champagne at an accessible price point.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir sparkling rose displays a delicate salmon pink colour with a fine, long-lasting mousse. The nose is expressive and elegant, featuring aromas of wild strawberry, cherry, and peach, enriched by 'bakery' yeast notes and a touch of chalky minerality. On the palate, the wine is creamy yet refreshing, showing a firm structure with flavours of raspberry and light spice. It is balanced and dry, finished with a 7g/L dosage that ensures a clean, sweet finish without any bitter aftertaste.

title: Albert Bichot Cremant De Bourgogne Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
Produced in France, this sparkling wine originates from the Bourgogne AOC, with its Pinot Noir grapes primarily sourced from the Côte Chalonnaise and Chardonnay from the Auxerrois. Maison Albert Bichot is a venerable family estate with roots in Burgundy dating back to 1350, though the wine business was officially founded in 1831. Their winemaking philosophy centers on a deep respect for the land and sustainable viticulture, intervening as little as possible during production to ensure the wine reflects its unique terroir.

Wine Description

This Crémant de Bourgogne presents a subtle and seductive rosé colour with fine, persistent bubbles. The aromatic profile is marked by intense notes of red berries, specifically raspberry and blackcurrant, accompanied by nuances of citrus fruit and a hint of spice. On the palate, the wine is fresh and lively, displaying a delectable gourmand character with a burst of vivacity. Composed of a blend of Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, and a touch of Gamay, it is vinified using the traditional method and aged for a minimum of 12 months on lattes. It is a 'wine of pleasure' designed for immediate enjoyment or short-term cellaring of up to 3 years.

title: Varichon & Clerc Privilege Blanc de Blancs
bodyHtml:
Varichon & Clerc Privilege Blanc de Blancs is produced in France, specifically within the alpine region of Savoie and the subregion of Seyssel. Established in 1901 in Seyssel, the maison is one of the oldest and most significant producers of Traditional Method sparkling wines in the area. Since the 1990s, the winery has been part of the Boisset family of wineries, maintaining its commitment to utilizing historical alpine grape varieties to create elegant, high-quality sparkling wines.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine displays a pale and brilliant gold colour with numerous fine bubbles. The sensory profile is marked by white fruit aromas of orchard fruits, apple, and pear, along with scents of white flowers and exotic fruit. On the palate, the wine is elegant and well-balanced, featuring a lively mineral attack, light toasted notes, and a long-lasting freshness. The body is light and subtle, finishing with a crisp, easy-to-drink character. The varietal composition is a blend of Ugni Blanc, Colombard, Chenin Blanc, Chardonnay, and the local Jacquère grape. The wine typically has an ABV of 12% and is produced using the Traditional Method with 15 months of ageing on the lees. This wine is not organic.

Food Pairing

This Blanc de Blancs is an ideal aperitif and pairs well with a variety of light dishes. Recommended pairings include seafood, lean fish, salads, and hors d'oeuvres. It also complements white meats such as chicken and turkey. For a classic pairing, it may be served with creamy cheeses like Brie and Camembert, or alongside smoked salmon and creamy seafood risottos.

Vintage Quality

As a non-vintage (NV) product, this wine is crafted by the winemaking team to maintain a consistent House style through a meticulous selection and blending of base wines.

title: Chateau Camensac 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Château Camensac is a Fifth Growth red wine from the Haut-Médoc appellation on the Left Bank of Bordeaux, France. The estate’s history is rooted in the 18th century, but it saw a modern revival after being purchased in 1964 by Enrique Forner, who applied his extensive winemaking experience from Spain's Rioja region to restore the property. Since 2005, the château has been owned by Jean Merlaut and Céline Villars-Foubet, who emphasize a 'vineyard up' philosophy and a constant search for excellence in expressing the estate’s unique gravel terroir.

Wine Description

It presents a deep ruby and purple colour that remains vibrant to the rim. The bouquet is complex and scented, opening with intense red fruit and red roses before revealing deeper notes of spiced berries, pencil shavings, white pepper, and crème de cassis. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied with a silky texture and ample volume. Flavours of blackberry, plum, and dark cherry are supported by firm, polished tannins and a mineral-limestone core. The finish is long and persistent, exhaling notes of savory salinity and savory dark fruit.

title: Champagne Eric Rodez Cuvee des Crayeres
bodyHtml:
Champagne Eric Rodez Cuvée des Crayères is a hallmark grower Champagne from the Grand Cru village of Ambonnay in the Montagne de Reims. The name Crayères refers to the ancient chalk pits used as cellars, which provide the ideal environment for aging this complex blend. As part of the Vins d'Auteur range, this cuvée showcases the blending expertise of eighth-generation winemaker Eric Rodez—a former oenologist at Champagne Krug—and his son Mickaël.

Wine Description

This wine typically displays a light golden hue with fine, persistent bubbles. The sensory profile is deeply rooted in its chalky origin:

  • Aroma: The nose is complex and layered, revealing mineral and floral notes that open into red apple, strawberries, and citrus fruit, balanced by autolytic hints of brioche, toast, and honey.

  • Palate: It is fresh and generous, featuring flavours of spring berries, Meyer lemons, and pink lady apples alongside a distinct, seashell-like mineral acidity.

  • Body and Finish: The wine is medium- to full-bodied with a creamy, frothy mousse and a vibrant, linear structure that carries into an exceptionally long, savoury finish.

  • Technical Details: The blend is consistently composed of 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay, sourced entirely from Grand Cru parcels. A high proportion of reserve wines (up to 70%) is used to maintain homogeneity across releases. Vinification occurs primarily in small oak barrels (80% to 90%) with partial malolactic fermentation (around 30%). The dosage is very low at 2 g/L to 2.5 g/L, classifying it as Extra Brut.

Food Pairing

The structured and vinous character of Cuvée des Crayères makes it suitable for a wide variety of pairings:

  • Seafood: It is an ideal match for oysters, grilled fish, and sashimi.

  • Main Courses: The wine's depth complements braised lamb shanks, roasted white meats, or herb-seasoned chicken.

  • Vegetarian: It pairs excellently with butternut squash and goat cheese ravioli or dishes featuring parmesan and tomato.

title: Jerome Choblet Chardonnay 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from the Loire Valley in France, specifically within the IGP Val de Loire. Jerome Choblet is a renowned fifth generation winegrower based at Domaine des Herbauges, located near the Lake of Grandlieu in the Loire-Atlantique department. The winery's philosophy combines age-old know-how with sustainable practices; the entire vineyard has been cultivated following Sustainable Agriculture guidelines since 1980 and holds both Terra Vitis and HVE Level 3 certifications.

Wine Description

The Jerome Choblet Chardonnay presents a lovely gold white colour. The sensory profile is intense and 'crunchy,' featuring a fresh bouquet reminiscent of white-pulp fruit, citrus, and orange blossom, with tropical highlights. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and supple, showcasing juicy flavours of pear and green apple balanced by a zesty liveliness. It is characterized by an unoaked style, having been aged on its lees for 8 to 14 months in underground vats without malolactic fermentation to preserve its crisp, aromatic purity.

title: La Soufrandiere Pouilly-Vinzelles 2023
bodyHtml:
La Soufrandière Pouilly-Vinzelles 2023 is a premium white Burgundy from the Mâconnais region of France. The estate, located in the village of Vinzelles, was acquired by the Bret family in 1947 and is currently managed by third-generation brothers Jean-Philippe and Jean-Guillaume Bret. Their winemaking philosophy is centered on deep respect for the land, having transitioned the 12-hectare estate to full biodynamic and organic farming in 2000. The brothers are pioneers of high-quality viticulture in southern Burgundy, focusing on revealing the unique mineral identity of their limestone-rich terroirs.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay is a blend from young vines (23 to 48 years old) located in the prized 'Les Quarts' parcel.

  • Colour: The wine displays a pale lemon or straw yellow colour with bright reflections.

  • Aroma: The nose is seductive and fragrant, offering aromas of almond, white flowers, citrus confit, and white peach.

  • Palate: On the palate, the wine is generous and rounded yet maintains a zesty, energetic 'bounce'. It features flavours of ripe yellow fruits, fresh pear, and carambola.

  • Body and Finish: It is medium-bodied with an appealing, silky texture and a long, persistent finish characterized by saline minerals and limestone tension.

  • Technical Details: The grapes are hand-picked and whole-cluster pressed; the 2023 vintage was vinified under the 'Zen' regime with minimal sulfur additions. The wine typically possesses an ABV of 13% to 13.5% and is aged for 11 months, with 80% in stainless steel tanks and 20% in used 228-litre oak barrels. The estate is certified organic by Ecocert and biodynamic by Demeter.

Food Pairing

The balance of creaminess and mineral tension in this wine makes it a versatile companion for sophisticated cuisine:

  • Seafood: It pairs perfectly with pan-fried monkfish, gratin of scallops, Mediterranean prawn brochettes, and shellfish.

  • Poultry and Meat: Suggested pairings include butter chicken with fenugreek or Lyon andouillette.

  • Vegetarian and Cheese: It complements cauliflower tabbouleh with apples and nuts, as well as creamy preparations of goat's cheese.

title: Bret Brothers Julienas La Bottiere 2023
bodyHtml:
Bret Brothers Juliénas La Bottière 2023 is a premium red wine from the Juliénas Cru, the northernmost appellation of the Beaujolais region in France. The Bret Brothers micro-négociant was founded in 2001 by Jean-Philippe and Jean-Guillaume Bret, who apply the same meticulous organic and biodynamic standards to purchased grapes as they do to their own estate, Domaine de la Soufrandière. The La Bottière cuvée is sourced from a tiny 0.5-hectare plot of old vines situated on pure granite and ancient alluvial soils.

Wine Description

This 100% Gamay is crafted in a 'throwback' style reminiscent of classic, old-era Beaujolais.

  • Colour: It typically presents a bright, transparent garnet to ruby red colour.

  • Aroma: The nose is highly aromatic and delicate, featuring scents of ripe red cherry, raspberries, and crushed violets, with subtle hints of pepper and meadow herbs.

  • Palate: On the palate, the wine is juicy and fresh, showcasing dark fruit flavours of cherries and stewed plums alongside piquant notes of stone and licorice.

  • Body and Finish: It is characterized by its round texture and fine-grained, supple tannins that provide a firm yet elegant structure. The finish is long and slightly spicy with a distinct mineral lift.

  • Technical Details: Part of the "Zen" series, the wine is fermented with 100% whole clusters and undergoes carbonic maceration using native yeasts. It is aged for approximately 10 to 11 months in used Burgundian oak barrels and bottled unfined and unfiltered with minimal sulfur additions (10–20 mg/L). The wine typically possesses an ABV of around 13%.

Food Pairing

The structured yet fruity profile of this Juliénas makes it a versatile companion for various cuisines:

  • Poultry and Meats: It is a classic match for roast chicken, duck confit, or grilled pork seasoned with herbs.

  • Charcuterie and Cheese: Suggested pairings include artisanal dry sausages, salami, and creamy cheeses like Brillat-Savarin, Brie, or Camembert.

  • Savoury Dishes: Its mineral notes complement earthy mushroom risotto, lentil stews, or grilled vegetables like zucchini and bell peppers.

  • Asian Cuisine: The fresh acidity can also temper the heat of Thai red curries or Szechuan stir-fries.

title: Spier Sauvignon Blanc 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from the Western Cape region of South Africa, specifically within the Coastal and Stellenbosch regions. Established in 1692, Spier Wine Farm is one of the country's oldest wine estates and has been owned by the Enthoven family since 1993. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a regenerative approach to viticulture, focusing on ethical farming and sustainability, which has earned them recognition as a WWF Conservation Champion.

Wine Description

The Spier Signature Sauvignon Blanc presents a pale straw colour with a delicate green hue. The sensory profile is defined by intense tropical fruit aromas, including passion fruit, guava, and green fig, alongside classic notes of gooseberry and green bell pepper. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and mouth-watering, showcasing a well-balanced acidity and a fresh, linear purity of fruit. It is characterized by its crisp, unwooded style and a persistent finish that often reveals subtle saline or flinty mineral undertones.

title: La Soufrandiere Macon-Vinzelles 'Le Clos de Grand-Pere' 2023
bodyHtml:
La Soufrandière Mâcon-Vinzelles 'Le Clos de Grand-Père' 2023 originates from a historic walled vineyard in the Mâconnais region of southern Burgundy, France. Managed by brothers Jean-Philippe and Jean-Guillaume Bret, the estate is renowned for its pioneering commitment to biodynamic viticulture, having farmed their vines without chemicals since 2000. This specific 1.1-hectare parcel was originally owned by their maternal grandfather and is situated on a rocky vein of ancient Jurassic limestone that is supposedly an old Roman path.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay presents a pale golden-yellow colour with luminous brilliance. The sensory profile is highly expressive and reflects a balance between warm ripeness and cool precision:

  • Aroma: The nose is seductive and precise, featuring scents of yellow apples, ripe pears, and lemon zest, alongside complex notes of brioche, blonde tobacco, and a hint of sage.

  • Palate: It is charming and open, delivering juicy, crisp fruit flavours of greengage and apple, supported by a creamy yeast texture and a touch of extract sweetness.

  • Body and Finish: The wine is medium-bodied with an energetic structure and a refreshing, mineral-edged finish marked by a saline quality.

  • Technical Details: The vines range from 40 to 115 years in age and are situated at 200 metres elevation. The 2023 vintage was vinified using spontaneous fermentation and malolactic fermentation, followed by 11 months of ageing—90% in stainless steel and 10% in used oak barrels—to preserve fruit clarity. It has an alcohol content of 13% ABV and is certified biodynamic by Demeter and organic by Ecocert.

Food Pairing

The richness and mineral tension of 'Le Clos de Grand-Père' make it a versatile partner for various cuisines:

  • Seafood: It is a classic match for grilled monkfish, scallops, oysters, and shrimp.

  • Poultry and Meat: Suggested pairings include Poulet de Bresse with a cream sauce or rabbit with mustard.

  • Vegetarian and Cheese: It pairs beautifully with mushroom risotto, light pasta dishes with herb butter, and local cheeses like Comté, Beaufort, or Brillat-Savarin.

title: Hoffmann Jayer Bourgogne Hautes Cotes de Beaune Rouge 2021
bodyHtml:
This elegant red wine hails from the Bourgogne Hautes Cotes de Nuits region in France. Originally known as Domaine Jayer-Gilles, the estate was renamed Domaine Hoffmann Jayer after its acquisition by Swiss enthusiast Jayer Hoffmann in 2017. Under the direction of winemaker Alexandre Vernet, the domaine focuses on a philosophy of meticulous vineyard management and a gravity-fed winemaking process designed to preserve the vibrant energy and mineral precision of their old-vine plantings.

Wine Description

The vintage presents as a brilliant ruby in the glass. On the nose, it offers an aromatic profile of ripe forest fruits, red cherry, and candied strawberry, accented by delicate floral notes, herbs, and a distinctive hint of chalky minerality. The palate is medium bodied and generous, balancing a smooth, ripe structure with high acidity and fine-grained tannins. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir from vines averaging 50 years of age, the wine shows impressive complexity and a long, fresh finish.

title: Ol' Beautiful Blueberry Lemon Iced Tea 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Blueberry Lemon Hard Iced Tea is a part of the refreshing "Hard Tea" lineup from Calgary’s Ol' Beautiful Brewing Co. Following the devastating fire that lost their Inglewood taproom in 2024, the brewery has continued to innovate through their "Sound Room" bar and partner brewing. This specific release is a sophisticated departure from the syrupy, malt-based coolers of the past. It is designed to be a "true" iced tea—brewed with real botanicals and actual tea leaves to provide a revitalizing, gently sparkling experience that tastes like it was made in a kitchen, not a lab.

Beverage Description

The Blueberry Lemon Iced Tea pours a vibrant, clear violet-to-crimson hue with a light, sparkling effervescence and a fleeting lace of bubbles.

Aroma: The nose is highly aromatic and "fresh." It leads with a dominant scent of jammy wild blueberries and bright lemon zest, followed by a distinct herbal undertone from the Honeybush tea base. There is a soft, natural honey-like sweetness that smells clean rather than sugary.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and exceptionally refreshing. It leads with a burst of tart blueberry juice and citrus tang, which is immediately balanced by the earthy, rounded flavor of the tea. It is notably light on sugar, finishing very dry with a crisp, revitalizing "snap" that cleanses the palate.

Profile: It sits at a sessionable 4.5% ABV and, as a tea-based beverage, has 0 IBU. It is notably caffeine-free.

Technical Notes: Unlike mass-market hard teas that use black tea and caffeine, Ol' Beautiful utilizes a custom Honeybush tea blend. Honeybush is a caffeine-free relative of Rooibos that provides an inherent, floral sweetness and a deep amber-red color. The beverage is brewed with this tea and then infused with blueberry and lemon components. It is "gently sparkling," meaning the carbonation is softer than a standard soda, making it easy to enjoy over ice.

title: Champagne Eric Rodez Ambonnay Rose Grand Cru
bodyHtml:
Champagne Eric Rodez Ambonnay Rosé Grand Cru is a prestige sparkling wine from the United States of France, specifically from the Grand Cru village of Ambonnay. The estate is led by eighth-generation winemaker Eric Rodez, who previously worked as an oenologist at Champagne Krug and now manages the domaine alongside his son, Mickaël. Their winemaking philosophy is deeply rooted in biodynamic viticulture and a complex blending process that often utilizes a high percentage of reserve wines aged in small oak barrels.

Wine Description

This rosé typically displays a delicate salmon or pale copper colour with a fine, persistent effervescence. The sensory profile is highly nuanced and reflects a sophisticated blending technique:

  • The nose is expressive and elegant, featuring aromas of wild strawberries, raspberries, and red currants, alongside complex notes of brioche, dried rose petals, and a hint of spice.

  • On the palate, the wine is vinous and structured, delivering a harmonious balance of fresh red fruit flavours and savoury, yeasty undertones.

  • The body is medium to full with a creamy texture and a vibrant acidity that provides excellent lift and energy.

  • The finish is long, clean, and mineral-driven, characteristic of the chalky Ambonnay terroir. The varietal composition is a unique blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, with a portion of the Pinot Noir added as still red wine to achieve the desired hue and structure. This cuvée is primarily aged in oak barrels and is produced following biodynamic and organic principles. It typically possesses an alcohol content of 12% to 12.5% ABV.

Food Pairing

The structured and gastronomic nature of this rosé makes it an ideal partner for a wide range of sophisticated dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with:

  • Smoked salmon, lobster, or grilled prawns with a light citrus dressing.

  • Roasted poultry, such as duck breast with a red berry reduction, or herb-crusted veal.

  • Charcuterie boards featuring premium cured meats and aged Comté cheese.

  • Light fruit-based desserts, particularly those featuring fresh berries or a subtle spice component.

title: Rhum JM 2015 Single Barrel New American Oak
bodyHtml:
Located in the small northern village of Macouba, Martinique, at the base of iconic volcano Mt. Pelee, Rhum J.M produces the finest AOC Rhum Agricole from estate-grown sugarcane.

Credited to be the first recorded distillery to produce Rhum Agricole, there is no fresher sugarcane crush in the world, taking less than an hour for sugarcane to go from field to fermentation tank. 

This aged agricultural rum comes from the JM distillery. It comes from a single cask selected for the New Vibrations collection.

First distilled in a traditional copper Creole column in 2015, it was then aged in a new American oak barrel toasted by the distillery's coopers.

title: Champagne Andre Clouet 'Chalky' Brut
bodyHtml:
Champagne André Clouet 'Chalky' Brut NV is a distinctive Blanc de Blancs that serves as a tribute to the ancient chalky terroir of the Champagne region. While André Clouet is traditionally known as a specialist in Pinot Noir from the Grand Cru village of Bouzy, this cuvée represents a significant deviation for winemaker Jean-François Clouet by focusing exclusively on Chardonnay. The wine is beautifully presented in a special white-coated bottle with a matching gift box designed to mimic the appearance of a chalk cliff.

Wine Description

  • Colour and Varietal: A bright golden-coloured Champagne made from 100% Chardonnay.

  • Terroir: The grapes are sourced one-third from the southern slopes of the Montagne de Reims and two-thirds from the Côte des Blancs.

  • Aroma: The nose is powerful and expressive, featuring citrus, almond, and blossom, alongside notes of lightly candied fruit, spice, and gingerbread.

  • Palate and Body: On the palate, the wine is mineral-driven and salty with a creamy perlage. It offers flavours of sweet citrus and ginger bread, balancing a "salty-chalky purism" with a seductive, melting charm.

  • Philosophy: The cuvée is a homage to the 200 million years of geological history that created the region's mineral-rich, limestone-heavy soil, which provides the vines with warmth, water drainage, and a unique saline character.

Food Pairing

The crisp, mineral, and saline profile of 'Chalky' makes it a highly versatile pairing partner.

  • Seafood: It is a classic match for fresh oysters, grilled langoustines, giant crevettes, and smoked fish.

  • Brunch and Appetizers: Suggested pairings include eggs Benedict and various apéro pastries.

  • Main Courses: The wine's structured acidity and richness allow it to complement succulent chicken breast served with a cream sauce.

title: Champagne Andre Clouet Brut Grande Reserve
bodyHtml:
Champagne André Clouet Brut Grande Réserve is a prestigious grower Champagne from the Grand Cru village of Bouzy in the Montagne de Reims subregion of France. The estate is led by Jean-François Clouet, whose ancestors served as the official printers to Louis XV's Royal Court at Versailles, a heritage reflected in the wine's intricate label design. The family's winemaking philosophy combines deep respect for tradition—utilizing ancient chalk cellars that once hid bottles during World War II—with a commitment to low-dosage, high-purity Pinot Noir-focused wines.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir (Blanc de Noirs) presents a bright golden-yellow colour with fine, persistent bubbles. The sensory profile is rich and multi-layered:

  • Aroma: The nose is effusive and fresh, showing high-toned notes of candied citrus, ripe pear, apricot, and strawberry, interwoven with complex nuances of hazelnut, brioche, and yeasty blossom honey.

  • Palate: It is round, creamy, and generous, delivering highly structured red fruit flavours such as cherry and raspberry alongside hints of spice and wild honey.

  • Structure & Body: The wine is medium- to full-bodied with a taut acid structure and a silky mouthfeel that balances opulence with refined elegance.

  • Finish: The finish is long and stimulatingly fresh, marked by a chalky minerality and a salty finesse.

  • Technical Details: This non-vintage cuvée includes approximately 30% reserve wines and is aged for a minimum of 36 to 48 months on the lees. It typically has a dosage of 6g/L to 8g/L and an ABV of 12%. Farming is generally described as conventional or following organic practices.

Food Pairing

The vinous and structured character of this Champagne makes it a highly versatile companion for food. It pairs exceptionally well with:

  • Seafood: Oysters, lobster, scallops, and ceviche or sashimi.

  • Main Courses: Poultry, white meats, and creamy pasta dishes or mushroom risotto.

  • Starters: Fine appetizers, sushi, and savoury pastries.

  • Dessert: Some enthusiasts recommend pairing it with fruit-based desserts like tarte tatin.

title: The Absolut Mixer Pack 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: The Absolut RTD (Ready-to-Drink) Mixer Pack is a variety pack that features an assortment of bartender-quality cocktails made with premium Absolut Vodka. While individual 750ml bottles of the Cosmopolitan are available at 20% ABV, the cans in the variety pack are typically formulated at a more sessionable 7% to 10% ABV. The variety pack generally includes the Classic Cosmo alongside other popular flavors like the Mango Mule, Berry Vodkarita, and Pineapple Martini.

title: Edouard Delaunay 'Septembre' Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
This red wine is a contemporary expression from the historic Maison Edouard Delaunay, a Burgundy house established in 1893 and revitalized in 2017 by Laurent Delaunay. The "Septembre" designation is a tribute to the most pivotal month in the vineyard, honoring the harvest and the winemaking process. This cuvée is designed to be a quintessential, accessible entry into the house's style, blending fruit from several distinct sub-regions to achieve a balance of finesse and fruitiness.

Wine Description

The Edouard Delaunay "Septembre" Bourgogne Pinot Noir is characterized by its elegance, purity, and authentic Burgundian personality.

  • Appearance: A superb, deep cherry red color.

  • Nose: Delicate and multifaceted, it opens with aromas of ripe cherry, Damson plum, and rhubarb, accented by floral hints of violet and lilac. Subtle notes of pine sap, toasted almonds, and freshly baked bread add a sophisticated complexity.

  • Palate: Remarkable for its breadth and freshness, the palate features flavors of raspberry and sour cherry. It is medium-bodied with a healthy backbone of fine-grained, pleasantly grippy tannins and a zesty acidity. The finish is surprisingly long and elegant, showing savory, earthy, and mineral undertones.

Food Pairing

Its vibrant acidity and sleek profile make it a versatile food wine. It is a classic partner for roasted chicken (specifically "Poulet à la Comtoise"), grilled pork chops, or lamb stew. It also pairs beautifully with earthy vegetarian dishes like mushroom risotto or gnocchi with truffles. For a more casual pairing, it works well with a selection of charcuterie and mild soft cheeses.

title: House of Rare Founder's Cut Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
House of Rare Founder's Cut Blanco is an ultra-premium, additive-free tequila that marks the first official release under the House of Rare label. This expression is designed as a high-end collectible, with a strictly limited production run of only 777 bottles worldwide. It is crafted with a focus on traditional methods, utilizing fully mature seven-year-old agaves and bottled at a higher-than-standard strength to preserve the intensity of the estate-grown agave. Each bottle is presented in a bespoke crystal decanter, emphasizing the brand's position at the intersection of spirits and luxury artistry.

Spirit Description

The liquid is crystal clear with a rich, oily texture that indicates high-quality slow distillation. On the nose, it is remarkably agave-forward, featuring deep aromas of roasted piña and earthy minerality. This is lifted by a vibrant herbal profile, including eucalyptus, mint leaf, and wild herbs, balanced by subtle notes of citrus peel and white pepper. The palate is structured and elegant, delivering a concentrated burst of sweet cooked agave followed by mineral salinity, rosemary, and green tea. The finish is exceptionally long and clean, characterized by a refreshing herbal dryness and a gentle peppery warmth. It is bottled at 46% ABV (92 proof).

title: Phillips IOTA Cerveza (Non Alcoholic) 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This beverage originates from Canada. It was launched in 2021 by Phillips Brewing and Malting Co., an independent craft brewery based in Victoria, British Columbia. The brewery was originally established in 2001 by Matt Phillips and has since grown into an award winning operation that values community and quality ingredients.

Spirit Description

The beer presents as a classic Mexican style lager with a light gold appearance. The aroma features subtle grainy notes from flaked corn and a touch of herbal hops. On the palate, it is light bodied and highly refreshing, offering a clean profile with a straightforward mouthfeel. The finish is crisp and dry, providing a thirst quenching quality. It is characterized by its simplicity and balance, designed to offer a vacation in every sip. The alcohol by volume is 0.5%.

title: Phillips IOTA Pale Ale (Non Alcoholic) 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This beverage originates from Canada. It was launched in 2021 by Phillips Brewing and Malting Co., an award winning independent craft brewery located in Victoria, British Columbia. The brewery was founded by Matt Phillips, who famously started the business using maxed out credit cards and has recently transitioned the company toward an employee ownership model.

Spirit Description

The beer displays a light gold colour in the glass. The aroma is characterized by a mix of floral hops, toasted cereal grains, and rounded honey notes. On the palate, it offers a smooth and balanced profile with subtle malt sweetness and a straightforward mouthfeel. The finish is crisp and refreshing, leaving a clean and lightly hoppy aftertaste. It strikes a purposeful harmony between high drinkability and authentic craft flavour. The alcohol by volume is 0.5%.

title: Roberto Voerzio Barbera Pozzo dell'annunziata 2012 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from Italy’s famed Piedmont region, specifically from the La Morra commune in the Barolo zone. Roberto Voerzio, one of Italy’s most esteemed and meticulous winemakers, founded his winery in the 1980s and quickly gained a reputation for extremely low yields and exceptional quality. His wines reflect a philosophy of precision viticulture and absolute dedication to terroir expression.

Wine Description
Barbera Pozzo dell'annunziata presents a deep, vibrant ruby colour in the glass. On the nose, it offers intense aromas of ripe black cherries, violets, and dark plum, interwoven with notes of balsamic, tobacco, and spice. The palate is rich and full-bodied, showcasing velvety tannins, a vibrant core of juicy red fruit, and refreshing acidity that balances the wine’s powerful structure. The finish is long and nuanced, with hints of sweet oak, dark chocolate, and crushed herbs.

Food Pairing
Ideal with braised short ribs, rich mushroom risotto, or aged cheeses like Parmigiano Reggiano. The wine’s structure and freshness cut through hearty dishes, enhancing both the flavours of the food and the depth of the wine. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Phillips IOTA Peach Wit (Non Alcoholic) 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This beverage originates from Canada. It is crafted by Phillips Brewing and Malting Co., an independent brewery founded in Victoria, British Columbia, in 2001 by Matt Phillips. After twenty years of sole ownership, the company recently transitioned toward an employee ownership model to recognize the passion and talent of its dedicated team.

Beer Description

The beer pours a soft golden yellow with a subtle haze and a creamy foam cap. The aroma is characterized by vibrant notes of ripe peach, gentle citrus, and soft malt. On the palate, it is light bodied and exceptionally smooth, balancing juicy stone fruit flavour with a refreshing profile. The finish is easy and clean, making it ideal for warm weather sipping. It is noted for its ability to deliver an authentic craft drinking experience with zero after effects. The alcohol by volume is 0.5%.

title: Domaine Anne F. Gros Pinot Noir Bourgogne 2023
bodyHtml:
Hailing from France’s renowned Burgundy region, specifically the Côte de Nuits, the 2023 Bourgogne Pinot Noir is a testament to the esteemed winemaking heritage of Domaine Anne Gros. Established in 1988 when Anne Gros took over her father's estate at just 18, the domaine has since been celebrated for its meticulous craftsmanship and expressive wines that reflect the unique terroir of Vosne-Romanée.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir showcases a deep crimson hue with purple undertones. The nose reveals a bouquet of red fruits, notably strawberry and raspberry, complemented by subtle earthy and spicy nuances. On the palate, the wine is vibrant and fresh, offering a harmonious balance between its fruit-forward character and refined tannins. The finish is elegant, leaving a lasting impression of purity and finesse.

Crafted from vines averaging 40 years in age, the grapes are sourced from three parcels: Les Champs d’Argent, Les Glapigny, and Les Pasquiers. The wine undergoes aging in barrels, with 30% new oak, imparting a subtle richness and softening the tannins.

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with roasted poultry, duck confit, or mushroom risotto. Its bright acidity and delicate structure also complement grilled salmon or a charcuterie board. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: JJ Prum Bernkasteler Lay Auslese 2020
bodyHtml:
This white wine originates from Germany, specifically the Bernkasteler Lay vineyard within the Middle Mosel. Estate Joh. Jos. Prüm (JJ Prüm) is a legendary producer, globally recognized for its signature style of Riesling that prioritizes extreme elegance, age-worthiness, and a "feather-light" balance. The Bernkasteler Lay vineyard is unique because its soil is composed of medium-deep, stony blue slate—heavier and deeper than in neighboring Wehlen or Graach—which tends to produce wines with a more assertive, richly textured profile.

Wine Description

  • Appearance: A clear, very pale gold that appears almost weightless in the glass.

  • Nose: It opens with a "fabulous range" of floral aromas, from European spring blossoms to tropical orchids. This is layered with white and yellow peach, almond cream, and minty herbs, all under a veil of spontaneous fermentation notes (a characteristic "sulfur" or smoky touch that dissipates with air).

  • Palate: Round and mouth-filling yet incredibly fine. It features concentrated flavors of peach, pear, and apricot, balanced by a crystalline, saline acidity. Critics describe it as "weightless" despite its Auslese sweetness, with a straight, delicate finish that mimics flowers dripping after a tropical storm.

  • Technical Details: 100% Riesling. Stated alcohol is very low at 7% ABV. It follows the Prüm tradition of stainless steel vinification to preserve absolute fruit purity.

Food Pairing

Because of its impeccable balance between sugar and acid, this Auslese is highly versatile. It is a superb match for rich desserts like fruit tarts, crème brûlée, or peach-based pastries. However, it also excels alongside savory and salty pairings, such as blue cheeses (Gorgonzola or Roquefort) or foie gras. It is also an excellent "meditation wine," enjoyed on its own as its flavors evolve over several hours or even days.

title: J Henry & Sons Small Batch Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Henry & Sons Small Batch Bourbon is a distinguished "farm-to-glass" spirit produced on the Henry family farm in Dane, Wisconsin. This bourbon is notable for its use of heirloom red corn, a variety developed at the University of Wisconsin in 1939, which the Henry family has grown since 1946. While the grains are grown on-site, the spirit is contract-distilled (historically at 45th Parallel Distillery) before returning to the farm to age in a rustic, non-temperature-controlled dairy barn. This exposure to Wisconsin’s extreme seasonal temperature swings (often fluctuating by 100°F annually) forces the whiskey deep into the wood, accelerating flavor extraction.

Spirit Description

This expression is a unique four-grain bourbon that utilizes both rye and wheat as flavoring grains. It presents a warm amber color with honeyed highlights. On the nose, it is exceptionally inviting, offering aromas of butterscotch, sandalwood, and brioche, accented by notes of stewed cherries and figs. The palate is creamy and robust, delivering layers of caramel, vanilla, and cinnamon spice, balanced by the earthy richness of the heirloom red corn. The finish is long and smooth, characterized by toasted oak, maple-soaked raisins, and a lingering touch of white pepper.

Food Pairing

The creamy texture and spicy-sweet profile of J. Henry make it a versatile partner for rich and savory dishes. It pairs beautifully with beef tenderloin crostini with horseradish cream or pecan-crusted walleye, where the grain-forward sweetness complements the nuts and protein. For a classic pairing, try it with aged Gouda or sharp Cheddar; the cheese's fat helps carry the bourbon's caramel and fruit notes. For dessert, it is an ideal match for a caramel cream puff or a dark chocolate tart, as the vanilla and cinnamon in the spirit harmonize with the cocoa and sugar.

title: Valfaccenda Roero Arneis Bianco 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy, this expressive white wine originates from the Roero region in Piedmont, a territory defined by its steep hills and ancient sandy soils. Valfaccenda is a small, artisanal winery led by Luca Faccenda and Carolina Roggero, whose philosophy is deeply rooted in 'conservative enology'—a commitment to making authentic wines that neither add nor take away from the natural transformation of the grapes. Their work focuses exclusively on the traditional grapes of the Roero, Arneis and Nebbiolo, aiming to transfer the true scent of the vines and the salinity of sea fossils directly to the drinker.

Wine Description

Valfaccenda’s Roero Arneis is a departure from the often 'rotund' or lifeless style of the variety, offering instead a wine of significant texture, substance, and vibrant energy. It presents a bright profile driven by white peach, Granny Smith apple, and citrus notes like lemon peel, seasoned with delicate highlights of fennel pollen, jasmine blossoms, and aromatic herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied with a notable salinity and a 'textbook' salty finish that is a hallmark of the estate's sandy terroir. Composed of 100% Arneis from organically farmed 10–15 year-old vines, it often undergoes partial skin maceration and natural malolactic fermentation to achieve its characteristic complexity and depth.

title: Counterpoint Brut
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This sparkling wine originates from Australia, primarily sourced from premium cool climate vineyards across South Australia. Counterpoint is a contemporary label produced by the Yalumba Family Winemakers, Australia's oldest family owned winery established in 1849. The winemaking philosophy focuses on creating modern, approachable wines that offer a perfect balance of fruit intensity and refreshing drinkability, reflecting the diverse landscapes of the region.

Wine Description

Counterpoint Brut presents a bright straw colour with a fine, persistent bead. The nose is fresh and inviting, displaying aromas of citrus zest, green apple, and white peach, with subtle undertones of toasted bread and yeast autolysis. On the palate, the wine is crisp and lively, featuring a creamy mousse and a refreshing acidity that carries the bright fruit flavours to a clean, zesty finish. The blend is typically composed of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, crafted using the Charmat method to preserve primary fruit aromatics. It is intended for immediate enjoyment and has an alcohol by volume (ABV) of 11.5%.

title: Barbeito Single Harvest 2011 Colheita Madeira - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
This exceptional single vintage Madeira originates from the dramatic volcanic slopes of Portugal, specifically crafted from a single vineyard located on the lower elevations of Estreito de Câmara de Lobos on the island's southern coast. Founded in 1946 by Mário Barbeito, Vinhos Barbeito is renowned for its preservation of authentic winemaking philosophies, championing the classic canteiro aging process while rejecting artificial additives like caramel or deacidification.

Wine Description

The Barbeito Single Harvest Colheita Madeira pours a brilliant, bright amber-gold colour. The nose opens with a beautifully complex bouquet of dried apricots, orange peel, toasted almonds, and pistachios, underlined by a touch of ripe quince, dry grass, and a distinct sea-spray salinity. On the palate, this medium-dry fortified wine is delicate yet structurally profound. It delivers layer upon layer of dried stone fruits, warm spice, and a gentle oxidative complexity, perfectly framed by a crisp, mouthwatering acidity and a fine mineral streak.

title: Don Adriano 1950 Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Don Adriano 1950 Reposado is an ultra-premium tequila that balances traditional Mexican craftsmanship with the refined influence of French cooperage. Produced in the heart of Jalisco from 100% Blue Weber agave, this expression is aged for six months in French oak barrels. This specific maturation period is longer than many standard reposados, allowing the spirit to develop a deeper, more sophisticated wood character while maintaining the vibrant, honeyed essence of the highland agave.

Spirit Description

This tequila presents a rich and inviting medium amber hue. On the nose, it offers a captivating harmony of sweet cooked agave, subtle toasted oak, and a clear touch of vanilla. The palate is intricate and notably smooth, delivering a delightful balance of caramel, earthy undertones, and warm baking spices. Fans of the brand often note a "smoky brûlée" quality on the finish, which is elegant and persistent with just a hint of black pepper. It is bottled at 40% ABV and is known for its silky mouthfeel, making it an excellent choice for those who prefer a less aggressive, more dessert-leaning sipping experience.

Food Pairing

The smooth, caramel-forward profile of Don Adriano 1950 Reposado makes it a versatile companion for savory and slightly smoky dishes. It pairs beautifully with grilled carne asada or chipotle-rubbed chicken, where the oak notes complement the char of the meat. For a vegetarian option, try it with roasted root vegetables or mushroom quesadillas. Its vanilla and spice undertones also make it a natural match for desserts like traditional flan, churros dipped in chocolate, or even a simple vanilla bean custard.

title: 33 Acres Of Heart (Non Alcoholic) 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This beverage originates from Canada. It is produced by 33 Acres Brewing Company, a family owned and operated business founded in 2013 by Josh Michnik in Vancouver, British Columbia.

The beverage presents a vibrant pink hue in the glass, derived from its botanical ingredients. The aroma is characterized by a sweet floral bouquet, bright lemon spritz, and a touch of grains of paradise spice. On the palate, it delivers a punchy hibiscus flavour with citrus freshness and a light fruitiness from prickly pear. The body is light and effervescent, typical of sparkling water. The finish is clean and refreshing with lingering floral notes. This product is an adaptogenic sparkling water rather than a fermented beer, and its alcohol by volume is 0.0%.

title: Gabriel Meffre Cotes du Rhone Villages Plan de Dieu 'Saint Mapalis' 2024
bodyHtml:
This distinguished red wine originates from the Plan de Dieu commune in the Côtes du Rhône Villages subregion of the Rhône Valley, France. Founded in 1936 in Gigondas by Gabriel Meffre and his wife, the winery has grown from a visionary family business into a leading producer in the southern Rhône. The winery's philosophy is rooted in its role as a 'Négociant-Éleveur' and producer, focusing on creating wines that inspire sharing and offer an exceptional reference for the region's terroir. The Plan de Dieu subregion was officially recognized in 2005, and the Meffre estate has pursued sustainable projects, including organic conversion for select domains since 2017.

Wine Description

The Gabriel Meffre 'Saint Mapalis' Plan de Dieu presents a healthy, vivid purple or deep ruby colour. The sensory profile is rich and fruit-forward, featuring aromas of plum, cassis, and blackberries, layered with notes of licorice, cocoa, and peppery garrigue spices. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and harmonious, showcasing an expansive mouthfeel with soft, plush tannins and a balanced acidity. It is characterized by its smooth texture and a fresh finish that sometimes reveals mineral or anise-scented notes. This classic Rhône blend typically consists of Grenache (60–65%), Syrah (30%), and Mourvèdre (5%)

title: Amelie & Charles Sparr Pinot Gris Sensation 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine Amelie & Charles Sparr was founded in 2017 by husband-and-wife team Charles and Amélie Sparr, both of whom hail from deep-rooted Alsatian winegrowing families. Charles is the twelfth generation of the Sparr family, which dates back to 1634. Their winemaking philosophy is based on creating terroir-true, dry wines using 100% biodynamic principles, having achieved Demeter certification as of the 2019 vintage. This approach involves meticulous manual and artisanal techniques, utilizing the lunar calendar, and planting beneficial herbs to enhance the vineyard ecosystem.

This wine is made exclusively from Pinot Gris grapes. It presents a pale straw yellow and bright colour. The nose is intense, offering complex aromas of nut, peach, fig, white peach, apple, and warm floral notes of violet. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, warm, and enveloping in taste. It shows remarkable density and complexity, with exotic fruit flavours and a subtle, lightly spicy character. Notes of melon and citrus provide freshness, while a mineral flavour enlivens the wine. The finish reveals subtle caraway and hints of tannin or bitterness, contributing to its length. The wine is a structured white, faithful to the traditions of the territory.

title: Shannon Ridge High Elevation Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from the Lake County region in the North Coast of California, USA. Produced by Shannon Ridge Family of Wines, the High Elevation collection is a testament to the family's commitment to mountain viticulture and sustainable practices. The winery's philosophy is rooted in their Ovis Cycle program, an integrated farming system where sheep graze the vineyards to manage cover crops and provide natural fertilization, ensuring the health of the high altitude volcanic soils.

Wine Description

The High Elevation Chardonnay presents a clear, pale straw colour with golden highlights. The sensory profile is bright and expressive, leading with aromas of crisp green apple, ripe pear, and tropical notes of pineapple, accented by subtle hints of vanilla and toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and well balanced, showcasing a creamy texture that is perfectly countered by a refreshing, mountain grown acidity. It is characterized by its clean fruit purity and a persistent, elegant finish that reveals nuances of citrus zest and a touch of flinty minerality. This wine has an ABV of 13.9% and is produced using grapes from vineyards situated at elevations reaching up to 2,400 feet.

title: Casa Maestri 'Single Estate' Reserva de MFM Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
This Reposado (rested) tequila originates from Mexico, specifically the state of Jalisco. It is produced at Destiladora del Valle de Tequila (NOM 1438), also known as Casa Maestri. Founded by Michael and Celia Maestri in 2008, the distillery is recognized for adhering to traditional methods and has become one of Mexico's most awarded tequila producers. This expression is handcrafted from 100% blue Weber agave selected for its high sugar content. The agave hearts are cooked in traditional stone ovens for 36 to 54 hours.

Spirit Description

The Reserva de MFM Reposado is a small-batch tequila that is rested in American white oak barrels for a minimum of two months. This aging process imparts a light wood flavour, softening the spirit while retaining the vibrant agave character.

  • Colour: A pale straw or light golden hue.

  • Aroma: The nose offers a blend of cooked agave, sweet oak, and vanilla, with undertones of toasted coconut, citrus, honey, and white pepper.

  • Palate: It is exceptionally smooth and balanced. The flavour showcases rich agave, followed by sweet notes of caramel, vanilla, soft wood spice, and a hint of fruit.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, refined mouthfeel.

  • Finish: The finish is clean, warm, and lingering. It leaves a pleasant, light sweet wood and spice note.

  • Stylistic Notes: This is an elegant, pure, and refined Reposado, offering a perfect bridge between the sharpness of a Blanco and the richness of an Añejo. It holds a Kosher Certificate and is both gluten-free and low in carbohydrates.

title: Casa Maestri 'Single Estate' Reserva de MFM Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
This spirit originates from Mexico, specifically from the heart of Tequila, Jalisco. Casa Maestri, also known as Destiladora del Valle de Tequila (NOM 1438), was founded by Michael and Celia Maestri. The distillery, which is proudly run by a team that is 90% women, is dedicated to high quality and authentic craftsmanship, carrying the culture and heritage of Mexico in every bottle. The philosophy is rooted in tradition, using an ancient, painstaking production process with the finest ingredients and an uncompromising commitment to quality and excellence.

Spirit Description

This is a Blanco or Silver tequila, meaning it is an unaged expression of the spirit. It is distilled from 100% blue Weber agave that is carefully hand selected.

Colour: It is crystal clear, reflecting its unaged purity.

Aroma: The nose features the fresh, clean aroma of cooked sweet agave. Notes of citrus, vanilla, white flowers, and a slightly herbaceous quality may be present.

Palate: The taste is described as clean, smooth, and crisp. It delivers a smooth and balanced experience with flavours of sweet agave, herbs, subtle mineral nuances, and notes of tropical fruits.

Finish: It has a clean, long, and refreshing finish. A delicate hint of black pepper complements the finish, which can be peppery and smooth.

Stylistic notes: This tequila balances tradition and purity with a fresh, smooth, and crisp profile. The agave is cooked in unique old fashioned stone brick ovens and the tequila is typically double distilled using a pot still method.

title: Alias Pinot Noir
bodyHtml:
This red wine comes from the United States, specifically from various cool-climate regions in California, with a significant portion of fruit often sourced from Monterey. The brand Alias was founded in 2007 by Gregory Ahn and Jonathan Egan (now part of the Folktale Wine Group). The name "Alias" refers to the founders' desire to keep their "secret project" hidden from the large wine corporations they worked for at the time, aiming to create honest, high-quality wines without the "industrial trickery" common in mass-market bottlings.

Wine Description

The Alias Pinot Noir is widely recognized as a "overachiever" for its price point, offering a classic California profile that balances fruit and oak.

  • Appearance: A clear, bright ruby red.

  • Nose: The bouquet is aromatic and welcoming, featuring notes of Bing cherries, fresh strawberries, and raspberries, complemented by hints of vanilla, cola, and a touch of smoked earth or tea leaf.

  • Palate: Medium-bodied and smooth, it delivers creamy flavors of red fruit and milk chocolate. It is characterized by a silky texture, lively acidity, and a soft finish that often carries a subtle peppery or cedar spice.

  • Technical Details: 100% Pinot Noir. The winemaking focuses on preserving varietal character, typically resulting in an alcohol by volume (ABV) of 13.5% to 13.8%.

title: Erbaluna Barolo Annunziata 2018
bodyHtml:
Italy’s Piedmont region, and more precisely the esteemed La Morra commune in the Barolo DOCG, is home to the Erbaluna estate. Managed by the organic-minded Oberto family, Erbaluna champions biodynamic principles and minimal intervention. The family has farmed these vineyards since the 1800s, and today the winery is a reference point for natural viticulture in Barolo. Their Annunziata vineyard lies in one of La Morra’s most prized subzones, known for producing elegant and aromatic wines.

Wine Description
This Barolo Annunziata is a striking example of Nebbiolo’s grandeur, presenting a luminous garnet colour with hints of ruby at the rim. Aromas are complex and persistent, with layered notes of dried rose petals, cherry compote, leather, truffle, and hints of spice. On the palate, it shows firm but ripe tannins, a vibrant acidity, and a refined structure, offering flavours of wild berries, tobacco, and earthy undertones. Medium to full-bodied with an enduring, savoury finish, the wine demonstrates depth and finesse.

Food Pairing
Ideal with rich mushroom risotto, truffle pasta, roasted lamb, or aged cheeses such as Castelmagno or Parmigiano Reggiano. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Alias Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
This white wine is produced in the United States, primarily from fruit sourced across cool-climate regions of California, including Monterey County. As part of the Alias "secret project" by Gregory Ahn and Jonathan Egan, this Chardonnay is designed to be a "cult wine for the common man." The goal is to provide a high-quality, balanced expression of the varietal at a value-driven price point, avoiding the heavy, over-manipulated styles sometimes found in industrial California Chardonnays.

Wine Description

The Alias Chardonnay is known for its bright, approachable, and well-balanced profile that bridges the gap between fresh fruit and subtle oak influence.

  • Appearance: A brilliant pale straw color, often laced with honey-like highlights.

  • Nose: Clean and expressive, featuring a mix of tropical and orchard fruits. You can expect aromas of pineapple, mango, and banana, accented by delicate hints of vanilla bean, toasted hazelnut, and jasmine tea.

  • Palate: The texture is medium-bodied, round, and smooth. Flavors of guava, yellow apple, and pear are balanced by a persistent, zippy acidity that keeps the wine refreshing. Unlike many entry-level California Chardonnays, it retains a focused structure without feeling overly heavy or buttery.

  • Technical Details: 100% Chardonnay. Winemaking typically involves partial malolactic fermentation (around 50%) and aging in a combination of stainless steel and new French oak to achieve its signature balance of creaminess and crispness. The alcohol by volume (ABV) usually falls between 13.5% and 13.7%.

Food Pairing

The wine’s vibrant acidity and subtle tropical notes make it an excellent partner for a variety of dishes. It pairs beautifully with roasted chicken seasoned with lemon and herbs, creamy seafood pasta, or grilled white fish like halibut. It also complements earthy appetizers like mushroom tarts or soft, creamy cheeses such as Brie and Camembert. For a casual pairing, it is surprisingly good with buttered popcorn or grilled vegetable pizza.

title: Alias Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from the United States, primarily from the vast California region. Like other wines in the Alias portfolio, this Cabernet Sauvignon is produced by the Folktale Wine Group. The brand was established to offer high-quality, straightforward wines at an accessible price point, often referred to by its founders as a "cult wine for the common man." The grapes are sourced from various vineyards across California to ensure a consistent, fruit-forward house style.

Wine Description

The Alias Cabernet Sauvignon is known for its bold, juicy, and approachable character.

  • Appearance: It typically shows a deep garnet or purple-red color in the glass.

  • Nose: The bouquet features ripe aromas of blackberries, currants, and blueberries, often layered with hints of baking spices, tobacco leaf, and vanilla.

  • Palate: On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied with a supple texture. It offers rich flavors of dark fruits and fresh cherries, balanced by soft hints of cocoa, cedar, and oak. The tannins are generally light and velvety, and the wine is supported by a snappy acidity that provides a clean finish.

  • Technical Details: This wine is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. It is made in an early-drinking style, often involving a shorter vatting time to ensure supple tannins. The alcohol by volume (ABV) typically ranges between 13.5% and 13.9%.

Food Pairing

This wine's structured yet fruit-forward profile makes it an excellent companion for hearty meals. It pairs naturally with grilled red meats like steak or burgers, and its savory tobacco notes complement smoked meats or herb-crusted lamb. It is also a great match for casual favorites like pepperoni pizza, hearty lasagna, or mushroom-based dishes like a rich risotto or portobello burgers.

title: Brinley Gold Shipwreck Spiced Rum
bodyHtml:
Brinley Gold Shipwreck Spiced Rum is produced on the Caribbean island of St. Kitts by the St. Kitts Rum Company. Founded in the early 1990s by Robert and Zachary Brinley, the brand was created with the goal of producing the "best tasting flavoured rums in the world". The "Shipwreck" name is a tribute to a British troopship that sank off the coast of St. Kitts during the Battle of Frigate Bay in 1782.

Spirit Description

This premium spiced rum is molasses-based and uniquely features a base of rum that has been aged for four years in once-charred American oak bourbon and whiskey barrels. It presents a rich amber or light brown hue with a slightly oily texture in the glass. The nose is dominated by butterscotch sweetness and firm vanilla, with inviting notes of cinnamon, toasted oak, and orange rind. On the palate, it is smooth and full-bodied, delivering a balanced blend of Madagascar vanilla, nutmeg, clove, and a playful burst of orange zest. The finish is medium in length, leaving a sweet and aromatic trail of warm baking spices. Brinley Gold Shipwreck Spiced is bottled at 36% ABV (72 proof).

title: Brinley Gold Shipwreck Mango Rum
bodyHtml:
Brinley Gold Shipwreck Mango Rum is produced on the Caribbean island of St. Kitts by the St. Kitts Rum Company. The brand is a family-owned collaboration between father Robert Brinley and son Zachary, who launched their first expressions in 2002 with the goal of elevating the flavoured rum category through high-quality, natural ingredients. The "Shipwreck" line takes its name from a 1782 British troopship that sank off the coast of St. Kitts, a local legend often associated with lost rum barrels.

Spirit Description

This premium flavoured rum is molasses-based and crafted by blending high-quality base rum from Guyana with natural extracts. It is specifically infused with fully ripe natural Brazilian mangoes to achieve a sophisticated, authentic fruit profile. The spirit presents a clear, pale yellow or light golden appearance. The nose opens with an explosive tropical zest, followed by aromas of succulent mango and subtle hints of peach and citrus. On the palate, it is full-bodied and fresh, offering a lush, natural mango sweetness that avoids artificial candy notes. It concludes with a "sunny, beach-kissed" aftertaste that is clean and lingering. Brinley Gold Shipwreck Mango is bottled at 36% ABV (72 proof).

title: Brinley Gold Shipwreck Coffee Rum
bodyHtml:
Brinley Gold Shipwreck Coffee Rum is produced on the Caribbean island of St. Kitts by the St. Kitts Rum Company. The distillery, founded in 1986 by Robert Brinley and later joined by his son Zachary, focuses on using all-natural ingredients to create premium flavored rums. Like others in the collection, the "Shipwreck" name commemorates a historic British troopship that sank off the coast of St. Kitts in 1782.

Spirit Description

This molasses-based rum is aged in oak barrels before being infused with natural Brazilian Arabica coffee beans. It presents a dark amber color and a rich, bold aromatic profile. The nose is characterized by strong roasted coffee bean aromas accompanied by notes of dark chocolate and vanilla. On the palate, it offers a decadent and syrupy texture with prominent flavors of espresso, butterscotch, toasted marshmallow, and toffee. The finish is smooth and warming, leaving a lingering sweetness of cocoa and roasted coffee. Brinley Gold Shipwreck Coffee is bottled at 36% ABV (72 proof).

title: Brinley Gold Shipwreck Coconut Rum
bodyHtml:
Brinley Gold Shipwreck Coconut Rum is produced on the Caribbean island of St. Kitts by the St. Kitts Rum Company. The brand was founded in 2002 by the father-and-son team Robert and Zachary Brinley, who aimed to revitalize the island’s rum industry using high-quality, natural ingredients. The "Shipwreck" name pays tribute to a British troopship that sank off the coast of St. Kitts during the Battle of Frigate Bay in 1782, a historical event well-known to local divers.

Spirit Description

This premium flavoured rum is handcrafted from a molasses base and blended with natural island coconuts. Unlike many mainstream flavoured rums, it is designed to provide an authentic tropical taste without artificial chemical notes. It presents a clear, brilliant appearance and an inviting aroma of fresh coconut with subtle hints of molasses. On the palate, it is smooth, creamy, and naturally sweet, delivering a rich coconut flavour that carries through to a clean, lingering finish. Brinley Gold Shipwreck Coconut is bottled at a bar-strength ABV of 36% (72 proof), making it more robust than typical coconut rums.

title: Coors Original 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Coors Original, famously known as the "Banquet Beer," has been a staple of American brewing since 1873. Founded by Adolph Coors in Golden, Colorado, it earned its nickname from the thirsty miners who held celebratory banquets with the brew in the late 1800s. For decades, it was a rare find outside of the West, building a cult following that included presidents and movie stars before achieving nationwide distribution. To this day, it remains true to its heritage, utilizing the same high-country barley and Rocky Mountain water sources that defined its original recipe.

Beer Description

This classic North American lager is a brilliant, clear golden color with an effervescent body and a thin, bright white head.

Aroma: It features an inviting nose of freshly baked bread and toasted malt, with subtle, understated hints of banana and pear.

Palate: The flavor profile is well-balanced and sessionable, offering a satisfying malty refreshment with a touch of corn-like sweetness. It is characterized by its signature "Mile High" crispness and a smooth, clean finish.

title: Terre Nere Brunello Di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
Produced in the heart of the Val d'Orcia in Montalcino, Tuscany, Italy, this wine represents a deep commitment to sustainable and biodynamic viticulture. The estate, spanning nine hectares of Sangiovese, is nestled within unspoiled woods and managed with a philosophy that emphasizes craftsmanship, tradition, and a regenerative approach to nature. Manual harvesting and spontaneous fermentation with indigenous yeasts are central to their mission of expressing the authentic soul of the Tuscan territory.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese displays a medium body and a vibrant sensory profile. On the nose, it offers textbook Brunello aromas of tart blackberries, black plums, and cherries, layered with notes of orange peel, dried flowers, and earthy undertones like damp earth and leather. The palate is rich and well-balanced, featuring ripe red and black fruits complemented by hints of molten chocolate, tobacco, and cedarwood. It possesses fine-textured tannins and a lively acidity that leads to a long, spicy finish with a subtle balsamic touch.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling - 94 points."

  • "Wine Enthusiast - 92 points."

  • "Vinous - 90 points."

Food Pairing

The structured body and fine acidity of this wine make it an ideal companion for rich, savory dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled lamb chops seasoned with fresh herbs or a hearty beef bourguignon. For a simpler arrangement, aged cheeses such as Pecorino or Parmesan beautifully highlight the wine's fruit-forward balance.

title: Arabella Sauvignon Blanc
bodyHtml:
Arabella Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant white wine hailing from the Robertson region of the Western Cape, South Africa. This family owned estate has been farmed by the De Wet family since the 1860s, though the modern winery was officially established in 2006 on land where Arabian horses still graze today. Under the guidance of father and son duo Stephen and Jamie de Wet, the winery emphasizes manual harvesting and careful vineyard management to produce quality wines that authentically reflect the unique calcium rich soils of the Robertson Valley.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc presents a pale lime green colour in the glass. The nose is greeted by an abundance of passion fruit and ripe fig aromas, occasionally complemented by notes of gooseberry, green apple, and zippy citrus. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and fruity, offering a crisp profile of white peaches and tart apples balanced by a refreshing, well integrated acidity. Stylistically, it is celebrated for its freshness and complexity, leading to a lingering and pleasant aftertaste with subtle mineral undertones.

title: Grey Goose Vodka - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Using only the finest ingredients, Grey Goose is renowned for its smooth and silky character. Expect subtle aromas of sweet citrus and white flowers; the palate is soft with a gentle and subtle sweetness that envelops your mouth; warm and spicy on the finish. Perfect in a classic martini.

title: Produttori del Barbaresco - Barbaresco 2022
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
The Produttori del Barbaresco is a prestigious cooperative winery located in the Barbaresco region of Piedmont, Italy. Founded in 1958 by the local priest, Don Fiorino Marengo, it was created to unite small growers and ensure the continued production of high-quality Nebbiolo. Today, the cooperative comprises over 50 member families who collectively manage approximately 250 acres of premium vineyards, maintaining a philosophy dedicated solely to the expression of the Nebbiolo grape.

Wine Description

The Barbaresco presents a jewelled red colour and an expressive, heady aromatic profile of ripe raspberry liqueur, fresh cherries, sweet herbs, and pressed flowers. On the palate, this medium-bodied wine reveals considerable depth with notes of dark cherry, plum, cloves, and a touch of mocha. It is texturally resonant, featuring a 'broader, rounder shoulder' than previous vintages, balanced by juicy acidity and ripe, firm tannins that lead to a clean, persistent finish.

Accolades

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 95 Points

  • James Suckling – 94 points

  • Vinous – 93 points

Food Pairing

This versatile Nebbiolo pairs exceptionally well with classic Piedmontese dishes such as tajarin with meat sauce, mushroom risotto, or truffle-infused pastas. It also complements richer proteins like duck ragù or roasted veal, as its bright acidity and tannins cut through the fat of the meat.

title: Circus Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
From the sun-drenched vineyards of Argentina, Circus Malbec hails from the Mendoza region, renowned for producing some of the world’s most expressive Malbecs. The wine is crafted by a dynamic, quality-focused team that blends modern winemaking practices with regional tradition, embodying Argentina's passion for bold, fruit-driven reds.

Wine Description
Circus Malbec presents a deep ruby colour with purple highlights. The nose bursts with ripe blackberry, plum, and a hint of violet, layered over subtle spice and mocha notes. On the palate, this full-bodied wine delivers plush tannins and a generous core of dark fruit, balanced by lively acidity and a touch of toasted oak. The finish is smooth and persistent, echoing its dark berry and pepper tones.

Food Pairing
This Malbec pairs beautifully with grilled meats, mushroom risotto, or aged cheddar. The wine’s bold structure and ripe fruit profile make it especially suited to Argentine-style barbecue. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Establishment Afternoon Delight Hazy Pale Ale 473 ml - 4 Cans
bodyHtml:
Afternoon Delight is the lighter, more "sessionable" sibling to Sky Rocket, crafted by Calgary’s The Establishment Brewing Company. While it carries the same pedigree as their award-winning IPAs, it is designed for maximum "drinkability" without sacrificing the complex hop aromatics the brewery is known for. It’s a New England Style Pale Ale (NEPA) that serves as the perfect mid-day refresher, delivering all the tropical "juice" of a heavy hitter but in a more nimble, lower-alcohol frame.

Beer Description
