This Pale Ale pours a characteristic glowing, opaque straw-yellow, looking very much like a glass of fresh-squeezed grapefruit juice with a soft, billowy white head.

Aroma: The nose is bright, breezy, and incredibly fruit-forward. Expect a vibrant bouquet of lemon zest, white grape, and crushed pineapple, followed by a subtle, floral hint of elderflower. It has a "green" and fresh quality that feels incredibly light and inviting.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a remarkably soft, "fluffy" mouthfeel. It leads with a delicate, crackery malt base that provides just enough structure to support a burst of citrus and stone fruit flavors. The finish is clean and slightly dry, with a gentle, rounded bitterness that disappears quickly, making it effortless to keep drinking.

Profile: It has a very accessible ABV of 5.4% and low perceived bitterness, prioritizing "crushability" over intensity.

Technical Notes: To achieve its signature texture at a lower gravity, Establishment uses a high proportion of wheat and oats. It is heavily dry-hopped with a focus on Citra and Simcoe, but often features a rotating "guest" hop to keep the profile fresh and exciting. Like their other hazy offerings, it is unfiltered and processed with extreme care to preserve the delicate, volatile hop oils.

title: Antech M Le Mauzac Brut Nature
bodyHtml:
This distinctive sparkling wine originates from the Limoux region in Languedoc, Southern France. Produced by Maison Antech, a family-owned estate now led by sixth-generation winemaker Françoise Antech, "M Le Mauzac" is a tribute to the region's heritage. While Limoux is famous for being the birthplace of sparkling wine (predating Champagne), this specific cuvée focuses on Mauzac, the traditional "soul" grape of the appellation. The winery's philosophy is rooted in sustainable viticulture and "precision" winemaking, utilizing the Méthode Traditionnelle to prove that Mauzac can produce world-class, bone-dry sparkling wine.

Wine Description

Antech "M Le Mauzac" presents a bright pale yellow colour with fine, persistent bubbles. The sensory profile is highly characteristic of the varietal, leading with unique aromas of dried apple peel, acacia flowers, and honey, accented by a distinct mineral "stony" quality. On the palate, the wine is sharp, clean, and incredibly fresh. It is a Brut Nature, meaning it has zero dosage (no added sugar), allowing the natural acidity and the varietal's signature "green apple" bite to shine through. It is characterized by its tension and a long, saline finish that leaves the palate refreshed. This 100% Mauzac typically has an ABV of 12% and is aged on the lees for at least 18 months.

title: Castello Di Verduno Barbera D'Alba 2025
bodyHtml:
This vibrant red wine hails from the Verduno village in the Languedoc-Roero hills of Piedmont, Italy. Castello di Verduno is a historic estate housed in a 16th-century castle, managed by the Burlotto and Blanco families. The winery's philosophy is rooted in traditionalism and "gentle" winemaking; they are famous for producing some of the most elegant, floral expressions of Piedmontese varieties. This Barbera is sourced from vineyards with white limestone and clay soils, which contribute to its signature brightness and mineral tension.

Wine Description

The Castello di Verduno Barbera d'Alba presents a deep ruby-purple colour with violet reflections. The nose is high-toned and exceptionally pure, offering a bouquet of ripe red cherries, blackberries, and damp earth, accented by sophisticated notes of dried rose petals and a hint of black pepper. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "electric," showcasing the varietal’s hallmark racy acidity and a crunchy red-fruit core. It is characterized by its lack of heavy oak having been fermented and aged in large neutral Slavonian oak botti and stainless steel allowing the fruit and terroir to remain center stage.

title: Chanzy Mercurey Les Bussieres 2022
bodyHtml:
This distinguished wine originates from the Mercurey AOC in the Cote Chalonnaise subregion of Burgundy, France. Domaine Chanzy, established in 1928 and based in Bouzeron, is one of the most significant landowners in the region and is recognized for its historical expertise in the Cote Chalonnaise. The Les Bussieres vineyard is situated on a northeast facing slope with deep limestone and clay soils, reflecting the winery's philosophy of producing site specific wines that balance ripeness with elegance.

Wine Description

The Chanzy Mercurey Les Bussieres presents a brilliant ruby colour with soft violet reflections. The sensory profile is complex and aromatic, leading with notes of wild strawberries, raspberries, and red cherries, layered with earthy undertones of forest floor and a touch of sweet spice. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and smooth, showcasing silky tannins and a vibrant acidity that provides a sense of freshness and lift. It is characterized by its balanced structure and a persistent finish that reveals subtle hints of tobacco and cocoa.

title: Chanzy Rully Les Cailloux 2018
bodyHtml: This elegant white wine originates from the Rully AOC in the Cote Chalonnaise subregion of Burgundy, France. Domaine Chanzy, established in 1928, is a significant landowner in the region and is recognized for its historical expertise across the Cote Chalonnaise. The Les Cailloux vineyard is aptly named for its stony, limestone rich soils, reflecting the winery's philosophy of producing site specific wines that highlight mineral precision and aromatic purity.

title: Giuliana Vicini Rosato 2024
bodyHtml:
This fresh and elegant rosé originates from the Colline Pescaresi subregion in Abruzzo, Central Italy. Produced by the Giuliana Vicini winery, this label is part of a portfolio that emphasizes the expressive potential of Abruzzo's micro-territories. The winery's philosophy focuses on traditional methods, such as hand-picking grapes and using temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks, to create wines that offer a modern, delicate alternative to the region's classic, more robust Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo.

Wine Description

The Giuliana Vicini Rosato presents a very delicate, light claret pink colour. The sensory profile is defined by a refined nose of fresh field flowers and red fruits, particularly strawberry and cherry, accented by subtle herbaceous nuances. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and smooth, showcasing a vibrant freshness and a well-balanced structure. It is characterized by its persistent fruitiness and an elegant, slightly almond-toned finish. This 100% Montepulciano d'Abruzzo typically has an alcohol content of 12.5%.

title: Lagarde Altas Cumbres Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
This expressive red wine originates from the Lujan de Cuyo and Uco Valley regions in Mendoza, Argentina. Bodega Lagarde, established in 1897 and acquired by the Pescarmona family in 1969, is one of the oldest and most traditional wineries in the region. The winemaking philosophy for the Altas Cumbres line focuses on preserving the primary fruit and the specific high altitude character of the vineyards to create a fresh, young, and approachable style.

Wine Description

The Lagarde Altas Cumbres Malbec presents a vibrant ruby red colour with distinct violet hues. The sensory profile is fruit forward and intense, featuring aromas of fresh red fruits such as plums and cherries, complemented by subtle floral notes of violet. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and well balanced, showcasing soft, rounded tannins and a pleasant freshness. It is characterized by its smooth texture and a persistent, fruity finish that mirrors the aromatic profile.

title: Lagarde Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
This classic red wine originates from the Lujan de Cuyo and Uco Valley regions in Mendoza, Argentina. Bodega Lagarde, established in 1897 and acquired by the Pescarmona family in 1969, is one of the oldest and most traditional wineries in the region. The winemaking philosophy for this line focuses on achieving a balance between varietal expression and elegance, utilizing high altitude vineyards to ensure freshness and complexity.

Wine Description

The Lagarde Cabernet Sauvignon presents an intense ruby red colour with deep garnet highlights. The sensory profile is complex and well defined, featuring aromas of blackcurrant, dark plum, and blackberry, layered with classic notes of green bell pepper and subtle spices. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and well structured, showcasing firm but ripe tannins and a vibrant acidity. It is characterized by its balanced mouthfeel and a persistent finish that reveals hints of graphite and cedar.

title: Lupinella Chianti Superiore 2023
bodyHtml:
This charming red wine originates from the Chianti DOCG in the Tuscany region of Italy. The La Lupinella estate was founded in 1977 by Vittoriano Bitossi, an heir to a family renowned for ceramic production since the 16th century. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a deep respect for the environment and the expression of native grape varieties, with a specific focus on the unique clay loam soils that serve as the foundation for both their vines and their historic ceramics.

Wine Description

The Lupinella Chianti presents a brilliant ruby hue in the glass. The sensory profile offers an elegant bouquet of ripe cherries, violets, and wild herbs, underscored by subtle notes of plum, earthy minerality, and a hint of spice. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and supple yet well structured, showcasing a fresh and linear character with sleek tannins and vibrant acidity. It is characterized by its balance of traditional and modern winemaking, resulting in a refreshing and 'terroir-transparent' take on the varietal.

title: Peyrassol Commandeur Provence Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This elegant white wine originates from the Cotes de Provence AOP in the Provence region of France. Founded in 1204 by the Order of the Templars and later held by the Order of Malta, Commanderie de Peyrassol is a historic estate currently owned by Philippe Austruy, who initiated a major modernization of the vineyards and facilities in 2001. The winery's philosophy emphasizes the preservation of aromatic freshness and the expression of the diverse clay and limestone soils of the estate through meticulous plot selection and sustainable viticulture.

Wine Description

The Peyrassol Commandeur Provence Blanc presents a brilliant golden straw colour with subtle green reflections. The sensory profile is refined and aromatic, featuring a bouquet of white flowers, honey, and fresh herbaceous notes, alongside fruity aromas of peach, pear, and citrus zest. On the palate, the wine is light to medium bodied and lively, showcasing a silky texture balanced by a racy, thirst quenching acidity. It is characterized by its aromatic complexity and a persistent, refreshing finish marked by citrus notes. This wine is a blend of 95% Vermentino (Rolle) and 5% Ugni Blanc, has an ABV of 13%, and is produced from certified organic grapes.

title: Zarate El Palomar Albariño 2024
bodyHtml:
This distinguished white wine originates from the Rias Baixas DO in the Galicia region of Spain. Bodegas Zarate, a historic family estate located in the Salnes Valley, has viticultural roots dating back to 1707. Under the direction of seventh generation winemaker Eulogio Pomares, the winery has become a reference point for the region, pioneering organic and biodynamic farming methods. The El Palomar vineyard is one of the oldest documented sites in Rias Baixas, featuring ungrafted vines planted in approximately 1850 on shallow granitic soils.

Wine Description

The Zarate El Palomar Albarino 2024 presents a bright yellow colour with greenish glints. The sensory profile is expressive and complex, featuring aromas of white flowers, jasmine, and citrus zest, complemented by notes of ripe stone fruit and a distinct flinty minerality. On the palate, the wine is powerful and well structured, showcasing a creamy, enveloping texture derived from aging on the lees. It is characterized by a precise, zippy acidity and a persistent, saline finish that reflects its Atlantic origin.

title: Peyrassol La Croix Red Blend 2023
bodyHtml:
This expressive red wine originates from the IGP Mediterranee within the Provence region of France. Commanderie de Peyrassol, established in 1204 by the Order of the Templars, is a historic 1,000 hectare estate located in the foothills of the Massif des Maures. Owned by Philippe Austruy since 2001, the winery's philosophy focuses on restoring the estate's centuries old reputation through meticulous plot selection and a commitment to sustainable viticulture.

Wine Description

The Peyrassol La Croix Red Blend presents a vibrant purple colour with violet tints. The sensory profile is fruit forward and intense, featuring aromas of liquorice, pepper, and peony that give way to a procession of small red and black fruits. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and supple, showcasing velvety tannins and a well melted acidity. It is characterized by intense flavours of ripe cherries, blackberries, and spices, leading to a round and fleshy finish. This blend typically consists of Syrah and Cabernet Sauvignon, has an ABV of 12.5%, and is produced from grapes under organic conversion.

title: Querciabella Chianti Classico Riserva 2021
bodyHtml:
This superior red wine originates from the Chianti Classico DOCG in the Tuscany region of Italy. Founded in 1974, the Querciabella estate is surrounded by the 'beautiful oaks' that give the winery its name and are intrinsic to the character of its business. The winemaking philosophy is rooted in a deep commitment to site selection and plant-based biodynamic viticulture, aiming to create a uniquely faceted expression of the Sangiovese grape by meldings nuances from diverse vineyard locations.

Wine Description

The Querciabella Chianti Classico Riserva 2021 presents a clear and sparkling ruby red colour. The sensory profile is delicate yet precise, featuring leading aromas of red roses, menthol, strawberry, and subtle black pepper, balanced by undertones of graphite and top soil. On the palate, the wine is powerful and cohesive, showcasing well-integrated, velvety tannins and a tangy, zesty acidity that creates a vivacious mouthfeel. It is characterized by its enormous density, depth, and sinewy structure, leading to a long lasting fruity finish with a bolt of citrus lightening.

title: Crown Royal Chocolate
bodyHtml:
Crown Royal Chocolate is a decadent limited-edition flavoured whisky originating from Canada. Crafted at the iconic distillery established in 1939 to commemorate the royal tour of King George VI and Queen Elizabeth, this expression represents the brand's modern commitment to innovation within the flavoured whisky category. The blend marries the legendary smoothness of signature Crown Royal whiskies—traditionally distilled from corn, rye, and malted barley—with rich, velvety chocolate notes.

Spirits Description

This 70-proof (35% ABV) spirit features a deep amber appearance with warm caramel hues. The aroma is highly indulgent, leading with creamy cocoa, vanilla bean, and soft caramel, balanced by a subtle whisper of toasted oak and warm whisky spice. On the palate, it is luxuriously smooth and full-bodied, unfolding layers of milk chocolate, toffee, and toasted marshmallow, with gentle hints of cinnamon. The finish is velvety and lingering, characterized by notes of dark cacao and a soft brown sugar sweetness that maintains the brand's hallmark smoothness. It is best enjoyed within its seasonal release window, either neat, over ice, or as a sophisticated base for dessert-style cocktails.

title: Soter Mineral Springs Ranch Pinot Noir 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Soter Mineral Springs Ranch Pinot Noir is the flagship estate wine from Soter Vineyards, originating from the United States in the Yamhill-Carlton subregion of Oregon's Willamette Valley. The wine is sourced exclusively from Mineral Springs Ranch, a 240-acre biodynamic farm and vineyard situated along a ridge-line with ancient marine sedimentary soils. Founded in 1997 by Tony and Michelle Soter, the winery operates with a philosophy of minimal intervention and environmental stewardship, having achieved Demeter biodynamic certification for the entire estate.

Wine Description

The 2021 vintage of this Pinot Noir is darkly coloured and concentrated, while the 2022 vintage is noted for its incredible tension and linearity. The aromatic profile is complex, typically opening with red cherry, wild strawberry, and cranberry, layered with rose petal, forest floor, and subtle notes of spice or cedar. On the palate, the wine is precise and structured, offering flavours of raspberry, marionberry, and black tea, often accompanied by a distinct mineral-driven core and a 'kiss' of sea salt. The body is elegant and medium-weighted, featuring fine-grained, grippy tannins and vibrant acidity that provides energy through a long, refined finish. This 100% Pinot Noir is typically aged for 12 months in French oak barrels (approximately 40% to 45% new) and has an alcohol content ranging from 13.6% to 13.8% ABV. The wine is produced from 100% biodynamically farmed estate fruit.

Food Pairing

This elegant and age-worthy Pinot Noir is a fine match for classic pairings such as roasted duck, venison, or herb-crusted lamb chops. Its earthy undertones also complement mushroom-based dishes like wild mushroom risotto or a savory mushroom butter. For local flair, it is frequently paired with Pacific Northwest salmon, particularly when grilled or served with green garlic potatoes.

title: Establishment Ocean View West Coast Pilsner 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Ocean View is a standout West Coast Pilsner from Calgary’s The Establishment Brewing Company. This relatively new sub-style is currently taking the craft world by storm, acting as a "bridge" between the crisp, clean structure of a German Pilsner and the bold, aromatic hopping of a West Coast IPA. Establishment, true to their reputation for technical excellence, has crafted a beer that offers the ultimate "best of both worlds": the refreshing "snap" of a lager with the punchy, resinous citrus of a modern IPA.

Beer Description

Ocean View pours a brilliant, crystal-clear straw-gold, strikingly different from the brewery's famous hazy IPAs, with a frothy, bright white head and tight, pinpoint carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is sharp, clean, and vibrant. It leads with a classic West Coast profile of grapefruit peel and sticky pine resin, followed by a delicate, floral scent of jasmine and lemongrass. Because it is a lager, the aroma remains incredibly "bright" and lacks any of the heavy, fruity yeast esters found in ales.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and remarkably "brisk." It leads with a dry, crackery malt base (think fresh saltine crackers). This is immediately met by a firm, assertive bitterness that delivers flavors of citrus pith and forest floor. The finish is exceptionally dry and "clean," leaving a lingering, spicy hop bite that encourages the next sip.

Profile: It sits at a very drinkable 5.0% ABV and features a significant bitterness (approx. 40–45 IBU) that provides more "cut" than a traditional pilsner.

Technical Notes: This beer is a showcase of high-quality Pilsner malt and a long, cold lagering process to achieve its "diamond" clarity. It is heavily hopped with Pacific Northwest varieties, specifically Citra and Simcoe, but applied with a "West Coast" sensibility (focusing on late-boil and dry-hop additions). The water profile is adjusted to be "crisp" and mineral-forward, enhancing the dry, snappy finish.

title: Establishment More Than Rain Czech Dark Lager 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
More Than Rain is an exceptional Tmavé Speciální Pivo (Czech Dark Lager) from Calgary’s The Establishment Brewing Company, originally brewed in collaboration with the local Rain Dog Bar. While many dark lagers lean toward the dry, roasted profile of a German Schwarzbier, More Than Rain is a deeper dive into the Czech tradition. It is designed to be richer, softer, and more malt-forward, offering a decadent complexity that remains remarkably "quaffable" thanks to traditional European lagering techniques.

Beer Description

This lager pours a beautiful, deep mahogany-to-ebony color with glowing garnet edges. It is topped with a dense, creamy, tan-colored head that leaves thick lacing on the glass.

Aroma: The nose is rich and inviting, dominated by toasted bread crust, dark chocolate, and roasted nuts. You’ll also find a distinct layer of dark fruit, think raisins or dried figs and a spicy, floral herbal scent from the traditional Czech hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a soft, "round" mouthfeel that is notably fuller than a standard pilsner. It leads with a complex malt sweetness of caramel and cocoa, followed by a smooth, bready richness. The finish is clean and balanced; while there is a hint of roasted bitterness, it is never harsh or "burnt," ending with a lingering spicy hop note.

Profile: It sits at an ABV of 5.6% (a 14° Plato "Speciální" strength), making it slightly more robust than a standard session lager but still incredibly smooth.

Technical Notes: Establishment went to great lengths for authenticity with this brew. They utilized semi-early red-bine Saaz hops sourced directly from Bohemia and water treated with reverse osmosis to mimic the soft water of the Czech Republic. The grain bill features a "cocktail" of continental malts, including Pilsner, Caramunich II, and Carafa Special II, and it is fermented with a traditional Isar lager yeast from Escarpment Labs.

title: Establishment Brewing Pilsgnar German Pilsner 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Pilsgnar is a technical masterpiece from Calgary’s The Establishment Brewing Company. While they are famous for their "juice-bomb" IPAs, Pilsgnar is where they flex their traditional brewing muscles. This is a quintessential German-style Pilsner a beer that is famously difficult to brew because there is nowhere for flaws to hide. It is designed for "crushability" and crispness, serving as a bright, bitter, and bracingly clean alternative to the heavy, hazy ales that dominate the modern craft scene.

Beer Description

Pilsgnar pours a brilliant, crystal-clear pale straw-gold with a massive, rocky white head that boasts exceptional retention and "Belgian-style" lacing.

Aroma: The nose is sharp, clean, and elegant. It leads with the scent of freshly baked crackers and honeyed malt, followed by a punchy, floral, and spicy bouquet from the traditional German Noble hops. You may also detect a faint, pleasant hint of lemon zest and dried hay.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a very "brisk" and effervescent mouthfeel. It leads with a delicate, grainy sweetness that is almost immediately overtaken by a firm, drying bitterness. The finish is famously "snappy" and clean, the hallmark of a true German Pils, leaving a lingering herbal and spicy hop note that demands another sip.

Profile: It sits at a highly sessionable 5.2% ABV and features a significant bitterness (approx. 35–40 IBU) that provides the structural "bite" expected of the style.

Technical Notes: This beer is a showcase of traditional European ingredients and methods. It is brewed with 100% German Pilsner malt and hopped exclusively with Hallertau Mittelfrüh and Tettnanger Noble hops. Establishment uses a specialized water treatment to mimic the soft, mineral-rich waters of Germany and subjects the beer to an extended, cold lagering period to achieve its "diamond" clarity and refined finish.

title: Establishment Sky Rocket Hazy IPA 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Sky Rocket is the quintessential New England IPA (NEIPA) from Calgary’s The Establishment Brewing Company. As one of the most decorated breweries in Canada (named Canadian Brewery of the Year in 2021), Establishment has perfected the art of the "haze." Sky Rocket is a core staple of their lineup, designed to showcase the "holy trinity" of modern hops in a package that is as plush and velvety as a cloud. It is a masterclass in balance, proving that a beer can be intensely hoppy without being even slightly abrasive.

Beer Description

Sky Rocket pours a dense, opaque, and glowing pale straw-yellow with a thick, meringue-like white head that sticks to the glass like sea foam.

Aroma: The nose is an aromatic "powerhouse." Expect immediate, high-definition notes of sweet tangerine, juicy peach, and passionfruit. Underneath the fruit is a refined, dank herbal quality reminiscent of fresh-crushed hop pellets and a faint, creamy vanilla undertone.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-to-full bodied with a remarkably soft, silken mouthfeel. It leads with a "juice-forward" sweetness of mango and citrus pulp. True to the NEIPA style, the bitterness is incredibly low and rounded (the "pillowy" finish), ensuring the tropical flavors remain the star from the first sip to the last.

Profile: It has a sturdy ABV of 6.5% and very low perceived bitterness, making it exceptionally smooth for its strength.

Technical Notes: This beer is built on a "cloud-like" grist of malted barley, oats, and wheat, which provides the protein-rich structure for its permanent haze and creamy texture. It is heavily dry-hopped with the iconic trio of Citra, Mosaic, and Simcoe, using modern hopping techniques to extract maximum essential oils while leaving behind the harsh vegetable bitterness.

title: Establishment Jam Rock Blackberry Sour 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Jam Rock is a legendary seasonal release (and frequent fan-favorite) from Calgary’s Eighty-Eight Brewing Co. While many sours can be sharp or aggressive, Jam Rock is designed to be a "smoothie-style" Blackberry Sour that leans heavily into nostalgic flavors, specifically reminiscent of blackberry jam or a fresh berry crumble. It’s part of the brewery's "playlist" of bold, colorful beers that prioritize high-impact fruit additions and a playful, approachable acidity.

Beer Description

Jam Rock pours a stunning, vibrant deep purple-to-magenta with a fizzy, pink-tinted head that settles quickly, characteristic of high-fruit-content sours.

Aroma: The nose is an absolute explosion of fresh blackberries. It smells remarkably like a jar of high-end jam or a berry-filled pastry. You’ll find secondary notes of lemon zest and a subtle, creamy sweetness that suggests vanilla or marshmallow.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a "jammy," slightly viscous texture. It leads with a massive burst of sweet-and-tart blackberry juice. The acidity is present but "soft" it’s a mouth-watering tartness rather than a sharp, puckering sourness. The finish is clean and fruity, with a lingering berry-skin dryness that keeps it from being cloying.

Profile: It typically sits around 5.2% ABV with near-zero bitterness, as the focus is entirely on the interplay between the fruit and the lactic acidity.

Technical Notes: This is a Kettle Sour, meaning the wort is soured with Lactobacillus in the brewhouse before being boiled and fermented. Eighty-Eight adds a massive amount of blackberry purée during fermentation to ensure the color and flavor remain as "true-to-fruit" as possible. Some iterations also include a touch of lactose (milk sugar) to provide that signature "Jam Rock" creamy mouthfeel and to balance the natural tartness of the berries.

title: Establishment My Best Friend's Girl Kolsch 473 ml - 4 Cans
bodyHtml:
My Best Friend’s Girl is the multi-award-winning Kölsch-style Ale from Calgary’s The Establishment Brewing Company. It is arguably one of the most decorated beers in Canada, having won Gold at the World Beer Cup (the "Olympics of Beer"). Named after the classic song by The Cars, this beer is the ultimate "bridge" style: it is fermented with ale yeast but finished with a long, cold lagering period. The result is a beer that possesses the delicate fruitiness of an ale and the crisp, clean snap of a lager.

Beer Description

This Kölsch-style ale pours a brilliant, crystal-clear pale straw-gold with a dense, sparkling white head and exceptionally fine carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is elegant, subtle, and incredibly clean. It leads with a delicate scent of honeyed pilsner malt and fresh-baked white bread, followed by a faint, characteristic fruitiness, think ripe pear or green apple. There is a soft, floral hop presence from traditional German Noble hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a soft, "pillowy" mouthfeel that quickly transitions into a brisk, effervescent finish. It leads with a mild, grainy sweetness that is perfectly balanced by a restrained, herbal bitterness. The finish is remarkably dry and clean, leaving virtually no aftertaste.

Profile: It sits at a highly sessionable 4.8% ABV and a low-to-moderate bitterness of approx. 20–25 IBU, prioritizing balance and refreshment.

Technical Notes: Establishment treats this beer with immense technical respect, adhering to the traditional brewing methods of Cologne, Germany. It is brewed with 100% German Pilsner malt and hopped with Hallertau Mittelfrüh. The "secret" is the specific Kölsch yeast strain, which produces those signature faint fruit esters, and a meticulous cold-conditioning (lagering) process that ensures its "diamond" clarity and smooth profile.

title: Cabin Brewing Luminosity German Pils 473 ml - 4 Cans
bodyHtml:
Luminosity is the core German-style Pilsner from Calgary’s Cabin Brewing Company. While Cabin is often celebrated for their creative "themed" beers and heavy IPAs (like Super Saturation), Luminosity is their tribute to precision. It is a "Northern German" style Pilsner, meaning it leans into a slightly more aggressive bitterness and a drier, more bracing finish than its Southern counterparts. It’s designed to be a "shining light" of clarity and crispness a technical, no-frills lager that showcases the beauty of simple ingredients.

Beer Description

Luminosity pours a brilliant, sparkling pale gold with a tall, frothy white head that exhibits excellent persistence and beautiful lacing.

Aroma: The nose is clean, bright, and floral. It leads with the scent of freshly baled hay, dried herbs, and lemon zest, supported by a foundation of sweet, bready pilsner malt. There is a distinct "noble" spicy quality that is characteristic of traditional German hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a sharp, effervescent carbonation. It leads with a fleeting, grainy malt sweetness reminiscent of unsalted crackers before a firm, assertive bitterness sweeps across the palate. The finish is remarkably dry and clean, leaving a lingering, spicy hop "snap" that is both refreshing and bold.

Profile: It sits at a sessionable 5.2% ABV and features a significant bitterness (approx. 35–40 IBU), providing the structural "bite" that defines the style.

Technical Notes: To achieve its authentic profile, Cabin uses 100% German Pilsner malt and a blend of traditional Noble hops (typically Hallertau Mittelfrüh and Saphir). The beer is subjected to an extended cold-lagering period to ensure maximum clarity and a "tight" flavor profile where all the ingredients are perfectly integrated.

title: Cabin Brewing Retrospectrum Pale Ale 473 ml - 4 Cans
bodyHtml:
Retrospectrum is the core American Pale Ale (APA) from Calgary’s Cabin Brewing Company. While their Super Saturation is the "hazy, pillowy" fan favorite, Retrospectrum is the brewery's tribute to the classic, balanced West Coast-style pale ales that launched the craft revolution. It is designed to be a "daily driver" complex enough to keep a beer geek interested, but balanced and clean enough to be incredibly approachable for anyone.

Beer Description

Retrospectrum pours a clear, brilliant copper-gold with a lively, frothy white head and consistent carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is a vibrant mix of "old school" and "new school" hop notes. Expect a bright burst of pineapple, orange zest, and grapefruit, backed by a distinct floral and slightly earthy undertone. Unlike the "juice" aroma of a NEIPA, this has a crisper, more structured scent.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a smooth, solid malt backbone. It leads with flavors of biscuit, honeyed toast, and soft caramel (thanks to the specialty Alberta malts). This sweetness is quickly cut by a firm, resinous bitterness and juicy flavors of citrus and tropical fruit. The finish is clean, dry, and slightly "sticky" with hop resins.

Profile: It sits at a sessionable 5.2% ABV and a firm 40 IBU, providing a classic "snap" that defines the American Pale Ale style.

Technical Notes: This beer is a showcase for Alberta’s world-class grain, utilizing Red Shed Rocky Mountain and Biscuit malts from Penhold, AB. It is hopped with a "greatest hits" blend of Citra, Amarillo, and Centennial, with Pahto used for a clean, consistent bittering base. It is fermented with a neutral American Ale yeast to ensure the focus stays entirely on the interplay between the malt and the hops.

title: Bellwoods Goosehead Pilsner 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Goosehead is a specialized "Canadian Pilsner" from Toronto’s Bellwoods Brewery, created as part of the Canadian Pilsner Project initiated by True History Brewing. While their flagship Bellweiser is a tribute to Old World traditions, Goosehead is an intentionally patriotic brew. The goal was to create a world-class pilsner using 100% Canadian ingredients from the grain to the hops to the yeast and celebrating the quality of homegrown agriculture with the technical precision Bellwoods is known for.

Beer Description

Goosehead pours a brilliant, pale straw-blonde with a fluffy, persistent white head and a bright, clear appearance.

Aroma: The nose is fresh and evocative. It leads with a distinct scent of bright honey and sweet grain, followed by an earthy, mineral quality often described as petrichor (the smell of rain on dry earth). There is a clean, herbal hop presence that stays subtle and refined.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and incredibly crisp. It leads with a delicate, biscuity malt sweetness that quickly gives way to a firm, assertive bitterness. The finish is dry and snappy, with light notes of lemon peel and a peppery hop spice that lingers briefly before cleaning the palate.

Profile: It sits at a highly sessionable 4.8% ABV and features a sturdy bitterness that provides more structure than a typical domestic lager.

Technical Notes: This beer is a showcase of Canadian terroir. It features barley malt from Alberta, Isar lager yeast from Escarpment Labs in Ontario, and Saaz hops grown at Myrtle Meadows in British Columbia. By using Canadian-grown Saaz, Bellwoods captures the spicy, noble character of the classic European hop but with a unique regional twist.

title: Bellwoods Kolsch 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Bellwoods Kölsch (simply titled Kölsch) is a refined, modern take on the traditional German style, released in 2024 to celebrate the 10th anniversary of Escarpment Labs (a renowned yeast laboratory in Ontario). While Bellwoods is often synonymous with hazy IPAs and wild sours, this beer showcases their ability to master delicate, yeast-driven styles. It is designed to be the "ideal sunny-day sipper" a crisp, elegant hybrid that strikes a perfect balance between the fruitiness of an ale and the clean finish of a lager.

Beer Description

This Kölsch pours a brilliant, translucent pale gold with a soft, frothy white head and lively carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is subtle, pretty, and highly aromatic. It leads with a distinct white wine-like minerality, followed by delicate notes of chamomile, fresh rain, and wildflower honey. It lacks the heavy "hoppy" punch of a Pale Ale, focusing instead on the sophisticated esters produced by the yeast.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and remarkably refreshing. It leads with a soft, crackery malt sweetness that quickly gives way to a complex profile of crisp pear, green apple, and a touch of herbal tea. The mouthfeel is famously "clean," with a dry, mineral-driven finish that is both quenching and sophisticated.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 4.5% and a very low, rounded bitterness that stays in the background, allowing the yeast and malt to shine.

Technical Notes: The heart of this beer is the Pink Boots Kölsch yeast strain (a Kölsch-specific strain with deep German roots provided by Escarpment Labs). This yeast is responsible for the signature "winey" minerality and fruit esters. It is brewed with high-quality pilsner malt and lightly hopped with traditional varieties to maintain its Old World character while delivering a "modern" level of technical polish.

title: Bellwoods Jelly King 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Jelly King is the crown jewel of Toronto’s Bellwoods Brewery and arguably one of the most famous sour ales in Canada. It was born from a simple but ambitious goal: to create a beer that is equally sour and hoppy without the long wait of oak aging. It is a "mixed-fermentation" dry-hopped sour that delivers immediate gratification. While it serves as the base for a dizzying array of fruited variants (ranging from Raspberry to Five Citrus), the "original" Jelly King remains a benchmark for the style, loved for its bright acidity and tropical hop punch.

Beer Description

Jelly King pours a hazy, glowing sunshine-yellow with a frothy white head that dissipates at a moderate pace, leaving a light ring of lace.

Aroma: The nose is an absolute explosion of tropical fruit. It leads with dominant notes of fuzzy peach, pink grapefruit, and tangerine, followed by a subtle, "funky" lactic tang. Because it is heavily dry-hopped, it smells much more like a fresh NEIPA than a traditional European sour.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a sparkling, prickly carbonation that dances on the palate. It leads with a sharp, refreshing acidity that is balanced by a lush, juicy fruitiness. You will find flavors of pineapple, passionfruit, and lemon zest. The finish is remarkably clean and dry, with a very low, rounded bitterness that allows the tartness to remain the star.

Profile: It has a sturdy yet approachable ABV of 5.6% and very low bitterness, as the "hoppiness" comes almost entirely from late-stage dry hopping for aroma rather than boiling for bitterness.

Technical Notes: This beer is a "mixed-fermentation" marvel. It is soured with a proprietary 5-strain house blend of Lactobacillus, which provides a complex, multi-dimensional acidity. It is then heavily dry-hopped, typically with Citra, to layer those tropical aromatics over the tart base. The addition of oats and wheat to the grain bill gives it a soft, "pillowy" mouthfeel that prevents the acidity from feeling too thin or abrasive.

title: J. Denuziere Cornas 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This powerful red wine hails from Cornas, the southernmost red-wine appellation of the Northern Rhône, famous for its "burnt earth" (Cornas in old Celtic) and sun-drenched granite terraces. Maison J. Denuzière has a storied heritage dating back to 1876, when Joanny Paret began distributing local wines via horse-drawn cart. Today, under the direction of oenologist Caroline Moro, the estate has transitioned from a historic négoce firm into a high-end domaine focusing on "micro-cuvées" that emphasize freshness and varietal precision. Their Cornas is primarily sourced from the "En Sauman" lieu-dit, a 1.2-hectare plot of steep, weathered granite terraces that produce some of the most concentrated and characterful Syrah in the valley.

Wine Description

J. Denuzière Cornas presents a deep, inky ruby color with violet reflections. The nose is classic and intense, offering a complex bouquet of blackberry, scorched earth, and crushed granite, layered with savory notes of leather, black pepper, and dried herbs. On the palate, the wine is muscular and robust, showcasing a dense core of dark plum and cassis fruit balanced by a striking mineral tension. It is characterized by its firm, "upright" tannins and a persistent finish marked by woodsmoke and salted licorice. This 100% Syrah typically has an ABV of 13.5% to 14% and was aged for approximately 15 to 18 months in French oak barrels (225L and 600L demi-muids) to soften its rugged structure while preserving its volcanic soul.

title: Castello di Montepo Sassoalloro 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from the rugged and beautiful Maremma region of southern Tuscany, specifically from the vineyards surrounding the historic Castello di Montepò near Scansano. Produced by the renowned Jacopo Biondi Santi, a direct descendant of the family that invented Brunello di Montalcino, Sassoalloro represents a modern evolution of Tuscan tradition. The wine is named after a massive volcanic erratic boulder located on the estate, known locally as the "Sasso Alloro" or "Witches' Stone," which has been the subject of local legends for centuries. The winemaking philosophy centers on the unique BBS11 clone (Brunello Biondi Santi 11) of Sangiovese Grosso, a proprietary heritage vine of the family. Unlike the long-aged traditional Brunellos, Sassoalloro is designed to be fresher and more dynamic, bridging the gap between historical pedigree and contemporary elegance.

Wine Description

Castello di Montepò Sassoalloro displays a brilliant, intense ruby red colour that often leans towards violet hues, especially in its youth. The nose is fresh, fragrant, and extremely persistent, led by distinct floral aromas of sweet violets and a generous fruit profile of Marasca cherries, raspberries, and wild berries, often underpinned by subtle earthy nuances and a whisper of forest floor. On the palate, the wine is celebrated for its soft and velvety texture; it is round and elegant, balancing the grape's natural vibrant acidity with silky, well-integrated tannins. It offers a "ready" yet sophisticated drinking experience with a long, harmonious finish. This 100% Sangiovese Grosso (BBS11) typically has an ABV of 13.5% and undergoes fermentation in stainless steel before being aged for approximately 14 months in un-toasted French oak barriques from the Tronçais forests, a specific choice made to enhance structure without overpowering the fruit with heavy toasted wood flavors. The optimal drinking window is from release up to 10–15 years.

title: Grey Goose Vodka Aluminum - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: Using only the finest ingredients, Grey Goose is renowned for its smooth and silky character. Expect subtle aromas of sweet citrus and white flowers; the palate is soft with a gentle and subtle sweetness that envelops your mouth; warm and spicy on the finish. Perfect in a classic martini.

title: Cirelli Vino Bianco Orange
bodyHtml:
Founded by Francesco Cirelli and his wife Michela in 2003, Agricola Cirelli is a 22-23-hectare farm dedicated to organic practices, certified by IMC. Their winemaking philosophy is centred on the pursuit of quality and respecting nature's rhythms, with minimal intervention in the vineyard and the cellar. The vineyards, situated amongst rolling hills, benefit from a maritime influence from the Adriatic Sea, which is only about 8 km away.

Wine Description

The color is a bright orange with golden reflections. The wine offers an intense and multi-layered sensory profile, with aromas of dried apricot, orange peel, elderflower, orange blossom, wild herbs, and white pepper. On the palate, it presents a balanced combination of fruit and bitterness with notes of citrus, ripe peach, ginger hints, and a mineral edge.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings also include fried trout with lemon, risotto Milanese, or a millet salad with cranberries and almonds.

title: Gut Oggau Timotheus (Weiss) 2023
bodyHtml:
Gut Oggau Timotheus 2023 is a captivating natural white wine from Burgenland, Austria. Founded in 2007 by Stephanie and Eduard Tscheppe-Eselböck, the estate operates as a living organism under strict Demeter-certified biodynamic principles. Timotheus is part of the 'parent' generation in the winery's fictional family tree, representing a character of quiet confidence and substance, crafted from 40-year-old vines rooted in limestone and slate soils.

Wine Description

This textured, amber-hued blend consists of Grüner Veltliner and Weissburgunder. The aromatic profile is complex and deep, offering notes of wild flowers, citrus oil, tropical fruit, and a distinct hint of spicy white pepper. On the palate, the wine is dry and medium-bodied with a powerful stature, featuring flavors of apple, honey, and grapefruit. Its structure is defined by a pleasant mineral acidity and a velvety texture, the result of one-third of the grapes fermenting on their skins for three weeks. This wine is bottled unfined and unfiltered with no added sulphur, ensuring a pure expression of its origin.

title: Giffard Falernum Syrup (Non Alcoholic) - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Giffard Falernum Syrup is a non-alcoholic product produced in Angers, France. It is crafted by a fifth-generation family business established in 1885, which utilizes traditional maceration techniques and 100% pure French sugar beet to recreate a Caribbean classic.

Spirit Description

This syrup presents a pale beige or translucent straw appearance. The aroma is highly fragrant and zesty, featuring an intense bouquet of lime and citrus notes. On the palate, it offers a complex and well-rounded flavor profile where the sharpness of lime and ginger is balanced by the warmth of cloves and a delicate, sweet almond finish. The body is syrupy and smooth, providing a rich mouthfeel that lingers with a spiced, tropical character. This product contains 0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The exotic and spicy profile of this syrup makes it a versatile ingredient for both sweet and savory applications. It can be used as a tropical glaze for roasted poultry or drizzled over coconut-based desserts and ice creams. It pairs exceptionally well with snacks like spiced nuts or tropical fruit platters featuring mango and pineapple. For a more unique culinary use, it can be incorporated into dressings for citrus-based salads or used to macerate berries for a sophisticated tart filling.

Distinctive Features

Giffard Falernum Syrup is distinguished by its commitment to an authentic recipe, blending natural extracts of lime, clove, and almond. It is crafted without the use of artificial preservatives and maintains the high aromatic intensity that the Giffard family is known for. The syrup is vegan-friendly and made with pure sugar beet, ensuring a clean and consistent sweetness that replicates the traditional "Velvet Falernum" mouthfeel without the alcohol.

Serving Suggestions

This syrup is a cornerstone of Tiki culture and a key ingredient for non-alcoholic tropical cocktails such as a 'Virgin Mai Tai' or a 'Non-Alcoholic Zombie'. It can also be enjoyed simply by adding a splash to ginger ale or sparkling water with a squeeze of fresh lime for a refreshing "Falernum Pressé." Beyond cold drinks, it serves as an exotic sweetener for lattes or hot spiced teas, adding a layer of Caribbean warmth to everyday beverages.

title: Cortese Langhe Nebbiolo 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in the heart of Piedmont, Italy, this elegant red wine comes from the Langhe DOC, a region world-renowned for its prestigious terroir and steep, hillside vineyards. Giuseppe Cortese is a legendary name in the village of Barbaresco, where the family has been crafting wine since 1971. The estate's philosophy centers on a deep respect for tradition and the unique microclimate of the Rabajà area. While their Barbaresco wines are built for long aging, this Langhe Nebbiolo is designed as a more accessible, "declassified" expression of the estate’s younger vines, offering the noble character of the Nebbiolo grape with a more immediate, approachable charm.

Wine Description

Cortese Langhe Nebbiolo displays a bright, translucent ruby red color with classic garnet reflections. The nose is highly aromatic and sophisticated, offering a fragrant bouquet of wild raspberries, dried roses, and red cherries, layered with subtle notes of leather, white pepper, and a hint of forest floor. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and well-structured, featuring the variety's signature "crunchy" acidity and firm, fine-grained tannins. It is characterized by its elegant tension and savory undertones of anise, tobacco, and a distinct mineral finish. This 100% Nebbiolo has an ABV of 13.5% to 14% and was fermented in stainless steel before undergoing a brief period of aging in neutral Slavonian oak casks to soften the tannins while preserving fruit purity.

title: Collective Arts Local Press Apple Cider 473ml – 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This crisp craft cider originates from Canada, specifically Hamilton, Ontario. Collective Arts Brewing was founded in 2013 by Matt Johnston and Bob Russell with a mission to fuse the creativity of craft beverages with the talents of global emerging artists. The company's philosophy centers on the belief that 'creativity fosters creativity,' using their cans as a 'global art gallery' to feature limited-edition works by international artists.

The 'Local Press' is the flagship cider of the brand, made from a blend of 100 per cent Ontario-grown apples, specifically Northern Spy, Ida Red, and Spartan. It presents a cloudy golden yellow colour and features large carbonation bubbles. The nose is very crisp with sweet apple aromas and subtle hints of pear. On the palate, the cider offers a medium bite with pleasant tartness, earthy notes, and a strong flavour of apple peel. Stylistically, it is described as super refreshing, clean, and balanced, leaning toward a semi-sweet and semi-tart profile. The finish is reminiscent of fresh apple juice. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 5.6 per cent, and the cider contains approximately 12 grams of sugar per litre. It is naturally gluten-free and is crafted without the deep tannins often found in more traditional English styles.

title: Patron Gran Smoky Tequila
bodyHtml: A sophisticated silver tequila with a perfectly balanced, very complex smoky flavor. Gran Patrón Smoky begins with the highest quality Weber Blue Agave. The piñas are roasted with mesquite for about seven days in small underground stone pits at Hacienda Patrón in Jalisco, Mexico. They’re then crushed with a tahona wheel, fermented, and distilled.

title: El Mayor Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
El Mayor Añejo is a premium spirit produced in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico, specifically just outside the city of Arandas. The brand is a result of a decades-old partnership between the Lux and Gonzalez families, with production led by Master Distiller Rodolfo Gonzalez, a third-generation tequilero whose children represent the fourth generation of the family legacy. The distillery’s philosophy centres on estate-grown excellence, utilizing 100% blue Weber agave cultivated at approximately 7,500 feet above sea level in mineral-rich, sandy soil.

Designed for slow, contemplative sipping, this 100% agave tequila displays a deep golden to amber hue following an extensive maturation period of 18 to 36 months in American white oak barrels. The nose is characterized by a complex bouquet of caramel, sweet fruit, and light oak, with deeper notes of butterscotch, vanilla, and 'brown spices' such as cinnamon and ginger. On the palate, it offers a smooth, medium-to-full-bodied entry that reveals layers of grilled tropical fruits, rich toffee, and a signature herbal quality. The finish is clean and velvety, lingering with a balance of lightly sweet agave fruit and suppressed heat, showcasing a sophisticated complexity that retains its essential 'agave-ness'.

title: Fernie Brewing Hit The Deck Hazy IPA - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Brewed in the heart of the Canadian Rockies in British Columbia, Fernie Brewing Co. is a family-owned craft brewery that began in a small barn in 2003. The brewery is dedicated to using high-quality malted barley, European hops, and fresh mountain spring water, with a philosophy centered on small-batch production and no preservatives. As a staple of BC's 'mountain culture', this brewery is managed by local 'powder-chasing' enthusiasts who emphasize quality and community in every brew.

This New England-style Hazy IPA pours a cloudy, golden-yellow with a thick, frothy white head. It features an intense sensory profile dominated by juicy, citrusy aromas of orange and tropical fruit, balanced by a light, refreshing body. On the palate, it is low in bitterness but high in hop flavour, offering a smooth and 'pillowy' mouthfeel thanks to the addition of flaked oats.

title: Castello di Ama Haiku 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Produced in the heart of Italy's Tuscany region, specifically within the Gaiole in Chianti area of Chianti Classico, Castello di Ama Haiku 2021 is a masterfully crafted Super Tuscan. The estate, founded in the 1970s and currently managed by Lorenza Sebasti and winemaker Marco Pallanti, is renowned for its commitment to site-specific winemaking and the early adoption of the 'cru' concept in the region.

Wine Description

This bottle reveals an intense reddish purple hue with ruby nuances. The aromatic profile is deep and refined, featuring a 'constellation' of cassis, dark berries, and fruits of the forest, layered with notes of cigar wrapper, wild herbs, and a hint of espresso. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and nascently complex, showcasing a vibrant core of pomegranate and black cherry fruit framed by clean mineral notes and polished, yet firm, tannins.

Accolades

  • Vinous - 95 points

  • James Suckling - 95 points

  • Wine Advocate - 94+ points

Food Pairing

The wine's balanced acidity and structured tannins make it an excellent companion for hearty dishes such as braised short rib ragu, roasted lamb with rosemary, or beef wellington. It also pairs beautifully with earthy mushroom-based pastas or aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

title: Bollinger Tribute To Moonraker 2007 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Produced in the heart of the Champagne region in France, this limited edition magnum celebrates the 40 year partnership between Champagne Bollinger and James Bond, which began with the 1979 film 'Moonraker'. Established in 1829, Bollinger is a family owned house renowned for its complex, Pinot Noir dominant style and commitment to traditional craftsmanship, including maintaining an on-site cooperage for barrel fermentation. The 'Tribute to Moonraker' is a highly exclusive release, with only 407 hand-finished pieces created, featuring a Saint Louis crystal ice bucket encased in a pewter and wood veneer shuttle designed by Eric Berthes.

Wine Description

This 2007 vintage Champagne presents a striking golden yellow hue with fine, persistent bubbles. The nose is complex and elegant, revealing an enticing bouquet of ripe apples, toasted hazelnuts, and brioche, alongside subtle hints of honey and citrus zest. On the palate, the wine is powerful and full-bodied, blending freshness with a smooth, chalky texture and flavours of golden apple, pear, almond, and a touch of spice. Composed of 70% Pinot Noir and 30% Chardonnay primarily from Grand Cru vineyards, it offers a long, elegant finish with a lingering impression of minerality and vanilla. This magnum has an optimal drinking window between 2025 and 2035.

Accolades

  • Wine Advocate - 94+ points

title: Fernie Big Steep Stout - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Big Steep Stout is a classic core offering from Fernie Brewing Co., located in the heart of the Rocky Mountains in Fernie, British Columbia. This beer is inspired by the legendary "Big Steep" ski runs of the local mountains, bold, intense, and rewarding. It is a traditional American style stout that prioritizes deep, roasted flavors and a sturdy body, making it the perfect companion for a cold winter night or a post ski gathering by the fire.

Beer Description

This stout pours a deep, opaque ink-black with a thick, creamy tan head and heavy lacing.

Aroma: It features a rich and inviting nose dominated by dark roasted coffee beans and bittersweet chocolate. Subtle hints of dried dark fruits and a faint smokiness add to its complexity.

Palate: The flavor profile is full-bodied and velvety. It delivers robust notes of espresso and dark cocoa, supported by a rich, bready malt sweetness. It finishes with a firm roasted bitterness and a slight earthy hop character that prevents the sweetness from lingering too long.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% and a moderate bitterness of 30 IBU, offering a satisfying "big" flavor profile without the high alcohol content of an Imperial stout.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a complex grain bill featuring chocolate malt, black malt, and roasted barley. This combination provides both the dark color and the layered toasted flavors, while the use of flaked oats contributes to its signature smooth and silky mouthfeel.

title: Hey Y'all Porch Pack Classics 341 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Hey Y'all Porch Pack Classics is produced in Canada, within the region of British Columbia and the subregion of Vancouver. Founded in 2014 by Canadian entrepreneurs, the brand was inspired by the lightly sweetened iced teas common in the Southern United States. While it captures a Southern aesthetic, the company is 100% Canadian owned and operated.

Spirit Description

This mixed pack contains a variety of non-carbonated, Southern-style hard iced teas brewed with genuine black tea leaf extracts. The 'Porch Pack' typically features three or four distinct flavours: Original Hard Iced Tea, Georgia Peach, and Hard Iced Tea & Lemonade, with Raspberry or Green Tea occasionally included depending on the edition. The sensory profile offers a balanced mix of classic brewed tea notes, juicy fruit sweetness, and tangy citrus. On the nose, it presents aromas of fresh tea, peach, and sweet malt, leading to a smooth, clean finish that is lightly sweet and refreshing.

title: Kavalan Peatist Ex-Bourbon Cask Single Malt Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Kavalan Peatist Ex-Bourbon Cask is a standout expression from the distillery's Peatist series, which explores the interplay between peated malt and Taiwan's intense subtropical climate. Unlike many peated whiskies that use unpeated spirit finished in peated casks, this is distilled from premium peated barley and fully matured in select American ex-bourbon barrels. The name Peatist reflects Kavalan's philosophy of using peat as a purposeful element to add depth and complexity rather than letting it dominate the distillery's signature tropical character.

Spirit Description

On the nose, a gentle wisp of peat smoke opens into vibrant layers of mango, banana, and longan fruit, followed by the sweet fragrance of coconut cream, vanilla, and honey. The palate is smooth and elegantly mature, featuring flavors of velvety vanilla butter cake and tropical fruits balanced by warm oak. A silky vanilla custard note lingers on the tongue, enhancing the subtle smokiness of the peat. The finish is long and pleasant, leaving a lasting impression of refined wood spice and orchard sweetness.

Food Pairing

The combination of light smoke and rich tropical sweetness makes this whisky an exceptional partner for both savory and dessert courses. It pairs beautifully with coconut-flavored desserts or banana caramel tarts, which echo its natural fruit profile. For a savory option, try it alongside honey-glazed nuts or mild hard cheeses like Gouda to balance the oak spice. Its maritime-adjacent smoke also makes it a surprising match for smoked salmon or grilled scallops in a cream sauce, where the high proof cuts through the richness and highlights the iodine depth of the seafood.

title: Establishment My Best Friend's Girl Kolsch - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
My Best Friend’s Girl is the award-winning flagship Kölsch style ale from Calgary’s The Establishment Brewing Company. A consistent favorite in the Alberta craft scene, it has earned multiple accolades, including gold medals at the Canadian Brewing Awards. This beer is a love letter to the traditional ales of Cologne, Germany, designed to be the ultimate "crispy boy", a beer that is refined, unpretentious, and technically flawless.

Beer Description

This Kölsch-style ale pours a brilliant, crystal-clear pale gold with a delicate, frothy white head and fine, persistent carbonation.

Aroma: It features a subtle and elegant nose. Expect light notes of honey and crackery malt, perfectly balanced by the classic floral and herbal aromatics of noble hops. A faint fruity ester, characteristic of the style, adds a hint of pear or white grape.

Palate: The flavor is clean and light-bodied. It leads with a delicate bready sweetness that quickly transitions into a crisp, snappy finish. The bitterness is present but restrained, serving only to refresh the palate for the next sip.

Profile: It has an ABV of 4.8% and a low bitterness (IBU), making it one of the most sessionable and versatile beers in their lineup.

Technical Notes: True to the Kölsch tradition, it is fermented with a specific ale yeast at cooler temperatures and then cold-conditioned (lagered) to achieve its signature clarity and clean profile. It is brewed with 100% German malt and noble hops to maintain stylistic authenticity.

title: Establishment Jam Rock Blackberry Sour - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Jam Rock is a highly sought-after seasonal release from Calgary’s The Establishment Brewing Company. This Blackberry Sour with Vanilla is designed to mimic the experience of a liquid berry cobbler or a fresh fruit preserve. Part of Establishment's commitment to "world-class beer without the pretension," Jam Rock has become a cult favorite for its vibrant color, bold fruit profile, and the expert balance between sharp acidity and smooth sweetness.

Beer Description

This fruited sour pours a stunning, opaque deep purple-to-burgundy color with a fleeting, pink-tinted foam head.

Aroma: It features an explosive nose of ripe, jammy blackberries. The fruitiness is complemented by a delicate, creamy scent of Madagascar vanilla bean and a bright, lactic tang that signals its sour profile.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied and incredibly flavorful. It leads with an intense tartness from the blackberries, which is immediately softened by the silky, rounding influence of vanilla. The result is a profile that tastes like a tart berry pie filling, finishing with a refreshing, puckering acidity.

Profile: It typically carries an ABV of around 5.6% and negligible bitterness, as the structure of the beer is defined by its acidity rather than hop character.

Technical Notes: Brewed using a kettle-sour process to achieve a clean, consistent tartness. It is conditioned on massive amounts of real blackberry purée and infused with high-quality vanilla beans. The addition of lactose (milk sugar) is often used to provide a creamy mouthfeel and to balance the sharp acidity of the fruit.

title: Phillips Electric Unicorn White IPA - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Electric Unicorn is a beloved staple from Victoria’s Phillips Brewing & Malting Co. This White IPA is a hybrid style that marries the spicy, fruity esters of a Belgian Witbier with the aggressive, aromatic hop profile of a Northwest IPA. It is designed to be a whimsical, high-energy brew that offers a complex sensory experience, balancing a creamy wheat body with a sharp, hoppy "horn" of bitterness.

Beer Description

This White IPA pours a hazy, pale straw color with a dense, frothy white head and visible carbonation.

Aroma: It features an eclectic and punchy nose, blending the coriander and orange peel notes of a Belgian ale with the tropical and citrus aromatics of West Coast hops. Expect scents of banana, clove, and grapefruit.

Palate: The flavor is a bright collision of styles. It begins with a soft, pillowy malt sweetness and spicy yeast character, which is quickly overtaken by a zesty hop profile of pineapple and citrus. It finishes with a crisp, dry bitterness that cleanses the palate.

Profile: It has an ABV of 6.5% and a moderate-to-high bitterness, providing a more robust experience than a traditional wheat beer while remaining lighter on its feet than a standard IPA.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a significant portion of wheat and oats to achieve its signature haze and silky mouthfeel. It is fermented with a specific Belgian yeast strain and aggressively hopped to ensure the IPA half of the hybrid style remains front and center.

title: Collective Arts Guava Gose 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
The Prophets & Nomads Guava Gose is a standout seasonal and mainstay in the "art-meets-beer" portfolio of Ontario’s Collective Arts Brewing. This beer is a modern, tropical riff on the traditional Gose, a historical German style known for its tartness and hint of salinity. By infusing the base with massive amounts of fresh guava, Collective Arts has created a pink, tropical powerhouse that is widely considered one of the most refreshing fruited sours in Canada.

Beer Description

This Gose pours a beautiful, hazy straw-to-soft-pink color with a fizzy, fleeting white head.

Aroma: It features an immediate, heady punch of tropical fruit. The scent of fresh, ripe pink guava is unmistakable, accompanied by a bright lactic tartness and a subtle, floral coriander spice.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied, tart, and incredibly effervescent. It leads with a sharp, puckering acidity that is quickly softened by the lush, sweet flavor of guava. True to the style, a tiny pinch of Himalayan salt on the finish rounds out the tartness and makes the fruit flavors pop, leaving the palate clean and refreshed.

Profile: ABV of 4.9% and negligible bitterness (around 12 IBU), as the beer’s structure relies on acidity and salt rather than hops.

Technical Notes: Brewed as a kettle sour using a lactic acid fermentation to achieve its bright tang. It is conditioned on significant amounts of guava purée and finished with crushed coriander and sea salt. This combination creates a "rehydration" effect that makes it a perfect pairing for hot summer days.

title: Phillips Tiger Shark Pale Ale - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Tiger Shark is a standout Citra-focused Pale Ale from Victoria’s Phillips Brewing & Malting Co. It was crafted to deliver the intense aromatic experience of a modern IPA but with a lower alcohol content and a lighter body, making it a quintessential "session" beer. Known for its approachable nature and bright, tropical personality, it has become a go-to for craft drinkers who want big hop flavor without the heavy punch of a traditional IPA.

Beer Description

This Pale Ale pours a bright, slightly hazy golden color with a frothy white head and a moderate amount of carbonation.

Aroma: It features a vibrant and highly aromatic nose dominated by the Citra hop. Expect intense notes of passionfruit, guava, and zesty grapefruit, with a very subtle floral backdrop.

Palate: The flavor is crisp and clean. It leads with a light, bready malt sweetness that quickly moves aside for a wave of tropical fruit flavors. It has a medium-to-light body and a smooth mouthfeel, finishing with a gentle, refreshing bitterness that doesn't overstay its welcome.

Profile: It has a sessionable ABV of 4.7% and a moderate bitterness of 35 IBU, striking a perfect balance between flavor intensity and drinkability.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a focus on the Citra hop variety, which is used liberally in the dry-hopping stage to maximize aroma. The grain bill is kept intentionally light to ensure the tropical hop characteristics remain the undisputed star of the show.

title: Fernie Brewing Project 9 - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Project 9 Pilsner is a flagship offering from Fernie Brewing Co., named after one of the most iconic and challenging mountain bike trails in Fernie, British Columbia. Just like the trail it’s named for, this beer is a local legend, designed to be the ultimate reward after a day of adventure in the Rockies. It is a clean, crisp, and technically precise German-style Pilsner that emphasizes quality ingredients and refreshing drinkability.

Beer Description

This Pilsner pours a brilliant, crystal-clear golden straw color with a lively carbonation and a tight, frothy white head.

Aroma: It features a clean and elegant nose with distinct floral and herbal notes from noble hops, underpinned by a delicate scent of sweet, bready malt and a hint of lemon zest.

Palate: The flavor is crisp and light bodied. It delivers a gentle, crackery malt sweetness that is quickly balanced by a refined, snappy bitterness. The mouthfeel is effervescent and clean, leading to a bone-dry, refreshing finish.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% and a moderate bitterness of 35 IBU, staying true to the traditional German Pilsner profile by offering a more assertive hop "snap" than a standard North American lager.

Technical Notes: Brewed with four simple, high quality ingredients: water, malted barley, hops, and yeast. It is cold-conditioned (lagered) for several weeks to achieve its signature clarity and smooth, crisp character.

title: Kujira Kyojin Single Grain Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Kujira Kyojin (meaning "Giant Whale") is a unique single grain Japanese whisky from the Masahiro Shuzo Distillery in Okinawa. Established in 1883, Masahiro Shuzo is one of Okinawa’s oldest distilleries, originally famous for crafting Awamori (a traditional rice spirit). Kujira Kyojin represents the distillery's "Giant" step into the global whisky market, utilizing 100% premium Indica rice and black koji for fermentation. Because of Okinawa’s subtropical climate, the whisky matures much faster than its Scottish counterparts, allowing this 3-year-old expression to develop a depth and color usually associated with much older spirits.

Spirit Description

The whisky has a light amber color and is matured exclusively in Virgin American White Oak barrels. On the nose, it is highly aromatic and unconventional, leading with warm spices, white chocolate, and rich toasted nuts, balanced by vibrant tropical fruits and a subtle floral hint of rose. The palate is velvety and rich, dominated by dark chocolate and vanilla, followed by exotic fruits and a touch of baked fruitcake. The finish is warm, dry, and elegant, leaving a lingering impression of refined oak and sophisticated dark chocolate. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

title: 21 Seeds Cucumber Jalapeno Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
21 Seeds Cucumber Jalapeño Blanco is a pioneer in the "infused" tequila category, founded in 2019 by Kat Hantas, her sister Nicole Hantas-Emanuel, and their friend Sarika Singh. Born in a home kitchen as a "better-for-you" alternative to wine and sugary cocktails, it uses a super-premium blanco tequila base that is cold-filtered and twice-distilled at the Casa Maestri distillery in Jalisco, Mexico. Unlike many flavored spirits that use synthetic syrups, 21 Seeds is infused with real fruit juice and natural botanicals, designed specifically to be "approachable" and easy to mix for a lighter, lower-calorie drinking experience.

Spirit Description

This tequila is crystal clear and notably smooth, purposefully avoiding the aggressive "burn" often associated with high-proof blancos. On the nose, it is remarkably fresh, leading with the scent of crisp, sliced cucumbers and the vegetal, earthy aroma of raw jalapeños. The palate is light-to-medium bodied and satiny, featuring bright cucumber notes upfront that are quickly met by a refined, subtle kick of jalapeño heat. Because it is infused with real juice rather than artificial flavors, it lacks any syrupy sweetness, finishing clean with a gentle, lingering spice. It is bottled at 35% ABV (70 proof), making it slightly lighter than standard tequilas.

title: Blindman New England Pale Ale - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
The New England Pale Ale (NEPA) from Blindman Brewing is the "juice-forward" counterpart to their more traditional hop offerings. While many breweries aim for maximum intensity, Blindman’s approach is one of balance and "drinkability." It is designed to deliver the lush, tropical aromatics and signature soft mouthfeel of the New England style, but at a slightly lower alcohol percentage and bitterness than a full-blown NEIPA. It’s a beer built for the "haze-heads" who want flavor without the heavy fatigue of a stronger ale.

Beer Description

This NEPA pours a dense, opaque glowing straw-yellow, looking very much like a glass of fresh pineapple juice, with a thick, billowy white head.

Aroma: The nose is an immediate tropical escape. Expect a concentrated bouquet of ripe mango, passionfruit, and sweet clementine, underscored by a very faint, pleasant "dank" herbal note that keeps the fruit from feeling one-dimensional.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a remarkably soft, "pillowy" mouthfeel. It leads with a velvety texture and flavors of citrus pulp and stone fruit. True to the New England style, the bitterness is very low and rounded, allowing the "juicy" hop character to dominate from the first sip to the finish.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 5.5% and low perceived bitterness, making it a "crushable" alternative to its heavier IPA cousins.

Technical Notes: Blindman utilizes a heavy hand of Citra and Mosaic hops (often alongside rotating varieties) primarily in the whirlpool and dry-hop stages to maximize oil extraction while minimizing bitterness. The grain bill features a significant amount of flaked oats and wheat, which provides the protein-rich structure for the permanent haze and the signature silky texture.

title: Establishment Classic Lager 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
The Classic from Calgary’s The Establishment Brewing Company is a masterclass in restraint and technical brewing. While Establishment is often celebrated for their complex barrel-aged sours and hazy IPAs, Classic represents their "brewer’s beer"—a clean, crisp, and flawlessly executed European-style Pale Lager. It is designed to be the ultimate everyday beer, providing a sophisticated alternative to macro-lagers by using premium ingredients and traditional lagering methods.

Beer Description

This lager pours a brilliant, crystal-clear pale straw-gold with a tight, creamy white head and fine, persistent carbonation.

Aroma: It features a delicate and refined nose. Expect clean scents of fresh-baked crackers and light honey from the malt, perfectly balanced by the herbal, floral, and slightly spicy notes of noble hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and exceptionally crisp. It leads with a subtle, grainy malt sweetness that is immediately followed by a snappy, refreshing dryness. The mouthfeel is smooth and "soft" (thanks to meticulous water chemistry), finishing with a clean, short-lived bitterness that invites another sip.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 4.8% and a low bitterness of 20 IBU, prioritizing balance and maximum "crushability."

Technical Notes: This beer is a labor of time and patience. It is brewed with 100% German pilsner malt and hopped with traditional Hallertau Mittelfrüh noble hops. It undergoes a long, cold lagering period (often six weeks or more) to ensure total clarity and a clean fermentation profile, free of any heavy esters or off-flavors.

title: Collective Arts Daily Forecast 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Daily Forecast (specifically the Daily Forecast: Mimosa) is a standout fruited sour from Ontario’s Collective Arts Brewing. As the name suggests, it is crafted to be the ultimate brunch companion, designed to replicate the experience of a classic mimosa. By blending a tart beer base with a massive amount of real juice, Collective Arts has created a "breakfast beer" that is as at home at a morning celebration as it is on a sunny patio.

Beer Description

This Mimosa Sour pours a bright, turbid orange—looking almost exactly like a glass of fresh-squeezed juice—with a fizzy, rapidly dissipating white head.

Aroma: The nose is dominated by an explosion of fresh, zesty orange. It smells remarkably authentic, featuring notes of sweet citrus pulp and a bright, lactic tang that hints at the sour beer base underneath.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied and highly effervescent. It leads with a lush, juicy sweetness from the unfermented orange juice, which is immediately balanced by a sharp, refreshing acidity. The finish is crisp and tingly, mimicking the bubbly "sparkle" of champagne.

Profile: It has a sessionable ABV of 4.5% and negligible bitterness. The structure is entirely defined by the interplay between the sweetness of the fruit and the tartness of the souring process.

Technical Notes: This beer is unique because it is blended with approximately 30% unfermented, freshly pressed orange juice. This high juice content provides the heavy body and authentic fruit flavor, while the lightly soured beer base provides the necessary acidity to keep it refreshing rather than syrupy.

title: Collective Arts Ood Dugges 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
The collaboration between Collective Arts Brewing (Hamilton, ON) and Dugges Bryggeri (Gothenburg, Sweden) is a standout entry in the 2022 Origin of Darkness series. This annual series is famous for pairing Collective Arts with world-class breweries to push the boundaries of barrel-aged stouts. For the Dugges edition, they took inspiration from Swedish confectionery, creating a decadent Chocolate, Raspberry, and Mint Imperial Stout that drinks like a liquid gourmet truffle.

Beer Description

This Imperial Stout pours a pitch-black, viscous liquid with a thin, mocha-colored head that leaves a moderate oily lace on the glass.

Aroma: It features a complex and layered nose. It leads with a sharp, cooling burst of peppermint, followed by the tart sweetness of jammy raspberries. Underneath, there is a rich foundation of dark chocolate and the subtle, boozy warmth of bourbon-soaked oak.

Palate: On the tongue, it is full-bodied and velvety. The flavor begins with intense dark chocolate fudge and sweet raspberry purée. The mint provides a refreshing, tingly contrast that prevents the heavy sweetness from becoming cloying. The finish reveals the barrel aging, with notes of vanilla, charred oak, and a lingering bourbon warmth.

Profile: It has a massive ABV of 11.6% and very low bitterness, as the structure is built on malt density and the interplay of adjuncts (mint, chocolate, and fruit).

Technical Notes: This is a Bourbon Barrel-Aged Imperial Stout. After aging in bourbon barrels to develop depth and vanilla notes, it was conditioned on large amounts of dark chocolate and raspberry purée, then finished with just the right amount of peppermint to create its signature "after-dinner mint" profile.

title: 33 Acres Brewing Darkness 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
33 Acres of Darkness is a multi-award-winning Schwarzbier (Black Lager) from Vancouver’s 33 Acres Brewing Co. This beer is a masterclass in contradiction: it looks like a heavy stout but drinks with the clean, refreshing "snap" of a crisp lager. It has become one of the most respected dark beers in Canada, famously winning World’s Best Schwarzbier at the World Beer Awards. It’s designed for those who love the flavors of dark chocolate and coffee but want a beer that is light enough for a summer evening.

Beer Description

This Schwarzbier pours a deep, dark mahogany—appearing nearly black in the glass—but reveals brilliant garnet highlights when held to the light. It is topped with a dense, creamy, tan-colored head.
