Aroma: The nose is sophisticated and inviting. It leads with dominant notes of baker’s chocolate and roasted nuts, followed by a subtle scent of cold-brew coffee. Unlike a porter, it remains very "clean" on the nose, with a faint herbal hop presence and no heavy fruity esters.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied and remarkably smooth. It leads with a delicate sweetness of toasted crust and dark cocoa, which quickly transitions into a dry, roasted finish. Because it is a lager, the mouthfeel is crisp and effervescent rather than thick or syrupy.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 5.0% and a moderate bitterness of 30 IBU, providing a perfect balance between roasted depth and lager-like refreshment.

Technical Notes: Brewed using a blend of roasted specialty malts and traditional German noble hops. The key to its award-winning profile is the bottom-fermentation process and an extended cold-lagering period. This ensures that the roasted barley flavors are smoothed out, removing any harsh or "burnt" astringency often found in dark ales.

title: 33 Acres Brewing Life 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
33 Acres of Life is the quintessential "California Common" (or Steam Beer) from Vancouver’s 33 Acres Brewing Co. This style is a rare hybrid in the beer world: it is brewed with a special strain of lager yeast but fermented at warmer, ale-like temperatures. The result is a beer that captures the best of both worlds—the crisp, clean finish of a lager and the fruity, complex aromatics of an ale. It is a brilliant copper-colored tribute to San Francisco’s brewing history, reimagined with West Coast precision.

Beer Description

This California Common pours a clear, beautiful amber-copper with a thick, off-white creamy head and moderate carbonation.

Aroma: It features a remarkably balanced and "toasty" nose. You’ll find immediate notes of caramelized malt and toasted sourdough, followed by a distinct woody and herbal hop scent—characteristic of the Northern Brewer hops used in this style. There is also a very faint, pleasant fruitiness (apple or pear) that comes from the warmer fermentation.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a smooth, rounded mouthfeel. It leads with a rich, bready malt sweetness and a touch of toffee. This is quickly balanced by a firm, earthy bitterness that cleanses the palate. The finish is dry and crisp, staying true to its lager roots.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 4.8% and a moderate bitterness of approx. 35 IBU, making it an exceptionally versatile food-pairing beer.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a blend of specialty crystal malts to achieve its deep amber color and toasted flavor profile. The use of Northern Brewer hops is essential to the style, providing a "rustic" bitterness that isn't citrusy or tropical like modern IPAs. It is the definition of a "sessionable amber," focusing on malt depth without being heavy.

title: Czechvar Dark 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Czechvar Dark Lager (known as Budweiser Budvar Tmavy Ležák in Europe) is a world-renowned dark lager from the state-owned Budějovický Budvar brewery in České Budějovice, Czech Republic. While the name "Czechvar" is used in North America due to trademark disputes, the liquid is the authentic, historic dark lager of Bohemia. It is often cited as one of the finest examples of a Schwarzbier or Czech Dark Lager ($Tmavé$), offering a complex, roasty profile while maintaining the legendary drinkability of a Czech pilsner.

Beer Description

This dark lager pours a stunning, deep ebony-brown with ruby-red highlights when held to the light. It is topped with a thick, persistent, tan-colored creamy head.

Aroma: It features a rich and layered nose. Expect dominant notes of roasted coffee beans and dark chocolate, balanced by a subtle sweetness of caramel and toasted hazelnuts. Unlike a stout, the aroma remains "clean" and crisp, with a faint floral hint from traditional Saaz hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a remarkably smooth, velvety mouthfeel. It leads with a gentle sweetness of dark malt and molasses, which quickly transitions into a roasted bitterness. The finish is surprisingly dry and refreshing, with none of the heavy, syrupy aftertaste often found in darker ales.

Profile: It has an ABV of 4.7% and a moderate bitterness of 24 IBU, making it incredibly sessionable despite its dark appearance.

Technical Notes: The secret to its depth lies in the use of four different types of malt: Pale, Munich, Caramel, and Roasted. It is brewed using the same soft artesian water and whole-cone Saaz hops as the original Pale Lager, and it undergoes a long, cold lagering process (often up to 90 days) to achieve its signature balance and refinement.

title: Banff Ave Black Pil 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
The Black Pil (Black Pilsner) is a cult-favorite seasonal and occasional mainstay from Banff Ave Brewing Co. Located in the heart of the Rockies, Banff Ave designed this beer to challenge the eyes and delight the palate. It is a "Schwarzbier" (German for black beer), which is essentially the dark cousin of a traditional Pilsner. It offers the roasted, complex flavors typically associated with a Stout or Porter but maintains the light body, crispness, and clean finish of a classic lager.

Beer Description

This Black Pilsner pours a deep, dark mahogany that appears nearly jet-black in the glass, topped with a thick, tan-colored creamy head.

Aroma: It features a surprising and sophisticated nose. Despite its dark color, it leads with the clean, floral, and spicy aromatics of noble hops. Underneath, there are gentle notes of toasted bread crust, bittersweet cocoa, and a hint of cold-brew coffee.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-light-bodied and remarkably crisp. It leads with a subtle, dark malt sweetness—think dark chocolate and toasted nuts—but avoids any heavy, syrupy mouthfeel. The finish is remarkably dry and "snappy," with a clean bitterness that quickly refreshes the palate.

Profile: It has an ABV of 4.8% and a moderate bitterness of 25-30 IBU, making it a "dark beer for people who like light beer."

Technical Notes: Brewed with a base of premium Pilsner malt and a careful addition of de-bittered roasted malts (like Carafa III). This allows the beer to achieve its striking black color and roasted flavor without the harsh, ashy astringency often found in stouts. It is fermented cold with a traditional lager yeast and aged (lagered) for several weeks to ensure a smooth, clean profile.

title: Buisson Charles Bourgogne Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
This exceptional white wine originates from the heart of the Côte de Beaune in Burgundy, produced by Domaine Buisson-Charles. Based in the prestigious village of Meursault, this estate is currently managed by Catherine Buisson and her husband Patrick Essa (a renowned wine critic turned vigneron), alongside their son Louis. While labeled as a regional "Bourgogne Blanc," this wine is widely regarded as a "Baby Meursault" by insiders. It is typically sourced from a specific plot called "Les Coutures"—and often labeled as "Hautes Coutures"—which sits just across the road from the official Meursault appellation boundary. The vines here are quite old (many between 40 and 60 years), and the winemaking philosophy is identical to that of the estate's Premier Crus: sustainable farming, low yields, and a lack of dogmatism regarding harvest dates, aiming always for the intersection of freshness and phenolic maturity.

Wine Description

Buisson-Charles Bourgogne Blanc displays a bright, glistening straw-gold colour. The nose is remarkably complex for its category, offering a bouquet that clearly hints at its Meursault pedigree: notes of lemon zest, fresh white peach, and acacia flowers are grounded by a distinct aroma of fresh hazelnut and warm brioche. On the palate, the wine is generous and fleshy, showcasing the estate's signature texture and weight. It balances ripe fruit density with a saline, stony minerality that provides tension and length. This 100% Chardonnay typically has an ABV of 13% and is aged for 12 to 15 months in French oak barrels (with a very low percentage of new oak, usually around 0–10%, to preserve purity). It finishes with a crisp, savory snap that invites the next sip.

title: Brandini Alta Langa Sparkling 2021
bodyHtml:
This elegant sparkling wine originates from the high hills of Piedmont, specifically within the prestigious Alta Langa DOCG, the region's premier appellation for Metodo Classico (traditional method) wines. Produced by Agricola Brandini, a winery based in La Morra best known for their Barolo, this wine represents their dedication to organic farming and high-altitude viticulture. The grapes are sourced from vineyards situated at significant elevations (over 500 meters above sea level), where the cooler temperatures preserve the acidity and aromatic complexity essential for top-tier sparkling wines. Brandini is a staunch advocate for sustainable agriculture, and this wine is Certified Organic, reflecting a philosophy that emphasizes the health of the soil and the purity of the fruit without the use of systemic chemicals.

Wine Description

Brandini Alta Langa displays a brilliant straw-yellow colour with golden reflections, animated by a fine, persistent perlage (bubbles). The nose is intense and fragrant, offering the classic "champenoise" bouquet of bread crust, yeast, and dried fruit, lifted by fresh notes of white flowers, citrus peel, and a hint of almond. On the palate, the wine is dry, savory, and beautifully structured, showcasing the power of the Pinot Noir alongside the elegance of the Chardonnay. It features a creamy mousse and a vibrant acidity that drives a long, clean finish marked by saline minerality. This blend typically consists of 85% Pinot Noir and 15% Chardonnay. It undergoes secondary fermentation in the bottle and is aged on its lees (yeasts) for 30 to 36 months before disgorgement. The ABV is typically around 12.5%.

title: Brandini Langhe Nebbiolo 2023
bodyHtml:
This vibrant red wine originates from the prestigious hills of the Langhe in Piedmont, produced by Agricola Brandini. Based in La Morra, Brandini is a modern, forward-thinking estate committed to organic agriculture and sustainable practices. Their Langhe Nebbiolo serves as a "junior Barolo," offering a younger, more accessible expression of the noble Nebbiolo grape without the extended aging requirements of its big brother. Sourced from the estate's younger vines grown in the classic marl and sandy soils of the region, this wine is designed to showcase the varietal's hallmark floral elegance and fresh fruit character. It is Certified Organic, reflecting the winery's philosophy that great wine begins with a healthy, chemical-free ecosystem.

Wine Description

Brandini Langhe Nebbiolo displays a bright ruby red colour that transitions to light garnet at the rim. The nose is fragrant and varietally pure, opening with classic aromas of wild strawberries, red cherries, and dried rose petals, accented by subtle hints of white pepper and anise. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and fresh, distinguished by fine-grained tannins that provide structure without being aggressive. It balances a juicy core of red fruit with a savory, mineral finish that makes it incredibly food-friendly. This 100% Nebbiolo typically has an ABV of 13.5–14%. To preserve its freshness while softening its edges, it undergoes fermentation in temperature-controlled steel tanks followed by aging for approximately 12 months in large Slavonian oak casks (botti grandi). The optimal drinking window is from release through the next 5 to 8 years.

title: Cuvee Eva Bordeaux Blanc 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This elegant white wine originates from the Bordeaux AOC in Southwest France and serves as a heartfelt tribute to Eva, the daughter of Cyrille Roche, owner of the wine merchant House SAVAS. The winery’s philosophy is to blend traditional Bordeaux expertise with a contemporary vision, producing wines that emphasize freshness, purity, and aromatic precision. Sourced from selected vineyards, including prestigious gravelly and clay-limestone terroirs, Cuvée Eva is crafted to be an accessible yet sophisticated expression of the region. It is often celebrated for offering a "Grand Cru" spirit at a remarkable value, highlighting the vibrant potential of Bordeaux’s white varieties.

Wine Description

Cuvée Eva Bordeaux Blanc presents a beautiful golden robe with brilliant highlights. The nose is expressive and complex, offering a refined bouquet of lemon zest, grapefruit, and lime blossom layered with tropical notes of pineapple and fresh herbs. On the palate, the wine is full and round, showcasing a silky texture balanced by a vibrant, "crunchy" acidity. It is characterized by its concentrated fruit profile and a subtle hint of toasted oak and caramel, which adds a sophisticated structural depth. This blend (typically 70% Sauvignon Blanc and 30% Sémillon, or 100% Sauvignon in select vintages) has an ABV of 13% and underwent meticulous aging, including lees stirring and 6 months in oak barrels, to enhance its creamy finish.

title: Last Best Tokyo Drift 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Last Best Tokyo Drift is a bold, turbo-charged India Pale Ale (IPA) crafted in Calgary, Alberta. The brewery and distillery, which opened its doors in May 2015, derives its name from the historical 'Last Best West' campaign launched by the Canadian government in the late 1800s to grow agriculture in the western prairies. Last Best Brewing & Distilling is part of a family of four Alberta-based breweries, alongside locations in Banff, Jasper, and Fort McMurray.

Description

  • Colour and Style: This beer is a New England style Hazy IPA that pours a hazy golden colour with a frothy white head.

  • Aroma: The nose is vibrant and expressive, featuring intense aromas of pineapple, stone fruit, and tangerine, accented by hints of grapefruit, mango, and resinous pine.

  • Palate and Body: On the palate, it is juicy and full-flavored with layered tropical fruit notes balanced by a smooth, subtle caramel malt backbone.

  • Finish: The finish is crisp and refreshing with a bold hop bite that reined-in perceived bitterness.

  • Technical Details: Brewed with a powerful blend of Mosaic, Galaxy, Citra, and Simcoe hops, the beer has an ABV of 7.2% and a bitterness rating of 74 IBU. It is sold in a 24-pack of 473 mL cans.

  • Philosophy: While not certified organic, the brewery emphasizes small-batch craft production and uses local ingredients, such as malted grains from the Canadian Rockies and heritage barley from Northern Alberta

title: 33 Acres Brewing Ocean 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
33 Acres of Ocean is the flagship West Coast Pale Ale that helped put 33 Acres Brewing Co. on the map. In a world of increasingly hazy and "juice-forward" ales, Ocean is a masterclass in the classic, refined West Coast style. It is designed to be a balance of high-quality malt and expressive hops, offering a "clean" bitterness that reflects the crisp, salty air of the Pacific Northwest. It is widely considered one of the most reliable and consistent Pale Ales in British Columbia.

Beer Description

This Pale Ale pours a brilliant, clear golden-straw color with a tight, frothy white head that leaves consistent "rings" of lace down the glass.

Aroma: The nose is bright, floral, and classically "piney." Expect immediate notes of grapefruit zest and resinous pine, followed by a subtle floral sweetness reminiscent of wildflower honey. There is a very clean, crackery malt base that provides a neutral backdrop for the hop aromatics.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a crisp, sparkling effervescence. It leads with a delicate, bready malt sweetness before a wave of citrus and forest floor hop flavors takes over. The finish is remarkably dry and clean, with a lingering, snappy bitterness that is assertive but never harsh.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.3% and a moderate bitterness of approx. 40 IBU, hitting the traditional mark for a balanced American-style Pale Ale.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a blend of premium base malts and specialty grains to ensure a light body that doesn't feel thin. It is hopped with classic Pacific Northwest varieties—typically including Cascade and Citra—to achieve its signature citrus and pine profile. The beer is fermented with a clean ale yeast and filtered to achieve its "brilliant" clarity, a hallmark of the 33 Acres aesthetic.

title: Sunshine Rain IPA 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Sunshine Rain IPA is a flagship craft beer produced in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. It is brewed by Cabin Brewing.

Description

This beer is a quintessential West Coast Style IPA known for its clarity and bright character. It pours a clear golden colour with a persistent white head. The aromatic profile is highly expressive, featuring a heavy dose of citrus and tropical fruit scents, specifically notes of tangerine, grapefruit, and mango, balanced by a resinous pine undertone. On the palate, the beer is crisp and dry, delivering a harmonious blend of fruit-forward hop flavours and a light caramel malt sweetness. The finish is clean and refreshing with a firm, lingering bitterness that is characteristic of the style. This IPA has an alcohol content of 6.7% ABV and a bitterness rating of 65 IBU. While it is not certified organic, the brewery uses high-quality local malts and a complex selection of hops to achieve its sensory depth.

title: Eighty-Eight Hi-Fi Hazy IPA 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Hi-Fi is the high-fidelity, high-intensity flagship New England IPA from Calgary’s Eighty-Eight Brewing Co. While its sibling Wave Pool is a tropical vacation, Hi-Fi is a deep dive into the "haze" craze prioritizing a massive, silky mouthfeel and "saturated" hop flavors. Named in line with the brewery’s love for vintage audio and 80s tech, this beer is designed to be a "loud" expression of modern hops, offering a complex, multi-layered juice profile that has made it one of the most sought-after hazy IPAs in Alberta.

Beer Description

Hi-Fi pours a dense, completely opaque glowing yellow, reminiscent of a fresh pineapple smoothie, with a thick, meringue-like white head and very soft carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is a "wall of sound" of tropical aromatics. Expect a heavy, sweet fragrance of overripe mango, stone fruit (peach/apricot), and a distinct "creamsicle" orange note. There is a subtle, dank herbal quality underneath that adds depth to the fruitiness.

Palate: On the tongue, it is full-bodied with a famously velvety, "chewy" mouthfeel. It leads with a lush sweetness of tropical nectar and citrus pith. Because it is a true-to-style NEIPA, the bitterness is incredibly low and rounded, serving only to balance the rich malt base. The finish is smooth and soft, leaving a lingering "hop juice" sensation on the palate.

Profile: It has a robust ABV of 6.7% and very low perceived bitterness, making it deceptively easy to drink despite its density and strength.

Technical Notes: The signature texture of Hi-Fi comes from a heavy proportion of flaked oats and wheat in the grain bill, which provides the protein required for its permanent opacity. It is "double dry-hopped" (DDH) with a rotating but heavy-hitting selection of hops, typically featuring Citra and Vic Secret. Vic Secret, an Australian hop, is largely responsible for the beer's unique pineapple and pine-resin complexity.

title: Quinta De Sao Francisco Obidos 2019
bodyHtml:
This distinguished wine originates from the Óbidos DOC in the Lisboa region of Portugal. Produced by Companhia Agrícola do Sanguinhal, a historic family-run estate founded in the 19th century, Quinta de S. Francisco is a benchmark for the region's Atlantic-influenced viticulture. The winery's philosophy combines tradition with innovation; they were pioneers in planting aligned, wired vineyards and separate varietal plots in a region traditionally known for mixed field blends. The estate is famous for its unique microclimate; shielded by the Serra do Montejunto but still cooled by Atlantic breezes resulting in wines with remarkable freshness and longevity.

Wine Description

The Quinta de S. Francisco red is a blend of traditional Portuguese varieties: Castelão, Aragonez (Tinta Roriz), and Touriga Nacional. It presents a deep ruby colour and an aromatic profile of ripe red fruits and blackberries, accented by notes of chocolate, vanilla, and spices (such as pepper and cinnamon) derived from aging in French and American oak. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, smooth, and well-structured, with a spicy character and a long, persistent finish.

title: Driftwood Juicy IPA 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Raised by Wolves is the celebrated "Juicy IPA" from Victoria’s Driftwood Brewery. While Driftwood is legendary for the aggressive, piney bitterness of their flagship Fat Tug IPA, Raised by Wolves represents their masterful take on the modern, fruit-forward movement. It is designed to prioritize "hop saturation" over bitterness, offering a lush, tropical experience that remains true to Driftwood’s reputation for technical excellence and bold flavor profiles.

Beer Description

This Juicy IPA pours a hazy, glowing apricot-gold with a soft, frothy white head and a moderate, lively carbonation.

Aroma: It features an explosive and "dank" tropical nose. Expect dominant scents of ripe mango, squeezed tangerine, and juicy stone fruits (like peach and nectarine), underscored by a subtle, resinous floral note that adds depth.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a soft, rounded mouthfeel. It leads with a delicate, bready malt sweetness that serves as a canvas for a wave of tropical fruit flavors—guava and pineapple predominate. Unlike a traditional West Coast IPA, the finish is smooth and low-bitterness, allowing the hop oils to linger pleasantly without a sharp "bite."

Profile: It has a robust ABV of 7.0% and a moderate-to-low perceived bitterness, hiding its strength behind its approachable, juice-like character.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a heavy emphasis on late-addition and dry-hopping using a blend of modern Northwest hops (typically including Citra and Mosaic). The use of oats and wheat in the grain bill provides the signature protein haze and silky texture, while a specific yeast strain is used to enhance the fruity esters that complement the hop profile.

title: Birrificio Messina Societa Lager 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Birra dello Stretto (often labeled under the producer name Birrificio Messina Società Cooperativa) is a beer with one of the most powerful backstories in the modern industry. After the historic Messina brewery was closed by multinational owners in 2011, 15 dedicated workers—the "Master Brewers"—refused to let their tradition die. They invested their own life savings (TFR) to form a cooperative and build a new brewery from scratch. This Lager is their flagship "rebirth" beer, designed to honor the soul of Sicily and the resilience of its people.

Beer Description

This premium lager pours a brilliant, translucent golden color with a compact, persistent white head and fine carbonation.

Aroma: It features a remarkably clean and "noble" nose. Expect classic aromas of toasted malt and fresh grain, balanced by a refined, persistent floral and herbal hop bouquet that is more aromatic than your average Mediterranean lager.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied and incredibly balanced. It leads with a delicate, "pure malt" sweetness that quickly transitions into a dry, slightly spicy hop character. The mouthfeel is smooth and crisp, finishing with a pleasant, lingering bitterness that makes it exceptionally refreshing.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% (though some variants like the DOC 15 are 4.7%) and a moderate bitterness that provides more structure and "bite" than mass-market Italian lagers.

Technical Notes: Brewed using a traditional bottom-fermentation process and high-quality "Puro Malto" (pure malt) barley. Unlike many industrial lagers, it is crafted with a focus on a long, patient cold-conditioning cycle to ensure a rounded flavor profile. It is often described as a "bridge" beer—uniting the approachability of a lager with the soul and passion of an artisanal cooperative.

title: Berliner Pilsner 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Berliner Pilsner is one of the most recognizable icons of German beer culture, famously adorned with the "Berlin Bear" (the Berliner Bär) on its label. Originally introduced in the German Democratic Republic (East Germany) in 1963, it has evolved from a socialist staple into a modern symbol of the capital's "cool," hardworking spirit. Brewed by the Berliner-Kindl-Schultheiss-Brauerei, it is a quintessential "everyman" beer—unfussy, technically sound, and deeply integrated into the city's nightlife and street culture.

Beer Description

This German Pilsner pours a pale straw-gold with brilliant clarity and a lively, frothy white head that dissipates to a thin, persistent collar.

Aroma: The nose is clean and classic. It leads with the scent of freshly baked white bread and grainy malt, followed by the characteristic herbal and "grassy" notes of Hallertau hops. Some tasters also note a very faint, bright hint of green apple or sourdough.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium-bodied with a sharp, sparkling carbonation. It offers a soft, crackery malt sweetness at the front of the sip, which is quickly overtaken by a dry, snappy bitterness. It is less aggressively bitter than some Northern German Pilsners (like Jever), making it highly approachable and "crushable."

Profile: It has a standard ABV of 5.0% and a moderate bitterness of approximately 30 IBU, providing exactly the "bite" expected of the style without being overwhelming.

Technical Notes: Brewed in strict accordance with the Reinheitsgebot (German Purity Law) using only water, barley malt, hops (and hop extract), and yeast. It is bottom-fermented and cold-lagered to ensure a sparklingly clean profile and high drinkability.

title: Collective Arts Pilsner 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
The Collective Arts Pilsner is a testament to the Hamilton brewery’s ability to master tradition just as well as they do experimental sours and IPAs. While their branding is defined by rotating gallery-style art on every can, the liquid inside this tallboy is a "back-to-basics" tribute to the German Pilsner style. It is designed to be the ultimate "fridge staple" clean, uncomplicated, and technically precise, providing a crisp counterpoint to their more aggressive hop-forward offerings.

Beer Description

This Pilsner pours a brilliant, crystal-clear straw-gold with a tight, frothy white head and high, streaming carbonation.

Aroma: It features a classic, noble hop-forward nose. Expect bright, herbal, and slightly floral scents (characteristic of Perle and Hallertau hops) layered over a delicate base of sweet, crackery pilsner malt.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and exceptionally "snappy." It leads with a soft, bready malt sweetness that is quickly overtaken by a clean, dry bitterness. The mouthfeel is crisp and refreshing, with a sparkling effervescence that scrubs the palate and leaves a short, herbal finish.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 4.9% and a moderate bitterness of approx. 30 IBU, hitting the traditional mark for a balanced German-style lager.

Technical Notes: Brewed with premium pilsner malt and traditional German hops. Following the strict traditions of the style, it undergoes a long, cold lagering process to ensure total clarity and a neutral yeast profile, allowing the quality of the water and grain to shine through without any distracting fruity esters.

title: Annex Idle Hands Pilsner - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Idle Hands is the gold-standard Italian Pilsner from Calgary’s Annex Ale Project. While traditional German Pilsners are known for their sharp bitterness and Czech Pilsners for their bready richness, the Italian style pioneered by Birrificio Italiano’s Tipopils adds a modern twist: dry-hopping. Annex has mastered this sub-style, creating a beer that is technically a clean, bottom fermented lager but carries the vibrant, floral aromatics usually reserved for fine ales.

Beer Description

This Italian Pilsner pours a brilliant, crystal-clear straw-gold with a dense, mousse-like white head and fine, persistent carbonation.

Aroma: It features a strikingly bright and "pretty" nose. Unlike a standard lager, the dry-hopping provides an elegant bouquet of wildflower honey, lemon zest, and fresh-cut grass, all supported by a base of sweet, crackery pilsner malt.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied, crisp, and incredibly "snappy." It leads with a delicate, bready malt sweetness that is quickly met by a firm, noble hop bitterness. The finish is remarkably dry and clean, with the floral hop oils lingering pleasantly on the palate.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 5.3% and a moderate bitterness of 35 IBU, offering a more aromatic and structured experience than a typical North American lager.

Technical Notes: Brewed with premium European pilsner malt and fermented cold with a neutral lager yeast. The defining characteristic is the generous dry-hop addition of Saphir and Hallertau Mittelfrüh noble hops. These varieties provide the signature "perfumey" top notes without adding the heavy resin or citrus found in New World IPAs.

title: Superflux Lager 473 ml - 24 Cans
vendor: 300772 - Copper And Theory Artisan Beer Supply
bodyHtml:
Simply titled "Lager," this brew is the minimalist's answer to the high-intensity IPAs that Superflux Beer Company is famous for. Brewed in Vancouver, this beer serves as the "palate cleanser" for the brewery—a technically perfect, no-frills lager that strips away the tropical fruit and haze to focus on pure, crisp execution. It is designed for those moments when you want a beer that "tastes like beer," but crafted with the same obsessive attention to detail as their most complex hazies.

Beer Description

Superflux Lager pours a brilliant, straw-gold that is strikingly clear, topped with a frothy, bright white head and tight, streaming carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is clean, elegant, and understated. It offers a gentle bouquet of sweet pilsner malt—reminiscent of fresh crackers or a summer grain field—paired with a very faint, noble herbal hop note.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and exceptionally "snappy." It leads with a delicate malt sweetness that is almost immediately cut by a sharp, dry finish. The mouthfeel is soft and refreshing, with a clean profile that leaves no lingering sweetness or heavy aftertaste. It is remarkably effortless to drink.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 5.0% and a low bitterness, prioritizing a smooth, balanced experience over hop or malt dominance.

Technical Notes: While simple in flavor, the brewing process is rigorous. It is brewed with high-quality base malts and traditional hops, then cold-lagered for an extended period to achieve its signature clarity and "brilliant" finish. Superflux treats this lager with the same reverence as their IPAs, ensuring the water chemistry is dialed in for a crisp, refreshing "bite."

title: Whistler Chestnut Ale 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
The Chestnut Ale is the legendary seasonal flagship from Whistler Brewing Company. First released as a winter specialty, its massive popularity turned it into a highly anticipated annual tradition. It is one of the most unique "nut ales" in Canada, specifically designed to capture the cozy, aromatic essence of autumn and winter in the mountains. Rather than relying solely on roasted malts for flavor, Whistler uses real roasted chestnuts to create a profile that is distinctly earthy and savory-sweet.

Beer Description

This ale pours a deep, clear mahogany-amber with a creamy, off-white head that leaves a moderate lace on the glass.

Aroma: It features a warm, inviting, and highly evocative nose. You’ll find immediate notes of roasted nuts, caramel, and vanilla, followed by a subtle "herbal" sweetness that is characteristic of the chestnut infusion.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a smooth, velvety texture. It leads with a rich malt sweetness—think toffee and toasted bread—which transitions into the star of the show: a deep, nutty, and slightly smoky chestnut flavor. The finish is clean and mellow, with very little hop bitterness, allowing the warm, nutty notes to linger.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% and a low bitterness of 25 IBU, making it an incredibly approachable and "comforting" beer for cooler weather.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a blend of specialty malts and real roasted chestnuts added during the brewing process. The use of chestnuts provides a unique starch and sugar profile that differs from barley alone, resulting in a specific "woody" sweetness and a silky mouthfeel that distinguishes it from a standard Brown Ale or Porter.

title: Damm Estrella 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Estrella Damm is the "Beer of Barcelona" and a symbol of Mediterranean lifestyle since 1876. Founded by August Küntzmann Damm, who emigrated from Alsace to escape the Franco-Prussian War, it was specifically designed to be lighter and more refreshing than heavy Central European lagers to suit the warm Spanish climate. Today, it remains Spain's oldest beer brand and is brewed using 100% natural ingredients—notably including rice from the Ebro Delta, which contributes to its signature crispness.

Beer Description

This Mediterranean lager pours a brilliant, clear golden color with amber reflections and a tight, creamy, long-lasting head.

Aroma: It features a clean, inviting bouquet. The nose is dominated by the scent of fresh spices and toasted grains, with a subtle floral backdrop and a hint of yeast.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium-bodied with fine, lively carbonation that creates a smooth mouthfeel. It leads with a delicate malt sweetness and notes of toasted cereal, followed by a refreshing acidity. The finish is clean, dry, and characterized by a persistent, refined bitterness.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.4% (though a 4.6% version is common in some international markets) and a bitterness of 26 IBU, providing more character and "bite" than many standard international pale lagers.

Technical Notes: The recipe has remained largely unchanged for over 140 years. It is brewed with Mediterranean pearl rice, which lightens the body and provides a clean finish. Damm is one of the few industrial breweries that still uses its own malthouse and maintains its own proprietary yeast strain, which has been preserved through three high-security reserves in Barcelona, Valencia, and London.

title: Superflux Mesa IPA 473 ml - 24 Cans
vendor: 300772 - Copper And Theory Artisan Beer Supply
bodyHtml:
Mesa is a standout "modern" IPA from Vancouver’s Superflux Beer Company. While Superflux is primarily known for their thick, "juice-bomb" NEIPAs, Mesa represents a more refined, structured approach. It sits comfortably between a hazy IPA and a classic West Coast style—offering the intense, saturated tropical aromatics Superflux is famous for, but with a leaner malt body and a cleaner, more refreshing finish. It is often described by the brewery as a "simple, focused IPA" designed for maximum drinkability.

Beer Description

Mesa pours a glowing, pale straw-yellow with a soft, hazy opacity and a frothy, bright white head that leaves excellent lacing on the glass.

Aroma: The nose is an explosion of "green" and tropical hop notes. Expect immediate hits of fresh lime zest, white grape, and passionfruit, followed by a subtle, resinous pine and a distinct floral quality (think elderflower or crushed gooseberries).

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-light-bodied with a crisp, effervescent mouthfeel. Unlike their heavier IPAs, Mesa leads with a very clean, cracker-like malt base. This allows the hop flavors—predominantly citrus pith and tropical stone fruit—to take center stage. The finish is remarkably dry and snappy, with a firm but smooth bitterness that cleanses the palate.

Profile: It has a robust ABV of 6.5% and a moderate bitterness that provides more "cut" than a standard New England IPA, making it feel lighter and more refreshing than its strength suggests.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a heavy focus on Nelson Sauvin and Citra hops. The Nelson Sauvin (from New Zealand) provides the signature "Sauvignon Blanc" grape and gooseberry notes, while the Citra adds the familiar citrus backbone. The water profile is treated to be slightly "crisper" than their flagship Colour & Shape, resulting in a beer that is less creamy and more "zesty."

title: Superflux Easy Tiger Pale Ale 473 ml - 24 Cans
vendor: 300772 - Copper And Theory Artisan Beer Supply
bodyHtml:
Easy Tiger is a staple in the Superflux Beer Company rotation, and like many of their offerings, it has evolved over time existing both as a "Hoppy Lager" and more prominently as an American Pale Ale. Regardless of the base style, the "Easy Tiger" philosophy remains the same: it is designed to be the more relaxed, lower-intensity sibling to their powerhouse IPAs. It captures the signature Superflux "hop saturation" but delivers it in a lighter, more sessionable package that is perfect for all-day drinking.

Beer Description

This Pale Ale pours a characteristic Superflux hazy straw-gold dense and opaque with a soft, billowy white head and fine carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is bright, zesty, and unmistakably citrus-forward. Expect a heavy hit of tangerine, lime zest, and white grapefruit, followed by softer tropical notes of lychee and a hint of green, herbal "dankness."

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a remarkably soft, watery-yet-silky mouthfeel. It leads with a clean, lean malt profile that stays out of the way, allowing the hops to shine. The flavors mirror the aroma with a burst of citrus juice, finishing with a crisp, low-to-moderate bitterness that is incredibly refreshing.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 4.5% and a restrained bitterness, making it significantly more "crushable" than their 6.5%+ IPAs while retaining a similar aromatic punch.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a heavy hand of Citra hops (and often supported by Simcoe or Mosaic depending on the batch). By utilizing oats and wheat in the grain bill, Superflux achieves that signature "hazy" texture and protein-rich mouthfeel even at a lower alcohol percentage, ensuring the beer never feels thin or "watery."

title: Superflux Colour & Shape IPA 473 ml - 24 Cans
vendor: 300772 - Copper And Theory Artisan Beer Supply
bodyHtml:
Colour & Shape is the definitive flagship of Vancouver’s Superflux Beer Company and arguably one of the beers that defined the New England IPA (NEIPA) movement in Western Canada. When people talk about "Superflux," this is usually the beer they are holding. It is designed to be an unapologetic "juice bomb"—a thick, opaque, and highly aromatic ale that prioritizes hop flavor and creamy texture over traditional bitterness.

Beer Description

This NEIPA pours a dense, completely opaque glowing orange—often likened to mango juice—with a thick, pillowy white head and very soft carbonation.

Aroma: It features an intense, "saturated" nose of tropical fruit. Expect a massive bouquet of ripe pineapple, fuzzy peach, and sweet clementine, with a subtle, creamy vanilla-like undertone that comes from the specific yeast and grain interaction.

Palate: On the tongue, it is famously full-bodied with a "chewy," velvety mouthfeel. It leads with a lush sweetness of tropical stone fruit and citrus pulp. Unlike a West Coast IPA, the bitterness is almost non-existent; it is soft, rounded, and "juicy" from start to finish, leaving a smooth, fruity coating on the palate.

Profile: It has a robust ABV of 6.5% and very low perceived bitterness, making it incredibly easy to drink despite its density and strength.

Technical Notes: This beer is a masterclass in hop-loading. It is brewed with a massive amount of Citra hops used exclusively in the whirlpool and dry-hop stages to extract essential oils without the harsh alpha-acid bitterness. The grist includes a heavy proportion of flaked oats and wheat, which provides the high protein content necessary for its signature permanent haze and silky, creamy texture.

title: Sierra Nevada Pale Ale 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Sierra Nevada Pale Ale is arguably the most important beer in the history of American craft brewing. Launched in 1980 by Ken Grossman in Chico, California, it didn't just define the American Pale Ale (APA) style—it launched a revolution. At a time when the market was dominated by light, bland lagers, this beer introduced the world to the bold, piney, and citrusy punch of American hops (specifically the Cascade variety). It remains a global benchmark for balance, quality, and consistency.

Beer Description

This classic APA pours a brilliant, deep amber-gold with a thick, resilient creamy white head and fine, steady carbonation.

Aroma: It features an iconic and unmistakable nose. Expect a fragrant burst of fresh pine resin and spicy floral notes, followed by the signature scent of grapefruit zest. Underneath the hops is a solid, sweet foundation of caramelized malt.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied and exceptionally well-balanced. It leads with a toasted, bready malt sweetness and hints of caramel. This is immediately met by a clean, assertive hop bitterness that cuts through the malt. The finish is crisp and dry, leaving a lingering trail of citrus pith and pine.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.6% and a firm bitterness of 38 IBU, providing a "snappy" character that remains incredibly drinkable.

Technical Notes: This beer is famous for its use of whole-cone Cascade hops, which are added to the kettle and then used again in the "hop back" for aroma. Unlike many modern beers that use hop pellets, Sierra Nevada’s commitment to whole-cone hops provides a more nuanced, "green" aromatic profile. Notably, it is bottle-conditioned, meaning a small amount of yeast is added to the bottle to allow for natural carbonation and a longer shelf life.

title: Peroni Nastro Azzurro Stile Capri 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Nastro Azzurro Stile Capri is a modern, Mediterranean-inspired expansion of the iconic Peroni portfolio. Launched to capture the essence of a "summer in a bottle," it is a light, easy-drinking lager designed to compete in the premium "sunshine beer" category (think Corona or Sol, but with Italian flair). It departs from the crisp bitterness of the standard Nastro Azzurro by adding a delicate infusion of Mediterranean lemon and olive leaf extract, resulting in a beer specifically tailored for beach clubs, patios, and hot Italian afternoons.

Beer Description

This lager pours a brilliant, pale straw-yellow—noticeably lighter than the original Peroni—with a fizzy, bright white head and high, sparkling carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is immediate and breezy. It leads with a clean, zesty scent of fresh lemon peel and a very subtle, earthy herbal note from the olive leaf. Underneath is a light, crackery malt base with virtually no heavy hop presence.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and incredibly refreshing. It leads with a soft, grainy sweetness that is quickly brightened by a delicate citrus tang. Unlike the original Nastro Azzurro, which has a distinct hoppy "bite," Stile Capri has a very low, rounded bitterness. The finish is short, clean, and crisp, with a faint, savory herbal undertone that keeps the citrus from feeling like a "shandy."

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 4.2% (lower than the standard 5.0% Nastro Azzurro) and very low bitterness, prioritizing maximum "crushability."

Technical Notes: Brewed with the same high-quality Italian maize (Nostrano dell’Isola) as the flagship, but finished with natural extracts of lemon and olive leaf. This infusion is designed to provide a "natural" refreshment rather than a sugary, flavored profile. It is often served directly from its clear glass bottle (which is UV-resistant to prevent skunking) with or without a slice of fresh lemon.

title: Hitachino Nest Espresso Stout 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Hitachino Nest Espresso Stout is a world-renowned specialty stout from Japan’s Kiuchi Brewery. While many coffee stouts simply add cold brew to a finished beer, Hitachino takes a more intensive approach by adding locally roasted espresso beans directly into the boil (the copper). Featuring the brewery's iconic "Owl" branding, this beer is a masterclass in how to integrate intense roasted flavors without losing the refined, balanced character that Japanese craft brewing is known for.

Beer Description

This Espresso Stout pours a deep, midnight black, completely opaque with a thick, frothy, tan-colored head that persists like the crema on a fresh shot of espresso.

Aroma: The nose is intense and decadent. It leads with a powerful hit of freshly ground dark roast coffee and burnt sugar, followed by rich layers of dark chocolate, toasted hazelnuts, and a hint of dark fruit (like raisins or dried plums).

Palate: On the tongue, it is full-bodied and velvety, bordering on "creamy." It leads with a deep, roasted malt sweetness—think bittersweet cocoa and molasses. This is immediately followed by the sharp, acidic "zing" of authentic espresso. The finish is long and warming, with a complex bitterness that comes from both the hops and the coffee beans.

Profile: It has a robust ABV of 7.0% and a moderate-to-high bitterness of 36 IBU, providing a sturdy structure that stands up to the bold adjuncts.

Technical Notes: Brewed using a sophisticated malt bill that includes Pale, Crystal, Black, and Chocolate malts, along with roasted barley. The defining characteristic is the addition of espresso beans in the kettle, which extracts the deep oils and aromatics of the coffee. It is hopped with Northern Brewer and Chinook to provide an earthy, spicy backbone that complements the roasted notes.

title: Courtalt Michelet Chablis Premier Cru Mont De Milieu 2023
bodyHtml:
This prestigious white wine originates from the Mont de Milieu vineyard, widely considered one of the finest and most "Grand Cru-like" of the Chablis Premier Cru sites. Domaine Courtalt-Michelet is a family-run estate born from the union of two winemaking families, Stéphanie Courtalt and Vincent Michelet, who manage approximately 28 hectares of vines. Their winemaking philosophy centers on a "reasoned" approach to viticulture (Lutte Raisonnée), emphasizing minimal intervention to allow the Kimmeridgian limestone soils to express their signature flinty character.

Wine Description

The Courtalt-Michelet Chablis Premier Cru Mont de Milieu presents a brilliant pale gold colour with silvery reflections. The nose is intense and refined, opening with aromas of white flowers, lemon curd, and crisp green apple, underpinned by a powerful "gunflint" smokiness and saline minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and concentrated, showcasing a rich, honeyed texture balanced by a racy, vibrant acidity. It is characterized by its high-altitude energy and a long, persistent finish that echoes with notes of citrus zest and crushed sea shells.

title: Tamdhu Batch Strength 008 Single Malt Scotch Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Tamdhu Batch Strength 008 is the eighth installment in the award-winning cask-strength series from this Speyside distillery. True to the brand's "Only the Best" philosophy, this release is matured exclusively in Oloroso sherry-seasoned oak casks from the bodegas of Jerez, Spain, with a high proportion being first-fill casks. Launched in late 2023, Batch 008 is designed to showcase the more intense, high-voltage side of Tamdhu's typically elegant profile, offering a natural copper hue and a rich, unfiltered texture.

Spirit Description

The whisky is bottled at a potent 55.8% ABV and is non-chill filtered with no added color.

  • Nose: It opens with warm, aromatic notes of Spanish oak, creamy vanilla, and honeycomb. Beneath the sweetness, there are layers of toasted nuts, red berries, and "high-pitched" notes of citrus zest and herbal mint.

  • Palate: The entry is sharp and vibrant, featuring summer berries and pomegranates. As it develops, the mouthfeel becomes velvety and rich, revealing flavors of candied lemon peel, milk chocolate, and gingerbread, balanced by a mounting wave of oak spice and cinnamon.

  • Finish: Long and evolving. It transitions from spicy orange tea and baked figs to a softer, malty conclusion with lingering hints of freshly peeled clementine and toffee. Adding a splash of water is highly recommended; it tames the initial alcohol heat and allows the more delicate notes of apricot and marzipan to bloom.

  • Part of a 2023 "hat-trick" of awards for Tamdhu at the Spirit of Speyside Whisky Festival.

Food Pairing

The "sherry bomb" nature of this whisky allows it to pair beautifully with rich, fatty, and highly seasoned foods.

  • Savory: It is a perfect match for smoked brisket or duck confit, where the high ABV cuts through the fat and the sherry notes complement the savory meat.

  • Cheese: Pair it with creamy blue cheese (like Stilton or Roquefort) or an extra-aged Gouda. The saltiness of the cheese provides a stark, delightful contrast to the whisky's honey and vanilla profile.

  • Dessert: Its toffee and spice notes make it a natural companion for dark chocolate brownies, pecan pie, or Christmas pudding served with brandy butter.

  • Snacks: Try it with roasted walnuts or almonds to draw out the Spanish oak influence.

title: Bellwoods Bellweiser Pislner 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Bellweiser is the flagship Pilsner from Toronto’s Bellwoods Brewery. While Bellwoods built its reputation on boundary-pushing barrel-aged sours (like Jelly King) and massive IPAs, Bellweiser is their tribute to the "Old World." It is a Noble-hopped, German-style Pilsner that has become a favorite among brewers and purists for its exceptional clarity and technical "honesty." It is designed to be the ultimate palette cleanser—simple, sophisticated, and flawlessly executed.

Beer Description

This Pilsner pours a brilliant, translucent pale gold with a thick, moussy white head that leaves beautiful, intricate lacing on the glass.

Aroma: The nose is clean, elegant, and nostalgic. It leads with the scent of freshly baled hay and honeyed crackers, followed by a refined, floral, and slightly spicy hop bouquet characteristic of traditional European noble hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and remarkably "brisk." It leads with a delicate, grainy malt sweetness that provides a soft landing before the hops take over. The finish is famously dry and "snappy," with a clean, grassy bitterness that lingers just long enough to refresh the palate for the next sip.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 4.8% and a moderate bitterness that provides the signature "bite" of a true German Pilsner.

Technical Notes: Bellweiser is brewed using traditional European techniques, including a long, cold lagering period. It utilizes a base of high-quality Pilsner malt and is hopped exclusively with Noble hop varieties (typically Hallertau Mittelfrüh and Saaz). The water profile is meticulously adjusted to ensure the beer feels "soft" on the tongue but finishes with a crisp, mineral-like precision.

title: Freixenet Prosecco
bodyHtml:
This premium sparkling wine originates from the Prosecco DOC in the Veneto region of Northern Italy. While Freixenet is world-renowned for its Spanish Cava, the house expanded into Italy to apply its century-long expertise in sparkling wine to the Glera grape. The wine is instantly recognizable by its "diamond-cut" bottle, a bespoke design intended to reflect the light and elegance of the wine inside. Freixenet’s philosophy for this Prosecco is to provide a high-quality, "lifestyle" sparkling wine that balances fruit-forward accessibility with a sophisticated presentation.

Wine Description

Freixenet Prosecco presents a brilliant golden straw colour with a persistent, lively effervescence. The sensory profile is fresh and aromatic, opening with a bouquet of citrus, green apple, and white flowers (honeysuckle and jasmine). On the palate, the wine is light to medium-bodied and clean, showcasing juicy flavours of lemon, ripe pear, and golden apple. It is characterized by its soft, creamy mousse and a refreshing acidity that leads to a crisp, elegant finish. This 100% Glera sparkling wine is produced using the Charmat (Tank) Method, which preserves the primary fruit aromatics, and typically has an ABV of 11%. The wine is classified as Extra Dry, meaning it has a slight, pleasing hint of residual sugar that balances its natural tanginess.

title: Kilbeggan Black Irish Whiskey - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Kilbeggan Black is a permanent, premium addition to the core range of the historic Kilbeggan Distillery, Ireland's oldest continuously licensed distillery (founded in 1757). This expression is a departure from the traditional "smooth and light" Irish profile, as it incorporates a small amount of peated malt. While most Irish whiskeys are triple-distilled, Kilbeggan Black is traditionally double-distilled in ancient copper pot stills—one of which is over 180 years old. This method preserves more of the grain's natural oils and character, resulting in a blended whiskey that offers significantly more depth and a subtle, smoky complexity.

Spirit Description

The whiskey is matured in ex-bourbon casks and presents a pale gold color. On the nose, it leads with a comforting sweetness of ripe apples and pears, followed by creamy butterscotch and a delicate hint of peat smoke that adds savory depth. The palate is mellow and well-rounded, featuring notes of green fruits and cereal that gradually develop into a soft, earthy peat smoke. The finish is medium-to-long and lingering, characterized by a persistent wisp of smoke and gentle baking spices. It is bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

title: Speyburn Single Malt 10 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Speyburn Single Malt 10 Year Old is produced in Scotland, within the Speyside region at the northern end of Rothes. The distillery was founded in 1897 by John Hopkins, who famously rushed to produce the first cask of spirit in a violent snowstorm on New Year's Eve to commemorate Queen Victoria's Diamond Jubilee. Designed by the legendary architect Charles C. Doig, the distillery is noted for its iconic pagoda roof and its unique multi-level design carved into the hillside. It is currently the only distillery to draw its water from the Granty Burn, a major tributary of the River Spey.

Spirit Description

This flagship expression is matured for at least 10 years in a combination of hand-selected American oak ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks. It presents a pale gold colour with amber highlights. The nose is fresh, clean, and aromatic, featuring zesty lemon, orange peel, and red apple, accompanied by delicate hints of cinnamon and floral heather. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and smooth, offering a delicate fruity character with layers of sweet toffee, butterscotch, and fresh apple pie. The body is soft and well-balanced, leading to a long, sweet finish marked by citrus, creamy toffee, and a lingering touch of barley. Speyburn 10 Year Old is typically bottled at an ABV of 40%.

title: Vintae El Pacto Ojo Gallo 2022
bodyHtml:
This unique and soulful red wine originates from the Alto Najerilla subregion of Rioja, Spain. Crafted by Viñedos El Pacto (a Vintae project), this wine revives the nearly extinct "Ojo Gallo" (Rooster’s Eye) style—a traditional "claret" where red and white grapes are co-planted, harvested, and fermented together. The winery's philosophy is a tribute to the ancestral viticulture of Cárdenas and the high-altitude, iron-rich clay soils that provide a distinctive mineral character to these heritage "plot blends".

Wine Description

The El Pacto Ojo Gallo is described as a "red with a white soul," presenting a translucent cherry-red colour with a light, Pinot-like depth. The nose is aromatic and complex, offering notes of wild strawberry, raspberry, and pomegranate, woven with Mediterranean herbs like thyme and rose petal. On the palate, the wine is lean, refreshing, and vertical; it forgoes heavy structure for a silky, fluid texture and a vibrant acidic core. It is characterized by its "sapid" and cleansing nature, leading to a mineral finish with hints of pink grapefruit and white chocolate. This blend consists primarily of Garnacha Tinta and Viura (approx. 70/30), with trace amounts of Tempranillo, Malvasía, and Graciano. It has an ABV of 13% and was aged for 10 to 12 months in a combination of 5,000-litre oak foudres and concrete tanks.

title: Pietrame Montepulciano d'Abruzzo Limited Edition 2022
bodyHtml:
Pietrame Montepulciano d'Abruzzo Limited Edition 2022 originates from Italy, specifically from the Abruzzo region. This wine is produced by Cantina Tollo, one of the foremost cooperatives in Italy, representing over 1,000 growers and managing approximately 3,000 hectares of vineyards. The 'Pietrame' brand is inspired by the traditional old stone buildings ('pietra' meaning stone) that dot the landscape between the Adriatic Sea and the Apennine Mountains. The winemaking philosophy focuses on typical and native vines of the area, traditionally cultivated with pergolas to накопление aromatic substances.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a ruby red colour with brilliant violet reflections. The sensory profile features floral aromas of violets, wild cherries, and woodland berries, complemented by notes of spice, cocoa, and sweet sage. On the palate, it is round and cool-toned, offering flavours of fresh blackberry, plum sauce, and dark cherry, alongside subtle hints of citrus and chalk dust. The body is full and well-structured, showing both elegance and balance with gentle, integrated tannins and vibrant acidity. Composed of 100% estate Montepulciano grapes, the wine is harvested in early October and refined in stainless steel vats for up to twelve months to preserve its fresh, aromatic intensity. It possesses an ABV of 13% and is produced following organic and sustainable practices.

Food Pairing

The structured tannins and bright character of this Montepulciano make it an excellent match for grilled Italian sausages with peppers or meat-lover's pizza. It also pairs well with hearty dishes such as eggplant parmigiana, rich meaty lasagne, or baked pasta (pasta al forno). Additional suggested pairings include roasted or grilled meats and semi-mature cheeses.

title: Poligonos San Pablo Cabernet Franc 2020
bodyHtml:
This high-altitude red wine originates from the San Pablo IG in the Tunuyán subregion of the Uco Valley, Mendoza, Argentina. Produced by Zuccardi Valle de Uco, the "Polígonos" range is a tribute to the diversity of the valley's terroirs, with each "polygon" representing a specific village or subregion. The San Pablo vineyard is one of the most extreme in Mendoza, situated at an altitude of approximately 1,400 metres (4,593 ft) at the base of the Andes mountains, where the cold mountain climate and Andean breezes dictate the wine's character.

Wine Description

The Zuccardi Polígonos San Pablo Cabernet Franc displays a bright ruby-red colour with violet hues. The sensory profile is remarkably fresh and herbal, defined by the extreme mountain climate. The nose opens with a core of fresh red fruits, such as raspberries and cherries, layered with intense herbal notes of mint, jalapeño, and tea leaves, alongside subtle hints of tobacco. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "raw," showcasing vibrant acidity and fine, steely tannins that provide a chalky texture. It is characterized by its linear, sappy, and juicy nature, leading to a long, mineral-inflected finish. This 100% Cabernet Franc was fermented in concrete vats with native yeasts, then aged for 10 months in used French oak foudres or barrels to preserve its mountain identity.

title: Domaine de la Motte Chablis 2023
bodyHtml:
Domaine de la Motte Chablis 2023 is a classic white wine from the Chablis region of Burgundy, France. The estate is a 25 hectare, family-run winery that has been passed down from father to son since 1950. It is currently managed by Bernard Michaut, an ex-chef, and his son Adrien, who are dedicated to producing meticulous, mineral-driven wines that reflect the specific Kimmeridgian and Portlandian terroirs of the region.

Wine Description

This wine is a straw-yellow colour and is crafted from 100% Chardonnay grown on fossil-rich Kimmeridgian clay soils. The aromatic profile features restrained citrus and stone fruit notes layered over a signature chalky, mineral base. On the palate, the wine is clear, linear, and well-balanced, delivering fresh lemon flavours underpinned by a fine minerality and a hint of salinity. While mostly fermented in stainless steel to maintain purity, the 'Motte style' often includes a small addition (around 10%) of oak-aged wine to provide extra richness and depth. The wine undergoes malolactic fermentation and is matured on its lees before bottling, resulting in an ABV of 12.5%. The estate is HVE Level 3 certified, confirming its commitment to sustainable viticulture and biodiversity.

Food Pairing

The crisp acidity and mineral edge of this Chablis make it a versatile companion for various dishes. It pairs excellently with simply cooked white fish, seafood, or a fresh green salad. Its slight richness also allows it to complement chicken in a creamy sauce, Thai cuisine, and soft cheeses like Brie or Camembert.

title: Stroppiana Bricco Cogni Barolo 2019
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Stroppiana Bricco Cogni Barolo is a distinguished red wine from the Piedmont region of Northern Italy, specifically from the village of La Morra. The Stroppiana estate, based in the hamlet of Rivalta, was established in the 1960s by the current owner Dario's father and maternal grandfather. Today, the winery remains a family-run operation led by Dario and his wife Stefania, along with their children Leonardo and Altea, who represent the fourth generation of winemakers. Their philosophy centers on high-quality production across 5.5 hectares of vineyards, utilizing selective thinning to ensure optimal grape maturation.

Wine Description

This wine displays a classic garnet red colour that develops orange or brick-red highlights as it matures. The sensory profile features a broad and intense olfactory spectrum, with aromas of raspberry, cherry, and pomegranate layered with complex notes of liquorice, tobacco, and smoky earth. On the palate, the wine is rich, full, and deep, showcasing a consistent tannic structure and bright acidity typical of the Nebbiolo grape. It offers a harmonious balance between sweet, soft initial notes and a savoury, very long finish. This 100% Nebbiolo wine is aged for a minimum of 38 months, including at least 18 months in wooden barrels, and typically possesses an alcohol content ranging from 14.5% to 15.0% ABV. While the winery emphasizes traditional quality, the wine is not specifically labeled as organic.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and high tannins of Bricco Cogni make it an ideal companion for hearty meat dishes such as lamb, beefsteak, or wild boar. It pairs naturally with Piedmontese specialties, including brasato al Barolo (braised beef), mushroom or truffle-based risottos, and rich pasta dishes like agnolotti del Plin. Additionally, the wine’s acidity effectively cuts through the fat of strong, aged cheeses such as Parmigiano Reggiano, Castelmagno, or Gorgonzola.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 vintage is highly regarded as a 'classic' year for Barolo, characterized by a long growing season that produced grapes with excellent phenolic ripeness and fresh acidity.

title: Stroppiana Barolo Vigna San Giacomo 2019
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Stroppiana Barolo Vigna San Giacomo 2019 is a premium red wine from Italy, specifically from the San Giacomo vineyard in the Rivalta di La Morra region of Piedmont. The estate is a family-run operation now in its fourth generation, led by Dario and Stefania Stroppiana along with their children, Leonardo and Altea. Their winemaking philosophy is rooted in a deep knowledge of the local soil and climate, maintaining a tradition that began when the family estate was founded in the mid-20th century.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a ruby-red colour characterized by typical garnet highlights. The sensory profile is intense and refined, featuring an aromatic bouquet of forest floor, ripe blackberries, and dried tobacco leaves, intertwined with notes of leather, spice, and licorice. On the palate, it is dry, warm, and velvety, offering flavours of dark cherry, cranberry, and plum skin, complemented by toasted oak, mocha, and sage. The body is full and structured with firm, well-polished tannins that are described as resonant yet not overpowering, leading to a long, savoury, and enveloping finish. This 100% Nebbiolo was aged for 12 months in French oak tonneaux followed by another 12 months in larger 20-25 hectolitre French oak barrels, resulting in an ABV between 14% and 15%. While the winery follows sustainable practices, this specific bottling is not noted as organic.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and acidity of this Barolo make it an excellent partner for rich meat dishes such as lamb, beefsteak, or wild boar. It is traditionally paired with regional specialties like brasato al Barolo (braised beef), game meats, and dishes featuring truffles or wild mushrooms. Additionally, the wine’s firm tannins complement aged cheeses such as Castelmagno or Gorgonzola.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 vintage in Barolo is considered a classic year characterized by excellent balance, freshness, and long-term ageing potential. The growing season began with a cool, wet spring that slowed early vine growth, followed by a warm summer with specific spikes in temperature that promoted steady ripening. A long, sunny autumn with significant diurnal temperature shifts allowed winemakers to carefully time the harvest in mid-October, capturing grapes with high skin-to-pulp ratios and ideal phenolic maturity.

title: Santa Julia Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
This accessible yet refined red wine originates from the Uco Valley in the Mendoza region of Argentina. Produced by Bodega Santa Julia, the winery is a standard-bearer for the Zuccardi family’s commitment to sustainable and organic viticulture. The "Reserva" line focuses on fruit sourced from high-altitude vineyards, specifically in Vista Flores and Tupungato, to capture the racy acidity and structural elegance that define the Uco Valley’s unique mountain terroir.

Wine Description

The Santa Julia Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon displays an intense ruby-red color with bright purple highlights. The sensory profile is a classic expression of the varietal in a cool mountain climate, featuring a bouquet of black cherries, prunes, and blackberries intertwined with spicy notes of black pepper, paprika, and a touch of dried herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and well-structured, showcasing concentrated dark fruit flavors and sharp, "vertical" tannins. It is characterized by a vibrant acidity that provides great freshness, leading into a long, persistent finish with a hint of cedar and spice.

title: Cave de Saumur 'Les Pouches' Chenin Blanc
bodyHtml:
Saumur Les Pouches White is a refined expression of the Loire Valley in France, specifically originating from the 'Les Pouches' lieu-dit in the commune of Montreuil-Bellay. This wine is produced by the Cave de Saumur, a pioneering co-operative established in 1957 that represents 160 families dedicated to quality-focused viticulture. The vineyard site has historical significance dating back to the Middle Ages, with its limestone rocks having been quarried to build the nearby fortified castle of Montreuil-Bellay.

Wine Description

This 100% Chenin Blanc presents a pale gold colour often accented by green or silver highlights. The sensory profile is intense and expressive, featuring a 'suave' nose of white peach, William pear, and nectarine, complemented by floral notes of acacia-lime and a distinct flinty minerality. On the palate, the wine is bone-dry with a round attack and a lively, mouthwatering acidity that leads into citrus flavours of grapefruit and lemon. The wine typically has an alcohol content ranging from 11.5% to 13.5% ABV. While not universally certified organic, the co-operative practices sustainable viticulture, including planting flowers among the vines to reduce pesticide use and conserve biodiversity.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and mineral core of this Chenin Blanc make it an ideal accompaniment for fresh seafood, including oysters, grilled sardines, and seafood platters. It pairs elegantly with flakey white fish served in cream sauces, poached trout with beurre blanc, or roast duck with peaches. Additionally, it is a classic match for fresh goat's cheese (chèvre) and can stand up to the heat of spicy Asian dishes.

title: Cepa 21 Hito Rosado 2024
bodyHtml:
Cepa 21 Hito Rosado 2024 is a modern rosé from the Ribera del Duero region of Spain. It is a project by Bodegas Cepa 21, a winery founded by José Moro and his siblings (the third generation of the Emilio Moro family) with the aim of creating innovative wines that blend local tradition with a minimalist, forward-thinking approach. The name 'Hito' refers to the stone posts or milestones used to mark boundaries and directions, reflecting the wine's role in guiding the winery's contemporary vision for the Tempranillo variety.

Wine Description

This wine presents a very pale salmon-pink colour that is clean and bright. The sensory profile features a fresh and delicate bouquet dominated by aromas of red fruits, such as raspberries and cherries, enriched by floral notes and a subtle citrus touch. On the palate, it is light, expressive, and very fresh, showcasing balanced acidity and a zesty character that mirrors the nose. Made from 100% Tempranillo, the grapes undergo a brief maceration followed by fermentation at a controlled temperature of 14°C for approximately 20 days. The wine is aged on its lees to add texture before bottling, resulting in an ABV of 13.5%.

title: Annex Forward Progress Pale Ale - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Forward Progress is the multi-award-winning flagship Pale Ale from Calgary’s Annex Ale Project. In a craft beer landscape often dominated by extremes, this beer was designed to find the perfect middle ground. Offering the aromatic intensity of a modern IPA with the refined balance and lower alcohol content of a classic Pale Ale. It has become a staple of the Alberta beer scene, celebrated for its incredible consistency and its status as a "gold standard" for the style in Western Canada.

Beer Description

This Pale Ale pours a slightly hazy, glowing golden-orange color with a thick, resilient white head and excellent lacy retention.

Aroma: It features a bright and complex hop bouquet. Expect dominant notes of zesty grapefruit, juicy peach, and tropical passionfruit, underscored by a subtle hint of resinous pine and floral honey.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-light-bodied and remarkably balanced. It leads with a delicate, bready malt sweetness that provides a sturdy base for the vibrant hop flavors. The finish is crisp and clean, with a moderate, punchy bitterness that refreshes the palate without being overwhelming.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 5.2% and a moderate bitterness of 40 IBU, hitting the "sweet spot" for all-day drinkability and flavor impact.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a focus on late-addition and dry-hopping techniques to maximize aroma and flavor while keeping bitterness in check. It utilizes a blend of modern Northwest hops (typically including Citra and Mosaic) and high-quality Alberta malted barley to create a beer that is truly reflective of its regional roots.

title: Zuccardi Jose Malbec 2018
bodyHtml:
This prestigious red wine hails from the Uco Valley in Mendoza, Argentina, specifically sourced from high-altitude estate vineyards in Paraje Altamira and Gualtallary. Named in honor of José Zuccardi, who led the family winery for decades, this label represents a "transition" in the estate's history moving from a traditional style toward a more refined, terroir-focused approach. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes the unique "mountain identity" of the Uco Valley, utilizing concrete fermentation and large oak foudres rather than small new barriques to ensure the fruit and mineral character remain the stars.

Wine Description

The José Zuccardi Malbec presents an intense, deep violet colour. The sensory profile is elegant and multi-dimensional, offering a complex bouquet of black plums, blackberries, and blueberries, layered with fresh herbal notes and subtle hints of spice and wet stones. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and powerful yet remarkably poised, featuring a chalky, mineral texture characteristic of the region's limestone-rich soils. It is characterized by vibrant acidity and firm, silky tannins that lead into a long, persistent finish. The wine was aged in large oak foudres and concrete vats to maintain its purity.

title: Sheringham Stormwatcher Gin
bodyHtml:
Sheringham Stormwatcher Gin is a seasonal release produced in Canada, within the province of British Columbia on Vancouver Island. Founded in 2015 by husband and wife team Jason and Alayne MacIsaac, the distillery originally operated out of their garage in Shirley, BC, before moving to its current facility in Sooke. This specific expression is inspired by the dramatic Pacific Northwest winters and the rugged beauty of coastal storms.

Spirit Description

Stormwatcher Gin is a rich, "moody" gin distinguished by its natural coastal grey hue, designed to evoke the misty atmosphere of the Vancouver Island shoreline. While the distillery is famous for using local winged kelp in its flagship Seaside Gin, Stormwatcher focuses on a "warming" botanical profile suited for cooler months. It features grounding notes of the forest and sea, offering a bold depth that lingers with a subtle brine and aromatic warmth. The palate is characterized by resinous juniper and savoury herbs, providing a comforting yet uncompromisingly West Coast sensory experience. Sheringham Stormwatcher Gin is bottled at an ABV of 43%.

title: Emilio Moro Finca Resalso 2024
bodyHtml:
Emilio Moro Finca Resalso is a vibrant red wine from the Ribera del Duero region in Spain. The wine is named after a historic vineyard planted in 1932, the birth year of Emilio Moro, the father of the winery's third-generation owners. As the youngest and most refreshing expression of the estate's Tempranillo, it was first released in 1994 and became the first 'young' wine in the region to incorporate oak ageing into its production. The Moro family follows a philosophy of 'kindness through social awareness' and is noted for being the first winery globally to include Braille on its labels.

Wine Description

This wine presents an intense cherry-red colour with a violet rim, characteristic of its youth. The sensory profile is highly expressive and fruit-driven, featuring a bouquet of red and black fruits such as blackberries, blueberries, and redcurrants. These primary aromas are often accompanied by subtle lactic nuances, hints of vanilla, and a touch of minerality derived from its time in wood. On the palate, the wine is well-structured and balanced with smooth, round tannins and a juicy, tasty character. Composed of 100% Tempranillo (locally known as Tinto Fino) from vines aged between 5 and 15 years, it is typically aged for 4 months in French oak barrels. The wine generally has an alcohol content of 14% to 14.5% ABV. While the winery employs environmentally friendly and sustainable viticulture without artificial irrigation, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The fresh acidity and bold fruit profile of Finca Resalso make it a versatile companion for a wide range of dishes. It pairs excellently with traditional Spanish tapas, including Jamón Serrano, spicy chorizo, and Manchego or Mahon cheese. For main courses, suggested pairings include grilled lamb chops with rosemary, beef tenderloin, or hearty stews. It also complements comfort foods such as paella, tomato-based pasta, and vegetarian options like mushroom risotto or roasted red peppers.

title: Pietrame Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Terre di Chieti IGP of Abruzzo, Italy, this wine is a product of Cantina Tollo, a prominent cooperative rooted in the region's viticultural history. The Pietrame label is inspired by the ancient stone buildings, or 'pietra', that dot the landscape between the Adriatic Sea and the Apennine Mountains.

Wine Description

This Pinot Grigio presents a pale straw yellow colour and a vibrant sensory profile. The nose is greeted by expressive aromas of exotic fruits, green apple, and apricot, accented by delicate floral notes of honeysuckle. On the palate, the wine is fresh and well structured, displaying a crisp acidity that balances its full bodied nature.

title: Bombay Sapphire Sunset
bodyHtml:
Produced in England at the award-winning Laverstoke Mill distillery, Bombay Sapphire Sunset is a special edition gin inspired by the warm, orange glow of the setting sun. This expression is the second release in the brand's series of Special Editions, curated by Master of Botanicals Ivano Tonutti. The distillery’s philosophy for this release focuses on enhancing the classic Bombay Sapphire recipe with botanicals that capture the mellow heat and tranquility of the transition from day to night.

This aromatic gin is clear in colour and features a vibrant, layered sensory profile. The nose offers a big and soft bouquet of mandarin zest, fragrant citrus freshness, and warm sweet spices. On the palate, the gin is juniper-forward and medium-bodied with an oily mouthfeel, accompanied by the sweetness of Spanish mandarin and bright spice notes of Indian white cardamom. Stylistically, it is complex but beautifully balanced, featuring a long finish led by aromatic cardamom and followed by the dusty floral notes of golden turmeric. It is crafted using the ten signature Bombay Sapphire botanicals plus three additional ingredients: sun-dried Murcian mandarin peel, turmeric, and white cardamom.

title: Domaine Rolet Cremant du Jura Rose
bodyHtml:
Domaine Rolet Crémant du Jura Rosé is a sparkling wine from France, specifically from the Jura region. Founded in 1942 by Désiré Rolet, the estate rose to prominence under the leadership of his four children before being acquired in 2018 by the Devillard, Flambert, and Dupuis families. As one of the largest independent producers in the Jura, the domaine manages 65 hectares of vineyards across all four local appellations, emphasizing a winemaking philosophy that maintains a traditional Jurassian style through meticulous vineyard work and minimal intervention. Comprised of 60% Poulsard, 20% Trousseau. 10% PInot Noir and 10% Chardonnay.

Wine Description

This rosé displays a beautiful creamy pink or orange hue with brilliant copper reflections. The sensory profile features a delicate floral nose with notes of honeysuckle, morello cherry, strawberry, and raspberry, accented by toast and vanilla.
