On the palate, the wine offers a creamy effervescence and lively acidity, delivering flavours of red currant, apple, and pomegranate that mirror the aromatic profile. The body is harmonious and fresh, leading to a long, snappy, and slightly salty finish. Typically a blend of Pinot Noir, Poulsard, and Trousseau, the wine is produced using the traditional method with at least 24 months of ageing on the lees and has an alcohol content of 12% ABV. The estate is currently in transition to full organic certification, with current practices described as sustainable and avoiding the use of herbicides or pesticides.

title: Blindman Lightshadows - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Lightshadows is the "little sibling" to the legendary Longshadows IPA from Lacombe’s Blindman Brewing. It was born out of a desire to capture the intense, modern hop profile of a heavy-hitting IPA but in a "Small IPA" (or Session IPA) format. It is designed specifically for those who want the aromatic complexity of a craft flagship without the high alcohol content, making it one of the most flavor-dense "light" beers in Alberta.

Beer Description

This Small IPA pours a hazy, pale lemon-gold with a surprisingly thick, frothy white head for its lower gravity.

Aroma: Despite its low ABV, the nose is punchy and vibrant. It leads with a bright burst of lemon-lime zest and white grapefruit, followed by softer notes of ripe pineapple and a subtle piney dankness. It smells significantly "bigger" than it actually is.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied but avoids feeling thin or watery. It leads with a very lean, crackery malt base that serves as a clean canvas for the hops. The flavor profile is dominated by citrus pith and tropical fruit, finishing with a crisp, snappy bitterness that is assertive but balanced.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 4.5% and a moderate bitterness. It is engineered for maximum "crushability" while maintaining a sophisticated hop presence.

Technical Notes: Blindman achieves the body of this beer through a clever use of flaked oats and wheat, which provides a silky mouthfeel and helps the beer retain its signature haze. It is heavily dry-hopped with the same premium varieties found in its bigger siblings (often Citra, Mosaic, or Simcoe), ensuring that the "shadow" of the hops remains long even in a lighter frame.

title: Blindman Five of Diamonds Pilsner - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Five of Diamonds is the quintessential flagship Pilsner from Lacombe’s Blindman Brewing, a brewery celebrated for its technical precision and deep commitment to Alberta agriculture. This beer is a "Pre-Prohibition Style" Pilsner, a nod to the robust, flavorful lagers brewed in North America before the industry shifted toward lighter, mass-produced styles. It is widely considered a "blue-collar" craft masterpiece—sophisticated enough for a tasting room but approachable enough for a backyard barbecue.

Beer Description

This Pilsner pours a brilliant, crystal-clear deep gold with a thick, frothy white head and a steady stream of fine carbonation.

Aroma: It features a clean and punchy nose led by the bready, honey-like scent of premium Alberta malt. This is perfectly balanced by a distinct floral and spicy hop bouquet, characteristic of traditional German noble hops, with a faint hint of lemon zest.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-light-bodied and incredibly crisp. It leads with a rich, grainy malt sweetness, reminiscent of fresh-baked crackers, that is immediately countered by a firm, snappy bitterness. The finish is remarkably dry and clean, leaving a lingering herbal hop note that refreshes the palate.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 4.8% and a moderate bitterness of 35 IBU, offering significantly more structure and "bite" than a standard commercial lager.

Technical Notes: This beer is a true showcase of regional ingredients. It is brewed with 100% Alberta-grown and malted barley, highlighting the world-class quality of local grain. It undergoes a long, cold lagering process to achieve its signature clarity and "snappiness." It is hopped with Loral and Saphir hops, which provide a modern, aromatic twist on classic European hop profiles.

title: The Macallan 18 Year Old Sherry Cask
bodyHtml:
The Macallan 18 Year Old Sherry Cask originates from the Speyside region of Scotland, crafted at the historic Macallan Estate. Established in 1824 by Alexander Reid, the distillery is currently owned by the Edrington Group, which maintains a commitment to traditional methods such as using curiously small stills and a meticulous wood programme.

Whisky Description

This iconic single malt presents a light mahogany natural colour, a result of nearly two decades of maturation in hand-picked, Oloroso sherry-seasoned European oak casks. The nose is rich and complex, offering a bouquet of dried fruits, ginger, and dates, layered with hints of vanilla, cinnamon, and orange zest. On the palate, the whisky is full-bodied and soft, unveiling dark chocolate-coated ginger, sultanas, and toasted mature oak that provide a velvety mouthfeel. The finish is long and elegant, sustained by lingering dried fruit, warm oak spice, and a refined interplay between sweetness and gentle wood tannins.

Food Pairing

The Macallan 18 Year Old Sherry Cask pairs exceptionally well with rich, indulgent flavours such as salted caramel dark chocolate or a classic chocolate ganache tart. For a savoury match, the whisky's dried fruit and oak notes beautifully balance the intensity of a mature blue cheese or a rosemary-infused leg of lamb.

title: Gnarled Vine Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
This robust red wine originates from the Lodi AVA in California's Central Valley. Gnarled Vine is a label produced by Oak Ridge Winery, the oldest operating winery in Lodi, which has been owned by the Maggio and Reynolds families for five generations. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes the unique characteristics of Lodi’s "gnarled" old vines, which produce lower yields of highly concentrated fruit. The estate is committed to environmental stewardship, with its vineyards being Certified Green under the Lodi Rules for Sustainable Winegrowing.

Wine Description

The Gnarled Vine Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold, fruit-forward wine with a deep ruby red colour. The sensory profile is dominated by intense aromas of blackberry jam, plum, and cassis, complemented by nuanced notes of vanilla, cedar, and mocha chocolate derived from oak aging. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and voluptuous, offering a rich core of dark berry fruit balanced by a firm acidic backbone and supple, well-integrated tannins.

title: White Claw Variety Pack #1 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml: White Claw is made from a blend of seltzer water, a gluten-free spirit base and a hint of natural fruit flavour. Each 355ml can contains just 100 calories and 1g of carbs. This 12-pack includes flavours of Natural Lime, Mango, Ruby Grapefruit and Black Cherry.

title: Yellow Dog Play Dead IPA - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Play Dead IPA is the multi-award-winning flagship from Port Moody’s Yellow Dog Brewing Co. As a pioneer of the "Brewers Row" scene in British Columbia, Yellow Dog crafted this beer to be an quintessential West Coast IPA. It is designed to showcase a big, aggressive hop profile while maintaining a level of balance and "crushability" that keeps it approachable. It has gained a massive following for its consistency and its ability to deliver classic Pacific Northwest flavors without being overly abrasive.

Beer Description

This West Coast IPA pours a clear, vibrant copper-gold with a resilient, frothy white head and excellent lacy retention on the glass.

Aroma: It features a bold and pungent nose that is classic to the style. Expect a heavy hit of resinous pine and dank herbs, followed closely by bright citrus notes of grapefruit zest and orange peel.

Palate: The flavor is assertive and hop-forward. It leads with a brief, subtle caramel malt sweetness that quickly gives way to intense flavors of pine and citrus. The mouthfeel is medium-bodied with a crisp carbonation, finishing with a firm, lingering bitterness that is clean and dry.

Profile: It has a robust ABV of 6.8% and a high bitterness of 65 IBU, staying true to its roots as a bold, "big" IPA.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a focus on classic Pacific Northwest hop varieties. The malt bill is carefully structured to provide enough backbone to support the high IBU count without becoming syrupy, ensuring the hop oils remain the focal point from the first scent to the final swallow.

title: 33 Acres Brewing Ocean Pale Ale - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Ocean is the flagship "West Coast" Pale Ale from Vancouver’s 33 Acres Brewing Company. Known for their minimalist aesthetic and high-quality standards, the brewery crafted this beer to be as clean and refreshing as the Pacific shoreline. It is designed to bridge the gap between a traditional English Pale Ale and a modern West Coast IPA offering a distinct hop presence and a refined, dry finish that has made it a staple in the British Columbia craft scene.

Beer Description

This Pale Ale pours a bright, crystal-clear golden hue with a dense, persistent white head and moderate carbonation.

Aroma: It features a crisp and inviting nose. Expect prominent notes of floral grapefruit and forest pine, supported by a subtle, honey-like malt sweetness and a hint of herbal spice.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied and exceptionally balanced. It leads with a delicate, toasted biscuit malt flavor that is quickly followed by a wave of citrusy hop character. The finish is notably dry and clean, with a refined bitterness that refreshes the palate.

Profile: It has a sessionable ABV of 5.3% and a moderate bitterness of 40 IBU, making it a highly versatile beer that pairs well with a variety of foods or stands perfectly on its own.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a blend of premium base malts and a selection of classic Pacific Northwest hops. The brewing process emphasizes a clean fermentation and a precise hop schedule to ensure the floral and citrus aromatics are bright and forward without being cloying or overly aggressive.

title: 33 Acres Brewing Sunshine - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
33 Acres of Sunshine is the flagship French Blancher (Witbier) from Vancouver’s 33 Acres Brewing Company. Designed with the brewery’s signature minimalist and clean aesthetic, this beer is a modern take on the traditional Belgian white ale. It is crafted to be the ultimate "summer in a glass" light, ethereal, and incredibly refreshing. It has become a staple for those seeking a sophisticated, fruit-forward wheat beer that prioritizes delicate spice and high drinkability over heavy sweetness.

Beer Description

This French Blancher pours a hazy, pale straw color with a thick, frothy white head and a lively, effervescent carbonation.

Aroma: It features a bright and aromatic nose led by distinct scents of sweet orange peel and crushed coriander. These spicy notes are balanced by a soft, bready wheat aroma and a faint hint of floral honey.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and silky. It offers a gentle, pillowy malt sweetness followed by a refreshing tang of citrus and a subtle peppery spice from the yeast and coriander. It finishes incredibly clean and dry, with almost no perceptible bitterness.

Profile: It has a sessionable ABV of 5.0% and a very low bitterness of 14 IBU, making it an exceptionally accessible beer for a wide range of palates.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a high proportion of malted wheat and un-malted oats to achieve its signature hazy appearance and smooth mouthfeel. It is infused with orange peel and coriander during the boil and fermented with a specific Belgian yeast strain to produce its characteristic fruity and spicy esters.

title: 33 Acres Brewing Life Cali Common - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
33 Acres of Life is the cornerstone "California Common" (or Steam Beer) from Vancouver’s 33 Acres Brewing Company. This style is a unique piece of North American brewing history, originating in 19th-century California when brewers used lager yeast at warmer ale temperatures. 33 Acres has refined this rustic tradition into a sophisticated, hybrid brew that offers the rich, toasty complexity of an ale with the clean, crisp finish of a lager. It is widely regarded as one of the most balanced and food-friendly beers in their lineup.

Beer Description

This California Common pours a clear, beautiful deep amber-to-copper color with a thick, off-white creamy head and fine carbonation.

Aroma: It features a warm and inviting nose led by toasted malts and sweet caramel. These scents are balanced by the distinct woody and minty aromatics of Northern Brewer hops, with a subtle hint of stone fruit from the warm fermentation.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied and exceptionally smooth. It leads with a rich, biscuit-like malt sweetness and notes of toffee, which are quickly countered by a firm, earthy bitterness. The finish is remarkably clean and dry, characteristic of its lager yeast heritage.

Profile: It has a very sessionable ABV of 4.8% and a moderate bitterness of 35 IBU, providing a sturdy flavor profile that remains refreshingly light on its feet.

Technical Notes: Brewed using a specific strain of lager yeast fermented at higher temperatures to produce unique esters not found in traditional lagers. It relies heavily on Northern Brewer hops for its signature "woody" bitterness and a precise blend of crystal malts for its deep amber hue and toasted sugar notes.

title: 33 Acres Brewing Nirvana IPA - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
33 Acres of Nirvana is the quintessential West Coast IPA from Vancouver’s 33 Acres Brewing Company. While many modern IPAs have trended toward extreme haze or tropical sweetness, Nirvana remains a steadfast tribute to the classic, balanced, and punchy IPAs that defined the craft movement. It is designed to be a "high-alpha" experience that remains incredibly clean, allowing the quality of the hops to resonate without being weighed down by heavy malts.

Beer Description

This West Coast IPA pours a luminous, clear golden-amber with a rocky, long-lasting white head and active carbonation.

Aroma: It features a sharp and intoxicating hop bouquet. Expect dominant notes of resinous pine needles and zesty grapefruit peel, rounded out by subtler hints of dried apricot and floral honey.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a crisp, assertive presence. It leads with a lean, crackery malt sweetness that quickly gives way to a massive wave of hop flavor—ranging from citrus pith to dank forest floor. It finishes with a firm, cleansing bitterness that lingers pleasantly.

Profile: It has a robust ABV of 7.0% and a high bitterness of approximately 70 IBU, making it the "big brother" in the 33 Acres core lineup.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a focused selection of Pacific Northwest hops and a clean-fermenting ale yeast. The malt bill is kept purposefully simple to provide just enough structure to support the high hop load, ensuring the beer remains dry and "bright" rather than syrupy or overly sweet.

title: Annex Band Wagon Lager - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Band Wagon is the quintessential "crushable" lager from Calgary’s Annex Ale Project. Known for their experimental and hop-forward ales, Annex created Band Wagon as a deliberate nod to the resurgence of high-quality, simple lagers. It is marketed as their lightest and crispest offering a "no-nonsense" beer designed for universal appeal. Since its release, it has quickly become a taproom favorite and a multi-year Judges Selection at the Alberta Beverage Awards.

Beer Description

This American-style light lager pours a brilliant, clear pale straw color with a bright white head and high effervescence.

Aroma: The nose is clean and minimalist. It features subtle notes of fresh-baked white bread and a delicate, crackery malt sweetness, complemented by a very faint herbal floral touch from the hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is exceptionally light-bodied and crisp. It delivers a gentle grainy sweetness that is immediately followed by a snappy, dry finish. The carbonation is lively, providing a refreshing "scrubbing" effect on the palate that makes it incredibly easy to drink.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 4.3% and a very low bitterness, prioritizing smoothness and maximum refreshment over complex hop or malt intensity.

Technical Notes: Brewed with premium Alberta malted barley and wheat to provide its signature light body and "crackery" foundation. It is lightly hopped with Willamette Valley hops and brewed with pure mountain water, then cold-conditioned to achieve its ultra-clean, "simple yet sophisticated" profile.

title: Annex Force Majeure NEIPA - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Force Majeure is the flagship New England IPA (NEIPA) from Calgary’s Annex Ale Project. In a brewery known for its scientific precision and bold experimentation, this beer represents the "unstoppable force" of modern hop-forward brewing. It is designed to be the antithesis of the bitter, clear West Coast IPA, focusing instead on a silky mouthfeel, opaque haze, and an explosive, juice-like aromatic profile. It has become one of the most recognizable and respected hazy IPAs in the Alberta craft market.

Beer Description

This NEIPA pours a thick, opaque straw-yellow resembling pineapple juice with a soft, persistent white head and moderate carbonation.

Aroma: It features a massive, "dank" tropical bouquet. Expect intense aromas of overripe mango, passionfruit, and candied citrus peel, underpinned by a distinct resinous hop character that keeps the fruitiness from feeling one-dimensional.

Palate: On the tongue, it is full-bodied with a soft, pillowy mouthfeel. It delivers a lush wave of tropical fruit flavors; pineapple and stone fruit predominate with a creamy sweetness from the grain bill. The finish is remarkably smooth, with a low, rounded bitterness that allows the hop oils to coat the palate.

Profile: It has a robust ABV of 6.9% and a low-to-moderate perceived bitterness, hiding its strength behind its soft texture and intense fruitiness.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a heavy proportion of flaked oats and wheat to create its signature protein-rich haze and velvety body. It is aggressively double dry-hopped (DDH) with high-alpha varieties like Citra and Mosaic, utilizing a fermentation-stage hop addition to encourage "biotransformation," which unlocks deep, juice-like aromatic compounds.

title: Bellwoods Roman Candle IPA - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Roman Candle is the flagship IPA from Toronto’s Bellwoods Brewery, a pioneer in the Canadian craft beer scene. Originally brewed as one of their very first recipes at their modest brewpub on Ossington Avenue, it has grown into a benchmark for the style. It is designed to be a "dry-hopped harmony," focusing on a massive aromatic impact and a clean, refreshing profile rather than overwhelming bitterness. It remains a definitive example of how a modern IPA can be both bold and elegantly balanced.

Beer Description

This IPA pours a slightly hazy, glowing golden-straw color with a pillowy, resilient white head.

Aroma: The nose is a vibrant explosion of tropical and citrus fruit. Dominant notes of bright grapefruit and juicy pineapple are complemented by subtle floral undertones and a hint of resinous pine.

Palate: On the tongue, it is remarkably crisp and dry. It offers a lean, crackery malt base that allows the hop flavors of tangerine zest and tropical fruit to take center stage. The finish is clean with a firm, refined bitterness that invites another sip.

Profile: It has an ABV of 6.8% and a moderate-to-high bitterness, providing a punchy West Coast soul with the softer, aromatic sensibilities of modern brewing.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a simple, high-quality malt bill to ensure a dry finish. It is aggressively dry-hopped with a blend of classic and modern hops to maximize aromatic complexity without adding astringency.

title: Red Truck Amber Ale - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Red Truck Amber Ale is the flagship "workhorse" brew from Vancouver’s Red Truck Beer Company. Built on a philosophy of honesty and classic styling, this beer is inspired by the vintage trucks that symbolize the brewery’s brand—reliable, timeless, and built to last. It is designed as a quintessential Northwest Amber Ale, striking a deliberate balance between a rich, toasty malt profile and a crisp, refreshing hop finish.

Beer Description

This Amber Ale pours a clear, deep copper-to-amber hue with a persistent, off-white frothy head and fine carbonation.

Aroma: It features an inviting nose of toasted malts and sweet caramel. These scents are balanced by a subtle, classic hop profile that brings notes of earthy pine and a touch of floral citrus.

Palate: The flavor is medium-bodied and well-rounded. It leads with a distinct biscuit-like maltiness and a hint of toffee, which is smoothly balanced by a clean hop bitterness. The mouthfeel is smooth, leading to a crisp, dry finish that avoids being cloying.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.2% and a moderate bitterness of 25 IBU, making it a highly versatile and food-friendly beer that appeals to a wide range of palates.

Technical Notes: Brewed using a blend of premium specialty malts (including Crystal and Munich) to achieve its signature color and caramel depth. It is hopped with traditional Pacific Northwest varieties to provide a structured bitterness that cuts through the malt sweetness.

title: Cabin Super Saturation Hazy Pale Ale 355 ml - 6 Cans
bodyHtml:
Super Saturation is the definitive flagship from Calgary’s Cabin Brewing Company and a heavy-hitter in the Western Canadian craft scene. As a "New England Pale Ale," it is designed to push the boundaries of how much hop flavor and aroma can be packed into a moderate-alcohol beer. It has become a benchmark for the "hazy" movement in Alberta, known for its incredible consistency, lush texture, and the intense tropical aromatics that give it its name.

Beer Description

This NEPA pours a dense, opaque glowing orange, often compared to a glass of fresh-squeezed juice, with a thick, pillowy white head.

Aroma: It features an "over-saturated" nose of tropical fruit. Expect a massive bouquet of ripe mango, juicy pineapple, and zesty tangerine, with a faint, pleasant "dank" herbal undertone that balances the sweetness.

Palate: On the tongue, it is remarkably soft and full-bodied. It leads with a velvety, creamy mouthfeel that carries flavors of stone fruit and citrus pith. Unlike traditional Pale Ales, the bitterness is kept very low and rounded, allowing the "juicy" hop character to dominate from start to finish.

Profile: It has a highly drinkable ABV of 6.0% and a low perceived bitterness, making it feel much more like a treat than a standard bitter ale.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a heavy helping of flaked oats and wheat to create its signature "chewy" texture and persistent haze. It utilizes a massive double dry-hop (DDH) schedule with premium Citra and Simcoe hops, focusing on late-stage additions to maximize essential oils while minimizing harsh bitterness.

title: Bruichladdich Micro-Provenance Single Cask #1188
bodyHtml:
Produced on the Rhinns of the Isle of Islay, Scotland, Bruichladdich Micro-Provenance Single Cask #1188 is an unpeated single malt that exemplifies the distillery’s commitment to barley and barrel transparency. Originally established in 1881, Bruichladdich was famously resurrected in 2001 and is currently owned by Rémy Cointreau.

Whisky Description

This 13-year-old expression, distilled in 2010 from unpeated Optic barley, presents a bright straw hue in the glass. The nose offers a vibrant bouquet of citrus zest, green orchard fruits, and a touch of vanilla, balanced by light floral notes. On the palate, it is creamy and medium-bodied, featuring layers of lemon, green apple, and toasted oak spice that transition into a delicate, airy sweetness. The finish is medium-long and clean, characterized by a lingering fruit sweetness and a subtle, signature maritime saltiness.

title: Annex Lorem Ipsum Amber Ale 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Lorem Ipsum is an award-winning staple of the core lineup at Calgary’s Annex Ale Project. While its name refers to the classic "filler text" used in design, the beer itself is anything but an afterthought. It was crafted to prove that an Amber Ale can be both complex and refreshing, successfully bridging the gap between old-school malt traditions and modern hop profiles. Its technical excellence has been recognized with significant accolades, including Gold at the 2024 Canadian Brewing Awards for North American Style Amber/Dark Lager.

Beer Description

This Amber Ale pours a deep, radiant copper-to-ruby red with a frothy, off-white head and excellent clarity.

Aroma: It features a sophisticated balance between sweet and sharp. The nose is led by toasted bread and rich caramel malts, which are brightened by a distinct citrusy pop and a hint of pine from the use of Citra hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is surprisingly light and crisp for its color. It leads with flavors of biscuit, toffee, and caramelized sugar, which are quickly cut by a refreshing wave of grapefruit and tropical fruit. It avoids the heavy, cloying sweetness often associated with ambers, finishing clean and dry.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.5% and a moderate bitterness that provides structure without overwhelming the delicate malt notes.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a blend of light and dark malts alongside roasted barley to achieve its deep, characteristic hue and toasted flavor profile. The inclusion of Citra, a hop typically reserved for IPAs, provides a modern, aromatic "lift" that makes this beer remarkably sessionable and unique within its style category.

title: Annex Band Wagon Lager 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Band Wagon is the quintessential "crushable" lager from Calgary’s Annex Ale Project. Known for their experimental and hop-forward ales, Annex created Band Wagon as a deliberate nod to the resurgence of high-quality, simple lagers. It is marketed as their lightest and crispest offering a "no-nonsense" beer designed for universal appeal. Since its release, it has quickly become a taproom favorite and a multi-year winner at the Alberta Beverage Awards.

Beer Description

This American-style light lager pours a brilliant, clear pale straw color with a bright white head and high effervescence.

Aroma: The nose is clean and minimalist. It features subtle notes of fresh-baked white bread and a delicate, crackery malt sweetness, complemented by a very faint herbal floral touch from the hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is exceptionally light-bodied and crisp. It delivers a gentle grainy sweetness that is immediately followed by a snappy, dry finish. The carbonation is lively, providing a refreshing "scrubbing" effect on the palate that makes it incredibly easy to drink.

Profile: ABV of 4.3% and a very low bitterness, prioritizing smoothness and maximum refreshment over complex hop or malt intensity.

Technical Notes: Brewed with premium Alberta malted barley and wheat to provide its signature light body and "crackery" foundation. It is lightly hopped with Willamette Valley hops and brewed with pure mountain water, then cold-conditioned to achieve its ultra-clean, "simple yet sophisticated" profile.

title: Belizean Blue Rare Blend Rum
bodyHtml:
Belizean Blue Rare Blend is a premium, high-proof expression produced by Travellers Liquors Ltd., a storied family-owned distillery in Belize. While the brand’s "Signature Blend" is known for its accessibility, the Rare Blend is a more sophisticated, "connoisseur-grade" release. It is a compilation of different rum varieties that have been aged for an average of 9 years, though the blend notably includes rare components that have matured for up to 17 years in Belize’s tropical climate. As with all Travellers products, it is crafted from locally grown, fairly produced sugarcane molasses and contains no added sugar or artificial colorants.

Spirit Description

The rum presents a deep, dark amber color and is bottled at a robust 48% ABV, providing a more intense and structured experience than standard Caribbean blends.

  • Nose: Highly aromatic and inviting. It leads with classic notes of vanilla and toffee, followed by a tropical medley of pineapple and papaya, with warm accents of nutmeg, cinnamon, and toasted coconut in the background.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and velvety. The entry is sweet and oily, delivering rich flavors of caramelized sugar and honey that transition into spicy oak, dried fruits, and a buttery coconut mid-palate.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long and warming. The 48% proof carries a persistent spice, leaving a final impression of vanilla bean and charred wood.

title: Tofino Blonde Ale 473 ml - 24 Cans
vendor: 300772 - Copper And Theory Artisan Beer Supply
bodyHtml:
Tofino Blonde Ale is the quintessential coastal "lawnmower beer" from Tofino Brewing Co. on the rugged west coast of Vancouver Island. Designed to be as breezy and approachable as a day at Chesterman Beach, this beer is a cornerstone of their lineup. It is crafted specifically for high drinkability, serving as a clean, reliable refresher for surfers, hikers, and locals alike. It avoids the complexity of heavy hops or malts, focusing instead on a crisp, straightforward profile.

Beer Description

This blonde ale pours a luminous, crystal-clear straw-gold with a light, frothy white head and active carbonation.

Aroma: It features a very subtle and clean nose. Expect mild scents of sweet malt and crackers, with a faint, breezy floral note from the light addition of hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and exceptionally refreshing. It delivers a soft, bready malt sweetness that is quickly followed by a clean, snappy finish. The bitterness is minimal, serving only to balance the grain character without lingering on the palate.

Profile: ABV of 5.5% and a very low bitterness, making it an ideal choice for those who prefer a beer that is easygoing and crisp.

Technical Notes: Brewed with premium malted barley and a touch of wheat to provide a smooth mouthfeel despite its light body. It is fermented with a clean-profile ale yeast and lightly hopped with traditional varieties to ensure a consistent, "barefoot" simplicity that defines the style.

title: Stroppiana Langhe Nebbiolo 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Stroppiana Langhe Nebbiolo is an elegant red wine from the Piedmont region of Northern Italy. Produced by the Stroppiana family in the village of La Morra, this wine is often considered a 'junior' version of their Barolo, offering a more immediate and accessible expression of the Nebbiolo grape. The winery, currently managed by Dario and Stefania Stroppiana along with their children, focuses on maintaining traditional viticultural practices across their small, family-owned estate.

Wine Description

This wine displays a bright ruby red colour that tends toward garnet as it ages. The sensory profile is marked by a delicate and fruity bouquet, featuring prominent aromas of violet, raspberry, and red currant, often accented by a hint of rose petal. On the palate, it is dry and harmonious with a velvety texture, showcasing flavours of fresh red berries, dark cherry, and a touch of white pepper. While it possesses the characteristic Nebbiolo acidity and tannin, they are more supple and approachable than those found in long-aged Barolo. Typically aged for approximately 6 to 8 months in stainless steel or used oak to preserve its freshness, the wine generally has an ABV of 14%. The wine is produced following sustainable farming principles, though it does not carry an official organic certification.

Food Pairing

Langhe Nebbiolo is a highly versatile food wine that pairs beautifully with tajarin pasta tossed in butter and sage or a simple tomato-based ragu. It is an excellent match for feathered game, roasted poultry, and veal dishes. Due to its balanced tannins, it also complements medium-aged cheeses such as Toma Piemontese or Fontina, as well as classic antipasti featuring cured meats.

title: Cerejeiras Lisboa Red 2023
bodyHtml:
Cerejeiras Lisboa Red is a traditional red wine from the Lisboa region of Portugal, produced by Companhia Agrícola do Sanguinhal. The winery was established in 1926 by Abel Pereira da Fonseca, an innovator who sought to combine traditional family winemaking with forward-thinking advances. Today, the family manages three historic estates, including Quinta das Cerejeiras, where this wine is crafted to express the distinct freshness of its Atlantic-influenced terroir.

Wine Description

This wine typically displays a lively ruby or garnet red colour. The sensory profile is marked by a youthful nose of freshly crushed berries, ripe cherries, and plums, often accompanied by subtle spicy hints or floral notes. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and well-structured, featuring ripe fruit flavours of blueberry and raspberry alongside supple tannins and a smooth, juicy character. The finish is soft and fruity, highlighting the wine's approachable nature. The varietal composition is a blend of traditional Portuguese grapes, typically including Castelão (60%), Aragonez (30%), and Touriga Nacional (10%). It generally possesses an alcohol content of 13% ABV and is aged for 6 to 8 months in stainless steel vats before bottling. While the producer has committed to sustainability since 2020, this specific bottling is not labeled as organic.

Food Pairing

The fresh acidity and fruit-forward profile of Cerejeiras Lisboa Red make it a versatile partner for various cuisines. It pairs exceptionally well with red meats, game, and hearty pasta dishes. Local Portuguese pairings might include grilled octopus or salt cod (Bacalhau) cooked in red wine. Additionally, it complements a variety of cheeses and casual fare such as pizza or charcuterie.

title: Kavalan King Car Group 45th Anniversary Palo Cortado Sherry Cask - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Kavalan King Car 45th Anniversary Palo Cortado is produced in Taiwan, within the Yilan County region. Released in late 2024, this limited-edition single malt commemorates the 45th anniversary of Kavalan’s parent company, the King Car Group, founded in 1979. The whisky is aged in rare Palo Cortado sherry casks sourced from Spain's "Sherry Triangle" a style of sherry that accounts for less than 1% of global production and is prized for combining the aromatic finesse of Amontillado with the robust body of Oloroso.

Spirit Description

This high-strength expression is matured in Taiwan’s subtropical climate, which accelerates the interaction between the spirit and the rare wood. It presents a deep caramel mahogany colour and is bottled non-chill filtered with no added colour. The nose is rich and intricate, bursting with cocoa powder, zesty citrus peel, and sweet dried fruits, followed by notes of toffee, pastries, and cardamom. On the palate, it is full-bodied and velvety, offering layers of orange pound cake, vanilla fruitcake, and roasted nuts. The experience is punctuated by hints of toasted biscuit and raisins, leading to a long, polished finish characterized by caramel toffee and crushed walnuts. It is bottled at a powerful 54% ABV and typically presented in a 1.5L cello-shaped decanter topped with a Swarovski crystal.

title: Barone di Valforte Abruzzo Pecorino 2024
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Barone di Valforte Abruzzo Pecorino 2024 is a classic white wine from the Abruzzo region of central-eastern Italy. The estate is owned by the Sorricchio family, who have held the baronial fiefdom of Valforte since the 14th century, spanning nine consecutive generations. Today, the winery is managed by brothers Francesco and Guido along with Guido's daughter, Annamaria Sorricchio. Their philosophy combines centuries of tradition with technological innovation, such as a new generation photovoltaic system, to maintain sustainable vineyard management while respecting the environment.

Wine Description

This wine is a straw-yellow colour and offers an aromatic profile featuring wild honey, citrus, and floral notes like broom and white flowers. On the palate, it is fresh yet strongly structured, delivering flavours of Asian pear, honeysuckle, and apricot backed by a pleasant minerality. The body is medium to full with lively acidity and a fruity finish. Composed of 100% Pecorino, the wine is vinified in stainless steel vats with cold stabilization to preserve its fresh character. The 2024 vintage typically possesses an alcohol content of 13% to 13.5% ABV.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and structured palate of this Pecorino make it an excellent partner for raw seafood, sushi, and various fish dishes. It pairs well with light sauces, pasta e olio, and seafood salads. For a more regional match, it is traditionally served with aged pecorino cheese or local Abruzzese dishes like fried stuffed olives (Olive all'Ascolana).

title: Superflux Happyness IPA 473 ml - 24 Cans
vendor: 300772 - Copper And Theory Artisan Beer Supply
bodyHtml:
Happyness is a core classic from Vancouver’s Superflux Beer Company, a brewery that has earned a near-mythical status for its mastery of the IPA. While many modern hazy IPAs lean entirely into "juice" territory, Happyness is designed as a bridge, it offers the lush, aromatic profile of a New England IPA but retains a focused, clean structure and a refined bitterness. It’s a beer that prioritized "happiness" through hop saturation and high-quality ingredients long before the hazy craze took over the West Coast.

Beer Description

This IPA pours a glowing, opaque golden-yellow with a soft, frothy white head and a moderate, lively carbonation.

Aroma: It features a bright and punchy nose led by "C-hop" aromatics. Expect intense scents of grapefruit zest and resinous pine, followed by tropical layers of passionfruit, peach, and a hint of floral citrus.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a soft, slightly pillowy mouthfeel. It leads with a clean, crackery malt base that serves as a canvas for the hops. The flavor profile is dominated by juicy citrus and tropical fruit, finishing with a crisp, balanced bitterness that is more pronounced than a standard NEIPA but smoother than a traditional West Coast IPA.

Profile: It has a robust ABV of 6.5% and a moderate bitterness that provides a structured, refreshing finish.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a heavy focus on the Citra hop variety, utilized in massive quantities during the dry-hopping stage to maximize essential oils. The water profile and grain bill (often featuring oats or wheat) are carefully tuned to provide a soft texture without becoming "muddy," ensuring the hop aromatics stay vibrant and "happy."

title: Maison Castel Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
This accessible red wine originates from the IGP Pays d’Oc in the Languedoc-Roussillon region of Southern France. Maison Castel is a prominent French artisan-négociant that combines 70 years of regional expertise with a modern approach to winemaking. Part of the "Discovery" range, this wine is designed to showcase the pure varietal expression of Pinot Noir from carefully selected parcels. The winery is deeply committed to sustainable viticulture, with many of its partners holding Terra Vitis or Agriculture Biologique (Organic) certifications.

Wine Description

The Maison Castel Discovery Pinot Noir displays a bright ruby red colour. The sensory profile is fruit-driven and elegant, featuring pronounced aromas of red and black fruits, specifically wild raspberry, cherry, and strawberry, with subtle hints of spice and violet. On the palate, the wine is round and supple, characterized by a silky texture and well-integrated, light tannins. It is a lightly oaked style that maintains a balanced structure and a fresh, mouth-watering finish. This 100% Pinot Noir typically has an ABV of 12% to 13.5%.

title: Absolut Tabasco
bodyHtml:
Absolut Tabasco is a high-profile collaboration launched in early 2026 between two industry titans: the Swedish vodka giant Absolut and the McIlhenny Company, makers of Tabasco Brand Pepper Sauce. This release targets the growing global trend for "hot and savory" flavors, specifically designed to streamline the creation of spicy cocktails. It is created by fusing Absolut’s classic winter wheat vodka with a natural essence derived from the same fermented, aged red pepper mash used to produce the iconic hot sauce.

Spirit Description

The vodka is crystal clear and bottled at 38% ABV (76 proof), making it slightly leaner and more mixable than standard 40% spirits.

  • Nose: It opens with a bright, vegetal pepper aroma and a distinct, vinegar-driven tang that immediately evokes the scent of a fresh bottle of Tabasco.

  • Palate: The entry is smooth and clean, but it quickly builds into a lively, cayenne-like heat. It effectively mimics the "slow burn" of the hot sauce, offering notes of sun-ripened chili and a subtle, underlying sweetness from the wheat base.

  • Finish: Long and warming. The heat lingers at the back of the throat without becoming overwhelming, tapering off into a crisp, dry spirit character.

title: Worthy Park White Overproof Rum
bodyHtml:
Worthy Park White Overproof Rum (frequently branded as Rum-Bar White Overproof) is a powerhouse spirit from the historic Worthy Park Estate in Lluidas Vale, Jamaica. As a "single estate" product, every step—from sugar cane cultivation to bottling—happens on-site. This rum is a landmark release because it is the first modern Jamaican overproof to blend traditional molasses-based distillates with fresh cane juice distillates. Unlike many high-proof rums that rely on column stills for neutrality, Worthy Park is 100% copper pot-distilled, preserving the intense "hogo" (funk) and character that Jamaican rum is famous for.

Spirit Description

This rum is crystal clear and bottled at the traditional Jamaican overproof strength of 63% ABV (126 proof). On the nose, it is remarkably bright and fragrant, dominated by overripe bananas, pineapple, and exotic fruits, with a grassy, vegetal edge from the cane juice. The palate delivers an explosive "overproof punch" that is surprisingly smooth for its strength. It features a concentrated fruit profile of papaya, strawberry jam, and honey, balanced by a savory, peppery heat and a hint of salinity. The finish is long and clean, leaving a lingering impression of tropical fruit and charcoal.

title: Benrinnes 11 Year Old 'A Tale of Two Banffs' Single Malt Scotch Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
A Tale of Two Banffs is a highly limited, single-cask release of Benrinnes 11 Year Old single malt scotch whisky. This expression was created as a collaboration between Cask 88 and the Banff Whisky Experience to celebrate the historic connection between the distillery’s home in Banffshire, Scotland, and its namesake town of Banff, Alberta, Canada. It is a "survivor" story of sorts, utilizing a heavy, "meaty" Speyside distillate and finishing it in high-intensity wood to create a profile that can stand up to the rugged landscape of the Canadian Rockies.

Spirit Description

This 11-year-old single malt underwent a specific two-stage maturation process: it was aged for 9 years in ex-bourbon casks before being finished for its final 2 years in Oloroso Sherry Octave casks. Octave casks, being much smaller than standard butts, provide a significantly higher surface-area-to-liquid ratio, leading to a rapid and intense flavor extraction.

  • Nose: It opens with a distinct red wine and ethanol punch, which quickly settles into a playful aroma of Juicy Fruit gum, citrus zest, and a hint of vanilla.

  • Palate: Surprisingly dry and tannic given the sherry finish. It features a "tannic tug" on the sides of the tongue, with nuanced notes of bold fruits and a subtle, meaty spice characteristic of the Benrinnes distillate.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long and evolving. The oak spice finally takes center stage, bringing a slight tropical sweetness and a lingering warmth. It is bottled at a powerful cask strength of 57% ABV (though some batches vary slightly to 56%) and is non-chill filtered with no added color.

Accolades & Exclusivity

  • Ultra-Limited Outturn: Only 230 bottles were produced worldwide, making it a highly sought-after collector's item in both Scotland and Alberta.

  • Community Recognition: Widely celebrated within the Alberta whisky community (notably by Craft Cellars and Whisky Drop) as a premier example of "terroir-bridging" storytelling.

  • Cask 88 Heritage: Bottled by Cask 88, a family-owned independent bottler renowned for their expertise in rare and single-cask scotch.

title: Master Of Malt Bunnahabhain Distillery 15 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Master of Malt Bunnahabhain Distillery 15 Year Old is a single malt Scotch whisky originating from the northeastern shores of the Isle of Islay, Scotland. Established in 1881 by the Greenlees Brothers, the distillery is known as the 'most northerly' on the island and was historically accessible only by boat, a heritage reflected by the helmsman icon on its labels. Bunnahabhain is celebrated for its distinctive unpeated style, utilizing mineral-rich water from the Margadale Spring and the tallest pear-shaped stills on Islay to create a lighter, more delicate spirit character.

Description

This 15-year-old expression presents a natural pecan gold hue. The nose opens with an inviting bouquet of fresh dark fruits, specifically black cherries, plums, and blackberries, intertwined with vanilla fudge, shortbread, and a hint of roasted nuts. On the palate, the whisky is silky and full-bodied, unfolding layers of treacle toffee, cinnamon pastries, and dried figs balanced by soft herbal notes and creamy caramel. The finish is long-lasting and warm, characterized by lingering spices, roasted coffee, and a distinct whisper of sea spray that highlights its coastal maturation.

title: Master Of Malt Cambus Distillery 34 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Master of Malt Cambus Distillery 34 Year Old is a rare single grain Scotch whisky from Scotland's Lowland region. Originally founded in 1806 near Alloa, Cambus was a pioneer in grain whisky production and a founding member of the Distillers Company Limited (DCL), now known as Diageo.

Whisky Description

This 34 year old single grain whisky presents a wonderfully waxy profile, having matured in a refill barrel before being finished in a rum barrel. On the nose, it offers a vibrant 'fruit salad' bouquet alongside brown butter cookies, maple pancakes, and candied nuts, eventually developing notes of waxed citrus and polished oak. The palate is zesty and sweet, featuring layers of waffles, honeyed melon, and lychee that transition into buttery fudge and drying spices.

title: Craigellachie 17 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Craigellachie 17 Year Old is a distinguished single malt Scotch whisky from the Speyside region of Banffshire, Scotland. Founded in 1891 by Alexander Edward and Peter Mackie, the distillery is currently owned by Bacardi under its John Dewar and Sons branch.

Whisky Description

This 17 year old expression presents a warm golden amber hue in the glass. The aromatic profile is complex and inviting, opening with rich notes of vanilla, treacle, and dark honey, followed by dried pineapple, melon, and a faint whiff of earthy smoke. On the palate, the whisky is remarkably oily and full bodied, delivering a sweet entry of custard creams and exotic tropical fruits before revealing its characteristic 'meaty' depth. Subtle spices such as clove, ginger, and black pepper emerge alongside notes of dark chocolate and toasted oak. The finish is long, waxy, and warming, characterized by a lingering smoky sweetness and a hint of tannin.

title: Glen Scotia 10 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Glen Scotia 10 Year Old Single Malt originates from the Campbeltown region of Scotland. Founded in 1832 by Stewart and Galbraith Company, the distillery is one of only three remaining producers in what was once the 'Victorian Whisky Capital of the World'.

Whisky Description

This unpeated single malt presents a warm amber colour and a medium viscosity. The nose is inviting and fresh, offering aromas of sea spray, sliced apple, and lemon zest, backed by sweet cereals and toasted oak. On the palate, the whisky is medium-bodied and smooth, revealing layers of syrup, melted brown sugar, orange marmalade, and tangy pineapple. These flavors are complemented by creamy oak vanilla and a signature maritime oiliness. The finish is long and warming, characterized by gentle ground ginger and cinnamon spiciness.

title: Chateau Ste Michelle Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
This accessible white wine originates from the Columbia Valley AVA in Washington State, USA. Chateau Ste. Michelle, established in 1934, is the oldest winery in Washington and has played a pivotal role in bringing European winemaking techniques to the Pacific Northwest. The winery's philosophy for its flagship Columbia Valley Chardonnay focuses on creating a "food-friendly" style by blending fruit from both cooler and warmer vineyard sites across the region to balance ripe fruit intensity with natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Chateau Ste. Michelle Chardonnay presents a pale gold colour with brilliant clarity. The sensory profile is fresh and soft, leading with juicy aromas of crisp green apple, citrus blossom, and pear, underpinned by subtle notes of vanilla and toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and vibrant, offering flavours of lemon zest and orchard fruit balanced by a creamy, buttery texture from sur lie aging. The finish is clean and persistent, with a delicate hint of sweet spice.

title: Cotarella Vitiano Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
This single-varietal red wine is produced in the Umbria region of central Italy, specifically within the Montecchio subregion of Orvieto. The estate, Famiglia Cotarella (formerly Falesco), was founded in 1979 by brothers Riccardo and Renzo Cotarella, two of Italy's most prominent oenologists. Their winemaking philosophy centers on elevating the status of Umbria and Lazio through a contemporary style that blends traditional heritage with innovative vineyard research. Since 2017, the third generation—sisters Dominga, Marta, and Enrica has managed the business, further emphasizing the connection between their native terroir and the family name.

Wine Description

The Cotarella Vitiano Cabernet Sauvignon displays an intense red colour with bright violet reflections. The sensory profile is young and expressive, featuring aromas of blackcurrant, plum, and dark cherry, accented by delicate notes of espresso, toast, and mocha. On the palate, the wine is bold and structured yet soft, offering ripe flavours of blackberry and black cherry balanced by a harmonious acidity. It is characterized by round, velvety tannins and a smooth texture that leads into a long, savoury, and subtly mineral finish.

title: Burrowing Owl Cabernet Franc 2022
bodyHtml:
This premium red wine originates from the South Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada, specifically sourced from estate vineyards in Oliver and Osoyoos. Founded in 1993 by the Wyse family, Burrowing Owl Estate Winery was established with a pioneering spirit, becoming one of the first in the province to transition entirely from hybrid to vinifera vines. The winery's philosophy is rooted in environmental stewardship and minimal intervention, utilizing a state-of-the-art gravity-flow system to preserve the true character of the fruit while protecting the local antelope brush ecosystem.

Wine Description

The Burrowing Owl Cabernet Franc presents a deep ruby to crimson colour. Its complex sensory profile offers intense aromas of red currant, plum, and cassis, layered with fragrant notes of violet, dried thyme, and savory tobacco. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied with a silky texture, showcasing flavours of ripe raspberry, wild blackberry, and black cherry balanced by a crisp acidity. It is characterized by firm, well-integrated tannins and a long, refreshing finish that reveals hints of graphite, baking spices, and dark chocolate.

title: Burrowing Owl Pinot Gris 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine is produced by the Burrowing Owl Estate Winery, located in the South Okanagan Valley of British Columbia, Canada. Since its founding in 1993, the winery has become a leader in the region, known for its "no-compromise" approach to quality and its commitment to environmental conservation, specifically protecting the endangered burrowing owl. The 2024 vintage represents a unique moment in the winery's history, as a severe "deep freeze" in January 2024 destroyed over 90% of the Okanagan's grape crop. To ensure continuity, Burrowing Owl and other premium producers were granted a one-year exemption to source high-quality fruit from the Pacific Northwest (Washington and Oregon) to supplement their limited estate yields.

Wine Description

The 2024 Burrowing Owl Pinot Gris maintains the estate’s signature style: refined, expressive, and texturally rich. It presents a pale straw colour and opens with an aromatic nose of pear, nectarine, and honeydew melon, layered with exotic notes of citrus blossom, jasmine, and a touch of honey. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and silky, offering flavours of ripe stone fruit and lemon zest balanced by a crisp, refreshing acidity. The finish is clean and persistent, showcasing a characteristic mineral undertone and subtle spice from short aging on the lees.

title: Burrowing Owl Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
This premium white wine originates from the Black Sage Bench in the South Okanagan Valley of British Columbia, Canada. Burrowing Owl Estate Winery was established by the Wyse family in 1993 on a site that has become legendary for its unique microclimate the hottest and driest in Canada. The winery's philosophy combines state-of-the-art technology, such as a four-level gravity-flow system, with environmental stewardship; they are famous for their on-site solar energy initiatives and their namesake conservation program for the burrowing owl.

Wine Description

The Burrowing Owl Chardonnay presents a clear, pale lemon-gold colour. The sensory profile is complex and well-integrated, featuring aromas of ripe pineapple, lemon zest, and cantaloupe, layered with rich notes of toasted hazelnut, vanilla, and honey. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied with a creamy, luscious texture derived from extensive lees stirring (batonnage) and partial malolactic fermentation. It displays balanced flavours of tropical fruit and crisp apple, supported by a refreshing acidity and a lingering, buttery finish with hints of spice and wet stone.

title: Maraska Orahovac Walnut Liqueur 750 ml - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Maraska Orahovac Walnut Liqueur is produced in Croatia, specifically in the city of Zadar within the region of Dalmatia. The company continues a tradition of liqueur production dating back to the 16th century, integrating five centuries of history into its modern manufacturing facilities built in 2006. As the most important liqueur producer in Croatia, Maraska continues the traditional business established by the unified historic factories of Zadar after the transition of the region to Yugoslavia.

Description

This traditional Croatian liqueur is uniquely prepared using hand picked unripe green walnuts, following centuries old household recipes. It presents a dark mahogany or deep amber colour in the glass. The nose is warm and inviting, offering aromas of roasted nuts, caramel, baking spices, and a delicate touch of citrus. On the palate, the spirit is rich, supple, and well rounded, featuring a complex tapestry of flavours where nutty undertones dance with notes of honey, vanilla, and warming spice. It possesses a moderately oily and rich body, leading to a smooth, persistent finish that is slightly tannic yet clean.

title: Adami Garbel Prosecco
bodyHtml:
Adami Garbel Brut Prosecco DOC Treviso is a vibrant sparkling wine produced in the Treviso province of the Veneto region in Northern Italy. The Adami family's winemaking history began in 1920 when Abel Adami purchased the original vineyard, with the winery releasing its first bottling in 1933. Today, the third generation, brothers Armando and Franco Adami, manages the estate with a philosophy that balances modern technology with a deep 'vineyard up' connection to the soil and traditional rural world.

Wine Description

This wine is typically a blend of 90% to 97% Glera and 3% to 10% Chardonnay, appearing pale straw yellow with a persistent, fine perlage and a dense, velvety mousse. The sensory profile is generous and complex, offering a bouquet of ripe peach, yellow apple, honeydew melon, and white flowers, accented by hints of candied lemon and flint. On the palate, the wine is nimble and full-flavored, mirroring its aromatic notes with a brisk acidity and a tangy progression that leads to a clean, refreshing finish.

title: Carmen Maria’s Legacy Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Carmen Maria's Legacy Cabernet Sauvignon is an elegant red wine from the Maipo Alto subregion of the Maipo Valley in Chile. Founded in 1850 by Christian Lanz and named in honour of his wife. Viña Carmen is the oldest winery in Chile and is renowned for its historical significance, including the 1994 rediscovery of Carmenere within its vineyards. Currently owned by the Claro Group as part of Santa Rita Estates, the winery is led by winemaker Ana Maria Cumsille, who continues the estate's legacy of innovation and high-altitude viticulture.

Wine Description

This single vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep sensory profile with a 'shadowed' aromatic intensity. The nose features dark roasted coffee, black currant, and graphite, perfumed by delicate notes of jasmine, lavender, and dark chocolate raspberry. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and 'silky', displaying vibrant flavours of Luxardo cherry, nectarine, and sweet cedar.

title: Campo di Sasso Occhione 2024
bodyHtml:
Tenuta di Biserno Occhione is a rare and elegant white wine produced in the Bibbona commune of the Upper Maremma region in Tuscany, Italy. Established in 2001, Tenuta di Biserno is a high-profile project founded by brothers Piero and Lodovico Antinori, along with their nephew Niccolò Marzichi Lenzi. The wine is named after the 'Occhione' (Eurasian stone-curlew), a protected species of water bird that nests in the dunes of nearby Marina di Bibbona. The estate's winemaking philosophy centers on expressing the unique maritime terroir of Bibbona, which features diverse alluvial and volcanic soils rich in sand and clay.

Wine Description

Occhione is the only white wine produced by the estate and is made in small quantities, primarily from grapes grown at Tenuta Campo di Sasso. It presents a brilliant straw yellow hue with greenish highlights. The sensory profile is characterized by a lively nose of pink grapefruit, lemon, and lime, interwoven with notes of tropical fruit, white flowers, and aromatic herbs. On the palate, the wine is delicate yet decisive, offering a soft, enveloping entry that evolves into a savory, mineral-driven mid-palate with a hint of varietal bitterness. The finish is fresh, vibrant, and citrusy.

title: Czechvar Lager - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Czechvar Lager is an iconic import from the Czech Republic, specifically brewed in the city of České Budějovice. The Budweiser Budvar Brewery, which produces this lager, was incorporated in 1895 as the Czech Joint Stock Brewery and remains a state owned symbol of national pride. Drawing on a brewing tradition that dates back to 1265, the brewery is dedicated to using premium local ingredients and a unique 90 day maturing period, which is significantly longer than mass market alternatives.

Beer Description

Pale golden yellow with creamy mousse; malty, toasted cereal, fruity and leafy/herbaceous, dried grass and hop aromas; crisp, fresh, medium bodied, richly textured with light creamy mouthfeel and refreshing bitter finish.

title: Adami Garbel Prosecco – 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Adami Garbel Brut Prosecco DOC Treviso is a vibrant sparkling wine produced in the Treviso province of the Veneto region in Northern Italy. The Adami family's winemaking history began in 1920 when Abel Adami purchased the original vineyard, with the winery releasing its first bottling in 1933. Today, the third generation, brothers Armando and Franco Adami, manages the estate with a philosophy that balances modern technology with a deep 'vineyard up' connection to the soil and traditional rural world.

Wine Description

This wine appears pale straw yellow with a persistent, fine perlage and a dense, velvety mousse. The sensory profile is generous and complex, offering a bouquet of ripe peach, yellow apple, honeydew melon, and white flowers, accented by hints of candied lemon and flint. On the palate, the wine is nimble and full-flavored, mirroring its aromatic notes with a brisk acidity and a tangy progression that leads to a clean, refreshing finish.

title: Hugel Classic Riesling 2023
bodyHtml:
Hugel Classic Riesling is a dry, elegant white wine from the Alsace region of France, representing the signature style of the Famille Hugel estate. Established in 1639 in the historic village of Riquewihr, the winery has been managed by 13 generations of the Hugel family, including current leaders like Jean-Frédéric Hugel. The estate's winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing pure varietal character and unique terroir through minimal intervention and a 'vineyard up' approach, pioneering legislation for Alsace noble grapes and late harvest wines.

Wine Description

This 100% Riesling is a pale straw colour with bright green highlights. The sensory profile is fresh and expressive, opening with dashed floral aromas of lily of the valley and elderflower alongside lively citrus zest, spring flowers, and meadows. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, lithe, and energetic, displaying crisp flavours of lemon, lime, yuzu, and green apple with subtle hints of pear. It features a 'detonating' energy and high, frisky acidity that leads to a long, mineral-laced finish with notes of wet slate and stone fruit.

title: Soter Estates Pinot Noir 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Soter Estates Pinot Noir 2022 is a premium red wine from the United States, produced in the celebrated Willamette Valley of Oregon. This bottling represents a sophisticated blend of fruit from the winery's three distinct estate vineyards located in the Ribbon Ridge, Eola-Amity Hills, and Yamhill-Carlton subregions. Founded over 20 years ago by legendary winemaker Tony Soter and his wife Michelle, the winery is renowned for its commitment to environmental stewardship and meticulous organic and biodynamic farming.

Wine Description

This ruby red wine offers a complex sensory profile that begins with enticing aromas of red plum, wild cherries, and rose petals, accented by notes of cinnamon, cedar, and tobacco. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and textured, delivering a rich core of boysenberry, black plum, and raspberry flavors alongside secondary hints of savory tea, dried herbs, and minerals. The wine is characterized by its fresh acidity and finely chalky, 'dusty' tannins that provide a firm structure and a long, refined finish. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, the 2022 vintage was fermented using 25% to 30% whole clusters and native yeasts, followed by 10 months of aging in French oak barrels, 30% of which were new. This estate wine is certified organic and biodynamic, with a production of approximately 3,473 cases and an alcohol content of 13.8%.

Food Pairing

The savory complexity and vibrant acidity of this Pinot Noir make it an ideal partner for roasted duck or herb-crusted chicken. It pairs exceptionally well with earthy dishes such as wild mushroom risotto, pasta with a duck ragu, or grilled salmon. Additionally, its structure complements charcuterie boards, pork tenderloin, and roasted root vegetables like beets.

title: Kapriol Grapefruit and Hibiscus Gin - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Kapriol Grapefruit and Hibiscus Gin is produced in Italy, within the region of Veneto. The spirit is crafted by Distilleria dell'Alpe, which was established in 1948 by Ferruccio de Bernard in the hillside village of Bastia d'Alpago. In 2002, the distillery was acquired by the Maschio family, historical Grappa and Prosecco producers, who revived the brand's original recipes while introducing contemporary artisanal expressions.

Description

This gin is based on the original 1948 recipe for Kapriol Dry Gin and features a selection of pink grapefruits and hibiscus flowers sourced from southern Italy. The botanicals, which include juniper, bay leaves, angelica, chamomile, and mugo pine, are infused in a wheat based alcohol before being distilled in historic copper pot stills built in 1947. The nose is intense with notes of citrus, juniper, rosemary, and pine, while the palate offers a harmonious and elegant contrast between the bitterness of grapefruit and the floral sweetness of hibiscus.

title: Zyra Gold Vodka
bodyHtml:
Zyra Gold Vodka is produced in Canada, within the region of Alberta and the subregion of Edmonton. The brand is a premium, digital first spirit line proudly distilled in collaboration with Hansen Distillery, an award winning craft facility located in the provincial capital. Established in 2021 by a group of friends, the brand focuses on small batch production designed for 'the culture', partnering with artists and creators to curate unique nightlife experiences.

Description

This flagship expression is a luxury triticale based vodka that undergoes a rigorous distillation process, being distilled thirty times for exceptional purity. It is triple filtered to achieve a crystal clear appearance and a refined sensory profile. The nose opens with subtle grain aromas, leading to a silky smooth and well balanced palate. It concludes with an elegant persistence and crystal clarity. .

title: Anohka Tempest Dry Gin - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Anohka Tempest Dry Gin is produced in Canada, within the region of Alberta and the subregion of Parkland County. The distillery was founded in 2021 by Gurpreet Ranu, a former particle physicist and lawyer who holds a master's degree in brewing and distilling. Operating as a farm to flask facility, the distillery grows its own grain and utilizes unique direct fire heating methods to create complex flavour profiles.

Description

This unfiltered London Dry style gin is handcrafted using 100% Western Canadian wheat and more than ten times the typical amount of botanicals. The botanical blend includes juniper, coriander, angelica, red rose petals, grapefruit peel, lime peel, orris root, Tellicherry black pepper, cardamom, Vietnamese cassia, and bay leaf. It presents a clear appearance that becomes alluringly translucent when chilled or mixed due to the high concentration of aromatic oils. The nose is characterized by resinous juniper, bright citrus, and an intoxicating blend of spices. On the palate, it is sweet and floral with notes of stone fruit and a refreshing botanical freshness, leading to a spicy finish with sustained length.

title: Kalani Coconut Rum
bodyHtml:
Kalani is an authentic coconut liqueur produced on the Yucatan Peninsula in Mexico. It is crafted by Casa D'Aristi, a family owned distillery founded in 1935 that is dedicated to upholding Mayan traditions and sustainable production practices. The distillery is renowned for using 100% natural regional resources, specifically the yellow dwarf coconuts harvested from their own historic 19th-century plantation in Oxtapacab.

Liqueur Description

This clear spirit offers an intense sensory profile, led by a rich nose of fresh desiccated coconut, toasted macaroon, and dark chocolate, accented by hints of creme caramel and fresh citrus. On the palate, it is indulgent and velvety with a syrupy texture that balances the sweetness of coconut icing and almond against a peppery bite from the pure sugar cane rum. The finish is long, elegant, and fresh, leaving lingering notes of toasted coconut and a tropical warmth.

title: J Lohr Golden Petal Pinot Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This rare white wine hails from the Arroyo Seco AVA in Monterey County, California. Pinot Blanc was one of the eleven original varieties planted by Jerry Lohr in 1972, and today the winery continues to be family-owned and operated by Jerry and his children. The winemaking philosophy for this bottling, often sourced from the F&G Vineyard, focuses on showcasing the intense fruit purity and unique minerality provided by the region's well-drained, stony cobblestone soils.

Wine Description

The J Lohr Golden Petal Pinot Blanc exhibits a pale yellow colour and a bouquet defined by stony minerals and subtle autumn orchard fruit. On the palate, the wine is full of energy but remains plush and lifted, with a texture influenced by lees contact that adds complexity without heaviness. Sensory notes include citrus pith, pears, and a hint of almonds, all balanced by a taut acidity.

Food Pairing

This wine's bright acidity and plush texture make it an excellent match for root vegetables and squashes. It is also highly recommended as an aperitif or paired with fresh salads such as apple and fennel, as well as shellfish served with a lemon aioli.

title: Wild Rose Barracks Brown Ale - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1996 by entrepreneurs Mike Tymchuk and Alan Yule, Wild Rose Brewery was established with the mission to 'free Albertans from the tyranny of boring beer'. The brewery is deeply rooted in local history, famously operating out of a historic air force hangar in the Currie Barracks area, a heritage that inspired the name of this flagship ale.

Beer Description

This English style brown ale presents a striking dark brown and ruby hued appearance. The aromatic profile is defined by rich notes of espresso and cocoa, which carry through to a palate that is both dark and mysterious yet remarkably approachable. Characterized by a medium body and mild hopping, it offers a sophisticated balance of malty sweetness and a crisp, smooth finish.

title: Big Rock Traditional - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml: English Style Brown Ale. A recipe gone untouched since Big Rock's founding. Toasty malt and sweet caramel up front, finishes with a nutty flavour, medium creamy carbonation and mild hop bitterness. Toasty malt and sweet caramel up front finishing with a nutty flavour, medium creamy carbonation, and mild hop bitterness.

title: Planet Oregon Pinot Noir 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Planet Oregon Pinot Noir 2022 originates from the United States, specifically from the renowned Willamette Valley in Oregon. This wine is a value-driven project from Soter Vineyards, a winery founded by Tony and Michelle Soter that focuses on sustainable practices and high-quality fruit. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes environmental stewardship, evidenced by the brand donating 1% of all sales to the Oregon Environmental Council.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir presents a youthful magenta and ruby colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is expressive, featuring scents of chocolate, fresh berries, and cherry pie, alongside nuanced notes of toasted spice, lilac, and pine needles. On the palate, the wine is smooth and rich, delivering flavours of raspberry jam, pie cherries, and blueberry, complemented by savoury hints of black tea, orange zest, and cloves. The body is medium and approachable, showing a snappy texture with fine, zesty tannins and balanced acidity that leads to a clean, fresh finish. This 100% Pinot Noir was aged for 8 months in used French oak barrels and possesses an ABV of 13.5%. The wine is produced using grapes that are 90% LIVE Certified Sustainable, 9% organically farmed, and 1% biodynamically farmed.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and red fruit profile of this wine make it a classic companion for Pacific Northwest salmon, whether grilled or roasted. It also pairs excellently with earthy dishes such as wild mushroom risotto, roasted beets, or a duck ragu. For meat-based options, consider herb-roasted chicken, pork tenderloin, or lean cuts of lamb seasoned with rosemary.

title: Jack Daniel's McLaren 2025 Edition - 700 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's McLaren V3 (also known as the 2025/2026 Edition) is the third installment in the high-octane global partnership between the Jack Daniel Distillery and the McLaren Formula 1 Team. Launched to celebrate the 2025/2026 racing season, this release commemorates the team's recent successes—including their 2024 Constructors' Championship title. While the first two versions were bottled at the standard 80 proof, the V3 has been "up-tuned" to a higher alcohol content to provide a more robust experience for collectors and motorsport fans.

Spirit Description

This limited edition uses the classic Jack Daniel’s mash bill but is elevated to a higher proof for a more intense flavor profile.

  • Appearance: Deep amber with golden highlights.

  • Nose: Warm caramel, charred oak, and vanilla bean lead the aroma, accented by hints of toasted pecan, banana bread, and sweet baking spice.

  • Palate: Smooth yet assertive. The increased proof brings out layers of brown sugar, caramel fudge, and ripe banana, balanced by a stronger presence of toasted oak and a gently peppered rye spice.

  • Finish: Long and creamy, with the charcoal-mellowed smoothness of Tennessee whiskey lingering alongside a clean, woody dryness. It is bottled at 43% ABV (86 proof), distinguishing it from the standard 40% flagship.

title: Wirra Wirra Farmer's Heart Grenache 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from McLaren Vale, South Australia. Originally established in 1894 by Robert Strangways Wigley, Wirra Wirra was famously rebuilt from ruins in 1969 by the visionary Greg Trott. The winery is dedicated to biodynamic and organic farming, guided by Trott's enduring philosophy of being serious about quality while ensuring winemaking remains fun.

Wine Description

Farmer's Heart Grenache presents a vibrant ruby red colour in the glass. The bouquet is striking, featuring red fruits, star anise, dried herbs, and soft rose petals, accented by hints of white strawberry compote. On the palate, it is medium bodied with a savory depth of umami and warm spices enveloped in creamy red fruit flavours. The wine shows a refined structure with fine, green tea like tannins and a persistent, spicy finish.

Food Pairing

This Grenache is an ideal companion for braised chicken with ginger, soy, and star anise, which complements its savoury profile. It also pairs beautifully with rosemary crusted lamb chops or a rustic vegetable ratatouille.

title: Merryvale Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
This elegant red wine originates from the Sonoma Coast AVA in California, sourced from premium sites including the Durell, Sunchase, and Huichica vineyards. Merryvale Vineyards holds a significant place in history as the first winery built in Napa Valley following the repeal of Prohibition in 1933. Since 1996, the estate has been solely owned by the Schlatter family, who combine European sensibilities with a focus on small-volume, high-quality production. Their winemaking philosophy emphasizes precision and the use of cool-climate fruit to create wines with exceptional texture, acidity, and aging potential.

Wine Description

The Merryvale Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir presents a polished and expressive profile with a medium body. This wine reveals complex aromas of raspberry, blood orange, and red cherry, complemented by intriguing notes of smoked paprika, cedar spice, and a hint of incense. On the palate, the wine is silky and seamless, offering concentrated flavours of pomegranate and cranberry balanced by bright acidity and earthier undertones of forest herbs. It is characterized by fine-grained, velvety tannins that lead into a graceful and persistent finish featuring notes of espresso bean and cocoa nibs. This wine is typically aged for 10 months in French oak, with approximately 40% being new barrels, and carries an ABV of 13.5%. While the estate vineyards are farmed sustainably and are certified Napa Green, this wine is not certified organic.

title: Little Engine Union Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
This distinguished red blend is produced in the Okanagan Valley region of British Columbia, Canada, primarily within the Naramata Bench subregion. Little Engine Wines was founded in 2011 by Steven and Nicole French, who began by purchasing the Corbishley Vineyard and have since expanded to multiple estate properties. The winery's philosophy is centred on the pursuit of excellence through low-yield farming and a minimalist approach in the cellar, allowing each wine to express the unique terroir of its origin.

Wine Description

The Little Engine Union Red Blend typically displays a mid to dark colour. Its sensory profile is marked by enticing aromas of cassis, bramble berries, and roasted meats, complemented by notes of dried herbs and creamy vanilla. On the palate, the wine is fruit-forward with flavours of blueberry, cranberry, and cassis, alongside subtle nuances of tobacco leaf and roasted red peppers. The texture is structured yet approachable, featuring velvety tannins and a bright acidity that leads into a graceful, lingering finish. The varietal composition varies by vintage but generally centres on Merlot (approximately 70–78%), rounded out with Cabernet Franc, Malbec, and occasionally Cabernet Sauvignon.

Food Pairing

This versatile blend is well-suited for a variety of hearty dishes. Suggested pairings include roasted meats, which complement the wine's savoury notes, as well as casual favourites like burgers and pizza. Its structured profile also makes it an excellent match for pasta dishes with rich sauces.

title: Foris Pinot Gris 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Foris Pinot Gris originates from the Rogue Valley in Southern Oregon, specifically from the estate’s vineyards in the Illinois Valley. Founded by the Gerber family in 1971, Foris is a pioneer in the region, specializing in Alsatian varietals. Their Pinot Gris is consistently noted for its "Best Buy" status, offering a profile that bridges the gap between the zesty Italian Grigio style and the richer, more textured Alsatian Gris.

Wine Description

The Foris Pinot Gris is known for its purity, achieved through whole-cluster pressing and fermentation in stainless steel to avoid any oak masking.

  • Appearance: Bright straw-gold with shimmering clarity.

  • Nose: Highly aromatic and fragrant. It typically leads with Asian pear, honeysuckle, and orange blossom honey, followed by hints of white stone fruit (nectarine and peach) and a touch of savory herbs or hay.

  • Palate: The wine features a broad, round entry with an enhanced mouthfeel and weight. Flavors of Bartlett pear, Meyer lemon, and melon are supported by a crisp, tangy acidity. The finish is often characterized by a distinctive sweet ginger spiciness and a clean, citrusy zest.

  • Technical Details: 100% Pinot Gris. Recent vintages (2022/2023) show an alcohol content of approximately 13.5% to 13.9% ABV and very low residual sugar (around 1.7 g/L), making it a dry but fruit-forward wine.

Food Pairing
