Because of its weight and ginger-snap finish, this Pinot Gris is exceptionally food-friendly. It is a classic match for scallops (especially seared or with butter), grilled shrimp, and halibut. Its acidity and spice profile also allow it to stand up to spicy Asian cuisine (Thai or Szechuan) and savory-sweet dishes like roasted chicken with apricots. For a cheese pairing, consider tangy goat cheese or a sharp white cheddar.

title: Sortilege Peach & Pear Whisky Lemonade 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Sortilège Peach & Pear Whisky Lemonade is a premium ready-to-drink (RTD) cocktail from the iconic Quebec brand Sortilège. Known primarily for their blends of Canadian rye whisky and pure maple syrup, Sortilège has expanded into the "canned cocktail" market with refreshing, fruit-forward expressions. This specific release combines the distillery's signature maple-finished rye whisky with the summery flavors of stone fruit and crisp pear, designed as a convenient, bar-quality patio drink.

Description

This cocktail presents a pale, hazy straw color. On the nose, it leads with the sweet, sun-ripened aroma of fuzzy peaches followed by the delicate, floral scent of Bartlett pears. The palate is light and refreshing, balancing the tartness of zesty lemonade with the smooth, warming undertones of Canadian rye whisky. Subtle hints of toasted maple wood—a hallmark of the Sortilège base—add a layer of complexity and a touch of caramel sweetness that rounds out the citrus acidity. It is lightly carbonated and bottled at a sessionable 5% ABV.

title: Seventh Heaven Dry Gin
bodyHtml:
Seventh Heaven Dry Gin is a premium, craft-distilled spirit from Station 22 in Longueuil, Quebec. Marketed as "Canada’s first impeccable Dry Gin," it is inspired by the classic London Dry style but elevated with local Canadian terroir. The name reflects its use of seven specific botanicals sourced from around the globe, which are processed using a lukewarm warm vapour infusion to preserve the delicate essential oils of the plants. This method results in a gin that is aromatic and flavorful without the harshness sometimes associated with high-proof spirits.

Spirit Description

The gin is crystal clear with a mellow and approachable character. On the nose, it leads with a vibrant bouquet of Nordic juniper and elderberries, accompanied by citrus peel and herbaceous notes of Labrador tea. The palate is highly complex and well-balanced, featuring exotic citrus flavors, often attributed to the "forbidden fruit" (a citrus hybrid)—layered with peppery juniper and earthy floral tones. Despite its 43% ABV, the mouthfeel is notably creamy and smooth. The finish is spicy, dry, and surprisingly warming, with lingering hints of coriander and green herbs.

The Seven Botanicals

The "Heavenly Seven" ingredients are sourced globally to create a specific flavor profile:

  1. Nordic Juniper Berries (Canada)

  2. Labrador Tea (Canada)

  3. Elderflower (England)

  4. Forbidden Fruit (Caribbean)

  5. Apricot Almonds/Kernels (Spain)

  6. Coriander Seeds (Morocco)

  7. Orris Flower Root (Italy)

title: Driftwood Fat Tug IPA - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Fat Tug IPA is the legendary flagship from Driftwood Brewery in Victoria, British Columbia. Since its release in 2010, it has become a cult icon and one of the most highly awarded beers in Canadian history. It is widely considered the gold standard for the Northwest-style IPA, known for its uncompromising hop intensity and its ability to maintain a dedicated following among hop heads across Western Canada.

Beer Description

This Northwest-style IPA pours a beautiful, slightly hazy deep gold to amber color with a thick, long-lasting white head that leaves significant lacing.

Aroma: It features an intense and complex hop bouquet. Expect a heavy punch of zesty grapefruit and resinous pine, layered with tropical notes of mango, melon, and passionfruit.

Palate: The flavor is a massive wave of hops supported by a sturdy malt backbone. It delivers aggressive citrus and tropical fruit flavors followed by a deep, resinous bitterness. Despite its strength, it remains remarkably balanced with a smooth, medium body and a dry, lingering finish.

Profile: It has a robust ABV of 7.0% and an IBU of 80+, placing it at the high end of the scale for bitterness and flavor intensity.

Technical Notes: Brewed with an excessive amount of hops throughout the boil and dry-hopping stages. The recipe focuses on bio-modification and yeast-hop interaction to pull out a unique, multi-dimensional aromatic profile that evolves as the beer warms.

title: Village Blacksmith - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Village Blacksmith is the flagship "Artisan Black Ale" from Calgary’s Village Brewing. In keeping with the brewery’s mission to celebrate the community’s "hidden gems", the craftspeople and makers, the Blacksmith represents the strength and grit of the traditional smithy. It is designed to be a bridge between a traditional English Dark Ale and a Stout, offering a rich, comforting profile that is substantial enough for a cold winter day but balanced enough to be enjoyed year-round.

Beer Description

This Black Ale pours a deep, dark mahogany that appears nearly opaque in the glass, topped with a thick, creamy tan head.

Aroma: It features a warm and inviting nose led by notes of toasted nuts, dark chocolate, and roasted malt. There is an underlying hint of caramel sweetness and a very faint earthy hop presence.

Palate: The flavor is medium-bodied and smooth. It leads with a rich, bready maltiness and flavors of dark crusty bread, followed by a gentle roasted bitterness reminiscent of cold-brew coffee. It avoids the heavy, syrupy mouthfeel of larger stouts, maintaining a clean and drinkable finish.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.4% and a moderate bitterness of 28 IBU, making it a flavorful, sessionable dark ale with a highly approachable character.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a blend of four different malts, including chocolate and roasted malts, to achieve its signature color and depth. It uses North American hops for balance, ensuring the roasted qualities are complemented rather than overshadowed by bitterness.

title: Phillips Blue Buck - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Phillips Brewing & Malting Co. in Victoria. Often cited as one of the beers that helped ignite the craft revolution in Western Canada, it is named after a mythical "Blue Buck" said to grant good fortune to those who see it. It is designed as a highly drinkable, "utility" ale that sits comfortably between a Pale Ale and an Amber Ale, making it a reliable favorite for both long-time craft fans and newcomers alike.

Beer Description

This English-style Pale Ale pours a deep amber to bronze color with excellent clarity and a frothy, straw-colored head.

Aroma: It features a delicate and balanced nose with soft notes of toasted caramel and biscuit, accented by subtle Northwest hop signatures of citrus and a faint hint of pine.

Palate: On the tongue, it is robust and malt-forward. It offers a rich backbone of toasted grain and caramel sweetness, which is quickly reined in by a crisp hop bitterness. It has a light-to-medium body and a smooth mouthfeel.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% and a moderate bitterness of approximately 23–30 IBU, resulting in a refreshingly crisp finish that doesn't linger too heavily.

Technical Notes: Brewed using a blend of premium malted barley and classic Northwest hops. The recipe focuses on a "malt-forward" architecture that is underpinned by the clean, bittering qualities of local hops to ensure maximum sessionability.

title: Peroni - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Peroni Nastro Azzurro is Italy’s premier export lager, a symbol of Italian style and craftsmanship since its launch in 1963. Brewed by Birra Peroni in Rome, it was originally inspired by the "Nastro Azzurro" (Blue Ribbon) won by the Italian ocean liner SS Rex in 1933. Positioned as a premium, sophisticated beer, it is designed to reflect the effortless elegance of Italian culture, offering a crisp and refreshing profile that has made it a staple in high-end bars and restaurants worldwide.

Beer Description

This international pale lager pours a brilliant, crystal-clear pale straw color with a lively effervescence and a thin, bright white head.

Aroma: It features a clean and delicate nose with subtle notes of grainy malt, white bread, and a distinct herbal, citrusy hop aroma from the use of noble hops.

Palate: The flavor is light-bodied and exceptionally crisp. It offers a subtle balance of sweet corn and malt, followed by a quick, dry bitterness that cleanses the palate. It is characterized by its high carbonation and "fizzy" mouthfeel, which enhances its refreshing quality.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% and a low-to-moderate bitterness of approximately 24 IBU, making it a highly drinkable and versatile beer.

Technical Notes: A key ingredient in Peroni Nastro Azzurro is "Nostrano dell'Isola" maize—a high-quality corn variety grown exclusively for Peroni in the fertile plains of Northern Italy. This corn provides the beer’s signature clarity and crisp, dry finish, while the use of premium hops ensures a sophisticated aromatic profile.

title: Toasted Head Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
This rich white wine hails from the California region of the United States, primarily sourced from the Dunnigan Hills AVA. The estate is situated 20 miles east of Napa Valley, where the Mediterranean-like climate features warm days and cool nighttime breezes from the Sacramento Delta. Toasted Head was named after the traditional cooperage practice of toasting both the barrel staves and the barrel heads to impart a signature smoky, vanilla character. The winery's philosophy focuses on producing high-quality, expressive wines at an accessible price point.

Wine Description

The Toasted Head Chardonnay displays a golden straw colour. The sensory profile is bold and oak-driven, opening with intense aromas of bourbon, butterscotch, white peach, and Asian pear. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, featuring creamy toast and peachy caramelized custard flavours.

title: Perrin Tavel 2021
bodyHtml:
This rosé hails from the Tavel AOC in the Southern Rhône Valley of France, a region uniquely dedicated to the production of rosé wines. The Perrin family, renowned for their stewardship of Château de Beaucastel, applies their generations of expertise and organic farming philosophy to this estate to capture the true essence of the Rhône terroir.

Wine Description

The Perrin Tavel presents a deep, shimmering pink hue with ruby reflections. The nose is expressive and complex, offering intense aromas of crushed red berries, such as raspberries and redcurrants, mingled with subtle floral notes and a touch of spice. On the palate, this full bodied rosé displays a rich, fleshy texture balanced by a refreshing acidity and a stony minerality. The finish is long and elegant, highlighting the wine's structural complexity and balance.

title: Maraska Williams Pear Brandy - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Maraska Williams Pear Brandy (also known as Viljamovka) is a prestigious fruit brandy, or eau-de-vie, produced by the historic Maraska Distillery in Zadar, Croatia. Founded in 1821, the distillery is world-renowned for its mastery of fruit distillation, particularly its Maraschino cherry liqueurs. This brandy is crafted exclusively from the Williams pear (known as the Bartlett pear in North America), prized for its intense aroma and juicy sweetness. To capture the pure essence of the fruit, the pears are fermented and then meticulously distilled using traditional copper stills, resulting in a spirit that is unaged and crystal clear.

Spirit Description

The brandy is colorless and clear, possessing a high-viscosity "oily" texture. On the nose, it is remarkably fragrant, offering an immediate and powerful burst of freshly sliced ripe pears, complemented by delicate floral undertones and a hint of dried apple. The palate is dry and sophisticated, delivering vibrant pear flavors that mimic the grit and sweetness of the fruit's skin. It maintains a silky mouthfeel with a subtle touch of baking spice and almond. The finish is crisp, clean, and elegantly lingering, leaving a refreshing fruit essence on the tongue.

title: Jack Daniel's Bonded Rye - 700 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Bonded Rye is a bold, "Bottled-in-Bond" expression that represents a major step in the distillery's evolution of rye whiskey. Adhering to the strict Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897, it is distilled by a single distiller in a single season, aged for at least four years in a federally bonded warehouse, and bottled at exactly 100 proof (50% ABV). Uniquely, Jack Daniel’s applies its signature charcoal mellowing process to the rye spirit, though it passes through a shallower layer of maple charcoal compared to their standard Tennessee Whiskey to ensure the grain’s characteristic spice remains intact.

Description

The whiskey is a rich golden amber. On the nose, it opens with crisp aromas of pear and apple, layered with sweet scents of toffee, maple sugar, and a hint of banana custard. The palate is full-bodied and zesty; the 70% rye mash bill delivers a robust kick of black pepper, cinnamon, and clove, which is expertly balanced by smoother notes of vanilla, cocoa, and toasted nuts. The finish is warming and medium-to-long, leaving a lingering impression of barrel char, baking spices, and a touch of herbal mint.

title: Matt & Steve's Caesar Hot & Spicy 473 ml - 24 Cans
vendor: 821444 - Matt & Steve's Tasty Bev Co. Inc.
bodyHtml:
Matt & Steve's Caesar Hot & Spicy is a ready to drink cocktail produced in Canada, within the province of Ontario. The brand was founded by friends Matthew Larochelle and Steve McVicker, who first gained fame in 2000 for creating the 'Extreme Bean', a hot and spicy pickled bean garnish. Based in a state of the art facility in Mississauga, the company remains committed to high quality, 'made in Canada' operations and has expanded from its pickling roots into the premium cocktail market.

Description

This bar strength Caesar is crafted using premium Canadian vodka that is column distilled and charcoal filtered for purity. The recipe features a base of 100% vine ripened tomatoes and a splash of the brand's signature 'Extreme Bean' brine to enhance the savoury depth. It presents a reddish, viscous texture typical of tomato based cocktails and offers a fresh, tangy profile with a bold spicy kick from a punch of cayenne pepper. The nose displays bold aromas of tomato, celery, and herbs, accompanied by zesty citrus notes of grapefruit and lemon with hints of coriander and clove. It possesses a rich, briny palate and a smooth, easy drinking finish.

title: Collective Arts Hazy State 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Collective Arts Hazy State is produced in Canada, within the region of Ontario and the subregion of Hamilton. The brewery was founded in 2013 by Matt Johnston and Bob Russell with a mandate to fuse the craft of brewing with the talents of emerging artists, musicians, and filmmakers. In 2014, the company moved into the historic former Lakeport Brewing facility near Hamilton's waterfront, which now serves as its primary production hub and a community space for creative events.

Description

This hugely flavourful yet extremely sessionable New England style IPA is double dry-hopped with 16 grams per litre of Amarillo, Citra, Mosaic, and Centennial hops. It presents a highly hazed, bright golden colour with a slim layer of delicate ivory foam. The nose is dominated by intense citrus and tropical fruit notes, including grapefruit, orange, guava, and mango. On the palate, it is crisp and hop-forward with layers of tropical fruit bliss and bright citrus that are balanced by a smooth, creamy body. Despite its rich mouthfeel, the beer remains refreshing with a moderate bitterness and a clean finish. Collective Arts Hazy State is bottled at an ABV of 4.1%.

title: Tiger Lager 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Tiger Beer is a world-renowned pale lager that first roared into existence in 1932 as Singapore’s first locally brewed beer. Produced by Asia Pacific Breweries (now part of the Heineken Group), it has grown from a regional favorite into a global icon, sold in over 75 countries. Known for its "Tropical Lagering" process, Tiger is specifically engineered to remain refreshing in the sweltering heat of Southeast Asia, earning it over 40 international accolades and gold medals for its consistent quality and purity.

Beer Description

This classic Asian lager pours a brilliant, crystal-clear straw gold with a lively carbonation and a thin, snowy white head.

Aroma: It features a clean and subtle nose with light notes of grainy malt, a touch of corn sweetness, and a faint, grassy hop presence.

Palate: The flavor is crisp and light-bodied, offering a delicate balance of bready malt and a soft, citrusy hop zest. It is defined by its smooth mouthfeel and a remarkably clean, snappy finish that leaves no lingering bitterness.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% and a low bitterness of approximately 18 IBU, making it an ideal session beer, especially when paired with spicy cuisine.

title: Wrexham Lager 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Wrexham Lager holds a storied place in brewing history as the oldest lager brewery in the United Kingdom, founded in 1882 by German immigrants Ivan Levinstein and Otto Isler. Based in Wrexham, North Wales, the brewery gained international fame for its ability to stay fresh during long sea voyages, leading it to be served on the British Army’s Nile Expedition and even famously listed on the beverage menu of the RMS Titanic. After a period of closure, the brand was vibrantly revived in 2011, returning to its original roots of quality and Welsh pride.

Beer Description

This classic Welsh Lager is a brilliant, crystal-clear pale gold with a steady stream of fine carbonation and a frothy, white head.

Aroma: It features a clean, delicate nose with traditional noble hop characteristics—offering light herbal and floral notes—complemented by a sweet, bready malt base.

Palate: The flavor is incredibly balanced and smooth. It delivers a gentle malty sweetness and a hint of honey, followed by a crisp, refreshing snap of bitterness that cleanses the palate.

Profile: It has an ABV of 4.0%, making it an exceptionally sessionable and "crushable" lager designed for easy drinking without sacrificing flavor.

Technical Notes: Brewed using soft Welsh water and a slow, cold-maturation process. It utilizes a traditional blend of hops and premium malted barley to maintain the authentic "Export" style character that made the brewery famous over a century ago.

title: Matt & Steve's Caesar Original 473 ml - 24 Cans
vendor: 821444 - Matt & Steve's Tasty Bev Co. Inc.
bodyHtml:
Matt & Steve's Caesar Original is produced in Canada, within the region of Ontario. The brand was founded by Matthew Larochelle and Steve McVicker, the creators behind the 'Extreme Bean' pickled garnish. This spirit-based cocktail is produced by Matt & Steve's Tasty Beverage Company, which transitioned from gourmet garnishes to ready to drink beverages by leveraging their signature pickling brine in their recipes.

Description

This ready to drink cocktail is crafted using premium Canadian vodka that is column distilled and charcoal filtered, blended with 100% vine ripened tomatoes. It presents a reddish, viscous appearance typical of tomato based beverages. The nose displays bold aromas of tomato, celery, pepper, and herbs with spicy undertones. On the palate, the profile is rich, briny, and savoury, featuring a splash of 'Extreme Bean' brine that adds depth to its tangy character. It concludes with a clean, tangy finish.

title: 1983 Creamy Espresso Martini 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
1983 Creamy Espresso Martini is a ready to drink cocktail produced in Canada, within the province of Ontario. Founded in 2021 by West Vancouver entrepreneurs Gabrielle Mustapich and Sheereen Price, the brand launched as the first creamy canned espresso martini in the Canadian market. The name 1983 pays homage to the year the original espresso martini was famously invented by legendary bartender Dick Bradsell in a Soho bar in New York City.

Description

This bar strength cocktail is crafted with real espresso, premium 10x distilled Canadian vodka, and a splash of real cream liqueur to provide a velvety finish. It pours with a smooth and sophisticated texture, presenting decadent aromas of bold coffee and fresh cream. The palate is rich and indulgent, balancing the robust intensity of espresso with a silky, sweetened creaminess that is never too heavy. It possesses a full body and an elegant mouthfeel, designed to replicate a freshly shaken bar quality cocktail. 1983 Creamy Espresso Martini is packaged in 250 ml cans and is bottled at 15% ABV.

title: Pura Vida XO Rum
bodyHtml:
Pura Vida XO Rum hails from Costa Rica, specifically crafted as the first rum in the country’s history to be entirely fermented, distilled, and matured within its borders. Produced by the French company Les Bienheureux, the brand embodies a philosophy of cultural tribute and environmental commitment, utilizing sustainable packaging made from recycled sugarcane bagasse.

Rum Description

This premium dark rum presents a brilliant golden-amber colour in the glass. The nose is remarkably elegant, offering a complex bouquet of well-caramelized crème brûlée, gingerbread, and tropical fruits like banana and pineapple, underscored by notes of raisin and dried apple. On the palate, Pura Vida XO is round and creamy, delivering balanced flavours of caramel, vanilla, and cedar with subtle spicy nuances and a touch of prune. It possesses a full body and a persistent, slightly spicy finish that remains elegant and long-lasting.

Food Pairing

The rich caramel and vanilla undertones of Pura Vida XO make it a superb companion for grilled meats, particularly a well-seared steak or honey-glazed pork chops. For a sweet conclusion, it pairs beautifully with dark chocolate mousse or a classic vanilla panna cotta, where the rum's oak notes and creamy texture can truly shine.

title: Giusti Sparkling Rose
bodyHtml:
This sparkling wine hails from the Veneto region of Italy, specifically from the 'Rosalia' estate in Nervesa della Battaglia. Established in 2003 by Ermenegildo Giusti, Giusti Wine is rooted in a family winemaking tradition dating back to the 1600s. The winery is dedicated to environmental respect and high-quality production, with the Rosalia estate being particularly significant as it was named in honour of the mother of Mr. Giusti's wife.

Wine Description

Giusti Rosalia Prosecco Rose Millesimato exhibits a delicate pink 'peach blossom' hue with a fine, persistent perlage. The bouquet is elegant and complex, offering intense aromas of golden apple, pink cherry, and nectarine, complemented by floral notes of wisteria and rose petals. On the palate, the wine is fresh and soft with a frothy texture and an intriguing savoury undertone that leads into a persistent, mineral finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile sparkling rose is an exceptional aperitif that pairs beautifully with delicate starters such as fish cruditée, fried seafood, and Parma ham. Its crisp acidity and fruity profile also complement a simple spaghetti with fresh grape tomatoes, basil, and extra virgin olive oil.

title: Wakefield Jaraman Shiraz 2019
bodyHtml:
This vibrant red wine is produced in the South Australia region, specifically blending fruit from the Clare Valley and McLaren Vale subregions. The Wakefield winery, known internationally as Taylors Wines, was established by the Taylor family in 1969 with a vision to create wines that rival the great estates of the Old World. Their winemaking philosophy for the Jaraman range focuses on marrying the distinctive characters of two iconic Australian wine regions to showcase the 'synergy of the soil'.

Wine Description

Wakefield Jaraman Shiraz presents a deep crimson red colour with a vibrant purple hue at the edges. The aroma offers a lifted burst of ripe mulberry, satsuma plum, and dark berry fruits, layered with subtle notes of violet, creamy vanillin, and a touch of tobacco spice. On the palate, the wine is rich and full-bodied, delivering concentrated flavours of blackberry and red fruit balanced by a lively acidity and hints of dark chocolate, cedar, and mint. Its texture is soft and inviting, with firm, well-integrated tannins providing a structured and persistent finish.

title: Ruinart Champagne Brut
bodyHtml:
This signature non-vintage champagne originates from the Champagne region of France. Founded in 1729 by Nicolas Ruinart, the House of Ruinart is recognized as the oldest established champagne house in the world. The winery's heritage is deeply rooted in the vision of Dom Thierry Ruinart, a Benedictine monk who foresaw the success of 'wine with bubbles'. Today, the maison is part of the Moët Hennessy group and is celebrated for its historic, UNESCO-listed chalk cellars (crayères) in Reims, where wines have been aged for centuries.

Wine Description

The R de Ruinart Brut displays a vibrant, clear yellow colour with shimmering golden reflections. The nose is fine and fruity, initially revealing fresh aromas of white-fleshed pear, reinette apples, and apricots, followed by delicate notes of hazelnuts and fresh almonds. Secondary impressions offer more intense scents of buttery brioche, biscuit, and white flowers. On the palate, the wine is balanced and full-bodied, enveloping the mouth in a harmonious roundness with sweet notes of golden fruit and plum tarts. The finish is long and direct, showcasing the characteristic mineral freshness of chardonnay. This blend typically consists of 40% Chardonnay, 45–55% Pinot Noir, and 5–15% Pinot Meunier, including 20–30% reserve wines from previous years.

title: Brotte Tavel 'Les Eglantiers' 2024
bodyHtml:
This distinguished rosé originates from the Tavel appellation in the Southern Rhône Valley of France. Maison Brotte is a historic family business founded in 1931 by Charles Brotte, a pioneer in bottling Rhône Valley wines who helped bring the region's character to a global audience. Currently led by the fourth and fifth generations of the family, the winery follows a philosophy of authenticity and craftsmanship, blending traditional methods with modern innovation to showcase the unique terroirs of their estate vineyards.

Wine Description

The 2024 Brotte Tavel Les Eglantiers presents a vivid, deep pink colour with bright golden reflections. The nose is intense and complex, offering fresh aromas of wild strawberry and red cherry complemented by nuances of white-fleshed stone fruits like peach and nectarine, and a hint of violet. On the palate, this full-bodied rosé is round and supple, showcasing rich flavours of fresh red fruit balanced by a refreshing, gentle acidity. It is characterized by a smooth elegance and a plump, persistent finish that features a slight tangy intensity.

title: Patron Citronge Orange & Jalapeno
bodyHtml:
Patrón Citrónge Orange & Jalapeño is a premium, spicy citrus liqueur that serves as a specialized extension of the classic Citrónge line. Developed at Hacienda Patrón in Jalisco, Mexico, this expression was specifically designed to simplify the creation of high-quality spicy margaritas. It combines the essence of high-quality oranges with the earthy, sharp heat of jalapeño peppers. Unlike some flavored spirits that use a neutral grain base, this liqueur is crafted with a foundation of Patrón Silver Tequila, providing an authentic agave backbone that integrates seamlessly into tequila-based cocktails.

Spirit Description

The liqueur is crystal clear with a bright, clean appearance. On the nose, it leads with a punchy aroma of fresh orange zest and tangerine, quickly followed by the distinct, vegetal scent of raw jalapeño and a faint hint of herbaceous agave. The palate offers a sophisticated play of "sweet and heat"—vibrant citrus sweetness is immediately met by a mounting, earthy jalapeño spice that coats the tongue without becoming overwhelming. The finish is smooth and long-lasting, leaving a lingering warmth of chili and a crisp orange aftertaste. It is bottled at 30% ABV (60 proof), which is slightly lower than the original Citrónge Orange, allowing the pepper notes to remain the focus.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and spicy kick of Citrónge Orange & Jalapeño make it a natural match for bold, flavor-heavy cuisines.

  • Mexican Classics: It is an incredible partner for al pastor tacos, ceviche, or shrimp aguachile, where the liqueur's heat echoes the chili in the food and its citrus cuts through the acidity.

  • Asian Fusion: Try it alongside spicy tuna rolls or Thai green curry; the orange notes harmonize with coconut and ginger, while the jalapeño reinforces the dish's spice.

  • Appetizers: It pairs surprisingly well with fried appetizers like calamari or jalapeño poppers, acting as a "liquid condiment" that refreshes the palate between bites.

title: Trolley 5 Yacht Rock Grapefruit Radler - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
The Yacht Rock Grapefruit Radler originates from Calgary, Alberta, Canada, crafted by the Trolley 5 Brewpub located in the heart of the Beltline district. Founded by Calgary locals PJ L'Heureux and Ernie Tsu, the brewery is named after the historic No. 5 Trolley Line that once served as the lifeline for the community. Their brewing philosophy focuses on bringing people together through shared milestones and high-quality, community-focused craft beverages.

Beer Description

This radler presents a light and refreshing sensory profile, characterized by its crushable nature and vibrant citrus core. On the nose, it offers a bouquet of sweet grapefruit, which is further rounded out by subtle notes of orange and a touch of lemon. The palate is smooth and easy-drinking, balancing the inherent sweetness of the fruit with a light backend bitterness that ensures a clean finish.

title: Evesham Wood Blanc du Puit Sec 2023
bodyHtml:
This unique white blend comes from the Eola-Amity Hills AVA within Oregon’s Willamette Valley. Evesham Wood, founded in 1986 by Russ Raney and now owned by his longtime apprentice Erin Nuccio, is one of the region’s most respected boutique wineries. The Blanc du Puits Sec (which translates to "White of the Dry Well") is a field blend sourced from the estate’s original 1986 plantings at the Le Puits Sec vineyard. The winery is a pioneer in organic viticulture and dry-farming, and this specific bottling is highly regarded for its texture and old-vine complexity.

Wine Description

The Evesham Wood Blanc du Puits Sec 2023 is an aromatic, savory, and richly textured white wine that balances exotic aromatics with a bright, structural core.

  • Appearance: Clear, pale straw with golden highlights.

  • Nose: Fruited and savory, featuring a complex bouquet of jasmine, honeysuckle, and rose petals, layered with notes of Granny Smith apples, Asian pears, and tangerines. There is a distinct savory element often described as lanolin or flint.

  • Palate: The mouthfeel is round and expansive, owing to barrel fermentation. It delivers flavors of yellow plums and peach skin, accented by almond nougat and a touch of honey. This richness is perfectly balanced by a "tangy" and "zesty" acidity that provides a linear, clean finish.

  • Technical Details: The 2023 blend is primarily 85% Pinot Gris and 15% Gewürztraminer, with trace amounts of Pinot Blanc, Kerner, and Rieslaner. The fruit comes from 1986-planted vines on their own rootstocks. The wine is co-fermented in neutral French oak barrels using native yeasts and undergoes spontaneous malolactic conversion. The alcohol content is approximately 12.5% ABV.

title: Luxardo Bitter Bianco – 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Luxardo Bitter Bianco is produced in Italy, in the Veneto region within the subregion of Torreglia. The company was founded in 1821 by Girolamo Luxardo in Zara, a city on the Dalmatian coast, to commercially produce his wife Maria Canevari’s refined maraschino liqueur. After the original distillery was destroyed during World War II, the family re-established the business in 1946 in Torreglia, where it remains independently owned and operated by the sixth generation of the Luxardo family.

Spirit Description

This clear, pale golden amber liqueur is a revival of an original 1930s family recipe that was recreated and refined using modern distillation techniques. It is crafted from a distilled infusion of bitter herbs and aromatic plants, including gentian, rhubarb, mint, marjoram, and bitter orange, with an final infusion of wormwood to enhance its bitterness and provide an ivory hue. The nose features bold aromas of orchard fruit, zesty citrus, and white petals accompanied by herbal notes and warm spices like cinnamon and clove. On the palate, it is bittersweet and round, offering layers of ripe pear, orange, and lemon balanced by rooty bitterness and a hint of honey sweetness. The body is smooth and oily, leading to a long, persistent finish of bitter herbs, white pepper, and spice. Luxardo Bitter Bianco is typically bottled at 30% ABV.

title: Giffard Agave Syrup (Non Alcoholic) - 700 ml Bottle
bodyHtml:
This product originates from France. It is produced by Giffard, a family owned company founded in 1885 by Emile Giffard, a pharmacist who transitioned into distilling after inventing a refined mint liqueur. Five generations later, the business remains independent and is renowned for its high quality liqueurs and syrups crafted in the Loire Valley.

Description

The syrup presents a beautiful honey colour with a thick consistency. The aroma is light and sweet, featuring gentle honey like notes. On the palate, it offers a smooth and naturally sweet profile with subtle honeyed nuances and a clean mouthfeel. It is characterized by its high aromatic intensity and is noted for having a sweetening power twice as potent as traditional sugar cane. The alcohol by volume is 0.0%.

title: Champagne Gremillet Brut Selection
bodyHtml:
Produced in France, this award winning grower Champagne originates from the Aube region, specifically from vineyards situated in the southern reaches of Troyes. The Gremillet estate was founded by Jean-Michel Gremillet in 1979, beginning with a small inheritance of vines and growing into a prestigious family run house now led by the second generation. The winery’s philosophy focuses on capturing the essence of 'success' and authenticity, utilizing sun drenched hillside vineyards to achieve a richer fruit profile than typically found in more northern reaches of the region.

Wine Description

This non-vintage Champagne presents a pretty, pale golden yellow colour rippling with fine and persistent bubbles. The nose is a lively alliance of floral and fruity notes, featuring acacia, hawthorn, peach, pear, and apricot, layered with characteristic sweet doughy overtones and brioche. On the palate, it is pleasant and refreshing, displaying a nice balance of acidity and maturity with flavours of baked biscuit, peach skin, and toasted spice. This medium bodied wine is composed of 70% Pinot Noir and 30% Chardonnay, utilizing only the 'cuvée' (first pressing) and aged on the lees for at least 18 to 22 months. It offers a clean, elegant finish with a crisp citrus lift.

title: Sumo Cat Riesling 2023
bodyHtml:
Crafted in Germany, this expressive Riesling is produced in the Rheinhessen region, an area celebrated for its diverse soils and high-quality white wines. The brand is part of the Citizen Wine portfolio, a producer founded with a vision to merge traditional winemaking with modern ingenuity and a commitment to sustainability. Its playful name, 'Sumo Cat', symbolizes a unique harmony of characteristics—the mighty power and strength of the sumo paired with the nimble freshness and agility of a cat.

Wine Description

This Halbtrocken (off-dry) Riesling presents a bright and playful sensory profile with a pale straw colour. The nose is greeted by an aromatic bouquet of green apple, pear, and citrus blossom, intertwined with floral hints of jasmine and a subtle mineral edge. On the palate, the wine offers a luscious mouthfeel with dense flavours of ripe peach and apricot, balanced by a 'knife-edge' acidity that provides a crisp, refreshing finish. A delicate touch of honey and notes of pineapple add further complexity to its light-bodied structure. Composed of 100% Riesling, this wine is best enjoyed while young and fresh to fully appreciate its zesty lift.

title: Embargo Esplendido Rum
bodyHtml:
Embargo Esplendido Rum is a sophisticated blend originating from several key Caribbean regions, including Guatemala, Trinidad and Tobago, Cuba, and Martinique. This brand is produced by the French blender Les Bienheureux, founded in 2015 by Alexandre Sirech and Jean Moueix.

Rum Description

This rum presents a rich sensory profile characterized by its deep, rounded character and smooth texture. The nose offers a pleasant bouquet of honey, orange blossom, and warm spices, complemented by notes of vanilla and caramel. On the palate, it is soft and balanced, featuring gourmet flavours of gingerbread, quince, and plum alongside hints of poached pear and chocolate. The body is medium to full, finishing with a lingering elegance of tobacco, wood, and a touch of sweetness.

title: Castello di Ama Haiku 2021
bodyHtml:
Produced in the heart of Italy's Tuscany region, specifically within the Gaiole in Chianti area of Chianti Classico, Castello di Ama Haiku 2021 is a masterfully crafted Super Tuscan. The estate, founded in the 1970s and currently managed by Lorenza Sebasti and winemaker Marco Pallanti, is renowned for its commitment to site-specific winemaking and the early adoption of the 'cru' concept in the region.

Wine Description

This bottle reveals an intense reddish purple hue with ruby nuances. The aromatic profile is deep and refined, featuring a 'constellation' of cassis, dark berries, and fruits of the forest, layered with notes of cigar wrapper, wild herbs, and a hint of espresso. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and nascently complex, showcasing a vibrant core of pomegranate and black cherry fruit framed by clean mineral notes and polished, yet firm, tannins.

Accolades

  • Vinous - 95 points

  • James Suckling - 95 points

  • Wine Advocate - 94+ points

Food Pairing

The wine's balanced acidity and structured tannins make it an excellent companion for hearty dishes such as braised short rib ragu, roasted lamb with rosemary, or beef wellington. It also pairs beautifully with earthy mushroom-based pastas or aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

title: Bowmore 18 Year Old Single Malt Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Bowmore 18 Year Old is a centerpiece of the core range from Islay’s oldest licensed distillery. It is widely considered the "sweet spot" of the Bowmore portfolio, balancing the vibrant peat of the 12-year-old with the refined, mellow fruitiness of the older expressions. Matured in a hand-selected combination of American oak ex-bourbon and European oak Oloroso sherry casks (including some Pedro Ximénez influences), this single malt is aged within the famous No. 1 Vaults—the only maturation warehouse in Scotland located below sea level—providing a unique microclimate for its long, slow rest.

Spirit Description

The whisky presents a mellow mahogany color, often described as auburn or polished mahogany. On the nose, it is deep and complex, revealing aromas of creamy caramel, toffee, and sun-ripened nectarines shrouded in a delicate, fragrant peat smoke. The palate is velvety and rich, offering a masterful blend of dark chocolate, brittle honeycomb, and juicy oranges, followed by nuances of roasted coffee and macadamia nuts. The smoke here is maritime and gentle, leaning more toward earthy tobacco and smoldering charcoal than medicinal peat. The finish is long and warming, leaving a balanced trail of Seville marmalade, floral blossoms, and a touch of sea salt. It is bottled at 43% ABV.

Food Pairing

The sophisticated balance of tropical fruit, salt, and smoke makes Bowmore 18 Year Old a premier candidate for luxury pairings.

  • Seafood: Its classic partner is fresh Scottish oysters (specifically West Coast oysters like Loch Fyne), where the whisky's brine and fruitiness amplify the natural sweetness of the shellfish.

  • Main Course: It pairs beautifully with Earl Grey tea-smoked venison or charcoal-roasted scallops, as the soft peat smoke reinforces the charred flavors of the meat.

  • Cheese & Dessert: It is an exceptional match for strong, nutty cheeses like aged Comté or a creamy blue cheese. For a sweet ending, try it with dark chocolate truffles or a raspberry milk chocolate bon-bon, which draws out the spirit's deep cocoa and stone fruit notes.

title: Attems Pinot Grigio Ramato 2024
bodyHtml:
Attems Pinot Grigio Ramato is a distinctive 'coppery' style wine from the Friuli DOC in the Friuli-Venezia Giulia region of Italy. One of the oldest estates in the area with a winemaking history dating back to 1106, Attems has flourished under the ownership of the Frescobaldi family since 2000. The winery operates with a 'vineyard-first' philosophy, focusing on the unique terroirs between the Adriatic Sea and the Alps to produce wines that express the authentic character and aromatic purity of the Friuli landscape.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a bright, typical copper hue with a mango coloured rim. The sensory profile is delicately floral on the nose, featuring notes of broom, Alpine rose, and green apple. On the palate, it is light yet precise and complex, displaying flavours of white grapefruit, mint, lime, and green apple supported by a balanced acidity. The finish is remarkably long and characterized by the area's distinct minerality and hints of currants.

title: Long Shadows Chester Red Blend 2019
bodyHtml:
Long Shadows Chester-Kidder Red Blend is a distinguished New World cuvée from the Columbia Valley in Washington State, United States. Established in 2002 by Washington wine pioneer Allen Shoup, Long Shadows Vintners is a unique consortium of ultra-premium wineries where Shoup recruited internationally acclaimed winemakers to produce signature wines from the region's best fruit. Named in honour of Shoup’s mother, Elizabeth Chester, and grandmother, Maggie Kidder, this specific label is crafted by the estate’s resident director of winemaking and viticulture, Gilles Nicault, who has been with the project since its inception.

Wine Description

This wine is a concentrated and deeply coloured blend, typically dominated by Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah, often with a small addition of Petit Verdot. Intense aromas of graphite, cassis, and cocoa beans, alongside earthy undertones and hints of sweet spice. On the palate, the wine is viscous and layered, displaying flavours of black currant, fresh fig, and ripe plum interwoven with saline, iron, and a hint of dark chocolate. It features a rich, textured mouthfeel supported by balanced acidity and firm, building tannins that lead to a lengthy, silky finish.

title: Dom Ruinart Rose 2009
bodyHtml:
Dom Ruinart Rosé is the prestige cuvée of Maison Ruinart, the oldest established Champagne house (founded in 1729). First produced in 1966, this vintage Champagne is a rarity, only released in years of exceptional quality. While most Rosé Champagnes are dominated by Pinot Noir, Dom Ruinart Rosé is unique for its exceptionally high proportion of Chardonnay, staying true to the house's signature style. It is often described as a "Blanc de Blancs with red wine," offering a sophisticated, vinous profile that bridges the gap between white and red wine.

Wine Description

Dom Ruinart Rosé is celebrated for its elegance, structural precision, and remarkable aging potential.

  • Appearance: A delicate coral or pale salmon pink with copper highlights and an incredibly fine, persistent mousse.

  • Nose: Complex and evolving. It typically opens with spicy notes of cinnamon, nutmeg, and roasted coffee, moving into fresh citrus (blood orange), exotic fruits (pomegranate, lychee), and floral notes of violet or peony.

  • Palate: The attack is silky and enveloping. It offers a balanced mix of tangy red fruits and a savory, saline minerality. The high Chardonnay content provides a firm, linear structure, while the Pinot Noir adds a "kiss of bitterness" and a smooth, full-bodied texture.

Food Pairing

  • Main Courses: It pairs exceptionally well with oily fish (salmon or tuna tataki) and white meats like veal or butter-poached poultry.

  • Bold Flavors: Its spicy notes allow it to stand up to duck breast with orange glaze or dishes seasoned with warm spices (saffron, cumin).

  • Vegetarian: It is one of the best Champagnes for truffle-based dishes or wild mushroom risottos, where its earthy, "gunpowder" notes can shine.

  • Cheese: Aged Comté or a 36-month Parmesan provide a perfect savory contrast.

title: 689 White Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
The 689 White Blend hails from the renowned Napa Valley region in California, USA. Founded in 2008 by industry veterans Curtis McBride and Kent Rasmussen, 689 Cellars is built on a philosophy of 'happiness, wealth, and longevity', represented by the Asian numerology of its name. The winery focuses on creating approachable, harmonious blends through close collaboration with trusted vineyard partners across the valley.

Wine Description

This medium bodied white blend presents a vibrant and fresh sensory profile. The nose opens with inviting aromas of orange blossoms and lemongrass, leading to a crisp palate defined by green apple, lemon, and bright citrus notes. Its structure is characterized by a sleek balance of acidity and layers of rich, polished fruit that carry through to a long, lively finish.

title: Ca' di Rajo Prosecco
bodyHtml:
Ca' di Rajo is a prominent Italian winery located in Rai di San Polo di Piave, in the province of Treviso. Established in 2005 by the Cecchetto brothers (Simone, Alessio, and Fabio), the estate builds on a family winemaking tradition dating back to 1931. The winery is uniquely famous for its preservation of the Bellussera system—an ancient, hand-worked "ray" vine training method where vines grow 4 meters high in a rhomboid pattern, appearing like "embroidery in the air."

Food Pairing

Because of their high acidity and balanced structure, Ca' di Rajo Proseccos are versatile. The Brut styles are excellent with battered vegetables, raw seafood (oysters and prawns), and even smoked salmon breakfast dishes.

Sustainability & Heritage

The winery manages nearly 20 hectares of vines trained in the Bellussera system. Because this method is incompatible with modern machinery, every aspect of vineyard management—from pruning to harvest—must be done by hand. This commitment makes Ca' di Rajo a guardian of Italian viticultural history, ensuring that their wines represent a 100% handcrafted legacy.

title: Lucien Muzard Santenay 'Champs Claude' Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Santenay appellation of the Côte de Beaune, France, the Lucien Muzard Santenay Champs Claude Blanc reflects a deep-rooted family heritage dating back to 1645. Currently managed by brothers Claude and Hervé Muzard, the estate focuses on low-impact viticulture and transitioned to organic and biodynamic practices starting in 2005. Their winemaking philosophy emphasizes elegance and energy, utilizing a mix of tank and barrel aging to produce wines that express the unique mineral character of their limestone-rich soils.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay is medium to full bodied with a sensory profile defined by precision and brightness. On the nose, it offers a lively bouquet of lemon zest, fresh pear, and hazelnuts, while the palate reveals a rich intensity with notes of citrus curd, white pepper, and a distinct saline minerality. The wine is structured with a subtle creamy texture from malolactic fermentation and 10 months of barrel aging, leading to a long, persistent mineral finish.

title: Pol Roger Brut Vintage Blanc de Blanc 2016
bodyHtml:
This prestigious sparkling wine originates from the Champagne region of France, specifically crafted from the renowned Grand Cru vineyards of the Côte des Blancs. Founded in 1849 by Pol Roger, the house remains a fiercely independent, family-run enterprise now managed by the fifth generation of his descendants. The winery is celebrated for its traditional philosophy, still employing a small team of manual riddlers a rarity in modern Champagne production to maintain the personal attention to detail that once captivated Sir Winston Churchill.

Wine Description

The 2016 Pol Roger Brut Vintage Blanc de Blanc displays a crystal-clear appearance with silvery tints and a delicate, persistent mousse. The bouquet is pure and direct, initially revealing fine minerality and white flowers before opening into complex aromas of grapefruit, candied lemon, and fresh croissants. On the palate, the wine is exceptionally fresh and crisp with a crunchy texture, featuring notes of citrus zest and toasted overtones balanced by a firm saline finish. This 100% Chardonnay cuvée is aged for six years in deep, cool cellars 33 metres below ground, resulting in a refined body and remarkable structural balance.

title: Monteleone Anthemis Etna Bianco 2023
bodyHtml:
Monteleone Anthemis Etna Bianco 2023 is a premium white wine produced on the volcanic slopes of Mount Etna in Sicily, Italy. The Monteleone project was established in July 2017 by food and wine journalist Giulia Monteleone, her father Enrico, and her husband, winemaker Benedetto Alessandro. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a non-interventional approach that respects the extreme environment of the volcano, utilizing native yeasts and minimal handling to craft wines that evoke the elegance and charm of their unique terroir.

Wine Description

This wine presents a refined straw yellow colour and a complex sensory profile defined by its volcanic origins. The nose offers an intense spectrum of citrus notes, white blossom, jasmine, and orange blossom, complemented by a rich minerality and hints of white pepper, wax, and deep cedar. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and vibrant, displaying a delightful tapestry of luscious yellow fruits, peach, and pineapple balanced by a tense, firm acidity. The structure is tight-knit and focused, leading to a long, captivating finish marked by a clean citrus return and salty minerality. Crafted from 100% Carricante grapes, the wine typically has an ABV of 12.5% and undergoes aging for six months in stainless steel followed by bottle refinement before release. The vineyards are certified organic.

title: Poggio Landi Rosso di Montalcino 2022
bodyHtml:
This red wine comes from Italy, specifically from the Rosso di Montalcino DOC in Tuscany. Poggio Landi is part of the Alejandro Bulgheroni Family Vineyards, which also includes the neighboring Podere Brizio. The estate’s vineyards are spread across some of Montalcino's most prestigious areas, ranging from 180 to 500 meters in altitude. Poggio Landi is known for its traditional approach and commitment to organic viticulture, producing wines that are celebrated for their elegance and strong connection to the unique Pliocene clay and marl soils of the region.

Wine Description

The Poggio Landi Rosso di Montalcino is often referred to as a "baby Brunello," offering a youthful and vibrant expression of the estate’s terroir.

  • Appearance: A deep, pretty ruby red color.

  • Nose: The bouquet is exuberant and fresh, featuring classic aromas of wild red berries, sour cherries, and blue flowers. These are complemented by subtle notes of cinnamon, orange peel, and earthy undertones like forest floor.

  • Palate: On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and energetic. It strikes a balance between juicy red fruit and a savory, earthy core. The texture is defined by velvety yet chalky tannins and a lively acidity that leads to a clean, persistent finish with hints of licorice and spice.

  • Technical Details: 100% Sangiovese. The wine undergoes spontaneous fermentation with indigenous yeasts for about 15 days, followed by 12 months of aging in large, untoasted 54hl French oak barrels and 3 months of bottle refinement. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 13.5% to 14%.

Food Pairing

This wine's refreshing acidity and structured tannins make it a fantastic companion for food. It pairs excellently with traditional Tuscan fare such as ossobuco, Florentine steak, or pasta with wild boar ragout. It also complements duck breast with ginger red cabbage, charcuterie boards featuring prosciutto and salami, and aged cheeses like Pecorino. For the best experience, serve it at 16-18°C (60-64°F) and consider decanting it for 30 minutes to let the aromatics open up.

title: Ferreira 'Dona Antionia' Reserve Tawny
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Douro region of Portugal, Ferreira Dona Antonia Reserve Tawny is a benchmark Port wine that pays tribute to one of the industry's most legendary figures. The House of Ferreira was founded in 1751 and remains an iconic symbol of Portuguese winemaking, largely due to the visionary leadership of Dona Antonia Adelaide Ferreira in the 19th century. Known affectionately as 'Ferreirinha', she revolutionized viticulture in the Douro Valley through her entrepreneurial spirit and deep commitment to the region's people and land.

Wine Description

This reserve Port displays a beautiful red colour with intense tawny shades that reflect its slow maturation in oak casks. The bouquet is rich and aromatic, featuring notes of very ripe plum, apricot, and marmalade alongside delicate floral hints. On the palate, it is a full bodied and well balanced wine that develops complex flavours of spices and roasted nuts through oxidative aging. The experience concludes with an elegant and persistent finish that blends sweetness with a light, saline tang.

title: Masi Costasera Riserva Amarone 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This prestigious red wine is produced in the Veneto region of northern Italy, specifically within the Valpolicella Classica zone. The Masi estate has a storied history dating back to 1772 when the Boscaini family acquired the Vaio dei Masi valley, and today the family continues to manage the property with a focus on traditional Venetian winemaking. The 'Costasera' name refers to the vineyard slopes that face the sunset, benefiting from the reflected light of Lake Garda and a mild climate that is ideal for the drying process.

Wine Description

The Masi Costasera Riserva Amarone is an opaque, dark red wine with an intense and complex sensory profile. The nose is dominated by super-ripe fruit aromas, including baked plums and cherries, layered with notes of cinnamon, vanilla, toasted coffee, and cocoa. On the palate, it is warm, majestic, and full-bodied, offering concentrated flavours of cooked cherries, cloves, and blackberry jam balanced by a refreshing acidity and velvety tannins. The wine is a blend of 70% Corvina, 15% Rondinella, 10% Oseleta, and 5% Molinara. It is aged for at least 38 months in Slavonian oak barrels and has an ABV of 15.5%.

title: Elvio Cogno Dolcetto D'Alba Mandorlo 2023
bodyHtml:
This vibrant red wine is produced in the Piedmont region of Italy, specifically within the renowned Ravera subzone of the Novello commune. The Elvio Cogno winery has been cultivating grapes in the heart of the Langhe since 1936, though the modern estate was famously established by Elvio Cogno in 1990 to focus on high-quality crus. The family's winemaking philosophy centres on a low-intervention approach that respects the local ecosystem and highlights the specific terroir of their one-hectare 'Mandorlo' (Almond) parcel.

Wine Description

The Elvio Cogno Dolcetto d'Alba Il Mandorlo presents an intense ruby red colour with distinct violet reflections. The bouquet is rich and expressive, bursting with aromas of ripe black cherry, blackberry, and plum, underpinned by delicate notes of violet, herbal spices, and a hint of liquorice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and harmonious, offering a refreshing tension with flavours of juicy dark fruit and sweet spices. It is characterized by its elegant, well-integrated tannins and a long, persistent finish that features a classic, slightly bitter almond note.

title: Remelluri Reserva Rioja 2017
bodyHtml:
This red wine comes from the Rioja region of Spain, specifically from the historic La Granja Nuestra Señora de Remelluri estate situated in the Rioja Alavesa subregion. The property has been a site of viticulture since the 10th century when it was founded by monks, but the modern era began when Jaime Rodriguez purchased the estate in 1967. Today, the winery is led by his children, Telmo and Amaia Rodriguez, who have reclaimed the estate's tradition of producing genuine 'chateau' wines exclusively from their own vineyards.

Wine Description

The 2017 Remelluri Reserva is a deep garnet red with ruby reflections. Its intense nose reveals aromas of ripe blackcurrants and cherries, layered with tobacco, vanilla, and sweet spices like cinnamon. The palate is round and well structured, offering flavours of wild berries and earth balanced by polished, velvety tannins and a precise acidity. The finish is long and balsamic with a distinct mineral character. The estate has followed organic farming practices for decades and received full organic certification in 2010.

title: Delille D2 Red 2022
bodyHtml:
DeLille Cellars D2 Red is a refined and expressive Bordeaux style blend from the Columbia Valley in Washington State, United States. Founded in 1992 by Charles and Greg Lill, Jay Soloff, and winemaker Chris Upchurch, DeLille Cellars was a pioneer in crafting Bordeaux style blends in the region, once being famously described as 'the Lafite Rothschild of Washington' by critic Robert Parker. The winery's philosophy is rooted in the belief that a well-crafted blend transcends the sum of its individual parts, a principle that guided the creation of D2 as their most sought-after label.

Wine Description

The aromatic profile is complex and layered, featuring initial scents of black cherry, ripe plum, and cassis, followed by nuances of milk chocolate, tobacco leaf, and crushed graphite. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied yet supple, displaying flavours of blackberry, blueberry compote, and red currant interwoven with hints of dried herbs, clove, and baking chocolate. It is defined by a luscious mouthfeel, powdery tannins, and mouthwatering acidity that lead to a long, seamless finish marked by cocoa nibs and preserved violets.

Food Pairing

It pairs exceptionally well with roasted or grilled red meats, such as steak and lamb, as well as game meats including wild boar or pork chops. For a more complex pairing, consider butternut squash risotto with black truffles or pasta dishes featuring wild mushrooms. The wine's acidity and dark fruit notes also complement aged hard cheeses and blue cheese.

title: Hinomaru Craft Gin
bodyHtml:
Hinomaru Gin Craft (also known as Kura-Fudo) is a premium Japanese gin produced by the historic Kiuchi Brewery in Ibaraki Prefecture. With a heritage in sake brewing dating back to 1823, Kiuchi is world-renowned for its Hitachino Nest Beer and more recently its Hinomaru Whisky. This gin represents a fusion of traditional fermentation and modern distillation; it is unique for using a rice shochu (Junmai) base that is gently aged in cedar barrels (the same wood used for traditional sake vats) before being infused with 12 carefully selected botanicals.

Spirit Description

The gin is crystal clear but possesses a notably velvety, oily texture—a hallmark of its aged rice spirit base. On the nose, it is a vibrant citrus explosion, moving away from the typical pine-heavy juniper profile to highlight fragrant yuzu and local Fukurai mandarins. These are supported by the floral notes of cherry blossom leaves and the earthy depth of green tea. On the palate, the entry is smooth and zesty, followed by the distinctive "electric" spice of sansho pepper. The finish is long and complex, offering refined minerality and a soft, woody undertone from the cedar barrel maturation. It is bottled at a bold 47% ABV.

Food Pairing

The citrus-forward and peppery profile of Hinomaru Gin Craft makes it a natural partner for Japanese and fusion cuisine. It pairs exceptionally well with sushi and sashimi, particularly fatty fish like salmon or yellowtail, where the yuzu acidity cleanses the palate. The sansho pepper notes make it a brilliant match for yakitori (grilled chicken skewers) or tempura, as the spirit cuts through the richness of the fried batter. For a western pairing, try it with a creamy goat cheese or a citrus-infused panna cotta.

title: JJ Prum Wehlener Sonnenuhr Kabinett Riesling 2020
bodyHtml:
This esteemed white wine originates from the Mosel region of Germany, specifically from the world-famous Wehlener Sonnenuhr ('Sundial of Wehlen') vineyard. The Joh. Jos. Prüm estate was founded in 1911 by Johann Josef Prüm following a family inheritance split, and it has since become one of the most iconic white wine producers in the world. Today, the winery is led by Dr. Manfred Prüm and his daughter Katharina, the fourth generation of the family to manage the estate, maintaining a philosophy of minimal intervention and traditional winemaking.

Wine Description

The 2020 JJ Prum Wehlener Sonnenuhr Kabinett is a pale yellow Riesling with a complex and delicate sensory profile. The nose is sublime and slightly flinty, offering aromas of stewed apricots, white peach, and green berries mixed with white florals and a touch of mandarin. On the palate, the wine is round and lush yet remarkably refined, featuring a vibrant core of acidity that balances its light sweetness and provides a 'crystalline' texture. The finish is long and sustainably salty, highlighting the deep grey slate terroir of the steep Wehlen slopes.

title: Hinomaru Whisky Signature 1823 - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Hinomaru Whisky Signature 1823 is a commemorative single malt produced by Kiuchi Brewing and Distilling to mark the 200th anniversary of the company's founding. While Kiuchi is world-famous for its sake and Hitachino Nest Beer, this whisky showcases their expertise at the Yasato Distillery at the foot of Mount Tsukuba. The spirit is crafted using locally grown barley from the Hitachino region and is matured in a complex triple-cask arrangement of bourbon, sherry, and rum barrels. This expression is a cornerstone of their core range, representing the brand's shift from a historic sake brewery to a modern global player in the Japanese whisky scene.

Spirit Description

The whisky displays a bright golden hue in the glass. On the nose, it offers an elegant and striking bouquet where floral aromas of chamomile and saffron meet sweet notes of vanilla, toasted cereal, and peach. The palate is well-structured and refined, delivering layers of ripe apricot, gingerbread, and honeyed sweetness, balanced by a distinct mineral quality. Despite its youth, the influence of the three cask types provides a subtle complexity, with the rum barrels contributing a hint of tropical warmth.

Food Pairing

It pairs beautifully with umami-rich Japanese dishes such as miso-glazed black cod or mushroom risotto, where the whisky's mineral edge and light spice complement the savory flavors. For a more casual pairing, try it with grilled yakitori or tempura; the 48% ABV and crisp acidity help cut through the richness of the charcoal-grilled meat or fried batter.

title: Dirty Laundry Hush Red 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Dirty Laundry Hush Red hails from the Summerland subregion of the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. The winery is built upon a colourful history dating back to the late 1800s, named after a Chinese immigrant's laundry business that famously doubled as a gambling den and brothel for Canadian Pacific Railway workers. Today, the winery is owned by a partnership including Bob Campbell and Neil MacGillivray, who maintain a winemaking philosophy focused on making approachable, fun, and 'never snooty' wines that remain accessible to everyone.

Wine Description

This vibrant red blend presents a smooth and easy-drinking sensory profile, characteristic of its medium-bodied structure. The nose is bright and expressive, bursting with aromas of pomegranate, raspberry jam, and cherry cola. On the palate, the wine is fruit-forward and juicy, featuring flavours of ripe strawberry, black currant, and cherry candy, complemented by a subtle pop of warm cinnamon spice and a hint of vanilla.

title: JJ Prum Wehlener Sonnenuhr Auslese Riesling 2018
bodyHtml:
This prestigious white wine originates from the Mosel region of Germany, specifically from the world-famous Wehlener Sonnenuhr vineyard. The estate of Joh. Jos. Prüm, founded in 1911 by Johann Josef Prüm, has remained a family-owned benchmark for quality in the Middle Mosel for over a century. Today, the winery is managed by Katharina Prüm, who maintains the estate's philosophy of meticulous, traditional winemaking and low yields to ensure the purest expression of Riesling from their extraordinarily steep slate slopes.

Wine Description

The 2018 JJ Prum Wehlener Sonnenuhr Auslese is a straw golden colour with a seductive and complex sensory profile. The nose is heady and intense, featuring aromas of honeyed melon, apricot blossom, and white peach, accented by herbal notes and a distinctive hint of flinty petrol. On the palate, the wine is luscious and creamy yet surprisingly vibrant, offering a symphony of tropical fruits like mangosteen and fresh pineapple balanced by a piquant, salty minerality and electric acidity.

title: Podere San Cristoforo Luminoso 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Podere San Cristoforo Luminoso is a vibrant white wine from the Maremma Toscana DOC region of Italy. The winery was founded by Lorenzo Zonin, who took over the property after years of neglect and restored it using a biodynamic approach to safeguard the land. Situated in a unique micro-zone caressed by ocean breezes, the estate focuses on minimal intervention winemaking to produce wines that authentically express their volcanic, mineral-rich terroir.

Wine Description

Luminoso presents as a dense and rich white wine characterized by its clarity and freshness. The sensory profile features a fragrant bouquet of apricot, yellow plum, and pineapple, accented by floral notes of acacia, daisies, and broom, with subtle hints of mint and cedar. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and juicy with a supple, glyceric texture and flavors of citrus peel and pulpy lemon fruit. The structure is defined by a crisp acidity and a savory, mineral finish that provides excellent persistence and balance.

title: Nicolas Potel Chablis 2025
bodyHtml:
Nicolas Potel Chablis is a white wine produced in the Burgundy region of France. Nicolas Potel, a prominent winemaker and négociant, founded Maison Nicolas Potel in 1998. Although the brand name was sold to the Cottin brothers (owners of Labouré-Roi) in 2008, the wines continue to be produced under this label, maintaining a reputation for quality and value. Potel himself now focuses on his own estates, Domaine de Bellene and Maison Roche de Bellene. The Chablis bottlings under the Nicolas Potel label are known for their classic, terroir-driven style that emphasizes the region's unique calcareous soils.

Wine Description

  • Appearance: A gleaming pale gold or bright straw yellow with lovely brilliance.

  • Nose: Elegant and fresh, featuring aromas of green apple, lemon zest, and white peach. These are often complemented by delicate floral notes, hints of honeysuckle, and a distinct flinty or chalky minerality.

  • Palate: The wine is typically medium-bodied and well-balanced. It offers a lively entry with flavors of citrus and stone fruits, supported by a saline or "oyster shell" minerality. The texture can show a faint creaminess, leading to a long, clean finish marked by refreshing acidity.

  • Technical Details: Made from 100% Chardonnay. The wine usually has an alcohol by volume (ABV) of 12.5% to 13% and is bottled under a natural cork.

Food Pairing

This wine is a classic partner for seafood and light summer fare. Its crisp acidity and mineral backbone make it a perfect match for raw oysters, grilled sea bass, or crab cakes. It also pairs wonderfully with creamy chicken tarragon, Caesar salad, or mild soft cheeses like Chaource. Because of its clean finish, it can even stand up to lightly spiced Asian dishes, such as squid nigiri or steamed prawns.

title: Oremus Aszu 5 Puttonyos 2018
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Oremus Aszu 5 Puttonyos is a prestigious sweet dessert wine from the Tokaj region in northeast Hungary. The Oremus estate, recognized for its excellence since 1630, was acquired in 1993 by the renowned Spanish winemaking group Vega Sicilia. Under the stewardship of the Álvarez family, the winery blends centuries-old traditions with modern techniques, utilizing UNESCO World Heritage vineyards and centuries-old underground volcanic galleries for aging. The winemaking philosophy centers on achieving a perfect balance between vibrant acidity and opulent sweetness, with production only possible in favorable vintages that allow for 'noble rot' (Botrytis cinerea).

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a bright light yellow to deep golden hue. The complex sensory profile features intense aromas of ripe peach, apricot, and dried fruits, evolving into notes of orange marmalade, honey, and floral jasmine. On the palate, it is full-bodied and velvety, offering concentrated flavours of candied orange peel, nectarine, and quince, accented by hints of hazelnut praline, stem ginger, and vanilla. The structure is defined by a dense texture and a bracing acidity that carves through the intense sweetness, leading to an exceptionally long and refined finish.

title: Mayacamas Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Mayacamas Chardonnay is a mountain grown wine from the Mount Veeder subregion of Napa Valley in the United States. Established in 1889 by John Henry Fisher, the winery is one of Napa Valley's most historic estates and is famed for its stone cellar built from local materials. After decades of ownership by the Taylor and Travers families, the Schottenstein family purchased the property in 2013 and continues to uphold a winemaking philosophy rooted in classical traditions and the unique volcanic terroir of the site.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay presents a pale gold hue and a sensory profile characterized by its non-malolactic, high-elevation style. The wine opens with lifted aromatics of chamomile, yuzu, and marzipan, accented by notes of honeyed citrus, orange blossom, and pencil shavings. On the palate, it is compact and layered, offering vibrant flavours of tangerine, white peach, and Bartlett pear supported by drive, energy, and secondary notes of bergamot and green cardamom. The wine is medium-bodied with a long, clean finish that lingers with orchard fruit, flint rock, and distinct salinity.

title: Glaswegin Raspberry & Rhubarb Gin
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

Glaswegin Raspberry & Rhubarb Gin is produced in Scotland, within the region of Glasgow and the subregion of Tradeston. The brand was founded by Andy McGeoch, who sought to create a 'truly overt' gin for the city of Glasgow. Distilled in small batches under a railway bridge, the gin is crafted in a handcrafted copper alembic still manufactured in Portugal.

2. Spirit Description

This elegantly pink gin is made with 100% natural ingredients, adding Scottish raspberries and rhubarb to a signature blend of eight botanicals. The nose offers aromas of warm raspberry jam and candied rhubarb, accompanied by notes of vanilla custard and rhubarb crumble. On the palate, it is uncompromisingly fruity and creamy with flavours of raspberry ripple ice cream, orange flower, and bright lemon. The body is smooth and well balanced, featuring milk thistle, coriander, and pink peppercorns that provide an aromatic warmth. It concludes with a long, refreshing finish marked by a pink peppercorn tingle and lemon peel. Glaswegin Raspberry & Rhubarb Gin is bottled at an ABV of 37.5%.

title: Doble 9 Ron Gran Reserva - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Doble 9 Ron Gran Reserva is an authentic Cuban rum produced by Beveland Distillers, a brand heavily inspired by the vibrant social culture and identity of Cuba. The name pays homage to the most popular variant of dominoes played on the island, where the "double nine" is the highest tile. True to the Cuban tradition of light and dry spirits, this rum is distilled from high-quality molasses using column stills. It is crafted without added sugars or flavorings, positioning it as a traditional and honest representation of the island's sugar production heritage.

Spirit Description

This rum presents a dark amber, almost mahogany color, with a body that is surprisingly syrupy and rich for a light Cuban style. On the nose, it offers a delicate bouquet of light tropical fruits, vanilla, and a hint of floral sweetness. The palate is smooth and persistent, delivering a unique transition from woody oak notes to a distinct almond-sweet finish. Fans of the spirit often note subtle undertones of caramel, citrus, and a faint medicinal phenol quality that adds complexity. Despite its deep color and mature flavors, it is bottled at a approachable 38% ABV, making it a soft and easy-sipping spirit.

title: Road 13 John Oliver Malbec 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Road 13 John Oliver Malbec is a premium red wine from the Golden Mile Bench sub-GI in the Okanagan Valley of British Columbia, Canada. Founded in 2003 by Pam and Mick Luckhurst on the site of a former orchard, the winery is now owned by the von Mandl Family Estates, which continues its legacy of crafting bold wines that reflect the southern Okanagan terroir. The winemaking philosophy is rooted in a 'hands in the soil' approach, emphasizing sustainable farming and a deep respect for the land to produce wines with intense, balanced flavours.

Wine Description

This full-bodied Malbec is characterized by a rich sensory profile and elegant structure. On the nose, it offers deep aromatics of dark cherry, raspberry, and blackcurrant, complemented by earthy tones and hints of spice. The palate is lush and layered, featuring flavours of dark chocolate covered blueberries and cherry Nibs balanced by vibrant acidity and polished tannins. The finish is lengthy, showing subtle notes of caramel, vanilla, and glossy oak. This wine was aged for 18 months in French oak barrels, of which 45% were new, to enhance its complexity and texture. While Road 13 follows a rigorous organic program and farms sustainably, specific organic certification for this bottling is not explicitly noted. The wine has an ABV of 13.5%.

title: Road 13 John Oliver Syrah 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Road 13 John Oliver Syrah is a premium red wine originating from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada, with grapes primarily sourced from the Golden Mile Bench and Black Sage Bench sub-regions. Established in 2003 on the site of a former orchard, Road 13 was acquired in 2018 by Anthony von Mandl, joining a portfolio of prestigious estates that emphasize independent winemaking and regional storytelling. The winery operates with a 'vineyard first' philosophy, focusing on sustainable practices and high-quality, bold southern wines that authentically express the local terroir.

Wine Description

This flagship Syrah presents an inky and inviting colour with a complex sensory profile. The nose features heady aromatics of plush blackberry, rich blueberry, and warm notes of holiday cake, black fig, and cedar. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and textured, displaying a vibrant, crisp acidity and layered flavours of blue fruit, mocha, and dark chocolate-covered cherry. It exhibits a refined structure with polished, glossy oak and supple tannins that lead to a lengthy, complex finish characterized by cherry and white pepper.

title: Chloe Prosecco
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Chloe Prosecco is an elegant sparkling wine from the Prosecco DOC in the Veneto region of Northern Italy. The Chloe Wine Collection, named after the Greek word for 'blooming', is a portfolio of award-winning wines crafted to showcase fragrant aromas and captivating layers. The collection has been developed under the expertise of experienced female winemakers like Georgetta Dane and Andrea Brambila, who focus on sourcing premium fruit from the world's most prized vineyards.

Wine Description

This wine is light straw yellow in colour with greenish hues and features a fine, silky mousse. The sensory profile is defined by an inviting nose of white flowers, apple blossom, and citrus, alongside notes of peach, green apple, and white guava. On the palate, it is light-bodied and refreshing, offering flavours of pears and tangerines balanced by an opulent yet elegant acidity. The finish is crisp and clean, revealing a hint of minerality that reflects the calcareous soils and mountain proximity of the vineyards. Crafted from 100% Glera grapes, this sparkling wine has an ABV of 11%.

title: Bonanza The Vinekeeper Napa Cabernet Sauvignon Lot 1 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
Bonanza The Vinekeeper Napa Cabernet Sauvignon Lot 1 is a premium red wine from the Napa Valley region in the United States. Launched in 2019, Bonanza is a project by Chuck Wagner, the owner and winemaker of the world-renowned Caymus Vineyards, who was inspired by his father Charlie Wagner Sr.'s love for an accessible glass of wine with daily meals. While the original Bonanza series explores diverse vineyard sites across California, 'The Vinekeeper' is a new series designed to showcase specific standout regions over time, with this debut release focused exclusively on the prestigious Napa Valley.

Wine Description

This debut release presents a medium ruby colour and a sensory profile that is rich, fruit-driven, and beautifully balanced. The nose is a captivating symphony of sun-drenched currants, dried roses, and grape pomace, with nuances of toasty oak that impart a subtle smoked meat and earthy character. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and plush, offering an orchestra of ripe blackberry, blueberry, and cocoa-dusted cherries. It features striking smoothness with silky tannins and hints of vanilla, cassis, and toasted bread. The finish is lengthy and mouthwatering, trailing off with notes of dark chocolate. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon typically has an ABV of 14.1% and is not certified organic.

title: Bonanza Chardonnay Lot 1 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
Bonanza Chardonnay Lot 1 is a white wine produced from diverse vineyard sites across California, United States. The Bonanza brand was launched in 2019 by Chuck Wagner, the owner and winemaker of the renowned Caymus Vineyards. Inspired by his father Charlie Wagner Sr., Chuck Wagner created Bonanza to celebrate the simple pleasure of enjoying a high-quality, accessible wine with everyday meals.

Wine Description

This wine is intentionally crafted in a non-traditional style for California, avoiding a heavy buttery or oak-driven profile in favour of a pure expression of the varietal. It presents a light straw colour and a vibrant sensory profile featuring aromas of light melon and fresh flowers. On the palate, the wine is bright and fresh with a slightly viscous mouthfeel and flavours of citrus, lemon peel, and green apple.
