It is medium to full-bodied with a crisp, dry finish and well-balanced acidity. This Chardonnay is unoaked and has an ABV of 13.7%.

title: Cedar Creek 'Crafted In BC' Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

CedarCreek Crafted In BC Pinot Noir 2024 is a unique release from the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia, Canada, born of necessity following a devastating January 2024 cold snap that destroyed over 90% of the local grape crop. Established in 1988, CedarCreek is one of British Columbia's original eight estate wineries and is currently owned by the von Mandl Family, who also oversee estates like Mission Hill. The winery operates under a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes a deep connection to the land and a commitment to sustainable, cool-climate viticulture.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir presents a deep ruby colour and a sensory profile characterized by its resilience and fruit concentration. The nose offers fresh red fruit aromas of cherries and red currants that transition into delicate notes of potpourri and violets. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and silky, displaying vibrant flavours of black plum and wild cassis alongside savoury herbs and an earthy cedar underside. The finish is clean and lingering, marked by subtle hints of spice and cracked pepper. Due to the 2024 crop loss, this specific 'Crafted In BC' bottling was produced using premium fruit secured from renowned cool-climate vineyards in Oregon's Willamette Valley region. The wine has an ABV of 13.5% and, while the estate vineyards are certified organic, this out-of-province fruit sourcing means the wine is not labeled as organic.

title: Marie Brizard Yuzu Liqueur - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Marie Brizard Yuzu Liqueur (often designated as No. 17 in their range) is an exotic and innovative spirit from the historic French house of Marie Brizard, founded in Bordeaux in 1755. This liqueur is a modern tribute to the yuzu fruit, a staple of Japanese gastronomy. To create this expression, the distillery uses natural essential oils extracted from fresh yuzu, ensuring the delicate and complex citrus profile is preserved. It is crafted without preservatives or artificial dyes, reflecting the brand's long-standing commitment to botanical clarity and quality.

Description

The liqueur is crystal clear and colorless. On the nose, it offers a subtle yet high-toned bouquet of citrus fruits, specifically mimicking the unique aroma of fresh yuzu peel—a blend of grapefruit, lime, and mandarin orange. On the palate, it is fresh and zesty with a balanced play between tart acidity and light sweetness. Unlike many syrupy citrus liqueurs, it maintains a clean mouthfeel with a distinctive, slightly bitter pithy edge on the finish that mimics the authentic taste of the raw fruit.

Food Pairing

The refreshing acidity and bright citrus notes of Marie Brizard Yuzu make it a versatile partner for light, fresh flavors. It is an exceptional match for seafood, particularly sushi, scallops, or fish tartare, where its citrus lift cuts through the richness of the fish. It also pairs beautifully with fresh, creamy cheeses like burrata or a light goat cheese. For dessert, it is an ideal companion for lemon tarts, fruit sorbets, or panna cotta. It is most commonly used by bartenders to add an "oriental" twist to classic cocktails like the Margarita or a French 75, though it is equally elegant served simply on the rocks.

title: Herradura 'Legend' Anejo Tequila
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Herradura Legend is a super-premium Añejo tequila that stands as a permanent, high-end addition to the Casa Herradura portfolio. Launched to celebrate the brand's pioneering spirit, having introduced both the Reposado and Extra Añejo categories to the world, this expression is defined by a unique barrel treatment. It is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave, naturally fermented with wild yeast, and matured for 14 months. What sets Legend apart is the use of specialized, heavily charred new American white oak barrels that have been deeply grooved to increase the surface area, allowing the spirit to interact more intensely with the toasted wood.

Spirit Description

This tequila possesses an intense, deep amber color. On the nose, it is rich and multi-dimensional, offering aromas of toasted oak, dried fruits, and citrus, anchored by sweet vanilla, caramel, and a distinct hint of roasted agave smoke. The palate is velvety and full-bodied; the unique grooved barrel aging provides bold flavors of dark chocolate, charred wood, and caramelized fruit, balanced by the herbal and peppery notes characteristic of Herradura's Lowland agave. The finish is exceptionally smooth and long-lasting, leaving a trail of toasted nuts, warm spice, and a lingering buttery sweetness. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

Food Pairing

The deep, woody, and chocolatey profile of Herradura Legend makes it an ideal candidate for pairing with rich, savory, or sweet dishes. It is a magnificent match for charcoal-grilled steaks or braised short ribs, where the charred oak notes of the tequila complement the smoky sear of the meat. For a more traditional pairing, try it with a rich Mole Poblano; the sauce's complex blend of chocolate and chili harmonizes perfectly with the spirit's cocoa and spice undertones. For dessert, it pairs beautifully with dark chocolate lava cake or an apple tart with caramel sauce. It is best enjoyed neat in a wide-rimmed glass or over a single large ice cube to appreciate its whiskey-like complexity.

title: Strathcona Spirits 'Dreamland on Fire' Canadian Whisky
bodyHtml:
Dreamland on Fire is a poignant, limited-edition release from Strathcona Spirits Distillery, Edmonton’s first craft distillery. This whisky was created to commemorate the first anniversary of a devastating fire that occurred at the distillery on December 18, 2024. The spirit is a literal "survivor," crafted from a selection of casks that were stored in a part of the building that evaded the flames. Released in late December 2025, it serves as both a tribute to the distillery's resilience and a "thank you" to the community that supported them during their year-long recovery.

Spirit Description

This expression is the 13th release in the distillery's experimental Dreamland series. It is a 7-year-old blended whisky featuring a high-rye base blended with single malt. True to the distillery’s penchant for unique cask finishes, this survivor’s blend was matured in Armagnac and Cognac casks, which imparts a sophisticated, old-world fruitiness to the rugged Alberta grain.

On the nose, it offers a complex profile of toasted oak, dried stone fruits, and a hint of the signature rye spice. The palate is rich and velvety, delivering deep notes of apricot, plum, and honey from the brandy casks, balanced by a sharp, peppery finish. It is bottled at 44.4% ABV, offering a robust but elegant drinking experience.

title: Strathcona Spirits Velvet Cream
bodyHtml:
Strathcona Spirits Velvet Cream is an artisanal, small-batch cream liqueur produced by Edmonton’s flagship craft distillery. Unlike mass-market cream liqueurs that often rely on artificial flavor compounds, Velvet Cream is defined by its "bark and bean" infusion process. It features a unique base spirit—a blend of Puerto Rican rum and Canadian Prairie rye.

Spirit Description

The liqueur has a rich, velvety texture and a pale cream appearance. On the nose, it is highly aromatic, dominated by the scent of authentic Madagascar Bourbon vanilla beans. On the palate, it delivers a lush, "nondenominational" sweetness that is balanced by subtle, earthy, and herbal undertones derived from infusions of Birch Bark and Red Willow. These local botanical additions provide a hint of "caramelized wood" that prevents the liqueur from being cloying.

title: Dingle Gin – 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Dingle Original Gin is produced in Ireland, within the County Kerry region on the Dingle Peninsula. The Dingle Distillery was founded in 2012 by Oliver Hughes, Liam LaHart, and Peter Mosley in a converted sawmill. It was the first purpose built, privately owned distillery to open in Ireland in over 150 years and is owned by the Porterhouse Brewing Company.

Spirit Description

This artisan gin is categorized as a London Dry style but is distinguished by the use of locally foraged botanicals including rowan berry, fuchsia, bog myrtle, hawthorn, and heather. The nose is clean and classic with bright juniper and piney notes, accompanied by a floral brightness from angelica stems and minty undernotes. On the palate, it begins with juniper and a jammy, fruity character, followed by a sudden cooling freshness of mint and eucalyptus. The body is crisp and well balanced, featuring a peppery finish of coriander and cubeb pepper. Dingle Original Gin is bottled at 42.5% ABV using water drawn from an onsite deep well.

title: Domaine Gobelsburg Riesling 2021
bodyHtml:
This white wine hails from Austria, specifically the Kamptal region. Schloss Gobelsburg is the oldest winery in the area, with a history tracing back to 1171 when it was managed by Cistercian monks. Today, the estate is led by Michael Moosbrugger. The Domaene Gobelsburg line represents their regional selection, crafted to be an accessible and representative expression of the Kamptal terroir. The winery focuses on sustainable practices and minimal intervention, often utilizing fruit from younger vines in esteemed vineyards like Gaisberg and Heiligenstein.

Wine Description

The Domaine Gobelsburg Riesling shows a clear, pale straw color in the glass. On the nose, it is highly aromatic and fresh, revealing scents of green apple, Meyer lemon, and white peach, accompanied by floral notes of jasmine and a subtle, flinty minerality. The palate is light to medium-bodied and bone-dry, characterized by a zippy, racy acidity that provides a sense of energy and lift. It offers clean flavors of citrus zest and stone fruit, leading to a refreshing finish with a lingering touch of salinity. This 100% Riesling is fermented in stainless steel to preserve its delicate aromatics and is bottled with an alcohol by volume (ABV) of approximately 12.5%.

Food Pairing

This wine's bright acidity and clean fruit profile make it an incredibly versatile food companion. It is a classic match for seafood, particularly shellfish, shrimp tempura, or grilled white fish. It also pairs wonderfully with spicy Asian cuisine, such as Thai green curry or Vietnamese spring rolls, where its acidity can temper heat. Additionally, it works well with light poultry dishes and fresh salads featuring goat cheese.

title: Le Serre Nuove Dell' Ornellaia 2023
bodyHtml:
Le Serre Nuove dell'Ornellaia is a premium red wine from the Bolgheri DOC in the Tuscany region of Italy. Produced by the legendary Ornellaia estate, the winery was founded by Lodovico Antinori and is now owned by the Frescobaldi family, who have a 700-year history of winemaking. Known as the estate's 'second vin', Le Serre Nuove is crafted under a philosophy of elegance and balance, serving as a more accessible introduction to the complex terroir and personality of the flagship Ornellaia.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep ruby red colour with a purple rim that highlights its concentration. The aromatic profile is expressive and sophisticated, offering scents of ripe black cherry, forest fruits, and crushed flowers, interwoven with notes of cedar spice, sweet pipe tobacco, sage, and a hint of blood orange. On the palate, it is full-bodied and richly flavoured with a silky, velvety texture. The sensory experience is defined by ripe tannins and refreshing acidity that balance flavours of plum, mocha, and cocoa.

title: Whitebox Pocket Negroni 100 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml:
Whitebox Pocket Negroni is a cult-favorite, ready-to-drink (RTD) cocktail that has redefined the quality expectations for canned spirits. Produced by Whitebox Cocktails, the first bartender-owned and operated production site in the UK, this "pocket rocket" is a full-strength, uncompromising version of the Italian classic. It is designed to deliver the exact dilution and complexity of a bar-made drink in a portable 100ml format, making it a staple for picnics, trains, or home bars.

Spirit Description

The cocktail follows the strict traditional 1:1:1 ratio, using high-caliber components: Porter’s Gin (a modern classic from Aberdeen), a proprietary sweet vermouth, and a bitter Italian aperitif.

  • Nose: Punchy and aromatic, with bold notes of zesty orange peel, forest floor juniper, and herbal wormwood.

  • Palate: It strikes a sophisticated balance between the syrupy sweetness of the vermouth and the aggressive, cleansing bitterness of the aperitif. Expect layers of blood orange, rhubarb, and a peppery botanical bite from the gin.

  • Finish: Long, drying, and bittersweet, with a lingering citrus oils finish. It is bottled at a potent 21.8% ABV, far higher than typical grocery-store canned "spritzes.

Food Pairing & Serving

The intense bitterness and high ABV of the Pocket Negroni require bold, savory partners to balance the palate.

  • The Classics: Pair with salty Marcona almonds, Castelvetrano olives, or a selection of cured meats like spicy salami or prosciutto.

  • Cheese: Mature, umami-rich cheeses like Parmesan, Pecorino, or a tangy blue cheese stand up beautifully to the gin’s botanicals.

  • Main Course: It works surprisingly well with fatty, charred meats like grilled lamb chops or even a rich pepperoni pizza.

  • Serving Tip: This must be served ice cold. You can drink it straight from the can (if chilled thoroughly), but it is best enjoyed poured into a rocks glass over a large block of ice with a fresh orange twist to express the oils

title: Whitebox Classic Cosmo 100 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml:
The Whitebox Classic Cosmo is a sophisticated, bar-quality ready-to-drink (RTD) cocktail that brings the iconic 1990s party classic into a contemporary, portable format. Developed by a team of world-class bartenders, this expression focuses on the "original" roots of the Cosmopolitan—aiming for a profile that is dry, zesty, and balanced rather than cloyingly sweet. Like the rest of the Whitebox "pocket" range, it is designed to provide a perfect serve without the need for shakers or specialized ingredients.

Spirit Description

This cocktail is a vibrant, perfectly proportioned blend of premium vodka, triple sec (orange liqueur), cranberry, and fresh lime.

  • Nose: Bright and inviting with zesty citrus oils and a hint of tart red berries.

  • Palate: It delivers a "more than the sum of its parts" experience, balancing the crispness of the vodka with the distinctive snap of cranberry and the sour tang of lime. The triple sec provides a subtle, sweet orange foundation that rounds out the acidity.

  • Finish: Clean, refreshing, and stylishly dry. It is bottled at 16.8% ABV in a 100ml can, offering a much more authentic strength and mouthfeel than typical low-ABV supermarket cans.

Food Pairing & Serving

The tart-sweet and chic profile of the Classic Cosmo makes it an ideal aperitif or a companion for light, stylish fare.

  • Appetizers: It is a classic match for smoked salmon blinis, shrimp cocktail, or a chicken Caesar salad (the acidity cuts through the creamy dressing).

  • Main Course: Try it with lobster mac and cheese or grilled chicken skewers, where the citrus-tart notes complement the smoke and richness.

  • Dessert: Pairs beautifully with salted dark chocolate truffles or a lemon tart, balancing the sugar with its vibrant acidity.

  • The Perfect Serve: Ensure the can is ice cold. For the full experience, pour it into a chilled Nick & Nora or Martini glass and garnish with a fresh orange peel (flamed if you're feeling fancy) or a lime wedge.

title: Deutz Classic Brut Champagne
bodyHtml:
Deutz Brut Classic is the flagship non-vintage cuvée from Champagne Deutz, a historic house founded in 1838 in the prestigious village of Aÿ. Known for its "understated elegance," this Champagne is widely respected by enthusiasts and critics alike for its consistency and finesse. It is a "multi-vintage" blend, meaning it uses a significant portion of reserve wines to maintain a steady house style year after year.

Wine Description

This Champagne is characterized by its harmony, purity, and silky texture, achieved through long maturation and a lack of oak influence during vinification.

  • Appearance: Intense golden color with extremely fine, persistent bubbles (a signature of the house).

  • Nose: Highly aromatic and fresh. It opens with floral notes like hawthorn and white blossoms, followed by rich scents of toast, marzipan, and ripe pears.

  • Palate: A balanced blend of freshness and richness. It offers flavors of crisp orchard fruits (apple and nectarine), citrus, and a touch of honey or nougat. The finish is long and clean, often showing a distinct chalky or saline minerality.

  • Technical Details: The blend typically consists of approximately one-third each of Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, and Pinot Meunier. It contains about 25–40% reserve wines and is aged for a minimum of three years on its lees (plus six months post-disgorgement). The dosage is usually around 8–9 g/L, and it has an alcohol content of 12% ABV.

Food Pairing

This is an incredibly "eclectic" Champagne that works well from start to finish during a meal. It is an ideal aperitif but also has enough body to accompany fish dishes like salmon tartare, turbot, or sole meunière. Its acidity makes it a famous "foil" for fried foods—such as fish and chips or fried chicken—and it pairs beautifully with creamy seafood pastas. For cheese, try it with soft varieties like Chaource or an aged Parmesan.

title: Telmont Reserve Brut Champagne
bodyHtml:
Telmont Réserve Brut is the signature non-vintage cuvée from Champagne Telmont, a house located in Damery that has surged into the global spotlight recently due to its radical focus on sustainability. Founded in 1912, the house is now backed by investor Leonardo DiCaprio and the Rémy Cointreau group. Telmont is known for its extreme transparency—listing detailed blend and disgorgement data on every label—and its "In the Name of Mother Nature" project, which aims for 100% organic viticulture by 2031.

Wine Description

The Réserve Brut is designed to be a "symphony" of the region's three iconic grapes, balanced to show freshness and maturity simultaneously.

  • Appearance: A delicate golden hue with a fine, steady mousse.

  • Nose: Elegant and complex, featuring aromas of honeysuckle, fresh pear, and green apple, evolving into richer notes of toasted almonds, vanilla, and brioche.

  • Palate: The mouthfeel is round and harmonious, balancing the edginess of Chardonnay with the depth of Pinot Noir. Flavors of mirabelle plum, custard, and lemon curd are supported by a crisp, mineral-driven acidity and a chalky finish.

Food Pairing

This Champagne’s balance of richness and tension makes it highly versatile. It is a perfect match for fresh oysters or a decadent caviar dish. Its creamy texture and acidity also allow it to pair beautifully with tuna tataki, creamy seafood pasta, or light poultry dishes. For a simple but elegant pairing, try it with mild soft cheeses like Chaource or Brie.

title: Ornus Dell'Ornellaia 2020 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Ornus dell'Ornellaia is an exclusive late-harvest dessert wine from the Bolgheri region of Tuscany, Italy. The wine is named after 'Fraxinus Ornus', the Latin name for the Manna Ash tree (Orniello in Italian), which also inspired the name of the Ornellaia estate itself. Established in 1981 by Marchese Lodovico Antinori and currently owned by the historic Frescobaldi family, the estate focuses on a philosophy of 'time, experience, and meditation' to produce wines that express the unique maritime terroir of the Tuscan coast.

Wine Description

This dessert wine presents a bright, signature golden yellow colour in the glass. The nose is intense and complex, featuring sweet honeyed aromas and quince notes alongside hallmark nuances of dried apricot, citrus, and hints of coconut and butterscotch. On the palate, the wine is velvety and multi-layered, showing a vibrant fruit acidity that provides verticality and freshness to balance its concentrated sweetness. The finish is long and harmonious, often revealing a subtle saline element. Crafted from 100% Petit Manseng, the grapes are hand-harvested in multiple passes to select only perfectly dried fruit.

Food Pairing

The complex sweetness and bright acidity of Ornus dell'Ornellaia make it an ideal partner for delicate and creamy desserts. It pairs beautifully with fruit-based dishes such as pear and lime strudel, almond milk jelly with lychees, or a banana trifle. The wine's honey and dried apricot notes also complement desserts featuring vanilla, sweet spices, or caramel, such as crème brûlée or apricot tarts. For a savoury alternative, it can be served with strong, salty blue cheeses or foie gras, which benefit from the wine's rich texture and long finish.

title: Casa Silva S7 Carmenere 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Casa Silva S7 Carmenere is a bold red wine from the Los Lingues vineyard in the Colchagua Valley of Chile. The Silva family's winemaking heritage dates back to 1892 when Emilio Bouchon arrived from Bordeaux, though the winery was officially founded under its own label in 1997. Viña Casa Silva follows a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes innovation and research, particularly into Carmenere clones and microterroirs, to authentically express the unique potential of the Chilean landscape.

Wine Description

This 100% Carmenere is a single-block selection from a 4.8-hectare parcel planted in 1997 at the foot of the Andes Mountains. It presents a deep ruby colour with a violet rim. The aromatic profile is powerful and dense, featuring notes of black currants, black plums, and black cherries intertwined with mocha, cocoa, tobacco, and spicy hints of nutmeg and cardamom. On the palate, the wine is ripe and structured with a silky texture and well integrated, velvety tannins. It offers rich flavours of boysenberry and forest fruits alongside an herbal background of bay leaf and menthol. The finish is long, layered, and elegant, marked by balsamic acidity and spicy touches of black pepper and chocolate.

title: Marques De Riscal Rueda Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Marqués de Riscal Rueda Sauvignon Blanc is an expressive white wine from the Rueda DO in the Castilla y León region of Spain. Founded in 1858 in Rioja, Marqués de Riscal is a pioneering estate that introduced Sauvignon Blanc to Rueda in 1974 and was instrumental in the creation of the Rueda Denominación de Origen in 1980. The winery is currently owned by the heirs of the Marqués de Riscal and maintains a winemaking philosophy that balances its 19th-century roots with innovative, sustainable viticulture.

Wine Description

This wine presents a pale yellow colour with distinct green highlights. The nose is complex and intense, featuring aromas of fresh grass and minerals layered with abundant fresh fruit notes of citrus, pineapple, and melon. On the palate, it is fresh and aromatic with a smooth, well-balanced structure and a long, clean finish. The wine is a single-varietal 100% Sauvignon Blanc crafted from estate-owned vineyards that have been certified organic since the 2018 vintage.

title: Echigo Koshihikari Beer 500 ml - 15 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Echigo Beer, Japan's first microbrewery established in 1994, is located in Niigata Prefecture, a region renowned for its high-quality rice and pristine water. The brewery’s Koshihikari Beer is named after the premium Koshihikari rice, celebrated for its delicate flavor and cultivated in Niigata’s lush fields. This beer exemplifies the harmony of Japanese brewing craftsmanship and local ingredients.

Beer Description
Echigo Koshihikari Beer pours a pale golden color with a crisp, clear appearance. The aroma is light and refreshing, featuring subtle notes of rice, freshly baked bread, and a hint of floral hops. On the palate, it offers a clean and smooth profile, with a mild sweetness from the Koshihikari rice, balanced by a gentle bitterness from the hops. The finish is dry and refreshing, making it an excellent choice for those who appreciate light, elegant lagers.

Food Pairing
This beer pairs wonderfully with sushi, sashimi, or lightly salted edamame. It also complements grilled fish, tempura, or vegetable stir-fries, enhancing the subtle flavors of the dishes. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Moet & Chandon Brut Rose Milestones
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Moët & Chandon Brut Rosé Impérial is a spontaneous and radiant champagne from the Épernay subregion of Champagne, France. Founded in 1743 by Claude Moët, the house is one of the world's most iconic champagne producers and is currently part of the LVMH luxury group. The winemaking philosophy for the Rosé Impérial focuses on a seductive palatal experience that reflects the diversity and complementarity of the three main champagne grape varieties, ensuring a consistent style across every 'milestone' celebration.

Wine Description

This champagne displays a glowing pink colour with dominant amber highlights and a fine, persistent bead. The sensory profile is lively and intense, featuring a bouquet of red fruits such as wild strawberry, raspberry, and cherry, accented by floral nuances of rose and a slight hint of pepper. On the palate, it is medium bodied and supple, offering a juicy intensity of berries followed by the fleshiness of peach and a subtle note of menthol. The structure is defined by a balance of roundness and firmness, leading to a fresh and lingering finish. Composed of 40% to 50% Pinot Noir (of which 10% is red wine), 30% to 40% Pinot Meunier, and 10% to 20% Chardonnay, the blend incorporates 20% to 30% specially selected reserve wines to maintain its signature complexity. It has an ABV of 12% and is not certified organic.

title: Cedar Creek Estate Riesling 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

CedarCreek Estate Riesling is a flagship white wine produced in the Kelowna subregion of the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. CedarCreek Estate Winery was founded in 1986 and is now owned by the von Mandl family, who have transformed it into one of the region's premier estates. The winemaking philosophy is led by Taylor Whelan and focuses on organic farming and cool climate viticulture, utilizing the unique north Kelowna terroir to produce wines with exceptional tension and aromatic purity.

Wine Description

This wine displays a bright, clear straw colour. The sensory profile is incredibly vibrant, featuring a nose of lime zest, green apple, and white peach, often accompanied by floral notes of jasmine and a distinct wet stone minerality. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied and off dry, offering a beautiful balance of juicy citrus fruits, apricot, and honeyed notes. The structure is defined by a bracing, electric acidity that cuts through the subtle residual sugar, leading to a long, crisp, and mouthwatering finish. Crafted from 100% Riesling grapes, the wine is fermented at cool temperatures in stainless steel tanks to preserve its delicate aromatics and freshness.

title: 1731 Fine and Rare Rum 'Belize' 7 Year Old
bodyHtml:
1731 Belize 7 Year Old is a single-origin rum released by the independent bottler 1731 Fine & Rare. The brand takes its name from the year the British Royal Navy officially began issuing rum rations to sailors. This expression is sourced from the famous Travellers Liquors distillery in Belize and is distilled using a traditional column still. Adhering to the 1731 philosophy, the rum is 100% tropically aged for at least seven years in ex-bourbon American white oak barrels and is bottled without added sugar, colorants, or chill-filtration to preserve its authentic character.

Spirit Description

In the glass, the rum displays a lustrous dark gold to amber hue. The nose is inviting and complex, leading with aromas of vanilla, toffee, and toasted oak, followed by warm baking spices like cinnamon and nutmeg, and a touch of tropical fruit. On the palate, the spirit is rich and oily, delivering flavors of butterscotch, juicy mango, and ripe apricot, which transition into savory notes of tobacco, dark chocolate, and roasted coffee. Despite its 46% ABV, the mouthfeel is remarkably velvety and well-integrated. The finish is medium-long and warming, leaving a lingering trail of salted caramel, cocoa, and a faint hint of sweet wood smoke.

title: 1731 Fine and Rare Rum 'Mauritius' 7 Year Old
bodyHtml:
1731 Mauritius 7 Year Old is a single-origin rum released by the Amsterdam-based independent bottler 1731 Fine & Rare. This expression is sourced from the Grays Distillery, one of the oldest and most prestigious distilleries on the island of Mauritius. Unlike many traditional Caribbean rums that focus solely on bourbon barrel aging, this Mauritian rum highlights the island's French heritage through its unique finishing process. It is a molasses-based rum, column-distilled and fully matured in the tropical climate of Mauritius before being bottled at 46% ABV with no added sugar, colorings, or chill-filtration.

Spirit Description

The rum presents a bright golden color. It is most famous for its surprising and vibrant aromatic profile; the nose leads with an unmistakable burst of fresh mint and menthol, layered over fruity notes of peach, grapefruit peel, and green apple. On the palate, the texture is creamy and well-rounded, likely due to its aging for a minimum of seven years in ex-Cognac casks, with select portions of the blend finished in Port and Acacia wood. This combination delivers a complex interplay of spicy oak, gingerbread, and vanilla, with the refreshing minty note persisting throughout. The finish is long, dry, and elegant, leaving a trail of woody tannins and citrus marmalade.

title: Dry Creek Spencers Hill Petite Sirah 2019
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Dry Creek Vineyard Spencer's Hill Petite Sirah 2019 is a robust red wine from the Dry Creek Valley AVA in Sonoma County, United States. Founded in 1972 by David S. Stare, Dry Creek Vineyard was the first new winery built in the region following Prohibition and was instrumental in securing AVA status for the Dry Creek Valley in 1983. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a 'no compromises' approach, focusing on appellation-driven and terroir-focused wines crafted with minimal intervention. Under the second-generation leadership of Kim Stare Wallace, the estate has maintained a long-term commitment to sustainability, becoming 100% Certified Sustainable in 2014.

Wine Description

This full-bodied wine displays a strikingly intense profile and deep, inky colour. The sensory profile features a complex bouquet of blackberry, black cherry, and plum, layered with nuanced aromas of nutmeg, marzipan, and fine leather. On the palate, the wine is dry and opulent, offering concentrated flavours of black currant, cinnamon, and dark chocolate, alongside notes of pie crust and dried herbs. It possesses a deep and rich mouthfeel with firm, well-integrated tannins and a long, lingering finish. This wine is crafted from 100% Petite Sirah grapes sourced from the iconic DCV9 estate vineyard in the Lytton Springs district. It was aged for 17 months in a combination of American and French oak barrels, with 32% new oak used to enhance its complexity.

title: Waterproof Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
bodyHtml:
Waterproof is a modern blended malt Scotch whisky produced by MacDuff International. The brand draws its inspiration from the rugged, rainy landscapes of Scotland and pays homage to Charles Macintosh, the Scottish inventor of the waterproof raincoat (the "Mac"). The name is a clever play on words: "Water" highlights the essential ingredient of the spirit, while "Proof" references the traditional measuring scale for alcohol strength. Unlike standard blends, this is a "pure malt" or blended malt, containing no grain whisky, and is batch-bottled at a higher-than-average strength of 45.8% ABV (91.6 Proof).

Whisky Description

This whisky presents a bright bronze-gold color. It is a sherry-influenced blend, utilizing spirits from a handful of top distilleries aged in a combination of first-fill and second-fill bourbon and sherry casks. The nose is rich and complex, featuring aromas of raisins, apple strudel, and red berry jam, balanced by musty notes of old leather and cereal barley. On the palate, it offers a silky, medium-bodied texture with flavors of toffee apples, dried figs, and fruitcake, accented by espresso and soft baking spices like cinnamon. The finish is long and warming, providing a drying oak quality with lingering hints of malt loaf and ginger.

Food Pairing

The sherry-led profile and punchy ABV of Waterproof make it a robust partner for both sweet and savory dishes. It pairs remarkably well with rich, dark chocolate desserts or a sticky toffee pudding, where the spirit's dried fruit and spice notes can shine. For a savory match, try it with roasted nuts or a platter of charcuterie, particularly smoked meats like prosciutto or beef rendang, as the whisky's oily texture and subtle smoke cut through the salt. Its higher strength also makes it a standout choice for an Old Fashioned or a premium Highball, where it can be paired with salty izakaya-style snacks or spicy wasabi peas.

title: Tequila Lopez Blanco
bodyHtml:
Tequila Lopez Blanco is an artisanal spirit produced by the Lopez family, who represent four generations of agave cultivation experience. The brand is rooted in the "El Sabino" estate located in the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico—specifically in the town of Jesús María. This region is famous for its high altitude and iron-rich red volcanic soil, which typically produces agaves with higher sugar content and more floral, fruity profiles compared to the earthier Lowland varieties. The Blanco expression is a pure representation of this terroir, bottled without aging to preserve the vibrant essence of the cooked agave.

Spirit Description

This tequila is crystal clear with a bright, silvery luster. On the nose, it offers a clean and intense aroma of sweet cooked agave, complemented by fresh herbal notes and a distinct touch of citrus peel. The palate is fresh and vibrant, delivering flavours of agave honey and mint, which transition into a crisp minerality. A signature characteristic of this Blanco is its peppery finish; it features a notable white pepper heat that lingers alongside a delicate natural sweetness. It is twice distilled in copper stills and typically bottled at 40% ABV (though some Mexican market versions may be 38%).

title: Ol' Beautiful Iced Tea 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Ol' Beautiful Hard Iced Tea is a refreshing departure from traditional malt-based beverages, crafted by Calgary’s Ol' Beautiful Brewing Co. Unlike many mass-produced hard teas that rely on syrupy concentrates, this version is brewed to perfection using authentic tea blends. It reflects the brewery's flair for the beautiful in imperfection, offering a sophisticated, gently sparkling alternative that feels more like a craft cocktail than a standard cooler.

Description

This hard iced tea is light and effervescent with a clear, golden-amber clarity and a fine, sparkling carbonation.

Aroma: It features a highly aromatic nose with deep herbal notes from African Honeybush tea, complemented by a soft, natural honey-like sweetness and a crisp, clean finish.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and refreshingly dry. It offers a subtle, earthy tea flavor with a touch of natural floral sweetness that is never cloying, finishing with a brisk and revitalizing snap.

Technical Notes: Brewed using a custom blend of African Honeybush tea (a caffeine-free relative of Rooibos), which provides its signature aroma and inherent sweetness without the need for heavy additives.

title: Carpineto Chianti Classico 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Carpineto Chianti Classico is a distinguished red wine from the historic Chianti Classico region in Tuscany, Italy. The winery was founded in 1967 by Giovanni Carlo Sacchet and Antonio Mario Zaccheo, who shared a vision of producing modern, world class wines from the potential of the local soil. Today, the family run estate spans 500 hectares across several prestigious appellations, maintaining a winemaking philosophy that integrates traditional techniques with cutting edge technology to ensure both elegance and longevity.

Wine Description

This wine presents a vibrant ruby red colour that develops garnet reflections with aging. The aromatic profile is intense and expressive, featuring notes of violets, berries, and red cherries accented by hints of leather, licorice, and tobacco. On the palate, it is full bodied and velvety with a well balanced structure that offers flavours of black cherry, plum, and earth. The finish is long and savoury, highlighting firm yet polished tannins and a persistent fruit character.

title: The Finnish Long Drink Zero Sugar 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Originating from Finland, this unique beverage pays homage to a post-war innovation designed to ease the service of cocktails at large public events, such as the 1952 Helsinki Olympics. The Long Drink category has since become a beloved staple in Finnish drinking culture. Produced by the Hartwall Brewery, a pioneering force in Finnish beverage production, this drink blends tradition with modern refreshment.

Crystal clear and sparkling, The Finnish Long Drink Zero Sugar opens with invigorating aromas of grapefruit zest and fresh citrus. The palate delivers a clean, crisp rush of tart grapefruit, underscored by hints of piney gin botanicals. Its light-bodied profile is balanced by effervescence and a dry, refreshing finish that lingers pleasantly. While not a wine, its composition of gin and citrus soda mimics the nuanced structure of a fine apéritif. This sugar-free version retains all the flavour and character of the original, without added sugars. Best enjoyed well-chilled and young, this is a drink designed for immediate enjoyment.

title: Bellingham "The Old Orchards" Chenin Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Bellingham Homestead 'The Old Orchards' Chenin Blanc is a premium white wine from the Coastal Region of South Africa. The winery, which dates back to 1693, takes the name for this series from the historic homestead in the Franschhoek Valley that was once the home of the pioneering Podlashuk couple. Bellingham is renowned for its spirit of innovation and was a pioneer of many successful vinous concepts in South Africa, focusing on region specific sourcing to showcase the country's most interesting varietals.

Wine Description

This wine displays an attractive pale gold colour with a platinum glow. The sensory profile is highly expressive, with a nose evocative of old orchards featuring aromas of tropical fruit, vanilla, melon, peach, and a hint of honey. On the palate, it is full bodied and richly satisfying, offering layers of marmalade, pear, and hazelnuts supported by a textured mouthfeel and slight creaminess. The finish is long and intense, with refreshing candied lime notes and a saline infused minerality.

title: Ol' Beautiful Melody West Coast IPA 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Ol' Beautiful Melody West Coast IPA is a flagship offering from Ol' Beautiful Brewing Co., located in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Established in 2017, the brewery is built on a philosophy that appreciates the 'old ways' of craftsmanship and finds beauty in imperfection.

Beer Description

This medium bodied West Coast IPA presents a clear, deep amber appearance. The sensory profile is led by a potent bouquet of fresh pine, grapefruit, melon, and apricot, primarily driven by generous additions of Simcoe and Amarillo hops. On the palate, the beer offers a classic hop forward experience where the astringent bitterness is perfectly balanced by a sweet, malty backbone featuring notes of caramel, biscuit, and subtle toffee. It is characterized by its approachable bitterness and a crisp, punchy finish.

  • Style: West Coast IPA (American IPA)

  • Hops: Simcoe and Amarillo

  • Malt: Features a blend of caramel and biscuit malts

  • ABV: 6.5%

title: Ol' Beautiful Abrazo Mexican Lager 355 ml - 6 Cans
bodyHtml:
Ol' Beautiful Abrazo is a standout core offering from Ol' Beautiful Brewing Co., located in the vibrant Inglewood neighborhood of Calgary, Alberta. Since its inception, the brewery has focused on "the old ways of doing things," emphasizing storied brewing traditions. Abrazo is their take on the classic Mexican-style lager a style historically influenced by 19th-century Austrian immigrants designed to be a crisp, approachable alternative to mass-produced imports.

Beer Description

This Mexican-style lager is light-bodied and brilliantly clear with a pale straw to golden hue and a bright, white head.

Aroma: Clean and unassuming, featuring subtle notes of sweet grain, light floral hops, and a hint of corn-like sweetness typical of the style.

Palate: It offers a smooth entry with a gentle, honey-like malt sweetness. This quickly gives way to a high level of carbonation and a refreshingly zesty, clean finish that avoids any lingering bitterness.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% and a very low bitterness profile, making it exceptionally crushable and designed for "long patio sessions."

Technical Notes: Brewed as a pale lager with a focus on a high-quality malt bill and a clean-fermenting yeast strain to ensure a crisp, dry mouthfeel.

title: Ardnamurchan AD Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Ardnamurchan AD Cask Strength is a powerhouse single malt from the remote Ardnamurchan Distillery on the rugged West Highland coast. Known for its extreme transparency and "farm-to-bottle" approach, the distillery utilizes local barley and renewable energy to produce one of Scotland's most distinctive new coastal malts. The Cask Strength Release is a limited, small-batch vatting—typically combining approximately 85-90% peated and 10-15% unpeated spirit—matured predominantly in ex-bourbon barrels (90%) with a small influence of sherry casks (10%). Bottled at its natural strength (typically between 57% and 59% ABV), it offers an unfiltered, high-voltage look at the distillery’s maritime DNA.

Spirit Description

The whisky presents a bright, natural straw-gold color. On the nose, it is intensely coastal and evocative, leading with aromas of salty sea spray, wet seashells, and bonfire ash, followed by lemon zest, honeycomb, and a hint of minty freshness. The palate is rich, oily, and explosive; waves of maritime peat smoke and black pepper spice are balanced by the sweetness of vanilla custard, crisp green apples, and salted toffee. The high ABV carries a distinct "chili-like" warmth that opens up beautifully with a few drops of water. The finish is long and slightly drying, characterized by lingering wood smoke, seaweed salinity, and a faint echo of orange peel.

Food Pairing

The intense salinity and smoke of the Cask Strength Release make it a bold companion for "land and sea" flavors. It pairs magnificently with fresh oysters or seared scallops, where the whisky's brine enhances the sweetness of the shellfish. For a more robust meal, try it with glazed pork belly or smoked venison sausages, as the high proof and peat smoke cut through the fatty richness of the meat. It also stands up well to mature blue cheeses like Roquefort or Stilton. For a sweet contrast, pair it with dark chocolate sea salt truffles, which draw out the hidden notes of cocoa and orchard fruit in the spirit.

title: Ol' Beautiful Pegasus Pale Ale 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Ol' Beautiful Pegasus is a staple in the core lineup of Calgary’s Ol' Beautiful Brewing Co. This beer is a contemporary take on the West Coast Pale Ale, designed to showcase a vibrant hop character while maintaining a high level of balance. It represents the brewery's commitment to creating approachable but soulful beers that satisfy both craft enthusiasts and casual drinkers alike.

Beer Description

This Pale Ale pours a bright, clear copper-gold with a resilient, lacy white head.

Aroma: It features a forward hop profile dominated by citrus and tropical fruit notes, such as grapefruit and passionfruit, backed by a subtle piney resin and a light caramel malt base.

Palate: The flavor is a harmonious blend of zesty citrus and stone fruit. A clean, biscuity malt sweetness provides a sturdy foundation that balances the assertive hop bitterness.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.4% and a moderate bitterness of 42 IBU, giving it enough bite to be flavorful without being overwhelming.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a blend of classic and modern North American hops. The malt bill is carefully selected to provide enough body to support the hop oils, resulting in a crisp and refreshing finish.

title: Ole Variety Pack 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Olé Tequila Variety Pack is the signature collection from British Columbia’s Olé Cocktail Co., the creators of Canada’s first premium tequila cocktail variety pack. Each cocktail is crafted using authentic Blanco Tequila imported from Jalisco, Mexico, blended with real fruit juices and organic agave nectar.

Description

This variety pack features a selection of vibrant, sparkling cocktails that range from citrusy and tart to tropical and spicy.

Selection Includes:

  • Margarita: The classic zesty lime cocktail with a pinch of sea salt.

  • Paloma: A bright and tangy grapefruit-forward favorite.

  • Chili Mango: A tropical blend of mango and peach with a subtle spicy kick.

  • Tequila Sunrise: A citrusy orange profile finished with a splash of pomegranate.

  • Passion Fruit: A bold and exotic tropical profile with a tart finish.

Aroma: Each expression features a bouquet of fresh-pressed citrus or tropical fruits, underscored by the clean, earthy scent of agave and a hint of mineral salt.

Palate: The flavors are balanced and natural, avoiding the syrupy sweetness of traditional coolers. Expect a light, bubbly mouthfeel with the authentic character of Blanco Tequila throughout.

Profile: All cocktails in the pack have an ABV of 5.2%. They are low-calorie and lightly sweetened with organic agave, maintaining a crisp and refreshing profile.

Technical Notes: Crafted with no artificial colors, flavors, or sweeteners. The cocktails are gluten-free, vegan-friendly, and use real fruit juice concentrates to achieve their authentic flavor profile.

title: Ole Margarita (Non Alcoholic) 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This beverage originates from Canada. It was founded in 2020 by the Olé Cocktail Co., an independent craft company based in Vancouver, British Columbia, that was later acquired by the Mark Anthony Group in 2024. The brand was inspired by the founders' desire to create premium, ready to drink cocktails using clean ingredients like organic agave and real fruit juices.

Spirit Description

The beverage is a crisp and sparkling non alcoholic margarita with a clear appearance. The aroma is defined by the zesty tang of freshly squeezed limes and subtle notes of earthy agave. On the palate, it offers a refreshing balance of citrus acidity and light sweetness from organic agave nectar, perfected with a pinch of sea salt. The body is effervescent and light, providing a clean finish that transports the senses to a tropical escape. It is crafted in small batches with no artificial flavours, sweeteners, or colours. The alcohol by volume is 0.0%.

title: Soalheiro Espumante Alvarinho Nature Pur Terroir
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Monção and Melgaço subregion of Portugal's Vinho Verde, Soalheiro was a pioneer as the first brand to produce 100% Alvarinho in Melgaço in 1982. The winery is family-owned and focuses on a philosophy of innovation and sustainability, utilizing organic viticulture to express the unique granite terroir of the Minho River Valley.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine displays a deep gold colour with fine, elegant bubbles. The nose is highly complex, offering intense bready and yeasty aromas alongside distinct mineral notes and hints of tree fruits like green apple and peach. On the palate, it is bone-dry and intense, featuring a voluminous mouthfeel and mouth-watering acidity that results from a complete malolactic fermentation.

Food Pairing

The intense flavour and palate-cleansing acidity of this sparkling wine make it an excellent companion for powerful gastronomy such as red meat, Brazilian feijoada, or barbecued vegetables. It also pairs beautifully with rich, fatty fish, lamb, and dishes featuring creamy mushroom sauces or mature cheeses.

title: Collosorbo Due Gemme Rosso 2022
bodyHtml:
Le Due Gemme Rosso is produced in the Tuscany region of Italy, specifically within the southern part of Montalcino. The estate, Tenuta di Collosorbo, was established in 1995 by Giovanna Ciacci following the division of her family's historic estate, Tenuta di Sesta, which dates back to 1850. The name 'Le Due Gemme' (meaning 'The Two Gems') is a tribute to Giovanna's two daughters, Laura and Lucia, who now manage the winery alongside her.

Wine Description

This wine features a rich ruby red colour, often showing purplish highlights in its youth. The sensory profile is intensely aromatic, offering notes of ripe cherry, strawberry, and black berries, balanced by floral hints of rose and exotic spices. On the palate, it is generous and fresh, displaying deep fruit flavours reminiscent of plum and roasted walnut with a menthol aftertaste. The structure is defined by fine, well-integrated tannins and a lively acidity that leads to a refreshing, medium-long finish. While older labels under the Sant'Antimo DOC were a broader blend of Sangiovese, Syrah, Merlot, and Cabernet Sauvignon, recent releases of the Toscana Rosso IGT are a focused blend of 50% Sangiovese and 50% Merlot. The wine typically has an ABV of 14.5% and is produced from the 'Il Quercione' vineyard, which has been farmed following organic principles since it was planted in 2001.

Food Pairing

The vibrant fruit and balanced structure of Le Due Gemme Rosso make it highly versatile for Italian cuisine. It pairs exceptionally well with classic pasta dishes, such as gnocchi al ragù or pasta with meat sauce, and is an ideal companion for pizza. For main courses, it complements grilled or roasted red meats, Florentine steak, and meat stews. It also matches effectively with mild or medium-aged cheeses like Pecorino.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage benefited from the warm, well-ventilated climate of southern Montalcino, resulting in a rich and driven fruit profile with animating acidity. In contrast, the 2019 growing season for Tuscany was marked by extreme summer heat due to climate change, yet it produced wines of very high quality with polished, silky tannins and gorgeous aromatic depth. The winery's hilltop location and protection from surrounding hills help mitigate vintage challenges, ensuring consistent ripening for the Sangiovese and Merlot grapes.

title: 1921 Tequila Anejo
bodyHtml:
1921 Tequila Anejo originates from the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico, specifically within the subregion of Arandas. Established in 1996 by founder Juan Francisco Collado, the brand was created to share Mexican culture and history, with its name specifically honouring the conclusion of the Mexican Revolutionary War. The distillery, Destileria Morales, follows traditional 18th-century production methods, utilizing slow-steaming in adobe and stone ovens followed by gentle extraction using a 'tahona' (giant millstone) to preserve the agave's authentic essence.

Description

This 100% Blue Weber agave tequila displays a brilliant amber-yellow hue with copper shades and a silky body that produces slow-descending 'tears' in the glass. The aromatic profile is complex and sweet, featuring prominent notes of honey, vanilla, and chocolate balanced by toasted wood and a hint of citrus. On the palate, it is exceptionally soft and rich, offering a diverse array of dried fruit, caramel, and butterscotch flavours supported by a gentle smokiness and spicy undertones. This medium-bodied spirit concludes with a long, warm, and velvety finish.

Food Pairing

The rich, oak-influenced profile of this Anejo pairs beautifully with savory grilled meats, such as a wood-fired ribeye steak or smoked beef cheek, which mirror the spirit's natural smokiness. For a more delicate experience, try it with creamy Manchego cheese to highlight the wood barrel notes, or traditional spicy Mexican dishes like 'cochinita pibil' to balance the heat with caramel sweetness.

title: Ole Paloma (Non Alcoholic) 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This beverage originates from Canada. It was founded in 2020 by the Olé Cocktail Co., an independent craft company based in Vancouver, British Columbia, that was recently acquired by the Mark Anthony Group. The brand was inspired by the founders' desire to create premium, ready to drink cocktails using clean ingredients like organic agave and real fruit juices.

Spirit Description

The beverage is a smooth and effervescent non alcoholic paloma with a clear, lightly tinted appearance. The aroma is defined by the zesty tang of fresh grapefruit and subtle notes of earthy agave. On the palate, it offers a refreshing balance of citrus acidity and light sweetness from organic agave nectar, perfected with a pinch of sea salt. The finish is clean and crisp, providing a thirst quenching quality with a 'salty' edge. It is crafted in small batches without artificial flavours, sweeteners, or preservatives. The alcohol by volume is 0.0%.

title: Simonnet Febvre Chablis Mont De Milieu Premier Cru 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Simonnet-Febvre Chablis Mont de Milieu Premier Cru is a prestigious white wine from one of the most celebrated 'climats' on the right bank of the Serein river in Chablis, France. Founded in 1840, Maison Simonnet-Febvre is one of the oldest traditional producers in the region and has been owned by the renowned Louis Latour family since 2003. The estate is particularly famous for being the only producer in Chablis to maintain the historical tradition of making sparkling wines (Crémant de Bourgogne) alongside its classic still Chablis range.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a bright, straw-yellow hue and a complex sensory profile that balances ripeness with intense mineral power. The bouquet is highly expressive, offering fragrant aromas of wild honey, lemon curd, and hazelnut, with exotic floral hints of hibiscus and a distinct iodized (saline) character. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied and powerful, featuring a rich, round texture with flavours of ripe orange, melon, and baked bread, underscored by the classic chalky minerality of the Mont de Milieu terroir. The structure is defined by a zesty acidity and citrus-bitter notes that lead to a remarkably long and saline finish.

Food Pairing

The richness and mineral tension of this Premier Cru make it a versatile partner for elegant and substantial dishes.

  • Seafood: It is an ideal match for grilled fish, scallops, lobster, or a traditional prawn bisque.

  • Meats & Creamy Dishes: Pair it with white meats in delicate sauces, such as mushroom-stuffed chicken breast or sweetbreads.

  • Cheese: It harmonizes well with French cheeses like Brie or a classic Pavé.

  • Gourmet Suggestions: For a more unique pairing, try it with sweet potato tempura or a refined fish stew like pôchouse.

title: Tequila Lopez Reposado
bodyHtml:
Tequila Lopez Reposado is the barrel-aged expression from the Lopez family’s "El Sabino" estate in the Highlands of Jalisco. Following the artisanal standards of their Blanco, this Reposado is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave grown in iron-rich volcanic soil at high altitudes. The spirit is aged for six months in American white oak barrels—longer than the minimum two-month requirement—allowing it to develop a mellowed complexity while retaining the vibrant, fruity character of the highland agave.

Spirit Description

This tequila presents a soft, golden amber hue. On the nose, the bright citrus and cooked agave notes of the Blanco are joined by warm aromas of caramel, vanilla, and toasted nuts. The palate is medium-to-full bodied and remarkably smooth, delivering a harmonious balance of honeyed sweetness and baking spices like cinnamon and clove. The influence of the American oak provides a buttery mouthfeel and a touch of balsa wood. The finish is long and warming, characterized by a gentle spicy pepper kick and a lingering hint of butterscotch. It is typically bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

title: Silverado Miller Ranch Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Silverado Miller Ranch Sauvignon Blanc is a bright and expressive white wine from the Yountville AVA in Napa Valley, California. Established in 1981 by Ron and Diane Miller (the daughter of Walt Disney), Silverado Vineyards is now owned by the Foley family, who continue the estate's legacy of crafting "classic Napa" style wines. The Miller Ranch vineyard, purchased by the family in 1976, is situated on the valley floor between the Napa River and Hopper Creek, where silty Yolo Loam and Clear Lake Clay soils provide an ideal environment for aromatic white varieties.

Wine Description

This wine presents a vibrant profile typical of the cooler southern Napa reaches. The nose is dominated by aromatic notes of ruby red grapefruit, lime, and stone fruit, accented by tropical hints of mango and pineapple. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and beautifully balanced, offering zesty citrus flavors of tangelo and lime sorbet alongside orange blossom and pear. The structure is characterized by energetic acidity and a crisp mineral finish, with a slightly oily texture provided by a small portion of barrel fermentation.

title: Old Forester 1910
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Old Forester 1910 Old Fine Whisky is produced in the United States, within the region of Kentucky and the subregion of Louisville. This expression is part of the Whiskey Row Series and is produced by the Brown–Forman Corporation, which was founded in 1870 by George Garvin Brown. The distillery is noted for being the only bourbon brand produced before, during, and after Prohibition, and it remains under the management of the founder's descendants today.

Spirit Description

This unique expression is a double-barreled bourbon that undergoes a second maturation in a heavily charred oak barrel to replicate a historic 1910 production accident. It presents a dark bronze colour and an aroma consisting of interlaced layers of buttercream, sticky toffee, cedar, and apricot. The palate is smooth and well rounded, featuring notes of sweet oatmeal raisin cookies, milk chocolate, caramel corn, and evolving baking spices like cinnamon and nutmeg. It possesses a full body with a viscous yet slightly dry mouthfeel, leading to a finish of charred oak and clean peripheral spice.

title: InchDairnie Distillery 'RyeLaw' - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
RyeLaw is a groundbreaking spirit from the InchDairnie Distillery in the Kingdom of Fife, Scotland. It holds the distinction of being a single grain Scotch whisky made with a high proportion of rye, a rare practice in a country dominated by barley. The creation of RyeLaw was inspired by historical records, such as the 1908 Royal Commission Report, which confirmed that rye was traditionally used in Scotch production. To handle the viscous nature of rye, InchDairnie uses a hammer mill and a mash filter (one of only two in Scotland) before distilling the spirit in a bespoke Lomond Hill still to achieve precise flavor extraction.

Spirit Description

The whisky presents a deep golden amber color. On the nose, it is highly aromatic and complex, offering distinguished rye spices like clove and nutmeg alongside sweet notes of vanilla fudge, toasted brown bread, and cedarwood. The palate is characterized by an oily, mouth-coating viscosity that balances a "cascading" pepperiness from the rye. Flavors of golden syrup, blackcurrant, and cereal mingle with hints of dark chocolate and roasted coffee. The finish is long and warming, leaving a lingering trail of toasted rye grain and a touch of savory umami. It is typically bottled as a 5-year-old vintage at 46.3% ABV, non-chill filtered and with natural color.

Food Pairing

The bold spice and rich texture of RyeLaw make it a versatile partner for intense flavors. It pairs exceptionally well with charcoal-grilled meats, such as a pepper-crusted ribeye or smoked venison, where the rye spice complements the char. For a sweet pairing, try it with a rich ginger cake or dark chocolate truffles; the whisky’s vanilla and dried fruit notes harmonize with the cocoa. Its viscous mouthfeel also allows it to stand up to strong, salty cheeses like Roquefort or a well-aged Pecorino. If serving in a cocktail, it provides a robust, spicy base for a sophisticated "Scottish Manhattan."

title: Torres Mas La Plana 2019
bodyHtml:
Torres Mas La Plana originates from a single 29-hectare vineyard in the Turons de Vilafranca subzone, located in the heart of the Penedès region in Catalonia, Spain. The estate was founded in 1870 by brothers Jaime and Miguel Torres, and the wine gained legendary status in 1979 when its 1970 vintage triumphed over top French labels at the Gault & Millau Wine Olympics in Paris. Today, the winery is managed by the fifth generation of the family, who have implemented a winemaking philosophy focused on regenerative viticulture to restore soil fertility and promote biodiversity.

Wine Description

This wine typically presents a deep ruby or dark, opaque red-purple colour. The sensory profile is intense and complex, featuring aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, and cassis, layered with notes of cedar, tobacco, truffle, and finely roasted spices. On the palate, it is full bodied and structured, offering flavours of ripe berry fruit, cocoa powder, and licorice, balanced by a bright, crunchy acidity. The finish is long and polished, characterized by velvety, well-integrated tannins and a lingering savouriness. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon varietal generally has an ABV of 14.5% and is produced using sustainable and organic viticulture principles.

Accolades:

  • 95 Points - James Suckling

    Excellent freshness and intensity of meaty blue fruit here with currants, blackberries, dark plums, peppercorns and chocolate, with dark earth and some spearmint. Crushed stone minerality on the palate, with fantastic freshness. Full-bodied, tight, caressing and perfectly ripe tannins. Already delicious, but will age beautifully. Cabernet sauvignon. Mas La Plana has become more refined and precise. Drink or hold.

  • 94 Points - Vinous

    A cuvée produced since 1970, the 2019 Mas La Plana is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon from Penedès. Aged 18 months in oak barrels and (61% new) with only 4% remaining in steel tanks, this wine presents a garnet hue with a purple sheen. The aromas feature cassis, tobacco and licorice, along with ripe cherry and orange petit four. Dry, rich and indulgent, it flows with intensity, eventually becoming compact due to its chalky mouthfeel.

  • 93 Points - Wine Spectator

    An enticing red, exuding fragrant sandalwood and star anise notes, this is plush on the palate, offering generous flavors of black plum reduction, baked bitter cherry, tea leaves and a subtle base note of fresh earth. Defined by sculpted, fine-grained tannins and lively acidity, this is seamlessly knit and harmonious. Drink now through 2034. 6,262 cases made, 450 cases imported.

title: Buffelsfontein Brandy - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Buffelsfontein Brandy is produced in South Africa and is closely associated with the country's local heritage and the rugged bushveld lifestyle. The brand is manufactured, bottled, and distributed by Halewood South Africa, a company established in 1999 that has grown into one of the country's prominent spirits producers. It was originally crafted by the creators of the well known Buffelsfontein Baardolie and has since expanded to include a range of beverages including wines and lagers.

Spirit Description

This brandy is known for being a smooth and easy drinking spirit that is matured for a period of three years. The nose is described as complex, offering distinct notes of strawberry and red cherry. On the palate, the spirit reveals refined layers of vanilla and spice, maintaining a balance that makes it accessible for various serving styles. It concludes with a soft finish, and while often used in premixes, the standing brandy typically has an ABV of 43%.

title: Glenmorangie 12 Year Old Single Malt with 2 Glasses
bodyHtml:
This single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, produced in the Highland region. Crafted at the historic Glenmorangie Distillery in Tain, Ross-shire—famous for operating the tallest stills in Scotland—this gift set features the distillery's flagship 12-year-old expression, Glenmorangie The Lasanta, alongside two branded tasting glasses. Under the guidance of Director of Whisky Creation Dr. Bill Lumsden, this whisky undergoes a dual-maturation process: spending 10 years in first- and second-fill ex-bourbon American white oak casks before finishing for an additional 2 years in hand-selected Spanish Oloroso and Pedro Ximénez sherry casks.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a warm, glowing reddish-amber hue in the glass. The nose is rich, sweet, and inviting, opening with aromas of warm spiced raisins, dark chocolate, and honeycomb, complemented by notes of fresh orange peel and toasted hazelnuts. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied with a smooth, velvety texture, delivering luscious flavours of sultanas, butterscotch, candied citrus, and spiced plums, balanced by subtle oak tannin and cinnamon. The finish is long, warm, and satisfying, leaving a sweet trail of dried fruit, cocoa, and gentle nutmeg spice. Bottled at an ABV of 43%, it offers a harmoniously balanced, rich, and sherry-forward profile.

title: Glenmorangie 12 Year Old Single Malt - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Glenmorangie 12 Year Old is a premium Highland single malt Scotch whisky produced at the Glenmorangie Distillery in Tain, Ross-shire, Scotland. Founded in 1843 by William Matheson, the distillery is home to the tallest stills in Scotland and is currently owned by the French luxury goods company Louis Vuitton Moët Hennessy (LVMH). In summer 2024, the distillery announced a major shift in its core range, replacing its flagship 'The Original 10 Year Old' with a new 'The Original 12 Year Old' expression to offer increased silkiness and complexity.

Spirit Description

The core 12-year-old expressions typically feature a marriage of spirit aged in American white oak ex-bourbon casks, with some versions receiving secondary maturation in specialized wine or sherry casks.

  • Colour: The 'The Original 12 Year Old' displays a vibrant amber or golden hue. The 'Lasanta' expression is noted for its ruddy copper or medium orange colour.

  • Aroma: The flagship 12-year-old nose is inviting and creamy, featuring orange marmalade, honey, vanilla, and tinned peaches. The 'Lasanta' variant offers deeper notes of raisins, honeycomb, and chocolate-covered hazelnuts.

  • Palate: It provides a silky, thick, and tongue-coating texture. Flavours include vanilla, apricot, dark chocolate, and floral honeysuckle, balanced by a touch of orange and pepper.

  • Body: The whisky is medium-bodied and velvety, known for its smooth elegance and creamy mouthfeel.

  • Finish: It concludes with a medium to long finish characterized by honeyed maltiness, tropical fruit sweetness, and a hint of zesty ginger or oak.

  • ABV: 'The Original 12 Year Old' is bottled at 40%. The 'Lasanta' expression is typically bottled at 43% or 46%.

title: Erdinger Weissbier 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Erdinger Weissbier is the signature brew of Erdinger Weißbräu, the world’s largest wheat beer specialist, located in Erding, Bavaria, Germany. Founded in 1886, the brewery remains independently owned and is a staunch practitioner of the Bavarian Purity Law, using only water, malted wheat and barley, hops, and yeast. Unlike most modern beers, Erdinger is a bottle-fermented "live" beer that undergoes a "Bayerische Edelreifung" (double maturity) method, maturing for three to four weeks in the bottle to develop its unique character.

Beer Description

This classic Hefeweizen (unfiltered wheat beer) is pale blond to amber-yellow in color with a natural, hazy cloudiness and a dense, creamy white head.

  • Aroma: Features a distinct yeasty nose with traditional wheat beer signatures of ripe banana and clove, along with doughy bread and floral hops.

  • Palate: It offers a full-bodied, slightly sweet malt flavor balanced by a refreshing effervescence and a mild, spicy hop finish.

  • Profile: It has an ABV of 5.3% and a low bitterness of approximately 13 IBU, making it incredibly smooth and sessionable.

  • Technical Notes: It is brewed with at least 50% wheat malt (typically closer to 60%) and a secret blend of yeasts.

title: Mazzolino Camara Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Mazzolino Camara Chardonnay is a vibrant white wine from the Provincia di Pavia IGP in the Oltrepò Pavese region of Lombardy, Italy. Tenuta Mazzolino was founded in the 1980s by Enrico Braggiotti, who sought to create a family estate rooted in both Italian tradition and Burgundian refinement. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a deep respect for the land, utilizing sustainable and organic farming practices across its 22 hectares of vineyards to produce authentic wines with a strong sense of identity.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay presents a pale straw yellow colour with subtle grey-green reflections. The sensory profile is bright and fragrant, led by fresh aromas of golden apple, grapefruit, and sage, with delicate notes of white flowers and acacia. On the palate, the wine is clean and crisp, showing a youthful citrus-driven energy supported by a distinct mineral backbone and a silky texture. It is vinified entirely in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks to maintain its aromatic purity and freshness, followed by four months of aging in steel and two months in the bottle before release. This unoaked style typically has an ABV of 12.5%.

title: Pastourelle de Clerc Milon 2020
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the renowned Pauillac appellation in Bordeaux, France, Pastourelle de Clerc Milon is the distinguished second wine of Château Clerc Milon. The estate, a Fifth Growth classified in 1855, was acquired in 1970 by Baron Philippe de Rothschild, who transformed the then-dilapidated property into a world-class vineyard. Today, the winemaking philosophy focuses on precision and technical excellence, utilizing a modern gravity-flow winery and hand-selected grapes from 247 distinct parcels to maintain a perfect balance of power and fruit.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep crimson appearance with a vibrant purplish hue. On the nose, it is elegant and expressive, revealing intense aromas of ripe black fruit, such as bilberry, mingled with scents of rose petal, mocha, and enticing pastry-shop notes. The palate is rich and explosive, featuring a creamy attack that leads into a smooth, full mid-palate dominated by juicy red and dark fruit. Chiseled, precise tannins provide a refined structure and complexity, while the long finish lingers with delicate touches of spice and cocoa.

Accolades

  • Vinous - 93 points

  • James Suckling - 93 points

Food Pairing

This Pauillac red is an excellent companion to classic meat dishes such as roasted or grilled lamb, beef, and duck. Its earthy undertones and dark fruit profile also pair beautifully with mushroom-based recipes, truffles, or hearty pasta dishes.

title: 7 Deadly Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

7 Deadly Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold red wine produced in the Lodi American Viticultural Area (AVA) of California, United States. The brand was established in 2002 by the Phillips brothers, Michael and David, who initially created the iconic '7 Deadly Zins' blend from seven diverse old vine Zinfandel vineyards. Following the massive success of their Zinfandel, the winery introduced 7 Deadly Cabernet Sauvignon in 2020, applying the same 'sinful' philosophy of crafting hedonistic, seductive wines from the hallowed, sandy clay soils of Lodi.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep, dark appearance and a full bodied sensory profile. The aromatic bouquet is expressive, featuring scents of fleshy ripe blackberries and plums layered with mocha, vanilla, and coffee. On the palate, it is seductive and smooth, offering jammy blackberry flavours and dark cherry notes complemented by hints of allspice, dark chocolate, and dried tobacco leaf. The structure is defined by a big mouthfeel, vibrant acidity, and gripping tannins that lead to a long, persistent finish. While this varietal is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, it is aged for approximately six months in French oak to enhance its complexity. It typically has an ABV of 14%.

title: Anakena Nuna Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Anakena Nuna Cabernet Sauvignon is a red wine from the Central Valley region of Chile. Viña Anakena was founded in 1999 by childhood friends Felipe Ibáñez and Jorge Gutiérrez in the Alto Cachapoal area, situated in the foothills of the Andes Mountains. In 2015, the winery was acquired by Accolade Wines, which has continued the founders' original goal of crafting innovative, New World wines that reflect the unique potential of Chile's volcanic soils. The name 'Nuna' is derived from the ancient Quechua word for 'soul', reflecting a philosophy of expressing the authentic spirit of the land.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon presents an intense ruby red colour with garnet or deep purple hues. The sensory profile features a bold aromatic bouquet of blackberry, cassis, and ripe plum, layered with notes of gentle spice and subtle vanilla. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied and smooth, offering flavours of ripe dark cherries and forest berries complemented by a whisper of toasted oak. The wine is characterized by an excellent balance of ripe, firm tannins and bright acidity, leading to a long and persistent finish.

title: Fledge and Co. Versnit Cinsault Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine comes from South Africa, specifically the Stellenbosch region in the Western Cape. The Fledge & Co. is a collaboration between winemakers Leon Coetzee and Margaux Nel (who is also the winemaker at the famous Boplaas estate). Their philosophy is to be "nomadic" winemakers, sourcing fruit from unique and often overlooked vineyard parcels across the Cape to create artisanal, minimal-intervention wines that challenge the status quo.

Wine Description

The Fledge & Co. Veld Versnit (often referred to as the Field Blend) is a "shape-shifter" of a wine that captures a single day's snapshot of a vineyard.

  • Appearance: A vibrant ruby red with a bright, youthful rim.

  • Nose: Highly aromatic and multifaceted. It features hedonistic notes of bright red and black hedgerow fruits from the Cinsault, which morph into earthy sweet notes of Alicante Bouschet, while gravelly and graphite-like blue fruit notes from the Cabernet Franc emerge periodically.

  • Palate: Joyously juicy and medium-bodied. It strikes a balance between approachable fruit and serious structural intrigue, with firmly restrained tannins and a lilt of acidity that provides freshness.

Food Pairing

This wine's juicy acidity and earthy complexity make it perfect for rustic, comforting fare. It pairs exceptionally well with a traditional South African braai (barbecue), slow-roasted leg of lamb, or a rich venison pie. For vegetarian options, try it with wild mushroom ragout or hearty lentil stews. It is best served slightly chilled to highlight its aromatic freshness.

title: Diamant de Loire Saumur Brut
bodyHtml:
This sparkling white wine originates from France, specifically the Saumur appellation in the Loire Valley. Diamant de Loire is a range produced by Les Caves de la Loire, a prominent cooperative founded in 1951. The winery focuses on expressing the unique limestone and chalk "tuffeau" soils of the region, which are famous for providing the ideal conditions for traditional method sparkling wines. The name "Diamant de Loire" is a tribute to the precision and clarity sought in their winemaking process.

Wine Description

The Diamant de Loire Saumur Brut is a fresh and lively sparkling wine crafted using the traditional method (méthode traditionnelle), involving a second fermentation in the bottle.

  • Appearance: A brilliant straw-yellow color with golden hues and a fine, persistent bead.

  • Nose: The bouquet is predominantly floral and fruity, typical of Chenin Blanc. It reveals aromas of ripe green apple, pear, and honeydew melon, accented by delicate notes of white flowers, hawthorn, and a subtle hint of toasted bread or brioche.

  • Palate: On the palate, the wine is crisp and well-balanced. It features a rounded attack followed by a decisive acidity that brings freshness and energy. The texture is refined, leading to a clean, mineral finish with lingering notes of citrus and dried fruits.

  • Technical Details: This wine is made from 100% Chenin Blanc. It undergoes aging on its lees for at least 9 months to develop its characteristic creaminess and depth. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is typically 12%.

Food Pairing

The high acidity and fine bubbles of this Saumur Brut make it an excellent aperitif. It pairs beautifully with salty snacks, fresh oysters, or seafood salads. It also complements light poultry dishes, vegetable tempura, and soft cheeses like Brie or local Crottin de Chavignol. For a dessert pairing, try it with an apple tart or fresh fruit salad to highlight its orchard fruit notes.

title: Barone Fini Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Barone Fini Pinot Grigio is a classic white wine produced in the Valdadige DOC of the Trentino-Alto Adige region in northern Italy. The Barone Fini winery boasts a legacy spanning over 500 years, with current owner Giovanni Bonmartini-Fini representing the 15th generation of the family to manage the estate. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes minimal human intervention and handpicking 100% of the grapes from vineyards nestled at the foot of the Alps to preserve the authentic 'mountain crispness' of the fruit.

Wine Description

This wine presents a light-bodied and stony profile with a crisp, lingering mouthfeel. The sensory profile features delicate floral aromas and notes of lemon mist on the nose. On the palate, it offers refreshing flavours of honeydew melon, ripe apples, and baked pear, accented by hints of candied lemon zest and almond biscotti. The structure is characterized by a bright acidity balanced with a warm minerality, resulting in a rich and clean finish.

title: Guigal Tavel Rose 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

E. Guigal Tavel Rose is a premium pink wine from the Tavel AOC, the only appellation in France dedicated solely to the production of rosé. The Guigal family has been selecting and blending wines from Tavel since 1942, and their commitment to the region was further solidified with the 2022 acquisition of the historic Château d'Aqueria.
