The estate's winemaking philosophy focuses on low yields and minimal intervention to produce robust, structured rosés that reflect the red wine personality of the Southern Rhône.

Wine Description

This wine presents a pure and deep salmon pink colour. The sensory profile is elegant and complex, featuring a nose of bright cherries, framboise, and subtle floral notes. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied with a round, layered texture and flavours of red plum, watermelon, and smoked cherry. The wine is well-structured with prominent tannins and a balanced acidity that leads to a long, mineral-driven finish. Composed of 60% Grenache, 15% Cinsault, 10% Clairette, 10% Syrah, and 5% other local varieties, it was matured exclusively in stainless steel tanks for six months to preserve its aromatic finesse.

title: Marques De Riscal XR Reserva 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Marques de Riscal XR Reserva is a red wine from the Rioja DOCa region in Spain. Established in 1858, Marques de Riscal is one of the oldest and most pioneering wineries in Rioja, famously commissioning Frank Gehry to design its emblematic 'City of Wine' hotel. The 'XR' label pays tribute to a historical Bordeaux tradition where cellar masters would chalk these letters on special barrels that showed exceptional characteristics during aging.

Wine Description

This wine displays an intense black-cherry colour with deep intensity and minimal signs of evolution. The sensory profile is highly expressive, featuring complex aromas of liquorice, cinnamon, and black pepper, complemented by notes of blueberries, blackcurrants, and balsamic undertones. On the palate, it is full-bodied and well-structured, offering a harmonious balance of ripe fruit, sweet spices, and coconut oil. The wine is characterized by polished, sculpted tannins and a refreshing acidity that leads to a long, persistent finish with gentle balsamic reminders.

title: Santa Julia La Oveja Natural White 2024
bodyHtml:
Santa Julia La Oveja Natural White is an aromatic white wine from the Maipú appellation in Mendoza, Argentina. Bodega Santa Julia was founded in 1950 by Alberto Zuccardi and remains a family-owned estate led by the Zuccardi family. The winery is a pioneer in sustainable viticulture and stands as the largest owner of organic vineyards in Argentina. Their winemaking philosophy for the natural range emphasizes minimal human intervention, utilizing native yeasts and bottling without added sulphites to maintain the pure identity of the land.

Wine Description

This wine displays a pale yellow colour with distinct greenish reflections. The sensory profile is intensely aromatic, featuring a magnetic bouquet of white fruits like peach and nectarine, layered with floral notes of rose petals, jasmine, and geranium. On the palate, it is light-bodied, dry, and lively, supported by a refreshing acidity and a medium intensity that highlights citrus flavours. The finish is clean, long, and citrusy, with a persistent lemon-zest impression and elegant herbal whispers. Crafted from 100% Torrontés grapes, the wine undergoes a 15-day maceration with skin contact to provide texture without heaviness. It has an ABV of 13.4% and is a certified organic and natural wine bottled unfiltered.

title: Tribute Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Tribute Sauvignon Blanc is a white wine from California, United States, primarily sourced from the North Coast region. The Tribute label is part of the Benziger Family Winery, which established the brand to honour the family's transition to certified sustainable and organic farming after decades of heritage in Sonoma. The winemaking philosophy focuses on 'sustainable excellence', utilizing vineyards that are certified under the Certified California Sustainable Winegrowing (CCSW) program to ensure land stewardship and water conservation.

Wine Description

This wine displays a pale straw colour with brilliant clarity. The sensory profile is highly expressive and bright, featuring a bouquet of citrus, grapefruit, and lime zest, accented by tropical notes of passion fruit and a touch of fresh cut grass. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied and exceptionally crisp, offering flavours of lemon curd, green apple, and white peach. The structure is defined by a zesty, mouthwatering acidity and a clean, refreshing finish with a hint of flinty minerality.

title: Yvon Mau B De Fonbadet 2019
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Yvon Mau B de Fonbadet is a red wine from the Bordeaux region of France. Originally established in 1897 in the heart of the Gironde, the Yvon Mau trading house is now a subsidiary of the Freixenet Group, one of the world's largest wine producers. The winemaking philosophy for the B de Fonbadet label involves a partnership with the historic Château Fonbadet, a Pauillac-based estate, to produce an accessible 'second label' style wine that captures the prestige of the region.

Wine Description

This wine displays a beautiful ruby-red colour. The sensory profile is elegant and fragrant, with a nose featuring aromas of fresh raspberry, blackberry, and dark cherries, accompanied by floral, toasted, and spicy notes. On the palate, it is medium-plus-bodied and supple, offering flavours of dark plum, cassis, and cocoa, accented by hints of bell pepper and fine herbs. The structure is characterized by refreshing acidity and firm, mellow tannins, leading to a long and persistent finish.

title: Imada Shuzo Fukucho Junmai Yuzu Lemon Sake - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Imada Shuzo, a historic brewery founded in 1868, this sake is crafted under the guidance of Miho Imada, one of the few female master brewers (Toji) in Japan. The brewery is located in a coastal town famous for being the birthplace of soft water brewing and is known for reviving the heritage rice variety Hattanso.

Description

This citrus infused sake possesses a hazy, pale yellow colour. The nose is remarkably vibrant and refreshing, dominated by the bright, zesty aromas of fresh yuzu and Japanese lemon. On the palate, it offers a crisp and tangy profile with a perfect balance between the tart acidity of the citrus and the mellow sweetness of the junmai sake base. The texture is light and clean, finishing with a lingering, juicy citrus savor that is both elegant and thirst quenching. ABV 8.5%.

title: Asahi Shuzo Kubota Manjyu Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Japan, Niigata Prefecture, Nagaoka City. Established in 1830, Asahi Shuzo is a historic brewery that believes the quality of sake cannot exceed the quality of its ingredients. They launched the iconic Kubota brand in 1985 to create a new profile of dry, crisp sake known as tanrei karakuchi.

Description

This Junmai Daiginjo displays a pristine, colourless appearance in the glass. The nose is sophisticated and floral, offering complex aromas of honeysuckle and tuberose alongside notes of Fuji apple and tart pear. On the palate, it reveals a plush, creamy texture with layers of savory umami and a medium body. The finish is exceptionally clean and crisp, disappearing quickly like morning mist. It is a perfectly balanced and elegant expression of the tanrei karakuchi style. ABV 15%.

Food Pairing

This sake pairs beautifully with premium sushi and sashimi, particularly rich cuts like chu-toro and uni. It also complements shellfish, steamed vegetables, and dishes like saltimbocca.

title: Sandhi Santa Rita Hills Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
Sandhi Wines, established in 2010, is a partnership between famed sommelier Rajat Parr and winemaker Sashi Moorman. The winery’s name is derived from the Sanskrit word for "collaboration," reflecting their joint effort with growers and nature. Their philosophy is centered on "In Pursuit of Balance," crafting wines with lower alcohol, higher acidity, and a distinct Burgundian influence that eschews the heavily oaked, buttery style often associated with California Chardonnay.

Wine Description

The Sandhi Sta. Rita Hills Chardonnay is often described as a "laser-focused" and racy expression of cool-climate fruit.

  • Appearance: Clear, pale lemon-gold.

  • Nose: Highly aromatic and complex, featuring notes of lemon curd, green apple, and white peach, often accompanied by the signature "struck flint" or matchstick reduction. Subtle hints of warm brioche, white flowers, and ginger add depth.

  • Palate: Medium-bodied and elegantly structured. It is celebrated for its vibrant, citrusy acidity and a saline minerality that persists through the finish. The texture is silky yet "grippy," reflecting careful 500L oak puncheon fermentation and aging with minimal new oak.

Food Pairing

The wine's bright acidity and saline notes make it a versatile food companion. It pairs beautifully with fresh seafood like grilled shrimp, seared scallops, or oysters. It also complements poultry dishes with lemon-herb seasonings, creamy pasta, and earthy appetizers like roasted leek and asparagus tarts or soft cheeses like Brie.

title: Michter's 10 Year Old Kentucky Straight Rye
bodyHtml:
Michter's 10 Year Old Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Rye is a limited-release whiskey that exemplifies the distillery's dedication to producing high-quality rye expressions. Aged for a decade in new American white oak barrels, this single barrel offering is bottled at 92.8 proof (46.4% ABV), capturing the essence of a "Kentucky-style" rye.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: Rich aromas of vanilla and toffee are complemented by toasted almonds, cinnamon, and a hint of orange citrus.

  • Palate: The whiskey presents deep notes of vanilla and toffee, with toasted almonds and cinnamon, accompanied by an ample dose of crushed pepper and a hint of orange citrus.

  • Finish: A long, satisfying finish that balances sweetness and spice, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavor profile.

Production Details

This rye is crafted from a mash bill that includes a significant portion of corn and malted barley alongside rye, distinguishing it as a "Kentucky-style" rye. The whiskey is aged for a minimum of 10 years in fire-charred, new American white oak barrels, allowing it to develop its rich and complex character.

Serving Suggestions

To fully appreciate its nuanced flavors, it's recommended to enjoy Michter's 10 Year Old Rye neat or with a few drops of water.

title: Stroppiana Bussia Barolo 2017
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Stroppiana Bussia Barolo is a red wine from the Barolo DOCG in the Piedmont region of Italy. The family estate, Cantina Stroppiana, was founded in the mid-20th century and is currently managed by the fourth generation of winemakers, Leonardo and Altea Stroppiana. The winery's history is deeply rooted in two prestigious townships, La Morra and Monforte d'Alba, with the Bussia vineyard specifically representing the family heritage of their mother, Stefania.

Wine Description

This wine displays a classic ruby red colour with distinct garnet highlights. The sensory profile is intense and refined, featuring a bouquet of forest floor, tobacco, and cocoa, which evolves into notes of white truffle and goudron as it ages. On the palate, it is full bodied, dry, and powerful, offering a warm and velvety texture with balanced yet firm tannins that provide a harmonious structure. Crafted from 100% Nebbiolo grapes sourced from the Bussia cru in Monforte d'Alba, the wine typically has an ABV of 14.5%. It undergoes aging for at least 38 months, including significant time in oak barrels, to achieve its characteristic complexity. While the winery emphasizes a close connection to the land and tradition, this specific vintage is not certified organic.

title: Conceito Legitimo Red 2020
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Conceito Legitimo Red originates from the Douro Valley in Portugal. The history of Conceito began in 1940 when brothers José and Luís Costa Ferreira acquired their first vineyard in Vale da Teja, though the family business is now led by Carla Ferreira and winemaker Rita Marques. The winery's philosophy is rooted in 'concept wine' out of love for the terroir, emphasizing precision, sobriety, and a deep respect for natural cycles.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a pale cherry red colour and a sensory profile described as pure, natural, and stripped. The aroma features peppery and spicy notes with hints of warm herbs and cherry fruit. On the palate, it is medium bodied with a spicy and 'greedy' lightness that makes it soft, fresh, and appetizing. The finish is persistent and focuses on elegant fruit purity. The varietal composition includes traditional Douro grapes: Tinta Roriz, Touriga Franca, and Touriga Nacional. The wine typically has an ABV of 12.5% to 13.5% and is fermented with native yeasts and minimal intervention. While not formally certified organic in all listings, the estate cultivates its 86 hectares without pesticides or herbicides.

title: Mucchietto Soave 2023
bodyHtml:
Mucchietto Soave is a white wine from the Soave region in the Veneto area of northeast Italy. The winery is part of a tradition that balances respect for the local ecosystem with modern winemaking, focusing on the expression of native grape varieties. The winemaking philosophy is rooted in organic viticulture, ensuring that the vineyards are managed without the use of synthetic chemicals to preserve the natural balance of the soil and the purity of the fruit.

Wine Description

This wine displays a bright straw yellow colour with subtle greenish reflections. The sensory profile features a delicate and fresh bouquet of white flowers, elderberry, and green apple, accompanied by light citrus notes. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied and well balanced, offering flavours of pear and stone fruit with a crisp acidity. The structure is defined by a characteristic mineral vein and a clean, refreshing finish that often reveals a hint of almond. Composed of 100% Garganega grapes, this wine typically has an ABV of 12%. It is certified organic, reflecting a commitment to sustainable environmental practices.

title: Noa Italian Bitter (Non Alcoholic) - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This beverage originates from Canada. It is produced by NOA, a Canadian brand focused on crafting premium non alcoholic spirits that prioritize complex flavour profiles. The brand is part of the Monsieur Cocktail family, an award winning operation based in Quebec City that values traditional distillation techniques and modern innovation.

Spirit Description

The spirit presents a vibrant red hue in the glass. The aroma is characterized by sweet herbal notes up front, featuring scents of orange, grapefruit, and a soft violet finish. On the palate, it delivers a frank and long lasting bitterness with flavours of gentian and quinine bark, balanced by fresh citrus fruit and warm spices like cinnamon and star anise. The body is multifaceted and refined, offering a zesty and refreshing finish. It is designed as a sophisticated alternative to classic Italian bitters like Campari. The alcohol by volume is less than 0.5%.

title: Noa Italian Amaro (Non Alcoholic) - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This beverage originates from Canada. It is produced by NOA, a Quebec based brand that specializes in high end non alcoholic spirits. The brand was developed by the experts at Monsieur Cocktail, a company renowned for its artisanal approach to syrups and cocktail mixers.

Spirit Description

The spirit features a deep, dark brown colour typical of traditional Italian digestifs. The aroma is complex and earthy, with notes of roasted coffee, cocoa, and an array of botanical herbs. On the palate, it offers a rich and velvety texture with a perfect balance of sweetness and intense bitterness from gentian root and cinchona bark. The finish is long and woody, leaving a sophisticated spicy warmth. It is designed to capture the soul of a classic amaro while remaining sugar free and low in calories. The alcohol by volume is less than 0.5%.

title: Noa Sweet Vermouth (Non Alcoholic) - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This beverage originates from Canada. It is produced by NOA, a Quebec based brand launched in 2023 by the team behind Monsieur Cocktail, including founder Patrice Plante. The company was born from a desire to improve inclusivity in the hospitality industry by providing sophisticated, high quality alternatives for those who choose not to drink alcohol.

Spirit Description

The spirit features a deep, rich colour reminiscent of traditional red vermouth. The aroma is complex, featuring front and centre notes of red fruit and subtle scents of wine vinegar. On the palate, it is round and dominated by blackcurrant and grape notes, which are balanced by caramel sugar, tannins, and warm spices. The finish is spicy and persistent, highlighted by a bold blackcurrant touch. It is inspired by the famous French Dolin style, offering an impressive aromatic balance and a smooth, nuanced mouthfeel. The alcohol by volume is less than 0.5%.

title: Domaine Rougeot Volnay Santenots Premier Cru 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Domaine Rougeot Volnay Santenots Premier Cru 2022 is a red wine from the Volnay Premier Cru appellation in the Côte de Beaune region of Burgundy, France. The Domaine is located in the centre of Meursault and has been in the Rougeot family for generations, with current winemaker Pierre Henri Rougeot producing minimal intervention wines since his return to the estate in 2010. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes organic farming and a natural approach, often bottling wines without added sulphur to preserve the energy and transparency of each specific terroir.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a luminous ruby red colour with cherry reflections and medium intensity. The sensory profile is elegant and complex, featuring intense aromas of red berries, cherry, and cranberry, underpinned by spicy notes of white pepper, earthy flavours, and a fine mineral trace. On the palate, it is medium bodied with a silky texture and lively acidity that tightens and carries the wine. The structure is defined by fine grained, perfectly integrated tannins and a long, persistent finish characterized by pure fruit and wet stone minerality. Crafted from 100% Pinot Noir, the wine typically has an ABV of 13%. It is produced from organically farmed vineyards and is often vinified without added sulphur.

Jasper Morris (Inside Burgundy) rates this vintage 93-96 points, calling it a "superb" and "impressive" wine.

title: Castello Di Verduno Barbaresco Rabajabas 2019
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Castello Di Verduno Barbaresco Rabaja Bas originates from the esteemed Barbaresco DOCG in the Piedmont region of Italy. The historic estate is owned by the Burlotto family and led by Gabriella Burlotto and Franco Bianco, who maintain a beautiful cellar at the top of the village of Verduno. The winemaking philosophy is deeply rooted in tradition, emphasizing soulful expressions of terroir through sustainable farming and time-honoured methods like fermentation with indigenous yeasts and aging in large oak barrels.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a beautiful medium red to light garnet colour typical of the Nebbiolo variety. The sensory profile is fragrant and clear, featuring primary aromas of wild strawberries, raspberries, and alpine berries, which are layered with notes of east-Asian spice, tobacco, sandalwood, and rose petals. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and structured yet elegant, offering a substantial mouth-filling texture with flavours of cherry, mint, and savory mineral earthiness. This 100% Nebbiolo is crafted from vines planted between 1974 and 1990 in the Rabajà-Bas vineyard, a site formerly part of the famous Rabajà cru before being divided by a road in the 1990s. The wine was fermented in stainless steel followed by 18 to 24 months of aging in large used Slavonian oak vats and typically has an ABV of 14%. It is produced using organic practices and bottled without fining or filtration. The optimal drinking window extends from the present through 2057.

title: Domaine des Garriguettes Cotes du Rhone 'Fleur de Lune' 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Domaine des Garriguettes 'Fleur de Lune' rouge originates from the Southern Rhône Valley in France, specifically from the biodynamically farmed vineyards near the village of Gadagne. This family-run estate, now led by Sébastien Clément, was a pioneer in organic viticulture in the region. The winemaking philosophy for the 'Fleur de Lune' cuvée focuses on alignment with the lunar calendar and biodynamic principles to produce expressive, soulful wines that reflect their Provençal heritage.

Wine Description

This red wine features a radiant garnet or deep vibrant purple colour. The sensory profile is aromatically explosive, offering intense notes of red and black fruits—such as blackberries, cherries, and peppered strawberries—interwoven with southern Rhône markers like thyme, olive, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and powerful yet approachable, characterized by a 'crunchy' fruit texture, savoury spice, and finely woven, harmonious tannins. The finish is juicy and persistent, balancing its richness with a fresh mineral drive. The varietal composition for the 2024 vintage typically blends 80% Syrah and 20% Grenache, though some parcels include Mourvèdre for added structure. It has an ABV of 14% and is certified organic (Ecocert) and biodynamic (Demeter), produced naturally without additives.

Food Pairing

The wine's generous fruit and savoury spice make it an ideal companion for hearty, slow-cooked dishes such as beef cheek ragu, lamb joints seasoned with garlic and rosemary, or classic Provençal stews. It also pairs effectively with grilled meats, charcuterie boards featuring salami and aged cheeses, and spicy dishes that complement its peppery profile.

title: Albert Bichot Bourgogne Aligote 'Champ Renard' 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Albert Bichot Domaine Adélie Bourgogne Aligoté 'Champ Renard' originates from the Mercurey region in the Côte Chalonnaise subregion of Burgundy, France. The estate, named after Albéric Bichot's daughter Adélie, was established in 2005 as part of the family owned Maison Albert Bichot, which has a legacy dating back to 1831. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes an 'organic spirit' and a commitment to capturing the precision and refinement of Burgundy's diverse terroirs through minimal intervention.

Wine Description

This wine displays a bright pale gold colour with crystalline clarity. The sensory profile features a fresh and floral nose dominated by white flowers, citrus peel, and green apple, underscored by notes of ginger spice and a mineral 'ocean breeze'. On the palate, it is fresh and lively with a vibrant acidity and a round, consistent body that offers flavours of kiwi fruit, grapefruit, and a touch of honeysuckle. The finish is clean, refreshing, and persistent, often revealing a hint of dried fruit or almonds. Crafted from 100% Aligoté grapes grown on calcareous clay soils, this wine is typically aged for 8 months in temperature controlled stainless steel tanks on fine lees to preserve its natural vivacity. The ABV is approximately 12% to 12.5%. While Maison Albert Bichot focuses on organic principles, this specific bottling is not widely listed as a certified organic product.

title: Maison Taisne Riocour Blanc de Noirs
bodyHtml:
Maison Taisne Riocour Blanc de Noirs is a sparkling wine from France, specifically the Les Riceys commune within the Aube region of Champagne. Established in 1837, the maison is currently led by the five de Taisne siblings, who began bottling their own wines in 2014 to pay tribute to their parents, Angelito de Taisne and Claude de Riocour. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on revealing the unique character of the Les Riceys terroir, characterized by steep slopes and rocky Jurassic limestone marl.

Wine Description

This Champagne presents a brilliant light gold colour with a fine, persistent effervescence. The nose is complex and chiselled, opening with fleshy aromas of stone fruits like Mirabelle plum and peach, which transition into earthy notes of undergrowth, humus, and brown mushrooms. Secondary aromas include freshly baked pastries, candied orange peel, dried flowers, and a hint of sweet spice. On the palate, the wine is both tender and rigorous, offering a balanced profile of juicy red berry fruits and a distinct mineral tension derived from its limestone origins. It is a full-bodied Blanc de Noirs made from 100% Pinot Noir, sourced predominantly from celebrated vineyards such as Tronchois and Val Germain. The wine typically features an ABV of 12% to 12.5% with a low dosage of 3.5g/L. While the estate has held HVE Level 3 certification since 2016, it is currently in conversion to certified organic status, with biodynamic practices also being tested on certain parcels.

Food Pairing

The vinous and intense nature of this Blanc de Noirs allows it to pair exceptionally well with structured dishes. It is highly recommended with seafood such as baked oysters, razor clams with lemon and dill, or a fresh sea bream tartare. Its power also complements poultry dishes like Bresse chicken or roasted chicken with herbs. For more robust pairings, it can accompany beef tartare, cured meats, or aged cheeses like Grana Padano.

Vintage Quality

As a non-vintage (NV) blend, this wine typically incorporates around 10% reserve wines and spends three years ageing on the lees to ensure a consistent house style. The 2024 growing season in the Aube was exceptionally difficult due to record rainfall and catastrophic mildew outbreaks, which significantly reduced yields. In contrast, the 2025 vintage has been described as 'ideal' and 'easy', characterized by beautiful weather and healthy clusters that promise excellent quality despite a medium-sized crop.

title: Fattoria del Pino Rosso di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
Fattoria del Pino Rosso di Montalcino is an authentic red wine from the Montalcino region in Tuscany, Italy. The estate was founded in 2000 by Jessica Pellegrini and her father, Nerio, in the renowned Montosoli area on the northern slopes of the Montalcino hill. Jessica, a former fashion professional, returned to the land to manage the estate with a philosophy centered on celebrating nature, tradition, and the purity of the Sangiovese grape.

Wine Description

This Rosso di Montalcino typically presents a pale ruby red colour. The sensory profile is fresh and lively, featuring vibrant aromas of red berries, wild strawberry, and rose hips, accented by floral notes of violets and hints of musk, menthol, and citrus. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and structured yet remains extremely drinkable and elegant. It offers soft, velvety tannins and a persistent, long-lasting finish that reflects the unique chalky and marl-rich soils of the Montosoli cru. The wine is composed of 100% Sangiovese Grosso and typically has an ABV ranging from 14% to 14.5%. Following organic and biodynamic principles, the grapes are fermented spontaneously with indigenous yeasts and aged for 12 months in steel followed by 8 months in large Slavonian oak barrels.

Food Pairing

The intense fruit and robust structure of this wine make it a versatile companion for traditional Tuscan cuisine. It pairs exceptionally well with pasta dishes featuring meat or tomato sauces, as well as grilled or stewed red meats like Florentine steak and lamb. Its balanced tannins and acidity also complement roasted poultry, such as rabbit, chicken, or turkey. For a cheese course, it is ideal with medium-aged to mature selections like Parmigiano Reggiano, pecorino, or Provolone del Monaco.

title: Francois Xavier Barc 'Le Vent Mineral' 2025
bodyHtml:
Francois-Xavier Barc 'Le Vent Mineral' is a refined dry white wine from the Vouvray appellation in the Loire Valley, France. The wine is produced by Complices de Loire, a venture founded in 2010 by Francois-Xavier Barc after many years of winemaking in Chinon. Barc's winemaking philosophy focuses on 'pleasure and quality', utilizing a demanding selection of vineyard plots and a sustainable approach to viticulture to reveal the authentic character of the Loire terroir.

Wine Description

This wine displays a bright golden colour. The sensory profile features an intense and fresh nose with floral notes of acacia and vibrant citrus aromas such as grapefruit and lemon. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and rounded, offering a generous and flavourful experience marked by candied white fruits and peach. A persistent and lingering acidity reinforces the wine's freshness and highlights its distinct mineral edge. Crafted from 100% hand-harvested Chenin Blanc, the grapes are sourced from parcels situated on clay and limestone soils on the edge of the valley. The wine typically has an ABV of 12% and is produced using traditional methods with ageing on the lees for a minimum of seven months to add structure. This product is certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and mineral structure of this dry Vouvray make it a versatile partner for a range of cuisines. It is particularly recommended for pairing with Asian and Caribbean dishes, especially those featuring seafood with coconut or mango sauces. Other suggested pairings include grilled fish, shellfish, and appetizers such as fresh goat cheese or Camembert with truffles. For a unique dessert pairing, it complements peach crumble or tarte tatin.

title: Elio Altare Barolo 'Arborina' 2020
bodyHtml:
Elio Altare Barolo Arborina 2020 is a prestigious red wine from the La Morra commune in the Piedmont region of Italy. The Altare family's history on this farm began in 1948, but it was Elio's revolutionary 1976 trip to Burgundy that transformed the estate's philosophy toward a more modern, elegant interpretation of Nebbiolo. Today, the winery continues to prioritize balance and finesse, utilizing manual vineyard labour and a 'hands-off' approach in the cellar to preserve the natural quality of the fruit.

Wine Description

This Barolo presents a bright ruby red colour with fine garnet reflections. The aromatic profile is intense and focused, offering a layered bouquet of dark cherry, cranberry, and wild strawberry, intertwined with floral notes of rose petals and dried violets. Subtle secondary notes of spice, leather, menthol, and rock salt add significant aromatic breadth. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, displaying a driving tannic profile that is both driving and silken in texture. It features a vibrant acidity and polished fruit flavours of black currant and balsamic-tinged berries, leading to a persistent and graceful finish. This 100% Nebbiolo is sourced from the clay-dominated south to south-east facing Arborina amphitheatre. The wine typically has an ABV of 15% and is aged for 24 months in French barriques. The estate follows organic farming practices, although it does not always carry formal certification on the label.

Food Pairing

The powerful tannins and elegant structure of this Barolo make it a natural match for hearty and rich dishes. It pairs excellently with roasted red meats, game such as venison or wild boar, and traditional Piedmontese truffle-based risottos. Its acidity also allows it to cut through the richness of aged cheeses like Castelmagno, Gorgonzola, or Parmigiano Reggiano.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 vintage in Barolo is recognized as a year of 'selective excellence', characterized by a warmer-than-average growing season that produced mid-weight wines of great seductive appeal and balance. Despite a challenging hailstorm in July that impacted some La Morra vineyards, the fruit achieved excellent maturity, resulting in wines with bright energy and refined tannins. Winemakers were particularly successful in capturing fresh, under-ripe fruit notes that provide a vital counterpoint to the season's warmth.

title: Domaine Denizot Sancerre Les Bouffants 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine Denizot Sancerre Les Bouffants originates from France, specifically from the prestigious Sancerre appellation in the Loire Valley. The estate is a family owned property spanning eight generations, currently led by Thibauld and Jennifer Denizot. Their winemaking philosophy centers on minimal intervention and sustainable viticulture to allow the natural characteristics of the Chavignol terroir to shine.

Wine Description

Les Bouffants shimmers with a pale straw colour and subtle green highlights. The nose is intensely aromatic and complex, presenting a bouquet of zesty lime, grapefruit, and green apple, alongside notes of boxwood, elderflower, and fennel. On the palate, the wine is energetic and well structured, balancing a silky texture with crisp acidity and flavours of ripe pear, white peach, and nectarine. It features a distinctive flinty minerality and a long, saline finish. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc is sourced from a mythical south-facing limestone hillside in Chavignol known for its early ripening potential. The wine has an ABV of 12.5% and is fermented and aged in a combination of 600 litre demi muids and 350 litre oak cigars for over one year. This wine is produced using organic practices.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and mineral backbone of this Sancerre make it an excellent companion for a variety of fresh dishes. It is a classic match for local goat cheeses, particularly Crottin de Chavignol. Suggested pairings also include seafood such as oysters, pan-seared scallops, or white fish served with citrus sauces. For more adventurous pairings, it complements lightly spicy Thai or Asian dishes, such as green curry or vegetable tempura.

title: Alain Gueneau Sancerre La Guiberte 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Alain Gueneau Sancerre La Guiberte is a white wine produced in the Sancerre appellation of the Loire Valley, France. The family owned and operated domaine is located in Sury en Vaux, where winemaker Alain Gueneau manages the 16 hectare estate alongside his daughter, Elisa. Their winemaking philosophy is dedicated to sustainable viticulture and preserving the unique terroir of their sloping vineyards, which are primarily composed of 'terres blanches' (calcareous clay) and stony 'caillottes' soils.

Wine Description

This wine displays a pale yellow hue with greenish reflections and excellent clarity. The sensory profile is elegant and precise, featuring delicate aromas of white peach, elderflower, and fresh herbs, such as nettle and menthol, followed by a hint of flinty minerality. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied and dry, offering refined flavours of sweet citrus, lemon, and grapefruit with a fleshy stone fruit core. The structure is defined by a moderate to sheer acidity that balances its ripeness, leading to a long, elegant finish with subtle notes of blanched almonds and lemon rind.

title: Clos Bellane Cotes Du Rhone Valreas Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Clos Bellane Cotes du Rhone Valreas Blanc 2023 is a white wine produced in the southern Rhone Valley of France. The estate was acquired in 2010 by Stephane Vedeau, whose winemaking philosophy focuses on 'high altitude freshness' by utilizing east-facing vineyards located 400 metres above sea level. This unique orientation and elevation allow the vines to receive morning sun while avoiding the intense heat of the afternoon, resulting in wines with remarkable tension and elegance.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a pale yellow colour with bright highlights. The sensory profile is elegant and aromatic, featuring a bouquet of white flowers, citrus zest, and ripe pear, complemented by subtle notes of honeysuckle and white peach. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and exceptionally fresh, offering a balanced acidity and a silky texture that carries flavours of lemon curd and apricot. The finish is long and clean, often revealing a distinct saline minerality characteristic of the estate's limestone-rich soils. The varietal composition is a blend of approximately 65% Marsanne, 30% Viognier, and 5% Rousanne. It typically has an ABV of 13.5% and is a certified organic wine.

title: Ciavolich Aries Pecorino 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Ciavolich 'Aries' Pecorino Colline Pescaresi 2024 is a white wine from the Abruzzo region in central Italy. The Ciavolich family, originally Bulgarian wool merchants, settled in Abruzzo in the 1500s and constructed one of the region's first underground wine cellars in 1853. Today, the estate is led by Chiara Ciavolich, whose winemaking philosophy balances modern interpretations of traditional varieties with sustainable practices and a deep respect for historical techniques.

Wine Description

This wine presents a bright straw yellow colour and offers an aromatic sensory profile. The bouquet opens with notes of minty freshness and herbal aromas of rosemary, thyme, and juniper berries, alongside citrus laced orchard fruit such as loquat and candied lemon. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, juicy, and supple, with flavours of ripe apple, pear, and white peach underscored by a distinct flinty minerality. The finish is long, energetic, and clean, often displaying a salty trail and refreshing citrus notes. Crafted from 100% Pecorino grapes, the wine is fermented in stainless steel, with a small percentage matured in old French oak tonneaux for three months. It has an ABV of 13% to 13.5% and is produced using sustainable farming practices, though it is not certified organic.

title: Chateau des Annereaux Lalande 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Chateau des Annereaux Lalande de Pomerol is a red wine from the Lalande de Pomerol appellation in the Libournais region of Bordeaux, France. The Hessel family has owned this historic estate since the 14th century, with the descendants of the original Annereau family farming the land without interruption for over six centuries. The winemaking philosophy is rooted in organic farming, a practice the estate has employed since 2007, and a commitment to preserving the heritage of its 25 hectare vineyard.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits an elegant and aromatic profile typical of its cool vintage. The sensory profile features intense notes of leather, spice, and chocolate on the nose, accompanied by black fruits, clove, and black pepper. On the palate, it is opulent and lush with a creamy texture and silky tannins that lead to a lingering, spicy finish. The varietal composition is a blend of 88% Merlot, 12% Cabernet Franc, and a small portion of Cabernet Sauvignon. It has a stylistic focus on freshness and balance rather than dense concentration. The ABV is approximately 14.5%. The wine is produced following organic farming methods.

title: R. Stuart Pinot Noir Big Fire 2022
bodyHtml: Dark plum. Aromas of cherry, plum, chocolate, coffee, and crushed blackberry. Flavours of chocolate, coffee, vanilla, cherry, nutmeg, and black pepper. A gentle beginning with a rich middle and a soft, long finish.

title: Plessis Duval Saumur Champigny 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Plessis Duval Saumur Champigny originates from the Saumur Champigny appellation in the Middle Loire Valley of France. The estate is part of the Castel Frères portfolio, a group with deep roots in French winemaking that emphasizes the expression of regional savoir-faire and 'terroir'. The vineyard is located in a protected area between the Loire and Thouet rivers, where winemakers have followed a biodiversity and sustainability program since 2004 to preserve the environmental health of the nine villages that comprise the appellation.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a luminous garnet red colour. The sensory profile is elegant and supple, featuring a bouquet dominated by red and black fruits such as cherry and raspberry, alongside floral hints of violet and lavender. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied and well structured, displaying dense black cherry flavours complemented by hints of coffee, green pepper, and savory earth. The wine is defined by fine, velvety tannins and a fresh, balanced finish with spicy undertones. Crafted from 100% Cabernet Franc grapes, it typically has an ABV 12.5%.

title: Francois Mikulski Pommard
bodyHtml:
Francois Mikulski's small winery, which is only about 9 hectares in size, has only existed since 1992, but it quickly made a name for itself worldwide thanks to its outstanding wines. 

Specialist journalists and wine connoisseurs like to compare his wines with those of the neighboring cult winemaker Coche-Dury - with the difference that they are significantly cheaper than them. The wines appear to be rather "modern" in style without actually being so. The use of new wood is only 20 to 30 percent. Cultivation takes place in a natural economy. The main focus is on preserving the natural balance and biodiversity of the soil.

title: Lagavulin 12 Year Old Special Release 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Lagavulin 12 Year Old Special Release 2024 is a premium single malt Scotch whisky from the Isle of Islay, Scotland. Produced by the Lagavulin Distillery, which was officially founded in 1816 by John Johnston, the brand is currently owned by the multinational spirits company Diageo. This specific expression, titled 'Fireside Tales', is part of Diageo's annual Special Release collection, a series that showcases rare and experimental bottlings from their prestigious distillery portfolio.

Spirit Description

This limited edition is matured in a unique combination of first-fill ex-bourbon and refill casks, a deliberate choice intended to temper Lagavulin's legendary peat smoke with sweet, active oak influence.

  • Colour: The spirit displays a bright golden or shimmering gold hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is clean and ashy, featuring intense peat smoke and maritime brine mingled with bright yellow fruits like pineapple and mango, alongside hints of fresh vanilla and coconut.

  • Palate: It offers a punchy and bold palate where bonfire smoke and charred oak meet creamy yellow custard and toffee. Flavours of lemon zest, honey, and aromatic baking spices like cinnamon and clove are also present.

  • Body: The whisky is medium-bodied with a rich and opulent mouthfeel that balances its high strength with velvety sweetness.

  • Finish: The experience concludes with a long, warming finish of deeply ashy notes, iodine, and tobacco, offset by a persistent caramel sweetness.

title: Castello Di Verduno Dolcetto D'Alba 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Castello di Verduno Dolcetto d'Alba is a red wine from the Alba region of Piedmont, Italy. The historic estate is a unique link between two prestigious wine towns, as the family owns the castle in Verduno (Barolo) and the Campot estate in Barbaresco. The winemaking philosophy, led by the Burlotto family and legendary oenologist Mario Scaglione, focuses on traditional, minimal-intervention techniques to produce wines that are pure, elegant, and expressive of their specific limestone-rich terroirs.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a vibrant ruby red colour with youthful violet reflections. The sensory profile is fresh and fruit-forward, featuring aromas of red cherry, raspberry, and crushed blackberries, accented by subtle floral notes of violets and a hint of bitter almond. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and dry, offering a crunchy fruit texture with balanced acidity and the characteristic soft tannins of the Dolcetto variety. The finish is clean and refreshing, often leaving a slight savory, almond-like note.

title: Agnes Paquet Hautes Cotes De Beaune Rouge 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Agnes Paquet Hautes Cotes de Beaune Rouge is a red wine from the Meloisey district in the Hautes Cotes de Beaune subregion of Burgundy, France. Agnes Paquet established her domaine in 2000 after deciding to reclaim a family vineyard plot that had been acquired in the 1950s and leased out for decades. Her winemaking philosophy is rooted in a deep respect for the land, focusing on organic farming and minimal intervention to allow the specific terroir of her 13 hectares to speak clearly through the wine.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a bright ruby red colour with crystalline clarity. The sensory profile is highly expressive, featuring intense aromas of red and black fruits such as cherry, raspberry, and blueberry, accented by delicate floral notes of lavender and a hint of white pepper. On the palate, it is fresh, juicy, and 'croquant' (crunchy), with a supple texture and a vibrant tension that reflects its high altitude origin. The structure is balanced with fine, well integrated tannins and a long, persistent finish that highlights pure fruit and a subtle spiciness.

title: Plessis Duval Muscadet Sevre Et Maine Sur Lie 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Plessis Duval Muscadet Sevre Et Maine Sur Lie is a white wine from the Loire Valley in France. The estate is part of the Castel Frères portfolio, a group dedicated to showcasing the diverse terroirs and regional expertise of French viticulture. The vineyards are situated near the Atlantic coast, where the maritime climate and unique soils of volcanic and metamorphic rock influence the vines.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a pale gold colour with crystalline reflections. The sensory profile is fresh and aromatic, featuring a bouquet of citrus fruits, green apple, and white flowers, accented by a distinctive mineral 'sea spray' note. On the palate, it is light bodied and crisp, offering vibrant flavours of lemon and lime balanced by a subtle creaminess. The 'Sur Lie' designation indicates the wine was aged on its fine lees, which provides a delicate richness, a soft mouthfeel, and a hint of yeasty complexity. Composed of 100% Melon de Bourgogne, it typically has an ABV of 12%.

title: Berton Metal Black Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Berton Metal Black Shiraz is a bold red wine from South Eastern Australia. Established by Bob and Cherie Berton in May 1996, Berton Vineyard has grown from a humble 30-hectare plot to become a significant independent producer known for its high-quality varietal wines. The winemaking philosophy behind the Metal Range is to take stand-alone varietals and craft exceptional, unrestrained expressions that uphold the reputation of Australian Shiraz for huge, intense flavours.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a deep, dark ruby colour and a decadent sensory profile. The aroma is concentrated with notes of blackberry, cherry, and plum, layered over toasty vanillin and spicy oak. On the palate, it is full-flavoured and intense, offering rich flavours of ripe berries, blueberry, and mocha with a velvety texture. The structure is defined by ripe, dense tannins that provide substantial length and a firm finish. The wine is suitable for vegetarians but is not certified organic.

title: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel 'Barrel Proof' Tennessee Whiskey
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Barrel Proof is a premium Tennessee Whiskey produced in Lynchburg, Tennessee. Crafted by the historic Jack Daniel Distillery, which is America's oldest registered distillery, this expression represents the first time the brand has offered a whiskey bottled directly from the barrel in its purest form. Each bottle is drawn from an individual barrel selected by the Master Distiller for its unique character and intensity, bypassing the standard dilution process to deliver a spirit of exceptional strength and depth.

Spirit Description

This whiskey presents a deep, rich mahogany colour in the glass, indicative of its high proof and interaction with the wood. The nose is intense and aromatic, delivering waves of sweet brown sugar, toasted oak, and rich vanilla, layered with the distillery's signature note of ripe banana. On the palate, it is full-bodied and viscous, offering a robust explosion of flavours including dark caramel, baking spices, and charred wood, balanced by a distinct sweetness. The finish is exceptionally long, warm, and peppery, leaving a lasting impression of toasted almond and barrel char.

title: Domaine de Maubet Rouge 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine is produced in France, specifically within the Gascony region (Côte de Gascogne). Domaine de Maubet has been a family-owned estate since 1855, originally functioning as a farm before the Fontan family dedicated the property entirely to viticulture in the 1980s. Their winemaking philosophy centers on a deep commitment to the environment and the production of expressive, fruit-forward wines that highlight the unique sand and clay soils of their estate.

Wine Description

The Maubet Rouge displays a bright and deep purple colour. The nose is highly aromatic and fresh, dominated by scents of ripe blackcurrants, blackberries, and a subtle hint of spicy green pepper. On the palate, the wine is supple and well-balanced, featuring soft tannins and a refreshing fruitiness that makes it very approachable. It offers a clean, medium finish with lingering notes of dark berries. This wine is a blend of Tannat, Merlot, and Cabernet Sauvignon.

Food Pairing

This wine's fresh fruit profile and moderate tannins make it an excellent choice for casual dining. It pairs wonderfully with grilled red meats, charcuterie boards, or a classic duck confit. It is also a great companion for Mediterranean vegetable dishes and semi-hard cheeses like Cantal or young Gouda.

title: Diplomatico Mantuano Rum
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Diplomático Mantuano is a premium blended rum from Venezuela, produced at the foot of the Andes Mountains in the town of La Miel. The distillery, Destilerías Unidas S.A. (DUSA), began its history in 1959 under the ownership of Seagram's International before being acquired in 2002 by a group of Venezuelan entrepreneurs. This locally owned estate holds the 'Ron de Venezuela' DOC (Protected Denomination of Origin) and is celebrated for its diverse distillation methods and artisanal approach to rum making.

Spirit Description

This rum presents a dark golden colour in the glass. The nose is rich and inviting, featuring prominent aromas of dried plums, oak, and a delicate spiciness. On the palate, the body is complex and well-balanced, delivering a less sweet and more robust profile than its counterparts, with notes of dried fruits, vanilla, and wood. The experience concludes with a harmonious and slightly dry finish, marked by lingering hints of oak and soft spice. It is a blend of rums aged for up to eight years in white oak casks—previously used for bourbon and malt whiskies, and is bottled at 40% Standard.

title: Viña Arboleda Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Viña Arboleda Pinot Noir originates from the Aconcagua Costa subregion within the Aconcagua Valley of Chile. The winery was founded in 1999 by Eduardo Chadwick, a fifth generation vintner and owner of the iconic Seña estate. The name 'Arboleda' (grove of trees) pays tribute to the 1,450 hectares of native forest surrounding the sustainably managed vineyards. The estate's philosophy focuses on crafting single vineyard wines that reveal the purest expression of the unique cool climate terroir through minimal intervention.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a bright ruby red colour with violet hues and a complex sensory profile. The bouquet offers intense aromas of rosehip, black cherry, and strawberries, accented by spicy touches of dill, rosemary, and soft notes of cinnamon. On the palate, it is fresh and vibrant with a medium body and flavours of red fruits, sweet spices, and subtle hints of damp earth or truffles. The structure is defined by fine grained, chalky tannins and a persistent acidity that leads to a long, mineral, and slightly saline finish. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, the wine typically has an ABV of 13% to 14% and is aged for approximately 11 months in French oak barrels. While the winery is strictly committed to sustainability, this specific label is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window extends for more than 6 years from the vintage date.

title: Diplomatico Exclusive Reserve Rum
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Diplomático Reserva Exclusiva is a world-renowned sipping rum from Venezuela, specifically produced in the Andes Mountains foothills near the town of Sarare. The distillery, Destilerías Unidas S.A. (DUSA), was established in 1959 and was originally a joint venture involving Seagram's International. In 2002, a group of Venezuelan entrepreneurs led by the Ballesteros family acquired the facility, transforming it into a 100% locally owned operation that has since become a global benchmark for premium rum.

Spirit Description

This rum presents a deep, rich mahogany colour with golden reflections. The nose is complex and highly aromatic, offering characteristic notes of maple syrup, orange peel, brown sugar, and liquorice. On the palate, the body is luscious and velvety, delivering a symphony of sweet toffee fudge, chocolate, and tropical fruits, balanced by oaky spice and hints of vanilla. The finish is exceptionally long and elegant, leaving a persistent warmth of caramelized sugar and dark cocoa. It is a blend of copper pot still rums aged for up to 12 years and is bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Diplomatico Planas Rum
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Diplomático Planas is a unique, aged white rum produced in Venezuela at the foot of the Andes Mountains. It is named after the "Planas" valley, a region whose specific microclimate and fertile lands contribute to the rum's distinct character. Unlike standard white rums that are often unaged, Planas is a blend of pot still, column still, and batch kettle distillates aged for up to six years. It is then carefully charcoal-filtered up to six times to remove the colour while retaining the complex flavours and oily texture acquired during maturation.

Spirit Description

This rum is crystal clear in appearance, though its heavy viscosity is often visible on the glass. The nose is surprisingly intense for a white rum, offering fresh and tropical aromas of coconut flakes, ground coffee, and a hint of lemon zest. On the palate, it delivers a rich, creamy mouthfeel with bold flavours of toffee, vanilla, and overripe banana, balanced by a subtle herbaceous zing and white pepper. The finish is long and pronounced, featuring lingering notes of coconut cream and a delicate oak influence. It is bottled at a higher-than-average 47% ABV, which provides an extra "kick" that helps it stand up in complex cocktails.

title: The Japanese Liqueur - Yuzukosho - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
The Japanese Liqueur - Yuzukosho is a groundbreaking "savory liqueur" that translates the iconic Japanese condiment yuzukosho into a liquid spirit. It is produced by The Japanese Bitters Company (often branded simply as The Japanese Liqueur), founded by renowned bartender Yuki Yamazaki. Based in Chiba, Japan, Yamazaki uses a combination of traditional maceration and modern sous-vide vacuum extraction to capture the hyper-authentic essence of Japanese botanicals. This expression specifically utilizes premium Kito Yuzu from Tokushima Prefecture, celebrated for its intense fragrance and high oil content.

Spirit Description

This liqueur is clear to pale yellow and offers a sensory experience that shifts from bright citrus to sharp heat. The nose is dominated by the zesty, floral aroma of fresh Kito Yuzu peel, with an underlying vegetal note of green chili. On the palate, the initial impression is the tart, refreshing acidity of yuzu, which is quickly followed by the distinct, creeping spiciness of Japanese green chili peppers. The mouthfeel is surprisingly viscous and bold due to the higher alcohol content, while the finish is long, clean, and invigoratingly spicy. It is bottled at 25% ABV (though some batches vary between 23% and 25%).

title: El Tequileno Rosado Joven Tequila
bodyHtml:
El Tequileño Rosado (often referred to as Rose Joven) is a highly innovative and visually striking expression from the historic El Tequileño distillery in the town of Tequila, Jalisco. Founded in 1959 by Don Jorge Salles Cuervo, the distillery is currently overseen by third-generation Master Distiller Jorge Antonio Salles. This "Rosa" style is part of a growing trend in the tequila industry that bridges the gap between spirits and fine wine. Unlike traditional gold tequilas that use caramel coloring, this Joven achieves its natural blush hue through a unique resting process in high-quality wine casks.

Spirit Description

This tequila is distinguished by its delicate, pale rose-gold colour. On the nose, it balances the earthy, cooked agave character of a classic highland tequila with an elegant "wine-like" floral bouquet and notes of red berries. The palate is smooth and sophisticated, offering a fusion of sweet agave, vanilla, and light acidity, followed by subtle hints of toasted nuts and dried cherries. Because it is a "Joven" (a blend of unaged blanco and aged tequila), it retains the vibrant, peppery energy of a white tequila while gaining a refined, velvety mouthfeel from its time in the wood. It is double-distilled in copper pot stills and bottled at 35% to 40% ABV.

title: Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique is a world-renowned single malt whisky from the Yilan County of Taiwan. Produced by the King Car Distillery, which opened in 2005, this expression is famous for pioneering the STR (Shave, Toast, Re-char) cask treatment process. This technique, developed by the late Dr. Jim Swan, treats American oak wine barrels that previously held both red and white wines to remove harsh tannins and unlock deep layers of fruit and vanilla. The intense tropical heat of Taiwan accelerates the maturation process, resulting in a whisky of extraordinary depth and maturity despite its relatively young age.

Spirit Description

This whisky presents a deep autumn gold with a reddish mahogany hue. The nose is a powerful fusion of caramelized sugars, dark chocolate, and "sticky" berry fruits, underpinned by Kavalan’s signature tropical notes of ripe mango, melon, and kiwi. On the palate, it is viscous and intense, delivering waves of vanilla fudge, espresso, and stewed plums, balanced by a sharp, peppery spice and toasted oak. The finish is remarkably long and complex, fading into notes of salted dark chocolate, walnut, and a delicate vinous dryness. As a "Solist" (Single Cask) release, it is bottled at a natural cask strength, typically ranging between 54% and 59.4% ABV.

title: Kavalan Solist Port Cask Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Port Cask is a high-intensity single malt whisky from the Yilan County of Taiwan. Produced by the King Car Distillery, this expression is fully matured in Portuguese Port barriques (fortified wine casks) in Taiwan’s unique subtropical climate. The extreme heat and humidity of the region act as a catalyst for maturation, allowing the spirit to extract deep, concentrated fruit and wood characters far more rapidly than in traditional whisky-producing regions. As part of the "Solist" series, each bottle is a single-cask, cask-strength release, meaning every batch offers a unique "solo" performance of the distillery's craftsmanship.

Spirit Description

This whisky displays a striking deep ruby or charred mahogany colour. The nose is rich and opulent, bursting with aromas of plum, blueberry, blackberry, and strawberry, underscored by a decadent layer of dark chocolate and roasted nuts. On the palate, the texture is viscous and "treacle-thick," delivering a bold explosion of stewed red fruits, citrus zest, and quality cocoa, balanced by the elegant wood spices of American oak. The finish is exceptionally long and warming, leaving a lingering aftertaste of burnt sugar, cinnamon, and a vinous Port dryness. It is bottled at a natural cask strength, typically ranging between 57.1% and 59.4% ABV.

title: HP Juniper Single Malt Whiskey (Non Alcoholic) - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This spirit originates from Canada. It is handcrafted in Quebec by HP Juniper, a brand founded by entrepreneurs Patrick Cool and Valerian Roy to provide premium alternatives for those seeking the traditional sensory experience of spirits without alcohol.

Spirit Description

The spirit presents a deep amber colour in the glass. The nose is defined by a full bodied and smoky complexity, featuring aromatics of peaty malt, ripe apples, and a touch of anise. On the palate, it offers a savoury profile with notes of smoky wood, warm vanilla, and toasted oak, delivering a slight burn on the tongue that mimics traditional whiskey. The finish is clean, warm, and lingering with a subtle spicy edge. It is characterized by its balance and restraint, leaning toward a dry, peated Scotch style. The alcohol by volume is less than 0.5%.

title: Foris Rogue Valley Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Foris Vineyards, established in 1976 by Ted Gerber, is a pioneer of this "alpine" region, situated at high elevations (1,500 feet) near the Siskiyou Mountains. The winery is celebrated for producing high-value, estate-grown wines—particularly Pinot Noir and Alsace-style whites—that reflect the cooler microclimate of the Illinois Valley sub-region.

Wine Description

The Foris Rogue Valley Pinot Noir is known for being a riper, more "voluptuous" alternative to its cousins in the Willamette Valley, while maintaining excellent balance.

  • Appearance: A clear, vibrant ruby-red.

  • Nose: Highly aromatic with a mixture of red and black fruit, including ripe cherry, black plum, and blueberry. It is often accented by complex notes of violets, rose petals, and brown spices (anise, cinnamon, and ginger).

  • Palate: Medium-bodied and supple. It typically offers a core of black cherry liqueur and red currant, layered with nuances of white pepper, mocha, and a hint of salted caramel. The tannins are smooth and the acidity is zesty, providing a structured yet approachable framework.

  • Technical Details: 100% Pinot Noir, predominantly from the Cedar Ranch and Maple Ranch estate vineyards. It is usually aged for 10 months in French oak.

title: Gagliardo Fallegro Langhe Favorita 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Gagliardo Fallegro Langhe Favorita is a white wine from the Piedmont region in northern Italy. The Gianni Gagliardo estate, now managed by the fourth generation of the family, is based in La Morra and has a long history of producing wines that emphasize elegance and territorial identity. The winemaking philosophy for this specific label, first created in 1974, focuses on the Favorita grape, a local biotype of Vermentino that was historically used as a table grape before being rediscovered for its potential as a fresh, high quality wine.

Wine Description

This wine displays a straw yellow colour with brilliant green reflections. The sensory profile is characterized by an intense and fresh bouquet featuring aromas of citrus fruit, white flowers, and green apple, with delicate hints of sea salt and Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, crisp, and remarkably refreshing, offering flavours of grapefruit and pear supported by a vibrant acidity. The finish is clean and persistent with a characteristic mineral edge. Crafted from 100% Favorita grapes, this wine typically has an ABV of 12.5% to 13%. It is fermented and aged in stainless steel tanks to preserve its aromatic purity and is not certified organic.

title: Pio Cesare Langhe Nebbiolo 2022 – 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Pio Cesare Langhe Nebbiolo 2022 is a red wine from the Langhe region of Piedmont, Italy. Founded in 1881 by Cesare Pio, the winery is one of the oldest in Alba and is currently managed by the fifth generation of the family. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes the 'family style' by blending fruit from diverse family owned vineyards in Barolo and Barbaresco to create a wine that captures the comprehensive character of the region rather than a single site.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a vibrant ruby red colour with garnet reflections. The sensory profile is elegant and complex, featuring aromas of red cherries, wild strawberries, and rose petals, accented by spicy notes of white pepper and a touch of tobacco. On the palate, it is medium bodied with a refined structure, offering flavours of ripe red fruit, forest floor, and a distinct mineral streak. The wine is characterized by silky yet firm tannins and a fresh acidity that leads to a long, savoury finish. Composed of 100% Nebbiolo, it typically has an ABV of 14% to 14.5% and is aged for approximately 24 months in large French oak vats with a small portion in barriques. While the winery follows sustainable practices, this label is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The elegant tannins and bright acidity of this Nebbiolo make it an excellent companion for a wide range of savory dishes. It pairs harmoniously with roasted veal, braised beef, or game meats like duck and pheasant. Its earthy undertones also complement truffle based pasta, mushroom risotto, and aged Italian cheeses such as Fontina or Castelmagno.

title: Wirra Wirra RSW Shiraz 2019
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Wirra Wirra RSW Shiraz is a flagship red wine from the McLaren Vale region in South Australia. The winery was originally established in 1894 by Robert Strangways Wigley, a former state cricketer and colourful local figure, whose initials 'RSW' give the wine its name. After falling into ruin for decades, the estate was rebuilt in 1969 by Greg Trott, who transformed it into one of Australia's most respected biodynamic producers. The winemaking philosophy today combines this rich history with a commitment to sustainable, high quality viticulture aimed at expressing the unique ironstone soils of the region.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a deep, dense crimson colour with bright scarlet clarity at the rim. The sensory profile is powerful and luxurious, offering a bouquet of dark plum, blackberry, and red berries intertwined with musky florals, mocha, and sweet baking spices like cinnamon and clove. On the palate, it is full bodied and opulent, featuring concentrated black fruit, dark chocolate, and espresso. The structure is defined by velvety fruit tannins and fine grained French oak, balanced by vibrant acidity and a long, savoury, mineral finish. This 100% Shiraz is sourced from low yielding old vines and matured for approximately 18 months in premium French oak, with one third being new barrels. It has an ABV of 14.5% and an optimal drinking window extending up to 25 years from release. Since 2014, the estate has been certified biodynamic.

title: Tenuta Garetto Rosina Barbera D'asti 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Tenuta Garetto Rosina Barbera d'Asti is a red wine from the Asti subregion of Piedmont, Italy. The estate, located in the village of Agliano Terme, was acquired in 2017 by the Gagliardo family, who have a long winemaking history dating back to 1847. Managed by the family's sixth generation, the winery's philosophy emphasizes the expression of the Nizza DOCG area's unique character through a blend of tradition and modern skill, often utilizing the estate's significant prevalence of old vines.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep colour and a fresh, round sensory profile. The sensory profile features prominent aromas of red cherry, red plum, and red liquorice, with additional notes of soil and earthy spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied and bright, characterized by high acidity and low, supple tannins that contribute to a remarkable finesse. The flavour profile includes ripe berries, blackberry, and black cherry, leading to a fresh and intense finish. This 100% Barbera is sourced from slightly younger vineyards on the estate and is aged in neutral containers, such as stainless steel and concrete tanks, to maintain fruit purity. It has an ABV of 14% and is produced as an organic wine.

title: Agnes Paquet Bourgogne Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Agnes Paquet Bourgogne Chardonnay is a white wine from the Burgundy region of France, specifically sourced from the Côte de Beaune. After studying business, Agnes Paquet returned to her family's estate in 2000 to reclaim vineyards owned by her ancestors since the 1950s, producing her first vintage in 2001. Her winemaking philosophy is rooted in a traditional and sustainable approach, having eliminated chemical herbicides in 2004 and achieved Ecocert organic certification starting with the 2021 vintage.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a light straw colour and a profile described as alive, energetic, and impossibly fresh. The sensory profile features an expressive nose of pear, lemon, and white flowers, accented by hints of almond blossom and a subtle spicy core. On the palate, it is lively yet round, balancing a crisp minerality and a striking 'acid sting' with succulent flavours of green apple and nectarine. The finish is persistent and clean, often displaying a notable saline edge. This 100% Chardonnay is a blend of fruit from the 'Les Lurets' vineyard in Volnay and purchased grapes from the Hautes Côtes de Beaune. It was fermented with natural yeasts and matured for 8 to 10 months in a combination of stainless steel tanks and oak barrels.

title: Agnes Paquet Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Agnes Paquet Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2023 is a red wine from the Burgundy region of France. The estate was founded in 2000 by Agnes Paquet, who reclaimed family vineyards that had been rented to other growers since the 1950s. Her winemaking philosophy focuses on minimal intervention and a 'deft touch' to allow the terroir to speak, emphasizing fruit forward profiles and soaring levels of drinkability.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a brilliant ruby colour with streaks of garnet throughout. The sensory profile features a nose of vibrant red berry and floral aromas. On the palate, it is sleek and racy with a soft mouthfeel and piquant flavours of red cherry, raspberry, and cranberry, leading into an invigorating finish. The varietal composition is 100% Pinot Noir, specifically sourced from the 'Les Croquamots' plot in Pommard. Stylistically, it is noted for its elegance, savoury character, and a balance of right weight and acid. The wine typically has an ABV of 12.5%. It is certified organic by Ecocert as of the 2022 vintage.

title: Valfaccenda Roero Nebbiolo 2023
bodyHtml:
Valfaccenda Roero Nebbiolo is a red wine from the Roero region in Piedmont, Italy. The winery, established in 2010 by enologist Luca Faccenda and his partner Carolina Roggero, is located in the 'Valle Faccenda', a small valley between Canale and Santo Stefano Roero with family viticultural roots dating back to 1749. Their winemaking philosophy emphasizes a 'hands-off' approach to translate the unique sandy terroir of Roero into the glass, avoiding the heavy extraction often found in neighbouring regions.

Wine Description

This wine presents a bright, luminous ruby red colour with violet reflections and delicate lightening at the rim. The nose is fragrant and precise, dominated by sour cherries, wild raspberries, and blackberry, complemented by floral notes of rosehip and blossoms, as well as herbal hints of thyme and subtle spice. On the palate, the wine is dry and elegant with a light to medium body that feels 'dancing' and nimble. It features a vibrant acidity and youthful, refined tannins that balance a delicate fruit sweetness, leading to an ethereal and cool finish. This 100% Nebbiolo is a blend from several vineyard sites, including Mompellini, Loreto, and San Grato, which are characterized by sandy and clay soils.

Food Pairing

This wine's refreshing acidity and elegant structure make it a perfect match for rustic, traditional Piedmontese cuisine. Suggested pairings include pasta with ragù or tomato sauce, mushroom and porcini risottos, and veal schnitzel or vitello tonnato. It also pairs excellently with grilled vegetables, game meats like venison, and aged cheeses.

title: Carlo Lotti Noelia Ricci Bro Bianco 2024
bodyHtml:
Noelia Ricci Bro Bianco is an organic white wine from the Emilia Romagna region of Italy, specifically from the hills of Predappio within the province of Forlì. The Noelia Ricci project was launched in 2013 as a dedicated 'winery-within-a-winery' on the historic Pandolfa estate, which has family roots dating back to 1941. The project is a tribute to Noelia Ricci, who first recognized the potential of these slopes in the 1970s; today, her grandson Marco Cirese leads the estate with a philosophy focused on drinkability, fine structure, and a contemporary approach to native local varieties.

Wine Description

This wine is a straw yellow colour with golden reflections. The sensory profile features a delicate bouquet of white fruit, lemon zest, and floral notes combined with citrus. On the palate, it is fresh and well-balanced, offering flavours of pear and lemon citrus supported by a mineral backbone and slight herbal notes. It is characterized by a crisp acidity and a harmonious finish that often displays light notes of bitter fruit. The varietal composition is 100% Trebbiano, specifically a blend of the Trebbiano Romagnolo and Trebbiano di Spagna biotypes. The wine has an ABV of approximately 12.5% to 13% and is produced using spontaneous fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks with partial skin contact. It is aged for six months on the lees in stainless steel and is certified organic.

Food Pairing

The bright structure and mineral character of this Trebbiano make it highly versatile for food. It is suggested for pairing with white meats, particularly those that are fatty and tasty, as well as lean fish and seafood. Its acidity and roundness also complement risotto dishes with savoury sauces and soft, ripe cheeses like Brie or Camembert.

title: Domaine Lucien Muzard et Fils Chassagne Montrachet 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Domaine Lucien Muzard et Fils Chassagne-Montrachet 2023 is a white wine from France, produced in the prestigious Chassagne-Montrachet appellation of the Côte de Beaune in Burgundy. The estate traces its viticultural roots in Santenay back to 1645 and was established in its modern form in the 1960s by Lucien Muzard, with sons Claude and Hervé taking the lead in 1992. Their winemaking philosophy balances traditional vinification with modern refinement, emphasizing a 'hands-on' approach in the vineyard to ensure high-quality fruit that serves as a mirror of its terroir.

Wine Description

This wine displays a brilliant profile characteristic of the 2023 white Burgundies, which are described as aromatic, juicy, and seductive. The nose reveals intense and pure fruit aromas, prominently featuring notes of hazelnut and almond alongside delicate floral hints. On the palate, the wine is 'greedy' and opulent, balancing dense fruit with a delicate, stimulating bitterness reminiscent of grapefruit. It is light to medium-bodied with a rich yet delicate texture, finishing with a persistent mineral tension that provides great freshness. This 100% Chardonnay is crafted from hand-harvested grapes, whole-bunch pressed and fermented with natural yeasts. The wine typically undergoes ageing in oak barrels, including up to 40% new oak, and maintains an ABV between 12.5% and 13%. While not certified organic, the estate follows organic principles and previously held biodynamic certification.

Food Pairing

The opulent texture and mineral backbone of this Chassagne-Montrachet make it an excellent companion for rich and gourmet dishes. It is particularly well-suited for service with roasted poultry, such as chicken with cream sauces, or delicate seafood like grilled sea bass and lobster. The wine's nutty and citrus notes also harmonize beautifully with mushroom risottos and aged cheeses like Comté or Brie.

title: Lucien Muzard et Fils Bourgogne Rouge 2024
bodyHtml:
Lucien Muzard et Fils Bourgogne Rouge is a red wine from France, produced in the heart of the Burgundy region. The estate is managed by brothers Claude and Hervé Muzard, representing the ninth generation of a family with viticultural roots in Santenay dating back to 1645. Their winemaking philosophy emphasizes a deep respect for terroir through organic farming and manual labour, transitioning the estate away from bulk sales to bottling 100% of their production to ensure high quality and purity.

Wine Description

This wine displays a glowing ruby or mid purple colour. The aromatic profile is fragrant and attractive, featuring classic Pinot Noir notes of red fruit, particularly cherry, raspberry, and blueberry, alongside floral hints of violets and a touch of light spice. On the palate, it is fresh and well balanced with a juicy mouthfeel and a distinct silkiness. The structure is defined by fine, ripe tannins and a subtle slatey minerality that persists into a medium finish. This 100% Pinot Noir is sourced from 1950s plantings across three parcels located in Santenay, lower Chassagne, and the Hautes Cotes de Beaune.

Food Pairing

The bright acidity and red fruit profile of this Bourgogne Rouge make it a versatile partner for a variety of dishes. It pairs excellently with roasted white meats such as chicken, turkey, or veal roast with herbs. Its earthy undertones also complement meaty fish, porcini bruschetta, and pasta with red sauces. For a cheese course, it is well suited for mature cheeses or a truffle Brie.

title: Lucien Muzard et Fils Bourgogne Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Lucien Muzard et Fils Bourgogne Chardonnay is a refined white wine from the Burgundy region of France. The estate is based in the village of Santenay and is currently managed by brothers Claude and Hervé Muzard, along with Claude's daughter Capucine, representing a family legacy that traces its viticultural roots back to 1645. Their winemaking philosophy centers on a profound respect for the land, utilizing organic farming practices and a blend of traditional and modern techniques to produce authentic expressions of the Burgundy terroir.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a golden colour with a greenish tinge. The aromatic profile is nuanced and structured, featuring a lively bouquet of white flowers, ripe orchard fruit, apple, and citrus, complemented by subtle notes of oak and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is creamy and rich yet balanced by a pleasant, fresh acidity and mineral undertones. Flavours of lemon zest and fresh pear are layered with delicate hints of butter and hazelnut, leading to a bright and precise finish.

Food Pairing

The creamy texture and vibrant acidity of this Bourgogne Chardonnay make it a versatile companion for various dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with lean poultry such as chicken or turkey, as well as fatty fish like salmon or tuna. Other suggested pairings include pasta in mild cream sauces, seafood dishes featuring clams or crayfish, and appetizers like avocado-based starters or tapas. For a cheese course, it harmonizes beautifully with mild and soft cheeses such as Brie, Ricotta, or Emmental.

title: Mildiani Saperavi Church Monastery Dry Red Wine 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hailing from the renowned Kakheti region of Georgia, this dry red wine is produced by the Mildiani Family Winery, which was established in 1991 by four brothers—Eldari, Levani, Leri, and Pridoni. The winery is situated in the Tsinandali microzone, where the brothers have integrated ancient Georgian traditions with modern winemaking technology to help revitalize the country’s post-Soviet viticulture.
