Their philosophy focuses on maintaining a 'special attitude' toward every stage of production, ensuring full control over their estate-owned vineyards to produce authentic expressions of native Georgian varietals.

Wine Description

The Saperavi is a deeply pigmented wine, presenting an intense dark ruby colour with cherry hues. It offers a pronounced varietal aroma characterized by ripe red fruits, dark sweet cherry, and black currant, complemented by subtle nuances of forest floor and aromatic herbs. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and rich, featuring high, biting tannins and a vibrant acidity level that is higher than average. Stylistic notes of prune, pomegranate, and smoky hints provide complexity, leading into a long, persistent finish. This Saperavi is approachable now but possesses the structure to be cellared for up to eight years.

title: Casa Maestri 'Single Estate' Reserva de MFM Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Casa Maestri 'Single Estate' Reserva de MFM Añejo Tequila originates from the Tequila Valley in Jalisco, Mexico. The distillery, officially known as Destiladora del Valle de Tequila, was founded in 2008 by Michael and Celia Maestri, who moved from Houston, Texas, to pursue their dream of creating ultra smooth tequila. Operating under a philosophy that merges tradition with innovation, the family run distillery is notable for being led by a team that is 90% women and is recognized as one of the fastest growing premium tequila producers in the world.

Spirit Description

This premium Añejo is crafted from 100% Tequilana Weber blue agave that is aged for seven years before being harvested from single estate fields. The agave is cooked in traditional stone/brick ovens and distilled twice in small batch pot stills to ensure authentic character.

  • Color: The spirit presents a brilliant copper gold or deep golden hue, a natural result of its extensive aging process.

  • Aroma: The nose is complex and inviting, featuring intense sweetness with scents of honey, caramel sauce, and maple syrup. These are layered with notes of medium oak wood, vanilla, raisins, and a faint hint of citrus.

  • Palate: It delivers an exceptionally smooth and full bodied mouthfeel. Dominant flavours include rich cooked agave, butterscotch, and pralines, complemented by nuances of cinnamon coffee cake, honey, and a hint of melon.

  • Finish: The finish is long and warming, characterized by lingering sweetness, spicy dryness, and echoes of smoky caramel and dark chocolate.

Aged for a minimum of 14 to 16 months in American white oak bourbon barrels, this tequila achieves a sophisticated balance between vibrant agave notes and rich barrel characteristics.

title: Casa Maestri Reserva de MFM Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
This exceptional spirit is handcrafted in the heart of Jalisco, Mexico. Casa Maestri is recognized as one of the best tequila producers in Mexico. The distillery was established by Michael and Celia V. Maestri in Tequila, Jalisco. The Reserva de MFM line honours co-founder Michael Franklin Maestri and reflects the essence of Mexican spirit. The Maestri–Villanueva family has a strong legacy in the liquor and tequila industry, committed to producing the best tequilas and leaving a legacy of hard work and honesty.

Tequila Description

  • Colour: Crystal clear, highlighting its purity and unaged nature.

  • Aroma: Expect fresh, clean aromas that showcase the natural character of the agave. Light notes of cooked sweet agave, vanilla, and subtle fruit may also be present.

  • Palate: The texture is typically smooth, crisp, and pure, allowing the agave flavours to shine through. It is characterized by cooked agave, vanilla, citrus, and olive. One profile describes a smooth and peppery entry leading to a burst of sweet tropical fruits, underpinned by the robust flavour of cooked agave.

  • Body and Finish: It offers a refined, silky texture and a clean, lingering finish that leaves a satisfying impression of authenticity. The finish is medium in length, with a satisfying aftertaste of peppery spice and lingering sweetness.

title: Casa Maestri Reserva de MFM Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This is a Reposado (rested) tequila that originates from Mexico, specifically the state of Jalisco. It is produced at Destiladora del Valle de Tequila (NOM 1438). The distillery, known as Casa Maestri, is recognized globally for its consistency and award-winning tequilas. The tequila is crafted from 100% blue Weber agave that is selected for its high sugar content. The production process includes baking the agave in traditional stone ovens and using a small-batch, pot still method of distillation.

2. Spirit Description

The Reserva de MFM Reposado is aged in oak casks for up to one year. Other descriptions state the Reposado undergoes aging for 8 months using whiskey barrels. The aging process imparts a golden hue and adds layers of vanilla, spice, and toasted wood.

  • Colour: Golden straw colour. Other descriptions note it is a brilliant golden amber with attractive clarity.

  • Aroma: The nose has a light aroma of cooked sweet agave, vanilla, and a hint of light fruit. Other notes include green apple and scorched lime peel, vanilla and cocoa, toasted cedar, and allspice. It also presents very slight herbaceous, clean, grassy, and buttery scents.

  • Palate: The initial taste is cooked agave and vanilla. It is a combination of pure agave, oak, vanilla, and spices. Tasting notes include vanilla and lemon cream soda, black pepper, and mallow root and sassafras. Some palates find anise, wood spice (especially cinnamon), a hint of coconut, some clove, and a pronounced pepperiness.

  • Body: Smooth and viscous.

  • Finish: It has a medium to long finish, with lingering sweetness, subtle spice, and a refined warmth. The finish of oak and chocolate are the most prominent.

  • Stylistic Notes: This tequila is smooth, complex, and is described as "Spicy & Complex". It is 100% Puro de Agave.

  • ABV: The spirit is bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

title: Domaine Rolet Arbois Tradition 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Domaine Rolet Arbois Tradition is a red wine from the Jura region of eastern France. Established in 1942 by Désiré Rolet, the estate is a benchmark for the region, currently encompassing 66 hectares across the four major Jura AOCs. The winery follows a philosophy that balances eight decades of tradition with modernity, utilizing separate vinification for each parcel to authentically capture the diverse limestone and marl soils of the Arbois terroir.

Wine Description

This light and perfumed red displays a clear, vibrant hue in the glass. The sensory profile opens with a lifted bouquet of rhubarb and juicy cherry, evolving into complex layers of wild strawberry, dried herbs, and forest floor. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and savory with a distinct 'Jura funk' and a mineral streak. The structure is defined by finely firm, tea-lined tannins and a refreshing, lean acidity.

title: DHOS Gin (Non Alcoholic) - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This spirit originates from the United States. It was created by the team at Ransom Distillery in Sheridan, Oregon, a pioneering craft spirits producer with over 25 years of heritage. The distillery is a family owned operation that values artisanal 'low tech' production and sustainability on its 40 acre organic farm.

Spirit Description

The spirit is clear and presents a traditional botanical profile. The aroma features vibrant essences of fresh pine, juniper berries, dried citrus, and candied lemon, with subtle notes of spearmint and wet earth. On the palate, it delivers a unique combination of warming spice and cooling sensations, offering layers of lemon, wintergreen, and menthol. The finish is complex and clean, marked by lingering notes of licorice root, coriander, and fennel seed. It is characterized by its balanced botanical bite and a realistic 'burn' provided by capsicum. The alcohol by volume is less than 0.5%.

title: HP Juniper Spiced Cane Rum (Non Alcoholic) - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This spirit originates from Canada. It is crafted in Quebec by entrepreneurs Patrick Cool and Valerian Roy, who founded HP Juniper to offer locally produced, authentic alternatives to traditional spirits. The beverage is distilled at Brasserie and Distillerie Champ Libre in Mercier and bottled in Cowansville, maintaining a commitment to regional production and craft quality.

Spirit Description

The spirit presents a rich amber appearance with dark, golden tones. The nose is highly aromatic, featuring prominent notes of vanilla, caramelized sugar, and warm spices such as cinnamon, clove, and nutmeg. On the palate, it offers a full bodied and smooth profile with flavors of molasses, brown sugar, and toffee sweetness. The finish is long and warming, providing a spicy complexity that includes a gentle 'burn' reminiscent of traditional rum. It is characterized by its assertive and bold style, designed to hold its own in mixed serves. The alcohol by volume is less than 0.5%.

title: HP Juniper Floral Gin (Non Alcoholic) - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This beverage originates from Canada. It was developed by entrepreneurs Patrick Cool and Valerian Roy, who previously founded Brasserie Amiral and launched the world's first gin style beer. The brand is recognized for introducing the first non alcoholic spirit based on gin botanicals to the Quebec market.

Spirit Description

The spirit features a lightly pink appearance in the glass. The nose is highly aromatic, presenting a bouquet of rose and violet alongside fresh vegetal notes of cucumber and hibiscus. On the palate, it offers a silky and smooth texture with a harmonious balance of juniper, elderberry flower, and organic rosemary. The finish is clean and refreshing, highlighted by a subtle bitterness and a dash of lemongrass. It provides the complexity of a floral London Dry style gin while remaining sugar free and low in calories. The alcohol by volume is less than 0.5%.

title: Berton Metal Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
The Berton Metal Cabernet Sauvignon is a premium red wine from South Eastern Australia. Established in 1996 by Bob and Cherie Berton in High Eden, Berton Vineyards has grown from a 'bonsai vineyard' into a contemporary operation known for its approachable and high-quality wines. Their winemaking philosophy centers on producing affordable, easy drinking wines by pairing modern technology with traditional techniques.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep crimson appearance with impenetrable violet hues. The aromatic profile is opulent, featuring an intense bouquet of cassis, blood plum, and red berries, accented by notes of dried oregano, cedar, and a touch of vanillin oak. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and seductive, offering folds of blackberry compote, blackcurrant jam, anise, and mint. The structure is defined by fine-grained tannins and well-integrated oak, leading to a long, flavoursome finish that showcases both complexity and depth.

Food Pairing

This robust Cabernet Sauvignon is best paired with rich, savoury dishes such as slow-cooked beef ragu pasta, grilled lamb cutlets with rosemary and asparagus, or a classic juicy steak. For a vegetarian alternative, a hearty eggplant parmesan or wild mushroom risotto provides a wonderful textural contrast to the wine's tannins.

title: The Winery of Good Hope Chenin Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Winery of Good Hope Chenin Blanc originates from South Africa, specifically within the renowned Stellenbosch region of the Western Cape. Founded in 1998 by Alex Dale and the team behind Radford Dale, the winery is built on a philosophy of optimism and ethical responsibility, producing high-quality wines with a 'conscience'. The estate is fully accredited for environmental and social-upliftment practices, emphasizing traditional, non-interventionist winemaking and sustainable viticulture on the slopes of the Helderberg Mountain.

Wine Description

The Winery of Good Hope Chenin Blanc displays a bright and pale straw colour with captivating brilliance. The nose is highly aromatic, revealing scents of ripe peaches, honeydew melon, and green apple, layered with delicate hints of white flowers and a touch of honey. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and expressive, offering a harmonious balance of zippy acidity and luscious fruit flavours such as lemon zest and apricot. A distinct minerality and a slightly waxy texture, derived from extended lees aging, lead to a clean, refreshing finish with lingering tropical notes. This wine is made from 100% bush vine Chenin Blanc and has an alcohol by volume (ABV) of 12.5%. While not certified organic, the winery follows natural, bug-friendly farming principles.

Food Pairing

This lively Chenin Blanc is a versatile partner for a variety of dishes. Its crisp acidity and fruit intensity pair exceptionally well with fresh seafood, such as grilled shellfish, prawns, or pan-seared scallops with mango salsa. It also complements light poultry dishes, herb-crusted goat cheese flatbreads, and spicy Asian cuisine or vegetarian quiches.

title: HP Juniper Agave (Non Alcoholic) - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This spirit originates from Canada. It is produced in Quebec by HP Juniper, a brand noted for being a pioneer in the non alcoholic spirit market within the province. The company crafts its beverages using traditional copper stills to provide authentic alternatives for those seeking the complex flavours of classic spirits without the effects of alcohol.

Spirit Description

The spirit presents as a golden honey coloured liquid. The nose offers a full bodied and smoky complexity. On the palate, it delivers robust notes of cooked agave, pepper, and a subtle hint of vanilla, reminiscent of an aged Tequila Añejo. The body is earthy and vegetal, leading into a pleasant bitter finish with a touch of smoke. It is carefully balanced to mimic the woody character of a traditional agave spirit while remaining sugar free and low in calories. The alcohol by volume is less than 0.5%.

title: Deanston Virgin Oak Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Deanston Virgin Oak Cask Strength is a single malt Scotch whisky produced in the Highland region of Scotland. The distillery is located in the town of Doune on the banks of the River Teith, housed in a converted 18th-century cotton mill that generates its own hydroelectric power. Owned by the Distell Group, Deanston is celebrated for its commitment to traditional, handcrafted production methods and its focus on sustainability.

Spirit Description

This limited-edition whisky presents a deep amber gold colour. The nose is intense and robust, featuring aromas of wood spice, creamy custard, and candied fruit, balanced by fresh notes of green apple and nutmeg. On the palate, it delivers the distillery's signature waxy texture, offering rich flavours of heather honey, butterscotch, and toffee, with a potent layer of warm cinnamon and oak spice. The finish is long and satisfying, marked by a twist of citrus zest and lingering sweet spice. It is bottled at 58.5% ABV.

title: Long Barn Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Long Barn Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 originates from California, United States, where the family owned and operated winery is based in the Napa Valley. The winery was founded with a philosophy of preserving regional character and agricultural charm, drawing inspiration from the historic long barn that serves as its namesake. Head winemaker Stefano Migotto, a legacy vintner from northern Italy, oversees production, blending old world traditions with a focus on creating wines that reflect their countryside birthplace.

Wine Description

This medium to full bodied wine displays a deep red colour and offers bold, ripe, fruit filled aromas. The sensory profile features luscious flavours of blackberry, rhubarb, and dried cherry, accented by distinctive notes of oak and cedar. On the palate, it exhibits great complexity with approachable structure and defined tannins that lead into a lingering finish. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon typically has an ABV of 13.5%.

Food Pairing

The bold fruit profile and defined tannins of this Cabernet Sauvignon make it an ideal companion for grilled or roasted red meats. Suggested pairings include prime rib, grilled steaks, and BBQ burgers, as the wine's structure effectively cuts through richer fats. It also harmonizes well with barbecued summer vegetables, Chicago or New York style pizzas with meat toppings, and aged cheeses such as mimolette.

title: Dezzani Langhe Nebbiolo 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Dezzani Langhe Nebbiolo originates from the Langhe hills in the Piedmont region of northern Italy. The winery was founded in 1934 by Luigi Dezzani Sr. in Cocconato d'Asti, a location historically renowned for a microclimate that uniquely benefits grape cultivation. Today, the estate is led by the third generation of the Dezzani family in partnership with the Rocca family and the Villa Rivalta cooperative, maintaining a philosophy that balances traditional Piedmontese typicity with modern winemaking technology.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo presents an intense red colour with bright garnet highlights. The sensory profile is fresh and fruity, featuring an engaging bouquet of crushed raspberries, sour cherries, and mint, complemented by floral notes of dried rose and heather. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and harmonious, delivering juvenile aromas of ripe fruit alongside herbal and spicy scents. It is characterized by a focused structure with 'dusty' minerality and pleasantly firm, sometimes astringent tannins that lead to a persistent finish. The wine typically has an ABV of 13.5% and undergoes refinement in concrete tanks and traditional oak barrels before further aging in the bottle.

Food Pairing

The fresh acidity and tannic structure of this Nebbiolo make it a natural partner for a wide variety of savoury dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with red and white meats served with rich dressings, such as roasted lamb, spicy sausages, or game. Its herbal and spicy undertones also complement elaborate first courses like pasta with mushroom sauce or BBQ marinated pork ribs. For a simpler option, it can be served as an aperitif alongside charcuterie and hard cheeses.

title: Guijiu Tianqing Baiju - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Guijiu-Tianqing is a premium sauce-aroma (Jiang-fragrance) Baijiu produced in the prestigious Maotai Town of Guizhou Province, China. The spirit is crafted by Shanghai Guijiu, a brand that blends the rigorous traditions of ancient Chinese brewing—specifically the complex '12987' production cycle involving multiple fermentations and distillations—with a modern, elegant philosophy. The name 'Tianqing' refers to the distinct 'sky blue' aesthetic of the packaging, symbolizing clarity and high ambition.

Spirit Description

The liquid is crystal clear and colorless in the glass, displaying excellent viscosity. The nose is refined and elegant, offering a sophisticated balance of deep floral aromas and sandalwood, layered over the characteristic savory notes of fermented soy and umami found in sauce-aroma spirits. On the palate, it is unexpectedly smooth and velvety for its strength, revealing complex flavours of ripe tropical fruits, toasted nuts, and a subtle spice. The finish is long, warming, and enduring, leaving a pleasant aftertaste of savoury grains and sweetness. It is bottled at 53% ABV.

Food Pairing

This Baijiu is best enjoyed neat at room temperature to appreciate its complex aroma. It is a classic partner for bold and spicy Chinese cuisine, such as Sichuan-style Kung Pao chicken or a rich braised pork belly (Hong Shao Rou), where the spirit's savoury power cuts through the fat and heat. It also pairs surprisingly well with aged parmesan cheese or dark chocolate desserts due to its umami depth.

title: Dezzani Barolo 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Dezzani Barolo originates from the Langhe area of the Piedmont region in northern Italy. The winery was founded in 1934 by Luigi Dezzani and is located in the village of Cocconato d'Asti, an area historically celebrated for its beneficial microclimate. The winemaking philosophy at Dezzani emphasizes a deep respect for Piedmontese varietals and traditional techniques, a commitment that saw the estate flourish into one of the region's most significant producers under the leadership of Romolo Dezzani during the late 20th century.

Wine Description

This Barolo presents a classic red garnet colour. The sensory profile is complex and elegant, offering a nose that ranges from ripe red fruits and raspberry to spicy notes of cinnamon and vanilla, underscored by traditional hints of toast, tar, and violet. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and dry with a velvety texture and firm, austere tannins that provide excellent structure. This 100% Nebbiolo is a blend of the Michet, Lampia, and Rose clones and typically possesses an ABV of 14% to 14.5%. The winemaking process includes 30 to 38 months of aging, with at least 18 to 24 months spent in large oak barrels to ensure a well-balanced finish.

Food Pairing

The powerful structure and tannic grip of this Barolo make it a natural companion for hearty, protein-rich dishes such as braised veal, baked beef shank, or roasted lamb with potatoes. Its earthy undertones of tar and spices also pair beautifully with game meats like venison and wild boar, as well as rich truffle-based risottos and mushroom stews. For a cheese course, it harmonizes well with matured or hard Italian cheeses such as Castelmagno, Gorgonzola, or Parmigiano-Reggiano.

title: Dezzani Otto Bucce Rosso 2022
bodyHtml:
Dezzani Otto Bucce Rosso is a complex red blend produced in the Piedmont region of northern Italy. The winery was founded in 1934 by Luigi Dezzani Sr., and it has since grown into a prominent estate that balances traditional Piedmontese heritage with innovative winemaking. The name 'Otto Bucce' translates to 'eight skins', reflecting the winery's unique philosophy of blending eight distinct grape varieties to create a harmonious and multi-layered expression of the local terroir.

Wine Description

This wine presents an intense ruby red colour enhanced by brilliant purple highlights. The bouquet is expressive and harmonic, offering a concentrated nose of cassis, black cherries, and licorice, along with delicate notes of vanilla, cinnamon, and sweet spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied and elegant, delivering a 'winey' taste with flavours of red fruits, blackberry, and a hint of earthy minerals. The structure is defined by creamy, well-integrated tannins and a subtle off-dry feel that contributes to a smooth, generous mouthfeel. This blend consists of Barbera, Dolcetto, Freisa, Bonarda, and Albarossa, combined with Merlot, Syrah, and Cabernet Sauvignon. It typically has an ABV of 13.5% and is aged for 12 months in a combination of large traditional barrels and French oak. This wine is vegan-friendly.

Food Pairing

The balanced acidity and spiced fruit profile of this wine make it an excellent partner for a variety of Italian and international dishes. It pairs beautifully with appetizers such as cold cuts, charcuterie, and light first courses like pasta with tomatoes or mushrooms. For main courses, it is ideally suited to grilled or barbecued meats, beef wellington, spare ribs, and hearty stews. It also harmonizes well with savory veggie or meat lover's pizzas.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

"With a dense color, the wine immediately reveals intense sweet and savory spice aromas followed by dark and ripe black-fruited characteristics. Lush on the palate, it offers blackberry, spice and fine tannins. A flashy wine that makes a statement."

title: Edinburgh Gin Rhubarb and Ginger
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Edinburgh Gin Rhubarb & Ginger is a full-strength flavoured gin produced in Edinburgh, Scotland. The brand is owned by Ian Macleod Distillers, a family-run company that acquired the distillery in 2016 to expand its portfolio of premium spirits. This specific expression was created as a potent, juniper-forward evolution of the distillery's highly successful fruit liqueur, designed to offer a more robust spirit that retains the signature flavour profile.

Spirit Description

This gin is classically served with premium ginger ale or tonic water and a wedge of lime to enhance its zesty character. It presents a delicate, pale pink hue in the glass. The nose offers bright and authentic aromas of fresh rhubarb and juniper, underpinned by a gentle sweetness. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious balance where the tartness of the rhubarb and the warmth of the ginger spice complement the piney juniper base, rather than overpowering it. The finish is smooth and full, leaving a lingering impression of zest and warming spice. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

title: High West 'A Midwinter Night's Dram Act 12' Straight Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Introduction

High West A Midwinter Night's Dram Act 12 is a limited-edition blended straight rye whiskey produced by High West Distillery in Park City, Utah. Founded in 2006 by David Perkins and his wife Jane, High West was the first legal distillery to open in Utah since 1870. The distillery, now owned by Constellation Brands, operates a historic saloon in Park City as the world's first ski-in gastro-distillery and a larger production facility in Wanship. Act 12 represents the 12th annual iteration of this seasonal release, which has become a hallmark of the distillery's expertise in blending and cask finishing.

Spirit Description

This whiskey displays a deep ruby-amber colour, reflecting its time spent in fortified wine casks. The nose is rich and festive, opening with aromas of brandied cherries, fig jam, and pecan cinnamon rolls, followed by allspice berries and a hint of French oak shavings. On the palate, the body is velvety and complex, delivering flavours of poached white peaches, stewed rhubarb, and Italian tiramisu, balanced by candied ginger and weathered cinnamon bark. The experience concludes with a long, silky finish that features lingering notes of sticky toffee pudding and spiced plum tea. It is bottled at 49.3% ABV and is composed of a blend of two rye mash bills finished in a combination of ruby and tawny Port barrels.

title: J.P. Wiser's 13 Year Old Japanese Oak Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

J.P. Wiser's 13 Year Old Japanese Oak is a limited-release expression from the J.P. Wiser's Wood Series, produced in Windsor, Ontario. It is crafted at the Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery, a facility with a heritage dating back to 1858 that remains a cornerstone of North American distilling. Master Blender Dr. Don Livermore developed this series to explore the impact of diverse wood species on traditional Canadian rye, utilizing experimental casks with Japanese oak inserts to bridge the gap between Canadian craftsmanship and Eastern tradition.

Spirit Description

This whisky presents a deep, captivating amber hue. The nose is highly aromatic, featuring notes of vanilla bean and creamy oakwood layered with dried fruits, praline, and a hint of nutmeg. On the palate, the spirit reveals a complex texture with flavours of toasted sugar, salted caramel, and cinnamon bark, characteristic of the 'exotic' influence of Japanese oak. These sweet and woody notes are balanced by a gentle embrace of black pepper and signature rye spice. The finish is long and warming, leaving a persistent trail of dried oak and sweet spice. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

title: J.P. Wiser's 27 Year Old Mizunara Oak Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

J.P. Wiser's 27 Year Old Mizunara Oak is an ultra-premium, limited-edition Canadian whisky produced at the Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario. This rare expression was developed by Master Blender Dr. Don Livermore as a pinnacle release within the brand's exploration of wood science. The whisky underwent a secondary maturation in rare Mizunara oak casks imported from Japan, blending nearly three decades of Canadian aging with the legendary 'temple incense' character of Japanese oak to create one of the most exclusive releases in the distillery's history.

Spirit Description

This whisky displays a brilliant deep copper colour with mahogany glints. The nose is incredibly complex and perfumed, offering the signature Mizunara aromas of sandalwood, agarwood, and dried flowers, followed by rich Canadian rye notes of toffee, dark chocolate, and black cherry. On the palate, the body is exceptionally oily and dense, revealing layers of honeyed malt, cloves, and apricot jam, underpinned by an exotic spice profile featuring black tea and incense. The finish is remarkably long and evolving, leaving a sophisticated trail of cedarwood, leather, and lingering cinnamon. It is bottled at a formidable cask strength of 62.1% ABV.

title: Lot No. 40 Oloroso Casks Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Lot No. 40 Oloroso Casks is a premium small-batch Canadian rye whisky produced at the Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery in Windsor, Ontario. Owned by Corby Spirit and Wine, the brand was revived in 2012 by Master Blender Dr. Don Livermore, based on a 19th-century family recipe from a seventh-generation distiller. This specific expression is part of the 'Rye Explorations' series, showcasing the versatility of 100% rye grain when enhanced by secondary maturation in Oloroso Sherry casks.

Spirit Description

This whisky presents a deep, rich amber colour with copper highlights. On the nose, the bold, peppery spice of the rye is softened by the influence of the Oloroso sherry, offering aromas of dried pear, roasted walnuts, and dark cherry, alongside a hint of tobacco. The palate is robust and full-bodied, delivering a complex interplay of spicy rye bread and clove with the sweet, nutty depth of praline and dried stone fruits. The finish is long, warming, and sophisticated, leaving lingering notes of oak, leather, and a delicate sherry sweetness. It is typically bottled at a cask strength of approximately 53.1% ABV.

title: Lagarde Organic Malbec 2023
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from Argentina, specifically from the Mayor Drummond subregion of Lujan de Cuyo in Mendoza. Founded in 1897, Lagarde is a historic estate featuring Malbec vines that are over 100 years old. Owned by the Pescarmona family since 1969, the winery is managed by sisters Sofia and Lucila, who have focused on sustainable practices and making Lagarde a certified B Corporation.

Wine Description

Lagarde Organic Malbec displays a deep and bright violet red colour. The aromatic profile is fragrant and precise, offering vibrant notes of ripe red fruits like cherry, plum, and raspberry alongside floral hints of violet and fresh herbs. On the palate, the wine is juicy and agile with a smooth texture, soft tannins, and a balanced acidity that creates a fresh mouthfeel. It is characterized by its pure fruit expression and 'round' style, as it is produced without oak aging to respect the natural vineyard cycles. This 100% Malbec has an ABV of 14.2% and is officially certified organic. The optimal drinking window is generally within 3 years of the harvest to enjoy its maximum freshness.

title: Rabbit Hole 'Heigold' Bourbon Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Rabbit Hole Heigold Bourbon Whiskey is a high rye Kentucky Straight Bourbon produced in the Nulu district of Louisville, Kentucky. The distillery was founded in 2012 by Kaveh Zamanian, a former clinical psychologist who left his practice to pursue his passion for whiskey making, eventually opening a state of the art facility in 2018. Now part of the Pernod Ricard portfolio, the brand is known for its modernist approach to tradition, utilizing unique grain bills and a commitment to never chill filtering its spirits.

Spirit Description

This bourbon presents a deep caramel hue in the glass, a result of maturation in hand selected barrels that are toasted and charred over wood fired flames. The nose is highly aromatic, offering a bouquet of toasted malt, warm baking spices, and vanilla, with subtle hints of lemon and mint. On the palate, the body is creamy and full, featuring layers of silky butterscotch and honey that transition into the spicy character of malted rye. The finish is long and impactful, characterized by a crescendo of black pepper, cedary oak, and a touch of bright citrus. It is bottled at 47.5% ABV (95 proof) and is crafted from a mash bill of 70% corn, 25% malted German rye, and 5% malted barley.

Accolades

  • Best Kentucky Small Batch Bourbon, World Whiskies Awards (2022)

title: Isle of Harris 'The Hearach' Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Hearach Single Malt is the inaugural whisky from the Isle of Harris, located in the Outer Hebrides of Scotland. The spirit is produced by the Isle of Harris Distillery, which opened in 2015 in the village of Tarbert and is often referred to as 'The Social Distillery' for its commitment to creating sustainable employment for the local community. Founded by Anderson 'Burr' Bakewell, the distillery revived legal distillation traditions on the island for the first time since the 1840s, with every drop of spirit crafted by local residents known as 'Hearachs'.

Spirit Description

This single malt presents an amber gold colour in the glass. The nose is highly aromatic and complex, offering initial notes of tropical fruits like pineapple and banana, followed by fresh citrus, floral honey, and a distinct sea breeze minerality underpinned by a subtle waft of peat smoke. On the palate, the body is thick and lush, delivering a balanced profile of butterscotch, candy apple, and malted barley, accompanied by gentle peat, baking spices, and a hint of salt. The finish is long and elegant, characterized by a lingering creaminess, toasted oak, and a delicate, ashy smoke. It is bottled at 46% ABV, non-chill filtered, and matured in a combination of first-fill ex-Bourbon casks and Oloroso and Fino Sherry butts.

title: Isle of Raasay 'Na Sia' Unpeated Ex-Rye Single Cask Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Raasay Na Sia Unpeated Ex-Rye Single Cask is a distinctive single malt Scotch whisky produced on the Isle of Raasay in the Inner Hebrides, Scotland. The spirit is crafted by the Isle of Raasay Distillery, which became the island's first legal distillery when it opened in 2017. Founded by Bill Dobbie and Alasdair Day of R&B Distillers, the estate is located in a converted Victorian hotel and is dedicated to producing artisanal whiskies that reflect the island's unique geology and maritime climate.

Spirit Description

This single cask expression presents a bright golden hue in the glass. The nose is vibrant and aromatic, offering a 'sea of fruit' with prominent notes of butterscotch, vanilla, and sweet malt. On the palate, the unpeated spirit reveals a robust and spicy character influenced by its maturation in first-fill Woodford Reserve rye whiskey casks, delivering intense flavours of black pepper, ginger, and cinnamon balanced by honeyed sweetness. The finish is long and warming, marked by a persistent spicy tingle and lingering notes of creamy toffee. It is bottled at a natural cask strength, typically ranging between 60.1% and 61.6% ABV depending on the specific cask.

title: Farnese Zabu Syrah 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Farnese Zabu Syrah is a red wine from the Terre Siciliane IGT in the southern region of Sicily, Italy. Vigneti Zabu is part of the Farnese Vini group, also known as Fantini, a winery that became a leading exporter in southern Italy through a policy of high quality research and international expansion. The winemaking philosophy at Vigneti Zabu focuses on minimal intervention to preserve the spicy and fruity notes provided by the unique microclimate near Lake Arancio in Sambuca di Sicilia.

Wine Description

This wine displays a clear ruby red colour with distinct purple and crimson highlights. The sensory profile is defined by an intense bouquet of red fruit, black cherry, and plum, accented by fresh balsamic hints and spicy notes of black pepper and licorice. On the palate, it is full bodied and lively, featuring noticeable but well integrated tannins that provide a firm yet harmonious structure. The finish is fresh, persistent, and clean.

title: Boudier Olive Gin
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

Boudier Olive Gin is produced in France, specifically in the city of Dijon within the region of Burgundy. Founded in 1874 by Gabriel Boudier, the house has spent 150 years refining traditional manufacturing processes for spirits and liqueurs. While long managed by the Battault family, the distillery was integrated into the Famille Piffaut Vins & Domaines group in 2022.

2. Spirit Description

This gin is an original creation from the house that blends the savoury essence of black olives from Nyons with a classic botanical base. The aromatic profile is delicate, with notes of olive supported by juniper and bright citrus on the nose. On the palate, there is a fresh juniper attack followed by a subtle olive intensity that provides a unique, savoury character. The body is well balanced, resulting in a clean, dry finish. Boudier Olive Gin is bottled at an ABV of 40%.

title: Imperial Gran Reserva Rioja 2018
bodyHtml:
CVNE (Compañía Vinícola del Norte de España), established in 1879, is a family-owned winery located in the heart of Rioja, Spain. Renowned for its dedication to quality and tradition, CVNE has been producing exceptional wines for over a century. The Imperial label, first produced in the 1920s, is one of the great names in Spanish winemaking and is only made in vintages that the company classifies as excellent.

Wine Description
The 2017 Imperial Gran Reserva Rioja displays a bright garnet color. On the nose, it reveals aromas of licorice, typical of the Tempranillo grape, along with forest fruits and notes of cloves, roasted coffee, cigar leaf, chocolate, caramel, and balsamic undertones from barrel aging. The palate is fine and elegant, with a deep and fatty mid-palate that envelops it. Friendly tannins and a touch of acidity provide a long and complex aftertaste. This wine is designed to last and improve over time, with an optimal drinking window extending over the next decade.

Food Pairing
This Gran Reserva pairs beautifully with roasted lamb, grilled steak, or aged Manchego cheese. It also complements dishes like mushroom risotto or charcuterie platters. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Sierra Nevada Pale Ale 355 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
It changed tastes, made hops famous, and brought an industry back from extinction. That’s a hard-working beer.  

Heavy on hops, that was always the brewery plan. So in 1980, we loaded Pale Ale up with Cascade—a new hop at the time named after the mountain range—and the intense aromas of pine and citrus sparked the American craft beer revolution.

title: Tsingtao 500 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml: China’s premier brand, brewed from the finest ingredients including spring water from Laoshan Mountain and Canadian malting barley. Founded in 1903 by German brewers, this beer is softer than German pilsner with a high malty flavor and well-hopped character, with its fine quality ingredients. Pale gold colour; aromas of green apple, pear, cereal and white flower; on the palate it is light-medium bodied and lightly carbonated, with subtle flavours of apple, biscuit and a lightly bitter finish.

title: Alvear Red Vermouth
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Alvear Red Vermouth (Vermouth Rojo) is a traditional artisanal aromatized wine produced in the Montilla-Moriles region of Andalusia, Spain. It is crafted by Bodegas Alvear, a historic estate founded in 1729, which holds the distinction of being the oldest winery in the region. Famous for their mastery of the Pedro Ximénez grape, the family-owned distillery uses a base of their aged Oloroso wine, blended with Pedro Ximénez sweet wine, to create this distinctively Andalusian aperitif.

Spirit Description

This vermouth displays a deep, dark cherry red colour with mahogany highlights. The nose is intense and complex, leading with the rich, raisin-like aromas of Pedro Ximénez grapes, layered with notes of cinnamon, balsamic herbs, and citrus peel. On the palate, it offers a creamy, velvety texture where flavors of dried figs, toasted nuts, and sweet spices are perfectly balanced by a sophisticated herbal bitterness. The finish is long and elegant, leaving a lingering impression of caramelized sugar, rosemary, and bitter orange. It is bottled at 15% ABV.

title: Benvolio Prosecco
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Benvolio Prosecco is produced in the Friuli-Venezia Giulia region of northeastern Italy, within the Prosecco DOC appellation. The brand was founded in 2008 and is part of the Jackson Family Wines portfolio, operating with a philosophy centered on the Italian relationship between wine, food, and joy. The name 'Benvolio' means 'well-wisher' in Italian, reflecting the winery's mission to offer approachable wines for everyday celebrations.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine presents a sharp golden straw colour with finely textured and persistent bubbles. The nose offers fresh citrus aromas with delicate hints of honey and fresh flowers. On the palate, a vibrant and crisp acidity serves as a counterpoint to flavours of ripe citrus, fresh peaches, green apple, and grapefruit. The finish is light, refreshing, and crisp.

title: Long Barn Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Long Barn Chardonnay is produced in California, United States, by the Fior di Sole winery based in the Napa Valley. The winery was founded by legacy vintner Stefano Migotto and his former wife, who moved from Italy to Napa in 1997 to bring old-world traditions to Californian viticulture. Drawing inspiration from a historic long barn that represents the estate's birthplace, the winemaking philosophy focuses on preserving regional character and agricultural charm in every bottle.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a medium to full body with a rich and layered texture. The sensory profile radiates bright citrus and tropical aromas that are complemented by notes of green apple, sun-drenched orange blossoms, and pear. On the palate, it is well-balanced and refreshing, offering a creamy mouthfeel enlivened by flavours of apricot, banana, and jasmine. A restrained malolactic fermentation and the use of both French oak and stainless steel provide distinctive sensations of vanilla, butter, and toasted bread on a round finish. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this wine has an ABV of 13.5%.

title: HP Juniper Classic Gin (Non Alcoholic) - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This spirit originates from Canada. It was developed by entrepreneurs Patrick Cool and Valerian Roy, who sought to create a locally made option for those watching their alcohol intake. The brand made history by launching the first non alcoholic spirit derived from gin botanicals in the Quebec market.

Spirit Description

The spirit is crystal clear and presents a traditional London Dry style with a light body. The nose is woody and lemon forward, featuring aromatics of juniper and citrus peel. On the palate, it is crisp and dry, offering a complex blend of yuzu lemon, organic cucumber, cinnamon, lemongrass, and coriander seed. The finish is clean and warm with a lingering spicy touch. It is characterized by its balance and freshness, providing an authentic gin experience without the sugar. The alcohol by volume is less than 0.5%.

title: Long Barn Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Long Barn Pinot Noir is produced in California, United States, by the Fior di Sole winery. The winery was founded by Stefano Migotto and Valentina Guolo-Migotto, who brought their Italian winemaking heritage to Napa Valley to create wines that honour regional character and agricultural charm. Drawing inspiration from a historic long barn that represents the estate's countryside birthplace, the winemaking philosophy focuses on crafting approachable wines that reflect their rustic origin.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a pale ruby colour and offers a soft, elegant sensory profile. The bouquet features bright aromas of cherry, strawberry, and raspberry, complemented by subtle notes of spice and earth. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied and well balanced, delivering flavours of sweet red berries, redcurrant, and a touch of vanilla from oak aging. The wine is characterized by supple tannins and a smooth, lingering finish that maintains a refreshing acidity. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this vintage typically has an ABV of 13.5%.

title: Masahiro Kaijin Japanese Blended Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Masahiro Kaijin Blended Whisky is crafted by the Masahiro Distillery, located in the subtropical prefecture of Okinawa, Japan. Established in 1883 by Shobun Higa, the distillery is one of the oldest and largest in the region, traditionally renowned for producing Awamori, a local rice spirit. This expression, whose name 'Kaijin' translates to 'Seaman' or 'Sea God', is a blend of grain and vintage malt whiskies designed to reflect the majestic and mysterious character of the ocean surrounding the Ryukyu Islands.

Spirit Description

The whisky displays a bright golden hue in the glass. The nose is vibrant and exotic, offering aromas of citrus, vanilla, and tropical fruits such as pineapple and papaya, underpinned by a hint of fresh-cut grass and a subtle oceanic minerality. On the palate, it is light-bodied yet rich, delivering an elegant balance of oak, butterscotch, and warm spices like ginger and black pepper. The finish is long and creamy, leaving a lingering impression of exotic fruit and soft spice. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Laphroaig 34 Year Old Ian Hunter Story: Book 5 Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Laphroaig 34 Year Old Ian Hunter Story: Book 5 is the final installment in the highly collectible Ian Hunter Story series, produced on the Isle of Islay, Scotland. This ultra-premium single malt pays tribute to Ian Hunter, the last member of the founding Johnston family to own and manage the distillery, who is credited with establishing Laphroaig's iconic profile and global reputation. 'Book 5', subtitled 'Enduring Spirit', serves as the culmination of this legacy, showcasing rare stocks distilled in 1987 and matured for over three decades in first-fill ex-Bourbon American oak barrels and Pedro Ximénez European oak hogheads.

Spirit Description

This whisky displays a deep, burnished copper colour. The nose is classic yet evolved, offering complex aromas of sweet bonfire smoke, iodine, and cured ham, interwoven with notes of beeswax, tropical fruit (grilled pineapple), and polished oak. On the palate, the body is oily and rich, delivering flavours of salted caramel, dark chocolate, and spicy white pepper, balanced by the signature medicinal peat reek which has softened over time. The finish is exceptionally long, dry, and resonant, leaving lingering traces of ash, sea salt, and old leather. It is bottled at 45.5% ABV.

title: Terralsole Brunello Riserva Vertical Mixed Pack (2005, 2006, 2012, 2015, 2016, 2017)
bodyHtml:
Terralsole Brunello Riserva Vertical is a collection showcasing six exceptional vintages—2005, 2006, 2012, 2015, 2016, 2017—of Terralsole Brunello Riserva.

2005 Vintage:

This 2005 Brunello Riserva offers a deep garnet hue, with evolved aromatics of dried cherry, leather, cedar, and hints of tobacco and forest floor. On the palate, it is full-bodied and structured, unfolding in layers of ripe plum, balsamic tones, and earthy minerality. Firm yet integrated tannins guide a persistent, elegant finish.

Accolades:
Wine Spectator – 92 points
Wine Enthusiast – 93 points

2006 Vintage:

The 2006 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva pours a deep garnet with subtle brick hues. On the nose, it reveals a complex bouquet of dried cherries, balsamic, leather, rose petal, and spice. The palate is richly layered, offering ripe red fruit, tobacco, forest floor, and earthy undertones, framed by silky tannins and vibrant acidity. Medium to full-bodied, it finishes long and refined with notes of cedar and dried herbs.

Accolades:
Wine Enthusiast – 96 points.
Wine Spectator – 94 points.
James Suckling – 95 points.

2012 Vintage:

The 2012 Brunello Riserva presents a deep garnet hue and opens with layered aromas of dried cherry, blackcurrant, leather, and hints of tobacco and cedar. On the palate, it is full-bodied and elegant, revealing dark plum, fig, and earthy undertones balanced by refined tannins and a lingering, savoury finish. Composed entirely of Sangiovese Grosso, this wine showcases the varietal’s depth and aging potential.

Accolades:
Wine Spectator – 94 points.
James Suckling – 95 points.

2015 Vintage:

This 2015 Brunello Riserva showcases a deep garnet hue with brick-red edges. The nose is complex and refined, with aromas of dried cherry, rose petal, tobacco leaf, and hints of balsamic and leather. On the palate, it offers layers of black cherry, plum, and savoury earthiness balanced by polished tannins and vibrant acidity. Full-bodied and structured, the wine reveals a long, persistent finish with notes of spice and dark chocolate. 

Accolades:
Wine Spectator – 94 points.
James Suckling – 95 points.

2016 Vintage:

The 2016 Brunello Riserva offers a powerful and elegant expression of Sangiovese. In the glass, it reveals a deep ruby hue with garnet edges. Aromas of ripe dark cherries, dried rose petals, and tobacco are layered with notes of balsamic, forest floor, and exotic spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied with fine-grained tannins, balanced acidity, and a complex core of black fruit, leather, and savoury minerality. The finish is long, polished, and persistent.

Accolades:
Wine Spectator – 95 points
Wine Enthusiast – 94 points
James Suckling – 96 points

2017 Vintage:

This 2017 Brunello Riserva is crafted exclusively from 100% Sangiovese Grosso. Deep garnet in colour, it opens with an intense bouquet of dried cherries, rose petals, leather, and hints of tobacco. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied with layered notes of dark plum, savoury herbs, and warm spice, balanced by vibrant acidity and firm, fine-grained tannins. The finish is long and elegant, revealing traces of earth and balsamic richness.

Accolades:
Wine Spectator – 94 points.
James Suckling – 95 points.
Vinous – 93 points.

title: Erdinger Alkoholfrei (Non Alcoholic) 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Erdinger Alkoholfrei is a premium non-alcoholic wheat beer brewed in Erding, Bavaria, Germany. It is produced by Erdinger Weißbräu, a family-owned brewery founded in 1886 that has become the world’s largest wheat beer specialist. Unlike many non-alcoholic beers that are lagers, Erdinger Alkoholfrei is a true top-fermenting wheat beer that has been gently de-alcoholized to retain its traditional character.

Product Description

This brew pours a hazy straw yellow with a tall, impressively creamy white head. The sensory profile is complex and refreshing:

  • Aroma: Expect classic wheat beer notes of ripe banana and clove, layered with aromatic malt, a hint of brioche, and subtle spicy hops.

  • Palate: It offers a smooth, medium-bodied mouthfeel with a perfect blend of spicy malt notes and caramel-sweet nuances.

  • Finish: The taste is rounded off by a hint of fruity acidity and a stimulating bitterness from aroma hops, leading to a clean, balanced finish.

Notably, it is widely marketed as a sporty thirst-quencher because it is isotonic and rich in vitamins such as B9 (folic acid) and B12, which support muscle regeneration and the immune system. It has an ABV of less than 0.5% and contains approximately 25 kcal per 100 ml.

title: Charles Heidseick Rose Reserve
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This distinguished Champagne is crafted by the historic House of Charles Heidsieck in Reims, founded in 1851 by the legendary Charles-Camille Heidsieck—known famously as "Champagne Charlie." The winery is celebrated for its uncompromising commitment to quality and its vast collection of reserve wines, housed in thousand-year-old Gallo-Roman chalk cellars (Crayères). The Rosé Réserve is a masterful blend that mirrors the complexity of the House's flagship Brut Réserve, but with the addition of high-quality red wines from the prestigious Pinot Noir terroirs of Les Riceys. This cuvée highlights the House’s philosophy of "Complexity, Precision, and Generosity," achieved through significantly longer aging than the region's standards.

Wine Description

Charles Heidsieck Rosé Réserve displays a sophisticated powdery pink robe with luminous glints of wild rose and a fine, persistent mousse. The nose is highly aromatic and nuanced, opening with fragrances of home-made strawberry jam and vineyard peach, which gradually evolve into warm, velvety notes of gingerbread, cinnamon, and honey. On the palate, the wine is powerful yet elegant, offering a burst of red forest fruits—raspberry, strawberry, and blackberry—nestled in a creamy, "velvety whipped cream" texture. It is characterized by a bright seam of acidity and a savory, mineral finish with a hint of smoky spice. This blend of 40% Pinot Noir, 35% Chardonnay, and 25% Meunier includes a high proportion of reserve wines (up to 35%) and has an ABV of 12%. It was aged for over 48 months on the lees in the chalk cellars and finished with a dosage of approximately 9–11g/L. The wine is ready to drink now but will continue to gain aromatic finesse through 2030.

title: Collosorbo Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml: Obtained from a meticulous selection of Sangiovese grapes from the best company vineyards, Brunello di Montalcino is the result of painstaking campaign work and targeted interventions in the cellar which, in respect and in the worship of an ancient tradition, preserve the integrity of the fruit and enhance the quality of a wine that in history and time of renewal in each bottle.

title: Gagliardo Da Batie Nebbiolo 2022
bodyHtml:
The winery, Poderi Gianni Gagliardo, has roots dating back to 1847 with the Colla family cultivating vineyards in Piedmont. Gianni Gagliardo established the winery in its current form in 1973. Now run by the sixth generation—Gianni’s sons Stefano, Alberto, and Paolo—the winery focuses on an artisanal approach with great attention to detail and respect for the environment. Their philosophy is to allow each vineyard to express the 'purest character' of the Nebbiolo grape, creating elegant and balanced wines.

Wine Description

It offers a sensory profile with aromatic red cherry and savoury aromas, accompanied by the typical notes of rose, tar, and hazelnut. Some vintages also show hints of oregano and liquorice. It is medium-bodied with firm, yet delicate tannins and bright acidity, leading to a velvety, smooth, and savoury, chalky finish with a persistent aftertaste.

title: Marques de Riscal Gran Reserva 2016 - 150th Anniversary
bodyHtml:
Marqués de Riscal is recognized as a true pioneer in modern Spanish wine, instrumental in shaping the identity of Rioja since its founding in 1858. The forward-thinking winery embraces a philosophy focused on vineyard health and resilience. This approach includes regenerative agriculture, keeping tilling to a minimum to increase soil organic matter, and using cover crops and trees to foster biodiversity.

Wine Description

The wine is an intense black-cherry colour with violet hues. On the nose, it offers a complex, balsamic, aromatic intensity that is beautifully balanced with fruit and subtle, lightly toasted notes from fine oak. A deeper look reveals aromas of black plum, dark chocolate, Earl Grey tea, black mushrooms, sweet cherries, plums, cedar, and intense lavender.

Accolades

  • 'James Suckling - 96 points'

  • 'Wine Enthusiast - 95 points'

  • 'Wine Spectator - 91 points'

Food Pairing

This Gran Reserva is a versatile gastronomic wine. Suggested pairings include ham, mature cheese, all kinds of roasts, red meat, poultry, and game casseroles. The structure and depth of the wine also complement charcuterie.

title: Castello di Montepo Sassoalloro Oro 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Castello di Montepò Sassoalloro Oro 2021 is a prestigious red wine from Italy, specifically from the Maremma region in Tuscany. This label marks a significant evolution in the Biondi Santi family's winemaking journey, which began in the 1800s when Ferruccio Biondi Santi first identified the specific Sangiovese Grosso clone that would define the history of Brunello di Montalcino. Under the leadership of Jacopo Biondi Santi and his son Tancredi, the estate's philosophy at Castello di Montepò emphasizes the potential of their exclusive 'BBS11' clone to express elegance and finesse in the unique, high-altitude marl soils of Scansano.

Wine Description

The Sassoalloro Oro 2021 is a monovarietal red entirely produced from Sangiovese Grosso BBS11 grapes. It presents a deep ruby colour, almost impenetrable, which heralds the wine's considerable structure. The nose radiates sophisticated aromas of blackberries, raspberries, and black cherries, seamlessly layered with notes of violets, new leather, chocolate, and espresso bean. On the palate, this medium to full-bodied wine is cohesive and lush, featuring chewy, dense tannins and flavours of black cherry drizzled with chocolate. Stylistically, power and balance coexist through careful maturation for 14 months in un-toasted Tronçais oak barriques, resulting in a velvety texture and a long, persistent finish. The 2021 vintage is particularly noteworthy as it serves as the 30th-anniversary bottling. Its optimal drinking window is projected from 2024 through approximately 2030.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 94 points

  • James Suckling – 91 points

title: Lagg Small Batch Palo Cortado Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Lagg Small Batch Palo Cortado Cask Finish is a peated single malt Scotch whisky produced on the Isle of Arran, off the west coast of Scotland. The spirit is crafted at the Lagg Distillery, which opened in 2019 at the southern tip of the island as the peated sister distillery to the well-established Lochranza Distillery. This expression is part of a limited small batch series designed to showcase the distillery's robust, smoky house style (using barley peated to 50ppm) matured in first-fill ex-Bourbon barrels and finished for six months in rare Palo Cortado Sherry casks.

Spirit Description

This whisky presents a warm, golden amber colour in the glass. The nose is complex and nutty, offering aromas of roasted hazelnuts and rich peat smoke interwoven with notes of caramelized figs, dried orange peel, and a hint of balsamic. On the palate, it is full-bodied and oily, delivering a sweet arrival of raisins and toffee that transitions into bold bonfire smoke, black pepper, and dried dates. The finish is long and warming, leaving lasting impressions of roasted nuts, gentle wood smoke, and a dry, tannic touch of dark chocolate. It is bottled at a natural cask strength of 56.2% ABV.

title: Eau Claire Ploughman's Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

Eau Claire Ploughmans Single Malt is produced in Canada, within the region of Alberta and the subregion of Diamond Valley. Founded in 2014 by David Farran, Eau Claire Distillery is the first craft distillery in the province and is located in a historic former movie theatre. The distillery focuses on a farm to glass philosophy, using traditional horse farming methods to harvest grain from local fields.

2. Spirit Description

This single malt presents a refined sensory profile characterized by its use of 100% Alberta malted barley. On the nose, it offers rich aromas of caramel, vanilla, and toasted oak, often accompanied by notes of dried fruit and honey. The palate is smooth and full bodied, delivering layers of malt sweetness, toffee, and gentle spice that are well balanced by subtle notes of smoke. It possesses a medium body with a long, warm finish featuring lingering flavours of soft spice and oak.

title: The Glenturret Triple Wood Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
The Glenturret Triple Wood is a premium Highland single malt Scotch whisky produced at Scotland's oldest working distillery, located in Crieff. Officially established in 1763, though with roots in illicit distilling dating back to 1717, the distillery has a storied history of ownership including the Drummond family, Remy Cointreau, and the Edrington Group. Since 2019, the distillery has been owned by the Lalique Group, a renowned luxury jewellery and crystal company, which shifted the focus toward boutique single malt releases. While the "Triple Wood" expression itself is a no-age-statement (NAS) whisky released annually, it sits as the entry point alongside the core 12 Year Old expression in the distillery's modern range.

Spirit Description

The Triple Wood is crafted by maturing the distillery's fruit-forward new make spirit in a combination of three distinct cask types: American oak sherry-seasoned casks, European oak sherry-seasoned casks, and American oak Bourbon barrels.

  • Colour: It presents a natural golden hue, often described as bright or pale straw.

  • Aroma: The nose is inviting and layered, featuring notes of custard cream, dried fruits, and wood spices, complemented by an intriguing tropical fruit aroma and hints of vanilla.

  • Palate: It offers a mellow and sweet profile with initial malty notes followed by refreshing citrus. Flavours of cinnamon, toffee, and a "wild fruit mix" provide a dynamic character with a slight spicy oak tingle.

  • Body: The whisky is medium-bodied and supple, known for its well-rounded and balanced texture.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long finish marked by solid oak notes, light ginger spiciness, and a lingering balance of honeyed maltiness.

  • ABV: The Glenturret Triple Wood is bottled at 44%.

title: Bruichladdich Octomore 15.2 Single Malt Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Bruichladdich Octomore 15.2 is a super-heavily peated single malt Scotch whisky produced on the Isle of Islay, Scotland. Crafted by the progressive Bruichladdich Distillery, this expression is part of the 15th annual Octomore series, which explores the margins of what is possible in whisky making through extreme peat levels and complex cask management. This specific bottling acts as a counterpoint to its stablemates, showcasing the influence of European oak by utilizing a unique maturation 'trifecta' of bourbon, wine, and Cognac casks.

Spirit Description

The whisky displays a pale straw colour, reminiscent of Hebridean sand. The nose is vibrant and sweet, opening with notes of lime zest and lemon meringue pie that sit atop a foundation of earthy peat smoke and toasted oak. On the palate, the texture is viscous and smooth, delivering rich flavours of vanilla custard, caramel, and toffee, balanced by a crack of black pepper and warming cinnamon. The finish is distinctly maritime, with waves of salt spray and lingering peat embers that endure long after the final sip. It is distilled from 100% Scottish Mainland barley, peated to 108.2 PPM, and bottled at 57.9% ABV.

title: Biere Sans Alcool White (Non Alcoholic) 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This beverage originates from Canada. It is produced by Bière Sans Alcool (BSA), a Montreal based brewery that focuses exclusively on crafting high quality non alcoholic beers. The company was founded with the goal of providing flavorful alternatives for social occasions without the compromise of traditional non alcoholic options.

Spirit Description

The beer presents a hazy, pale straw colour with a persistent white head. The aroma is characterized by classic witbier notes of coriander, orange peel, and subtle hints of wheat. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied with a smooth, slightly creamy texture and flavors of citrus zest and soft spice. The finish is crisp, clean, and highly refreshing. It displays excellent balance and a traditional Belgian style profile. The alcohol by volume is less than 0.5%.

title: Bruichladdich Octomore 15.1 Single Malt Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Bruichladdich Octomore 15.1 is a super-heavily peated single malt Scotch whisky produced on the Isle of Islay, Scotland. Crafted by the innovative Bruichladdich Distillery, known as the 'Progressive Hebridean Distillers', this expression serves as the 'control' bottling for the 15th annual Octomore series. It is distilled from 100% Scottish Mainland Concerto barley and aged for five years in first-fill bourbon barrels and re-charred ex-bourbon casks, showcasing the raw power of the spirit without the influence of European oak.

Spirit Description

This whisky displays a bright, golden colour described by the distillery as 'Winter Sun'. The nose is potent and vibrant, opening with aromas of caramel and citrus zest wrapped in dry, earthy peat smoke, followed by layers of spicy aniseed, vanilla custard, and tropical fruits like mango and banana. On the palate, it delivers an immediate warmth with flavours of sweet dry malt, apricot jam, and toffee, balanced by the intense, signature peat smoke. The finish is long and maritime, featuring lingering notes of charred oak, vanilla, and a fresh sea spray crispness. It is bottled at 59.1% ABV with a phenol content of 108.2 PPM.

title: Biere Sans Alcool Raspberry Sour (Non Alcoholic) 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This beverage originates from Canada. It is produced by Bière Sans Alcool (BSA), a Montreal based brewery that focuses exclusively on crafting high quality non alcoholic beers. The company was founded by a team of enthusiasts dedicated to offering a modern and inclusive drinking experience without the effects of alcohol.

Spirit Description

The beer presents a dense, mellow, and purplish red body in the glass. The aroma is characterized by a fresh and vibrant fragrance of sun ripened raspberries. On the palate, it delivers a soft and balanced sweet and sour kick with a smooth mouthfeel. The finish is clean and fizzy, offering a refreshing tartness that lingers pleasantly. It is noted for its ability to provide a full sensory craft experience while keeping the mind clear. The alcohol by volume is less than 0.5%.

title: Toki Black Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Suntory Toki Black is a limited-edition blended Japanese whisky from the House of Suntory, released in late 2025 to mark the tenth anniversary of the original Toki brand. Produced by Suntory Spirits, which operates the iconic Yamazaki, Hakushu, and Chita distilleries, this expression was inspired by Japan's vibrant 'Jazz Kissa' (jazz listening bar) culture. It represents a significant evolution of the standard Toki profile, introducing a peated element to the blend for the first time in the series' history.

Spirit Description

This whisky possesses a clear gold appearance with bright highlights. The nose is aromatic and layered, featuring scents of baked apple, oregano, and honey blossom. On the palate, the body is richer and more complex than the original expression, delivering flavours of butterscotch sweetness balanced by notes of clove, cinnamon, and toasted rosemary. The finish is persistent and spicy, characterized by white pepper, ginger, and a refined, gentle lingering smokiness derived from the inclusion of Hakushu peated malt. It is bottled at 43% ABV.

title: Mezzacorona Merlot 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Mezzacorona Merlot originates from the Trentino region in Northern Italy, specifically from vineyards situated north of Lake Garda. Established in 1904, Mezzacorona is a prominent cooperative that today consists of over 1,500 farmer members who focus on high quality production and sustainable development practices. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes a strong tie between modern techniques and the land, utilizing the diverse microclimates of the Italian Alps to craft estate grown wines known for elegance and balance.

Wine Description

This ruby red wine features an intense bouquet characterized by aromas of sweet red fruits such as black cherries and pomegranates, accented by notes of milk chocolate, clove, and vanilla. On the palate, it is juicy and nuanced with a soft texture, offering flavours of ripe plum and subtle spice supported by silky, well integrated tannins. It is a medium bodied red with a dry, balanced finish and a typical alcohol content of 13% ABV. While not certified organic, the winery is renowned for its sustainable SQNPI certification and integrated production protocols.

title: Blue Run Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey 'Chosen 23'
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Blue Run Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey 'Chosen 23' is a distinctive single barrel expression released under the prestigious 'Chosen' private barrel program by Blue Run Spirits. Based in Georgetown, Kentucky, the company was co-founded by Mike Montgomery and is celebrated for disrupting the traditional whiskey industry with a focus on modern design and exclusive, high-quality releases. This particular bottling is curated with the expertise of Whiskey Director Shaylyn Gammon, who oversees the selection of barrels to ensure a premium sensory experience that highlights the nuance and complexity of their stocks.

Spirit Description

This bourbon pours a rich, deep amber colour. The nose is complex and inviting, featuring aromas of ripe red fruits—both skin and flesh—layered with citrus oleo saccharum, vanilla bean, and cinnamon candy, alongside hints of light roast coffee and chocolate chip cookies. On the palate, the profile is bold and leather-forward, unfolding with notes of tobacco leaf, barrel char, and cacao powder, balanced by baking spices and citrus peel. The finish is enduring and sophisticated, leaving lingering impressions of tobacco, leather, and dark chocolate. It is bottled at 55% ABV.

Food Pairing

The robust leather and tobacco notes of this bourbon make it an ideal match for rich, savoury dishes such as a dry-aged ribeye steak or venison stew. For a dessert pairing, the dark chocolate and coffee undertones complement a flourless chocolate cake or dark chocolate truffles. It also pairs exceptionally well with a premium cigar to echo the spirit's earthy finish.

title: Domaine Landron Atmospheres (Methode Traditionnelle)
bodyHtml:
This sparkling wine is produced in France, specifically within the Loire Valley near Nantes. Domaines Landron is a renowned estate led by Jo Landron, a pioneer in the region who champions organic and biodynamic viticulture to express the true identity of the terroir. The winery is celebrated for its commitment to hand-harvesting and minimal intervention, ensuring that each bottle captures the freshness and mineral character of the vineyard.

Wine Description

Domaines Landron Atmospheres presents a pale yellow colour with fine, persistent bubbles. The nose is fresh and aromatic, offering notes of bright citrus, pear, and red berries, alongside subtle hints of brioche and white flowers. On the palate, it is crisp and precise, with a creamy texture balanced by racy acidity and a saline, mineral finish. The blend typically consists of Folle Blanche, Pinot Noir, and Chardonnay. It is best enjoyed within 2 to 3 years of release.

Food Pairing

This sparkling wine is an ideal aperitif but also has the structure to pair with fresh seafood, particularly oysters or grilled shrimp. It also complements light poultry dishes, vegetable terrines, or soft goat cheeses.

title: Stratus Decant Cabernet Franc 2020 - 3 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Stratus Vineyards, located in the Niagara-on-the-Lake sub-appellation of Ontario, Canada, is widely recognized as a benchmark producer for sustainable, gravity-flow winemaking in North America. Operating out of the world’s first LEED-certified winery, Stratus focuses heavily on low-intervention viticulture, low yields, and meticulous plot-by-plot harvesting.

The Stratus Decant Cabernet Franc 2020 is one of the estate's most distinct flagship releases. Produced only in exceptional years, it is bottled in a custom-designed, asymmetrical bottle created by renowned designer Karim Rashid. The bottle features a series of angled cuts that act as a built-in decanter, catching sediment as the wine is poured—a nod to the estate's philosophy of bottling wines unfiltered and unfined.

Wine Description

The Stratus Decant Cabernet Franc 2020 displays an opaque, deep ruby-purple core. On the nose, it opens with powerful and seductive aromas of ripe black cherry, wild blackberry, and crushed red plums, seamlessly interwoven with notes of roasted red pepper, tobacco leaf, dark cocoa, graphitic minerality, and subtle toasted oak spice.

On the palate, the warm and pristine 2020 vintage comes through clearly. It is full-bodied, rich, and plush, yet maintains remarkable definition and poise. Dense, velvety tannins wrap around a concentrated core of dark fruit, dried herbs, and dark chocolate. Vibrant acidity provides a firm spine that carries the wine into a long, warming, and savory finish.

Crafted from 100% Cabernet Franc and aged in select French oak barrels, this unfiltered release offers incredible immediate intensity while possessing the structural depth to age gracefully in cellar over the next 10–15 years.

title: Magazzino Dognale Amaretto Club -700ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Amaretto Club is a premium artisanal liqueur produced by Vecchio Magazzino Doganale in the Calabria region of Southern Italy. The distillery, founded by Ivano Trombino, is celebrated for its commitment to rural traditions and the use of locally sourced, natural ingredients to revive ancestral recipes. This specific 'Cordiale Italiano' highlights the agricultural richness of the area, specifically utilizing almonds from Amendolara.

Description

This liqueur presents a deep, intense amber colour. The nose is aromatic and enveloping, characterized by rich notes of marzipan, vanilla, and roasted almonds, accented by a hint of citrus zest and sweet spices. On the palate, it is velvety and soft, delivering a balanced sweetness that gives way to the distinctive, persistent taste of bitter almond and caramelized sugar. The finish is long, harmonious, and pleasantly nutty. It is bottled at 27% ABV.

title: Elijah Craig Rye
bodyHtml: The first extra-aged Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey to join Elijah Craig's award-winning family of Bourbons. A unique combination of spicy rye grains and sweet corn, coupled with steadfast attention to detail, gives Elijah Craig Straight Rye the perfect balance of flavour and smoothness.

title: Derthone Colli Tortonesi Timorasso 2022
bodyHtml:
This remarkable white wine is from Italy, specifically the Piedmont region and the Colli Tortonesi subregion. Derthona is the ancient name for the town of Tortona, which gives the appellation its name. Vietti Winery, which produces a notable version of this wine, boasts a rich history dating back to 1873 in Piedmont. The winery, which is currently managed by Luca Currado, champions a winemaking philosophy of minimal intervention to allow the terroir and grape to express themselves naturally.

Wine Description

On the nose, it offers an appealing complexity with fruity scents of pear, peach, and crisp green apple. Floral notes of acacia and hawthorn are present, along with a characteristic hint of honey. The palate is dry, warm, and soft, showing a vigorous, energetic acidity that translates into an impeccable balance. This medium-bodied white is textured and savory, often revealing strong mineral and herbal undertones, like freshly crushed thyme and sage. The wine has a long, lingering finish.

Accolades

  • Vinous - 93 points

  • James Suckling - 92 points

  • Wine Enthusiast - 91 points

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include rich seafood, chicken sautéed with garlic and tomato, or creamy aged cheeses. It pairs exceptionally well with traditional Piedmontese preparations, such as veal with tuna sauce or tagliolini with truffle.

title: Clos Figueras 'Font de la Figuera' 2022
bodyHtml:
This expressive red wine originates from the rugged and prestigious Priorat DOCa in Catalonia, Spain, specifically from the village of Gratallops, the spiritual heart of the region. Produced by Clos Figueras, the estate owned by celebrated wine importer Christopher Cannan, this wine serves as the "Second Vin" to the flagship Clos Figueras. The estate was purchased in 1997 on the recommendation of René Barbier (of Clos Mogador fame), who recognized the potential of the site's old vines. Named "Font de la Figuera" after a wild fig tree that grows by a natural spring on the property, this wine is designed to be approachable and vibrant earlier than the Grand Vin.

Wine Description

Clos Figueras Font de la Figuera displays a deep, intense ruby colour with violet rims. The nose is aromatic and complex, offering a classic Priorat bouquet of ripe red and black berries (brambles, wild raspberries), interwoven with distinct mineral notes of wet slate (llicorella), graphite, and Mediterranean herbs like thyme and rosemary. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full bodied with a lovely freshness that balances the region's natural power. It features juicy fruit flavors, subtle spicy oak notes, and fine-grained tannins that provide structure without heaviness. The finish is long and mineral-driven.

title: Olim Bauda Barbera D'asti La Villa 2024
bodyHtml:
This classic red wine comes from Italy's northwest, specifically the Piedmont region, and is classified under the Barbera d'Asti DOCG appellation. The estate, Tenuta Olim Bauda, has a rich history dating back four generations, with the Bertolino family's involvement in winemaking and trade beginning over a century ago. The three Bertolino siblings—Dino, Diana, and Gianni—revived the family's winemaking tradition in 2000 after a hiatus, re-establishing the estate as a top Piedmont producer with a focus on blending modern and classic styles.

This wine is a pure expression of the Barbera grape, which makes up 100 per cent of its varietal composition. It displays an accentuated and vivid ruby red colour with youthful violet hues. The nose has good finesse, being vinous and intense with pleasant hints of sour cherry, raspberry, and red berries. On the palate, the wine is full bodied, juicy, and pleasant, showing great freshness, a silky texture, and lively acidity. The farming practices employed are sustainable, with the grapes organically grown. The optimal drinking window extends up to eight to ten years after the vintage, though it is also enjoyable young and vibrant.

title: Chateau Cambon Beaujolais 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from the Beaujolais region of France, this wine is specifically from vineyards in Saint-Jean-d'Ardières, situated ideally between the prestigious crus of Morgon and Brouilly. Château Cambon is an iconic estate born from the collaboration of the late Marcel Lapierre—the godfather of the natural wine movement—and his lifelong friend Jean-Claude Chanudet. Today, the estate is managed by Marie Lapierre and Chanudet, continuing the legacy of low-intervention winemaking. The wine is sourced from ancient Gamay vines, some planted as far back as 1914, rooted in a mix of granitic, clay, and siliceous soils. Although it carries the humble "Beaujolais" appellation, the terroir and vine age give this wine a depth and structure that rivals many classified Crus, often referred to by insiders as a "Cru in disguise."

Wine Description

Château Cambon Beaujolais displays a vibrant, bright ruby colour with violet hues.
