The nose is a classic expression of pure Gamay, bursting with fresh aromas of crushed raspberries, wild strawberries, and tart cherries, accented by floral notes of violet and peony. On the palate, the wine is energetic and juicy (often described by the French term gouleyant), featuring a silky texture and soft, melted tannins. It balances its lush fruitiness with a distinct mineral backbone and a savory, earthy finish derived from the granite soils.

title: Buisson Charles Bourgogne Rouge 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This elegant red wine originates from the Côte de Beaune in Burgundy, produced by Domaine Buisson-Charles. While the estate is world-renowned for its powerful Meursault whites, winemaker Patrick Essa applies the same meticulous care to his limited production of reds. Sourced from vineyards located within the commune of Meursault (specifically the lieux-dits of "Les Malpoiriers" and "Les Coutures"), the vines for this Bourgogne Rouge sit on clay-limestone soils just below the village level. These plots benefit from the same microclimate as the prestigious Meursault whites but are planted to Pinot Noir. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes purity and "digestibility," aiming for a wine that transcends its regional classification through the use of old vines (some over 50 years old) and a gentle extraction approach that favors finesse over power.

Wine Description

Buisson-Charles Bourgogne Rouge typically displays a vivid, bright ruby red colour with violet tints in its youth. The nose is fresh and expressive, bursting with high-toned aromas of crunchy red cherries, wild raspberries, and strawberries, underpinned by subtle notes of wet earth, forest floor, and a hint of spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and juicy, distinguished by its silky texture and approachable structure. It avoids the rustic harshness sometimes found in regional Burgundies, offering instead soft, ripe tannins and a vibrant line of acidity. The finish is clean and savory, with lingering notes of tart red fruit. This 100% Pinot Noir typically has an ABV of 13% and is aged for 12 to 15 months in French oak barrels (mostly second and third-fill to avoid dominating the delicate fruit).

title: J. Denuziere Saint Joseph Blanc 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in the heart of the Northern Rhône Valley, this sophisticated white wine originates from the Saint-Joseph AOC, an appellation stretching along the steep, granite-rich right bank of the Rhône River. Maison J. Denuzière, established in 1876, has evolved from a historic merchant house into a high-end domaine under the expert guidance of oenologist Caroline Moro. The winery’s philosophy focuses on a "parcel-by-parcel" approach, selecting fruit from high-elevation granite terraces that impart a distinct mineral tension. This Saint-Joseph Blanc is a testament to the House's dedication to freshness and precision, highlighting the elegance of 100% Marsanne sourced from the northern end of the appellation.

Wine Description

J. Denuzière Saint-Joseph Blanc displays a brilliant straw-yellow color with shimmering golden highlights. The nose is highly aromatic and nuanced, offering an elegant bouquet of jasmine, honeysuckle, and sea buckthorn layered with notes of ripe plum, yellow pear, and honeydew melon. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and well-structured, featuring a silky, mouth-filling texture balanced by a refreshing, "crunchy" acidity. It is characterized by its complex mineral play and savory undertones of anise, white flowers, and a persistent saline finish. This wine has an ABV of 13.5%.

title: Vina Costeira Meu Albarino 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hailing from the historic D.O. Ribeiro in Galicia, Northwest Spain, this expressive white wine represents a unique departure from the more common Albariños of neighboring Rías Baixas. Viña Costeira, founded in 1968, is a benchmark cooperative winery that played a pivotal role in recovering native Galician grape varieties. The "Meu" range meaning "Mine" or "One's Own" in the Galician language reflects a philosophy of personal dedication and a deep connection to the land. While Ribeiro is traditionally famous for its Treixadura-based blends, this cuvée showcases the Albariño grape in its purest form, grown on the region's signature sabrego (decomposed granite) soils along the steep terraces of the Avia and Miño river valleys.

Wine Description

Viña Costeira Meu Albariño displays a brilliant, light straw-yellow color with shimmering green reflections. The nose is highly aromatic and fresh, offering an elegant bouquet of Fuji apple, white peach, and melon, layered with delicate notes of orange blossom, freshly chopped parsley, and mint leaf. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and remarkably full-textured, showcasing a "crunchy" acidity and a phenolic mid-palate that provides unexpected depth. It is characterized by its mineral elegance and a persistent finish marked by citrus zest and a distinctive saline tang. This 100% Albariño has an ABV of 13%.

title: Domaine Vallot Cotes du Rhone 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in the northernmost part of the Southern Rhône, this authentic red wine hails from the village of Vinsobres, an area famed for its high-altitude vineyards and cooling breezes. Domaine Vallot is one of the oldest and smallest family estates in the region, now managed by François Vallot (a fourth-generation winemaker) and his daughter Anaïs. The estate is a pioneer of conscious viticulture, having practiced organic farming since the 1990s and achieving full Demeter Biodynamic certification in 2007. Their philosophy centers on minimal intervention, utilizing spontaneous fermentations and the unique microclimate of their 450-meter elevation vineyards to produce wines that emphasize freshness and "gourmand" fruit over heavy extraction.

Wine Description

Domaine Vallot Côtes-du-Rhône "Le Coriançon" displays a vibrant ruby color with deep purple reflections. The nose is highly aromatic and "gulpable," offering a field-blend bouquet of black cherry, raspberry, and bramble berry layered with notes of violets, white pepper, and wild Mediterranean garrigue. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied yet remarkably fresh, showcasing a "crunchy" fruit profile balanced by a stony, calcareous minerality. It is characterized by its silky, elegant tannins and savory undertones of black tea, cinnamon, and a hint of earthy mushroom on the harmonious finish.

title: Alfred Gratien Champagne Brut Classique
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Alfred Gratien Champagne Brut Classique originates from the historic town of Épernay in the Champagne region of France. Established in 1864 by Alfred Gratien, the house has maintained a rigorous tradition of craftsmanship for over 150 years. The winemaking philosophy is defined by a commitment to manual processes, with all first fermentations occurring in small oak barrels to ensure a consistent, elegant style.

Wine Description

This Champagne presents a bright, golden colour with an exceptionally fine and long-lasting mousse. The sensory profile features delicate aromas of peach, apricot, and exotic fruits, complemented by subtle notes of white flowers, biscuits, and pastry. On the palate, the wine is fresh and lively, displaying a creamy texture and a deep, layered complexity with hints of dried apple and a mineral, saline finish. This non vintage blend is composed of 56% Chardonnay, 24% Pinot Meunier, and 20% Pinot Noir, and it is typically aged on its lees for four years before release. The wine has an ABV of 12.5% and a sugar content of 11 g/L.

title: Chateau La Tour de Mons 2005
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Château La Tour de Mons 2005 is a classic red wine from France, produced in the prestigious Margaux appellation of the Médoc region. This historic estate, which traces its origins back to the 13th century, is a true 'clos' located in the northern part of Margaux along the banks of the Garonne. Since 2020, the property has been owned by the Perrodo family, who also own the renowned Third Growth Château Marquis d'Alesme and Château Labégorce, continuing a philosophy that emphasizes balance, elegance, and respect for the unique gravel and limestone-clay terroir.

Wine Description

This 2005 vintage presents an intense, deep ruby colour with developing garnet hints. The aromatic profile is broad and complex, featuring a tapestry of black fruit, red plum, and violet interwoven with woody, spicy notes, cedar, and cocoa. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and dense, offering a lush and harmonious texture with a 'frank' attack and a fine, well-integrated tannic structure. The varietal composition is a traditional blend of 61% Merlot, 33% Cabernet Sauvignon, 3% Petit Verdot, and 3% Cabernet Franc, aged for 12 months in French oak barrels. Stylistically, it combines richness and concentration with a persistent, fresh finish. This wine is currently in its optimal drinking prime, with a window extending through 2030 for well-cellared bottles.

title: Chateau De Villegeorge 2000
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Château de Villegeorge 2000 is a classic red wine from France, hailing from the Haut Médoc appellation in the Bordeaux region. The estate's history dates back to the 18th century when its wines were so highly regarded they fetched prices equivalent to Third Growths; in 1932, it was one of only six estates awarded the prestigious 'Cru Exceptionnel' status. Since 1992, the winery has been led by oenologist Marie-Laure Lurton, who continues her father Lucien's philosophy of sustainable viticulture, emphasized by the estate's 'Terra Vitis' and HVE 3 environmental certifications.

Wine Description

The 2000 vintage presents a deep brick-red colour, reflecting its extensive bottle age. The sensory profile is classic and savoury, opening with a refined nose of violets, blackcurrant, and red cherry tinged with secondary notes of cedar, tobacco, and forest floor. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and well-balanced, featuring a 'vinuosity' characterized by a dry but lively attack and a juicy mouthfeel. The varietal composition is a traditional Bordeaux blend typically consisting of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and a touch of Petit Verdot. It showcases mature, velvety tannins and a refreshing acidity that leads to a long, sophisticated finish. This wine has reached full maturity and is currently in its optimal drinking window.

title: Chateau Loudenne 2000
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Château Loudenne 2000 is a classic red wine from France, produced in the Médoc region of Bordeaux. Historically known as 'the pink castle' due to its distinctive rose-coloured walls, the estate has a legacy dating back to the 17th century and was notably owned by the British Gilbey brothers for over a century starting in 1875. In 2000, the property transitioned from the ownership of the drinks giant Diageo to the Lafragette family, maintaining its reputation as one of the oldest and most picturesque 'Cru Bourgeois' estates in the Médoc.

Wine Description

The 2000 vintage displays a beautiful, deep garnet-red colour. The sensory profile is elegant and classic, with a nose featuring blackcurrant, chocolate, and black cherry accented by spicy notes and hints of vanilla and cedar. On the palate, the wine is powerful and well-balanced, showcasing round black cherry fruit and a medium body with firm, well-integrated tannins that have softened over two decades of ageing. This Bordeaux blend typically consists of equal parts Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, though some bottlings include small portions of Cabernet Franc. Stylistically, it is characterized by its fresh acidity and long finish, with subtle tertiary notes of coffee and earth developing from 12 to 16 months of French oak ageing. This wine is currently in its prime drinking window.

title: Domaine Derey Freres Fixin Vielle Vigne 2023
bodyHtml:
This Pinot Noir originates from France, specifically the Burgundy region and the Côte de Nuits subregion. Domaine Derey Frères is a historic estate established in 1650, currently managed by three brothers who maintain a deep respect for their heritage and terroir. Their winemaking philosophy emphasizes organic farming and minimal intervention to ensure the wines authentically reflect their specific origins.

Wine Description

The Domaine Derey Frères Fixin Vieille Vigne 2023 displays a deep ruby colour. The nose is expressive and elegant, revealing aromas of ripe red fruits such as cherries and raspberries, complemented by nuances of licorice, sweet spices, and a delicate touch of oak. On the palate, this medium-bodied wine is round and ample, supported by fine, silky tannins and a distinct minerality that leads to a persistent, balanced finish.

Food Pairing

This wine's structure and flavour profile make it an excellent companion for rich poultry dishes such as roast duck, goose, or game birds. It also pairs beautifully with grilled red meats like ribeye steak or beef bourguignon. For a cheese course, try serving it with local Burgundian options like Epoisses or other strong, washed-rind cheeses.

title: Amiral De Beychevelle 2010
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Serving as the second label of the historic Fourth Growth estate Château Beychevelle, it is crafted with the same meticulous sorting and traditional barrel ageing techniques as the Grand Vin. The winery's philosophy emphasizes elegance and finesse, a legacy dating back to the 16th century when ships passing the estate on the Gironde would 'lower their sails' (Baisse-Voile) in respect for the owner, the Duke of Épernon.

Wine Description

The 2010 vintage displays a deep, intense red colour with subtle purple reflections. The nose is highly expressive, opening with a rich bouquet of blackcurrant, blackberry, and dark cherry, accented by floral notes of violet, spices, and a hint of fresh tobacco. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and succulent, featuring a deep structure supported by noble, velvety tannins and remarkable freshness. This classic Bordeaux blend is composed of 68% Cabernet Sauvignon and 32% Merlot, offering a generous and balanced profile. Stylistically, it combines power with an elegant, silky mouthfeel and a long finish. While it can be enjoyed now, this vintage possesses a significant drinking window extending through 2033.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 92 points

  • Wine Enthusiast – 91 points

  • Vinous – 91 points

title: Ferrand Dry Curacao Yuzu Late Harvest - 700ml
bodyHtml:
Ferrand Dry Curaçao Yuzu Late Harvest originates from France, specifically crafted within the celebrated Cognac region. The spirit is produced by Maison Ferrand, a distillery renowned for blending traditional craftsmanship with innovation under the stewardship of proprietor and Master Blender Alexandre Gabriel. Drawing inspiration from 19th-century recipes, the estate focuses on reviving lost production techniques to create artisanal spirits that honour the history of the region.

Description

This liqueur displays a rich, golden amber colour with bright highlights. The nose is highly aromatic, leading with intense notes of spicy yuzu zest and tangerine, which evolve into warmer hints of vanilla, marzipan, and delicate floral touches of rose and geranium. On the palate, the body is round and luscious, offering complex flavours of candied citrus peel, tropical fruit, and almonds, balanced by the depth of the brandy base and a touch of nutmeg. The finish is long and fresh, leaving a lingering impression of zesty citrus and sweet pastry notes. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Brancaia Il Blu 2021
bodyHtml:
Brancaia Il Blu is a premier Super Tuscan originating from the Chianti Classico region of Italy. Founded in 1981 by Swiss couple Brigitte and Bruno Widmer, the estate gained international acclaim almost immediately after its Chianti Classico won a major tasting only two years later. Today, owner and winemaker Barbara Widmer continues the family legacy with a philosophy centered on organic viticulture and a commitment to creating wines that authentically express their unique Tuscan terroir.

Wine Description

This flagship red displays a dense ruby red colour and offers an extremely elegant nose featuring aromas of currant, blackberry, and black cherry, layered with notes of violet, cocoa, and sweet tobacco. On the palate, the wine is rich and full-bodied with a complex sensory profile that includes dark chocolate, licorice, and mineral tension, all supported by a line of firm, creamy tannins and vibrant acidity.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling – 97 points."

  • "Vinous – 96 points."

  • "Wine Advocate – 95 points."

  • "Wine Spectator – 95 points."

Food Pairing

Brancaia Il Blu is best enjoyed alongside dishes with intense flavours, such as grilled beef, roasted lamb, or braised game like wild boar. It also pairs beautifully with savoury mushroom risotto or aged cheeses such as Pecorino Toscano.

title: Chateau Kirwan 2011
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from France, specifically from the Margaux appellation in the Médoc region of Bordeaux. Château Kirwan is a prestigious Third Growth estate (Troisième Grand Cru Classé) under the 1855 classification. The estate takes its name from Mark Kirwan, an Irishman who settled in Bordeaux in the mid-18th century, though it has been owned and managed by the Schÿler family since 1926. The winery's philosophy balances centuries of tradition with modern innovation, focusing on precise vineyard management and an artistic but disciplined winemaking process to faithfully reflect its unique sandy-gravel terroir.

Wine Description

Chateau Kirwan 2011 presents a deep red colour that has gained complexity and depth with bottle age. The nose is aromatic and expressive, featuring a combination of black fruits, cassis, and cherry layered with sophisticated notes of vanilla, liquorice, and cinnamon. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and strikingly fleshy, with flavours of deeply ripened black cherry, cocoa, and mocha. It is characterized by its tactile, 'velour-like' texture and smooth, velvety tannins that coat the palate, leading to a fresh and lingering finish with a dry, mineral edge. This blend consists of 55% Cabernet Sauvignon, 21% Merlot, 15% Cabernet Franc, and 9% Petit Verdot, with an ABV of approximately 13.5%. While the estate follows sustainable practices and is a leader in environmental management, this bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is from 2017 through 2031.

title: Charles Heidsieck Blanc De Blancs
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This champagne originates from France, specifically from the Champagne region. Founded in 1851 by the legendary Charles-Henri Heidsieck, the house is one of the most admired in the region for its commitment to complexity and long term aging. In 2011, the winery was acquired by the Descours family, who continue the founder's philosophy of using high proportions of reserve wines and extended maturation in two thousand year old chalk cellars to achieve a signature silken texture.

Wine Description

The Charles Heidsieck Blanc de Blancs is a pale, crystalline gold colour with fine, persistent effervescence. The nose reveals a sophisticated bouquet of white peach, candied citrus, and honeysuckle, accented by toasted hazelnuts and a delicate pastry character. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with a creamy, velvety texture that balances fresh acidity with notes of lemon oil, tangerine, and a distinct chalky minerality. It is characterized by its tension and 'surprising suavity,' leading to a long finish with a hint of saline minerality. This cuvée is crafted from 100% Chardonnay and typically includes 25% reserve wines. The ABV is 12%. While the house utilizes sustainable viticulture and avoids insecticides, this wine is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window for this non vintage bottling is from now through 2030.

title: The Glenrothes 42 Year Old - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Glenrothes 42 Year Old is a rare and prestigious single malt Scotch whisky from the Speyside region of Scotland. The Glenrothes Distillery was founded in 1878 by James Stuart and is currently owned by the Edrington Group. This limited release, which debuted in early 2023, represents a significant milestone for the distillery as its first ever 42 year old expression, following only the elusive 50 year old in terms of age.

Spirit Description

Master Whisky Maker Laura Rampling selected just four exceptional refill casks from 1980 to create this unique marriage, aiming to refine the distillery's signature fruity spirit without the wood overpowering its delicate character.

  • Colour: The whisky possesses a naturally deep amber tone, a result of four decades of oak maturation without added colouring.

  • Aroma: The nose is intensely aromatic and tropical, featuring sun-ripened apricots, orange peel, mango, and passionfruit, layered with sugared almonds, coriander seed, and a hint of fresh cedar wood.

  • Palate: It offers a richly sweet and velvety mouthfeel with notes of honeycomb, brown sugar, and vanilla. These are complemented by orange oil, toasted almonds, and earthy undertones of coriander and cedar.

  • Body: The spirit is described as smooth, creamy, and beautifully elegant.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, persistent, and velvety smooth finish that lingers with sweet aromatic notes and gentle earthy spices.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at 43%.

Accolades

As an ultra-limited release with only 1,134 bottles produced globally, The Glenrothes 42 Year Old is primarily recognized as a masterpiece of maturation and a pinnacle of the distillery's house style.

  • Exceptional Heritage: The distillery itself has a long history of critical acclaim; for example, its 25 Year Old expression was awarded the Chairman's Trophy for Best Speyside Single Malt at the Ultimate Spirits Challenge in 2018.

  • Mastery Recognition: Master Whisky Maker Laura Rampling has been lauded for her "science, alchemy, and magic" in selecting the specific four casks that allowed the bright character of The Glenrothes to shine at such an advanced age.

title: Jameson Triple Triple
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Jameson Triple Triple is a premium Irish whiskey produced at the Midleton Distillery in County Cork, Ireland. The brand was founded in 1780 by John Jameson and is currently owned by Irish Distillers, a subsidiary of Pernod Ricard. This expression is notable for being both triple distilled and triple cask matured, building on the signature smoothness of the original Jameson blend. Originally introduced as a travel retail exclusive, it has since graduated to a wider general release.

Spirit Description

This whiskey is a blend of single pot still and single grain Irish whiskeys that undergo a unique maturation journey in three distinct types of barrels. There are two notable variations of this expression: one matured in bourbon, sherry, and Malaga wine casks, and a newer edition matured in bourbon, sherry, and sweet chestnut casks.

  • Colour: The spirit presents a rich golden hue in the glass.

  • Aroma: The nose opens with inviting aromas of toffee fudge, vanilla, and hazelnut chocolate, balanced by subtle orchard fruits like sweet pear and green apple.

  • Palate: It delivers a luscious and textured mouthfeel with notes of creamy fudge, vanilla, and dark chocolate, complemented by mild nutty undertones and gentle wood spices.

  • Body: The whiskey is characterized by a velvety smooth, silky, and supple body that remains rounded without being overpowering.

  • Finish: It concludes with a medium to long finish where the fruit and spices gently fade, allowing the balanced influence of oak and chestnut (or Malaga) to linger.

  • ABV: Jameson Triple Triple is typically bottled at 40%.

title: Big Peat 12 Years Old - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Big Peat 12 Years Old is a premium Islay blended malt Scotch whisky produced by the independent bottler Douglas Laing & Co.. Launched in August 2020, it is a permanent addition to the Remarkable Regional Malts series, which was first established in 2009 to showcase the distinctive maritime character of Scotland's whisky regions. The spirit is a unique marriage of single malt whiskies exclusively from the island of Islay, including well known names such as Ardbeg, Caol Ila, Bowmore, and the legendary Port Ellen.

Spirit Description

True to the traditional Douglas Laing style, this 12 year old expression is bottled without artificial colouring or chill filtration. It is matured predominantly in ex-bourbon casks to allow the naturally oily and phenolic character of the Islay spirit to take centre stage.

  • Colour: The whisky possesses a natural and seductive golden hue.

  • Aroma: The nose opens clean, fresh, and oceanic with salty sea air and iodine, developing into sweet malt dried over peat and hints of lemon zest.

  • Palate: It offers a rich and concentrated palate of charred oak, chimney smoke, and summer tar, complemented by notes of roasted barley, dark chocolate, and black pepper.

  • Body: The spirit is full bodied, oily, and thick, providing a warming sensation with every sip.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long and lingering finish of brown sugar, bonfire ashes, and a real phenolic quality.

  • ABV: Big Peat 12 Years Old is bottled at 46%.

title: K Vintners Phil Lane Syrah 2019
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Walla Walla Valley within the Columbia Valley of Washington State. Produced by K Vintners, a brand under the House of Smith, the Phil Lane Syrah is named after the winery's first estate vineyard, which was part of the original homestead property purchased by Charles Smith in 2001. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes the integrity of the site, utilizing 100% whole cluster fermentation and native yeasts to capture the unique 'divine specialness' of this one acre plot.

Wine Description

K Vintners Phil Lane Syrah displays a dark, opaque ruby or magenta purple colour. The nose is opulent and complex, offering a kaleidoscope of aromas including black cherry, baked plum, fresh fig, and lavender, interlaced with savoury notes of olive tapenade, cured meat, and charred cedar. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and layered, featuring a dense core of black fruits, black pepper, and star anise balanced by a seamless mouthfeel and a great veil of tension. It is characterized by its flawless balance, zesty acidity, and a long, persistent finish marked by crushed slate and spice. This 100% Syrah typically has an ABV of 14.5% and is aged for approximately 21 months in French oak puncheons (40% to 50% new). While the estate follows sustainable viticulture, this bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through approximately 15 to 20 years.

title: K Vintners Vino Rosso
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Columbia Valley region of Washington State. Produced by K Vintners, a brand under the House of Smith, it was created by renowned winemaker Charles Smith, who famously began his winemaking career in 1999 selling bottles out of the back of his Astro van. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a 'wine for the people' approach, focusing on small-lot, single-vineyard expressions and high-quality field blends that reflect the integrity of the site through native yeast fermentation and sustainable farming practices.

Wine Description

K Vintners Vino Rosso displays a beautiful, shimmering dark ruby red colour. The nose is highly inviting, offering aromas of small Italian cherries, black plum, and blueberries, seamlessly layered with notes of loose tobacco, suede, and a hint of cool ash. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and punchy, featuring flavours of wild berries and subtle spices that are neatly wrapped in a smooth, leathery texture. It is characterized by its vibrant energy, fine-grained tannins, and a short yet pleasant finish. This blend typically consists of 70% Cabernet Sauvignon and 30% Sangiovese (though some vintages include Cabernet Franc), with an ABV of approximately 13.5%. While the estate follows sustainable management practices, including zero use of pesticides and herbicides, this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through approximately five years.

title: Ridge Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Santa Cruz Mountains in California. Founded in 1962 by four Stanford engineers, Ridge Vineyards is world renowned for its Monte Bello vineyard, which first gained international fame during the 1976 Judgement of Paris. The winery's philosophy centres on a 'pre industrial' approach to winemaking, which relies on traditional methods and minimal intervention to allow the fruit's distinctive character to express the terroir.

Wine Description

The 2022 Estate Cabernet Sauvignon is a saturated purple wine featuring intense aromas of black cherry, blueberry, and cola, layered with dried herbs, cedar, and sweet tobacco leaf. On the palate, it is medium bodied with rich textures and flavours of red and black fruits, exotic spices, and distinctive mineral notes of gravel and wet clay. This 'Baby Monte Bello' is known for its weightlessness, presenting bright saline minerality and soaring fresh acidity that balances its generous fruit core. The varietal composition for this vintage is 86% Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Petit Verdot, and 5% Merlot. It has an ABV of 13.5% and is produced using hand harvested, estate grown grapes that are fermented with native yeasts. Although Ridge is deeply committed to sustainability and organic farming, this specific bottling is typically noted as being from sustainably farmed estate vineyards. The optimal drinking window for this wine is from 2025 through 2040.

Accolades

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 97 points.

  • Decanter - 95 points.

  • Vinous - 94 points.

  • Wine Enthusiast - 94 points.

  • James Suckling - 93 points.

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 92 points.

Food Pairing

The elegant structure and savory minerality of this wine make it a versatile partner for rich meat dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled ribeye steak, roasted leg of lamb with rosemary, or a hearty beef stew. Its herbal notes and bright acidity also complement savoury mushroom risotto or aged hard cheeses like cheddar and gouda.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in the Santa Cruz Mountains was marked by the third consecutive year of drought, resulting in low yields and small, highly concentrated berries with ample tannin. A significant Labor Day heatwave challenged the region, but the winemaker's skill in managing extraction and timing the harvest produced wines with remarkable verve, purity, and aromatic complexity.

title: Angel's Envy 10 Year Old - Cask Strength
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Angel's Envy 10 Year Cask Strength is a landmark release from the United States, produced at the company's distillery in Louisville, Kentucky. Founded in 2010 by Bourbon Hall of Fame Master Distiller Lincoln Henderson and his son Wes Henderson, the brand is currently a subsidiary of Bacardi Limited. This specific expression, debuted in October 2025, represents the first ever age stated bourbon in the distillery's history.

Spirit Description

This limited edition bourbon is a blend of sourced Kentucky straight bourbons that were matured for a cumulative ten years in new charred American white oak and port wine barrels. It is finished for up to three years in port casks imported from the Douro Valley in Portugal and is bottled at an uncut cask strength.

  • Colour: The spirit displays a beautiful, deep new penny copper hue with rich reddish amber highlights.

  • Aroma: The nose is sweet and fragrant, featuring cinnamon toast and creamy fruit nougat woven over a backbone of candied nuts, leather, and brown sugar.

  • Palate: It offers a rich, dessert like palate with notes of baklava, ripe apricot, and crème brûlée, complemented by vanilla, toasted oak, and a touch of grains of paradise spice.

  • Body: The bourbon possesses a bold and robust body that remains surprisingly elegant and lean despite its high proof.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, warming finish where the port influence builds gracefully, revealing notes of rum raisin cake and lingering grape tannins.

  • ABV: This edition is typically bottled at 61.3% (122.6 proof).

title: Blindman Five of Diamonds Pilsner - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Blindman Five of Diamonds Pilsner is brewed by Blindman Brewing, an award-winning craft brewery located in the heart of Lacombe, Alberta, Canada. Founded in 2014, the brewery is known for its commitment to local ingredients and sustainability initiatives, such as on-site carbon capture and solar energy. This specific beer is a collaboration with their neighbours, Len Thompson Fishing Lures; a portion of the proceeds from every can sale supports fisheries restocking and conservation programs across Alberta.

Beer Description

This German style pilsner pours clean and bright with a pale straw yellow hue and a fluffy white head. The sensory profile features a light malt sweetness on the nose complemented by a subtle floral hop fragrance. On the palate, it is crisp and snappy, offering a refreshing balance of crackery, white bready malts and a light bitterness that is well rounded. The body is light with smooth carbonation, resulting in an easy drinking and mellow finish. It is crafted to be a timeless, classic pilsner with an ABV of 4.8% and a bitterness of 25 IBU.

title: Stemmari Nero D'Avola 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Stemmari Nero d'Avola is produced in Sicily, Italy, primarily within the province of Agrigento near Sambuca di Sicilia where the grape thrives in clay-rich soils. The winery is part of the Mezzacorona group and is based at a historic 17th-century estate in Acate di Ragusa, which originally served as a noble summer residence. Stemmari's winemaking philosophy centres on the 'Art of Living, Sicilianly', blending traditional respect for the island's unique terroir with modern vinification techniques to create elegant, fruit-driven wines.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a deep ruby red colour with distinct violet reflections. The intense bouquet features prominent notes of wild strawberries, currants, and pomegranate, accompanied by subtle hints of black plums and dark cherries. On the palate, it is soft and velvety with a medium body and pronounced fruitiness. The wine is often matured for six months in French barriques, which adds complexity through light notes of vanilla and baking spices.

title: Stemmari Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Stemmari Pinot Grigio is produced in the Ragusa province of south-eastern Sicily, Italy. The winery, whose name refers to a 17th-century aristocratic coat of arms, is owned by the Mezzacorona group and shares its estate with the Feudo Arancio brand. The winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the vibrant spirit of the island's diverse landscape by blending traditional Sicilian respect for the land with modern, innovative techniques.

Wine Description

This wine presents a soft straw yellow colour and a bouquet filled with notes of white peach, pear, and dried yellow flowers. On the palate, it is fresh and medium-bodied with a pleasant minerality and flavours of green apple and citrus. The finish is clean and persistent, often showing hints of saline and almond. The vineyards are managed under sustainable practices, and the grapes are harvested at night to preserve their delicate aromatic complexity.

title: Trolley 5 Hattori Hanzo Green Tea Rice Lager - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Trolley 5 Restaurant & Brewery is located in the heart of Calgary, Alberta, along the iconic 17th Avenue Southwest. Co-founded by born-and-raised Calgarians PJ L'Heureux and Ernie Tsu, the brewery opened in June 2016 at the site formerly occupied by the well-known Melrose Café and Bar. Named after the historic No. 5 Trolley line that once serviced the Beltline neighbourhood, the establishment focuses on bringing the community together through craft beer and global comfort food.

Description

Hattori Hanzo is a Japanese Green Tea Lager with an alcohol by volume (ABV) of 4.8% and a bitterness rating of 17 IBU. Inspired by Japanese mastery, this beer is a blend of rice lager and Japanese green tea that has been lagered for 120 days. It presents a pale straw colour with a hazy appearance and a light body. The sensory profile features biscuity and earthy aromas with distinct hints of green tea, leading to a crisp, refreshing palate that is 'as sharp as Hanzo's blade'. It is crafted to be light and endlessly drinkable.

title: Mezzacorona Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Mezzacorona Chardonnay is produced in the Trentino region of Northern Italy, with vineyards situated at the base of the Dolomites at altitudes of 200 to 300 metres. Founded in 1904, Mezzacorona is a historic cooperative consisting of over 1,600 family growers who manage a 'large garden of vines' across diverse alpine microclimates. The winery's philosophy focuses on sustainability and integrated production, utilizing modern winemaking techniques to express the unique character of the pre-Alpine terroirs.

Wine Description

This wine displays a radiant straw yellow colour with brilliant highlights. The bouquet is delicately perfumed, offering aromas of white fruits, green apple, and citrus, accented by soft notes of chamomile blossoms. On the palate, it reveals an elegant structure with refreshing flavours of apricot and melon, supported by a crisp acidity and a slender body. The finish is persistent and refined, leaving a clean, mineral impression.

title: Ponce Blanco 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in the heart of Spain’s Castilla-La Mancha region, this distinctive white wine originates from the Manchuela DO. It is the creation of Juan Antonio Ponce, a visionary winemaker who founded Bodegas y Viñedos Ponce in 2005 at the age of 23. The winery is renowned for championing indigenous, often forgotten varieties like Bobal and the rare Albilla de Manchuela used here. Formerly known as "Reto," the wine has been renamed Ponce Blanco to reflect its status as the estate's primary white expression. The vineyards are located at high altitudes (roughly 700 to 800 meters), where limestone and calcareous clay soils provide a cool-climate tension that is rare for central Spain.

Wine Description

Ponce Blanco exhibits a brilliant straw-yellow hue with steely, greenish reflections. On the nose, it is strikingly original and terroir-driven, offering a bouquet of pink grapefruit, lime peel, and green apple, underscored by complex notes of wild herbs, fennel, and a distinct flinty minerality. The palate is linear and "electric," characterized by a sharp, mouthwatering acidity and a textured, slightly creamy mouthfeel from extended lees contact. It reveals savory undertones of bitter almond, white pepper, and a salty, sea-breeze finish.

Food Pairing

The "electric" acidity and saline mineral core of Ponce Blanco make it a spectacular pairing for Atlantic seafood and shellfish, particularly oysters, grilled sea bass, or octopus a la gallega. Its structural weight from barrel aging allows it to stand up to richer dishes such as stuffed chicken with quince, mushroom risotto, or pasta with pesto. It is also an excellent match for Japanese cuisine, particularly sashimi and tempura, where its citrus notes act as a natural palate cleanser. For a cheese pairing, seek out aged goat cheeses or a classic Manchego.

title: Sandrone Dolcetto D'Alba 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This vibrant red wine hails from the Piedmont region of Northern Italy, specifically from the Dolcetto d'Alba DOC. Established in 1970 by the late, legendary Luciano Sandrone, the winery is a cornerstone of modern Barolo history, now managed by the second and third generations of the Sandrone family. The estate's philosophy is rooted in an intimate understanding of the Langhe’s complex terroir, utilizing organic principles and meticulous vineyard management. This Dolcetto is a unique "village-style" blend, sourced from 11 distinct vineyard parcels across the prestigious communes of Barolo, Monforte d’Alba, and Novello, resulting in a wine of far greater complexity than standard single-vineyard examples.

Wine Description

Sandrone Dolcetto d'Alba 2023 presents a striking ruby red color with youthful violet reflections. The nose is highly aromatic and classic, opening with a bouquet of crushed blue fruits, black plum, and marasca cherry, woven together with delicate notes of lavender, mint, and leather. On the palate, the wine is plush yet precise, showing a medium-bodied structure that balances sweet fruit density with a stony, mineral texture. It is characterized by ripe, fine-grained tannins and the variety's signature refreshing acidity, leading to a persistent finish with a subtle, elegant hint of bitter almond. This 100% Dolcetto has an ABV of 13% and was aged exclusively in stainless steel tanks to preserve its vivid aromatics and varietal purity. To maintain its freshness and "crunchy" fruit character, the wine is bottled after a brief period of refinement. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is from 2024 through 2029.

Food Pairing

The bright fruit profile and moderate tannins of this Dolcetto make it an incredibly versatile companion for traditional Italian cuisine. It pairs exceptionally well with charcuterie boards featuring prosciutto and mortadella, or hearty pasta dishes like tagliatelle with mushroom ragù or lasagna. Its acidity harmonizes beautifully with tomato-based sauces and casual fare like Margherita pizza. For a main course, consider grilled sausages, roasted chicken, or herb-crusted pork chops. It also complements semi-hard cheeses such as Pecorino or young Parmigiano Reggiano.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in the Langhe was characterized by a cold, dry winter followed by a challenging but ultimately rewarding growing season. Significant rainfall in May and June replenished water reserves, while a hot, sunny August ensured full phenolic ripeness and flavor concentration. Despite lower yields due to summer hailstorms, the fruit harvested was of excellent quality. The 2023 wines are noted for their surprising delicacy, lower pH, and impressive aromatic purity, resulting in a Dolcetto that is both approachable in its youth and beautifully balanced.

title: Alvear Pedro Ximenez (PX) Solera 1927 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This fortified dessert wine originates from Spain, specifically from the Montilla Moriles appellation in the province of Cordoba. Founded in 1729 by Diego de Alvear y Escalera, Bodegas Alvear is the oldest winery in Andalusia and has remained family owned for eight generations. The winery's philosophy is rooted in the unique terroir of the Sierra de Montilla, considered the 'grand cru' subzone of the region, where the Albariza soils—rich in limestone and mud—provide the ideal environment for the Pedro Ximenez grape.

Wine Description

Alvear Pedro Ximenez Solera 1927 displays a deep mahogany or dark amber colour with heavy viscosity. The nose is complex and decadent, offering intense aromas of dark maple syrup, roasted pecans, and raisins layered with notes of coffee, toffee, and dried apricots. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and unctuous, featuring concentrated flavours of fig, Nutella, and dark chocolate caramel balanced by a surprising stream of acidity that prevents it from feeling cloyingly heavy. It is characterized by its remarkable depth and a seemingly unending finish that replays notes of orange peel and spice. This 100% Pedro Ximenez wine is produced by sun drying grapes on straw mats to concentrate sugars before fermentation and fortification to 16% ABV. While the vineyards are farmed sustainably without the use of harmful pesticides or irrigation, the wine is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through 2050 and beyond, as the wine's high sugar and alcohol content allow it to age almost indefinitely.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 98 points.

  • Wine Enthusiast - 96 points.

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 96 points.

  • Vinous - 95 points.

  • James Suckling - 94 points.

  • Wine Spectator - 94 points.

Food Pairing

The intense sweetness and complex nutty profile of this Solera 1927 make it a versatile partner for rich desserts and bold savory contrasts. It pairs perfectly with vanilla bean ice cream (traditionally poured directly over the top), pecan tarts, or dark chocolate ganache. Its salty and nutty undertones also complement strong blue cheeses like Stilton or Roquefort, and it is frequently enjoyed as a 'meditation wine' alongside salted nuts or a fine cigar.

title: Roku Sakura Bloom Edition - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Roku Sakura Bloom Edition is a premium craft gin from Japan, specifically produced in the city of Osaka. It is the first limited release in the Seasonal Festival Collection by the House of Suntory, a historic distillery founded in 1899 by Shinjiro Torii. The House of Suntory is currently owned by Suntory Global Spirits, Inc.. This edition celebrates the Japanese tradition of 'hanami', or cherry blossom viewing, and follows the philosophy of 'shun', which emphasizes harvesting ingredients at their peak seasonal ripeness.

Spirit Description

This gin is meticulously crafted using a blend of six Japanese botanicals and eight traditional gin botanicals, featuring a special focus on 'sakura' flowers and leaves harvested at their seasonal peak. Each botanical is distilled separately in four distinct types of pot stills to extract optimal flavour profiles.

  • Colour: The spirit presents a bright and clear appearance.

  • Aroma: The nose is inviting and soft, evoking early spring with gentle floral notes of cherry blossom, fresh herbs, and vibrant juniper.

  • Palate: It offers a smooth and elegant palate characterized by a delicate fruity sweetness of cherry blossoms, balanced by a nostalgic hint of saltiness from the 'sakura' leaf and a touch of citrus zest.

  • Body: The spirit possesses a complex and refined body that balances floral elegance with the earthy depth of green teas and the warmth of 'sansho' pepper.

  • Finish: It concludes with a persistent and lingering finish where sweet floral layers transition into subtle spices and a final hint of salinity.

  • ABV: Roku Sakura Bloom Edition is bottled at 43%.

title: On Y Danse Valdellecorti Vino Rosso
bodyHtml:
The Val delle Corti winery is a small, family-run farm in Radda in Chianti, a high-altitude subregion renowned for producing elegant and pure expressions of Sangiovese. Founded in 1974 by Giorgio Bianchi, the winery is now owned and operated by his son, Roberto Bianchi, and his wife, Lis, who took over in 2000. They are committed to organic farming and traditional winemaking, believing in bringing out the full potential of Sangiovese to produce true, terroir-driven wines.

Wine Description

'On Y Danse' is a Vino Rosso created from a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Sangiovese. This wine was born from Roberto Bianchi’s desire to approach a typical 'Bordeaux blend' on Radda in Chianti's land. Val delle Corti's wines are often noted for their clarity, gentle yet vibrant structure, and beautiful balance.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include pasta with tomato or meat sauce, chicken, and other meat dishes like roasts or stews.

title: Martini Dry Vermouth - 1 Litre
bodyHtml:
This iconic dry vermouth originates from Italy, specifically the Piedmont region. Produced by Martini & Rossi, a house founded in 1863 by Luigi Rossi and Alessandro Martini, this specific expression was first introduced on New Year's Day in 1900 after ten years of development. The distillery remains a symbol of Italian 'aperitivo' culture, with recipes that have been carefully guarded for nine generations.

The vermouth presents a pale gold or straw colour and is crafted from a base of Italian white wines. Its complex sensory profile features crisp, citrus-scented notes with a delicate perfume of raspberry and lemon. At its heart is the violet-scented tartness of Florentine Orris, alongside a secret blend of over 30 botanicals including rare woods, herbs, and roots. On the palate, it is light-bodied, dry, and refreshing, showing hints of green apple, melon, and a subtle woody background that leads to a clean, slightly bitter finish.

title: Charpentier Blanc de Noirs
bodyHtml:
The Charpentier Blanc de Noirs is a powerful testament to the black grapes of the Marne Valley. Crafted by the Charpentier family, who have tended vines in this region for generations, this cuvée strikes a difficult balance: it possesses the broad, muscular richness of Pinot Noir while maintaining a crystalline, mineral-driven tension that is often rare in such powerful wines.

This is a "gastronomic" Champagne. It does not just disappear as an aperitif; it demands attention. With extended aging (often up to 60 months) and a low "Extra Brut" dosage, it offers a purity that allows the terroir to speak clearly without being masked by sugar.

title: Little Book IX Cask Strength
bodyHtml:
Little Book Chapter 9, titled 'None For Granted,' is a limited-edition, cask-strength blended whiskey released in 2025 by the James B. Beam Distilling Co.. This ninth annual installment in the series is an uncut and unfiltered blend of five Kentucky straight whiskeys, aged between seven and 11 years.

Originating from Clermont, Kentucky, Little Book is a passion project created by Freddie Noe, the eighth-generation master distiller at Jim Beam. The series name pays tribute to 'Little Book,' a childhood nickname given to Freddie by his grandfather, the legendary Booker Noe. Freddie Noe's winemaking philosophy for this line focuses on experimentation and the limitless possibilities of blending different aged spirits to create something entirely new each year.

Whiskey Description

Color: Deep copper with golden undertones.

Aroma: Ripe apple, butterscotch, and baking spices. Some tasters also note vanilla, cherry, tobacco, and light dill.

Palate: Built on 'foundational flavors' of brown sweets, warm vanilla, creamy caramel, and big oak. It features rich butterscotch, stone fruits, and a viscous mouthfeel.

Body: Bold and robust, reflecting its cask-strength nature.

Finish: Long-lasting and layered, with waves of spice, toasted sugar, seasoned wood, and lingering barrel char.

title: Tarlant Zero Rose Nature
bodyHtml:
Originating from the Marne Valley in Champagne, France, this cuvée comes from a family owned grower house with roots dating back to 1687. Now under the care of the twelfth generation, led by Benoît Tarlant, the estate manages 14 hectares across 57 distinct plots. The Tarlant family philosophy focuses on a pure, radical winemaking style that emphasizes the terroir through organic and biodynamic practices, minimal intervention, and a pioneering commitment to zero dosage.

Wine Description

The Tarlant Zero Rose Nature NV presents a pale coral pink or salmon hue. The nose is expressive and precise, revealing an inviting bouquet of wild strawberry, raspberry, and rhubarb, accented by notes of blood orange, cherry blossom, and a hint of fresh almond or pastry cream. On the palate, the wine is bone dry and medium bodied, featuring a fine, creamy mousse and a silky texture. It displays a vibrant tension between ripe red fruit and a savory, chalky mineral drive that carries through to a clean, saline finish.

Accolades

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 92 points

Food Pairing

This wine's structural finesse makes it an ideal companion for seared tuna, smoked salmon with crème fraiche, or aged Comté cheese. It also pairs elegantly with lighter fare such as grilled shrimp with lemon or a savory zucchini and red onion frittata.

title: Caleno White Coconut Rum (Non Alcoholic) - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
This exotic non-alcoholic spirit originates from the United Kingdom and is inspired by the vibrant 'sun-drenched spirit' of Colombia. Caleño was founded by Ellie Webb, who created the brand after being frustrated by the lack of exciting alcohol-free options while on nights out. Her mission is to bring 'joy to not drinking' by infusing her spirits with the tropical flavours, colours, and rhythms of her family's homeland.

Spirit Description

Colour: Clear.

Aroma: Fresh coconut with subtle, tropical notes of vanilla and pineapple.

Palate: Rich and velvety with a smooth, sweet exotic taste.

Body: Smooth and creamy, offering a 'silky' texture that captures the natural depth of a fine rum without the alcohol.

Finish: A smooth and lingering sweetness.

Composition: This non-alcoholic rum alternative is distilled using a blend of fresh coconut, pineapple, and vanilla.

ABV: 0.0%.

Dietary Information: This spirit is vegan-friendly, gluten-free, sugar-free, and low in calories. It is not certified organic.

title: Delamotte Brut Champagne
bodyHtml:
Delamotte Brut is a distinguished non vintage sparkling wine from France, specifically crafted in the prestigious Côte des Blancs region of Champagne. Established in Reims in 1760 by François Delamotte, it stands as the fifth oldest house in the region and is now headquartered in the Grand Cru village of Le Mesnil sur Oger. Today, the house is owned by Laurent Perrier and operates as the sister house to the legendary Champagne Salon, sharing the same dedicated viticultural and winemaking teams.

Wine Description

This Champagne presents a brilliant silver yellow hue with a fine, delicate mousse. The aromatic profile is pure and inviting, featuring lemon oil, crisp orchard fruits, and white blossoms, layered with subtle notes of warm biscuits, ginger, and brioche. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and balanced, offering a lively interplay of fresh pear, candied lemon peel, and a chalky minerality.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and delicate fruit notes of this Brut make it an ideal companion for fresh seafood, such as oysters, sashimi, or succulent shellfish. It also pairs beautifully with creamy asparagus risotto or light fruit desserts like poached pears and apricot tarts.

title: Bolla Prosecco Spumante Extra Dry
bodyHtml:
Bolla Prosecco Spumante Extra Dry originates from the Veneto region in northeast Italy, with grapes sourced primarily from the Treviso area. The winery’s history dates back to 1883, when Abele Bolla established the family's first cellars in Soave, beginning a legacy rooted in a passion for the territory's traditional styles. Today, under the ownership of Gruppo Italiano Vini, the winery continues to balance innovation with its historic heritage, focusing on producing wines that respect the identity of the grapes and their origin.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine presents a pale straw yellow colour with a fine, persistent perlage and a soft, creamy mousse. The aromatic profile is intense and fragrant, revealing prominent notes of green apple, honeydew melon, and pear, alongside delicate hints of white peach, citrus blossom, and a touch of almond. On the palate, it is fresh and harmonious, showcasing a balance between the moderate sweetness of the Extra Dry style and a lively acidity that enhances its fruit forward character.

Food Pairing

  • Refined appetizers such as smoked salmon toast or fresh cheese canapés with dried fruits.

  • Delicate seafood dishes, including sushi, sashimi, or grilled shrimp with lemon.

  • Light Italian fare such as a mushroom omelette, vegetable risotto, or creamy pasta dishes.

  • Fresh fruit based desserts like strawberry mousse or lemon sorbet.

title: Freixenet Cordon Negro Brut Cava
bodyHtml: There's only one way to make this Spanish sparkler even more special. Present it, chilled and wrapped, to your loved ones. This citrusy favourite is a staple. A light, modern Cava with a very refreshing style and lots of bubbles that really last. When you taste it, you’ll pick up hints of citrus fruit and an aroma that reminds you of both apple and pear as well as peach, melon and pineapple, along with light yeasty and minerally notes and lively effervescence.

title: Establishment Brewing Chaise Longue - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Establishment Chaise Longue originates from Calgary, Alberta, within the Manchester Brewing District. The Establishment Brewing Company was founded by friends Dave Ronneberg, Mike Foniok, and Brandon Hart, who transitioned from decorated homebrewing backgrounds to open the brewery in 2019. Their winemaking and brewing philosophy focuses on the character of mixed culture fermentation, seeking to create beers that are simple in nature but complex in flavour.

Beer Description

This petite saison, or table beer, presents a straw toned gold colour with a high fizz factor and a light, bright appearance. The aroma is reminiscent of summer, featuring fresh cut lemons, herbs, hay, and field flowers. On the palate, it delivers a crisp and dry profile with distinct notes of lemon and white pepper. While the body is light and crushable, it is notably fuller than its low alcohol content would suggest, concluding with a clean finish.

title: Lamarca Prosecco - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Lamarca Prosecco originates from Italy, specifically within the Veneto region and the renowned Treviso subregion. Founded in 1968, La Marca is a prestigious winery cooperative representing over 5,000 winegrowers who dedicatedly farm more than 17,000 acres in the heart of Italy's lush Prosecco region. The winery is celebrated for its commitment to quality and its philosophy of sharing the Italian 'La Dolce Vita' through approachable, elegant sparkling wines.

Wine Description

This Prosecco presents a pale, golden straw colour and sparkles with lively, persistent, and full-textured bubbles. The aromatic profile is intense and fragrant, offering a bouquet of fresh-picked citrus, ripe lemon, and white pulpy fruits alongside delicate hints of honey and honeysuckle blossoms. On the palate, the wine is crisp and clean, delivering flavours of green apple, juicy peach, and ripe lemon framed by subtle mineral undertones and a touch of toast.

title: Jean Vesselle Brut Reserve
bodyHtml:
The Jean Vesselle Brut Réserve is the perfect introduction to the Vesselle style: rich, fruit-forward, and incredibly inviting. While many Champagnes rely heavily on Chardonnay for lightness, this cuvée is proudly built on Pinot Noir (80%).

It offers the best of both worlds—the weight and vinosity of a red grape variety, lifted by just enough Chardonnay to keep it fresh and energetic. It is a "comfort" Champagne; unpretentious yet sophisticated, making it the ideal bottle to pop for Sunday brunch, a roasted chicken dinner, or simply because it’s Tuesday.

title: Collective Arts Local Press Apple & Cherry Cider 473ml – 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This vibrant craft cider is produced in Canada, specifically in Hamilton, Ontario. Collective Arts Brewing was established in 2013 by Matt Johnston and Bob Russell with a mission to fuse the craft of brewing with the talents of global emerging artists. Their philosophy is built on the belief that 'creativity fosters creativity,' using their beverage cans as a canvas to feature limited-edition works by artists from around the world.

The 'Local Press Apple & Cherry is crafted by taking their flagship apple cider base and blending it with fresh Montmorency cherry juice sourced from the Niagara escarpment. It displays a bright and colourful appearance. The nose is rich and sharp, offering aromas of fresh orchard apples and tart cherries, with some detecting mild candied cherry and banana notes. On the palate, the cider is tart and fruity with a medium bite. It features a natural, genuine cherry flavour; including subtle notes of cherry pits, balanced by a smooth and clean apple finish. Stylistically, it is described as being 'like a sweet cherry pie without the buttery crust,' offering an indulgent yet refreshing experience that balances fruit-forward sweetness with a crisp, slightly sour edge. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 5.8 per cent.

title: No Boats On Sunday Pear Cider 473ml – 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This refreshing craft cider originates from Canada. The brand, owned by Andrew Peller Limited, is produced regionally, with specific versions crafted in British Columbia, Ontario, and Nova Scotia using fruit sourced 100 per cent locally from each respective province. The name pays homage to a historical era in Halifax when boat traffic was restricted on Sundays so that hard-working locals could pull up their oars and spend time with family and friends.

The Pear Cider is a crisp blend crafted from locally sourced pears and apples. It displays a transparent light yellow colour, often featuring a subtle green hue, with large, streaming bubbles. The nose is characterized by fresh, clean aromas of ripe pear and orchard apples mingled with delicate floral and spring blossom notes. On the palate, the cider is light-bodied, smooth, and lightly sparkling. it delivers a balanced profile that combines the natural sweetness of fresh apples with the juice of ripe pears. The finish is refreshing and light, featuring lingering notes of pear and orchard fruit. Stylistically, it is described as an easy-to-consume, off-dry cider with a syrupy pear element that remains crisp and clean. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 5.0 per cent.

title: No Boats On Sunday BC Cider 473ml – 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This crisp craft cider originates from Canada, specifically from British Columbia, where it is brewed in Kelowna. The brand, owned by Andrew Peller Limited, pays homage to a historical period in Halifax when locals restricted boat traffic on Sundays to ensure time was spent with family and friends. The cidery follows a philosophy of being present in the moment and crafting beverages that are 'close to home' by using 100 per cent locally sourced fruit.

The BC Original Apple Cider is a premium craft beverage made from 100 per cent British Columbia-grown apples, with the McIntosh variety making up the majority of the blend. It displays a clear, pale golden colour with fine, delicate bubbles. The nose features fresh aromas of orchard apples, citrus, and subtle floral notes. On the palate, the cider is light-bodied and off-dry, delivering authentic juicy apple flavours balanced by a touch of tartness and subtle hops added to enhance the profile. It is characterized by its refreshing, easy-drinking nature and a clean, bright apple finish. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 5.0 per cent.

title: San Felice Rosso
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Toscana IGT region in Tuscany. Produced by Agricola San Felice, the winery is part of a historic estate that includes the Antica Pieve San Felice in Pincis village near Castelnuovo Berardenga. While the estate has roots dating back centuries, it has been owned for more than 50 years by the Allianz Group, which has heavily invested in its vineyards and winemaking research. San Felice is recognized for its innovative spirit, particularly for its 'Vitiarium' experimental vineyard where it has spent decades researching and reviving forgotten indigenous Tuscan grape varieties.

Wine Description

San Felice Rosso displays a young but rich ruby red colour in the glass. The nose is aromatic and refreshing, offering scents of raspberry, cherry, and lavender. On the palate, the wine is fresh and juicy, featuring bright acidity and soft tannins that make it an harmonious and easy-drinking 'daily-wine'. It is characterized by its contemporary Tuscan style, delivering clear red fruit notes of cherry and raspberry. This blend is primarily composed of 80% Sangiovese, complemented by 10% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Merlot. The ABV is typically 13%. While the estate follows sustainable viticulture practices, this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through five to six years.

title: Frontonio Garnacha Blanca 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from Spain, specifically from the Valdejalón IGP within the Aragón region. Bodegas Frontonio was established in 2008 by Master of Wine Fernando Mora in his garage, with a mission to recover ancient viticultural traditions and restore the reputation of old vines in the region. The winery's philosophy centres on minimal intervention and sustainability, often utilizing a 200 year old underground cave system that provides natural temperature control for gravity based processing and aging.

Wine Description

Frontonio Garnacha Blanca 2020 displays a bright lemony yellow colour that is semi opaque in appearance. The nose is aromatic and showy, offering scents of white flowers, lime, and grapefruit layered with notes of beeswax, pollen, and subtle smoky hints. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and energetic, delivering a creamy texture balanced by crisp acidity and a distinct chalky grip. It is characterized by its mineral length and saline finish, often showing complex flavours of peach, apple, and white pepper. This 100% Garnacha Blanca wine (though sometimes blended with Macabeo in specific cuvées like 'La Loma & Los Santos') typically has an ABV of 13.5%. While not all bottlings carry formal certification, the winery manages its old vines according to organic farming practices without the use of chemicals. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is estimated from 2023 through 2035.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 96 points.

  • Guia Penin - 95 points.

  • Vivino Community - 4.2 points.

Food Pairing

The rich texture and saline minerality of this Garnacha Blanca make it a versatile partner for a wide range of flavourful dishes. It pairs perfectly with grilled turbot, broiled lobster, or scallops in a brown butter sauce, which complement its pithy structure and creamy mouthfeel. Its herbal and spicy undertones also enhance roasted chicken with lemon and thyme, mild Thai coconut curries, or mushroom based risottos. For a cheese course, consider soft creamy varieties like Brie or medium hard nutty options such as Swiss or Emmentaler.

title: Marani Khvanchkara 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Georgia, specifically from the Khvanchkara micro zone within the Racha region. Produced by Telavi Wine Cellar under the Marani brand, the winery was established in 1915 near the city of Telavi in Kakheti. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a century of tradition, seamlessly intertwining historical Rachan winemaking techniques with modern innovation to showcase the diversity of indigenous Georgian grape varieties.

Wine Description

Marani Khvanchkara displays a light ruby or burgundy colour. The nose is aromatic and complex, offering a penetrating attack of raspberry and strawberry aromas layered with notes of roasted almonds and a hint of juniper or pine cones. On the palate, the wine is soft and concentrated, featuring a velvety texture with dominant flavours of wild strawberry and sweet cherries balanced by a fresh, slightly sour finish. It is characterized by its natural semi sweet character, which is achieved by using late-harvest grapes that are fermented in stainless steel until the desired balance of sugar and acidity is reached. This wine is a traditional blend of the indigenous Aleksandrouli and Mujuretuli grape varieties, typically reaching an ABV of 11% to 11.5%. While the winery utilizes sustainable methods and respects natural processes, this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through three to five years to best enjoy its fresh berry profile.

Food Pairing

The natural sweetness and vibrant fruit profile of this Khvanchkara make it an ideal partner for a variety of desserts and savoury dishes. It pairs perfectly with fruit salads, cherry tarts, and soft cheeses such as Brie or Camembert. Its berry notes and balanced acidity also complement red meats, poultry, and fresh salads. For the best experience, it is recommended to serve this wine slightly chilled at a temperature of 11°C to 13°C.

title: Georgian Valleys Tsinandali 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from Georgia, specifically from the Tsinandali appellation in the Kakheti region. Produced by Tbilvino under the Georgian Valleys label, the winery is currently run by brothers Zurab and Giorgi Margvelashvili, who have modernized the estate founded in 1962 to combine thousand year old traditions with contemporary technology. Tsinandali is considered Georgia's most historically significant PDO for white wine, established in the 19th century and named after the estate of noble poet Aleksandre Chavchavadze.

Wine Description

Georgian Valleys Tsinandali displays a pale straw or light gold colour. The nose is charming and aromatic, offering a bouquet of white flowers, fresh grapes, and citrus layered with notes of quince, green apple, and pear. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and crisp, featuring a harmonious balance between refreshing acidity and a mineral core. It is characterized by its linear and precise structure, leading to a long finish that often includes subtle nutty or saline nuances. This wine is a classic blend of 85% Rkatsiteli and 15% Mtsvane grapes, fermented in stainless steel vats at cool temperatures to preserve its vibrant fruit aromatics. The ABV typically ranges from 12% to 12.5%, and the residual sugar is below 2 g/L, making it a dry table wine. While the estate follows high quality standards, this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through three to five years, though premium examples can age for up to ten years.

Food Pairing

The crisp acidity and mineral profile of Tsinandali make it a versatile partner for a wide variety of fresh and light dishes. It pairs perfectly with white fish, shrimp, and shellfish, as well as roasted chicken served with lemon or herb sauces. Its floral and orchard fruit notes also complement fresh salads, light pasta dishes, and vegetarian cuisine like mushroom based recipes. For a traditional Georgian experience, it harmonizes well with khachapuri (cheese bread) or soft cheeses such as feta and goat cheese.

title: Georgian Valleys Saperavi 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Georgia, specifically from the Kakheti region. Produced by Tbilvino under the Georgian Valleys label, the winery was once the largest wine company in the Soviet Union before being acquired in the early 1990s by brothers Giorgi and Zura Margvelashvili. The estate's philosophy shifted from quantity to quality under their leadership, focusing on giving wines a typical Georgian identity through the use of indigenous grapes and a blend of stainless steel and traditional oak aging.

Wine Description

Georgian Valleys Saperavi displays a bright garnet or deep ruby red colour. The nose is juicy and expressive, offering aromas of fresh blackberry, cherry, and plum layered with hints of coffee, cinnamon, and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and rich, featuring intense flavours of cassis, black fruit, and liquorice balanced by a lively acidity and firm, chewy tannins. It is characterized by its authentic local character and a long, berry-forward finish with notes of oak and sweet spices. This 100% Saperavi wine typically has an ABV of 13% and is produced using hand-selected grapes from vineyards located at altitudes of 200 to 700 metres. While the winery employs modern vinification techniques in stainless steel and partial maturation in wooden barriques, this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through 15 years, as the wine has significant aging potential.

title: Georgian Valleys Kindzmarauli 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Georgia, specifically from the Kindzmarauli micro-zone within the Kakheti region of eastern Georgia. Produced by Tbilvino under the Georgian Valleys label, the winery is currently managed by brothers Zurab and Giorgi Margvelashvili, who have overseen the modernisation of this historic estate founded in 1962. The winery's philosophy bridges centuries-old Georgian traditions with contemporary techniques, utilizing the unique terroir on the left bank of the Alazani River where mineral-rich alluvial soils and black shale help ripen grapes to high sugar levels.

Wine Description

Georgian Valleys Kindzmarauli displays an amazing combination of dark ruby and vibrant scarlet colours with violet tones. The nose is scented and expressive, offering aromas of Maraschino cherry, cassis, blackberry, and dried fig layered with hints of raisins and white chocolate. On the palate, the wine is velvety and medium-bodied, featuring a harmonious balance between its natural semi-sweet fruitiness and a delightful acidity. It is characterized by its lush texture and dominant tones of ripe black cherry, pomegranate, and chocolate, leading to a smooth, persistent finish with notes of spice and pepper.

Food Pairing

The natural sweetness and structured tannins of Kindzmarauli make it an exceptionally versatile companion for both savoury and dessert courses. It pairs perfectly with chocolate cake, ripe strawberries, and fruit-based desserts like cherry pie or blackberry cobbler. Its acidity and bold fruit also complement spicy Asian dishes, tangy barbecued meats, grilled lamb, and blue cheese, where the wine's sweetness softens the cheese's sharpness.

title: Georgian Valleys Khvanchkara
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Georgia, specifically from the Khvanchkara micro-zone in the Racha region of western Georgia. Established in 1962, the producer JSC Tbilvino was the primary winemaking facility during the Soviet era before being privatized in the late 1990s by brothers Zurab and Giorgi Margvelashvili. The winery's philosophy combines traditional Georgian techniques, such as the use of qvevri (clay vessels), with modern technology to showcase indigenous grape varieties while maintaining high quality standards for global export.

Wine Description

Georgian Valleys Khvanchkara displays a characteristic dark ruby colour with a reddish shade or violet gleam around the edges. The nose is aromatic and fruity, offering intense scents of blackberry, raspberry, and black cranberry layered with a distinguishable violet bouquet and notes of ripe cherry. On the palate, the wine is light to medium bodied and velvety, featuring a harmonious balance between its natural semi sweet fruitiness and a fresh acidity. It is characterized by its soft, enjoyable taste with dominant tones of wild strawberry and forest berries, leading to a long and juicy finish. This wine is an authentic blend of the indigenous Aleksandrouli and Mujuretuli grape varieties, typically reaching an ABV of 11.5% to 12.5%. The wine is naturally semi sweet, with a residual sugar content usually ranging between 30 and 45 g/L. While Tbilvino utilizes modern and sustainable methods, this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through three to five years to preserve its fresh berry character.

Food Pairing

The natural sweetness and vibrant acidity of Khvanchkara make it a versatile companion for both savoury and dessert courses. It pairs perfectly with spicy Asian cuisine, duck in fruit sauces, and game meats such as venison. Its berry profile also complements a variety of sweets, including cherry tarts, berry jellies, baklava, and traditional Georgian desserts featuring nuts and honey. For a savoury alternative, it harmonizes well with mature blue cheeses or hard cheeses and mushrooms.

title: Georgian Valleys Alazani Valley Red 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Georgia, specifically from the Kakheti region within the Alazani Valley. Established in 1962, the producer JSC Tbilvino was once a primary factory for the Soviet winemaking industry before emerging as an independent, award winning company in the late 1990s with a philosophy focused on modernizing ancient recipes. The Alazani Valley itself is one of Georgia's most famous names, named after the river that forms the border with Azerbaijan, where a warmer climate allows grapes to reach a delectable natural sweetness.

Wine Description

Georgian Valleys Alazani Valley Red displays a shimmering ruby colour with garnet tones. The nose is aromatic and tender, offering scents of red berries, forest fruits, and ripe plums layered with hints of blossoms and earthy fig chutney. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and smooth, featuring a refined balance between its natural semi sweet fruitiness and a vibrant acidity. It is characterized by a lively character with dominant tones of raspberry and blackberry, followed by a gentle finish with a splash of citrus. This wine is a blend of approximately 70% Saperavi and 30% Rkatsiteli grapes, which are fermented in temperature controlled tanks until the desired residual sweetness of roughly 38 g/L is reached. The ABV is typically 11.5%. While the winery emphasizes high quality standards, this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through 2026.

Food Pairing

The semi sweet profile and balanced acidity of this Alazani Valley red make it an excellent companion for a wide range of spicy and savoury dishes. It pairs perfectly with spicy Asian or fusion cuisine, pork ribs, and hearty meat dishes like roast goat or venison curry. Its fruit forward nature also complements holiday meals like turkey with cranberry sauce and sweet treats such as cherry pie, fruit jelly, or shortbread cookies.

title: Gerard Raphet Bourgogne Rouge 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from France, specifically from the Burgundy region within the regional Bourgogne AOC appellation. Established in the 1920s, Domaine Gérard Raphet is a historic family winery based in Morey Saint Denis that is currently led by fourth generation winemaker Gérard Raphet and his daughter, Marion. The winery's philosophy is rooted in traditional, handmade production from field to bottle, utilizing exceptionally old vines—many surpassing 100 years of age—to create soulful wines that emphasize purity and the unique limestone terroir of the Côte de Nuits.

Wine Description

Gérard Raphet Bourgogne Rouge 2023 displays a delicate ruby or light raspberry red colour in the glass. The nose is aromatic and expressive, offering scents of fresh picked red cherries, strawberries, and autumn leaves layered with notes of cinnamon, blood orange, and a subtle forest floor earthiness. On the palate, the wine is light to medium bodied and fresh, delivering vibrant flavours of raspberry, pomegranate jam, and red currant supported by soft, well incorporated tannins and a brilliant acidity. It is characterized by its elegant perfume, 'see-through' clarity, and a slightly rustic finish marked by delicate bitter pit fruit and mineral undertones. This 100% Pinot Noir typically features an ABV of 13% and is produced from 40 year old vines located in the 'Les Grands Champs' lieu-dit of Gevrey Chambertin. The wine is fermented on indigenous yeasts and aged for 18 months in older French oak barrels before being bottled unfined and unfiltered.
