While the winery employs sustainable (lutte raisonnée) farming practices that prioritize organic methods, the wine is not formally certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through five to seven years.

Accolades

  • Burghound - 86-89 points.

  • CellarTracker - 88 points.

  • Vivino Community - 3.7 points.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and delicate fruit profile of this Bourgogne Rouge make it a versatile companion for lighter meats and earthy vegetarian dishes. It pairs perfectly with roast pork or chicken, as well as poultry like turkey or pheasant served with a traditional bread sauce. Its herbal and spicy notes also complement porcini mushroom crostini, beef in oyster sauce, and delicately spiced Mediterranean fare.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Burgundy is regarded as a high quality and abundant year, offering 'Burgundian' transparency and a return to a more classic, fresh style compared to recent warmer years. A relatively cool and wet summer followed by a harvest heatwave resulted in Pinot Noir with perfectly ripe fruit on the palate balanced by a satisfying, invigorating freshness and gentle tannins.

title: Guinness Draught 440 ml - 8 Cans
bodyHtml: Rich and creamy. Distinctively black. Velvety in its finish. This iconic beer is defined by harmony. Sip after sip, sweet counters bitter as the malt arrives on cue to complement a base of roasted barley. Just as the unmistakable white head sits flush atop the dark beer, so do the flavours counter and combine perfectly. This is our greatest innovation. Truly unique. Perfectly balanced.

title: Fernie Brewing Slingshot Session IPA 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: An award-winning, lower alcohol IPA. Regular IPA imbibers will not be disappointed with our selection of traditional and newer hop cultivars. Dry-hopped to provide the distinct citrusy, tropical fruit and pine flavours and aromas, resulting in a refreshing and easy-drinking Session IPA.

title: Kokanee 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: Kokanee, the best selling lager in B.C., gains its particular character from the blend of Pacific Northwest hops. The beer has twice won brewing industry awards for its smooth, clean and lightly hopped flavor. It has an alcohol content of 5% abv.

title: Bud Light 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: Bud Light is brewed with barley, hops, water and rice for a smooth taste that’s made for living.

title: Hendrick's Gin - 1.75 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hendrick's Gin is a super-premium spirit from Scotland, produced by William Grant & Sons at the Girvan distillery in South Ayrshire. Launched in 1999, the gin was created by Master Distiller Lesley Gracie, a chemist who sought to develop a distinct expression using two rare antique copper stills: an 1860 Bennett pot still and a 1948 Carter-Head still. The brand is known for its iconoclastic approach, packaged in a dark brown apothecary style bottle that reflects its 'oddly made' handcrafted nature.

Description

This gin is uniquely crafted using a symphony of 11 traditional botanicals, further enriched by unusual infusions of Bulgarian rose and specially selected cucumber. The combination of a robust spirit from the Bennett still and a delicate spirit from the Carter-Head still results in an impeccably balanced profile.

  • Colour: The spirit is perfectly clear and polished in the glass.

  • Aroma: The nose is bright and inviting, starting with mild citrus tones and herbal juniper, accented by floral scents of rose petal, violet, and a light cucumber influence.

  • Palate: It offers a silky entry with flavours of sweet elderberry, lime, and orange zest that intertwine with rose, lavender, and a burst of juniper pine.

  • Body: The gin possesses a medium to full body with a smooth, velvety, and well rounded texture.

  • Finish: It concludes with a lengthy and crisp finish, marked by a pleasant bitterness, dry spice, and a delicate fade of sweet citrus custard pastry.

  • ABV: In North America, the spirit is typically bottled at 44% alcohol by volume, while the European version is often 41.4%.

title: Borgogno Grappa di Barolo
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Borgogno Grappa di Barolo is a premium artisanal spirit from Italy, specifically produced in the Piedmont region within the village of Barolo. The winery, Giacomo Borgogno & Figli, was founded in 1761 by Bartolomeo Borgogno and is recognized as the oldest continuously operating winery in the Barolo area. After being managed by the Borgogno family for five generations, the estate was acquired in 2008 by the Farinetti family, who remain dedicated to maintaining the distillery's historical traditions and classic style.

Spirit Description

This grappa is crafted exclusively from the fermented pomace of Nebbiolo grapes used in the production of Barolo wine. It is distilled using a discontinuous cycle in small steam powered copper boilers and is aged in wooden barrels for approximately 24 months.

  • Colour: The spirit presents a bright pale yellow or straw yellow colour with golden reflections.

  • Aroma: The nose is delightful and layered, featuring fresh floral notes of flowers and ripe grapes alongside delicate scents of pear, green apple, and soft spices.

  • Palate: It offers a rich, fresh, and elegant palate with a silky and well rounded texture. The grape flavours are echoed in the mouth, accompanied by harmonious woody notes.

  • Body: The spirit is characterized by an intense and persistent structure that remains balanced and velvety.

  • Finish: It concludes with a pleasant hint of spice on the finish, showing a persistent and clean aftertaste.

  • ABV: Borgogno Grappa di Barolo is bottled at 43% alcohol by volume.

Accolades

Borgogno Grappa di Barolo has received notable recognition for its quality and craftsmanship in international spirits competitions.

  • Silver Medal: Awarded at the USA Spirits Ratings in 2024 for its silky and well rounded profile.

  • 90 Points: Rated by Gilbert & Gaillard in January 2024, praised for its delightful floral nose and elegant palate.

  • Cultural Standing: The winery's heritage is deeply linked to Italian history; its Barolo was famously used for the toast at the celebratory lunch for the Unification of Italy in 1861.

Food Pairing

The intense structure and persistent floral notes of this grappa make it a versatile partner for rich and savoury culinary experiences.

  • Savoury: It is traditionally proposed at the end of a meal as a digestif to help cleanse the palate.

  • Cheese: Aged Italian cheeses such as Parmigiano Reggiano, Gorgonzola, or Castelmagno provide a creamy contrast to the spirit's woody notes.

  • Dessert: Its spicy and fruity profile pairs excellently with dark chocolate, hazelnut based pastries, or traditional Italian tarts.

  • Serving: For the best sensory experience, it is recommended to serve this grappa at a temperature between 16°C and 18°C in a large tulip shaped glass.

title: Bepi Tosolini Grappa Distillery Edition - Barrique Ex-Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Bepi Tosolini Grappa Distillery Edition - Barrique Ex-Whisky is a premium artisanal spirit from Italy, specifically produced in the northeastern region of Friuli Venezia Giulia. The distillery was founded in 1943 by Giuseppe 'Bepi' Tosolini, a native of Friuli who dedicated his life to transforming grappa into a refined and sophisticated distillate. Today, the company remains family owned and is managed by the founder's grandchildren, Giuseppe, Bruno, and Lisa, who continue the 'Tosolini method' of artisanal distillation in traditional steam pot stills.

Spirit Description

This grappa is distilled from the fresh pomace of various noble Friulian grape varieties, using a manual distillation process that selects only the purest part of the distillate, known as the 'heart'. It is then seasoned in the Tosolini cellars within European oak barriques that previously contained first quality original whisky.

  • Colour: The liquid presents a rich orange hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is complex and enveloping, featuring notes of marmalade, orange, and toasted oak.

  • Palate: It offers a very rich and spicy character with enveloping notes of jam, citrus, and toasted oak.

  • Body: This grappa is characterized by a strong and full bodied profile that is clean on the palate.

  • Finish: It concludes with a smooth, clean, and persistent finish.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at 40%.

Food Pairing

The warm, spicy, and fruit forward profile of this whisky finished grappa makes it an ideal companion for post dinner relaxation.

  • Savoury: It serves as an excellent digestif and can be enjoyed as a 'caffe corretto', either served alongside or added to an espresso.

  • Sweet: It pairs elegantly with rich desserts, particularly those featuring dark chocolate, nuts, or candied orange peel.

  • Serving: For the best sensory experience, it is recommended to serve this grappa at a temperature between 18°C and 20°C in a balloon glass to allow the whisky influenced aromas to develop.

title: Bepi Tosolini Grappa Distillery Edition - Barrique Ex-Rum
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Bepi Tosolini Grappa Distillery Edition - Barrique Ex-Rum is an artisanal spirit from Italy, specifically produced in the northeastern region of Friuli Venezia Giulia. The distillery was founded in 1943 by Giuseppe 'Bepi' Tosolini, a visionary who transformed grappa from a rustic, rough spirit into a refined product for connoisseurs. Currently operational in Povoletto near Udine, the distillery remains a family owned enterprise led by the founder's grandchildren, Giuseppe, Bruno, and Lisa.

Spirit Description

This aged grappa is crafted from the fresh pomace of various noble Friulian grape varieties, distilled according to the 'Tosolini method' using traditional artisanal steam pot stills. The spirit is matured in American oak barriques that previously contained first quality Caribbean rum in the family's own cellars.

  • Colour: The spirit presents a soft amber hue accented by orange highlights.

  • Aroma: The bouquet is enveloping and soft, featuring fruity notes alongside sweet vanilla, honey, and candied fruit.

  • Palate: It offers a rich and velvety taste that plays with flavours of honey and vanilla, demonstrating a warmth imparted by the rum barrel seasoning.

  • Body: The distillate is characterized by a soft, smooth, and full bodied texture.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long and enveloping finish that reveals a rounded aftertaste of rum and sweet spice.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at 40%.

Accolades

Bepi Tosolini is recognized as one of Italy's premier grappa distillers, having received the 'Alambicco d'Oro' award for excellence in grappa production. This specific Distillery Edition is a rare release, with a limited production of only 2,001 bottles globally. The distillery's innovative approach, including the founder's early adoption of artisanal steam stills, has established it as a benchmark for quality in the international spirits market.

Food Pairing

The sweet, warm, and spicy characteristics derived from the rum cask finish make this grappa an ideal postprandial selection.

  • Savoury: It can be enjoyed as a digestif following a meal, particularly when paired with high quality coffee.

  • Sweet: The notes of vanilla and honey complement rich desserts such as chocolate cake, tropical fruit tarts, or traditional Italian pastries.

  • Chocolate: Bittersweet or dark chocolate provides a sophisticated contrast to the spirit's velvety sweetness.

  • Serving: For an optimal sensory experience, it is recommended to serve this grappa at a temperature between 18°C and 20°C in a large balloon glass to allow the complex aromas to develop.

title: Mom's Homemade Blood Orangecello - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Mom's Homemade Blood Orangecello is a super premium, small batch liqueur from the Netherlands. It is produced by Zuidam Distillers, an independent family distillery founded in 1975 by Fred van Zuidam in the town of Baarle-Nassau. The recipe was originally created by Helene van Zuidam, the mother of current master distillers Patrick and Gilbert, who initially made the liqueur in very small quantities solely for family and friends.

Description

This liqueur is crafted using carefully selected blood oranges that are hand peeled to ensure a perfect flavour without the bitterness of the pith. Helene's specific recipe introduces further complexity through the addition of fresh lemon, lime, and a subtle hint of bergamot.

  • Colour: The spirit possesses a vibrant and natural red-orange hue derived from the blood orange rinds.

  • Aroma: The nose is intensely aromatic and fresh, featuring a rich bouquet of zesty blood orange combined with bright notes of lime and floral bergamot.

  • Palate: It delivers a very smooth and soft mouthfeel with a harmonious balance of deep citrus sweetness and refreshing acidity.

  • Body: The liqueur is characterized by a supple, velvety, and well-rounded texture.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, clean, and refreshing citrus finish that lingers with notes of sweet orange and bergamot.

  • ABV: This expression is typically bottled at 30%.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and sophisticated citrus profile of Mom's Homemade Blood Orangecello make it a versatile partner for varied culinary experiences.

  • Savoury: It pairs exceptionally well with Mediterranean style salads featuring fennel and red onions, or seafood dishes such as grilled prawns and scallops where the citrus cuts through the richness.

  • Dessert: The liqueur is a perfect match for dark chocolate parfaits, almond based pastries, or citrus sorbets. It also complements creamy desserts like vanilla cheesecake or panna cotta.

  • Serving: It should always be served very, very cold, ideally kept in the freezer. It is traditionally enjoyed neat as a digestif but also serves as an excellent base for premium cocktails such as an 'Italian Margarita' or an 'Orange Gin Spritz'.

title: Charles Heidsieck Cuvee Champagne Charlie 2017
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This prestige cuvée originates from France, produced in the Champagne region by the historic Maison Charles Heidsieck. Founded in 1851 by Charles-Camille Heidsieck—the original 'Champagne Charlie'—the house is renowned for its deep, cathedral-like chalk cellars (crayères) that date back to the 3rd century. The 'Champagne Charlie' cuvée was first created in the 1970s as a tribute to the founder's audacious spirit, with only five historic vintages released between 1979 and 1985. After a 37-year hiatus, the house officially revived this legendary label in 2022 to celebrate the bicentennial of its founder's birth.

Wine Description

The modern rebirth of Champagne Charlie is a multi-vintage blend that emphasizes the 'Charles spirit' through a high proportion of mature reserve wines. The wine displays a luminous golden robe with an extremely fine and persistent mousse. The nose is opulent and complex, offering aromas of grapefruit, roasted pineapple, and fresh peach, layered with persistent pastry notes, vanilla blossom, and exotic spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied and structured, blending juvenile freshness with a mature silkiness and a 'dry fleshiness'. It is characterized by a long finish featuring nuances of candied citrus, liquorice, and bitter orange. The varietal composition for the most recent releases typically consists of approximately 52% to 66% Chardonnay and 34% to 48% Pinot Noir. The ABV is 12%, and while the house achieved B Corp Certification in 2022 for its sustainable practices, the wine is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The intense structure and aromatic depth of Champagne Charlie make it a versatile partner for high-end gastronomy. It pairs perfectly with rich seafood dishes, such as monkfish à la meunière or shellfish with brown butter sauce. Its mature silkiness also complements roasted poultry, duck charcuterie, or a flatiron steak served with pomme frites. For a refined pairing, consider serving it with creamy desserts featuring ginger or roasted strawberries.

title: Etter Apricot Fruit Brandy - 350 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Etter Apricot (Etter Aprikose) is a premium fruit brandy, specifically an eau de vie, from Switzerland. The Etter family has a long winemaking and distilling heritage in the Zug region, where Paul Etter founded the commercial distillery in 1870. Currently managed by the fourth generation, the distillery is recognized as one of Europe's most traditional yet modern specialty producers. While the company was synonymous only with cherry brandy (kirsch) until 1981, it has since expanded to include a high-quality range of fruit distillates, including this apricot expression.

Spirit Description

This fruit brandy is distilled from 100% Swiss fruit, specifically utilizing the highly aromatic Royal Luizet apricots from the Wallis region. Following distillation, the spirit is matured for several years in glass demijohns, a process essential for revealing its depth and richness before bottling.

  • Colour: The spirit is crystal clear and colorless, a hallmark of unaged fruit distillates.

  • Aroma: The nose features full-bodied, sun-kissed aromas that are described as both delightful and refreshing.

  • Palate: It offers a rich, smooth, and pleasant taste with a lovely texture that faithfully represents the aromatic profile of fresh apricots.

  • Body: The spirit is characterized by a sophisticated and well-integrated sweetness, maintaining a clean and robust fruit-forward body.

  • Finish: It concludes with an impressive, unique, and complex length.

  • ABV: This fruit brandy is typically bottled at 42% (84 proof). (Note: A lighter liqueur version also exists at 15% ABV).

Accolades

Etter's fruit brandies are highly regarded in international competitions, with the distillery frequently earning top honors for its craftsmanship.

  • Gold Medal: Awarded to Etter Apricot (42% vol.) at the DistiSuisse 2019/2020 competition.

  • Distiller of the Year: The Etter Söhne AG facility was named Distiller of the Year for 2023/2024 by DistiSuisse.

  • Quality Recognition: The brand is consistently praised for producing spirits 'by connoisseurs for connoisseurs'.

Food Pairing

The intense fruitiness and clean acidity of this apricot brandy make it a versatile partner for both sweet and savory dishes.

  • Savoury: It pairs harmoniously with cured meats such as prosciutto or salami and complements rich appetizers like foie gras.

  • Cheese: The brandy is an excellent match for creamy or tangy cheeses such as Brie, Camembert, and sharp cheddar.

  • Dessert: It enhances fruit-based desserts, particularly those featuring fresh apricots or jams, and pairs well with almond-based pastries like marzipan or almond cake.

  • Serving: Traditionally served as a digestif after a meal, it can also be enjoyed before dinner as an aperitif to stimulate the appetite. For the best expression of its fruit aromas, it should be served at room temperature in a tulip-shaped glass.

title: L'Arack De Musar - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

L'Arack de Musar is a premium artisanal spirit from Lebanon, produced by the world-renowned Chateau Musar winery in the Bekaa Valley. Founded in 1930 by Gaston Hochar in a 17th-century Mzar castle in Ghazir, the winery is globally recognized for its dedication to tradition and quality under the long-standing leadership of the Hochar family. This arack is a masterful expression of Lebanese heritage, crafted from grape alcohol with an average age of five years before undergoing a meticulous four-fold distillation process.

Spirit Description

This arack is distinguished by its purity and sophistication, achieved through four distillations—one more than the traditional three used for most Lebanese aracks. During the final distillation, fragrant local anise seeds are added to the grape spirit. Following distillation, the spirit is matured for one year in traditional terracotta amphorae, which facilitates the sedimentation of solid matter while enriching the liquid with unique liquorice notes.

  • Colour: In its pure state, the spirit is crystal clear; however, it displays a mesmerizing cloudy or milky white appearance when water is added.

  • Aroma: The nose is intense and clean, dominated by powerful aromas of star anise, fennel, and fresh liquorice strap, with subtle hints of crushed eucalyptus.

  • Palate: It reveals a silky, smooth, and surprisingly sweet texture despite being a dry spirit. Flavours are concentrated and juicy, featuring deep notes of aniseed and liquorice.

  • Body: The spirit is medium-bodied with a slightly glycerous, velvety mouthfeel.

  • Finish: It concludes with an exceptionally long, clean, and dry finish characterized by a lingering warmth and a persistent aftertaste of liquorice.

  • ABV: This spirit is bottled at a formidable 53%.

Food Pairing

As a traditional Lebanese spirit, L'Arack de Musar is a versatile companion for both appetizers and post-meal courses.

  • Savoury: It is the classic match for traditional Lebanese mezze, including hummus, baba ghannouj, tabbouleh, and grilled halloumi. Its herbal profile also pairs excellently with barbecued lamb skewers, grilled eggplant, and spicy goat cheese dips like shankleesh.

  • Dessert: The spirit can be used to flavour jellies or sorbets and complements fruit-based desserts.

  • Serving: While traditionally served by 'breaking' the arack—adding one-third arack to two-thirds water over ice—the extra distillation allows this particular version to be enjoyed neat as a smooth digestif.

title: Dillon's Orange Bitters - 100 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Dillon's Orange Bitters is an artisanal cocktail ingredient originating from Canada, specifically produced in Beamsville, Ontario, in the heart of the Niagara wine region. Founded in 2012 by Geoff Dillon, the distillery is known for its commitment to 'honest spirits', utilizing traditional copper pot stills and local ingredients whenever possible. The winemaking philosophy—or in this case, the distilling approach—focuses on small-batch production that highlights the region's natural bounty by using a base spirit derived from 100% locally grown Niagara grapes.

Wine Description

The Dillon's Orange Bitters presents an aromatic profile of fresh, juicy orange and lemon. The nose is complex and zesty, offering scents of sweet and bitter orange peel accented by floral verbena and exotic spices like black cardamom. On the palate, the bitters are vibrant and mid-sweet, delivering balanced flavours of citrus and juniper with smoky overtones and a subtle warmth from red peppercorns. It is characterized by its layered complexity and a clean, aromatic finish. This product is crafted from a blend of diverse orange varieties, gentian root, and other botanicals. The ABV is 50%. While the distillery sources the purest, often organic, ingredients from leading growers, this specific product is not certified organic. It is intended for immediate use and adds significant depth to a variety of spirits.

Food Pairing

The vibrant citrus and botanical notes of these bitters make them an essential and versatile addition to the bar and kitchen. They pair perfectly with rye-based drinks, gin, and vodka, and are considered a 'must-have' for completing a classic Old Fashioned or a White Negroni. In terms of broader pairings, the orange notes harmonise well with ingredients such as mezcal, dark chocolate, and ginger. They can also be used in culinary applications to brighten up vinaigrettes or to add a zesty, bitter complexity to fruit-based desserts.

title: Dillon's Ginger Bitters - 100 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Dillon's Ginger Bitters is a small batch artisanal product originating from Canada, specifically crafted in Beamsville, Ontario, within the Niagara wine region. Established in 2012, Dillon's Small Batch Distillers was founded by Geoff Dillon and his father, Dr. Peter Dillon, with a commitment to making 'honest spirits'. The distillery's philosophy focuses on utilizing copper pot stills and a bounty of local, seasonal ingredients sourced through close partnerships with Niagara farmers to ensure unparalleled quality.

Description

The Dillon's Ginger Bitters presents a pungent nose with bold notes of candied and fresh ginger. The aroma is layered with scents of lime zest and a whisper of smoke. On the palate, the bitters are highly spicy and bitter, delivering a powerful 'up-front' ginger kick balanced by a subtle background of fennel and cherry. It is characterized by its bright, fiery heat and a complex, textured profile. These bitters are crafted from a base of 100% local Niagara grapes, utilizing both fresh and dried local ginger along with other natural botanicals. The ABV is 50%. While the distillery emphasizes fresh, natural ingredients and responsible farming practices, the bitters are not certified organic. They are intended for immediate use and maintain their intensity for an extended period.

Food Pairing

The fiery and aromatic nature of these ginger bitters makes them exceptionally versatile for both beverages and culinary uses. They pair perfectly with brown spirits like brandy and rye whisky, serving as a key ingredient in an autumn Sidecar or a signature Sazerac. The bitters also complement gin-based drinks such as a Matcha Highball or a Gin Paloma. Beyond cocktails, they are a great addition to vegetable stir-frys and can add a spicy depth to various baking recipes.

title: SunnyCider Apple Cider 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This classic craft cider originates from Canada, specifically Calgary, Alberta. SunnyCider is Calgary's premier craft cidery, born out of a community project in the Sunnyside neighbourhood where co-founder Tim Kitchen began home-fermenting in 2010. The business was formalized in 2019 by Tim and Darlene Kitchen alongside Dennis Scanland, with a philosophy focused on community, waste prevention, and low-intervention production.

The 'Apple' is the cidery's flagship product, crafted from 100 per cent Canadian apples. It is made using a combination of urban apples harvested through a Calgary community donation program and fresh apple juice from the Okanagan. The cider presents as a straight, pure expression of the fruit with zero artificial flavours or preservatives. On the palate, it is dry, crisp, and incredibly refreshing, bursting with authentic apple flavour. Stylistically, it is a low-sugar beverage that follows a low-intervention winemaking approach, meaning the fermentation is gently guided without chemical additives or heavy filtering. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 5.1 per cent. All SunnyCider products are gluten-free and vegan.

title: Horizon De Bichot Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from France, produced from vineyards in the Limoux region of the South of France within the Languedoc Roussillon area. Founded in 1831 by Bernard Bichot, Maison Albert Bichot is a historic, family owned winery currently managed by sixth generation owner Albéric Bichot, who has led the estate since 1996. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a pioneering spirit, utilizing the diverse 'four climates' of the Limoux terroir—Mediterranean, Autan, Oceanic, and Upper Valley—to create an innovative alliance of fruit finesse and intensity.

Wine Description

The Horizon de Bichot Pinot Noir displays a deep cherry red colour. The nose is fragrant and clean, offering aromas of black fruit such as blackberry and blackcurrant combined with scents of wild cherry, raspberry, and earthy notes of fresh mushroom. On the palate, the wine is dry and medium bodied, delivering flavours of cherry that evolve into peppery and mentholated notes. It is characterized by its silky texture, fresh acidity, and a long finish that features a hint of cedar complementing its complex fruitiness. This 100% Pinot Noir typically features an ABV of 13% to 13.5%. While the domaine's own vineyard wines are certified organic, this specific négoce bottling is focused on sustainable vineyard management and is not certified organic.

title: Romain Duvernay Rasteau
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from France, specifically from the Rasteau subregion in the Southern Rhône Valley. Romain Duvernay is a talented oenologist who established his merchant business, NewRhône Millésimes, in Châteauneuf-du-Pape in 1998 alongside his father, Roland. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a deep respect for environmental traditions, focusing on 'reasoned viticulture' and working closely with local growers to select grapes at their optimal maturity. Previously a supplier to prestigious houses such as Guigal, Duvernay began producing wines under his own signature in 2010 to showcase the unique personality of the Rhône's premier appellations.

Wine Description

The Romain Duvernay Rasteau displays a bright and deep red colour. The nose is rich and expressive, offering scents of very ripe black fruits, such as blackberry and cassis, alongside harmonious notes of prune, vanilla, and pepper. On the palate, the wine is powerful, voluminous, and supple, delivering concentrated dark fruit flavours integrated with fine, tight tannins and a velvety texture. It is characterized by its significant body and a long, lingering finish that often reveals liquorice and spicy undertones. This varietal composition typically consists of 70% Grenache, 20% Syrah, and 10% Mourvèdre. The ABV is notably high, ranging from 15% to 15.5%. While not always certified organic, the producer increasingly prioritizes organic and High Environmental Value (HVE) labelled estates. The optimal drinking window is between 2023 and 2027, though it possesses an ageing potential of 10 to 15 years.

title: Pilsner Urquell 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Pilsner Urquell is brewed in Plzeň, Czech Republic, and is recognized as the world's first golden lager. The brewery was established in 1842 by the citizens of Pilsen, who hired Bavarian brewer Josef Groll to create a new, lighter style of bottom fermented beer. Today, the brewery is owned by Asahi Group Holdings and continues to be the only site where the beer is produced to ensure a consistent flavour globally.

Beer Description

This iconic pilsner presents a pale gold colour with a bright, clear appearance and a dense white foam head. The sensory profile features inviting aromas of sweet cereal malt, lemon zest, and spicy floral hops. On the palate, it delivers a perfectly balanced flavour of fresh bread and honey-like malt sweetness, offset by a 'velvety' and fragrant hop bitterness. The body is dry and medium-bodied with natural carbonation, leading to a crisp, clean, and refreshing finish. It is crafted using a traditional triple decoction process and is composed of 100% Czech ingredients: soft Plzeň water, sweet Moravian barley, and bitter Saaz hops. It has an ABV of 4.4%.

title: Corona Cero (Non Alcoholic) 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml: Introducing Corona Cero 0.0%. With 60 calories per 355ml can and 0.0% ABV, Cero provides 30% of your daily value of vitamin D, delivering a refreshing and crisp finish, and a clear and brilliant pale golden colour. Enjoy with a slice of lime.

title: Coors Light 341 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml: A classic light, sweet flavour, balanced with a clean hop finish.

title: Casamigos Blanco Tequila - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
Casamigos Blanco isn’t just tequila—it’s a party in a bottle crafted with a dash of celebrity stardom. Co-founded by George Clooney (yes, that George Clooney), this ultra-smooth tequila was born out of late-night laughs and a simple goal: to make a tequila so good, you’d never need salt or lime to mask it. Spoiler alert—they nailed it.

Made from 100% Blue Weber agaves grown in the Jalisco Highlands, this Blanco is fresh, crisp, and undeniably cool (just like its creator). It’s slow-cooked in brick ovens for 72 hours and fermented for twice as long as most tequilas, giving it a clean, velvety texture that’s all about quality.

Tasting Notes:

  • Nose: Fresh citrus, sweet agave, and a subtle herbal whisper.
  • Palate: Vibrant hints of grapefruit and vanilla, with a soft, smooth finish that practically whispers “pour another.”

Perfect for sipping neat, on the rocks, or jazzing up your margaritas, Casamigos Blanco proves that tequila doesn’t have to be loud to steal the show. And, hey, when George Clooney’s behind the bottle, you know it’s a class act. Cheers to living the Hollywood dream—one sip at a time!

title: Nestor Fileri White 2023
bodyHtml:
Discover the ancient spirit of the Peloponnese with Nestor Fileri White, a wine that brings a piece of Greek history to your glass. Produced in the sun-drenched vineyards of Trifylia, Messinia, just a stone's throw from the ancient Palace of King Nestor, this wine showcases the unique character of the Fileri grape.

Often considered the ancestor of the aromatic Moschofilero, Fileri is a revived indigenous variety that has found its perfect expression in the sandy-clay soils of Southern Greece. The result is a vibrant, dry white wine that balances aromatic intensity with elegant freshness.

In the glass, it pours a bright pale yellow. The nose is an inviting bouquet of white flowers, jasmine, and zesty citrus fruits. On the palate, it is crisp and well-structured, offering flavors of stone fruit and gooseberry, finishing with a refreshing minerality and a hint of fruit-driven sweetness. It is a perfect introduction to the modern renaissance of Greek winemaking.

title: Stiegl Goldbrau 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Stiegl Goldbräu originates from Salzburg, Austria, where it is brewed by the Stieglbrauerei zu Salzburg. Established in 1492, Stiegl is Austria's largest private brewery and has been owned by the Kiener family for more than 120 years. Often referred to as 'Salzburg's Liquid Gold', the brewery is known for its 'Slow Brewing' process, which emphasizes gentle maturation and the use of regional raw materials.

Beer Description

This traditional Austrian style Märzen presents a clear, deep golden-yellow colour with a dense, white foam head. The sensory profile features aromas of grainy malt and floral hops, with subtle notes of lemon, grass, and ripe fruit. On the palate, it is full-bodied and finely-malted, offering a honey-like sweetness that is well-balanced by a gentle, refreshing bitterness. The body is characterized by a creamy and silky mouthfeel, leading to an incredibly clean, crisp, and long malt finish. The brew is crafted with 100% Austrian ingredients, including pilsner malt from the Weinviertel region, hops from the Mühlviertel, and pure spring water from the Untersberg mountain. It typically has an ABV of 5%. While Stiegl operates its own organic farm for specialty grains, Goldbräu is not certified organic.

title: Sol Cerveza 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml: Sol Cerveza is a refreshing Mexican lager beer with 4.5% ABV. Brewed with quality malted barley and hop extract, every crisp and invigorating sip of this beer connects you to the positive energy of the sun.

title: Morgenster Cabernet Franc 2022
bodyHtml:
About the Estate:
Morgenster Estate has long been renowned for its mastery of Bordeaux varietals, and their Cabernet Franc is a testament to the exceptional terroir of the Helderberg in Stellenbosch. While this variety is often used merely as a blending partner, Morgenster allows it to take center stage, proving it has the structure, elegance, and complexity to stand alone.

Grown in the ancient, rocky soils of the Lourens River Valley, this wine benefits from the cooling ocean breezes of nearby False Bay. This maritime influence allows the grapes to ripen slowly, retaining their signature freshness and aromatic lift.

Tasting:
In the glass, it reveals a deep, inviting ruby hue. The nose is complex and layered, offering characteristic aromas of ripe dark berries and plums, interwoven with hints of graphite, pencil shavings, and a touch of cinnamon spice. On the palate, it is smooth and refined, with silky tannins and a lingering savory finish. It is a sophisticated expression of South African winemaking that drinks beautifully now but will reward patient cellaring.

title: Veuve Clicquot Brut - Puffy Bottle Holder
bodyHtml: Veuve Clicquot's Yellow Label Brut reflects the superb vineyards they own and the consistent nature of their House style. The predominance of Pinot Noir provides the structure that is so typically Clicquot, while a touch of Pinot Meunier rounds out the blend. Chardonnay adds the elegance and finesse essential in a perfectly balanced wine.

title: Tiraki Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
From New Zealand’s Marlborough region, Tiraki is rooted in the Southern Valleys on Longfield Farm, where the Hammond family has farmed for six generations. Established as a winery in 2020, Tiraki reflects the family’s Ngāi Tahu Māori heritage—‘Tiraki’ translates to ‘clearing of the sky’—and their commitment to sustainable viticulture and expressive wines.

Wine Description
This Sauvignon Blanc shines with a pale straw colour and green highlights. Aromas of passionfruit, guava, peach, grapefruit, and fresh herbs rise from the glass, accented by hints of lime and wild nettle. The palate is vibrant and textural, balancing tropical fruit intensity with crisp minerality and lively acidity. Medium-bodied and elegant, the finish is long and lingering, leaving a refreshing impression.

Food Pairing
Ideal with freshly shucked oysters, grilled white fish, shellfish, or vibrant salads. Soft cheeses such as goat’s cheese also complement its herbal edge. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Undone No. 5 'This is Not Italian Apero' (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Undone No. 5 'This is Not Italian Apero' is a non alcoholic bittersweet aperitif originating from Hamburg, Germany. The brand was founded in 2019 by professional cocktail experts with a mission to prove that high quality ingredients and passion, rather than alcohol content, define a great drink. The distillery uses a patented process to dealcoholize real Italian aperitifs, preserving the essence of traditional aperitivo culture.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic aperitif presents a smooth vermilion or deep orange red appearance. The aroma is characterized by bright citrus oils and herbal complexity, featuring scents of sweet orange zest and traditional Italian botanicals. On the palate, it delivers a refreshing and zesty profile of sweet orange and rhubarb, balanced by the herbal depth of gentian and a light sweetness. The body is light and crisp with a sophisticated botanical structure, leading to a clean finish with lingering notes of citrus and bitter herbs. It contains less than 0.3% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The bittersweet structure and refreshing acidity of this aperitif make it a versatile partner for a wide range of light fare. It pairs beautifully with classic antipasti, mixed olives, and Italian cheeses such as pecorino or ricotta crostini. For a more substantial pairing, it complements Mediterranean flavours including grilled seafood like prawns and scallops, or light pasta dishes such as ravioli with cod. It is also an excellent accompaniment to salty snacks and small fried appetizers like salt cod croquettes or Milanese meatballs.

Distinctive Features

Undone No. 5 is distinguished by being crafted from actual de-alcoholized Italian aperitif rather than simple botanical infusions, ensuring an authentic 'Aperol style' experience. It is a mindful choice for health conscious consumers as it is vegan, gluten free, and contains approximately 18.6 calories per 30 ml serving. The recipe uses natural ingredients including rhubarb roots, gentian shoots, and orange juice concentrate, with coloring derived from sweet potato and carrot. This spirit is specifically engineered to provide the necessary 'bite' and complexity required for professional grade alcohol free cocktails.

Serving Suggestions

To best enjoy its 'golden hour' elegance, this aperitif should be served well chilled over plenty of ice. It is the essential ingredient for an 'Italian Spritz UNDONE', made by mixing 1.5 oz of the spirit with 3 oz of non alcoholic sparkling wine and a splash of soda water in a wine glass. It can also be enjoyed as a simple long drink when paired with premium tonic water and garnished with a fresh orange slice. For optimal quality, it is recommended to store the bottle in a cool place away from sunlight and consume within two months of opening.

title: Undone No. 2 'This is Not Gin' London Dry Juniper (Non Alcoholic) - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Undone No. 2 'This is Not Gin' London Dry Juniper is a non alcoholic spirit alternative produced in Germany. The brand was founded with the mission to provide high quality alternatives for bar enthusiasts, utilizing a patented process where alcohol is removed from real gin distillate to retain characteristic aromas.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic spirit presents a clear and bright appearance, mimicking the look of a traditional London Dry Gin. The nose is greeted by the fragrance of freshly harvested juniper, complemented by crisp citrus tones and a subtle hint of cucumber peel. On the palate, it delivers a pronounced juniper essence and light herbal undertones, featuring vibrant flavours of lemon balm, subtle ginger warmth, and a touch of pepper. The body is crisp and clean with an authentic botanical complexity. It leads to a refreshing and long finish characterized by lingering citrus and botanical herbs. This product contains less than 0.3% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The bright acidity and botanical profile of this gin alternative make it a versatile companion for various light and fresh dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with fresh seafood, such as grilled prawns, oysters, and smoked salmon, where the citrus notes enhance the briny flavours. For a more casual pairing, it complements Mediterranean dishes, fresh herb salads, and light appetizers like soft brie or goat cheese. It also serves as a delightful partner for sushi, as the crisp juniper and ginger notes mimic the traditional accompaniment of pickled ginger.

Distinctive Features

Undone No. 2 is distinguished by its use of real London Dry gin as a base, which undergoes a specialized dealcoholization process to preserve the essential oils and botanical structure. It is a health conscious choice, being certified vegan, gluten free, and low in calories, containing approximately 2.4 to 3 calories per 30 ml serving. The recipe features natural ingredients including juniper distillate, herbs, and spice extracts. Unlike many simple botanical waters, it is designed to maintain the 'bite' and complexity required to stand up in mixed drinks.

Serving Suggestions

This spirit alternative is primarily intended for mixing in classic gin based cocktails at a 1:1 ratio. For a signature 'G&T UNDONE', mix 50 ml of Undone No. 2 with premium tonic water over ice and garnish with a grapefruit zest or a slice of lemon. It is also an essential component for a non alcoholic 'Negroni UNDONE' when combined with Undone No. 7 Not Orange Bitter and Undone No. 9 Not Red Vermouth. For a garden fresh option, it can be muddled with fresh basil or cucumber for a 'Basil Smash' or 'Cucumber Collins'.

title: Undone No. 1 'This is Not Rum' Jamaica Cane (Non Alcoholic) - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Undone No. 1 'This is Not Rum' Jamaica Cane is a non alcoholic dark rum alternative produced in Hamburg, Germany. Launched in 2019, the brand was founded by André and Mehmet with the goal of providing high quality alternatives for the global bar community. Unlike many non alcoholic spirits that are simple botanical blends, Undone begins with authentic fermented and aged Jamaican pot still rum before gently extracting the alcohol.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic spirit presents a rich dark mahogany or amber appearance, achieved through the use of caramel coloring to mimic aged dark rum. The aroma is intense, featuring the signature "funk" and ester notes of Jamaican distillates alongside tropical fruits and liquorice. On the palate, it delivers a complex profile of mango, papaya, and caramel, balanced by the light sweetness of sugar cane and a hint of vanilla. The body is smooth and full, leading to a finish with a subtle peppery spiciness and toasted oak notes. It contains 0.3% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The bold, tropical, and spicy character of this rum alternative makes it a natural partner for vibrant Caribbean and Asian cuisines. It pairs exceptionally well with jerk chicken, coconut based curries, and grilled pineapple, as its sweetness balances the heat of the spices. For casual social events like summer BBQs, it complements smoky grilled meats and spicy appetizers. It also serves as a sophisticated accompaniment to desserts featuring tropical fruits or rich chocolate.

Distinctive Features

Undone No. 1 is distinguished by its patented dealcoholization process, which preserves the complex esters and barrel aging characteristics of the original spirit. It is a health conscious choice, containing only 3.3 calories per 30ml and 0.7g of carbohydrates, making it both low calorie and keto friendly. The product is certified vegan and gluten free, and it is crafted using natural ingredients including maple syrup and fig extract to enhance its depth of flavour.

Serving Suggestions

While it can be sipped neat, this spirit is designed primarily for use in classic rum cocktails at a 1:1 ratio. For a signature serve, create a 'Jamaican Mule' by mixing 5cl of Undone No. 1 with spicy ginger beer and fresh lime juice. It is also highly effective in a 'Cuba Libre' with cola and lime, or in tropical tiki drinks like a 'Jungle Bird' or 'Mai Tai'. To maintain freshness, it is recommended to consume the product within two months of opening and store it in a cool place.

title: Undone No. 3 'This is Not Whiskey' American Malt (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Undone No. 3 'This is Not Whiskey' American Malt is a non alcoholic spirit alternative originating from Hamburg, Germany. The brand was founded to capture the spirit of a beverage in its essence rather than its alcohol, utilizing a process where original spirits are disassembled to extract the alcoholic content. This specific expression is crafted from a unique blend that combines the characteristics of American Bourbon and Irish Whisky.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic malt presents a dark mahogany liquid typical of aged spirits. The nose is characterized by toasted grain and vanilla aromas, along with scents of wood barrel, honey corn flakes, orange peel, and apple. On the palate, it delivers a full bodied flavour featuring bold oak, green apple, and toffee, balanced by a touch of smoke and sweetness. The body is rich and smooth, leading to a smoky finish that replicates the complexity of a fine whiskey. This product contains less than 0.3% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The smoky and oak forward profile of this spirit alternative makes it an ideal companion for rich and savoury dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with barbecued or smoked meats, grilled steak, and bacon wrapped appetizers, where the salt and fat harmonize with the woody barrel notes. For a lighter pairing, it complements grilled salmon with lemon herb butter or earthy roasted nuts like walnuts and herby almonds. It also serves as a sophisticated match for desserts, particularly warm apple crisp with vanilla ice cream or dark chocolate, which highlights the vanilla and toffee undertones of the spirit.

Distinctive Features

Undone No. 3 is distinguished by a patented vacuum dealcoholization system that preserves the natural aromas and flavours of single malt whiskey. It is a health conscious choice for a mindful lifestyle, containing only 2.7 to 3 calories per 30 ml serving and very low sugar content. The product is certified vegan and gluten free, and it uses natural ingredients such as maple syrup and caramel colour to achieve its authentic depth. Unlike many botanical blends, this spirit is designed to maintain the 'bite' and complexity required for professional cocktail building.

Serving Suggestions

While it can be enjoyed on the rocks for a simple serve, this spirit is primarily designed as a base for classic whiskey cocktails. For a sophisticated 'Manhattan UNDONE', it should be combined with Undone No. 9 vermouth over ice. It is also highly effective in an 'Old Fashioned' when muddled with orange and cherry, or mixed simply with ginger beer for a 'Whiskey Ginger'. For a refreshing long drink, mix it with cola or ginger ale and garnish with a lemon wedge. To ensure the best quality, store the bottle in a cool place and consume within several weeks of opening.

title: Prima Pave Sparkling Grand Cuvee (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Prima Pavé Sparkling Grand Cuvée is a non alcoholic white sparkling wine originating from Northern Italy. The brand was cofounded by Certified Specialists of Wine and hospitality entrepreneurs Dejou and Marco Marano, who partnered with a progressive Italian winemaker to develop a sophisticated alcohol free collection. Dejou conceived the idea for the brand while pregnant with her first child, seeking an alcohol free wine that offered the complexity and food friendly flavours of traditional fine wines.

Wine Description

This premium sparkling wine presents a bright appearance with a creamy texture and fine, persistent bubbles. The aroma features a refined bouquet of orange blossom, dried apricot, baked pear, and toasted hazelnut. On the palate, it delivers a complex profile of juicy orchard apples, lemon shortbread, and vanilla bean, complemented by a racy acidity. The body is elegant and well structured, leading to a bone dry and persistent finish characterized by notes of lemon verbena and bread crumbs. It contains 0.0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The structured acidity and dry finish of this Grand Cuvée make it an exceptional partner for rich and savoury dishes. It pairs beautifully with premium seafood such as grilled lobster, seared scallops, and oysters. For a more substantial pairing, it complements Peking duck, crispy pork belly, and truffled chicken. It also harmonizes well with creamy textures like truffle risotto or cacio e pepe, and works effectively alongside fresh Mediterranean options like tabbouleh.

Distinctive Features

Prima Pavé Sparkling Grand Cuvée is distinguished by its use of sustainably farmed grapes from the Friuli region, typically featuring a blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir or Pinot Grigio. The wine is crafted using a proprietary, low intervention reverse osmosis filtration process that removes alcohol while preserving the natural texture, mouthfeel, and complexity of the varietal. This multi medal winning sparkler is non GMO certified, vegan friendly, and gluten free, and contains no added sugar, artificial flavours, or colours.

Serving Suggestions

To enjoy the fine bubbles and elegant aromatics at their best, this wine should be served well chilled at a temperature between 6°C and 8°C. It is ideally poured into a tulip shaped flute, which helps to preserve the creamy mousse and concentrate the scents of pear and brioche. While it is a standout choice for toasts at milestone celebrations like weddings or baby showers, its dry and refreshing nature also makes it a refined treat for everyday moments or as a sophisticated gift.

title: Prima Pave Sparkling Blanc de Blancs (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Prima Pavé Sparkling Blanc de Blancs is a non alcoholic wine originating from the Tuscany region of Italy. The brand was cofounded by Certified Specialist of Wine Dejou Marano and her husband Marco Marano, who sought to create a sophisticated alcohol free experience that mirrors the complexity of traditional Italian sparkling wines.

Wine Description

This non alcoholic sparkling wine presents a brilliant straw yellow colour with a fine and persistent effervescence. The aromatic profile is elegant and fresh, featuring notes of white peach, green apple, and honeydew melon, with delicate floral hints of elderflower. On the palate, it delivers a crisp and balanced flavour with a lively acidity and a subtle minerality. The body is light and airy, leading to a clean, dry finish that maintains the structure of a premium Blanc de Blancs. It contains 0.0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The bright acidity and delicate fruit notes of this wine make it an ideal companion for a variety of light and refined dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with fresh seafood such as oysters, grilled sea bass, or sushi. For a more savoury pairing, it complements creamy vegetable risottos, truffle based pasta, or soft cheeses like brie and camembert. It also serves as a refreshing palate cleanser alongside light appetizers and garden salads.

Distinctive Features

Prima Pavé Sparkling Blanc de Blancs is distinguished by its 'terroir first' approach, utilizing a blend of classic Italian grape varieties including Glera, Pinot Grigio, and Sauvignon Blanc. The wine is crafted using a proprietary gentle dealcoholization process that occurs at low temperatures to preserve the natural aromas and complex character of the grapes. It is a health conscious choice as it is vegan friendly, gluten free, and contains no added sugar, flavours, or chemicals, with only 22 calories per serving.

Serving Suggestions

To enjoy its lively perlage and fresh fruit profile, this wine should be served well chilled at a temperature of 6°C to 8°C. It is best presented in a traditional tulip or flute glass to concentrate the floral aromas and maintain the fine bubbles. While it is a sophisticated choice as a standalone aperitif for any celebration, it can also be used as a premium base for alcohol free cocktails like a 'Virgin French 75' or a 'Peach Bellini'.

title: Clase Azul Dia De Los Muertos Musica (2024 Limited Edicion)
bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Tequila Día de Muertos Edición Limitada Música is a super premium limited edition spirit from Mexico, specifically the high altitude region of Jalisco. Released in late 2024, this bottling marks the fourth installment of the 'Nuestros Recuerdos' collection, a five year series of limited edition creations celebrating various facets of the Day of the Dead. The distillery, Clase Azul Mexico, was founded by CEO Arturo Lomelí and remains a privately held, Mexican owned luxury house.

Spirit Description

This aromatic añejo was crafted by Master Distiller Viridiana Tinoco, who aged the tequila for 26 months in American whiskey casks before finishing the blend in Scotch whisky casks.

  • Colour: The spirit presents an intense gold colour.

  • Aroma: A complex nose features a harmonious blend of honey, peat smoke, and nutmeg alongside dried plum, caramelised agave, oak, and vanilla.

  • Palate: The palate is smooth and full bodied with a melody of complexity including honey, butterscotch, toasted oak, cinnamon, vanilla, and dark chocolate.

  • Body: This tequila possesses a full and velvety body.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, soulfully lingering finish characterised by dried fruit sweetness, oak complexity, toasted vanilla, and a hint of smokiness.

  • ABV: This limited edition is bottled at 40%.

title: Noughty Sparkling Chardonnay (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml: Beautifully crafted organic, vegan, Halal alcohol-free sparkling Chardonnay that has taken the drinks industry by storm. Elegant pale colour with a crisp and ripe apple scent accompanied by a touch of sweetness.

title: Newblood Shiraz (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml: Made in Australia via Newblood’s unique triple distillation method of de-alcolisation, this Shiraz is bursting with flavour. Robust and full bodied, this red wine features all of the aroma, flavour, and mouthfeel of a traditional Shiraz with hints of oak, blood plum and dark chocolate, rich tannins and a velvety finish. It is also low in sugar with just 2.4g per 100mls and lower in calories than regular red wine with just 22KCal per 100mls.

title: Newblood Rose (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml: Australian-made, NEWBLOOD Non-Alcoholic Rose is a non alcoholic rose wine. It features aromas of rose petals, watermelon and sweet strawberry. Pale pink in colour, it is low in calories and vegan friendly.

title: Newblood Chardonnay (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml: Made in Australia via Newblood’s unique triple distillation method of de-alcolisation, this Chardonnay is bursting with flavour. With all of the aroma, flavour, and mouthfeel of a classic Australian buttery Chardonnay, this wine features hints of oak, citrus blossom and honeysuckle along with a crisp palate that’s fresh and balanced.

title: Samuel Smith Nut Brown Ale Beer 550 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This ale is from the United Kingdom, specifically Yorkshire, England. Samuel Smith Old Brewery is one of the oldest independent breweries in Britain, established in 1758. It is known for its traditional brewing methods, including using the original yeast strain since 1900 and brewing water from its own deep well. The brewery is one of the few in the world to still own and operate its own coopers, ensuring the perfect maintenance of its oak casks for maturation.

2. Beer Description

Samuel Smith's Nut Brown Ale pours a deep, lustrous copper-brown colour with ruby highlights. The aroma is rich and complex, offering distinct notes of hazelnut, almond, and cocoa, backed by a subtle earthy hop character. On the palate, the beer is smooth and well-balanced, delivering flavours of toasted nuts, caramel, and a gentle roasted malt sweetness. It has a medium body and a soft, velvety mouthfeel, which leads to a clean, nutty finish with a slight, balancing bitterness. This ale is styled as an authentic English Brown Ale, showcasing a masterful balance between malt complexity and traditional character. The ABV is typically 5.0%.

title: Adictivo Anejo Blue Label
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Adictivo Blue Label Añejo is a premium, 100% Blue Weber agave tequila from the country of Mexico, specifically the region of El Arenal in Jalisco. Distilled at El Castillo de Tequila (NOM 1560), this expression is part of a brand founded by Gildardo Partida, a third-generation tequilero. The Blue Label edition is a limited-release presentation of their aged spirit, distinguished by its striking blue ceramic decanter and gold lettering, designed for collectors and those seeking an elegant gift.

Spirit Description

This Añejo is characterized by its significant sweetness and smooth, oily texture, often described as a "whiskey drinker's tequila" due to its rich wood influence.

  • Production: Made from fully matured agave and aged for 24 months (two years) in French white oak barrels. It is sometimes described as a blend of tequilas aged in two different types of oak casks to achieve its specific profile.

  • Colour: Intense dark golden amber.

  • Aroma: A harmonious blend of toasted oak and sweet dried fruits like figs and dates, with secondary notes of caramel, vanilla candy, and maple sugar-infused honey.

  • Palate: Extremely silky and velvety. Sweet flavours of butterscotch and vanilla lead the way, followed by tropical fruits, honey, and a delicate touch of spice and roasted agave.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and lingering with a persistent sweet touch and gentle oak warmth.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

title: Pol Roger Cuvee Sir Winston Churchill 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Pol Roger Cuvée Sir Winston Churchill 2018 is a prestige sparkling wine from France, specifically originating from the renowned Champagne region. The house remains independently owned and operated by the descendants of Pol Roger, who established the winery in 1849 in the town of Épernay. This prestige cuvée was first released in 1975 to honour Sir Winston Churchill, who was a close friend of Odette Pol Roger and a devoted fan of the house's robust style. The winemaking philosophy for this cuvée focuses on robustness, maturity, and a full bodied character, traits that the great statesman sought in his personal champagne.

Wine Description

This prestige cuvée presents a radiant mid yellow gold colour with a fine, persistent stream of bubbles. The nose is intricate and well balanced, opening with aromas of white flowers, citrus, and white peach, followed by complex layers of gingerbread, acacia, and lightly toasted hazelnut. On the palate, the wine is sleek, structured, and expansive, delivering a rich core of candied fruit, blood orange, and brioche balanced by a vibrant mineral freshness and a creamy mousse. It is a Pinot Noir dominated blend, sourced exclusively from Grands Crus vineyards that were already under vine during Churchill's lifetime. The wine has an alcohol content of 12.5% ABV and was disgorged in June 2024 with a dosage of 7 g/L. It is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window extends from 2025 through 2048.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 97 points

  • James Suckling - 96 points

  • Vinous - 96 points

  • Jancis Robinson MW - 18/20 points

  • Wine Advocate - 94 points

Food Pairing

The vinous weight and structural grip of this champagne make it an exceptional partner for a wide variety of gastronomical dishes. It pairs brilliantly with fresh seafood such as oysters, grilled white fish, or lobster in a creamy butter sauce. Its full bodied character also complements savory main courses including roasted chicken with morels, tender lamb cutlets, or sweetbreads. For cheese courses, it is best suited to 18 month matured Parmigiano Reggiano, aged Comté, or truffled brie.

Vintage Quality

The 2018 vintage was a warm and generous year, characterized by a particularly hot and sunny summer that led to an early harvest starting in late August. Despite the heat, the fruit from Grand Cru chalky slopes retained high levels of acidity and low pH, resulting in a Churchill release that is noted for its surprising energy, vibrant freshness, and elegant, 'airy' structure.

title: Clase Azul Dia De Los Muertos Aromas (2023 Limited Edicion)
bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Día de Muertos "Aromas" Añejo is an ultra-premium, limited-edition tequila from the country of Mexico. Released in late 2023, it is the third installment in the five-year "Nuestros Recuerdos" series. This specific expression, crafted by Master Distiller Viridiana Tinoco, is a sensory tribute to the distinct fragrances of the Day of the Dead, particularly the cempasúchil (marigold) flowers and copal incense that guide souls back to the world of the living.

Spirit Description

This Añejo tequila is aged for 25 months, beginning its maturation in American whiskey casks before undergoing a unique finishing process.

  • Finishing: The blend is finished for several months in Casks of Martinique Rhum (Rhum Agricole), a rare choice that adds earthy and herbal complexity to the sweet agave base.

  • Colour: Amber with copper reflections.

  • Aroma: An aromatic bouquet featuring peach, pear, and raisin, followed by candied orange peel, toasted walnut, and floral notes reminiscent of marigolds.

  • Palate: Smooth and robust. It delivers flavours of seasoned oak, clove, and cacao, balanced by the herbal, grassy sweetness characteristic of the rhum agricole finish.

  • Finish: Long and elegant with lingering traces of spice and dried fruit.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

The Decanter

The 2023 edition is housed in a handcrafted ceramic decanter that serves as a canvas for Mexican artistry.

  • Design: The decanter is finished in a deep marigold-orange glaze, transitioning into a dark, charcoal-like base.

  • Ornamentation: The exterior features hand-painted illustrations of cempasúchil flowers. It is adorned with a 24-karat gold-plated medallion depicting a skeleton figure amidst a field of marigolds, handcrafted by artisans from the Milma workshop.

  • Exclusivity: Production was limited to only 3,500 decanters worldwide.

title: Clase Azul Dia De Los Muertos Recuerdos (2025 Limited Edicion)
bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Día de Muertos "Recuerdos" (Memories) Añejo is an ultra-premium, limited-edition tequila from Mexico. Released in late 2025, it serves as the fifth and final installment of the "Nuestros Recuerdos" series, a five-year collection dedicated to the traditions of the Day of the Dead. This expression, crafted by Master Distiller Viridiana Tinoco, is designed as a liquid tribute to cherished memories, specifically recalling the scents of traditional Mexican kitchens.

Spirit Description

The 2025 edition is a sophisticated blend of Añejo tequilas aged between 12 and 38 months. A unique aspect of its production involves a portion of the agave being cooked in traditional pit ovens to provide a resounding depth and a subtle hint of smoke.

  • Maturation: Aged exclusively in first-use American whiskey casks to impart rich, woody characteristics.

  • Colour: Deep amber.

  • Aroma: A complex bouquet featuring cooked Blue Weber agave, dark cherry, and orange peel, layered with warm oak, vanilla bean, spiced cinnamon, and toasted almond.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and velvety. Initial notes of sweet vanilla and butterscotch are balanced by dark sugar, hints of chocolate, and baking spices like nutmeg.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long and smooth, with lingering notes of sweet oak, rich caramel, and a sophisticated whisper of spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

The Decanter

True to the brand's heritage, the 2025 limited edition is housed in a handcrafted ceramic decanter that doubles as a work of art.

  • Design: The ivory-colored decanter features traditional ofrenda (altar) illustrations by Mexican artist Erika Rivera.

  • Ornamentation: It is adorned with a handcrafted 24-karat gold locket medallion that opens to reveal a piece of reflective obsidian, symbolizing the connection between the present and the past.

  • Exclusivity: Only a limited number of bottles were released globally, making it one of the most anticipated and coveted collectibles in the premium spirits market.

title: Rio Light Rose Flavoured Lychee Brandy 330 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Rio Light Rose Flavoured Lychee and Brandy is a refreshing beverage produced in China. The brand is part of the Rio Cocktail lineup, which has become a popular lifestyle product known for its vibrant and approachable profiles. Originally inspired by the colourful cocktail culture, the brand focuses on blending premium fruit juices with carefully selected spirits for a modern drinking experience.

Spirit Description

This sparkling drink presents a soft pink or clear appearance with delicate bubbles. The aroma is characterized by the fragrant merging of floral rose extract and the tropical scent of fresh lychee. On the palate, it delivers a refreshing and sweet experience, where premium lychee juice is balanced by the elegance of red rose. The body is light and smooth, leading to a clean finish that carries a characterful touch from the inclusion of brandy. This specific version contains 3% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The floral and fruity structure of this beverage makes it a versatile partner for light and fragrant dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with Mediterranean cuisine, where the fruit notes can balance grilled vegetables or herb crusted chicken. For a more exotic pairing, it complements spicy Asian dishes like Thai green curry or Vietnamese stir fried scallops, as the sweetness of the lychee helps to offset the heat. It also serves as a delightful accompaniment to fresh fruit based desserts, such as mango puff pastry or a vanilla berry salad.

Distinctive Features

Rio Light is distinguished by its unique blend of concentrated lychee juice and low temperature red rose extract. Unlike simple flavoured sodas, it incorporates a mix of vodka, grape wine, and brandy to provide a more complex and refined depth. The product is crafted with at least 3% original juice content and uses pure cane sugar for sweetness. It is designed as a 'tasty lifestyle' drink, offering a sophisticated alternative to traditional beers or high alcohol cocktails.

Serving Suggestions

To enjoy the fragrance of roses and lychee at its best, this drink should be served well chilled. It is recommended to pour it into a champagne glass or a tall glass filled with ice cubes. For an enhanced sensory experience, garnish with fresh lychees, edible rose buds, or a sprig of thyme. It can also be used as a base for a light spritzer by adding extra sparkling water or club soda for added fizz.

title: Lautus Rose (Non Alcoholic) 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introducing an exquisite alcohol-free Pinotage grapes Rose wine from Voor Paardeberg, a charming wine-growing area near Paarl in South Africa's Western Cape region.

Immerse yourself in the pure aromas of sweet redberry fruit and delicate floral notes, expertly crafted through the meticulous process of alcohol removal. Experience the elegance of this wine as its palate reveals a hint of sweetness, culminating in a refreshing finish enhanced by perfectly balanced acidity.

title: Henkell Sparkling Wine (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Henkell Sparkling Wine, specifically the Henkell Alcohol Free variety, originates from Wiesbaden, Germany. The winery was founded in 1832 by Adam Henkell and is currently owned by the Henkell Freixenet group, which is one of the leading sparkling wine producers in the world.

Description

This alcohol free sparkling wine presents a light yellow colour with green reflections and a fine, long lasting perlage. The aroma is fresh and fruity, featuring notes of pear, green apple, and peach, complemented by a subtle hint of vanilla. On the palate, it delivers a clean and crisp flavour profile with a well balanced sweetness and refreshing acidity. The body is light and elegant, leading to a smooth finish that maintains the character of a traditional Sekt. It contains 0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The vibrant effervescence and fruity structure of this sparkling wine make it a versatile partner for a variety of light dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with fresh seafood, shellfish, and light salads featuring citrus dressings. For a more substantial pairing, it complements spicy Asian cuisine and poultry dishes. It also serves as a delightful accompaniment to fruit based desserts or can be enjoyed alongside mild cheeses.

Distinctive Features

Henkell Alcohol Free is distinguished by its use of traditional winemaking techniques followed by a gentle vacuum distillation process to remove the alcohol while preserving the natural aromas. This process ensures that the wine retains its classic bouquet and lively character. The product is a mindful choice for health conscious consumers, as it contains significantly fewer calories than standard sparkling wine and is both vegan and gluten free.

Serving Suggestions

To enjoy this sparkling wine at its best, it should be served well chilled at a temperature between 6°C and 8°C. It is traditionally served in a flute glass to showcase the fine bubbles and concentrate the fruity aromas. Beyond being served on its own as a refined aperitif, it can also be used as a base for non alcoholic cocktails such as a 'Sparkling Berry Punch' or a 'Virgin Mimosa'.

title: Dr. Zenzen Pinot Grigio (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Dr Zenzen Pinot Grigio is a non alcoholic white wine produced in Germany. The house of Dr Zenzen has a historic legacy as wine growers dating back to 1636, representing a family tradition of more than 380 years. This 13th generation family owned company produces wine in the hills above the river Mosel, specifically in the picturesque village of Valwig.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic Pinot Grigio presents a straw yellow appearance and is medium bodied on the palate. The nose is fresh and crisp, featuring a bouquet of lemon and lime with distinct hints of peach and apricots. On the palate, it is well balanced and fruity, offering the characteristic flavours of citrus and stone fruit typical of the varietal. The finish is dry and refreshing, maintaining the finesse of a traditional white wine without the alcohol. This beverage contains 0.0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The fresh acidity and fruity structure of this wine make it a versatile partner for many different types of cuisine. It pairs particularly well with light proteins such as chicken and various types of seafood. For casual dining, it is an excellent accompaniment to pizza or spicy pasta dishes, as its crispness balances richer or more piquant flavours. It is also suitable as a general purpose white wine for virtually any social occasion.

Distinctive Features

Dr Zenzen Pinot Grigio is distinguished by its expert dealcoholization process, which aims to preserve the traditional characteristics of the Pinot Grigio grape. It is produced from grapes grown in the Rheinpfalz appellation of Germany, a region known for its high quality viticulture. This wine is a mindful choice for health conscious consumers as it is gluten free and contains significantly fewer calories than its alcoholic counterparts. The bottle is typically finished with a Stelvin closure to ensure the fresh fruit aromas are perfectly preserved.

Serving Suggestions

To enjoy the full range of its citrus and stone fruit notes, this wine should always be served chilled. It is best presented in a standard white wine glass, which helps to concentrate the delicate floral and fruit aromas. Given its refreshing and crisp nature, it serves as an ideal aperitif or a sophisticated alcohol free alternative for summer gatherings and brunch.

title: Dr. Zenzen Nullnummer Cabernet Sauvignon (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Dr Zenzen Nullnummer Cabernet Sauvignon is a non alcoholic red wine originating from Germany. The house of Dr Zenzen has been engaged in winemaking since 1636, representing a family tradition of more than 380 years in the Mosel wine region.

Spirit Description

This alcohol free wine presents a deep garnet red colour and is produced from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon grapes. The aroma is characterized by an expressive note of blackcurrant, which is reflected on the palate alongside a full bodied and round structure. It offers a soft and velvety texture, providing the flavour and finesse of a traditional red wine without the alcohol. This beverage contains 0.0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The robust profile of this non alcoholic Cabernet Sauvignon makes it a wonderful accompaniment to heartier dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with beef and game dishes, as well as pasta served with strong, savoury sauces. Additionally, it is an ideal match for spicy cheeses that can stand up to its rich fruit notes.

Distinctive Features

Dr Zenzen Nullnummer Cabernet Sauvignon is distinguished by its heritage, coming from the Rheinpfalz appellation which is known for producing high quality German wines. The wine is crafted to retain the traditional sensory qualities of the varietal while being gluten free and significantly lower in calories than standard alcoholic wines. It is bottled with a Stelvin closure to ensure the freshness of its blackcurrant fruit profile is preserved.

Serving Suggestions

To best enjoy its velvety texture and fruit forward notes, this red wine is best served chilled. It should ideally be served in a standard wine glass to allow the aromas to fully develop. This 0.0% ABV alternative is suitable for any social occasion, offering a sophisticated drinking experience for those choosing to avoid alcohol.

title: Dr. Zenzen Dornfelder Red (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Dr Zenzen Dornfelder Red is a non alcoholic wine that comes from Germany. The house of Dr Zenzen has a long family history as wine growers dating back to 1636, representing more than 380 years of tradition in the Mosel wine region.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic red wine presents a deep cherry hue with subtle violet tones. The aroma features an expressive bouquet of fresh pomegranate, red currants, and ripe cassis. On the palate, it is smooth and balanced, offering harmonic flavours of cherries and berries with a touch of vanilla and mild tannins. The body is beautifully light yet well rounded, leading to a velvety finish. It contains 0.0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The rich character and fruity notes of this Dornfelder make it a suitable partner for heartier dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with all types of game, dark meats, and pasta served with red sauces. For those with a sweet tooth, it is an ideal accompaniment to dark chocolate or chocolate cheesecake. It also complements savoury snacks such as cheese and biscuits.

Distinctive Features

This wine is produced from the Dornfelder grape, a variety often referred to as the 'Shooting Star' among German red wine grapes for its rapid rise in popularity. The wine is crafted using a gentle de alcoholization process to preserve the richness and complexity of the fruit. It is a mindful choice for health conscious consumers, as it is gluten free and contains only one third of the calories typically found in alcoholic wines.

Serving Suggestions

To enjoy the full sensory profile of the cherries and berries, this red wine is best served slightly chilled. It is bottled with a Stelvin closure to maintain its freshness and vibrant fruit character. This alcohol free alternative is perfect for occasions where you want the full bodied flavour of a German red wine without the alcohol.

title: Dr Zenzen Nullnummer Chardonnay (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Dr Zenzen Nullnummer Chardonnay is a non alcoholic white wine originating from the Rheinpfalz region of Germany. The house of Dr Zenzen has a long history as wine growers dating back to 1636, representing a family tradition of more than 380 years in German winemaking.

Spirit Description

This alcohol free Chardonnay presents a straw yellow appearance and is full bodied on the palate. The sensory profile features notes of yellow apple, gooseberry, melon, and banana, which are accompanied by a subtle hint of vanilla. It is characterized by its freshness and finesse, offering the flavour of a traditional white wine without the calories. This beverage contains 0.0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The structured and fruity profile of this non alcoholic wine makes it a versatile partner for various meals. It serves as a wonderful accompaniment to spicy dishes, which benefit from its fruit forward character. Additionally, it is well suited for creamy pasta sauces and dishes that feature bold lemon flavours. It can also be paired effectively with vegetarian cuisine or light appetisers.

Distinctive Features

Dr Zenzen Nullnummer Chardonnay is produced from 100% Chardonnay grapes and is both gluten free and vegan friendly. It is crafted using a dealcoholization process that utilizes rectified concentrated grape must and carbon dioxide to maintain its complexity. The wine is bottled with a Stelvin closure to preserve its freshness and primary fruit aromas.

Serving Suggestions

To experience the full range of its tropical fruit and vanilla notes, this wine is best served chilled. It should ideally be poured into a standard white wine glass to allow the aromas of apple and banana to develop. This alcohol free alternative is suitable for any occasion where a refined white wine experience is desired without the consumption of alcohol.

title: Domaine La Colombette Cabernet Sauvignon (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Black plum and marzipan aromas make for an intriguing nose. It’s generous, with a velvety texture, gentle tannins and refreshing acidity.
