Flavours of tart blackberries, cassis, liquorice and brambles abound. Each sip reveals fruit- forward dark black fruits graced with touches of rosemary, violets and thyme, culminating in a delightfully juicy finish.

title: Dhos Aperitivo Free (Non Alcoholic) - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Dhōs Bittersweet is a non alcoholic spirit alternative originating from Sheridan, Oregon, in the United States. It is handcrafted at Ransom Distillery, a pioneering craft spirits producer with over 25 years of heritage in artisanal techniques for whiskey and gin.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic aperitif presents a vibrant ruby hue and is inspired by the profile of classic Italian bitter liqueurs. The aroma is a complex symphony of exotic floral notes, including hibiscus and crushed field flowers, layered with baked oranges, watermelon, and kumquat. On the palate, it delivers a smooth and silky texture with the caramelized sweetness of brulée oranges and the earthy bitterness of rhubarb, cinchona, and gentian root. The body is rich and viscous, leading to a spiced finish marked by notes of burnt citrus oil, vanilla, and green herbs. It contains less than 0.5% alcohol by volume, which is considered a negligible amount.

Food Pairing

The herbal complexity and bitter orange notes of this spirit make it an excellent partner for a variety of savoury and fresh foods. It contrasts beautifully with salty or rich dishes such as pepperoni pizza, earthy mushroom flatbreads, or juicy beef burgers. For a lighter option, the rhubarb and citrus profile complements summer salads featuring leafy greens, goat cheese, and citrus based dressings. It also harmonizes well with tangy cheeses and crunchy nuts, which echo its subtle botanical depth.

Distinctive Features

Dhōs Bittersweet is distinguished by its production process, which involves blending steam distilled botanicals and extracted oils from scratch rather than removing alcohol from a finished spirit. This small batch, unfiltered approach ensures maximum flavour and aroma while remaining sugar free and containing only five calories per serving. The product is certified clean label, pesticide free, and is sweetened naturally with monk fruit and stevia.

Serving Suggestions

A popular way to enjoy this spirit is in a 'Bittersweet Spritz', made by mixing 50ml of the spirit with soda water over crushed ice and garnishing with a fresh orange slice. For a more complex 'Sunset Spritz', it can be combined with fresh orange juice and sparkling water in a wine glass. It also serves as a versatile base for non alcoholic versions of classic cocktails such as a 'Negroni', 'Americano', or a 'Bittersweet Paloma' made with grapefruit juice and lime.

title: Brochet Zero Sauvignon Blanc (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Brochet Zero Sauvignon Blanc originates from France, specifically within the renowned Loire Valley region. The wine is produced by Ampelidae, an organic estate founded in 1995 by Frédéric Brochet, a pioneering winemaker and researcher who modernised viticulture in the southern Loire subregion of Haut Poitou. The winery operates with a philosophy that combines state of the art innovation with a deep respect for the environment, maintaining strict organic farming specifications for all its vineyards.

Wine Description

This organic white wine presents a pale straw colour that highlights its fresh and clean character. The aroma is unmistakably Sauvignon Blanc, featuring vibrant notes of fresh citrus, white flowers, and herbaceous scents of grass and fresh cut straw, followed by tropical passionfruit and gooseberry. On the palate, it is light bodied and crisp, delivering bright flavours of lemon, peach, and grapefruit balanced by a subtle minerality. The finish is clean and brisk, leaving a refreshing citrus zest that lingers gently without excessive sweetness. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc varietal composition is masterfully dealcoholized at very low temperatures under vacuum to preserve its authentic aromatics and structure. It contains 0.0% ABV, is certified organic and vegan, and has a notably low sugar content of 1.8 g per 100 ml. The optimal drinking window is over the next 1 to 2 years, and it should be served well chilled at approximately 8°C.

title: BIBI Bitter Aperitivo Soda (Non Alcoholic) 237 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

BIBI Bitter Aperitivo Soda is a non-alcoholic sparkling beverage from Canada, specifically originating from Toronto, Ontario. Produced by 361 Degrees Inc., the brand was developed as a lighter, more refreshing take on classic Italian 'rosso-amaro' bitters. BIBI is crafted using high-quality botanical extracts and natural flavours sourced from an artisan flavour house in Italy with over 80 years of history, known for producing world-class chinotto sodas.

Wine Description

This sparkling soda presents a vibrant, classic red colour characteristic of traditional Italian aperitifs. The nose is complex and layered, featuring an aromatic infusion of blood orange, bittersweet herbs, spices, and selected roots. On the palate, it is medium-weight and light, offering a fresh, bright citrusy profile that is significantly less syrupy and sweet than typical bitters. The drink finds a fine balance between citrus zest, herbal bitterness, and the gentle sweetness of cane sugar, finishing with a crisp and refreshing dryness. It is made with carbonated water, cane sugar, quinine, and natural fruit extracts, and it contains no preservatives or artificial colours. This beverage has 0% ABV, is vegan-friendly and gluten-free, and contains 70 calories and 18 g of sugar per 237 ml can. It is not a certified organic product. While intended to be enjoyed fresh, it is best served well-chilled on its own with ice or used as a versatile cocktail mixer.

title: Benjamin Bridge Piquette Zero (Non Alcoholic) 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Benjamin Bridge Piquette Zero is a non-alcoholic wine-style spritzer from Canada, specifically originating from the Gaspereau Valley in Nova Scotia. Founded in 1999 by entrepreneurs Gerry McConnell and Dara Gordon, the winery began as a small boutique project along the south-facing slopes of the Bay of Fundy. Today, the family-led team—including second-generation leaders Ashley and Devon McConnell-Gordon—operates as a dedicated sparkling wine house and a certified B Corp. Their winemaking philosophy centers on capturing a unique sense of place, reflected in the Piquette Zero line as a craft alternative to industrially dealcoholized wines that often lose their natural character.

Wine Description

This lively alcohol-free beverage presents a golden sapphire colour with a blond hue in the glass. The nose is vibrant and zesty, offering an aromatic bouquet of key lime, blood orange peel, yuzu, bergamot, and lemon preserve. On the palate, it is bright and vivacious, channeling the essence of a citrus grove complemented by a balancing texture of tart cherries and delicate fruit bitterness. The body is light and refreshing, finishing with a crisp acidity and a subtle maritime saline breeze inspired by the winery's tidal ecosystem. It is crafted from a base of grape skins and must (60%), mineral water (39%), Citra hops, and sea salt. This beverage contains 0% ABV, is vegan-friendly and gluten-free, and contains 0 g of sugar and 50 calories per 250 ml serving. While the winery follows sustainable practices, this product is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is within 1 to 2 years of purchase to maintain its zesty freshness.

title: Ariel Chardonnay Premium (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Ariel Chardonnay, with its tropical fruit character and subtle oak from barrel aging, has a distinctive combination of buttery apple and butterscotch flavors, combined with a toasty French oak bouquet. This is a non-alcoholic wine that will continue to develop complexity as it ages.

Try it with spaghetti carbonara, mango mahi-mahi, sauteed scallops, crispy duck.

title: Ariel Cabernet Sauvignon Premium 2024 (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Ariel Cabernet Sauvignon Premium is a non alcoholic red wine from the United States, produced in California's Central Coast region. The winery was a pioneer in the American non alcoholic market, established under J. Lohr's sustainably farmed estate vineyards to provide high quality alternatives to traditional wines. Ariel employs a proprietary cold filtration and reverse osmosis process to remove alcohol while preserving the natural flavors and textures of the grapes.

Wine Description

This premium red wine presents a deep ruby or red hue with a full bodied structure that mimics traditional California Cabernet. The aroma is rich and inviting, offering scents of blackcurrants, cherries, blueberries, and chocolate, complemented by a hint of toasty oak and black pepper. On the palate, it delivers smooth, layered fruit flavors with a dry finish and soft tannins that provide a refined and clean texture. The 2021 vintage is a 100% Cabernet Sauvignon varietal composition that is matured in oak barrels prior to dealcoholization. It has an alcohol content of less than 0.5% ABV and contains approximately 52 calories per 240 ml (8 oz) serving. While the winery practices sustainable viticulture, this specific wine is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is generally within 1 to 2 years of the vintage to maintain its fresh fruit profile.

title: New Level Berserker Blonde - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Introduction

New Level Berserker Blonde is brewed by New Level Brewing in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. The establishment is a unique heavy metal themed brewery that fuses the worlds of punk rock and craft beer. It is known for its creative and bold flavour profiles, often serving its products in a cozy setting filled with games and music.

Beer Description

This American blonde ale is designed to be approachable for newcomers while remaining complex enough for craft beer enthusiasts. It pours a golden hue and delivers a clean sensory profile with notes of cereal grains and subtle hints of citrus. On the palate, the beer is crisp and refreshing, featuring a balanced malt character and gentle hop bitterness. The body is medium to full due to the addition of oats, which provide a smooth texture and extra sweetness, leading to a clean finish. The brew has an ABV of 5.5% and a low bitterness of 20 IBU.

title: Annex Waste Land - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Annex Waste Land is brewed by Annex Ale Project, which is located in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Founded in 2015 by Andrew Bullied and Erica O'Gorman, the brewery began with a centrally located taproom in the 'Barley Belt' east of Macleod Trail. The brewery is known for pushing the boundaries of craft beer and soda production, often launching experimental and seasonal brews that challenge traditional industry standards.

Beer Description

This American West Coast IPA presents a balanced sensory profile that blends tradition with modern innovation. The aroma is characterized by pine and floral notes, which are driven by a complex symphony of hops including Chinook, Simcoe, Galena, Citra, and Galaxy. On the palate, the beer features amplified flavours and a classic West Coast bitterness, supported by a layered malt base of Two Row, Crystal, Vienna, and Biscuit malts. The body is full and robust, finishing with the intensified characteristics of Spectrum Citra hops, which were used here for the first time in an Annex brew. The alcohol content is 6.4% ABV, and it is noted for having trace bitterness despite its hoppy profile. There is no information available to suggest this beer is organic.

Food Pairing

The classic bitterness and tropical fruit notes of this West Coast IPA make it an excellent partner for rich and savoury dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with hearty fare such as beef burgers or spicy grilled sausages, as the hop profile cuts through the fat and protein. For a more refined pairing, it can be served alongside sumac spiced seared scallops or sous-vide lamb sirloin, which benefit from the beer's citrus and pine undertones. Additionally, its crisp finish complements appetizers like house-made elk corn dogs or spicy snacks that echo the hop complexity.

title: Dos Equis Special Lager - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Dos Equis originates from Mexico and is brewed by the Cuauhtémoc Moctezuma Brewery, which is based in Monterrey, Mexico. This company is a subsidiary of the Dutch brewing giant Heineken International. While several other international brands are brewed under license in Canada by companies like Sleeman, Dos Equis is imported directly from Mexico for the Canadian market.

Beer Description

This traditional Mexican style lager is typically pale golden in colour and offers a crisp, refreshing sensory profile. The aroma features a subtle blend of malt and earth tones, while the palate delivers a clean, well balanced taste with a hint of biscuit like malt sweetness. It is characterized by a light body and a smooth, easy drinking finish with low bitterness, indicated by a 10 IBU rating. The varietal composition includes a blend of water, malted barley, hops, and adjuncts. It has an ABV of 4.5%. There is no information to suggest that this beer is organic.

Food Pairing

The light and crisp profile of this lager makes it an ideal partner for fresh and spicy flavours. It pairs exceptionally well with Mexican street food, such as shrimp tacos with lime or chicken fajitas, as the clean finish cuts through the richness of grilled meats. Its subtle malt sweetness also complements spicy Asian dishes and light seafood like ceviche. For casual snacks, it can be served alongside garden salads with citrus vinaigrettes or classic salty appetizers.

title: Campio Czech Amber Lager - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Campio Czech Amber Lager is brewed by Campio Brewing Co. in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Established in 2018, the brewery is part of the Bearhill family of brewpubs and operates out of a flagship location in Edmonton's downtown Ice District. The brewery aims to fuse the city's blue-collar heritage with an artistic flair, producing a diverse range of beers that reflect the local community.

Beer Description

This traditional Czech style lager, also known as Polotmavý Ležák or 'half-dark beer', presents a bright and crisp amber appearance. The sensory profile is led by a rich and complex malt aroma featuring prominent notes of toasty bread, caramel, and a subtle hint of chocolate. On the palate, it delivers deep toasted malt and biscuity flavours balanced by the distinctive floral, earthy, and woody notes of traditional Czech Saaz hops. The body is smooth and medium-full, offering a warm yet crushable mouthfeel that concludes with a gentle, clean bitterness. This brew is crafted with a complex grain bill and has an ABV of 4.7%. There is no information available to suggest this beer is organic.

Food Pairing

The malty complexity and balanced bitterness of this amber lager make it a versatile partner for a wide range of dishes. It pairs particularly well with spicy Asian cuisine, such as miso ramen, as the malt sweetness complements the savoury and spicy broth. Its toasty notes also make it a classic match for grilled meats, including beef burgers and steaks, or hearty Alberta-inspired fare like Detroit-style deep dish pizza. For a lighter pairing, consider serving it with roasted chicken or snacks like warm salted pretzels, which enhance the beer's bready character.

title: Heineken - 5 Litre Mini Keg
bodyHtml:
Wherever you go in the world, it’s always refreshing to see something you recognize. That green bottle, the red star, the smiling ‘e’… like an instant welcome from an old friend. The Original.

For over 150 years, a ceaseless commitment to purity and quality has made Heineken the most iconic beer brand in the world. When you see the red star on the green bottle, you know every ice-cold, crisp sip will deliver that richly satisfying flavor with subtle fruity notes. A tradition of taste that has lived on for over a century and a half thanks to the simplicity and quality of the ingredients and the meticulous attention to the brewing process.

title: Pilsner Urquell - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Pilsner Urquell is the world’s first golden lager and arguably the most influential beer in history. First brewed in 1842 in the city of Plzeň (Pilsen), Czech Republic, it is the original "Pilsner"—in fact, Urquell literally translates to "Original Source." Before its creation, most beers were dark and cloudy; Urquell introduced the world to clarity and golden brilliance. To this day, it remains the gold standard for the Bohemian (Czech) Pilsner style, still brewed using traditional methods and local ingredients that define the category.

Beer Description

Pilsner Urquell pours a deep, saturated gold (often described as "old gold") with a dense, wet, creamy white head that exhibits incredible persistence and leaves a thick "Brussels lace" on the glass.

Aroma: The nose is an iconic balance of sweet and spicy. It leads with a rich scent of toasted bread and honeyed malt, immediately followed by the aggressive, floral, and peppery aroma of Saaz hops. There is a very subtle hint of diacetyl (a buttery note), which is a traditional and intentional characteristic of Czech lagers.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a soft, round mouthfeel. It leads with a complex malty sweetness and notes of caramel, which is quickly cut by a sharp, assertive bitterness. The finish is long and refreshing, with the spicy hop character lingering alongside a clean, mineral dryness.

Profile: It sits at an ABV of 4.4% and a firm bitterness of 40 IBU, making it significantly more bitter and flavorful than most "international" pilsners.

Technical Notes: The beer’s unique character is a result of three specific factors:

  • Triple Decoction: A labor-intensive mashing process where portions of the mash are boiled and returned to the main tun, caramelizing the sugars and creating that deep golden color.

  • Soft Plzeň Water: The local water is extremely soft, which allows the high hop bitterness to feel smooth and rounded rather than harsh or metallic.

  • Saaz Hops: It is brewed exclusively with Saaz hops grown in nearby Žatec, providing the signature earthy, spicy complexity.

title: Establishment Brewing 'Afternoon Delight' Hazy Pale Ale - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Afternoon Delight is a standout core offering from Calgary’s The Establishment Brewing Company, a brewery renowned for its technical mastery of both Belgian-style wild ales and modern hop-forward styles. This Hazy Pale Ale (often categorized as a New England Pale Ale) is designed to be the ultimate sessionable "juice bomb." It captures all the lush, tropical aromatics of a heavy Hazy IPA but scales them down into a lighter, more approachable ABV. It is a beer that prioritizes "drinkability" and "softness" above all else, making it a perennial favorite in the Alberta craft scene.

Beer Description

Afternoon Delight pours an opaque, milky straw-yellow with a dense, mousse-like white head. Its appearance is reminiscent of fresh-pressed pineapple juice, typical of the "hazy" style.

Aroma: The nose is vibrant and incredibly fruit-forward. It leads with a massive hit of passion fruit, peach, and candied orange, followed by a subtle, creamy scent of vanilla and melon. There is no harsh pine or resinous scent; instead, it smells like a tropical fruit salad.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a remarkably soft, "pillowy" mouthfeel. It leads with flavors of ripe mango and citrus zest, backed by a gentle, bready malt sweetness. The bitterness is exceptionally low, providing just enough balance to keep the fruit flavors crisp without any lingering hop "burn."

Profile: It sits at a highly sessionable 5.4% ABV and a very low perceived bitterness, emphasizing flavor and aroma over "bite."

Technical Notes: The signature texture of Afternoon Delight is achieved through a heavy addition of flaked oats and wheat in the grain bill, which provides the proteins responsible for both the haze and the silky mouthfeel. It is heavily dry-hopped with modern varieties—typically a combination of Citra and Simcoe—to extract the tropical essential oils while keeping bitterness to a minimum. The brewery uses a specific "Expressive" yeast strain that works in tandem with the hops to produce those lush, fruity esters.

title: Ol' Beautiful Pegasus Pale Ale - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Pegasus Pale Ale is a standout core offering from Calgary’s Ol' Beautiful Brewing Co., located in the heart of Inglewood. While the brewery often experiments with unconventional ingredients (like their Okami Kasu), Pegasus represents their take on the modern American Pale Ale. It is designed to be the "workhorse" of their lineup a beer that bridges the gap between a light lager and a heavy IPA. It strikes a precise balance between a sturdy malt backbone and the vibrant, citrusy aromatics of Pacific Northwest hops, making it a favorite for those who want flavor without palate fatigue.

Beer Description

Pegasus pours a clear, glowing amber-gold with a thick, frothy white head and moderate carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is bright and "piney." It leads with a classic punch of grapefruit zest and resinous pine, followed by a sweet, foundational scent of caramelized malt and honey. There is a subtle floral quality that rounds out the hop profile, giving it a fresh, forest-like bouquet.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a smooth, balanced mouthfeel. It leads with a distinct toasted biscuit and caramel sweetness, which is immediately met by a firm, refreshing bitterness. The flavor profile is dominated by citrus peel and herbal spice, finishing dry with a clean, lingering hop "snap" that invites another sip.

Profile: It sits at a sturdy 5.4% ABV and a moderate bitterness of approx. 35–40 IBU, providing a classic Pale Ale structure.

Technical Notes: Pegasus is a showcase of traditional American hop varieties, likely utilizing a blend of Citra, Centennial, or Chinook to achieve its citrus-and-pine character. The "beautiful" balance is achieved through the use of Crystal malts, which provide the amber color and the residual sweetness necessary to stand up to the hop oils. It is fermented with a clean American ale yeast to ensure the ingredients remain the star of the show.

title: Grizzly Paw Rutting Elk - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Rutting Elk Red is one of the original flagship brews from Canmore’s Grizzly Paw Brewing Company. A staple of the Alberta craft scene since 1996, this beer is a classic Amber Ale (or Irish Red Ale style) that captures the transition from the light, crisp lagers of summer to the heavy stouts of winter. It is designed to be a "malt-forward" masterpiece, focusing on the rich, toasted flavors of the grain rather than the bitterness of the hops. Like the elk it’s named after, this beer is bold, sturdy, and a true icon of the Canadian Rockies.

Beer Description

Rutting Elk pours a beautiful, clear deep copper-to-ruby red with a frothy, off-white head that leaves excellent lacing on the glass.

Aroma: The nose is warm and comforting. It leads with dominant notes of toasted caramel and fresh-baked bread, followed by a subtle hint of roasted nuts and dried fruit (like raisins or plums). There is a very faint, earthy hop presence in the background that provides a grounding balance to the sweet malt.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a smooth, slightly "chewy" mouthfeel. It leads with a rich toasted malt sweetness and caramel toffee, followed by a soft, nutty middle. The bitterness is kept low to moderate, providing just enough structure to balance the malt without being sharp. The finish is clean and slightly dry, with a lingering warmth of roasted grain.

Profile: It sits at a balanced 5.0% ABV and a moderate bitterness of approx. 20 IBU, making it an approachable yet flavorful ale.

Technical Notes: The signature deep red color and caramel flavor come from a specific blend of Crystal and roasted malts. These specialty grains are kiln-dried to different levels to provide a complex sugar profile that doesn't fully ferment, leaving behind that signature body and sweetness. Like all Grizzly Paw beers, it is brewed with pure mountain water from the Canmore watershed, which helps maintain a soft, smooth profile.

title: Guinness Stout - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Guinness Draught is the global benchmark for the Irish Dry Stout and one of the most iconic beers in history. Since Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000-year lease on the St. James’s Gate Brewery in Dublin in 1759, it has become a symbol of Irish craftsmanship. It is a beer defined by technical brilliance: though it looks dark and "heavy," it is actually lower in calories and alcohol than many light lagers. It is famous for its "surge and settle" nitrogen pour, resulting in a velvet-like texture that is unique in the brewing world.

Beer Description

Guinness is famous for its "black" body which is actually a deep ruby red when held to the light and its thick, stable, ivory-colored head that remains until the very last sip.

Aroma: The nose is subtle, clean, and roasty. It leads with dominant notes of roasted barley, charred wood, and fresh coffee beans, followed by a faint, "tangy" lactic note from the house yeast. There is no hop aroma; the scent is entirely driven by the dark, kiln-dried grains.

Palate: On the tongue, it is surprisingly light-bodied with a silky, creamy mouthfeel (thanks to the nitrogen). It leads with a mild bitterness of bittersweet chocolate and espresso, balanced by a soft, grainy sweetness. The finish is remarkably dry and clean, with a slight "ashy" roastiness that refreshes the palate rather than coating it.

Profile: It sits at a sessionable 4.2% ABV and a moderate bitterness of 45 IBU, though the bitterness is perceived as "roasted" rather than "hoppy."

Technical Notes: The secret to Guinness is the use of roasted unmalted barley, which provides the dark color and the dry, coffee-like finish. The legendary creamy head is achieved through Nitrogenation. Unlike most beers that use CO2, Guinness uses a "beergas" mix (75% Nitrogen, 25% CO2). Because Nitrogen bubbles are much smaller and do not dissolve as easily, they create the famous "cascading" effect and a dense, mousse-like foam.

title: Alley Kat Scona Gold Kolsch - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Scona Gold is the legendary flagship Kölsch-style Ale from Edmonton’s Alley Kat Brewing Company. As one of the oldest craft breweries in Alberta (founded in 1995), Alley Kat created this beer as a tribute to the Strathcona neighborhood. It is one of the most decorated beers in Canadian history, having won multiple Gold medals at the Canadian Brewing Awards. It is designed to be the ultimate "crossover" beer offering the delicate complexity of an ale with the clean, refreshing finish of a lager.

Beer Description

Scona Gold pours a brilliant, crystal-clear deep gold with a frothy white head and fine, persistent carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is clean, subtle, and inviting. It leads with the scent of honeyed cereal grain and toasted biscuits, followed by a very faint, characteristic fruitiness think ripe pear or white grape which is a hallmark of the Kölsch yeast. There is a soft, herbal hop presence that keeps the bouquet balanced.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a smooth, "round" mouthfeel. It leads with a gentle malt sweetness, which is quickly met by a mild, flowery bitterness. The finish is remarkably crisp and "short," meaning it cleans up off the palate quickly, leaving a faint, pleasant graininess.

Profile: It sits at a highly sessionable 5.0% ABV and a low bitterness of 20 IBU, making it an exceptionally balanced "all-day" ale.

Technical Notes: Scona Gold is a hybrid style. It is fermented with a specific Kölsch ale yeast at cooler temperatures, then "lagered" (cold-conditioned) for several weeks. This process suppresses the heavy fruit notes of an ale while maintaining a soft, delicate ester profile. It is brewed using premium two-row malted barley and traditional German Noble hops, ensuring an authentic European character with an Alberta soul.

title: Glenfarclas Family Cask 2008 (Summer Release 2024)
bodyHtml:
The Glenfarclas Family Cask 2008 – Summer Release 2024 is a rare single-cask bottling from Glenfarclas distillery, nestled in Speyside and run by the Grant family since 1865. As part of the esteemed Family Cask series—launched in 2007—each vintage sees only one specially selected cask bottled at cask strength to honour the distillery’s heritage of exceptional sherry-matured single malt.

Spirit Description
Distilled in 2008 and bottled in summer 2024, this whisky spent approximately 16 years in a refill sherry-type cask (cask #2112), yielding a robust 57.7 per cent ABV. It reveals rich notes of caramel and pear drops, with layers of sherry character throughout.

Accolades
This expression has received high praise from enthusiasts, with an average score of around 88/100. Tasting impressions often describe it as a “sherry bomb” with prunes, raisins, cloves, and ginger on the palate, and caramel, coffee, and marzipan on the finish. Others note aromas of caramel, honey-glazed apples, and dried fruits, with a full-bodied, semi-dry palate showing white pepper, oak, dried herbs, and dry hay on a medium-long finish.

Pairing
This powerful sherry-influenced whisky suits rich or bold flavours. Ideal pairings include dark chocolate desserts, mature hard cheeses, or robust savoury dishes such as braised lamb or aged steak to mirror its spicy, sweet oak character and lingering finish.

Vintage Quality
The 2008 vintage provided concentrated distillate well-suited to long sherry cask maturation. Bottled over 16 years later, this release exemplifies Glenfarclas’ skill in developing depth, complexity, and elegant power from long-term cask ageing.

title: Glenfarclas Family Cask 2007 (Summer Release 2024)
bodyHtml:
This single malt originates from Scotland’s renowned Speyside region, specifically Glenfarclas distillery—still family‑owned and operated by the Grant family since 1865. Established in 1836, the distillery prides itself on its rich sherried style and deep reserves matured in traditional warehouses.

Whisky Description
Colour: deep amber. Aroma: richly inviting with dried fruits and marmalade. On the palate: layered complexity showcasing red currant, dried fig, cinnamon‑spiced shortbread, cherry liqueur, dark toffee, nutmeg, and cocoa—all balanced with youthful vibrancy. The body is full and robust, finishing with warming clove, orange zest, and oak lingering gracefully,

Food Pairing
Pairs exquisitely with rich desserts—think dark chocolate tart or warm plum crumble—or savory fare like aged blue cheese or spiced game terrine. These pairings gently underscore the dram’s complex spice and fruit notes, offering a perfect match to enhance the whisky’s depth and character.

title: Glenfarclas Family Cask 2006 (Summer Release 2024)
bodyHtml:
This single‑cask single malt originates from Scotland’s Speyside region, operated by the fifth‑generation Grant family, who have maintained an unbroken tradition of family ownership since 1865. The Glenfarclas distillery, founded in 1836, is renowned for its independence and its signature age‑worthy, sherry‑influenced whiskies.

Description
On the nose, expect fresh golden sultanas, blossom honey, orange zest, vanilla tablet, polished oak and a hint of cocoa dust. The palate delivers silky toffee‑apple, malted biscuit and ripe plum, with nuances of cinnamon‑spiked chocolate, roasted almond and candied citrus. The medium‑long finish is warming and subtly drying, with lingering sherry‑soaked fruitcake, soft oak tannin, and a final flourish of vanilla‑malt sweetness.

Food Pairing
Pair with a rich Christmas‑fruit cake to accentuate the cinnamon and dried‑fruit notes; or try crème brûlée, which complements the honey‑vanilla sweetness and polished oak. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Glenfarclas Family Cask 2004 (Summer Release 2024)
bodyHtml:
The Glenfarclas Family Cask 2004 (Summer Release 2024) comes from the Speyside region of Scotland, an area celebrated for producing refined, full-bodied single malts. Glenfarclas, family-owned since 1865, is recognised for its dedication to traditional whisky-making and for its exceptional sherry cask maturation. The Family Casks range offers single cask expressions chosen to capture the best of the distillery’s vintage stocks, with each bottling reflecting a unique facet of Glenfarclas’s heritage and craft.

Whisky Description
Deep amber in appearance, it opens with aromas of sultana cake, blossom honey, and orange marmalade, layered over beeswax-polished oak, toasted walnut, and a touch of espresso crema. The palate is rich and full-bodied, revealing silky toffee apple, treacle pudding, and sweet malt, before unfolding into clove-spiked chocolate, roasted hazelnut, and candied citrus peel. The finish is long and gently drying, leaving impressions of sherry-soaked fruitcake, warming oak spice, and vanilla-malt sweetness.

Food Pairing
This whisky’s depth and complexity shine when paired with indulgent, flavour-driven dishes. Dark chocolate truffles or flourless chocolate cake enhance its cocoa and nutty tones, while mature cheddar or aged Gouda echo its malty depth. Savoury pairings such as roast venison with redcurrant reduction or duck breast glazed in orange elevate its fruit and spice notes. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Vite Colte Barbera d'Asti 2023
bodyHtml:
Vite Colte is a distinguished producer located in the Piedmont region of Italy, specifically based in Barolo. The winery operates as a collaborative project, bringing together hundreds of local winegrowers who focus on low yields and meticulous vineyard management to produce high-quality wines. Their philosophy balances traditional winemaking techniques with a spirit of renewal, ensuring each bottle expresses the authentic character and heritage of the Piedmontese terroir.

Wine Description

This Barbera presents a deep ruby red colour that often shades toward purple. The bouquet is opulent and complex, offering fragrant aromas of violet, cherry, and raspberry alongside deeper notes of liquorice and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is dry and full-bodied, featuring a silky texture and a concentrated profile of dark berries, forest fruits, and a hint of coffee. It is characterized by a vibrant, well-integrated acidity that provides freshness and balance, leading into a long, persistent finish with fine-grained tannins and delicate spicy notes.

Food Pairing

This Barbera is an excellent companion to rich pasta dishes such as lasagna or ravioli, and it pairs exceptionally well with roasted meats like beef or lamb chops. Its bright acidity also makes it a classic match for tomato-based sauces and aged cheeses like Fontina.

title: Fantini Trebbiano d'Abruzzo 2024
bodyHtml:
Fantini Trebbiano d'Abruzzo is a bright white wine from the Abruzzo region of Italy. The Fantini group was established in 1994 by Valentino Sciotti with the goal of creating high quality wines from this area, a mission that proved so successful the group eventually expanded across southern Italy. Based in the northern part of Abruzzo around the town of Ortona, the winery focuses on combining ripeness and freshness by utilizing vineyards situated 230 metres above sea level on calcareous clay soils.

Wine Description

This wine displays a bright straw yellow colour and is characterized by its fresh and vivacious nature. The nose is quite intense and persistent, offering a bouquet of yellow fruits such as peach and medlar, alongside floral notes of white flowers and orange blossom. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied with a zesty, mouthwatering acidity and a crisp, flavoursome profile that includes overtones of citrus, green apple, and a subtle hint of almonds. The finish is delicate, clean, and persistent. Crafted from 100% Trebbiano grapes, the wine is fermented in stainless steel tanks at 12°C for 20 days to preserve the primary fruit character. It has an alcohol content ranging from 11.5% to 12.5% ABV depending on the specific bottling and is best enjoyed young, within a drinking window of up to 2 years.

title: Anciano Cava Brut
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Anciano Cava Brut is a traditional sparkling wine from Spain, produced in the Cava Denominación de Origen (DO) within the hills of Catalonia. The wine is crafted by Covides, one of the region's top bodegas, which manages over 3,000 hectares of vineyards to ensure a consistent supply of high quality grapes. Drawing on centuries of Spanish winemaking history, the estate employs the traditional 'méthode champenoise' to create a stylish and affordable alternative to premium sparkling brands.

Wine Description

This Cava presents a pale yellow colour characterized by fine and persistent bubbles. The nose is notably fruity, featuring clear hints of fresh apples. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and displays a satisfying balance between sweet fruit flavours and vibrant acidity. It is composed of a traditional blend of 45% Xarel-lo, 35% Macabeo, and 20% Parellada. The wine has an alcohol content of 11.5% ABV and is typically enjoyed over an optimal drinking window of 1–3 years to maintain its freshness. While the estate manages its land with respect and sustainability, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

Accolades

  • Decanter - 91 points

  • Decanter - 90 points

title: Wakefield Jaraman Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Wine Description 

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon.

  • Color: Deep ruby red colour to the centre with a youthful purple hue to the edges (at release).

  • Aroma: Lifted aromas of dark blackcurrant fruit, subtle choc-mint, and a hint of eucalyptus. Notes of red cherry, black currant, dark chocolate, and well-integrated oak spice are also present.

  • Palate: A rich, full-bodied wine with intense cassis and blackberry fruit flavours. It also presents notes of dark plum, mocha, menthol, and cedar. The palate is often described as lively or bright with dark fruit, minty cassis, currant, and earthy notes.

  • Body and Finish: Full-bodied and rich. The wine is structured, well balanced, and the tannins are typically fine, firm, or well-integrated. It has a persistent, long finish.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is often noted for its balance, structure, complexity, and approachability.

Food Pairing 

Suggested pairings include hearty dishes such as:

  • Truffle Aioli Beef Burgers.

  • Herb-crusted lamb chops.

  • Grilled meats, like marinated, grilled flank steak or T-bone steaks.

  • Beef enchiladas, barbecued ribs in sauce, or hamburger.

  • A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Chateau de Fuisse Macon Villages 2024
bodyHtml:
Château de Fuissé, an emblematic estate in Burgundy, has a long history dating back to the mid-15th century. The Vincent family has owned the domain since 1862, with Antoine Vincent currently representing the fifth generation of the family to manage the property. The estate owns around 40 hectares of vines, which are spread over more than 100 plots, and they are renowned for their expertise with the Chardonnay grape.

Wine Description

It presents a pale straw or bright gold colour with possible green reflections. The aroma is bright and inviting, offering notes of white peach, ripe pear, and citrus zest, complemented by delicate floral notes and a hint of crushed stone or chalk. The palate is crisp and lively, delivering flavours of green apple, lemon curd, and honeysuckle. The wine is medium bodied, with a lovely, juicy texture.

Food Pairing

Pairs effortlessly with grilled seafood, white fish, roast chicken, or fresh salads with citrus vinaigrette. Its vibrant acidity and mineral backbone also complement soft cheeses like goat cheese or comté.

title: Terra Vega Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Terra Vega Sauvignon Blanc is a crisp and refreshing white wine from the country of Chile, primarily sourced from the high-quality vineyards of the Central Valley (Valle Central). Produced by the family-owned winery Viña Luis Felipe Edwards, the Terra Vega label is born from a fusion of Chilean viticultural heritage and state-of-the-art winemaking technology. The wine is notable for being certified Vegan and Kosher (including Mevushal and Kosher for Passover), making it a versatile choice for a wide range of dietary requirements and cultural celebrations.

title: Suntory -196 Vodka Soda Variety Pack 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: Suntory -196 (minus one-ninety-six) Vodka Soda is a premium ready-to-drink (RTD) canned cocktail, produced by the world-renowned House of Suntory. The name refers to the brand's signature "Freeze Crush Technology," a unique production method where whole fruits are flash-frozen in liquid nitrogen at -196°C. The frozen fruit is then pulverized into a fine powder and infused into high-quality vodka, capturing the intense, true-to-life essence of the entire fruit, including the peel. The variety pack offers a convenient way to sample the brand's most popular citrus-forward expressions.

title: Fernie Brewing Project 9 - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Project 9 Pils is brewed by Fernie Brewing Company, located in Fernie, British Columbia, Canada. The brewery was started by a local family in 2003 under their garage roof before moving to a dedicated facility in 2007. This multi-award-winning flagship brew is named after one of Fernie's most famous mountain bike trails.

Beer Description

This true Bavarian pilsner is clean and crisp, presenting a transcendent quality achieved through time-honoured brewing methods. The sensory profile is defined by an exceptional continental hop flavour and aroma derived from fine noble hops, including the Saaz variety. On the palate, it offers a smooth and refreshing experience with a balanced hop character. The body is supported by a grain bill of Munich, Pilsner, and pale western Canadian malts. This beer has an ABV of 5% and a bitterness of 35 IBU. There is no information to suggest that this beer is organic.

Food Pairing

The crisp nature and noble hop profile of this pilsner make it a versatile companion for various meals. It pairs exceptionally well with classic pub fare such as chicken wings or a hearty burger, where the carbonation cleanses the palate. Its refreshing quality also complements lighter summer salads and a selection of mild cheeses. Additionally, the balanced bitterness of the Saaz hops makes it a suitable partner for spicy foods, helping to temper the heat.

title: Denizot Pouilly Fume 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in France, this elegant white wine hails from the Pouilly Fumé appellation in the Upper Loire Valley. Domaine Denizot is a historic family estate led by sixth generation winemakers Thibauld and Jennifer Denizot, who recently took over from Thibauld's parents, Thomas and Marie. The winery is located in Verdigny, and the family is currently transitioning their 18.5 hectares of vines to organic and biodynamic farming. Their winemaking philosophy emphasizes minimal intervention and a 'micro-cru' approach to express the exceptional diversity of their limestone and flint terroirs.

Wine Description

This 100% Sauvignon Blanc presents a limpid, pale lemon yellow colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is finely etched, leading with delicate scents of white flowers, elderflower, green apple, and white peach. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and precise, offering a supple texture with vibrant layers of pink grapefruit, lime zest, and gooseberry. It is defined by its incisive structure and a deep minerality reminiscent of crushed flint and wet stone. The finish is dry, tense, and lingering, leaving a gentle saline and smoky trail. While refreshing upon release, this wine has the depth to be enjoyed through 2028.

title: Mezzacorona Dinotte Red Blend Dolomiti 2022
bodyHtml:
Mezzacorona, a major wine cooperative, was initially established by 13 members in 1904 as the 'Cantina Sociale di Mezzocorona'. Over the centuries, generations of families have dedicated themselves to sustainable grape cultivation, preserving the territory's integrity. Based at the foot of the Italian Dolomites, the winery manages approximately 2,600 hectares of Trentino vines, selecting optimal sites for the various grape varieties they grow.

Wine Description

The Dinotte Red Blend is a harmonious fusion of indigenous Teroldego and Marzemino grapes, balanced by the international varietal Merlot. The Teroldego provides a full-bodied structure with profound flavours of 'red currants, blackberry, and blueberry'. The Marzemino contributes a pleasant, 'juicy character' that results in a 'soft, velvety, palate pleasing wine'. Finally, Merlot rounds out the blend with aromatic notes of 'vanilla and cocoa'. This wine is described as 'fruit-forward and supple on the entry,' offering a silky texture, ripe tannins, and well-integrated acidity that contribute to a harmonious and rounded profile.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for this red blend include hearty appetizers, baked pastas, savoury sauces, and spicy cuisine.

title: Laurent Miquel Solas Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
The Miquel family are eighth-generation winemakers who have tended their vineyards in the heart of the Languedoc for many centuries. Laurent Miquel, who returned to the family domaine in 1996, focuses entirely on quality, believing it 'starts and ends in the vineyard'. The winery's philosophy respects the past while constantly seeking better, more natural, and sustainable ways to produce their wines, achieving comprehensive HVE Level 3 certification for their estates.

Wine Description

This is a single Pinot Noir varietal wine. It presents a bright and juicy sensory profile. On the nose and palate, you can find abundant red fruit notes, especially strawberry and cherry. Additional nuances include fresh mushroom and wild herb flavours, along with a touch of spice on the finish. The Solas line, named for the Irish word for 'light' (a reference to Laurent Miquel's Irish wife, Neasa) and the exceptional Mediterranean sunlight, aims for a wine that is distinct but carries a 'lightness in every drop'.

Food Pairing

This light and vegan-friendly Pinot Noir is an ideal match for light meats and light cheeses. Suggested pairings include roasted goose breasts on a red currant coulis, traditional charcuterie, or Bouillabaisse.

title: Cantina Marilina Sketta Grecanico 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This distinctive white wine hails from Italy, specifically the island of Sicily, in the southeastern province of Siracusa, near the town of Pachino. Cantina Marilina was established in 2007 by Angelo Paternò, a long-time Sicilian winemaking veteran, who purchased 60 hectares of vineyards. The winery is now managed by his daughters, Marilina and Federica, who champion a minimal interventionist and organic winemaking philosophy with absolute respect for the earth.

Wine Description

  • Color The wine presents a wonderfully bright, golden yellow hue.

  • Aroma On the nose, one finds notes of lemon and acacia. Earlier vintages also featured aromas of green apple, fresh citrus, and a hint of peach.

  • Palate This is a balanced and complex white wine, which starts wonderfully dry and crisp on the palate. Notes of bitter almond are apparent, along with a smooth, textural richness. The wine is a pure varietal, made from 100% Grecanico grapes.

  • Body and Finish The wine is subtly full-bodied, with a fleshy texture and a persistent finish, featuring saline nuances in some vintages.

  • Stylistic Notes Vinification in concrete tanks and a brief period of skin contact (maceration) helps develop this wine's aromatic complexity and lovely texture.

title: Fontodi Filetta Di Lamole 2022
bodyHtml:
Produced in the heart of Italy, this wine hails from the Chianti Classico region of Tuscany, specifically the high-altitude subregion of Lamole. The Fontodi estate has been owned by the Manetti family since 1968, though their local history as terracotta tile artisans stretches back centuries. Winemaker Giovanni Manetti restored the Filetta vineyard to produce a wine that reflects the distinct, cooler terroir of Lamole, which is home to some of the oldest Sangiovese vines in the region.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese displays a vibrant ruby red colour with a clarity reminiscent of Pinot Noir. The aromatic profile is highly perfumed and lacy, featuring notes of plum, wild cherry, and blackberry intertwined with white pepper, sage, and dried rose petals. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and elegant, offering a silky texture with refined, grainy tannins and a lively acidity. The finish is vibrant and tense, showing notable concentration and a lingering hint of mineral-rich graphite.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points

  • Vinous - 93 points

  • James Suckling - 93 points

Food Pairing

Pair with a classic Tuscan Bistecca Fiorentina, pasta with wild boar ragu or savory duck sausage, or aged cheeses such as Parmigiano Reggiano or Pecorino Toscano.

title: Ruffino Chianti Classico Riserva Ducale 2022
bodyHtml:
Ruffino Chianti Classico Riserva Ducale originates from Italy, specifically from the Tuscany region and the Chianti Classico subregion. Founded in 1877 in Pontassieve, Ruffino became a pioneer in exporting Tuscan wines and was appointed the official supplier to the Italian royal family in 1890. The 'Riserva Ducale' name, first released in 1927, honors the Duke of Aosta, who was so impressed by the wines that he granted the estate his royal patronage. The winery's philosophy combines historical knowledge with technical precision, focusing on sustainability through biodiversity and responsible vineyard management.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep ruby red colour with garnet reflections and a medium-to-full body. The sensory profile is elegant and aromatic, featuring a bouquet of ripe cherries, plums, and wild berries, complemented by floral notes of violet and red roses. On the palate, it is balanced and refined, delivering flavours of red berries, savory spices, and tobacco, underpinned by a toasty character with hints of cardamom and cloves. The finish is long and persistent, characterized by fresh acidity, fine-grained tannins, and a pleasant mineral aftertaste with notes of rosemary.

  • Varietal Composition: Predominantly Sangiovese, often blended with small proportions of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is aged in oak barrels to develop its classic structure and tightly woven balance between fruit and spice.

  • ABV: Typically 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While Ruffino prioritizes sustainability and biodiversity, this specific wine is generally not certified organic.

title: Krug Blanc de Noir 'Clos d'Ambonnay' 2006
bodyHtml:
Krug Blanc de Noir 'Clos d'Ambonnay' 2006 originates from France, within the prestigious Champagne region and the historic Ambonnay Grand Cru subregion. The house of Krug was founded in 1843 by Joseph Krug, a visionary who sought to craft the ultimate Champagne every year regardless of seasonal climate variations. The winemaking philosophy behind this ultra-prestige 'tête de cuvée' focuses on showcasing the absolute purity of a single, walled 0.68-hectare monopoly vineyard plot in the heart of Ambonnay. This release represents only the sixth vintage edition ever produced from this legendary vineyard since its inaugural 1995 harvest.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine presents a deep, luminous golden colour with shimmering copper highlights in the glass and possesses a heavy, full-bodied structure with a voluminous, muscular, and exceptionally precise texture. The sensory profile is incredibly concentrated, expressive, and complex, opening with an intense nose of candied apple, baked plum tart, and spices, woven with aromas of dates, bitter orange, smoke, and roasted hazelnuts. On the opulent and vinous palate, it delivers deep flavours of black cherry, salted caramel, and citrus peel, beautifully integrated with notes of toasted almonds, praline, and a sophisticated touch of gastronomic bitterness. The finish is remarkably long, structured, and saline, leaving a lingering trail of redcurrant acidity and smoky minerality.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its verticality, power, and graceful balance, displaying a harmonious interplay of solar warmth and a crisp, mineral-driven backbone. To achieve its spectacular refinement, the wine spent more than 15 years ageing on its lees in the deep chalk cellars of Krug before a highly limited disgorgement. Only 4,514 individually numbered bottles were produced, representing an exceptional rarity for collectors.

  • ABV: 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate meticulously manages its single plot with dedicated hand labour to capture the pure expression of the terroir, this commercial release is not certified organic.

title: Billecart Salmon Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
The Brut Rosé is a fresh and elegant Rosé Champagne, blend of Chardonnay, Pinot Meunier and Pinot Noir vinified as red wine. Radiant colour with graceful effervescence, a persistent mousse and fine bubbles rising slowly in the glass. Subtle and fine aromas leading to an expressive red berry flavour with citrus zest. Creamy and smooth on the palate, evolving to strawberries notes and a raspberry finish. Light, balanced and precise. The best pairing to any happy occasion! Pairs perfectly with charcuterie, sushi, grilled salmon or a langoustine carpaccio. It will also enhance lightly sweetened red berry desserts with an acidic crunch.

96 Points - Wilfred Wong of Wine    After decades of tasting and savoring the Billecart-Salmon Brut Rosé Champagne, this wine remains one of my favorites wines in the world. This wine is fresh, bright, and steady with its alluring aromas and flavors of red currants and strawberries. Enjoy it with fresh salmon and avocado hand rolls. 

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast    The palest of rosés, this is an elegant, structured wine. Its dryness is balanced by the fine apple and red-currant fruits and the strong sense of minerality. Fragrant and lightly structured, this fine bottling is ready to drink.

92 Points - Wine Spectator    A lively rosé Champagne with a pleasing, citrusy juiciness to the flavors of steeped raspberry, white peach and blanched almond. A subtle thread of chalky minerality winds through the finish. Drink now through 2023.

91 Points - Decanter    Currently based on the 2016 harvest, this is floral and citrussy, showing a lithe, graceful balance. It’s a blend of 40% Chardonnay, 30% Pinot Noir and 30% Meunier, with about 40% of reserve wine, and red wine accounts for 7% of the blend. Its delicate, subtly expansive flavours of raspberry and strawberry are enlivened by a tangerine-like acidity, and while it feels ripe and full in flavour on the palate, it never loses its sense of refinement and poise, finishing with detailed length and depth.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate    Based on the 2016 vintage, the new NV Brut Rosé from Billarcart-Salmon has turned out nicely, mingling notes of red berries and plums with notions of peach, dried flowers and orange rind. Medium to full-bodied, pillowy and elegant, it's bright and charming, with a generous core of fruit, racy acids and a pinpoint mousse. Giving and demonstrative, it's already drinking well.

title: Lingua Franca Pinot Noir 'Avni' 2024
bodyHtml:
Avni Pinot Noir is focused and flavorful, yet harmonious and balanced, with an overlying elegance and velvety mouthfeel. Red fruits dominate the flavor profile with some black cherry, spice, black tea, fresh herbs, and a hint of black cherry, tar and rose petal, finishing with a round texture.

It is versatile, pairing well with hot smoked salmon and roasted poultry, even grilled meats.

Both the red and white Avni are bottled under diam, which should give restaurants another level of confidence in terms of consistency if the wines have been store halfway decently. This Pinot Noir offers a fantastic nose out of the gate, with ripe cherries. A joyful wine, it’s floral and pretty, retaining lovely freshness, with a chalky texture and a clean finish.

title: Peroni 330 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml: Pours a clear pale gold colour with fine head. Pleasant aromas of crisp apple, citrus pith and freshly baked bread with floral hops. On the palate it is medium bodied and moderately carbonated, with flavours of apple, toasted grains and light notes of citrus, grass and caramel on a refreshingly bitter finish.

title: Castello Di Ama Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'San Lorenzo' 2021
bodyHtml:
#9 Wine Spectator Top 100 of 2025

The 2021 Castello di Ama 'San Lorenzo' Chianti Classico Gran Selezione is a red wine from the Chianti Classico region in Tuscany, Italy. Named after the picturesque San Lorenzo valley, this wine exemplifies the estate's commitment to quality, tradition, and the expression of Sangiovese in its purest form.

Vineyard and Production

  • Grape Composition: Predominantly Sangiovese, with small amounts of Merlot and Malvasia Nera.

  • Vineyards: Sourced from the estate’s historic vineyards—Bellavista, Casuccia, San Lorenzo, and Montebuoni—located at elevations between 460 and 525 meters above sea level.

  • Soil: Clay and calcareous composition, providing excellent drainage and a distinctive mineral profile.

  • Vinification: Fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks, followed by aging in oak barrels to enhance complexity, texture, and depth.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Bright medium ruby red with a luminous rim.

  • Aroma: Elegant and refined, featuring vibrant notes of cherry, cranberry, dried flowers, cedar, and a touch of smokiness.

  • Palate: Juicy and structured, with fine-grained tannins and impressive length. Layers of dark red fruit, licorice, spice, leather, and graphite lead to a clean, mineral-driven finish.

Critical Acclaim

  • James Suckling: 99 points – 'This is really perfumed and gorgeous, with black cherries, blackcurrants and violets. Full-bodied with totally integrated tannins and a palate presence that is pretty spectacular. Wonderful finish. Give this three or four years. Try after 2027. '

  • Vinous (Antonio Galloni): 94 points – Praised for its power, depth, and dark red fruit character, with a structured profile and a long aging potential.

Serving and Pairing

Decant for at least one hour before serving at 16-18°C (61-64°F) to allow the wine’s aromas and structure to fully develop. This Chianti Classico Gran Selezione pairs beautifully with bistecca alla fiorentina, wild boar ragù, aged pecorino cheese, and truffle-infused dishes. Its balance of acidity and tannins makes it a great match for rich pasta dishes and roasted game meats.

title: Simonnet Febvre Chablis Premier Cru 2022
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the historic Chablis region of Burgundy, France, this Premier Cru is a quintessential expression of its northern terroir. Established in 1840 by barrel maker Jean Febvre, Maison Simonnet Febvre is one of the oldest wineries in the region and has been owned by Maison Louis Latour since 2003. Under the leadership of director and winemaker Paul Espitalié, the estate maintains its independent winemaking philosophy, focusing on sustainable vineyard management and traditional techniques to craft wines that prioritize purity, elegance, and a clear sense of place.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay pours a pale golden colour, often tinged with subtle green reflections. The nose is complex and delicate, offering an aromatic bouquet of white flowers, acacia, and ripe orchard fruits like pear and white peach, underscored by classic flinty and mineral notes. On the palate, the wine is well structured and medium bodied, showcasing a succulent yet elegant texture with flavors of candied citrus, yellow apple, and a distinct chalky minerality. It is characterized by its flawless balance between generous fruit ripeness and a vibrant, electrical acidity that leads into a persistent, saline, and iodized finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator – 92 points

  • James Suckling – 95 points

Food Pairing

The wine's bright acidity and mineral core make it a versatile companion for sophisticated cuisine. It pairs exceptionally well with fresh seafood, such as grilled fish, oysters, or prawn bisque, as well as white meats served in creamy sauces.

title: Henry of Pelham Rose
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Henry of Pelham is a prominent family-owned winery located on the Short Hills Bench in the Niagara Peninsula, Ontario. They are recognized for a diverse range of rosé wines, spanning from easy-drinking table wines to high-end, traditional-method sparkling releases. As of late 2025, the estate continues to be a leader in the region, recently being named the #1 Winery in Ontario by National Wine Awards.

Wine Description

This is the estate’s signature "Classic" series rosé, known for its consistency and crisp, dry style. The 2024 vintage, released in early 2025, benefitted from a warm harvest with well-timed rain.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend primarily featuring Gamay Noir, Zweigelt, and Cabernet Sauvignon.

  • Aromatic Profile: The nose is defined by delicate scents of rose petals and vibrant aromas of fresh-picked cherries and raspberries.

  • Palate and Body: It is a refreshing, dry, and light-bodied wine. The palate offers flavors of cherries, tart cranberry, and elderflower.

  • Structure: It maintains a crisp energy with moderate acidity and a clean finish.

  • Winemaking: The grapes receive approximately 3 hours of skin contact to achieve its vibrant pink color and are fermented at cool temperatures in stainless steel to preserve fruit delicacy.

title: Podere 414 Toscana Rosato 'Flower Power' 2025
bodyHtml:
Podere 414 "Flower Power" Toscana Rosato is an organic rosé wine from the Maremma region of coastal Tuscany, Italy. Produced by the renowned oenologist Maurizio Castelli, the name "Flower Power" is a tribute to the 1960s hippie counterculture, reflecting the wine's philosophy of simplicity, immediacy, and a carefree nature. It is widely considered a benchmark for high-quality, approachable Sangiovese rosé.

Wine Description

This wine is designed to be a "riviera" style rosato—light, brilliant, and exceptionally easy to drink.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Sangiovese, sourced from organically farmed vineyards near the town of Scansano.

  • Aromatic Profile: The nose is vibrant and floral, opening with distinct notes of wild meadow flowers and tropical fruit such as grapefruit, pineapple, and melon. It is often accompanied by secondary scents of wild strawberry, apricot, and a hint of Mediterranean scrub.

  • Palate and Body: On the palate, the wine is light-bodied and "dancingly" fresh. It offers a core of crunchy red fruit—predominantly strawberry and redcurrant—balanced by a bone-dry finish and a subtle saline minerality that reflects its maritime origin.

  • Structure: The wine is defined by its crisp, clear acidity and a sleek frame. Unlike more structured or oak-aged rosatos, Flower Power emphasizes purity and a "bone-clear" fruit expression.

  • Winemaking: The grapes are harvested early (typically in the first decade of September) to preserve high acidity. The wine is made using the "saignée" method or soft pressing with very short skin contact (6 to 8 hours) to achieve its delicate salmon-pink hue. Fermentation takes place at low temperatures in stainless steel tanks, where it remains briefly before being bottled fresh in the spring.

Food Pairing

Flower Power is a highly versatile "pool wine" or aperitif that pairs well with informal and light summer dishes:

  • Seafood: Sushi, sashimi, salmon carpaccio, grilled prawns, or spaghetti with clams.

  • Light Starters: Bruschetta with tomato and basil, rice salads, or fresh seasonal platters.

  • Meats: White meats like grilled chicken or veal medallions.

  • Cheese: Fresh soft cheeses or mild goat cheese.

title: Billecart Salmon Cuvee Nicolas Francois 2012
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Billecart-Salmon Cuvée Nicolas François 2012 is the latest release of the estate's prestige vintage bottling, marking the first release of this cuvée since the legendary 2008 vintage. Named in tribute to the house’s founder, the 2012 emerges from a growing season that was initially challenging due to frost and hail but was rescued by a warm, sun-drenched August and September. This vintage is widely regarded as one of the greatest of its decade, offering a broader and more demonstrative profile than the tightly coiled 2008.

Wine Description

The 2012 vintage reflects the natural radiance and ripeness of the year, balanced by Billecart-Salmon’s signature mineral tension and precision.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend of 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay. The fruit is sourced from 83% Grand Cru and 17% Premier Cru vineyards. Pinot Noir originates from Mareuil-sur-Aÿ, Verzenay, and Aÿ, while the Chardonnay is sourced from the Côte des Blancs (Le Mesnil-sur-Oger, Chouilly, and Avize).

  • Aromatic Profile: The bouquet is rich and expansive, featuring aromas of candied lemon, honeysuckle, and ripe peach. It is complemented by mature notes of beeswax, orange zest, roasted hazelnuts, and a hint of vanilla bean.

  • Palate and Body: On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, ample, and enveloping. It offers a layered core of orchard fruits, such as pear and apricot, alongside savory nuances of baking spice and toasted brioche. The mouthfeel is defined by a creamy mousse and a deep, resonant texture.

  • Structure: Despite the warmth of the 2012 season, the wine maintains a mouthwatering acidity and a firm, chalky structure. The finish is remarkably long, tense, and saline, showing a "peacock's tail" display of complex flavors.

  • Winemaking and Aging: Following the house's traditional methods, 17% of the blend was vinified in oak barrels to add depth and breadth. The wine underwent partial malolactic fermentation (with approximately 20% blocked to preserve freshness) and was aged on its lees for 10 years (120 months) before being disgorged in May 2023.

  • ABV: 12.5% to 13.2%.

  • Dosage: Extra Brut (3.8 g/L), reflecting the house's move toward lower dosages to emphasize terroir transparency and the richness of the vintage.

Accolades

The 2012 Nicolas François has been met with significant critical acclaim upon its 2025 release:

  • James Suckling: 97 points

  • Owen Bargreen: 97 points

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate: 96 points

  • Vinous (Antonio Galloni): 95 points

  • Decanter: 95 points

title: Domaine des Carlines Cremant du Jura
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Domaine des Carlines Crémant du Jura is an artisanal sparkling wine from the Jura region in eastern France. Established in the village of Menétru-le-Vignoble—famous for its Château-Chalon wines—the domaine is led by Patrick and Sophie Ligeron. They focus on preserving the traditional identity of Jura viticulture through organic farming and minimal intervention. Their Crémant is crafted using the traditional method (the same process used in Champagne), emphasizing the unique limestone and marl terroir of the region to create a sparkling wine with distinct mineral energy and local character.

Wine Description

The Crémant du Jura from Domaine des Carlines is prized for its elegance, fine bubbles, and the "savory" profile typical of the Jura.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically 100% Chardonnay, though some cuvées may incorporate a small percentage of Pinot Noir or Savagnin depending on the specific bottling.

  • Aromatic Profile: The nose is bright and expressive, offering scents of green apple, citrus zest, and white flowers. Because it spends significant time on its lees, it also develops sophisticated notes of fresh brioche, toasted nuts, and a hint of the "yellow fruit" or oxidative nuttiness that Jura is famous for.

  • Palate and Body: On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied with a creamy yet precise texture. It features flavors of lemon curd, pear, and a touch of saline minerals. The mousse is fine and integrated, providing a smooth mouthfeel.

  • Structure: The wine is defined by its high natural acidity and a distinct chalky finish. It is often bottled with low dosage (Extra Brut or Brut Nature style), which allows the purity of the fruit and the stony minerality of the soil to remain at the forefront.

  • Winemaking and Aging: The grapes are hand-harvested and fermented with indigenous yeasts. The wine undergoes secondary fermentation in the bottle and is aged on its lees for an extended period—often exceeding the 12-month minimum requirement—to enhance its complexity and depth.

  • ABV: Usually 12.5%.

title: Domaine du Bagnol Cassis Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Domaine du Bagnol Cassis Rose is an elegant and storied wine from the Cassis appellation in Provence, France. Located at the foot of Cap Canaille, the highest maritime cliff in Europe, Domaine du Bagnol is one of the oldest estates in the region, with roots dating back to 1867. Cassis was the very first AOC in Provence, and it remains unique for its limestone-heavy soils and maritime influence. This rose is highly regarded for its refinement and distinct mineral character, often considered a benchmark for the appellation.

Wine Description

The rose from Domaine du Bagnol is known for its pale complexion and a profile that emphasizes finesse over power.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically a blend of Grenache, Mourvedre, and Cinsault.

  • Aromatic Profile: The nose is fresh and delicate, featuring notes of small red berries like wild strawberry and raspberry, joined by hints of peach and citrus zest. Floral nuances of white flowers and a touch of garrigue (wild Provencal herbs) are also common.

  • Palate and Body: On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium bodied with a silky texture. It offers flavors of crisp red fruit and nectarine, balanced by a vibrant, saline acidity.

  • Structure: The hallmark of Bagnol Rose is its limestone-driven minerality. It finishes clean and dry with a refreshing sea-salt tang that reflects its coastal origin.

  • Winemaking: The grapes are hand-harvested and immediately pressed at cool temperatures to maintain aromatic purity. Fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks, and the wine is aged on its fine lees for several months to add a subtle roundness to the mid-palate.

title: Tarlant Zero Brut Nature
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Tarlant Zero Brut Nature is a highly regarded grower Champagne produced by the Tarlant family in the Vallee de la Marne, France. The Tarlant estate, established in 1687, is currently managed by the 12th generation, represented by Benoit and Melanie Tarlant. This wine is the estate's signature "calling card," representing roughly 70% of their production. It is a Brut Nature, or zero-dosage Champagne, meaning no sugar was added during the disgorgement process. The Tarlant family were pioneers in the zero-dosage movement in the late 1970s, aiming to showcase the unadorned purity of their terroir.

Wine Description

Tarlant Zero is typically a non-vintage blend that utilizes a base year complemented by a significant proportion of reserve wines.

  • Varietal Composition: An nearly equal blend of the three main Champagne varieties: 32% Chardonnay, 32% Pinot Noir, and 32% Pinot Meunier. The remaining 4% often consists of rare, "forgotten" indigenous varieties such as Petit Meslier, Arbane, and Pinot Blanc.

  • Aromatic Profile: The nose is intense, fresh, and complex. It offers a vibrant bouquet of citrus zest (lemon, mandarin), white orchard fruits (green apple, pear), and white flowers like acacia. Due to extended aging on the lees, it also develops sophisticated notes of toasted almond, hazelnut, brioche, and honey.

  • Palate and Body: This is a full-bodied, bone-dry Champagne with a remarkable mineral tension. It possesses a silky, creamy texture and a fine, persistent perlage. Flavors of crisp citrus and white fruit are underscored by a distinct salty minerality and a chalky grip that reflects the limestone and flint soils of the Marne Valley.

  • Winemaking and Aging: The estate practices organic viticulture across 63 individual parcels. Each plot is vinified separately in used French oak barrels to provide structural support without overwhelming the fruit. Malolactic fermentation is generally avoided to preserve natural acidity. The wine undergoes an exceptionally long secondary fermentation in the bottle, often resting on the lees for 5 to 7 years before being disgorged without any added sugar.

  • ABV: 12%.

Accolades

Tarlant Zero is consistently praised by critics for its precision and depth:

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate: 90 points

  • James Suckling: 93 points

  • Wine Spectator: 91 points

  • Vinous (Antonio Galloni): 93 points

title: Sorelle Bronca Rose Brut 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Sorelle Bronca Rose Brut is a refined and delicate sparkling wine from the Veneto region of Italy. It is produced by sisters Antonella and Ersiliana Bronca, who established their estate in the mid-1980s. The winery is highly regarded for its commitment to organic viticulture and small-batch production, with vineyards located on steep hillsides in the prestigious Prosecco DOC and DOCG zones. Unlike many large-scale commercial sparkling wines from the area, Sorelle Bronca focuses on hand-harvesting and natural winemaking techniques to ensure purity and freshness.

Wine Description

This Rose Brut is known for its elegant light pink color and a perlage that is both fine and persistent.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend of 90% Glera (the traditional grape for Prosecco) and 10% Pinot Nero (Pinot Noir).

  • Aromatic Profile: The nose is delicate and expressive, offering a bouquet of floral and fruity notes. It typically features scents of fresh roses and wisteria combined with red currants, strawberries, and raspberries.

  • Palate and Body: On the palate, the wine is soft yet energetic. It develops vertically with a fragrant persistence and an acidulous backbone that keeps the fruit flavors bright. It is light-bodied and crisp, with a dry finish characteristic of the Brut style.

  • Winemaking: The grapes are picked early to maintain high natural acidity. The process involve a soft pressing of whole grapes and a primary fermentation in stainless steel tanks. The secondary fermentation follows the Martinotti (Charmat) method, often resting on the lees for at least two months to add complexity and texture.

  • ABV: 11%.

  • Sugar Content: Typically around 7 g/L to 13 g/L, maintaining a dry but approachable profile.

title: Cardamaro - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
On the nose it is strong and complex, thanks to the blend of the various extracts and the long ageing process.

Spicy notes of Hunchback Cardoon, Gentiana, clary sage and liquorice are prominent; hints of dried fruit, grapes and ginger also emerge.

The taste is sweet, full and well-orchestrated flavour reflecting the extraordinary balance between the sweet note, the bitter quality of some of the officinal herbs and the pleasant tastiness of the wine.

title: Corona Extra 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Originating from Mexico, Corona Light is brewed by Grupo Modelo, a brewery founded in 1925 and now part of Anheuser-Busch InBev. Grupo Modelo has become one of the most internationally recognized Mexican breweries, renowned for its crisp, easy-drinking lagers enjoyed worldwide.

This pale golden lager pours with a light, effervescent body and a subtle, white head. On the nose, it offers delicate aromas of malt, citrus zest, and a touch of hops. The palate is refreshing and clean, with crisp carbonation, light malt sweetness, and a hint of graininess. Its light body and dry finish make it highly approachable.

title: Poplar Grove Cascadia Series Pinot Gris 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Poplar Grove Cascadia Series Pinot Gris 2024 is a vibrant white wine from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. Produced by Poplar Grove Winery, one of the oldest original family-owned wineries on the Naramata Bench, this wine is part of their Cascadia Series. This series is designed to showcase the unique terroir and climatic conditions of the Pacific Northwest, focusing on freshness, purity of fruit, and a bright, approachable style.

Wine Description

The 2024 vintage was shaped by the specific conditions of the Okanagan growing season, resulting in a wine with excellent aromatic intensity and a crisp, refreshing profile.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Gris.

  • Aromatic Profile: The nose is clean and highly aromatic, featuring bright notes of Granny Smith apple, ripe pear, and honeydew melon. Subtle floral hints of white spring blossoms and a touch of citrus zest add to its inviting bouquet.

  • Palate and Body: On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium bodied with a zesty, energetic mouthfeel. It offers flavors of orchard fruit, white peach, and a squeeze of fresh lime. The 2024 expression emphasizes a lean, mineral-driven style rather than a heavy or oily texture.

  • Structure: The wine is defined by its racy acidity, which provides a crisp and mouth-watering sensation. The finish is clean and lingering, with a faint stony minerality that is characteristic of the glacial soils found in the Okanagan Valley.

  • Winemaking: To preserve the primary fruit aromatics and fresh acidity, the juice is fermented at cool temperatures in stainless steel tanks. There is no oak influence, ensuring that the natural characteristics of the Pinot Gris grape remain the focus.

  • ABV: Typically ranges between 12.5% and 13.0%.

title: Bouzereau Chassange Montrachet Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
This fine red wine originates from France, specifically the Côte de Beaune subregion of Burgundy, within the Chassagne Montrachet AOC appellation. The Bouzereau name is associated with several generations of winemaking in Meursault and the surrounding Côte de Beaune, carrying on a tradition with great respect for the terroir. Winemakers, such as the two sisters at Domaine Hubert Bouzereau-Gruère & Filles, continually strive to produce well-balanced wines with beautiful minerality, aromatic purity, and good acidity for finesse.

Wine Description

This is a pure red Burgundy, made from 100 per cent Pinot Noir. The wine typically shows a brilliant ruby colour. It has a pleasant and fruity nose with elegant notes of red fruit, which can also include mineral notes. On the palate, the wine often presents a subtle, rich, and extremely aromatic profile, showcasing flavours of raspberry and blackberry with fine-grained or silky tannins.

title: Fathertime Precious Batch Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Father Time (stylized as Fathertime) Precious Batch Bourbon is a limited-run, collectible Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey from the country of the United States. This spirit is a celebrity collaboration between comedian Jim Gaffigan and independent film director Stu Pollard. The brand is themed around the "paternal sacrifice" and the brief periods of peace every hard-working parent earns. It is distilled in Kentucky and bottled by Fathertime Bourbon, LLC in Bardstown. The Precious Batch series consists of ultra-limited releases, including the "Firstborn Edition," "Second Child Syndrome," and "Middle Child Mystery".
