Spirit Description

Fathertime Precious Batch is crafted using traditional bourbon-making methods and aged in new American oak charred barrels. Each bottle of the Firstborn Edition is personally hand-signed by Jim Gaffigan.

  • Colour: Amber.

  • Aroma: The nose features inviting scents of rich aged honey, delicate tea blossom, vanilla, and caramel. Some tasters also note aloe vera and tart rhubarb.

  • Palate: The palate is beautifully balanced and sweet, revealing notes of oak, cherry, quince crumble, and burnt caramel.

  • Finish: A pleasantly powerful finish with lingering notes of honeysuckle and sweet tea.

  • Mashbill: One major release features a mashbill of 58% corn, 33% rye, and 9% malted barley.

  • ABV: The "regular strength" small batch is bottled at 46.2% ABV (92.4 proof), while the "Empty Nester Strength" (cask strength) expressions reach up to 62.8% ABV (125.6 proof).

title: The Kujira 10 Year Old Bourbon Barrel
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Kujira 10 Year Old Ryukyu Whisky is a premium single grain whisky from the country of Japan, specifically the subtropical island of Okinawa. It is produced by the Masahiro Distillery, which was founded in 1883 and is one of the oldest and largest distilleries in the Ryukyu Islands. This expression is distilled from 100% premium Indica rice and utilizes Okinawa's unique black koji for fermentation. The warm and humid climate of the region significantly accelerates the maturation process, resulting in a rounded body and deep amber hue. While many expressions are matured in virgin white oak, this specific version is matured for over 10 years in ex-bourbon barrels.

Spirit Description

The Kujira 10 Year Old Bourbon Barrel is characterized by its smooth, buttery, and spicy profile, drawing significant influence from its decade of maturation in bourbon casks.

  • Colour: Deep amber.

  • Aroma: The nose is fresh and sweet, featuring scents of nectar, honey, and brown sugar accompanied by floral notes and soft oaky aromas. Spices such as cinnamon and cloves provide a sapwood-like quality reminiscent of bourbon.

  • Palate: It offers a sweet and buttery mouthfeel with flavours of soft caramel sauce, baked bread, and liquorice. The taste is enriched by charming spices such as cloves and cinnamon, with additional hints of green raisins and dates.

  • Finish: A good length with a slight pleasant bitterness that balances the sweetness. Persistent notes of green raisins and liquorice are followed by a long, warming finish of spices.

  • ABV: Bottled at 43% ABV.

Accolades

The Kujira 10 Year Old range has received several prestigious international awards for its quality and innovative production methods:

  • Double Gold Medal: San Francisco World Spirits Competition (2021).

  • Silver Medal (91 points): International Wine & Spirit Competition (2021).

  • Silver Medal: International Spirit Challenge (2020 and 2023).

title: Kujira 25 Year Old Ryukyu Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Kujira 25 Year Old Ryukyu Whisky is an ultra-rare, luxury spirit from the country of Japan, specifically the subtropical island of Okinawa. It is produced at the Masahiro Distillery, which was founded in 1883 and remains one of the oldest and largest distilleries in the Ryukyu Islands. Unlike traditional Japanese whiskies made from malted barley, Kujira is distilled from 100% premium Indica rice and fermented with Okinawa’s native black koji. This expression is a limited masterpiece hand-selected by Master Blender Arakaki Sunao from rare stocks matured for over a quarter-century.

Spirit Description

This whisky is matured for at least 25 years in a combination of sherry, bourbon, and white oak casks. The subtropical climate of Okinawa facilitates a "rapid maturation" miracle, imbuing the spirit with an intensity and depth of flavour often associated with even older whiskies.

  • Colour: Deep amber, with no caramel colour added.

  • Aroma: The nose is complex and inviting, featuring the sweet bitterness of dark chocolate, floral notes, sweet coconut, and tropical fruits with a hint of aged leather.

  • Palate: Rich and multi-layered, the palate offers a majestic Oriental taste with notes of dark chocolate, dried fruits, citrus, and vanilla. Subtle sweetness and hints of sandalwood and white oak add significant depth.

  • Finish: A warm, gentle, and harmonious finish that lingers in the mouth with traces of spice, dried fruit, and a touch of smokiness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 43% ABV.

title: 1921 Crema de Tequila Liqueur
bodyHtml:
1921 Tequila Crema Liqueur (also known as 1921 Crema de Tequila) is a gourmet cream liqueur from the country of Mexico, produced in the Jalisco Highlands (Los Altos). The brand, Casa 1921, was established in 1996 to promote Mexican culture through ultra-premium spirits; the name 1921 commemorates the final year of the Mexican Revolution. The liqueur is distinguished by its base of 100% Blue Weber agave 1921 Tequila Blanco, which is blended with dairy cream and traditional Mexican flavours.

Spirit Description

This liqueur is a silky fusion of premium tequila and smooth cream, often described as having a texture similar to a thick latte or a rich milkshake. It is gluten-free.

  • Production: The base tequila is made from estate-grown agave slow-cooked for 72 hours in masonry ovens, fermented with proprietary yeast, and double-distilled in stainless steel pot stills.

  • Colour: Creamy beige with a caramel or well-creamed coffee tone.

  • Aroma: Delicate and sweet with notes of fresh agave, coffee, vanilla, and cinnamon.

  • Palate: Velvety and moderately sweet. It features a prominent mix of coffee, vanilla, and cinnamon, followed by subtle hints of chocolate, roasted nuts, and the warm spice of unaged tequila.

  • Finish: Smooth and persistent with a lingering dessert-like aftertaste of coffee and caramel.

  • ABV: Bottled at 15% ABV.

Accolades

1921 Tequila Crema is highly regarded in the industry for its balance and quality, often setting a standard for the tequila cream category.

  • Double Gold Medal: San Francisco World Spirits Competition (2024).

  • Gold Medal: San Francisco World Spirits Competition (2025).

  • 91/100 Points: Rated by Wine Enthusiast.

title: Appleton Estate 8 Year Old Double Cask Rum
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Appleton Estate 8 Year Old Double Cask is a limited edition, premium Jamaican rum that represents a significant milestone as the distillery's first-ever cask-finished release. Launched in June 2024 as a Canadian exclusive, only 13,000 bottles were produced. The expression was crafted by legendary Master Blender Dr. Joy Spence to unite the tropical heritage of Jamaica's Nassau Valley with the "misty" traditions of the Scottish Highlands.

Spirit Description

This rum is a blend of pot and column still distillates, meticulously managed from "cane to cup" at the Appleton Estate, which has been distilling since 1749. It is matured for eight years in the tropical Jamaican climate—where rum ages approximately three times faster than in cooler regions—before undergoing a unique finishing period.

  • Maturation: Aged for a minimum of eight years in Number One American white oak bourbon barrels, then finished in barrels that previously held Dr. Joy Spence's favourite 18 Year Old Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky.

  • Colour: Brilliant honeyed bronze with a subtle green ring of ageing.

  • Aroma: A bouquet of spiced fruit, dried raisins, and vanilla, balanced by the distillery’s signature orange peel note and a hint of honey.

  • Palate: Smooth and rich with layers of caramel, orange, honeyed nuts, and sweet vanilla. Some tasters note hints of peat, scotch tones, and leather from the single malt cask.

  • Finish: Lengthy and exceptionally smooth, featuring lingering notes of holiday spice and warm oak.

  • ABV: Bottled at 43% ABV.

Accolades

While a newer limited release, the foundational Appleton Estate 8 Year Old Reserve won a Gold Medal at the 2024 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. The Double Cask edition has been praised by collectors as a "rare collectable" that punches well above its price point, particularly for its innovative fusion of Jamaican funk and Speyside elegance.

Food Pairing

The complex interplay of fruit, spice, and scotch-influenced oak makes this rum highly versatile for both neat sipping and refined cocktails.

  • Savoury: Pair with rich, fatty foods like smoked brisket or glazed pork belly to complement the rum's oak and caramel notes.

  • Sweet: The honey and raisin profile pairs excellently with desserts like banana-infused tarts, dark chocolate, or pecan pie.

  • Signature Serve: The "Obair Fashioned"—2 oz of Double Cask rum, 0.25 oz brown sugar syrup, and 3 dashes of orange bitters, stirred and served on the rocks with an orange twist.

  • Sipping: It is widely recommended to be enjoyed neat or on the rocks to fully appreciate the Speyside finish.

title: Bulldog Gin
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Bulldog London Dry Gin is a premium gin from the United Kingdom, specifically distilled in England at the historic G&J Greenall Distillery. Launched in 2007 by former investment banker Anshuman Vohra, the brand was created to offer a modern, bold alternative to "outdated" gins. Its name and "Bulldog Spirit" are inspired by Sir Winston Churchill. In 2017, the brand was acquired by the Campari Group, which now oversees its global distribution.

Spirit Description

Bulldog is a "modern" interpretation of the London Dry style, quadruple-distilled in copper pot stills using 100% British wheat and Welsh water. It is distinguished by a unique blend of 12 botanicals sourced from eight countries, including exotic ingredients like dragon eye (a fruit similar to lychee), white poppy, and lotus leaves.

  • Colour: Crystal clear.

  • Aroma: A bouquet of piney juniper, floral lavender, citrus lime zest, and a musky, nutty hint of angelica.

  • Palate: Unexpectedly smooth and creamy for a 40% spirit. It features a juniper-forward taste balanced by layers of almond, liquorice, and cassia spice.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a soft mouthfeel.

  • Finish: A crisp finish with lingering notes of nutty angelica and a warm, cracked black pepper spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

Accolades

Bulldog Gin earned early acclaim as one of the highest-rated gins ever by Wine Enthusiast Magazine at the time of its launch. Its accolades include:

  • Top 50 Spirit: Named a Top 50 Spirit by Wine Enthusiast.

  • Silver Medal: Awarded at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

  • Bronze Medal: Earned at the Berlin International Spirits Competition (2020).

  • Design Awards: Its iconic black bottle with a studded collar neck has received multiple industry accolades for packaging design.

title: Rebel 100 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Rebel 100 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey (KSBW) is a high-proof wheated bourbon from the United States, produced at the Lux Row Distillery in Bardstown, Kentucky. As a core member of the Rebel (formerly Rebel Yell) family, it utilizes the brand's original wheated recipe that dates back to 1849, which replaces the traditional spicy rye grain with soft wheat for a smoother profile. The brand was renamed from "Rebel Yell" to "Rebel" in 2020 and is currently owned by MGP Ingredients.

Spirit Description

Rebel 100 is crafted from a mash bill of corn, wheat, and malted barley, aged in new charred American oak barrels. It is the same recipe as the distillery's standard 80-proof expression but bottled at a higher intensity to provide a fuller flavour.

  • Colour: Deep amber with a rich hue.

  • Aroma: Inviting and sweet, featuring bold scents of honey, vanilla, and caramel, balanced by oaky tones and hints of stone fruits like raisins or plums.

  • Palate: The high proof delivers a "hot" sensation on the tongue with robust flavours of toffee, buttered corn, and black pepper. It maintains a silky mouthfeel with notes of gingerbread and chocolate-chip cookies.

  • Body: Bold and full-bodied with a smooth but intense texture.

  • Finish: A long, dry, and warming finish that fades into a combination of cinnamon gum, vanilla pod, and white chocolate.

  • ABV: Bottled at 50% ABV (100 proof).

Accolades

Rebel 100 is recognized for offering exceptional quality and "award-winning complexity" at an approachable price point:

  • 93 Points: Awarded by Whisky Advocate.

  • 96 Points: Rated by the Bartender Spirits Awards (2023), where it received a Silver Medal.

  • Gold Medal: San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

  • Gold Medal: ASCOT Awards (2022).

  • Bronze Medal: International Wine & Spirit Competition (2022).

title: Rebel 100 Aged 6 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Rebel 100 6 Year Old is a Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey from the United States, specifically produced at the Lux Row Distillers in Kentucky. This expression is a permanent addition to the Rebel (formerly Rebel Yell) portfolio, launched in spring 2024 to celebrate the brand's long-standing heritage. It utilises a time-honoured wheated bourbon recipe that dates back to 1849.

Spirit Description

This bourbon is crafted from a wheated mash bill consisting of 68% corn, 20% wheat, and 12% malted barley. It is aged for a full six years in new charred oak barrels and bottled at 100 proof (50% ABV).

  • Colour: Burnished gold.

  • Aroma: The nose features rich scents of vanilla and honey, accompanied by notes of dark fruits.

  • Palate: It offers an intense, full-bodied flavour profile starting with dark fruits, followed by bright citrus and robust oak. Additional notes of white pepper, ginger, and almond provide complexity.

  • Finish: The finish is described as velvety smooth with a lingering hint of warming spice.

Accolades

Despite being a relatively new release, the Rebel 100 6 Year Old has already secured several prestigious industry awards:

  • Double Gold Medal: San Francisco World Spirits Competition (2025).

  • Gold Medal: ASCOT Awards (2025).

  • Silver Medal: World Whiskies Awards (2025).

  • Silver Medal: International Wine & Spirit Competition (2024).

title: Duckhorn Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
This structured and "genteel" red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the premier Napa Valley region in California. Founded in 1976 by Dan and Margaret Duckhorn, Duckhorn Vineyards is an iconic Napa institution that helped define the modern era of American winemaking. While the winery originally focused on Merlot, its Cabernet Sauvignon has become a benchmark for the region, known for its "seamless blend of elegance and strength". The winemaking philosophy involves a "terroir-driven" approach, blending fruit from top-tier estate vineyards; including sites on the alluvial fans of the valley floor and the coveted slopes of Howell Mountain to achieve a harmonious and complex profile.

Wine Description

Duckhorn Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep ruby core. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and expressive, featuring a nose of dark red berries, cassis, and cardamom, layered with sophisticated notes of fresh tobacco, crushed stones, and a hint of dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and "smooth," showcasing rich flavours of fig jam and boysenberry pie underpinned by a refined minerality and warm oak spice. It is characterized by its firm, dusty tannins and a vibrant acidity (typically around 0.58 g/100ml) that provides an impressive structure and a long, polished finish. This blend typically consists of approximately 94% Cabernet Sauvignon, with small amounts of Merlot and Cabernet Franc added for softness and complexity, reaching an ABV of 14.5%. The wine is matured for 16 months in 100% French oak, with roughly 50% being new barrels. While the estate is a leader in sustainable viticulture and uses organic fertilizers, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Stag's Leap Wine Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon Artemis 2021
bodyHtml:
Stag’s Leap Wine Cellars Artemis Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 originates from the United States, specifically from the Napa Valley region in California. Founded in 1970 by Warren Winiarski, the winery gained international fame in 1976 when its 1973 S.L.V. Cabernet Sauvignon triumphed over prestigious French crus at the 'Judgment of Paris'. Following years of collaboration, the historic estate returned to family hands in 2023 when the renowned Italian winemaking family, Marchesi Antinori, acquired full ownership. The winery’s philosophy focuses on producing wines of classic beauty that balance New World innovation with Old World restraint, a commitment further highlighted by becoming the first estate in the Stags Leap District to achieve Regenerative Organic Certified status in 2024.

Wine Description

This full-bodied red wine displays a deep, inviting hue characteristic of premium Napa Valley Cabernet. The sensory profile opens with expressive aromas of boysenberry, plum, and dark currant, layered with complex notes of chocolate, baking spice, and a hint of toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is rich and creamy with a fresh mid-palate, delivering flavours of blackberry, mocha, and crushed raspberry balanced by persistent, satiny tannins. The finish is long and satisfying, echoing the wine’s richness with subtle accents of cedarwood, anise, and sweet tobacco.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend primarily consisting of 98% Cabernet Sauvignon, complemented by 1% Cabernet Franc, 0.5% Malbec, and 0.5% Merlot for added aromatic freshness.

  • ABV: Recorded at 14.5% or 15% depending on the bottling format.

  • Organic Status: While the estate vineyards are Regenerative Organic Certified, this specific bottling draws from diverse independent growers across Napa Valley and is generally considered sustainably produced.

  • Stylistic Notes: Aged for 15 months in French oak (33% new), this wine is designed to showcase the regional character of Napa Valley through astute grape selection and skillful blending.

Food Pairing

The structured tannins and lush fruit profile of Artemis make it an ideal companion for flavourful, marbled red meats. Suggested pairings include grilled tri-tip, braised beef short ribs, or a seared filet mignon served with sautéed mushrooms. For those preferring pasta, it pairs excellently with dishes featuring wild mushrooms and prosciutto.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Napa Valley is regarded as one of the best of the decade, characterized by low yields and small-sized berries that produced wines of exceptional concentration and intensity. Despite challenging dry conditions during the winter and spring, a moderate summer with cool afternoon breezes allowed for a smooth, steady harvest that preserved vibrant acidity. Head winemaker Marcus Notaro and his team adapted to these drought conditions by precisely managing the canopy and irrigation, resulting in a vintage noted for its brightness, purity, and impressive aging potential.

title: Periquita Red 2023
bodyHtml: Ruby red wine, with aromas of blackberries, raspberries, dry figs and cherries with a fruity, balanced for fruit/acidity with pleasant soft tannins.

title: Amis De Beauregard Blanc De Noirs
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This sparkling wine originates from France, specifically from the Champagne region. Champagne Amis de Beauregard was founded by Julien (a winemaker's grandson with family roots in the Marne Valley) and Yohann (an enlightened amateur), who later brought in Julien N to enrich the adventure. The winery's vision is to make good champagne accessible to the general public, with an offbeat and authentic approach. They aim to break the traditional codes of champagne by offering unique and accessible vintages, while promoting the passionate work of the winegrowers of the Marne Valley.

2. Wine Description

This is a Blanc de Noirs ('White of Blacks'), meaning it is a white sparkling wine made exclusively from black-skinned grapes.

Colour: The search results do not explicitly state the colour, but as a Blanc de Noirs, it is typically a pale yellow to light gold hue.

Aroma: The nose offers an elegant and generous profile, with a lively first impression marked by ripe yellow fruit. Notes include lightly stewed apricot, peach, a hint of caramel, and delicate floral notes. Other descriptions include an elegant palate of red fruits and orchard fruits like apple and pear, combined with ripe citrus and a touch of soft spices like vanilla.

Palate: The palate reveals a creamy texture reminiscent of vanilla cream and fine pastries. It is underpinned by lovely power and seductive roundness. Notes of candied lemon are present, subtly mentholated, which brings freshness and complexity.

Body: The wine is described as elegant and generous, with lovely power.

Finish: It has a fresh, well balanced finish and a long, delicious finale. The finish has a sweet evocation of key lime pie.

Varietal composition: The wine is made from 100% Meunier (Pinot Meunier) and includes 40% of five year old reserve wine.

Optimal drinking window: The search results do not explicitly state an optimal drinking window.

Stylistic notes: This Champagne is an expression of the Meunier grape. It is a fun, accessible, and modern Champagne. The style is one of roundness and balance.

ABV: The Alcohol by Volume (ABV) is 12.5%.

title: Antinori Badia A Passignano Chianti Classico 2001
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Antinori 'Badia a Passignano' Chianti Classico originates from Italy, specifically the Tuscany region, within the subregion of Chianti Classico. The estate is a historic monastery dating back to 395 CE, where Galileo taught mathematics for a period. The vineyards are rich with the experience of centuries past. The estate was purchased by the esteemed Antinori winemaking family in 1987, who are now in their 26th generation of vintners. The wine made here is aged in the vast cellars that run beneath the Abbey, which date back to the 10th century and maintain constant temperature and humidity. The estate produces a single wine: the Chianti Classico Riserva or Gran Selezione.

Wine Description

This red wine is a Chianti Classico, typically holding the designation of Riserva or Gran Selezione, which is the highest designation of quality in Chianti. The varietal composition is 100 percent Sangiovese. It is deep ruby red in colour. The nose is complex and intense, presenting notes of black cherries, dog rose, delicate hints of milk chocolate and cocoa. The bouquet is completed by floral aromas of lavender, irises, saffron, and slightly aromatic powder, along with sweet notes of vanilla, cloves, and leather. The palate is lively, vibrant, lean, and defined by a long, savoury finish, or rich, mouth-filling, succulent, and flavourful. It is well-sustained by an extraordinary freshness and mineral qualities, with silky, vibrant tannins. It has a lingering flavour profile, and a persistent aftertaste of bitter cocoa and citrus. The wine is full-bodied and has a great aging potential. The Alcohol By Volume (ABV) is generally around 14.5 percent to 15 percent.

title: Antinori Badia A Passignano Chianti Classico 2005

title: Chateau De Suronde La Realiste Chenin Blanc 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This fine white wine is from France, specifically the Loire Valley region, and the small, highly regarded appellation of Quarts de Chaume Grand Cru. The wine is produced by Château de Suronde, an estate with a rich history that has been a benchmark for the sweetness and complexity of Quarts de Chaume wines.

Château de Suronde's unique terroir is located on the right bank of the Layon river. The estate is celebrated for its commitment to high-quality viticulture, which is essential for producing the noble rot-affected grapes required for this style. The estate practices organic and biodynamic farming methods, focusing on purity and expression of the terroir. The 'La Réaliste' cuvée represents a commitment to showcasing the potential of dry Chenin Blanc from this Grand Cru terroir.

Wine Description

'La Réaliste' is 100% Chenin Blanc, a dry white wine from a parcel traditionally reserved for sweet wines. It is described as a wine of great balance and complexity. It presents a bright yellow-gold colour.

The nose is expressive and precise, offering aromas of white fruit such as quince and pear, along with notes of citrus peel, honey, and a distinct mineral, smoky reduction.

On the palate, it is full-bodied, with a firm structure. The flavours are concentrated, highlighting yellow plum, apricot, and honey. The wine's exceptional character comes from a perfect balance between its depth, richness, and its crystalline acidity, which provides tension and freshness. The finish is long, complex, and marked by a distinct saline minerality. The grapes are harvested from schisty, carboniferous soils in the heart of the Grand Cru appellation. The wine is fermented and aged for about a year in barrels (demi-muids), only 10% of which are new, to preserve the purity of the fruit. The wine offers great complexity, vibrant freshness, and excellent ageing potential.

title: Tama No Hikari "Blue Fox Mane" Kitsune - 300ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Tama No Hikari "Blue Fox Mane" Kitsune (also known as Aomanekitsune or Lucky Fox) is a Junmai Ginjo sake from the country of Japan, specifically the Fushimi ward of the Kyoto prefecture. The brewery, Tamanohikari Sake Brewing Co., was founded in 1673 and is renowned for its 1964 revival of the junmai style (pure rice sake made without added alcohol or sugar). The "Blue Fox" label is inspired by the Fushimi Inari Shrine, where foxes are revered symbols; the design features a beckoning fox (manekitsune) with its right hand raised, a traditional motif believed to invite fortune and money.

Description

This Junmai Ginjo is crafted using premium Japanese rice polished to a ratio of 60%. It is characterized by a well-balanced profile that highlights the natural umami of the rice.

  • Colour: Clear white.

  • Aroma: Fruity and floral on the nose, featuring light scents of apple, melon, and cooked rice with subtle hints of honey and nuts.

  • Palate: The taste is medium-dry to sharp, offering a clean and refreshing acidity balanced by the savoury richness of rice umami.

  • Body: It features a medium-dry body with a light finish.

  • Finish: A sharp, refreshing finish that is not too overpowering.

  • ABV: It is typically bottled at 15.4% ABV (ranging between 15% and 16%).

  • Sake Meter Value (SMV): +3.5.

Food Pairing

The dry and balanced nature of this sake makes it exceptionally versatile for pairing with a variety of cuisines.

  • Japanese Cuisine: It pairs excellently with Japanese pub fare (izakaya), sushi, and delicate sashimi.

  • Savoury Dishes: Its light umami and acidity complement grilled meats and savoury snacks.

  • Western Pairings: Due to its clean profile, it can also be enjoyed with French and Italian dishes.

  • Serving Temperature: While it is highly recommended to be served well chilled (about 5°C) or chilled (10°C), it can also be enjoyed warmed (40°C) or at room temperature to highlight different umami characteristics.

title: Dassai Shochu - 720ml
bodyHtml:
From the renowned Asahi Shuzo brewery comes a spirit that bridges the gap between sake and shochu. Dassai Shochu is a rare "Kasutori" shochu, crafted by distilling the fresh sake lees (kasu) of Dassai’s famous Junmai Daiginjo.

While most shochu is made from sweet potato or barley, this unique spirit captures the fruity, floral elegance of top-tier sake. By distilling the lees on the very same day the sake is pressed, Dassai preserves the delicate aromatics of Yamada Nishiki rice, notes of melon, peach, and white flowers, that usually vanish in standard distillation.

Bottled at 39% ABV, it is designed to be lighter than a whiskey but more potent than sake, delivering a clean, crisp finish that lingers beautifully. It is a spirit born from the pursuit of perfection, ensuring that not a single drop of the brewery's craftsmanship goes to waste.

title: Fantini Edizione - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Very intense garnet red; intense and persistent nose, recalling cherries, plums, ripe currant, tobacco, and a toasty note on the finish; excellent structure and roundness; rich, velvety tannins, and a long lasting finish; spicy notes of vanilla & chocolate.

title: Barone Ricasoli Brolio Chianti Classico Riserva 2022
bodyHtml:
The history of the Barone Ricasoli family is intrinsically linked to this territory, with historical evidence showing their possession of Brolio Castle since 1141, making Ricasoli one of the oldest wine-producing families in Italy. Baron Bettino Ricasoli, an illustrious ancestor, is credited with crafting the original 'Chianti formula' in 1872. Today, under the guidance of Francesco Ricasoli, the 32nd Baron, the winery is committed to continuous improvement, focusing on research into Sangiovese clonal selection, sustainable vineyard practices, and making wines that reflect the land's unique history and diverse soils.

Wine Description

On the palate, it is voluminous and medium to full-bodied. It possesses a well-balanced acidity, minerality, and structured, appreciable tannins that are described as soft, elegant, and well-smoothed. Stylistically, it offers a great balance between richness and depth of fruit with a mouthwatering, fresh acidity. Notes on the palate include tart cherry, medicinal raspberry, worked leather, and a black-cherry tang with peppery earth. The finish is long and persistent.

Food Pairing

Suggested food pairings include traditional Tuscan dishes such as Bistecca alla Fiorentina, osso buco, pappardelle with ragout sauce, and mushroom risotto. The wine also pairs well with liver paté, aged salami and cheese, or a simple pasta ragu.

title: Cavit Collection Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Cavit Pinot Noir is a red wine from Italy, produced in the Lombardy region under the Provincia di Pavia IGT designation. It is a standout selection from the Cavit Collection, a brand produced by the Cantina Viticoltori del Trentino, a consortium of cooperatives renowned for elevating the standard of Italian wines since 1950. While Cavit’s headquarters are in Trentino, this specific wine is sourced from the Oltrepò Pavese area, known as the "Pinot Noir capital of Italy." The wine is a classic expression of this distinct terroir, where vines thrive on sloping hillsides featuring calcareous clay soils that are ideal for producing elegant, fruit-forward Pinot Noir.

Wine Description

The wine displays a youthful, vibrant ruby red colour with violet hues, sometimes leaning towards a bright purple at the rim. The aromatic profile is inviting and delicate, full of red berry fruits, with distinct notes of black cherry, raspberry, and crushed strawberry, accompanied by subtle hints of earth and polished wood. The varietal composition is 100% Pinot Noir. It is a medium-bodied, silky, and approachable wine. The palate is fresh, smooth, and dry, with a well-defined fruit character that offers satisfying depth without heaviness. Stylistically, it is a harmonious wine, balancing the natural acidity of the grape with soft, supple tannins. The wine is matured for a short period in oak barrels to refine its texture before final finishing in stainless steel.

Food Pairing

This wine is a superb match for grilled lamb chops, roasted poultry, or a classic mushroom risotto. Suggested pairings also include grilled salmon, soft cheeses, tomato-based pasta dishes, or a savory lentil stew.

title: Caymus Cabernet Sauvignon 'Napa Valley' 2023
bodyHtml: Caymus Cabernet is one of Napa Valley’s most celebrated wines. Made from grapes farmed in 8 of Napa Valley’s 16 appellations, the wine has a signature style that is dark in colour, with layered lush aromas, rich fruit and ripe tannins and flavours including cocoa, cassis, ripe berries and as approachable in youth as it is in maturity. Chuck Wagner continues to make two world-renowned Cabernet Sauvignons, Caymus Napa Valley and Caymus Special Selection. Caymus Special Selection Cabernet Sauvignon is the only wine in the world to be honoured twice as Wine Spectator magazine’s “Wine of the Year” for the 1984 and 1990 vintages.

title: Burrowing Owl Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Burrowing Owl Cabernet Sauvignon is a premium red wine from Canada, produced in the Okanagan Valley within the Oliver and Osoyoos regions. It is a flagship bottling from Burrowing Owl Estate Winery, one of British Columbia’s most iconic and environmentally conscious producers. Founded by the Wyse family, the estate helped pioneer the region's reputation for world-class Bordeaux varietals. The wine is a classic expression of the Black Sage Bench terroir, which features deep, sandy soils and intense heat, creating the ideal conditions for ripening Cabernet Sauvignon to perfection.

Wine Description

The wine displays a deep, opaque ruby colour with a dark purple core. The aromatic profile is complex and savoury, full of dark fruits, with notes of ripe cassis, blackberry, and black plum, accompanied by the region’s signature hints of dusty sage, dried herbs, roasted red pepper, and graphite. The varietal composition is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. It is a full-bodied, robust, and intense wine. The palate is rich and structured, with a core of concentrated black fruit supported by firm, ripe tannins and a refreshing acidity that keeps the wine lively. Stylistically, it is a powerful yet polished wine that balances New World ripeness with Old World structure. The wine is matured for 18 months in a combination of French, American, and Hungarian oak barrels. The finish is long and satisfying, with lingering notes of dark chocolate, spice, and cedar.

Food Pairing

This wine is a superb match for a grilled rib-eye steak with black olive butter, rosemary-crusted rack of lamb, or a classic roast beef. Suggested pairings also include braised pork shanks, aged sharp cheddar, or a rich mushroom "Bourguignon."

title: Giffard Piment d'Espelette Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Giffard Piment d'Espelette Liqueur is a premium chile liqueur from the country of France, with production based in Angers in the Loire Valley. The key ingredient, Piment d'Espelette, is a rare, hand-harvested red chile pepper grown only in a limited area of the Basque region of France. This pepper, which has a warm heat of force 4 on the Scoville scale, has held AOP/DPO (Protected Designation of Origin) recognition since the 17th century. The Giffard company, renowned for its commitment to quality and taste, has been producing liqueurs since pharmacist Emile Giffard began his work in 1885.

Spirit Description

This chile liqueur is made from the maceration of whole, fresh Espelette peppers, with a hint of aged rhum agricole from Martinique added to the final blend for depth. The maceration process includes the green stalks of the peppers to impart a grassy note.

  • Colour: Bright straw yellow, with an intense shine and copper-gold reflections.

  • Nose: It is frank and herbaceous, with notes of fresh chili-pepper and freshly cut grass, balanced by a gentle warmth in the background.

  • Palate: The attack is dry, followed by assertive chili and a smooth, warm mid-palate with hints of vanilla and sweet spices. The intensity of the spice rises but is well-judged and not overpowering.

  • Body: The liqueur has a strong aromatic intensity with balanced, warm, and spicy notes.

  • Finish: The finish is a gourmet cocoa, persistent spiciness, with a caramelized and slightly musky aftertaste.

  • ABV: It is bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Les Fiefs de Lagrange 2015
bodyHtml:
Les Fiefs de Lagrange 2015 is a red wine from France, produced in the Bordeaux region and the Saint-Julien appellation. It is the second wine of Château Lagrange, a Troisième Grand Cru Classé (Third Growth). Created in 1983, the wine is seen as much more than a second wine, made from vines that are already 30 years old on average. The wine is a classic expression of the estate's terroir, which features fine gravel soils for the Cabernet Sauvignon and clay soils for the Merlot.

Wine Description

The wine displays a brilliant nice colour with purple hues, sometimes a deep and intense purply blue. The aromatic profile is delicate, full of black and red fruits, with notes of red cherries, strawberry, light red currant jus, and subtle hints of menthol and spices. The varietal composition is a blend of 55% Cabernet Sauvignon, 41% Merlot, and 4% Petit Verdot. It is a full-bodied, structured, and luscious wine. The palate is fresh, juicy, and charming, with a dense texture that gives concentration. Stylistically, it is a well balanced wine, described as the most complete Fiefs de Lagrange since the 2009 vintage. The wine is matured for 13 months in French oak barrels, 20% of which are new. The finish is long and persistent, with a solid tannic structure that is fine and elegant. The ABV is 13%. The optimal drinking window is from 2018 to 2030, with the recommendation to wait until 2022. The wine is produced under sustainable viticulture practices.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 92 points

Food Pairing

This wine is a superb match for grilled lamb chops, duck breast with cherry sauce, or a classic roast beef. Suggested pairings also include lentil stew, mushroom risotto, roast chicken, or a stuffed duck.

Vintage Quality

The 2015 vintage in Saint-Julien produced homogeneous, high-quality wines, which are vivid and refined. The growing season was marked by a dry, mild spring, which led to excellent flowering, followed by a particularly dry summer. The resulting wines have ripe fruit, fine acidity, and tannins with the ability to age.

title: Les Fiefs de Lagrange 2016
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Les Fiefs de Lagrange 2016 is a red wine from France, produced in the Bordeaux region and the Saint-Julien appellation. It is the second wine of Château Lagrange, a Troisième Grand Cru Classé (Third Growth) estate. Created in 1983, the wine's production aims to increase the quality of the Grand Vin (first wine) through a more drastic selection of grapes. The wine is vinified from vines that are already 30 years old on average.

Wine Description

The wine has a deep ruby with purple highlights or a dark and purple colour. The aromatic profile is intense, with pure black cherry, crème de cassis, and crushed violets. Other aromas include cassis, ripe plum, black cherry, cedar, graphite, and a touch of menthol. The varietal composition is a blend of 55% Cabernet Sauvignon, 41% Merlot, and 4% Petit Verdot. It is a medium-bodied wine. The palate is lively and fresh, with crisp acidity and a quite tensile mouthfeel. Flavours include blackcurrant, blackberry, and cherry, with notes of spice and tobacco. Stylistically, it is a vibrant, well balanced wine, showcasing polished, dense fruit character with appealing purity and freshness. The wine is matured for 13 months in barrels, 20% of which are new oak. The finish is long, with fruit, spice, and mineral lift. The ABV is 13.5%. The optimal drinking window is now to 2030, or 2021 to 2035. The wine is produced under sustainable practices.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 93 points

  • Decanter - 93 points

  • The Wine Independent (Lisa Perrotti-Brown MW) - 91 points

  • Vinous (Neal Martin) - 91 points

  • Wine Enthusiast - 90 points

Food Pairing

This wine is ideal with roast lamb with rosemary, entrecôte bordelaise, or duck breast with cherries. Suggested pairings also include venison stew, truffle risotto, aged Comté cheese, and mushroom ragout. The wine is also considered ideal with pork dishes, which will not diminish its elegance.

Vintage Quality

The 2016 vintage in Bordeaux was very successful, producing exceptional wines. The climatic conditions were marked by a mild and rainy spring, followed by a warm and dry summer. The late and long harvest, which took place from October 3rd to the 24th, allowed for optimal ripening.

title: Veuve Du Vernay Blanc De Blanc
bodyHtml:
This sparkling wine originates from France, within the Bordeaux region, but is labelled as a Vin Mousseux, or French Sparkling Wine. Veuve du Vernay is a widely recognized brand of French bubbly created by the house of Patriarche Père & Fils, which was established in 1780. The brand is named in honour of the widow ('Veuve') of a French nobleman who supported the establishment of the maison (house).

This 'Blanc de Blanc' is made exclusively from white grape varieties, which typically include Ugni Blanc, Colombard, and Chardonnay. It displays a brilliant, light straw yellow colour with fine, persistent bubbles. The nose is fresh and fruity, featuring notes of white flowers and peach. On the palate, the wine is lively, delicate, and well-balanced. It is known for its fresh, dry character and elegant complexity, which comes from its production using the traditional méthode Charmat (tank method). Stylistically, it is crisp, clean, and refreshing, making it an excellent example of an accessible French sparkling wine. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is typically 11.5 per cent.

title: Pacifico Clara 355 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml: Cerveza Pacifico Clara, better known as Pacifico, is a Mexican pilsner-style beer. It was first brewed in 1900 when three Germans opened a brewery, the Cerveceria del Pacifico in Mazatlán. Cerveza Pacifico is named so because the Pacifico brewery is located in the Pacific Ocean port city of Mazatlán, in the state of Sinaloa, México

title: Bavaria 500 ml (Non Alcoholic) - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Bavaria 0.0% Original is a non alcoholic beer originating from the Netherlands. It is brewed by Bavaria Brewery, which was founded in 1719 in the village of Lieshout and has been independently owned by the Swinkels family for seven generations. The brewery is one of the oldest in the Netherlands and utilizes its own natural mineral water spring and on-site malting plant to maintain full control over the quality of its ingredients.

Beer Description

This non alcoholic pilsner presents a clear, light golden colour. The sensory profile features an authentic beer aroma with notes of malt, hops, and a subtle fruitiness. On the palate, it offers a distinct grain flavour where the natural sweetness of the malt is well balanced by a mild bitterness. The body is full yet light, characterized by a creamy mouthfeel and a refreshing finish with a pleasantly sharp bite. The varietal composition is crafted from natural mineral water, barley malt, hop extract, and natural flavourings. It contains 0% alcohol by volume and is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The clean and balanced nature of this pilsner makes it a versatile companion for various cuisines. It pairs exceptionally well with deep fried snacks such as calamari, as the carbonation helps cut through the richness of the batter. Its light malt sweetness also complements the heat of spicy Asian dishes and charcoal grilled meats. Additionally, it serves as a refreshing partner for young, mild cheeses and fresh seafood.

title: Yamamoto Pure Black Junmai Ginjo - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Yamamoto Pure Black Junmai Ginjo is from Japan, specifically the region of Akita. The Yamamoto Sake Brewery was founded in 1901. The current brewer, Tomofumi Yamamoto, is the fourth-generation owner and also serves as the Tōji (Master Brewer), a rare combination in Akita sake. In 2005, he launched the 'Pure Black' brand, which has since become the main brand and backbone of the brewery. The brewery uses natural soft water sourced from the Shirakami Mountains.

Description

This is a modern, fresh style of junmai ginjo. The sake has aromas of rockmelon, kiwi, pineapple, grapefruit, and natural wet stone. The palate is dominated by flavours of sherbet, citrus peel, honeydew, pink grapefruit, and minerals. It is bottled shortly after pressing, which leaves a slight spritz on the palate. The sake is characterized by a clean finish and food friendly acidity. The ABV is 15% or 16%.

Food Pairing

This junmai ginjo's light, fresh, and fruity profile makes it well-suited for a variety of dishes. It is an excellent pairing for sushi and sashimi. The style also complements salads, light vegetables, and tofu dishes. Given its acidity and light umami, it pairs well with the meatiness of grilled king oyster mushrooms in a tare sauce, or King Oyster Yakitori. Its light, fruity notes are ideal with delicate meats such as grilled chicken.

title: Okunomatsu Shuzo Yusa Junmai Ginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
The Okunomatsu brewery was founded in 1716 during the Edo period by a family of former samurai who transitioned into the sake and oil merchant business. The brewery is currently led by Joji Yusa, the 19th generation of the founding family, after whom this specific brand is named.

Description

This sake presents a wonderfully balanced profile with a refreshing aroma of honeydew melon, orange blossom, and ripe pear. The palate is characterized by a soft, gently sweet creamy touch with flavours of macadamia nuts, toasted nuts, and taffy. It is medium bodied with a juicy, fruity finish that remains mild and clean. This Junmai Ginjo has an alcohol content of 16% and a rice polishing rate of 55%.

Food Pairing

The balanced acidity and umami of this sake make it a versatile choice for both Japanese and international cuisines. It pairs exceptionally well with seafood dishes such as steamed clams, garlic butter scallops, or seafood ceviche. The creamy texture of the sake also complements meatier options like grilled pork chops or king oyster mushroom yakitori. For a Western style pairing, consider serving it with roasted chicken or a mild Comté cheese to highlight its subtle nutty notes.

title: Yoshido Shuzo Gassan Izumo Junmai Ginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
The Yoshido brewery was established in 1899 and is located at the foot of the historic Gassan castle ruins. The brewery is celebrated for its use of ultra soft water, which is sourced from the mountains of the Chugoku region and contributes to the signature 'super soft' mouthfeel of their sake.

Description

This sake is characterized by a bright, clear appearance and an inviting aroma of fresh green apple and white flowers. On the palate, it is exceptionally smooth and medium bodied, offering a delicate balance of gentle sweetness and subtle umami. The finish is remarkably clean and crisp, showcasing the purity of the local spring water used in the brewing process. It has an alcohol content of 15%.

Food Pairing

The soft texture and clean profile of this Tokubetsu Junmai make it an ideal companion for a variety of seafood dishes. It pairs beautifully with fresh oysters, sashimi, or grilled trout seasoned with lemon. For a more savoury pairing, it also complements vegetable tempura or a mild chicken hot pot. Its versatility allows it to be enjoyed chilled or at room temperature.

title: Francois Mikulski Bourgogne Aligote 2023
bodyHtml:
The François Mikulski Bourgogne Aligoté is crafted in Burgundy, France, from old vines planted between 1929 and 1948. This wine exemplifies Mikulski’s commitment to organic practices, with grapes fermented using native yeast and aged in stainless steel. Known for its bright and refreshing character, it offers a glimpse into the depth possible with the often-underestimated Aligoté grape.

  • Colour: Pale yellow with green highlights.
  • Aroma: Citrus-driven with notes of lemon peel, white flowers, and fresh herbs like mint.
  • Palate: Expressive flavors of lemon custard, sage, and slate contribute to its vibrant profile.
  • Body: Light to medium-bodied, with refreshing acidity and a smooth texture.
  • Finish: Crisp, clean, and persistent, leaving a lingering citrus impression.

This Aligoté pairs beautifully with seafood, terrines, or goat cheese, and can be enjoyed now or cellared for further development. It showcases not just freshness but also complexity, making it ideal for both casual sipping and refined meals.

title: Francois Mikulski Monthelie Les Toisieres 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

François Mikulski Monthélie Les Toisières 2023 is a red wine from France, produced in the Burgundy region and the Monthélie appellation within the Côte de Beaune subregion. The estate, run by François and Thomas Mikulski, is highly regarded for its precise, minimal-intervention approach to winemaking. The winery's philosophy centres on producing refined wines that express the elegance of Pinot Noir on confidential terroirs, such as the 'Les Toisières' lieu-dit.

Wine Description

The wine is 100% Pinot Noir. It has a light robe or a deep ruby red colour with vibrant hues. The aromatic profile is elegant and vertical, strongly marked by a fine minerality, with aromas of fresh red fruits, cherry, raspberry, plum, and a wide array of sweet and fine spices, including pink, Sichuan, and Espelette pepper. Notes of aquatic flowers, leather, and candied red fruits also emerge. It is a light to medium-bodied wine. The palate is fresh and very balanced, with dynamic fruit excited by an expressive acidity. It is juicy, showing delicate flavours of candied cherry, redcurrant, and a touch of quince, supported by fine, well-matured tannins. Stylistically, it is a refined, elegant, and harmonious wine, possessing a loquacious persistence where soil and spices intermingle. The wine is made from 45+ year old vines, with gentle extraction to preserve delicacy, and is aged in barrel with 20% new oak. The finish is very focused, marked by a saline and mineral aspect, with substantial length. The ABV is 12.5% or 13.5%. The optimal drinking window is 5 to 8 years, or 3 to 7 years. The vineyards are farmed using practising organic methods.

Food Pairing

This refined red Burgundy pairs wonderfully with roast poultry, especially fried roast chicken and peas. Suggested pairings also include pork filet mignon with mushrooms, guinea fowl in grapes, rabbit with mushrooms and lardons, and mature Comté cheese.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Monthélie was marked by balanced weather conditions, allowing for optimal ripening of the Pinot Noir. This resulted in wines with strong aromatic intensity, a pure expression of red fruits, and a refined, harmonious structure. The density and maturity of the vintage have given this village wine a dazzling quality.

title: Francois Mikulski Pinot Noir Bourgogne 2023
bodyHtml:
François Mikulski Pinot Noir Bourgogne 2022 is an organic Pinot Noir from the Côte d'Or in Burgundy. Known for its elegance, it showcases the purity of Pinot Noir with a focus on lightness and aromatic complexity​.

  • Colour: Bright ruby with hints of garnet.
  • Aroma: Fresh cherry, raspberry, and light earthy notes.
  • Body: Light-bodied with a silky texture and vibrant acidity.
  • Finish: Clean and refreshing with lingering red fruit notes

title: Flavio Fanti Brunello di Montalcino 'La Palazzetta  - Special Edition' 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

La Palazzetta Brunello di Montalcino is a red wine from Italy, produced in the Tuscany region and the Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation. The estate is a family owned and operated business run by the Fanti family. The winery's philosophy is centred on minimal intervention, with the entire estate certified organic, focusing on the quality and authenticity of the Sangiovese Grosso grape. Their vineyards are located near the Abbey of Sant'Antimo, known for its favourable microclimate.

Wine Description

The wine is 100% Sangiovese Grosso. It exhibits a beautiful, deep ruby red colour. The aromatic profile is complex and elegant, offering scents of ripe red fruit, cherry, plum, tobacco leaf, and exotic spice. Nuances of licorice, forest floor, and mint also emerge. It is a full bodied wine. The palate is fresh, powerful, and deeply structured, with concentrated fruit and earthy notes. The tannins are fine-grained and firm, providing the backbone for long ageing. Stylistically, it is a classic, pure, and savoury Brunello, showcasing the intense character of the grape. The wine is aged for 36 months in large Slavonian oak barrels (botti). The finish is long, dry, and persistent. The ABV is 14.5%. The optimal drinking window is from 2025 to 2045. The wine is organic.

title: Carpineto Dogajolo Toscano Bianco 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Carpineto Dogajolo Toscano Bianco is a white wine from Italy, produced in the Tuscany region and the Toscano I.G.T. (Indicazione Geografica Tipica) appellation. Carpineto is a winery with a history dating back to 1967, owned by the Sacchet and Zaccheo families. The winery's philosophy centres on producing international quality wines that are deeply representative of the Tuscan region. The Dogajolo line is celebrated as the estate's younger, approachable expression of Tuscan winemaking.

Wine Description

The wine typically has a pale, bright straw-yellow colour with greenish hints. The aromatic profile is noted for its freshness and vivacity, offering fragrant notes of green apple, white peach, citrus, and a hint of acacia flower. The varietal composition is a blend of Chardonnay, Grechetto, and Sauvignon Blanc. It is a medium bodied wine. The palate is fresh, crisp, and well balanced, with a lovely structure and persistence. Stylistically, it is a clean, modern, and versatile white wine. It is fermented and matured in stainless steel tanks to preserve its aromatic purity and freshness. The finish is clean and lingering. The ABV is typically 12.5%. The optimal drinking window is young, within two years of the vintage. Information on organic status is not available in the sources.

Food Pairing

This fresh white wine is highly versatile and makes an excellent aperitif. Suggested pairings include light appetizers, seafood, raw fish, vegetarian dishes, and white meats. It also pairs well with pasta and risotto dishes.

title: Catena Appellation Paraje Altamira Malbec 2022
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from Argentina, specifically from the prestigious Paraje Altamira district in the Uco Valley, Mendoza. Produced by Bodega Catena Zapata, a family-owned estate founded in 1902 by Italian immigrant Nicola Catena, the winery is celebrated for its pioneering work in high-altitude viticulture. The "Appellation" range is inspired by the French village-wine concept, focusing on the distinct terroir of specific sites; here, the high-altitude (1,095m) chalky soils of Altamira are the focal point.

Wine Description

Catena Appellation Paraje Altamira Malbec 2022 displays an intense purple hue. The nose is expressive and highly aromatic, offering scents of ripe blackberries, blueberries, and red plums layered with floral notes of lavender, violets, and a hint of orange peel or balsam. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and well-structured, featuring an elegant, "chalky" texture that is characteristic of the Altamira terroir. It is characterized by its fresh acidity, silky tannins, and flavours of dark berries, fine spices, and a touch of cocoa leading to a dry, mineral-inflected finish. This 100% Malbec has an ABV of 13.2% to 13.5% and was aged for 6 to 13 months in French oak barrels (25% to 40% new). While the winery is a champion of sustainable farming, this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through 2032.

Accolades

  • Vinous (Joaquín Hidalgo) - 92 points.

  • James Suckling - 92 points.

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 92 points.

Food Pairing

The fresh acidity and elegant, chalky structure of this Malbec make it a sophisticated partner for a wide range of proteins. It pairs perfectly with leaner cuts of grilled red meat such as sirloin or flank steak, as well as roast chicken or turkey with savory herbs. Its spicy and floral undertones also complement meat pot pies, lamb chops with mint, and dishes featuring earthy mushrooms or roasted peppers. For a cheese course, it is an exceptional match for blue cheeses like Gorgonzola or pungent varieties like Manchego and aged Cheddar.

title: Taylor Fladgate 30 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml: At a beautiful moment in its evolution, this blend has a lingering richness. The aromas are deep, complex and heady; the flavors of fresh apricot and nutmeats bring Douro almonds to mind. While the texture is luscious, light tannins keep it tight and firm. For fireside conversation.

title: Chateau De Miniere Tension Chenin Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine comes from France, specifically the Loire Valley, within the Touraine appellation. Château de Minière is a 16th-century estate that, since 2010, has been owned and operated by a passionate Belgian couple, Kathleen Van den Berghe and her husband. Their philosophy centres on respecting the land and expressing the terroir, committing to organic farming and minimal intervention in the cellar.

The 'Tension' cuvée is made from 100 per cent Chenin Blanc. This wine displays a bright, clear, golden colour. On the nose, it is highly aromatic, featuring notes of citrus, grapefruit, and exotic fruits, with a hint of honey. On the palate, the wine is powerful, mineral-driven, and bone-dry, showing exceptional tension (hence the name) and freshness. It is known for its purity and long-lasting finish. Stylistically, it is a dry, crisp expression of Chenin Blanc, demonstrating great balance and a subtle salty edge derived from the estate's limestone and clay soils. The estate is certified organic.

title: Chateau De Miniere Equilibre Cabernet Franc 2022
bodyHtml:
This red wine comes from France's Loire Valley, within the Touraine subregion, and is designated under the Bourgueil AOC appellation. Château de Minière is an estate dedicated to organic farming, led by Kathleen Van den Berghe, who focuses on a modern approach to Bourgueil traditions. The estate's philosophy emphasizes gentle winemaking with limited extraction to produce fresh, balanced wines that express the unique terroir.

The 'Équilibre' cuvée is a pure varietal, made from 100 per cent Cabernet Franc. It is sourced from the estate's younger vines, which are typically 30 to 40 years old. The wine displays a ruby colour with garnet reflections. The nose presents aromas of fresh red fruits. On the palate, the wine is described as round and full, with a fruity accent that supports a very lightly tannic structure. Stylistically, it is designed to be accessible, light, sincere, and expressed with harmony, making it a true gateway to Minière's red wines. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 13.5 per cent. The grapes are grown on sand and sandy-clay soil, and the estate is certified organic. The optimal drinking window is generally considered to be up to five years.

title: Chateau De Miniere Interpretation Cabernet Franc 2018
bodyHtml:
This red wine is from France, originating in the Loire Valley, within the Bourgueil AOC appellation. Château de Minière, an estate with a rich history, has been led since 2010 by Kathleen Van den Berghe and her husband. They have a philosophy focused on respect for the land and the terroir, committing the 29-hectare vineyard to organic farming (certified since 2013).

Wine Description

The 'Interprétation' cuvée is a pure expression of the Cabernet Franc grape, making up 100 per cent of the varietal composition. Sourced from older vines (some over 100 years old) on the estate's limestone and clay soils, this wine is typically only made in the greatest vintages. This red wine exhibits an intense red colour. The nose is noted for being very expressive, with aromas of red fruits, spices, and pepper. On the palate, the wine is fresh yet structured, with a good texture and the classic earthy-herbal notes of Cabernet Franc. It is known for its intense, expressive, and delicate character, combining power with elegance. The finish is long and very aromatic, with hints of spices and pepper along with deeper blackberry and bramble flavours. Stylistically, it is complex, precise, and expressive, meant for laying down.

title: Luneau Papin Gula Ana Muscadet 2020
bodyHtml:
This exceptional dry white wine originates from France, within the western Loire Valley, specifically the Pays Nantais region, and is classified under the Muscadet Sèvre et Maine AOC, bearing the Cru Communal Goulaine designation. The estate, Domaine Luneau Papin, is one of the leading names in Muscadet, tracing its roots back to the early 18th century, with the Luneau family growing the Melon de Bourgogne grape for over two centuries. The current generation, led by Pierre-Marie Luneau and his wife Marie Chartier-Luneau, continues the estate's tradition of privileging the Melon de Bourgogne grape with a dedication to expressing the unique terroir.

Wine Description

The 'Gula Ana' cuvée is a pure expression of the Melon de Bourgogne grape, making up 100 per cent of the varietal composition, sourced from old vines planted in 1974. It presents an intense straw yellow colour with radiant luminosity. The wine’s aroma is complex, displaying bright, juicy fruit notes of yellow apples, mirabelle plums, and kumquats, underpinned by lanolin, crushed stone, and a salty Atlantic breeze. On the palate, the wine is juicy and crisp, exhibiting great complexity and a remarkable structure. It features elegant acidity, deep minerality, and striking salinity, which, with air, develops creamy texture and nuances of ginger, tobacco, and caramel. This Muscadet is noted for its impressive depth and length, demonstrating a precise balance between fruit, fresh acidity, and mineral structure.

title: Jaboulet Crozes Hermitage Les Jalets 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This wine comes from France, specifically the Rhône Valley region, within the Crozes-Hermitage AOC appellation of the Northern Rhône. Paul Jaboulet Aîné is a historic winery, founded in 1834, and has built a reputation for producing exceptional wines from the diverse terroirs of the region. Since the Frey family acquired the estate in 2006, they have embraced organic and biodynamic farming practices, with all Jaboulet vineyards being certified organic as of 2016. The 'Les Jalets' cuvée is sourced from terraced vineyards in Les Chassis, named after the large, rounded stones, or 'galets,' deposited by ancient glaciers. Winemaker Caroline Frey's philosophy centers on minimal intervention to allow the natural expression of the terroir to shine.

Wine Description

This red wine (Rouge) typically displays a deep garnet red colour. The aroma offers notes of black fruits and spices, with a bouquet layering raspberry, wild strawberry, blackberry, and ripe cherry, along with hints of violet, pepper, and licorice. On the palate, it is described as juicy, supple, and round, with a medium body and savoury notes of black olive and leather as well as ripe raspberries. The wine features silky and refined tannins that are fine-grained, providing structure without excessive weight. It is noted for its excellent balance and refreshing freshness. The finish is long, persistent, and smooth, sometimes showing subtle roasted notes.

title: Albert Boxler Pinot Gris Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
This compelling white wine hails from France, specifically the Alsace region. Domaine Albert Boxler, situated in the village of Niedermorschwihr, is a venerable estate whose family settled in Alsace in 1672. The domaine has been led by Jean Boxler since 1996, who, following in his grandfather Albert's footsteps, focuses on producing precise, expressive wines that clearly reflect their granite-driven terroir.

The 'Réserve' bottling is made from 100 per cent Pinot Gris. The grapes are sourced from granite parcels in Niedermorschwihr, including young vines from the Grand Cru sites Sommerberg and Brand, with some vines as old as 65 years. Pinot Gris from Alsace is prized for its full-bodied and richly textured style. The wine exhibits a nose of ripe russet pear, subtle smoke, and pepper spice. On the palate, it is generous with juicy pear fruit, but remains stony and precise in shape, showcasing a lovely flicker of smoky reduction on the long finish. User reviews frequently mention notes of honey, ginger, minerals, apricot, peach, and a savoury, earthy side. Stylistically, it is complex, precise, and flinty, often showing a hint of residual sugar (around 15 g/L depending on the vintage) which perfectly balances the palate. The estate has practiced organic farming for over twenty years.

title: Albert Boxler Gewurztraminer Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
This opulent white wine comes from France, specifically the Alsace region. Domaine Albert Boxler, situated above the village of Niedermorschwihr, is a benchmark for classical Alsatian expression. The Boxler family settled in Alsace in 1672, but it was not until 1946 that Albert Boxler, after returning from Montana, vinified and bottled the first vintage under the family name. Today, the estate is led by Jean Boxler, who approaches winemaking with the rigour of an artist, focusing on wines that are authentic, sincere, precise, and expressive of the terroir.

The 'Réserve' bottling is a pure expression of the Gewurztraminer grape, making up 100 per cent of its varietal composition. It typically presents a golden colour. The nose is expressive, spicy, and floral, with elegant notes that can include rosehips, ginger, lychee, ripe pink grapefruit, and soursop. On the palate, the wine is often suave, creamy, round, and rich in ripe fruit, demonstrating a curvy and tropical texture with fine, structuring bitters. The ABV is typically around 13.5 per cent to 14.0 per cent. The wine is made from certified organic estate vineyards, where some vines are more than 80 years old. It is aged for around eleven months on the lees, typically in large, neutral oak foudres or stainless steel. The optimal drinking window extends well into the future, with cellaring potential up to 2038 or longer for certain vintages.

title: Negra Modelo 355 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml: A medium bodied lager with slow roasted caramel malts that is brewed to prove dark beer can deliver both full flavor and refreshing taste.  Brewed longer to enhance the flavors, this Munich Dunkel-style Lager gives way to a rich flavor and remarkably smooth taste.

title: Laphroaig Elements 3.0
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Laphroaig Elements 3.0 is a limited edition Single Malt Scotch Whisky from the country of Scotland, specifically the Islay region. The Laphroaig Distillery, established in 1815, is renowned worldwide for its distinctly smoky and medicinal Islay whisky. The 'Elements' series, of which this is the third release, focuses on exploring how adjustments to the whisky-making process impact the final flavour profile. This expression specifically explores the impact of a shorter fermentation period on the resulting spirit.

Spirit Description

Elements 3.0 is a cask-strength, non-chill filtered whisky made with a notably short fermentation period of only 55 hours. This is the standard length of fermentation for Laphroaig, and it is a key difference from other whiskies in the Elements series. The spirit was matured in a combination of refill quarter casks and first-fill bourbon barrels. The colour is described as a light gold. On the nose, it is intensely smoky, featuring aromas of soot, coal dust, sweet lemon oil, and new leather, alongside hints of sea spray and subtle sweetness. The palate is mouth-coating, sweet, and powerful, with flavours of sweet medicinal smoke, lemon zest, sweet cream, and sea salt. The shorter fermentation is believed to highlight the spirit's core, medicinal and peaty character. The finish is long and dry, with a lingering medicinal peat smoke and a sweet, smoky aftertaste. It is bottled at a cask strength of 54.3% ABV.

Accolades

As a limited-edition series, the Elements releases, including 3.0, are highly sought after by collectors and enthusiasts who appreciate the distillery's transparent approach to production methods. This particular release is appreciated for its ability to showcase the distillery's classic, smoky profile in a pure, cask-strength format.

Food Pairing

The intense peat smoke, medicinal notes, and creamy sweetness of Laphroaig Elements 3.0 make it a robust pairing partner.

  • Savoury & Rich: It pairs exceptionally well with strong, pungent flavours like blue cheese or smoked salmon, as the peat smoke harmonises with the richness.

  • Meats: Consider pairing it with smoky barbecue, charcuterie, or roasted meats to complement the whisky's intensity.

  • Serving: Due to its high ABV, it is recommended to enjoy it neat or with a splash of water, which helps to temper the strength and open up the aromatic complexity.

title: Laphroaig Elements 2.0
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Laphroaig Elements 2.0 is a limited edition Single Malt Scotch Whisky from the country of Scotland, specifically the Islay region. The Laphroaig Distillery was established in 1815 by brothers Donald and Alexander Johnston, becoming one of the three Kildalton Distilleries on the island's south coast. The distillery is renowned for using its own malting floor and peaty water from the Kilbride Stream, contributing to its signature smoky, medicinal flavour. The 'Elements' series is an exploratory line that challenges the boundaries of whisky making by focusing on how different aspects of production can engineer unique flavours.

Spirit Description

Elements 2.0 is a cask-strength, non-chill filtered whisky that was distilled during a particularly frosty January. The whisky's defining feature is its extended fermentation process of up to 115 hours, significantly longer than the standard 55 hours. This longer fermentation encourages a secondary fermentation that introduces extra tropical and fruity notes, which perfectly balance the spirit's classic peaty character. The colour is a bold, pale gold. The nose is fruity and subtly coastal, with aromas of stewed apples, vanilla custard, and zesty orange peel alongside subtle peaty notes. The palate is fruity, sweet, and salty, delivering flavours of green apples, runny honey, cream soda, and soft peatiness reminiscent of a smouldering bonfire and smoked seafood. The finish is long and sweet, with an increasingly warming smokiness that 'leaves smokiness sitting like a blanket'. It is bottled at a cask strength of 59.6% ABV.

Accolades

This expression has received significant recognition, showcasing the success of the distillery's experimentation. Laphroaig Elements 2.0 was awarded 'Whisky of the Year 2024' by Whisky Advocate, a leading North American whisky magazine. This high rating recognises the uncompromising craftsmanship that went into creating the spirit.

Food Pairing

The intense smoky, fruity, and coastal character of this single malt makes it a suitable partner for bold flavours.

  • Its fruity richness and coastal dimension make it a perfect companion for smoked seafood, raw oysters, or smoked salmon.

  • The smoky notes pair well with rich meats such as steak or with barbecue-style dishes.

  • The sweet and fruity aspects are complemented by desserts like apple-based sweets or very dark chocolate, which often pairs well with peaty whiskies.

  • The cask strength is powerful, so it is best enjoyed neat or with a few drops of water to reveal its full aromatic complexity.

title: The Macallan A Night on Earth: First Light
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Macallan A Night on Earth: The First Light is a limited edition Single Malt Scotch Whisky from the country of Scotland, specifically the Speyside region. The Macallan Distillery was established in 1824 by Alexander Reid, and it is renowned worldwide for its commitment to the mastery of wood and spirit. This release is the fourth instalment in the annual 'A Night on Earth' series, which celebrates how different cultures mark the turn of the year. This edition commemorates the arrival of the new year's first light in New Zealand, one of the first countries in the world to greet the sunrise on January 1st.

Spirit Description

This single malt is crafted from a harmonious combination of sherry-seasoned American and European oak casks, with a sparing inclusion of American oak ex-bourbon barrels. The colour is a deep golden sand. The nose offers caramel notes of burnt icing sugar, a silky vanilla sweetness, red berries, and a fleeting scent of Manuka honey. The palate is rich with caramel and mellow baking spices, vanilla ice cream, toasted marshmallows, stone fruits, and hints of coconut and Manuka honey. The body is warm and welcoming, with a fruity profile that echoes the joy of festive summer gatherings. The finish is sweet and fruity, with mellow spice and a touch of toasted oak. The spirit is bottled at 43% ABV.

Food Pairing

The warm, fruity, and sweet profile of this whisky makes it well-suited for dessert pairings.

  • Sweet Treats: Pair it with sweet and fruity desserts, such as the New Zealand-inspired pavlova, dark chocolate, or fruit tarts.

  • Bakery Items: Its creamy vanilla and sweet oak notes are enhanced by powdered-sugar doughnuts or lemon meringue.

  • Serving Suggestions: It is recommended to be enjoyed neat to fully experience its delicate complexity, or with a few drops of water. It can also be enjoyed in a refreshing long-serve cocktail.

title: Quinta De La Rosa Port 10 Year Old
bodyHtml:
This aged Tawny Port comes from Portugal, specifically the Douro Valley region, under the Porto DOC appellation. Quinta de la Rosa is a family-owned single quinta (estate) that has been producing high-quality Port wine for many generations. The estate is currently owned and run by the Bergqvist family, with Tim Bergqvist and his daughter Sophia at the helm. Since the 1988 vintage, they have been one of the few quintas to bottle their own Port and Douro table wines, focusing on quality and a lighter, drier style.

This is a blend of traditional Douro grape varieties, which typically includes Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz, and Tinta Barroca. It displays a vibrant brick-red colour with a light tawny rim. The nose is complex, showing notes of figs, nuts, dark honey, cinnamon, caramel, and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is rich, mellow, and smooth, offering flavours of dried fruit, nuts, and spice. Stylistically, it is noted for its lovely freshness and balance, combining a youthful fruit character with the mature, nutty complexity developed through extensive aging in old oak pipas (barrels). The average age of the component wines in the blend is ten years. This wine is made from grapes grown on the estate's Grade A vineyards, which are farmed sustainably. Once opened, this aged Tawny can remain fresh for several weeks.

title: Giuseppe Gorelli Rosso di Montalcino 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Giuseppe Gorelli Rosso di Montalcino is a red wine from Italy, produced in the Tuscany region and the Rosso di Montalcino D.O.C. appellation. Owner and winemaker Giuseppe Gorelli is a 'winemaker's winemaker' who was born and bred in Montalcino. He worked with the grand master of Sangiovese, Giulio Gambelli, and spent fifteen years at the Consorzio di Brunello di Montalcino before striking out on his own in 2017. His philosophy is minimalist and soil first, believing that quality is made in the vineyard, and his wines are characterized by finesse and elegance.

Wine Description

The wine is 100% Sangiovese. It has an intense ruby red colour, sometimes with garnet reflections. The aromatic profile is complex, offering scents of cherry, red fruit, ripe berries, and mature strawberries. Notes of floral intensity, dried violet, blood orange, spices, liquorice, and cedar also emerge.

It is a medium bodied wine that is often described as overachieving and leaning toward Brunello territory. The palate is dry, harmonious, fresh, and juicy, with flavours of crushed berries, sour cherry, and plum. It has gripping, long tannins that are fine and attractive, and a lively acidity. Stylistically, it is a classic Montalcino wine at its finest, with laser like purity, elegance, and finesse over power. The wine ferments using ambient yeasts and is aged for about ten months in a combination of Slavonian oak casks and stainless steel. The finish is persistent, long, and minerally, with an earthy, saline quality. The ABV is either 13.5%, 14%, or 15% depending on the vintage.

title: Mathieu and Camille Lapierre Le Beaujolais 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Mathieu and Camille Lapierre Le Beaujolais is a red wine from France, produced in the Beaujolais region. The wine is made by the family run Domaine Lapierre, located in the village of Villié-Morgon. The estate was pioneered by Marcel Lapierre, who was a master of natural wine and a leader in the Beaujolais natural wine movement, rejecting synthetic chemicals and additives. Since Marcel's death in 2010, his son Mathieu and daughter Camille have continued his legacy, maintaining the philosophy of gentle, natural, and now biodynamic viticulture and winemaking. This 'Le Beaujolais' cuvée is considered a lively, fresh take on the appellation.

Wine Description

The wine is 100% Gamay. It has a clear and light ruby colour. The aromatic profile is fragrant and expressive, with a powerful mixture of red and black fruits, often noted as ripe cherries, violets, and strawberry. Further nuances include red raspberry, pomegranate, cedar, and an earthy minerality.

It is a light to medium bodied wine, though it is described as quite full for this category. The palate is round, juicy, and fruit forward, with dark cherry, raspberry, and pomegranate dominating the fruit. The tannins are subtle yet present, providing a good backbone, and are sometimes described as lightly grippy. Stylistically, it is a naturally made wine, that is pure, easy drinking, and offers a silky texture with bright acidity. The wine undergoes full carbonic maceration without sulphur dioxide (SO₂) and is aged for roughly six months. The finish is long and lingers nicely, with the fruit and minerality sticking around. The ABV is 13%. The wine is organic. The optimal drinking window is not explicitly provided, but it is highly drinkable in its youth.

Food Pairing

This wine is classified as 'Light & Juicy,' making it versatile for pairing with a wide range of cuisines. Suggested pairings include charcuterie and cheese platters, mixed bean salad, grilled salmon, sausages, and light pasta dishes. Alternate recommendations include roasted chicken with farro and herb pistou, or Coq au Vin.

title: Cono Sur Pinot Noir 'Ocio' 2019
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Casablanca Valley of Chile, Ocio is the flagship icon of Viña Cono Sur, a winery that has established itself as one of the world's most significant Pinot Noir producers. Founded in 1993, the winery launched the 'Pinot Noir Project' in 1999, collaborating with Burgundian winemaker Martin Prieur to define a premium Chilean expression of the varietal.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir displays a deep ruby red colour and offers a high aromatic intensity. The bouquet is a complex blend of red fruits, cherry, and raspberry, layered with sophisticated notes of spices, tobacco, and a subtle forest floor earthiness. On the palate, the wine is silky and elegant, showcasing a refined concentration of fine tannins balanced by a vibrant acidity. Aged for 14 months in French oak (70% in barrels and 30% in foudres), the wine exhibits remarkable depth and a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing

The elegant structure and vibrant acidity of this Pinot Noir make it an exceptional companion for roasted duck breast, grilled tuna, or delicate red meats. It also pairs seamlessly with earthy mushroom-based dishes and aged cheeses such as Gouda or Manchego.
