title: Champagne Pierre Peter Cuvee de Reserve Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru
bodyHtml:
Exclusively crafted from 100% Grand Cru Chardonnay, this non-vintage Champagne defines elegance and depth. Its extraordinary complexity on the palate is achieved through a generous blend containing at least 45% reserve wines.

At the heart of this cuvée lies a unique "perpetual reserve," inspired by the Solera Method, which is enriched by a library of wines spanning more than 25 different years. With vintages dating back as far as 1988, every sip offers a taste of history and unparalleled maturity.

title: Domaine Amelie & Charles Sparr White Blend 'Cerisier en Fleur'
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Domaine Amelie & Charles Sparr White Blend 'Cerisier en Fleur' is a white wine from France, produced in the Alsace region, and is classified as a Vin de France (VdF). The Domaine was recently established in 2017 by Amélie and Charles Sparr, who both hail from esteemed, long standing winemaking families in Alsace. Their philosophy is a bold one: to create terroir true, dry wines using manual and artisanal techniques, with all vineyards converted to organic and biodynamic practices. The name 'Cerisier en Fleur' translates to 'Cherry Blossom,' referencing the wine's light, floral character.

Wine Description

The wine is a special white blend. The varietal composition is a blend of Riesling, Muscat, and Pinot Blanc. Some sources also mention a blend that includes Pinot Gris. The grapes are sourced from gravel, clay, and limestone soils.

It is a medium bodied wine. The aromatic profile is fresh, with notes of melon and Asian pears, a touch of minty freshness, and a desirable aromatic intrigue. The Muscat grape contributes a distinct floral touch. The palate is succulent, silky, vibrant, and fresh. The Riesling provides a notable acidity, keeping the wine lively. Stylistically, it is smart, fresh, and modern, offering a very dry profile with less than 2 g/L residual sugar. The wine undergoes spontaneous fermentation in stainless steel tanks. The finish is clean and invigorating. The ABV is 12.5%. It is a multi vintage blend. The vineyards are farmed using organic and biodynamic principles. Information on the optimal drinking window is not available in the sources.

Accolades

  • Gismondi On Wine - 16½/20 (2023 vintage)

Food Pairing

This wine is juicy, bright, and fresh, making it a flexible pairing. Suggested pairings include fried food, spicy dishes, roast white meats, stinky cheese, aperitif, and crunchy greens.

title: Campagnola Amarone della Valpolicella Riserva 2013
bodyHtml:
Campagnola Amarone della Valpolicella Riserva is a red wine from Italy, produced in the Veneto region and the Valpolicella D.O.C.G. appellation. The wine is made by the Campagnola family, who have been dedicated to viticulture since 1886 and are now in their fifth generation. The winery's philosophy is rooted in tradition, with a dedication to the appassimento (drying) process that is essential to Amarone, resulting in wines of great concentration, structure, and longevity. The Riserva represents a selection of the best grapes and extended maturation.

Wine Description

The wine has an intense, dark garnet red colour. The aromatic profile is rich, intense, and complex, offering scents of dried plums, ripe cherries, black cherry preserve, and wild berries. Further notes include tobacco, dark chocolate, leather, liquorice, roasted almonds, and hints of spice.

The varietal composition is a traditional blend of Corvina, Rondinella, and Molinara. It is a full bodied wine. The palate is very warm, velvety, and elegant, with concentrated, raisined fruit flavours. The tannins are fine and harmonious, perfectly integrated with the wine's acidity and notable structure. Stylistically, it is a magnificent, powerful, and balanced wine with great concentration and a long life ahead.

Food Pairing

This classic Amarone pairs exceptionally well with rich, substantial dishes. Suggested pairings include braised beef, game dishes (such as venison or wild boar), roasts, and aged hard cheeses like Parmesan.

title: Bowmore Masters' Selection 21 Year Old Edition 4
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, specifically the Islay region. It is the fourth and final release in the Bowmore Aston Martin Masters' Selection series. The Bowmore Distillery, the oldest licensed whisky producer on Islay, dates back to 1779. This expression is a collaborative creation between Bowmore's Master Blender Ron Welsh (before his retirement) and Aston Martin's Chief Creative Officer Marek Reichman. The collaboration aims to celebrate the shared values of precision, heritage, and excellence between the two luxury brands.

2. Spirit Description

This is a 21-year-old single malt. It was matured in a careful selection of ex-Tawny Port American Oak casks and Refill Sherry Butts, specifically Oloroso Sherry butts. The maturation process was designed to bring together components of the previous three releases to achieve a finale that celebrates flavour and complexity.

  • Colour: Mahogany, a deep and timeless tone infused from the Tawny Port casks.

  • Aroma: Rich and complex, balanced between a nutty character and sweetness. Initial notes include roasted hazelnuts, leather, fresh pipe tobacco, dark chocolate, and oak spices. This is followed by dark maple syrup, liquorice, and charred peaches, with a subtle background of Crème Anglaise, bergamot syrup, and light peaty notes.

  • Palate: Honey sweet with rich salted toffee, roasted chestnuts, and grilled Seville orange zest. Further notes include sultanas, dry thyme, oak spices, and velvety milk chocolate. A gentle peat smoke is also present.

  • Body: The mouthfeel is initially velvety.

  • Finish: The finish is long and drying. It is mouth-warming with lingering notes of peat smoke.

  • Stylistic Notes: This single malt pays homage to the intentionality that defines Bowmore, gathering momentum, flavour, and intensity at every stage. It is a limited-edition release.

  • ABV: The alcoholic strength is 51.4% ABV.

title: Okunomatsu Hiya-Oroshi - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
The Okunomatsu Sake Brewery, established in 1716, has a rich history dating back to a family of defeated samurai who turned to sake production to make a living. Now managed by the 19th generation of the family, the brewery is dedicated to crafting powerful sake with clarity and precision. Located in the idyllic Nihonmatsu City at the foot of Mount Adatara, the brewery is blessed with pure, clean water that has trickled down through the mountain for 40 years, providing the ideal mineral balance for brewing.

Sake Description

'Hiya-oroshi' is a seasonal style of sake released in the autumn after being stored coolly throughout the summer. This maturation period allows the sake to develop a rich, mature, and umami-forward flavour profile. It typically has a soft, rounded texture that complements its complex aroma, which may include notes of fruit, steamed rice, and spices. The taste is often milder and richer than freshly pressed sake, with the roughness fading away.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include hearty autumn foods such as red meats, shellfish, and mushrooms.

title: Tenuta di Vignole 'Crespine' Gran Selezione 2013
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This Gran Selezione red wine originates from Italy, specifically the Tuscany region, within the Chianti Classico DOCG appellation, near the town of Panzano in Chianti. Tenuta di Vignole is a Chianti Classico specialist situated in the heart of the region, known as the Conca d'Oro (the Golden Basin), an area famous for its prestigious wines. The winery is committed to producing high-quality Sangiovese, with all grapes grown in the estate's own vineyards.

Wine Description

The 'Crespine' Gran Selezione 2013 is a powerful and concentrated expression of Chianti Classico. It presents an intense colour, with a vivid ruby red that has slightly orange reflections after aging. The wine is made primarily from Sangiovese (100% or sometimes including 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, depending on the source). The nose reveals spicy aromas and hints of black cherries and blackberries, with tertiary notes developing with age. Some tasting notes for the 2013 vintage describe a floral opening of rose and lilac, followed by notes of citrus and undried spices. The wine is velvety, full-bodied, and warm on the palate, with well-integrated, yet still present, tannins. The 2013 is noted for its bright acidity and a long, persistent, and satisfying finish with a sweet aftertaste. It is made from a selection of the best Sangiovese grapes, which are handpicked and fermented in tonneaux (large barrels). The malolactic fermentation and aging for more than 30 months took place in small 225-litre barriques.

title: Portia Verdejo Rueda 2024
bodyHtml:
The winery is known for its architecturally impressive, avant-garde design, which displays modern design, winemaking function, and artistic detail. Bodegas Portia is owned by Familia Martínez Zabala. The winemaking philosophy is centred on creating a modern expression of Ribera del Duero by prioritizing the preservation of freshness and fruit aromas, and minimizing the influence of oak.

Wine Description

The nose is highly aromatic and complex, dominated by notes of white peach, citrus fruit, fennel, a hint of tropical fruit, and pleasant herbaceous notes. On the palate, the wine is fresh, juicy, and lively with mineral finesse and well-integrated acidity. It is fine and elegant, with a very balanced passage and characteristic, slightly bitter nuances. The wine features a well-defined texture and medium body. It has a clear, crisp, and refreshingly long finish with herbaceous notes.

Food Pairing

The Portia Verdejo Rueda is an ideal accompaniment to grilled fish, marinated seafood, light tapas, or goat's cheese. It pairs well with appetizers, fish-based dishes, fideuà, rice, pasta dishes, smoked foods, soft and creamy cheeses, and white meats.

title: Bad Bull Spicy Tamarindo
bodyHtml:
The Bad Bull Spicy Tamarindo is a flavoured spirit originating from Mexico. The brand, Bad Bull, crafts this product by combining a Blanco Tequila with the exotic flavours of tamarind and a hint of spice. The resulting spirit is made to be well-balanced and approachable, making it a popular choice for cocktails or sipping on its own.

Tequila Description

This flavoured tequila presents a clear straw colour. The aroma is complex, featuring notes of sweet peach rings, green apple candy, chillies, and honey. On the palate, Bad Bull blends the sweet, savoury, and sour notes of the tamarind fruit, which is then followed by a fresh hint of spiciness. The spirit is described as having a dry-yet-fruity medium body and an easy, smooth finish, with lingering flavours of sour green apple, lemon zest, vanilla, and aloe.

Suggested Pairings

The sweet, tangy, and spicy profile pairs well with the refreshing taste of cucumber soda.

title: Proprieta Sperino Uvaggio 2020
bodyHtml:
The Proprietà Sperino winery was re-established in 1999 when Paolo De Marchi, one of Italy’s most respected artisans, and his son Luca returned to their Lessona roots to restore the historic family estate. The Sperino family—an ancient dynasty of medical professionals—was involved in viticulture in the 19th century and were pioneers in bottling and research against Phylloxera. The winery's philosophy is to remain faithful to history by employing traditional methods like spontaneous fermentation in open, wooden fermenters, minimal technological intervention, and avoiding chemical herbicides and artificial fertilisers in the vineyards.

Wine Description

On the nose, it offers a very floral perfume, with lifted aromas that include red/purplish fruit, dried herbs, rose petal, blood orange, mint, and white pepper. The palate is packed with attractive, fresh, and juicy red fruit. Stylistic notes include a seductive simplicity, great texture from its supple, approachable tannins, and well-balanced acidity. It is elegant and approachable, with savoury and mineral notes that extend through the long, vibrant finish. Nebbiolo's characteristic structure is tempered and complemented by the Vespolina and Croatina.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for the 'Uvaggio' include traditional Piedmontese dishes. Its refined tannins and savoury notes make it an excellent match for a rich risotto with fresh porcini mushrooms.

title: Anne Sophie Dubois Fleurie 'Les Cocottes' 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant red wine originates from France, specifically the Beaujolais region, within the prestigious cru of Fleurie. The estate is run by Anne-Sophie Dubois, a dynamic winemaker who took over the domaine in 2006 at the age of 23. Originally from a Champagne winemaking family, she chose to settle in Beaujolais in 1992 when her family purchased the property. Anne-Sophie is part of a young generation of vignerons redefining Beaujolais, focusing on organic farming (certified since 2018) and a minimal intervention approach in the cellar. Her philosophy is to express the fruit and finesse of Gamay grown on the pink granite soils of her Fleurie vineyards, using old barrels for ageing without imparting an oaky taste.

Wine Description

This 'Les Cocottes' is made from 100% Gamay. It is the first wine bottled in each vintage and is created for joyful, early drinking. The wine is a semi-carbonic maceration style, showcasing primary fruit and aromatic intensity. It typically presents as a light-to-medium bodied red. Expect a bouquet and palate bursting with crunchy red berry fruits like cherry, raspberry coulis, and wild strawberry, alongside notes of plum and a subtle earthy or floral undertone.

Food Pairing

This fresh and lively Beaujolais is an incredibly versatile companion to a variety of foods. It pairs beautifully with cheese and charcuterie, grilled duck or other poultry, and French onion soup. The wine's vibrant red fruit and refreshing acidity make it a superb match for BBQ seafood.

title: Miolo Lote 43 Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
The history of the Miolo Winery began in 1897 when the Italian patriarch Giuseppe Miolo arrived in Brazil and purchased his first plot of land, known as 'Lote 43', in what is now Vale dos Vinhedos. Produced only with the best vintages, the 'Lote 43' wine pays homage to the family patriarch and expresses the most distinctive characteristics of the region. The philosophy of the Miolo Wine Group is to explore the Brazilian terroir and show the world the country's potential for producing quality wines.

Wine Description

The 2022 vintage is a blend of 60% Merlot and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon. The wine presents a ruby colour that is very intense and deep.

  • Aroma: The bouquet is highly aromatic, offering notes of sour cherries, mulberries, and roasted herbs, along with intense notes of plum, tobacco, truffles, cocoa, and cloves.

  • Palate and Body: It is full bodied, soft, and juicy. The palate is mellow and ripe, with a light sweet-sour touch.

  • Finish: The rounded tannins and correct level of acidity provide a unique freshness and balance, leading to a persistent and extensive finish.

Accolades

  • 'James Suckling - 93 points'

Food Pairing

It is an excellent match for hearty foods like the 'gaucho' barbecue, especially picanha medallions, or meats with a certain level of sweetness, high tenderness, and succulence.

title: Checkmate Queen Taken Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Checkmate Artisanal Winery Queen Taken Chardonnay 2022 is a white wine from Canada, produced in the Okanagan Valley region of British Columbia. Checkmate Artisanal Winery was established in 2012 with a bold vision to produce world class Chardonnay and Merlot in the Okanagan Valley, setting a new standard for excellence. The winery's philosophy centres on minimal intervention, allowing nature to take its course and enabling the grapes, which are sourced from unique, single vineyard blocks, to fully express their unique terroir. The 'Queen Taken' Chardonnay is sourced from a single vineyard block within the Oliver Osoyoos sub region, known for its concentration and texture.

Wine Description

The wine is 100% Chardonnay. It has a pale gold colour. The aromatic profile is rich and complex, offering scents of butterscotch, spice, lemon curd, and white peach. Further notes include lime, grapefruit, and a distinct minerality.

It is a full bodied wine. The palate is creamy and plush, with a generous core of concentrated fruit. Flavours include brioche, butterscotch, and lemon meringue, beautifully integrated with a bright, focused acidity. Stylistically, it is a powerful, rich, and elegant Chardonnay that balances New World intensity with Old World finesse. The wine underwent wild fermentation and was aged for 16 months in French oak barrels, 40% new. The finish is long, complex, and marked by a subtle minerality. The ABV is 14.1%. The optimal drinking window is now through 2030. The vineyards are farmed using organic practices.

title: Rivarose Mediterranee Sparkling Rose
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Rivarose Méditerranée Sparkling Rosé is a sparkling wine from France, produced in the Provence region, specifically under the Méditerranée I.G.P. (Indication Géographique Protégée) appellation. The winery's heritage dates back to 1876 when it was known as Vins Rameau, and it is the oldest sparkling wine producer in Provence. The current name, Rivarose, was adopted in 2004. The winery's philosophy is rooted in traditional methods while specializing exclusively in high-quality rosé sparkling wines.

Wine Description

The wine has a delicate, luminous pale pink colour with fine, persistent bubbles. The aromatic profile is fresh and intense, offering beautiful notes of red berries, particularly raspberry, wild strawberry, and cherry. Further aromas include subtle hints of flowers and citrus.

The varietal composition is a blend of traditional Provençal grapes, including Cinsault, Grenache, and Syrah. It is a medium bodied wine. The palate is lively and fresh, with lovely roundness and a crisp texture. Flavours of red berries and cherry dominate the taste. Stylistically, it is a dry, elegant, and well balanced sparkling rosé. The wine undergoes its second fermentation using the traditional méthode close (Charmat method) to preserve the fresh fruit character. The finish is long, clean, and refreshing. The ABV is 12.5%. It is ready to be consumed now.

title: Poplar Grove Syrah 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Poplar Grove Syrah is a red wine from Canada, produced in the Okanagan Valley region of British Columbia. Poplar Grove Winery was founded in 1993 by the Holler family on the Naramata Bench near Penticton. The winery's philosophy is a dedicated focus on the quality of their estate grown grapes, which are sourced from vineyards across the Okanagan Valley. Poplar Grove is known for its commitment to growing and producing Bordeaux varietals, but its Syrah program is highly regarded.

Wine Description

The wine is 100% Syrah. It has a deep, saturated purple red colour. The aromatic profile is complex and intense, offering notes of black cherry, blackcurrant, dark chocolate, tobacco, and black pepper. Further aromas include plum, cassis, dried fig, and hints of toasted oak.

It is a full bodied wine. The palate is rich and velvety, with an expansive mouthfeel and flavours of dark berries, mocha, plum, and black pepper. It has firm, integrated tannins and a good acidic structure. Stylistically, it is a big, bold, and concentrated wine with excellent balance. The wine was aged for 22 months in 50% new French oak barrels. The finish is long and elegant. The ABV is 14.5%. The optimal drinking window is now through 2030. Information on the organic status of the wine is not available in the sources.

title: Condesa Prickly Pear and Orange Blossom Gin
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Condesa Prickly Pear and Orange Blossom Gin is a spirit from the country of Mexico, specifically the region of Mexico City (CDMX). The gin is produced by Flor de Luna, a micro-distillery established in Mexico City in 2015. It is noted for being the first distillery in Mexico where only women maestras destiladoras (master distillers) work, led by Maestra Destiladora Hillhamn Salome. The name 'Condesa' is inspired by the thriving, artistic neighbourhood of La Condesa in Mexico City.

Spirit Description

This gin is an Extra Dry Gin that is formulated to capture the essence of a sunny Mexican afternoon. The key botanicals include juniper berries, coriander seeds, xoconostle (magenta prickly pear), orange blossom, raspberry, and lime zest. The base spirit is derived from Mexican grains, including rye, corn, barley, and wheat. The distillation is done in handmade copper pot stills with reflux chambers. The spirit is described as clean, bright, and fragrant, combining indigenous desert cactus fruit with soft floral notes. On the nose, it offers aromas of fresh prickly pear and delicate orange blossom. The palate delivers flavours of vibrant prickly pear, floral orange blossom, and a pop of raspberry acidity. It is smooth, refreshing, and balanced, with a body that is approachable and enjoyable. The finish is long and elegant, with lingering floral and fruity notes. It is bottled at 43% ABV.

title: Taylor Fladgate 'Victory' 80 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
The 80-Year-Old "Victory" Port—a rare, historic release anchored in the iconic 1945 vintage—originates from Portugal within the world-famous Douro Valley region. Harvested during the historic autumn of 1945 as World War II came to an end, this bottle stands as a living artifact of 20th-century history. Renowned Port houses, most notably Taylor Fladgate with their Very Old Single Harvest releases, preserved select casks of this extraordinary vintage deep in their lodge cellars in Vila Nova de Gaia. The winemaking philosophy behind this cuvée relies on decades of patient, unhurried wood aging. By allowing the fortified wine to evaporate and concentrate slowly inside seasoned oak pipes over eight decades, the winery transformed a legendary harvest into a pinnacle of intensity, complexity, and liquid history.

Wine Description

This fortified tawny port presents a deep, luminous amber-mahogany appearance in the glass with a striking olive-green rim—the visual hallmark of extreme cask age. It possesses a full-bodied, viscous, and extraordinarily concentrated structure defined by a silky, mouth-coating, and almost syrupy texture balanced by searing natural acidity. The sensory profile is astonishingly intense and multifaceted, opening with a rich bouquet of dried figs, medjool dates, dark raisins, and candied orange peel, seamlessly intertwined with secondary and tertiary notes of toasted walnuts, pipe tobacco, molasses, espresso, singed caramel, cedarwood, and antique furniture varnish. On the expansive palate, it delivers a wave of concentrated dark treacle, dried stone fruits, and warm Christmas spices, bound together by a vibrant acid backbone that cuts cleanly through its natural sweetness. The finish is virtually endless, lingering on the palate for minutes with residual impressions of roasted coffee, exotic spice, toasted nuts, and singed oak.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional field blend of classic Douro grape varieties, dominated by Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz (Tempranillo), Tinta Barroca, and Tinto Cão.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes were foot-trodden in traditional granite lagares and fortified with neutral grape spirit (aguardente) to halt fermentation while retaining natural sugars. Aged for 80 years in neutral oak pipes (approximately 600-liter casks), the wine underwent continuous slow oxidation and concentration through evaporation (the "angel's share"), yielding a wine of incredible structural intensity that requires no further bottle aging.

  • ABV: 20.0% to 20.5%.

Vintage Quality

The 1945 vintage in the Douro Valley is universally acknowledged as one of the greatest, most legendary Port vintages in recorded history. Following a dry winter and a hot summer with minimal rainfall, yields were severely reduced, but the surviving grape clusters achieved unprecedented sugar levels, phenolic concentration, and thick-skinned color extraction. Picked by hand during a season filled with global celebration, the 1945 harvest produced wines of immense power and tannic longevity. Decades of micro-oxygenation in wood softened those fierce young tannins into a seamless, velvety elixir. Today, 80-year-old bottlings from this harvest stand at their absolute zenith, offering a rare tasting experience that bridges world history and liquid artistry.

Food Pairing

The profound density, vibrant acidity, and complex nutty profile of an 80-year-old aged tawny Port make it a decadent standalone digestif or an extraordinary companion to rich desserts and sharp cheeses.

  • Cheeses: Pairs magnificently with pungent, aged blue cheeses such as Stilton, Roquefort, or Gorgonzola Piccante, where the wine's sweetness cuts through the cheese's salt and cream.

  • Nuts & Dried Fruits: Complements toasted walnut tarts, pecan pie, roasted almonds, and figs soaked in honey or dark spirits.

  • Desserts: Matches gracefully with high-percentage dark chocolate tarts, crème brûlée, sticky toffee pudding, or traditional fruitcakes.

  • Cigars: An exceptional pairing for a fine, aged Habano or full-bodied Dominican cigar post-dinner.

title: The Prisoner Wine Co. - The Prisoner Derange Red Blend 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Prisoner Derange Red Blend is a wine from the United States, specifically the Napa Valley subregion within California. The Prisoner Wine Company, known for its bold style, was founded on the philosophy of creating 'mixed blacks' that were inspired by the Italian immigrants who originally settled in Napa Valley. The winery's first release, 'The Prisoner', quickly achieved cult status and sparked a trend toward innovative California red blends. The name 'Derange' is French for 'deranged' or 'disordered', reflecting the blend's nature of combining high-elevation and premium lots from across the portfolio.

Wine Description

This wine is a powerfully structured red blend, typically composed of Cabernet Sauvignon, Petite Sirah, and Syrah. Other varietals used in the blend often include Merlot, Malbec, and Zinfandel. The wine presents a dark and silky appearance. On the nose, it is full of aromas such as bramble fruit, dark cherry, baking spices, vanilla bean, dark chocolate, and caramel.

It is full bodied with a rich and full mouthfeel. The palate offers layers of vanilla, cassis, and sweet black fruit, framed by soft, plush tannins and a balanced acidity. Notes of toasty oak, plum skin, and herbal hints of bay leaf and sage add complexity, leading to an opulent, velvety finish. The wine is aged for 18 months in 100% French and American oak barrels, with 45% new oak. The optimal drinking window is not explicitly listed, though its structure suggests it has ageing potential. There is no information to indicate that the wine is organic.

Food Pairing

The Prisoner Derange Red Blend pairs well with rich, savoury main courses. Recommended pairings include Kalbi Short Ribs or Chicken Mole Tostada. Its structure and flavour profile also complement grilled meats, such as grilled pork ribs with a hot/sour dipping sauce, or a perfectly cooked steak. Other suggestions are lamb, veal, and poultry.

title: Checkmate Silent Bishop Merlot 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Checkmate Artisanal Winery Silent Bishop Merlot 2021 is a red wine from Canada, produced in the Okanagan Valley region of British Columbia. Checkmate Artisanal Winery was established in 2012 with a bold vision to produce world class Chardonnay and Merlot in the Okanagan Valley, setting a new standard for excellence. The winery's philosophy centres on minimal intervention, allowing nature to take its course and enabling the grapes, which are sourced from unique, single vineyard blocks, to fully express their unique terroir. The Silent Bishop Merlot is sourced from the cooler western benches of the South Okanagan, facing the delicate morning sun, which results in a wine of freshness, dark fruit, and structure.

Wine Description

The wine is 100% Merlot. It has a dark red colour. The nose offers intense red and black fruits, floral notes, coffee, tobacco, and spice. The freshness of the Western side is reflected in its red currants and raspberries scents.

The palate has well balanced acidity, fruit, and oak, producing a wine of harmony and length. It is plush but with sticky tannins, black cherries, and blackcurrant. The tannins are firm and give structure, assuring a long life in a cold cellar. Stylistically, it is a rich flavourful wine with depth. The fruit is organic and the wine undergoes wild fermentation before ageing in French oak barrels for 20 months. The finish is smoky, resiny, and dry. The ABV is 15.27%. The wine is labelled as very dry (0–5 g/L residual sugar). It will age well. The optimal drinking window is not explicitly provided in the sources, but it is assured a long life in a cold cellar.

Accolades

  • Anthony Gismondi - 92/100 points

Food Pairing

Our wine experts suggest this Canadian Merlot wine would be a perfect match with beef, lamb, and veal dishes.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage was a challenging climate year. Despite this, the vineyards benefit from long summer days and porous soils, with the cooler western benches allowing grapes to escape late day baking. The winemaker's approach of minimal intervention, coupled with attention to detail and hand harvesting, aims to highlight the unique terroir even in a difficult year.

title: Poplar Grove CSM 2022
bodyHtml:
Poplar Grove CSM is a red wine from Canada, produced in the Okanagan Valley region of British Columbia. Poplar Grove Winery was founded in 1993 by the Holler family on the Naramata Bench near Penticton. The philosophy of Poplar Grove is a dedicated focus on the quality of their estate grown grapes, which are sourced from vineyards across the Okanagan Valley. The winery is particularly known for its commitment to growing and producing Bordeaux varietals.

Wine Description

The wine has a deep, saturated purple red colour. The aromatic profile is complex, offering notes of black cherry, blackcurrant, dark chocolate, tobacco, and black pepper. Further aromas include plum, cassis, dried fig, and hints of toasted oak. The wine is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, and Merlot, which is where the "CSM" designation is derived. The palate is rich and velvety, with an expansive mouthfeel and flavours of dark berries, mocha, plum, and black pepper. It has firm, integrated tannins and a good acidic structure.

title: Pol Roger Pure Extra Brut
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Pol Roger Pure Extra Brut is a non-vintage Champagne from France, produced in the Épernay region. The Champagne house Pol Roger was founded in 1849 and has a philosophy centred on elegance, balance, and consistency. It is still owned and run by the descendants of the founder. This particular cuvée, 'Pure Extra Brut,' was launched in 2008 and is the house's non-dosage, bone-dry expression. The house aims to showcase the purest expression of the Champagne blend without the addition of any sugar.

Wine Description

The wine has a crystalline appearance with a pale gold hue and a persistent, fine stream of bubbles. The aromatic profile is noted for its freshness and vibrancy, opening with notes of green apple, pear, mandarin peel, and crisp minerality. These are followed by tertiary notes of hazelnut, acacia flower, toasted brioche, and lime blossom.

The blend is typically equal parts, or close to it, of the three main Champagne varieties: 33% Pinot Noir, 33% Pinot Meunier, and 34% Chardonnay. The wine is medium bodied, with a very dry and precise palate. It has a lively, taut acidity that is beautifully integrated with flavours of citrus zest, white peach, and chalky minerality. Stylistically, it is bone dry, pure, and elegant, offering an impressive balance of power and finesse. It is an Extra Brut with zero dosage (0 g/l). The wine is aged for at least three years in the deepest cellars in Épernay. The finish is clean, long, and refreshing, with a touch of saline minerality. The ABV is 12.5%. It is enjoyable now but can be aged for several years. Information on the organic status of the wine is not available in the sources.

title: Ruffino Modus Primo 2021
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1877 by cousins Ilario and Leopoldo Ruffino, the winery has a history of championing Tuscany's reputation by producing clean, precise, and delicious wines. Ruffino's winemaking philosophy honours the idea that the best wines come from the best vineyards, which is maintained by meticulously choosing top sites, managing the vines, and employing non-interventionist practices to let the quality of the fruit reveal itself.

Wine Description

This wine is a 'Super Tuscan' blend of Sangiovese, Merlot, and Cabernet Sauvignon. It displays a deep garnet and ruby red colour. The nose offers dark notes of mature black fruit, with elegant and discreet wood completing a bold bouquet. Other aromatic notes include ripe cherries, plum, cassis, vanilla, baking spices, dark berries, and balsamic touches.

On the palate, it is described as full-bodied, generous, and complex, with a dark core and a radiant finish. Flavours include ripe dark berry, dark cherry, blueberry, plum, chocolate, dark bitter chocolate, spicy, savoury, and velvety notes. The wine is structured by high and precise tannins that are firm, chewy, and gripping.

Food Pairing

The complex flavour profile and structure of the Ruffino Modus Primo make it suitable for rich, savoury dishes. Suggested pairings include Italian and international meat dishes, such as grilled beef steaks, venison, and classic Tuscan dishes like Bistecca alla Fiorentina.

title: Glen Breton Rare 21 Year Old Whisky
bodyHtml:
Glen Breton Rare 21 Year Old is a distinctive Canadian single malt whisky crafted in the region of Nova Scotia, Canada. It is produced by Glenora Inn & Distillery, which was founded in 1990 by Bruce Jardine with the vision of creating North America's first single malt whisky in the Scottish tradition. The distillery is situated in Glenville on Cape Breton Island and uses pure water from MacLellan’s Brook, which tumbles out of the Mabou Highlands and runs through the distillery grounds. The whisky-making philosophy honours tradition, using only barley, yeast, and water, while the maturing whisky gains character from the local terroir of the Cape Breton Highlands, which is rich with apple, maple, and spruce trees.

Whisky Description

This single malt whisky presents a light gold colour. The aroma is complex and layered, featuring notes of vanilla, honeycomb, dried orchard fruits like baked apple and apricot, as well as soft citrus and a light floral touch. On the palate, the whisky is rich and full-bodied. Flavours include toffee, butterscotch, wild apples, toasted oak, leather, hay, and a hint of maple. The barley flavour is prominently featured, harmoniously integrated with layers of barrel flavour from the aging in American oak barrels.

title: Denizot Sancerre 'Damocles' 2023
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

The Denizot Sancerre 'Damocles' is a white wine from France, specifically the Loire Valley region, within the subregion of Sancerre. The Denizot family has been farming vines in the Sancerre appellation for ten generations, with their current 25-hectare estate run by Thibauld and Jennifer Denizot. The Denizot family’s philosophy centres on organic and biodynamic practices, emphasizing a return to natural methods to allow the terroir to fully express itself. The 'Damocles' cuvée is a single vineyard expression sourced from their oldest vines, which are rooted in a specific type of limestone soil known as 'caillottes'.

2. Wine Description

  • Varietal Composition: This wine is made from 100 percent Sauvignon Blanc.

  • Colour: It displays a bright, pale yellow hue with green reflections.

  • Aroma: The bouquet is complex and expressive, offering intense notes of citrus fruits like grapefruit, lemon, and white flowers. A subtle mineral quality is also evident.

  • Palate & Body: On the palate, the wine is powerful, textured, and full bodied, with a creamy, rich mouthfeel. It exhibits pure, precise fruit flavours and a noticeable minerality from the unique soils.

  • Stylistic Notes: The style is elegant and extremely well balanced, marked by both ripeness and a stimulating freshness. The wine is structured, yet lively.

  • Finish: The finish is long, complex, and driven by persistent minerality.

  • ABV: The Alcohol By Volume (ABV) is approximately 13.5 percent.

  • Certification: The wine is produced using organic and biodynamic principles.

title: Matsu Malvasia 'La Jefa' 2021
bodyHtml:
Matsu Malvasia 'La Jefa' is a white wine from Spain, produced in the Toro region. The name 'La Jefa' means 'The Boss'. Matsu's philosophy, whose name means "to wait" in Japanese, is a journey along the passage of time throughout three generations of winemakers. This project aims to elaborate wines that retain the traditional power of the Toro vineyards while combining it with freshness and elegance. 'La Jefa' is notable as the first white wine from the mainly red producing Toro region.

Wine Description

The wine has a straw yellow colour of medium intensity, with grey overtones and is very bright. The aromatic profile is highly complex, with notes of vanilla, ripe stone fruits, and creamy notes standing out. It is complemented with slight aniseed nuances, reflecting a nose harmonized by its ageing in casks. The varietal composition is 100% Malvasia, though some sources mention Malvasia and 'other varieties'. The grapes are sourced from plots between 50 and 150 years old.

It is an intense and full bodied white wine. The palate is mouth-filling and silky, with great creaminess. Flavours include creamy vanilla, melon, apricots, and peaches. It retains great acidity and vibrancy, which balances the sweet nuances and fine texture. The wine spends 14 months on its lees and is aged in new French oak barrels. Stylistically, it is a very balanced, elegant, and rich wine. The ABV is either 13% or 15% depending on the vintage. The optimal drinking window is to drink now. The wine is biodynamic.

Accolades

  • Decanter - 93 points

  • Wine Enthusiast - 92 points

  • James Suckling - 91 points

Food Pairing

This wine is perfect for anyone who likes rich, creamy white wine styles and will elevate any meal with big flavours. Suggested pairings include roast suckling pig or milk-fed lamb. It also pairs well with salads, seafood, white meat, rich fish, shellfish, and charcuterie.

Vintage Quality

General information for the Toro region highlights the continental climate with an Atlantic influence, which is dry with many hours of sun, and very cold in winter. A considerable temperature contrast between night and day favours an optimum maturation of the grape.

title: Monteleone Etna Rosso 2023
bodyHtml:
Monteleone Etna Rosso 2023 is a red wine from Italy, produced in the Sicily region and the Etna D.O.C. appellation. The winery is a small, family run estate located on the northern slopes of Mount Etna. Founded in 2017 by Giulia Monteleone and her partner Benedetto Alessandro, the estate's philosophy is centred on personally overseeing all stages of grape processing to ensure the wines reflect the unique volcanic terroir and energy of Etna. The vineyards are located at approximately 500 metres above sea level and benefit from a volcanic sandy soil enriched by the nearby Alcantara River.

Wine Description

The wine has a brilliant ruby hue. The aromatic profile is a ripe, fruity style with scents of pine, Mediterranean herbs, ripe cherries, and pomegranate. Further notes include ripe red fruit, subtle smokiness, spice, dried thyme, and a clean, subtle earthy smoked touch.

The varietal composition is almost exclusively Nerello Mascalese, with a small addition of Nerello Cappuccio. It is a light to medium bodied wine. The palate offers supple, juicy fruit and smooth tannins. It has chewy acidity, quite biting tannins, and an austere finish. Flavours include elegant cranberry and pomegranate interwoven with earthy herbs and crushed stone. The wine matures for 18 months in a combination of 10% new and 90% used French oak tonneaux (large barrels), followed by six months of bottle refinement. Stylistically, it is a refined Etna Rosso, embodying Sicily's unique high altitude terroir. The finish is fresh with a hint of saltiness. The ABV is 13.5%. It is recommended to drink now. The vineyards are certified organic, a reflection of Monteleone's deep respect for the land.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 92 points

Food Pairing

This wine is well suited for roasted and stewed meats, semi aged and aged cheeses, and pork dishes with sage.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Etna faced challenges, including a May 3rd hailstorm and the presence of mildew, which led to lower vine yields. However, the latest rains after the hot and dry summer slowed down the ripening process, enhancing the phenolic and aromatic components, which was decisive for quality. This wine is described as a high quality offering from a demanding year.

title: Peri Peri Zibibbo Liola 2024
bodyHtml:
The Peri Peri project began when the Cerchio family acquired a site in the Noto area of southern Sicily, a classic agricultural zone known for its chalk-rich soils and Mediterranean varieties. The name 'Peri Peri' is a tribute to the ancient explorers and travellers, or 'wanderers,' who met at this junction point of the Mediterranean, while 'Liola' references a classic Sicilian play. The Famiglia De Cerchio's philosophy is centred on organic winegrowing and respect for natural cycles, which includes embracing spontaneous fermentation to ensure the wines are an authentic expression of their place of origin.

Wine Description

The sensory profile is intensely aromatic, with aromas that lean toward citrus blossom, white peach, lime zest, and a light herbal note reminiscent of fresh mint. Other notes include lychee, mandarin peel, orange blossoms, jasmine, and tropical fruits. On the palate, it is dry, clean, and fresh. Flavours of mandarin, pear skin, and gentle tropical notes are evident.

title: Ridge Vineyards Zinfandel Pagani Ranch 2023
bodyHtml:
From the United States, this wine hails from Sonoma Valley in California, specifically the Pagani Ranch in the Sonoma Valley AVA. Ridge Vineyards is a historic California winery founded in the 1960s and renowned for its dedication to terroir-driven winemaking. With a focus on sustainable farming and minimal intervention, Ridge has built a legacy around single-vineyard expressions—Pagani Ranch being one of its most iconic Zinfandel sources, planted in the late 19th century.

This Zinfandel showcases a deep ruby hue with vibrant clarity. On the nose, it opens with an expressive bouquet of black raspberry, cherry compote, and sweet spice, followed by hints of wild herbs and crushed violets. The palate is rich yet balanced, featuring ripe blackberry, licorice, and a touch of peppery warmth. It is medium to full-bodied, with structured tannins and refreshing acidity carrying through to a long, polished finish.

Accolades

  • Vinous – 94 points.

  • Jeb Dunnuck – 94 points.

  • Wine Advocate – 93 points.

Food Pairing

Pair this wine with grilled lamb chops with rosemary, slow-cooked beef stew, or roasted eggplant with Mediterranean herbs. Its bold fruit and vibrant acidity make it a superb partner for savoury, spice-laden dishes. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Breton Trinch Bourgueil 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant red wine hails from France, specifically the Loire Valley region and the Bourgueil subregion. Domaine Catherine & Pierre Breton is a celebrated family-run estate with a history of organic viticulture since 1985. They are globally recognized as influential figures in the natural and organic wine movement, with a philosophy rooted in sincerity and reflecting the living character of the wine and its terroir.

Wine Description

It presents a deep ruby red colour. The nose offers an interesting bouquet of red fruits like raspberry and blackcurrant, with notes of brambleberry, violet, liquorice, and subtle hints of green pepper or an herbaceous note. On the palate, it is fresh and juicy with a medium body and supple, soft tannins. The finish is clean, with balanced acidity and lingering notes of cherry and caramel.

Food Pairing

It pairs excellently with charcuterie, grilled meats (including beef), salads, or dishes featuring goat cheese. It is also recommended with lighter fare like fish-based main dishes or poultry.

title: Chateau Boutisse 2018
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This red wine is from France, specifically the Bordeaux region and the Saint Émilion Grand Cru appellation in the Libournais subregion. Château Boutisse has a history dating back to the 18th century, with its vineyards situated on the limestone plateau of Saint Christophe des Bardes. The estate is currently owned and managed by the Maret family, who are dedicated to sustainable viticulture and preserving the vineyard's rich natural environment. Their philosophy focuses on producing wines that express the unique qualities of the Saint Émilion terroir with elegance and finesse.

2. Wine Description The wine displays a deep, intense ruby red colour. On the nose, it is complex and expressive, offering ripe fruit aromas of black cherry and plum, complemented by notes of cedar, leather, and sweet spice from oak ageing. The palate is full-bodied and well-structured, featuring concentrated dark fruit flavours supported by firm, refined tannins. It is a wine with great balance and freshness, showing a harmonious integration of fruit, oak, and acidity. The finish is long, elegant, and persistent, suggesting its potential for further ageing. The varietal composition is typically dominated by Merlot (around 85%), blended with Cabernet Franc and a touch of Cabernet Sauvignon.

title: Domaine Drouhin Pinot Noir 'Laurene' 2023
bodyHtml:
Domaine Drouhin Oregon, established in 1987 by the Drouhin family of Burgundy, France, is situated in the Dundee Hills of Oregon's Willamette Valley. The estate is renowned for its commitment to sustainable viticulture and crafting wines that reflect the unique and distinguished terroir of the region.

The Pinot Noir Laurène is the pinnacle of the estate's selection, a cuvée named after Véronique Drouhin's daughter. It represents the finest expression of the estate's barrels.

Wine Description

This signature Pinot Noir consistently showcases a beautiful medium color, offering an expressive aromatic profile of red and dark berries (like cherry and raspberry), complemented by complex notes of dried rose petals, wild herbs, and subtle baking spices derived from meticulous oak aging.

On the palate, it is always medium-bodied and graceful, delivering layers of concentrated fruit, refined acidity, and a silky texture. The Laurène is celebrated for its exceptional richness, complexity, and structural elegance, making it a wine that is both immediately approachable and built for long-term cellaring.

Suggested Pairings

This complex and layered Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with roasted duck, grilled salmon, seared venison, or an earthy mushroom risotto, enhancing the wine's depth and structure.

Accodlades

97 Points - James Suckling: Rich, powerful and gorgeous, drenched in fruity, savory, mushroomy flavors on a full body and super-smooth tannins. It is deep in black cherry, blackcurrant, cedar and pine character that expands on the palate and lingers in the finish. Drink or hold.

title: Highland Park Cask Strength No. 5
bodyHtml:
This single malt Scotch whisky hails from Scotland, specifically the Island region, in the subregion of Orkney. The Highland Park Distillery has been crafting award-winning whisky in Kirkwall, Orkney, since 1798. Founded by Magnus 'Mansie' Eunson—a church beadle and notorious whisky smuggler—the distillery maintains and reimagines craft traditions, most notably by using locally sourced, aromatic heathered peat. This unique peat imparts a subtle, fragrant smoky character that delicately balances the complex, rich flavours of their spirit.

Whisky Description

The aroma is complex and spicy, opening with notes of dried cloves, fresh oregano, crushed pine needles, and lingering wood smoke. On the palate, you’ll find a powerful, spicy complexity with delicious intensity. Influenced by Pedro Ximénez sherry casks, the flavour leans into rich, sun-dried fruits like prunes, dates, and sultanas. First-fill European oak casks add aromatic hints of liquorice and winter spices, balanced by cocoa nibs and light oak from the ex-bourbon casks. The body is bold and oily, while the finish is spicy, rich, and delightfully fragrant, lingering on notes of sherried fruits and sweet spices.

Food Pairing

Given its full-bodied structure and prominent notes of dark dried fruit, aromatic spice, and gentle smoke, this whisky complements rich, hearty dishes. Suggested pairings include:

  • Hearty, high-fat content dishes like grilled red meats, such as a hay smoked rib of beef.

  • Strong, smoky blue cheeses.

  • Dark chocolate and dried fruits and nuts.

title: Chateau Noaillac 2016
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Chateau Noaillac is a red wine from France, specifically the Bordeaux region, within the subregion of Médoc. The estate, located in the far north of the appellation, was purchased in 1983 by the current owners, the Pages family. The family realized the soil in this northerly part of the Médoc had once produced excellent wines, despite the land having been abandoned. The winery, which is also run by Marc Pages's grandson, Damien Pages, has earned a reputation for its attentive winemaking and sustainable practices. The estate spans 113 acres with limestone and clay soils that are ideal for grape growing.

Wine Description

This wine is a Bordeaux Blend Red, typically made from a combination of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Petit Verdot. A common blend is 55 percent Merlot, 40 percent Cabernet Sauvignon, and 5 percent Petit Verdot, though some vintages show a greater proportion of Merlot. The wine is a rich ruby hue. The aroma bursts with ripe blackcurrant, blackberry, and delicate undertones of vanilla and cedar, or notes of black fruits, spices, and cedar. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with concentrated dark fruit flavours, revealing notes of strawberry, fleshy plum, cassis, and sweet spices. The style is often classic and harmonious, with a pleasing balance, and integrated, fine-grained, smooth tannins. The finish is long and fruity with a lingering aftertaste. The wine is often aged for 12 months in French Oak barrels. The Alcohol By Volume (ABV) is approximately 13 percent to 13.5 percent. The wine is designated as Sustainable and was promoted to Cru Bourgeois Supérieur status with the 2025 classification.

title: Calera Pinot Noir 'Muns Vineyard' 2021
bodyHtml:
Calera Pinot Noir Muns Vineyard is a red wine from the United States, specifically from California's Central Coast region and the Santa Cruz Mountains appellation. Calera was founded by Josh Jensen in 1974, who was a pioneer in American Pinot Noir, driven by the belief that limestone-rich soils, as found in Burgundy, were essential to making great wine. Calera began sourcing fruit from Muns Vineyard in the Santa Cruz Mountains in 2015, appreciating the depth and complexity of these wines. The vineyard is located at a high, windswept elevation of 2,600 feet above the fog line, which lengthens the growing season and produces thicker grape skins.

Wine Description

The wine is 100% Pinot Noir. Aromas are inviting, featuring wild strawberry, cherry, sweet plum, and fresh cracked black pepper. Further aromatic notes include red raspberry, mild black cherry, earthy wet stone, dried wildflowers, and a touch of lavender. It is a medium bodied wine. On the palate, there is a lovely balance between acid and tannin that frames the lush berry flavours. Hints of sweet and savoury spice emerge throughout. Stylistically, this windswept mountain vineyard produced a beautifully bright and elegant Pinot Noir. The unpretentious feel of the wine truly expresses its site, offering an enviable earthiness and a slightly rough, brambly character. The wine was aged for 15 months in 100% French oak, 30% new. It concludes with a long, graceful finish. The ABV is 14.5%. Information on the optimal drinking window is not available in the sources. Information on the organic status of the wine is not available in the sources.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 95 points

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points

  • Wine Advocate - 92 points

Vintage Quality

The 2021 growing season in the Santa Cruz Mountains began with below average winter rainfall, followed by moderate spring temperatures that led to a typically timed budbreak. The temperate weather continued into summer, which provided extra hangtime for the grapes. The resulting wines offer beautiful depth and concentration, with dynamic acidity and pure, focused flavours.

title: Michter's US*1 Small Batch American Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Michter's US*1 Small Batch American Whiskey is a highly regarded whiskey from the country of the United States. The Michter's lineage traces its origins back to Shenk's Distillery, founded in 1753 in Schaefferstown, Pennsylvania, a legacy that Michter's continues to honour as America's first whiskey company. This expression is part of the US*1 line, which references this heritage. Today, Michter's is headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky. This particular expression represents the revival of the traditional American whiskey category, which is distinguished from the more common bourbon and rye styles.

Spirit Description

This Small Batch American Whiskey uses an undisclosed mash bill, differentiating it from a straight bourbon or rye, and it is bottled without an age statement. A key characteristic is that it is aged in a process called 'Chop Barrel' aging. This means the whiskey is matured in new American white oak barrels that have had their staves air-dried for a minimum of 18 months and are then heavily toasted before being lightly charred. The colour is a rich, medium amber. The nose is sweet and complex, with aromas of dried fruit, butterscotch, and sweet vanilla. The palate is full-bodied and soft, offering sweet caramel and vanilla notes, with hints of dried apricot, toffee, cinnamon, and a pleasant, velvety mouthfeel. The finish is clean, with sweet oak and gentle brown sugar lingering. The spirit is bottled at 41.7 per cent ABV.

title: Michter's US*1 Small Batch Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Michter's US★1 Small Batch Bourbon is a distinguished Kentucky Straight Bourbon crafted with meticulous attention to detail. Utilizing the highest quality American corn, this bourbon is aged to perfection in barrels that have been both toasted and charred, a process that enhances its rich flavor profile.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Deep amber hue, indicating a well-matured spirit.
  • Aroma: Inviting notes of rich caramel, vanilla, and hints of dried fruit, complemented by subtle oak undertones.
  • Palate: A harmonious blend of sweetness and spice, featuring flavors of butterscotch, toffee, and dark chocolate, balanced by a touch of cinnamon and pepper.
  • Finish: Smooth and lingering, with echoes of oak and a gentle warmth.

Production Details

  • Proof: 91.4 (45.7% ABV)
  • Mash Bill: Emphasizes high-quality American corn (specifics undisclosed).
  • Barrel Entry Proof: Entered into barrels at 103 proof, lower than the industry standard, to enhance flavor extraction during aging.
  • Barrel Treatment: Barrels are seasoned for 18 months and undergo a unique toasting and charring process to develop deeper flavors.

title: Michter's US*1 Small Batch Sour Mash
bodyHtml:
Michter's US*1 Small Batch Sour Mash Whiskey is an American whiskey with roots tracing back to the country of the United States. The Michter's legacy originates from Shenk's Distillery, founded by a Swiss Mennonite farmer in Schaefferstown, Pennsylvania, in 1753, which is considered America's first whiskey company. Michter's Original Sour Mash was the distillery's most popular product during the 1970s and 1980s but disappeared from the market in 1989. It was triumphantly reintroduced in 2012 as part of the US*1 line, staying true to the profile of its predecessor. Today, Michter's is based in Kentucky, in the heart of the modern American whiskey industry. The US*1 expressions are named to honour the brand's heritage harkening back to America's first whiskey company.

Spirit Description

Michter's US*1 Small Batch Sour Mash Whiskey is made using a unique grain selection that prevents it from being categorised as either a bourbon or a rye. Its unusual mash bill likely has less than the 51% corn required to be called bourbon, but includes a fair amount of corn, rye grain, and some barley malt. The 'Sour Mash' moniker refers to the production process where a portion of previously fermented mash is used as a starter for the new mash. This small-batch whiskey is aged in fire-charred, new American white oak barrels. The colour is copper. On the nose, it offers scents of warm toasted burnt sugar, spice, sweet fruit, candied cherries, and honeyed vanilla, with aromas of marshmallows, oak, and cinnamon. The palate is silky, smooth, and sweet with flavours of caramel, vanilla, toffee, coffee cake, and stone fruit. It is often described as starting like a bourbon and finishing like a rye. The finish is clean, with a mild heat and a spicy rye and black pepper presence that lingers. It is bottled at 86 proof, or $43\%$ Alcohol by Volume (ABV).

Accolades

This whiskey has received high praise, including being named 'Whisky Of The Year' for 2019 by The Whisky Exchange. This distinction made Michter's US*1 Sour Mash the first whiskey made in the United States to ever achieve this honour.

Food Pairing

The whiskey's balance of sweetness and spice makes it an excellent base for classic whiskey cocktails like an Old Fashioned or a Manhattan. Its silky smooth texture and intricate flavours also make it perfect for sipping neat or on the rocks. For pairing with food, its rich profile is complemented by smoked meats, dark chocolate, or aged cheeses.

title: Crystal Head Vodka Lunar Limited Edition - Year of the Horse
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Crystal Head Vodka Lunar Horse is a limited-edition vodka celebrating the Lunar New Year, specifically the Year of the Horse in 2026. It is distilled in the country of Canada. The iconic skull bottle design was created by actor Dan Aykroyd and artist John Alexander. The limited-edition bottle is handcrafted by glass artisans and features a vibrant metallic red finish with gold foil artwork, honouring the Chinese zodiac tradition of the Horse, which symbolises freedom, energy, and perseverance.

Spirit Description

The vodka inside the Lunar Horse edition is the brand's award-winning, original formula. It is distilled from the finest Canadian corn, making it gluten-free and additive-free with no added sugar or citrus oils. The spirit is blended with pristine water from Newfoundland, Canada. It is quadruple distilled and filtered seven times, with three of those filtrations passing through layers of semi-precious Herkimer diamonds. The colour is clean and crystal clear. The nose is clean and neutral, with delicate hints of citrus and sweet grain. The palate is described as silky and smooth, with subtle notes of vanilla, pepper, and a gentle sweetness from the corn base. The finish is crisp, clean, and refreshing, with a soft, warming character that highlights its refined purity. The vodka has an ABV of 40.0% (80 proof).

title: Michter's Toasted Barrel Finish Bourbon (Limited Release)
bodyHtml:
“Due to limited availability, purchases are restricted to 1 bottle per customer.”

Introduction

Michter's US*1 Toasted Barrel Finish Bourbon is a unique expression of Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey from the country of the United States. The Michter's brand has a deep history, tracing its roots to America's first whiskey company, Shenk's Distillery, founded in Pennsylvania in 1753. Today, the brand operates out of Louisville, Kentucky. This expression was originally released in 2014 and pioneered the use of a secondary toasted barrel finish in the American whiskey industry.

Spirit Description

This bourbon begins as Michter's US*1 Kentucky Straight Bourbon. It is then transferred to custom-made, fire-toasted, new American white oak barrels for an additional period of aging, after being fully matured. These unique finishing barrels are air-dried for 18 months and toasted to a precise specification, but are not charred. This secondary maturation contributes to a deep, dark amber colour. The nose is sweet and complex, featuring notes of vanilla, toasted marshmallow, dark honey, and crème brûlée. The palate is rich and luscious, with flavours of sweet, spicy vanilla, dark chocolate, cherry, maple syrup, and balancing spice. The additional time in the toasted barrel imparts a depth of flavour and a velvety mouthfeel. The finish is long, warm, and sweet, often described as having a lingering note of gingerbread. It is bottled at 45.1% ABV.

title: Baileys - 1.14 Litre
bodyHtml: Baileys is currently made in Dublin, Ireland, where it originated. This creamy liqueur is renowned for its rich and indulgent flavour profile. Combining the smoothness of Irish whiskey with the lusciousness of fresh cream and a hint of cocoa and vanilla, Baileys offers a delightful balance of sweetness and depth. Critics often commend Baileys for its luxurious and velvety texture, praising its versatility in both sipping on its own or as an addition to coffee or dessert cocktails. Its iconic taste and smooth finish have made Baileys a beloved choice for those seeking a decadent and comforting indulgence.

title: Corvezzo Prosecco Rose 2024
bodyHtml: An organic Prosecco DOC with a brilliant perlage. Intense hints of pear and white flowers on the nose. In the mouth, it is fresh, with an enveloping foam accompanying the drink towards a balanced and persistent finish. Perfect match with crispy fried fish.

title: Ezra Brooks  Old 7 Year Old Rye
bodyHtml:
The Ezra Brooks brand is produced by Luxco, which founded Lux Row Distillers in Bardstown, Kentucky. The company's legacy is tied to the heart of Bourbon Country. Ezra Brooks is distilled using high-quality ingredients and is charcoal filtered to produce a mellow flavour and smooth finish.

Whisky Description

The appearance is a rich amber with reddish hues. The aroma has rich notes of caramel, vanilla, oak, and a hint of spice. The palate is smooth and velvety, presenting flavours of caramel, vanilla, oak, black pepper, and a touch of sweetness. The finish is long and elegant, with a lingering warmth and refined smoothness. Overall, the whiskey exhibits slightly sweet and oaky tones with hints of vanilla and honey, concluding with a warm touch of spice and tobacco.

title: Dario Princic Ribolla Gialla 2018
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Friuli-Venezia Giulia region. The winery is located in Oslavia, a hamlet of Gorizia, in the Collio area near the border with Slovenia. Dario Princic, along with other local pioneers, was a staunch supporter of a non-interventionist approach in the vineyard and cellar, and of making white wines with skin contact to give great depth. Dario founded his winery in 1993, having worked his vineyards organically since 1988, not using any chemicals. His winemaking philosophy is based on long pellicular maceration for all his white wines, spontaneous fermentation in open vats, and aging in used wooden barrels, resulting in super-complex, intense, flavourful, and deep wines.

2. Wine Description

Dario Princic Ribolla Gialla is an emblematic orange wine that is a leading expression of his style and the Collio area.

  • Colour: The wine often shows a brilliant orange colour in the glass.

  • Aroma: The nose has notable citrus notes, especially orange and orange peel. Aromas of roasted almonds, sweet spices, apricots, herbaceous notes, and a slight sensation of hydrocarbons. Other descriptors include sweet spices, dried fruit, and apricot jam.

  • Palate: The wine is flavourful, mineral, and unique. The mouthfeel is held together by a tannic texture and has frank saline acidity. The 2017 vintage was described as savoury, mineral, thin in texture, balanced, and having moderate tannins.

  • Body: The search results do not explicitly state the body.

  • Finish: The search results do not explicitly state the finish.

  • Varietal composition: The wine is made from 100% Ribolla Gialla. The grapes are collected by hand and fermented with their native yeasts. The must remains in contact with the skins and macerates for 35 days in open wooden barrels. The wine is aged for 30 months in French oak barrels and is not filtered.

  • Stylistic notes: This is an exciting orange wine. It is a complex wine with delicate tannins. It has a very strong, unique character and great energy.

  • ABV: 12.50%

title: Chateau Ksara Arak (Ksarak)
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This arak is an authentic, traditional anise-flavoured spirit and is considered the national drink of Lebanon. It originates from Lebanon, produced by Château Ksara, the country's largest winery, located in the Bekaa Valley. Château Ksara was established in 1857 by French Jesuit monks. The company, which was later bought by a local consortium of businessmen in 1973, is known for its long history and resilience. Château Ksara uses Obeidy (or sometimes Ugni Blanc) grapes, an indigenous variety, as the base.

2. Spirit Description

Ksarak Arak is a premium, aniseed-based eau-de-vie that is triple-distilled. The first distillation releases alcohol from the wine base, and subsequent distillations are done in a specially designed alembic still to infuse the spirit with fresh green aniseed. The aniseed is sourced exclusively from the prized Al Heeneh village on the slopes of Mount Hermon. Through an innovative technique, only the heart of the distillate, known as the 'pure flower,' is used. The spirit is matured for 28 months (approximately 2 years) in traditional hand-made clay jars from the village of Beit Chebab.

  • Colour: Clear in its pure form. When diluted with water, it transforms into a milky-white elixir (the louche effect).

  • Aroma: It has pronounced and complex herbal aromas of anise and licorice.

  • Palate: The taste is spicier than other araks. It has the typical aroma of licorice, with notes of pepper and fennel.

  • Body: Medium body.

  • Finish: The finish confirms its complex herbal and spicy flavours.

  • Stylistic Notes: Ksarak is refined to be the purest and healthiest arak. Its clean taste and purity are the result of the innovative distillation and maturation process.

  • ABV: The alcoholic strength is 53% ABV.

title: Mermaid Pink Gin
bodyHtml: Complex, refreshing, and beautifully pink. This contemporary gin leads with a nose of fresh strawberry and zesty citrus. The taste is a bold journey through vibrant berry notes and warm spices, finished with a distinctive hint of sea air. Smooth, layered, and perfectly balanced.

title: Mulderbosch Faithful Hound Red Blend 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This wine is from South Africa, specifically the Stellenbosch region. Mulderbosch celebrates the great Bordeaux tradition of blending, and the 'Faithful Hound' label honours a dog that kept a three-year vigil outside an empty cottage on the farm after being abandoned by its master. The goal with each bottling of Faithful Hound is to produce a rich, complex wine that comfortably expresses old world class and the generosity of fruit associated with Stellenbosch.

Wine Description

Sensory Profile: The wine has a purple core with a deep red outer rim. It offers a youthful entrance with aromas of bramble berry, baked rhubarb, and dense, ripe plum. Notes of licorice and a faint inkling of earthy and herbaceous fynbos lead to a full palate of sweet berry fruit, accompanied by elegant matching oak maturation and polished, medium-chewy tannins. It is full-bodied and rich, with flavours of spiced plum, blueberry, raspberry, and blackberry. It has a bright, structured, and juicy palate with good purity and length.

title: White Claw Variety Pack #2 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml: Latch on to this super-cool variety pack from the ever-popular, White Claw. The offer features 3 355 mL cans each of the Classic Lemon, Tangerine, Watermelon and Raspberry. You'll realize why White Claw is so popular.

title: Belle Glos Pinot Noir Las Alturas 2020 (Green Wax)
bodyHtml:
Belle Glos is owned by the Wagner family, also known for Caymus Vineyards. The Belle Glos brand focuses on Pinot Noir from distinct, cool-climate coastal vineyards in California, aiming to produce a signature style that is rich, bold, and expressive of the specific vineyard's terroir, often featuring deep colour and concentrated flavour.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir displays a deep ruby red or dark garnet colour. Aromas burst from the glass, showcasing fragrant notes of blueberry pie, dried fig, kola nut, vanilla, moist soil, and hints of coffee grounds or cocoa. The palate is rich and dark, featuring flavours of blackberry pie, black cherry, wild berries, creamy milk chocolate, toffee, and subtle notes of nutmeg.

Accolades

  • "Wine Spectator - 91 points."

  • "Wine Enthusiast - 90 points."

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings are tailored to the wine's rich, bold structure and dark fruit profile. Classic matches for a powerful Pinot Noir like this include rich beef stew, barbecue pork ribs, or a platter of Manchego cheese and quince.

title: Pol Roger Rose 2018
bodyHtml:
Pale salmon with delicate pink hues. Great intensity of color with a fine and persistent effervescence. The nose is intense and reminiscent of a basket of red fruits where raspberry, redcurrant and blackcurrant mingle, with the added nuances of exotic mango and papaya. With time and air, the floral aromas of rose and honeysuckle then dominate. Mouth-filling on the palate with some sophistication and an impressive length. Despite the obvious ripeness on the palate, the wine has a terrific freshness and very present acidity suggesting a bright future for this cuvee.

This Brut Rose is the ideal choice to accompany fish such as grilled salmon or even sushi. It also marries perfectly with fruit tarts and other fruit desserts; try pairing with a forced rhubarb fool, the sharpness of the fruit complementing the elegant structure of the wine.

95 Points - James Suckling

If you like Burgundian pinot noir reds then you should love this very winey and structured rosé champagne, with its zesty blood orange freshness. And, in spite of this it is very refreshing with a complex spicy finish. Good potential.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Brut Rose opens to a superb bouquet revealing scents of plums, red berries, pastry, almond, mandarin orange and lemon oil complemented by classy autolytic notes. On the palate, this remarkable rose has a tauter and more fine-boned texture than usual, which is enhanced by bright acids and a chalky, saline finish.

title: Tua Rita Per Sempre Syrah 2016
bodyHtml:
This rare and powerful red wine originates from the Toscana IGT appellation in the Suvereto subregion of coastal Tuscany, Italy. While Tua Rita is world-famous for its Merlot, Per Sempre (meaning "Forever") is the estate's definitive statement on Syrah, born from Rita Tua’s personal passion for the variety. The winery's philosophy focuses on expressing the unique "metalliferous" soils of the Colline Metallifere, where high iron and mineral content impart a distinctive savory and salty character to the grapes.

Wine Description

The Tua Rita Per Sempre Syrah 2016 presents a deep, almost impenetrable garnet-ruby colour. The sensory profile is exceptionally aromatic and structured, featuring a sophisticated bouquet of crème de cassis, ripe plums, and figs, layered with complex notes of lavender, black pepper, liquorice, and violets. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and masculine yet remarkably polished, showcasing a thick, concentrated texture with silky tannins and a vibrant, mineral-driven acidity. It is characterized by its seamless balance and a long, savory finish that reveals hints of charcuterie and dark cocoa. This 100% Syrah has an ABV of 15% and was aged for 16 to 18 months in new French oak barriques slightly less time than other vintages to preserve its fresh fruit energy.

Food Pairing

The intense power and spicy complexity of this Syrah make it an ideal companion for robust and flavorful meat dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with filet mignon, grilled venison, or Moroccan lamb stew. Its savory undertones also complement pork chops with a rhubarb-cherry sauce or dishes featuring earthy champignon sauces. For a classic Italian pairing, it matches beautifully with Bistecca alla Fiorentina, wild game, or well-matured hard cheeses such as aged Pecorino.

Vintage Quality

The 2016 vintage in Tuscany is widely considered a modern legend, often described as the best in 20 years. A cool spring followed by a warm summer with significant diurnal temperature shifts allowed for perfect phenolic ripeness while maintaining high natural acidity. For Syrah specifically, 2016 provided the heat necessary for full flavor development without the over-extraction often seen in "hotter" years, resulting in a wine that critics have hailed for its delineation and elegance.

title: Larceny Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Larceny is produced by Heaven Hill Distillery and is an extension of their Old Fitzgerald line. The spirit is inspired by the tale of John E. Fitzgerald, a US Treasury Agent who, as legend has it, used his keys to 'thieve' sips from the best casks of Old Fitzgerald bourbon while guarding the bonded rickhouses. These 'Fitzgerald Barrels' were noted for being "exceptionally smooth".

Whisky Description

Aroma: Fresh bread and toffee, with notes of butterscotch, along with buttery bread, honey, nuts, and vanilla.

Palate: Buttery caramel and honeyed notes, with initial notes of sweet corn and a hint of oak, cinnamon, and a rich mouthfeel.

Body: Medium-to-full body.

Finish: Long, gently sweet, and savoury.

title: Ezra Brooks 99 Proof Bourbon - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Ezra Brooks 99 Proof is a Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey. Its origins date back to 1957 when it was first conceived as a genuine, charcoal-filtered bourbon. The brand is owned and marketed by MGP Ingredients. Ezra Brooks is distilled at Lux Row Distillers in Bardstown, Kentucky, a key region for American bourbon production. The production process uses a traditional sour mash recipe. The foundation of the bourbon is a blend of corn, rye, and malted barley. The mash bill is typically 78% corn, 10% rye, and 12% malted barley, giving it a high corn content for a sweet flavour and rye for a hint of spice.

Spirit Description

The Ezra Brooks 99 is a pure, oak-barrel-aged Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey that is bottled at an elevated proof to enhance its flavour profile. Its production process includes charcoal filtration, which occurs after maturation and just before bottling, to ensure a smooth, mellow finish and maintain clarity.

  • Colour: Not specified, but generally amber/gold due to new, charred American oak barrel aging.

  • Aroma: The nose is described as mild and approachable. It has hints of caramel, vanilla, chocolate, and spice. Some notes include butterscotch, white pepper, marshmallows, and mango.

  • Palate: The flavour is full-bodied. The classic notes are caramel and vanilla, with hints of chocolate and spice. Other tasting notes include white and black pepper, toasted oak, banana, mango, and perfume. The bourbon features bold, concentrated flavours of caramel and vanilla.

  • Body: Medium to full body, with a silky mouthfeel. Master Distiller John Rempe aimed for a high-proof bourbon without sacrificing the rich, smooth notes Ezra Brooks is known for.

  • Finish: The finish is medium-long. It is smooth, drinkable, and warm. Notes of maple syrup, caramel sauce, perfume, and pepper carry through.

  • Stylistic Notes: The 99 proof amplifies the rye spice of the whiskey, counteracting some of the corn's sweetness, offering a balanced taste for the ambitious bourbon lover.

  • ABV: The spirit is bottled at 99 proof, which is 49.5% ABV.

title: Quilmes Clasica 340 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
• Style: Lager, a blonde pilsner style.
  • ABV: 4.9% alcohol content by volume.
  • Ingredients: Brewed using natural ingredients including water, malted barley, adjunct (corn), and hops (Patagonian Nugget, Cascade, Victoria, and Mapuche).
  • Tasting Notes: Offers a smooth, balanced flavor with gentle malt sweetness, subtle hop bitterness, and a crisp, dry finish.
  • Serving Suggestion: Best served very cold at an ideal temperature of 3°C.

title: Domaine George Vieilles Vignes Chablis 2023
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This white wine is from France, specifically the Burgundy region and the Chablis subregion. Domaine George is a family-owned estate located in the village of Courgis. Second-generation winemaker Michel George, along with third-generation winemakers David and Jonathan, continue the family's tradition. The vineyards are situated on steep slopes with Kimmeridgian soils composed of limestone, clay, and marine fossils, which imparts a distinct minerality to the wine.

2. Wine Description

This wine has a pale gold colour with subtle green reflections. The nose is fresh, lively, and pure with an emphasis on citrus fruit, and sometimes includes floral notes of lime-flower or mint. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied for a Chablis, yet remains fresh and elegant with a frank attack and complex flavours of very ripe citrus fruits, green apple, and white-fleshed fruits. There is a full and pleasantly rich texture that is balanced by a vibrant, steely, and persistent acidity. The finish is long, pure, and mineral-driven. The varietal composition is 100% Chardonnay. The optimal drinking window is typically within two to three years of the vintage, but the old vines provide the concentration for ageing up to eight to ten years. The ABV is 12.5%. Some wines from Domaine George are organic, but the status of this specific bottling is not consistently confirmed across sources.

title: NSO Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This wine is from the USA, specifically California, and the Paso Robles El Pomar District subregion in the Central Coast. The NSO brand is a project by winemaker Dusty Nabor, a California native known for a philosophy focused on over-delivering value with wines meant for 'no special occasion'. This wine is made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon grapes sourced from a single vineyard in the Paso Robles area. The winemaking emphasizes showcasing the fruit with a focus on polished, approachable structure.

2. Wine Description

This wine is typically a deep ruby or dark colour. The aroma profile is inviting and features notes of blackberry, cassis, and vanilla, layered with hints of oak and dark cocoa.
