The palate is rich and full-bodied, offering a concentrated profile of ripe dark fruits like black cherry and currant, balanced by a touch of spice. It is noted for its refined, smooth, and velvety tannins that coat the palate, which is balanced by a fresh, bright acidity. The finish is long and persistent, showing hints of tobacco and French oak. The varietal composition is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. The wine is approachable and delicious now, but it is structured to cellar for years to come. The ABV is not explicitly listed across all sources, but New World Cabernet Sauvignon generally ranges from 13.5% to 15.5%. The wine is not confirmed as organic.

title: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge - 1.14 Litre
bodyHtml:
Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge is a premium and unique orange liqueur that originates from France. The story began in 1827 when Jean-Baptiste Lapostolle founded a distillery in Neauphe-le-Château, France, producing fruit liqueurs. In 1880, Louis-Alexandre Marnier Lapostolle, the founder's granddaughter's husband, had the innovative idea of blending French cognac with a rare variety of bitter orange from the Caribbean, the 'Citrus bigaradia'. He created the famous liqueur, which was originally named 'Curaçao Marnier' before being renamed 'Grand Marnier' by his friend, the famed hotelier César Ritz.

2. Spirit Description

Cordon Rouge, meaning 'Red Ribbon,' is the flagship and original expression of Grand Marnier, known as a fruit liqueur that emphasizes candied citrus flavour. It is a blend of exceptional French cognac (51%) and the bitter essence of wild tropical oranges (49%). The cognac used is sourced from Cognac's best five regions, with an average age of 3 to 5 years. The bitter orange distillate is created by macerating sun-dried bitter orange peels in neutral alcohol before slow distillation. Slow ageing in French oak casks gives it incomparable roundness and subtlety.

  • Colour: It is a bright topaz colour, brilliant with gold and amber tints.

  • Aroma: The complex nose features attractive orange notes with nuances of candied zests. It also carries vanilla flavours from the cognac and a light but firm oak character.

  • Palate: The flavour is full and ample. Bitter orange aromas are balanced by cognac notes of hazelnuts and toffee, with secondary impressions of caramelized sugar and warmth. The overall structure balances the orange's bitterness with the sugar's sweetness and wood spiciness.

  • Body: The mouthfeel is smooth and concentrated.

  • Finish: The finish is long and harmonious. When sipped neat, the finish is full of orange marmalade and spicy oak, with a light bitterness creeping in at the very end.

  • Stylistic Notes: This is a versatile, iconic liqueur that works equally well as a sipping liqueur and as a flexible cocktail ingredient.

  • ABV: The alcoholic strength is 40% ABV.

title: Mission Hill Reserve Brut
bodyHtml:
This Reserve Brut is a charmat method blend of Chardonnay and 10 percent pinot noir sourced from two estate vineyards on Oliver's Black Sage Bench and Golden Mile Bench.

Soft and pretty, with pear blossom, lime pith, white peach on a softer, lighter (11-degree) palate. The acidity is pretty brisk, mind, keeping the finish snappy and bright. A lovely starter or brunch wine this summer.

title: Lolo Tequila Mandarin Fizz 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This ready-to-drink cocktail is crafted in Vancouver, British Columbia, by the beverage experts at Strathcona Beer Company. They are committed to creating fresh, high-quality, and all-natural cocktails that taste like they were handmade in a bar. Lolo Cocktails focuses on using freshly squeezed citrus and house-made electrolytes in their products.

Description

This canned cocktail presents a refreshing and vibrant profile. It is characterized by a sun-kissed fusion of freshly squeezed mandarin juice, bold blood orange, and a hint of tangerine essence. It is light in body with a pronounced fizz, offering a dangerously smooth finish.

title: Lolo Honey Paloma Fizz 355 ml – 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This ready-to-drink tequila cocktail originates from British Columbia. Lolo Drink Company was founded by the Vancouver-based craft brewery, Strathcona Beer Company. The cocktails are handcrafted entirely in-house by experts in Vancouver, using high-quality, all-natural ingredients to produce Canada's first ready-to-drink tequila cocktail with balancing electrolytes.

Description

The cocktail has a citrus-forward bouquet. It is described as delicious, well balanced, and thirst-quenching, with a taste that is light and naturally bright. It features freshly squeezed pink grapefruit juice, natural pink grapefruit essence, and B.C. honey. A touch of lime and agave nectar is also included.

title: Lolo Tequila Lime Fizz 355 ml – 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
The Lolo Tequila Lime Fizz is a Canadian ready-to-drink cocktail, crafted in Vancouver, British Columbia. It is mixed and canned by the beverage experts at Strathcona Beer Company. This company is noted for its high-quality, all-natural ingredients and for creating Canada's first ready-to-drink tequila cocktail that includes mineral-rich electrolytes with sea salt, an innovation developed by their brewmaster who is also a biochemist.

Spirit Description

Features citrus-forward notes, given it's made with freshly squeezed lime juice. The taste is described as fresh and fizzy, with a clean flavour and a balance of fresh citrus, pure premium tequila, and balancing electrolytes.

Food Pairing

Ceviche with lime and cilantro, grilled fish tacos, shrimp cocktail, and sushi/sashimi. The acidity of the spirit complements the fresh citrus and herbs in the ceviche.

title: Casoni Nocino di Modena
bodyHtml:
The Historic "Black Gold" of Modena. Casoni Nocino is a benchmark example of Italy’s traditional green walnut liqueur. Produced by the Casoni family, who have been distilling in Modena since 1814, this liqueur captures the authentic flavors of Emilia-Romagna.

Following strict tradition, green walnuts are harvested in late June (specifically on the Feast of San Giovanni), while the nuts are still soft and the oils are most potent. They are then macerated for months to extract a deep, dark flavor profile that balances rich sweetness with a distinct tannic bite.

Tasting Notes: A velvety texture with intense notes of toasted walnut, dark chocolate, and holiday spices.

How to Serve: Traditionally served neat as a digestivo after a meal, or poured over high-quality vanilla gelato for a decadent dessert.

title: The Dot "Pear" Gemischter Satz 2023
bodyHtml:
Don’t let the name fool you, there are no actual pears in this bottle, just the pure, vibrant magic of Austrian grapes. The Dot "Austrian Pear" Gemischter Satz is a fresh and lively field blend crafted by the renowned Pfaffl family.

Gemischter Satz is Austria’s traditional "mixed set," where different white grape varieties are grown, harvested, and fermented together to create a wine that is greater than the sum of its parts. True to its nickname, this vintage bursts with aromas of ripe orchard pear, crisp apple, and a hint of citrus blossom. On the palate, it is zesty, aromatic, and perfectly balanced, a modern take on a Viennese classic that is effortless to drink.

Taste Profile: Ripe pear, green apple, citrus zest, and white flowers.

Perfect For: Sunny afternoons, picnic spreads, or anyone looking to explore Austria’s most charming white wine style.

title: Coole Swan Irish Creme
bodyHtml: Coole Swan is a unique blend of single malt Irish whiskey, Belgian white chocolate and fresh dairy cream. A taste experience that lingers for you to savour and enjoy. Made in Ireland, and only in Ireland, Coole Swan is a meticulously crafted liqueur made with heart.

title: River Retreat Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Looking for a versatile red that pairs with almost anything? The River Retreat Pinot Noir delivers approachable elegance at incredible value.

Grown in the warm, sun-drenched vineyards of the Murray Darling, this light-to-medium bodied wine bursts with fruit-forward character. Expect a bouquet of fresh raspberries and strawberries supported by a soft, savory earthiness. Aged briefly with French oak, it offers a polished texture without being heavy.

Why we love it:

Taste: Juicy red berries, vanilla hints, and a smooth, dry finish.

Goes with: Your Friday night pizza, Sunday roast chicken, or a charcuterie board with Brie and Camembert.

Bonus: A portion of proceeds aids wetland conservation in the Murray Darling basin.

title: Fukucho Hattanso Hybrid Kimoto R4
bodyHtml:
The "Impossible" Sake from Japan’s Most Innovative Brewer. This bottle represents one of the most exciting projects in the modern sake world. Brewed by Miho Imada—one of the few female Toji (Master Brewers) in Japan—this sake features the Hattanso rice grain, a variety that had gone extinct for a century. Imada-san spent years reviving this heirloom rice from just a handful of seeds, and she remains the only brewer in the world to use it.

The "Hybrid Kimoto" method combines the ancient pole-ramming fermentation technique with modern Ginjo yeast. The result is a sake that bridges the gap between history and innovation: vibrant, texturally complex, and bursting with energy.

Tasting Notes: Expect a lively, slight natural fizz (petillance) on the tongue. The palate is driven by bright citrus (lemon zest, grapefruit), wild herbs, and a savory, mineral finish. Pairing: Designed specifically for seafood. Perfect with fresh oysters, scallop crudo, or lemon-herb roasted chicken.

title: Balbo Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon is characterized by a deep ruby red and violet colour. The sensory profile includes a spiced nose with aromas of red and black fruits such as morello cherries and blackcurrants. These fruit notes are combined with touches of tobacco and vanilla. The wine has a distinguished palate, with good tannins and a deep, memorable finish. Depending on the market, this wine can also be labelled as 'Roble'. It is a Cabernet Sauvignon. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is in the range of 13%.

title: Martinelli Giuseppe & Luisa Zinfandel 2023
bodyHtml:
Martinelli Winery's history dates back to the 1880s when Giuseppe Martinelli and Luisa Vellutini emigrated from Tuscany, Italy, and established their original Zinfandel vineyard on the steep, non-terraced Jackass Hill. The winery's current Zinfandel program honours their determination and continues the legacy of a family that has been growing grapes for over 135 years. The wine is produced from a vineyard planted in 1994, which uses bud wood grafted from those original centenarian Jackass Hill vines.

Wine Description

The wine is a saturated ruby red color. The sensory profile is inviting, with aromas of ripe black cherry, Santa Rosa plum, and subtle, warming spices, alongside notes of cedar, red berries, baked earth, cranberry, blueberry, wildflowers, and spice. The palate is lively and bright, delivering vibrant cherry tart, succulent plum, and generous, spicy flavors of black cherry and raspberry laced with bittersweet mocha, savory pepper, and anise.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 94 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 94 points

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 93 points

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for Zinfandel include barbecue pork, roast lamb, grilled chicken, pulled pork, and hearty dishes like meat stews and robust pastas. Its bold, fruit-forward flavors and ample tannins make it an excellent match for bold, rich foods, such as bacon-wrapped tenderloin or grilled sausages.

title: Martinelli Bella Vigna Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
The Martinelli Family has been cultivating grapes and producing wine in the Russian River Valley since the late 1880s. The winery is dedicated to creating limited-production wines by carefully hand-farming each vineyard to produce only the highest quality fruit. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on reflecting the unique terroir of the Sonoma Coast vineyards while maintaining a sense of consistency across vintages.

Wine Description

This wine is crafted from 100% Chardonnay. On the nose, one finds inviting aromas of golden apple, fresh lemon juice, and graham cracker. It is vibrant upon entry with flavours of lemon and pear. The wine has a bright acid feeling on the palate, leading to a citrus-splashed and refreshing finish. Stylistically, the wine is balanced and refreshing.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include seafood dishes, roasted poultry, and creamy pastas. The versatility of Sonoma Coast Chardonnay also makes it a great match for pork, vegetarian dishes, and soft cheese.

title: Monteleone Etna Bianco 2024
bodyHtml:
Monteleone is a relatively new Etna producer, started in 2017 by Giulia Monteleone, her father Enrico, and her husband Benedetto Alessandrino. The winery is driven by a family-centric philosophy that has erased the boundary between life and work, transforming their lives through the complex adventure of winemaking. Their project began after choosing an old two-hectare vineyard near the Alcantara River on the north slope of Mount Etna, a place they considered their 'locus amoenus' or ideal spot to make wine.

Wine Description

This Etna Bianco is made exclusively from 100% Carricante grapes. On the nose, it offers delicate wafts of white blossom and citrus fruit, with notes of acacia flowers and ripe stone fruit. One may also find a lovely saline aroma and oyster-shell minerality, with hints of lemon leaves and white pepper. The palate is characterized by notes of ripe citrus fruits, peach, and apricot, mingling with ripe yellow fruits. It is a full white wine with a light body and tense, vibrant acidity that is perfectly balanced.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include fresh cheeses, white fish, fried seafood, and seafood-based main dishes or pasta/rice dishes. Specific suggestions include risotto with porcini mushrooms, or pesce crudo/ceviche/sushi.

title: Jackson Triggs Cabernet Sauvignon - 16 Litre Box
bodyHtml: This red wine originates from Canada, primarily from the wine regions of Ontario (Niagara Peninsula) or British Columbia (Okanagan). For over 30 years, Jackson Triggs has been recognized as an award winning Canadian winery, pouring passion into their winemaking. The winery, part of the Great Estates Niagara and Okanagan groups, emphasizes craftsmanship from vineyard to bottle, aiming to deliver flavourful and delicious wines.

title: Jackson Triggs Chardonnay - 16 Litre Box
bodyHtml: This white wine originates from Canada, primarily from the Ontario region (Niagara Peninsula) or the British Columbia region (Okanagan Valley). Jackson Triggs has been recognized as an award winning Canadian winery for over 30 years, driven by a passion for winemaking. The winery, which is part of the Great Estates Niagara and Okanagan groups, focuses on meticulous craftsmanship from the vineyard to the bottle to deliver flavourful and consistent wines.

title: Aurore Bachelet Pommard Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This elegant Pinot Noir originates from France, specifically the Burgundy region. The specific appellation (subregion) is Pommard, a village in the Côte de Beaune renowned for its robust and deep-structured red wines. Aurore Bachelet, a graduate of business school, returned to her Burgundian roots, receiving training in viticulture and oenology and working alongside her father, Vincent, for five years. The domain is situated in Santenay, in the southern part of the Côte de Beaune, and follows a winemaking philosophy that is as non-interventionist as possible, aiming to preserve the authenticity and identity of the region's classic varietals.

Wine Description

The Aurore Bachelet Pommard 2021 showcases a vivid, clear red color. The wine offers delicate aromas of red currant and cherry, with spices that are expected to develop further with age. On the palate, the wine is lively and balanced, presenting fine tannins and an overall elegant and refined profile. This wine is made from 100% Pinot Noir grown on 55-year-old vines in clay-limestone soils. Following manual harvesting, the wine undergoes cold pre-fermentation maceration and fermentation in vats for 15 days. It is then aged for 12 months in oak barrels, followed by 5 months in stainless steel tanks. While ready to be enjoyed now, it has the potential to age for several more years in a cellar.

title: Chateau Clarisse Puisseguin St. Emilion 2019
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from France, within the Bordeaux region, specifically the Saint Emilion subregion and the satellite appellation of Puisseguin Saint Emilion. Founded in 2009 by Olivia and Didier Le Calvez, the domain is the result of their passion for wine and their deep desire to transmit a family history. The château, named after their daughter Clarisse, operates with a profound pursuit of excellence and a commitment to working with the exceptional clay-limestone terroir.

Wine Description

This wine is a classic Bordeaux blend, primarily composed of Merlot and Cabernet Franc, sometimes with a touch of other varietals. Merlot contributes small red fruit notes and roundness to the wine, while Cabernet Franc provides structure and spiciness. The wine displays a deep, bright ruby colour with shining reflections. Aromas often include black cherries, plums, licorice, smoke, and flowers. On the palate, the wine is described as lush, supple, and rich in sweet, ripe, red fruits, supported by a nice roundness and great freshness. It has supple yet powerful tannins. The wine can be enjoyed upon release but also has excellent ageing potential, drinking well for up to eight to ten years depending on the vintage. Château Clarisse is certified organic, a commitment that began its conversion process in 2016 and achieved certification in 2019.

title: Yoshi no Gawa Hiya-Oroshi - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Yoshi No Gawa Hiya-Oroshi originates from Nagaoka City in the Niigata Prefecture of Japan. Established in 1548, Yoshi No Gawa is the oldest sake brewery in Niigata and is famous for its "tanrei karakuchi" (crisp and dry) style. This specific "Hiya-Oroshi" bottling is a seasonal autumn release, traditionally shipped only once a year starting in September to celebrate the changing of the seasons.

Description

The term "Hiya-Oroshi" refers to sake that is pasteurized once in the spring, aged cool throughout the summer to mellow its edges, and then bottled and shipped in the fall without a second pasteurization.

  • Texture & Aroma: This aging process results in a rounder, more velvety texture than fresh spring sake. It features a subtle and elegant aroma with hints of seasonal autumn fruits.

  • Flavor Profile: On the palate, it is smooth and savory with developed umami notes, balanced by the signature crisp, clean finish characteristic of Niigata sake.

  • Technical Details: It is typically a Junmai Ginjo grade with an alcohol content of approximately 15.5% and a rice polishing rate of 55%. It utilizes 100% local Niigata rice and the brewery's famous "Tenka-Kanrosen" soft spring water.

Seasonal Tradition

In Japanese brewing culture, Hiya-Oroshi is seen as a way to experience the "evolution" of sake. While a bottle opened in early September might still have a lingering youthful brightness, the same sake opened later in October or November will have deepened into a richer, more complex, and silkier beverage.

Food Pairing

Because Hiya-Oroshi is matured alongside the autumn harvest, it is specifically designed to complement the rich and savory "flavors of fall."

  • Autumn Harvest: Pairs perfectly with grilled Pacific saury (sanma), matsutake mushrooms, roasted chestnuts, and root vegetables like sweet potato.

  • Savoury Classics: Its enhanced umami makes it an excellent match for dishes with miso or soy sauce bases, as well as Japanese hot pots (nabe) and oden.

  • Western Pairings: For a non-traditional match, try it with hard aged cheeses or roasted game meats, which highlight the sake's rounded structure.

  • Serving Temperature: While it is delicious chilled (10°C) to show off its fruitier side, it is also highly recommended to serve it at room temperature or gently warmed (35°C–40°C) to fully expand its aromatic depth and sweetness.

title: Antinori Vie Cave Malbec 2022
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

    The Aldobrandesca 'Vie Cave' is a red wine from Italy, specifically the Tuscany region, within the Maremma subregion. The wine is produced by the Fattoria Aldobrandesca estate, which is owned by the Antinori family. The estate is situated in the southern part of the Tuscan Maremma, in what is known as 'the Etruscan Tuff zone'. The wine's name, 'Vie Cave,' is a dedication to the ancient Etruscan excavated roads in the area. The Antinori family has a winemaking history in Tuscany dating back six centuries. The estate's vineyards are planted on the slopes of a tufa spur where the town of Sovana is located, with Malbec thriving in the region's volcanic soils.

  2. Wine Description

    This wine is a single-varietal red made from 100% Malbec grapes. It typically presents an intense, dark, and dense ruby red colour. The aroma is rich, offering enticing fruity notes of blackberries, blueberries, and sour cherries, blended harmoniously with spicy hints of cloves and vanilla, and complemented by light notes of tobacco. On the palate, the wine is rich, captivating, and full-bodied, with silky and velvety tannins. Stylistic notes include being balanced and soft. The finish is long and persistent, defined by hints of bitter chocolate and mint. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is approximately 14.5% to 15%.

title: Lingua Franca Avni Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Lingua Franca was co-founded in 2015 by Master Sommelier Larry Stone and renowned Burgundian producer Dominique Lafon. The project was inspired by an exceptional vineyard Stone purchased in the Eola-Amity Hills in 2012. The winery's philosophy is centred on the exploration of Oregon's terroir, focusing on organic and regenerative farming principles to achieve freshness, tension, and complexity in their wines.

Wine Description

On the palate, it is vibrant and beautifully balanced, with a round texture and a clean, lingering finish. Flavours include nuances of lemon peel, green apple, and river stone, mingling with a delicate hint of pear and quince.

title: Cono Sur Cabernet Sauvignon 'Silencio' 2015
bodyHtml: This is a voluptuous Pinot Noir with rich fruit notes of cherry, raspberry, plum and strawberry, a red fruit party, enhanced by subtle smoked hints. In mouth sweet fruit notes stand out, and its fine tannins give it a great texture and a mouth-filling structure.

title: Fossacolle Brunello di Montalcino 2019
bodyHtml:
The Fossacolle estate is a small, family-run 'jewel-cellar' located in the southern part of Montalcino, with only four hectares of land. Owner Sergio Marchetti belongs to an old patriarchal family whose roots in the area date back to the 18th century. The winemaking activity officially began in 1984, after the owner of the lands gifted the 'Podere Fossacolle' to the Marchetti family. Today, the family manages the vineyards, with Sergio’s son-in-law, Adriano Bambagioni, overseeing the oenological and commercial aspects.

Wine Description

On the nose, it offers aromas of sour red cherries, fennel, and lifted floral notes of lavenders and potpourri. The palate is medium-bodied and round textured, sustained by great complexity. Stylistically, it exhibits an optimal equilibrium, elegance, and complexity. The tannins are noteworthy, described as silky and oily, leading to an excellent length and persistent finish.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include red meats, game, and matured cheeses such as Pecorino Toscano or Parmigiano-Reggiano. Try it with stewed and braised meat dishes or a rich, tomato-based pasta.

title: Taylor Fladgate Historical - The Globe
bodyHtml:
aylor Fladgate is one of the oldest and most respected historic wine houses, with a founding date of 1692. 'The Globe' is the fourth release in the acclaimed Historical Collection, celebrating centuries of Port heritage and Taylor Fladgate's mastery of cask-aged Port. The limited-edition bottle is inspired by the spherical, mouth-blown 'shaft and globe' English wine bottles prevalent in the mid-17th century.

Wine Description

'The Globe' is a specially blended Reserve Tawny Port. It presents a deep, reddish-brown core framed by a slender brick-red rim. The mature, rich nose offers inviting aromas of coffee, butterscotch, dried fruit, plum, and raisin, enveloped by delicate notes of spice, wood, and nuttiness. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and dense with a smooth, velvety texture. Flavours of indulgent caramel, toffee, nuts, and preserved fruit linger, culminating in a long, warming finish.

Food Pairing

The aged Tawny Port's mellow, nutty profile makes it a natural match for pecan pie, crème brûlée, or even aged Manchego cheese.

title: Martinelli Vigneto Di Evo Zinfandel 2022
bodyHtml:
The Martinelli family has been growing grapes in the Russian River Valley since the 1880s, when founders Giuseppe Martinelli and Luisa Vellutini eloped from Italy and began farming land. Now in their sixth generation of farming, the family continues their legacy of hands-on farming and stewardship of the land, with a primary goal of hand-crafting quality wines born in their estate vineyards. The wines are minimally handled, unfined, and unfiltered, allowing the true nature of the vineyard to shine through.

Wine Description

The wine offers aromas of rich red raspberry, cinnamon, and sweet clove. The palate is lively and full of juicy red plum and black cherry flavours, which lead to exotic spice notes and a long finish.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for this rich and intense Zinfandel include lamb or a venison main course with elements like beetroot, caramelized chestnuts, chocolate, and juniper. For a vegetarian option, try grilled portobello mushrooms or roasted eggplant, which highlight the wine's herbal hints.

title: Martinelli Bella Vigna Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
The Martinelli family has been a part of the Russian River Valley's history since 1887, first planting Zinfandel and Muscat Alexandria vines. The family, now in its sixth generation of wine growers, began producing Pinot Noir under their own label in 1993, and the 'Bella Vigna' (Italian for 'Beautiful Vines') label is a blend curated from their estate Pinot Noir vineyards to reflect the Martinelli style.

Wine Description

It boasts a bouquet of summertime cherries and raspberries. On the palate, it presents supple flavours of ripe cherries and pomegranate, accented by a dusting of cinnamon. Other notes include leather, violet, clove, and earthiness. This is a rich, full-bodied, and generously structured wine with silky, balanced tannins and refreshing acidity. It is unfined and unfiltered, showcasing a complex and rounded palate with a long, lingering finish.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include roasted poultry like duck or chicken, grilled or roasted salmon or tuna, pork tenderloin, and lighter red meat dishes. Its earthy undertones make it an excellent match for mushroom-based dishes, such as truffle risotto, or roasted root vegetables.

title: Benjamin Bridge Piquette 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This sparkling beverage originates from Canada, specifically the Nova Scotia region. Benjamin Bridge is a leading winery in the Gaspereau Valley, recognized for its exceptional sparkling wines and commitment to sustainable viticulture. Their Piquette is a unique, lighter style beverage made using the traditional method of adding water to the pomace (the leftover grape skins, seeds, and stems) after pressing, then re-fermenting it.

Wine Description

Benjamin Bridge Piquette is primarily made from the pomace of certified organic estate-grown grapes, often a blend of white and red varieties, including aromatic hybrids. It is a naturally sparkling, low alcohol (typically 6.8% ABV or lower), and slightly sweet beverage.

title: Honor Cava Rose - Non Vintage
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction 

The Honor Cava Rosé is a sparkling wine from Spain, produced in the Cava Designation of Origin (DO), which is largely centred in the Penedès region of Catalonia. The winery, Celler Jan Vidal, has a long tradition in viticulture, tracing its roots back half a century. The family behind the winery was originally a farming family in the heart of the Penedès region. Celler Jan Vidal emphasizes tradition, culture, and elegance in its winemaking. The family's philosophy focuses on constant improvement and minimizing the human footprint on their wines, using traditional methods and local grape varieties from their vineyards located in the Alt Penedès and Baix Penedès areas.

2. Wine Description

The Honor Cava Rosé has a cherry pink colour with bright purple reflections. It is crafted primarily from the indigenous Trepat grape variety. The aroma is varietal in character, fruity and complex, with a strong emphasis on red forest fruits, particularly strawberries and raspberries. On the palate, the wine is described as fresh, pleasant, and balanced, showing good structure with well-integrated carbonation. The Cava is made using the traditional method, with secondary fermentation occurring in the bottle. It is typically aged for a minimum of 9 months on the lees, and often aged for 12 months, which is beyond the DO Cava's minimum requirement. The wine has an alcohol by volume (ABV) of 11.5%. The winery, Celler Jan Vidal, is noted for using traditional methods and local varieties from their organic vineyards, indicating the wine is likely organic. The optimal drinking window is immediately, serving chilled between 8°C and 10°C.

title: Penfolds Grandfather Rare Tawny 20 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The Penfolds Grandfather Port is a renowned fortified wine from Australia, sourced from specially selected South Australian vineyards. Penfolds has a long and proud tradition of fortified wine production dating back to 1844, when Dr. Christopher and Mary Penfold began making tonics and fortified wines. The name 'Grandfather' dates back to 1915, when an oak cask containing a blend of the company's finest tawnies was set aside for the exclusive use of the Penfold family. The winery's overarching philosophy is an uncompromising commitment to quality and a distinctive 'House Style' defined by meticulous fruit-sourcing and a focus on blending to achieve consistency and richness.

Wine Description

This fortified wine is a deep tawny colour with a distinctive yellow-green edge, characteristic of extended wood maturation. It is a rare tawny style, made from a blend of up to 13 different varieties. The backbone of the blend is primarily Shiraz, Grenache, Mataro (Mourvèdre), and Cabernet.

The aroma is extremely complex and fragrant. On the nose, it displays intense raisin fruits, fruitcake, liquorice, and roasted walnuts, seamlessly integrated with nutty and vanillin aged characters. The palate is luscious, rich, and full-flavoured, presenting classical Penfolds fruitcake and vanillin oak flavours. It has a sweet, full, and round mid-palate, and a finish that persists on and on, delivering impressive length, freshness, and complexity.

As a non-vintage (NV) tawny, the average blended age is a minimum of 20 years. It is fully matured and bottled for immediate enjoyment; it is best consumed within 12 months of purchase. The typical Alcohol by Volume (ABV) is around 20.0%.

title: Eau Claire Distillery Single Malt Whisky Batch 008
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Eau Claire Distillery Single Malt Whisky Batch 008 is from Canada, specifically the region of Alberta and the subregion of Turner Valley. Eau Claire Distillery was founded by David Farran, who was inspired to start the distillery after learning that Alberta barley is used in much of Scotland's whisky production. The distillery uses a farm-to-glass ethos, including traditional horse farming methods to plant and harvest some of the grain for their whiskies.

Spirit Description

This single malt is distilled from 100% Alberta-grown barley, using crystal-clear glacial water from the Sheep River. The nose of this whisky offers notes of oak shavings, grassy fields, and raisins, as well as red fruit, brown sugar, green apple, and white pepper. The palate features flavours of sweet malt, vanilla, toffee, and dried fruit compote, with additional notes of caramelised toffee. The finish is described as having toasted coconut, walnut, and cocoa powder notes, and also a palate-covering, building pepper spice and red fruit jam. It is bottled at 44.4% ABV, showcasing a bold, grain-forward character.

Food Pairing

This rich, warm, and textured single malt whisky with notes of orchard fruit, toasted oak, and gentle spice is a good match for a variety of foods. Consider pairing it with a selection of aged cheeses like gouda or cheddar, or with sweet nuts such as almonds. The whisky's spice and fruit notes would also complement desserts like dark chocolate or apple pie.

title: Francois Chidaine Touraine Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
François Chidaine is celebrated for his pivotal role in the Montlouis wine renaissance and is considered one of France's most revered white winemakers. Taking over from his father in 1989 with only four hectares, François has expanded the estate and is known as a pioneer of organic and biodynamic farming in the region. His winemaking philosophy includes a commitment to regenerative agriculture, encouraging biodiversity and establishing permanent cover crops to nurture the soil's complex fungal network.

Wine Description

This wine displays a pale lemon-green hue with a limpid, brilliant colour. It is made from 100% Sauvignon Blanc grapes, cropped from vines in the heart of the Touraine appellation. The aromatic profile is classic Loire Valley, offering a delicate bouquet of ripe citrus like key limes, grapefruit, and lemons, mingling with notes of white flowers and fresh cut grass. The palate is crisp and racy, defined by lean citrus fruits and taut, bright acidity. It is fleshy and balanced, with stone fruits and a strong chalky drive and mineral undertones.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with grilled fish, shellfish, sushi, sashimi, and ceviche. Other suggested pairings include asparagus, shrimp and avocado salad, and goat's cheese.

title: Chanoine Freres Brut Reserve Privee
bodyHtml:
This is a sparkling wine from France in the Champagne region and Appellation d'Origine Contrôlée (AOC). The Champagne is produced by Chanoine Frères. Founded in 1730, Chanoine Frères is noted as the second oldest Champagne house. The winery's expertise is founded on quality and tradition, with a philosophy of passing on the pleasure of Champagne to future generations.

Wine Description

This is a Non Vintage (NV) product produced using the traditional method. It is a Champagne blend, typically including the three main Champagne grapes: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, and Pinot Meunier. The blend is often dominated by Pinot Noir.

  • Colour: It has a limpid, straw colour, sometimes described as pale warm gold. The foam is fine and persistent.

  • Aroma: The nose is subtle and aromatic, with notes of lemon confit, citrus fruits, gingerbread, cinnamon, and honey. Other aromas noted are peach, apricot, spice, ripe apricots, white peach, and fresh baked bread.

  • Palate: The palate is lively and round, delivering flavours in line with the aromas. Tasting notes include fig, raisin, toasty notes, apple, and orange.

  • Body: The wine is described as medium-bodied, offering a harmonious balance between freshness and richness. It is well balanced, giving a wine that is lively, rich, and structured.

  • Finish: The finish is medium in length and may show a slight citrus oil bitterness.

  • Varietal Composition: Champagne blend, including Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, and Pinot Meunier. Specific blends vary, for example, 55% Pinot Noir, 31% Pinot Meunier, 14% Chardonnay or 77% Pinot Noir, 16% Chardonnay, and 7% Pinot Meunier.

  • ABV: It has an alcohol by volume of 12% to 12.5%.

  • Optimal Drinking Window: Drink now. The non vintage wine may be best enjoyed through to 2025.

title: Fernie What The Huck What The Huck Berry Ale - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
What the Huck is the award-winning flagship fruit beer from Fernie Brewing Company, nestled in the heart of the Rocky Mountains in British Columbia. While many fruit beers use common berries like raspberry or strawberry, Fernie celebrates the regional identity of the Kootenays by using huckleberries a wild, tart mountain berry that is notoriously difficult to harvest. It is a "mountain-to-can" success story and one of the most recognizable fruit ales in Western Canada.

Beer Description

What the Huck pours a deep, slightly hazy purple-burgundy with a frothy, lavender-tinted head that offers a striking visual contrast in the glass.

Aroma: The nose is highly aromatic and distinctive. It leads with a punchy scent of wild huckleberries and forest fruit, which smells like a cross between a tart blueberry and a sweet cranberry. There is a soft, underlying bready malt sweetness that grounds the vibrant fruit notes.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a smooth, almost velvety mouthfeel. It leads with a burst of sweet-and-tart berry flavor. Because huckleberries have a more complex, earthy profile than garden berries, the beer has a sophisticated depth. The finish is clean and slightly dry, with the natural tannins of the fruit providing a subtle, refreshing "snap."

Profile: It sits at a sessionable 5.0% ABV and a very low bitterness of 15 IBU, ensuring the delicate mountain berries aren't overshadowed by hops.

Technical Notes: The base of What the Huck is a clean-fermented Wheat Ale. The inclusion of malted wheat provides a soft, "pillowy" texture and helps carry the fruit flavors across the palate. Fernie uses a high-quality huckleberry addition during the conditioning process to ensure the flavor tastes like authentic fruit rather than artificial candy.

title: Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label Brut - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

The Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label Brut is a signature Champagne from France, specifically the Champagne region. The Champagne House, Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin, was founded in 1772 by Philippe Clicquot-Murion in Reims, France. The house rose to international acclaim under the leadership of Madame Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin, who was widowed at 27 and took over the business in 1805. She became known as the 'Grande Dame of Champagne' for her vision, determination, and innovative spirit. Her contributions include pioneering the riddling table process (to clarify the wine) and producing the first known vintage and first blended rosé Champagnes. The house's winemaking philosophy is defined by its quest for excellence, a love for Pinot Noir, and a mastery of the art of ageing, with the motto, 'Our wines must be flattering both to the palate and the eye'.

2. Wine Description

The Yellow Label Brut has a striking, brilliant golden-yellow hue and a foaming necklace of fine, persistent bubbles. The varietal composition is dominated by Pinot Noir (50–55%), which provides the wine's structure and body, balanced by Chardonnay (28–33%) for finesse and elegance, and Pinot Meunier (15–20%) for a round, fruity character. The wine is a Non-Vintage (NV) Brut.

The aroma is initially reminiscent of yellow and white fruits like pear and apple, developing into more complex notes of vanilla, freshly baked brioche, toasted nuts, and sometimes a subtle citrus zest or chalky undertone. On the palate, it delivers a fresh, vivacious attack followed by a harmonious and well-structured body, with a symphony of fruit (pear, lemon, peach) and pronounced toasty, nutty, and savory flavours from the ageing. The wine has a medium-body, a creamy, elegant texture, and a long, clean finish.

The complexity is achieved by blending grapes from 50 to 60 different Crus (vineyards) and including a significant proportion of reserve wines (up to 45%). The wine undergoes a minimum of three years of bottle ageing on the lees in their chalk cellars (crayères), which is longer than the minimum requirement for non-vintage Champagne. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is typically 12% (some sources indicate 12.5%). The dosage is around 9 grams per litre (g/L), classifying it as Brut. The optimal drinking window is immediately, but it has a cellar potential of 3 to 5 years. There is no information provided to indicate the wine is organic.

title: Moutard Brut Grande Reserve
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This sparkling wine originates from France, specifically the Champagne region and the Côte des Bar in the southernmost Aube department. The Moutard family, whose roots in Burgundy can be traced back to 1642, established their Champagne house in 1952 in the village of Buxeuil. The house philosophy is to produce wines that express the unique characteristics of their terroir, emphasizing sustainable viticulture and traditional Champagne methods.

Wine Description

The Moutard Brut Grande Reserve is a non vintage Champagne, primarily a blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. It is made from grapes sourced from a variety of plots, with a significant amount of reserve wine (up to 30%) incorporated to ensure a consistent house style. The wine spends a minimum of three years on its lees, developing complexity and fine effervescence.

  • The colour is often a delicate pale gold with a steady stream of fine bubbles.

  • Aromas include notes of white flowers, honey, citrus, pear, and toasted bread or brioche from the extended ageing.

  • The palate is described as rich, creamy, and well structured, displaying notes of toasted nuts, baked apple, citrus, and minerality.

  • The finish is persistent, clean, and refreshing, demonstrating excellent balance and elegance.

  • The style is dry (Brut) and complex, showcasing the freshness and depth that comes from its time on the lees.

  • The optimal drinking window is immediate, though it can age for an additional 2–5 years in a cool cellar.

title: Pastourelle de Clerc Milon 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine comes from France, specifically the Bordeaux region, in the appellation of Pauillac. Pastourelle de Clerc Milon is the second wine of Château Clerc Milon, a Cinquième Grand Cru Classé (Fifth Growth) in the 1855 Bordeaux Wine Official Classification. The estate, located in the northern part of the appellation, is contiguous with the vineyards of two First Growths, Château Mouton Rothschild and Château Lafite Rothschild. Château Clerc Milon has been owned by Baron Philippe de Rothschild and his family since 1970. The wine's name, 'Pastourelle,' refers to a traditional dance that symbolizes the romantic encounter between a knight and a shepherdess, echoing the two dancers featured on the Grand Vin's label.

Wine Description

The 2022 vintage is noted for being a ripe, medium to full-bodied, and concentrated second wine, considered one of the best examples of this cuvée to date. The colour is typically described as a deep garnet-purple or a deep ruby red with a distinct purple hue.

The aroma is expressive, bursting with notes of juicy blueberries, kirsch, red fruits, violets, and black plum. Tertiary notes of underbrush, sandalwood, dried sage, cigar wrapper, and subtle pencil shavings also emerge. The varietal composition is a blend, primarily composed of 52% Cabernet Sauvignon, 40% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc, 2% Carmenère, and 1% Petit Verdot.

On the palate, the wine is plump, juicy, and rounded in texture, with flavours of ripe dark fruits such as blackcurrant, blackberry, and plum. Stylistically, it is described as plush, highly accessible, and a crowd-pleaser, with elegance and precision. It features soft, cushioned, and velvety tannins that are well-integrated, providing structure without being assertive. It possesses just enough freshness and a lively character. The finish is clean, with notes of blueberry, mint chocolate, pepper, or cocoa powder, and a good length. The wine is aged in second-fill barrels (used oak) for approximately twelve months, with some portion aged in amphorae, and no new oak is typically used. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 14.5%, or 14.47% as measured. The optimal drinking window is noted as starting around 2025 to 2034. Information on the wine being organic is not available, though the Grand Vin estate farms close to 50% of its vines using organic techniques.

title: Taylor Fladgate Sentinels Vintage Port 2022
bodyHtml:
Taylor’s is one of the oldest and most prestigious Port houses, founded in 1692, and the Sentinels name is inspired by the granite pillars, or 'marcos de feitoria,' that were erected between 1758 and 1761 to demarcate the highest quality Port wine regions. This blend is crafted to celebrate the rich heritage and distinct, powerfully fruity style of the Pinhão Valley.

Wine Description

The bouquet offers an explosion of powerful woodland fruit, layered with rich blackcurrant, dark plum, and cherries. Subtle notes of dark cherry, rose petals, mint, and rockrose enhance the aroma, showcasing complexity. On the palate, the Port displays remarkable freshness and purity of fruit, with focused berry flavours of damsons, plums, and black cherries. It has hints of lavender and herbal notes, and a long, evolving finish that demonstrates its elegance and vigour.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for Vintage Port include a variety of richly flavoured cheeses, such as blue-veined varieties like Stilton, Roquefort, or Gorgonzola. Dried fruits such as apricots or figs, as well as nuts and dark chocolate, also complement its rich profile.

title: Coffele Castel Cerino Soave 2024
bodyHtml:
The Coffele winery, with cellars dating back to the 1600s, is located in the heart of the old walled village of Soave. The estate was brought back to life in 1971 by Giovanna Visco and her husband Giuseppe, and today is run by their children, Alberto and Chiara. Their winemaking philosophy is rooted in a passion for the land and the pursuit of excellence, using organically farmed Garganega vineyards on the steep slopes of the Castelcerino cru.

Wine Description

The aromas are subtle and fresh, suggesting white flowers like hawthorn and cherry blossoms, complemented by notes of fresh apple, white plum, sage, and minerals. On the palate, the wine is dry and structured, offering excellent harmony and balance. The finish is long and refreshing, with characteristic almond notes.

title: Honig Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Honig Vineyard & Winery is a family-owned and operated business in the heart of Napa Valley, established in 1984. The family purchased the Rutherford ranch in 1964 and, after the patriarch Louis Honig passed away, his family produced a tribute Sauvignon Blanc in 1980 that won a Gold Medal, leading to the winery's creation. The winery is a leader in sustainability, being certified by the California Sustainable Winegrowing Alliance and Fish Friendly Farming.

Wine Description

The complex aroma offers layered notes of cassis, blackberries, and dark cherries, with hints of cedar, vanilla, and baking spices. The palate is full-bodied and well-structured, featuring rich black fruit flavours like plums and blackberries, interwoven with notes of chocolate, espresso, and toasty oak. 

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include robust dishes like grilled steaks, lamb chops, and beef ribs, as well as roasted poultry with savoury sauces, and hearty stews like beef stew or osso buco.

title: La Magia Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This red wine comes from Italy, specifically the Tuscany region, in the appellation of Brunello di Montalcino DOCG. Fattoria La Magia is a prestigious winery located in the heart of the Montalcino region. The estate is distinguished by its magnificent cherry tree, which identifies its cru, 'Ciliegio'. La Magia focuses on producing wines that balance power and structure with superb elegance.

2. Wine Description

This is a full-bodied, structured, and elegant red wine. The colour is ruby red with a tendency towards garnet red. The aroma features red berries, slight minerality, and fine spice notes. Specific notes include hints of mint, cedar, camphor, and dried black cherries. Other descriptors include floral notes, sour cherry (amarena), ripe cherry, citrus zest, and a pleasant spicy-toasted nuance.

The varietal composition is 100% Sangiovese Grosso. On the palate, it is full-bodied, concentrated, and silken. The flavour profile includes vividly ripe red and blue fruits, Morello cherry, raspberry jam, vanilla, and star anise. The body is elegant, refined, and structured, with a soft creaminess. Stylistically, it has a generous acidity and elegant, restrained, and finely chiselled tannins that provide a muscular grip. The finish is dramatic, long, and lingering, leaving a lasting impression of fruit, spice, and a hint of minerality. The wine is aged for three years, mainly in 500-litre French oak tonneaux (large barrels), followed by six months of refinement in the bottle. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is typically 14.5% or 15%. This wine is noted for its concentration and elegance that only the Sangiovese grape can deliver in its ideal environment. The optimal drinking window is noted as starting around 2025–2026 and extending to 2032–2036 or even 2048. Information on the wine being organic is not available.

title: Bussola Valpolicella Classico 2023
bodyHtml:
Azienda Agricola Tommaso Bussola was established in 1977 when a young and passionate Tommaso Bussola began working at his uncle Giuseppe's small wine estate. Starting with traditional methods, Tommaso felt the need to experiment, and his philosophy now revolves around loving and respecting the land by carefully exploiting what nature provides, using a patient and long process with the vines.

Wine Description

It offers complex aromas of fresh cranberry, cherry, dried herbaceous notes, rich blueberries, vibrant pepper, spices, leather, and smoke. On the palate, it has flavours of raspberry, plum, and cherry with spicy hints, a light to medium body, and a chewy, velvety tannin structure.

Food Pairing

Given its bright fruit and lively acidity, it would be an excellent match for veal burgers with mango and goat cheese, or pappardelle with duck confit.

title: Laroche 'L' Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Laroche 'L' Chardonnay is a white wine from France, produced in the Languedoc Roussillon region and the Pays d'Oc I.G.P. (Indication Géographique Protégée) appellation. The wine is made by Domaine Laroche at their property, Mas La Chevalière. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a belief that great wine comes from great terroir, applied here in the Mediterranean climate of the Languedoc, where the Chardonnay grapes benefit from warm days and cool nights. This wine represents a modern, fresh, and approachable expression of Chardonnay.

Wine Description

The wine is 100% Chardonnay. It has a clear and brilliant pale straw colour. The aromatic profile is noted for its freshness and fruit, offering scents of pungent citrussy aromas, honey melon, ripe pear, and orchard fruit. Further nuances include subtle butter and vanilla.

It is a medium bodied wine. The palate is clean and round, with lively flavours of peach, pear, and citrus. The acidity is refreshing and well balanced. Stylistically, it is a lovely, well crafted, and fruit-driven wine, showing great finesse and a smooth texture. It is typically fermented and aged in temperature controlled stainless steel tanks to preserve its aromatic purity, though some vintages may see a very small percentage of barrel ageing. The finish is persistent and clean. The ABV is typically 13.0%. The optimal drinking window is to enjoy within a year or two of the vintage. The winery is committed to sustainable practices.

title: Laroche L Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This red wine comes from France, specifically the Languedoc region, produced under the IGP Pays d'Oc designation. The wine is a product of Laroche and its Mas la Chevalière property. Michel Laroche purchased the Mas la Chevalière vineyards in 1995, establishing the winery near Béziers after a ten-year search for a suitable Languedoc site. The winery is noted for its innovative approach to energy management. The winemaking philosophy, shared by winemaker Géraud Blanc and the team, prioritizes purity of fruit, a refined balance, and working in tune with nature.

2. Wine Description

The colour of this 100% Pinot Noir wine is described as a bright ruby red. It is noted for its fine, elegant structure and finesse. The aroma displays ripe cherry and strawberry notes. The nose can also have a sensation of black fruit and fleshy, ripe cherries with a hint of spice.

The palate is bright and juicy, combining fruit-forward flavours with supple, velvety tannins. It is light to medium-bodied, well-balanced, and expressive. Flavours include raspberry, strawberries, cherry, and cranberry notes. The finish is long and refreshing. The wine is aged for six months, primarily in stainless steel tanks (80%) on lees, with a smaller portion (20%) matured in oak barrels (half muids and 228 L). The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 12.5%. The grapes are predominantly sourced from organic vineyards of growers with whom Laroche has long-term partnerships. These grapes come from the Northern Gard at the foothills of the Cévennes. The winemaker's use of only natural products and no chemical pesticides or herbicides underscores a commitment to organic viticulture.

title: Lyeth Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine comes from the United States, originating from the California region. Lyeth Estate was founded in Sonoma County in 1981 by Chip Lyeth, whose passion for winemaking grew out of a 1972 family trip to Bordeaux, France. Chip Lyeth was dedicated to the vision of making outstanding Cabernet Sauvignon and blending in other varietals for complexity, which led to the creation of the Meritage blend upon which Lyeth built its success. Over 30 years later, the winery remains dedicated to this tradition of Bordeaux-inspired blending. Currently, the Director of Winemaking is Nicole Walsh, who has over 25 years of experience and a commitment to sustainability.

Wine Description

The colour of this Cabernet Sauvignon is often described as deep crimson or dark, rich ruby. The aroma is complex and expressive, offering notes of red cherry, boysenberry-cedar, a touch of minerality, or raspberry and floral notes. For the 2022 vintage, the nose includes violets and raspberries. The palate is full-bodied, rich, and often described as having a generous texture. Flavours include savoury spice, bramble raspberry, chocolate-cherry, black currant, plum, cocoa, and ripe plums.

The wine is primarily Cabernet Sauvignon. Some vintages, such as the 2016, are a blend of 77% Cabernet Sauvignon, 11% Petit Verdot, 10% Merlot, and 2% Malbec, while others like the 2022 vintage are noted as 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. The wine is aged, with the 2022 vintage spending 12 months on 100% new French oak, which adds depth, richness, and a smooth, velvety mouthfeel. It has balanced acidity and a structured tannic profile. The finish is long and lingering, revealing notes of baking chocolate, ripe plums, or just more dark fruit. The stylistic notes are bold, structured, and complex. The alcohol by volume (ABV) typically ranges from 13.5% to 14.5%. Information on the wine being organic is not available. The optimal drinking window for the 2022 vintage is noted as 'Now to 2028'.

title: The Arran Amarone Cask Finish
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This single malt Scotch whisky originates from Scotland, specifically the Island region, produced at the Arran Distillery in Lochranza on the Isle of Arran. The distillery was founded in 1994 by Harold Currie, a former director at Chivas Brothers, marking the revival of legal whisky production on the island after a 155-year gap. The Isle of Arran Distillers, the current owner, maintains a core range of single malts and aims to create a spirit that is rich but gentle and fruity.

2. Wine Description

This whisky is a non-age-statement single malt that is first matured in traditional oak casks (often ex-Bourbon) for several years, then 'finished' in a selection of Amarone wine casks sourced from an artisan producer in the Veneto region of Italy.

The colour is described as burnished copper with an unusual reddish or pinkish hue, as no artificial colouring is added. The aroma offers notes of cherry, 'Turkish delight,' chocolate, poached pears, a touch of cranberry, and honey. On the palate, expect plums, cherries, cinnamon, liquorice, and blackberries, often with notes of dark chocolate, stewed fruits, and toffee. The body is full and rounded. The finish is medium to long, with sweetness, pears, 'Turkish delight,' cherries, and dark chocolate. The wine cask influence brings a luxurious Italian wine character that complements the complex and vibrant Scottish malt. The optimal drinking window is not specified, as this is a spirit. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 50%. The whisky is non-chill filtered and has natural colour. Information on the whisky being organic is not available.

title: Weinert Cabernet Franc 2019
bodyHtml:
Bodega y Cavas de Weinert was founded in 1975 by Don Bernardo C. Weinert, a Brazilian businessman of German origin. The winery's unwavering philosophy is to produce high-quality, classic Argentine wines, a commitment it upholds through meticulous manual harvesting, fermentation in temperature-controlled cement tanks, and long ageing in large French oak casks in deep, cool, underground cellars.

Wine Description

On the nose, it offers a profile of dark fruit like blackcurrant and blueberry, complemented by herbal notes, tobacco, and chocolate. The palate is juicy and full-bodied, delivering ripe berry flavours, balanced tannins, and good acidity. Hints of cedar, coffee, and green bell pepper contribute to its complex sensory experience and long finish.

title: Argento Cabernet Franc Reserva 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine is from Argentina, originating in the Mendoza region, with grapes often sourced from subregions like Alto Agrelo in Luján de Cuyo. Bodega Argento, established in 1998, has consistently built a reputation over the past two decades for producing fresh wines that express the unique terroir of Mendoza, which is defined by its semi-arid climate, alluvial soils, and high altitude at the foothills of the Andes. The winery, which is owned by Alejandro Bulgheroni, is dedicated to sustainable production and is one of Argentina’s largest organic growers, with a philosophy of minimal intervention and a focus on fruit purity and vibrancy.

Wine Description

The Argento Cabernet Franc Reserva typically displays a delicate ruby or deep ruby colour. The aromatic profile is vibrant, showcasing notes of cherry, raspberry, and blackcurrant leaf, often with additional complexity from herbal spice, black pepper, and tobacco. On the palate, the wine is rich and often described as medium to full bodied, with flavours of ripe red and black fruits like cassis, blackberry, and plum. It possesses sweet, polished, and sometimes chalky or chewy tannins that provide structure, balanced by good acidity that maintains freshness and leads to a long finish. The varietal composition is 100% Cabernet Franc. The wine's alcohol by volume (ABV) is approximately 14% to 14.5%. The wine is crafted from certified organic grapes, and the winemaking includes ageing in French oak barrels.

title: Cafe de Paris Brut
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

This sparkling wine comes from France, specifically the Bordeaux region, where it is elaborated in Cubzac les Ponts. Café de Paris has a unique and authentic expertise, having produced sparkling wines from its historic cellars in Cubzac les Ponts since 1898. The brand was acquired by Cordier in 2020 and its winemaking blends batonnage with traditional French techniques to create a distinct, low-sweetness style.

2. Wine Description

The wine presents a crystal-clear, pale yellow colour with a vibrant stream of fine bubbles. Its aroma is bright and expressive, offering vibrant citrus and delicate floral notes. The palate is dry, well-balanced, and refreshing, with a focus on aromatic freshness and citrus notes. This wine is a blend of six white grape varieties: Sauvignon Blanc, Ugni Blanc, Sémillon, Chardonnay, Chenin Blanc, and Colombard. It is noted for its complexity and fine bubbles, which balance its very low sweetness. The optimal drinking window is noted as 2025–2027. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 11.5%. Information on the wine being organic is not available in the provided sources.

title: Taylor Fladgate 1975 Single Harvest Port
bodyHtml:
Taylor Fladgate, established in 1692, is one of the oldest of the founding Port houses and has maintained a long, unbroken family tradition. Today, it is the namesake of the Fladgate Partnership, which remains 100% family-run and is dedicated entirely to the production of Port wine, setting a benchmark for Vintage Port.

Wine Description

It exhibits a deep amber-bronze colour with a luminous, jewel-like golden rim, reflecting its long cask ageing. The bouquet is complex and elegant, offering aromas of wild honey, molasses, and tea leaves, complemented by notes of red cherry compote, cedar cigar box, wild rosemary, thyme, and fresh mint. The palate has a sumptuous and velvety entry, unveiling rich flavours of blood orange marmalade, dried figs, apricots, rum baba, butterscotch, dates, and candied citrus.

Food Pairing

This Very Old Single Harvest Port pairs perfectly with desserts featuring figs, almonds, and caramel, such as crème brûlée. It is also an excellent match for hard, nutty cheeses like Parmesan and Manchego, or the rich intensity of a foie gras.

title: Taylor Fladgate 2003 Vintage Port
bodyHtml:
Taylor Fladgate is considered one of the pinnacle Port houses, declaring a Vintage Port only in years when the harvest achieves perfection, which puts the company's reputation on the line with a worldwide audience. Their Vintage Ports are renowned for their massive structure, aromatic power, and distinct 'masculine' style, and are crafted from the finest estate vineyards, including Quinta de Vargellas.

Wine Description

The classic Taylor nose offers exotic and floral scents like violet and spice set against a backdrop of intense dark berry fruit. Notes of molasses, burnt sugar, and jammy plums can also emanate from the glass. The palate is stylish and racy, showcasing a tight fabric of sinewy tannins and packed with concentrated grapey flavours that intensify through the long finish. It is full-bodied, hugely dense, and immensely rich, yet amazingly balanced and harmonious.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 98 points

  • Wine Enthusiast - 97 points

  • Wine Spectator - 94 points

  • Decanter - 93 points

Food Pairing

The classic association is with a mature blue cheese such as Stilton, where the piquancy of the cheese is perfectly matched by the powerfully majestic flavours of the Vintage Port.

title: Chimay Gold 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml: The Chimay Gold, which is brewed in the heart of Scourmont Abbey, was for long reserved for the monastic community and its guests and staff. Its refreshing aromas of hops and spice are now yours to try.

title: Johanna Cecillon Cidre Divona 330 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml: J. Cecillon Cidre Divona is a premium, artisanal dry cider from the country of France, specifically the Brittany region. It is produced by Domaine Johanna Cécillon, a family-run cidery in Sévignac that follows a philosophy of natural and biodynamic viticulture. The name Divona pays homage to the Celtic goddess of sacred springs, reflecting the estate's deep connection to the land. The 330 ml format offers a convenient individual serving of this highly structured and expressive cider.

title: Heineken 0.0 (Non Alcoholic) 330 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Heineken 0.0 is a non alcoholic lager originating from the Netherlands. The Heineken company was founded in 1864 by Gerard Adriaan Heineken, who purchased the 'De Hooiberg' brewery in Amsterdam. To this day, the brewery remains under the significant influence of the Heineken family, maintaining a legacy of independent brewing that has spanned over 150 years.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic lager presents a golden yellow appearance with a soft, white foam. The aroma is crisp and flavourful, characterized by refreshing fruity notes and a classic malty scent. On the palate, it offers a perfectly balanced taste with a soft malty body and a subtle hint of sweetness. The body is smooth and refreshing, leading to a clean finish that is less bitter than many traditional lagers. It contains 0.0% alcohol by volume and is crafted using the same natural ingredients as the original lager.

Food Pairing

The crisp and balanced profile of this brew makes it a versatile companion for various snacks and light meals. It pairs exceptionally well with salty hot chips or pretzels, where the malt sweetness contrasts effectively with the salt. For a more substantial pairing, it complements a classic margherita pizza, acting as a palate cleanser between bites of savoury cheese and tomato. It also harmonizes with light proteins such as grilled chicken or mild fish dishes like cod.

Distinctive Features

Heineken 0.0 is distinguished by its 'double brewed' process, which uses the same natural ingredients as Heineken Original, including the unique A Yeast developed in 1886. The alcohol is gently removed using vacuum distillation before the brew is blended with natural flavourings to ensure a distinctively balanced profile. This alcohol free option is also a lower calorie choice, containing only 21 calories per 100ml.

Serving Suggestions

For the most refreshing experience, this beer should be chilled in the refrigerator for at least an hour before serving. It is ideally poured into a chilled beer glass or mug at a 45 degree angle to create a proper head of foam. The glass should be slowly straightened as the pour reaches three quarters full to achieve a perfect finish. While it is enjoyable on its own, it can also be garnished with a slice of lime or lemon for a bright citrus twist.

title: Argyle Vintage Brut 2018
bodyHtml: This wine is subtle, spicy and refreshing with its distinctive lime, apple and black pepper aromas. The flavors linger enticingly on the finish with elegance and style.

title: Barbeito Verdelho Reserva 10 Year
bodyHtml:
This fortified wine originates from Portugal, specifically the Madeira region.

Vinhos Barbeito is one of the youngest Madeira houses, founded in 1946 during a challenging period following World War II. The founder, Mario Barbeito, began by acquiring significant stocks of old vintages.

Today, the company is run by his grandson, Ricardo Diogo Freitas, who focuses on a quality-driven, forward-thinking direction. Ricardo’s philosophy includes offering only 100% Canteiro wines and using additional aging periods, while avoiding the addition of caramel or deacidification.

  • Wine Description

    • The Barbeito Verdelho Reserva 10 Year is a medium-dry Madeira made from 100% Verdelho grapes.

    • It presents a bright, light gold colour.

    • The wine offers notes of light polished wood, ripe citrus, floral notes, white sultanas, and honey on the nose. Other notes mentioned include citrus peel, blossom, mushroom, almond, and orange marmalade.

    • On the palate, it has a smooth texture and is described as being soft, persistent, and very well balanced. It has a fresh and energetic acidity with a mineral touch, leading to a lingering finish. The style is medium-dry with high acidity and a high alcohol content of around 19%.

    • The wine is aged in French oak casks for over 10 years using the traditional Canteiro method, a process associated with high-quality wines that involves aging in a warm environment to encourage oxidative development.

    • The wine is bottled ready for drinking and will keep well for several months after opening.

  • Food Pairing

    • Suggested pairings for the Verdelho style of Madeira include dishes that can stand up to its fresh acidity and complex profile.

    • It is an excellent choice as an aperitif.

    • Specific recommendations include consommé, smoked salmon, dried ham, patés, and spaghetti with clams and orange.

    • It also pairs well with liver pâté, and the acidity allows it to complement fatty meats and rich cheeses.

title: Torley Hungaria Grande Cuvee Brut
bodyHtml:
Ripe and honeyed, this is a good value sparkling blend!

This wine is a mix of Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, and Rhine Riesling that has been matured for more than a year to enhance depth. Wild honey, musk melon, stone fruits, and toasted, leesy undertones are all expected. The palate is loaded with stone fruits and orange blossom water, with strong honeyed flavours.  The methode transvasee, which transports the wine from bottle to tank and back, is used instead of the traditional Champagne method. For the price, there is a lot of complexity.

84 Points - Wine Enthusiast     Clean, citric and minerally on the nose, this Hungarian sparkler follows with good, medium-bodied flavors of toast and mineral on the palate. It has a restrained style but the fruit still flirts with the tongue and leaves a finish that is both pert and sweet.

title: Glenfarclas 30 Year Old
bodyHtml: Superb single malt from the Glenfarclas distillery, aged for 30 years. Three decades of maturation have resulted in a fantastically full-bodied, satisfyingly Sherried and all-around awesome flavour profile. Now presented with a box designed as an homage to the unmistakable red door of the Glenfarclas warehouse.

title: Kavalan Solist Oloroso Sherry 54.8% ABV
bodyHtml:
Kavalan Solist Oloroso Sherry Single Cask Strength is a premium single malt whisky from the Yilan County of Taiwan. Established in 2005 by the King Car Group, the Kavalan distillery is renowned for its philosophy of blending traditional Scottish distillation methods with Taiwan's unique subtropical climate to accelerate the maturation process. This rapid aging, often described as 'science meets nature', allows the spirits to achieve a depth and complexity in just a few years that would typically require decades in cooler regions.

Whisky Description

This whisky presents a deep, mouth-watering raisin and dark mahogany colour. The nose is clean and complex, offering intense layers of dried fruit, nuttiness, and spices, with distinct touches of marzipan, vanilla, and dark chocolate. On the palate, it is rich, oily, and full bodied, delivering robust notes of plums, raisins, and tropical mango alongside warm cinnamon and a hint of fine coffee. The finish is exceptionally long and warming, evolving with dark fruit, chocolate, and lingering earthy spices.

Food Pairing

The intense sherry influence and complex spice profile of this whisky pair exceptionally well with robust, savoury dishes such as slow braised oxtail stew or Peking duck. For a dessert match, it beautifully complements a dense chocolate torte or a rich fig cake, which echoes its deep fruit character.

title: Kavalan Solist Ex-Bourbon Cask - Cask Strength
bodyHtml:
Kavalan Distillery is Taiwan's first whisky maker and the nation's only family-owned whisky distillery. It is owned by the large Taiwanese conglomerate, the King Car Group, which was founded in 1956. The distillery, named after the indigenous Kavalan people, was completed in December 2005 and produced its first spirit in March 2006. Kavalan has quickly gained international recognition, winning numerous awards for its single malt whiskies, which are characterized by an exceptional aroma shaped by Taiwan's warm climate and the influence of renowned whisky experts.

Whisky Description

  • Color: Luminous pale amber

  • Aroma: The nose features clean and fresh tropical fruitiness, with pleasant notes of vanilla, coconut, and spices. Other notes can include poached pear, coconut ice, cardamom, and cinnamon.

  • Palate: It is smooth and soft, with a well-balanced natural sweetness, vanilla, and oak spices. Notes of mango, pineapple, a thick layer of caramel, and vanilla pod earthiness are often present. The palate is round, complex, and boasts silky smoothness.

  • Body: Full-flavoured and complex, this cask-strength, non-chill-filtered single malt has a substantial mouth-feel.

  • Finish: The finish is rather long and smooth, marked by vanilla, caramel, light woodiness, and whisky spice, or cinnamon notes.

Food Pairing

Pair with aged, hard cheeses such as Gouda or Manchego, which have caramel-forward notes that mimic the whisky's flavour profile.

title: The Macallan Classic Cut – Limited 2025 Edition
bodyHtml:
The Macallan distillery, founded by Alexander Reid in 1824, was one of the first distillers in Scotland to be legally licensed. Its reputation is built on the 'Six Pillars,' a set of guiding principles, with a key focus on the mastery of wood and spirit. The distillery is renowned for its commitment to using exceptional oak casks, particularly sherry-seasoned oak from Spain, which contributes up to 80% of the whisky's final character and 100% of its natural colour.

Whisky Description

  • Colour: Golden Sunset.

  • Aroma: Orange oil, barley sugar, velvety milk chocolate, caramel wafer, creamy vanilla panna cotta, and freshly baked apple turnover.

  • Palate: Icing sugar sweetness with fresh fruits like grapefruit and mandarin, lemon zested meringue, and caramelized almonds.

  • Body and Stylistic Notes: The Classic Cut series is a limited annual release of a high-strength single malt, bottled at the whisky maker’s preferred strength of 50.6% ABV. Matured in a combination of sherry-seasoned European and American oak, alongside ex-Bourbon casks, this expression delivers a rich, layered, and complex profile.

Food Pairing

The whisky's rich and evolving profile, with its notes of fruit, chocolate, vanilla, and warming oak spice, pairs exceptionally well with rich, nutty, and sweet desserts.

title: Kavalan Solist Oloroso Sherry 57.8% ABV
bodyHtml:
Kavalan, established in 2005, is Taiwan's first whiskymaker and only family-owned whisky distillery. The distillery is backed by the King Car Group, which had a long-term goal of producing a world-class Taiwanese whisky. Kavalan's unique approach involves harnessing Taiwan's subtropical climate to accelerate maturation, a pioneering method developed with the help of whisky expert Dr. Jim Swan.

Whisky Description

  • Colour: Dark and mouth-watering raisin.

  • Aroma: Complex with multi-layers of dried fruit, nuttiness, and spices, alongside notes of marzipan and vanilla. Other notes include black licorice and cocoa powder.

  • Palate: Rich, oily, and full-bodied. It presents pleasant dried fruit and spices, with a rich sherried taste, dark chocolate, cinnamon, clove, black pepper, and sometimes a hint of tobacco. The texture can be thick and creamy.

  • Body: Full. This whisky is complex, even for a sherry cask expression, and possesses a naturally smooth and rich character. It is best served neat.

  • Finish: Long, lingering on the mouth with dried fruit, spices, and a hint of fine coffee.

Food Pairing

The rich, full-bodied character and intense dried fruit notes from the Oloroso sherry cask pair well with complex, rich flavours. Aged Gouda or strong, salty cheeses. The saltiness and sharpness of the cheese offer a wonderful contrast to the whisky's richness and sweetness.

title: Innis & Gunn The Original - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Innis & Gunn The Original is a Scottish golden ale known for its smooth, rich flavor profile from being matured in single malt whisky barrels, bringing notes of vanilla, toffee, and oak, balanced by citrus and orange marmalade, with a creamy, velvety feel and a hint of understated bitterness, making it a unique, mellow, and slightly sweet beer. 

Key Flavor Characteristics:

  • Primary Notes: Vanilla, toffee, biscuity malt, and oak.

  • Balancing Flavors: Orange marmalade, citrus, and sweet fruit.

  • Mouthfeel: Creamy, smooth, rich, and velvety.

  • Finish: Soft, with a gentle, understated bitterness.

title: Giffard Creme de Cacao Brown
bodyHtml: Deep brown colour. Very strong aroma of cocoa, coated with vanilla and chocolate. A strong chocolate palate. Intense and creamy flavor of roasted cocoa beans.

title: Joel Gott Cabernet Sauvignon '815' 2022
bodyHtml:
Joel Gott Cabernet Sauvignon '815' originates from California, United States, specifically through a complex blending process of fruit sourced from Napa, Sonoma, Lake County, Central Coast, Mendocino, and Lodi. Founded in 1996 by fourth-generation vintner Joel Gott, the winery established itself with a philosophy of crafting elegant, food-friendly wines by cultivating long-term relationships with diverse vineyard sites across the state. The '815' designation is a tribute to Joel and Sarah Gott's daughter, Lucy, who was born on August 15.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon typically displays a dark, deep colour with aromas of bright red fruit, black cherry, and blackberry, complemented by notes of clove, vanilla, and brown sugar. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it opens with concentrated dark fruit flavours followed by velvety, well-structured tannins and hints of cedar, mocha, and toasted spice. The finish is long and textured, often revealing lingering notes of vanilla and coffee. The varietal composition is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, aged for approximately 18 months in American oak (with roughly 25% to 30% new oak) to enhance tannin development. It has an ABV of 13.9% to 14.3% and is produced using sustainable winemaking practices, though it is not certified organic.

title: Prima Pave Sparkling Rose Brut (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Prima Pavé Sparkling Rosé Brut is a non alcoholic wine originating from the Tuscany region of Italy. The brand was cofounded by Marco and Dejou Marano, who combined their passion for Italian culture and fine wine to develop a range of alcohol free sparkling wines that maintain the complexity of traditional viticulture.

Wine Description

This non alcoholic rosé presents a delicate pale pink colour with a fine and persistent effervescence. The sensory profile features a bouquet of red currants, wild strawberries, and raspberries, complemented by subtle floral notes of rose petals. On the palate, it is crisp and dry with a lively acidity and a balanced structure that highlights fresh berry flavours and a hint of melon. The body is light and elegant, leading to a clean, refreshing finish with a touch of minerality. It contains 0.0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and red fruit notes of this sparkling wine make it a versatile partner for a variety of Mediterranean and international dishes. It pairs beautifully with light appetizers such as prosciutto with melon, bruschetta, or fresh caprese salad. For a main course, it complements grilled salmon, sushi, and spicy Asian cuisine, where its crispness balances piquant flavours. It also serves as a sophisticated accompaniment to soft cheeses like goat cheese or creamy desserts featuring fresh berries.

Distinctive Features

Prima Pavé Sparkling Rosé Brut is distinguished by its 'terroir first' approach, utilizing a blend of classic Italian grapes including Montepulciano, Pinot Grigio, Sauvignon Blanc, and Gewürztraminer.
