The wine undergoes a proprietary low temperature dealcoholization process in Italy to ensure the preservation of the grapes' natural antioxidants and complex aromatic profile. This wine is a mindful choice for health conscious consumers as it is vegan friendly, gluten free, and contains no added sugar or artificial flavours, with only 24 calories per serving.

Serving Suggestions

To enjoy the delicate floral and berry notes at their best, this wine should be served well chilled at a temperature between 6°C and 8°C. It is ideally presented in a flute or tulip glass to maintain the fine perlage and concentrate the bouquet. While it is an excellent standalone choice for toasts and celebrations, it can also be used as a premium base for non alcoholic cocktails such as a 'Sparkling Rosé Spritz' with a splash of soda and a fresh strawberry garnish.

title: Brandini 'Le Margherite' Arneis Langhe 2025
bodyHtml:
Brandini is a family-run winery located in the heart of the Langhe region, renowned for its dedication to organic farming and sustainable winemaking practices. The estate focuses on crafting wines that reflect the unique terroir and elegance of Piedmont.

  • Tasting Notes: A fresh and elegant wine with a bright aromatic profile of white flowers, citrus, and subtle pear. On the palate, it delivers a crisp and clean experience, featuring balanced acidity and a distinct minerality.

  • Serving Suggestions: Serve chilled at 8-10°C (46-50°F). This wine pairs wonderfully with light seafood dishes, fresh salads, and creamy cheeses.

  • Winemaking: Crafted with care to highlight the natural qualities of the Arneis grape, reflecting the unique terroir of the Langhe region.

title: Gallina de Piel Ikigall 2024
bodyHtml:
This fragrant and highly energetic white wine originates from Spain, within the Penedès Denominación de Origen (D.O.) appellation of Catalonia. Gallina de Piel is an imaginative winemaking project founded by David Seijas, the celebrated former Head Sommelier of the legendary three-Michelin-starred restaurant El Bulli. The estate operates under a philosophy of highlighting Spain's premier gastronomic terroirs by collaborating with local growers and focusing entirely on native varieties. The name "Ikigall" seamlessly combines the Japanese concept of Ikigai (the meaning of life or a reason for being) with the Gall (the iconic rooster native to the Penedès region). The grapes are sourced from Cal Cassanyes, resting at an altitude of 160 metres above sea level on silty loam and sandy soils that impart an ideal natural freshness to the fruit.

Wine Description

The Gallina de Piel Ikigall presents a bright, clean straw-yellow profile in the glass. Its sensory profile is highly aromatic, open, and intensely floral, unfolding a vibrant bouquet driven by white flowers, orange blossom, and vineyard peach from Ordal, layered with citrus sensations of mandarin and fresh fennel accents. On the palate, the wine is fresh, racy, and nicely textured, wrapping completely around the mouth with an energetic core of crisp citrus fruit and stone fruit. It is characterized by an outstanding, mouthwatering acidity and a distinct, saline minerality that drives into a lively, cleansing, and persistent finish.

title: Massican Annia California White 2023
bodyHtml:
Massican is the Napa Valley’s only winery singularly focused on producing white wine. Founder and winemaker Dan Petroski started the brand in 2009 with the goal of creating crisp, refreshing, Mediterranean inspired white wines, drawing inspiration from the Friuli region of northeastern Italy. The name ‘Massican’ itself refers to Mons Massicus, an ancient Italian ridge, honouring the area where Petroski’s great-grandparents were born.

Wine Description

It presents a pale greenish gold colour in the glass. Aromatically, it offers delicate notes of apple and citrus blossoms, honeysuckle, and wet stones, with suggestions of lemon, oyster shell, and saline. On the palate, the wine is sleek and juicy, revealing alluring flavours of lemons, peaches, Meyer lemon, tangerine, and a subtle hint of sea foam.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include light fare such as grilled whitefish, fried calamari, mussels, or other seafood and light pasta dishes.

title: Follin-Arbelet Corton Bressandes Grand Cru 2020
bodyHtml:
This is a Burgundy Côte de Beaune Red wine made from 100% Pinot Noir. The grapes come from vines planted between 1955 and 1960 in the Corton 'Les Bressandes' vineyard, which has an ideal southeast exposure on the Corton hill.

Sensory notes for the wine often include mentions of bright red fruit, such as cherry and raspberry, alongside black fruit notes of blueberry and blackberry. Further complexity comes from 'earthy' notes and forest floor. The palate offers a contrast to some other Corton wines, exhibiting more weight and structure. It is characterized by a firm structure of fine tannins, a refined texture, and a deep core of fruit with succulent acids. The overall style is intense, pure, and deep with stony freshness, framed by a balanced structure. Notes of oak, cedar, and tobacco are also present. The wine is a cellar worthy treasure, offering age worthy complexity and potential to peak in flavor after about a decade. The Domaine practices sustainable farming and the wine is bottled unfined and unfiltered.

Food Pairing

This powerful and concentrated Grand Cru Pinot Noir is an excellent match for red meats and poultry. Suggested pairings include beef, veal, game (such as deer or venison), and general poultry dishes. A classic pairing like roast duck would also be an excellent choice. The structure of the wine, with its firm tannins and depth, stands up well to richly flavoured dishes. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Terralsole Trio 2011
bodyHtml:
This is a full-bodied red blend crafted from Cabernet Franc, Merlot, and Syrah. The wine offers ripe flavours of blackberry, plum, and sweet tobacco. Decanting the wine can reveal hints of leather, cocoa, and herbs, adding layers to the palate. The wine features moderate acidity and velvety tannins with a medium-long, satisfying finish. The 'Trio' is a well-balanced, approachable, and elegant SuperTuscan that is enjoyable now but has a moderate aging potential to develop further over the next 8–10 years. The use of Cabernet Franc instead of the more common Cabernet Sauvignon contributes to the wine's round, elegant, and unique profile.

Food Pairing

The bold flavour profile and structure of the 'Trio' make it an excellent partner for rich dishes. Suggested pairings include grilled meats, pasta with meat sauce, aged cheeses, beef, lamb, veal, poultry, and cured meats. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Ambo Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
This white wine originates in Italy, specifically within the Friuli D.O.C. (Denominazione di Origine Controllata), located in the Friuli-Venezia Giulia region. Ambo Grigio is part of the 'Ambo' line from Alessandro Berselli Vigneti & Vini. It is a single-varietal wine from a region well-known for producing light-bodied, delicate, and crisp Italian white wines. The winemaking is focused on maintaining the wine's freshness and distinct varietal character.

This white wine is crafted from 100% Pinot Grigio grapes. It displays a straw yellow colour with delicate green reflections. The aroma is fruity and elegant, featuring notes of peach and yellow apple, along with a citrusy note and hints of tropical fruit. Critics and users also frequently detect notes of pear, green apple, and citrus. The palate is fruity with a distinguishable note of peach. Its freshness and persistence make it a very pleasant, easy-to-drink wine. It is considered a dry wine with a residual sugar of 4 grams per litre. The alcohol content is 12.5% by vol.

title: Tiberio Trebbiano D'abruzzo 2024
bodyHtml:
Tiberio is a relatively new winery, established by Riccardo Tiberio in 2000 after he discovered an impressive old plot of Trebbiano Abruzzese vines. The estate is now run by his highly competent children, daughter Cristiana and son Antonio. Their winemaking philosophy centres on highlighting the purity and transparency of the variety and the place. They champion true Trebbiano Abruzzese, a noble and rare variety that was often confused with others in the region. The family exclusively uses free run juice for their white wines, believing it conveys the purest expression of the fruit, vintage, and terroir.

Wine Description

On the nose, it elegantly unfolds vibrant aromas of lemon and grapefruit, intertwined with the delicacy of white flowers, such as jasmine, and a gentle herbal touch. Other profiles include musky peach, apricot, crushed rocks, and hints of lemon zest.

On the palate, it is described as refreshing and balanced, with lively acidity enhancing the character of yellow fruit, like peach, and tart orchard fruits. The wine presents a soothingly soft texture, a subtle saline nuance, and a distinctive mineral-driven character.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings should be tailored to the wine's pronounced acidity, citrus, and saline character. It is a delightful match for a Caprese salad, hot house tomatoes, mozzarella di bufala, and basil. Another excellent option is a cheesy pasta, as the wine's acidity will balance the creaminess well.

title: Ambo Nero Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'approachable' red wine originates from Italy, within the expansive Provincia di Pavia I.G.T. appellation in the historic Oltrepò Pavese region of Lombardy, Northern Italy. Produced by Provvinco / Ambo Wines a modern winemaking house dedicated to showcasing regional Italian varietal classics with contemporary purity this bottling highlights Northern Italy's long-standing affinity for high-altitude Pinot Nero (Pinot Noir). Sourced from choice vineyard parcels planted along rolling foothill slopes at the base of the Apennines, the vines thrive in well-draining soils composed of clay, limestone, and gravelly marl. Northern Italy’s sub-alpine microclimate brings warm, sunny days tempered by cool mountain breezes descending from the Alps and Apennines, enabling Pinot Nero grapes to achieve optimal phenolic ripeness while retaining a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Ambo Nero Pinot Noir presents a brilliant, translucent ruby color in the glass with bright garnet and violet reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and fruit-forward, delivering an energetic, juicy, and elegant portrait of Northern Italian Pinot Nero. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe red cherries, wild raspberries, and crushed red plums, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of fresh violets, dried rose petals, subtle forest floor (sous-bois), and a clean line of soft stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and supple, showcasing a succulent core of tart red berries, cranberry, and blood orange zest. It is characterized by its balanced energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that maintains effortless drinkability across the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is weightless, silky, and smooth, framed by delicate, soft-grained tannins that glide into a crisp, dry finish accented by lingering notes of cherry skin, red currant, and mild herbal spice.

title: Bottega Gold Brut
bodyHtml:
Bottega Gold Brut originates from Italy, within the northeastern Veneto region and the Prosecco DOC. The winery, widely recognized for its iconic and eye-catching mirrored gold-plated bottle, has built a global reputation for blending Italian style with high-quality viticulture. The brand's philosophy focuses on capturing the true aromatic potential of the region's terroirs, selecting grapes from hillside vineyards in the province of Treviso where mild climates and significant day-to-night temperature shifts enhance the aromatic complexity of the fruit.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine presents a bright, straw yellow colour in the glass, enlivened by a fine and persistent perlage. The sensory profile is refined and expressive, featuring an aromatic nose of green apples, pears, and citrus fruits, layered with delicate floral notes of white flowers, acacia, wisteria, and lily of the valley, finishing with hints of sage and soft spices. On the palate, it is soft, harmonious, and elegant, delivering a slim body with a lively yet balanced acidity that complements its clean fruit character. The finish is crisp and persistent, leaving a refreshing, dry impression.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Glera.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is crafted using the Charmat (tank) method, where fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks to safeguard the natural freshness and vibrant, fruity brightness of the grape variety.

  • ABV: 11%.

  • Organic Status: While Bottega emphasizes environmental sustainability across its operations, this specific commercial bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The versatility, crisp acidity, and fine, silky mouthfeel of Bottega Gold Brut make it a brilliant match for light first courses and fresh seafood.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with raw oysters, seafood crudités, steamed lobster with lemon garlic sauce, and salt-baked sea bass.

  • Light Fare: An exceptional choice for a welcoming aperitif, it complements a full sushi and maki platter, fresh garden salads, and lightly spiced curry dishes.

  • Savoury: Suggested pairings include a traditional Prosecco risotto, creamed codfish, or simple starters featuring fresh or stewed vegetables.

  • Cheese: Matches gracefully with fresh, mild options such as soft goat cheese.

title: Medici Concerto Lambrusco 2025
bodyHtml:
The wine is crafted by Medici Ermete, a winery with a rich history in Lambrusco production that dates back to 1890. A fifth-generation family winery, Medici Ermete is a pioneer of high-quality Lambrusco, creating the first single vineyard, single vintage Lambrusco, called 'Concerto', in 1994.

Wine Description

Displays intense ruby red colour with please and persistent fruity aromas. On the palate the wine is dry, yet fruity at the same time. Soft, fresh and lively this sparkling red is balanced and pleasantly harmonious.

title: Empress 1908 Premium Gin Collection - 3 x 375ml Bottles
bodyHtml:
The Empress 1908 gin collection originates in Canada, specifically from Victoria, British Columbia. This handcrafted gin is a collaboration between Victoria Distillers and the legendary Fairmont Empress Hotel in Victoria. The gin is named for and inspired by the hotel's long history, with '1908' acknowledging the year the Empress Hotel first opened its doors. This spirit embodies a fusion of traditional elegance and modern sophistication.

Gin Description

The core of the collection is the Empress 1908 Indigo Gin, handcrafted in small batch copper-pot stills. The Indigo Gin's varietal composition includes eight signature botanicals, notably juniper, grapefruit peel, ginger root, rose petal, cinnamon bark, coriander seed, and a signature blend of black tea served at the Fairmont Empress Hotel. The most visually distinctive botanical is the butterfly pea blossom, which imparts a deep, vivid indigo colour.

title: Murviedro Sericis Cepas Viejas Monastrell 2019
bodyHtml:
This single-varietal red wine hails from Spain, specifically the eastern coast's Denominación de Origen Protegida (DOP Alicante). Bodegas Murviedro was founded by the Schenk family in 1927. Their winemaking philosophy is rooted in a belief and deep respect for their local terroirs, combining innovative techniques with grapes from traditional vineyards. The 'Sericis' line is named for the Latin word for 'silky,' paying homage to the region's silk heritage and the wine's gentle character.

Wine Description

The wine displays an intense red colour with purple tones. It is crafted entirely from 100% Monastrell (Mourvèdre) grapes sourced from 'old vines' (Cepas Viejas). The nose is highly aromatic, presenting powerful aromas of ripe fruit—such as blackberry and plum—layered with toasted oak and hints of spice. On the palate, this is a full bodied, fleshy, and complex wine, with a silky texture and a fruit-driven core. Flavours often include blackcurrant, dried earth, clove, and black pepper, supported by ripe, balanced tannins. It is aged for a minimum of 14 months in French oak barrels. The Sericis is a silky red wine with a very long, pleasant finish that often recalls toasted notes. The wine is suitable for vegetarians and vegans.

Accolades

  • 'Wine Enthusiast - 92 points'

Food Pairing

The rich and intense profile of the Monastrell makes it an ideal wine to accompany red meats, grilled white fish, and game dishes. Its bold structure and ripe tannins pair perfectly with hearty stews, roasted foods, and strong, cured cheeses. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Caviar Bleu Gin
bodyHtml:
Caviar Bleu Gin is a 'Grand Cru' expression distilled in France. Its precise distillation is expertly handled by a former Cellar Master from a renowned Cognac house, Jean Marie Bernard, lending an unparalleled level of artisanal skill to the production.

Gin Description

Caviar Bleu presents with a refined elegance. Its delicate, complex, and harmonious aromatic profile is built on a precise distillation process. The core botanical is a wild juniper from Manosque, Provence, which contains a concentration of aromatic compounds four to ten times higher than commonly cultivated varieties.

For a refreshing highball, pair with a premium neutral tonic water, garnished with a slice of finger lime or a sprig of fresh rosemary to highlight the herbaceous and citrus notes.

title: Tocornal Sauvignon Blanc 2025 1.5 Litre - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Tocornal Sauvignon Blanc originates from the Central Valley of Chile. Cono Sur Vineyards and Winery was founded in 1993 with a vision to produce expressive and innovative wines that convey the spirit of the 'new world'. The winery emphasizes a philosophy of quality and environmental respect, avoiding 'dusty bottles and genealogy' in favour of creativity and high quality.

Wine Description

This wine displays a medium straw colour and presents a sensory profile featuring floral aromas with notes of pear, herbs, and citrus. The palate is crisp and light bodied, delivering flavours of pink grapefruit, green apple, and subtle spicy or oaky undertones. It concludes with a refreshing finish that ranges from extra dry to slightly off dry. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc typically has an ABV of 12% to 13%.

title: Undone No. 7 'This is Not Orange Bitter'
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Undone No. 7 'This is Not Orange Bitter' is a non alcoholic spirit alternative produced in Hamburg, Germany. The brand was founded in 2019 by André and Mehmet with the goal of providing high quality alternatives for the global bar community. The company utilizes a patented dealcoholization process that starts with real fermented spirits and wines to maintain an authentic flavour profile.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic bitter presents a vibrant ruby red or deep orange appearance. The nose offers earthy notes combined with the typical sweetish bitterness of Italian Amaros and warm orange scents. On the palate, it delivers a complex, bittersweet profile of blood orange, grapefruit, and gentian, balanced by spicy herbal notes of thyme and clove. The body is medium with a classic bitter structure and botanical sophistication. It leads to a clean finish where a spicy bitter herb note dominates the lingering aftertaste. This product contains less than 0.3% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The bold bitterness and citrus brightness of this spirit make it an ideal companion for salty and savoury Italian appetizers. It pairs exceptionally well with charcuterie boards, green olives, and salted nuts, which help to balance the bitter herbs. For a more substantial pairing, it complements dishes with bitter greens like radicchio or arugula and rich, cheesy pasta where the acidity can cut through the fat. It is also a refined choice to serve alongside Mediterranean seafood or fritto misto during elegant aperitif moments.

Distinctive Features

Undone No. 7 is distinguished by its 'terroir driven' production method, using real orange bitter spirits as a base rather than simple botanical blends. It is a health conscious alternative, containing approximately 12 to 18 calories per 30 ml serving. The product is certified vegan and gluten free, and it uses natural ingredients like sweet potato and carrot concentrates for its colour instead of synthetic dyes. To ensure traditional bitter complexity, the recipe includes bitter herb essence and flavouring quinine.

Serving Suggestions

While it can be enjoyed neat or over ice with an orange twist, this spirit is primarily designed as a core component for alcohol free versions of classic cocktails. For a signature 'Negroni UNDONE', combine equal parts of Undone No. 7 with Undone No. 2 Not Gin and Undone No. 9 Not Red Vermouth. It also works excellently as a long drink when mixed with soda water, tonic, or fresh orange juice. For a lighter option, a 'Bitter Orange Spritz' can be made by mixing one part of this bitter with two parts non alcoholic sparkling wine and a splash of soda.

title: Undone No. 9 'This is Not Red Vermouth' Red Torino Aperitif (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Undone No. 9 'This is Not Red Vermouth' Red Torino Aperitif is a non alcoholic spirit alternative originating from Hamburg, Germany. The brand was founded in 2019 by André, Mehmet, and Felix, a team of professional bar and music enthusiasts who sought to create high quality alcohol free options for the global bar community. The company utilizes a patented dealcoholization process that begins with real fermented spirits and wines, removing the alcohol while preserving the complex flavour compounds and aging notes.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic aperitif presents a rich red or dark mahogany appearance. The nose is warm and spicy, featuring the typical aromatic scents of wormwood herb, cinnamon, and sweet orange. On the palate, it delivers a complex bittersweet profile with notes of deep grape sweetness, dark berries, and burnt caramel. The body is medium with a classic vermouth structure and herbal sophistication, leading to a smooth finish characterized by lingering spices and traditional elegance. This product contains less than 0.3% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The bold, spiced, and rich structure of this red vermouth alternative makes it a versatile partner for hearty and savoury dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with robust flavours such as cured meats, salami, and aged hard cheeses like cheddar or blue cheese. For a more substantial pairing, it complements braised beef short ribs, lamb shanks, and savoury Italian pasta dishes. It also serves as a sophisticated accompaniment to fruit based desserts, particularly roasted pears with a vanilla reduction.

Distinctive Features

Undone No. 9 is distinguished by its 'terroir first' approach, using real Italian red vermouth as a base before gently extracting the alcohol molecules. It is a health conscious choice, being vegan, gluten free, and low in calories, with approximately 15 to 18 calories per 30 ml serving. The product is crafted with natural ingredients including grape juice concentrate, cinnamon essence, and botanical extracts. Unlike many competitors that use simple botanical blends, Undone maintains the authentic tannins and acidity of a fermented wine through its unique extraction technology.

Serving Suggestions

To best enjoy its complex sweetness and herbal depth, this spirit should be served slightly warmer than white vermouth, ideally between 12°C and 14°C. It is a key ingredient for classic cocktails such as a 'Negroni UNDONE' or a 'Manhattan', where it can be combined with Undone No. 2 Not Gin or Undone No. 3 Not Whiskey. For a simpler 'V&T UNDONE' serve, mix 1.5 oz of the aperitif with dry tonic water over ice and garnish with an orange twist. It is recommended to consume the product within eight weeks of opening and to store it in a cool place protected from sunlight.

title: Benjamin Bridge Pink Piquette Zero (Non Alcoholic) 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Benjamin Bridge Pink Piquette Zero is a non-alcoholic wine-style beverage from Canada, specifically originating from the Gaspereau Valley in Nova Scotia. Founded in 1999, Benjamin Bridge has established itself as a premier Canadian sparkling wine house, and it is a certified B Corp known for its commitment to capturing the 'tidal ecosystem' of its maritime terroir. The Piquette Zero line was launched in 2021 as a craft alternative to industrially dealcoholized wines, utilizing a proprietary process that captures the essence of traditional wine from grape skins, botanicals, and hand-harvested sea salt rather than stripping alcohol post-fermentation.

Wine Description

This lively non-alcoholic beverage presents a light and elegant wild rose petal hue in the glass. The aroma is a meadow-like medley of floral and botanical notes complemented by tropical fruit and zesty citrus. On the palate, it is medium-weight and caressing, delivering an exhilarating freshness with uplifting flavours of passionfruit, sweet grapefruit, and key lime. The finish is clean and invigorating, marked by a delicate saline breeze from a pinch of Bay of Fundy sea salt added to complement its maritime roots. It is crafted using a unique blend of grape skins, mineral water, and botanicals such as organic rosehip and elderflower. This beverage contains 0% ABV and is both vegan-friendly and gluten-free. It contains 0 g of sugar and only 50 calories per 250 ml can. While it incorporates some organic botanicals, it is not a certified organic product. The optimal drinking window is over the next 1 to 2 years, and it is best served well-chilled.

title: Caprili Rosso di Montalcino 2022
bodyHtml:
Vibrant ruby red color. Intense and fruit-rich on the nose. It has a dry, warm and slightly tannic palate with a marked bitterish note in the finish.

91 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Ripe and rich with pure black cherry, the 2021 Rosso Di Montalcino is compact in its aromatics of black licorice and menthol. Generous and dark on the palate as well, it offers notes of wet stone, blackberry, and fresh black cherry. It is firm in its structure at this stage, although it is certainly a solid Rosso that offers a lot of depth.

title: Domaine Gerard Neumeyer's 'La Tulipe' Pinot Blanc 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from France, produced in the northern part of the Alsace region near the village of Molsheim. Domaine Neumeyer, formerly known as Domaine Gérard Neumeyer, is a family-owned estate founded in 1925 that is currently managed by Jérôme Neumeyer following the passing of his father, Gérard, in 2019. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a pursuit of precision and finesse, favouring a dry style that balances focused acidity with mineral tension, reflective of the cool-climate geography of the Bas Rhin.

Wine Description

The 'La Tulipe' Pinot Blanc presents a clear, fresh appearance often described as medium straw in colour. The nose is aromatic and delicate, featuring scents of white flowers, fresh orchard fruits like baked apple and sweet pear, and a distinct earthy undertone. On the palate, the wine is typically dry to off-dry with a creamy, medium-bodied texture and flavours of lemon curd, apricot, and a hint of smoke or spice. It is characterized by its harmonious balance of ripe fruit generosity and a briny mineral note that lingers on a fresh finish. This wine is 100% Pinot Blanc and generally has an ABV of 13.5% to 14%. The estate has been organically farmed since 2010 and is certified organic, with current winemaking also adopting biodynamic principles. The wine is ready to drink upon release and typically maintains its freshness for several years.

Food Pairing

The versatile profile and balanced acidity of this Pinot Blanc make it an ideal companion for a wide range of light and savoury dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with meaty fish such as salmon, mackerel, and tuna, as well as seafood delicacies like oysters and mussels. It is a traditional match for Alsatian cuisine, including quiche lorraine, onion tarts, and tarte flambée. Additionally, it complements white meats such as veal in cream sauce, roast chicken, and mild soft cheeses like sheep cheese.

title: Preda del Falco Montefalco Sagrantino 2019
bodyHtml:
Preda del Falco is a distinguished winery nestled in the historic hills of Montefalco, within the Umbria region of central Italy. Dedicated to the preservation of traditional winemaking, the estate is recognized for crafting powerful expressions of indigenous varietals, particularly the robust Sagrantino grape. Its name, translating to ‘Falcon’s Prey’, honours the natural heritage and commanding presence of the landscape.

This 2019 Montefalco Sagrantino opens with a deep garnet hue and an aromatic intensity that weaves together ripe blackberry, dried plum, anise, and leather. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied structure marked by firm, gripping tannins and vibrant acidity, supported by dark fruit, tobacco, and a hint of dark chocolate. Aged to integrate complexity and depth, the wine finishes with enduring length and spice. 

Food Pairing

Ideal alongside slow-cooked meats such as osso buco, grilled lamb chops, or aged pecorino. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Cipriani Virgin Bellini (Non Alcoholic) 180 ml - 4 Bottles
bodyHtml:
The Cipriani Virgin Bellini presents a reimagined rendition of the famed cocktail, now offered in a non-alcoholic version of refined elegance.

Available in convenient 180ml bottles, packaged in sets of 4, this delightful beverage is perfect for enjoying on its own or as an essential element in creative mixology.

title: Falkenstein Riesling Alto Adige Valle Venosta 2024
bodyHtml:
The Riesling is one of the most characteristic vineyard in the area of Saturno, in Valle Venosta, where the Falkenstein winery, one time devoted to fruits’ cultivation, produces its personal version of Riesling obtaining an elegant wine.

Its Southern position and the soil rich of minerals create a complex wine with a brilliant straw colour, with a rich bouquet with floral tastes of citrus fruits and honey. The mineral taste is balanced, with a good structure. 

This type of wine is perfect if served in combination with fish dinners, sea food, and also smoked fish.

title: Floresta Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Floresta Cabernet Sauvignon originates from Chile, specifically from the Maipo Valley region and the Alto Jahuel subregion. Founded in 1880 by Don Domingo Fernández Concha, Viña Santa Rita is one of Chile's most historic and pioneering wineries. The winemaking philosophy for the Floresta line, led by winemaker Sebastián Labbé, emphasizes a modern, high altitude expression of terroir that focuses on elegance and structural precision. The grapes are sourced from the Los Ratones mountain range at an altitude of 637 metres, where rocky, colluvial soils with low clay content mimic the ideal conditions of the Médoc.

Wine Description

This red wine displays an intense and deep ruby red colour with dark reflections. The sensory profile is complex and layered, featuring an aromatic nose of ripe raspberry, cherry, and blackberry, interwoven with savoury notes of cedar, tobacco, graphite, and herbal hints of thyme or oregano. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied and well balanced, delivering a fresh and juicy texture with firm, grippy tannins and refreshing acidity. The finish is long, persistent, and concentrated, often showing mineral nuances of gravel and tar.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its restrained and elegant style, achieved through spontaneous fermentation and ageing in used French oak barriques to ensure the wood is well integrated and does not overwhelm the fruit.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 13.5% and 14%.

  • Organic Status: Not specified as organic.

Food Pairing

The firm structure and vibrant acidity of Floresta Cabernet Sauvignon make it an ideal partner for savoury and protein rich dishes.

  • Meats: It pairs perfectly with grilled red meats, fine steaks, and traditional Chilean dishes like chili con carne.

  • Savoury Fare: Suggested pairings include beef tacos or gourmet burgers topped with aromatic cheeses.

  • Vegetarian: Complements meaty Portobello mushrooms, fire roasted vegetables, or a rich wild mushroom risotto.

title: Olympic Brewery Fix Hellas Lager Beer 330 ml - 20 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Greece’s Olympic Brewery, located in Thessaloniki, is a proud union between Fix Brewery—the first major Greek brewery established in 1864—and the Carlsberg Group. The legacy of Fix as a household name in Greece carries forward through its emblematic Hellas Lager, reflecting a commitment to traditional values and modern brewing excellence.

Fix Hellas Lager pours a clear, golden yellow with a moderate white head and fine carbonation. On the nose, it delivers subtle malt aromas accompanied by faint grassy and floral notes. The palate is clean and crisp with a light to medium body, showcasing flavours of bread crust, soft hops, and a touch of sweetness balanced by mild bitterness. The finish is smooth and refreshing, with a delicate dry edge that enhances its drinkability. This lager is crafted from a blend of carefully selected Greek barley and hops, fermented under strict temperature control to ensure freshness and consistency. Best enjoyed young, within one year of production, to fully appreciate its vibrant profile.

title: Hiedler Riesling Langenlois
bodyHtml:
Weingut Hiedler, established in 1856, is a family-operated winery located in Langenlois, within Austria's renowned Kamptal wine region. Now under the stewardship of Ludwig Hiedler's sons, Ludwig Jr. and Dietmar, the estate continues its legacy of producing distinctive wines that reflect the unique terroir of their vineyards.

Wine Description

The Hiedler Langenlois Riesling presents a light yellow-green hue with silver reflections. On the nose, it offers delicate aromas of peach and blossom honey, complemented by subtle hints of mango and citrus.

title: Checkmate Chardonnay 'Queen Taken' 2021
bodyHtml:
This wine is 100% Chardonnay. The varietal composition in 2021 was a mix of the original Dekleva clone and recently planted old Wente clones, with the latter adding minerality and complexity. It remains consistent in offering aromas and flavours of pear, subtle ginger, and wet stones. The palate has a creamy texture on the mid-palate, wet stone minerality, and a savoury, vibrant undercurrent, suggesting a textural firmness and exceptional ageability. The winemaker's restoration of the vineyard has resulted in a leaner, fresher wine with lower alcohol, intended to be tighter and more Burgundian in style. Fifty percent of the wine was wild fermented, and all of it was barrel-aged in 58% new French oak for 16 months. 

Accolades

  • John Schreiner - 98 points

  • Anthony Gismondi - 96 points

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points

  • Wine Enthusiast - 92 points

Food Pairing 

Suggested pairings include rich fish like halibut, poultry such as chicken and turkey, and creamy pasta dishes. The wine's richness, acidity, and minerality make it a beautiful match for soft, creamy cheeses like Brie and triple-cream. You could also consider pan-seared scallops or herb-crusted halibut.

This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Redbreast Tawny Port Edition
bodyHtml:
• Aroma: Sweet and warming confectionery notes of buttered pastry are present, accompanied by aromas of caramelized almonds and subtle undertones of praline and dried cherry. Scents of floral honey with delicate herbal character also linger, with seasoned oak and pot still spices enhancing the spirit's sweet and full-bodied nature.

  • Palate: It is rich and nutty at first, with notes of chocolate-coated hazelnut and salted caramel, followed by fresh plums and dried fig. The flavour profile includes an initial burst of sweetness from the port casks balanced by pot still spices. The texture is luscious and creamy, and the tannins' soft presence works in harmony with this, evoking notes of orange marmalade with delicate hints of toasted oak.

  • Body and Finish: The whiskey is full-bodied and complex. The finish is long and satisfying, with lingering pot still spices and fruit notes gradually fading, allowing the tawny seasoned oak to impart a lasting impression.

  • Varietal Composition: This is a single pot still Irish whiskey. It was initially matured in a combination of bourbon and Oloroso sherry casks. To complete its maturation, all of the whiskeys were blended and married in freshly seasoned tawny port hogsheads for a final maturation period of 14–25 months.

  • Stylistic Notes: The spirit is rich, layered, and wonderfully balanced. The soft tannin presence adds complexity and balances the sweetness.

     

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for this whiskey's layered complexity and rich flavour profile include aged cheeses to accentuate its nutty and fruity nuances, or dark chocolate desserts for a rich contrast.
Its rich character also complements the savoury depth of smoked meats. A perfect match to enhance the spirit's complexity.

title: Pecchenino Barolo Bussia - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The wine has an intense garnet red colour. The nose is initially austere, then evolves to recall complex floral notes like dried rose petals and red fruit notes such as red cherries and raspberry. Secondary aromas include liquorice, spice, tobacco, tar, blood orange, and hints of cinnamon and clove. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rich, and powerful with fine sensations of ripe red fruits. It displays a wonderfully silky texture, taut and compact tannins, vibrant and vertical acidity, and a long, lingering finish. This classic Barolo is extremely elegant and refined, possessing the muscularity and structure for aging. The varietal composition is 100% Nebbiolo. Optimal cellaring can extend beyond 25 years, with some vintages suggesting a potential until 2042 or longer.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with a range of rich and flavourful dishes. Suggested pairings include fresh pasta with meat sauce or truffle, roasted or braised red meats, game, and long-aged cheeses. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Piccini Brunello di Montalcino 2019
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

  • This wine has a complex red colour that tends towards garnet.

  • The bouquet is punctuated by notes of licorice, cherry, and spice. Other aromas can include oak, vanilla, leather, smoke, and mushroom.

  • It is a full-bodied, structured wine.

  • The palate is full, spicy, and elegant, offering flavours such as cherry, raspberry, licorice, and coffee.

  • It has soft, fine-grained tannins and lively acidity.

  • The finish is persistent and long.

  • The varietal composition is 100% Sangiovese Grosso.

  • Piccini's estate properties, which include their Montalcino estate, have been converted to organic farming.

  • The wine is aged for a minimum of five years before release, including at least two years in oak. Optimal drinking can be after 2023 or 2024, depending on the vintage.

Accolades

  • 'International Wine & Spirit Competition - Gold, Trophy (2011 Vintage)'

  • 'International Wine Challenge - Gold (2011 Vintage)'

  • 'International Wine Challenge - Gold (2018 Vintage)'

  • 'Wine Enthusiast - 94 points (2018 Vintage)'

  • 'James Suckling - 91 points (2018 Vintage)'

Food Pairing

  • Suggested pairings include game, red meat, and mature cheeses.

  • Traditional Tuscan pairings are classic, such as pappardelle with game ragu (sauce), beef stews, or roast lamb.

  • It pairs well with hearty dishes like bistecca alla Fiorentina (Florentine T-bone steak).

  • Specific cheeses include Pecorino Toscano, Parmigiano-Reggiano, or Gorgonzola. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Pascal Chatonnet Lalande de Pomerol Esprit Lalande 2019
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

Lalande-de-Pomerol wines are characterized by a deep red colour and display notes of red fruit, with barrel aging often developing notes of plum, leather, and coconut. They are typically full-bodied, powerful, well-structured, and smooth. Common varietal blends in the appellation are dominated by Merlot, often around 80%, with Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Malbec also authorized.

Wines from the 2019 vintage in the appellation are described as soft, silky, and polished, with notes of sweet red fruits and cocoa, showing freshness and an approachable character. The typical Lalande-de-Pomerol wine has a good ageing potential of five to ten years, and many 2019s are ready to drink now or can be cellared for up to 2030-2032.

Food Pairing

  • Lalande-de-Pomerol wines are Merlot-dominant, well-structured reds that pair well with hearty, rich dishes.

  • Suggested pairings include roast saddle of lamb, duck with foie gras, tournedos, duck breast, or game-based dishes such as venison stew and roast wild boar. They are also excellent with regional specialities and robust red meats, such as grilled rib steak or oven cooked lamb saddle.

  • This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Contra Soarda Breganze Vespaiolo 2024
bodyHtml:
Contrà Soarda, which translates to 'hamlet on the slope', was established by Mirco and Gloria Gottardi in 1999, fulfilling a dream built on their family's century-long connection to the land through their restaurant business. Located on the mineral-rich volcanic hillsides at the foot of the Asiago plateau, the estate is committed to organic viticulture and enhancing their unique terroir by cultivating indigenous varieties like Vespaiolo.

Wine Description

The wine is a varietal expression of 100% Vespaiolo. It is fermented cool and slow in stainless steel to preserve its fresh character. The sensory profile offers vibrant and fresh aromas of Meyer lemon, tangelo, pineapple, and honeysuckle, with subtle hints of lime leaf. On the palate, the wine is bright and full-bodied, with a texture of mixed citrus oils leading to flavours of lemon, pear, and tart apricot.

Accolades

  • 'Wine Enthusiast' – 91 points

Food Pairing

Its pronounced acidity makes it a natural partner  for a platter of smoked meats and cheeses or cacio e pepe pasta.

title: Bardos Romantica Crianza 2022
bodyHtml:
Bodegas Bardos (Fuentemolinos, Burgos) is the Vintae Wine Company project in the Ribera del Duero. To settle in the denomination, Vintae sought out the area with the highest altitude, Páramo de Corcos, 10,000 hectares that live all year round under extreme temperatures and in which the highest quality DO grapes are obtained. 

Deep cherry red color with a dark violet edge. Intense and complex aromas of ripe fruits, dark fruits, jam, tobacco and leather. Full bodied wine with strong structure and noticeable freshness. Smooth and elegant, complemented with gentle tannins and a pleasant finish.

title: Culmina Decora Riesling
bodyHtml:
Decora is an intensely aromatic Riesling that whets the palate with mouth-watering acidity. Showing delicate spice, floral, and stone fruit aromas, Decora displays pronounced flavours of citrus, mineral, and stone fruit, creating a wine of outstanding vivacity, delicacy, elegance, and style. 

Pair with oysters on the half shell with kefir lime and lemongrass mignonette.

title: Fuentenarro 4 Meses En Barrica 2023
bodyHtml:
From Spain’s Ribera del Duero region, Viña Fuentenarro is crafted by a family-owned winery in La Horra, Burgos. The García family has managed the estate for generations, cultivating Tempranillo vines with a commitment to natural methods, avoiding chemical fertilisers and herbicides. Their philosophy centres on expressing the character of the land and the purity of the varietal through careful, minimal intervention winemaking.

Wine Description

It shows a deep cherry red colour with violet hues, brilliant and lively in the glass. On the nose, it offers intense aromas of red and black fruits such as blueberry, plum, and redcurrant, layered with notes of vanilla, roasted coffee, and subtle truffle. The palate is generous and enveloping, with ripe fruit flavours, smooth integrated tannins, and balanced acidity. Its body is medium, with a long, persistent finish marked by freshness and elegance.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with grilled red meats, roasted lamb, hearty stews, and semi-cured cheeses. The fruit-driven profile and gentle oak influence make it versatile at the table.

title: Antigal Uno Malbec Platinum 2020
bodyHtml:
This powerful red wine is produced in Argentina, specifically in the Mendoza region, with grapes sourced from the high-altitude Uco Valley. The wine is a limited-edition offering from Antigal Winery & Estates, whose history in Russell, Maipú, Mendoza, dates back to a historic winery established in 1897. The winery's philosophy emphasizes nature-friendly winemaking, utilizing gravity-fed technology for a gentle process to preserve the fruit's essence and the soil's character, promoting a harmonious interaction between soil, climate, and plants. The vineyards are located at the foot of the Andes mountain range.

Wine Description

The Antigal Uno Malbec Platinum is a rich, intense red wine made predominantly from the Malbec grape. It is often described as having a violet-red or dark ruby colour. The aromatic profile is dense and complex, with notes of vanilla, blueberry, plum, strawberry, and blackberry, complemented by enticing hints of violets and milk chocolate. Further notes can include black tea, sassafras, and white-peppered oak. The palate is full-bodied, luscious, and deep. It offers rich, dark fruit flavours like black cherry and baked blueberries, supported by hints of baking spices and cocoa.

title: Albert Bichot Coteaux Bourguignons
bodyHtml:
This red wine often presents a ruby red colour, sometimes with garnet highlights.

It is a blend of Burgundy's red varietals, Pinot Noir and Gamay.

The aroma is fruity and spicy, with prominent notes of cherry, redcurrant, and liquorice, sometimes accompanied by a touch of rose petal.

The palate is full bodied and delectable, showcasing red and black fruits, and supported by pleasing or fine tannins, often with a hint of toast.

It is smooth and well balanced on the palate, with a fresh and fruity finish, possessing a medium body and a silky texture.
The appellation allows Pinot Noir and Gamay to express their inherent freshness.

The diversity of the region's terroirs, which range from calcareous clay to granitic soil, gives this wine a lovely, complex aromatic profile.

It is typically recommended to be enjoyed immediately to appreciate all of its fruitiness, as it is not intended for long-term cellaring, but some vintages may be cellarable for a few years.

title: Laurent Saillard White
bodyHtml:
This white wine is intensely aromatic. The blend is made from a majority of Sauvignon Blanc, complemented by a percentage of Ugni Blanc. The wine displays notes of citrus, fresh cut grass, and crunchy green bell pepper. 
It is described as 'Intense & Structured', and is a natural wine. 
For a different white wine from Saillard, the 'Lucky You' cuvée is typically an uncommon blend of about 80% Sauvignon Blanc and 20% Chardonnay. 
The 'Lucky You' cuvée also sees an élevage (maturation) of about six to eight months in neutral vats before being bottled without filtration.

Food Pairing

  • This intensely flavoured, natural white wine pairs well with lighter-intensity meats such as fish or chicken.

  • Dishes with bright, zesty flavours or light seafood are often recommended for light, crisp white wines like those with Sauvignon Blanc.

  • Considering the wine's intensity and structure, a pairing with grilled fish or poultry would be suitable. 
    Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Dom Perignon P2 2000
bodyHtml:
The Dom Pérignon P2 2000 reveals a seductive bouquet marked by incredibly generous energy and profound complexity.

  • Colour, Aroma, Palate: The bouquet is ripe and lively, offering notes of stone fruit, tangy touches of bergamot, and warm scents of summer harvest and brioche. Smokier, more mineral accents, and tertiary nuances like iodine, lemon oil, tangerine, and oyster shell also complete the aromatic profile. The palate has a vibrant opening, showcasing richness, complexity, and a refined structure. Flavours of baked peach, lime blossom, brioche, salted almond, and spun honey are wrapped around sleek, mouth-watering acidity.

  • Body and Finish: It is medium to full-bodied, satiny, and textural, with a fine, youthfully boisterous mousse. The length is long, precise, and mouthwateringly saline, featuring touches of bitterness, liquorice notes, and toasted malt.

  • Varietal Composition and Optimal Drinking Window: The varietal composition is a blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, with the P2 2000 being approximately 52% Chardonnay and 48% Pinot Noir. The Champagne was aged for about 16 years on the lees before disgorgement in 2017. While drinking beautifully now, with notable complexity, the optimal drinking window is generally considered to be now through 2030.

  • Stylistic Notes: This vintage is elegant, intense, and harmonious. It is wonderfully alluring, presenting a striking interplay of the maturity that develops over extended time on lees and the retained freshness.

Accolades

The Dom Pérignon P2 2000 has received significant critical acclaim, showcasing its exceptional quality.

  • "Wine Spectator - 97 points."

  • "James Suckling - 97 points."

  • "Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 94 points."

title: Scarpa 'Briccomora' Barbera d'Asti 2023
bodyHtml:
Antica Casa Vinicola Scarpa, founded in 1854, is a historic winery in Nizza Monferrato with a long-standing reputation for producing elegant and age-worthy red wines. The winery’s modern identity and focus on quality over quantity were largely shaped by Mario Pesce, who was among the first producers to champion Barbera as a serious, complex wine starting in the 1960s.

Wine Description

The aroma is intense and complex, showcasing a bouquet of bright red and dark fruits such as cherry, black cherry, raspberry, and plum, with delicate floral hints of violets and subtle spicy or savoury undertones. On the palate, the wine is dry, energetic, and fruit-forward, featuring flavours of ripe red and black fruits. A signature high acidity—often described as crisp or clean—provides excellent structure and liveliness, creating a refreshingly pure and balanced style. It has a medium body, soft or moderate tannins, and finishes clean, persistent, and powerful.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include pasta with rich tomato-based sauces, fresh egg pasta dishes, grilled meats, roasted vegetables, and aged cheeses.

title: Gatinois Tradition Brut Grand Cru de Ay Champagne
bodyHtml:
Produced in France, this Champagne hails from the prestigious Aÿ Grand Cru, a historic village in the Vallée de la Marne. The Gatinois family has a winemaking heritage spanning over 12 generations, focusing on expressing the 'heart and soul' of their exceptional terroir through traditional methods. As a revered grower-producer, the estate utilizes its own fruit to craft wines that emphasize the power and elegance characteristic of Aÿ’s Pinot Noir.

Wine Description

This Champagne displays a deep golden hue accented by subtle coppery reflections. The nose is delicate, featuring aromas of fresh pear and lime blossom that evolve into complex layers of ripe orchard fruit and toasted brioche. On the palate, a vibrant and fresh attack leads to a rich, round body with a harmonious balance of fruit and finesse. Notes of apple, ginger, and roasted almonds emerge before a creamy finish marked by a distinct chalky minerality.

Accolades

  • Vinous - 93 points

Food Pairing

This Champagne is an excellent match for sophisticated starters such as foie gras toasts, sea scallop carpaccio, or fresh sushi. Its structure also allows it to pair beautifully with richer dishes like creamy seafood risotto or white truffle potato chips.

title: Illimis Pinotage 2023
bodyHtml:
Illimis, the Latin word for 'clarity', defines the winemaking philosophy of founder and viticulturist Lucinda Heyns. She believes in minimal intervention and allowing the wine to express its origin with clarity, finesse, and complexity, seeing the wine as a 'window to where its vineyard is rooted'. Heyns established Illimis Wines in 2015 after studying viticulture in South Africa and gaining experience in California and Italy.

Wine Description

The Illimis Pinotage 2023 is a 'lighter style of Pinotage' made from 100% Pinotage grapes. On the nose, it offers 'opulent mashed berries, juicy plum, and violets' with 'whispers of earthy and spicy undertones'. The palate is described as 'alluring' and 'bright', unfolding with inviting charm. It transitions the earthy and spicy undertones onto the palate.

Food Pairing

This Pinotage pairs well with grilled, roasted, or braised red meat like lamb kebabs or venison burgers. Its compatibility with spicy food suggests a pairing with Thai dishes, spicy Chinese dishes, or Cape Malay Curry.

title: Penfolds Max's Shiraz - Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
The wine is a tribute to Penfolds' former Chief Winemaker, Max Schubert (1948–1975), a legendary figure who created the iconic Grange. Schubert's constant pursuit of excellence paved the way for those who followed and allowed the status and heritage of Penfolds to grow.

Wine Description

The wine shows a deep ruby-purple or plum core with strawberry brightness at the rim. The aromatic profile is an 'aromatic kaleidoscope' led by primary fruits such as fresh blackberries, mulberry compote, and poached plums. Notes of mulberry leaf and bay leaf reveal the Cabernet Sauvignon inclusion, while warm and generous baking spices hint at the warm-climate Shiraz. On the palate, the wine is incredibly smooth in texture, with a rich and plush mouthfeel.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for this style include complex, rich flavours like a beef Wellington or simple dishes like an American-style beef burger.

title: Antigal Uno Malbec Dolores Vineyard 2020
bodyHtml:
A Malbec from Argentina, specifically the Mendoza region, the grapes are sourced from the Uco Valley, a high-elevation area at the foothills of the Andes.

The wine is produced by Antigal Winery & Estates, which was established on the site of a historic winery dating back to 1897 in Russell, Maipú. After a complete refurbishment in 2000, Antigal transformed into a home for high-quality wines. Their winemaking philosophy is centred on the pursuit of excellence and protecting the grapes through a gravity-flow system. The 'Uno' Malbec was the winery's first signature wine, with the number '1' inspired by the metal hoops used to mark the first bottles.

  • Aroma: Offers thick scents of plum, strawberry, and blackberry, with enticing hints of violets, vanilla, and milk chocolate. Other notes can include purple flowers, baking spice, and cocoa.

  • Palate: The wine is packed with flavours of red currants, cassis, blackberry, raisin, and subtle spice accents of cinnamon, vanilla, and star anise. The fruit is brightened by carefully protected natural acidity.

  • Body and Finish: It is extremely smooth in terms of mouthfeel, driven by a slow current of acidity and silky, finely-grained tannins. It provides an agreeably persistent finish. The wine is aged for 8-10 months in French and American oak barrels.

title: Chateau Des Bormettes Cote & Mer Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This fresh rosé is from France, in the Provence region, within the specific appellation of Côtes de Provence. The grapes are grown on the particular terroir of La Londe-les-Maures, which benefits from an exceptional geographical location facing the Mediterranean Sea.

Château des Bormettes is a century-old family estate, with tangible traces of wine production dating back to the 10th century. The current estate has been in the Faré family for almost a century, and their winemaking philosophy involves sustainable cultivation on their schist and quartz soils to preserve the unique terroir. The winery focuses on producing wines that truly reflect this terroir, and they avoid excessive intervention or fining products to create the fashionable pale rosé style.

Wine Description

The Chateau Des Bormettes Cote & Mer Rosé is a light-bodied, fresh, fruity, and mineral wine.

title: Il Borro Borrigiano Igt Toscana 2024
bodyHtml:
This wine is from Italy, specifically the Tuscany region, under the broader Toscana IGT (Indicazione Geografica Tipica) classification.

The Il Borro estate has a rich, thousand-year history, and was purchased by founder Ferruccio Ferragamo in 1993, who was captivated by the area's history and natural beauty. Since 2012, the Ferragamo family, with Salvatore Ferragamo now as CEO, has been converting Il Borro into a certified organic and eco-sustainable estate, driven by a philosophy grounded in authenticity, sustainability, and respect for tradition.

Wine Description

This dynamic and versatile red wine has a ruby red colour with noticeable purple reflexes.

  • The nose presents vibrant aromas of fresh red fruits, particularly reminiscent of cherries, along with subtle hints of white pepper. Some vintages also show light spicy scents of ginger.

  • The Borrigiano blend typically features Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon, with a common composition being 70% Sangiovese and 30% Cabernet Sauvignon. On the palate, the wine offers a pleasant acidity and well-refined, soft tannins.

  • This wine is serene, balanced, and nuanced, with a lively fruity finish that leaves the mouth completely clean and refreshed.

  • Il Borro has been certified organic since 2015. This wine is made from organically grown grapes and is often described as an organic red wine.


    Food Pairing

    • Borrigiano is a versatile wine that can be enjoyed with a whole meal or on any occasion.

    • It is perfect for accompanying dishes from simple Tuscan cuisine, such as bread-based soups like ribollita and pappa al pomodoro.

    • Other great pairings include fresh or only slightly aged cheese.

    • It also complements uncomplicated meat dishes. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Amatitena Tequila Blanco
bodyHtml:
This spirit is a Tequila Blanco from Mexico, specifically the region of Jalisco, in the subregion of Amatitán (often referred to as the Tequila Valley/Los Valles). The brand, Amatiteña, is named after the town of Amatitán, Jalisco, known as "The Cradle of Tequila". The tequila is made by fifth-generation maestro tequilero Don Alberto Partida, who continues his family's legacy while championing the use of exclusively historical and ancestral distilling methods that predate the mid-19th century. Amatiteña is a single estate tequila, made with 100% Blue Weber agave (Agave tequilana) grown on the Partida family's land.

Amatiteña Tequila Blanco is a testament to the complex flavour of meticulously crafted agave spirit. It is double distilled in historical 19th-century alembic copper pot stills and is bottled at 42% ABV (84 proof).

  • Colour: Crystal bright with silver hues.

  • Aroma: The aromas are powerful, sweet, and intense. Notes include cooked agave, intense smoke, lemon/lime citrus, and a fresh minty note. An herbal medley of lemon thyme, sage, and dill is present, along with black and green peppercorns, earthy minerals, and a growing level of smoke.

  • Palate: The texture is thick, strong, and has a large body. The flavour is a vibrant and clean experience, showcasing bold fruit notes, caramel, smokey honey sweet agave, warming pepper heat, assertive spices, and anise. Subtle notes of purple flowers, fresh vanilla bean, dried dates and figs, and a persistent pulse of salinity also appear.

  • Body and Finish: The overall profile is stunning and formidable. The finish is round, warm, and balanced, fading away slowly and satisfyingly with a savoury white pepper on the end.

  • Production Methods: The piñas are cooked in a rare, traditional stone oven over mesquite wood fire, a method that predates the steam ovens common today. The cooked agave is then milled using a stone tahona wheel. Fermentation occurs with the agave fibres (bagasse) in open air wood tanks (tinas), using ambient yeast and water from an ancient spring, making each batch a unique expression of terroir.

title: Modelo Especial 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml: Well-balanced flavor, with a smooth hop character and a crisp, refreshing finish. Modelo Especial is characterized by its orange blossom aroma and a grassy note. Modelo Especial products contain water, barley malt, unmalted grains, and hops.

title: Chartreuse Green  - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Chartreuse Green Liqueur is a legendary herbal spirit with a rich history, made in France in the Chartreuse Mountains of the Isère region, near Grenoble. The story of the liqueur begins in 1605, when an ancient manuscript containing a recipe for an 'elixir of long life' was gifted to the Carthusian monks near Paris. The recipe eventually reached the Grande Chartreuse monastery, where, after over a century of study, Brother Jérôme Maubec perfected the formula in 1737.

Wine Description

On the nose, it offers a powerful, herbaceous, and peppery bouquet with prominent notes of mint, pine sap, lemon zest, anise, and baking spices. The palate delivers a rush of complex flavours: it is initially sweet, evolving into a pungent, spicy, and strongly vegetal or herbaceous character. Notes often include mint, aniseed, pine, citrus, and a subtle medicinal quality, all contributing to its balanced complexity.

This bold and complex liqueur is traditionally enjoyed as a digestif, served neat and chilled, to fully appreciate its intense aromatic power.

title: Angel's Envy Triple Oak
bodyHtml:
This spirit is a Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey from the United States, distilled in Louisville, Kentucky. Angel's Envy was founded by Bourbon Hall of Fame member and Master Distiller Lincoln Henderson and his son Wes Henderson. The distillery is renowned for innovating the foundations of bourbon through a unique secondary finishing technique. Master Distiller Owen Martin created this expression to mark the first new, permanent addition to the brand's Signature Series lineup in over ten years.

Description Angel's Envy Triple Oak is bottled at 92 proof (46% ABV). The mash bill consists of 72% corn, 18% rye, and 10% malted barley.

  • Colour: A golden caramel hue.

  • Aroma: The nose offers fresh, ripe apricot balanced by rich toasted oak, with highlights of honeysuckle blossom. Further savoury notes include dry leather and pipe tobacco.

  • Palate: The body is full with bold baking spices from the oak, and subtle hints of brioche and vanilla custard. It delivers a complexity of flavour with baking spices, dark fruits, and a touch of cinnamon. The Chinkapin oak adds layers of caramel, vanilla, and a rich coffee nuance.

  • Body and Finish: Top notes of red plum are anchored by fresh tobacco and leather tannins. The finish has a pleasant spice, with lingering notes of nutmeg, black pepper, and cardamom. It closes with a refined sweetness of brown sugar and molasses. The finish is long and dry on the back end, having taken on a decent amount of tannin in its secondary finishing.

  • Production: This unique profile is achieved by initially ageing the bourbon in new American white oak barrels, then finishing a blend of bourbons in three distinct oak casks: Hungarian oak, Chinkapin oak (from Kentucky), and French oak (from France).

Accolades

  • The 'Robb Report' described it as "An excellent addition to the Angel's Envy lineup."

title: Cuvelier & Fils Haut Medoc 2019
bodyHtml:
The story of the Maison H. Cuvelier & Fils is one of family legacy and a deep love of the trade. Founded by Henri Cuvelier as a wine trading house in Haubourdin in 1804, the family has since demonstrated renowned expertise in the terroir and wine production. Their winemaking philosophy, as applied to their estates, is rooted in dedication and patience, with all efforts going into vine growing to produce outstanding grapes.

Wine Description

The Cuvelier & Fils Haut Médoc is made from a blend that includes Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. Haut Médoc wines are often known for their concentration and backbone. Haut Médoc wine is described as round, fruity, concentrated, and forward.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs well with game meats, roast lamb, or hearty beef stews.

title: Malivoire Gamay 2024
bodyHtml:
Malivoire is a blend of innovative thinking with respect for tradition, committed to a long-term, wholistic view of their vineyard farms. The winery, established by Martin Malivoire in 1995 with the purchase of the Moira Vineyard, has become a base for creativity and sustainability, producing wines that are uniquely and proudly Canadian. Their philosophy highlights a gentle, eco-centric approach, including gravity flow winemaking to preserve delicate flavours and aromas while minimizing oxidation and energy consumption, along with reducing synthetic inputs in the vineyard.

Wine Description

It exhibits aromas of stewed black cherry, candied berries, and red liquorice, as well as sensations of dark Niagara cherry, raspberry, black pepper, fragrant juniper, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is bright and juicy, with notes of blackcurrant and a peppercorn spice. It offers a refreshing, fruit forward style with vibrant acidity and balance.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include charcuterie, grilled duck in a plum sauce, or Korean Pork Bulgogi. It also pairs well with braised lamb, grilled chicken, salmon, or lighter-weight meat dishes like roast chicken or pork chops.

title: Laporte Sancerre Le Grand Rochoy 2023
bodyHtml:
Domaine Laporte, established in Saint-Satur in 1850, has earned a reputation for quality and a pioneering spirit over several generations. The estate, which is certified organic, aims for purity and excellence while showing great respect for its land. The wine is a benchmark single-vineyard Sancerre from the domaine's iconic flint hillside, 'Le Grand Rochoy', which is a single-vineyard monopoly for the estate.

Wine Description

The aromatic profile is complex, showcasing notes of crisp apple, white peach, and citrus blossom. It is marked by iodine and mineral aromas reminiscent of its flint-rich terroir, with an exotic touch of passion fruit. On the palate, this medium-bodied Sauvignon Blanc is lively, focused, and precise, featuring vivid acidity. It is well-structured and elegant, balancing roundness and liveliness, with a subtle salinity that leads to a long, pure, and saline finish.

Food Pairing

This wine’s vibrant acidity and mineral spine make it an excellent partner for fresh goat cheese, oysters, or grilled sea bass. It also pairs beautifully with vibrant salads, scallops ceviche, or even chicken prepared with citrus marinades.

title: Chateau Pegau Plan Pegau
bodyHtml:
The wine is a project of Laurence Féraud, owner and winemaker of the renowned Domaine du Pegau. The Féraud family has a long history of cultivating vines in the Provence region, dating back to 1670. Domaine du Pegau was launched in 1987 by Laurence and her father, Paul Féraud, and is named after the terracotta wine jugs found in the excavations of the 14th century Pope’s Palace in Avignon. The winemaking philosophy remains deeply traditional, and this 'Plan Pegau' cuvée is considered the 'little brother' of the prestigious Châteauneuf du Pape 'Cuvée Réservée'.

Wine Description

'Plan Pegau' is a distinctive, multi-vintage red blend that aims to capture the hallmark personality and style of Pegau in an approachable format. This rich, meaty red wine exhibits a bright red colour, sometimes with amber reflections. The aroma features notes of red fruits and spices, with some lots also showing dark berries, roasted meat, and black pepper. On the palate, it delivers layers of red and dark fruit character, soft, supple tannins, and complex spice notes from extended ageing.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for this rich, savoury Rhone-style red include all types of classic meat dishes, such as veal, pork, beef, lamb, duck, and game.

title: Barbeito Sercial Reserva 10 Year
bodyHtml:
Vinhos Barbeito is a renowned, family-owned winery, founded in 1946 by Mario Barbeito de Vasconcelas during a challenging period for Madeira. The winery is known for its commitment to traditional methods and for producing ‘super-pure, almost crystalline wines’ under the direction of Ricardo Diogo Vasconcelos Freitas. The Sercial grapes for this wine are sourced from various quality vineyards, including those in Jardim da Serra and Ribeira da Janela.

Wine Description

The wine displays a greenish gold colour. On the nose, it offers complex aromas of dried fruits, pine, and resin. The palate is mineral and salty, showing a strong and heady acidity. It is a dry and fresh wine that maintains its invigorating acidity throughout. The finish is long and dry, with some descriptions calling it 'almost endless'.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include oysters, French onion soup, octopus salad, and hard cheeses like Parmesan.

title: La Mariniere Muscadet 2023
bodyHtml:
The wine is a product of Les Celliers du Prieure or Loire Proprietes, depending on the bottling, though the Muscadet appellation in the Pays Nantais area has deep viticultural history possibly dating back to the Roman times, with vineyards now benefiting from a microclimate influenced by the sea. Winemaking in this area often highlights the local terroir and the freshness of the Melon de Bourgogne grape.

On the nose, it offers delicately fruity aromas that intermingle with citrus and mineral notes, sometimes including green apple and white blossoms. The palate is lively and bright, showing flavours of lemon, pear, and minerality. Due to its 'sur lie' ageing—spending the winter in vats on its fine fermentation lees—the wine is supple, round, and possesses a beautiful vivacity, with the process adding a touch of creaminess and complexity.

Food Pairing

It is perfect with appetizers, such as salmon tartar or rillettes, and its traditional partner, oysters.

title: Miro Organic Reserva Red Vermouth - 1 Litre
bodyHtml: Miro Red Vermouth enchants the palate with its captivating blend of aromatic herbs and luscious fruits. A symphony of flavours unfolds as the velvety liquid dances on the tongue, revealing layers of botanicals and spices. Sweet notes of red berries and cherries intertwine with hints of warm vanilla and exotic spices, creating a harmonious balance between richness and vibrancy. Miro red Vermouth entices with its smooth and lingering finish, leaving a delightful warmth and a touch of elegance. This exquisite Vermouth is currently made at the Miro distillery in Reus, a city nestled in the Catalonia region of Spain, renowned for its centuries-old tradition of Vermouth production.

title: Argyle Pinot Noir Reserve 2023
bodyHtml:
In 1987, Argyle was founded by pioneering vintner Rollin Soles, with a belief that the cool climate of Oregon’s Willamette Valley was ideal for producing sparkling wines. Their winemaking program now includes sparkling wines, Chardonnays, Pinot Noirs and Rieslings, which have earned acclaim for their elegance, vineyard-driven character and uncommon age-ability. While Argyle has quietly established a reputation as an Oregon icon, they have remained deeply rooted in the Willamette Valley community, and true to the grower-first ideals that inspired its founding. 
 
This Pinot Noir showcases the elegance and silky texture found across its four sites throughout the Willamette Valley. Red cherry, rose petal, and savoury tea layers abound, with an underlying minerality weaving together with firm, yet polished tannins and dynamic energy. Cold soaking and fermenting entirely in small, 1.5-ton fermenters enhanced the wine’s silkiness, while 20% whole cluster inclusion contributed freshness, layered complexity, and vibrant length.

title: Ployez Jacquemart Blanc de Blanc 2010
bodyHtml:
This vintage Champagne is from the Ployez-Jacquemart family House, established in 1930. The House is located in Ludes, a Premier Cru village in the heart of France's Champagne region. The vineyards used for this wine are from Premier and Grand Cru sites in both the Montagne de Reims and Côte des Blancs sub-regions. Current cellar master, Laurence Ployez, the granddaughter of the founders, is a third-generation winemaker who oversees the winemaking process. The winery's philosophy is centred on safeguarding the wine's freshness and minerality by following a rigorous and precise technical chain, including extra-long ageing sur pointe (nose-to-punt). They blend very lightly in an Extra Brut style to allow the natural fruitiness and authentic personality of each wine to express itself.

Wine Description

The Ployez-Jacquemart Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut 2010 is a single-varietal Champagne made exclusively from Chardonnay grapes. It has an elegant mousse and a refined finish.

The sensory profile is complex and elegant. The bouquet is bright, precise, and complex, offering notes of delicious apple, pear, and fresh-baked bread. It also presents subtle roasted notes, alongside aromas of hazelnut, chalky soil, lovely floral tones, and a discreet framing of buttery oak. The palate is deep, full-bodied, and precise, with an excellent core and a fine base of mineral drive. All the creaminess of the Chardonnay is said to explode on the palate. The wine shows impeccable balance and focus, with a long, bright, very complex finish.

The wine was aged for fully ten years on its fine lees before being disgorged, and finished with a low dosage of just under four grams per litre. This preserves the purity of the wine and allows all the Chardonnay aromas to be expressed. The optimal drinking window is long, with one critic suggesting it can be enjoyed between 2024 and 2055.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 94 points

  • Vinous - 93 points

Food Pairing

This Blanc de Blancs is a versatile sparkling wine. Suggested pairings are tailored to its purity and freshness, including seafood, shellfish, crab, and lobster. Its delicacy also makes it a great choice for sushi and sashimi, or lean to medium-fat fish. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Tilenus Ecologico Mencia 2025
bodyHtml:
Produced by Bodegas Estefanía, located in the Bierzo Designation of Origin (DO), in the Castilla y León region of northwestern Spain. Bodegas Estefanía was founded in 1999 when the Frías Family converted an old creamery into a winery. The winery's flagship brand, 'Tilenus', is a tribute to Teleno, the ancient Celtiberian god of war, and the labels feature a Roman coin discovered in one of their vineyards, reflecting the region's Roman heritage. Bodegas Estefanía manages nearly 40 hectares of century-old vineyards with clay soils rich in minerals. The 'Ecologico' in the name signifies that the wine is from an organic wine producer, and the estate is currently in the organic certification process.

Wine Description

This wine is a single-varietal red made from 100% Mencía grapes. Mencía is a native grape of the El Bierzo region and is often praised for its ability to produce aromatic and fresh wines with a longer life in the bottle.

The Mencía grape offers a flavour profile that includes raspberry, pepper, and leather, along with tart cherry, violet, anise, and blackberry notes. The style of Mencía is generally medium-bodied with refreshing acidity and silky, supple tannins.

title: Lionel Faury Saint Joseph Rouge 'La Gloriette' Vieilles Vignes 2022
bodyHtml:
The Faury family has been working the steep hillsides of the Northern Rhône for generations. Jean Faury established the property above Chavanay and his son, Philippe, took over in 1979, the year he bottled the first vintage and began developing the estate. Since 2005, the estate has been managed by Lionel Faury, whose winemaking philosophy is guided by responsible viticulture, respect for the granite terroir, and an approach that yields wines combining power, balance, and finesse.

Wine Description

On the nose, it offers expressive aromas of dark cherry, blackberry, violets, and black pepper, often complemented by mineral, olive, smoky bacon, or potpourri notes. The palate is typically concentrated, broad, and flavourful, with a transparent dark fruit character, such as black and blue fruit, salty olive, and floral pastille notes. It is a medium-bodied, bold, and structured red that showcases Syrah's peppery aromatics and has a silky texture with a harmonious frame of fine-grained tannins.

title: Gallo Merlot 2023
bodyHtml:
This smooth red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the California region. Gallo Family Vineyards was founded in 1933 by brothers Ernest and Julio Gallo in Modesto, California, following the repeal of Prohibition. Over more than 80 years of family ownership, the winery has grown into the largest family-owned winery in the United States and the largest wine producer in the world by volume. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a family promise to provide approachable, quality wines for every occasion, ensuring that every bottle is a reflection of their long-standing heritage and commitment to easy enjoyment.

Wine Description

Gallo Family Vineyards Merlot presents a rich ruby red colour in the glass. The sensory profile is fruit-forward and inviting, with a bouquet that features aromas of ripe plum, black cherry, and blackberry, complemented by subtle hints of mocha, vanilla, and sweet wood. On the palate, this full-bodied wine is soft and medium-dry, offering juicy flavours of dark berries and red cherry supported by gentle spice and a whisper of oak.

Stylistically, it is celebrated for its balanced mouthfeel and velvety richness. The finish is smooth and lingering, with pleasant notes of ripe fruit and a touch of warm vanilla. While crafted for immediate and easy drinking, its consistent style ensures it remains a reliable choice for casual sipping or social gatherings.

title: Domaine Besson Chablis Mont de Milieu Premier Cru
667 Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml: Dark aromas of black tea, blackberry, charred wood and menthol show on the nose of this bottling. Light tannins frame baked boysenberry and licorice-dust flavours on the palate, which offers a pinch of pepper too.

title: Jackson Triggs Cabernet Sauvignon Proprietor's Reserve
bodyHtml: Light to medium ruby garnet colour; dry and medium bodied with lively crisp cassis berry character and very light tannins.

title: Pelee Island Cabernet Franc
bodyHtml:
Pelee Island Winery is located in the South Islands sub-appellation of Ontario, Canada, on Pelee Island, the southernmost grape-growing region in the country. With a history dating back to 1854, the estate is regarded as the birthplace of winemaking in Canada. The winery operates over 700 acres of farmland with a philosophy deeply rooted in sustainability, being one of only five Ontario wineries to be both Sustainable Winemaking Ontario (SWO) Winery and Vineyard certified.

Wine Description
