This Cabernet Franc is a deep ruby red wine that offers a bold yet elegant expression of the varietal. The nose features intense aromas of perfectly ripened red fruits, light currant jam, and a touch of spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and well-balanced, showcasing flavours of succulent summer berry pie, plum, and dark chocolate, layered with subtle notes of cedar and vanilla. It is characterized by vibrant acidity and velvety, finely grained tannins that lead into a long, graceful finish. Composed of 100% Cabernet Franc, this VQA wine is typically approachable upon release but can be cellared for several years to further develop its complexity.

title: Tommasi Ripasso Valpolicella Classico Superiore 2021
bodyHtml: Elegant and delicious Ripasso is made from Valpolicella, with grape skins from Amarone production added to the process to create a richer wine. Smoky, foral, black plum preserve and spice. A tasty treat with veal parmigiana, osso buco or beef fajitas.

title: Miller Genuine Draft 355 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml: This famously smooth lager is brewed from premium ingredients, cold-filtered four times and never pasteurized. It's a pale golden colour with delicate aromas and flavours of light fruit, cereal grain, citrus, bready malt and herb. Light, crisp and creamy on the palate with a clean, refreshing finish. Great palate refresher.

title: Alexander Keith's India Pale Ale 341 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Discover the iconic Canadian beer that traces its rich heritage back to Halifax, Nova Scotia, in 1820. Founded by Scottish immigrant Alexander Keith, this ale is a classic of the Canadian Maritimes. The brewery itself is one of the oldest working breweries in North America. When you crack open a Keith's, you're not just enjoying a beer—you're tasting over two centuries of brewing history!

Don't let the name confuse you: Alexander Keith's is the original balanced ale. Unlike modern, hop-heavy IPAs, this classic recipe reflects an older, more understated style of British ale, offering a smooth, approachable taste.

  • Appearance: Pours a beautiful, clear pale gold colour.

  • Flavour Profile: It's brewed slowly using select malted barley and a proprietary yeast strain. The taste is malty and smooth, featuring gentle sweetness with subtle notes of black licorice.

  • Hops: This ale uses North American flavour and bittering hops but remains mildly bitter and lightly hopped for distinct drinkability.

title: Sumarroca Letargia Brut Nature
bodyHtml:
This Cava displays a pale yellow colour with fine, persistent bubbles and a bright yellow colour with a gold rim for the 2012 vintage. The complex aroma presents intense notes of white fruit and flint, with soft hints of fresh apple and citrus. These fruit notes are beautifully interwoven with developing nuances of toast, pastry, and brioche, stemming from long ageing on the lees. On the palate, the wine is elegant, fresh, and tasty, with a creamy, fleshy stone fruit character and an integrated mousse. It has a lively mouthfeel with lemon curd acidity, showcasing a balanced and complex profile. The finish is long, dry, and elegant, where the pastry and toasted notes reappear to provide longevity.

The traditional Cava varietal composition for the 'Letargia' is typically Xarel-lo, Macabeo, and Parellada.

Food Pairing

This seriously elegant Cava is divine with seafood and shellfish. Suggested pairings also include cured cheese, white meats, and seafood rice dishes. The Cava's complexity and long, dry finish make it a versatile pairing partner. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Gut Oggau Emmeram 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from Austria, specifically from the Burgenland region. Established in 2007 by Eduard and Stephanie Tscheppe-Eselböck, Gut Oggau is a pioneer in the natural wine movement, working with a 13-hectare estate that has not seen chemical treatments for over 20 years. The winery's philosophy centres on a fictional family tree where each wine is given a name and a face that represents its unique personality; Emmeram is characterized as the globetrotting, sophisticated 'son' or 'uncle' figure with a captivating and playful charm.

Wine Description

Gut Oggau Emmeram displays a cloudy, golden appearance and is often noted for a very light, natural fizz. The nose is powerful and exuberant, offering aromas of lychee, rose petals, and gardenia layered with citrus zest, honey, and tropical fruits like passionfruit and papaya. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and bone dry, delivering a succulent core of pear and apricot balanced by bright acidity and a satisfying 'wet stone' minerality. It is characterized by its intense aromatic complexity and a direct, energetic structure that avoids the heaviness often associated with its variety. This 100% Gewürztraminer is produced from 40-year-old vines grown on limestone and sand soils, with an ABV typically ranging between 12.5% and 13.7%. The wine is fully biodynamic (Demeter certified), fermented with indigenous yeasts in neutral oak barrels, and bottled unfined, unfiltered, and with no added sulphur. The optimal drinking window is from release through five to seven years.

title: Peri Peri Nini Bianco Siciliane 2023
bodyHtml:
• The 'Nini' Bianco is typically a single-varietal wine made from the indigenous Sicilian white grape, Grillo.

  • On the nose, the wine is intensely savoury, with aromas that suggest hot stones, preserved lemons, toasted almonds, crushed wild herbs, and salt.

  • On the palate, it exhibits a fresh tang, contributing to a vibrant and expressive style with lively acidity.

  • Grillo wines are generally described as fresh and well-structured, with a slightly sapid and mineral finish.

  • The wine is produced using organic winegrowing practices. 

    Food Pairing

    • As a Southern Italy White, this wine is considered a match for shellfish, vegetarian dishes, and appetizers and snacks.

    • More generally, Grillo pairs well with white fish.

    • This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Devevey Bourgogne Aligote
bodyHtml:
This is a white wine made entirely from the Aligoté varietal. It is described as a richly textured Aligoté with notes of lemon confit, fresh herbs, and violet. The wine exhibits fresh, bright acidity and has a long finish. It is made from organically certified grapes. The wine is aged in barrel for 12 months. While Aligoté is often best appreciated while young, typically consumed within one to three years, some Aligoté wines can be aged for a few years.

Food Pairing 

Its lively acidity and fresh character make this wine an excellent accompaniment to a variety of dishes. Traditional pairings include grilled fish, seafood, and goat's cheese. It is also highly versatile, pairing well with oysters, snails, cod, shrimp, crab salad, and artichokes. This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Maison Darragon Le Haut Des Ruettes Vouvray 2024
bodyHtml:
The Darragon family have been winegrowers in Vouvray for nine generations (since 1761). Over time, they have put down deep roots in the Vouvray region, passing down their know-how to obtain a high-quality product. The vineyard is located between the village of Vouvray and the border of the municipality of Vernou-sur-Brenne. The estate now covers 40 hectares (99 acres).

The brilliant and bright pale-yellow colour with golden glints leads to a nose combining the sweetness of pale-fleshed fruit with that of honeyed flowers. Delicately tender and sweet on the palate, with a good balance of sweetness and freshness. Long and harmonious finish.

title: Peri Peri Tinuzzo Nerello Mascalese 2021
bodyHtml:
The wine is made from 100% Nerello Mascalese grapes. It generally presents with a ruby clear colour.

The aromatic profile is noted for being surprisingly interesting and floral, with notes of rose petals, violets, plums, cherries, and wild strawberries. Other aromas include earthy notes, pencil shavings, dried leather, tobacco, spices, and herbs.
On the palate, it is dry and is often described as medium-bodied, with medium-plus acidity and medium tannins. Flavours include sour red cherry, cranberry, and other red fruits.

The wine is appreciated for its soft tannins, balanced acidity, and good balance. It is certified organic.

It offers a delightful experience often likened to fine Pinot Noir, with enough structure to age well for around 5–15 years, depending on the producer.

Food Pairing

  • This wine is versatile and pairs well with a multitude of dishes.

  • Suggested pairings include red meats, game, and aged cheeses. It is also recommended with rich and spicy dishes, structured first courses, beef, and lamb. Reviewers have specifically enjoyed it with veal tortellini and cream sauce. 
    A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: La Monacesca Verdicchio Di Matelica 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in Italy, this distinguished white wine originates from the Marche region, specifically within the Verdicchio di Matelica subregion. The estate, located in the municipality of Matelica, derives its name from a 10th-century settlement of Benedictine monks who fled Longobard persecutions to build a monastery and church on these lands. In 1966, Casimiro Cifola purchased the property and established the winery, a legacy now carried on by his son, Aldo Cifola. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a deep respect for the Verdicchio grape, opting out of barrel aging to ensure that the pure quality and characteristics of the fruit remain the central focus.

Wine Description

This wine presents a bright straw yellow colour, often accompanied by elegant greenish reflections. The aromatic profile is complex and refined, offering a bouquet of white flowers, lime, yellow apple, and wild herbs, with deeper nuances of anise, cedar, and dried fruit as it breathes. On the palate, it is powerful and full-bodied yet remarkably well-balanced, delivering flavours of citrus, white cherry, and almond skin. It possesses a lively acidity and a pronounced mineral depth, leading to a long, persistent finish characterized by a fine almond note and a distinct chalky edge that reflects the limestone-rich soils of the Matelica Valley.

Crafted from 100% Verdicchio, the wine is celebrated for its precise varietal expression and structural richness. While it is fresh and energetic enough for immediate enjoyment, its robust body and acidity allow it to age gracefully in the cellar for several years.

title: Castello di Ama Chianti Classico Riserva Montebuoni 2021
bodyHtml:
Ama is an old, fortified village situated near Radda and Gaiole in the heart of the Chianti Classico region. The Castello or Castle of Ama is surrounded by the beautiful Tuscan countryside and is near some of the original, noble families of the Chianti region. The meticulously cultivated vineyards are privy to optimal exposures and consist of fertile soils.

Deep ruby red with purple nuances. Fruit-forward. aromas of blackberry, blueberry, raspberry and currant. A well balanced, refined and harmonic palate with long-lasting aromatic profile. A pure expression of elegance.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

First released in 2018, this wine draws its fruit from a site about one kilometer over from the celebrated Vigneto Bellavista with similar conditions. The Castello di Ama 2021 Chianti Classico Riserva Montebuoni is a broad and rich expression of Sangiovese that offers concentrated blackberry, plum and velvety tannins. The wine shows attractive accessibility and a generous midweight mouthfeel. 2024 – 2032

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Rich and fleshy, with a supple texture, plus saturated flavors of cherry, raspberry, rose and mineral. Firms up yet keeps building on the palate to the persistent and complex aftertaste. Already beautifully balanced but should integrate even further with a few more years in the bottle. Sangiovese and Merlot. Best from 2026 through 2042.

title: Ruinart Brut Rose Champagne
bodyHtml:
The history of Ruinart rosé, the first rosé champagne to appear, dates back to the 18th century. While Ruinart rosé champagne first appeared over 250 years ago, its excellent quality remains the essential feature of the production of this delicate wine to this day.  45% of the Chardonnay is from the Côtes des Blancs and Montagne de Reims vineyards.  55% of the Pinot Noir is from the Montagne de Reims and the Vallée de la Marne vineyards, 18 to 19% of which has been made into red wine.  20 to 25% coming from reserve wines from the two previous years. 

The nose is subtle and fresh, first offering an original palette of tropical fruits (guava and lychee) and small berries (raspberries, cherries and wild strawberries) in the first instance.  The attack is distinct and full on the palate, cradled by a gentle effervescence.  Freshly picked berries are delightfully expressed, and the balance brings together a beautiful freshness and voluptuous body, expressed by an elegant bracing touch of mint and pink grapefruit.

title: Vina Albina Crianza
bodyHtml:
The wine displays a bright cherry red colour. Aromas include fresh fruit and licorice, along with pronounced notes of spice and toasty flavours from the new oak.
On the palate, it is soft in the mouth with pleasant and velvety tannins, leading to a nice long harmonious finish.
The blend is 80% Tempranillo, 15% Mazuelo, and 5% Graciano, with grapes sourced from Cenicero and San Vicente de la Sonsierra. The wine is aged for 18 months in new American oak barrels, which adds hints of spice and cedar, followed by an additional 6 months in the bottle prior to release.
This aging regime puts it in the 'Crianza' category but with enough oaking that it could have been classified as a Reserva.

Food Pairing

  • Suggested pairings for this style of wine include lamb, veal, and poultry.

  • Rioja Crianzas are medium-bodied red wines that are excellent choices for heartier dishes with lamb, pork, mushrooms, or earthy vegetables.

  • A Crianza's fruity freshness makes it a perfect complement for aged sheep's milk cheeses like Manchego.

    This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Lonetree Authentic Dry Cider 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Lonetree Authentic Dry Cider is the flagship offering from British Columbia’s Lonetree Cider Co., a producer dedicated to honoring the heritage of the Okanagan Valley. Using only 100% BC-grown apples, this cider is crafted to represent the "Old World" style moving away from the syrupy, sugar laden profiles of commercial ciders. It is designed to be a sophisticated, crisp, and natural alternative that highlights the pure character of the fruit.

Cider Description

This cider is brilliantly clear with a very pale straw color and a light, sparkling effervescence that persists in the glass.

Aroma: It features a clean and bright bouquet of fresh-pressed green apples, with subtle floral notes and a hint of earthy skin, lacking any artificial or candy-like scents.

Palate: On the tongue, it is remarkably crisp and light-bodied. It delivers a sharp, refreshing apple tartness followed by a bone-dry finish. The absence of heavy sugar allows the natural acidity of the apples to cleanse the palate.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.5% and is fermented to be fully dry, making it a highly sessionable and gluten-free choice for those who prefer a more fermented, wine-like character.

Technical Notes: Crafted using a specific blend of culinary apples and traditional cider varieties sourced from Okanagan orchards. It is cold-fermented to preserve the delicate aromatics of the fruit and contains no artificial flavors or colors.

title: Lonetree Ginger Apple Cider 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This zesty craft cider originates from Canada, specifically British Columbia, and is crafted using fruit from the sun-soaked Okanagan Valley. Lonetree Cider Co. is a proudly Canadian owned company that focuses on traditional, old-fashioned cider-making techniques. Their philosophy is rooted in supporting local family orchards, some of which feature trees nearly 80 years old, ensuring their ciders are made from 100 per cent real apples rather than concentrates.

The Ginger Apple Cider is a signature blend that combines crisp, dry apple cider with the exotic warmth of real ginger. It displays a transparent dark-yellow colour with medium carbonation. On the nose, a spiced ginger aroma dominates, complemented by notes of zesty candied ginger and mild dessert apples. The palate is crisp and balanced, beginning with a light hit of sweet apple that is quickly overtaken by a strong, spicy ginger kick. It is characterized by a dry finish that can feel almost hot at the back of the throat, leaving a long-lasting, tingly linger on the palate. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 5.5 per cent. This cider is naturally gluten-free and contains approximately 7 grams of sugar per can.

title: Grizzly Paw Rundlestone Easy IPA 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Grizzly Paw Rundlestone Easy IPA is a celebrated core offering from The Grizzly Paw Brewing Company, located in the heart of the Canadian Rockies in Canmore, Alberta. Named after the iconic local limestone used in the region's historic buildings, this beer is designed for those who love the complexity of an IPA but want the drinkability of a lighter session ale. It embodies the adventurous spirit of the mountains, providing a perfect reward after a day on the trails.

Beer Description

This "Easy" IPA (Session IPA) pours a clear, bright golden-amber with a light, frothy white head and consistent carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is vibrant and hop-forward, featuring a blend of citrus zest, juicy grapefruit, and subtle tropical notes, with a background of clean, crackery malt.

Palate: It offers a light-bodied and crisp mouthfeel. The flavor is dominated by zesty orange and piney hop notes, balanced by a gentle, bready malt sweetness. It finishes dry and clean with a refreshing, controlled bitterness.

Profile: It has an ABV of 4.5% and a moderate bitterness of 35 IBU, making it flavorful and aromatic while remaining light enough for multiple pints.

Technical Notes: Brewed using a blend of classic Pacific Northwest hops to achieve its citrus and pine character. The lower alcohol content is achieved through a precise malt bill that maintains a satisfying body despite the lower gravity.

title: Undone No. 8 'This is Not Wine Aperitif' Little French Aperitif (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Undone No. 8 'This is Not Vermouth' Little French Aperitif is a non alcoholic spirit designed to replicate the experience of a traditional French white wine aperitif. Produced by the German company Undone in Hamburg, it is crafted using a patented dealcoholization process that starts with real spirits and wine to maintain an authentic flavour profile.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic aperitif presents a brilliant golden yellow appearance. The nose is fragrant and sweet, combining the scent of fresh grapes with Mediterranean herbal notes, particularly thyme. On the palate, it unfolds a full bouquet of sweet orange, ginger, and wild berry notes, offering a light and refined structure. The body is characteristically herbaceous and floral, leading to a clean, slightly bitter finish that mimics the traditional vermouth experience. It contains 0.0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The herbal complexity and brightness of this aperitif make it a sophisticated partner for light, fresh fare. It pairs exceptionally well with Mediterranean dishes, such as grilled sea bass or salads featuring tomato, basil, and burrata. For a classic snack pairing, serve it alongside salted nuts, olives, or a charcuterie board with mild cheeses. It also complements seafood, specifically shellfish like oysters and mussels, where its acidity and herbal notes enhance the fresh, briny flavours.

Distinctive Features

Undone No. 8 is distinguished by its production method: unlike many botanical blends, it begins as a real alcoholic French wine aperitif before the alcohol is gently extracted. This ensures the preservation of complex botanical essences and natural wine aromas. The product is vegan, gluten free, and low in calories, containing approximately 12 to 18 calories per 30ml serving. It is designed specifically for those seeking a high quality alternative for social drinking without the effects of alcohol.

Serving Suggestions

This versatile liquid is intended primarily as a mixer for sophisticated non alcoholic cocktails. For a signature serve, create a 'French Wild Berry UNDONE' by mixing 2 oz of the aperitif with 4 oz of wild berry lemonade in a wine glass over ice. It also functions as an elegant vermouth replacement in a 'White Spritz' when combined with sparkling non alcoholic wine, or in a 0.0% Negroni paired with a non alcoholic gin and orange bitter. For a simpler preparation, serve it chilled over ice with a splash of tonic water and a lemon twist.

title: Lapis Luna Zinfandel 2022
bodyHtml: Rich, dark, and enticing. Flavors of lush blueberry, plums, and blackberry cobbler. Finish is smooth, long, and juicy.

title: Undone No. 4 'This is Not Mezcal' Mexican Smoky Agave (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Undone No. 6 'This is Not Mezcal' Mexican Smoky Agave is a non alcoholic spirit alternative produced in Hamburg, Germany. The brand was founded to provide the bar community with high quality alternatives that maintain the true essence of traditional spirits. The company utilizes a multi stage process to remove the alcohol from real fermented products before blending the remaining essence with natural flavours to mirror the profile of an alcoholic original.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic agave spirit presents a clear appearance with a complex sensory profile. The nose features exciting floral agave scents alongside notes of cooked pumpkin and a gentle, present smokiness. On the palate, it delivers the signature taste of classic Mexican smoky agave with layers of pear and earthy undertones. The body is refined and light, leading to a smooth finish characterized by a lingering agave flavour and subtle smoke. This product contains less than 0.3% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The smoky and floral structure of this spirit makes it a natural partner for bold and vibrant cuisines. It pairs exceptionally well with traditional Mexican dishes such as tacos, enchiladas, and fresh guacamole. For a more substantial pairing, it complements grilled meats and spicy foods, where the smokiness of the agave mirrors the charred flavours of the grill. It also serves as a refreshing accompaniment to citrus based seafood dishes like ceviche or grilled shrimp.

Distinctive Features

Undone No. 6 is distinguished by its 'terroir driven' base, which is refined from real mezcal rather than being a simple botanical water. It is a health conscious choice, being vegan, gluten free, and low in calories, with only 1.8 calories and 0.3 g of sugar per 30 ml serving. The product is crafted using natural ingredients including agave thickening juice, tequila flavour, and natural smoke flavour. This spirit is designed to maintain its aromatic intensity even when mixed, providing the necessary 'bite' for professional cocktail applications.

Serving Suggestions

To enjoy the classic smoky agave profile at its best, this spirit is primarily intended as a core ingredient for alcohol free cocktails. For a 'Virgin Paloma', mix 50 ml of Undone No. 6 with 100 ml of grapefruit juice and soda water in a glass filled with ice. It is also ideal for a 'Not Smoky Margarita' by shaking 50 ml of the spirit with 25 ml of lime juice and 15 ml of agave syrup. For a simple long drink, it can be served with ginger beer as an 'Agave Mule' or mixed with fresh pink grapefruit juice. It is recommended to store the bottle in a cool place protected from sunlight and consume it within eight weeks of opening.

title: Lucky Lager 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml: Lucky Lager was introduced to beer drinkers in 1934. The name Lucky was selected from a name-search contest. Fully fermented, Lucky Lager uses select ingredients and hops to deliver a remarkably clean, crisp-tasting beer.

title: Village Wit 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: An unfiltered wheat ale with notes of orange peel and coriander. Dedicated to all who spin stories, spread laughter, and entertain.

title: Poderi Colla Bonme Vermouth - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
This distinctive aromatized wine, classified as a Vermouth, hails from Piedmont, Italy. The name 'Bonmè' is significant, as it refers to wormwood (Artemisia absinthium) in the Piedmontese dialect, a key botanical in traditional vermouth recipes. Poderi Colla is a family-owned winery with a rich history in Piedmontese viticulture dating back to the 1894, with the family's winemaking roots going back to 1703. The estate's philosophy is centred on the naturalness and originality of their wines, combining centuries-old traditions with a deep respect for the land, which is carried into the production of their Vermouth.

Poderi Colla's Bonme is a white Vermouth crafted from 100% Muscat grape must. Historically, this style was called Moscato all'Assenzio. The vermouth is sweet because the fermentation of the Muscat must is prevented by immediately adding pure Buongusto alcohol. This process preserves the grape's natural sugar and its extraordinary aromatic charge.

The flavour is built by infusing approximately twelve herbs and botanicals—including peels, seeds, roots, and flowers—separately in alcohol for one to two weeks. These extracts are meticulously blended to achieve the right balance.

  • Colour: Lemon to golden yellow.

  • Aroma: Highly aromatic, with a nose featuring floral, citrus, and herbaceous nuances.

  • Palate: It offers vibrant citrus flavours—including lemon, pineapple, and orange—complemented by a complex herbal profile and an almondy roundness.

  • Stylistic Notes: The blend is allowed to rest for several months to allow the flavours to integrate seamlessly before bottling. This vermouth is noted for its complexity and excellent balance.

The Bonme Vermouth is versatile and can be served as an aperitif or a digestif. It should be served chilled, ideally at $7-8\degree \text{C}$ ($45-48\degree \text{F}$) as an aperitif to enhance its refreshing qualities.

title: Vecchio Amaro del Capo Riserva del Centenario
bodyHtml:
Vecchio Amaro del Capo Riserva del Centenario is a special reserve liqueur produced in limited, numbered quantities by Gruppo Caffo in Calabria, Italy. This exclusive expression was created to celebrate the centenary of Distilleria Caffo (1915-2015). The Caffo family, with four generations of distilling expertise, has perfected the original Amaro del Capo recipe. The 'Riserva' represents a gift for connoisseurs, embodying a century of experience and passion.

Wine Description

Vecchio Amaro del Capo Riserva is a unique combination of Amaro and Italian brandy, with an alcohol content of $37.5\%$ ABV.

  • Production: It is made from a secret recipe of 29 Calabrian herbs, flowers, fruits, and roots. The ingredients are infused according to ancient, artisanal methods and then blended with fine wine spirits (brandy) that have been aged for a long time in Slavonian oak barrels. The precious liqueur is then further refined in oak barrels for an additional six months to achieve maximum harmony among all its ingredients.

  • Sensory Profile: The liqueur displays an intense and bright amber or golden yellow colour.

    • Aroma: The nose is noted for being fruitier and softer than the classic expression. Aromas include honeysuckle, mandarin orange, saffron, candied fruit, citrus, with touches of cinnamon, licorice, and vanilla.

    • Palate: It is rich and decadent without being cloyingly sweet. The taste is delicate, with bitter notes well balanced by sweet notes. Flavours include spice and fruit, strawberry jam, gentian, bitter orange, cinnamon, and milk chocolate. It features a dried fruits-driven core with supporting flavours of black cherry, dried herbs, and red berries. The texture is rich.

    • Finish: The finish is long, with a medley of baking spices, most notably licorice and clove.

  • Stylistic Notes: This is a rewardingly complex sipper with layer upon layer of bitter herbs, sweet fruit, and oaken spice. It is intended as a refined digestivo and a product for meditation.

Accolades

  • Grand Gold Medal (Gran Gold Medal) - Concorso Mondiale Spirits Selection de Bruxelles (2016)

    • Recognised as the best herbal liqueur in the world (miglior liquore d'erbe al mondo).

title: Village Blonde 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml: Crisp and dry with a balance of subtle fruit and floral hops. Celebrating all who dare to be unique with their personal style.

title: Barbi Brunello Di Montalcino 2021
bodyHtml:
This distinguished red wine hails from Italy, originating from the historic core of the Brunello di Montalcino DOCG in Tuscany. Produced by Fattoria dei Barbi—an estate managed by the Colombini family whose roots in Montalcino date back to 1352—the property stands as one of the most classic expressions of the region. The winery focuses on a winemaking philosophy that marries time honoured traditions with modern viticulture, utilizing sustainably farmed vineyards positioned at elevations ranging from 300 to 500 metres above sea level to craft authentic Sangiovese wines of profound regional character.

Wine Description

The 2021 Brunello di Montalcino presents an intense and brilliant ruby red colour in the glass. On the nose, it displays a rich and complex bouquet dominated by ripe red cherries, plums, raspberries, and wild cherries, beautifully accented by hints of hazelnut, cloves, sweet cinnamon spice, and a touch of fresh mint. The palate is deeply structured, harmonious, and full bodied, offering a vibrant core of plum fruit and orange zest neatly counterbalanced by a juicy, well balanced acidity. A compact, fine grained web of gripping tannins provides a solid textural frame, leading into a long, persistent, and savory finish marked by dark chocolate and mineral salts. Composed of 100% Sangiovese, this estate bottling is engineered for extensive cellaring, with an optimal drinking window spanning from 2027 through 2046.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 growing season in Montalcino is considered a triumph, characterized by a low amount of rainfall and some of the coolest average temperatures noted in a decade. Despite minor challenges like an early April frost, the cool daytime conditions allowed the late-ripening Sangiovese fruit to mature slowly and evenly, preserving structural freshness, deep phenolic ripeness, and immense aromatic intensity.

title: Tenzan Shichida Aiyama Hiya-Oroshi - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Tenzan Shichida Aiyama Hiya-Oroshi originates from the Saga Prefecture in Japan. The Tenzan Sake Brewery was established in 1875, though the Shichida family's business history in the region dates back to 1861 when they operated a water mill. Currently led by sixth-generation owner Kensuke Shichida, the brewery is situated near the Gion River and utilizes mineral-rich water from the Tenzan mountain system for its production.

Description

This seasonal autumn release is a 'namazume' style sake, which is pasteurized once in the spring and matured over the summer to mellow its profile. It presents an elegant aroma of white flowers, yellow apples, and white peach, with deeper notes of steamed pear, toasted rice, and chestnut. On the palate, it is luscious and full-bodied with a soft, plump mouthfeel, featuring flavours of ripe grape, fig, cashew, and cream. The character is defined by a rich sweetness balanced by subtle lactic complexity and a lingering earthy finish. It has an alcohol content of 17% and utilizes Aiyama rice from Hyogo Prefecture polished to 75%.

Accolades

  • Kura Master - Gold Award (Junmai Category) 2020

  • U.S. National Sake Appraisal - Silver Award (Shichida Series) 2020

  • National New Sake Competition - Gold Award (Brewery Recognition)

  • IWC International Wine Challenge - Gold Medal (Brewery Recognition)

Food Pairing

The weighty structure and umami-rich profile of this Hiya-Oroshi make it an ideal partner for savoury and creamy dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with rich meats such as wagyu steak or stir-fried beef with green peppers. The sake's sweetness and lactic notes also complement pasta with white sauce, sweet potato in cream sauce, or cheese-flavoured snacks. For seafood, consider grilled shrimp or squid tempura to highlight the sake's depth. It is recommended to be served slightly chilled between 15°C and 20°C, or gently warmed to 42°C to accentuate its autumnal character.

title: Louis Guntrum Dry Riesling 2023
bodyHtml:
The Louis Guntrum Estate was established in 1648, and the cellars are situated directly on the Rhine between the villages of Nierstein and Oppenheim. It is currently owned and managed by the 11th generation of the family, Louis Konstantin Guntrum. The winery is focused on producing high-quality wines with passion, drawing from their deep history in the region.

Wine Description

The Louis Guntrum Dry Riesling 2023 offers an elegant and classical Riesling expression. It is a pale golden white wine. It features delicate aromas of white peaches, apricot, and juicy pears. On the palate, it provides a crisp, juicy, and joyful profile with lasting flavours. The wine is dry with a medium body. Its elegant character comes from a perfect balance of fruit and acidity.

Food Pairing

This dry Riesling is a versatile wine, perfect as an aperitif, but it also pairs well with a variety of foods. Consider pairing it with all kinds of seafood, including scallops, fish, and shellfish.

title: Berta Distillery - Amaretto di Mombaruzzo - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Berta Distillerie Amaretto di Mombaruzzo originates from Italy, within the northwest region of Piedmont in the subregion of Monferrato. Founded in 1947 by Paolo Berta in the small village of Mombaruzzo, the historic family distillery built its worldwide acclaim through artisanal grappa production. Today, the enterprise continues to be guided by the Berta family, marrying time-honoured Piedmontese distillation traditions with indigenous local ingredients.

Spirit Description

This premium amaretto presents a rich amber, copper appearance in the glass. The sensory profile features an intense and fragrant nose dominated by bitter almond, marzipan, toasted hazelnuts, and subtle vanilla, underpinned by gentle aromatic grappa notes. On the palate, the body is luscious, velvety, and exceptionally well balanced, delivering deep flavours of candied apricot kernels, sweet almond paste, and warm caramel without cloying sweetness. The finish is remarkably long, smooth, and refined, leaving a lingering warmth of roasted nuts and delicate cocoa. This artisanal liqueur is bottled at an alcohol by volume of 28%.

Food Pairing

The deep roasted almond character and velvety sweetness of this amaretto make it an outstanding digestif and dessert companion. It pairs magnificently with traditional Italian amaretti cookies, vanilla bean panna cotta, or tiramisu. For a savoury pairing, it serves as an intriguing accompaniment to sharp, aged blue cheeses or simply poured neat over artisanal espresso gelato.

title: Asahi Super Dry 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
This internationally acclaimed beer originates from Japan and is produced by Asahi Breweries, Ltd. The company’s roots trace back to the Osaka Beer Brewing Company, established in 1889. Asahi Super Dry revolutionized the beer market when it was launched in 1987, introducing the world’s first 'Super Dry' beer style. The brewery’s philosophy is centred on delivering a distinct, quick, and clean finish—a taste profile they term Karakuchi—through advanced, precise brewing techniques.

Asahi Super Dry is classified as an Adjunct or Rice Lager. It is brewed using the finest malted barley, hops, and a combination of adjuncts including rice and corn. The beer pours a clear, light blond colour. The sensory profile is characterized by its crisp, clean, and refreshing nature. The flavour is subtle and dry, deliberately engineered with a fast finish that quickly cleanses the palate. This signature 'dryness' is achieved with a proprietary yeast strain, Asahi #318, which ferments sugars to a high degree of attenuation. The overall stylistic note is one of balance and freshness, making it highly drinkable. The optimal window is to enjoy this beer fresh.

title: Benjamin Bridge Nova Zero Sparkling (Non Alcoholic) 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Benjamin Bridge Nova Zero is a non alcoholic sparkling wine beverage originating from the Gaspereau Valley in Nova Scotia, Canada. Inspired by the winery's iconic Nova 7, this beverage was developed by Benjamin Bridge Vineyards, a family owned farm winery founded in 1999. The winery is recognized as a leader in Canadian sparkling wine and is a proudly certified B Corp, reflecting its commitment to social and environmental standards.

Wine Description

This aromatic non alcoholic sparkling beverage presents an elegant wild rose hue in the glass. The sensory profile is characterized by enticing aromas of ripe peaches, guava, and lychee, with delicate hints of orange blossom and white roses. On the palate, it delivers an instantly refreshing blend of citrus, green apple sorbet, and honeysuckle, leading to a clean and lively finish. Rather than being a dealcoholized wine, it is crafted through a proprietary process using carbonated water and Muscat grape must, resulting in a balanced and fresh body that mirrors the elegance of its namesake. It is vegan, gluten free, and contains less than 0.5% ABV. This product is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and floral sweetness of Nova Zero make it a versatile partner for a variety of fresh and aromatic dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with Mediterranean inspired salads, lighter proteins such as roasted chicken, and fresh seafood like steamed mussels or scallops. Its refreshing carbonation and fruit forward profile also make it an ideal companion for spicy foods, including Thai or Indian cuisine, where it helps temper the heat. Additionally, it serves as a sophisticated aperitif alongside antipasto and fresh cheeses like Brie.

title: Chateau Bellefont Belcier 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Château Bellefont Belcier is a historic estate in Saint Emilion, with origins dating back to the late 18th century. Currently under the ownership of Peter Kwok, the château has flourished through substantial investments and a commitment to sustainable viticulture. The vineyard, located on the famed limestone plateau, benefits from exceptional terroir, enabling the production of refined and elegant wines that reflect both tradition and modern precision.

Wine Description

The 2022 Château Bellefont Belcier presents a deep garnet hue, offering a rich and aromatic bouquet of blackberries, ripe plums, and violets, with subtle hints of graphite and warm spices. On the palate, it unfolds with layers of dark fruit, cocoa, and savoury notes, supported by velvety tannins and a full-bodied structure. The finish is long and mineral-driven, leaving impressions of freshness and finesse. Crafted from a blend of Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Cabernet Sauvignon, this vintage showcases remarkable balance and complexity. Best enjoyed from 2027 through 2045, it is a wine of both immediate allure and ageing potential.

Accolades

"James Suckling - 95–96 points."
"Wine Advocate - 93–95 points."
"Vinous - 93–95 points."

Food Pairing

This Saint Emilion pairs beautifully with roasted lamb, duck confit, or a rich mushroom risotto. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Bordeaux is noted for its exceptionally warm and dry growing season, which produced concentrated, ripe fruit with excellent tannin maturity. Despite the challenges of heat, the team at Château Bellefont Belcier demonstrated skillful vineyard management, ensuring a harmonious and expressive wine that captures the essence of the year.

title: Chateau Bellefont Belcier 2022
bodyHtml:

The 2022 Château Bellefont Belcier presents a deep garnet hue, offering a rich and aromatic bouquet of blackberries, ripe plums, and violets, with subtle hints of graphite and warm spices. On the palate, it unfolds with layers of dark fruit, cocoa, and savoury notes, supported by velvety tannins and a full-bodied structure. The finish is long and mineral-driven, leaving impressions of freshness and finesse. Crafted from a blend of Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Cabernet Sauvignon, this vintage showcases remarkable balance and complexity. Best enjoyed from 2027 through 2045, it is a wine of both immediate allure and ageing potential.

Accolades

"James Suckling - 95–96 points."
"Wine Advocate - 93–95 points."
"Vinous - 93–95 points."

Food Pairing

This Saint Emilion pairs beautifully with roasted lamb, duck confit, or a rich mushroom risotto. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Bordeaux is noted for its exceptionally warm and dry growing season, which produced concentrated, ripe fruit with excellent tannin maturity. Despite the challenges of heat, the team at Château Bellefont Belcier demonstrated skillful vineyard management, ensuring a harmonious and expressive wine that captures the essence of the year.

title: Clos du Marquis 2017
bodyHtml:
Clos du Marquis is a distinguished red wine from the Saint-Julien appellation within the Bordeaux region of France. The name, created in 1902, was inspired by the 'Petit Clos' adjacent to the Château de Léoville, the residence of the Marquis de Las Cases. Clos du Marquis is a historical brand of the Domaines Delon, who also own Château Léoville Las Cases.

Wine Description

The wine presents a medium to deep garnet-purple colour. It has a highly aromatic profile, displaying vibrant notes of crushed blackcurrants, blackberries, and plums, along with classic Cabernet notes of cassis. Secondary aromas include violets, Indian spices, cigar box, graphite, and chocolate notes. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, with a finely crafted, polished texture. The black fruit core is framed by firm, grainy, and finely-grained tannins, supported by a bold freshness and bright acidity.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling - 94 points."

  • "Wine Enthusiast - 94 points."

  • "Wine Advocate - 93 points."

  • "Decanter - 90 points."

Food Pairing Suggested pairings include hearty dishes such as roast beef, lamb shoulder, venison, duck breast, or wild boar stew.

title: Philippe le Hardi Pinot Noir Bourgogne "Le Champ Lambert" 2023
bodyHtml:
From France’s Burgundy region, this Pinot Noir comes from the Hautes-Côtes de Beaune subregion. The wine is produced by Château Philippe-Le-Hardi, a historic estate dating back to the 14th century, once owned by Philippe the Bold, Duke of Burgundy. Today, the domaine is known for its commitment to sustainable viticulture and expressing the distinct terroirs of Burgundy.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir shows a brilliant ruby colour in the glass. The aromas are vibrant with red fruits such as cherry and raspberry, complemented by subtle floral tones and a hint of earthiness. On the palate, it offers medium body with refreshing acidity, soft tannins, and flavours of ripe berries, crushed violets, and light spice. The finish is smooth and elegant, lingering with a mineral touch that reflects its limestone-rich soils.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with roasted chicken, duck breast, and grilled salmon, as well as mushroom risotto or soft cheeses like Brie and Camembert.

title: Kopke Colheita Port 1975
bodyHtml:
Kopke Colheita Port is a single-harvest Tawny Port, meaning all the grapes are from a single vintage year, unlike a standard Tawny which is a blend of multiple harvests. The wine is produced from traditional Douro grape varieties grown on steeply terraced vineyards with schist-sandstone soil. Following hand-picking, crushing, and careful maceration, fermentation is halted by adding grape brandy (fortification) to maintain the wine's natural sweetness. A Colheita must be aged in oak barrels for a minimum of seven years before bottling, a process that imparts its unique complexity.

  • Colour: This port features an intense brown colour with attractive brick-coloured or deep amber hues and a tawny rim, indicative of its long barrel ageing.

  • Aroma: The rich and concentrated bouquet is laden with aromas of dried fruits (figs, apricots, orange peel), a refined note of spice, and classic oxidative notes of caramel, roasted nuts, and occasionally marzipan.

  • Palate: It is smooth and velvety on the palate, with good structure, balanced acidity, and a pleasant unctuousness. The flavour profile is rich and concentrated, delivering notes of caramel, toffee, chocolate, and subtle hints of spice.

  • Body and Finish: The wine is harmoniously structured, with a silky, mellow texture. It culminates in a long and enduring finish, where the nutty and dried fruit flavours linger.

title: Henschke Riesling 'Peggy's Hill' 2023
bodyHtml:
Henschke is one of Australia's oldest family-owned wineries, with a history spanning over 150 years. The family has been making wine since Johann Christian Henschke planted a small vineyard in 1862. The current custodians, fifth-generation winemaker Stephen Henschke and his viticulturist wife, Prue, continue a tradition of handcrafting exceptional wines. Their philosophy is deeply rooted in organic and biodynamic farming to ensure a healthy balance with the natural landscape and the faithful expression of their unique terroir. The 'Peggy's Hill' Riesling is named after a local landmark, a hill located at the top of the range between the villages of Eden Valley and Keyneton.

Wine Description

The Henschke Riesling 'Peggy's Hill' 2023 is made from 100% Riesling grapes sourced from a selection of longstanding Eden Valley growers. It displays a pale straw colour with green hues. The aromatic profile is fragrant and intense, with notes of frangipani, white rose, almond blossom, lime leaf, white musk, jasmine, and fresh herbs. The palate is pure and concentrated with flavours of lemon rind, lime, and white stone fruit. It is balanced by a fine, mineral acidity and possesses a laser-like focus and excellent length. The winemaking involves fermenting the juice in tanks and bottling post-vintage to preserve the delicate aromatic fruit characters. The optimal drinking window is immediately through to 2033.

Food Pairing

The wine is a fantastic match for white fish, seafood, and a classic Australian pairing of fresh yabby or prawns. It would also pair well with courgette, asparagus in butter sauce, and a cheese course featuring Emmental. This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Dragon Stout 284 ml - 24 Bottes
bodyHtml: Dark brown/black colour, with a distinctive, smoky, and malty nose. Rich, bitter and sweet flavours with leathery notes.

title: Sordo Langhe Bianco Rapuje 2021
bodyHtml:
This white wine is from Italy, specifically the Piedmont region and the subregion of Langhe. Azienda Agricola Giovanni Sordo is a family-run winery, now managed by Giorgio Sordo, the son of Giovanni, and represents the third generation of a family with over a century of winemaking tradition. Founded in 1912 by great-grandfather Giuseppe, the significant turning point came with Giovanni Sordo, who bought several elite Nebbiolo vineyards.

Wine Description

The Sordo Langhe Bianco 'Rapujè' 2021 is a Northern Italy white wine made from a blend of Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc, with some sources also including Viognier. The wine is said to have a delicate yet impressive depth on the nose, offering a full-bodied, harmonious, dry, complex, and beautifully balanced profile. It features a unique, rich, and long-lasting finish.

Food Pairing

An ideal choice for aperitifs, shining alongside light and refined dishes such as seafood starters, delicate risottos or pasta, shellfish, subtle fish courses, and white fish.

title: Domaine des Garriguettes Cotes du Rhone Le Beret Bleu 2024
bodyHtml:
Domaine des Garriguettes is a family-owned estate located near Avignon, and was the first winery in its village to embrace organic agriculture. The estate is committed to a traditional production philosophy that respects nature and the cycle of the seasons, with its grapes cultivated organically and biodynamically, certified by Demeter International Standards.

Wine Description

Le Beret Bleu is a delightful, delicate red wine made entirely from the Cinsault grape variety (100% Cinsault), which some call the 'Pinot of the South'. It presents a lovely, bright ruby colour and offers a fruit-forward, pleasant nose of small red fruits. On the palate, it is described as juicy and fresh, with notes of redcurrant and raspberry or violets and small red fruits. The wine is medium bodied with a moderate acidity level and a fine, elegant tannic structure.

title: Cusumano Chardonnay Jale 2023
bodyHtml:
The Cusumano winery was established in 2001 when brothers Alberto and Diego Cusumano took over from their father, Francesco. Cusumano's winemaking philosophy centres on highlighting the importance of 'terroir' knowledge, investing in innovative technologies, and nurturing a passion for winemaking.

Wine Description

In the glass, it shines in a light gold colour with a greenish tinge. The aroma is complex and fine, offering notes of ripe pear, white flowers, pineapple, and citrus zest, complemented by subtle notes of vanilla and roasted hazelnut kernel from the six months of oak barrel ageing. On the palate, the wine is full, structured, creamy, and precise, showcasing finesse rich fruit and a skilfully used wood influence.

Food Pairing

The wine's creamy texture, refreshing acidity, and rich flavour profile make it an excellent match for poached fish, risotto, vegetarian dishes, and dishes with buttery or creamy sauces.

title: Prodigo Nero D'Avola 2023
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from Italy and specifically comes from Sicilia (Sicily), under the subregion designation of Terre Siciliane IGT. The Prodigo line was created to celebrate the harmonious link between Italian food and wine, with 'Prodigo' meaning 'lavish, sumptuous, luxurious or grand'.

Wine Description

The wine has a ruby-red colour. On the nose (aroma), it offers a slightly spicy bouquet with notes of dried figs and ripe fruits like blackberry and boysenberry. The palate is medium-bodied and full-bodied with flavours of prune, mature black cherry, and a hint of star anise. The wine is balanced and complex, showcasing its richness alongside good structure. The finish is round, velvety, with a note of vanilla, and a lingering dry character from the tannins.

Food Pairing

This rich and structured red wine is an excellent match for various hearty meals. Suggested pairings include classic pasta dishes, rich pasta dishes, small goods, or dishes like red meats and aged cheeses.

title: Castello di Ama Chianti Classico 2022
bodyHtml:
The Castello di Ama Chianti Classico 2022 is a vibrant and generous red wine from the Chianti Classico region of Italy. The wine's forward personality and impeccable balance make it a fine choice for drinking.

Wine Description

This 'Ama' Chianti Classico, first produced in 2010, is made almost entirely from grapes from the estate's younger vineyards. It is composed of 96% Sangiovese and 4% Merlot. The wine presents a brilliant, deep ruby red colour. On the nose, it offers an enticing bouquet of red currant, cherry, violet, and strawberry aromas, with subtle hints of cinnamon and rose.

The palate is medium-bodied and harmonious, with flavours of ripe red fruit, chalky minerality, and a touch of white pepper. It is a fresh and floral wine with a core of bright acidity and silky, polished tannins that provide a chalky frame. The finish is crisp, tangy, and refreshing.

Accolades

  • 'James Suckling - 94 points'

  • 'Decanter - 91 points'

  • 'Vinous - 91 points'

Food Pairing

The Castello di Ama Chianti Classico 2022 is a food-friendly wine. It pairs well with vegetable-forward pasta dishes and grilled meats. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Tequila Cascahuin Destino Blanco
bodyHtml:
Destilería Cascahuín, which means 'Cerro de Luz' or 'Fiesta en el Cerro' in the pre-Hispanic language, has been producing tequila since 1904. The distillery is now helmed by Master Tequilero Salvador Rosales Torres, alongside his son Salvador 'Chava' Rosales, and is known for its commitment to traditional production methods.

Wine Description 

Bottled unfiltered, it is clear in colour and offers prominent aromas of fresh roasted agave, citrus zest, white pepper, and a subtle herbal earthiness. The palate is crisp and full bodied, showing notes of baked agave, green peppercorn, and honeyed lime, balanced by a touch of sea salt and smoky vegetal undertones.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include seafood tacos, ceviche (where the citrus notes of the dish complement the tequila's undertones), or light, fresh cheeses like goat cheese, feta, or queso blanco.

title: Giusti Pinot Nero Rosato Le Stanghe 2024
bodyHtml:
Giusti Wine, established by Ermenegildo Giusti in 2003, is rooted in a family history of winemaking in the Veneto region dating back to the 1600s. The winery's philosophy centres on a clear commitment to quality, while also maintaining a strong respect for the environment and the area's natural beauty and culture of hospitality.

Wine Description

The Giusti 'Le Stanghe' Pinot Nero Rosato 2024 presents a brilliant, rose petal colour. The nose offers clear aromas of fruit salad, featuring notes of peach, melon, apricot, and raspberry, all in perfect balance. Floral notes of lilac and violet emerge progressively, adding complexity. On the palate, this wine is harmonious and fresh, exhibiting excellent balance.

Food Pairing

Pairs beautifully with raw fish marinated in citrusy sauces, such as sea bass with orange zest and white pepper.

title: Massican Hyde Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from the United States, specifically the Napa Valley region of California. The grapes are sourced from the prestigious Hyde Vineyard in Carneros, which is nestled in the southern part of Napa Valley. Massican was established in the early 2000s as the Napa Valley’s first exclusively white wine winery. Winemaker Dan Petroski, who also spent nearly 15 years as winemaker for Napa's Larkmead, launched Massican as an ode to the Mediterranean and his time spent in Italy. Hyde Vineyard is one of California’s most famous and historic Chardonnay sites, founded by Larry Hyde in 1979.

Wine Description

  • On the nose, the wine typically presents alluring aromas of citrus zest, honey, and delicate spice. Other aromatic notes can include pineapple, lychee, gardenia, lemon curd, and white tea.

  • The wine is made from 100% Chardonnay, specifically using the Musqué clone of Chardonnay. It is often described as medium-bodied to medium-plus bodied, showcasing a sleek, crisp, and linear style.

  • The palate is vibrant and layered, offering flavours such as crunchy green apple, lemon cream, Meyer lemon, nectarine, and mango. A distinct sea salt minerality and lively acidity are hallmarks of this wine.

  • The finish is typically crisp and lingering, carrying a filigreed minerality.


    Food Pairing 

  • This Chardonnay's full-bodied texture and citrus notes make it an excellent match for rich seafood dishes, such as olive oil poached swordfish or Venetian Bay scallops.

    • Its rich and complex profile also pairs perfectly with the luxurious flavours of white truffle risotto. Suggested pairings also include roast white meats, meaty fish, and dishes with white sauces.

    • Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Peddlers Barrel Aged Gin
bodyHtml:
Peddlers Barrel Aged Gin originates from China, specifically born in Shanghai. The brand was founded by three friends, inspired by the hustle and bustle of Shanghai's diverse community and the desire to showcase the creativity and innovation they had experienced in China. Peddlers Gin is proud to represent Chinese and Asian spirits globally, using a blend of ingredients from the West and the Far East.

Description

The nose presents a cinnamon spice undercurrent and faint notes of zesty lime. On the palate, the French oak contributes mellow cherry stone fruit and vanilla. Caramel notes from the pinot noir grapes come through and blend with the floral pepper flavours. The spirit is noted for having a richer sweetness, with an almost chewy body. The finish is an enjoyable piquant pepperiness that becomes dry, combining with deeper flavours of angelica and liquorice.

title: Black Tot Historic Solera Rum
bodyHtml:
The Black Tot Historic Solera Rum is a premium Caribbean rum, a blend of rums from Guyana, Barbados, and Jamaica. The Black Tot brand, owned by Elixir Distillers, is a tribute to the long tradition of naval perpetual blending and takes its name from Black Tot Day (July 31, 1970), the day the Royal Navy ended the daily rum ration for its sailors. Black Tot honours this history by crafting nuanced and complex rum blends that feature total transparency on their composition and provenance.

Rum Description

  • Colour: Copper amber or dark amber with brown highlights.

  • Aroma: The nose is a decadent blend of figs, plums, chocolate, and fudge, with warming spices emerging. Other notes include rum and raisin fudge, chocolate covered cappuccino, dried cranberries, redcurrants, toasted cinnamon sticks, and sultanas.

  • Palate: The palate offers rich, velvety textures with flavours of dark chocolate, a subtle coffee undertone, nuts, and ripe figs. Notes of pink grapefruit, lemon oil, sultanas, plums, and baked banana build alongside the sweetness complemented by espresso. The body is rich and full-bodied.

  • Finish: A satisfyingly dry and long finish with lingering spice and dried fruit notes. Hints of citrus zest brighten the experience alongside ripe tropical fruit notes and lingering spice and dried fruit.

  • Varietal Composition: The rum is distilled from molasses. The blend consists of rums from Guyana, Barbados, and Jamaica. The composition is 40% Guyanese rum (3–5 years, pot/column still), 35% Barbadian rum (5 years, pot still), 20% unaged Guyanese rum (pot/column still), and 5% Jamaican rum (3 years, high ester profile). It is aged in ex-bourbon and ex-sherry oak casks (Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso) and then matured through a three tier solera system.

  • Stylistic Notes: This is a rich, decadent, and complex rum. The traditional three-tier Solera process of blending rums of various ages results in remarkable depth and character, with an unadulterated taste.

Food Pairing

The rich, decadent, and spicy character of Black Tot Historic Solera pairs exceptionally well with rich and flavourful foods.

  • Cured Meats: The saltiness and texture of cured meats provide a contrast to the rum's sweetness and rich fruit notes.

  • Aged Cheeses: The depth and savoury complexity of aged cheeses complement the dark fruit, chocolate, and spice notes of the rum.

  • Dark Chocolate: The natural pairing of rum with dark chocolate highlights the spirit's dominant flavours of chocolate, coffee, figs, and plums.

This pairing highlights the spirit's depth and character.

title: Tolaini Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'Montebello Sette' 2021
bodyHtml:
The Tolaini estate was established by Pierluigi Tolaini, a Tuscan native who emigrated to Canada in 1956. After a successful career in transportation and logistics in North America, he returned to his homeland in 1998 to pursue his dream of making great wine, acquiring the Montebello and San Giovanni estates. Tolaini’s philosophy is based on the fundamental principal that 'the best fruit produces the best wine'.

Wine Description

The wine exhibits a dark, bright ruby colour. The nose is vibrant and complex, offering aromas of ripe cherry, blood orange, and violet, layered with notes of tobacco, leather, and Tuscan herbs. On the palate, it is full-bodied, robust, and dense, continuing with a dark berry profile and accents of bay leaf and mint. It is a complex wine with incontestable structure, supported by compact yet sweet, firm, and dusty tannins.

Accolades

  • Decanter - '95 points'

  • James Suckling - '93 points'

  • Vinous - '93 points'

Food Pairing

This full-bodied Chianti Classico Gran Selezione pairs beautifully with roasted meats, aged cheeses, and hearty pasta dishes.

title: Mas De Daumas Gassac White 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine has a lovely deep, clear gold colour.

  • Aroma: The nose opens intensely floral, gradually evolving into delicate notes of yellow-fleshed fruits. Notes of acacia, honeysuckle, lychee, and melon have also been noted.

  • Palate: The palate offers a very energetic balance with a frank and rather lively attack, softened by beautiful notes of ripe fruit, citrus, and fresh almond. Notes of peach, green melon, pineapple, and green apple are also present. The blend is described as layered, focused, and textural.

  • Body and Finish: It has a round finish that plays on decadent notes, all supported by a delicate grain of tannin and bitters. It is characterized as a White - Tropical and Balanced style.

  • Varietal Composition: The blend consists of 39% Viognier, 27% Chardonnay, 13% Petit Manseng (or Manseng), 10% Chenin Blanc, 7% Muscat, and 4% Sauvignon Blanc. It also contains 11% rare varieties, including Marsanne, Roussanne, Petit Courbu, Muscat Petit grain, Muscat d'Alexandrie, Gros Manseng, Sémillon (France), and Fiano (Italy). The varietals listed by the winery total more than 100% (with 11% rare varieties).

  • Optimal Drinking Window: The wine can be enjoyed young to appreciate its magnificent minerality and complex fruit aromas, or it may be cellared for four to twelve years to reveal a richer character with notes of honey and crystallized fruits.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 91 points.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include oysters, foie gras, grilled fish, or goats' cheese and feta. The wine is also delicious on its own as an aperitif. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Erdinger Alkoholfrei (Non Alcoholic) 500 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Erdinger Alkoholfrei is a non alcoholic wheat beer produced in the town of Erding, Germany. The brewery was established in 1886 by Johann Kienle and was later acquired in 1935 by Franz Brombach, who gave the company its current name in 1949. Ownership was subsequently passed to his son, Werner Brombach, who recently transferred his shares to a non profit family foundation to ensure the brewery remains independent.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic brew presents a hazy, straw yellow appearance topped with a fine, tall white froth. The aromatic profile features spicy malt notes and subtle hops, layered with delicate hints of brioche, banana, and clove. On the palate, it offers a rich malt flavour with caramel sweet nuances and a stimulating bitterness from aroma hops. The body is medium and velvety with creamy carbonation, leading to a clean, fresh finish with a hint of light, fruity acidity. It contains less than 0.5% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The malty character and effervescence of this wheat beer make it a versatile companion for various dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with freshly baked, soft pretzels, as the toasted malt notes highlight the salty crust. For a more substantial meal, it complements boiled mussels or light starters like fried fish. The beer also acts as a refreshing palate cleanser for richer fare, such as grain salads or roasted vegetable dishes.

Distinctive Features

Erdinger Alkoholfrei is distinguished as an isotonic beverage, making it a popular choice for sports recovery due to its ability to help the body regenerate after physical exertion. It contains essential vitamins B9 (folic acid) and B12, which support the immune system and energy metabolism, along with natural polyphenols. Brewed according to the Bavarian Purity Law using only water, wheat malt, barley malt, hops, and yeast, it is also low in calories, containing only 25 kcal per 100 ml.

Serving Suggestions

To enjoy the full sensory experience, this beer should be served well chilled in a tall weissbier glass. A traditional technique involves pouring most of the beer into the glass before swirling the final portion in the bottle to release the settled yeast, then topping it off to create a classic cloudy finish. It is a refreshing alternative for social gatherings, sporty occasions, or as a lively way to quench thirst without the effects of alcohol.

title: St. Hallet Blackwell Shiraz 2019
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Australia, specifically the Barossa Valley in South Australia, a region synonymous with premium Shiraz. St Hallett was established in 1944 by the Lindner Family, who were Silesian pioneers in the Barossa. The winery's philosophy is centred on a deep understanding of the diverse Barossa vineyards, with a particular focus on preserving old vines and championing Shiraz. The Blackwell Shiraz is a tribute to long-serving winemaker Stuart Blackwell, who contributed to the estate for over three decades

The St Hallett Blackwell Shiraz 2019 is a full-bodied red wine. Its varietal composition is predominantly Shiraz, sometimes blended with small amounts of Semillon and Tempranillo. It displays a rich, deep crimson red color with vibrant hues. The aroma offers complex layers of blackberry, fine cocoa, and hints of baking spices. On the palate, it is opulent and elegant, with flavours of blackberry, black forest fruit, and waves of cocoa and baking spice. It has supple, polished tannins and a luscious, succulent texture, sometimes likened to 'Thai silk'. The wine is brilliantly structured, balanced, and is considered a classic Barossa Shiraz style. It was matured in American oak barrels for 12–16 months. The optimal drinking window is extended, with cellar potential suggested up to 2039.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 92 points
  • 'Robert Parker’s Wine Advocate' - 92 points
  • 'Wine Spectator' - 91 points

Food Pairing As a powerful, full-bodied red, the Blackwell Shiraz pairs beautifully with equally rich and hearty dishes. Suggested pairings include chargrilled steak, slow-braised beef cheeks, or roasted lamb shoulder with rosemary and garlic. Its dark fruit and cocoa notes also complement smoky barbecue ribs and pepper-crusted meats. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Castello Di Ama Chianti Classico 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This classic red wine originates from Italy, specifically the Tuscany region, within the Chianti Classico subregion, in the municipality of Gaiole in Chianti. Castello di Ama was founded in 1976 by four families from Rome who sought to restore a prestigious estate. Winemaker and General Manager Marco Pallanti, along with co-owner Lorenza Sebasti, leads the estate with a focus on expressing the uniqueness of the terroir and a commitment to sustainable viticulture. This particular bottling, 'Ama', was first introduced in the 2010 vintage to highlight the characteristics of the estate's younger, more productive vines.

Wine Description

It is a quintessential Chianti Classico with a deep ruby red colour. The aromatic profile is notably fresh and floral, offering scents of black cherry, red plum, red rose, and cinnamon. Other notes include orange undertones and the elegance of red currant, cherry, and violet aromas.

On the palate, it is medium-bodied and refined. The flavour profile features juicy red fruit, cherry pits, and mineral accents. It is structured with silky tannins and characterized by vibrant, peppy acidity, leading to a tangy and crisp finish. This wine offers a forward personality and impeccable balance, making it a fine choice for drinking now and over the next decade or so.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling – 94 points."

  • "Decanter – 91 points."

  • "Vinous – 91 points."

Food Pairing

This poised, food-friendly Chianti Classico, with its polished tannins and crisp acidity, is highly versatile. It is well-matched to medium old cheese, mild game dishes, and dark poultry. It is also a perfect accompaniment for pizza, pasta, and casseroles, such as a classic pasta al ragù. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Clarendelle Medoc 2019
bodyHtml:
Clarendelle is the premium brand wine of Clarence Dillon Wines, established in 2005 by Prince Robert of Luxembourg, the great-grandson of Clarence Dillon who purchased Château Haut-Brion in 1935. The brand’s mission is to continue the legacy of perfection left by Clarence Dillon. Clarendelle benefits from the blending expertise and know-how of the First Growth winemaking team at Domaine Clarence Dillon.

Wine Description

The Clarendelle Médoc is a Bordeaux Médoc style red blend. Ruby in colour with a well-rounded palate, exhibiting notes of cassis, cherries, and earth, with firm tannins.

Food Pairing

Pair with grilled steak or full-flavoured cheeses like sharp cheddar or comté.

title: Prestige Bordeaux Collection Case 2022 (by Duclot Group) - 9 Bottles
bodyHtml:
This collection is a showcase of nine of the most celebrated wines from the Bordeaux region of France. It is curated and exclusively distributed by Duclot, a historic and highly-respected Bordeaux négociant (wine merchant) established in 1886. The Duclot Group's philosophy centres on a deep understanding of the Bordeaux wine region and maintaining direct relationships with top châteaux. The 'Caisse Duclot Collection' is a signature, limited-edition offering, featuring a premium selection of some of the most prestigious wines of Bordeaux from a single vintage.

The nine bottles in the 2022 case typically include one bottle of each of the following iconic estates, covering a range of prestigious appellations:

  • Château Mouton Rothschild, Pauillac

  • Château Lafite Rothschild, Pauillac

  • Château Margaux, Margaux

  • Château Haut-Brion, Pessac-Léognan

  • Château La Mission Haut-Brion, Pessac-Léognan

  • Château Pétrus, Pomerol

  • Château Cheval Blanc, Saint-Émilion

  • Château Ausone, Saint-Émilion

  • Château d'Yquem, Sauternes (Sweet Wine)

title: Dillon's Vodka Cocktail Variety Pack 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml: Each refreshingly real cocktail starts with the award-winning, handcrafted Dillon's Vodka, complimented by refreshing flavours and a big splash of soda. Flavours included in the Variety Pack; Blueberry, Peach & a Twist of Lemon; Raspberry, Lemon & a Hint of Lavender and Apricot & a Touch of Ginger.

title: Sordo Giovanni Barolo 2020
bodyHtml:
The Sordo Giovanni winery, a family-run estate, was founded in 1912 by Giuseppe Sordo in the municipality of Castiglione Falletto. The turning point came with Giovanni Sordo, who along with his wife Maria, acquired several elite Nebbiolo vineyards. Today, the fourth generation, led by Giorgio Sordo and his daughter Paola, continues the family tradition. Their philosophy is completely traditional, involving long submerged-cap macerations and aging exclusively in large Slavonian oak barrels to preserve the sincere varietal character of Nebbiolo.

The Sordo Barolo 2020 is a monovarietal wine made from 100% Nebbiolo grapes. It exhibits a red garnet colour with orangey nuances that will become more accentuated over time. The aroma is described as delicate, ethereal, intense, pervasive, and lingering, with notes of red berries, dried rose, and hints of fresh red fruit and sweet spices.

The flavour is warm, full, complex, dry, and harmonious. The palate is lifted and fresh, with an austerity balanced by the presence of sweet and complex tannins. The wine shows fine-grained tannins and perfectly balanced acidity, providing an elegant structure. This is a very long-lived wine with great evolutionary potential. 

Food Pairing

Barolo's structured nature and savoury elegance pair exceptionally well with rich and complex dishes. Suggested pairings include:

  • Roasts.

  • All game dishes.

  • Lasagne and other meat-based main courses.

  • Lamb dishes.

  • Parmesan Cheese course.

A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Frasca La Guaragna Barbera D'Asti 2020
bodyHtml:
The Frasca 'La Guaragna' Barbera D'Asti 2020 is made from 100% Barbera grapes from vines averaging 20 years old. The wine exhibits a vibrant ruby red colour, often with purple highlights.

The aroma is fragrant with ripe cherries, crushed plums, wild blueberries, and perfumed mulberries, accompanied by hints of violet and spice. The palate is juicy and vibrant, offering a medium-bodied texture. It is characterized by brisk, tart acidity and flavours of red berries, sour cherries, and a touch of black pepper. The tannins are soft and finely sticky, framing a stony core. The wine is known for its fruity and approachable profile. Vinification involves soft pressing, long macerations, and aging exclusively in stainless steel tanks to preserve the natural freshness and fruitiness. The finish is smooth and persistent, with lingering fruity notes and a pleasant hint of spice.

title: Esquimalt Rosso Vermouth - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml:
Founded by Michela and Quinn Palmer, Esquimalt Vermouth is distinguished as the first non-European producer in history to win World's Best Vermouth titles. Their winemaking philosophy blends traditional Italian Rosso Vermouth techniques—drawing on formulas from long-forgotten 19th-century houses—with a modern, empirical approach. This unique methodology involves separately extracting the flavours from thirty-two different botanicals before blending them into a continuously aged Solera system, ensuring precision and consistency in every bottle.

  • Colour: A rich, deep red or Rosso hue, consistent with traditional Italian sweet vermouth.

  • Aroma: The nose is lovely, aromatic, and savoury, hinting at the complex botanical blend. Additional notes of plums, figs, and oranges are present, layered over dark spice and brown sugar.

  • Palate: The mouthfeel is notably very wine forward, indicating a strong character from its base of fortified blueberry-blossom mead. The judges noted it as 'very ripe and delish', balanced by a pleasant herbalness and spicy accents of white pepper, cloves, and star anise.

  • Body & Finish: Possesses a creamy, rich texture and a complex, lingering finish that features nuances of rosemary, cinnamon, and cola, which roll smoothly into the next sip.

title: Blasted Church 'Nectar of the Gods' 2023
bodyHtml:
Blasted Church is a small, family-run winery that aims to achieve greatness by focusing on the pursuit of quality, utilising the best grapes and best oak barrels. The 'Nectar of the Gods' project is the result of this philosophy, intended to be a true expression of the season unencumbered by the status quo.

The 'Nectar of the Gods' is a traditional Bordeaux Blend, featuring Cabernet Sauvignon from the estate, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot. It pours a deep ruby colour. The aromatic profile is complex, with notes of ripe plum, bramble berries, cured meat, leather, and cassis. The palate begins with a fresh yet rich attack of bramble berries, chocolate, and plum. A structure of fine-grained tannin builds through the mid-palate, carrying the texture into the balanced finish. Stylistically, the wine exhibits a beautiful balance between freshness and a ripe fruit profile, with great structure. Given the exceptional quality of the vintage, this wine is expected to have outstanding ageing potential.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for this bold, structured red blend include prime rib, roasted lamb, and mushroom dishes. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Guinness Draught 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Rich and creamy. Distinctively black. Velvety in its finish. This iconic beer is defined by harmony. Sip after sip, sweet counters bitter as the malt arrives on cue to complement a base of roasted barley. Just as the unmistakable white head sits flush atop the dark beer, so do the flavours counter and combine perfectly. This is our greatest innovation. Truly unique. Perfectly balanced. 

Developed in 1959, this beer was our brewers’ celebration of Arthur Guinness signing his 9,000-year lease – a fitting way to mark 200 years groundbreaking brewing. With a skilful pairing of nitrogen gas and carbon dioxide, the smooth, velvety texture was born. Distinguished by its legendary stormy surge upon pouring, Guinness Draught brewed up a storm all of its own. It established itself as the top-selling Guinness beer with lightning speed. Drinkers were instantly drawn to its complexity; its bold combination of flavours made a lasting impression. Guinness Draught was an unparalleled success.

title: Tierra Sagrada Anejo Tequila (made by Adictivo Tequilas)
bodyHtml:
Tierra Sagrada Añejo Tequila is a premium spirit from Mexico, specifically produced in the heart of Jalisco, the recognized birthplace of tequila. The brand name translates to 'Sacred Earth', reflecting a profound reverence for the land and the ancient art of agave cultivation. It is produced at Destiladora del Valle de Tequila (NOM 1477), having previously been associated with NOM 1560 and NOM 1653, and is crafted under the stewardship of Tequilas Gonzalez Lara, S.A. de C.V..

Spirit Description

This añejo is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave and undergoes a patient maturation process to achieve its refined character. It is aged for a minimum of 12 months, with some special editions matured for up to two years in French oak barrels.

  • Colour: The spirit displays intense golden amber or deep amber tones with luminous golden highlights.

  • Aroma: The nose is marked by an intense woody and toasted aroma, featuring notes of roasted agave, caramel, vanilla, and dried fruits with subtle hints of spice.

  • Palate: It offers a silky and full-bodied texture with a harmonious blend of honey, dark chocolate, and warm spice. Subtle notes of fruit are balanced by the underlying sweetness of cooked agave.

  • Body: The tequila is described as exceptionally smooth and sophisticated, leaning toward the sweeter side of the flavor spectrum.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, lingering, and smooth finish that highlights oak and sweet agave.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at 40%.

Accolades

Tierra Sagrada is highly regarded by consumers for its quality and artistic presentation.

  • Collector Standing: The brand is frequently noted for its unique and beautiful bottle designs, which some users have compared to elegant perfume bottles.

  • Consumer Ratings: It is a highly-rated sipping tequila, with many aficionados comparing its smooth, sweet profile favorably to well-known brands like Clase Azul or Don Julio 1942.

  • Competition Success: The spirit has been noted for winning awards at spirit competitions, which further solidifies its reputation as a well-balanced and meticulously crafted añejo.

Food Pairing

The deep notes of aged wood and caramel in this añejo make it a versatile companion for both hearty main courses and decadent desserts.

  • Savoury: It pairs harmoniously with rich, bold meals such as grilled steak, lamb chops, or barbecued ribs. It also stands up well to traditional Mexican dishes with significant heat, such as mole or slow-cooked carnitas.
