  • Cheese: The rich profile enhances the flavors of well-aged cheeses, including sharp Gruyère or creamy Camembert.

  • Sweet: It is an ideal match for dark chocolate truffles, caramel cakes, vanilla custards, or a decadent crème brûlée.

  • Serving: To fully appreciate its complexity, it is best enjoyed neat at room temperature or on the rocks.

title: Bottega Gold Rose Brut - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Colour and Appearance - Brilliant, subtle pink colour, fine and persistent perlage.

Bouquet - Intense, elegant, complex, characterized by floral and fruity notes, mainly mixed berries, currants and wild strawberries.

Taste - Fresh, delicate, soft, structured, with balanced acidity and a pleasant and persistent aftertaste.

title: Bottega Gold Brut - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Colour and Appearance - Brilliant, subtle pink colour, fine and persistent perlage.

Bouquet - Intense, elegant, complex, characterized by floral and fruity notes, mainly mixed berries, currants and wild strawberries.

Taste - Fresh, delicate, soft, structured, with balanced acidity and a pleasant and persistent aftertaste.

title: Clarendelle Amberwine 2021 - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Clarendelle Amberwine is a dessert wine from the Monbazillac region of Southwest France. The brand was created by Prince Robert of Luxembourg, who is the owner and CEO of Clarence Dillon Wines. The name 'Clarendelle' is a combination of "Clarence" and "Dillon," honouring Prince Robert's great-grandfather, Clarence Dillon. The Clarendelle wines, inspired by the style of Château Haut-Brion, aim to be affordable yet display complexity, elegance, and balance.

Wine Description

Clarendelle Amberwine has a golden-yellow colour, which deepens to a magnificent "amber" as it ages. The wine is a blend of Sémillon and Muscadelle grapes. On the nose, it is very expressive with aromas of candied fruit and citron. Notes of ripe mango, peach slices, honey, orange marmalade, dried apricots, and beeswax are also present. On the palate, the wine is rich and luscious. It is full-bodied and soft, with a fine balance between sugar and acidity. It features flavours of honey, white peach, and apricot, and has a lively, long finish. The wine's character and structure are a result of a combination of late harvest and botrytis cinerea (noble rot) grape maturation.

title: Guinness Zero 440 ml (Non Alcohol) - 4 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Guinness Zero, also known as Guinness 0.0, is a non alcoholic stout originating from St James's Gate in Dublin, Ireland. The Guinness brewery has a storied history dating back to 1759, when it was founded by Arthur Guinness, and today it is part of the global Diageo portfolio.

Description

This alcohol free stout features the same dark ruby red liquid and creamy white head as the original draught. The aroma is sweet and malty with distinct hints of roasted coffee and dark chocolate. On the palate, it delivers a beautifully smooth and balanced flavour profile that combines bitter, sweet, and roasted notes. The body is velvety and creamy, thanks to the use of nitrogen, leading to a characteristically dry finish that is unmistakably Guinness. It typically contains less than 0.5% alcohol by volume, often measured as 0.05% depending on local regional regulations.

Food Pairing

The deep, roasted character of this stout makes it an excellent companion for hearty and savoury dishes. It pairs traditionally with Irish fare such as lamb or beef stew, and mashed potato croquettes served with a rich cheese sauce. For a more modern pairing, it complements grilled burgers, barbecue ribs, and fried chicken. It also serves as a sophisticated match for desserts, particularly an apple and pear tart or a rich chocolate cake.

Distinctive Features

Guinness Zero is distinguished by a four year development process intended to ensure it perfectly replicates the taste of Guinness Draught. To achieve this, the brewers start by brewing the beer with the same natural ingredients—water, barley, hops, and yeast—before removing the alcohol using a specialized cold filtration method. This process protects the integrity of the beer by avoiding thermal stress. Additionally, the product is vegan friendly and contains only 17 calories per 100ml, making it a low calorie alternative.

Serving Suggestions

To achieve the perfect pour, the beer should be chilled and poured into a glass at a 45 degree angle until it is three quarters full, allowing the surge to settle before filling it to the top. In cans, a nitrogen widget is included to recreate the iconic creamy head and smooth texture of the draught version. It is best served in a standard pint glass to appreciate the visual surge and settle. Beyond drinking, it can also be used as a flavorful ingredient in cooking, such as in marinades or as a base for a stout beer cheese fondue.

title: Chateau Lafon Rochet 2018
bodyHtml:
Château Lafon-Rochet 2018 is a well-regarded red wine from the Saint-Estèphe appellation in Bordeaux, France. It is a 4th Growth Estate from the 1855 Classification.

Wine Description The 2018 vintage is noted for being 'richer and bolder' than usual, with a full-bodied profile and a firm structure. The blend for the 2018 vintage is typically around 64% Cabernet Sauvignon, 26% Merlot, 6% Petit Verdot, and 4% Cabernet Franc, though some sources list slightly different proportions. The wine is aged in a percentage of new French oak barrels. Common tasting notes include ripe black and blue fruits, with a 'crunchy' or 'juicy' quality. Secondary notes of dark chocolate, licorice, forest floor, lead pencil, tar, and earthy or mineral undertones are also frequently mentioned. Some reviewers find hints of spice, wild mint, or smoky, grilled cedar on the nose. The wine has firm, ripe, and often chewy tannins, a round and mouth-filling texture, and good acidity that provides a 'freshness' to the finish. It typically has a long, flavorful, and clean finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 95 points, Editors' Choice.

  • James Suckling - 94 points.

  • Decanter - 94 points.

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 94 points.

  • Neal Martin (Vinous) - 93 points.

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 91 points.

Food Pairing This wine would pair well with grilled meats and strong cheeses. Its full-bodied and firm structure would stand up to a rich steak or lamb dish, and its notes of black fruit would complement the savory flavours.

Vintage Quality The 2018 vintage in Bordeaux was a challenging but ultimately successful one, with the ability to be flexible with vineyard treatments proving important.

title: Giffard Grenadine Syrup (Non Alcoholic) - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Giffard Grenadine Syrup is a non alcoholic product originating from Angers in the Loire Valley, France. The house of Giffard was established in 1885 by Emile Giffard, a pharmacist who transitioned into distilling after creating a highly successful mint liqueur. Five generations later, the company remains family owned and is recognized globally for its high standards of quality in the cocktail and bar industry.

Spirit Description

This syrup presents an intense and brilliant red colour. The aromatic profile is powerful and gourmet, featuring the scents of red fruits such as currants, blackberries, and strawberries, balanced by a delicate hint of vanilla pod. On the palate, it offers an 'explosion' of red fruit flavours including raspberries and blackcurrants, accompanied by a touch of acidity for balance. The body is smooth and rich, leading to a soft finish where the roundness of vanilla adds a delicate, sweet note. This product contains 0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The sweet and tart fruit profile of this syrup makes it a versatile ingredient for both sweet and savoury culinary applications. It can be used as a glaze for meats such as duck, chicken, lamb, or pork, and serves as an effective substitute for honey or sugar in savoury sauces. In desserts, it is ideal as a topping for cheesecake, custard, or ice cream, and can be incorporated into granitas or sorbets. It also functions as a colourful and flavourful syrup for pancakes or parfaits.

Distinctive Features

Giffard Grenadine Syrup is distinguished by its use of 100% pure sugar from French beets and concentrated red fruit and lemon juices. It is crafted with at least 13% minimum red fruit juice equivalent and contains no preservatives. The syrup is pasteurized to ensure perfect preservation of its aromatic intensity and natural flavour. While many modern grenadines are solely pomegranate based, this traditional French recipe utilizes a blend of red fruits to achieve its signature complexity.

Serving Suggestions

A staple for any bar, this syrup is essential for creating the ombre effect in a 'Tequila Sunrise' or adding fruitiness to a 'Singapore Sling'. For non alcoholic options, it is the primary ingredient in classics such as the 'Shirley Temple' (mixed with ginger ale and lime) and the 'Roy Rogers' (mixed with cola). It can also be enjoyed as a simple refreshing cordial by diluting it with still or sparkling water over crushed ice.

title: Tom Gore Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
A well-priced, medium-bodied Chardonnay, easy to enjoy chilled on its own or paired with roast turkey or chicken.

Bright on the palate with ripe apple, stone fruit, dried pineapple, dulce de leche flavours finishing smooth and creamy.

title: Villa Calcinaia Chianti Classico 2022
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Chianti Classico, near the village of Greve-in-Chianti, this wine hails from the Tuscan estate of Villa Calcinaia. The estate has been owned by the Capponi family since 1524. The winery's philosophy is to craft wines that are balanced, elegant, and refreshing, with a savouriness and intensity that ensures their longevity.

Wine Description

The Villa Calcinaia Chianti Classico 2019 has a ruby red colour with garnet shading. It is made from a blend of 90% Sangiovese and 10% Canaiolo grapes, which are certified organic and handpicked. On the nose, it is very aromatic and savory, with notes of bright red fruit, roses, violets, and dried leaves. You may also find notes of cherry, ripe fruit, redcurrant, fresh herbs, and a 'meaty/charcuterie' character. On the palate, the wine is supple and dry, with a medium body and a well-balanced structure. It features round fruit flavours, refreshing acidity, and well-integrated tannins.

Food Pairing

This wine is ideal with grilled meats, poultry, cured meats, and aged cheeses. It also pairs well with roasts, tomato-based dishes, and is an excellent match for pizza, including Pizza Margherita. The pairing of this wine with rich meat dishes highlights its well-balanced structure and persistent finish.

title: Aime Roquesante Cotes de Provence Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
The brand is associated with Les Maîtres Vignerons de Saint-Tropez, a producer that reinforces its commitment to showcasing the diverse microclimates of the Saint-Tropez area. The winemaking philosophy blends tradition with a focus on purity, aiming to deliver a genuine taste of Provence.

Wine Description

The wine presents an appealing pale rosé colour. On the nose, it offers aromas of sweet berries, red fruits, and a hint of cut grass. The blend typically consists of Cinsault, Grenache, and Syrah. On the palate, the wine is full and powerful, offering lots of freshness and excellent balance. Notes of lovely watermelon and grapefruit contribute to a delicious and refreshing finish.

Food Pairing

This rosé is particularly good as an aperitif and was made for sharing. Suggested food pairings include Provençal tapas-style foods, such as a platter of cold meats and mini-toasts with olive tapenade

title: Moulin du Chateau La Lagune 2019
bodyHtml:
This wine is a second wine of the esteemed Château La Lagune, originating from France, in the Bordeaux region's Haut-Médoc appellation. Château La Lagune, one of the oldest estates in the Médoc, with origins dating back to 1587, is known for its magnificent Chartreuse built between 1730 and 1855. The winery, a Third Growth Grand Cru Classé, is now run by Caroline Frey, who champions environmentally friendly viticulture, with the vineyard certified organic in 2016 and biodynamic in 2022.

Wine Description

The Moulin du Chateau La Lagune 2019 is a red Bordeaux blend that typically favours Merlot, contributing to its early approachability. It presents a beautiful, clear ruby colour. The nose is intense, combining fragrances of red and black fruits, like cassis, black cherry, and blackberry, with hints of violet and cedarwood. On the palate, the wine is elegant, fresh, and medium-bodied with smooth, well-integrated, round tannins. Flavours echo the aromas, showing fresh blue and black fruits, black pepper, and mint, leading to an elegant, persistent, and refreshing finish.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 92 points

  • Decanter – 92 points

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include grilled or roasted meats, such as beef or leg of lamb. The rich fruit and fine structure of the wine also complement dark chocolate notes.

title: Antigal Uno Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Antigal Winery & Estates is established on the site of a historic winery in Russell, Maipú, Mendoza, with origins dating back to 1897. The winery underwent a complete remodelling to combine a historically important landmark with state-of-the-art, high-tech functionality. Their winemaking philosophy is driven by the pursuit of excellence, aiming to create well-balanced, quality wines that express the essence of the Mendoza terroir.

Wine Description

Golden yellow with slight greenish tones. It dazzles on the nose with great aromatic complexity, presenting tropical fruit notes such as white peach, apricot, and pineapple, complemented by fine notes of vanilla.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings tailored to the wine’s flavour profile include grilled fish, pasta with cream-based sauces, and caramelised vegetables.

title: Antigal Uno Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
Antigal Winery & Estates was established on the site of a historic winery in Maipú, Mendoza, first built in 1897. After being completely refurbished starting in 2000, Antigal was founded with a focus on producing high-quality wines, moving away from bulk production. The winery employs a gravity-fed system in its winemaking process, a gentle technique that helps protect the natural acidity of the fruit.

Wine Description

On the nose, it offers plum, strawberry, and blackberry aromas with hints of violets, vanilla, and milk chocolate. The palate is described as juicy and soft, with mouth-filling black and red fruit flavours, along with notes of cedar, chocolate, and vanilla spice. It has a silky texture, soft tannins, and a style marked by freshness and good balance, leading to an agreeably persistent finish.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings tailored to its structure and fruit profile include roasted leg of lamb, steak, and extra aged cheeses.

title: Bodegas Lan Edicion Limitada 2021
bodyHtml:
The 2019 Edición Limitada from Bodegas LAN is a distinguished red wine from Spain's renowned Rioja region. This limited edition blend comprises 82% Tempranillo, 10% Mazuelo, and 8% Graciano, sourced from 35 to 40-year-old vines in the Viña Lanciano estate. The wine undergoes meticulous vinification, including malolactic fermentation in new French oak barrels, followed by aging for 8 months in new French oak barriques and an additional 7 months in new Russian oak barrels.

Colour: Ripe cherry red, deeply colored and bright. 

Aroma: Intense aromas of ripe, almost candied black fruit such as plum, blackberry, and blackcurrant, complemented by notes of cocoa, toffee, black tobacco, spices, and a mineral streak characteristic of the Viña Lanciano estate.

Palate: Warm and velvety, with a round, ripe profile. The wine exhibits a very tannic yet elegant structure, offering flavors that mirror its aromatic profile. 

Body: Full-bodied with a robust and harmonious structure, showcasing both power and finesse.

Finish: Long and harmonious, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors. 

Accolades: 

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This wine exemplifies Bodegas LAN's commitment to quality and innovation, offering a modern expression of Rioja's rich winemaking heritage.

title: Heineken - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Heineken Lager Beer is a global powerhouse and the definitive face of the International Pale Lager. Founded in 1864 by Gerard Adriaan Heineken in Amsterdam, it became the first premium Dutch lager to conquer the world stage. Recognized by its iconic green bottle and red star, it is designed to be a consistent, high-quality "world beer" that tastes the same whether you are in a bar in Amsterdam, a stadium in London, or a patio in Calgary. It is a beer that prioritizes crispness and a specific "skunky" hop character that has become its global signature.

Beer Description

Heineken pours a bright, crystal-clear straw gold with a lively, effervescent carbonation and a frothy white head that maintains decent persistence.

Aroma: The nose is distinct and instantly recognizable. It leads with a slightly skunky, herbal hop aroma, followed by a clean, sweet scent of pale malt and corn-like grain. Because it is famously bottled in green glass, the light-strike provides a "dank" herbal quality that fans of the brand have come to expect as part of its profile.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and highly refreshing. It leads with a crisp grainy sweetness and notes of cracker, which is quickly followed by a moderate, grassy bitterness. The mouthfeel is "zippy" due to high carbonation, and the finish is exceptionally clean and dry with a lingering herbal snap.

Profile: It sits at a standard 5.0% ABV and a balanced bitterness of approx. 19–23 IBU, providing more "bite" than many American-style light lagers.

Technical Notes: The heart of Heineken’s flavor is their proprietary "A-Yeast." Developed in the 19th century, this specific strain provides the subtle fruity notes and the crisp, clean finish that distinguishes it from other mass-market lagers. It is brewed with 100% natural ingredients—barley malt, water, hops, and yeast—and is fermented in horizontal tanks to provide the yeast with the ideal pressure to develop its signature flavor profile.

title: Andres Baby Canadian Sparkling
bodyHtml: Aromas of fresh apple and pear which carry through on the palate. This sparkling wine has just a touch of sweetness balanced by refreshing acidity and a delicate mouth-feel.

title: Wayne Gretzky Salted Caramel Whisky Cream
bodyHtml: A delicate creamy tan in colour. The aromas and flavours of this cream liquor excite the palate with rich notes of melted caramel, sweet cream and a hint of marshmallow and milk chocolate. The mouth-feel is smooth, rich, sweet and creamy, with a long pleasing finish.

title: Cayran Cairanne Grande Reserve Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
• The wine typically shows a straw yellow color with green highlights.

  • The nose is very expressive, often offering notes of peach, apricot, jasmine, and white blossoms. In the mouth, it is rich with flavors of white fruit, pineapple, honey, and lemon. The palate is often round and mineral, with a terrific tension between the round Southern Rhône character and a firm core of acidity. The wine is elegant, well-balanced, and structured, leading to a long finish with good aromatic persistence.

  • The blend is dominated by Grenache Blanc (50%), with the remainder being Clairette (20%), Bourboulenc (20%), and Marsanne (10%).

    Food Pairing

     Suggested pairings include seafood, Provençal-style dishes, and grilled white meats.

    • It is also excellent with a green salad with warm goat's cheese, grilled bass with fennel, or codfish accras.

      This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Rougeot Saint Romain La Combe Bazin 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine is 100% Chardonnay. The colour is a lovely pale lemon or a light straw yellow with greenish reflections. The nose is fresh, showing notes of fresh citrus, white flowers, green apple, and discreet minerality. There is also an open style that can be characteristic of unsulphured wine, with only a hint of wood. On the palate, the wine is elegant and authentic, offering a precise structure and remarkable mineral tension. Tastes include a lively acidity, crisp pear, and lemon zest, with a subtle hint of hazelnut. The wine shows delicate fruit and measured richness, backed by generous fruit and a fabulous long finish. This is a refined Chardonnay with great complexity, a result of the cool climate and the old vines (about 85 years old) in the single vineyard of 'La Combe Bazin'. It is drinking well now but will benefit from two to three years of cellaring. The wine is often vinified with no added sulphites (Sans Sulfite Ajouté), highlighting the natural expression of the terroir. 

Food Pairing

The wine's refreshing acidity and delicate minerality make it an excellent match for delicate fish that is pan-fried or steamed. Suggested pairings include seafood such as oysters and mussels, or poached fish with lemon butter. It is also highly recommended with creamy, soft cheeses like Camembert or Brillat-Savarin, whose texture is well balanced by the wine's slightly mineral acidity. This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Cantina del Pino Barbaresco 'Ovello' 2018
bodyHtml:
• Colour: Intense ruby red.

  • Aroma: The bouquet offers notes characteristic of the Ovello cru, including an edge of pomegranate, a soft scent of prune, wild forest berries, and a note of mint and violets.

  • Palate: The flavour is elegant and dry, with good, fine-grained, and silky tannins balanced by fresh acidity. It has an intriguing hint of balsamic and shows concentrated red berry and floral notes.

  • Body and Finish: This is a full-bodied wine. The overall style is elegant, structured, and soft, with a silky texture and good length.

  • Varietal Composition: This wine is made from 100% Nebbiolo grapes.

  • Optimal Drinking Window: Proper cellaring at a steady temperature can allow this wine to keep its characteristics for 20-30 years. It is structured to ensure both early approachability and long aging potential.

Accolades 

  • Robert Parker - 90+ points.

  • Vinous - 93 points.

Food Pairing

  • Suggested Pairings: The wine pairs well with flavorful dishes like roast meats, red meats, aged cheeses, and game (such as venison or deer). Lamb is also a natural partner for this Barbaresco.

    This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Erdinger Alkoholfrei (Non Alcoholic)  330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Erdinger Alkoholfrei is a non alcoholic wheat beer produced in the town of Erding, Germany. The brewery was established in 1886 by Johann Kienle and was later acquired in 1935 by Franz Brombach, who gave the company its current name in 1949. Ownership was subsequently passed to his son, Werner Brombach, who recently transferred his shares to a non profit family foundation to ensure the brewery remains independent.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic brew presents a hazy, straw yellow appearance topped with a fine, tall white froth. The aromatic profile features spicy malt notes and subtle hops, layered with delicate hints of brioche, banana, and clove. On the palate, it offers a rich malt flavour with caramel sweet nuances and a stimulating bitterness from aroma hops. The body is medium and velvety with creamy carbonation, leading to a clean, fresh finish with a hint of light, fruity acidity. It contains less than 0.5% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The malty character and effervescence of this wheat beer make it a versatile companion for various dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with freshly baked, soft pretzels, as the toasted malt notes highlight the salty crust. For a more substantial meal, it complements boiled mussels or light starters like fried fish. The beer also acts as a refreshing palate cleanser for richer fare, such as grain salads or roasted vegetable dishes.

Distinctive Features

Erdinger Alkoholfrei is distinguished as an isotonic beverage, making it a popular choice for sports recovery due to its ability to help the body regenerate after physical exertion. It contains essential vitamins B9 (folic acid) and B12, which support the immune system and energy metabolism, along with natural polyphenols. Brewed according to the Bavarian Purity Law using only water, wheat malt, barley malt, hops, and yeast, it is also low in calories, containing only 25 kcal per 100 ml.

Serving Suggestions

To enjoy the full sensory experience, this beer should be served well chilled in a tall weissbier glass. A traditional technique involves pouring most of the beer into the glass before swirling the final portion in the bottle to release the settled yeast, then topping it off to create a classic cloudy finish. It is a refreshing alternative for social gatherings, sporty occasions, or as a lively way to quench thirst without the effects of alcohol.

title: Antinori Guado Al Tasso 2016
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

The 2016 Guado Al Tasso displays an intense ruby red colour. The aroma is complex and captivating, expressing pleasant notes of fruit and sweet spices, such as plums, blueberry jam, leather, and liquorice root. Balsamic sensations, including mint and camphor, add freshness and complexity to the bouquet. On the palate, the wine is long and dynamic, with a full body. It is noted for its exceptional elegance, seamless texture, and profound softness. The finish is persistent, accompanied by supple, fine-grained, and elegant tannins. The blend for the 2016 vintage is 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Merlot, and 20% Cabernet Franc, notably not including Petit Verdot in this particular year. The optimal drinking window is suggested to be from 2019 through 2038.

Accolades

  • 'Wine Advocate' - 98 points

  • 'James Suckling' - 98 points

  • 'Vinous' - 98 points

  • 'Decanter' - 96 points

  • 'Wine Enthusiast' - 96 points

  • 'Wine Spectator' - 94 points

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for the structure and flavour profile of this wine include prime rib, roasted chicken, rack of lamb, or a gourmet burger. Traditional Italian pairings include Bistecca alla Fiorentina (Florentine-style steak) served rare, fresh porchetta (roast pork), or pappardelle al ragu' di cinghiale (pappardelle with wild boar ragu). Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

Vintage Quality

The 2016 vintage for Bolgheri, and Tuscany in general, is considered an excellent year. Ideal conditions throughout the season, including a mild winter, a warm summer without extreme temperature spikes, and a favourable day-to-night temperature swing during ripening, led to the development of exceptional aromatic components and excellent freshness in the grapes. The resulting wines are noted for being very well-balanced and displaying great elegance.

title: Jim Barry The Armagh Shiraz 2014
bodyHtml:
This monumental red wine originates from the Clare Valley in South Australia. The Armagh is the flagship "Icon" wine of Jim Barry Wines, first released in 1985 and named after the Irish settlers who arrived in the region in 1849. The winery's philosophy is defined by its focus on single-vineyard expression; the wine is sourced from a historic 8-acre block planted in 1968 on its own roots. These low-yielding, old vines produce fruit of extraordinary concentration, earning the wine a "Langton’s Exceptional" classification—the highest tier for Australian investment-grade wines.

Wine Description

The Jim Barry The Armagh Shiraz 2014 presents an opaque, deep purple-black colour. The sensory profile is incredibly intense and brooding, featuring a complex nose of blackberry, mulberry, and dark chocolate, layered with sophisticated notes of clove, sage, anise, and charcuterie. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and profound, showcasing a massive structural core of granitic, fine-grained tannins and a surprising mineral freshness. It is characterized by its "monolithic" yet balanced power, leading to an exceptionally long finish with hints of graphite, espresso, and savory spice. This 100% Shiraz has an ABV of 14% and was aged for 16 months in 100% French oak (approx. 60-70% new) to support its dense fruit profile.

Vintage Quality

The 2014 vintage in the Clare Valley was characterized by a cool spring followed by a warm summer and a timely "cooling" rain in February. These conditions allowed for a slow, steady ripening process that preserved vibrant natural acidity while developing the deep, dark fruit flavours for which the Armagh vineyard is known. Critics have noted that the 2014 release is more "elegant and structural" than the blockbuster 2012 or 2013 vintages, showing a remarkable transparency of site and immense aging potential.

title: Fattoria Selvapiana Chianti Rufina 2022
bodyHtml:
The Fattoria Selvapiana Chianti Rufina 2022 is a classic red wine from Italy, specifically the Tuscany region and the Chianti Rufina subregion. Fattoria Selvapiana, established in 1826, is one of the most respected estates in Rufina. The estate is celebrated for producing red wines of considerable longevity that beautifully reflect their unique terroir. The proximity of the Apennine Mountains creates a microclimate with cooler summers and significant day/night temperature variations, which is key to the finesse and elegance of the wines. 

Wine Description

  • Colour: Vibrant ruby red.

  • Aroma: Aromas include ripe blackberry, red cherry, a hint of spice, and notes of wood smoke and loam. Further aromatic notes can include fresh red berries, citrus peel, and hibiscus.

  • Palate: The palate is mellow, ripe, and juicy, yet maintains a fine, elegant style. It features core flavours of dusky cherry, plum, and blackberry, complemented by notes of spice, leather, and earthiness.

  • Body and Structure: This is a medium-bodied and well-structured wine, with fine tannins and refreshing, balanced acidity.

  • Finish: The wine has a long and smooth finish, where the smoky note echoes or a lifted, floral note is present with crisp, citrus-laced hints.

  • Varietal Composition: Primarily Sangiovese with small contributions from traditional blending partners: Canaiolo, Colorino, and Malvasia Nera. The varietal blend is generally around 95% Sangiovese and 5% Canaiolo (plus other traditional grapes).

  • Drinking Window: The optimal drinking window is generally considered to be from 2025 to 2033. It is ready to drink now but has potential for cellar aging.

  • Stylistic Notes: An excellent example of the finesse and crispness that the Rufina subzone delivers, demonstrating a classic and refined style.

  • Organic: The vineyards of Fattoria Selvapiana are officially certified organic.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 90 points

  • James Suckling - 91 points 

Food Pairing 

This versatile red wine pairs beautifully with a range of dishes. Consider classic Italian pairings like pasta with tomato sauce or Penne all'Amatriciana. The wine also complements roasted meats, chicken in tomato sauce, sausage, fragrant mushroom dishes, lamb, and hard cheeses.

This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Maison Nicolas Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
The 'Maison Nicolas' Chardonnay is straw-yellow in colour. It has aromas of white flowers and acacia, with notes of toasted almonds and honey. On the palate, it is a dry wine with a round texture, offering notes of citrus and white fruit, with a hint of vanilla on the finish. The wine is fresh, balanced, and crisp, with a vibrant character. The Maison Nicolas Chardonnay is aged in wood for 6 to 8 months to add complexity and finesse.

Food Pairing

This Chardonnay is an ideal pairing for fish in sauce, white meats, and mild cheeses. It is also recommended with seafood, poultry, or creamy pasta dishes. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Citadelle 'No Mistake' Old Tom Gin
bodyHtml:
Citadelle 'No Mistake' Old Tom Gin is a French gin from the Charente region. It is produced by Maison Ferrand, a company known for its Plantation rum and Cognac. Citadelle Gin was founded in 1996 and is recognized as a pioneer of craft gin globally. The 'No Mistake' Old Tom Gin is a tribute to the gin traditions of 18th and 19th-century England, inspired by a popular 19th-century gin recipe.

Gin Description

This Old Tom gin has an amber or golden hue from its barrel aging. The aroma is fresh and intense, with predominant notes of juniper and orange zest, followed by cardamom. The nose also has hints of wood and spice, with standout notes of cubeb and stewed raisins. On the palate, it is rich, full, and elegant with a bittersweet profile. It features notes of candied lemon zest, anise, and almond, which lead to spicy hints of nutmeg, cinnamon, and cubeb pepper. The finish is long and refined, with floral, spicy, and woody nuances. This gin is slightly sweeter than a London Dry gin but drier than a Genever.

The gin is a combination of Citadelle Réserve and toasted, barrel-aged Caribbean cane sugar. The sugar is toasted in copper cauldrons and then aged in barrels for three to four months with a small amount of gin. The sweetened gin is then aged further in casks, some of which are former Ferrand barrels. The process includes three separate aging steps, making it unusual in its category.

title: Haras de Pirque Hussonet Cabernet Sauvignon Gran Reserva 2018
bodyHtml:
Hussonet is produced with Cabernet Sauvignon grown in Haras de Pirque’s vineyards in the Maipo Valley. This wine is a fascinating expression of this characteristic territory offering herbaceous and spicy notes sustained by extraordinary freshness, typical of this terroir. Hussonet is an intense red colour. On the nose, notes of cinnamon, bay leaves and mint merge with herbaceous sensations and toasted notes that express Maipo Valley’s fresh character. The palate is soft with pleasant tannins that offer aromas of red fruit and chocolate.

Hussonet pairs perfectly with pasta, red meat and game.

title: Pian Dell'orino Rosso Di Montalcino
bodyHtml:
• This wine is made from 100% Sangiovese, often referred to as Sangiovese Grosso in Montalcino. 

  • Color, Aroma, and Palate: It typically presents a bright, jewelled ruby or light, bright ruby red color, occasionally being a more dense, dark cherry red. The aroma can be pure and aromatic with notes of red cherry, pomegranate, rose petal, blood orange, wild herbs, crushed stone, and sometimes sweet spices. On the palate, it is sleek and energetic. Flavours often include candied cherries, ripe red fruits, sour cherry, fresh plum, liquorice, and a mineral depth.

  • Body and Finish: The wine is often described as having a seamless, graceful, medium-bodied profile, with great fibre and density on the palate. It has fine, sometimes chalky, well-defined tannins and a lively, precise acidity that provides a remarkable freshness. The finish is long and persistent, with a clean perfume and lingering floral, herbal, or dried cherry and licorice notes.

  • Stylistic Notes: This Rosso di Montalcino is praised for its balance, clarity, and elegance, often transcending the category to reach a 'Brunello level' of quality, reflecting the terroir with a finely structured acidity. It is an organic wine, as the grapes are grown using biodynamic principles.

  • Optimal Drinking Window: While enjoyable when young, it has potential to age and reward cellaring, with some vintages suggesting successful evolution over the coming 10 years.

Food Pairing 

Suggested pairings for this Tuscan red wine include hearty meat dishes such as beef, lamb, and veal, as well as poultry, and cured meat. It pairs excellently with typical Tuscan cuisine like wild boar ragout with pappardelle, or a Chianina rib steak. The wine’s structure and fruit flavours also make it suitable for pasta dishes with meat or tomato sauces, risotto, aged cheeses (like Pecorino or Parmigiano Reggiano), and dark poultry. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Wrexham Lager 330 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: In the glass, an elegant wild rose hue. On the nose, aromas of ripe peaches, guava and lychee, hints of orange blossom and white roses. An instantly refreshing palate of citrus, green apple sorbet and honeysuckle gives way to a clean and lively finish.

title: Writers' Tears Copper Pot Ice Wine Cask Whisky
bodyHtml:
• Sensory Profile: The whiskey presents aromas of peach and apricot layered over a distinct pot still spice. On the palate, you will find notes of floral blossom and nutty oak. The finish is a fruit compote of mango and lychee. It is described as being medium in body with a long finish.

  • Varietal Composition: It is a unique marriage of aged Single Pot Still and aged Single Malt Irish Whiskey, both triple-distilled and entirely from 100% barley—malted and unmalted. The initial spirit was aged and matured in American Oak, Bourbon casks before its finish in icewine hogsheads.

  • Stylistic Notes: This expression is characterized by a dynamic combination of predominantly spicy single pot still married with single malt Irish whiskey, complimented beautifully by the intense natural sweetness imparted by Inniskillin's icewine. The whiskey is non-chill filtered. 

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for this whiskey include charcuterie and cheeses, or homemade fruit loaves served warm from the oven.

This pairing highlights the spirit's depth and character.

title: Corte Adami Spumante Brut Rose 2023
bodyHtml:
The Corte Adami winery, established in 2004 by Angelo and Andrea Adami, represents a fusion of traditional roots and modern elegance. The Adami family has a long history in viticulture, having supplied grapes for generations before deciding to produce their own high-quality wines from their ancestral vineyards in Valpolicella and Soave. Their philosophy is centered on emphasizing quality, respect for nature, and showcasing the territoriality and originality of local grapes.

Wine Description

The Corte Adami Spumante Brut Rose presents in all its beauty with an intense 'rosè' colour and a fine, continuous perlage. The wine is crafted from 100% Corvina grapes, which is known as 'croina' in the local dialect. On the nose, it is elegant and delicate, offering hints of raspberries, blueberries, and roses. The palate has a good balance between alcohol content and residual sugar, with a pleasant freshness and a long persistence.

Food Pairing

This Spumante Brut Rose is highly versatile in its food pairings. It is an excellent match for various dishes, including fish starters and fish soups, well-seasoned soups and pasta, and white meat in a casserole.

title: Chalmers Dott Ribolla Gialla 2021
bodyHtml:
Chalmers Wines is a tight-knit family operation that has been championing Italian grape varieties suited to Australia's warm, dry climate for over three decades. Their philosophy is to craft authentic, distinctive wines that are fundamentally expressions of place, showcasing the unique characteristics of their vineyards with meticulous attention to detail and sustainable viticultural practices.

Wine Description

On the nose, it smells 'crunchy' with notes of green apples, celery, cucumber slices, and peas, alongside tangy lime juice and slippery honeydew melon. Further aromas include green fruit elements like feijoa and guava, coupled with ripe Meyer lemon and fresh lychee. The palate is textural and flavourful, with a waxy, mealy texture, a pithy grip, and a zesty acidity leading to a fine finish.

Food Pairing

It is an excellent match for a summer long lunch consisting of fresh salads and platters piled high with cold seafood.

title: Helios Distillery Kura 'The Whisky' Sherry Cask Finish
bodyHtml:
This is a pure malt whisky finished in Oloroso sherry casks. The whisky is initially aged in American White Oak. It is noted that the whisky used is imported Scotch malt whisky.

  • Aroma: Complex aromas of dark berries, finishing on dried apricot and vanilla. Other notes include apricot and light fruit notes with malt and spice.

  • Palate: Smooth and creamy with flavours of fig, raisin, and cinnamon. It is soft with good sweetness and winter spice. Other descriptors include rich notes of vanilla and chocolate, sherried fruit, caramel, toasted oak, and spice. Some tasting notes indicate bitter dark chocolate.

  • Body: Smooth and full bodied.

  • Finish: Long and lingering, with sweetness of chocolate and sherry dominating. Other notes describe a long, spicy, and smooth finish or a medium length finish with lasting bitter chocolate and a slight woody astringency. A gentle woodiness and smoky taste are also present.

  • Stylistic Notes: This is a delightful new whisky that is bold yet balanced. The maturation in the finest Oloroso sherry casks imparts rich notes.

Food Pairing

  • The rich and warming nature of this sherry cask finished whisky makes it an excellent after dinner drink.

  • Suggested pairings:

  • Dark desserts like chocolate cake or vanilla ice cream. The rich, dark chocolate notes in the whisky will complement a chocolate cake.

  • Dark chocolate and coffee flavours, such as Tiramisu.

  • Spicy food, such as Thai curry or Indian food. The warming spice notes in the whisky will complement the heat of the dish.

    Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Terra Vega Carmenere Kosher 2024
bodyHtml:
This Carmenère is ruby red with soft violet hues. The nose presents aromas of black fruits, along with hints of spice and a subtle touch of vanilla from oak ageing. On the palate, notes of plums and blackberries are prominent. The tannins are soft and silky, leading to a balanced finish. The wine is made primarily from the Carmenère varietal. Some older vintages have been noted as 90% Carmenère and 10% Alicante Bouschet. The style is generally described as a medium-bodied and fruity red wine.


All Terra Vega wines are certified Vegan.

title: Czechvar Premium Lager 500 ml - 20 Bottles
bodyHtml: The world-famous beer produced by the renowned brewery in Ceske Budejovice, Czech Republic, is known as Czechvar in North America. Czechvar is the golden original, with over 700 years of brewing history in the South Bohemian region, and is widely regarded as one of the best lagers in the world by many aficionados.

title: Budweiser 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: This pale lager is described as having a bright, pale golden colour with crystal-clear clarity and a natural foam head. The aroma is slightly malty with moderate esters that can present a hint of applelike fruitiness, alongside subtle floral notes.

title: Molson Canadian 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: Brewed with Canadian water, prairie barley and no preservatives, this lager is as clean, crisp and fresh as the country it comes from. Molson Canadian earns its name with an iconic taste derived from authentic Canadian ingredients.

title: Feudo Montoni Rose di Adele 2022
bodyHtml:
Rose di Adele is the name of the cru from which the grapes hail. The name has its origins in a rose garden that Fabio’s father, Elio, dedicated to his beloved wife, Adele. 

The color is light pink “onion skin,” with bronze reflections. Notes of pink rose petal and violets combine with aromas of black pepper, blackberries, pomegranate and strawberries. On the palate, it has a pleasant astringency, a good structure, is fresh, persistent and sapid.

title: Giffard Creme de Violette Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Giffard is a family owned and operated business located in the Loire Valley in France. The company was established in 1885 by Emile Giffard, a pharmacist with a curious and inventive nature. Inspired by the intense summer heat, he created a clear mint liqueur to cool and refresh his clientele. Today, the family continues his tradition of macerating and distilling fruits, herbs, and spices to naturally flavour their products.

Description Giffard's 'Crème de Violette' is a natural fruit liqueur made from an infusion of violet flowers and extracts of violet leaves. The liqueur has a clear, deep purple colour with slight garnet shades and a bright appearance. On the nose, it offers an intensely floral, spring aroma with notes of violet, rose, candied violets, and a hint of vanilla and wintergreen. The palate is very aromatic, sweet, and smooth, with pronounced violet flavours and notes of lavender and rose. It has a silky and viscous texture, a gentle citrus acidity, and a long, floral finish. The name 'crème' refers to its syrupy texture and high sugar content, not the presence of cream, making the liqueur entirely vegan friendly.

title: Ischia Sapori 'Rucolino' Amaro Alla Rucola
bodyHtml:
This artisanal herbal liqueur originates from Italy, produced on the volcanic island of Ischia in the Gulf of Naples (Campania). Handcrafted by Ischia Sapori—the island's premier craft distillery founded in 1990—this iconic expression holds a cult status as the definitive, original Amaro alla Rucola. Created using a centuries-old local island recipe, its defining botanical is fresh wild arugula (rucola), harvested directly from Ischia's mineral-rich volcanic soil. The arugula leaves are infused in grain spirit alongside citrus peels (Campanian orange and lemon) and a proprietary blend of island herbs, roots, and spices. Bottled at 60 proof (30.0% ABV), it presents a dark, peppery, and earthy variation on traditional southern Italian digestivi.

Spirit Description

This amaro displays a deep, dark ebony to mahogany color in the glass with thick, slow legs. On the nose, it is intensely aromatic, savory, and unique, opening with immediate wafts of freshly cracked black pepper, bitter arugula greens, and charred espresso beans, underlaid by stewed prunes, dark cocoa, and dried orange peel. On the palate, it feels thick, syrupy, and full-bodied, delivering an initial burst of sweet caramel sauce, dark chocolate, and candied citrus, before rapidly transitioning into a peppery, green, and pleasantly bitter mid-palate driven by the raw bitterness of the arugula leaf. The finish is long, warm, and satisfyingly dry, trailing off with lingering roasted herbs, herbal bitterness, espresso bean dryness, and a persistent peppery warmth.

title: Borgogno Barolo Classico 2020
bodyHtml:
This Barolo is made from 100% Nebbiolo grapes, the sole varietal of the wine. In the glass, it shows a ruby red color that may include garnet highlights or a slightly rusty red core. The wine's aromatic profile is complex and plentiful, offering notes of dried Morello cherry, black tea, and lush red roses, along with camphor and tobacco. Other notes include pine forest, violet, rose hip, dark spice, juicy raspberry, and wild strawberry. On the palate, it is full-bodied, bold, and driven by a core of dark fruit and spice. It is characterized by stern, persistent, and robust tannins which are well-balanced by warmth and freshness. Stylistic notes include an outstanding purity and balance, delivering warmth, structure, and freshness, with a long, slightly astringent finish. The grapes for the Borgogno Barolo Classico are organically grown. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is generally suggested from now until 2042.

Accolades

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 97 points

  • Kerin O'Keefe - 95 points

  • James Suckling - 93 points 

Food Pairing 

This full-bodied and intense Barolo is excellent with hearty and rich dishes. Suggested pairings include red meat main courses, such as fillet with green pepper, Florentina steak, or grilled ribeye. It pairs beautifully with braised meat, wild game, or osso bucco. Dishes featuring mushrooms, such as mushroom stew or tagliatelle with mushrooms, are also great complements. For cheeses, pair it with hard, matured, or long-aged varieties like Castelmagno or Pecorino. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

Vintage Quality 

The 2020 Barolo vintage is considered very good to excellent, exhibiting great poise, elegant fruit concentration, and promising aging potential. A mild, dry winter and sunny spring led to an early start to the vegetative cycle, but a cool, wet May slowed ripening and replenished essential soil moisture. Warm summer temperatures were moderated by regular rain showers, sustaining hydration, followed by sunny and mild weather in September and early October, which allowed gradual, excellent ripening of the Nebbiolo grapes. The wines of this vintage show intense red fruit profiles, with supple, fresh, and round tannins, which is a testament to the overall quality.

title: Paladin Rose of Pinot Grigio 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
The Paladin winery, located on the border of Italy's Eastern Veneto and Friuli regions, has a history rooted in Roman times. The company was founded by Valentino Paladin 50 years ago and is now managed by his children. The vineyards benefit from calcareous clay soils and a mild climate, which contribute to the richness and flavour intensity of the wines. The region is known for its high percentage of native grape varieties.

Wine Description The Paladin Rosé of Pinot Grigio 2023 is made from 100% Pinot Grigio grapes, which naturally develop a pinkish skin when fully ripe. The wine has an elegant copper colour with pink highlights. The nose offers a complex bouquet of notes including fresh pear, dried flowers, violets, and wild strawberry. On the palate, it is described as dry and refreshing, with flavours of raspberry, peach, and juicy strawberry fruit. It has a light and playful body with a long finish.

title: Castelvecchi Chianti Gran Selezione Madonnino Della Pieve 2018
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Tuscany's Chianti region, this wine comes from the historic Fattoria di Castelvecchi estate. Mentioned in medieval documents as a "castle and court," the winery has a history spanning over a thousand years. The vineyards are considered a heritage of Italian viticulture, with some vines over 50 years old. The wines are aged in the ancient cellar under the vaults of the castle, which helps to create a balance between power and elegance.

Wine Description

The Castelvecchi Chianti Gran Selezione is made entirely from Sangiovese grapes. It has a lively garnet-red colour. The nose offers an array of aromas including black cherry, crushed cherry, worn leather, and clay. On the palate, there are flavours of black cherry, fresh herbs, and crushed stone. It is a ripe, full-bodied wine with a significant tannic structure that needs food to soften. This wine is described as powerful and structured, with a long and satisfying finish.

Accolades

  • 95 Points - James Suckling

  • 94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Food Pairing

This full-bodied Tuscan red is a great match for red meat or steak. It pairs well with meaty lasagna, meat-lover’s pizza, or spaghetti and meatballs. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Antonelli Montefalco Rosso 2021
bodyHtml: Ruby red in colour. The olfactory impact is intense and fruity, with hints of cherry and wild berries. On the palate, it is dry, balanced and well-structured. The freshness provided by the Sangiovese gives it excellent drinkability. A quality table wine that goes well with flavoursome first courses (ravioli, risotto, tagliatelle), red meat and mature cheese.

title: Kilchoman 18 Year Old - Ex-Bourbon Barrels 20th Anniversary Series
bodyHtml:
The Kilchoman distillery was founded in 2005 by Anthony Wills and is an independent, family-run operation. It was the first distillery built on Islay in over 124 years. The distillery operates as Islay’s only 'farm distillery,' which means it performs all parts of the whisky-making process—from growing barley at Rockside Farm to bottling—on the island itself.

Whisky Description

The whisky presents a full-bodied nose rich with butterscotch, vanilla bean, and toasted coconut, with a gentle layer of oak smoke. Smooth and structured, featuring sweet caramel, spiced apple, and vanilla fudge, balanced by a thread of subtle peat smoke, white pepper, and salty driftwood. It has a long, warming finish with notes of honeycomb, sea breeze, and sweet smoke wrapped in soft oak.

title: Hennessy Paradis
bodyHtml:
This luxurious spirit is a Cognac brandy from France, specifically from the Charente region and the Cognac appellation. Hennessy, one of the world's most important and oldest cognac houses, was founded in 1765 by Irish military officer Richard Hennessy. The blend was created in 1979 by Maurice Fillioux, the sixth Master Blender, as an ode to symphonic music, comparing the union of eaux-de-vie to a 'symphonic orchestra' achieving a perfect harmony. The house relies on the exceptional savoir-faire of the Fillioux family, who have served as Master Blenders for eight generations, upholding a tradition of selection, maturation, and blending.

Cognac Description

Hennessy Paradis is immediately delightful with its rich copper or amber gold colour. The nose is complex, exuding floral notes of jasmine, delicate floral notes, and dry roses, underpinned by subtle notes of cinnamon and exotic fruit. On the palate, this is a graceful, full-bodied, and perfectly balanced blend. It is both voluptuous and round, combining smoothness and strength with a characteristic silky texture.

title: Bodegas Piedra Crianza 2021
bodyHtml:
The story of Bodegas Piedra began in the Toro lands when a family purchased one of the largest plots of old vineyard in the DO in 1968, with the goal of crafting excellent quality wines. Their vineyards are located at an altitude of 750 metres in the area known as 'Estancia Piedra'.

Wine Description

This 'Crianza' displays an attractive, intense, clean, and bright cherry red colour with garnet flashes on the rim. The nose is complex, marked by an abundant presence of ripe red fruits layered over an elegant spicy and toasted background. The wine offers a smooth, savoury, and creamy texture on the palate, where the fruit notes reappear. It is a structured, medium to full bodied wine with fine and well integrated tannins. 

Food Pairing

Recommended pairings include roasted lamb, grilled ribeye steak or sirloin steak, and braised dishes or stews like oxtail. The wine is also ideal with aged cheeses such as Manchego.

title: Hennessy XO - Jean-Michel Othoniel Collaboration Cognac
bodyHtml:
This extraordinary collaboration hails from the Cognac region of France. The Hennessy brand was established in 1765 by Richard Hennessy, and has become synonymous with luxury, elegance, and quality in the cognac world. Hennessy’s philosophy is deeply rooted in craftsmanship and creativity, which is why the Maison frequently partners with esteemed artists and designers.

Cognac Description

Hennessy XO (Extra Old) was first created in 1870 and remains celebrated for its complexity and depth of flavour. The cognac is an assemblage of over 100 eaux-de-vie that are aged for up to 30 years. The colour is a deep amber hue with glints of mahogany, reflecting its extended maturation. The nose presents a harmonious and intricate bouquet of candied fruit, subtle spices, oak, and a hint of cocoa. On the palate, this full-bodied cognac is rich and velvety, unveiling layers of dried fruit, dark chocolate, black pepper, prunes, leather, and toasted oak.

title: Elena Walch Schiava 2025
bodyHtml:
Elena Walch is a leading Alto Adige wine estate that remains in family hands. The winery's philosophy is dedicated to its 'terroir'—the idea that wines must be the individual expression of their soil, climate, and cultivation. Elena Walch, an architect before entering the world of wine, was a pioneer in the Alto Adige wine sector, developing her personal philosophy, experimenting with new methods, and leading the local quality revolution.

Wine Description

This wine presents a bright ruby colour and a delicate hint of cherry on the nose. On the palate, the wine is harmonious and elegant, with naturally mild acidity and fine tannins. A pleasant bitter almond flavour complements the finish. It is an elegant, fruit-forward red wine with good length.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include Mediterranean dishes, pasta dishes, and antipasti. It also pairs well with cold cuts and salami, roast meat, grilled meat, and medium-aged cheeses.

title: Deschutes Fresh Squeezed IPA 355 ml - 24 Cans
Agavero Tequila Liqueur
bodyHtml: Agavero Tequila Liqueur is currently made in Mexico, known for its tequila production. This unique liqueur combines 100% blue agave tequila with the flavours of Damiana, an aromatic herb native to Mexico. The result is a rich and velvety liqueur with a distinct and enchanting flavor profile. Agavero Tequila Liqueur offers notes of honey, caramel, vanilla, and a subtle herbal essence. Critics praise its smoothness, sweetness, and the delicate balance between the tequila and Damiana flavours. It is often regarded as a versatile and enjoyable spirit, perfect for sipping on its own or adding a unique twist to cocktails. Tequila enthusiasts appreciate its distinctive character and the touch of Mexican tradition it brings to their drinks.

title: Langley's Old Tom Gin
bodyHtml:
Description

  • Colour: Light gold.

  • Aroma: Presents notes of juniper and creamy orange essence with a touch of juicy tangerine.

  • Palate: Offers a slow kick of juniper, fennel, nutmeg, lemon peel, and coriander.

  • Body/Finish: The body is described as more botanically intense and sweeter than a London Dry. It develops into a smooth, soft, and lingering sweetened finish.

  • Stylistic Notes: Based on an 1891 recipe using eight botanicals, it is a classic, mildly sweeter style. It is well-balanced and respectful of the history of gin and the craft of distilling.

  • Varietal Composition: Made with a base of 100% grain spirit.

Food Pairing

  • The gin's sweeter, spicier, and citrus profile makes it versatile for pairing.

  • It pairs well with contrasting flavours like salty, fatty foods such as smoked salmon canapés or gravlax, where the smokiness complements the flavour profile.

  • The sweetness and spice notes from botanicals like nutmeg and fennel also align well with richer savoury dishes, such as lamb kofta or a rich Indian curry.

  • For a simple pairing, a cheese plate featuring strong aged cheeses like Manchego or Stilton, or creamy cheese such as goat cheese, offers a nice contrast to the gin's botanicals.

title: Roc de l'Abbaye Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

  • The wine is made from 100% Pinot Noir grapes, grown on clay-limestone plateau soil in the Sologne Viticole region.

  • Its colour is a young garnet. The aroma offers scents of sweet strawberries, dried honey, and hints of pepper overlaying subtle red fruits. On the palate, there are flavours of cranberry and redcurrant.

  • This medium-bodied red wine is described as a delicate wine with real finesse, offering a silky, smooth, and refined style. It is noted as being oaked.

  • The optimal drinking window is to drink it now or cellar it. The farming method is traditional. 

Food Pairing

  • Suggested pairings include barbecued pork, skewers wrapped in bacon, charcuterie, and Beef Bourguignon. Other suggestions are cured meat, red meat, pasta, pasta with tomato sauce, risotto, roasted vegetables, steak, Tarte tatin, veal roasted, and general chicken and turkey dishes.

  • Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience

title: Prunotto Barbaresco Secondine 2020
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

This wine is made from 100% Nebbiolo grapes sourced from the Secondine vineyard. It presents a clear, bright red colour with ruby or intense garnet red highlights, and sometimes light brown hints.

  • Sensory Profile:
    The nose is fragrant, intense, and seductive, with well-defined aromas that include complex floral notes of violets and dried roses, intertwined with hints of red fruit, such as raspberries and strawberries. The palate is refined, delicate, and pleasant, with notes of red fruit and spice. Stylistic notes include a good balance between body and freshness, a velvety or silky texture, and supple, round, and elegant tannins. The wine closes with a long, elegant finish.

  • Optimal Drinking Window: The wine has an excellent cellaring potential, with one suggestion to drink now or cellar until 2035.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 94 points

  • Robert Parker - 92 points

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points

  • Monica Larner, Wine Advocate - 92 points

  • Falstaff - 90 points

  • Antonio Galloni, Vinous - 89 points

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include truffle pasta, risotto, roast lamb, and matured cheeses. The wine's elegance and structure make it versatile with rich Italian fare.

Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 growing season in the Barbaresco area was characterized by a mild and dry winter followed by a sunny, dry start to spring, which led to early growth. Cooler temperatures and significant rainfall in May and June slowed development but provided beneficial groundwater reserves, preventing water stress in the summer. Excellent weather conditions in September, featuring significant day-to-night temperature fluctuations, guaranteed an ideal ripening phase. Overall, the 2020 vintage is noted for yielding wines with great poise, seductive fruit concentration, elegance, and round, supple tannins, promising excellent ageing potential.

title: Chateau Latour Camblanes Cadillac 2021
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

This Bordeaux blend, dominated by Merlot, also includes Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet France. The typical Latour Camblanes blend is predominantly Merlot, which lends it a refined and delicate profile.
On the nose, it opens with pleasant aromas of juicy red fruit and subtle spicy nuances. Other notes may include ripe plums, red cherries, and blackberries, with hints of vanilla, tobacco, and spices from oak ageing. The palate is generally medium-bodied, described as gourmet with flavours of freshly-picked red berries, along with hints of toast and cocoa. The wine showcases smooth or velvety tannins that are finely balanced. Stylistically, the wine is approachable with an elegant tannic structure, a balanced acidity, and a clean, delicious finish. The structure is also described as firm and bold, suggesting ageing potential.

Food Pairing

  • Suggested pairings for this Merlot-dominant Bordeaux include roasted meats and grilled vegetables.

  • It also pairs well with soft cheeses.

  • Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Domaine Santa Duc Chateauneuf Du Pape 'Pied De Baud' 2019
bodyHtml:
LOCATION: Plot situated in the Le Pied de Baud lieu-dit to the north of Châteauneuf-du-Pape on the edges of the Brusquières plateau.

METHOD OF CULTIVATION: Eco-certified organic and certified biodynamic.

AGE OF VINES: Average 90 years.

HARVESTING & VINIFICATION: The grapes are handpicked into crates and sorted manually in the vineyard before a second, table sorting in the cellar.  A proportion is destemmed, the quantity being determined by the nature of the vintage and the parcel, and the grapes are fed by gravity into the vats to ensure the integrity of the berries.  Fermentation takes place in thermo-regulated stainless steel vats for 20 to 30 days, with two long pumping over sessions daily. Punching down is decided after tasting. Pressed pneumatically. Malolactic fermentation in vat. The wines are clarified by settling over winter in the cellar. Barrel filling occurs in the spring. 

AGEING: 18 months in 36-hectoliter oak Stockinger foudres, and 8-hectoliter terracotta amphorae. Unfined and unfiltered at bottling.

Located on the edge of the Brusquières plateau, this wine is made from grapes grown in the Le Pied de Baud vineyard, a wooded plot north of Châteauneuf-du-Pape.

This wine is a blend of 80% Grenache, 15% Mourvèdre, and 5% Cinsault.

Accolades

Jeb Dunnuck, 94 Points

The 2019 Châteauneuf Du Pape Le Pied De Baud has a deep purple-ruby color and a rich, forward bouquet of red and blue fruits, ground pepper, and violets, with noticeable minerality. It’s a full-bodied, structured wine that will benefit from a few years of aging and can be enjoyed for a decade or more.

Wine Spectator, 93 Points

This wine is nicely expressive, with an open and inviting profile of warmed raspberry and plum reduction notes, complemented by hints of red tea, anise, and fruitcake. The texture is silky, with a slight bramble note that adds a pleasant contrast. It finishes with a lovely encore of fruit and is ready to drink now.

title: Louis Latour Marsannay Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
Marsannay marks the northern gateway to the Côte d’Or, and received its Appellation Contrôlée in 1987. Maison Louis Latour, which has roots dating back to the family's first vineyard purchase in the Côte de Beaune in 1731, established the Maison Louis Latour in 1797.

Wine Description

Louis Latour Marsannay Rouge 2022 is made entirely from the Pinot Noir varietal. It displays a deep ruby colour. The nose offers aromas of cherry and liquorice, with suggestions of earthy, floral, black cherry, and blackberry notes. On the palate, the wine is full and fresh, revealing cherry and peppery notes, along with sour cherry fruit. It is medium bodied with a core of freshness. The style is characterized by elegant tannins and mineral energy, resulting in a balanced and persistent wine with a nice length in the finish.

Accolades

  • 'James Suckling - 93 points'.

  • 'Wine Enthusiast - 91 points'.

  • 'Wine Spectator - 90 points'.

Food Pairing

Pair with roasted duck, lamb stew, and mature cheeses. It also pairs well with beef, veal, poultry, and game.

title: Marques de Riscal Arienzo Crianza 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine is from the Rioja region in Spain, specifically the Rioja Alavesa subregion.

Wine Description
The Marques de Riscal 'Arienzo' Crianza 2019 is a fresh, fruity red wine. It has a clean, brilliant ruby red colour. The aromas of red fruits are mingled with hints of vanilla and coconut from the oak aging. The palate is fresh and fruity with a pleasant entry, and a full and supple mouthfeel. The wine is a blend of Tempranillo, Mazuelo, and Graciano grapes. It is aged for 17 months in American oak barrels.

Food Pairing
The wine's body and structure make it a good match for a variety of dishes. It pairs well with grilled red and white meats, pasta, pulses, and roasted poultry. It is also a great pairing for cured cheeses and oily fish.

A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Voerzio Martini Bricco Cappellina 2024
bodyHtml:
• The varietal composition of this wine is 100% Arneis.

  • It presents a very bright, straw yellow colour with green shades and excellent brightness.

  • The aroma is fresh and harmonious, featuring notes of white peach, passion fruit, and a great olfactory balance with citrus notes. Other delicate and slightly vegetal sensations may also be present.

  • On the palate, it is intense, fresh, and very aromatic, showcasing an excellent sour-sweet balance. Flavour notes include ripe yellow melon, strong minerality, and sapidity, with a persistence of soft sensations.

  • This is a dry white wine. 

Food Pairing 

Suggested pairings for this style of wine include shellfish, lean fish, white fish, mature and hard cheese, and cured meats. Specific dishes like octopus marinated in lemon juice, seafood salad (Insalata di frutti di mare), and rice dishes such as squid ink risotto (Risotto nero) are excellent matches.

title: Woodford Reserve 'Master's Collection' Madeira Cask - 700 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Whisky Description

  • Color: Chestnut or dark caramel.

  • Aroma: A fruit-forward and complex bouquet featuring dark cherries, candied oranges, brown sugar, and mixed berries, with hints of clove, nutmeg, and vanilla.

  • Palate: The palate is a rich tapestry with robust dried dark fruit notes like raisin and dried cranberries, toffee, vanilla, apples, and baking spice, backed by nutty notes from the Madeira casks. It has a medium-thin mouthfeel and a distinctly sweet profile.

  • Body: The body is generally light, with the flavour matching its 90.4 proof.

  • Finish: A long, smooth finish with lingering flavours of candied walnut, fruit notes, subtle chocolate, and sweet caramel undertones.

  • Composition: This expression is a blended American whiskey, composed of bourbon, rye, and wheat whiskeys that were individually finished in Madeira casks, then blended with a separate, unfinished Kentucky Straight Wheat Whiskey.

  • Stylistic notes: The whiskey is a beautifully balanced, fruit-forward, and complex expression that leverages the rich, fortified-wine notes from the Madeira casks.

title: Pietrabianca Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

This wine is predominantly Chardonnay, blended with a small percentage of Fiano (typically 90% Chardonnay and 10% Fiano). It presents a straw yellow colour with possible golden or light greenish reflections. The nose is intense, unfolding aromas of white pulp fruit, such as yellow peach, pear, and melon, complemented by citrus notes of orange and lime. Delicate floral notes of hawthorn and acacia, along with subtle hints of vanilla and white chocolate, complete the aromatic profile.

On the palate, the wine is described as balanced, elegant, fresh, and structured. It has a soft entry and a pleasant acidity, leading to a medium to full body.
The Pietrabianca shows outstanding freshness and complexity. It closes with pleasant minerality, which is typical of the Bocca di Lupo estate's soils. It can be enjoyed immediately but also has a potential optimal drinking window of up to 5 years.

This wine is made from organically grown grapes and is certified organic.

 

Food Pairing

This wine is a perfect accompaniment to fish dishes and appetizers. Suggested pairings include shellfish, seafood risotto, grilled squid, and white meats. It is also ideal with semi-mature cheeses.

Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Romero Amber Rum
bodyHtml:
This rum opens with notes of vanilla, butterscotch, and caramel. The palate is described as smooth and velvety, with flavours of toffee, dark chocolate, and a hint of spice. The rum has a long sherry finish, with hints of almond and dried fruit. Other notes mentioned include rich caramel, toasted oak, molasses, and a touch of smokiness. It has a full-bodied mouthfeel.
The rum is distilled in Canadian-made copper pot stills and is made from fancy molasses, blackstrap molasses, and cane sugar. The spirit is rested in fresh ex-bourbon barrels from Woodford Reserve and is finished in Oloroso Sherry casks imported directly from Jerez, Spain.
This is a remarkably smooth rum with exceptional depth and complexity. The rum is described as excellent sipped neat, over ice, or in premium cocktails.

Food Pairing 

This Amber Rum, being an aged rum, pairs well with robust, savoury, and rich dishes.

  • The rum's depth and complexity, combined with its caramel, vanilla, and dried fruit notes, make it an excellent match for grilled steak, which enhances the woody and caramelized nuances of the spirit.

  • Its subtle sweetness and oak character also work well with roasted dishes, such as honey-glazed pork chops.

  • For dessert, the rum's notes of almond and dried fruit complement dishes featuring creamy textures and sweetness, such as dried fruit platters or cheesecake.

A perfect match to enhance the spirit's complexity.

title: Borgo Scopeto Vin Santo 2009 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

This is a blend of Trebbiano Toscano and Malvasia grapes. The grapes are dried for three months in well-ventilated rooms after harvest. Following a soft pressing, the must is transferred to partially filled French oak barriques where fermentation occurs over 12 months. The wine then ages for four years in small casks called 'caratelli'.

This wine presents a vibrant golden yellow colour. The aroma is ethereal and intense, with accents of raisin and dried fig, and can include notes of honey, balsamic, leather, dark chocolate, caramel, almond, and biscuit. On the palate, it is sweet, harmonious, and velvety, described as ample and showing refinement, balance, complexity, and length. A balancing acidity prevents it from being cloying.

Food Pairing

  • Suggested pairings for this dessert wine include dry pastries, crostate (pies/tarts), biscuits, and cookies.

  • It also makes an interesting and decadent partner to sweet blue cheeses, foie gras pâté, or cannoli with ricotta and dark chocolate chips.

title: Huteau Boulanger Sauvignon Blanc 'La Muse' Val de Loire 2025
bodyHtml:
Wine Description

This wine is crafted from 100% Sauvignon Blanc. It presents a pale yellow colour with subtle greenish sparks. The aroma is rich with intertwining notes of citrus and exotic fruit, layered with nuances of elderflower, fresh herbs, and a distinctive mineral piquancy. Unoaked, the palate offers a smooth, perfectly balanced, and juicy texture reminiscent of lemon sorbet, featuring bracing citrus, green apple, and exotic fruit flavours. Bright acidity and the signature Loire Valley minerality underpin a long finish, making for an elegant, fresh, and complex white wine that is ready to be enjoyed upon release. Vignoble Huteau Boulanger employs sustainable and minimal intervention viticulture practices, though the wine is not formally certified organic. 

Food Pairing

 Suggested pairings tailored to the wine's bright acidity and crisp flavour profile include:

  • Freshly shucked oysters and clams 

  • White fish dishes like pan-seared cod or sea bass 

  • A classic goat cheese salad or a block of semi-firm Brie 

Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Chateau Livran 2018
bodyHtml:
Château Livran is located in Saint Germain d'Esteuil, in the Médoc subregion of Bordeaux, France. The estate has a history that spans more than 700 years, with its origins tracing back to 1280 when it was founded by brothers Arnaud and Béraud de Goth. In 2013, the property was acquired by Olivier Michon and his wife, Edwige Lurton-Michon, who is the daughter of Lucien Lurton. The Michon family has undertaken significant restructuring of the estate, including replanting the vineyards and building a new cellar in 2016 to better express the terroir's diversity.

Wine Description

The Château Livran 2018 is a blend of grape varietals, with some sources listing Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, and Merlot, while others specify 65% Merlot and 35% Cabernet Sauvignon or 60% Merlot and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon. The wine is described as having a deep and shining ruby colour. It presents a sleek nose with subtle notes of sweet vanilla oak, ripe red fruits, and a spice profile that includes cumin. On the palate, the wine is braced with bright, fresh raspberry notes and is described as being expressive and elegant, with a nice tannic structure. It is considered a well-balanced wine. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is listed as 2021-2028.

Food Pairing

Suggested food pairings for the Château Livran 2018 include beef, lamb, poultry, and game. The wine is also noted to pair well with charcuterie, cheese, white meat, and red meat. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

Vintage Quality

The 2018 vintage in Bordeaux was described as excellent, and possibly even legendary, despite initially challenging weather conditions. The winter and spring were unusually wet and warm, which led to a significant outbreak of downy mildew. The winemaker's skill in adapting to these challenges would have been critical to the vintage's success.

title: Ricasoli Roncicone Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2021
bodyHtml:
This wine is from Italy, specifically the Chianti Classico DOCG in Tuscany. The Ricasoli family has been making wine for nearly 1000 years and is considered one of Italy's oldest wineries.

Wine Description
Roncicone' Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2021 is made from Sangiovese grapes, with a small portion of other local varieties. The wine has a deep ruby colour with garnet reflections. On the nose, it offers ripe red fruit aromas like cherry and raspberry, combined with delicate notes of leather, tobacco, and earthy spice. The palate is full-bodied with a rich texture, firm tannins, and a bright acidity characteristic of Chianti. Flavours of dark berries, black plums, and a touch of leather lead to a long finish with notes of vanilla, dried herbs, and a touch of oak. Some reviews note a mineral quality, with a sense of "crushed seashell and chalk" due to the unique soil of the vineyard, which contains marine fossils.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 97+ points

  • Falstaff Guide - 97 points

  • Wine Spectator - 96 points

  • James Suckling - 96 points

  • Decanter - 93 points

  • Vinous - 93 points

Food Pairing
This wine is ideal for pairing with hearty dishes. It pairs well with grilled meats, roasted lamb, or classic Tuscan dishes like 'ribollita'. It also complements aged cheeses such as pecorino or parmesan. This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Mount Gay Black Barrel Double Cask Blend
bodyHtml:
Mount Gay Black Barrel Double Cask Blend originates from Barbados, which is often considered the birthplace of rum. The Mount Gay distillery, established in 1703, is the world's oldest continuously running commercial rum distillery. The distillery uses pure, coral-filtered water and a blend of Barbadian and Caribbean molasses to craft their rums. Mount Gay rums are produced in traditional double copper pot and copper column stills. 

Rum Description

  • Color: The Rum's ageing process suggests a golden or amber hue.

  • Aroma: The nose presents notes of toasted oak, butter, dried fruit, and spices. Other aromas noted are toasted brown sugar, molasses, vanilla, melon, and orange peel.

  • Palate: It is described as bold and aromatic. Flavours include orange zest, black pepper, toasted vanilla, and toffee, as well as gingerbread and lychee. Other descriptors include vanilla, caramel, and a hint of banana. The profile is rich, complex, and smooth, with a pronounced oaky, bourbon-like taste.

  • Body: It has a warm, medium body.

  • Finish: The spirit offers a long, lingering finish.

     

Food Pairing The bold and complex flavour profile of the rum, with notes of vanilla, toffee, and spice, makes it versatile. Suggested pairings designed to complement its characteristics include:

  • Slow-cooked lamb ribs braised with ginger, chilli, and soy sauce.

  • Duck confit spring rolls.

  • Charcuterie, particularly aged cheeses such as gouda, and barnyard-y goat cheese.

  • Salty tostones with a light garlic sauce.

  • Indulgent pairings like chocolate, cheese, or steak.

  • For vegetarians, grilled crispy cabbage and umami-rich dishes like nutty mushroom or miso preparations.

Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Talisker 14 Year Old Special Release 2025
bodyHtml:
This Talisker expression, 'Molten Seas,' was matured in ex-bourbon casks and then finished in new American oak casks that were toasted using the heat from volcanic rocks from Skye. This innovative finishing process contributes to a bold and rounded palate that blends cracked black pepper, roasted nuts, and orchard fruit with notes of honey and oak char. The nose offers hints of sea salt, fresh brine, and smoked driftwood, along with citrus peel and sweet malt. 

Food Pairing

Smoky whiskies like Talisker pair well with a variety of foods, including grilled meats, intense cheeses, and salty dishes.
