The peppery and salty notes of Talisker make it a good match for oysters, with some people even putting a few drops of the whisky directly on their oyster. Other suggested pairings include a hearty stew or roasted meat, as the smokiness of the whisky can cut through the richness of the food. It can also be paired with smoked salmon and other seafood.

title: The Botanist Rested Gin
bodyHtml:
Whisky Description

The Botanist Rested Gin is a cuvée of approximately 16 different cask types that have been aged in Bruichladdich's Islay warehouse for a minimum of six months. The resting period in the casks imparts a light amber colour and extra viscosity. On the nose, it has notes of warming spices and candied citrus peels, with a bouquet of perfumed juniper, baking spices, and oak. It also presents subtle hints of dried fruits from the wood. The palate is soft with a complex and balanced flavour profile where the botanicals harmonize with the spices from the wood. The spirit has a deep, rich mouthfeel and a crisp, clean finish with fresh herbal notes, juniper, and citrus. The spirit is vibrant and complex, with the cask influence adding depth and character. 

Food Pairing

The spirit's flavour profile lends itself well to cocktails. It can be enjoyed on the rocks to appreciate its nuanced character, or used in cocktails like a Martinez or a gin Old Fashioned. It also adds depth to a classic Bee's Knees. A "Spicy & Rested" Paloma variation, which combines the gin with grapefruit juice, jalapeño honey, and soda, is another suggested pairing. This pairing highlights the spirit's depth and character.

title: Millebuis Pinot Noir - Gamay 2024
bodyHtml:
This wine is a blend of Pinot Noir and Gamay grapes, with a typical composition being 50% of each varietal. It has a deep red colour with an attractive bouquet and purple highlights. On the palate, it has a crunchy texture with notes of ripe, red berries, such as raspberry and redcurrant. It's described as a supple, elegant wine with fine, delicate tannins. The wine should be served between 16–18°C.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 vintage in Burgundy is considered to be of good quality. The late harvest required meticulous sorting, and a sunny spell in September allowed the grapes to reach good ripeness. The red wines from this vintage are noted for being aromatic, indulgent, and having a rich concentration of fruit. The finesse and elegance of the wines demonstrate the winemakers' skill in adapting to the year's challenges.

Food Pairing

This wine's flavor profile and structure make it a great match for a variety of dishes. It pairs well with light meats or poultry, such as chicken, turkey, and duck. It can also be paired with dishes like pasta with tomato sauce, steamed vegetables, and even some fish dishes for red wine enthusiasts.

A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Fratelli Alessandria 'Gramolere' Barolo 2020
bodyHtml:
• This is a full-bodied red wine made from 100% Nebbiolo grapes, the variety responsible for Barolo.

  • The sensory profile features aromas of macerated cherries and savoury roasted mushrooms, which mingle with dried flowers and shaved rosewood. Further notes include black cherry, rose petal, forest floor, menthol, spice, and dried herbs.

  • On the palate, it presents dark berries, iron, and dried herbs, with a citrus-driven, pithy texture, and hints of mint and balsamic.

  • Stylistically, the wine is described as poised, elegant, and fresh, with a sophisticated bouquet and good balance. The tannins are firm yet beautifully shaped and fine-grained, supported by a lifting acidity.

  • Optimal drinking window is suggested from 2026 to 2040, or a short- to medium-term drinking window.

  • The estate practises organic farming methods, though it is not certified.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 95 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 93 points

  • Antonio Galloni - 93 points

  • Robert Parker - 93 points

 

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for Barolo typically include rich and hearty dishes, which balance the wine's robust structure, high tannins, and acidity. Recommended matches include braised beef, truffled risotto, or aged cheeses, particularly strong cheeses like Castelmagno or Parmigiano Reggiano. The wine also pairs beautifully with game meats, veal, osso buco, and traditional Piedmontese dishes like brasato al Barolo (braised meat).

A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 Barolo vintage is noted for producing mid-weight wines characterised by balance, freshness, and elegance rather than sheer power. Though the growing season was generally warm and presented some challenges such as frost in April, hailstorms in June, and a significant rain event in early October, the summer was moderate without severe heat spikes. Winemakers' skill was particularly relevant in adapting to the weather challenges, and the resulting wines offer excellent aging potential, though they are considered more approachable and drinkable in their youth compared to some other vintages.

title: Speck Brothers The Bootlegger Baco Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Henry of Pelham Family Estate Winery, which released its first vintage in 1988, is named after Henry Smith, an early settler in the Niagara Peninsula. His father, Nicholas, was a United Empire Loyalist who received the deed to the land where the winery is now located. The Speck brothers, who own the winery, shovel-planted the modern-day vineyards in the Short Hills Bench subregion in 1984, establishing themselves as Ontario's Baco Noir pioneers.

Wine Description

Aromas and flavours of black currant, blueberry, and spicy notes. Hints of briar patch fruit, smoke, and toasty oak may also be present. On the palate, it is described as bold and sassy with rich fruit, tame tannins, and juicy acidity. The wine is generally medium-bodied, and the stylistic notes highlight its intensity and smooth finish.

Food Pairing

Pair with grilled red meat, such as flank steak or grilled sirloin, as well as hearty fare like cured meat and hard cheese. The wine's structure and dark fruit character also complement tomato-based pastas and pizzas.

title: Yvon Mau Bordeaux Mixed Pack - 3 Bottles
bodyHtml:
This pack contains 1 bottle each of the following:

Chateau Lucques Bessan 2016

Wine Description

In the glass, the wine reveals a deep ruby hue. Aromas of blackcurrant, spiced plum, and blackberry mingle with notes of savoury herbs, graphite, and a touch of smoke. The palate is full-bodied yet balanced, with lively acidity supporting flavours of dark berries, licorice, and hints of olive tapenade. Tannins are firm but well integrated, leading to a long, structured finish with mineral undertones. The blend is primarily Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Cabernet Franc.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 91 points

Chateau de Lafaurie Monbadon 2016

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep ruby colour with purple reflections. On the nose, it offers aromas of black plum, blackberry, and blackcurrant liqueur, layered with hints of cedar, tobacco, and grilled meat. The palate is juicy and balanced, delivering ripe dark fruits alongside notes of liquorice, pepper, and graphite minerality, wrapped in subtle toasted oak. Medium- to full-bodied, with firm yet refined tannins, it finishes with freshness and a lingering savoury complexity.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 91 points

Chateau Moulin Neuf 2020

Wine Description

The 2020 vintage shows a deep garnet colour in the glass. Aromas of ripe red berries, subtle spice, and a touch of cedar lead into a palate that is supple and round, with smooth tannins and fresh acidity. Medium-bodied yet structured, the wine offers notes of blackcurrant, cherry, and hints of cocoa, finishing with gentle spice and elegance.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 87 points

  • Tim Atkin – 86 points

title: Mott's Clamato Gin Cucumber 458 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This ready-to-drink Caesar cocktail is a blend of gin, Clamato juice, and a hint of cucumber, originating from the Mott's Clamato brand. While Mott's Clamato juice itself has a U.S. origin, the concept of the Caesar is a Canadian national cocktail.

Description

  • This smooth, premixed Caesar offers savory, citrus, cooling, and salty taste sensations. The flavour profile includes sweet tomato and clean cucumber notes, perfectly balanced with a dash of crisp gin.

  • The cocktail is a variation of the classic Caesar, incorporating gin and cucumber for a refreshing and herbaceous twist. Stylistically, it's noted for being a smooth, crisp, and refreshing drink.

title: Delamotte Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
The Delamotte Brut Rosé is a non-vintage Champagne from France, specifically the Champagne region.

Wine Description

The wine has a pale salmon or rose hue with fine, persistent bubbles. Its varietal composition is a blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, with some sources stating 80% Pinot Noir and 20% Chardonnay, while others list 88% Chardonnay and 12% Pinot Noir. The grapes are sourced from Grand Cru vineyards in the Côte des Blancs for Chardonnay (including Le Mesnil-sur-Oger, Avize, and Cramant) and the Montagne de Reims for Pinot Noir (including Bouzy, Ambonnay, and Tours-sur-Marne).

On the nose, the wine offers aromas of red fruits like red currant, wild strawberry, raspberry, and cherry, along with hints of blood orange, tangerine, brown butter, and floral notes like rose petal. The palate is vivacious, supple, and round, with a delicate and refined feel. Flavours include raspberry skin, pomegranate, grapefruit zest, and a subtle smokiness. The wine is fresh, poised, and has a long, delicately chalky finish. This rosé is made using the 'saignée' (maceration) method, where the juice is left in contact with the grape skins to extract colour and flavour, a technique not commonly used in Champagne production.

Accolades

  • Decanter - 95 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 94 points (2019 base vintage)

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 92 points (2023)

  • James Suckling - 93 points

  • Wine Enthusiast - 92 points

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points

  • Wine & Spirits - 93 points

 Food Pairing

The Delamotte Brut Rosé is a versatile wine that can be enjoyed as an aperitif or with a meal. Its acidity and bright red fruit profile make it a good match for lighter dishes. Suggested pairings include poultry dishes, salty or fried foods, and seafood like scallops or shrimp with citrus vinaigrette. It also pairs well with red meats, white meats, and Mediterranean cuisine such as hummus or mezzes. For dessert, it complements red fruit-based dishes like raspberry charlotte or red fruit soups.

title: Maison Nicolas Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
The 'Maison Nicolas' Chardonnay is straw-yellow in colour. It has aromas of white flowers and acacia, with notes of toasted almonds and honey. On the palate, it is a dry wine with a round texture, offering notes of citrus and white fruit, with a hint of vanilla on the finish. The wine is fresh, balanced, and crisp, with a vibrant character.

Food Pairing

This Chardonnay is an ideal pairing for fish in sauce, white meats, and mild cheeses. It is also recommended with seafood, poultry, or creamy pasta dishes. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Black Sage Vineyard Pipe 2017 - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
This fortified wine originates from the Okanagan Valley subregion in British Columbia, Canada. Black Sage Vineyard focuses on crafting premium wines that reflect the intensity of its sun drenched, desert-like vineyard site. The estate is celebrated for its commitment to quality, utilizing the unique conditions of the Black Sage Bench to produce robust, ripe fruit.

Wine Description

Black Sage Vineyard Pipe is a deep, fortified red crafted entirely from Merlot grapes. On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of sweet, ripe dark fruits, including hints of plum, vanilla, and subtle spice notes like cinnamon and clove. The palate is full and mouth coating, revealing rich layers of blackberry, raisins, and figs balanced by soft, round tannins and a touch of residual sweetness. With an alcohol content of 19.5%, the finish is lengthy and warm, showing excellent complexity and a smooth, spicy character.

title: Clase Azul Durango Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Tequila, known for bringing you beautifully painted porcelain bottles of Jalisco's finest spirit, has branched out into mezcal. Most mezcals are Oaxacan mezcal, mind you, but mezcal from the Mexican state of Durango is the real deal. This isn't contracted juice either, they purchased part of the production and registered their NOM number (D291G).

It took them two years to get this project up and running, showing you how serious some of the more prominent brands are getting about mezcal. Not only is this mezcal strikingly different in appearance and origin, but it's also made from a type of wild agave most have never heard of: cenizo, one of the species native to Durango.

The result is quite extraordinary. This Mezcal is full of smoke, slat, and roasted agave. It is an excellent soft, delicate Mezcal Tequila from Clase Azul.

title: Bask Pinot Grigio - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml:
BASK Pinot Grigio originates from Canada, with production spanning key regions in Ontario and British Columbia. The brand was developed with a modern winemaking philosophy focused on lifestyle and wellness, specifically crafting 'low sugar' wines that allow consumers to enjoy a full-flavoured experience with zero grams of sugar per serving. This focus on transparency and 'guilt free' enjoyment has made it a popular choice for those seeking a lighter, contemporary alternative to traditional varietals.

Wine Description

This Pinot Grigio presents as a bright and clear white wine, often showing pale straw hues in the glass. The sensory profile is led by fresh, vibrant aromas of green pear and lime zest. On the palate, the wine is light bodied and brisk, featuring consistent flavours of crisp pear, citrus, and hints of fresh green apple. It is stylistically dry and balanced, offering a clean, polished finish with a refreshing acidity that cleanses the palate. Made from 100% Pinot Grigio grapes, this wine is best enjoyed fresh and chilled; the 3 litre box format is designed for convenience, keeping the wine fresh for several weeks after opening.

title: Grizzly Paw Grumpy Bear Honey Wheat - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Grumpy Bear Honey Wheat is one of the most beloved year-round offerings from Canmore’s Grizzly Paw Brewing Company. Despite its intimidating name, this beer is famously easygoing and sweet-natured. It belongs to the American Wheat Ale family but with a distinctly Albertan twist: the addition of local honey. It is designed to be a "comfort beer" soft, smooth, and subtly sweet making it a favorite for those who want a bit more body and "soul" than a light lager provides.

Beer Description

Grumpy Bear pours a hazy, pale straw-yellow typical of unfiltered wheat beers with a frothy white head and a soft, inviting glow.

Aroma: The nose is delicate and "sunny." It leads with the scent of freshly baked bread and sweet clover honey, followed by a light, floral perfume. There is a faint, spicy note from the yeast and hops, but the dominant impression is one of natural, unrefined sweetness.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a creamy, "pillowy" mouthfeel provided by the high wheat content. It leads with a gentle, honey-drenched grain flavor, followed by a soft malt backbone. The bitterness is almost non-existent, serving only to keep the honey from feeling syrupy. The finish is smooth and clean, with a lingering hint of wildflower sweetness.

Profile: It sits at an ABV of 5.0% and a very low bitterness of 14 IBU, ensuring maximum "crushability."

Technical Notes: This beer is brewed using a significant proportion of malted wheat, which gives it its signature hazy appearance and silky texture. The "secret ingredient" is 100% pure Alberta honey, added during the brewing process. Unlike honey-flavored sodas, the yeast ferments most of the sugar in the honey, leaving behind the complex floral aromatics and a subtle "honey-kissed" finish rather than a heavy, cloying sweetness.

title: Chateau Les Carmes Haut Brion 2022
bodyHtml:
France’s Bordeaux region is home to Chateau Les Carmes Haut Brion, located in the Pessac-Léognan appellation just southwest of the city of Bordeaux. This estate has a storied history dating back to the 16th century and was originally owned by the Carmelite order, hence the name. Since 2010, it has been under the stewardship of Patrice Pichet, whose investment in architectural innovation and vineyard precision has elevated the estate to new heights of acclaim.

Wine Description
The 2022 vintage of Chateau Les Carmes Haut Brion is a dazzling blend of 40% Cabernet Franc, 34% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 26% Merlot. In the glass, it presents a deep, saturated purple hue. Aromatically, it is complex and expressive, offering notes of blackberry, graphite, crushed violets, and sweet spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, with fine-grained tannins, vibrant acidity, and remarkable freshness. The finish is long and mineral-driven, revealing hints of dark chocolate, herbs, and floral undertones.

Accolades
● Wine Advocate - 100 points.
● Vinous - 100 points.
● Decanter - 100 points.
● James Suckling - 97+ points.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs elegantly with roasted lamb, truffle risotto, or grilled duck breast. Earthy mushrooms and herb-infused dishes also bring out its layered complexity. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Chateau Larrivet Haut Brion 2022
bodyHtml:
Château Larrivet Haut Brion is a prestigious estate located in the southern part of the Pessac-Léognan appellation in Bordeaux. Once part of the original Château Haut Brion domain, it became independently recognized in the late 19th century and has since built a reputation for producing elegant and age-worthy wines. Under the ownership of the Gervoson family since 1987, the château has undergone significant modernization, combining tradition with innovation to express the unique gravel and clay terroirs of its vineyards.

This 2022 vintage offers a deep garnet hue with striking clarity. On the nose, it displays an expressive bouquet of ripe blackberries, cassis, and violet, accented by hints of graphite, cedar, and toasted spice. The palate is rich and structured, showing layers of dark fruit, licorice, and subtle mocha, supported by firm yet polished tannins.

Accolades
● James Suckling – 95–96 points
● Decanter – 93 points

Food Pairing
Pair this Bordeaux classic with grilled lamb chops, duck confit, or a mushroom risotto with truffle oil. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Corte Mainente Soave Classico Pigno 2024
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s Veneto region, this wine comes from the Soave Classico area, where volcanic soils and hillside vineyards have produced distinctive white wines for centuries. Corte Mainente is a family estate dedicated to preserving traditional Veronese viticulture, particularly through its cultivation of Garganega grapes using the pergola system on steep slopes. The Pigno vineyard is one of their signature crus, representing their philosophy of terroir expression and authenticity.

Wine Description

Corte Mainente Soave Classico Pigno 2024 is made from 100% Garganega, fermented and aged in temperature-controlled cement tanks. It presents a straw-yellow colour with delicate green reflections. The nose reveals floral notes of jasmine and chamomile, citrus tones of lemon and grapefruit, and hints of almond and green melon. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied with balanced acidity, fresh minerality, and a persistent almond-kissed finish.

Food Pairing

Ideal with seafood, white meats, and vegetable-based dishes, as well as risotto or lightly flavoured pasta.

title: Voerzio Martini Barolo 2021
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s Piemonte region, specifically the famed Barolo zone, this wine comes from Voerzio Martini, an estate based in La Morra. The winery is family-run and places a strong emphasis on respect for tradition while adopting innovative approaches to enhance elegance and drinkability in its Nebbiolo wines.

Wine Description

The 2019 Barolo presents a brilliant garnet colour with delicate brick highlights at the rim. Aromas reveal layers of dark cherry, blackcurrant, rose petals, and hints of liquorice, tobacco, and dried herbs. On the palate, it is full-bodied with refined tannins and a vibrant backbone of acidity, balancing ripe red fruit with earthy and spicy undertones. The wine lingers with a long, persistent finish marked by elegance and structure.

Food Pairing

Ideal with braised beef, mushroom risotto, or truffle-infused pasta. The wine’s firm tannins and savoury notes also pair beautifully with aged cheeses like Parmigiano Reggiano.

title: Sandrone Nebbiolo D'Alba Valmaggiore 2022
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s renowned Piedmont region, this wine hails from the Nebbiolo d’Alba DOC, specifically the steep Valmaggiore vineyard in the Roero hills. Luciano Sandrone, one of the most respected modern producers in Piedmont, has been crafting wines since 1978, combining traditional methods with precise vineyard management. The Valmaggiore site, with its sandy, south-facing slopes, has long been prized for producing Nebbiolo of finesse and aromatic intensity.

Wine Description
Brilliant ruby red in colour, this wine opens with alluring aromas of red cherry, raspberry, and violet, accented by notes of orange zest and subtle spice. On the palate, it shows vibrant acidity and medium body, with fine-grained tannins that lend structure without overpowering the fruit. The finish is long and elegant, echoing flavours of red berries, floral tones, and hints of clove and earth.

Accolades

  • Decanter – 93 points.
  • Jeb Dunnuck – 93 points.
  • Vinous – 93 points.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with classic Piedmontese dishes such as tajarin pasta with white truffle or braised veal shank. It also complements roasted game birds, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses.

title: Teaninich 8 Year Old Special Release 2025
bodyHtml:
Teaninich is a Scotch whisky distillery located in the Highlands of Scotland, near the village of Alness. Founded in 1817 by Captain Hugh Munro, who owned the Teaninich Estate, the distillery was built to ensure a consistent buyer for the barley grown on his land. Teaninich is known for its unique production methods, notably being one of only two distilleries in Scotland to use a mash filter instead of a traditional mash tun. The distillery's output is primarily used in blended Scotch whiskies, especially for brands owned by Diageo, which acquired the distillery in 1933. Official single malt bottlings from Teaninich are rare, but independent bottlings are becoming more common.

The Teaninich 8 Year Old Special Release 2025 is a single grain Scotch whisky that resulted from a 2016 'rye experiment'. It was distilled using a mash of malted rye and barley in pot stills and matured in ex-Bourbon casks. The bottling is at a cask strength of 60.3% ABV. The producer describes the whisky as a "rebellious rye experiment" with a "subversive spicy toffee sweetness". It is characterized by deep aromas of cinnamon and clove.

The Teaninich 8 Year Old Special Release 2025 is a result of a 2016 rye experiment, showcasing the distillery's willingness to deviate from tradition and their unique use of a hammer mill. The hammer mill, which grinds malted barley into a powder, also allows the distillery to work with other grains, such as rye.

Food Pairing This whisky's rebellious charm and bold, spicy toffee sweetness would pair well with rich, savoury dishes to enhance its character.

title: Oban 12 Year Old Special Release 2025
bodyHtml:
The Oban distillery is one of the oldest in Scotland, founded in 1794 by the Stevenson brothers. Located in the port town of Oban, the distillery's whisky style is a unique blend of the smoky, dry character of the Scottish Islands and the lighter, sweeter notes of the Highlands. The distillery is one of the smallest in Scotland, using only two pot stills, which emphasizes a focus on quality, authenticity, and heritage rather than high volume.

This limited edition single malt is the Oban 12 Year Old 'Heart of the Harbour,' part of the 2025 Diageo Special Releases. The whisky was matured for at least 12 years in ex-bourbon casks. It is bottled at 54.7% ABV and has a pale gold colour.

The nose reveals a maritime character with notes of sea salt and fresh brine, as well as hints of dried seaweed and a touch of vanilla and honey from the oak. There are also notes of soft orchard fruits like green apple and pear, balanced with a subtle citrus zest. The palate is smooth and delivers malt sweetness with baked apple, toffee, and a subtle wood spice. The finish is long and dry with a hint of pepperiness.

title: Singleton of Glen Ord 17 Year Old Special Release 2025
bodyHtml:
The Singleton of Glen Ord distillery, founded in 1838, is located on the edge of the Black Isle in the Highlands region of Scotland. It is one of the oldest distilleries in Scotland and is the only remaining single malt Scotch whisky distillery on the Black Isle. While the majority of its output has traditionally gone to blends like Johnnie Walker and Dewar's, the distillery has released its own single malts, which have received multiple international awards.

This 17-year-old single malt is part of the Diageo Special Releases 2025 collection and is bottled at 55.5% alcohol by volume (ABV). The whisky was finished in ex-mezcal and second-fill sherry casks, an unconventional combination that gives it new flavour depths.

The nose has aromas of baked apples, pear, and peach, along with subtle hints of honey and vanilla. As it breathes, notes of cinnamon, nutmeg, and mild oak emerge. The tasting notes from the producer highlight a rich, fruity taste combined with aromatic spice. It has a smooth, creamy texture and a flavour profile that includes dried fruit, baked apple, and chilli pepper notes.

Accolades
The Singleton of Glen Ord's single malt range has received several international awards, including three Gold awards for the 12-Year-Old, 15-Year-Old, and 18-Year-Old expressions.

The Glen Ord distillery was named Scotland's Leading Distillery Tour for 2024, an achievement that recognizes both the distillery and the local community.

Food Pairing
This whisky's rich and spicy profile would pair well with cured meat, smoked fish, or venison. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Cointreau Noir
bodyHtml:
Cointreau Noir is a blend of Cointreau orange liqueur and Rémy Martin cognac, with an infusion of walnuts and almonds. It was inspired by a recipe called 'Majestic' that was created by Édouard Cointreau in the early 20th century. Cointreau is owned by Rémy Cointreau.

Description

Cointreau Noir has a clear, golden amber color. It offers a complex and opulent aromatic profile with notes of pungent orange zest, tangerine, vanilla, honey, gingerbread, nuts, and a touch of spice. On the palate, it is smooth, full-bodied, and lush. The flavor profile includes intense orange, marmalade, and bitter orange with notes of saffron, vanilla, and leathery, nutty cognac. The finish is long and bittersweet, with lingering notes of marmalade, vanilla bean, and a mellow cognac glow. The liqueur has a judicious sweetness that is balanced by the alcohol, creating a velvety and smooth texture. It is composed of about 70% Cointreau triple sec liqueur and 30% Rémy Martin cognac.

Accolades

  • Ultimate Beverage Challenge - 94 points

  • Guía Peñin - 92 points

  • San Francisco World Spirits Competition - Gold Medal (2011)

  • ISW Meininger's International Spirits Award - Gold (2023, 2024)

Cointreau Noir can be enjoyed neat or on ice. Its richness and complexity also make it a versatile choice for cocktails, such as a "Noir Old Fashioned" or a "Cognac Margarita". When pairing with food, consider dishes that complement its flavor profile. The liqueur's rich, sweet, and nutty characteristics are well-suited for desserts, particularly those with chocolate or nuts, as they highlight its deep, cocoa, and vanilla undertones.

title: Lagavulin 12 Year Old Special Release 2025
bodyHtml:
Lagavulin is a single malt Scotch whisky distillery located on the Isle of Islay, in the Islay region of Scotland. The name 'Lagavulin' is an anglicization of the Gaelic lag a'mhuilin, which translates to 'hollow by the mill'. The distillery officially dates back to 1816, although there are records of illicit distillation on the site as far back as 1742. It is now owned by Diageo plc.

The Lagavulin 12 Year Old is a single malt Scotch whisky. Lagavulin is known for its slow distillation process, which is the slowest of all Islay whiskies, and for its use of malted barley from Port Ellen Maltings. The production process involves drying the malt over peat fires, which imparts the signature smoky flavour. The spirit is then matured in oak casks, often a combination of first-fill ex-Bourbon and refill casks.

This whisky has a bold, smoky character with notes of bonfire smoke, ash, and iodine. The flavour profile can also include sweetness like toffee, honey, and vanilla. Other notes often detected are citrus fruits, black pepper, and hints of roasted coffee beans. It has a long, warming finish with lingering notes of ash and tobacco. The body is typically described as medium with a soft, buttery texture.

title: Mionetto Prosecco (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml: This award-winning Prosecco offers vivid fruit character and persistent effervescence. On the palate the notes of Asian pear, honey and lees give way to a creamy mouthfeel with pleasant stonefruit, chocolate and mineral hints. Serve well chilled with a selection of cured meat, cheese, and crisps.

title: Leitz 'Eins Zwei Zero' Sparkling Rose (Non Alcoholic) 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: The EINS-ZWEI-ZERO Sparkling Rose is a refreshing sparkler that exudes cool, red fruits and lean minerality. With its invigorating perlage, it instantly brings upon that summer feeling. In addition to the notes of rose hips and sky berries, often present in rosé, this rosé variation conveys a remarkable freshness giving it incredible versatility – a pleasant aperitif, as a spritz mixer, or simply as a constant companion to enjoy relaxing evenings.

title: Leitz Pinot Noir (Non Alcoholic) 250 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
The new ZERO-POINT-FIVE Pinot Noir offers a very appealing, vinous character; that is clean and fresh. Fruity notes of red currants and cherries are surrounded by a nicely embedded tannin structure and an almost dry finish.

Of course, an alcohol-free wine will never have the same depth, structure, and mouthfeel as a wine with alcohol, but the ZP5 comes extremely close and is simply a wine that tastes … Impressive!

This can pair well with roasts or game; it’s a nice option with grilled fish or lamb biryani.

title: Mott's Clamato Caesar Pickled Bean 458 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Mott's Clamato Caesar Pickled Bean originates from Ontario, Canada. It is produced by Canada Dry Mott's Inc., a company that has played a central role in popularizing Canada's quintessential cocktail since the Caesar was first created in Calgary in 1969. The brand is known for providing bartender quality, ready to drink versions of this classic beverage to consumers across the country.

Description

This ready to drink, spirit based cocktail presents a bold and savoury sensory profile. The aroma is characterized by savoury tomato, celery salt, and green beans with a briny, spicy kick. On the palate, it offers a smooth blend of tangy tomato and zesty pickle brine, balanced by mild spices and a touch of citrus. The body is medium with a refreshing, vegetal complexity that leads to a crisp finish with lingering notes of spice and pickled bean zest. It has an ABV of 5.5%.

title: Coedo Rice & Yuzu Japanese Pale Ale 333 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Japan’s Saitama Prefecture is home to Coedo Brewery, a craft brewery rooted in centuries of agricultural tradition and a commitment to artisanal precision. The brewery, founded in the 1990s, draws inspiration from the local cultivation of sweet potatoes and rice, blending tradition with innovation in its range of craft beers. Coedo has become known for creating distinctive beers that integrate Japanese ingredients and sensibilities.

Coedo's Rice & Yuzu Pale Ale is a refined expression of Japanese brewing finesse. Pale golden and lightly hazy in appearance, this ale is brewed with polished rice and delicately infused with yuzu, the fragrant Japanese citrus. On the nose, it offers vibrant aromas of lemon zest, white flowers, and fresh-cut herbs. The palate is crisp and refreshing, featuring light malt sweetness, a subtle rice creaminess, and bright, tangy citrus notes from the yuzu. With a light body, dry finish, and balanced bitterness, it delivers a harmonious drinking experience that is both lively and elegant. Best enjoyed fresh to appreciate its aromatic nuances and delicacy.

title: Sleeman Honey Brown 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml: Honey Brown Lager boasts a rich copper with a creamy, off-white foam, creating a full-bodied lager with a touch of natural honey and a slightly sweet finish. The distinctive clover honey notes in this fine brew accent the aromas of toasted grain and caramel.

title: Crazy Uncle Hard Root Beer 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: Smooth and rich natural flavours of sarsaparilla, sweet birch, wintergreen and licorice root with a creamy vanilla finish.  Crisp and refreshing flavour without being overly sweet.  This truly is a craft soda for "grown-ups."

title: Bud Light Chelada 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml: Bud Light Chelada with Clamato is the perfect combination of smooth refreshment and savory flavor. It's the taste of Bud Light you love, blended with the spicy richness of Clamato Tomato Cocktail. Best served over ice and garnished with lime.

title: Village CRFT Pale Ale 473 ml (Non Alcoholic) - 4 Cans
Grizzly Paw Beavertail Raspberry Ale 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Beavertail Raspberry Ale is one of the most famous fruit beers in Western Canada, brewed by The Grizzly Paw Brewing Company in Canmore, Alberta. A longtime favorite in their mountain-side taproom, it is designed to be a crisp, accessible wheat ale with a vibrant fruit twist. Named after the iconic Canadian pastry (and the flat tail of the national animal), it has become a "must-try" for visitors to the Rockies, prized for its natural fruit flavor and refreshing qualities.

Beer Description

This fruit ale pours a beautiful, slightly hazy reddish-pink color with a soft, pink-tinged white head.

Aroma: It features an immediate and unmistakable bouquet of fresh, sun-ripened raspberries. The aroma is bright and sweet-tart, with a subtle, bready malt background from the wheat base.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and effervescent. It leads with a gentle, wheaty sweetness that is quickly followed by the tangy, authentic flavor of real raspberries. It strikes a fine balance between tart and sweet, avoiding the syrupy heaviness of many fruit beers and finishing clean and dry.

Profile: It has a highly sessionable ABV of 5.0% and a very low bitterness of 10 IBU, allowing the fruit aromatics to take center stage.

Technical Notes: Brewed as a traditional North American wheat ale using a significant portion of malted wheat for a smooth, soft mouthfeel. It is infused with natural raspberry puree during the conditioning process to ensure a genuine fruit character and its signature ruby-pink hue.

title: Grizzly Paw Powder Hound Blonde - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Powder Hound Blonde Ale is a cornerstone of the Grizzly Paw Brewing Company in Canmore, Alberta. Named after the enthusiasts who chase fresh "powder" in the nearby Canadian Rockies, this beer is designed as the ultimate post-mountain refresher. Since the brewery's start in 1996, Powder Hound has served as a reliable "bridge" beer offering more flavor and body than a standard domestic lager while remaining light enough to be incredibly approachable.

Beer Description

Powder Hound pours a clear, vibrant golden-yellow with a soft white head and steady carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is clean and inviting. It leads with a mild malty sweetness reminiscent of honey and freshly baked bread. Because it is an ale, you will find a very subtle fruitiness think ripe yellow apple balanced by a faint, earthy hop scent.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a smooth, "easy-going" mouthfeel. It leads with a delicate biscuit-like malt flavor and a touch of sweetness. The bitterness is kept very low, serving only to provide a clean finish that doesn't linger. It is intentionally simple and balanced.

Profile: It sits at a very manageable 4.5% ABV and a low bitterness of 15 IBU, making it an ideal "all-day" session ale.

Technical Notes: This beer is brewed with a blend of pale malts and a touch of crystal malt to give it that signature golden hue and bready backbone. It is fermented with a clean-fermenting ale yeast at slightly cooler temperatures to keep the profile crisp. A key ingredient is the Canmore mountain water sourced from the local watershed, which is naturally soft and helps produce a very smooth final product.

title: Coors Light 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml: Coors Light remains one of Canada's fastest growing beer brands due to its ice-cold, easy-drinking taste and contemporary image. A popular choice with young, active beer drinkers who appreciate its crisp, refreshing taste.

title: Old Style Pilsner 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml: Old Style Pilsner is a medium body lager that is true to its Western Canadian roots. It has not changed since our beer was first brewed in 1926. Why? It’s right there on the bottle…“old style”. Those are more than just words on a beloved label. Being true to who we are has kept our drinkers loyal and kept Pilsner from being a fad.

title: Grizzly Paw Grumpy Bear Honey Wheat 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Rutting Mule (formerly known as Bighorn) Nut Brown Ale is a foundational flagship from The Grizzly Paw Brewing Company in Canmore, Alberta. Brewing in the heart of the Canadian Rockies since 1996, Grizzly Paw designed this ale to be as rugged and reliable as its mountain namesake. It is a quintessential English-style Brown Ale that prioritizes malt complexity and "comfort" over hop bitterness, making it a legendary après-ski staple for locals and tourists alike.

Beer Description

This Nut Brown Ale pours a deep, clear mahogany with ruby highlights when held to the light, topped with a creamy, tan-colored head.

Aroma: It features a warm and inviting nose led by toasted hazelnuts, roasted malts, and a distinct touch of chocolate. Subtle notes of caramel and brown sugar provide a sweet aromatic backbone.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied and exceptionally smooth. It delivers a rich, nutty flavor profile with layers of dark bread crust, toffee, and a hint of mild coffee. The finish is clean and slightly sweet, with just enough earthy hop bitterness to provide balance.

Profile: It has a sessionable ABV of 5.0% and a low bitterness of 20 IBU, making it an approachable and highly drinkable dark ale.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a complex blend of five different malts, including Chocolate and Crystal malts, to achieve its deep color and layered sweetness. It uses traditional English hops for a subtle, earthy structure and is fermented with a clean ale yeast to ensure the malt characteristics remain the primary focus.

title: Grizzly Paw Powder Hound Blonde Ale 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Powder Hound Blonde Ale is a core flagship from Canmore’s Grizzly Paw Brewing Company. True to its name, this beer is a tribute to the "powder hounds" of the Bow Valley—those who live for fresh snow and mountain adventures. It is designed to be the ultimate easy-drinking, post-activity beer: light, clean, and unpretentious. It serves as the perfect entry point for those new to craft beer while providing the crisp consistency that seasoned locals expect from a mountain-brewed ale.

Beer Description

This blonde ale pours a brilliant, crystal-clear pale gold with a bright white head and a lively, streaming carbonation.

Aroma: It features a subtle and clean nose. Expect delicate scents of sweet grainy malt and fresh white bread, with a very faint hint of floral honey and a touch of herbal hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and exceptionally crisp. It delivers a soft, bready malt sweetness that is immediately balanced by a mild, clean bitterness. The mouthfeel is smooth and effervescent, leading to a quick, dry finish that encourages another sip.

Profile: It has an ABV of 4.5% and a low bitterness of 15 IBU, making it one of the most sessionable and approachable beers in the Grizzly Paw lineup.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a simple, high-quality malt bill to ensure a light color and clean profile. It is fermented at slightly cooler temperatures with a neutral ale yeast to minimize fruity esters, resulting in a beer that drinks with the refreshing snap of a lager but the soft character of an ale.

title: Ol' Beautiful Okami Kasu Japanese Ale 355 ml - 6 Cans
bodyHtml:
Ol' Beautiful Okami Kasu is a flagship collaboration between Calgary’s Ol' Beautiful Brewing Co. and Chef Darren MacLean of the acclaimed Japanese restaurant, Shokunin. Designed specifically to bridge the gap between craft beer and Japanese culinary traditions, it is celebrated for its inventive use of specialty ingredients. It stands as a unique Japanese Ale that provides a sophisticated alternative to standard light lagers.

Beer Description

This Japanese-style Rice Ale is deceptive; it pours brilliantly clear with a pale straw to golden color and a clean, ivory-white head, visually mimicking a crisp pilsner.

Aroma: Subtle and clean, featuring light floral notes and a soft graininess, with a faint, intriguing "uptown funk" derived from its unique fermentation additives.

Palate: The mouthfeel is the standout feature surprisingly rich, silky, and almost creamy. It offers a gentle malt sweetness that transitions into a clean, boozy finish with a hint of savory complexity.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% and a very low bitterness of 10 IBU, making it exceptionally smooth and highly compatible with delicate flavors.

Technical Notes: The recipe includes a substantial portion of rice to achieve its signature silky texture. The defining ingredient is Sake Kasu the residual rice paste left over from sake production, which imparts the beer’s distinctive creamy body and subtle, "boozy" funk.

title: Miller Genuine Draft 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml: This famously smooth lager is brewed from premium ingredients, cold-filtered four times and never pasteurized. It's a pale golden colour with delicate aromas and flavours of light fruit, cereal grain, citrus, bready malt and herb. Light, crisp and creamy on the palate with a clean, refreshing finish. Great palate refresher.

title: Canmore Brewing Highline Lager 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: Light in body and colour with hints of stonefruit and grain.

title: Brava 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml: Brava is a premium lager that is brewed in small batches using only the finest, hand-selected hops and barley. The result is a light, crisp, distinctive lager that is easy drinking and very refreshing.

title: Uncommon Dry Craft Cider 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This flagship cider originates from Canada, specifically Calgary, Alberta. Uncommon Cider Co. is Western Canada's first urban cidery, founded in 2016 by Brodie Thomas. The company's philosophy is rooted in a quality-driven approach that respects traditional English-style cider-making while pushing boundaries through experimentation and active community involvement, such as their annual fruit drive.

The 'Dry' is a crisp, traditional cider made from 100 per cent pressed apple juice. It displays a clear golden colour with a floral and fresh orchard aroma. On the palate, the cider is dry and crushable, featuring notes of ripe fruit and the slight hint of tannin. The finish is strong, defined by freshly picked apples and juicy white grape acidity. Stylistically, it aims for a balance between traditional English depth and modern freshness, avoiding apple juice concentrates or added sweeteners. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 6.5 per cent. This cider is naturally gluten-friendly.

title: Monday Zero Rum (Non Alcoholic) - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Monday Zero Alcohol Rum is a non alcoholic spirit originating from San Diego, California. The brand was founded with a mission to support a cultural shift toward self care and mindful living, allowing individuals to enjoy adult beverages without compromise. Each bottle is handcrafted in small batches at the company's Southern California distillery using natural ingredients.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic rum alternative presents a bold and dark appearance inspired by the aged rums of the Caribbean. The aroma features sweet notes of sugar cane and tropical fruit layered with the scent of fresh tobacco leaf. On the palate, it delivers a complex blend of burnt caramel, banana, butter pecan, and oaky vanilla, with subtle undertones of roasted coffee and mocha. The body is rich and textured, leading to a long finish with a satisfying hint of heat. This beverage contains 0% alcohol by volume.

Distinctive Features

Monday Zero Alcohol Rum is distinguished by its use of natural ingredients sourced from the Caribbean to ensure an authentic flavour profile. It is a health conscious choice, being vegan, gluten free, and keto friendly, with only 5 calories and 0g of carbohydrates per serving. The production process focuses on maintaining the ritual of traditional spirits, offering a big 8 allergen free product that is also low in sugar.

Serving Suggestions

To experience the spirit at its best, it should be treated like a premium aged rum and mixed in a 1:1 ratio for classic cocktails. It is ideal for a 'Dark and Stormy' when mixed with ginger beer and lime, or a 'Classic Daiquiri' with fresh lime juice and simple syrup. For a more sophisticated serve, it can be used in a 'Rum Old Fashioned' over a large ice cube with bitters and an orange twist. It also pairs simply and effectively with cola for a refreshing, alcohol free highball.

title: Heineken 330 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml: Brewed to be the best since 1873. For over 150 years, a ceaseless commitment to purity and quality has made Heineken the most iconic beer brand in the world. When you see the red-star on the green bottle, you know every ice-cold, crisp sip will deliver that richly satisfying flavour with subtle fruity notes. A tradition of taste that his lived on for over a century and a half thanks to the simplicity and quality of the ingredients and the meticulous attention to the brewing process.

title: Sunnycider Saskatoon Apple Cider 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This Prairie-inspired craft cider originates from Canada, specifically Calgary, Alberta. SunnyCider is Calgary's first brick-and-mortar craft cider house, established in 2019 by neighbours Tim Kitchen, Darlene Kitchen, and Dennis Scanland. The business grew from a 2013 community project in the Sunnyside neighbourhood aimed at finding creative uses for local backyard fruit, eventually evolving into a professional operation with a philosophy deeply rooted in community, sustainability, and low-intervention production.

The 'Saskatoon Apple' is a blend of the cidery's dry apple base and locally sourced Saskatoon berry juice. It displays a beautiful depth with a rich, berry-infused colour. On the nose, it remains apple-forward while offering the lush aroma of ripe Saskatoon berries. The palate is well-balanced and flavourful, featuring crisp apple notes layered with lightly sweet, jammy berries and a hint of earthy fruit leather. Stylistically, it is described as the least dry of the SunnyCider lineup, yet it remains quite dry in character with very little residual sugar.

title: Grizzly Paw Grapefruit 355 ml - 4 Cans
bodyHtml: Made in the Bow Valley and hand-packaged by locals all our sodas are produced in small batches with cane sugar and mountain fed water.

title: Uncommon Ginger Cider 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This vibrant, small-batch cider originates from Canada, specifically Calgary, Alberta. Uncommon Cider Co. is Western Canada's first urban cidery, established in 2016 by founder Brodie Thomas. The cidery's philosophy combines a love for traditional, full-juice English-style cider with a passion for pushing boundaries through experimentation and active community involvement, such as their local fruit collection initiatives.

The Ginger Cider is crafted by blending fresh-pressed ginger with the cidery's wild cider base. It displays a lively, clear appearance with an inviting aroma of fresh ginger. On the palate, the cider is off-dry with a balanced sweetness that gives way to a classic, fiery ginger kick. Stylistically, it is described as crushable and vibrant, reminiscent of a citrus-rimmed Moscow mule. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 5.2 per cent. Like all Uncommon ciders, it is made from 100 per cent pressed fruit juice without the use of concentrates or added sweeteners. This cider is naturally gluten-free.

title: Uncommon Crush Cider 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This crisp craft cider originates from Canada, specifically Calgary, Alberta. Uncommon Cider Co. is recognized as Western Canada's first urban cidery, founded in 2016 by Brodie Thomas. The company's philosophy is rooted in a passion for traditional, full-juice English-style ciders, focusing on a quality-driven approach that utilizes 100 per cent real fruit juice rather than concentrates or added sweeteners.

The 'Crush' is a clean and classic cider made with 100 per cent British Columbia apples. It displays a bright appearance and is noted for being bursting with floral aromatics. On the palate, the cider is crisp and refreshing, offering a 'classic with a twist' profile that emphasizes the natural character of the fruit. Stylistically, it is a dry and very crushable beverage designed for easy drinking. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 5.0 per cent.

title: Cornelissen Monjebel Rosso 2021
bodyHtml:
Frank Cornelissen founded his estate on Mount Etna in 2001 with a philosophy of minimal intervention, allowing the volcano’s unique terroir to fully express itself. His vineyards, many planted with old vines, are cultivated organically and often biodynamically, producing wines of striking purity and energy.

Wine Description

Munjebel Rosso is made from 100% Nerello Mascalese grown in multiple parcels across Etna’s northern slopes, including Zottorinoto-Chiusa Spagnolo, Feudo di Mezzo-Porcaria, Rampante sottana, Piano Daini, and Crasà. In the glass, it shows a vibrant ruby hue. Aromas of red berries, wild strawberries, dried herbs, rose petals, and subtle volcanic minerality rise from the nose. The palate is lively and textured, offering crunchy red fruit, blood orange, spice, and hints of savoury brine.

Food Pairing

Ideal with roasted lamb, grilled pork, wild mushroom risotto, or aged pecorino. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Millebuis Cote Chalonnaise Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
This vibrant wine offers subtle scents of white blossoms and fruits, accompanied by hints of toast. Its flavor profile is enriched with a refreshing saline note, creating a lively experience on the palate. The finish is extended and marked by striking minerality.

Originating from the La Roche de Culles area in Culles-Les-Roches, at 330 meters elevation and south/southeast exposure, these vineyards benefit from limestone and marl soils, shaping the distinctive character of our Bourgogne Côte Chalonnaise Chardonnay La Roche de Culles.

title: Sadashi Japanese Whisky Mizunara Oak
bodyHtml: Sadashi Mizunara Oak Finish Japanese Whisky is an exceptional spirit reflecting the artistry and distinctive qualities of Japanese whisky production. Its unique character comes from maturation in Mizunara oak casks, native to Japan, which fosters a deeper interaction between wood and whisky due to its porous nature. This results in a refined complexity, featuring aromas and flavors of sandalwood, incense, spices, tropical fruits, vanilla, and a subtle coconut nuance. The whisky offers a smooth, balanced palate with harmonious sweetness and spice, culminating in a long, gratifying finish. It’s an outstanding choice for connoisseurs seeking a sophisticated tasting journey.

title: Benjamin Bridge Nova 7 Sparkling
bodyHtml:
Benjamin Bridge's Nova 7 has become a Nova Scotian wine icon in just a short amount of time. It showcases the crispness, beautiful aromatics and signature acidity that are quickly becoming the defining characteristics of outstanding Nova Scotian wine.

Produced in the European spirit of lightly sparkling, off-dry wines, it is a versatile wine that can be enjoyed as an aperitif, at brunch, with friends on a sunny patio or paired with lightly spicy cuisine, fresh fruits or cheeses.

title: Village Blacksmith 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml:
Savour notes of caramel, chocolate and espresso in this well-balanced black-malt ale. In honour of all those who work at the intersection of tradition and innovation.

A dark flavourful ale with notes of chocolate, espresso and licorice. This award-winning beer is known for its exceptional balance of dark malt and medium bitterness.

title: Albert Bichot Santenay Blanc 2019
bodyHtml:
From France’s Burgundy region, in the Côte de Beaune subregion, this wine reflects the elegance of Santenay. Albert Bichot, founded in 1831 and still family-owned, is a leading Burgundy house that focuses on terroir-driven wines crafted with respect for tradition and innovation. The estate is known for producing wines that highlight purity of fruit, balance, and a sense of place.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay offers a brilliant pale gold colour. The nose opens with white flowers, citrus, and notes of candied pineapple, with delicate touches of elderflower and hazelnut. On the palate, it reveals a rich yet mineral style, carried by fresh acidity and a hint of salinity. Subtle notes of gingerbread and vanilla complement flavours of apple and pear. The body is medium to full, smooth, and well-rounded, with a persistent, elegant finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 90 points.

Food Pairing

Pairs beautifully with white meats such as roast chicken, seafood like salmon or halibut, and creamy cheeses.

title: Chateau Sociando Mallet 2022
bodyHtml:
Château Sociando Mallet is located in the commune of Saint-Seurin-de-Cadourne, just north of Saint-Estèphe in the Haut-Médoc. Owned by Jean Gautreau until his passing in 2019, the estate is renowned for producing classically styled, age-worthy Bordeaux wines despite not being part of the 1855 classification. With its gravel-rich terroir and proximity to the Gironde estuary, the vineyard is ideally situated for growing exceptional Cabernet Sauvignon.

Wine Description
The 2022 vintage reveals a deep, inky purple hue in the glass. Aromas of ripe blackcurrant, blackberry, and graphite intertwine with notes of violet, tobacco, and cedar. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied, with firm yet polished tannins and a core of juicy dark fruit supported by a backbone of fresh acidity. Hints of crushed stones and savoury herbs lend added complexity. The finish is persistent, refined, and marked by a classic Médoc structure.

Food Pairing
This structured red wine pairs beautifully with roast lamb, grilled ribeye, or duck breast with red wine reduction. Its depth and minerality also complement wild mushroom risotto or aged hard cheeses such as Comté or Manchego.

title: Bottega Alexander Grappa 'Alex'
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy’s Veneto region, Bottega is a family-owned winery and distillery with a long tradition of craftsmanship in both wine and spirits. Under the Alexander label, the Bottega family showcases its expertise in distilling fine grappas, emphasizing quality, innovation, and a respect for Italian heritage.

Grappa Description

This is a crystal-clear, unaged grappa crafted from select pomace distilled in copper stills. The three-phase distillation process under vacuum and bain-marie heating preserves delicate aromatics. On the nose, it reveals fresh and intense aromas of fruit and flowers with hints of dried berries. The palate is smooth yet powerful, offering elegance and persistence, with lingering fruity notes. Medium-bodied, it strikes a balance between strength and refinement. 

Food Pairing

Pairs beautifully with strong cheeses, dark chocolate, or desserts featuring dried fruits such as figs and dates.

title: Chateau Siran Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
From France’s famed Bordeaux region, specifically the Margaux appellation in the Médoc, Chateau Siran is a historic estate with a lineage tracing back to the 17th century. Family-owned since 1859 by the Miailhe family, the estate stands out for its commitment to sustainable viticulture and meticulous vinification practices that emphasize elegance and longevity.

Wine Description
Chateau Siran Rouge 2022 displays a deep ruby colour with purple reflections. The nose is expressive with aromas of ripe blackberries, cassis, and violets, supported by subtle notes of cedar, graphite, and sweet spice from oak ageing. On the palate, it offers a medium to full body with silky tannins and a fine balance between ripe fruit and freshness. Layers of dark plum, tobacco leaf, and cocoa unfold on the mid-palate, leading to a long, persistent finish with a mineral edge.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 94 points.
  • Wine Spectator – 94 points.
  • Vinous – 94 points.
  • Wine Advocate – 92 points.

Food Pairing

Pairs beautifully with herb-crusted lamb, duck confit, or wild mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Tenuta Bocca de Lupo Cabernet 'Locone' 2022
bodyHtml:
From southern Italy’s Puglia region, the Castel del Monte DOC is home to Tenuta Bocca di Lupo, part of the Antinori family estates. The winery embraces organic viticulture and focuses on expressing the unique character of the Murgia plateau through international and indigenous grape varieties. Its philosophy blends tradition with innovation, highlighting the intensity and freshness that the terroir imparts to Cabernet Sauvignon.

Wine Description

The 2022 ‘Locone’ pours a deep ruby with purple highlights. On the nose, it opens with ripe blackcurrant, bramble, and cherries, lifted by notes of rosemary, mint, cocoa, and liquorice. The palate is generous, starting softly with a juicy fruit core, then evolving into velvety yet firm tannins that provide structure. Hints of herbs and spice add complexity, while the finish is persistent, slightly dry, and well supported by freshness.

Food Pairing

An excellent companion to grilled beef, roast lamb, or hearty pasta ragù. It also pairs well with game and aged cheeses such as Pecorino or Parmigiano-Reggiano.

title: Chateau Joanin Becot 2022
bodyHtml:
Owned by Juliette Becot of the renowned Saint-Émilion Becot family, Chateau Joanin Becot is a rising star in Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux. The estate focuses on sustainable vineyard practices and meticulous winemaking, aiming to produce wines that express the finesse and identity of the terroir. With deep family roots in Bordeaux, the estate benefits from top-tier expertise and a dedication to quality.

This 2022 vintage displays a deep ruby colour with violet reflections. On the nose, it opens with expressive aromas of ripe blackberries, cassis, violets, and hints of sweet spice and graphite. The palate is supple yet structured, showcasing velvety tannins wrapped around juicy black fruit, dark chocolate, and a touch of licorice. Medium to full-bodied with a fresh core and a long, polished finish, the wine reflects its limestone-clay terroir with clarity and poise.

Food Pairing
Pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, mushroom risotto, or aged cheddar. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Chateau La Conseillante 2022
bodyHtml:
Château La Conseillante, founded in the 18th century, is considered one of the jewels of the Pomerol plateau. Owned by the Nicolas family since 1871, the estate is celebrated for its precision, elegance, and consistently refined expression of Merlot blended with Cabernet Franc. Under the direction of winemaker Marielle Cazaux, the château continues to honour tradition while embracing innovation.

Wine Description

The 2022 vintage presents a deep, garnet-purple colour with radiant intensity. Aromas of black raspberries, mulberries, violets, rose petals, and subtle notes of mint and truffle rise from the glass, layered with hints of blackcurrant and crushed stones. The palate is full-bodied and velvet-textured, revealing concentrated flavours of blueberries, plums, Morello cherries, and summer berries. Balanced acidity, refined tannins, and a saline, perfumed finish create a wine that is both sensual and precise. This is an intellectual and harmonious Pomerol that combines depth with finesse.

Accolades

  • Wine Advocate – 100 points

  • Decanter – 100 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck – 98 points

  • Vinous – 98 points

  • James Suckling – 98 points

Food Pairing

A perfect companion to roasted duck breast, filet mignon with truffle sauce, or wild mushroom risotto. Its refined tannins and aromatic complexity also make it an excellent partner for aged cheeses such as Comté or Ossau-Iraty.

title: Moulin de Duhart 2022 (by Chateau Duhart Milon)
bodyHtml:
From the heart of France’s renowned Bordeaux region, Moulin de Duhart 2022 hails from Pauillac on the Left Bank of the Gironde estuary. This second wine of Château Duhart Milon benefits from the same terroir as its Grand Cru sibling. Owned by Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite) since 1962, Château Duhart Milon is celebrated for its meticulous vineyard management and classic Pauillac style, reflecting a philosophy of precision and tradition.

Wine Description

Moulin de Duhart 2022 showcases a deep ruby hue with violet reflections. The nose opens with an expressive bouquet of fresh red berries, raspberry, and wild cherry, interlaced with floral notes of lilac and rose petals. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with velvety tannins and lively acidity, offering flavours of blackcurrant, dark chocolate, and a subtle earthy undertone. Hints of tobacco and spice contribute to a lingering, succulent finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Advocate – 94 points.

  • James Suckling – 96 points.

  • Vinous – 94 points.

Food Pairing

This elegant red pairs beautifully with herb-crusted lamb chops, grilled duck breast, or roasted mushroom risotto. Its layered fruit and earthy character also complement aged cheeses such as Comté or Gruyère.

title: Chateau Chasse Spleen Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
Château Chasse-Spleen is a historic estate in the Left Bank's Moulis-en-Médoc appellation, first recognized for its quality in the 19th century. Today, the estate is owned by the Merlaut family and continues to be a benchmark for excellence in the Médoc. Known for its poetic name inspired by the French writer Baudelaire, Chasse-Spleen has built a reputation for producing wines of elegance and depth that reflect the gravelly terroir of its vineyards.

Wine Description
This 2022 vintage presents a deep ruby-red hue in the glass. The nose opens with a complex bouquet of blackcurrant, graphite, violet, and a hint of cedar, echoing classic Médoc character. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, delivering layers of dark plum, cassis, tobacco leaf, and spice, all carried by structured tannins and fresh acidity. The blend typically includes Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Petit Verdot, showcasing the harmony between ripe fruit and refined oak influence.

Food Pairing
Ideal with roast lamb, duck confit, or grilled portobello mushrooms with truffle oil. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Grizzly Paw Mountain Mule 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml: Made with Grizzly Paw Ginger Beer, lime juice, and Vodka. This mule can kick... but in a friendly non-aggressive kind of way. It kicks like the way you kick your feet up after getting home from a long hike.

title: Borgogno Pinot Grigio 'Zamogrigio'
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Friuli in north-eastern Italy, Le Vigne di Zamò is a family-run estate established in 1978 and now overseen by Tullio Zamò and his family. The winery is known for combining tradition with innovation, focusing on varietal purity and expressing the distinct terroirs of Friuli. Their vineyards, situated across some of the region’s finest hillsides, are cultivated with deep respect for the land and local winemaking heritage.

Wine Description

This wine is made entirely from Pinot Grigio grapes, one of Friuli’s most renowned white varietals. It shows a bright straw-yellow colour with coppery reflections. On the nose, it offers delicate floral notes layered with pineapple, banana, and subtle pear. The palate is fresh and rounded, with good body and a savoury mineral edge.

Food Pairing

A versatile choice as an aperitif, this Pinot Grigio shines alongside shellfish, sushi, and light antipasti. It also pairs beautifully with delicate baked fish, vegetable soups, or creamy risottos.

title: Dormilona White Blend 'Orenji'
bodyHtml:
From Australia’s renowned Margaret River region in Western Australia, Dormilona is the project of winemaker Josephine Perry, who is known for her organic and minimal-intervention approach. The winery has gained a reputation for producing expressive, textural wines that reflect the purity of the fruit and the individuality of each site.

Wine Description
Dormilona ‘Orenji’ is a skin-contact white blend of Semillon and Sauvignon Blanc. Fermented on skins for two weeks and matured in cement egg for eight weeks, it displays a striking amber hue. Aromas of peach, guava, and lemongrass mingle with notes of citrus and tropical fruit. The palate is lively and textural, with hints of tart persimmon and a subtle chewiness from extended skin contact. Balanced acidity carries through to a clean, persistent finish.

Food Pairing
Excellent with spiced dishes, grilled vegetables, seafood, and richer cheeses.

title: Laurent Saillard Gamay Noir La Pause
bodyHtml:
From the Loire Valley in France, this wine is crafted by Laurent Saillard, a former restaurateur turned winemaker who has embraced natural and organic practices. Saillard works with old vines planted in 1978, originally part of the famed Clos Roche Blanche estate, and is committed to producing pure, terroir-driven wines with minimal intervention.

Wine Description

This Gamay Noir pours a bright ruby red in the glass. The nose is fragrant with aromas of red cherries, raspberries, and wild strawberries, complemented by subtle floral notes and a touch of earthiness. On the palate, it is fresh and lively, with juicy red fruit, gentle spice, and a mineral backbone. The body is light to medium, supported by vibrant acidity and fine-grained tannins, leading to a clean, elegant finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile Gamay pairs beautifully with charcuterie, roasted chicken, mushroom dishes, or even a simple Margherita pizza. Its freshness and balance make it equally suitable for lighter fare such as grilled salmon or vegetarian dishes with herbs.

title: Cibonne Rose Tentations 2025
bodyHtml:
From France’s Provence region, Clos Cibonne is a family-run estate with deep historical roots dating back to the late 18th century. Known as one of the rare estates authorized to use the Tibouren grape, Clos Cibonne champions authenticity and tradition while embracing modern, sustainable viticulture. The winery has gained a reputation for producing distinctive rosés with both freshness and depth, setting it apart in Provence.

Wine Description
This rosé shows a vibrant salmon-pink hue. The nose reveals fresh aromas of blood orange, rhubarb, peach, wild strawberry, and delicate floral hints, accented by a touch of smoke. On the palate, it offers lively citrus zest and red fruit notes with a savoury edge contributed by Tibouren, supported by gentle tannins and a fruit-sweet core. The body is medium, finishing crisp and dry with mineral undertones.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with Mediterranean fare such as grilled vegetables, Niçoise salad, or herb-roasted chicken. It also complements seafood pasta and lightly spiced dishes.

title: Anthony Buchanan White Blend 'Snafu' 2022
bodyHtml:
Crafted in Canada’s Okanagan Valley, Anthony Buchanan Wines is a small-scale, artisanal producer known for minimal-intervention winemaking. Buchanan, a sommelier turned winemaker, is dedicated to creating expressive wines that highlight vineyard character through organic farming, ambient yeast fermentation, and low sulphur use.

Wine Description

This white blend pours a pale straw hue with golden reflections. The nose is aromatic and layered, offering pineapple, pear, apple pith, and delicate white flowers, alongside hints of ginger spice and honey. On the palate, it is textural yet vibrant, with flavours of stone fruit, cantaloupe, and a subtle pie-crust funk. Medium-bodied with streaming acidity, the wine finishes clean and mineral-driven.

Food Pairing

Pair this wine with fresh seafood such as scallops, ceviche, or mussels, where the bright acidity complements briny flavours. It also works beautifully with roasted poultry, fresh cheeses, or lightly spiced Asian dishes.

title: Saumur Cabernet Franc La Paleine 2023
bodyHtml:
From France’s Loire Valley, this wine hails from the Saumur appellation, specifically the Puy-Notre-Dame subregion. Domaine de la Paleine, an organically and biodynamically farmed estate, oversees around 35 hectares of vines. Established with a philosophy of expressing terroir through minimal intervention, the domaine is known for producing elegant and terroir-driven Cabernet Franc and Chenin Blanc.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Franc displays a deep ruby hue. The nose offers lifted aromas of red cherry, raspberry, and subtle blackcurrant, accented by mineral undertones and a hint of spice. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, with supple tannins and lively acidity. Flavours of ripe red fruit mingle with earthy and herbal notes, finishing long and balanced. The wine shows freshness and precision, reflecting the limestone and marl soils of the region.

Food Pairing

Pairs beautifully with roast lamb, grilled beef, duck breast, or earthy mushroom dishes. It also complements hard cheeses such as aged Comté or Cheddar.

title: Glenfiddich 23 Year Old Grand Cru Single Malt Scotch Whisky
bodyHtml:
Matured in a small number of ex-sherry casks and American oak casks, Glenfiddich Grand Cru has been finished for four months in a combination of first-fill and second-fill French oak casks that have been used to ferment wine that will eventually become a famous sparkling wine. The palate offers notes of creamy vanilla, brioche, pear sorbet and white grapes, complimented by aromas of freshly-baked bread, apple blossom and lemons.

Caroline Roddis (The Whisky Exchange):

NOSE:  Soft lemon and pink lady apple notes sit alongside a heavier creaminess. Marzipan and honey brioche follow. The apple becomes more intense with time, picking up grapes, floral honey and the merest hint of red fruits along the way.

PALATE:  Oily. Sweet, honeyed fruits and a rush of cream, then baked apple tart with extra apple skins and flecks of spice. The sweet nuttiness from the nose is present too.

FINISH:  Dry and short, with notes of hazelnuts, brioche and honeysuckle.

title: Lafon & Chamboissier 'Racine' Rose
bodyHtml:
France’s Provence region is renowned for producing some of the world’s most elegant rosé wines, and Lafon & Chamboissier is a stellar representation of that legacy. The winery is a collaboration between Dominique Lafon—famed for his work in Burgundy—and François Chamboissier of Bordeaux, who have joined forces to create terroir-driven wines from select southern French vineyards. Their approach emphasizes minimal intervention and precision, honouring the character of each grape and vineyard site.

Wine Description
This Provence rosé pours a delicate, pale salmon pink, shimmering in the glass. The nose is vibrant with notes of fresh wild strawberries, red currants, and white peach, lifted by a floral whisper of rose petals and citrus zest. On the palate, it is dry, crisp, and elegantly textured, showing flavours of stone fruit, grapefruit, and a hint of herbaceous garrigue. The wine is light to medium in body with bright acidity and a clean, mineral-laced finish.

Food Pairing
Perfect alongside Niçoise salad, grilled Mediterranean vegetables, or herb-marinated chicken. Its crispness also complements seafood dishes like shrimp ceviche or seared tuna. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Cass Fresh Beer 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Korea's #1 selling and most loved beer.

This lager goes through a sophisticated Cold Brew method for 72 hours using the best raw ingredients to make the ultra refreshing and clean taste.

title: Le Carillon de l'Angelus 2021
bodyHtml:
Le Carillon de l'Angélus is the second wine from Château Angélus, a Premier Grand Cru Classé 'A' estate located in the Bordeaux region of France, specifically in the Saint-Émilion appellation. The de Boüard family has owned the estate for eight generations. The vineyard is situated in a natural amphitheatre, a location that amplifies the sounds of the bells from the surrounding churches, which inspired the name Angélus. The winemaking is precise and meticulous, with a focus on preserving aromatics.

Wine Description

The 2021 vintage of Le Carillon de l'Angélus is a blend of 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Franc. The wine offers a nose with aromas of fresh, ripe, and spicy fruit. It also features scents of black cherries, mulberries, redcurrants, and flowers, along with hints of cedar, clove, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied with pliant tannins and a fine bead of acidity. It is described as elegant, balanced, and fresh, with a suave and harmonious finish. It also has a lovely energy and a smooth, long finish. The wine is a classic, mid-weight Bordeaux that is enjoyable in its youth but also has aging potential.

Accolades

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 94 points

  • James Suckling - 93 points

  • Vinous - 93 points

  • Decanter - 92 points

  • Wine Advocate - 92 points

title: Le Carillon de l'Angelus 2016
bodyHtml:
Le Carillon de l'Angélus is the second wine from Château Angélus, a Premier Grand Cru Classé 'A' estate located in the Bordeaux region of France, specifically in the Saint-Émilion appellation. The de Boüard family has owned and operated the château since 1782, and its history is deeply tied to the Angélus prayer, which was traditionally heard from the three churches surrounding the vineyard. Since 2012, Stéphanie de Boüard-Rivoal, who represents the eighth generation of the family, has been at the helm of the estate. The winemaking is precise and meticulous, with a focus on preserving aromatics and adapting techniques to the specific style of the wine.

Wine Description

This wine is a blend of 75% Merlot and 25% Cabernet Franc. It is appreciated for its pure fruit aromas, velvety tannins, and elegant finish. The 2016 vintage has a deep, sensual, and beautifully layered character. On the nose, it offers a "rocking" bouquet of cassis, black cherries, black raspberries, dried herbs, and graphite, with notes of spice box, chocolate, and wet stones. The palate is medium to full-bodied with a seamless, balanced, and impressively textured feel. It features lively red and black fruit flavours and is structured with soft, fine-grained tannins and fresh acidity. While the wine can be enjoyed now, it has a long-term aging potential and is expected to evolve well for 10-15 years.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 95 points

  • Decanter - 94 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 93 points

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 93 points

  • Wine Enthusiast - 93 points

  • Vinous - 92 points

Food Pairing

The wine's rich character and polished tannins make it a versatile pairing partner. It would be a perfect match for grilled red meats like steak or lamb, which can stand up to its full body and structure. The wine's earthy and savoury notes also complement dishes featuring mushrooms or truffles. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Grizzly Paw Rutting Elk Red 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Grizzly Paw Rutting Elk Red Ale is a cornerstone of the core lineup at The Grizzly Paw Brewing Company in Canmore, Alberta. As one of the brewery’s most decorated and recognizable beers, it pays homage to the majestic elk that roam the Bow Valley. This Red Ale is designed to be a "mountain classic," offering a richer, more malt-forward experience than a standard lager while remaining exceptionally balanced and accessible for all-day enjoyment.

Beer Description

This Amber/Red Ale pours a beautiful, clear mahogany to deep copper color with a dense, creamy off-white head.

Aroma: It features an inviting and warm bouquet of toasted malts, with distinct notes of caramel, toffee, and a light nuttiness, complemented by a subtle earthy hop presence.

Palate: The flavor profile is dominated by a rich, biscuit-like malt sweetness. Notes of burnt sugar and caramel are balanced by a gentle, spicy hop bitterness that provides a clean and structured finish. It offers a medium body with a smooth, velvety mouthfeel.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% and a moderate bitterness of 20 IBU, making it a flavorful yet highly sessionable choice for those who prefer malt complexity over hop intensity.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a specialized blend of roasted and crystal malts to achieve its signature color and sweet-toasted flavor profile. It utilizes traditional bittering hops to ensure the malt remains the star of the show while maintaining a crisp, balanced edge.

title: Stella Artois 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml: Stella Artois is a premium European lager of noble traditions, that truly symbolizes European style and sophistication. It traces its roots to 1366, has a full distinctive taste and is brewed with the finest barley and hops.

title: Tears Of Llorona Extra Anejo Tequila - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originally intended to be German Gonzalez’ own private stock, Tears of Llorona No. 3 Extra Anejo Tequila is hand-crafted from 100% blue agave grown in the volcanic soil surrounding Atotonilco, in the highlands of Jalisco, where growth is extremely slow. Gonzalez selects these agaves late in the harvest, at their peak ripeness, using his years of experience and special knowledge passed down from his father. 

Once harvested, Gonzalez brings the agaves to his distillery where they are roasted, then shredded, in the traditional way to extract the sugar-rich juice called the aguamiel. The aguamiel is then fermented with a proprietary strain of yeast before being twice-distilled through copper pot stills.

After distillation, the Tears of Llorona No. 3 Extra Anejo Tequila is aged for nearly five years in several different types of barrels — half ex-Scotch whisky barrels, a quarter Sherry casks and another quarter French Limousin barrels previously used to mature Cognac — before being blended together at optimal maturity.

title: Crown Royal Reserve 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
