Crown Royal, established in 1939 to commemorate the royal tour of Canada by King George VI and Queen Elizabeth, has become a symbol of Canadian whisky excellence. Crafted in Gimli, Manitoba, the distillery is renowned for its meticulous blending techniques and dedication to quality. The Crown Royal Reserve 12 Year Old is a testament to this legacy, offering a refined expression of their craftsmanship.

Whisky Description
The Crown Royal Reserve 12 Year Old presents a rich amber hue, indicative of its extended maturation. On the nose, it exudes aromas of red and orchard fruits, complemented by vanilla and light baking spices. The palate reveals a harmonious blend of orchard fruit, white chocolate, rye spice, and toasted oak, delivering a full-bodied and complex experience. The finish is smooth and lingering, with mild heat and notes of cinnamon spice and apple.

Serving Suggestions
This distinguished whisky is best enjoyed neat or with a splash of water to fully appreciate its intricate flavours. It also serves as an excellent base for classic cocktails such as the Old Fashioned or Manhattan, where its depth adds a sophisticated twist. Pairing it with dark chocolate or a fine cigar can further enhance the tasting experience, highlighting the whisky's depth and character.

title: Heineken 0.0 (Non Alcoholic) 330 ml - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Heineken 0.0 is a non alcoholic lager originating from the Netherlands. The Heineken company was founded in 1864 by Gerard Adriaan Heineken, who purchased the 'De Hooiberg' brewery in Amsterdam. To this day, the brewery remains under the significant influence of the Heineken family, maintaining a legacy of independent brewing that has spanned over 150 years.

Description

This non alcoholic lager presents a golden yellow appearance with a soft, white foam. The aroma is crisp and flavourful, characterized by refreshing fruity notes and a classic malty scent. On the palate, it offers a perfectly balanced taste with a soft malty body and a subtle hint of sweetness. The body is smooth and refreshing, leading to a clean finish that is less bitter than many traditional lagers. It contains 0.0% alcohol by volume and is crafted using the same natural ingredients as the original lager.

Food Pairing

The crisp and balanced profile of this brew makes it a versatile companion for various snacks and light meals. It pairs exceptionally well with salty hot chips or pretzels, where the malt sweetness contrasts effectively with the salt. For a more substantial pairing, it complements a classic margherita pizza, acting as a palate cleanser between bites of savoury cheese and tomato. It also harmonizes with light proteins such as grilled chicken or mild fish dishes like cod.

Distinctive Features

Heineken 0.0 is distinguished by its 'double brewed' process, which uses the same natural ingredients as Heineken Original, including the unique A Yeast developed in 1886. The alcohol is gently removed using vacuum distillation before the brew is blended with natural flavourings to ensure a distinctively balanced profile. This alcohol free option is also a lower calorie choice, containing only 21 calories per 100ml.

Serving Suggestions

For the most refreshing experience, this beer should be chilled in the refrigerator for at least an hour before serving. It is ideally poured into a chilled beer glass or mug at a 45 degree angle to create a proper head of foam. The glass should be slowly straightened as the pour reaches three quarters full to achieve a perfect finish. While it is enjoyable on its own, it can also be garnished with a slice of lime or lemon for a bright citrus twist.

title: Stiegl Grapefruit Radler 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Stiegl Grapefruit Radler originates from Salzburg, Austria. It is produced by the Stieglbrauerei zu Salzburg, an independent, family owned brewery founded in 1492, making it one of Austria's most historic brewing institutions. The brewery has been owned by the Kiener family for more than 120 years and is currently the largest private brewery in Austria, known for blending centuries-old traditions with modern innovation.

Beer Description

This refreshing radler is a blend of Stiegl Goldbräu lager (40%) and natural grapefruit soda (60%), resulting in a beverage that is golden to pale yellow with a natural amber cloudiness. The sensory profile is dominated by a fresh, zesty grapefruit aroma with subtle hints of sweet pale malt. On the palate, it delivers a juicy and tangy fruitiness with a sweet-tart combination that is balanced by the crispness of the beer base. The body is light and effervescent with moderate carbonation, leading to a smooth, clean, and highly refreshing finish. The brew contains real grapefruit juice and is free from artificial sweeteners and colouring. It has a low alcohol content, typically ranging between 2% and 2.5% ABV.

title: Uncommon Haskup Berry Cider 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This distinctive craft cider is produced in Canada by Uncommon Cider Co., which is Western Canada's first urban cidery located in Calgary, Alberta. Established in 2016 by founder Brodie Thomas, the company was born from a passion for traditional full-juice, English-style ciders discovered while living overseas. The cidery's philosophy revolves around a quality-driven approach that pushes the boundaries of traditional cider-making through constant experimentation and strong community involvement.

The Haskap Berry Cider is a core, year-round offering that gains its unique character and vibrant blush colour from the addition of haskap berries, a sweet-tart blue fruit. It displays a striking pink colour and offers a complex aromatic profile with notes of pomegranate, plum, and fruit leather. On the palate, the cider is light and refreshing with a subtle berry sweetness balanced by the crisp acidity of the apple base. Stylistically, it remains true to the producer's commitment to using 100 per cent pressed fruit juice rather than concentrates or added sweeteners. The alcohol by volume (ABV) for this cider is 6.7 per cent. It is naturally gluten-free.

title: Il Borro Pian Di Nova Toscana 2022
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s celebrated Tuscany region, Pian di Nova is produced by Il Borro, a prestigious estate near San Giustino Valdarno in the province of Arezzo. Owned by the Ferragamo family since 1993, the estate has become a symbol of Tuscan excellence, merging a centuries-old winemaking tradition with modern sustainability and craftsmanship.

Wine Description
In the glass, it shows a deep ruby colour with violet reflections. The nose is expressive with notes of ripe red berries, violets, and a hint of spice such as black pepper and cardamom. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied, offering juicy cherry and blackberry flavours layered with subtle nutmeg and pimento. The tannins are soft and velvety, while a bright acidity brings freshness and balance.

Food Pairing
This wine’s supple tannins and spice make it a versatile partner for a variety of dishes. Pair with roasted lamb, beef tenderloin, wild boar ragù, or aged Pecorino cheese. It also complements spiced cuisines such as Indian lamb curry.

title: Roemerhof Riesling Kabinett 2022
bodyHtml:
The Roemerhof Riesling Kabinett originates from Germany's esteemed Mosel region, specifically crafted from grapes grown in the middle Mosel Valley. The winery is owned by the Heinz Eifel family, who have been producing wine in the heart of the Mosel for over 400 years. Working alongside his daughter, winemaker Anne Eifel-Spohr, Heinz Eifel focuses on producing award winning Rieslings that reflect the tradition and character of ancient Roman wine culture in the region.

Wine Description

This 100% Riesling presents as a well balanced young wine with a fresh and fruity profile. On the nose, it exudes vibrant aromas of peaches and citrus, which carry through to the palate alongside a crisp acidity that expertly balances its slight sweetness. The wine is light bodied with a low alcohol content of approximately 8.5%, offering a clean and refreshing finish.

Food Pairing

The gentle sweetness and bright acidity of this Kabinett make it an ideal companion for aged cheeses, such as sharp cheddar or gouda. It also pairs beautifully with chicken dishes and rich cream sauces, which are cut through by the wine's refreshing structure.

title: Erdinger Oktoberfest 500 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml: Pours cloudy amber in colour with a frothy white head. Fresh fruit aromas and smooth malt flavours are combined with a pronounced hop bitterness. Round and full-bodied with a clean and refreshing mouthfeel. Enjoy this festive brew served in a stein! Pair with pork sausages with grainy mustard.

title: Mission Hill Quatrain 2020
bodyHtml:
Mission Hill Family Estate is one of the most acclaimed wineries in Canada, founded in 1981 by Anthony von Mandl. With a philosophy rooted in sustainable vineyard practices and artisanal winemaking, Mission Hill has become a benchmark for the Okanagan, showcasing the region’s ability to produce world-class wines of depth and elegance.

Wine Description

In the glass, it displays a deep ruby hue. Aromas of dark plum, blackberry, and subtle spice rise immediately, layered with hints of chocolate and dried herbs. On the palate, juicy notes of red currant and blueberry bring freshness, while smoky accents and supple tannins create a structured yet vibrant mouthfeel. Full-bodied, with a rounded texture and a lingering, precise finish, this wine offers both power and finesse. 

Food Pairing

An excellent companion to grilled steak, braised lamb shank, or mushroom risotto. Aged cheeses with bold character also complement its depth.

title: Cacchiano Chianti Classico 2021
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s heartland, the Cacchiano Chianti Classico originates in Gaiole in Chianti, within the historic Chianti Classico DOCG of Tuscany. Castello di Cacchiano, owned by Count Giovanni Ricasoli-Firidolfi, continues a family lineage dating back over a thousand years. The estate’s winemaking philosophy centres on respecting tradition while refining balance and terroir expression.

Wine Description
This wine shows a brilliant ruby red colour. On the nose, it offers fresh red fruits such as raspberries and currants, accented with hints of orange blossom and subtle spice. The palate is juicy and savoury, framed by vibrant acidity and fine, firm tannins that give structure and length.

Food Pairing
Ideal with Tuscan classics such as bistecca alla fiorentina, wild boar ragù, or aged pecorino. Its lively acidity also complements tomato-based pastas, grilled lamb, or earthy mushroom dishes.

title: Cacchiano Chianti Classico Riserva 2020
bodyHtml:
From the rolling hills of Tuscany, Italy, this Chianti Classico Riserva hails from Castello di Cacchiano, an estate with deep roots in Gaiole in Chianti. Owned by the Ricasoli family for nearly a thousand years, the winery is renowned for its commitment to traditional winemaking balanced with modern refinement. Its vineyards, planted at elevations of 340 to 490 metres, are celebrated for producing wines with elegance and longevity.

Wine Description

This Riserva displays a brilliant ruby red colour. The nose is layered with ripe Vignola cherries, red plums, and floral undertones, intertwined with notes of tobacco, cocoa, and Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it offers a harmonious structure with tightly knit yet elegant tannins, medium to full body, and a savoury freshness that carries into a persistent finish.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with bistecca alla Fiorentina, roast lamb with rosemary, or mature pecorino.

title: El Tocador Old Vines Tempranillo 2023
bodyHtml:
From Spain’s vast wine region of Castilla La Mancha, El Tocador showcases the country’s most celebrated grape, Tempranillo. This old-vine bottling reflects the heritage of the vineyards, where mature vines yield fruit of intensity and depth. The philosophy behind El Tocador emphasizes expressive fruit, balanced winemaking, and accessibility, making it a strong representation of modern Spanish value wines.

Wine Description

In the glass, the wine presents a deep ruby to violet colour. Aromas open with ripe black cherries, blueberry jam, and rose petals, layered with hints of mocha, dark chocolate, and dried herbs. On the palate, velvety tannins frame flavours of berry compote, dark cherry, and cherry cola, accented by vanilla, clove, and anise. Medium to full-bodied, the wine finishes long, with lingering spice and subtle freshness.

Food Pairing

This Tempranillo is versatile at the table. It pairs beautifully with roast lamb, grilled beef, or rich stews, while its fruit and spice notes complement cured meats and manchego cheese.

title: Ol' Beautiful Fingers Crossed NEIPA 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Ol' Beautiful Fingers Crossed is an award-winning New England IPA (NEIPA) that has quickly become a standout in the Calgary brewery’s core lineup. Celebrated for its excellence, it recently secured a Silver Medal at the 2024 Alberta Brewing Awards. This beer exemplifies the hazy movement, focusing on a massive fruit-forward hop presence and a soft, approachable texture rather than the aggressive bitterness found in traditional IPAs.

Beer Description

This New England IPA pours with a characteristic heavy haze and a pale, golden-straw color, topped by a thick, frothy white head.

Aroma: The nose is hit with an immediate wave of tropical intensity. Expect dominant notes of lush pineapple and ripe mango, complemented by bright citrus undertones of orange and lime.

Palate: On the palate, the beer is notably silky and fluffy. It delivers a juicy explosion of tropical fruit flavors that mirror the aroma, all while maintaining a very low bitterness. The mouthfeel is pillowy and full, leading to a smooth, clean finish.

Profile: It has an ABV of 6.0% and is characterized by a low bitterness profile, making it much more approachable than a standard West Coast IPA.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a hefty malt base that includes oats or wheat to create its signature pillowy mouthfeel. It is heavily dry-hopped with a combination of Citra and Azacca hops, which are responsible for the intense pineapple and mango characteristics.

title: Vina Albina Reserva 2019
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Spain's celebrated Rioja region, Viña Albina Reserva 2019 hails from Rioja Alta, a subregion renowned for producing refined, age-worthy wines. It is crafted by Bodegas Riojanas, a historic winery founded in 1890 by the Artacho and Cuevas families. The winery’s legacy is deeply rooted in traditional Rioja winemaking, with a continued focus on quality, heritage, and terroir expression.

Wine Description

This reserva opens with a deep ruby hue and garnet reflections, hinting at its careful aging. On the nose, it reveals elegant aromas of ripe red berries, dried plum, and cherry, layered with subtle vanilla, clove, and toasted cedar from extended oak aging. The palate is medium to full bodied, offering a balanced structure with silky tannins, a core of dark fruit, and hints of leather, spice, and cocoa that add to its complexity. The finish is long and smooth, showcasing the harmony between fruit and oak.

Food Pairing

Pairs beautifully with roast lamb, grilled ribeye steak, or traditional Spanish tapas such as jamón ibérico and aged Manchego cheese. It also complements mushroom risottos or pasta with savoury tomato sauces.

title: Maison Castel Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Maison Castel Chardonnay 2023 is a white wine from France, produced by Maison Castel, which was founded in 1949 by nine Castel siblings. The company's philosophy is to produce quality French wines that can be enjoyed by everyone. Maison Castel sources grapes from various French regions, which is reflected in its diverse portfolio of wines.

Wine Description

This wine is a 100% Chardonnay. It has a pale or bright yellow colour. The nose presents ripe notes of peach and pineapple. The palate is subtle and delicate with a refreshing finish. It is described as being well-balanced with a focus on fresh citrus and white-fleshed fruit aromas. The wine is also noted for being unoaked. The grapes are sourced from different geographic areas, including the Mediterranean region, which provides ripe fruit and tropical notes, and the Côtes de Gascogne, which contributes acidity and citrus aromas.

title: Gray Monk Latitude 50 White 2024
bodyHtml:
Gray Monk Latitude 50 White is a white wine from the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia, Canada. The winery, Gray Monk Estate Winery, was established in 1972 by George and Trudy Heiss. The Heiss family, who came from Austria and Germany, were pioneers in the BC wine industry and were the first to plant Pinot Gris in the province. Today, the winery is proudly owned and operated by Andrew Peller Limited.

Wine Description

This wine is a blend of several white varietals, which can include Vidal, Gewürztraminer, Riesling, and Muscat. The 2024 vintage, for example, is a blend of Vidal, Gewürztraminer, Riesling, and Muscat grapes. The wine has a pale straw hue. On the nose, it has delicate notes of orange blossom and white peach. The palate is a blend of citrusy freshness and the subtle sweetness of ripe peaches and other orchard fruits like melon and apple. It is described as light to medium-bodied, smooth, refreshing, and off-dry, with a hint of spice on the finish. The grapes are gently pressed and the juice is cool-fermented and aged in stainless steel tanks to preserve the fruit's aromatics.

title: Brotte Gigondas 'La Marasque' 2022
bodyHtml:
Maison Brotte is a family-run estate founded in 1931, rooted in the Southern Rhône Valley and known for its innovation and expression of terroir. Currently led by Laurent Brotte, the third generation, the winery upholds a tradition of crafting elegant, terroir-driven wines. The Gigondas vineyards, nestled at the foot of the Dentelles de Montmirail, benefit from rugged limestone soils and a Mediterranean climate, producing wines of structure and aromatic richness.

This 2022 Gigondas pours a deep ruby red with purple hues. The nose is intense and fragrant, offering aromas of cherry brandy, wild red berries, black pepper, garrigue, and hints of licorice and vanilla. On the palate, it is generous and full-bodied, layered with ripe cherry, jammy red and black fruits, and savoury herbs. The tannins are velvety yet firm, providing balance to the wine’s rich texture and lingering spice-laced finish.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with braised beef short ribs, wild boar terrine, or grilled lamb with rosemary. Its spice and structure also complement Indian dishes with rich sauces or Mexican mole.

title: First Drop Chardonnay Real Time 2023
bodyHtml:
First Drop 'Real Time' Chardonnay is a white wine from Australia, with fruit sourced from the Adelaide Hills, a region known for its quality Chardonnay. The winery, First Drop, was founded in 2004 by friends Matt Gant and John Retsas. Their philosophy is to create wines that are meant to be enjoyed and appreciated, combining traditional sensibility with a passion for innovation. Based at their 'Home of the Brave' winery in the Barossa Valley, they are known for their modern, vibrant, and approachable wines.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay has a pale straw colour. The nose offers notes of apples, yellow peach, pear blossoms, and hints of toasted hazelnuts. The palate has flavours of nectarine, white peaches, and fresh lemon curd, with hints of brioche. It is a restrained and refined expression of Chardonnay, with a tightly textured palate and minimal oak influence, keeping the wine vibrant and clean.

title: Evesham Wood Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
From the United States, this Pinot Noir hails from Oregon’s renowned Willamette Valley, a region celebrated for producing some of North America’s most elegant expressions of the grape. Founded in 1986, Evesham Wood is committed to sustainable, low-intervention winemaking, with vineyards certified organic and farmed following Biodynamic principles. The winery’s philosophy emphasizes balance, respect for terroir, and wines that authentically reflect place.

Wine Description

Evesham Wood Pinot Noir shows a brilliant ruby hue in the glass. Aromas reveal layers of red cherry, raspberry, and subtle floral notes, lifted by hints of loam and spice. On the palate, it is silky and medium-bodied, with lively acidity supporting bright red fruit flavours and gentle earthy undertones. A touch of oak adds structure without overwhelming the fruit, leading to a long, graceful finish.

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with roast duck, mushroom risotto, or cedar-plank salmon. The bright acidity cuts through richness, while earthy undertones resonate with savoury dishes.

title: Nueveuno Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Nueveuno Añejo Tequila is a Mexican tequila from the Valles (lowlands) subregion of Jalisco. It is produced by Agavero Unidos de Amatitán, S.A. de C.V.. The brand aims to produce a traditional, classic, and complex tequila with a focus on using 100% Blue Weber agave. The tequila is also certified kosher and is a confirmed additive-free spirit.

Description

This tequila has an amber colour with golden hues and is full-bodied. It is made from 100% organic agave that is cooked in stone/brick ovens and then distilled in stainless steel pot stills. It is aged for up to 18 months in used American white oak bourbon barrels. The aroma has delicate notes of orange peel, vanilla, caramel, and spices such as cinnamon and cloves. You can also find ripe fruit aromas like banana and mango, as well as notes of maple and cappuccino coffee. The palate is sweet and powerful, confirming the aromas achieved during the aging process. The finish is very long-lasting. This tequila is certified organic.

title: Drumshanbo Gunpowder Brazilian Pineapple Gin
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Drumshanbo Gunpowder Brazilian Pineapple Gin is an Irish gin from the Shed Distillery in the rural village of Drumshanbo, County Leitrim, Ireland. The Shed Distillery was founded by PJ Rigney, whose goal was to fuse oriental botanicals with local Irish ones. This particular gin is part of the 'Curious Cocktail Collection'.

Description

This gin is a variation of the original Drumshanbo Gunpowder Irish Gin, which is slow-distilled by hand in medieval copper pot stills. The original gin is made with a combination of eight botanicals distilled in the pot still and four botanicals that are vapour-infused, including Chinese gunpowder tea, oriental grapefruit, Chinese lemon, and kaffir lime. The Brazilian Pineapple Gin adds a new layer of flavour with the inclusion of Brazilian pineapple. The gin's taste profile is citrus-forward, with notes of juniper, grapefruit, and green tea, and a subtle spiciness. The Shed Distillery prioritizes organic and fair-trade practices, ensuring all botanicals are grown without harmful chemicals.

title: Alberta Premium Golden Rye 9 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Alberta Premium Golden Rye 9 Year Old is a Canadian whisky from Alberta, Canada, distilled by Alberta Distillers Ltd.. Located in Calgary, Alberta Distillers is one of the few remaining 100 per cent Canadian rye whisky producers in North America and has been producing whisky for over 50 years. The distillery was founded in 1946 by local entrepreneurs Max Bell and Frank McMahon with the goal of creating high-quality, affordable products that are grounded in western Canadian values. The company is known for its 'seed to sip' philosophy, which emphasizes local sourcing, transparency, and quality at every stage of production, and uses grains from the Canadian Prairies and water from the Canadian Rockies.

Description

This whisky is crafted with 100 per cent Canadian rye grain and aged for nine years. The aging process uses three distinct barrel styles: new white oak, ex-bourbon, and ex-Canadian whisky casks. It has a golden amber colour. The aroma is described as having notes of caramel, leather, and coconut. On the palate, the whisky has flavours of raisin and molasses, with a finish that is sweet, yet laced with the signature rye spice. It is noted for its complexity and smoothness. There is no information to indicate that this whisky is organic.

Accolades

  • International Wine & Spirits Competition - Silver Medal

title: Pagodes de Cos 2022
bodyHtml:
From the renowned Saint Estephe appellation in Bordeaux, France, Pagodes de Cos is the esteemed second wine of Château Cos d’Estournel, a classified Second Growth estate with deep roots in the Médoc. Founded in the early 19th century, the winery is now under the ownership of Michel Reybier, whose commitment to precision and innovation upholds the estate’s reputation for bold yet refined wines.

Wine Description
The 2022 vintage of Pagodes de Cos presents a vivid, deep ruby hue in the glass. Aromas unfurl with dark cherries, cassis, crushed violets, and hints of graphite and cedar. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied yet graceful, with layers of blackcurrant, ripe plum, dark chocolate, and a subtle spice from well-integrated oak. The tannins are smooth and polished, supporting a long, harmonious finish.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 95 Points

  • Decanter - 94 Points

Food Pairing
Ideal with roasted lamb, duck confit, or grilled portobello mushrooms, this wine’s structure and elegance are enhanced by dishes with earthy and savoury elements. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Vilmart Grande Reserve Premier Cru (NV)
bodyHtml:
This prestigious and 'harmonious' sparkling wine originates from France, within the Rilly-la-Montagne terroir of the Montagne de Reims subregion in Champagne. Founded in 1890 by Désiré Vilmart, the house has remained family-owned for five generations and is currently led by Laurent Champs. Vilmart & Cie is a renowned 'récoltant-manipulant', meaning they produce champagne exclusively from their own 11 hectares of estate-owned Premier Cru vines. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a 'wine first' approach, utilizing large oak casks for vinification and strictly avoiding malolactic fermentation to preserve the natural freshness, tautness, and 'pronounced identity' of the fruit.

Wine Description

The Grande Réserve Premier Cru presents a bright appearance with a 'finely detailed bead' and persistent mousse. The sensory profile is rich and complex, featuring an intense nose of white flowers such as honeysuckle and lilac, layered with notes of ripe cherry, pear, and fresh butter. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and 'silky', showcasing flavours of crunchy Asian pear, tangerine, and slivered almond, complemented by hints of grated ginger and elderflower. It is characterized by a creamy texture and a 'frank vinosity' that balances strength with an invigorating freshness. The finish is clean, long, and slightly mineral, often trailing off with a final note of grapefruit. This blend typically consists of 70% Pinot Noir and 30% Chardonnay, reaching an alcohol content (ABV) of 12.5%. The estate is committed to environmentally friendly viticulture and holds certifications for 'Haute Valeur Environnementale' (High Environmental Value) and 'Viticulture Durable' (Sustainable Viticulture).

title: Nueveuno Deep Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Nueveuno is an artisanal tequila brand rooted in the heart of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted by Nohemi Partida, one of the few female master distillers in the industry, the brand stands out not only for its commitment to sustainability and organic practices, but also for its dedication to producing tequila that is authentic and expressive.

This Deep Reposado expression is aged in a double barrel system, delivering a rich, layered profile that straddles the line between reposado and añejo. In the glass, it shows a golden amber hue. The nose opens with aromas of cooked agave, vanilla, and caramel, followed by subtle notes of oak, hazelnut, and dried fruit. On the palate, it is smooth and full-bodied, offering a rich blend of spice, warm wood tones, and roasted agave sweetness, with a lingering, elegant finish. 

Food Pairing
Ideal alongside grilled lamb chops with rosemary, mole poblano, or aged manchego cheese. The tequila's layered spice and mellow oak tones complement robust, savoury flavours.

title: Domaine Belle 'Les Pierrelles' Crozes-Hermitage 2022
bodyHtml: The Belle family own top quality vineyards across the northern Rhone, producing vivid expressions from their organic Syrah grapes. Matured in 75% old and 25% new barrels, this silky smooth, voluptuous Crozes-Hermitage has juicy flavours of plum, blackberry and chocolate. A Rhone star.

title: Pedro Martinez Alesanco Reserva 2017
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Spain, specifically from the Rioja DOCa region within the subregion of Rioja Alta. Bodegas Pedro Martinez Alesanco is a family winery based in the village of Badarán, one of the coldest zones in Rioja Alta, where they cultivate vineyards at altitudes between 650m and 750m. The winery's philosophy centres on a deep commitment to terroir and the use of indigenous Rioja varieties, particularly pioneering the recovery of the minority variety Maturana Tinta.

Wine Description

Pedro Martinez Alesanco Reserva 2017 displays a garnet red colour with ruby hues and an intense pigmentation. The nose is expressive and evolves slowly in the glass, revealing aromas of blackberries, blackcurrants, and ripe cherries layered with balsamic hints and delicate vanilla notes from the wood. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and elegant, offering a succulent core of blueberries and cherries integrated with firm, fine grained tannins. It is characterized by its remarkable balance, refreshing acidity, and a long finish that lingers with notes of spices and mineral undertones. This wine is a blend of 90% Tempranillo and 10% Garnacha, having spent 18 months in French oak barrels followed by 26 months of bottle ageing before release. The ABV is 14%, and while the winery focuses on local varieties and natural vineyard management, the wine is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from 2024 through 2030.

Food Pairing

The complex structure and savoury oak notes of this Reserva make it an ideal companion for a variety of meat centric dishes. It pairs perfectly with roast lamb, beef tenderloin, or veal, as the wine's tannins and acidity cut through the richness of the meat. It also complements Middle Eastern dishes like meat sambousek and can be enjoyed alongside aged cheeses or hearty stews.

title: Coto de Gomariz 'The Flower and the Bee' Souson Ribeiro 2023
bodyHtml:
The bees that carry out the pollination of the flower of the vine are the starting point of everything in the vine and in Gomariz. It is aged for four months in wood to polish the tannins of the powerful Souson, which results in a wine with character, fresh, fruity, and very balanced. Its uniqueness never leaves you indifferent, and attracts the best sommeliers in the world for star dishes as it is suitable for risky pairings.

The Souson for the Flower & the Bee is hand harvested, then macerated at a low temperature in contact with the skins.  Alcoholic fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks using wild yeasts, with periodic pump overs and punch downs. The Flower & the Bee spends four months in oak barrels, where it rounds out until it is bottled on a Fruit Day according to the biodynamic calendar.

title: Manvi Happiness Super Tuscan 2020
bodyHtml:
The Manvi Happiness Super Tuscan pours a deep ruby red with a violet hue. On the nose, it bursts with aromas of ripe black cherries, plums, and cassis, layered with subtle notes of vanilla, baking spices, and a touch of cedar from oak aging. The palate is full-bodied and velvety, showcasing a rich core of dark fruit balanced by bright acidity and finely integrated tannins. Hints of dark chocolate and earthy undertones add depth to the long, elegant finish.

This Super Tuscan is a blend of Sangiovese and Merlot, combining the structure and vibrancy of the former with the plush fruit and smooth texture of the latter. While drinking beautifully now, it will continue to evolve gracefully over the next 5 to 7 years.

Food Pairing

Pair this wine with grilled lamb chops, wild mushroom risotto, or aged pecorino cheese. Its depth and structure make it a versatile companion for hearty dishes, while its balanced acidity keeps the palate refreshed.

title: Domaine Curry Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml:
Domaine Curry's Cabernet Sauvignon hails from Napa Valley, California, USA. Co-founded by Ayesha Curry and Sydel Curry-Lee in 2015, the winery is dedicated to producing bold, high-quality wines that reflect the strength and elegance of their founders' vision. Domaine Curry has become part of The Prisoner Wine Company family, further enhancing its reputation in the wine industry.

Wine Description

The Domaine Curry Cabernet Sauvignon is a meticulously crafted blend predominantly featuring Cabernet Sauvignon, complemented by Petit Verdot, Merlot, and Cabernet Franc. This wine presents a deep, rich color and offers an aromatic bouquet of bright red fruit, clove, caramel, dark red cherry, cola, and cinnamon toast. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied experience with supple, velvety tannins, culminating in a savory and lengthy finish. The careful oak aging process imparts subtle notes of cedar and tobacco, adding complexity to the wine's profile.

title: Lingua Franca Estate Chardonnay 'Bunker Hill' 2022
bodyHtml:
Lingua Franca's Bunker Hill Chardonnay originates from the Willamette Valley in Oregon, USA. Founded in 2015 by Larry Stone, David Honig, and Dominique Lafon, Lingua Franca is renowned for producing wines that authentically express their terroir. The Bunker Hill Vineyard, established in 1995, is among the earliest Dijon-clone Chardonnay plantings in Oregon, situated in the South Salem Hills at elevations between 650 and 700 feet. The vineyard's shallow, rocky volcanic soils contribute to the wine's distinctive mineral character.

Wine Description

The Bunker Hill Chardonnay displays a pale yellow-green hue. Aromas are predominantly mineral-driven, featuring notes of flint, hay, fresh herbs, lemon zest, and yellow flowers. On the palate, the wine is precise and taut, with underlying lemon nuances and a silky finish.

This Chardonnay pairs exceptionally well with refined seafood dishes such as halibut, turbot, sole, flounder, or cod prepared with beurre blanc or simply poached in butter and seasoned with herbs or fennel pollen, accompanied by a squeeze of lemon juice.

title: Henschke Shiraz 'Tappa Pass' 2021
bodyHtml:
The Henschke family, sixth-generation winemakers, have been crafting exceptional wines since 1868 in the Eden Valley region of South Australia. Known for their unwavering dedication to sustainability and site expression, Henschke produces wines that capture the essence of their vineyards, with 'Tappa Pass' being a homage to the rich viticultural heritage of both the Eden and Barossa Valleys.

This 2021 Shiraz presents a deep crimson core with vibrant garnet edges. The nose is intensely aromatic, opening with ripe blackberry, dark plum, and mulberry, intertwined with hints of sage, anise, black pepper, and clove. On the palate, it is plush and powerful, yet balanced with fresh acidity and supple tannins. Layers of dark berries and black cherry are supported by notes of mocha, cedar, and earthy spice, leading to a long, savoury finish. Composed entirely of Shiraz, this wine shows structure and finesse, with the potential to age gracefully over the next 15 to 20 years.

Accolades

  • The Wine Advocate – 95 points

  • James Suckling – 94 points

Food Pairing

Perfect alongside herb-crusted lamb, grilled venison, or beef short ribs with rosemary jus. Aged cheeses like clothbound cheddar or aged gouda also complement the wine’s intensity and complexity.

title: Okunomatsu Kinmon Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Okunomatsu Brewery, located in Fukushima Prefecture, Japan, has been producing sake since the early 18th century. Known for its balance of tradition and innovation, the brewery emphasizes quality brewing techniques that highlight regional purity and craftsmanship. Kinmon, also called ‘Gold Crest,’ reflects the brewery’s philosophy of creating elegant yet approachable sake.

Description

This sake offers a clear, pale appearance with a delicate aromatic profile. Notes of rice, subtle florals, and a hint of melon lead into a palate that is smooth and balanced, carrying a gentle warmth. The body is light to medium, with a finish that is clean and slightly rounded. Alcohol content is approximately 15%. It is crafted for versatility, equally enjoyable slightly chilled or gently warmed. The style leans toward freshness and harmony, making it an easy-drinking premium sake.

Food Pairing

Okunomatsu Kinmon pairs beautifully with sushi, sashimi, grilled white fish, or light vegetable dishes. Its gentle sweetness also works with mild cheeses or lightly seasoned chicken. This pairing highlights the sake’s depth and character.

title: Nardini Amaro
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy by Distilleria Nardini, the country’s oldest grappa distillery founded in 1779, Nardini Amaro reflects over two centuries of tradition. Still family-owned, the distillery is located in Bassano del Grappa in the Veneto region, renowned for its expertise in distilling fine spirits and amaros.

Liqueur Description

Nardini Amaro is a deep mahogany liqueur crafted from a secret blend of botanicals including bitter orange, gentian root, peppermint, licorice, and spices. On the nose, it offers enticing aromas of dark chocolate, citrus zest, and cooling mint. The palate is rich and complex, with layers of mocha, espresso, liquorice, and herbal freshness balanced by a subtle sweetness. Medium-bodied and silky in texture, it finishes long and harmonious, with a lingering bittersweet note of cocoa and mint. Best enjoyed neat, over ice, or in creative cocktails, its versatility makes it a refined choice for both sipping and mixing.

Food Pairing

This amaro pairs beautifully with rich chocolate desserts, roasted nuts, or strong cheeses such as gorgonzola. It also complements citrus-infused pastries and works well as a digestif after hearty Italian meals.

title: Domaine George Monopole Chablis Talva 2024
bodyHtml:
Domaine George is a family-owned estate based in Courgis, founded by Michel George in 1997 after leaving the local cooperative. Today, the domaine is managed by his sons David and Jonathan, who continue the legacy of crafting authentic Chablis wines. Their exclusive Talva monopole vineyard reflects the family’s commitment to precision and terroir expression.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a pale yellow colour with subtle green reflections. The nose is pure and dry, marked by delicate floral notes and fresh citrus. On the palate, it is lively and refreshing, showing a fine balance of fruit, minerality, and acidity typical of classic Chablis. The medium body and clean, lingering finish highlight both finesse and freshness.

Food Pairing

An ideal companion to oysters, shellfish, grilled white fish, or sushi, where its minerality enhances delicate flavours. It also pairs beautifully with creamy cheeses and light charcuterie.

title: Carleone Chianti Classico - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Tuscany, Italy, in the historic Chianti Classico zone of Radda in Chianti, comes Carleone Chianti Classico. The estate, Tenuta di Carleone, was founded in 2012 by Austrian Karl Egger alongside winemaker Sean O’Callaghan, known for his minimal-intervention approach and dedication to authentic Sangiovese expression. The property spans forests, streams, and hillside vineyards that embody the region’s heritage and purity of fruit.

Wine Description
This Chianti Classico is crafted from 100% Sangiovese grapes, organically farmed and hand-harvested. It presents a brilliant ruby colour in the glass. Aromas unfold with fresh cherries, red raspberries, rose petals, and subtle spice, followed by hints of tobacco and crushed stone. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with lively acidity, refined tannins, and layers of red fruit, violet, and savoury earth.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with roasted white meats, braised dishes, tomato-based pasta, and pizza. Its freshness and savoury notes also make it an excellent companion to aged cheeses and rustic Tuscan fare.

title: Chateau Montfollet Grand Vin 2016
bodyHtml:
Château Montfollet is owned by Dominique Raimond, a fifth-generation winemaker deeply rooted in the Blaye region. The estate has built a reputation for producing wines that respect tradition while showcasing the terroir’s modern expression, with meticulous attention to both vineyard management and cellar practices.

Wine Description

This cuvée presents a deep ruby colour with purple reflections. On the nose, it reveals rich aromas of blackberries, plums, and black cherries, layered with subtle notes of vanilla, spice, and a touch of cedar. The palate is ample and structured, offering concentrated dark fruit flavours balanced by lively freshness. Fine-grained tannins give the wine depth and texture, leading to a long, elegant finish accented with hints of licorice and grilled notes.

Food Pairing

Ideal with hearty dishes such as wild boar stew, roast lamb, or braised short ribs.

title: Invivo Unity Prosecco
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy’s Veneto region, Invivo Unity Prosecco comes from the innovative New Zealand winery Invivo & Co., co-founded by Tim Lightbourne and Rob Cameron.

Wine Description
This Prosecco shows a pale straw colour with a fine, persistent bead. The nose reveals fresh aromas of citrus, green apple, and white flowers, with subtle hints of orange zest. On the palate, it is crisp and lively, offering flavours of lemon, apple, and delicate floral notes. The wine has a light to medium body with refreshing acidity and a clean, elegant finish.

Food Pairing
Perfect with light antipasti, fresh seafood, or a classic Margherita pizza. It also pairs beautifully with creamy cheeses and summer salads.

title: Joie Farm Chardonnay 'En Famille'
bodyHtml:
This Chardonnay originates from Canada’s Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, specifically sourced from the Con Vida Vineyard on Skaha Bluff and, in some vintages, complemented by fruit from the Naramata Bench. JoieFarm, founded in 2004, is an acclaimed winery recognized for producing wines that embody the spirit of conviviality and terroir expression. Their philosophy emphasizes minimal intervention and a focus on capturing the freshness of the Okanagan.

Wine Description
The Joie Farm Chardonnay ‘En Famille’ is a refined expression of cool-climate Chardonnay. It pours a pale gold hue, offering aromas of baked pecans, lemon curd, apple, vanilla bean, and fresh white flowers, layered with sage, tarragon, and a touch of cinnamon. On the palate, it is creamy yet balanced with lively acidity, showcasing orchard fruits, citrus, hazelnut, and subtle mineral notes of granite and wet stone. Full malolactic fermentation and lees aging provide depth, texture, and complexity, while oak influence adds finesse without overwhelming the wine.

Food Pairing
This Chardonnay pairs beautifully with roasted chicken, creamy risotto, or grilled lobster with herb butter. Its freshness and layered texture also complement dishes like seared scallops with citrus beurre blanc.

title: Clase Azul Gold Tequila
bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Gold is a unique Tequila Joven, a blend that combines Clase Azul Plata with a special Reposado tequila matured in French oak casks and an eight-year-old Extra Añejo aged in American whiskey casks and finished in sherry casks. Notes of green apple, orange peel, fresh fig, raisins, light note of almond and walnut. On the palate you'll find toasted wood, fig, green olive, ginger, and dark chocolate.

The Clase Azul Tequila Gold decanter challenges the impossible! Its shimmering glass is fused against a black ceramic base, a technique that took our experts 6 years to develop.

title: Hacker Pschorr Munich Gold - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Hacker-Pschorr Munich Gold is a quintessential Münchner Export (or Dortmunder Export) lager from one of Munich's "Big Six" breweries. While the brewery’s history dates back to 1417, "Munich Gold" was originally brewed in the late 19th century to cater to a growing demand for a slightly stronger, more malt-forward version of the traditional Helles. It is a beer that bridges the gap between the everyday "session" lager and a celebratory brew, offering a deeper color and a richer body while strictly adhering to the Reinheitsgebot (German Purity Law).

Beer Description

This lager pours a brilliant, deep golden-yellow, noticeably darker and more "honey-toned" than a standard pilsner with a thick, creamy white head and vigorous carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is rich and elegantly balanced. It leads with a dominant scent of sweet, bready malt and honey, followed by a delicate, floral perfume from Bavarian noble hops. You may also pick up a subtle hint of freshly cut grass and toasted grain.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a smooth, velvety mouthfeel. It leads with a robust malt sweetness and notes of toasted biscuit, which is quickly balanced by a gentle, spicy bitterness. Despite its richness, the finish remains remarkably clean and "brisk," with a slight mineral dryness that refreshes the palate.

Profile: It sits at a slightly elevated 5.5% ABV with a moderate bitterness of 22 IBU, providing more "weight" and complexity than a typical light lager.

Technical Notes: Munich Gold is a true product of its geography. It is brewed using locally sourced Bavarian summer barley and a blend of Hallertau Tradition and Hallertau Herkules hops. The beer's unique character is heavily influenced by the hard, mineral-rich water of Munich, which enhances the malt's roundness. It undergoes a long, cold maturation process to ensure its signature "smooth" profile and diamond-like clarity.

title: Jack Daniel's Honey
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: This whiskey-based liqueur is a sweet take on a classic. Blending Jack Daniel's whiskey with real honey, for a one-of-a-kind flavour experience. Smooth texture with naturally sweet flavours are discovered on the palate along with a pleasant warming sensation. Enjoy on its own, over ice, add to coffee or use in cocktails.

title: Elio Altare Barbera d'Alba 2024
bodyHtml:
Elio Altare, a pioneering figure in modern Barolo winemaking, transformed his family's estate in La Morra during the 1980s by embracing innovative techniques and sustainable practices. Today, his daughter Silvia Altare continues this legacy, crafting expressive wines that reflect both tradition and innovation.

Wine Description

The 2023 Barbera d'Alba showcases a deep ruby hue with violet reflections. On the nose, it offers elegant aromas of blackberry, sweet spices, and subtle floral notes. The palate is warm and full-bodied, featuring a harmonious balance of acidity and soft tannins, leading to a long finish of red fruits. Produced from 100% Barbera grapes sourced from 10 to 30-year-old vines grown in calcareous and sandy soils, the wine undergoes a 3-4 day maceration in rotary fermentors at controlled temperatures, followed by 5 months of aging in used French barriques.

Accolades

  • Vinous – 90 points

Food Pairing

This wine pairs wonderfully with dishes such as roasted pork loin, mushroom risotto, or aged cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano. These combinations enhance the wine's depth and character.

title: O'Rourke's Peak Cellars Chardonnay 2018
bodyHtml:
O’Rourke’s Peak Cellars is located in Lake Country, in the northern part of the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia. The estate was founded by Dennis O’Rourke, an Alberta businessman, and today the winery spans more than 110 acres with a focus on crafting expressive wines from estate-grown fruit. The winery is recognized for its commitment to sustainable vineyard practices and a philosophy of producing wines that reflect the unique Lake Country terroir.

Wine Description
This Chardonnay is made with estate fruit and vinified using whole-bunch pressing, overnight settling, and barrel aging for ten months, with approximately twenty percent new oak. It shows aromas of orchard fruits such as green and yellow apple, along with ripe pineapple and citrus zest. Subtle baking spice and a hint of pie crust add depth. The palate is creamy yet fresh, with balanced acidity, medium body, and a lingering finish marked by minerality and elegance.

Accolades

  • Gismondi on Wine – 91 points

  • WineAlign – 89 points

Food Pairing
This Chardonnay pairs beautifully with roasted chicken, seared scallops, or creamy pasta dishes. The combination of freshness and richness also complements grilled salmon or lobster.

title: Albert Bichot Horizon de Bichot Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
From France’s Languedoc region, specifically Limoux, this Chardonnay is part of Albert Bichot’s Horizon de Bichot range. Founded in 1831 and still family-owned, Albert Bichot is renowned for its commitment to showcasing the unique terroirs of France through sustainable viticulture and meticulous winemaking. The Horizon series highlights the interplay of diverse climates and soils, bringing layered complexity to each bottle.

Wine Description
Pale gold in colour with subtle green reflections, this Chardonnay opens with bright aromas of white flowers, citrus zest, and ripe peach. The palate is well-balanced, combining fresh grapefruit, hints of hazelnut, and creamy vanilla tones from gentle oak ageing. Medium-bodied with a lively acidity, it delivers a clean, slightly saline finish that lingers elegantly.

Food Pairing
Ideal with roasted chicken, seared scallops, or creamy mushroom pasta. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character, allowing its freshness and subtle richness to shine.

title: Col Silente Bolgheri 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced by Castelli del Grevepesa, a historic cooperative founded in 1965, which brings together over 100 growers united by a commitment to traditional Tuscan winemaking and terroir expression. The Bolgheri area is renowned for producing internationally acclaimed Bordeaux-style blends known as ‘Super Tuscans’.

Wine Description
Col Silente Bolgheri is a vibrant ruby red with violet highlights. On the nose, it shows expressive varietal character: dark fruit aromas of blackberry and black cherry are complemented by subtle notes of violet, spice, and vanilla. The palate is structured yet supple, with velvety tannins, balanced acidity, and layers of ripe fruit, earth, and dark chocolate.

Food Pairing
Pairs beautifully with braised venison, wild boar ragù, grilled red meats, or strong aged cheeses.

title: Gilvesy Bohem Cuvee 2024
bodyHtml:
The Gilvesy Bohem Cuvee originates from the Badacsony region on the north-west shore of Lake Balaton in Hungary. Founded in 2012 by Hungarian expat Robert Gilvesy, who returned to his ancestral homeland from Canada, the winery is situated on the former Esterházy estate on Szent Gyorgy Hill. The winemaking philosophy focuses on organic cultivation and minimal intervention to express the unique volcanic terroir, which is characterized by six million year old basalt formations and mineral-rich soils.

Wine Description

This light-bodied white cuvee displays a pale, zesty appearance. The aromatic profile is defined by fresh notes of mint, lemon, and sliced cucumber, often accompanied by a distinct flinty minerality. On the palate, the wine is vibrant and crisp, featuring flavors of green apple, citrus fruit, and white peach supported by a persistent, saline finish.

Food Pairing

The wine’s sharp acidity and mineral tension make it an excellent match for light summer fare, such as grilled white fish with lemon and herbs or a zesty ceviche. It also pairs beautifully with fresh garden salads featuring walnuts and dried cranberries or creamy goat cheese.

title: Testalonga Baby Bandito 'Stay Brave' Chenin Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Testalonga Baby Bandito Stay Brave is a specific wine produced by Testalonga, a South African winery known for its natural winemaking practices. It is part of the "Baby Bandito" range of wines the winery offers.

Packed full of citrus and ginger with amazing complexity and roundness to it from the delicate oak treatment and malolactic fermentation. It has an underlying minerality on the palate but balanced with acidity and fruit. It really is a joy to drink, and you can tell how much care and attention has been put into the winemaking.

The grapes are fermented for 11 days whilst macerating with their skins before being pressed into old oak barrels. Nothing is added apart from a tiny amount of sulphur before bottling.

title: Gallina de Piel Pinkgall 2024
bodyHtml:
Gallina de Piel Pinkgall originates from Spain, within the Navarra region and the Baja Montaña subzone. Founded in 2017 by David Seijas, the former Head Sommelier of the world-renowned three-Michelin-starred restaurant El Bulli, the winery operates as a 'negociant' project. Seijas's winemaking philosophy focuses on collaborating with local growers across Spain's gastronomic northern regions to create versatile, food-friendly wines that tell an emotional story of their specific terroir.

Wine Description

This rosé presents a brilliant coral-to-intense pink colour from three hours of skin maceration. The sensory profile is fresh and vibrant, featuring an aromatic nose of strawberries, raspberries, and yuzu citrus, accented by floral and balsamic notes of lavender, fennel, and anise. On the balanced palate, it delivers refreshingly dry and light fruit flavours with a persistent, pleasant finish.

  • Varietal Composition: A unique blend exploring the 'three shades' of Garnacha—Garnacha Tinta (red), Garnacha Blanca (white), and Garnacha Roya (grey).

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine undergoes three months of ageing on fine lees in stainless steel tanks to enhance mouthfeel and preserve its vibrant fruit profile and aromatic complexity.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 12% and 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery emphasizes sustainable and traditional practices, this specific bottling is not typically certified organic, though related projects from the producer often utilize organic vineyard management.

Food Pairing

The versatile nature and crisp acidity of Pinkgall make it an ideal companion for a variety of light snacks and regional specialities.

  • Starters: It pairs excellently with fresh salads, light appetizers, and various fish dishes.

  • Regional Pairing: A recommended regional match includes piquillo peppers stuffed with cod and bechamel sauce.

  • Social Setting: Its dry and refreshing profile makes it perfect to enjoy casually by the glass with friends.

title: Ogier Cotes Du Ventoux Rose
bodyHtml:
​The Ogier Ventoux Rosé is a wine hailing from the Ventoux appellation in the southern Rhône Valley, France. Established in 1859, Ogier has a rich history in winemaking, evolving from a cooperage to a renowned négociant-éleveur. The winery is celebrated for its dedication to expressing the unique terroirs of the Rhône Valley, combining traditional methods with modern techniques to craft wines of exceptional quality.​

Wine Description

This rosé showcases a delicate salmon hue, inviting the senses with aromas of watermelon, fresh bread, floral notes, red pear, and plum. On the palate, it is extra dry, presenting juicy flavours of melon and red plum, complemented by a pleasant finish. The wine is crafted from a blend of Grenache, Syrah, and Cinsault grapes, resulting in a harmonious balance of freshness and complexity. With an alcohol content of 12.5%, it is best enjoyed well-chilled, making it an ideal companion for warm summer days on the patio.

title: Casa Raia Brunello di Montalcino 2019
bodyHtml: Rich, taut acidity, and huge but beautifully ripened tannins coat your entire palate. It’s powerful, structured, and built to last. And the wine just goes and goes, blossoming in the glass, bringing forward different aromas like characters on a stage. Every breath of air brings this wine to life in a new way. Find notes of eucalyptus, plum, dried cherry, vanilla, clove, old balsamic, leather, cigar... The list goes on. It’s truly a living wine.

title: Q&A Red Cuvee 2020
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
​Q&A Red Cuvée is a premium wine from Canada's Okanagan Valley, crafted through the collaboration of actor and director Jason Priestley, Winemaker’s CUT proprietor Michal Mosny, and broadcaster Terry David Mulligan. With over 50 years of combined industry experience, they embarked on the Q&A project by re-examining their extensive knowledge, resulting in a wine that reflects meticulous attention to detail.

Wine Description

The Q&A Red Cuvée is an elegant yet densely concentrated blend composed of 45% Cabernet Sauvignon, 38% Merlot, 13% Cabernet Franc, and 4% Petit Verdot. It presents expressive aromas of midsummer Okanag an cherry and wild blackberry, seamlessly balanced by notes of cloves and cedar. The thoughtful, restrained use of oak keeps the fruit at the forefront, leading to a polished palate with fine-grained tannins and exceptional depth.

Food Pairing

Q&A Red Cuvée pairs wonderfully with grilled or roasted meats such as beef tenderloin or lamb chops. Its rich fruit profile and balanced structure also complement hearty pasta dishes and aged cheeses. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.​

title: Arnaldo Rivera Barolo Undicicomuni
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Arnaldo Rivera, a revered figure in the Langhe region, founded the Cantina Terre del Barolo in 1958. His vision was to unite local winegrowers, preserving traditional winemaking practices while promoting collective success. Today, the winery continues to honor his legacy, producing wines that reflect the rich heritage and terroir of Barolo.

Wine Description

The Barolo Undicicomuni is a testament to the diverse terroirs of Barolo, crafted from Nebbiolo grapes sourced across the eleven communes of the appellation. In the glass, it displays a classic garnet hue. The nose reveals an intricate bouquet of spiced cedar, leather, and hints of scorched earth. On the palate, wild and savory notes intertwine with crushed raspberry, figs, cinnamon, and star anise, supported by velvety tannins and fresh acidity. This wine embodies the complexity and elegance characteristic of traditional Barolo.

title: Q&A RMV White Blend
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
​The Q&A RMV is a white blend from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. This inaugural vintage combines 58% Roussanne, 34% Marsanne, and 8% Viognier.

Wine Description

This wine presents a generous nose of honeyed apricots, candied lemon, and beeswax, complemented by expressive orange blossom aromatics and subtle oak spice. On the palate, it is textured and intensely concentrated, showcasing a beautiful balance that reflects its careful blending. A tasting note highlights additional nuances of baking spice, kaffir lime, and croissant, attributing these to 12 months of oak aging, with 8% in new Slovakian oak.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with dishes that complement its rich and aromatic profile. Consider pairing it with a citrus salad topped with ginger and cinnamon, as the wine's richness will balance the acidity of the citrus, creating a harmonious blend of flavours. ​

title: Tenuta di Sesta Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2019
bodyHtml:
Tenuta di Sesta, established in 1850, is a historic winery located in the southern part of Montalcino, Tuscany, Italy. Owned and operated by the Ciacci family, the estate has consistently focused on traditional aging methods in large oak barrels and has adapted vineyard management practices to align with climatic changes, all to authentically express the Montalcino terroir.

Wine Description

The Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 'Duelecci' is crafted exclusively from 100% Sangiovese grapes, sourced from the estate's finest vineyard, Vigna Duelecci. This wine exhibits a ruby red color that evolves towards garnet with aging. On the nose, it offers elegant and refined aromas of licorice, berry jam, tobacco, star anise, and spices. The palate is intense and deep, with a rich and expressive center, fine and evolved tannic texture, and a finish of great balance.

title: Gilbert Petillant Naturel (Pet Nat) Riesling
bodyHtml:
​Gilbert Family Wines, established in 2010, is a boutique family winery in Australia, primarily sourcing grapes from the Orange region of New South Wales. Under the guidance of winemaker Will Gilbert, the winery focuses on crafting contemporary wines that reflect the unique climates of their vineyards.

Wine Description

The Gilbert Pétillant-Naturel Riesling is a sparkling wine made using the traditional méthode ancestrale, resulting in a naturally effervescent beverage. In the glass, it presents a cloudy straw colour, indicative of its unfiltered nature. Aromas of citrus, particularly lemon curd, are complemented by bright apple notes. On the palate, the wine is crisp and textured, with lively citrus flavours and a fine bead that enhances its refreshing character.

Food Pairing

This Pétillant-Naturel Riesling pairs excellently with fresh seafood dishes such as oysters, ceviche, or grilled prawns. Its zesty acidity and effervescence also make it a delightful companion to soft cheeses like chèvre or creamy brie. These pairings highlight the wine’s freshness and enhance its complex flavours.

title: Settlement Sauvignon Blanc Heritage Vineyard 2022
bodyHtml:
Settlement Wines, founded by winemaker Chris Darling in Marlborough, New Zealand, is committed to producing wines that express the unique terroir of their vineyards. The Heritage Vineyard, established in the early 1990s, is a certified organic site located on the southern side of the Wairau Valley. Its north-facing, flat aspect and free-draining silty clay loams, resulting from historical flooding of the Wairau River, provide an ideal environment for cultivating premium Sauvignon Blanc grapes.

Wine Description

The Heritage Vineyard Sauvignon Blanc showcases a pale straw hue with vibrant aromas of fresh citrus, tropical fruits, and subtle floral notes. On the palate, it offers excellent concentration and refreshing acidity, featuring varietal characters of citrus and stone fruit leading to a long finish.

title: Gilbert Petillant Naturel (Pet Nat) Rose
bodyHtml:
​The Gilbert Pétillant-Naturel Rosé is a sparkling wine hailing from Mudgee, New South Wales, Australia. Crafted by Gilbert Family Wines, a fifth-generation winemaking family established in 2004, this wine reflects their commitment to producing contemporary wines that honor their heritage and the unique terroir of the region.

Wine Description

This Pét-Nat Rosé is made exclusively from Sangiovese grapes, presenting a cloudy, bright pink hue in the glass. On the nose, it offers fresh and vibrant aromas of watermelon and strawberry leaf. The palate is crisp and textured, showcasing subtle strawberry and watermelon flavors with a hint of spiced bread dough and musk. It is medium-bodied with a semi-short, abrupt finish.

Accolades

  • Drink Easy Awards – Best Pet-Nat in Australia

Food Pairing

This versatile wine pairs excellently with a variety of dishes. It complements fried and breaded chicken, pork, fish, and veal dishes. Additionally, it pairs well with slow-cooked pork belly, smoked salmon, fried Indian snacks and starters, as well as various seafood and shellfish. These pairings highlight the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: La Spinetta 'Derthona' Timorasso 2024
bodyHtml:
Timorasso is an ancient indigenous grape variety of Piemonte. Vineyards are located in the villages of Montemarzino, Montegioco and Monleale. 

The wine has an incredible structure and longevity, the delicate citrus and floral notes sing in concert leading to a vibrant long finish.

title: Terre Nere Rosso di Montalcino 2022
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Italy's renowned Montalcino region in Tuscany, Terre Nere's Rosso di Montalcino is a testament to the Vallone family's dedication to authentic winemaking. Established in the late 1990s by Pasquale Vallone, a Sicilian banker with a passion for viticulture, the 15-hectare estate is situated near Castelnuovo dell'Abate, beneath the historic Castello della Velona. The vineyards benefit from mineral-rich soils shaped by the ancient Amiata volcano, contributing to the unique terroir of their wines.

Wine Description

This Rosso di Montalcino is crafted exclusively from 100% Sangiovese Grosso grapes. It showcases a ruby red hue with garnet reflections. The bouquet reveals enticing aromas of cherry, violet, and hints of maraschino. On the palate, it offers elegance and harmony, with youthful yet high-quality tannins, balanced freshness, and a pleasantly fruity aftertaste.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with pasta dishes featuring rich sauces, cured meats, and a variety of cheeses. Such combinations enhance the wine's depth and character, creating a memorable dining experience.

title: Parajes del Valle Orange Wine 2025
bodyHtml:
Parajes del Valle, established in 2018, is a dynamic winery situated in Spain's Jumilla region. The winemaking team is led by María Jover, a talented vintner who previously honed her skills at the renowned Vega Sicilia. The winery is committed to producing authentic wines that reflect the purity of their land through sustainable viticulture practices.

Wine Description

This organic orange wine is crafted from 100% Macabeo grapes. It displays a soft orange hue with a slightly cloudy appearance. The aromatic profile includes notes of guava, quince, and jasmine, leading to flavours of Valencia orange, lime juice, and yellow currant on the palate. The wine is light-bodied with refreshing acidity and balanced tannins, culminating in a lingering finish.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs wonderfully with Asian cuisine, such as pork or chicken dumplings, goat cheese and caramelized onion canapés, or barbecued Asian chicken breast with bean sprout salad.

title: San Felice Vermentino 2025
bodyHtml:
​San Felice Vermentino is a dry white wine hailing from Tuscany, Italy, crafted entirely from the Vermentino grape variety. The San Felice estate, renowned for its dedication to quality and tradition, oversees vineyards in the Maremma region, where the Mediterranean climate and diverse soils contribute to the wine's distinctive character. ​

Wine Description

This Vermentino displays a straw-yellow hue. The nose reveals aromas of grapefruit, white flowers, and freshly mowed hay. On the palate, it offers a refreshing crispness with subtle citrus undertones, balanced by a pleasant minerality.

Food Pairing

This wine is excellent as an aperitif and pairs well with light pasta dishes and seafood. These combinations enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Les Lunes Wine Cosmic Blend
bodyHtml:
Les Lunes Wine, based in California's North Coast, is a pioneering winery that leases and meticulously tends its own vineyards, embodying a hands-on approach reminiscent of California's early winemakers. Their philosophy emphasizes minimal intervention in the cellar, focusing instead on precise vineyard management to produce wines that reflect the unique character of their terroir.

Wine Description

The Cosmic Blend is a vibrant and innovative take on traditional Bordeaux-style wines. This blend comprises 56% Cabernet Sauvignon, 19% Zinfandel, 14% Pinot Gris, and 11% Merlot. In the glass, it presents a deep ruby hue. The nose is greeted with enticing aromas of juicy cassis, wild blueberries, and subtle herbal notes characteristic of Cabernet Sauvignon. On the palate, it offers luscious black fruit flavors, complemented by fine-boned tannins and a fresh acidity that enhances its drinkability. The finish is smooth and lingering, showcasing the wine's balance and complexity.

Food Pairing

This versatile wine pairs wonderfully with a variety of dishes. It complements grilled hanger steak and frites, enhancing the savory flavors of the meat. Additionally, it pairs well with roasted lamb, hearty poultry dishes, or game meats like venison, offering an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Domaine Bailly-Reverdy Sancerre 'La Mercy Dieu' 2024
bodyHtml:
​Sensory Profile

In the glass, this Sancerre presents a pale-yellow hue with subtle green reflections. The bouquet is complex, offering pronounced aromas of citrus fruits and floral notes, underpinned by a marked minerality. On the palate, it delivers a fresh and crisp attack, evolving into a well-structured experience that balances vivacity with roundness. Flavours of ripe peach and spring blossom are complemented by the wine's inherent minerality, leading to a lingering finish that underscores its aromatic power. ​

Food Pairing

This Sancerre pairs excellently with goat's cheese, whether dry or semi-dry, as well as grilled fish and poultry dishes. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character, creating a harmonious dining experience that highlights its freshness and complexity.

title: Cabin Brewing Luminosity German Pils - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Luminosity German Pils is brewed by Cabin Brewing Company in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Founded in late 2018, the brewery was established by a team of award-winning homebrewers and professionals, including Darrin Sayers, Jonas Hurtig, and Haydon Dewes. The brewery is located in an industrial area south of downtown Calgary, where it operates a taproom designed to evoke the cozy and nostalgic feeling of a traditional family cabin.

Beer Description

This traditional German style pilsner presents a glorious and gentle golden hue. The sensory profile is defined by delightful spicy and floral aromas on the nose, which are derived from a duo of noble European hops, Hallertauer Mittelfruh and Czech Saaz. On the palate, it is crisp and dry with long lasting bready malt notes and clean flavours provided by a Weihenstephan yeast strain. The body is light to medium, featuring a refined bitterness that slowly builds as you drink. Crafted using 100% German Best Pils malt, this lager offers a balanced and highly drinkable experience. It has an ABV of 5.3% and a bitterness of 40 IBU. There is no information to suggest that this beer is organic.

Food Pairing

The crisp and dry profile of this pilsner makes it an excellent companion for a wide range of light and savoury dishes. It pairs traditionally with German fare such as Bratwurst and Schnitzel, as the carbonation and bitterness help cut through the richness of the meat. The beer's bready malt notes and floral hop character also complement light seafood dishes, including steamed fish, crab, and lobster. For lighter options, consider serving it with fresh summer salads or delicate cheeses such as mozzarella, brie, or mild white cheddar.

title: Antonio Caggiano Fiano di Avellino 'Bechar' 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Antonio Caggiano Fiano di Avellino 'Bechar' is a white wine produced in the Irpinia subregion of Campania, Italy. The winery was founded in 1990 by Antonio Caggiano, a passionate photographer who returned to his family's vineyards in Taurasi after travelling the world. The estate's winemaking philosophy focuses on the preservation of indigenous varieties, and the winery is now managed by Antonio's son, Giuseppe (known as Pino), who continues the family tradition of producing wines that reflect the unique volcanic terroir of the province of Avellino.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits an intense golden yellow colour with lively reflections. The sensory profile is complex and generous, featuring a bouquet of white peach, fresh apricot, and orange oil, accented by floral notes of white flowers and chamomile. On the palate, it is full bodied and well balanced, showing a rich texture with flavours of tropical fruit, honey, and toasted hazelnut. The structure is defined by a refreshing acidity and a savory, saline minerality that leads to a long finish with a characteristic hint of bitter almond. Crafted from 100% Fiano grapes sourced from vineyards in Lapio situated 400 metres above sea level, the wine is fermented in stainless steel tanks at low temperatures to preserve its aromatic purity.

title: Domaine De Castelnau Picpoul Garenne 2024
bodyHtml:
Nestled in the sun-drenched Languedoc region of southern France, Domaine De Castelnau is a family-run estate with roots dating back to the 19th century. Under the stewardship of Jean-Baptiste de Clock, the winery blends tradition with innovation, emphasizing sustainability and terroir-driven winemaking. Located near the Mediterranean, the estate benefits from cooling sea breezes that preserve the freshness and vibrancy of its wines.

This 2024 Picpoul Garenne offers a pristine expression of the Picpoul grape. Pale lemon in colour with glints of green, it exudes aromas of citrus blossom, white peach, and sea spray. On the palate, zesty lemon and green apple notes mingle with hints of saline minerality, creating a crisp, medium-bodied wine with razor-sharp acidity and a lingering, mouthwatering finish. Made from 100% Picpoul, it is best enjoyed young, within 1–3 years of vintage, to capture its bright and lively character. The wine showcases impressive balance between fruit intensity and bracing freshness.

Food Pairing
Pair this Picpoul with oysters, grilled shrimp, or lemon-infused chicken dishes. Its high acidity and saline edge make it an ideal companion for seafood and light Mediterranean fare. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Maison Perron De Mypont Bourgogne Blanc 2022
bodyHtml:
Maison Perron de Mypont, situated in the historic village of Puligny-Montrachet, is a revitalized estate dating back to the 15th century. In 2019, renowned Mosel winemaker Ernst Loosen acquired part of the Vieux Château de Puligny-Montrachet and, alongside Burgundy expert Manoël Bouchet, embarked on a mission to craft wines that honor Burgundy's rich heritage while embracing modern winemaking techniques.

Wine Description: This Bourgogne Chardonnay is a harmonious blend sourced from select parcels across the Côte de Beaune, Côte Chalonnaise, and Chablis. Harvested during cool mornings to preserve freshness, the grapes underwent whole-cluster pressing and native yeast fermentation. The wine matured for nine months in used French oak barriques and 600-liter demi-muids, enhancing its texture without overshadowing its purity. The result is a vibrant Chardonnay exhibiting aromas of white fruits and delicate flowers, underpinned by a fine mineral structure.

Food Pairing: This Chardonnay pairs excellently with shellfish, pasta dishes, rich fish like salmon or tuna, mild and soft cheeses, and cured meats. These pairings accentuate the wine's freshness and complexity.

title: Albert Bichot Fleurie La Madone 2023
bodyHtml:
From France’s Beaujolais region, in the celebrated Fleurie appellation, this wine hails from the slopes surrounding the Chapel of the Madonna on Montagne de Fleurie. Albert Bichot, founded in 1831 and still family-owned, is renowned for crafting wines that faithfully reflect each terroir. The winery’s focus on sustainable viticulture and precise winemaking has cemented its reputation for elegance and consistency.

Wine Description
This 100% Gamay wine displays a bright ruby red colour. The nose offers a refined bouquet of iris, violet, and carnation, alongside ripe red berries such as strawberry and raspberry, with a delicate touch of nutmeg and subtle mineral notes. On the palate, it is supple yet structured, with juicy red fruit, a fine balance between freshness and roundness, and a long, aromatic finish. Medium-bodied, it shows finesse and charm, capturing the quintessential floral character of Fleurie.

Food Pairing
Ideal with charcuterie, roast chicken, or grilled pork tenderloin. Its floral elegance also pairs beautifully with mushroom risotto or mild, semi-soft cheeses such as Brie. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Maison Perron De Mypont Bourgogne Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
Hailing from France, this Bourgogne Rouge originates in the iconic Burgundy region, renowned for its limestone-rich soils and centuries-old winemaking traditions. Maison Perron De Mypont is a family-owned domaine dedicated to producing expressive wines that showcase the purity and elegance of Pinot Noir. Rooted in a philosophy of minimal intervention and terroir transparency, the winery blends tradition with a modern sensibility to craft wines of finesse and authenticity.

Wine Description
The 2022 Bourgogne Rouge opens with a bright ruby hue, signalling freshness and vitality. On the nose, aromas of wild cherry, crushed raspberry, and subtle violet intertwine with earthy undertones and a hint of spice. The palate is lively and well-structured, offering flavours of red berries, cranberry, and a touch of savoury forest floor. Light to medium-bodied, the wine is balanced by refreshing acidity and fine tannins that lead into a lingering, elegant finish. Composed entirely of Pinot Noir, this vintage is best enjoyed young to fully appreciate its vibrant fruit profile but will continue to evolve gracefully over the next 3–5 years.

Food Pairing
This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with herb-roasted chicken, mushroom risotto, or grilled salmon. Its bright acidity and silky texture also make it a lovely companion to duck confit or soft cheeses like brie. A perfect match to enhance the wine’s complexity.

title: Mission Hill Oculus 2014 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Canada’s Okanagan Valley, located in British Columbia, is home to Mission Hill Family Estate, a landmark winery recognized for its commitment to quality and sustainability. Established in 1981 and owned by Anthony von Mandl, the estate has played a pivotal role in elevating British Columbia's global wine reputation. Oculus is Mission Hill’s flagship Bordeaux-style blend, crafted with precision from the estate’s top vineyard sites.

Wine Description
The 2014 Oculus displays a deep ruby colour with garnet hues, revealing its depth and maturity. The nose opens with rich aromas of blackcurrant, plum, and dried herbs, layered with subtle notes of cedar, tobacco leaf, and dark chocolate. On the palate, it is full-bodied and well-structured, offering concentrated flavours of black cherry, cassis, and baking spices supported by fine-grained tannins and integrated oak. The finish is long, savoury, and elegant, marked by freshness and complexity.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator – 93 points.

  • Decanter – 92 points.

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled lamb chops, rosemary-crusted beef tenderloin, or aged cheddar. The robust structure and layered complexity of the wine complement rich, flavourful dishes. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Chehalem Mountains Pinot Noir
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from the United States, in Oregon’s renowned Willamette Valley, specifically the Chehalem Mountains AVA. The winery, Chehalem, was founded in 1980 and has built a reputation for producing terroir-driven wines that respect both land and tradition.
