With a philosophy rooted in sustainability and minimal intervention, the vineyard highlights the region’s unique soils and cool climate, allowing Pinot Noir to fully express its elegance and complexity.

Wine Description
Chehalem Mountains Pinot Noir pours a bright ruby hue. Aromas open with red cherry, raspberry, and plum layered with subtle notes of mushroom, forest floor, and a hint of spice. On the palate, it delivers a medium body with vibrant acidity, showcasing flavours of blackberry, red currant, and savoury undertones of tobacco and clove. Fine-grained tannins add texture, while the finish lingers gracefully with a touch of earthiness and mineral lift.

Food Pairing
This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with roasted duck, herb-crusted pork tenderloin, or wild mushroom risotto. Its acidity and earthy complexity also complement salmon or truffle-based dishes.

title: Tool Shed Off the Wall Hopped Wheat 473 ml - 4 Cans
bodyHtml: Imagine a fruit salad gone rogue, throwing the wildest party. Mosaic, El Dorado, and Azacca show up uninvited, creating chaos in a can - bold, wild, and off the wall.

title: SunnyCider Just Peachy 355 ml - 6 Cans
bodyHtml: Looking for an amazing peach cider? Look no further. Just Peachy is everything a peach lover wants without overpowering the apple cider. It’s semi-dry, with flavours reaching all the corners of your mouth. Made with 100% Okanagan apples and real, natural peach flavour. This cider tastes like summer but drinkable year round.

title: Bearface Whisky Ginger & A Hint of Lime 473 ml - Single Can
bodyHtml: Subtle oak notes of Canadian whisky, followed by hints of ginger, lime and citrus. and ginger with a tart citrus bite.

title: Chateau Lagrange 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Chateau Lagrange is a red wine from the Saint Julien subregion of Bordeaux, France. This historic estate was classified as a Third Growth in the 1855 Classification and is currently owned by the Japanese liquor group Suntory. Since 1983, under the vision of uncompromised quality, the winery has undergone a spectacular restructuring of its vineyards and cellars to achieve the highest precision in its winemaking. The team, led by winemaker Matthieu Bordes, focuses on a plot-by-plot approach to vinification to faithfully express the diversity of its gravelly soils.

Wine Description

Chateau Lagrange 2022 exhibits a deep garnet-purple colour. The nose is expressive and elegant, offering bombastic notions of crème de cassis, blackberry preserves, and redcurrant jelly alongside nuances of violet, peony, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and structured with a dense core of black fruit infused with blood orange and light spices like cinnamon and star anise. It is characterized by its opulent yet refined texture, vibrant freshness, and polished, fine-grained 'cashmere' tannins. This blend reached a new estate record of 86% Cabernet Sauvignon, complemented by 12% Merlot and 2% Petit Verdot. The ABV is 13.5%, and the optimal drinking window is from 2027 to 2055.

Accolades

  • Vinous - 97 points.

  • Decanter - 96 points.

  • The Wine Independent - 96 points.

  • Wine Advocate - 94+ points.

  • James Suckling - 95 points.

Food Pairing

This Saint Julien is beautifully suited to classic French meat dishes such as roasted lamb with rosemary, duck breast with cherry sauce, or beef tenderloin. Its structured profile also pairs well with veal, game birds, and hearty grilled or braised dishes. For a cheese course, aged varieties such as Comté or aged cheddar are recommended to complement the dark fruit and spicy nuances of the wine.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Saint Julien is described as an exceptional but extreme year, being the hottest on record in Bordeaux. Despite the challenging conditions, the vines' resilience on gravelly soils resulted in small, concentrated grapes with surprising acidity and freshness. Yields were low at 34 hl/ha, but the quality is regarded as brilliant, ranking the 2022 among the estate's finest recent vintages alongside 2016 and 2020.

title: Cognac Leyrat Assemblage No. 1
bodyHtml: This single estate cognac comes from the Fin Bois region. This is an easy drinking cognac with notes of orange peel, brown sugar and ripe sweet fruit with a very silky mouthfeel.

title: Fattoria Pomona Chianti Classico 2020
bodyHtml:
Italy’s renowned Tuscany region is home to Fattoria Pomona, situated in the heart of Chianti Classico, near Castellina in Chianti. This family-run estate is managed by Monica Raspi, a former veterinarian turned winemaker, who brings passion and precision to her craft. With organic farming practices and a minimalist intervention approach, the estate exemplifies a deep respect for tradition and terroir.

Wine Description
This Chianti Classico pours a luminous ruby red, characteristic of high-quality Sangiovese. On the nose, it offers lifted aromas of sour cherry, rose petals, and subtle earthy undertones. The palate is elegant and fresh, with red berry fruit, savoury herbs, and hints of tobacco and spice. Medium-bodied with vibrant acidity and fine tannins, it culminates in a long, harmonious finish. Made from 100% Sangiovese, it showcases purity and finesse. Best enjoyed now through 2027, it reflects both varietal integrity and regional typicity.

Accolades
Vinous – 91 points
Wine Enthusiast – 90 points

Food Pairing
Pair this Chianti Classico with grilled lamb chops, mushroom risotto, or aged pecorino. Its bright acidity and savoury complexity elevate earthy and umami-rich dishes. A perfect match to enhance the wine’s complexity.

title: Le Caillou Cotes Du Rhone Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: The Cotes du Rhone blanc cuvee is a white wine with a beautiful pale yellow color with golden highlights, a floral nose and white fruits and citrus fruits. The palate is full and develops notes of jasmine, yellow fruits complemented by notes of vanilla. Beautiful mineral and long finish.

title: Paul Jaboulet Crozes Hermitage Domaine de Thalabert 2022
bodyHtml:
France’s Rhône Valley is home to the esteemed Crozes Hermitage appellation, and Domaine de Thalabert is one of its most historic vineyards. Owned by Maison Paul Jaboulet Aîné—founded in 1834 and revitalized under the ownership of the Frey family since 2006—the estate reflects a legacy of meticulous viticulture and terroir-driven winemaking. Domaine de Thalabert, located in the southern sector of Crozes Hermitage, is one of the oldest estate vineyards in the region, renowned for its galet-strewn soils and mature vines.

Wine Description
This vintage presents a deep ruby-purple hue, offering aromas of blackberries, violets, cracked pepper, and a hint of smoked meat—classic markers of Northern Rhône Syrah. On the palate, it unfolds with layers of dark plum, black cherry, and liquorice, supported by fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity. The wine is medium to full-bodied with a mineral core and savoury nuances that lead into a long, peppery finish.

Food Pairing
Pair this Syrah with grilled lamb chops, rosemary-infused duck breast, or a rich lentil and mushroom stew. The wine’s savoury character and fine tannins make it an excellent companion for earthy and herbaceous dishes.

Accolades

93 Points - James Suckling

Lots of black and green pepper in the nose, but also lots of blackberry fruit. Impressive concentration and full supple tannins that give this considerable power at the long velvety and earthy finish. Excellent aging potential, and that's rare in this vintage. From organically grown grapes. Drink or hold.

title: Ruffino Romitorio di Santedame 2020
bodyHtml:
Ruffino's Romitorio di Santedame is a distinguished Chianti Classico Gran Selezione hailing from the renowned "Conca d'Oro" area in Castellina in Chianti, Tuscany, Italy. This limited-production wine is crafted from a single vineyard and showcases a blend of 90% Sangiovese and 10% Colorino grapes.

Winery Background

Established in 1877, Ruffino has built a reputation for producing high-quality Tuscan wines. The Santedame estate, where Romitorio di Santedame originates, features a medieval hermitage ("Romitorio") that underscores the region's rich history. Ruffino's dedication to reviving native grape varieties, such as Colorino, reflects their commitment to preserving and celebrating Tuscany's viticultural heritage.

Sensory Profile

  • Color: Deep ruby red with violet hues.

  • Aroma: Enticing scents of black currant, cranberries, and raspberries, complemented by smoky spices like cloves, nutmeg, and cinnamon.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and elegant, offering flavors of strawberries, coffee, hazelnuts, and mint chocolate. The wine's impressive balance integrates alcohol and acidity within a robust structure.

title: Lake Breeze Unoaked Chardonnay 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
The 2022 Lake Breeze Unoaked Chardonnay comes from the Naramata Bench in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Lake Breeze Vineyards, established in 1996, is renowned for producing wines that reflect the unique terroir of this region, emphasizing minimal intervention to showcase the natural characteristics of their grapes.​

Wine Description

This light-bodied Chardonnay presents a fresh and delicate profile. On the nose, it offers enticing aromas of citrus and cantaloupe. The palate reveals notes of orange peel and lime, complemented by subtle spice and a nutty finish. The absence of oak aging allows the pure fruit flavors to shine, resulting in a wine that is both vibrant and approachable.​

title: Andeluna Cabernet Franc Pasionado 2021
bodyHtml:
The Andeluna Cabernet Franc Pasionado 2021 hails from Argentina's renowned Mendoza region, nestled at the foothills of the Andes. Andeluna Winery, known for its focus on high-altitude viticulture, has built its reputation on producing wines that express the unique terroir of the region. Their winemaking philosophy emphasizes sustainable practices and a meticulous approach to crafting wines that reflect both tradition and innovation.

Wine Description:

The Andeluna Cabernet Franc Pasionado 2021 offers a vibrant deep ruby hue. On the nose, it delivers an elegant bouquet of dark berries, with hints of bell pepper, subtle spices, and a touch of tobacco. The palate is medium-bodied, with rich blackcurrant and plum flavours, balanced by smooth tannins and a refreshing acidity. The wine's structure is harmonious, showcasing a delicate complexity that persists on a long, smooth finish. This wine is 100% Cabernet Franc, and it is best enjoyed within the next 5-7 years for optimal freshness and development.

Accolades:

  • Wine Spectator – 94 points

  • James Suckling – 93 points

Food Pairing:

This wine pairs beautifully with grilled meats, such as lamb or rib-eye steak, as well as roasted vegetables. The richness of the wine complements the savoury flavors of the dishes, creating a balanced and memorable dining experience.

title: Henschke Cabernet Sauvignon 'Marble Angel' 2021
bodyHtml:
Established in 1868, Henschke is a family-owned winery renowned for its commitment to quality and innovation. Currently led by fifth-generation winemaker Stephen Henschke and viticulturist Prue Henschke, the estate emphasizes sustainable practices and the expression of terroir. The 'Marble Angel' vineyard, situated in Light Pass, is named in honour of Julius Henschke, Stephen’s great-uncle and a celebrated sculptor known for his works crafted from Angaston marble quarried adjacent to the vineyard.

Wine Description:

This single-vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep crimson hue with garnet reflections. The bouquet is aromatic, featuring notes of cassis, violets, wild forest berries, and crushed flowering herbs, complemented by hints of graphite, black olive, and cedar. On the palate, it is rich and plush, offering flavours of mulberry, blueberry, and cassis, supported by fine-grained tannins and a mineral backbone.

title: Chateau Fonroque 2019
bodyHtml: The wines of Fonroque are naturally rich and racy. The clay terroir gives them strength and profundity. The limestone gives them a definite mineral quality. There is a lovely freshness on the palate, with much elegance and refinement. Its length foreshadows a substantial cellaring potential.

title: Lopez De Haro Rosado 2023
bodyHtml: Hacienda Lopez de Haro is a wine of intense colour and pleasant bouquet, in which the nuances of mature fruit stand out. In the mouth it is soft, expressive and elegant, combining a fruity character with the notes lent by the cask, in perfect balance.

title: Domane Wachau Gruner Veltliner Smaragd Ried Achleiten 2024
bodyHtml:
The Domane Wachau is located in Austria's Wachau wine region, specifically in the Ried Achleiten subregion, one of the area’s most celebrated vineyard sites. Known for its steep slopes and ideal microclimates, the vineyard produces wines with exceptional balance and intensity. The winery is committed to organic farming practices and sustainable viticulture, reflecting a philosophy that combines tradition with modern techniques. Their approach to winemaking allows the true character of the terroir to shine through in each bottle.

Wine Description

The Gruner Veltliner Smaragd Ried Achleiten is a striking wine that presents a brilliant pale gold colour with green tints. On the nose, it is expressive, offering aromas of ripe stone fruits, such as apricot and peach, complemented by herbal notes and a subtle hint of spice. The palate is full-bodied, with a creamy texture and a vibrant acidity that cuts through the richness, providing balance and structure. Flavours of citrus, lime zest, and a touch of minerality linger on the finish, contributing to a long, refreshing conclusion.

Food Pairing

This Gruner Veltliner pairs beautifully with grilled white fish, roast chicken, or fresh spring vegetables. The wine’s lively acidity and depth make it a perfect complement to dishes featuring herbs, garlic, or lightly spiced sauces.

title: Punctum Rosado 2021
bodyHtml:
Punctum Rosado hails from the Castilla region of Spain. This wine is produced by Dominio de Punctum, a family venture founded in 2005 by siblings Jesus, Ruth, and Cristina Fernandez at their Finca Fabian estate. The winery is dedicated to organic and biodynamic viticulture, focusing on sustainable practices that respect the natural ecosystem of their high altitude vineyards.

Wine Description

This modern and stylish rose presents a pale pink salmon colour in the glass. The nose is powerful and expressive, offering pleasant aromas of wild strawberries, fresh cut watermelon, rose petals, and a hint of peach. On the palate, the wine is fresh and dry with a balanced acidity and a light to medium body. Notes of red berries and citrus lead into a clean finish characterized by a distinctive, salty minerality.

Food Pairing

The fresh acidity and mineral profile of this wine make it an excellent partner for vegetarian dishes, light salads, or as a refreshing aperitif. It also pairs beautifully with Mediterranean seafood, such as grilled shrimp with lemon or a black olive tapenade.

title: 1792 Small Batch Bourbon
bodyHtml: 1792 Small Batch Bourbon is sophisticated and complex. A distinctly different bourbon was created with precise craftsmanship and made from their signature "high rye" recipe and the marriage of select barrels carefully chosen by their Master Distiller. 1792 Bourbon has an expressive and elegant flavour profile. Unmistakable spice mingles with sweet caramel and vanilla to create a bourbon that is incomparably brash and bold yet smooth and balanced. Elevating whiskey to unprecedented new heights, 1792 Bourbon is celebrated by connoisseurs worldwide.

title: Coors Original 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml: Coors Original is a sessionable golden lager with an inviting aroma of freshly baked bread and understated hints of banana and pear. Its satisfying flavour, which balances subtle sweetness and malty refreshment, offers a crisp, smooth finish.

title: Chateau Mille Roses Haut Medoc 2022
bodyHtml:
Chateau Mille Roses is a family-owned estate located in the southern part of the Haut-Medoc appellation, near Macau and Arsac. Established in 1999 by Sophie and David Faure, the estate spans approximately 10.85 hectares, with 5.5 hectares in Haut-Medoc and 5.35 hectares in Margaux, nestled between two Grand Cru Classe vineyards. Since 2013, the vineyard has been certified organic, reflecting the owners' commitment to sustainable viticulture and environmental stewardship.

  • Tasting Notes: This Haut-Medoc wine exhibits a deep ruby color and offers aromas of concentrated blackberry fruits, complemented by notes of praline and floral hints. On the palate, it is characterized by a rich and tight tannic structure, with silky and fine tannins. The wine is refreshing, supported by pleasant acidity, with subtle wood and chocolate notes emerging, leading to a smooth, elegant finish.

  • Serving Suggestions: Serve at 16-18°C (60-64°F). This wine pairs excellently with beef, lamb, poultry, and game dishes.

  • Winemaking: The grapes are sourced from vines planted in deep gravelly soils, managed with high-density plantings and strict vineyard practices to maintain low yields and high-quality fruit. The estate avoids the use of chemical herbicides and pesticides, adhering to organic farming principles. The wine undergoes fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks, followed by aging in French oak barrels to enhance its complexity and aging potential.

title: Canyon Road Merlot 2022
bodyHtml: Canyon Road wines were inspired by the scenic roads that wander through California's stunning wine country. This Merlot is soft and elegant with deep flavours of rich cherries and jammy blackberries.

title: Tahbilk Marsanne Nagambie Lakes 2022
bodyHtml: Intense aroma of lemon acid drops, with a herbal note. The palate is soft and fruity, round and dry, fresh and vital with finishing softness and the impression of a trace of sweetness.

title: Dorrance Syrah Cuvee Ameena 2022
bodyHtml:
Dorrance Wines, founded by Christophe and Sabrina Durand in 2000, is situated in Cape Town's Heritage Square. As South Africa's first urban winery, Dorrance sources grapes from select vineyards across the Cape, emphasizing minimal intervention and traditional winemaking techniques to craft wines of refined character.

Wine Description

This Cuvée Ameena Syrah presents an alluring bouquet of dark fruits intertwined with subtle white pepper notes. On the palate, it offers a svelte and silky texture, revealing rich depth and purity of fruit. The wine is elegant, balanced, and inherently fresh, culminating in a lingering farewell. Its fine-boned structure is complemented by firm tannins derived from 100% whole-bunch fermentation.

title: Borgogno Zamo Bianco Friuli 2023
bodyHtml:
From the northeastern edge of Italy, this white blend hails from the Friuli Venezia Giulia region, renowned for its elegant and expressive white wines. Le Vigne di Zamo, the producer, is a celebrated family-run estate founded in 1978 in Rosazzo, a subregion of Colli Orientali del Friuli. Under the stewardship of the Zamo family, the winery is committed to crafting wines that reflect the region’s terroir through minimal intervention and a deep respect for tradition.

Wine Description
Borgogno Zamo Bianco 2023 is a luminous straw-yellow wine with greenish highlights. On the nose, it delivers fresh floral notes intertwined with citrus zest, green apple, and hints of wild herbs. The palate is crisp and lively, with flavours of pear, lemon peel, and white peach supported by a mineral backbone and balanced acidity. Light to medium-bodied, it finishes clean with a whisper of almond and salinity that invites another sip. This blend typically includes local varietals such as Friulano, Ribolla Gialla, and Sauvignon Blanc, which together provide freshness, aromatic depth, and textural finesse. Best enjoyed young, within 2–3 years of vintage.

Food Pairing
Ideal alongside delicate seafood dishes such as grilled prawns, calamari, or steamed mussels, as well as spring vegetable risottos or goat cheese salads. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Biutiful Cava Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
Biutiful Cava Brut Rosé is a sparkling wine made exclusively from 100% Garnacha grapes, sourced from 40- to 50-year-old vines situated at altitudes of 300–400 meters on calcareous clay and broken limestone soils. The wine undergoes secondary fermentation in the bottle (Méthode Champenoise) and is aged on its lees for a minimum of 12 months prior to disgorging.

In the glass, it presents a pale salmon hue with a lively effervescence. The nose offers a bouquet of fresh red berries, blood orange, and floral notes, complemented by subtle mineral undertones. On the palate, it is brisk and youthful, delivering flavors of juicy raspberry, cherry, and candied rose, with a refreshingly bitter edge that deepens on the back half. The finish is tangy and precise, leaving a lingering floral note.

Accolades:

  • Vinous – 90 points

  • Wine Enthusiast – 88 points

Food Pairing:
This versatile sparkling rosé pairs well with a variety of dishes, including shellfish, appetizers, lean fish, cured meats, and as an aperitif. Its bright acidity and red fruit profile make it an excellent companion to enhance the complexity of your meal.

title: Cedar Creek Chardonnay Platinum Jagged Rock 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from Canada’s Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, a region celebrated for its diverse microclimates and expressive wines. CedarCreek Estate Winery, established in 1987 and now part of the von Mandl Family Estates (owners of Mission Hill), is one of the Okanagan’s pioneering wineries. Their commitment to organic farming and precision winemaking is central to their identity, with a philosophy rooted in expressing the unique terroir of each site—most notably their Jagged Rock Vineyard.

Wine Description
This Chardonnay pours a brilliant golden straw in the glass. The nose offers layered aromas of lemon curd, crisp apple, and white peach, underpinned by flinty minerality and subtle oak-derived vanilla and hazelnut notes. On the palate, it’s medium-bodied and beautifully textured, with vibrant acidity balancing the ripe orchard fruit. The wine finishes long and clean, with a touch of saline minerality reflecting the rocky soils of its namesake vineyard. Crafted entirely from Chardonnay, it is a precise, elegant wine with a drinking window from now through 2028, though it may reward a few more years of cellaring.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with butter-poached lobster, roasted chicken with tarragon, or a creamy wild mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Dr. H Thanisch Riesling Feinherb 2023
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Germany's renowned Mosel region, the Dr. H. Thanisch estate boasts a winemaking legacy dating back to 1636. Situated in Bernkastel-Kues, the winery cultivates 16 hectares of prime vineyards, including a significant portion of the esteemed Berncasteler Doctor vineyard. The estate's commitment to traditional methods and meticulous vineyard management ensures wines that authentically express the Mosel's unique terroir.

Wine Description

The 2023 Dr. H. Thanisch Riesling Feinherb is a 100% Riesling crafted in an off-dry style, showcasing the Mosel's signature elegance and minerality. Harvested early at Kabinett-level ripeness, the grapes are sourced from steep, slate-rich slopes, imparting a distinctive flinty character to the wine. In the glass, it presents a deep golden hue. The nose is vibrant with aromas of peach, pear, cumquat, watermelon, currant, grapefruit, and subtle hints of gooseberry and raspberry.

Food Pairing

This versatile Riesling pairs wonderfully with a variety of dishes, including light salads, seafood, Asian cuisine, chicken, and risotto. Its off-dry profile and crisp acidity also make it an excellent aperitif. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Dr. H Thanisch Riesling Bernkasteler Badstube Kabinett Trocken 2022
bodyHtml:
The Dr. H. Thanisch estate, one of the most historic wineries in the Mosel, has been family-owned for over 375 years. Located in Bernkastel-Kues, this traditional estate is especially revered for its holdings in the famed Bernkasteler Badstube and Doctor vineyards. Today, the winery is led by Sofia Thanisch, continuing a legacy of refined, terroir-expressive Rieslings with a focus on sustainable viticulture and minimal intervention in the cellar.

This 2022 Kabinett is a radiant expression of Mosel Riesling. Pale lemon in colour with shimmering green highlights, it opens with captivating aromas of white peach, crisp green apple, lime zest, and a whisper of flint. The palate is vibrant and off-dry, with finely woven acidity that lifts notes of juicy citrus, apricot, and delicate floral tones. Light-bodied and elegant, it finishes with mouthwatering minerality and a gentle sweetness that lingers.

Composed entirely of Riesling, this wine is best enjoyed now through 2032 to capture its youthful freshness and graceful development. It exemplifies the hallmark balance and precision of the Kabinett style from this renowned site.

Accolades

James Suckling – 93 points
Wine Advocate – 91 points

Food Pairing

Ideal alongside spicy Asian cuisine such as Thai green curry, Vietnamese lemongrass chicken, or sushi with a wasabi kick. It also complements light pork dishes and herbed cheeses beautifully. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Dr H Thanisch Riesling Bernkasteler Graben GG 2022
bodyHtml:
From Germany's famed Mosel region, the Dr H Thanisch Bernkasteler Graben GG 2022 hails from a distinguished single vineyard nestled within the Bernkastel area. The estate, rooted in tradition and helmed by the Thanisch family for generations, is renowned for its unwavering commitment to showcasing the Mosel's expressive terroir through precise, elegant Rieslings.

This Grosses Gewächs (GG), or Grand Cru dry Riesling, pours a shimmering pale gold in the glass. It opens with lifted aromas of white peach, lemon zest, and crushed slate, underpinned by subtle floral notes and a hint of fresh herbs. The palate is laser-focused and precise, delivering a core of citrus and orchard fruit flavours wrapped in vibrant acidity and mineral tension. Medium-bodied with a dry profile, it concludes with a long, saline-inflected finish. Crafted entirely from Riesling, this wine reflects the cool elegance of the 2022 vintage and is best enjoyed from 2025 through 2035 for peak expression.

Food Pairing
Ideal with seared scallops, grilled white asparagus with lemon butter, or pork tenderloin with a Riesling glaze. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Dillon's Dry Gin 7 Bartenders Series
bodyHtml:
A traditional dry style gin made by vapour distilling through juniper and other botanicals. This classic gin is made from a base of 100% Ontario rye grain.
The perfect Martini gin!

title: Dillon's Rye Vodka Bartenders Series
bodyHtml: Crafted from our 100% Ontario rye grain based spirit, this vodka is distilled through oak resulting in a clean and smooth finish.

title: Fattoria Pomona Chianti Classico Riserva 2019
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Tuscany, Italy, the Fattoria Pomona estate lies in the renowned Chianti Classico region, within the commune of Castellina in Chianti. This family-run winery is helmed by winemaker Monica Raspi, who returned to her roots to honour her family's legacy with a focus on sustainable viticulture and minimal-intervention winemaking. The estate is known for its meticulous care in both vineyard and cellar, producing wines that reflect the unique terroir of the Chianti hills.

This Chianti Classico Riserva 2019 is a pure expression of Sangiovese, showcasing a luminous ruby red colour with garnet reflections. On the nose, it reveals an elegant bouquet of red cherries, wild strawberries, and dried herbs, layered with subtle notes of tobacco, leather, and forest floor. The palate is harmonious and well-structured, with firm yet polished tannins supporting flavours of ripe red fruit, balsamic spice, and a savoury minerality. Medium to full-bodied, the wine finishes long and persistent with a touch of earthy elegance. Best enjoyed now through 2030, it exhibits a balanced profile with freshness and depth that typify a well-crafted Riserva.

Accolades
Vinous – 93 points.
Decanter – 92 points.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with Tuscan classics like bistecca alla fiorentina, wild boar ragu, or aged Pecorino cheese. Its acidity and tannin structure complement rich, savoury dishes beautifully. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Isle of Raasay Dun Cana Sherry Quarter Cask
bodyHtml:
Introducing Dun Cana – Sherry Quarter Cask Release, a new whisky encompassing the prowess of Raasay’s mighty volcanic mountain. 66 million years in the making, they’re delighted to introduce this new release into their single malt range.

Peated and unpeated spirit matured first in the strong foundations of our American rye casks with a second maturation in Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso sherry quarter casks, this whisky exudes peppery spice, dried sultanas and hints of vanilla with a finish of lingering salty chocolate and a light hint of aromatic wood smoke.

title: Levert Freres Coteaux Bourguignons 2023
bodyHtml:
From France’s Burgundy region, under the Coteaux Bourguignons AOC, this wine is crafted by Levert Frères, a historic Burgundy house established in Mercurey in 1595. Now guided by oenologist David Fernez, the estate continues a centuries-old tradition of producing approachable, terroir-driven wines that showcase both heritage and freshness. The Coteaux Bourguignons appellation offers flexibility in blending grapes from across Burgundy, resulting in expressive, versatile wines.

Wine Description
This vintage blends approximately 90% Gamay and 10% Pinot Noir, delivering a light-bodied, fruit-forward red. In the glass, it reveals a bright ruby hue. Aromas of raspberry, strawberry, and rose petals mingle with subtle earthy notes reminiscent of potting soil. On the palate, it is lively and fresh, with fine tannins, moderate acidity, and a delicate structure balanced by a generous mouthfeel. The finish is clean and subtly floral, leaving a refreshing impression.

Food Pairing
This wine’s bright fruit and soft tannins make it exceptionally food-friendly. It pairs beautifully with poultry dishes, portobello mushrooms, and classic beef bourguignon. Lighter fare such as prosciutto sandwiches or shrimp saganaki also complement its freshness.

title: Ruffino Rose Aqua Di Venus 2021
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s Tuscany region, specifically the coastal area of Maremma, Ruffino’s Aqua di Venus Rosé captures both the elegance of the Mediterranean and the richness of Tuscan winemaking. Founded in 1877, Ruffino is one of Italy’s most respected wineries, known for its commitment to tradition and quality. Today, Ruffino combines historic expertise with a modern approach to create wines of distinction, reflecting the character of their terroir.

Wine Description

This rosé is crafted in a Provençal-inspired style, blending Syrah, Sangiovese, and Pinot Grigio. It presents a radiant pale pink colour with coppery-golden highlights. The bouquet reveals floral notes, Mediterranean herbs, citrus, and hints of red cherry. On the palate, it is dry, crisp, and fresh, with lively acidity and a savoury, mineral-driven backbone.

Food Pairing

Perfect with grilled or baked fish, seafood soups, fresh cheeses, charcuterie, and vegetarian dishes. The wine’s bright acidity and mineral freshness make it an ideal companion to lighter fare, enhancing its elegance and balance.

title: Kourtaki Retsina of Attiki
bodyHtml:
This distinctive wine hails from Greece, specifically the Attiki region surrounding Athens. Produced by Kourtaki, a historic winery founded in 1895 by Vassilis Kourtakis, it is among Greece’s most recognized names. Today, the family-owned estate continues its legacy of crafting traditional wines that honour Greek heritage, with a particular passion for showcasing the unique style of Retsina.

Wine Description

Kourtaki Retsina of Attiki presents a clear, pale lemon colour in the glass. On the nose, it offers vibrant aromas of pine resin mingled with citrus peel, fresh herbs, and hints of white flowers. The palate is dry and medium bodied, delivering lively notes of lemon zest, green apple, and a gentle pine character that carries through to the finish. Crisp acidity lends balance and freshness, making each sip both invigorating and true to the ancient Greek tradition. This wine is made predominantly from the Savatiano grape, well known for its resilience in the warm Mediterranean climate. Best enjoyed young, within one to two years of bottling, to appreciate its zesty vitality.

Food Pairing

Pair this classic Retsina with Greek mezze such as grilled halloumi, olives, and dolmades, or with seafood dishes like calamari and lightly fried white fish. The pine accented freshness of the wine lifts herbal and citrus notes in Mediterranean cuisine, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Chica Chida Peanut Butter Agave Spirit
bodyHtml:
Crafted in Mexico, the birthplace of agave spirits, Chica Chida is produced by a distillery that blends traditional techniques with playful innovation. Known for their creative approach to flavoured agave-based drinks, the producers behind Chica Chida embrace both authenticity and originality, creating spirits that reflect modern flair while honouring agave’s deep cultural roots.

Golden amber in hue, Chica Chida Peanut Butter Agave Spirit offers a bold and indulgent aroma of roasted peanuts, caramel, and sweet vanilla. On the palate, it's creamy and smooth, with rich layers of nutty sweetness balanced by a hint of earthy agave character. Full-bodied and slightly warming, the finish is long and silky, echoing toasted peanut and subtle spice. This spirit is made from agave spirit infused with natural peanut butter flavour, resulting in a unique and decadent taste profile. Best enjoyed neat, over ice, or as a fun twist in dessert cocktails.

title: Pajzos Tokaj Furmint 2021
bodyHtml:
The esteemed Château Pajzos estate is located in the historic Tokaj region of northeastern Hungary, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its winemaking tradition. Acquired in the early 1990s by Jean-Louis Laborde, also co-owner of Château Clinet in Pomerol, Pajzos is known for its meticulous vineyard management and commitment to preserving the region's indigenous grape varieties, particularly Furmint.

This Furmint is a striking white wine showcasing the grape’s expressive character. Pale straw in colour, it opens with a bouquet of green apple, pear, and lime blossom, complemented by mineral undertones typical of Tokaj’s volcanic soils. The palate is crisp and vibrant, revealing flavours of citrus, quince, and flinty salinity, supported by a medium body and bright acidity. The finish is long and clean, leaving a lingering impression of orchard fruit and wet stone.

Food Pairing
Pair with pan-seared scallops, creamy goat cheese, or chicken piccata. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Maison Castel Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
From France’s Languedoc-Roussillon region, this Cabernet Sauvignon carries the Pays d’Oc indication. Maison Castel, founded in 1949, is one of France’s most respected family-owned wine companies, renowned for blending tradition with innovation. The estate’s philosophy focuses on expressing the diversity of French terroirs while making wines that are approachable and elegant.

Wine Description

The 2023 Cabernet Sauvignon shows a brilliant purple hue. On the nose, it reveals ripe blackcurrant, blackberry, and hints of vanilla. The palate is round and fruit-forward, with supple tannins and smooth texture. Notes of black fruit dominate, supported by subtle spice and a touch of oak, leading to a balanced and expressive finish.

Food Pairing

Ideal with red meats, sauced dishes, lasagna, and mature cheeses. Beef lasagne, in particular, accentuates the wine’s depth and roundness.

title: Pasqua Bianco Veneto 'Hey French'
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s Veneto region, Pasqua Vigneti e Cantine is a family-owned winery founded in 1925 in Verona. Now led by the third generation, the Pasqua family is known for its innovative winemaking philosophy, combining deep respect for tradition with bold experimentation. ‘Hey French’ embodies this spirit, showcasing the best of multiple vintages blended into a single expressive white wine.

Wine Description

This multi-vintage white is a blend of Garganega, Pinot Bianco, and Sauvignon Blanc sourced from volcanic soils on the Veronese slopes of Monte Calvarina, within the Soave area. Pale golden in colour, it offers complex aromas of chamomile, citrus zest, almonds, tropical fruit, and subtle beeswax. The palate is layered and elegant, showing ripe stone fruit, citrus oil, roasted nuts, and a distinctive mineral edge. Medium- to full-bodied, the wine balances richness with vibrant acidity, leading to a long, textured finish.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with creamy risottos, roasted poultry, or delicate seafood dishes such as scallops and prawns. It also complements soft cheeses and herb-driven Mediterranean fare.

title: Brotte Crozes Hermitage La Rollande 2023
bodyHtml:
From France’s Northern Rhône, this wine hails from the Crozes Hermitage appellation, the largest in the prestigious Hermitage region. Maison Brotte, a family-run estate founded in 1931, is renowned for crafting elegant Rhône wines that reflect both tradition and terroir. Their ‘La Rollande’ label exemplifies Brotte’s philosophy of producing approachable yet age-worthy Syrah.

Wine Description

The 2023 vintage presents a deep ruby colour with violet hues. The nose reveals expressive aromas of black cherry, blackcurrant, liquorice, violets, and subtle white pepper, evolving with notes of roasted meat and savoury herbs. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and silky, with flavours of dark fruit, olives, and a peppery edge balanced by vibrant acidity and a refined stony depth. The finish is smooth, lingering with hints of spice and violet.

Food Pairing

An excellent match for grilled short ribs with herbes de Provence, roasted lamb, or charcuterie platters featuring cured meats and aged cheeses.

title: Lake Breeze Pinot Blanc 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Lake Breeze Vineyards, located on the renowned Naramata Bench, is known for crafting wines that capture the purity of the region’s fruit and terroir. Family-owned and celebrated for its focus on balance and elegance, the winery has earned a reputation for producing one of Canada’s finest Pinot Blancs.

Wine Description
This Pinot Blanc shows a pale straw colour with glints of green. Aromas of Granny Smith apple, lemon zest, and honeysuckle rise from the glass, complemented by subtle mineral undertones. On the palate, it is clean and crisp, with flavours of citrus and fresh tropical fruit, supported by vibrant acidity. Medium-bodied with a bright, lingering finish, the wine displays excellent freshness and balance, making it both expressive and approachable.

Food Pairing
Ideal with west coast seafood such as spot prawns, scallops, or grilled halibut. It also pairs beautifully with fresh salads, roast chicken, and soft cheeses.

title: Vignetti del Sole Montepulciano d'Abruzzo 2022
bodyHtml:
Italy’s Abruzzo region, nestled between the Adriatic coast and the Apennine mountains, is home to Montepulciano, one of the country’s most beloved red grapes. Vigneti del Sole, originally founded by the Pasqua family in Verona in 1925, produces approachable wines that reflect Italian tradition and everyday enjoyment. Their philosophy emphasizes freshness, balance, and affordability, making them a household name for Italian table wines.

Wine Description

This Montepulciano d’Abruzzo pours a deep ruby red with violet highlights. On the nose, it offers bright red fruit aromas of cherry, raspberry, and plum, layered with subtle notes of sweet spice and dried herbs. The palate is medium-bodied, with smooth tannins and lively acidity that make it vibrant and easy to drink. Flavours of juicy red berries carry through to a balanced finish, leaving a pleasant, fruit-forward impression.

Food Pairing

This wine shines alongside classic Italian fare. Pair it with tomato-based pasta, wood-fired pizza, or grilled sausages for a comforting meal. It also works well with aged cheeses and roasted vegetables.

title: Brinley Gold Shipwreck Coconut Cream Rum
bodyHtml:
Produced on the Caribbean island of St. Kitts, Brinley Gold Shipwreck Coconut Rum Cream is part of the Brinley family’s artisanal Shipwreck collection. The Brinleys have been crafting rums with dedication and small-batch precision, drawing inspiration from the island’s rich maritime heritage. Their philosophy centres on blending authentic island flavours with premium Caribbean rum.

Rum Description

This cream liqueur pours a smooth, milky white with a delicate sheen. On the nose, it offers rich coconut, hints of toasted coconut, vanilla, and light tropical spice. The palate is velvety yet lighter than many cream liqueurs, showcasing sweet coconut cream balanced by subtle notes of nutmeg and cardamom. Medium-bodied, it carries a silky texture and a smooth, lingering finish that highlights the natural coconut.

Food Pairing

This coconut cream rum pairs beautifully with tropical desserts such as pineapple upside-down cake, coconut macaroons, or banana bread. It also complements rich savoury dishes like jerk chicken skewers or a mild Thai curry.

title: Balvenie 21 Year Old PortWood
bodyHtml:
The Balvenie 21 Year Old PortWood is a distinguished single malt Scotch whisky from the renowned Balvenie Distillery in Dufftown, Scotland. Established in 1892 by William Grant, the distillery is celebrated for its commitment to traditional craftsmanship and innovation in whisky production.

Production Process

This 21-year-old expression undergoes initial maturation in traditional oak casks, followed by a secondary aging period in 30-year-old port pipes (casks previously holding port wine). This finishing process imparts additional depth and complexity to the whisky, resulting in a refined character.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: A perfume of fruity and ripe raisin notes, backed by a nutty dryness.
  • Palate: Creamy and silky with fruit, honey, and spice notes.
  • Finish: Long, gentle, nutty.

Accolades

The Balvenie 21 Year Old PortWood has garnered significant acclaim, including:

  • Double Gold Medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition in 2009 and 2012.
  • A score of 94 points from the Beverage Testing Institute in 2009 and 2010.

Serving Suggestions

Best enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or with a splash of water to expand the flavor.

title: Atelier Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
From the United States, this Pinot Noir hails from California’s Russian River Valley in Sonoma County, a region internationally recognized for elegant and expressive Pinot Noir. The winery behind Atelier focuses on crafting small-lot, vineyard-driven wines that capture the character of the valley’s cool-climate terroir. Their philosophy emphasizes balance, detail, and a strong connection to the land.

Wine Description
Atelier Pinot Noir displays a vibrant ruby hue. Aromas unfold with ripe strawberries, pie crust, smoked meat, and subtle floral undertones. On the palate, layers of black cherry, wild herbs, and star anise intermingle with notes of toasty oak, tea, and savoury spice. The wine is full-bodied with round tannins, carrying pomegranate, raspberry, and earthy tones of autumn leaves. It concludes with a lingering finish highlighted by baking spice and rose petal.

Food Pairing
This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with duck breast, mushroom risotto, or herb-roasted pork. Its savoury spice and red fruit depth also make it an excellent companion to aged cheeses.

title: Stiegl Grapefruit Radler - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Stiegl Grapefruit Radler is a world-renowned refreshing beverage from the privately owned Stiegl Brewery in Salzburg, Austria, which has been brewing since 1492. A Radler (German for cyclist) was traditionally created by mixing beer with fruit soda to provide a lower-alcohol, thirst-quenching drink for active individuals. Stiegl’s version has become a global benchmark for the style, combining their centuries-old brewing expertise with the vibrant, natural flavor of real fruit juice.

Beer Description

This Radler is naturally hazy with a pale, cloudy pink-orange color and a light, fizzy white head that dissipates quickly.

Aroma: It features an intense, bright nose of fresh-squeezed grapefruit. The aroma is highly aromatic and zesty, with subtle underlying notes of bready malt and a hint of herbal hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and effervescent. It offers a perfect balance of tart citrus acidity and a soft, fruity sweetness. The finish is remarkably clean and revitalizing, with the crispness of the lager base cutting through the juice.

Profile: It has a very low ABV of 2.0% and negligible bitterness, making it an ideal choice for daytime refreshment, post-activity recovery, or as a light alternative to standard cocktails.

Technical Notes: This beverage is a blend of 40% Stiegl-Goldbräu (their flagship premium lager) and 60% all-natural grapefruit soda. It contains no artificial sweeteners or coloring, relying entirely on real fruit juice to achieve its signature flavor and cloudy appearance.

title: Benriach Malting Season Third Edition
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Speyside, Scotland, Benriach Distillery is one of the few distilleries still practising traditional floor malting. Founded in 1898, it has long been celebrated for its inventive spirit and commitment to heritage techniques, with this annual release honouring the artistry of hand-malted barley.

Whisky Description

This small-batch single malt presents a golden barley hue. On the nose, layers of freshly harvested barley intertwine with orchard fruit, wild bergamot, pear, and meadowsweet honey. The palate is smooth and creamy, revealing clementine zest, floral honey, apricot, malted almond, and a delicate trace of wild cherry. Medium- to full-bodied, it finishes long with gentle barley spice, oak tannins, and a touch of soft smoke.

Food Pairing

Pair with roasted duck, caramelised root vegetables, or mature cheddar. This pairing highlights the whisky’s depth and character, drawing out its balance of sweetness and spice.

title: Rothschild Sauvignon Blanc Rimapere 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in New Zealand, this Sauvignon Blanc hails from Marlborough’s prestigious Rapaura subregion in the Wairau Valley. The Rimapere vineyard was established in 2012 by Baron Edmond de Rothschild, part of the renowned Rothschild wine family. The name ‘Rimapere’, meaning ‘five arrows’ in Māori, is a tribute to both the Rothschild family emblem and New Zealand’s cultural heritage.

Wine Description
This Sauvignon Blanc displays a bright pale gold hue with green reflections. Aromas of lime, pink grapefruit, passionfruit, kiwi, and fresh-cut herbs leap from the glass, supported by subtle notes of white flowers and flint. On the palate, it is vibrant and zesty, delivering layers of citrus, tropical fruit, and earthy minerality. The wine has a medium body with racy acidity, finishing long and precise with a clean, elegant persistence.

Food Pairing
This expressive wine pairs beautifully with goat cheese, fresh oysters, asparagus risotto, or sushi. The lively acidity and mineral edge balance rich or creamy dishes, making it versatile across many cuisines.

title: Misty Cove Estate Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
From New Zealand’s Marlborough region, Misty Cove Wines is a proudly family-owned estate producing expressive, fruit-driven wines that capture the essence of their coastal vineyards. The winery focuses on sustainable viticulture and minimal intervention winemaking, ensuring each bottling reflects both terroir and varietal purity.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc shines a pale straw colour with green hues. The nose bursts with passionfruit, lime zest, rockmelon, and subtle herbal notes, layered with hints of tropical mango and fresh-cut grass. On the palate, it is vibrant and juicy, offering flavours of citrus, feijoa, and stone fruit, supported by crisp acidity and a delicate mineral thread.

Food Pairing

Excellent with fresh oysters, goat cheese salads, lemon-grilled chicken, or spicy Thai dishes.

title: Dillon's Cranberry Gin
bodyHtml:
Dillon’s Small Batch Distillers, located in Beamsville, Ontario, is a family-run craft distillery known for its focus on locally sourced ingredients and traditional copper pot distillation. Since its founding in 2012, Dillon’s has built a reputation for producing innovative, small-batch gins that celebrate Niagara’s fruit-growing heritage.

Wine Description
This cranberry-infused gin displays a rich ruby hue. On the nose, it opens with bright red berry aromas layered with warm winter spices. The palate is vibrant and fresh, offering tart cranberry notes balanced by hints of pepper, clove, and a subtle underlying sweetness from the rye-based spirit. Medium-bodied, with a smooth mouthfeel and a lightly spiced finish that lingers with gentle warmth.

Food Pairing
Excellent with roasted turkey, game birds, or pork tenderloin glazed with cranberry sauce. It also pairs beautifully with soft cheeses and charcuterie, where its tart fruit and spice lift savoury flavours.

title: Harvey & Harriet White Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
From the Central Coast of California, this wine hails specifically from San Luis Obispo County. Produced under the Booker Wines estate, the Harvey & Harriet label pays homage to winemaker Eric Jensen’s parents. The philosophy behind this project is to craft approachable, high-quality wines that remain accessible, reflecting a dedication to family values and authentic winemaking.

Wine Description

The 2022 White Blend pours a medium golden hue. Aromas of ripe white peach, beeswax, baked bread, and subtle green herbs are complemented by notes of tangerine, pineapple, and honeydew. On the palate, it shows a satiny texture with fresh acidity and mineral undertones. Medium-bodied and balanced, the wine carries a creamy structure that lingers into a long, fragrant finish.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with seared scallops, creamy risotto, grilled chicken with herbs, or fresh summer salads. The combination enhances the wine’s tropical fruit character and creamy oak finish.

title: Harvey & Harriet Red Blend 2023
bodyHtml:
Crafted by Booker Vineyard, Harvey & Harriet is the creation of Eric Jensen, who founded the estate with a mission to make world-class wines accessible. The wine is named in honour of his parents, reflecting a philosophy rooted in family, community, and the expressive potential of Paso Robles terroir.

Wine Description

Harvey & Harriet Red Blend pours a deep ruby hue. Aromas unfold with layers of blackberry, fig, and currant, accented by cocoa, spice, and leather. On the palate, it offers rich dark fruit balanced by fine-grained tannins, subtle notes of brown sugar, and hints of toasted wood. Medium to full-bodied, it carries impressive density and freshness, finishing with a bright, lingering lift.

Food Pairing

This bold blend pairs beautifully with grilled meats, braised short ribs, or roast lamb. Mature cheddar or aged gouda also complement its structure and depth.

title: Zinck Cremant d'Alsace Rose (NV)
bodyHtml:
From the heart of France’s Alsace region, Domaine Zinck is a family-owned estate founded in 1964 in the village of Eguisheim. Today, the winery is led by Philippe Zinck, who continues his family’s tradition with a forward-thinking focus on sustainability and terroir expression. The estate embraces organic and biodynamic farming to craft wines that are precise, lively, and true to their origin.

Wine Description
This Crémant d'Alsace Brut Rosé is made from 100% Pinot Noir, a grape variety known for its finesse and fruit purity. Pale salmon in colour with a vibrant shimmer, the wine opens with aromas of redcurrant, wild strawberry, and rosehip. The palate is lively and refreshing, offering notes of raspberry, citrus zest, and a delicate hint of grapefruit bitterness. A fine, persistent mousse brings elegance and texture, finishing with a clean, dry flourish. Medium-bodied and crisp, it is best enjoyed young to savour its expressive fruit. While not officially certified organic, the winery follows sustainable and eco-conscious practices.

Food Pairing
Perfect alongside shrimp cocktail, salmon tartare, or a fresh goat cheese and beet salad. Also delightful with poultry dishes or charcuterie platters featuring prosciutto and olives.
This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Disaronno Amaretto - 1.14 Litre
bodyHtml: Disaronno Amaretto, produced in Saronno, Italy, is an iconic and beloved liqueur. Crafted with care, this amaretto liqueur has gained worldwide acclaim. Its distinct flavour profile combines the rich, smooth notes of sweet almonds with hints of marzipan and vanilla. Critics rave about Disaronno Amaretto, praising its versatility in cocktails and its delightful nutty aroma. With a velvety texture and a touch of sweetness, it adds depth and complexity to a variety of drinks. Whether sipped neat, on the rocks or mixed into classic cocktails like the Amaretto Sour, Disaronno Amaretto is a timeless indulgence that never fails to impress.

title: Felton Road Pinot Noir 'Block 5' Otago 2023
bodyHtml:
From New Zealand’s South Island, this wine hails from Central Otago, specifically the Bannockburn subregion. Felton Road, established in 1991 and owned by Nigel Greening, has become a benchmark producer for biodynamic viticulture in the region. The estate is renowned for its meticulous single-block expressions, with Block 5 considered one of its most iconic parcels.

Wine Description

The Block 5 Pinot Noir displays a deep ruby hue with a vivid core. Aromas unfold in layers of black cherry, dark florals, cassis, and wild herbs, framed by savoury spice and subtle earthy notes. On the palate, the wine shows a finely woven texture, balancing ripe fruit intensity with elegant tannins and bright acidity. Medium to full-bodied, it offers depth and complexity, leading to a long, refined finish.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with duck confit, roasted venison, or mushroom risotto. Its savoury undertones also complement herb-crusted lamb or truffle-infused dishes.

title: Bowmore 29 Year Old Timeless Series
bodyHtml:
From Scotland’s Isle of Islay, Bowmore is the island’s first recorded distillery, established in 1779. Renowned for its balance of maritime character, smoky peat, and refined fruit notes, Bowmore has built a reputation as one of the world’s classic single malt producers. The Timeless Series celebrates patience in whisky making, with rare releases that showcase long maturation in Bowmore’s legendary No.1 Vaults.

Whisky Description

This 29-year-old single malt presents a deep amber colour, reflecting its extended maturation in sherry-seasoned European oak and ex-bourbon American oak casks laid down in 1991 and 1992. The nose reveals sherry-soaked raisins, cocoa, orange marmalade, cherry blossom, and subtle liquorice, underpinned by warm Christmas spices. On the palate, rich layers of plum jam, dates, dark chocolate, espresso, and gentle oak spice intermingle with a touch of salinity and Bowmore’s signature soft peat smoke. Full-bodied and complex, the whisky offers remarkable balance between sweetness, spice, and smoke.

Food Pairing

This rare expression pairs beautifully with rich dishes such as braised short ribs, venison stew, or dark chocolate truffles. The whisky’s smoky-sweet complexity complements savoury umami flavours, while its rich finish enhances decadent desserts.

title: Balvenie 30 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The Balvenie 30 Year Old is a distinguished single malt Scotch whisky from the renowned Balvenie Distillery in Speyside, Scotland. This exceptional expression is crafted by marrying whisky aged in traditional American oak casks with that aged in European oak sherry casks, resulting in a complex and harmonious profile.

Tasting Notes:

  • Nose: A rich bouquet featuring floral honey, accompanied by nutty and oily notes with hints of allspice.

  • Palate: Warming and rich, presenting flavors of dried fruits, sherry, and a subtle nuttiness.

  • Finish: Long and mellow, with sweet undertones and a touch of spice.

Accolades:

  • San Francisco World Spirits Competition: Double Gold Medal

  • Wine Enthusiast: Perfect Score

Serving Suggestions:

Best enjoyed neat, allowing the intricate flavors to be fully appreciated.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Mortlach Single Malt 15 Year Old 'Distillery Labels'
bodyHtml:
From Scotland’s renowned Speyside region, this single malt is produced at the historic Mortlach Distillery, often referred to as the ‘Beast of Dufftown’ for its bold, meaty style. Bottled by independent family-owned bottler Gordon & MacPhail, established in 1895, the release belongs to their celebrated ‘Distillery Labels’ range, which honours long-standing partnerships with iconic distilleries.

Whisky Description

Deep amber in colour, the Mortlach 15 Year Old offers aromas of sherry-soaked raisins, toffee, liquorice, and marmalade, lifted by woodland freshness. The palate is rich and full-bodied, unfolding layers of blackcurrant jam, cherry, creamy vanilla, and citrus zest, reminiscent of Black Forest cake. A subtle meaty undertone anchors the whisky’s complexity, balanced by notes of dark chocolate, spice, and gentle wood smoke. The finish is long, warming, and rounded, with lingering candied orange and malt sweetness.

Food Pairing

This robust single malt pairs beautifully with venison stew, slow-braised short ribs, or dark chocolate desserts such as flourless cake. Strong cheeses like aged Gouda or blue also complement its bold character.

title: Bladnoch 30 Year Old Lowland Single Malt Scotch
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Produced in Scotland’s Lowlands, Bladnoch is the southernmost distillery in the country, located in Galloway. Established in 1817, the distillery has a rich history and was revitalised in recent decades under new ownership. Bladnoch is renowned for crafting refined single malts that showcase elegance, balance, and the unique terroir of the Lowlands.

Description

This exceptional 30-year-old single malt was matured in a combination of ex-Oloroso and ex-Moscatel sherry casks, resulting in a whisky of remarkable depth and character. The colour is a deep golden amber, reflecting its long maturation. On the nose, aromas of dried apricots, nutmeg, Seville orange zest, and delicate floral notes emerge. The palate is layered with marzipan, almonds, and citrus tones, underscored by a subtle sweetness and nutty richness. The body is elegant yet full, leading to a finish that is light, floral, and lingering with a gentle peppery warmth.

Food Pairing

Pair this whisky with roasted duck breast, dark chocolate truffles, or a rich almond tart. The savoury depth of the duck enhances the whisky’s spice and citrus tones, while desserts highlight its nutty and sherried layers.

title: Podere San Cristoforo Amaranto 2019
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s coastal Maremma region in Tuscany, Podere San Cristoforo is a certified organic and biodynamic estate founded and run by Lorenzo Zonin. The winery is known for its minimal-intervention philosophy, focusing on expressing the purity of Sangiovese through careful vineyard practices and restrained cellar work.

Wine Description
Amaranto 2019 is crafted from 100% Sangiovese, fermented with native yeasts in stainless steel and matured for ten months in old French oak barriques. In the glass, it shows a bright ruby red colour. The nose reveals violets, red currants, raspberries, and pomegranate with subtle spicy nuances. On the palate, it is fresh and medium-bodied, with vibrant acidity, refined tannins, and an elegant balance that carries through to a persistent finish.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with grilled meats, roasted pork, and aged Italian cheeses. It also complements traditional Tuscan fare such as salami and rustic pasta dishes.

title: Garzon Tannat Single Vineyard 2022
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Uruguay, this exceptional Tannat comes from the Garzón region in Maldonado, situated just a few kilometres from the Atlantic coast. Bodega Garzón, owned by Argentine businessman Alejandro Bulgheroni, is celebrated for pioneering sustainable viticulture in Uruguay, with its impressive hillside vineyards and state-of-the-art, LEED-certified winery. The estate is a beacon for precision viticulture, producing expressive wines that reflect the unique coastal terroir.

Wine Description

This single-vineyard Tannat showcases a deep ruby colour with vibrant purple hues. The nose offers an alluring bouquet of blackberries, plums, and violets, underpinned by subtle notes of graphite, spice, and freshly ground coffee. On the palate, it is full-bodied yet remarkably refined, with layers of dark fruit, liquorice, and mineral nuances wrapped in polished tannins. The wine carries impressive structure and balance, culminating in a long, savoury finish with echoes of dark chocolate and crushed stones.

Food Pairing

Pair this robust Tannat with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, or aged Manchego cheese. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character, creating a memorable dining experience.

title: Canyon Road Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: Canyon Road is based in California's Alexander Valley and is known for well-made wines that express true varietal flavours. The Cabernet Sauvignon delivers dark fruit and spicy notes, in a style that is fruit-forward and crowd-pleasing. Soft tannins and a splash of fresh acidity make this a versatile wine for entertaining.

title: Henry Of Pelham Cuvee Catharine Brut
bodyHtml:
Henry Of Pelham Cuvee Catharine Brut originates from Canada, specifically from the Niagara Peninsula region and the Short Hills Bench subregion in Ontario. The Speck brothers, Paul, Matt, and Daniel, helm the winery, which stands on land deeded to their ancestor in 1794. The estate follows a philosophy of sustainable stewardship, managing 300 contiguous acres of original farmland to maintain a consistent flavour profile and soil quality. This sparkling wine is named in memory of family matriarch Catharine Smith and is crafted as a Niagara expression of a time honoured wine style.

Wine Description

This premium sparkling wine presents a light straw colour and a medium body. The sensory profile is elegant and complex, featuring an aromatic nose of peach, pear, and warm ripe lemon, accented by toasty notes and a scent of toasted almond croissant. On the palate, the attack is linear yet generously mouth-filling, delivering fresh orchard fruit flavours of apple and citrus alongside hints of brioche, almond paste, and a light dusting of nutmeg. The finish is clean, long, and effervescent, characterized by lingering notes of wet stones and butter pastry.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is hand picked and bottle fermented using the traditional method, seeing a lengthy aging period of up to 36 months on the lees to ensure a toasty and refined character.

  • ABV: Recorded at 12.0%.

  • Organic Status: The estate utilizes sustainable farming methods and is noted for its commitment to biological balance, though this bottling is specifically classified as sustainably and traditionally farmed.

Food Pairing

The bright acidity and toasty complexity of Cuvee Catharine Brut make it a versatile partner for both refined and savoury dishes. Suggested pairings include fresh oysters with lemon, salmon caviar, and creamy soft cheeses such as Brie. It also complements hearty fare like tomato based pastas, pizzas, and even grilled flank steak seasoned with Asian spices. For a classic match, pair it with fried chicken or salty appetizers to balance its zesty citrus notes.

title: Bailly Lapierre Cremant de Bourgogne Reserve
bodyHtml: A blend of the Appellation’s four grape varieties (Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Gamay, Aligoté), the wine is congenial, rounded and full, with a varied bouquet. A thirst-quencher, it is a very easy drinking Crémant, clearcut, clean with a lovely freshness.

title: Felton Road Pinot Noir 'Block 5' 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
From New Zealand’s South Island, Central Otago is the country’s most southerly wine region, famed for its world-class Pinot Noir. Felton Road, established in 1991 in Bannockburn, has become an iconic name in biodynamic and organic viticulture. The Block 5 vineyard, planted in 1993, sits on a north-facing slope of loess, clay, and schist soils, producing wines of remarkable depth and longevity.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir shows a deep ruby hue with vibrant clarity. The bouquet opens with dark florals, black cherry, wild herbs, and subtle spice. On the palate, it is elegant yet concentrated, offering flavours of ripe strawberry, plum, cassis, and hints of sandalwood and cocoa. The texture is sleek with fine-grained tannins, balanced by taut acidity and a mineral undertone. Medium to full-bodied, the wine carries a long, refined finish with great cellaring potential.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 97 points.

  • Wine Advocate – 95 points.

  • Vinous – 97 points.

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with roasted duck, mushroom risotto, or herb-crusted lamb. Its refined tannins and layered complexity also complement dishes like char-grilled salmon or wild boar ragu. Together, these pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character.

title: Burn Cottage Moonlight Race Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
#44 on Wine Spectator’s Top 100 Wines of 2025

This red wine originates from New Zealand, produced in the premier Pinot Noir region of Central Otago. Burn Cottage Vineyard Property is a 24-hectare estate owned by the Sauvage family, who established the site in 2002. The winery's philosophy is rooted in biodynamic farming and minimal intervention, aiming to let each vineyard's unique character reveal itself through the wine. The Moonlight Race name refers to an 1100-metre-long water channel that passes through the property, originally created by early European immigrants.

Wine Description

The Burn Cottage Moonlight Race Pinot Noir exhibits a luminous ruby hue with excellent clarity. The nose is aromatic and vibrant, offering intense layers of strawberry, wild raspberry, and black cherry, accented by citrus peel, wild herbs, and autumnal earth. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied with a supple, layered texture. It is characterized by its integrated tannins, bright acidity, and a seamless progression of flavours including juicy summer berries, black tea spices, and a refined mineral edge. This 100% Pinot Noir is a blend from three estate vineyards—Burn Cottage, Sauvage, and Luna—and is typically bottled unfiltered and unfined. The ABV is 13.5%, and the estate is certified organic and biodynamic.

title: Giacondi Sangiovese Rubicone 2024 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy’s Emilia Romagna region, within the Rubicone IGT area, this wine reflects the approachable style for which the region is known. The Giacondi label is part of MGM Mondo del Vino, a respected producer that focuses on accessible, everyday Italian wines. Their philosophy emphasizes drinkability, quality, and value.

Wine Description

This Sangiovese pours a bright ruby red with violet reflections. The nose reveals aromas of fresh red berries such as cherry and plum, alongside hints of violet and subtle spice. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, offering lively acidity, soft tannins, and a smooth, balanced texture. The finish is dry and clean, with a touch of bittersweet fruit that enhances its freshness.

Food Pairing

Ideal with classic Italian dishes, it pairs beautifully with tomato-based pastas, pizza, roasted meats, or aged cheeses. It also complements lighter fare such as bruschetta or a Caprese salad.

title: Catena Zapata Malbec 'Argentino 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Bodega Catena Zapata is one of Argentina's high altitude Malbec pioneers. The Catena family began making wine in Mendoza in 1902. Nicolas Catena, third generation family vintner, was one of the first to see the potential of Mendoza's mountain vineyards for producing high quality Malbec. In 1994, he became the first Argentine to export a world-class bottling of Malbec under the Catena label.

The Catena Zapata Malbec Argentino shows a saturated dark violet color with ruby reflections; the nose offers cassis, blueberries and violets, along with a strong suggestion of soil tones. It combines density and sweetness on the one hand, with gripping, lightly saline flavors of mocha, dark berries, spice, and minerals; a palate-staining finish dominated by sweet black and blue fruits.

Pairs well with lamb chops, beef tenderloin, and goat cheese.

96 Points - James Suckling

A really well-balanced malbec here that is slightly spicier and richer. Black cherries, dark olives and some violets. Fleshy and almost full-bodied on the palate with juicy, naturally rendered fruit and very fine-grained tannins. Balance is the word.

title: Felton Road Chardonnay 'Block 2' Otago 2024
bodyHtml:
Felton Road Chardonnay 'Block 2' Otago originates from New Zealand, within the South Island region and the Central Otago subregion. The estate is located in the Bannockburn subregion, where it was established at The Elms Vineyard. The winemaking philosophy is centered on minimal intervention and estate grown fruit to allow the unique characteristics of the site to shine through. Block 2 was planted in 1992 on a sheltered, east sloping plot defined by deep, angular schist gravel soils that bring a distinctive focus and depth to the fruit.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a pale gold colour with greenish highlights and possesses a medium to moderately full body. The sensory profile is highly elegant, precise, and complex, opening with an aromatically restrained nose of citrus blossom, lemon zest, green melon, and its hallmark elderflower notes, accompanied by hints of white blossoms and green pear. On the sleek and linear palate, it delivers pure, restrained fruit flavours of crisp apple, white peach, and grapefruit, supported by an athletic structure, a sheath of mineral phenolics, and a mouthwatering, sappy acidity. The finish is long, vibrant, and bone dry, culminating in a distinctive, gentle brine note and a lingering sense of salinity.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay, entirely from the Mendoza clone.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its remarkable structural focus, harmony, and site expression. It undergoes spontaneous fermentation with indigenous yeasts and complete malolactic fermentation in seasoned French oak barrels (only 4% new) where it ages for 16 months before being bottled unfined and unfiltered under screw cap.

  • ABV: 14%.

  • Organic Status: The vineyard is farmed strictly according to biodynamic principles and holds full Demeter and BioGro certifications.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, pure mid palate, and distinct mineral tension of this Chardonnay make it a versatile partner for elegant, lightly seasoned dishes.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with fresh seafood options such as raw oysters, shrimp, crab, or premium grilled fish.

  • Savoury: Suggested pairings include dishes with subtle richness that benefit from a crisp, linear contrast, such as an almond croissant or light poultry preparations.

  • Cheese: Matches gracefully with hard, structured artisanal cheeses such as mature Manchego or Parmesan.

title: 17 Valley Pinot Noir 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
From New Zealand’s renowned Marlborough region, the Seventeen Valley Pinot Noir is produced by Mount Riley Wines, a family-owned winery led by the Barker family. Mount Riley is recognised for combining tradition with innovation, producing wines that highlight the purity and vibrancy of Marlborough fruit. The Seventeen Valley bottling is crafted only in exceptional vintages, representing the estate’s pinnacle expression of Pinot Noir.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir displays a deep crimson hue with a translucent edge. The nose is perfumed with ripe red fruits such as strawberries, cherries, and pomegranate, layered with hints of red licorice, sumac, and dried herbs. On the palate, it offers plush fruit concentration supported by fine, pliable tannins and bright acidity. Subtle French oak ageing adds smoky notes, spice, and structure without overwhelming the fruit. Medium-bodied yet powerful, it strikes a balance between freshness and complexity, finishing long and silky.

Food Pairing

Ideal with game dishes such as duck breast, venison, or wild mushroom risotto. It also complements roasted lamb, charcuterie, or earthy vegetable dishes. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Paddy Borthwick Pinot Gris 2025
bodyHtml:
Produced in the heart of Wairarapa, New Zealand, the Borthwick Estate is family-owned and known for its sustainable viticulture and riverside setting. The Pinot Gris vines thrive on stony, free-draining alluvial soils shaped by the nearby Ruamahunga River. This terroir—marked by warm days, cool nights, and a balanced climate—imbues the wine with clarity, texture, and regional character.

Wine Description

Paddy Borthwick Pinot Gris is aromatic and refined, offering a bouquet of ripe pear, quince, green apple, and delicate honeysuckle, layered with subtle baking spice and lees-driven minerality. On the palate, it is medium-bodied yet bright, with a smooth texture, gentle oak influence, and a dry, crisp finish highlighted by a lingering touch of spice.

Food Pairing

Its aromatic fruit and crisp minerality make it a superb match for Thai green curry, sushi, roast pork with pear sauce, creamy pasta, poultry, or light seafood dishes. These pairings highlight the wine’s balance of richness and freshness.

title: Felton Road Pinot Noir 'Calvert' 2024
bodyHtml:
From Central Otago, New Zealand, Felton Road has established itself as a benchmark producer of Pinot Noir, with a reputation for purity, balance, and site expression. The winery farms organically and biodynamically, with full BioGro and Demeter certification, and vinifies with minimal intervention. The Calvert Vineyard, situated in Bannockburn, is celebrated for producing wines of refinement and elegance, expressing the deep schist soils and distinctive microclimate of the site.

Wine Description

The Calvert Pinot Noir displays a deep ruby colour with lifted aromatics of rose petal, violet, and spice, layered with red and dark berry fruit. The palate is finely textured, showing a core of sweet cherry fruit, subtle earthiness, and savoury notes of forest floor and spice. Silky tannins and bright acidity frame the wine, giving it poise and length. The style is elegant, floral, and mineral-driven, with a long, harmonious finish. Crafted with indigenous yeasts, gentle handling, and ageing in French oak, the wine is unfined and unfiltered, preserving its natural character and complexity.

Food Pairing

The graceful yet structured style of Calvert makes it a versatile partner for duck breast, venison, lamb with rosemary, or wild mushroom risotto. Its floral aromatics and fine tannins also shine alongside truffle dishes or soft cheeses.

title: Maison Merveille Bordeaux Red 2023
bodyHtml:
From France’s renowned Bordeaux region, Maison Merveille crafts wines that embody the elegance and tradition of this world-famous appellation. The estate is dedicated to accessible, fruit-forward Bordeaux blends that remain true to their heritage while offering exceptional value for everyday enjoyment.

Wine Description

Maison Merveille Bordeaux Red 2020 is a dry red blend composed of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Malbec. In the glass, it shows a deep ruby colour. The nose reveals bright aromas of blackcurrant, raspberry, and cranberry, complemented by subtle herbal notes of mint and thyme. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with well-balanced acidity and gentle tannins, offering layers of red and black fruit that finish with freshness and finesse.

Food Pairing

This Bordeaux blend pairs beautifully with grilled lamb, roast chicken, or mushroom risotto. Its bright fruit and balanced tannins also complement semi-hard cheeses such as Comté or aged cheddar.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Balmenach Single Malt 2008 'Connoisseurs Choice'
bodyHtml:
From Scotland’s Speyside region, the Balmenach Distillery is one of the area’s oldest legal distilleries, founded in 1824. Though much of its whisky traditionally goes into blends, independent bottler Gordon & MacPhail has a long history of selecting and maturing exceptional single malts, giving enthusiasts a rare opportunity to explore Balmenach’s character through their Connoisseurs Choice series.

Description

On the nose, it opens with aromas of orchard fruit, honeyed malt, and subtle floral notes, layered with spice and a touch of citrus zest. The palate delivers a full-bodied profile of baked apples, pears, toffee, and warming spices, with undertones of nutmeg and vanilla. The finish is long and satisfying, with lingering spice and subtle sherry richness.

Food Pairing

Pair with rich dishes such as roasted duck with spiced orange glaze, aged cheddar with honey, or dark chocolate truffles.

title: Benromach Contrasts: Double Matured Bordeaux Wine Cask Finish
bodyHtml:
This single malt whisky hails from Scotland’s Speyside region, produced by the independent family-owned distillery Benromach, established in 1898 and revived in 1998 under Gordon & MacPhail. The distillery is renowned for its traditional small-scale methods, using predominantly manual equipment and crafting whisky with a subtle smoky character, a rare trait among Speyside producers.

Whisky Description

This limited-edition expression is aged for 12 years—first in first-fill bourbon casks for seven years, followed by five years in Bordeaux red wine casks. The result is a whisky of deep amber colour. The nose offers delicate floral tones of rose layered with honey and ripe red fruits. On the palate, it reveals zesty tangerine, dark forest fruits, and toasted oak, balanced by a medium body and finishing with Benromach’s signature soft peat smoke. Its style emphasises both rich fruit complexity from the wine casks and the classic lightly smoky Speyside character.

title: Villa Sparina Brut
bodyHtml:
Italy’s Piedmont region, in the heart of Gavi, is home to Villa Sparina, a winery founded in the 1970s by the Moccagatta family. The estate is renowned not only for its award-winning wines but also for its resort and restaurant, offering a holistic experience that reflects the region’s traditions and hospitality. Villa Sparina is particularly celebrated for its work with the Cortese grape, emblematic of Gavi.

Wine Description

In the glass, it shows a fine and persistent perlage with an elegant mousse. Aromas of bread crust, minerality, and hints of honey unfold delicately.
