The palate is fresh and fragrant, with balanced acidity and subtle earthy nuances that lead into a long and graceful finish. The wine is full-bodied yet vibrant, expressing both finesse and character. Best enjoyed now but capable of ageing gracefully for a few years.

Food Pairing

Perfect as an aperitif, Villa Sparina Brut pairs beautifully with fresh seafood such as oysters and clams, or lighter dishes like sushi and delicate appetisers.

title: Drumshanbo Gunpowder Gin Italian Fig & Laurel
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Drumshanbo Gunpowder Gin is crafted at The Shed Distillery, founded by PJ Rigney. The distillery is known for blending tradition with innovation, using exotic botanicals alongside Irish craftsmanship. This edition, created in collaboration with renowned Italian mixologist Bruno Vanzan, reflects a meeting of Irish distilling expertise and Italian flavour inspiration.

Gin Description

Crystal clear in appearance. On the nose, bright citrus zest is joined by sweet fig and fragrant laurel, supported by subtle Tuscan juniper. The palate is layered with grapefruit and fig, balanced by herbal complexity and classic oriental spice. The body is smooth and rounded, while the finish is clean, dry, and refreshing with lingering notes of laurel and fruit. This edition is composed of traditional Drumshanbo botanicals, oriental gunpowder tea, and the addition of Italian viola fig and laurel, showcasing freshness, balance, and depth.

title: Hester Creek Rose Cabernet Franc 2025
bodyHtml:
Produced in Canada at Hester Creek Estate Winery in British Columbia, the 2024 Rosé Cabernet Franc draws its fruit from Washington State’s Columbia Valley, particularly Red Mountain and Horse Heaven Hills, due to a harsh freeze in B.C. vineyards. Founded in 1968, Hester Creek is one of the Okanagan’s pioneering wineries, known for its innovation and resilience in adapting to challenging vintages.

Wine Description
This rosé presents a vivid deep pink to pale ruby colour. On the nose, it offers bright aromas of pink grapefruit, cherry, rhubarb, cream soda, and cooked strawberries. The palate is medium-bodied and just off-dry, showcasing layers of strawberry, cranberry, and pomegranate, balanced by lively acidity and freshness.

Food Pairing
This rosé pairs beautifully with charcuterie, bold cheeses, roasted chicken, salmon, and spicy salami. The balance of fruit and freshness complements savoury and rich dishes alike.

title: Le Serre Nuove Dell' Ornellaia 2022
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s coastal region of Tuscany, in the renowned Bolgheri DOC, comes Le Serre Nuove Dell Ornellaia 2022. Produced by Tenuta dell Ornellaia, one of Italy’s most prestigious estates founded in 1981, the winery is celebrated for its Bordeaux-inspired blends crafted with Tuscan elegance. Now under the ownership of the Frescobaldi family, Ornellaia remains a benchmark for quality and terroir expression in Bolgheri.

Wine Description
This deep ruby-red wine opens with aromas of ripe blackcurrants, blackberries, violets, and hints of Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied with plush fruit and refined tannins, showing layers of dark cherries, figs, and a touch of cocoa. Notes of cedar and sweet spice from barrique ageing (15 months, one-third new oak) add complexity without overpowering the fruit.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 95 points.

  • Wine Spectator – 93 points.

  • Vinous – 92 points.

  • Decanter – 90 points.

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled lamb, braised beef short ribs, or prime rib, this wine also pairs beautifully with aged cheeses and game dishes.

title: Le Petit de Ducru Beaucaillou 2022
bodyHtml:
From France’s Bordeaux region, this Saint-Julien wine comes from the prestigious Château Ducru Beaucaillou, an estate renowned since the 18th century for producing elegant and age-worthy wines. Owned by the Borie family, the château is celebrated for its meticulous vineyard management and a philosophy centred on precision, balance, and terroir expression.

Wine Description
This blend of approximately 75% Merlot, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 5% Petit Verdot presents a deep ruby colour in the glass. The nose reveals floral notes of lily alongside blackberries, plum, cocoa, and hints of vanilla. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, offering silky tannins, supple texture, and vibrant freshness. Layers of red cherry, raspberry coulis, and subtle tobacco are lifted by graphite and spice, culminating in a refined, mineral-tinged finish.

Accolades

  • Jeb Dunnuck – 92 points

  • Vinous (Neal Martin) – 91 points

  • James Suckling – 94 points

  • Decanter – 92 points

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, roast duck, or beef tenderloin with peppercorn sauce. Its freshness and elegance also complement earthy mushroom risotto or aged hard cheeses.

title: Pietradolce Archineri Etna Bianco 2022
bodyHtml:
Italy’s Sicily region, specifically the Etna DOC in the Milo subzone on the volcano’s eastern slopes, is home to Pietradolce. Founded in 2005, the winery is dedicated to producing expressive wines from indigenous varietals rooted in volcanic soil. Pietradolce works with ancient, pre-phylloxera vines and embraces minimal intervention to showcase the purity and minerality of Mount Etna’s unique terroir.

Wine Description
Crafted from 100% Carricante grapes grown on 150-year-old vines at 850 metres elevation, the Archineri Etna Bianco presents a luminous straw yellow hue. On the nose, it offers captivating aromas of white peach, orange blossom, Meyer lemon, flint, and Mediterranean herbs. The palate is crystalline and focused, with vibrant acidity and pronounced salinity.

Food Pairing
Ideal alongside grilled branzino, oysters, or Sicilian seafood pasta. Its fresh acidity and savoury minerality also complement dishes featuring fennel, citrus, or herbs.

title: Antica Torino Amaro Della Sacra
bodyHtml: The ingredients are all-natural: leaves, flowers, seeds, roots, resins, spices, and barks. Some typical of the territory of Piedmont such as gentianella and hops flowers, others more ‘exotic,’ discovered over the centuries during the exploration of new lands, including the vanilla of Madagascar, the green cardamom of the Indies, the myrrh of the Middle East, as well as the chinchona bark of South America. Amaro Della Sacra is created by macerating the ingredients in grain alcohol and ageing until all the elements are well incorporated.

title: Bacardi Gold
bodyHtml:
Bacardi Gold, produced in Puerto Rico, is a golden-coloured rum crafted under the expertise of the Maestros de Ron Bacardi. The Bacardi family, with its rich history dating back to 1862 in Santiago de Cuba, built its reputation on producing smooth, approachable rums. Now operating internationally, the distillery continues to uphold its founding principles of quality, consistency, and innovation while blending tradition with modern production techniques.

Rum Description
Bacardi Gold presents a warm amber hue with a soft, inviting glow. The aroma opens with gentle notes of vanilla and buttery caramel, layered with hints of toasted almond and sweet banana, complemented by a whisper of orange zest. On the palate, it is light-bodied yet rounded, offering a smooth balance of mellow sweetness and subtle spice, with delicate traces of ginger root leading into a clean, dry finish.

Food Pairing
Bacardi Gold pairs beautifully with grilled pineapple, jerk chicken, or caramel-based desserts, where its smooth vanilla and caramel notes complement the food’s richness. It also works well alongside tropical fruit salads or creamy coconut-based dishes. This pairing highlights the spirit’s depth and character, especially when served in a relaxed, social setting.

title: Glenfarclas 40 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml: A remarkably well-priced addition to the Glenfarclas range, this 40yo has been simply-packaged in line with the rest of the standard bottlings from the distillery, and has been bottled at the perfect drinking strength of 46%. A 40 year old sherried Speyside designed for drinking rather than sitting on a mantlepiece or in a display cabinet - bravo. Awarded a very well-merited Gold Medal at the Malt Maniacs Awards 2010.

title: Douglas Laing's Rock Island Blended Whisky - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: An extraordinary encapsulation of the very best Single Malts distilled on the glorious islands of Islay, Arran, Jura and Orkney (amongst others), Rock Island is a subtle, smoky and sweet celebration of the sea.

title: 50th Parallel Pinot Gris 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
From Canada’s Okanagan Valley, British Columbia, 50th Parallel Estate is a modern winery celebrated for its meticulous vineyard practices and commitment to expressing the unique terroir of Lake Country. Founded by Curtis Krouzel and Sheri-Lee Turner-Krouzel, the estate has built a reputation for producing elegant, fruit-driven wines with a focus on Pinot varieties and sustainable practices.

Wine Description
The 2024 Pinot Gris displays a pale straw hue with glints of silver. On the nose, aromas of mandarin orange, ripe apple, honeysuckle, and orange blossom mingle with delicate notes of golden honey. The palate offers flavours of candied apple and orange peel, balanced by a refreshing citrus backbone and a soft, rounded texture from lees ageing. Medium-bodied and finely balanced, the wine finishes with crisp acidity and subtle creaminess that lingers gracefully.

Food Pairing
This versatile wine pairs beautifully with grilled prawns, pan-seared salmon, soft cheeses such as goat or feta, and lightly spiced dishes like samosas.

title: Gaia de Chateau Puybarbe 2022
bodyHtml:
From France’s Bordeaux region, in the Côtes de Bourg appellation, Château Puybarbe is a family-owned estate with a long tradition of quality winemaking. The vineyard is committed to sustainable practices, holding High Environmental Value and ISO 14001 certifications, and has been progressing through organic conversion. The philosophy at the estate emphasizes balance, respect for the environment, and producing approachable, terroir-driven wines.

Wine Description

Gaïa de Château Puybarbe is a Merlot-dominant red blend that captures the elegance of Right Bank Bordeaux. It presents a deep ruby colour and opens with aromas of ripe blackberries, dark cherries, and delicate hints of roasted coffee and cacao. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, with juicy fruit, supple tannins, and subtle spice. The wine offers balance, freshness, and a savoury finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile Bordeaux red complements a wide range of dishes, including roast chicken, grilled pork tenderloin, game sausages, and hearty stews. It also pairs beautifully with mushroom risotto or roasted vegetable dishes.

title: Stark-Conde Cabernet Sauvignon Three Pines 2020
bodyHtml:
From South Africa’s Stellenbosch wine region, specifically the scenic Jonkershoek Valley, this wine hails from the renowned Stark Conde estate. Founded by José Conde and located on the family’s Oude Nektar farm, the winery is celebrated for crafting elegant, terroir-driven wines in small batches. The ‘Three Pines’ vineyard, planted on decomposed granite soils, is one of the estate’s most prized sites, producing Cabernet Sauvignon with remarkable structure and finesse.

Wine Description
Deep garnet in colour, this Cabernet Sauvignon offers captivating aromas of cassis, violet, black cherry, and subtle cedar. On the palate, layers of blackberry, dark plum, and dark chocolate unfold, accented by hints of tobacco and spice. Medium to full-bodied, it displays fine, silky tannins and vibrant acidity, leading to a long, polished finish.

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled ribeye, braised lamb shanks, or hearty mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Chateau La Chapelle Canterane
bodyHtml:
From France’s Bordeaux region, in the renowned appellation of Saint-Émilion, Château La Chapelle Canterane has been under the stewardship of the Trabut-Cussac family for nearly four centuries. Nestled in the commune of Saint-Étienne-de-Lisse, the estate benefits from sun-drenched clay-limestone slopes, producing wines of character and elegance. The winery is dedicated to traditional viticulture with selective harvesting and meticulous care from vine to bottle.

Wine Description
This Saint-Émilion Grand Cru presents a deep garnet hue with violet reflections. On the nose, it offers expressive aromas of ripe blackberries, blackcurrant, and plum, complemented by subtle hints of cedar, violet, and spice. The palate is round and well-structured, with supple tannins supporting flavours of dark fruit, cocoa, and a touch of minerality. Medium to full-bodied, the wine carries a long, harmonious finish. Crafted primarily from Merlot, with a balance of Cabernet Franc, it combines richness with freshness and finesse.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with classic French fare such as côte de bœuf, tournedos with truffle butter, or wild boar with mushrooms. It also complements rich pasta dishes like foie gras tagliatelle or aged cheeses. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Chateau Richebon
bodyHtml:
Château Richebon is a Pauillac estate in Bordeaux with deep ties to the prestigious Château Croizet Bages, a Fifth Growth in the 1855 classification. Owned by the Quié family since 1942, the vineyard traces its history back to the 17th century, with the Croizet brothers and later the Calvé family helping shape its legacy. Today, Anne-Françoise and Jean-Philippe Quié guide the estate with a focus on producing elegant, authentic Pauillac wines that balance tradition and modernity.

Wine Description
A blend of approximately 60% Cabernet Sauvignon and 40% Merlot, Château Richebon offers a deep ruby hue and an expressive nose of blackcurrant, cherry, and subtle spice. On the palate, ripe black fruits are layered with notes of cedar and a hint of graphite, supported by supple yet structured tannins. Medium to full bodied, the wine shows fine balance and freshness, with a lingering, elegant finish.

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled rib-eye steak, roast lamb with rosemary, or a rich beef bourguignon. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Feudi Maccari Grillo 2024
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s sun-soaked island of Sicily, in the region of Noto in the southeast, Feudo Maccari crafts expressive wines rooted in the area’s rich viticultural heritage. The estate, owned by Antonio Moretti Cuseri and his daughter Monica since 2000, is renowned for its bush-trained vines, volcanic and calcareous soils, and a winemaking philosophy focused on purity and expression of terroir.

Wine Description
This 100% Grillo displays a bright straw-yellow colour. On the nose, it opens with aromas of white flowers, citrus zest, and ripe pear, layered with hints of Mediterranean herbs and a subtle saline minerality. The palate is fresh and vibrant, offering flavours of crisp apple, lemon, and mango, underpinned by a delicate almond note. Medium-bodied with balanced acidity, it finishes with a clean, lingering, slightly salty edge.

Food Pairing
An excellent companion to grilled seafood, seafood risotto, or citrus-infused chicken. It also pairs beautifully with fresh garden salads or light vegetarian dishes.

title: Protea Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from South Africa’s Western Cape, the Protea Pinot Grigio is crafted by Anthonij Rupert Wines, a family-owned estate celebrated for its sustainable practices and commitment to showcasing the diversity of the Cape’s vineyards. The winery sources grapes from premium sites in Franschhoek, Groenekloof, Darling, Elgin, and Elandskloof, creating a wine that reflects the region’s fresh coastal influence and varied terroir.

Wine Description
Made from 100% Pinot Grigio grapes, this wine is hand-harvested in the cool early mornings to preserve its delicate aromatics. The fruit undergoes whole-bunch pressing, overnight settling, and fermentation in stainless steel tanks, followed by several months on the lees to enhance mouthfeel and complexity. In the glass, it shows a pale straw colour with a faint green hue. Aromas of ripe nectarine, peach, and stone fruit mingle with subtle floral and citrus notes. The palate is bright and juicy, revealing flavours of nectarine, crunchy apple, lemon zest, and a light mineral edge.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with fresh seafood, creamy pasta dishes, or a classic Caprese salad. The stone fruit and citrus freshness lift lighter dishes, while its gentle texture complements creamier elements. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Cornelissen Monjebel Bianco 2022
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s Sicily region, specifically the northern slopes of Mount Etna, Cornelissen Monjebel Bianco is crafted by renowned natural winemaker Frank Cornelissen. His estate, founded in 2001, is dedicated to non-interventionist methods that respect the land’s volcanic terroir. Cornelissen’s philosophy is to allow nature to guide the process, producing wines that are pure expressions of Etna’s unique soils and microclimate.

Wine Description

This wine is a blend of Grecanico Dorato and Carricante grapes, grown on volcanic soils at elevations of 620–750 metres. It pours a golden yellow colour with slight amber reflections from its short skin contact. Aromas reveal citrus, stone fruit, dried herbs, and saline minerality, alongside subtle notes of resin and ginger. On the palate, it is textural and savoury, with layers of apricot, pear, and citrus zest balanced by firm acidity and a gentle tannic grip. The body is medium to full, with a long, mineral-driven finish. 

Food Pairing

The wine’s structure and savoury character pair beautifully with seafood, poultry, creamy pasta dishes, and Sicilian classics such as carbonara. Its minerality enhances delicate dishes, while its texture complements richer fare.

title: Felton Road Chardonnay 'Block 6' 2023
bodyHtml:
From New Zealand’s Central Otago, specifically the Bannockburn subregion, Felton Road has become a benchmark producer renowned for its organic and biodynamic viticulture. Founded in 1991, the winery has built its reputation on meticulous vineyard practices, minimal intervention winemaking, and an unwavering focus on terroir expression.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a bright lemon colour in the glass. Aromas open with citrus, grapefruit, and apple layered with subtle leesy notes, toasty oak, and a whisper of brioche. On the palate, it delivers flavours of mandarin, yellow cherries, and pear, supported by butterscotch and mineral undertones. The medium-plus body is finely textured with a lightly creamy mouthfeel, balanced by fresh acidity. The finish is long, elegant, and laced with saline minerality.

Accolades

  • Vinous – 94 points.

Food Pairing

This Chardonnay’s richness and mineral freshness make it an excellent companion to roasted chicken with lemon and herbs, creamy pasta with wild mushrooms, or a simple seared scallop dish. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Casa Raia Bevilo Toscana Rosso 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Casa Raia is a small, family-run estate located just outside the medieval town of Montalcino, at an elevation of approximately 375 metres. The winery, owned and operated by Pierre Jean Monnoyer and Kalyna, is dedicated to certified organic and biodynamic farming, respecting the rhythms of nature and the individuality of each vintage. Their philosophy centres on minimal intervention, allowing the vines and terroir to express themselves fully.

Wine Description
In the glass, it shows an intense ruby red colour with brilliant clarity. Aromas reveal layers of blackcurrant, blackberry, and raspberry, interwoven with thyme, nutmeg, tobacco, and subtle dried fig. The palate is full-bodied yet graceful, with ripe black fruit, earthy spice, and a hint of cocoa, supported by fine tannins and lively acidity.

Food Pairing
Perfect alongside classic Tuscan fare such as bistecca alla Fiorentina, wild boar ragù with pappardelle, or aged pecorino. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Le Grappin Chardonnay Macon Villages Blanc
bodyHtml:
From France’s Burgundy region, in the Mâconnais subregion, this Chardonnay is crafted by Le Grappin, founded in 2011 by Andrew and Emma Nielsen. The winery focuses on uncovering exceptional, often overlooked vineyard sites and producing wines with minimal intervention. Sourcing from cool slopes above the village of Azé, the fruit benefits from clay-limestone soils and a microclimate that preserves freshness and vibrancy.

Wine Description
A pale lemon-gold in the glass, this wine opens with bright aromas of apple, pear, and peach, layered with hints of citrus, melon, and a subtle mineral undertone. On the palate, it is fresh and lively, offering flavours of ripe orchard fruit, tropical passion fruit, and lemon zest, supported by gentle notes of butter, toast, and vanilla from lees ageing. Medium-bodied with a creamy texture, it delivers balanced acidity and a lingering, elegant finish.

Food Pairing
Ideal with roast chicken, creamy pasta dishes, grilled vegetables, or a classic Caesar salad. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Felton Road Pinot Noir 'Macmuir' 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from New Zealand, specifically from the Bannockburn subregion of Central Otago. Established in 1991, Felton Road is a world renowned estate that has become a benchmark for cool climate winemaking under the ownership of Nigel Greening and the technical guidance of founding winemaker Blair Walter. The winery operates on a domaine model, utilizing exclusively estate grown fruit from vineyards managed with a strict commitment to organic and biodynamic principles.

Wine Description

Felton Road Pinot Noir Macmuir presents a deep colour with an intense and complex sensory profile. The nose is richly fragrant, offering aromatics of morello cherry, dark plum, and violets layered with savoury notes of dried thyme, sage, and a hint of dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is bold and concentrated, featuring black fruit flavours, liquorice, and anise supported by fine grained, powdery tannins. It is characterized by a svelte, polished texture and a distinct mineral tension that leads to a long, finely tuned finish. This 100% Pinot Noir is crafted using gravity flow, native yeast fermentation, and approximately 25% whole clusters before aging for 13 months in French oak barrels. The wine is fully certified organic by BioGro and biodynamic by Demeter. The ABV typically ranges between 14% and 14.5%.

title: Felton Road 25th Vintage Celebration Mixed Case 2021 - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
From Central Otago, New Zealand, Felton Road has built an international reputation as one of the leading producers of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. Certified organic and biodynamic, the estate is devoted to sustainable farming and minimal-intervention winemaking. This limited mixed case was created to celebrate Felton Road’s 25th vintage, highlighting their most acclaimed single-vineyard expressions.

Wine Description

This six-bottle case offers a curated showcase of Felton Road’s vineyards, featuring four Pinot Noirs and two Chardonnays. The Pinot Noirs display the hallmark depth, complexity, and fine tannin structure that Central Otago is known for, with layers of dark berry fruit, spice, and mineral precision. The Chardonnays are equally distinguished, offering elegant citrus, stone fruit, and flinty minerality balanced by texture and freshness. Together, the case captures the essence of Felton Road’s craftsmanship and vineyard diversity.

Accolades

  • Calvert Pinot Noir – 95 points (Wine Advocate)

  • Cornish Point Pinot Noir – 96 points (James Suckling)

  • Block 3 Pinot Noir – 97 points (The Real Review)

  • Block 5 Pinot Noir – 97 points (James Suckling)

  • Block 2 Chardonnay – 94 points (The Real Review)

  • Block 6 Chardonnay – 96 points (Wine Advocate)

Food Pairing

The Pinot Noirs pair beautifully with roast duck, venison, lamb, or wild mushroom dishes, while the Chardonnays shine with seafood, creamy chicken, or soft cheeses. Presented together, this case offers an ideal collection for a celebratory dinner or tasting flight. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Central Otago was marked by balance and finesse, producing wines with excellent concentration and elegance. Each vineyard in this case reflects both the strengths of the season and Felton Road’s ability to capture site expression at its finest.

title: Gehringer Brothers Auxerrois 2025
bodyHtml:
Gehringer Brothers Estate Winery, nestled on the Golden Mile Bench in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley, was established in 1985 by brothers Walter and Gordon Gehringer. After extensive microclimate evaluations, they selected this prime location for its ideal grape-growing conditions. Both brothers honed their winemaking skills in Germany, bringing European expertise to their Canadian vineyard. Their commitment to quality and consistency has made them a standout in the region, particularly noted for their exceptional white wines.

Wine Description
Old Vines Auxerrois is crafted in an off-dry style, showcasing a soft, mellow acidity complemented by subtle fruit flavours. This wine offers a harmonious balance, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a versatile and approachable white wine.

Food Pairing
This Auxerrois pairs beautifully with a variety of dishes. Its balanced profile complements seafood, poultry, and light pasta dishes. The wine's subtle fruitiness and gentle acidity enhance the flavours of the meal, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Havana Club Seleccion de Maestros Dark Rum
bodyHtml:
Crafted in Cuba, Havana Club Selección de Maestros represents the pinnacle of Cuban rum-making tradition. Produced by the Maestros del Ron Cubano, this expression is the result of a unique collective blending process, showcasing the artistry and heritage of Cuba’s most skilled rum masters.

Spirit Description
This dark rum presents a deep amber hue with warm mahogany highlights. On the nose, it reveals complex aromas of toasted pecans, spices, and rich wood notes. The palate is full-bodied and smooth, with layers of cocoa, coffee, sweet tobacco, and brown sugar, balanced by a subtle smokiness. The finish is long and warming, leaving impressions of spice and dark caramel.

title: Prophecy Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
Crafted in California, Prophecy Pinot Noir is part of a collection of wines designed to showcase iconic varietals from renowned regions. The brand takes its inspiration from artistry and storytelling, reflecting the philosophy of creating expressive wines that highlight balance and character. With a focus on varietal purity, Prophecy presents wines that are approachable yet layered with complexity.

Wine Description
This Pinot Noir shines with a translucent ruby colour in the glass. The bouquet opens with red fruit notes of cherry, raspberry, and strawberry, lifted by hints of vanilla, toasted oak, and a touch of coconut. On the palate, it offers a silky, medium body with flavours of ripe cherry and raspberry supported by subtle brown spice. The texture is smooth and balanced, carrying through to a long, velvety finish that lingers gently. The wine is crafted in a modern, fruit-forward style, emphasizing freshness and elegance.

title: Salvia E Limone
bodyHtml: In Torino Salvia & Limone is traditionally enjoyed like Limoncello. Served after dinner, with a chill. But with the cocktail explosion in Italy, it's become a fun modification for cocktails, stirred or shaken. Sage and lemon being the highlighted ingredients, this liqueur infuses local herbs and botanicals from Torino with neutral grain spirit, and works in partnership with Carlo Alberto for the technical infusion. This liqueur can be enjoyed on its own, or experienced in some of your favorite styles of cocktail recipes.

title: Dalmore Vintage Collection 2006
bodyHtml:
Produced in Scotland’s Highland region, The Dalmore distillery has built a reputation for mastery in cask maturation since its founding in 1839. Known for its partnership with the sherry house González Byass and its pioneering use of fine casks, The Dalmore has become a benchmark for luxury single malt whisky, blending heritage with innovation in every release.

Description

The Dalmore Vintage Collection 2006 is an 18-year-old single malt matured initially in American white oak ex-bourbon casks before being refined in rare 30-year-old Matusalem and Amoroso sherry casks. Bottled at 47.2% ABV, non-chill filtered and of natural colour, it reveals deep amber hues. On the nose, it opens with sherry-soaked raisins, roasted figs, cedarwood and honey. The palate is rich with dark fruits, liquorice, cacao, and a citrus lift of bergamot and blood orange. The finish lingers with cassia bark, dark chocolate and antique sherry notes, offering a complex and indulgent experience.

Food Pairing

This distinguished whisky pairs beautifully with venison tenderloin, dark chocolate torte, or aged Manchego cheese. These combinations enhance its layered sweetness and spice, highlighting the whisky’s depth and character.

title: Dillon's Gin Variety Pack 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml:
At Dillon's, they take great pride in handcrafting products using copper stills and fresh local ingredients without artificial flavours or colours. They strive to make new enjoyable spirits from old ideas and to do so with unparalleled quality, one batch at a time. They are a group of passionate individuals. They are passionate about crafting honest spirits and in turn crafting honest, spirit and ingredient forward cocktails. They make spirits how they like them. When you know what you like, it's simple and they like to keep it simple. They began this journey back in 2012 with a lot of passion, drive, commitment, and a big dream. A dream to make the best possible spirits and be honest at every step. It takes an honest day’s work in the truest sense to make honest to goodness spirits.

The Variety Pack includes:

4 x 355mL Tangerine, Lemon & A Hint of Mint Gin Cocktail

4 x 355mL Black Cherry & A Touch of Cranberry Gin Cocktail

4 x 355mL Blackberry, Lemon & A Dash of Elderflower Gin Cocktail

title: Domaine Drouhin Pinot Noir Cloudline 2022
bodyHtml: Cloudline Cellars represents a first for Dreyfus, Ashby, their own wine. Given their love for Pinot Noir and their long history developing Domaine Drouhin Oregon and other fine wines, it's probably not surprising that they've chosen Oregon's Willamette Valley as the home for this exciting project. The Cloudline colour is a deep ruby, with a dense texture, deft balance, and a fruit-driven core. Aromatics include plum, cranberry, a touch of toast, and various dark fruits. Well-integrated tannins lead to a pleasing and complete finish, in a word, delicious.

title: Dalmore Vintage Collection 2009
bodyHtml:
Matured in American white oak ex-Bourbon barrels and enhanced by hand-selected Matusalem Sherry casks, and Graham’s 10 year old Tawny Port pipes. Non-chill filtered and natural colour.

Whispers of Manuka honey, dark plum, cracked black pepper, and hints of clove. Morello cherries and dates, elevated with notes of candied Seville orange, fresh figs, and light cacao. Rich plum complemented by moist ginger cake, roast chestnut, and soft wood spice.

title: Birra Moretti L'Autentica 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Birra Moretti L’Autentica is Italy’s most famous export and a symbol of the Italian "art of living." First brewed in 1859 by Luigi Moretti in Udine, its label famously features "Baffo" (the Mustachioed Man), a character Luigi supposedly spotted in a local trattoria and photographed in exchange for a drink. While it has grown into a global brand, L’Autentica remains a faithful representation of a premium Italian Lager—designed to be light, elegant, and the perfect companion to Mediterranean cuisine.

Beer Description

This international pale lager pours a brilliant, translucent maize-gold with a thick, frothy white head and fine, lively carbonation.

Aroma: It features a delicate and welcoming nose. Expect scents of fresh-baked white bread and sweet corn, balanced by a subtle floral and grassy hop aroma. There is a characteristic "cleanliness" to the scent that is hallmark to the style.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and remarkably smooth. It leads with a gentle, grainy malt sweetness and a touch of honeyed biscuit. The mouthfeel is crisp and effervescent, finishing with a very mild, rounded bitterness that cleanses the palate without lingering.

Profile: It has an ABV of 4.6% and a low bitterness of 12 IBU, prioritizing refreshment and balance over intensity.

Technical Notes: Brewed using a high-quality blend of hops and a special variety of Italian maize, which contributes to its light body and clear, bright color. It is bottom-fermented at low temperatures and cold-conditioned to ensure the yeast profile remains neutral, allowing the delicate malt flavors to shine.

title: Marolo Dco. Ulrich Vermouth Extra Dry
Donini Merlot 2024 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Donini Merlot originates from Italy, specifically within the Venezia appellation of the Veneto region. The Donini story began at the turn of the 20th century in a Milanese trattoria, where the owner, Signore Donini, was celebrated for his skill in selecting exceptional wines for his patrons.

Wine Description

This Merlot presents a bright ruby red colour in the glass. The sensory profile features a fragrant bouquet of ripe red fruits, notably plum and cherry, accented by delicate herbaceous scents and subtle notes of clove or pastry dough. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and dry, offering a balanced structure of soft tannins and lively acidity. The finish is clean and slightly lingering, characterized by lingering fruit and a hint of blackberry.

title: Louis Bouillot Cremant de Bourgogne Rose (NV)
bodyHtml: Founded in 1877, Bouillot was one of the first to experiment with the crafting of sparkling Burgundy wine. This blend of Pinot Noir, Gamay and Chardonnay is ever delightful, fruity and dry with pretty strawberry, citrus and a touch of spice. Sip or pair with smoked salmon.

title: Lamarca Prosecco - 187 ml Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the Prosecco DOC appellation, Lamarca Prosecco represents a quintessential, sparkling, and refreshing expression of Italian Glera. Produced by La Marca Trevigiana, a highly respected cooperative of growers in northeastern Italy founded in 1968, the brand has become a global standard for premium Prosecco. Sourced from sun-drenched vineyards across the rolling hills of Treviso, the winemaking philosophy focuses on gentle pressing of the grapes followed by a controlled secondary fermentation in stainless steel pressure tanks using the Charmat method. This process preserves the grape's delicate aromatic compounds, bright fruit acidity, and vibrant natural effervescence, creating a clean, crisp, and refreshing sparkling wine suitable for any celebration.

Wine Description

The wine presents a pale straw yellow colour with delicate greenish reflections and a fine, persistent stream of lively bubbles. An inviting, highly aromatic bouquet opens with fresh notes of green apple, white peach, and juicy Meyer lemon, interwoven with delicate nuances of white flowers, honey, and subtle citrus blossom. On the palate, it is light bodied, crisp, and lively, delivering refreshing flavours of crisp orchard fruit and lemon zest supported by a vibrant, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Finishing clean, dry, and invigorating, it leaves a pleasant, lingering impression of sweet apple and subtle mineral freshness. Composed predominantly of Glera, it offers an exceptionally versatile, food-friendly, and uplifting sparkling wine profile with broad global appeal.

title: Chehalem Pinot Noir Rose
bodyHtml:
From the United States, this rosé hails from Oregon’s renowned Willamette Valley, specifically the Chehalem Mountains subregion. Chehalem Winery, established in 1990 and now part of the Stoller Wine Group, is known for its focus on sustainable practices and expressive Pinot Noir. The winery highlights terroir-driven wines that showcase the purity and vibrancy of Oregon fruit.

Wine Description
This rosé is crafted from 100% Pinot Noir, fermented predominantly in stainless steel with small portions in concrete eggs and neutral French oak to enhance texture. In the glass, it shines a delicate salmon pink. Aromas of fresh garden strawberries, grapefruit pith, and subtle floral notes of hydrangea and rose petal lead the bouquet. On the palate, it is bright and elegant, offering crisp citrus, tart red berry, and hints of stone fruit, with a smooth body and a juicy, quenching finish. The high natural acidity and minerality ensure freshness and balance, making it a lively yet refined expression of Oregon rosé.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with summer salads, fresh goat cheese, grilled salmon, or herb-roasted chicken. Its lively acidity also complements Asian dishes with ginger and citrus elements. A perfect match to enhance the wine’s complexity.

title: Adictivo Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Adictivo Extra Añejo Tequila is a luxury spirit from Mexico, specifically produced in the region of El Arenal, Jalisco. The distillery is located in an area known as the 'Gateway to Tequila Country', where volcanic soils provide an ideal environment for agave. Founded by Gildardo Partida in 2016, the brand draws on over a century of family tradition in tequila production. While the legal minimum for the extra añejo category is three years, Adictivo matures its spirit for a full seven years in French white oak barrels to achieve its signature profile.

Spirit Description

This tequila is crafted from 100% pure Blue Weber agave, which is slow cooked in traditional brick ovens before undergoing double distillation.

  • Colour: It displays a deep amber hue with distinct reddish highlights.

  • Aroma: The nose is rich and complex, featuring sweet fruit aromas combined with caramel, vanilla, and toasted oak. Subtle hints of chocolate, baking spices, and honey further enrich the bouquet.

  • Palate: It possesses a silky and oily texture with prominent flavours of toffee, maple, and roasted nuts. The palate is notably sweet, offering notes of vanilla candy and butterscotch layered over cooked agave.

  • Body: The spirit is full bodied and velvety, often compared to a fine Cognac in its depth and smoothness.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, rich finish characterized by a persistent sweet touch and lingering notes of toasted oak.

  • ABV: This extra añejo is bottled at 40%.

title: Grosset Polish Hill Riesling 2024
bodyHtml: This surprises with its almost riotous aromatics. Delightful floral aromas with hints of lime juice and beeswax – though it’s white flowers that dominate. It’s almost joyful or playful. On the palate, tight, fine and intense; a pure and unevolved thread of lime juice at its core.

title: Serafini & Vidotto Manzoni Bianco 2024
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s Veneto region, specifically the Montello–Colli Asolani DOC, Serafini & Vidotto is a renowned winery founded in 1986 by Francesco Serafini and Antonello Vidotto. Known for their commitment to sustainable viticulture and meticulous attention to detail, the estate has built a reputation for producing elegant wines that express the unique terroir of the Montello hills.

Wine Description

In the glass, it shows a pale straw-yellow hue with soft golden highlights, bright and crystalline. On the nose, it reveals exotic fruit notes of pineapple, kiwi, and passion fruit, intertwined with citrus, white peach, apple, and delicate floral hints of elderflower and white blossoms. Subtle herbal tones of sage, mint, and geranium complement a distinct mineral character reminiscent of wet stone and flint. The palate is fresh and balanced, offering smooth warmth, gentle salinity, and a prolonged fruity persistence.

Food Pairing

Ideal with Prosciutto di Parma, risotto or pasta with seafood, grilled sole, or spaghetti allo scoglio. Fresh cheeses such as cow’s milk, sheep, or goat varieties also make an excellent match. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Clos Cibonne Tibouren Tradition Rouge 2023
bodyHtml: A dark ruby red with a full body and mellow tannins. Thick, sweet and complex on the finish and marked by aromas of spices and black fruits such as blackcurrant and blackberries.

title: Jean Tardy Bourgogne Hautes Cotes de Nuits 'Cuvee Maelie' 2019
bodyHtml:
In 1966, Jean Tardy started working vines in Nuits-St-Georges, Vosne-Romanée and Clos Vougeot under a crop-sharing arrangement with Domaine Meo-Camuzet. From the 1980s, he started slowly but surely to build his estate, acquiring land in the likes of Chambolle-Musigny, Nuits-Saint-Georges, Vosne-Romanee and Gevrey-Chambertin over the next 30 years. Jean's son Guillaume took charge of the winemaking in 2001. He continues to work under the watchful eye of Jean, the two of them doing everything to ensure healthy fruit and excellent ripeness. That means short pruning, de-budding and strict green harvest to keep yields down. 

Fermentation takes place with infrequent pigeage to keep the elegance and finesse of the fruit. The wines are gently pressed to barrel and matured on lees, receiving their first racking at final blending. With only five hectares all up, these traditional, precise and elegant wines are domain-bottled in tiny quantities.

title: Cazadores Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Cazadores Extra Añejo Tequila comes from the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico, an area celebrated for producing some of the finest Blue Weber agave. Founded in 1922 by Don José María Bañuelos, Cazadores has maintained a commitment to both heritage and innovation, using traditional methods alongside modern refinements. The distillery’s unique seven-day fermentation process, famously accompanied by classical music, and its dedication to sustainable, zero-waste production, have become hallmarks of its identity.

Tequila Description
Aged for a minimum of three years in new American oak barrels, Cazadores Extra Añejo shows a deep golden colour with a luxurious, velvety texture. Aromas of vanilla, cinnamon, roasted apple, nutmeg, and hints of caramel unfold in layers. On the palate, it is rich and smooth with a buttery mouthfeel, offering flavours of baked fruit and warm spice. The finish is long and warming, showcasing a harmonious integration of oak influence and agave character. The style is elegant, complex, and balanced, making it a refined sipping spirit.

Food Pairing
Best enjoyed neat or with a large cube of ice, this tequila pairs beautifully with creamy pasta, seared steak, or rich desserts such as flan. These pairings highlight the spirit’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Zorzal Malbec Eggo Tinto de Tiza 2018
bodyHtml: This hand harvested, single vineyard wine from Gualtallary is 100% Malbec. This unique wine is completely fermented and aged in a large concrete egg and sees no oak. It is a dense, dark purple color with rich fruit flavors of blueberry and boysenberry, lilac and wet rain bounce on the nose, and has a strong mineral undertone of crushed wet rock and chalk. Eggo is the perfect combination of a chalky, terroir driven wine, with vibrant fruit and a long smooth finish.

title: Girls' Night Out Sangria
bodyHtml:
Girls' Night Out Sangria is a vibrant, Spanish-inspired beverage crafted to evoke the essence of a sun-drenched beach in Barcelona. This sangria harmoniously blends fresh fruit flavors, offering a refreshing and enjoyable experience.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Bright purple hue.
  • Aroma: Upfront aromas of orange, nutmeg, red berries, and peach.
  • Palate: Candied spiced citrus and berry fruit flavors, culminating in a refreshing finish.

Serving Suggestions

Girls' Night Out Sangria is delightful on its own but truly shines when mixed in a large pitcher with slices of your favorite fresh (or frozen) fruits and some ice. It's an ideal companion for gatherings with friends, embodying a fun and relaxed atmosphere.

Food Pairing

This sangria pairs well with a variety of dishes, including marinated olives, seafood paella, fried calamari, and Brie. Its fruity and slightly carbonated profile complements both savory and sweet flavors, making it versatile for different culinary experiences.

Product Details

  • Alcohol Content: 6.5%
  • Serving Temperature: 8º - 10º C

title: Vista Point Pinot Grigio - Colombard
bodyHtml: Fruity and refreshing, this wine has bright notes of apple, peach and citrus with a crisp and refreshing finish.

title: Apothic Dark 2022
bodyHtml: A dark take on the smooth classic, dark fruit flavours intertwine with notes of dark chocolate and coffee. Apothic Dark is an opulent blend of Petite Sirah, Teroldego, Cabernet Sauvignon, Zinfandel, Petit Verdot and Merlot.

title: Carnivor Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: Meat was made for Carnivor. Carnivor wine is a feast for the glass. The boldly blended Carnivor Cabernet Sauvignon is layered with notes of dark cherry, blackberry jam and perfectly toasted oak.

title: Portillo Sauvignon Blanc 2024
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in Argentina, this vibrant white wine originates from the high-altitude plateau of the Uco Valley in the Mendoza region. Portillo, meaning 'path' or 'gateway', is crafted by winemaking pioneers Bodegas Salentein, who established the first and largest wine estate in the Uco Valley in 1996. The winery's philosophy is rooted in harmony with nature, utilizing a unique state-of-the-art gravity-flow system across three subterranean levels to minimize fruit handling and protect the integrity of the grapes.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc presents a brilliant straw yellow colour, often accompanied by marked greenish sparks. On the nose, it is highly aromatic and fruity, revealing intense notes of pink grapefruit, white peach, and tropical fruits like passion fruit. The palate is crisp and refreshing, delivering a harmonious blend of lychee, mango, and pineapple flavours supported by a lively acidity. It possesses a medium body and an invigorating mouthfeel, leading to a clean, persistent, and citrus-driven finish.

Crafted from 100% Sauvignon Blanc, the grapes are grown at elevations between 3,500 and 5,600 feet, where high thermal amplitude ensures a superior balance between sugars and acidity. To preserve its fresh character, the berries undergo a short cold maceration with dry ice before a controlled fermentation. While designed for immediate enjoyment as a youthful and stimulating 'terrace wine', it maintains its freshness well within a drinking window of three to four years.

title: Smashberry Red Blend 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Cabernet dominant, with cassis, blackberry, and sweet pipe tobacco. Hints of grape cotton-candy from the Grenache, and denser-then -usual structure from the rare Lagrein grape. Delicious from the first sip to the last.

42% Cabernet Sauvignon, 26% Syrah, 16% Merlot, 8% Lagrein, 8% Grenache

title: Bodacious Smooth Red
bodyHtml: Medium ruby in colour with aromas of sweet plum, Nutella, blood orange, and candied berries. Medium-sweet with the same flavours as on the nose.

title: Matchbook Chardonnay Old Head 2022
bodyHtml: This rich and oaky wine offers plenty of butterscotch, ginger and nutmeg flavours on a full body. It's very concentrated in flavour and balanced to the soft side.

title: Annie's Lane Semillon - Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: This Semillon - Sauvignon Blanc from Clare Valley exhibits subtle but intense citrus aromas. The rich palate is packed with fruit characters and provides lovely depth, eventually culminating in a crisp and refreshing finale.

title: Apothic White 2023
bodyHtml: Apothic White blends Chardonnay, Riesling and Pinot Grigio for a medium-bodied wine with vibrant layers of flavor. Riesling lends Apothic White its floral notes and firm acidity. Chardonnay adds texture and body, while Pinot Grigio contributes refreshing flavors of juicy pineapple, peach and apricot, leading to a crisp, balanced finish.

title: Jacob's Creek Moscato Rose 2025
bodyHtml: Our Dots wines delightfully showcase the sweet flavours and aromas of fresh summer fruit. Raspberry and strawberry with notes of fresh pear. Fragrant red berries with a touch of sherbet. Serve on its own, or with light pasta dishes.

title: Gato Negro Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: Pale-yellow in colour with greenish hues. Intense aroma with tropical notes of grapefruit, pineapple, mango and soft herbal notes. Fresh, with perfect acidity, pleasing finish and fruity.

title: Mazzei Chianti Classico Riserva Ser Lapo 2023
bodyHtml: Notes of glazed cherries and ripe raspberries with candied orange peel, red licorice and hints of violets. Medium- to full-bodied with chocolaty texture and firm, but polished tannins. Shows depth and richness to its fruit. Compact and lengthy. Chalky finish.

title: Umberto Cesari Pinot Grigio Liano 2023
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s Abruzzo region, within the Terre di Chieti IGT, the Umberto Cesari Liano Pinot Grigio 2023 is crafted from organically grown grapes. Umberto Cesari, founded in 1964, is renowned for combining traditional Italian winemaking with modern precision. The winery’s commitment to quality and terroir expression has made it a respected name in both domestic and international markets.

Wine Description
This Pinot Grigio presents a pale straw yellow colour with a subtle green hue. The nose offers aromas of crisp apple, ripe pear, lemon zest, and delicate white flowers, with a faint almond nuance. On the palate, it is light-bodied and refreshing, delivering flavours of white peach, citrus, and a gentle mineral note. A vibrant acidity balances the fruit, creating a clean, lively profile. The finish is bright and crisp, leaving a subtle echo of citrus and almond.

Food Pairing
An ideal aperitif, this Pinot Grigio pairs beautifully with seafood such as scallops or shrimp prepared with fennel and basil. It complements fresh cheeses, mushroom-based dishes like barbecued stuffed mushrooms, and delicate vegetarian starters. These pairings highlight the wine’s freshness and finesse, creating a harmonious dining experience.

title: Myoka Rangyoku Grand Cuvee Junmai Dai-Ginjo Shizuku Genshu - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Myoka Rangyoku Grand Cuvée Junmai Daiginjo Shizuku Genshu is an exceptional sake produced by Daishichi Sake Brewery in Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. This masterpiece is crafted using the traditional kimoto method and is a blend of select vintages spanning over two decades, resulting in a harmonious and complex profile.

Tasting Notes:

  • Aroma: Delicate notes of violet, fresh cream, and pear.

  • Palate: Rich and layered flavors with a powerful, round body, leading to a clear and serene aftertaste that lingers gracefully.

Production Details:

  • Rice Variety: Yamada Nishiki.

  • Rice Polishing Ratio: 50% (super flat rice polishing).

  • Alcohol Content: 16%.

  • Pressing Method: Shizuku (free run drops), ensuring the purest expression of the sake.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Best enjoyed chilled at 10-13°C (50-55°F).

  • Glassware: Pour approximately one-third into a large glass and swirl gently to awaken its complex aromas and flavors.

  • Food Pairings: Pairs exquisitely with dishes such as sea bream in sake-kasu sauce, grilled crab in the shell, lobster with turnips in zabaglione sauce, and wild boar stew in Bordelaise sauce with mushrooms.

Availability:

This sake is produced in extremely limited quantities, with only about 1,000 bottles released every three years, making it a highly sought-after collector's item.

Origin:   Fukushima Prefecture  |   Rice:  Yamada-Nishiki   |   Super Flat Rice Polished to:   50%   |   Alcohol:  16%

title: Woodbridge Pinot Grigio
bodyHtml: With aromas of nectarine and fresh peach, our crisp and refreshing Woodbridge Pinot Grigio is a food-friendly wine and a delightful addition to any warm and sunny afternoon. Pale straw colour along with floral, cantaloupe and citrus aromas and a hint of fresh bread. Medium-bodied with a fresh, citrus finish.

title: Glenfarclas Family Cask 1999 (Summer Release 2024)
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Speyside, Scotland, Glenfarclas is one of the few remaining independent, family-owned distilleries in the country. Founded in 1836 and still run by the Grant family, the distillery is famed for its dedication to traditional whisky-making, with an emphasis on sherry cask maturation and long-term ageing. The Family Casks collection, launched in 2007, offers rare single-cask releases, each representing a unique vintage from the distillery’s extensive reserves.

Wine Description
The whisky displays a deep amber hue, offering aromas of dried fruits, polished oak, toffee, and a delicate spice. On the palate, layers of sultanas, roasted nuts, honeyed malt, and hints of orange zest unfold, supported by soft tannins and a refined oak influence.

Food Pairing
An excellent match for roast duck with orange glaze, venison in a red wine reduction, or aged Gouda. This pairing highlights the whisky’s depth and character.

title: Glenfarclas Family Cask 2005 (Summer Release 2024)
bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas Family Cask 2005 (Summer Release 2024) hails from the Speyside region of Scotland, crafted at the historic Glenfarclas Distillery in Ballindalloch. Established in 1836 and still owned by the Grant family, Glenfarclas is renowned for its dedication to traditional methods, including direct-fired stills and exclusive use of high-quality sherry casks. This family-run operation has built a reputation for producing rich, complex single malts that showcase the unique character of Speyside.

Description
This 18-year-old single malt presents a deep amber colour with a rich, oily viscosity. The nose is layered with aromas of dried fruits such as raisins and red berries, enhanced by delicate floral notes of rose and the sweetness of caramel and figs. On the palate, it delivers concentrated sherry-driven richness, unfolding flavours of dark chocolate, cocoa, pickled ginger, and perfumed spices, underpinned by a gentle fattiness that adds luxurious mouthfeel. The finish is long and warming, leaving lingering impressions of spice and dried fruit sweetness.

Food Pairing
Perfect with rich desserts such as dark chocolate tart or sticky toffee pudding, where the whisky’s sweetness harmonises with the dish, or with savoury pairings like roasted game accompanied by a red wine reduction, allowing the spirit’s spice and sherry depth to enhance the meat’s complexity. Together, these pairings create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Glenfarclas Family Cask 2003 (Summer Release 2024)
bodyHtml:
Glenfarclas Distillery, family-owned since 1865, founded in 1836 by Robert Hay, and still in the hands of the Grant family. Renowned for traditional production methods—direct‑fired stills and extensive sherry‑cask maturation—Glenfarclas celebrated and continues through its Family Casks series, established in 2007, which showcases single cask releases from vintages spanning decades.

Whisky Description

  • Aroma (Nose): Offers a “bold and quirky mix—wellies and a bicycle tyre repair kit,” underlaid by dark chocolate and fruit

  • Palate (Taste): Full‑bodied with an initial fizz and spice that smooth into mellow spices and fruit

  • Finish: Long and mellow, fading into a soft, lingering warmth

  • Varietal/Composition: Single malt Scotch whisky, cask strength, distilled in 2003; matured in a plain butt (4th‑fill sherry cask)

  • Body & Style: Robust and complex; characterised by rich malt, sweet fruit, spice, and enduring warmth. Reflects the celebrated Speyside style with sherry‑influenced depth, uncoloured and non‑chill‑filtered.

Food Pairing

Pairs beautifully with dark chocolate desserts or spiced cheeses—such as a dried‑fruit and nut cake or aged manchego—where the whisky’s spice, fruit, and chocolate notes echo and enhance the flavours. This pairing highlights the dram’s depth and character.

title: Tenuta Del Pajaru Picuraru Primitivo 2024
bodyHtml: A dense, brambly nose of dark cherry and blackberry aromas meets lifted elements of crushed black pepper and potpourri spice. It's plush and supple in feel, yet there's ample power behind all the rich berry tones thanks to lasting, fresh acidity.

title: Cusumano Alta Mora Etna Bianco 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Etna Bianco D.O.C. appellation located on the active volcanic slopes of Mount Etna in northeastern Sicily. Produced by Alta Mora the dedicated Etna estate established in 2013 by brothers Alberto and Diego Cusumano this wine is a showcase of high-altitude volcanic viticulture. Sourced from choice vineyard parcels across five distinct contrade (including Verde, Pietramarina, and Arrigo) situated on the northern slopes of the volcano at elevations between 600 and 800 meters above sea level, the old bush vines (albarello) are rooted in dark, mineral-rich volcanic ash, pumice, and basaltic lava soils. Etna’s extreme mountain-maritime microclimate features intense alpine solar exposure, cool mountain winds, and drastic diurnal temperature swings, allowing Carricante grapes to achieve complete phenolic maturity while building a razor-sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity and intense volcanic minerality.

Wine Description

The Cusumano Alta Mora Etna Bianco presents a luminous, pale straw-yellow color in the glass with bright greenish-gold and silver reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, mineral-driven, and precisely focused portrait of Mount Etna’s volcanic terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of lemon zest, green apple, and white peach, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of orange blossom, crushed volcanic rock, flint, lemongrass, and a distinct line of smoky, saline minerality. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard fruit, citrus curd, and salted melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly cuts through the mid-palate texture. The mouthfeel is weightless, supple, and linear, carrying into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of lime peel, white pepper, and crushed basalt.

title: Le Haut Medoc De Lagrange 2016
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Le Haut-Médoc de Lagrange 2016 is a red wine from France, specifically from the Bordeaux region and the Haut-Médoc appellation. The wine is a cuvée produced by the historic Château Lagrange, a Third Growth in the Classification of 1855, which is located in the Saint-Julien commune of the Left Bank. Grapes have been grown at Château Lagrange for over 600 years. The wine's creation applies the same expertise and philosophy as the Château's Grand Vin, and it is made from vines neighbouring the main Saint-Julien domain.

Wine Description

This red wine is draped in a dark ruby or deep dark ruby colour. The aromatic profile is expressive, gourmand, and complex, featuring notes of fresh red and black fruits, such as black cherry and blackcurrant. Further nuances include liquorice, menthol, cloves, gingerbread, and a characteristic balsamic touch. Tasting notes also include black fruit, cassis, cedar, dark chocolate, graphite, and vanilla.

The blend is typically dominated by Cabernet Sauvignon, with 70% Cabernet Sauvignon and 30% Merlot reported in some instances. The wine is full-bodied. On the palate, it is silken, smooth, almost unctuous, with well-coated, round tannins that deploy a good balance. Stylistically, it is a very harmonious and balanced wine that seduces with the elegance characteristic of the vintage. It has a lively mouthfeel. The wine spent 12 months aging in oak barrels. The finish is lovely, long, and flavourful. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is $13\%$. Enjoyable now, the wine will continue to evolve gracefully through 2028.

Food Pairing

This elegant red wine pairs well with red meats, game, or a cheese platter. Suggested pairings tailored to the wine's profile include grilled lamb chops, beef stew, or a mushroom risotto. Other excellent pairings for this style of wine are flank steak with shallots, prime rib of beef, or lamb tagine. It is also recommended with Santa Fe sirloin steaks on the barbecue, venison burgers with barbecue sauce and Quebec cheese, or lamb racks with rhubarb.

Vintage Quality

The 2016 vintage in Bordeaux, particularly in the Médoc, was widely regarded as an excellent one. The wines from this year are noted for their good concentration, layered fruit, and firm or soft tannins. This wine, in particular, displays the elegance characteristic of the vintage.

title: Angeline Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: This Cabernet is eager to please both Cabernet drinkers and red wine fans alike. The bouquet and front palate are intense with notes of fresh blackberry, rich currant and a touch of light cocoa. Medium-bodied with soft tannins infused with vanilla and a subtle caramel, finishing with bright fresh fruit and a touch of earthiness.

title: Volcanes De Chile Tectonia Red
bodyHtml:
This revealing and sophisticated wine is intense violet in colour. the bouquet reveals deep aromas of wild flowers, some spices like oregano and cinnamon, fresh red and black fruit, such as black cherry, raspberry and strawberry. there are also notes of smoke, tobacco and minerals.

This is a wine with personality, weight, body and structure, featuring rich, velvety and energetic tannins. It achieves good balance between fruit and wood. the finish is dense, elegant, complex and persistent.

title: Sand Point Family Vineyards Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Fresh aromas of tropical fruit and ripe apple. Layers of vanilla and pineapple balanced by oak.  Pairs well with chicken, mussels, shrimp, and pasta with white sauce.

title: Mi Terruno 'Uvas' Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml: A great daily drinker from the Maipu region of Mendoza, Argentina!  This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon has a deep claret colour with reddish hues.  The nose is a fine mix of aromatic herbs with pepper and red fruit.  The palate is smooth with thick tannins followed by a long, drawn-out velvety finish.  Enjoy it with seasoned pork or roast lamb with mint sauce.

title: Lunaris Pinot Grigio 2024
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: A pretty pale gold, this wine offers abundant fruit aromas with hints of eucalyptus, forest flowers and pink grapefruit. The wine is well balanced with soft notes of peaches, tropical fruit and a hint of jasmine that offers a long finish.

title: Edetaria Seleccio Grenache 'El Mas'
bodyHtml: Purple-colored, it exhibits balsamic flavours, rich aromas of spice, red currants, cherry, cacao, tobacco leaf and mineral. Medium to full-bodied, it has excellent depth of flavour, nicely integrated oak, tannin, and acidity, and enough structure to evolve for several more years and conserve the freshness.

title: Bodacious Dark Red Blend
bodyHtml: With its distinctly smooth and bold taste profile, Bodacious comes in an assortment of blends, varietals and sizes. A new addition to the family, Bodacious Dark brings vibrant cassis, chocolate and toasted oak flavours; dry with a hint of fig jam on the finish. Ripe, fruity and easy to enjoy.

title: Wetzer Soproni Kekfrankos
bodyHtml: Brooding red but with freshness on its side. Dark cherry, red plum, some cola and mushroomy elements in the mix with dried seaweed umami tang playing a hand. Sits just under medium weight, saline minerally characters in tow. Very pleasing, supple and energetic red of great interest and deliciousness.

title: Bodacious Bourbon Barrel Aged Red Blend
bodyHtml: Bodacious wines are gaining a following for their bold, yet smooth character. Enjoy spicy red fruit aromas and flavours, along with notes of caramel, cloves and vanilla contributed by bourbon barrel ageing. The palate is smooth and elegant, followed by a lengthy finish. Enjoy with grilled steak or barbecue ribs.

title: Kolonist Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced from Merlot grapes from "Kolonist" own plantations.  A pleasant aroma of red berries, with dominant notes of ripe cherries and vanilla. Light tones of exposure gradually transform into notes of jam, and the balanced and delicate taste with rounded tannins encourages you to enjoy every sip.

This drinking wine goes well with meat dishes with berry sauces, duck, patés and Italian dishes.

Grapes are grown in Bessarabia of the Danube (southwestern part of the Odessa region).

title: Kanonkop Pinotage 2014
bodyHtml:
To many, Kanonkop is considered to be the South African equivalent of a Premier Cru or First Growth. For others, Kanonkop is not just a wine estate.

It is a place of natural beauty where hospitality, family values, tradition, history and interesting characters are as integral to our ability to create magnificent wines as the ancient decomposed granite soils, the cool air from the Atlantic Ocean and the old dryland vineyards.

The Pinotage is a very complex wine with hints of red fruit flavours which reflects some Pinot Noir style elegance and structure. Big, bold tannin structures which are down played by ripe tannins and elegance.

92 Points - James Suckling

Bright and delicious aromas of blackberries, blackcurrants, fruit compote and hints of vanilla and sweet spices. The full-bodied palate has a really fresh blueberry tinge that runs all the way through it with silky tannins and a long finish. 

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A juicy, racy style, with deliciously pure plum and blackberry compote flavors enlivened by an anise note that lingers through the finish. Features dark fruit but remains bright and fresh in feel. Well done. 

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2014 Pinotage is matured for 16 months in 80% new oak. It offers a vivid and powerful bouquet of black cherries, licorice, melted tar and blueberries that seem to gush from the glass. The palate is powerful on the entry with bold tannin, but there is the acidity here to keep everything balanced and counter the layers of fruit with freshness and tension. As I have written before, Kanonkop know how to make a great Pinotage and this is a delight.

title: Weekday Wine Pinot Grigio
bodyHtml: Crisp, luscious, and refreshing. Completed by a lingering, mouth-watering finish. A wine to wind down with.

title: Kolonist Riesling 2022
bodyHtml:
A semi-dry Riesling made ​​from grapes grown on the shores of Lake Ialpug in Odessa region, on clay-gravel soils rich in organic matter. The grapes are harvested in the cool hours of the day and only by hand, undergoes destemming and soft pressing. Wort is cooled, clarified and 8-12 hours pumped into stainless steel tanks, where for 3 weeks undergoes slow fermentation for better extraction of flavors. Before bottling the wine undergoes pasting and light filtering while retaining its fullness and color. 

A pale straw color with a greenish tint. Extremely balanced taste wines inherent mineral shades that create a strong foundation and give a good structure and aftertaste - incredible durability.  Impressive wine fruity aroma with notes of peach emphasized.

title: Cupcake Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: This Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant, crisp wine that comes from vineyards in the South Island of New Zealand, where the cool growing season allows their grapes to mature slowly and gain character and complexity. Flavours of Meyer lemon, white nectarine and key lime integrate with subtle hints of grapefruit, gooseberry and citrus, culminating into a long, balanced finish. Pair oysters on the half shell, creamy lobster risotto or a picnic in the park.

title: Kleinood Tamboerskloof Mourvedre Meevaller
bodyHtml:
A "Meevaller" is an untranslatable Dutch-Afrikaans word that kind of sums up "a delightful, unexpected surprise".

This was originally planted, like the Viognier, to blend in small percentages into the flagship Syrah. However one season, a barrel was forgotten among the others in the winery and when it was discovered, well, what a delightful surprise!

Harvested in the cool early morning, the fruit and juice are gently handled before fermenting in stainless-steel and macerated for 14 days. One quarter of the crop is whole-bunch fermented in barrel, then the final is matured for 16 months in second fill 500L French oak boutes. 

It shows subtle, pretty floral aromas with sweet-cherry pie filling. On the palate it's dry, bursting with tart strawberry flavours and acidity, shows soft tannin, some dill herb, and a zippy, long finish.

title: Escudo Rojo Reserva Carmenere 2022
bodyHtml:
Escudo Rojo Reserva Carmenère is crafted in Chile by Baron Philippe de Rothschild’s Escudo Rojo brand—a Chilean venture established in 1999 to bring Bordeaux’s winemaking excellence to Chile’s best terroirs. This wine is made from 100 per cent Carmenère grapes grown in the Colchagua and Rapel valleys, regions celebrated for their Mediterranean climate, diverse soils (from deep clay to gravelly maicillo), and dramatic diurnal temperature swings that nurture both power and elegance.

Wine Description
This Carmenère is medium- to full-bodied, with a deep crimson hue. On the nose, expect ripe dark berries—blackberry, blueberry—alongside savoury herb notes, mocha, and subtle roasted coffee bean and black pepper accents. The palate is plush and well-balanced, offering fresh, vibrant fruit, silky tannins, and a hint of oak-derived warmth and tobacco. The finish is smooth, lingering, and has a refined complexity.

Food Pairing
This Carmenère pairs beautifully with rich, savoury dishes—grilled lamb, roast duck, slow-braised beef, mushroom-based risotto—all work wonderfully with its concentrated fruit and herbal depth. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Tenuta Mazzolino Chardonnay Blanc 2020
bodyHtml:
Tenuta Mazzolino Chardonnay ‘Blanc’ is produced in Lombardy, within the Oltrepò Pavese hills of northern Italy. The estate, established by Enrico Braggiotti and now managed by his granddaughter Francesca Seralvo, is situated on the famed ‘Pinot Noir hill’ and benefits from clay-loam soils enriched with mineral elements.

Wine Description
Made from 100 per cent Chardonnay, this wine displays a bright, straw-yellow hue with golden tints. Aromas are rich and complex—yellow-fleshed fruits, citrus zest, white floral notes, toasted nuances such as butter, vanilla, and nutty accents. On the palate, it is full, velvety and well-balanced, combining fresh, lively acidity with a pronounced sapidity and a long, persistent finish. 

Food Pairing
This Chardonnay elegantly complements luxurious crustaceans such as lobster, langoustine, or crab, white-fish dishes in delicate sauces, creamy risottos with seasonal vegetables, and semi-aged cheeses. These pairings underscore both the wine’s complexity and its richness.

title: Bollina Corte Medicea 'Cletus' Rosso Toscana 2021
bodyHtml:
Bollina Corte Medicea ‘Cletus’ Rosso Toscana IGT originates from Tuscany, Italy, and sits under the broader Toscana IGT appellation. The wine is produced by Bollina (also referred to as Corte Medicea), a producer dedicated to crafting modern, value-driven red blends from the region.

Wine Description
This blend combines 50 per cent Sangiovese with 50 per cent Merlot, offering a deep ruby-red hue. On the nose, expect inviting aromas of dark fruits—blackberries, plum jam and ripe cherries—elegantly spiced with vanilla, cinnamon and chocolate nuances. On the palate, it is full-bodied and concentrated, boasting smooth, ripe tannins, satisfying structure and a long, silky finish.

Food Pairing
Pairs beautifully with traditional Tuscan fare such as grilled steak, BBQ ribs, lasagna, fresh cheeses, braised beef short ribs, rich mushroom risotto, wild boar ragù or beef stew. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Gaudou Malbec Exception
bodyHtml: Dark colour with purple highlights. Concentrated nose of black fruit, earthy touches. The mouth also evokes the blackberries with a touch of licorice. A flexible style, fruity, delivering immediate pleasure.

title: Cupcake Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon comes from the sun-drenched vineyards of California where warm days slowly ripen the grapes to ensure a bold, savoury wine. Rich flavours of ripe blackberry, cherry and plum lead to a lovely, juicy mouthfeel balanced by soft notes of espresso and spice. Enjoy with a burger and truffle fries or at a dinner party with all of your favourite people.

title: Terroso Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 (Kosher)
bodyHtml: Aromas of fresh herbs and hints of vanilla. Well-balanced tannins and dark fruits present on the palate. Medium-bodied, with a long finish. Pair with red meats such as steak, roast beef and brisket or tomato-based pasta dishes.

title: Zorzal Malbec Gran Terroir
bodyHtml:
It is a Malbec of great aromatic intensity, in which a lot of minerality is perceived, oregano, flowers and a balanced contribution of lactic aromas added by the wood, In the mouth, it enters wide but with very good acidity that makes it fresh and lively, with tannins textured. It is a wine that has a lot of nerve. Long and sweet finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

Lots of dark fruit on the nose and palate, such as blackberries and blueberries, as well as some crushed stones. It’s medium-to-full-bodied with chewy tannins and a fresh, linear finish. Brightness to this.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The darker and denser 2019 Gran Terroir Malbec feels unusually dark and ripe, with more tannins and somewhat more rusticity but showing the chalky tannins from Gualtallary. This would do well with powerful food. It's a more powerful expression of the grape and the place.

title: Fuzion Shiraz - Malbec 2025
bodyHtml: Pale ruby-purple colour with aromas of crushed berries and spice. Dry, full-bodied flavours of candied berries and black pepper.

title: Finca Las Moras Malbec Reserva
bodyHtml: A soft, full bodied wine with ripe berries and plum flavours with an elegant touch of smoke and vanilla from its contact with wood. This wine is an ideal complement to roasted red meat and pasta dishes with tomato sauce.

title: Little Long Dog Rouge 2024
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: The blend of Grenache and Syrah is at once intensely fruity and slightly aromatic on the nose. Plump and juicy with luscious texture and subtle twist of spice on the finish, it is a fruit driven style brimming with blackberry flavours yet underpinned with a backbone that hints at something more serious.

title: Jip Jip Rocks Shiraz 2022
bodyHtml:
Jip Jip Rocks Shiraz originates from the Padthaway region in South Australia. The winery is owned by the Bryson family, who have been involved in South Australian agriculture since 1855 and operate under the Morambro Creek umbrella. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on modern, minimal-intervention methods to ensure the final wines authentically reflect their unique regional character and the mineral-rich Terra Rossa soils of the estate.

Wine Description

This Shiraz presents a deep ruby black or violet colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is complex, featuring blackberry, eucalyptus, and dark chocolate, accented by notes of cedar, cinnamon, and Earl Grey tea. On the palate, the wine is rich and medium-full bodied with a supple, velvety texture and vibrant acidity. Flavours of ripe plum and mocha are supported by fine-grained tannins and well-integrated French and American oak, leading to a lingering finish with hints of black toast and spice.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling - 95 points"

  • "Wine Enthusiast - 91 points"

Food Pairing

The wine's robust structure and spiced dark fruit profile make it an ideal companion for roast beef, grilled ribeye steak, or lamb tagine. It also pairs exceptionally well with savoury, smoky dishes such as barbecued pork ribs or a wood-fired pizza topped with olives and feta.

title: Circus Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Originating from Argentina in the famous Mendoza region, specifically from high-altitude vineyards along the foothills of the Andes Mountains, Circus Cabernet Sauvignon represents a lively, fruit-driven expression of South American red winemaking. Sourced from estate vineyards benefit from intense solar radiation and cool mountain nights, Circus is crafted to showcase the vibrant varietal purity and accessible structure of Argentine Cabernet Sauvignon. The winemaking philosophy focuses on sustainable viticulture, temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation, and gentle oak contact to produce a smooth, food-friendly wine designed for everyday enjoyment.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, vibrant ruby red colour with dark garnet edges in the glass. An inviting and fruit-forward bouquet opens with aromas of ripe cassis, dark plum, and black cherry, layered with subtle notes of green bell pepper, cedar wood, cocoa, and sweet baking spice. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied, rich, and smooth, delivering generous flavours of juicy blackberry, red currant, and dark chocolate supported by a balanced streak of fresh natural acidity. Framed by soft, rounded tannins and a clean texture, it concludes with a warm, supple finish marked by lingering notes of dark berry fruit and subtle oak spice. Composed of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, it combines expressive Argentine black fruit generosity with an easy-drinking, approachable structure.

title: Jack Larkin Hyde Pinot Noir 2020
bodyHtml:
Jack Larkin Wines was founded by Sean Larkin, a Scotland native who transitioned from a career in sheet metal to becoming a sommelier and wine broker, eventually leading him to winemaking in Napa Valley. The wine is produced using fruit from the renowned Hyde Vineyard, which Larry Hyde founded in 1979. Located in the heart of Carneros, Hyde Vineyard benefits from the cooling effects of the Petaluma Gap, with morning fog and coastal breezes fostering a long growing season that is ideal for Pinot Noir.

Wine Description

This Pinot offers enticing aromas of ripe red cherries and wild strawberries, with delicate notes of rose petals and violet. Hints of redwood forest-floor earthiness add complexity to the bouquet. On the palate, this wine showcases a harmonious balance between fruitiness and elegance. Juicy flavors of raspberry and black cherry dance gracefully alongside nuances of baking spices, particularly cinnamon and clove.

title: Peller Estates Pinot Grigio Proprietor's Reserve
bodyHtml: A great summer sipper, this Pinot Gris is light, crisp and refreshing with flavours of apple, pear and just a hint of spice.

title: Wyndham Shiraz Bin 555 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Deep purple colour with a spicy fruit bouquet of coffee, prune, smoke, licorice and a floral note. Smoky black fruit flavours with a long, full finish.

title: Starmont Sauvignon Blanc 2022
