bodyHtml: Starmont Sauvignon Blanc displays fresh aromas of grapefruit, kaffir lime and jasmine. A crisp and delicious entry leads to a bright and fleshy mid-palate, good acidity and structure showcasing flavours of citrus, guava and mango. The finish is moderately long, clean and refreshing.

title: Brumont Bouscasse Jardins Philosophique 2017
bodyHtml: Blend of some native varietals: Petit Courbu and Petit Manseng. Lovely nose of honey, spice and ripe tree fruit. Apricots and pears with a rich mouthfeel that is more exuberance vs power. Highly interesting wine.

title: Catena Criolla 'La Marchigiana'
bodyHtml: La Marchigiana honours the natural and sulphite-free homemade wine legacy with this very limited production. In 1898, Nicola Catena arrived in Argentina from Le Marche, Italy, bringing with him the family tradition of creating natural wines, preserved only by their own tannins. It is a "naked wine," in which only the grapes and terroir speak.

title: Ejamu Chianti Superiore Zimbato 2024
bodyHtml: A quintessential and beautifully crafted Chianti. An intense ruby red appearance with a bounding bouquet of violets sour cherries, wild berries and a distinctly floral aroma.  On the palate the wine is full, round, and soft, embracing the mid-palate like a hug from an old friend. A persistent floral fruitiness characterizes the charming taste with long silky tannins devoid of any astringency. Truly a treat with most prototypical Italian fare, pizza, red sauce, polpette, you name it.

title: Diabolica White
bodyHtml: Clear medium lemon-yellow in colour; forward and complex aromas of table grapes, orange blossom, beeswax and honey; off-dry, with medium body and zesty acidity; flavours of pineapple, juicy table grapes and tropical fruit.

title: Torre Zambra Montepulciano d' Abruzzo Madia 2024
bodyHtml: From the Abruzzo wine region, Torre Zambra Madia Montepulciano D'abruzzo is great value. Fragrant on the nose with lavender, earthy florals, herbs and savoury spices. Medium-plus-bodied with ripe dark cherry, earthy florals, savoury herb vibrant and plushy on the palate. Pour with a meaty lasagne.

title: Maloof 'Wax On, Wax Soif' Red Blend 2023
bodyHtml:
Light bodied red for your late summer blues. Earthy and smooth, full of blue fruits and white pepper.

Hand harvested from the organically farmed Steelhead Run Vineyard in Applegate Valley AVA. This is a cool, high-elevation site planted in 1993. Co-fermented on the skins for 7 days with daily punchdowns before being pressed off and moved to stainless steel to finish fermentation. Matured in neutral oak barrels.

title: Gut Oggau Winifred Rose 2023
bodyHtml:
The Gut Oggau winery, founded in 2007 by Eduard and Stephanie Tscheppe, meticulously restored a 17th-century winery in the small town of Oggau after it had been abandoned for twenty years. The winery’s immediate transition to biodynamic farming was enabled by the two decades of neglect, which allowed all previous chemicals and pesticides to wash away from the vines.

Wine Description

The wine is a dry, light-bodied rosé that offers a full-bodied, smooth, and juicy texture. The sensory profile includes notes of forgotten watermelon, rosy reduction, tart cranberry, just-ripe strawberries, and herbaceous glimpses with a mineral spark. There is a touch of savoury spice, allspice, and a mineral undertone, which results in a charming and refreshing drink.

Food Pairing

This smooth, full-bodied rosé pairs beautifully with a variety of dishes including roast white meats, meaty fish, fresh seafood, and light salads.

title: Carmen Carmenere Premier Reserva 2024
bodyHtml: Ruby colour with spicy currant and berry aromas. Medium bodied, dry wine. Lively berry fruit with pepper and spice notes and good finish.

title: Los Cardos Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml:
Los Cardos wines from Doña Paula showcase fresh, approachable wine grown in some of the finest appellations of Argentina. Los Cardos is a Spanish word for "the thistles" flowers known in Argentina for their intense and surprisingly vivid colour and sharp thorns. In Mendoza, their presence is an unmistakable signal of good terroir. The grapes are sourced from sustainably managed vineyards growing in a challenging climate with a breathtaking landscape at more than 3,300 ft. above sea level, where they enjoy the constant breeze from the Andes Mountains. The resulting wine is fresh and perfect for every occasion.

Deep ruby red colour. The wine is expressive and spicy, with black pepper, graphite and cassis aromas. In the mouth, black fruit and gentle tannins with a round pleasing texture.

title: Peller Estates Cabernet - Merlot
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Crafted in the heart of the Niagara Peninsula in Ontario, Canada, this wine represents the long standing tradition of Peller Estates, a winery that has been a cornerstone of Canadian viticulture for four generations. The Proprietor's Reserve series is designed to offer approachable, high quality wines that reflect the unique cool climate terroir of the region. With a winemaking philosophy centered on precision and a dedication to expressing authentic varietal character, the estate continues to be one of Canada's most respected and popular producers.

Wine Description

The Peller Estates Cabernet Merlot Proprietor's Reserve is a medium bodied red blend featuring a deep ruby red colour. The nose is rich and expressive, offering aromas of black fruit, strawberries, and plum, complemented by subtle notes of black pepper, chocolate, and black tea. On the palate, the wine is smooth and fruit forward, showcasing flavours of cherries, spiced plums, and red currants balanced by soft, velvety tannins and a refreshing acidity. The finish is dry and lingering, with delicate hints of spice, oak, and toasty vanilla. Typically a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Cabernet Franc, this wine is crafted for immediate enjoyment but can be cellared for short term aging to further integrate its complexity.

title: Jackson Triggs Cabernet Sauv - Merlot Proprietor's Reserve
bodyHtml:
This approachable red blend hails from Canada, primarily produced in the renowned Niagara Peninsula of Ontario and the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. Founded in 1993 by Allan Jackson and Donald Triggs, the winery was built on a philosophy of crafting high-quality, accessible wines that showcase the unique characteristics of Canadian terroir.

Wine Description

Jackson Triggs Cabernet Sauv Merlot Proprietor's Reserve presents a medium-bodied sensory profile with a deep ruby colour. The nose is greeted by a bouquet of dark cherry, plum, and subtle herbaceous notes, accented by hints of mocha and toasted oak from aging. On the palate, the wine is smooth and velvety, delivering flavours of ripe blackberry and warm spice supported by gentle tannins and balanced acidity. This blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot offers a harmonious balance of structure and softness, concluding with a lingering, fruit-driven finish.

title: Jackson Triggs Cabernet Sauvignon - Shiraz Proprietors' Selection
bodyHtml: Jackson Triggs Proprietor's Selection Cabernet/Shiraz is a bold and full-bodied red blend from Canada’s Niagara Peninsula. The bouquet features aromas of blackberry, currants, leather, tobacco, and sweet vanilla. On the palate, lively notes of cherry, blackberry, cocoa, tobacco, and licorice give way to a smooth, lingering finish. The tannins are soft and the overall structure of the wine is approachable. This is an easy-drinking wine with good complexity and balance. Enjoy it on its own as a pre-dinner aperitif, or pair it with grilled red meats and full-bodied Italian dishes.

title: Manischewitz Concord Kosher Red Wine
bodyHtml: A sweet wine with a pleasant mouth feel and a smooth aftertaste. A smooth fruity wine with plenty of grape flavour and a subtle aroma of confectionery flavours. The crisp acidity balances the sweetness and upfront fruit aromas. The natural fruitiness allows this wine to be served chilled. Goes wonderfully with barbecued meats, and fruity desserts.

title: Galil Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon Galilee 2024
bodyHtml:
Galil Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon hails from the Upper Galilee region of Israel. Established in 2000 as a joint venture between the renowned Golan Heights Winery and Kibbutz Yiron, the winery is committed to revitalizing a winemaking history that dates back over 2,000 years. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on a 'blend of contrasts,' pairing cutting-edge technology with a deep respect for the natural environment through pioneering sustainability initiatives, such as being the first Israeli winery to receive LODI RULES certification.

Wine Description

This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon radiates a deep garnet hue with opaque purple reflections. The aromatic profile is dominated by intense blackcurrant, ripe plum, and raspberry, interwoven with delicate whispers of cedar, tobacco leaf, and Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and elegantly structured, featuring juicy black cherry and blackberry flavours supported by fine-grained tannins and a refreshing mineral-tinged snap. Stylistically, it offers a harmonious balance of fruit intensity and vibrant acidity, culminating in a long, firm, and dry finish.

title: Lurton Sauvignon Blanc Fumees Blanches 2024
bodyHtml: Pale straw colour with lifted citrus, nutty and grassy aromas with a note of kiwi fruit. Medium-bodied. A crisp citrus flavour with a medium-length finish.

title: Two Oceans Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: An abundance of ripe berry fruit aromas with subtle oak spice. A soft, fruit-driven wine with juicy berry fruit flavours and subtle hints of oak. Excellent served with red meat dishes such as roast lamb, stews, grilled meat, as well as with robust pasta dishes.

title: Woodbridge Sauvignon Blanc
bodyHtml: With crisp, bright, refreshing citrus and tropical aromas and flavours, this Sauvignon Blanc is a fruit forward wine that shines alone and alongside food. A lovely accompaniment to seafood and light chicken dishes, this Sauvignon Blanc is a perfect complement to seared scallops over linguine. The wine also pairs nicely with warm weather dishes such as fresh spring salad and fresh appetizers such as oysters and crab cakes. Enjoy this Sauvignon Blanc slightly chilled.

title: Jackson Triggs Sauvignon Blanc Proprietor's Select
bodyHtml: Their Sauvignon Blanc has a distinctive floral bouquet, which is complemented by notes of citrus fruit and dill. It has good structure and an elegant, refreshing finish.

title: Frontera Merlot
bodyHtml: The color of the wine is a deep red with great intensity. On the nose, the wine shows delicious hints of plums and herbs. This Merlot reveals hints of chocolate and spice, while integrating perfectly with the dark fruit flavors. The wine is smooth with great structure. Frontera Merlot is a delightful accompaniment to white meats, cheeses, and pasta dishes. Serve at room temperature.

title: Vint Chardonnay Private Selection 2023 (by Robert Mondavi)
bodyHtml:
Originating from the Central Coast region of California, USA, 'Vint' is the latest evolution of the Robert Mondavi Private Selection label. Robert Mondavi established his namesake winery in 1966 with the vision of creating California wines that could stand among the world's finest. This wine reflects his core philosophy that quality winemaking begins in the vineyard, combining time-honored traditions with modern techniques to produce a fruit-forward, approachable style.

Wine Description

Vint Chardonnay presents a bright golden-straw colour, often accented by a subtle greenish tinge. The nose is seductive and exotic, revealing layers of ripe pineapple, peach, and citrus fruits intertwined with notes of vanilla, toasted oak, and caramel. On the palate, the wine is powerful yet supple, offering a rich and creamy mouthfeel driven by partial malolactic fermentation and aging on the lees. Flavours of baked apple and tropical fruit are balanced by a refreshing acidity, leading to a long, smooth finish with hints of sweet baking spices.

Food Pairing

  • Pairs exceptionally well with roasted poultry, such as chicken or turkey with rosemary stuffing.

  • Complements rich seafood dishes, including grilled salmon, buttery shellfish, or roasted trout.

  • Enhances creamy pasta dishes like fettuccine Alfredo or white-sauce carbonara.

  • A perfect match to enhance the wine’s complexity when served with soft-ripened or medium-strong cheeses.

title: Two Oceans Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot 2023
bodyHtml:
At the tip of Africa where two oceans collide, extraordinary grape growing conditions exist. Under sunny skies grapes soak up the summer heat and then the fresh ocean breeze cools them. This ripens and sweetens the grapes, and inspires Two Oceans to craft exceptional wines. Whether along the coast or further inland, the presence of the oceans is never far away. Cooling sea breezes and mists can lower temperatures during the lead-up to the harvest , slowing down ripening. Grapes aren’t hurried but develop in their own time with flavours that are balanced, intense and plentiful.

Two Oceans Cabernet Sauvignon-Merlot is a medium-bodied, smooth, and very approachable wine.  Ruby red in colour. An abundance of ripe berry fruit aromas with subtle oak spice. A soft, fruit-driven wine with juicy berry fruit flavours and subtle hints of oak. Excellent served with red meat dishes such as roast lamb, stews, grilled meat, as well as with robust pasta dishes.

title: Hardy's Stamp Shiraz - Cabernet 2023
bodyHtml: Deep ruby/purple core with a bright crimson rim. Intense, ripe raspberries and cherries with overtones of vanilla and spice on the nose. Very good fruit intensity of raspberries and black cherries with well integrated vanilla oak influence. This wine has soft round tannins and a good length.

title: Cypress Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Cypress Chardonnay is straw yellow in colour with youthful hues. The inviting nose offers aromas of daffodil, ripe apple, and citrus, complemented on the palate by white peach, pineapple, and orange marmalade followed by a long creamy finish. The balanced acidity and rich texture is a perfect pairing for many dishes, including oven-roasted chicken or shrimp citrus risotto.

title: Jackson Triggs Cabernet Sauvignon - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Light to medium ruby garnet colour; dry and medium bodied with lively crisp cassis berry character and very light tannins.

title: JL Denois Grand Vin Pinot Noir 2020
bodyHtml:
Crafted by renowned winemaker Jean-Louis Denois, this Grand Vin Pinot Noir originates from the Haute Vallée de l'Aude in the Languedoc region of France. Denois, a pioneer in introducing noble grape varieties to the Languedoc, employs biodynamic farming practices to produce wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region.

Tasting Notes:

  • Appearance: Deep garnet hue with violet reflections.
  • Nose: A harmonious blend of animal notes, licorice, black fruits, and a balsamic touch.
  • Palate: Balanced flavors of spicy fruit, underpinned by silky tannins and refreshing acidity, leading to an aromatic finish.

Food Pairing:
This Pinot Noir pairs excellently with beef dishes, veal, and pasta. Notable pairings include barbecued côte de boeuf with coarse salt, veal roast with chanterelles in cream, and lasagna bolognese.

title: La Playa Carmenere
bodyHtml: Velvety light purple. On the nose, ripe blueberries with a hint of fine smoke. It has good ripe fruit presence with rounded tannins. Certified Sustainable and Certified Vegan.

title: Domaine D'Or Red - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: A medium-bodied wine with flavours of strawberries and cherries. The soft easy tannins, balancing acidity and red berry fruit finish, make this a great wine for everyday drinking.

title: High Note Red Blend
bodyHtml:
A relatively new addition to the Mendoza wine scene, Vista del Sur was founded in 2008. The winery is run by winemaker Leopoldo Kuschnaroff. Born to a family of Ukrainian immigrants, Leopoldo was trained at the prestigious Cuyo University in Mendoza and has also worked with the Catena family since 2007. For the High Note wines he sources grapes from five vineyards in the Uco Valley - Vista Flores, La Consulta, Altamira, Eugenio Bustos and Gualtallary.

Bright purple red in appearance, on the nose the High Note Andes Red Blend loads on plush aromas of red plum, blueberry, vanilla, milk chocolate and cocoa. The medium-full bodied palate is laden with blackfruit flavors and creamy moutfilling tannins. Acidity is moderate but balanced. Sweet spice notes on the finish round out this very friendly wine.

title: Provenance Vineyards Deadeye Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Provenance Vineyards began in 1999 and quickly earned a stellar reputation as the Napa Valley Cabernet house. Over the years, Provenance expanded into also producing tasting-room only regional exclusives and single-vineyard wine for other red, Bordeaux-style blends and white wine. Its founding family had the vision to produce fine wines that were true works of art of unique “provenance” or authentic origin.

True to Paso Robles' signature style, the Deadeye Cabernet Sauvignon is big and bold, ready-drinking, with a rich texture and firm backbone. The nose opens with tempting aromas of currant, black licorice and hints of coffee. On the palette, the opulent, sweet-fruit flavors are balanced with subtle notes of anise, peppercorns and a touch of tobacco to add warmth and dimension.

A plush mid-palate finish with textured minerality and bright acidity, making this a great accompaniment to a rich, savory meal.

title: Naked Grape Chardonnay - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The Naked Grape Chardonnay is a approachable, contemporary white wine produced by the Grape Valley Wine Company, based in Modesto, California (under the E. & J. Gallo umbrella), with regional iterations also expertly crafted by Arterra Wines Canada. The brand’s philosophy is rooted in the "bare it all" concept focusing on the true, unadorned character of the fruit rather than heavy oak influence. This "original classic" is designed to be a versatile, easy-drinking staple that prioritizes varietal purity and smooth drinkability, making it a favorite for those who prefer a cleaner, more fruit-forward expression of Chardonnay.

Wine Description

Naked Grape Chardonnay presents a pale, bright lemon color in the glass. The nose is highly aromatic and inviting, offering the essence of baked apple, ripe pear, and golden peach, often accented by subtle tropical notes of pineapple. On the palate, the wine is mid-bodied and remarkably smooth, delivering a silky, creamy texture that balances its crisp orchard fruit flavors with a hint of sweet caramel and vanilla. Characterized by its soft acidity and "un-oaked" freshness, it leaves a rounded, lingering fruit finish. This wine typically features an ABV of 12.5% to 13%.

title: Luxardo Aperitivo
bodyHtml:
Luxardo Aperitivo Italiano is crafted in Italy by Girolamo Luxardo S.p.A., a historic family-run distillery founded in 1821. Originally established in Zara (now Zadar, Croatia), the company relocated to Torreglia near Padua after the Second World War. Luxardo is renowned for its expertise in producing high-quality liqueurs rooted in Italian tradition, with this aperitivo designed for refreshing pre-dinner enjoyment.

Product Description
This ruby-red aperitivo is made from a refined infusion of herbs, roots, and bitter orange. It has an alcohol content of approximately 11 per cent, making it ideal for lighter drinking occasions. On the nose, it offers vibrant aromas of orange zest, grapefruit, and subtle floral notes. The palate is fresh and lively, balancing gentle bitterness with sweet citrus flavours, and hints of herbal complexity. The finish is clean, moderately dry, and pleasantly lingering.

Food Pairing
Best enjoyed as part of a classic Italian spritz—served over ice with Prosecco and soda water—or paired with light canapés, olives, cured meats, and fresh cheeses. This pairing highlights the aperitivo’s lively citrus character and refreshing bitterness.

title: Magellan Le Fruit Defendu Rose 2025
bodyHtml: For the Rose Fruit Defendu, the Cinsault grapes are de-stemmed and transferred to tanks for short soaking on the skins. They only use the free-run juices, no pressed juices, which are settled and fermented in stainless steel tanks. Temperature control is not too strict because an old varietal like this one would not appreciate high-tech winemaking! All the grapes are picked by hand. Shows equally well as an aperitif or with Mediterranean vegetables grilled over a wood fire. 100% Cinsault.

title: Daou Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
From the sun-drenched hills of Paso Robles, California, Daou Family Estates stands out as a premier winery in the Adelaida District. Founded by brothers Georges and Daniel Daou, the estate is known for its dedication to producing Bordeaux-style wines with precision and passion. The estate's unique terroir, set atop calcareous clay soils at high elevation, contributes to its exceptional winemaking reputation.

Wine Description
Daou Chardonnay displays a brilliant pale gold hue in the glass. Aromas are layered and expressive, with notes of Fuji apple, ripe pear, citrus blossom, and toasted almond. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and silky, showcasing flavours of pineapple, vanilla cream, and Meyer lemon, supported by a subtle minerality and refreshing acidity. The mouthfeel is lush yet balanced, with a lingering, elegant finish.

Food Pairing
Perfect with creamy pasta dishes, butter-poached lobster, roast chicken with lemon and herbs, or mild cheeses like brie or camembert. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Gulfi Cerasuolo di Vittoria 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Italy, specifically the Sicily region within the Cerasuolo di Vittoria DOCG, the only appellation in Sicily to hold the highest DOCG status. Gulfi is one of the most representative wineries of the island, based in Chiaramonte Gulfi on the Iblei Mountains. The estate's philosophy is centred on 'naturalness', utilizing organic farming and traditional alberello (head-trained) vine systems to craft wines that express the unique light and landscape of southeastern Sicily.

Wine Description

The Gulfi Cerasuolo di Vittoria 2023 displays an intense ruby red colour with youthful violet highlights. The nose is vivid and aromatic, offering a charming bouquet of fresh red berries, marasca cherries, and raspberries, interwoven with delicate floral notes of rose and violet. On the palate, the wine is elegant and harmonious, featuring a medium body with a silky texture and vibrant acidity that provides a refreshing lift. It concludes with a long, clean finish marked by persistent fruit and a subtle mineral edge. This wine is a blend of 50% Nero d'Avola, which provides structure and depth, and 50% Frappato, which contributes perfume and freshness. It is certified organic and has an alcohol by volume (ABV) of 13.5%.

Accolades

  • Decanter - 91 points.

  • James Suckling - 90 points.

Food Pairing

This versatile Sicilian red pairs exceptionally well with a variety of Mediterranean flavours. It is an excellent match for white meats like roast chicken or pork, as well as rich fish dishes such as seared tuna or swordfish. It also complements pasta with ragu, mushroom risotto, or a platter of traditional Italian charcuterie and medium-aged cheeses.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in southeastern Sicily was characterized by a balanced growing season, despite some summer heat typical of the region. The harvest period allowed for the Nero d'Avola and Frappato grapes to reach optimal ripeness while maintaining the characteristic freshness and bright aromatic profile that define high quality Cerasuolo di Vittoria.

title: Freixenet Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: This Pinot Grigio is an elegant white wine from the picturesque vineyards of the Garda region. It has a floral and delicate fruity palate with subtle hints of crisp citrus. Enjoy it chilled for an aperitif or pair it with seafood, vegetarian dishes, pasta, fried fish or sushi.

title: Caudalia Umea Grenache Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Caudalia Umea Grenache Blanc is a white wine produced by Bodegas Caudalia, a winery located in the Baja Montaña subzone of Navarra, Spain. This wine is crafted exclusively from 100% Grenache Blanc grapes, a mutation of the red Grenache Noir variety, and is notable for its rarity in the Navarra region.

Vineyard Details

  • Location: Lerga, Baja Montaña, Navarra
  • Soil: River terrace soils with medium-low fertility, ensuring limited yields and concentrated flavors

Tasting Notes

  • Color: Bright, clear appearance
  • Aroma: Fresh floral scents with hints of citrus and stone fruits
  • Palate: Crisp and refreshing, with balanced acidity and flavors of pear, peach, and subtle minerality

Serving Suggestions

  • Temperature: Serve chilled at 8-10°C (46-50°F)
  • Food Pairings: Ideal with seafood, light salads, and soft cheeses

title: Chateau Saintongey Rose
bodyHtml:
Château Saintongey Rosé is a distinguished wine from the Bordeaux region of France, crafted predominantly from Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, and Merlot grapes. This blend reflects the estate's commitment to producing elegant and expressive rosé wines that embody the character of Bordeaux.

Colour: Pale pink with subtle salmon hues, indicating its freshness and vibrancy.

Aroma: Delicate notes of strawberry, cherry, and raspberry, enlivened by spicy undertones, offering a refreshing and inviting bouquet.

Palate: Soft and silky on the palate, with a fruity profile that mirrors the aromatic notes. The wine benefits from a pleasant liveliness that conveys balance and length.

Body: Light to medium-bodied with a smooth and balanced texture, making it an easy-drinking rosé.

Finish: Clean and crisp, leaving a lingering impression of its fruity and spicy characteristics.

Accolades: While specific critic scores for this vintage are not readily available, previous vintages have been well-received by consumers, with average ratings around 3.6 out of 5 on Vivino.

This rosé is best enjoyed chilled and pairs excellently with light dishes such as salads, seafood, or as an aperitif.

title: La Storia Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: The grapes for the La Storia Chardonnay were sourced from an established Russian River vineyard with small berries and clusters providing a great concentration of aromas and flavours. The grapes were hand-picked early in the morning at the lowest temperature possible. They pressed the fruit directly without destemming for preserving more of the delicate aromas. The entire lot was barrel fermented using three different types of yeast with partial malolactic fermentation to preserve the fruit expression of the grapes and to keep more of the natural acidity and freshness. The lees on the bottom of the barrels were stirred twice per month for increased mouthfeel and viscosity. This Chardonnay has the aromas of tropical fruits, ripe apples, peaches, and apricots. Further aeration reveals deeper aromas of toast with a touch of caramel and ripe Meyer lemons meringue and a bit of minerality. The mouthfeel is generous and rich, with tamed acidity and a long and round finish. Cheers!

title: Canyon Road Pinot Grigio
bodyHtml:
This crisp white wine originates from the United States, specifically from the California appellation. Canyon Road Winery, established in 1980, is located in Geyserville within Sonoma County and is part of the esteemed E. & J. Gallo portfolio. The winery's philosophy is inspired by the scenic roads that wind through California’s wine country, with a focus on crafting approachable, fruit-forward varietals that offer exceptional value.

Wine Description

The Canyon Road Pinot Grigio showcases a pale, straw-yellow hue in the glass. The aromatic profile is bright and inviting, featuring fresh scents of lemon zest, green apple, and pear, underpinned by delicate floral blossom undertones. On the palate, this medium-bodied wine delivers vibrant flavours of crisp green apple, zesty citrus, and ripe white peach.

title: Zorzal Eggo Sauvignon Blanc De Cal
bodyHtml:
Zorzal Wines is a boutique winery founded in 2008 by the renowned wine-making Michelini Brothers together with Canadian investment partners. The winery and vineyards are located at Gualtallary in the Uco Valley, one of the most outstanding areas for viticulture in Argentina. At 1,350 meters above sea level Gualtallary is located at the highest point of the Mendoza wine province at the foot of the Tupungato volcano, which provides the perfect terroir for wines with great structure and acidity.

This is a bright Sauvignon Blanc, showcasing mineral intensity combined with enticing white peach notes. The wonderful volume and texture on the palate is balanced by a refreshing acidity, through to a persistent finish.

title: Prophecy Sauvignon Blanc
bodyHtml: Aromas of grapefruit, lychee and Meyer lemon offer crisp, citrus refreshment, complemented by hints of fresh cut grass.

title: Zorzal Eggo Franco Cabernet Franc
bodyHtml: This hand harvested, single vineyard wine from Gualtallary is composed of 100% hand harvested Cabernet Franc. This unique wine is completely fermented and aged in a large concrete egg and sees no oak. This subtle and nuanced wine shows soft plush tannins with raspberries, ripe black currant and an underlying chalk-driven finish. Fresh wet soil, hazelnuts, figs, and savory spice dominate this earth-driven wine. Herbal and candied fruit scents, with notes of cow blood and iron, are common. The lack of oak brings out the bare tannins and adds an earthy note, which is a big part of Gualtallary's wild side. The Eggo wines showcase the perfect combination of a chalky, terroir driven wine, with vibrant fruit and a long smooth finish.

title: La Storia Merlot 2021
bodyHtml: La Storia Merlot is and has been a consistently fine example of the ability of this classic Bordeaux variety to make solid, tasty, and age-worthy wines. The main aromas and flavours are dark cherry, plums, a bit of black liquorice, and herbs. The new oak barrels contribute a touch of vanilla, brown sugar, cocoa dust, and toast. On the mouth the wine is soft and viscous, balancing the acidity and the tannins well for such a young wine. The finish is long and soft with a suggestion of sweetness backed by ripe tannins.

title: Cassone Malbec Obra Prima Reserva
bodyHtml:
This Malbec is made exclusively of selected grapes of a 100+ year old vines estate. A wine of deep concentration and blackberry fruit, cherries and fig with a touch of spice. Its ripe tannins and fruit flavors lead to a long-lasting finish. The wine was aged in French oak barrels, delivering soft notes of vanilla, coffee and tobacco. This wine is unfiltered. This wine was aged 12 months in new French oak barrels.

Wonderful with grilled red meats, strong cheeses and pasta dishes. It is also ideal to pair with stews, game dishes or vegetables, such as stuffed potatoes, baked pumpkins or peppers. 

90 Points - James Suckling

A bold, sweet-smelling array of blueberries and blackberries with hints of violets and fresh oak. The palate is quite suave and supple with a rich sleeve of ripe, red-plum and dark-berry flavor.

title: Koyle Syrah Royale
bodyHtml: This Chilean Syrah from Koyle is certified Organic and Biodynamic. It is sourced from vineyards in Los Lingues, Colchagua Andes and spends about 30 days fermenting in stainless steel before 22 months of maturation in 400 Litre French Oak casks.

title: Giorgio & Gianni Nero Rosso
bodyHtml:
Giorgio & Gianni Nero Rosso is a red wine from the Puglia region in southern Italy, crafted entirely from Negroamaro grapes. This varietal is known for producing wines with deep color and rich flavors, reflecting the warm Mediterranean climate of the area.

Colour: Very dark, almost inky, indicating high concentration.

Aroma: An extraordinary combination of seductive layers of aromas, including dark fruits like blackberries and plums, complemented by rich toasted oak flavors.

Palate: Full-bodied with a robust structure, offering flavors of ripe dark fruits intertwined with notes of vanilla and subtle spices.

Body: Full-bodied with a velvety texture and well-integrated tannins.

Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lingering impression of its rich and layered flavors.

title: Lagarde Guarda Malbec
bodyHtml:
With the first vine planted in 1897, Lagarde is one of the oldest wineries in the Mendoza region with Malbec vines over 100 years old. With only two owning families in its history, Lagarde was acquired by the Pescarmona family in 1969. Today the winery is run by young sisters Sofia and Lucila Pescarmona, third generation of the winemaking family During the following decades Lagarde focused on defining its particular style of wines. Striving to consistently innovate Lagarde was the first Latin American producer to plant non-traditional varieties such as Viognier and Moscato Bianco, adding to its unique style.

Since 1999, the wines have been under the dedicated supervision of winemaker, Juan Roby, who along with the Pescarmonas enjoy creating high-quality wine made from grapes grown exclusively on their winery-run vineyards. Today the winery and estate are run by third generation Pescarmonas, sisters Sofia and Lucila Pescarmona. Under their direction, Lagarde creates exceptional terroir character wines that reflect a strong sustainable commitment to the land and its people.

title: Ringbolt Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
The Ringbolt was a ship that sank during the 1800s off the rugged Australian coast near Margaret River, now a premium wine region. This elegant Cabernet goes down beautifully! Serve with oven-roasted top sirloin, grilled sausages or hearty lamb stew.

The wine is deep crimson red, it opens with classical Margaret River Cabernet Sauvignon fresh varietal notes of bright berried fruits, briar and sea spray, followed with wafts of chocolate and mocha and finishes with subtle spiced oak aromas. The medium to full bodied palate shows cherry and satsuma plum characters leading to a fruit-sweet mid palate of chocolate and mocha, finishing with defined tannins. The wine is elegant and shows great length of flavour and a well structured palate line. Enjoy now or cellar for eight to ten years.

title: Leaping Horse Merlot 2022
bodyHtml: Straight-forward in style, the Leaping Horse Merlot has violet and dark fruit aromas with pleasant plum, black cherry and a little green olive character creeping into the flavor. Mouth-filling yet smooth, Leaping Horse has created an unpretentious wine that can pair with just about anything.

title: Roberto Voerzio Sarmassa di Barolo 2009 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Roberto Voerzio roots himself in the vineyards of Piemonte. Working beside both his father and grandfather, the beauty of La Morrainspired Roberto to pioneer for new pastures. Since age 20, the young man was aware of the prestige that came with his region, as well as the untapped potential unforeseen with La Morra and greater Langhe.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2009 Barolo Sarmassa di Barolo (tasted in a magnum) shows delicate embroidery of shaved mineral, dried cherry fruit, ash, tar, licorice, ginger and light teriyaki. End notes of toasted hazelnut are reminiscent of the perfumes that waft over Alba’s Ferrero chocolate factory.

94 Points - Vinous

The 2009 Barolo Sarmassa is all about pure sensuality. Freshly cut roses, sweet cherries, raspberries, mint and subtle spices are woven together in a finely knit fabric of the utmost elegance. Like the Cerequio, a wine it shares so many qualities with, the Sarmassa is quite rich and voluptuous in this vintage, but all the elements are very much in the right place. Elegance and power are rarely this well balanced.

93 Points - James Suckling

Loads of dried fruits such as strawberries and cherries. Full and very silky textured from the ripe tannins. Hints of cocoa and lightly toasted oak too. Wonderful tannins.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Ripe and rich, with a smooth texture wrapped around the flavors of cherry, plum, vanilla and cedar. Features a dense swath of tannins underneath and finishes with a loamy note.

title: Vicchiomaggio Agostino Petri Chianti Classico Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Tuscany, Italy, the Vicchiomaggio estate lies within the Chianti Classico region, near the town of Greve in Chianti. With a winemaking history dating back to the Renaissance, Castello Vicchiomaggio is today owned and operated by the Matta family, who uphold a philosophy of tradition fused with innovation. The estate is particularly renowned for its Sangiovese-based wines that reflect the terroir's elegance and structure.

Wine Description
This Chianti Classico Riserva displays a deep ruby colour with garnet highlights. On the nose, it offers intense aromas of ripe cherry, black plum, leather, and hints of violet, layered with subtle oak spices and earthy undertones. The palate is rich yet refined, with medium to full body, smooth tannins, and a vibrant acidity that gives the wine lift and freshness. Flavours of dark berry fruit, tobacco, dried herbs, and a touch of espresso unfold through a long, elegant finish.

Accolades
James Suckling – 94 points
Decanter – 93 points
Wine Spectator – 92 points

Food Pairing
Pair this Riserva with herb-roasted lamb, grilled portobello mushrooms, or aged Pecorino cheese. Rich pasta dishes such as pappardelle al cinghiale (wild boar ragu) also bring out the wine’s depth and savoury character. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Los Cardos Sauvignon Blanc
bodyHtml: The grapes were grown in renowned vineyards using sustainable agriculture practices. Light green with bright aromas and flavours of fresh citrus, herbs, kiwi, lees and yellow berry. Medium bodied and fresh on the palate with green fruit and mineral-like notes on the cleansing finish. A great "house" white.

title: Peller Estates Merlot Proprietor's Reserve
bodyHtml:
Three generations ago when Andrew Peller arrived in Canada from Hungary, he had a dream of creating a culture similar to what he had known in Europe where Canadians could enjoy great quality wines with family and friends.

That dream continues to be at the heart of what we do everyday at Peller Estates. It’s evident in the careful way our vineyard crews trim the vines during the hot days of summer to ensure our grapes are receiving just the right amount of sunlight. It’s why winemaker, Katie Dickieson sets out at first light to assess the grapes each morning as harvest season approaches to determine when the conditions are ideal for picking. It’s what drives every decision we make from vine to bottle. We hope you’ll agree it’s an approach that creates delicious wines that you’re proud to serve to family and friends.

-John Peller

title: Baron Philippe de Rothschild Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml: The wine has a sustained, brilliant colour shading to violet at the rim and a nose that opens with airing on predominantly mineral notes mingled with more typical aromas of blackcurrant bud and cherry liqueur. On the palate it displays an attractive structure of stylish tannins accompanied by rich and generous spice and black cherry flavours with a touch of liquorice and menthol. The mature and powerful finish, complete, long and dense, expresses all the character of Cabernet Sauvignon grown in the best Languedoc vineyards.

title: Cypress Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
This 'Cypress Cabernet Sauvignon' is a Central Coast offering from California, United States. The wine is produced by J. Lohr Vineyards & Wines, a family-owned and operated company founded by Jerry Lohr in 1974. The 'Cypress' line focuses on crafting approachable and value-driven wines that capture the essence of California's diverse wine regions.

Wine Description

The aroma is an attractive mix of ripe red fruits, black cherries, black currants, and violets, along with a bouquet of spicy cedar and a cigar box note. On the palate, this wine is round, soft, and rich, offering a mouthful of varietal Cabernet fruitiness. It is generally a medium-bodied wine with a plump mouthfeel and a soft, persistent, and lingering finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile Cabernet Sauvignon is an excellent partner for a wide range of dishes, particularly grilled red meats like burgers, steak, and lamb chops.

title: Casillero Del Diablo Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml: Dark, ruby red with aromas of cherries, black currant, and dark plums. This Cabernet Sauvignon is very concentrated, rich in flavour, perfectly balanced, and boasts a satisfying and lingering finish.

title: Donini Merlot 2024 - 1 Litre
bodyHtml:
Donini Merlot 2024 originates from Italy, specifically within the Venezia appellation of the Veneto region. The Donini story began at the turn of the 20th century in a Milanese trattoria, where the owner, Signore Donini, was celebrated for his skill in selecting exceptional wines for his patrons. Today, the winery continues this legacy by focusing on popular Italian varieties sourced primarily from the Adige valley, emphasizing a winemaking philosophy of high quality and accessibility.

Wine Description

This Merlot presents a bright ruby red colour in the glass. The sensory profile features a fragrant bouquet of ripe red fruits, notably plum and cherry, accented by delicate herbaceous scents and subtle notes of clove or pastry dough. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and dry, offering a balanced structure of soft tannins and lively acidity. The finish is clean and slightly lingering, characterized by lingering fruit and a hint of blackberry.

title: Undurraga T.H. Carignan 2020
bodyHtml: Its acidity is firm and tight, while its savage tannins offer a solid structure. The lifted flavours of flowers and red cherries deliver a fruity yet complex palate.

title: Catena Bonarda 'La Marchigiana' 2022
bodyHtml:
Concentrated blueberry and dark fruit laced with cedar, tobacco, earth and spice. A medium-to-full-bodied wine with finely grained tannins.

92 Points - James Suckling

A full body and a rich mouthfeel dominate this 82% semillon and 18% sauvignon blanc wine. Golden apples, Bosc pears and a touch of almonds.

title: Jean Tardy Nuits Saint Georges 'Au Bas de Combe' Vieilles Vignes 2020
bodyHtml:
Fermentation takes place with infrequent pigeage to keep the elegance and finesse of the fruit. The wines are gently pressed to barrel and matured on lees, receiving their first racking at final blending. With only five hectares all up, these traditional, precise and elegant wines are domain-bottled in tiny quantities.

In 1966, Jean Tardy started working vines in Nuits-St-Georges, Vosne-Romanée and Clos Vougeot under a crop-sharing arrangement with Domaine Meo-Camuzet. From the 1980s, he started slowly but surely to build his estate, acquiring land in the likes of Chambolle-Musigny, Nuits-Saint-Georges, Vosne-Romanee and Gevrey-Chambertin over the next 30 years. Jean's son Guillaume took charge of the winemaking in 2001. He continues to work under the watchful eye of Jean, the two of them doing everything to ensure healthy fruit and excellent ripeness. That means short pruning, de-budding and strict green harvest to keep yields down. 

Dense purple black. This is usually the outstanding cuvee and once again the nose promises very well, Dark fruit, concentrated but not too ripe, a little bit of black cherry, then some ripe strawberry, easily enough fruit to surround the tannins, just the right acidity. More muscle than the Vosne, but very well balanced for a medium to long term future.

title: Jean Tardy Gevrey Chambertin 'Champerrier' Vieilles Vignes
bodyHtml:
In 1966, Jean Tardy started working vines in Nuits-St-Georges, Vosne-Romanée and Clos Vougeot under a crop-sharing arrangement with Domaine Meo-Camuzet. From the 1980s, he started slowly but surely to build his estate, acquiring land in the likes of Chambolle-Musigny, Nuits-Saint-Georges, Vosne-Romanee and Gevrey-Chambertin over the next 30 years. Jean's son Guillaume took charge of the winemaking in 2001. He continues to work under the watchful eye of Jean, the two of them doing everything to ensure healthy fruit and excellent ripeness. That means short pruning, de-budding and strict green harvest to keep yields down. 

Fermentation takes place with infrequent pigeage to keep the elegance and finesse of the fruit. The wines are gently pressed to barrel and matured on lees, receiving their first racking at final blending. With only five hectares all up, these traditional, precise and elegant wines are domain-bottled in tiny quantities.

The bouquet is quite restrained but there is a wealth of attractive red fruit here, raspberry and alpine strawberry together, then a more savoury finish, a few tannins, no discordant acidity, and good length.

title: Oxford Landing Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This Chardonnay originates from the Riverland region of South Australia, situated along the banks of the River Murray. Founded in 1958 by the late Wyndham Hill-Smith, Oxford Landing is part of the historic, family-owned Yalumba wine company, which remains fiercely independent under the Hill-Smith family's stewardship.

Wine Description

This wine is a pale straw green in colour. The aromatic profile features yellow peach and ripe nectarine alongside unique notes of native Australian lemon myrtle, wild honey, and freshly cut hay. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied with layers of stone fruit and fig, complemented by a subtle cinnamon spice and toasty vanilla derived from partial barrel maturation and lees contact.

Food Pairing

This Chardonnay is an excellent companion to steamed salmon with sugar snap peas or avocado pasta. It also pairs beautifully with a chickpea, coriander, and lime salad or creamy dishes like chicken meat pie.

title: Santa Rita 120 Sauvignon Blanc
bodyHtml:
120 is a traditional and historical brand that makes the concept of a simple wine genuine and open to an amazing experience. Living la "Vida 120" means taking advantage of the simple side of life, enjoying every moment with the people you love, with no complications and in the sincerest way possible, sharing good wine with friends and family.

The wine has a great fruit intensity with citrus notes. The palate shows a balanced acidity and freshness with a pleasant fruity finish. Its medium-long persistence makes it light and easy to enjoy wine.

title: Gato Negro Merlot
bodyHtml: Bright ruby colour; gentle red fruit aromas with hints of licorice; dry, medium to full-bodied, with sweet berry fruit flavours and a moderate to long pleasant finish.

title: Santa Carolina Cabernet Sauvignon-Merlot 2024
bodyHtml: Garnet red colour; aromas of cassis and black raspberries; medium-full bodied with ripe fruit flavour and light cedar spice on the finish.

title: Santa Rita 120 Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from the Central Valley of Chile. Founded in 1880 by Domingo Fernandez, Santa Rita is a pioneer of Chilean viticulture that focuses on high quality and sustainability. The 120 Series is named in honour of 120 patriots who found refuge in the winery's cellars during Chile's 19th century struggle for independence.

The Santa Rita 120 Cabernet Sauvignon is an intense violet red wine with a detailed sensory profile. The nose is dominated by red and black fruits, complemented by notes of clove, vanilla, and tobacco derived from oak aging. On the palate, this medium to full bodied wine features sweet, smooth tannins and a fresh, juicy finish. It is a 100% Cabernet Sauvignon varietal with an optimal drinking window of three to five years.

Food Pairing

This robust Cabernet Sauvignon is an ideal match for hearty red meats, such as grilled steak or roasted lamb. It also pairs exceptionally well with pork, spicy sausages, and aged cheeses like sharp cheddar or gouda. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Gato Negro Cabernet Sauvignon 2025
bodyHtml: Ruby red with garnet edge, floral, spice, berry cocktail, liquorice and mushroom aromas. Dry, medium body, soft fruit and soft medium tannin; an easy to enjoy dry wine with fruity, moderate finish.

title: Lindeman's Sauvignon Blanc Bin 95
bodyHtml: Elegant and refreshing, this medium bodied wine is packed with layers of fruit flavour, reflecting the varied regional base. Gooseberry and kiwi fruit flavours are at the fore, leading to a grassy, smooth finish.

title: Lindeman's Shiraz Bin 50
bodyHtml: Deep ruby/purple colour. Floral, coffee, dark fruit and candy on the nose with toasted oak notes. Dry, medium-bodied, with a coffee and sweet dark fruit center and good length.

title: Cupcake Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml: Cupcake Chardonnay is crafted with grapes from California’s esteemed Monterey County. They barrel ferment their Chardonnay to achieve a rich, creamy wine with flavours of apple, lemon, vanilla and a hint of toasted almond. Enjoy with crab cakes or copious amounts of sunshine.

title: Zorzal Owners Blend Climax
bodyHtml: Deep and complexity of plum, spices and marmalade. Soft and mature tannins.

title: Frontera Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml: Deep ruby colour. Light cassis, plum, cherry, currant, raspberry, chocolate, earth and mint aroma. Dry, medium-bodied, with good berry flavour, through to a pleasant fruity finish.

title: Gaja Ca'Marcanda Promis 2024
bodyHtml:
Gaja's Ca'Marcanda Promis is a distinguished red blend from Tuscany, Italy. The name "Promis" is derived from the Latin word "promissio," meaning promise, symbolizing the Gaja family's dedication to crafting wines of exceptional quality and character.

Wine Description

In the glass, Promis showcases a vibrant ruby-red hue. On the nose, it offers aromas of red and black fruits complemented by hints of cinnamon, star anise, and subtle spices. The palate is fresh and juicy, with fine-grained and silky tannins. The finish is elegant and persistent, displaying a harmonious balance of structure and fruit.

Food Pairing

This versatile red blend pairs beautifully with a range of dishes, including grilled meats, pasta with rich tomato-based sauces, and roasted vegetables. It also complements aged cheeses and charcuterie, making it an excellent choice for both casual gatherings and formal occasions.

title: Punt E Mes
bodyHtml: Punt e Mes is an aperitif with a golden orange colour with topaz tones, herby aromas and dark red, and black dahlia with vermilion shades. The initial taste is one of sweetness, characterized by an intriguing accent of orange. This is followed by the characteristically bitter taste of the quina and ends on a sweet note. The bitterness is not as strong as that found in the Italian amaro.

title: AsomBroso Eros Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
AsomBroso ‘Eros’ Reposado is a celebration of craftsmanship, passion, and the rich heritage of Jalisco’s tequila-making tradition. Crafted from the finest Blue Weber Agave, grown in the region’s mineral-rich volcanic soil and nurtured by expert agave farmers, this tequila delivers remarkable depth and character.

Our unique 9-month aging process begins with ‘11-Year-Vintage’ French oak barrels whose staves are coated with the caramelized sweetness of slow-cooked agave. Into these seasoned barrels, we introduce our estate-grown tequila, gently rolling them to infuse the spirit with the oak’s subtle complexity and the agave’s natural richness. The result is a reposado with a light amber hue, a sweet and flavourful profile, and a refined smoothness—perfect for sipping neat, enjoying on the rocks, or elevating your favourite cocktails.

Production Details

  • Agave Type: 100% Blue Weber Agave

  • Agave Region: Jalisco (Tequila Valley)

  • Specific Region: Valles – San Juanito De Escobedo

  • Cooking Method: Stone/brick ovens

  • Extraction: Roller mill expeller

  • Water Source: Estate deep well water

  • Fermentation: Closed stainless steel tanks with Champagne yeast, without fibres

  • Distillation: Twice distilled

  • Stills: Stainless steel with copper coil

  • Aging: 9 months in agave-seasoned French oak (‘11-Year-Vintage’ barrels)

  • ABV/Proof: 40% ABV (80 proof)

  • Other Notes: No additives

title: Asombroso Collaboration Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
The Collaboration’ is the meeting point of two worlds of excellence—Mexico’s finest ultra-premium tequila and Napa Valley’s legendary winemaking tradition. This extraordinary extra añejo begins its journey aging for 11 years in new French oak, developing exceptional depth and elegance. It is then finished for an additional year in American oak Cabernet Sauvignon barrels from the renowned Silver Oak Cellars, infusing the tequila with distinctive wine-driven complexity.

The result is a one-of-a-kind, double barrel-rested, additive-free masterpiece, produced in extremely limited quantities—only 504 bottles annually. Rich, layered, and deeply sophisticated, ‘The Collaboration’ is crafted for the true connoisseur.

Tasting Profile

  • Aroma: Oak wood, ripe fruit, and bold Cabernet notes

  • Palate: Balanced agave with Cabernet richness, leathery fruit undertones, and a smooth, lingering finish

Production Details

  • Agave Type: 100% Blue Weber Agave

  • Agave Region: Jalisco (Tequila Valley)

  • Specific Region: Valles – San Juanito De Escobedo

  • Cooking Method: Stone/brick ovens

  • Extraction: Roller mill expeller

  • Water Source: Estate deep well water

  • Fermentation: Closed stainless steel tanks with Champagne yeast, without fibres

  • Distillation: Twice distilled

  • Stills: Stainless steel with copper coil

  • Aging: 11 years in new French oak, followed by 1 year in Silver Oak Cellars American oak Cabernet Sauvignon barrels (double barrel-rested)

  • ABV/Proof: 40% ABV (80 proof)

  • Other Notes: No additives

  • Annual Production: 504 bottles

title: Asombroso Ultrafino Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Asombroso Vintage Extra Añejo is the pinnacle of patience, artistry, and the rich tradition of Jalisco’s tequila-making heritage. Crafted from estate-grown Blue Weber Agave, cultivated in the mineral-rich volcanic soils of San Juanito De Escobedo, each plant is nurtured by skilled jimadores until reaching peak maturity. This exceptional tequila is then aged for an extraordinary 11 years in new French oak barrels, creating remarkable depth, elegance, and character.

Its deep amber hue and luxurious aromatic profile reveal notes of warm agave, vanilla, caramel, honey, and butterscotch. On the palate, it is velvety and layered—sweet oak, spice, and delicate floral undertones carry through to an exceptionally long, refined finish. Designed to be savoured neat, this tequila offers an unforgettable sipping experience worthy of its rare status.

Tasting Profile

  • Aroma: Warm agave, vanilla, caramel, honey, butterscotch, and subtle oak spice

  • Palate: Velvety texture with sweet oak, spice, and delicate floral undertones, leading to an exceptionally long, refined finish

Production Details

  • Agave Type: 100% Blue Weber Agave

  • Agave Region: Jalisco (Tequila Valley)

  • Specific Region: Valles – San Juanito De Escobedo

  • Cooking Method: Stone/brick ovens

  • Extraction: Roller mill expeller

  • Water Source: Estate deep well water

  • Fermentation: Closed stainless steel tanks with Champagne yeast, without fibres

  • Distillation: Twice distilled

  • Stills: Stainless steel with copper coil

  • Aging: 11 years in new French oak barrels

  • ABV/Proof: 40% ABV (80 proof)

  • Other Notes: No additives

title: Asombroso Extra Anejo Gran Reserva Tequila
bodyHtml:
AsomBroso ‘Gran Reserva’ is the pinnacle of refinement in our tequila portfolio—a spirit where time, craftsmanship, and tradition converge. Beginning with our 100% Blue Weber Agave Silver, the tequila is aged for five full years in new French oak barrels, a process that imparts extraordinary depth and elegance. This meticulous maturation creates a premium extra añejo with a complexity and richness often compared to fine aged cognac or Armagnac.

Best savoured in a snifter to fully experience its layered aromas and flavours, ‘Gran Reserva’ delivers a luxurious sipping experience meant to be appreciated slowly.

Tasting Profile

  • Aroma: Sweet spice with cinnamon, nutmeg, light honey, and delicate butter notes

  • Palate: Buttercream with hints of oak, leading to a smooth, medium-bodied finish

Production Details

  • Agave Type: 100% Blue Weber Agave

  • Agave Region: Jalisco (Tequila Valley)

  • Specific Region: Valles – San Juanito De Escobedo

  • Cooking Method: Stone/brick ovens

  • Extraction: Roller mill expeller

  • Water Source: Estate deep well water

  • Fermentation: Closed stainless steel tanks with Champagne yeast, without fibres

  • Distillation: Twice distilled

  • Stills: Stainless steel with copper coil

  • Aging: 5 years in new French oak barrels

  • ABV/Proof: 40% ABV (80 proof)

  • Other Notes: No additives

title: AsomBroso Silver Tequila
bodyHtml:
AsomBroso ‘El Platino’ is a proud expression of Mexican tradition and craftsmanship. Crafted from 100% slow-cooked Blue Weber Agave grown in the heart of Jalisco’s Tequila Valley, this ultra-premium silver tequila offers a refined, authentic taste that is truly one of a kind.

Awarded Top Tequila by the San Francisco World Spirits Competition for two consecutive years, ‘El Platino’ has earned its place among the finest tequilas in the world.

Through a proprietary process of multiple distillations and meticulous filtration, we achieve the perfect balance—preserving the agave’s natural character while eliminating the harsh finish found in many other tequilas. The result is a sophisticated spirit, ideal for sipping neat or elevating your favourite cocktails.

Production Details

  • Agave Type: 100% Blue Weber Agave

  • Agave Region: Jalisco (Tequila Valley)

  • Specific Region: Valles – San Juanito De Escobedo

  • Cooking Method: Stone/brick ovens

  • Extraction: Roller mill expeller

  • Water Source: Estate deep well water

  • Fermentation: Closed stainless steel tanks with Champagne yeast, without fibres

  • Distillation: Twice distilled

  • Stills: Stainless steel with copper coil

  • Aging: Unaged (blanco/silver)

  • ABV/Proof: 40% ABV (80 proof)

  • Other Notes: Distilled at or near proof; no additives

title: Hacienda Lopez de Haro Crianza 2021
bodyHtml: Hacienda Lopez de Haro is a round, pleasant and expressive wine, made from the Tempranillo, red Garnacha and Graciano grape varieties and aged for more than 2 years in oak and bottle. A wine of intense color and a pleasant bouquet, in which the nuances of mature fruit stand out. In the mouth it is soft, expressive and elegant, combining a fruity character with the notes lent by the cask, in perfect balance.

title: Manvi Arya Vino Nobile di Montepulciano 2020 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Manvi is a boutique winery located in the picturesque hills of Montepulciano, Tuscany. Owned and operated by a passionate couple who left corporate careers to follow their love for wine, Manvi focuses on biodynamic principles and sustainable farming. Their small-scale production allows for meticulous attention to detail, ensuring wines that are both expressive and authentic.

Wine Description
Arya Vino Nobile di Montepulciano presents a deep ruby red colour with garnet reflections. On the nose, it opens with elegant aromas of ripe cherry, violet, dried herbs, and a subtle undercurrent of tobacco and leather. The palate is refined and balanced, offering flavours of plum, dark berry, and savoury earthiness wrapped in polished tannins and lively acidity. Medium to full-bodied, it finishes long with a touch of minerality and spice.

Accolades
Vinous - 92 points.
Decanter - 91 points.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with classic Tuscan dishes such as wild boar ragù, mushroom risotto, or aged pecorino cheese. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Prieure de Montezargues Tavel Rose 2024 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction
The Prieure de Montezargues Tavel Rosé hails from Tavel AOC in the Southern Rhône Valley, France. The estate has been a fixture of winemaking in the region for generations, known for producing expressive and high-quality rosé wines. With a focus on sustainable viticulture and respect for the terroir, the winery captures the essence of Tavel’s unique combination of sun-drenched climate and rocky soil.

Wine Description
This rosé presents a brilliant pale pink color, capturing the eye with its delicate hue. On the nose, it offers an aromatic bouquet of fresh strawberries, raspberries, and a hint of citrus zest, accompanied by floral notes of rose petals. The palate is fresh and crisp, with balanced acidity and a medium body that carries through the clean, dry finish.

Food Pairing
Pair with grilled seafood, such as shrimp or scallops, or a fresh Mediterranean salad with goat cheese. This combination highlights the wine’s crisp acidity and vibrant fruit character. It is also a perfect companion to light poultry dishes, enhancing the wine’s subtle depth and complexity. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Bodegas Lan Crianza 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originating from Spain's renowned Rioja region, Bodegas Lan Crianza 2018 is a testament to the winery's commitment to quality and tradition. Established in 1972, Bodegas LAN combines modern winemaking techniques with respect for Rioja's rich heritage. The name 'LAN' is an acronym representing the three provinces that form the Rioja Designation of Origin: Logroño, Álava, and Navarra.

Wine Description

  • Color: Intense red cherry with a garnet rim.

  • Aroma: Predominant notes of red fruits such as strawberry, raspberry, and peach, complemented by hints of vanilla, toffee, and a subtle touch of cinnamon.

  • Palate: Balanced and silky, offering a structured mouthfeel with a long-lasting and satisfying finish.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 91 points.

Food Pairing

Ideal pairings include grilled lamb chops, roast chicken, or pork loin. These combinations enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience. ​

title: Domane Wachau Gruner Veltliner Smaragd Ried Axpoint 2024
bodyHtml:
Domäne Wachau is one of Austria’s most renowned wineries, located in the heart of the Wachau Valley. The winery has a long history, with its roots dating back centuries. Today, it is known for producing wines that highlight the unique terroir of the region, focusing on sustainable practices and maintaining a balance between tradition and innovation. Grüner Veltliner Smaragd Ried Axpoint is a product of this dedication to quality and craftsmanship.

Wine Description:
The Domäne Wachau Grüner Veltliner Smaragd Ried Axpoint is a vivid, golden wine that gleams with brightness. On the nose, it is complex and intense, with layers of citrus zest, white pepper, and subtle floral notes. The palate is full-bodied and vibrant, offering a refreshing balance of acidity and minerality, accompanied by flavours of ripe green apple, citrus fruits, and a touch of honeyed richness. The wine finishes with a long, crisp finish, showcasing the wine's complexity and elegance. Made from 100% Grüner Veltliner, this wine offers a perfect balance of freshness and depth.

Food Pairing:
This Grüner Veltliner is an ideal match for a variety of dishes, particularly those with rich and savoury profiles. Try it with roasted chicken, grilled fish, or a creamy goat cheese. The wine's vibrant acidity and mineral edge complement the richness of the food, creating a well-rounded and harmonious dining experience.

title: Nakano Matcha Umeshu - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Nakano BC is a historic sake brewery and distillery located in the lush mountains of Wakayama, Japan. Founded in 1932, the company draws on deep-rooted traditions while embracing innovation in flavour crafting. Known for its artisanal umeshu (plum wine), Nakano BC takes pride in using only high-quality, locally grown Nanko ume and natural spring water from the Fujishiro region.

Sake Description
A captivating fusion of traditional umeshu and Japanese green tea, Nakano Matcha Umeshu presents a vivid jade-green hue. On the nose, it exudes fragrant notes of sweet plum, fresh-cut grass, and earthy matcha. The palate opens with luscious sweetness from ripe ume, balanced by a creamy texture and the slightly bitter, umami-rich depth of Kyoto-grown matcha. Medium-bodied with a soft, velvety mouthfeel, it finishes smooth and lingering, with a refreshing herbal note. Crafted from 100% Japanese ume and ceremonial-grade matcha, this unique liqueur is best enjoyed slightly chilled or over ice, with an optimal drinking window within 1–2 years of bottling for peak vibrancy.

Food Pairing
Ideal alongside light desserts such as matcha tiramisu or mochi, it also complements savoury dishes like agedashi tofu and sushi rolls with a hint of sweetness. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Valdicava Rosso di Montalcino 2022
bodyHtml:
Valdicava is a prestigious estate located in the Montosoli area of Montalcino, Tuscany. Established in 1953, it has gained a reputation for producing some of the finest expressions of Sangiovese, particularly their renowned Brunello di Montalcino. The estate is committed to traditional viticulture and meticulous vineyard management, ensuring the production of high-quality wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region.

2022 Rosso di Montalcino

The 2022 Valdicava Rosso di Montalcino is crafted from 100% Sangiovese Grosso grapes, often referred to as a "baby Brunello" due to its shared characteristics with the estate's flagship wine. In the glass, it exhibits a vibrant ruby red color. The nose reveals fresh aromas of red cherries, raspberries, and wild strawberries, complemented by floral hints and subtle earthy notes.

On the palate, it is medium-bodied with lively acidity and fine tannins, offering flavors of juicy red fruit, herbs, and a touch of spice. The finish is long and clean, with a refreshing minerality that adds depth.

Food Pairing

This Rosso di Montalcino pairs beautifully with a range of dishes, including pasta with rich sauces, roasted meats, and aged cheeses. These pairings enhance the wine's vibrant fruit flavors and balanced structure, creating a harmonious dining experience.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator: 90 Points. "A dense red, evoking cherry, earth, and eucalyptus flavors, this is tightly wound. Not giving a lot of pleasure today, but give this a few months to unravel. Then make a nice ragù. Best from 2025 through 2029."

title: Domaine Labbe Abymes Vin Blanc de Savoie 2024
bodyHtml:
Domaine Labbé, nestled in the heart of France's Savoie region, has been cultivating vineyards since 1975. Initially a mixed farming venture, the estate transitioned to viticulture under the guidance of founders Roger and Marc Labbé. Today, cousins Jérôme and Alexandra Labbé manage the 10-hectare estate, upholding a commitment to sustainable practices and the expression of their unique terroir. 

Wine Description

The Domaine Labbé Abymes Vin Blanc de Savoie is crafted exclusively from the Jacquère grape, a varietal indigenous to the region. This wine presents a pale yellow hue with subtle green reflections. On the nose, it exudes fresh aromas of white flowers and citrus, notably lemon zest. The palate is lively and crisp, offering harmonious flavors that persist pleasantly, culminating in a clean, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile white pairs excellently with seafood dishes such as shellfish and lean fish. It also complements traditional Savoie specialties like fondue and raclette, enhancing the wine's freshness and minerality.

title: Bodega Chacra 'Barda' Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
Bodega Chacra, situated in the Río Negro Valley of northern Patagonia, was established in 2004 by Piero Incisa della Rocchetta, a descendant of the family behind Italy's renowned Sassicaia wine. The winery is dedicated to producing exceptional Pinot Noir and Chardonnay wines that reflect the unique Patagonian terroir.

Wine Description
The 2023 'Barda' Pinot Noir presents a translucent ruby hue, indicative of its elegance and finesse. The nose offers an aromatic bouquet of red cherries, wild strawberries, and subtle floral notes, intertwined with hints of earthy minerality and a touch of spice. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with vibrant acidity, showcasing flavours of ripe red berries, wet forest floor, and cedar, culminating in a long, bright finish with plenty of energy. The wine is crafted from 100% Pinot Noir grapes, sourced from younger vineyards planted in 1990 with cuttings from their original ungrafted vines

Accolades
James Suckling – 94 points

Food Pairing
This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with dishes such as grilled salmon, roasted poultry, mushroom risotto, and soft cheeses. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character.

title: Benjamin Bridge White Blend 'Wild Rock' 2025
bodyHtml:
Benjamin Bridge, situated in Nova Scotia's picturesque Gaspereau Valley, is celebrated for its commitment to crafting wines that reflect the unique maritime terroir of the region. The winery emphasizes sustainable practices and a minimalist approach to winemaking, allowing the character of the grapes and the land to shine through.

Wine Description:

In the glass, this white blend presents a shiny straw colour with a golden wheat hue. The nose offers a combination of citrus oils, bittersweet floral perfume, lime, and tangerine, interlaced with saline coastal undertones. On the palate, the wine is naturally plush yet dry, with an inherent softness and roundness. Flavours of orange creamsicle, pear tart, freshly cut grass, and botanicals lead to a vibrant, echoing finish.

Food Pairing:

This wine pairs beautifully with fresh seafood dishes such as grilled scallops or lemon-herb shrimp, as well as light salads featuring citrus vinaigrettes. Its bright acidity and coastal nuances complement the freshness of these dishes, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Settlement Pinot Noir 2019
bodyHtml:
Blank Canvas is the personal wine label of husband-and-wife team Matt Thomson and Sophie Parker-Thomson MW. With over 45 years of combined experience in the global wine industry, they focus on crafting small-batch, single-vineyard wines that highlight the unique terroirs of New Zealand. The Settlement Vineyard, established in 2009, is organically farmed and situated on a north-facing hillside in the Omaka Valley. This vineyard is known for producing Pinot Noir with exceptional structure and depth.

Wine Description:

The 2019 Settlement Vineyard Pinot Noir is a powerful and structured wine, showcasing the characteristics of the Omaka Valley. It presents a complex bouquet of ripe red berries, savoury dried herbs, and subtle oak and baking spice notes. On the palate, the wine is dense and rich, with a youthful energy that transitions smoothly through berry flavours and savoury elements, supported by firm tannins and balanced acidity. The wine is 100% Pinot Noir, specifically Clone 777, and was fermented with 50% whole bunches, contributing to its tannic backbone and ageing potential.

Food Pairing:

This Pinot Noir pairs excellently with herbed grilled lamb, duck confit, or mushroom risotto. The wine's structure and savoury notes complement the richness of these dishes, enhancing the overall dining experience.

title: Domane Wachau Riesling Smaragd Ried Loibenberg 2023
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Austria's Wachau region, the Domane Wachau Riesling Smaragd Ried Loibenberg 2022 reflects the winery's deep-rooted history and commitment to producing exceptional wines. Domane Wachau is renowned for its rich winemaking tradition, focusing on producing wines that showcase the region's unique terroir. The Loibenberg vineyard, a prestigious site within the Wachau, contributes to the wine's exceptional quality, thanks to its steep slopes and optimal exposure to the sun.

Food Pairing
This Riesling pairs beautifully with a variety of dishes, including grilled seafood, Asian cuisine, and creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert. The wine's acidity and fruit-forward nature balance the richness of these foods, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Clos Des Papes Chateauneuf Du Pape Rouge 2019
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from France, within the world-renowned Châteauneuf-du-Pape A.O.C. appellation in the Southern Rhône Valley. Domaine Clos des Papes, led by the legendary Paul-Vincent Avril, is widely regarded as one of the ultimate benchmark estates of the region. Sourced from 24 distinct parcels spread across 32 hectares of organically farmed vineyards, the estate benefits from a complex mosaic of terroirs most notably the famous galets roulés (large quartz quartzite stones) over clay, limestone, and sand. The Mediterranean climate, defined by intense solar warmth tempered by the forceful, cooling Mistral wind, enables the diverse grape varieties to achieve full phenolic maturity while preserving remarkable structural balance, fresh vitality, and profound mineral depth.

Wine Description

The 2019 Clos des Papes Châteauneuf-du-Pape Rouge presents a deep, luminous garnet-ruby color in the glass with vivid crimson and magenta shimmers at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a masterfully precise, layered, and noble portrait of Southern Rhône terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crushed kirsch, wild blackberries, red plum compote, and black raspberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of garrigue (wild lavender, rosemary, and thyme), cured meats, black pepper, star anise, damp earth, crushed limestone, and subtle cedarwood. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, athletic, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent, power-packed core of dark stone fruits, blood orange zest, and cocoa nibs. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its rich mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and linear, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of iron, tapenade, and dried herbs.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 growing season in the Southern Rhône is celebrated as a solar, powerful, and remarkably balanced vintage. A warm, dry summer with intense sunshine was tempered by timely late-summer rainfall and the cooling influence of the Mistral wind, allowing grapes to achieve full phenolic skin maturity while retaining bright natural acidity and firm skin tannins. Paul-Vincent Avril harvested pristine, low-yielding fruit with ideal structural parameters. The resulting 2019 Clos des Papes Rouge combines generous warmth and fruit concentration with noble structural restraint, built to evolve and improve gracefully in a cellar over the next 15 to 25+ years.

title: Grgich Hills Chardonnay Miljenko's 100th Birthday 2020
bodyHtml:
The Paris Tasting Commemorative Chardonnay is a recreation of the now-famous 1973 Chardonnay crafted by Mike Grgich that beat the best French white wines in the historic Judgement of Paris. This wine has an elegant bouquet of fresh peach, key lime, and pineapple, enhanced by hints of Madagascar vanilla and caramel. Both soft and dense on the palate, it exudes juicy aromatics of green apple and fresh pineapple harmoniously balanced by crisp and refreshing acidity.

For this wine Grgich selected only the best grapes, which are primarily from their oldest block of Chardonnay, the Old Wente clone planted in 1989. Through a combination of clone, age, and cool climate, this single block in their estate vineyard in the chilly Carneros region of Napa Valley creates wonderfully rich flavors, balanced with crisp acidity. They farm all their certified organic vineyards naturally, using the principles of regenerative agriculture.

title: Burrowing Owl Pinot Gris 2023
bodyHtml: A vibrant pale lemon with intense aromas of pear, lemon and lime, white peach, honeydew melon and white flowers. The palate is crisp and refreshing with pear and green apple, lemon zest, clove spice and some wet stone minerality and a zesty grapefruit phenolic grip on the long finish. Pair this with trout stuffed with lemon and thyme.

title: E. Pira e Figli Chiara Boschis - Dolcetto d'Alba 2022
bodyHtml:
The 2022 Dolcetto d'Alba is a vibrant expression of Piedmont’s everyday red, crafted entirely from Dolcetto grapes sourced from vineyards in Barolo. It pours a deep ruby colour with a lively purple hue. The nose bursts with fresh blackberries, violet petals, and hints of spice and crushed stone. On the palate, it delivers bright, juicy fruit — think wild cherry and plum — backed by a subtle bitter almond edge and soft tannins. Medium-bodied with a silky texture, the wine finishes with energetic freshness and mineral lift, making it highly drinkable and approachable young. Best enjoyed within 3–5 years of the vintage to capture its vibrant fruit character and pure varietal charm.

Food Pairing
This Dolcetto pairs beautifully with mushroom risotto, grilled sausages, or pasta with meat ragu. Its bright acidity and soft tannins also make it an excellent companion for hard cheeses or pizza with prosciutto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Gakki Masamune Omachi Nakadori - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
From Japan’s Niigata Prefecture, Gakki Masamune is a premium sake produced by the respected Ochiai Shuzo brewery, known for its dedication to traditional methods and local ingredients. Founded in 1897, the brewery takes pride in its small-scale, handcrafted approach, emphasizing the pristine quality of Niigata’s water and rice. Gakki Masamune is recognized for its elegance, with the Nakadori label representing the middle pressing, considered the purest portion of sake.

This sake is brewed using the revered Omachi rice, Japan’s oldest sake rice variety, valued for its earthy depth and soft, complex character. The sake displays a pale, clear hue with delicate floral aromas of jasmine, fresh melon, and white peach. On the palate, it is silky and layered, offering notes of pear, stone fruit, and a gentle umami undertone. Light to medium-bodied, the finish is clean and lingering with subtle minerality. It is a Junmai Daiginjo grade, made from rice polished down to 50% or less, showcasing superb balance and refinement. Best enjoyed slightly chilled, it is recommended to be consumed within two years of release for optimal freshness.

Food Pairing
This sake pairs beautifully with seared scallops, lightly grilled chicken, or vegetable tempura. It also complements soft cheeses or sashimi, where the elegant acidity and umami resonance enhance the dish's texture. A perfect match to enhance the sake’s complexity.

title: Alois Lageder Pinot Bianco Versalto 2022
bodyHtml:
This harmonious and high-altitude white wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Alto Adige DOC (South Tyrol) in the heart of the Alps. Versalto is a curated composition of Pinot Bianco sourced from unique sites at elevations between 480 and 660 meters, including Pochi di Salorno, Penone, and Tirolo near Merano. The name reflects the "harmony of high altitudes," blending Mediterranean soils with volcanic and limestone origins.
