Alois Lageder, a certified biodynamic estate, uses this label to showcase a more structured and mineral-driven side of Pinot Bianco compared to their "Classic" range.

Wine Description

Alois Lageder Versalto Pinot Bianco presents a clear, bright straw-yellow color with a distinctive green shimmer. The sensory profile is elegant and "restrained," featuring an aromatic nose of unripe pear, orchard-fresh apple, and candied lemons, layered with sophisticated notes of slate, wet stone, and tea biscuits. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "linear," showcasing a crisp, direct personality with a tang of salinity and refreshing acidity. It is characterized by its remarkable "Dolomitic quality" and a lingering finish of elderflower and dried thyme. This 100% Pinot Bianco reached an ABV of 11.5% to 12% and was matured on the lees for approximately nine months in a combination of stainless steel tanks and large oak casks.

title: Glenfiddich 26 Year Old Grande Couronne
bodyHtml:
The Glenfiddich 26 Year Old Grande Couronne is a luxurious expression matured for 26 years, primarily in American and European oak casks, before being elegantly finished in rare French cognac casks. In the glass, it exhibits a rich golden hue with copper highlights. On the nose, it offers an opulent bouquet of sweet toasted oak, café crème, soft brown sugar, and a delicate hint of spice. The palate unfolds with layers of decadent flavours: vanilla, sweet brioche, sandalwood, and gentle baking spices, complemented by whispers of rich fruitcake and citrus zest. Medium to full-bodied, the whisky glides smoothly to a long, elegantly sweet finish with subtle oak and creamy toffee notes. The cognac cask finish lends remarkable finesse, enhancing the whisky’s complexity and adding a graceful vibrancy.

Food Pairing

Pair this exceptional single malt with duck breast glazed in a dark berry reduction, or a platter of aged Gruyère and walnuts to echo its nutty, sweet undertones. Rich chocolate desserts, such as a flourless chocolate cake, also complement its sumptuous texture and layered sweetness. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Junmai Ginjo Handago Kobo 1801 - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Established at the end of the Edo period in 1844, Nakano Sake Brewery Co., Ltd. has a rich history of refining traditional brewing techniques while integrating innovative modern technology. The brewery operates with a philosophy of 'creating a rich food culture through Japanese sake', maintaining a legacy that has spanned over 180 years.

Description

This Junmai Ginjo is distinguished by its use of yeast strain No. 1801, which creates a splendid and gorgeous ginjo aroma featuring notes of ripe pear, banana, jasmine, and chestnut. Meticulously crafted using local Wakamizu rice polished to 55%, it offers a harmonious and rich umami profile on the palate with hints of apple, grape, and coconut. The body is very well balanced, presenting an interesting contrast between its fragrant bouquet and a slightly dry, mouth watering finish. It has an alcohol content of 15% to 15.5% and a Sake Meter Value of +2.0.

Food Pairing

The versatile nature and light umami of this sake make it an ideal companion for a variety of seafood and vegetable dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with Japanese classics such as vegetable tempura, grilled mackerel, and fresh sashimi. Its fruity notes and balanced acidity also complement king oyster mushroom yakitori, pickled onions, or a cool hiyayakko tofu dish. For the best sensory experience, it is recommended to be served chilled to preserve its delicate floral and fruit aromas.

title: Mi Familia Plata
bodyHtml: Made in Amatitan, Jalisco, using 100% agave. Intense aromas of cooked agave and subtle sweet vanilla notes that give way to the pure flavor of slightly fruity agave. This blanco is perfect for sipping or mixing in any tequila cocktail.

title: Domaine De La Croisee Pouilly Fume Magma
bodyHtml:
This expressive white wine originates from France, within the renowned Loire Valley region and the famed Pouilly Fume subregion. Domaine de la Croisee was established when winemakers Nolwenn and Matthieu acquired an 8.5-hectare estate in the heart of the appellation in 2019. Driven by a commitment to organic viticulture and natural winemaking, they revitalised the neglected vineyards to showcase the area's geological mosaic of Kimmeridgian marl, limestone, and flint soils.

Wine Description

Domaine de la Croisee Pouilly Fume Magma presents a crystal-clear, pale gold colour with silvery highlights. The bouquet opens with delicate floral aromas of linden blossom and lemon verbena, accompanied by notes of white fruits, chamomile, and subtle smoky spice. On the palate, it exhibits a silky, full-bodied profile filled with rich flavours of ripe mango, pineapple, and sweet citrus, perfectly balanced by vibrant freshness.

title: Roederer Estate Brut
bodyHtml:
#20 Wine Spectator Top 100 of 2024

Roederer Estate Brut is a sparkling wine from the United States, crafted in California’s renowned Anderson Valley, Mendocino County. The estate was established in 1982 by Champagne Louis Roederer, one of the most prestigious Champagne houses in France, bringing centuries of expertise to Californian soil. The Roederer family’s commitment to estate-owned vineyards and meticulous winemaking ensures wines of exceptional finesse and consistent quality.

Wine Description

Roederer Estate Brut presents a brilliant pale gold colour with a lively stream of fine bubbles. The nose offers enticing aromas of crisp green apple, pear, and citrus, interwoven with delicate notes of hazelnut and fresh-baked brioche from extended lees ageing. On the palate, it is vibrant and elegantly balanced, displaying flavours of lemon zest, stone fruit, and a hint of spice, carried by a creamy mousse. The wine is medium-bodied with a refreshing acidity, culminating in a long, clean finish with a touch of minerality.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points.

  • Wine Enthusiast - 92 points.

Food Pairing

Roederer Estate Brut pairs wonderfully with a wide range of dishes, from oysters on the half shell and smoked salmon canapés to roasted chicken or creamy mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Francois Villard Syrah Seul En Scene 2021
bodyHtml:
This Syrah hails from France, specifically from the renowned Northern Rhône Valley in the Saint-Joseph appellation. Francois Villard, initially a chef, turned to winemaking in the late 1980s and quickly gained acclaim for his meticulous vineyard work and expressive wines. His estate, established in Saint-Michel-sur-Rhône, is celebrated for its commitment to organic practices and showcasing the terroir of granite-rich hillsides.

Wine Description

The 2021 Seul En Scene is 100% Syrah. In the glass, it presents a deep ruby-purple hue. The nose opens with aromas of blackberries, cassis, violets, cracked pepper, and a subtle hint of smoked meats. On the palate, it is medium-bodied yet vibrant, offering layers of dark fruit, olive tapenade, and graphite. Fine-grained tannins and bright acidity give it a lively structure, leading to a long, mineral-driven finish.

Accolades

  • "Vinous - 93 points."

  • "Wine Advocate - 92 points."

Food Pairing

Pair this Syrah with grilled lamb chops with rosemary, peppered steak, or a mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Glenlivet Fusion Cask
bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet Fusion Cask is a unique expression that showcases the distillery’s forward-thinking approach. This whisky displays a bright amber colour. On the nose, enticing aromas of ripe pear, caramel, and delicate spice unfold alongside hints of toasted coconut. The palate is medium-bodied and remarkably smooth, offering layers of vanilla fudge, baked apple, and subtle ginger warmth. Its finish is long and rounded, leaving impressions of sweet oak and light pepper.

Food Pairing

This whisky pairs beautifully with roast pork tenderloin, aged Gruyère, or a rich apple tart. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience, enhancing the spirit’s nuanced sweetness and gentle spice.

title: Cotarella Brunello di Montalcino 'Le Macioche' 2013
bodyHtml:
This distinguished Brunello di Montalcino hails from Italy, in the renowned Tuscany region, specifically the celebrated Montalcino area. The 'Le Macioche' estate is an historic property that became part of the Cotarella family portfolio in 2017, under the guidance of Riccardo and Renzo Cotarella, famed Italian oenologists. They are dedicated to producing expressive wines that highlight the unique terroir of each vineyard, emphasizing meticulous vineyard management and minimal intervention winemaking.

Wine Description

The 2013 Cotarella Brunello di Montalcino 'Le Macioche' showcases a brilliant ruby hue that lightly transitions to garnet at the rim. On the nose, it offers compelling aromas of ripe red cherry, raspberry, rose petals, subtle tobacco leaf, and earthy undertones. The palate is elegant yet structured, delivering flavours of plum, dried cherry, leather, and hints of balsamic. Medium to full-bodied, it reveals refined tannins and vibrant acidity, leading to a long, savoury finish accented by spice and mineral notes.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator – 92 points.

  • James Suckling – 92 points.

  • Wine Enthusiast – 90 points.

Food Pairing

This Brunello’s refined tannins and bright acidity make it an exceptional match for roasted leg of lamb with rosemary, wild mushroom risotto, or aged Pecorino. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Alois Lageder Bianco Cason 2021
bodyHtml:
This rare and "avant-garde" white wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Casòn Hirschprunn estate in Magrè, within the Alto Adige region. While Alois Lageder is famous for its classic Pinot Bianco, the "Casòn" label represents the estate's top-tier "Crus" and experimental range. The winery's philosophy here is to push the boundaries of the terroir, creating a white wine with the structure and longevity typically reserved for grand reds.

Wine Description

Alois Lageder "Casòn" Bianco presents a brilliant straw-yellow color with greenish reflections. The sensory profile is rich and "baroque," featuring a complex bouquet of ripe peach, quince, and mango, layered with sophisticated notes of roasted almonds, sweet vanilla, and a hint of exotic spices. On the palate, the wine is strong, full-bodied, and "gentle," showcasing a harmonious balance between its creamy texture and a digestible, fresh acidity. It is characterized by its significant saltiness and a very long-lasting finish. This wine reached an ABV of 13% and underwent a rigorous vinification: spontaneous fermentation in barriques (1/3 new French oak), followed by 11 months of aging on the fine lees and further refinement in large wooden casks.

title: Domaine Chermette Brouilly Pierreux 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from France, specifically the Beaujolais region in southern Burgundy, with the Brouilly appellation as its origin. Domaine Chermette is a family-run estate established in the 19th century, now managed by Martine and Pierre-Marie Chermette. Renowned for championing traditional, low-intervention Beaujolais winemaking, the domaine focuses on expressing terroir and cultivating old vines without synthetic chemicals.

Wine Description

The Domaine Chermette Brouilly Pierreux 2023 is crafted entirely from Gamay Noir à Jus Blanc grapes sourced from granitic soils typical of Brouilly. In the glass, it reveals a vibrant ruby hue. The nose is lifted and perfumed, offering notes of wild strawberries, red cherries, subtle violets, and a faint earthy minerality. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with bright acidity and fine, silky tannins. Juicy red berry flavours intermingle with hints of crushed rock and a delicate peppery spice, leading to a fresh, elegant finish.

Food Pairing

Pair this Brouilly with roast chicken, grilled pork tenderloin, or a mushroom and thyme tart. The wine's bright fruit and subtle earthy undertones complement both lighter meats and savoury vegetable dishes beautifully. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Highwood Distillers Cruxx Natural Grain Spirit - 375 ml Plastic Bottle
bodyHtml: At 95% alcohol, CRUXX is an odorless, flavorless spirit distilled from wheat grain made to be a base for your liquid creations. From liqueurs like “Lemoncello” to bitters the wide range of mixing options are endless. This product is never to be consumed without adding other ingredients, or water at a minimum, to dilute the alcohol content down to a responsible level.

title: Campari - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Campari is a globally recognized red apéritif originating from Novara, Italy, where it was invented in 1860 by Gaspare Campari. The brand is the flagship of the Campari Group, an Italian company that has grown into the sixth-largest spirits group worldwide and is currently headquartered in Sesto San Giovanni. Ownership transitioned from the founding family to the Garavoglia family in the 1970s, under whom the company launched a series of strategic acquisitions to build a portfolio of over 50 premium brands.

Description

Crafted from a secret infusion of herbs, aromatic plants, and fruit macerated in alcohol and water, Campari is still made according to its original 1860 recipe.

  • Colour: Vivid scarlet or crimson red; famously, the natural carmine dye derived from cochineal insects was replaced with artificial colouring in 2006 for most markets.

  • Aroma: Intense and herbaceous with a touch of citrus, particularly grapefruit peel, and subtle floral notes.

  • Palate: Bright and bitter-sweet with a complex medicinal character featuring notes of bitter orange, herbs, and mild spices like cinnamon.

  • Body: Lighter in body than many liqueurs, offering a supple and refreshing mouthfeel.

  • Finish: A bracing and slightly spicy exit with lingering herbal bitterness.

  • ABV: Depending on the international market, the alcohol by volume typically ranges from 20.5% to 28.5%, with North American bottles often at 24% or 25%.

title: Alois Lageder Pinot Noir 'Krafuss' 2021
bodyHtml:
This refined and "contemplative" red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Krafuss estate in the village of Appiano, within the Alto Adige DOC (South Tyrol). The Krafuss vineyard is one of Alois Lageder’s prestigious "Crus," perched on a southeast-facing hilltop at elevations between 430 and 450 meters. In 1991, the estate transformed this historic site; which dates back to the Middle Ages, into a dedicated Pinot Noir vineyard planted with high-density clones on morainic soils composed of clay, rocks, and limestone. The winery's philosophy follows strict Demeter-certified biodynamic principles, aiming to capture the "dynamic tension" and alpine flair of this unique high-altitude terroir.

Wine Description

Alois Lageder Krafuss Pinot Noir presents a brilliant garnet hue with ruby shimmers. The sensory profile is complex and "restrained," featuring an aromatic nose of earthy strawberries, wild berries, and cherries, layered with sophisticated notes of violets, blood orange, pepper, and flint. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and "silky," showcasing a vibrant energy with flavours of peach tea, cinnamon, and smoky nuances. It is characterized by its elegant tannins and a wonderfully pronounced salty tension that leads to a long, mineral-laden finish. This 100% Pinot Noir reached an ABV of 13% to 14% and was matured for 18 months in French oak barriques and puncheons (1/3 new) after spontaneous fermentation.

title: Red Bank Canadian Whisky
bodyHtml:
Red Bank Canadian Whisky hails from the scenic coastal province of Nova Scotia, a region more known for its rugged maritime landscapes than its distilleries. This whisky is the product of Red Bank, a venture brought to life by Canadian entrepreneur Nicholas Hamilton and internationally renowned musician Bryan Adams, who together sought to create a spirit that embodies Canadian craftsmanship and spirit.

Whisky Description

Colour: Golden amber, reflecting careful maturation.
Aroma: Opens with inviting notes of caramel, toasted oak, and a gentle hint of vanilla bean, interlaced with subtle dried fruit and a wisp of spice.
Palate: Smooth and approachable, offering flavours of butterscotch, light toffee, and sweet grains, balanced by gentle oak tannins and a mild peppery spice. The mouthfeel is soft yet structured, with an undercurrent of baking spice that adds complexity.
Body & Finish: Medium-bodied with a warm, mellow finish that lingers with nuances of vanilla and light caramel.

title: Jermann Picolit Collio 2018 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Italy’s Friuli Venezia Giulia region, particularly the Collio DOC area, is renowned for its exceptional white wines. Jermann, established in 1881 and still family-owned, stands as one of Friuli’s most innovative wineries, merging tradition with modern winemaking. Silvio Jermann revolutionized the estate in the 1970s, focusing on purity of varietal expression and meticulous vineyard practices.

Wine Description

This Picolit is a brilliant golden straw in colour. On the nose, it opens with delicate aromas of acacia honey, dried apricots, white flowers, and subtle herbal nuances. The palate is elegantly sweet yet balanced by fresh acidity, offering layers of candied citrus, ripe pear, and hints of almond. It is medium-bodied, with a silky texture that leads into a long, refined finish marked by lingering floral and mineral notes. Made from 100% Picolit, it shows beautifully now but also has the potential to evolve gracefully over the next 5–7 years. This wine is a testament to Jermann’s philosophy of producing distinctive, terroir-driven wines that highlight Friuli’s unique varietals.

Accolades

• Wine Enthusiast – 94 points.
• James Suckling – 93 points.

Food Pairing

Perfect alongside foie gras, blue cheese, or almond tarts. The wine’s gentle sweetness and vibrant acidity make it an exceptional match for rich patés and delicate pastries, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Kris Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Crafted in the northern Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige, Kris is a brand under the ownership of the well-regarded Orowines group. Established with the goal of producing approachable, high-quality wines from classic Italian varietals, Kris emphasizes sustainable vineyard practices and precise winemaking techniques. The winery sources fruit from select hillside vineyards, allowing the expression of fresh alpine character and varietal purity.

This Pinot Noir presents a bright ruby red colour with delicate garnet reflections. On the nose, it opens with elegant aromas of red berries, cherries, and subtle hints of rose petals and earth. The palate is medium-bodied, showcasing juicy raspberry and cherry flavours layered with notes of baking spice and soft oak influence. Balanced acidity and silky tannins create a smooth texture, leading to a refined, lingering finish.

Food Pairing
Pair Kris Pinot Noir with herb-roasted chicken, mushroom risotto, or grilled salmon. The wine’s bright acidity and supple texture also complement soft cheeses such as brie or camembert. A perfect match to enhance the wine’s complexity.

title: Petaluma Chardonnay Adelaide Hills 2021
bodyHtml:
Australia’s Adelaide Hills region, nestled within South Australia, is renowned for its cool climate and exceptional white wines. Petaluma, established in 1976 by industry pioneer Brian Croser, is known for its commitment to terroir-driven winemaking. The winery's philosophy focuses on selecting the best sites for each varietal, and the Adelaide Hills vineyard has been central to its reputation for elegant, age-worthy Chardonnay.

Wine Description
This 2021 Chardonnay showcases a brilliant straw-yellow hue with subtle green flecks. On the nose, it opens with lifted aromas of white peach, nectarine, and citrus blossom, underpinned by notes of roasted hazelnuts and a touch of oak spice. The palate is refined and layered, delivering flavours of stone fruit, lemon curd, and cashew. A backbone of vibrant acidity supports its medium-bodied structure, leading to a long, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing
An excellent companion to grilled lobster, roasted chicken with tarragon, or creamy mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Per Se Aperitivo
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Per Se is the first 100% Portuguese aperitivo, crafted in Portugal by the producer Casa Redondo. Inspired by the vibrant sunset culture of Lisbon, the brand captures the essence of southern European conviviality and pre-dinner social rituals. This modern spirit is distilled and infused with a secret blend of 24 botanicals, designed to reflect the authentic, warm flavours of the region.

Per Se Aperitivo features a bright, warm orange colour reminiscent of iconic southern European sunsets. The aroma is complex yet balanced, led by intense notes of orange zest and cardamom, complemented by hints of Jamaican pepper and Portuguese hops. On the palate, the drink is light, sweet, and uncomplicated, offering a harmonious blend of citrus oils and delicate spicy undertones. It possesses a velvety mouthfeel and a 14.5% ABV, finishing with a smooth, lingering citric freshness and a measured, refreshing bitterness.

title: Bosio Passato Barbera D'Alba 2020
bodyHtml:
Bosio Family Estates, founded in 1967 and based in the heart of Piedmont, is a family-owned winery now under the stewardship of Luca Bosio. This dynamic winery honours traditional Piedmontese viticulture while embracing modern techniques to craft expressive and elegant wines. Their vineyards in the Langhe and Roero areas yield wines that reflect deep regional character and attention to detail.

Wine Description
This 100% Barbera presents a rich ruby red hue with garnet reflections. On the nose, it exudes intense aromas of black cherry, ripe plum, and violet, with hints of vanilla and mocha from subtle oak aging. The palate is velvety and concentrated, offering flavours of dark berries, licorice, and sweet spice, framed by supple tannins and refreshing acidity. Medium to full-bodied, the wine finishes long with balanced structure and a touch of minerality.

Food Pairing
Ideal with rich pasta dishes such as tagliatelle with wild boar ragù or mushroom risotto. It also pairs beautifully with grilled meats, aged cheeses, and rustic pizza with truffle oil. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Trivento Malbec - Cabernet Franc Golden Reserve 2023
bodyHtml:
This bold and expressive red wine hails from Argentina’s Mendoza region, specifically from the esteemed Luján de Cuyo subregion, known for its high-altitude vineyards and premium wine production. Trivento, a prominent winery owned by Chile's Concha y Toro group, was established in 1996 and has quickly gained international recognition for crafting wines that capture the essence of the Andes terroir. The name ‘Trivento’ refers to the three winds that influence the region’s climate—Polar, Zonda, and Sudestada—helping to shape the grapes’ distinctive character.

Wine Description
The 2023 Golden Reserve presents a deep, ruby-purple colour with vibrant clarity. On the nose, it delivers a compelling bouquet of ripe blackberries, cassis, and violets, layered with hints of cedar, tobacco, and dark chocolate. The palate is lush and full-bodied, with finely grained tannins and a silky texture that supports complex flavours of plum, blueberry compote, graphite, and sweet spices. The blend of Malbec and Cabernet Franc offers both rich fruit depth and herbal elegance.

Accolades
James Suckling – 93 points.
Tim Atkin – 92 points.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, wild mushroom risotto, or dry-aged ribeye steak. Aged cheeses such as manchego or aged cheddar also complement its structure. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Familia Conesa Finca La Sabina Cabernet Sauvignon Gran Reserva 2012
bodyHtml:
This exceptional Cabernet Sauvignon hails from Spain, specifically the Castilla–La Mancha region, near the village of El Bonillo in Albacete province. Familia Conesa is a family-run winery known for its commitment to ecological viticulture and traditional winemaking techniques. The Finca La Sabina estate sits at over 1,000 metres above sea level, offering a unique terroir that enhances the elegance and structure of their wines.

Wine Description
Deep garnet in colour with brick hues on the rim, this mature Gran Reserva opens with layered aromas of ripe blackcurrant, dried fig, cedar, and tobacco, underscored by leather and sweet spice. On the palate, it offers a full-bodied, silky texture with flavours of cassis, balsamic reduction, dark chocolate, and earthy undertones. The tannins are well-integrated and fine, contributing to a long, savoury finish.

Food Pairing
Pairs beautifully with roasted lamb, beef Wellington, or aged Manchego cheese. The wine’s richness and tertiary character also complement mushroom risotto and truffle-infused dishes.
Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Hakutsuru Yuzu Nigori - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hakutsuru Yuzu Nigori originates from Kobe, Japan, and is produced by the Hakutsuru Sake Brewing Company. Founded in 1743 in the Nada district, Hakutsuru is one of Japan's oldest and most renowned sake producers. This award-winning liqueur, which has earned Gold from the Monde Selection for several consecutive years, blends traditional unfiltered sake with the zesty, aromatic juice of the yuzu citrus fruit.

Product Description

This "Nigori" (cloudy) yuzushu presents a milky yellow appearance because it is roughly filtered, allowing fine fruit pulp to remain in the bottle for a richer texture. The sensory profile is defined by an intense, fresh citrus aroma reminiscent of lemon, lime, and mandarin orange. On the palate, it offers a creamy, velvety mouthfeel with a complex balance of natural sweetness, tangy acidity, and a subtle, pleasant bitterness from the yuzu peel. It is crafted with 100% Japanese-grown yuzu and contains no artificial flavours, colours, or acidulants. The alcohol content typically ranges between 9.5% and 10.5% ABV.

title: James Gin California Dreamgin'
bodyHtml:
Crafted in the United States, James Gin California Dreamgin’ hails from California, a region renowned for its innovation in both wine and spirits. This artisanal gin is the brainchild of actor and entrepreneur James May, co-host of The Grand Tour and Top Gear, whose passion for flavour experimentation has culminated in a gin that defies convention.

California Dreamgin’ is a vividly expressive, golden-hued gin that leans into bold citrus and exotic spice. On the nose, it bursts with notes of orange peel, mandarin zest, and fragrant cardamom, followed by a hint of earthy angelica root and warm cinnamon. The palate offers a lively interplay of sweet citrus and herbal spice, supported by a creamy mouthfeel and a soft peppery finish.

Food Pairing
California Dreamgin’ shines in creative cocktails, pairing beautifully with light seafood dishes such as grilled prawns with citrus glaze or sushi with yuzu soy. It also complements spicy Thai or Vietnamese cuisine, where its bright citrus and spice lift the flavours. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Starlight Chung Ha Sparkling Sake - 295 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Starlight Chung Ha Sparkling Sake is a modern Korean beverage originating from South Korea. Produced by Lotte Chilsung Beverage Co., it was launched as an innovative extension of the traditional 'Chungha' brand, which has been a staple of refined rice wine in Korea since 1986. The brand name 'Starlight' draws inspiration from the beverage's sparkling carbonation, which is intended to evoke the image of bright stars in a night sky.

Description

This unique sparkling sake is a blend of traditional Korean refined rice wine (cheongju) and white wine, specifically sourced from Spain. It presents a clear appearance with an effervescent character. The sensory profile features a delicate aroma of rice accented by subtle fruity undertones from the white wine. On the palate, it is lightly sweet, crisp, and refreshing, offering an approachable and fruity flavour profile that is less intense than typical sparkling sake. The body is light with a bubbly mouthfeel, leading to a clean, invigorating finish with a gentle lingering sweetness. This beverage is crafted using cold fermentation below 15°C and chilled filtration to remove bitterness and unpleasant odours. It has an ABV of 7%.

title: Chateau Barbebelle Cuvee Fleuris Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This rosé hails from France, specifically the picturesque hills of Provence in the Coteaux d’Aix-en-Provence appellation. Château Barbebelle is one of the oldest estates in the region, owned and operated by the Herbeau family for four generations. Their 300-hectare estate, with 45 hectares under vine, is dedicated to sustainable viticulture and elegant winemaking, reflecting a deep respect for Provençal terroir.

Wine Description
A luminous pale pink in the glass, the 2024 Cuvée Fleurie reveals an expressive bouquet of fresh strawberries, rose petals, and citrus zest. On the palate, it is bright and silky, delivering flavours of redcurrants, white peach, and a touch of grapefruit. The wine is medium-bodied with a fine balance between fresh acidity and a delicate minerality, culminating in a crisp, dry finish.

Food Pairing
Pair this elegant rosé with grilled shrimp skewers, Niçoise salad, or a goat cheese tart. It also complements Mediterranean mezze platters and lightly spiced Asian dishes. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: The Roost Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Organically farmed and masterfully crafted, Bonterra Organic Vineyards epitomizes wines that are perfectly in tune with nature. A celebration of farm-fresh flavors, the portfolio features wines coaxed from the earth by careful farming practices carried out on a dynamic network of estate and partner farms throughout California.

Bright and aromatic, this wine delivers fresh and nuanced complexity with a juicy fruit core. Aromas of lemon rind and honeysuckle open into tangerine and pineapple on the full, smooth palate, with subtle shades of magnolia and white tea. The excellent texture and viscosity is uplifted by fresh acidity.

96 Points - Tasting Panel

Saturating the palate with honeysuckle and juicy pear, this Burgundian-style California Chardonnay is one of the best we have tasted all year, embodying not only its vineyard but the character of Mendocino County. Lemon blossom adds to its floral essence with a brightness that sings. A touch of vanilla custard weaves its way toward a vivacious finish.

title: Vasse Felix Filius Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: A deep perfume with blackcurrant, blueberry and coffee mocha complexities. Notes of dusty earth and woody perennial herbs mingle with hints of nori, dried forest leaves and wild mushrooms to create an inviting aroma. A light fragrant entrance with blackcurrant, raspberry and pot pourri builds to earthy complexities and fine dry dusty tannins which serve to frame the fruit. A comfortable, soft, juicy body and tannin profile finishes the wine fresh and long.

title: Gerard Tremblay Chablis Premier Cru 'Montmain' 2023
bodyHtml:
The Chardonnay grapes for this surprisingly robust white wine hail from 40-year-old vines nestled in the esteemed 1er Cru ‘Montmain’ vineyard. A cleverly crafted blend, 30% of this wine gracefully matures in seasoned oak barrels, contributing to its luxurious and velvety character.

In the glass, it boasts a brilliant pale yellow hue with hints of vibrant green. The aromatic profile reveals delicate acacia flower notes, ripe yellow nectarine, and zesty green citrus fruits. On the palate, it offers a round and creamy texture enriched with honeyed undertones that gracefully lead to a lively yet enduring finish.

title: Pepperjack Barossa Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: Pepperjack Barossa Cabernet Sauvignon is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon parcels, sourced from premium vineyards throughout the Barossa. Pepperjack Cabernet Sauvignon offers bright red and blue berry fruit flavours and fine talky tannins. A rich, plush and concentrated wine with distinct varietal leafy notes and fine, textural tannins.

title: Blade and Bow Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
A homage to the legendary Stitzel-Weller distillery, Blade and Bow Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey uses a unique Solera System aging process to preserve some of the distillery’s oldest whiskey stocks, including some of the last bourbon produced there before it closed in 1992. 

The solera liquid is mingled with other fine whiskies aged and bottled at Stitzel-Weller. Aged in new charred American white oak barrels, this bourbon has a subtle aroma of fresh fruit and a taste that includes hints of dried apricot, ripe pear and a sweet roasted grain. The finish has notes of charred oak and warm winter spices.

title: Kanonkop Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
bodyHtml:
South Africa’s Kanonkop Estate is located in the prestigious Stellenbosch region within the Western Cape. A family-owned winery since 1973, Kanonkop has become synonymous with high-quality, age-worthy red wines. Under the guidance of winemaker Abrie Beeslaar, the estate is renowned for its traditional winemaking practices and deep-rooted commitment to expressing the character of its terroir.

Food Pairing
Pair this Cabernet Sauvignon with herb-crusted lamb, prime rib roast, or aged cheddar. Its structured tannins and rich fruit profile also make it a superb match for grilled portobello mushrooms or venison stew. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Whistlepig Piggyback Bourbon
bodyHtml:
PiggyBack 100 Proof Bourbon gives a bold approach to whiskey a sweeter spin.

Born from their signature grain’s other half, it starts with a high Corn mash bill (keeping a dash of Rye of course). Six long years of age in Char #3 barrels adds layers of flavor before bottling at 100 Proof.

Sip it neat or shake it in a classic. With its sweeter profile, PiggyBack 100 Proof Bourbon shines in citrus and sour drinks.

Nose: Caramel corn partnered with oak notes.

Palate: Maple and vanilla with a creamy mouth feel.

Finish: Herbal tea with a hint of honey.

title: 1800 Cristalino Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
1800 Cristalino Añejo Tequila is a luxury, crystal-clear aged spirit produced in Jalisco, Mexico. The 1800 brand name honors the historical year tequila was first successfully aged in wood barrels, and the line is produced under the stewardship of Casa Cuervo at the historic Ex-Hacienda Los Camichines distillery (NOM 1122). First introduced to capitalize on the rapidly growing ultra-premium Cristalino category, this expression blends the barrel-aged depth of an Añejo with the brilliant, clear appearance and crisp drinkability of a Blanco.

Spirit Description

1800 Cristalino is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave harvested at peak maturity. The agaves are slow-cooked in traditional masonry brick ovens, extracted using roller mills, and double-distilled in copper pot stills. The spirit undergoes a dual-barrel aging process, maturing for 16 months in a combination of new American and French oak barrels, followed by a 6-month finish in Port wine casks. After aging, the deep amber tequila goes through a proprietary charcoal filtration process that strips out the color while retaining the complex wood-derived flavors and silky mouthfeel.

  • Colour: Perfectly crystal clear, bright, and transparent.

  • Aroma: Rich and inviting, dominated by sweet vanilla, caramel, milk chocolate, and honeyed agave, complemented by subtle hints of red fruit, toasted oak, and delicate baking spices.

  • Palate: Velvety, soft, and approachable on the entry. Upfront flavors of butterscotch, vanilla bean, and sweet cooked agave blend into roasted nuts, dark chocolate, and a faint hint of berry sweetness from the Port cask finish.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a round, smooth, and lush mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Crisp, clean, and refreshing, with lingering notes of sweet vanilla, soft oak, and mild black pepper warmth.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof) in a signature trapezoidal bottle featuring a distinct diamond-cut glass pattern representing the filtration process.

title: Chateau de la Chapelle Blaye 2020
bodyHtml:
Chateau de la Chapelle Blaye 2020 originates from France, within the Blaye Cotes de Bordeaux subregion of the larger Bordeaux region. The estate is situated on the slopes above the village of Plassac and has been owned by the Lorteaud family since 1960. The winery maintains approximately 20 hectares of vineyards and follows a philosophy of creating fruity and supple wines that respect the authentic spirit and character of the local terroir.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a beautiful ruby garnet colour in the glass. The sensory profile features an intense and spicy nose with sweet aromas of dark plum, chocolate, and subtle floral hints such as violet and rose. On the medium bodied palate, it is warm, deep, and generous, offering flavours of blackcurrant, blackberry, and cherry with touches of earth, smoke, and pencil shavings. The structure is defined by firm yet coated tannins and a refreshing acidity that leads to a clean, persistent finish. The varietal composition for the 2020 vintage is 85% Merlot and 15% Cabernet Sauvignon. It has an alcohol content of 13% or 14% depending on the bottling and is aged in stainless steel to preserve fruit purity.

Food Pairing

The supple fruit and traditional structure of this Bordeaux blend make it well suited for a variety of meat centric dishes. Suggested pairings include lamb chops, roast beef, pork cutlets, and shepherd's pie. It also complements beef tartare, truffle tagliatelle, beef stew, and nutty or aged cheeses.

title: Chateau Giscours 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
97 Points - James Suckling

Walnut and cocoa powder. Crushed stones, too. It’s full and layered with round tannins and a juicy and plush texture. Crushed velvet that turns to silk. Very cool and long. Plenty going on here. Give it three to four years to come together. But will age beautifully for years to come. A blend of 65% cabernet sauvignon and 35% merlot. 

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Giscours has turned out very well in bottle, wafting from the glass with aromas of sweet berries, cherries, burning embers, lilac and violets framed by a discreet patina of new oak. Full-bodied, layered and concentrated, it's polished and perfumed, with a velvety, seamless profile and bright animating acids, concluding with a long, resonant finish. Alexandre Van Beek and his team are taking this estate to heights it hasn't hit since the 1970s, and this is another of the great bargains of the 2019 en primeur campaign. 

94+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Checking in as a blend of 65% Cabernet Sauvignon and 35% Merlot, the 2019 Chateau Giscours is one heck of an impressive Margaux. Deep purple-hued, with a great nose of both black and blue fruits as well as sappy herbs, tobacco, and flowers, it has nicely integrated oak, medium to full body, ripe yet certainly present tannins, and a great finish. It's beautifully done. Hide bottles for 4-6 years and enjoy over the following two decades or so.  

94 Points - Decanter

This is a serious Giscours, with medium intensity violet-edged ruby colour. High aromatics on the nose with cumin and cloves, followed by black cherry and cassis fruits that do a good job of filling the palate, and a cooling menthol finish as the tannins close in. Enjoyable overall, succulent yet with precision. Harvest lasted for an entire month, from September 11 to October 12, the longest ever at the estate and a reflection of more precise plot-by-plot work, with vines separated according to age and terroir.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Really solid for the vintage, with a fresh edge to the mix of black currant, blackberry and fig paste flavors. This wine's energy extends through the finish, where humus, singed cedar, savory and iron-tinged minerality add range and cut. Still shows the vintage's excessive heat, but this manages it better than most of its peers. Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot.

title: Livio Felluga Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Livio Felluga Chardonnay is a single-variety Chardonnay white wine produced by the Livio Felluga winery, in the DOC Friuli Colli Orientali in Friuli-Venezia Giulia, Italy.

Livio Felluga Chardonnay is made with manually harvested clusters from vineyards with loam and sandstone soils. The grapes are gently destemmed when they reach the winery to then undergo a short maceration. They are gently pressed and the must is clarified by decantation. Then fermentation takes place in stainless steel tanks and under controlled temperatures.

The Livio Felluga winery has a long history of love and passion for Friuli. Livio Felluga returned to this area, which had been abandoned after World War II, and managed to revive viticulture. He is now considered to be the father of Friuli viticulture and his wines are among the best in Italy.

Pairs well with risottos, white fish, rice dishes, or as an aperitif.

title: Brother's Bond Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Crafting an exceptional taste profile took time and patience. After the long process of blending and tasting an ample assortment of mash bills, we are proudly presenting to the world a bourbon that will captivate palates with its harmonious balance of complex flavors.

From American farms come classic four grains – corn, rye, wheat, and barley.

With every sip you discover rich and complex flavors. Each batch is personally held up to a gold standard, ensuring that every experience you have with Brother's Bond Bourbon will be unforgettable.

title: Zuccardi Malbec Concreto 2024
bodyHtml:
Zuccardi Malbec Concreto showcases the essence of high-altitude Malbec from the Uco Valley, specifically Paraje Altamira. This wine reflects Zuccardi’s commitment to purity, with grapes fermented and aged in concrete containers, preserving the natural characteristics without oak influence.

Colour: Deep, vibrant red with purple hues.
Aroma: Aromas of wild plum, black cherry, and violets, with hints of crushed stones and subtle tobacco.
Palate: Juicy and fresh, offering flavors of mulberry, blueberry, and red berries, accented by a chalky texture and spicy finish.
Body: Full-bodied with firm tannins and a balanced structure.
Finish: Long, savory, with refreshing minerality.

title: Tyrconnell Single Malt Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml: Aromas of roasted nuts, nougat, and mild oak precede a palate that is honeyed and rich in texture. The finish brings forth the malt component, allowing a keen graininess to move to the forefront. Drink neat, or on the rocks. Also, adding a reasonable amount of water to the whiskey is an option, as it will allow the nuances and complexity of the whiskey to more clearly present themselves.

title: Angel's Envy Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
When other bourbons stop, Angel's Envy finishes!

There's bourbon and divine inspiration painstakingly crafted into a sublime spirit you'll want to share with the world. They make the second one. ANGEL'S ENVY is what happens when 200 years of bourbon tradition meet an independent master craftsman's instinct to improve. It's a total return to the art of craft-first, hand-blended batches of 8 to 12 barrels at a time.

They taste every barrel throughout each aging process to ensure that the spirits meet their perfectionist standards. This would be enough for any other premium bourbon, but they think you deserve more. That's why they finish every one of their whiskeys in hand-selected finishing barrels. For an added layer of flavour and complexity, their bourbon and special cask strength are finished in ruby port casks, and their rye is finished in rum barrels. There's no set time for this process.

Angel's Envy is their masterpiece inspired by Master Distiller Lincoln Henderson's lifetime crafting fine spirits. Pours a deep amber with aromas and flavours of almond, honey, apple, cinnamon, and blueberry compote. It's full-bodied and elegantly smooth with a long-lasting finish. Savour solo after a meal.

title: Redwood Empire Pipe Dream Bourbon
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Pipe Dream Bourbon Whiskey is named after the 14th largest tree on the planet. As the first bourbon whiskey from Redwood Empire Distillery, Pipe Dream sits at 90 proof and is a blend of barrels aged between 4 and 12 years. It is made from a high corn mash bill.

Colour... Yellow gold.

Nose... The nose is relatively sweet. It starts with notes of candied orange and transitions into cherry syrup. Corn is very noticeable, but not in a way that typically denotes a young bourbon. There is a musty funk, likely from the older barrels. It has a lovely, thick nose.

Palate... The palate is medium-thick. Sweet corn is present throughout the palate. Next up are notes of orange marmalade sticking to the mid-palate well. This then transitions to that nice cherry syrup flavour on the back palate. Some darker, almost grape-like flavours on the front of the palate disappear after the whiskey is swallowed. This is a lovely palate for a lower-proof bourbon!

Finish... The finish is medium and begins with orange marmalade notes on the mid-palate. These transition to oak spice and bread notes that eventually coat the entire palate, including the roof of the mouth. The finish is much longer than one would expect and is fairly viscous.

In Closing... Wow, that is very impressive. The blending of the older barrels into the batched elevated this whiskey to the next level. The depth of flavours was exceptional and did not leave anything to be desired. This is one of the best 90-proof whiskies that you can buy for the price.

title: Black Tot Rum
bodyHtml:
On the 31st of July 1970, a 300-year-old Royal Naval tradition ended at precisely 6 bells in the forenoon watch, when the last rum ration was issued aboard ships of the British Royal Navy; a day to be forever remembered as Black Tot Day.

Forty years on, in 2010, as a mark of respect to this wonderful tradition, Elixir Distillers launched Black Tot Last Consignment a blend of rum made up of the very last remaining stocks of Royal Navy rum that had been discovered in naval warehouses in Dartmouth and Deptford. This historic rum had sat dormant for over 30 years, only seeing the light of day on state occasions and Royal weddings.

In 2019 Elixir Distillers launched a new, accessible rum that pays homage to the history of naval rum whilst turning the style on its head. Black Tot rum is a blend of some of the finest spirits from Barbados, Guyana and Jamaica, creating a modern,  versatile and multi-layered rum that appeals to rum and whisky lovers across all seas.

title: Basil Hayden's 10 Year Old Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Basil Hayden's 10 Year Old Bourbon is a premium expression from the Basil Hayden's lineup, known for its high-rye mash bill and approachable flavor profile. Introduced in December 2018 as a limited annual release, this bourbon has garnered attention for its extended aging and refined character.

Mash Bill:

  • Corn: 63%

  • Rye: 27%

  • Malted Barley: 10%

Tasting Notes:

  • Appearance: Dark amber.

  • Nose: Aromas of oak, cocoa, toffee, baking spices, vanilla powder, dried fruit, hazelnuts, with subtle hints of citrus and s'mores.

  • Palate: Flavors of oak, toffee, leather, roasted nuts, cocoa, vanilla powder, dried dark fruit, graham cracker, baking spices, complemented by notes of orange peel and a slight yeastiness.

  • Finish: Medium length with lingering notes of oak, dried fruit, yeast, nuts, and a touch of baking spice, concluding with a biscuity aftertaste.

Alcohol Content:

  • Bottled at 40% ABV (80 proof).

Serving Suggestions:

  • Neat: Enjoying it straight allows the intricate flavors to shine.

  • On the Rocks: Serving over ice can mellow the rye spice and enhance the caramel sweetness.

  • Cocktails: Suitable for classic bourbon cocktails like the Old Fashioned or Manhattan, where its balanced profile can complement other ingredients.

title: Legent Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Legent Bourbon is a collaboration between the two halves of Beam Suntory. It's a Kentucky bourbon, made by Jim Beam master distiller Fred Noe, that includes three components. The first is the bourbon itself, matured for approximately five years, along with parcels finished in California red wine casks (for approximately one extra year) and sherry casks (for approximately two extra years). The whiskeys were blended by Suntory chief blender Shinji Fukuyo. The first new standalone bourbon brand to come from the company in 27 years, Legent debuted March 2019 as a permanent member of the portfolio.

See More USA Whisky

title: Old Overholt Straight Rye Whiskey Aged 4 Years
bodyHtml: Old Overholt is an appropriately old brand of rye whiskey and one half of "The Olds", alongside Bad Santa's favourite, Old Grand-Dad. It's a classic straight rye produced by Jim Beam.

title: Vecchio Amaro Del Capo
bodyHtml: Vecchio Amaro Del Capo, crafted in the Calabria region of Italy, is a renowned and authentic amaro. Made with a secret recipe passed down through generations, this liqueur embodies the essence of Italian tradition and craftsmanship. Its flavour profile offers a harmonious blend of herbs, roots, and botanicals, resulting in a complex and bittersweet taste. Critics praise Vecchio Amaro Del Capo for its exceptional quality, often describing it as a well-balanced and invigorating digestif. With its distinctive flavour and smooth finish, it is enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or used as a key ingredient in cocktails. Vecchio Amaro Del Capo is a cherished choice for those seeking a taste of Italian indulgence.

title: Fournier Pouilly Fume Les Deux Cailloux 2024
bodyHtml:
The Fournier family estate has grown from five hectares in 1950 to 60 hectares today, divided over the appellations of Menetou Salon, Sancerre and Pouilly Fume. The family have recently completed building a brand new winery, whose design, equipment and impeccable hygiene rank as amongst the finest in France.

Wine Description

A hint of ripe oranges on the nose leading to creamy and zesty flavours on the palate. Serve chilled. Perfect on its own or with light seafood dishes.

title: Grand Mayan Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Grand Mayan's handcrafted Reposado Tequila is produced with the purest, central-highland Blue Agave with the highest standards of production.

Aged in American and French oak casks for 6-8 months, Grand Mayan Reposado Tequila is smooth for sipping with notes of oak and chocolate. Grand Mayan Reposado is full on the palate and leads into a layered and delicious long finish.

Each unique cermanic decanter is hand crafted, individually numbered and hand painted with real gold by local Mexican artists in Mexico City, making each bottle a piece of artwork, but it's what's inside that is truly a masterpiece.

title: Old Forester Kentucky Straight Bourbon - 750 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Old Forester Bourbon was the first to be sold in America in sealed glass bottles to avoid unsavoury folks tampering with their carefully-considered recipe. It was first seen on shelves in 1870, and the rye-rich bourbon continues to be enjoyed today.

Overall: Bourbon doesn't get made for over 140 years without it being pretty great, so it's unsurprising that Old Forester is, well, pretty darn great!

Finish: Juicy orange and spicy oak continue on the finish.

Palate: Starts quite sweet with caramel and maple syrup, though swiftly develops intense oaky elements and hints of pine resin. Sweetness returns slightly on the mid-palate.

Nose: Top notes of orange blossom and cedar. Soon, the classic rye bread warmth and a lingering waft of buttered pancakes are developed.

title: Clos Bellane Cotes du Rhone Villages Valreas 2024
bodyHtml: The color is purple with intense and dark purplish reflections, betraying an exceptional maturity. The nose evokes graphite, menthol blackcurrant, green pepper with a terroir touch evolving in the altidude garrigue, olives, camphor, undergrowth. In the mouth, the velvety tannins are carried by the freshness of the terroir and give an additional dimension. The structure is present, but the trajectory on the palate is harmoniously striking, ending on a finely distinguished spicy fruity note.

title: Alma Negra 'M' Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
This captivating wine hails from Argentina, specifically the Mendoza region, known globally for its exceptional high-altitude vineyards. Produced by the celebrated Ernesto Catena Vineyards, Alma Negra (‘Black Soul’) is a project by Ernesto Catena, son of Nicolás Catena, one of Argentina’s most influential wine figures. The winery embraces a philosophy that combines organic and biodynamic practices with a profound respect for the terroir, crafting wines that are expressive and mysterious.

Wine Description

Alma Negra ‘M’ Red Blend reveals a deep, inky purple hue. On the nose, it delivers alluring aromas of ripe blackberries, plums, and cassis intertwined with hints of violet, dark chocolate, and subtle sweet spices. The palate is plush and generous, showcasing layers of juicy black fruits complemented by earthy undertones and a touch of pepper. Medium to full-bodied, the wine is beautifully balanced by fresh acidity and velvety tannins, leading to a long, elegant finish with lingering notes of mocha and black cherry.

Food Pairing

This robust yet refined blend pairs wonderfully with grilled lamb chops, beef short ribs, or a wild mushroom risotto. Its dark fruit and savoury spice interplay beautifully with rich, flavourful dishes, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Little Book Chapter 8 Cask Strength
bodyHtml:
Knowing that rye has roots extending to the beginning of American Whiskey and holds more than two centuries of heritage, you could say, “it’s been done.” But with this chapter, “Path Not Taken,” we explore the future of American Rye by blending a unique range of rye whiskies together and show you that rye still has plenty of stories left to tell.

“Path Not Taken” is about reimagining the variety that rye grain has to offer and pushing the limits of what it can be. We look across America’s oldest whiskey frontier from a new vantage point and create a complex, redefined and differentiated profile by blending ryes of different age, char and mash bill.

The story of rye has been told countless ways. But never like this.

title: Hamilton Russell Vineyards Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml: Bright, vibrant natural acidity and a marked dry minerality combine with structural length and complexity in this elegant, classically styled wine.

title: Grace O'Malley Irish Pirate Queen Gin
bodyHtml:
The Grace O'Malley Heather Infused Irish Gin, named after the legendary 16th-century pirate queen, features a unique blend of 14 botanicals native to the wild coast of Ireland. Key botanicals include heather, wild thyme, red clover, blackthorn, bilberry, and rock samphire, giving the gin a fresh, herbaceous, and slightly coastal character.

Colour: Crystal clear.
Aroma: Intense herbal notes with a fresh juniper base, complemented by aromatic dried heather and a touch of salinity.
Palate: Fresh and vibrant, with grassy vegetal undertones and lively citrus hints. Maritime undertones add depth, reflecting the gin's coastal inspiration.
Finish: Rounded and well-balanced, with a floral and slightly briny aftertaste.

This gin, with an ABV of 43%, is versatile for both sipping and mixing. It pairs beautifully with tonic, served over ice, and garnished with herbs and a slice of pink grapefruit. Winner of a gold medal at the 2021 San Francisco World Spirits Competition, it is recognized for its balance and complexity.

title: Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength - Batch 17
bodyHtml:
Powerful, uncompromising and more than a little special. Laphroaig Batch 17 offers a truly natural experience that preserves the bold and rich soul of Islay peat like no other.

Laphroaig Batch 17 rewards those who yearn to explore. Our Original Cask Strength is barrier-filtered to remove char particles and maintain purity, unleashing a rich character that’s true to the wind-lashed island from where it came: what you pour is what we draw from the barrel.

Our signature notes run wild alongside a soothing sweetness: stewed apple, vanilla cream and pears in syrup, followed by the familiar lappings of sea salt, herbal smoke, crisp seaweed and cooling menthol. Enjoy it neat or with water, for a gentle haze of glowing gold.

title: Chateau Cos d'Estournel Blanc 2022
bodyHtml:
Chateau Cos d’Estournel is an iconic Bordeaux estate located in Saint Estèphe, part of the prestigious Médoc region. Founded in 1811 by Louis-Gaspard d’Estournel, the property is now under the ownership of Michel Reybier, who continues its legacy of meticulous winemaking and innovation. Known for its exotic architecture and bold approach, Cos d’Estournel exemplifies the union of heritage and modern precision.

This 2022 vintage of Cos d’Estournel Blanc is a stunning expression of Bordeaux Blanc, offering brilliant clarity and pale gold hues. On the nose, it bursts with vibrant aromas of white peach, grapefruit zest, lime blossom, and subtle flinty minerality. The palate is layered and energetic, featuring notes of citrus, green apple, crushed stone, and a touch of salinity, all woven into a medium-bodied frame with precise acidity.

Accolades

97 Points - James Suckling: Pretty and rich white peach, pear and apple aromas and flavors. Full-bodied with plenty of fruit and bright acidity. Chalky and stony. Happy to watch.Barrel Sample: 96-97

96 Points - Decanter: Green apple, grass, soft floral touches, some orange zest and fresh pineapple. Electric and thrilling, this is sharp, agile, sweet, tangy and salty - a gorgeous combination of fresh citrus fruits and peach flesh with flint and wet stone edges. Lovely direction and focus and still such depth on the mid palate which some are lacking. Has appealing orange, lemon, peach, pear, apple fruit, juicy friendliness and yet this has persistence from start to finish that is so captivating and electric. Round, deep, sensual, rich and opulent but not heavy, retains its firm structure but with a delicious lemony sugary brightness that just lifts the palate and keeps the attention. A brilliant white wine, just so enjoyable from the moment it touches the palate, widening, expanding, deepening and delighting.
Barrel Sample: 96

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck: The Grand Vin 2022 Château Cos D'Estournel Blanc is similarly light gold-hued and is based on 74% Sauvignon Blanc and 26% Semillon. Lots of pear, white flowers, crushed citrus, and subtle salty nuances all shine here, and it's medium to full-bodied, rich, and layered, with a great finish. It's cut from the same cloth as the Pagodes yet brings a touch more precision, vibrancy, and length.

Food Pairing
Perfect alongside grilled sea bass with lemon and herbs, shrimp risotto, or a fresh goat cheese tart. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Chateau Chasse Spleen Blanc 2022
bodyHtml:
Château Chasse Spleen is a historic and well-regarded estate located in the Moulis-en-Médoc appellation of Bordeaux, France. Though better known for its red wines, the estate also crafts a limited production white Bordeaux of exceptional quality. The winery’s name—evoking the poetic idea of chasing away melancholy—speaks to its commitment to elegance, inspiration, and tradition. It has been managed by the Merlaut family since 2000, with a focus on expressive terroir and precise viticulture.

A rare white from the Médoc, the 2022 vintage of Chasse Spleen Blanc is composed predominantly of Sauvignon Blanc, complemented by a smaller proportion of Sémillon. It displays a luminous pale gold hue with green reflections. On the nose, it opens with vibrant citrus notes—lemon zest and pink grapefruit—followed by white peach, elderflower, and a subtle mineral edge. The palate is fresh and zesty, with a medium body and vivid acidity that carries flavours of lime, gooseberry, and a touch of salinity.

Food Pairing
Ideal alongside fresh goat cheese, grilled prawns, or a citrus-dressed fennel salad. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Alberta Premium Cask Strength 5th Release
bodyHtml:
Alberta Distillers Ltd, makers of the No. 1 selling 100% rye whisky in the world, Alberta Premium, is proud to announce the return of its highly coveted Alberta Premium Cask Strength Rye. 

Crafted and distilled in Calgary, Alberta, Alberta Premium Cask Strength Rye is made from 100% Canadian Prairie rye grains grown by local farmers and distilled with nutrient-dense, glacier fed spring water from the surrounding Rocky Mountains. The liquid is 100% pot distilled and aged in new white oak barrels. The resulting liquid is balanced with unique flavor nuances, including smooth vanilla, black currant, and spice.

title: Schladerer Williams - Birne (Pear) - 350 ml
bodyHtml:
Schladerer Williams Birne is a German pear brandy, crafted by Schladerer distillery in the Black Forest region. This eau de vie is renowned for its pure expression of ripe Williams pears, offering a refined and aromatic experience.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Crystal clear, showcasing its purity.

  • Aroma: Opens with intense aromas of ripe Williams pears, complemented by subtle hints of spice and a touch of vanilla.

  • Palate: Smooth and elegant, the palate is enveloped by the natural sweetness of pears, with a clean and crisp finish.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Serve chilled, around 10-12°C (50-54°F), to fully appreciate its aromatic complexity.

  • Glassware: Use a tulip-shaped glass to concentrate the aromas.

  • Food Pairings: Pairs excellently with fresh fruit desserts, soft cheeses, or enjoyed as a digestif.

title: Antano Crianza 2018
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Spain’s renowned Rioja region, Antano Crianza 2018 is a testament to the legacy of Bodegas Antaño, produced by Grupo Garvey. This historic winery emphasizes traditional methods combined with modern techniques, ensuring consistent quality and authenticity. Nestled in the Rioja Alta subregion, the vineyard benefits from an ideal microclimate for cultivating Tempranillo.

Wine Description
Deep ruby red in the glass, this Crianza opens with aromas of ripe red cherries, vanilla, and a touch of toasted oak. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and well-balanced, offering flavours of plum, spice, and a hint of leather. The tannins are firm yet refined, contributing to a structured mouthfeel and a lingering, elegant finish.

Food Pairing
Pair Antano Crianza 2018 with grilled lamb chops, chorizo stew, or manchego cheese. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Ruffino Prosecco
bodyHtml: An ideal partner for savoury appetizers this sparkling wine has lifted aromas fresh bread, quince, Asian pear and cantaloupe. On the palate, quince, pear, melon and honey flavours carry through to a fresh finish.

title: Mionetto Prosecco Brut - 200 ml Bottle
bodyHtml: This award-winning Prosecco offers vivid fruit character and persistent effervescence. On the palate the notes of Asian pear, honey and lees give way to a creamy mouthfeel with pleasant stonefruit, chocolate and mineral hints. Serve well chilled with a selection of cured meat, cheese, and crisps.

title: Lav Lager Beer 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
The success of LAV is a result of the more than 100 years of experience in brewing in Celarevo, in which the brewery has continuously invested in new technologies to brew the best quality products.

LAV is a full-bodied pale lager with a fruity aroma and well-balanced bitterness. LAV has a beautiful golden colour, a dense and a distinctive malty taste.

title: Girlan Pinot Bianco 2024
bodyHtml:
At Cornaiano, on the hills of the Oltradige, at a height between 450-500m, ventilation is optimal for Pinot Bianco, which is widely used here. Vinification and aging in stainless steel, where it also partly performs malolactic fermentation. The yield per hectare of 70 hl collects the minerality of the soil well.

Delicate aroma that expresses itself on subtle notes of apple blossom, lively flavor and good structure to open as an aperitif and also excellent to accompany fish or white meat dishes.

title: Nervi Conterno Gattinara
bodyHtml:
Nervi Conterno Gattinara 2022 originates from Italy, produced in the Gattinara DOCG within the subregion of Alto Piemonte. Founded in 1906, Nervi is the oldest winery in the Gattinara appellation and boasts exceptional holdings across volcanic, mineral-rich soils. In 2018, the estate was acquired by Roberto Conterno of the iconic Giacomo Conterno Barolo estate, who introduced his traditional winemaking philosophy—combining long maceration and extended aging in large oak casks to express the pure character of Alto Piemonte.

Wine Description

In the glass, this red wine presents a pale ruby colour with delicate red-orange highlights near the rim. The nose is aromatic and complex, revealing notes of fresh cherry, wild strawberry, Parma violet, orange peel, and sweet spices blended with underlying hints of tobacco, white pepper, and wet stone. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied with tense, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant, salty acidity. Flavours of crushed red fruit, blood orange, and subtle dried herbs lead to a long, polished finish with lingering notes of liquorice and subtle smoke. Crafted from 100% Nebbiolo (locally known as Spanna) and aged for 36 months in large oak barrels, this wine exhibits extraordinary freshness, balance, and fine-cut elegance, offering an optimal drinking window from 2026 through 2038.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 96 points.

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 94 points.

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points.

  • Vinous - 93 points.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and structured tannins of this Nebbiolo make it a superb accompaniment to braised beef short ribs, roasted veal loin, and wild game like venison. It also aligns effortlessly with baked pasta dishes, rich mushroom risotto, or aged Italian cheeses such as Parmigiano-Reggiano and Pecorino.

title: Angels & Cowboys Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Displays a bouquet of summer orchard fruit ranging from tangerine to peach accented by aromatic floral notes of violet and rose petal. 

On the palate the racy acidity delivers a focused savory herb element and minerality, along with delicate watermelon, raspberry, and Rainier Cherry fruit. Fresh and quaffable, this Rosé possesses a thirst-quenching fruitiness and dry finish that call for pairing with charcuterie platters, oysters, or a simple bowl of fresh strawberries.

title: Henschke Henry's Seven 2024
bodyHtml:
Henschke is one of Australia’s most celebrated family-owned wineries, established in 1868 and now under the stewardship of fifth-generation winemaker Stephen Henschke and viticulturist Prue Henschke. The estate has built a global reputation for its commitment to sustainability and biodynamic viticulture, crafting wines that reflect the character of the Eden and Barossa Valleys. Henry's Seven is named in honour of winemaker Henry Evans, a pioneer of viticulture in South Australia.

Wine Description
This 2023 vintage offers a vibrant ruby hue with a perfumed bouquet of redcurrants, plums, violets, and five-spice. On the palate, it reveals juicy red and black berries, layers of peppery spice, and subtle herbal notes, supported by fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity. Medium-bodied with a silky texture, the wine finishes with elegance and persistence.

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled lamb chops, rosemary roasted vegetables, or duck breast with cherry sauce. The wine’s brightness and spice complement savoury and lightly sweet dishes alike. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Paul Zinck Gewurztraminer Eichberg Grand Cru 2019
bodyHtml:
From the Alsace region in northeastern France, the Paul Zinck winery is a family-owned estate located in Eguisheim, a village renowned for its viticultural heritage. Now led by Philippe Zinck, the estate has built its reputation on sustainable vineyard practices and a commitment to expressing terroir through precise, elegant wines. The Grand Cru Eichberg vineyard, with its south-facing limestone-clay slopes, is celebrated for producing intensely aromatic and age-worthy whites.

Wine Description
This 2019 Gewurztraminer presents a golden straw hue with luminous clarity. On the nose, it exudes rich and exotic aromas of lychee, rose petal, candied ginger, and ripe mango. The palate is opulent yet balanced, with flavours of spiced pear, orange blossom, and honeyed citrus layered atop a vibrant mineral backbone. Medium to full-bodied, the wine unfolds with a lush texture and finishes long with a touch of sweet spice and freshness.

Accolades
Vinous - 93 points.
Wine Enthusiast - 92 points.

Food Pairing
Pair this expressive Gewurztraminer with dishes such as Thai green curry, foie gras with fig compote, or blue cheese tart. Its aromatic richness and touch of sweetness also make it a standout with Indian butter chicken or Moroccan tagines. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Jacob's Creek Shiraz 2024
bodyHtml:
Spicy red berry with subtle mocha and vanilla oak influence. Soft red berry and rich plum with a spicy cedar finish. This wine is a great example of the approachable style of Jacob’s Creek Classic wines.

Enjoy on its own or with roast leg of lamb or hard cheeses such as Cheddar.

title: Ruffino Chianti 2024
bodyHtml: Ruffino's original wine, and one of the world's most recognized Tuscan wines. The wine is extra dry, medium-bodied and well-structured. Enjoy aromas and flavours of chestnut, leather, rye bread and red berry fruit, with spicy notes and a touch of pepper. Serve with wild boar ragu, grilled steak or roasted vegetables.

title: Sons of Sugarland Syrah 2024
bodyHtml:
One grape...one clone...one vineyard...one immensely explosive Syrah that is truly a Syrah for Syrah lovers. The SH99 Syrah clone from the ‘Karibib Vineyard’ in the Polkadraai Hills in addition to a bit of sulfur is all that makes up this sublime wine. Reenen shares the 11 rows of Syrah with Lukas Van Loggerenberg (for his ‘Graft’ Syrah), Sam Lambson’s Minimalist Wines, as well as Jean Smit’s Damascene wines. This is the highest parcel of this ocean-facing vineyard that gets rammed by the cool breezes. Reenen’s goal with this wine is to make it as raw as possible but still with a pretty side. In a very short time this has risen to Syrah royalty in South Africa alongside Reenen’s ‘Epilogue’.

The fruit was hand-harvested in one morning and brought back to the winery where the fruit was placed into a concrete fermenter. Fermentation kicked off naturally with the juice on the skins and stems, and continued for 10 days. The lot was pressed to a 15hL concrete egg with gross lees intact and left to age for 10 months. It was bottled without fining or filtration and just a small addition of sulfur.

This wine is hauntingly good. It smells like freshly cracked black pepper and violet, layered over red and black berries. Poise, finesse, and measured power weave through the palate. Spectacular.

title: Barossa Valley Estate Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml: Shiraz is quite the celebrity. The Barossa Valley was created and is still home to the greatest Shiraz in the world. With alluring exotic spice and vibrant fruit flavours of red plum and fresh blackberry, Barossa Valley Estate Shiraz captures us with its striking presence, and bold but elegant style, leaving an indelible impression. Pairs perfectly with steak, lamb, beef, game, béarnaise, and peppercorn sauces.

title: Roberto Voerzio Barolo Torriglione 2011 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Roberto Voerzio roots himself in the vineyards of Piemonte. Working beside both his father and grandfather, the beauty of La Morra inspired Roberto to pioneer for new pastures. Since age 20, the was aware of the prestige that came with his region, as well as the untapped potential unforeseen with La Morra and greater Langhe.

Now a living legend of Piemonte, Roberto founded his philosophy on 3 pillars: Prime Location, Natural Farming, and the Unique maintenance of vineyards -low yields, extreme selection (green harvest) with high density plantation. He strives for a wine that only finds perfection in its rarity.

“One of the central tenets of the Voerzio approach,” says Antonio Galloni, “is a steadfast belief that the relationship between low yields and high quality is always linear.”

Aromas of smoke, black cherries, southern herbs, red roses, licorice. Full-bodied yet suave; impeccable. Pair with grilled steak or roasted fowl; risotto with truffles; well-aged Italian sheep’s cheese.

title: Bouchard Pere & Fils Beaune du Chateau Premier Cru Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
Bouchard Père & Fils, established in 1731, is one of Burgundy’s oldest wine estates, now owned by the Henriot family. With centuries of expertise and access to exceptional terroirs, the house is celebrated for its meticulous viticulture and elegant expressions of Pinot Noir. The Beaune du Château cuvée is unique to the estate, blending grapes from several Premier Cru vineyards exclusively owned by Bouchard.

Wine Description
This Premier Cru Pinot Noir displays a radiant ruby colour. On the nose, it offers lifted aromas of red cherry, raspberry, and subtle violet, interwoven with hints of spice and forest floor. The palate is refined and harmonious, delivering flavours of juicy red berries, fine tannins, and a whisper of oak. Medium-bodied with a persistent, silky finish, the wine shows both elegance and structure.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with herb-crusted lamb chops, wild mushroom risotto, or roast duck with cherry glaze. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Flora Organic Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
This wine displays an intense ruby red colour. The nose presents notes of ripe red fruits, such as strawberries and raspberries, along with spices like black pepper and white pepper, and slight hints of tobacco. On the palate, it has good volume and a balanced acidity, with firm tannins. The wine is round with a long, medium persistence on the finish. The varietal composition is a red blend, with Carmenere listed as the primary varietal.Stylistically, the wine is described as light and fruity, with a good balance.
The 'Flora Organic Red Blend' is made from organically grown grapes and is certified organic.

Food Pairing

  • Based on its profile of ripe red fruit, spice, and firm tannins, this wine is well-suited to pair with richly flavoured meat dishes.

  • Suggested pairings include grilled meats like pulled pork or sausages, or other hearty dishes like chili.

  • The balanced acidity and firm tannins make it an excellent complement to grilled or roasted red meats and can cut through the richness of the protein.

  • A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

Vintage Quality

  • The 2021 vintage was generally considered a standout year in many New World regions, often yielding excellent fruit structure and beautifully balanced flavours. In the hands of a skilled winemaker like Luis Felipe Edwards, the final product is a well-integrated wine that showcases its varietal character.

title: Ca Modeano Prosecco Ajar
bodyHtml: Ajar in Friulian means air, but also wind; a sound that evokes freshness of perfumes and harmony of sounds. Light straw yellow, it has fine and persistent bubbles. On the nose it is floral and finely aromatic, with a varietal note. Fresh, soft palate, moderately alcoholic and persistent. A sparkling wine rich in nuances, which adapts to any situation.

title: Armand de Brignac Gold Brut  (Ace of Spades) - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Crafted in the prestigious Champagne region of France, Armand de Brignac is produced by the Cattier family, who have owned and cultivated vineyards in Chigny-les-Roses since 1763. The brand was revived by Sovereign Brands in the early 2000s, and famously acquired by Shawn ‘Jay-Z’ Carter in 2014, later forming a partnership with LVMH in 2021. Armand de Brignac’s commitment to traditional craftsmanship and quality is evident in every detail, from hand-applied pewter labels to the selection of top-quality grapes from premier and grand cru vineyards.

Wine Description

The Gold Brut is a multi-vintage Champagne composed of 40% Pinot Noir, 40% Chardonnay, and 20% Pinot Meunier. It displays a vibrant, golden straw colour in the glass with an elegant mousse. Aromas of peach, apricot, and red berries are complemented by hints of citrus, brioche, and subtle floral notes. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and creamy with a lush mouthfeel. Flavours of ripe orchard fruits are layered with vanilla, toasted almonds, and a touch of honey, leading to a long, silky finish marked by finesse and complexity.

Food Pairing

Perfectly suited to refined dishes such as lobster with drawn butter, seared scallops, or duck pâté with toasted brioche. It also pairs well with creamy cheeses or truffle risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Primo Amore Moscato
bodyHtml:
Primo Amore Moscato originates from Italy, specifically from the sun-kissed vineyards of the Puglia region in the south. The wine is produced by the Zonin family, who have been vintners since 1821 and currently head the largest private winemaking company in Italy. The name 'Primo Amore', or 'first love', reflects the winery's philosophy of capturing the joy of discovery experienced when a wine drinker first encounters the sweetness and fragrance of this delicate varietal.

Wine Description

This wine displays a straw-yellow colour with golden reflections and a delicate, lightly sparkling (pétillant) mousse. The sensory profile is intensely aromatic, featuring inviting scents of ripe peaches, apricots, and exotic fruit, accented by hints of honey and candied ginger. On the light-bodied palate, it is refreshing and pleasantly sweet, delivering flavours of stone fruit, melon, and citrus. The finish is clean and fruity with lingering hints of stone fruit. This wine is made from 100% Moscato Bianco grapes and has a low ABV of 7.0%.

title: Heron Bay Sauvignon Blanc (NV)
bodyHtml: Crisp and vibrant with bright fruity notes and a zesty finish, will pair well with seafood, cheeses and salads.

title: Basil Hayden's 'Toast' Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
From Basil Hayden, this consists of an entirely new brown rice mash bill and a secondary finish in toasted barrels. The result is a bourbon with less spice, and deepened notes of sweet caramel with a bright, light mouthfeel.

Aroma: Toasted oak complemented by dried fruit and caramelized sugar.

Taste: Toasted wood and vanilla with a light mouthfeel.

Finish: Sweet caramel.

Colour: Dark amber.

title: 11th Hour Cellars Pinot Noir (NV)
bodyHtml: A classic combination of subtle raspberry and black cherry flavours with soft tannins and a very smooth finish. Serve with Roasted Pork Tenderloin, Glazed Duck, and Roasted Mushrooms with Herbs.

title: Beringer Bros. Bourbon Barrel Red Blend 2020
