bodyHtml: Aged for 60 days in American Oak Bourbon barrels, this wine is bursting with aromas of blackberry, dark chocolate, and vanilla cream. The palate is lush with ripe tannins and integrated acidity, showcasing toasted hazelnuts, toffee, and black cherry preserves on the finish.

title: Old Soul Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon contains ripe, dark fruit, smoke, and vanilla notes with full-bodied sweet fruit and a creamy texture. Softer tannins and refined tones of blackberries and cherries finish on the palate.

title: Castle Rock Cabernet Sauvignon California 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from California’s esteemed Paso Robles region. Castle Rock Winery, founded in 1994, is known for producing high-quality, value-driven wines sourced from premium vineyards across the West Coast. The winery emphasizes minimal intervention and a focus on terroir, delivering approachable wines that reflect each region’s character.

Wine Description
Deep garnet in colour, this Cabernet Sauvignon opens with inviting aromas of ripe blackberries, cassis, and hints of vanilla and toasted oak. On the palate, it presents a medium to full body with flavours of dark cherry, plum, and subtle spice layered over supple tannins. A balanced structure and a smooth, lingering finish showcase its approachability and ageing potential.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with grilled ribeye steak, lamb shanks, or mushroom risotto. Its bold character also complements aged cheddar and peppercorn-crusted beef. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Knotty Vines Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
bodyHtml:
Knotty Vines is made for the modern wine drinker to be shared with friends or even with your knotty side. It's time to stop denying your dark side and seduce it instead. Stimulate your wickedness, enjoy the electricity, and experience how good it feels to be knotty.

An indulgent Cabernet Sauvignon packed with mocha and black cherry flavours, this smooth, rich, medium-bodied wine finishes with playful silky tannins.

title: Frank Family Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Take a trip back in time at the Frank Family Vineyards. First constructed as the Larkmead Winery in 1884, the building was refinished with native sandstone from the nearby hills in 1906 and still stands tall today. The massive stone edifice is considered an archetype of California’s wine country; it appears on the National Register of Historical Places and is listed as a Point of Historical Interest in the state of California.

This is a quintessential Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon with pronounced aromas of blackberry, cassis, and vanilla that welcome you into the glass. Flavors of black plums, nutmeg, dark chocolate, and a touch of espresso enhance the wine's complex and full-bodied structure, with a core of elegant acidity from start to finish.

title: The Prisoner Wine Co. - Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
The Prisoner Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the United States, within the Napa Valley region of California. The winery was launched in 2000 by Dave Phinney, who drew inspiration from old world field blends to create a thoroughly modern Californian style. Its iconic label features 'Le Petit Prisonnier', an etching by Spanish artist Francisco Goya that represents a visual protest against injustice and oppression. Today, Director of Winemaking Chrissy Wittmann and her team collaborate with over 100 growers in Northern California to source exceptional fruit unrestricted by tradition.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep colour and a full, lush body. The sensory profile is rich and decadent, featuring an aromatic nose of black cherry, ripe plum, and vanilla, often accented by notes of cinnamon bark, clove, and fresh ground coffee. On the soft and plush palate, it delivers concentrated flavours of cassis, blackberry pie, and velvety cocoa, interwoven with hints of dried red berries and holiday spices. The finish is sturdy, smooth, and lingering, characterized by persistent fruit notes and a touch of toasted vanilla bean.

  • Varietal Composition: Primarily Cabernet Sauvignon, often blended with small amounts of Merlot, Syrah, Malbec, Petite Sirah, and Charbono.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its opulent and bold elegance, typically aged for 15 months in a combination of French and American oak barrels to add layers of spice and structure.

  • ABV: Typically recorded at 15%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery focuses on meticulous fruit selection and modern Californian sensibilities, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The bold structure and rich fruit profile of this Cabernet Sauvignon make it a versatile partner for flavourful and hearty dishes.

  • Meats: Pairs excellently with grilled ribeye steak, smoked brisket, or slow braised BBQ pulled pork.

  • Savoury: Suggested pairings include meat lover's pizza, lamburgers, or portobello mushrooms overlaid with smoked cheese.

  • Cheese: Matches well with aged gouda, which complements the wine's cocoa and dark fruit notes.

title: Mirassou Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml: For every moment, there’s a Mirassou wine. Grown in the California sun and infused with a casual West Coast spirit, their collections of red and whites started more than 160 years ago. Easy to sip, easy to love, and immediately recognizable—just look for the sun. Their wines are made for everyday celebrations, impromptu happy hours, with friends and family, or quiet moments. "We make wines that complement life’s bright moments—big and small."

title: Bonanza Cabernet Sauvignon - 375 ml (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
This accessible and full-bodied red wine originates from the United States, specifically from several premier vineyard sites across the state of California. Produced by Chuck Wagner, the owner and winemaker of the renowned Caymus Vineyards, Bonanza is a tribute to the 'bonanza' of quality Cabernet that can be found in overlooked parcels throughout the 'Golden State'. The Wagner family has a deep history in Napa Valley dating back to the 1850s, and their winemaking philosophy for this label emphasizes creating a delicious, consistent wine meant for the simple pleasure of daily enjoyment.

Wine Description

Bonanza Cabernet Sauvignon presents a medium ruby red colour with a sophisticated sensory profile. The nose is nuanced, opening with scents of currants, dried roses, and fresh tilled soil, layered with hints of toasty oak and smoked meat. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and 'strikingly smooth', showcasing flavours of blueberries, blackberries, and luscious dark fruit paired with the warmth of vanilla and toasted bread. It is characterized by silky tannins and a long, mouth-watering finish that trails off with notes of unsweetened chocolate, coffee, and cassis. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon reached an alcohol content (ABV) of approximately 13.8%. While the Wagner family utilizes meticulous standards in their vineyard sourcing and fermentation, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Chateau Guiraud 'G' Bordeaux Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Château Guiraud is a prestigious estate in the Sauternes appellation of Bordeaux, France, with a winemaking history dating back to the 18th century. Known for its commitment to biodiversity and organic viticulture, the estate was the first 1er Grand Cru Classé in 1855 to be certified organic. Its dry white ‘G’ cuvée reflects the estate’s focus on purity, expression, and balance.

Pale gold in the glass, the 2023 vintage of 'G' Bordeaux Blanc opens with vibrant aromas of white peach, citrus zest, and honeysuckle, with subtle herbal and mineral undertones. On the palate, it is fresh and lively, offering flavours of lemon curd, green apple, and a whisper of tropical fruit, all supported by crisp acidity and a delicate roundness.

Food Pairing
Pair this crisp white with grilled shrimp skewers, goat cheese tartlets, or a fresh arugula and citrus salad. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Chateau Barbebelle Cuvee Fleuris White 2023
bodyHtml:
Château Barbebelle is one of the oldest estates in Provence, located just outside Aix-en-Provence and managed by the fourth-generation Herbeau family. The 300-hectare property is known for its commitment to sustainable viticulture, combining traditional savoir-faire with a modern touch that reflects in its elegant wines.

This 2023 vintage of Cuvée Fleurie White offers a radiant expression of southern French terroir. Pale straw in colour with green reflections, it opens with fragrant aromas of white peach, acacia blossom, and citrus zest. On the palate, it is fresh and vibrant, showcasing flavours of lemon, pear, and a hint of minerality, supported by a medium body and crisp acidity. The finish is clean and lingering, with floral undertones adding charm.

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled shrimp, lemon-herb chicken, or a Provençal goat cheese salad. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Chateau Haut Chaigneau Lalande De Pomerol 2018
bodyHtml:
Chateau Haut Chaigneau is a well-regarded estate located in the Lalande de Pomerol appellation on Bordeaux’s Right Bank. Owned by the Chatonnet family, with famed oenologist Pascal Chatonnet at the helm, the estate is known for its meticulous attention to detail in both vineyard and cellar practices. The winery combines traditional Bordeaux sensibilities with modern winemaking precision to craft wines of depth and elegance.

Wine Description

The 2018 Chateau Haut Chaigneau presents a deep ruby colour with garnet highlights. Aromatically, it offers an expressive bouquet of ripe black cherries, plums, violets, and hints of cocoa and spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, with supple tannins and a velvety texture. Flavours of dark berries, mocha, and earthy undertones unfold in layers, balanced by fresh acidity and a long, harmonious finish.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs elegantly with roasted duck breast, braised short ribs, or mushroom risotto. The supple tannins and layered palate complement rich and savoury dishes without overpowering them. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Benjamin Bridge Pet Nat Artisanal Wine
bodyHtml:
Benjamin Bridge is a family-owned winery nestled in the Gaspereau Valley of Nova Scotia. Founded in 1999, the winery has gained recognition for its dedication to traditional methods and its unique expression of the cool climate terroir. Committed to sustainability and artisanal quality, Benjamin Bridge is considered a leader in sparkling wine production in Canada.

Wine Description
The 2021 Pet Nat reveals a cloudy straw hue with a lively effervescence typical of the méthode ancestrale. On the nose, it offers vibrant citrus notes of lemon zest and green apple, interwoven with nuances of wildflower, fresh herbs, and a faint yeasty undertone from its natural fermentation. The palate is brisk and invigorating, presenting flavours of grapefruit, pear, and subtle brioche. Light to medium in body, the wine finishes with bright acidity and a dry, tangy close that lingers with minerality.

Food Pairing
Ideal alongside fresh oysters, goat cheese salad, or sushi rolls with cucumber and avocado. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Masi Osar Oseleta 2015
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy’s Veneto region, the Masi Osar Oseleta 2015 is a rare and distinctive expression of a nearly forgotten varietal. Crafted by the prestigious Masi Agricola, a family-owned estate with a winemaking legacy dating back to the 18th century, this wine is a tribute to traditional techniques revitalized through innovation. Masi is renowned for its expertise in appassimento—the drying of grapes to concentrate flavour—a hallmark of their Amarone wines and also a component of this bottling.

This wine is made entirely from Oseleta, a rediscovered indigenous grape known for its deep colour and firm tannins. In the glass, it presents an intense, almost opaque ruby hue. The nose opens with powerful aromas of blackcurrant, plum, and dark cherry, interwoven with hints of licorice, clove, and dark chocolate. On the palate, it is full-bodied and bold, showing layers of ripe black fruit, spice, and earthy undertones. Tannins are muscular yet polished, balanced by a lively acidity.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 94 points.

  • Decanter – 93 points.

  • Wine Enthusiast – 92 points.

Food Pairing
Ideal with richly flavoured dishes such as braised short ribs, wild game, or aged cheeses. The wine’s intensity and structure complement hearty, umami-driven foods. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Pieroth Blue Kerner Kabinett Burg Layer Schlosskapelle 2021
bodyHtml: The Burg Layer Schlosskapelle vineyard is the flagship estate of the Pieroth family. The vineyard is situated on the slopes surrounding our head office and is planted with a selection of various grape varieties. In 1976 in recognition of over 300 years and to distinguish its unique and exquisite wine the Pieroth family revived an old tradition. Naturally occurring Cobalt in local sands used to make the glass, turned the glass bottles blue. This beautiful Kabinett wine is soft and elegant. The bouquet has a fresh slightly floral nose, accompanied by subtle green apple, white peach, honey, tea and lime flavours. Light bodied and well balanced, with lively fresh acidity makes this the ultimate white wine for all occasions.

title: Fantini Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: Farnese Pinot Grigio is a very easy to drink white wine. Representing excellent value it is tasty with hearty soup on a cold winter night or the perfect sipper on a hot summer night!

title: Inniskillin Okanagan Riesling Icewine 2022 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Golden yellow in colour, this icewine is intense with fruit aromas of apricot, peach and tropical fruits. Its rich palate is overflowing with sweet nectar flavours and is balanced with a crisp acidity. This delicious Icewine can be enjoyed as a dessert all on its own, or paired wonderfully with dark chocolate, poured over vanilla ice cream or complimented by a nice aged cheddar cheese.

title: Roserock 'Zephirine' Pinot Noir by Domaine Drouhin Oregon 2022
bodyHtml:
Founded by the renowned Drouhin family of Burgundy, Domaine Drouhin Oregon has firmly established itself as a benchmark of elegance and finesse in the Willamette Valley since 1987. The Roserock vineyard, acquired in 2013, lies at the southern tip of the Eola–Amity Hills AVA and is known for its elevation, volcanic soils, and cool climate—ideal conditions for growing exceptional Pinot Noir.

Wine Description
The 2022 'Zephirine' Pinot Noir opens with a deep ruby colour, offering a captivating aromatic profile of ripe black cherry, dark raspberry, rose petal, and a hint of baking spice. On the palate, it is richly layered with flavours of red currant, plum, and subtle earthiness, all wrapped in fine-grained tannins. Medium-bodied with refined acidity, the wine exhibits excellent balance, elegance, and a long, mineral-driven finish.

Accolades
● Wine Spectator – 94 points
● James Suckling – 95 points
● Wine Enthusiast – 94 points

Food Pairing
Pair this Pinot Noir with herb-crusted lamb, wild mushroom risotto, or duck breast with cherry glaze. The wine’s refined texture and aromatic complexity elevate the flavours of these dishes. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Mijenta Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Mijenta is an artisanal, small-batch tequila from the Highlands of Jalisco. It brings together a passionate community, the best possible materials and a traditional process to celebrate the best of the land and its people. No other tequila looks like it or tastes like it. 

Inspired by a shared cultural heritage, Mijenta offers a unique super premium spirit that is carefully crafted with a commitment to environmental sustainability and support for the local community. Mijenta's products are handmade, and numbered and embrace traditional methods, crafting excellence through a bespoke distillation process.

Aged up to 6 months in a blend of American white oak and European acacia casks, presenting a more mature and fuller expression with a long finish on the palate.

title: Jam Jar Sweet Shiraz 2024
bodyHtml: This fresh, fruity, semi-sweet wine displays aromas and flavors of ripe, juicy berries with dark chocolate undertones. The perfect balance between sweetness and acidity makes for a refreshing approachability. It is a versatile food wine, best served slightly chilled.

title: Pilla Select Aperitivo
bodyHtml: Pilla Select Aperitivo, crafted in Italy, is a captivating and versatile liqueur. Produced with meticulous care, this aperitivo embodies the essence of Italian craftsmanship. Its flavour profile is a delightful combination of bitter orange peel, herbs, and aromatic spices, resulting in a complex and well-balanced taste. Critics praise Pilla Select Aperitivo for its authenticity and versatility, noting its ability to elevate classic cocktails such as the Spritz or Negroni. With its vibrant flavour and enticing aroma, it adds a sophisticated touch to any pre-dinner libation. Pilla Select Aperitivo is a cherished choice for those seeking a taste of Italian indulgence.

title: Orin Swift Mannequin Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' white wine originates from the United States, within the expansive California A.O.C. appellation. Produced by Orin Swift Cellars the legendary Napa Valley estate founded by winemaker Dave Phinney, celebrated worldwide for crafting bold, highly expressive, and artfully packaged wines "Mannequin" represents the winery's flagship white assemblage. Sourced from choice, low-yielding vineyard plots across California's premier cool-climate Chardonnay regions (including Carneros, Sonoma Coast, and Mendocino), the vines thrive in complex soils ranging from gravelly loam to clay and eroded limestone. The maritime microclimates feature persistent ocean fog and cooling Pacific breezes, allowing the grapes to build immense aromatic power and rich textural volume while retaining a vibrant, balancing natural acidity.

Wine Description

Orin Swift Mannequin Chardonnay presents a rich, luminous golden-yellow color in the glass with bright brass and pale emerald reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and decadent portrait of modern California Chardonnay. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe Meyer lemon, yellow apple, honeydew melon, and white peach, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of roasted pineapple, jasmine flowers, sweet Madagascar vanilla, toasted brioche, lemon curd, and a subtle line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, opulent, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of tropical fruits, grilled stone fruit, and orange zest. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its broad mid-palate weight. The mouthfeel is mouth-coating, supple, and weightless, framed by a rich, velvety texture gained from extensive lees contact that carries into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of toasted oak, hazelnut, and citrus peel.

title: Cimarron Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
Cimarrón Reposado Tequila is an artisanal, additive-free spirit originating from Atotonilco El Alto in the Highlands (Los Altos) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Produced at the legendary Tequileña Distillery (NOM 1146) under the direction of Master Distiller Enrique Fonseca, Cimarrón was created to deliver an uncompromising, traditional tequila at an approachable price point. It is widely celebrated among bartenders and agave purists as one of the ultimate value-to-quality benchmarks in the tequila industry.

Spirit Description

Cimarrón Reposado is crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves cultivated on high-elevation hillside fields. The agaves are slow-roasted in low-pressure autoclaves and extracted using a proprietary waterless crushing technique to preserve natural sugar concentration. Following natural fermentation with winemaker's yeast, the liquid is double-distilled utilizing a unique blend of column-still (approx. 80–90%) and copper alembic pot-still (10–20%) distillates. The tequila rests for 3 to 6 months in uncharred American white oak barrels to gently round out the spirit without overpowering the core agave character.

  • Colour: Pale straw gold with bright, luminous highlights.

  • Aroma: Inviting and agave-forward, opening with cooked agave sweetness, baked apples, and light citrus peel, backed by soft vanilla, warm cinnamon, and a gentle earthy woodiness.

  • Palate: Balanced, dry, and soft on the entry. Upfront notes of rich roasted agave and honeyed sweetness give way to subtle dark chocolate, toasted nuts, cinnamon red-hot spice, and light barrel oak.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, clean, and slightly silky mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Crisp, warming, and medium-long, closing with lingering black pepper, baking spices, dry earth, and sweet agave.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Bread & Butter Chardonnay Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
At Bread & Butter they believe good things in life shouldn't be complicated. Good things should just be good, honest, and simple. And the same goes for their wine. Bread & Butter Wines unlock the simplicity that people crave in life. Simply enjoyable flavors made for simple moments in a complex world. A bottle of Bread & Butter is the opportunity to take a breath, let your shoulders drop, and refresh your mindset.

This Chardonnay is rich, vibrant, and memorable. Enjoy notes of vibrant golden apple, pear, toasted brioche, and rich vanilla bean.

title: Tierra Rica Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Tierra Rica is an organic Chilean wine, available as both Cabernet Sauvignon and Sauvignon Blanc. Certified Vegan, with a compostable cork and lightweight glass, 

This wine is produced using sustainable and organic practices, they are doing their best to keep the ecosystem in balance. Rich and robust flavours of plum, black cherry, blackberry and smoky oak lead to a warm and lengthy finish. Enjoy it on its own or with steak, prime rib or a mushroom tart; vegan friendly.

title: Caribou Crossing Whisky
bodyHtml: Dark honey in the glass, this whisky boasts maple and cedar aromas in the bouquet. Expect lots of spice on the palate, including clove, cinnamon, nutmeg, cayenne and black pepper, all smoothed over by a ribbon of maple and honey. It finishes big, round, buttery and mouthwatering. Selected to the 2015 Wine Enthusiast Top 100 Spirits.

title: 1000 Stories Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
This rich, full flavoured Cabernet Sauvignon expresses a pioneering spirit along with signature bourbon barrel notes of charred vanilla and dried herbs. Each lot began its journey in traditional French and American oak wine barrels. Then, in true 1000 Stories fashion, winemaker Bob Blue finished a small portion of the wine in new bourbon barrels, with the balance aged in neutral bourbon barrels.

The result is a signature 1000 Stories wine, layered and complex, with classic Cabernet flavours of cherries and currant, underscored by a nuanced thread of graphite. Their unique barrel aging process gave this wine its hints of burnt sugar, vanilla, dried herbs, and even a touch of smokiness.

title: Rust En Vrede Syrah 2022
bodyHtml:
Established in 1694, Rust en Vrede is proud to be part of a remarkable wine tradition. Since 1977 the Engelbrecht family has specialized in the exclusive production of red wine, with the focus on Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah. Proprietor Jean Engelbrecht has worked to maintain Rust en Vrede as one of South Africa’s premium red wine estates, with full-bodied, complex wines that reflect the uniqueness of their Stellenbosch terroir.

Floral perfume of jasmine with black cherry and tobacco. Full-bodied with bold fruit, showing red cherry, blueberry and black forest gateau. Subtle pink peppercorn and cumin compliment savoury notes of smoky meat. Balanced acidity, fine spicy tannins and a juicy finish.

title: Conundrum White 2023 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
The Conundrum White is a celebrated multi-varietal blend hailing from California, United States. Created by the Wagner family, the same visionaries behind the iconic Caymus Vineyards, this wine was born from Charlie Wagner Sr.'s passion for blending different whites to find the perfect dinner accompaniment.

Wine Description

This wine displays a bright, pale straw colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is intense and inviting, featuring layers of apricot, honeysuckle, and tropical notes of guava and melon. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied with a lush, rounded texture balanced by a refreshing vein of acidity. Flavours of peach and pear mingle with subtle citrus zest, leading to a long, crisp finish characterized by its signature complexity.

title: Starmont Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Starmont Chardonnay is crafted to enjoy with food or simply by the glass. The wine is pale gold in colour with aromas of bright citrus, apple, and vanilla. The soft entry leads to a mid-palate with medium body and acidity and plenty of volume. Flavours of apple and pear, along with citrus, fresh mineral and subtle oak notes lead to a refreshing, medium length finish.

title: Aviation Gin
bodyHtml:
Like the world's finest gins, Aviation is distilled using a proprietary maceration recipe that produces a pure medley of botanical flavour.

STEP 1: INFUSION It all starts with our precise blend of botanicals – cardamom, coriander, French lavender, anise seed, sarsaparilla, juniper, and two kinds of orange peel. The botanicals are suspended in a pure, neutral grain spirit for 18 hours in macerating tanks.

STEP 2: DISTILLATION The macerate is then pumped into a still along with pure water. Steam jackets heat the macerate, the vapours go into the condenser, which cools the vapours to form the gin distillate.

STEP 3: THE CUT In a meticulously monitored process, the first fluid leaving the still, the "heads," is removed. Collecting the "heart of the spirit" throughout the run, the distillers then determine the end of the cycle and make the final cut, "the tails." This process takes approximately 7 hours and at this point, the "heart cut" is 142 proof.

STEP 4: BLENDING & BOTTLING The "heart cut" is transferred to a blending tank where pure water is added, bringing the gin to the desired 84 proof. It is then sent to the bottling line for filling, capping, and labeling. Aviation is then hand-packed into boxes and ready to ship.

A unique combination of carefully selected botanicals are used to create a gin that coats the glass with slow-moving tears. On the nose, spiciness up front, layered with citrus zest, juniper and floral notes. Full, warm and viscous with sweet/spicy notes emerging mid-palate followed by a long, sweet and spicy finish.

title: Bib & Tucker Small Batch 6 Years Old Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Bib & Tucker Small Batch 6 Years Old Bourbon is a premium straight bourbon whiskey from the United States. Originally launched in 2014, the brand draws inspiration from the 1880s, an era when people donned their finest attire—vulgarly known as 'bib and tucker'—to celebrate great achievements. It is a sourced product produced in Tennessee and aged in the rolling hills of the region, utilizing the traditional Lincoln County Process.

Description

This bourbon features a mash bill consisting of corn, rye, and malted barley, which is double distilled in pot stills. It is aged for at least six years in first fill white American oak barrels with a light, low char level, then bottled at 46% ABV (92 proof).

  • Colour: A rich caramel and medium amber colour with distinct copper highlights.

  • Aroma: Fragrant and sweet, showcasing scents of vanilla, orange zest, fresh grass, caramel candy, cocoa bean, and light sawdust.

  • Palate: It displays an initial sweetness of orange jam, long stewed fruits, and brown sugar. This evolves into warm oak spices, cinnamon, nutmeg, licorice, and a subtle touch of Christmas cake.

  • Body: It possesses a lighter, thinner texture rather than a chewy or heavy structure, contributing to an easy drinking and accessible mouthfeel.

  • Finish: A long, smooth finish marked by lingering notes of caramel, tobacco, honey, and custard cream, closing out with a light, dry touch of barrel bitterness.

title: Maggio Family Vineyards Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: The Maggio family has been producing wine grapes in Lodi for five generations, giving exceptional fruit to top California winemakers. This wine is silky smooth and full-bodied, with lush pear and ripe apple notes with touches of toffee on the finish.

title: Chloe Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: Chloe Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold, sophisticated wine with luscious flavors of black cherry, ripe plum and dark chocolate, followed by delicate notes of roasted coffee and cinnamon bark. This well-balanced wine has a full-bodied mouthfeel and sturdy tannic structure that leads to a long, lingering finish.

title: Quinta Do Vale Meao Meandro Douro Tinto 2023
bodyHtml: A vibrant nose of floral, high-toned with raisin-like fruit. Decent palate weight, but not overloaded, with a fine, peppery structure and a savoury finish. Velvety rich bergamot and woodsmoke-edged blackberry, fine tannins.

title: Lindeman's Gentleman's Collection Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
In 1843, Dr. Lindeman, an upstanding man of formidable character, started his own winery. In doing so, he set his sights on civilising a colony of hard-drinking ruffians by introducing them to more gentlemanly pursuits, such as the enjoyment of a refined drop. Today, we're carrying on that tradition through the Gentleman's Collection.

Dark fruits, hints of dried herbs and mocha on the nose. The dense palate sees sour red fruits balance out the sweet with a chocolate tannin finish. A fine choice for any discerning gent.

title: The Prisoner Wine Co. - Unshackled Red Blend
bodyHtml: A purity of fruit is evident, featuring aromas of raspberry, blueberry, and crushed violets. Flavors of spiced dried cherries, florals, and a hint of white pepper translate to a balanced wine that's uplifting, supported with a generous mouthfeel.

title: Napa Cellars Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Grapes for this Napa Cellars Chardonnay were selected primarily from vineyards in Napa Valley with a portion from nearby Clarksburg AVA. The climates in these areas of California provide ideal conditions for growing Chardonnay. The proximity of Napa’s vineyards to the fog and breeze from San Francisco and Marin Bay creates a mild, Mediterranean climate.

title: Gemtree Uncut Shiraz 2019
bodyHtml:
Uncut Shiraz is generous, layered, bright and textural. The aromas of blueberry, mulberry and spiced vanilla oak are intense and complex. Uncut is a rich and pure Shiraz. The lively fruit flavours are polished and surrounded by natural oak flavours and balanced acidity, all hallmarks of Gemtree Wines.

92 Points -  Huon Hooke, The Real Review, November 2011 (2019 Vintage)

"This has an impressively deep, bright, youthful purple-red colour and an appealing aroma of berry fruits and spices, with a nicely harmonized touch of oak. The wine is full-bodied and intense with abundant tannins as well as soft texture, the finish long. It’s well-concentrated but also accessible young. An excellent young Shiraz."

title: Tocornal Chardonnay - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: An attractive white wine made from Chardonnay grapes. Fresh, clean and fragrant, it is the perfect aperitif wine, suitable for both everyday use and for special occasions.

title: Fabre en Provence Cotes de Provence Rose 2024
bodyHtml: This is a classic rose. It has fine ripe, but crisp, fruit and delicious balanced acidity. With its fresh character, which is contrasted with the intense fruit, this is a real food friendly rose.

title: Saint Cosme Blanc 'Les Deux Albion' 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the southern Rhône Valley region, specifically within the Principauté d'Orange IGP and surrounding Côtes du Rhône terroirs, Saint Cosme 'Les Deux Albions' Blanc represents an aromatic, textured, and deeply mineral white Rhône cuvée. Crafted by Louis Barruol at Château de Saint Cosme—an historic estate with winemaking roots dating back to Roman times in 1410—this white bottling extends the legacy of the acclaimed 'Les Deux Albions' range. Sourced from high-elevation, cool-climate vineyards planted on limestone, clay, and gravelly alluvial soils, the winemaking philosophy utilizes direct whole-cluster pressing, natural yeast fermentation in wooden vats, and aging on fine lees without oak over-extraction. The result is a vibrant, gastronomy-minded white wine characterized by stone-fruit purity, floral complexity, and fine limestone tension.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale straw yellow colour with bright greenish-gold reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with seductive aromas of fresh white peach, ripe apricot, green apple, and melon, interwoven with elegant notes of white jasmine blossom, honeysuckle, crushed limestone, wild fennel, and toasted almond. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, satiny, and rounded, delivering generous flavours of orchard fruit, lemon curd, and white nectarine, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a rich, coat-the-mouth texture derived from fine lees contact and a driving mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus peel, savory herbs, and a clean mineral grip. Composed of a classic white Rhône blend featuring Viognier, Picpoul, Marsanne, Roussanne, and Clairette, it combines southern Rhône warmth and aromatic richness with crisp, refreshing balance and precision.

title: Maggio Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: This Lodi Cabernet Sauvignon has rich berry fruit with oak and vanilla notes. With hints of baking spices, it reminds one of a mouthwatering berry pie, tasty crust and all. It has a medium body and gentle tannins making for a very pleasurable wine experience.

title: Highwood Distillers Cruxx Natural Grain Spirit
bodyHtml: At 95% alcohol, CRUXX is an odorless, flavorless spirit distilled from wheat grain made to be a base for your liquid creations. From liqueurs like “Lemoncello” to bitters the wide range of mixing options are endless. This product is never to be consumed without adding other ingredients, or water at a minimum, to dilute the alcohol content down to a responsible level.

title: Napa Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: Aromas of blueberry, blackberry and hints of hazelnut. Medium to full body, silky tannins and a flavourful finish.

title: El Enemigo Cabernet Franc 2022
bodyHtml:
El Enemigo Cabernet Franc 2022 originates from Argentina, within the Mendoza region and the high-altitude Gualtallary subregion of the Uco Valley. The winery was founded in 2009 by Alejandro Vigil, the chief winemaker at Catena Zapata and a soils engineer, alongside historian Adrianna Catena. Their partnership is built on a shared passion for history and a philosophy of 'irreverence' toward the status quo, aiming to produce wines that confront the 'enemy within' through minimal human intervention. The estate is inspired by traditional European styles, particularly the cool-climate expressions of Bordeaux's Pomerol region.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep purple colour with dark intensity and soft violet tones. The sensory profile is complex and layered, featuring an aromatic nose of blackcurrants, ripe plums, and cassis, interwoven with notes of violet, black pepper, and tobacco leaves. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it delivers a fresh impact and excellent structure, with flavours of ripe red fruits and hints of eucalyptus and cedar. The wine is characterized by a sturdy, mineral-driven core and firm yet polished tannins, leading to an explosive and persistent finish.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend of 90% Cabernet Franc and 10% Malbec.

  • ABV: Recorded at 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery utilizes certified sustainable and eco-friendly practices, including spontaneous fermentation with wild yeasts, this specific wine is not typically certified organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine underwent a 60-day maceration and was aged for 15 to 16 months in a combination of ancient oak foudres, barriques, and concrete tanks to preserve terroir clarity.

title: Dillon's Absinthe
bodyHtml: Created by macerating, vapour distilling, and finally a steeping in fresh wormwood, lemon balm, hyssop (grown at the distillery) with other natural ingredients. No artificial colours are added allowing this absinthe to truly open up with the addition of ice-cold water. Crisp and clean with notes of anise and grapefruit.

title: Errazuriz Chardonnay Reserva 2024
bodyHtml: Bright yellow colour with rich pineapple and banana with vanilla aromas. Full-bodied, creamy and lush with pineapple fruit, baked applet and buttery, vanilla nut flavours.

title: Chateau de Fuisse Saint Veran 2024
bodyHtml: Crisp, clean and bright Chardonnay. A beautiful golden hue. Stone fruits like apricots and peaches are abundant and in the forefront of the nose. A flinty characteristic stands out and the classic nutty notes really hit home on the palate. A delightful Chardonnay for fuller flavoured fish-focused dishes.

title: Tommasi Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2020 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Deep ruby red color with garnet shades. Warm, ripe on the nose, intense and of great refinement. The taste is complex, smooth, full bodied, lots of cherry notes and plum.

Tommasi Amarone is a wine which one can proudly serve on special occasions, particularly with red meats, game and ripe cheeses. But it can also be sipped an ideal companion to enjoyable conversation.

title: Cedar Creek Meritage 2021
bodyHtml: Early in the morning, Anarchist Mountain casts its long shadow over Haynes Creek vineyard, cooling the vines until the sun bursts over the mountain’s ridge. As the day unfolds, blowing dust coats their boots and clothing as midsummer heat radiates up from the dry ground. This contrast of dark and light, cold and heat, blesses us with a harmony of black currant and plum characters in this blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, and Cabernet Franc.

title: Jim Beam Repeal Batch
bodyHtml: Celebrating 85 years since the repeal of prohibition, Jim Beam is releasing a non-chill filtered bourbon, bottled at 86 proof. Aromas and flavours of sweet corn, vanilla, toffee, baking spices and a hint of charred oak lead to a balanced and smooth finish. Serve with smoky barbecue, or craft a classic Manhattan.

title: Crotin Barbera d'Asti 'La Martina' 2022
bodyHtml:
Crotin's La Martina features Barbera grown naturally in the Asti district of Piemonte. It is petite, feisty, and full of energy. This wonderful Barbera has zesty acidity, excellent depth and concentration on the palate, and is reminiscent of raspberry jam and wild woodland currants. This is one of those wines that vanishes from your glass before you realise it. It's beautifully woven and wonderfully delightful.

Ruby red color with violet reflections. The nose manifests intense and complex fruity aromas of cherry, raspberry, blackberry and black cherry, followed by dried purple flowers and notes of licorice. On the palate it is full bodied and fresh.

title: Boen Pinot Noir Tri-Apellation 2023
bodyHtml:
This Pinot Noir hails from the United States, specifically California, blending fruit from three prestigious regions: Sonoma County, Monterey County, and Santa Barbara County. Böen is part of the Copper Cane Wines & Provisions portfolio, created by winemaker Joseph Wagner, a fifth-generation Napa Valley winemaker. Wagner brings a legacy of bold, expressive winemaking, aiming to showcase California's diverse terroirs through approachable, yet layered wines.

Wine Description

The 2022 Böen Pinot Noir displays a deep ruby red colour with brilliant clarity. Aromas of ripe cherries, dark berries, and baking spice rise from the glass, layered with subtle hints of rose petal and toasted oak. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with velvety tannins and balanced acidity, offering flavours of black cherry, plum, clove, and vanilla. The finish is long and smooth with a touch of earthiness and cocoa.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with herb-crusted pork tenderloin, grilled salmon, or mushroom risotto. The ripe fruit and spice notes also complement aged cheeses and charcuterie. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Michael David Lodi Zinfandel Old Vine 2022
bodyHtml:
The 2021 Michael David Lodi Zin Old Vine Zinfandel is a bold and expressive red wine from Lodi, California, crafted by the family-owned Michael David Winery. With a legacy dating back to the 1850s, the Phillips family has been cultivating grapes in the region for nearly a century, emphasizing sustainable farming practices and quality winemaking. The winery's commitment to excellence was recognized when it was named the 2020 American Winery of the Year by Wine Enthusiast Magazine

Wine Description

This Zinfandel showcases a deep ruby-red hue and offers a rich tapestry of aromas, including blackberry tart, dark chocolate, and graham cracker. On the palate, it presents flavors of boysenberry, plum, and spice, culminating in a lasting oak finish . The wine is full-bodied with a firm tannin structure and lively acidity, reflecting the complexity derived from Lodi's old vine vineyards, some of which are over 100 years old.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 90 points

Food Pairing

This Zinfandel pairs exceptionally well with hearty dishes such as grilled meats, barbecue, rich stews, and aged cheeses. Its bold profile and rich flavors also make it a delightful wine to savor on its own, offering a taste experience that is both indulgent and memorable.

title: Blue Nun Rivaner German White Wine 2021
bodyHtml: Made using the classic Rivaner grape, this wine has balance, softness & depth of fruit flavour.

title: Imagery Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: Opulent, dark fruit of black cherry with spice, cinnamon and clove on the entry. Smooth integrated oak brings out cola flavors in the mid-palate and a vanilla toast on the finish that enhances the wine's soft balanced texture.

title: Layer Cake Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
Layer Cake, established in 2007, is part of Hundred Acre Winery where Jayson Woodbridge makes serious California cult Cabs. He’s been called “one of California’s most flamboyant, talented, contrarian wine producers”, “crazy cult wine hero”, and “dedicated and devoted to value and excellence”.  Although he was happy with Hundred Acre’s success, Woodbridge wanted to show that he could make affordable wines that seriously over deliver.

He did just that with Layer Cake, sourcing grapes in some of his favourite wine regions in the world including Australia, Argentina, Italy, Spain, and California, knowing that he would find great value. Using the same winemaking techniques that he uses for One Hundred Acre cabs ensures quality and wines that reflect their origin. These carefully crafted Layer Cake wines are affordable luxuries.

title: Rodney Strong Merlot Sonoma County 2021
bodyHtml:
Founded by wine industry pioneer, Rod Strong, in 1959, Rodney Strong Vineyards is now owned by the Kleins, a farming-based family that prides itself on land stewardship and a relentless push for superior wine quality from Sonoma County. After purchasing the company in 1989, Tom Klein began the endeavour that today brings together excellent vineyards, the industry's finest winemaking equipment, and exceptional talent. The winery farms and sources grapes from vineyards throughout Sonoma County, focusing on Alexander Valley, Russian River Valley and Chalk Hill. Rodney Strong Vineyards is best known for its estate-bottled and vineyard-designated wines and is also recognized for their sustainable and Fish Friendly Farming, dedication to solar energy production and becoming carbon neutral in 2009.

Lush with notes of black cherry, dark berries and plum with a hint of dried herbs. This wine is silky and voluptuous with soft tannins and finishes with a touch of cocoa and vanilla. The luscious dark fruit flavours are enhanced by aging in 100% small French oak barrels. Enjoy this soft, rich, elegant Merlot with charcuterie, grilled pork ribs and burgers.

title: Joseph Drouhin Chardonnay Bourgogne 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the regional Bourgogne Blanc appellation, Joseph Drouhin Chardonnay Bourgogne represents a classic, pure, and elegant expression of Burgundian Chardonnay. Established in 1880, Maison Joseph Drouhin is one of Burgundy's most revered historic houses, currently managed by the fourth generation of the Drouhin family and globally acclaimed for its commitment to organic and biodynamic viticulture. Sourced from choice estate parcels and long-standing partner vineyards situated across the Côte de Beaune, Côte Chalonnaise, and the Auxerrois, the vines sit on classic limestone and clay soils. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes gentle whole-cluster pressing, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats and neutral oak barrels, and aging on fine lees for 7 to 8 months to preserve pristine varietal fruit aromatics, crisp minerality, and authentic Burgundian terroir precision.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale straw yellow colour with bright greenish reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with delicate aromas of fresh green apple, ripe Williams pear, white peach, and lemon curd, interwoven with subtle notes of white acacia flowers, fresh hazelnut, crushed limestone, and a hint of warm brioche. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, crisp, and refreshing, delivering generous flavours of citrus zest, white orchard fruit, and mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by a smooth, satiny texture derived from gentle lees contact and a balanced mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, persistent finish marked by lingering lemon peel, subtle nuttiness, and a fresh mineral lift. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, it combines Burgundian elegance and freshness with effortless drinkability and charm.

title: L'Oiseliniere Muscadet 'Sur Lie' 2024
bodyHtml:
France’s Loire Valley is home to Domaine de l’Oiselinière, located in the Muscadet Sèvre et Maine appellation of the western Loire. This historic estate, situated in the village of Gorges, dates back to the 17th century and has long embraced sustainable and organic viticulture. The estate’s distinctive terroir, with granite-rich soils and proximity to the Atlantic Ocean, imparts a remarkable freshness and minerality to its wines.

Wine Description
Pale straw in colour with green reflections, the 2024 vintage of L’Oiseliniere Muscadet 'Sur Lie' offers a vibrant bouquet of lemon zest, green apple, and crushed oyster shell. On the palate, it delivers a lively interplay of citrus and saline notes, supported by a light to medium body and a laser-focused acidity. The wine finishes clean and mineral-driven, showcasing excellent tension and purity.

Food Pairing
An ideal companion to oysters, clams, and mussels, this wine also pairs beautifully with chèvre and fresh salads. Its bracing acidity and saline edge enhance the umami character of seafood, while the lees aging complements creamy textures. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Tiefenbrunner Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml: Straw yellow in colour with lemon reflexes, this Pinot Grigio is youthful and lively. On the nose, this wine has aromas of citrus, white blossoms, pears, apples and meadow grass. There is a fresh, crisp minerality and a clear finish. Wonderful as an aperitif as well as a wine that pairs well with butter-poached fish, scampi's, and pasta dishes such as pasta primavera.

title: Frey Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml: Some 20 hectares grown organically are behind this fabulous, elegant and finely-wooded Pinot Noir. Accents of black cherry, cedar, earth and mocha embellish a palate with a soft tannic structure.

title: Orin Swift Slander Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Pale ruby in the glass, the wine opens with no-fuss aromatics of bright strawberry, candied cherry, crushed gravel, wet brick, white pepper and brushed violet. Enveloping in a sophisticated, elegant manner, the palate has similar tones to the nose with some black cherry and a touch of minerality. Vibrant and energetic through the finish, the wine closes with a pleasant vein of acidity, capable of myriad pairings.

“There’s a soul to this business and that soul isn’t just from the people who make wine, it’s from everyone who loves wines that make them feel something.” Dave Phinney

title: Joel Gott Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: The 2023 Joel Gott Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant white wine crafted in California, USA. Joel Gott Wines, founded in 1996, is renowned for producing high-quality, approachable wines by sourcing premium fruit from diverse regions across California. Now under the ownership of Trinchero Family Estates, the winery continues to uphold its commitment to excellence and value.

title: Canvasback Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: This lush and alluring Cabernet Sauvignon begins with aromas of ripe strawberry, grenadine, and Bing cherry that leap from the glass, followed by notes of sarsaparilla, root spices, black licorice cinnamon and star anise. On the palate, it is both luxurious and energetic, with plush tannins and ripe red berry flavours balanced by enlivening energy and sophisticated hints of cigar wrapper, granitic minerality and sweet baking spices.

title: Coppola Cabernet Sauvignon Paso Robles 2023
bodyHtml:
The Francis Ford Coppola Winery was founded in 1975 when the famous film director, Francis Ford Coppola, acquired the estate with the goal of producing quality wines. The winery is known for producing a variety of acclaimed wines and has grown into an established wine legacy that celebrates life through the art of wine and cinema.

Wine Description

Diamond Collection Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon boasts delightful notes of black fruits, coffee, almond, and vanilla on the nose. Concentrated ripe stone fruits meet a hint of toasted oak on the palate with an opulent body lead to a long, sophisticated finish.

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs beautifully with grilled meats, such as grilled steaks and roasted lamb, and hearty stews. It is an ideal match for roast beef, grilled game sausages, meat-lover’s pizza, or a hearty burger.

title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2020 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Italy’s Il Poggione is a historic estate located in Sant’Angelo in Colle, a subregion of Montalcino in Tuscany. Founded in the late 1800s, the estate is now owned and operated by the Franceschi family, whose dedication to tradition and sustainability is evident in their meticulous vineyard practices and classic winemaking style. Il Poggione is widely respected as one of the original Brunello producers, emphasizing elegance, longevity, and terroir expression.

Wine Description
Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino showcases a deep garnet colour with brilliant ruby reflections. The nose is rich and layered, offering notes of dark cherry, blackcurrant, dried herbs, leather, and tobacco, interwoven with hints of vanilla and sweet spices from oak aging. On the palate, it is full-bodied and structured, with ripe tannins and vibrant acidity supporting flavours of red plum, balsamic, and forest floor. The finish is long and savoury, with a firm mineral backbone.

Food Pairing
Ideal with rich dishes such as wild boar ragu, grilled lamb chops, or aged Pecorino Toscano. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Sea Sun Chardonnay 2023 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
This expressive and balanced white wine originates from the United States, specifically from coastal regions within the state of California. Sea Sun is produced by winemaker Charlie Wagner, whose family founded the renowned Caymus Vineyards and has deep roots in Napa Valley dating back to the 1850s. The winery's philosophy is rooted in exploring diverse coastal vineyard sites; spanning Monterey, Santa Barbara, and Solano counties, where the cooling 'sea' breezes and bright 'sun' allow for an extended growing season and heightened fruit complexity.

Wine Description

Sea Sun Chardonnay presents a brilliant appearance with enticing scents of toasted wood, brown spice, and lush dried apricot. The sensory profile is further layered with alluring aromas of honeysuckle and candied Meyer lemon rind. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and 'lush yet vibrant', showcasing bright flavours of white peach, apricot, and mandarin orange. It is characterized by a creamy, buttery texture balanced by a lively natural acidity that provides an enlivening freshness. The finish is round and persistent, often described as having a 'grippy' and toasty quality. This 100% Chardonnay typically reaches an ABV of approximately 14.1%. While the Wagner family emphasizes natural forces in their viticulture, this wine is not certified organic.

title: Marques De Caceres Crianza 2020
bodyHtml: Intense, ruby red colour. Expressive nose with notes of raspberries, blueberries and cherries, enlivened by a touch of spice a depth of vanilla. Charming fruit in the mouth with good structure that highlights concentrated flavours and fleshy tannins.

title: Wyndham Estate Shiraz Bin 555 2024
bodyHtml: Crimson red with vibrant purple hues. Lifted aromas of plum, clove, chocolate and mocha supported by subtle vanillin oak. A generous wine with up front plum complimented by dark cherry and spice. The fruit is further supported by fine savoury tannins and subtle oak, ensuring that flavour persistence is a key to this wine.

title: Waterstone Merlot 2018
bodyHtml:
Waterstone Winery was formed in 2000 with the simple concept of creating luxury wines at affordable prices. Bringing together previously established relationships with Napa Valley growers and vintners, the winery set out to develop balanced wines of varietal character through intelligent sourcing. Preferring to focus on the wine itself rather than the accumulation of land and facilities, Waterstone owns no vineyards, nor does it own the facility where their wines are made. Dedicated winemaking, strong relationships with top growers and long-term grape contracts are the keys to Waterstone’s quality and success.

Spiced plum, baking spices and cedar predominate in the aroma. A structured and medium-bodied Merlot with rounded tannins and lingering notes of black and red cherries.

title: Cats in Space Felicette Grenache 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant Grenache comes from the sun-drenched vineyards of southern France, specifically the Languedoc-Roussillon region, known for its old vines and Mediterranean terroir. Named after Félicette—the first cat in space—this wine celebrates curiosity and exploration. The winery behind this bottle embraces a modern yet earth-conscious approach, working with sustainable viticulture and minimal intervention winemaking to let the grape and terroir shine.

Wine Description
In the glass, this Grenache shows a vivid ruby hue with flashes of violet at the rim. Aromas burst forward with ripe raspberry, crushed strawberries, and hints of black pepper and dried herbs. On the palate, it offers juicy red fruits, subtle spice, and soft tannins with a supple medium body and a silky texture. The finish is clean and fruit-forward, marked by a whisper of minerality and vibrant acidity.

Food Pairing
Pair with grilled lamb skewers, Moroccan-spiced chickpeas, or a roasted vegetable tart. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Fantini Primitivo 2025
bodyHtml: This Primitivo shimmers cherry red in the glass. Gentle tones of cherry compote, lightly spiced, flow into the nose. On the palate it presents a variety of aromas of dark, red fruits, such as blackberries, cherries and cassis - again all with a slightly spicy-peppery touch. Soft tannins round off the harmonious taste experience.

title: Arnaces Prosecco (NV)
bodyHtml: Aromas of green pear, apple, lemon and lime. Well balanced and delicious for sipping at your next party!

title: Poppy Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: This focused, elegant Chardonnay's aromas feature sweet golden apple, ripe citrus, tropical fruit and almond with touches of creamy yeast, vanilla and oak in the background. On the palate, the rich flavors are complemented by a light touch of toasty oak and refreshing citrus with mineral notes and bright acidity in the finish. Pair this Chardonnay with roasted butternut squash and tortellini.

title: J Bouchon Rose Reserva 2023
bodyHtml: A bone dry rose from the Maule estate of Bouchon Family Wines whose coastal vineyards on granite make a much fresher style than we've come to expect from Chile. A crisp and vibrant pink based on the native Pais grape, this has watermelon and a touch of spice with just a hint of pomegranate on the finish.

title: Shannon Ridge Cabernet Sauvignon High Elevation 2021
bodyHtml:
Shannon Ridge is dedicated to crafting luscious, fruit-driven wines that express the distinct characteristics of fruit grown in the high valley region of Lake County, California. Family-owned and operated, Shannon Ridge was founded in 2001. The vineyards hug the mountain rims along the southeast edge of High Valley AVA. Surrounded by dramatic landscapes and pristine wilderness, the story of High Valley is visible from their property. Look to your south at 2,200 feet on top of the Terre Vermeille vineyard, and you'll see the deep blue waters of Clear Lake, which provide cooling winds throughout their long summer days. Turn to the west, and you can distinguish where the lava flows give way to the alluvial fan of the ancient lake bed on the valley floor. From the north, you can feel the cold night winds from Snow Mountain and the peaks of the Mendocino National Forest.

This is a classic, everyday drinking Cabernet. Great fruit upfront, balanced complexity on the mid-palate and a kiss of oak on the lingering, yet soft, finish.

91 Points - Wilfred Wong

The 2021 Shannon Ridge High Elevation Cabernet Sauvignon is intense and persistent on the palate. This wine exhibits aromas and flavors of concentrated blackberries. Pair it with a grilled, well-marbled ribeye.

title: Gorgo Bardolino 2024
bodyHtml: A fresh and fruity Bardolino made from Corvina, Rondinella and Molinara. The wine is medium bodied with notes of sour cherries, blackcurrants and a hint of black pepper. Soft and supple in the mouth, this wine has a long and fruity finish.

title: Loch Lomond 18 Year Old
bodyHtml: This is an 18 year old single malt Scotch whisky from the Loch Lomond distillery in the Highlands region. After spending 18 years maturing in oak, this expression has developed a complex flavour profile featuring red berries, mature oak, vegetal peat and runny honey. Loch Lomond are renowned for being able to produce a variety of styles at their distillery, including malts, grains and blends.

title: Z. Alexander Brown Uncaged Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Z. Alexander Brown wines are a creative collaboration between Zac Brown, of Zac Brown Band, and Napa Valley winemaker John Killebrew. Highlighting the quality of California's best-growing regions, Z. Alexander Brown wines unveil a robust style reflective of the land and the unlimited potential that can result from a pair of artists with a passion for bringing food, people and a sense of place together through creativity.

Honey-coloured in the glass, Z. Alexander Brown Chardonnay exudes bright aromas of white peach, grilled pineapple and Meyer lemon with hints of toasted oak and baking spice. A rich, velvety mouthfeel is supported by core flavours of apricot, tangerine, vanilla and beeswax. These complex, layered flavours extend into the finish. This Chardonnay is well-balanced and full-bodied with an acidic undertone, making it a perfect pairing with a wide range of fare. Pairs well with Roast chicken and caramelized or grilled vegetables, risotto, creamy soups or pasta.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '23' Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Dassai's flagship sake, '23', is refined elegance in a glass.  Dassai polished down Yamada-Nishiki rice to 23%, producing their ultimate Junmai-Daiginjo sake.  '23' delivers honey-like sweetness with an exquisite butterfly-effect finish. 

This opulent sake from Japan's Yamaguchi Prefecture reveals delicate aromas of lily, white peach, and vanilla.  This perfume is beautifully balanced with bosc pear, musk melon, and fresh rain water on the palate. Excellent depth of flavour with an elegant lasting finish.  

'23' pairs divinely with Raw Oysters, Truffle, and Spot Prawns.  

94 Points - Decanter

From Japan’s far west beyond Hiroshima, Dassai produces only junmai daiginjo in three main styles; 23, 39 and 50, reflecting their respective polishing ratios. This lovely aromatic daiginjo displays plenty of intense, fragrant floral and melon notes, fresh without the unpasteurised zing of nama sake. It is smooth and richly flavoured with melon, pear, peach and touches of coconut and cinnamon. There is a lovely rich texture and elegant, long dry finish.

title: Z. Alexander Brown Uncaged Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
Z. Alexander Brown wines are a creative collaboration between Zac Brown, of Zac Brown Band, and Napa Valley winemaker John Killebrew. Highlighting the quality of California's best-growing regions, Z. Alexander Brown wines unveil a robust style reflective of the land and the unlimited potential that can result from a pair of artists with a passion for bringing food, people and a sense of place together through creativity.

Dark garnet in the glass, commanding aromas of blueberry, caramel and toasted oak preview a bold, mouth-filling palate stacked with concentrated layers of ripe dark fruit, black cherry and milk chocolate. Robust and full-bodied with excellent weight in the mid-palate, this complex wine leaves a lasting impression with a smooth, round and full finish.

title: La Storia Cuvee 32 2022
bodyHtml:
Based on the famous 'Super Tuscans', The La Storia Cuvee 32 is a vibrant and smooth wine that has become the flagship wine for the winery. Expect intense cherry/cassis aromas contributed by the Sangiovese followed by deeper red fruit aromas of plums, blueberry and a hint of pomegranate.

Typical for the blend is an enticing mixture of herbs and spices making the wine particularly enjoyable with Italian style food. With more air the wine shows more complex yet still in developing stage aromas and flavors of cocoa, cinnamon, leather and black licorice. The mouth feel is medium to full with relatively high, food friendly acidity and a long and fresh finish.

title: Imagery Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
This crisp and elegant Chardonnay boasts a bouquet of aromas that include juicy apple, tangy lime and sweet pear, that will tantalize your taste buds. The subtle hints of oak and a touch of Chenin Blanc enhance the wine's overall liveliness, making it the perfect choice for any occasion.

The balanced flavors of green apple and vanilla lead to a creamy finish that will leave you wanting more.

title: Ultimate Provence Rose 2024
bodyHtml: The Ultimate Provence estate is on the outskirts of St. Tropez in the South of France. This is a unique, bold style and an exciting wine that packs something distinctly different. The beauty of this wine extends from the bottle to the contents. Layers of raspberry and strawberry jam in the nose invite you to a gorgeous, yet spicy palate. A fresh wine with great acidity for food pairing, but roundness to enjoy on its own. If you only have one bottle to bring, this is the ultimate wine for any occasion.

title: Austin Hope Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
The Hope family has been farming in Paso Robles for more than 30 years. When they arrived in this barely discovered region, they planted apples and grapes. Little did they know that the rolling, oak studded terrain of Paso Robles would one day become a viticultural terroir of significance and one of the top wine growing regions for quality red wine within the Central Coast.

The classic ruby colour of this wine is stunning and sets the stage for this robust Cabernet Sauvignon. On the nose, aromas of tobacco, dark chocolate shavings, fresh black currant hints of savoury notes. On the palate, layers of vanilla, coco powder, juicy cherry, baking spices and signature tobacco create a full body wine that is balanced by a splash of fresh acid and round, refined tannins.

title: Castiglion del Bosco Brunello di Montalcino 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
96 Points - James Suckling

This is really fine on the palate with wonderfully integrated tannins that give tension and focus. It’s medium-bodied with lovely berry, cherry, cedar and spice. Peaches and flower stems, too. Creamy texture. Extremely long and vivid. Structured, but showing beautiful drinkability with wonderful balance and form.

95 Points - Vinous

The 2019 Brunello di Montalcino is a gorgeous interpretation of Northwest Montalcino terroir, with a darkly alluring bouquet of sage and rosemary giving way to crushed blackberries and stone dust. This opens with a lovely inner sweetness, perfectly balanced by crisp red fruits, mineral tones and a core of vibrant acidity. It finishes grippy and long yet surprisingly fresh, with a staining of primary concentration that lingers on and on.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Deep ruby in color, the 2019 Brunello Di Montalcino opens to aromas of ripe cherries, toasted cedar, candied flowers, rosemary, and vanilla. Approachable and medium-bodied, it’s elegant on the palate, with fine tannins and a supple texture with even balanced acidity. It offers a very appealing weightless feel, with mineral underpinnings and notes of tangerine citrus on the palate.

title: Planteray XO 20th Anniversary Rum
bodyHtml: A combination of rums, aged between 12 to 20 years and rested in a variety of casks, create this 20th-anniversary edition. The result is a stunning amber colour, with aromas of fruit, vanilla, and milk chocolate. The palate reveals complex flavours of cinnamon and sweet molasses with a balanced and delicate finish.

title: Citra Montepulciano d'Abruzzo 2023 - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Deep ruby in color with purple highlights. Classic Montepulciano aromas of wild berry, dried herbs, and black pepper are framed by chewy tannin and bright acidity.

title: Le Cinciole Chianti Classico 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Panzano subregion within the Chianti Classico region of Tuscany. Podere Le Cinciole has been owned and operated by Valeria Viganò and Luca Orsini since the early 1990s. Their winemaking philosophy is rooted in a deep respect for the land, focusing on organic practices and a non invasive approach to highlight the unique galestro soil of their high altitude vineyards.

Wine Description

Le Cinciole Chianti Classico displays a bright ruby red colour. The nose is expressive and elegant, offering aromas of red cherry, raspberry, and violet, layered with subtle notes of earth, spice, and 'sous bois'. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and vibrant, featuring a core of juicy red fruit balanced by firm, chalky tannins and a refreshing acidity. It is characterized by its remarkable tension, purity of fruit, and a savory, mineral driven finish. This 100% Sangiovese wine has an ABV of 14% and is officially certified organic. The wine is aged in traditional large Slavonian oak barrels to maintain its freshness and regional identity.

Food Pairing

The high acidity and structured tannins of this Chianti Classico make it an ideal partner for traditional Tuscan cuisine. It pairs perfectly with grilled meats such as 'bistecca alla fiorentina', roasted lamb with rosemary, or wild boar ragout. Its bright fruit profile also complements tomato based pasta dishes, mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano.

title: Zontes Footstep Bolle Felici (NV)
bodyHtml: Bolle Felici is deliciously fresh and zingy. It’s the sun, it’s your friends, it’s your land of milk and honey. A chic drink with a light fizz. Bring it to life with a platter of sweet melon wrapped in wafer-thin prosciutto. This wine is cheerful, effervescent in style with delicate aromas of crunchy green apples, limes and pretty pears.

title: Black Velvet Toasted Caramel Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduced in 1951, Black Velvet Whisky is named for its signature, velvet-like texture. Black Velvet Toasted Caramel Canadian Whisky's smooth quality is the result of blending the whisky "at birth," meaning during maturation rather than later in the whisky-making process. 

The Black Velvet Distilling Company is located near the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Lethbridge, Alberta, Canada. Black Velvet Toasted Caramel Whisky is a distinctive blend, infusing hints of sweet caramel into the smooth, easy-drinking flavour you've come to expect from Black Velvet. The caramel, toffee, and cream notes accentuate and complement the woody whisky characters. The palate is rich and luscious with a creamy aftertaste that lingers and delights. A perfect balance of caramel flavour and warm, toasted notes allows its smooth, defined whisky character to come through. 

Using crystal-clear Canadian water, plus the finest rye, grains, and corn, the whisky is painstakingly distilled and put up in premium oak barrels to gently mature. Ideal for any occasion, Black Velvet Toasted Caramel Canadian Whisky has a smooth texture that is an ideal addition to countless cocktail recipes. The result is a velvety, rich whisky you can enjoy straight, on the rocks, or blended with your favourite mixer. Enjoy!

title: Zonin Prosecco Brut 1821
bodyHtml:
Very well-balanced and appealing, with the extremely delicate almond note that is typical of Prosecco. Pale straw colour, pear, melon and lime flavours. Medium-bodied with soft spritz, pear and melon flavours followed by lime flavour to finish.

An excellent aperitif, it can also be served throughout the meal, including dessert, as long as the dishes are not too strongly flavoured.

title: Astrolabe Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: The Astrolabe Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc is made from grapes grown across three Marlborough sub-regions, the Wairau Valley, the Awatere Valley and the Kekerengu Coast. The winemakers machine harvest the grapes at night or in the cool parts of the day to preserve the purity and intensity of flavours. In the winery, they take great care to handle the fruit in a way which allows the flavours and aromas of the region to come through. Sauvignon Blanc is widely considered by the wine drinkers of the world to reach its pinnacle of potential in Marlborough. The style is dry, expressive and elegantly balanced.

title: Ridge Vineyards Zinfandel Pagani Ranch 2022
bodyHtml:
From the United States, this wine hails from Sonoma Valley in California, specifically the Pagani Ranch in the Sonoma Valley AVA. Ridge Vineyards is a historic California winery founded in the 1960s and renowned for its dedication to terroir-driven winemaking. With a focus on sustainable farming and minimal intervention, Ridge has built a legacy around single-vineyard expressions—Pagani Ranch being one of its most iconic Zinfandel sources, planted in the late 19th century.

This 2022 Zinfandel showcases a deep ruby hue with vibrant clarity. On the nose, it opens with an expressive bouquet of black raspberry, cherry compote, and sweet spice, followed by hints of wild herbs and crushed violets. The palate is rich yet balanced, featuring ripe blackberry, licorice, and a touch of peppery warmth. It is medium to full-bodied, with structured tannins and refreshing acidity carrying through to a long, polished finish.

Accolades

  • Decanter (94 pts): Emphasizes the wine’s "grace" and complex spice profile (spiced blood orange and liquorice). It notes that because this is a cooler site, it is always Ridge's last harvest, resulting in a more refined, "classical" California style.

  • Wine Advocate (94 pts): Focuses on the unique aromatic layers, mentioning surprising notes of yellow peach and floral perfume alongside a long, expressive finish and silky tannins.

  • Wine Enthusiast (94 pts): Calls out the wine’s opulence and concentration, specifically praising the "raspberry-lime acidity" that prevents the rich tannins and barrel spices from feeling heavy.

Food Pairing

Pair this wine with grilled lamb chops with rosemary, slow-cooked beef stew, or roasted eggplant with Mediterranean herbs. Its bold fruit and vibrant acidity make it a superb partner for savoury, spice-laden dishes. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Salvioni Rosso di Montalcino 'La Cerbaiola' 2022
bodyHtml:
The Salvioni family has been growing Sangiovese grapes for generations, starting in the early 1900s. Thanks to the last descendent, Mr. Giulio Salvioni, this winery also vinifies and bottles Brunello di Montalcino. The first production dates back to 1985.

Ruby red in color, the Salvioni Rosso di Montalcino has a nose of rose petals and crushed flowers with bright red fruit such as ripe cherry. Concentrated, but soft and well-balanced with acidity on the palate.

title: Chateau La Nerthe Cote du Rhone Blanc 'Les Cassagnes' 2024
bodyHtml: Pale and bright color with green hints. Very aromatic nose on white orchard fruits (pear and peach) and lime notes. The mouth is fruity, showing a fine balance between richness and freshness, remains generous, round, without being heavy or alcoholic. It’s a well-balanced wine, fine and elegant!

title: Chateau Montus
bodyHtml:
Château Montus is often referred to as 'The Cathedral of Tannat' and has been nicknamed the 'Petrus of the Southwest' by some critics. Winemaker Alain Brumont is credited with single-handedly proving that world-class wines could be made in the Madiran appellation.

Wine Description

The wine presents a dense, dark ruby colour with purple reflections. The complex aroma offers notes of dark plums, mulberries, blackcurrant, and blackberries, accented by hints of peppercorns, dried herbs, sweet spices, and a touch of leather. On the palate, the wine is rich and generous, displaying concentrated dark black fruits, a massive structure, and a deep tannic profile.

Food Pairing

This full-bodied wine is an excellent match for rich, full-flavoured dishes. Suggested pairings include grilled steak, roast beef, rack of lamb, or traditional French dishes like duck confit and cassoulet.

title: Mezcal de Leyendas Jabali
bodyHtml:
Handcrafted by 5th generation Maestro Mezcalero Cosme 'Tucho' Hernandez Martinez, Mezcal de Leyendas Maguey Jabalí Oaxaca is an artisanal mezcal blanco. It's made from maguey 'Jabalí', an endemic agave variety from Oaxaca that's mostly grown in the wild.

The nose is greeted with complex spices and dried chiles. The well-balanced palate brings meaty flavors of overripe fruits. The finish is long, savory, and earthy.

title: Gerard Bertrand Cote des Roses Rose Wine 2025
bodyHtml: A wine to celebrate the Mediterranean Art of Living! Its originality lies in its original rose-shaped bottle, created by a young designer from Ecole Boulle. A soft, pale, brilliant pink with bluish tints developing over time towards more orangey nuances. The bouquet releases aromas of summer fruits, cassis, and redcurrant. Floral notes of rose along with hints of grapefruit complete the picture. The finish is fresh, offering notes of candy. On the palate, the impression is fresh and full, with great aromatic persistence and balance. Pairs well as an aperitif or with shellfish and subtly spiced dishes.

title: Umberto Cesari Costa Di Rose 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This rosé wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Rubicone IGT area within the Emilia-Romagna region. Founded in 1964 by Umberto Cesari in the hills of Castel San Pietro Terme, the winery was among the first to champion the potential of Sangiovese in this territory. The winery's philosophy combines a deep respect for local tradition and the environment with the use of modern technology to produce high-quality wines that reflect their regional identity. Costa Di Rose is designed as a contemporary interpretation of Sangiovese, intended to showcase the variety's multifaceted personality through a fresh and refined lens.

Wine Description

Umberto Cesari Costa Di Rose displays a brilliant antique rose colour with silky highlights. The nose is delicate and fragrant, offering a bouquet of wild strawberries, raspberries, and cherries layered with notes of pomegranate, sweet violets, and a subtle hint of poppy. On the palate, the wine is crisp, linear, and remarkably fresh, featuring vibrant acidity and a pleasant savouriness. It is characterized by its long-lingering, aromatic fruitiness and a classic Sangiovese touch of dried plum on the finish. This 100% Sangiovese is produced from vineyards with an average age of 10 years, undergoes low-temperature fermentation, and matures for 6 months in stainless steel tanks to preserve its purity of fruit. The ABV is 12.5%, and while the winery emphasizes sustainable viticulture, the wine is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through three to five years.

title: Umberto Cesari Prosecco Liano
bodyHtml: Umberto Cesari Winery, founded in 1964, lies in the hills of Castel San Pietro Terme, in western Romagna. Their winemaking has always focused on our local native grapes, but over time they have added international varieties as well. Day by day, they have watched their vineyards grow, as has their awareness that their local growing area is their most important natural resource.

title: Anthonij Rupert Optima Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml: Complex bouquet of fruitcake, cedar, cocoa and a perfumed whiff of dried lavender. Broad, fleshy and succulent with all of that the nose promises being delivered on the palate. Spice sprinkled cedar with rich dark fruitcake flavour. Wonderfully soft, rounded and silky palate that shows cohesion and refinement. Impressive density and concentration that doesn’t overwhelm. Nor does the oak used in the maturation of this impressive blend. Plush, comfortable and eminently rewarding with a lingering dry tail.

title: Escorihuela 1884 Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
This high-altitude dry red wine originates from Argentina, crafted in the prestigious Uco Valley of the Mendoza region. Founded in 1884 by Don Miguel Escorihuela Gascón, Bodega Escorihuela Gascón is one of Mendoza's oldest and most historic operating wineries. The "1884" Gran Reserva line pays homage to the winery’s founding year and reflects a commitment to single-varietal purity and extended oak aging. Sourced primarily from high-elevation vineyards in subregions like Agrelo and the Uco Valley (situated over 3,000 feet above sea level), the vines benefit from intense solar radiation, dramatic diurnal temperature swings, and mineral-rich alluvial soils irrigated by Andean snowmelt.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2021 vintage displays a deep, dark ruby color with dark violet edges.
