The expressive nose opens with intense aromas of ripe black currant, cassis, and black cherry, layered alongside signature herbal notes of crushed eucalyptus, bell pepper, and graphite, framed by subtle toasted oak nuances of cedar, sweet tobacco, and dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, structured, and muscular, delivering a dense core of dark fruit balanced by firm, fine-grained tannins and a streak of crisp mountain acidity. Crafted from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the hand-harvested grapes undergo careful sorting, cold maceration, and temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks. The wine is aged for approximately 12 to 14 months in French oak barrels before additional bottle aging prior to release. The alcohol by volume sits at 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The muscular structure, firm tannic backbone, and savory herbal accents of this Argentine Cabernet Sauvignon make it an exceptional match for rich, savory red meat dishes. It pairs naturally with classic Argentine asado, including grilled ribeye steak, skirt steak with chimichurri sauce, roasted rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, and venison loin. It also complements traditional beef empanadas, wild mushroom risotto, and aged hard cheeses like Manchego, sharp Cheddar, or mature Gouda.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Mendoza was an exceptional, cool-climate season that yielded wines of striking aromatic purity, elevated natural acidity, and refined structural elegance. Lower summer temperatures allowed Cabernet Sauvignon grapes to undergo prolonged, uniform ripening without over-concentration, preserving fresh fruit character and vibrant acidity. The 2021 Escorihuela 1884 Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon offers impressive immediate fruit density upon release after decanting, while possessing the structural integrity to cellar comfortably over the next 8 to 12 years.

title: El Tequileno Reposado Gran Reserva Tequila
bodyHtml:
Best Tequila of the Year 2023 - International Spirits Challenge

El Tequileno Gran Reserva is made from 100% Estate Agave grown in the Highlands of Jalisco. It is aged for a minimum of 4 months in American Oak and blended with small amounts of Anejo. This is a must-have for any reposado collector.

title: Takara Sho Chiku Bai Shirakabegura Mio Sparkling Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Takara Sake, a leading international producer of sake and mirin, this sparkling expression is crafted at the renowned Shirakabegura brewery. The brewery is located in the Nada district, which is historically significant as Japan's premier sake-producing region due to its superior water quality and proximity to high-quality rice.

Description

This sparkling sake features a clear, effervescent appearance with persistent fine bubbles. The aroma is bright and inviting, offering scents of fresh grape, ripe pear, and a hint of melon. On the palate, it delivers a refreshing and light-bodied profile with a delicate sweetness that is perfectly balanced by a crisp acidity. The finish is clean and lively, making it an approachable choice for those new to sake. ABV 5%.

title: Alhambra Reserve 1925 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Alhambra Reserva 1925 is a distinguished lager produced by Cervezas Alhambra, a brewery founded in 1925 in Granada, Spain. This beer is celebrated for its craftsmanship and the use of the legendary Saaz hop variety, which contributes to its unique character.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Dark amber with a bright appearance and a thick, creamy foam head.
  • Aroma: Intense aroma combining soft fruity notes with subtle hints of cereal, complemented by light floral and spice overtones characteristic of Saaz hops.
  • Palate: Full-bodied with flavors of toasted cereal and hops, perfectly balanced by medium bitterness and spicy hints, leading to a rich, highly agreeable taste.

Alcohol Content:

6.4% ABV.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Best served chilled at 6-8 °C (42.8–46.4 °F).

  • Glassware: Ideal for serving in a pilsner glass to enhance its aromatic profile and maintain its carbonation.

  • Food Pairings: Complements a variety of dishes, including grilled meats, seafood, and spicy cuisine, enhancing the dining experience with its balanced bitterness and rich flavor.

title: Chateau Minuty 'M' Cotes de Provence Rose 2025
bodyHtml: M de Minuty is the quintessential Cotes de Provence rosé, a style that Chateau Minuty defined, and is the reason behind their success as the world's top producer of premium rosé. Fresh, lively and perfectly balanced, fantastic quality, glass in hand transports you to the seaside and the French riviera lifestyle, watching the sea and the sky, surrounding yourself with friends and family, and enjoying life to the fullest.

title: The Prisoner Wine Co. - Unshackled Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml:
Produced by The Prisoner Wine Company, a disruptive Napa Valley-based winery founded in 2000 and acclaimed for breaking traditional blending conventions, the Unshackled tier was created to deliver bold, approachable, and contemporary California expressions with vibrant fruit purity. Guided by Director of Winemaking Chrissy Wittmann, the winemaking philosophy centers on multi-regional sourcing to layer cool-climate structure with warm-climate richness, utilizing temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation followed by maturation in a combination of French and American oak barrels (including neutral and seasoned wood) to craft a plush, fruit-forward Cabernet Sauvignon without heavy oak dominance.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep, opaque ruby-purple hue. On the nose, it opens with vibrant, expressive aromas of ripe blackberry, black cherry, and plum, layered with subtle notes of vanilla bean, cracked black pepper, sweet baking spices, and a hint of dried sage. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full body with a smooth, supple, and crowd-pleasing mouthfeel. Concentrated dark berry fruit flavors are framed by soft, rounded tannins and balanced natural acidity that keeps the profile lively and approachable. The finish is clean, warm, and moderately persistent, echoing with dark cocoa, gentle toasted oak, and ripe black fruit.

title: Bonanza Cabernet Sauvignon (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from the United States, produced in the California region. Bonanza is a non vintage Cabernet Sauvignon created by Chuck Wagner, the owner and winemaker of the world renowned Caymus Vineyards. The winery's philosophy is centred on creating a 'multi lot' wine that celebrates the everyday enjoyment of Cabernet, sourcing fruit from diverse California vineyards to achieve a consistent, delicious, and approachable style.

Wine Description

The Bonanza Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep, dark ruby colour with a purple rim. The nose is expressive and inviting, offering aromas of luscious blackberries, dark cherries, and currants, complemented by subtle notes of vanilla, toasted oak, and a hint of dried herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and supple, delivering flavours of ripe dark fruit, blueberry jam, and cocoa with a touch of sweet spice. It is characterized by its velvety texture, balanced acidity, and a long, fruit forward finish with silky tannins. This wine is primarily Cabernet Sauvignon, often blended with small amounts of other red varietals to enhance its roundness. The ABV is typically 14.6%. The wine is not certified organic, and the optimal drinking window is within 1 to 5 years of release.

title: Orin Swift 8 Years In The Desert 2022
bodyHtml:
Orin Swift 8 Years In The Desert originates from California, United States, and is typically sourced from diverse vineyard sites across the state, including the North Coast and Napa County. The winery was founded in 1998 by Dave Phinney, who named the venture by combining his father's middle name, Orin, with his mother's maiden name, Swift. The brand is currently owned by E. & J. Gallo, though Phinney remains the creative force behind its innovative labels and winemaking philosophy. The name of this particular wine refers to the eight year period during which Phinney was legally barred from producing Zinfandel blends after selling his previous brand, The Prisoner.

Wine Description

This red blend presents a dark, nearly opaque crimson colour with an amethyst or purple rim. The sensory profile is intense and exuberant, opening with aromas of ripe blueberry, black plum, wild raspberry, and espresso bean, accented by notes of allspice, cedar, and sweet oak. On the full bodied palate, it is unctuous and concentrated, delivering flavours of blackberry jam, black plum preserves, and morning bun, alongside hints of dark chocolate and dried tarragon. The structure is defined by soft, textured tannins and a bright acidity that helps balance the wine's powerful fruit core.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically a blend of Zinfandel, Petite Sirah, and Syrah (the 2023 vintage is 74% Zinfandel, 24% Petite Sirah, and 2% Syrah).

  • ABV: Typically high, recorded at 15.6% for recent vintages.

  • Ageing: Matured for approximately seven to eight months in French oak, with roughly 32% to 35% new oak.

93 Points - Decanter

A proprietary red blend of Zinfandel, Petite Sirah, and Syrah aged seven months in 32% new oak. Brambly red berry fruit, red spices, curry, coriander, cumin, and cedarwood were kissed with vanilla. Round, rich, silken red berry fruits, strawberry preserves, and grilled herbs are harnessed by intricate tannins of fine-grained cedarwood with a long saline mineral finish augmented by crunchy cinnamon-kissed red berry fruits.

title: Triennes Rose Mediterranee 2025
bodyHtml: A crush of salty, stony minerality and crisp watermelon introduces this svelte, thirst-quenching Rosé. Dusty pink in hue, it's a briskly concentrated sip marked by splashes of raspberry and wild strawberry flavours.

title: The Pale By Sacha Lichine 2025
bodyHtml:
Created by Sacha Lichine following his acquisition of Château d’Esclans in 2006, his vision was to create the greatest rosés in the world igniting the “Rosé Renaissance”. Sacha introduced new and innovative winemaking techniques to Provence which revolutionized the styles of rosés being produced from this region. This led to the creation of Whispering Angel, a world class rosé which presents both ease and accessibility making for enjoyment and pleasure.
 
Named after its transparent, pink colour, The Pale by Sacha Lichine embodies all the characteristics of an authentic Rosé from Provence. It is expressive both inside and out and bears great aromatic freshness on the nose followed by more subtle, fruity notes on the palate. Its elegant palate pairs nicely with its colourful and playful label. Let The Pale by Sacha Lichine transport you to the roaring twenties.

title: Banshee 'Ten Of Cups' Sparkling (NV)
bodyHtml:
Vibrant, bright and aromatic with notes of tropical fruit, green apple and citrus complemented by marzipan and honeysuckle. The wine is persistent on the palate and creamy on the finish, with hints of toast rounding out this beautiful, balanced wine.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This elegant, well-balanced wine is trim and compact, offering subtle crisp apple and bright lemon notes lightly accented by toast and ginger. Relatively light and restrained, it is wonderfully appetizing and will make an excellent aperitif.

title: Ornellaia 2021 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Ornellaia 2021 displays the characteristics of a typical vintage in Bolgheri, with not a few sunny spells and devoid of rain, crafting a rich and concentrated wine that is also deeply expressive and generous. Signature notes of Mediterranean shrub, herbs, cypress berries, classic blackberry and dark fruit aromas unfurl on the nose, accompanying a palate endowed with dense tannins but certainly not lacking in precision and finesse. The finish is vibrant and enduring, bringing a feeling of aromatic freshness and elegance.

99 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blackcurrants, iodine, crushed stone, hints of mint and sage. Blue fruits. Full-bodied with chewy tannins that open with air. It’s racy and very long. Very tannin driven and energetic with power and focus. Muscular and very toned. This is the best Ornellaia for the cellar in years.

98 Points - Wine Spectator

An intense red, defined by lively acidity and framed by dense, ripe tannins that showcase its black currant, blackberry, violet and toasty oak aromas and flavors. Iron and wild herb accents emerge as this plays out on the finish. Though expressive at this stage, this youthful version will benefit from time in bottle. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Best from 2027 through 2046.

97 Points - Decanter

While the summer was hot and dry, with three months of drought, the vines' roots were able to tap water reserves which had been topped up by rainfall the previous winter and spring. Despite the warm growing season, Ornellaia 2021 feels less dense and muscular than vintages of old, offering pretty floral and wild herb perfumes alongside ripe red and black fruit scents. It's intense, fresh and vertical in character, with fine, ripe, round tannins that seem to be a trademark of the vintage – it's a gorgeous, breezy iteration of the Bolgheri benchmark that is already drinking well. The blend is 53% Cabernet Sauvignon (up from 50% in 2020), 25% Merlot (down from 32%), 15% Cabernet Franc (up from 13%) and 7% Petit Verdot (up from 5%); a carefully considered response from the winemaking team to the increasingly warm summers in the region.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Ornellaia 2021 Bolgheri Superiore Ornellaia offers an extra layer of richness, generosity and plushness that shapes a very open-knit and exuberant Tuscan red. The blend is 53% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot, 15% Cabernet Franc and 7% Petit Verdot. You feel the fruit and oak weight of the wine, the extract and the 15% alcohol content. All of these elements come together to big effect. From that power, you get black cherry, dark fruit, sweet spice and barbecue smoke. The fruit tannins are young, and this edition of Ornellaia proves worthy for medium or long-term drinking, especially as it softens up with more bottle age.

title: Cantina Del Pino Langhe Nebbiolo 2024
bodyHtml: Grown in Barbaresco and aged for eight months in stainless steel, this wine has all the fruity and spicy characteristics of a traditional Barbaresco, but it is meant to be consumed young. Complex and smooth with a good structure of fruit and tannins. Rich and ample, with berries, spice and leather. Dried cherry, mint, tobacco, licorice, incense and crushed flowers are all nicely lifted in this aromatic, easygoing Langhe Nebbiolo.

title: Cusumano Alta Mora Etna Rosso 2023
bodyHtml:
Italy’s Cusumano Alta Mora Etna Rosso hails from the slopes of Mount Etna in Sicily, one of Europe’s most active volcanoes. The Cusumano family, renowned in Sicily for revitalizing traditional winemaking, established the Alta Mora project to honour Etna’s unique terroir, cultivating vineyards at high altitudes on volcanic soils. Their vision emphasizes minimal intervention and respect for the environment, showcasing the purity and minerality typical of Etna wines.

Wine Description
This ruby-hued red wine is crafted entirely from Nerello Mascalese, a native varietal celebrated for its elegance and vibrancy. The nose is perfumed with red cherry, wild strawberry, rose petals, and hints of flint and dried herbs. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and finely structured, offering flavours of sour cherry, crushed stones, and a touch of black tea. The tannins are firm yet polished, and the finish is long with lingering mineral notes.

Food Pairing
Ideal alongside grilled lamb chops, mushroom risotto, or Sicilian caponata. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Studio Rose by Miraval 2025
bodyHtml:
Studio Rose by Miraval originates from the IGP Méditerranée region of Provence, France. The estate, famously associated with Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie since 2008, is managed in partnership with the legendary winemaking Perrin family. Named as a tribute to the on-site recording studio where Pink Floyd recorded 'The Wall', the wine embodies a philosophy of Mediterranean 'Art de Vivre' and is influenced by the unique, salty soils near the coast.

Wine Description

This wine presents a seductive, very pale pink colour with bright pastel reflections. The nose is elegant and refined, offering a superb aromatic bouquet of small red berries, cherry blossom, and grapefruit. On the palate, the wine is ample and racy, featuring seductive flavours of blood orange, redcurrant, and white peach, balanced by a fresh mineral structure and a hint of sea iodine. It is a medium-bodied, dry rosé with a long, saline finish that highlights its coastal character.

title: Clos Cibonne Rose 'Cuvee Tradition' 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction
Clos Cibonne is a historic Provençal estate with roots dating back to the 18th century. Family-owned for generations, it holds the prestigious Cru Classé designation and is renowned for championing the rare Tibouren grape. Overlooking the Mediterranean, the vineyard benefits from cooling sea breezes and a unique microclimate that shapes the estate’s distinctive rosé style. The winery’s philosophy blends tradition with minimal intervention, producing age-worthy rosés of remarkable character.

Wine Description
The 2023 Clos Cibonne Rosé ‘Cuvee Tradition’ displays a delicate salmon-pink colour with a coppery hue. Aromas reveal layers of dried strawberry, blood orange zest, Mediterranean herbs, and a subtle saline lift. On the palate, it offers medium body with a textured, almost savoury depth, underscored by flavours of peach skin, thyme, citrus rind, and gentle spice. Aged for 12 months under a thin layer of yeast (fleurette) in large century-old oak casks, the wine gains a distinctive umami nuance and remarkable persistence. The finish is long and complex, balancing freshness with a lingering herbal-mineral note.

Food Pairing
Ideal alongside Provençal classics such as pissaladière, bouillabaisse, and salade niçoise. It also complements tomato-based pasta, grilled prawns, and aged cheeses. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Mission Hill Meritage Estate 2022
bodyHtml:
Mission Hill Family Estate, located in the heart of British Columbia’s Okanagan Valley, is one of Canada's most iconic wineries. Founded in 1981 and owned by Anthony von Mandl, Mission Hill is known for its commitment to sustainability, architectural grandeur, and focus on crafting expressive, terroir-driven wines that reflect the unique climate and soils of the region.

Wine Description
A deep ruby red, the 2022 Meritage Estate opens with inviting aromas of black cherry, cassis, and dried herbs, accented by hints of cedar and vanilla from careful oak aging. On the palate, it is full-bodied and structured, showcasing dark fruit, graphite, and subtle spice with refined tannins and a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing
Pair this bold red with grilled lamb chops, prime rib, or wild mushroom risotto. The structured tannins and layered flavours make it a standout with aged cheddar or truffle-infused dishes. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Chateau Haut Brion 2016 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
In the prestigious Bordeaux region, Château Haut Brion resides in the Pessac Léognan subregion of Graves. Recognized as the oldest of the Bordeaux First Growth estates, its history dates back to the 16th century, and it has been owned by Domaine Clarence Dillon since 1935. The château is renowned for its dedication to precision and innovation, consistently producing wines that reflect both tradition and the unique character of its exceptional terroir.

Wine Description
The 2016 Château Haut Brion reveals a deep, opaque ruby colour, exuding concentration and depth. Aromatically, the wine opens with layers of blackcurrant, plum, graphite, cigar box, and subtle floral notes, all interwoven with a gentle smokiness. On the palate, the blend—composed of approximately 56% Merlot, 37.5% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 6.5% Cabernet Franc—delivers remarkable power balanced by finesse, featuring velvety tannins, a core of ripe black fruit, and hints of spice and earth. Full-bodied and impeccably structured, the wine finishes long and savoury, with extraordinary freshness and mineral precision. Best enjoyed from 2026 to 2060, it is a benchmark example of the château's mastery in both richness and elegance.

Accolades
Wine Spectator – 98 points
Robert Parker – 100 points
Vinous – 100 points

Food Pairing
Superb with roasted venison, beef Wellington, or truffle-infused risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

Vintage Quality
The 2016 vintage in Bordeaux is widely celebrated as exceptional, marked by a cool, wet spring and a perfectly warm, dry summer that allowed for slow, even ripening. The result is a vintage of remarkable balance, purity, and ageing potential, with Château Haut Brion achieving extraordinary finesse and depth through meticulous vineyard and cellar work.

title: Tamnavulin 1970 Speyside Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Born in December 1970, only four years after the distillery was opened. There are fewer than 1,000 individually numbered bottles of this exceptional single malt. Non-Chill Filtered.

Maturation... Initially matured in Bourbon Barrels, then aged in 30 Years Old Apostoles Oloroso Sherry Butts before being returned into First Fill Bourbon barrels for a final finishing period. This 48-year-old whisky is the oldest in the Tamnavulin collection.

Colour... Golden copper.

Nose... Creamy caramel, juicy pear, walnut cake and nutty praline.

Palate... Dark treacle, delicate frangipane, tropical coconut and ripe figs.

title: South Star Speyside Single Malt 10 Year Old
bodyHtml: A mysterious Speyside single malt from independent bottler South Star Spirits. This particular expression was distilled in 2011 and given ten years to mature in ten first-fill hogshead, until it was bottled up at 48% ABV. With a whole load of distilleries in Speyside, it might be tough figuring out which one was responsible for this whisky, so perhaps just enjoy it for what it is – delicious!

title: Pierre Paillard La Grande Recolte Bouzy Grand Cru 2012
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Pierre Paillard La Grande Récolte Bouzy Grand Cru 2012 is a vintage Champagne from France, produced in the Montagne de Reims region. It comes from the prestigious Bouzy appellation, which is classified as a Grand Cru. Champagne Pierre Paillard is a renowned family-owned vigneron house. La Grande Récolte is an assemblage of old Chardonnay and Pinot Noir vines, embodying the quintessence of the Pierre Paillard vineyard's expertise. This cuvée is made only in great years to highlight the richness of an exceptional vintage. The bottles were matured in the Paillard's deep cellar for 10 years before disgorgement, which is necessary to achieve the distinct, complex style of the house.

Wine Description

This Champagne reveals a bright golden hue, animated by an exceptionally fine and persistent stream of bubbles. The aromatic profile is broad and refined, offering notes of red fruits, blood orange, and wet chalk. These primary aromas evolve into nuances of brioche, toasted hazelnut, and candied citrus.

It is an assemblage of old vines, typically a blend of 50% Chardonnay and 50% Pinot Noir, though some sources report 45% Chardonnay and 55% Pinot Noir. The wine is medium to full-bodied, ample, and concentrated, with a bright lemon acidity. On the palate, it has a highly layered and gastronomic character, with strata of chalk, lemon, and white cherry streaming along the supple palate. The bubbles are thin, creamy, and sensuous. Stylistically, it is tense, sophisticated, and very complex, displaying concentrated intensity while retaining remarkable elegance and gracefulness. It is an Extra Brut with a very low dosage of 1.8 grams per litre (g/l) or 1 g/l. The ABV is $12.5\%$. The finish is long, mineral, precise, marked by great class, ample flake salts, and a lingering meringue and saline quality.

Accolades

  • Gismondi On Wine - 93 points

  • Robert Parker - 94 points

Food Pairing

This Champagne is undoubtedly the perfect companion to match with decadent food. Suggested pairings include scallops, foie gras, and lobster.

Vintage Quality

The 2012 vintage in Champagne was distinguished by its complexity and precision, making it a truly exceptional year. It is considered one of the best vintages of recent decades. The season benefited from ideal climatic conditions that favoured a harmonious and optimal maturation of the grapes. The resulting wine is noted for its complexity and well-defined character.

title: La Venenosa Sierra Del Tigre
bodyHtml: The crown jewel of the La Venenosa line-up, not a statement of its greatness necessarily, but of its rarity. From the municipality of La Manzanilla de la Paz located in the famous town of Jalisco, this is a single-distilled raicilla made from the wild foraged agave Inaequidens.

title: Chivas Regal 25 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The world's first luxury whisky. Taking New York by storm in 1909, this legendary whisky has seen it all. Having survived two World Wars and outlived Prohibition, this 25-year-old Scotch whisky was reborn to be saluted and honoured evermore. Because blended is better in life and in Scotch.

Only the rarest 25-year-old Scotch whiskies are blended together for this legendary blend. Every drop is meticulously blended to rekindle the light intensities and subtle textures made famous by the original Chivas 25 in the early 1900s.

title: Casanova Di Neri 'IrRosso Toscana' 2023
bodyHtml:
Italy’s famed Tuscany region, specifically around Montalcino, is home to Casanova di Neri, an estate founded in 1971 by Giovanni Neri. Today, Giacomo Neri, his son, leads the winery with a vision that seamlessly blends tradition and modern innovation. Casanova di Neri is celebrated for its meticulous vineyard management and unwavering commitment to expressing the unique terroir of Montalcino.

Wine Description

The Rosso Toscana 2023 pours a vivid ruby red. On the nose, it reveals vibrant notes of ripe cherries, wild strawberries, and hints of rose petal, underpinned by subtle earthy undertones. The palate is lively and medium-bodied, offering flavours of juicy red berries, delicate spice, and a touch of mineral. Silky tannins and fresh acidity give the wine structure and elegance, leading to a graceful, lingering finish.

Food Pairing

Pair this wine with classic Tuscan dishes such as pappardelle with wild boar ragu or grilled lamb chops seasoned with rosemary. It also complements hard cheeses like pecorino. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Wynns Shiraz Coonawarra Estate 2021
bodyHtml:
This elegant Shiraz hails from Australia, specifically the renowned Coonawarra region in South Australia. Wynns Coonawarra Estate, established in 1891 and owned by Treasury Wine Estates, is celebrated for its heritage vineyards planted on Coonawarra’s famed terra rossa soils. The winery’s philosophy combines respect for tradition with a commitment to expressing varietal and regional purity.

Wine Description

The Wynns Shiraz 2021 displays a vibrant deep ruby colour. On the nose, it offers enticing aromas of dark cherries, mulberries, and a subtle lift of black pepper, underscored by hints of liquorice and gentle oak spice. The palate is medium-bodied yet generously flavoured, showcasing ripe berry fruits, fine-grained tannins, and a whisper of mocha. It finishes with impressive length and a balanced freshness, making it immediately appealing while promising several years of graceful development.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, roasted duck, or a hearty mushroom risotto. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience that accentuates the wine’s vibrant fruit and savoury spice.

title: Alois Lageder Chardonnay 'Lowengang' 2016
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from Italy, specifically the Alto Adige region in the foothills of the Dolomites. Alois Lageder is a family-owned winery founded in 1823, now led by Alois Clemens Lageder, the sixth generation. The estate is renowned for its commitment to biodynamic viticulture and an ethos of sustainability, producing wines that express the unique Alpine terroir with precision and elegance.

Wine Description

Lowengang Chardonnay is a striking expression of Alto Adige Chardonnay. It presents a brilliant straw yellow color with golden reflections. On the nose, it reveals layered aromas of ripe orchard fruits such as golden apple and pear, intertwined with citrus zest, subtle vanilla, and delicate notes of hazelnut and flint. The palate is full-bodied and finely textured, delivering a balanced interplay of rich fruit, bright acidity, and a gentle mineral backbone that carries through to a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing

Pair this sophisticated Chardonnay with seared scallops, roasted chicken with thyme, or a wild mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Vignerons De Buxy Cote Chalonnaise Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
This Chardonnay hails from France, specifically the Côte Chalonnaise subregion in Burgundy. Founded in 1931, Vignerons De Buxy is a cooperative winery that brings together passionate growers from the Côte Chalonnaise and Mâconnais. United by a shared philosophy of expressing terroir with precision and respect for nature, the winery has become a key player in elevating the region’s reputation for quality wines.

Wine Description

This wine shines a bright pale gold in the glass. The nose is fresh and inviting, opening with delicate aromas of white flowers, citrus zest, and green apple, layered with subtle hints of hazelnut and chalky minerality. On the palate, it is vibrant and medium-bodied, showcasing flavours of lemon curd, crisp pear, and a touch of almond. A fine balance between bright acidity and gentle creaminess leads to a clean, persistent finish with lingering notes of citrus and wet stone.

Food Pairing

Pair this Chardonnay with grilled shrimp skewers, roasted chicken with lemon and herbs, or a creamy mushroom risotto. These dishes beautifully highlight the wine’s freshness and nuanced minerality. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Kokanee Gold 355 ml - 15 Cans
bodyHtml: Brewed with a blend of 4 malts and western grown North American Hops. Rich amber colour, brewed to a fuller body with a hint of caramel after taste.

title: Storyteller Gin Cocktail Mixer Pack 355 ml - 6 Cans
bodyHtml:
Contains:

2x Lime Rickey

2x Bee's Knees

2x French 75

This cocktail mixer pack includes an artful trio of botanically inspired flavours designed to complement gin perfectly. Each mixer exhibits a unique sensory profile—from citrusy brightness and floral notes to herbaceous depth and a crisp, refreshing finish. With a medium body and clean structure, the mixers are balanced to enhance rather than overpower, allowing the nuanced character of the gin to shine through.

Formulated with natural juices, extracts, and carefully calibrated sweetness, these mixers elevate the classic gin cocktail into a modern, effortless indulgence. Best enjoyed chilled, shaken or stirred with your preferred gin, and served over ice.

title: Mas de Daumas Gassac Rose Frizzante 2023
bodyHtml:
From the south of France, this sparkling rosé hails from the Languedoc region, specifically the Gassac Valley near Aniane. Mas de Daumas Gassac, founded in the 1970s by Aimé and Véronique Guibert, is often dubbed the ‘Grand Cru of the Midi.’ The estate has gained international acclaim for its commitment to low-intervention winemaking and its unique, terroir-driven wines that defy expectations for the region.

This 2023 Rosé Frizzante displays a vibrant pale pink hue with fine, persistent bubbles. On the nose, it bursts with fresh red berries, crushed strawberries, and hints of citrus blossom. The palate is crisp and lively, offering notes of raspberry, grapefruit, and a delicate herbal undertone. Light-bodied and refreshingly dry, the wine finishes clean with a subtle mineral streak. Made primarily from Cabernet Sauvignon with a touch of local varietals, this frizzante-style rosé is best enjoyed young, ideally within 2 years of the vintage to capture its brightness and charm. It stands out for its freshness and finesse, offering a refined sparkling experience.

Food Pairing
Pair this sparkling rosé with summer salads, grilled prawns, or goat cheese tartlets. It also complements sushi and light Mediterranean fare. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Freixenet Premium Cava Rose
bodyHtml:
Crafted in Spain, this sparkling rosé originates from the Penedès region in Catalonia, a historic winemaking area celebrated for its Cava production. Freixenet, founded in 1861 and still family-owned, has become one of the world’s most iconic Cava producers, known for its commitment to traditional methods combined with innovation. The estate emphasizes sustainability and precision in viticulture to ensure quality in every bottle.

This elegant rosé displays a vibrant pale pink hue with fine, persistent bubbles. Aromas of wild strawberries, red currants, and subtle floral notes rise from the glass, leading to a lively palate of fresh raspberry, ripe cherry, and hints of citrus zest. Light-bodied and refreshingly crisp, it delivers a balanced acidity and a clean, smooth finish. Made predominantly from Trepat grapes with a touch of Garnacha, it is best enjoyed young to capture its fresh, fruit-driven charm.

Food Pairing
Pair this sparkling rosé with fresh seafood, charcuterie, or goat cheese salad. It also complements light pasta dishes or can be enjoyed on its own as an aperitif. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: El Gran Legado De Vida Anejo
bodyHtml:
Crafted in Mexico, El Gran Legado De Vida Anejo hails from the heart of Jalisco, the historic centre of tequila production. The brand is a tribute to Mexican heritage and craftsmanship, produced by a family-owned distillery dedicated to traditional methods and sustainable practices. With a focus on artisanal quality, the producers emphasize slow-cooked agave and extended aging to create a rich, refined spirit.

This anejo tequila presents a deep amber colour, reflective of its lengthy aging process in oak barrels. On the nose, expect layers of cooked agave, vanilla, caramel, and toasted oak, complemented by subtle spice and dried fruit. The palate is smooth and full-bodied, offering a harmonious blend of sweet and savoury flavours—think butterscotch, nutmeg, and hints of tobacco. The finish is long and warming, with lingering notes of dark chocolate and roasted nuts. Made from 100% blue Weber agave, this tequila is aged for over 12 months, offering complexity and elegance typically associated with aged spirits. Best enjoyed neat or in a premium cocktail.

title: Bodegas Piedra Verdejo Piedra 2024
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1968, Bodegas Piedra is a family-run estate located in the Guareña Valley of Toro. The estate is renowned for its sustainable viticulture and commitment to expressing the unique terroir of its old-vine vineyards. With a deep respect for tradition and a progressive spirit, the winery crafts expressive wines that highlight the richness of the region.

Wine Description
This 100% Verdejo displays a bright pale yellow hue with greenish reflections. On the nose, it offers vibrant aromas of citrus blossom, white peach, and freshly cut grass, layered with hints of fennel and stone fruit. The palate is crisp and refreshing, with zesty acidity balanced by a subtle creaminess and a mineral-driven finish. Medium-bodied with a lingering, elegant close, this wine showcases the hallmark freshness and complexity of Verdejo from Toro. Best enjoyed young, within 2–3 years of the vintage to preserve its aromatic intensity.

Food Pairing
Excellent with grilled prawns, citrus-marinated chicken, or a fresh goat cheese salad. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Il Borro Rose Borrorosa 2024
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Italy’s Tuscany region, Il Borro Rosé Borrorosa 2024 hails from the Valdarno di Sopra subregion, nestled in the foothills of the Apennines. Il Borro, a historic estate dating back to the 13th century and revitalized by the Ferragamo family in the late 1990s, is a fully organic property dedicated to expressing the land through sustainability and precision viticulture.

This 2024 vintage displays a radiant pale pink hue, with an expressive nose of wild strawberries, fresh red cherries, and delicate floral undertones of rose petal and white blossoms. On the palate, it is crisp and elegant, offering flavours of raspberry, pomegranate, and a touch of citrus zest. The wine is light to medium in body, with a vibrant acidity and a clean, mineral-driven finish. Composed primarily of Sangiovese, it is best enjoyed young, ideally within two to three years of release to preserve its freshness and finesse.

Food Pairing
Enjoy it with grilled prawns, watermelon and feta salad, or thinly sliced prosciutto with melon. A perfect match to enhance the wine’s complexity.

title: Road 13 Honest John's White 2024
bodyHtml:
Canada, British Columbia, Okanagan Valley – Golden Mile Bench
Road 13 Vineyards is a celebrated winery located in the heart of the Golden Mile Bench sub-appellation, known for producing expressive, terroir-driven wines. Under the stewardship of Anthony von Mandl's Iconic Wineries of British Columbia, Road 13 has built its reputation on a blend of tradition and innovation, honouring its roots while embracing forward-thinking viticulture.

Wine Description
This vibrant white blend shimmers a pale straw in the glass. The nose is a lively interplay of tropical fruit, citrus blossom, and melon, supported by hints of green apple and honeysuckle. On the palate, it is fresh and crisp, with flavours of pear, pineapple, and lime zest unfolding in layered harmony. Medium-bodied with bright acidity, it finishes clean and mineral-driven. Crafted from a mix of aromatic white varietals—most commonly Chardonnay, Viognier, Sauvignon Blanc, and Chenin Blanc—this wine is best enjoyed young, ideally within 1–3 years of the vintage to preserve its vivid character. Its hallmark is balance and purity, showcasing the Okanagan’s sunny climate and cool evenings.

Food Pairing
Pair this expressive white with grilled halibut, chicken piccata, fresh garden salads with citrus vinaigrette, or goat cheese crostini. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Tenuta Olim Bauda Grignolino D'Asti Isolavilla 2024
bodyHtml:
This elegant wine hails from Italy, in the renowned Piedmont region, specifically within the Asti subregion. Tenuta Olim Bauda is a family-owned estate run by the Bertolino family, who have meticulously revived historic vineyards with a focus on preserving local grape varieties. Their commitment to quality and tradition shines through in their expressive wines, which capture the unique terroir of their carefully tended plots.

Wine Description

The Grignolino D’Asti Isolavilla 2024 pours a delicate, translucent ruby. On the nose, it offers enticing notes of wild strawberries, rose petals, and a hint of white pepper. The palate is vibrant and refined, showcasing flavours of red currant, sour cherry, and a subtle earthy spice. Light-bodied yet surprisingly structured, this wine reveals a lively acidity and fine-grained tannins that lead to a graceful, lingering finish. Made entirely from Grignolino grapes, it exemplifies the varietal’s hallmark freshness and understated complexity.

Food Pairing

Delightful with charcuterie, grilled vegetables, or a classic Margherita pizza, this wine’s bright acidity and delicate tannins also pair beautifully with lighter pasta dishes or roasted poultry. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Checkmate Merlot 'End Game' 2021
bodyHtml:
The 2021 'End Game' Merlot is a captivating expression of the Okanagan’s potential for world-class Merlot. In the glass, it reveals a deep ruby hue. The nose is complex and inviting, offering layers of dark cherries, blackberries, and plums, accented by hints of graphite, violet, and subtle baking spices.

On the palate, this wine is full-bodied yet exceptionally balanced, delivering rich flavours of ripe black fruit, cocoa, and a touch of sage. Fine-grained tannins provide structure, while a fresh acidity lifts the mid-palate, leading into a long, polished finish with notes of dark chocolate and crushed stones. Crafted entirely from Merlot, it shows beautiful integration of oak, adding nuances of vanilla and toast without overshadowing the fruit. This vintage is expected to drink wonderfully through 2030.

Accolades

  • Decanter - 93 points.

Food Pairing

Pair this Merlot with herb-crusted rack of lamb, mushroom risotto, or aged cheddar. The wine’s generous fruit and savoury undertones make it equally compelling alongside roasted game or grilled portobello mushrooms. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Sordo Giovanni Barolo 2016
bodyHtml:
Italy’s famed Piedmont region is home to Sordo Giovanni, a historic family-run winery based in Castiglione Falletto. For over a century, the Sordo family has cultivated Nebbiolo grapes across some of Barolo’s most prestigious crus, combining traditional methods with a deep respect for terroir. Their philosophy emphasizes minimal intervention and long ageing in large Slavonian oak barrels, resulting in classically styled, age-worthy Barolos.

Wine Description
This 2016 Barolo reveals a garnet red hue with subtle brick reflections, characteristic of a wine beginning to show some evolution. On the nose, it offers an elegant and layered bouquet of dried roses, forest floor, cherry, tar, and hints of truffle and spice. The palate is full-bodied and structured, with firm yet integrated tannins, lively acidity, and flavours echoing the aromatic profile—red fruit, licorice, leather, and earthy undertones. The finish is long and refined, suggesting excellent ageing potential. Made from 100% Nebbiolo, this wine shows balance, precision, and the hallmark austerity of traditional Barolo.

Accolades
● Wine Spectator – 92 points
● James Suckling – 93 points

Food Pairing
This Barolo pairs beautifully with braised short ribs, wild mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses like Parmigiano Reggiano. The wine’s bold structure and complex profile stand up to rich, savoury dishes, enhancing both food and wine. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Fratelli Borgogno Barolo Cannubi 2021
bodyHtml:
Italy’s famed Piedmont region is home to Barolo, often referred to as the "King of Wines". Within this appellation, Cannubi stands as its most prestigious cru, nestled in the heart of Barolo itself. Fratelli Borgogno is a historic, family-owned estate with deep roots in the Langhe hills, known for producing traditionally styled Barolos that reflect the elegance and longevity of the terroir. Their dedication to low-intervention winemaking and respect for the land continues to guide their philosophy today.

Wine Description
The 2021 Barolo Cannubi presents a luminous garnet red hue, typical of Nebbiolo, with a complex bouquet of dried roses, cherries, sweet tobacco, and hints of truffle and tar. On the palate, it opens with precision and grace—flavours of red currant, cranberry, and licorice are supported by firm, fine-grained tannins and vibrant acidity. The wine is medium to full-bodied with a long, mineral-driven finish and a touch of spice. Composed entirely of Nebbiolo, it showcases the Cannubi cru’s hallmark balance and finesse.

Accolades
Vinous - 94 points.
Wine Advocate - 93 points.

Food Pairing
This Barolo pairs exquisitely with braised short ribs, truffle risotto, or aged Parmigiano Reggiano. The wine’s structure and earthy undertones complement rich, savoury dishes, enhancing both the complexity of the wine and the depth of the cuisine. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Carrera Anejo
bodyHtml:
Carrera Añejo is crafted in Mexico, where the art of tequila-making is deeply rooted in centuries-old tradition. Produced in the highlands of Jalisco, this spirit reflects the passion and expertise of its distillers, who emphasize patience, craftsmanship, and heritage. Carrera is known for its commitment to producing premium tequilas using only the finest blue Weber agave, harvested at peak maturity.

Carrera Añejo presents a deep amber hue with golden highlights, a result of extended aging in oak barrels. On the nose, it reveals rich aromas of toasted oak, vanilla bean, and caramelized agave, layered with subtle hints of dried fruit and baking spices. The palate is smooth and refined, offering flavours of butterscotch, cinnamon, and roasted nuts, with a velvety mouthfeel. It has a full body and a long, warming finish that lingers with a touch of spice and dark chocolate. Made exclusively from 100% blue Weber agave and aged for a minimum of one year, this Añejo tequila is a fine expression of balance and complexity. Best enjoyed neat or with a single cube of ice.

title: Carrera Blanco
bodyHtml: The crystal clear blanco has an aroma of cooked agave with light citrus and nuts. Initially strong with agave on the palate, followed by lime and touches of hazelnut.

title: Carrera Blanco Still Strength
bodyHtml:
Introducing Carrera Tequila Blanco Still Strength, a meticulously crafted masterpiece by the renowned Mauricio Camarena. This exceptional tequila offers a sensory journey like no other, captivating the palate and the senses with its unparalleled character.

From the moment it graces your glass, the intoxicating aroma of Carrera Tequila Blanco Still Strength entices with a delightful combination of citrus notes and hints of anise. However, it is the presence of roasted agave that truly shines, commanding attention and setting the stage for an extraordinary tasting experience.

The flavor profile of this tequila is a true revelation, leaving a lasting imprint on the taste buds. Bold and intense, it unleashes a symphony of flavors, with an almost chocolate-like essence taking the lead. The complexity of this blanco is unmatched, as anise and roasted agave dance harmoniously in the background, creating a deeply rich and satisfying sensation.

title: Carrera Reposado
bodyHtml:
Carrera Tequila is a family-owned distillery rooted in the heart of Amatitán, Jalisco, where generations have cultivated the traditions of artisanal tequila production. The brand reflects a commitment to craft, heritage, and the expression of terroir found only in the Tequila Valley’s volcanic soils.

Carrera Reposado is a golden amber tequila that exemplifies elegance and balance. Aged for six months in American oak barrels, it opens with rich aromas of cooked agave, vanilla, toasted almonds, and a hint of baking spice. On the palate, the tequila is smooth and full-bodied, revealing layers of caramel, oak, and pepper with a silky texture. The finish is long and warming, with lingering notes of dried fruit and gentle oak tannins. This expression is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave and offers a harmonious blend of sweetness and spice, ideal for sipping or refined cocktails.

title: Carrera Reposado Cristalino
bodyHtml:
Crafted in Mexico’s heartland of tequila, Jalisco, Carrera Reposado Cristalino comes from a distillery that celebrates the legacy of artisanal tequila production. The Carrera name evokes a racing spirit, honouring the family’s longstanding passion for horses and traditional agave cultivation. The distillery is known for combining time-honoured methods with contemporary refinement, producing tequilas that emphasize purity and craftsmanship.

This Reposado Cristalino is a filtered tequila that retains the smoothness of its barrel aging while showcasing the brilliance and clarity of a Blanco. Pale silver in colour with a crystalline sheen, it opens with expressive aromas of cooked agave, vanilla, and a whisper of oak. On the palate, it is silky and refined, balancing mellow notes of caramel and almond with a clean, mineral finish. Made from 100% Blue Weber agave, it offers a medium-bodied mouthfeel and a smooth, lingering finish.

title: Chateau Saint Hilaire Medoc 2020
bodyHtml:
This classic red hails from France, in the famed Bordeaux region, specifically the Médoc on the Left Bank. Chateau Saint Hilaire, a family-owned estate with deep roots in Médoc viticulture, is renowned for crafting elegant wines that embody the traditional Bordeaux philosophy of balance and terroir expression. With vineyards benefiting from gravelly soils and excellent drainage, the estate focuses on producing wines that reflect both heritage and meticulous care.

Wine Description
A beautiful deep ruby colour, this Médoc blend opens with inviting aromas of ripe blackberries, cassis, and a subtle touch of cedar and graphite. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious interplay of dark fruits, plum, and hints of vanilla from well-integrated oak. Medium to full bodied with fine-grained tannins, the wine offers a long, graceful finish marked by notes of spice and earthy minerality. Primarily composed of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, it shows both the plushness and structure typical of the region.

Food Pairing
Enjoy this wine alongside grilled lamb chops with rosemary, mushroom risotto, or aged cheddar. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Agri Segretum Todi Marmocchio Rosso 2018
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from Italy, specifically from Umbria in the Todi area, a historic town known for its medieval charm and rich viticultural heritage. Agri Segretum is a small family-run estate committed to organic farming and minimal intervention, allowing the unique terroir of their vineyards to express itself fully. The winery is dedicated to crafting wines that capture the essence of Umbria, blending tradition with a respect for the environment.

Wine Description

The Marmocchio Rosso displays a deep ruby hue with lively garnet reflections. On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of ripe red cherries, plums, and subtle hints of wild herbs, interwoven with delicate notes of sweet spices and earth. The palate is medium-bodied yet structured, featuring a vibrant acidity that brings freshness to the rich fruit flavours. Silky tannins lead to a persistent finish marked by nuances of tobacco and mineral undertones. This wine is crafted primarily from Sangiovese, with small additions of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, contributing to its layered complexity.

Food Pairing

Pair this elegant Umbrian red with grilled lamb chops seasoned with rosemary, or a hearty wild boar ragu over pappardelle. Mature cheeses like Pecorino also complement its savoury depth beautifully. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Eau Claire Stampede Canadian Rye Whisky
bodyHtml: A true cowboy-forward whisky with a spicy rye kick. Stampede Rye Whisky is made from the finest ingredients – glacier-fed water, Alberta-grown rye, finished in oak barrels – and inspired by the world’s greatest celebration of the West, the Calgary Stampede. True to ranch life, Stampede Whisky is a no-nonsense easy-sipper you can always depend on.

title: Niepoort Red 'Drink Me Nat Cool' 2024
bodyHtml:
Niepoort is a pioneering family-run estate renowned for its innovative approach to winemaking. Currently led by Dirk Niepoort, the fifth generation of the Niepoort family, the winery has built a global reputation for balancing tradition with experimentation. Their ‘Nat Cool’ line reflects a commitment to low-intervention wines that are light, approachable, and naturally expressive.

Wine Description
This red wine from Bairrada region is a vibrant ruby colour with a soft, cloudy hue due to its natural fermentation process. The nose offers fresh aromas of crushed red berries, cherry compote, and wild herbs, accompanied by a faint yeasty note. On the palate, it’s delightfully lively and juicy, with a light body, crisp acidity, carrying flavours of strawberries, pomegranate, and a touch of white pepper. The finish is clean and refreshing with a slightly savoury edge.

Composed primarily of Baga, a native Portuguese grape variety known for its structure and acidity, this wine is best enjoyed young to preserve its exuberant freshness and natural effervescence. Its low alcohol and playful character make it an ideal summer sipper.

Food Pairing
Pair this juicy red with charcuterie boards, grilled sausages, mushroom tacos, or even pizza topped with spicy salami. Its brightness and effervescence cut through fatty, savoury dishes with ease.

title: Fielding Unoaked Chardonnay 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Fielding Unoaked Chardonnay is a premium white wine originating from the Niagara Peninsula in Ontario, Canada. The wine is produced by Fielding Estate Winery, a family-owned operation situated on the Beamsville Bench, a sub-appellation renowned for its cool-climate viticulture. Founded by Ken and Marg Fielding, the winery is affectionately known as 'The Wine Lodge' and features architecture inspired by Northern Ontario's cottage country.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay presents a brilliant straw-yellow hue in the glass. The sensory profile is fruit-driven and fresh, with aromatics of Honeycrisp apple, nectarine, melon, and tropical hints of pineapple and guava. On the palate, it is light and crisp, showcasing flavours of orchard fruit, citrus, and a subtle streak of minerality or salinity. While the body is light and refreshing, the wine possesses a remarkable roundness and texture derived from being kept on its lees, leading to a clean, vibrant finish. Fermented at cool temperatures in stainless steel to preserve its natural acidity, it did not undergo malolactic fermentation. This wine is typically enjoyed in its youth to maintain its freshness, with some vintages suggested for consumption within a four-year window. It has an ABV of 12.5%. There is no indication that this wine is certified organic, though the winery emphasizes sustainable farming and minimalist winemaking.

title: Strathcona Spirits Pinot Gin
bodyHtml: Aged in meticulously selected French and American white oak Pinot Noir casks. Botanicals harmonize on the wood, while the brisk, light pinot from the cask lends delicate plum, and an airy ethereal pear texture. French oak on the nose.

title: Bailly Lapierre Saint-Bris Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Hailing from France's Burgundy region, specifically the Saint-Bris appellation near Chablis, Bailly Lapierre is renowned for its unique production of Sauvignon Blanc—a rarity in Burgundy. The winery, located in Saint-Bris-le-Vineux, is committed to quality and tradition, reflecting the essence of the Saint-Bris terroir.

This 100% Sauvignon Blanc presents a pale gold hue with green reflections. The bouquet offers aromas of white fruits, fresh herbs, and subtle notes of citrus and blackcurrant flowers. On the palate, it is fresh and vibrant, showcasing delicate minerality and the richness of white fruits, culminating in a floral and fruity finish.

Food Pairing

This Sauvignon Blanc pairs excellently with seafood dishes such as oysters, clams, and fish, as well as fresh and semi-dry goat cheeses. These pairings highlight the wine's depth and character.

title: Benjamin Bridge Rose 'Wild Rock' 2024
bodyHtml:
Benjamin Bridge is a family-owned winery nestled in Nova Scotia's Gaspereau Valley, Canada. Established in 1999, it has garnered acclaim for producing premium sparkling and still wines that reflect the region's cool-climate terroir. Under the guidance of head winemaker Jean-Benoit Deslauriers, the winery emphasizes sustainability and innovation in its winemaking practices.

Wine Description

The Wild Rock Rosé presents a delicate salmon hue in the glass. On the nose, it offers vibrant aromas of grapefruit, spring flowers, guava, lemon, and a hint of sea breeze. The palate is bright and stone-fruit-forward, showcasing flavours of juicy peaches, ripe cherries, and white tea. The wine concludes with a long, delightful finish featuring subtle notes of rose petals and wet stones, accompanied by earthy and spicy undertones.

Food Pairing

This rosé pairs beautifully with a variety of dishes, including chicken salad, seafood tacos, and vegan fare. Its bright acidity and subtle fruit notes complement the flavours of these dishes, enhancing the overall dining experience.

title: Dillon's Cherry Gin
bodyHtml: Crafted using the Dry Gin 7 as the base, our Cherry Gin is infused with local sour cherries, then lightly sweetened with organic cane sugar. Excellent as an aperitif or give your Negroni a local twist!

title: Hatt et Soner Champagne Rose
bodyHtml:
Hatt et Söner is a boutique Champagne house with Swedish roots, founded by a family passionate about preserving the artisanal heritage of the region. Nestled in the Côte des Bar in southern Champagne, the house works closely with local growers to produce terroir-driven wines that reflect finesse and elegance. With a commitment to traditional methods and minimal intervention, their Champagnes express both purity and complexity.

This rosé Champagne is a delicate and refined expression of the region, showing a pale salmon hue with vibrant effervescence. The nose reveals enticing aromas of wild strawberries, red currants, and rose petals, underscored by subtle notes of brioche and citrus zest. On the palate, it is fresh and elegant with flavours of raspberry, pomegranate, and a hint of spice, all supported by fine bubbles and a creamy mousse. The finish is long, clean, and refreshingly dry. Crafted primarily from Pinot Noir, with a touch of Chardonnay and Meunier, it is best enjoyed young to capture its bright, fruit-forward character, though it can age gracefully for several years.

Food Pairing
Pair this Champagne Rosé with tuna tartare, duck prosciutto, or soft cheeses like Chaource. The wine’s delicate red fruit and crisp acidity cut through richer textures, enhancing each bite. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Prats & Symington Prazo De Roriz 2018
bodyHtml:
The Prats & Symington Prazo de Roriz 2018 is a distinguished red blend from the Douro Valley, Portugal. This wine is a collaboration between the Symington family, renowned for their Port production, and Bruno Prats of Bordeaux, known for his expertise in crafting fine wines. Sourced from the historic Quinta de Roriz estate, which dates back to the 18th century, this wine reflects a commitment to quality and tradition.

Wine Description

In the glass, the Prazo de Roriz 2018 presents a deep purple hue. The aromatic profile is rich and expressive, featuring notes of raspberry, black currant, blackberry, black cherry, black olive, and rosehip. On the palate, it is dry and full-bodied, with medium acidity and ripe, medium-plus tannins. Flavours mirror the nose, culminating in a medium-plus, raspberry-infused finish. The wine is complex and brooding, yet maintains a sense of freshness and vibrancy. It is crafted from a blend of traditional Portuguese grape varieties, including Touriga Franca, Touriga Nacional, Tinta Roriz, and Tinta Barroca, and is aged for four to five months in French oak barrels to enhance its structure without overshadowing the fruit.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 92 points

  • Wine Spectator – 90 points

  • Wine Enthusiast – 89 points

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with grilled, stewed, or roasted meats, such as beef, lamb, or game. Its robust structure and rich fruit profile complement hearty dishes, enhancing the overall dining experience.

title: Benjamin Bridge White Blend 'Tidal Bay' 2025
bodyHtml:
Benjamin Bridge, nestled in Nova Scotia's Gaspereau Valley, has been a trailblazer in Canadian winemaking since its inception in 1999. Renowned for its traditional method sparkling wines, the winery emphasizes sustainability, with certified organic vineyards and eco-friendly practices. Under the guidance of head winemaker Jean-Benoit Deslauriers, Benjamin Bridge crafts wines that authentically reflect the unique maritime terroir of the region.

Wine Description
Tidal Bay presents a pale straw hue with a subtle emerald tint. On the nose, it offers crisp and youthful aromas of lemon interlaced with ripe apricot, complemented by subtle hints of sea breeze and flint. The palate reveals a wide variety of meadow botanicals lifted by citrus and elderflower aromas, culminating in a vibrant acidity that invigorates the palate and echoes through a long finish.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with seafood dishes such as lobster, scallops, and mussels, as well as cold salads and light appetizers. Its crisp acidity and mineral notes complement the freshness of the sea, enhancing the overall dining experience.

title: Vineland Estates Unoaked Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Vineland Estates Winery, nestled in Ontario's Niagara Peninsula, has been a beacon of Canadian winemaking excellence for over 30 years. Under the guidance of winemaker Brian Schmidt, the winery emphasizes authenticity and a deep connection to the land, producing wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region.

Wine Description
The 2023 Unoaked Chardonnay is a vibrant expression of the varietal, showcasing a lively bouquet of fall apple, Bosc pear, and fresh lemon, complemented by a subtle hint of buttered toast. On the palate, it offers a crisp and refreshing experience, with the fruit-forward character leading to a clean, enduring finish. Crafted without oak influence, this Chardonnay maintains its pure, fruit-driven profile, making it an exemplary representation of the unoaked style.

Food Pairing
This Chardonnay pairs wonderfully with dishes that benefit from a touch of acidity to balance their richness. Consider serving it alongside grilled chicken, seafood pasta, or a fresh goat cheese salad. Its crisp profile also complements vegetarian dishes and light appetizers, enhancing the overall dining experience.

title: Rivera Cappellaccio Aglianico Riserva Castel Del Monte 2019
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Italy, produced in the Puglia region within the Castel del Monte DOCG. Rivera was founded in the late 1940s by Sebastiano de Corato, who sought to showcase the viticultural potential of the Murgia hills. The winery's philosophy combines traditional and modern techniques to craft wines that are true to their terroir while meeting international standards. Now in its third generation, the de Corato family continues to focus on indigenous grape varieties like Aglianico, emphasizing sustainable practices and quality.

Wine Description

The Rivera Cappellaccio Aglianico Riserva presents a dense ruby colour with a garnet red rim. The nose is intense and complex, offering aromas of black cherry, dried plum, and wild red berries, layered with notes of leather, pipe tobacco, liquorice, and balsamic herbs. On the palate, the wine is warm and full bodied, featuring a rich core of dark fruit and spices integrated with mineral freshness. It is characterized by its powerful structure and firm, grippy tannins that lead into a persistent and aromatic finish. This 100% Aglianico has an ABV of 13.5% to 14% and is matured for 12 months in a combination of French oak barriques and large Slavonian oak barrels, followed by a further year of bottle refinement.

title: Cedar Creek Rose Organic Platinum South Kelowna Slopes 2023
bodyHtml:
CedarCreek Estate Winery, located on the eastern shore of Okanagan Lake, is a pioneering force in British Columbia’s organic winemaking movement. Established in 1986 and now part of the Von Mandl Family Estates, the winery is recognized for its commitment to regenerative farming and low-intervention practices. The South Kelowna Slopes, recently designated as a sub-GI (Geographical Indication), provide a unique terroir of glacial soils and lake influence that contribute to refined, cool-climate expressions.

Wine Description
This rosé displays a delicate pale salmon hue, reflecting its elegant and restrained style. The nose opens with fresh aromas of wild strawberries, white peach, and rose petals, layered with a touch of citrus zest. On the palate, it is vibrant and dry, offering red berry flavours, subtle watermelon, and a hint of wet stone minerality. Medium-bodied with crisp acidity, the wine finishes clean and refreshing, showcasing finesse and balance. Crafted from Pinot Noir and Pinot Gris, it is best enjoyed young, ideally within 1–2 years of vintage to capture its brightness and purity.

Food Pairing
Pair this lively rosé with grilled prawns, goat cheese salads, or fresh sushi rolls. Its acidity and mineral tension make it equally suitable for creamy pasta dishes or Mediterranean fare. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Old Pulteney 'Pineau Des Charentes Wine Cask Matured' - Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Old Pulteney is a celebrated distillery located in the town of Wick in the northern Highlands of Scotland. Established in 1826, it has built a reputation for producing maritime-influenced whiskies, shaped by its coastal location. Known as ‘The Maritime Malt,’ Old Pulteney is owned by Inver House Distillers and places emphasis on traditional craftsmanship and coastal maturation techniques.

Tasting Notes

This special edition single malt Scotch whisky was initially matured in traditional American oak casks before a finishing period in ex-Pineau des Charentes wine casks from France. The result is a vibrant amber spirit with copper highlights. The nose offers lush aromas of candied citrus peel, spiced orchard fruits, and floral honey, underscored by coastal salinity. On the palate, it reveals layers of sultanas, baked apple, white grapes, and nutmeg, framed by the signature briny undertone Old Pulteney is known for. Medium-bodied with a rich, waxy mouthfeel, the finish is long, warming, and elegantly sweet, with lingering notes of dried fruits and a hint of maritime salt.

Food Pairing

Enjoy this refined whisky alongside aged cheddar, foie gras, or duck with cherry glaze. Its sweet and savoury profile also makes it a striking match for roasted nuts or honey-glazed ham. A perfect match to enhance the whisky’s complexity.

title: Graffigna Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve 2023
bodyHtml:
Graffigna, founded in 1870 by Italian immigrant Santiago Graffigna, is one of Argentina’s oldest wineries and a pioneering name in the San Juan region. Nestled in the Pedernal Valley, the estate is known for its high-altitude vineyards and a commitment to innovation while preserving traditional winemaking values.

Wine Description
This Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep ruby colour with violet highlights. The nose is expressive, offering ripe blackberry, cassis, and dark cherry layered with notes of vanilla, tobacco, and a hint of spice from oak ageing. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied with structured tannins and vibrant acidity, delivering flavours of blackcurrant, plum, and subtle chocolate. The finish is long, with savoury undertones and a touch of minerality. Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, this wine is best enjoyed now through 2028. Its style leans toward bold yet balanced, offering freshness and complexity.

Food Pairing
Excellent with grilled ribeye, lamb stew, or portobello mushroom burgers. Aged cheeses like manchego or gouda also complement the wine’s robust profile. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Laughing Stock Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
From British Columbia, Canada, Laughing Stock Vineyards is nestled on the Naramata Bench in the Okanagan Valley. Founded by former financial executives Cynthia and David Enns, the winery has gained renown for its meticulous approach to viticulture and small-lot winemaking, reflecting both precision and personality in every bottle.

Wine Description
The 2022 Laughing Stock Pinot Noir displays a luminous ruby colour with garnet undertones. On the nose, it offers a refined bouquet of red cherry, raspberry, and dried rose petals, layered with subtle notes of forest floor and baking spice. The palate is elegantly structured with flavours of cranberry, pomegranate, and a hint of clove, supported by fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity. This medium-bodied wine finishes with silky persistence and a whisper of toasted oak. Crafted entirely from Pinot Noir, it is best enjoyed now through 2028 for optimal expression. The wine exhibits freshness and complexity, showcasing the terroir of the Naramata Bench.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with herb-crusted salmon, duck breast with cherry glaze, or wild mushroom risotto. These combinations enhance the wine’s aromatic complexity and supple texture. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Niepoort White Pet Nat 'Drink Me Nat Cool' 2024
bodyHtml:
Niepoort is a family-run winery founded in 1842 and now in the capable hands of Dirk Niepoort, a fifth-generation winemaker celebrated for his innovative spirit and commitment to low-intervention practices. The Nat Cool line reflects a philosophy of making wines that are fresh, approachable, and expressive of their terroir.

Wine Description
This white Pet Nat (Pétillant Naturel) from Vihno Verde region opens with a lightly cloudy straw hue, a natural result of its bottle-fermentation process. The nose bursts with lively aromas of green apple, citrus zest, pear skin, and a hint of fresh herbs. On the palate, it is vibrant and refreshing, showing a delicate sparkle that enhances its crisp acidity and notes of lemon, white peach, and crushed rocks. It is light-bodied with a zippy, clean finish that leaves a faint mineral trace. Composed primarily of indigenous Portuguese white varietals such as Arinto, Rabigato, and Códega do Larinho, this Pet Nat is best enjoyed young, within 1–2 years of the vintage, to preserve its effervescent charm.

Food Pairing
This playful and zesty sparkler pairs beautifully with sushi, ceviche, fresh goat cheese, or Mediterranean mezze. The wine’s crisp acidity and gentle bubbles cleanse the palate, making it an ideal companion for fried seafood or herb-laced vegetarian dishes. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Fattoria Amo Pet Nat 'Rebel' 2022
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Italy’s picturesque Emilia-Romagna region, Fattoria Amo is a small, artisanal winery committed to natural farming and minimal-intervention winemaking. Founded on a philosophy of ecological harmony and expression of terroir, the estate focuses on crafting wines that are vibrant, pure, and full of personality. 'Rebel' represents the estate’s playful, nonconformist approach to the traditional styles of sparkling wine.

Wine Description
The 2022 'Rebel' Pet Nat is a naturally sparkling wine that exudes a cloudy, golden hue with a lively, unfiltered effervescence. On the nose, it bursts with aromas of yellow apple, pear skin, lemon zest, and subtle floral undertones. The palate is zippy and energetic, offering flavours of orchard fruit, tangy citrus, and a faint touch of lees-derived brioche. Light to medium-bodied, with a crisp acidity and a dry, refreshing finish, it shows excellent balance and raw charm.

Food Pairing
Ideal alongside light fare such as fried calamari, goat cheese salads, or fresh focaccia with olives. The wine’s vibrancy and slight funk complement salty and tangy dishes, cutting through richness with ease. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Woodford Reserve 'Baccarat Edition' Kentucky Straight Bourbon
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Woodford Reserve 'Baccarat Edition' Kentucky Straight Bourbon is an ultra-luxury spirit from the United States, specifically produced in the heart of Woodford County, Kentucky. The distillery, located on a National Historic Landmark site where fine bourbon was first made in 1812, is currently owned by the Brown-Forman Corporation. This unique expression represents a collaboration between the historic American distillery and the renowned French crystal house, Baccarat, to celebrate the historical connections between France and Kentucky.

Spirit Description

This bourbon is crafted by finishing Woodford Reserve's most complex Kentucky straight bourbon in select XO Cognac barrels from France for an additional three years. This process aims to achieve a seamless fusion of American whiskey character and French oak elegance.

  • Colour: The spirit displays a clean and brilliant deep honey amber hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is rich and toasted, featuring oak dusted with chocolate and cocoa notes, creamy vanilla bean, and hints of clove and cinnamon spice over a deep layer of dried fruit and citrus peel.

  • Palate: It delivers an impeccably balanced and silky palate where elegant vanilla, dark chocolate, and dried fruit top layers of rich malt, toasted nuts, and oak.

  • Body: The whiskey is notably polished with a velvety, satin texture and opulent depth.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, warm, and elegantly layered finish characterized by delicately spiced caramel mocha notes and a creamy confectionary tail.

  • ABV: This edition is typically bottled at 45.2%.

Accolades

Woodford Reserve 'Baccarat Edition' is highly regarded by connoisseurs and critics alike as a pinnacle of luxury bourbon.

  • 95 Points: Rated by 'Whisky Advocate' for its exceptional quality and craftsmanship.

  • Collector Standing: Highly praised by 'Forbes' for its unique blend of flavours and smooth finish, it is considered a centerpiece for serious collectors.

  • Presentation: The spirit is housed in a bespoke, handmade Baccarat crystal decanter that takes five days to create, featuring real gold lettering and a crystal topper adorned with the distillery's initials.

title: Scapa The Orcadian Glansa
bodyHtml:
Along the rocky and rugged shores of the Isle of Orkney you will find the Scapa Distillery who have recently released their first peated expression, Scapa Glansa.  The name comes from Old Norse for shining storm laden skies and captures the unique history of the isle of Orkney, with its Viking past as well as the stormy spirit inside the bottle. Scapa pride themselves on their dedication to traditional distilling and are one of the few manually run distilleries around today.

Nose: Full of fruit and sweetness.  It has tangy citrus fruits alongside subtle orchard fruits - peaches and apples with the tell-tale zest of oranges and lemons.  Underneath all this is a dense whiff of bonfire smoke filled with charcoal and sulphur.

Palate: The lemon zest also becomes more pronounced and is joined by some wonderfully smooth caramel, with subtle hints of oak wood. The caramel has depth and character and as well as interacting perfectly with the fruits. The smoke is dense but not overwhelming, allowing the other flavours to show themselves fully.

Finish: Long and winding - allowing the smoke to move like it is coming straight off a peat fire.

title: The Dot Austrian Blackberry Zweigelt 2023
bodyHtml:
Juicy. Smooth. Seriously easy to love.

Looking for a red wine that’s full of flavor but doesn’t take itself too seriously? Say hello to The Dot Austrian Blackberry Zweigelt. This Austrian red is bursting with juicy blackberry and cherry flavors, with just a touch of spice to keep things interesting.

It’s super versatile — great with burgers, pizza, pasta, or even just a cozy night on the couch. It’s light enough to enjoy on its own, but bold enough to stand up to food. Chill it slightly if it’s warm out — yes, it can handle that too.

Whether you’re hosting friends or winding down after work, this smooth, fruit-forward wine is a no-fuss, crowd-pleasing choice.

title: Arette Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: 100% agave of beautiful transparence, great body, and flavor. Arette tequila has the aromas of herbs and citrus that characterize lowlands tequila, you can especially tell with the blanco style.

title: Escorihuela Gascon 1884 Viognier 2022
bodyHtml:
From the renowned Agrelo region in Mendoza, Argentina, the Escorihuela Gascón 1884 Viognier 2022 is a testament to the winery's commitment to elegance and quality. Founded in 1884, Escorihuela Gascón is one of Argentina's oldest wineries, dedicated to producing wines that reflect the country's rich viticultural heritage.

Wine Description

This 100% Viognier wine presents a vibrant yellow hue with bright golden highlights. The nose is complex, offering aromas of apricot, ripe peaches, honey, and orange peels, complemented by subtle smoky and vanilla notes. On the palate, it is broad and well-defined, filling the mid-palate with honest flavors and balanced by medium acidity. The finish is long and tasty, showcasing the wine's harmony and depth.

Food Pairing

Ideal pairings for this Viognier include pork, poultry, rich fish like salmon or tuna, and spicy dishes. These combinations enhance the wine's complexity and provide a memorable dining experience.

title: Blue Grouse Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Founded in the Cowichan Valley on Vancouver Island, Blue Grouse Estate Winery is a family-owned winery with deep roots in sustainable viticulture. Known for its cool-climate expression and dedication to terroir-driven wines, Blue Grouse has earned acclaim for crafting elegant and balanced wines that reflect the unique maritime influence of the region.

This 2023 Chardonnay opens with a pale golden hue, capturing the freshness of its coastal origins. On the nose, it offers vibrant aromas of green apple, citrus blossom, and wet stone, followed by subtle notes of toasted almond and vanilla from restrained oak aging. The palate is crisp yet creamy, with flavours of lemon curd, pear, and a touch of saline minerality. Medium-bodied with lively acidity, it finishes with finesse and length, displaying excellent balance and a hint of complexity.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with seared scallops, roast chicken with lemon herb butter, or a creamy mushroom risotto. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Mission Hill Sauvignon Blanc Reserve 2025
bodyHtml:
Crafted in Canada, Mission Hill Reserve Sauvignon Blanc is a testament to the resilience and innovation of Mission Hill Family Estate, located in West Kelowna, British Columbia. Established in 1966, Mission Hill has been a pioneer in the Okanagan Valley, embracing organic farming practices and sustainable viticulture to produce wines of exceptional quality.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc presents a bright, pale straw hue. On the nose, it offers vibrant aromas of passion fruit and lime zest, characteristic of Marlborough's terroir. The palate is crisp and refreshing, showcasing tropical fruit flavours complemented by vibrant acidity, leading to a clean, invigorating finish.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with fresh seafood dishes such as clams and mussels, as well as summer salads featuring goat cheese and asparagus. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Kapriol Gin Blood Orange and Peach
bodyHtml: Kapriol Gin Blood Orange & Bergamot is based on the original 1948 recipe of the Kapriol Dry Gin. In order to indulge our palates we choose only the best Blood Orange and Peaches from Sicily and Emilia Romagna.
