The botanicals are first infused in the finest wheat based alcohol, and then distilled in our historical pot stills from 1947, built by artisan Antonio Padovan. Both the smell and the palate are almost taken into a trip amongst italian finest and most beautiful orchards in the mediterranean sea!

title: Kapriol Gin Lemon and Bergamot
bodyHtml: This delicious gin is based on the original Kapriol Dry Gin recipe, dating back to 1948. Crafted in 75-year-old pot stills, using premium lemons and bergamots from southern Italy, this wheat-based gin erupts with fresh Mediterranean flavours. Its citrusy vibrancy is perfect for crafting modern and classic gin cocktails!

title: Henry of  Pelham 'The Goat Lady' Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml:
Crafted in Canada’s Niagara Peninsula, Henry of Pelham's 'The Goat Lady' Chardonnay is part of the Speck Brothers' Family Tree series. This wine pays homage to Marion, a neighbour who cared for goats near the vineyard and famously won over the Speck family's dog with warm bowls of fresh goat's milk. Henry of Pelham, a family-owned winery established in 1988, is renowned for producing expressive, terroir-driven wines from estate-grown grapes.

Food Pairing

This Chardonnay pairs well with roast chicken accompanied by root vegetables, creamy pasta dishes, or risotto. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character.

title: Chateau Camensac Haut Medoc Grand Cru Classe 2016
bodyHtml:
Château de Camensac Haut-Médoc Grand Cru Classé is a Fifth Growth (Cinquième Cru) wine in the historic 1855 Bordeaux Classification, placing it among the prestigious Grand Cru Classé wines of the Médoc. Known for its full-bodied elegance, this Cabernet Sauvignon blend showcases the remarkable quality of the region. The wine exhibits a deep ruby-red color, with aromas of ripe red fruits, blackcurrant, and earthy undertones.

Colour: Deep ruby-red with a rich and inviting intensity.

Aroma: Elegant notes of ripe red fruits, including blackcurrant and cherry, along with hints of cedar, earth, and soft spice.

Palate: Full-bodied and well-structured, with flavors of red and dark berries, refined minerality, and layered complexity. The well-integrated tannins offer a smooth, balanced texture.

Body: Full-bodied, with polished tannins and a supple, velvety mouthfeel.

Finish: Long and harmonious, leaving a lasting impression of dark fruit and subtle earthy notes.

Crafted to age beautifully, Château de Camensac Haut-Médoc Grand Cru Classé (Fifth Growth) is ideal for cellaring, promising greater depth with time. Perfect for special occasions, this wine pairs beautifully with roasted meats, game, and mature cheeses, making it a memorable choice for collectors and enthusiasts alike.

title: Longrow Peated
bodyHtml:
Produced in Scotland’s Campbeltown region, Longrow is a label of the historic Springbank Distillery, which has been family-owned since 1828. Longrow whiskies were first introduced in the 1970s as a heavily peated alternative to Springbank’s more lightly peated styles, with a nod to the region’s once-prominent peat influence. Crafted entirely in-house from malting to bottling, Longrow reflects a philosophy rooted in traditional methods and hands-on craftsmanship.

Whisky Description
This single malt displays a pale straw colour. The nose is instantly evocative with rich peat smoke layered over notes of coastal brine, warm cereal, and citrus peel. On the palate, it offers bold smoky character balanced by lemon zest, green apple, and a touch of black pepper. Medium-bodied with an oily texture, the whisky unfolds into a long, savoury finish featuring earthy peat, salted caramel, and gentle spice. Made from 100% malted barley and aged in ex-bourbon barrels, this expression is non-chill-filtered and bottled without added colouring. While there is no declared vintage on the label, it is typically aged for around 6 years.

Accolades

  • Whisky Advocate - 91 points

  • Jim Murray’s Whisky Bible - 94.5 points

Food Pairing
This peated whisky is a striking match for grilled lamb, smoked duck breast, or aged cheddar. For a unique pairing, try it with dark chocolate and sea salt. A perfect match to enhance the whisky's complexity.

title: Martin's Lane  Pinot Noir Naramata Ranch 2022
bodyHtml:
The 2022 Martin's Lane Naramata Ranch Pinot Noir is a distinguished single-vineyard wine from the Naramata Bench in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley, Canada. Martin’s Lane Winery, established in 2014, is renowned for its exclusive focus on Pinot Noir and Riesling. Under the guidance of winemaker Shane Munn, the winery emphasizes organic farming and minimalist winemaking practices, including spontaneous fermentation and avoidance of fining or filtering, to authentically express the unique terroir of each vineyard.

Wine Description

The 2022 vintage presents a vibrant ruby hue with a complex bouquet of red cherry, raspberry, and subtle floral notes, complemented by earthy undertones. On the palate, it offers a silky texture with layers of red fruit, delicate spice, and a hint of minerality, leading to a long, graceful finish. Crafted from a selection of Dijon clones, including 667 and 943, grown on the geologically diverse slopes of the Naramata Ranch Vineyard, this Pinot Noir showcases the elegance and intensity characteristic of the site.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 93 points

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with dishes such as roast duck, grilled salmon, or mushroom risotto. Its balanced acidity and refined tannins enhance the flavours of these dishes, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Martin's Lane Pinot Noir 'Simes Vineyard' 2022
bodyHtml:
Martin's Lane Winery, situated in the Okanagan Valley of British Columbia, is renowned for its dedication to crafting premium Pinot Noir and Riesling wines. The winery employs gravity-flow winemaking techniques and emphasizes minimal intervention to preserve the purity of its wines. The Simes Vineyard, located in East Kelowna, benefits from a unique microclimate and diverse soils, contributing to the complexity and elegance of its Pinot Noir.

Wine Description

The 2022 Martin's Lane 'Simes Vineyard' Pinot Noir presents a vibrant ruby hue. On the nose, it offers an intricate bouquet of red cherry, raspberry, and subtle floral notes, complemented by hints of earth and spice. The palate is refined, showcasing flavours of ripe red berries, delicate oak, and a touch of minerality. This medium-bodied wine exhibits a harmonious balance between acidity and tannins, leading to a long, elegant finish. Crafted exclusively from Pinot Noir grapes, it is expected to reach its peak drinking window between 2025 and 2030.

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with dishes such as roasted duck, grilled salmon, or mushroom risotto. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character.

title: Drumshanbo Gunpowder California Orange Citrus Gin
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: An intriguing expression of Drumshanbo Gunpowder Irish Gin with refreshing hints of California Orange Citrus.

title: Orin Swift Mercury Head Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
The 2021 Mercury Head Cabernet Sauvignon presents an almost-black, opaque garnet hue, indicating its depth and concentration. On the nose, it offers immediate aromas of ripe cassis, charred ribeye, sandalwood, and freshly cut oak. Delving deeper reveals layers of blackberry, black plum, fennel, licorice, and dark chocolate. The palate is rich and balanced, showcasing a deep cassis core. The finish is sweet and lingering, with softly textured chalky tannins.

This wine is composed of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, sourced from esteemed vineyards including Stagecoach and Warnock on Atlas Peak, Morisoli in Rutherford, and Taplin in St. Helena. It was aged for 13 months in French oak barrels, 58% of which were new, and boasts an alcohol content of 15.5%.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate: 95 points

  • Wine Spectator: 91 points

Food Pairing

This robust Cabernet Sauvignon pairs excellently with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, or aged cheddar cheese. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character.

title: Prunotto Mompertone 2016
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1923 in Alba, Piedmont, Prunotto is a historic winery that has played a significant role in the region's viticultural heritage. In 1989, the estate became part of the renowned Marchesi Antinori family, bringing together traditional Piedmontese winemaking with innovative approaches. The Mompertone vineyard, located in the Monferrato area, is known for its calcareous clay soils interspersed with sandy veins, contributing to the wine's distinctive character.

Wine Description

Prunotto Mompertone is a blend of Barbera and Syrah, showcasing a deep ruby red hue with purple reflections. The nose is expressive, offering aromas of cherries, forest floor, spices, vanilla, and cocoa. On the palate, the wine is rich and velvety, with a persistent and harmonious profile. Supple, elegant tannins provide structure, while the balanced acidity ensures freshness.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with dishes such as orange-glazed leg of lamb, three-meat tourtière, osso buco with star anise, or spaghetti with meatballs. These pairings highlight the wine's depth and character.

title: Giffard Orgeat Syrup (Non Alcoholic) - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Giffard Orgeat Syrup is a non alcoholic product produced in Angers, France. The company was founded in 1885 by Emile Giffard, a pharmacist who established the distillery following the success of his Menthe Pastille liqueur. Today, Giffard remains an independent, family owned business managed by the fifth generation.

Spirit Description

This almond syrup presents a milky, off white appearance similar to the colour of coconut cream. The aromatic profile is rich and gourmet, featuring intense scents of bitter almond, frangipane, and crushed nuts. On the palate, it delivers a smooth and sweet flavour of orgeat with a complex, fruity freshness and a subtle hint of orange blossom. The body is velvety and sweet, leading to a long finish that emphasizes traditional confectionary notes. This product contains 0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The nutty and sweet structure of this syrup makes it a versatile companion for various desserts and snacks. It pairs exceptionally well with fruit based sweets, such as peach cobbler or grilled stone fruits like plums and apricots. For a savoury contrast, it can be served alongside a charcuterie board featuring salty cheeses and toasted hazelnuts. It also complements spicy Asian inspired dishes, such as poke bowls or shrimp ceviche, by providing a creamy sweetness that balances the heat.

Distinctive Features

Giffard Orgeat Syrup is distinguished by its use of 100% pure sugar derived from French beets and natural almond flavouring. It is crafted without artificial preservatives and undergoes flash pasteurization to ensure the perfect preservation of its aromatic complexity. This syrup is suitable for a variety of dietary preferences as it is vegan, gluten free, and contains no fat. Its high brix level of 61.4% ensures a consistent and intense flavour profile for mixing.

Serving Suggestions

As an essential ingredient in tiki culture, this syrup is fundamental for creating a non alcoholic 'Mai Tai' or a 'Japanese Mocktail'. It can be enjoyed simply by diluting it with soda water and a squeeze of fresh lime for a refreshing 'Orgeat Fizz'. In hot beverage applications, it serves as an excellent sweetener for espresso, lattes, and teas, adding a rich frangipane depth. It also performs well in creamy mocktails, such as a coffee based 'A Wilhelm Cream'.

title: Giffard Lavander Syrup (Non Alcoholic) - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Giffard Lavender Syrup is a non alcoholic product originating from Angers in the Loire Valley, France. The house of Giffard was established in 1885 by Emile Giffard, a pharmacist who founded the distillery after creating a refined white mint liqueur. Today, the company remains independent and family owned, with the fifth generation continuing to uphold the quality standards for their extensive range of syrups and liqueurs.

Spirit Description

This syrup presents a vibrant violet or purple colour. The aromatic profile is characterized by the powerful and evocative scent of lavender fields. On the palate, it offers concentrated notes of dried lavender flowers balanced by a pure sugar sweetness. The body is smooth and fluid, leading to a finish that provides a pleasant herbal freshness. This product contains 0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The floral and herbal character of this syrup makes it a versatile ingredient for a variety of culinary applications. It is an excellent addition to sweet treats such as cakes, cookies, and ice creams, and can be drizzled over pancakes, waffles, or French toast for a gourmet breakfast experience. For savoury pairings, it can be used to glaze meats like chicken, pork, or lamb, providing a unique sweet and savoury contrast. It also harmonizes well with soft cheeses, such as baked brie, and can be whisked into salad dressings or vinaigrettes.

Distinctive Features

Giffard Lavender Syrup is distinguished by its use of natural lavender aroma and pure sugar derived from French beets. It is crafted without the use of preservatives and is pasteurized to ensure the perfect preservation of its delicate floral notes. The syrup is designed to dissolve smoothly in both hot and cold preparations, making it a reliable tool for professional bartenders and home cooks alike. It is also suitable for various dietary needs as it is non GMO and free from artificial flavours.

Serving Suggestions

This syrup is a popular choice for infusing a floral essence into beverages such as hot or iced tea, lattes, and lemonade. A refreshing 'Lavender Lemonade' can be made by combining the syrup with fresh lemon juice and water or soda. In mixology, it serves as a sophisticated sweetener for cocktails like a 'Lavender Gin Fizz', 'Lavender Collins', or a 'Lavender Margarita'. For a simple non alcoholic serve, it can be stirred into sparkling water with a squeeze of lemon and a sprig of fresh lavender as a garnish.

title: Borgogno Barbera D'Asti Cascina Valle Asinari 2020
bodyHtml:
Produced by Cascina Valle Asinari, a historic estate in San Marzano Oliveto, this wine is crafted from 100% Barbera grapes cultivated on sandy and silty soils. The winery employs traditional methods, including fermentation in cement tanks with indigenous yeasts and aging in large Slavonian oak casks, to create a wine that reflects the character of its terroir.

Tasting Notes:

  • Colour: Deep ruby red with violet reflections.

  • Aroma: The nose is rich and complex, offering notes of ripe red fruits such as cherry and raspberry, complemented by hints of underbrush, licorice, and a mentholated finish.

  • Palate: On the palate, the wine is tense and dense, featuring saline tannins and a finish that echoes the underbrush notes.

  • Body and Finish: Medium-bodied with a well-structured profile, the wine exhibits a pleasant acidity that balances its richness, leading to an elegant and persistent finish.

Food Pairing:

This Barbera d’Asti pairs excellently with hearty dishes such as pasta with meat sauces, risottos, and roasted meats. Its acidity and structure complement the richness of these foods, enhancing the overall dining experience.

title: Borgogno Zamo Rosso Friuli Colli Orientali 2022
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the Friuli Colli Orientali DOC in northeastern Italy, Le Vigne di Zamò is a family-owned estate established in 1978 in Rosazzo, Udine. Renowned for its dedication to indigenous varietals and meticulous craftsmanship, the winery has become a benchmark for quality in the region.

Wine Description

The Zamò Rosso 2022 is a harmonious blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Refosco dal Peduncolo Rosso. In the glass, it presents a deep ruby hue. The nose is greeted with vibrant aromas of cherry, raspberry, and violet. On the palate, it offers a fresh and direct profile, with integrated tannins and a medium body, culminating in a clean, fruit-forward finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile red pairs beautifully with hearty first courses, stewed or grilled fish, white meats, and fresh or medium-aged cheeses. These combinations enhance the wine's fruitiness and structure, creating a delightful dining experience.

title: Hacienda Lopez de Haro San Vicente de la Sonsierra 2020
bodyHtml:
This 2020 vintage is a blend of 90% Tempranillo and 10% Mazuelo, sourced from 18 hectares of selected vineyards at an average altitude of 530 metres in San Vicente de la Sonsierra. The wine underwent a 12-day maceration, followed by controlled fermentation at temperatures below 25°C. It was then aged for 14 months in a combination of new and second-use French oak barrels (40%) and Eastern European oak barrels (60%).

In the glass, it presents an intense cherry colour with garnet hues at the rim, showcasing vibrancy and brightness. The nose is marked by predominant aromas of black fruits, complemented by balsamic and mineral notes, offering great depth. Additional nuances of broom, forest floor, and sweet undertones from barrel aging contribute to its complexity.

On the palate, the wine is fresh, enveloping, and persistent. The breadth of the Tempranillo variety is harmoniously combined with the acidity and tension of Mazuelo, resulting in a wine of considerable complexity and nuance.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with a variety of dishes, including roast lamb, lamb chops, stews, casseroles, and cured cheeses like Manchego. Its depth and character are highlighted when accompanied by hearty and flavourful meals.

Accolades:

91 Points - 2023 Decanter Word Wine Awards

title: Clos des Brusquieres Chateauneuf du Pape 2023
bodyHtml:
Clos des Brusquières Châteauneuf du Pape is a distinguished red wine from the Southern Rhône Valley in France, specifically the renowned Châteauneuf du Pape appellation. Produced by Clos des Brusquières, a traditional estate managed by Claude Courtil—nephew of the legendary Henri Bonneau—this winery is known for crafting a single red wine that embodies the classic character of the region.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a deep ruby hue and offers an aromatic bouquet of ripe dark berries, dried fruits, forest floor, spices, and subtle oak nuances. On the palate, it is full-bodied and well-structured, showcasing flavours of mature fruit complemented by notes of spice, cool herbs, camphor, and oak.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with rich meat dishes such as beef, lamb, and game. The robust flavours and structured tannins complement hearty meals, enhancing the wine's complexity and providing an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Chateau de Tracy Pouilly Fume 'Mademoiselle de T' 2023
bodyHtml: Ideal with seafood, spicy dishes, and vegetables. It pairs well with Thai and Japanese cuisine, enhancing the wine's depth and character.

title: Aalto Crianza 2023
bodyHtml:
Aalto is a distinguished red wine hailing from Spain's renowned Ribera del Duero region. Crafted by Bodegas Aalto, established in 1999 by esteemed winemaker Mariano García and Javier Zaccagnini, the winery is dedicated to producing high-quality wines that embody the diverse terroirs of the area.

Wine Description

This 100% Tinto Fino (Tempranillo) wine showcases a deep purple hue. The nose is rich with aromas of ripe black fruits, complemented by floral undertones and subtle toasted notes. On the palate, it offers a harmonious blend of concentrated dark fruit flavors, hints of licorice, tobacco, and spices, all balanced by a fresh minerality and well-integrated acidity. The wine's silky texture and enveloping tannins lead to a long, sweet finish.

Food Pairing

Aalto pairs exceptionally well with red meats, game dishes, and roasted lamb shank accompanied by mashed potatoes. These combinations enhance the wine's depth and character, creating a memorable dining experience.

title: Twomey Anderson Valley Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
The 2022 Twomey Anderson Valley Pinot Noir is a distinguished red wine from California's Anderson Valley, renowned for its cool-climate viticulture. Twomey Cellars, established by the Duncan family of Silver Oak fame, has been crafting exceptional wines since 1999, emphasizing sustainable practices and a commitment to expressing the unique terroir of their vineyards.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a beautiful, elegant structure characterized by bright acidity that gracefully layers across the mid-palate and elevates the finish. On the nose, it offers enticing aromas of nougat, dark cherry, and wild strawberry, complemented by subtle hints of fir tips and underbrush, reflecting the complexity and detail inherent to Anderson Valley wines.

title: Duckhorn Merlot 2022 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Founded by Dan and Margaret Duckhorn in 1976, Duckhorn Vineyards has been a pioneer in establishing Merlot as a premium varietal in Napa Valley. The winery emphasizes quality and consistency, sourcing grapes from its estate vineyards and top sites throughout the region.

Wine Description

This Merlot presents a deep ruby hue and opens with enticing aromas of black cherry, spiced plum, and subtle notes of cedar and tobacco leaf. On the palate, it offers a velvety texture with flavors of plum, candied black cherry, red licorice, and sweet baking spices. The wine's lively acidity and fine tannins contribute to a gracefully structured profile, culminating in a lush, lingering finish.

Food Pairing

This Merlot's versatility makes it an excellent companion to a variety of dishes. It pairs well with roasted meats such as lamb, beef, or pork, as well as grilled vegetables and hearty stews. For a vegetarian option, consider mushroom risotto or roasted eggplant. The wine's depth and character are enhanced when accompanied by aged cheeses like Gouda or Brie.

title: Calgary Beer Craft Lager by Village 355 ml - 12 Cans
bodyHtml:
Village Brewery's reimagining of this iconic brew honours its past while incorporating contemporary craft techniques and quality ingredients. 

This recipe is more crushable than ever - a craft lager, with Alberta barley and light hops, tailor-made for Calgary summers. It's called Calgary Beer because it's for everyone.

title: Mount Veeder Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States, specifically California's renowned Napa Valley, Mount Veeder Winery has a rich history of crafting exceptional wines that embody the unique characteristics of mountain viticulture. The winery's commitment to expressing the distinct terroir of its estate vineyards on Mount Veeder is evident in each bottle, showcasing a dedication to quality and authenticity.

Wine Description

This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep, dark magenta hue. The nose is expressive, offering notes of baking spices, cedar, fig, and black cherry. On the palate, brooding red fruit flavors dominate, complemented by a soft yet structured mouthfeel with plush tannins and moderate acidity. The finish is long and lingers with hints of black tea and bramble.

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs excellently with robust dishes such as grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, or a hearty mushroom risotto. The wine's depth and character are highlighted when accompanied by rich, savoury flavours, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Rodney Strong Rockaway Cabernet Sauvignon Single Vineyard 2018
bodyHtml:
Rodney Strong Vineyards, established in 1959, is a pioneering winery located in Sonoma County, California. Founded by Rodney Strong, a celebrated American dancer turned winemaker, the winery has been instrumental in showcasing the potential of Sonoma's diverse terroirs. The Rockaway Vineyard, situated in the heart of Alexander Valley just east of Geyserville, is renowned for producing exceptional Cabernet Sauvignon grapes.

Wine Description

The 2018 Rockaway Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep, inky hue, indicative of its concentration. On the nose, it offers aromas of black currants and spearmint. The palate is enveloped with flavors of dark plum and red currant, complemented by subtle notes of tobacco and leather. An underlying earthy minerality is balanced by hints of baking spices, contributing to a rich, complex structure and a long, lingering finish. This wine is composed of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon and is expected to age gracefully over the next 8 to 10 years.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast: 93 points.

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs exceptionally well with hearty dishes such as char-grilled hanger steak or lamb rogan josh. The wine's depth and character are highlighted when accompanied by rich, flavorful meats, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Chateau Kalian Bernasse Monbazillac 2017
bodyHtml:
Château Kalian, situated in the Monbazillac appellation of southwestern France, is a family-owned estate established in 1992 by Anne and Alain Griaud. The estate spans over 9 hectares and transitioned to organic farming practices in 2012. The name "Kalian" is a blend of their children's names, Katell and Kilian, both of whom are trained oenologists. Kilian now oversees the estate's operations.

Wine Description

The 2017 Château Kalian Bernasse Monbazillac is a certified organic sweet wine composed of 85% Sémillon and 15% Muscadelle. In the glass, it presents a deep straw-yellow hue. The nose is pronounced with aromas of orange blossom, honey, and ripe tropical fruits such as pineapple and mango. On the palate, it is luscious and full-bodied, offering flavors of marmalade, yellow fruits, and exotic stone fruits, all balanced by a refreshing acidity. The finish is warm and lingering, leaving a lasting impression of its rich fruit profile.

title: Albino Rocca Langhe Nebbiolo 'Rosso di Rocca' 2023
bodyHtml: A purchase in 2016 of a vineyard in Magliano Alfieri, a municipality on the left side of the river Tanaro, gave birth to this new version of Nebbiolo. The result was a highly fragrant red wine, with young friut and flower aromas, fresh flavors that are ready to enjoy at many different occasions.

title: Aix Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Maison Saint Aix, the winery that crafts this wine, is nestled in the renowned Coteaux d’Aix-en-Provence appellation. The estate is rooted in a rich winemaking heritage and is dedicated to honouring the Provençal terroir. For over a decade, Maison Saint Aix has committed to artisanal craftsmanship and sustainability, blending tradition with innovation to ensure healthy vines and pure wines.

Wine Description

This wine presents a pale, hypnotizing pink or a salmon pink colour. The nose offers delicate and inviting aromas of red currants, yellow plum, fresh red apple, citrus, flowers, and a hint of cherries and cassis. On the palate, it is refreshingly crisp, dry, and well-balanced, delivering flavours of peach, plum, wild berries, tart cherry, and citrus. Stylistic notes include an appealing weight, juicy acidity, and a tense, dry finish with a fine, granitic minerality.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include a broad spectrum of seafood and Asian cuisine, smoked salmon, sushi, and oysters. It also pairs beautifully with soft cheeses, Brie, and Margherita pizza.

title: Somersby Apple cider 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Taste: Easy drinking apple cider with a unique balanced taste. Pleasant sparkling sweetness with a fruity and sour balance for a very refreshing drink.

Aroma: Dominantly fresh apple tuned with floral, green and blooming notes.

title: Domaine Weinbach Riesling 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine Weinbach is a prestigious winery located in the heart of the Alsace region of France, a region known for producing some of the finest Rieslings. The estate, established in 1612, is now run by the Faller family, who have dedicated themselves to biodynamic farming and sustainable practices. The vineyard’s philosophy focuses on preserving the natural expression of the terroir, producing wines of exceptional balance and character.

Wine Description
The Domaine Weinbach Riesling is a brilliant pale golden colour, reflecting its purity and finesse. The nose opens with delicate aromas of white flowers, citrus zest, and hints of stone fruit, with subtle notes of flinty minerality. On the palate, it is vibrant and crisp, showcasing a finely structured acidity and a medium body. The wine delivers flavours of green apple, lemon, and a touch of peach, with a lingering, dry finish that adds to its overall elegance. Its freshness and complexity make it a standout in the cellar.

Food Pairing
This Riesling pairs wonderfully with fresh seafood, such as oysters or grilled lobster, as well as Asian cuisine with a balance of sweetness and spice. It also complements dishes like roasted poultry or creamy goat cheese. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Pasqua Passione Sentimento Bianco 2023
bodyHtml:
Pasqua Vigneti e Cantine is a historic Italian wine estate specializing in Veneto wines. It is widely recognized for its Valpolicella, Amarone, Soave, and Prosecco portfolio, but also produces a variety of other wines, including the PassioneSentimento Bianco.

Wine Description

This wine is produced using the appassimento method, where grapes are left to dry in special racks, concentrating the sugars and aromas. After pressing, the wine undergoes maceration on the skins to enhance complexity and structure, followed by vinification in stainless steel tanks at controlled temperatures. A portion of the wine is then aged in French oak barrels, adding depth and richness.

In the glass, it presents a pale straw yellow hue. The nose is rich, offering notes of peach, apricot, banana, and gooseberry. On the palate, it is round and juicy, with a distinct sweet aftertaste and a long-lasting finish.

title: Dorrance Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
​Dorrance Wines, established in 2000 by French expatriate Christophe Durand in Cape Town, South Africa, is renowned for crafting wines that marry Old World elegance with the unique terroir of South Africa. The 2022 Pinot Noir marks their inaugural venture into this varietal under the Dorrance label.

Sensory Profile

This youthful Pinot Noir presents aromas of black fruits intertwined with hints of pepper, black olives, and licorice. On the palate, it is tense and structured, offering freshness and vibrancy, culminating in a natural acidity that underscores the noble character of this cultivar.

title: Tolaini Cabernet Sauvignon Legit 2021
bodyHtml:
Founded by Piero Luigi Tolaini in 1998, the Tolaini estate is situated in the Chianti Classico area of Tuscany. The winery focuses on integrating traditional Italian winemaking practices with modern techniques to create wines that are both authentic and innovative. The 'Legit' label features the iconic image of jazz musician Thelonious Monk, symbolizing the wine's blend of classic style and bold character.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2020 'Legit' Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep ruby red hue. The aromatic profile includes notes of green pepper, licorice, and graphite, intertwined with subtle hints of oak and vanilla. On the palate, it offers a full-bodied experience with ripe fruit flavors, balanced acidity, and well-integrated tannins, leading to a persistent finish. This wine is expected to age gracefully over the next decade.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator: 93 points.

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs exceptionally well with hearty dishes such as grilled steaks, braised short ribs, and aged cheeses. The wine's structure and depth complement rich flavors, enhancing the overall dining experience.

title: Lingua Franca Estate Pinot Noir 'Tongue 'n Cheek' 2021
bodyHtml:
This vibrant red wine originates from the United States, carrying the Eola-Amity Hills AVA designation within Oregon's celebrated Willamette Valley. Lingua Franca was co-founded in 2015 by master sommelier Larry Stone and iconic Burgundian winemaker Dominique Lafon, driven by a desire to explore the region's unique terroirs. The estate is guided by a winemaking philosophy focused on organic and regenerative farming practices, utilizing a gravity-flow winery overseen by winemaker Thomas Savre to capture optimal freshness, tension, and complexity.

Wine Description

Tongue 'n Cheek Pinot Noir presents a dark ruby colour with faint purple reflections in the glass. The nose is highly complex and delicate, unfolding heady, expressive aromas of wild mountain berries, dark black cherries, and dried pomegranates mingled with fragrant violet petals, graphite, and savory spices like anise, clove, and cinnamon. On the palate, this medium-bodied wine feels sleek, silky, and beautifully poised. It delivers an intense, focused core of blueberry and red raspberry fruit neatly framed by a simmering backbone of mineral-tinged acidity and fine, well-integrated tannins. Subtle undercurrents of smoky black tea, forest floor, and potpourri add marvelous savory depth to its supple texture.

title: Squealing Pig Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Squealing Pig is a contemporary New Zealand winery located in the renowned Marlborough region, celebrated for its cool climate and expressive Sauvignon Blancs. Known for its playful branding and quality-driven approach, the winery sources grapes from premium vineyard sites to produce fresh, vibrant wines. Their philosophy centres on crafting approachable wines that capture the essence of Marlborough terroir.

Wine Description
The 2022 Squealing Pig Sauvignon Blanc displays a pale straw hue with hints of green. The bouquet opens with vivid aromas of juicy pineapple, fresh basil, lemon pith, and cut grass. On the palate, it delivers an energetic burst of citrus—lime, lemon, and grapefruit—layered with nuances of white peach and a delicate herbal undertone. Light to medium-bodied, the wine offers bright acidity, a silky texture, and a focused, refreshing finish. This vintage stands out for its balance of fruit purity and zesty liveliness.

Food Pairing
Perfect pairings include Thai green curry with fish, fresh tomato and basil salad, grilled asparagus with lemon zest, or chicken and sage skewers. These dishes complement the wine’s herbal and citrus profile. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Chateau De Clotte 2015
bodyHtml:
Château de Clotte is a historic estate located in the Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux appellation of southwestern France. Founded in 1782 by the Roy de Clotte family, the château is nestled on 22 hectares of clay and clay-limestone soils ideal for cultivating classic Bordeaux varietals. With a longstanding commitment to tradition and quality, the estate produces wines that reflect both the region’s heritage and its unique terroir.

Wine Description
The 2015 vintage is a refined Bordeaux blend predominantly composed of Cabernet Franc, supported by Merlot and Malbec. It pours a deep garnet in the glass, offering aromas of ripe plum, black cherry, and warm spice, layered with notes of cedar and vanilla. On the palate, it reveals a supple texture and well-integrated tannins, delivering flavours of dark berries, tobacco leaf, and subtle earthy undertones. Medium to full-bodied, the wine finishes with elegance and length, showcasing the richness and balance of the vintage.

 

Food Pairing
A versatile companion to food, this wine pairs beautifully with roasted beef, duck breast, mushroom risotto, and game meats such as venison. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and structure. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Small Gully Mr. Black's Concoction GSM 2015
bodyHtml:
Small Gully Wines is located in the heart of the Barossa Valley, South Australia—one of the country’s most prestigious wine regions. Founded with a focus on crafting wines of intensity and character, the winery is known for its bold, fruit-driven expressions. The ‘Mr. Black’s Concoction’ series embodies the estate’s commitment to showcasing the strength and complexity of traditional Rhône-style blends.

Wine Description
This GSM blend—Grenache, Shiraz, and Mataro—offers a rich and layered sensory experience. Deep ruby in colour, the wine opens with aromas of ripe red berries, dried herbs, and subtle earthy notes. On the palate, the Grenache brings sweet raspberry and red currant tones, the Shiraz adds body, dark plum, and black pepper spice, while the Mataro contributes firm structure and a savoury finish. Medium to full-bodied, the wine is balanced by fresh acidity and smooth tannins, delivering impressive length and complexity. This blend is unashamedly bold yet remarkably refined, a hallmark of Barossa craftsmanship.

Food Pairing
Ideal pairings include slow-roasted lamb shoulder, duck confit, or smoked sausages with rosemary and garlic. The wine’s structure and depth complement richly flavoured dishes with hearty textures. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Kilchoman Batch Strength
bodyHtml: Matured in a combination of re-charred red wine casks, oloroso sherry butts and bourbon barrels, a few drops of water were added post maturation to produce a Batch Strength of 57% abv. The result is a colossal dram combining the natural peat smoke and citrus character of Kilchoman with dark fruits, rich spices and salted caramel sweetness.

title: Kilchoman Port Cask Matured 2024 Edition
bodyHtml: The Port Cask Matured limited edition was aged for the full term of its maturation in ruby port hogsheads, selected from two contrasting ages, the youngest being 6 years old, then bottled at 50% abv.

title: Phillips Dinosour Jurassic Mix Pack 473 ml - 8 Cans
bodyHtml:
This is an 8-pack of 473 ml tall cans, featuring two cans each of:

Dinosour Blackberry Sour Ale 

This fruit beer pours a beautiful pale pink colour with aromas of watermelon, blackberries and sour apples. Sharp carbonation and light in body, a firm sour flavour is balanced with moderate fruit sweetness, finishing puckeringly dry.

Dinosour Raspberry Lime Sour Ale

Dinosour Raspberry Lime Sour packs a delightfully tart bite. Soured with our house-cultured Lacto strain, raspberry juice and lime juice are added during pre and post-fermentation periods, balancing the sour line flavour with juicy berry sweetness.

Dinosour Stone Fruit Sour Ale

A ripe and juicy sour ale that has the perfect balance of sweet and tart. Crafted with the finest quality barley and wheat malt, we co-ferment with a blend of in-house lactobacillus and ale yeast for a zingy, effervescent, and punchy sour beer base. Aged on a stone-fruit medley of apricots, peaches, and nectarines, the flavours meld perfectly together so much so it’s hard to tell where one begins and the other ends, for a lush, fizzy treat.

Dinosour Pink Lemonade Sour Ale

Dinosour Pink Lemonade packs a delightfully tart bite. Soured with our house-cultured Lacto strain, lemon and cranberry juice are added pre and post-fermentation, balancing sour and citrus flavours with light berry sweetness.

title: Booker Vineyard 'Oublie' 2019
bodyHtml:
The 2020 Oublié from Booker Vineyard is a distinguished Rhône-style blend hailing from the Paso Robles region of California. Crafted by winemaker Eric Jensen, this wine exemplifies the estate's commitment to organic and biodynamic farming practices on their 100-acre property.

Wine Description

Comprising Grenache, Syrah, and Mourvèdre, the 2020 Oublié presents a deep ruby-purple hue. The nose is greeted with confident aromas of boysenberry, licorice, and cedar. On the palate, lively flavors of raspberry coulis intertwine with notes of blonde roast coffee and chocolate ganache, culminating in a harmonious and complex profile.

Accolades

  • Wine Advocate awarded this vintage 95 points

  • James Suckling rated it 95 points

  • Vinous gave it 92 points

Food Pairing

Oublié is traditionally one of Booker Vineyard's most food-friendly wines, pairing well with a variety of dishes. Its balanced structure and complex flavor profile make it a versatile companion to both hearty and nuanced culinary creations.

title: Leclerc Briant Extra Brut Reserve Champagne (NV)
bodyHtml:
Hailing from France, Leclerc Briant Brut Reserve Champagne comes from the heart of Champagne, specifically the Épernay area in the Marne Valley. Founded in 1872, Champagne Leclerc Briant is a historic estate that has been a pioneer in biodynamic practices within the region. Now owned by an American couple, the winery continues its legacy under the direction of Hervé Jestin, emphasizing minimal intervention and respect for the terroir.

Wine Description

This Champagne reveals a brilliant golden straw hue with a lively stream of fine bubbles. Aromas are vibrant and layered, showing notes of crisp green apple, lemon zest, toasted brioche, and delicate floral hints. On the palate, it offers a harmonious balance of freshness and depth, with flavours of pear, almond, and subtle minerality that lead to a refined, creamy finish. The wine has a medium body with a bright, persistent mousse.

Food Pairing

Perfect alongside oysters, shrimp tempura, or a delicate goat cheese tart. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Henschke Grenache Johann's Garden 2022
bodyHtml:
Henschke, a family-owned winery established in 1868, has been a pillar of Australian winemaking for generations. Their dedication to crafting high-quality wines is evident in their meticulous vineyard management and traditional techniques. Johann's Garden pays homage to the early Silesian pioneers of the Barossa, many named Johann, whose perseverance laid the foundation for the region's thriving wine culture. The term 'garden' reflects the German word 'weingarten,' traditionally used by Barossa growers to describe their vineyards.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a medium ruby hue with purple undertones. The bouquet is deeply perfumed, featuring freshly cut red berries, rhubarb, cherry, and liquorice, intertwined with garrigue herbs, lavender, mace, and subtle white pepper notes. On the palate, it offers a rich, spicy profile with vibrant raspberry and mulberry flavors, balanced by fresh acidity and culminating in a long, elegant finish with fine, silky tannins.

title: Radford Dale Gamay Noir 'Vinum' 2022
bodyHtml:
​Radford Dale's Vinum Gamay Noir 2022 is a distinguished South African red wine originating from the Polkadraai Hills in Stellenbosch. This vintage marks the third expression of Gamay Noir by Radford Dale, highlighting their commitment to this esteemed varietal. The winery's dedication is evident in their establishment of new Gamay vineyards, including the first plantings in over two decades on the Polkadraai Hills, serving as a mother block for future quality cuttings.

Sensory Profile

In the glass, the wine presents a deep purple hue with a violet rim. The nose is greeted with aromatic notes of mulberry and spiced plum, offering a generous and juicy bouquet. On the palate, it exhibits medium weight, ripe fruit flavors, and substantial tannins that culminate in a rewarding, full finish. The wine's balance of richness and freshness makes it both approachable and complex.

title: Castello di Verduno Barolo 2020
bodyHtml:
Castello di Verduno's Barolo is a distinguished red wine hailing from the renowned Barolo DOCG region in Piedmont, Italy. This wine is crafted from 100% Nebbiolo grapes sourced from the Boscato vineyard in Verduno, showcasing the winery's commitment to expressing the unique terroir of this area.

Sensory Profile

This Barolo presents a captivating bouquet featuring aromas of sweet tobacco, earthiness, orange peel, cedar, dried flowers, licorice, and herbs. On the palate, it offers a harmonious blend of these complex notes, supported by refined tannins and a lingering finish. The wine's structure and depth reflect the classic characteristics of Nebbiolo from this esteemed region.

Food Pairing

This Barolo pairs exceptionally well with rich dishes such as braised beef, truffle-infused risottos, and aged cheeses. The wine's acidity and tannic structure complement the depth and flavors of these dishes, enhancing the overall dining experience.

title: Kopke Colheita Port 1967
bodyHtml:
​Kopke Colheita Port 1967 is a distinguished single-harvest tawny port from Portugal's renowned Douro Valley. Produced by Kopke, the oldest port house established in 1638, this wine reflects the estate's commitment to quality and tradition.

Winery Background

Founded by Nicolau Köpke, Kopke has a long-standing reputation for crafting exceptional ports, particularly their Colheita (single-harvest) expressions. The 1967 vintage commemorates significant historical events, such as the first successful human-to-human heart transplant performed by Dr. Christiaan Barnard in South Africa.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Deep amber with greenish hues.

  • Aroma: Dominant notes of dried fruits, particularly hazelnut.

  • Palate: Impressive structure featuring flavors of caramel and chocolate, leading to a superb and persistent finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast: 95 points.

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate: 95 points.

Food Pairing

This port pairs exceptionally well with desserts featuring caramel, dried fruits, and spices. Consider enjoying it alongside caramel fondant with apple and ginger jelly, tarte Tatin, crème brûlée, or mild cheeses. For a refreshing contrast, try it with a tangerine parfait.

title: Bideona Viura de Cabezadas 2020
bodyHtml:
Bideona Viura de Cabezadas 2020 is a white wine from the Rioja Alavesa region in Spain, crafted by Bodegas Bideona. This wine is made exclusively from the Viura grape, sourced from vineyards averaging 30 years of age, situated on limestone soils. The term "Cabezadas" refers to the uppermost parts of these vineyards.

Sensory Profile

  • Colour: Pale yellow with greenish reflections; clear and bright.​

  • Aroma: Fresh and subtle, featuring pure stone fruit notes with hints of white flowers and a touch of struck match.

  • Palate: Light and crisp, yet well-concentrated with fruit flavours. The finish is refreshingly dry with a slight mineral quality.​

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with dishes such as grilled white fish, seafood paella, roasted chicken, and creamy pasta dishes. These pairings highlight the wine's freshness and subtle complexity, creating a delightful dining experience.

title: Caymus Cabernet Sauvignon 'California' 2022 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Caymus Vineyards, founded in 1972 by the Wagner family in Napa Valley, California, is celebrated for its dedication to crafting bold, polished Cabernet Sauvignon wines. Over the decades, the family has expanded their expertise beyond Napa to explore the richness of California’s broader winegrowing regions. The ‘California’ Cabernet Sauvignon blends fruit from diverse appellations across the state, delivering a wine that reflects the Wagner family’s exacting standards and statewide terroir.

Wine Description
In the glass, this Cabernet pours a deep garnet colour. Aromas of ripe blackberry, cassis, and dark cherry unfold alongside notes of cocoa, vanilla bean, and subtle toasted oak. The palate is rich and fruit-forward, offering layers of black plum, raspberry compote, and mocha wrapped in velvety tannins. Medium to full-bodied with a plush mouthfeel, the wine finishes smooth, warm, and satisfying. Its round texture and supple structure make it especially approachable in its youth, though it will evolve gracefully for up to a decade.

title: Pecchenino Barolo 'Le Coste di Monforte' 2019
bodyHtml:
This wine comes from Italy, specifically the Piedmont region within the Barolo DOCG. The Pecchenino winery is a historic family estate established in the late 18th century, with documentation of winemaking dating back to the early 1900s under the guidance of grandfather Attilio. Since 1987, the winery has been run by brothers Orlando and Attilio Pecchenino, who have expanded the estate to 39 hectares. While they were originally famous for their Dolcetto, they have built a formidable reputation for Barolo since acquiring prestigious plots in Monforte d'Alba in 2004. Their philosophy focuses on manual vineyard work, low yields for maximum concentration, and the use of traditional winemaking techniques like the 'submerged cap' method to faithfully express the unique terroir of their single vineyards.

Wine Description

The 2019 'Le Coste di Monforte' is crafted from 100% Nebbiolo grapes sourced from a single vineyard at an altitude of 440 metres. It displays a garnet red colour and a rich, deep nose. The aromatic profile is complex, featuring pure cherry, strawberry, violet, and hay, layered with savory notes of tobacco, white pepper, wild mint, and liquorice. Some tasters also note accents of iron, wild thyme, and rosemary.

On the palate, this is a robust and fleshy red with a full-bodied structure. It presents a taut, mineral finish supported by dense but silky, well-balanced tannins. The wine is characterized by its bracing acidity and a 'blood orange' streak on the finish that drives its energy. Stylistically, it offers a harmonious balance between intense fruit and a powerful, mineral-driven backbone. The optimal drinking window is estimated to be from 2027 through 2047, though some suggest it can age well until 2063.

Accolades

  • 'Wine Spectator - 95 points'

  • 'James Suckling - 93 points'

  • 'Wine Advocate - 93 points'

title: Taylor Fladgate Quinta de Vargellas Vintage Port 2019
bodyHtml:
Taylor Fladgate's Quinta de Vargellas Vintage Port 2019 is a distinguished single-quinta vintage Port from Portugal's renowned Douro Valley. Quinta de Vargellas, a historic estate in the Douro Superior, has been esteemed for its exceptional Port wines since the 1820s. The 2019 vintage showcases the estate's commitment to producing wines of elegance and longevity.

Sensory Profile

This Vintage Port presents a deep purple-black hue with a narrow red rim and magenta highlights. The nose is polished and precise, featuring pure, bright fruit aromas dominated by raspberry and cherry, complemented by subtle botanical notes of bracken, underwood, wild herbs, and flowers. On the palate, it is compact and racy, with vibrant acidity and fine, linear tannins. The distinctive fruit quality re-emerges, extending into a long, seductive finish.

Accolades

  • James Suckling: 95 points.

  • Wine Enthusiast: 95 points.

  • Wine Spectator: 95 points.

Food Pairing

This Vintage Port pairs exceptionally well with richly flavored cheeses such as blue-veined varieties and walnuts. Dried fruits like apricots or figs also complement its complex profile. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Tantalus Cabernet Franc 2023
bodyHtml:
Tantalus Vineyards, located in the Okanagan Valley of British Columbia, Canada, has a storied history dating back to 1927, making it one of the oldest continuously producing vineyards in the region. The winery is renowned for its commitment to crafting exceptional wines that authentically express their terroir.

The Cabernet Franc from Tantalus' Further Afield Series is a notable addition to their portfolio. This wine presents a bright ruby hue and offers a complex bouquet featuring notes of tomato leaf, cardamom, fresh tobacco, and crushed rocks, complemented by juicy raspberry and pomegranate aromas. The palate mirrors these aromas, delivering flavors of plum and raspberry, with additional hints of tobacco and pomegranate. The wine is characterized by its great length and a core mineral line, reflecting the high-quality vineyard from which it originates.

Crafted from 100% Cabernet Franc sourced from a certified-organic vineyard in Osoyoos, this wine underwent fermentation in separate batches at varying temperatures, utilizing both wild and inoculated yeasts. Stem inclusion involved up to 40% whole clusters, depending on the batch.

title: Cristom Pinot Noir Paul Gerrie Vineyard 2021
bodyHtml:
The 2021 Cristom 'Paul Gerrie Vineyard' Pinot Noir originates from the Eola-Amity Hills subregion within Oregon's Willamette Valley. Cristom Vineyards, established in 1992 by the Gerrie family, is renowned for its commitment to producing wines that reflect their unique terroir. The Paul Gerrie Vineyard, named after the founder, was planted in 2014 and features a variety of volcanic soils, contributing to the wine's distinctive character.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir presents a complex sensory profile:

  • Color: Dark ruby hue.

  • Aroma: An inviting bouquet of blueberry, mocha, and almond.

  • Palate: The palate is dominated by Bing cherry flavors, complemented by notes of bittersweet dark chocolate and black coffee. The wine exhibits velvety tannins and explosive acidity, contributing to its balanced structure.

  • Body: Medium to full-bodied with a tightly coiled structure, indicating potential for aging.

  • Finish: Long and tannic, with repleting floral notes and a sapid quality.

Accolades

  • Jeb Dunnuck: 96 points.

  • James Suckling: 94 points.

  • Vinous: 94+ points.

  • Decanter: 93 points.

title: El Tequileno Blanco Still Strength Tequila
bodyHtml: 100% Blue Weber agave. Bottled at a potent 100 proof (50% ABV) straight from the still, it embodies the robust and unfiltered character of high-quality agave. Our first Still Strength presents an authentic and powerful tequila experience.

title: Soalheiro Alvarinho Classico 2024
bodyHtml:
This single-varietal white wine hails from Portugal, specifically the Vinho Verde DOC, in the subregion of Monção and Melgaço. Quinta de Soalheiro was established in 1974 by João António Cerdeira and his parents, António Esteves Ferreira and Maria Cerdeira, with the pioneering decision to dedicate an entire, sun-drenched parcel of land to the Alvarinho grape.

Wine Description

The Soalheiro Alvarinho Clássico 2024 displays a bright, lemon-yellow colour. As a single-varietal wine, it is made entirely from Alvarinho grapes. It offers an elegant and fresh fragrance that reveals the variety's aromatic complexity. The palate presents intense tropical and mineral notes that are perfectly balanced by its lively acidity and moderate alcohol content. Stylistically, it is noted for its freshness and elegance, its svelte, textured body, and an unusual ability to evolve in the bottle.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 91 points

Food Pairing

The 'Clássico' serves as an excellent apéritif. It is an ideal complement to lighter-flavoured dishes and pairs particularly well with a range of foods, including seafood, grilled fish, white meats, and aged cheeses.

title: Soalheiro Alvarinho Granit 2024
bodyHtml:
Soalheiro Granit Alvarinho is a distinguished white wine from Portugal's Vinho Verde DOC, specifically the Monção and Melgaço sub-region. Soalheiro, established in 1974 by João António Cerdeira, was among the pioneers in cultivating Alvarinho grapes as a continuous vineyard in Melgaço. Today, the third-generation family members continue this innovative spirit, focusing on expressing the unique terroir of their region.

Wine Description

This wine presents a bright, lemon-yellow hue and exudes elegant aromas with pronounced mineral notes. On the palate, it is crisp, dry, and persistent, showcasing earthy and stony flavours. A notable sensation of saltiness reflects the influence of the granite soils on the Alvarinho grape.

Food Pairing

With its mineral character and lively acidity, Soalheiro Granit Alvarinho pairs exceptionally well with Mediterranean dishes such as seafood, grilled fish, or oven-baked fatty fish. It also complements white and smoked meats, mature cheeses, and delicate Asian cuisine like sushi or dumplings.

title: Martin's Lane Naramata Ranch Pinot Noir 2020
bodyHtml:
Martin's Lane Winery, established in 2014, specializes exclusively in Riesling and Pinot Noir. Under the guidance of winemaker Shane Munn, the winery emphasizes organic farming and minimal intervention techniques to produce wines that authentically express their unique vineyard sites.

Wine Description:

The 2020 Naramata Ranch Vineyard Pinot Noir presents a highly perfumed nose, leading to a complex palate of black cherries intertwined with savoury, spicy licorice notes, culminating in a rich umami finish. This wine is both elegant and silky, showcasing the depth and character typical of the Naramata Bench terroir.

Accolades:

  • Anthony Gismondi, Gismondi on Wine – 96 points.

Food Pairing:

This Pinot Noir pairs exceptionally well with dishes such as herb-crusted lamb, wild mushroom risotto, or grilled salmon. These pairings accentuate the wine's complexity and enhance its elegant profile.

title: To Kalon Vineyard Company Highest Beauty Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
To Kalon Vineyard Company is dedicated to crafting exceptional Cabernet Sauvignon that embodies the rich heritage and unique terroir of the historic To Kalon Vineyard. Established in the 1860s by H.W. Crabb, who named it "To Kalon," Greek for "highest beauty," the vineyard has become renowned for producing wines of remarkable purity and intensity.

Wine Description

The 2021 Highest Beauty Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep, rich hue in the glass. Aromas of boysenberry, black currant, and blackberry puree captivate the senses, complemented by subtle notes of loam, licorice root, and singed alder. On the palate, this full-bodied wine offers soft tannins and a polished structure, leading to a long, elegant finish with a hint of iron. Crafted exclusively from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon grapes harvested at night to preserve their freshness, the wine underwent careful sorting followed by a long, slow fermentation and maceration, enhancing its complexity and depth.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator – 95 points

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs exceptionally well with hearty dishes such as grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, or roasted lamb. The wine's rich fruit profile and structured tannins complement the savory depth of these dishes, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Rivetto Barolo Leon Riserva 2019
bodyHtml:
​Rivetto Barolo Leon Riserva is a distinguished red wine hailing from Italy's renowned Barolo DOCG region, specifically the esteemed Serralunga d'Alba subregion. Crafted by the fourth-generation Rivetto family, this wine embodies their commitment to organic and biodynamic practices, reflecting a deep respect for the land and a dedication to producing wines of exceptional quality.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo wine presents a medium deep ruby hue with a rusty rim. The nose is elegant, offering floral notes alongside aromas of red berries, ginger, and spices. On the palate, it showcases good crispness, a youthful texture with a firm tannic core, and bright acidity. Layers of red berries lead to a persistent, long, and lingering finish, indicating good potential for development.

title: Achaval Ferrer Cabernet Franc 2021
bodyHtml:
Achaval Ferrer, established in 1998 in Mendoza, Argentina, has garnered acclaim for its commitment to producing high-quality wines that authentically express the region's terroir. The winery emphasizes minimal intervention and sustainable practices to showcase the pure character of each varietal.​

Wine Description

The 2021 Achaval Ferrer Cabernet Franc presents a deep ruby hue. On the nose, it offers vibrant aromas of cranberries, complemented by subtle herbal notes and a hint of bell pepper. The palate is expressive, featuring soft tannins and balanced acidity, with flavours of raspberry sauce and herbs that lead to a medium finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 89 points. ​

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Franc pairs well with grilled meats such as beef and venison, as well as dishes featuring bell peppers or herbaceous components. Its balanced acidity and medium body also complement aged cheeses, enhancing the wine's depth and character.

title: French Door Estate Heritage 2021
bodyHtml:
​French Door Estate Winery, located on the Black Sage Bench in Oliver, British Columbia, is a family-owned and operated vineyard established in 2019. Inspired by their travels through Provence, owners Audra and Jason Shull aim to craft wines that embody the elegance and tradition of French winemaking. Under the guidance of consulting winemaker Pascal Madevon, the winery focuses on producing low-intervention wines from sustainably grown grapes, emphasizing a classic old-world French style.

2021 Vintage

The 2021 Héritage is a Bordeaux-style blend comprising Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, Syrah, and Petit Verdot. In the glass, it presents a deep, inviting hue. The nose reveals aromas of red cherries and strawberries, complemented by hints of coconut, baking spices, and dried flowers. On the palate, layers of dark red fruits intertwine with notes of tobacco and mint, enriched by flavours reminiscent of pomegranate juice, cherry pie filling, and pastry. The finish is long and earthy, leaving a lasting impression. This wine is medium to full-bodied, showcasing a harmonious balance between its fruit-forward character and structured tannins. While approachable now, it also possesses the potential for graceful aging over the next 5–7 years.

Accolades

As of March 2025, specific accolades for the 2021 Heritage have not been published. However, previous vintages have received notable praise.

title: De Forville Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
De Forville, established in 1860 by Gioacchino De Forville, is a historic winery in the Piedmont region of Italy. With origins tracing back to Wallonia, the family settled in Barbaresco and has since been influential in promoting the Nebbiolo grape. Their commitment to quality and tradition extends to their production of Chardonnay.

Wine Description

The De Forville Piemonte Chardonnay is a 100% Chardonnay wine sourced from vineyards in Castagnole Lanze at the "Cascina Buc" farmhouse and in Coazzolo. Vinified and aged exclusively in stainless steel, this wine showcases a pale straw yellow color with greenish reflections. On the nose, it offers delicate and fresh aromas of wildflowers. The palate is dry, velvety, and harmonious, reflecting its light and fresh character.

title: Martin's Lane Pinot Noir 'Simes Vineyard' 2020
bodyHtml:
Martin's Lane Winery, located in the Okanagan Valley of British Columbia, Canada, is renowned for its focus on producing exceptional Pinot Noir and Riesling wines. Established by Anthony von Mandl, the winery is named in honour of his father and reflects a commitment to crafting wines that express the unique terroir of the region. The Simes Vineyard, situated on the East Kelowna Slopes, is notable for its steep, north-facing orientation and granite-based soils, contributing to the distinctive character of its wines.

Wine Description

The 2020 Simes Vineyard Pinot Noir presents a deep, rich colour, indicative of its concentration. On the nose, it offers an intricate bouquet of black cherry and blackberry, complemented by subtle spicy notes. The palate is dense and vivid, showcasing flavours reminiscent of black spicy fruits, with a silky texture attributed to the high percentage of whole-bunch fermentation. This Pinot Noir is well-balanced, with bright acidity and refined tannins, leading to a long, elegant finish.

Accolades

  • Gismondi on Wine – 93 points.

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir pairs exceptionally well with dishes such as herb-crusted lamb, wild mushroom risotto, or roasted duck breast. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Shaw and Smith Shiraz Adelaide Hills 2013
bodyHtml:
Produced by the renowned Shaw + Smith winery, this vintage exemplifies the elegance and complexity achievable in cool-climate Shiraz. The 2013 growing season was marked by dry conditions and cool nights, contributing to the wine's depth and complexity.

Colour: Medium to deep garnet with purple hues, indicating its concentration and maturity.

Aroma: Expressive notes of red and black cherries, black raspberries, pepper, star anise, and violets, creating a complex and inviting bouquet.

Palate: Medium-bodied with a soft, satiny texture, offering fresh and pure flavors of red and black fruits, complemented by gentle spice and floral undertones. The palate is well-balanced, with great concentration leading to an elegant, long finish.

Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, refreshing texture that emphasizes purity and balance.

Finish: Bright and lingering, with a delicate minerality that leaves a refreshing and slightly saline aftertaste.

Accolades:

  • 96 Points – James Suckling
  • 92 Points – Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Shaw + Smith Shiraz 2013 is crafted to be enjoyed upon release but also has the potential to develop further complexity with short-term cellaring over the next decade. It pairs excellently with grilled meats, hearty stews, and aged cheeses, making it a versatile choice for various dining occasions. The wine was aged for 14 months in French oak, with one-third being new, enhancing its depth and complexity.

title: Undurraga T.H. Syrah Leyda 2023
bodyHtml:
​The Undurraga T.H. Syrah Leyda hails from Chile's renowned Leyda Valley, a subregion of the San Antonio Valley. Viña Undurraga, established in 1885, is celebrated for its commitment to expressing Chile's diverse terroirs through its Terroir Hunter (T.H.) series. This initiative focuses on uncovering distinctive micro-terroirs to craft wines that authentically represent their origins.

Wine Description

This Syrah presents a deep, rich colour and exudes a pronounced coastal character. The nose offers aromas of raw meat, liqueur-like black fruits, spices, and herbs. On the palate, it is succulent with soft tannins, delivering a harmonious blend of flavours and creamy textures. The wine's structure is complemented by a vibrant acidity, contributing to its freshness and balance.

Food Pairing

This Syrah pairs excellently with grilled lamb, beef stews, and game meats. The wine's depth and character are highlighted when accompanied by dishes featuring rich, savoury flavours.​

title: Cedar Creek Pinot Noir Platinum East Kelowna Slopes 2022
bodyHtml:
CedarCreek Estate Winery, founded in 1986, is a cornerstone of British Columbia's Okanagan Valley wine scene. Dedicated to organic farming and sustainable viticulture, the winery focuses on crafting site-specific wines that capture the unique expressions of their terroir. The East Kelowna Slopes vineyard, shaped by glacial activity, offers varied soils and elevations that are ideal for growing premium Pinot Noir.

This vintage reveals a deep ruby colour, offering dark, brooding aromas of plum, blackberry, and raspberry leaf. The palate is structured and expressive, with firm yet polished tannins and a layered core of dark fruit and earthy spice. Naturally fermented using wild yeasts, the wine was vinified in a mix of concrete and stainless steel vessels, then aged for 14 months in 35% new French oak. The result is a balanced, age-worthy Pinot Noir with both tension and elegance.

Accolades
Anthony Gismondi – 92 points

Food Pairing
Excellent with grilled salmon, roasted quail, or a wild mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

Vintage Quality
The 2022 growing season in the Okanagan Valley delivered warm days and cool nights, encouraging excellent ripening conditions. CedarCreek's commitment to organic vineyard practices and precise winemaking yielded a Pinot Noir of exceptional structure and finesse.

title: Cedar Creek Pinot Noir Platinum South Kelowna Slopes 2021
bodyHtml:
CedarCreek Estate Winery, founded in 1986, is one of the Okanagan Valley’s founding wineries, known for its commitment to organic farming and minimal-intervention winemaking. The estate’s South Kelowna Slopes, particularly the Home Block Vineyard planted in 1991, provide a cooler microclimate and varied soils ideal for cultivating expressive, site-specific Pinot Noir.

This 2021 vintage opens with a deep ruby colour and inviting aromatics of wild strawberries, cranberries, and rosehip, layered with subtle earthy undertones. The palate is bright and focused, showing a lifted acidity and fine, integrated tannins. The wine’s structure is elegant and fresh, with a delicate finish that lingers with red fruit and mineral notes. Crafted with minimal intervention and aged with precision, this wine reflects both the vintage and the character of its hillside origins.

Accolades
Sara d'Amato – 91 points

Food Pairing
Pairs well with roasted duck breast, seared salmon, or wild mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

Vintage Quality
The 2021 growing season in the Okanagan Valley saw record heat and the earliest harvest on record. Despite the challenging conditions, CedarCreek’s attentive vineyard management yielded a Pinot Noir with impressive balance, structure, and concentrated fruit expression.

title: Zenato Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico 2020 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Zenato Amarone della Valpolicella Classico originates from Italy, within the Veneto region and the Valpolicella Classico subregion. Established in 1960 by Sergio and Carla Zenato, the property has cemented a global reputation for quality focused viticulture centered in the Sant'Ambrogio township. The family's winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the depth of local traditions with style and precision, allowing their vines to coexist with the stony, chalky limestone hillside soils of the region.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep ruby red appearance that tends towards garnet with aging, and possesses a big, powerful, and full bodied structure with a plush, velvety texture. The sensory profile is exceptionally intense, complex, and enveloping, opening with an aromatic nose of maraschino cherries, cassis, dried plums, and figs, balanced by undertones of sweet tobacco, bay leaves, truffles, and fine spices. On the warm and pillowy palate, it delivers luscious, deep flavours of dark chocolate fudge, blackberry jam, licorice, and prunes, cut through with a cleansing natural acidity and soft, integrated tannins. The finish is remarkably long, majestic, and savory, leaving trailing trails of cocoa powder, toasted black pepper, and subtle balsamic notes.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional Valpolicella blend primarily composed of 80% to 85% Corvina Veronese, rounded out with 10% Rondinella, and 5% minor regional varieties like Oseleta and Croatina.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its masterful balance of immense extract and freshness, crafted via the traditional appassimento method. Hand picked clusters are left to dry in ventilated rooms for 3 to 4 months before a slow winter fermentation on the skins and extended aging for 36 to 48 months in large Slavonian oak casks.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 16.5% and 17%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate relies on meticulous, manual agriculture and strict fruit selection to safeguard the transparency of the Sant'Ambrogio plots, this bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The robust body, deep fruit concentration, and velvety tannic frame of this Amarone Classico make it an ideal partner for rich, deeply savory gastronomy.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with thick cuts of dry aged beef like a traditional Bistecca Fiorentina, braised meat dishes, slow simmered pot roasts, and hearty beef pies.

  • Savoury & Italian Staples: Suggested pairings include a rich wild mushroom risotto, pasta served in a decadent cream sauce with truffles, or wild game reductions.

  • Cheese: Matches spectacularly with structured platters of mature, hard aged cheeses such as Parmigiano Reggiano or sharp blue selections.

title: Highwood Long Island Iced Tea Mix - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Using the traditional recipe from the 1970s, they combine four of Highwood's finest spirits (vodka, gin, rum, and triple sec) to produce this delicious cocktail. The back label provides the details, down to the ounce, on how to make and enjoy the perfect Long Island Iced Tea.

title: Samuel Smith Organic Apricot Fruit Beer 550 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml: Handcrafted at the tiny All Saints Brewery set in a time warp in Stamford using the old manually operated brewing equipment. Finest organically grown barley and wheat are used to create a  complex ale which, having undergone primary and secondary fermentation with different yeasts and extended maturation, is taken to Samuel Smith’s small, independent British brewery at Tadcaster. There it is blended with pure organic cherry, strawberry, raspberry or apricot fruit juices and more organic beer to create fruit beers of considerable strength and flavour. The smooth distinctive character of the matured beer serves as the perfect counterpoint to the pure organic fruit juice.

title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino  2018 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino originates from the renowned Montalcino region in Tuscany, Italy. Founded at the end of the 19th century by Lavinio Franceschi, the estate was a pioneer in marketing Brunello and a founding member of the local wine consortium. Today, successors Leopoldo and Livia Franceschi maintain the winery's legacy by blending traditional winemaking crafts with innovative sustainable practices, such as hand-harvesting and aging in large French oak barrels.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese wine displays a brilliant ruby red colour with intense, persistent aromas of dark cherry, blackberry, and red fruit, layered with exotic spice, leather, and tilled earth. On the palate, it is full bodied and well balanced, offering a warm, savory profile with velvety, smooth tannins and a zesty acidity that provides freshness. The finish is long and elegant, marked by notes of licorice, tobacco, and balsamic-tinged fruit.

Accolades

  • Vinous - 96 points

  • James Suckling - 94 points

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 94 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 94 points

  • Decanter - 92 points

Food Pairing

This Brunello is an ideal companion for rich meat dishes such as roast lamb, wild boar ragu, or a classic Florentine steak. It also pairs beautifully with earthy truffle-based pastas and mature cheeses like Pecorino Toscano or Parmigiano-Reggiano.

title: Domaine Tempier Bandol Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Domaine Tempier Bandol Rosé 2024 is widely regarded as the global benchmark for serious, age-worthy rosé, produced in the Bandol appellation of Provence, France.

The estate’s history dates back to 1834, but its modern reputation was forged by Lucie 'Lulu' Tempier and Lucien Peyraud, who married in 1936 and dedicated their lives to establishing Mourvèdre as the premier grape of the region. Managed today with the same pioneering spirit, the winery operates with a philosophy of deep respect for nature, utilizing organic and biodynamic practices that follow lunar cycles. Tempier is unique for producing a rosé with the structure of a fine white wine, designed to evolve in complexity over several years in the bottle.

Wine Description

The 2024 vintage presents a pale salmon pink colour and a remarkably fragrant nose of raspberries, apples, and steely minerals. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and luscious with a mouth-coating texture, balanced by high acidity and a slight effervescence. Sensory notes include red berries, apple peel, and bitter citrus rinds resembling grapefruit or orange, leading to a long finish defined by grapefruit and intense mineral drive.

This wine is a blend of approximately 55% Mourvèdre, 25% Grenache, and 20% Cinsault, though some parcels may include small amounts of Carignan. The Mourvèdre provides the wine with its signature character, balance, and aging potential. The grapes are hand-harvested from vines averaging 20 years of age and undergo cold pellicular maceration and direct pressing before fermenting with indigenous yeasts. The 2024 release has an ABV of 13% and is certified organic.

Accolades

  • 94 Vinous: "The 2024 Bandol Rosé from Domaine Tempier is utter class. Flaunting its trademark perfume of grapefruit peel, savory herbs, white flowers and sea spray, the Tempier Rosé shines in a league of its own. The mineral intensity and concentration through the mid-palate is really on another level in 2024. Supreme balance and textural finesse are the orders of the day. This is wine I consider a must-buy every year, but the 2024 is easily the best edition of Tempier Rosé in recent memory. Best of all, it will easily age for years."

Food Pairing

This gastronomically expressive rosé is highly versatile, pairing exceptionally well with Mediterranean and Provençal cuisine. It is a delightful match for grilled seafood such as prawns, octopus, or red mullet, as well as classic dishes like ratatouille or salade niçoise. Its structured profile also allows it to harmonize with poultry, particularly roasted chicken seasoned with herbs de Provence, and tangy cheeses like goat cheese.

Vintage Quality

The 2024 vintage in Provence was a year of resilience, beginning with exceptionally heavy rainfall in March that replenished deep water reservoirs. While coastal vineyards like those in Bandol were protected by the warmth of the Mediterranean, the region faced challenges from spring frosts in mid-April and localized hail in May. A hot, sunny summer followed, with a heatwave in mid-August that required rapid harvesting to preserve acidity. The resulting wines are characterized by excellent aromatic freshness and a good concentration of body.

title: Ippolito 1845 Calabrise Rosso 2024
bodyHtml:
This red wine is from Italy, specifically the region of Calabria. Ippolito 1845 is the oldest winery in Calabria, with over 170 years of history, and is located in the heart of Calabrian viticulture in Cirò Marina. Winemakers for five generations, the Ippolito family's mission is the recovery and enhancement of native grape varieties, such as Calabrese, and the protection of their territory, applying a sustainable philosophy.

Wine Description

The 'Calabrise' is a modern expression of its native red variety. It is made from 100% Calabrese grapes, which is a local name for what is often known as Nero d'Avola, grown on sandy and limestone soils. The wine is dark red in colour with bright purple hues. On the nose, it presents complex aromas of red fruits, black cherries, and plums layered with black pepper and a subtle savoury edge. The palate is fresh, juicy, and pulpy, echoing the ripe red and dark fruit with a gentle spice note and a touch of earth. It has very smooth and caressing tannins, a medium to medium-plus body, and a clean, persistent finish that lingers with dark berries and peppery spice. Fermentation and ageing take place for seven months in stainless steel tanks, avoiding oak influence to preserve the purity of the fruit.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Calabrese (Nero d'Avola)

  • Optimal Drinking Window: Enjoy now (as it balances ripe fruit with ease of drinking)

  • Organic: The estate is committed to sustainable farming and winemaking methods

title: Chateau Trianon Saint Emilion Grand Cru 2015
bodyHtml:
Château Trianon is a distinguished wine estate located in the Saint-Émilion Grand Cru appellation of Bordeaux, France. Established in the late 17th century, the estate has a rich history intertwined with influential figures from Libourne and Saint-Émilion.
