In 2000, Dominique Hébrard, former co-owner of Château Cheval Blanc, acquired Château Trianon, ushering in a new era of quality and innovation for the vineyard.

Wine Description

The 2015 Château Trianon Saint-Émilion Grand Cru presents a deep, dark ruby hue with a firm core and subtle brightening at the rim. The nose is inviting, offering aromas of macerated cherries complemented by notes of toasted bread, mocha, caramel, and vanilla. On the palate, this wine is ample and fleshy, delivering a warm, smooth texture balanced by refreshing acidity. The tannins are silky, contributing to a harmonious and long-lasting finish.

This blend predominantly features Merlot, supported by Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, and a touch of Carménère. The 2015 vintage is approachable now but has the structure to evolve gracefully through 2025.

Accolades

  • Jeff Leve, The Wine Cellar Insider – 88 points.

  • Guide Hachette des Vins – Cited as a charming wine with a macerated cherry nose and a well-balanced, fresh palate.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with a variety of dishes, including beef, lamb, poultry, and game (deer, venison). These pairings highlight the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.​

title: Faiveley Bourgogne Pinot  2023
bodyHtml:
Domaine Faiveley, established in 1825, is a family-owned winery located in the heart of Burgundy, France. Now in its seventh generation under the leadership of Erwan and Eve Faiveley, the domaine has grown to become one of the largest vineyard owners in Burgundy, with holdings spanning from the Côte de Nuits to the Côte Chalonnaise. Their commitment to sustainable viticulture and respect for terroir is evident in their wines, which are celebrated for their elegance and depth.

Wine Description

Faiveley Bourgogne Pinot Noir displays a beautiful ruby color. On the nose, it offers pleasant, fresh red-fruit aromas, notably cherry and raspberry, complemented by subtle earthy notes. The palate mirrors these red-fruit flavors, presenting a rich and ripe substance with fine, round tannins.

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir pairs wonderfully with a variety of dishes, including:

  • Roasted poultry, such as duck or chicken, which highlights the wine's red-fruit character.

  • Grilled salmon or tuna, where the wine's acidity complements the richness of the fish.

  • Mushroom risotto, enhancing the earthy nuances in both the dish and the wine.

title: Laphroaig Strong Characters 33 Year Old Islay Single Malt
bodyHtml: Laphroaig 33 Year Old Strong Characters is a single malt Scotch whisky that celebrates the history of the Laphroaig distillery and the strong characters that have contributed so significantly to it. In this case, the distillery co-founder Donald Johnston, who set up the distillery with his brother, Alexander, in 1815. He features on the whisky’s packaging in an illustration by artist Bill Bragg, who will also illustrate each edition in the series. This Islay whisky was aged for 33 years in a combination of American oak barrels and European oak sherry hogsheads, giving it a distinctive smoky character and robust flavour profile.

title: Aizu Homare Kiwami Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Homare Sake Brewery is in Kitakata city on the foot of Mt. Iide. The brewery was originally established as the Kanou Shuzo in 1918 and changed its name throughout the years before eventually becoming the Aizu Homare Brewery.

Junmai Daiginjo is the highest grade of sake. To qualify for this designation, a sake must be made with rice polished to half of its original weight.

From the first sip you will enter an unforgettable world of freshness and harmony.

title: Aizu Homare Yuzu - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
THomare Sake Brewery Co., Ltd. was established in 1918 and is currently managed by the fourth generation of the Karahashi family. The brewery is renowned for its innovative approach, blending traditional craftsmanship with modern scientific analysis to produce a diverse range of approximately thirty different products.

Description

This yuzushu is a fusion of junmai sake and 100% Japanese yuzu fruit juice. It presents an aromatic profile rich with the scent of fresh citrus and essential oils from the yuzu skin. On the palate, the junmai sake base provides a soft, smooth texture that balances the natural tartness and sweetness of the fruit. The taste is often compared to an Italian limoncello, featuring juicy citrus up front followed by a refreshing lime and grapefruit-like acidity. It has an alcohol content of approximately 10% to 11%.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and citrus character of this yuzu sake make it an ideal aperitif or a refreshing accompaniment to fruit-based desserts. It pairs exceptionally well with Japanese staples such as sushi, karaage, and tempura, where the citrus helps cut through oily textures. For Western-style pairings, it complements Caesar salads, creamy dips, or steamed shellfish like mussels and clams. It is best served chilled, on the rocks, or mixed with soda water to enhance its refreshing qualities.

title: Feudo Montoni Lagnusa Nero d'Avola 2022
bodyHtml:
This organic red wine originates from Italy, specifically the Sicily DOC region on the island of Sicily. Feudo Montoni is a historic producer, making top quality wines on its grounds since 1469. The winery's philosophy emphasizes the use of natural forces in winemaking, utilizing 'gravity' for transport, 'time' for refinement, and the 'mountains' and winter for refrigeration.

Wine Description

It pours a ruby red color. It offers a complex perfume with notes of cherries (sometimes noted as cooked cherries or cherries in alcohol), red plum, blackberry, and wild berries, harmonizing with warm spicy nuances of cinnamon and clove. Hints of iodine and blood orange also appear. On the palate, the wine's structure is elegant rather than powerful, featuring soft texture, buoyant tannins, vibrant acidity, and a sapid (savory) taste. Mentholated notes amplify the wine's freshness. It has a lifted feel and a pleasantly tart, energetic finish.

Food Pairing

The wine’s spicy, fruity, and savory profile makes it versatile for many dishes. Suggested pairings include roasted and grilled red meats, game, grilled tuna fish, and mature hard cheeses.

title: Laroche Premier Cru 'L'Homme Mort' 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine Laroche, established in 1850, is a prominent winery in Chablis, France, renowned for its extensive holdings of Premier and Grand Cru vineyards. The estate has been instrumental in elevating the quality of the Chablis appellation, notably through the creation of a charter of excellence for Grand Cru producers. Their historic cellars, the Obédiencerie, continue to age their esteemed wines, reflecting a deep respect for tradition and terroir. ​

Wine Description

The 2022 Chablis Premier Cru 'L'Homme Mort' showcases a brilliant pale gold hue. On the nose, it reveals enticing aromas of citrus zest, green apple, and subtle spice notes. The palate is characterized by vibrant acidity, a medium body, and a pronounced minerality typical of the Kimmeridgian limestone soils. The finish is long and harmonious, leaving a lasting impression of freshness and elegance. ​

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator – 91 points.

Food Pairing

This Chablis pairs exquisitely with seafood dishes such as oysters, seared scallops, and grilled prawns. It also complements poultry dishes with light sauces and soft cheeses like Camembert. These pairings enhance the wine's minerality and bright acidity, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Laroche Premier Cru 'Le Butteaux' 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine Laroche, established in 1850, is a prominent winery located in Chablis, Burgundy, France. Renowned for its commitment to quality, the estate has been instrumental in elevating the Chablis appellation, notably through the creation of a charter of excellence for Grand Cru producers. The winery continues to produce and age its Premier and Grand Cru wines in the historic cellars of the Obédiencerie, a testament to its rich heritage.

Wine Description

The 2022 Domaine Laroche Chablis Premier Cru 'Les Butteaux' is a white wine crafted exclusively from Chardonnay grapes. In the glass, it presents a brilliant, pale gold hue. The nose reveals a complex bouquet of citrus zest, green apple, and subtle floral notes, underscored by a distinct minerality. On the palate, this wine is lively and precise, offering a harmonious balance between its crisp acidity and creamy texture. Flavours of lemon, white peach, and a hint of almond lead to a long, refreshing finish. This wine showcases the characteristic minerality and freshness of the Chablis terroir.

Accolades

While specific accolades for the 2022 vintage of 'Les Butteaux' are not yet available, Domaine Laroche's Premier Cru wines have historically received high praise from critics and wine publications.

Food Pairing

This Chablis Premier Cru pairs excellently with a variety of dishes. It complements seafood such as oysters, scallops, and grilled fish, as well as poultry dishes in creamy sauces. Additionally, it pairs well with soft cheeses like Brie or Camembert. These pairings enhance the wine's minerality and vibrant acidity, creating a memorable dining experience.

title: Laroche Chablis Premier Cru 'Les Vaucoupins' 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine Laroche, situated in the heart of Chablis, France, boasts a rich history intertwined with the region's winemaking traditions. With 90 hectares of vineyards anchored on some of the most esteemed crus, the domaine is renowned for producing wines that embody the purity and minerality characteristic of Chablis.

Wine Description

The 2022 Chablis Premier Cru 'Les Vaucoupins' presents a pale gold hue. On the nose, it reveals intense aromas of white flowers, complemented by subtle notes of citrus and wild mint. The palate is both ripe and delicate, showcasing a harmonious balance between fresh acidity and elegant fruit flavors, leading to a lingering mineral finish. ​

Food Pairing

This wine pairs exquisitely with grilled white meats and goat cheeses, enhancing the wine's depth and character.

title: ALT Sparkling Rose Non Alcoholic
bodyHtml: Alt. Sparkling Organic Rosé is a fresh and aromatic non-alcoholic sparkling rosé wine made with 100% Tempranillo grapes from sandy and calcareous soils in the middle of Spain. Crisp acidity & strong effervescence with hints of summer berries & watermelon accompanied by an aromatic aroma.

title: ALT Sparkling Blanc de Blancs Non Alcoholic
bodyHtml: A crisp and refreshing non-alcoholic sparkling white wine made with 100% Chardonnay grapes from southern Spain. Bright acidity and strong effervescence with hints of green apple and citrus peel.

title: The Ned Pinot Gris 2025
bodyHtml:
The Ned Pinot Gris originates from New Zealand, specifically from the Marlborough region and the Waihopai Valley subregion. Established in 2006, The Ned is the award winning passion project of Brent Marris, a pioneer of the Marlborough wine industry who named the brand after one of the tallest peaks southeast of his vineyards. Marisco Vineyards, the parent company, remains family owned and operated, with Brent and his wife Rosemary focused on building a multi-generational legacy in their 268-hectare property.

Wine Description

This wine is instantly recognizable for its unique salmon pink hue, achieved by allowing a portion of the naturally pink-skinned grapes to undergo skin contact for 8 to 10 hours before pressing. The sensory profile is bright and aromatic, featuring a nose of nectarine, white peach, and honeydew melon with underlying nuances of spice. On the palate, it is lush and medium-bodied, delivering flavours of juicy stone fruit and spicy poached pear supported by a satin texture and vibrant acidity. The finish is long and unctuous, reflecting the ripeness of the Marlborough cool-climate fruit.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Gris.

  • Stylistic Notes: Crafted in an off-dry style, the wine balances its notable fruitiness with fresh acidity and a subtle hint of ginger or baking spice.

  • ABV: 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While produced using sustainable viticulture and certified vegan, this specific bottling is not typically certified organic.

title: Campo di Sasso Insoglio del Cinghiale 2024
bodyHtml:
​Tenuta di Biserno, established in 2001 by brothers Lodovico and Piero Antinori, is situated in Bibbona, within Tuscany's coastal Maremma region. The estate is renowned for its dedication to crafting exceptional wines that embody the unique terroir of the Upper Maremma.

Wine Description

Insoglio del Cinghiale is a vibrant red blend primarily composed of Syrah, complemented by Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Petit Verdot. In the glass, it displays a deep purplish-red hue with violet reflections. The nose reveals an intricate bouquet of cherries and sour cherries, interwoven with elegant peppery and woody spices, and subtle hints of rosemary and myrtle, characteristic of the Mediterranean maquis. On the palate, it is fresh and lively, supported by balanced acidity that enhances its juiciness. The wine is medium-bodied with well-integrated tannins, leading to a persistent finish.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with game dishes such as roast pheasant or rich game stews. When slightly chilled, it complements summer picnics and barbecues, enhancing the wine's depth and character.

title: Convene Pinot Noir Russian River 2022
bodyHtml:
Convene is the latest venture by Dan Kosta, co-founder of the acclaimed Kosta Browne Winery. After selling Kosta Browne, Dan took a hiatus before establishing Convene, bringing along his winemaker from his previous endeavor. This collaboration continues their legacy of crafting exceptional Pinot Noir and Chardonnay wines, focusing on premier vineyards within California's esteemed appellations.

Wine Description

The 2022 Convene Russian River Valley Pinot Noir showcases the distinctive terroir of its origin. In the glass, it exhibits a vibrant ruby hue. Aromas of cherry and raspberry are prominent, complemented by subtle notes of rose petals and violets. On the palate, the wine offers luscious flavors of ripe black cherry and blackberry, framed by bright tannins and balanced acidity. The deft use of French oak imparts a touch of elegance, leading to a refined and enduring finish.

title: Convene Pinot Noir Sonoma Coast 2019
bodyHtml:
​Convene by Dan Kosta's 2019 Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir is a testament to the region's winemaking excellence. Founded in 2019 by Dan Kosta, co-founder of the renowned Kosta Browne Winery, Convene focuses on crafting world-class Pinot Noir and Chardonnay from Sonoma's finest appellations. Partnering with winemaker Shane Finley, who has an impressive résumé including stints at Copain, Paul Hobbs, and Kosta Browne, the duo brings a wealth of experience and passion to this venture.

Wine Description

This elegant Pinot Noir presents aromas of crunchy red fruits, plum skin, and wilted rose. On the palate, flavors of wild strawberry, blueberry, and cola are accentuated with hints of green tea, graphite, and vanilla. The wine boasts a silky texture, balanced acidity, and a lingering, velvety finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 93 points

  • Wine Spectator – 92 points

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with dishes like roasted duck with cherry glaze, wild mushroom risotto, or herb-crusted salmon. These pairings highlight the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Convene Chardonnay Russian River Valley 2022
bodyHtml:
Convene, established by renowned vintner Dan Kosta, is a distinguished winery in California's Russian River Valley. Kosta, co-founder of the acclaimed Kosta Browne winery, brings his extensive expertise to Convene, focusing on crafting exceptional wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region.

Wine Description

The 2022 Convene Russian River Valley Chardonnay presents a pale straw hue. On the nose, it offers aromas of coconut shavings, nutmeg, and hazelnut. The palate reveals flavours of Bartlett pear, pineapple, and green apple, complemented by notes of crème brûlée, vanilla bean, and white florals, leading to a prolonged finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 92 points.

title: Samuel Smith Organic Lager 550 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml: Brewed with great care using only organic malted barley, organic hops, medium-soft water and a bottom-fermenting yeast; matured at low temperatures to bring out its delicate flavour and soft hop-character finish.

title: Grizzly Paw Gin Squeeze 355 ml - 4 Cans
bodyHtml: Grizzly Paw handcrafted Bitter Lemon Soda, natural lemon juice and Gin lovingly compressed into a compact little package.  Ready to embrace at will. 5.5% alc./vol

title: Domaine La Colombette Chardonnay (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Discover the exquisite taste of this non-alcoholic Chardonnay. This meticulously crafted blend showcases the vibrant essence of ripe peaches, complemented by subtle hints of citrus and fig.

Delight your palate with the harmonious interplay of gingery and grassy spices, while a refreshing acidity adds a lively touch. The experience culminates in a lingering flinty mineral undertone, ensuring a truly satisfying and refined choice.

title: Aizu Homare Lychee Nigori Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Established in 1918 as Kanou Shuzo, the brewery eventually became Aizu Homare, a name meaning "honor" or "glory". Located at the foot of Mount Iide, the brewery utilizes exceptionally soft subterranean water—traditionally worshipped as a gift from the gods—to produce its diverse range of sakes. Under the leadership of fourth-generation president Hiroyuki Karahashi, Aizu Homare has gained international acclaim, notably winning the Champion Sake title at the 2015 International Wine Challenge.

Description

This fruit-infused sake is a milky, unfiltered nigori blended with natural lychee and a touch of lemon juice. It features a cloudy appearance and a velvety, smoothie-like texture due to the presence of fine rice sediment. The nose is vivid and aromatic, unfolding with layers of ripe lychee, banana, and pear. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious balance of creamy sweetness and crisp, tangy acidity, reminiscent of biting into a fresh, peak-season lychee. The finish is refreshing and light, leaving a delicate umami undertone. ABV 10%.

Food Pairing

The lush sweetness and tropical profile of this lychee nigori make it an excellent choice for an aperitif or a palate cleanser. It pairs exceptionally well with spicy dishes, such as buffalo chicken wings or Thai curry, where the creamy texture helps mellow the heat. For a sweet conclusion, serve it chilled alongside chocolate desserts, fresh fruit, or vanilla bean panna cotta. It is also highly versatile for cocktails; try mixing it with two parts tonic water and a sprig of fresh mint for a refreshing long drink.

title: Aizu Homare Kiwami Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Aizu Homare Kiwami Junmai Daiginjo originates from Kitakata City in the Fukushima Prefecture of Japan. The Homare Sake Brewery was established in 1918 by Kosaku Karahashi, who transitioned from running a miso and soy sauce shop to managing a sake brewery. Currently led by fourth-generation president Hiroyuki Karahashi, the brewery is situated at the foot of Mount Iide and is renowned for its use of pristine mountain water and its expansive 4,000 square metre Japanese garden.

Description

This premium Junmai Daiginjo is crafted with a meticulous polishing rate of 50%, utilizing either Yamada Nishiki or Gohyakumangoku rice. It presents an elegant and refreshing sensory profile characterized by refined fruity notes of luscious melon and banana, alongside gentle floral undertones. The palate is smooth and silky, offering a white wine-like consistency with a crisp mouthfeel and a sharp yet soothing finish. Known for its complex depth and harmonious sweetness, it has an alcohol content of 16%.

Food Pairing

The fruit-forward and aromatic nature of this sake makes it an excellent partner for delicate and tender ingredients. It pairs exceptionally well with seafood such as salmon sashimi, scallops, and white fish, as well as lightly grilled sea bass. The sake's crisp acidity also complements savoury options like smoked ham, smoked duck, and soft cheeses such as Brie or Camembert. For a unique match, its floral profile helps balance the heat of spicy tantanmen or the richness of vegetable tempura.

title: Aizu Homare Peach Nigori Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Aizu Homare Peach Nigori Sake is from Japan, specifically the historic Aizu region in Fukushima Prefecture. The Homare Sake Brewery was founded in 1918 by Kosaku Karahashi in Kitakata City, a town famous for its abundant pristine water and kura (storehouses). The brewery sits at the foot of Mount Iide, "the mountain worshipped as a god," and uses its incredibly soft, high-quality subterranean water for brewing. The name "Homare" translates to "honor" or "glory," reflecting the founder's wish to create a sake that is the pride of the region.

Description

This is a luscious, fruity style of unfiltered sake (nigori) blended with pure peach juice. The sake has vibrant aromas of ripe white peach, fresh cream, and subtle hints of steamed rice. The palate is characterized by a velvety, smoothie-like texture that balances the natural sweetness of the fruit with the gentle tartness of the sake base. It is bottled with coarse rice sediment, giving it a cloudy appearance and a rich mouthfeel. The finish is refreshing and juicy, not overly cloying. The ABV is roughly 8% to 9%.

title: Fuji Takasago Yamahai Plum Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by the renowned Fuji Takasago Brewery, this sake is crafted in Hokkaido, Japan, where pristine natural conditions provide the ideal setting for traditional sake production. Known for their dedication to quality, the brewery artfully blends heritage techniques with local ingredients to create this delightful plum sake.

Tasting Notes

This sake showcases a brilliant golden hue and exudes inviting aromas of ripe plums, honey, and a hint of almond. The palate is rich and balanced, offering luscious plum sweetness complemented by a delicate tartness that lingers on the finish. With its smooth texture and harmonious flavour profile, it’s an exquisite example of a Yamahai plum sake.

Serving Suggestions

Serve chilled to fully enjoy the vibrant fruit flavours. Pair this plum sake with desserts like cheesecake or panna cotta, or contrast its sweetness with savoury dishes like teriyaki chicken or sushi rolls. For the perfect experience, serve in a small glass or traditional ochoko.

title: Village Cider 473 ml - 4 Cans
bodyHtml:
Some of the best things happen over a drink. Ideas are born, friendships forged, deals struck. Village Brewery began that way too, with friends sharing beer, ciders and dreams for a community brewery. A brewery that would support Calgary’s artists and craftspeople. A brewery that would create the excellent ales, ciders and lagers that friends and neighbours deserve.

The Village Apple Cider blends the sweet, tart and refreshingly crisp flavour of apples with subtle notes of pear and earl grey tea. Smooth, semi-dry and balanced this all-natural hard apple cider will get you straight through those hot summer days.

title: Five Farms Irish Cream Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Five Farms is a premium Irish cream liqueur produced in County Cork, Ireland. It is distinguished as the world's first farm-to-table Irish cream liqueur, with fresh cream sourced exclusively from five family-owned farms in the region. The cream is blended with premium triple-distilled Irish whiskey within 48 hours of collection, ensuring exceptional freshness and quality.

Tasting Notes
This liqueur presents a rich, creamy texture with a milky chocolate caramel color. On the nose, it offers inviting aromas of butterscotch, marshmallow, and vanilla bean. The palate is smooth and indulgent, featuring flavors of coffee, coconut, maple, and fresh cream, leading to a satisfying, mouth-coating finish.

Production Details
Five Farms is crafted with a higher butterfat content than typical cream liqueurs, contributing to its luxurious mouthfeel. The liqueur contains 10% Irish whiskey, a higher proportion than most Irish creams, resulting in a more pronounced whiskey character. It has an alcohol content of 17% ABV (34 proof).

Food Pairing
This versatile liqueur can be enjoyed neat, over ice, or as an addition to coffee. It pairs wonderfully with desserts such as chocolate mousse, tiramisu, or vanilla ice cream, enhancing their flavors and providing a harmonious dining experience.

title: Caleno Dark and Spicy Rum (Non Alcoholic) - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Caleño Dark and Spicy is a non alcoholic spirit originating from England. The brand was founded by Ellie Webb, who was inspired by the vibrant colours and rhythms of her Colombian heritage to create joyful alcohol free alternatives.

Description

This non alcoholic rum alternative presents a golden hue and a complex sensory profile. The aroma is characterized by notes of pineapple and coconut with a touch of warm spice. On the palate, it delivers a smooth blend of vanilla, kola nut, and cacao, balanced by a light ginger heat. The body is velvety and rich, leading to a finish brightened by hints of fresh lime. This spirit is crafted through a 48 hour steam distillation of tropical botanicals and contains 0% alcohol by volume.

title: Clark Estate Block 8 Riesling
bodyHtml:
​Clark Estate is a family-owned winery located in the Upper Awatere Valley of Marlborough, New Zealand. Established in 1998 by Peter and Jane Clark, the estate has grown over the years, with their children, Sarah and Simon, joining the venture. The winery is known for producing vibrant wines that reflect the unique terroir of their 32-acre vineyard. 

Wine Description

Block 8 Riesling showcases a pale yellow hue with greenish tints. On the nose, it exudes pure aromas of lemon citrus, lime zest, and freshly cut apple. The palate is finely balanced between natural fruit sweetness and crisp, chalky acidity, offering a medium-sweet profile with an alcohol content of 8%. This single-vineyard Riesling captures the essence of the Awatere Valley, delivering great poise and structure with flavors that burst from the glass. ​

Food Pairing

This medium-sweet Riesling pairs excellently with Asian cuisine, where its natural fruit sweetness complements spicy and aromatic dishes. It also serves as a delightful lunchtime aperitif, offering a refreshing and balanced experience.

title: Masi Modello Merlot - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Masi Modello Merlot originates from Italy's Trevenezie region, encompassing Veneto, Friuli Venezia Giulia, and Trentino-Alto Adige. Masi, a renowned winery, is celebrated for its dedication to the rich heritage of native grape varieties and traditional winemaking techniques, reflecting the authentic essence of this land.

Wine Description

This Merlot showcases a bright ruby red hue. The bouquet harmoniously blends fruity notes with spices such as cinnamon and vanilla. On the palate, attractive plum flavours integrate well with soft tannins and supporting acidity, making the wine very drinkable. With an alcohol content of 12%, it offers a well-balanced and approachable profile.

Food Pairing

This versatile Merlot pairs excellently with legume-based dishes, cured meats, or heavy pasta dishes. These combinations highlight the wine's depth and character, creating an enjoyable dining experience.

title: Regaleali Nero d'Avola 2021
bodyHtml:
Regaleali Nero d'Avola is a distinguished red wine hailing from Sicily, Italy. Produced by the esteemed Tasca d'Almerita family at their Tenuta Regaleali estate, this wine reflects a legacy of winemaking excellence that dates back to the 19th century. The Tasca d'Almerita family is renowned for their commitment to quality and innovation, making significant contributions to the promotion of Sicilian wines.

Wine Description

This wine showcases a bright ruby-red color and offers layered aromas of cherry, mulberry, and raspberry. On the palate, it is complex and supple, with ripe berry flavors framed by silky tannins. The wine matures in large 30 and 60 hl barrels of Slavonian oak, resulting in good structure and remarkable drinkability.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '39' Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
​Asahi Shuzo's Dassai '39' Junmai Daiginjo is a premium sake hailing from Japan's Yamaguchi Prefecture. Established in 1948, Asahi Shuzo is renowned for its dedication to crafting high-quality sake, focusing exclusively on Junmai Daiginjo styles. The brewery combines traditional methods with modern technology to produce sakes that are celebrated worldwide.

Sake Description

This sake showcases a luscious and juicy character with a nectar-like sweetness on the palate, followed by a long, bright finish. It is crafted using Yamada Nishiki rice polished down to 39% of its original grain size, resulting in a refined and elegant flavor profile. The aroma presents notes of juicy melon, while the palate offers a creamy texture with higher acidity, striking a balance between subtle aroma and richness.

title: Petrolo Galatrona 2023
bodyHtml:
Petrolo's Galatrona 2022 hails from the Valdarno di Sopra region in Tuscany, Italy. The Petrolo estate, renowned for its commitment to quality and tradition, has cultivated the Galatrona vineyard since the late 1980s. Planted with low-vigor Bordeaux clones, the vineyard spans approximately 10 hectares, yielding wines that express the unique terroir of the area.

Wine Description

This 100% Merlot wine exhibits a deep ruby color. The nose is enchanting, offering floral aromas of violets and lilacs, intertwined with notes of orange peel, raspberries, and rose petals. On the palate, it is medium- to full-bodied with creamy, caressing tannins and a harmonious balance between acidity and fruit. The finish is notably long, leaving a lasting impression of freshness and energy.

Accolades

  • James Suckling: 100 points

  • Decanter: 96 points​

  • Vinous: 94 points

Food Pairing

Galatrona 2022 pairs exceptionally well with rich dishes such as beef and venison. The wine's structure and depth complement the robust flavors of these meats, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Chateau Lafon Rochet 2016
bodyHtml:
A Fourth Growth Estate from the 1855 Classification, Château Lafon-Rochet is located in the Saint-Estèphe appellation of Bordeaux, France. The estate's history dates back to 1680. The vineyard is on two ridges of the Saint-Estèphe appellation, where gravel soils provide drainage and clay provides nutrients to the vines. Since 1960, the estate has been owned by the Tesseron family.

Wine Description The Château Lafon-Rochet 2016 has a deep, dark ruby red color. The wine is a blend of 67% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot, 6% Cabernet Franc, and 2% Petit Verdot. It is a full-bodied, rich, and intense wine. On the nose, it has a mix of red and black fruit aromas, with notes of crushed violet, wild mint, crushed stone, pencil shavings, cassis, and loganberry. The palate is beautifully balanced with supple tannins and lovely acidity. It has flavours of black fruit, dark chocolate, and spicy, roasted notes. The finish is long, deep, and layered with fine tannins and notes of black pepper and tobacco. The wine can be enjoyed now, but it is often better with a few years of bottle age.

Accolades

  • Vinous - 95 points

  • Decanter - 94 points

  • James Suckling - 94 points

  • Wine Enthusiast - 94 points

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 91-93 points

Food Pairing This wine is best served with all types of classic meat dishes, including veal, pork, beef, lamb, duck, and game. It also pairs well with roasts, grilled dishes, and mushrooms. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Koenig Ludwig Wheat Beer 500 ml - 20 Bottles
bodyHtml:
König Ludwig Weissbier (Hell) is a crown jewel of Bavarian brewing tradition, holding a direct lineage to royalty. Produced by König Ludwig Schlossbrauerei Kaltenberg, the brewery is owned and operated by Prince Luitpold of Bavaria a direct descendant of King Ludwig I and King Ludwig II (who built Neuschwanstein Castle). His family’s ancestors notably held the exclusive royal monopoly on brewing wheat beer in Bavaria for centuries and penned the famous Reinheitsgebot (Beer Purity Law) in 1516. König Ludwig is an authentic, world-class Bavarian Hefeweizen that represents the golden standard of traditional German wheat beers: naturally cloudy, deeply aromatic, and supremely balanced.

Beer Description

König Ludwig Weissbier pours a luminous, cloudy honey-amber color topped with a massive, rocky, and long-lasting snow-white head that leaves delicate, creamy lacing behind.

Aroma: The nose is classic, complex, and textbook Bavarian yeast excellence. It leads with dominant, warm notes of ripe banana and clove, followed by subtle undertones of bubblegum, nutmeg, and fresh-baked wheat bread. There are no heavy hop scents; it smells entirely of ester-rich yeast and sweet, wholesome grain.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a creamy, effervescent, and velvety mouthfeel driven by high natural carbonation. It leads with a gentle wave of sweet banana loaf and vanilla, which transitions seamlessly into a refreshing mid-palate marked by a spicy clove bite and mild citrus tang. The finish is remarkably smooth, crisp, and clean, leaving a faint, pleasant grain sweetness lingering on the back of the palate.

Profile: It sits at an authentic 5.5% ABV and a gentle bitterness of 15 IBU, focusing entirely on yeast-driven esters and malt harmony rather than hop bitterness.

Technical Notes: This beer adheres strictly to traditional Bavarian methods. It is brewed using a high proportion of malted wheat (at least $50\%$) alongside fine barley malt, pure spring water, and select Hallertau hops. The magic lies in its proprietary, top-fermenting unfiltered ale yeast, which produces the signature isoamyl acetate (banana) and eugenol (clove) aromatics. It undergoes a specialized bottle and keg conditioning process, remaining unfiltered to preserve its natural cloudiness, complex proteins, and smooth texture.

title: El Gran Legado de Vida Tequila Blanco
bodyHtml:
With its elegant presentation, El Gran Legado De Vida is crafted from 100% agave, distilling aromatic notes and the natural flavors inherent to agave. The cooking process in masonry ovens imparts a unique taste, capturing the essence of cooked agave. This method preserves the freshness of citrus notes, enticing one to savor its voluptuous and smooth profile. It's a legacy that withstands the test of time.

El Gran Legado De Vida showcases its distinct character with each sip, offering a rich flavor palette. It reveals the meticulous process of its creation, highlighting the careful attention to every detail of flavor and quality that narrates its story.

title: Protea Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
Protea Wines is a distinguished brand under the Anthonij Rupert Wyne Estate, located in the picturesque Franschhoek Valley of South Africa. The estate is renowned for its commitment to producing wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region, combining traditional winemaking techniques with modern innovation. The Protea range is celebrated for its vibrant and accessible wines, capturing the essence of South African viticulture.

Wine Description

Colour: Bright, pale straw with green hues.

Aroma: Enticing notes of tangy passionfruit, lime, and nectarine, complemented by hints of fresh fruit salad.

Palate: The lively, crisp palate bursts with bright flavours of grapefruit, lime, and stone fruit. A vibrant acidity is complemented by a subtle hint of gravel and flint, adding layers of complexity and a dry, mineral edge to the mouthfeel.

Body: Light to medium-bodied with a refreshing, zesty character.​

Finish: Focused and energetic, this wine finishes with a deliciously dry, lemon-zest note.

title: Feudo Montoni Inzolia Fornelli 2022
bodyHtml:
Established in 1469, Feudo Montoni is one of Sicily's oldest estates, renowned for its commitment to organic viticulture and traditional winemaking practices. The Sireci family, current proprietors, maintain the estate's legacy by emphasizing sustainability and authenticity in their wines.

Wine Description

This 100% Inzolia wine presents a straw yellow hue with light green reflections. The nose reveals floral notes of Sicilian Spanish broom flowers and chamomile, accompanied by aromas of pear, yellow melon, and honey. On the palate, it offers a well-balanced acidity with persistent freshness, leading to a long finish with unique mineral notes.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 90 points.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with grilled fish, crudo, white meats, and fresh cheeses. It also serves as a delightful aperitif. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character.​

title: Tantalus Pinot Noir 'Maija' 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction
Tantalus Vineyards, located in the Okanagan Valley of British Columbia, Canada, is renowned for its commitment to producing exceptional, terroir-driven wines. Established in 2004, Tantalus has garnered acclaim for its sustainable practices and focus on varietals that express the unique characteristics of their vineyard site. The 'Maija' Pinot Noir is a special cuvée named after proprietor Eric Savics' daughter, reflecting the winery's dedication to family and tradition.

Wine Description
'Maija' Pinot Noir pours a bright garnet hue, offering an inviting visual appeal. On the nose, it presents a lush bouquet of ripe red cherries, dried strawberries, and lifted floral notes, complemented by subtle hints of forest floor, dried thyme, and graphite. The palate reveals a slightly richer expression, with herbaceous undertones intermingling with darker fruit flavors such as bramble berries and blackberries. The wine showcases great length on the finish, characterized by a wonderful grip and release of subtle, juicy tannins.

Food Pairing
This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with dishes such as roasted quail, grilled salmon, or a mixed mushroom risotto. The wine's depth and character are highlighted when enjoyed alongside these culinary delights, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Domaine Michel Gros Bourgogne Cote d'Or 2023
bodyHtml:
Winery Background: Domaine Michel Gros, established in 1830, is a family-owned estate in Vosne-Romanée, Burgundy. The Gros family has cultivated vineyards for six generations, emphasizing traditional methods and expressing the unique terroir of their plots.

Wine Description: This 100% Pinot Noir wine presents a bright ruby hue. Aromas of maraschino cherries, mulberries, and a hint of orange zest create a perfumed bouquet. The palate is sweet on entry, with low acidity, offering a fleshy and dense texture. While it provides immediate pleasure, it may benefit from additional precision on the finish.

Food Pairing: This wine pairs well with dishes like coq au vin, roasted duck breast, or mushroom risotto. These pairings highlight the wine's depth and character.

title: Yamazaki 18 Year Old 'Mizunara Cask' - 100th Anniversary
bodyHtml:
Crafted by Japan’s oldest malt whisky distillery, Yamazaki, this exceptional 18-year-old expression embodies the refined artistry of Suntory’s whisky-making tradition. Established in 1923 in the forested valleys of Kyoto Prefecture, Yamazaki is renowned for its meticulous craftsmanship and pioneering use of Mizunara oak casks. This limited-edition whisky showcases the rare and highly prized influence of Japan’s native Mizunara oak, celebrated for its distinctive spice and complexity.

Whisky Description

Deep amber in colour, Yamazaki 18 Year Old Mizunara Cask offers an exquisite aromatic profile of sandalwood, fragrant incense, and dried coconut, hallmarks of Mizunara oak. The palate reveals layers of dark cherry, ripe plums, and honeyed almonds, balanced by warm cinnamon and clove spices. Silky and full-bodied, the whisky lingers on the finish with notes of Japanese cedar, sweet vanilla, and a whisper of smoke, creating a profoundly elegant and enduring experience.

Accolades

  • International Wine & Spirit Competition - Gold Medal
  • Whisky Advocate - 94 points

Food Pairing

This whisky pairs beautifully with roasted duck, aged Parmesan, or dark chocolate pralines. Its complex layers also complement umami-rich dishes such as Wagyu beef or miso-glazed black cod.
"Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience."

title: Gruber Roschitz Gruner Veltliner Reipersberg 2024
bodyHtml:
Gruber Röschitz is a family-owned winery located in Röschitz, within Austria's Weinviertel region. The Gruber family has been cultivating vineyards here for generations, emphasizing organic practices and a deep respect for their unique terroir. Their commitment to sustainability and quality is evident in their wines, which authentically reflect the characteristics of their vineyards.

Wine Description

The Ried Reipersberg Grüner Veltliner showcases a bright yellow-green hue with silver reflections. On the nose, it presents fine clementine zest, apricot touches, and hints of pineapple, creating an inviting bouquet. The palate is juicy and elegant, with a fine acid structure, mineral notes, and yellow stone fruit on the finish, leaving a long-lasting impression.

title: Huber Moments Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Weingut Markus Huber, located in Reichersdorf, Austria, is a family-owned winery renowned for its commitment to quality and sustainability. Established in 1648, the Huber family has cultivated vineyards in the Traisental region for over ten generations. Their philosophy emphasizes minimal intervention and organic practices, resulting in wines that authentically express the terroir of Lower Austria.

Wine Description

The Moments Rose captivates with its bright salmon pink hue. The bouquet reveals delicate aromas of bright fruits, freshly picked strawberries, and flowers. On the palate, the wine showcases beautiful minerality and elegance.

title: Chateau Philippe le Hardi Clos de la Chaise Dieu Bourgogne Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Chateau Philippe le Hardi, formerly known as Chateau de Santenay, is a historic estate that once belonged to Philip the Bold, the first Duke of Burgundy (1342-1404). Renowned for its colourful glazed tile roof, the chateau oversees a vast vineyard spanning 98 hectares across the Cote d'Or and Cote Chalonnaise. The estate is committed to sustainable viticulture, reflecting a deep respect for Burgundy's rich winemaking traditions.

Wine Description

The Clos de la Chaise Dieu Monopole is a 100% Chardonnay wine showcasing a bright, pale golden hue. The nose is expressive, offering aromas of white peach, mango, grapefruit, lemongrass, and a subtle hint of vanilla. On the palate, it is lively and balanced, with a refreshing acidity complemented by a delicate touch of oak. The wine's elegance and freshness make it a superb example of Burgundy's white wines.

title: Domaine Giroux Pouilly Fuisse 2022
bodyHtml:
​Domaine Giroux, located in Fuissé within the Mâconnais region of Burgundy, France, specializes in producing high-quality white wines from the Chardonnay grape. The estate is currently managed by Sébastien Giroux, who continues the family's dedication to traditional winemaking practices.

Wine Description

The Domaine Giroux Pouilly-Fuissé Vieilles Vignes is a dry white wine crafted exclusively from old-vine Chardonnay, with plantings dating back to 1942. This limited-production wine showcases a golden hue with emerald reflections.

title: Domaine Courtault Michelet Chablis 2023
bodyHtml:
Domaine Courtault Michelet is a distinguished winery located in Lignorelles, one of the 20 wine-growing villages surrounding Chablis in the Burgundy region of France. The estate is a result of the 2021 merger between two family-owned vineyards: Domaine Jean-Claude Courtault, established in 1984 by Jean-Claude and Marie-Chantal Courtault, and Domaine Stéphanie et Vincent Michelet, founded in 2008 by their daughter Stéphanie and her husband Vincent. This union combines decades of winemaking expertise and a shared passion for authentic Chablis wines.

Wine Description

The Domaine Courtault Michelet Chablis is crafted exclusively from 100% Chardonnay grapes sourced from 30-year-old vines planted in clay and limestone soils, characteristic of the Chablis terroir. The wine exhibits a pale gold hue and offers aromatic notes of peach and apricot. On the palate, it is vibrant and expressive, showcasing a magnificent structure with flavors of lemon zest, green apple, and a distinct minerality.

title: Domaine Gerard Millet Sancerre Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Domaine Gérard Millet is a family-owned winery located in Bué, within the esteemed Sancerre region of France's Loire Valley. With a winemaking legacy spanning over five generations, the estate is currently managed by Gérard and Isabelle Millet, alongside their son Steve. The domaine encompasses 24 hectares of vineyards, 19 of which are dedicated to the Sancerre appellation, with the remaining five in Menetou-Salon.

Wine Description

This Sancerre Blanc is crafted exclusively from 100% Sauvignon Blanc grapes. It presents a pale gold hue in the glass, releasing vibrant aromas of grapefruit, lemon zest, and subtle floral notes. On the palate, the wine is crisp and refreshing, showcasing flavors of lime, green apple, and a hint of nectarine, all balanced by a pronounced minerality. The finish is clean and enduring, marked by lively acidity that enhances its overall freshness.

title: Cantina Zaccagnini Rose Tralcetto 2025
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1978 in Bolognano, Cantina Zaccagnini has grown from a small family-run business to an internationally recognized winery, managing over 300 hectares of vineyards. The winery follows a philosophy of "absolute quality, from cluster to glass," emphasizing meticulous vineyard management and careful winemaking techniques. The signature ‘Tralcetto’—a small piece of vine attached to each bottle—symbolizes the strong connection between the wine and its origins.

Wine Description:
This rosé presents a medium-intensity pink hue with vibrant clarity. The nose offers floral nuances of violets and roses, intertwined with tart red berry notes of raspberry and red currant. On the palate, it is fresh and well-balanced, with a crisp acidity that enhances its delicate fruit character. A refined minerality lingers through the finish, leaving impressions of small red fruits. Crafted from carefully selected red grapes, the wine undergoes a short maceration period followed by soft pressing and fermentation in stainless steel at controlled temperatures, preserving its bright and aromatic profile.

Food Pairing:
This rosé pairs beautifully with aperitifs, white meats, seafood, and light, delicate pizzas. Together, these pairings enhance the wine’s freshness and elegance.

title: Chiola Rose Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo 2024
bodyHtml:
The Chiola family played a significant role in Loreto Aprutino’s history during the 19th century, and their legacy is honored through this distinguished rosé. The name 'Chiola' reflects the winery’s deep connection to the region’s winemaking heritage.

Wine Description:
This rosé displays a brilliant light ruby red color. The nose offers an expressive bouquet of raspberry, blackberry, cherry, and other red fruits. On the palate, it is fresh and spicy, embodying the vibrant cherry-like character typical of Cerasuolo wines. Crafted from 100% Montepulciano grapes, it undergoes a short maceration process to achieve its distinctive hue. The wine is well-balanced, with pleasant acidity and a lingering finish.

title: Garnier & Fils Chablis 'Mont de Milieu' Premier Cru 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France's esteemed Chablis region in Burgundy, Domaine Garnier & Fils is a family-owned winery founded by brothers Xavier and Jérôme Garnier. Since 1996, they have been dedicated to producing exceptional wines that reflect the unique terroir of their vineyards. Their commitment to traditional, environmentally friendly, and organic practices has positioned them among the notable producers in Chablis.

Wine Description
The Chablis Premier Cru 'Mont de Milieu' 2022 is crafted exclusively from 35-year-old Chardonnay vines rooted in white stony soils rich in fossilized oyster shells. This terroir imparts a distinctive saline minerality to the wine. The wine undergoes fermentation with native yeasts over three months at 20ºC, followed by malolactic fermentation. It is then aged in a combination of 600-litre French oak barrels (demi-muids) and stainless steel tanks, achieving a harmonious balance between oak complexity and stainless steel purity.

In the glass, it presents a brilliant golden hue. The nose reveals subtle notes of pollen intertwined with a delicate vanilla fragrance. On the palate, it offers a rich, fleshy core of yellow fruit, complemented by a pronounced saline character that is emblematic of its terroir. The wine is well-structured, with a fresh acidity and a lingering mineral finish.

Accolades

  • La Revue du vin de France: 93 points

Food Pairing
This Chablis pairs excellently with seafood dishes such as pan-fried scallops or oven-baked lobster. It also complements creamy salmon preparations and mild, soft cheeses. These pairings highlight the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

Vintage Quality
The 2022 vintage in Chablis experienced favourable conditions, leading to wines with exceptional ripeness, freshness, and minerality. Domaine Garnier & Fils' meticulous vineyard management and winemaking practices have resulted in a wine that truly reflects the essence of its terroir.

title: Scala Ciro Rosso Classico Superiore 2023
bodyHtml:
Scala Cirò Rosso Classico Superiore originates from Italy, within the southern Calabria region and the historic Cirò DOC. Perched on hilly terrain just a few kilometres from the Ionian Sea, the estate has been held by the Scala family since the 17th century, with the dedicated winery officially established in 1949. Now guided by Luigi Scala alongside his son Francesco representing the third generation of winemakers, the estate's philosophy focuses on preserving ancient southern Italian wine traditions through meticulous, low-yield manual viticulture.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a luminous ruby red appearance that develops light garnet reflections with maturity, and possesses a medium body with a wonderfully crisp, airy structure. The sensory profile is characterfully rustic, complex, and savory, opening with an aromatic nose of wild plums, sour cherries, and fleshy raspberries, layered with sun-dried tomatoes, dried tea leaves, wilted violets, and exotic eastern spices. On the palate, it delivers an energetic wave of fresh red berry fruits balanced by a distinctive vein of coastal salinity, structured by firm, finely integrated tannins. The finish is remarkably persistent, clean, and savory, showing an exceptional structural poise.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Gaglioppo, a thick-skinned ancient variety indigenous to southern Italy.

  • Stylistic Notes: To preserve the elegant, refreshing fruit profile of the grape and soften its natural toughness, the hand-harvested fruit undergoes controlled maceration and temperature-regulated fermentation in stainless steel. It is then aged for 12 to 18 months entirely in traditional cement tanks, followed by an additional 6 months of refinement in the bottle before release.

  • ABV: 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: Cultivated under strict eco-conscious guidelines utilizing natural cover crops like lupins for nitrogen fertilization, this estate bottling is certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, savory undercurrents, and firm tannic frame of this Gaglioppo make it an exceptional match for Mediterranean cuisine and earthy, flavor-packed dishes.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with classic osso buco, grilled lamb chops dusted with herbs, pan-seared veal fillet, or traditional beef meatballs.

  • Savoury & Hearty: Suggested pairings include stuffed red bell peppers, rustic wild mushroom and truffle risotto, or rich pasta dishes featuring a savory meat ragù.

  • Casual Staples: An incredible companion for wood-fired pizzas topped with pepperoni or spicy sausage, and savory charcuterie platters.

title: Tenuta Di Trinoro Toscana Le Cupole Rosso 2023
bodyHtml: The “Second Vin “of Tenuta di Trinoro, Le Cupole was first produced in 1995. It is a blend of Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Petit Verdot, with percentages varying with each vintage. Fermented in stainless steel and aged in one to three year old barriques and cement, Le Cupole is velvety and approachable. This wine hits the palate with exuberance, full of fleshy, bright fruit, extracted tannins, and rich color.

title: Gusbourne Blanc de Blancs 2019
bodyHtml:
Since the first vines were planted in 2004, Gusbourne's unwavering vision has been to create the finest vintage-dated wines exclusively from their own vineyards. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a low-intervention and exacting craft, meticulously tending to the vines and employing whole-bunch pressing to yield only the finest juice, ensuring that the terroir is clearly reflected in every bottle. The estate's history dates back to 1410, and today, a modern goose crest (the 'Goosemark') on each bottle honours this heritage.

Wine Description

Elegant and pure, Blanc de Blancs is a signature sparkling. Characteristically complex, bright and balanced, we select our finest parcels of Chardonnay for this ageworthy wine.

Food Pairing

It's the perfect choice for a sophisticated aperitif or to serve alongside seafood.

title: Craven Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
From west-facing 1999 planted vines on Polkadraai's Karibib Vineyard's decomposed granites, this was early picked and 70% whole cluster, fermented native and on skins for a short time before moving into neutral French barrel.

This opens into black cherry, wild raspberry, thorns, dusty graphite, seasoned with wild mint and scrubby wild herbs, all around a pure black cherry core. Tannins are characteristically granitic grippy and finely structural, and acidity is easily capable of carrying this to a lingering slate finish. Finesse and structure = a rare combo.

title: Fontana Tempranillo - Syrah Roble Organico 2021
bodyHtml: An opulent red that is gloriously aromatic, with expressive notes of ripe, red berries from the Tempranillo, enhanced by a touch of pepper from the Syrah, spicy cloves and a subtle hint of vanilla. Concentrated and full bodied on the palate with remarkable freshness and length.

title: Dooley's White Chocolate Cream
bodyHtml:
The irresistible taste and velvety texture of white chocolate, coupled with the aroma of wild berries, all united in premium vodka, create a truly heavenly fusion that invites you to combine and experiment.

It's not just fantastic drinks, cocktails, and coffee creations that can be conjured with it; this chocolatey-fruity cream liqueur from Dooley's also serves as a refined ingredient for desserts, ice creams, baked goods, or chocolates, bringing forth unique moments of happiness.

title: Chateau la Grolet Tete de Cuvee Cotes de Bourg 2020
bodyHtml:
The Hubert family own and farm two nearby vineyards, Chateau Peybonhomme-les-Tours in the Cotes de Blaye, and Chateau La Grolet to the south in the Cotes de Bourg. Both of these Right Bank Estates are farmed biodynamically. The Cotes de Bourg is a beautiful landscape of rolling hills that are sometimes referred to as the 'little Switzerland of the Gironde'.

Steep gravel slopes are prime for planting Merlot, the number one contender in this blend. A bit of time in new oak marries fruit and wood tannins, and the in-bottle result is a harmony of terroir and tradition.

title: Suntory -196 Lemon Vodka Soda 355 ml - 4 Cans
bodyHtml: Real Whole Lemons. Frozen and crushed using a proprietary Japanese process then infused with premium vodka. The result is a mouthwatering lemon flavor and refreshing taste. Best Served Chilled.

title: Carpano Botanic Bitter - 1 Litre
bodyHtml:
Carpano Botanic Bitter is the product of a careful selection of ten aromatic herbs that are infused with traditional method to reach a balanced taste of all the botanical components. The latest addition to the Carpano family is created with the company’s over 230-year-long passion for quality without compromises.

Discover the bright ruby-colored Carpano Botanic Bitter and dive into its unique taste, initially sweet, yet balanced with flavors of citrus and plantains, and with a hint of barley, fresh almonds and essential oils of orange peels not yet fully ripe. It leaves an aftertaste of white turmeric, very similar to a delicate ginger infusion, which is followed by long notes of bitterness from myrrh and gentian. Delicate hints of cinchona create a pleasantly pungent finish.

title: Sordo Giovanni Nebbiolo d'Alba 2022
bodyHtml:
Sordo Giovanni is a well-respected winery in Piedmont, known for crafting elegant and expressive Nebbiolo wines. This Nebbiolo d'Alba comes from vineyards located in the prestigious Langhe area, benefitting from the region's unique terroir, rich in limestone and clay. This wine showcases the classic characteristics of Nebbiolo, with a balance of structure, finesse, and aging potential.

Tasting Notes

Color: Bright garnet red with slight orange hues.
Nose: Aromatic and refined, featuring notes of red cherries, violets, dried roses, and hints of spice and leather.
Palate: Medium-bodied with vibrant acidity, fine tannins, and flavors of red berries, licorice, and earthy undertones.
Finish: Long and persistent, with lingering notes of dried herbs and subtle oak.

Optimal Drinking Window

2023–2028. Can be enjoyed now with some aeration but will develop further complexity with aging.

Serving Suggestions

Decanting: Recommended for 30–60 minutes before serving.
Serving Temperature: 16-18°C (60-64°F).
Pairings: Perfect with truffle-based dishes, braised meats, risotto, aged cheeses, and hearty pasta dishes like tagliatelle al ragu.

title: Brandini Barolo 'Cerretta' 2019
bodyHtml:
Agricola Brandini Barolo Cerretta is a prestigious and elegant Italian wine that stands out for its strong character and intense flavors. The wine is produced in the hills of Piedmont, Italy, from 100% Nebbiolo grapes and is aged for two years in oak barrels before being bottled. 

The result is a complex wine with a distinctive aroma of rose petals, cherries, and truffles. On the palate, it's full-bodied and rich with flavors of dark fruit, tobacco, and vanilla, making it a perfect match for grilled meats, wild game, and flavorful cheeses. This wine is a must-try for any wine enthusiast looking for a classic Italian red that's both rich in history and taste.

title: Josh Cellars Prosecco Rose
bodyHtml:
Josh Cellars Prosecco Rose hails from Italy's renowned Prosecco DOC region in the Veneto area. Founded by Joseph Carr, Josh Cellars began as a tribute to his father, Josh, embodying values of hard work and family. In 2019, Carr partnered with the Pozzi family, esteemed Italian wine producers, to introduce their first sparkling wine offerings, including this Prosecco Rose.

Wine Description

This sparkling rose exhibits a delicate blush hue. On the nose, it presents fresh wild berry and blackberry aromas. The palate is characterized by refreshing acidity and bright effervescence, delivering flavors of wild berries and blackberries. The wine is light-bodied with a crisp, clean finish.

title: Alberta Premium Batch 10 Legacy Reserve
bodyHtml:
Alberta Premium Batch 10 Legacy Reserve is a limited-edition Canadian rye whisky crafted by Alberta Distillers Ltd. This expression commemorates a decade of whisky-making, blending select spirits from 2001 to 2010 to create a harmonious and complex profile.

Production and Craftsmanship

Each year from 2001 to 2010, Alberta Distillers laid down batches of whisky, selecting the finest from ten different warehouses across their 42-acre site. These whiskies, aged in new white oak, ex-bourbon, and ex-Canadian whisky barrels, were meticulously blended to highlight the unique characteristics of each vintage. The result is a rich and layered rye whisky that reflects a decade of dedication and expertise.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Amber hue.

  • Aroma: Enticing notes of dark chocolate and subtle oak, complemented by dried prunes, warm pear, and banana.

  • Palate: A rich combination of espresso and dark chocolate flavors, balanced with hints of banana and toffee.

  • Finish: Smooth and creamy, leaving a lasting impression.

Accolades

Alberta Premium Batch 10 Legacy Reserve has been recognized for its excellence, earning Gold at the 2024 International Spirits Challenge and Double Gold at the 2024 SIP Awards. These honors reflect its superior quality and craftsmanship.

title: Tantalus Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
​Tantalus Vineyards, located on the eastern slopes of the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada, is renowned for its commitment to producing exceptional single-vineyard wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region. Established in 2004, the winery has built a reputation for crafting high-quality Riesling, Chardonnay, and Pinot Noir, with some of the country's oldest vinifera plantings forming the backbone of their estate.

Wine Description

The Tantalus Chardonnay presents a shimmery gold hue in the glass, offering inviting aromas of lemon curd, fresh orange zest, buttered popcorn, and hazelnut praline, all elevated by a flinty minerality. On the palate, it is concentrated and textured, showcasing flavors of white peach, green papaya, ambrosia apple, and lemon oil. The wine achieves a harmonious balance between its weight and acidity, with subtle French oak influence that complements rather than overpowers the fruit.

title: Remnant 'Fly By Night' Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml: First-fill Bourbon and Australian Apera casks bring aromas of mocha, blood orange, and fresh ripe peach, with a hint of toasted marshmallow. On the palate, decadent flavors of dark chocolate orange, meringue, and salted caramel evolve into an elegant finish of almond croissant and vanilla custard.

title: The Gardener French Riviera Gin
bodyHtml:
​The Gardener French Riviera Gin is a London Dry gin that encapsulates the essence of the French Riviera. This 100% organic gin is the result of a collaboration between actor Brad Pitt, the renowned Perrin family, and master distiller Tom Nichol, celebrated for his tenure as Tanqueray's master distiller.

Sensory Profile

  • Appearance: Clear and bright.​
  • Aroma: Dominant notes of juniper complemented by fresh citrus nuances, including pink grapefruit, bitter orange, and sweet orange. Subtle hints of blackcurrant and mint add complexity.
  • Palate: Smooth and balanced, showcasing a harmonious blend of juniper and citrus flavors. The presence of botanicals like angelica, coriander, and liquorice contributes to its depth.

title: Vignerons De Buxy Buissonnier Montagny 2020
bodyHtml:
Vignerons de Buxy Buissonnier Montagny 2019 is a distinguished white wine from the Montagny appellation in Burgundy, France. Crafted by the Vignerons de Buxy cooperative, this Chardonnay showcases the elegance and minerality characteristic of the region.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Brilliant light golden hue.

  • Aroma: Expressive nose with notes of white peach, hazelnut, and subtle hints of exotic fruits.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and elegant, featuring intense spicy nuances and a mineral finish.

  • Finish: Impressive length, highlighting the wine's balance and finesse.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Serve between 12°C and 14°C (54°F to 57°F) to fully appreciate its aromatic complexity.

  • Glassware: Use a tulip-shaped glass to concentrate the aromas.

  • Food Pairings: Pairs excellently with hot or gratinéed shellfish, fine fish dishes, baked or stewed white meats, and even exotic cuisines like paella or Asian dishes.

title: Field & Forge Tried & True Light Golden Ale 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Tried & True is a signature core offering from Field & Forge Brewing Co., located in Innisfail, Alberta. This brewery is dedicated to honoring the hard-working spirit of the prairies by crafting honest, high quality beers. The Light Golden Ale is designed as the ultimate "bridge" beer offering the approachability of a domestic light lager but with the added character and craftsmanship of a true small-batch ale. It is an uncomplicated, reliable brew meant for post-work relaxation or a day in the sun.

Beer Description

This Light Golden Ale pours a brilliant, crystal-clear pale straw color with a light, frothy white head and lively carbonation.

Aroma: It features a clean and inviting nose with subtle notes of freshly cracked grain, a touch of sweet honey, and a very faint herbal hop presence.

Palate: The flavor is light-bodied and exceptionally smooth. It offers a gentle bready malt sweetness that is quickly followed by a crisp, refreshing finish. It is intentionally designed to be clean and neutral, avoiding any heavy bitterness or lingering aftertaste.

Profile: It has an ABV of 4.5% and a very low bitterness of 15 IBU, making it one of the most sessionable and "crushable" beers in their lineup.

title: Hitachino Nest White Ale 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hitachino Nest White Ale is a celebrated craft beer originating from the Ibaraki Prefecture in Japan. It is produced by Kiuchi Brewery, a historic establishment founded in 1823 by Gihei Kiuchi that originally focused exclusively on sake production for over 170 years. The brewery ventured into craft beer in 1996 following changes to Japanese brewing laws, combining traditional sake brewing expertise with global influences to create its signature owl branded ales.

Beer Description

This Belgian style witbier presents a light golden and hazy appearance in the glass. The sensory profile features a fresh, complex aroma of orange and citrus integrated with coriander and nutmeg. On the palate, it delivers a soft and flavourful taste with a sweet-fruity-tart character and a mild acidity produced by the wheat malt. The body is light and creamy with a refreshing, mildly hopped finish that includes notes of spicy clove and ginger. The varietal composition includes Pilsner and wheat malts, hopped with Perle and Styrian Goldings, and uniquely flavoured with orange juice, orange peel, coriander, and nutmeg. It has an ABV of 5.5%.

title: Hitachino Red Rice Ale 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml: This Red Rice Ale is brewed using a red rice from ancient times.  Enjoy the rose pink color along with the fruity flavor and aroma.  7% ABV.

title: Alexander Keith's India Pale Ale 341 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml: Pale gold colour; light fruit and malt aroma; refreshing hoppy taste & finish.

title: Bodega Chacra Pinot Noir 'Lunita' 2023
bodyHtml:
​Bodega Chacra's 'Lunita' Pinot Noir 2023 hails from the Río Negro Valley in Patagonia, Argentina. Established in 2004 by Piero Incisa della Rocchetta, a member of the family behind Italy's renowned Sassicaia, Bodega Chacra is dedicated to producing wines that authentically express their terroir. The 'Lunita' vineyard, planted in 1945, spans just 1.5 hectares and consists of ungrafted vines that have been meticulously revitalized over the past 13 years.

This Pinot Noir displays an incredibly perfumed bouquet with notes of violets and white flowers, complemented by raspberry, cherry, and strawberry flavors. Hints of sliced lemon rind, mineral nuances, and fine wet sand undertones add complexity. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with fine tannins that provide a beautiful, rather endless finish.

The 2023 vintage has garnered significant acclaim, with James Suckling awarding it 98 points, praising it as the best 'Lunita' ever.

This wine pairs wonderfully with dishes such as roast duck, grilled salmon, or mushroom risotto. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: White Sands White Rum - 1.14 Litre Plastic Bottle
bodyHtml: Named after the famous beaches where its journey begins. White Sands is a smooth, flavourful imported white rum that’s a perfect companion mixed in summer cocktails or with your favorite soft drink.

title: Pocas Reserva Tinto 2019
bodyHtml:
Established in 1918, Poças is a family-owned winery renowned for its dedication to producing high-quality wines that reflect the rich heritage of the Douro Valley. With vineyards located in the Cima Corgo and Douro Superior subregions, Poças combines traditional winemaking techniques with modern practices to craft wines of exceptional character.

Wine Description:

  • Colour: Deep ruby red.
  • Aroma: Intense notes of dark berries, plums, and subtle hints of herbs and spices.
  • Palate: Medium complexity with flavours of dried plums, integrated tannins, and a mineral undertone. A touch of nougat adds to its finesse.
  • Body: Full-bodied and elegant.
  • Finish: Persistent with a finely spiced aftertaste.

Varietal Composition: A blend of Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz, and Tinta Barroca from vines aged between 40 to 60 years.

Accolades:

  • Falstaff - 91 points.
  • Wine Enthusiast - 93 points.
  • Robert Parker - 90 points.

Food Pairing: This wine pairs exceptionally well with dishes such as ossobuco, oxtail, and traditional Portuguese tripe. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character.

title: Lake Breeze Semillon
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Lake Breeze Vineyards, nestled in the heart of British Columbia's Naramata Bench, has been crafting exceptional wines since its establishment. The winery is celebrated for its dedication to producing high-quality, small-lot wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region.

Wine Description

Lake Breeze Semillon greets the eye with a pale straw hue. On the nose, it offers vibrant aromas of pink grapefruit and gooseberry, interwoven with subtle herbal nuances reminiscent of nettle and jalapeño skins. The palate is robust, delivering a crisp yet nutty finish. This wine is crafted for long-term aging, allowing its complex flavours to evolve gracefully over time.

Food Pairing

This Semillon pairs wonderfully with dishes such as grilled seafood, particularly prawns or scallops, where the wine's crispness complements the sweetness of the shellfish. Herb-roasted chicken or a fresh goat cheese salad would also harmonize with the wine's herbal and citrus notes. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character, creating a memorable dining experience.

title: Lake Breeze Macintyre Heritage Reserve Astra Chardonnay 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Lake Breeze Vineyards, situated on British Columbia's Naramata Bench, has been producing wines that embody the unique terroir of the region. In 2016, they introduced the MacIntyre Heritage Reserve label, featuring premium wines like the 'Astra' Chardonnay, which showcases the winery's dedication to crafting exceptional expressions of classic varietals.

Wine Description

The 2021 'Astra' Chardonnay is a testament to Lake Breeze's commitment to excellence. While specific tasting notes for this vintage are not available, previous releases have showcased a pale straw hue with aromas of citrus and green apple. The palate typically offers a balance of bright acidity and subtle oak influences, leading to a clean, crisp finish. Earlier vintages have been noted for their mix of citrus, pear, and spicy hazelnut flavours, with a nose combining bright green apple and citrus with buttery tones.

Food Pairing

This Chardonnay pairs excellently with dishes such as lobster, roasted chicken, or grilled halibut. Its crisp acidity and subtle oak nuances complement creamy or buttery sauces, while its fresh citrus notes enhance delicate seafood flavours. Together, these pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating a memorable dining experience.

title: Dillon's Coffee Liqueur
bodyHtml: The new Coffee Liqueur is the perfect blend of coffee and chocolate flavour to make any cocktail a rockstar.

title: Open Coast Gin
bodyHtml:
Open Coast Gin is a handcrafted dry gin produced on Canada's east coast, specifically in Newfoundland and Labrador. The distillery emphasizes simplicity and character, reflecting the region's maritime heritage.

Gin Description

This artisanal gin offers fresh aromas of juniper berries, lemon, lime, and cracked pepper, which carry through to a lingering finish. The bright and strongly aromatic profile sets it apart from typical London Dry Gins.

title: Winemakers Cut Sauvignon Blanc
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Winemaker's CUT is a boutique winery located in the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia, Canada. Established by Slovakian-born proprietor and winemaker Michal Mosny and his wife Martina, the winery emphasizes sustainable farming practices, including a zero-pesticide policy and low sulfur use, to produce wines that authentically express the unique terroir of their vineyards.

Wine Description

Winemaker's CUT Sauvignon Blanc showcases a bright, light straw color. On the nose, it offers inviting aromas of pear, pineapple, white peach, and a hint of fresh green herbs. The palate is medium-bodied and dry, featuring flavors of green plum and a touch of oak, leading to a round and balanced finish. This expressive Sauvignon Blanc combines bright citrus fruits with fresh-cut grass and herbs, leading to a precise, stony palate with exceptional fruit concentration sustained by balanced, crisp acidity. The wine is naturally vegan.

title: Batasiolo Barolo Cerequio 2014
bodyHtml:
Batasiolo, a renowned winery in Italy's Piedmont region, is celebrated for its exceptional Barolo wines. The Cerequio vineyard, one of their prized crus, is situated in the prestigious Barolo DOCG area, known for producing wines of remarkable character and elegance.​

Wine Description

The 2014 Batasiolo Barolo Cerequio displays a deep garnet red colour with subtle orange tinges. Its aromatic profile is distinctive, offering balsamic hints intertwined with notes of vegetables, flowers, and spices, creating an immediately recognisable bouquet. On the palate, it is full-bodied, elegant, harmonious, and balanced, with great persistence.

Food Pairing

This Barolo pairs excellently with red meats, game, roasts, and aged cheeses. When matured, it also serves as an excellent sipping wine.

title: Batasiolo Barolo Boscareto 2014
bodyHtml: Beni di Batasiolo is a renowned Italian winery located in the heart of the Piedmont region, specifically in the Barolo appellation. With a rich history and a commitment to traditional winemaking practices, the estate spans 106 hectares, of which 60 hectares are dedicated to Nebbiolo, the grape variety used to produce their esteemed Barolo wines.

title: Batasiolo Barolo Brunate 2014
bodyHtml:
Beni di Batasiolo is a renowned family-owned winery located in the heart of Italy's Piedmont region, specifically in the La Morra commune of the Langhe area. Established in 1978 by the Dogliani family, the winery has grown to encompass over 320 acres of estate vineyards across nine estates. Their philosophy harmoniously blends tradition with modern techniques, ensuring that the quality of their wines reflects the unique characteristics of their terroir.

Wine Description

The 2014 Batasiolo Barolo Brunate is crafted exclusively from Nebbiolo grapes sourced from the esteemed Brunate vineyard, situated in the southern part of the La Morra commune. The vineyard's compact blue marl soil, interspersed with layers of sand, imparts distinctive qualities to the wine. In the glass, it presents a deep garnet red hue with subtle orange tinges. The nose is greeted with intense aromas of nuts, stewed prunes, roses, and violets, complemented by hints of spice and toast. On the palate, it is full-bodied and balanced, with firm tannins and a harmonious structure.

Food Pairing

This Barolo pairs exquisitely with rich dishes such as beef lasagne, meat ravioli, and aged cheeses like Grana Padano. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Batasiolo Spumante Metodo Classico 2016
bodyHtml:
Batasiolo, situated in the heart of Italy's renowned Piedmont region, is a family-owned winery with a rich history. The Dogliani family, proprietors of Batasiolo, have been producing wines that embody the essence of their terroir, combining tradition with innovation to craft exceptional offerings.

Wine Description: This sparkling wine presents an intense straw yellow hue, clear and bright, with a very fine and persistent perlage. The aromatic profile is notably intense, featuring hints of yeast, bread crust, herbs, acacia flowers, and honey. On the palate, it is expansive and harmonious, with a persistent reflection of the aromatic notes perceived on the nose. The blend of Pinot Nero and Chardonnay grapes contributes to its balanced structure and complexity.

Food Pairing: This versatile sparkling wine pairs delightfully with appetizers and desserts. Its body makes it an ideal all-round accompaniment, suitable for entrées, cheeses, pasta dishes, fish, white meats, feathered game, and barbecued meats. Serving it at a temperature of 6°-8°C enhances its depth and character.

title: Batasiolo Barolo Vigneto Corda della Briccolina 2014
bodyHtml:
Beni di Batasiolo is a renowned Italian winery situated in the heart of the Piedmont region, specifically in the Barolo appellation. With a rich history and a commitment to traditional winemaking practices, the estate has established itself as a producer of high-quality Barolo wines. The Vigneto Corda della Briccolina vineyard is one of their prized crus, known for producing wines of notable character and depth.

The 2014 Batasiolo Barolo Vigneto Corda della Briccolina presents a complex sensory profile:​

  • Colour: Deep garnet red with subtle brick hues, indicative of its maturity.

  • Aroma: The nose reveals layers of forest floor, dark spices, toasted oak, and menthol.

  • Palate: On the palate, it offers notes of raw sour cherry, powdered sage, and a hint of roasted coffee bean. The wine is taut and linear, with firm acidity and dusty, close-grained tannins leading to a drying finish.

  • Body: Medium to full-bodied, reflecting the Nebbiolo grape's inherent structure.​

  • Finish: The finish is characterized by lingering tannins and a slight austerity, suggesting potential for further aging.​

This wine is crafted exclusively from 100% Nebbiolo grapes, adhering to the traditional varietal composition of Barolo.​

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 87 points.

Food Pairing

This Barolo pairs excellently with rich dishes such as roasted lamb, game meats like venison, and hearty pasta dishes featuring truffles or mushroom-based sauces. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Abbia Nova 'Senza Vandalismi' Cesanese del Piglio 2021
bodyHtml:
