Located in the town of Piglio, about thirty miles east of Rome, Abbia Nova is a brand-new artisanal winery by cousins Daniele and Pierluca Proietti. The name 'Abbia Nova' refers to an ancient Roman road linking the town of Piglio, in the southwestern part of the region, with Abruzzo.

Made from the ancient Roman grape Cesanese d'Affile, this handcrafted wine is juicy with aromas of fresh red berries and also of darker fruit such as blackberry. There is smoke, hints of fresh herbs and a shy note of nutmeg too. The acidity on the palate is vibrant and full of lively energy.

title: Orion Okinawa Premium Draft 334 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Orion Draft Beer offers mild taste and crisp aftertaste developed in the semitropical climate. It is invigorating, and yet has rich body that only beer can offer. It goes well with any dish, not to mention Okinawan cuisine, bringing out the best of each dish and stimulating appetite.

Foam-promoting protein, one of the components of foam, is increased during the brewing process to enhance the formation and retention of foam. The crispness of the beer contrasts with the rich creamy foam, making you never feel tired of the taste.

title: Hakkaisan Seishu - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1922, Hakkaisan Brewery is situated at the foot of Mount Hakkai, an area renowned for its deep snow and exceptionally soft spring water known as 'Raiden-sama no Shimizu'. The brewery is dedicated to the philosophy of producing high-quality sake for as many people as possible, using the traditional techniques of Niigata's snow country.

Description

This signature Seishu is clear and colourless, representing the quintessential Niigata style of 'tanrei karakuchi' (light and dry). The aroma is fresh and delicate, featuring subtle notes of rice and a clean, floral bouquet. On the palate, it offers a smooth, mellow texture with a crisp purity that is free of extraneous elements. Despite being a regular class sake, the rice is polished to 60% and fermented slowly at low temperatures to ensure a refined, elegant body. It concludes with a mouthwatering, dry finish that disappears quickly. ABV 15.5%.

title: Bowmore 18 Year Old 'Sherry Oak'
bodyHtml:
Bowmore 18 Year Old 'Sherry Oak' displays a deep amber hue with golden highlights. On the nose, it reveals inviting aromas of dark chocolate, dried figs, roasted coffee, and signature Islay smoke, complemented by nuances of orange peel and rich spices. The palate is full-bodied and complex, offering layers of sweet sherry-soaked raisins, treacle toffee, and cinnamon, balanced beautifully with a gentle maritime salinity and lingering peat smoke. The mouthfeel is velvety and refined, culminating in a long, warming finish with hints of spiced oak and dried fruit. This expression, matured in Oloroso sherry casks, delivers both richness and harmony, making it a standout among aged Islay single malts.

Accolades

  • "Whisky Advocate - 93 points."
  • "International Spirits Challenge - Gold Medal."
  • "Ultimate Spirits Challenge - 94 points."

Food Pairing

This luxurious whisky pairs exceptionally with dark chocolate truffles, smoked duck breast, or aged cheddar. The interplay between sweet, savoury, and smoky elements makes for a memorable tasting experience. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Bowmore 15 Year Old 'Sherry Oak'
bodyHtml:
Bowmore Distillery, established in 1779, stands as a pioneer in Islay whisky production, renowned for its harmonious balance of peat smoke and refined character. Located on the shores of Loch Indaal, Bowmore continues to embrace traditional techniques, including floor malting and ageing in the historic No. 1 Vaults. With a focus on craftsmanship and time-honoured practices, Bowmore’s whiskies capture the essence of their unique coastal environment.

Whisky Description

Bowmore 15 Year Old 'Sherry Oak' displays a rich mahogany colour, reflecting its extended maturation in Oloroso sherry casks. The nose is generous and layered, opening with aromas of dried fruits, treacle, and roasted nuts, accented by the distillery’s signature gentle peat smoke. On the palate, this single malt is medium to full-bodied, offering flavours of dark chocolate, raisins, and spiced orange, balanced by savoury notes of leather and toasted oak. A smooth, velvety texture carries through to a lingering finish, where hints of sweet sherry, smoky embers, and warming spice intertwine. The result is a whisky of depth and elegance, showcasing Bowmore’s mastery of sherry cask maturation.

Accolades

  • "San Francisco World Spirits Competition - Double Gold."
  • "Whisky Advocate - 92 points."
  • "International Wine and Spirit Competition - Gold Medal."

Food Pairing

This distinctive Islay whisky pairs wonderfully with slow-cooked beef stew, grilled venison, or dark chocolate tart. The interplay of smoky richness and sweet sherry notes enhances savoury and decadent dishes alike. A perfect match to enhance the whisky's complexity.

title: Kaze no Mori Tsuyuhakaze 507 - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Kaze no Mori Tsuyuhakaze 507 is produced in Gose City, Nara Prefecture, by Yucho Shuzo. Founded in 1719, the brewery sits in the historic heartland of Japanese sake production. The Kaze no Mori brand, launched in 1998, is famous for its "Muroka Nama Genshu" approach, meaning the sake is unfiltered, unpasteurized, and undiluted. This method preserves the natural carbon dioxide from fermentation, giving the liquid a signature lively character.

Description

The 507 designation indicates a 50% rice polishing rate and the use of Kyokai Yeast No. 7. It is brewed with Tsuyuhakaze, a specialty sake rice variety unique to Nara. Because it is unpasteurized, the sake retains a slight natural effervescence and a bright, "zippy" texture on the tongue. The aroma is youthful and fresh, featuring notes of green apple, white floral blossoms, and wild strawberry. On the palate, it balances a creamy sweetness with a sharp, refreshing acidity. It typically has an alcohol content of 16% and must be kept refrigerated at all times to prevent spoilage.

Food Pairing

This sake performs much like a dry sparkling wine, making it an excellent palate cleanser for a variety of cuisines. It pairs beautifully with fresh, raw seafood like tuna tartare, carpaccio, or oysters with a citrus vinaigrette. The natural fizz and high acidity also help it cut through the richness of fried foods like shrimp tempura or even a classic Margherita pizza. For a cheese pairing, it is exceptional with soft options like goat cheese, burrata, or brie. It should be served deeply chilled in a wine glass to allow the carbon dioxide to lift the floral aromatics.

title: Chateau Haut Bailly II 2022
bodyHtml:
Chateau Haut Bailly, with a history dating back to the 16th century, stands as one of the most revered estates in Pessac Léognan. Under the ownership of the Wilmers family since 1998, the property has flourished, combining respect for tradition with modern innovation. ‘Haut Bailly II’ is the estate’s second wine, crafted with the same meticulous care as the grand vin, highlighting the elegance and finesse of this historic terroir while offering earlier approachability.

Wine Description

Chateau Haut Bailly II 2022 reveals a deep ruby colour with youthful violet reflections. The nose is immediately inviting, with aromas of fresh blackcurrant, ripe plum, and red cherry, accented by hints of violet, graphite, and gentle spice. On the palate, this blend of predominantly Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon is medium-bodied, offering supple tannins and a vibrant core of juicy red and black fruits. The wine is beautifully balanced, showing freshness and precision, with a silky texture that leads to a graceful finish marked by notes of cocoa and toasted oak. Best enjoyed from 2025 to 2035, this vintage exemplifies the approachability and charm of Haut Bailly’s second label.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling - 93 points."
  • "Vinous - 92 points."
  • "Wine Advocate - 91 points."

Food Pairing

This elegant Bordeaux pairs wonderfully with herb-crusted lamb, roasted duck breast, or mushroom risotto. The wine’s balance and finesse make it a versatile companion for a range of refined dishes. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Bordeaux was marked by an exceptionally hot and dry growing season, resulting in small, concentrated berries and wines of impressive structure and ripeness. Thanks to expert vineyard management and careful timing of the harvest, Chateau Haut Bailly produced a remarkably fresh and harmonious wine despite the challenging conditions.

title: Marzadro Amaro
bodyHtml: Amaro Marzadro is inspired by the ancient recipes for herbal liqueurs of the Trentino tradition. Since the 1950s, Attilio and Sabina Marzadro have been collecting plants and herbs on the Monte Baldo massif, 2218 metres above sea level, which they used to flavour their spirits. After careful selection, Cape Aloe, Alpine Rhubarb, Greater Gentian, Chamomile, Fennel, Holy Thistle, Galega and different varieties of Yarrow are left to cold macerate for 20 to 30 days. Its red colour is also provided by rhubarb, which gives the liqueur a bitter and fresh flavour at the same time.

title: La Gritona Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Agave, caramel, vanilla, oak, and hints of citrus. Smooth and rich with notes of cooked agave, caramel, vanilla, cinnamon, and a touch of pepper. Full-bodied with a velvety texture, showcasing flavors of agave, oak, butterscotch, and a subtle spiciness.

title: Peri Peri Vicere Inzolia 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in Sicily, Italy, ‘Vicere’ Inzolia 2023 by Peri Peri is a vibrant expression of the island’s rich winemaking heritage. Inzolia, an indigenous Sicilian grape, thrives in the region’s sun-drenched vineyards, producing wines that showcase freshness and Mediterranean character. Peri Peri is dedicated to crafting wines that capture the essence of Sicily’s terroir, emphasizing purity and balance in every bottle.

Wine Description

This Inzolia presents a bright straw-yellow hue with golden reflections. The nose reveals delicate aromas of white peach, citrus blossom, and ripe pear, intertwined with hints of almond and saline minerality. On the palate, it is crisp and refreshing, with lively acidity enhancing flavours of lemon zest, green apple, and a touch of honeydew melon. The medium-bodied structure carries a silky texture, leading to a clean, lingering finish with subtle herbal undertones.

Accolades

  • Decanter - 92 points
  • Vinous - 91 points

Food Pairing

Enjoy this elegant Sicilian white with grilled seafood, fresh oysters, or pasta alle vongole. It also pairs beautifully with light Mediterranean salads and soft cheeses like burrata. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Sicily benefited from warm days and cool nights, ensuring optimal ripening while preserving acidity. This balance resulted in a vibrant and expressive Inzolia with pronounced aromatics and freshness, reflecting the region’s maritime influence.

title: Caliterra Cabernet Sauvignon 'Tributo' 2018
bodyHtml:
Produced in the heart of the Colchagua Valley, Chile, this wine represents the Caliterra philosophy of crafting environmentally friendly wines that express the pureness of Chilean nature. The winery was established as a partnership focused on 'La Calidad de la Tierra' (the quality of the land), emphasizing sustainable vineyard management and precision wine growing.

Wine Description

This ruby red Cabernet Sauvignon is elegant and expressive, opening with intense aromas of blackberries, red currants, and cassis. As it develops in the glass, the nose reveals complex spicy notes of cinnamon, black pepper, and tobacco leaf, alongside subtle hints of mocha and caramel. On the palate, the wine is well balanced with great volume, supported by soft, velvety tannins and a crisp acidity.

title: Bollinger 'La Grande Annee' 2015
bodyHtml:
Champagne Bollinger, an esteemed and independent French Champagne house founded in 1829, is celebrated for its commitment to quality and tradition. Located in Aÿ, within the renowned Champagne region, Bollinger maintains over 150 hectares of vineyards, with a significant emphasis on Pinot Noir plantings. The house is known for its meticulous craftsmanship, using oak fermentation and extended lees aging to produce wines of exceptional depth and complexity.

Wine Description

La Grande Année 2015 is a distinguished vintage Champagne, meticulously crafted from a blend of 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay. The grapes are sourced from 11 crus, predominantly Verzenay, Aÿ, and Mareuil-sur-Aÿ for the Pinot Noir, and Chouilly and Avize for the Chardonnay. This composition includes 79% Grand Crus and 21% Premier Crus.

This Champagne presents a luminous golden hue, indicative of its maturity and depth. The nose is rich with aromas of pear, orange oil, and white flowers, complemented by subtle notes of mocha, toasted hazelnuts, and a hint of fino sherry. On the palate, it offers a medium to full-bodied experience, with a dense core of fruit framed by chalky structuring extract, leading to a long, sapid finish.

Accolades

  • Antonio Galloni, Vinous - 96 points
  • Decanter - 94 points
  • Richard Juhlin - 93-95 points
  • Essi Avellan MW - 94-96 points

Food Pairing

La Grande Année 2015 pairs exquisitely with a variety of dishes. Its complexity and depth enhance the flavors of foie gras with caramelized apples, roasted duck breast, or a rich chocolate cream dessert. These pairings highlight the wine's versatility and elevate the dining experience.

title: Bollinger Champagne PN VZ19
bodyHtml:
Bollinger, one of Champagne’s most revered houses, is known for its rich, Pinot Noir-driven style. Established in 1829 in Aÿ, the estate has consistently delivered exceptional cuvées with a focus on depth, structure, and aging potential. The PN AYC19 continues the PN series, highlighting the character of Pinot Noir from the 2019 vintage, predominantly sourced from the Grand Cru village of Aÿ.

Wine Description

This Champagne presents a radiant golden hue with subtle copper highlights. The nose is expressive, offering layers of ripe orchard fruits, candied citrus, toasted brioche, and delicate hints of almond and spice. The palate is structured and full-bodied, displaying flavors of baked apple, quince, and dried apricot, interwoven with chalky minerality and a touch of honeyed richness. The fine mousse and vibrant acidity provide balance, leading to a lingering, complex finish. Crafted from predominantly Pinot Noir, this release showcases Bollinger’s signature depth and refinement.

Food Pairing

PN AYC19 pairs beautifully with seared scallops, roasted poultry, or creamy cheeses such as aged Comté. Its richness also complements truffle-infused dishes or mushroom-based risottos. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 growing season in Champagne was marked by warm conditions, producing ripe, concentrated fruit. This vintage benefits from the inclusion of reserve wines, ensuring both freshness and complexity. The result is a Champagne with immediate appeal yet significant aging potential.

Ratings & Critical Acclaim

  • Wine Advocate: 94 points – Recognized for its layered complexity, vibrant acidity, and long finish.
  • Vinous: 93 points – Praised for its textural depth, bright citrus notes, and refined mousse.
  • Decanter: 92 points – Noted for its balance of richness and elegance, with a pronounced mineral backbone.
  • Wine Spectator: 92 points – Described as finely tuned, with persistent bubbles and a mouthwatering profile.

This latest PN series release reinforces Bollinger’s mastery of Pinot Noir, capturing both power and finesse in a compelling, terroir-driven expression.

title: Chateau Moulin Saint Georges 2022
bodyHtml:
Château Moulin Saint Georges is a highly regarded estate in the Saint-Émilion appellation of Bordeaux, France. Owned by the Vauthier family since 1921, the château benefits from the same meticulous attention to detail as its prestigious sibling, Château Ausone. The estate’s 7-hectare vineyard sits on clay-limestone soils with a southwest exposure, ensuring optimal ripening conditions for its Merlot and Cabernet Franc vines. The Vauthiers’ expertise in winemaking results in wines that beautifully express the finesse and complexity of Saint-Émilion’s terroir.

Wine Description

A blend of 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Franc, the 2022 vintage displays a deep garnet-purple hue. The nose is layered with aromas of dark berries, ripe cherries, violets, and a touch of creamy new oak. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, showcasing lush fruit, fine-grained tannins, and a distinctive chalky minerality. The texture is refined, with a structured yet velvety mouthfeel leading to a long, elegant finish. Aged for approximately 18 months in French oak barrels, this wine is crafted for both early enjoyment and long-term aging.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 94–95 points
  • Wine Advocate - 90–92+ points
  • Vinous - 90–93 points
  • Jeb Dunnuck - 93–95 points
  • La Revue du Vin de France - 93–95 points

Food Pairing

This wine pairs exceptionally well with rich and flavourful dishes such as beef, veal, and lamb. It also complements hearty stews, roasted game, and aged cheeses, enhancing the wine’s depth and complexity.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Bordeaux experienced a warm growing season, leading to wines with rich concentration and ripe tannins. Despite the heat, careful vineyard management maintained balance and freshness, resulting in a structured wine with impressive depth and long-term aging potential.

title: Tenuta Olim Bauda Barbera d'Asti Superiore 'Le Rocchette' 2021
bodyHtml:
Piedmont is almost as famous for truffles as it is wine, those elusive delectable delights that need to be rooted out from the depths of the forest, so scarce but so worth it. Much the same can be said for Olim Bauda, secluded and out of the way, down a long drive off the busy Via Prata, the path gently meanders continuously rising to finally reveal the family home through a grove of trees, or if you arrive in truffle season, more likely through a rolling mist. The estate is run by three siblings, Dino, Diana and Gianni who have devoted themselves to creating fresh, expressive Barbera d’Asti and clean, pure scintillating Gavi in the most delicate low interventionist way and without doubt they are worth all the trouble you might encounter to enjoy them.

Garnet red with purple hues. On the nose it shows complex, subtle, deep aromas with well balanced notes of ripened fruit, plum, cocoa and spice. To the palate is soft and harmonious, well structured and properly alcoholic with sweet and fine-grained tannins that give the wine proper fullness. It has a persistent and enticing close.

title: Truth Be Told Sauvignon Blanc 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Truth be Told Sauvignon Blanc, is inspired by the classic white Bordeaux bottlings from France. A blend of sauvignon blanc and semillon, this wine was barrel fermented in neutral oak and has a vividly fresh nose of starfruit, sliced melon and seashells intertwined with expressive floral notes. A well-balanced wine with layers of citrus fruits bursts from the glass, and the crisp finish and mouth-watering acidity will have you asking for more.

title: Clos Alkio 2021
bodyHtml: Clos Alkio is a boutique winery established in 2020 by Finnish wine enthusiast Mikko Alkio, located in the heart of Priorat, Catalonia, Spain. The estate spans approximately 25 hectares near the village of Gratallops, a region renowned for its prestigious wine-making heritage. Clos Alkio is dedicated to producing high-quality wines that reflect the unique terroir of Priorat, utilizing both traditional and modern viticultural practices.

title: Castello Di Ama Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'San Lorenzo' 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Chianti Classico Gran Selezione DOCG appellation in Gaiole in Chianti, Castello di Ama Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'San Lorenzo' 2022 represents an historic, benchmark estate expression of Tuscan terroir. Named after the picturesque valley where the historic 18th century estate villas stand, 'San Lorenzo' is crafted from a rigorous selection of fruit sourced from the estate’s four premier historic vineyard sites: Bellavista, Casuccia, San Lorenzo, and Montebuoni. Situated at high elevations between 460 and 525 metres above sea level on gravel-rich clay-limestone soils, the vines benefit from exceptional diurnal temperature variations. The winemaking philosophy under technical director Marco Pallanti involves parcel-by-parcel manual harvesting, ambient yeast fermentation in stainless steel vats, and maturation in fine French oak barriques (approximately 22% new) for around 10 to 12 months. The result is a Gran Selezione of extraordinary harmony, vibrant red and black fruit concentration, and sublime Gaiole freshness.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with bright purple-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly complex bouquet opens with noble aromas of ripe black cherry, wild strawberry, dark plum, and elderberry, interwoven with sophisticated notes of crushed violet petals, sandalwood, dried lavender, cinnamon spice, graphite, and leather. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied, ample, and dense, delivering concentrated flavours of dark fruit, cassis, and mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by taut, supple, finely knit tannins and a driving mid-palate structure, it concludes with an extraordinarily long, persistent finish marked by lingering red berries, savory herbs, and a clean chalky mineral grip. Composed of 80% Sangiovese blended with 13% Merlot and 7% Malvasia Nera, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2027–2045. Stylistically, it combines grand cru-like refinement and aromatic complexity with impressive vintage depth, structure, and cellaring capability.

title: Giffard Passionfruit Syrup (Non Alcoholic) - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Giffard Passion Fruit Syrup is a non alcoholic product originating from Angers in the Loire Valley, France. The house of Giffard was founded in 1885 by pharmacist Emile Giffard, and today the company remains a fifth generation family owned independent business renowned for its commitment to high quality botanical extracts.

Description

This syrup presents an oily, slightly cloudy, and hazy gold or pale saffron yellow appearance. The aroma is intense and exotic, reminiscent of blackcurrant bud, sap, and elderberry, with recognizable musky and tart passion fruit fragrances. On the palate, it delivers a tangy flavour that balances the sweetness of the pure sugar syrup with zingy, gourmet pulp and a hint of lime. The body is viscous with a nectar like consistency, leading to a drier finish marked by a subtle astringency and a touch of bitterness. This product contains 0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The complex acidity of this syrup makes it an ideal companion for bold, mononote flavours such as white chocolate, vanilla bean, and coconut cream. It pairs exceptionally well with creamy desserts like cheesecake, panna cotta, or yogurt, where the tart fruit notes can cut through the richness. For a savoury contrast, it can be used in marinades and sauces for seafood or served alongside snacks featuring chilli pepper and ginger for a spicy tropical twist. It also serves as a vibrant topping for breakfast items like pancakes, waffles, and fruit based parfaits.

Distinctive Features

Giffard Passion Fruit Syrup is distinguished by its use of 100% pure sugar derived from French beets and concentrated passion fruit juice, ensuring a minimum juice equivalence of 12%. It is crafted with natural flavourings and is free from preservatives, with pasteurization used to guarantee the perfect preservation of its aromatic intensity. This product is suitable for various dietary requirements as it is vegan and gluten free.

Serving Suggestions

A popular way to enjoy this syrup is by creating a 'Virgin Passion Fruit Mojito', made by churning the syrup with lime juice, fresh mint, and crushed ice, then topping with sparkling water. For a simpler refreshment, it can be mixed with soda water or added to iced tea and lemonade for a tropical lift. It also serves as a key component in alcohol free 'Pornstar Martinis' or 'Hurricanes' when combined with vanilla or citrus elements. Additionally, it can be used to flavour smoothies, milkshakes, and protein shakes.

title: Wayne Gretzky Red Cask Whiskey - Mini 50ml
bodyHtml: A remarkable blend produced from locally sourced grains and finished in red wine casks from the winery which impart a pale amber colour. Expect a smooth and refined flavour profile that includes notes of marzipan, light citrus, vanilla, oak and spice; the finish is long, warming and balanced.

title: Tyrrell's Single Vineyard Hunter Semillon 2017
bodyHtml:
The wine is floral fruit in youth, which moves towards biscuity characters with age. The palate is soft bodied with smooth acids.

95+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2017 vintage was an exceptional season for Semillon in the Hunter, and the nose here leads with sun-drenched honeysuckle, green apple skins, caper brine and crushed shells. In the mouth, the wine is gentle swaying on the brink of evolution; it's still so tight and glassy, but it's starting to hint at the enveloping texture and complexity that will develop over the next couple of years. A marvel.

title: Giffard Coconut Syrup (Non Alcoholic) - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Giffard Coconut Syrup is a non alcoholic product originating from Angers in the Loire Valley, France. The house of Giffard was founded in 1885 by Emile Giffard, a pharmacist who transformed his shop into a distillery after the success of his signature mint liqueur. Today, the company remains independent and family owned, with the fifth generation continuing to produce a wide range of syrups and liqueurs.

Spirit Description

This syrup presents an opaque, milky white appearance with a clear to light greyish tint. The aroma is of medium intensity, featuring the sweet scent of coconut milk alongside notes of fresh, pungent coconut flesh. On the palate, it offers a rich and fresh taste of coconut milk and grated coconut pulp, characterized by a smooth and balanced sweetness. The body is creamy and indulgent, leading to a long finish with satisfying notes of lightly toasted coconut. This product contains 0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The tropical and creamy profile of this syrup makes it a versatile ingredient for both sweet and savoury pairings. It is an ideal addition to desserts, such as drizzled over freshly baked pastries, incorporated into coconut themed cakes, or used as a topping for ice cream. In savoury applications, it can be used to enhance sauces with a tropical flair, particularly those inspired by Caribbean or Asian cuisines. It also pairs well with fresh fruit platters and light snacks like nuts or biscuits.

Distinctive Features

Giffard Coconut Syrup is distinguished by its use of natural ingredients, including pure sugar from beets, coconut milk, and milk proteins. It is crafted without the use of artificial colours or preservatives and is pasteurized to ensure perfect preservation of its aromatic profile. The production process draws on over 135 years of family expertise, ensuring a high quality syrup that dissolves smoothly in both hot and cold preparations.

Serving Suggestions

This syrup is a staple for professional mixologists and home bartenders alike, serving as a key ingredient in a classic 'Pina Colada' or a 'Coconut Daiquiri'. For non alcoholic options, it can be used to create a 'Virgin Coconut Mojito' or added to smoothies, milkshakes, and iced black tea. It is also highly effective in coffee and tea applications, such as a 'Coconut and Caramel Latte' or a 'Bounty Coffee'.

title: Giacondi Trebbiano Rubicone 2024 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Brilliant straw yellow in colour. Very pleasant with intriguing notes of white flowers on the nose and a refreshingly dry palate.

title: Giffard Elderflower Syrup (Non Alcoholic) - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Giffard Elderflower Syrup is a non alcoholic product produced in Angers, France. It is crafted by a fifth generation family business established in 1885, which utilizes traditional maceration techniques and 100% pure French sugar beet.

Spirit Description

This syrup presents a warm amber or light sunny yellow appearance. The aroma is very fragrant, featuring powerful floral scents of elderflower alongside exotic notes of lychee and lemon. On the palate, it offers a subtle and refreshing flavour that balances bright elderflower with a delicate acidity and a gentle citrus twist. The body is smooth and light, leading to a clean finish that evokes the feel of a summer garden. This product contains 0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The floral and slightly acidic profile of this syrup makes it an excellent addition to a variety of culinary creations. It can be drizzled over cakes or stirred into ice creams and fruit purees to add a sophisticated floral lift. For a more unique pairing, it complements savoury dishes such as Atlantic salmon or salads featuring cucumber and buffalo mozzarella. It also harmonizes well with light snacks like nuts or fruit based desserts like raspberry tarts.

Distinctive Features

Giffard Elderflower Syrup is distinguished by its use of natural aroma from hand picked elderflowers and concentrated lemon juice. It is crafted without the use of artificial preservatives and is certified vegan, gluten free, and non GMO. The production process relies on the family's extensive expertise in capturing the pure essence of botanicals to ensure high aromatic intensity.

Serving Suggestions

This syrup is highly versatile and can be enjoyed simply by diluting it with still or sparkling water to create a refreshing elderflower pressé. In mixology, it is a key ingredient for non alcoholic cocktails such as a 'Virgin Hugo' or an 'Elderflower Spritz' garnished with a slice of lemon and fresh mint. It also serves as a refined sweetener for hot or iced drinks, including lattes, green tea, and espresso mocktails.

title: Tenuta Olim Bauda Gavi di Gavi 2024
bodyHtml:
Piedmont is almost as famous for truffles as it is wine, those elusive delectable delights that need to be rooted out from the depths of the forest, so scarce but so worth it. Much the same can be said for Olim Bauda, secluded and out of the way, down a long drive off the busy Via Prata, the path gently meanders continuously rising to finally reveal the family home through a grove of trees, or if you arrive in truffle season, more likely through a rolling mist. The estate is run by three siblings, Dino, Diana and Gianni who have devoted themselves to creating fresh, expressive Barbera d’Asti and clean, pure scintillating Gavi in the most delicate low interventionist way and without doubt they are worth all the trouble you might encounter to enjoy them.

Aromas of citrus, green apple, and white flowers with subtle hints of almond. On the palate, bright acidity that enhances a refreshing nature. The mineral-driven finish adds complexity and depth, making it both versatile and refined.

title: Domaine Cauvard Chorey les Beaunes 2017
bodyHtml:
Domaine Cauvard is a family-owned winery with 17 hectares of vineyards situated in the heart of the Cote de Beaune, Burgundy. With three generations of winemaking expertise, the estate is renowned for producing elegant Pinot Noir wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region.

  • Tasting Notes: This light and supple red wine presents a bright color with enticing aromas of raspberry, cherry, and licorice. On the palate, it offers a well-structured profile with elegant tannins, leading to a fruity and harmonious finish.

  • Serving Suggestions: Serve at 14-16°C (57-61°F). This versatile Burgundy pairs well with charcuterie, cheese boards, and roasted poultry.

  • Winemaking: Crafted from 100% Pinot Noir grapes, the wine undergoes sustainable viticulture practices. The wine is vinified to highlight the purity and finesse of the varietal.

Domaine Cauvard's Chorey-les-Beaune exemplifies the estate's dedication to producing high-quality Burgundy wines that are both approachable and expressive of their origin.

title: Falkenstein Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Falkenstein Sauvignon Blanc originates from Italy, specifically from the Alto Adige region (Südtirol) and the Val Venosta subregion. The winery, which has been family-owned for over 400 years, saw a significant shift in 1995 when Franz and Bernadette Pratzner transitioned from apple cultivation to viticulture. Today, the estate is managed by Franz and his daughter Magdalena, who follow a philosophy of manual labor and minimal intervention to produce wines that reflect their specific mountain terroir.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a straw yellow colour with brilliant reflections and a medium-to-light body. The sensory profile is fresh and complex, featuring an aromatic nose of alfalfa, green pepper, and gooseberry, enriched with pleasant mineral notes. On the palate, it is fresh, iodized, and pleasantly brackish, delivering flavours of blackcurrant, grapefruit, and elderflower. The structure is defined by a vibrant, accentuated acidity that lingers on the refreshing finish.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Sauvignon Blanc.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is fermented in acacia barrels for 7–10 weeks and aged in the same containers for 9 months before bottling, contributing to its unique personality and complexity.

  • ABV: 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery utilizes organic and biodynamic practices to respect the environment, the estate is not currently certified organic.

title: Castello Tricerchi Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
Tricerchi’s Brunello is a blend of fruit from three different vineyards: Vigna del Velo, Vigna del Castello, and Vigna dei Cipressi, with a varying range of exposures. After picking in early October, fermentation is carried out with indigenous yeasts, mostly in steel; maceration is for a total of about 30 days on the skins; after pressing, the wine is aged in large neutral oak barrels for about 30 months.

93 Points - Vinous

The 2019 Brunello di Montalcino displays a vibrant ruby hue, wafting up with an earthy blend of flowery undergrowth and crushed rocks before giving way to dried strawberries. It opens with a pleasant inner sweetness and creamy textures. Fresh acidity enlivens its red fruits and rosy inner florals. Violet and lavender florals linger through the long perfumed finale as a hint of fine tannins tug at the palate. What a darling.

title: Craven Pinot Gris 2023
bodyHtml: Pinot Gris is not widely planted in Stellenbosch making this a relative rarity. These young vines are planted on an interesting sedimentary rock, cemented into a duricrust by iron oxides. Locally this red soil is called Koffieklip or Coffee Stone. These are usually the first grapes to come into the winery in early January. The wine is fermented in open top tank with about 10% whole-cluster inclusion. After just over a week on skins, it is pressed off into old oak barrels.

title: Scarpa 'Bric du Nota' Nebbiolo d'Alba 2022
bodyHtml: This is exceptionally elegant, almost understated Nebbiolo with the classic Roero perfume (from sandy soils). It’s Nebbiolo as it used to be made — where structure, spices, and minerals are at least as important as fruit.

title: Hugel Pinot Noir 'Grossi Laue' 2014
bodyHtml:
Grossi Laue signifies the finest vineyards in Alsace dialect and represents an equivalent to the German Grosses Gewachs or the Burgundian Grand Cru.

A Pinot Noir with real minerality, profound and deep which year after year comes closer to that of a Cote d'Or! A truly profound and complex red wine, aged 8 to 10 months in partially renewed oak barriques.

93 Points - James Suckling

Spicy, dried-sage and coffee-bean nose with delicate red-fruit aromas and a touch of orange zest. Medium-bodied with the structure to age, but the healthy tannins are now well integrated. The fresh and mineral finish is longer and more harmonious than I thought possible in this challenging vintage.

title: Huteau Boulanger 'La Muse' Muscadet Sevre et Maine Sur Lie 2023
bodyHtml: Huteau-Boulanger owns a winery called Moulin Camus, which has become well known for Muscadet wine. ‘La Muse’ is a range in their line-up, offering a variety of wines that are true and classic to each varietal. This wine is made from 100% Melon de Bourgogne, also known as Muscadet. It’s super bright and fresh, revealing a mix of lemon, lime, tart apple and pear. The wine is also aged sur lie (on the lees) for 3 months. This gives the wine a little extra creaminess and depth.

title: Aroa Larrosa Rose 2021
bodyHtml:
The 2021 Aroa Larrosa Rosé is a vibrant wine from Navarra, Spain, crafted by Bodegas Aroa. This organic rosé is made predominantly from Garnacha (Grenache) grapes, embodying the winery's dedication to sustainable and natural winemaking practices.

Colour: Clean and bright carmine red with raspberry pink edges, showcasing its freshness and vibrancy.

Aroma: Fresh, fruity, and intense, with prominent notes of raspberry and wild strawberries, enhanced by citrus hints of tangerine and delicate floral nuances of dianthus.

Palate: Succulent and invigorating, featuring flavors of melon and tropical fruits that add liveliness. The wine maintains a crisp balance between acidity and sweetness, providing a harmonious and refreshing experience.

Body: Light-bodied with a delicate texture, making it easy-drinking and ideal for warm weather.

Finish: Sweet yet balanced, with a clean, crisp finish that leaves a lingering impression.

Accolades: The 2021 vintage received a critic score of 90 points, acknowledging its quality and appeal.

title: Le Caillou Cotes du Rhone Rouge 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured red wine originates from France, within the regional Côtes du Rhône A.O.C. appellation in the sun-drenched Southern Rhône Valley. Produced by Domaine Le Clos du Caillou a legendary, biodynamically farmed estate situated in Courthézon, famed for its boundary-adjacent parcels right on the Châteauneuf-du-Pape borde. This bottling represents one of the greatest values and quality benchmarks in the entire region. Sourced from organically and biodynamically certified estate vineyards rooted in fine quartz-sand, limestone-clay, and round quartzite river pebbles (galets roulés), the vines benefit from a Mediterranean microclimate. Generous summer sunshine is tempered by the cooling, drying influence of the Mistral wind, allowing traditional Rhône varieties to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining a vibrant, mouthwatering natural acidity and detailed aromatic lift.

Wine Description

The Le Caillou Côtes du Rhône Rouge presents a luminous, deep garnet-ruby color in the glass with vivid magenta and crimson highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, precise, and silk-textured portrait of sandy Southern Rhône terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crushed wild raspberries, black cherries, and dark plums, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh violets, lavender, garrigue herbs, cracked black pepper, and a subtle line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and supple, showcasing a succulent core of tart red fruits, licorice, and blood orange zest. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its mid-palate fruit concentration. The mouthfeel is weightless, velvety, and linear, framed by fine-grained, ultra-soft tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of garrigue, dark berry hull, and subtle spice.

title: Paquet Macon Villages Nos Cinq Terroirs 2025
bodyHtml:
100% Chardonnay sourced from the 5 terroirs of Macon-Prisse, Macon-Davaye, Macon-Fuisse, Macon-Lugny and Macon-Loche. This Macon-Villages has a pretty pale gold hue. Rich nose of citrus, yellow fruits and white flowers. The palate is well-balanced, combining freshness and fleshiness, followed by a saline finish. 

Ideal as an apéritif but also an excellent accompaniment to shellfish, veal, poultry, sushi and risotto.

title: Campo alla Sughera Arnione Bolgheri Superiore 2014
bodyHtml: Intriguing and intense sensations of cassis and blueberries, then elegant floral aromas of violet and rose, marine scrub, eucalyptus and Caribbean cedar. Well structured, it balances glyceric softness with high-tannin tannins. Persistent.

title: The Calling Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml: Plum red in color with aromas of blackberry, toasted spices, and vanilla. The palate is rich, elegant and beautifully structured with layers of black fruit and freshly roasted coffee, finishing with round and supple tannins.

title: Mission Hill Reserve Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Beautiful aromatics of ripe red berries, blood orange and pink grapefruit on the nose, lead to vibrant flavors of watermelon, rhubarb, and strawberries in cream on the palate.

This Rose is bright to start, leading to a very soft and refreshing finish.

title: Ca' del Baio 'Sermine' Langhe Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Ca' del Baio Langhe Chardonnay Sermine is a beautifully crafted white wine that encapsulates the essence of the Langhe region in Piedmont, Italy. Produced by the acclaimed Ca' del Baio winery, this Chardonnay is made from carefully selected grapes grown in the Sermine vineyard, known for its optimal terroir and microclimate.

The wine exudes aromas of citrus fruits, white flowers, and a touch of oak. On the palate, it reveals a perfect balance of acidity, minerality, and creamy texture, leading to a long and elegant finish. Ca' del Baio Langhe Chardonnay Sermine is a delightful expression of Italian winemaking artistry.

title: Pecchenino Barolo 'Bussia' 2015
bodyHtml: The Pecchenino family has been working in a wine-growing sector. Today, Pecchenino consists of 54 acres in Dogliani and an additional seven acres in Monforte. Focused on the production of high-quality Dolcetto, Nebbiolo and a few other varieties, Pecchenino's vines are painstakingly cared for by hand. In addition to its consistent high quality, Pecchenino distinguishes itself by being the only winery to produce Aged in oak, resulting in Dolcetto wines with an aging potential of over 10 years.

title: Gulfi Cerasuolo di Vittoria Classico 2021
bodyHtml: Made with the traditional 50% of Nero d'Avola and 50% Frapatto, the wine shows a beautiful deep hue with young highlights. Intense fruity nose accented with ripe redcurrant and cassis. The same aromas recur on the palate where freshness fuses with lovely substance. It pairs well with white meat, tuna and other elaborate fish dishes.

title: Chateau Mille Roses Margaux 2020
bodyHtml:
Chateau Mille Roses, established in 1999 by Sophie and David Faure, is a family-owned estate located in the southern part of the Margaux appellation, near Macau and Arsac. The estate spans approximately 10.85 hectares, with 5.5 hectares in Haut-Medoc and 5.35 hectares in Margaux, nestled between two Grand Cru Classe vineyards. Since 2013, the vineyard has been certified organic, reflecting the owners' commitment to sustainable viticulture and environmental stewardship.

  • Tasting Notes: This Margaux wine exhibits a deep ruby color and offers aromas of concentrated blackberry fruits, complemented by notes of praline and floral hints. On the palate, it is characterized by a rich and tight tannic structure, with silky and fine tannins. The wine is refreshing, supported by pleasant acidity, with subtle wood and chocolate notes emerging, leading to a smooth, elegant finish.

  • Serving Suggestions: Serve at 16-18°C (60-64°F). This wine pairs excellently with beef, lamb, poultry, and game dishes.

  • Winemaking: The grapes are sourced from vines planted in deep gravelly soils, managed with high-density plantings and strict vineyard practices to maintain low yields and high-quality fruit. The estate avoids the use of chemical herbicides and pesticides, adhering to organic farming principles. The wine undergoes fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks, followed by aging in French oak barrels to enhance its complexity and aging potential.

Chateau Mille Roses Margaux reflects the elegance and refinement typical of the Margaux appellation, showcasing the dedication of its owners to producing wines that honor the traditions of the region while embracing sustainable practices.

title: Vignerons de Buxy Cote Chalonnaise Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Vignerons de Buxy Cote Chalonnaise Pinot Noir is a red Burgundy produced in the Cote Chalonnaise subregion of France. The Cave des Vignerons de Buxy, founded in 1931, is a world renowned cooperative born from the desire of local growers to unite their efforts in vinifying and marketing their wines. The winery's philosophy is guided by human values, innovation, and sustainable development, focusing on expressing the unique identity of southern Burgundy.

Wine Description

This wine displays a fine, clean red colour with ruby reflections. The sensory profile opens with typical Pinot Noir aromas of morello cherry, blackcurrant, and redcurrant, layered with hints of smoke, humus, and occasionally animal notes. On the palate, it is rich and complex with a firm texture supported by supple, elegant tannins and a fine balance. The finish is fresh and spicy, echoing the red fruit and earthy notes found on the nose. This 100% Pinot Noir is crafted from grapes grown on east and southeast facing slopes with shallow, pebbly calcareous soil.

title: Heineken 330 ml - 24 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Wherever you go in the world, it’s always refreshing to see something you recognize. That green bottle, the red star, the smiling ‘e’… like an instant welcome from an old friend. The Original.

For over 150 years, a ceaseless commitment to purity and quality has made Heineken the most iconic beer brand in the world. When you see the red star on the green bottle, you know every ice-cold, crisp sip will deliver that richly satisfying flavor with subtle fruity notes. A tradition of taste that has lived on for over a century and a half thanks to the simplicity and quality of the ingredients and the meticulous attention to the brewing process.

title: Monkey 47 Dry Gin - 375 ml
bodyHtml: This elegant gin was created with the use of 47 ingredients. Notes of juniper, lemon peel, cucumber and mint on the nose. The palate is graced with flavours of clove and grapefruit. Medium-bodied and fruity, the finish is long-lasting and refined. Craft a lovely Gin and Tonic with this spirit or enjoy it with smoked trout.

title: Jim Beam Black 7 Year Old
bodyHtml: Something magical happens to the whiskey in its seventh year in cask. Jim Beam calls it the sweet spot, where smoothness meets notes of caramel, vanilla, and warm oak, and the liquid turns a rich gold. This is the mellow whiskey you’ll find in the new Jim Beam Black. Enjoy Jim Beam Black neat, on the rocks, or in a Jim Beam Black Old Fashioned.

title: The Calling Russian River Valley Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
The 2022 The Calling Russian River Valley Pinot Noir is a red wine from Sonoma County, California. This vintage exemplifies the region's renowned terroir and the winery's commitment to crafting exceptional Pinot Noir.

Vineyard and Production

Sourced from select vineyards within the Russian River Valley, the 2022 vintage benefited from a growing season marked by balanced temperatures and minimal rainfall. These conditions allowed for optimal ripening of the Pinot Noir grapes, resulting in a wine that harmoniously balances fruit expression and acidity. Traditional winemaking techniques, including fermentation in stainless steel and aging in French oak barrels, were employed to enhance complexity and depth.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Vibrant ruby-red hue.

  • Aroma: Enticing notes of Bing cherry, fresh strawberry, and orange zest.

  • Palate: A velvety, smooth texture with flavors of red plum, violet, and subtle earthiness. The wine exhibits a balanced acidity and a lingering finish.

Critical Acclaim

  • Wine Spectator: 91 points. Described as a streamlined version, with a pure beam of cherry and blood orange coulis zipping through, flecked with red tea and savory hints. Offers a light mineral echo through the finish. Drink now through 2030.

  • Wine Enthusiast: 90 points. Fresh raspberry, cherry, and orange-blossom aromas are displayed on the nose of this elegant and expressive wine. The palate is both floral and bright, with juicy acidity and just enough grip of tannin for balance. This would pair marvelously with smoked-salmon canapés.

Serving and Pairing

This Pinot Noir is best served slightly chilled, around 55°F (13°C). It pairs well with a variety of dishes, including smoked salmon canapés, roasted poultry, grilled vegetables, and soft cheeses. Its balanced profile also complements dishes featuring earthy mushrooms or light tomato-based sauces.

title: Tesseron Vineyards 'PYM-RAE' 2017
bodyHtml:
The 2017 Tesseron Estate 'Pym-Rae' is a red wine from Napa Valley, California. Crafted by the Tesseron family, renowned proprietors of Château Pontet-Canet in Bordeaux, this wine exemplifies their commitment to producing exceptional wines that reflect the unique terroir of their vineyards.

Vineyard and Production

Sourced from the estate's vineyard on Mount Veeder, the 2017 'Pym-Rae' is a blend of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon and 20% Merlot. The vineyard, originally planted in the late 1990s, has been dry-farmed since its acquisition by the Tesseron family in 2016. The 2017 vintage presented challenges, including a significant heat spike during Labor Day weekend and regional fires during harvest. Despite these conditions, the vineyard's elevation and meticulous vineyard management resulted in healthy, balanced grapes. Notably, no Cabernet Franc was included in this vintage due to the timing of the fires affecting its harvest. The wine was aged in French oak barrels, contributing to its complexity and aging potential.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Deep garnet-purple hue.

  • Aroma: Expressive notes of black cherries, mulberries, and plum preserves, complemented by hints of dark chocolate, Indian spices, sandalwood, and cinnamon stick.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and plush, with a firm yet refined structure. Flavors of bright raspberries, mushrooms, and bark are evident, leading to a racy and fine finish.

Critical Acclaim

  • Wine Advocate: 97 points. Praised for its depth and complexity, with bold fruit flavors and an opulent undercurrent of spices and wood notes.

  • James Suckling: 97 points. Described as rich, flamboyant, and decadent, with bright fruit and a tight, refined structure.

  • Jeb Dunnuck: 96 points. Noted for its weight and mid-palate density, standing out among the 2017 vintage wines.

Serving and Pairing

To fully appreciate its complexity, decant the wine for at least an hour before serving at a temperature of 16-18°C (61-64°F). This wine pairs exceptionally well with hearty dishes such as grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, or aged cheeses. Its robust structure and depth also make it a suitable companion for rich stews and roasted game meats.

title: Wild Winds The Fohn Munich Helles Lager 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
The Fohn Munich Helles Lager is brewed by Wild Winds Brewery, a woman owned craft brewery founded by Certified Cicerone Jen Rogers. Originally planned for Pincher Creek, Alberta, the brewery currently operates and crafts its beers in Calgary. The beer's name is inspired by the Foehn winds—warm, dry gusts that descend mountain slopes—which are famously known as 'Chinooks' in Southwest Alberta.

Beer Description

This German style Helles lager presents as an unfiltered brew with a characteristic haze and a medium to full body. The sensory profile features a clean and smooth aroma with subtle spicy, floral, and earthy hop notes. On the palate, it delivers a mildly grainy-sweet malty flavour supported by a malt bill of 100% Alberta malt from Canada Malting and Red Shed Malting. The finish is soft with a low bitterness, resulting from the use of German yeast and late additions of German Perle or Hersbrucker hops. This sessionable lager has an ABV of 5% and a bitterness of 18 IBU.

title: Tool Shed Flat Cap Stout 473 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Flat Cap is a staple core offering from Calgary’s Tool Shed Brewing Company. This beer is a tribute to the "working man’s" stout, designed to be hearty and flavorful while remaining approachable enough for a full session. True to Tool Shed’s roots of starting in a literal backyard shed, Flat Cap embodies a no-nonsense, high-quality approach to traditional dark ales, offering a rich experience without the overwhelming heaviness or high alcohol content often associated with the style.

Beer Description

This traditional Stout pours a deep, opaque obsidian black with a thick, tan, creamy head that leaves beautiful lacing on the glass.

Aroma: It features a robust nose dominated by dark roasted malts, offering distinct notes of espresso, bittersweet chocolate, and a hint of toasted oats.

Palate: The flavor profile is rich and layered, mirroring the aroma with deep coffee and cocoa notes. It provides a smooth, medium-bodied mouthfeel with a subtle creamy texture, finishing with a pleasant, dry roasted bitterness that balances the initial malt sweetness.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.5% and a moderate bitterness of 32 IBU, making it flavorful and complex yet remarkably easy to drink.

title: Paulaner Pils 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
The brilliant, bright yellow beer is crowned by a pure white, thick foamy head. The hoppy, crisp, clean taste delivers on the consumer’s expectation; this is a beer that expresses the master brewer’s years of experience in a traditional recipe.

The Paulaner Pils is brewed strictly in the Pilsener style - with the best Hallertau hops providing its typical bitter aroma. Paulaner beer lovers like to tell each other the anecdote while toasting, according to which the pilsner originally came from Bohemia, but was created by a brewer from Southern Germany. And the Paulaner Pils does justice to that.

title: Kinjo Premium Daiginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Aizu Homare Premium Daiginjo Sake is a sake produced by Homare Sake Brewery, located in Kitakata City, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1918, the brewery has a long-standing reputation for crafting high-quality sakes that honor traditional brewing methods while embracing innovation.

Sake Description

This Premium Daiginjo is meticulously brewed using Yamadanishiki rice, polished to a 39% seimaibuai (remaining rice grain), allowing for the extraction of the purest flavors. The sake presents a clear, pristine appearance. On the nose, it offers an elegant bouquet of melon, grape, and strawberry aromas. The palate is smooth and round, with a harmonious blend of fruity notes and a subtle sweetness, leading to a clean, crisp finish.

Food Pairing

The refined profile of this Daiginjo makes it an excellent accompaniment to delicate dishes such as sashimi, sushi, and lightly grilled seafood. It also pairs well with soft cheeses and can complement light appetizers, enhancing the overall dining experience.

title: The Calling Monterey County Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml: Ruby red and bursting with fruit on the nose and palate. Hints of white pepper, rose petal, raspberry, and a subtle touch of Monterey Bay salinity.

title: The Calling Dutton Ranch Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
The Calling Dutton Ranch Chardonnay is a distinguished white wine from the Russian River Valley in Sonoma County, California. Sourced from the renowned Dutton Ranch vineyards, this Chardonnay exemplifies the region's commitment to producing high-quality wines with expressive character.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Pale golden hue with brilliant clarity.

  • Aroma: Enticing bouquet of ripe tropical fruits such as papaya and grilled pineapple, complemented by subtle notes of vanilla shortbread and orange blossoms.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and well-structured, featuring flavors of mango, candied ginger, and a touch of Meyer lemon. The wine's vibrant acidity and supple texture create a harmonious balance, leading to a lingering, elegant finish.

Accolades

  • 92 Points - Wine Spectator

  • 90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Serving and Pairing

This Chardonnay is best served chilled at around 50°F (10°C). It pairs exceptionally well with dishes such as roasted poultry, grilled seafood, creamy pastas, and soft cheeses. Its vibrant fruit profile and balanced acidity also make it a delightful companion to spicy Asian cuisine.

title: Stella Rosa Mango Chili
bodyHtml: This semi-sweet, semi-sparkling wine is made with a proprietary blend of primarily the Moscato D’Asti grape with natural flavors of ripe tropical mango and spicy chili. Serve chilled or mix with your favorite spirit.

title: Salvioni Rosso di Montalcino 'La Cerbaiola' 2023
bodyHtml:
For the Salvionis, wine implies collective activity. Surrounded by woodland, the 20 hectares of La Cerbaiola look out over the Val d’Orcia from an altitude of 420 metres, opening up like a gently sloping plateau four kilometres to the southeast of Montalcino.

Salvioni’s La Cerbaiola Rosso di Montalcino is a vibrant and refined expression of Sangiovese, offering both immediacy and depth. The nose bursts with red cherry, wild berries, and violet, layered with hints of sweet spice, tobacco, and fresh herbs. The palate is lively yet structured, showcasing juicy red fruit, earthy minerality, and finely grained tannins, all lifted by bright acidity. A long, elegant finish lingers with notes of dried flowers and subtle balsamic nuances. A polished and expressive Rosso, perfect for pasta dishes and grilled meats.

title: Quinta Quietud Toro Corral De Campanas 2022
bodyHtml: Corral de Campanas is a red wine that captivates the senses with its vibrant bouquet of red fruits such as cherries and strawberries, interwoven with delicate hints of vanilla and pepper. Upon tasting, its youth and vivacity are unveiled, offering a velvety yet robust texture that leaves a lasting impression of its succulence and harmony. This wine is an impeccable selection for those in pursuit of a fruit-forward flavor and a revitalizing experience with each sip.

title: Cabin Brewing Super Saturation - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Super Saturation is the beloved flagship New England Pale Ale from Calgary’s Cabin Brewing Company. Since its release, it has become a benchmark for the style in Alberta, winning numerous awards for its incredible hop depth and silky texture. Designed to be "saturated" with hop flavor without the harsh bitterness of traditional IPAs, it captures the cozy, nostalgic essence of cabin life—comforting, approachable, and consistently high-quality.

Beer Description

This New England Pale Ale (NEPA) pours a thick, opaque hazy gold with a soft, persistent white head and a glowing, juice-like appearance.

Aroma: It features an explosive tropical nose, dominated by intense notes of candied orange, succulent peach, and ripe mango, with a hint of forest pine.

Palate: The flavor is a wash of tropical fruit salad and citrus zest. It offers a soft mouthfeel that coats the palate, followed by a remarkably low bitterness that allows the juicy hop oils to shine.

Profile: It has an ABV of 6.0% and a very low perceived bitterness, making it incredibly smooth and dangerously drinkable for its strength.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a heavy dose of flaked oats and wheat to create its signature hazy body and creamy mouthfeel. It is aggressively dry-hopped with a massive amount of Citra and Simcoe hops to achieve its deep "saturation" of tropical aromatics.

title: Speri Amarone della Valpolicella Classico Sant'Urbano 2020
bodyHtml:
Speri Amarone della Valpolicella Classico Sant'Urbano is a red wine from the Valpolicella region in Veneto, Italy. Produced by the historic Speri family, this Amarone is crafted from a meticulous selection of Corvina Veronese and Corvinone (75%), Rondinella (20%), and Molinara (5%). The grapes undergo the traditional appassimento process, drying for around 100 days to concentrate their flavors before fermentation.

Tasting Notes

  • Aroma: An intense bouquet of dried violets, black cherries, fresh coffee grounds, cocoa powder, and subtle spices.

  • Palate: Full-bodied yet refined, with silky textures and layers of polished red berry fruit. Balanced acidity and structured tannins create a long, persistent finish with hints of dark chocolate, spice, and earthy minerality.

  • Structure: Well-integrated tannins and fresh acidity provide excellent aging potential.

title: Renaissance Sancerre 'Les Magie de Caillottes' 2023
bodyHtml:
Renaissance Sancerre 'Les Magie de Caillottes' originates from France, within the Loire Valley region and the Sancerre appellation. The winery is a collaborative project between brothers Mathieu and Benoît Fleuriet and their friend Stéphane Marchand. Their winemaking philosophy centers on a deep respect for terroir, utilizing organic and biodynamic farming to produce unadulterated, lively, and precise wines. The 'Magie des Caillottes' cuvée is specifically sourced from a stony vineyard in Amigny, planted in the late 1990s on calcareous 'caillottes' soil.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a golden colour with green reflections and a medium body. The sensory profile is characterized by an expressive nose of citrus and white floral notes such as hawthorn. On the palate, it is described as frank, straight, and well structured, featuring a high acidity and a distinct mineral drive that leads to a balanced, gourmet finish.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Sauvignon Blanc.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is fermented slowly with indigenous yeasts and aged for nine months in a combination of concrete tanks (80%) and foudres (20%) to preserve freshness and energy.

  • ABV: 13%.

  • Organic Status: Certified organic and biodynamic (effective from the 2023 vintage).

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and mineral character of this Sancerre make it an excellent partner for fresh and delicate flavours.

  • Seafood: Pairs exceptionally well with various types of fish and shellfish, particularly oysters, grilled sea bass, and scallops.

  • Poultry and White Meats: Complements herb roasted chicken or turkey prepared with a light lemon juice.

  • Savoury and Vegetarian: Suggested pairings include mixed salads, especially those featuring goat's cheese like Crottin de Chavignol, and grilled vegetables or quinoa dishes.

  • Cheese: A traditional match for tangy and creamy goat's cheeses from the Loire Valley.

title: Chateau Ste Michelle Cabernet Sauvignon 'Cold Creek' 2021
bodyHtml:
Planted in 1972, Cold Creek Vineyard stands as one of the oldest and most acclaimed vineyards in Washington State. Relatively early harvests produce moderate yields with concentrated grapes. The end result: intense flavors and deep color.

Cabernet from this iconic 45-year-old vineyard consistently delivers power, structure and rich concentrated black fruit. The wine offers black cherry flavors and chocolate notes with typical Cold Creek density and user friendly power.

title: Podere Ferrale Chianti Classico 2021
bodyHtml:
Podere Ferrale's Chianti Classico 2021 is a red wine from the heart of Tuscany, produced in the prestigious Chianti Classico region. The estate is situated at an elevation of 555 meters between Siena and Florence, with vineyards dedicated to Sangiovese and Canaiolo, two of the region’s signature grape varieties.

Vintage and Winemaking

The 2021 vintage in Chianti Classico has been widely praised for its outstanding quality, with ideal growing conditions that led to wines of great structure, freshness, and complexity. Podere Ferrale’s commitment to traditional winemaking ensures that their Chianti Classico reflects the purity of the terroir, balancing vibrant acidity with well-integrated tannins.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Deep ruby red with garnet reflections.
  • Aroma: Expressive notes of red cherry, wild berries, violet, and subtle hints of spice and dried herbs.
  • Palate: Medium-bodied with bright acidity, silky tannins, and flavors of ripe red fruit, earthy undertones, and a touch of oak. A well-balanced and elegant finish.

Serving and Pairing

This Chianti Classico is best enjoyed at a serving temperature of 16–18°C (60–64°F). It pairs beautifully with traditional Tuscan dishes such as pasta with ragu, roasted meats, and aged cheeses. Decanting for about 30 minutes before serving will enhance its aromatic complexity.

title: Fiol Prosecco
bodyHtml:
FIOL Prosecco is a premium Italian sparkling wine produced in the Treviso region of Veneto, Italy. Founded in 2010 by a group of friends from Treviso, the brand aims to bring a modern and vibrant twist to traditional Prosecco while maintaining its elegance and heritage.

Production and Style

Made from 100% Glera grapes, FIOL Prosecco is produced using the Charmat method, where secondary fermentation occurs in stainless steel tanks. This technique helps preserve the wine’s bright fruit characteristics and fresh, crisp profile. The Extra Dry style offers a well-balanced experience with a slight touch of sweetness, making it highly versatile.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Light golden color with fine bubbles and a creamy foam.
  • Aroma: Elegant bouquet of white flowers and acacia, complemented by crisp apples, pears, and citrus zest.
  • Palate: Lively and refreshing, with a delicate balance of fruit, acidity, and subtle sweetness. The finish is smooth and clean, making it an easy-drinking yet refined sparkling wine.

Serving Suggestions

FIOL Prosecco is best served chilled and can be enjoyed on its own or as the base for cocktails like the Aperol Spritz. Its balanced acidity and gentle sweetness pair well with light appetizers, seafood, sushi, and fresh salads.

title: Zuidam Orange Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Zuidam Orange Liqueur is a premium citrus-infused spirit crafted by Zuidam Distillers in the Netherlands. This liqueur combines the vibrant essence of fresh sweet and bitter oranges with the elegance of aged French Cognac, resulting in a refined and well-balanced flavor profile.

Tasting Notes

  • Aroma: Bright and aromatic with fresh orange zest, subtle floral notes, and a touch of vanilla from the Cognac.
  • Palate: A harmonious blend of sweet and bitter orange flavors, enriched by the smooth, warming presence of aged Cognac. The mid-palate reveals hints of oak and spice, leading to a balanced, lingering finish.

Serving Suggestions

  • Neat or on the rocks: Enjoy the rich and complex citrus notes on their own.
  • Cocktails: Use as a premium substitute in classic cocktails like the Sidecar or Margarita for added depth and sophistication.
  • Culinary Uses: Incorporate into desserts, such as orange-infused cakes or chocolate truffles, to enhance their citrus character.

title: Hampton Water Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hampton Water Rose originates from France, within the Languedoc region of the south. Launched in 2018, the brand is a family business created by rock star Jon Bon Jovi and his son, Jesse Bongiovi, in collaboration with acclaimed French winemaker Gérard Bertrand. Their winemaking philosophy centers on disrupting the traditional wine category with a modern, approachable brand that captures the 'spirit of the Hamptons' while utilizing the expertise of the South of France.

Wine Description

This rose typically presents a pale, salmon pink colour. The sensory profile is fresh and lively, featuring a fragrant nose of red berries such as strawberry and raspberry, complemented by citrus notes, white flowers, and a distinct mineral character. On the medium-bodied palate, it delivers bright flavours of cherry and watermelon balanced by a crisp acidity and a touch of wet-stone minerality. The finish is long, dry, and refreshing, a result of meticulous ageing in new French oak barrels.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional Southern French blend of 60% Grenache, 15% Cinsault, 15% Mourvèdre, and 10% Syrah.

  • ABV: Generally ranges between 13% and 14.2% depending on the vintage.

  • Ageing: Portions of the wine are aged for 30 to 60 days in new French oak to enhance texture and complexity.

  • Organic Status: While Gérard Bertrand is known for biodynamic viticulture, this specific wine is not certified organic.

title: The Wines of Francis Coppola Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml: This Chardonnay has fresh aromas of ripe peach and toasted brioche. The cooler climate brings forth layered flavors of tangerine, pear, and bright acidity with a hint of honeysuckle on the finish.

title: Hendry Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2017
bodyHtml: Dense, dark berry color. In the initial aromas, pretty blackcurrant and caramel form the base notes, with soft cedar and black licorice. Very firm tannins portend a long life for this ripe, concentrated, dark wine.

title: Smokehead High Voltage Islay Single Malt
bodyHtml:
If Smokehead is an assault on your senses, then High Voltage Single Malt Whisky is an all-out attack.

Deeply rich and intensely peaty, this one hits all the senses with a rush of black smoke, creamy, nutty notes and a tangy sea salt finish. Smokehead High Voltage is explosive and reserved for those who go all out. No matter what others think.

title: Wakefield Clare Valley Riesling 2025
bodyHtml:
Situated in the heart of South Australia's beautiful Clare Valley, Wakefield has become one of Australia's best-loved and most trusted wineries since they established back in 1969. Their Riesling has elegant characters of fresh lime, lemon and subtle tropical fruit with a crisp and refreshing palate that finishes with lively balanced acidity.

Wine Description

Pale straw yellow in colour with subtle green highlights along the edges. Lifted fresh and vibrant aromas of kaffir lime and lemon, followed by layers of subtle blossoms and florals. Displays intense citrus fruit characters of fresh lemon and lime along with hints of orange blossom on the palate.

title: Prince Hill Vineyards Willamette Valley Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Prince Hill Vineyards' 2022 Willamette Valley Chardonnay is a remarkable expression of Oregon's premier Chardonnay-growing region. Located in the Dundee Hills AVA, the vineyard thrives in a cool climate and volcanic soils, ideal for producing wines of balance and complexity. This vintage showcases the Duncan family's dedication to sustainable viticulture and high-quality winemaking.

Wine Description

The 2022 Willamette Valley Chardonnay displays a pale straw-yellow hue with brilliant clarity. On the nose, it exudes aromas of green apple, lemon zest, and white peach, alongside delicate floral and mineral undertones. The palate is vibrant, featuring crisp acidity and flavors of citrus, pear, and a touch of tropical fruit. Subtle hints of toasted oak and vanilla add depth without overpowering the wine’s natural elegance. The finish is long and refreshing, with a clean, mineral-driven conclusion.

Food Pairing

This Chardonnay pairs beautifully with dishes such as grilled salmon, roasted chicken, creamy risottos, or shellfish like oysters and scallops. Its bright acidity and balanced texture also make it an excellent match for goat cheese or salads with citrus vinaigrette.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast: 93 points – Praised for its elegance, balance, and integration of oak and fruit.
  • Wine Spectator: 91 points – Recognized for its vibrant acidity and nuanced layers of fruit and minerality.
  • James Suckling: 92 points – Highlighted for its fresh citrus character, clean finish, and exceptional quality.

Additional Notes

The 2022 growing season in the Willamette Valley featured cooler temperatures, allowing for extended ripening and excellent flavor development in the grapes. The use of partial French oak aging, with a blend of new and neutral barrels, lends complexity and texture without overshadowing the wine's purity. This Chardonnay reflects the unique terroir of Prince Hill Vineyards and the skillful craftsmanship of the Duncan family.

title: Prince Hill Vineyards Dundee Hills Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml: The Prince Hill Vineyards Dundee Hills Pinot Noir captures the essence of Oregon’s prestigious Dundee Hills AVA. Sourced from Prince Hill Vineyards, this Pinot Noir reflects the region’s volcanic soils and temperate climate, delivering a wine of remarkable depth, balance, and elegance. A true representation of the unique terroir of the Willamette Valley, this Pinot Noir offers an expressive profile that delights the senses with every sip.

title: Masumi Nanago Yamahai Junmai Daiginjo - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by the historic Miyasaka Brewing Company (founded in 1662), the Nanago—meaning "Number Seven"—is a tribute to the brewery's most famous discovery. In 1946, a unique yeast strain was identified in their fermentation tanks; designated as Association Yeast No. 7, it became the most widely used sake yeast in the world. This specific sake is a liquid celebration of that heritage, crafted using the ancient yamahai brewing method, which relies on natural lactic acid development rather than modern additions.

Description

This ultra-premium sake features a clear appearance and a profile that defies the typical expectations of the rugged yamahai style. While many yamahai sakes are punchy and earthy, the Nanago is celebrated for its understated elegance and "seventh heaven" refinement. The nose offers a complex bouquet of ripe bananas, yellow peaches, and subtle hints of cereal and laurel. On the palate, it delivers a silky, full-bodied texture with layers of clear umami, subdued sweetness, and firm acidity. Subtle notes of Nilla wafers and molasses are balanced by a tight bitterness and a slight peppery timbre in the finish. It is brewed with local Kinmon Nishiki rice polished down to 40%. ABV 15%.

Food Pairing

The structural acidity and expansive umami of this sake make it an exceptional partner for a broad range of high-end cuisines. Its refined profile complements traditional Japanese dishes like whiting tempura, asparagus goma-ae, and bamboo shoots stewed in dashi. It also transitions beautifully to Western fare, pairing elegantly with seafood risotto, truffle mac and cheese, or lemon and garlic prawns. For a richer experience, serve it chilled alongside grilled salmon, roasted chicken, or aged cheeses.

title: Borgogno Riesling 'Era Ora' 2021
bodyHtml: Borgogno Langhe Era Ora, a wine with character and a meaningful name: ‘Era Ora’ ('It was time' in English), as it was the first white wine from Borgogno after 250 years of red wine history. They worked with Riesling because they were looking for a grape variety that could produce a wine with great ageing potential and structure.

title: Josh Cellars Seaswept Sauvignon Blanc - Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml: Seaswept from Josh Cellars is a light, refreshing Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Grigio blend. The aromas reveal grapefruit with melon and light floral notes. Bright flavours of citrus fruit with a crisp, refreshing mouthfeel. Enjoy it chilled on its own, as an aperitif, or pair it with chicken, fresh salads and cheeses.

title: Honest Thief Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: Made from premium vineyards in the Paso Robles AVA, this wine captures the spirit of 1850’s California. It’s a rebellious red, fermented in stainless steel and oak, with notes of dark fruit, brown spice, and a dusting of toasted tobacco that offers you a distinct taste of Paso Robles.

title: Tantalus Syrah 2022
bodyHtml:
A deep maroon in colour, this wine displays wonderful spiced and nuanced aromatics. Blueberry and blackberry compote with dusty white pepper and a touch of nutmeg. There is a buoyant floral quality to the wine with a hint of classic charcuterie notes in the background. 

The palate is fruity and structured with rich black and blue fruits carrying through the palate. Long and velvety with a plush round mouth feel this wines shows cardamom and pepper with orange peel and a touch of pomegranate and red licorice, adding intrigue. The finish is long and lifted with great clarity and minerality. The tannins are fine grained and very well integrated.

title: Corona Extra 330 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml: Classic and authentic, Corona Extra is the easy-to-enjoy beer that enhances life's meaningful moments. Corona is approachable, easy- going, confident, and timeless. The unmistakable colour, the one-of-a-kind taste and the unparalleled flavor of its Mexican heritage make Corona one of the most recognizable and widely enjoyed beers in the world.

title: Joseph Phelps 'Insignia' 2021
bodyHtml:
Insignia captivates the senses with vibrant aromas of black cherry, hibiscus, and wild blackberry, subtly accented by fresh earth and a hint of Tahitian vanilla. On the palate, these dark fruit characteristics are harmonized with warm tones of redwood bark and baking spices. Plush, soft tannins and bright acidity enhance the length, complementing the rich fruit and savory undertones.

98 Points - James Suckling

A standout vintage for one of California’s most collectible cabernet sauvignons. The color is black throughout, but with a dark garnet rim. Gorgeous aromatics of spearmint, pencil shavings, toasted oak and dark plums, before a silky, fresh but firm texture takes over the palate and dusky blackcurrant, tobacco-leaf, rose-petal and cedar notes emerge and linger. Full-bodied and saturated with rounded, well-integrated tannins that emerge on the lingering finish and keep melting in the glass. 

96+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

96+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

94 Points - Wine Spectator

title: Chateau d'Yquem 2020 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Château d'Yquem, located in the Sauternes appellation of Bordeaux, France, is celebrated as one of the finest producers of sweet wines in the world. The 2020 vintage continues this storied legacy, offering a harmonious blend of richness, complexity, and elegance.

Blend and Production

The 2020 Château d'Yquem is composed of 75% Sémillon and 25% Sauvignon Blanc. This blend highlights the estate's mastery in balancing the opulence of Sémillon with the bright acidity and aromatic lift of Sauvignon Blanc. The wine contains 135 grams per liter of residual sugar and was crafted with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring its signature finesse and ageability.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: A pale lemon-gold hue with radiant clarity.
  • Nose: Aromas of candied ginger, orange blossom, ripe peach, and pineapple, complemented by subtle notes of jasmine, almond tart, and a hint of saffron.
  • Palate: Full-bodied and opulent, with flavors of honeyed apricot, marzipan, and vanilla. A perfect balance of sweetness and vibrant acidity provides remarkable freshness and precision. The finish is long, lingering, and layered with floral and spice nuances.

Critical Acclaim
