  • Wine Enthusiast: 97 points – Celebrated for its balance of sweetness, freshness, and complexity, showcasing a vibrant energy.
  • James Suckling: 96 points – Praised for its purity, luscious fruit, and seamless integration of sweetness and acidity.
  • Decanter: 96 points – Noted for its elegance, structure, and ability to evolve gracefully over time.
  • Wine Spectator: 95 points – Highlighted for its depth, complexity, and long, refined finish.
  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate: 94 points – Recognized for its aromatic complexity, texture, and potential for long-term aging.

Serving and Cellaring

The 2020 Château d'Yquem is best served chilled, between 50–54°F (10–12°C). While it is enjoyable now for its vibrant fruit and floral notes, it has the structure and balance to age for decades, developing additional layers of complexity and richness over time.

Conclusion

The 2020 Château d'Yquem is a masterpiece that exemplifies the estate’s dedication to excellence. With its perfect balance of sweetness, acidity, and aromatic depth, this vintage is a standout choice for both immediate enjoyment and long-term cellaring. A true icon of Sauternes, it represents the pinnacle of winemaking craftsmanship.

title: Meukow VS 'Black Panther' Cognac - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Meukow VS Black Panther Limited Edition Cognac is a distinctive creation from the House of Meukow, known for its iconic panther emblem that symbolizes strength, elegance, and sophistication. Crafted under the expertise of Cellar Master Anne Sarteaux, this special blend highlights Meukow’s commitment to exceptional quality and innovative design.

Production and Aging

This cognac is aged for a minimum of two years, incorporating eaux-de-vie sourced from various Cognac regions, including a significant proportion from Grande and Petite Champagne. The aging process in Limousin oak barrels imparts rich, woody flavors and enhances the fruity, silky character of the cognac.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: A rich mahogany hue with warm amber tones.
  • Nose: Delicate floral notes interwoven with hints of orchard fruits, toasted vanilla, and light herbal undertones.
  • Palate: Balanced flavors of young fruits, licorice, and a touch of pink pepper, leading to a finish of warm brioche and subtle garden herbs.

Bottle Design

The Meukow VS Black Panther Limited Edition bottle is a sleek black design featuring the signature embossed panther motif. The unique sparkle detailing on the bottle evokes the elegance of the panther’s coat, making each bottle one of a kind.

Accolades

  • Double Gold Medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition.
  • Bronze Medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition for its craftsmanship and refined profile.

Serving Suggestions

Meukow VS Black Panther is versatile in its enjoyment:

  • Neat: Best savored at room temperature to appreciate its complexity.
  • On the Rocks: A refreshing way to enjoy its smooth and rich profile.
  • Cocktails: Ideal as a base for premium cocktails, adding depth and elegance.

Additional Notes

Established in 1862, the House of Meukow combines tradition and innovation to produce high-quality cognacs. The VS Black Panther Limited Edition represents the pinnacle of Meukow’s artistry, blending exceptional cognac with a striking and modern design, appealing to both collectors and connoisseurs.

title: Meukow Xpresso Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Meukow Xpresso is a distinctive liqueur that artfully blends Meukow's renowned Cognac with rich, roasted coffee flavors. This innovative fusion offers a harmonious balance between the smoothness of Cognac and the robust essence of espresso, creating a unique tasting experience.

Tasting Notes

  • Aroma: Intense notes of freshly roasted coffee beans, complemented by hints of burnt oak, dark chocolate, and a touch of bitter orange.

  • Palate: A smooth and sweet entry leads to powerful flavors of espresso, intertwined with subtle undertones of dark chocolate and a gentle warmth from the Cognac.

  • Finish: Long-lasting with lingering notes of coffee and a mild, pleasant bitterness.

Serving Suggestions

Meukow Xpresso is versatile and can be enjoyed in various ways:

  • Neat: Best savored chilled or frozen to fully appreciate its rich flavors.

  • On the Rocks: Pour over ice to enhance its refreshing qualities.

  • Cocktails: An excellent base for innovative cocktails, adding depth and complexity.

  • Desserts: Pairs wonderfully with desserts, especially those featuring chocolate or coffee elements.

Additional Notes

With an alcohol content of 20%, Meukow Xpresso offers a balanced profile that appeals to both Cognac enthusiasts and coffee lovers. The iconic Meukow panther emblem adorns the bottle, symbolizing the strength and elegance of this unique liqueur.

This liqueur is a testament to Meukow's innovative spirit, offering a contemporary twist on traditional Cognac by infusing it with the rich flavors of espresso. Whether enjoyed on its own or as part of a creative cocktail, Meukow Xpresso provides a memorable and indulgent experience.

title: Meukow Vanilla Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Meukow Vanilla Liqueur is a luxurious blend of Meukow Cognac and natural vanilla flavors. This unique fusion offers a harmonious balance between the richness of cognac and the silky, aromatic essence of vanilla, creating an indulgent and versatile liqueur.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: Floral and spicy aromas with hints of narcissus, licorice, and vanilla.
  • Palate: A fruity core with prominent vanilla, dried and candied fruits, complemented by sweet notes of caramel, almond, and cinnamon.
  • Finish: Smooth and lingering, highlighting the perfect integration of vanilla and cognac.

Serving Suggestions

Meukow Vanilla Liqueur can be enjoyed in various ways:

  • Neat: Savor its complexity and richness straight.
  • On the Rocks: Enjoy over ice to enhance its refreshing and smooth qualities.
  • Cocktails: Use as a base or an accent in cocktails to add depth and aromatic sweetness.

Accolades

  • Superior Taste Award: 2 stars by the International Taste & Quality Institute in Brussels.
  • Gold Medal: 94 points ("Exceptional") by the Beverage Testing Institute of Chicago.
  • Brand of the Year: Recognized by Drinks International Magazine for its innovation and excellence.

Additional Notes

The House of Meukow, established in 1862, is known for its iconic panther emblem, symbolizing strength, elegance, and sophistication. Meukow Vanilla Liqueur reflects the brand's commitment to quality and tradition, offering a product that appeals to both seasoned cognac enthusiasts and those exploring innovative liqueurs.

title: Meukow XO Cognac
bodyHtml:
Meukow XO Cognac is an expression from the House of Meukow, established in 1862 by brothers Auguste-Christophe and Gustav Meukow. Renowned for its exceptional quality, this XO (Extra Old) cognac is crafted from a meticulous selection of eaux-de-vie sourced from various crus, each aged for a minimum of ten years, surpassing the standard six-year requirement for XO classifications.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Deep amber with mahogany highlights.

  • Nose: A complex bouquet featuring candied orange, dried fruits, and floral notes, complemented by hints of hazelnut and almond.

  • Palate: A harmonious blend of leather and licorice flavors, leading to an intense finish with nuances of coffee and vanilla.

The remarkable roundness of Meukow XO is attributed to the careful selection of eaux-de-vie and the extended aging process, resulting in a cognac that is both powerful and elegant.

Serving Suggestions

Meukow XO Cognac is versatile in its enjoyment. It can be savored neat as a digestif, over ice, or as a component in sophisticated cocktails. Its rich and delicate aromas, combined with mellow tannins, make it suitable for various occasions.

title: Meukow VSOP 'Red Edition' Cognac
bodyHtml:
Meukow VSOP Red Edition Cognac is a distinguished expression from the House of Meukow, established in 1862 by brothers Auguste-Christophe and Gustav Meukow. This limited edition cognac is renowned for its exceptional quality and distinctive presentation, featuring the iconic panther emblem on a striking red bottle.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Clear amber-yellow with golden tints.

  • Nose: A fruity and floral bouquet with notes of candied orange, apple, plum, and rose.

  • Palate: Powerful flavors of leather and licorice, leading to an intense finish with hints of coffee and vanilla.

The remarkable roundness of Meukow VSOP Red Edition is attributed to the meticulous selection of eaux-de-vie and an aging process that exceeds the traditional requirements for VSOP cognacs.

Serving Suggestions

This versatile cognac can be enjoyed neat as a digestif, over ice, or as a component in sophisticated cocktails. Its rich and delicate aromas, combined with mellow tannins, make it suitable for various occasions.

Additional Notes

The House of Meukow is known for its distinctive panther emblem, symbolizing the strength, elegance, and suppleness of their cognacs. The Meukow VSOP Red Edition is a testament to the brand's dedication to quality and tradition, offering a harmonious blend of flavors that appeal to both connoisseurs and newcomers alike.

title: Meukow VS Cognac
bodyHtml:
Meukow VS Cognac is a refined and approachable expression from the House of Meukow, established in 1862 by Auguste-Christophe and Gustav Meukow. Renowned for its dedication to quality and innovation, Meukow crafts its VS (Very Special) Cognac from meticulously selected eaux-de-vie sourced from all six Cognac regions, aged for a minimum of two years, as required for the VS classification.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Clear amber with golden hues.
  • Nose: Aromas of caramel, dried apricots, vanilla, and warm spices like allspice and nutmeg.
  • Palate: Smooth and medium-bodied, featuring flavors of orange peel, caramel, honey, and subtle oak. The finish is well-rounded, with lingering notes of licorice and nutmeg.

Serving Suggestions

Meukow VS Cognac is versatile and can be enjoyed in various ways:

  • Neat: Perfect as a classic digestif to savor its complexity.
  • On the Rocks: Enhances its smooth texture and reveals additional layers of flavor.
  • Cocktails: An excellent base for sophisticated drinks, adding depth and richness to mixed creations.

Additional Notes

The iconic panther emblem on the bottle symbolizes the strength, elegance, and suppleness of Meukow Cognacs. Meukow VS is an ideal choice for those new to Cognac as well as seasoned enthusiasts, offering a perfect harmony of flavors and versatility for any occasion.

title: Tatenokawa Seiryu Junmai Daiginjo - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Tatenokawa Shuzo, a brewery founded in 1832 that became the first in Yamagata to produce only Junmai Daiginjo grade sake. The name "Seiryu" translates to "Clear Stream," a tribute to the pristine water of the Mogami River and the refreshing, transparent nature of this specific brew. It is crafted using local Dewasansan rice, a variety developed specifically for the Yamagata climate.

Description

This sake is exceptionally light and smooth, designed to be an easy-drinking introduction to the world of premium Daiginjo. The nose is gentle and fruity, featuring scents of fresh blackcurrant, green apple, and white flowers. On the palate, it is light-bodied and crisp, offering a subtle sweetness balanced by a soft acidity and a clean, refreshing finish. By polishing the rice to 50%, the brewery ensures a refined profile that remains approachable for daily enjoyment. ABV 15%.

Food Pairing

Because of its "Clear Stream" character, this sake is a fantastic companion for lighter seasonal dishes. It pairs beautifully with white fish sashimi, cold tofu with ginger, and lightly dressed spring salads. Its clean finish also makes it a great match for delicate steamed appetizers like dim sum or shrimp dumplings. It is best served well-chilled in a wine glass to fully appreciate its delicate aromatics and crisp structure.

title: Tenzan Shichida Junmai Muroka Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Tenzan Shichida Junmai Muroka Sake is a Japanese sake produced by Tenzan Sake Brewery, located in the Saga Prefecture on Kyushu Island. Established in 1875, the brewery is renowned for its dedication to traditional brewing methods and the utilization of high-quality local ingredients. The term "Junmai" indicates that the sake is made purely from rice, water, yeast, and koji, without any added alcohol or sugars, while "Muroka" signifies that the sake is unfiltered, preserving its natural flavors and characteristics.

Sake Description

This sake is brewed using locally sourced Saga rice, polished to a specific ratio to achieve the desired flavor profile. The unfiltered nature of "Muroka" imparts a rich and robust character to the sake. On the nose, it offers inviting aromas of ripe fruits such as melon and pear, complemented by subtle earthy undertones. The palate is well-balanced, showcasing a harmonious blend of umami and sweetness, with flavors of steamed rice, nuts, and a hint of spice. The finish is smooth and lingering, leaving a pleasant aftertaste that invites another sip.

Food Pairing

Tenzan Shichida Junmai Muroka Sake's complexity and depth make it a versatile companion to various cuisines. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled seafood, roasted meats, and dishes featuring rich umami flavors. Additionally, it complements aged cheeses and savory appetizers, enhancing the overall dining experience.

title: La Braccesca Vino Nobile Di Montepulciano 2018
bodyHtml:
La Braccesca Vino Nobile di Montepulciano 2018 is a refined red wine from Tuscany, Italy, crafted by the Antinori family's La Braccesca estate. This wine showcases the rich heritage and winemaking excellence of Montepulciano, a region celebrated for its elegant and structured wines.

Wine Description

The 2018 vintage is primarily composed of Sangiovese (locally known as Prugnolo Gentile), with a small percentage of Merlot. It displays a bright ruby red color in the glass. On the nose, it reveals fruity notes of raspberries and plums, complemented by sweet aromas of vanilla. On the palate, the wine is well-balanced, with soft, ripe tannins and a smooth, lengthy finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile red wine pairs beautifully with dishes such as spicy sausage casserole, meaty lasagne, and roasted leg of lamb. Its balanced acidity and structured tannins also make it an excellent match for hearty Italian dishes and aged cheeses.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast: 90 points – Noted for its aromas of ripe dark-skinned berry and camphor, with a plush palate offering black cherry, blackberry, and dark spice alongside smooth tannins.
  • Natalie MacLean: 91 points – Described as a smoky Sangiovese-based red with spiced plum, dark cherry, blackberry, and toasty oak notes on its medium-bodied frame.

title: Dolly Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Just like Dolly herself, this Chardonnay is bold, charming, and full of character! Crafted in the heart of California wine country, Dolly Parton Chardonnay 2023 is a celebration of sunshine, music, and a whole lot of heart. This wine takes you straight to a front porch on a warm summer evening, where every sip is like a sweet Southern serenade.

Wine Description
This Chardonnay glows with a golden straw hue, as vibrant as a Tennessee sunrise. The nose opens with lively aromas of ripe peaches, baked apples, and a touch of vanilla, followed by hints of toasted almonds and citrus blossoms. On the palate, it’s as smooth as Dolly’s harmonies, with flavors of creamy pineapple, butterscotch, and a dash of lemon zest. Medium-bodied with a luxurious texture, it finishes with just the right amount of zing to keep you coming back for another encore.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with fried chicken, buttery cornbread, or a classic mac and cheese for the ultimate comfort combo. For a lighter flair, try it with a crisp Caesar salad or grilled salmon. Together, they create a match as perfect as Dolly and a rhinestone-studded microphone!

Vintage Quality
The 2023 vintage brought plenty of sunshine and just enough cool evenings to create a Chardonnay that’s as balanced as it is delightful. This wine is crafted with a playful nod to Southern hospitality, bringing people together for good times and great memories.

Additional Notes
Accolades: "Wine Enthusiast - 92 points."
Perfect for front porch sipping, backyard BBQs, or adding a touch of sparkle to your next gathering.

title: Faust Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml:
Faust Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a distinguished red wine from Napa Valley, California. Produced by Faust Wines, this vintage exemplifies the rich winemaking heritage of the region, offering a modern expression of Napa Valley's renowned Cabernet Sauvignon.

Wine Description

This 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep ruby hue in the glass. On the nose, it exudes inviting aromas of ripe blackcurrants and blackberries, complemented by notes of crushed walnuts, cedar, and a hint of earthiness. The palate is full-bodied and creamy, with firm, polished tannins providing structure. Flavors of dark fruit are balanced by subtle oak influences, leading to a balanced and lingering finish.

Food Pairing

The robust profile of Faust Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 makes it an excellent companion to hearty dishes such as grilled lamb chops, Asian chicken salad, and pork tenderloin. Its balanced acidity and tannin structure also complement rich, savory flavors, enhancing the dining experience.

Accolades

This vintage has garnered significant acclaim from wine critics:

  • James Suckling: 95 points – Praised for its inviting aromas, creamy structure, and balanced, lingering finish.

  • Wine Spectator: 94 points – Ranked #4 in the Top 100 Wines of 2024, highlighting its classic aromas and flavors, with delicate violet notes lifting the dark fruit on the nose.

  • Wine Enthusiast: 93 points – Recognized for its depth and complexity, showcasing the quality of Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon.

Additional Notes

The 2021 growing season in Napa Valley was marked by favorable conditions, allowing for optimal ripening of the Cabernet Sauvignon grapes. Faust's commitment to sustainable viticulture and meticulous winemaking practices is evident in this vintage, resulting in a wine that is both expressive and refined. With its harmonious balance and aging potential, Faust Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a noteworthy addition to any wine collection.

title: Kanaya Takasago Plum Gold Leaf - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Junmai grade sake is carefully infused with locally sourced Kaga ume plums for an entire year, followed by the addition of elegant gold flakes, famous for their production in Kanazawa. This stunning plum sake beautifully balances the sweetness and tartness of the ume plums, while the touch of brandy enhances its aroma and adds depth to the overall flavor profile. The incorporation of gold leaf not only elevates the visual appeal but also signifies luxury and craftsmanship, making this sake a truly unique experience.

Food Pairing
This umeshu pairs beautifully with light desserts such as mochi, fruit tarts, or panna cotta. It also complements savory dishes like teriyaki-glazed salmon or agedashi tofu, offering a balance of sweetness and acidity. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Sugar Rush by Wakatsuru - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Sugar Rush is a unique creation by Wakatsuru Shuzo, a historic distillery established in 1918 in Toyama Prefecture, Japan. Known for its artisanal approach, Wakatsuru has developed this intriguing and playful expression to appeal to modern tastes while showcasing its expertise in crafting distinctive beverages.

Product Description

Sugar Rush is a spirit that balances sweetness and complexity. It offers a vibrant, playful profile with a touch of richness, crafted to delight both seasoned enthusiasts and those exploring new styles of Japanese spirits. It embodies Wakatsuru’s tradition of innovation and craftsmanship.

Tasting Notes

  • Aroma: Fresh and enticing notes of caramelized sugar, light vanilla, and subtle hints of tropical fruit.
  • Palate: Smooth and rich with a pronounced sweetness that is well-balanced by light spice and citrus undertones.
  • Finish: Clean and refreshing with a lingering sweetness and a whisper of toasted flavors.

Serving Suggestions

  • Neat: Best enjoyed as a sipping drink to fully appreciate its sweetness and complexity.
  • On the Rocks: Serving it chilled enhances its refreshing qualities while slightly muting the sweetness.
  • Cocktails: Use it as a base for creative, dessert-inspired cocktails.

Food Pairing

  • Desserts: Pairs beautifully with creamy desserts like panna cotta or crème brûlée.
  • Savory: Complements sweet-salty combinations such as prosciutto-wrapped melon or teriyaki-glazed dishes.

title: Dillon's Peach Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Dillon’s Small Batch Distillers, located in the heart of Ontario’s Niagara region, is renowned for its dedication to crafting spirits that reflect the local terroir. By utilizing fresh, locally sourced ingredients, Dillon’s creates authentic and high-quality liqueurs. Their Peach Liqueur captures the essence of Niagara’s famed peaches, offering a true taste of the region.

Liqueur Description
Dillon's Peach Liqueur presents a clear, golden hue, indicative of its pure fruit origins. The nose is greeted with the fragrant aroma of ripe Niagara peaches, complemented by subtle notes of honey and floral undertones. On the palate, it delivers a luscious and smooth experience, showcasing the natural sweetness and juiciness of fresh peaches, balanced by a gentle warmth from the 100% Canadian rye base. The finish is clean and refreshing, leaving a lingering taste of sun-kissed fruit.

Food Pairing
This versatile liqueur pairs beautifully with light desserts such as vanilla panna cotta, peach cobbler, or almond biscotti. It also enhances cheese platters featuring soft cheeses like Brie or Camembert. In cocktails, it adds a delightful peach note to classics like Bellinis or can be simply enjoyed over ice. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

Additional Notes
Accolades: "Canadian Artisan Spirit Competition - Gold Medal Winner."

title: Zuccardi Q Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Argentina, Zuccardi Q Cabernet Sauvignon is sourced from select high-altitude vineyard lots in the Gualtallary and La Consulta subregions of the Uco Valley. The Zuccardi family, now led by third-generation winemaker Sebastián Zuccardi, is renowned for a contemplative winemaking philosophy that prioritizes the expression of unique mountain terroirs. Their commitment to innovation and understanding the local soil has established the winery as a global benchmark for Argentine excellence.

Wine Description

This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon displays an intense purple colour with deep red hues. On the nose, it offers a complex aromatic profile featuring ripe red and black fruits, specifically blueberries and cassis, layered with freshly chopped herbs, violets, and subtle spicy notes. The palate is medium to full bodied, characterised by firm, fine-grained tannins and excellent balance. Its structure is defined by a refreshing acidity and a long, velvety finish that reveals hints of iodine and dark fruit.

Food Pairing

The wine’s bold tannins and rich fruit profile make it an ideal partner for grilled steak seasoned with sea salt or roasted lamb with aromatic herbs. It also pairs exceptionally well with hearty pasta dishes, such as rigatoni with black truffles, where the wine's acidity cuts through the richness of the sauce.

title: Wiser's Special Blend
bodyHtml:
Special Blend is a smooth, mellow Canadian whisky that reveals a deep gold colour and suggests hints of spice, vanilla and oak. Its subtle sweetness delivers a full finish that is clean and compact.

This versatile spirit can be enjoyed any number of ways – it tastes great simply on the rocks or mixed with your favourite soda.

title: Aizu Homare Nigori - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Japan’s Fukushima Prefecture, Homare Brewery has been crafting fine sake since 1918. Known for its dedication to traditional brewing methods, the brewery embraces local ingredients and techniques to produce exceptional quality. The brewery’s name, "Homare," symbolizes honor and pride, reflecting their commitment to excellence.

Sake Description:
This nigori sake boasts a cloudy, milky appearance due to its coarse filtration, characteristic of the style. The aroma reveals notes of sweet rice, coconut, and a touch of vanilla. On the palate, it is rich and creamy with flavors of ripe banana, melon, and a hint of almond, complemented by a slightly sweet finish. The full-bodied texture and silky smoothness create a harmonious balance, offering a delightful experience.

Food Pairing:
Pair this sake with spicy Asian dishes, creamy desserts like panna cotta, or savory items such as grilled eel or yakitori. Together, these combinations enhance the sake’s sweetness and rich texture, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Dillon's Orange Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Dillon’s Small Batch Distillers, located in the heart of Ontario’s Niagara region, is renowned for its handcrafted spirits made with locally sourced ingredients. Combining a passion for distilling with modern techniques, Dillon’s has earned a reputation for creating premium-quality liqueurs. Their Orange Liqueur is a vibrant and versatile spirit, crafted to elevate cocktails and stand out on its own.

Liqueur Description
Dillon's Orange Liqueur boasts a radiant amber-gold hue. On the nose, it exudes enticing aromas of fresh orange zest, candied citrus, and a touch of warm vanilla. The palate is rich and smooth, offering layers of sweet orange, marmalade, and a hint of spice, perfectly balanced by a touch of acidity. The finish is clean and citrusy, leaving a lingering warmth that showcases its artisanal craftsmanship.

Accolades: "Canadian Artisan Spirits Competition - Gold Medal Winner."

Food Pairing
This orange liqueur shines when paired with chocolate desserts, like dark chocolate truffles or orange-infused tarts. It also complements cheese platters featuring creamy Brie or aged Gouda. As a versatile addition to cocktails, it enhances classics like Margaritas and Sidecars, highlighting the liqueur’s bright citrus character.

title: Takara Sake Sho Chiku Bai Yuki Nigori Lychee - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Takara Sake USA Inc., established in 1983 in Berkeley, California, is renowned for producing a diverse range of traditional and flavored sakes. Among their offerings is the YUKI Nigori Lychee, a 375 ml bottle that combines the rich heritage of Japanese sake brewing with the exotic essence of lychee fruit.

Sake Description

YUKI Nigori Lychee is an unfiltered sake, known as 'nigori,' which gives it a characteristically cloudy appearance and a creamy texture. The infusion of lychee imparts a bright tropical aroma, harmonizing with the mellow and fruity profile of the nigori sake. This results in a well-balanced sweetness and a pleasant finish, making it a delightful choice for those who appreciate flavored sakes.

Food Pairing

This lychee-flavored nigori sake pairs excellently with spicy-sweet foods, such as Thai dishes or barbecue. For dessert, it complements white cake or can be enjoyed on its own as a sweet treat. Its versatility also allows it to be a component in tiki cocktails, adding a unique twist to classic recipes.

Additional Notes

With an alcohol by volume (ABV) of 10%, YUKI Nigori Lychee is best served chilled to enhance its refreshing and fruity characteristics. The 375 ml bottle size makes it convenient for sharing or for those new to flavored sakes looking to explore different taste profiles.

title: Wiser's 10 Year Old
bodyHtml: This award-winning blend of corn and rye is triple barrel aged 10 years in new white oak, American bourbon and used Canadian whisky barrels. The complex flavours of caramel, honey, vanilla, dried fruit and spices are balanced by subtle notes of green apple and pear. Smooth with a pleasant finish. Sip neat or on the rocks.

title: Rivetto Nebbiolo D'Alba Amphora 2022
bodyHtml:
Rivetto's Nebbiolo d'Alba Vigna Lirano Amphora 2022 is a red wine from the Piedmont region of Italy. Produced by Enrico Rivetto, the first certified biodynamic winemaker in the Barolo area, this wine exemplifies a commitment to natural and sustainable viticulture. The Nebbiolo grapes are cultivated on the Lirano hill, situated at an altitude of 400 meters with western exposure, on calcareous clay soils near the border of the Barolo zone.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo wine is crafted using spontaneous fermentation with indigenous yeasts in terracotta amphorae, a method that preserves the purity of the grape's expression. The wine undergoes extended maceration in these neutral vessels, allowing for a natural micro-oxygenation that softens tannins and enhances complexity.

In the glass, it presents a luminous ruby hue. The nose is vibrant, offering aromas of ripe red berries, violets, and subtle earthy undertones. On the palate, it is harmonious, with fresh acidity and fine-grained tannins supporting flavors of cherry, raspberry, and a hint of spice. The finish is elegant and persistent, reflecting the wine's balanced structure.

Food Pairing

This Nebbiolo pairs well with a variety of dishes, including roasted meats, game, and aged cheeses. Its fresh acidity and refined tannins complement rich flavors, making it a versatile choice for hearty Italian cuisine.

Additional Notes

The use of amphorae in winemaking is a nod to ancient practices, allowing for a pure and unadulterated expression of the Nebbiolo grape. Rivetto's dedication to biodynamic principles and minimal intervention results in a wine that authentically reflects its terroir and vintage.

title: Kloud Original Gravity Beer 500 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml: Kloud Original Gravity is one of the most demanding premium Korean beers offered by Lotte. The beer has a clear, bright pale golden yellow color, and it tastes pale malt with a sweet touch of corn.

title: Mikado Ginjo - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by the historic Matsuoka Brewery (established in 1851), Mikado Ginjo is a centerpiece of a brewery renowned for its unique hard-water brewing process. While most premium sakes utilize soft water, Matsuoka uses mineral-rich spring water filtered through the limestone of the Chichibu Mountains, giving their spirits a distinctive "sharpness and roundness". The name Mikado (Emperor) was chosen to represent the brewery's pursuit of the highest quality in sake production.

Description

This premium Ginjo is clear and refined, characterized by a smooth texture and a crisp, refreshing profile. The nose is well-balanced and moderately elegant, offering a classic ginjo bouquet of pear, green apple, and citrus, with subtle notes of lemongrass. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied with a rich flavor that avoids being overly heavy. It features a slightly dry crispness and a mellow depth that has been evolved over the brand's 30-year history. It is crafted from high-quality sake rice polished to 60%, a ratio that removes fats and proteins to ensure a clear taste free of distractions. ABV 15%–16%.

Food Pairing

The "mild and rich" nature of Mikado Ginjo makes it an exceptionally versatile companion for a variety of cuisines. It is a natural match for vegetable dishes, salted yakitori, and fresh oyster dishes. Its slightly dry finish also allows it to cut through the richness of fried foods or lightly spiced Western dishes. In Japan, it is often served at izakayas alongside simple salted appetizers. For the best experience, it is recommended to be served lightly chilled or at room temperature to allow its delicate fruit aromas to shine.

title: Our Story Sparkling
bodyHtml:
Celebrate life’s memorable moments with Our Story Sparkling. This enchanting sparkling wine is crafted to embody joy, connection, and the beauty of shared experiences. With its delicate bubbles and refreshing flavor, it’s perfect for any occasion, from casual gatherings to special celebrations.

Blend: Riesling, Gewurztrainer, Muscat, Chardonnay and Gamay Noir.

title: Taiheizan Honjozo Nigori Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Taiheizan Honjozo Nigori Sake is produced by Kodama Brewing Co. Ltd., located in Akita Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1879, the brewery is known for its dedication to traditional sake brewing methods, producing both sake and soy sauce.

Sake Description

This nigori sake has a creamy yet drier mouth-feel with aromas of rice, banana, and nuts. The palate reveals subtle sweetness and cloudiness, balanced by a crisp, dry finish, making it distinct compared to other nigori sakes.

Food Pairing

Taiheizan Honjozo Nigori Sake pairs well with BBQ, sukiyaki, or sashimi, enhancing the dining experience with its balanced and versatile profile.

Additional Notes

This sake is available in a 300 ml bottle, making it suitable for individual enjoyment or as part of a tasting selection. It is best served chilled to fully appreciate its nuanced flavours and textures.

title: Sumarroca Brut Reserva 2023
bodyHtml:
Sumarroca Brut Reserva is a Cava produced by Bodegues Sumarroca, a family-owned winery situated in the Penedès region of Catalonia, Spain. The estate is renowned for its commitment to sustainable and organic farming practices, cultivating a variety of grapes across diverse microclimates influenced by the Mediterranean Sea and the Montserrat mountains.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine is crafted from a blend of traditional Cava grape varieties: Xarel·lo, Macabeo, and Parellada, with a minimal addition of Chardonnay (less than 7%). Each grape variety undergoes primary fermentation separately in stainless steel tanks. The wine is then blended and bottled with a small dosage for a second fermentation, followed by a minimum aging period of 24 months on the lees.

In the glass, Sumarroca Brut Reserva displays a bright straw-yellow color with fine, persistent bubbles. The nose reveals fresh aromas of citrus fruits and apples, complemented by subtle notes of pastry from its extended aging. On the palate, it is crisp and refreshing, with a well-integrated acidity and a pleasant, fruity finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile Cava pairs excellently with a variety of dishes, including shellfish, appetizers, lean fish, and cured meats. Its bright acidity and fine bubbles make it an ideal aperitif and a delightful companion to many cuisines.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Toro Melt Pineapple Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Nakano Kunizakari Toro Melt Pineapple is a fruit-infused sake produced by Nakano Sake Brewery Co. Ltd., located in Aichi, Japan. Established in 1844, Nakano Sake Brewery seamlessly blends traditional craftsmanship with modern technology to create high-quality sake and fruit liqueurs.

Wine Description

This unique beverage presents a luscious, velvety texture with rich, ripe pineapple flavours. The palate is complemented by notes of lychee, pear, and caramel, offering a smooth and indulgent experience. With an alcohol content of 7.5%, it is best enjoyed chilled or incorporated into creative cocktails.

Food Pairing

Nakano Kunizakari Toro Melt Pineapple pairs well with spicy dishes, grilled seafood, or light desserts, enhancing the dining experience with its sweet and fruity profile. This pairing highlights the beverage’s depth and character.

Additional Notes

Nakano Sake Brewery is recognized for its dedication to quality and innovation. The Toro Melt Pineapple is a testament to their expertise, combining traditional sake-making techniques with vibrant fruit flavours to create a truly delightful and versatile drink.

title: Hoyne Hoyner Pilsener 650 ml  - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Hoyne Brewing Company, located in the heart of Victoria, British Columbia, is renowned for its dedication to quality and craftsmanship. Founded by Sean Hoyne, a master brewer with over two decades of experience, the brewery specializes in creating small-batch beers that showcase both tradition and innovation. The Hoyne Pilsner is a testament to this philosophy, inspired by classic European styles yet brewed with the spirit of the Pacific Northwest.

Beer Description
Hoyne Pilsner pours a brilliant straw-golden color with a creamy white head. The aroma is crisp and inviting, with notes of freshly baked bread, floral hops, and a hint of citrus. On the palate, it delivers a smooth, medium-bodied experience with flavors of malt sweetness, balanced by a clean, refreshing hop bitterness. The finish is dry and satisfying, making it a versatile beer for any occasion.

Food Pairing
This pilsner pairs wonderfully with grilled chicken, fish and chips, or soft cheeses like Brie. It also complements lighter fare such as garden salads and fresh shellfish, enhancing the beer’s crisp and refreshing character. Together, they create a harmonious and memorable pairing.

title: Echigo Red Ale 330 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Echigo Red Ale is a flavorful and well-crafted Japanese craft beer that captures the essence of balanced brewing. Brewed by Echigo Beer Co., it offers a rich and malty profile with hints of caramel and a touch of hop bitterness. With its medium body and smooth finish, Echigo Red Ale creates a satisfying and enjoyable palate.

This beer reflects the artistry of blending traditional and modern brewing techniques, making it a delightful choice for those seeking a flavorful and versatile beer experience, perfect for pairing with a range of dishes or savoring on its own.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Saika Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Nakano Kunizakari Saika Daiginjo originates from Handa City in the Aichi Prefecture of Japan. The Nakano Sake Brewery was established in 1844 and has been managed by the Nakano family for over 180 years. Currently led by President Masami Nakano, the brewery is known for its philosophy of 'creating a rich food culture through Japanese sake' and its ability to blend Edo-period traditions with cutting-edge brewing technology.

Description

This Daiginjo is clear in appearance and is brewed using 'Ginpu' rice from Hokkaido, which is polished down to 50%. The aromatic profile is elegantly dry, featuring a bouquet of wild grape, white lily, and field flowers. On the palate, it offers a silky and smooth texture with notes of lychee, green apple, melon, and hints of honey and guava. It is characterized by a refined body, nice acidity, and a crisp, lingering finish. The alcohol content is 15% to 15.5%.

Food Pairing

The elegant fruit notes and dry profile of Saika Daiginjo make it an ideal companion for delicate seafood and light Western fare. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled prawns, scallops in cream, and fatty tuna sashimi or nigiri. Its balanced acidity also complements chicken yakisoba, vegetable tempura, and fresh fruit salads. For a Western-style match, consider serving it alongside mild cheeses or a zesty melon and cucumber salad to highlight its floral top notes.

title: Gorgo Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2020
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1973 by Roberto Bricolo, Gorgo is now led by his daughter Roberta, who transitioned the estate to certified organic farming in 2014. The winery is celebrated for its commitment to traditional local methods and a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes freshness, directness, and a distinct mineral character.

Wine Description

This full bodied and powerful Amarone presents a deep ruby red colour with violet highlights that transition toward garnet as it ages. The complex bouquet offers an inviting array of plums, blackberries, and ripe dried red fruits, underscored by toasted almonds, spicy hints, and nuances of licorice. On the palate, the wine is rounded and rich, featuring a velvety texture and an elegant balance between its structured alcohol content and refreshing acidity. Composed primarily of Corvina Veronese, Corvinone, and Rondinella, this wine demonstrates superb complexity and a long, persistent finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 93 points

  • Wine Spectator - 91 points

  • James Suckling - 92 points

Food Pairing

  • Slow cooked dishes such as braised meats, beef daube, or hearty stews.

  • Traditional Italian mushroom risotto or pappardelle with truffles.

  • Aged cheeses like Parmigiano Reggiano or Pecorino to enhance the wine's aromatic qualities.

title: Miyasaka Shuzo Masumi Shiro Junmai Ginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml: Shiro is Masumi's 'session sake.' It has the fruitiness and delicacy of a good junmai ginjo yet is soft and light enough to enjoy every day. Mild aromas of banana and apple lead into a palate that is gently sweet and brightened by acidity and lingering savoury umami. Pairing suggestions of fresh greens, salads with citrus accents, grilled shrimp & chicken, dairy and cheese dishes.

title: Tissot Chardonnay 'Patchwork' 2022
bodyHtml: Patchwork is an inviting white wine with expression of stone fruits and honey enhanced by lovely spices in the background. Crunchy, yet rich attack followed by a lovely minerality and fruits notes over a long finish.

title: Il Poggione Rosso Di Montalcino 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Rosso di Montalcino is a very important wine for Tenuta Il Poggione. Produced entirely from Sangiovese grapes, sourced in the estate's younger vineyards, Rosso di Montalcino is aged in large casks and barriques before a period of bottle aging. 

Intense ruby red colour. Fruity bouquet with red berry notes. Very well structured, yet soft, long-lasting flavour with smooth, velvety tannins.

title: Josh Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve Bourbon Barrel Aged 2022
bodyHtml:
This rustic and robust Bourbon Barrel Aged Cabernet Sauvignon takes the award-winning Josh Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon and ages it for two months in charred Bourbon barrels to create a richer, more complex wine. For wine enthusiasts looking for a more robust, bolder red wine, our bourbon barrel aged offering is a perfect choice.

Rich and complex on the nose with notes of blackberry, dark chocolate, vanilla, coffee, and sweet burnt toffee. In the glass, bourbon barrel aging imparts vanilla, brown spice, and caramel flavors, which blend harmoniously with ripe plum, cranberry, and hints of barbecued meats.

title: Hitachino Nest Yuzu Lager 350 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Hitachino Nest Yuzu Lager, crafted by the renowned Kiuchi Brewery in Japan, combines the brewery's dedication to traditional brewing techniques with a unique Japanese twist. Infused with yuzu, a fragrant Japanese citrus fruit, this lager offers a refreshing and zesty drinking experience.

Tasting Notes

This lager pours a golden straw color with a fine, frothy head. On the nose, it showcases vibrant aromas of fresh yuzu, lemon zest, and a hint of floral hops. The palate is crisp and light, with bright citrus flavors balanced by subtle malt sweetness and a gentle bitterness. The finish is clean and refreshing, with a lingering touch of yuzu zest.

Serving Suggestions

Best enjoyed chilled at 4–6°C in a tall glass to emphasize its crispness and citrusy aromas. Pair it with light and flavorful dishes such as sushi, grilled fish, or citrus-marinated chicken. It also complements Asian-inspired salads and mildly spiced dishes, enhancing their vibrant flavors.

title: E. Guigal Cotes du Rhone Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
E. Guigal, one of the most esteemed producers in the Rhône Valley, is renowned for crafting exceptional wines that showcase the diversity and richness of the region. The Côtes du Rhône Blanc 2022 is a testament to their dedication to quality and tradition, blending Rhône varietals to produce a white wine of remarkable balance and character.

Wine Description

The 2022 vintage is a brilliant pale gold in color, with an aromatic bouquet of white flowers, peach, and citrus, complemented by subtle notes of honeysuckle and almonds. On the palate, it is fresh and lively, with flavors of ripe pear, green apple, and a touch of tropical fruit, all balanced by a crisp acidity. The wine’s medium body and smooth texture lead to a long, elegant finish with hints of minerality.

Food Pairing

This versatile white pairs beautifully with a range of dishes, including grilled fish, roasted chicken, creamy pastas, or a fresh summer salad. It also complements soft cheeses like Brie or Camembert, highlighting the wine’s bright and refreshing qualities.

title: Domaine des Carlines 'Gaillardon' 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction
From France’s Jura region, in the Côtes du Jura appellation, Domaine des Carlines is based in Ménétru-le-Vignoble within the renowned Château-Chalon area. Founded in 2015 by Patrick and Sophie Ligeron, this family-run estate spans approximately 11 hectares, with 3 hectares in the prestigious Château-Chalon designation. The winery practises sustainable viticulture with a move toward organic certification, focusing on minimal intervention and traditional Jura winemaking.

Wine Description
This white blend of Chardonnay and Savagnin offers a luminous golden hue. On the nose, it reveals delicate floral aromas intertwined with notes of fresh bread dough. The palate is generous yet precise, with ripe orchard fruit framed by a creamy texture and lifted by vibrant acidity. Medium-bodied, it carries through to a firm, lingering finish, marked by both freshness and subtle minerality.

Food Pairing
Its crisp acidity and layered texture make it an excellent match for poultry, mature cheeses such as Comté, and earthy mushroom dishes. It also pairs beautifully with creamy seafood preparations and savoury tarts. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Francis Ford Coppola Sofia Rose 2023
bodyHtml:
Francis Ford Coppola Sofia Rosé is a beautifully crafted wine inspired by the elegance and charm of Sofia Coppola, the winemaker’s daughter. Produced in California’s renowned wine country, this rosé embodies the Coppola family’s dedication to artistry and excellence in winemaking.

Wine Description

Sofia Rosé pours a delicate pink hue with glimmers of salmon. The nose greets you with aromas of fresh strawberries, raspberries, and a hint of rose petals, complemented by subtle citrus undertones. On the palate, it is refreshing and vibrant, showcasing flavors of red berries, watermelon, and a touch of white peach. The wine’s crisp acidity and light, dry finish make it an elegant choice for any occasion.

Food Pairing

This rosé pairs wonderfully with a variety of dishes, including grilled salmon, shrimp tacos, goat cheese salads, or a light charcuterie board. Its bright and fruity profile enhances the flavors of fresh and savory foods, creating a harmonious dining experience.

title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label - Ice Chalet
bodyHtml:
The Johnnie Walker Blue Label Ice Chalet Scotch Whisky is a limited-edition release that combines the artistry of Johnnie Walker Blue Label with a stunning and unique design, inspired by the themes of winter and luxury. This special edition was created to celebrate the exclusivity and refined craftsmanship that Blue Label is known for, while also offering an eye-catching collectible for whisky enthusiasts.

About Johnnie Walker Blue Label

Johnnie Walker Blue Label is the epitome of the Johnnie Walker portfolio, renowned for its exceptional quality and blending expertise. It is crafted from some of Scotland's rarest and most exceptional whiskies, delivering a smooth, complex flavor profile with layers of honey, spices, dried fruit, and subtle smokiness. Each bottle is individually numbered, emphasizing its exclusivity and craftsmanship.

Ice Chalet Edition

The Ice Chalet edition features a frosted, winter-inspired design that evokes the elegance and tranquility of a snow-covered landscape. The bottle and packaging incorporate sleek, frosted glass elements, with motifs and patterns that celebrate the serene beauty of winter. The design perfectly complements the luxurious and smooth profile of Johnnie Walker Blue Label, creating a unique sensory and visual experience.

Appeal and Collectibility

This limited-edition release is aimed at collectors, gift-givers, and connoisseurs who appreciate both the artistry of packaging and the exceptional quality of the whisky. The Ice Chalet edition is ideal for special occasions, particularly during the winter season, and makes a memorable gift or centerpiece for any whisky collection.

Serving Suggestion

To fully appreciate the depth and complexity of Johnnie Walker Blue Label, it is best enjoyed neat or with a splash of chilled water. This enhances the whisky's intricate flavors, including its signature balance of sweetness, spice, and smoke.

title: Hennessy XO - CNY Year of the Horse
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hennessy XO Lunar New Year 2026 is a limited-edition prestige cognac from the country of France, specifically the Cognac region. Released to commemorate the Year of the Horse in the Chinese zodiac, this bottling symbolizes vitality, success, and renewal. For this 2026 edition, Hennessy collaborated with acclaimed contemporary Chinese artist Xu Zhen to design a striking decanter that fuses cultural heritage with modern artistry. The release follows the tradition of Hennessy's annual artistic collaborations for the Lunar New Year, celebrating the House's long-standing bond with China.

Spirit Description

The cognac in the bottle is the classic Hennessy XO (Extra Old) blend, a robust and complex masterpiece originally created in 1870. It is composed of over 100 eaux-de-vie sourced from the premier crus of the region and aged for up to 30 years in young oak barrels.

  • Colour: Deep, luminous amber with rich mahogany reflections.

  • Aroma: The nose reveals an intricate bouquet of candied fruit, cocoa, and warming spices like cinnamon and clove, balanced by whispers of vanilla and oak.

  • Palate: A silky and full-bodied mouthfeel that delivers layers of dark chocolate, prunes, and roasted almonds. Complex notes of leather, nutmeg, and honeyed oak emerge as the spirit develops.

  • Finish: Exceptionally long, elegant, and persistent, leaving a lingering trail of warm spice and sweet dried fruit.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Domaine Rolet Cremant du Jura
bodyHtml:
The current NV Cremant du Jura Blanc Brut is fermented in stainless with no MLF, and spends at least 2 years sur lattes before disgorged (date noted on the case) with 4 g/L. Based on chardonnay (50%), with savagnin, trousseau, poulsard, and pinot noir filling out the rest. This comes off estate vineyards in Arbois, Passenas, and Le Vernnois. 

Crisp green apple, bright lemon, fresh almond is kissed with meringue on the brisk, shining palate finishing with a slick of salinity. Quite lively at present, and a lovely evolution of style for the house.

title: Vajra Barolo 'Albe' 2022
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s Piedmont region, in the famed Barolo DOCG, this wine is crafted by the G.D. Vajra estate. Founded in 1972 by Aldo and Milena Vajra, the winery is family-owned and renowned for its traditional yet innovative approach. With vineyards at some of the highest elevations in Barolo, Vajra produces wines of remarkable elegance, precision, and aromatic purity.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo shows a brilliant garnet colour. On the nose, it opens with delicate aromas of rose petals, violets, red cherry, raspberry, and orange zest, layered with hints of spice, balsamic herbs, and subtle tobacco. The palate is vibrant and energetic, delivering flavours of fresh red fruit, crushed flowers, and savoury undertones. Fine, velvety tannins are balanced by lively acidity, giving the wine a refined structure and long, graceful finish.

Food Pairing

This Barolo pairs beautifully with braised meats, roasted lamb, or hearty pasta dishes in rich tomato or mushroom sauces. It also complements aged cheeses such as Parmigiano Reggiano.

title: Peri Peri 'Malpelo Rosso' 2021
bodyHtml:
This wine represents the harmonious union of three native Sicilian grape varieties: Nerello Mascalese, Frappato, and Perricone, offering a rich and complex tasting experience that expresses the unique characteristics of each variety and the mastery of winemaking that skillfully brought them together.

Malpelo has a beautiful ruby color with violet reflections that denote its youthfulness and vitality. On the nose, delicate notes of fresh red fruits, such as strawberries and cherries, are accompanied by subtle hints of spice. Floral hints of violets and roses also emerge, adding a touch of elegance to the overall aroma of the wine. On the palate, this blend offers a pleasant harmony of flavors. The fruity notes of strawberries, cherries, and raspberries blend with subtle spicy undertones and a slightly herbaceous character. It has a balanced structure with soft tannins and good acidity, providing freshness and liveliness.

title: Chehalem Pinot Gris 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Willamette Valley in Oregon. Founded in 1990 by Harry Peterson Nedry and now under the sole ownership of Bill Stoller, Chehalem is a pioneering estate that achieved B Corp certification in 2018. The winery follows a vineyard first philosophy, focusing on sustainable practices and minimal processing to create wines that express the distinct terroir of its three estate vineyards.

Wine Description

Chehalem Pinot Gris displays a bright, pale straw colour with luminous clarity. The nose is clean and vibrant, offering an aromatic bouquet of fresh pear, white pollen, and lime peel, accented by stone fruit notes of apricot and tropical hints of honeydew melon. On the palate, the wine is juicy and bright with a light mid palate viscosity and a refreshing mineral streak that provides a distinct, 'crunchy' texture. It is characterized by its impeccable balance between ripe fruit character and crisp, energetic acidity, leading to a long and balanced finish with a clear mineral quality. This 100% Pinot Gris is fermented in stainless steel to preserve its aromatic profile and typically has an ABV of 12.5% to 12.9%. While the winery is B Corp certified and follows sustainable LIVE and Salmon Safe standards, this specific wine is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from now through 2030.

title: Chateau Ormes de Pez 2021
bodyHtml:
This red wine comes from France, specifically the Saint Estephe appellation in the northern Médoc region of Bordeaux. The estate has a storied history dating back to the 18th century and was acquired in 1940 by Jean Charles Cazes, whose family also owns the renowned Chateau Lynch Bages. Today, Jean Charles Cazes directs the property, maintaining a winemaking philosophy that balances modern techniques with traditional savoir-faire to produce harmonious wines that authentically express their gravelly terroir.

Wine Description

In the glass, it displays a deep ruby to garnet purple colour. The nose is highly aromatic, offering notes of plum preserves, black cherry, and red currants alongside nuances of graphite, toasted spice, and dried mint. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and structured, with a core of dark berries balanced by a 'piercing iron' mineral note and polished, firm tannins. It is characterized by its vibrancy and poise, finishing with a lingering fragrant earth and saline quality.

title: Carpano Bianco
bodyHtml: Carpano Bianco has a light yellow colour, a fresh and complex aroma and an easily identifiable winey note, in addition to citrussy and exotic fruit flavours. Fresh cocoa beans and almonds complete the bouquet of this delicious vermouth. An initially smooth and velvety palate is rounded off by a complex winey note with mineral tones. Persistent and delightful, this vermouth is perfect for any occasion.

title: Bols Pink Grapefruit Liqueur
bodyHtml: This pink liqueur is brimming with fresh bitter grapefruit notes, supported by a pleasant sweet and sour bite. With the growing popularity of this refreshing fruit, Bols Pink Grapefruit liqueur is an indispensable addition to our celebrated range of citrus liqueurs.

title: Bodegas Piedra Joven Toro 2025
bodyHtml: The intense nose of sour cherries and blueberries is a promising harbinger. This is typical for the region: concentrated fruit in connection with crumbly tannins and a lot of pressure on the palate. Interesting animal note typical of the variety, a bit of caramel, with good length and creaminess.

title: Arioso Vermentino 2023
bodyHtml:
The Toscana Bianco Arioso di Campo alla Sughera is born in vineyards located in the heart of the splendid Bolgheri terroir.

It is produced exclusively with Sauvignon Blanc grapes, harvested and selected entirely by hand. After a soft pressing and a cold decanting of the must, the grapes ferment at controlled temperature. Subsequently the wine ages in stainless steel tanks and for a further period in the bottle before being placed on the market.

Arioso is characterized by a bright straw yellow color with greenish reflections. The nose opens with an intense and fragrant bouquet, with hints of white peach, enriched with pleasant notes of mint and rue. On the palate it has a good structure, with a full body and a refreshing acidity.

Perfect to accompany fish dishes, raw fish and sushi, it is ideal in combination with aperitifs.

title: Cantillon Rose de Gambrinus 750 ml - Single Bottle
bodyHtml: A blend of lambics and raspberries, 200 g of raspberries per litre of beer. Beer with a slightly acidic, fruity and fragrant taste. Just like Kriek, the "fruitiness" of Rosé de Gambrinus is at its best when the beer is young. With age, the lambic will take the upper hand, but this is at the expense of the fruit component. 5.5% ABV.

title: Cantillon Kriek 750 ml - Single Bottle
bodyHtml:
Cantillon is something of a miracle. The Brussels-based brewery helped popularize spontaneously fermented wild beers called lambics, and blended lambics called gueuze. Its beer was once near extinction, but today is among the rarest and most revered liquids in the world. You'll be sipping history if you're lucky enough to lift Cantillon to your lips. 
 
A blend of lambics and sour cherries, 200 g of cherries per litre of beer. A slightly acidic taste of red fruit complemented with subtle almond flavours. Kriek brings out its maximum "fruitiness" when drunk young. With age, the lambic will take the upper hand, but this is at the expense of the fruit component. 5.5% ABV.

title: Cantillon Gueuze 750 ml - Single Bottle
bodyHtml:
Paul Cantillon and Marie Troch founded Cantillon in 1900. In 1937, their sons Robert and Marcel joined the business. Shortly after that, both brothers departed for World War II. After the war, with sales in decline, Robert sold his portion of the business to Marcel. Soon, Marcel wanted out, too. Marcel's daughter, Claude, saved the family business. Her husband, Jean-Pierre Van Roy, took over the brewery in the early 1970s. Their son, Jean Van Roy, is Cantillon's current owner and brewmaster.

Gueuze is the ultimate result of a complex blend of lambics of different ages and with different tastes kept in oak barrels. The brewer's primary task involves tasting, and he or she will have to try around a dozen lambics from different barrels, finally selecting five or six. It is by this method that gueuze 100% lambic, presenting the typical characteristics of Cantillon Brewery's beers, is produced. Each blended batch yields a slightly different gueuze because the natural elements at the heart of the beer make it impossible to produce a standardized product.

A slightly acidic and fruity taste, a delicate and woody fragrance and a dry finish that lingers on the palate. Beer with taste evolution that will keep for a long time in a cellar. 5.5% ABV.

title: Cantillon Grand Cru Bruocsella 750 ml - Single Bottle
bodyHtml: Vintage lambic. All the beers are from the same brewing season and mature in barrels for three years. A beer with a highly complex structure that has a wine-like and somewhat oxidized taste, the slightly acidic structures mingling with more mellow aspects. Robust yet elegant, Bruocsella can be considered the missing link between the worlds of wine and beer. Since there is no secondary fermentation in the bottle, Bruocsella is a flat, non-sparkling beer. 5% ABV.

title: Pierre Meurgey Pernand Vergelesses 2020
bodyHtml:
Pierre Meurgey, a fourth-generation winemaker, continues his family's legacy in Burgundy with this Pernand-Vergelesses 2020. Sourced from the Côte de Beaune sub-region, this wine exemplifies the unique terroir of Pernand-Vergelesses, a village renowned for its Chardonnay and Pinot Noir wines.

Tasting Notes:

  • Appearance: Pale lemon and lime hues.
  • Nose: A powerful bouquet featuring notes of bacon fat, indicative of its maturation process, despite the absence of new oak.
  • Palate: Concentrated crisp white fruit flavors with an unusual weight for a Pernand-Vergelesses, finishing with a hint of licorice.

Food Pairing:
This Chardonnay pairs well with poultry dishes, such as roasted chicken or turkey, and complements creamy sauces and soft cheeses.

Vintage Quality:
The 2020 vintage in Burgundy is considered excellent, producing wines with remarkable balance and aging potential.

Accolades:

  • Jasper Morris, Inside Burgundy: "Quite a powerful bouquet with a little bacon fat... Unusual weight for Pernand-Vergelesses, with a lick of licorice to finish."

title: Rossville Union Master Crafted Straight Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Rossville Union Master Crafted Straight Rye Whiskey is produced by the historic Ross & Squibb Distillery in Lawrenceburg, Indiana, a region renowned for its rich rye whiskey heritage dating back to 1847. This expression is a blend of the distillery's 51% and 95% rye mash bills, aged for at least five years, showcasing their expertise in crafting premium rye whiskey.

Tasting Notes:

  • Nose: Sweet caramel aromas with hints of dried fruit and a subtle smokiness.
  • Palate: A fruit-forward profile complemented by notes of vanilla, toffee, and oak, leading to a slightly smoky undertone.
  • Finish: Robust and spicy with a hint of cherry, culminating in a clean and balanced conclusion.

Serving Suggestions:
This versatile rye whiskey can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as a base for classic cocktails like the Manhattan or Old Fashioned. Its balanced flavor profile also pairs well with grilled meats and aged cheeses.

title: Camille Cayran Cotes Du Rhone L'Insouciante Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Southern Rhone valley of France, this red blend carries the prestigious Cotes du Rhone designation. The wine is crafted by Cave de Cairanne, a historic cooperative founded in 1929 that unites 65 dedicated growers committed to sustainable and often organic viticulture. Their winemaking philosophy emphasizes minimal intervention, utilizing concrete tanks and minimal sulphur to preserve the natural freshness and personality of the fruit.

Wine Description

This organic red displays a brilliant ruby and violet colour with deep garnet nuances. On the nose, it offers an intense profile of blackcurrant, red berries, and cherries, underscored by a distinct spicy framework. The palate is rich and concentrated, featuring powerful notes of plum, fig, and candied fennel seed, balanced by rounded, supple tannins.

title: Taylor Fladgate Very Very Old Port
bodyHtml:
Taylor Fladgate, one of the most prestigious names in Port wine, has unveiled its remarkable Very Very Old Port, a testament to centuries of expertise in crafting fine fortified wines. This exceptional release comprises a blend of rare and meticulously aged Ports, with some components dating back over a century. It celebrates the legacy of Taylor Fladgate as a pioneer of quality and tradition in the Douro Valley.

Tasting Notes

Color: Deep mahogany with golden highlights.
Aroma: Profoundly aromatic, offering layers of dried fruits, walnuts, and molasses, complemented by notes of antique wood, spice, and orange zest.
Palate: Silky and complex, with an extraordinary balance of sweetness and acidity. Flavors of figs, caramel, and toasted almonds unfold, enriched by nuances of cinnamon and coffee.
Finish: Exceptionally long and smooth, leaving a lingering impression of elegance and finesse.

Serving Suggestions

Best served slightly chilled in a small Port glass to fully appreciate its intricate aromas and flavors. Perfect as an after-dinner indulgence, it pairs beautifully with roasted nuts, aged cheeses, or simply enjoyed on its own as a meditative experience.

Significance

Taylor Fladgate Very Very Old Port is not only a celebration of time and craftsmanship but also a collector’s item. Encased in exquisite packaging, it represents a rare opportunity to own and savor a piece of history, embodying the timeless artistry of Port winemaking.

title: Les Dominios De Berceo Reserva '36' 2006
bodyHtml:
he Gonzalo Berceo Rioja Reserva 2006 is a remarkable expression of Spain’s famed Rioja region, crafted by Bodegas Berceo, one of the oldest wineries in the area. Named after Gonzalo de Berceo, a celebrated medieval poet, this wine embodies the artistry and tradition of Rioja winemaking. The 2006 vintage showcases the balance and aging potential that define Reserva-level wines from this region.

Tasting Notes

Color: Deep garnet with a brick-red rim, reflecting its maturity.
Aroma: A bouquet of dried red fruits, cedar, and leather, interwoven with notes of spice, vanilla, and a touch of earthy complexity.
Palate: Silky and refined, with flavors of cherry, plum, and dried fig complemented by hints of tobacco, clove, and oak. The well-integrated tannins and vibrant acidity provide structure and elegance.
Finish: Long and graceful, leaving impressions of spice and subtle oak.

Food Pairing

This Reserva pairs beautifully with grilled lamb, roasted game, or aged Manchego cheese. It also complements dishes with earthy components, such as mushroom risotto or truffle-infused recipes.

Vintage Significance

The 2006 vintage benefited from favorable weather, resulting in wines of excellent balance and complexity. Gonzalo Berceo Reserva 2006 is an elegant representation of Rioja’s ability to produce age-worthy wines that evolve beautifully over time, offering a harmonious blend of tradition and finesse.

title: The Macallan Rare Cask
bodyHtml:
The Macallan Rare Cask is a testament to The Macallan’s unwavering dedication to crafting exceptional single malts. Produced at the iconic distillery in Speyside, Scotland, this whisky is drawn from an extraordinary selection of sherry-seasoned oak casks, chosen for their rarity and character. Each batch is non-age-stated and created to celebrate the brand's mastery of wood and spirit.

Tasting Notes

The Rare Cask dazzles with a deep mahogany hue, reflecting its sherry cask heritage. On the nose, rich aromas of dried fruits, vanilla, and dark chocolate are complemented by subtle spices and a hint of orange zest. The palate unfolds luxuriously, revealing layers of raisins, nutmeg, ginger, and a touch of toffee sweetness. The finish is long, warm, and satisfyingly smooth, with whispers of oak and spice lingering gracefully.

Serving Suggestions

Best enjoyed neat in a tulip-shaped glass to fully experience its complexity and depth. Adding a few drops of water can reveal additional layers of flavor. Pair with dark chocolate, dried figs, or a well-aged cheese for a decadent tasting experience.

title: Alter Ego de Palmer 2021 (by Chateau Palmer)
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
'Alter Ego 2021' is a sophisticated expression from Château Palmer, a revered estate in the Margaux appellation of Bordeaux. Known for its dedication to biodynamic practices and meticulous craftsmanship, this second wine of Château Palmer offers a distinct personality while maintaining the elegance of its flagship label.

Wine Description

The 'Alter Ego 2021' showcases a deep ruby hue with captivating aromas of ripe blackberries, cassis, and a hint of violet. On the palate, the wine reveals layers of dark fruit, fine tannins, and a subtle touch of cedar and spice, characteristic of its oak aging. Medium to full-bodied, it exhibits a silky texture and a lingering, elegant finish with notes of graphite and fresh herbs. The blend typically includes Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Petit Verdot, offering balance and approachability in its youth while promising aging potential.

Food Pairing

Perfectly complementing roasted lamb, duck confit, or aged cheeses, 'Alter Ego 2021' brings out the best in rich, savory dishes. A delightful pairing to enhance the wine’s depth and complexity.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage reflects the challenges of a cooler growing season, resulting in a wine of remarkable precision and freshness. Its refined structure and vibrant acidity make it a standout among contemporary Bordeaux offerings.

title: Gaja Langhe Conteisa Barolo 2020
bodyHtml:
Located in Piedmont in northwestern Italy, the GAJA winery is widely considered to be one of the greatest estates in the world, producing coveted and collectible labels. The Conteisa single vineyard is located in La Morra. It faces south and consists of clay, calcareous marl soils and sand.

Tasting Notes

  • Aroma: Delicate nose, with hints of cherry compote, mint, marzipan, sweet and spicy notes of ginger, and pepper. 
  • Palate: In the mouth it is delicate, ethereal and elegant, with very sweet and spicy tannin, notes of wild mint and a long, lingering finish.

Accolades

  • James Suckling: 98 Points
  • Vinous: 97 Points
  • Wine Enthusiast: 95 Points
  • Wine Spectator: 94 Points

title: Chateau Mongravey Cru Bourgeois 2023
bodyHtml: Intense deep purple robe. Seductive and intense nose of cassis, raspberries, spices, vanilla and unctuous grilled and toasty aromas. Well-structured wine that is at the same time rich and lush in the mouth with smooth tannins and a very long finish.

title: Brendel Noble One Chardonnay 2019
bodyHtml:
Brendel Wines is celebrated for its commitment to crafting wines that honor traditional winemaking practices while embracing innovation. Located in Napa Valley, Brendel focuses on creating approachable and expressive wines with a modern twist.

  • Tasting Notes: This Chardonnay offers a harmonious blend of richness and vibrancy. Aromas of green apple, pear, and citrus zest are complemented by subtle notes of vanilla and toasted almond. The palate is creamy yet fresh, with a lingering finish of minerality and balanced acidity.

  • Serving Suggestions: Serve chilled at 10-12°C (50-54°F). Pairs beautifully with roasted chicken, creamy pasta dishes, and grilled vegetables.

  • Winemaking: Made with a focus on minimal intervention to preserve the true character of the Chardonnay grape, this wine showcases the purity and elegance of Napa Valley fruit.

title: Marques Reserva Especial Rum
bodyHtml:
Ron Marqués Reserva Especial is a distinguished rum produced by Fábrica Nacional de Licores (Fanal) in Costa Rica. With a heritage rooted in the rich traditions of Central American rum-making, Fanal has been crafting quality spirits since its establishment. This Reserva Especial is a testament to their dedication to producing premium rums that reflect the unique terroir and culture of Costa Rica.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Golden yellow.

  • Nose: Delicate aroma with subtle hints of smokiness.

  • Palate: Deliciously smooth with a balanced sweetness, featuring notes of caramel and vanilla, complemented by a gentle smoky flavor.

  • Finish: Soft and mellow, leaving a pleasant lingering taste.

title: Chateau d'Aqueria Tavel Rose 2024
bodyHtml: The intense pink color is characteristic of a great Tavel and shines with bright red glints. Aromas of raspberry and strawberry share the glass with peppery notes. The wine is balanced and flavorful, and the finish is long with caramel notes. It is a gastronomic rosé that pairs with every part of the meal from aperitif through dessert.

title: Glendronach 10 Year Old (Vintage 2013)
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
The GlenDronach 10-Year-Old (Vintage 2013) is a single malt Scotch whisky from the renowned GlenDronach Distillery, located in the Highland region of Scotland. This expression, exclusive to the Canadian market, showcases the distillery's commitment to traditional sherry cask maturation and craftsmanship.

Maturation:

  • Cask Type: Matured exclusively in Pedro Ximénez sherry casks, imparting rich and complex flavors to the whisky.

Tasting Notes:

  • Nose: A harmonious blend of Seville blood oranges and cherries, complemented by notes of harvest-ripe barley, roasted chestnuts, and winter-spiced cocoa.

  • Palate: A vibrant burst of red berry fruit compote and mandarin orange, with lingering currents and Morello cherries, balanced by barley sugar and subtle hints of ginger.

  • Finish: Smooth and warming, with enduring notes of spiced fruit and gentle oak.

Production Details:

  • Distillation Year: 2013

  • Bottling Year: 2023

  • Alcohol by Volume (ABV): 43%

  • Non-Chill Filtered: Preserving the whisky's natural character and depth.

  • Natural Color: Derived entirely from its time in Spanish sherry oak casks.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Neat: Enjoy neat to fully appreciate the intricate flavors and aromas.

  • With Water: A few drops of water can open up additional layers of complexity.

title: Remy Martin VSOP Cognac - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Rémy Martin VSOP is a distinguished Fine Champagne Cognac, representing a harmonious blend of eaux-de-vie sourced exclusively from the Grande Champagne and Petite Champagne crus. This expression embodies the Cellar Master's art of blending, resulting in a cognac renowned for its balance of powerful and elegant aromas.

Tasting Notes:

  • Aroma: An aromatic harmony of powerful elegance with notes of vanilla, dried apricot, and candied pear.

  • Palate: A balance of aromatic dried fruits and delicate liquorice, offering a complex flavor experience.

  • Finish: Structured and layered, with a rounded harmony of dried fruits, providing a satisfying mouthfeel and silky texture.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Neat: Enjoy at room temperature to fully appreciate its aromatic richness and depth.

  • On the Rocks: Serving over ice enhances its smoothness and reveals additional layers of flavor.

  • Cocktails: Versatile in mixology, Rémy Martin VSOP elevates classic cocktails such as the Rémy Ginger, showcasing its elegance and fruity aromas.

title: Remy Martin VSOP Cognac - CNY Year of The Snake
bodyHtml:
Rémy Martin VSOP – Year of the Snake Limited Edition is a special release celebrating the Lunar New Year, specifically the Year of the Snake. This edition features a collaboration with contemporary Chinese artist Huang Yuxing, whose vibrant artwork adorns the packaging, symbolizing renewal and positive energy associated with the zodiac sign.

Tasting Notes

  • Color: A warm and mysterious ochre in the bottle, transforming to a vibrant gold in the glass.
  • Aroma: Dominant notes of vanilla from aging in French oak barrels, followed by dried apricot and candied pear.
  • Palate: A perfect harmony between the strength of dried fruit flavors and subtle notes of licorice, offering a complex flavor experience.
  • Finish: Well-balanced, structured, and multi-layered, combining the roundness of dried fruits with a pleasant mouthfeel and silky texture.

Serving Suggestions

  • Neat: Enjoy at room temperature to fully appreciate its aromatic richness and depth.
  • On the Rocks: Serving over ice enhances its smoothness and reveals additional layers of flavor.
  • Cocktails: Versatile in mixology, Rémy Martin VSOP elevates classic cocktails such as the Rémy Ginger, showcasing its elegance and fruity aromas.

title: Remy Martin 1738 Royal Accord Cognac - (No Canister)
bodyHtml:
Rémy Martin 1738 Accord Royal is a celebrated Cognac that pays tribute to a royal decree issued by King Louis XV in 1738. This decree recognized the exceptional quality of Rémy Martin’s eaux-de-vie and granted the winery the rare privilege to expand its vineyards. Crafted from a blend of eaux-de-vie exclusively sourced from the Grande Champagne and Petite Champagne crus, this Fine Champagne Cognac exemplifies craftsmanship and tradition.

Tasting Notes

  • Aroma: Rich and complex with notes of butterscotch, baked spices, figs, and a hint of dark chocolate.
  • Palate: Smooth and mellow, featuring flavors of caramelized fruit, toasted nuts, and spiced oak.
  • Finish: Long and creamy, with a nutty warmth and subtle hints of cinnamon and vanilla.

Serving Suggestions

  • Neat: Best enjoyed neat to appreciate its aromatic depth and smooth texture.
  • On the Rocks: Chilling it with ice enhances its elegance and balance.
  • Cocktails: A versatile Cognac that adds richness to classic cocktails like the Sidecar or Old Fashioned.

title: Morgenster Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml:
Morgenster Sauvignon Blanc 2022 is a vibrant white wine from the esteemed Morgenster Estate, located in Stellenbosch, South Africa. This wine showcases the region's capability to produce expressive and well-balanced Sauvignon Blancs.

Vineyard and Winemaking Details:

  • Grape Variety: 100% Sauvignon Blanc.

  • Harvesting: Grapes were harvested at optimal ripeness to enhance tropical fruit characteristics.

  • Vinification: After de-stemming and slight crushing, the grapes were immediately pressed. Fermentation occurred in stainless steel tanks at low temperatures to preserve freshness. The wine was bottled shortly after fermentation to maintain its vibrant fruit profile.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Bright, clear appearance.

  • Aroma: Abundant tropical fruit aromas, including pineapple and peach blossoms, complemented by hints of flint and citrus zest.

  • Palate: Harmonious and well-balanced, featuring flavors of green apple, lemon zest, and a subtle minerality. The integrated acidity leads to a lingering, crisp finish.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Serve chilled at 8-10°C (46-50°F).

  • Food Pairings: Ideal with fresh seafood, summer salads, white meats like chicken or turkey, and soft cheeses such as goat's cheese. It also pairs well with dishes seasoned with herbs like parsley, basil, and dill.

Cellaring Potential:

  • Best enjoyed young to appreciate its fresh and vibrant character; suitable for consumption within 2 to 3 years from the vintage date.

title: Poggio Torselli Rosso Toscana 2020
bodyHtml: This wine is crafted under the Toscana IGT (Indicazione Geografica Tipica) classification, allowing for greater flexibility in grape selection and winemaking techniques. The vintage showcases the estate's commitment to quality and the rich winemaking heritage of the region.

title: Poggio Torselli Chianti Classico Riserva 2020
bodyHtml: Poggio Torselli Chianti Classico Riserva 2020 is a distinguished red wine from the renowned Chianti Classico region in Tuscany, Italy. Crafted predominantly from Sangiovese grapes, this Riserva exemplifies the rich winemaking heritage of the area.

title: Patron XO Cafe
bodyHtml:
Patrón XO Cafe is a unique coffee-flavoured liqueur crafted in Jalisco, Mexico, blending ultra-premium Patrón Silver Tequila with the essence of rich, dark coffee. Renowned for its innovation and quality, Patrón has redefined the possibilities of tequila-based liqueurs, creating a product celebrated for both sipping and mixing.

Tasting Notes

  • Color: Deep, dark brown.
  • Nose: Aromas of freshly brewed coffee, roasted nuts, and a hint of agave.
