  • Palate: The flavour profile is bold and robust, showcasing a perfect balance of freshly brewed coffee, light tequila, and a touch of chocolate.
  • Finish: Smooth, dry, and slightly bitter, emphasizing its coffee essence without excessive sweetness.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast: 94 Points – “A balanced and bold liqueur that highlights coffee and tequila harmoniously.”

Optimal Drinking Window

This liqueur is best enjoyed immediately and does not require aging. It remains consistent in quality over time.

Serving Suggestions

Serve Patrón XO Cafe chilled or over ice for a straightforward experience. It is also an excellent addition to cocktails such as espresso martinis or coffee-inspired drinks. Pair it with desserts like tiramisu, dark chocolate, or even coffee cake for a harmonious finish.

title: Leitz 'Zero Point Five' Non-Alcoholic Pinot Noir
bodyHtml:
Leitz's 'Zero Point Five' Non-Alcoholic Pinot Noir is a notable offering from the esteemed Leitz winery, situated in Germany's renowned Rheingau region. With a winemaking heritage spanning over 200 years, Leitz has adeptly combined tradition with innovation, particularly in the realm of non-alcoholic wines.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Pale ruby red.

  • Nose: Aromas of red currants, cherries, and subtle earthy notes characteristic of traditional Pinot Noir.

  • Palate: Juicy red and black cherries, cranberries, and a hint of mushroom earthiness. Subtle tannins contribute to a rich mouthfeel, leading to an almost dry finish.

title: Leitz 'Eins Zwei Zero' (Non Alcoholic) Riesling
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Leitz 'Eins Zwei Zero' Riesling is a non alcoholic white wine originating from the esteemed Rheingau region in Germany. The Leitz family has a storied winemaking heritage dating back to 1744, with current proprietor Johannes Leitz taking over the estate in 1985 and growing it into one of the largest family owned wineries in the region. Johannes began producing dealcoholized wines in 2016, spurred by a personal health condition and a request from a Michelin starred chef for high quality alcohol free pairing options.

Spirit Description

This non alcoholic Riesling presents a pale straw hue with a slight shimmer. The nose is aromatic, offering fresh scents of green apple, citrus zest, and lime, with subtle hints of rhubarb, tarragon, and red apple. On the palate, it is crisp and refreshing, featuring a balanced interplay of vibrant acidity and residual sugar that highlights flavours of lemon curd, apricot, and peach. The body is light and delicate with a touch of minerality, leading to a clean, off dry, and remarkably long finish. It contains less than 0.5% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The versatility and bright acidity of this wine make it a charming companion for a variety of international cuisines. It is particularly effective at tempering the heat of spicy Asian dishes such as Pad Thai, sushi, and Indian or salmon curries. For lighter fare, it pairs beautifully with fresh summer salads, gratinated cauliflower crostinis, and Mediterranean style poultry. It also complements seafood favourites like fried chicken, oysters, and simply poached salmon.

Distinctive Features

Leitz 'Eins Zwei Zero' is distinguished by its use of the same high quality, handpicked grapes and vineyard practices employed for the estate's award winning alcoholic wines. The wine undergoes a gentle dealcoholization process through low temperature vacuum distillation, which allows the alcohol to evaporate at 28°C to preserve natural aromas and terroir characteristics. This flagship varietal is also gluten free and vegan friendly, offering a mindful alternative that maintains the depth and structure of a traditional Riesling.

Serving Suggestions

To best enjoy its refreshing mineral base and citrus notes, this wine should be served well chilled at a temperature between 6°C and 8°C. It is ideally presented in a standard white wine glass to allow the delicate aromas of orange and tarragon to develop fully. While perfect for a light meal on a sunny day, its clean finish and lack of alcoholic warmth also make it a sophisticated choice for alcohol free social gatherings or as a refined aperitif.

title: Chateau Angelus 2021
bodyHtml:
Château Angélus 2021 is a distinguished red wine from the Saint-Émilion appellation in Bordeaux, France. This vintage is notable for its blend, comprising 60% Cabernet Franc—the highest proportion ever used by the estate—and 40% Merlot.

Tasting Notes

  • Color: Deep garnet with purple reflections at the rim.
  • Nose: Fresh cranberries, ripe soft fruit, nuances of blackberries, a touch of black pepper, and candied orange zest.
  • Palate: Taut red berry fruit with good density, fine ripe tannins, fresh and well-structured. Red cherries and blackcurrants dominate the finish, showcasing great length and aging potential.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast: Highlighted the wine's perfumed Cabernet Franc aromas with violet, spice, and touches of black-fruit tannins. Smoky with a serious, dense structure, the wine shows succulent richness and is recommended for enjoyment starting in 2028.
  • Falstaff: 94 Points – Described as having taut red berry fruit, fine ripe tannins, and a well-structured profile with excellent aging potential.

Optimal Drinking Window

This wine is expected to develop beautifully with age and is best enjoyed from 2028 onwards.

Serving Suggestions

Decanting for about an hour is recommended to allow the wine to open up fully. Serve at a temperature of 15.5°C (60°F). This wine pairs excellently with classic meat dishes such as veal, pork, beef, lamb, duck, game, roast chicken, as well as rich fish courses like tuna, mushrooms, pasta, and a variety of hard and soft cheeses.

title: Famiglia Cotarella 'Montiano' 2020
bodyHtml: A symphony of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Sangiovese, Montiano Famiglia Cotarella encapsulates the vibrant spirit of Lazio, Italy. Each sip reveals rich notes of dark fruit, spice, and a touch of earth, culminating in a lingering, harmonious finish.

title: Gaja Cabernet Sauvignon 'Darmagi'
bodyHtml:
Gaja's 'Darmagi' is an iconic Cabernet Sauvignon from the Langhe region in Piedmont, Italy. The name, meaning "what a pity" in the Piedmontese dialect, was inspired by Giovanni Gaja's reaction to planting Bordeaux varietals in an area traditionally reserved for Nebbiolo. Introduced in the late 1970s, 'Darmagi' represents Angelo Gaja’s innovative approach to winemaking and his vision to elevate the expression of international varieties in Italy.

Tasting Notes

  • Color: Deep ruby red with a garnet rim.

  • Nose: Aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, cedar, and sweet spices, accompanied by subtle notes of graphite and tobacco.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and complex, featuring flavors of ripe dark fruits, cocoa, and a touch of mint, supported by velvety tannins and vibrant acidity.

  • Finish: Long and refined, with a balance of power and elegance.

Serving Suggestions

Decant for at least one hour to allow the wine to open up fully. Serve at a temperature of 16-18°C (60-64°F). This wine pairs excellently with roasted meats, hearty stews, and aged cheeses.

title: Castello Bonomi Franciacorta 'Cru Perdu' Brut 2019
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Castello Bonomi Franciacorta CruPerdu Brut Millesimato 2019 is a sparkling wine from the Franciacorta DOCG region in Lombardy, Italy. This vintage is crafted from a blend of 70% Chardonnay and 30% Pinot Noir grapes, reflecting the estate's dedication to producing high-quality Franciacorta wines.

Tasting Notes

  • Color: Bright straw-yellow with subtle effervescence.

  • Nose: Fragrant and intense, featuring fruity and floral aromas against a backdrop of freshly baked bread.

  • Palate: Full-bodied yet fresh, with delightful acidity and a fresh, fruity aftertaste.

Winemaking Process

The grapes are harvested from vineyards located on the slopes of Monte Orfano, at approximately 275 meters above sea level. After a gentle pressing, the first fermentation occurs in stainless steel tanks. The second fermentation follows the traditional Metodo Classico, with the wine maturing on its lees for over 36 months, enhancing its complexity and depth.

Historical Context

The name "CruPerdu," meaning "lost vineyard," originates from a discovery in the summer of 1986 when Castello Bonomi's Chef de Cave, Luigi Bersini, found vine plants hidden among ivy and wild shrubs. This lost vineyard inspired the name of this exceptional cuvée.

Serving Suggestions

For optimal enjoyment, serve at a temperature of 6-8°C (43-46°F). This versatile Franciacorta pairs well with shellfish, lean fish, mild and soft cheeses, and works beautifully as an aperitif.

title: Apostata Old Vine Tempranillo 2020
bodyHtml:
Apóstata Old Vine Tempranillo 2020 is a distinguished red wine from the Castilla y León region of Spain, produced by Península Vinicultores. This wine is crafted exclusively from 100% Tempranillo grapes sourced from old vines, reflecting the winery's commitment to authenticity and innovation.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Dense dark red with a black core, exhibiting notable viscosity.

  • Nose: Intense aromas of ripe blackberries, plums, and cherry pie, accompanied by hints of vanilla, sweet spices, and delicate smoky notes.

  • Palate: Full-bodied with well-structured tannins, featuring flavors of dark fruit, black pepper, and a touch of oak. The wine has a long, harmonious finish with distinctive palate aromas.

Winemaking Process:

The Apóstata Tempranillo undergoes aging for 12 months in barrique, enhancing its complexity and depth. This meticulous process results in a balanced and elegant character, showcasing the traditional qualities of Tempranillo.

Food Pairing:

This wine pairs excellently with braised veal, beef stew with porcini mushrooms in port wine sauce, lamb with rosemary jus, and fully ripe hard cheeses.

Serving Temperature:

For optimal enjoyment, serve at a temperature between 16°C and 18°C (60°F to 64°F).

title: Caleno Light & Zesty Spirit (Non Alcoholic) - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Caleño Light & Zesty is a non alcoholic spirit produced in the United Kingdom. The brand was founded by Ellie Webb, who created the beverage in her kitchen after feeling uninspired by the alcohol free options available during a night out. The company history is deeply influenced by Webb's Colombian heritage, aiming to capture the vibrant colours and tropical flavours of her family's homeland.

Spirit Description

This gin alternative is clear in colour and offers a bright, full bodied aroma of tropical fruits. The palate is mild and refreshing, featuring a lively blend of pineapple, papaya, and citrus with a subtle hint of spice from green cardamom. It has a light body with a lingering finish that leaves a slight, pleasant burn on the tongue. The spirit is balanced and fresh, characterized by the inclusion of the golden South American Inca berry. It contains 0% alcohol by volume.

title: Chateau Clerc Milon 2021
bodyHtml:
Château Clerc Milon, a distinguished Fifth Growth estate from the 1855 Bordeaux Classification, is situated in the Pauillac appellation of Bordeaux, France. The 2021 vintage is a blend of 59% Cabernet Sauvignon, 28% Merlot, 10% Cabernet Franc, 1.5% Petit Verdot, and 1.5% Carmenère.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: Aromas of dark berries, minty cassis, violets, and pencil shavings.
  • Palate: Medium to full-bodied, velvety and concentrated, with an ample core of fruit, lively acidity, and sweet, chalky tannins.
  • Finish: Long and persistent, showcasing finesse and balance.

Accolades

  • Wine Advocate: 93 Points
  • Vinous: 94 Points

Optimal Drinking Window

This wine is expected to develop beautifully with age and is best enjoyed from 2027 through 2045.

Serving Suggestions

Decanting for about an hour is recommended to allow the wine to open up fully. Serve at a temperature of 16-18°C (60-64°F).

title: Chateau Clerc Milon 2020
bodyHtml:
Château Clerc Milon, a distinguished Fifth Growth estate from the 1855 Bordeaux Classification, is situated in the Pauillac appellation of Bordeaux, France. The 2020 vintage is a blend of 53% Cabernet Sauvignon, 37% Merlot, 8% Cabernet Franc, and 2% Petit Verdot.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: Aromas of dark berries, cigar wrapper, exotic spices, and burning embers.
  • Palate: Medium to full-bodied, fleshy, and layered, with lively acidity and a long, saline, violet-inflected finish.
  • Finish: Persistent and elegant, with a balance of rich fruit and minerality.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast: 95 Points – "A firm structure and dark tannins give this wine a solid backbone. It has the weight and richness to support the tannins, with a juicy black-currant flavor."
  • Jeb Dunnuck: 94 Points – "Ripe currants, cassis, damp earth, graphite, and crushed stone-like minerality define the bouquet. Medium to full-bodied, with a focused, pure texture, expansive richness on the mid-palate, and ripe, building tannins."

Optimal Drinking Window

This wine is expected to develop beautifully with age and is best enjoyed from 2025 through 2040.

Serving Suggestions

Decanting for about an hour is recommended to allow the wine to open up fully. Serve at a temperature of 16-18°C (60-64°F).

title: Carruades de Lafite 2021
bodyHtml:
Carruades de Lafite, the second wine of Château Lafite Rothschild, originates from the Pauillac appellation in Bordeaux, France. The 2021 vintage is a blend of 55% Cabernet Sauvignon, 36% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc, and 4% Petit Verdot.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: Aromas of red berries, cassis, cedar box, and orange rind.
  • Palate: Medium to full-bodied, lively and layered, with good concentration and a long, penetrating finish.
  • Finish: Elegant and persistent, highlighting the wine's balance and structure.

Accolades

  • James Suckling: 95 Points
  • Wine Enthusiast: 94 Points

Optimal Drinking Window

This wine is expected to develop beautifully with age and is best enjoyed from 2025 through 2042.

Serving Suggestions

Decanting for about an hour is recommended to allow the wine to open up fully. Serve at a temperature of 16-18°C (60-64°F).

title: McConnell's 5 Year Old Irish Whisky
bodyHtml:
Established in Belfast in 1776 by brothers John and James McConnell, McConnell's is one of Ireland's oldest whisky brands. After a hiatus beginning in the 1950s, the brand was revived in 2020, continuing its legacy of producing quality Irish whisky.

5 Year Old Irish Whisky

This expression is a blend of Irish malt and grain whiskies, aged for five years in first-fill American oak ex-bourbon barrels.

  • Color: Honey gold.
  • Nose: Light citrus notes, peppered spice, and vanilla undertones.
  • Palate: Earthy fruits, butterscotch, and vanilla sweetness, complemented by white pepper and oak woodiness.
  • Finish: Sweet spice, oak, with lingering ripe fruits.

Food Pairing

This whisky pairs well with aged cheeses, smoked salmon, or dark chocolate desserts, enhancing its vanilla sweetness and subtle spice.

title: Stolen X Rock & Rye
bodyHtml:
Stolen X Rock & Rye is a modern interpretation of the classic pre-Prohibition cocktail, Rock & Rye, traditionally made with rye whiskey, rock candy, and citrus. This contemporary version is crafted by infusing aged American rye whiskey with organic raw honey and real orange peel, resulting in a balanced flavor profile reminiscent of an Old Fashioned.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Dark amber-orange hue, similar to a muddled orange in whiskey.
  • Nose: Dominant notes of orange blossom, sweet spices, and candied citrus.
  • Palate: Creamy mouthfeel with flavors of citrus-infused honey, complemented by subtle rye spiciness and clove undertones.
  • Finish: Lingering sweetness with a warm, smooth finish.

Production Details

  • Made with 100% American rye whiskey aged over two years in new American oak barrels.
  • Infused with fresh orange peel and organic raw honey.
  • Bottled at 80 proof (40% ABV).

Serving Suggestions

  • Enjoyed neat, over ice, or as a shot.
  • Can serve as a base for cocktails, offering a convenient alternative to traditional mixed drinks.

title: Freemark Abbey Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml:
Established in 1886, Freemark Abbey Winery is one of Napa Valley's historic wineries, located in St. Helena, California. With a legacy spanning over a century, the winery has been instrumental in shaping Napa's winemaking heritage, consistently producing wines that reflect the region's unique terroir.

2019 Cabernet Sauvignon

The 2019 Freemark Abbey Cabernet Sauvignon is a blend predominantly composed of Cabernet Sauvignon, complemented by small percentages of Merlot, Malbec, Petit Verdot, and Cabernet Franc. In the glass, it exhibits a deep garnet color. The nose reveals aromas of dark chocolate, pomegranate, cedar shavings, blackberry, and leather.

On the palate, flavors of blueberry compote, black cherry, espresso, and cigar box emerge, accompanied by bright and juicy fruit-forward sensations. The wine's texture is rich and bold, with well-structured tannins that make it approachable now, yet suitable for aging over the next decade or more.

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs excellently with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, or aged cheddar cheese. These pairings enhance the wine's robust flavors and create a harmonious dining experience.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast: 93 Points. "A fresh, polished style, with a relatively open-knit core."
  • Gismondi on Wine: 92 Points. "In 2019, this Napa Valley Cabernet opens with rich dark baking chocolate and blackberry. Similar flavors mark the palate with some espresso and reasonably bright acidity that lends a fresh, juicy character to what is a youthful red."

title: Champagne RC Lemaire Cuvee Select Reserve
bodyHtml:
This distinguished Champagne is produced in the Marne Valley, a subregion renowned for its exceptional Meunier grapes. The House of Roger Constant Lemaire has a rich history dating back to the late 19th century, with the family carrying on unique 'savoir faire' since 1945. Their winemaking philosophy is defined by a rare commitment to non-malolactic fermentation, a process intended to preserve the natural freshness, minerality, and authentic aromas of the fruit.

Wine Description

This Cuvée Sélect (also known as Sélect Réserve) presents a bright straw or pale gold colour with a fine, persistent mousse. The nose is fresh and inviting, offering a bouquet of citrus fruits, green apple, and pear, layered with complex hints of toasted hazelnut, forest strawberry, and a touch of sweet pastry. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and fruity, revealing a crisp acidity and a creamy texture with flavours of lemon zest, white peach, and brioche. Crafted as a Blanc de Meuniers from 100% Pinot Meunier, it is aged for at least four years in the cellars to develop depth and complexity. This artisanal Champagne features a dry, well integrated finish with subtle mineral and saline undertones.

title: Chateau Des Landes Cuvee Prestige 2015
bodyHtml:
Château des Landes is a family-owned estate situated in the Lussac-Saint-Émilion appellation of Bordeaux, France. Established in 1952 by Jean Lassagne, the vineyard has been meticulously managed by the Lassagne family for generations, focusing on producing high-quality Merlot-based wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region.

2015 Cuvée Prestige

The 2015 vintage of Château des Landes Cuvée Prestige is crafted exclusively from old-vine Merlot, showcasing the depth and character of the varietal. This wine exhibits a deep, dark ruby hue, indicating its concentration. On the nose, it presents ripe red fruit aromas, complemented by floral notes, wood, spice, and a touch of vanilla.

The palate is rich and dense, offering flavours of blackberry, dark plum, anise, and sweet dried tobacco leaf. The wine is juicy, smooth, and sensuous, with well-integrated tannins providing structure and balance. A toasty character from oak aging adds complexity, leading to a powerful and complex finish. This full-bodied wine has an alcohol content of 13.5% and is classified as extra dry. It is approachable now but has the potential to cellar and develop further complexity through 2028.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with hearty dishes such as tourtière, roast beef, and turkey. These pairings enhance the wine's rich fruit flavours and toasty oak nuances, creating a harmonious dining experience.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast: 91 Points. "Ripe and structured, this wood-aged wine is still developing. It has a dark structure, dense blackberry fruit, and powerful concentration. A peppery touch of alcohol gives it a bitter finish, which should dissipate as it ages. Drink from 2022."
  • Natalie MacLean: 90 Points. "A full-bodied 100% Old Vines Merlot sourced from the Lussac-Saint-Émilion appellation. Château des Landes Cuvée Prestige is toasty on the palate with blackberry, dark plum, anise, and sweet dried tobacco leaf flavours. Juicy, smooth, and sensuous on the palate. Nice now, but can easily cellar for eight years or more."

title: Klein Constantia Vin De Constance 2016
bodyHtml:
Vin de Constance 2016 is a celebrated sweet wine from Klein Constantia Estate, located in the heart of South Africa’s Constantia Valley. This iconic wine is crafted from 100% Muscat de Frontignan grapes and has a legacy dating back to the 18th century, earning acclaim among royalty and wine connoisseurs alike.

Vineyard and Terroir
The estate’s vineyards are nestled on the slopes of Constantiaberg, benefiting from cooling ocean breezes and granite-rich soils. These unique conditions allow for the slow ripening of grapes, enhancing their aromatic complexity and natural acidity.

Winemaking Process
Grapes are hand-picked in multiple passes to ensure perfect ripeness. After gentle pressing, fermentation is carried out in stainless steel and French oak barrels, allowing the wine to preserve its fruit purity while gaining depth from extended barrel aging. The 2016 vintage matured for three years in a combination of 50% new French oak and acacia barrels before bottling.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Brilliant amber-gold with luminous reflections.
  • Aroma: Aromas of ripe apricots, candied orange peel, and honey are layered with hints of spice, ginger, and floral notes.
  • Palate: Luxuriously rich and opulent, featuring flavours of dried stone fruits, marmalade, and vanilla. A vibrant acidity balances the sweetness, leading to an exceptionally long, elegant finish.

Accolades
Vin de Constance 2016 has garnered critical acclaim, with numerous 97+ point ratings from leading wine publications, reaffirming its place among the world’s finest sweet wines.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs exquisitely with foie gras, blue cheeses, or desserts like tarte Tatin or crème brûlée. It also shines as a contemplative wine, enjoyed on its own to savour its unmatched complexity and refinement.

title: Prima Pietra Toscana Rosso 2020
bodyHtml:
Prima Pietra Toscana Rosso 2020 is an elegant red wine crafted from the highest vineyard on Tuscany’s coastal area. This wine, produced by Tenuta Prima Pietra, embodies the region’s dedication to excellence and its affinity for Bordeaux grape varieties.

Vineyard and Terroir
Situated at an altitude of 450 meters, the vineyard benefits from a mix of clay and rocky soils and the influence of the nearby Tyrrhenian Sea. These conditions contribute to the wine’s vibrant acidity, refined tannins, and complex aromatic profile.

Winemaking Process
Prima Pietra 2020 is a meticulous blend of Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Petit Verdot. The grapes are hand-harvested, vinified in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks, and aged in French oak barrels, of which 50% are new, for 18 months. This process enhances the wine’s structure and imparts subtle oak nuances.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Deep ruby red with garnet reflections.
  • Aroma: A complex bouquet of black cherries, plums, and cassis, layered with hints of tobacco, cedar, and sweet spices.
  • Palate: Full-bodied and well-structured, showcasing concentrated fruit flavors balanced by elegant tannins and a long, persistent finish.

Accolades
The 2020 vintage has been praised by critics for its richness and balance, solidifying Prima Pietra’s reputation as a standout Tuscan red.

Food Pairing
Prima Pietra pairs beautifully with grilled lamb, roasted game, or aged cheeses. Its refined structure and depth elevate any dining experience, creating a harmonious match with bold, flavourful dishes.

title: Bowmore 12 Year Old 'Sherry Oak'
bodyHtml: This dram expresses the essence of Bowmore with rich amber colour; subtle notes of citrus and honey with typical peaty smokiness; the flavours are sweet and delicious with heather and honey; a soft peat smoke note lingers on a long and mellow finish.

title: Delamotte Blanc De Blancs 2018
bodyHtml:
93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Delamotte 2018 Blanc de Blancs is showing well today, evoking a gourmand, complex bouquet of pastry, almonds, ripe orchard fruits, spices and spring flowers. Medium to full-bodied, layered and chiseled, it’s enveloping and round with a fleshy core of fruit, though not as fleshy as the 2012, concluding with a tense and long finish.

91 Points - Vinous

The 2018 Brut Blanc de Blancs is a blend of fruit from Le Mesnil-sur-Oger, Avize, Oger, Cramant, Chouilly and Oiry, six villages in the Côte des Blancs. Crushed rocks, mint, slate, lemon peel and green pear lend notable freshness. Like most wines in this vintage, the Blanc de Blancs is airy and medium-bodied in structure, but it shows lovely tension and fine balance. There’s plenty of Delamotte class, in an understated style.

title: Christophe Mignon 'ADN de Foudre' Meunier Brut Nature
bodyHtml: Mignon is famous for his dedication to the Pinot Meunier grape, which dominates his small 6 hectare estate of primarily clay-limestone, characteristic of the Marne Valley, but here he uses all three of Champagne's most famous grapes.

title: Jasci & Marchesani Montepulciano d'Abruzzo 'Nerube' 2022
bodyHtml: Jasci & Marchesani is a family-owned winery located in Monteodorisio, within the Abruzzo region of Italy. The estate has a rich history of producing organic wines, with a commitment to sustainable viticulture and respect for the environment. Their vineyards are situated at an altitude of 190 meters above sea level, benefiting from optimal sun exposure and soil composition, which contribute to the distinctive character of their wines.

title: Degani Valpolicella Classico Superiore 2022
bodyHtml:
Degani make this Valpolicella from a blend of 40% Corvina, 30% Rondinella, 24% Corvinone and 5% Altre; partially drying the grapes prior to fermentation. Deep ruby red in appearance with freshly perfumed aromas, this wine is velvety in texture and persistent on the palate.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Crushed red cherries, juice dripping down the cheeks and wild flower aromas permeate the glass of this red. Well balanced with fine tannins and zippy acidity that shines with raspberry and red currant flavors balanced by fresh herbs and black tea notes on the finish.

title: Alberto Voerzio Barolo Castagni 2020
bodyHtml: Ruby red with garnet highlights. Aromas and flavors of spice, cherries, pepper, earthy mushrooms, touch of oak. Good tannic structure, balanced acidity, full body and long finish.

title: Domaine de Baronarques White 2021
bodyHtml:
An attractive pale yellow. Aromas of citrus fruit, preserved lemon zest, white blossom, verbena and brioche mingle on the complex and intense nose. A clean and fresh attack leads into an expansive, full-bodied and voluptuous mid-palate, its attractive heft offset by remarkable freshness. Developing highly complex flavours of ripe fruit, honey and acacia blossom with touches of toast, it culminates in an exceptionally long and mineral finish.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Lovely aromas of white peaches and flowers on the nose. Approachable and crisp, the palate is loaded with concentrated flavors of passion fruit, lemon, subtle notes of vanilla and mouth-watering acidity.

90 Points - Decanter

Balancing the purity of citrus fruit with a plush, opulent texture, this shows a serious side that comes with meticulous winemaking. Flashes of honeysuckle mix with green apple and crab apple characters. There's a flinty reduction and a touch of char on the finish, but the fruit is very pure and appetising.

title: Domaine Gerard Raphet Bourgogne Passetoutgrain 2023
bodyHtml:
Raphet’s Passetoutgrains is a 50/50 split of Pinot Noir and Gamay. From 30-year-old vines, crafted with indigenous yeasts and aged in old French barrels for 18 months, this is an intoxicatingly fresh and approachable red.

It exudes attractive notes of red cherries, cranberries and orange rind on the nose. The palate delivers on this promise, with succulent notes of pomegranate, blood oranges and cherries on harmoniously balanced and vibrant palate. It will also age well over the coming few years, but is perfect to be drunk right now.

title: Chateau d'Hanteillan 2018
bodyHtml: The nose reveals notes of blackberry, ripe raspberry and more lightly spices associated with a hint of flowers as well as dine hints of spices (in the background) and a very discreet hint of fresh leather. On the palate this wine expresses notes of crunchy cherry, crunchy blackberry and more slightly fleshy/crunchy raspberry associated with a discreet hint of flowers, toasted and a very discreet hint of fresh leather and vanilla. There is a very discreet hint of chocolate on the finish/persistence.

title: D1 London Gin
bodyHtml:
D1 London Gin encapsulates quintessential British flavours and aromas, with orange and fruit tea expressions around a confidently balanced juniper backbone.

The distillation in copper brings in fresh blackcurrant aromas that marry with the prominent nettle notes to deliver the smoothest and most versatile gin you will ever enjoy.

title: Daou Rose 2020
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
This wine is delightfully fragrant and floral, showing lovely aromas of fresh strawberry, sliced peach, and watermelon with nuances of hibiscus, cherry, and clover honey. The palate is refreshingly crisp yet lusciously smooth, revealing juicy flavors of nectarine, orange, strawberry parfait, and golden delicious apple. These primary flavors are underlain by plush, pleasing notes of papaya and honeydew melon, accented with a suggestion of rosehip tea. A long, clean finish lingers with impressions of peach, citrus zest, and Barbados cherry.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Light peach and apricot aromas are leveled by wet rock, rose and lemon peel accents on the nose of this bottling. It tightens firmly on the sip, where melon and stone fruit flavors are splashed by a bit of citrus.

title: El Gran Legado de Vida Still Strength Artesanal Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Made at the Tequila Cascahuin Distillery, perhaps best known and beloved for their house brand of the same name, El Gran Legado is an elegant sipping blanco that benefits from many of the same traditional methods employed by the distillery. Cooked for 3 days in a large stone oven, or "horno", it is then allowed to cool for an additional day before being crushed.

A roller mill is used to separate the juice from the pulp, and then the juice is fermented over a four day period in stainless steel tanks. It is double distilled, first in a steel alembic pot still, then in a copper alembic pot still. Coming off the still at about 55% abv, it is then reduced to 40% bottling proof and allowed to mellow for 15-30 days before bottling. The result is a nose full of sweet floral aromas, bright lemon peel, minerality, and mint. On the palate there is sweet agave, black pepper, wet stone, and more citrus. Fantastic body and medium-long finish.

title: Bodyguard Chardonnay by DAOU Vineyards 2020
bodyHtml:
Founded by brothers Georges and Daniel Daou, DAOU Vineyards is situated in the Adelaida District of Paso Robles, California. The estate is renowned for producing wines that marry traditional techniques with modern innovation, reflecting the unique terroir of DAOU Mountain. The Bodyguard series pays tribute to the brothers' mother, Marie Daou, symbolizing strength and grace.

Bodyguard Chardonnay

The Bodyguard Chardonnay is crafted from 100% Chardonnay grapes. In the glass, it presents a bright golden hue. The nose is rich and fragrant, offering aromas of spiced pear, star jasmine, vanilla bean, and tropical rainforest, with trailing scents of pineapple, mango, crushed filberts, and buttered toast, accented by hints of allspice and honeysuckle.

On the palate, it is crisp and silky, expanding with mouthwatering flavors of white peach, pineapple, honeydew melon, and lemon zest. Underlying tropical notes of papaya, kiwi, and passion fruit are laced with toasty oak and baking spices. A lush, clean finish reveals lingering impressions of citrus, almond, and vanilla.

The wine undergoes 10 months of barrel aging in 30% new French oak, 30% new American oak, and 40% neutral French oak, contributing to its complexity and depth.

Food Pairing

This Chardonnay pairs beautifully with dishes such as roasted poultry, creamy pasta, or seafood in butter sauces. These pairings enhance the wine's opulent flavors and create a harmonious dining experience.

title: Llama Malbec Old Vine 2023
bodyHtml: Warm, rich, and inviting, with exuberant notes of dark blackberry, black cherry, blueberry cobbler, and dark plum, alongside spiced notes of cinnamon, clove, allspice and vanilla. Alluring notes of black pepper, graphite, and floral violet are interwoven with delicate savory notes of fresh thyme, lavender and wild sage.

title: Grizzly Paw Better Lemon Soda (Non Alcoholic) 355 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
This beverage originates from Canada. It is produced by The Grizzly Paw Brewing Company, which was founded in 1996 by Niall Fraser in Canmore, Alberta. The company operates a state of the art facility in the Canadian Rockies and is well known for its community focus, with proceeds from this specific soda donated to support colleagues facing unforeseen life challenges.

Spirit Description

The soda is clear and free from artificial colouring. The aroma is bright and zesty, featuring the sharp scent of fresh citrus. On the palate, it offers a handcrafted profile brewed with real cane sugar and fresh mountain water, delivering a balanced lemon flavour that is less bitter than traditional sodas. The body is light and effervescent with a crisp, refreshing finish. It is noted for being a healthier alternative, containing only 15 calories and 1 g of sugar per 355 ml can. The alcohol by volume is 0.0%.

title: Two Hands Shiraz 'Lily's Garden' 2021
bodyHtml:
Lily’s Garden is a generous wine with cascading blue fruits and a rich long palate. General sand based soils provide lovely lifted aromatics, softness and roundness. The label’s blue colour takes inspiration from McLaren Vale’s close proximity to the sea.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Lily's Garden Shiraz is from McLaren Vale and smells at first like a lot of good-quality oak, with lashings of toasted coconut, nutmeg, crunchy chicken skin, nutmeg and cedar. In the mouth, however, the fruit washes over any notion of oak and splashes every part of the palate with pure purple flavor and color. This is a concentrated and opulent Shiraz, with all the trappings of McLaren Vale. It is refreshing and very "made," perfect. By the book.

title: Sobr Riesling - Alcohol Free
bodyHtml:
Sobr Riesling is a non-alcoholic white wine crafted in Germany, offering the vibrant and refreshing qualities of a traditional Riesling without the alcohol content.

Tasting Profile

  • Aroma: Notes of lime, citrus, and crisp green apples.
  • Palate: A well-balanced combination of fruity sweetness and refreshing acidity, with a clean mineral finish typical of Riesling.

Food Pairing

This alcohol-free Riesling pairs beautifully with spicy Asian cuisine, fresh seafood, and light salads. Its zesty character complements dishes with bold or tangy flavors.

Characteristics

  • Made from premium Riesling grapes.
  • Retains the hallmark freshness and complexity of Riesling.
  • Perfect for those seeking a sophisticated, alcohol-free alternative.

Sobr Riesling captures the essence of traditional Riesling, making it an excellent choice for social occasions or relaxed dining without compromising on taste or quality.

title: Cliff Lede Poetry Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Cliff Lede Poetry Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 is a distinguished red wine from the Stags Leap District in Napa Valley, California, produced by Cliff Lede Vineyards. This wine exemplifies the winery's commitment to crafting exceptional Cabernet Sauvignon that reflects the unique terroir of their estate vineyards.

Vineyard and Terroir

  • Poetry Vineyard: Situated on a steep west-facing hillside, the vineyard spans from the highest elevations of the Stags Leap District to the valley floor.
  • Soil Composition: Shallow, volcanic soils atop fractured shale, contributing to the wine's complexity.
  • Viticulture: High-density planting with low yields results in small, flavorful berries, enhancing concentration and depth.

Winemaking Process

  • Harvesting: Grapes are hand-picked during the cool nighttime hours to preserve freshness.
  • Sorting: A meticulous three-tiered sorting process, including optical sorting and individual berry selection, ensures optimal fruit quality.
  • Fermentation: Whole berries undergo cold soaks lasting five to eight days, followed by fermentation managed through a combination of pump-overs and délestage.
  • Maceration: Extended maceration of up to six weeks allows for exceptional extraction and fine-tuning of tannin profiles.
  • Aging: Aged for twenty-one months in French oak barrels, 74% new, enhancing structure and complexity.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Deep garnet-purple color.
  • Aroma: Aromas of warm summer mulberries, fractured rock, and violet perfume envelop the glass.
  • Palate: Flavors of wild blackberry preserves, black truffle, sea salt, and steak au poivre juices. Plush tannins swathe the finish, wrapping the tongue in a mineral-laden, majestic embrace with lingering flavors.

Blend Composition

  • Cabernet Sauvignon: 85%
  • Merlot: 6%
  • Cabernet Franc: 6%
  • Petit Verdot: 3%

Accolades

  • The Wine Independent: 100 Points – "The medium-bodied palate is tightly wound at this youthful stage, revealing layer upon layer of fragrant black and red fruits with loads of mineral sparks, supported by fine-grained tannins and seamless acidity, finishing with epic length."
  • Vinous: 98 Points – "The 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Poetry is one of the finest wines from Cliff Lede. A classic Stags Leap Cabernet, it races across the palate with dense, inky fruit, crème de cassis, lavender, licorice, chocolate, spice, and espresso."
  • Wine Enthusiast: 96 Points – "This well-balanced and elegant wine shows beautifully integrated black fruits, oak spices, and hints of mint and cedar in the aroma, with similarly delicious flavors wrapped in fine-grained tannins for a velvety texture."

Serving Suggestions

  • Temperature: Serve at 16-18°C (60-64°F).
  • Decanting: Decant for about an hour before serving to allow the wine to open up and reveal its full complexity.
  • Food Pairings: Complements well with grilled steaks, roasted lamb, or aged cheeses.

title: Finca Sophenia Altosur Malbec 2021
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
The 2021 Sophenia Altosur Malbec wine was grown on estate vineyards at the highest point in the Uco Valley—a region that is “arguably producing Argentina’s finest Malbecs,” according to Decanter.

This wine landed on the list of the Decanter World Wine Awards’ top 50 wines of the year, earning Best in Show honors and a tremendous 97-point score from the DWWA judges.

title: Stirm Wine Co. 'Joaquinite' Pinot Noir
bodyHtml:
Joaquinite is a rare gemstone found in a remote mine deep in the rugged mountains of San Benito County. It is found often alongside the also extremely rare Benitoite and Neptunite. We utilize Pinot Noir from the historic Gimelli Vineyard (aka El Gabilan) in the heart of the limestone (calcite) laden Cienega Valley.

These alkaline soils, and strong diurnal shift from the warm day/cold night dynamic that allow the grapes to both ripen and retain freshness. This wine is made from 100% Pinot Noir from two different vineyard blocks planted in 1997.

title: F de Fournier Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
Domaine Fournier Père et Fils produces its F de Fournier Sauvignon Blanc from vines planted in the Loire Valley and fermented in Sancerre. The vines come from younger vines planted on loamy-sandy and loamy-calcareous soils. The vineyard is cultivated with the utmost care in order to preserve the full aromatic potential of the grape variety.
The Sauvignon Blanc F de Fournier shows its aromas of citrus and passion fruit. On the palate it is salty and tangy, with a nice sweetness and an aromatic return of toasted citrus

Goes well with aperitifs, fish dishes, cold cuts and cheeses

title: Empress 1908 Cucumber Lemon Gin
bodyHtml: Inspired by the flavours of afternoon tea, experience the brilliantly balanced Empress 1908 Cucumber Lemon Gin. Eight expertly blended botanicals create an exquisite spirit with lively citrus notes, crisp cucumber, fragrant jasmine, and delicate spice. Brighten up your next cocktail creation with Empress Cucumber Lemon Gin.

title: Stella Artois 330 ml - 12 Bottles
bodyHtml: Stella Artois is a premium European lager of noble traditions, that truly symbolizes European style and sophistication. It traces its' roots to 1366, has a full distinctive taste and is brewed with the finest barley and hops.

title: Pine Ridge Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley 2023
bodyHtml:
Pine Ridge Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley originates from the United States, within the California region and the renowned Napa Valley AVA. Founded in 1978 by Gary Andrus, the historic estate is situated in the heart of the Stags Leap District along the Silverado Trail. The winery's philosophy bridges meticulous, sustainable viticulture with precision winemaking. To craft this flagship cuvée, the winemaking team expertly selects and blends fruit from across 160 acres of premier estate vineyards spanning five distinct Napa sub-appellations: Stags Leap District, Howell Mountain, Oakville, Rutherford, and Carneros.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, intense ruby appearance in the glass and possesses a bold, full-bodied structure with an opulent texture. The sensory profile is elegant, expressive, and complex, opening with an inviting nose of ripe blackcherries, blueberries, and blackberry bramble, seamlessly interwoven with dark chocolate, spearmint, and Hungarian baking spices. On the plush and juicy palate, it delivers a generous stream of cranberry sauce, raspberry jam, and cassis, layered with cocoa nibs, vanilla cream, and espresso. The finish is remarkably long, succulent, and polished, balanced by a vibrant acidic backbone and framed by firm, silky tannins.

title: Terralsole Brunello 'Vigna Pian Bossolino' 2016
bodyHtml:
A perfect five-star vintage with depth, complexity, and exceptional aging potential.

Pian Bossolino is a standout, showcasing rich aromas of black cherry, licorice, and spices, framed by silky tannins and lively acidity. This wine offers a seamless blend of power and elegance, with subtle notes of cedar and earth emerging with decanting. It pairs beautifully with osso buco or aged Pecorino, complementing its bold, structured profile. Designed for long-term aging, it will continue to evolve gracefully over the next 20-25 years. This vintage reflects Montalcino’s finest craftsmanship and is ideal for grand occasions. A must-have for collectors, it delivers a polished, long-lasting finish.

title: Caliterra Sauvignon Blanc Reserve 2024
bodyHtml: Clear pale straw colour; fresh cut grass, gooseberry and citrus/lime aromas; dry medium body with round flavour of melon and citrus.

title: The Macallan Classic Cut - Limited 2024 Edition
bodyHtml:
Each expression of The Macallan’s single malt whisky reveals the unrivalled commitment to the mastery of wood and spirit for which The Macallan has been known since it was established in 1824. It is an expression of our enduring desire to go beyond the ordinary, to seek out the extraordinary, and create peerless single malts.

The eighth release in The Macallan’s annual Classic Cut series demonstrates our ongoing quest to seek out the extraordinary. This exceptional single malt has been matured in a combination of sherry seasoned European and American oak, and ex-bourbon casks.​ On the nose are notes of rich vanilla, citrus peel and sweet oak, before baked custard, sweet green apple and vanilla are unveiled on the palate.

title: Cakebread Cabernet Sauvignon 'Suscol Vineyard' 2021
bodyHtml:
94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Lots of plums, darker cherries, currants, tobacco, and graphite-like notes emerge from the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Suscol Springs, a gorgeously complex, medium to full-bodied, finesse-driven effort. A blend of 98% Cabernet Sauvignon and 1% each of Merlot and Cabernet Franc, aged in 54% new oak, it has some background spicy wood notes, remarkable purity, and great tannins.

93 Points - James Suckling

Blackberries and blackcurrants with some herbs, lemon and violets. Full-bodied with round tannins and a juicy finish. Beautiful fruit with savoriness and softness. Goes on for minutes.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

A luscious mouthfeel and saturated black-fruit flavors give this wine a smooth, deep expression. Aged in 70% new barrels, it’s loaded with blueberries, black cherries and dark chocolate that weave through soft, silky tannins.

title: Belle de Brillet Pear and Cognac Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Belle de Brillet is a premium pear liqueur that masterfully combines the intense fruitiness of Williams pears with the elegance of Cognac. Crafted in France, this unique spirit captures the essence of ripe fruit while maintaining the depth and warmth of its fine Cognac base.

Production and Craftsmanship

Each bottle contains the essence of approximately 18 perfectly ripe Williams pears, which are macerated to extract their full flavor. This natural pear infusion is then blended with Cognac, vanilla, and subtle sweeteners to create a smooth and aromatic liqueur. The production process emphasizes the use of high-quality, all-natural ingredients with no artificial additives.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Rich golden hue.
  • Aroma: Bold pear aromas complemented by hints of honey, vanilla, and light floral undertones.
  • Palate: A luscious, velvety texture with flavors of fresh pear, caramelized sugar, and warming Cognac. The finish is long, smooth, and elegantly sweet.

Serving Suggestions

  • Neat: Best enjoyed at room temperature to appreciate its full complexity.
  • On the Rocks: Chilled over ice for a refreshing, slightly mellowed experience.
  • Cocktails: A sophisticated addition to drinks like a Pear Mimosa, Belle Collins, or a Pear Manhattan, enhancing depth and flavor.

title: Cirelli Vino Bianco Biologico 2022
bodyHtml: Rich straw yellow, bright and clear.Herbal-spicy aromas such as camomile, sage, light tobacco, pome fruit, apricot peel and peach pits, framed by orange zest and subtle yeasty notes. Tart flavour with gently animating bitter notes of sage and mild, well-integrated acidity. Multi-layered with a hesitant attack. Uncomplicated, varietal wine with a lively, herbal-spicy profile and refreshing acidity.

title: Sottano Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: Deep and intense color with ruby hues. Black pepper, red bell peppers, cassis, cappuccino, tobacco and varied spices are part of the complex aroma this wine displays. In the mouth, mint and chocolate play in perfect harmony with black fruits.

title: Dr McGillicuddy's Butterscotch Schnapps
bodyHtml: Dr McGillicuddy has been a household name for generations because of the pureness of flavour his spirits offer. This offers intense aromas and flavours of sweet butterscotch and caramel with a nice long finish. Nice over ice or layered over creme de cacao for a flavourful shooter.

title: Norton Family Blend Privada 2023
bodyHtml:
This premium red blend originates from Luján de Cuyo, a prestigious subregion of Mendoza, Argentina. Founded in 1895 by English engineer Edmund James Palmer Norton, Bodega Norton is a pioneer of Argentinian viticulture. Since 1989, the estate has been owned by the Swarovski family, whose philosophy centers on 'Signature Winemaking' to reflect the unique heritage and quality of their century-old vines.

Wine Description

Privada Family Blend presents a deep, dark ruby red colour with violet reflections. The aromatic profile is complex and expressive, featuring intense notes of ripe blackberries, black cherries, and spiced plums, complemented by a fine touch of smoke, tobacco, and dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and velvety, showing elegant flavours of cassis, mocha, and raspberry integrated with polished tannins and a mineral nuance.

title: Alter Ego de Palmer 2017 (by Chateau Palmer)
bodyHtml:
94 Points - James Suckling

This is a delicious and savory wine with beautiful, ripe and creamy tannins, as well as chocolate and plum character. Full body. The flavors turn to wet earth and mushrooms with some leather. A blend of 53% merlot, 41% cabernet sauvignon and 6% petit verdot. Lovely finish.

93 Points - Decanter

I love the bright perky fruit that we have here. They had to be careful with extraction to retain this delicacy but have been successful with it. Not enormously concentrated, at least compared to the first wine, but it has lovely classicism, with fresh fruit and some gourmet swirls of cinnamon and chocolate, 3.75pH, 25% new oak.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

title: Ole Smoky Hunch Punch
bodyHtml: Let's get this party started! A hearty step up from the party punch you may remember, Ole Smoky Hunch Punch Moonshine is a delicious and potent concoction that combines smooth moonshine with a summertime blend of orange, pineapple, and cherry juice. It packs a punch for any bunch!

title: Havana Club 3 Year Old - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Clear, pale lemon; aromas suggest vanilla, banana with a hint of smoked oak; full body with flavours of tropical fruit, banana, caramelized pear, spice, smoke, chocolate and vanilla notes leading to a pleasant finish.

title: Contino Reserva 2021
bodyHtml: On the nose, echoes of healthy and mature red fruit in after a perfect maturation. Floral and balsamic notes add freshness, all together in harmony with subtle toasted notes from its time in barrel. In the mouth, fine and subtle with nice tannins and perfect acidity that make it a persistent wine with a long finish.

title: Chevessac Pineau Des Charentes Privilege Rose
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Chevessac Pineau des Charentes Privilege Rose is a prestigious fortified liqueur wine from the Cognac region of France. Produced by the renowned Merlet Distillery, also known as Distillerie Merlet & Fils, the estate has a long-standing family tradition of quality control and expertise dating back to 1850. This 'mistelle' is crafted through the 'mutage' process, where the fermentation of fresh grape must is halted by the addition of Cognac eau-de-vie, reflecting a centuries-old winemaking heritage unique to the Charente terroir.

Wine Description

This Rose Pineau presents an intense red colour with copper highlights and brown tinges. The nose is powerful and expressive, dominated by vibrant aromas of red fruits, specifically raspberry and Morello cherry, with underlying notes of subtle spice. On the palate, the wine is supple, generous, and velvety, offering a harmonious blend of red fruit flavours and delicate spicy accents. It is a complex, medium-to-full-bodied liqueur with an alcohol content typically around 17% and a long, aromatic finish. Crafted primarily from Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, it is aged in oak barrels to achieve its signature depth. While it can be enjoyed young for its fresh fruit, it possesses a significant drinking window and can be aged for 2 to 20 years.

title: St George Terroir Gin
bodyHtml: A profoundly lush and aromatic gin with a real sense of place, Terroir is our ode to the wild beauty of the Golden State. In your glass, it conveys what we love about the monumental groves of trees, moist and misty glens, and sun-baked chaparral of our favorite landscapes. Sip it and be transported.

title: Prieure de Montezargues Tavel Rose 2024
bodyHtml: A bright cherry pink, this Tavel rose shows aromas of yellow peach, red currant and blood orange. On the palate, this medium to full bodied wine has notes of cherry and Sicilian orange with sweet touches of almond and pastry cream. It has a long and elegant finish.

title: Venge Vineyards Scout's Honor Proprietary Red 2022
bodyHtml:
The 2022 Venge Vineyards Scout’s Honor Proprietary Red offers a bold and rich expression, rooted in Napa Valley’s renowned vineyards. This full-bodied blend primarily consists of Zinfandel, complemented by Charbono, Petite Sirah, and a small portion of Syrah. Each component contributes to a dynamic profile, with the Zinfandel providing vibrant fruit, and the Petite Sirah and Syrah adding depth, structure, and complexity.

Colour: Deep ruby with garnet highlights.
Aroma: Aromas of ripe blackberries, dark cherries, and licorice, with hints of pepper and sweet vanilla.
Palate: A concentrated burst of black fruits and currants, layered with spices and a touch of char.
Body: Full-bodied, with velvety tannins that enhance the wine’s richness.
Finish: Long, with lingering notes of dark fruit, oak, and peppery spice.

Aged for 14 months, with 50% of the barrels being new American oak, the 2022 vintage is crafted to be approachable upon release while also having the potential to age gracefully over the next 5-8 years. It pairs beautifully with grilled meats, such as lamb or beef, making it a versatile choice for hearty meals.

The wine honors the memory of Scout, the vineyard’s loyal Labrador, embodying the warmth and character of both the wine and its inspiration. This release continues the legacy of producing crowd-pleasing, fruit-forward wines perfect for both immediate enjoyment and cellaring.

title: Domaine Seguin Manuel Mercurey 'Vieilles Vignes' 2024
bodyHtml: With a nice purple colour, it possesses a lovely aromatic power of ripe red fruit aromas mingled with a hint of toasted oak notes. Good concentration, appealing and round on the palate, it has a velvety finish.

title: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Honey - Mini 50 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: This whiskey-based liqueur is a sweet take on a classic. Blending Jack Daniel's whiskey with real honey, for a one-of-a-kind flavour experience. Smooth texture with naturally sweet flavours are discovered on the palate along with a pleasant warming sensation. Enjoy on its own, over ice, add to coffee or use in cocktails.

title: Skyy Raspberry Vodka
bodyHtml: Skyy Infusions are made with natural flavours and water enriched with Pacific minerals - resulting in a truly superior liquid.

title: Taittinger Brut Reserve - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: A brilliant golden yellow color. The bubbles are fine, while the foam is discreet yet lingering. The nose, very open and expressive, delivers aromas of fruit and brioche. Fragrances are reminiscent of peach, white flowers (hawthorn, acacia) and vanilla. The palate is lively, crisp and harmonious. This is delicate wine with flavors of fresh fruit and honey.

title: Cain Concept The Benchland Napa Valley 2012
bodyHtml: The nose is fruity, aromatic and incisive. It reveals fine notes of wild flowers, cassis and blackberry associated with fine hints of Sichuan pepper, vegetal hints as well as discreet touches of jammy raspberry, discreet hints of spice and a fine touch of cinnamon.

title: Three Olives Vodka
bodyHtml: Three Olives is a premium vodka 4x distilled and filtered yielding an exceptionally pure and smooth vodka that is 100% GMO-free. The palate entry is silky, textured and enhanced with mineral notes. It is extremely mixable and can be used in a variety of cocktails ranging from a vodka soda to a Bloody Mary.

title: Corralejo Reposado Tequila
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
For nearly 250 years, the distillation methods of Hacienda Corralejo have been preserved, refined, and developed by the local community into a tradition of tequila.  From estate grown agave to estate bottling; great care is taken at each phase of production to ensure an impeccable high quality artisan product.

Light straw in the glass.   Aromas of sweet vanilla, honey, spice, hints of oak with flavors of lemon-lime, peppercorn, honey, oak, agave. The palate is medium-bodied with a smooth, warm finish.

title: Ryan's Irish Cream
bodyHtml:
Ryan's Irish Cream is made with dairy-fresh cream, rich chocolate, natural vanilla, and the finest imported Irish Whiskey for a critically-acclaimed taste.

Granted a gold medal from the International Spirits tasting panel for Smoothest Liqueur, Ryan's is an indulgent treat sipped neat, chilled, in hot or cold coffee or in an after-dinner cocktail.

title: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: Bright topaz, brilliant with gold and amber tints. Attractive orange notes with nuances of candied zests; vanilla flavours from the cognac. Full and ample; bitter oranges aromas balanced by cognac notes of hazelnuts and toffee. The finish is long and harmonious.

title: McGuinness Orange & Brandy
bodyHtml: After chocolate and vanilla, orange is the most popular flavour around the globe, although you don't need to travel very far to enjoy this naturally flavoured treat. Amber in the glass with aromas and flavours of sweet orange with spiced, nutmeg and herbs followed by a long, sweet and warming finish.

title: Sour Puss Raspberry
bodyHtml: Bright reddish-pink; raspberry with a slight herbal bitterness; sour, sweet and bitter raspberry flavour.

title: Canadian Club - 375 ml
bodyHtml: The legend of Canadian Club began in 1858 and grew to become one of the world's most iconic whiskies. Pouring a medium gold you will find aromas of roasted almond, vanilla and pepper; with spicy vanilla, cornflakes and a faint nutty flavour on a medium weight palate with a long finish.

title: Decoy Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Decoy was established in 1985 by legendary vintners Dan and Margaret Duckhorn, originally as a single second-label wine to support the Duckhorn Vineyards brand. Decoy has since evolved into a focused winery renowned for producing attractively priced wines that express their full charm and complexity in their youth.

Wine Description

On the nose, this Cabernet Sauvignon showcases rich blackberry and blueberry aromas with hints of baking spice and black pepper. The palate is full-bodied and bursting with juicy fruit, where flavours of black cherry, ripe plum, cranberry, and tapenade may be found, complemented by oak-inspired hints of nutmeg, vanilla, and cardamom. The wine is structured by strong, silky, mouthcoating tannins, with juicy acidity adding poise and energy. The finish is bold, smooth, and long, with a touch of spice.

Food Pairing

Hearty beef dishes, such as a cowboy ribeye steak frites with bearnaise, or Gnocchi Bolognese.

title: Laberinto Cenizas Pinot Noir
bodyHtml: Matured in old 400-litre barrels, this is fresh, crunchy and very mineral, all redcurrant, pomegranate and blood orange flavours and a savoury, earthy undertone. Delicious.

title: Laberinto Arcillas Riesling 2022
bodyHtml:
Clean, deep yellow-green color. It has an intense fruity and oily character with hints of quince and medlar on the one hand, and on the other, rich aromas of white flowers such as acacia and trees native to Colbún such as Quillay Saponina. On the palate it is a structured wine with good depth and rich acidity. 

Ideal with fish such as trout and all types of charcuterie.

title: Matsu Tempranillo El Recio 2023
bodyHtml: Tertiary aromas from the barrel, with notes of vanilla, pastries, cocoa and coconut. At the same time, it maintains freshness as fruit notes also dominate, especially red fruits and strawberry tones. Very balanced mouth, and full of complexity. Pleasant entry and very good tannic structure, with silky, velvety tannins: This combined with very good acidity gives it length.

title: Entre Lacs Red Wine - 16 Litre Box
bodyHtml: Ruby red colour; light fruit with a touch of earth; cranberry fruit flavour with tart finish.

title: Entre Lacs White Wine - 16 Litre Box
bodyHtml: Pale straw colour; light lemon-apple nose with a hint of the grape; soft, dry flavour; easy drinking.

title: Bolla Amarone Della Valpolicella L'Origini 2018
bodyHtml: Garnet hues and purplish rim, hints of tobacco, aromatic herbs and bottled fruit on the nose, with notes of chocolate, plum and morello cherry jam on the caressing palate. A finale nuanced with spice and balsam delivers a long, lingering finish.

title: Los Danzantes Coyote
bodyHtml:
Los Danzantes Coyote mezcal is produced from Coyote maguey, grown in the Rìo Flor area in Zimatlan de Alvarez.

It is cooked in an underground conical wood-fired oven fired with white oak. Fermentation is natural and lasts 8 days, in 800-litre wooden vats with indigenous yeasts. The discontinuous distillation process takes place in two stages.

Produced by Maestra Mezcalera Karina Abad Rojas, this mezcal is fresh and rounded.

title: Chateau Croizet Bages 2020
bodyHtml:
Chateau Croizet Bages is a prestigious Fifth Growth estate located in the Pauillac appellation of Bordeaux, France. Originally part of the larger Bages estate, it was acquired by the Croizet brothers in the 18th century before being purchased in 1942 by Paul Quié, a wine broker whose descendants, Anne Francoise and Jean Philippe Quié, continue to manage the property today. The estate’s winemaking philosophy focuses on the expression of its 27-hectare contiguous vineyard situated on deep gravelly soils, which produces structured wines known for their balance and longevity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep ruby-red colour and an expressive sensory profile. The nose is complex, offering a bouquet of blackcurrant, dark cherry, and blackberry layered with savory hints of cedar, tobacco, and subtle vanilla from French oak. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and velvety, showcasing ripe dark fruits, dark chocolate, and a touch of spice supported by firm yet polished tannins.

Accolades

  • "Vinous - 94 points."

  • "James Suckling - 93 points."

  • "Decanter - 92 points."

Food Pairing

This Pauillac is best served with classic meat dishes such as grilled red meats, roasts, or a hearty beef stew. It also pairs exceptionally well with mature cheeses like Manchego or savory dishes featuring mushrooms and truffles.

title: Skorpios 1618 Tequila Blanco Tahona
bodyHtml:
A delicious taste of smooth and complex with a distinct and traditional taste.

An ultra-smooth, yet complex inter woven flavors of citrus, butter, earth, cooked agave and volcanic stone. A perfect expression of the land of Jalisco – water, earth, land and agave fields. A long and deep taste of pure crisp and traditional, artisanal notes.

title: E Jamu Rabizza Sangiovese
bodyHtml:
E Jamu Rabizza Sangiovese originates from Italy. Produced by Rabizza, this wine embodies a commitment to expressing authentic regional character and traditional winemaking philosophy.

Wine Description

E Jamu Rabizza Sangiovese presents a bright ruby red colour with garnet reflections. The nose opens with inviting aromas of fresh red cherries, crushed blackberries, wild herbs, and a subtle hint of savoury spice. On the palate, this medium-bodied wine delivers vibrant acidity and soft, well-integrated tannins, featuring rich flavours of ripe red plum, tart cherry, and subtle earthiness. The experience concludes with a clean, refreshing, and balanced finish with lingering fruit notes.

title: La Gioiosa Aurea Prosecco Treviso
bodyHtml: The aroma is fruity and flowery with hints of ripe golden apple and small mountain flowers. The dry, fresh and flavoursome sensation on the palate is followed by a fruity and harmonious aftertaste.

title: Tengumai Yamahai Jikomi Junmai - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
The brewery was founded in 1823 during the late Edo period by the first generation of the Shata family, who established the facility at the foot of the sacred Mount Haku. Now led by the eighth generation of the family, the brewery is famously named 'Tengumai' (meaning 'Dance of the Goblin') because it was said the sake was so delicious that even the mystical forest-dwelling Tengu would dance after drinking it.

Description

This sake is distinguished by its characteristic golden yellow colour and a bold sensory profile. The aroma is rich and complex, featuring funky notes of mushroom and earthy tones alongside hints of spicy walnut bread and honeyed mead. On the palate, it offers a buttery mouthfeel with a dry, acidic, and earthy first impression that reveals more floral notes when served chilled. It is a full-bodied sake that balances deep umami with a crisp, long-lasting finish. The alcohol content is 16%.

Food Pairing

The intense tartness and full-bodied nature of this Yamahai style make it a versatile partner for many cuisines. It pairs exceptionally well with rich, umami-forward dishes such as miso, teriyaki, or sukiyaki. Its lactic acidity also complements Western options like mushroom risotto, charcuterie, or pungent cheeses like Comté and cheddar. For an ideal experience, serve this sake warmed to 40°C to highlight the harmony between its acidity and savoury umami flavours.

title: Domaine Altugnac Pinot Noir Les Turitelles 2024
bodyHtml:
Domaine Altugnac Les Turitelles Pinot Noir 2024 is an elegant red wine crafted in the Pays d'Oc region within the southern Languedoc-Roussillon territory of France. Established in 1997 by childhood friends and Mâcon co-owners Christian Collovray and Jean-Luc Terrier, the estate is now managed alongside their sons, Julien and Pierre-Alexis. The family's winemaking philosophy focuses on utilizing high-elevation terroirs reaching up to 500 metres, where significant day-to-night temperature variations and limestone-centric soils ensure a slow, complete maturation that gives the wine its distinct freshness and regional character.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir displays a beautiful, light garnet color in the glass. The sensory profile opens with an expressive and perfumed nose of red fruit, showcasing vibrant aromas of Montmorency cherry, raspberry, and blueberry, accented by hints of fine spices like nutmeg, cinnamon, and a touch of mocha. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and beautifully balanced, framing its juicy strawberry and blackcurrant flavours with soft, velvety tannins and a wonderfully dry structure. Driven by a lovely natural freshness and complexity, it flows into a smooth, clean finish that highlights the delicate finesse of the varietal.

title: Gianni Gagliardo Barolo 'La Morra' 2017
bodyHtml:
Gianni Gagliardo's 2017 Barolo del Comune di La Morra is a distinguished expression of Nebbiolo from the La Morra commune within Italy's esteemed Barolo region. This wine exemplifies the elegance and aromatic finesse characteristic of La Morra's terroir.

Winemaking and Aging

The 2017 vintage was marked by challenging conditions, including early warmth and subsequent hailstorms, which necessitated meticulous vineyard management. Despite these challenges, Gianni Gagliardo produced a wine that reflects the resilience and quality of the Nebbiolo grape. The wine underwent traditional fermentation processes, followed by aging in large oak casks to enhance its complexity and structure.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Bright garnet red.

  • Nose: Aromatic layers of violets, cherries, and subtle earth, with hints of licorice and herbs.

  • Palate: Smooth and well-structured, featuring red fruit flavors with vibrant acidity and a touch of minerality.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with refined tannins.

  • Finish: Long and balanced, with lingering floral and savory notes.

Serving and Pairing

This Barolo pairs beautifully with red meats, game dishes, and mature cheeses. It is approachable now with decanting but will continue to evolve with cellaring over the next 10–15 years, revealing deeper complexity as it matures.

title: Prima Pave Sparkling Rose Dolce (Non Alcoholic)
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Prima Pavé Sparkling Rosé Dolce is a non alcoholic wine handcrafted in Northern Italy. The brand was founded by hospitality entrepreneurs and Certified Specialists of Wine, Dejou and Marco Marano, who partnered with a progressive Italian winemaker to create a sophisticated alcohol free collection that honours terroir and tradition.

Spirit Description

This sweet sparkling rosé presents an elegant pink hue and a shimmering, fine perlage. The aromatic profile is expressive, featuring scents of wild strawberry, raspberry, and rose petal, layered with candied citrus and a hint of warm caramelized honey. On the palate, it delivers a lush and silky texture with juicy notes of red berries, blood orange, candied lychee, and peach. The body is full and round, balanced by a bright, refreshing acidity that leads to a clean floral finish. This beverage contains 0.0% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The delicate sweetness and vibrant structure of this wine make it a versatile companion for both spicy and sweet fare. It pairs exceptionally well with rich and salty cheeses like Parmigiano Reggiano, gorgonzola, or soft ripened goat cheese. For a more substantial match, it complements spicy international cuisines such as lamb vindaloo, Korean BBQ, and Szechuan tofu. It is also a natural partner for fruit based desserts, including raspberry macarons, strawberry shortcake, and fruit tarts.

Distinctive Features

Prima Pavé Sparkling Rosé Dolce is distinguished by its 'terroir driven' blend of sustainably farmed grapes, including Montepulciano d'Abruzzo, Pinot Grigio, Sauvignon Blanc, and Gewürztraminer. The wine is crafted using a proprietary, low intervention dealcoholization process through reverse osmosis filtration, which takes place over several weeks to preserve the complex flavours and mouthfeel of a traditional fermented wine. This award winning product is vegan friendly, gluten free, and Non GMO certified, containing 0.0% alcohol and no added sugar or artificial chemicals.

Serving Suggestions

To best enjoy its lively fruit notes and fine bubbles, this sparkling wine should be served well chilled at a temperature between 6°C and 8°C. It is ideally presented in a champagne flute, tulip, or coupe glass to enhance its delicate floral aromatics and visual appeal. For an extra touch of sparkle, a lemon twist may be added to further balance the natural sweetness. This 'Dolce' style is suitable for any festive occasion, from intimate picnics and baby showers to black tie events and milestone celebrations.

title: Poggio alle Gazze Dell' Ornellaia 2021
bodyHtml:
Poggio alle Gazze dell’Ornellaia is one of Italy’s most innovative and progressive white wines, providing an altogether different experience of the Ornellaia estate and its Mediterranean influences.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

An elegant, complex nose offers lime, citrus blossom and gooseberry, then mixed dried herbs and an almost imperceptible but essential umami undertone of Parmesan rind. The balance between savory and citrus continues on the palate, where a mineral backbone and substantive acidity provide structure within a rich, satiny texture.

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Reminiscent of a great Bordeaux Blanc, it opens in the glass to aromas of Meyer lemon oils, green pineapple, jasmine, and white peaches. It’s medium-bodied, although it has phenomenal concentration and length without ever feeling austere. It floats across the palate with ease and is mouthwatering, with a fantastic finish. An exceptional wine.

93 Points - James Suckling

Sliced apple, pineapple, apricot and crushed stone aromas follow through to a medium body with creamy texture and pleasant bitter lemon flavors at the end.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

92 Points - Wine Spectator

title: Enguera Sueno de Megala
bodyHtml: Deep dark red colour, brick tones on the rim. Notes of stewed fruit and compote stand out, but the freshness of the Mediterranean style is maintained. Floral and fresh fruit aromas are preserved, but also aromatic herbs such as mint, rosemary and scrub. The clove stands out among the spicy aromas, white pepper, curry notes. High concentration, great volume and breadth on the palate, well polished sweet tannins. Excellent balance, very long and pleasant aftertaste on the palate.

title: La Carlina Langhe Nebbiolo 2024
bodyHtml: Light red with ruby sparks. A warm and fruity bouquet with dried rose petals scents and blackberry and blueberry aromas. Full bodied, chewy and rich with dusty tannins and a juicy yet elegant finish.

title: Cuma Malbec 2021
bodyHtml: Intense aromas of blueberry and pomegranate burst through on the nose. Juicy black cherry, plum and almost brambly flavours appear on the palate that stays fresh from first to last sip. Try it alongside as well as in the sauce of your next pot roast.

title: Francois Chidaine Touraine Rouge 2023
bodyHtml: A trio of quintessentially Loire grapes come together in a red most ravishing! Francois and Manuela Chidaine have been making some of the region’s most distinctive wines since the late ‘80s, among the earliest proponents of biodynamic winemaking and regenerative agriculture. Ripe, peppered & a touch vegetal with a gleaming heart of gold – red-verging-on-black fruit, bright acid & Dusty Springfield tannins.

title: Cave de Cairanne la Grande Reserve 2020
bodyHtml: Very perfumed, with soft plum, fragrant black raspberry, and ripe strawberry across an expansive, gilded palate framed with softly cushioned tannins threaded with pink peppercorn. A fresh stony acidity can lift this big red through a saline finish.

title: Fiol Prosecco Rose 2021
bodyHtml: Mesmerizing coral shade with subtle pink reflections. On the nose, fruity aromas of raspberry and wild strawberry with hints of citrus lemons and white flowers. Refreshing and elegant expression of FIOL, with the Pinot Noir shining through, showcasing a harmonious palate and persistent finish.

title: Contra Soarda Gaggion Marzemino Nero 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Veneto region of Italy, specifically within the volcanic hills of San Michele di Bassano del Grappa, this wine is a pure expression of the indigenous Marzemino Nero grape. The Gottardi family established the Contra Soarda estate in 1999, reclaiming abandoned, rugged terrain to build a bio-architectural cellar integrated into the mountainside. Their winemaking philosophy centers on low intervention, organic farming, and a deep respect for the land's volcanic heritage.

Wine Description

This 100% Marzemino Nero presents a striking dark ruby-red colour with purple highlights. The aromatic profile is intense and focused, leading with scents of wild berries, black cherry, and mountain herbs, complemented by delicate notes of black pepper and violet. On the palate, the wine is dry and medium bodied, offering a lively acidity and firm yet well-integrated tannins that balance flavors of macerated plums, dark fruit, and a hint of tobacco.

Food Pairing

The wine's bright acidity and rustic structure make it an excellent partner for tomato-based dishes like pasta Bolognese or hearty mushroom polenta. It also pairs beautifully with roasted white meats, grilled poultry, or mature local cheeses.

title: Feudo Montoni Terre di Elio Nerello Mascalese 2021
bodyHtml: Aged in cement tanks and has very little contact with wood to highlight its subtle and timid texture on the palate. The color is pale ruby, on the nose are hints of wild catmint, wormwood, and laurel, together with scents of rose petals and of lily.

title: Weninger Pinot Noir
bodyHtml:
Franz Weninger’s vineyards are certified biodynamic producing natural wines on two sides of the Burgenland border – both in Austria and Hungary.  Franz’s father was a pioneer of organic farming in Hungary during the 1980s, and as a result, for Franz, organic farming became not just the only way, but the minimum practice.

After travelling to study & practice winemaking, Franz returned to the family winery in 1999.  Soon enough, he began taking their farming practices to the next level by converting everything to biodynamics, and replanting vineyards needing rehabilitation with traditional grape varieties.  He hasn’t pulled out his father’s old-vine plantings of international varieties, and so while the estate boasts an eclectic array of grape varieties, the focus is clearly on Blaufränkisch and the patchwork of ancient soils that make up the estate.

title: Glup Naranjo 2021
bodyHtml: This ‘GLUP’ is 100% fragrant moscatel (aka muscat) that was fermented on skins for six months to extract a woven basket of texture to catch all the ripe fruits in. Yellow in colour with golden edges, lychee, elderflower, mandarin, Sichuan peppercorn, wild mint & citrus concentrate. Pour alongside grilled octopus with lots of herbs.

title: Empirical Spirits - Ayyuk
bodyHtml:
The smoky Pasilla Mixe chili is the sole botanical and the source of all the complexity in Ayuuk. After distillation the best fractions are rested in a sherry Oloroso cask, allowing the flavors to infuse and mature with each other, giving a smooth, distinct and savory finish. 

Serve over ice, with grapefruit soda and a squeeze of lime for the perfect Paloma. Or try Ayuuk with Ginger Beer.

title: Empirical Spirits - The Plum, I Suppose
bodyHtml: The kernel inside plum stones is the foundation of this spirit. Rather than tasting of stone fruit, the kernel lends a marzipan, bitter almond flavor. Distilled marigold kombucha brings another side of floral and tannic notes reminiscent of plum skins; the combination is sort of the suggestion of plum, hence the reference to the Robert Frost poem. Perception of sweetness with a refreshing finish. Keep refrigerated.

title: Alzinger Riesling Durnstein Federspiel 2021
bodyHtml: Weingut Alzinger is located on a magnificent stretch of the Danube 65km west of Vienna, on a majestic bend where the great river sweeps past Unterloiben in the region of Wachau. This is surely one of the most spectacular wine regions in the world, so stunningly beautiful that it has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

title: Flor del Desierto Carnei Sotol
bodyHtml: Sotol Ono is made with Dasylirion Cedrosanum, which takes 12 to 15 years to reach maturity in the wild. The sotol is pulled out of the earth with axes, and the spiny leaves are cut from the pinas to transport to the Vinata. Once in the Vinata, Maestro Gerardo Ruelas roasts the pinas for about 3 days, then grinds them by hand using axes and knives. The plants then ferment for 5 and 7 days, depending on the weather, before being distilled.

title: Francois Chidaine Petillant 2019
