bodyHtml: Chidaine’s Pet Nat is stunning. Gorgeous notes of citrus, quince and and stone fruit blossoms in the nose give way to a sophisticated sparkler with fine mineral notes and crisp acidity. The texture is fresh and linear but shows evidence of lees contact in the mouth.

title: Averill Creek Joue White Blend 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Tense, textured and highly mineral - a delicate nose of white flower and fresh rain invites a lush mid-palate, culminating in a structured, firm finish.

title: Torre Zambra Pecorino 'Poggio Salaia' 2025
bodyHtml: This full-bodied white wine is made from Pecorino grapes grown on the Salaia estate in the Abruzzo region of Italy. It is characterized by salinity and fruit flavors that include citrus and apricot, as well as floral notes of white rose and acacia. Its balance of acidity and body makes it a versatile wine that pairs well with many types of food.

title: Checkmate Merlot 'Silent Bishop' 2020
bodyHtml:
The von Mandl family began their journey over 40 years ago. The first sign of the real potential of the vineyards came in 1994 with a surprise win at the International Wine & Spirit Competition in London for ‘Top Chardonnay in the World.’ The family has developed exceptional vineyards with distinctive Chardonnay and Merlot clones, some of which are now over 40 years old, at what are now CheckMate Artisanal Winery vineyards.

A nose of intense red and black fruits, floral notes, coffee, tobacco and spice. The palate has well-balanced acidity, fruit and oak; producing a wine of harmony and length.

title: Castro Ventosa Valtuille Mencia
bodyHtml: Dark ruby-colored, this wine reveals an enticing perfume of baking spices, eucalyptus/pine notes, black cherry, and black raspberry. It is smooth-textured, sand fruit-forward, making it a terrific introduction to the Mencia grape.

title: Laurent Lequart Millesime 2015
bodyHtml:
This vintage is made from a blend of equal parts Meunier and Chardonnay matured in oak barrels. This cuvee reflects the richness and purity of an exceptional vintage.

The nose is delicate, evoking light notes of toasted bread, sea spray, pistachio, almond, candied pear. It evolves with aeration towards notes of orange blossom, honey, butter, hazelnut and roasting. The palate is rich and assertive with a creamy effervescence and a fruity pulp, borrowed from vinosity and salinity finely supported by a lemony and orange acidity.

title: Provenance Vineyards Deadeye Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
A classic Monterey County Chardonnay, this wine offers ripe, tropical aromas of pineapple softened by notes of baked apple and brioche. The palate of this medium-bodied wine unfolds with layers peaches and Asian pears, melting into a long, lasting finish with a sumptuous mouth-feel.

This Chardonnay makes a great accompaniment to seafood, poultry, or pork. Pair with a spicy curry-based sauce or with lightly-aged sheep's milk cheeses.

91 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of ripe apricots and mangoes with pastry crust, almonds and honeysuckle. Medium- to full-bodied with creamy texture. Polished and sleek with mineral undertones.

title: Catoctin Creek Roundstone Rye Cask Proof
bodyHtml: The cask proof version of the ever-popular Roundstone Rye is a very special expression. Delicious, dark, complex and ridiculously smooth for the proof, with notes of chocolate, tanned leather, and tobacco.

title: Catoctin Creek Roundstone Rye 80 Proof Single Barrel
bodyHtml: Roundstone Rye is a very unique rye whisky, made completely from scratch at our distillery in Purcellville, Virginia.  This pre-Prohibition style rye whisky is made from 100% rye grain, sourced locally when available.  It is mashed, fermented, distilled and aged completely in our distillery, before bottling it at a very sippable 80 proof.  Aged in new charred white oak casks for a period of around two years, the whisky is smooth, woody, with that full-bodied fruity-nutty grain flavor typical of a Virginia rye whisky. Roundstone Rye has a delicious woody taste, with notes of caramel, rich butter toffee, and just a hint of lemon in the nose.

title: 291 Colorado Rye Small Batch
bodyHtml:
291 Colorado Whiskey is a uniquely American story – honoring the Western whiskey of a bygone era, 291 is the passion project of a former New York City fashion photographer and was first created in a small basement from a one-of-a-kind still constructed from old copper photographic plates. 

291 is Hardmade the Colorado Way, grain to barrel to bottle, and the distillery’s whiskeys are finished with toasted staves of Colorado aspen trees. 291 has been earning awards and recognition since its first run off the still in 2011.

Picture in the Wild West. Leather, dirt roads, cowboys, mountains, the good, the bad, and the ugly. A mash bill similar to Seelbach's founder's all-time favorite rye whiskeys. Distilled grain to glass and finished with the help of deep charred American white oak barrels. Toasted aspen staves takes the caramel notes to maple and give our whiskey a distinct Colorado flavor reminiscent of a time long passed.

title: Domaine Muzard Lucien et Fils Premier Cru Santenay Gravieres 2023
bodyHtml:
This elegant red wine hails from the Santenay Premier Cru appellation in the Côte de Beaune region of Burgundy, France. The estate has been managed by the Muzard family since 1645, with brothers Claude and Hervé now representing the ninth generation of winemakers at the domaine. Their philosophy focuses on a deep respect for the land and traditional winemaking techniques, including hand-harvesting and the use of indigenous yeasts, to create wines that authentically embody the Burgundy terroir.

Wine Description

Gravieres presents a deep, lightly pigmented ruby colour in the glass. The nose is seductively aromatic, revealing intense notes of strawberries and crushed raspberries complemented by subtle floral hints of rose and a delicate buttery touch. On the palate, the wine is magnificently smooth and unctuous, featuring a full, velvety mid-palate where the tannins are finely coated by ripe fruit. This 100% Pinot Noir displays a refined complexity and a savory, classic style with a persistent, graceful finish.

Food Pairing

This wine's rich texture and nuanced fruit profile make it an ideal companion for roasted poultry such as duck or turkey. It also pairs exceptionally well with savory game birds and slow-cooked casseroles that mirror its smooth, structured character.

title: Andreas Bartel Champagne Brut (NV)
bodyHtml:
Andreas Bartel Champagnes are the expression of the terroir of the Cote de Bar. This fruity and generous wine surprises with its flexibility and freshness.

To be enjoyed as an aperitif or during a meal, in combination with white meat or fish.

title: Rivetto Langhe Nascetta 2020
bodyHtml:
Solid, naturally made full class wine. Golden yellow color with thick tears. Variegated aroma with mineral notes, white fruits, gooseberry. Spicy taste with distinguished texture, slim and raspy with fine acidity and a long fresh fruity aftertaste.

Goes well with noble white sea fish, fried or grilled, with refined sauces. Also with leafy vegetables and white mold cheeses.

title: Lost Lantern American Vatted Malt No 1
bodyHtml: Lost Lantern American Vatted Malt Edition No. 1 is one of the first blends of single malts ever made in the United States. More than that, it represents the whiskey world’s true spirit of collaboration and harmony. Lost Lantern brought together the founders and distillers behind some of the country’s most distinctive single malts, all of whom hand-selected barrels for an in-person collaborative blending session. Over the course of a single marathon day, we worked, tasted, and blended together. The result was this unique and special blend.

title: Hardy's HRB Cabernet Sauvignon 2017
bodyHtml: Fresh and bountiful aromas of dark bramble fruits, mulberry, violets, mint, chocolate and black olive. A dense and complex palate exhibiting rich dark berry fruit flavours, and dark chocolate, cassis with hints of mint, tobacco leaf and well integrated fine grain French oak. The palate has layers of flavour, elegant balance, and finishes with an abundance of fine silky tannins.

title: Faiveley Mercurey 'Vieilles Vignes' 2021
bodyHtml:
This Cote Chalonnaise village takes its name from the God Mercury (God of trade). Mercurey is intersected by the Agrippa road which linked Chalon-sur-Saône to Autun in the Roman era. The wines of Mercurey have given this village its reputation throughout the world. Mercurey is one of the largest wine regions in Bourgogne with over 600 ha of vignes.

The palate reveals a smooth, fruity attack and evolves towards notes of ripe red berries and a touch of vanilla. An intensely aromatic wine with a delicate structure and silky smooth tannins that will win over wine experts and amateurs alike.

title: Proclamation Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Proclamation Whiskey celebrates the birth of the Proclamation and Ireland’s independent spirit. A full-bodied extra smooth whiskey that has been matured in ex-Bourbon casks and has been deftly blended with a touch of sherry finished malt to give it a rounded toasted finish.

A triple-distilled whiskey with a distinctive character thanks to the artful blending of casks both rich and elegant interweaving through them mellow cereal tones with gentle tannins. Certainly a blended whiskey that is worth savouring.

title: Sorgin Gin
bodyHtml: From Bordeaux winemaker Sabine Jaren, this gin is distilled from Sauvignon Blanc and other grapes, and puts fruity sweetness front and center, reading more like a brandy than a traditional gin. Candied grape and a hint of dark fruit mingles with hints of lime and ginger heat, leading into a floral exhale. The botanical mix includes blackcurrant buds, grapefruit and violet.

title: Castelvecchi Solana Super Tuscan 2018
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
The Fattoria di Castelvecchi boasts an illustrious historical past, with the ancient winery dating back to the tenth or eleventh century, excavated beneath the castle. The estate's significance is tied to its strategic location in the heart of Tuscany, situated between Florence and Siena. The name 'Solana' is a tribute to a historic owner of the estate, Marquis Abelardo Gutierrez de la Solana, who contributed to the territory's reputation for quality wine over a century ago.

Wine Description

In the glass, it shows an intense red colour with purple overtones. The sensory profile is elegant and intense; the perfume features notes of violet, rose, and balsamic herbs. These aromatic notes warrant hints of red fruits such as blackberry, wild strawberries, and candied fruit, which evolve into a delicate, refined bouquet of spices. On the palate, the wine is described as wide and elegant, supported by soft tannins and scents of spices such as cloves and pepper, coffee, and chocolate.

Food Pairing

Given its bold flavours and robust tannins, the 'Solana' Super Tuscan pairs wonderfully with rich, savoury dishes. Suggested pairings include second dishes featuring red meat, such as roasted or grilled steak or lamb, and rich pasta dishes like those with Bolognese or creamy sauces.

title: Guidi Selezione Vernaccia di San Gimignano 2023
bodyHtml: A wine with purity of fruit and complexity. The wine is driven by overripe peach, fresh honey, baked golden raisin bread and blanched almond skin. A wine great with seafood and salty foods.

title: Flat Rock Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml: Innovative Flat Rock Cellars specializes in crafting elegant Pinot Noir. This excellent wine is a great introduction, with its flavours of berry preserves, herbs, blood orange and watermelon. It works well with grilled salmon or with veal in a red wine reduction.

title: Cantina Vini Tipici Dell'Aretino Chianti Riserva De'Vasari 2019
bodyHtml: Cantina dei Vini Tipici dell’ Aretino is an association of winemakers bringing together more than 400 members. Collectively, they own more than 800 hectares of vineyards under cultivation, specializing in Arezzo area of Tuscany, and the production of organically farmed grapes for production of Chianti.

title: Renato Ratti Barolo Marcenasco 2020 - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml: Garnet red color with a bouquet of licorice and tobacco. Noble and generous, glory of old Piedmont, this wine is suitable for aging. It conquers the palate with the conviction of strength, harmony and fullness and holds its sway at length. Barolo Marcenasco is smooth, balanced, elegant and faithfully, best to drink between 6 to 12 years after the vintage. Pair this wine with red meats on the spit or grilled, game, "grande cuisine", white and red meat dishes and aged cheeses.

title: Chiorri Grechetto 'Titus' 2023
bodyHtml: Grechetto by Chiorri winery is a fruity but dry white wine with aromas of lemon heads, crisp opal apple, strawberries and a juicy acidity. It can be considered a great Italian alternative to un-oaked Chardonnay or Pinot Gris.

title: Cantina Marilina Currivu Rosso
bodyHtml: The Marilina Currivu Rosso is made from a blend of Nero d'Avola and Merlot made from grapes hand-harvested from vineyards in the San Lorenzo District of south eastern Sicily. Juicy and fruit forward, the wine was vinified and aged in concrete tanks for 8 months.

title: Servin Chablis 'Les Pargues' 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: The 'Les Pargues' Chablis is expressive, fresh, clean, medium-bodied, succulent, has solid acidity. Flavors of tree fruits, passion fruit, mint, lemon, lime, pineapple, kiwi, cream, vanilla, minerals, and floral notes lead seamlessly into the clean and dry finish that exhibits very fine length. Will pair well with lemon risotto.

title: Azimut Cava Brut Nature Rosato
bodyHtml:
The Azimut Rosato is produced from Monastell and Garnacha. Using the traditional method, the same as that used in the production of Champagne, the wine was given a short period of time on the skins to draw out a delicate strawberry salmon hue.

The palate is dominated by vibrant red fruit notes and crunchy minerality. Given that this wine received no dosage of sugar, the finish is bone dry.

title: Zarate Albarino 2025
bodyHtml: Fresh, clean nose with fresh white fruit and citric notes. The palate is packed with fresh fruit flavors and mineral notes, crisp acidity, and quite vivacious.

title: Bushmills Original Irish Whiskey - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Bushmills Original Irish Whiskey is produced at the historic Old Bushmills Distillery in County Antrim, Northern Ireland. As the world's oldest licensed whiskey distillery, it was granted a royal licence to distill by King James I in 1608 and has been officially registered since 1784. Now owned by Proximo Spirits, the distillery continues its long-standing philosophy of triple distillation and the use of 100% malted barley in its malt whiskey components to ensure a signature smooth and approachable character.

Whisky Description

This blended Irish whiskey presents a light golden or medium honey hue in the glass. The nose is bright and fresh, offering inviting aromas of honey, vanilla, and fresh fruit such as green apples and pears, accented by subtle hints of spice. On the palate, it is light-bodied and remarkably smooth, featuring a gentle warming sensation with flavors of vanilla ice cream, crème brûlée, and a touch of honey sweetness.

title: Lamole di Lamole Gran Selezione 2017
bodyHtml: A concentrated, bright ruby red color acts as a prelude to the bouquet of violets and red and black berry fruits, which mingle attractively with spicy and balsamic aromas. On the palate, it is powerful and vigorous, dynamic and elegant.

title: Bodegas Caudalia Umea Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Husband and wife team Ivan Lopez Barco and Raquel Grandival Allende share a philosophy to respect the earth and the environment that surrounds them, to show the maximum varietal expression of their grapes. 

With deep knowledge and experience, the dream of turning their passion for wine into a way of life came to fruition in 2010. Sustainable farming practices are a principle of their work, as they seek biological balance through minimal intervention, allowing the land to freely express itself.

title: Francois Le Saint Sancerre Silex 2022
bodyHtml: This sauvignon blanc is certified organic and biodynamically farmed, from 35 year old vines grown on a 3.15ha plot of clay soils with flint and marls, native fermented. A broken stone base lines this medium white, with lemon pith and peel, anjou pear, white grapefruit, and ample mineral salts that turn into lingering flint on the finish.

title: Don Mateo Cupreata Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Don Mateo Mezcal is a unique and brand and new appellation not only in Alberta, but also in Canada as it’s the only Mezcal of its kind from the State of Michoacan in Mexico which is located in the center west of the Mexican Republic, on the extreme southwest of the central highlands.

Most of these Agaves are Wild and Organic, and, at the Don Mateo Distillery they practice a lot of biodynamic techniques. Mezcal Don Mateo is also part of the Bat-Friendly program/certification as bats are very important for the pollination of wild agave. These are also high altitude agave grown and located at 2,000 to 2,600 meters above the sea level.

Last but not least, these are brand new Agave varieties that are indigenous to the Michoacán Terroir, making Don Mateo a point of difference in the rest of this category in all 9 different Mezcal Appellations as almost 95% of Mezcals available in the province come from the Mexican State of Oaxaca (South). Mezcals from the State of Michoacán are often called: “The XO’s of Mezcals” due to their complexity notes and fine drinkability!

title: Bacardi Spiced Rum - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Aging in select charred oak barrels imparts hints of smoke, rounded out by notes of dried fruits, creamy butterscotch, maple, custard and a balancing spicy, peppery finish. Filtering through a secret blend of charcoals gives this its signature smooth taste while allowing its bold characteristics to shine through.

title: Crotin Spumante Rosato
bodyHtml: This is literally summer in a bottle! A blend of Freisa, Barbera and Pinot Noir create this beautifully dry wine that is filled with sunshine. Fresh, tart summer berries, chalk, white blossom and pink citrus. Need I say more? Pair with a buttery brie cheese.

title: Calicantus Sollazzo Rosato
bodyHtml: Sollazzo, meaning “fun under the sun,” is made with Corvina, Rondinella, Molinara, and a little Sangiovese from a west-facing site planted in pergola. This is a fairly fertile plot, less calcareous than the vineyards that make the Bardolino Classico wines.

title: J Wilkes Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: This wine opens with dense, ripe aromas of black currant, cherry, toffee, hints of cigar box and a touch of baking spices. Flavors of blue and blackberry fruits, fig, raspberry jam and subtle notes of mocha and sweet pipe tobacco fill the palate.

title: Lunaria Ramoro Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Lunaria Ramoro Pinot Grigio originates from Italy, within the Abruzzo region and the coastal Terre di Chieti subregion. The wine is produced by Cantina Orsogna, a cooperative company established in 1964 that has grown to become a massive producer of organic and biodynamic wines in southern central Italy. Under the innovative 'Lunaria' brand, the winery operates with a philosophy focused on ethical harmony with nature, human community, and environmental preservation, which includes supporting the WWF LIFE Euroturtles project to protect Mediterranean sea turtles.

Wine Description

This unique white wine behaves like an orange or ramato style selection, presenting a bright copper-orange or rose-gold appearance and possessing a rich, medium-bodied palate texture. The sensory profile is floaty, ethereal, and highly intense, opening with a vibrant nose of yellow pulp fruits, pink grapefruit, ripe apricots, and fresh peaches, balanced by floral top notes. On the savoury, texturally complex palate, it delivers an expressive tropical fruit salad character highlighting soft guava, melon, and mango. The finish is bone dry, clean, and remarkably fresh, leaving a persistent, herbal, and sapid impression.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Grigio.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its traditional with a twist framework, undergoing a spontaneous fermentation with indigenous yeasts alongside approximately 30 days of direct grape skin contact in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats before refining in concrete tanks.

  • ABV: 12% to 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: Reflecting the cooperative's core philosophy, this bottling is fully certified organic, biodynamic by Demeter standards, and registered as vegan-friendly.

Food Pairing

The deep skin-contact texture, zesty fruit profiles, and savoury complexity of this Ramoro selection make it an incredibly versatile pairing option for full-flavoured meals.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with grilled shrimp and cucumber wraps, cod fillets, steamed shellfish, or traditional fish soups.

  • Poultry & Meats: Suggested pairings include roasted chicken dishes, light pork sliders, or white meats tossed with fresh summer garden salads.

  • Light Fare: Complements casual first courses accompanied by light herbal or cream sauces and vegetable appetizers.

title: Cuvaison Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml:
92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This complex and rather full-bodied wine offers interesting nuances of herbs, minerals and citrus on a broad texture with a light tanginess behind them. Good depth and concentration add to a lingering finish.

title: Sheringham Beacon Gin
bodyHtml: Formerly Kazuki Gin, “Beacon” embodies a sense of place, signifying two monumental sites on Vancouver Island where Sheringham Distillery originated–the iconic Sheringham Point Lighthouse beacon located by our first distillery and the beloved springtime cherry blossom-lined Beacon Hill Park. Brilliant floral and fruitiness of the cherry blossoms deliver polished and rounded edges with soft citrus notes of yuzu and grapefruit, and local green tea leaves and flowers give a delicate herbaceous note through to the finish. Beacon Gin is elegant on its own and brilliantly nuanced in a Sheringham cocktail.

title: Tenuta de Castellaro Ypsilon
bodyHtml:
A blend that harmonizes three red berries characteristic of Lipari, Sicily and Etna: Corinto, Nero d'Avola and Alicante in a wine ready to drink, purple and full-bodied that maintains freshness and minerality.

Low temperature vinification with short maceration of the wine with the skins. No clarification takes place, only static decantation and repeated racking to make the wine naturally clear before bottling.

A red wine that takes its name from the geographical shape of the Aeolian archipelago, which draws a Ypsilon lying on the sea, off the Sicilian coast.

title: Muriel Gran Reserva 2016
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Characteristic ruby ​​red with an orangey rim from maturation. Very intense, with aromas of vanilla, coffee, spices and ripe fruit, combined with hints of maturation in the bottle: leather, dried leaves, tobacco. Smooth and silky, with a lot of personality.

title: Baron De La Ley Reserva 2019 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Ruby-red colour. On the nose it surprises you with its powerful fruity character mingling with reminders of its noble ageing, traces of coconut, toffee and attractive wild herb nuances. After a powerful attack the sensation of soft, supple volume gradually extends across the palate to end with a long finish. In the aftertaste you are again reminded of the red-berry fruit mingled with hints of wild herbs.

title: Harlan Estate 2019
bodyHtml:
The 2019 Harlan Estate is a red wine from Napa Valley, California. Known for its exceptional quality, Harlan Estate consistently produces wines that exemplify the unique terroir of the region and the vision of its founders.

Vineyard and Production

Situated in the western hills of Oakville, Harlan Estate spans approximately 240 acres, with 40 acres under vine. The vineyards are planted on hillside sites with volcanic and sedimentary bedrock, featuring thin, well-drained soils that contribute to the wine’s intensity and complexity. The 2019 growing season was favorable, with a long, even ripening period, allowing for full phenolic development and refined tannin structure. The wine was aged in French oak barrels, ensuring depth, elegance, and longevity.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Deep garnet-purple hue.
  • Aroma: Expressive bouquet of blackberries, cassis, and dark cherries, with underlying notes of cedar, dark chocolate, truffle, and dried herbs.
  • Palate: Full-bodied and impeccably structured, with layers of ripe dark fruit, tobacco, cocoa, and graphite. The tannins are finely integrated, providing a seamless balance of richness, power, and elegance. The finish is long and persistent, leaving impressions of spice, crushed rocks, and fresh florals.

Critical Acclaim

  • Wine Advocate: 100 points – Praised for its depth, layered complexity, and seamless texture. Noted for its rich yet fresh character, with a lingering, detailed finish.
  • Jeb Dunnuck: 100 points – Described as an extraordinary Napa Valley wine with incredible purity, a powerful yet refined structure, and an effortless balance between fruit, acidity, and tannins.
  • Vinous (Antonio Galloni): 97 points – Recognized for its elegance and finesse, with floral and herbal nuances complementing the wine’s deep fruit core.

Serving and Pairing

Decant for at least one hour before serving at 16-18°C (61-64°F) to allow the wine’s aromas and structure to fully develop. This wine pairs exceptionally well with grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, or aged cheeses. Its robust structure and depth also make it a perfect match for game meats, truffle-infused dishes, and slow-roasted lamb.

title: Craven Cinsaut Stellenbosch
bodyHtml: This has a delicate cranberry and pomegranate bouquet with a bit of a rhubarb and bay leaf emerging with air.  The transparency and delineation of aromas and flavors is really special.  It offers red berries, black currants, rooibos tea, and a touch of white pepper and a saline element.  The finish is precise and yet welcoming with chalky-edged tannins that linger.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Sakagura Nigori Umeshu - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Japan, Aichi Prefecture, Handa City. Founded in 1844, Nakano Sake Brewery Co., Ltd. is a historic producer located on the Chita Peninsula that combines traditional Edo period techniques with modern equipment. The brewery operates its own farm, the Kuni Zakari Farm, where they meticulously cultivate thousands of plum trees to ensure the highest quality ingredients for their liqueurs.

Description

This nigori umeshu features a cloudy, unfiltered appearance due to the inclusion of roughly pressed plum pulp. The aromatic profile is intense and fruity, offering waves of juicy plum flesh, ripe peach, and persimmon. On the palate, it provides a rich, viscous texture with layers of apricot, honey, and sweet tea. The experience is perfectly balanced by a natural tartness and a surprising lightness that leads to a clean, fresh finish. ABV 8%.

Food Pairing

The creamy texture and sweet-tart balance of this umeshu make it an excellent partner for desserts such as vanilla ice cream, fruit sorbet, or apple tarts. It also pairs well with crisp garden salads and light appetizers. For a more traditional experience, it can be enjoyed on the rocks or mixed with soda water to complement spicy Asian cuisine and savory snacks like nuts and cheese.

title: Stroppiana Nascetta 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the Piedmont region of Italy, this wine is a pure expression of the Langhe DOC, with fruit sourced from vineyards in Rivalta di La Morra and Bussia di Monforte d'Alba. The Stroppiana family estate was founded in the mid-20th century and is currently managed by the fourth generation, Dario and Stefania, alongside their children Leonardo and Altea. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on quality over quantity, employing selective thinning to ensure optimal grape maturation and a deep respect for their historic land.

Wine Description

This 100% Nascetta presents a brilliant straw yellow colour with subtle greenish highlights. The nose is complex and persistent, opening with citrus and grapefruit that transition into notes of pale stone fruit, white flowers, and exotic sensations. On the palate, it offers a medium-bodied and fleshy texture, delivering a flood of crispness layered with orange blossom, honey, and pineapple. Stylistically, the wine is well-balanced with a pleasant acidity and a savory, silky finish that hints at dried fruit.

title: Egan's Vintage Grain Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml: Selected by Jonathan V. Egan, a member of the sixth generation of the Egan family, this single grain Irish whiskey was allowed to mature in American oak bourbon barrels for a minimum of eight years. Jam packed with fruit and spice, this one.

title: Marchesi di Gresy Barbera d'Asti 2019
bodyHtml:
The Marchesi di Gresy estate, Tenute Cisa Asinari, has roots tracing back to the mid-seventeenth century. The di Grésy family has been producing wine since 1973. Today, Alberto di Grésy, supported by his children Ludovica and Alessandro, guides the estate with a philosophy of 'gentle precision', allowing the native grapes and the land to speak without excess. The estate's aim is to create wines that reflect the elegance and structure of Piemonte.

Wine Description

The wine pours an intense ruby red with violet reflections. The bouquet presents strong and rich typical aromas of blackberries, raspberries, and ripe cherries. On the palate, it is described as a fine and elegant, mouthfilling character with great drinkability. Tasting notes also include ripe and tart plum, cherry, violets, turned earth, and savory herbs, often finishing with a zippy acidity.

Food Pairing

A wonderful match for main courses like roasted red meats, mixed boiled meats, or Barbera-braised meats. Its bright acidity also makes it suitable for rich, dark meats, herbaceous cheeses, and hearty dishes featuring mushrooms, root vegetables, or grilled vegetables.

title: Petit Vega '28 Meses En Barrica' 2019
bodyHtml:
This powerful and elegant red wine originates from Spain, specifically from the Ribera del Duero appellation within the Castilla y León region. Petit Vega is a personal project by Isaac Fernández Montaño, one of Spain's most renowned oenologists. His wines have consistently achieved great recognition, with several having scored over 95 points by Robert Parker.

Wine Description

Petit Vega '28 Meses En Barrica' is crafted exclusively from 100% Tempranillo grapes. It offers a nose of blackberry and cassis liqueur, accented with touches of balsamic and minerals. The palate is powerful and flavourful, marked by mature fruit flavours intertwined with hints of coffee, cocoa, and licorice. It possesses a velvety texture and structure, showcasing depth and is an elegant and structured red wine. The finish is long and elegant.

Food Pairing

This robust Tempranillo pairs excellently with beef, lamb, and game dishes, such as deer or venison. Its mature and complex profile also complements aged cheeses like Manchego.

title: Rombauer Napa Valley Merlot 2022
bodyHtml: Fragrant aromas of cherry, mint, and eucalyptus. On the palate, this wine has silky smooth tannins with lush flavors of blueberry and spice. A well-integrated acidity makes this an excellent wine to pair with grilled meats and red sauce pasta dishes.

title: Rombauer Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
This 2023 vintage is an extraordinary expression of Sauvignon Blanc, a wine that is consistently adored by both consumers and critics. With each year, we strive to make our wines better through small improvements in the vineyards and winemaking process. We can’t wait for you to take a sip.

Lifted and concentrated aromas of passion fruit, green melon, and hints of fresh cut grass all dance on the nose. The palate is linear and intense, with similar flavors that are joined by notes of kiwi and Key lime. Each sip is framed with mouthwatering acidity and a burst of grapefruit that lifts the long finish.

title: Unculin Dona Blanca Godello 2021
bodyHtml:
From Spain’s Bierzo region in northwestern Castilla y León, this white wine comes from the hands of José Antonio García, a winemaker dedicated to reviving old vineyards in his home village of Valtuille de Abajo. His ‘Unculin’ range reflects both heritage and modern precision, with a focus on organic practices and minimal intervention to highlight terroir expression.

Wine Description
In the glass, it shows a pale straw hue. The nose offers white flowers, citrus zest, and stone fruit, with subtle balsamic and herbal undertones. The palate is fresh and mineral, showing good weight and texture balanced by saline lift and a long, dry finish. Stylistically, it combines roundness with a taut, almost austere character that reflects the Bierzo terroir.

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled octopus, roast chicken with lemon and herbs, or creamy vegetable risotto. The lively freshness balances rich textures, while its mineral backbone highlights delicate flavours.

title: Poggio Salvi Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2019
bodyHtml: Intense ruby red with garnet tones. Ample and complex, notes of cherries, sweet tobacco, licorice, chocolate, and coffee. Sapid and full, with a distinct freshness, well structured, evolving tannins. Matches perfectly with red roasted meat, seasoned cheese, and truffles.

title: Taylor Fladgate Vintage Port 2016
bodyHtml:
Taylor Fladgate, a revered name in the world of Port wine, has been producing exceptional vintages since its founding in 1692. Nestled in Portugal's Douro Valley, the estate is family-owned and has maintained a legacy of excellence through centuries of dedication to traditional craftsmanship. Known for its meticulous vineyard selection and blending expertise, Taylor Fladgate creates wines that are celebrated for their longevity and elegance.

The 2016 Vintage Port is a testament to Taylor Fladgate’s unparalleled expertise. It pours a deep, inky purple with a vibrant rim, exuding aromas of blackberries, cassis, and violets, layered with notes of spice, dark chocolate, and a touch of cedar. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and intensely concentrated, with velvety tannins that balance the richness of the dark fruit. Subtle minerality and a long, harmonious finish add further complexity, promising remarkable ageing potential over the next several decades.

This remarkable Vintage Port pairs beautifully with blue cheeses like Stilton, dark chocolate desserts, or roasted walnuts, where its opulence and structure shine. Together, these pairings enhance the wine’s character and create an unforgettable indulgence. As critic Jancis Robinson noted, the 2016 Taylor Fladgate is “a benchmark Port that combines power and finesse, destined to age gracefully.”

title: Rowen Sonoma County Red Blend 2015
bodyHtml:
ROWEN red blend is a lush and elegant wine consisting of wonderful high elevation, mountain fruit. The wine has aromas of black raspberries, cocoa and black pepper from the co-fermented Viognier. On the palate, the wine is balanced and structured from the Cabernet Sauvignon with notes of blackberries, cassis, nutmeg, and vanilla. 

Co-fermenting the Syrah with the Viognier is a classic Northern Rhone technique which adds an exotic floral element to the finished wine as well as a rounder mouthfeel. Enjoy this wine now with sharp cheeses and charcuterie, braised lamb shanks, grilled filet mignon or cellar for enjoyment for years to come.

92 Points - Wilfred Wong

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

title: Mission Hill Compendium 2020
bodyHtml:
Canada is the country of origin for this wine, originating from British Columbia in the Okanagan Valley region. Founded in 1981 by Anthony von Mandl, Mission Hill Family Estate stands as an architectural landmark and a pioneer of premium winemaking in Western Canada. The winery follows sustainable viticultural practices across its south Okanagan estate vineyards, aiming to express the distinct microclimates and gravelly soils through meticulous hand harvesting and small-lot production.

Wine Description

Mission Hill Legacy VQA Compendium displays a deep, luminous garnet red colour in the glass. The complex nose delivers expressive aromas of rich black currant, dark plum, and blackberry, layered with cedary wood spice, cocoa, and subtle savoury herb undertones. On the full-bodied palate, this classic Bordeaux style red blend exhibits fine grained, grippy tannins and bright acidity that bring balance and structure through a long, polished finish. Crafted from a refined blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot, it displays remarkable power, balance, and cellar potential.

title: Silver Gate Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml: Light purple red in colour and abundant in aroma and flavor. Silver Gate Pinot Noir leads with ripe raspberry, cherry and strawberry cream. Silky on the palate with notes of red fruit, the wine closes with silky tannins & a pleasant, strawberry finish.

title: Pueblo Viejo Tequila Blanco
bodyHtml:
Pueblo Viejo Blanco Tequila is a true representation of traditional Mexican craftsmanship. Distilled meticulously from 100% blue agave, it boasts a pristine clarity. Its aroma teases with fresh agave and hints of citrus, setting the stage for a palate that combines sweet agave essence with a touch of peppery zest.

This tequila's smooth finish makes it a favorite for sipping straight or elevating any cocktail. With every sip, Pueblo Viejo Blanco transports you to the heart of Mexico, promising both authenticity and unmatched quality.

title: Cocchi Extra Dry White Vermouth - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Giulio Cocchi, established in 1891 in Asti, Italy, has a rich history of crafting fine aromatized wines and aperitifs. Renowned for its dedication to traditional methods and quality, the winery introduced the Cocchi Vermouth di Torino Extra Dry in 2021 to commemorate its 130th anniversary.

This vermouth presents a pale straw hue and offers fresh green apple and white flower aromas. The palate is zippy and remarkably light, with mouthwatering lemon peel and the barest hints of fresh herbs and peppermint on the super-clean, brisk exhale. 

Cocchi Extra Dry Vermouth is an excellent choice for classic cocktails like the Martini, where its crispness and herbal notes enhance the drink's complexity. It also pairs well with seafood dishes, such as oysters or grilled fish, and can be enjoyed chilled on its own as a refreshing aperitif. Together, these pairings highlight the vermouth’s depth and character.

The introduction of this Extra Dry Vermouth reflects Cocchi's commitment to innovation while honoring its storied past. The 2021 release has been well-received, with Wine Enthusiast awarding it 97 points, noting its "zippy and remarkably light" profile.

title: Ketel One Vodka - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Using carefully selected European wheat and a combination of modern and traditional distilling techniques, we produce an exceptional product, both crisp to taste and soft on finish. Here, the 4Fs – Fragrance, Flavour, Feel and Finish – help to define what makes Ketel One Vodka so unique.

title: Nonino L'Aperivitvo Botanical
bodyHtml:
Nonino Distillatori, established in 1897 in Friuli, Italy, is a family-owned distillery renowned for its dedication to quality and innovation in the production of grappa and liqueurs. Over the years, the Nonino family has been instrumental in elevating the status of grappa, transforming it into a premium spirit appreciated worldwide.

Liqueur Description
L’Aperitivo Nonino BotanicalDrink is a vibrant Italian aperitif crafted from a blend of 18 botanicals, including herbs, flowers, roots, and fruits. These botanicals are carefully harvested from and around the Nonino estate in Friuli and dried at low temperatures to preserve their natural intensity. The infusion is then combined with Nonino’s renowned ÙE® Grape Distillate Monovitigno® Fragolino, resulting in a 100% natural, vegan-friendly aperitif without artificial flavors or colors. The liqueur presents a vivid yellow hue and offers a fresh, citrus-forward aroma with floral and balsamic notes. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious balance of citrus freshness and subtle bitterness, leading to a crisp, refreshing finish.

Serving Suggestions
L’Aperitivo Nonino BotanicalDrink is versatile and can be enjoyed in various ways:

  • Classic Spritz: Combine 4 cl of L’Aperitivo Nonino with 4 cl of sparkling wine or 6 cl of tonic water over ice. Garnish with a lemon zest or a squeeze of lemon juice for a refreshing aperitif.

  • Negroni Variation: Replace the traditional bitter component with L’Aperitivo Nonino to create a lighter, citrus-infused Negroni.

  • On the Rocks: Serve over ice with a twist of orange or lemon peel to appreciate its complex botanical flavors.

Its balanced profile also makes it an excellent accompaniment to light appetizers, such as olives, charcuterie, or fresh cheeses, enhancing the overall dining experience.

Accolades
L’Aperitivo Nonino BotanicalDrink has been recognized for its excellence, winning the "Best Aperitif of the Year" award by Meininger, Germany's most important food and wine magazine, for three consecutive years: 2021, 2022, and 2023.

title: La Stoppa Trebbiolo Rosso 2023
bodyHtml:
La Stoppa Trebbiolo Rosso originates from Italy, specifically from the Emilia-Romagna region in the northwest province of Piacenza. The estate was founded in the late 19th century by Giancarlo Ageno, a wealthy lawyer who first identified the area's viticultural potential. Since 1991, it has been run by Elena Pantaleoni and head winemaker Giulio Armani, who shifted the estate away from international varieties to focus exclusively on indigenous grapes better suited to the local climate. Their winemaking philosophy centers on a non-interventionist approach, utilizing organic farming, spontaneous fermentations with native yeasts, and minimal use of sulphur.

Wine Description

Trebbiolo Rosso is considered the estate's 'everyday' wine, typically made from younger vines aged between 10 and 45 years. It presents a brilliant ruby or deep purple colour in the glass. The sensory profile is vibrant and aromatic, featuring notes of fresh red berries, dark cherry, and plum, layered with earthy undertones of undergrowth, wild herbs, and a hint of spice. On the medium-bodied palate, it is juicy and racy with a firm backbone of acidity and gentle tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional blend of 60% Barbera and 40% Bonarda (Croatina).

  • ABV: Typically between 12.5% and 13.5% depending on the vintage.

  • Organic Status: The estate has been farmed organically since the early 1990s and received official certification in 2008.

  • Stylistic Notes: Unlike the estate's other reds that age for many years, Trebbiolo is fermented in stainless steel or cement tanks with approximately 20 days of skin maceration and is released the summer after harvest to maintain its freshness.

title: Vina Real Reserva 2019
bodyHtml: CVNE (Compañía Vinícola del Norte de España), established in 1879, is a family-owned winery located in the heart of Rioja, Spain. Renowned for its dedication to quality and tradition, CVNE has been producing exceptional wines for over a century. The Viña Real label, introduced in the 1920s, is celebrated for its modern approach to classic Rioja winemaking, emphasizing the unique terroir of the Rioja Alavesa sub-region.

title: Mozart Chocolate Cream Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Mozart Distillerie, established in 1954 in Salzburg, Austria, is renowned for its premium chocolate liqueurs that harmoniously blend the art of distillation with the rich flavors of fine chocolate. The distillery's dedication to quality and innovation has positioned it as a leader in the chocolate liqueur market.

Liqueur Description
Mozart Milk Chocolate Liqueur is a full-bodied, creamy liqueur crafted with Belgian chocolate, fresh cream, and aromatic notes of vanilla and cocoa. This fine blend, together with the special crafting process, makes it a unique Austrian specialty. The liqueur presents a deep semi-brown, glistening color and offers a very creamy and smooth mouthfeel.

Serving Suggestions
This indulgent liqueur can be enjoyed neat, over ice, or as a luxurious addition to coffee or hot chocolate. It also serves as an excellent base for dessert cocktails, such as a Chocolate Martini or a decadent twist on a classic White Russian. Additionally, it can be drizzled over vanilla ice cream or used in baking to add a rich chocolate flavor to cakes and pastries.

Accolades
Mozart Milk Chocolate Liqueur has received numerous awards in appreciation of its high product quality, reflecting the distillery's proficiency, experience, and passion in producing exceptional chocolate liqueurs.

title: Hyde No. 5 The Aras Cask 1860 Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Hyde Irish Whiskey, named in honor of Ireland's first president, Douglas Hyde, is renowned for its dedication to traditional Irish whiskey craftsmanship. The Hyde No. 5 The Áras Cask 1860 is a single grain Irish whiskey that exemplifies this commitment. 

Whiskey Description
Hyde No. 5 is a triple-distilled, pure grain Irish whiskey, originally distilled in a traditional Coffey copper column still from pure corn (maize) grain. It is made in small batches and matured in U.S. ex-bourbon casks for six years, followed by a nine-month finish in French ex-Burgundy red wine oak casks from the Côte d’Or. This maturation process imparts a ruby-red color and a complex flavor profile. On the nose, it offers notes of sweet custard, apple peel, red berries, and orange blossom honey. The palate is creamy and nutty, with a finish that is long and satisfying.

Serving Suggestions
This whiskey is best enjoyed neat or with a splash of water to fully appreciate its intricate flavors. It also serves as an excellent base for classic cocktails such as the Old Fashioned or Manhattan, where its depth adds a sophisticated twist. Pairing it with dark chocolate or a fine cigar can further enhance the tasting experience, highlighting the whiskey's depth and character.

Accolades
Hyde No. 5 The Áras Cask 1860 has received critical acclaim, including a 91-point rating from Whisky Advocate, which praised its well-judged finish and complex flavor profile.

title: Petit Bonhomme Verdejo Blanco 2023
bodyHtml:
Les Vins Bonhomme, founded by Nathalie Bonhomme, is dedicated to producing wines that showcase the unique terroirs of Spain. Collaborating with local winemakers, the winery emphasizes sustainable practices and authentic expressions of regional varietals. The El Petit Bonhomme Blanco 2023 is a testament to this philosophy, crafted from 50-year-old bush vines in the Rueda appellation.

Wine Description
The 2023 El Petit Bonhomme Blanco presents a pale golden hue. On the nose, it offers enticing aromas of pear and peach, complemented by herbaceous and mineral notes. The palate is crisp and vibrant, featuring citrus and passion fruit flavours with a round texture. The finish is intense and powerful, leaving a lasting impression. This wine is best enjoyed young to fully appreciate its fresh and lively character.

Food Pairing
This Verdejo pairs wonderfully with seafood dishes such as grilled prawns, ceviche, or a classic paella. It also complements light salads and soft cheeses like goat cheese. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

Accolades
While specific awards for the 2023 vintage are not detailed here, previous vintages have received notable recognition, including a 90-point rating from James Suckling for the 2019 vintage.

title: Haras de Pirque Cabernet Franc Gran Reserva 'Galantas' 2018
bodyHtml:
The 2018 Haras de Pirque Cabernet Franc Gran Reserva 'Galantas' is a striking red wine from the Maipo Valley in Chile. This wine primarily features Cabernet Franc, with a small addition of Carménère, reflecting the cool climate and high-altitude vineyards in the Maipo Andes at over 700 meters above sea level.

Colour: Deep red with purple hues.
Aroma: Offers intense aromas of blackberries, blueberries, and subtle hints of tobacco and roasted coffee.
Palate: Smooth and structured, with dark fruits, cassis, and notes of graphite. Its tannins are refined, providing a silky mouthfeel.
Body: Full-bodied, with a well-integrated structure.
Finish: Long, persistent, with a vibrant and fresh character.

This wine was aged for 14 months in French oak barrels, enhancing its complexity while preserving its elegance. With an ABV of around 14.5%, it pairs beautifully with grilled meats and robust dishes. The 2018 vintage, marked by a cooler growing season, allowed the grapes to develop slowly, achieving optimal ripeness and balance.

This wine represents the highest expression of Cabernet Franc in the Maipo Valley, showcasing the region's capacity to produce elegant and distinctive wines with excellent aging potential, drinking well now but capable of developing further through the next decade.

title: Czechvar Lager 500 ml - 24 Cans
bodyHtml:
Czechvar is the authentic Czech lager brewed by the state-owned Budějovický Budvar brewery in České Budějovice, Czech Republic. While known as Budweiser Budvar throughout most of the world, it is branded as Czechvar in North America. This beer is a cultural icon of the South Bohemian region, where brewing has occurred for over 700 years. It is widely considered one of the finest examples of the Bohemian Pilsner style, adhering to strict traditional methods and using only locally sourced, premium ingredients.

Beer Description

This premium lager pours a deep, brilliant gold with a thick, creamy white head that exhibits excellent retention.

Aroma: It features a rich and complex bouquet dominated by the spicy, floral notes of Saaz hops, balanced by a distinct bready, toasted malt sweetness and a hint of honey.

Palate: The flavor is full-bodied and smooth, offering a perfect harmony of sweet Moravian malt and a refined, lingering bitterness. It has a rounded, buttery mouthfeel that transitions into a crisp, clean, and refreshing finish.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% and a moderate bitterness of approximately 22 IBU, providing a sophisticated depth of flavor that remains highly sessionable.

title: Greywacke Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Greywacke, established by renowned winemaker Kevin Judd in 2009, is a family-owned winery located in Marlborough, New Zealand. After serving as the founding winemaker at Cloudy Bay for 25 vintages, Judd embarked on his own venture, naming it after New Zealand's prevalent bedrock, greywacke. The winery is celebrated for its commitment to producing wines that authentically express Marlborough's unique terroir.

Wine Description
The 2022 Greywacke Chardonnay presents a pale golden hue. On the nose, it offers enticing aromas of brown sugar and vanilla custard, intertwined with bright citrus notes reminiscent of homemade lemon curd. The palate is layered with ripe golden peaches and caramelised figs, driven by a seam of flinty minerality. An earthy richness evokes thoughts of freshly cut hay, roasted nuts, and faint whiffs of wood smoke. This wine boasts a tight structure and excellent ageing potential, making it enjoyable now and over the next 5–7 years.
Food Pairing
This Chardonnay pairs beautifully with dishes such as roasted chicken with herbs, grilled salmon, or a creamy mushroom risotto. For a cheese pairing, consider aged cheddar or a soft brie. These combinations enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Maggiolo Chianti Classico 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Maggiolo Chianti Classico 2022 is a sophisticated red wine from the Tuscany region of Italy, specifically within the Greve in Chianti commune. Produced by the Lamole di Lamole winery, which was founded in 1947 and is now part of the Gruppo Santa Margherita, the wine is named after the 'giaggiolo' (iris) flower that blooms in the vineyards during the month of May ('Maggio'). The estate's philosophy focuses on organic viticulture and leveraging its unique 'height advantage', with some of the highest-altitude vineyards in the appellation sitting between 420 and 655 metres above sea level.

Wine Description

This 2022 vintage presents a bright ruby red colour and a textured, rounded sensory profile. The bouquet is floral and fruity, offering aromas of cyclamens, violets, cherries, and raspberries, complemented by notes of wild herbs, sweet spices, and cacao. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and balanced, featuring fresh yet mellow sensations with rounded tannins and a well-calibrated acidity that adds vibrancy. The varietal composition is a blend of 80% Sangiovese, with the remaining 20% split between Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, a combination that provides both structure and accessibility. It underwent maturation for approximately one and a half years in oak casks and barriques, followed by further aging in the bottle before release. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is generally through 2027 or 2028.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 93 points

title: Weninger Rozsa Petsovits 2024
bodyHtml: Not your average rose! Deep, floral aromatics mingle on the nose with a woody earthiness, underpinned by fruity, dark cherry notes. There's a buzzy, tingly Szechuan pepperiness that lingers on the tongue long after finishing, and a weightiness to this wine that makes you want to sit and savour it. Dare we say it, the ultimate winter rosé? You be the judge.

title: Fettercairn 12 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml:
After years of maturing in American white oak ex-bourbon barrels, the Fettercairn 12-Year-Old is the colour of sunlight and amber honey. Come closer and discover the taste of our signature tropical house style with this welcoming single malt whisky.

Taste: Vanilla and pear, with soft spices.

Finish: Refreshing nectarine and tropical fruit, with subtle roasted coffee, clove, and ginger. A memorable finish of sultanas and black toffee.

title: Flor de Cana 30 Year Old V Generaciones Single Barrel Rum
bodyHtml: Flor De Cana will celebrate 130 years and five generations’ involvement since its founding back in 1890. To mark the occasion, this 30-year-old single barrel rum distilled back in 1988 is being offered. Sub titled ‘V Generaciones’, it’s the company’s oldest rum to date, matured in a single ex-Bourbon barrel. 411 bottles are on offer world wide, each individually numbered and featuring the signatures of the five family generations behind the company.

title: Domaine Masse Cote Chalonnaise Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine Masse, a family-owned winery established in 1935, is situated in the heart of Burgundy's Côte Chalonnaise region. Under the stewardship of Fabrice Masse, who took over from his father in 2000, the estate has upheld its commitment to traditional winemaking while embracing sustainable practices. Certified as 'High Environmental Value' for its biodiversity and sustainability efforts, Domaine Masse produces wines that authentically express the unique terroir of the region.

Wine Description
The 2022 Domaine Masse Côte Chalonnaise Chardonnay Vieilles Vignes presents a pale golden hue. On the nose, it exudes fresh notes of apple and white peach, accompanied by a hint of hazelnut. The palate is broad yet balanced, with a fine citrus note running through it, leading to a steely structure and a crisp finish. This wine is drinking well already and is expected to maintain its vibrancy over the next 2–3 years.

Food Pairing
This Chardonnay pairs beautifully with dishes such as grilled salmon, roasted chicken with herbs, or a creamy mushroom risotto. For a cheese pairing, consider soft cheeses like Brie or Camembert. These combinations enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

Accolades
While specific awards for this vintage are not detailed here, Domaine Masse's dedication to quality has consistently earned it recognition among wine enthusiasts and critics alike.

title: Contino Gran Reserva 2018
bodyHtml:
Viñedos del Contino, established in 1973, was a groundbreaking winery in Rioja, introducing the 'château concept'—a significant departure from tradition as the first single-estate winery committed to expressing a unique site. The estate is surrounded by 62 hectares of vineyards from which all its wines are sourced. The history of the property dates back to the 16th century, reflected in the winery’s name, which refers to the 'contino', an officer of the royal family's guard.

Wine Description

On the nose, it is described as opulent, intense, and very complex, with aromas of black and red fruits well integrated with toasted notes. Specific aromatic notes include purple plum, mocha, violet, clove, mint leaf, dark chocolate, cherry, chocolate, sandalwood, incense, and mushroom. The palate is polished and powerful, but well-balanced with silky tannins. Flavours of blackberry and black cherry are present. The wine exhibits a medium body and a chalky, long, and persistent finish that carries balsamic and fruity notes.

Accolades

  • 'James Suckling - 98 points'

  • 'Robert Parker The Wine Advocate - 95 points'

  • 'Vinous - 96 points'

  • 'Wine Enthusiast - 96 points'

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for this wine include red meats and lambs. Other excellent matches are spicy chicken, grilled pork chops, roast pheasant, and grilled sausage.

title: Champagne Chavost Blanc d'Assemblage Brut Nature
bodyHtml:
The Champagne Chavost Estate was created in 1946 in the village of Chavost. Solidarity and sharing of their land are the core values which they run on that have been passed down from their ancestors. These values push them to produce only the highest quality of grapes that allow them to create unique Champagne.

This incredible blend of varietals are hand picked one by one at their optimal maturity, a signature of this style of Chavost’s cuvée wines, low intervention is the inspiration. This means, no added sulphites, done without enzymes, tannin or coal, and fermentation is reliant on indigenous yeasts and spontaneous malolactic fermentation that is naturally-occuring. Fermentation occurs in stainless steel which elegantly exacerbates the mineral content of the wine from the clay-limestone terroir. This wine is a standout and any champagne fan must experience this bottle.

title: Cedar Creek Syrah Platinum Haynes Creek 2021
bodyHtml:
CedarCreek Estate Winery, established in 1987, is a pioneering winery located in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Renowned for its commitment to organic farming and sustainable viticulture, CedarCreek crafts wines that authentically express the unique terroir of the region.

Wine Description
The 2021 CedarCreek Platinum Haynes Creek Syrah showcases a deep ruby hue, indicative of its concentration. On the nose, it offers an enticing bouquet of ripe blackberries, plums, and violets, interwoven with subtle notes of graphite and cedar. The palate is medium to full-bodied, showcasing a harmonious balance between juicy dark fruit flavours and savoury undertones. Structured with fine-grained tannins and vibrant acidity, the wine culminates in a long, elegant finish. While approachable now, it possesses the potential to develop further complexity over the next 3 to 5 years.

Food Pairing
This versatile Syrah pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, roasted duck breast, or a hearty mushroom risotto. For a cheese pairing, consider aged Gouda or a mild blue cheese. These combinations enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Cedar Creek Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
CedarCreek Estate Winery, established in 1987, is a pioneering winery located in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. Renowned for its commitment to organic farming and sustainable viticulture, CedarCreek crafts wines that authentically express the unique terroir of the region.

Wine Description
The CedarCreek Platinum Border Vista Sauvignon Blanc presents a pale straw hue with greenish reflections. On the nose, it exudes vibrant aromas of lime, lemongrass, and subtle green cooking herbs, complemented by a hint of the South Okanagan's characteristic sagebrush. The palate is lively and refreshing, featuring electric acidity and flavours of citrus and fresh herbs.

Food Pairing
This Sauvignon Blanc pairs wonderfully with dishes such as grilled asparagus with lemon vinaigrette, goat cheese salad, or freshly shucked oysters. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Tommasi 'Rafael' Valpolicella Classico Superiore 2022
bodyHtml:
Tommasi 'Rafael' Valpolicella Classico Superiore is a refined red wine from the Veneto region, known for its balance of elegance and complexity.

Colour: Bright ruby red.
Aroma: Offers vibrant notes of red berries, cherries, and floral hints, along with undertones of fine herbs, vanilla, and baking spices.
Palate: Juicy and expressive, with flavors of ripe cherries, subtle spices, and a refreshing acidity. Medium tannins contribute to a smooth, silky texture.
Body: Medium-bodied with well-rounded structure.
Finish: The wine closes with a medium-long finish, carrying hints of spice and herbs.

This wine represents Tommasi’s deep-rooted commitment to the region's traditional winemaking practices and highlights the elegance of the Valpolicella Classico zone.

title: Jayson Red Blend By Pahlmeyer 2021
bodyHtml:
This rich and fleshy red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the premier Napa Valley region in California. Jayson is the "approachable" second label from the iconic Pahlmeyer estate, designed to be enjoyed upon release while maintaining the same mountain-grown pedigree as the flagship wines. The winemaking philosophy, led by Katie Vogt, focuses on a "core of ripe, concentrated mountaintop fruit" blended with valley floor parcels to achieve a lush, fruit-driven style with an emphasis on "joie de vivre".

Wine Description

Jayson Red Wine presents a rich and concentrated profile, with mountain-grown Merlot as its structural heart. The sensory profile features expressive aromas of crushed black cherry, mushroom, and saddle leather, layered with sophisticated hints of blackcurrant and forest floor. On the palate, the wine is "mouth-filling and plush," showcasing deep flavours of black cherry and currant laced with mocha, milk chocolate, and toasty baking spices. It is characterized by caressing, polished tannins and a persistent acidity that guides the interlaid flavours through a long, pure finish.

Food Pairing

The opulent fruit and supple texture of this blend make it a fantastic companion for bold, savory dishes. It pairs perfectly with char-grilled steak topped with chimichurri sauce, or a succulent roasted rack of lamb. Its earthy and mocha undertones also complement portobello mushroom burgers with gruyere, eggplant parmesan, and sautéed wild mushrooms. For a simple pairing, it is an excellent match for aged Gouda or dishes featuring caramelized onions.

title: Greywacke Botrytis Pinot Gris - 375 ml
bodyHtml: A vibrant mix of nectarines, yellow peaches and cassis combines with the bright fragrance of lemon zest laced with musky, jasmine-like floral nuances. The palate is packed with ripe stone fruit, melons and mandarin creating a succulent tropical-fruited style with that classic Marlborough zing.

title: Greywacke Riesling 2023
bodyHtml:
The bright, fruity scent of fresh nectarine intermingles with perfumed notes
of citrus and coriander flowers. A vibrantly fragrant style, layered with a beeswax-like
complexity and a subtle thread of anise. The palate is generous, with flavours of honeydew
melon, Pink Lady apple and candied lemon. A spine of fresh acidity gives vibrancy and balance to the succulent and lingering, off-dry finish.

title: Galliano Espresso Liqueur - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Coffee liqueur cocktails exist of a combination of bittersweet coffee and sweet liqueur. You can enjoy Espresso liqueur on its own as a simple after-dinner drink or add it to a cocktail to provide a robust earthy flavor. One thing is sure, our Galliano Espresso liqueur is a game changer in the coffee liqueur cocktails world.

The full-flavored palate of Galliano Espresso liqueur is very close to that of a strong caffe corretto with dark chocolate covered and heavily roasted coffee beans. The oily espresso finish has an almost pepperminty freshness.

title: Garzon Reserva Albarino 2025
bodyHtml:
This premium white wine originates from the Maldonado region of Uruguay, situated a mere 18 kilometres from the Atlantic Ocean. Bodega Garzón is a family-owned estate founded by Alejandro Bulgheroni and his wife Bettina, who transformed a 700-hectare olive farm into a pioneering viticultural project. Under the guidance of renowned consultant oenologist Alberto Antonini, the winery focuses on producing terroir-driven wines that reflect the estate's ancient granitic soils, some of the oldest on the planet. The winery itself is a global leader in sustainability, having been the first in the world to earn LEED certification for its entire facility.

Wine Description

The Garzón Reserva Albariño presents a brilliant pale yellow colour with subtle greenish reflections. The nose is highly expressive, featuring a bouquet of white peach, citrus fruit, and jasmine, layered with honeyed notes and white flowers. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied with an unctuous, creamy texture derived from three to six months of aging on fine lees in stainless steel and cement tanks. It displays a vibrant core of acidity balanced by saline minerality and flavours of lemon and green mango. The finish is long and refreshing, marked by a characteristic stony persistence.

title: Bottega Vinai Muller Thurgau 2022
bodyHtml:
Bottega Vinai Müller Thurgau 2022 is a distinguished white wine from the Trentino region of northern Italy. Produced by Cavit, a renowned cooperative winery, this wine is crafted exclusively from the Müller Thurgau grape variety. The vineyards are situated on the Brentonico Plateau, in Valle di Cavedine, and Cimone, at altitudes between 500 and 700 meters above sea level, benefiting from glacial and dolomitic limestone soils.

This terroir imparts a unique minerality and freshness to the wine.

Colour: Pale straw yellow with bright green reflections, indicating its youth and vibrancy.

Aroma: A complex bouquet featuring aromatic notes reminiscent of lime and bergamot, complemented by delicate hints of elderflower and acacia, with subtle spicy undertones of sage and bay leaf.

Palate: Rich and lusciously crisp, showcasing great balance with flavors of citrus, green apple, and a touch of minerality, leading to a pleasantly bitter finish.

Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, refreshing texture that emphasizes purity and balance.

Finish: Bright and lingering, with a delicate minerality that leaves a refreshing and slightly saline aftertaste.

title: Black Stallion Chardonnay North Coast 2022
bodyHtml:
This elegant white wine hails from the United States, specifically the prestigious North Coast appellation of California. Black Stallion Estate Winery is located on the historic Silverado Trail in Napa Valley, situated on an estate that once served as the Silverado Equestrian Centre. Purchased in 2010 by the Indelicato family, a fourth-generation wine-growing family, the winery is dedicated to crafting expressive, high-quality wines that pay homage to the property's rich heritage and the diverse terroirs of Northern California.

Wine Description

In the glass, North Coast Chardonnay displays a brilliant golden yellow hue with golden highlights. The sensory profile opens with lush, bright aromas of pear, Golden Delicious apple, and orange blossom, complemented by toasted oak, vanilla, and hints of almond. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied wine is expansive and creamy, offering flavours of ripe Bosc pear, white peach, and orange marmalade intertwined with nutmeg and tangerine zest. The finish is long and supple, featuring notes of toasted bread, caramel, and a light buttery touch.

title: Tenuta Bellafonte 'Collenotollo' Montefalco Sagrantino 2016
bodyHtml: Tenuta Bellafonte represents, without a shadow of a doubt, the new way for the Sagrantino di Montefalco. The beautiful project of Peter Heilbron, a wise, convivial and pragmatic man, has its centre in Bevagna, a municipality located in the northern part of the Umbrian denomination. Where nature offers a fresh climate, excellent exposures and a vineyard to be rediscovered compared to the historical Montefalco plots.

title: El Jolgorio Madrecuishe Mezcal
bodyHtml:
El Jolgorio Madrecuishe Mezcal is the rarest and most exquisite mezcal in the world. It is made from the wild agave Madrecuishe, which takes 30 years to mature. The agave is then slow-roasted in an underground oven, crushed by a mule-drawn tahona, and fermented with natural yeasts. The fermented mash is then distilled twice in copper pot stills.

El Jolgorio Madrecuishe Mezcal has a unique flavor profile that is unlike any other mezcal. It has notes of roasted agave, smoke, citrus, and herbs. The mezcal is smooth and easy to drink, but it also has a strong and lingering finish.

title: Del Maguey Single Village Mezcal 'Vida'
bodyHtml: An exquisite mezcal hand-crafted in the village of Santa Catarina Minas. Expect aromas and flavours of fig, citrus, granite, honey, and green herbs. Medium-bodied and earthy with a long-lasting, well-balanced finish. Serve neat with smoked chicken nachos, jalapeño poppers, or on its own after a meal.

title: Cedar Creek Cabernet Franc 2022
bodyHtml:
CedarCreek Estate Winery, established in 1987, is one of British Columbia's pioneering wineries, located in the picturesque Okanagan Valley. Dedicated to producing premium wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region, CedarCreek has garnered acclaim for its commitment to sustainable viticulture and meticulous winemaking practices.

Wine Description
The CedarCreek Estate Cabernet Franc presents a deep ruby hue, indicative of its concentration. On the nose, it offers an enticing bouquet of ripe blackberries, plums, and violets, interwoven with subtle notes of graphite and cedar. The palate is medium to full-bodied, showcasing a harmonious balance between juicy dark fruit flavours and savoury undertones. Structured with fine-grained tannins and vibrant acidity, the wine culminates in a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing
This versatile Cabernet Franc pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, roasted duck breast, or a hearty mushroom risotto. For a cheese pairing, consider aged Gouda or a mild blue cheese. These combinations enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Austin Paso Robles Chardonnay (Austin Hope Winery)
bodyHtml:
The Austin Paso Robles Chardonnay is produced by Austin Hope Winery, which is located in the Paso Robles subregion of California, United States. The Hope family has been farming in Paso Robles since 1978, originally planting both apples and grapes. The family's philosophy is deeply rooted in the values that define the region, prioritising family, quality, and the expression of Paso Robles terroir. Owner and Winemaker Austin Hope has a lifelong desire to make wines that reflect all that Paso Robles has to offer, and his wines have helped to set the benchmark for luxury wines in the region. The winery was also awarded the 2022 American Winery of the Year by Wine Enthusiast.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a beautiful, darker golden hue in the glass. The nose is anticipated with bright tropical notes. Aromatically, it shows yellow peach, vanilla, and marshmallow aromas. The wine is $100% Chardonnay.

On the palate, it exhibits riper, warm-climate qualities that are harmoniously balanced with the brisk acidity and lemon zest notes of cool-climate fruit. The entry is clean and fresh, gaining midpalate weight with layered tropical and honeydew flavours. The body is full and rich, with notes of creamy baked pineapple and salty marshmallow flavours. Barrel fermentation and subsequent sur lie ageing, with monthly stirring for the first three months, contribute to the wine's creamy nature. Stylistically, it strikes a balance between classic California richness and a fresh varietal expression, delivering freshness, depth, and exceptional drinkability. The wine finishes with a crisp flourish. The alcohol content is $14.5% ABV.

Accolades

Austin Hope Winery was awarded '2022 American Winery of the Year' by Wine Enthusiast.

Food Pairing

This wine is a versatile partner for food. Suggested pairings include seafood such as grilled shrimp or lobster. It is also well-suited to roasted chicken and creamy pasta dishes like fettuccine Alfredo. The wine’s notes of vanilla and butter make it a great match for soft cheeses such as Brie or Camembert. For a more casual option, it pairs perfectly with buttered parmesan popcorn.

Vintage Quality

While the 2022 vintage in California had a growing season that was, at times, difficult, the overall vintage quality was excellent. The growing season began with a chilly but dry winter, but considerable rainfall late in the previous year helped replenish water reserves in the ground. This allowed the Chardonnay grapes to develop a harmonious balance of ripe fruit and refreshing acidity.

title: Antinori Rosso di Montalcino 'Pian delle Vigne' 2023
bodyHtml:
The Antinori family, with a winemaking history dating back to 1385, is synonymous with excellence and innovation in Italian wine. Pian delle Vigne, their estate near Montalcino, Tuscany, is celebrated for producing wines that embody the elegance and character of the region. The Rosso di Montalcino 'Pian delle Vigne' is crafted from 100% Sangiovese, showcasing the estate’s dedication to tradition and terroir.

Description

The 2022 Rosso di Montalcino 'Pian delle Vigne' exhibits a bright ruby red colour. Aromas of red cherry, wild strawberries, and dried herbs are layered with hints of violets and a touch of spice. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and vibrant, offering silky tannins and fresh acidity that balance the juicy red fruit flavours. The finish is clean and elegant, with a whisper of savoury earthiness. Best enjoyed young, this wine is approachable now and will drink beautifully through 2027.

Food Pairing

This versatile wine pairs wonderfully with Tuscan-inspired dishes such as pappardelle with wild boar ragu, margherita pizza, or a platter of cured meats and aged Pecorino. These pairings highlight the wine’s freshness and complexity, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Hennessy VS (Very Special) Cognac
bodyHtml:
Hennessy Very Special (V.S) is one of the most popular cognacs in the world. Matured in new oak barrels, Hennessy V.S is bold and fragrant. Its beguiling character is uniquely Hennessy, a timeless choice with an intensity all its own. Hennessy V.S offers toasted and fruit notes, with a rich, clearly defined palate and a welcoming exuberance.

Hennessy V.S expresses its vibrant and dynamic personality through unique artist partnerships and annual limited editions. Easy to enjoy, it’s a perfect cognac for high-energy occasions and sharing the moment.

The round and robust flavours of Hennessy V.S make it very versatile and ideal for any cocktail possibility, from classic recipes and sophisticated cocktail creations to easy mixed drinks.

title: Saint K Never Really Loved You Anyway Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Saint K 'Never Really Loved You Anyway' Chardonnay 2022 exemplifies the region's ability to craft wines with both richness and vibrant acidity. The 2022 vintage has been recognized for its exceptional quality, earning a 90-point rating from Wine Enthusiast. 

  • Colour: Pale straw yellow with bright, clear reflections, indicating its freshness and clarity.
  • Aroma: Warm aromas of hazelnut, baked peach, toasted coconut, and sandalwood are inviting on the nose.
  • Palate: The palate kicks off with grippy tension and zesty acidity before opening into white peach, toasted macadamia nut, and coconut flavors, reminiscent of a Hawaiian vacation.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, refreshing texture that emphasizes purity and balance.
  • Finish: Bright and lingering, with a delicate minerality that leaves a refreshing and slightly saline aftertaste.

Accolades:

  • 90 Points – Wine Enthusiast

title: Martin's Lane Naramata Pinot Noir 2019
bodyHtml:
Produced by Martin's Lane Winery, this wine is crafted exclusively from Pinot Noir grapes sourced from the Naramata Ranch Vineyard, known for its diverse elevations and exposures. The vineyard features a mix of clones, including Pommard, 943, 828, and 667, contributing to the wine's complexity.

  • Colour: Deep ruby red with a vibrant hue, indicating its concentration and youth.
  • Aroma: Expressive aromas of black cherries and savory spices, intertwined with notes of licorice and a hint of umami, creating a complex and inviting bouquet.
  • Palate: The palate is elegant and silky, showcasing flavors of black cherries, savory spices, and licorice, balanced by a vibrant acidity and fine-grained tannins. The wine's mid-palate offers a rich structure, leading to a long, harmonious finish.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, refreshing texture that emphasizes purity and balance.
  • Finish: Bright and lingering, with a delicate minerality that leaves a refreshing and slightly saline aftertaste.

title: Poggio Torselli Chianti Classico 2020
bodyHtml:
The Poggio Torselli estate, on the Chianti hills, has roots in the Florentine Renaissance. Mentioned in 1427, it passed between rich Tuscan families, from the Angiolini to the Antinori. Overlooking Florence and Brunelleschi’s Dome, the estate is a landscape jewel of vineyards and olive groves. After conservative restorations from 1999 to 2005, in 2002 the Villa, the Italian Garden and the park returned to their ancient splendor. In 2003, the new winery was completed for the revival of wine production. Today the property belongs to the Cusano family, an Italian-Canadian family who started an innovation project focusing everything on wine quality thanks also to the oenological consultancy of Carlo Ferrini.

Brilliant ruby red, with lively notes and intense reflections, resulting clear and viscous in the glass. On the nose, the wine is complex and refined, with a predominance of the typical Sangiovese fruit, accompanied by notes of morello cherry, blackberry, cherry and undergrowth. Upon tasting, the entry into the mouth is warm and enveloping, immediately striking for its softness and complexity. The acidic note gives freshness and is well balanced by firm but sweet tannins, which contribute to the overall harmony.

title: Santa Margherita Sparkling Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
Santa Margherita, established in 1935 in Italy's Veneto region, is renowned for its dedication to producing wines that authentically express their terroir. The Santa Margherita Sparkling Brut Rosé exemplifies this commitment, offering a harmonious blend of richness and elegance.

  • Colour: Pale pink with a bright, clear appearance, indicating its freshness and vibrancy.
