  • Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring pleasing floral aromas with hints of red berries, artfully crafted with a blend of white wine made from Chardonnay and Glera grapes and a red varietal, Malbec.
  • Palate: Delicate yet vibrant and well-rounded, remaining on the palate and making this a deliciously easy-drinking wine.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both depth and elegance.
  • Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

title: Smirnoff Vodka - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Founded in 1864 by Pyotr Arsenievich Smirnov, what we now call Smirnoff was the first vodka to use charcoal filtration in the distillation process. This charcoal filtration produces a spirit that is ideal for mixing because of its smooth and clean palate; perfect in a Moscow Mule.

title: Woodford Reserve - 375 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Woodford Reserve Distillery, located in the heart of Kentucky's bourbon country, is renowned for its meticulous craftsmanship and dedication to producing premium small-batch bourbons. The Woodford Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey in the 375 ml bottle offers enthusiasts a taste of this esteemed distillery's signature spirit.

Tasting Notes:

  • Aroma: Rich dried fruit, hints of mint and oranges covered with a dusting of cocoa, faint vanilla and tobacco spice.
  • Palate: Rich, chewy, rounded and smooth, with complex citrus, cinnamon and cocoa. Flavors of toffee, caramel, chocolate and spice notes abound.
  • Finish: Silky smooth, almost creamy at first with a long, warm satisfying tail.

title: The Macallan A Night on Earth 'Jerez de la Frontera'
bodyHtml:
The Macallan A Night on Earth in Jerez de la Frontera is a Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky that captures the essence of celebration and shared moments. Inspired by the vibrant New Year's Eve traditions of Jerez de la Frontera, the heartland of Sherry wine, this release is a toast to Nochevieja - a night brimming with meaning and age-old customs.

This unique expression of The Macallan is crafted from a meticulously balanced combination of European and American sherry seasoned oak casks. These casks impart a complexity and depth of flavor that is quintessentially Macallan, yet distinctively influenced by the Sherry heritage of Jerez. The result is a whisky that not only symbolizes the spirit of a special night but also embodies the craftsmanship and tradition that The Macallan is renowned for.

title: Bramare Cabernet Sauvignon 'Lujan de Cuyo' 2021
bodyHtml:
Viña Cobos, established in 1999 by renowned winemaker Paul Hobbs, is acclaimed for producing exceptional wines that reflect the unique terroirs of Argentina's Mendoza region. Bramare Cabernet Sauvignon 'Luján de Cuyo' exemplifies this dedication, offering a harmonious blend of richness and elegance.

Colour: Bright red with dark tones, indicating its concentration and aging potential.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring hints of pink pepper, black fruits, and sandalwood, offering a complex and inviting profile.

Palate: Angular with tight tannins, the palate presents flavors consistent with the nose, complemented by a balanced acidity and a long, satisfying finish. 

Body: Full-bodied with a rich and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

title: The HYPE Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml:
689 Cellars, established in 2008 by Curtis McBride and winemaker Kent Rasmussen, is renowned for crafting wines that embody the essence of California's diverse terroirs. The 2020 The HYPE Cabernet Sauvignon exemplifies this dedication, offering a harmonious blend of richness and elegance.

Colour: Deep burgundy, indicating its concentration and aging potential.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring notes of chocolate-covered blueberries, black cherry, violet, and a touch of seasoned oak.

Palate: Full-bodied and well-structured, highlighting juicy layers of dark fruit and velvety tannins that lead to an exotic, spicy finish.

Body: Full-bodied with a rich and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

Accolades:

  • 91 Points - Tasting Panel Magazine

title: Ramey Pinot Noir Russian River 2017
bodyHtml:
This Ramey Russian River Valley Pinot Noir strikes a fine balance between rich, unctuous styles and leaner, coastal styles. It is at once both elegant and delicious.

After all, David Ramey is a man who Decanter called “one of California’s best and most respected winemakers” and Wine Spectator lauded as having a “master’s touch.” While his legendary Chardonnay program began with single-vineyard designates, he flipped the script with Pinot Noir, aiming to capture the essence of the broader Russian River appellation.

92+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Pale to medium ruby-purple in color, it has a gregarious, youthful nose with tangerine peel, soft baking spices, forest floor and a wicked vein of floral nuance with warm red and black fruits at the core. The palate gives good concentration of spicy fruit, with grainy tannins and juicy acidity, finishing long and spicy.

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

As to the reds, the 2017 Pinot Noir Russian River Valley comes from a handful of sites and spent 14 months in just under 40% new French oak. Its translucent ruby color is followed by a complex, earthy effort that offers mulled strawberry and cherry fruit, notes of dried herbs, forest floor, and saddle leather, medium-bodied richness, and a great texture. This Burgundy lover’s Pinot Noir shines for its complexity and elegance more than power and richness.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine is sourced from a selection of different vineyards, including Bucher along Westside Road. Earthy funk underlies high-toned red cherry, rhubarb and strawberry, threading the needle between richness and crispness. A salty savory finish tops things off.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Delicate, with finely textured dried cherry and raspberry tart flavors, supported by fresh acidity. Shows cherry confit notes midpalate, revealing plenty of spice and smoke hints on the finish.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai Umeshu '23' - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Asahi Shuzo Dassai Umeshu '23' is an exquisite Japanese plum liqueur that harmoniously blends tradition and innovation. Crafted by Asahi Shuzo, renowned for their premium Dassai sake line, this umeshu is made using the finest Nanko plums from Wakayama Prefecture and their acclaimed Dassai 23 Junmai Daiginjo sake, which is polished down to 23% of the rice grain.

Appearance: Pale golden hue with a slight pink tint, indicating its freshness and the quality of the plums used.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring notes of ripe plum, honey, and almond, offering a complex and inviting profile.

Palate: The palate is opulent and expansive, with captivating flavors of sweet plum, balanced acidity, and a hint of nuttiness. The palate is harmonious, with a long and subtle finish.

Body: Medium-bodied with a rich and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

Accolades:

  • Gold Medal - International Wine Challenge
  • 95 Points - Decanter

This umeshu exemplifies Asahi Shuzo's dedication to producing liqueurs that are both expressive and true to their terroir, offering a delightful experience for Japanese plum liqueur enthusiasts.

title: Gerard Bertrand Domaine De Villemajou Red 2023
bodyHtml:
Gérard Bertrand Domaine de Villemajou Red is a refined red wine from the prestigious Corbières Boutenac subregion in Languedoc, France. The estate is the family home of Gérard Bertrand, inherited from his father, Georges Bertrand, and is where he performed his first harvest in 1975. The winery is globally recognized for its commitment to biodynamic viticulture and its focus on revealing the unique terroirs of the South of France.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep garnet or intense purple robe in the glass. The aromatic profile is complex and powerful, featuring notes of jammy blackberry, plum, and black cherry layered with sweet spices, leather, roasted coffee, and hints of clove and licorice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and round, showing a supple texture and beautiful fruit intensity framed by fine-grained, melted tannins.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include:

  • Grilled red meats such as fillet of beef, lamb chops, or venison.

  • Traditional Mediterranean fare, including lamb tagine or game.

  • Mature hard cheeses like Manchego, Comté, or Mimolette.

title: Castano Monastrell Ecologico 2024
bodyHtml: Intense appealing red color with garnet highlights. Outstanding clean and bright, spicy nose with hints of red stone fruit, plum and cherry. On the palate is structured but soft standing out the strawberry caramel and the liquorice. It shows freshness with a silky ending.

title: Roebuck Estates Rose de Noirs 2017
bodyHtml: Crafted from handpicked Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier grapes grown at beautiful Sussex vineyards, this Rose de Noirs is vibrant and expressive with delightful notes of ripe strawberries, pink grapefruit and white peach, lifted by a hint of dried rose petals.

title: Bret Brothers Macon Ige 'Les Vernayes' 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced by the Bret Brothers, known for their commitment to organic and biodynamic viticulture, this wine is crafted exclusively from Chardonnay grapes sourced from the 'Les Vernayes' climat in the village of Igé. The vineyard is situated on an east-facing slope with a 20% gradient, at an altitude of 220 meters, featuring limestone-rich soils that contribute to the wine's minerality and complexity.

Colour: Pale gold with green reflections, indicating its freshness and vibrancy.

Aroma: Enticing aromas of citrus fruits, green apple, and white flowers, complemented by subtle notes of wet stone and a hint of spice.

Palate: The palate is crisp and lively, showcasing flavors of lemon zest, pear, and a touch of almond, balanced by a refreshing acidity and a pronounced minerality that reflects its terroir.

Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, refreshing texture that emphasizes purity and balance.

Finish: Bright and lingering, with a delicate minerality that leaves a refreshing and slightly saline aftertaste.

title: Poggio Torselli Bizzarria Rosato 2022
bodyHtml:
Poggio Torselli Bizzarria Rosato is a distinguished rosé wine from the renowned Poggio Torselli estate, located in the heart of Tuscany, Italy. This wine is crafted from a blend of indigenous grape varieties, including Pugnitello and Sangiovese, reflecting the estate's commitment to traditional Tuscan viticulture. 

Colour: Intense and glittering salmon pink, showcasing its vibrant character.

Aroma: Bright fruity notes of fresh raspberry and cherry, complemented by a subtle savory undertone.

Palate: Well-balanced and fresh, with a juicy profile that makes for an enjoyable drinking experience.

Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, refreshing texture that emphasizes purity and balance.

Finish: Medium-long, leaving a pleasant and lingering impression.

title: Okunomatsu Junmai Daiginjo Navy Blue - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Okunomatsu Junmai Daiginjo Navy Blue originates from Nihonmatsu City in the Fukushima Prefecture of Japan. The Okunomatsu brewery was founded in 1716 and has been under the continuous ownership of the founding family for nineteen generations. The brewery combines centuries of tradition with modern technology, utilizing the natural soft water from the local Mount Adatara to craft its premium sake range.

Description

This sake is clear in appearance and is brewed using a signature sparkling method that retains a subtle, natural effervescence when first opened. The aromatic profile is elegantly balanced, featuring notes of fresh melon, green apple, and white flowers. On the palate, it offers a medium body with a silky texture and flavours of ripe pear and honeydew, supported by a gentle umami backbone. The finish is remarkably clean and crisp, characteristic of the brewery's refined brewing style. It has an alcohol content of 15% to 16% and a rice polishing rate of 50%.

Food Pairing

The elegant and crisp nature of Navy Blue makes it a superb companion for delicate seafood dishes such as fluke sashimi, raw oysters, or steamed sea bass. It also pairs beautifully with lightly fried vegetable tempura or a fresh spinach and citrus salad. For a more savoury match, consider serving it with roasted chicken or mild white cheeses to complement its subtle fruit sweetness. To best appreciate its delicate 'ginjo-ka' aromas, it is recommended to be served chilled in a wine glass.

title: Domaine Comte Senard Bourgogne Blanc 'Lorraine' 2022
bodyHtml:
The 2022 Bourgogne Blanc 'Lorraine' from Domaine Comte Senard is a distinguished white wine hailing from the Burgundy region in France. Crafted exclusively from Chardonnay grapes, this wine exemplifies the estate's dedication to producing wines that reflect the unique terroir of Burgundy.

Colour: Pale gold with greenish reflections, indicating its youth and vibrancy.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring notes of white flowers, lemon, and acacia, complemented by subtle hints of fresh citrus.

Palate: Fresh, light, and crisp, offering flavors of lemon and acacia, with a nice hint of freshness on the finish.

Body: Light-bodied with a crisp and refreshing mouthfeel, showcasing both elegance and finesse.

Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

Accolades:

  • 90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

title: Chateau Dompierre 2018
bodyHtml:
Chateau Dompierre is a wine estate located in the commune of Saint Laurent Medoc, in the Gironde department, in the Nouvelle Aquitaine region. The estate founded and managed by Michel Aroldi produces red wine from the Medoc.

The red wine Dompierre Pauillac is made from the single grape variety Cabernet Sauvignon, grown in the Saint Lambert sector of the commune of Pauillac. It is produced at a rate of 10,600 bottles per year.

title: Franzia Rose White Zinfandel - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml: A crisp and refreshing blush wine with delicate strawberry aromas. Serve chilled. Complements cheeses, salads and simple pasta.

title: Andreas Bender Hofpasch Riesling Zenit 2018
bodyHtml:
Andreas Bender Hofpäsch Riesling Zenit is a distinguished white wine from the Mosel region of Germany, renowned for its delicate minerality and vibrant fruit character. Crafted by winemaker Andreas Bender, this wine exemplifies the traditional Auslese style, offering a harmonious balance between sweetness and acidity. The term "Zenit" signifies that this wine is produced only in exceptional vintages, highlighting its superior quality. 

Colour: Pale golden yellow with bright, clear reflections, indicating its freshness and purity.

Aroma: Enticing aromas of ripe apricot, peach, and citrus zest, complemented by floral notes of jasmine and a subtle hint of slate minerality.

Palate: Lush and balanced, featuring flavors of honeyed stone fruits, green apple, and a touch of lemon, with a crisp acidity that provides structure and a refreshing finish.

Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, velvety texture that is both refreshing and balanced.

Finish: Long and lingering, with a delicate minerality that leaves a refreshing and slightly saline aftertaste.

title: Albarino Marques de Murrieta Pazo Barrantes 2022
bodyHtml:
Pazo Barrantes Albariño is a distinguished white wine from the Rías Baixas region in Galicia, Spain. Produced by the esteemed Marqués de Murrieta family, this wine is crafted exclusively from 100% Albariño grapes cultivated on the 12-hectare Pazo de Barrantes estate, where the average vine age is 40 years.

Colour: Pale golden yellow with silver reflections, indicating its freshness and clarity.

Aroma: Enveloping nose with intense aromas of nectarine and yellow plum, hints of acacia blossom, and fennel on a balsamic background.

Palate: Vibrant and expressive, revealing the freshness of the vintage on a lively palate that leads to a broad and persistent finish.

Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, refreshing texture that emphasizes purity and balance.

Finish: Bright and lingering, with a delicate minerality that leaves a refreshing and slightly saline aftertaste.

title: Gerard Bertrand 'Heritage An 1152' Malbec 2020
bodyHtml:
The 2020 'Héritage An 1152' Malbec by Gérard Bertrand is a red wine from the Cahors appellation in the South West of France. This wine pays homage to the historic year 1152, marked by a significant union between France and England, symbolizing the rich heritage of the region. Crafted exclusively from Malbec grapes, it exemplifies Bertrand's dedication to producing wines that reflect the unique terroir of Cahors.

Colour: Dark red with purple-blue hues, indicating its concentration and youthfulness.

Aroma: An intense bouquet featuring notes of dark berries and violet, complemented by subtle hints of cassis and licorice.

Palate: Structured with silky tannins, this vintage offers a harmonious balance of ripe dark fruits, fresh acidity, and fine-grained tannins, leading to a broody, full-bodied, and seductively smooth experience.

Body: Full-bodied with a rich and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

Accolades:

  • 92 Points - Natalie MacLean

title: E. Guigal Cote Rotie 'La Turque' 2020
bodyHtml:
'La Turque' from E. Guigal is a renowned wine from the Côte-Rôtie appellation in the Northern Rhône Valley, crafted primarily from Syrah with a small addition of Viognier from the esteemed La Turque vineyard. This vintage masterfully reflects the terroir, blending strength with elegance.

Colour: Deep ruby red with intense, dark tints indicating high concentration.

Aroma: Richly aromatic with small red fruits, blackberry, and morello cherry, complemented by savory nuances and mineral undertones.

Palate: The palate opens with a supple, balanced structure showcasing concentrated cassis and darker fruits. The wine maintains remarkable freshness, a mid-palate depth, and refined tannins.

Body: Full-bodied yet graceful, with a weightless quality on the palate.

Finish: Long and harmonious, repeating mineral and floral notes on a chewy, extended finish.

Accolades:

97 - 99 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2020 Côte Rôtie La Turque brings a touch more mid-palate density and offers a straighter, more inward bouquet of cassis, graphite, smoked meats, and iron, with subtle gamey, bloody background nuances. It too is full-bodied and has a concentrated, structured mouthfeel, remarkable purity, and a killer finish. Reviewed March 2024

96 - 99 Points - Vinous

The 2020 Côte-Rôtie La Turque is shaping up to be terrific. Bold and supremely complex, it unwinds with expressive mocha, ripe black fruits, cured meat, pencil shavings and cedarwood nuances. Refreshing acidity neatly balances the elevated flavor concentration, all framed by a firm yet polished tannic corset. Simply put, the 2020 La Turque is a wine of class and precision, with notable inner energy and verticality. Review Date: 03/2024

98 Points - James Suckling

The nose is like what you smell when you enter a spice market in the Far East. Great concentration and underplayed power on the full-bodied palate, but also graceful, the generous dose of toasty oak almost perfectly integrated. Extremely long finish that keeps on pumping out the berry fruit, butter, orange and stone character. Drinkable now, but best from 2027. Review Date: 05/2024

title: Venge Zinfandel Croix Vineyard 2022
bodyHtml:
The 2022 Croix Estate "1904" Zinfandel is a distinguished red wine from the Russian River Valley in Sonoma County, California. Crafted predominantly from Zinfandel grapes, with a small addition of Alicante Bouschet, this wine originates from the historic Croix Estate Vineyard, established in 1904.

Colour: Deep, jet-black hue, indicative of Alicante Bouschet's influence on color concentration.

Aroma: Lively aromatics of boysenberry, blueberry, black cherry, and lavender immediately capture attention.

Palate: The mouthfeel is a viscous, luscious harmony of star anise, black plum, blackberries, and savory sweet bliss.

Body: Full-bodied with a rich and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and persistent, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure

This wine exemplifies Croix Estate's dedication to producing wines that are both expressive and true to their terroir, offering a delightful experience for Zinfandel enthusiasts.

title: Rooster Rojo Smoked Pineapple Tequila
bodyHtml:
Rooster Rojo Smoked Pineapple Tequila is a distinctive spirit crafted in the town of Tequila, Jalisco, Mexico. This unique expression combines traditional tequila-making techniques with innovative flavor infusion, resulting in a harmonious blend of smoky and tropical notes.

Production Process:

  • Base Tequila: Made from 100% Blue Weber agave, the tequila is aged for at least 12 months in ex-bourbon barrels, classifying it as an Añejo.
  • Infusion: After aging, the tequila is infused with smoked red Spanish pineapples, imparting a distinctive flavor profile.

Tasting Notes:

  • Aroma: Ripe banana, sticky pineapple, and subtle smoke.
  • Palate: Tropical fruit flavors with oak spice, roasted agave, and a gentle smokiness.
  • Finish: Medium length, smooth, with lingering smoky and fruity notes.

Serving Suggestions: This tequila can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as a unique base for cocktails such as a Smoked Pineapple Margarita.

Rooster Rojo Smoked Pineapple Tequila offers a unique tasting experience, blending traditional tequila craftsmanship with innovative flavor infusion.

title: Red Schooner Transit 3 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
This bold and 'innovative' red wine originates from Australia, specifically from the premier Barossa Valley and McLaren Vale regions of South Australia. Produced by the Wagner family, the creators of the iconic Caymus Vineyards, Transit 3 is part of the 'Red Wine of the World' series. The Wagners have a storied farming history in Napa Valley dating back to the 1850s, and their winemaking philosophy for the Red Schooner label involves a global approach where grapes are sourced internationally and produced in the signature, supple Caymus style.

Wine Description

Transit 3 presents a dark, swirling purple colour and offers a rich, 'New World' sensory profile. The nose is vibrant and complex, featuring scents of a 'berry basket', chocolate-covered strawberries, and fresh mint, alongside layered notes of smoky meat and wet soil. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and 'lush', showcasing intense flavours of ripe strawberry, raspberry, and plum with a unique hint of Australian mint. It is characterized by exceptionally soft, dusty tannins and a silky texture that provides a smooth mouthfeel. The finish is persistent, trailing off with traces of brown spice and refreshing fruit. This blend consists primarily of Grenache, Shiraz, and Mataro (GSM), often with a small amount of Cabernet Sauvignon, and reaches a high alcohol content (ABV) of 15.4%. While the Wagner family utilizes traditional farming methods and hand-selection, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Oak & Priest Sauvignon Blanc 'Out of the Park'
bodyHtml: Out of the Park Sauvignon Blanc is a rich and full-bodied white wine blend with layers of fresh citrus and stone fruits melded with minerality and crisp acidity. The addition of Semillon adds a touch of weight and viscosity while deepening the mid-palate and lengthening the finish.

title: Renato Ratti Barolo Marcenasco 2021 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'vibrant' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Barolo D.O.C.G. appellation of the northern Piedmont region. The Renato Ratti estate is universally celebrated as a historic revolutionary force in modern Piedmontese winemaking; in the 1960s, founder Renato Ratti single-handedly reshaped the region by introducing the concept of single-vineyard crus and drafting the first modern classification map of Barolo's terroirs. The "Marcenasco" vineyard—located in the commune of La Morra below the ancient 15th-century Abbey of Annunziata—holds a monumental legacy as the very first single-vineyard Barolo ever bottled by the estate, beginning with the historic 1965 vintage. Today, under the guidance of Renato's son, Pietro Ratti, the winery produces this flagship cuvée from old vines rooted in silt, clay, and calcareous marl soils, capturing the legendary elegance and aromatic complexity of La Morra.

Wine Description

The 2021 Renato Ratti 'Marcenasco' Barolo presents a classic, reflective garnet-red appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is exceptionally elegant, complex, and high-toned, perfectly embodying the finesse-driven style of La Morra. The bouquet opens with a captivating, multi-faceted display of macerated red cherries, cranberries, and preserved orange peel, beautifully layered with fragrant underlays of fresh violets, sweet licorice, tobacco leaf, and a distinct line of graphite and chalky minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, precise, and beautifully focused, showcasing a core of crunchy red fruits, pomegranate, and mulling spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a refreshing, vibrant backbone of natural acidity. The mouthfeel is remarkably sleek and polished, driven by lavish, ultra-fine, and velvety tannins that carry into a long, youthful, and highly savory finish highlighted by lingering notes of minty herbs, incense, and a pinch of black pepper.

title: CHIC Cava Brut (NV)
bodyHtml:
The CHIC Cava Brut from Barcelona is a fresh and lively sparkling wine made using the traditional method (Méthode Traditionelle). It originates from the Penedès region of Catalonia, where Mediterranean and continental influences create ideal conditions for growing the classic Cava grape varieties: Macabeo, Xarel·lo, and Parellada.

Colour: Light yellow with greenish reflections and fine, persistent bubbles.
Aroma: Offers fresh citrus, green apple, and subtle notes of yeast from the secondary fermentation.
Palate: Crisp and elegant, with flavors of lemon, apple, and a touch of minerality.
Body: Light-bodied with refreshing acidity.
Finish: Clean, with lingering citrus notes.

With an ABV of 11.5%, this cava is excellent as an aperitif or paired with tapas, seafood, or light salads. Its lively profile and refreshing acidity make it suitable for casual gatherings and celebrations alike. CHIC Barcelona Brut reflects the approachable elegance of Spanish sparkling wines, delivering excellent value for the price.

title: Domaine Zind Humbrecht Pinot Gris Heimbourg 2021
bodyHtml:
The 2021 Domaine Zind-Humbrecht Pinot Gris Heimbourg is a standout wine from the Alsace region of France. Sourced from the Heimbourg vineyard in Turckheim, the grapes benefit from the unique microclimate created by the vineyard’s west-facing slope, limestone-rich soils, and cooling valley winds, resulting in a refined, terroir-driven expression.

Colour: Intense yellow with golden hues.
Aroma: Subtle notes of pear, peach, and white fruit, along with hints of smokiness and beeswax.
Palate: The wine is very dry but offers a velvety texture, with vibrant acidity balancing the richness. Flavors unfold slowly in the glass, revealing layers of orchard fruit and a touch of minerality.
Body: Medium-bodied with depth and elegance.
Finish: Long and smooth, with lingering acidity and mineral undertones.

This vintage is recommended for cellaring, with optimal drinking between 2026 and 2039. Decanting is advisable if opened young to allow the wine to fully express its nuanced profile. It pairs wonderfully with rich seafood dishes, poultry, or creamy cheeses, enhancing the wine's bright acidity and texture. With an alcohol content between 12.5% and 13.6%, it offers both precision and versatility in food pairings.

title: Gray Monk Pinot Gris Washington State Limited Edition 2024
bodyHtml: Washington State Pinot Gris shows aromas of citrus and subtle orchard fruit followed by refreshing notes of apple and white peach on the palate.

title: Frasca La Guaragna Freisa D'Asti 2022
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s renowned Piedmont region, this wine hails specifically from the Asti area, the traditional home of the Freisa grape. Frasca La Guaragna is a family-run estate with deep roots in the region, dedicated to expressing Piedmont’s heritage through sustainable viticulture and minimal-intervention winemaking. Their philosophy focuses on elegance, authenticity, and letting native varietals shine.

Wine Description

This Freisa d’Asti pours a vibrant ruby red with purple highlights. On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of wild berries, violets, and hints of herbs. The palate reveals juicy redcurrant, mulberry, and blackberry, balanced by lively acidity and subtle notes of black tea and earth. Medium in body with fine, slightly rustic tannins, it finishes with freshness and a lingering mineral edge.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with traditional Piedmontese dishes such as tajarin pasta with meat ragù, roasted game birds, or braised rabbit. It also complements mushroom risotto or aged cheeses like Castelmagno.

title: Domaine Comte Senard Aloxe Corton Cuvee Jules 2022
bodyHtml:
The 2022 Domaine Comte Senard Aloxe-Corton Cuvée 'Jules' is a tribute to the estate’s founder, Jules Senard, crafted from Pinot Noir grapes grown across several prized plots, including Les Bruyères and Les Boutières. This wine reflects the unique terroir of Aloxe-Corton in Burgundy, with a focus on finesse and structure.

  • Colour: Deep ruby red.
  • Aroma: A bright bouquet of red fruits such as cherries and raspberries, with subtle floral and earthy hints.
  • Palate: Supple and expressive on entry, showcasing vibrant fruit flavors balanced by fine tannins.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with smooth texture and elegant structure.
  • Finish: Long and well-balanced, leaving notes of fruit and minerality.

The 2022 Cuvée Jules pairs beautifully with barbecued meats, poultry, and game dishes, making it a versatile choice for food lovers and collectors alike. This wine showcases the heritage and meticulous winemaking that define Domaine Comte Senard’s approach. For further details, you can explore additional insights on the producer's official pages and wine marketplaces.

title: Wynns Black Label Coonawarra Shiraz Old Vines 2021
bodyHtml:
The 2021 Wynns Black Label Old Vines Shiraz represents Coonawarra's celebrated cool-climate style, crafted from some of the region’s oldest vineyards. These vines, planted between the 1890s and 1920s, lend depth and complexity to the wine, showcasing the winery’s heritage and attention to detail.

  • Colour: Deep ruby red with purple hues.
  • Aroma: Notes of ripe blackberries, cherries, and subtle pepper, with undertones of chocolate and cedar.
  • Palate: Rich and layered with red and dark fruit flavors, complemented by spice and oak nuances.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with fine, silky tannins.
  • Finish: Long and balanced, leaving hints of pepper and fruit.

This wine pairs excellently with grilled meats, lamb, or game dishes. It offers both immediate appeal and long-term aging potential, drinking well now through 2031. With its heritage of old vines and Wynns' dedication to quality, this wine reflects the essence of Coonawarra's renowned terroir.

title: Silenus Tyros Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml:
The 2017 Silenus Tyros Cabernet Sauvignon offers a bold expression of Napa Valley terroir. A blend of 77% Cabernet Sauvignon and 23% Merlot, this wine is crafted to highlight ripe fruit flavors with a smooth, approachable structure. Aged for 22 months in a mix of French and American oak, it showcases the vineyard diversity across Napa’s sub-appellations.

  • Colour: Deep ruby with garnet undertones.
  • Aroma: Black cherry, plum, and leather, complemented by hints of mocha and dried herbs.
  • Palate: Smooth and balanced with flavors of ripe red fruits, cedar, and pomegranate, finishing with subtle oak spice and vanilla.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with soft tannins.
  • Finish: Long and dry, with lingering notes of smoke and oregano.

Accolades:

  • 91 Points - Natalie MacLean
  • 90 Points - Decanter

This wine is ready to enjoy now but can also be cellared through 2028. It pairs beautifully with pork tenderloin, BBQ ribs, or roasted lamb, offering a versatile option for various meals. For those looking to explore approachable Napa wines with depth and finesse, this bottle offers great value.

title: Dillon's Unfiltered Gin 22
bodyHtml:
Dillon's Unfiltered Gin 22 is a complex, artisanal gin crafted from a grape-based spirit in Beamsville, Ontario. Infused with 22 botanicals, this gin is known for its bold flavors and smooth mouthfeel, thanks to the absence of chill filtering. The botanicals include lavender, juniper, and hibiscus, resulting in a floral and aromatic profile.

  • Colour: Slightly cloudy when chilled or mixed, highlighting its unfiltered nature.
  • Aroma: Bright notes of citrus, juniper, lavender, and pine, with subtle herbal nuances.
  • Palate: A layered combination of licorice, orris root, and spices, with citrus in the background.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with a silky, smooth texture.
  • Finish: Long, with lingering floral and herbal tones.

Accolades:

  • 93 Points - Wine Enthusiast (2015)
  • Double Gold Medal - 2014 San Francisco World Spirits Competition
  • Platinum Medal - 2013 SIP Awards

This gin works well in cocktails like martinis or gin and tonics, where its bold character can shine. Its unfiltered style adds depth and complexity, making it a favorite among those who appreciate distinctive, flavorful gins.

title: NODO Tequilana Reposado
bodyHtml:
NODO Tequilana Reposado is an artisanal agave spirit made from 100% Blue Weber agave, grown in Zacatecas, Mexico. Although it cannot be labeled as tequila due to being outside the official denomination of origin, it follows traditional methods of production. Aged for four months in single-use bourbon barrels, this spirit embodies smoothness with complex layers of flavor.

  • Colour: Light golden.
  • Aroma: Subtle oak and caramel notes with hints of agave and vanilla.
  • Palate: Smooth and well-rounded, with flavors of baked agave, light spices, and a touch of sweetness.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with a velvety texture.
  • Finish: Long and balanced, leaving delicate notes of oak and vanilla.

This reposado is ideal for sipping neat but also works well in cocktails like Margaritas and Palomas, making it versatile for various drinking experiences. It highlights the craftsmanship and authenticity behind NODO’s agave spirits, offering a refined alternative for those seeking unique expressions from outside the traditional tequila regions.

title: NODO Tequilana Blanco
bodyHtml:
NODO Tequilana Blanco is an artisanal agave spirit crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave in Zacatecas, Mexico. Though it cannot be officially labeled as tequila due to being produced outside the designated region, it mirrors the traditional craftsmanship of high-quality tequila. The agave is harvested at peak maturity and double-distilled in a copper and steel alembic still, resulting in a spirit that emphasizes purity and authentic agave character.

  • Colour: Crystal clear.
  • Aroma: Bright agave notes with hints of citrus, herbs, and subtle minerality.
  • Palate: Crisp and fresh with earthy agave flavors, balanced by light citrus and peppery undertones.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, clean texture.
  • Finish: Long and vibrant, leaving refreshing mineral and herbal notes.

This versatile spirit is excellent for sipping neat or using in cocktails, offering a refined, traditional experience reminiscent of pre-industrial tequila-making methods.

title: NODO Coffee Tequilana
bodyHtml:
NODO Coffee Tequilana is a unique agave-based spirit that blends the earthy richness of Tequilana Weber agave with bold coffee flavors. Crafted in Zacatecas, Mexico, it undergoes an infusion of freshly ground coffee beans and raw cane sugar for 15 days, resulting in a rich and complex beverage that bridges the world of coffee and spirits.

  • Colour: Dark amber to coffee-brown, reflecting the infusion of roasted coffee beans.
  • Aroma: Aromatic coffee notes with hints of caramel, orange zest, and subtle agave undertones.
  • Palate: A smooth interplay of espresso, chocolate, and earthy agave, balanced by a touch of sweetness.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with a velvety mouthfeel.
  • Finish: Long and warming, leaving notes of coffee, cocoa, and a hint of citrus.

This beverage is ideal for sipping on its own or incorporating into coffee-based cocktails. With its harmonious blend of coffee and agave, it offers an exciting twist for both coffee lovers and tequila enthusiasts.

title: NODO Coconut Tequilana
bodyHtml:
NODO Coconut Tequilana is a unique agave spirit infused with real coconut, crafted with meticulous care in Mexico. It combines traditional Blanco Tequilana Weber agave with the tropical essence of fresh coconut, resulting in a smooth and slightly sweet spirit with a modern twist.

  • Colour: Clear with a slight viscosity.
  • Aroma: Intense coconut fragrance, accompanied by hints of tropical fruit and subtle agave undertones.
  • Palate: A smooth balance of coconut sweetness, light agave notes, and a touch of cane sugar.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with a silky texture.
  • Finish: Long and refreshing, with lingering tropical fruit and mild sweetness.

This coconut-infused agave spirit is ideal for sipping neat or incorporating into tropical cocktails. It offers a fresh take on flavored agave spirits while staying true to the craftsmanship of traditional Mexican distilling methods. NODO Coconut Tequilana is a versatile spirit, perfect for creating refreshing summer cocktails.

title: Luigi Bosca De Sangre Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml:
Luigi Bosca De Sangre Cabernet Sauvignon, sourced from Luján de Cuyo and the Uco Valley in Mendoza, offers a bold expression of Argentina’s rich terroir. Aged for a year in oak barrels, this wine showcases the winery’s commitment to crafting structured yet approachable Cabernet Sauvignon.

  • Colour: Deep garnet red.
  • Aroma: Blackcurrant and blackberry with hints of green bell pepper, mint, and cocoa.
  • Palate: Juicy red fruit flavors complemented by pepper and dark chocolate undertones.
  • Body: Full-bodied with fine tannins and well-balanced acidity.
  • Finish: Long and smooth, leaving a touch of spice and coffee notes.

title: Flambeaux Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
vendor: 301962 - My Cellar Wines And Whiskeys Ltd.
bodyHtml:
The 2019 Flambeaux Cabernet Sauvignon from Alexander Valley in Sonoma County showcases the winery’s signature style, emphasizing structure and bold fruit flavors. This vintage is crafted primarily from Cabernet Sauvignon, with small amounts of Malbec and Petit Verdot to enhance complexity.

  • Colour: Deep ruby with garnet reflections.

  • Aroma: Aromas of black currants, dark plums, and hints of spearmint, with subtle herbal notes like basil.

  • Palate: Concentrated flavors of blueberries, blackberries, and baking spices, offering a rich, full-bodied profile.

  • Body: Full-bodied with moderate tannins and a polished mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Long and smooth, with lingering fruit and spice nuances.

Accolades:

  • 92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This wine is built to be enjoyed now but will also develop further complexity through 2030, making it an excellent choice for aging. It pairs beautifully with grilled meats, hearty stews, or aged cheeses, enhancing its robust character.

title: Jean Louis Chave Saint Joseph 2023
bodyHtml:
From France’s Northern Rhône Valley, the Jean Louis Chave Saint Joseph 2023 is a benchmark expression of Syrah. Domaine Jean-Louis Chave, a family estate with roots tracing back to 1481, has become synonymous with exceptional Rhône winemaking. Under Jean-Louis Chave’s stewardship, the domaine continues its tradition of blending multiple vineyard parcels to craft wines of depth, balance, and authenticity.

Wine Description

The 2023 Saint Joseph presents a deep ruby colour. The nose is vibrant with red and black fruits, notably plum, cassis, and blackberry, intertwined with violet, black olive, graphite, and savoury spice. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, delivering layers of dark currant, licorice, and smoked meat. The tannins are polished yet firm, lending structure to a wine that carries both minerality and elegance. Its finish is persistent and complex, leaving lingering notes of pepper and florals.

Food Pairing

Ideal alongside grilled lamb chops, roasted duck, or braised beef, the wine’s savoury depth also complements mushroom risotto or aged cheeses.

title: Francois Mikulski Hautes Cotes de Beaune Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: Francois Mikulski Hautes Cotes de Beaune Blanc is a bright and fresh white Burgundy crafted from 50+ year old vines, organically farmed and fermented with indigenous yeast. This elegant Chardonnay is aged in barrel, with 17% new oak, delivering a wine that flexes beautifully with food. Perfectly paired with stinky cheese, roast white meats, root veggies, or enjoyed as an aperitif, this wine is both versatile and impressive. It’s a must-have for any fine wine collection.

title: Brotte Chateauneuf du Pape 'Les Hauts De Barville' 2020
bodyHtml:
Les Hauts de Barville Chateauneuf-du-Pape offers ripe mulberry and strawberry notes abound from nose to finish, accented by hints of sweet spice and dried Mediterranean herbs. While rich and plush in body, it has brisk, integrated acidity and finely edged tannins that lend elegant structure.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Exuberant and expressive, this offers cherry coulis, raspberry, red licorice and warm earth notes that are juicy and open-knit, yet propped up with snappy acidity, a refreshing surge of fine mineral and a note of tar. Grenache, Syrah and Mourvedre. Drink now through 2030. 10,000 cases made, 3,500 cases imported.

91 Points - James Suckling

A classic, grenache-dominated Chateauneuf with a wide spectrum of red fruit, as well as notes of spices and violets. Rich, but with plenty of moderately dry tannin to balance the fleshiness, this has a long finish, where the sweetness and savory character are neatly matched. Drink or hold.

title: Brotte Chateauneuf du Pape Red 'Les Hauts de Barville' 2020
bodyHtml:
This distinguished red wine hails from the Châteauneuf du Pape appellation in the Southern Rhône Valley of France. Maison Brotte is a historic family business established in 1931 by Charles Brotte, a pioneer in bottling Rhône Valley wines. Currently managed by the fourth and fifth generations of the Brotte family, the winery follows a philosophy of highlighting the purity of fruit and the specific characteristics of their limestone and sand-based terroirs.

Wine Description

The Brotte Chateauneuf du Pape 'Les Hauts de Barville' presents a deep ruby red colour with slight violet reflections in its youth. The sensory profile is intense and refined, featuring complex aromas of ripe red fruits, black cherries, and blackberries, often accented by notes of liquorice, spices, and sun-dried garrigue. On the palate, the wine is rich and unctuous, offering a supple and creamy texture balanced by fresh acidity and fine-grained, mineral tannins. This blend is predominantly Grenache, complemented by Syrah and Mourvèdre, and occasionally a small percentage of Cinsault.

title: Arkenstone Cabernet Sauvignon NVD 2019
bodyHtml:
Crimson with a garnet core. This Cabernet greets you with violets, ripe red cherry, lilac and graphite on the nose. The complexity resulting from the blend of beautiful Eastern mountain vineyards translates into bright ripe red fruits, cassis and pomegranate on the front palate, seamlessly moving to black raspberry, blueberry, orange peel, dark chocolate and rosemary exploding mid-palate. Eucalyptus, fresh herbs, mocha and black cherry round out the long satisfying finish.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

All Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon NVD is a smoking value and comes from Pritchard Hill, Howell Mountain, and Calistoga. It spent 22 months in 75% new French oak. Cassis, black raspberries, violets, and floral notes all define the bouquet, and it’s medium to full-bodied, seamless, and incredibly polished, with terrific balance.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2019 NVD Cabernet Sauvignon is deep garnet-purple in color, giving up notes of black cherry preserves, baked plums and boysenberries with touches of cassis, spice box and dried mint. The palate is medium to full-bodied, firm and refreshing, delivering loads of red fruit sparks and a long, savory finish.

93 Points - Wine Spectator 

Dark and winey, this Cabernet is packed with a mix of black currant paste, blackberry preserves and melted black licorice, all kept focused and defined thanks to a spine of graphite and a gilding of sweet spices. This will have lots of fans for sure.

title: Domaine Comte Senard Bourgogne Rouge Cuvee 'Auguste' 2022
bodyHtml: Named after the winemaker’s son, Auguste, this Bourgogne Rouge is expressive and complex on the nose, with red fruit aromas. A wonderful wine for everyday – fresh and fruity.

title: Cantina del Pino Barbaresco 'Ovello' 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The Barbaresco DOCG "Ovello" by Cantina del Pino is a wine that embodies the quintessence of Nebbiolo, grown in one of the most renowned crus of Barbaresco, the Ovello vineyard. This winery, guided by the passion and expertise of a family deeply rooted in the history and viticulture of Barbaresco, produces a wine that reflects the power and elegance of the terroir.

Visually, the "Ovello" has an intense garnet red color, with orange nuances that become more accentuated with aging. On the nose, the wine expresses a rich aromatic range, where notes of ripe red fruits stand out, such as cherry and plum, enriched by nuances of withered flowers, spices, tobacco and a light trace of chocolate, all supported by a subtle mineral thread which gives further complexity.

On the palate, Cantina del Pino's Barbaresco "Ovello" shows all its structure and depth, with robust but finely crafted tannins that integrate perfectly with the typical acidity of Nebbiolo, guaranteeing a balanced and persistent sip. The finish is long and allows spicy and fruity reminiscences to emerge, with a pleasant mineral vein that cleans the palate.

This wine pairs beautifully with intense and tasty dishes, such as roast meats, game, mushroom dishes and mature cheeses. Barbaresco "Ovello" is also an excellent companion for moments of reflection, capable of evolving and revealing ever new layers of aromas and flavors as time passes.

title: A Pachas Reserva 2019
bodyHtml:
Vinícola de Arganda, founded in the 1940s and moved to new premises in 2002, brings modern technology into play to produce quality wine. Located in the Madrid region, the winery benefits from natural irrigation from the Tagus River, which supports the cultivation of the Tempranillo grape on its 150 hectares of vineyards. The uniqueness of this wine is due to its origin from an area surrounded by three rivers, which ensures ideal conditions for the wine's complex and spicy aroma.

A Pacha Reserva expresses an intense and spicy aroma that is long and elegant in the mouth. This wine is particularly suitable for dishes with rice, poultry, white meat, red meat and cheese, making it a versatile companion to many meals. From the Arganda del Rey vineyard comes this wine, a tribute to traditional viticulture and modern technology hand in hand. What makes this wine special is its ability to combine cherry flavors with a spicy yet elegant profile, reflecting the unique terroir.

title: A Pachas Joven Tempranillo 2022
bodyHtml:
Vinícola de Arganda, founded in the 1940s and moved to new premises in 2002, brings modern technology into play to produce quality wine. Located in the Madrid region, the winery benefits from natural irrigation from the Tagus River, which supports the cultivation of the Tempranillo grape on its 150 hectares of vineyards. The uniqueness of this wine is due to its origin from an area surrounded by three rivers, which ensures ideal conditions for the wine's complex and spicy aroma.

This Madrid Tempranillo is ruby red in color with an intense nose of red fruits. Balanced with good tannin and fruit, it is medium in body with a bright finish.  This is a red that can be sipped on its own with friends but is extremely versatile with a variety of cuisine. Enjoy with tapas or main dishes like pizzas, grilled octopus, cured meats and pastas.

title: A Pachas Crianza 2021
bodyHtml: Explore the robust flavors of A Pachas – Crianza, a Spanish red wine known for its rich taste and aromatic depth. Crafted in Spain, this exquisite wine combines the essence of ripe fruits with a hint of oak, perfect for any occasion.

title: Val di Suga Brunello di Montalcino 2019
bodyHtml:
The 2019 Val di Suga Brunello di Montalcino is a classic expression of Sangiovese from Tuscany’s prestigious Montalcino region. This wine combines grapes from three distinct vineyard sites—northeast, southeast, and southwest—each contributing unique characteristics to the blend. The result is a harmonious balance of elegance, warmth, and minerality.

Colour: Intense ruby red with slight garnet reflections.
Aroma: Notes of ripe red fruits, complemented by subtle hints of dried flowers, spices, and a touch of oak.
Palate: On the palate, it offers flavors of cherry and red berries, with refined tannins and balanced acidity, creating a lively and structured profile.
Body: Medium to full-bodied with depth and finesse.
Finish: Long and expressive, leaving lingering earthy and floral notes.

This wine was aged for 24 months in large Slavonian oak barrels, followed by six months in the bottle, which enhances its complexity while preserving the fruit's freshness. With an alcohol content of 14%, it pairs beautifully with red meats, game, and dishes featuring truffles. The 2019 vintage stands out for its freshness and balance, promising excellent aging potential through the next decade, with a peak drinking window starting from 2024.

Accolades:
93 Points - Wine Spectator

title: Clarendelle Saint Emilion 2020
bodyHtml:
Brilliant colour, with a beautiful, dark red hue. The maturity is evident from the outset, with fleshy red berry aromas, particularly black cherry and blackcurrant. They are followed by some subtle animal notes, hints of forest floor and a dash of violet. The gentle extraction process has yielded a well-balanced and concentrated wine, with velvety smooth tannins. 

The palate is full-bodied and indulgent.  Full-bodied on the palate, it is delicious and very fruity, with notes of cocoa. Hints of spices and liquorice come through on the aftertaste. It displays long-lasting flavours and is silky and delicious throughout. All in all, a delicate yet powerful and wonderfully complex wine.

title: The Macallan Single Malt Harmony Collection Vibrant Oak
bodyHtml:
The fourth release in the Harmony Collection has been created in collaboration with Cirque du Soleil to tell our oak story in an imaginative, visual and innovative way.

The whisky, created by The Macallan Whisky Mastery Team, is matured in a combination of first fill sherry seasoned American oak casks and refill sherry casks. These have been carefully selected to deliver the classic American oak flavours of vanilla, citrus and sweet oak, naturally derived from the cask during maturation, with a medium, sweet finish that delicately lingers.

title: Caymus Cabernet Sauvignon 'Napa Valley' 2022 - 50th Anniversary
bodyHtml:
The 2022 Caymus Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon marks the 50th anniversary of Caymus Vineyards, a family-owned winery established in 1972 in Napa Valley, California. This special release celebrates five decades of winemaking excellence, showcasing the Wagner family's dedication to producing high-quality Cabernet Sauvignon.

Colour: Deep, opaque ruby red, indicating its concentration and youthfulness.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring notes of ripe blackberries, cassis, and dark cherries, complemented by hints of vanilla, tobacco, and dark chocolate.

Palate: Full-bodied and well-structured, offering flavors of dark plum, blackberry, and savory spices, complemented by a rich, fleshy texture.

Body: Full-bodied with a rich and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and persistent, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

Accolades:

  • 95 Points - Natalie MacLean
  • 91 Points - Wine Spectator
  • 90 Points - CellarTracker Community Ratings

title: Yangarra Estate Grenache McLaren Vale 'Ovitelli' 2021
bodyHtml: Ovitelli is the most perfumed and elegant Grenache from the sands at Yangarra. Sourced from a single block, the vibrant fruit of those dry grown 1946 bush vines is rewarded with a long, luxurious ferment and a whole autumn on skins in big ceramic eggs.

title: Bottega Gold Brut - 200 ml
bodyHtml: Bottega Gold is a Prosecco DOC, obtained by the vinification of Glera grapes. The elegance, freshness and liveliness of its bubbles stem from the beauty and tradition of its territory, where unmistakable panoramas are shaped by vineyards.

title: Santa Ema Cabernet Sauvignon 'El Cruce' 2022
bodyHtml: Santa Ema El Cruce Select Terroir wines offers an outstanding value with freshness and richness. This Cabernet Sauvignon generously offers aromas and flavors of plums, blackberries, and raspberries with a light touch of toast.

title: The Deacon Blended Scotch Whisky
bodyHtml: The Deacon is a masterful blend of both smoky Speyside and peaty Islay malt whiskies, making for a complex, rich, and smoky dram. In our blend, the single malts from Islay have a characteristic peaty smoke flavour, while the single malts from the mainland have a bonfire-like smoke character. A nose of charred orange, sweet malty biscuits and woodsmoke gives way to juicy orange on the palate along with delicate spice, and tangy peat. The finish is both sweet and smoky, long and smooth.

title: Three Finger Jack Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: 'Three Finger Jack' references a tall tale of the eponymous outlaw who searched the Sierra Foothills for treasure. Reflective of its namesake, this suave, appealing Chardonnay is bold and charismatic, with flavours of pear, mango, and toasted almonds, plus hints of butterscotch from barrel ageing.

title: Vega Sicilia Valbuena No 5 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Few wines have a history as distinguished as that of Vega Sicilia. Founded in the 1860’s, its reputation on its flagship vintage has for more than 100 years produced two great wines, each appropriately named "Unico."

The purest expression of the Tinto Fino (Tempranillo) in Vega Sicilia. Tinto Fino is clearly the predominant wine in the assemblage of the varieties that make up this magnificent wine. The other variety used is Merlot, which is added to a greater or lesser extent depending on the vintage.

97 Points - James Suckling

Extremely perfumed with violets and a bouquet of flowers. Then there’s blue fruits such as blueberries and raspberries. Medium-bodied with beautifully crafted tannins that give a superb mouthfeel and finesse. Refinement with depth and focus. 

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Valbuena was produced with a blend of Tinto Fino with 3% Merlot. It has 14.5% alcohol, a pH of 3.88 and 4.6 grams of acidity. I love the nose; it is perfumed and subtle. And the wine is beautifully textured; the tannins are very fine, silky even, quite different from the tannins from the other 2019s from the group that I tasted next to this, Macan and Pintia. A triumph over the conditions of the year, it's a more elegant Valbuena than I anticipated.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

There's a quiet power to this polished red, with sculpted, chalky tannins enmeshed in a graceful range of ripe black plum and black cherry flavors, plus accents of Earl Grey tea, violet and cigar box. Long and silky, with a vibrant, well-spiced finish.

title: Chateau Cheval Blanc 1995
bodyHtml:
Chateau Cheval Blanc is a property that needs no introduction. The wines of Cheval Blanc have been described as, “the finest cashmere,” and “elegance in motion,” by Pierre Lurton who oversees this Saint-Emilion Premiere Grand Cru Classe A Estate. Though the estate has never been ranked in the 1855 Classification, Chateau Cheval Blanc produces wines with quality that is on par with Left Bank First Growths. Though the wines of Chateau Cheval Blanc are considered some of the best in all of Bordeaux, if you ask any member of the team at the property, they will humbly tell you it is all about terroir. 

96 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of rose petal and hints of fresh herbs such currant leaf. Tobacco, too. Medium body, very fine tannins and a balanced fruit. Extremely refined and polished. A beautiful harmony.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

This is an outrageously decadent Cheval Blanc. The nose is layer upon layer of ebullient, red-berried fruit: raspberries, crushed strawberries, lavish creamy new oak and a touch of vanilla pod.

93 Points - Vinous

93 Points - Wine Spectator

title: Floresta Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
This 100% Chardonnay originates from Chile, specifically from the coastal Limarí Valley. Founded in 1880, Viña Santa Rita is a pillar of Chilean viticulture that balances its deep historical roots with a modern focus on sustainability and innovation. Under the direction of winemaker Sebastián Labbé, the Floresta range emphasizes a 'minimal intervention' philosophy designed to showcase the unique calcareous soils and maritime influence of specific vineyard parcels.

Wine Description

The Santa Rita Floresta Chardonnay presents as a bright yellow wine with elegant, austere, and dry characteristics. The nose is dominated by white fruit and floral notes, specifically white peach and pear, accented by a distinct touch of stony minerality. On the palate, the wine offers a creamy texture that is expertly balanced by a vibrant, saline energy derived from the region's limestone soils. Its complex sensory profile includes notes of sweet lime, pineapple, and hazelnut, concluding with a long finish marked by honey and sea salt.

title: Taittinger Comtes Grand Cru Blanc Brut 2013
bodyHtml:
Originally known as Forest-Fourneaux with history dating back to 1734 and in 1932 Pierre Taittinger bought the House and the Taittinger label was born. A century of incredible growth saw Taittinger become one of the biggest producers and today is one of the last big independent, family-owned Houses.

Taittinger Comtes de Champagne is a prestige cuvee Blanc de Blancs made entirely from Chardonnay grapes sourced from the best Grand Cru vineyards in the prestigious Cote des Blancs region. It is only produced when the harvest is of exceptional quality worthy of a vintage year.

98 Points - James Suckling

Nervy and tight with notes of crushed almonds, chalk, white grapefruit, digestive biscuits, lemons and apricot stones. Hints of fennel and white pepper. Deep and mineral, with plenty of power. Very fine bubbles. Long drive at the end.

title: Rosebank 32 Year Old (Release 3)
bodyHtml:
Rosebank Distillery, often hailed as the "King of the Lowlands," has a storied history dating back to the 19th century. After ceasing production in 1993, the distillery was revived by Ian Macleod Distillers, culminating in the release of the 32-Year-Old Legacy Release Three in 2023. This remarkable whisky serves as a testament to the distillery’s heritage and its triumphant return to prominence.

This exceptional single malt Scotch whisky, distilled in 1990, showcases Rosebank's signature triple-distilled character. It presents a pale gold hue, with a nose offering sweet aromas of pineapple and candied ginger mingling with lemon and marzipan, accompanied by hints of white pepper and café latte. The palate is velvety, featuring notes of malt, thyme, butterscotch, tropical fruits, drying oak, and softly warming spice. The finish is soft and long, with notes of lemon, honeyed porridge, and toasted walnut.

This whisky pairs beautifully with dishes such as seared scallops, creamy risotto, or mild cheeses, enhancing the whisky's depth and creating an unforgettable dining experience.

The 2023 release of this 32-year-old expression marks a significant milestone in Rosebank's revival, offering enthusiasts a rare opportunity to experience the distillery's classic Lowland style. It is the oldest in the series and a celebration of Rosebank's craftsmanship and legacy.

title: Dos Angeles Caidos Tequila Rosa
bodyHtml:
Introducing Tequila Blanco Rosa: aged to perfection in Tempranillo Wine Barrels from Vinas del Sol; barrels that once held the award-winning Santos Brujos wine. Its vibrant color and enticing aromas promise a taste sensation like no other.

Enjoy the smooth, flavorful journey with every sip, culminating in a satisfying finish. Elevate your Tequila experience with the innovative fusion of tradition and sophistication in the Tequila Blanco Rosa.

title: Dos Angeles Caidos Tequila Blanco
bodyHtml: Enjoy the essence of Tequila Blanco, 100% Agave Azul, pure and additive free. Crystal clear with silver reflections, it delights with a hint of sweetness, balanced acidity, and lingering notes of pepper and herbs. Experience the craftsmanship in each sip, where fresh grass meets toasted aromas and mineral undertones. A harmonious blend of flavors awaits in this extraordinary Tequila Blanco.

title: Charles Heidsieck Brut - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
A deep golden robe. Delicate vivacious and long-lasting bubbles are the result of more than 36 months of ageing in chalk cellars. With 40% of reserve wines (the maximum possible amount), the blend offers a complex, voluptuous nose with notes of freshly baked brioche and the richness of roasted coffee beans. 

A precise selection of wines, purposely limited to 60 crus, ensures the Charles Heidsieck Brut Reserve a deliciously sophisticated harmony. An opulent selection of ripe, sun-drenched fruits such as mango, apricot, and greengage plum combines with dried fruits, pistachio and almond. The texture is reminiscent of a crisp layer of nougatine on a velvety cream pastry filled with plump red plums and ripe cherries. The reserve wines, some dating back ten years give the wine lushness. The depth of the thousand-year-old chalk quarries where the wine matures offer a touch of praline along with notes of amber and vanilla.

title: Blue Canyon Estate Grown Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Blue Canyon wines are truly the “Soul of the Pacific Ocean.” They deliciously express the nuances of each grape variety and the vineyards where the grapes are grown. Our wines are unique to this maritime-influenced region, the meeting point of land and sea.

Crisp, fresh and open with aromas of green apple, citrus blossom and a hint of vanilla spice. Bright pear and citrus flavors with a lively touch of savory oak lead into a lingering tropical fruit finish.

title: Poderi Aldo Conterno Langhe Nebbiolo 'Il Favot' 2019
bodyHtml: The grapes used to make "Il Favot" come from vineyards which have undergone periodical implantations, and so have a maximum age of 15 years. The skin contact is limited to 6-8 days so to extract few tannins and more colour from the skins themselves, with the result of getting a well-coloured wine with a remarkable softness.

title: Poderi Aldo Conterno Barbera D'Alba 'Conca Tre Pile' 2020
bodyHtml:
Poderi Aldo Conterno, one of the most esteemed wineries in Piedmont, is known for producing wines that embody tradition and excellence. The 2020 Barbera d'Alba "Conca Tre Pile" comes from a special hillside vineyard in the Bussia Soprana area of Monforte d'Alba, where older vines and optimal exposure result in wines of great depth and character.

Vineyard and Harvest

The Barbera vines in the "Conca Tre Pile" vineyard are up to 45 years old, benefiting from the well-drained, calcareous-clay soils of the region. The grapes are harvested by hand in early October, ensuring only the highest-quality fruit is selected.

Vinification and Aging

After careful sorting, the grapes undergo fermentation in stainless steel vats with extended skin contact for approximately 8 to 10 days at controlled temperatures. The wine is then aged in oak barrels, where it develops structure, complexity, and a refined integration of fruit and wood.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Deep ruby red with vibrant purple hues.
  • Nose: Expressive aromas of ripe blackberry, plum, and dark cherry, layered with subtle notes of vanilla, tobacco, and warm spice.
  • Palate: Rich and full-bodied, with concentrated flavors of black fruits and hints of licorice and toasted oak. A bright acidity keeps the wine fresh, while well-integrated tannins provide depth and balance. The finish is long and lingering with a touch of minerality.

Serving Suggestions

This Barbera d'Alba pairs beautifully with rich Italian dishes such as pasta with meat sauces, grilled meats, and aged cheeses. It is best served at 16–18°C (60–64°F) and can be enjoyed now or cellared for further complexity.

The 2020 Barbera d'Alba "Conca Tre Pile" from Poderi Aldo Conterno is a standout example of Barbera at its finest. With its balance of fruit, acidity, and structure, it offers both immediate enjoyment and long-term aging potential, making it a must-have for lovers of classic Piedmontese wines.

title: Domaine Comte Senard Bourgogne Blanc 'Ana' 2022
bodyHtml: Domaine Comte Senard is nestled in the heart of the charming Burgundy village of Aloxe-Corton. The vineyard was established in 1857 by Jules Senard, who passionately developed his two hectares of vines. Today it boasts ten hectares of vines, including eight hectares of Pinot Noir red grapes and two hectares of Chardonnay. Convinced that to produce great wines, quality raw materials are essential, the winemaker applies the same meticulous care in the cellar as they do in the vineyards.

title: Lost Peak Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml: This distinctive Chardonnay offers glimpses of vanilla and almond, underscored by tropical fruit undertones and a lingering, slightly toasted finish.

title: Rhum JM 2013 Single Vintage
bodyHtml:
Immerse yourself in the essence of Martinique with the 2013 vintage Rhum Vieux J.M Hors d'age, an exquisite creation from the Rhum J.M distillery, nestled on the majestic slopes of Mount Pelee. Every year, this renowned distillery reveals its precious treasure, the Hors d'age rum.

This exceptional rum has been meticulously aged for 9 years in recycled bourbon barrels, continuing the tradition of JM Vintage Rums. This long maturation gives it complex notes of candied fruit, woodiness and vanilla, creating a symphony on the palate that will enchant rum connoisseurs.

title: Rhum JM 2016 Ex Bourbon Cask #1607
bodyHtml:
Located in the heart of the Caribbean, it is in Macouba in the north-east of the island of Martinique (France) between the Roches River and the Macouba River that the Fonds-Preville Distillery was established in 1845. It is nestled at the foot of Mount Pelee in a green setting of incredible biodiversity.

The cane fields are in the immediate vicinity of the distillery, set in the middle of the 300-hectare Fonds-Préville estate created in 1790.

Considered by the press and connoisseurs as the ‘best old rum in the world’, J.M creations have a unique flavour. Their superior quality is the result of generations of proven know-how and a tenacious desire to preserve traditional farming and production methods. The wild richness of this preserved terroir, its generous nature, its rich volcanic soil, its contrasting climate, its naturally filtered pure water and its extremely fresh sugar cane give all its character to this Martinique Agricultural Rum.

title: Rhum JM 2015 New Oak Cask #1512
bodyHtml: Considered by the press and connoisseurs as the ‘best old rum in the world’, J.M creations have a unique flavour. Their superior quality is the result of generations of proven know-how and a tenacious desire to preserve traditional farming and production methods. The wild richness of this preserved terroir, its generous nature, its rich volcanic soil, its contrasting climate, its naturally filtered pure water and its extremely fresh sugar cane give all its character to this Martinique Agricultural Rum.

title: The Arran Malt Machrie Moor 10 Year Old
bodyHtml: A ten year old edition of Arran's Machrie Moor, which introduces a smoky edge to the distillery's excellent single malt. The peaty elements pair wonderfully with the vibrant, fruity, softly grassy whisky, and with ten years of maturation in first fill bourbon casks behind this one, you can expect a fab flavour profile right here. The name, if you're curious, comes from peat bog on the western side of the island.

title: Rhum JM 2014 New Oak Cask #1409
bodyHtml: Considered by the press and connoisseurs as the ‘best old rum in the world’, J.M creations have a unique flavour. Their superior quality is the result of generations of proven know-how and a tenacious desire to preserve traditional farming and production methods. The wild richness of this preserved terroir, its generous nature, its rich volcanic soil, its contrasting climate, its naturally filtered pure water and its extremely fresh sugar cane give all its character to this Martinique Agricultural Rum.

title: Prati by Louis Martini Cabernet Sauvignon Sonoma County 2022
bodyHtml: This Louis Martini Sonoma County Cabernet Sauvignon is an approachable, fruit-driven wine. It offers a welcomingly round mouthfeel with ripe notes of red fruit and cherry. Delicate hints of dark chocolate and oak spice on the finish add layers of elegance and freshness, offering a rich yet balanced expression of the varietal.

title: Wente Mount Diablo Highlands Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
Inviting aromas of red fruit, highlighted by bright, fresh plum and red cherry. Subtle notes of toffee and coffee bean intertwine, leading to a delicate undercurrent of white pepper. The wine is medium-bodied and well-balanced. This red blend dances on the palate with the harmonious fusion of red fruit flavors and a touch of oak. A seamless finish lingers gracefully, showcasing the perfect balance between fruitiness and a touch of spice.

This versatile Central Coast Red Blend complements a range of dishes. Enjoy it alongside grilled, herb-marinated chicken, mushroom risotto, or a classic Margherita pizza. For cheese lovers, pair with aged gouda or creamy brie.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This youthful wine starts with aromas of blackberry, jammy black cherry and woodspice. Loaded with acid and sharper in texture, the palate delivers fruity flavors of red and black berries.

90 Points - James Suckling

A medium-bodied, juicy and fruity red with aromas of dark cherries, plums and warm spices. Round tannins and texture with a mellow finish.

title: Bodegas Benjamin Rothschild & Vega Sicilia 'Macan Clasico' 2021
bodyHtml:
Macan Clasico emerged from the heart of La Rioja. A wine of yesterday and today that respects the most authentic and typical style of a prestigious region.

Macan and Macan Clasico are the joint vision that two great names of the wine world, Rothschild and Vega Sicilia. They are very elegant wines, where the harmony of their aromas and flavours show the authenticity of the land from where they come and its capacity to produce great wines.

Red wine wholly made using the Tempranillo variety. After the alcoholic fermentation, the malolactic process is carried out in barrels and in tanks. The ageing takes place in extra fine and fine grain French wood, the majority in new barrels and the rest in one-wine barrels. It remains in wood for 15 months and then in bottles until it is sold.

title: Antinori Castello della Sala Cervaro 2024
bodyHtml: Cervaro della Sala is a light straw yellow in color with light green highlights. The nose offers aromas of chamomile, white flower blossoms and flint. The palate is savory, lively, and fresh. A Mediterranean style wine with outstanding aging potential.

title: Kraljica Plum Brandy
bodyHtml: Rich and sophisticated fragrance of real fruit dominates the taste of this brandy, which is harmonious and with a final touch of pure oak flavour.

title: Nobleza 33 Tequila Blanco
bodyHtml:
Nobleza 33 Tequila Blanco is an artisanal, small-batch unaged spirit produced in Arandas within the High-Altitude Highlands (Los Altos) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the acclaimed Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados distillery (NOM 1414), the expression embodies the brand’s core philosophy, "La Virtud de la Espera" (The Virtue of Waiting). Designed for agave purists, this additive-free blanco highlights the bright, unadulterated terroir of Los Altos agave combined with traditional artisanal processing techniques.

Spirit Description

Nobleza 33 Blanco is made from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves cultivated in the mineral-rich red clay soil of the Jalisco Highlands. The agaves are slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens and extracted, followed by an open-air fermentation process utilizing proprietary wine yeast strains accompanied by classical music playing in the fermentation room. Double-distilled in copper pot stills, the spirit is unaged and bottled straight from distillation to capture the pure agave and floral complexity of the distillate.

  • Colour: Luminous, crystal clear with bright silver highlights and heavy cling on the glass.

  • Aroma: Bright and highly aromatic, opening with sweet cooked agave, fresh lime zest, and grapefruit, accompanied by white pepper, floral blossoms, subtle green bell pepper, and an inviting stony minerality.

  • Palate: Silky, vibrant, and agave-forward on the entry. Upfront flavors of rich roasted agave and bright citrus yield to crisp green apple, floral notes, white pepper spice, and a subtle salinity that reflects the Highland terroir.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a round, velvety, and mouth-coating texture.

  • Finish: Clean, crisp, and long, leaving trailing notes of sweet cooked agave, cracked black pepper, citrus peel, and gentle mineral dryness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Nobleza 33 Tequila Reposado Legado
bodyHtml:
Nobleza 33 Tequila Reposado Legado is an artisanal, small-batch aged spirit produced in Arandas, within the High-Altitude Highlands (Los Altos) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the famed Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados distillery (NOM 1414), this expression honors the brand's philosophy of patience and traditional craftsmanship. Expanding upon the distillery’s renowned additive-free Blanco foundation, Legado is aged in select oak casks to achieve a harmonious balance between vibrant Highland agave sweetness and refined barrel-aged complexity.

Spirit Description

Nobleza 33 Reposado Legado is produced from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves harvested from the red clay soils of Los Altos. The agave piñas are slow-cooked in traditional stone brick ovens, extracted, and fermented in open-air vats using proprietary wine yeast strains. Following double distillation in copper pot stills, the distillate rests for several months in hand-selected white oak barrels. This careful maturation allows the spirit to absorb subtle oak, vanilla, and spice notes while preserving the core unadulterated agave character.

  • Colour: Pale golden amber with bright straw and honeyed reflections.

  • Aroma: Rich, warm, and inviting, opening with cooked agave, sweet vanilla bean, and light caramel, followed by toasted oak, subtle baking spices, citrus peel, and gentle floral undertones.

  • Palate: Smooth, velvety, and complex on the entry. Upfront flavors of roasted agave, butterscotch, and soft vanilla blend seamlessly into toasted almond, gentle cinnamon spice, dried fruit, and a subtle mineral backbone.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a soft, rounded, and coating mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and clean, trailing off with lingering sweet agave, soft oak tannins, mild pepper, and a delicate honey sweetness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Nobleza 33 Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
Nobleza 33 Reposado Tequila is an artisanal, small-batch spirit produced in Arandas within the High-Altitude Highlands (Los Altos) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the acclaimed Feliciano Vivanco y Asociados distillery (NOM 1414), the brand operates around a ethos centered on "The Virtue of Waiting" (La Virtud de la Espera). Combining traditional highland agave harvesting with slow maturation, Nobleza 33 delivers an authentic, additive-free expression celebrated by agave purists.

Spirit Description

Nobleza 33 Reposado is crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves matured in the iron-rich red soil of Los Altos. The agaves are slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens and extracted, followed by an open-air fermentation process utilizing proprietary wine yeast strains accompanied by soothing classical music. After double distillation in copper pot stills, the liquid rests in select oak casks (including white oak and wine barrels) to balance ripe fruitiness with gentle barrel spice.

  • Colour: Bright pale golden straw to light honey with warm amber glints.

  • Aroma: Aromatic and predominantly fruit-forward, opening with sweet orange citrus, cooked agave, and light oak, complemented by vanilla bean, cake batter, and subtle notes of red apple and dried fruit.

  • Palate: Creamy, complex, and well-rounded on the entry. Upfront flavors of roasted agave, toasted hazelnut, and crisp red apple give way to soft caramel, light cocoa, warm oak, and subtle earthy minerality.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a dense, silky, and coating mouthfeel that clings lightly to the glass.

  • Finish: Smooth, elegant, and persistent, closing with trailing notes of toasted wood, dark cocoa, sweet agave, and gentle baking spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Foxglove Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml: Foxglove Cabernet Sauvignon offers all of the enjoyment you've come to love about California Cabernet Sauvignon. The cool climate and fog layer of the Central Coast allows for a longer, cooler growing season than you see in Sonoma or Napa Valley. This produces a fresher and less dense Cabernet Sauvignon.

title: The Sexton Single Malt Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml: Inside the distinct, black hexagonal bottle is a bright golden spirit with warming aromas of toffee, marzipan, citrus, allspice and hints of dark chocolate. On the palate flavours of dried fruit and oak shine through, a direct result of aging in Oloroso Sherry casks; the finish is smooth and supple with a kiss of sweetness.

title: Maraska Zadar Cherry Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Maraska, a distinguished Croatian distillery with roots tracing back to 1759, is renowned for its production of Maraschino liqueur. Located in Zadar, along the Adriatic coast, Maraska has upheld a rich tradition of crafting this unique cherry liqueur for over five centuries. The distillery's commitment to quality and heritage is evident in every bottle, making it a staple in both local and international markets.

Description
