Maraska's Maraschino liqueur is crafted from the indigenous Marasca cherries, which are native to the Dalmatian region. This clear liqueur presents a harmonious blend of sweet and slightly tart cherry flavors, accompanied by subtle almond notes derived from the cherry pits. The aroma is rich and aromatic, offering a bouquet of cherry and floral undertones. On the palate, it delivers a smooth and balanced experience, with a lingering finish that is both sweet and slightly bitter, characteristic of the Marasca cherry.

Serving Suggestions
Traditionally enjoyed as a digestif, Maraska Maraschino can be sipped neat or over ice. Its versatility also makes it a favored ingredient in classic cocktails such as the Aviation, Martinez, and Hemingway Daiquiri, where it imparts a distinctive cherry flavor that enhances the overall profile of the drink. Additionally, it can be drizzled over desserts like vanilla ice cream or used in baking to add a unique cherry essence. 

Accolades
Maraska's dedication to preserving the authentic production methods of Maraschino liqueur has garnered international recognition, solidifying its reputation as a producer of high-quality spirits. While specific awards for this liqueur are not detailed here, its longstanding presence in the market speaks to its esteemed status among connoisseurs and casual drinkers alike.

title: Dos Angeles Caidos Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml: 100% Blue Agave Tequila, double distilled. High-quality agave is carefully selected and processed through cooking, spontaneous fermentation, and double distillation. It presents a well-defined straw color with golden reflections and has a complex aromatic intensity with notes of cinnamon, wood, pepper, clove, olive leaves, and a pleasant hint of vanilla, complemented by toasted chestnuts and a slight dark chocolate scent. On the palate, it showcases its texture and complexity with a prolonged finish dominated by toasted notes, inviting repeated tasting.

title: Don Julio Blanco - 1.75 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Pure tasting tequila made only from quality agave. Pours clear with lively aromas of fresh agave, lemon, lime, and grapefruit. Smooth on the palate with light agave sweetness, delicate grassy notes and a hint of black pepper leading to a clean finish.

title: Sunshine Bay Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: Intense tropical and citrus aromas. Striking notes of nettles, pink grapefruit and kiwifruit leap from the glass. The crisply defined palate is underlined with minerality, lingering with guava and ripe pear.

title: Liquidity Merlot 2019
bodyHtml:
This elegant Merlot hails from Canada, specifically the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, a region renowned for its diverse microclimates and exceptional viticulture. Liquidity Wines, situated in the heart of Okanagan Falls, is celebrated for its meticulous approach to sustainable farming and artisanal winemaking. Owned by Arterra Wines Canada, the winery combines modern techniques with respect for the land, crafting expressive wines that showcase the region’s unique terroir.

Wine Description

Liquidity Merlot 2019 presents a deep ruby hue with inviting garnet edges. On the nose, it reveals complex aromas of ripe plum, black cherry, and cassis, interwoven with subtle hints of cedar, vanilla, and dried herbs. The palate is plush and medium to full-bodied, delivering flavours of blackberry, dark chocolate, and a touch of savoury spice. Silky tannins and a well-integrated acidity lead to a long, smooth finish accented by notes of mocha and gentle oak.

Food Pairing

This Merlot’s supple texture and rich fruit profile pair wonderfully with herb-crusted lamb, grilled portobello mushrooms, or a classic beef tenderloin. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Louis Latour Pinot Noir 'Les Pierres Dorees' 2021
bodyHtml: Best known for its Gamay Noir wines, the Beaujolais region in southern Burgundy can also produce fleshy, vibrant Pinot Noirs. This cuvee from the famed Louis Latour reveals notes of cherry, licorice, and nutmeg with a hint of violet. Enjoy it tonight with a fresh salad, or cellar it for another five years.

title: Chateau Pegau Pink 2022
bodyHtml:
Pink Pegau Rose is a pink/salmon in color, with peach, floral and red fruit aromas. Bone dry, with a crisp, mouth-watering acidity leading to a long, spicy, mineral finish.

Enjoyable as an aperitif, this versatile rose will also pair well with a wide range of foods (charcuterie, Salmon Rillettes, grilled summer vegetables, hummus with crudités, and more).

title: Jayson Chardonnay 2020 by Pahlmeyer
bodyHtml:
Pahlmeyer was founded in 1986, by a desire to be great by its eponymous creator Jayson Pahlmeyer. With a dream to create a California Mouton, Jayson and his partners spared no resource to make this dream a reality. Whether it was finding the perfect piece of land high atop Napa Valley’s Atlas Peak or covertly smuggling in Bordeaux cuttings, all pieces of Pahlmeyer’s history have led to its place as one of the top brand names from Napa Valley. 

Wine Description
The Jayson Chardonnay 2020 presents a brilliant straw yellow hue in the glass. On the nose, it unfolds with layers of ripe pear, golden apple, and Meyer lemon interwoven with nuances of honeysuckle and subtle vanilla from well-integrated oak. The palate is rich and creamy yet beautifully balanced by a vibrant acidity, delivering flavors of stone fruit, citrus zest, and a delicate minerality. Medium to full-bodied, it offers a long, elegant finish with lingering notes of toasted almond and crème brûlée.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points.

  • James Suckling - 92 points.

  • Wine Enthusiast - 92 points.

Food Pairing
Delight in pairing this Chardonnay with seared scallops drizzled with a citrus butter sauce, or a roasted chicken seasoned with fresh herbs and garlic. A creamy mushroom risotto also beautifully complements its texture and depth. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Reifel Rye
bodyHtml: Created in honour of legendary distiller George H. Reifel, this rye is a masterpiece that George would be proud of. Aged in charred white oak and ex-bourbon barrels it has an abundance of aromas and flavours of toffee, vanilla, pear and chocolate. With great depth, this whisky has a lingering warmth on the finish.

title: Santa Ema El Cruce Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: Santa Ema El Cruce Select Terroir wines offers an outstanding value with freshness and richness. This Sauvignon Blanc is fresh and young with layers of citrus fruit, pear and apple aromas and flavors. Highly aromatic citrus fruit with notes of pears and apples.

title: Blasted Church OMG 2018
bodyHtml:
The wine opens with toasted brioche, strawberry, raspberry, and secondary aromas of lemon zest and Granny Smith apple.

Persistent, delicate, and refined bubbles wash over the palate, carrying with them a wave of red berry, lemon curd, and toasty bread notes into the long, vibrant finish.

title: Arabella Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from South Africa, produced in the Robertson region within the Western Cape. Arabella is a family owned and run business by the De Wet family, who have farmed the land in Ashton since the 1860s. The winery's name is a tribute to the Arabian horses that graze on the estate's pastures. Their winemaking philosophy centres on manual harvesting and careful vineyard management to produce top quality wines that faithfully reflect the unique calcium rich soils of the Robertson valley.

Wine Description

The Arabella Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep ruby red colour with a vibrant hue. The nose is brimming with abundant blackcurrant aromas, complemented by subtle hints of cherry, baking spice, and cedar. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and juicy, delivering concentrated flavours of ripe plum and dark berries. It is characterized by its smooth texture, fine tannins, and a persistent finish with earthy and spicy undertones. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon typically features an ABV ranging from 13.5% to 14% and is aged for 5 to 10 months in French oak to add softness and complexity.

title: Bulleit Barrel Strength Batch No. 8
bodyHtml:
Bulleit Barrel Strength is medium amber in colour, with gentle spiciness and sweet oak aromas. The mid-palate is smooth with tones of maple, oak and nutmeg. The finish is long, dry and satiny with a light toffee flavour, but with deepened oak notes.

Distilled in Kentucky from the highest quality ingredients, this new variant is a barrel strength version of Bulleit Bourbon with the same high-rye mash bill. Bulleit Barrel Strength won Best Straight Bourbon and received a Double Gold Medal from the 2018 San Francisco World Spirits Competition, and earned a score of 92 at the 2017 Ultimate Spirits Challenge – continuing Bulleit’s history of sharing award-winning whiskeys.

The barrels selected to create Bulleit Barrel Strength were emptied and combined into a single batch without the inclusion of any additional water after the whiskey was removed from the barrels. Aged and bottled at Stitzel-Weller in Louisville, Ky., this new offering allows bartenders and fans of great whiskey the opportunity to taste Bulleit Bourbon straight out of the barrel, uncut and non-chill filtered.

title: Casamigos Cristalino Reposado
bodyHtml: Casamigos Cristalino Reposado is made from 100% Blue Weber agaves from the rich clay soil of Mexico. Our reposado is twice distilled and aged to perfection in American white oak barrels, then carefully charcoal filtered to restore the crisp, bright agave flavor found in our Blanco Tequila while maintaining some of the cask notes. The filtration process removes the golden honey color of the Reposado, resulting in a crystal-clear spirit.

title: G4 Tequila Blanco (80 Proof)
bodyHtml:
G4 Tequila Blanco is an unaged artisanal spirit originating from the Highland region of Los Altos in Jalisco, Mexico. The brand is produced at the renowned El Pandillo distillery under the ownership of the Camarena family, who represent a century-long, fourth-generation legacy of traditional tequila fabrication. Master Distiller Felipe Camarena is celebrated for combining deeply traditional methods with custom-engineered, eco-friendly distillery innovations.

Spirit Description

G4 Blanco is made from 100% estate-grown blue Weber agave cooked in traditional stone ovens for 22 hours. Instead of using a traditional volcanic stone wheel, the agave is crushed by a custom-built mechanical shredder nicknamed "Felipone". The defining element of G4 is its water source: it is proofed using a unique 50/50 blend of collected rainwater and natural spring water, capturing a pure Highland terroir.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and luminescent.

  • Aroma: Highly expressive and crisp. The nose is dominated by incredibly clean cooked agave, a profound wave of fresh rain on hot pavement (petrichor), wet stones, bright lime zest, and intense white pepper.

  • Palate: Crisp, vibrant, and incredibly agave-forward. Upfront notes of sweet roasted agave and vegetal green pepper blend seamlessly into a mineral-heavy mid-palate, complemented by notes of citrus peel and subtle anise.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a beautiful natural oiliness that coats the throat cleanly, lacking the harsh burn found in mass-produced tequilas.

  • Finish: Long, crisp, and drying, leaving a powerful signature kick of cracked black pepper and lingering agave sweetness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Martoccia Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
Brunello di Montalcino is surely one of the most well-known and treasured wines in the world. It is a red wine of extraordinary elegance and concentration obtained from a long ageing process. It has a full and ethereal fragrance with hints of wild berries, black cherry and vanilla.

Bright ruby red, tending to garnet with aging. Bouquets of cherry, plum and spices. Full bodied , lively acidity with flavors of red fruits. Fresh and long aftertaste. Long aging potential wine.

title: Louis Jadot Puligny Montrachet 2020
bodyHtml:
The House of Louis Jadot has been producing exceptional Burgundy wines since its founding in 1859 by Louis Henry Denis Jadot. For the past 150 years Louis Jadot has continued as one of the great names of Burgundy and has gained international reputation for its superb red and white Burgundy wines. 

Distinctive, concentrated fresh fruit and vanilla aromas carry on to the palate and culminate in a persistent, lingering finish. Puligny produces wines with greater firmness and depth than those of Meursault, and greater refinement and delicacy than those of Chassagne.

title: Louis Jadot Meursault 2020
bodyHtml:
The House of Louis Jadot has been producing exceptional Burgundy wines since its founding in 1859 by Louis Henry Denis Jadot. For the past 150 years Louis Jadot has continued as one of the great names of Burgundy and has gained international reputation for its superb red and white Burgundy wines.

Ripe, full-fruited aromas and flavors include brioche and hazelnut. A medium body and supple texture carry into a persistent finish.

Pairs with fish, shellfish, poultry and cheeses.

title: Melifera Immortelle Gin Botanical
bodyHtml:
Envision an ethereal, windswept island, wild yet gentle. Let yourself be carried away by the heat of the dunes, the mist of the Atlantic island and the beauty of its golden soils. It is on this island Melifera thrives.

She invites you to imagine, to dream and takes you someplace else to guide you, step by step, to the heart of your emotions.

Melifera commits to preserving and respecting this place.

Distilled locally in a distillery with ancestral know-how. Certified Ecocert, it is the only organic gin to use the immortelle flower, harvested by hand from plants sown on the island of Oleron. As local roots and respect for the ecosystem is crucial to them, Melifera is a brand committed to preserving biodiversity.

title: Gruber Roschitz Gruner Veltliner 2023
bodyHtml: Medium greenish yellow, silver reflections. Fresh yellow apple fruit, a hint of orange zest and blossom honey, inviting bouquet. Medium body, nuances of honeydew melon, fine acidity, mineral-salty notes on the finish.

title: Escorihuela 1884 Gran Reserva Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml: Yellow in the glass. The nose delivers pear, lime and pineapple notes in a pencil box frame. Fairly creamy and taut in the mouth, the well-balanced palate is redolent with fruity flavor before the long-lasting, nutty finish.

title: Escorihuela 1884 Gran Reserva Malbec 2021
bodyHtml: Deep, bright, violet red color with matching reflections. The nose is expressive and fruity. Fresh and ripe red fruits are appreciated in balance, such as plums and blueberries, jammed forest fruits and violets. On the palate it is a juicy red with clear fruit flavors, with notes of vanilla and chocolate from its aging in oak. Its attack is fresh and juicy. It flows wide with a gentle texture and good balance. Round, sweet and elegant tannins that ensure a pleasant and long finish.

title: Trapiche Malbec Tesoro 2021
bodyHtml: Aromas and flavors of crushed blackberries, black tea, hints of roasted nuts, and licorice.

title: Roebuck Estates Classic Cuvee 2017
bodyHtml: Rich, yet pale lemon in colour. Notes of baked pears and citrus fruits are layered with a toasty richness and hint of sweet spice. Delicate bubbles linger on the palate leading to a long, beautifully balanced finish.

title: Roebuck Estates Blanc de Noirs (NV)
bodyHtml: Crafted exclusively from handpicked Pinot Noir grapes grown at the Roman Villa vineyard, Blanc de Noirs is a rich, yet beautifully balanced wine with notes of baked apples and ripe stone fruits, layered with a touch of brioche and roasted walnuts.

title: Nugan Estate Zinfandel 2020
bodyHtml:
This wine by nature is a robust red grape variety that revels in the warm climate at Langhorne Creek in South Australia. Zinfandel is a robust red grape variety that revels in the warm climate at Langhorne Creek in South Australia. After harvest, the grapes were crushed and chilled for cold soaking and maceration. The parcel was inoculated with pure yeast culture and pumped over four times daily to extract maximum colour and flavoured. The wine was then transferred to American oak hogsheads for fermentation and maturation for 18 months. The blended wine was cold stabilized and earth filtered before being dispatched for bottling.

Dense inky red in apperance with a youthful crimson hue. Fragrant notes of glace cherry, red current, perfume and bramble. A full falvoured wine with foundations of persistent fine tannins, candied red fruits, liqueur plum, allspice and a grind of pepper.

title: Pio Cesare Barbaresco 2020 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The Nebbiolo grapes for this wine are sourced exclusively from the Cesare family’s own vineyards: the famous “Il Bricco” Estate and the great hill of San Stefanetto, both located in the village of Treiso. One third of the wine was aged in French oak botti and barriques (one third new) for 30 months. The remainder spent three years in large French oak casks.

A very classic Barbaresco, this is an elegant wine with ripe, spicy fruit and great depth and complexity. The gentle tannins show finesse, but make no mistake: this is a Barbaresco with structure and opulence. It shows very long ageing potential.

96 Points - James Suckling

Very fine and polished with plum, strawberry and cedar aromas as well as an iodine, sea shell and chocolate undertone. Medium body, ultra-fine tannins and a beautiful finish. It’s poised and gorgeous. Such brightness and finesse with structure.

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

title: Pio Cesare Barolo - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The Nebbiolo for this Barolo was sourced from a number of family-owned vineyards: Ornato in Serralunga d’Alba, Gustava in Grinzane Cavour, Roncaglie at La Morra, and Ravera in Barolo-Novello. The balance of the grapes comes from growers the Cesare family has worked with for years.

The fruit was fermented in stainless steel tanks (up to one month of skin contact), then the wine was transferred to French oak (the majority in 20 to 50 hectolitre casks, the remainder in smaller barriques) where it matured for three years.

Pio Cesare produces classic Barolo at a very high level. That expertise is apparent in the wine’s structure, harmony, gentle tannins, and balanced fruit. It is immediately approachable, but with very long ageing potential.

97 Points - James Suckling

Very primary fruit with beautiful aromas of peaches, strawberries, berries and flowers. It’s medium- to full-bodied, with bitter citrus, cedar, chocolate and coffee bean character. Tight at the end.

93+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

title: Black Stallion Cabernet Sauvignon North Coast 2022
bodyHtml: This rich and refined wine does not require years of further aging to achieve ideal balance and enjoy upon release. The full-bodied structure is a hallmark. The wine opens with stunning aromas of blackberry, black currant, and toasty notes of cedar; the palate is concentrated with bold, velvety flavors of black cherry and a hint of spice. Intense, concentrated fruit and fine grained tannins with beautifully balanced acidity extends to an elegant finish.

title: Cain Concept The Benchland Napa Valley 2015
bodyHtml: The Cain Vineyard site is truly spectacular, cradled in a bowl overlooking St. Helena from the top of the Spring Mountain District. In 1980, Joyce and Jerry Cain purchased part of the McCormick Ranch, a homestead dating back to the 1840's. The Cains were in search of a unique mountain property where they could realize their dream of planting the five classical Bordeaux varietals from which to draw one ideally structured wine, which would result as a blend of all five varieties.

title: Tequila Fuenteseca Extra Anejo 7 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Fuenteseca Tequila presents the mastery of agave cultivation and tequila distillation using agave cultivated in various soil types, distilled in assorted still types, and rested in an array of vessels, be they of stainless steel or a collection of wooden casks from around the world… harmonizing to create incomparable spirits in a series of limited bottlings.

Three-quarters of the bottling made in a double-copper column still with removed plates to achieve a lower distillation proof and the remaining quarter made in an alembic pot still. Half of the run was then stored in American white oak previously used to age California red wine, and the remaining half barreled in used dark French Oak. The casks were then stored for 7 years at 3,800' elevation in a cool-climate subterranean barrel room.

The tequila offers spicy sweet oak, caramel, vanilla, with hints of black pepper, apricots, and baking spices, culminating in a spicy-sweet extra añejo finish with pronounced oak and a sweet dry aftertaste.

title: Magellan Le Fruit Defendu Rose - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml: Burgundy born Bruno Lafon grew up and worked at the family domaine before making his own way in the south of France. This is a charming, Provence-like rose in its pale pink colour and red fruit flavours. But it tastes like it has been loved: hand picked and gently nurtured from grape to glass, it is finely textured with long aftertaste.

title: Cain Concept The Benchland Napa Valley 2015 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: The Cain Vineyard site is truly spectacular, cradled in a bowl overlooking St. Helena from the top of the Spring Mountain District. In 1980, Joyce and Jerry Cain purchased part of the McCormick Ranch, a homestead dating back to the 1840's. The Cains were in search of a unique mountain property where they could realize their dream of planting the five classical Bordeaux varietals from which to draw one ideally structured wine, which would result as a blend of all five varieties.

title: Castello Romitorio 'Romitorio Toscana' 2022
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the sun drenched hills of Tuscany, Italy, Castello Romitorio 'Romitorio Toscana' is a bold and expressive Super Tuscan. Established in 1987 by famed Italian artist Sandro Chia, the estate has long been celebrated for fusing creative freedom with rigorous winemaking traditions.

Wine Description

This deeply concentrated red blend is crafted from equal parts Syrah and Petit Verdot, sourced from the wild hills of Scansano and vinified at the estate's Montalcino facility. In the glass, it reveals an intense garnet-red hue. The nose offers a rich, complex bouquet of blackberry, boysenberry, and ripe red plums, layered with nuanced aromas of lavender, dried flowers, violet, cracked white pepper, and a hint of smoky bacon fat. On the full bodied palate, the wine is supple, tense, and beautifully integrated, showcasing polished, silky tannins and a lively acidity that keeps the dark fruit profile vibrant and fresh.

Food Pairing

The robust structure, dark fruit core, and complex herbal undertones of this blend make it an exceptional match for hearty, savory dishes such as roasted venison, grilled prime rib, or slow braised wild boar ragu.

title: Tequila Fuenteseca Extra Anejo 5 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Fuenteseca Tequila presents the mastery of agave cultivation and tequila distillation using agave cultivated in various soil types, distilled in assorted still types, and rested in an array of vessels, be they of stainless steel or a collection of wooden casks from around the world… harmonizing to create incomparable spirits in a series of limited bottlings.

62% of this expression’s tequila was column-distilled, then aged in European barrels that were previously used to age wine. 38% of the tequila in this lot was distilled in an Alembic pot still, then aged in French Oak barrels. The result is a smooth, rich, and complex flavour profile.

title: Tequila Fuenteseca Blanco Single Estate 2020
bodyHtml:
Fuenteseca Tequila presents the mastery of agave cultivation and tequila distillation using agave cultivated in various soil types, distilled in assorted still types, and rested in an array of vessels, be they of stainless steel or a collection of wooden casks from around the world… harmonizing to create incomparable spirits in a series of limited bottlings.

This Cosecha bottling is made from over-ripe Highland pinto Blue Weber agave grown at 5,019′ elevation in the rugged, extremely mineral-laden caliche soil of Vista Hermosa, Micohoacán, the southernmost region within the D.O. This area’s calcium carbonate-suffused, mineral-rich terroir is evident in Tequila Fuenteseca Cosecha’s fantastically-heightened minerality that beautifully accents the pure agave flavors of sweet, cooked yams and warm baking spices. Rested in stainless steel for 3 years.

title: Marques de la Concordia NV Seleccion Especial Brut 2022
bodyHtml:
Marqués de la Concordia, a distinguished Spanish winery, has been producing exceptional wines since 1882. Located in the heart of the Penedès region, approximately 40 km southwest of Barcelona, the estate has a rich history of crafting high-quality cavas using traditional methods. Their commitment to excellence has earned them international acclaim, with their cavas consistently receiving awards for their superior quality.

Wine Description

The Monistrol Selección Especial Brut is a sparkling wine made from a blend of Macabeo, Xarel-lo, and Parellada grapes. It presents a pale yellow color with a slight straw hue. On the nose, it offers a balanced bouquet with fine aromas resulting from its aging process. The palate is characterized by long-lasting bubbles that provide a fresh and lively aftertaste. This cava is carefully aged in quiet underground cellars for 15 months before release, following the traditional Champagne method.

Food Pairing

This cava pairs excellently with appetizers, soups, and white fish dishes. Its refreshing profile also makes it a delightful accompaniment to light salads and seafood. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Casa Silva Chardonnay Coleccion 2025
bodyHtml:
Located in the small village of El Tambo near San Fernando, Casa Silva was originally founded by Emilio Bouchon of Bordeaux in 1982. In recent years, Mario Silva and winemaker Mario Geisse have raised the quality of the winery to the point where Casa Silva is now the most awarded Chilean winery of the 21st century.

Pair with baked salmon, steamed mussels w/ garlic, sea bass, and fresh salads. Great with soft white cheeses.  Limpid yellow in colour.  An attractive nose of tropical fruit with almonds, walnuts and hints of butter. Refreshing, crisp, and without oak and malolactic fermentation. Has a nice long finish.

title: L'Usine Cellars Sleepy Hollow Vineyard Pinot Noir 2019 (Orin Swift)
bodyHtml: L'Usine Sleepy Hollow Vineyard is a Pinot Noir that isn't dominated by ripe fruit aromas; instead, the earthy side of the varietal takes center stage. The medium crimson hue has a dark rim that foreshadows the nose of brioche, potting soil, black fig, pomegranate and some red fruits scattered throughout. Flooding the palate, the entry is pure raspberry preserve with a hint of crunchy blueberry and strawberry on the mid-palate. The welcoming toasted oak on the finish rounds out the wine with a soft, lifting mouthfeel and a lingering note of cranberry and acid.

title: Gabbiano Toscana Dark Knight 2021
bodyHtml: The nose is dominated by intense notes of ripe red berry fruit and complementary aromas of sweet spices, coffee chocolate, and vanilla. Full body ample and balanced on the palate, the wine shows silky tannins along with a sweet and spicy finish and aftertaste.

title: Nielson Chardonnay Santa Barbara 2022
bodyHtml:
Nielson Chardonnay originates from the United States, specifically from the Santa Barbara County region of California's Central Coast. The winery pays homage to its namesake, Uriel J. Nielson, a viticultural pioneer who in 1964 planted the first commercial vineyard in Santa Barbara County—a region previously dismissed by neighboring farmers as too cold for viticulture. Currently part of the Jackson Family Wines portfolio, the winery utilizes small lot winemaking techniques such as hand pruning and block by block harvesting to capture the specific nuances of the region. The winemaking philosophy focuses on expressing the purity, freshness, and vibrancy of Santa Barbara County, where maritime influences like morning fog and Pacific breezes preserve natural acidity.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay is recognized for bridging the gap between historical and contemporary Californian styles, offering a balance of richness and brightness.

  • Aroma: The nose is packed with fruit, featuring creamy citrus, tropical notes, and citrus blossom, alongside hints of clean linen.

  • Palate: The palate is both lush and concentrated, delivering flavours of honey, citrus sorbet, and fresh orchard fruits like apple and pear.

  • Body and Finish: It typically possesses a medium body with a textural, silky mouthfeel and fresh acidity. The finish is marked by a light salinity and a lingering mineral character.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 13.9% and 14.2%.

  • Organic Status: Grapes are sourced from vineyards certified sustainable by the CCSW (Certified California Sustainable Winegrowing) program.

  • Stylistic Notes: Winemaking techniques often involve a combination of stainless steel fermentation to preserve fruit purity and neutral oak barrel aging to add complexity without overwhelming the wine with toast or vanilla.

title: Clos du Bois Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
When Clos du Bois was founded in 1974, Sonoma County was better known for its prunes, walnuts and dairy farms than for its wine grapes. With more soil types than France, Founder Frank Woods recognized the potential of Sonoma County as a world-class wine growing region, and it is here in Sonoma's Alexander Valley where Clos du Bois has been making outstanding wines for more than three decades.

The Clos du Bois Chardonnay is a refreshingly aromatic wine from the rugged coast of California. Scents of warm apple pastry rise from the glass with touches of honey and toasted oak. Bright layers of freshly sliced pear and ripe apple with zests of citrus carry through the long finish.

title: Pursued by Bear 'Bear Cub' Red Blend 2021
vendor: 301962 - My Cellar Wines And Whiskeys Ltd.
bodyHtml:
From a vintage marked by low yields, warm growing conditions, and sufficient hang time to produce wines with intense aromas and concentrated flavors, the 2020 Bear Cub is fruit-forward and youthful, bursting with black fruit and an appealing hint of cedar. Juicy summer berries, black currant, ripe plum and streaks of shaved cocoa are richly expressive on the palate. Smooth and easy drinking with a finish that lasts, this Cub has enough structure to prove it's no baby.

Blend: 57% Cabernet Sauvignon, 43% Merlot

title: Pursued by Bear Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
vendor: 301962 - My Cellar Wines And Whiskeys Ltd.
bodyHtml:
The 2020 Pursued by Bear Cabernet Sauvignon is a deep, darkly colored wine offering generous notes of wild blackberry, cocoa powder, and warm vanilla spice. Undertones of black plums and ripe, dark cherries build layered complexity on the palate with the wine’s fine-grained tannins and balanced acidity creating a generous and richly textured mouthfeel that gives way to a long, expressive finish. 

From a vintage that will be remembered for producing beautiful wines displaying outstanding aromatics, concentrated flavors and fresh vibrancy, this classic Washington Cab shows an ideal mix of lush, pure New World fruit and Old World structure.

Blend: 95% Cabernet Sauvignon, 5% Merlot

91 Points  James Suckling

Robust and firmly tannic, this muscular wine offers black cherry and black pepper flavors on a rather tight texture that needs a rich protein dish for pairing.

title: Pio Cesare Barolo 'Ornato' - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The Pio Cesare family’s unique winemaking method stresses minimal intervention to produce wines of particularly supple flavor expression. A ceaseless devotion to the individuality of each of the region’s wines informs Pio Cesare's choices in the cellar: shorter maceration, separate lot fermentation, judicious selection for barrel and large cask aging, and bottling schedules determined by the ideal structure of each wine. This allows Pio Cesare to craft wines of varying weight, ageability and drinkability as determined by the vineyard rather than market fashion.

First launched with the 1985 vintage, Barolo Ornato was Pio Cesare's original single-vineyard bottling. Great structure, power, concentration, with a very long life. Produced in small quantities.

98 Points - James Suckling

title: Bindi Sergardi Cabernet Sauvignon 'Mocenni 91' 2020
bodyHtml: Dark garnet red color. Incredible intense bouquet with notes of coffee, hazelnut, incense, licorice. An impressive tannin structure, suitable for long aging. It has a long, persistent lingering. A good acidic component that is well balanced with the tannins. This wine, in its own unique and unmistakable way expresses the characteristic salinity and minerality of the terrain. An excellent expression of Cabernet Sauvignon in Chianti Classico area of production.

title: Domaine de l'Enclos Chablis 2023
bodyHtml:
Aromas of lemon zest and lemon blossom, crushed oyster shells, light spice. Medium-bodied, fresh and long on the palate.

Drink as an aperitif orwith grilled fish and herbs, roasted chicken or fresh cheeses.

title: 3-4-5 Extra Anejo Tequila (Glass Decanter)
bodyHtml:
From architect, distiller and master blender Enrique Fonseca. Melange of 30% three year, 40% four year and 30% five year Extra Anejo tequilas aged exclusively in French oak. 

Selected for optimum flavor and aromatics, this is the pinnacle of highland super premium tequila. The spectacular mark is presented in limited edition crystal decanters designed, signed and numbered by the iconic Mexico City artist, Alonso Gonzalez Jr.

title: Errazuriz Villa Don Maximiano 2017
bodyHtml:
Villa Don Maximiano is the second wine from Don Maximiano Founder's Reserve, inspired by the villa built by the founder in the Aconcagua Valley in 1870.

A reflection of years of learning, it is a blend made from Bordeaux and Mediterranean varieties, with a contemporary personality and character and excellent ageing potential.

Composition: 28% Syrah, 25% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Malbec, 17% Cabernet Franc, 10% Mourvedre

Further back some nice notes of cocoa and clove appear, culminating with a slight floral hint that reminds of violets.  Aligned with what is perceived on the nose, the palate offers cherries, raspberries and cassis flavors, plus the sweet notes of cocoa and clove.  Of a wide entrance, it is a generous wine, with good tension and juiciness that provide freshness, framed by mature tannins that marvelously surround the mouth, along with a long and very pleasant persistence.

94 Points - James Suckling

Beautiful aromas of currants, coffee and dried flowers.  Full body, round and juicy tannins with berry, chocolate and light vanilla undertones.  Delicious finish.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

title: Alain Brumont Madiran Tour Bouscasse 2019
bodyHtml: Of all the wines that Alain Brumont makes, the wines from Chateau Bouscasse are the most polished. To Alain they reflect the style of wine that was prevalent in Madiran during the 1800’s. Deep purple-red in appearance, the nose of the Tour Bouscasse has forceful aromas of rich blackcurrants, black plums, licorice, dark chocolate, cardamom and vanilla. The palate is bold with moutfilling blackfruit flavors and muscular tannins. On the finish a dusting of cocoa and baking spice rounds things out. We suggest serving this wine with Gascon style duck confit and cassoulet.

title: Pursued by Bear 'Blushing Bear' Rose 2022
vendor: 301962 - My Cellar Wines And Whiskeys Ltd.
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the classic Bandol roses of southern France, the 2022 Blushing Bear is a beautiful salmon pink color, offering fragrant aromas of honeysuckle, wild strawberries, and grapefruit. Refreshing and flavorful with a soft, lush entry and bright notes of Bartlett pear, guava, and crisp apple. Mouthwatering acidity and a lively finish make this the perfect wine to enjoy at twilight on a warm summer evening.

Sourced exclusively from Walla Walla Valley vineyards, hand-picked grapes were gently whole-cluster pressed to capture perfumed aromatics and delicate flavors. Afterwards, the juice was fermented and aged in stainless steel for five months to deliver a clean, fresh style.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This stainless-steel fermented and aged rosé is the perfect accompaniment to a Saint-Tropez tan. Lemon, wild-strawberry and rosemary aromas are fresh and inviting. Tangy tangerine and sweet Fuji apple flavors nimbly pirouette on a crisp texture driven by brisk acidity. This bear is just right.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2022 Blushing Bear Rose, a blend of 73% Mourvedre and 27% Grenache, opens to white and yellow flowers, citrus blossom and wild cherries, with hints of yellow apple and citrus aromas on the nose. Medium-bodied, the palate is fresh, succulent and food-friendly, culminating with a crisp, mineral-laced finish.

title: Argiano Toscana Rosso Non Confunditur 2023
bodyHtml:
Fresh and versatile, Non Confunditur is generous, rich in aromas and with a defined structure.

Complex aromas of blackcurrants, black licorice, violets, sandalwood and graphite. Medium-bodied with a solid core of fruit in the center palate and fine, chewy tannins that run the length of the wine. Crunchy and chewy.

title: Grgich Hills Sauvignon Blanc (Fume Blanc) 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' white wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Napa Valley A.V.A. in coastal Northern California. Produced by Grgich Hills Estate the legendary, family-owned winery co-founded in 1977 by Miljenko "Mike" Grgich, whose victory at the 1976 Judgment of Paris forever elevated Napa Valley white winemaking;this bottling (traditionally labeled as Fumé Blanc) stands as a landmark benchmark of age-worthy, complex California Sauvignon Blanc. Sourced exclusively from estate-grown, certified organic and biodynamic vineyard blocks in cool-climate southern Napa Valley (primarily Carneros and American Canyon) alongside estate blocks in Rutherford, the vines thrive in well-draining clay-loam and volcanic alluvial soils. The coastal maritime climate brings dense morning fog from San Pablo Bay and refreshing afternoon sea breezes, allowing the grapes to achieve optimal phenolic maturity while locking in a razor-sharp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Grgich Hills Estate Fumé Blanc presents a brilliant, pale straw-gold color in the glass with bright chartreuse and silver reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, expressive, and precisely focused portrait of organic Napa Valley terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of lemongrass, kaffir lime leaf, and juicy white peach, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of passionfruit, green apple, orange blossom, flint, and a subtle line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a vibrant core of crunchy orchard fruit, lemon curd, and melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly cuts through the mid-palate texture. The mouthfeel is broad, supple, and linear, carrying into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of lime peel, white pepper, and subtle neutral oak spice.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in Napa Valley was widely heralded as a landmark vintage, defined by a cool, long, and late growing season with generous winter rainfall. These extended ripening conditions allowed Sauvignon Blanc and Semillon grapes in cool southern Napa Valley to build complex skin flavor profiles gradually while preserving pristine natural acidity levels. Grgich Hills harvested clean, healthy fruit at peak structural balance. The resulting 2023 Grgich Hills Estate Fumé Blanc combines energetic fruit purity with noble structural drive, built to drink beautifully today and evolve gracefully in a cellar over the next 6 to 10 years.

title: Manvi Ojas Nobile di Montepulciano Riserva 2021
bodyHtml:
The Manvi Riserva is not just a Nobile aged one extra year but, is a wine that we make only in exceptionally good years - when the grapes are of top quality.

It is yet again a full-bodied 100% Sangiovese wine aged in French oak barrels for 30 months, then refined in the bottle for at least a year and a half. With intense aromas, notes of sour cherries, wild berries, pepper and other spices, this is an incredibly well balanced wine

title: Marrenon Les Grains Rose de Merlot 2024
bodyHtml:
Marrenon Les Grains Rosé de Merlot is a vibrant rosé from the Luberon region in southern France. Crafted exclusively from Merlot grapes, this wine reflects the unique terroir of hillside vineyards with clay-limestone and sandy loam soils.

Colour: Intense pink with cherry reflections, indicating its freshness and vibrancy.

Aroma: Aromatic notes of red berries, complemented by mineral undertones, offering a refreshing and inviting bouquet.

Palate: Voluptuous and balanced, combining freshness with a subtle sweetness. Flavors of small red fruits are prominent, providing a pleasant and harmonious taste.

Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth and balanced texture, making it an easy-drinking rosé.

Finish: Clean and crisp, leaving a lingering impression of its fruity and mineral characteristics.

This rosé is best served chilled, between 8 and 10°C, and pairs excellently with cold cuts or a Provençal salad.

title: Ricasoli CeniPrimo Chianti Classico 2021
bodyHtml:
The Ricasoli CeniPrimo Chianti Classico originates from the Gaiole subregion of the Chianti Classico zone in Tuscany, Italy. The Ricasoli family has been producing wine since 1141, making it the oldest winery in Italy and the fourth oldest family business in the world. This specific Gran Selezione is a "cru" bottling from a 6.35-hectare vineyard situated on an ancient fluvial terrace of the Ombrone River, where the winemaking philosophy focuses on expressing the unique silty and clay-rich terroir.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese presents an intense ruby red colour with light garnet reflections. The ethereal nose offers a complex bouquet of ripe cherry, strawberry, and blackberry, interwoven with light balsamic notes, sweet almond, and medicinal herbs. On the palate, the wine is voluminous and well-structured, featuring dusty, granular tannins typical of the Brolio river terraces. It displays a sleek, racy body with a beam of acidity that drives flavours of orange peel, cedar, and earthy forest roots into a long, lively finish.

title: Argiano Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the world-renowned Brunello di Montalcino D.O.C.G. appellation situated in southern Tuscany. Argiano is one of Montalcino’s most revered and historic estates, with origins dating back to 1580. Operating under a precision-driven viticultural philosophy led by CEO Bernardino Sani and consulting oenologist Alberto Antonini, the estate has undergone an organic conversion and a soil-mapping revolution that highlights distinct micro-terroirs across its 57 hectares of vineyards. Situated on a magnificent plateau at 300 meters above sea level in the southwest quadrant of Montalcino, the vines are rooted in ancient marl, limestone, and clay soils (galestro and alberese). The estate enjoys warm, Mediterranean-influenced daylight tempered by cooling night breezes off the nearby Mount Amiata and Tyrrhenian Sea, yielding Sangiovese of extraordinary structural finesse, aromatic lift, and longevity.

Wine Description

Argiano Brunello di Montalcino presents a brilliant, ruby-garnet color in the glass with light orange-terracotta reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a quintessential expression of southwest Montalcino terroir. The bouquet opens with a captivating display of wild sour cherries, red plums, and crushed dried cranberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of sweet tobacco leaf, leather, dried lavender, crushed chalk, and a signature Tuscan note of wild rosemary and forest floor. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, taut, and precisely focused, showcasing a core of bright red stone fruits, blood orange zest, and licorice. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and linear, framed by silky, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into a long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of iron, spice, and dried Mediterranean herbs.

title: Sheringham Lemon Gin Liqueur
bodyHtml:
This Lemon Gin Liqueur was born when Jason dreamt up a drink that was light, refreshingly delicious, and easy to shake up.

Made with a gin base specifically crafted to pair with the juice of delectable, premium lemons, this liqueur exemplifies simplicity at its finest. The fresh, tart notes of the lemon are gently sweetened to create a spirit that is 100% Sheringham.

Enjoy this liqueur in a simple cocktail or on its own, shaken over ice. It’s sure to evoke the simple pleasures of the summer—no matter the season.

title: Stonestreet Estate Vineyards Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from the United States, specifically the Alexander Valley appellation in Sonoma County, California. Stonestreet Estate Vineyards is a legendary mountain estate climbing the slopes of the Mayacamas Mountain range. Their vineyards range in elevation from 400 to an astounding 2,400 feet. This "Estate" bottling represents a masterful master-blend of their best high-altitude blocks (averaging 25 years of age). Due to the cooler mountain temperatures and volcanic soils, Stonestreet is famous for creating a style that bridges the gap between California's classic richness and a structural, mineral-driven backbone.

Wine Description

The Stonestreet Estate Vineyards Chardonnay is a full-throttle, powerful mountain Chardonnay that leans into opulent textures while maintaining excellent high-altitude composition.

  • Appearance: Luminous, brilliant golden straw hue.

  • Nose: Rich and wonderfully fragrant. It opens with an expressive fusion of lemon meringue, baked pear, and apricot, layered with complex nuances of sweet ginger, chamomile, biscuits, and a distinct flinty minerality.

  • Palate: Full-bodied, textured, and glossy. The palate delivers a generous mouthful of lemon curd, ripe nectarine, and pineapple, beautifully framed by hints of toasted brioche and butterscotch. Despite its flavor heft, a driving, altitude-born acidity cuts through the weight, lending a refreshing, linear precision to a long, spicy finish.

Food Pairing

This wine’s luxurious texture and bright acidity make it an exceptional partner for high-end seafood and rich, savory dishes. It pairs magnificently with butter-poached lobster or seared sea scallops served over a potato purée. It is also a wonderful match for roasted poultry with wild mushroom cream sauce, grilled halloumi cheese, or a classic French ratatouille.

title: Pink Marmalade Gin
bodyHtml:
Emphatically Citrus. Decidedly Smooth

A dry, zesty, unmistakably premium gin – balancing  organic botanicals, with a moment of  colour-changing magic.

Traditional small batch distillation meets modern and exciting flavours with the inclusion of 13 choice botanicals. These range from fiery pink peppercorns to soothing chamomile and even salted grapefruit marmalade.

When mixed with tonic, it undergoes a natural colour change from cool blue to subtle rose pink with thanks to the rather magical ‘Butterfly Pea’ flower.

title: Bailly Lapierre Cremant de Bourgogne Rose
bodyHtml:
This Rose Cremant comes from lightly steeped Pinot Noir and Gamay grapes. The first variety brings a winey character, the second its unmistakable aromas of red berry fruit. A wine for easy enjoyment par excellence, it possesses a delicious softness free of anything sugary. Entirely fresh and with real finesse, its mousse displays an almost frothy, airy lightness.

Mainly Pinot Noir with a touch of Gamay, this fruity wine is bright with acidity and crisp red-currant flavors. Its acidity and zesty character are enhanced by the lively mousse.

title: Torabhaig Allt Gleann Single Malt
bodyHtml:
As the second distillery ever to be built on the Isle of Skye, they combine a respect for the heritage of the island and its whisky making traditions with a fresh spirit of creativity to achieve a distinctive distillery style which they call Well-Tempered Peat.

Nose: Delicate coal smoke and petrichor. Leaf mulch and dried limes. Pomegranate juice and sea air with pear drop and white grape juice beneath.

Palate: Very light bodied. Barbeque- charred apples and pears, smoked orange segments and a little green olive. A touch of celery and chive.

Finish: Medium length. The smoke dissipates, leaving a delicate medicinal aftertaste.

title: Tamellini Soave 2023
bodyHtml: Straw yellow color, intense, fragrant and floral nose, intense and velvety flavor with a note of almonds. As an aperitif, pizza margherita with mozzarella di bufala and basil. Fresh water fish. Delicate pasta and rice dishes.

title: Tomato Wheels Lambrusco
bodyHtml: Tomato Wheels Lambrusco is a sparkling red wine bursting with notes of violet, cold blueberries, lavender and crème fraîche—with cheek gushing acidity and a little rip of tannin.

title: Spinelli Rosato Cerasuolo D'Abruzzo Pallano 2021
bodyHtml: Cherry red color with bright purple hues. Intense fruity aromas, delicate floral notes and hints of berries and black cherry. With a good structure, it is soft, fresh and balanced. Excellent as an aperitif and perfect with pizza, it is definitely versatile in combinations at the table. It goes well with both white meats and fish, but is unsurpassed with fish broth, tripe, fresh cheeses and grilled vegetables.

title: Bodegas Arzuaga 'La Planta' Tempranillo 2023
bodyHtml: Clean, bright, high intensity and cherry red in color with a cardinal rim. High aromatic intensity, with a great variety of fruits, where the aromas of red fruits stand out and the acid strawberry and cherry predominate and along with these the notes of scrubland and resins, mineral touches and roasted aromas typical of its stay in the barrel. Balance and harmony between the taste components, you are faced with a structured, meaty wine that always amazes for its smoothness and freshness typical of La Planta wine.

title: Alois Lageder Cabernet Sauvignon 'Cor Romigberg' 2018
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1855, this family owned winery produces some of the best wines in Italy's northern region. Lageder's wines are about harmony; blending purity of fruit and concentration, with restraint and subtlety.In essence, an attempt to capturing the delicacy, yet vibrancy of these northerly vineyards.

A great red wine, with a complex aroma that is richly expressed with warm nuances: spices, sweet fruit, spices and flowers that lead us in this olfactory experience, which ends with a very pleasant woody scent. In tasting it is surprising for its charismatic but well balanced impact and for the persistence that seems endless.

title: Alois Lageder Cabernet Sauvignon 'Cor Romigberg' 2013
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1855, this family owned winery produces some of the best wines in Italy's northern region. Lageder's wines are about harmony; blending purity of fruit and concentration, with restraint and subtlety.In essence, an attempt to capturing the delicacy, yet vibrancy of these northerly vineyards.

A great red wine, with a complex aroma that is richly expressed with warm nuances: spices, sweet fruit, spices and flowers that lead us in this olfactory experience, which ends with a very pleasant woody scent. In tasting it is surprising for its charismatic but well balanced impact and for the persistence that seems endless.

title: Heitz Cellar Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley 2022
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1961 by Joe and Alice Heitz, Heitz Cellar is a cornerstone of Napa Valley's winemaking heritage, celebrated for pioneering single-vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon. Today, under the stewardship of Gaylon Lawrence Jr. and Master Sommelier Carlton McCoy, the estate continues to honour its classic roots while implementing organic and sustainable farming across its historic sites. The winery remains dedicated to crafting timeless, pure expressions of Napa Valley terroir that balance elegance with remarkable longevity.

Wine Description

This expression exhibits a striking garnet hue with deep magenta undertones in the glass. The bouquet opens with alluring aromas of crushed blackberry, cassis, and fresh violet, accented by subtle hints of dried thyme, cocoa, and sweet spice. On the palate, a refined core of dark plum, wild black fruit, and savoury herbs is framed by lively acidity and supple, structured tannins. Crafted as a 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, this medium-to-full-bodied wine achieves a harmonious balance between vibrant freshness and layered complexity, concluding with a long, elegant finish.

title: Aztecan Kappuccino Cream Liqueur
bodyHtml: A Kapuccino-flavored coffee with a creamy consistency for its milk, sweet combination with a soft touch of alcohol, antique and delicious. A coffee flavor that you will remember for that exquisite sensation in the palate.

title: Casa Raia Bevilo Toscana Rosso 2018
bodyHtml:
Just 2 km from Montalcino, at an altitude of 375 meters, one will find the beautifully situated Casa Raia. Most of the domain of only 4.5 hectares was planted in the late 1970s by Ludmilla Temertey, who handed over the reins to her daughter Kalyna and her husband Pierre Jean Monnoyer in 2006. Pierre Jean's motto is il vino viene fatto in vigna which roughly translated means that the vine determines how the wine becomes. The aim of Casa Raia is therefore to preserve the biodiversity and natural balance of the vineyards. The vineyards are dotted with a variety of organic plants and flowers that provide natural nutrients to the soil. The entire estate is therefore certified organic.

The Bevilo is full-bodied and powerful with a beautiful elegance that is typical for the wines of Pierre Jean. On the nose, notes of dark fruits such as blueberries and raspberries with ripe notes of barrel maturation. Ripe forest fruit on the palate, powerful but ripe tannins and a very pleasant freshness in the finish.

title: Veuve Clicquot Extra Brut Extra Old
bodyHtml: Veuve Clicquot Extra Brut Extra Old is a champagne that is made from a blend of reserve wines, some of which are up to 20 years old, along with a base of younger wines. The exact blend of grape varieties is not specified by the producer. The wine is aged in the cellar for at least 3 years, which is longer than the minimum requirement for champagne. The wine is then disgorged and a low dosage of sugar is added, resulting in an "extra brut" style that is very dry and crisp. The wine has notes of dried fruit, toasted brioche, and nuts, and is known for its complexity and elegance.

title: Shafer Chardonnay Red Shoulder 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, this Chardonnay hails from the prestigious Red Shoulder Ranch estate vineyard located in the Carneros District of Napa Valley. Shafer Vineyards has been a cornerstone of Napa Valley for over 40 years, established in 1972 by John Shafer who transitioned from a publishing career to viticulture. The winery is celebrated for its commitment to sustainability, having been the first in the U.S. to go 100% solar, and is currently led by the long standing team of Doug Shafer and winemaker Elias Fernandez.

Wine Description

This luminous Chardonnay presents a brilliant straw yellow colour and opens with elegant aromas of citrus blossom, honeysuckle, and exotic spice. The palate is midweight and textural, offering a core of ripe fruit including nectarine, mandarin orange, and honeydew melon, balanced by a flinty minerality. With a focus on energy and finesse, the wine features a vibrant 'laser beam' of acidity and a lithe structure that leads to a long, pure, and refined finish.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 95 points.

  • Vinous - 94 points.

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points.

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 93 points.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and flinty minerality of this Chardonnay make it an ideal companion for seared scallops, lobster, or Dungeness crab cakes. Its textural richness also allows it to pair beautifully with herb roasted chicken, creamy pasta dishes like fettuccine Alfredo, or soft cheeses such as Brie and triple cream.

title: Alberta Distillers Ltd. Rare Batch No.1
bodyHtml:
From world-renowned Alberta Distillers Limited comes this Rare BatchTM/MC Issue No. 1 – the first in a special series offering the best of the best. First barreled at the turn of the millennium in 2000 and aged for 23 long years, this rare whisky’s resting time has finally come to an end. Out here, where the prairie gives way to the Rocky Mountains, lies the perfect place for distilling spirits.

A pristine, epic land. Of Space and Freedom. Of wide blue skies, clean air, and vivid light. Of Pure, mineral rich glacial water, and robust prairie grains.

title: Tenuta San Jacopo 'Orma del Diavolo' Rosso 2017
bodyHtml: Powerful and expressive it aromatic complexity gives intense ripe black cherry, red flowers and sweet oriental spices. Balsamic and liquorice taste in the mouth, intense and fruity with elegant soft tannins. Organic and vegan certified. Sangiovese 50%, Merlot 30%, Cabernet Sauvignon 20%.

title: Paltrinieri Sant'agata Lambrusco Sorbara 2024
bodyHtml:
91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of wild red berry, violet and rose waft out of the glass on this fragrant, fantastic sparkler. The vibrant, elegant palate doles out juicy strawberry, red cherry, orange zest and star anise before a dry finish. A lightly foaming mousse and bright acidity provide the food friendly structure. One bottle won't be enough.

title: Escala Humana Livvera Malvasia 2024
bodyHtml:
This 100% Malvasia comes from a single vineyard in the El Zampal region of the Uco Valley. The nose shows orange peel, lemon balm, and sage with some bright aromas reminiscent of Fruit Pebbles.

The wine has a slight orange color showing the 90 days of skin contact and has a rich texture with good acidity and hints of kumquat.

title: Napier Klein Louis Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml: Selected Sauvignon Blanc grapes are sourced from the cool climate region of Darling, which is influenced by the cooling Benguela Current. This wine is fresh and zesty with aromas of green pepper, freshly mowed grass and a touch of grapefruit while the palate shows tight fruit, lively acidity and a dry finish.

title: Villa Lobos Distillation Strength Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: Villa Lobos is a perfect example of handcrafted Tequila made with passion and care in the traditional way. Villa Lobos Blanco 55% is soft and bursting with flavour of the famous Villa Lobos 'white pepper nose' which is amplified when added to ice or any other mixer.

title: Chateau De Sancerre Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
The wine presents a beautiful, intense purple color. On the nose, aromas of red fruits and Morello cherries dominate, but a hint of spice brings complexity. The mouth is ample, rich, not void of freshness. The tannins are supple. The finish has a slight woody character that prolongs the tasting.

It is the only Sancerre wine that can be marketed under the exclusive name of “Château de Sancerre”.

title: Pieropan Soave Classico 2024
bodyHtml:
Pieropan Soave Classico originates from Italy, within the Veneto region and the historic Soave Classico DOC zone east of Verona. Founded in 1880 by Leonildo Pieropan, the family estate—now directed by his sons, Andrea and Dario—is universally recognized as the pioneer that elevated Soave from a generic commercial white into a world-class wine. Sourced entirely from the hillside vineyards of the historical Classico zone, characterized by ancient volcanic and clay-limestone soils, Pieropan’s winemaking philosophy relies on low yields, organic viticulture, hand-harvesting, and fermentation entirely in neutral vessels. This approach preserves the pure, vibrant floral and mineral identity of the Garganega grape without the oak influence.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a pale, brilliant straw-yellow appearance in the glass with shimmering greenish reflections. It possesses a light-to-medium-bodied, crisp, and beautifully proportioned structure defined by a silky, fluid, and mouth-refreshing texture. The sensory profile is highly delicate, floral, and precise, opening with an inviting nose of white orchard blossoms, elderflower, green apples, and yellow pear, interwoven with subtle undertones of lemon zest, fresh almond, and crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it delivers a focused, energetic core of orchard and citrus fruits supported by a vibrant thread of natural acidity and a distinct saline-mineral streak. The finish is clean, dry, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of bitter almond, citrus zest, and wet stones.

  • Varietal Composition: 85% Garganega and 15% Trebbiano di Soave.

  • Stylistic Notes: The organic grapes are hand-picked in multiple passes to ensure optimal ripeness. Following gentle whole-cluster pressing and cold settling, the wine undergoes temperature-controlled fermentation in glass-lined cement tanks. To preserve freshness, natural acidity, and pure fruit character, the wine undergoes no malolactic fermentation and ages on its fine lees in cement tanks for several months prior to bottling.

  • ABV: Typically 12.0% to 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: Fully Certified Organic (certified by ICEA), reflecting decades of sustainable farming, biodiversity preservation, and zero chemical synthetic inputs across their hillside estate plots.

Food Pairing

The vibrant natural acidity, subtle almond undertones, and clean mineral finish of Pieropan Soave Classico make it an exceptional match for light Italian and international cuisine.

  • Seafood & Shellfish: Pairs magnificently with grilled sea bass, pan-seared trout, oysters on the half shell, calamari, or clam linguine (linguine alle vongole).

  • Poultry & Light Meats: Excellent alongside herb-roasted chicken breast, lemon-piccata veal cutlets, or turkey scaloppine.

  • Pasta & Risotto: Ideal with spring vegetable risottos, pea and mint pasta, asparagus quiche, and pesto Genovese dishes.

  • Cheeses: Matches gracefully with fresh goat cheese (Chèvre), young Asiago, fresh Mozzarella di Bufala, or mild Ricotta.

title: Park Distillery Maple Rye
bodyHtml: From Park Distillery in Banff. This rye is made with 100% locally-farmed Alberta rye and blended with hand-tapped Quebec maple syrup, giving it the perfect balance of sweetness and flavour. A great addition to any coffee!

title: Dillon's Small Batch Sweet Vermouth
bodyHtml: A rich, delicious, and sweet vermouth, it’s ingredients of bitter orange peel, sasparilla, vanilla, and cinchona pair with hints of strawberry to make a balanced vermouth.

title: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge - 200 ml
bodyHtml: Grand Marnier's signature expression, created in 1880 by Louis Alexandre-Marnier Lapostolle by combing the character of cognac with the intensity of bitter orange.  It has brilliant amber and topaz tones and aromas with vanilla cognac nuances and hints of candied zest.  Bitter orange flavours are balanced by cognac notes of hazelnuts and toffee, followed by a long, harmonious finish.

title: Castello di Querceto Chianti Classico 'La Corte' Gran Selezione 2018
bodyHtml:
95 Points -  James Suckling

Aromas of sweet berries, cedar and some bark follow through to a medium body with firm, velvety tannins and a juicy finish. Layered and very pretty. So delicious now, but it will also age wonderfully. Drink or hold.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

This vintage saw freezing winter temperatures and a hot summer. The 2018 Chianti Classico Gran Selezione La Corte draws fruit from a pretty south and southwest-facing vineyard with well-draining, sandy soils. This wine is beautifully intact and fresh. It reveals a primary bouquet of wild cherry, plum and forest fruit. The finish is linear, tight and polished, especially regarding the tannins. It ages 12 months in both barrique and tonneaux made from Tronçais and Allier oak and sees another six months in bottle before its commercial release.

title: Rejon Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Elaborated with 100% Tequilana Weber blue agave. Left to blend for 2 to 11 months in white oak barrels made out of both, American and French oak. The combination of white oaks gives this Tequila a golden tone and a distinctive resinous touch adding to its unique taste.

title: Tromba Cafeto Tequila Coffee Liqueur
bodyHtml:
The highest quality coffee liqueur made with the finest ingredients--the ultimate combination of 100% agave tequila tromba and artisanal Mexican grown coffee with a touch of agave nectar and natural botanicals. 

Developed with a proprietary cold brew tequila extraction process that uses tequila instead of water to extract the coffee's natural flavor--no concentrates or artificial flavors added.

title: Gemma di Luna Red Gem
bodyHtml:
Crafted from a blend of carefully selected Italian red grape varietals, Red Gem opens with a bouquet of rich, ripe red fruit.

On the palate, this meticulous blend imparts a nuanced range of flavors from tart cherry to fig jam, with soft tannins and a smooth, velvety mouthfeel. It finishes off with beautiful notes of black pepper and bittersweet chocolate.

title: Chateau La Fleur de Bouard 2016
bodyHtml:
Chateau la Fleur de Bouard is a Bordeaux Right Bank winery in the Lalande-de-Pomerol appellation. It produces several Merlot-dominant cuvees and is known for its unique state-of-the-art winery.

93 Points - James Suckling

Fragrant and spicy, ripe and juicy with a ton of crushed berry character. The generous, supple tannins nicely support the full body and long, silky finish.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

It has a medium to deep garnet-purple color and is a little youthfully reticent to begin, giving way to provocative crushed rocks, tilled soil, mossy bark and cigar box scents over a core of blueberry compote, black raspberries and blackberry pie with a waft of dried herbs. Medium to full-bodied, the earth-laced palate is positively charged with energy, framed by very fine-grained tannins and wonderful freshness, finishing on a lingering mineral note.

92 Points - Vinous

The 2016 La Fleur de Boüard is gorgeous. Sweet, floral notes lift the red berry fruit in this gracious, mid-weight wine. Raspberry, wild flowers, mocha, spice and mint all run through this lithe, silky wine. The 2016 possesses notable silkiness, nuance and finesse. This is a terrific showing.

91 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

90 Points - Decanter

title: Louis Roederer Starck Brut Nature 2015
bodyHtml:
Yellow hue with shimmering highlights and an even flow of lively bubbles. The bouquet is pure, elegant, vertical, rich and concentrated. Nuances of ripe fruit combined with exceptional finesse: fine, delicate citrus peel (lemon, orange) and vanilla (Madagascar bourbon vanilla) along with warmer notes of baked apple and Tarte Tatin that gradually give way to aromas of nougat. 

The palate offers a marked and singular contrast: it is very expressionist thanks to the broad, juicy, almost sensual texture of the Cumières clay soils in a sunny year, yet distinctly minimalist due to a fresh, pure, mineral and mouthwatering backbone associated with its zero dosage. Ripe citrus fruit combines with warm stone notes further accentuating the mouthwatering, umami sensation. The finish is light, energetic and ethereal.

95 Points - James Suckling

This is very minerally and stony, with chalk and salt and oyster-shell undertones. It’s full-bodied and layered, yet remains intense with a lively finish. Done dry. Umami. No dosage. From biodynamically grown grapes with Demeter certification. Field blend from a single plot in Cumieres.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2015 Champagne Starck Brut Nature is forward with vinous and spicy aromas of saline and red currant, orange blossom, and smoke. It is expansive on the palate while maintaining a core of fresh acidity, with peach, dried flowers, and wet stone. This complex and unique expression is full of energy and has great gastronomic appeal. 

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The most compelling rendition of this bottling that Roederer has produced to date, the 2015 Brut Nature exhibits inviting aromas of golden orchard fruit, clear honey, dried white flowers and wet stones. Medium to full-bodied, layered and vinous, with a fleshy, concentrated core of fruit, chalky structure and a long, precise finish, it's a Pinot Noir-dominant blend from Cumieres that's slightly lower in pressure, making for a more delicate mousse.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

With a label designed by designer Philippe Starck, this Champagne has benefitted from its aging. That has softened the wine’s natural dryness and given it maturity and a light biscuit flavor. It is a fully balanced wine that is ready to drink.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

93 Points - Wine & Spirits

93 Points - Vinous

title: El Ateo Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
The agaves are sourced from the brand's estates in Guanajuato and Los Altos. The brand owner's family has been farming agave for over 80 years.

Brick oven cooked, Tahona crushed, wild yeast fermentation in stainless steel, stainless steel pot stills with copper coil and aerated. Cherry on top is that it's confirmed additive free by TMM.

title: El Ateo Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
El Ateo Blanco Tequila ("El Ateo" translating to "The Atheist") is an ultra-premium, additive-free artisanal spirit produced in Arandas within the High-Altitude Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. Distilled at the purpose-built Plantaciones Tequilana distillery (NOM 1635); which crafts El Ateo as its single dedicated brand, the project was founded by Luis Angel Villalobos and Luis Villalobos. The brand stands out by combining estate-grown Blue Weber agaves from Guanajuato with traditional Highlands distillation techniques, emphasizing science, precision, and terroir.

Spirit Description

El Ateo Blanco is crafted from 100% estate-grown agaves cultivated on fields first established by Don Luis Villalobos in 1953 in Romita, Guanajuato. Hand-selected at peak maturity with high sugar content (around 39 Brix), the agave piñas are slow-cooked in traditional stone brick ovens and crushed using a traditional volcanic stone tahona wheel. Fermented with wild yeast in open-air stainless steel tanks, the liquid is double-distilled in stainless steel pot stills fitted with copper coils, proofed with deep well water, and aerated before bottling.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, luminous, and bright with heavy, slow-falling tears on the glass.

  • Aroma: Complex and inviting, opening with bright sweet cooked agave, warm cinnamon spice, lemongrass, and grapefruit peel, layered alongside wet stone minerality, fresh bell pepper, and subtle floral blossoms.

  • Palate: Rich, silky, and agave-forward on the entry. Upfront flavors of sweet roasted agave, cinnamon, and ripe citrus yield to a savory mid-palate featuring sea salt minerality, fresh herbs, lime zest, and a hint of green pepper.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a round, buttery, and velvety texture.

  • Finish: Crisp, warming, and persistent, closing with trailing notes of white pepper, sweet vanilla, bright citrus peel, and crushed limestone minerality.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof)

title: Chateau La Lagune 2019
bodyHtml:
The 2019 Château La Lagune is a distinguished red wine from the Haut-Médoc appellation in Bordeaux, France. As a Troisième Grand Cru Classé estate, Château La Lagune has a storied history of producing exceptional wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region. This vintage is a blend of 70% Cabernet Sauvignon, 26% Merlot, and 4% Petit Verdot, showcasing the classic Bordeaux varietals.

Colour: Deep ruby-red, almost opaque, indicating its concentration and depth.

Aroma: Rich aromas of plum and graphite, with subtle hints of cedar and vanilla, offering a complex and inviting bouquet.

Palate: The palate reveals ripe plum fruit with vanilla nuances and a milky texture. It is followed by smooth, fine, velvety tannins that add grip towards the finish. The acidity is soft, and the alcohol provides a warming sensation. The concentrated fruit leads to a long, rich finish with touches of bitter liquorice.

Body: Full-bodied with a well-structured and balanced profile, combining power with elegance.

Finish: Long and rich, with lingering notes of concentrated fruit and subtle bitterness, indicative of its aging potential.

Accolades: The 2019 vintage has received critical acclaim, including a 95-point rating from Neal Martin of Vinous, who described it as "one of the best La Lagune releases in recent years." Additionally, Wine-Searcher notes an average critic score of 92/100 based on 14 reviews.

This vintage exemplifies Château La Lagune's commitment to quality and tradition, offering a wine that is both approachable in its youth and capable of aging gracefully over the next few decades.

title: Spy Valley Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml: Fresh and vibrant on the palate with layers of plum and spice, creating a finely balanced and long finish.

title: Tolaini Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'Montebello Sette' 2019
bodyHtml:
Tolaini's 2019 Chianti Classico Gran Selezione, known as "Vigna Montebello Sette," is a distinguished expression of 100% Sangiovese from the Chianti Classico region in Tuscany, Italy. This wine is crafted from the Montebello number 7 vineyard, where silty soils with a significant presence of stones contribute to its remarkable complexity and structure.

Tasting Notes
In the glass, the wine exhibits a deep ruby hue. The nose is vibrant and layered, with aromas of ripe cherry, tobacco, leather, and subtle hints of licorice and spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied with elegant tannins, harmonized with a core of fruit and balanced by fresh acidity. The finish is long and satisfying, reflecting the true character of Sangiovese and the unique terroir of the Montebello vineyard.

Winemaking Process
The grapes are harvested manually and meticulously sorted twice to ensure optimal quality. Whole berries are placed into stainless steel fermentation tanks and a smaller portion into French oak fermenters. Fermentation lasts 20 days under temperature control, with regular remontage and occasional delestage. After fermentation, a long maceration follows, and malolactic fermentation takes place in large 25-hectolitre oak fermenting casks.

Aging Potential
This vintage is particularly concentrated and structured, with fine tannins and vibrant acidity. While approachable now, it promises further evolution and complexity over the next decade.

Food Pairing
This Chianti Classico Gran Selezione pairs beautifully with roasted meats, aged cheeses, and hearty pasta dishes. Its depth and elegance make it an exceptional companion for elevated dining experiences.

Accolades
The 2019 vintage has received critical acclaim, including:

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate: 94 points
  • James Suckling: 93 points
  • Jeb Dunnuck: 92 points
  • Wine Spectator: 92 points
  • Decanter: 92 points
  • Wine Enthusiast: 91 points

title: Lagavulin 11 Year Old Single Malt 'Offerman Edition'
bodyHtml:
Lagavulin Offerman Edition: Caribbean Rum Cask Finish is a limited-edition offering created by Lagavulin Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky in partnership with long-time partner Nick Offerman.

The 11 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky was finished for a little over 8 months in casks that previously held Caribbean Rum, infusing a symphony of sweet smoke that marries the notes of the tropics with the peaty elixir of Islay.

title: Don Fulano Blanco Fuerte Tequila
bodyHtml:
Don Fulano Blanco Fuerte is a premium overproof tequila produced in Mexico, specifically from the Highland region of Los Altos in Jalisco. It is crafted by the Fonseca family, whose legacy in agave cultivation spans five generations and 140 years. Distilled at the historic 'La Tequileña' facility (NOM 1146) in the town of Tequila, the spirit is made from hand selected mature agave from the family's orchards. Under the leadership of Master Distiller Enrique Fonseca and Sergio Mendoza, the brand emphasizes a low intervention process that is entirely free of additives.

2. Spirit Description

This 'Fuerte' (meaning strong) expression is an unaged blanco tequila bottled at 100 proof, designed to offer a concentrated and punchy representation of agave.

  • Colour: The spirit is unaged and presents a bright, crystal clear appearance.

  • Aroma: The nose is profoundly aromatic, featuring cooked agave, fresh herbaceous tones, and white pepper, alongside floral glimmers of jasmine and orange blossom.

  • Palate: It offers a full bodied entry with bold roasted agave and a pronounced minerality, followed by mid palate notes of tropical fruits like papaya and lime with hints of wet cement.

  • Body: The tequila is characterized by its generous complexity and ethereal texture, reflecting the high mineral content of the volcanic well water used in production.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, dry, and vibrant exit that carries lingering earthy tones and a trace of molasses.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at a high strength of 50%.

title: Giant Steps Pinot Noir Sexton 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Yarra Valley region of Australia, this single vineyard wine hails from the revered Sexton Vineyard in the Gruyere subregion. Founded in 1997 by Phil Sexton, Giant Steps was established with the goal of creating authentic, site-specific Chardonnay and Pinot Noir that reflect the unique cool climate of the valley. Under the guidance of Head Winemaker Melanie Chester, the winery focuses on minimal intervention and gravity flow techniques to ensure the distinct personality of each vineyard is transparently expressed in the glass.

Wine Description

This concentrated Pinot Noir presents a deep ruby hue and opens with heady aromas of kirsch, damson plums, and licorice root, accented by complex notes of blueberry bush, graphite, and wild herbs. The palate is medium-bodied and fleshy, featuring a core of black cherry, blackberry, and pomegranate supported by ripe, persistent tannins and a bright, natural acidity. With its firmly integrated structure and savoury finish of dried thyme and sandalwood, this wine demonstrates exceptional balance and power.

Food Pairing

The wine's savoury depth and firm tannins make it an excellent partner for turmeric and garlic roasted chicken with couscous, or a rich mushroom risotto featuring roasted enoki. It also pairs beautifully with barbecue quail seasoned with five spice and fried spring onions.

Accolades:

James Suckling (96 Points):

Complex aromas of blueberry bush, wild blackberries, graphite and pomegranates.
