The palate is medium-bodied with seamlessly integrated tannins and bright acidity, giving notes of Damson plums, dark cherries, coffee beans and wild raspberries. Vibrant and refined, with a firmly integrated structure.

Jasper Morris MW (95 Points):

Earthy, bunchy aromas lead with snapped twig, cassia, liquorice root, kirsch, plum and nutmeg, backed by dried herbs, pan juices and subtle clove. Damp earth rises with air. The palate is fulsome and sappy with sapidity and power – dark cherry, plum skin, stalkiness, tilled earth and dried cranberry, lifted by forest floor notes. Mocha hints lurk but don’t fully emerge. Chalky, firm tannins cut the texture and funnel complexity into a savoury finish. Whole bunch integration adds savoury dimension around the fruit. Excellent texture and intensity.

Wine Spectator (95 Points):

A stunning red, with a fleshy core of black cherry, plum and blackberry flavors accented with salted black licorice, cardamom, Earl Grey and dried thyme. Accents of fresh tomato leaf and sandalwood linger on the finish alongside firming tannins.

title: Domaine Drouhin Pinot Noir 'Dundee Hills' 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

From the United States, in Oregon’s renowned Willamette Valley, this Pinot Noir hails from the Dundee Hills AVA, a subregion celebrated for producing elegant and expressive wines. Domaine Drouhin was established in 1987 by the Drouhin family of Burgundy, France, who brought generations of winemaking expertise to Oregon. The estate is known for its dedication to crafting wines of finesse, balance, and complexity, guided by sustainable viticulture practices.

Wine Description

The vintage displays a luminous ruby hue. Aromas unfold with layers of rhubarb, dried violets, black tea, and plum, complemented by hints of raspberry, cranberry, and lightly roasted coffee beans. On the palate, it offers sour and black cherries, stone fruits, white pepper, earthy undertones, and subtle spice notes reminiscent of bergamot and cola. Medium-bodied with velvety tannins and bright acidity, the wine achieves a harmonious balance, leading to a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing

Ideal alongside roast duck with cherry glaze, herb-crusted lamb, or wild mushroom risotto. Its freshness and nuanced flavours also complement cedar-planked salmon or creamy brie. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: El Ateo Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
El Ateo is a new brand from a new distillery, NOM 1635.

The agaves are sourced from the brand's estates in Guanajuato and Los Altos. The brand owner's family has been farming agave for over 80 years.

Brick oven cooked, Tahona crushed, wild yeast fermentation in stainless steel, stainless steel pot stills with copper coil and aerated. Cherry on top is that it's confirmed additive free by TMM.

title: Elvis Midnight Snack Whiskey
bodyHtml:
This take on the famous late-night concoction delivers the hunka hunka burning love for peanut butter, banana and bacon flavor you’ve been dreaming of.

Midnight Snack celebrates the flavors from Elvis Presley’s midnight snack sandwich of peanut butter, bananas and bacon. The labels feature notable references to Presley, including his signature and the letters “TCB” printed on the neck of the bottle, referring to “Taking Care of Business,” a phrase which was the mantra for Elvis and his Memphis Mafia.

title: Chateau Montus Pacherenc du Vic Bilh 2015
bodyHtml:
Pacherenc du Vic-Bilh Sec is one of the oldest appellations: a magical, mythical name, imperial and secret, synonymous with respect. 

Focusing relentlessly on experimenting with barrels for 20 years, Chateau Montus Sec has received the full benefit of these efforts: this wine's special character is due to its vinification and ageing in 600 litre barrels, called demi-muids, made from wooden staves that are more than four centimetres thick. The impact of the wood on the wine is reduced, with a more mellow woodiness, beneficial to the preservation of the fruity aromas, while maintaining a perfect balance, for a very expressive, high quality wine.

title: Chateau Montus Blanc Sec Pacherenc du Vic Bilh 2014
bodyHtml:
Pacherenc du Vic-Bilh Sec is one of the oldest appellations: a magical, mythical name, imperial and secret, synonymous with respect. "The tamer of grapes varieties and creator of great wines, Alain Brumont, has made a great dry white wine at Montus." (Pierre Casamayor).

Focusing relentlessly on experimenting with barrels for 20 years, Chateau Montus Sec has received the full benefit of these efforts: this wine's special character is due to its vinification and ageing in 600 litre barrels, called demi-muids, made from wooden staves that are more than four centimetres thick. The impact of the wood on the wine is reduced, with a more mellow woodiness, beneficial to the preservation of the fruity aromas, while maintaining a perfect balance, for a very expressive, high quality wine

title: St. Innocent Shea Vineyard Pinot Noir 2019
bodyHtml:
The philosophy behind the winemaking at St Innocent is that the function of wine is to complement and extend the pleasure of a meal. The characteristics of a wine should enhance different food and flavor combinations - this interaction amplifies the pleasure of a meal. To this end, St. Innocent wines tend toward higher acid levels, and more diverse and balanced flavors.

Shea has intense dark aromas of dried flowers, white pepper, dried blackberries and earth. Supple while pervasive flavors of raspberry, black cherry and dried strawberry are intertwined with cola, dark chocolate and ginger root. The ample tannins blend effortlessly with the sweet acidity, fading gently into the finish.

Pair with hearty dishes with some sweetness and richness like lamb chops, pork tenderloin, duck breast and lentil dishes.

94 Points - James Suckling

A fresh, vivid red with sliced strawberry, orange peel, crushed stone and some flowers. It’s medium-bodied with fine tannins and a long, vivid finish. All in finesse and energy.

title: St. Innocent Temperance Hill Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
The philosophy behind the winemaking at St Innocent is that the function of wine is to complement and extend the pleasure of a meal. The characteristics of a wine should enhance different food and flavor combinations - this interaction amplifies the pleasure of a meal. To this end, St. Innocent wines tend toward higher acid levels, and more diverse and balanced flavors.

Temperance Hill has a beautifully perfumed nose of baking spices with ginger, cinnamon and allspice, dark dried roses and blackberries. Very fresh redberries and cherries with vibrant acidity and hints of allspice fill your mouth. The freshness continues into the finish with spices and dried fruits that linger softly on the palate.

title: St. Innocent Freedom Hill Chardonnay 2020
bodyHtml:
This structured and expressive white wine originates from the United States, within the Willamette Valley AVA of Oregon. Sourced entirely from the acclaimed Freedom Hill Vineyard, the site is nestled in the foothills of the Coast Range, roughly 10 miles southwest of Salem. The vineyard features a southwest exposure at an elevation of 520 to 580 feet, sitting on ancient, well-drained sedimentary clay loam soils. Founded by pioneering winemaker Mark Vlossak, St. Innocent operates under a philosophy of minimal cellar intervention and site transparency. The specific microclimate at Freedom Hill benefits from warm air rising from the valley floor during the day to ripen the fruit, balanced by cool nightly ocean breezes that lock in essential natural acidity.

Wine Description

The 2020 St. Innocent Freedom Hill Vineyard Chardonnay presents a lovely, pale yellow-gold appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is wonderfully dense and fragrant, opening with an expressive bouquet of Granny Smith apple, Bosc pear, and Elberta peach skin, beautifully layered with notes of lily of the valley, baked apple, chamomile tea, and a touch of warm cinnamon. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, rich, and striking, showcasing a texturally complex core of ripe orchard fruit extracts and subtle sugar cookies that mimic a decadent fruit beurre blanc. It is characterized by its outstanding, nervous tension and a vibrant backbone of juicy acidity that balances the deep concentration, driving into an extended, lingering finish wrapped in ground spices, flinty minerality, and a light touch of vanilla cream.

This 100% Chardonnay is crafted from premium Dijon clones 76 and 548 planted in 2006 and 2007. The grapes were whole-cluster pressed and barrel-fermented using indigenous yeasts. The wine naturally completed malolactic fermentation and was matured sur lies (on its fine lees) for 11 months entirely in neutral, used French oak barrels to achieve a supple, creamy texture without masking the fruit beneath heavy wood flavor. The wine reached a well-balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5%, with a total production of 816 cases. Reflecting the domain's core values, the vineyard blocks are managed under strict sustainable agricultural practices.

title: Caol Ila Sansibar Single Malt 2009 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Mouthcoating whisky with spirit and cask both showing strongly above a smoky Islay backdrop. A powerful winter warmer.

Sansibar Whisky is a German independent bottler founded by Jens Drewitz, who carefully selects and bottles some of the finest casks of whisky and rum. He initially did so with the purpose of supplying his restaurant Sansibar, but Sansibar Whisky is now held in high esteem all over the world.

title: Draaiboek Kinkel Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Draaiboek means ‘script’ in Afrikaans. A script is a story come to life, given meaning through the character’s performance and words spoken. Every wine comes bottled with its very own script. An unedited narrative drafted by years spent in the vineyard, sculpted by changing seasons and nurtured by caring hands. 

The result is a tale that captivates each drinker on a unique adventure into one’s inner imagination. A fantastical land where life is simple and possibilities are endless. It also stirs memories of past travels, moments shared with friends, and good food. It was with exactly this honest intention to express one’s creativity that a group of friends came together to craft Draaiboek Wines. 

This wine, slow to unveil its allure, has a reserved nose hinting at apple blossom and stone fruit. The vibrant entry introduces citrus, leading to a tangy, chalky palate. The subtle oak adds structure, not flavour. It's elegant, finishing with lime zest.

title: Eterno Verano Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
An ode to the sun, sea and joy of living.

Made for adventurous souls, Tequila Eterno Verano embodies the spirit of the classic surf film “The Endless Summer.” Handmade from 100% Blue Weber agaves grown in both the highlands and lowlands of Jalisco, Mexico.

We patiently wait 5-8 years before harvesting our agaves, which is like waiting for the perfect wave. We bottle our tequilas using environmentally friendly recycled glass and finish with a natural cork closure, so you can enjoy consciously.

Aged for a minimum of 6 months in whiskey barrels, this reposado tequila has an aroma of fresh lime and honey, a taste of white pepper and butterscotch, then finishes with smooth agave sweetness and pepper spice.

title: Lagrimas de Dolores Mezcal Joven Maguey Cenizo
bodyHtml:
The state of Durango, in north-central Mexico, is home to an amazing diversity of indigenous agave species and varietals, second only to Oaxaca in the south. Germán Gutierrez and his family-owned mezcal brand, Lágrimas de Dolores, is making it their mission to produce and showcase this biodiversity and flavour in both their own mezcals and by offering support to other mezcal producers who are growing agave in the more remote and inaccessible parts of Durango.

The Gutierrez family produces their mezcals at their own historic Hacienda Dolores in Durango City, dating from the 17th Century, and their agaves come from the hills of their own Rancho La Campana de Santa Elena in Mezquital. They roast using traditional underground volcanic rock fire-pit roasting methods, ferment in pine vats using only wild yeast from the air, and distill using copper and stainless steel pot stills. Their bottle and leatherwork pays homage to the long equestrian culture and traditions of Durango.

They have planted over 200,000 Maguey Cenizos on their ranch, and continue to plant up to 50,000 more agaves every year, including the other wild species that are used in their family’s and other producers’ mezcals as part of an ongoing commitment to sustainable operations and preservation of the more than 30 species of agave that exist in the State of Durango.

title: Nautilus Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
Nautilus Pinot Noir hails from the Marlborough region of New Zealand, specifically utilizing fruit from the Southern Valleys. Founded in 1985, Nautilus Estate is a family owned winery under the stewardship of Robert Hill Smith, a fifth generation winemaker. The winery is dedicated to a philosophy of producing expressive, structured wines that marry perfectly with food, often utilizing state of the art facilities like the Southern Hemisphere's first dedicated Pinot Noir winery.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir presents a vibrant and elegant sensory profile, opening with a wave of dark cherry and blackberry aromas underpinned by smoky, spicy, and floral highlights. On the palate, it is complex and layered, delivering flavors of red berry and sour cherry balanced by a finishing savouriness and fine, polished tannins. The wine is medium bodied with a seamless, textural mouthfeel and a long, satisfying finish of elegance and finesse.

title: Indri Single Malt Indian Whisky
bodyHtml:
The magic of the marriage of three different wood casks come to its splendour when our malts are matured in ex-bourbon, ex-french wine and ex-sherry casks. It embellishes our malt with the finest shade of Amber, whiff of caramelized pineapple, vanilla, hints of black tea, raisins & citrus and subtle nuttiness. The smoothness and flavour linger long after the glass has been put aside.

Trini, The three wood was conceptualized based on the individual contribution of each wood without overshadowing the original whisky profile which is light fruity with sweet vanilla and spice, a subtle nuttiness to chew on with a medium to reasonably long finish.

Nose: Gentle and mellow on the nose. Hints of black tea, caramelised pineapple with a whiff of oak comes forward, followed by vanilla and honey from the bourbon oak and traces of spiced tannins from the European oak, finally topped up with vinous raisin and sweet sherry notes.

Palate: Elegant richness, smooth and warm on the sides of the mouth. Gentle spice and woody characteristics.

Finish: A subtle and balanced finish, each flavour compliments the other without dominating each other. A smooth and long after taste with sweet fruity flavours coming up from the warmth of the throat, lingering long after

title: Louis Roederer Cristal Brut 2016
bodyHtml:
Louis Roederer Cristal Brut is a vintage Champagne from France. It is the flagship cuvée of Maison Louis Roederer, a family-owned and independent Champagne house founded in 1776 in Reims. Cristal was first created in 1876 for Tsar Alexander II of Russia. The wine is produced from 45 exceptional vineyard plots, all of which are Grand Cru sites in the Montagne de Reims, the Vallée de la Marne, and the Côte des Blancs. For the 2015 vintage, all 45 plots over twenty years old were used, which is a rare occurrence, last done in 2002. The vineyards are run using organic and biodynamic practices.

Wine Description

The Champagne has a shining, beautiful golden yellow colour. It presents a complex aromatic expression with hints of yellow fruit, toasted almonds, and wheat from the Chardonnay, harmoniously blended with the juicy red fruit notes of Pinot Noir. Aromas also include citrus oil, crisp stone fruits, white flowers, crushed mint, subtle hints of buttery pastry, clover honey, freshly shaved ginger, marzipan, and jasmine.

The blend is 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay, which reflects the estate's vineyard composition. It is a medium to full-bodied, deep, and layered wine with a concentrated and introverted core of fruit. The palate is lively and concentrated, opening with a silky touch and unveiling scents of preserved citrus fruit, candied citrus, and iodized spices. It is framed by chalky extract and animated by a fine, vibrant, pinpoint mousse. The wine maintains a timeless, chalky temperament that is freed from the sunny character of the vintage. Stylistically, it has tremendous freshness, elegance, and a finely honed precision, showcasing a perfect combination of softness and concentration. The wine is a Brut with a dosage of 7 grams per litre (g/l). It is aged for six years in the cellar and rests for a further eight months after disgorgement. The finish is long, pure, lingering, and underpinned by subtle oaky, sappy, and saline notes, providing a lovely combination of finesse and concentration. The ABV is 12.5%. Cristal can be aged for over twenty years without losing its freshness and character.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 98 points

  • Wine & Spirits - 98 points

  • James Suckling - 97 points

  • Wine Spectator - 96 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 96 points

  • The Wine Advocate - 95+ points

  • Decanter - 95 points

Food Pairing

This great Champagne is the perfect accompaniment to exceptional fish and shellfish dishes. Suggested pairings include succulent Maine lobster, white truffle risotto, sashimi grade yellowtail, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano. Other recommendations include shellfish and crab.

title: Mar Azul Habanero Tequila
bodyHtml: Hand-crafted using the highest quality Blue Weber Agaves nourished in the rich volcanic soil of Jalisco. It is crafted with habanero extract, agave nectar and Tequila.

title: L'Ecole No. 41 'Ferguson'
bodyHtml:
Ferguson is L’Ecole’s pre-eminent Bordeaux blend, in keeping with our reputation for excellent single-vineyard wines from the Walla Walla Valley. Ferguson reflects the unique terroir expression of its microclimate and geological site

With a flavor profile distinctly influenced by its volcanic basalt soil, Ferguson is a richly structured, age-worthy, and energetic wine offering complex, mineral-laced aromas of cassis, blueberry, boysenberry, iron, fresh tobacco, and sandalwood. Layers of black and red fruit flavors are laced with hints of espresso and framed by expressive tannins integrated with crushed rocks and graphite. Intense, racy, and structured, Ferguson’s pronounced natural acidity carries through to a compelling and enduring finish.

title: Louis Jadot Chablis Montee de Tonnerre Premier Cru 2022
bodyHtml:
Louis Jadot Chablis Montee de Tonnerre Premier Cru 2022 originates from the Chablis region of Burgundy, France, specifically from the esteemed Montee de Tonnerre subregion. Founded in 1859 by Louis Henry Denis Jadot, the maison has been managed by the Gagey family since 1985, maintaining a deep commitment to expressing the unique nuances of Burgundy's terroirs. Their winemaking philosophy balances traditional methods with modern technology to ensure each wine faithfully represents its specific appellation.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay presents a beautiful pale gold hue and offers a refined, mineral-driven sensory profile. The nose reveals elegant aromas of pineapple, white flowers, and citrus zest, complemented by notes of green apple and a distinct flinty minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and well-balanced, featuring a silky texture with flavours of ripe pear and peach underscored by vibrant acidity. The finish is long and graceful, characterized by a persistent saltiness and a touch of roasted hazelnut.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 95 points

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points

  • Wine Advocate - 92 points

  • Decanter - 91 points

Food Pairing

This wine's rich texture and saline minerality make it an exceptional companion for seafood dishes such as grilled langoustines, scallops, or sushi and sashimi. It also pairs beautifully with white meats in creamy sauces and French cheeses like Beaufort or Comté.

title: Bodegas Enguera Cava Brut Nature Organic Finca in a Bubble (NV)
bodyHtml:
The elegant Enguera Finca In A Bubble Cava Brut Nature from Spain is a cuvee, organically pressed from the grape varieties Chardonnay and Viura. After the harvest, the grapes are quickly brought to the winery. Here they are sorted and carefully crushed. Now follows the fermentation of the base wines. After the assemblage of the cuvee follows the further aging based on the classic bottle fermentation.

Enguera Finca In A Bubble Cava Brut Nature from the wine-growing region of Catalonia shows in the glass in brilliant shimmering light yellow. The bubbles of this sparkling wine shine in the glass vital and long-lasting. To the nose, this Bodegas Enguera sparkling wine reveals all sorts of acacia, grapefruit, green apple and lemon.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Ardmore Single Malt 1996 'Distillery Labels'
bodyHtml: Bottled under Gordon & MacPhail's Distillery Label range, this 1996 vintage Ardmore was matured in refill American hogsheads, before bottling at 46%.

title: L'Ecole No. 41 Semillon 2022
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1983 in the Walla Walla Valley, L'Ecole No 41 is one of Washington State's most iconic and oldest family-owned wineries. Housed in the historic Frenchtown School depicted on their label, they have earned international acclaim for producing distinctive wines of the highest quality.

Refreshing and richly textured, this expressive Semillon shows vibrant melon, peach, Granny Smith apple, and fragrant honeysuckle set against a ginger and key lime character. On the palate, it is supple and energetic, replete with pear and stone fruit flavors, persisting to a balanced, crisp finish.

91 Points - Vinous

Sweet spring flowers, lemon-laced apples and confectionary spice introduce the 2022 Sémillon. A model of grace and purity, this is perfumed and slightly exotic, with suggestions of mint that offset green melon notes and ample juicy acidity that keeps the energy high.

91 Points - James Suckling

A full body and a rich mouthfeel dominate this 82% semillon and 18% sauvignon blanc wine. Golden apples, Bosc pears and a touch of almonds.

title: L'Ecole No. 41 Seven Hills 'Perigee' 2020
bodyHtml:
L’Ecole No. 41 is a partner in the 170 acre acclaimed Seven Hills Vineyard, which is planted in wind-blown loess of geologically young and mineral rich soils. One of the most renowned vineyards of Walla Walla, Seven Hills is Certified Sustainable and Salmon Safe and was recognized as one of the Ten Great Vineyards of the World by Wine & Spirits Magazine.

Perigee epitomizes this estate vineyard’s distinctive cedar and beautiful dark cherry, framed by a structured elegance. It explodes with pretty aromas of spiced cassis and boysenberry, along with tobacco leaf, pencil lead, and cola that are lifted by notes of spring flowers, sage, anise, and thyme. The finish is complex with silky tannins.

title: Compass Box Metropolis The Extinct Blends Quartet Whisky
bodyHtml:
The Soul of Blended Scotch is Found in the City

For our third release in the Extinct Blends Quartet, we step into the throng of a striving city through the ages. Industriousness jostles up against elaborate architecture; people and provisions from diverse places mingle; commerce meets culture. Blended Scotch whisky began in the metropolis, with blending vats in Glasgow and Edinburgh producing bottles for urban jungles around the world. The soul of blended Scotch continues to reside in the city.

Vanilla arrives first on the nose, followed by a medley of different honeys. Fudge, apricot and pineapple lead to fresh fig. A rich and very complex palate with sultana, apricot again and hints of smoky woodiness. A long and sweet finish, with a pleasing weight.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Caol Ila Single Malt 2005 18 Year Old 'Connoisseur's Choice'
bodyHtml:
Festive spice aromas infuse with cured meats and stewed plum. Red berry flavours combine with fruitcake and subtle coffee bean. A full finish with lingering citrus fruit and bonfire embers.

Passion for single malt Scotch whisky has been at the heart of our family business for four generations. The Connoisseur's Choice range is an ever-changing collection of unique perspectives on distilleries’ own bottlings, non-chill-filtered single cask and small batch expressions bottled at cask strength — exceptional one-offs.

title: Ol' Beautiful Okami Kasu Japanese Ale - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Okami Kasu is a unique and innovative Japanese-style ale from Calgary’s Ol' Beautiful Brewing Co., located in the historic Inglewood district. This beer is a standout in the Alberta craft scene due to its unconventional ingredient: Sake Kasu. This is the rice "lees" or sediment left over from the sake brewing process (specifically sourced from the local Milton-Freewater sake producer). It is designed to be an incredibly clean, "high-definition" lager-like ale that pushes the boundaries of traditional brewing by incorporating Japanese fermentation heritage.

Beer Description

Okami Kasu pours a pale, brilliant straw color with a slight, natural haze and a tight, sparkling white head.

Aroma: The nose is delicate, floral, and highly distinct. It leads with a scent of steamed jasmine rice and sweet melon, followed by a unique, slightly creamy aroma reminiscent of vanilla and light almond—which comes from the sake rice. There is virtually no hop aroma, allowing the subtle fermentation characters to shine.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a crisp, refreshing carbonation. It leads with a gentle, silky sweetness from the rice, followed by a clean, slightly "umami" complexity and a touch of pear. The finish is remarkably dry and "snappy," with a mineral-like cleanliness that mimics a high-quality dry sake.

Profile: It sits at a very sessionable 5.0% ABV and a low bitterness of approx. 10–12 IBU, emphasizing texture and subtle flavor over hop intensity.

Technical Notes: The "secret" to this beer is the addition of Sake Kasu during the brewing process. The kasu contains residual yeast and enzymes that contribute to the beer's unique mouthfeel and dry finish. It is brewed with a combination of pilsner malt and rice, then fermented at cooler temperatures with a neutral ale yeast to ensure the delicate rice and melon notes are not overshadowed by fruity esters.

title: Ol' Beautiful Abrazo Mexican Lager - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Ol' Beautiful Abrazo is a standout core offering from Ol' Beautiful Brewing Co., located in the vibrant Inglewood neighborhood of Calgary, Alberta. Since its inception, the brewery has focused on the old ways of doing things, emphasizing storied brewing traditions. Abrazo is their take on the classic Mexican style lager, a style historically influenced by 19th-century Austrian immigrants designed to be a crisp, approachable alternative to mass-produced imports.

Beer Description

This Mexican-style lager is light-bodied and brilliantly clear with a pale straw to golden hue and a bright, white head.

Aroma: Clean and unassuming, featuring subtle notes of sweet grain, light floral hops, and a hint of corn-like sweetness typical of the style.

Palate: It offers a smooth entry with a gentle, honey-like malt sweetness. This quickly gives way to a high level of carbonation and a refreshingly zesty, clean finish that avoids any lingering bitterness.

Profile: It has an ABV of 5.0% and a very low bitterness profile, making it exceptionally crushable and designed for long patio sessions.

Technical Notes: Brewed as a pale lager with a focus on a high-quality malt bill and a clean-fermenting yeast strain to ensure a crisp, dry mouthfeel.

title: Benromach Single Malt Single Cask Sherry Hogshead 2013 #306
bodyHtml: A limited edition single cask bottling, selected and bottled in partnership with the Whisky Rant Podcast. Rich stewed fruit aromas with smooth dark chocolate and autumnal spices, followed by a touch of soft smoke.

title: Argiano Brunello di Montalcino 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Italy's iconic Tuscany region, specifically the historic hill town of Montalcino, the Argiano Brunello di Montalcino represents a pinnacle of traditional Tuscan winemaking. The historic Argiano estate dates back to the late 16th century, boasting centuries of rich heritage and viticultural significance. Under its dedicated ownership and the guidance of winemaker Bernardino Sani, the winery follows a philosophy focused on organic farming and meticulous vineyard management to craft wines that genuinely express their unique terroir.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese reveals a sparkling, intense ruby color in the glass. The bouquet is complex and dark, offering inviting aromas of fresh dark cherries, blackberry, and orange blossom, complemented by hints of white cedar, grilled herbs, and cloves. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and beautifully balanced, bringing a vibrant, racy energy and a distinctive saline note that enhances its gastronomic appeal. It possesses a firm yet silky texture with fine-grained, chewy tannins and a refreshing spine of acidity that carries through to a long, polished finish layered with red fruit and balsamic nuances.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 96 points.

  • Vinous - 94+ points.

  • Decanter - 94 points.

  • James Suckling - 94 points.

Food Pairing

The structured tannins, deep dark fruit, and refreshing acidity of this wine make it a natural match for hearty Tuscan cuisine, such as roasted wild boar, slow-cooked beef stews, or aged Pecorino cheese.

title: Kamora Coffee Liqueur
bodyHtml: This versatile Mexican liqueur is made from only the finest beans that are roasted to perfection. Easy to enjoy anytime, this combines decadent flavours of vanilla, chocolate, caramel and aromatic coffee all on a silky smooth textured palate.

title: Tequila Fuenteseca Extra Anejo 15 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The Atotonilco highland agave used in the lot were harvested late into the Spring, just before the arrival of 1998’s summer rains. It was laid into barrel in August of that summer and spent the next 15 years stored in a dry, earthen-floor aging room in the town of Atotonilco el Alto.

Because the agave used here had lower sugar content resultant of the prior year’s El Niño storms (which had water-logged the plants), a delightful faint sweetness is restored by aging nearly entirely in American white oak. A scant 3% of the lot was laid into French Oak, in order to contribute a subtle dark oak tannin complexity.

Dry and complex, master distiller Enrique Fonseca has released this selection at 43% ABV as the optimal proof for this intriguing 15 year tequila.

title: Tequila Fuenteseca Extra Anejo 21 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Often described as the world's first "Grand Cru" Tequila, Master Distiller Enrique Fonseca created this product with the goal of producing the world's oldest aged tequila. It is made exclusively in copper-pot stills, but the barrel-aging technique is often the most talked about part of the process.

Most of the spirit rested in barrels that once aged Canadian rye whiskey, although one barrel used previously held white wine from California. The casks were stored for 10 years in a dry, earthen-floor aging room in the town of Atotonilco el Alto before being designated as worthy of a longer aging and moved to a higher, cooler climate of Chapingo, Jalisco, which sits on the slope above Atotonilco el Alto.

This collector's item is unexpectedly pale in colour for an extra anejo. The nose is moderately spicy, rounded with notes of butterscotch. There are oaky vanilla flavours on the palate, but the agave still comes through nicely, leaving a soft, long finish with hints of coconut.

title: Tequila Fuenteseca Extra Anejo 9 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Fuenteseca Tequila presents the mastery of agave cultivation and tequila distillation using agave cultivated in various soil types, distilled in assorted still types, and rested in an array of vessels, be they of stainless steel or a collection of wooden casks from around the world… harmonizing to create incomparable spirits in a series of limited bottlings.

Master Distiller Enrique Fonseca's innovative approach involves distilling three-quarters of the batch in a modified double-copper column still and the rest in an alembic pot still, followed by aging a quarter of the distillate in American white oak casks previously used for California red wine and the remainder in used dark French Oak. This process culminates in a nine-year maturation in a damp-climate cellar, once an early 20th-century water cistern, ensuring a slow, cool aging with minimal wood interaction.

The result is a limited series of tequila with a rich amber color, and notes of espresso, vanilla, and cocoa.

title: Caymus Cabernet Sauvignon 'California' 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This dark and rich red wine originates from United States, bearing a broad California appellation. Founded in 1972 by the Wagner family, Caymus Vineyards is one of Napa Valley's most iconic names, now celebrating over 50 years of winemaking. While world-renowned for their Napa Valley bottlings, this 'California' Cabernet Sauvignon was introduced with the 2021 vintage to explore the state’s diverse vineyard land beyond the Napa borders. The Wagner family's philosophy focuses on 'signature hallmarks'—sourcing fruit from hidden pockets across the state with ideal stony soils and maritime influences to produce a wine that is consistently supple and approachable.

Wine Description

The 2023 Caymus 'California' Cabernet Sauvignon presents a saturated, dark ruby colour. The aromatic profile is intense and layered, featuring hallmark notes of ripe blackberry, cassis, and dark plum, accented by cocoa powder, sweet spice, and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and luxurious, revealing a rich texture with flavours of chocolate-dusted berries, mocha, and black cherry.

This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon is crafted in a bold, opulent style with fine-grained, velvety tannins that provide immediate drinkability. The finish is long and polished, lingering with notes of baking spice and warm, ripe fruit. While it is designed to be seductive and 'effortlessly drinkable' upon release, its concentrated fruit and structure allow it to soften beautifully with age.

Food Pairing

The wine's rich fruit and supple tannins make it a perfect match for hearty, fire-grilled dishes such as ribeye steak with herb butter or BBQ brisket. It also pairs elegantly with short rib ragu, beef bourguignon, or aged cheeses like Gouda and Comté. This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Cantera Negra Silver Tequila
bodyHtml: A highly earthy Tequila distinctive for its minerality and the forward taste of cooked agave. Our Silver stands out for a touch more sweetness than most tequilas, and presents beautiful notes of citrus. We love that this tequila is spicy and peppery on the tongue and cheeks, but perfectly smooth on the back of the throat.

title: Cantera Negra Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Cantera Negra Reposado is aged for at least 7 months in ex cognac and bourbon barrels. Our Reposado has refined notes of roasted agave, oak, vanilla, and a hint of citrus in background. It is enjoyable for sipping or as the high-end base for craft cocktails.

title: Cantera Negra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Cantera Negra Anejo offers a remarkably smooth taste and a warm finish. Although never bottled until passing the stringent taste testing standards of their family panel, it is aged at least 18 months.

Their Anejo maintains the subtle citrus and earthy hints of our Silver and Reposado products, but the aging process imparts and highlights subtle new flavors resembling the cooked agave itself, with a more woody and vanilla ending. Its flavor is so unique and enjoyable as a sipping tequila that Cantera Negra Anejo stands apart from all other typical tequilas on the market today.

title: Dulce Momento Anejo Cristalino Mezcal
bodyHtml: This crystalline aged mezcal goes through a 1-year ageing period in French Oak barrels before being filtered through the fine crystals of activated charcoal. This ageing process provides the intensity of mezcal.

title: Dulce Momento Espadin Joven Mezcal
bodyHtml: The distillation of this artisanal mezcal allows you to savour an irresistible combination of sweetness and smoothness.

title: Don Fulano Imperial Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Don Fulano Imperial is the oldest, exceptionally rich and complex with a great combination of elegance and power. Blended from dark European oak and oloroso sherry casks it’s abundant in fruit notes and spices like clove and cardamom. Deep notes of old leather, tobacco and a lavish aroma of black cherries frame its singular style. It is velvety and permanent in mouth. An exotic delight to sip on its own

Finished in Oloroso casks, this stunning extra añejo is exceptionally rich with fruit notes of dried black cherries and apricots.

On the palate are lavish spice elements like cardamom and allspice emerge.

Aromas of sweet brown spices, cloves, nutmeg and pepper are abundant in this expression.

On the nose are complex flavors of coffee beans, dark chocolate, old leather and tobacco as well as cola nut and roasted nuts create a unique sensory experience.

The finish is velvety, rich and incredibly complex, the Imperial is truly outstanding and is best enjoyed neat.

title: Rejon Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Rejon Extra Anejo Tequila is a premium tequila that has been aged for at least three years in oak barrels, giving it a rich and complex flavour profile.

This tequila is made from 100% blue agave and is distilled in small batches to ensure quality and consistency. It has notes of caramel, vanilla, oak, and dried fruit, with a smooth and velvety finish. Rejon Extra Anejo Tequila is best enjoyed neat or on the rocks to fully appreciate its depth of flavour.

title: Lobos 1707 Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Lobos 1707 Tequila, Extra Anejo is the alpha Tequila – over four hundred years of refinement that harkens back to 1707.

Born of 100% pure Blue Weber agave Tequila, it is aged to perfection for three years in American white oak and finished in historic PX wine barrels using the solera method, permitting the Tequila time to evolve into its most lasting, flavorful experience.

Superbly unorthodox. Unapologetically smooth.

title: Komos Reposado Rosa Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tequila Komos Reposado Rosa is an ultra-premium aged spirit crafted in Jalisco, Mexico (NOM 1110). Created by former Master Sommelier Richard Betts, Tequila Komos draws heavy inspiration from Mediterranean winemaking techniques to reimagine luxury tequila. Positioned at the intersection of fine wine and artisanal agave spirits, this expression gains its signature delicate rosé-pink hue by resting in French oak red wine barrels previously used for Napa Valley wines. It is presented in a handcrafted, upcyclable pink ceramic decanter adorned with Mediterranean reactive glazes.

Spirit Description

Komos Reposado Rosa is produced from 100% Blue Weber agaves harvested from both the Highlands (Los Altos) and Lowlands (Valles) of Jalisco, blending floral brightness with rich mineral complexity. The agave piñas are slow-cooked in traditional stone brick ovens, naturally fermented, and double-distilled in copper pot stills. The spirit is then aged for approximately 60 to 65 days (2 months) in French oak barrels that held Napa Valley red wine, allowing residual grape skins and oak tannins to impart a subtle fruitiness and natural pink hue. Before bottling, the tequila undergoes a signature winemaking aeration process gently tumbling the liquid to soften its mouthfeel and round out the texture.

  • Colour: Delicate, luminous rosé pink with pale salmon and blush highlights.

  • Aroma: Soft, floral, and deeply aromatic. The nose opens with cinnamon-dusted rose petals, fresh strawberries, and dark cherries, followed by sweet cooked agave, creamy vanilla, and subtle red wine cask spice.

  • Palate: Lush, silky, and balanced on the entry. Upfront flavors of ripe dark plum, blackberries, and chocolate-covered strawberries merge into sweet butterscotch, vanilla, and roasted agave, backed by light grape-skin tannins and a subtle saline minerality.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a soft, rounded, and velvety mouthfeel resulting from post-aging aeration.

  • Finish: Long, smooth, and refreshing, trailing off with persistent notes of dark chocolate, red fruit sweetness, gentle oak, and a clean, dry floral snap.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Gran Diamante Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
100% blue agave aged eight months, made from the finest estate grown highland agave aged in french oak barrels.

The palate is brimming with spice, pepper, balanced agave, caramel, slight wood and smoke. The body is medium weight with a buttery velvety texture. This tequila has a refined bouquet, laced with aromas of butterscotch, slight smoke and wood.

title: Dulce Momento Montana Joven Mezcal
bodyHtml: The wild Maguey Montana is unique in the entire country. Its characteristic color signals that it is ripe and ready to give an artisanal mezcal a flavour that will leave you speechless.

title: Gran Diamante Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Gran Diamante Tequila Anejo is crafted from the finest estate-grown Agave Tequilana weber and is aged eighteen months in new, French oak barrels. It has a luscious body and a satiny texture. It's smooth hints of muted spice, pepper and oak undertones taper down to a thoroughly enjoyable finish.

This full-bodied Anejo has a refined bouquet, with aromas consisting of butterscotch, cinnamon and nutmeg spices, with hints of chocolate and cigar. Its slight wood and smoke essence give it a character and nuance found in older Anejos.

title: Number Juan Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Aged a full 5 years in a charred white oak, retired bourbon barrel, this work of art merges smooth taste while taking every essence of it’s barrel. This 12 year process delivers a world class drink simply superior to any.

In the shadow of the great volcano “Tequila”, nestled in the lowlands rich and fertile Blue Agave fields of Amatitan, Jalisco Mexico where some say God himself kissed the earth, lived an honest, simple man of great integrity…

Don Juan Alejandro, truly felt blessed being a part of this magical land. Steadfast to embracing his gift from God coupled with a passion for his craft, the reputation of a heartfelt tequila was born. While others mass-produced, Juan Alejandro refused to ever compromise the Soil, Agave, or the Tequila’s integrity. In the immortal words of Don Juan Alejandro, “whatever your craft may be, be great & never quit and God shall bless your path”.

On behalf of my ancestors, I proudly present a Superior Tequila. Throughout every step of its production, taste the heart & passion of Mexico in every bottle.

title: Gran Diamante Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
100% blue agave Blanco made from the finest estate grown highland agave.

The Blanco has a wafting bouquet; aromas of spice, slight vanilla, vegetal and floral tones. The palate is brimming with spice, pepper, and well balanced agave notes. The body is medium weight with a buttery velvety texture.

title: Cantera Negra Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Aged no less than 36 months, Cantera's Extra Anejo drinks like a bourbon-lover’s Tequila. Rich and buttery smooth from start to finish, this very special Tequila offers notes of chocolate and coffee. They artfully blend bourbon-cask and cognac-cask aged Tequila with it for an unrivaled, sophisticated taste. 

Their Extra Anejo makes a great sipping drink with dessert. We find pairing it with dark chocolate creates an outstanding and rewarding experience.

title: Adictivo Extra Anejo Tequila 14 Year Old 'Kings Edition Extra Rare'
bodyHtml:
The Adictivo 14-Year-Old Extra Añejo Kings Edition Extra Rare is meticulously crafted from 100% pure blue agave. This exceptional tequila undergoes a remarkable aging process, maturing for 14 years in French oak barrels and culminating with a finishing touch in sherry casks. The narrative of this extraordinary tequila commenced two decades ago, spanning from the initial planting of the agave.

The journey continued through the jima at the ripe age of 6 years and eventually unfolded into a remarkable 14-year period of repose within the barrel.

The result is a truly rare and distinguished expression that captures the essence of a two-decade-long commitment to excellence in tequila craftsmanship.

title: Gran Diamante Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Aged 48 months in French Oak barrels, our extra anejo retains the same spice and agave foundation found in all of our award-winning tequila, while also showcasing the highest levels of refinement and smoothness of any extra anejo.

Expressions include notes of chocolate, light smoke, wood and tobacco, arriving mid-palate with an enchantingly lingering finish.

Extremely limited production, these numbered bottles are what you would expect: Nothing but the best in celebratory tequila.

title: Remirez de Ganuza Gran Reserva 2015
bodyHtml:
Remirez de Ganuza Gran Reserva 2015 originates from Spain, within the Ebro Valley region and the prestigious Rioja Alavesa subregion. The winery was established in 1989 by Fernando Remirez de Ganuza, who founded the estate on a meticulous approach to checking and purchasing premier vineyard plots around the Sierra Cantabria. The current winemaking philosophy combines cutting-edge ingenuity with a deep commitment to high-precision viticulture, focusing exclusively on hand-harvesting old, low-yielding vines to craft luxurious wines built for extensive aging.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a luminous cherry-red or deep ruby appearance with impressive depth in the glass and possesses a powerful, full-bodied structure with a luxurious, refined texture. The sensory profile is highly intense and multi-layered, opening with an aromatic nose of bing cherries, wild blackberries, and strawberry compote, beautifully accented by sweet spices, dairy notes, earthy incense, and cedarwood. On the plush and opulent palate, it delivers deep flavours of black fruits, plums, and liquorice, seamlessly balanced by a chalky minerality and bright, lively acidity. The finish is remarkably long, vibrant, and silky, leaving a persistent trail of savoury wood spices and mature primary fruits.

  • Varietal Composition: A classic old-vine cuvée composed of 88% Tempranillo, 10% Graciano, and 2% minor regional white grape varieties like Viura and Malvasia.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its paradoxical balance between modern fruit richness and classical elegance, trading heavy textures for structured poise. The grapes are sourced from vines averaging over 60 years of age, and the wine undergoes a masterfully integrated 38-month maturation program in 100% new French oak barriques.

  • ABV: Recorded between 14.5% and 15%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate relies on meticulous, non-interventional grape manual sorting, this release is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The firm tannic core, dense mid-palate, and bright acidity of this Gran Reserva make it a spectacular match for high-end, protein-driven gastronomy.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with dry-aged beef steaks, slowly braised lamb shoulder, slow-cooked venison stews, or roasted meats seasoned with rosemary and garlic.

  • Game: Suggested pairings include rich wild game dishes or traditional hearty casseroles featuring a geconcentreerde sauce.

  • Cheese: Matches gracefully with structured artisanal platters of mature, hard cheeses such as an aged Manchego or sharp white Cheddar.

Vintage Quality

The 2015 vintage in Rioja is regarded as an exceptional and high-quality year, characterized by growing conditions that yielded a perfect balance of fruit maturity and structural freshness. The season offered ideal weather conditions that allowed the late-ripening varieties to accumulate immense extract and flavor concentration. The winemaker's skill in executing their famous separation of the grape bunches—using only the optimal 'shoulders' of the clusters—successfully maximized the fruit purity of the harvest, resulting in a legendary 2015 release with a cellaring trajectory built to evolve gracefully in the cellar for at least another 10 to 15 years.

title: Yoshi no Gawa Minamo Nakagumi Daiginjo Hiroshima Yeast - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Yoshi No Gawa Minamo Nakagumi Daiginjo originates from Nagaoka City in the Niigata Prefecture of Japan. This expression is part of the premium "Minamo" line, which translates to "water's surface," a name that honors the Shinano River and the pristine groundwater used by the brewery. Founded in 1548, Yoshi No Gawa is the oldest brewery in Niigata and is currently managed by the 20th generation of the Kawakami family.

Description

This Daiginjo is particularly unique because it is a "Nakagumi" bottling, meaning the liquid is collected from the middle section of the sake press—often considered the most balanced and highest-quality part of the batch.

  • Yeast & Aroma: It is fermented with a specific Hiroshima-style yeast, which departs from the typical Niigata style by offering a more flamboyant and intensely fruity bouquet. You can expect aromas of ripe green melon, pineapple, and zesty citrus.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it is bold and rich yet maintains the structured elegance of a Daiginjo. It features layers of citrus and cream, with a slight, pleasant astringency that balances its natural sweetness.

  • Technical Details: It is bottled at a high alcohol content of 17.5% ABV, indicating it is likely a Genshu (undiluted) style. The finish is remarkably zesty, clean, and long-lasting.

Food Pairing

The complex citrus and cream profile of this Nakagumi Daiginjo makes it a superb companion for both refined Japanese dishes and modern Western cuisine.

  • Seafood: Its vibrant citrus notes and structured body pair beautifully with high-end sushi, fatty tuna (otoro), and lobster with butter sauce.

  • Creamy & Savoury: The lactic hints from the "Nakagumi" press make it a natural match for Camembert cheese, scallops in cream sauce, or even a light chicken alfredo.

  • Zesty Starters: It serves as an excellent aperitif alongside a zesty melon and prosciutto salad or fresh oysters with a lemon-ginger mignonette.

Serving Temperature: It is best enjoyed chilled in a wine glass to allow the complex "Hiroshima yeast" aromatics to fully open up.

title: Unico Zelo Tropo Sparkling Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
A bright, zingy and crystal-clean Blanc de Blancs made by Unico Zelo and produced from Adelaide Hills Chardonnay.

Beautifully simple and an excellent summer sparkling. 

Vegan Friendly.

title: Lobos 1707 Mezcal
bodyHtml: Each sip conjures its epic past: created from 100% Espadín agave, roasted in an open, conical Oaxacan fire pit, then ground in an Egyptian stone mill, resulting in a stealthily smooth liquid whose flavor experience is deep, affecting, and will leave its mark with the subtle warmth of spice.

title: Komos Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Komos Extra Anejo is aged for a minimum of three years in a combination of French oak white wine barrels and American oak whiskey barrels. The richness of American oak is masterfully blended with the refinement of French oak.

True to Komos’ craftsmanship, this expression is made in Mexico using perfectly ripe 100% Blue Weber Agave, hand-harvested from the distinct terroirs of both the highlands and lowlands of the Tequila Valley in Jalisco. The pinas are roasted in traditional stone ovens, and the aguamiel is naturally fermented and twice distilled in copper pot stills. It is then aged in specially selected barrels and masterfully blended to create an opulent tequila with notes of dried orange peels, candied ginger, and toasted pecans. The final touch is gentle aeration: the winemaking technique of tumbling the liquid to take on oxygen to make the mouthfeel softer and smoother, while adding a richness and roundness.

title: Yoshi no Gawa Minamo Nakagumi Junmai Daiginjo Niigata S-9 Yeast - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Yoshi No Gawa Minamo Nakagumi Niigata S-9 is a top-tier expression within the "Minamo" series from Niigata's oldest brewery, Yoshi No Gawa (est. 1548). The Minamo line is designed to represent the "water's surface," reflecting the purity of the Shinano River and the brewery's own spring water. This specific bottling highlights two rare technical choices: the collection of "Nakagumi" (the prized middle-press liquid) and the use of the regional Niigata S-9 yeast.

Description

This Junmai Daiginjo is crafted during the traditional winter-brewing season using Koshi Tanrei rice, a premium grain developed specifically for Niigata's climate and polished down to 40%.

  • Yeast Influence: The Niigata S-9 yeast is a regional variation of the famous Association Yeast No. 9. It is celebrated for producing a "flamboyant" fruity bouquet while maintaining a clean, steady fermentation at low temperatures.

  • Aroma: It features an intense and elegant nose with prominent notes of green apple, lemon, and white floral blossoms, accompanied by hints of muscat melon and white spices.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it is remarkably mild and smooth with a rich umami core. The flavors of green apple and melon harmonize with a light rice sweetness and a delicate, creamy texture.

  • Technical Profile: This is a powerful sake with an alcohol content of 17.5% ABV. It typically has a Sake Meter Value (SMV) of +1 and a crisp acidity of 1.4, resulting in a clean, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing

The combination of high alcohol, rich umami, and zesty citrus notes makes this sake a sophisticated partner for both high-end Japanese and contemporary Western dishes.

  • Premium Seafood: Its acidity and "S-9" fruitiness pair exceptionally well with fatty tuna (otoro), sea urchin (uni), and butter-poached lobster or scallops.

  • Rich & Creamy: The "Nakagumi" richness complements creamy textures like burrata cheese, chicken alfredo, or dishes featuring a white wine cream sauce.

  • Zesty Starters: It is an excellent match for oysters with a lemon-ginger mignonette or a fresh green apple and fennel salad.

  • Serving Tip: Best enjoyed chilled in a wine glass to allow the flamboyant fruity aromas to fully develop.

title: Le Petit Smith Haut Lafitte Rouge 2021
Cepa 21 Malabrigo 2019
bodyHtml:
Cherry red color with garnet edges, clean and deep. The nose is very intense and elegant, with nuances of black fruit and spicy notes well assembled with aging in wood, obtaining a very balanced and round whole. The palate is intense, voluminous and with a long and persistent aftertaste.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This deep-garnet-colored wine has aromas of cassis, cocoa powder and a touch of baking spice. Luxurious tannins backdrop the blackberry, black cherry, dark chocolate and black olive flavors, with a hint of dried herbes de Provence that persists into the enduring finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

A full-bodied, firm red with roasted herbs, bay leaves, soy, coconut and black fruit on the nose. Meaty and toasty, with plenty of spice to the fleshy black fruit. Excellent length. Tempranillo. Drink from 2024.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A fresh, fragrant red, with lovely notes of cigar box spices and cured tobacco on the nose accenting baked blackberry and black plum fruit, dark chocolate and herbed olive on the palate. Reveals hints of minerally iron and graphite that add savory depth and complexity, while sculpted tannins emerge to firm the finish. Drink now through 2029.

title: Lobos 1707 Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
Rated as “one of the best five tequilas in the world” from Forbes Magazine, Lobos 1707 Reposado Tequila is a 100% pure Blue Weber agave that reaches its perfectly robust flavor through rest. After ruminating for over six-to-eight slow months in American white oak barrels, the liquid is finished at its leisure in historic Pedro Ximenez (PX) wine barrels using the solera method.

Once sipped, it reveals its spicy, bold, audacious character.  The reward is a liquid worth celebrating.

title: Bret Brothers Macon Villages Cuvee 'Terroirs du Maconnais' 2022
bodyHtml:
Blended from multiple classic Maconnais terroirs, including Vire-Clesse, Saint-Veran En Combe, Pouilly-Fuisse En Carementrant and others.

Dusty fresh nose of white fruits and apple blossoms, fresh herbs and mineral hints. Smooth palate with fine acidity and a pointed, vivid texture.

title: Yoshi no Gawa Yuzu Sparkling Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Yoshi No Gawa Yuzu Sparkling Sake is a refreshing, effervescent liqueur from the historic Yoshi No Gawa brewery in Niigata Prefecture. Established in 1548, the brewery combines its centuries-old expertise in sake brewing with real Japanese yuzu juice to create this modern, low-alcohol beverage. Often labeled as "Awayuki Yuzu Sparkling" in Japan, it is designed for casual enjoyment and as a lively alternative to traditional wine or cider.

Description

This sparkling sake is a blend of premium sake, natural yuzu juice, and carbon dioxide to create a zippy, citrus-forward experience.

  • Aroma: A vibrant and intense bouquet of fresh yuzu peel, grapefruit, and a hint of minty coolness.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it features gentle bubbles that burst with flavors of lemon peel, lychee, and yuzu jam. It draws on the natural sweetness of the rice koji to balance the sharp, refreshing tartness of the citrus.

  • Technical Profile: It is a light and accessible drink with an alcohol content of 7% to 7.5%. It has a Sake Meter Value (SMV) of -33, indicating a high level of residual sweetness that is perfectly offset by its high acidity (Acidity: 4).

Food Pairing

The bright acidity and sweet citrus notes make this sparkling sake an excellent palate cleanser and a delightful partner for both savory and sweet dishes.

  • Aperitif & Appetizers: Serve it alongside smoked duck breast, prosciutto with fresh melon, or creamy dips to contrast the rich fats.

  • Spicy Cuisine: The sweetness and effervescence help tame the heat of spicy Thai salads, buffalo wings, or Szechuan-style appetizers.

  • Desserts: It is a natural match for vanilla bean ice cream, citrus fruit jellies, or almond tofu. It can also be poured directly over a fruit sorbet for a sophisticated dessert float.

  • Serving Tip: Best enjoyed well-chilled, straight from its 300 ml bottle-can or poured into a flute or white wine glass to preserve the bubbles and concentrate the citrus aromatics.

title: Grand Mayan Silver 3D Triple Distilled Tequila
bodyHtml:
Grand Mayan 3D Silver is a triple distilled blanco tequila that is extremely smooth, light and crisp. Great straight or for premium cocktails.

Grand Mayan tequila is presented in a hand made bottle by Mexican Artists. This ultra aged tequila is patiently crafted with the highest standards of production to produce an array of pleasant flavours and aromas.

Light and crystal clear. On the nose, sweet agave, citrus such as grapefruit peel. Sweet herbs such as eucalyptus, rosemary, and mint on the palate. A smooth and fast finish, with faint notes of white pepper and grapefruit.

title: St. Supery Dollarhide Ranch Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon presents with deep, dark reds and purples. Aromas are opulent with ripe blackberry, black plum, cassis, chocolate, and toasted oak. A rich, dense profile follows with flavors of cassis and ripe black fruits, espresso, mocha, and molasses with subtle oak in influence. It is a deep, structured wine with excellent fine-grain tannin.

96 Points - Tasting Panel

Aged for 20 months in 100% French oak (54% new), the wine offers a broad and generous mouthfeel with chewy tannins. The fruit is ripe and almost gobby, becoming more streamlined as it opens up. Dark berries are lush and sweet with hints of brown sugar. Acidity and chalky lift are well defined and have the mouth imploring for that next sip. Refined, elegant, polished, and poised.

94 Points - James Suckling

Lots of ripe fruit with blackberries and blueberries, as well as fresh herbs, tobacco and cedar. It’s full-bodied, layered and flavorful. A little tight and tannic at the end.

92 Points - Decanter

91 Points - Wilfred Wong

title: Cakebread Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Cakebread Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the United States, within the California region and the prestigious Napa Valley subregion. Founded in 1973 by Jack and Dolores Cakebread, the estate has spent decades establishing a benchmark reputation for high-quality, family-run winemaking. The winery's operational philosophy relies on blending fruit sourced from distinct pockets across the appellation to balance different microclimates and soils. This approach highlights the bold fruit intensity of legendary locations like Rutherford and Oakville alongside structural depth contributed by the warmer northern reaches of Calistoga and the cooler southern pockets of the Suscol watershed.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a dark ruby or deep garnet appearance in the glass and possesses a full-bodied structure with a refined, balanced, and elegant texture. The sensory profile is highly fragrant, complex, and layered, opening with an expressive nose of plush blackcurrants, mulberries, ripe blackberry, and boysenberry, seamlessly complemented by notes of dark chocolate, baking spices, violet, and toasty oak. On the smooth, round, and sumptuous palate, it delivers concentrated dark fruit flavours, spiced black plum, olive tapenade, and cedar, beautifully balanced by fresh, bright acidity and a fine hint of rock minerality. The finish is dry, long, and persistent, leaving a lingering impression framed by finely integrated, velvety tannins.

Food Pairing

The structural concentration, robust fruit layers, and integrated tannins of this Napa Cabernet Sauvignon make it a spectacular match for rich, savory gastronomy.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with premium cuts of grilled steak, an andouille-crusted filet mignon, beef Wellington, a steakhouse cheeseburger, or pork meatballs served with braised peppers.

  • Game & Poultry: Complements rich wild game preparations like venison empanadas served with golden raisins and pecans, or a slow-cooked beef brisket.

  • Heavy Fare: Matches gracefully with classic steakhouse dinners, hearty pasta dishes, or roasted vegetables with a rich, savory profile.

title: Domaines Ott Chateau de Selle Rose 2025
bodyHtml: Soft and creamy with mild acidity. The wine smells like melons and a salty beach with hints of cherries. If a rosé cold have a structure, this is one of them. It would be a wonderful wine to share with a sunset.

title: Yoshi No Gawa Hiya Nama Nama - 300 ml Bottle
bodyHtml:
Yoshi No Gawa Hiya Nama Nama is a specialty sake originating from the Niigata prefecture of Japan. It is produced by Yoshi No Gawa, which was founded in 1548 and holds the distinction of being the oldest brewery in the Niigata region and the fifth oldest in all of Japan. The brewery is located in the Settaya region of Nagaoka City, an area blessed with pure soft water from an underground spring known as 'Tenka Kanrosen'.

Description

This 'Hiya Nama' is a rare, shelf stable unpasteurized sake that offers a fresh and invigorating sensory profile. It features luscious aromas of steamed rice, ripe pear, lychee, and passion fruit. On the palate, the sake is light and elegant with a warm mouthfeel, showcasing layers of pear and fresh mineral vibrancy. It is brewed with Gohyakumangoku rice polished to 65%, resulting in a clean and crisp finish. The alcohol by volume is 14.5% and it is best served well chilled.

Food Pairing

The fresh and versatile nature of this sake makes it an excellent match for a variety of cuisines. Its mineral notes and fruitiness pair perfectly with raw oysters, sashimi, and Japanese pickles. It also complements grilled meats and seafoods, as well as savory appetizers like chawanmushi or fresh creamy cheeses like brie. For a Western pairing, it has been noted to go particularly well with Italian seafood dishes or even savory BBQ.

title: Yoshida Gassan Junmai Daiginjo - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Yoshida Gassan Junmai Daiginjo originates from Yasugi City in the Shimane Prefecture of Japan. The Yoshida Sake Brewery, established in 1743, originally served the Hirose clan during the Edo period. The name "Gassan" refers to the regional landmark Mount Gassan; historically, the finest batch of sake each year was dubbed "Gassan" and presented to the local Lord. The brewery is famous for using what is considered some of the softest brewing water in Japan, taken from a local well and noted for its extreme purity and low mineralization.

Description

This refined sake is a flagship of the Gassan line, known for its elegant and sweet creamy essence. It is crafted primarily from premium Yamada Nishiki rice.

  • Aroma: A delicate and fruity bouquet with notes of honeydew melon, lychee, and lily of the valley.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it offers a harmonious balance of berry-like sweetness and vibrant acidity. Expect flavors of wild berries, ruby grapefruit, and dried apricot.

  • Technical Profile: The rice is polished to either 45% or 50% (varying by specific lot), resulting in a clear, refined flavor. It typically has an alcohol content of 15% to 15.5%, a Sake Meter Value (SMV) of +2.0, and a soft, lingering finish.

Food Pairing

The graceful structure and fruity acidity of this Junmai Daiginjo make it a perfect match for delicate seafood and creamy textures.

  • Seafood: Pairs beautifully with grilled scallops, lobster, and seafood-based pastas. It also complements white fish like seabream or sea bass.

  • Rich Appetizers: The berry-like acidity cuts through the richness of triple cream brie or camembert cheese.

  • Refined Starters: Its floral notes are excellent alongside fresh oysters or a light melon and prosciutto salad.

  • Serving Tip: To fully appreciate its "ginjo-ka" (fruity aroma) and refined profile, it is best served chilled in a wine glass.

title: Saint K Gravesend Lagrein 2021
bodyHtml: The nose of blackberry(not the phone), menthol, baking spice, and violets leads to a tannic, thick and spicy palate with black cherry, plum and massively dark chocolate notes.

title: Saint K Yokai Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
Sourced from Santa Barbara County, this is wonderfully salty Chardonnay with brioche, lemon rind, orange zest and Pink Lady apple flavors.

Beautifully textured, with serious length, the outstanding 2021 ‘Yokai’ will provide drinking enjoyment for the next eight years — and possibly more.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Rich aromas of browned butter, butterscotch and sea salt are pleasantly creamy and engaging on the nose of this bottling, which also shows floral hints of plumeria and jasmine. A fine line of lime-pith-like acidity drives down the palate, cutting through honeydew and cherimoya flavors.

title: Saint K Around The Way Rose 2022
bodyHtml: The nose of melon rind, rose petal and fresh thyme lead into a palate of bright acidity with strawberry, citrus, mineral and fresh cut watermelon. This will certainly be drinkable over the next 4-5years.

title: Richvale Pool Party Pink 2023
bodyHtml:
Richvale Pool Party Pink 2023 originates from the Central Coast region of California, specifically within Santa Barbara County. Richvale Wine Co. is a whimsical project led by winemaker Curt Schalchlin of Sans Liege, featuring the lighthearted persona of 'Rowdy Richvale'. The winery's philosophy focuses on producing wines with energy, nuance, and a sense of playful fun, designed to be enjoyed casually with friends.

Wine Description

This rosé presents an orange pink appearance and a vibrant, high-energy profile. The nose is aromatically bright, featuring notes of grapefruit, citrus, and a hint of yeast. On the palate, the wine is light to medium bodied, showing crisp flavours of tart cherry, cranberry, and watermelon. It is crafted with a focus on freshness and balance, leading to a clean and lively finish that emphasizes its 'poolside-ready' style.

Food Pairing

The wine's rich and fruity style makes it an excellent match for spicy dishes, light appetizers, and fresh snacks. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled poultry, such as chicken or turkey, as well as fruit-based desserts.

title: Chateau de Montifaud 'Heritage Louis Vallet' 50 Year Old Cognac
bodyHtml:
A highly traditional Cognac estate that has been in the same family for six generations. Montifaud has a little over 300 acres of vineyard, spanning the Grande Champagne and Petite Champagne premier crus, widely considered the two finest growing regions. 

This is a simply staggering Cognac that demonstrates the very best of this distillery, made using some of the oldest stocks in their reserves, distilled between 1956 to 1963. None of the spirit in this blend is anything less than 50 years old. These distillates have been aged in the house’s cool, dry cellar, where they have slowly developed a fantastic complexity. This Cognac is produced from 80% Ugni Blanc grape with the remaining 20% made up of Colombard and Folle Blanche varieties. On the nose this is a rich, intense and decadent Cognac, with powerful oak, dried fruit and nutty aromas, a little rancio and espresso, and some chocolate dusted crème caramels. The palate is rich with dried apricot and prunes, dusty oak panelling, strong grape flavour. A cigar smoke emerges after a while, accompanied by chewy toffee and bright vanilla. The finish is long and smooth, with a buttery yet drying oak note that lasts and lasts. A beautiful Cognac.

title: Yoshi No Gawa Minamo Sousai Junmai - 720 ml Bottle
bodyHtml:
Yoshi No Gawa Minamo Sousai Junmai is a contemporary expression from the historic Yoshi No Gawa brewery in Nagaoka, Niigata. As the oldest brewery in the region (est. 1548), they launched the "Minamo" series to showcase a "reinterpretation of Niigata style"—moving slightly away from the traditional bone-dry profile toward a more expressive, aromatic, and food-friendly character. The name "Sousai" translates to "vibrant colors," reflecting the multi-layered flavor profile of this specific Junmai.

Description

This sake is crafted to be a high-quality "all-rounder" that bridges the gap between traditional Junmai richness and Ginjo-like aromatics.

  • Aroma: It features an inviting nose of ripe yellow peach, white flowers, and a subtle hint of steamed rice.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a smooth, velvety texture. It offers a gentle sweetness reminiscent of nectarines and honey, balanced by a soft acidity that prevents it from feeling heavy.

  • Technical Profile: Brewed with local Niigata Gohyaku Mangoku rice polished to 65%, it has an alcohol content of 15%. Unlike the flagship Yoshi No Gawa labels, this bottling emphasizes a more succulent, juicy mouthfeel.

Food Pairing

The "Sousai" Junmai is specifically engineered to be a "食中酒" (shokuchushu), or sake enjoyed during a meal. Its balance of fruitiness and acidity allows it to pair with a surprisingly wide range of flavors.

  • Japanese Cuisine: Pairs naturally with vegetable tempura, grilled chicken yakitori with tare (sweet soy sauce), and slightly richer sushi like unagi (eel).

  • Western Fare: The stone fruit notes and smooth body make it an excellent companion for roast pork with apples, herb-crusted chicken, or a classic Caesar salad.

  • Cheese: It is particularly delightful with semi-soft cheeses like Gouda or Havarti, where the sake’s rice-derived umami complements the dairy.

Serving Temperature: While it is excellent chilled (8°C–12°C), its Junmai character allows it to be enjoyed at room temperature, which brings out more of the honeyed rice notes.

title: Saint K Flower Bomb White 2022
bodyHtml:
The nose hits with tart green apple, honeydew and orange blossom. On the palate... lime sorbet, baked apple and smashed rosemary.

It’s tasting great now, but will continue to improve over the next 6-8years.

title: Remirez de Ganuza Tasnocho 2016
bodyHtml:
Sourced from a selection of the best grapes from vines stocks with an average age of 60 years. The 50 ha. of vineyards are located in different plots around four villages in the Rioja Alavesa: Samaniego, Leza, Elciego and Laguarda. Harvested manually and followed by a careful sorting of the grapes at the winery.

Intense nose with layers of liquorice, cherries, blackberries, spices with smooth creamy oak notes.  On the palate good concentration of cherry fruit, soft entry showing a silky texture  with some fairly serious tannins but well integrated. Long creamy aftertaste.

title: Richvale 'I Love Pizza' Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
Richvale Wine Co., based in California's Central Coast, is known for crafting playful and approachable wines that celebrate the joy of casual gatherings. Their offerings, such as the "I Love Pizza" Red Blend, are designed to complement everyday moments with friends and family.

The 2022 "I Love Pizza" Red Blend is a harmonious mix of 59% Dolcetto, 26% Mataro (Mourvèdre), and 15% Counoise. This full-bodied red wine presents dark fruit aromas on the nose, leading to a juicy texture on the palate. The blend offers a rich and intense profile, making it an excellent companion for a variety of dishes. 

Optimal Drinking Window: This wine is crafted for immediate enjoyment and is best consumed within 1-2 years of its vintage to fully appreciate its fresh and vibrant flavors.

Food Pairing Suggestions: As the name suggests, this red blend pairs exceptionally well with pizza, enhancing the flavors of both the wine and the dish. It also complements grilled meats, pasta with red sauces, and a variety of cheeses.

title: Saint K Black Cat Bone Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Nose: Cranberry Raisin Pie, Torched kumquat, gingerbreard, damp earth, wintergreen, and new furniture.

Palate: Light mushroom soy sauce, cardamom, marjoram dried herb. Tart cherry, orange blossom tea, lamb’s blood

title: Kojima Sohonten Toko Karakuchi Junmai Daiginjo - 720 ml Bottle
bodyHtml:
Produced by Kojima Sohonten, a historic brewery founded in 1597 that served as the official purveyor to the powerful Uesugi clan. The brewery recently transitioned to an all-Junmai facility, removing all added distilled alcohol from its production to focus on the pure expression of rice and water. The "Toko" brand name translates to "Eastern Light". This specific Karakuchi expression is designed to be crystal clear and exceptionally dry, standing out even among other premium dry sakes.

Description

This Junmai Daiginjo is characterized by its crystalline clarity and a slight hardness that highlights its refreshing nature. On the nose, it offers a joyful and fragrant bouquet reminiscent of young melons. The palate is lean and racy, delivering a sharp, clean taste with a smooth, dry finish that avoids a heavy lingering aftertaste. It is brewed using Dewakirari rice, a variety developed in Yamagata specifically for its ability to produce clean, sharp flavors. The rice is polished to 50%, the standard for the Daiginjo grade, to ensure a refined and elegant profile. ABV 15%, SMV +6 (Dry).

Food Pairing

The "Karakuchi" (extra dry) style of this sake makes it a superb palate cleanser and an ideal companion for a broad range of meals. Its crispness and melon notes pair perfectly with fresh seafood, particularly sushi, sashimi, and lightly grilled fish. Because it lacks heavy umami, it also works well with lighter Western dishes like salads with citrus dressings, vegetable tempura, or mild creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert. It is best served well-chilled (around 5–10°C) in a white wine glass to help focus its delicate fruit aromas while maintaining its sharp, refreshing edge.

title: Kojima Sohonten Toko Junmai - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Kojima Sohonten Toko Junmai originates from Yonezawa City in the Yamagata Prefecture of Japan. Founded in 1597, Kojima Sohonten is one of the oldest active breweries in Japan, having served as the official sake purveyor to the Uesugi clan, the powerful lords of the Yonezawa domain. The brand name "Toko" translates to "Eastern Light," a name given to the brewery's flagship shop over four centuries ago.

Description

This Junmai is a "classic" style that represents the snowy, high-quality terroir of Yamagata. It is brewed using 100% Haenuki rice, a local variety primarily grown for food but prized in brewing for its clean, stable fermentation profile.

  • Aroma: It presents a gentle and clean nose with notes of steamed rice, white floral blossoms, and a subtle hint of banana.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a soft, round mouthfeel. It features a well-balanced umami profile with flavors of soft melon and marshmallow, transitioning into a crisp acidity.

  • Technical Profile: The rice is polished to 60%, which technically qualifies it for Ginjo grade, but the brewery labels it as a Junmai to emphasize its rice-forward depth. It has an alcohol content of 15% and a Sake Meter Value (SMV) of +3, indicating a gentle dryness.

Food Pairing

Because this sake strikes a balance between rice-derived umami and a clean finish, it is an exceptionally versatile companion for a wide variety of meals.

  • Traditional Japanese: Pairs perfectly with grilled mackerel (saba), vegetable tempura, and simple nigiri sushi.

  • Hearty Fare: The rice-forward profile stands up well to warm dishes like chicken sukiyaki, oden, or savory dumplings.

  • Western Pairings: Its soft acidity makes it a great match for roasted chicken with herbs or a creamy mushroom risotto.

  • Serving Temperature: This is a highly adaptable sake. While refreshing when chilled (10°C), it is particularly famous for its beauty when served at room temperature or gently warmed (40°C), which unlocks a deeper sweetness and a creamier texture.

title: James Gin Asian Parsnip: Navy Strength
bodyHtml:
This has the same spiced & subtly sweet flavour as our award-winning Asian Parsnip gin but with an extra kick of 57% alcohol.

An American customer asked when we were going to make a Navy Strength version of Asian Parsnip. We didn’t know what he meant, so we looked up the history of Navy Strength Gin. With no help at all from the Royal Navy, we created Asian Parsnip at 57% ABV - the same taste profile as Asian Parsnip but now with the added benefit of helping us defeat the French.

title: James Gin London Drizzle
bodyHtml:
Since most gins are designated ‘London Dry’ - and London generally isn’t, James came up with the idea of making one that evoked ‘the smell of rain on a hot pavement in Regent’s Park.’ That distinctive scent that hangs in the air, just as those first drops of rain hit the ground on a summer day, is called ‘petrichor’.

One of the key components of petrichor is also present in beetroot - so we’ve combined that with lovage, bay, orange, and ginger to create a gin designed to instantly invoke the majesty of our Sceptered Isle.

As Samuel Pepys may have observed: “Ye Aprile raine falling pon the hot paving seemed drearisome, but gave off so fweet a fmell that my hearte was greatly uplifted, and I thought unto myfelf that ‘twould one daye make for an bangyng gyn.’

title: Beefeater Pink Gin
