bodyHtml: A vibrant new Pink Gin made using the original Beefeater London Dry Recipe with the addition of Natural Strawberry flavouring to give it a vibrant and delicious strawberry taste.

title: Paquera Mezcal Joven 100% Maguey Espadin
bodyHtml:
Produced by a CO-OP in San Miguel Ejutla, Paquera is an award-winning mezcal that was created from methods perfected over generations of dedicated family artisans.

Earthy, smokey nose; silky and earthy with vegetal flavors and some sweet vanilla notes; smooth and lush, balanced and long.

title: Ken Wright Pinot Noir Bonnie Jean 2022
bodyHtml: This elegant Pinot shows definition and detail, with expressive cherry and red currant flavours that are laced with black tea and cocoa. Finishes with medium-grained tannins.

title: Beaulieu Vineyards Tapestry Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
Tapestry Red Blend bursts with aromas of ripe blueberry and blackberry with hints of sage, lavender, and cedar. 

Rich and smooth on the palate and balanced by structured tannins and fresh acidity, enjoy Tapestry with pasta, cheese, red meats... or any time you’re celebrating with friends and loved ones.

title: Banff Ave White Wit - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
White Wit is the flagship Belgian-style wheat ale from Banff Ave Brewing Co., located in the heart of the Banff townsite. As a sister brewery to Jasper Brewing Co., Banff Ave is known for creating approachable, high-quality beers that cater to both international tourists and rugged locals. This Witbier (literally "white beer") is their most popular offering, designed to be an incredibly refreshing, citrus-forward alternative to the heavy stouts and bitter IPAs often found in mountain towns.

Beer Description

White Wit pours a hazy, pale straw-yellow with a thick, moussy white head and a soft, luminous glow—a result of being unfiltered.

Aroma: The nose is bright, spicy, and aromatic. It leads with a dominant scent of sweet orange peel and fresh coriander, followed by a faint, "clove-like" spiciness from the Belgian yeast. You will also find a soft, bready aroma from the large portion of unmalted wheat used in the grain bill.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a creamy, "fluffy" mouthfeel that feels substantial yet light. It leads with flavors of tangerine and lemon zest, followed by a delicate herbal spiciness. The bitterness is almost non-existent; instead, the beer relies on its high carbonation and a slight "yeasty" tang to provide a clean, refreshing finish.

Profile: It sits at a sessionable 5.0% ABV and a very low 10 IBU, making it the ultimate thirst-quencher.

Technical Notes: This beer follows the traditional Belgian Witbier blueprint. It is brewed with a significant amount of unmalted wheat and oats, which provide the signature cloudiness and silky texture. It is spiced during the boil with bitter orange peel and crushed coriander seeds. A specific Belgian ale yeast is used to produce the subtle spicy and fruity esters that define the style, and the beer is served unfiltered to keep all those complex flavors intact.

title: Plantation XO 20th Anniversary Rum - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
To honor Alexandre Gabriel’s 20th anniversary as Master Blender, Plantation Rum created Plantation XO 20th Anniversary using a blend of quintessential extra-old rums from Barbados.

First aged in bourbon casks in Barbados for many years, this rum is then sailed across the ocean in barrels to the southwest of France to be further matured in small Ferrand French oak casks.

This centuries-old “double ageing“ process imparts incredible smoothness and complexity. It unveils a sophisticated palate of chocolate, vanilla, ripe banana, roasted coconut and a hint of fresh mango notes. With a remarkably long finish, Plantation XO 20th Anniversary is truly a rum to savor.

title: Ken Wright Pinot Noir Yamhill Carlton 2022
bodyHtml: Ken Wright Cellars Pinot Noir produced from this region displays savory spicy and floral qualities and a lush textural palate. Tart cherry andbramble fruits mingle with spice notes of cinnamon, clove, and cola.  Elegant and focused on the palate with a balanced structure on the finish.

title: Tissot Arbois 'DD' Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
From Stephane Tissot's Biodynamic vineyard in Arbois, named for Stephane's father, Andre "DD" Tissot. Macerated 1-3 months, primarily in large wooden vats. Unfined and unfiltered, with no added sulfites. 

Ripe, fresh fruit and warm spices. The palate is precise, full and sapid. The tannins are present, young and provide a nice tactile sensation for a long finish. 

This is a delicious blend of Trousseau, Poulsard, and Pinot Noir co-fermented. Serve slightly chilled and enjoy with a variety of cheeses, roasted chicken, or on its own.

title: Rivo Gin
bodyHtml: This gin is foraged from the mountains in Lake Como and the ideology of these spirit makers is to take and give to the land which has already won over six awards. The small batch production is done with love and craftsmanship. This spectacular gin is made with no sugars, no additives and no artificial ingredients.

title: Blue Chair Bay Mocha Rum Cream
bodyHtml: Explore the indulgent side of the Caribbean with this Blue Chair Bay Mocha Rum Cream. Drink the decadent, smooth blend of robust coffee paired with a rich, luxurious chocolate that carries coconut and spices in a light, elegant way. Whether it's a spiked coffee or straight on the rocks, Blue Chair Bay Mocha Rum Cream will enthrall your senses.

title: Il Poggione Sant'Antimo Vin Santo Riserva 2010
bodyHtml:
Il Poggione was one of the first wineries to market the Brunello di Montalcino wine as early as the 1900’s, and one of the founding members of the Brunello di Montalcino Consortium.

After more than a Century, Lavinio Franceschi’s work is still a fundamental point of reference for his successors, Leopoldo and Livia, who continue to develop the business with that same dedication and unrelenting passion, combining the ancient skills of winemaking crafts and tradition with the latest, most innovative techniques.

Typical traditional Tuscan wine produced from Trebbiano and Malvasia grapes, harvested, then dried on straw mats in the old traditional way, in order to increase the sugar concentration.  After pressing, fermentation and slow aging take place in Caratelli, 100 litre (27 US Gallons) barrels, on the “madre”, a compound of yeasts and bacteria kept from year to year, which has a significant effect on the characteristics of the Vin Santo.

Amber in colour, intense bouquet with notes of dried apricot, bitter almond and honey. Neither too sweet nor too dry, its good acidity make it a versatile wine to accompany many kinds of food.

title: Stoller Dundee Hills Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
Located in the heart of Oregon's Willamette Valley in the Dundee Hills AVA, Stoller uniquely offers world class wines and genuine hospitality in a stunning setting. 

This wine opens with ample aromas of wet stone and lemon tart. Firm vibrancy braces the palate, conveying tension alongside satisfying flavors of persimmon and starfruit. The finish is clean and taut with fading plusher fruit flavors lingering on the palate. Though intriguing now, this wine should unravel in complexity for years to come.

90 Points - Wine & Spirits

By turns juicy and crisp, this youthful chardonnay leads with scents of apple fritters and pear; the fruit smells glazed and rich, only to firm up with brisk acids.

title: Plantation 5 Year Reserve Amber Rum
bodyHtml:
Plantation 5 Year is distilled in Barbados, where it is aged in ex-bourbon barrels for three to four years before being shipped to France to age for another one to two years in Ferrand Cognac casks.

The result is a subtle and tropical Barbadian-style rum, excellent for aperitifs or classic cocktails like the Mai Tai.

title: Jack Daniel's - 375 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Set up in 1866, Jack Daniel's became the US's first registered distillery, it soon became a legendary American whiskey. Shows aromas and flavours of caramel, vanilla, nut and oak with smoky tones. The palate is smooth and sweet with light spicy finish. Serve neat or use in a cocktail.

title: Meiomi Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
With its deep ruby color, Meiomi Cabernet Sauvignon opens with expressive aromas of blackberry, boysenberry, and bramble, along with notes of toasty vanilla and graham cracker. This wine owes much of its complexity to a blend of premium grapes harvested from California’s most notable winegrowing regions. 

Made in the unique Meiomi style, this fruit-forward, delicious red wine gracefully unifies each of its respective appellations, with flavors of black currant, minty herbs, ripe blackberry, raspberry, boysenberry, and other dark red, jammy fruits. The full flavors of this multifaceted Cabernet wine are highlighted by a plush, velvety mouthfeel that leads to a long finish.

title: Penderyn Icons of Wales No. 11 - Patagonia
bodyHtml:
On the 28th July 1865, 153 people embarked on the Mimosa, sailing for Patagonia to establish a Welsh colony and preserve their language and culture. Times were difficult, but today Patagonia has 50,000 Welsh descendants, 5000 Welsh speakers and holds annual Eisteddfodau. ‘Little Wales beyond Wales…’

Penderyn Patagonia is produced by marrying Penderyn's single malt whisky with that of La Alazana Distillery in Patagonia. This is #11 in the Icons of Wales series of bottlings, celebrating a significant person, milestone or event from Wales. It is bottled at 43% abv.

Sweet, floral and perfumed on the nose. Orchard fruits – green apples and sweet pears – vanilla, a light aroma of honey and caramel. The palate is nicely balanced. Sweet honey, apple tart and juicy pears with vanilla and light oaky notes. A mix of spices: cinnamon, peppers and a hint of cloves, together with almonds and creamy toffee. Dried fruits lingering with sweet spice at the end.

title: Dusted Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: This medium bodied wine is both lithe and expressive, with embracing tannins wrapping gently around a focused core of dried  herb-accented black cherry and licorice flavors, dancing with finesse on the finish.

title: Chiusa Grande Vinosophia Montepulciano D'Abruzzo 2024
bodyHtml:
The Abruzzo’s classic red. Montepulciano is an under-appreciated workhorse (in fact the second most planted red variety in Italy!). Chiusa Grande delivers accurate and delicious wines that exemplify the ideals of natural balance and respect for tradition.

This bottling is an example of how a low intervention, unencumbered wine can be crowd pleasing, instantly crushable, and available at a great price. Black cherry, plum skins, third-wave coffee, and a hint of tobacco make this a terrific pairing for meaty pizzas, lasagna, or even burgers.

title: Fukumitsuya 'Tradition' Junmai Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Fukumitsuya Sake Brewery, the oldest brewery in Kanazawa founded in 1625, this sake is often labeled under the Fukumasamune brand name. Fukumitsuya is a dedicated junmai-only brewery that transitioned away from adding distilled alcohol in 2001 to focus on the purity of rice and water. The brewery uses Hyakunensui (100-Year Water), which is mineral-rich spring water that takes a century to filter from Mt. Hakusan down to the brewery's wells.

Description

This sake is well-structured and highly fragrant, designed to be an approachable and easy-drinking expression of the brewery's heritage. On the nose, it offers a pleasant aroma that precedes a palate balancing elegant sweetness with a bright acidity. It is characterized by its clean finish, which leaves subtle nutty notes and a refined aftertaste. Because it is a junmai, it is crafted using only rice, water, and koji, highlighting the natural umami of the grain. ABV 13%–13.7%.

Food Pairing

Tradition Junmai is a versatile accompaniment to a wide variety of cuisines thanks to its balanced structure. It pairs excellently with classic Japanese dishes like sashimi and tempura, but its subtle nuttiness and acidity also make it a great match for Western fare, including roasted poultry or lightly seasoned pasta. It is a reliable choice for pairing with fermented foods, which mirror the brewery's own expertise in rice fermentation. This sake can be enjoyed across a broad temperature range: serve it chilled to emphasize its fragrance, at room temperature for balance, or gently warmed to bring out its mellow sweetness.

title: Jinro Makguli 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Jinro Makguli is a traditional Korean rice wine originating from South Korea. Produced by HiteJinro, a brewery with a history spanning over 100 years, this beverage is crafted using 100% Korean rice and pure spring water. It is made without preservatives or artificial flavours, employing traditional artistry to create a beverage often regarded as one of the best-tasting rice wines globally.

Description

This makgeolli (or makguli) features a milky white, opaque appearance due to being loosely filtered, which retains fine rice particles. It offers a sweet and sour sensory profile with distinct aromas of rice and faint oatsy, chalky notes. On the palate, it is delicate and extremely smooth with a thicker mouthfeel compared to typical pasteurized brews, though it remains easy to drink. The beverage has an alcohol by volume of 6% and a sugar content of approximately 2.3 g/L.

Food Pairing

Jinro Makguli is traditionally served chilled and pairs exceptionally well with 'jeon', which are Korean fried pancakes or fritters, as the creaminess of the wine balances the richness of the oil. Its bright profile also complements spicy marinated meats, pork belly, and savory dishes like braised lamb shanks or five-cheese quiche. For a lighter pairing, it can be enjoyed with a Hawaiian-style chicken salad or a refreshing cucumber and orange raita.

title: Martedi Rosso Vigneti Tardis 2020
bodyHtml:
The vineyards in Acciaroli and Casal Velino Vigneti Tardis celebrate ancient local varieties.

Their wines are made with a light touch and low intervention throughout the process. A mixture of stainless steel and old unseasoned oak is used for fermentation and aging.

The wine is juicy, young, fruit forward with low tannins, and best served a little chilled. Delicate notes of mulberries, bright floral and savoury.

title: Poggio Torselli Bizzarria Rosso Toscana 2022
bodyHtml:
Bizzarria Rosso is bright ruby red in colour, with lively highlights and clear violet reflections.

The nose, elegant and clean, is dominated by the most typical fruit of Sangiovese with notes of strawberry, black cherry and balsamic hints.  It features striking freshness and integrity of the fruit, straight and "vinous".

In the mouth the wine is surprising for its great cleanliness and simplicity of drinking, further evolving into a more mineral taste and a bitter finish recalling dark chocolate and spices.

title: Grounded Wine Co. Collusion Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml:
Collusion Cabernet has nothing to hide! Dark as night, this red evokes notes of red currants and sweet tobacco, wrapped around a core of plum, red berry, and silky-smooth tannins.

Pour it behind closed doors alongside nicely-salted grilled New York Strips.

title: Tesseron XO Lot No. 29 Exception Cognac
bodyHtml:
The Tesseron Lot No 29 Exception is a well-aged blend, truly worthy of its name. A unique XO, made up of Grande Champagne eaux-de-vie - this Cognac’s maturation process has passed through at least three generations of the Tesseron family who have dedicated their passion and love for Cognac through the family business. With fresh and floral fragrances, Lot No 29 unveils velvety aromas of mocha chocolate alongside dried fruit and hints of honey. Its prevailing rancio is characterized by the decades spent in old oak barrels - a true jewel of the Grande Champagne cru.

The colour of lustrous topaz with a heady nose that is decadent with layers of honey, figs, plums & exotic fruit laced with oak. Sumptuous and silky, this Cognac retains freshness and vitality.

Supremely elegant on the palate, combining dried fruit with hints of mocha and cocoa, refreshed by floral aromatics. Extremely well balanced and complex, with marmalade notes emerging on a persistent finish.

title: Colome Malbec 'Autentico' 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Colome 'Autentico' is a red wine from Argentina, specifically the Calchaquí Valleys in the Salta region. Bodega Colome is the oldest working winery in Argentina, originally opened in 1831. The winery pays tribute to its pioneers who planted the original vineyards, and the fruit for 'Autentico' comes from their best single vineyard at 2,300 metres above sea level. This high altitude, combined with a large diurnal temperature swing, is key to the winemaking philosophy, as it produces grapes with thicker, darker skins and helps retain a natural, fresh acidity. The winery uses sustainable farming practices to achieve the 'authentic' expression of the terroir.

Wine Description

The wine is a pure, unoaked, single-vineyard expression of 100 percent Malbec. It is made in an old winemaking style using ancient techniques such as pigeage (punch down) and has no oak influence to retain freshness and purity of fruit. The wine is intense in colour, often displaying violet hues. It offers a complex bouquet of aromas like red cherries, blackberries, and figs, intertwined with notes of clove, elegant spice, and minerals. The palate is crisp and robust with concentrated, ripe, round tannins and a very good, lively acidity that provides structure and balance. The style is full-bodied and concentrated, with a long-lasting, pure fruit finish. The wine is aged for 10 months in tank and concrete egg, followed by 10 months in bottle. The Alcohol By Volume (ABV) is 14.5 percent. Bodega Colome's vineyards use sustainable farming practices.

title: Matua Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml:
Matua holds a pivotal place in New Zealand's wine story, as brothers Bill and Ross Spence were the first to produce a New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc in 1974. The winery's name, 'Matua,' means 'head of the family' in te reo Māori, reflecting its foundational role. Their winemaking philosophy, often summed up as 'let the fruit do the talking,' focuses on enhancing the natural character of the grapes.

Wine Description

This classic Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc is deliciously pure, bursting withripe lemon citrus notes and hints of passion fruit and basil. The palate isfresh and vibrant with concentrated blackcurrant leaf and a touch of classiccut grass and green melon. So refreshing, you'll be left wanting more.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with fresh seafood, such as white fish like cod or snapper seasoned with lemon and herbs. Its crisp acidity and herbaceous notes are a perfect match for fresh goat cheese or a green salad with a citrus vinaigrette.

title: Admiral Rodney HMS Princessa Rum
bodyHtml:
HMS Princessa was originally a Spanish vessel captured by the British in 1780 at the battle of Cape St. Vincent. Captained by Charles Knatchbull with Rear Admiral Francis Samuel Drake abroad, this 70 gun ship of the line was one of the first ships to engage the French in the Battle of the Saints. Fighting valiantly, the Princessa engaged the enemy throughout the battle and inspired us to create this rum that embodies power and integrity.
 
Deep mahogany colour with honeyed raisins on the nose and a hint of vanilla and tobacco. Sweet with intense brown sugar, creme brulee tones balanced by dry toasty oak. Complex finish with good oak integration, caramel, and tropical spice.

title: El Enemigo Bonarda 'La Esperanza' 2022
bodyHtml:
El Enemigo Bonarda 'La Esperanza' is a red wine from Mendoza, Argentina. Crafted exclusively from Bonarda grapes, this single-vineyard expression showcases the unique terroir of the La Esperanza vineyard and the meticulous winemaking of El Enemigo.

Vineyard and Production

Sourced from the La Esperanza vineyard in San Martín, Mendoza, the vines are over 80 years old, planted in deep sandy and clay soils. Traditional vinification methods were employed, including fermentation with wild yeasts over 15 days at controlled temperatures, followed by a 25-day maceration period. The wine was then aged for 12 months in 100-year-old foudres, contributing to its complexity and elegance.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Brilliant hue, denoting youth and freshness.

  • Aroma: Enticing notes of pink peppercorns and a hint of roses.

  • Palate: Well-structured with rich, ripe black fruit flavors and hints of herbs. The palate is balanced by good acidity, leading to a tasty finish.

Serving and Pairing

To fully appreciate its complexity, serve this Bonarda at 16-18°C (61-64°F). It pairs exceptionally well with a variety of dishes, including grilled meats, pasta, and cheeses. Its balanced acidity and rich fruit profile make it a versatile companion for both casual and fine dining.

title: Jura 10 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
bodyHtml:
A smooth all-rounder for the modern drinker; gentle spice and sherry sweetness.

Crafted in exceptionally tall stills and matured for 10 years in America White Oak ex bourbon barrels. The finishing touch is a finish in the finest aged Oloroso Sherry casks from Jerez, Spain. A sweet, smooth whisky with flavours of rich dark chocolate and vanilla cream throughout.

title: Jura 12 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
bodyHtml: The core of the Jura range, aged for 12 years in bourbon casks and then finished in Oloroso sherry. The result blends the distillery's characteristic gently smoky character with sweetness, spice and dark fruit. A great introduction to Jura.

title: Shinobu 15 Year Old Pure Malt Dragon Edition
bodyHtml:
Selected with only the finest malt whiskies uniquely chosen to celebrate the Year of the Dragon. Aged more than 15 years in Sherry and Bourbon casks.  Finished in Mizunara oak barrels, adding an unparalleled oriental elegance to this special edition spirit.

All-natural ingredients and without coloring and other additives. A true expression of fine craftsmanship.

A 2020 World Whisky Awards Category Winner. The Shinobu Dragon Year edition is a testament to its distinguished taste and quality.

Fresh oak, vanilla, and floral notes, with a subtle touch of sandalwood on the nose.   On the palate is a refined mix of ripe fruits and lemon zest, with hints of leather and a blend of cinnamon and ginger.  The finish is long, rich finish with oak and fruity undertones, lightly accented by sandalwood.

title: Mayenda Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Mayenda Tequila Blanco is a rich, complex and elegant ultra-premium sipping tequila made using a pioneering process, which adds two extra steps of craft and care to extract flavors from the heart of the agave. Crafted at Casa San Nicolas, in Arandas, Jalisco by Maestro Tequilero, Jesus Susunaga and his team, each bottle of this small-batch high-end tequila is produced with the aim of capturing the aromatic, caramelized agave notes that are typically lost in the production process. The result is a unique, agave-forward sipping experience with new and unexplored flavors from the agave.

This ultra-premium tequila offers aromas of honey, cinnamon, and orange blossom, followed by caramelized agave notes on the palate, with notes of citrus, honey, and baking spices at the finish. Mayenda Tequila Blanco is best enjoyed at room temperature as a neat serve.

title: Atanasio 'Origenes' Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Immerse yourself in the purity of Atanasio Origenes Blanco Tequila. With its crystal-clear appearance, it promises an unparalleled sensory experience from the moment you lay eyes on it. Each sip reveals a symphony of flavors, meticulously distilled from the finest blue agave plants cultivated in the sun-kissed fields of Jalisco.

Atanasio Orígenes Espíritu Fuerte Blanco Tequila is a premium Mexican spirit made with 100% agave. It has a smoky, earthy aroma with a hint of citrus, and a smooth, full-bodied flavor with notes of pepper, vanilla, and caramel. The finish is warm and oaky, with a delicate hint of sweetness. It is perfect for sipping neat or in traditional cocktails such as the Margarita, Paloma, or Tequila Sunrise.

title: Atanasio 'Beso de Amor' Tequila Blanco
bodyHtml:
Experience your first encounter with Tequila Atanasio like a tender 'love kiss' (Beso de Amor) – smooth and intense. With a perfectly balanced profile at 37% ABV, this Blanco tequila is crafted for beginners; it is soft but maintains all the authentic flavours of blue agave.

Visuals: Glistening platinum flashes with a light-density body.

Aroma: Herbaceous with distinct agave notes, sweet citrus hints, and a touch of mint.

Taste: Gentle on the palate, confirming the citrus notes from the aroma, concluding with a sweet aftertaste and a subtle mineral sensation.

title: Bacardi White Rum - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Aged for a minimum of 1 year in charred American oak this classic bar essential offers subtle aromas with hints of citrus, vanilla and herbal elements over a spirity foundation; dry on the palate, light to medium bodied, delicately flavoured with light vanilla tones, hints of pepper and spice leading to a dry, clean finish.

title: Max Ferdinand Richter Riesling Spatlese Veldenzer Elisenberg 2022
Ink Grade Andosol Red Blend 2017
bodyHtml:
The estate on Howell Mountain is no ordinary vineyard. Planted to nurture rather than disrupt the ecosystem that has thrived there for centuries, the Ink Grade is at once lush and rugged, idyllic and unforgiving. This dynamic balance is expressed in every bottle.

Andosol draws inspiration from the historic field blends of California. The inherent stress the rugged site lends to grape growing will saturate the grapes with intensity and depth. An elegant example of this historic varietal, Andosol is a reflection of all that Ink Grade has to offer, a wine polished and bold.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend that can change from vintage to vintage, the 2017 Andosol is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Zinfandel. While the nose is marked by scents of redcurrants and gentle herbal shadings, the palate is full-bodied but taut and juicy, with silky but firm tannins and ample length.

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blueberries, plums, dried oregano, earth, tar and peppercorns. Medium-bodied with fine tannins and lively acidity. Vibrant and juicy with a crunchy finish.

title: Ink Grade Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley 2019
bodyHtml:
The estate on Howell Mountain is no ordinary vineyard. Planted to nurture rather than disrupt the ecosystem that has thrived there for centuries, the Ink Grade is at once lush and rugged, idyllic and unforgiving. This dynamic balance is expressed in every bottle.

The Ink Grade Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon opens with a nose of fresh cassis, pomegranate, and cocoa with elements of thyme, mint, candied orange peels, nutmeg, cloves, and paprika. The palate is linear throughout with a consistent midpalate of bright and lifted acidity and well-integrated raw mountain tannins that close in a persistent finish.

94 Points - James Suckling

So much pine needle, flowers, currants and ripe plums on the nose. Medium-bodied with fine and polished tannins. Linear and very tight with a clarity and energy. Vivid is the word. 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This classic style of Cabernet shows great balance, a snug structure and complex flavors that range from black cherry to black olive to sage and cedar. Moderate tannins and good acidity add to a slightly grippy and appetizing texture.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Expressive, with bramble and black licorice notes leading off, followed quickly by fresh black cherry and currant preserves. Features flashes of bay leaf and mesquite on the sleek finish, with a strong mineral underpinning as well.

91+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Marked by black cherries and cassis aromas, the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon is a fairly muscular effort—not that it's big or bulky, but it shows plenty of tannic depth and a crisply acidic spine.

title: Gallica Cabernet Sauvignon Oakville 2019
bodyHtml:
Racy and saturated with hints of blackberry pie and forest floor, Gallica Cabernet Sauvignon wears the mantle of Napa Valley at its core with the best of Oakville’s high tone personality. Youthful and luminous, with bold fruit accentuated by juicy and round tannins. Bright and lovely, It can be admired while young but will enjoy a long life with further cellaring.

96+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon, which includes 3% Cabernet Franc and is all from the Oakville Ranch Vineyard, is top notch stuff and certainly plays with the best in the vintage. Beautiful black fruits, crushed stone, spicy oak, and floral notes define the bouquet, and it’s medium to full-bodied, with ripe yet certainly present tannins and one heck of a great finish.

95+ Points - Vinous

The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon is shaping up be another jewel of a wine from Rosemary Cakebread. Ample and explosive, the Cabernet shows all of the natural richness of the vintage in spades. 

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

92 Points - James Suckling

title: Varnier Fanniere Esprit de Craie Extra Brut (NV)
bodyHtml:
The NV Extra Brut Esprit de Craie is 100% Chardonnay from Avize, Oger and Grauves.

Brisk and vibrant in the glass, (it) offers up plenty of citrus, floral and mineral character.

title: Domaine Zind Humbrecht Riesling Roche Roulee 2021
bodyHtml: Pale straw yellow colour. The nose is bright and reveals a beautiful panoply of fruity aromas as well as lime blossom. This early character and already quite open style is also found on the palate. The attack on the palate is supple, caressing but firms up on the finish, revealing a ripe and structuring acidity. Beautiful saline finish that lingers on with an attractive fruity profile.

title: Luce Lux Vitis 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Luce Lux Vitis 2019 has a ruby red color. The nose is striking for its great complexity: notes of red and black fruit mingle, accompanied by elegant nuances of vanilla, dried flowers, and hints of Mediterranean herbs. The palate is vibrant, with powerful and silky tannins, rich and elegant that give the wine liveliness and a very long gustatory persistence; a Lux Vitis of great longevity.

94 Points - Robert Parker's wine Advocate

The Tenuta Luce 2019 Lux Vitis opens to an inky dark appearance with pressed blackberry, sweet cinnamon and cumin. There is some oak astringency on the tannins that will relax in time. Otherwise, this is a richly textured and concentrated red wine to drink on a cold winter evening by an open fire. The wine is almost full-bodied, but it actually feels more streamlined on the close.

94 Points - James Suckling

A rich and layered cabernet sauvignon with juicy fruit and lots of currant and berry aromas, as well as hints of spices. Full-bodied and flavorful with freshness and brightness at the end.

title: Ely by Callaway Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: Aromas of blackberry jam, ripe cherry and cassis, with hints of dark chocolate and vanilla. Medium-bodied with moderate tannins and a kiss of toasted oak and vanilla flavors.

title: Luce Della Vite 2017 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Luce was the first wine from Montalcino made by blending Sangiovese and Merlot grapes. It was thanks to the collaboration of the Marchesi de’ Frescobaldi and the Robert Mondavi Families that came the idea of matching the roundness and softness of Merlot, whose vineyards were planted in these plots since the 1970s, with the elegance and structure of Sangiovese.

97 Points - James Suckling     

Dark berry, walnut, cedar and violet aromas with just a hint of chocolate. Full-bodied, layered and rich with ripe tannins and a vivid finish. Shows energy and a velvety texture. Deep and long.

title: Giroux Pouilly Fuisse Premier Cru 'Les Vignes Blanches' 2021
bodyHtml:
France, Burgundy, Mâconnais, Pouilly-Fuissé.
Domaine Giroux is a family-owned estate rooted in the heart of southern Burgundy, producing fine wines that reflect the distinct terroir of the region. With a legacy of traditional viticulture and a commitment to sustainable practices, the estate has become known for crafting elegant and expressive white Burgundies. ‘Les Vignes Blanches’ is sourced from the newly established Premier Cru vineyards in Pouilly-Fuissé, a recognition of their superior terroir and historic significance.

Wine Description
This Premier Cru Chardonnay displays a radiant pale gold hue with glints of green. The nose is refined and layered, offering aromas of white peach, acacia blossom, toasted almond, and a subtle minerality. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied with a textured mouthfeel, combining ripe orchard fruit with zesty citrus and a chalky, saline character. Balanced acidity and delicate oak integration lead to a long, harmonious finish that reflects both finesse and depth. Crafted from 100% Chardonnay, the wine is best enjoyed from 2024 through 2030, showing potential for further aging.

Accolades
Wine Enthusiast – 93 points.
Decanter – 92 points.

Food Pairing
Pair this expressive white Burgundy with seared scallops, roast chicken with lemon thyme, or creamy mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Luce Brunello di Montalcino 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Luce Brunello shows an intense ruby red color. The nose is complex and fragrant, with notes of ripe red fruit, supported by pleasant sensations of blond tobacco and exotic spices. In the mouth, the wine is harmonious, rich and highly structured, with silky tannins that together with freshness give a very long persistence. A sophisticated and powerful wine.

96 Points - James Suckling

A finely structured and focused Brunello with a complex array of cherries, blackberries, dried roses, bark, licorice and hints of praline. Iodine and oyster shells, too. Medium-to full-bodied with firm, very fine tannins. Beautiful texture and balance. Remains fresh and fine until the end.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

93 Points - Wine Spectator

title: Luce 2021 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Luce originates from the renowned Montalcino region in Tuscany, Italy. The estate, Tenuta Luce, was born in the 1990s from a historic partnership between Marchese Vittorio Frescobaldi and Napa Valley pioneer Robert Mondavi, a collaboration that aimed to combine the structure of Italian Sangiovese with the plushness of American-influenced Merlot.

Wine Description

This wine displays a shimmering ruby red colour. The nose is complex and layered, offering crisp red berry fruit such as redcurrant and pomegranate, interwoven with delicate floral essences and subtle hints of spice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and enveloping; ripe, supple tannins provide a velvety texture that balances a vibrant, fresh mid-palate. The finish is remarkably long and savoury, showing great concentration and elegance.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 97 points

  • Decanter - 95 points

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points

title: Sena Red Blend 2019 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
A deep, bright ruby red color with purple hues, Sena 2019 shows complexity on the nose with red and black fruits aromas and a distinctive freshness. Several layers of aromatics deliver suggestions of pepper, dill and rosemary alongside coffee beans, pastries and vanilla. On the palate Sena shows blueberry pie and cassis cream notes whilst brimming with fresh-picked red and black fruits. Sena 2019 is a very elegant wine, with great structure, complexity and depth – with notable freshness and polished tannins.

Blend: 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 21% Malbec, 15% Carmenere, 4% Petit Verdot

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Seña was produced with a Bordeaux blend of 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 21% Malbec, 15% Carmenere and 4% Petit Verdot with the Chilean character of the high percentage of Carmenere. Most of the volume fermented in stainless steel with some 10% in concrete vats, and the final blend matured for 22 months in French oak barrels, 80% of them new, and 10% in Stockinger vats. It's 13.5% alcohol and has good acidity and freshness, coming through as medium-bodied, elegant and balanced. This is incredibly elegant, subtle and harmonious even at this early stage. It has floral aromas, notes of orange peel, a touch of creamy sweet spices and great freshness. The palate is medium-bodied, seamless and pure, with pungent flavors and a soft texture. It's long, clean, defined and super tasty. I feel this wine is getting better and better by the vintage. The grapes were picked quite early, and that helped to contain the ripeness and seems to have been a great decision. There was also an exception in the Panquehue zone where the Sena vines are, where the summer was cooler than the average, so quite different to many other regions in Chile.

98 Points - James Suckling

Such beautiful aromas of crushed berries, currants, walnuts, allspice and nutmeg follow through to a full body with tight, ultra fine tannins that provide length and intensity. A finish of slightly dried cherries with wet earth, slate and stone. Chewy and fine-grained. A wine with soul and length. Give it time. 

97 Points - Decanter

The twenty-fifth vintage of a wine first made in 1995 by the Mondavi and Chadwick families is one of Francisco Baettig’s best editions yet: 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 21% Malbec, 15% Carmenere and Petit Verdot aged for 22 months in French oak (10% in foudres). The nose offers redcurrant, blackberry, and cherry over a bed of sweet spices, cedar and peppers. Dense core and firm grip, it needs to be decanted or left in the bottle for a while longer.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Boasts vibrant red cherry and berry flavors, which are well-knit and bear a minerally richness. The juicy finish features accents of dried green herbs and is supported by engaging tannins. Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, Carmenere and Petit Verdot.

title: Giroux Pouilly Fuisse 'Les Raidillons' 2021
bodyHtml:
Dry white wine offering a golden colour with emerald.  Very unique bouquet mixing acacia flower and brioche notes. The mouth is complex and rich with a beautiful finish on almonds notes.

From a single vineyard named Les Raidillons made of limestone and clay. 100% Organic (certification on progress since 2019).

Slow pressed followed by a cold fermentation withonly native yeast. Aged in oak barrel (400 liters) during 11 months then in tank for a year. Light filtration just before the bottling (generally beginning of September, in November for this vintage, 2 years after the harvest).

title: Vidal Fleury Cote Rotie 2019
bodyHtml:
A red wine, dry and good for keeping. Appellation of Origin since 1940, it is one of the oldest vineyards in France and present in the Vidal-Fleury range since 1781. This rare, very remarkable wine has fabulous balance. 

On the right bank of the Rhône, Côte-Rotie combines the structure of the Cote Brune with the aromas of the Cote Blonde. It is the northernmost appellation of the Rhone Valley, where the vineyard is located on terraces which can be very narrow.

An intense and very complex nose (fresh fruit followed by violet, pepper and black olive). A palate, on blackcurrant and spices, supple, rich and full of freshness with a very straight persistence in aroma and structure.

Accolades

94 points - Jeb Dunnuck

Moving to the Côte Rôties, the 2019 Côte Rôtie Brune Et Blonde De Vidal-Fleury is terrific, and this is a great vintage for the region. Black raspberries, dried flowers, savory meats, and spice all dominate the bouquet, and it’s medium to full-bodied, has ultra-fine tannins, and a great finish. I suspect this will be a smoking value and keep for 10-12 years

title: Gallica Cabernet Franc Oakville 2018
bodyHtml:
While Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon are often spoken about in the same breath, they could not be more different. We love working with this wonderous varietal from Oakville Ranch Vineyard and the resulting wines. Experience has allowed us a more insightful approach to not only winemaking but matching cooperage type, size, and age to its delicacy. We are blessed with days of ample sunshine and chilling fog in Napa Valley.

Our interpretation of Cabernet Franc straddles the divide between understated elegance, herbal undertones, and California’s signature all with the esprit of low intervention winemaking. Our goal is to pick clusters at ideal ripeness, each berry plump and flavorful.

title: Gallica Grenache Sonoma Valley 2019
bodyHtml: Notes of strawberry ganache, hard candy, and a sensational ruby color with darker savory notes, brown apple skin, and even some road tar.

title: Gallica Cabernet Sauvignon Oakville 2012
bodyHtml:
Cabernet Franc from this rocky site graces the blend with silky tannins, but it’s the floral notes that are so appealing. Aromatically explosive, layers of dark cherry, mandarin peel, savory dried herbs wrapped in the warmth of subtle oak, make this bottling worthy of aging yet approachable today.

95 Points - James Suckling

I love the purity of fruit in this red with dark berry, raspberry and fresh mint character. Full body, firm and silky tannins and a long, stylish finish. Very impressive for the vintage. Drink or hold. Best ever from here.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Far superior to the 2011 is the 2012 Cabernet Sauvignon from an Oakville source. It offers notes of baking spices, cedarwood, forest floor, blackcurrants and toasty barrique.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

title: Beurer Trollinger 2022
bodyHtml:
Clocking in at a delightful 11% ABV, this is the perfect chillable red, but also a wonder with foods of all sorts, from cheese to salads and lighter grilled offerings.

Bright, with a dry finish, with pure fruit and no barnyard or cider notes to speak of.

title: Pago Casa Gran Casa Benasal Tinto 2021
bodyHtml:
The “recent” history of wine at Pago Casa Gran estate began at least 300 years ago. They have preserved an ancient wine cellar from those times in the Casa Benasal building. Manuela Galbis, the founder’s mother, reinitiated wine production at Pago Casa Gran during the 1960’s.

The youngest and most vibrant presentation of Pago Casa Gran’s red blend series, this inky, juicy wine, a blend of  Syrah, Monastrell and Garnacha Tintorera, still holds remarkable freshness with a fleet footed structure. An admirable balance to achieve in this region. Blackberry, crushed violets, gentle tannins, and a refreshing back palate. Lovely and superbly priced juice from this holistic estate!

title: Chiusa Grande 'Vinosophia' Cerasuolo 2023
bodyHtml:
Set among the rolling hills of Abruzzo and surrounded by the Gran Sasso d’Italia and Majella Mountains, at Chiusa Grande Organic Farm Rocco D’Eusanio, his son and grandchildren represent the winemaking tradition of their family, looking towards the future whilst honouring the past.

Many roses in the Adriatic are simply referred to as Cerasuolo, not to be confused with the wine Cerasuolo di Vittoria, both simply meaning, Cherry-like. This vegan-friendly example shows lovely fresh flowers, cherry (of course), as well as a light almond nuttiness and a minty lift. With a fresh palate and seductive mid-weight finish, this is fleshy yet lively, a dangerously quaffable patio wine that begs for Margherita pies or sardines with chimichurri. A bottle full of sunshine and relaxation.

title: Alheit Vineyards 'Fire by Night' 2023
bodyHtml:
The grapes were hand sorted and whole bunch pressed. The juice is very lightly settled with no additions to the raw juice, wild fermentation in cement eggs, foudres, and old barrels of various sizes. Fermentation lasted for about one month. The wine was kept on lees for around 12 months, then rested in tank on fine lees without fining for a further six months prior to bottling. Very simple, careful winemaking.

The wine is bright and bristling. The youthful nose shows some thatchy reduction, fynbos, and green citrus. The pallet is very fine-boned, with a firm pithy structure and mouth-watering acidity.

title: Matt Taylor Komorebi Chardonnay 2019
bodyHtml: This dry white from Sonoma's Komorebi Vineyard sees whole-cluster pressing, fermentation in concrete eggs, and aging in neutral 600L demi-muids for 20 months. This medium-bodied Chardonnay has citrus and apple aromas, with racy acidity. Pair with dressed Dungeness crab.

title: Solaia 2021 (by Tenuta Tignanello) - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Solaia hails from Italy, specifically Tuscany’s renowned Chianti Classico region, within the subregion of San Casciano in Val di Pesa. Produced by Marchesi Antinori at their celebrated Tenuta Tignanello estate, this wine embodies centuries of Tuscan winemaking excellence. The Antinori family, with a heritage stretching back to 1385, is celebrated for pioneering the Super Tuscan movement, combining tradition with innovation in their prestigious vineyards.

Wine Description

The Solaia 2021 reveals an intense ruby red color. On the nose, it opens with powerful aromas of ripe blackberries, dark cherries, cassis, and violets, intricately layered with nuances of sweet tobacco, graphite, and subtle spices. The palate is rich and full-bodied, offering a velvety texture balanced by vibrant acidity and refined tannins. Flavours of dark fruits, chocolate, and hints of licorice unfold seamlessly, leading to a long, elegant finish with a touch of minerality.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling - 97 points."

  • "Wine Advocate - 96+ points."

  • "Vinous - 96 points."

Food Pairing

Pair this distinguished wine with dry-aged ribeye, lamb racks seasoned with rosemary, or hearty mushroom risotto. The Solaia 2021’s depth and elegant tannins make it equally captivating alongside aged cheeses such as Parmigiano Reggiano. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Moric Burgenland Blaufrankisch 2021
bodyHtml:
Made in an early-drinking style from 'younger' vines (10-50 years old) grown on limestone, primary rock, and loam from Neckenmarkt and Lutzmannsburg. Fermented in open vats and steel tank. A wonderful introduction to Roland's elegant take on Blaufrankisch with its signature characteristics of high-toned aromatic blue fruits, spice, and black tea. A wine that will drink now and age well for years to come. 

"Roland Velich makes the best Blaufrankisch on the planet, full stop." - Jancis Robinson

title: Domaine Zind Humbrecht Riesling Calcaire 2020
bodyHtml: This dry Riesling has an expressive fruity, citrus nose. The velvety palate finishes with a beautiful ripe acidity, hiding the density of the wine. Its classic limestone minerality will continue to develop over time.

title: Tenuta di Biserno Lodovico 2012 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Lodovico is a rare, unexpected assemblage from their Biserno estate. They had previously identified parcels of the estate that were particularly conducive to the cultivation of Cabernet Franc and Merlot, but they only recently discovered within that micro-climate and terroir an even more special parcel, Vigna Lodovico, that has been yielding superior, singular results. It then became immediately clear to everyone involved that this unique character must be fostered, that this individual expression demanded to be crafted. Lodovico, an extraordinary wine, is only available in extremely small quantities through exclusive wine merchants.

Ripe dark fruit with well integrated spicy oak adding notes of freshly ground coffee, cocoa. Relatively tight knit, dense with ripe, polished tannins and great length. It is a powerful yet elegant wine which needs time to express its full potential. This wine is about texture and complexity. A nose that gives plenty to think about and to discover. The full bodied and rich texture is balanced by a fine acidity.

title: Max Ferdinand Richter Veldenzer Elisenberg Riesling Kabinett 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
92+ Points - Rober Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Elisenberger Riesling Kabinett is dense, cool, very precise and flinty-mineral on the nose, which is still reductive but exciting. Coming from a coolish side valley that was picked at roughly 84° to 85° Oechsle at the end of September, this is a gorgeously lush and mouth-filling Riesling with the mineral piquancy of quartzite soils. There is no aggressive acidity here, there is nice tartaric acidity that makes this a seductive Kabinett you can't resist. This is a fabulous, very long and enchanting Riesling. The wine has slightly more than 50 grams of residual sugar and comes in at 8.5% alcohol.

title: Casa da Baleia Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml:
Situated on the lime-rich soils on the cliff banks of the Duivenhoks River, Baleia is a unique terroir standing alone on this beautiful district of the Cape South Coast. A stone’s throw away from Sebastian’s Bay and the towns of Vermaklikheid and Stilbaai,  the wines smell of the ocean!

Lovely juicy, tropical fruits such as litchi, forrel pear and a hint of sea mist. The lush balanced palate entertains with granadilla, guava and prickly pear.

Best enjoyed next to the ocean with freshly-harvested shellfish.

title: Cenizo Colonial Hacienda Dolores Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Cenizo Colonial Hacienda Dolores is made with maguey Cenizo (agave Duranguensis). The Gutierrez family and Fabiola Avila produce this lighter maguey Cenizo mezcal at their own historic Hacienda Dolores, and their agaves come from the hills of their own Rancho La Campana de Santa Elena in Mezquital. They roast the agave using traditional underground ovens, ferment in pine vats using only wild yeast from the air, and distill using copper and stainless steel pot stills similar to those used in Oaxacan mezcal production.

Cenizo Colonial Hacienda Dolores has notes of smoked meat, mesquite, and light hints of pepper and dried herbs on the finish.

title: Domaine Rostaing Cote Rotie 'Cuvee Ampodium' 2022
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine originates from the prestigious Côte Rôtie appellation in the Northern Rhône region of France. Domaine Rostaing, currently directed by Pierre Rostaing, is renowned for maintaining a philosophy focused on wine consistency, sophistication, and true expression of origin.

Wine Description

'Cuvee Ampodium' is a 100% Syrah that displays a pure, clean, and deep profile. The nose is tightly wound yet highly expressive, revealing layers of fresh forest berries, black cherry, red plum, crushed violet, and delicate pepper, with background notes of cedar, graphite, and blood. On the palate, it delivers a fresh and profound intensity supported by a powerful 'iron backbone' and firm, finely polished tannins.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 93 points.

  • James Suckling - 94 points.

  • Vinous - 92 points.

Food Pairing

The intense mineral structure, savory character, and dark fruit profile of this Syrah make it a superb accompaniment to roasted game birds, pepper-crusted prime rib, or a rich wild mushroom risotto.

title: Whitehaven Sauvignon Blanc 'Greg' 2022
bodyHtml:
Greg Sauvignon Blanc offers a refined, pure, and distinctive expression of the Awatere Valley sub region. It has fresh and lifted aromas of green-gage plums, tomato leaf, grapefruit, gentle herbaceous notes, and hints of wet river stones.

Complex and textured with flavours of fresh green herbs, green pepper, and layers of white peach, boxwood, and a subtle suggestion of sea salt. The palate is concentrated yet elegant and finishes with lingering flavours, refreshing acidity and punchy minerality.

A perfect accompaniment to fresh seafood, summer salads, grilled herbed chicken, and creamy goat cheese.

title: Frank Family Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
A beautiful expression of the Carneros appellation, this Pinot Noir opens with lively aromas of strawberry, ripe red cherry, and a touch of baking spice. The palate is greeted with a juicy, full-bodied mouthfeel and refreshing, well-balanced acidity that lingers on the finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

A fresh and bright pinot with sliced-strawberry, raspberry and orange-peel aromas and flavors. Medium body with fine, racy tannins and a bright and energetic finish.

title: Cenizo Colonial San Miguel de Temoaya Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Cenizo Colonial Temoaya is made with maguey Cenizo (agave Duranguensis). Enrique de la Cruz produces this mezcal in San Miguel Temoaya, where they roast in an underground wood-fired earthen oven, ferment with wild yeast in wooden “coffins” recessed into the ground, mill the agave by hand using machetes, and distill in the traditional alembique viejo of Durango. 

This is a “Filipino”-style still similar to the clay pot stills of Oaxaca – except that holding the liquid is a copper base vessel recessed into the mud-brick hearth over a fire, and the upper montera is an upside down cone made of wooden staves held together by metal rings (like a conical wooden barrel open at the large bottom end and closed with a barrel end at the top), with the liquid mezcal flowing out through a hollow log into a condenser tank with a copper coil.

Cenizo Colonial Temoaya is fruity with notes of fresh earth, chili pepper, oregano, and light hints of smoke on the finish.

title: Chloe Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the cool Northern Italian Valdadige D.O.C., Chloe Pinot Grigio is a classic expression of this timeless varietal.

Alluring aromatics lead into an intense expression of the Pinot Grigio grape with a generously structured mouthfeel.

On the palate, fruit-forward flavours of juicy white peach, soft melon, crisp apple and floral honeysuckle lead to a crisp, refreshing finish with a subtle undertone of Meyer lemon.

title: Caymus Cabernet Sauvignon 'Napa Valley' 2023 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Caymus has a signature style that is dark in color, with rich fruit and ripe tannins – as approachable in youth as in maturity. Since its founding in 1972, Caymus has become renowned as a consistent leader in the production of Napa Valley Cabernet. 

Grapes for this wine are farmed in a range of Napa’s sub-appellations – from Coombsville to Calistoga – with fruit from the valley floor creating lushness and the hillsides providing backbone. Diversification enables them to make the best possible wine in a given year, featuring layered, lush aromas and flavors, including cocoa, cassis and ripe berries.

title: E & J Brandy - 375 ml
bodyHtml: America's best-selling brandy. Distilled and aged to demonstrate finesse and delicacy of California brandy...loads of fruit and varietal grape flavors dominate, with a tight balance of butterscotch and vanilla notes recovered from carefully selected barrels used in aging...lightly bodied with a crisp clean finish.

title: Marion Valpolicella Borgo 2021
bodyHtml: At the head of the Marion family estate, Stefano Campedelli and his wife Nicoletta are known for their wines made from high quality fruit featuring a well-balanced acidity. A true thirst-quencher, this Valpolicella is easy-to-drink, supple and fresh, with plenty of accessible fruit, it will will delight you!

title: Jermann Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml: Brilliant straw-yellow colour with light greenish highlights. Intense, persistent, and fruity aromas with a pleasant hint of elderflower. Full and dry taste, elegant and balanced.

title: Ely Chardonnay 2020 by Callaway Cellars
bodyHtml:
Paso Robles is an ideal region for growing Chardonnay because of its long hot days, crisp, cool nights, and diverse soils. 

The Ely Chardonnay has lifted aromas of tropical mango and pineapple, with creamy hints of crème brûlée and caramel. Rich, round flavors of ripe red apples, butterscotch and toasted bread.

title: Lingua Franca Estate Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Lingua Franca was co-founded by Larry Stone, David Honig, and Dominique Lafon in 2015, inspired by the exceptional vineyard site in the Eola-Amity Hills that Larry bought in 2012. They soon hired Thomas Savre, a brilliant young winemaker with work experience at some of the best domaines in Burgundy and an inquisitive mind. All are committed to farming and winemaking practices that respect the environment, believing that complex and undisturbed ecosystems help to create the most complex and seductive wines.

Lingua Franca Estate Pinot Noir enters with red fruits of raspberry and pomegranate, juicy red cherry, and has moderate, round tannins that provide structure. The finish is medium long and mineral with a discernable salinity. 

95 Points - Wine Spectator

A compelling, multilayered red, with lilting raspberry and cherry flavors that expand to reveal fresh violet and earthy mineral accents, which build tension toward refined tannins.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2021 Pinot Noir Estate sees 25% new oak, with 25% whole cluster inclusion, and pours a jeweled ruby hue. Super expressive on the nose, with notes of framboise, wild herbs, rosemary, and dusty earth, the palate takes on more iron richness in its texture and profile, with ripe fruit and tannins and an even spine of acidity. 

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

title: Domaine Zind Humbrecht Riesling Clos Windsbuhl 2022
bodyHtml: Bright pale yellow colour. The nose is still slightly closed, almost austere, but discreetly reveals beautiful aromas of citrus fruits, bergamot, verbena and lemongrass. It is easy to feel the youthful austerity of this terroir and to guess a complex evolution over the next few years. The mouthfeel is discreet, almost airy, of great elegance. Very quickly the taste buds are awakened by a ferociously tense structure based on a punchy acidity. The wine forces salivation and its delicacy makes it very easy to appreciate and go back to it.

title: Max Ferdinand Richter Riesling Mulheimer Sonnenlay Zeppelin Label 2024
bodyHtml:
Situated in the heart of the Mosel's finest vineyards, the Max Ferdinand Richter estate has been in the family for over 300 years. The family owns 48 acres of priceless vines on the magnificent stretch of the river between Erden and Brauenberg including all the best sites: Graacher Himmelreich, Wehlener Sonnenuhr and Brauenberger Juffer and Richter's monopole Veldenzer Eilsenberg. This is quite literally an embarrassment of riches.

On the nose, apple, citrus and slate stone. Clean pure structure; mineral texture with rich mouth-filling flavours of orchard fruits and juicy layers. Shows a well zesty and spicy refreshing style. Well-balanced structure, animating. The elegant fruit structure finishes with great length.

title: Sokol Blosser Evolution Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml: Evolution Chardonnay is anything but buttery, decidedly not oak-y and refreshes like summertime sprinklers. The winemaking team crafted a Chardonnay in the style they’d like to drink themselves. Dangerously floral and fruit-driven with a crisp finish. This wine makes it easy to enjoy drinking a young Chardonnay, and even easier to share with friends.

title: Pierre Gimonnet Special Club Oger Grand Cru Brut 2015
bodyHtml:
95 Points - James Sucking

Tightly wound and intensely mineral, this is a very serious and concentrated vintage champagne that just needs a bit more time in the bottle for the still discreet citrus notes to unfold. However, there are already so many layers of flavor on the tightly focused palate and at the long, very exciting finish. 

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The richest and most exuberant of these lieux-dits bottlings—reflecting both site and vintage—is the 2015 Brut Special Club Oger Grand Cru, a dramatic wine that bursts with aromas of confit citrus, pear, peach and white flowers. Full-bodied, layered and enveloping, it's broad and fruit-driven, even if it isn't as fine-boned or elegant as the Cramant and Chouilly Special Clubs. 

92 Points - Vinous

The 2015 Brut Special Club Oger Grand Cru is an attractive, powerful wine. Citrus peel, white flowers, chalk and the savory notes typical of so many 2015 are nicely laced together. I would give the 2015 a year or two in the cellar to come together, as it is a bit disjointed at present, but I would not wait too long, as flavors that are savory today may very well develop into more overpowering vegetal notes over time. The Oger is a blend taken from the Terres de Noeel, Brulis, Champ Nerons and Fondy lieux-dits.

title: Domaine Rene Rostaing 'La Landonne' Cote Rotie 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine René Rostaing is an elite, benchmark estate in Côte-Rôtie, situated in the Northern Rhône Valley of France. Founded by René Rostaing in 1971, the domaine was significantly elevated around 2000 when he inherited prized old-vine parcels from his uncle, Marius Gentaz, and father-in-law, Albert Dervieux. Today, the estate is meticulously managed by René's son, Pierre Rostaing, who honors a winemaking philosophy focused on tradition, transparency, and a minimal use of new oak to allow individual terroirs to speak. The single-vineyard La Landonne is sourced from one of the most celebrated, steep iron- and shale-rich slopes in the appellation, renowned for yielding wines of tremendous power and longevity.

Wine Description

The Domaine René Rostaing 'La Landonne' Côte-Rôtie 2022 is a profound, deeply complex, and tightly wound masterpiece. In the glass, it features a brooding, dark ruby-purple profile. The bouquet is highly expressive and layered, unveiling concentrated aromas of smoked black fruits, raw steak, and cassis, seamlessly framed by notes of fresh violets, graphite, stemmy complexities, pencil shavings, and a touch of orange rind.

On the palate, this 100% Syrah is medium to full-bodied, dense, and impeccably balanced. In step with the estate’s traditional methods, the fruit was fermented completely with whole bunches and aged predominantly in large, neutral demi-muid casks, keeping new oak restricted to a maximum of 10%. The 2022 vintage presents a slightly fleshier and more immediate texturing than classic cooler years, yet it remains anchored by firm, serious, and mineral-laced tannins alongside an inky, driving finish. It demands cellar patience, with an optimal drinking window estimated between 2028 and 2060.

title: L'Ecole No 41 Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: With its classic Cabernet profile, this expressive wine shows layers of dark fruit, black pepper, and espresso, accented by an array of floral notes, including violet and lavender. With blackberry, dark cherry, and cassis on the palate, it is framed with fine tannins which carry through to a flavorful finish.

title: Castello Bonomi Franciacorta Cru Perdu Grande Annata Extra Brut 2016
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
CruPerdu Grande Annata is made from Chardonnay and Pinot Noir of the same vintage. Only in the best vintages do the grapes of these two varieties achieve a particular acid structure and savouriness, characteristics that are also found in the wine, giving it greater complexity and longevity. When these peculiarities are confirmed after at least 48 months on the lees, a limited number of bottles are selected and left to rest for another year before being sold.

Blend: 70% Chardonnay, 30% Pinot Noir

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

CruPerdu is from an old reclaimed vineyard that shows its pedigree from the start with fresh citrus notes, orchard fruits, ginger, jasmine and intense minerality. The palate is firm and structured and shows the potential for a long life. Crushed stones give way to candied orange zest and fresh brioche with a touch of cream all balanced by stunning acidity.

title: El Jolgorio Tobaziche Mezcal
bodyHtml:
El Jolgorio Tobaziche is made with maguey Tobaziche, which is a member of the agave Karwinskii family. This agave takes about 14 years to mature before it is ready for harvest. Master Mezcalero Pedro Vasquez is widely known for the incredible mezcal he creates, and this mezcal is no exception. It carries deep notes of pine, green bananas, lime peel, and a hint of tar that mixes with clean smoke.

This mezcal is rare. If you see it, try it.

title: Alheit Vineyards Chenin Blanc Hereafter Here 2024
bodyHtml: The grapes were picked early in the morning, sorting in the vineyard, and whole bunch pressed. The juice was very lightly settled with no additions to the raw juice, wild fermentation in took place in old barrels of various sizes. Fermentation lasted for about two months. The wine was kept on lees for around 12 months, then rested in tank on fine lees without fining for a further six months prior to bottling. Very simple, careful winemaking.

title: Domaine des Carlines 'La Vouivre'
bodyHtml:
Domaine des Carlines, established by Patrick and Sophie Ligeron in late 2015, is located in the small village of Menetru-le-Vignoble, part of the Chsteau-Chalon, Grand Cru dei Vin Jaune appellation, in one of its finest sections, distributed over the villages of Château-Chalon, Menetru-le-Vignoble, and Domblans.

Packed with warm notes of ripe white fruits and spice, La Vouivre is made from a cuvee of 70% Chardonnay and 30% Savagnin.

title: Hennessy XO
bodyHtml:
Hennessy XO (Extra Old) is a prestigious cognac originating from the Cognac region of France. The House of Hennessy was founded in 1765 by Richard Hennessy, an Irish officer who served in the army of King Louis XV. Created in 1870 by Maurice Hennessy and Master Blender Emile Fillioux, Hennessy XO was the first cognac in the industry to bear the XO label, originally intended as a private blend for family and friends. Today, the Maison is part of the LVMH luxury group and remains the world's largest manufacturer of cognac.

Spirit Description

Hennessy XO is a complex masterpiece composed of a blend of up to 100 different eaux de vie, some aged for as long as 30 years in young oak barrels to achieve a balance of power and roundness.

  • Colour: It possesses an intense and deep amber hue, which is a visual sign of its strength and long maturation.

  • Aroma: The nose is rich and fragrant with notes of candied fruit, orange rind, butterscotch, and dried plums, underscored by subtle spices and vanilla.

  • Palate: The palate experience is described as a seven-part odyssey, beginning with sweet candied fruit followed by a sensation of rising heat and a spicy edge of black pepper and chocolate.

  • Body: It is full-bodied, robust, and voluptuous, offering a smooth yet powerful mouthfeel.

  • Finish: The finish, referred to as the 'Infinite Echo', is exceptionally long and persistent, echoing omnipresent notes of oak, vanilla, and warm spice.

  • ABV: Hennessy XO is bottled at 40%.

title: Douglas Laing's XOP Cameronbridge 45 Year Old
bodyHtml:
In keeping with their Diamond Anniversary theme, the packaging of these Single Casks will reflect the exceptional nature of the Whiskies:

Each bottle will be cosseted within a Diamond shaped, embellished, luxury gift box.

Within the gift box will be a beautifully presented 70cl bottle adorned with metal labels and a premium booklet / certificate hand-signed by Fred Laing and Cara Laing

For this specialist offering, and to ensure the ultimate Whisky drinking moment, we have partnered with glass artisan Richard Brendon who is renowned for classic, genuinely hand-crafted crystal glassware

title: Culmina Hypothesis 2017 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Deep in colour and intensity, Hypothesis represents the culmination of our efforts to create an icon quality wine from select micro blocks on our Golden Mile Bench estate. A rich, bold, and terroir-driven blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Malbec and Petit Verdot. 

Black cherry aromatics are complimented by savoury sage and eucalyptus notes. The rich and complex palate showcases wild red fruit layered with cloves and warming spices with hints of black currant. The finely structured tannins and elegant acidity carry the fruit through a long, refined finish.

title: Jermann Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml:
Silvio Jermann's Chardonnay is an authentic mirror of the Friulian Collio, told through a family's passion for their land. In an area particularly suited and linked to the old regional tradition, Jermann has been able to find a place for itself among Friuli's greatest exponents through quality wines with a strong territorial imprint. Simple ingredients and strong passion have guided this agricultural reality for years, which in 30 years of history has risen to the top of regional and national production.

The white Chardonnay wine illuminates the glass with its brilliant straw-yellow coat edged with greenish hues. The aromatic profile is intense and complex, characterized by a symphony of notes of yellow fruit, citrus and white flowers, with trails of almond on the finish. The palate reveals itself to be delicate, refined and immediate with a definite sapid-mineral lash. The sip is elegant and well-proportioned, calibrated by the beautiful constant relationship between field and freshness. Best enjoyed as an aperitif or paired with white fish and shellfish dishes, it also goes very well with vegetable dishes, delicate white meats and fresh cheeses. An indelible sip that tastes of Friuli.

title: Tobermory 42 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml:
After being distilled on the Isle of Mull, Tobermory 42 was aged for a whopping 42 years and bottled at a cask strength of 95.4 proof. Released in 2016, the single malt has no added coloring and isn't chill-filtered. 

On the nose are massive waves of dark chocolate, tobacco, Sherry-soaked raisins and roasted chestnuts. A touch of liquorice root.  The palate has roasted chestnut, now with notes of oily walnut and dry oak. Cherry, redcurrant, thick treacle and a touch of cracked black pepper.

Dry spices last ages on the finish, with chocolate-covered raisins bringing a balancing sweetness.

Get one of only 650 bottles of this well-aged single malt today!

title: Viva Mexico Reposado
bodyHtml:
Starts with bold, ripe fruit flavor front & center. The agave sweetness remains and then peppery kick comes into play. Nice oils and silky mouthfeel develop.

Wheat yellow tone with amber highlights. On the nose, notes of cooked agave, accompanied by almonds, pineapple, cherry, peach and syrup. In the mouth, smooth with a balance of sweetness and flavors of preserved fruits, syrups and barrels.

Finishes with some green notes and is long and memorable.

title: Pedro Parra y Familia Trane Cinsault 2022
bodyHtml:
Pedro Parra, a famous terroir expert in Chile, started his own wine label of Pedro Parra Y Familia after about 15 years of being a wine consultant. He travelled all over the world and understood different styles and cultures of winemaking, before he went on to start his own label in the little-known places of Chile – Itata and Bio Bio.

Elegant and perfumed with plush red fruit and herbal characters. Juicy on the palate with soft tannins and vibrant acidity.

title: Vidal Fleury Saint Joseph Blanc 2021
bodyHtml:
The Saint-Joseph appellation is a succession of granite terraces which overlook the river for around fifty kilometers. Our vintage comes from grapes grown in the South and North of the appellation. The climate is semi-continental with the influence of the cooler Massif Central and the Rhône which brings mildness.

The nose reveals aromas of nectarines and orange peel. Aging in oak barrels gives complexity to the bouquet with notes of dried fruit and coconut.

A full-bodied attack that fills the mouth. The mid-palate presents a beautiful balance and the finish is remarkable with fresh and spicy notes.

title: Domaine de la Mordoree 'La Reine des Bois' Tavel 2022
bodyHtml:
Ideally situated at the crossroads of Provence and Languedoc, the Domaine de la Mordoree produces some of the greatest vintages of the Rhone valley: Lirac, Tavel, Chateauneuf-du-Pape and Condrieu.

The emblematic cuvee of the estate, it will seduce you with its aromas of red fruits, strawberries and raspberries.

91 Points - James Suckling

A well-framed and precise Tavel with bramble berries, dried herbs and pomegranates. Medium body with a succulent core of forest berries and a fresh finish.

title: Grant Burge Filsell Old Vine Shiraz 2017
bodyHtml:
The Filsell vineyard with near century-old vines is considered one of the best vineyards in the Barossa Valley and consistently produced fruit of great intensity and concentration.  Planted in 1920, this vineyard also produces some of the fruit for Grant Burge Wines' flagship Shiraz, the highly acclaimed Meshach. 

Filsell is known to loyal followers as Meshach's younger brother.  This rich, bold, vibrant red wine has intense aromas and flavours of mulberry, coffee bean, allspice and milk chocolate.

title: Cantina di Negrar Valpolicella 2020
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: This versatile red wine hails from the world-famous Valpolicella region. The wine styles of this region range from light-bodied to full and rich. Ruby red, with aromas and flavours of licorice, rye bread, berry mix and red fruit. Medium-bodied and fruity with soft tannins, this is perfect for spaghetti and meatballs.

title: Domaine Jamet Cotes du Rhone 2023
bodyHtml: Tinned strawberry, mulberry – a lick of cracked black pepper beneath. A sprinkle of clove, pepper and cinnamon on the palate. Light in body, refreshing and so drinkable. Light and floral and already ready. A subtle liquorice note on the salty finish.

title: Domaine Santa Duc Les Quatre Terres Cotes du Rhone 2021
bodyHtml:
A blend of four parcels scattered throughout Southern Rhône, this wine is elegant and refined yet extremely approachable. It opens with lovely floral aromas, followed by juicy notes of blackberry, black cherry, strawberry, and garrigue on the plush palate. Bright acidity highlights the firm tannic structure and carries into a focused mineral finish.

This estate integrates a thoughtful simplicity to the craft of winemaking that results in beautiful purity of expression in the elegant, focused, and polished wines.

91 Points - James Suckling

What a fresh and elegant Cotes-du-Rhone this is, with bright raspberry, sour cherry and candied orange aromas. Excellent balance of ripe red fruits, fine tannins and lively acidity on the focused palate. Long, surprisingly mineral finish.

title: Clos des Fous Pinot Noir 'Pour Ma Guele' 2021
bodyHtml:
To produce the “Pour Ma Gueule” Itata Valley Clos des Fous each of the three varieties used in this blend were hand harvested, vinified and aged separately. After crushing, the musts were fermented in concrete and stainless-steel tanks, with malolactic fermentation taking place in tank and old barrels for 12 months. Once finished, the wines were blended together, making a unique and distinctive wine. The name is a French expression “for my gob”, a term used to describe a stash of wine for the producer to drink with friends and family. The grapes for Pour Ma Gueule are sourced largely from Itata Valley located 400 km south of Santiago. 

Pour Ma Gueule is dark ruby in colour with violet highlights. A fruit-forward wine with aromas of red berries, black cherry and black pepper with hints of violets. These elements come through to the palate, revealing a medium-bodied wine with fine tannins and lively acidity.

title: Domaine de la Mordoree 'La Dame Rousse' Lirac Rouge 2021
bodyHtml:
Ideally situated at the crossroads of Provence and Languedoc, the Domaine de la Mordoree produces some of the greatest vintages of the Rhone valley: Lirac, Tavel, Chateauneuf-du-Pape and Condrieu.

Deep red color. Aromas of red fruits (raspberry, blackcurrent) and flowers (violet). The palate is full, rich and ample; nicely concentrated. Long & fresh finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of spiced cherries, forest berries and sweet spices. Medium body with fine tannins. Layered and textured with a velvety mid-palate. Balanced and harmonious with a focused finish and excellent length.

title: Domaine de la Mordoree 'La Reine des Bois' Lirac Blanc 2022
bodyHtml:
Ideally situated at the crossroads of Provence and Languedoc, the Domaine de la Mordoree produces some of the greatest vintages of the Rhone valley: Lirac, Tavel, Chateauneuf-du-Pape and Condrieu.

Gold with green hints. Aromas of white and yellow fruits - peach, apricot, pear, citrus fruits, verbena, acacia. The palate is round, fruity, complex and elegant, with a long finish.

title: Pierre Gimonnet & Fils Brut Cuis Premier Cru (NV) - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
The Gimmonets have many old-vine parcels in 30 acres of some of the Cote des Blancs’ choicest grands crus, but the house makes no Champagnes that meet grand cru regulations, rather chose to blend from different sites in order to craft their desired style. All of their reserve wines used for their NV are housed in bottles rather then the more common practice of keeping reserve wines in tanks.

This Cuvee Brut Cuis 1er Cru represents the archetype style of the Pierre Gimonnet & Fils. It is a lively and light Chardonnay based Champagne with all of the freshness and purity of great Cote des Blancs.

title: Wakefield Cabernet Sauvignon 'The Visionary' 2015
bodyHtml:
This pinnacle release Cabernet Sauvignon is crafted from the very finest fruit selection and is entirely estate grown and bottled on the Taylor family estate in the Clare Valley, South Australia.

A dark red-black core framed by a crimson rim.  The wine is attractively scented with wild berry and bramble hints backgrounded by light chocolate and mint notes with a subtle smoky cigar air from extended premium oak maturation. 

The wine delivers a focused, upfront berry and summer fruits profile that jumps straight to the centre of attention and is counterbalanced by a mouth-watering freshness. There is a ripe and highly integrated tannin and oak firmness to the focused, long finish. This wine has lovely dimensions and a poised, elegance and depth that reflects it’s carefully selected provenance, vinification and cellaring.

title: Hunter Laing's 'Old & Rare' Dufftown 30 Year Old (Distilled 1991)
bodyHtml:
Hunter Laing have been bottling and blending since 1949, during which time they have been accumulating and maturing some very special whiskies. They have also acquired great skill in selecting the right time to bottle these gems. Their Old & Rare “Platinum” series of cask strength bottlings, launched in 2001, is one result of this skillful craft.

This is a splendid Speyside single malt from the Dufftown distillery, matured for 30 years in a single bourbon barrel between November 1991 and May 2022.

The whisky was independently bottled by Hunter Laing, releasing a total of 247 cask-strength bottles for its Old & Rare Platinum series.

title: Pedro Parra y Familia Monk Cinsault 2022
bodyHtml:
Pedro Parra y Familia Monk Wine is an elegant Chilean creation. It boasts a vibrant ruby hue, with a tantalising bouquet of dark fruit, smoke, and minerality. Notes of blackberry, plum and earthiness tantalise the palate, bolstered by sturdy tannins and a tantalising hint of spice. This is a full-bodied red, produced in the Itata Valley, renowned for its unique terroir. Production is limited, ensuring exclusivity. The mezcla of Cinsault and Pais grapes in this sophisticated blend is a testament to Parra's talent as a leading soil specialist. A captivating and refined wine, it’s perfect for the discerning palate.

The wine delivers aromas of cranberry, cherry and wild herbs. Due to the granitic clay soils, Monk is the most structured and layered of Pedro's three single vineyard wines, with fine tannins and fresh acidity on the palate.

title: Espolon Cristalino Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the beautiful crystalline waters found in Cenotes -- Espolon Cristalino was developed using a combination of traditional and modern techniques, using 100% pure Blue Weber agave and a filtration process that leaves us with an aged, yet crystal clear tequila.
