This unique blend of Anejo with a touch of extra Anejo tequila is artfully filtered through charcoal, for the shortest amount of time possible to retain its signature flavor, while removing both harsh notes and color.

title: H. Billiot Fils Grand Cru Brut Rose (NV) - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Billiot's NV Brut Rosé is super-expressive. Blood orange, mint, cinnamon and red berry are all laced together in this nuanced, wonderfully inviting Rose.

Medium in body and gracious in feel, the Rosé is delicate and yet has more than enough resonance to fill out its frame effortlessly.

title: Vidal Fleury Crozes Hermitage 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The Crozes-Hermitage appellation is one of the prestigious wines of the northern Rhone valley. Here, the grape varieties give their best. Syrah for red wines, Marsanne and Roussanne for white wines.

Dark red and moderately deep. A nose of blackcurrant, plum, violet but also pepper and toast, with a vegetal note. A supple, fresh palate, black fruit, mineral, with roundness and persistence based on fresh fruit.

Ideal pairings for this wine include game birds, red meat, cold meat, mature fatty cheese, and pork dishes.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of dark plums, blueberries, blackberry, violets, crispy bacon and freshly picked thyme fill the glass. The palate is fresh and enveloped by flavors of pomegranate, rhubarb, plums and blackberries. With its polished tannins, the wine becomes juicier with aeration, making it easy to enjoy now.

92 Points - James Suckling

This rather rich and plush Crozes has excellent integration of restrained toasty oak with ripe blueberry and blackberry fruit on the well-structured palate. Just beginning to show what it’s made of! Long, rather compact finish. Drink or hold.

title: Provenance Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley 2019
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from the United States, specifically the renowned Napa Valley region in California. Provenance Vineyards was founded in 1999 and quickly established a strong reputation as a top Napa Valley Cabernet house.

Wine Description

On the nose, it offers intense and rich aromas of espresso, ripe cherries, blueberry, tapenade, and dark chocolate. The palate is described as silky and rich with expressive flavors of blackberry and cocoa, supported by a full body. It is a structured and opulent wine with ample, fine, and grainy tannins that provide a 'papery texture' and complexity, which contributes to a long yet vertical finish.

Accolades

  • 'James Suckling'  – 93 points

  • 'Wine Enthusiast' – 93 points

  • 'Vinous' – 93+ points

Food Pairing

This elegant Cabernet Sauvignon pairs beautifully with rich red meats such as grilled steaks and pot roast.

title: Trimbach Gewurztraminer Reserve 2016
bodyHtml:
The fruitiest and the spiciest of the varietals – a unique wine.

Its dry personality makes it ideal as an aperitif and it pairs extremely well with specialty cuisine with pronounced flavors. Gewurztraminer is a fine accompaniment for fish or seasoned meats, spicy and exotic dishes, soft cheeses (such as the famous Munster), and a plethora of desserts.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Beeswax and crushed pine notes are layered with poached apple, Marcona almond and lemon curd flavors in this dry, medium-bodied version, framed by sleek acidity and petrol-laced minerality. 

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Very ripe notes of pear and peach dominate the nose, while the palate brims with freshness. The concentrated body has texture from the zestiness but also that background of ripe richness. It finishes completely dry, with a streak of mandarin on the long finish.

title: Phantom Creek Estates Becker Cuvee 2019
bodyHtml:
Led by renowned viticulturist Helmut Becker, over 30 different grape varieties were specifically planted at (what’s now) Becker Vineyard as a demonstration that traditional European vines could survive in British Columbia. And not only did they survive—they thrived.

Becker Vineyard was one of the first in the South Okanagan to showcase the potential for late ripening Bordeaux reds, putting it at the forefront of the shift that would soon take place in the region’s winegrowing philosophies.

Select barrels were chosen to create a distinct and full-bodied red wine.  Petite Cuvee is a true expression of South Okanagan, showcasing an intense core of dark fruit and cocoa with lifted notes of spice and cigar box.

title: Domaine de la Mordoree 'La Dame Rousse' Tavel Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Mordoree's Tavel Rose La Dame Rousse is produced from organically and biodynamically grown vineyards, and is a beautiful blend of three terroirs: galets roules (cobblestones), flat white limestones and sandy soils.

A lovely color and fruity aromas of strawberry, cherry, redcurrant, pink grapefruit and tangerine combine with floral scents and rose fragrance. Fresh, round and smooth in the mouth.

title: Domaine de Beaurenard 'Boisrenard' Chateauneuf du Pape 2019
bodyHtml:
Made from old vines of different varieties growing together, with moderate yields, Boisrenard is characterized by the silky weave of its tannins and its generous fruit. A wine of immense depth.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Brought up all in foudre, it boasts a dense purple hue to go with a sensational, full-bodied, multi-layered array of red and black currants, toasted spice, peppery garrigue, and new leather-like aromas and flavors. 

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Rich and ripe, offering an alluring smoky edge throughout. Layers of warmed plum preserve and cherry compote roll through, picking up tobacco and warm earth notes along the way. 

94 Points - James Suckling

Deep nose of damson plums and black cherries with subtle spice and tobacco-leaf aromas. Rich and concentrated with a ton of healthy tannins that beautifully support the full body, the mineral acidity lighting up the long finish. 

93+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Chateauneuf du Pape Boisrenard is 80% Grenache, with the balance a mix of the other permitted varieties. Fermentation took place in wood (including a small proportion of new barrels), with maturation in foudres. Scents of mint and garrigue accent black cherries and plum on the nose, and I thought I detected a hint of charred oak as well (tasted blind). Full-bodied, rich and velvety, this is a thickly textured, concentrated beauty, with a long, mocha-tinged finish.

title: Domaine de Beaurenard 'Boisrenard' Chateauneuf du Pape Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: This wine symbolizes our love for white Châteauneuf-du-Pape. We find delicate floral notes, a fresh texture and crisp, juicy fruit with a saline finish. Just like a walk in our a Provencal garden.

title: Salentein Numina Gran Corte 2021
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Salentein Numina Gran Corte is an exceptional wine that hails from the prestigious Salentein winery in the foothills of the Andes Mountains in Argentina. This red blend showcases the unique terroir of the region, combining the elegance of Malbec with Cabernet Sauvignon's depth and structure, along with the spiciness of Merlot.

The result is a rich and complex wine that entices with intense aromas of dark fruits, such as blackberry and black currant, layered with hints of chocolate, tobacco, and vanilla. On the palate, it offers a well-balanced, full-bodied experience with velvety tannins and a long, satisfying finish. Salentein Numina Gran Corte is a captivating choice for those seeking a bold and luxurious wine that truly embodies the essence of Argentine winemaking.

title: Chateau des Tours Brouilly 'Les Tours' 2023
bodyHtml:
Complex and fine nose dominated by notes of ripe fruit, floral notes and some spices. In the mouth, the tannins are present with a silky, unctuous texture.

Little by little, the aromas are revealed in the mouth throughout their complexity and especially in a beautiful length supported by a beautiful freshness.

title: Domaine Latour Giraud Pommard 'Cuvee Carmen' 2020
bodyHtml: A somber, even brooding, nose features notes of ripe dark berries, newly turned earth and a whiff of spice. The fresh, full-bodied and intense middle weight flavors display a touch of rusticity on the youthfully austere finale. This will need a few to further flesh out and add depth.

title: Domaine Latour Giraud Pommard 'Cuvee Carmen' 2020
bodyHtml: A somber, even brooding, nose features notes of ripe dark berries, newly turned earth and a whiff of spice. The fresh, full-bodied and intense middle weight flavors display a touch of rusticity on the youthfully austere finale. This will need a few to further flesh out and add depth.

title: Clos des Fous Pinot Noir 'Subsollum' 2018
bodyHtml:
The ambitious project that led to this wine can be summed by the quest for extreme terroirs where you could plant vines on Chilean soil, despite unfavourable expert opinions.

This quest beginning in 2007 was pure madness to some, and certainly proved challenging for its four founding partners, but what a success it turned out to be.

This Pinot Noir is a case in point: Magnificent fruit complete with mineral and spice notes.  A bouquet of delicate red fruits and wet forest aromas. Charming and distinguished, this gentle wine offers a persistent mouthfeel. It has a fresh acidity that shows a great potential on the smooth and elegant finish.

Try this wine with wild mushroom risotto, honey-balsamic glazed salmon, or fennel-garlic pork roast.

title: Domaine Delaporte Sancerre Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Domaine Vincent Delaporte Sancerre Rosé originates from France, within the Loire Valley region and the Sancerre subregion. The domain is an historic family enterprise nestled in the verdant hills of the village of Chavignol, where viticulture has been passed from father to son since the 17th century. Since 2010, the property has been guided by grandson Matthieu Delaporte, whose winemaking philosophy balances strict precision, environmental respect, and a desire to highlight individual terroirs.

Wine Description

This rosé wine displays a clear, rather light salmon or sparkly redcurrant appearance and possesses a medium-to-full body with a rounded mouthfeel. The sensory profile is elegant, clean, and forward, opening with an aromatic nose of fresh strawberries, raspberries, wild peach, and orange pith, accompanied by delicate floral scents. On the savory palate, it delivers a fine clarity and concentration, layering juicy cherry and grapefruit flavours with a smoky mineral lift and a light touch of white pepper. The finish is remarkably long and persistent, leaving lingering memories of citrus fruits, blackcurrants, and rubbed slate.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its structural harmony and layered complexity, achieved through direct whole cluster pressing and fermentation in temperature controlled stainless steel tanks to keep the racy acidity fresh and crisp.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 12.5% and 13%.

  • Organic Status: The vines are cultivated without herbicides using sustainable agriculture principles to safeguard the local ecosystem, and recent releases are officially certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, subtle tannic frame, and deep mineral drive of this Sancerre make it an exceptional partner for a wide variety of gastronomical dishes.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with grilled salmon fillets, seafood risotto, grilled lobster, and platters of fresh shellfish.

  • Light Fare: An ideal companion for a classic Salade Niçoise, delicatessen meats, fresh summer salads, and lightly spiced paella.

  • Cheese: Matches traditionally and beautifully with the local goat cheese of its home village, Crottin de Chavignol.

title: Marcel Lapierre Morgon 2023 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The Lapierres age their wines on fine lees for at least nine months in oak foudres and futs ranging from three to thirteen years old. These wines are the essence of Morgon: bright, fleshy fruit with a palatable joie de vivre that was undoubtedly inherited from their creator.

Domaine Lapierre's vines are located on the Morgon terroir, undoubtedly one of the most famous Beaujolais crus. Typically, Morgon has four dominant aromas: cherry, violet, raspberry and a very slight touch of liquorice. Combining lightness and richness, this Morgon has an aging potential of around ten years on average.

title: Langmeil Jackaman's Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Langmeil Winery, situated in the heart of the Barossa Valley, is a family-owned estate known for preserving some of the oldest vines in the world and for its dedication to traditional winemaking methods. The vineyard's Jackaman's block was planted in the 1960s and named after Arthur Jackaman, a charismatic local butcher, boxer, and WWII paratrooper. His commitment to the land is carried on by Langmeil, which nurtures this historic plot with the same care and attention to detail that Jackaman once did.

Wine Description
This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon reveals a deep crimson colour with purple hues. The nose opens with vibrant aromas of blackcurrant, blueberry, and liquorice, enriched by nuances of French oak, black olive, and a touch of cedar. On the palate, the wine delivers juicy blue and black fruits layered with briary spice and savoury undertones. It is medium to full-bodied, with silky tannins and a subtle sweetness from 25 months of ageing in French oak hogsheads—48% new and 52% seasoned. The finish is long and velvety, marked by youthful energy and refined complexity. This wine is vegan friendly and crafted with a focus on expressing site and varietal character. Optimal drinking is suggested from now through 2032.

Food Pairing
Ideal companions include chargrilled rib-eye, roast duck, and venison. These bold, savoury dishes complement the wine’s structure and rich fruit profile.
A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Domaine de Beaurenard Cotes du Rhone 2021
bodyHtml:
This Cotes du Rhone is full of fresh, juicy red fruit and a refreshing floral note. Its smoothness, freshness and delicate characteristics offer immediate pleasure.

Blend: 70% Grenache, 30% Syrah

title: Fraser and Thompson Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Canadian singer Michael Buble is behind Fraser and Thompson Whiskey. A blend of 92% Canadian whisky and 8% Kentucky bourbon, Fraser and Thompson Whiskey offers delicate aromas with hints of fig, blood orange and vanilla.

The palate is smooth and creamy with rich, complex flavours of caramel, sweet vanilla, light oak and a hint of spice. It finishes subtle and warm.

title: Don Julio Rosado Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
Don Julio Rosado is a reposado tequila finished in Ruby Port wine casks from the enchanting Douro wine region of Northern Portugal.

The result is a deliciously unique reposado tequila with a delicate pink hue and sweet notes of dried red fruit & caramel. Smooth unlike any other. Don Julio Rosado is best enjoyed on the rocks. For a lighter, longer drink, add a splash of club soda and lemon garnish. It is made for daytime moments best spent outdoors with friends.

title: Anae Gin Francais
bodyHtml:
Straight from Charente, Anae is one of the first French gins that is as beautiful as it is organic. All of the distilled ingredients come from the four corners of the French region.

Maceron berries, cornflowers, chamomile, thyme... all come from committed producers. Notes of citrus and fresh pear, then spices and anise, Anae gin brilliantly combines freshness and depth.

title: Cantine San Marzano 'Anniversario 62' Primitivo di Manduria Riserva 2019
bodyHtml:
In 1962, 19 winemakers, determined to demonstrate the high potential of wines from Salento, founded “Cantine San Marzano”. A long time has passed since then, yet their old vines still produce rare and precious grapes.

This wine has a very intense and elegant ruby red colour; broad and complex fruity fragrance with hints of plum, cherry jam and tobacco, slightly spicy; a full-bodied wine, smooth and rich in tannins, with a finish that offers notes of cocoa, coffee and vanilla.

title: Langmeil Rough Diamond Grenache 2021
bodyHtml:
90 Points - James Suckling

A fruity, ripe and juicy grenache with notes of red cherries, strawberries, violets, thyme and raspberry compote. Full-bodied, soft and round with a fruity finish.

title: Castello Di Bolgheri Superiore 2020
bodyHtml:
Hand picked grapes that are selected with care during the harvest as well as during the destemming process. Harvest started at the end of August with the Merlot, followed by the Cabernet Franc, ending with the Cabernet Sauvignon at the end of September.

Currant and fresh-herb aromas with hints of grilled vegetables. Medium to full body. Juicy center-palate with a chewy finish. Structured and tannic, yet the centre-palate is fresh.

title: Cantina Terre del Barolo Nascetta 2018
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Straw yellow in colour, it has a good intensity, aromatic, floral and citrus nose. Savory and persistent palate, excellent with appetizers and first courses, fish-based specialties including raw fish, fresh cheeses.

title: Chateau de Ricaud Cadillac Cotes de Bordeaux 2018
bodyHtml: Chateau de Ricaud Cadillac Cotes de Bordeaux signals a new lease of life for the estate. This cru wine interprets the utimate expression of Merlot on clay-limestone soils and Cabernet Sauvignon on gravel. Well-structured and complex, it combines intense fruit with lovely soft character. The excellent quality of recent vintages has made this wine one of the rising stars in Cadillac Cotes de Bordeaux.

title: Louis Jadot Gevrey Chambertin Clos St. Jacques Premier Cru 2017
bodyHtml:
A full-bodied, complex wine, this Premier Cru has a broad array of aromas and fine expression of terroir as well as impressive length on the palate. It will develop for more than 10 years in the bottle—or up to 40 in great vintages.Serve with game, meats, mushroom dishes and strong cheeses.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

With its dense tannins and concentration, this wine is impressive both for aging and for its power. With bold structure the wine sustains the black fruits with verve. It will age well and will not be ready before 2025.

92+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2017 Gevrey-Chambertin 1er Cru Clos Saint-Jacques (Domaine Louis Jadot) unfurls in the glass with an incipiently complex bouquet of sweet red berries, coffee roast, raw cocoa, candied peel and cedary new wood. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, ample and layered, with an abundance of satiny structuring tannin, juicy acids and a long, pure finish. As usual, this will require some bottle age, but it's one of the high points of the collection.

93 Points - James Suckling

Shows a solid finish with ripe and linear tannins, as well as attractive sliced-strawberry, raspberry and citrus flavors. Medium to full body. Solid. Give it three to four years to soften. Try after 2023.

title: Alzinger Gruner Veltliner Loibenberg Smaragd 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Alzinger Grüner Veltliner Loibenberg Smaragd originates from Austria, within the Niederösterreich region and the Wachau subregion. Weingut Alzinger is a family winery located in Unterloiben that stopped selling its grapes to make its own wines when Leo Alzinger took over in 1970. Working alongside his son, Leo Junior, the family maintains a winemaking philosophy focused on honest, open craftsmanship that calmly reflects the distinct root structures and terroir of the valley.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a bright, light yellow colour and possesses a full, concentrated body that remains remarkably sleek and cool. The sensory profile is highly expressive and multi-layered, featuring an aromatic nose of dried herbs, sliced pears, chopped apples, and yellow kiwi, laced with white pepper and a gentle yeasty creaminess. On the palate, it is smooth, flowing, and elegant, delivering flavours of stone fruit, grapefruit, and fennel supported by an exquisite tension, precise tannins, and a striking, lively acidity. The finish is exceptionally long, textured, and firm, culminating in a dry, savory exit marked by dark minerality, fern, and white miso.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Grüner Veltliner.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its incredible structural focus and purity, avoiding any oak barrel maturation to maximize the natural freshness and gripping, transparent minerality of the fruit.

  • ABV: 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate emphasizes traditional manual agriculture and careful land stewardship, this bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, dry structure, and deep savory components of this Smaragd make it a well-balanced partner for a wide array of food pairings.

  • Seafood: Pairs beautifully with a selection of seafood, raw oysters, and delicate white fish preparations.

  • Meats: Complements roasted white meats, such as herb-seasoned pork or poultry.

  • Savoury: Suggested pairings include traditional rice dishes, rich vegetable terrines, and fresh legumes.

  • Salads: Matches excellently with crisp summer salads that welcome the wine's herbaceous undertones.

title: Alzinger Durnstein Federspiel Gruner 2022
bodyHtml:
Leo Alzinger is located in Unterloiben, just across the street from Knoll. Leo owns parcels in two of the great vineyards in this part of the river valley: Loibenberg and Steinertal. Alzinger’s wines are never forceful or assertive; they are instead amazingly sanguine and calmly transparent.

The Durnsteiner Federspiel Gruner Veltliner is an elegant example of what Gruner can be, always crystal clear, animating and wholesome, with herbs, citrus, and fresh stone fruit.

92 Points - James Suckling

Bright and fruity gruner showing aromas of pineapples, papayas and peaches. Medium-bodied, juicy and vibrant. Excellent length, too, with citrus zest and nutmeg notes at the end.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Graceful with a mineral crunch adding to the notes of apple and lime, all backed by a firm backbone of acidity. This is a rather delicate example, with nice floral highlights and a sea-salt note, which would all match beautifully with smoked fish.

title: Quintessa Estate Proprietary Red Blend 2020
bodyHtml:
The great wines of the world consistently express the distinct qualities of the estates from which they come. In Napa, Quintessa is such a wine. To preserve the natural mosaic of the vineyard, each small plot is farmed, harvested and vinified individually so that the nuances of the land shine through. Afterward, the best components are brought together to create a wine of elegance and harmony. A timeless classic.

Quintessa enters on a core of cassis, black cherry, and currants enveloped by clove spice and savory dried herbs. Layers of structured tannin and the distinct mineral imprint of the Quintessa terroir give way to a structured and polished finish. Balanced and with well-integrated movement, this elegant and complex wine has plenty of life ahead of it – drinking well now and with cellar potential for at least 20 years.

98 Points - Decanter

Here is one of the stars of this challenging vintage. A muscular wine, leading with tremendous freshness on the palate, restrained red-toned fruit, and very subtle yet elegant cedar wood intermixed with red-rock minerality. Medium to full-bodied, offering more black fruit on the palate, redolent of muddled blackberries and juicy plums. An iron fist in a velvet glove comes to mind, given the tannin texture, which leads with the furry, velvety side of the glove and transitions to an undercurrent of ironclad and dusty minerals. All this turns fresh and lively through the finish. 

94 Points - James Suckling

A lovely red with a pretty core of currants, berries, spices and mushrooms. Medium to full body, layers of polished tannins and a juicy finish. A very balanced and fine wine. A little chewy.

title: Blackened X Rabbit Hole Whiskey
bodyHtml:
A blend of straight bourbon whiskeys distilled in Tennessee & Kentucky finished in calvados casks

Blackened Whiskey and Rabbit Hole Distillery are both known for forging their own paths in American whiskey. Rabbit hole’s unique mash bills and sourcing malt from europe, coupled with blackened whiskey’s sonic-enhancement process are proof that innovation can come in unexpected ways in whiskey making.

Rob and kaveh believe that creation is personal and that quality and artisanship drive everything they do.they constantly challenge the way they approach whiskey making and are always striving to surpass current standards. It’s these shared values and the appreciation for art in all its forms that came together in this collaboration that resulted in a complex, bold flavor profile.

title: Chloe Rose 2022
bodyHtml: Chloe Central Coast Rose is a dry, bright and delicious wine that is light and elegant in style. Delicate notes of fresh strawberries, raspberries and watermelon dance on the nose and palate, unfolding into a crisp and well-balanced wine with bright acidity and a refreshing finish.

title: Writers' Tears Japanese Mizunara Cask Finish
bodyHtml: The nose is rich and oily with Bramley apple peels, brown butter, walnut oil, and exotic woods. Hugely satisfying mouthfeel of toffee, nut, malt, and baked sugar as pepper and clove take flight, leaving baked apple, walnut, currant, and ripening plum. This achieves perfect center ground between the sweetness, spice, and mizunara wood, and the spice combination from the 9-month finish and single pot still is divine.

title: Hilary Goldschmidt Charming Creek Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml:
The rolling hills and gentle slopes near the town of Sebastopol were once home to apple orchards filled with songbirds. By the early 1990’s though, most of the orchards were replanted with grapes. The factors that define a quality Chardonnay vineyard are numerous, but Nick Goldschmidt believes matching varietal and rootstock to the right vineyard site yields the most flavorful grapes. 

The fresh bright red hue with purple edges leads into aromas of black cherry with hints of raspberry and black plum. The mouth opens with delicious vanilla and mocha merged with the same cherry and plum found on the nose. Enticing traces of graphite and a mineral essence build down the length of the mouth, joining pomegranate and more vanilla in the finish.

92 Points - Wilfred Wong

The 2019 Goldschmidt Vineyards Hilary Cabernet Sauvignon is demonstrative and persistent on the palate. This wine excels with aromas and flavors of oak, charred barrels, black fruits, and licorice. Pair it with Argentine grilled beef. 

91 Points - James Suckling

This has ripe and smoky character with lots of dark and blue-fruit aromas, together with hints of spices and dark chocolate. Full body and a firm tannin structure. Has hints of blueberry jam on the palate, yet it’s fresh and juicy. Long, chocolatey finish.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Stylish, with a flash of menthol giving way to streamlined cassis and cherry paste flavors wrapped in notes of red licorice, while hints of mesquite line the finish.

title: Domaine Gassier Nostre Pais Blanc 2020
bodyHtml:
Nostre Pais White is more about freshness, purity and balance that about exuberance. It offers fabulous notes of fresh citrus, white flowers and flint.

Medium-bodied and focused, its soft finish evinces a great deal of minerality. In 2020, the whites and ross were tense, particularly the Grenache. Roussanne and Viognier are very sprightly and don’t have the usual opulence. Lots of elegance and balance!

2020 is a vintage focused on freshness with almost Burgundian accents.

91 Points - James Suckling

It’s hard to believe that this refreshing white wine, with its orange-blossom nose and lively medium-bodied palate, has 14% alcohol. Positive touches of tannin and minerals give clear contours to the supple finish. From organically grown grapes.

91 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Also terrific, the 2020 Costieres De Nîmes Nostre Pais Blanc is 65% Grenache Blanc, 20% Clairette, and the rest Viognier and Roussanne. Clean, crisp citrus and stone fruits as well as floral nuances define the bouquet, and it’s medium-bodied, balanced, and elegant on the palate, with good acidity. I’d be thrilled to drink a bottle any time over the coming couple of years and certainly wouldn’t be surprised to see it evolve nicely for longer

title: Villa Sparina Gavi di Gavi 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The golden yellow colour perfectly matches the intense ripe fruit aromas and with some aging, tropical fruits and nuanced herbs appear. Round in texture with a medium body, the wine lingers in the mouth with its long finish. Gift this wine to a history buff as the unique bottle shape was modeled after a long-forgotten bottle that the Moccagatta family discovered in the ancient cellar when they took over the property.

91 Points - James Suckling

A creamy and fruity white with sliced apples and pears, as well as some flint, parsley and fennel undertones. Medium-bodied, fresh and satisfying.

title: Ricasoli Roncicone Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2020
Secret Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Secret Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon leads with bright fruit aromas and hints of sage. On the palate, ripe black plum, black cherry and currant flavours mingle with dark chocolate. Tannins are rich yet supple leading to a lovely, lingering finish.

title: Crown Royal Blackberry
bodyHtml:
Crown Royal, the jewel of Canadian Whisky, was introduced in 1939 by Samuel Bronfman to celebrate a royal tour. From its humble beginnings at Gimli Manitoba distillery, Crown Royal has grown into a world-renowned brand under Diageo's stewardship. 

Crown Royal Blackberry Canadian Whisky is an extraordinary twist on a classic. This blackberry-infused Whisky, encased in a regal bottle, offers a sensory journey from the first pour. The palate dances with succulent blackberry notes intertwined with Crown Royal's signature smoothness. Each glass raised is not just a sip of Whisky; it's an immersion into Crown Royal's legacy of pushing flavor boundaries. So, here's to the refined journey of Crown Royal Blackberry Whisky, where innovation meets taste.

title: Blue Canyon Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml: Medium-bodied and approachable with a silky texture and long, layered finish. Lush and elegant cherry and raspberry flavors show on the palate with hints of vanilla, oak spice and rose petal on the nose.

title: Batasiolo Barolo Riserva 2017
bodyHtml:
A careful selection of grapes and long ageing in oak casks give this wine a haunting character rich in mature aromas.

Deep garnet red colour with delicate orange tinges. It is distinguished by a particular aromatic range tending towards maturity. It is jammy, nutty, toasty and floral with a good development. A winning taste with supply hints backed by a good alcohol content and a harmonious union of tannins and crispness, offering pleasant sensations of completeness and body.

title: Cirillo 'Ancestor Vine 1850' Semillon 2019
bodyHtml: The Cirillo 1850 Semillon is harvested entirely from a single vineyard at Light Pass in the Barossa Valley. It is believed to be the oldest producing Semillon vine on earth! Picked early in the season, normally in mid‐late January, it is harvested with great acidity. The fruit is handpicked and basket pressed. The wine is then tank fermented, without oak.  It is extremely pale green/yellow, almost clear in colour.

title: Garrison Brothers Single Barrel Bourbon
bodyHtml:
The embodiment of unique, authentic bourbon and arguably, the Holy Grail of Custom Craftsmanship.. Every barrel has its own distinct personality and character. That’s the true beauty of Single Barrel. This bourbon has a beautiful, dark copper color and long legs.

The  nose is a very aromatic savory impression, accompanied by mahogany, mocha, burnt cinnamon stick, clove, nutmeg and rubber.  on the palate, indulgent dark chocolate / cacao nib is followed by tobacco, burnt pastry, dried orange, molasses, butterscotch, nutmeg and ginger.  Great length with gradually fading tobacco, light touch of toffee and more nutmeg.

title: Mauro Molino Langhe Nebbiolo 2024
bodyHtml: Italy's best source for wine reviews, the Gambero Rosso, raves about the family-owned and managed Mauro Molino estate: 'The Molinos again showed why they are among the top Langhe producers.  This Nebbiolo is made from 10-30 year old vines in Monforte d’Alba and Guarene. Fermentation in stainless steel, then aging six months in large French oak casks coopered in Austria."

title: Pierre Gimonnet & Fils Rose de Blancs Brut (NV)
bodyHtml:
The Gimonnet family has been growing vines in Champagne since 1750. Pierre Gimonnet, for whom the estate is named, began making wine in the village of Cuis in 1935; today Pierre’s grandsons Didier and Olivier are in charge of the estate.

This wine is mostly vinified with chardonnay and a hints of pinot noir to give a light pink colour and to add berries fresh fruit flavours.

title: Blason d'Issan 2014 (by Chateau d'Issan)
bodyHtml:
Chateau d’Issan is in the heart of the Margaux appellation, a truly privileged location, which explains the outstanding quality of its wines. The mild weather, regulated by being close to the sea and the Gironde Estuary, provides ideal conditions for vine growth. The vines at Chateau d’Issan benefit from close, on-going care designed to produce perfectly ripe grapes. 

92 Points - James Suckling

Very aromatic and bright with currants and orange peel on the nose. Full body, velvety tannins and a delicious finish. Love the texture to this. Fantastic second wine of Issan. Majority is merlot. Beautiful now but better in two or three years.

title: Signe Macon Villages 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Signe Macon Villages 2023 is a premium white wine from France, specifically produced in the Mâconnais region of southern Burgundy. This wine belongs to the Mâcon Villages regional appellation, which comprises several villages known for producing superior dry white wines primarily from Chardonnay grapes. While specific historical details for the Signe label are limited, the Mâconnais area has a rich winemaking history dating back to the Gallo-Roman era and was further developed by the powerful abbeys of Cluny and Tournus.

Spirit Description

Crafted from 100% Chardonnay grapes, this wine is typically vinified in stainless steel vats to retain its vibrant fruit expression and regional freshness.

  • Colour: This white wine presents a brilliant, golden yellow hue that is both limpid and bright.

  • Aroma: The nose is fresh and delicate, featuring a floral and fruity bouquet of citrus, green apple, and white fleshed fruits, accented by hints of almonds, mint, and honeysuckle.

  • Palate: It delivers a well balanced and refreshing palate with a supple texture. The taste profile showcases lively flavours of orchard fruit and lemon zest layered with a subtle chalky minerality.

  • Body: The wine is light to medium bodied, noted for its spontaneity and charming, elegant structure.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, crisp, and clean finish that underscores the purity of the Chardonnay fruit.

  • ABV: The alcohol content for this vintage is approximately 13.5%.

Food Pairing

The fresh acidity and mineral edge of this Chardonnay make it a versatile partner for a variety of seasonal and lighter fare.

  • Savoury: It pairs exceptionally well with roasted chicken with herbs, white fish, or veal cutlets in a cream sauce.

  • Seafood: The wine's crispness is a classic match for oysters, grilled prawns, mussels, and shellfish.

  • Appetizers: It is a perfect choice for an aperitif, served alongside tapas, vegetable quiches, or snails.

  • Cheese: Mâconnais goat cheeses, Brie, and Camembert provide a creamy contrast to the wine's vibrant fruit notes.

  • Serving: For the best expression of its character, serve well chilled between 10°C and 12°C.

title: Castello Dei Rampolla Sammarco 2020
bodyHtml:
This elegant red hails from Italy, specifically from the heart of Tuscany in the Chianti Classico region, near Panzano. Castello dei Rampolla has been in the di Napoli Rampolla family since 1965, with Alceo di Napoli pioneering organic and later biodynamic viticulture well before it was mainstream. Today, his children Luca and Maurizia carry on this philosophy, producing wines that respect the land and emphasize purity and terroir expression.

Wine Description

The 2020 Sammarco is a compelling blend of 85% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Merlot, and 5% Sangiovese. In the glass, it presents a deep ruby colour. The nose is striking, offering layers of ripe blackcurrants, cassis, and dark cherries, interwoven with notes of graphite, fresh herbs, and subtle violet. On the palate, it is full-bodied with polished tannins, showcasing concentrated dark fruit alongside hints of tobacco, leather, and spice. The wine balances power and finesse beautifully, leading to a long, savoury finish marked by mineral nuances and refreshing acidity. It is best enjoyed from 2025 through 2040.

Accolades

  • Vinous - 97 points

  • Wine Advocate - 96+ points

  • James Suckling - 96 points

Food Pairing

Try this superb Tuscan red with grilled Florentine steak, roasted lamb with rosemary, or aged pecorino. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Bodegas Emilio Moro 'Malleolus' 2023
bodyHtml:
Bodegas Emilio Moro 'Malleolus' originates from Spain, specifically from the Ribera del Duero region and the Castilla y León subregion. The name 'Malleolus' is derived from the Latin word for 'majuelo,' which is how locals in Pesquera de Duero refer to their vineyards. Founded three generations ago, the winery is currently managed by the third generation of the Moro family, who emphasize a common policy based on tradition, innovation, and social responsibility. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the fullest expression of terroir through sustainable practices while preserving a long family legacy of land stewardship.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a very deep cherry red colour and a medium-to-full body with a powerful, concentrated structure. The sensory profile is intense and complex, featuring a nose of ripe black fruits, such as blackberry jam, alongside resinous notes of cedar, tobacco, and balsamic herbs. On the palate, it is velvety and well-balanced, delivering flavours of spiced berries and cherries integrated with nuances of vanilla, chocolate, coffee, and cloves. The finish is long and firm, showcasing chalky tannins and a persistent aftertaste of dark fruit and aromatic woods.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Tempranillo (locally known as Tinto Fino).

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is aged in French oak barrels (often 500-litre) for approximately 18 months, which helps achieve a balance between maturity and freshness.

  • ABV: Recorded at 14.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate is not specifically certified organic for this bottling, the Moro family utilizes organic and sustainable practices to respect and protect the environment.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and intense flavours of 'Malleolus' make it an ideal companion for rich and savoury dishes. Suggested pairings include:

  • Meats: Roasted lamb, venison, beef steak, or roasted elk.

  • Hearty Fare: Rich game dishes and stewed red meats.

  • Mediterranean Cuisine: Substantial Mediterranean dishes and mature cheeses.

title: Montifaud Vieux Pineau des Charentes Blanc
bodyHtml: The name Chateau de Montifaud is historically linked to the land where the distillery sits. A castle used to be located there, which is why the word "Chateau" is permitted to be used, a rarity in Cognac. Documents show that the Vallet family has been making cognac here since 1837, though the family believes production started even earlier. Sixth generation Laurent Vallet currently runs the business, taking over from his father Michel in 2010, though Michel still plays an active role in the business.

title: Livio Felluga Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Italy, this Sauvignon Blanc originates in the northeastern region of Friuli Venezia Giulia, specifically the Colli Orientali subregion, renowned for its premium white wines. Livio Felluga, a pioneering figure in the region, established the winery in the 1950s after fleeing war-torn Istria. Now run by the fifth generation, the estate is celebrated for combining tradition with innovation, cultivating vineyards on hillside slopes to produce expressive, terroir-driven wines.

This vintage opens with a pale straw yellow hue and greenish reflections. The nose is vibrant and refined, marked by intense notes of passion fruit, grapefruit, elderflower, and tomato leaf. On the palate, the wine is fresh and structured, offering crisp acidity balanced by layers of citrus zest, gooseberry, and mineral nuances. Medium-bodied with a persistent, aromatic finish, it showcases Sauvignon Blanc’s characteristic brightness and purity. Composed entirely of Sauvignon Blanc grapes, it is best enjoyed young, within 2–4 years, to capture its fresh aromatics and vivid energy.

Food Pairing
Excellent with grilled asparagus, goat cheese salads, and fresh seafood such as oysters or scallops. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Graham's Port Gift Pack - 5 x 200 ml
bodyHtml:
This lovely Selection of Port allows one to really appreciate Graham's house style through the dry crisp white port to the incredibly complex 20-year-old Tawny. The selection also includes Graham's signature wine, Six Grapes.

 This gift pack contains 1 bottle (200 ml) of each of the following:

 Fine White Port

2014 Late Bottle Vintage

Six Grapes Reserve

10-Year-Old Tawny

20-Year-Old Tawny

title: Chateau de la Gardine Chateauneuf du Pape 2022
bodyHtml:
Château de la Gardine Châteauneuf du Pape originates from France, within the Southern Rhône region and the Châteauneuf du Pape appellation. One of the most deeply rooted estates in the region, its winemaking traditions date back to the 18th century. The 52-hectare vineyard is characterized by a terroir of gravel, loam, limestone, and pebbles, with some of the oldest vines planted in 1925. The estate is renowned for its unique, asymmetric 'Gardine' bottle shape and a winemaking philosophy that produces powerful, classically styled wines aged in a combination of small French oak barrels and large foudres.

Wine Description

This red blend typically presents an intense ruby red colour and a full body. The sensory profile is warm and spicy, featuring a concentrated nose of blackberries, dried plums, and liquorice, often accompanied by herbaceous 'les garrigues' and peppery thyme accents. On the palate, the wine is rich and fleshy with a velvety texture, delivering flavours of dark fruit and violets alongside distinct notes of tobacco and leather. The finish is long and structured, sometimes described as slightly chewy in its youth.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically a blend of 65% Grenache, 15% Mourvèdre, 15% Syrah, and 5% Muscardin.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its harmonious balance between ripe fruit intensity and traditional Southern Rhône freshness.

  • ABV: 14.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate employs high-quality viticultural practices, this specific bottling is not generally noted as certified organic in standard listings.

Food Pairing

The robust and earthy character of Château de la Gardine makes it a versatile partner for rich, savoury dishes.

  • Meats: It pairs excellently with grilled lamb chops, beef rib with bone marrow, roast pheasant, or a traditional Provençal beef stew.

  • Savoury & Hearty: Suggested pairings include wild boar casserole, venison stews, or roasted quails with cherries and balsamic reduction.

  • Regional Classics: Matches well with hearty cassoulet or truffle-infused dishes such as scrambled eggs or omelettes with truffles.

  • Cheese: Complements well-aged hard cheeses such as Comté, Manchego, or Cantal.

title: Grant Burge Paso Ink Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Inspired by its Australian roots and Californian pioneering spirit, the Grant Burge Paso Ink hails from Paso Robles AVA fruit. The California Central Coast region is renowned for its Cabernet Sauvignon that produces rich, powerful and flavor packed wines. Paso Ink showcases the region’s potential by including fruit from more than a dozen local growers. The average elevation of these vines is 800 feet and the soils are predominantly calcareous based.  

True to its namesake, Paso Ink is intensely inky in color as it is opulent and powerful on the palate. Paso Ink offers consumers premium packaging cues with a vibrant and contemporary label that features an abstract gold ink splatter, reflecting the intensity and vibrancy of the wine.

title: Domaine des Carlines Chardonnay Cotes du Jura 'En Lya' 2020
bodyHtml:
Patrick Ligeron's Domaine des Carlines is quickly making an impression not only on Jura geeks, but also on fans of terroir in general. The domaine vineyard holdings lie partly within the Chateau-Chalone sub-AOC, each one delivering its own particular expression of the Chardonnay and/or Savagnin grapes.

The En Lya vineyard is a west-facing site on high limestone content. Despite the increased sun exposure, the fruit still retains impeccable acidity and balance thanks to the site's high elevation. The wines are aged 12-15 months in barrel with spontaneous malolactic fermentation.

title: Grant Burge Shiraz Miamba 2020
bodyHtml:
Totally opaque inky black core with a deep dark red black hue. Aromas of liquorice, ripe blackberries and dark plum rise from the glass overlaying toasty vanillin oak and spice. Rich and juicy the full bodied palate is teeming with lusciously textured black fruit flavours that include blackberries, liquorice and dark plum underscored by lightly toasted vanillin oak and spice.

Round opulent mouthfeel with velvet smooth tannins.

Medium to long aftertaste of black cherries, liquorice, blackberries, subtlety toasted vanillin cedar and spice.

title: Tool Shed Late to the Party Hazy IPA - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Late to the Party is a vibrant, modern Hazy IPA from Calgary’s Tool Shed Brewing Company. As the name cheekily suggests, Tool Shed known for their classic, clear-as-a-whistle ales like People Skills was famously "late" to jump on the New England IPA (NEIPA) trend. However, when they finally arrived, they did so with technical precision. This beer is designed to be a "juice bomb," prioritizing massive tropical fruit aromatics and a soft, silky mouthfeel over the aggressive, resinous bitterness of old-school IPAs.

Beer Description

Late to the Party pours a thick, opaque "pineapple juice" yellow with a dense, creamy white head and a soft, glowing appearance.

Aroma: The nose is an absolute explosion of tropical fruit. It leads with a heavy hit of passion fruit, mango, and crushed pineapple, followed by a bright citrus burst of tangerine and lime zest. There is no "dank" or piney scent here; it is purely focused on the "punch-bowl" aromatics of modern hops.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-to-full bodied with a pillowy, "juicy" mouthfeel that coats the palate. It leads with flavors of ripe stone fruit and tropical nectar, followed by a soft, bready malt middle. The bitterness is exceptionally low and "soft," providing just enough structure to keep the beer from being cloying without any sharp or "scratchy" hop burn.

Profile: It sits at a sturdy 6.5% ABV and a low perceived bitterness, making it dangerously easy to drink for its strength.

Technical Notes: To achieve the signature haze and "pillowy" texture, Tool Shed utilizes a heavy dose of flaked oats and wheat in the grain bill. The hop profile is driven by a massive double dry-hop (DDH) regimen, typically using varieties like Citra and Mosaic. By adding the majority of the hops during and after fermentation, they extract all the essential oils for aroma and flavor while leaving the harsh bittering acids behind.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Caol Ila Single Malt 13 Year Old 'Discovery'
bodyHtml:
The perfect introduction to G&M's portfolio, the Discovery range has been created to provide an introduction to single malt whiskies from some of Scotland’s most admired distilleries. Each expression sits within one of the bold flavour profiles of ‘Sherry’, ‘Smoky’ or ‘Bourbon’, making these single malts ideal for the whisky-lover who enjoys exploration through flavour and character.

On the nose it is bright. Clean sweet peat smoke, pineapple, pear, and sweet malt.  On the palate it has sooty earthiness (with a hint of graphite). Develops to honey sweetness, with apple, banana and ginger.  The finish is long but quite light. Slight effervescence as the peat starts to fade.

title: Langmeil 'The Freedom 1843' Shiraz 2022
bodyHtml:
The Lindner family of Langmeil Winery has been immersed in the Barossa’s culture of farming, food, wine and community for six generations. Their commitment to quality in all aspects is unwavering and any wine that bears the Langmeil name represents the family’s pursuit of excellence in wine and community. 

Deep crimson with purple hues. An intense aroma of ripe Satsuma plum, herbal and savoury notes combine with hints of cedar and sweet spices. Rich, sweet fruit is balanced wonderfully with briary and sweet spices and lovely, silky tannins. A full-bodied, textural wine, showing great complexity with hints of cedar and allspice flowing through to the lengthy, brambly fruit finish.

title: Langmeil 'The Fifth Wave' Grenache 2021
bodyHtml:
The Fifth Wave is Langmeil’s most treasured Old Vine Garden Grenache and is dedicated to the fifth generation of the Lindner family. The vineyard was planted in 1973 and serves as a call to arms to preserve, promote and protect the best of the Barossa as well as an oft-overlooked variety.

Medium depth crimson with purple hues. Dark cherry, raspberry and sweet spice mingle with hints of cedary oak and savoury notes, adding complexity. Juicy red berries and dark cherries flow through the palate, with the soft, sweet fruit balancing with sweet and briary spices. The finish lingers on a fruity and spicy note with typical chalky yet fine-grained tannins.

Pair with slow cooked lamb shanks; crispy skin salmon; roast pork or duck; dark chocolate.

title: Masi Mezzanella Amandorlato Recioto 2016
bodyHtml:
A cru Recioto wine that stands out for particular complexity and for its characteristic almondy aftertaste. Its subtle charm is thanks to the well ventilated vineyards that allow it to go through ideal appassimento conditions. It’s also considered a real rarity.

The first impression on the palate is sweetness and richness. Then its seductive magic kicks in to make it more serious, drier and fuller. The final impression is of bitter-sweet tastes, such as in plain chocolate and high quality cigars.

title: Martell VSOP Cognac
bodyHtml:
Martell VSOP is an authentic expression of the Martell style. The House perpetuates an uncompromising savoir-faire by ageing its eaux-de-vie exclusively in barrels of fine-grained oak.

This specificity encourages the development of refined aromas, exemplified by the lusciously fruity notes of Martell VSOP.

title: MMAD Vineyards Chenin Blanc 2021
bodyHtml:
Lovely mild ripening conditions gave Chenin Blanc with an array of characters including citrus peel, cumquat, hessian, sea spray and a hint of lanolin. The fruit was hand-picked, and approximately one third was whole bunch pressed to old French oak puncheons, and the balance crushed for more skin contact, and fermented in concrete vats before going to puncheons. 

The wine combines a fine-ness from the whole bunch pressed component with more texture from the crushed fruit, and an array of characters including citrus peel, cumquat, hessian, sea spray and a hint of lanolin. The palate is long and framed by crisp acidity, with exciting ageing potential.

title: Nabal Crianza 2018
bodyHtml:
Very vivid garnet color of great density and depth with a clean and bright appearance. On the nose, it has varietal aromas of ripe red fruit with a spicy and sweet background, standing out aniseed and other infusion herbs notes.

It is powerful and expressive entrance on the palate maintaining the balance between fruit and noble wood.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

title: Puerto Del Monte Mencia 2020
bodyHtml: Deep cherry red with purple highlights, intense aromas of black fruit, notes of tar and pencil lead that characterise the Mencia grape with some hints of spices. Fresh acidity well balanced with the sweetness of the alcohol and a touch of oak, medium bodied with a long fruity finish

title: Quilt Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve 2018
bodyHtml:
Deep garnet in color. Baking spice aromas of cinnamon and clove are intertwined with dark stone fruits, blackberry pie, vanilla, white pepper and notes of oak and rose. A full bodied palate presents layers of dark black cherry, coffee, blackberry, dark currant and notes of milky chocolate. Beautifully rounded with an unctuous velvety mouth-feel.

This refined wine is a sensational expression of what a Napa Valley Cabernet represents with a long, smooth finish and fine grained tannins.

title: Les Halos De Jupiter Chateauneuf Du Pape 2022
bodyHtml:
Les Halos de Jupiter Châteauneuf du Pape originates from France, within the Southern Rhône region and the Châteauneuf du Pape appellation. The project is a collaboration between winemaker Michel Gassier and the renowned oenologist Philippe Cambie, who shared a winemaking philosophy focused on magnifying the quality of Grenache. The estate is named after the planet Jupiter—symbolizing the leading Châteauneuf du Pape appellation—and its moons, which represent surrounding Southern Rhône appellations. This wine is crafted to showcase the region's diverse terroir by blending fruit from stone-covered vineyards for intensity, clay soils for richness, and sandy terroirs for purity.

Wine Description

This red wine is typically bold and opulent, designed to express the character of very old vines. It presents a full body that is often balanced by a lively acidity. The sensory profile features high fruit intensity, offering an opulent bouquet of ripe blackcurrants, dark cherries, and plums. On the palate, the wine reveals complex layers of blackberry fruit accented by subtle hints of black pepper and spice. Well-structured tannins provide a robust framework, leading to a harmonious finish.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional blend typically consisting of 85% Grenache (from vines over 100 years old), 10% Syrah, and 5% Mourvèdre.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its balance of power and finesse; it is aged in a combination of one and two-year-old French oak demi-muids, foudres, and concrete vats to refine its structure.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 14% and 15%.

  • Organic Status: Produced with minimal intervention—including no fining or filtering—though it is not generally specified as certified organic.

title: MMAD Vineyards Grenache 2021
bodyHtml: Planted in 1939. Lovely mild ripening conditions produced Grenache of great intensity. There is a purity and a density, but also a lightness that belies the energy and power of the fruit. The aromatics are intense and perfumed with notes of raspberry coulis, cinnamon and a hint of fennel seed which unfurl in the glass. The grapes were mostly destemmed and fermented as whole berries in open concrete and stainless steel before ageing in used 500 litre puncheons.

title: Quintessa Estate Proprietary Red Blend 2015
bodyHtml:
The 2015 Quintessa is a seductive wine beginning with intense black fruits and warms pice and finishing with dense yet silky tannin. Opening with aromas of black cherry and blackcurrant, the wine expands in the glass as notes of clove, bay leaves, and dark chocolate layering on top of crushed rock, graphite and red earth. Fine grained tannin and dense fruit bound together by lively acidity and a long finish complete the picture and promise further pleasure in the years to come.

97 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blue fruits, blackberries, tile and lead pencil. Full body, firm tannins and a fresh, bright finish. Layered and intense with white-pepper and salt undertones. Love the finish to this racy young wine. Beautiful blue fruits! Drink in 2020 and onwards. From biodynamic grapes.

94+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2015 Proprietary Red Wine has a very deep purple color and notes of crushed rocks, dusty earth and iron ore over blackcurrants and black cherries, plus hints of tapenade, bay leaves, underbrush and chargrill. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is bursting with densely packed, youthful black fruits, framed by finely grained tannins and refreshing acidity, finishing long and mineral laced.

title: Tilia Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
Sustainability pioneers, Tilia Wines were the first to carry the certified sustainable seal from Bodegas de Argentina on the label.

Today, Tilia is the first wine label to illustrate the path toward sustainability in Argentina. Through powerful symbols, the label highlights Tilia’s core values and represents programs implemented by Tilia to practice both environmental and social sustainability. 

Bright red color with intense violet hues. Fresh nose of violets and rich plum marmalade laced with chocolate and vanilla oak flavors. A soft, sweet entry leads to a well-structured and long, persistent wine. Round, silky tannins.

Pair this Malbec with a meat dish that mirrors its tangy berry flavors like cranberry pot roast or roast duck with sour cherry sauce.

title: Antinori Le Mortelle 'Botrosecco' Maremma Toscana 2023
bodyHtml:
Botrosecco is ruby red in color. Its nose is intense, and complex defined by sensations of ripe red fruit, sour cherries and plums, together with spicy notes of paprika and white pepper.

On the palate it’s velvety, savory with mouth filling tannins and a persistent finish.

The aftertaste brings back fragrant hints of red fruit, tobacco and cocoa.

title: Culmina Chardonnay Dilemma 2022
bodyHtml:
Culmina Family Estate Winery, situated on the Golden Mile Bench in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley, was established in 2007 by the Triggs family, renowned for their contributions to Canadian winemaking. In 2019, the estate transitioned to new ownership under Arterra Wines Canada. The winery is celebrated for its meticulous vineyard practices and commitment to producing wines that reflect the unique terroir of their estate.

Wine Description:

The 2022 Dilemma Chardonnay is crafted exclusively from estate-grown fruit sourced from Margaret's Bench, a high-elevation vineyard known for its cooler climate. This wine presents a harmonious blend of richness and elegance. On the nose, it offers inviting aromas of brioche, nougat, and honeyed floral notes. The palate reveals flavours of apricot, ripe orange, and warm butter, balanced by the freshness characteristic of Culmina's terroir. Aging in a combination of new and seasoned French oak barrels, along with stainless steel, imparts subtle vanilla bean nuances and a creamy texture, culminating in a long, savoury finish.

Food Pairing:

This Chardonnay pairs beautifully with dishes such as pumpkin agnolotti in toasted hazelnut brown butter, pan-seared scallops with lemony salsa verde over cannellini bean ragù, and grilled rainbow trout accompanied by a warm chanterelle mushroom and lentil salad. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character.

title: Amador Whiskey 10 Barrel Hop
bodyHtml:
Sourced from pedigreed craft distillery in Anderson Valley, CA. 90% two-row barley whiskey + 10% craft IPA beer based whiskey. Aged in French oak for 2 1/2 years. Finished in Napa Cellars American + French oak for another 6 months. Bottled at 96 proof.

Amador Whiskey Co. believes in elevating the art of distilling to create premium spirits with an edge. This dedication to craft results in the unique taste experience of Amador’s limited release 10-Barrel Hop-Flavored whiskey. Aged in ten barrels over four years, this whiskey is a blend of 90% straight malt and 10% hop-infused whiskey distilled from craft IPA beer, resulting in a satisfying spirit that speaks to its origins.

Both elements are aged separately for over two years in French oak wine barrels before joining forces in Amador Whiskey Co.’s family Chardonnay barrels for another two years. And the taste changes whether enjoyed neat, over ice, or in a whiskey-based cocktail. Tasting neat will bring rich flavors of caramel, cloves and vanilla on the palate with an extra long finish. With a bit of ice, the hoppy IPA flavors are coaxed out, blending smoothly with those classic whiskey notes, perfect for hot summer days when an ice cold beer is the only thing on your mind.

This is a drink to take your time with, to savor the flavors that will only deepen with age. We recommend cellaring a case of this limited release, for enjoyment over the next 20 to 30 years.

title: Rum Nation Guatemala Gran Reserva
bodyHtml:
On the nose it is flowery, delicate, with the typical perfume of cane sugar, and a hint of buttery character. Dates, raisins, orange rind.

Easy, velvety, warm on the palate. Sweet but not syrupy, with notes of vanilla, cola, raisins. Crème brûlée, and a final herbal touch like vermouth, with a hint of orange rind, anise and liquorice

The finish is getting more tannic and toasted, with the herbal note and some black pepper coming to the fore. Delicate final burst of warmth. 

One of the lightest rums in their selection, with a pleasantly sweet touch in the Latin style but without ever becoming too sugary.

title: Catena Cabernet Franc 'San Carlos' 2024
bodyHtml:
The Catena Cabernet Franc Appellation El Cepillo presents a purple color with red ruby tones. The nose offers elegant aromas of spices, and fresh herbs as thyme and rosemary, red berries, cassis and raspberries, with layers of cedar. The mouthfeel is full and rich with cassis, raspberries flavors and notes of black pepper and oregano. The finish is bright and fresh with finely grained tannins.

This versatile wine is fantastic paired with rich meat dishes such as stews and braises, Latin dishes with heat and a little kick such as enchiladas or moles and lamb dishes and tomato based pasta and sauces. Additionally this wine is delicious paired with dark chocolate and berries and also served alongside a cheese plate.

title: K Vintners Cattle King Syrah 2020
bodyHtml:
Located at the base of the Blue Mountains in Walla Walla Washington, K Vintners opened its doors to the public on December 3rd, 2001. The property at 820 Mill Creek Road where the winery sits was homesteaded in 1853 with the adjacent farmhouse built in 1872.

This one rides the range with notes of grilled meat, dried herbs, wild sarsaparilla, white pepper and a whisper of menthol. Dusty, taunting and moody. Baked rock, earthy licorice, black cherry compote, with a lightness of being. Lively, dense and enticing. It goes the distance.

title: Chloe Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
The Chloe Wine Collection is created for sophisticated wine enthusiasts who appreciate all things extraordinary and timeless. Specially crafted by winemaker Georgetta Dane, the iconic wines of the Chloe Wine Collection offer the structure and depth of exceptional fruit from some of the world’s preeminent wine growing regions.

Chloe Pinot Noir is an elegant, yet complex wine that delivers supple structure, ripe fruit flavors and robust aromas. It exudes fruit-forward flavors and aromas of fresh strawberry, juicy plum and black cherry. A plush, velvety mouthfeel is followed by an undeniably, satisfying finish with soft notes of spicy clove and vanilla.

title: Chateau Paveil de Luze 2016
bodyHtml:
The dress is dark garnet with a pretty purple nose. Aromas of very ripe red fruit. Fresh mouth, small vegetal notes. The wine is very elegant and marked by a cabernet-sauvignon class, the whole is refined and of great length. A very big Paveil-de-Luze!

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2016 Paveil de Luze is terrific. Wafting from the glass with notions of crème de cassis, loamy soil, cigar wrapper, pencil shavings, dark chocolate and rose petals, it's medium to full-bodied, layered and concentrated, with fine depth at the core and a more introverted, tightly wound profile than the 2019.

90 Points - Decanter

Approaching readiness, the oak remains a little dominant but there is a ripe berry-fruit feel that ripples through as the wine opens in the glass. Fresh acidity holds your attention through the palate, with touches of peony flowers on the finish. Drinking Window 2021 - 2038

title: Orin Swift Machete
bodyHtml:
Orin Swift Machete originates from California, USA, with fruit sourced from premium vineyards across the state, including prominent sites in the Yorkville Highlands, Alexander Valley, and the prestigious Monte Rosso vineyard. Founded by visionary winemaker Dave Phinney, Orin Swift is renowned for its bold, expressive wines and a philosophy that prioritizes quality fruit selection and creative blending over traditional appellation constraints.

Wine Description

This red blend is nearly opaque with a deep aubergine and inky purple core. The nose is immediate and complex, offering a diverse array of aromas ranging from ripe plum, cassis, and lilac to more savoury notes of espresso bean, new leather, and wet concrete. On the full bodied palate, the wine reveals intense layers of blackberry compote, dark chocolate, and black cherry, balanced by a touch of blood orange zest. Its structure is defined by firm, puckering tannins and a lingering acidity that leads into a long, velvety finish with traces of minerality.

The Iconic Labels: A Collector’s Dream

Machete is as famous for its exterior as its interior. Shifting away from traditional vineyard sketches, Phinney treated the bottle like a film poster.

  • 12 Unique Labels: Each case of Machete features 12 different high-contrast, cinematic photographs.

  • The Aesthetic: The images—featuring a white police car and a model with a machete in the desert—evoke a "grindhouse cinema" vibe that turned the wine into an instant collectible.

  • Scarcity & Hype: By using 12 different labels, Phinney created a "set-collecting" culture among wine enthusiasts, making every bottle a conversation starter.

*Receive one of twelve possible labels.  *Specific labels cannot be requested.

title: Liquore Strega
bodyHtml:
Strega liqueur is one of the most famous Italian liqueurs , it is unique and unmistakable for its taste, thanks to the exclusive use of natural ingredients. Its processing starts with the grinding of about 70 herbs and spices, they are being selected from all over the world, and each one of them has unique properties. Among these herbs we find Ceylon cinnamon, Florentine iris, Italian Apennine juniper, Samnite mint, which grows along the riverbanks in the whole region.

The liqueur gets its characteristic yellow colour from the precious Saffron that is added to the herb distillate. Strega liqueur is aged in ash barrels over a long period of time to ensure a perfect blending of the different aromas.The resulting distillate is 40% proof and only after the ageing process is the liqueur bottled and distributed all over the world.

title: Our Story Charming White 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine is from Canada, specifically from the Niagara Peninsula region in Ontario. Produced by Between The Lines Winery, it is part of a distinguished portfolio crafted by the Wertsch family, who arrived in Niagara from Germany in 1998. The winery, established in 2010 by brothers Greg and Yannick Wertsch, is located in Niagara-on-the-Lake and operates with a philosophy of combining Old World traditions with New World innovation to create accessible and flavour-focused wines.

Wine Description

Our Story Charming White is a refreshing and fruit-forward blend that typically features Chardonnay, Riesling, Gewurztraminer, and Vidal grapes. It displays a vibrant sensory profile with aromas of citrus, orchard fruits, and pear, accompanied by subtle wet stone and mineral undertones. On the palate, the wine is plush and bright, offering flavours of lemon drops, ripe peach, and pear. This light and crisp white is categorized as very dry and maintains a refreshing character without oak aging. The ABV is 11.0%.

title: Petaluma Cabernet Sauvignon Coonawarra 2019
bodyHtml:
Deep red with purple hues with a lovely dark fruit driven nose. Hints of cassis and spice.

Petaluma White Label Coonawarra Cabernet Sauvignon is a medium bodied, elegant, dry red wine. The palate has hints of mocha with subtle herbaceousness and spice. Soft velvety tannins follow dark berry fruit characters.

title: 19 Crimes Shiraz
bodyHtml:
19 Crimes Shiraz originates from Australia, sourced broadly across the warm, sun-drenched vineyards of South Eastern Australia. Owned by Treasury Wine Estates, the brand pays homage to the 19 infractions that carried the sentence of "punishment by transportation" to Australia during the late 18th and 19th centuries. Operating with a consumer-focused philosophy centered on accessibility, consistency, and technological innovation (such as their pioneer augmented reality labels), 19 Crimes crafts a crowd-pleasing, bold Australian Shiraz that emphasizes fruit sweetness, plush textures, and rich oak influence.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a deep, saturated ruby-garnet appearance in the glass with bright purple highlights. It possesses a full-bodied, generous, and round structure defined by a plush, velvety, and fruit-forward texture. The sensory profile is fragrant and upfront, opening with bold aromas of ripe dark plums, black cherries, and raspberry jam, interwoven with prominent secondary notes of sweet vanilla oak, dark chocolate, mocha, toasted coconut, and gentle baking spices. On the palate, it delivers an approachable, jammy core of dark berry fruit balanced by low-to-medium natural acidity and soft, completely rounded tannins. The finish is smooth, warm, and lingering, characterized by a sweet impression of dark fruit, vanilla, and cocoa.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Shiraz (Syrah).

  • Stylistic Notes: Fermented in stainless steel tanks to extract generous fruit and color, the wine undergoes aging on American oak staves and chips to impart its signature rich vanilla, chocolate, and spice profile. A small touch of residual sugar is deliberately maintained to enhance its soft, mouth-filling sweetness and early approachability.

  • ABV: 13.5% to 14.1% (varies slightly by market/bottling).

title: Martell VS Cognac
bodyHtml: Martell VS cognac, the VS meaning `Very Special` was created around 150 years ago under the name of 3 stars (***) and today has a worldwide reputation. Harmonious and well balanced, its taste is fruity, mellow and with a pleasing fresh and pure feeling in the mouth.

title: Domaine Nico 'Grand Mere' Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
With a winning combination of cool weather, high elevation and well-draining alluvial soils, it is no surprise that Mendoza's Uco Valley is one of the most exciting up-and-coming wine regions in Argentina. Healthy, easy-to-manage vines produce low yields of high-quality fruit, which in turn create flavorful, full-bodied wines with generous acidity.

Red cherry and strawberry fruit aromas. As it opens up, a little black fruit combined with a spicy character of black pepper and cinnamon. Medium acidity with a horizontal mouth.

title: Catena Malbec Vista Flores 2023
bodyHtml: On the nose, it offers intense aromas of ripe raspberries and cassis with notes of pepper, clove, and a touch of cedar. On the palate, it is full-bodied and rich and displays layers of black currant and black raspberry with notes of cedar and oregano. This Cabernet Sauvignon is an elegant wine with silky tannins that provide structure and a long and persistent finish.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Caol Ila Single Malt 2007 'Connoisseurs Choice'
bodyHtml:
Passion for single malt Scotch whisky has been at the heart of this family business for four generations. This range is an ever-changing collection of unique perspectives on distilleries’ own bottlings, non-chill-filtered single cask and small batch expressions bottled at cask strength — exceptional one-offs.

Cured meat aromas are balanced by ripe green apples and cocoa powder. Fruitcake notes develop with hazelnuts and autumnal spice.

Stewed fruit and honeycomb give way to rich cinnamon. Cracked black pepper comes to the fore alongside malted biscuit and sweet smoke. A full finish with dark chocolate, toasted oak and bonfire embers.

title: Domaine Nico 'Histoire d'A' Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Luscious raspberries, strawberries and hints of cinnamon, dried herbs, black pepper and cloves define the nose while the first sip reveals a rich well-rounded texture and silky smooth tannins. This is a very elegant yet approachable New World-style Pinot Noir with juicy fruit flavours carefully balanced by a gentle streak of acidity on the finish. 

A great wine to enjoy with charcuterie, cheeses, or a big plate of fresh pasta served with a rich tomato sauce.

title: Domaine Nico 'La Savante' Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
This profound and meticulously structured red wine originates from Argentina, within the Uco Valley region of Mendoza and the high-altitude district of Gualtallary. Domaine Nico is a specialized, pioneering project from the Catena family, founded by Dr. Laura Catena out of her deep fascination with exploring the extreme limits of high-altitude terroirs for Pinot Noir. The estate follows a winemaking philosophy focused on extreme parcel precision and site transparency, naming this specific bottling 'La Savante' or the scholar to denote its serious, intellectual precision. The fruit is sourced exclusively from a tiny, 1.44-hectare plot inside the Adrianna Vineyard, originally planted in 1994 on soils layered with boulder debris and dispersed calcium carbonate.

Wine Description

Domaine Nico 'La Savante' Pinot Noir presents a translucent, medium ruby-red appearance in the glass. Its sensory profile is incredibly fragrant and high-toned, unfolding subtle yet enveloping aromas of rose petals and fresh red fruits alongside complex notes of earthy thyme, rosemary, black pepper, and sweet clove. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, racy, and slender, showcasing an adventurous core of red berries, cherries, and garrigue herbs. It is characterized by its outstanding, mouthwatering acidity and an angular, chalky texture driven by incisive yet velvety tannins. The finish is exceptionally long and crystalline, balancing a fine varietal austerity with juicy succulence, integrated oak, and persistent notes of wet stones and savory herbs. This 100% Pinot Noir reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5%. The fruit was fermented with roughly 40% whole clusters in 600-litre roll fermenters before maturing in French oak barriques, only 10% of which were new. While the vineyard is cultivated with absolute respect for the natural environment, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Langmeil Cabernet Sauvignon Blacksmith 2023
bodyHtml:
In 1842 a 32-year-old Blacksmith, Christian Auricht, arrived from Prussia with his wife and four children. He settled in the new village of Langmeil and established a forge in what was to become a thriving trading post.  His original smithy remains to this day and is a feature of the winery’s heritage setting.

Bright and rich berry fruits coat the palate and combine with brambly spice, hints of black olive and liquorice. Medium to full-bodied with velvety, fine-grained tannins adding to the structure which flows through the long, fruity and spicy finish.

title: Shaw and Smith Shiraz Adelaide Hills 2022
bodyHtml:
Shaw + Smith Shiraz is a medium bodied cool-climate Shiraz, in which balance is more important than power.

The Adelaide Hills was long considered too cool to ripen Shiraz. By the early 2000s, though, the potential for outstanding Shiraz from the right sites in the Adelaide Hills was compelling, and the first Shaw + Smith Shiraz was made in the 2002 vintage. Since then, Shiraz in the Hills has gone from strength to strength, its hallmarks being fragrance, intensity, and medium bodied elegance.

title: Sandhill Harvest Series Red 2017
bodyHtml:
Each bottle of Sandhill wine is made from grapes that come from one of six unique BC vineyards - Sandhill Estate, Hidden Terrace, Rocky Ridge, Casorso Family, Osprey Ridge, and Vanessa Vineyard. Each and every vineyard possesses its own magical combination of soil type, microclimate, exposure, drainage and other geographical idiosyncrasies. The complex, subtle, unique character of each vineyard reveals itself in your glass.

Their winemaking techniques are designed to enhance, not interfere with, the naturally occurring fruit flavors in their wines. Two words you will hear frequently from Sydney Valentino to describe her winemaking technique are "gentle" and "non-interventionist." Great fruit, helped along only when necessary using a soft touch, will result in great single vineyard wine from BC.

title: Schrader Cabernet Sauvignon CCS Beckstoffer To Kalon 2019
bodyHtml:
Extraordinarily rich and inky dark, the opulent Schrader CCS is loaded with gobs of ultra-ripe blue and black fruit aromas and flavors. Summer-picked blackberries, boysenberries, wild blueberries, and plum preserves abound and are layered with alluring notes of violets, black truffles, sweet earth, graphite, and fruitcake spice. Offering lavish fruit character, fine structure, and silky-smooth tannins, Schrader CCS carries forward the tradition of excellence for the marque as one of the most honored and adored wines in our portfolio.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard CCS from the To Kalon Vineyard in Oakville is another heavenly wine in the lineup. I always find another level of purity in this cuvee, and the 2019 offers remarkably pure creme de cassis-like fruits as well as notes of white flowers, incense, toasted spice, and unsmoked tobacco. Full-bodied, deep, round, and plush on the palate, I love its tannins, it brings incredible richness while staying perfectly balanced and fresh, and it’s just already a joy to drink.

98 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Hugely concentrated black cherries are joined by dried spices, slightly peppery notes and cedar on the nose, while the palate is full-bodied and plush yet firm at its core. It's a well-rounded, elegant example of Oakville Cabernet, nicely balanced, with attractive notions of blueberry and mint on the lengthy finish. 

98 Points - Wine Spectator

Throws off a range of sassafras, chaparral and anise aromas before yielding up a prodigious core of açaí berry, plum and blackberry compote. Offers a nice interplay of power and purity, with tarry violet and loamy incense accents. While tannic through the finish, this terrific version reveals a subtle ripple of acidity and a hint of iron. 

98 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of mint, eucalyptus, crushed blackcurrants and lead pencil follow through to a full body with dark fruit and mint on the palate. Velvety tannins and a long finish. Fantastic structure. Savory. Minerally.

title: Whistlepig 15 Year Old
bodyHtml:
