Sustainably harvested right off their 500-acre farm, the wood has more rings than the standard American oak used in whiskey barrels, imparting more flavor during maturation. Custom toast and char profiles takes the flavor even further, just like a perfectly toasted marshmallow. 

When launched in 2016, this was the oldest release from Whistlepig. Made with predominantly Canadian rye, this is finished in toasted virgin-oak barrels which add extra spiciness to the toffee and caramel flavours.

title: Catena Alta 'Historic Rows' Malbec 2022
bodyHtml: Catena Alta Malbec shows a deep violet color, with blue reflections. The nose is elegant and complex with ripe red and black berry fruits, notes of violets and lavender and a touch of leather, spice and vanilla flavors. The palate is full and rich with soft and sweet tannins and a silky, smooth structure. Multiple layers of rich cassis, black currant and blackberries are interwoven with hints of licorice and black pepper. Its lengthy finish is marked by wonderful minerality, finely grained tannins and lively acidity.

title: Don Adriano 1950 Anejo Ultra Premium Tequila
bodyHtml:
Don Adriano 1950 is an Ultra Premium Anejo Tequila - Aged 18 months in French Oak Barrels and produced using only 100% Blue Agave; it delivers a tequila sipping experience like no other.

Don Adriano 1950 Anejo Ultra Premium Tequila is a true masterpiece in the world of spirits. Crafted with the utmost dedication and aged for an impressive duration, this tequila offers an unrivalled taste experience. Distilled in the heart of Mexico's tequila region, it embodies the essence of tradition and craftsmanship. The 1950 Anejo boasts a rich amber hue and complex, smooth flavour profile with notes of vanilla, caramel, and oak, thanks to its lengthy aging process in oak barrels. Sipping this tequila is like journeying through time and history, a true testament to the art of tequila-making. It's a must-try for connoisseurs seeking the pinnacle of tequila excellence.

title: Grand Marnier Grande Cuvee Quintessence In Baccarat Crystal
bodyHtml:
Quintessence Grande Cuvee is the ultimate masterpiece of Maison Grand Marnier. Extremely rare and inspired by the brand’s origins, Quintessence embodies pure luxury. Its unrivalled elegance and exclusivity are elevated by the handcrafted Baccarat crystal carafe. This extraordinary spirit is based on a century-old recipe found in the brand archives: Bigaradia oranges are macerated in Cognac and double distilled, yielding a drink richer, more full-bodied and complex than ever before. This limited release Grande Cuvee is crafted with the rarest and oldest hors d’âge cognacs, exclusively from Grande Champagne, including a 70 years old vintage from the Marnier Lapostolle private family cellar. Grand Marnier Quintessence Cognac is a pure expression of heritage & ultimate beauty. A liquid so rare, savouring it becomes an unforgettable experience.

The crystal decanter – an incredible piece of art created by Maison Baccarat. A crystal podium with a drop-shaped decanter, handmade and unique – holds Grande Cuvee Quintessence liqueur. This masterpiece from Grand Marnier is crafted from the oldest family reserves – Hors D’âge cognacs up to 70 years old – exclusively from Grande Champagne. The blend comes from only 11 selected barrels, among which 2 are from 1947, and 3 demijohns from Paradis, which are believed to be even older. Everything about Grand Marnier Cuvee Quintessence reveals its uniqueness.

title: Thirty Bench Benchmark Red 2020
bodyHtml:
Dry and smooth, this full bodied red blend features Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Merlot. Each year the blend is chosen by the Winemakers to feature and highlight the best of the vintage. Extra Dry with 2.0 gm/L of residual sugar, this deep red features ripe juicy dark fruits with hints of spice and oak.

Serve this award winner with grilled meats, flank steak, leg of lamb and aged Cheddars.

title: Pajzos Tokaji Esszencia 2010
bodyHtml:
Esszencia is literally the pure liquid of the Aszu berries that run off naturally from the vats in which they are collected during harvest. The sugar concentration is enormous (residual sugar over 450g/l) and the alcohol level remains low (3.3%). Unlike any other wine, the Esszencia maintains its quality and drinkability for at least 200 years!

Dark amber color. The nose shows very complex aromas of fresh apricot, honey, acid drop candy, that come along with hints of candied ginger and Earl Grey tea. Luscious and full-bodied on the palate with notes of apricot tart, white peach and lemon, completed by cardamom flavours. Great balance on a long, creamy finish.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

This rich, mouthcoating sweetie shows impeccable balance, with tangy, citrus-laced acidity and a zesty hint of candied ginger providing support for the fine range of fleshy poached peach and raspberry fruit, spun honey, lemon thyme and ground cardamom flavors. Long and creamy on the mouthwatering finish.

title: Wild Turkey 101 Rye
bodyHtml:
A legendary 101 proof straight rye whiskey known for its deep golden amber color and warm, smoky flavor with a rich, balanced aroma of vanilla and spice. Noted for its long finish, Wild Turkey 101 Rye exhibits a signature spiciness that stands up in a classic cocktail. It’s what we think a real American rye should taste like.

Rich, balanced caramel with honey and vanilla aromas. Warm, smoky flavors of grain and spice.  Long and lingering spice with hints of smoke finish.

title: Catena Alta Malbec 'Historic Rows' 2020 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Bodega Catena Zapata is one of Argentina's high altitude Malbec pioneers. The Catena family began making wine in Mendoza in 1902. Nicolas Catena, third generation family vintner, was one of the first to see the potential of Mendoza's mountain vineyards for producing high quality Malbec.

Catena Alta Malbec shows a deep violet color, with blue reflections. The nose is elegant and complex with ripe red and black berry fruits, notes of violets and lavender and a touch of leather, spice and vanilla flavors. The palate is full and rich with soft and sweet tannins and a silky, smooth structure. Multiple layers of rich cassis, black currant and blackberries are interwoven with hints of licorice and black pepper. Its lengthy finish is marked by wonderful minerality, finely grained tannins and lively acidity.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Gorgeous and elegantly layered, with orange peel, hibiscus and hints of river mint as the entry to red currant and wild strawberry flavors, which are enlivened by a crunchy base of mineral acidity that allows the core flavors to spread out and linger around suave tannins.

93 Points - James Suckling

Ripe and racy fruit full of dried strawberries, cherries and some sweet spices. Juicy and generous on the medium-bodied palate with some sappy, sweet fruit. 

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The perfumed and floral 2020 Catena Alta Malbec is serious and keeps the balance and poise in this warm and challenging year of the pandemic. It's ripe without excess at 13.8% alcohol and has mellow acidity, coming through as serious and balanced in the palate, with abundant, fine-grained tannins and a tasty and long finish. It's a serious Malbec that overdelivers for the conditions of the year.

title: Bardos Reserva 2020
bodyHtml:
Bardas Reserva is a wine of the D.O. Ribera del Duero collection, elaborated by the Bards Winery, OF the Grupo Vintae.

It is made with grapes from old vineyards of low production, selected from the best areas of Ribera del Duero. Among them, in mythical reserve, it stands out an old vineyard of low production of about 60 years of ink of the country, selected in the central part of the denomination in the zone of Fuentemolinos, seated in a slope of great slope and clay-calcareous soil, and another vineyard Adjoining, younger, about 20 years of Cabernet Sauvignon.

title: Liquidity Wines Pinot Noir Reserve 2020
bodyHtml:
Each individual pick of Pinot Noir is lovingly hand sorted, destemmed, and fermented in small batch vessels. The fermenters were hand plunged and gently pressed to French oak. After 16 months in oak, every barrel was tasted as part of our blending process.

Dreamy dark red cherries, forest floor, and cedar aromatics grab your attention. On the palate, this Pinot Noir is both powerful and refined, with dusty tannins and lush juicy fruits.

Pair with chile rellenos, mushroom burger, and a fireside reading nook.

title: MMAD Vineyards Shiraz 2021
bodyHtml:
Sourced from a vineyard in Blewitt Springs planted in 1941, careful and considered winemaking, with just a small amount of whole bunches, culminated in a wine with intense fruit and some savouriness to balance everything out beautifully.

While the packaging might be minimal, the flavour isn't. Dark and red fruits, violets and spice shine over a foundation of firm tannins and energetic acid. This is a wine you want to sip just so you can make the flavours last forever.

The fruit was hand-picked, 80% destemmed, and whole berries and whole bunches were fermented in open vats with gentle extraction. 

There is old vine concentration, and opulence on the palate, with notes of mulberry, blackberry, cinnamon, and dark chocolate. Generous, layered, and complex, with tannins and savoury notes that keep the fruit in check.

title: Hetszolo Tokaj Sweet Szamorodni 2017
bodyHtml:
Szamorodni is a historical wine category of Tokaj just as 3 Puttonyos Aszu. They have basically the same richness and style in nose and taste too. At the production of Sweet Szamorodni they do not select the aszu berries out from the bunch of grapes but they macerate and press it as it was given by the nature.

Deep lemon yellow in colour with a aromatic nose of pear, fig marmalade and faint smoky note; the palate is sweet and medium bodied with medium acidity and flavours of baked pear and fig followed by an enduring preserved peach-like finish.

It marries well with creamy, fruity desserts and of course goes well with goose liver too. It is worth trying also with oriental food or dishes with some curry spice for example.

title: Writers' Tears Cask Strength 2023 Limited Edition
bodyHtml: A blend of aged Single Pot Still and aged Single Malt Irish whiskeys matured on American oak casks and bottled at cask strength. Notes of butterscotch, ginger and pepper mingle with the flavours of toasted oak, dark chocolate and sweet vanilla, finishing with a bold and complex character. Serve neat or on the rocks.

title: Spier Frans K Smit 2017
bodyHtml:
The artistic Spier winery is located close to the South African town of Stellenbosch. The history of this beautiful and sprawling winery dates back to as early as 1692, which makes it one of the most ancient wineries in South Africa. 

Spier Frans K. Smit Red Blend is a sophisticated wine that offers the perfect balance of power and elegance. Produced by one of South Africa’s most renowned wineries, this blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Malbec, and Cabernet Franc is a true masterpiece. The wine boasts a deep ruby color with aromas of blackcurrant, cherry, vanilla, and spicy oak. The palate is rich and complex with flavors of dark fruit, tobacco, and chocolate. The tannins are firm, yet velvety, leading to a long and satisfying finish. This wine pairs well with hearty dishes such as roasted meats, stews, and aged cheeses.

title: Ken Forrester The Gypsy 2017
bodyHtml:
Ken Forrester Wines The Gypsy is a South African red wine that is rich, complex, and full-bodied. It is a blend of seven different grape varieties, including Grenache, Syrah, Mourvèdre, Carignan, Petit Verdot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Viognier. The wine is named after the winery's founder and owner, Ken Forrester, who is well-known for his commitment to producing exceptional wines.

The Gypsy is a popular choice for wine enthusiasts who appreciate a bold and flavorful red wine. It has aromas of dark fruits, spices, and licorice, and a palate that is full of flavor with notes of plum, blackcurrant, and black pepper. This wine pairs well with red meat, game, and strong cheeses.

title: Caol Ila Moonbrach 'Spaceman Series' Single Malt 2007
bodyHtml:
Pronounced “Cull Eela." It’s the Gaelic name for the Sound of Islay, which separates the island from Jura. For some, the distillery’s pronunciation is as remote as its location, sitting as it does on the rugged eastern coast, where it has remained hidden from view since 1846. However you say it, the fine, smoky whisky produced by generations of islanders is worth exploring.

Aged for 14 Years.  Distilled in Aug 2007 & Bottled in Mar 2022.  Matured in a Hogshead.

title: Bread & Butter Prosecco Rose 2022
bodyHtml:
This DOC Prosecco Rose is made in a small town in Italy near Venice is shimmering, delicately-fruity, and persistent.

What you’ll enjoy about this wine: Aromas of florals and citrus are followed by lively yet soft notes of ripe apple, pear and white peach. Balanced with refreshing acidity, the creamy mouthfeel and layers of soft bubbles persist through to the long, elegant finish.

title: Aroa Mutiko 2020
bodyHtml:
Aroa Mutiko 2020 unveils its youthful allure and a seductive fruit-laden bouquet from the initial taste. On the nose, it unfurls scents of fresh cherries and raspberries, complemented by hints of licorice and a spiced undertone, beckoning to an exuberant tasting experience. On the palate, its fruity and robust character is affirmed, with supple tannins, delivering a velvety texture that glides effortlessly, imparting a lasting and delightful impression. It is the quintessential choice for those in pursuit of an expressive and effortlessly enjoyable red wine.

Organic and Vegan.

title: Kanonkop Pinotage 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
In 1924, while heading up Oenology and Viticulture at the University of Stellenbosch, Professor Abraham Perold made a crossing of two grape varieties that today forms the South African wine industry’s unique selling point. Pinot Noir and Cinsaut (once known as Hermitage in South Africa) became Pinotage, a red-blooded South African grape variety.

First vintage: 1973

Vibrant aromas of blueberries, ripe plums, black cherries, cinnamon and vanilla on the nose. The palate is sultry and luxurious, with densely packed flavours of berry compote, wild bramble, plum tart and spicy Christmas cake.

Ripe tannins are beautifully intertwined between the layers of fruit, adding a dense and broad texture to the wine. The subtle spicy tones and plush black cherry flavours on the lingering finish completes a very elegant and ageworthy wine.

title: Summerhill Cipes Ariel Organic 2000
bodyHtml:
Summerhill Pyramid Winery (established 1991) is Canada's largest organic winery, BC's first Demeter biodynamic vineyard, and Canada's foremost producer of sparkling wine. Their winemaking philosophy is that organic and biodynamic provides the royal road to producing exceptionally beautiful, authentic, terroir-based wine that will connect you with the beautiful Okanagan Valley.

Fresh and vibrant primary fruit among the rich, mature, aged character. Creamy lemon custard, warm brioche, candied orange, lemon zest, ripe apple, dried apricot, walnut, and ginger on the palate. This complexity, creaminess and opulent mouthfeel can only come with extended sur lie bottle aging.

A beautiful accompaniment to baked oysters, Dungeness crab, and goat cheese in phyllo pastry.

title: Chateau Laballe Bas Armagnac VSOP - 2.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Deep in the heart of Gascony, is Chateau Laballe, a family owned estate that produces an admirable range of still wines and perhaps more famously, the distilled spirit known as Armagnac. Chateau Laballe’s founding father, Jean-Dominique Laudet, purchased the domaine back in 1820. After a career in the spice trade, Jean-Dominique’s dream was to settle down in the country and produce France’s oldest spirit. Today, Cyril Laudet and his wife Julie represent the 8th generation to continue the family tradition of producing a range of fine Armagnacs.

The youngest wine in Laballe's V.S.O.P is 4 years old. Nuances of white flowers, plums and vanilla with a supple and well rounded finish.

title: Pepperjack Barossa Shiraz 2024
bodyHtml:
Rich dark red in colour with a dark purple rim, the nose shows rich concentrated red and blue fruits, dark chocolate and rich mocha notes with hints of spice and cedary oak. 
The palate is rich and plush with good structure. There is a concentrated layer of berry fruit and oak which is balanced with the fine tannins to give length and power while finishing soft and full of flavour.

title: Godet Renaissance Grande Champagne Cognac
bodyHtml:
A Unique Grande Champagne Cognac: For the Renaissance Man and the Modern-Day Drinker

Introducing Godet Renaissance - an exceptional cognac blend of the oldest eaux de vie that the Godet House has to offer, some dating back to the 19th century. This 70 to 170-year-old Paradis Cognac is truly a masterpiece. The name Renaissance was given to this cognac as it was miraculously preserved in an underground cellar that was walled up during the war. This cognac is made exclusively from Cognac premier cru, the Grande Champagne.

The crystal glass decanter is completely hand-crafted and covered with a rose gold leaf, making it a true work of art. Each of the treasured decanters that leave our Atlantic cellars is numbered, making it an exclusive collection item.

This precious Cognac should most certainly be enjoyed neat, its premier cru provenance and blend of 19th and 20th-century eaux-de-vie provide a luxurious and rare drinking experience unlike any other. To enjoy the Cognac's aromas further, hand warm your snifter or tulip glass before taking that very first sublime sip.

title: Santa Rita Pewen 2022
bodyHtml:
Santa Rita Pehuén originates from Chile, within the prestigious Apalta subregion of the Colchagua Valley. Produced by Viña Santa Rita—one of Chile’s oldest and most historically significant wineries, founded in 1880—Pehuén represents the estate's pinnacle expression of Carmenère. Named after the ancient Pehuén (Araucaria or Monkey Puzzle tree) native to the Chilean Andes, the wine is sourced from a single, historic vineyard block planted in 1938 on deep granite-and-clay soils. Operating with a ultra-premium philosophy, Santa Rita combines meticulous hand-sorting, micro-fermentation, and extended oak maturation to elevate Carmenère into a world-class, age-worthy luxury wine.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, opaque purple-violet appearance in the glass with an inky dark core. It possesses a full-bodied, dense, and velvety structure defined by a plush, mouth-coating, and expansive texture. The sensory profile is rich, seductive, and highly complex, opening with an intense bouquet of black plum preserves, dark cherries, and wild blackberries, seamlessly layered with signature Carmenère notes of dark chocolate, roasted coffee beans, dried herbs, sweet tobacco leaf, graphite, and subtle red paprika spice. On the palate, it delivers a massive, fruit-concentrated core supported by fine-grained, ripe, and polished tannins and a balanced thread of acidity that keeps the palate lively. The finish is remarkably long, lingering, and opulent, leaving persistent echoes of cocoa, sweet cedar, and dark berry fruits.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically 90% to 95% Carmenère, blended with small proportions of Cabernet Sauvignon or Syrah for structural framing.

  • Stylistic Notes: Hand-harvested from low-yielding 80+ year-old vines in Apalta. The grapes undergo cold maceration prior to fermentation in small stainless steel tanks and concrete vats. The wine undergoes malolactic fermentation and ages for approximately 18 to 20 months in French oak barrels (with a high percentage of new oak), followed by extended bottle aging prior to release.

  • ABV: Typically 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The opulent weight, dense fruit core, and distinct savory-spice profile of Pehuén Carmenère make it a magnificent companion to rich, high-end gastronomy.

  • Fine Meats: Pairs exceptionally well with grilled prime ribeye, roasted rack of lamb with garlic and herbs, slow-braised beef short ribs, or char-broiled steaks with chimichurri sauce.

  • Game & Poultry: Ideal when served alongside pan-roasted duck breast with a plum or blackberry reduction, wild boar ragù, or venison loin.

  • Earthy Dishes: Complements dishes featuring dark mole sauce, roasted root vegetables, truffle-infused risottos, and dishes with roasted bell peppers or cocoa-nib rubs.

  • Cheeses: Matches gracefully with mature, firm cheeses such as aged Manchego, 24-month Comté, sharp cheddar, or smoked Gouda.

Vintage Quality

Sourced from the warm, amphitheater-shaped Apalta valley, Pehuén demonstrates remarkable consistency across vintages. The old, deep-rooted vines planted in 1938 navigate climatic variations effortlessly, extracting natural balance and soil minerality. In warmer vintages, Pehuén exhibits lush, broad fruit weight with sweet chocolate and plum undertones. In cooler or more balanced years, it showcases heightened floral aromatics, fresh blackberry purity, and distinct herbal-spice complexity. Designed as a flagship collectible, Pehuén is approachable after decanting in its youth, yet possesses the structural concentration and tannic frame to cellar gracefully over 15 to 25 years.

title: Rocas de Sena 2021
bodyHtml:
96 Points - James Suckling

Focused nose, showing fresh red chili chocolate with cigar, truffle, mint, olive and grilled meat. This is a medium-to full-bodied red with incredibly juicy and bright fruit and fine, caressing tannins that linger in the long, creamy but precise finish. Elegant and extremely drinkable with complexity. on top of 38% malbec, 25% syrah, 15% cabernet sauvignon, 14% grenache and 8% petit verdot. The real deal. Second wine of Seña. Drink or hold.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A new second wine here, the 2020 Rocas de Sena is named after the rocky soils from Seña is different as it includes Mediterranean grapes in the blend. This is the first vintage produced, and it’s a blend of 38% Malbec, 25% Syrah, 15% Cabernet Sauvignon, 14% Grenache (from their property in Vertientes, where the Syrah also comes from) and 8% Petit Verdot from selected plots from their property in Aconcagua. 2020 was warm and dry and saw an early harvest that delivered concentrated and powerful wines, this one at 14% alcohol and with a pH of 3.53 and 6.09 grams of acidity. It fermented mostly in stainless steel and 10% in concrete eggs, and the blend matured for 22 months in French oak barrels, 65% of them new. The nose is very expressive, and the palate is juicy and textured palate, a little warmer and riper than the Sena, with that Mediterranean twist from the Garnacha and Syrah. It has an intense nose, quite primary, with red berries, herbs and even a citrus touch, but there is no sweetness at all. The fine tannins have grip, and the finish is dry and serious. The élevage was similar to the Seña, but in the future, they might go for a slightly shorter élevage and use some foudres. The wine has a very nice bright color and is still young and lively, very much in the serious and elegant style of the Seña, despite the warm inaugural vintage, showing in the juicy palate. 30,000 bottles produced.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

An enticing nose offers notes of blackberry and blueberry alongside green bell pepper, light notes of cassis add to its complexity. On the well-structured palate, chalky but firm tannins reveal plum, blackberry, cherry and eucalyptus. Vibrant acidity balances out the flavors throughout the delicious finish. This Malbec-based blend, with Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, Grenache and Petit Verdot, is fresh and bold with good aging potential.

title: Royal Tokaji 'Nyulaszo' Aszu 1st Growth 6 Puttonyos 2017
bodyHtml:
Nyulaszo (meaning “a good place to catch hares”) is a celebrated First Growth vineyard overlooking the village of Mad. Its volcanic bedrock is overlaid with rich, brown clay interspersed with lighter rhyolite tuff, consistently producing racy, perfumed, elegant wines with a steely backbone. This wine is lively and elegant, highly perfumed on the nose with ripe peach and apricot on the palate balanced by silky acidity. The finish is long and incredibly complex. Sip on its own as an aperitif, serve with fruit-based desserts or hard cheeses, or enjoy this mouth-watering wine on its own instead of a pudding.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Amber colored in the glass, this single-vineyard Nyulaszo wine has aromas of jasmine, orange zest and freshly picked apricot. In the mouth there are flavors of orange marmalade, white peach and apricot with a good balance of sweetness and acidity.

94 Points - Decanter

Ginger spiced fresh apricot, orange blossom, marmalade and a hint of flint on the nose. White pepper-dusted apricot and ripe persimmon, with crystallized ginger spiciness and raisin, dried apricot complexity follow through.

94 Points - Vinous

This has a lighter and perhaps less complex bouquet compared to Royal Tokaji’s other cuvees, though it develops nicely in the glass to reveal lemon verbena, dried mango and wild peachy scents. The palate is much more open, its impressive weight and concentration effortlessly counterbalanced by a fine line of acidity. This is very harmonious and poised, and almost Sauternes-like toward the finish.

title: Achaval Ferrer Finca Mirador Malbec 2015
bodyHtml: A glorious nose of perfumes, flowers and dark berries. Full body, with a wonderful backbone of tannins with delicate milk chocolate, berry and hints of walnuts. Goes on for minutes.

title: Imagery Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml: Balanced and smooth, this Pinot Noir has layered notes of jammy strawberry, cherry and boysenberry. The fruit flavors are enriched by well integrated oak and blended with Petit Verdot to achieve a substantial body. This Pinot Noir is rich and complex with soft tannins and a long layered finish. Petit Verdot contributes to the beautiful color and substantial body of the wine.

title: Yalumba The Tri Centenary Grenache 2018
bodyHtml:
Established in 1849, Yalumba is Australia’s most historic family owned wine company. It remains fiercely independent and extremely progressive through the generational ownership by the Hill-Smith family. Yalumba’s longevity and success is a result of patience, collaboration and progressive thinking. 

Medium red in color. Aromas of red cherry, berry fruits, anise and milk chocolate are melded by complex herbs and spices. The hallmark of this wine is 100 day post-ferment maceration which imparts incredible silky texture and refinement to the palate, creating a textural wine with depth, structure, vibrant acidity and defined tannins. Stunning now, it will gradually evolve over the medium term.

Pair with pork and pear sausage rolls with prune relish, grilled broccoli, green olives and white bean salsa or buckwheat, pomegranate and carrot tabbouleh.

96 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of blueberries and wild herbs, as well as raspberries and a complex, spicy and fragrant edge. Blood orange and pomegranate here, too. The palate is smoothly emulsified and has red-cherry, raspberry, orange and blood-orange flavors. Pithy kick on the finish and plenty of concentration. Very resolved. 

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

From 130-year-old vines, this Grenache offers an enticing, intriguing perfume of strawberries still on their stems, cut flowers in water, vanilla bean and florals. The mid-weight palate is starting to show some bottle age, with slightly cooked red-berry-jam flavors, but there’s still a lick of juicy freshness and a tannic tug.

title: Orin Swift Abstract Red Blend 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The Orin Swift Abstract Red Blend is a rich and expressive proprietary red wine from California, United States. Founded in 1998 by David Swift Phinney, Orin Swift Cellars began with just two tons of Zinfandel and grew into an iconic brand known for its bold winemaking and evocative, collage style labels. Now part of the Gallo portfolio, the winery continues to follow Phinney’s original philosophy of sourcing high quality fruit from diverse vineyards across the state to create wines with signature drinkability and complexity.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a dark purple core with a vibrant neon ruby rim. The aromatics are intense and broody, featuring notes of ripe black plum, cacao, and black pepper, layered with hints of cedar, dried porcini, and forest floor. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and coating, offering lush flavors of blueberry preserves, dark chocolate, and balsamic glaze, balanced by a bright acidity and a touch of anise. The finish is long and satisfying, showcasing chewy tannins and a unique umami note similar to eggplant yakitori.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and dark fruit profile of the Abstract Red Blend make it an excellent companion for bold, savoury dishes such as braised beef, grilled steaks, or rich barbecue. It also pairs beautifully with Mediterranean cuisine, earthy vegetarian dishes like mushroom risotto, or a truffle brie served on crusty bread.

title: Schild Estate Pramie 2019
bodyHtml: Inviting notes of creamy freshly scraped vanilla pods and a melange of dark compote fruit draws the drinker in to discover more. Once in the mouth, flavors of blood plums and blackberries are supported by classic Shiraz notes of coffee bean and subtle pepper spice. There is a depth and chewiness to the palate which hints at the quality of fruit, but also a brightness and vitality that is derived from the elevated location of the vineyard site. The fruit rolls out though the back of palate all the while encapsulated by a well resolved tannin frame which will soften over time in the cellar.

title: Chloe Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
The 2022 Chloe Chardonnay is a sophisticated white wine from Monterey County, California, crafted entirely from Chardonnay grapes. This vintage exemplifies the region's cool-climate terroir, offering a harmonious balance of fruit and oak.

Colour: Pale gold with a bright, clear hue.

Aroma: Enticing aromas of fresh citrus, apple, and pear, complemented by notes of creamy butter, vanilla, and toasted oak.

Palate: Ripe flavors of fresh citrus, apple, and pear, with a creamy mid-palate and soft hints of vanilla and toasted oak.

Body: Medium-bodied with a well-balanced structure and sophisticated intensity.

Finish: Unforgettable, silky finish that lingers gracefully.

Accolades: The 2022 vintage has received positive reviews, including a 90-point rating from Wine Enthusiast, highlighting its light, easygoing, and clean aromas of honeysuckle, almond, and lemon butter, with a citrusy kick on the palate.

title: Fattoria del Cerro Vino Nobile di Montepulciano Riserva 2017
bodyHtml:
Fattoria del Cerro, with its 94 hectares of Vino Nobile di Montepulciano vineyards recorded in the register, is the largest private estate producing Vino Nobile. The spaciousness and the different exposition of the vineyards allow selecting the best grapes to make high quality wines.

Fattoria del Cerro Vino Nobile di Montepulciano Riserva is a vivid ruby red color. Nose of violet, wild black cherry, wild berries and touches of spices with a slight vanilla finish. Full, enveloping, fine and elegant flavor, with an excellent persistence.

92 Points - James Suckling

Dark-cherry, dark-plum, dried-herb and mushroom aromas with some spices and walnuts. It’s medium-bodied with creamy tannins and lively acidity. Fresh and vibrant, with a chalky texture. Flavorful finish with excellent length. Drink or hold.

title: Summerhill Estate Keter (NV)
bodyHtml:
Summerhill’s “Keter” was selected to be served to the heads of government during a working lunch at the 44th G7 Summit, hosted in La Malbaie, Quebec, Canada, June 9, 2018.

The very best grapes from multiple vintages were hand-selected for this Okanagan Valley variation on a Right Bank Bordeaux-style blend. 

This medium-to-full-bodied red wine has notes of bright red plum, blackberries, and black cherries deepened with violet, vanilla and mocha. On the palate, its tannins are supple with refreshing acidity, delicate minerality, and a long finish.

Enjoy this special bottle with roasted venison, rib-eye steak, veal Bolognese or fine cheeses.

title: Orin Swift Palermo Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
A brooding red core with a rich cardinal hued rim, the wine opens with classic Napa Cabernet Sauvignon aromatics—ripe cassis, sunburst raspberry, graphite and chapparal surrounded by a balanced frame of new oak. The bold aromatics translate onto the palate seamlessly with more cassis, red licorice, fresh fennel and mixed berry compote. Integrated yet prominent puckering tannins finish off the wine with a touch of lingering black tea.

This label features a photo of mummified 16th-century Cardinal in Palermo, Italy. The photo's sense of power, reverence and dignity is reflective of how their winemaker crafts Cabernet.

title: Frank Family Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Take a trip back in time at the Frank Family Vineyards. First constructed as the Larkmead Winery in 1884, the building was refinished with native sandstone from the nearby hills in 1906 and still stands tall today. The massive stone edifice is considered an archetype of California’s wine country; it appears on the National Register of Historical Places and is listed as a Point of Historical Interest in the state of California.

A bright and balanced wine with vibrant aromatics of baked apple, white nectarine, and toasted oak. A lively entry of tropical fruit and citrus expands with notes of rich lemon curd and brioche bread pudding. Ample yet refined, this unmistakably Carneros wine finishes with a refreshing wave of acidity.

title: Glen Grant 18 Year Old
bodyHtml: Introduced in 2016 (along with a 12 Year Old expression), this 18 Year Old Glen Grant delivers gorgeous notes of vanilla, nuts and caramel.

title: Champagne Edouard Duval Brut d' Eulalie (NV)
bodyHtml:
This Champagne has a bright and pale-yellow gold color appearance with light straw reflections. It is animated by fine, vivid bubbles which forms arrays of persistent beads. The visual sensation announces a rich and fresh wine.

The first nose expresses the earthly and marine origin of our terroir, evoking iodine notes and smoked limestone, relayed by violet fragrances, with some exotic pepper accents. The aeration of Champagne adds to the pleasure notes of black cover, cherry, pomelo, blackberry, with some subtle woody toasted bread accents.

The first contact in the palate is rich and fresh, with a creamy and melted effervescence. This Champagne develops a luscious and full-bodied fruity profile, accentuated by an integrated acidity of pomelo and fleshy fruit. The middle of the mouth is orchestrated by a limestone minerality that confers fruity volume, iodine salinity and long aftertaste. The juicy finish relays a general harmony with a freshness of limestone and saline that resonates in the palate, the signature of our terroirs.

title: Stonestreet Estate Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml:
Stonestreet Estate Vineyards is located in the Alexander Valley of Sonoma County, California. Founded in 1989 by wine industry pioneer Jess Jackson, the winery is renowned for its high-elevation 'mountain' wines. The estate spans 5,500 acres across the Mayacamas Mountain range, with vineyards rising from 400 to 2,400 feet in elevation to capture the diverse mesoclimates of the region.

Wine Description

The Estate Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep garnet purple colour and opens with vivacious aromas of redcurrants, black raspberries, and dried Provence herbs. The palate is full bodied and rich, featuring notes of dark plum, blood orange, star anise, and cocoa. This wine is celebrated for its fantastic energy and freshness, supported by ripe, grainy tannins and a long, savory finish.

title: Graham's Vintage Port 2020 'Bicentenary Limited Edition'
bodyHtml:
This wine reveals extraordinary aromatic scope, ranging from exotic açaí berry fruit and typical traces of mint which are very much a Malvedos hallmark. There are also suggestions of fresh pine and orange blossom, delivering a sensation of great freshness. On the palate there are layers of bright, concentrated black fruits (blackcurrant and blackberry) wrapped in a seductive robe of opulence and charm. Quite irresistible.

Blend:40% Touriga Franca, 25% Touriga Nacional, 22% Sousão, 7% Old Mixed Vines (Field Blend), 6% Alicante Bouschet

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Lush, open and expressive, with captivating violet, boysenberry and mulberry aromas and flavors that stream forth, underscored by a mouthwatering licorice snap note. This has lots of energy in reserve, too. Best from 2038 through 2060.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Vintage Port is a blend of 25% Touriga Nacional, 40% Touriga Franca, 22% Sousão and various others, including a blend from old vines. It comes in with 118 grams of residual sugar after 18 months in old oak vats. This likely got a little extra incentive in terms of its declaration because of Graham's bicentenary, but it is a pretty good offering. Sweet and easy, this comes into a good place with just a couple of hours of aeration. It opens disjointed and angular, then resolves into a lovely Port with great fruit and good supporting structure. This needs some time. It should develop more and improve. When it gets to where it is going, it is going to be delicious. Let's start here, but plan on cellaring this. There were 3,000 bottles made in this bicentenary limited edition.

94 Points - James Suckling

A plump and juicy Graham with lots of iodine, plum and sweet-berry character. Some herb and mint, too. Medium-to full-bodied, very sweet and flavorful with lots of length. Fine tannins and refined character. Fresh and delicious. 3,000 bottles. One for earlier drinking. Try after 2028.

title: Old and Rare Springbank 31 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Old and Rare Springbank 31 Year Old is a Single Cask Single Malt Scotch Whisky from the country of Scotland, specifically the Campbeltown region. The original spirit was distilled at the Springbank Distillery, which is one of the three remaining distilleries in Campbeltown. Springbank is distinct for producing three different styles of single malt (Springbank, Longrow, and Hazelburn), malting its own barley, and bottling on site. This expression was independently bottled by Hunter Laing & Co. for their prestigious 'Old & Rare Platinum' series.

Spirit Description

This is a single cask, cask strength whisky, distilled in 1991 and matured for 31 years before being bottled in October 2022. It was aged in a single refill hogshead cask. The refill cask maturation allows the secondary esters and Springbank's complex character to take precedence over heavy oak influence. The colour is described as burnished gold. The nose offers aromas of apricots, Highland toffee, and light smoke. The palate is subtly sweet, with notes of marzipan, peaches, and green herbs. The Springbank house style is coastal, oily, briny coconut, and medium-bodied smoke. The body is rich, complex, and shows remarkable depth from the long maturation. The finish is medium-length and full of fruity hints. It was bottled at cask strength, 49.3% ABV.

Accolades

This is an extraordinary and collectible release, paying tribute to the craftsmanship of Campbeltown's revered distillery. Only 188 bottles of this single cask single malt were released globally. The older expressions of Springbank are highly sought after by collectors, with this 31 year old bottling considered beyond scarce.

title: Piper Heidsieck Rare Rose Millesime 2014
bodyHtml:
Rare Rose Millesime 2014 sweeps you up in a whirlwind of aromas. Fourth rosé vintage of the house, the wine’s sensory eccentricity enhances the expressive palette of Rare Champagne. A talkative wine whose unbridled energy reveals itself immediately, this rosé vintage later reveals a tender, fragrant intensity, both floral and spiced.

The wine’s incredibly dense, coppery rose gold colour anticipates the richness and depth of its bouquet. The bubbles are very subtle.  Rare Rose Millesime 2014 displays its extraordinary personality from the first nose. After strong aromas of red and dark fruits - wild strawberry, black cherry, blackberry - and blood orange, on the second nose, musk, apricot and candied orange covered in dark chocolate come together, simultaneously revealing a hint of candied fruit and chocolate, violet, rose, and guava. Finally, spiced aromas - star anise and pepper - emerge, complemented by a touch of kirsch and brioche.

The nose lingers on the palate, thanks in particular to the violet and red fruits. The attack is succulent and fiery in its concentration. Pomegranate, Morello cherry and dried flowers assert themselves. Notes of strawberry tart and crème patissiere then characterize the generous, velvety flavour. Rare Rose Millesime 2014 finishes with a powerful, swirling, vinous tension, worthy of a fine dining champagne: chocolate, pink peppercorns and kirsch bloom on the palate. A wonderfully long, positive bitterness rounds off the tasting of this eccentric vintage.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Bursts with vibrant energy as soon as this hits the palate, yet is refined and elegant throughout -- akin to a prima ballerina's marriage of stored power and grace. Reveals a lovely range of strawberry coulis, blood orange granita, raw almond, honeycomb, smoke and chalk notes framed by chiseled acidity and carried on the vivacious, finely detailed mousse. Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. Drink now through 2038.

title: Calazan Rum Special Anejo
bodyHtml: A blend of 12-13 rums aged no less than 2 years in ex-bourbon barrels, beer barrels, ex-rum barrels and new white American Oak barrels. This is the Blanco unfiltered

title: Rum Nation Guatemala XO 20th Anniversary
bodyHtml:
For the 20th anniversary of Rum Nation, they have handpicked some of the best and sweetest casks of this precious rum from Guatemala. Made from sugar cane molasses and distilled in a column still, it is aged for a period of at least 4 years in ex-bourbon white oak barrels in the tropical climate of the Hondo river region. 

The secret of its richness is a second maturation for 16 months in Oloroso and Pedro Ximenez casks in their cool Italian location. This enhances the rum's winey and fruity notes and its natural sweetness of fragrant vanilla and raisins, adding an extra layer of complexity. Sweet and luscious, honeyed and nutty. A limited edition in an elegant decanter to celebrate 20 years of rum discoveries all around the world.

title: Glenmorangie Grand Vintage Single Malt 1998
bodyHtml:
The Glenmorangie Grand Vintage 1998 is like embarking on a transatlantic journey from the world of classic bourbon, to the sherry bodegas in Jerez, both finessed with virgin new charred oak. Rich with vibrant fruits, smooth toffee, and ginger, this whisky’s eloquence is a symbol of our elegant, experimental style.

The year this whisky was distilled, there was a fresh air of enthusiasm at the Distillery. Having joined Glenmorangie some years before, Dr Bill Lumsden had just taken charge of all Glenmorangie’s whisky creation. And he was bursting with ideas for evermore delicious whiskies.

Rich and mellow on the nose, with hints of toffee, ripe fruits such as pears, plums and baked apples, and some gentle oak. This is followed by some sweet vanilla, fragrant spearmint and a mellow, warming, waxy note, like fragrant incense. Some water releases Glenmorangie’s classic citrus notes of lemon and mandarin orange along with sweet tobacco, a touch of lavender, and the merest hint of ginger.

A zesty, almost effervescent mouthfeel leads into a burst of vibrant fruitiness, some chocolatey notes, a soft butter candy flavour and a hint of toffee, juicy raisins and figs. Then comes a suggestion of orange-flavoured chocolate, clove, ginger and aniseed.

title: Langmeil Jackaman's Cabernet Sauvignon 2012
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Langmeil Jackaman's Cabernet Sauvignon 2012 is a premium red wine from Australia, specifically sourced from the Barossa Valley in South Australia. The winery is located on a historic trading village site established in 1842 and is currently owned by the Lindner family, whose Barossan heritage spans six generations. This specific wine is named after Arthur Jackaman, a colorful local paratrooper, boxer, and butcher who meticulously tended the small vineyard plot before passing it into Langmeil's care upon his retirement.

Wine Description

This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon is produced from a historic vineyard planted during the 1960s. The 2012 vintage was aged for 25 months in a combination of 36% new and 64% second-fill French oak hogsheads.

  • Colour: It displays a medium to deep crimson hue with vibrant purple highlights.

  • Aroma: The nose is lifted and complex, featuring blackcurrant and blueberry entwined with biscuity French oak, minty hints, savoury black olive, and touches of liquorice and cedar.

  • Palate: Bright, juicy blue and red fruits flow onto the palate, which is layered with briary spice and additional savoury notes of black olive and cedar.

  • Body: The wine is medium to full-bodied with a rich, silky, and well-integrated tannin structure.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, velvety finish that balances fruity intensity with a subtle touch of oak sweetness.

  • ABV: This vintage is bottled at 14.5% alcohol by volume.

Accolades

Langmeil Jackaman's Cabernet Sauvignon 2012 has received significant praise from major wine critics.

  • 93 Points: Awarded by James Halliday in August 2015, who noted the wine retained an excellent crimson hue and was full of blackcurrant fruit.

  • 93 Points: Awarded by Jeremy Oliver, who suggested an optimal drinking window from 2024 through 2032.

title: Ancnoc Sherry Cask Finish Peated Edition
bodyHtml:
Peated whisky from the Knockdhu distillery has here been finished in sherry casks, adding layers of fruit and spice to the smoky, honey and citrus notes typical of its smoky single malt. 

Wondering why the whisky is called anCnoc? It's named after the source of the water Knockdhu uses to produce its single malts. 

Sweet honey and tropical fruit, notes of cinnamon and rich toffee, delicate campfire smoke on the nose.

Toffee apples coated in warming spices, deep vanilla, a rich, sweet, smoky character. Long wood smoke, caramel, vanilla finish.

title: Ancnoc Peatheart Batch 3
bodyHtml:
Throughout the Scottish uplands, most extensively in the north and west, you will find the heart of the peatlands. Remote and isolated yet rich in iconic wildlife, this environment rules the landscape and provides a valuable fuel for the whisky-making process.

A natural resource, peat was historically embraced as fuel to fire the still and dry the barley for the distillation of whisky. It is traditionally cut by hand using several traditional cutting tools.

An initial smoky burst surrenders to a surge of fruitiness. Ripe pears and the citrus notes of apples and limes with just a touch of tobacco in the background. The nose is balanced yet an undeniable smoky sweetness prevails.

Smoke laced with leather and sweet stewed apples. Chocolate is there too, perfectly complemented by sweet vanilla and zesty lemon. The finish has a lingering warmth with a floral smokiness.

title: Austin Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon (Austin Hope Winery)
bodyHtml:
Austin Hope Cabernet Sauvignon is a distinguished red wine from Paso Robles, California, crafted by Austin Hope Winery, renowned for producing expressive and robust Cabernet Sauvignons that reflect the unique terroir of the region.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Deep ruby hue.

  • Aroma: Enticing aromas of fresh black cherry, burnt sugar, and a slight smokiness.

  • Palate: Flavors evolve with vanilla foam, ripe dark fruit, roasted coffee, and nuances of spice. This full-bodied wine is rounded out with smooth, supple tannins, brightened by a touch of acidity, leading to a balanced finish.

Serving Suggestions

  • Temperature: Serve at 15-18°C (59-64°F).

  • Decanting: Decanting for about an hour before serving can enhance the wine's aromatic profile and complexity.

  • Food Pairings: Complements well with grilled steaks, roasted lamb, or dark chocolate desserts.

title: Tyrrell's Vat 9 Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml:
Vat 9 Shiraz is sourced from the best parcels on the Tyrrell Estate ‘Ashmans’. These vines have a minimum age of 50 years, and are grown in red clay soils over limestone. Weinkeller and the Short Flat make up the majority of the Vat 9 blend. The five-hectare Short Flat Vineyard is located directly north of the driveway of the Tyrrell’s Estate. The vineyard is a mosaic of vine ages with two distinctly named Shiraz blocks: the Mathews and Contours vineyards. Grapes from these vineyards, which were both planted in 1968 and are both situated at an elevation of about 115m, form an integral part of the blend in our flagship Vat 9 Shiraz.

Vibrant purple in colour, a regal nose showing lifted spice, dark fruits and subtle hint of oak. The palate is medium-bodied showing great intensity and the velvety texture that is seen in the best wines from this vintage. The palate structure is effortless with no rough edges showing wonderful balance of fruit, acid, oak and tannin.

title: Mollydooker Carnival of Love Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml: This is as life should be – a Carnival of Love. A place where everyone wants to be, and no one wants to leave.

title: Mollydooker Gigglepot Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
Mollydooker is a family owned and operated winery based in a charming part of the world that is McLaren Vale, South Australia. The dedicated team make a portfolio of wines that beautifully represent the warm, coastal climate of the region, but with the uniqueness that results from their trademarked winemaking techniques.

Gigglepot Cabernet is vibrant yet elegant, with a nose full of juicy red berries and subtle hints of exotic spice. The palate takes you through an array of fruit flavours and mocha notes with a toasty, savoury aftertaste. Beautifully balanced, the Gigglepot’s delicate tannins show restraint allowing the fruit spectrum to shine.

title: 19 Crimes Death Row Records Red Blend 2020
bodyHtml:
When you’re not sippin’ on gin and juice, this red wine runs deeper than the homies. Pop the cork and enjoy flavor richer than your bands. Round and soft, with good weight and body… and the wine is nice too. If we had to make it slap it might go something like this... Another hit come to pass, red wine in your glass

Pop the cork and the flavor hit richer than your bands.   Thick, round and soft with good weight and body The wine’s nice too and now we got a party.

title: Mission Hill Chardonnay Perpetua 2021
bodyHtml: Bright fruit and incredibly fresh acidity characterize the 2021 vintage of Perpetua. Notes of stone fruit, citrus, and flint are accentuated by a fine lemon acidity and seductive textures, showcasing harmonious integration of fruit, oak, and texture.

title: Red Rooster GSM 2020
bodyHtml:
The Red Rooster GSM is a Rhône-style red blend crafted in the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia, Canada. Red Rooster Winery, perched on the Naramata Bench, is known for producing expressive wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region. The winery, under the ownership of Andrew Peller Limited, emphasizes minimal intervention winemaking to highlight the natural characteristics of their grapes.

Wine Description

This GSM blend comprises Grenache, Syrah, and Mourvèdre, each contributing distinct elements to the wine. Grenache offers vibrant red fruit and spice, Syrah adds depth with dark fruit notes and a hint of pepper, while Mourvèdre brings richness and complexity. The wine presents a harmonious balance of these varietals, resulting in a medium to full-bodied profile with a smooth texture and a lingering finish.

title: Little Engine Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
A luxurious floral nose with creamy fig, plum nectar and raspberry compote surrounded by baking spice. An elegant weight on the palate is welcoming with lively fruit accented by cured meat notes and maple.

We recommend patience and a favourable cellaring environment to encourage the development of alluring tertiary characteristics.

title: Red Rooster Winery Cabernet Franc Icewine - 200 ml
bodyHtml: This rarest and sweetest Rooster of them all - has a copper red colour and aromas of wild strawberry, pomegranate molasses, and rhubarb.

title: Wayne Gretzky Estates No.99 Cabernet Franc Icewine 2019
bodyHtml: Beautiful aromas of cherry and apple skin. Well layered and concentrated palate with apple, caramel and cherry. Persistent with a fresh finish.

title: La Maldita Garnacha Red 2023
bodyHtml: Made from Garnacha grapes aka Grenache grapes, this red is fresh and fruit-forward with aromas of strawberries, tart cherries and notes of spring flowers. The palate is fruit-forward and medium-bodied with vibrant acidity, finishing with silky tannins. Enjoy it with tapas, pizza and pasta.

title: Red Rooster Winery Riesling Icewine
bodyHtml: This rarest and sweetest Rooster of them all - has a bright yellow gold colour and aromas of marmalade, golden kiwi, papaya and delicate floral honey.

title: Henry Of Pelham Ice Wine Riesling 2019 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: The early cold of winter in the Short Hills Bench allows for a consistently high-quality Riesling Icewine to be made every year, even though Riesling is among the most challenging grapes to use for icewine. Rich, perfumed and citrusy. Further aging will enhance minerality, and nuances of dried fruits and honey. Delicious in its youth, this icewine will also cellar for at least 15 years, in part due to the removal of Botrytis-affected fruit. Serves well as an aperitif with strong blue cheeses or seared foie gras, or for dessert with fresh fruit.

title: Yalumba Cabernet Sauvignon - Shiraz FDR1A 2016
bodyHtml:
This wine opens with the brooding aromas of dark cassis, then reveals subtle high-tone fresh mints, red fruits and spices and finally the sublime perfumed floral aromatics of violets and sweet cherries. Medium to full bodied, the palate is fine and sophisticated and elegantly layered with dark red currants, black cherry and mulberry fruits.

Vegan and Vegetarian Friendly

title: Bread & Butter Pinot Noir Reserve 2023
bodyHtml:
At Bread & Butter they believe good things in life shouldn't be complicated. Good things should just be good, honest, and simple. And the same goes for their wine. Bread & Butter Wines unlock the simplicity that people crave in life. Simply enjoyable flavors made for simple moments in a complex world. A bottle of Bread & Butter is the opportunity to take a breath, let your shoulders drop, and refresh your mindset.

Wine Description

Delicate and silky notes of bing cherry, sweet rhubarb, and strawberry meld together with aromas of earthy forest floor and baking spices. Finishes with bright acidity that makes every sip linger.

title: Pol Roger Rich Demi-Sec
bodyHtml:
Launched in 2001, this cuvee does not only accompany desserts but it will rejoice the most demanding connoisseur's sweet tooth.

Half-way between sec and demi-sec (dry and semi-dry), the cuvée Rich is distinguished by its perfect harmony due to a fine balance between sugar and natural acidity.

The Cuvee is the result of the harmonious blend, in equal proportions, of the three Champagne grape varieties: pinot noir, pinot meunier and Chardonnay from 30 different crus. 25% reserve wines are used to produce this cuvee.

The Cuvee Rich is kept in the cellar for a minimum of 4 years. Following disgorging, it is topped up by a dosage of 34g/l to enhance its sweet flavour.

title: Sandhill Cabernet Franc Icewine 2018
bodyHtml: This rare Cabernet Franc Icewine has a deep cranberry red colour and enticing aromas of wild strawberry, cherry preserves and red plum jam.

title: Two Hands Waterfall Block Single Vineyard Shiraz 2020
bodyHtml:
Waterfall Block is the newest addition to the Single Vineyard stable, and a very unique and interesting vineyard, close to the Adelaide CBD.

Waterfall Block is a complex steep site that needs to be seen to be believed. It has many short steep rows that are protected from the early morning light from the highest point of the Mount Lofty Ranges behind and again by the searing late day sun from a steep hillside to the north.

This is an amazing microclimate that allows the low-yielding vines to ripen at their leisure with a canopy that keeps moving along with minimal stress.

title: Glenlivet Founder's Reserve Single Malt - 1.75 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
To truly capture the essence of George Smith?s vision, The Glenlivet Founder's Reserve has been created using the time-honoured distillation methods that he introduced so long ago. Made with water from the same crystal-clear mountain streams in the same cold, pure air, The Glenlivet Founder's Reserve is as smooth and fruity as the whisky that first ran from the original copper pot stills.

These unique, lantern-shaped copper stills, designed by the man himself, are not the only important tools in our distilling legacy. The traditional oak casks in which we mature the whisky give each expression its own distinct characteristics. When George Smith began distilling, The Glenlivet had no age statements and he selected whisky from casks of a range of ages. We have replicated this freedom with The Glenlivet Founder?s Reserve, selecting whisky from a variety of traditional aged oak casks. Then, to lend a modern twist to the flavour of the expression, Master Distiller Alan Winchester marries together a selection of the aged oak casks and American first-fill oak casks. American first-fill oak casks are those that have never before been used to mature whisky.

Selective use of these casks provides a smooth, creamy sweetness that mingles harmoniously with the delicate flavours and complex fruity tones already present in the whisky.

title: Chateau De Laubade VSOP Bas Armagnac
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Golden and bright in the glass, this offers a mild honey and wildflower scent. The robust palate shows dried apricot, cocoa and dark honey notes laced with espresso, finishing with clove and black pepper sparks. Made with brandies an average of 9 years old.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

title: Kanonkop Pinotage 2021
bodyHtml: Vibrant aromas of blueberries, ripe plums, black cherries, cinnamon and vanilla on the nose. The palate is sultry and luxurious, with densely packed flavors of berry compote, wild bramble, plum tart and spicy Christmas cake. Ripe tannins are beautifully intertwined between the layers of fruit, adding a dense and broad texture to the wine. The subtle spicy tones and plush black cherry flavors on the lingering finish completes a very elegant and age-worthy wine.

title: Chateau Laballe Bas Armagnac 2003
bodyHtml:
Chateau de Laubade was built in 1870 and is today the premier Armagnac property, composed of 260 acres of single vineyard. It is located in Sorbets d’Armagnac, in the heart of the noblest area of the appellation: the Bas Armagnac. The Lesgourgues family has been running the estate since 1974. Since 1998, Arnaud and Denis Les-gourgues, as the third generation have been actively involved in the quest of excellence, to make Chateau de Laubade an undisputed reference in the Armagnac category.

Each vintage entirely comes from a single harvest and distillation year. Each vintage clearly expresses its age, which is a specificity of Armagnac and the signature of the house. More than 80 different vintages matured in Chateau de Laubade’s cellars. Currently, the oldest vintage is from 1888. 

Each vintage tells a particular story. A story dealing with the ongoing climate changes, with the unique Cellar Masters know-how that has followed one another, along the generations. The casks quality and the cellars temperature participate to the vintage special identity as well. 

Finally, each vintage is a particular chapter of the estate and draws on its long history, rich know-how and dedication to quality from several generations of men and women’s high involvement. Chateau de Laubade only releases its vintages after a minimum of 15 years of ageing in oak casks from Gascony.

title: Chateau Laballe Bas Armagnac 12 Rich
bodyHtml:
Château Laballe's Bas Armagnac 12 Rich is a distinguished French brandy from the Bas Armagnac region, crafted from a blend of 80% Ugni Blanc and 20% Baco grapes. This expression is aged for a minimum of 12 years in oak barrels sourced from the Landes forest, imparting depth and complexity to the spirit.

Colour: Medium deep amber, reflecting its extended maturation.

Aroma: The nose offers scents of orange zest, chocolate, spice cake, and oak. 

Palate: The palate is soft, balanced, and generous, with notes of hummus, cumin, orange zest, and pound cake. 

Body: Full-bodied with a rich and creamy mouthfeel, balanced by a lively acidity that adds freshness.

Finish: Long and harmonious, with the mineral and floral notes repeating on a wonderfully extended and subtly chewy finish.

Accolades: The 2019 'La Turque' has received exceptional reviews from critics:

  • Jeb Dunnuck: 98-100 points, noting its meatier, more savory, mineral-driven aromatics and incredible core of pure cassis and darker fruits.

  • Wine Advocate: 98-100 points, highlighting its seamless blend of grilled cherries, espresso, black olives, and exotic hints of black truffle into a full-bodied powerhouse.

  • Vinous: 96-98 points, describing smoke- and mineral-accented cherry and blackberry scents, along with powerful suggestions of exotic spices, incense, and cracked pepper.

title: Chateau Laballe Bas Armagnac Resistance
bodyHtml:
For nearly two centuries now, the Laudet family produces the Château Laballe’s Armagnacs on the estate. From the vineyard management to the years of aging, everything is done to extract and preserve the most of the SablesFauves soils’ singular characteristics. The vines are cherished and soils worked to highlight the iron oxide (main characteristic of Sables Fauves) that brings a subtlety and fullness specific to the Château Laballe‘s Armagnacs.

Laballe’s idea was to create an authentic young spirit that would shine on the back bar for use in cocktails as well as having enough depth and polish to be consumed neat. To this end, the three eaux de vie spent their first year after distillation in new 410-litre Chene Noir Gascon barrels from Bartholomo (the last barrel maker in the Landes region) to develop texture and sweetness, and then the rest of aging in older barrels, bringing more earthy and savoury notes. 

On the nose, you are immediately struck by the distinctiveness of this grape, with aromas of apple, smoke and citrus giving way to a round, salty expression in the mouth that finishes with a hint of licorice. It’s a delightfully elegant spirit with impressive balance of flavour, complexity and elegance as well as good length and the hearty weight you’d expect from a quality Bas Armagnac. Unique, and well worth the Resistance.

title: Chateau Haut Brion 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Haut-Brion 2019 vintage is one of the most successful vintages produced after a hot and dry summer. This fine wine has the structure of 2005, with the freshness of 2010. A modern, richer version of the 1990 vintage.

100 Points - James Suckling

The is very refined and elegant with a fine-tannin line running through the center of the palate. It’s very intense and precise. Full-bodied with great, tight fruit. This is subtle and complex, then it opens on the palate and shows incredible depth and intensity. Great length, going on and on for minutes.

99 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Haut-Brion is a blend of 48.7% Merlot, 43.2% Cabernet Sauvignon and 8.1% Cabernet Franc, harvested from the 10th of September to the 3rd of October. The estimated label alcohol degree is 14.5%. Displaying a deep garnet-purple colour, it comes off incredibly shy and reticent to begin, needing considerable coaxing to reveal notes of dark chocolate-covered cherries, blackberry preserves, woodsmoke and sandalwood, before launching into a full-scale fireworks display of iron ore, cumin seed, redcurrant jelly, red roses, oolong tea and Sichuan pepper scents plus a waft of cardamom. The medium to full-bodied palate delivers the most exquisitely ripe, finely grained tannins with a lively backbone of freshness supporting the tightly wound, earth-laced black fruit layers, finishing very long and minerally. This is one of the most finely structured, tightly knit wines of the vintage. Given time, I wouldn't be at all surprised if it goes atomic and eventually takes top place for the vintage.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Château Haut-Brion checks in as a classic blend of 49% Merlot, 43% Cabernet Sauvignon and the rest Cabernet Franc. Its deep purple hue is followed by a stunning bouquet of ripe black cherry and currant-like fruit as well as classic Graves cold fireplace, burning embers, tobacco, and cedar pencil. More regal, firm, and classically structured on the palate, this full-bodied beauty has a deep, concentrated mid-palate, building tannins, background oak, and a great, great finish. It's very much in the focused, elegant, yet still concentrated and powerful style of the vintage. It will need a solid decade of cellaring, but it’s a brilliant wine. Best after 2032. 

97 Points - Decanter

Powerful and confident, there is no mistaking this concentration of ripe damson and black cherry fruits, set against coffee, earth, sage and black chocolate. Tons of tannins on display but extremely fine, to the point that you almost don't notice them, then once the wine has left your mouth you suddenly realize how many there are, and how they are still exerting pressure. Great persistence, slowing everything down and asking you to stop and think. Clear ageing ability here.

title: Vasse Felix Chardonnay Heytesbury 2024
bodyHtml: Bright, light golden straw. On the nose, elegant, fragrant notes of hazelnut, mealy wafer and brioche intertwine with grapefruit, hints of fine lemon pith and honey dew melon. Underlying tones of candlewax, champignon, ginger and fennel also play a part in this complex perfume. A satin light entrance builds to a long, tangy dry finish filled with delicate characters reminiscent of peach custard brioche, hazelnuts and candle wax, supported by fine lemon pith and anise.

title: Charles Heidsieck Brut 2013
bodyHtml:
After many years aging in the unique and ancient Crayeres acquired by its founder Charles Heidsieck, Brut Millesime reveals itself as a champagne poised between elegance and complexity, with a smooth texture and great length on the palate. Charles Heidsieck Brut Millesime 2013 is a blend of ten Grands Crus and Premiers Crus meticulously selected by the House, expressing magnificent minerality, intensity and acidity. This exceptional cuvee was aged for ten years in Gallo-Roman Crayeres. True to the Charles Heidsieck style, Millesime 2013 already displays all the elegance and power of an outstanding vintage, qualities which will only be enhanced with time.

94 Points - James Suckling

A very striking nose with Reine Claude plums, old-fashioned apple varieties and some Nordic herbs. Structured and crisp with a very firm core, the finish driving and full of energy. Rich long finish with a chalky core. 

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The bouquet of the 2013 Brut Millesime is compellingly fresh and minty, complicated by notes of white fruit—notably pear and apple—citrus and gentle spices, as well as a light touch of smoke. With aeration, elegant pastry notes come to the fore. On the palate, this is a structured, tension-filled but airborne Champagne with racy acidity, fleshy and charming texture and a long, penetrating finish.

title: Kujira Ryukyu 15 Year Old Single Grain Whisky
bodyHtml:
Kujira Ryukyu 15 Year Old Single Grain Japanese Whisky is distilled from 100% premium rice and matured in Sherry, Bourbon and American White Oak Casks for more than 15 years, giving a mellow taste and silky texture to this exquisite whisky. The subtropical climate in Okinawa provides a warm and humid storage condition that accelerates the maturation process. This environment creates subtle fruity and botanical flavors with intense texture, enhancing the uniqueness of Ryukyu Whisky.

Dried plums, candied fruits, with mints and chocolate aromas. Sweet elements such as chocolate, vanilla, and honey giving a pleasant taste, followed with spices, slight smoky flavors and toasty breads. Remarkably smooth, slightly sweet licorice and peppery texture develops into a clean and long finish.

title: Admiral Rodney Officer's Release No. 2 2009 Rum
bodyHtml: The second entry in Admiral Rodney’s Officer’s Release series, distilled in 2009 and finished in ex-Irish whiskey casks. The nose entices you with notes of clove, allspice, baked honey, prunes and rapsberries. The palate is fruity and spicy, expertly combining cherry, blackcurrant, sweet chilli and Asian spices with a hint of saltiness to finish.

title: Dutch Courage Dry Gin - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Zuidam Dutch Courage Dry Gin has a nose that is clean with fresh citrus and earthy juniper notes and a beguiling hint of spice and vanilla. The balance of Zuidam Dry Gin makes it perfect for a refreshing Gin and Tonic or a perfect Dry Martini.

Dutch Courage dry gin is distilled from Nine botanicals: juniper berries and iris root from Italy, coriander from Morocco, angelica, sweet oranges and fresh whole lemons from Spain, liquorice root from India, cardamom and whole vanilla beans from Madagascar.

The gin is distilled using a unique distillation method with separate distillation of each botanical so producing a fresh, complex and layered flavour from a total of 14 distillations.

title: Ron Abuelo XV Napoleon Cognac Cask Finish
bodyHtml: One of three releases in Abuelo’s XV Finish Collection, this has spent the end of its 15-year maturation in barrels which used to hold Napoleon Cognac. A dry rum with notes of dried fruit and coffee.

title: Pommery Cuvee Louise 2005
bodyHtml:
The 2005 Pommery Cuvée Louise is a prestigious Champagne from the renowned Pommery house in Reims, France. This vintage is crafted from a blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir grapes sourced exclusively from Grand Cru vineyards in Avize, Cramant, and Aÿ. Named in honor of Louise Pommery, the founder's widow who significantly influenced the house's legacy, this cuvée exemplifies elegance and refinement.

Colour: Bright green-golden hue, indicating its maturity and vibrancy.

Aroma: A deeply impressive nose with great elegance and precision, offering refined aromas reminiscent of ripe pear, juicy Mirabelle, tangerine zest, and freshly toasted brioche. Subtle hints of mild spices and white blossoms add to its complexity.

Palate: The palate is tremendously enjoyable with a lovely presence of effervescence, high dosage feeling like 9 or 10 g/l, and a lengthy finish replaying caramel apple notes. This Champagne showcases a rich, brioche style with a creamy texture and lively, persistent mousse.

Body: Full-bodied with a rich and creamy mouthfeel, balanced by a lively acidity that adds freshness.

Finish: Long and harmonious, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and elegant structure.

Accolades: The 2005 Cuvée Louise has received critical acclaim, including a 95-point rating from Natalie MacLean, who described it as "elegant and sophisticated." Additionally, it has an average score of 91.7 points based on 13 community reviews on CellarTracker.

This vintage is a testament to Pommery's dedication to producing exceptional Champagne, offering a harmonious blend of richness, complexity, and elegance.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Mr George Legacy 3rd Edition Single Malt 1959 'Glen Grant'
bodyHtml:
The third edition of the Mr. George Legacy is here. It is a 63 year old single malt, matured in First Fill Sherry, and bottled at 56.5%.

George Urquhart, or ‘Mr George’ as he was known, joined his father, John at the family business ninety years ago in 1933 and became a key advocate of single malt whisky at a time when most whisky went into blends. ‘The father of single malt’ as he’s been called, Mr George was a firm believer in the importance of guiding principles, passed down to future generations. The Third Edition in the Legacy range pays tribute to his beliefs and vision – and features whisky from our last ever cask from 1959.

Distilled on 15th October 1959 and spending its entire maturation in cask no. 3665, a first fill Sherry butt, this Third Edition of the Mr George Legacy Series was bottled on 2nd November 2022 at a remarkable cask strength of 56.5% ABV. This whisky is from Gordon & MacPhail’s last cask – from any distillery – from 1959.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Mr George Legacy 2nd Edition Single Malt 1957 'Glen Grant'
bodyHtml:
Glen Grant 1957 Gordon and MacPhail 64 Year Old Mr George Legacy / 2nd Edition

A remarkable 1957 Glen Grant, bottled as a 64-year-old for the second edition of Gordon & MacPhail’s Mr. George Legacy. Mr George, of course, refers to George Urquhart, the legendary director who invented the Connoisseurs Choice range in 1968, and grandfather of G&M’s current Operations Director, Stuart Urquhart.

This 64-year-old Glen Grant 1957 is from a first fill sherry butt, Cask #3483, that has given it an extraordinarily dark chestnut colour, and yielded a batch of 298 bottles at a jaw-dropping 56.1%. The list of incredible Glen Grants bottled by Gordon & MacPhail is a very long one, but this 1957 64-year-old looks destined to go straight into the pantheon.

This incredible whisky was filled into single first-fill ex-Sherry butt #3483 on 10th October 1957. It was bottled at cask strength in 2021 and resulted in 298 bottles.

title: R.C. Lemaire Champagne Cuvee Trianon (NV)
bodyHtml:
Cuvee Trianon (the flagship Cuvee of the Lemaire House) is a blend of 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay. Matured in temperature controlled steel vats and the alcoholic fermentation is maintained by 16 degrees to preserve the wines delicate aromas. This champagne is our best awarded bottle.

Pale gold, crystal clear, pearlescent bubbles. Fresh youthful nose, yellow citrus flowers, orchard fruits with hints of fennel and cream, shortcake pastry. Charming fine mousse, fruit jelly, pear and a mature finish with brioche tone.

title: Chateau de Cerons Graves Blanc 2020
bodyHtml:
Chateau De Cerons Graves Blanc, 2020, white Bordeaux is a blend of 55% Sémillon, 45% Sauvignon Blanc and 5% Sauvignon Gris It is matured on the lees for six months in stainless steel tanks.

A tasty and full bodied wine, with a nose of ripe lemon, a beautiful minerality and a hint of fresh mint.

title: Rum Sponge Uitvlugt Rum 1998 25 Year Old Edition No.22
bodyHtml: Behold Rum Sponge Edition No.22! A single refill barrel of 1998 Uitvlugt from Guyana, bottled at 25 years of age and featuring about 1.5 degrees of reduction down to our preferred bottling strength of 60%.

title: Rum Sponge Long Pond 2004 18 Year Old Edition No.17
bodyHtml:
Avast ye land Spongers! Ahoy be Rum Sponge Edition No.17 - an 18 year old Long Pond Jamaican Rum bottled at a timber-shivering 60%! 

This single recycled rum barrel of Jamaican legend Long Pond was matured for 13 years* in Jamaica, before being early-landed in the dis-United Kingdom for the rest of its wood-bound life. 

When they got our grubby little Sponge paws upon it, they reduced it from around 66% to 60% and shoved it into these lovely, astonishingly standardised bottles for you.

title: Biondi Santi Brunello di Montalcino 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
It is a rare phenomenon that a wine can trace its origins to a single man. Brunello di Montalcino, however, owes its existence to Ferrucio Biondi-Santi and its fame to his family. Now on the seventh generation of winemakers, the Biondi-Santi family continues to produce wines renowned for their elegance and extraordinary longevity.

This Brunello is a wine of light and energy. On the nose crispy notes of sour cherries, blood oranges and small red berry fruits are accompanied by scents of Mediterranean balsamic herbs and a touch of flint. On the palate energy, sweet fruit and silky tannins form a caressing sensation of elegance and equilibrium, leading us towards a long-lingering finish with a distinct savory touch, fresh and clean.

96 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2017 Brunello Di Montalcino is surprising in its freshness, considering the warmth of the vintage, and speaks to the cooler, northern-facing exposition of the estate. It is refined with ripe red cherry, raspberry, anise, and incense and is fresh with cherry fruit, warming spices, macchia, and herbes de Provence. It is ripe though it maintains a medium frame, with well-managed tannins and balanced acidity. It is a lovely and charming wine and is rather approachable now.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A delicately sweet note of fresh summer cherry is a precursor to budding complexity and a very articulate bouquet that opens quickly in the glass. Immediately pleasing fruit is a characteristic of the 2017 growing season that had above average temperatures and drought throughout the summer. The resistant 2017 Brunello di Montalcino takes on these challenges without missing a beat. The wine's celebrated acidity and its small berry nuances remain intact. The tannins are silky and the wine's flavors fade slowly even after you have taken your last sip.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A fresh, energetic red, boasting black cherry, blackberry, iron, rosemary and stone flavors. Reveals assertive tannins that ply the long finish for now, but this is all about balance and definition. Shows terrific length.

title: Rum Sponge Barbados 2000 22 Year Old Edition No.18
bodyHtml:
A single refill barrel of Barbados rum, distilled in 2000 and matured for 22 years before bottling at natural cask strength of 47.6%. 

The label for this edition celebrates the blissful joy that is Teams and Zoom meetings, which they have all discovered and come to love during the pandemic. It is also a helpful guide to identifying this rum's distillery of origin, given that the label is made up of four squares. 

This is a sibling cask to Rum Sponge edition 14 and, like that one, is decidedly easy and approachable while still displaying richness of character and depth. The nose is highly exotic with tinned tropical fruits in syrup, while the palate shows firm oak spices, medicines and fresh bread notes. Luscious, easy and super pleasurable!

title: Dictador XO Aurum Rum
bodyHtml:
Dictador XO Aurum Rum is a high-end and luxurious expression of rum from Dictador, a renowned Colombian rum distillery. This particular rum is part of their XO series, indicating that it is an extra-old rum with extended aging.

The “Aurum” in the name refers to the Latin word for gold, hinting at the exceptional and refined nature of this rum. It is aged for a significant period, allowing it to develop a complex and rich flavor profile.

Dictador XO Aurum Rum is known for its smooth and velvety taste, with notes of caramel, toffee, vanilla, and oak. It offers a harmonious and balanced palate, providing a truly indulgent rum-drinking experience.
