As a top-tier rum, Dictador XO Aurum is typically enjoyed neat or on the rocks to fully savor its exquisite flavors and aged character. It has gained recognition among connoisseurs and rum enthusiasts for its exceptional quality and craftsmanship.

title: Laroche Chablis 'Les Blanchots' Grand Cru 2022
bodyHtml: A real elegance appears in this grand cru, with a typical spring blossom aromas and a delicate mineral finish. On the palate, it offers a silky mouthfeel supported by a lively, racy acidity. Blanchots is delicate, silky and shows its charm after five years in bottle and at peak after 10 to 12 years.

title: Remy Martin Louis XIII Le Mathusalem  (6 Litre Crystal Decanter)
bodyHtml:
Rémy Martin Louis XIII Le Mathusalem is an extraordinary Cognac presented in a 6-liter crystal decanter, representing the pinnacle of the Louis XIII collection. Crafted from up to 1,200 eaux-de-vie sourced exclusively from the Grande Champagne cru, each aged between 40 to 100 years, this Cognac epitomizes the heritage and craftsmanship of the House of Rémy Martin.

Decanter and Presentation

  • Design: The decanter is a masterpiece, handcrafted by a team of over 20 master crystal artisans. Its design draws inspiration from a 16th-century flask discovered on the site of the Battle of Jarnac in France. The creation of such a large crystal decanter requires exceptional skill and precision.
  • Limited Production: Only 50 of these 6-liter decanters are produced each year, making it a highly coveted collector's item.
  • Coffret: The decanter is presented in an opulent display chest, accompanied by eight crystal glasses designed by Christophe Pillet, a serving tray, and a traditional pipette (spear) for an authentic serving ritual.

Tasting Notes

  • Aroma: A complex bouquet featuring notes of myrrh, honey, dried roses, plum, honeysuckle, and leather.
  • Palate: An intricate tapestry of flavors, including figs, passion fruit, and ginger, with subtle nuances of cigar box and nutmeg, leading to a harmonious and enduring finish.

Serving Suggestions

  • Temperature: Serve at room temperature to fully appreciate its aromatic complexity.
  • Glassware: Use the accompanying crystal glasses to enhance the tasting experience.
  • Ritual: Employ the traditional pipette to extract the Cognac, mirroring the practices of the Cellar Master.

title: Dictador 12 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
Made from the fermentation of virgin sugar cane honey, partly distilled in copper and partly in steel, which gives the Rum a medium bodied texture.

On the nose, the Rum is intense with notes of caramel, honey, and lightly roasted coffee.

On the palate it offers flavours of caramel, cocoa, honey, and coffee. A soft and round feel in the mouth, it has a light oaky finish.

title: Casale del Giglio Bellone Lazio Bianco 2025
bodyHtml: Deep yellow flecked with gold. The wine evokes sunshine and ripe tropical fruit such as mango and papaya, carefully balanced by a marked acidity which makes it suitable for long bottle aging. Rich, ample and lingering on the palate with light floral and spicy notes. Hallmarked by its pronounced acidity and zesty tang. A long finish.

title: Waterstone Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve 2015
bodyHtml:
Waterstone Winery was formed in 2000 with the simple concept of creating luxury wines at affordable prices. Bringing together previously established relationships with Napa Valley growers and vintners, the winery set out to develop balanced wines of varietal character through intelligent sourcing. Preferring to focus on the wine itself rather than the accumulation of land and facilities, Waterstone owns no vineyards, nor does it own the facility where its wines are made. Dedicated winemaking, strong relationships with top growers and long-term grape contracts are the keys to Waterstone's quality and success.

Black cherry and cassis, sweet pastry, anise, violet, and notes of crushed rock on the nose. Mouth-coating, fine dusty tannins with flavors of blackberries and mineral notes on the finish.

title: Jack Daniel's - Mini 50 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: A 50ml miniature bottle of the world-famous Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey, which of course goes through the Lincoln County Process of being filtered through sugar maple charcoal.

title: Tamdhu Single Malt 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Tamdhu 18 Year Old Old Speyside single malt Scotch whisky. Matured in Oloroso Seasoned Sherry Casks sourced from Spain. Limited release.  Combining American Oak Oloroso and European Oak Oloroso casks, the 18-Year-Old unites Tamdhu’s signature fruity spirit and 18 long years of full-term sherry maturation to deliver layers of indulgent flavour and a deep natural colour which reflects the quality of the oak.

Bottled at 46.8% abv and non-chill filtered, on the nose the Tamdhu 18-Year-Old delivers rich dark fruits with ripe cherry and plum. Zesty citrus notes cut through an indulgent base of nutty milk chocolate and honey-baked oats.

To taste, crisp red apple emerges alongside dried fruits, with some sweet spice coming in the form of cinnamon, vanilla, and brown sugar.  A long, lingering, and rewarding finish brings spiced stewed apple and an unmistakable hint of sherry.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Glenburgie Single Malt 1967 'Archive Release #3709'
bodyHtml:
Distilled in 1967, and filled into a Refill Sherry Hogshead, cask 3709, this 53 year old Glenburgie has been bottled at a cask strength of 48.8%.

An elegant, rich, and old-school whisky; layered, complex, and far from over the hill.

Sweet and smooth with ripe blackcurrant, dark honey, toasted almonds and mature oak.  Stewed raisin aromas and autumnal spice complement rich fruitcake. Full and long finish with lingering notes of mixed nuts.

title: Highland Park 25 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Highland Park 25 Year Old was created from just 12 casks - five first-fill European oak sherry hogsheads, two first-fill American oak sherry casks and five virgin American oak hogsheads - carefully selected and married together by Highland Park's master whisky maker Gordon Motion.

Matured on Orkney for quarter of a century, the nose brings aromas of sweet coconut, honeyed violets and undercurrents of warm oaky spice. The palate offers notes of exotic lychee, sun-ripened Seville oranges, oak-smoke coconut and heathery peat smoke, followed by aniseed, fresh rosemary and lingering peat smoke that build in the finish.

title: Tequila Cascahuin Extra Anejo
bodyHtml:
Tequila Cashcahuin strives towards continuous innovation in their products to satisfy the sworn tastes of their customers, taking care of their original production processes and thus achieving the authentic flavour that characterizes Tequila Cascahuin. Different techniques throughout the process may vary as the master distillers work with the Agave respectfully to find what time and production is necessary in order to create the best tasting batch of Tequila possible.

First rested 4 years in large, wooden tanks at the distillery. These tanks are more than 60 years old. 48 months rested in American oak barrels. This extra anejo introduces aromas of cooked ripe agave, notes of honey, ripe pineapple, and touches of menthol and darjeeling tea. Concluding with freshly ground coffee, bitter chocolates, berries and orange peel. The flavor is sweet with a slight astringency from the barrel. Provoking memories of cooked agave and the once robust blanco tequila. This drink is a perfect balance of barrel and tequila and an enchanting reminder of this 16 year long process (from field to barrel).

title: Knob Creek Cask 12 Year Old Bourbon 100 Proof
bodyHtml: Knob Creek 12 Year is a small batch bourbon whiskey bottled at 50% abv and aged for a minimum of 12 years in select oak barrels. The nose highlights the perfect aging of this bourbon with tones of warm oak and vanilla blended over layers of caramel, bakery pastries, and splashes of cream. On the palate are more notable hits of aged oak, leather, and pops of sweet vanilla marshmallow seasoned with crushed white pepper.

title: The Macallan The Harmony Collection 'Amber Meadow'
bodyHtml:
The Harmony Collection Amber Meadow is an ode to Scotland, to its dizzying landscapes. Anyone who has ever trodden its vast flowered meadows and fields of barley stretching as far as the eye can see, caressed by the low-angled sun of late summer, knows what it entails. This is the case for the McCartney sisters – Stella, the stylist, and Mary, the photographer – who spent their childhood exploring them.

The third annual-release in the Harmony Collection has been created in collaboration with Stella and Mary McCartney and celebrates the fertile lands of Scotland. The presentation box and bottle label are made with discarded meadow cuttings and the whisky was matured ex-sherry and ex-bourbon casks. This has imparted aromas of honeysuckle, coconut and citrus peel on the nose, leading to notes of almond, honeydew melon and green tea on the palate.

title: Domaine Faiveley Latricieres Chambertin Grand Cru 2021
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1825, Bourgognes Faiveley has been handed down from father to son for over 175 years. As the sixth generation to take the reins, Francois Faiveley manages, with equal amounts passion and competence, the largest family domaine in Burgundy. Methodically reconstructing vineyards fractured by French inheritance laws, Bourgognes Faiveley today owns more appellations in their entirety (monopoles) than any other domaine in Burgundy.

96 Points - James Suckling

Take the trouble to investigate the depths of this very impressive 2021 Grand Cru Burgundy, the aroma spectrum of which stretched from redcurrant to violet, from wet earth and savory to wild blackberry. Impressive power that’s beautifully integrated on the rich palate. Bright and beautifully crafted at the very long finish. 

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Taut and sinewy, with cherry, raspberry, menthol and oak spice aromas and flavors under the grip of dense, dusty tannins. The fruit and supple texture still need to emerge and balance the tannins. Best from 2026 through 2040.

93+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Wafting from the glass with aromas of red berries and plums mingled with vine smoke, spices and rose petals, the 2021 Latricieres-Chambertin Grand Cru is medium to full-bodied, supple and seamless, with melting tannins, vibrant acids and a giving, perfumed profile that privileges sensuality over power.

93 Points - Decanter

Fairly dark in colour, the 2021 Latricieres has rich, ripe blackberry fruit with accents of mineral, leather, and earth and an undercurrent of dark chocolate. The texture is firm and tannic, with balanced acidity and good length. This wine is solid and exemplary, and if it lacks the frisson this bottling often has, it has rewarding ripeness and length and should improve with age

91+ Points - Vinous

The 2021 Latricieres-Chambertin Grand Cru, traditionally the latest Grand Cru that Faiveley picks, has quite a tertiary, classically-styled "old school" bouquet of dark berry fruit, touches of Earl Grey and forest floor. The palate is medium-bodied with fine-grain tannins, taut and fresh, a little foursquare with a peppery finish that might fool you into thinking there were some whole bunches. Lots of character and charm.

title: Antinori Chianti Classico Riserva 2020 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Italy’s Antinori estate is one of the oldest and most respected wine dynasties in the world, with roots tracing back to 1385. The Chianti Classico Riserva is crafted in the heart of Tuscany, specifically in the Chianti Classico region, where Antinori has played a pioneering role in elevating Sangiovese-based wines to global acclaim. The Marchesi Antinori family continues to lead the estate with a commitment to tradition and innovation, crafting wines that reflect both heritage and forward-thinking winemaking.

Wine Description
This 2020 Chianti Classico Riserva presents a deep ruby red colour with garnet highlights. The nose offers vibrant aromas of ripe red cherries, dried herbs, violet, and subtle notes of leather and spice. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied with polished tannins and a lively acidity that supports flavours of blackberry, tobacco, and hints of cedar.

Accolades
● Wine Spectator – 93 points
● James Suckling – 94 points
● Vinous – 92 points

Food Pairing
Ideal pairings include grilled Florentine steak, wild mushroom risotto, or aged Pecorino cheese. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Brunel de la Gardine Cotes du Rhone Blanc 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This refreshing white wine hails from the southern Rhône Valley in France, specifically within the expansive Côtes du Rhône appellation. The Brunel family has a rich history as winegrowers in the region dating back to 1670. Their modern legacy began in 1945 when Gaston Brunel acquired Château de la Gardine in Châteauneuf du Pape. Today, the family continues to honour their heritage through the 'Brunel de la Gardine' collection, selecting premium grapes from across the Rhône to produce wines that embody authenticity, quality, and a deep respect for the environment.

Wine Description

The Côtes du Rhône Blanc is a classic southern Rhône blend, typically composed of Grenache Blanc, Clairette, Roussanne, Viognier, and Bourboulenc. In the glass, it displays a bright, pale yellow colour with brilliant green reflections. The aromatic profile is expressive and floral, featuring notes of white flowers, citrus zest, and ripe peach, often accented by a hint of honeycomb or hazelnut. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and nicely rounded, offering a juicy 'attack' of lemon, pamplemousse, and quince. It is characterized by a silky texture and a vibrant energy, concluding with a fresh, mineral-driven finish and a subtle touch of almond. This wine is designed for immediate enjoyment to preserve its aromatic freshness.

title: Patron 'El Alto' Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
Patron El Alto Reposado Tequila is the ultimate expression of the craft and artistry that takes place at the Hacienda Patron. Their Master Distillers have dedicated themselves to perfecting their craft for decades, and Patron El Alto is the culmination of their passion and expertise.

Using only the finest 100% Weber blue agave from the highest regions of the Atotonilco El Alto, known for their exceptional sweetness, they meticulously handcraft this aged tequila. They grind the agave with volcanic stone, bake it in clay ovens for days, and age it to perfection.

With subtle notes of caramel, dried fruit, and vanilla, this ultra-refined tequila is naturally sweet and incredibly smooth, making it the perfect choice for sipping and savoring.

From its elegant presentation to its complex and perfectly balanced flavor profile, Patron El Alto Reposado Tequila is the ultimate indulgence for any tequila lover.

title: Dow's 30 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
Dow's 30 Years Old Tawny is made exclusively from grapes sourced at "A" classified vineyards (the highest), which includes Dow's Quinta do Bomfim and Quintada Senhora da Ribeira, two of the very best vineyards in the Douro valley. This enviable position is reflected in the excellent quality and consistency of the style evident in Dow's 30Years Old Tawny.

This 30 Years Old Port is a beautifully mature wine of great distinction. Pale and delicate, it has superb complexity and style. With a concentrated and nutty nose and a full, fresh and lingering finish. It is a very skillful blend, creating an excellent balance between nutty oak and raisin fruit flavors.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Gorgeous, with a beguilingly creamy mouthfeel that lets waves of date, fig, persimmon, golden raisin, toffee and praline glide along while notes of ginger and juniper flash underneath. Manages to be viscous and light-footed at the same time.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

This muscular Tawny is dry, concentrated and stern at times. Although on paper it doesn't have much less sugar than the Graham's this issue, the balance is different. It starts slow, then shows some notable bite on the finish. Gracefully constructed and sensually textured, it's never too thick or overpowering, but it always seems dense and intense anyway. Its complexity and focus are impressive. Then, it finishes rather dry. This was certainly one of the stars here.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A superbly dense, concentrated wine so rich in flavor that it almost has a brooding, dark quality. The hint of medicinal character just gives all this intensity a lift, and goes with flavors of roasted nuts and licorice. The aftertaste has just the right acidity.

92 Points - Decanter

Warm and nutty, with chocolate and coffee tones to the creamy, mouth-filling fruit leading to a serious and long finish.

title: Vinedo Chadwick 2019
bodyHtml:
Viñedo Chadwick 2019 is a distinguished red wine from the Maipo Valley in Chile, produced by Viña Errázuriz. This vintage is crafted predominantly from Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, with a small addition of Petit Verdot. The vines, planted in 1992, are situated in Puente Alto, one of the premier zones within Maipo, renowned for producing exceptional Cabernet Sauvignon.

Colour: Deep ruby with purple reflections, indicating good depth and concentration.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring notes of ripe red berries, tangerine, and floral nuances, complemented by subtle hints of cedar and spices from oak aging.

Palate: The wine offers a harmonious balance of juicy red fruit flavors, elegance, and great tension. It showcases a firm structure with fresh and crisp tannins, leading to a wonderfully fresh and pure finish.

Body: Medium to full-bodied with a polished texture, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

Accolades:

  • 99 Points - James Suckling
  • 97 Points - Wine Advocate
  • 97 Points - Falstaff
  • 94 Points - Jane Anson

title: Merryvale Antigua Dessert Wine
bodyHtml:
Merryvale Vineyards is a family-owned Napa Valley winery dedicated to passionate winemaking and the fine art of living well. For the past 25 years Merryvale has been turning exceptional Napa Valley grapes into world class wine. 

Merryvale is world renowned for rich, powerful Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay, the iconic Bordeaux-style red blend, Profile, and their everyday drinking, fruit driven brand, Starmont. Merryvale's historic building was the first winery built in the Napa Valley after the repeal of Prohibition in 1933, and has become a must see attraction for visitors to the valley.

Golden/amber in color from its long aging in French oak, the wine is a complex combination of nuts and orange-peel aromas. Thick and rich in the mouth, the nuts and orange-peel theme continues from the entry through the long finish, highlighted by the many subtleties from the fine brandy and time in the barrel.

Antigua pairs well with Tiramisu, Crème Brulée, Almond Biscotti, Hazelnut Torte, Pecan Pie, Cheeses (particularly blue), and Fruit.

title: Culmina Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Culmina Family Estate Winery's Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the Golden Mile Bench in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley, Canada. Founded by the Triggs family, Culmina is dedicated to crafting wines that authentically express the distinct terroir of their estate vineyards. The winery employs meticulous site selection and sustainable farming practices to produce wines of exceptional quality.

Wine Description

This a single-varietal wine sourced entirely from estate-grown grapes on Arise Bench. It underwent maturation for 16 months in French oak barrels, with a composition of 40% new and 60% one-to-two-year-old barrels. This wine presents classic aromas of cassis complemented by layered notes of sandalwood, cloves, bay leaf, and the distinctive Okanagan garrigue. On the palate, it offers rich dark fruit flavours intertwined with spicy black pepper and savoury wild herbs. The fine-grained tannins contribute to a complex and powerful finish.

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs excellently with buckwheat crêpes stuffed with sautéed wild mushrooms and leeks. The earthy flavours of the mushrooms and the savoury notes of the leeks harmonize with the wine's rich fruit profile and herbaceous spice, enhancing its depth and character.

title: Yangarra Estate McLaren Vale Roussanne 2021
bodyHtml:
Yangarra focuses solely on grapes from the Southern Rhone, like this Roussanne, which is sourced from two estate blocks and wild-fermented in French oak barrels to add complexity.

Richly-textured whites like this can stand up to bolder flavours, so try matching this with a herb-crusted pork roast.

title: Petrolo Torrione Toscana 2021
bodyHtml:
This Estate was bought by the Bazzocchi family in the 1940s and since the mid 80s has been headed by Lucia Bazzocchi Sanjust with the assistance of her son Luca. Petrolo Estate is located at the site of what was originally a small medieval town called Galatrona and a ower from this period (itself built on foundations dating back to the Roman era) still exists on the property.

  • 95 Points - James Suckling

    Inviting aromas of dark and blue fruits together with subtle notes of chocolate and spices with hints of blue flowers and crushed stones. Medium- to full-bodied, complex and structured, but ethereal and weightless at the same time. That’s where generosity meets delicacy. It’s fluid, dynamic and so drinkable now, yet better to give it a couple of years in the bottle. From organically grown grapes.

  • 94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

    The nose is like a cool, damp forest, with dark berries, fresh earth, but with a quiet rumbling of heat and savory undertones, and the palate maintains the balancing act between cool and warm, sweet and savory, buoyant but indulgent. Valdarno delivers at every price point, but this is a particularly stellar deal.

title: El Tequileno Extra Anejo Limited Edition
bodyHtml:
From the hearts and minds of Gran Tequilero, Juan Antonio Salles and Master Distiller, Jorge Antonio Salles, father and son, comes their first Extra Anejo, a celebration of El Tequilemo Tequila and their long-standing tradition of crafting exquisite tequilas.

Introducing El Tequileño Limited Edition Extra Añejo, a one-of-a-kind exclusive blend meticulously crafted from unique barrels, each carefully selected for their robustness, incredible depth, and velvety finish.

The Extra Anejo is bottled in a keepsake crystal decanter, which draws inspiration from the “penca” of the blue weber agave, and it is elegantly presented in a custom box adorned with an earthy embroidery pattern, bringing this exclusive blend to life.

The Extra Anejo is a limited-quantity, limited-edition tequila, with only 1000 bottles produced. Each box comes with its own certificate of authenticity and bottle number.

title: Hartfield & Co. Old Bourbon County
bodyHtml:
Bourbon County was founded in 1785, seven years before Kentucky gained her statehood. In the wake of the American Revolution. Bourbon County was named after the French House of Bourbon and encompassed 1/5th of the territory. The Scotch-Irish frontiersman that settled in Kentucky brought their love and knowledge of distilling. Those early settlers crafted a sweet, corn whiskey from limestone-filtered water aged in charred oak barrels in the mild Kentucky climate.

These pioneers floated barrels of whiskey down waterways to the port of New Orleans where the distinctive Kentucky spirit became known as bourbon whiskey, named after the county of origin. As the region was separated into smaller counties this area of Northern-Eastern Kentucky became known as Old Bourbon County.

Hartfield & Co. Distillery, the only distillery in modern-day bourbon county, proudly presents old bourbon county - a spirit hand-crafted from corn. Wheat and malted barley in the birthplace of bourbon whiskey.

title: Bladnoch Liora Single Malt Scotch
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Matured in both Bourbon and New Oak casks to showcase the combination of fresh cut apples, toasted caramel, peppery spices and fresh oak flavours. The first Bladnoch bottled at ‘Distiller’s Strength’ of 52.2% ABV.

Fresh cut apples, with toasted caramel and floral notes. Caramelised toffee apples with peppery spices and fresh cut oak. Long, with a slight warming dryness.

title: Castello di Bolgheri 'Varvara' 2022
bodyHtml:
The origins of Bolgheri Castle date back to 1200. Since then, it has been the property of the Counts of Gherardesca family. In the second half of the 1700s, restoration work and improvements were made to the building, and the cellars were built. In 1895, the castle’s facade was modified, with the construction of the tower and merlons as we still see them today.

A vintage which produces vines with character, rich fruit and full-bodied more than 2019. They search to emphasize this characteristic. Varvara is particularly well cared for in details from the fruit to the tannin. It will be a proper wine for long ageing. 

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The nose is a sun-soaked seafaring adventure, with savory notes of dried meat from the hold and leather belts and boots mixing with a rich fruitiness and the salty sea air. The rich, fruity, chocolaty palate eventually turns spicy, and that spice dances with searing acidity to prolong the finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

A linear and vivd red with black-cherry and orange-peel aromas and flavors. Fresh flowers, too. Medium to full body, chewy tannins and a bright finish.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Here's a quality, easy-to-drink blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Cabernet Franc. The 2020 Bolgheri Rosso Varvara is integrated and smooth with no rough spots. Black fruit, pressed rose, earth and spice are carefully woven together. All elements are in place, and the wine is available at a very attractive price point.

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2020 Varvara is potent with aromas of pine sap, dried black cherry, leather, and menthol that are followed by a medium to full-bodied red, with a gentle texture and warming notes of black plum, tea leaf, and wooded earth. 

92 Points - Wine Spectator

An expressive red, boasting black currant, blackberry, plum, iron and tobacco flavors, with firm, dusty tannins lending support. Fresh and balanced, with plenty of length and staying power.

title: 19 Crimes Death Row Records Sparkling (NV)
bodyHtml:
19 Crimes is defiant by nature, bold in character, and always uncompromising. They are proud to partner with entertainment icon, Snoop Dogg, who embodies all these qualities, and more, through hard work and perseverance. Snoop Dogg is a culture creator, innovator, and a leader in pop culture.

19 Crimes is a brand that was built on authentic stories of rebellion, defiance, loyalty and perseverance. In 1788, banishment to Australia from the UK became the punishment of choice. If you broke any one of the 19 Crimes, you sailed on a harrowing journey where months later your fate awaited. Times were tough but these individuals were tougher and they overcame adversity and insurmountable odds to ultimately claim redemption.

Crafted from the finest California grapes, this bubbly is about to become the superstar of your cellar. Crisp and memorable, just like a killer hook. But remember, just like the sickest freestyle, this drop is spontaneous – it's here for a good time, not a long time.

title: Domaine J.A. Ferret Pouilly Fuisse Tete de Cru 'Clos des Prouges' 2019
bodyHtml:
Domaine Ferret is situated at the heart of the village of Fuissé and has long been a producer of some of the appellation's top cuvées. Founded in 1840, it was the first Domaine to begin bottling at the property shortly after the Second World War. Furthermore, the focus on vinifying each parcel of vines separately from a relatively early date allowed Ferret's owners to identify the top climates (vineyard zones).

Creamy honeysuckle aromas and a vivid palate show a pleasing balance between depth of flavour and richness, and a long ripe rich finish revealing notes of gingerbread and flowers. A wine that will keep and develop beautifully over time.

title: Louis Jadot Chambertin Grand Cru 2017
bodyHtml:
The House of Louis Jadot has been producing exceptional Burgundy wines since its founding in 1859 by Louis Henry Denis Jadot. For the past 150 years Louis Jadot has continued as one of the great names of Burgundy and has gained international reputation for its superb red and white Burgundy wines. Louis Jadot is not only one of the largest producers of estate Burgundies of the Cote d'Or, it is one of the most celebrated exporters of premium Burgundies, owning close to 140 acres of vineyards from 24 of the most prestigious sites in Burgundy.

This wine is deeply colored, with an intense bouquet of black currants and other black and red berries. The mature wine often has aromas of musk or licorice. Made for aging, the wine will improve for 20 to 25 years in the bottle.

Serve with elaborate and strongly flavored foods such as mutton, boeuf bourguignon, coq au vin, game or game pate and strong cheeses.

title: Tequila Arte NOM 1123 Blanco Historico
bodyHtml:
The Rosales family produces ArteNOM Blanco Historico 1123 in El Arenal, Jalisco at their renowned Destileria Cascahuin from lower-brix valley agave that are the hallmark of the Lowland tequila style: earthy, vegetal, herbaceous, and slightly peppery. 

This seleccion is made from those valley plants which, once distilled into tequila, are barrel-conditioned for 21-28 days in brandy casks that previously held Oaxacan mezcal, such as high-end blanco tequilas from the Tequila Valley were sometimes prepared in the early 1900s. For this reason, this expression is referred to as a "Blanco Historico."

title: Tequila Arte NOM 1579 Blanco
bodyHtml:
The mountain town of Jesus-María  is tequila’s highest altitude agave region, and the El Pandillo Distillery is arguably one of the most forward-thinking and sustainable distilleries in the business.

There, Felipe Camarena masterfully crafts this bright, aromatic tequila from stressed hillside agave plants, slowly roasted in brick ovens and macerated intact with fiber for a pronounced agave flavor.

ArteNom Seleccion de 1579 Blanco is a caramelized agave flavored tequila with a full and medium bodied mouth feel.

title: Fords Gin
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: A London Dry Gin that uses numerous botanicals to create this pleasing and versatile style. Bright and aromatic with layers of citrus fruit, jasmine, juniper, coriander, angelica root and hints of vanilla. Medium-bodied with lingering grapefruit, juniper and floral notes. Perfect for cocktails; pair with savoury dishes.

title: Dievole Chianti Classico Petrignano 2020
bodyHtml: Dievole Petrignano Chianti Classico is a deep ruby red color. There's a fruity bouquet of distinctive ripe fruit, cherry and blackberry notes. Juicy, full and opulent on the palate with confirmation of the blackberries and ripe fruit. A warming and velvety finish with fine, polished tannins.

title: Tequila Arte NOM 1146 Anejo
bodyHtml:
Created by Master Distiller Enrique Fonseca at Tequilena in the town of Tequila and produced using agaves grown in the highlands near Atotonilco el Alto.

Total aging of almost 3 years, first in used Cabernet Franc wine barrels from the Loire Valley of France for a minimum of 14 months then laid into toasted American white oak previously used to age either Canadian whiskey or Tennessee rye whiskey, for a minimum of 14 additional months.

Stainless steel fermentation with Mendoza wine yeast strains.

Verified Additive Free by Tequila Matchmaker.

title: Rhum Clement Agricole Tres Vieux XO 6 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The Clement XO is a 6-year-old rum from Martinique, produced at the Distillerie du Simon distillery. Distilled from sugar cane juice using a Creole Column, it has an ABV of 42%.

With a woody, vanilla, cinnamon, and fruity aroma, this rum offers a palate that features woody, cognac, vanilla, sugarcane, and fruity notes. Users appreciate its surprising complexity and well-balanced flavors, resulting in an enjoyable and well-established drinking experience.

A great introduction to the world of French Agricole rums, the Clement XO offers a unique and delightful taste of Martinique.

title: Fratelli Alessandria 'del Comune di Verduno' Barolo 2021
bodyHtml: Located in a charming XVIII century house boasting a simple yet imposing architecture, just by the historic centre of Verduno town, the winery was founded at the beginning of XIX century. Today the owner Gian Battista together with his wife Flavia, his brother Alessandro and his son Vittore proudly carry on their ancestors' tradition and passion for wine making.

title: Tequila Arte NOM 1414 Reposado
bodyHtml:
Truly making an ART of their NOM, Tequila Artenom features expressions of unique altitudes, heritage, agave cultivation and distillation techniques. 

This Reposado is born from estate-grown agave in the Highlands of Jalisco, and produced at Distileria El Ranchito, with no additives in order to let the tequila profile and terroir shine through. 

Agave mash is fermented with a field-extracted, wild yeast. Color of very pale, yellow straw, smoked citrus nose with hints of vanilla and roasted sweet potato. Taste of salted vanilla cookie, allspice, oak, and some slight heat- but minimal burn.

title: Domaine Ferret Pouilly Fuisse 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine Ferret has played a key role in defining the quality of the region. It was the first domaine in Pouilly-Fuisse to begin bottling on the estate, shortly after the Second World War. Further, its long-standing focus on vinifying each parcel of vines separately has allowed for the identification of the top terroirs.

Subtle notes include minerals, yellow fruits, flowers, fresh hazelnuts and spices, with an intense finish. The perfect equilibrium of this wine allows it to retain its vibrancy with age.

Pair with shellfish and mollusks, seafood risotto, grilled or pan-fried fish, veal cutlets with creamy sauces and cheeses, especially goat or hard cow milk cheeses.

title: Poli Elisir Limone Limoncello
bodyHtml:
The fresh and stimulating aroma of the lemon peel and the balanced alcoholic structure have made the limoncello much more than a pleasurable digestif.

In the course of the last hundred years this simple and natural liqueur has become an after-dinner ritual to celebrate an enioyable meal.

title: Clarendelle Bordeaux Rouge 2017 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
In Chateau Haut-Brion, Clarence Dillon found not only the charm of an elegant and fabled estate, but also the opportunity of a lifetime. He discovered a tarnished jewel. This estate had sparkled for centuries prior to these difficult times and yet in 1934, Mr. Gibert, the current owner, had not been successful in his bid to give the estate away to the town of Bordeaux because of the high maintenance costs and meager returns.

The estate needed someone of passion and means to allow it to weather the storm. Clarence Dillon immediately entered into negotiations to acquire the estate and requested that his Paris office continue these on his departure by ship to the United States.

Clarendelle's name thus pays homage to the ancestor who brought the family to this region. In creating Clarendelle the team from Clarence Dillon Wines and their colleagues at Domaine Clarence Dillon, wish to discover and extract the best from the enormous potential and savoir-faire that this region and terroir provide.

title: Rhum JM Agricole Blanc
bodyHtml:
Rhum J.M Blanc displays the raw power of what is regarded as the best terroir on the island. Oily lime zest and anise balance out a chalky earthiness on the palate. The perfect rhum for a ti'punch or daiquiri.

Overwhelming aromas of fresh lime, honey, and cane flower are balanced with more savory vegetal notes and a beautiful expression of anise - unique to Rhum J.M. Round and sweet on the palate, honey and cane flowers really shine through. The stewed banana and grilled pineapple, the signature of Rhum J.M, is ever present as well as the unmistakable vegetal and mineral undertones.

title: Talbott Chardonnay Sleepy Hollow Vineyard 2021
bodyHtml:
This elegant Chardonnay hails from the United States, specifically California’s renowned Santa Lucia Highlands AVA in Monterey County. Talbott Vineyards, founded in 1982 by Robb Talbott, has long been celebrated for its commitment to single-vineyard expressions, particularly from its Sleepy Hollow Vineyard, which is recognized as one of California’s grand cru sites for Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. The estate’s focus on meticulous vineyard management and minimalist winemaking allows the unique terroir of Sleepy Hollow to shine through each vintage.

Wine Description

This vintage displays a brilliant straw-yellow colour in the glass. The nose opens with inviting aromas of ripe pear, golden apple, lemon curd, and subtle hints of toasted brioche and vanilla, courtesy of well-integrated oak. On the palate, it is full-bodied yet vibrant, delivering layers of stone fruit, citrus zest, and a touch of honeyed richness. A vein of minerality and bright acidity brings remarkable balance and freshness, leading to a long, creamy finish accented by notes of baking spice and roasted nuts.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 93 points.

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 92 points.

Food Pairing

Pair this Chardonnay with seared scallops, roasted chicken with lemon and thyme, or a rich mushroom risotto. These dishes accentuate the wine’s depth and layered texture. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Louis Jadot Corton Pougets Grand Cru 2017
bodyHtml:
The House of Louis Jadot has been producing exceptional Burgundy wines since its founding in 1859 by Louis Henry Denis Jadot. For the past 150 years Louis Jadot has continued as one of the great names of Burgundy and has gained international reputation for its superb red and white Burgundy wines. 

This powerfully structured, rich-fruited wine offers deep, layered berry and oak aromas and flavors, and a persistent finish. It should be held for 5 years in bottle before being opened, and will develop for 15 to 20 years in the cellar. Serve with roasts or highly seasoned meats, game and most cheeses.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Marked by kirsch, spice and underbrush notes, this red is intense and solidly built, with concentrated cherry and berry fruit. Juicy midpalate, leading to long, chalky finish.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2017 Corton-Pougets Grand Cru (Domaine des Heritiers Jadot) is showing brilliantly from bottle, wafting from the glass with an inviting bouquet of cherries, raspberries and red plums, mingled with notes of orange rind, sweet spices and flowers. On the palate, it's full-bodied, supple and enveloping, with velvety tannins, excellent depth at the core, succulent acids and a perfumed finish.

title: Fratelli Alessandria 'Gramolere' Barolo 2019
bodyHtml:
Located in a charming XVIII century house boasting a simple yet imposing architecture, just by the historic centre of Verduno town, the winery was founded at the beginning of XIX century. Today the owner Gian Battista together with his wife Flavia, his brother Alessandro and his son Vittore proudly carry on their ancestors' tradition and passion for wine making.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Barolo Gramolere (with 7,000 bottles made) shows a slightly sweeter and riper fruit profile. This wine comes from the village of Monforte d'Alba, which is known for more structured and powerful wines compared to Verduno (where this winery is based), which offers lighter, more floral wines instead. Gramolere shows dark fruit, plum and spice, but it also has a pretty mineral note of rust or iron. However, within this portfolio, this wine may well deliver the longest drinking window.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

More concentation of fruit can be found in the 2019 Barolo Gramolere. with raspberry liqueur, spice box, and licorice. It is medium bodied but has a more expanded feel. with notes of dried apricot, grenadine, blood orange, and tobacco.

93 Points - James Suckling

This has a fresher, red-fruited and spicy nose with hints of dried flowers, licorice and bark undertones. Full-bodied, polished and refined with vivid acidity. Layers of fine tannins with a long, encompassing finish.

title: Louis Jadot Savigny les Beaune Narbantons Premier Cru 2017
bodyHtml:
The House of Louis Jadot has been producing exceptional Burgundy wines since its founding in 1859 by Louis Henry Denis Jadot. For the past 150 years Louis Jadot has continued as one of the great names of Burgundy and has gained international reputation for its superb red and white Burgundy wines. 

Louis Jadot Savigny Les Beaune 1er Cru Les Narbantons is an elegant red wine with pure, earthy and plum Pinot Noir fruit, balanced structure and a full finish.

Try with terrines (rabbit or pork), moussaka, steak tartare, ducks breast dishes and hard, mature cheeses. Good with any grilled and roasted red meats, rack of lamb with a herb crust for example.

title: Louis Jadot Beaune 'Clos des Couchereaux' Premier Cru 2017
bodyHtml:
For the past 150 years Louis Jadot has continued as one of the great names of Burgundy and has gained international reputation for its superb red and white Burgundy wines. Louis Jadot is not only one of the largest producers of estate Burgundies of the Cote d'Or, it is one of the most celebrated exporters of premium Burgundies, owning close to 140 acres of vineyards from 24 of the most prestigious sites in Burgundy.

Les Couchereaux vineyard is situated on top of the slope, in the middle of the commune and has a southern exposure of well drained soils. The resulting 100% pinot noir shows ripe fruits of raspberry and cherry, with hints of spice and smoky character. Dense and structured it is rich and warm.

title: Chalone Chardonnay 2020
bodyHtml:
Chalone Chardonnay originates from the Chalone AVA, a unique high elevation mountain plateau in Monterey County, USA. The historic Chalone Vineyard, founded by Dick Graff in 1960 and now under the stewardship of the Foley Family, sits on limestone and decomposed granite soils at the base of an extinct volcano. This rugged terroir, perched 1,800 feet above the Salinas Valley, is dedicated to producing Burgundian style wines that emphasize the site's distinct minerality and bright acidity.

Wine Description

This golden hued Chardonnay presents a complex sensory profile beginning with an aromatic bouquet of lemon curd, mandarin orange, and a touch of toasted brioche. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and honeyed, balancing flavors of lemon-lime and spiced baked apple with subtle notes of peach and pineapple. Its structure is defined by a round mouthfeel and classic Chalone wet rock minerality, which leads to a lifted, dry, and exceptionally long finish.

title: Josh Cellars Prosecco (NV)
bodyHtml: This fabulous Prosecco can turn any occasion into a celebration. Enjoy it anytime! It offers up bright notes of fresh pear, green apple, melon and citrus with floral tones. On the palate, its great bubbles and zesty acidity makes this an excellent aperitif and allows it to work with a variety of antipasti and light dishes.

title: Trois Noix Napa Valley Chardonnay 2020
bodyHtml:
Trois Noix began as a collaboration with amazingly talented friends who happened to be fabulous winemakers and grape growers, with the goal of making fresh and precise wines of time and place. Standing on that foundation today, they are a bridge between “Established Napa” and “Next Napa,” holding onto that sense of place while inviting as many people as they can to revel with them in their shared love of wine.

Crafted from a small lot of the historic Muir-Hanna Vineyard in Oak Knoll, Trois Noix Chardonnay offers delicate notes of white peach, green apple, and jasmine. They chose to forego any malolactic fermentation to maintain the fruit’s freshness and purity of expression, resulting in a wine with medium body, crisp acidity, and minerality.

Though a cold glass is enjoyable on its own, the racy acidity and medium body makes it a perfect pairing for grilled halibut or a creamy risotto.

title: Squealing Pig Rose 2023
bodyHtml:
Squealing Pig, a New Zealand winery established in 2010, is celebrated for its vibrant and approachable wines. Sourcing grapes from renowned regions like Marlborough and Central Otago, the winery emphasizes quality and a playful spirit, appealing to both casual drinkers and connoisseurs.

Wine Description
The Squealing Pig Rosé showcases a delicate pale pink hue. On the nose, it exudes enticing aromas of juicy stone fruits and freshly picked strawberries. The palate is bright and inviting, filled with notes of creamy citrus tart and just-picked strawberries, leading to a refreshing finish. This wine is best enjoyed young to fully appreciate its vibrant character.

Food Pairing
This Rosé pairs wonderfully with light salads, seafood dishes, and soft cheeses. Its refreshing profile also makes it a delightful accompaniment to summer picnics and barbecues. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Bodega Noemia Patagonia Malbec A Lisa 2022
bodyHtml:
A dense violet and plum color. Bouquet of dark berries, cherry, minerals, and cocoa. Medium-bodied with an excellent structure, notes of cherry and cassis; with balanced, persistent tannins.

Pair with steak, turkey and pasta dishes.

title: Michele Chiarlo Barbera d'Asti La Court 2013
bodyHtml:
92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Earthy aromas of ripe black cherry, porcini mushroom, menthol, game and moist just-tilled soil slowly make their way to the forefront. The aromas carry over to the chewy concentrated palate along with a hint of tobacco while buffed tannins provide smooth support. It’s savory and already accessible.

title: Michele Chiarlo Barolo Tortoniano 2021
bodyHtml:
Garnet with brilliant luminous hues. On the nose, it is inviting and complex with notes of rose petals, juniper berries and fine spices. It has ample, good structure with a silky texture of tannins which already give a surprising harmony to the juvenile stage of this Barolo. Remarkable elegance and persistence.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Inviting aromas recalling truffle, wild mint, woodland berry and spice escape the glass along with whiffs of rose. The aromas carry over to the savory, elegant palate together with crushed raspberry and star anise while taut, fine-grained tannins provide structure. Fresh acidity keeps it balanced. It's already approachable but also shows great mid-term aging potential. Best After 2024

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The Michele Chiarlo 2018 Barolo Tortoniano reveals a hint of vintage ripeness with dried raspberry and cherry behind grilled herb and anise seed. The Tortoniano is tight and firm now in its youth with some mild tannic astringency that will surely relax with just a few more years of bottle age. The wine needs four or five years to flesh out and gain in volume.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A spicy style, with a core of cherry and berry fruit augmented by eucalyptus, tobacco, iron and toasty oak notes. This has intensity, yet ends on the elegant side, courtesy of vibrant acidity.

90 Points - James Suckling

Rich red berries, thickened up with sous-bois notes. Medium-bodied with light tannins and a touch of firmness to the finish.

title: Boutinot Les Coteaux Schisteux Seguret 2022
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Rich, fruit driven and elegant - a fantastic Rhone red - and in a magnum! A classic Rhone wine sporting structure and finesse. Intense notes of vanilla, black cherry fruit.

title: WhistlePig 18 Year Old Double Malt
bodyHtml:
WhistlePig Double Malt Rye is their oldest Rye, patiently mellowed for 18 years. Before industrial distillation, America’s original farmers would malt a small portion of their grain to start fermentation, the essential step that turns water and rye into glorious whiskey. As a nod to the farmers, Double Malt Rye is crafted from a mash bill of Rye, Malted Rye and Malted Barley. History aside, these grains unite in a show-stopping Rye Whiskey that stretches far and wide across the flavor spectrum. Its base of 79% Rye delivers bold, peppery spice, while 15% Malted Rye adds soft, floral and earthy character. A final 6% of malted barley brings rich, sweet, toasted notes.

To take the expansive palate of WhistlePig Double Malt even further the 4th Edition is finished in Spanish PX Sherry Casks. At once bold, complex, delicate and elegant, WhistlePig 18 is the whiskey that your most memorable toasts require, and a gem on any bar.

Each annual edition of our Double Malt Rye is crowned with a bespoke glass topper, handmade in Vermont.

title: Lamb's Dark Navy Rum - 1.14 Litre Plastic Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Lamb's Dark Navy Rum is a traditional spirit with a heritage rooted in the Caribbean, blending rums from Barbados, Guyana, Jamaica, and Trinidad. The brand was established in 1849 by 22-year-old Londoner Alfred Lamb, the son of a wine and spirits merchant, who matured his blends in cool cellars beneath the River Thames. While the name pays homage to the historic British Royal Navy tradition of issuing daily rum rations, the company is now a prominent part of the Corby Spirit and Wine portfolio in Canada, where it continues to honor its original maritime character and smooth, refined philosophy.

Spirit Description

This full bodied dark rum is crafted using traditional methods and is celebrated for its robust yet well balanced profile.

  • Color: The rum pours a deep mahogany brown with rich copper highlights.

  • Aroma: The nose is highly aromatic, featuring natural sweet cane and butter-rum alongside pungent molasses, treacle, toffee, and warm baking spices like nutmeg.

  • Palate: On the palate, it delivers a complex blend of sweet island spice, dark molasses, and caramelized fruitcake. Subtle oak undertones are balanced by notes of espresso, cinnamon, and a hint of liquorice.

  • Body and Finish: It possesses a smooth, velvety mouthfeel with a warm, lingering finish that leaves a slightly smoky and spicy dry impression.

The spirit is a meticulous blend of 18 different Caribbean rums, aged to achieve maturity and complexity before being bottled at 40% ABV. Its iconic hexagonal bottle was originally designed to prevent it from rolling across the decks of ships at sea.

title: Painted Rock Cabernet Sauvignon Skaha Bench 2023
bodyHtml:
Painted Rock began with John and Trish Skinner’s belief that the Okanagan Valley had enormous, largely unrealized, potential. While the area was long known for producing some of the world’s finest fruit, it was the wines produced from the 1980’s “Vinifera Program” (where vineyards were paid to remove high producing, inferior hybrids and plant vinifera) that convinced the Skinner’s that the Okanagan would one day be an internationally recognized wine region. 

Concentrated dark fruit with a silky texture, boasting flavors of mocha, cassis, blackberry leaf, and a hint of eucalyptus—well balanced and delightful.

title: Stags' Leap Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley 2021
bodyHtml:
Stags' Leap Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 originates from the United States, specifically from the Napa Valley region in California. Established in 1893, Stags' Leap Winery is one of California's most historic wine estates, located on a unique plot in the Stags Leap District known for its volcanic soils and distinct microclimate. Winemaker Christophe Paubert follows a philosophy of 'low intervention' and strategic sourcing, selecting fruit primarily from the southern, cooler parts of Napa Valley to maintain the signature elegance, focus, and structural balance for which the estate is renowned.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, saturated ruby colour and a medium to full body. The sensory profile is plush and inviting, opening with a vibrant nose of black raspberry, blackcurrant, and blackberry preserves, alongside delicate floral hints of violet, lavender, and cedar. On the palate, it delivers ripe dark plum and black cherry flavours supported by savory notes of sagebrush, clove, and woodsmoke. The wine is characterized by a soft, silky texture with velvety tannins that provide a firm grip, balanced by bright acidity and a tangy undertone.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend consisting of 85% Cabernet Sauvignon, 4% Petit Verdot, 4% Malbec, 4% Tannat, 1% Petite Sirah, 1% Cabernet Franc, and 1% Merlot.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its polished and refined structure, having been aged for 19 months in French oak barrels (27% new) to preserve fruit freshness while adding complexity.

  • ABV: 14.6%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate focuses on sustainable farming and precise vineyard management, this specific bottling is not typically certified organic.

Food Pairing

The savory structure and dark berry profile of this Cabernet Sauvignon make it a versatile partner for rich and robust dishes.

  • Meats: Pairs excellently with grilled tri tip, braised short ribs, herb crusted rack of lamb with a blackberry balsamic glaze, or rare steaks.

  • Savoury & Rich: Suggested pairings include pasta with wild mushrooms and prosciutto, beef Wellington, or mushroom ravioli with arrabbiata sauce.

  • Cheese: Complements mature hard cheeses such as aged cheddar, Parmesan, or Pecorino.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Napa Valley is regarded as an exceptional benchmark year, producing fruit of intense flavour and aromatic intensity. Despite being the second consecutive year of drought conditions which resulted in lower yields and smaller berry sizes, the summer provided moderate temperatures and cool evening breezes that allowed for even ripening. Winemakers took advantage of these near perfect conditions to craft wines with fantastic character, tremendous balance, and polished structural depth.

title: Squealing Pig Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml: Select grapes from Central Otago and Marlborough went into this ripsnorter wine, with a palate bursting with maraschino cherry and blackcurrant flavours, framed by toasty oak. Layers of delicate tannin create an opulent texture that flows to a lingering finish.

title: Vina Zorzal Garnacha Malayeto 2021
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Malayeto 2021 is a red wine with a pleasant range of aromas where red fruits stand out accompanied by spicy notes. Excellent balance, freshness and acidity on the palate. A red wine of great finesse, that is juicy and ripe, with a pleasant depth, long finish and delicious minerality.

One of Zorzal’s most elegant wines.

title: Squealing Pig Pinot Grigio 2022
bodyHtml: Squealing Pig Pinot Gris offers a nose that is brimming with aromas of delicate pear, nectarine, and lemon tart, with perfumed white flowers. The palate is ripe and concentrated, bursting with freshly picked nectarine, nashi pear flavours, and a hint of honeysuckle.

title: Screaming Eagle 'Second Flight' 2014
bodyHtml:
Second Flight offers up floral, blue and black fruit, mocha and white chocolate characteristics. It possesses full-bodied, silky flavors, and a finish that lasts 50+ seconds. It can be enjoyed now, but should evolve effortlessly for 12-15+ years.

97 Points - James Suckling

Intense blackberry and blueberry aromas with hints of fresh mushrooms. Black truffles, too. Full-bodied, tight and chewy with polished and velvety tannins. Long and muscular finish. Energetic. December 2016 availability. Needs four to five years to soften but it's impressive now.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Very deep purple-black, the 2014 Second Flight (composed of 57% Merlot and 43% Cabernet Sauvignon with no Cabernet Franc) is a little closed at this youthful stage, offering glimpses of blueberry compote, blackberry pie and cassis notions with touches of garrigue, bay leaves, black truffles, rose hips and underbrush plus a hint of wood smoke. Medium-bodied, the palate delivers wonderful freshness, with very firm, very finely grained tannins and layers of vibrant black fruits, finishing on a profound minerally note. With this vintage, we can see something of a stylistic departure, offering an expression of Merlot that is bright, refreshing, elegant and perfumed, and it is perhaps more similar to Screaming Eagle in terms of style than it has ever been. Beautiful!

95 Points - Decanter

Second Flight, which began life as Screaming Eagle's second wine, is evolving into an entirely different cuvée dominated by Merlot and mostly drawn from the eastern band of the property which tends to produce the most floral, elegant wines. A superb and expressive bouquet of high-toned black fruit, violet, blood orange and mint is the prelude to a rich, full-bodied palate with a lovely core of primary fruit, a savory chassis of powdery tannins, and a bright line of balancing acidity.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2014 Second Flight is similar to the 2012 with its silky, plush, elegant style. A blend of mostly Merlot with smaller amounts of Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon, it offers terrific notes of cassis and cherry fruits, with lots of spice, sandalwood, and dried earth/flower nuances developing with time in the glass. It’s beautifully balanced, has plenty of power and richness, and a seamless texture. It’s going to drink nicely for 10-15 years.

title: Chapoutier Bila Haut L'Esquerda 2019
bodyHtml:
​The Chapoutier Bila Haut L'Esquerda 2019 is a distinguished red wine from the Côtes-du-Roussillon Villages Lesquerde appellation in the Roussillon region of southern France. Maison M. Chapoutier, established in 1808, is renowned for its commitment to biodynamic viticulture and expressive terroir-driven wines. The Bila-Haut estate, acquired by Michel Chapoutier in 1999, showcases the unique characteristics of the Roussillon terroir, particularly the granitic soils of Lesquerde.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep, intense colour. The nose reveals maturity with aromas of black fruits and warm spices, complemented by floral notes (violet) and subtle smoky hints. On the palate, it is both supple and powerful, with tight, robust tannins leading to a fresh, lingering finish. The blend predominantly consists of Syrah, with Grenache and Carignan, harvested between mid-September and mid-October. The grapes undergo destemming, followed by a maceration period of approximately four weeks, with fermentation temperatures not exceeding 32°C. The wine is aged for 7-8 months in concrete vats.

Accolades

  • James Suckling: 92 points
  • Jeb Dunnuck: 93 points

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with hearty dishes such as osso buco or Provençal daube. These combinations enhance the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Baileyana Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml: This Chardonnay exudes effortless elegance with aromas of lavender and citrus that develop into luscious flavors of grilled cinnamon peaches and ripe tropical fruits. Hints of minerality emphasize the wine’s natural liveliness and is balanced by notes of vanilla, clove and spice that lead to a smooth, memorable finish.

title: Baileyana Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
Exemplifying the vivid excellence of the Edna Valley region, this Pinot Noir exudes expressive dark fruit notes, currants and blueberries, along with a hint of vanilla and cherry cola. The wine has a brilliant acidity that is balanced by fleshy notes of ripe cherry and brown sugar, along with soft, supple tannins that lead to a long, memorable finish.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Lively, fresh and engaging aromas of black raspberry, wild herb and wet stone draw the nose deeply into this bottling, which packs a lot of punch for a fair price. Rich and lush flavors of boysenberry meet with chai on the delicious and engaging palate.

title: Vina Zorzal Crianza 2020
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.

title: Component Wine Co. Petit Verdot 2021
bodyHtml:
Component Wine Company creates single-varietal, single-vineyard wines from Napa Valley, Sonoma, Bordeaux & Provence. Our goal is to provide an intimate & elevated experience in which you learn about the intrinsic characteristics of each grape and each region. How can you discuss the influence of Petit Verdot in a great blend without knowing it intimately first? We hope to aid in that pursuit, while producing some delicious wines along the way.

The Petit Verdot is dense, spiced, showing dark fruit, exotic spice and precision in structure. This wine is drinking beautifully now, and will continue to develop and express more of its secondary nuances over the coming two decades.

title: Michele Chiarlo Barolo Palas 2022
bodyHtml:
The grape variety chosen for this sensational traditional Italian wine is Nebbiolo which comes from Piedmont, from the area of Monforte, Verduno, La Morra. Harvested by hand. Vinification takes place in steel tanks. 13/14 days of maceration in contact with the skins and soft wetting of the cap with the "shower" system at a temperature between 32 and 27 ° C. Malolactic fermentation in steel. Finally the refinement which develops for a at least 3 years, it ages for 24 months in large barrels before refining in the bottle.

A garnet red color with bright reflections. The scent on the nose is varied, first fruity then spicy. The taste is full-bodied, structured, with a well-balanced acidity and a moderately persistent finish.

title: J Lohr Cabernet Sauvignon Signature 2021
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from the United States, crafted in the Paso Robles region of California’s Central Coast. J Lohr Vineyards & Wines is a family-owned estate founded by Jerry Lohr, who pioneered winemaking in the region over five decades ago. With a reputation for innovation and dedication to terroir-driven wines, the winery produces this Signature Cabernet Sauvignon as a tribute to Jerry Lohr’s lifelong contribution to California winemaking.

Wine Description

The 2021 J Lohr Signature Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold and expressive red. Deep garnet in colour, it opens with aromas of cassis, violet, conifer, and hints of cedar. On the palate, layers of blackcurrant, dark chocolate fudge, and coffee cream intertwine with chai spice and subtle tobacco, all supported by firm tannins and a mouth-coating texture. Full-bodied and complex, the wine delivers a long, layered finish with remarkable balance and finesse.

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, rosemary-crusted lamb, or braised short ribs. For a vegetarian option, try it with mushroom risotto or roasted root vegetables.

title: Stalk & Barrel Handcrafted Canadian Whisky
bodyHtml:
This handcrafted Canadian whisky combines a blend of corn, rye and malt whiskies. Pouring a brilliant gold, it opens with aromas of caramel apple and light floral notes; creamy on the palate with vanilla and butterscotch favours and a zingy white pepper note on the finish.

Great for cocktails or serve on the rocks.

title: Tolpuddle Vineyard Pinot Noir Tasmania 2024
bodyHtml:
Tolpuddle Vineyard was established in 1988 and it took its name from the Tolpuddle Martyrs: English convicts transported to Tasmania for forming an agricultural union. The leader of the Martyrs, George Loveless, served some of his sentence working on a property near Richmond, part of which is now Tolpuddle Vineyard.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

In this 2023 iteration, it is clearly evident, but it sits within the confines of the pomegranate/cherry/raspberry fruit with aplomb. Providing further depth of character, a backdrop of star anise, blood orange, coffee grounds, lilac and red apples drive across the palate. This is an enduring wine of sophistication and long-term aesthetic value. 13.5% alcohol, sealed under screw cap.

title: Marimar Estate Dona Margarita Vineyard Pinot Noir 'Mas Cavalls' 2014
bodyHtml: Elegant nose, with classic varietal aromas of wild cherry, clove and sandalwood plus the characteristic note of forest floor from this special vineyard. The tannins are supple and graceful, and the palate is round, complex and fleshy. I would recommend serving it at cellar temperature, between 58-60° F.

title: Felton Road Pinot Noir 'Block 3' Central Otago 2023
Lucien Crochet Sancerre 'Les Calcaires' 2022
bodyHtml:
The wine is complex with notes of white and Citrus fruit. On to the palate refreshing minerality in a slightly accented attack which gives a nice lean bitterness, propping up the notes of citrus, yuzu and lemongrass rounding off this elegant and fine Sancerre.

The grapes are handpicked with the entire bunches fed into pneumatic presses via a conveyor belt
Light pneumatic pressing and cold settling for 24  to 36 hours at approximately 6°C. Fermentation then takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats with a small part in oak barrel. The wines are fined, racked and filtered before bottling.

title: Chateau Ste Michelle Canoe Ridge Estate Merlot 2018
bodyHtml: Bursting with fruit aromatics of sweet cherries backed by sweet vanilla, beautifully balanced red fruits and a well-rounded mouth feel lead to soft, subtle tannins. Light touches of tobacco and spice round out a silky, velvety finish.

title: Bramare Cabernet Sauvignon 'Lujan de Cuyo' 2018
bodyHtml:
The 2018 Bramare Cabernet Sauvignon from Viña Cobos is a distinguished red wine hailing from the Luján de Cuyo region in Mendoza, Argentina. Crafted predominantly from Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, this wine exemplifies Viña Cobos' dedication to producing wines of exceptional quality and character.

Colour: Deep and intense red with dark violet hues, indicating its concentration and youthfulness.

Aroma: A powerful aromatic expression featuring notes of black and red fruits like plum and blackberry, elegantly complemented by spicy nuances.

Palate: Good structure in the mouth, with round tannins leading to a long and persistent finish.

Body: Full-bodied with a rich and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

Accolades:

  • 94 Points - Vinous
  • 93 Points - James Suckling
  • 91 Points - Wine Spectator

bodyHtml:

title: R. Lopez de Heredia Rioja Vina Tondonia Reserva 2011
bodyHtml: Vibrant red leading slightly towards amber. Light fresh texture with notes of vanilla and dried berry aromas. Rich, very dry, smooth, developed. Firm tannins and good balance.

title: Canadian Club Invitation Classic 15 Year Old Sherry Cask
bodyHtml:
First, in the series, this one-time release whisky has all the hallmark notes of CC Classic 12 YO elevated to 15 years with the secondary aging in Oloroso sherry casks. The results are rich aromas of toffee, spice and subtle sweetness with warm and creamy flavours with mellow wood on the palate.

Sip neat or over ice.

title: Casa Dragones Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Casa Dragones Reposado Mizunara is the first tequila rested exclusively in new Mizunara casks, a rare oak native to Japan and traditionally used for aging Japanese whiskies. This delicately rested tequila delivers subtle notes of orange blossom, apricot and coffee bean.

Light, bright golden with a silky texture, and long pronounced legs. Orange blossom, magnolia with gentle notes of honey and sandalwood. Balanced notes of oak, butterscotch and apricot. Long finish with hints of coffee bean and mellow spice.

title: Casa Dragones Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Elevate the way you enjoy tequila with Casa Dragones Blanco, a full-bodied sipping tequila created in Mexico City. Casa Dragones Blanco is an unaged, small batch, 100% Pure Blue Agave silver tequila, crafted to deliver the true essence of agave through an innovative process that focuses on purity, for a crisp, smooth taste.

Truly a tequila to be savored, take a journey with the fresh fruit aroma, the balanced notes of sweet agave and warm spice and a crisp, light finish with a bright aftertaste. This full-bodied tequila liquor is made with pure, natural spring water emanating from the Volcano of Tequila for a fresh, crisp, herbaceous taste. Whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks or in signature craft cocktails, Casa Dragones Blanco offers a beautifully balanced flavor.

This Casa Dragones tequila bottle is the perfect gifting and special occasion alcohol. This award-winning tequila was voted “Best Blanco Tequila” by Epicurious, “Top Ten Blanco Tequilas” by Food & Wine Magazine and one of Oprah’s Favorite Things.

title: Casa Dragones Joven Tequila
bodyHtml:
Small batch, master blend of 100% Blue Agave silver and extra aged tequila, rested in new American Oak barrels, for a complex, smooth taste that is perfect for sipping and pairing with food. 96 points Best Tequila Rating by Wine Enthusiast.

The craftsmanship behind Casa Dragones Joven Sipping Tequila is unparalleled. Each bottle is signed, numbered and engraved by hand. So, no two bottles are ever the same, making it an exceptional gift for your tequila lover.

Rich silky body, with brilliant platinum hues and long pronounced legs. indicated a full body with a sleek texture on the palate. Fresh and inviting, subtle floral and citrus aroma with notes of sweet roasted agave. Soft and smooth with hints of vanilla and spiced undertones, balanced with delicate notes of pear. Clean, warm finish with hints of hazelnuts and a bright, open aftertaste.

title: Del Professore Crocodile Gin
bodyHtml:
A must for your bar. This gin concocted in small batches is the result of a collaboration between Jerry “The Professor” Thomas, owner of a speakeasy in Rome, and the Antica Distilleria Quaglia, specialized in the production of vermouth and grappa.

With a nod to the “Old Tom” style, it is made from aromatics benefiting from cold infusion and gentle filtration. Thus, the essential juniper berry shares the dance floor with coriander, elderflower, vanilla and allspice. Slightly sweet, it is absolutely sublime on ice or dare it as a negroni.

title: Long Meadow Ranch Cabernet Sauvignon 2017
bodyHtml:
In the late 1800’s, the majestic Long Meadow Ranch property thrived with vineyards, apple orchards, olive groves, hay and a goat milk dairy until farming fell dormant during Prohibition. Over the following years, the property became swallowed by the encroaching forest until the Halls bought the property in 1989.

The Hall family carefully breathed life back into the land, nurturing it back to its glory, and then some, by cutting back the abandoned olive trees and replanting the vineyards and apple orchards as you see them growing today.

Aromas of dark red fruit, black tea, sweet cedar and black pepper. The entry introduces plush, soft tannins that persist to the finish. Seamless and sweetly extracted, it reveals layers of flavors in the progression on the palate. Made with organically grown grapes.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Earthy dung and compost give this wine a wild edge, followed by additionally savory highlights of leather and tobacco. Made in an elegant, understated style, with balanced ripeness, the fruit is a mix of plum and cassis, finished in cedar and clove.

title: Kujira Ryukyu 24 Year Old Japanese Bourbon Cask Whisky
bodyHtml:
This Kujira Ryukyu Whisky is 100% selected rice distilled and matured in first fill bourbon barrels for more than 24 years by Kumesen Shuzo in Okinawa. Okinawa is part of the Ryukyu Islands, which are a chain of subtropical islands located at the southernmost tip of Japan. Kujira Ryukyu Whisky is an utterly unique tropical style Japanese Whisky. Thanks to the island’s warm climate, whisky takes less time to mature and thus has a stronger aroma and a bolder taste.

Kumesen Syuzo has been operational since 1952, and its primary product is Awamori. Back in 1989, though, the distillery started experimenting with whisky making in different oak barrels. In 2018, it introduced its first 20 Year Old Single Grain Whisky aged in bourbon cask also known as Kujira Ryukyu whisky.

This small batch Kujira Ryukyu Whisky is matured in bourbon barrel for more than 24 years which is made entirely of rice provides a wonderful taste profile that has distinguished itself from its malt counterparts and creates a refreshing choice for spirits lovers.

Gold 95pts (International Wine & Spirit Competition 2021)

title: Michele Chiarlo Nizza Cipressi 2018
bodyHtml:
The wine producing firm of Michele Chiarlo was founded in 1956 by the sole and present owners, Michele and Giuseppina Chiarlo. Son of over seven generations of esteemed wine growers, Mr. Chiarlo is today one of the most respected producers of the fine wines of Piedmont and a leading figure in its viticultural industry.

Cipressi Nizza is a supple red, packed with fresh blackberry, blueberry, and violet flavors, supported by a firm yet pliant structure. This is persistent, expanding on the finish with a nice sapidity and drinkability.

Ideal pairings for this wine include cured meats, pasta with meat sauce, risotto, fillet, guinea fowl, and medium-aged goat cheeses.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

This supple red is packed with fresh blackberry, blueberry and violet flavors, supported by a firm yet pliant structure. This is persistent, expanding on the finish. 

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Nizza Cipressi is a generous and abundant red wine that shows the latitude and versatility of the native Piedmont Barbera grape. It opens to dark intensity and sweet aromas of blackberry, plum and black currant. Soft tones of cinnamon and baking spice also appear.

title: Cascina Adelaide Preda Barolo 2018
bodyHtml:
“Preda” is the pride of Cascina Adelaide’s winery: a Barolo that is the result of careful selection and expert care, from the vineyard to the bottle. 

The very intense and decisive ruby red color of Barolo Preda heralds an expressive character, which is confirmed on the nose with notes of plum jam, blueberries and mentholated nuances.

In the mouth it stands out with its imposing body and surprises with a note of liquorice that accompanies hints of ripe red fruit.

title: Hidden Bench Estate Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Hidden Bench Estate Chardonnay originates from Canada, specifically from the Beamsville Bench sub-appellation within the Ontario region. Founded in 2003 by Harald Thiel and his family, the winery is a premium artisanal estate dedicated to crafting terroir-focused wines exclusively from its own vineyards. The winemaking philosophy is non-interventionist and quality-driven, emphasizing a 'sense of place' through the use of organic and biodynamic viticulture and indigenous yeast fermentations.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay typically presents a pale gold colour in the glass. The sensory profile is complex and elegant, featuring a nose of ripe pear, grapefruit zest, orange blossom, and hints of toasted marshmallow or warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and dry, delivering layers of stone fruit, green apple, and cold cream balanced by a zesty acidity and the hallmark 'steely' minerality of the Beamsville Bench.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% estate-grown Chardonnay sourced from the Locust Lane, Felseck, and Rosomel vineyards.

  • ABV: Typically ranges between 13% and 13.8% depending on the vintage.

  • Organic Status: The wine is certified organic by Pro-Cert and produced using biodynamic principles.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is often aged on its lees for 9 to 10 months in a combination of French oak (barriques and puncheons) and concrete vessels, and is bottled unfined and unfiltered.

Food Pairing

The wine's refreshing acidity and subtle minerality make it highly versatile for food pairings. Suggested pairings include:

  • Seafood: Grilled white fish tacos with citrus slaw, lobster in butter sauce, or fresh grilled seafood.

  • Poultry & Meat: Herb-roasted chicken, turkey breast, or pork tenderloin.

  • Savoury & Vegetarian: Brown-butter and sage gnocchi, ravioli in an Alfredo sauce, or earthy mushroom-based dishes.

  • Cheeses: Complements mild aged cheeses or appetizers featuring goat cheese.

title: Blasted Church Chardonnay Unorthodox 2021
bodyHtml:
Colour: Medium gold.

Nose: Orange blossom, lemon zest, and stone fruit with a persistent undercurrent of spicy muscat.

Palate: Lemon and a tropical muscat note open the attack and carry into the fresh mid-palate. Tangerine and pineapple take the wine into a persistent, well-balanced finish.

Pairings: Halibut, buttery crab, or a citrusy roasted chicken.

title: Benromach 40 Year Old 2022 Edition
bodyHtml: The second batch of 2022-release of Benromach 40 Year Old has been matured in sherry casks to create aromas of cinnamon, ginger, Seville orange, roasted hazelnut and stewed red berries that fill the nose. The palate offers notes of Morello cherries, baked apple, liquorice, dark chocolate, fruit cake and black pepper, with hints of dark berries and rich oak lingering in the finish.

title: Benromach 40 Year Old 2022 Edition Batch 2
bodyHtml:
The second batch of 2022-release of Benromach 40 Year Old has been matured in sherry casks to create aromas of cinnamon, ginger, Seville orange, roasted hazelnut and stewed red berries that fill the nose.

The palate offers notes of Morello cherries, baked apple, liquorice, dark chocolate, fruit cake and black pepper, with hints of dark berries and rich oak lingering in the finish.

title: F X Barc Sauvignon Blanc Expression 2023
bodyHtml:
Complices de Loire is boutique brand from the Loire Valley, born from the Friendship of Francois Xavier Barc and Gerald Vallee in 2010. Francois Xavier Barc brings extensive experience of winemaking; while Gerald Vallee is the fourth generation of winegrowers in Saint Nicolas de Bourgueil.

Made from grapes harvested from vineyards planted to sandy soils, this is a classic rendition of Loire Valley Sauvignon Blanc.

title: Cuvaison Pinot Noir Carneros 2021
bodyHtml: This Estate Pinot Noir reveals a wild berry character defined by succulent notes of blackberry and black tea that roll into layers of hawthorn, plum and wild strawberry. The marriage of both black and red fruits embodies the classic Los Carneros Pinot Noir, bursting with the heightened aromatics and excellent freshness that define our Cuvaison estate vineyard. The flavors are bold and expansive on the palate, while a vibrant acidity heightens the long and harmonious finish.

title: Cuvaison Chardonnay Carneros 2021
bodyHtml:
Established in 1969, Cuvaison produces Chardonnay and Pinot Noir grown exclusively on its estate vineyard in the heart of the world-renown region of Carneros in Napa Valley.

Wine Description

Produced in a vintage that brought us intensely concentrated fruit, this Chardonnay is lush and bright, inviting you in with warm notes of baked apple, pear and honeysuckle. Expansive across the palate with hints of lemon chiffon and apricot, this vintage enjoys a rich and unctuous finish of warm vanilla and brioche.

Accolades

  • 92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

  • 91 Points - James Suckling

title: Chicken Cock Cotton Club Rye
bodyHtml:
Originally established in Paris, Kentucky in 1856, Chicken Cock was forced to move production up to Canada during Prohibition. The Canadian Rye whiskey produced during that period was then smuggled back into the U.S. in tin cans, earning the brand the nickname, “The whiskey in a tin can."
