Experience the taste of history with Chicken Cock Cotton Club Rye, a 20-year-old rye whiskey that pays tribute to the Prohibition era and the legendary Cotton Club speakeasy. This exceptional whiskey is bottled at 50% ABV (100 proof) and comes in a 750ml size, making it a highly sought-after collector's item and a top choice for whiskey connoisseurs.

Aged for two decades in charred oak barrels, Chicken Cock Cotton Club Rye delivers a bold and robust flavour profile that is both unique and satisfying. On the nose, you'll find hints of baking spices, caramel, and oak, while the palate offers rich flavours of dark chocolate, rye spice, and toasted nuts, balanced by a touch of fruity sweetness. The finish is long, warm, and lingering, leaving you with an unforgettable whiskey experience.

title: Chicken Cock Island Rooster Rye
bodyHtml:
Chicken Cock is kicking off what it terms the “Summer of the Rooster” with a new limited-edition release of Island Rooster Rum Barrel Rye.

The new expression starts with Chicken Cock’s Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey and is finished in Caribbean rum casks for at least six months. Island Rooster has a 95% rye and 5% malted barley mash bill, which is bottled at 95 proof (47.5% ABV) in an apothecary-style embossed bottle featuring a premium metal cup cap –perfect for pouring while outside this summer.

Island Rooster was inspired by a trip to the Caribbean, where roosters announce the coming day. With this new release, Chicken Cock is announcing its “Summer of the Rooster” program where the brand will showcase its bold, confident, and expressive take on the iconic Chicken Cock rooster.

title: Chicken Cock Double Oak
bodyHtml:
You can't have great whiskey without great wood. That is why they aged our 8-year-old whiskey in American oak barrels twice. This process allows them to extract all of the great flavor within the oak to create a robust and interesting sipper.

Chestnut brown. Dark chocolate covered berries, toasted coconut shavings, and caramel coffee. Sapid flavors of vanilla bean, wae cone, steeped berries, and warm baking spices. Round and balanced with creamy undertones and hints of creme brulee and cinnamon flan.

title: Chicken Cock Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml: Distilled, aged, and bottled in Kentucky, Chicken Cock Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey has a rich, elegant mahogany hue color, a nose with a nice balance of oak tones with sweet notes of dried fruit, caramel and vanilla.

title: Double Diamond Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 (by Schrader Cellars)
bodyHtml:
In 2001, Fred Schrader created Double Diamond to make fine-quality Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon that could be enjoyed every day without breaking the bank. This character-driven expression of America’s premier wine region is crafted by Thomas Rivers Brown in the Schrader Cellars tradition of excellence which has earned an unprecedented record of twenty-seven 100-point scores from the world’s most respected critics. Double Diamond’s new label, as fabulous as the wine inside, was created by Carol Schrader. In fact, Carol met Fred when she was designing the original label back in the early 2000s.

Now, Fred and Carol are able to fulfill their dream of bringing Double Diamond to an even broader spectrum of fine wine lovers.

In the glass, the wine displays a nearly opaque ruby-purple hue. Upon closer inspection, aromas emerge in waves suggesting framboise, nutmeg, toasted cedar bark, plum reduction, and pennyroyal mint. The sleek palate is marked by mouth-watering notes such as blackberry compote, dark chocolate shavings, cassis, oolong tea, flint, and lavender. The dynamic flavors interact on the mid-palate with a vivid harmony, carrying through to the long floral finish, which lasts for up to a minute. With a pleasing acidity and fine tannic framework, this wine is very enjoyable today and should develop gracefully in the cellar for years to come.

title: Provenance Vineyards Deadeye Red Blend 2018
bodyHtml:
Expressive aromas of ripe black cherry, blackberry and dark chocolate invite the senses, complemented by subtle notes of clove and spice. The palate showcases structured tannins rounded out by exuberant red berry fruits and vanilla bean flavors. The wine is deliciously chewy, round and plush.

Deadeye Red Blend by Provenance Vineyards lives at the creative intersection of careful vineyard selection and winemaker’s expertise in blending. The Deadeye icon draws directly from the Provenance logo, where the crosshairs symbol sits over the “O,” signifying their winemaking precision.

title: Cockburn's Special Reserve
bodyHtml: One of the world's mainstays in from Porto, the Cockburn's Special Reserve (first produced in 1969) simply drinks well. This Port is not overtly sweet and shows a pleasing balance of elements, ripe fruit, creamy toffee, and dried herbs. Drinks well by itself, or with medium-sweet desserts.

title: Gonzales Byass Nutty Solera
bodyHtml: Intense nut, raisin, spice, toffee, coffee and orange zest notes as if it was built for cold nights during the winter holidays around the fire. The palate is medium sweet, full bodied and rich with raisin, clove, walnut, orange zest and some earthy, meaty notes in the background.

title: El Tequileno Reposado Cristalino Tequila
bodyHtml: Produced using 100% Blue Weber agave and natural spring water. The fermentation takes place in stainless steel tanks without fibres. Copper pot still and aged in American White Oak barrels. Aromas of vanilla, mint and orange peel on the nose with vanilla coming through on the palate.

title: El Tequileno Blanco Platinum Tequila
bodyHtml:
El Tequileno Platinum is made from 100% Estate Agave grown in the Highland of Jalisco. It is left to mellow in American Oak for thirty days before bottling. Can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks or makes a phenomenal margarita!

Cooked agave, herbal notes, delicate notes of anis and black pepper.  Slight spiciness and sweet cooked agave. Delicate and smooth.

title: El Tequileno Blanco Platinum Tequila - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
El Tequileno Platinum is made from 100% Estate Agave grown in the Highland of Jalisco. It is left to mellow in American Oak for thirty days before bottling. Can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks or makes a phenomenal margarita!

Cooked agave, herbal notes, delicate notes of anis and black pepper.  Slight spiciness and sweet cooked agave. Delicate and smooth.

title: El Tequileno Reposado Gran Reserva Tequila - 375 ml
bodyHtml: El Tequileno Gran Reserva is made from 100% Estate Agave grown in the Highlands of Jalisco. It is aged for a minimum of 4 months in American Oak and blended with small amounts of Anejo. This is a must-have for any reposado collector.

title: El Tequileno Anejo Gran Reserva Tequila
bodyHtml: This Anejo gran reserva tequila is made with 100% Blue Agave from the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Expect alluring aromas of orange, honey, vanilla, and leather. On the palate, sweet oak, pepper, cooked agave, dried fruit, and caramel. Full-bodied with a long finish. Serve neat alongside apple caramel tarts.

title: El Tequileno Reposado Rare Tequila
bodyHtml:
Reposado Rare is the story of a father and son who wanted to create something unique. They wanted to age a tequila for the length of an Anejo but get creative with the barrel. The original plan was to rest it for 15 months, in a pipon (large format barrel) but things didn't go as planned and it spent 6 years in the pipon. The 6 years of undisturbed rest created a tequila of amazing complexity, with rich exceptional depth. Only 300 bottles of Reposado Rare have been bottled. Each bottle is individually numbered and signed. 

Vanilla, honey, subtle touch of black pepper, cooked agave on the nose. Taste of marzipan, light spiciness with notes of sweet agave and oak.

title: Maker's Mark Bourbon Cask Strength Batch 23-03
bodyHtml:
Bottled at barrel proof, Maker’s Mark Cask Strength ranges from 108 to 114 proof depending on the barrels. Surprisingly smooth, this bourbon retains the signature, front-of-the-palate flavors of Maker’s Mark while amping up the vanilla and rich oak notes.

Big oak, vanilla and caramel in aroma.  Flavours are robust, with a warm texture and notes of caramel, vanilla and spice.  Long finish on front of tongue, harmonious with no harsh bitterness.

title: El Tequileno Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Aged 100% Agave Tequila produced with the best blue agave. Aged in white oak barrels, which give El Tequileno Tequila Reposado a soft, distinguished flavour, with a quality that satisfies the most demanding tastes.

title: Lagavulin Islay 12 Year Old Single Malt Special Release 2023
bodyHtml:
Thick wisps of aromatic herbal smoke honour the ancient art of tattooing. The sweet scent of ripe plums lingers, as smoky black ink etches an outline of past generations ascending to legendary heights. Each work of art is a map of historic victories, carved on a living canvas.

Inspired by the spirit of intensity and pride that shines through Lagavulin history of more than 200 years, our Malt Master explores the symbols of the ancient Mesoamerican art of tattoo. The whisky, finished in Don Julio Anejo tequila casks, pulses with herbal flavours ancient and modern.

Amid fierce glints of gold, fresh notes of clean sea air, citrus and ripened berries mingle with intense herbal smoke in a fusion of aromas, while the creamy-smooth texture plays canvas to a rich palette of flavours. Sweet with juicy plums and hint of saltiness, the flavours deep-etch their impression for a lip-tingling whisky of legends.

title: Merryvale Solstice Brut (NV)
bodyHtml:
Sourced exclusively from their Stanly Ranch Estate Vineyard on the Napa side of Carneros, this non-vintage release of their Solstice Sparkling wine is a blend of 92% Pinot Noir and 8% Chardonnay drawn from the 2018, 2019 and 2020 vintages.

This sparkling wine was made in the methode champenoise, which means the bubbles are created by a secondary fermentation in the bottle. Since the first release, we made the stylistic decision to age the bottles sur latte for 24 months, which is 9 months longer than the minimum required by law for non-vintage Champagne.

As a result, having spent two years in bottle sur lie, there is a pleasant aroma of toasted hazelnut. The Chardonnay in the blend provides aromas of Meyer lemon and a steely minerality. The Pinot Noir portion of the blend provides weight on the mid-palate and flavors of sour cherry. The use of the reserve wine in the blend adds a complexity and depth on both the nose and the palate. Finished in a Brut style, this sparkling wine shows a crisp and refreshing finish.

title: Sandeman Tawny 10 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The intense red tawny color with shades of brick, typical of this style of aged yet youthful wine, anticipates the elegant and complex aroma, combining ripe fruit, jam and nuts, with hints of vanilla and raisins. In the mouth, Sandeman Tawny 10 Years Old is a most flavorsome wine, full-bodied and appealing, with a persistent finish.

92 Points - Decanter

Deep hue. Marked fresh red fruit, almost vinous aromas. Big and bold with brooding dried fruit and a dark chocolate finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Rich and supple, offering creamy flavors of hazelnut, Christmas pudding and ripe cherry, with cocoa powder notes. Lush and spicy on the long, ripe finish.

91 Points - James Suckling

Dried fruit, bark, and burnt orange aromas follow through to a medium body, medium-sweet palate with more dried fruits, and an earthy finish. Fruitier style.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The youngest in the great range of Sandeman aged tawnies, this 10-year-old brings out fruit as well as wood flavors. That gives the wine freshness to balance its natural richness, spice and fine acidity. Dried fruits come through at the end.

title: Sidewood Estate Pinot Noir 'Abel' 2021
bodyHtml:
Aromas of mulberry, dark plum and old Forrest jump from the glass, seamless leading to the velvety palate of blue berries, licorice, loamy soil and black truffle.

Concentrated flavors that remain light on the palate, with a finessed elegant finish.

title: Luca Chardonnay Altos De Mendoza G Lot 2023
bodyHtml:
Beautiful pale gold color with enticing aromas of lemon crème, baking spices and a minerality in its long finish. The aromas carry through to the palate, and are joined by hints of white peach flavors, spiced baked pear, and a stony/mineral flavor that creates a stylish wine that appears part New and part Old World. This wine will age well for years in a cellar.

Pairs well with most fish, crab, chicken and even pork.

title: Henry of Pelham Cabernet - Merlot 2021
bodyHtml: Plummy, yet bright with red-berry fruit and smoky notes this Cabernet-Merlot is a dry red wine.

title: Harveys Bristol Cream
bodyHtml: Floral, herbals, caramel, dried citrus and fig aromas. Very soft, sweet, slightly nutty flavour. Medium-bodied and rich.

title: Offley Duke Of Oporto Ruby
bodyHtml: Bright ruby red; fresh nose of cherries, berries and spice; the palate is not too sweet, the fruit is a bit candied here, but the freshness is attractive and there is a hint of tannin; no lack of flavour, quite good length. Good for what it is and what it costs.

title: Warre's Warrior Reserve
bodyHtml: The nose shows a lot of complexity with chocolates, dates, figs, raisins, plums, red liquorice, blackcurrants, mulberry and black cherry with a nice oak integration and a spicy, mint finish.

title: Masukagami Shuzo Seishu Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Established in 1892, Masukagami Co., Ltd. is a historic brewery whose name is derived from a waka poem in the Manyoshu, Japan's oldest anthology of poetry. The "Seishu" expression is the brewery's standard or entry-level offering, crafted to be a reliable "daily drinker". In the legal context of Japanese liquor laws, Seishu simply means "clear sake," but as a product label, it often represents a brewery's signature house style—one that is accessible, consistent, and deeply reflective of its regional roots.

Description

True to the Niigata tradition, this sake is characterized by a "light and tasty" flavor profile designed for easy drinking. It is clear and crisp, featuring a subtle, clean scent of fresh rice and a hint of stone fruit or plum. On the palate, it is dry and refreshing with a smooth, unassuming body that makes it highly approachable. The brewery focuses on maintaining a "playful spirit" even in their standard brews, ensuring that the sake remains vibrant and balanced rather than one-dimensional. The finish is remarkably clean, leaving the palate refreshed. ABV approximately 15%–15.5%.

Food Pairing

Masukagami Seishu is a "very versatile" sake intended to be enjoyed alongside a wide variety of cuisines. Its dry and crisp nature makes it a natural partner for traditional Japanese dishes like sashimi, grilled fish, and vegetable tempura. However, its light body also allows it to transition seamlessly to Western fare; it is often paired with Italian or French seafood preparations, where it enhances the ingredients without overpowering them. It can be enjoyed at a broad range of temperatures, from lightly chilled to warm, making it a flexible choice for year-round evening drinking.

title: Kolonist Bisser Brut 2019
bodyHtml:
Kolonist Bisser Brut is an exquisite sparkling wine that embodies elegance and sophistication. Crafted with precision, this bubbly delights the palate with its crisp and refreshing character. Its fine bubbles dance on the tongue, releasing a symphony of flavors, including hints of green apple, citrus, and floral notes. With a balanced acidity and a dry finish, Kolonist Bisser Brut is the perfect choice for celebrating special moments or elevating any occasion.

Whether enjoyed on its own or paired with a variety of dishes, this sparkling wine from the Kolonist collection promises a delightful sensory experience that lingers in memory. Cheers to indulgence!

title: Magija Apricot Brandy
bodyHtml: Magija apricot rakija is colourless and crystal clear. The scent feels full, well-developed and gentle. It tastes impressive, complete and harmonious, with a great length on the palate. Best served at room temperature or chilled up to basement cellartemperature. It is most often served as an aperitif but can also be served at the end of a meal.

title: Barros Colheita Port 1998
bodyHtml:
Barros wines are a celebration of Portuguese talent. They express a talent which is very Portuguese, enhanced by experience and knowledge. They were created in the beginning of the 20th century, in 1913, and soon became a reference brand to Port wine consumers. In honour of the Portuguese consumer, Barros wines encompass Port Tawny wines and Port Ruby wines.

93 Points -  Wine Spectator 

Amber colour with a bouquet reminiscent of dried fruits and spice. Soft and velvety on the palate with a lingering finish.

title: Ciroc Passion Vodka
bodyHtml:
Celebrate every occasion with the tropical flavors of Ciroc Passion. Our rich-tasting spirit is made with vodka distilled five times from fine French grapes and is finished in a tailor-made copper pot still in Southern France.

Masterfully infused with an exotic blend of distinctive flavors inspired by the tropics, this beachside-ready spirit shines with subtle notes of pineapple, citrus, mango, and hibiscus, resulting in a tasting experience that is lusciously different and elegantly smooth.

For the perfect summertime cocktail, enjoy with soda and lemon or a splash of lemonade.

title: Fettercairn 16 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml: More fabulous Fettercairn to enjoy as the fourth release from the brand's annual batch of 16-year-old single malt arrives. For the 2023 bottling, Fettercairn selected whisky aged in a combination of first-fill bourbon casks and Port pipes and then bottled it up at 46.4% ABV.

title: Tracy & Cie Sauvignon Blanc Les Marnes 2024
bodyHtml: Attracted by the terroir of Menetou Salon, the vineyards of Tracy & Cie were carefully selected to express the best characteristics of the grapes. The wines are made with same philosophy that has made Chateau Tracy world-renowned - purity, balance, terroir-driven, sustainably farmed, and handcrafted.

title: Blandy's 5 Year Old Reserva
bodyHtml:
The Blandy family is unique in being the only family of all the original founders of the Madeira wine trade to still own and manage their own original wine company. Throughout its long history on the island, the family has played a leading role in the development of Madeira wine throughout its long history. Members of the family continues to live on Madeira, maintaining a tradition that goes back to 1811; 2 centuries of fine wine production.

Attractive golden-brown colour. The nose has the classic bouquet of Madeira wines, nuts, caramel and notes of spices and wood. On the palate it is velvety, soft and firm, balanced acidity. A long finish of mouth with notes of mint.

title: Barack Palinka Apricot Brandy
bodyHtml:
Barack Palinka is a traditional Hungarian apricot brandy without added artificial colors and flavorings. Apricots (translated into Hungarian Barack) are grown, distilled and stored in oak barrels in the Hungarian lowlands.

Barack Palinka is the name for a type of spirit that is made exclusively from fruit harvested in Hungary. We recommend always serving it chilled!

title: Evesham Wood Pinot Noir Eola Amity Hills 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from the United States, produced in the Eola Amity Hills subregion of the Willamette Valley in Oregon. Evesham Wood was founded in 1986 by Russ Raney and is now owned and operated by Erin and Jordan Nuccio, who maintain the estate's original focus on site specificity. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes minimal intervention and organic farming, utilizing non-irrigated vineyards and native yeast fermentations to produce wines that are elegant, balanced, and reflective of their volcanic soil origins.

Wine Description

The Evesham Wood Pinot Noir Eola Amity Hills presents a brilliant ruby colour. The nose is aromatic and layered, offering scents of fresh pomegranate, wild strawberry, and rose petal, with deeper notes of forest floor and wet stone. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and lithe, delivering a vibrant core of red fruit integrated with subtle earthy undertones and white pepper. It is characterized by its high acidity, fine-grained tannins, and a long, savoury finish that showcases its cool-climate energy. This 100% Pinot Noir typically has an ABV of 13% and is produced from estate-grown grapes that are certified organic by Stellar Certification Services.

title: Fettercairn 18 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Fettercairn 18 Year Old annual limited release, has been created using a handpicked selection of first fill and refill ex-bourbon American white oak casks and then finished in responsibly sourced 100% Scottish oak casks.

As the new make spirit evolves in this unique cask duo, it creates balance and brings a beautiful richness and depth to their tropical distillery house character.

title: Vigneti Zabu Impari Nero D'Avola 2022
bodyHtml: Deep ruby red, impenetrable, with garnet highlights.  Wrapping, intense, elegant, with spicy notes of liquorice, black pepper, tobacco, blackberry jam.  Spicy aftertaste, very long-lasting ending, with sweet hints.

title: Flecha Azul Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Founded by Abraham Ancer and Aron Marquez and backed by Mark Wahlberg this premium tequila is free from additives and aged six months in ex-bourbon American oak barrels. It features notes of vanilla and butter and delivers a round sweet finish with a subtle taste of brown spices. Enjoy neat or on ice.

title: Casa Dos Vinhos Fine Old 5 Year Old Madeira
bodyHtml:
Casa Dos Vinhos Fine Old Madeira is a fortified wine, aged in oak casks for five years. It has amber copper colour and is 19% alcohol by volume.

The wine is sweet, with balanced and crisp acidity, dried fruit and burnt sugar flavours with hints of ‘rancio’ and a long, warm finish.  Aromas of rich, baked/smoke, mincemeat, toffee and butterscotch.

This wine is perfect served as an aperitif, on the rocks, with a twist of lemon.  It can also be served as a dessert wine with cheeses, cakes, fruit compotes or rich puddings.

title: Ar.Pe.Pe Rosso di Valtellina 2023
bodyHtml:
When he presented his Prelude for Solo Violin to the public in Paris, the young Johann Sebastian Bach appeared fragile and evanescent, and yet the master of an impressive technique. There was nothing ordinary about it and every movement of the bow brought something new, a music that left everyone speechless.

When the first Italian PopWine rankings were announced at Vinitaly 2014, the Rosso di Valtellina was the first to reach the top spot. La Gazzetta dello Sport talked of the rise of this tonic Nebbiolo from the Alps, describing its youthful impetuosity and modern expressive elegance.

The Rosso di Valtellina DOC from ARPEPE first saw the light in 2003, after a sweltering summer that had put their vines and our winegrowers sorely to the test. It would not have been fair to demean all their hard work by selling off the grapes, which were unsuitable for making a vintage wine. The choice came naturally: what might have had little value in the distant future could be given great dignity when young. The Rosso di Valtellina thus acquired a free and light-hearted personality, even though its elder siblings, more serious and refined, feared it might not last for years.

title: Levert Freres Chablis 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from France, produced in the renowned Chablis region of Burgundy. Levert Frères is a historic winery known for its commitment to traditional winemaking practices that aim to highlight the unique persona of the Chablis terroir. The winemaking philosophy centres on preserving the classic characteristics of the region—freshness, purity, and elegant mineral expressions.

Wine Description

The Levert Frères Chablis presents a bright pale straw colour in the glass. The nose is aromatic and gently complex, offering a 'hazelnut-tinged' bouquet of ripe lemon-apple meringue, grapefruit, and lemon pith. On the palate, the wine is dry and medium-bodied with a lively, harmonious texture featuring flavours of lemon, apple, and melon meringue. It is characterized by its crisp acidity, balanced structure, and a lingering, lightly saline, minerally finish. This 100% Chardonnay typically has an ABV of 12.5%.

title: Newfoundland London Dock Proof
bodyHtml:
An old style Demerara rum aged in Guyana for two years, and blended at 57.1% or 100 British Proof, it has a strong aroma of molasses and burnt caramel punctuated by hints of citrus, banana peel, vanilla and baking spices.

Dark and strong with a bold taste, London Dock is perfect for rum cocktails.

title: Cedar Creek Pinot Noir Aspect 'Block 2' 2020
bodyHtml:
Their Home Block vineyard, planted on the eastern shores of Okanagan Lake in 1991, has shown us time and again that it produces truly exceptional Pinot Noir.

This wine is a tribute to the unique blend of clones planted on clay, silt, and stone. Fermented with wild yeasts and aged in French oak for a year to allow the different expressions of Pinot Noir to marry into a wine that perfectly captures the character of their founding vineyard.

title: Cedar Creek Pinot Noir Aspect 'Block 4' 2019
bodyHtml:
Their Home Block vineyard, planted on the eastern shores of Okanagan Lake in 1991, has shown us time and again that it produces truly exceptional Pinot Noir.

This wine is a tribute to the unique blend of clones planted on clay, silt, and stone. Fermented with wild yeasts and aged in French oak for a year to allow the different expressions of Pinot Noir to marry into a wine that perfectly captures the character of their founding vineyard.

title: Cedar Creek Chardonnay Aspect 'Block 5' 2020
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from Block 5 at the top of their Home Block Vineyard. What used to be a vigorous, heavy canopy quickly showed a big change as a result of the organic viticulture practices they put in place.

The fruit is developed riper flavors, but less sugar than it had in previous years.

title: Obsidian Ridge Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: The Estate Cabernet is the signature wine of Obsidian Ridge and embodies the complexity and wildness of the site. The structure and intensity of upper blocks is complemented by aromatics and acidity of cooler blocks. Aromas of freshly-cut red cherries with hints of cinnamon and spice. Flavors of mulberry and plum, woven with dried oregano and chapparal, are supported by a rich texture of fine, leathery tannins. Notes of star anise, cinnamon, and orange peel inspire pairing with Mediterranean dishes. Fresh acidity keeps the wine lively on the finish.

title: Casal Farneto Montepulciano 2023
bodyHtml:
Casal Farneto Wine Estate is located in the Le Marche region, between the sea and the Apennines and surrounded by some of Ancona's most beautiful hilly scenery. This is the landscape of high-quality wines such as Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi. The estate works on principles of tradition, technology and sustainability around its 35 acres of vineyard, combining these to produce great quality wines. Both red and white grapes are grown here under the shade of the Farnetto oaks that lend their name to the estate with a particular focus on organic wines.

Medium to full-bodied with an intense bouquet of dark cherries and black plums. Smooth tannins and a warming, generous finish.

title: Bottega Rose Gold Extra Brut (NV) - 200 ml
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s Veneto region, Bottega Rose Gold is a sparkling rosé Prosecco crafted entirely from Pinot Noir grapes. Presented in a striking rose gold-tone 200 ml bottle, it combines style, elegance, and flavour in a size perfect for parties, weddings, and special occasions.

Wine Description
This sparkling rosé displays a delicate salmon-pink colour with lively, persistent bubbles. The nose reveals fresh strawberry, raspberry, and subtle floral aromas, layered with hints of cream and vanilla. On the palate, it is fruit-forward and refreshing, made in a slightly off-dry style that balances juicy red berry flavours with bright acidity. The finish is smooth, light, and celebratory

Food Pairing
A natural partner to cakes, berry tarts, and fruit-based desserts, this sparkling rosé also pairs beautifully with vanilla sponge or cream-filled pastries. These combinations highlight the wine’s red fruit character and its touch of sweetness.

title: Neleman Nucli Organic Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
Nucli is the Catalan word for core, in this case the essence of good wine. This beautifully clear red wine is a blend of tempranillo, syrah and petit verdot grapes. Spicy, fruity and fresh aroma of red fruit and a touch of oak.

The taste is juicy, full and aromatic with light and soft tannins in the aftertaste. Delicious accessible round red wine, delicious to drink on its own or to combine with slightly spicy dishes of poultry or pork. The best when chilled.

title: Chateau Fontenil 2015
bodyHtml:
In 1986 when Michel Rolland purchased Chateau Fontenil, his original intentions were to buy a house on the right bank. However, Michel fell in love with the Chateau and the vines, ultimately deciding to continue using the estate for the production of high-quality wines. Rolland spent nearly 13 years renovating and revitalizing the estate. 

The Estate manages 11 hectares of vines averaging nearly 45 years in age with the majority of plantings dedicated to Merlot and Cabernet Franc. The wines are fermented in small wooden and steel vats with a touch of whole cluster fermentation and aged in 100% French oak with 60% new oak influence.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of impeccably ripe cassis, blackberries, and dark cherries. Very fruit-focused nose. The palate has a suave array of layered tannins that carry dark-cherry and blueberry flavors. Really pure wine.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2015 Fontenil is deep garnet-purple in color with crushed red and black currants, black cherries, and mulberries notions with an earthy undercurrent of underbrush and truffles plus a waft of tilled soil. The medium to full-bodied palate has bags of purity and minerality with a firm frame of chewy tannins and lively acid line lifting the youthful fruit to a long finish. This should age beautifully!

91 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

From the home estate of Michel and Dany Rolland, the 2015 Fontenil is an elegant, fresh, medium-bodied Fronsac excelling on its purity and finesse. Displaying beautiful notes of black fruits, plums, leafy herbs, and hints of lead pencil, it has integrated acidity, ripe, moderate tannin, and an impeccably balanced profile that will keep it drinking nicely for at least a decade.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Solid, with a core of steeped plum and black currant fruit that melds nicely with singed alder and smoldering tobacco notes. Light chalky minerality hangs on the finish, giving this cut and length.

title: Small Gully Shiraz Oscar's Estate Vineyard 2016
bodyHtml:
Small Gully produces wines of a distinctively bold and intense Barossa style with a great expression of fruit character which reflects the region and meticulous vineyard management.

Smooth and succulent and wonderfully robust with intense blackberry fruit, caramel, and cocoa shows good acid. This wine is polished in texture, glowing with plum, sage cream and spice flavours. The palate is dry, with nice fruit and a plush texture. Finishes long and lithe. The palate is dry, with nice fruit and a plush texture.

title: Spier Merlot Signature Collection 2023
bodyHtml:
This medium-bodied red originates from South Africa’s renowned Western Cape. Established in 1692, Spier Wine Farm is one of the oldest wine farms in Stellenbosch and has been owned by the Enthoven family since 1993.

Wine Description

The Spier Merlot Signature Collection presents a medium ruby red colour in the glass. The nose is inviting and berry-forward, offering aromas of red and black berries and ripe dark cherries, underscored by a subtle hint of mint and eucalyptus. On the palate, the wine is plump and round, featuring a juicy freshness, bright acidity, and sleek, well-integrated tannins.

title: Pablo Claro Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml: Pablo Claro Chardonnay is made from 100% organic and biodynamic Chardonnay grapes grown in the estate's own vineyards around the Dominio de Punctum estate. Bright golden yellow colour with light green reflections. A bouquet of green apple, pear and hints of exotic fruits like pineapple on the nose. On the palate it is tasteful, a bit creamy and round with fresh acidity, which makes it appear tangy. In the finish the bouquet of exotic fruits echoes.

title: Lapis Luna Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: Crimson in the glass with aromas of dark chocolate, cherry and a hint of roasted coffee. Rich and full textured on the palate with profound dark fruit. The finish brings succulent tannins and is long reaching, leaving you craving for more.

title: Three Thieves Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: A classic California wine, Three Thieves is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, sourced from the Monterey and Lodi regions. Medium-bodied and rich, with forward aromas and flavours of berry compote, candy and dried pear. The toasty and vanilla notes from ageing in French and American oak barrels linger on a long and spicy finish.

title: Dona Dominga Cabernet - Carmenere 2025
bodyHtml: Plummy and smoky spiced, balsamico and grilled peppers with leather and smoke and spice with dusty grippy tannins on the finish. Good acidity and spiced cherry flavors linger... This old-vines blend of Cabernet and Carmenere is one for the hard cheese and meat dishes.

title: Felton Road Pinot Noir Bannockburn 2024
bodyHtml: On the palate, there is a combination of transparency, power and tension. The silky entry of spice and savory notes expand to pure, deep fruits, braced with acidity, but luscious throughout. The frame is a finely woven lattice work: intricate and detailed with astrong sense of longevity. This exemplary wine is a blend of four properties that elegantly expresses the graceful and more subtle side of Pinot Noir from Bannockburn.

title: Craggy Range Sauvignon Blanc Te Muna 2025
bodyHtml: Craggy Range is a family-owned winery established in 1997 and named by the U.S publication Wine Enthusiast magazine as New World Winery of the Year for 2014. It is situated in the shadow of the spectacular Te Mata Peak in the premium wine-growing area of Hawke’s Bay, New Zealand. Based on the single vineyard philosophy of winemaking, Craggy Range was the first in the Southern Hemisphere to make single vineyard wines from multiple New Zealand regions with grape varieties matched to place. The winery produces a portfolio of quality wines including the iconic Prestige and Family collections, as well as Limited Editions all reflecting the place and the people.

title: Banfi Pinot Grigio San Angelo 2024
bodyHtml:
Banfi San Angelo Pinot Grigio is a distinguished Italian white wine from the renowned Banfi winery in Tuscany.

This wine is best enjoyed in its youth, chilled to perfection, and comes in an elegant Banfi-labeled bottle, embodying a tradition of Italian winemaking excellence. Banfi San Angelo Pinot Grigio offers a delightful taste of Tuscany's winemaking heritage. Fresh, fruity and crisp, this refreshing Pinot Grigio has the barest hint of effervescence. A fresh bouquet of pear, peach, honey and a touch of anise opens to mouthwatering acidity and a rich mouthfeel with a slight effervescence. Outstanding with savory antipasti, seafood or light dishes like pasta primavera. Delicious also after the meal.

title: Fabulous Ant Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
This Pinot Noir from South Central Hungary is excellent value with cherry, strawberry and clove aromas on the nose and a silky, light-bodied palate.

Pair with BBQ Chicken and Potato Salad or Smoked Salmon. Perfect red wine to pair with Christmas Turkey!

title: Henry Of Pelham Sibling Rivalry White 2020
bodyHtml: It's in the partnership, three brothers blending inspiration and passion. These personalities work together to bring three different philosophies. A triumvirate of Riesling, Chardonnay and Gewurztraminer. Think lime citrus and apple freshness with a dash of lychee fruit, in that order.

title: Bodega Noemia Malbec J Alberto 2021
bodyHtml:
These 4 hectares of vineyards were planted in 1955. The vines are massale selection, original rootstock ungrafted, so there is nothing clonal about these vines, and each one is genetically different from the other. The vineyard is composed of 95% Malbec interplanted with 5% Merlot. It is irrigated up to 4 times a year by the traditional method of flooding, with water of maximum purity coming from the Río Negro, which is the soul of our valley. The vineyard does not receive any type of treatment, sprays or sulphites; it is certified organic.

94 Points - James Suckling

A full-bodied red with olives, blackberries, wild blueberries, mussel shells and hints of licorice on the nose. Fresh and creamy, structured too, with a delicious saline minerality and fine, tea-like tannins. Drink or hold.

title: Feudi di Romans Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
Feudi di Romans Pinot Grigio is an exquisite Italian white wine that epitomizes elegance and finesse. Hailing from the renowned Friuli-Venezia Giulia region, it showcases the essence of the grape variety. This Pinot Grigio is meticulously crafted, reflecting the winery's dedication to quality. With a pale straw color, it exudes an enticing bouquet of fresh orchard fruits, zesty citrus, and subtle floral notes.

The palate is a harmonious blend of crisp acidity and a delicate mineral backbone, offering a refreshing and well-balanced taste. Feudi di Romans Pinot Grigio is a perfect choice for those seeking a refined, Italian white wine experience.

title: Paul Zinck Riesling 2023
bodyHtml:
Just a few kilometers southwest of Colmar, the Zinck winery is located in Eguisheim, one of the loveliest villages in Alsace. The climate is semi-continental, sunny, temperate and dry, sheltered by the Vosges mountains.

Transparent lemon yellow colour. An unusually floral style, this wine retains full fruit aromas of citrus and a rare hint of pineapple. Citrus fruit in abundance, like a bowl of fruit salad with a clear, crisp and long finish.

title: Trimbach Riesling 2023
bodyHtml: Its delicate bouquet, beautiful balance, dry character, distinguished fruitiness and natural liveliness contribute to its exceptional richness. As required by the house style, it is vinified dry, straight, and precise, every year.

title: Eisele Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 'Altagracia' 2013
bodyHtml:
First planted to vines in the 1880s, Eisele Vineyard sits in the northeast Napa Valley, just east of Calistoga at the base of the Palisades Mountain range. Farmed organically since 1998 and biodynamically since 2000, the site has been principally dedicated to Cabernet Sauvignon for the last fifty years. 

At first, the nose reveals rose petal notes with a hint of peony, then it opens up with blackcurrant, dark cherry aromas and a pinch of licorice. The mouthfeel is unctuous and succulent with a savory black fruit sustained by tight tannins and a finish on blond tobacco notes. This may be the finest Altagracia to date.

95 Points - James Suckling

Glorious aromas, like walking into a flower shop, from roses to lilacs. Lots of dark fruit too. Then goes to slate and dark mushroom. Full body, super refined tannins and refresh and ultra-clean finish. A thoroughly balanced and refined wine.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2013 Cabernet Sauvignon Altagracia is a beauty. Dense, opaque purple, a big sweet kiss of blueberry and black raspberry fruit intermixed with forest floor and violets is followed by a lush, medium to full-bodied wine with terrific concentration, light tannin and an approachable style.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Charmingly supple and complex, with layers of earth- and mineral-laced currant and wild berry flavors.

title: Domaine de Beaurenard Chateauneuf du Pape Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
In 1344, it was reported to the Pope living in Avignon that "the principal vineyards are Bois Renard, Blacquieres, Bois de Senechaux, Cabrieres, Carbonnieres, Colombis, and Mont Redon." The Coulon family has farmed that area named Bois Renard since they purchased it in 1695; seven generations of dedication, meticulous care, and excellence. Adding vineyards over the past 300 years, Domaine de Beaurenard is now 74 acres of Chateauneuf du Pape in several parcels, and over 60 acres of Cotes du Rhone located primarily in Rasteau.

This wine symbolizes Domaine de Beaurenard's love for white Chateauneuf-du-Pape. Delicate floral notes, a fresh texture and crisp, juicy fruit with a saline finish.

title: Road 13 Seventy Four K 2022
bodyHtml: The Seventy-Four K has notes of cassis, and mint woven through a matrix of soft, silky tannins in a medium frame. The overall impression is of a seductive wine that is carefully crafted to drink well now and for the next few years.

title: Long Shadows Merlot Pedestal 2020
bodyHtml:
Long Shadows Pedestal Merlot 2020 hails from the Columbia Valley in Washington State, a region renowned for its ability to produce world-class Bordeaux varietals. The winery is part of the Long Shadows Vintners collection, a visionary project founded by Allen Shoup that brings together celebrated winemakers from around the globe to craft exceptional wines from Washington’s best vineyards. Pedestal is created by famed Pomerol winemaker Michel Rolland, whose blending expertise and attention to detail have made it one of the most sought-after Merlots from the Pacific Northwest.

Wine Description
This wine displays a deep, dark ruby hue. The nose opens with expressive aromas of black cherry, huckleberry, violet, and dark chocolate, intertwined with hints of oak spice and Turkish coffee. On the palate, it is lush and full-bodied, offering concentrated flavours of ripe plum, blackberry compote, mocha, and graphite, accented by subtle notes of grilled herbs and camphor. The tannins are fine-grained yet firm, providing structure that frames the wine’s plush fruit core, while a streak of fresh acidity ensures balance and elegance. The finish is long and satisfying, leaving lingering impressions of cocoa, wild berries, and spice.

Accolades
Jeb Dunnuck – 94 points.
Vinous – 93 points.
James Suckling – 92 points.

Food Pairing
An ideal match for braised beef short ribs, roasted lamb, or mushroom risotto. The wine’s depth and richness are elevated by the savoury elements of these dishes, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Tawse Cabernet Sauvignon Icewine 2019 - 200 ml
bodyHtml: Candied apple and red bell pepper jelly come to mind when nosing this gorgeous red ice wine. This delectable nectar is perfectly balanced between fruit sweetness and acidity, think freshly made strawberry jam and tangy raspberry with that hint of pepper so characteristic of the varietal. It will charm any ice wine skeptic. Pair with your best dark chocolate or with a nice sharp cheddar cheese.

title: Volpe Pasini Ribolla Gialla 2023
bodyHtml:
Volpe Pasini is one of Friuli Venezia Giulia's most significant traditional wineries, with records of a Volpe estate dating back to 1596. The estate, which includes the magnificent 'Villa Rosa' building, is currently owned by Emilio Rotolo. Volpe Pasini’s philosophy is to maintain the varietal typicity of its indigenous grapes while adding sophistication through modern winemaking. The 'Ribolla Gialla' grape is a point of pride for the company and has been grown in the estate's 'Mura’s Garden' vineyard since the 1800s.

Wine Description

Made from 100% 'Ribolla Gialla', an indigenous white grape with naturally high acidity, this wine is typically straw yellow with pale green reflections. The aromatic profile is noted for great scents of fruit and delicate floral notes. Tasting notes specifically mention 'sliced lemons', 'green melon', and hints of 'salt and stone' on the palate, which is medium to full bodied.

Food Pairing

It is excellent as an aperitif and is recommended with dishes featuring white fish, shellfish, and fried seafood.

title: Cantina Tramin Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml: This Pinot Grigio is full-bodied, with a rich extract and is pale yellow in colour. Its flavour is delicate and pleasantly soft with lasting notes of nuts and honey. This wine pairs well with dishes based on mushrooms, fish and seafood. Also recommended as an aperitif.

title: Drusian Prosecco Valdobbiadene Brut (NV)
bodyHtml:
Pale straw yellow with golden hues. Green apple and floral notes combine with a cream texture on the palate.

The Drusian estate lies in the “Route of Prosecco and wines from the hills of Conegliano and Valdobbiadene” on hills long established for their wine-making tradition, and which now are known for the production of Prosecco. The Drusian family has been producing Prosecco wine for three generations. It all started with Grandfather Giuseppino in the middle of the Nineteenth Century.

title: Domaine Ramonet Chassagne Montrachet Rouge 2020
bodyHtml:
This magnificent Domaine de la Cote de Beaune extends over 13 ha in the town of Chassagne-Montrachet. A true temple of chardonnay, the terroirs of Chassagne-Montrachet give birth, with its neighbor Puligny-Montrachet, to the greatest white wines in the world! On these magnificent white wine terroirs of the south of the Cote de Beaune, some plots give birth to very high quality red wines, such as this Chassagne-Montrachet Rouge of the Domaine Bachelet-Ramonet.

A fruity wine, ample, nicely woody, presenting a beautiful final structure, ensuring a nice potential for aging.

title: Quails' Gate Red Blend 'Queue' 2022
bodyHtml:
Quails' Gate Red Blend 'Queue' originates from Canada, specifically from the Okanagan Valley region and the West Kelowna subregion in British Columbia. The Stewart family has farmed this land since 1908, with Richard Stewart Sr. establishing a leading nursery before his son, Dick, planted the first grapevines in 1961. Formally founded in 1989 by Ben and Ruth Stewart, the winery is now a third-generation family business renowned for its mature vinifera plantings and commitment to sustainable viticulture. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes quality over quantity, focusing on handcrafted wines that express their unique sense of origin.

Wine Description

This premium red blend is characterized as a smooth, rich, and robust wine with a full body. The sensory profile features an open and expansive bouquet of blueberry, black cherry, plum, cocoa, and violet. On the palate, it delivers rich waves of dark fruit, black pepper, and 'inescapably supple' tannins. The long finish is described as building gradually with equal measures of strength and elegance.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Syrah.

  • Stylistic Notes: The name 'Queue' is derived from the Latin word cõda, referring to a musical arrangement that punctuates the end of a symphony; the wine is crafted to capture the essence of the finest blocks on the West Kelowna estate.

  • ABV: 14.5%.

  • Organic Status: While not certified organic, the estate has been certified by Sustainable Winegrowing BC since 2022 and practices reduced-impact farming.

title: Bruichladdich Black Art Edition 11.1
bodyHtml:
Crafted with an enigmatic blend of aged spirits, its contents remain a closely guarded secret, known only to the master distiller. Each sip reveals layers of dried fruits, honeyed caramel, rich oak, and gentle spice, harmoniously intertwined. With its deep amber hue, this single malt whisky is a sensory journey, taking you through waves of evolving flavors, reminiscent of the ever-changing Islay coast. 

Bottled at a natural cask strength, it is non-chill filtered and free from artificial coloring, preserving the spirit’s authentic character. The limited-edition release, presented in an elegant, collectible bottle, makes it a coveted addition to any whisky connoisseur’s collection.

title: Peerless Straight Rye Single Barrel
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Kentucky Peerless’s identity as an artisan distillery is centered around its uncompromising quality and innovative nature. There is possibly no better exemplification of this than our Single Barrel program. Their team promotes only barrels of supreme quality and uniqueness for Single Barrel consideration. Rare notes and characteristics that make each barrel stand apart from the standard profile are celebrated and show off the range of Peerless spirits.

Every Drop is honestly crafted. They craft using strictly sweet mash, starting with fresh water and grain in each batch.

Their whiskey is never chill-filtered, leaving all the craft flavors you love intact. Peerless Whiskey is bottled at barrel proof.

title: Peerless Small Batch Straight Rye
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
A full-bodied taste that cannot be imitated.

Peerless Straight Rye Whiskey is well-balanced, bolstered by sweet tones of maple, brown sugar, and light citrus sweetness. Finish with a hint of oak & no burn on the throat. Due to the carefully unique distilling process, Peerless offers a smooth taste that stands out from other ryes. A palatable sipping rye to be savored with friends and family.

Every Drop is honestly crafted. They craft using strictly sweet mash, starting with fresh water and grain in each batch.

Their whiskey is never chill-filtered, leaving all the craft flavors you love intact. Peerless Whiskey is bottled at barrel proof.

title: Puncher's Chance 'The Left Cross'
bodyHtml:
Punchers Chance Kentucky Straight Bourbon is inspired by two great American traditions: whiskey and fighting for what we believe in. With a challenger mindset, Puncher’s Chance honours those who know how far they’ve come and what it took to get there. Those who started early—stayed late. Day after day. Year after year. Those who follow their instincts instead of the crowd, roll with the punches and stand up for what they believe in.

Aged for 14 years in wood rickhouses, THE LEFT CROSS was finished in freshly dumped 12-year-old Jamaican rum casks for two to six months – an extremely rare finish for a bourbon at this maturity. The result is a balanced and nuanced spirit where the natural bourbon characteristics and the rum finishing co-exist beautifully. The name The LEFT CROSS is a reference to Jamaican heavyweight fighter Donovan “Razor” Ruddock, a southpaw who, with a devastating left cross punch, battled the likes of Mike Tyson and Lennox Lewis. The left cross finishing blow became Ruddock’s much-admired calling card.

Aged in new American Oak barrels, the whiskey picks up the flavors of a long-matured bourbon, including vanilla, dark fruit, and warm oak. The rum finishing enhances the sipping experience by introducing Jamaican rum’s famous and distinct “funk” – adding rich flavors of brown sugar, ripe bananas, and sweet baking spice reminiscent of Bananas Foster. The finish is long and soft with the slightest hints of rum lingering for a near eternity.

title: Chateau Grand Bouchon 2016
bodyHtml:
Born from an association between Hubert de Bouard (Angelus, 1er grand cru classe de St-Emilion) and the Yvon Mau negoce business, here is a classic left-bank blend dominated by Merlot. Typical (in a good way), it reveals notes of cassis, cherry, raspberry and undergrowth, joined by a slight woody note, courtesy of the oak involved.

91 Points - James Suckling

title: Castello di Ama Chianti Classico 2021
bodyHtml:
Castello di Ama, established in 1976, is a renowned winery located in the heart of Tuscany's Chianti Classico region. The estate spans approximately 250 hectares, with 90 hectares dedicated to vineyards, and is celebrated for its commitment to producing high-quality wines that reflect the unique terroir of the area.

The 2021 Castello di Ama Chianti Classico is crafted predominantly from Sangiovese grapes, showcasing a bright ruby red color. On the nose, it offers enticing aromas of violet, redcurrant, cherries, and strawberries. The palate is fragrant and harmonious, with well-balanced fruity notes, polished tannins, and fresh acidity, leading to a satisfying finish.

Optimal Drinking Window: This wine is approachable upon release and can be enjoyed over the next 5 to 7 years, allowing its flavors to develop further with short-term cellaring.

Food Pairing Suggestions: This Chianti Classico pairs beautifully with traditional Tuscan dishes such as osso buco, pasta Bolognese, and ribollita.

title: Ole Smoky Salty Caramel Whiskey
bodyHtml: Might be the best thing to happen to whiskey since, well, whiskey. Savor every sip of this blend of rich, sweet 60 proof whiskey that tastes like liquid caramel with a hint of salt at the end of it. Whiskey never tasted so decadent.

title: Quinta da Taboadella Dao Jaen 2021
bodyHtml:
Quinta da Taboadella Dao Jaen originates from the Dão region in central Portugal. The estate, owned by the Amorim family since 2018, is steeped in over 15 centuries of history, with archaeological remains dating back to a first-century Roman villa. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a symbiosis between ancestral Roman heritage and contemporary sustainability, utilizing gravity-flow technology and natural materials like cork and wood to produce wines with great freshness and complexity.

Wine Description

This single-varietal red presents a deep, brilliant ruby colour and an expressive nose of fresh red fruits like cherry and plum, complemented by dark fruit and a distinctive note of allspice. On the palate, the wine is succulent and well-structured, featuring soft, fine tannins that wrap around a tense yet delicate body. It offers a vibrant sensory profile of bluish fruits and white spices with an elegant, lively acidity that leads into a long, flavourful finish.

Food Pairing

The wine's spicy profile and elegant structure make it a versatile companion for grilled red meats, roast beef, or game dishes. It also pairs exceptionally well with flavourful Mediterranean cuisine, hearty bean stews, and aged cheeses from the Serra da Estrela region.

title: Adictivo Anejo Black Edition
bodyHtml: A high-quality tequila made from 100% pure blue agave. The dark amber color with reddish hues and limited edition black bottle make it a visually striking product. The toasted flavor and sweet fruit aromas also sound delicious, and the fact that it's produced in El Arenal Jalisco, a region known for its agave landscape and traditional distilleries, adds to its appeal.

title: Crystal Head Vodka - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Crystal Head uses the highest quality grain and pristine water from Newfoundland, Canada to craft an additive-free and gluten-free vodka. Crystal Head is quadruple distilled and filtered seven times. Three of the filtration pass through layers of Herkimer diamonds as final distinctive touch. The detailed integrity of the skull-shaped bottle was proudly designed with a pure spirit in mind.

A clean, clear and colourless spirit. On the nose – neutral grain aromas with a delicate touch of citrus. Silky smooth with a hint of sweetness and vanilla. A sweet, creamy finish.

title: Scarabus Batch Strength
bodyHtml:
This right here is a higher-strength edition of Hunter Laing's Scarabus single malt, which is an Islay single malt from an undisclosed distillery. To make it, casks are specially selected to be bottled at the bumped-up strength.

While the standard expression is bottled at 46% ABV, this one weighs in at a burly 57% ABV, which has helped to bolster the robust, smoky notes at its core.

title: Littlemill 25 Year Old 'Private Cellar Edition'
bodyHtml:
When Littlemill closed in 1994, the dismantling of this historic cornerstone of Scottish distilling ensured there was no coming back. The building was stripped of assets and subsequently destroyed by fire, making this Lowland operation on the banks of the river Clyde one of the quietest silent distilleries there are. Stock remains however and, by the rules of rarity and excellence in distilling, its value rises every year. The operation is now owned by the Loch Lomond Group, which also owns Glen Scotia and Loch Lomond distillery. A small series of expressions continue to emerge annually from Littlemill stock, in tiny batches of a few hundred bottles. 

The prices match Littlemill’s exclusivity while the whisky in each bottle more than equals the high standards it has set itself. Each bottle represents fragments of the past and future of Scottish distilling. Each is a slice of history and owning one is a guarantee of value. But they also set a benchmark for future standards in Scottish distilling – they simply cannot be replaced. 

Littlemill 25, bottled at 50.4%, is part of the brand’s Private Cellar Edition. Released in 2015, it represents the final years of the working distillery, having been laid down in the very late 1980s or early 1990, some four years before the distillery

title: Teeda Japanese Craft Rum 21 Year Old
bodyHtml:
An exceptional terroir for an outstanding rum! The Helios distillery has launched a 21-year-old aged version of its Teeda craft rum.

With a tropical climate and an average temperature of 22.5°C make this archipelago the only place in Japan where sugar cane cultivation is possible. We find all the power and subtlety of this iodized rum, which has revealed itself in the depths of this unique terroir and full of richness.

This rum is only aged in oak barrels and made from sugar cane molasses. The fermentation of molasses is extremely long, 30 days, to be then distilled in copper pot still and aged in oak barrels.

title: Nc'nean Organic Single Malt
bodyHtml: An organic single malt whisky from Nc'nean, made with Scottish barley and matured in a combination of specially-selected red wine and American whiskey casks. The palate offers notes of lemon curd, poached peaches, juicy apricots and spicy white pepper.

title: Castello Di Ama Montebuoni Chianti Classico Riserva 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Deep ruby red with purple nuances. Fruit-forward. aromas of blackberry, blueberry, raspberry and currant. A well balanced, refined and harmonic palate with long-lasting aromatic profile. A pure expression of elegance.

Blend: 95% Sangiovese, 5% Merlot

95 Points - James Suckling

Very subtle aromas of dark berries, licorice and violets. Really floral and bright. Medium-bodied with very fine tannins that integrate beautifully into the wine. Such a lovely and sophisticated mouth-feel to this. Drinkable already, but better in two or three years.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

This is a new wine with the inaugural 2018 vintage introduced last year. The Castello di Ama 2019 Chianti Classico Riserva Montebuoni draws its fruit from a vineyard site that sits parallel to Vigneto Bellavista about one kilometer over and enjoys similar exposures. The estate felt that it needed to fill a gap in the portfolio between the entry-level wines and the top-shelf Gran Selezioni. That's where the Riserva Montebuoni comes in. This 15-hectare site was purchased by Marco Pallanti in 1997, and a lot of work went into moving earth and preparing the poor, clay-based terrain for planting. These results show beautifully concentrated fruit over a medium to full-bodied approach with lingering smoke, blackberry and sweet tobacco.

92 Points - Decanter

The second vintage of this single-vineyard Riserva, Montebuoni is sourced from vines at least 20 years old. It provides a logical progression from Ama’s annata, made from younger vines. As with the annata, ageing is in second-use French oak barriques. A sweet herbal mix of fennel and tarragon mingles with strawberry and rhubarb. Hints of vanilla permeate throughout. Smooth and polished, it glides across the palate. Lightly powdered tannins are quite delicate and well-integrated. Mouthwatering and cheerful, with a cranberry tang.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Rich, boasting cherry, plum, earth, leather and sanguine notes. Firm, yet the fruit holds its own through the lively, persistent finish. Fine balance and energy overall. Sangiovese and Merlot.

title: Tromba Cedano Tequila
bodyHtml:
Cedano is the culmination of 50 years experience and representative of the journey of Marco Cedano’s lifelong passion to craft the worlds finest tequila’s. Marco began his journey in Tequila with one guiding principle: to honor the agave and the land from which it comes. From his revolutionary stand to make only 100% blue agave tequila, to the creation of Tequila Tromba, to the development of his proprietary still and distillation process, he has always stayed true to this guiding principle.

Marco, along with Rodrigo, have created a fitting testament to his 50 years and the legacy of the Cedano Family. Using an innovative Cedano Process, they have crafted a Reposado Tequila of unmatched flavor, complexity and refinement. All of this is captured in a hand crafted and hand labeled artisan bottle worthy of this exquisite spirit.

Dense and rich on the palate with notes of soft warm wood, dried fruit, vanilla, toasted cashew, almond and peanut. Aromas of vanilla and aged wood with a top note of caramelized agave. Hints of cherry, soft florals and a fresh citrus overtone. Strong, gold finish.

title: Hunter Laing's Cragganmore 1995 - 26 Year Old 'Old & Rare'
bodyHtml:
Joining Hunter Laing's Old & Rare Platinum collection comes this cracking single malt from Cragganmore. Distilled in October 1995, the whisky spent the next 26 years resting in a single sherry butt, which yielded a total of 300 cask strength bottles when it was opened in 2022.

Nose: Toasted almonds and cherry Madeira cake, leathery oak, and soft, buttery fruit.

Palate: Woody spice builds alongside biscuity malt and chocolate raisins. Roasted nuts and drying spice gather beneath.

Finish: Sweet and spicy with fiery cinnamon, poached pears, prickles of pepper, and boozy sultanas.

title: Khortytsa Platinum Vodka - 375 ml
bodyHtml: This vodka owes its unique taste to artesian water and high-quality grain alcohol Finest Wheat of the new generation. Khortytsa was the first to make vodka based on Finest Wheat alcohol. An oatmeal infusion adds unparalleled smoothness to vodka

title: Koblevo Saperavi Red Wine
bodyHtml: Extremely balanced varietal wine made from grapes of old Georgian sort of Saperavi which had been cultivated has on Ukrainian land for decades. Its unique ruby color, refined flavor with tones of morocco and blackberry and velvety flavor which fascinates with its elegance and nobility.

title: Joseph Drouhin Cote de Beaune Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: A truly delicious and harmonious wine. Pale gold color, very bright. The aromas bring to mind honey, almond and lemongrass (citronella). As the wine matures, intense flavors of grilled hazelnut and almonds are in evidence.

title: San Matias Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
San Matias Blanco Tequila is the essence of Casa San Matias' great reserve of agaves from the highlands of Jalisco, the pure spring water and the combination of steel and copper from the stills result in an extraordinary tequila.

The attention to detail in the process gives it a spirit of its own, which is why San Matias Blanco is the Soul of Tequila.

title: Albert Brenot Nuits Saint Georges 2018
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1849 by Albert Brenot in Savigny-lès-Beaune, Doudet-Naudin is one of the oldest Burgundy wine Maisons. In 1933 it was acquired by the Doudet family, who have developed and expanded the Maison while preserving its fundamental values: respect for traditions and excellence. Christophe Rochet, the current head of Doudet-Naudin, is committed to maintaining the values of this well-respected Maison while restructuring it.

The color is deep, a bright ruby. The nose is of great finesse. We find notes of red fruits and spices. The palate is fresh and in his youth sits on a beautiful fruit (cherry, blackcurrant and kirsch) with a lovely elegance. This wine, very feminine, is highlighted by the finesse and elegance of the tannins that advertise great potential to keep.

title: Albert Brenot Gevrey Chambertin 2016
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1849 by Albert Brenot in Savigny-lès-Beaune, Doudet-Naudin is one of the oldest Burgundy wine Maisons. In 1933 it was acquired by the Doudet family, who have developed and expanded the Maison while preserving its fundamental values: respect for traditions and excellence. Christophe Rochet, the current head of Doudet-Naudin, is committed to maintaining the values of this well-respected Maison while restructuring it.

Complex, rich, promising wine has a great fruity taste with an expressive structure, decorated with velvety tannins. The finish is long and vigorous.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Benromach Single Malt 1982 Burgundy Finish 'Private Collection'
bodyHtml:
Gordon & MacPhail present this spectacular Benromach bottling, matured for almost four decades in a single first-fill Burgundy cask hand-picked by members of the Urquhart family. Bottled at an impressive cask strength of 59.9% abv, and presented in show-stopping wooden box. Only 207 bottles exist of this fine Speyside dram.

On the nose, we find notes of sweet orchard fruits and cocoa, leading to a palate of sumptuous raspberries, black pepper and lemon peel. The finish is a full one, which lingers with delectably fruity notes.

title: Appleton Estate Signature Rum - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Harvest gold/honey colour with remarkable clarity and brilliance. Subtle scents of brown sugar, light spice, dried fruits and orange peel. Rich flavors of toasted honey wheat bread and refined sugar. Finishes as serenely as it started.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Milton 1949 72 Year Old 'Private Collection'
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Gordon & MacPhail Milton 1949 72 Year Old 'Private Collection' is an exceptionally rare Single Malt Scotch Whisky from the country of Scotland, specifically the Speyside region. This expression was distilled at the Milton Distillery, which is known today as Strathisla, the oldest working distillery in Speyside. The distillery was acquired by Chivas Brothers in 1950 and renamed Strathisla in 1951. This bottling by independent bottler Gordon & MacPhail is the oldest and last-ever single malt from the company to carry the Milton Distillery name, paying homage to the distillery's original identity.

Spirit Description

Distilled in 1949, this whisky spent an astounding 72 years maturing in a single first-fill sherry puncheon, cask number 383, before being bottled in 2022. The whisky is described as having a rich, fruity, and full-bodied character. The nose is complex, featuring baked forest fruits, rich sherry influences, sweet vanilla pod, and Seville orange. Stewed fruit aromas give way to vibrant festive spice and soft lemon zest. The palate is inviting and vibrant, with flavours of butterscotch, bright citrus, nutmeg, apple pie, and caramel. Notes of baked apple, poached pear, and honeycomb also come to the fore. The long finish is characterised by lingering apple, dark toffee, and a subtle hint of smoke. It was bottled at its natural cask strength of 48.6% ABV.

Accolades

This is an exceedingly rare and highly celebrated release, with only 180 bottles available worldwide.

  • The whisky was described as 'gloriously drinkable' by renowned whisky writer Gavin D. Smith.

  • It received an 'Outstanding!' rating of 96 Points from WhiskyCast.

  • Whisky Advocate described its flavour journey as weighted, silky, and complex.

  • This is considered the oldest single malt ever released to carry the Milton Distillery name.

title: Kentucky Owl Mardi Gras XO Cask Limited Edition 11 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The Kentucky Owl Mardi Gras XO Cask Limited Edition is an extremely small release created thanks to Stoli Group's diverse portfolio. Beginning with a Kentucky Owl 11-year-old Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey, the product was then finished for over one year in Bayou Rum XO Casks. Created in celebration of the spirit of Mardi Gras and the pride of Louisiana, the rare Bayou XO Casks create a unique whiskey. The Mardi Gras edition is bottled at 102.8 proof (51.4% ABV).

On the nose, Kentucky Owl Mardi Gras XO Cask Limited Edition greets drinkers with robust toasted rye bread notes, smothered in farm fresh sweet butter, with hints of cinnamon, allspice and nutmeg. The mouthfeel begins with a robust, flavorful Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey, followed by a flurry of sweet butter whipped with allspice. The finish is smooth, with the sweet softness of butter and allspice giving way to a long and warming nutmeg coda.

title: Jura 14 Year Old 'American Rye Cask'
bodyHtml:
Jura 14 Year Old American Rye Cask is a celebration of Jura’s bright community spirit; a close-knit group of around 212 individuals, whether you are coming from near or far, you can always rely on a warm welcome from this tiny island community. Every time you pour a glass, you’re raising a dram with the islanders who have a hand in making it and with every rye-spiced sip you will taste Jura’s bright and characterful spirit. A gift from our tiny island community to you.

Matured in American white oak ex bourbon and hand selected American Rye barrels, the casks deliver depth and complexity to our 14-year-old single malt with layered spice, aromatic, herbal and floral qualities.

title: Glen Grant 1952 - 70 Year Old 'Queen's Platinum Jubilee'
bodyHtml: An impressive 1952 Glen Grant single malt from Gordon & MacPhail's Private Collection that was matured in a single first-fill sherry butt for 70 years, before being bottled to honour the Platinum Jubilee of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II on 6 February 2022, the date of the Queen's accession. Aromas of beeswax and ripe figs mingle with toffee, orange zest, raisins and aged leather on the nose, complemented by notes of blackberry compote, clementine, milk chocolate, black pepper and a hint of wood smoke throughout the palate and lingering in the finish.

title: Scarabus 10 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Scarabus, meaning ‘rocky place' in Old Norse, is named after a mystical area of Islay. This is a 10 year old version of Hunter Laing's original Scarabus single malt Scotch whisky. Produced by an undisclosed distillery on the legendary isle of Islay, this expression is aged in a combo of refill, ex-bourbon and virgin oak casks, and bottled up after a decade of maturation.

Soft phenolic peat smoke, slightly bitter with hints of Lapsang Souchong, tar, sea spray and toasted brioche developing along the way on the nose. Behind it lemon and honey sweetness. Golden syrup, vanilla, and a slow rumble of peaty smoke and crushed peppercorns. In the mouth a tad rounder and more voluminous than its little brother. Sweet peat, umami and some floral freshness. Medium length.

title: Johanneshof Reinisch Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml: The Reinisch Family estate, like many others in Austria, makes use of Pinot noir quite convincingly. Remarkable aromatic precision with notes of cherry, cranberry, pot-pourri and pink pepper on a long, soft and persistant mouth.

title: Gray Whale Gin
bodyHtml:
A London Dry style gin that is seven times distilled and uses botanicals sourced from sustainable farms or wild foraged.

Aromas of citrus fruit, juniper and a hint of coastal fir trees are followed by flavours of fresh mint and sea kelp. The flavours are long-lasting with a creamy almond finish.

Proudly supporting Oceana.

title: Krol Potato Vodka
bodyHtml:
KROL means "King" in Polish, which is quite relevant to the status of vodka in the world of spirits. KROL is crafted from original recipes dating back to the 1790s when the Polish began using potatoes as the main component in vodka production. KROL is crafted thoroughly in full compliance with these original formulas to maintain an honorable place among all vodka.

What makes KROL stand out among the great variety of potato vodka is its soft and memorable taste. Once sensed, this flavor is difficult to confuse with anything else. Being neutral and mild, it is perfect for any occasion. Smooth if tasted neat and subtle as a part of cocktails. Connoisseurs claim this delicious gluten free vodka to be tender and well-balanced.

title: Kolonist Odessa Black 2023
bodyHtml:
This intense dark rubywine was made from the Ukrainian grape variety – Odeskyi Chornyi.

Rich, deep and juicy, this is a local brand wine with a strong Ukrainian character. On the nose there are smoky notes of blackberries and mulberry. The taste has notes of dried fruit, while the soft tannins offer a silky lasting finish.

title: Fen Chiew Guo Chang 50 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Fen Chiew is a revered Chinese baijiu that epitomizes traditional craftsmanship. Originating from Shanxi, it presents a distinctive aroma, delicate fruitiness, and a harmonious interplay of flavors. This baijiu holds a special place in Chinese culture and is enjoyed neat, as a homage to its heritage, or as a key component in cultural celebrations and toasts. Fen Chiew stands as a testament to the rich legacy of Chinese distillation and is a symbol of conviviality.

Aromas of cereal, corn and wheat along with notes of plum, nectarine and almonds. Well balanced on the palate with a subtle and elegant finish. Serve neat as an aperitif or try in cocktails.

title: Grant's Family Reserve - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Complex, clean and fruity. Grant’s Family Reserve is one of the world’s best loved Scotch whiskies and enjoyed in over 180 countries. Grant’s Master Blender skillfully blends around 25 of the finest single malt and grain Scotch whiskies to make Grant’s Family Reserve. The basis for the blend is the widely acclaimed Girvan grain whisky.

title: Grand Marnier Revelation
bodyHtml:
Grand Marnier Revelation is the prestige expression of Grand Marnier with the most Cognac-forward taste, thanks to an extremely high Cognac content bringing exceptional depth and length to the palate. Designed for true connoisseurs, this expression uses only the finest Cognacs at the forefront. Grand Marnier has been world-famous since its early days in 1880 for audaciously marrying Cognac and Bigaradia orange essence.

With Grande Cuvee Revelation, Grand Marnier elevates this assemblage by using XXO Cognac and only a dash of Bigaradia essence. The rare Cognac is perfected with just a touch of this high-quality fragranced ingredient, high sought-for in fine fragrances for its unique scent.

title: Paladin Syrah 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Syrah is an international grape variety famous for its spicy notes that Paladin interprets with great elegance. The grapes are harvested at optimal ripeness, it is a generous vine; of great quality and typicality.

The bouquet is enveloping with intense notes of red fruit, such as blueberry, raspberry and amarena. Pleasantly fruity and fresh, with a hint of spice and black pepper.  In the mouth, cherries in alcohol and coffee stand out.

title: Bacardi Gold Rum - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Hand blended, charcoal filtered and aged for two years in American white oak barrels. This rum brings depth and character to classic rum cocktails while maintaining balance. Expect vanilla, butterscotch and lemon zest aromas; light fruit and toffee flavours and a lightly spicy warm finish.

title: Famille Perrin Rascal Rouge 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'approachable' red wine originates from France, within the sunny, wind-swept growing regions of the Southern Rhône Valley. Produced by Famille Perrin; the world-renowned winemaking family behind the legendary Château de Beaucastel in Châteauneuf-du-Pape, 'Rascal' (often produced under the Les Christins or Nature regional range depending on market allocation) is a playful, high-value cuvée designed to showcase pure Southern Rhône character. Sourced from sustainably farmed vineyard parcels rooted in gravelly alluvial soils, clay, and limestone, the vines thrive under the classic Mediterranean climate. Intense daytime sunshine is tempered by cool nighttime air and the drying influence of the Mistral wind, allowing traditional Rhône grapes to accumulate generous fruit depth while preserving a bright, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Famille Perrin Rascal Rouge presents a deep, luminous garnet-ruby color in the glass with bright crimson and magenta highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and fruit-forward, delivering an energetic, juicy, and expressive portrait of Southern Rhône terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe crushed blackberries, wild red cherries, and black plums, seamlessly layered with subtle underlays of dried garrigue herbs (thyme, rosemary), sweet baking spices, black pepper, and a clean line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, supple, and smooth, showcasing a succulent core of dark berry compote, blood orange zest, and cocoa powder. It is characterized by its balanced energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that maintains freshness across the mid-palate. The mouthfeel is broad, silky, and weightless, framed by soft, rounded tannins that glide into a long, dry, and pleasingly spicy finish accented by notes of cherry skin, black pepper, and Mediterranean herbs.

title: Valley Commons Rose 2021
bodyHtml: This luscious iridescent Rose is made with 100% Merlot grapes form the South Okanagan. Vibrant and bright, it shows hints of red berries, watermelon, and creamy strawberry aromas.

title: Edinburgh Classic Dry Gin
bodyHtml:
This Classic gin is an unmistakeable London Dry, born in the ancient and magical city of Edinburgh. Much like its birthplace, what lies within this bottle is far from ordinary. 

The finest grain spirit is brought together with an original balance of 14 botanicals. Filled with wonder, from distillation to first sip, this award-winning gin is a labor of love and the heart of their range.

Enjoy how you like. We drink it with tonic, a twist of orange, lots of ice – and lots of friends.

title: Bread & Butter Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve 2020
bodyHtml:
The Bread & Butter Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve hails from the United States, specifically the renowned Napa Valley region of California. Founded in 1999 as Winery Exchange (now WX Brands), the winery is currently owned by the Terold company of the Bemberg Family Group and operates a boutique tasting room on the historic Silverado Trail. The winemaking philosophy centers on 'uncomplicated' enjoyment, focusing on bold, fruit forward expressions that highlight the depth and richness of Napa Valley's premium fruit.

Wine Description

This reserve Cabernet Sauvignon presents a dark ruby colour in the glass. The sensory profile is intense and expressive, opening with bold aromas of mocha, blackberries, toasted oak, and savory baking spices. On the palate, the wine is lush and full bodied, delivering concentrated layers of black cherry, plum, and sweet dried tobacco supported by firm, grippy tannins. The finish is long and elegant with subtle oak undertones.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and high tannins of this Cabernet Sauvignon make it an ideal companion for rich, flavorful dishes such as grilled ribeye steak, mushroom risotto, or aged cheddar or blue cheese.

title: Les Pensees de Lafleur 2020
bodyHtml:
93+ Points - Vinous

The 2020 Les Pensees (they have dropped the “de Lafleur”) is a blend of 29% Merlot and 71% Cabernet Franc picked September 11–19.
