This is backward at first and needs some coaxing from the glass, almost reluctantly offering blackberry, crushed stone, violet and incense. The palate is silky-smooth on the entry, deep and pixelated, armed with a killer line of acidity and a very cool and sophisticated, beguiling finish. Stunning.

93+ Points - James Suckling

A lovely round and juicy wine, with blackberry and milk chocolate and velvety tannins. Full and very attractive. Texture is everything here. The second wine of Lafleur. 65% Merlot and 35% Cabernet Franc.

93 Points - Decanter

This has the physicality of tannins right up front, a clear signature of the vintage, but nothing is heavy or bitter, rather they exert a pressure that gives form and shape to the ripe berry fruits, balanced by mocha, fennel and smoked cocoa bean. Not as joyous as in some vintages of Pensées, but extremely hard to argue with its quality, and the deft, bright finish.

title: Famille Perrin Rascal Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the southern Rhone Valley, specifically within the Ventoux region, Famille Perrin Rascal Blanc represents a vibrant, easy-drinking expression of classic Rhone white blending. Owned and operated by the famed Perrin family of Chateau de Beaucastel, Famille Perrin is renowned for pioneering organic and sustainable viticulture across southern France. The winery's philosophy focuses on capturing the pure, aromatic expression of traditional Rhone grape varieties through cool-temperature stainless steel fermentations without oak influence, yielding fresh, food-friendly, and terroir-driven wines.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, pale straw colour with delicate green reflections in the glass. An inviting and fresh bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of white peach, green apple, and juicy pear, layered with subtle floral notes of jasmine, citrus blossom, and lemongrass. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, crisp, and well balanced, delivering lively flavours of white stone fruit, lemon zest, and crisp melon, all supported by a clean spine of refreshing natural acidity. Concluding with a crisp, mineral-tinged finish, it leaves a refreshing impression of orchard fruit and subtle herbal lift. Composed of a classic southern Rhone blend featuring Viognier, Grenache Blanc, Marsanne, and Roussanne, it combines expressive floral and stone fruit aromatics with effortless, bright everyday freshness.

title: Paulaner Oktoberfest - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Paulaner Oktoberfest (or Wiesn) flavor is a bright, golden, malt-forward lager with balanced sweetness and crispness, featuring notes of toasted bread, honey, light citrus, and caramel, finishing with a subtle hop spice and clean, smooth finish, making it rich yet surprisingly easy to drink for its 6% ABV. It's a harmonious blend of strong malt character and delicate floral hops, offering a taste of "October sunshine". 

Key Flavor Characteristics:

  • Malt: Dominant notes of honey, bready sweetness, caramel, and toasted grains (like white bread or toast).

  • Hops: A light, floral, and slightly spicy hop presence provides balance, with hints of citrus or apple/pear.

  • Sweetness: A pleasant sweetness, often described as off-dry, but not cloying, balanced by malt depth.

  • Finish: Clean, crisp, and smooth, with a soft, gentle bitterness that makes it very drinkable.

  • Aroma: Fragrant with cereal, honey, and light floral or citrus notes.

title: Kopke 40 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
In 1638, Kopke's path as a winegrower is entwined with the history of its location. The Douro was destined to become the chosen stage for this marriage between the will of man and nature took place. Quinta de São Luiz was acquired in 1922 and has since become the place where all Kopke’s DOC Douro wines are produced. The great connoisseurs of Douro wines have always recognised this property as one of the most important in the region, for the quality of its soil and vines and for its cultural traditions. 

Deep amber in colour, with a greenish rim. On the nose it is complex, with notes of dried fruits, like raisins, fig and walnut, wrapped in subtle hints of vanilla and honey. On the palate, it is dense, silky and concentrated, with impressive freshness. A powerful and particularly enduring finish.

95 Points - Wine Spectator 

Dark orange amber with a golden edge. Medium weight and voluptuous to roll around in the mouth. Excellent acidity. Figs, marzipan and walnuts with just a hint of heat on the very long finish. Otherwise, really tasty and sumptuous Tawny.

title: St. George Absinthe Verte - 200 ml
bodyHtml:
The first legal American absinthe released after the U.S. ban was lifted in 2007, St. George Absinthe Verte remains one of the most acclaimed and respected spirits in this category.

Made from a host of real botanical ingredients, this is a layered and evocative expression of this beguiling and highly spirituous herbal elixir.

title: Aberfeldy 21 Year Old
bodyHtml:
A deep, concentrated antique amber colour shimmers in the glass, with seductive notes of caramel, raisin, dried apricot, potpourri and honey roasted pecans.

On the palate it is smooth, with heat that mellows and flavours of roasted chestnuts, nutmeg, toffee and dried fruit lingering on a long and haunting finish.

title: Trapiche Malbec Medalla 2021
bodyHtml: A full-bodied, flavoured red wine offering intense aromas of red and black fruits. A smooth, velvety texture and round, velvety tannins. This exquisite red wine from Argentina's Trapiche winery boasts intense aromas of ripe red and black fruit. Its full-bodied texture is marked by velvety tannins, creating a smooth, velvety finish. Perfectly balanced, this bottle will be sure to delight.

title: Adictivo Reposado Cristalino Tequila
bodyHtml:
Adictivo Reposado Cristalino Tequila is made with 100% Pure Blue Agave, visually this tequila is crystal bright, with a soft and refined taste and aromas of wood and cooked agave.

Adictivo Tequila is produced in El Arenal Jalisco, the gateway to the blue region of tequila. The agave landscape and ancient distilleries have marked indelibly to this region in its passage through time, forging a distinct identity and a style rooted traditional and current life fully.

Tequila Adictivo is founded by Gildardo Partida, passionate tequila, grandson and son of tequileros, proud of their roots and the legacy his family has left him, which has been dedicated for over 100 years "The art of making tequila".

title: Koblevo Cabernet
bodyHtml:
Classic red wine made from Cabernet Sauvignon grapes. It has a mellow taste with a perfectly balanced sweet ripe tannins and spicy spicy notes. Its charming fragrance is enriched with multifaceted aroma of red berries.

The first vineyards near Tiligul regional landscape park in Koblevo were planted in 60-ies of the last century, occupied 1,100 hectares and are raw materials for the leading companies in the country.

title: Sheringham Chocolate Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Made in the spirit of romance, Jason and Alayne wanted a special, decadent dark chocolate sipper, perfect for extra sweet moments with the ones they love. Sheringham teamed up with Sirene Chocolate, artisan chocolate makers from Victoria, B.C., to produce a dark chocolate-lover’s dream: Sirene Chocolate Liqueur. 

Using the byproducts of their production process—the shells and husks of cacao beans that have been ethically grown and sourced—they extract the raw characteristics of the cacao. The final result is a beautifully layered experience, allowing you to taste notes of fruit, citrus, fudge, and leather, ever so lightly back-sweetened. A perfect liqueur to sip on its own, it’s equally enjoyable in a cocktail.

title: Nostalgija Quince Brandy
bodyHtml:
Redistilled quince brandy aged in oak barrels for at least three years. The raw material is 100% locally produced quince, without the addition of any enhancers, smells and flavours.

Chilled at basement temperature, it gets on very well with all dishes dominated by red meat, with starters, grilled meat and vegetables, and cooked meat. Chilled in the freezer, it is perfect with cakes and sweets, nuts, almonds, hazelnuts.

Rich scent, with a scent of wood, not intensive. The taste is characteristic for premium aged brandies. delightful and sophisticated.

title: Moma Bianco Rubicone
bodyHtml:
Moma Bianco Rubicone IGT is a white wine from the Rubicone region in Italy. It is made from a blend of white grape varieties, including Trebbiano and Chardonnay. 

This wine has a pale yellow color and a delicate aroma of citrus fruits and white flowers. On the palate, it is crisp and refreshing with flavors of lemon, pear, and a hint of tropical fruit. It has a medium body and a clean, dry finish.

Moma Bianco Rubicone IGT is a versatile wine, often enjoyed as an aperitif or paired with seafood, salads, and light pasta dishes. It is best served chilled and enjoyed young.

title: Tres Agaves Organic Anejo
bodyHtml:
‘Anejo’ in Spanish means ‘aged’ or ‘mature’.  Anejo to Tres Agaves means a Tequila made with slowly roasted, organic agaves grown in the Tequila Valley, and rested for 18 months in repurposed Kentucky Bourbon and Tennessee Whiskey barrels. 

As their Anejo ages in-barrel, it takes on the smoky sweet caramel and butterscotch flavors, floral tones, and hints of rosemary spice to mature into the Organic 100% de Agave Anejo Tequila the Ultimate Spirits Competition awarded 97-points.  Have you ever made a Manhattan Mexicano?  Or a Tequila Old Fashioned?  Their Anejo is just as delicious in a tequila drink as it is sipped neat or on the rocks.  So, find a bottle near you (or send it to your doorstep), gather your family or friends, and let our hard work be your escape to relaxation.

title: Tres Agaves Organic Reposado
bodyHtml:
When your Reposado is awarded a Wine Enthusiast ‘Top 100 Spirit of the Year’, you can be sure you’ve got a good thing going.  Maybe it has to do with the organic blue agaves grown in the Tequila Valley, imbued with the region’s terroir.  Or maybe it’s the combination of Tres Agaves' Tennessee Whiskey and Kentucky Bourbon barrels that age their Reposado for 9 months, imparting hints of citrus, spice, and baked tropical fruits. 

The end result is the same, a Reposado with a perfect balance of agave-forward notes and barrel flavors.  An Organic 100% de Agave Reposado Tequila that can be just as easily sipped neat or mixed in a tequila drink or margarita.  So, find a bottle near you (or send it to your doorstep), gather your family or friends, and let their hard work be your escape to relaxation.

title: Tres Agaves Organic Blanco
bodyHtml:
When it comes to Tres Agaves' Blanco, they’re rebels. Relaxed, but rebels nonetheless. You see, by law, a Blanco Tequila can be aged up to 60 days in order to mute the agave flavors. But they love the taste of agave, because when your agaves are organic, grown in the Tequila Valley, and slowly roasted to perfection, there’s nothing to hide. That’s why they bottle their Blanco just as soon as it’s distilled. 

The result? Vibrant and sweet agave aromas that include hints of citrus, mint, and pear typical of the Tequila Valley terroir.  But don’t just take their word for it.  The Ultimate Cocktail Challenge awarded their Blanco the ‘Chairman’s Trophy’. 

So, find a bottle near you (or send it to your doorstep), gather your family or friends, and let their hard work be your escape to relaxation. 

100% de Agave. Estate Grown. Unaged. Vibrant and sweet agave aromas dominate with supporting notes of citrus, pear, and hints of wild mint. A pleasing taste and silky texture make it ideal for sipping or mixing.

title: Stara Sokolova Plum Brandy Lux 7 Year
bodyHtml:
Stara Sokolova is based on a centuries old tradition of the Bogdanovic family from the village of Kostojevici near Bajina Bata. The name Stara Sokolova, meaning “Old Falcon’s”, is derived from the historical name of the watershed of the river Drina in Western Serbia.

In this Region of the Falcon, the tradition of cultivation of plums has always been of the utmost importance. Plums have always been eaten fresh, dried for winter, and used for making jams and other traditional preserves. Most of the harvest, however, was reserved for producing the natural distilled brandy known as rakija. Good rakija was not only a source of pride for the household, but also the basis of its economic wealth. Before the development of the modern economy and finance, rakija was the primary means of saving for the future.

Stara Sokolova has become a symbol of Serbia, and appears prominently on tables during festivals and celebrations. It is available alongside single malt Scotches and Congacs in fine hotels and restaurants throughout Belgrade and Serbia, and is now exported to countries across the world from Canada and the United States on one side, to Australia on the other.

title: Black Sage Vineyard Merlot 2021
bodyHtml:
On the nose there are notes of ripe plums, blackberries, vanilla, cloves, and some sweet smoke. The palate has similar flavours of rich ripe fruit and spices with pleasant smoky vanilla notes. The tannins are soft and the finish is long with the flavours lingering long after the last sip.

Pair with pot roast, meatloaf, venison steaks, other braised meats and firm cheeses.

title: Johnnie Walker Red Label - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Red Label is a powerful mix of up to 30 malts and grains. It's a combination of light whiskies from Scotland's East Coast and more peaty whiskies from the West, expertly balanced to create an extraordinary depth of flavour.

It crackles with spice and is bursting with vibrant, smoky flavours – followed by a mellow bed of vanilla, a fresh zestiness and the Johnnie Walker signature of a long, lingering, smoky finish.

title: Nicolas Maillart Montchenot Premier Cru 2018
bodyHtml: This cuvee comes only from the village of Villers Allerand, precisely from the hamlet of the village of Montchenot (my mother's village). Montchenot has the particularity of being the junction village between the small mountain and the large mountain, and shares the geology of the two regions (sand, clay and chalk).

title: Johnnie Walker Red Label - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Red Label is a powerful mix of up to 30 malts and grains. It's a combination of light whiskies from Scotland's East Coast and more peaty whiskies from the West, expertly balanced to create an extraordinary depth of flavour.

It crackles with spice and is bursting with vibrant, smoky flavours – followed by a mellow bed of vanilla, a fresh zestiness and the Johnnie Walker signature of a long, lingering, smoky finish.

title: Ron Abuelo Centuria
bodyHtml: A rare rum blend made in Panama, Ron Abuelo Centuria is aged in Jack Daniel’s whiskey barrels in the solera method. Some of the rums are as old as 30 years, and the flavour is astonishingly rich and punchy.

title: Mortlach 'The Katana's Edge' Single Malt Special Release 2023
bodyHtml:
A moonlit shine of steel flashes, in the sweet calmness of the night. Swiftly the katana, a sword crafted with complexity and precision, pierces the darkness, revealing bold mysteries of the midnight hour. Wielded with astonishing skill, it shines as a symbol of elegance and craftsmanship.

Mortlach is famed for its sweet yet savoury taste, defiantly rare among Speyside malts. Our Malt Master drew inspiration from the flavours of Japan, and finished part of this expression in ex-Kanosuke Japanese Whisky White Oak casks. To add balance to the sweetness, ex-pinot noir French Oak casks were used to finish the remaining part of the whisky.

A golden gleam introduces sweet, aromas of ripe melon and pear along with spiced flavours cutting the sweetness. The notes create an umami-rich taste that lingers in the long, enticing and spicy finish. The result is a sweet-savoury intensity as deep and complex as the mighty katana.

title: Roseisle 12 Year Old Special Release 2023
bodyHtml:
Introducing Roseisle Special Release, a single malt scotch whisky that embodies the essence of Scottish distilling traditions. Aged for 12 years and bottled at natural cask strength, this whisky is a testament to the skill and craftsmanship of its distillers.

Matured in a combination of first-fill ex-bourbon and refill casks, this whisky boasts a complex and well-balanced flavor profile. The first-fill ex-bourbon casks impart notes of vanilla and honey, while the refill casks bring out hints of spice and dried fruit.

Distilled, matured, and bottled in Scotland, this whisky is a true representation of the region’s distilling heritage.

Whether you’re a seasoned whisky connoisseur or new to the world of single malt scotch, Roseisle Special Release is a must-try. Its exceptional flavor profile, natural cask strength, and expert maturation make it a standout among whiskies, and it’s sure to become a beloved addition to your collection.

title: Bearface Wilderness Series #3
bodyHtml:
Bearface has gone to the edge of the Canadian wilderness, beyond the forests of their Bear Country home, to Mitlenatch Island, off the rugged coast of the Pacific Northwest. Bearface elementally ages the finest single-grain whisky in selected wine casks.

Then they proof with distilled water, collected from artisan salt makers on Canada’s wild Pacific coast.

The result is a bold, smooth whisky with deep minerality, elemental smokiness and a salty-sweet finish, that captures the essence of the Canadian Pacific.

title: Talisker Single Malt 'The Wild Explorador' Special Release 2023
bodyHtml:
Introducing Talisker Special Release - a truly exceptional Scotch whisky. This limited edition release has been crafted using only the finest ingredients, distilled, matured, and bottled entirely in Scotland.

Talisker Special Release has been finished in a combination of ruby, white, and tawny port casks. This carefully curated finishing process has allowed the whisky to develop a complexity of flavor that is truly unparalleled.

Bottled at natural cask strength, this whisky offers an intense and robust flavor profile that is sure to delight even the most discerning of palates.

Whether you are a seasoned Scotch enthusiast or just looking to explore the world of premium whisky, Talisker Special Release is the perfect choice. With its exceptional flavor profile and limited availability, this whisky is sure to be a prized addition to any collection.

title: Castello di Bolgheri Flocco 2022
bodyHtml: A classic Sangiovese bouquet of crushed cherry, stone, and a lovely dry, fruity taste, where the cherry notes of the Sangiovese grape are rounded off by the rounder and fuller taste of Cabernet Sauvignon.

title: Vincent Latour Meursault-Gouttes d'Or Blanc Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Burgundy region, specifically within the Meursault Premier Cru appellation in the Cote de Beaune, Domaine Vincent Latour Meursault Blanc Gouttes d'Or Premier Cru represents a prestigious, deeply textured, and mineral-driven expression of classic Chardonnay. Produced by Domaine Vincent Latour under winemaker Vincent Latour, the estate is renowned for combining traditional Burgundian craftsmanship with modern precision, including long aging on fine lees in large oak foudres and demi-muids. Sourced from the historic Premier Cru vineyard Gouttes d'Or—meaning Drops of Gold, named for the golden hue and rich texture its wines exhibit—the vineyard sits on stony limestone and clay soils. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes organic vineyard practices, native yeast fermentation, minimal battonage, and barrel aging (approximately 20% to 25% new) to craft a white Burgundy of opulent concentration, luminous clarity, and exceptional cellaring longevity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, deep golden yellow colour with luminous green highlights in the glass. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with opulent aromas of yellow apple, white peach, and poached pear, interwoven with sophisticated notes of toasted hazelnut, lemon curd, white acacia blossom, crushed limestone minerality, and subtle vanilla bean spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, rich, and satiny, delivering generous layers of ripe orchard fruit, citrus oil, and savory toasted pastry, all supported by a vibrant, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by Meursault's signature buttery texture and a profound mineral spine, it concludes with a long, powerful finish marked by lingering notes of citrus zest, roasted nuts, and salty minerality. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, it combines lush, golden fruit richness with crisp limestone tension and premier structural depth.

title: Buchanan's De Luxe 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
A classic for nearly 100 years, Buchanan’s 12-year old whisky is one of the world’s most iconic and awarded luxury Scotch whisky brands. It has a soft and fruity flavor, with orange and chocolate notes that allow it to be served on the rocks or with soda, garnished with a strip of orange peel. Originally called Buchanan’s Finest Liqueur, James Buchanan personally consulted and approved the blend, which has a soft and fresh profile that separates it from other more dense whisky profiles.

Slight hints of peat, orange zest and vanilla cream on the palate. Vanilla continues on the palate, with plenty of orchard fruit in tow. Caramel sweetness. A cigar box and peat smoke finish.

title: J. Denuziere Crozes Hermitage Blanc 2020
bodyHtml: Tropical notes of pineapple and mango are accented by lashes of cashew and crushed granite in this dry, satiny blend of Marsanne and Roussanne. It's an ample, juicy wine packed with youthful, sun-kissed fruit but balanced neatly by soft tangerine acidity and a delicate grip of tea tannins on the finish.

title: Chateau Croix Mouton 2020
bodyHtml:
The history of the Chateau Croix Mouton dates back to the Gallo-Roman era, as evidenced by the remains of a very old viticultural past. Chateau Croix-Mouton is located along the many meanders of the Dordogne, in the city of Lugon. The architecture of the current premises and the presence of a very large fireplace dating from Louis XIV prove the importance of succession in the seventeenth century. Chateau Croix-Mouton is listed in the Guide Feret in 1881, like all major Bordeaux estates.

Croix Mouton produces wines intended for pleasure, and excellent while still young. They are full bodied and rich in flavour, easy to drink but with finesse and a stunning display of fresh red fruit on the palate. After the release of its first vintage, Chateau Croix Mouton was very quickly recognised by Bordeaux wine experts as being excellent value for money.

title: Cantina Levorato Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Cantina Levorato Pinot Grigio originates from Italy, within the Veneto region and the delle Venezie DOC appellation. Founded in 1922 in Dolo, near Venice, Cantina Levorato is a family-run winery with over a century of heritage. The estate blends traditional winemaking heritage with modern temperature-controlled technology, focusing on producing approachable, fresh, and regional expressions that capture the cool climate character of northeastern Italy's gravel and alluvial terroirs.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a bright, pale straw-yellow colour with subtle greenish highlights. The nose is crisp and delicate, opening with fresh aromas of green apple, crisp pear, and white peach, layered with floral notes of acacia blossoms and vibrant citrus zest. On the palate, it exhibits a light-to-medium body with bright, lively acidity and a clean, dry structure. Stylistically, it offers an easy-drinking, fruit-forward, and mineral-accented profile that concludes with a refreshing finish carrying subtle hints of lemon peel and almond.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Pinot Grigio

  • Alcohol by volume: 12.0%

title: Chateau Lynch Moussas 2020
bodyHtml:
The Irishman John Lynch acquired the estate together with the vineyards of what is today the neighbouring Chateau Lynch-Bages and had the chateau built in the 18th century.  From the 1970's onwards until today, major investments have been made at the Chateau and in the vineyard, significantly improving quality. Chateau Lynch-Moussas is the only Casteja-Chateau on the left bank not exclusively distributed through Borie-Manoux but through the "place de Bordeaux".

94+ Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is an estate that really has been turned round by the Casteja family. This new vintage shows fine potential, a balance between fruit and the rich texture of ripe Cabernet Sauvignon. The wine will age seriously well.

94+ Points - James Suckling

This is a very structured red with lots of blackberry, currant, walnut and graphite. Full-bodied and long. Nice chewiness.

91 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Darker currants, ripe cherries, saddle leather, cedar pencil, and smoked tobacco notes all emerge from the 2020 Chateau Lynch-Moussas, a medium-bodied Pauillac offering ripe, supple tannins, terrific overall balance, integrated oak, and outstanding length.

91 Points - Decanter

Rich smoky notes, coffee, mocha, raspberry and black cherry, grilled cedar - a little short on the finish. Tasted several times, and the oak is pretty dominant, it struggles to allow enough gaps through the structure to let the fruit out. 

91 Points - Wilfred Wong

The 2020 Chateau Lynch-Moussas deftly combines richness with style. This wine offers aromas and flavors of savory notes, earthiness, a chalkiness. Try it with pan-fried flank steak and baby bok choy.

title: Pere Ventura Primer Reserva Brut (NV)
bodyHtml:
Primer Reserva Brut is an amazingly aromatic cava with extraordinary freshness, a paradigm of the harmony between delicacy and classic consistency.

A cheerful, pleasant cava which, with its perfect blend of fruitiness, freshness and subtly complex aromas, suits any drinking occasion.

Straw yellow tones with green-gold highlights. Fine, firm beads rising briskly and forming a perfect rosary. Young, delicate, spring-like aroma with an evocative fruity freshness, an expression of citrus and orange blossoms, topped by soft almond and toasty notes. A sensation of balance and freshness, with well-integrated CO2 accompanying its fruity taste with subtle hints of ageing.

title: Amador Whiskey 'Port Cask' 92 Proof
bodyHtml:
Sourced from the pedigreed Willett family distillery in Bardstown, KY. Mashbill consists of 74% rye, 11% corn, 15% barley. Aged in new charred American Oak barrels for 3 years. Finished in Amador County Terra d’Oro Port barrels for 9 to 12 months. Bottled at 92 proof. Pairs perfectly in a Waldorf cocktail, Vieux Carre, or Sazerac.

Deep copper brown color with red hue from Port wine barrels. Classic rye spice with aromas and flavors of gingerbread, cookie dough, toffee, and hints of vanilla and honey. Full bodied and decadent.

title: Amador Whiskey 'Chardonnay Cask' 86 Proof
bodyHtml:
Sourced from the pedigreed Willett family distillery in Bardstown, KY. Mashbill consists of 65% corn, 20% wheat, 15% barley Aged in new charred American Oak barrels for 3 years. Finished in Napa Cellars Chardonnay barrels for 9–12 months. Bottled at 86 proof. Pairs perfectly in an Old Fashioned, Manhattan, or Boulevardier.

Exquisite copper brown color. Notes of vanilla, caramel, butterscotch, roasted almond mingle with hints of honey and tobacco. Rich and full bodied with a creamy, long finale.

title: Amador Whiskey 'Cabernet Cask' 90 Proof
bodyHtml:
Amador Whiskey Co.’s Double Barrel Classic Bourbon does something a little extra—it captures the heart of Kentucky in every glass. This 72% corn small batch classic bourbon upholds the high standards of Kentucky bourbon with a deep understanding that it’s more than a spirit, but a culture—a lifestyle. 

Amador’s classic low-rye bourbon was aged in new charred American oak barrels for three years, taking time to soak in flavors of vanilla, caramel and mildly tart black cherry notes. Distinct from its Kentucky counterparts, Amador Whiskey Co.’s Double Barrel Classic Bourbon also captures the California spirit. The whiskey’s second barrel aging is done in Napa Valley California, where this classic drink steps into luxury, aging for 9 to 12 months in medium toast French oak Napa Cabernet Sauvignon barrels. 

The Cabernet aging results in a copper brown bourbon tinted with a cabernet red hue, sensational vanilla characteristics and a silky mouthfeel. The result is a rich take on a Kentucky bourbon, exuding deep flavors of vanilla and toast followed by notes of creme brulee that conclude with hints of spice in a long, complex finish. When you reach for this bottle, you’re reaching for the Amador golden standard, whether in a Perfect Manhattan cocktail or just slow sipping nice and neat.

title: Giffard Curacao Triple Sec
bodyHtml:
Triple sec is an orange liqueur distilled three times at 20-40°. The fruit peels macerate for several months in vats filled with alcohol to obtain an infusion which will be distilled. It can be sweetened with sugar or honey (100g/L min).

Curacao, originally made by the dutch, is generally considered a triple sec, it takes its name from the island of Curacao, an island in the Netherlands Antilles, which produces small bitter oranges.

Translucent and crystalline color. Fresh and candied citrus scent, typical of sweet and bitter oranges. Sweet and delicate, fresh citrus fruit with a slight note of bitterness typical of orange and grapefruit peels. On ice, Curacao Triple Sec is not as sweet but more lively, with eucalyptus and orange blossom notes.

title: Skorpios 1618 Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
Skorpios 1618 Tequila Reposado embodies the essence of patience and perfection. Aged for a minimum of 6 months in oak barrels, this exquisite tequila showcases a delicate balance of tradition and innovation. Its golden hue hints at the complexity within, as it unveils a symphony of flavors. You'll discover notes of caramel, vanilla, and a subtle agave sweetness, all expertly interwoven with the gentle influence of oak. The result is a remarkably smooth and refined tequila that lingers on the palate, offering a sophisticated sipping experience.

Skorpios 1618 Tequila Reposado is a testament to the artistry of tequila making, appealing to connoisseurs and newcomers alike.

• Deep rooted agaves / minimum 7-10 years
• Aging: Min 6-12 months
• Single Estate Agaves
• Brick Ovens
• Roller Crushed
• Copper Pots
• Open Air Fermentation
• Deep Well Water/Natural Spring
• 100% Agave Sugars
• American Oak Barrels
• Double Distilled

title: Skorpios 1618 Tequila Joven
bodyHtml:
Skorpios 1618 Joven Tequila is a remarkable fusion of tradition and innovation. This exquisite tequila blends carefully selected young and aged agave spirits to create a uniquely balanced profile. Its crystal-clear appearance belies the complexity within, as it offers a bouquet of citrus and floral notes, complemented by subtle hints of agave and a gentle smokiness. The result is a tequila that's both smooth and full of character, perfect for sipping or crafting premium cocktails.

Skorpios 1618 Joven Tequila captures the essence of agave with a contemporary twist, making it a versatile and captivating choice for tequila enthusiasts seeking a refined taste experience.

• Deep rooted agaves / minimum 7-10 years
• Tequila Blanco blended with 22-24 month aged Anejo
• Single Estate Agaves
• Brick Ovens
• Roller Crushed
• Copper Pots
• Open Air Fermentation
• Deep Well Water/Natural Spring
• 100% Agave Sugars
• Tequila Anejo aged in American Oak Barrels
• Double Distilled

title: Chateau Lagrange 2019
bodyHtml: Grapes have been grown at Chateau Lagrange, St.-Julien, for over 600 years. Third Growth in the Classification of 1855, its vineyard stretches over two Gunzian gravel slopes where the highest point of Saint-Julien thrones on the beautiful estate. An uncompromising quest for excellence, such is the philosophy there. For several decades now the exceptional terroir has inspired a unique approach where precision and innovation are paramount.

title: Bundaberg Rum Overproof
bodyHtml: First distilled in 1888, Bundaberg Rum is as Australian as it gets. Made from 100% sugar cane then matured to perfection, Bundaberg Rum Overproof is distilled and aged for a bold, rich flavour full of oak, caramel and spice.

title: Boracay Coconut Rum
bodyHtml: Smooth Philippine white rum gets some attitude with the exotic taste of coconut. Suit the flavor to your mood whether you take it straight, on the rocks or mixed. Boracay Rum captures the island experience. Choose to party with the sweet and tropical taste of coconut mingling with light a blend of nougat and vanilla that finishes with a good hint of macaroon. With 25% alcohol content, you can be sure that the party will never stop! It’s one beach vacation after another with every sip of Boracay rum.

title: Louis Roederer Collection 246 Blend (NV)
bodyHtml:
Produced in France’s iconic Champagne region, this multi-vintage cuvée represents the 246th blend since the house’s founding in 1776. Still family-owned and operated, Louis Roederer remains dedicated to an uncompromising pursuit of excellence, managing its estate with a focus on sustainable and biodynamic viticulture to fully express the unique qualities of the terroir. The winery’s philosophy centers on adapting to nature's offerings, utilizing a perpetual reserve to ensure a consistent house style characterized by elegance, complexity, and balance.

Wine Description

Collection 246 presents a luminous golden-yellow colour with exceptionally fine, even bubbles. The bouquet is complex and inviting, revealing aromas of mirabelle plum, nectarine, and candied lemon, layered with toasted vanilla notes and a subtle, briny reduction. On the palate, the wine is light and delicate, offering flavours of peach and floral pollen supported by a fresh, oily, and powdery texture. This blend features a high proportion of Chardonnay (54%), balanced by Pinot Noir (35%) and Meunier (11%), resulting in a wine of ethereal finesse and a saline, chalky finish.

Accolades

  • "Wine Spectator - 93 points"

  • "James Suckling - 93 points"

  • "Vinous - 93 points"

Food Pairing

The wine’s remarkable balance and lifted acidity make it a natural partner for a variety of sophisticated dishes. Its saline character and fine bubbles pair beautifully with seafood such as spicy bluefin tuna, salt and pepper squid, or devilled crab on toast. For a richer experience, the umami notes in the reserve wines perfectly complement beef tartare with parmesan or creamy cheeses.

title: Masumi Sparkling Origarami Sake - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
The Miyasaka Brewing Company was established in 1662 by the Miyasaka family, who transitioned from being samurai to the lords of the Suwa area to becoming master sake brewers. The brewery gained significant prominence in 1946 with the discovery of Yeast Number Seven in its fermentation tanks, a strain that remains the most widely used sake yeast in the world today.

Description

This lightly cloudy, naturally sparkling sake is fermented in the bottle and sold unfiltered 'on-the-lees' in a style similar to petillant naturel wines. It presents a delicate aroma with notes of apple, pear, and a uniquely inviting fragrance characteristic of Yeast No. 7. On the palate, it offers a sensory double-entendre by combining crisp bubbles and wine-like acidity with the creamy, savoury richness and umami of traditional sake. The finish is clean and refreshing with a subtle sweetness and a lingering touch of honey. This Junmai Ginjo has an alcohol content of 11% to 12% and a rice polishing rate of 55%.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and fine effervescence of this sparkling sake make it a versatile companion for both Japanese and Western cuisines. It pairs naturally with fresh seafood such as sashimi, raw oysters, and uni, as well as miso-cured or marinated dishes like miso black cod. Its lactic notes and savoury depth also complement aged or washed-rind cheeses, lobster risotto with truffles, and even quatro formaggio pizza. For an ideal experience, it should be served deeply chilled to highlight its crisp bubbles and refreshing citrus-like acidity.

title: Vidigal Porta 6 Reserva 2020
bodyHtml:
The team at the family owned Vidigal Wines, led by Antonio Mendes, makes this Reserva from a blend of local and international grapes grown in the vineyards around Lisbon.

A Complex wine with red fruits both berries and dry fruits. Fruity and soft and full on the finish.

Ideal with roast red meat.

title: Louis Jadot Santenay Clos des Gatsulards 2016
bodyHtml: The House of Louis Jadot has been producing exceptional Burgundy wines since its founding in 1859 by Louis Henry Denis Jadot. For the past 150 years Louis Jadot has continued as one of the great names of Burgundy and has gained international reputation for its superb red and white Burgundy wines. Louis Jadot is not only one of the largest producers of estate Burgundies of the Cote d'Or, it is one of the most celebrated exporters of premium Burgundies, owning close to 140 acres of vineyards from 24 of the most prestigious sites in Burgundy.

title: Angove Organic Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Brilliant ruby in colour with a pronounced nose of oak toast, cedar, prune, chocolate and light herbal character. The palate is medium-bodied, extra dry, with soft to medium acidity and noticeable tannins; expect concentrated toast and prune character, chocolate, and a medium length herbaceous finish.

title: Red Spot Irish Whiskey 15 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Red Spot Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey has matured for over 15 years in a combination of American Bourbon casks, Spanish sherry butts and Sicilian Marsala wine casks, all contributing in rich and complex flavours, making it the top spot in the range.

Pot Still spices with rich cooked fruit, baked apple, mango and black cherry. Hazelnut and a touch of new leather fuse with toasted American Oak. A mix of ripe fruit sweetness from the Marsala seasoned wine casks. While the fruit remains, sweet red pepper and cracked black pepper add some spiciness, finished by notes of American Oak and barley. Finishes with an extra long infusion of fruits and spices.

title: Benriach 16 Years Old
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
The Benriach Distillery was founded in 1898 and although the rough-hewn walls of our warehouses may seem unassuming, they are home to a rare breed of creative expertise in whisky distilling and eclectic cask maturation.

It is where their ingenious and dedicated team spend their days crafting their award winning Speyside single malts, tirelessly pushing the limits of flavour possibility.

A rich and complex 16-year-old single malt from Benriach, this whisky has been matured in a combination of ex-bourbon, ex-sherry and virgin oak casks. Aromas of honey, creamy hazelnuts, baked apples, ginger and apricots fill the nose, complemented by notes of honeyed malt, toasted oak, stone fruits, cinnamon-baked apples and wisps of smoke throughout the palate.

title: Coto De Imaz Gran Reserva 2018
bodyHtml:
Brilliant ruby colour with russet tones. Mature and elegant, its aromatic richness changes and subtly becomes more apparent as the wine breathes. Notes of toast and coconut followed by tertiary aromas (leather, wet earth), and red fruit and dried fruit. Round, silky tannins, persistent and complex aftertaste.

It is an ideal accompaniment for roast-sucking lamb, game, or red meat.

Blend: 90% Tempranillo, 10% Graciano

title: Chateau Grand Puy Ducasse 2015
bodyHtml:
This chateau is highly unusual in that it is located in the heart of Pauillac. Included in the famous 1855 classification, and benefiting from the rich diversity of some of the finest vineyard land in Pauillac, Grand-Puy Ducasse is one of the leaders of this appellation. This great wine is made with the utmost care and the most up-to-date technological methods.

This Grand-Puy Ducasse is a Pauillac of a deep red colour with violet reflections. It reveals at first a subtle nose of aromatic intensity, which quickly evolves with aeration. It is followed by sensual notes of black fruits, dominated by blackcurrant, blackberry and black cherry, with fine notes of liquorice and spice as well as light touches of mocha and cedar. The attack and the mid-palate are pleasant and smooth, lingering with powerful and glossy tannins, which provides this grand Paulliac a very beautiful and attractive depth. 

90+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2015 Grand-Puy-Ducasse has a classic pencil lead and cedar-scented bouquet that feels just a little foursquare at the moment. The palate is medium-bodied with a dash of spice on the entry. This is underpinned by quite robust tannin, but fortunately this Pauillac forages finesse towards the finish that is well balanced and offers attractive persistence. While not as showy out of barrel, I suspect it may coalesce and turn into one of the better wines from this estate in recent years. My banded score based upon that optimism.

title: Palmer & Co. Champagne Blanc De Blancs (NV)
bodyHtml:
Champagne Palmer & Co. was established in 1947 by seven grower-families with Premier Cru and Grand Cru vineyards in the Montagne de Reims region of Champagne. Winemaking at Palmer is a highly collaborative affair: Cellar Master Xavier Berdin and a team of four oenologists taste over 200 distinct lots. The team must reach full consensus before any blend is finalized. 

Subtle aromas of citrus, white flowers, and almonds. Silky on the palate with beautiful minerality. An incomparably pure cuvee. 100% Chardonnay.

Crafted from Chardonnay primarily from the magnificent terroirs of Villers-Marmery and Trepail. These Premier Crus in the Montagne de Reims area, recognized for their elegance and freshness, are harmoniously blended with the delicately fruity Chardonnay of the Cote de Sezanne.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Wafting from the glass with a toasty bouquet of citrus oil, orchard fruit, bee pollen, nectarines and iodine, it's medium to full-bodied and fleshy but precise, with fine depth at the core, racy acids and a pinpoint mousse. This comes warmly recommended.

93 Points - Wilfred Wong

The Champagne Palmer & Co. Blanc de Blancs is concentrated yet refined and delicate with a long and lasting finish. This wine shines with aromas and flavors of stones, minerals, and savory spices. Pair it with grilled Dungeness crab and enjoy the feast. 

91 Points - James Suckling

A focused yet creamy and rounded Blanc de Blancs with plenty of croissants, apple pie, pear tart, hazelnuts, shortcrust, white peaches and lemon curd. Soft and supple mousse. Bright finish.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

A lively version in an aperitif style, offering a balanced mix of ripe green apple and pear, biscuit, candied ginger and chalky mineral set on a light, lacy bead.

title: E. Guigal Hermitage Rouge 2019
bodyHtml:
Guigal’s Hermitage Rouge is a true expression of the Northern Rhone Valley, where the red wines have a profile unlike anywhere else in the world, an irresistible combination of warm flavors of red and black fruit and exotic spice notes that bring great pleasure.

The quintessential syrah, balancing power with finesse and complexity in a wine capable of aging and improving for decades in the cellar. Brings in concentrated fruit with excellent acidity.

95 Points - Vinous

Glass-staining ruby. Powerful, mineral- and smoke-accented black and blue fruit, potpourri, olive and vanilla aromas acquire a spicy nuance as the wine opens up. Offers densely packed cherry-cola, cassis and blueberry flavors that show excellent clarity and a smoky top note. Finishes impressively long, youthfully chewy and spicy, with building tannins and a suave, lingering candied violet note.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Where the 2018s lead with their fruit, the 2019s lead with their tannins, and that's readily apparent with the 2019 Hermitage. A deep purple-hued effort, it boasts terrific notes of darker fruits, smoked meats, graphite, and crushed stone. Powerful, structured, and full-bodied, it's a brilliant Hermitage in the making, although not for those looking for instant gratification.

title: Louis Latour Marsannay Blanc 2019
bodyHtml:
Maison Louis Latour is one of the most highly-respected negociant-eleveurs in Burgundy. Maison Louis Latour is the producer of some of the finest Burgundian wines.

A fresh bouquet of citrus fruits. The same aromas are found upon tasting with a floral finish to the wine. Round and velvety, with a good length, it is delicious while still young but a few years of cellaring will make it even more appealing.

91+ Points - James Suckling

An impressive wine for this underrated appellation, this has exactly what you expect from a good white Burgundy, marrying floral, ginger and candied-citrus character with a medium body, some nice mid-palate richness and mineral acidity. The touch of oak supports the cool, elegant finish nicely.

title: Desolas Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Desolas Mezcal Blanco is delicately hand crafted from the Salmiana Agave in San Luis Potosi, Mexico creating a unique mezcal with a botanical and fresh aroma and smooth and balanced taste.

Desolas is a brand that is inspired by traditional time-honored techniques of mezcal production, the artisanal process of crafting the agave spirit, the natural elements of the sun and the land, and a focus on the deliberate journey of creation and discovery.

title: Hajszan Neumann Gruner Veltliner Nussberg 2024
bodyHtml:
Weingut Hajszan Neumann is located at the foot of the Nussberg and the district of Grinzing, with 20 hectares of certified biodynamic vineyards spread across the region's mineral-rich, weathered limestone soils. This cuvee comes from the cooler Weisleiten and Haarlocke vineyards.

Wine Description

Bright and fresh, though now with a slight honeyed slick, this streams verbena, pear skin, crab apple, river stones along a streamlined palate, seasoned with subtle white pepper and pithy wild lime. Under stelvin, this will continue to go the distance, becoming even more interesting as it ages.

title: Crystal Head Vodka Onyx
bodyHtml:
With its luxurious black finish and matching crest debossed cap, the bottle celebrates the powerful warrior crystal, Onyx. Sharing its powers of intuition, focus, positivity and protection to those who keep it close. Onyx connects to our earth with its protective energy, allowing in no light. Onyx combines all colours of the spectrum and is said to absorb negativity; the darker the stone, the more energy it holds. 

Crafted from Blue Weber agave, Onyx acts as a symbol of the human journey. It focuses on positivity, calling on one's inner creative spirit. Like all Crystal Head expressions, Onyx is blended with the purest water from Newfoundland, Canada. This gives the final product a clean and semi-sweet finish. Staying true to Crystal Head values, Onyx contains no oils, sugars or additives.

Fresh green grass, nuanced white pepper, and hints of citrus on the nose. Soft and smooth with a touch of spice and sweetness, which develops into the subtle yet unmistakable earthy grip of agave. A medium finish of green grass, pepper and citrus.

title: Savian Ti Amo Organic 2021
bodyHtml:
TI AMO, two words for a great wine with a deep meaning, like the old grapes used to obtain this wonderful red wine. A wine that wants to remember passion for tradition and love for future and innovation. The elegant label and the evocative name immediately make it a wine suitable for special or romantic events.

In this exciting wine is the succession of intense red and violet reflections colous. Intense pleasant parfume, clear aroma of blackberry and raspberry. A wine of great personality, balanced, full, decisive and particularly full-bodied.

title: Crystal Head Vodka - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml:
The original Crystal Head Vodka is crafted from locally sourced, Canadian corn. It is distilled four times into a neutral grain spirit and blended with pristine water from Newfoundland, Canada. The vodka is filtered seven times, of which three are through layers of semi-precious crystals known as Herkimer diamonds. 

Crystal Head Vodka offers a clean, clear and colourless spirit. On the nose are neutral grain aromas with a delicate touch of citrus. The palate is silky smooth with a hint of sweetness and vanilla, ending with a sweet, creamy finish.

title: Yangarra Estate Grenache McLaren Vale 2022
bodyHtml:
Yangarra Estate is a biodynamic wine farm in the McLaren Vale region in South Australia. The Yangarra philosophy centres around producing wines solely from its single-vineyard estate and the property is devoted to the best grape varieties of the southern Rhone. Yangarra's combination of rare geologies, moderate altitude, abundant sunshine and cool evening breezes make it perfect for growing varieties that thrive in these moderate maritime environments.

The Old Vine Grenache is a complex, perfumed and elegant wine with a trademark tannin structure.

title: Emiliana 'Ge' Red Wine 2019
bodyHtml: Deep plum red with violet tones. Bouquet: Presents intense aromas of black fruits and berries with mineral notes and a soft touch of tobacco. Generously fruity with cedar notes. Well balanced with tremendous volume, well rounded tannins and a long finish.

title: Dalmore 12 Year Old Sherry Cask
bodyHtml:
A new addition to the Highland malt maker's award-winning Principal Collection, the Sherry Cask Select showcases the affinity between The Dalmore and sherry.

This expression begins its journey in American white oak ex-bourbon casks, where it spends ten years maturing, laying down the foundations of the distillery's house style: chocolate, orange and spice. The liquid is then finished in an assemblage of hand-curated sherry barrels from Andalusia in Spain, making this 12-year-old a delicious and decadent drinking experience, full of sweet fruits and autumnal spice.

title: Mas de Daumas Gassac Rouge 2021
bodyHtml:
Purchased in 1970 by Aime Guibert, the 30-hectare Mas de Daumas Gassac was originally intended as a holiday retreat. However, a visiting oenologist, Henri Enjalbert identified many similarities between the soils of the estate and those of certain great estates of the Medoc. This, combined with the estate's unique micro-climate, persuaded M.Guibert to begin planting vines in 1971, the first wines being released in 1978. Made according to organic principles, the wines are now 'cult classics'. This elegant and balanced red is a blend of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon plus 10 other varieties including Merlot, Tannat, Tempranillo, Syrah and Nebbiolo.

A deep, ruby-red in colour, on the nose scents of cassis and leather with mineral notes. Full-bodied and dry on the palate with spicy red-fruit flavours, the tannins are pronounced yet well-balanced and the finish is long and smoky, Try with braised stuffed shoulder of lamb with peppers or a venison stew with juniper berries and cream.

title: Ukiyo Japanese Blossom Gin
bodyHtml: Ukiyo Blossom Gin is made with a base of distilled shochu, which gets redistilled with juniper, mandarin, and more. Following that, it's infused with sakura flower, imparting a helping of fragrant floral notes. Deliciously bright and elegant, we think this will make for a brilliant G&T, and do very well in Spritzes.

title: Chiyomusubi Ultra Yuzu
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1865 during the Edo period, Chiyomusubi Sake Brewery is a historic family-run facility located at the entrance of the famous Shigeru Mizuki Road. The brewery is renowned for its deep connection to the local community and its commitment to using traditional brewing methods, such as sourcing pristine, slightly soft water by hand from the Chugoku Mountains. The name Chiyomusubi translates to "eternal happiness and lasting bonds," reflecting the brewery's mission to foster connections through its spirits.

Description

This premium yuzu liqueur is clear with a vibrant yellow-golden hue. It is crafted by blending Chiyomusubi's high-quality sake with a generous 25% of natural yuzu juice, resulting in an exceptionally refreshing and aromatic profile. The nose is bursting with citrusy freshness, offering charming notes of pink grapefruit, earl grey tea, and jasmine flowers. On the palate, it provides a full-bodied fruity flavour with a masterful balance of tart acidity and gentle sweetness. The experience is light and crisp, concluding with a long, beautiful finish featuring hints of ginger and dried herbs. ABV 6%.

Food Pairing

The bright acidity and intense citrus profile of Ultra Yuzu make it a versatile dessert sake that pairs exceptionally well with tropical fruit flans, scones, and cakes. It is also a surprising but excellent match for afternoon tea staples like club sandwiches. Beyond food, it serves as a sophisticated component for cocktails or can be enjoyed in its pure form, poured over ice cream, or mixed with soda water for a refreshing long drink.

title: Louis Latour Marsannay Rouge 2019
bodyHtml:
Maison Louis Latour is the producer of some of the finest Burgundian wines but has also pioneered the production of fine wines from outside Burgundy's confines. These wines from the Ardeche and the Coteaux de Verdon are slowly gaining esteem for their unmatchable quality outside Burgundy.

The Marsannay is sturdy and robust due to the rich iron-based soil. The wine has an intense bouquet of red fruit and a silky palate with a distinct gamey character and great tannic appeal.

92 Points - Wilfred Wong

The 2019 Louis Latour Marsannay Rouge shows excellent and intricate nuances. This wine excels with aromas and flavors of red and black fruits. Enjoy it with garlic and rosemary-infused roast leg of lamb.

title: Ignite Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
This clear agave spirit originates from Jalisco, Mexico, created as part of the premium spirits portfolio under the Ignite Spirits brand (founded by Dan Bilzerian). Ignite Blanco Tequila is produced at a certified tequila distillery in Jalisco using 100% Blue Weber Agave (Agave tequilana Weber var. azul) harvested from mature plants. The agave piñas undergo traditional slow-cooking in brick ovens (hornos) and autoclaves before juice extraction, fermentation, and double distillation in copper/stainless pot stills. The unaged spirit is bottled clear at 80 proof (40.0% ABV) without resting in oak, designed to showcase the bright, herbaceous, and sweet nature of Jalisco agave in an accessible modern format.

Spirit Description

This blanco tequila exhibits crystal-clear clarity with brilliant silver highlights and clean, fast legs clinging to the glass. On the nose, it is clean, bright, and sweet, opening with prominent notes of cooked sweet agave, candied lime zest, and subtle green pepper, followed by soft undertones of white pepper, lemon peel, and a faint tropical floral sweetness. On the palate, it feels light-to-medium-bodied, smooth, and approachable, delivering an immediate burst of sweet roasted agave, citrus pulp, and sweet cream before evolving into a mild mid-palate of cracked white pepper and fresh herbal grassy tones. Free of wood tannins, the profile emphasizes approachable sweetness with minimal bite. The finish is short to medium, clean, and mildly warm, trailing off with lingering impressions of sweet agave nectar, lime rind, and a soft, dry pepper kick.

title: Empress Cocktail Gin
bodyHtml:
This premium spirit is part of a superior mix — a cocktail that includes you: your inspiration, creativity, and favourite fine ingredients.

The contemporary Canadian gin is crafted in small batches and numbered by hand. It is carefully distilled with 10 botanicals that together balance the

characteristic flavour of juniper with citrus, floral and spice.  These botanicals yield a vibrant concoction that is lovingly blended with pure Canadian water. The result is a complex cocktail spirit as full-bodied and complex as a fine single-malt whisky. Victoria Gin makes classic and contemporary cocktails sing.

Let this bright Canadian gin surprise you!

title: Gordon & MacPhail Glen Grant Single Malt 11 Year Old 'Discovery'
bodyHtml:
Gordon & Macphail Glen Grant 11 Year Old Discovery from Glen Grant Distillery is carefully matured in Gordon & Macphail’s own casks with spirit entrusted to them from the Glen Grant Distillery. Aged 11 years on oak casks.

Tasting Notes: Sweet and tropical, fresh lemon and lime aromas followed by coconut and mango. Flavors of elderflower lead to grapefruit zest and light charred oak with gentle spice on the finish.

title: Bowsaw Small Batch Bourbon
bodyHtml:
A triumphant mash bill consisting of 75% corn, 21% Rye and 4% malted barley.

Powerful vanilla notes fused with rich caramels make this an ultra-smooth, bucket list bourbon.

title: Little Engine Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml: This Chardonnay has a soft creamy undertone with delicious notes of lemon curd, vanilla meringue and tangerine on the nose. The palate is fresh but intriguing with white peach, gooseberry and honeydew melon. The finish is clean and refreshing with lingering hints of lemonade. Best enjoyed upon release through 2025 under ideal cellaring conditions.

title: Grey Goose Vodka - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Grey Goose Vodka is currently made in France, specifically in the Cognac region. This premium vodka is known for its smooth and refined flavour profile. It is crafted using high-quality French wheat and pure water sourced from the Gensac Springs. Grey Goose offers a clean and crisp taste, with subtle hints of citrus and a touch of sweetness.

Critics consistently praise Grey Goose Vodka for its exceptional quality and craftsmanship. It has been lauded for its smoothness, purity, and versatility in cocktails. Vodka enthusiasts appreciate its elegance and consistently high standards, making it a preferred choice for those seeking a top-tier vodka experience.

title: Bombay Citron Presse
bodyHtml:
Bombay Citron Presse is a new creative gin expression inspired by the flavours of the classic Tom Collins cocktail. A zesty spirit that’s easy to mix, inspiring creative twists on classic cocktails.

Capturing the real flavour and essence of hand-picked Mediterranean lemons harvested early in the season to capture, the bright, zestful citrus notes at their most vibrant. Their flavour is concentrated to create a naturally refreshing, fruits infusion.

Bombay Citron Presse has a naturally refreshing and sophisticated flavour that is easy to mix and perfect for Summer cocktail occasions, from a classic Presse & Tonic, Ultimate Tom Collins, or simply over ice in a lighter Presse & Soda.

title: Teremana Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Following the success of Teremana Blanco and Reposado and backed by global superstar Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson, their Anejo is now entering the tequila ring.

Apple, pear, oak, vanilla, agave, caramel, and baking spice notes. The rich palate guides you to a long, complex finish. Try with samosas topped with green chutney.

title: Bombay Bramble
bodyHtml:
Infused with all-natural blackberries and raspberries harvested at the peak of ripeness, for a richer, more vibrant flavor.

Bombay Bramble is best enjoyed simply with tonic, poured over ice and garnished with a squeeze of lemon. Perfect for the approaching Summer season, the Bombay Bramble & Tonic is a sophisticated option for those that enjoy a touch of fruit in their G&T.

Easy to mix and perfect for experimentation with its rich, bold, berried flavour. The refusal to add additional sugar and artificial flavours increases Bombay Bramble’s versatility and provides a far more sophisticated taste.

title: Frescobaldi Nipozzano Chianti Riserva 2022
bodyHtml:
#31 on Wine Spectator’s Top 100 Wines of 2025

This acclaimed Italian red achieved significant global recognition after being named #31 on Wine Spectator’s Top 100 Wines of 2025, a prestigious list released in late 2024.

Deep red with garnet colour; floral aromas of red plum and berries, blood orange fruit with cedar notes; extra dry, medium to full bodied, with balanced fruit flavours, notes of plum, red fruit and citrus with a touch of spice and leather; balanced medium acidity and a long finish.

title: Dillon's Melon Gin
bodyHtml:
Made with Unfiltered Gin 22 as the base which includes 22 botanicals, peeled and steeped locally grown cantaloupe and lightly sweetened with organic cane sugar. Notes of citrus fruit zest, fresh cantaloupe and hints of pine, smooth and complex on the palate.

Great for cocktails or sipping on ice. Pair with fresh salads.

title: Chambord - 375 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Chambord is a super premium liqueur, hand crafted in the Loire Valley in France. Chambord black raspberry liqueur is hand crafted with raspberries, blackberries, Moroccan citrus peel, Madagascar vanilla, honey, XO cognac, herbs and spices. The result is unprecedented level of complexities in colour, aroma and flavour.

title: Padre Azul Anejo Tequila - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: Padre Azul Anejo Tequila is matured in hand-selected oak bourbon barrels for at least 18 months. The additional oak influence gives this premium tequila complex flavours such as cinnamon, chocolate and caramelized nuts.

title: Padre Azul Silver Tequila - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: Padre Azul Silver is bottled straight after its double distillation. This gives it its clear, transparent colour and its incomparable taste of fresh agave. This young tequila is perfect for mixing high-quality cocktails.

title: Yalumba Cabernet Sauvignon 'The Signature' 2022
bodyHtml:
Yalumba 'The Signature' Cabernet Sauvignon Shiraz originates from Australia's prestigious Barossa Valley in South Australia. Established in 1849, Yalumba stands as Australia's oldest family owned winery, driven by a fierce commitment to sustainable viticulture and independent craftsmanship. 'The Signature' serves as a sentimental pillar of their winemaking philosophy, with each vintage dedicated to an individual who has profoundly enhanced the traditions and culture of the estate.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Shiraz blend reveals a deep, dense, and opaque plum-red colour in the glass. On the nose, it opens with highly defined, expressive aromatics of dark chocolate-dusted blackberries, blackcurrants, and Doris plum, subtly accented by complex hints of cedar, pouch tobacco, pencil shavings, and fresh mint. The palate is full-bodied, rich, and concentrated, displaying an elegant interplay between ripe dark fruits, sweet mocha, and savoury elements like bay leaf and olive tapenade.

title: Luxardo Sambuca - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: This classic Italian liqueur has been family owned for generations. The use of essential oils from the star anise seed provide intense aromatics and concentrated flavours that are balanced by light bitterness and velvety smooth texture on the palate.

title: Te Awa Left Field Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This lively white wine is produced in New Zealand, with fruit primarily sourced from the celebrated Marlborough region, though some vintages may feature fruit from the cooler Nelson region. Te Awa Estate is part of the prestigious Villa Maria group, and the 'Left Field' label was created to venture beyond convention and embrace a winemaking philosophy of creativity and individuality. The brand is known for its quirky identity—featuring fantastical creatures like the 'Flying Squidmill'—and aims to craft innovative wines that showcase the vibrant, fresh character of New Zealand's unique terroirs.

Wine Description

The 'Left Field' Sauvignon Blanc presents a brilliant appearance with light-footed vibrancy. The bouquet is flamboyant and aromatic, parading scents of passion fruit, nectarine, and lemongrass alongside gentle hints of green herb and gooseberry. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and refreshingly crisp, delivering a burst of tropical fruits, citrus, and zesty pomaceous flavours.

Stylistically, this 100% Sauvignon Blanc is dry and harmonious, intertwining its juicy fruit power with a salivating acid line and a distinct mineral highlight.

title: Santo Fino Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
When Sammy Hagar gets together with friends in Cabo San Lucas you never know what's coming next. So begins the history behind Santo’s Tequila and Mezquila - both borne out of good friends, great food, a lot of tequila and the search for a taste revelation: “a higher spirit.”  Together, rocker Sammy Hagar and chef Guy Fieri found their virtuoso with Juan Eduardo Nunez, the third-generation master distiller from the famed distillery El Viejito, founded in 1937, in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. 

Sammy’s history of making world-renowned tequila, Guy’s world-famous taste buds, and Juan Eduardo’s award-winning craftsmanship, bring to life the portfolio of Santo spirits; a sinfully smooth old world style tequila blanco and anejo, an oak-aged reposado, a and the world’s first mezquila.

Their tequilas are additive free and they do not use any sugar or coloring agents in their tequilas.

title: Ransom Spirits Bourbon
bodyHtml: Aged a minimum of 2 years in Charred American oak, including 12 year-old barrels from their French Alembic Pot Stills. Made up of a unique 4 mash grain build, including 66% Corn, 23% Rye, 6% Wheat and 4% Malted Barley grown on their organic farm, you will experience classic Bourbon aromas with notes of toffee and soft caramel, mixed with sweet corn. Rich and warm flavors that balance a soft oak influence and cereal grain with additional hints of cocoa powder, anise, and a deep honey mouth feel. The finish has a long spicy Rye warmth with orange zest that gives way to a final touch of malt.

title: Gerard Bertrand Cote des Roses Rose Limited Edition 2022
bodyHtml:
The robe shows a soft, pale, brilliant pink with bluish tints developing over time towards more orangey nuances. The bouquet releases aromas of summer fruits, cassis and redcurrant Floral notes of rose along with hints of grapefruit complete the picture. On the palate the impression is fresh and full, with great aromatic persistence and balance The finish is fresh, offering notes of candy.

This Languedoc is ideal as an aperitif or with shellfish and subtly spiced dishes.

title: Chateau Aimee Cuvee Jean Jules 2020
bodyHtml:
A Medoc estate with only 3 hectares of vines planted to 30 year old Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot vines.

Fermented in a combination of steel and cement vats making for a Bordeaux that's fruited and delicious and from a very fine vintage.

title: Duck Pond Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml: Bright ruby in color with a light rim, this dry Pinot Noir offers a great view of the vintage. In the glass bright cherry and berry notes play with hints of cola. Mild notes of oak and soil add depth and complexity. On the palate, rich cherry, berry and plum round out a fruity and velvety finish.

title: Wakefield Chardonnay Jaraman 2021
bodyHtml: On release the wine is a very pale straw colour with a youthful green hue. It has intense lifted aromas of melon and lime with hints of stone fruits. There are underlying tropical notes of green pineapple and guava and subtle secondary characters of flint, cedar and spice. The palate displays citrus fruits, fig and melon flavours along with a clean, mineral acidity and a touch of lemon zest. Texturally, it is very delicate, with a soft mid palate and well-integrated oak.

title: Chateau d'Aurilhac 2011
bodyHtml:
Chateau d'Aurilhac is at the head of the queue in the new generation of the great wines of the Medoc. Its terroir, in the rural district of Pauillac, surpasses itself each vintage by a vinification and maturation process always more ambitious: its a dense and complicated wine with subtle and resounding aromas.

The nose expresses aromas of black fruits (cherry, blackcurrant), spicy and slightly woody notes. The palate delivers a rich and creamy body, ending in a long finish.

title: Boschkloof Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot 2023
bodyHtml:
The Cabernet Sauvignon-Merlot blend is a classic Bordeaux-style wine that showcases the best of both New World fruit and Old World structure.

The grapes were handpicked and fermented separately with both inoculated and native ferments, resulting in a wine with a plush mouthfeel and silky tannins. The resulting wine has a deep ruby-black color, with concentrated flavors of blackberries, plums, and baking spices. This wine has impressive complexity and ageability for a wine at this price point.

The well-draining granitic soils of the Polkadraai Hills in Stellenbosch provide the perfect terroir for this wine, resulting in a concentrated and complex red that will continue to improve over the next 3 to 5 years.

title: Road 13 Viognier 2020
bodyHtml:
Complex in all the right ways! Quince, pear, and papaya on the nose and flavours of Caramelized apple and pear with subtle citrus and vanilla bean notes on the palate. This Viognier is all kinds of bright and just the right amount of balance.

Pairs perfectly with grilled prawns, roasted chicken, corn-on-the-cob, and stuffed pork tenderloin.

title: Kraken Black Spiced Rum - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: One of the fastest growing rum brands, The Kraken is the world’s first black spiced rum, housed in an iconic bottle. This black rum from the Caribbean is blended with more than 13 secret spices to create this mythical beast of a spiced rum. Intense molasses, spice and brown sugar aromas on the nose and rich coffee, chocolate, vanilla bean, spice, molasses and clove flavours on the palate make this ideal in mixed drinks.

title: Van Gogh Espresso Vodka - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: Van Gogh Espresso Vodka is created with nothing but the best Colombian beans, giving this premium vodka a bittersweet coffee taste. With just a hint of citrus and a silky cocoa finish, Van Gogh Espresso is the perfect blank canvas for any coffee-inspired creation.

title: O'Rourke's Peak Cellars Gruner Veltliner 2021
bodyHtml:
With the hue of neon yellow, the aromas are ripe and reminiscent of a European bakery at Christmas. Sauternes also comes to mind, as the ‘late harvest’ aromas of honey, candied almonds, golden raisin and dried apricot pour over the rim, and as the wine unfolds, Meyer lemon, crème brûlée and roasted nuts will dazzle you.  On the palate, freshly ripped-from-the-garden herbs, yellow plum and pomelo tickle the taste buds, while the rich, round and plump texture carries through a long finish.

A delicious wine for lighter proteins, like roasted chicken, beer can chicken, chicken tagine or cedar plank salmon paired with some char-grilled green veg.  If you’re feeling like something with a little more flavour punch, a kale Caesar salad or paella with saffron and smoked paprika should do the trick!

title: The Walking Fool 2022 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
Caymus-Suisun, an extension of the renowned Wagner family's winemaking legacy, is situated in California's Suisun Valley, just east of Napa Valley. The 2021 The Walking Fool is a distinctive red blend that showcases the unique terroir of this region.

Composition: This wine is a blend of Zinfandel and Petite Sirah, two varietals that thrive in Suisun Valley's climate.

Tasting Notes:

  • Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring notes of juicy raspberries and espresso, creating a complex and inviting profile.

  • Palate: Smooth and lively, with flavors of ripe red fruits complemented by softly fine tannins, leading to a harmonious finish.

title: Tanqueray - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Tanqueray Gin is a Premium English Gin that delivers a clean, crisp taste. It is 47.3% alcohol by volume and is sold in a unique and distinctive green bottle, based on a cocktail shaker. Very fresh and smooth on the nose with slight hints of juniper and citrus coming through. A good hit of liquorice is present on the palate, with a slight spice that creates a long tingle.

title: Beefeater - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Mild lemon with pine facets builds into an aggressive, but not overpowering pine-forward juniper heart. Spice builds towards the end with swells of gentle coriander, chewy licorice root, and a bit of bitter orange.

title: Castiglion del Bosco Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
The aromatic details of this wine say a lot about the vintage climate, early-onset but with still a great acidity component.

The wine is lemon with greenish reflections, the nose expresses fresh floral notes enhanced with constant a hint of citrus fruit, such as grapefruit and orange peel. The great minerality, combined with a good acidity, embody the possibility of evolution of this wine.

title: Podere Orma Toscana 2019
bodyHtml:
This fabulous Super Tuscan hails from the highly sought-after Bolgheri wine-growing area.  Orma, a seductive blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc, is a darling among critics.  This Super Tuscan possesses the perfect combination of power and seductive finesse – as many great Bordeaux blends often do - yet captures the distinctive herbaceous aromas of Italian terroir.  

Super Tuscans are the perfect wines for fans of international varietals who are looking to experiment and try something creative and new. Orma is the quintessential wine for discovering the enviable terroir of Bolgheri, a region known as the jewel of Tuscany.

97 Points - James Suckling: This is a tight and powerful Orma with solid tannins that beautifully frame the fruit in the wine. Full-bodied and focused with intense structure and fruit character. Perhaps the best Orma ever.

95 Points - Robert Parker: A blend of 50% Merlot, 30% Cabernet Sauvignon and 20% Cabernet Franc, the 2019 Orma opens to a soothing display of ripe fruit with blackberry, candied cherry, spice, white pepper and even a speck of red chili flake. The mouthfeel is round and soft with a pop of sour cherry. The vineyards are planted in soils rich in pebbles and clay with a little sand at 60 meters above sea level.

title: Berta Distillery - Selezione Del Fondatore Paolo Berta Grappa - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Berta Distillerie Selezione del Fondatore Paolo Berta originates from Italy, within the northwest region of Piedmont in the subregion of Monferrato. Founded in 1947 by Paolo Berta in the hillside village of Mombaruzzo, the historic family distillery built a world-renowned reputation through premium artisanal distillation. Today, the multi-generational family estate continues to craft exceptional spirits, dedicating this flagship, extended-age grappa as a homage to the founder's visionary dedication.

Spirit Description

This ultra-premium aged grappa displays a deep amber appearance with luminous golden and mahogany reflections in the glass. The aromatic nose opens with a complex, majestic bouquet featuring ripe marasca cherries, dried apricot, cacao, and sweet vanilla, underpinned by gentle tobacco and toasted oak nuances. On the palate, the body is broad, velvety, and exceptionally harmonious, delivering an opulent combination of dark chocolate, ripe berries, baking spices, and dried fruit. The finish is remarkably long, dry, and persistent, leaving a trailing warmth of refined wood spice, roasted nuts, and delicate grape pomace. This spirit is matured for 20 years in carefully selected oak casks and is traditionally bottled at an alcohol by volume of 43%.

Food Pairing

The profound oak depth, dried fruit sweetness, and velvety texture of this 20-year-old spirit make it a peerless digestif. It pairs magnificently with high-cocoa dark chocolate, artisanal hazelnut tortes, or dried fruit and nut platters that mirror its aged complexity. For a savoury pairing, it serves as an extraordinary companion to aged, mature cheeses like Castelmagno or sharp Parmigiano Reggiano.

title: Chateau Malescasse 2016
bodyHtml:
The vineyard surrounding Chateau Malescasse is situated on one of the best gravelly hilltops to be found between Margaux and St Julien Beychevelle, near the river, which makes it an exceptional quality growing area with deep, well drained soil.

Purple garnet in color, this displays an intense nose of elderberry, blackcurrant, blueberry and fresh raspberry, complemented by notes of toast and humus. The dense palate displays good volume right from the start, and builds on a tight structure of ripe, fresh tannins. Meaty, full-bodied and powerful, it develops robustly towards a concentrated tannic finish with magnificent length.

Try pairing with a tournedos Rossini or roast salt marsh lamb.

93 Points - Decanter

A broad-shouldered Haut-Medoc that feels true to the vintage, fleshed out with cassis and blackberry fruits and confident tannins, traces of heat through the mid-palate making it a little uncharacteristic of the appellation, but this has swagger and interest – an excellent wine.

92 Points - James Suckling

A touched of char-grilled character, next to bitter chocolate and full black fruit. This is big-boned Haut-Médoc that packs a serious punch at the front, but is quite silky and long at the finish. 

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Saturated ruby/purple-colored with a smoking good bouquet of blackberries, saddle leather, dried herbs, and lead pencil, this beauty hits the palate with medium to full-bodied richness, a rounded, sexy texture, and a serious finish. Hats off to this estate and the consulting team of Stephane Derenoncourt for this stunning effort. 

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Solidly built, showing tobacco and charcoal notes mixed with dark currant and blackberry compote flavors. There's good energy here and the fruit and earth details meld well through the finish.

title: Allegrini Lugana Oasi Mantellina 2021
bodyHtml: Allegrini Oasi Mantellina Lugana DOC is an Italian white wine renowned for its warm, vibrant flavors. This wine offers fresh aromas of citrus, stone fruits, and white floral notes with a crisp, balanced finish. It is perfect for adding a touch of Italian elegance to any meal.

title: Palmer Champagne Brut Reserve (NV)
bodyHtml:
Champagne Palmer & Co. was established in 1947 by seven grower-families with Premier Cru and Grand Cru vineyards in the Montagne de Reims region of Champagne. Winemaking at Palmer is a highly collaborative affair: Cellar Master Xavier Berdin and a team of four oenologists taste over 200 distinct lots. The team must reach full consensus before any blend is finalized.

Citrus, pear, and apricot aromas with discrete notes of hazelnut and buttery brioche. Succulent and substantial with an unfettered freshness. The model of balance.

Their flagship wine, crafted from a selection of the most prestigious terroirs in Champagne and distinguished by its elegance and finesse—the timeless signature of the Palmer style. A significant proportion of réserve wines contributes a rare fullness and maturity.

title: Palmer Champagne Rose Solera (NV)
bodyHtml:
Champagne Palmer & Co. was established in 1947 by seven grower-families with Premier Cru and Grand Cru vineyards in the Montagne de Reims region of Champagne. Winemaking at Palmer is a highly collaborative affair: Cellar Master Xavier Berdin and a team of four oenologists taste over 200 distinct lots. The team must reach full consensus before any blend is finalized.

The palate for this Champagne offers flavors of wile strawberries, with hints of red and black currants, vanilla and spice. Fresh and full-bodied, with fine tannins and elegant fruits.

Serve chilled. Excellent as an aperitif. Paris well with finely sliced Bellota ham, smoked salmon, chicken and spring vegetable samosas, grilled red mullet, assorted cheese and red berry fruit zabaglione.

96 Points - James Suckling
