Very dry and flavorful with dried strawberries, flowers, and dried roses. Medium-bodied with a dryness and complexity. It’s tight and focused with phenolic tension and intricacy. Tight and very long. Minerally. Chalky. Exciting.

93 Points - Decanter

With aromas of red berries, spring flowers, pastry, smoke and strawberry/raspberry hints, the Rose Solera from Palmer & Co has a dynamic palate with a fine bead of bubbles energising its vinous, almost full-bodied texture.

92 Points - Wilfred Wong

The Champagne Palmer & Co. Rose Solera is a most unusual Champagne in which the cuvee is enriched with 30-year-old solera of red wines vinified in oak barrels. This wine shines with aromas and flavors of wild strawberries, cherries, sandalwood, and savory spices. Enjoy its palate staying power with pan-seared scallops wrapped with thick sliced bacon.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Dry and satiny on the palate, this offers up-front notes of white raspberry, delicate herbs, fleur de sel and orange peel that are more subtle through to the finish. Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier.

title: Charles Heidsieck Blanc des Millenaires 2007
bodyHtml:
In the early 1980s, the Charles Heidsieck Cellar Master decided to reserve the very best Chardonnays for a cuvee named Blanc des Millenaires. Across thirty years, only seven Blanc des Millenaires have ever been produced; 1983, 1985, 1990, 1995, 2004, 2006 and now, 2007. The House’s exacting requirements for quality and ageing potential show how exceptional the Chardonnays from these harvests were.

A pale gold color with glints of light green typical of chardonnay grapes. The saline minerality is all-pervading. We detect toasted and smoky notes. When swirled, fresh citrus notes appear: grapefruit, yuzu and quince. They bring a cheeky youthfulness to this fine nose, combined with creamy accents and subtil salt butter caramel notes. The identity of the vintage is intertwined with a sharp and classy acidity. An enveloping texture is then revealed with accents of lemon meringue pie and subtle saline notes. Its generosity is very prominent and will continue to develop with ageing. The finish is long and full-bodied with silky sensations.

97 Points - Wine Enthusiast

One of the great Blanc de Blancs Champagnes, this wine only hints of its age and maturity. Up front, the wine has layers of white fruits and a steely texture. It is behind those features that the brioche and almond character begins to show. 

96 Points - James Suckling

Intense oyster-shell and candied-lemon aromas pull you into this very elegant champagne, which is so precise on the sleek and focused palate with a finish of crystalline purity and brightness. Still really youthful, thanks to the uplifting freshness! A Blanc de Blancs from 5 top Crus in the Cote des Blancs.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Unwinding in the glass with scents of crisp stone fruits, honeycomb, buttered pastry, yellow apples, pear and freshly baked bread, it's full-bodied, ample and seamless, with a concentrated core of fruit and a chiseled, racy profile.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Sleek and linear, with racy acidity defining the up-front impact on the palate, but then the plushly creamy texture deftly delivers woven aromas and flavors of apricot and ripe white raspberry, pickled ginger, white blossoms and salted Marcona almond, allowing them to expand through to the mineral-laced finish.

title: Berta Distillery - Tre Soli Grappa di Nebbiolo - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Berta Distillerie Tre Soli Tre Grappa di Nebbiolo originates from Italy, within the northwest region of Piedmont in the subregion of Monferrato. Founded in 1947 by Paolo Berta in the hillside village of Mombaruzzo, the historic family distillery built a world renowned reputation through premium artisanal distillation. Today, the multi generational family estate continues to craft exceptional spirits, utilizing fresh pomace sourced from celebrated regional vineyards to produce this flagship aged grappa.

Spirit Description

This premium aged grappa displays an alluring amber appearance with luminous golden reflections in the glass. The sensory profile opens with an expressive, complex nose dominated by ripe blackcurrant, apricot, and marasca cherry, complemented by notes of sweet vanilla, cacao, and toasted oak. On the palate, the body is broad, velvety, and exceptionally harmonious, delivering a rich balance of dark fruit, baking spices, hazelnut, and soft dried raisins. The finish is remarkably long, dry, and persistent, leaving a trailing warmth of refined wood spice and lingering Nebbiolo fruit depth. This artisanal spirit is aged for eight years in medium-toasted oak casks and is traditionally bottled at an alcohol by volume of 43%.

Food Pairing

The profound oak depth, dark fruit elegance, and velvety texture of this aged grappa make it a peerless after dinner digestif. It pairs magnificently with artisanal dark chocolate, roasted hazelnuts, or traditional Piedmontese gianduja desserts. For a savoury match, it serves as an extraordinary companion to aged, crumbly cheeses such as Castelmagno or sharp Parmigiano Reggiano.

title: Don Julio Primavera Tequila
bodyHtml:
In 1942, Don Julio Gonzalez decided to establish his roots in Atotonilco El Alto, Mexico where he acquired his Distillery “La Primavera”. Tequila Don Julio Primavera honors our late founder's legacy as he believed reposado tequila was tequila at its finest. 

This deliciously smooth expression takes Tequila Don Julio's traditional Reposado and finishes it in a highly coveted European cask, which previously held wine infused with macerated orange peel, for a silky, sophisticated, light citrus taste. “Primavera” is best enjoyed on the rocks with an orange wheel or in our signature drink, the Primavera Sunset.

title: Metaxa 12 Star Brandy
bodyHtml:
Medium amber; showing aromas of orange peel, honey comb, toffee, chocolate and dried flowers; the palate is lively and balanced with flavours of honeyed fruit, figs, raisins, prunes, spice and toasted oak on the long finish.

Enjoy neat or with a cube of ice.

title: De Kuyper Peachtree Schnapps
bodyHtml: Clear, light spirit, bursting with the taste of tree-ripe peaches. Great neat, iced or in a cocktail.

title: Cabin Brewing Sunshine Rain IPA - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Sunshine Rain is the quintessential West Coast IPA from Calgary’s Cabin Brewing Company. It was crafted to strike the perfect balance between the bold, aromatic hop profiles of the Pacific Northwest and a clean, refreshing drinkability. The name reflects the duality of the style, bright, sunny citrus notes paired with a crisp, refreshing rain of bitterness. It has become a staple for hop lovers who appreciate a modern take on a classic style that emphasizes aroma and clarity.

Beer Description

This West Coast IPA pours a brilliant, clear golden-straw color with a fluffy, persistent white head and excellent lacy retention.

Aroma: It features a vibrant and punchy nose led by distinct notes of zesty grapefruit, resinous pine, and a medley of tropical fruits like pineapple and mango.

Palate: The flavor is crisp and assertive. A light, crackery malt base provides just enough support for waves of citrus and dank hop character. It finishes bone-dry with a firm, lingering bitterness that is clean rather than astringent.

Profile: It has an ABV of 6.7% and a moderate-to-high bitterness, staying true to its West Coast roots while remaining remarkably refreshing.

Technical Notes: Brewed with a focused selection of premium base malts to ensure a light body. It is heavily hopped with classic varieties specifically Citra, Simcoe, and Mosaic to achieve its complex layering of fruit, citrus, and pine.

title: Bushmills 12 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
This refined age-stated single malt originates from the village of Bushmills in County Antrim, Northern Ireland, crafted at the historic Old Bushmills Distillery. Serving as the bridge between the vibrant 10 Year Old and the triple-wood 16 Year Old, Bushmills 12 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey is made from 100% unpeated malted barley, triple-distilled in traditional copper pot stills using water drawn from Saint Columb’s Rill. The whiskey matures for a minimum of 11 years separately in seasoned ex-bourbon barrels and Spanish Oloroso sherry butts before being married together and transferred into Marsala wine casks (sweet Sicilian fortified wine casks) for a final finishing period of 6 to 12 months. It is bottled at 80 proof (40.0% ABV).

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a rich amber-gold hue with warm bronze reflections and graceful, medium tears along the glass. On the nose, it is luscious, sweet, and heavily perfumed with dark fruit, opening with aromas of dried apricots, spiced dates, caramelized apples, and dark honey, supported by undertones of toasted hazelnut, vanilla cream, and a distinctive candied nutty note from the Marsala wood. On the palate, the triple distillation delivers a characteristically silky, rounded, and coating mouthfeel. An initial rush of sweet golden raisins, poached pear, and brown sugar transitions into mid-palate layers of milk chocolate, baking spices (nutmeg, clove, and cinnamon), and toasted almond paste. The Marsala cask finish adds caramelized stone fruit depth and sweet fortified wine nuances without overpowering the crisp malt backbone. The finish is medium-to-long, warm, and mellow, trailing off with lingering impressions of dried fruit compote, honeyed oak, cocoa dust, and soft baking spice.

title: Moet & Chandon Ice Imperial (NV)
bodyHtml:
From Moet & Chandon comes their Ice Imperial Champagne, and it's been crafted to be served over ice!

A fun and fruit-forward Champagne, it's all dressed and ready for any black tie events that may come its way.

title: Clos du Soleil Winemaker Series Pinot Gris 2021
bodyHtml:
The grapes for this Pinot Gris were grown on Clos du Soleil's organic-certified Whispered Secret Vineyard, a cooler site on the south side of the valley, ideal for flavour development while maintaining beautiful acidity.

A rich, ripe expression of Pinot Gris, on the nose this wine presents the taster with aromas of ripe nectarine skin, fresh pear juice and lemon zest.

On the palate the wine is dense with flavours of ripe nectarine, peach, pear and crisp apple, with a streak of stony minerality. It has a finegrained texture in the mouth, leading into a long, juicy finish of stone-fruit flavours complemented with zingy citrus acidity.

title: Dewar's Double Double 27 Year Old - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Treat yourself to the unparalleled experience of Dewar's Double Double 27-Year-Old Scotch Whisky, skillfully crafted using a unique four-stage ageing process that ensures ultimate smoothness. This exceptional blend is finished in Palo Cortado sherry casks, further enhancing its complexity and charm.


The Dewar's Double Double 27-Year-Old captivates with its inviting array of heady, aromatic floral notes, perfectly accompanied by honeyed fruits and a hint of subtle spice. The signature silky smooth finish lingers on the palate, leaving you with a truly memorable whisky encounter.

Elevate your whisky collection with this exquisite blend, which showcases the art of masterful ageing and the remarkable influence of Palo Cortado sherry casks. Don't miss the opportunity to explore the enchanting world of Dewar's Double Double 27-Year-Old and indulge in a taste of whisky perfection.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Fenocchio Barolo Castellero 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Fenocchio has a small parcel of 0.8 hectares in this exceptional cru located near the town of Barolo. The soils in the western exposed vineyard are marl and tuff with a high percentage of sand making for excellent drainage. The Nebbiolo Michet and Lampia vines there average 30 years of age.

Excellent with red meats, game and aged cheeses. As well as with many rich international dishes.

title: Fenocchio Langhe Nebbiolo 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine is from Italy, originating in the Tuscany region, specifically the Rosso di Montalcino DOC. Caparzo is one of the 30 historical wineries in Montalcino, established in the late 1960s. The winery's name is thought to originate from Ca' Pazzo, meaning 'House of the Crazy,' as seen in ancient maps. A key strength of Caparzo is that it possesses vineyards in nearly all of Montalcino's best areas, which allows the estate to draw the best from every vintage. The estate's philosophy is centred on maintaining faith with the traditions of Brunello and the local terroirs, while also embracing a creative spirit and dedication to innovation to ensure the highest quality. In 1977, Caparzo was a pioneer in Montalcino, introducing the concept of Cru by vinifying grapes from the La Casa vineyard separately.

Wine Description

The Caparzo Rosso di Montalcino 2024 is an intense ruby red in color. It is made from 100% Sangiovese grapes. The bouquet is complex and persistent, with an expressive nose that is reminiscent of violets, raspberries, and pomegranates. Some primary taste impressions noted are very young cherries, sweet licorice, and cedar.

On the palate, the wine is described as warm, dry, generous (or rich), and well-balanced. It has a medium body, silky tannins, and lively acidity. Stylistically, it is characterised as strong, spicy, and earthy, with perceptible tannins and acidity. The wine is structured to perfectly embody the Caparzo philosophy of technical perfection with a great sense of terroir. The wine is aged for four to eight months in a combination of stainless steel and oak wood, followed by a minimum of three months in the bottle. The optimal drinking window is suggested for several years of aging (four to eight) for those with patience, but it can also be enjoyed in its youth.

Food Pairing

This Rosso di Montalcino is versatile and pairs well with a variety of dishes. Suggested pairings include red meats, pasta dishes with sauce, legume-based soups, and aged cheeses. It is also recommended with hearty vegetable dishes and grilled meat.

This pairing highlights the wine's depth and character.

title: Marchese Antinori Brut Rose Franciacorta
bodyHtml:
The Antinori family has been committed to the art of winemaking for over six centuries since 1385, when Giovanni di Piero Antinori became a member of the “Arte Fiorentina dei Vinattieri,” the Florentine Winemakers’ Guild.

While not losing the typical elegance of Franciacorta, this rose also has a structure that makes it ideal for meals as well as for aperitifs. Onion skin pink with lot of tiny bubbles. Red currant, raspberry, wild strawberry, pastry and roses water on the nose. Dry, mouth-filling and refreshing.

title: Mirabeau Rose Gin
bodyHtml:
This beautiful pale pink Dry Gin was inspired by the abundance of botanicals growing wild on their wine estate near Saint Tropez and living in an area steeped in the history of world-famous perfume trade, they set out on a new journey to create a truly unique and original gin.

At its core Mirabeau Gin is a classic Dry Gin. Mirabeau has used a 100% grape-based neutral spirit which adds roundness and subtle fruitiness to the palate. Lemons and Coriander add layers of fresh citrus character. Orris and Angelica roots impart floral and earthy tones respectively. Rose Petals, Lavender and Jasmine are used sparingly to bring a variety of floral tones. Finally, Bay, Thyme and Rosemary add a finely balanced herbaceous character to the blend.

title: Montes Wings Carmenere 2021
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates in Chile, specifically from the Colchagua Valley region and the Apalta sub-region. Viña Montes was founded in 1988 by four friends: Aurelio Montes (Chief Winemaker), Douglas Murray, Alfredo Vidaurre, and Pedro Grand. The winery has gained international recognition for the quality and consistency of its products, priding itself on using sustainable viticultural practices and a commitment to preserving the environment.

Wine Description

The intense nose reveals aromas of black fruit, such as blackberry and blueberry, accompanied by pleasant spice notes of bell pepper and black pepper. Sweet notes from the French oak barrels add further complexity. On the palate, the wine is rounded, showing extreme smoothness and potency. Stylistic notes include 'lively acidity' and 'energy and tension' on the palate. It is a full-bodied wine that remains fresh and balanced, culminating in a very long, pleasant finish.

Accolades

  • "Wine Spectator - 93 points"

  • "Wine Advocate - 93 points"

  • "Wine Enthusiast - 91 points"

Food Pairing

Red meats, pork tenderloin with roasted beets and cranberries, duck confit or magret, stuffed pasta with pumpkin, or aged goat cheese with figs.

title: Pio Cesare Barbera D'Alba 2023
bodyHtml:
Pio Cesare has been producing wine for more than 100 years and through generations. The tradition began in 1881, when Pio Cesare started gathering grapes in his vineyards and purchasing those of some selected and reliable farmers in the hills of Barolo and Barbaresco districts.

At Pio Cesare, there has always been a conviction that great wine can come only from the finest grapes and the winery's output has always been limited through adherence to the highest standards.

The Barbera grapes grown in the Barolo area give full structure, plummy and complex flavor, with spicy and ripe fruit, blackberry aroma and a hint of toasted tobacco. It ages quite well. Vinous, this classic Barbera has a very well balanced acidity and really represents the traditional character of the Barbera grape.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Linkwood Single Malt 25 Year Old 'Distillery Labels'
bodyHtml: This 15 year old single malt is from the Linkwood Distillery in Speyside and bottled by Gordon & MacPhail. Linkwood Distillery was founded in 1821 by Peter Brown when whisky distillation was still illegal in Scotland. Production began in 1825, after Glenlivet, which claims to be the first legal distillery, making Linkwood arguably the country's second legal distillery. Most of the whisky produced at the Linkwood distillery is used in blends, most notably Johnnie Walker and White Horse. 46% alc./vol.

title: Cesare Bussolo Fossati Barolo - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Cesare Bussolo, a La Morra native, and Roberto Voerzio’s right-hand man since 2007 has made an impeccable start making wine under his own label.

As a child, Cesare played with his sister among the vines in the vineyard he now owns; a beautiful west-facing site called Santa Lucia. After wine school in Alba, which he graduated in 1998, Cesare worked for local traditionalists Bovio for seven years.  Along the way to Barolo Cesare is struck by Roberto Voerzio, in the small village of La Morra, where the simple idea of the Cru is crucial and the finesse dominates the structure and power. The two work together, day by day, and Cesare absorbs as much as he can from Voerzio: instilling him with a deep care of the vineyard and respect for the natural environment.  Extremely low yield per plant, a very light touch in the cellar, and respect to the container (barrique or big barrel, new or used).

There’s a beautiful elegance and perfume to the scent & flavours, fruit weight builds on the palate while maintaining a sense of sophistication. Texturally the tannins are fine, building to have impact along the full length of the palate.

title: Aberlour 16 Year Old (Single Cask Selection 2005 Sherry Hogshead)
bodyHtml:
Aberlour 16 Year Old Single Cask Selection 2005 Sherry Hogshead is a whisky of exceptional character and distinction. Crafted with care in the heart of Speyside, Scotland, this limited edition release showcases the influence of a sherry hogshead cask in maturing the spirit to perfection. With a deep amber color, it exudes an enticing aroma of rich dried fruits, warm spices, and a hint of oak. On the palate, flavors of luscious dark chocolate, dried apricots, and sweet toffee interplay harmoniously, complemented by a velvety smooth texture. The finish is long, satisfying, and leaves a lingering impression of sophistication.

Aberlour 16 Year Old Single Cask Selection is a true treasure for whisky enthusiasts seeking a sublime and unforgettable experience. Only 252 bottles.

title: Mar Azul Coconut Tequila
bodyHtml:
Mar Azul is a family owned company based in San Antonio, Texas who understand what it takes to make the perfect Tequila. They focus on the traditional way of making their Tequila. Their Blue Weber Agave comes directly from the State of Jalisco, and they still use the traditional technique to create the unique and flavorful Tequila called Mar Azul.

Mar Azul Coconut Tequila is handmade using only the best coconuts from the Mexican tropics, rich in nutrients and of superior quality. They allow, thanks to Mara Azul's recipes, to give them the warm aromatic beauty and the abundantly generous flavor of coconut.

With its particularly tropical aroma, its soft and light tones of honey will stand out, transporting you to your favorite long-awaited beach...

A timeless flavor regardless of the seasons and emotions.

Distinguished alone or accompanied.

title: Mar Azul Chocolate Tequila
bodyHtml:
Mar Azul is a family owned company based in San Antonio, Texas who understand what it takes to make the perfect Tequila. They focus on the traditional way of making their Tequila. Their Blue Weber Agave comes directly from the State of Jalisco, and they still use the traditional technique to create the unique and flavorful Tequila called Mar Azul.

Mar Azul Chocolate Tequila is a family treasure and its magic comes from choosing and using the best cocoa seeds, grown in the southwest region of Oaxaca, Mexico.

It is in that climate that thanks to the dedication of their ancestral growers, they give Mar Azul the richness of their grains with their great body and aroma, complete and strong: Admire the presence of chocolate.

On the palate it leaves a generous and rich taste of bitter, superb chocolate. The perfect invitation for a lasting finish, thanks to Tequila, warm and soft.

title: Mar Azul Banana Tequila
bodyHtml:
Mar Azul is a family owned company based in San Antonio, Texas who understand what it takes to make the perfect Tequila. They focus on the traditional way of making their Tequila. Their Blue Weber Agave comes directly from the State of Jalisco, and they still use the traditional technique to create the unique and flavorful Tequila called Mar Azul.

Mar Azul Banana Tequila is made in order to perfect its splendid creamy flavor using a mixture of bananas grown for this purpose and organically fertilized, guaranteeing its unique flavor.

As a result of the search for its originality, Mar Azul obtained the exact aroma, tropical and fresh, with an insightful and striking flavor. When you try it, you will find a durable, warm and soft finish on the palate. As fresh as the memory of childhood but seasoned with the firmness of the agave.

Their fruits are never exposed to ethanol gas to induce ripening.

title: Mar Azul Almond Tequila
bodyHtml:
Mar Azul is a family owned company based in San Antonio, Texas who understand what it takes to make the perfect Tequila. They focus on the traditional way of making their Tequila. Their Blue Weber Agave comes directly from the State of Jalisco, and they still use the traditional technique to create the unique and flavorful Tequila called Mar Azul.

Mar Azul Tequila Almond demonstrates a firm refined obsession. To find its essence, it is made using a mixture of the best almonds from northern regions cultivated and brought together sustainably by organic farmers from Mexican soils.

Immediately its aromatic notes will vibrate: rich and elegant when mixed with agave and woods. An emotion that no palate should miss.

Your gift is a firm, durable, warm and soft finish.

title: Glen Garioch 17 Year Old 'The Renaissance' 3rd Chapter
bodyHtml:
One of the oldest of Scotland’s many, many distilleries, Glen Garioch can trace its roots all the way back to 1797. This beautiful 17 year old is the third release from their Renaissance range, matured in ex sherry and bourbon casks and bottled at 50.8%.

The nose opens with a nose of sweet honey, juicy citrus fruits and rich barley. The grains really play a background role, but they allow the bolder flavours to jump out. Candied orange peel, lemons and grapefruits add a nice tang, with a zesty liveliness to the. They are joined by chocolate and candyfloss, adding a lovely saccharine sweetness.

The palate is spicier, with white pepper, cinnamon and star of anise coming out. These go perfectly with the citrus fruits and the chocolate. The spice is warming and gives the fruits a lovely edge. Malted grains and oak wood add a depth to the dram, with a lovely elegant orchard note. These really allow the sweeter notes to develop and stop them from overwhelming the palate.

The finish is big and bold, with oranges and chocolate abounding.

title: Cedar Creek Rose 2025
bodyHtml: Made from estate Pinot Noir grapes, this wine smells like rhubarb pie with fine spice and earthy undertones. It has a hint of sweetness and is very well balanced with a mouthwatering finish.

title: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel - Mini 50 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Single barrel whiskey selected by the master distiller for its unique character. This is richer and bolder than the regular JD No. 7. Deep amber and fragrant with coconut, caramel, vanilla, and peach aromas. The palate is dry, intense and fruity and spicy oak flavours leading to a smooth, long finish.

Savour on its own.

title: Clydeside Stobcross Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Time, and the distiller’s skills have worked their magic. Three ingredients - water, malted barley, and yeast - have come together to create something new, crafted on The Clydeside. Stobcross, the road where our journey began.

This Clydeside Single Malt Whisky is produced using clear water from Loch Katrine, 100% Scottish barley and then matured in the finest Oak casks.

title: Talenti Brunello di Montalcino 2019
bodyHtml:
A selection of 100% sangiovese grapes grown in estate-owned vineyards located on the south-easterly and south-westerly slopes of Montalcino, at an altitude from 250 to 400 m MSL. The soils are made up of sandy loam, with clay and Galestro marl. The wine ages in 500-litre French oak tonneaux and 15/25-Hl Slavonian oak barrels for at least 24 months, followed by a period of ageing in bottle. 

The wine has a deep ruby red colour with garnet highlights, and an ample, slightly spicy bouquet. It is full, intense, smooth and velvety on the palate, with sweet, elegant tannins.

93 Points - James Suckling

This has aromas of ripe and dried berry fruit, praline, porcini and chili chocolate. Some salted olives, too. I like the interplay of savory and sweet fruit, with sleek tannins, fresh acidity and a medium body rendering this a very balanced and approachable Brunello.

title: Upper Bench Riesling 2022
bodyHtml:
This Riesling is beautifully clean, crisp and dry and is as versatile as they come - enjoy it as a patio sipper or pair with seafood, grilled meats or charcuterie. Riesling is also a surprisingly great pairing with our King Cole blue cheese.

On the nose, Granny Smith apple, pineapple, lemon meringue, whipped cream, and pear.  On the palate, bright acidity, Spartan apple, lemon, honey, and gooseberry.

title: Ramos Pinto 'Vinces' Very Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
Founded by Adriano Ramos Pinto in 1880, Casa Ramos Pinto soon made itself known for its innovative and pioneering strategy. Associated with quality bottled wines and with a cutting-edge strategy, this company is based on the modernisation of the selection, blending, and ageing circuits, on constant viticultural research, and on the special care that Adriano Ramos Pinto dedicated to the packaging and promotion of his wines. Ramos Pinto wines have thus become a benchmark for quality.

Vinces forms part of the motto of the House of Ramos Pinto, it means “you will win”. Right at the start, founder Adriano Ramos Pinto chose the Latin phrase IN HOC SIGNO VINCES – with this symbol, you will win – as a vision for prosperity. The launch of Vinces carries the legacy of its ancestors yet speaks of contemporary elegance. This very old Tawny Porto, with an average age of 100 years, comes from the family reserves. Aged in wooden casks, Vinces was perfected by Ana Rosas, great-niece of the founder and Master Blender at Ramos Pinto.

title: Fireball Cinnamon Whisky - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml:
The blending of smooth Canadian whisky and intense cinnamon flavour result in a bold shot that is fragrant with pronounced aromas of cinnamon and spice; on the palate the spicy flavours of cinnamon intermingle with caramel notes on a long, hot finish.

Serve well chilled. Great on its own, use in cocktails or apple desserts.

title: Marolo Grappa di Moscato Solera 6
bodyHtml:
The new Solera Grappas are fruit of the continuous research, which has always distinguished Marolo, for the most particular distillation techniques and methods, from all over the world but rigorously applied to grappas from native vines, obtained from fresh pomace, managed by hand through discontinuous distillation.

Golden color, the nose has aromas of white flowers and yellow pulp fruit. In the mouth, sensations of apricot, candied citrus and light notes of pear, complemented by nuances of rose and elderberry, with dried fruit and almond finish.

A rich and exciting distillate, where the vine of origin is always, and in any case, easy to identify, perfect with any type of dessert or as a sumptuous and always pleasant drink after meal.

title: Marolo Grappa di Barolo 15 Year Old
bodyHtml: The long aging gives to this grappa a unique sensory mark. Its extremely deep colour announces the aromatic strength and the smoothness that you'll find during the tasting. It is a dry and severe grappa, without mawkish notes; the aromatic profile is dominated by spices (clove, pepper, liquorice, tobacco, nutmeg, anice ) and from the scent given by the barrel. The sensations linked to the pomace used for this grappa didn't disappear along the years, but they match with prune, candied and dry fruit like nuts and almond. The result is extremely clean and pleasant.

title: Dolce & Gabbana Donnafugata Rosa Sicilia Rosato 2024
bodyHtml: This rose is a blend of Nerello Mascalese and the ancient variety Nocera. It's bright, juicy and floral, with bold red fruit, citrus, peach, and subtle spice. The volcanic soils of Sicily shine through in the smoke-edged minerality. Tangy, refreshing and food-friendly, it's perfect for whatever's on your plate.

title: Grappa Paternum Barricata
bodyHtml:
Grappa Paternum Barricata is an irresistible Italian spirit that will captivate your senses and leave you craving for more. Crafted with utmost care and passion, this aged grappa is a true masterpiece. Made from the finest grape pomace and carefully distilled in copper stills, it undergoes a transformative journey in oak barrels, where it acquires its remarkable character.

The result is a rich and complex grappa with enticing aromas of dried fruit, toasted wood, and a touch of vanilla. With a smooth and velvety texture, Grappa Paternum Barricata offers a harmonious blend of flavors that will transport you to the heart of Italy with every sip. Indulge in this extraordinary spirit and experience the artistry of Italian grappa at its finest.

title: R. Jelinek Silver Label Triple Distilled Kosher Slivovitz
bodyHtml: A high-quality, three times distilled plum brandy, made the same way for centuries. Kosher for Passover Silver Slivovitz, made of the best well-matured plums, has a smooth, slightly almond taste.

title: R. Jelinek Plum Brandy Kosher Slivovitz
bodyHtml: Slivovitz (plum brandy) is produced from fully matured fruit grown in the plum region of Bohemia. This triple distilled product, made from the Jelinek firm's own recipe, ranks among the premium quality alcoholic beverages worldwide. The bouquet of this golden Slivovitz reminds one of cognac, but it tastes like very fine plums. The unique harmonious flavor and the golden color are acquired by Slivovitz because Limousin oak shavings are embedded in the spirit for ten years.

title: R. Jelinek Gold Aged 10 Years Kosher Slivovitz
bodyHtml:
This 10-year-old gold kosher slivovitz represents the continuation of gold slivovitz production in Vizovice. The idea of making gold slivovitz first came about as a result of the Jelínek brothers’ experience with brandy production, which they started in 1923 in collaboration with the French cognac maker Denis Mounié.

The 10 years it spends ageing in oak casks give it its gold colour, an aroma close to that of cognac, and a harmonious fruity flavour with a distinctive woody undertone.

Only the highest-quality hand-harvested plums are used for production. This is followed by the triple distillation of a ripe plum mash under the supervision of a representative of the Jewish Orthodox Union. The spirit is then aged for ten years under carefully controlled conditions, in a range of temperatures and with alternating exposure to air, which affects the resulting colour, flavour, and aroma. Its bottling is also supervised by a rabbi.

title: Mi Familia Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Mi Familia Flores Extra Añejo Tequila is a luxury aged spirit originating from Amatitán in the Valles (Lowlands) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the Selecto de Amatitán distillery (NOM 1459), the spirit is produced in small batches by the Flores family. Designed to highlight the harmony between rich oak influence and sweet cooked agave, this expression undergoes an extended maturation process that yields a deep, dessert-like sipping tequila.

Spirit Description

Mi Familia Extra Añejo is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave harvested from the lowland fields of Jalisco. The agaves are cooked in autoclaves, fermented in stainless steel tanks, and double-distilled in copper-lined stills. The spirit is then aged for a minimum of 36 months (3 years) in charred American white oak barrels, developing its characteristic rich amber tone and smooth profile.

  • Colour: Deep golden amber to reddish-mahogany with bright copper highlights.

  • Aroma: Soft, sweet, and dessert-forward. The nose opens with rich caramel, butterscotch, vanilla bean, and toasted oak, followed by dark chocolate, dried fruit, subtle cinnamon spice, and a hint of citrus peel.

  • Palate: Extremely smooth, lush, and velvety on the entry. Upfront flavors of cooked agave, brown sugar, toffee, and sweet vanilla give way to dark chocolate, roasted nuts, black cherry, and baking spices like nutmeg and cinnamon.

  • Body: Full-bodied with an oily, coating viscosity that delivers a rich, tongue-coating mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and lingering, closing with notes of sweet butterscotch, toasted oak, mild black pepper, and subtle fruit sweetness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Maker's Mark - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Use of red winter wheat instead of rye produces a noticeably sweeter, less bitter, less harsh whisky. Pours rich golden amber colour with an enticing nose of butterscotch and vanilla bean; the palate is smooth with delectable toffee and milk chocolate flavour followed by a lightly spiced finish. Serve over ice with chilli.

title: Meyer Family Pinot Noir Okanagan Valley 2023
bodyHtml:
Meyer Family Vineyards have been crafting wines in the Okanagan Valley since 2006. Voted one of the top wineries in Canada, they focus on small lot productions of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir drawing heavily from Burgundian influences.

Aromas of ripe dark cherries, autumn leaves and subtle smoke and oak notes. Those aromas carry onto the broad and silky smooth palate that is enlivened by lively acidity and dusty tannins. A long pleasing finish. Top-notch, and top value, classy wine. Pair this Pinot Noir with any salmon dish, baked, grilled, or fried. It would also pair nicely with seafood.

title: Chicken Cock Chanticleer Cognac Barrel Finish Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Chicken Cock Whiskey – known as “The Famous Old Brand” – has released Chicken Cock Chanticleer, a Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey finished in fine French Cognac barrels.

Chicken Cock Whiskey rose to fame as the house whiskey at The Cotton Club, one of Prohibition’s most legendary speakeasies. The brand managed to survive Prohibition by swiftly moving production around and smuggling bottles into the United States in tin cans.

After Prohibition, Chicken Cock enjoyed a resurgence before a distillery fire just after World War II put it out of business. In 2012, Matti Anttila rediscovered the brand and set out to resurrect it to its Prohibition-era glory. Since then, the team has introduced a flagship KY Straight Bourbon and KY Straight Rye Whiskey, made in partnership with Bardstown Bourbon Company as part of its collaborative distilling program, along with several other highly sought after limited-releases.

Vibrant notes of ripened peaches, delicate sweet cream, and succulent honey on the nose. Tannic bursts of vanilla and cherry complimented by softened plums, candied dates, and banana flambe. Finishes with hot caramelized sugar, melted butter, and fresh citrus zest.

title: Caballito Cerrero Azul Anejo 48
bodyHtml:
The Caballito Cerrero Azul Anejo is a destilado de agave produced by the renowned Tequila brand founded by Alfonso Jimenez Rosales in Amatitan, Jalisco. This expression is crafted using agaves grown exclusively on the family's land, including maguey Azul (Agave tequilana) and maguey Chato (Agave angustifolia). It has been aged for an impressive five years in American White Oak barrels.

The aroma of this anejo tequila reveals delightful notes of pear, peach, and floral tones. It offers a silky creme caramel profile with subtle hints of cinnamon, nutmeg, oak, and agave that remain prominent. The palate experiences a wave of perfume-like fruit and floral flavors, followed by mild pepper, vanilla, and a slight bitterness on the back of the tongue. It presents a harmonious blend of sweet and savory notes. The finish is long-lasting, warming, and characterized by lingering pepper and spices. It concludes with a slightly musty bitterness, providing a unique and memorable ending to the tasting experience.

title: Louis Michel & Fils Chablis Grand Cru Vaudesir 2019
bodyHtml:
The Michel family has been cultivating their passion for tradition and the Chablis terroir since 1850. In the mid-20th century, the family stopped making wine in wooden barrels in favor of stainless steel tanks to create clean, pure, and precise Chablis without adding artificial woody flavors. Through this philosophy, combined with limited yields inspired by organic wine-growing techniques, the Domaine has developed a worldwide reputation for fine winemaking in stainless steel tanks. A firmly-rooted sense of excellence is passed down from generation to generation.

Gourmand, Grand Cru Vaudesir nose reveals notes of rhubarb and acacia flower. Fine and elegant in the mouth, with buttery, brioche aromas, and a dominant hint of coconut.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Chablis Grand Cru Vaudesir wafts from the glass with aromas of green apple, crisp apricot, mandarin, fresh pastry and iodine. Full-bodied, satiny and layered, it's textural and enveloping, with a concentrated core of fruit and a long, perfumed finish. This has turned out brilliantly.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

A lean and steely white, with moderate apple and earth flavors and touches of herbs and graphite for grace notes. Puts on some weight midpalate, before converging on the stony finish.

title: Caballito Cerrero Chato Anejo 48
bodyHtml:
Caballito Cerrero is a unique agave spirit, a distillery with a rebellious streak. Although their agave spirits often fit the criteria to be called tequila they are instead a "destilade de agave".

Chato is an agave variety similar to espadin, which is used in a lot of mezcal expressions. 

Aged 14 months in ex-bourbon casks, this is a layered, complex agave spirit - very refined.

Caballito Cerrero was founded in 1950 by Don Alfonso Jiménez Rosales who had previously founded Herradura. So the story goes, after falling out over a family dispute Don Alfonso started Caballito Cerrero which means 'the one that doesn't need horseshoes,' a not-so-subtle reference to Herradura which translates to "horseshoe". The agave spirit is produced at the Santa Rita factory, which was built in 1873 by Don Alfonso's father-in-law.

title: Caballito Cerrero Chato Reposado 46
bodyHtml:
The Caballito Cerrero Chato Reposado 46 is a distinct offering from the Caballito Cerrero brand. It is crafted using maguey Chato, which refers to the agave Angustifolia variety, often related to or synonymous with maguey Espadin.

The color of this reposado is a light straw hue, considering its 9-month aging period. It appears oily in the glass, with long-lasting legs/tears. The aroma is delightful, showcasing strong agave notes and hints of butter and pepper. It presents a rich and characterful bouquet. The palate experiences a full-bodied agave flavor complemented by buttery sweetness. It offers a more intriguing taste profile than the tequilana weber (el azul) variety, with subtle hints of nuts and citrus. The finish is marked by pepper notes, warm and dark sweetness, and a medium-long duration. It provides a pleasant and smooth conclusion, combining refinement with a bold character.

title: Amrut Intermediate Sherry Single Malt Whisky Cask Strength
bodyHtml:
According to Indian Mythology, when Gods and Rakshasas – the demons – churned the oceans using the mountain Meru as a churner, a golden pot sprang out containing the Elixir of Life. That was called the “Amrut”. The great founders of the distillery aptly named it Amrut Distilleries.

Amrut Intermediate Sherry Single Malt Whisky is a product of many years research to produce whiskies matching world standards. The whisky is made from selected Indian barley grown at the feet of the Himalayas, nurtured by the waters flowing there and cultivated by old and traditional agricultural practises. It is carefully mashed and distilled in small batches to preserve the natural aroma and matured in oak barrels in a unique tropical condition, at an altitude of 3,000 feet above sea level at Bangalore, the garden city of India. This exclusive bottling of Amrut Cask Strength Single Malt offers the connoisseur the rare opportunity to sample this Treasure of India

To retain the natural characteristics of this oak aged Indian Malt Whisky, they do not chill filter and it comes straight from the barrel in its natural colour.

New make spirit was matured in the traditional way in Virgin/ Ex Bourbon casks and is then transferred into Spanish Ex-Oloroso Sherry Butts wherein it matures for a year more gaining an added sherry finish. The finishing touch is thus lent by a further period of maturation in ex-bourbon casks. The results is an essay in elegance with subdued sherry notes that bears the tell-tale Amrut Signature of quality and innovation—a worthy successor to the much acclaimed Amrut Fusion and Amrut Double Cask.

title: Amrut Portonova Indian Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Amrut Portonova is an un-peated single malt whisky matured initially in a combination of new American oak and ex-bourbon barrels then transferred to once-used port pipes, imported from Portugal and finally back to ex-bourbon casks.

It is aptly names as Portonova as there is a town called Parangipettai (Portonovo) on the east coast of India, in the southern state of Tamil Nadu, a territory that was under Portuguese control from the 16th to the 18th century.

title: Fontanabianca Langhe Arneis 2022
bodyHtml:
A 100% Arneis from a Domaine that has been hailed by the international press. It is an elegant and floral wine.

The bouquet offers aromas of fruit and white flowers nuanced by notes of acacia honey, quince and dried fruit. Very nice freshness on the palate, it starts off lively and evolves on a smooth and delicious mid-palate. Superb minerality!

title: Leroux Triple Sec
bodyHtml:
The Leroux family of distillers dates back over 100 years. Its products originated in belgium but are today produced in the US. They are made with the finest natural ingredients and the entire line is certified kosher, a unique point of differentiation.

Triple sec (meaning triple distilled) is a strong sweet and colorless orange flavored liqueur. It is made from the dried peel of oranges found on curacao an island in the caribbean. This is an indispensable component in every bar.

title: Remy Martin Louis XIII 'Time Collection' - Tribute to City of Lights 1900
bodyHtml:
The Louis XIII City of Lights – 1900 special edition is presented in a limited series of 2,000 numbered decanters. The decanter is based on the distinctive design, inspired by a 16th-century flask uncovered from the site of the Battle of Jarnac and later owned by Louis XIII founder Paul-Emile Rémy Martin.  1900 is the second edition in our exclusive Time Collection, a series of limited-edition Louis XIII decanters commemorating the year that Louis XIII cognac was unveiled at the famous Paris World Fair.

Handcrafted by skilled artisans, the City of Lights – 1900 decanter features 13 dentelle spikes rather than the usual 10, seven fleur-de-lys in 18ct gold, and a central medallion. A limited-edition stopper takes the form of an upturned decanter and incorporates NFC technology that allows you to register your decanter with the Louis XIII Society and receive a unique numbered medal minted by the Monnaie de Paris.

The cognac inside our limited-edition Tribute to City of Lights – 1900 decanter is made from a unique blend of the finest and most precious eaux-de-vie from grapes grown in the exceptional terroir of Cognac Grande Champagne. The specially selected eaux-de-vie are aged slowly in Limousin oak casks called tierçons before being expertly blended to create our signature cognac. Containing aged eaux-de-vie, each carefully watched by generations of Cellar Master, every drop of LOUIS XIII cognac represents decades of craftsmanship and know-how, resulting in a unique taste of time that will be similar in the next century.

title: Little Engine Elevation Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' white wine originates from Canada, within the prestigious Naramata Bench sub-g.I. appellation in the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia. Produced by Little Engine Wines a ultra-premium boutique winery dedicated to Burgundian varietal mastery this bottling highlights the winery’s multi-tiered quality hierarchy, where the Elevation series reflects heightened structural tension, vineyard focus, and aging potential. Sourced from estate and choice partner vineyard blocks rooted in deep glacial silt, gravel, and clay-marl terraces overlooking Okanagan Lake, the vines benefit from a unique northern continental microclimate. Warm summer days and long daylight hours are balanced by cool breezes blowing off the deep glacial lake, enabling Chardonnay to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining a razor-sharp natural acidity and intense mineral drive.

Wine Description

Little Engine Elevation Chardonnay presents a luminous, pale straw-gold color in the glass with bright platinum and subtle emerald reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an energetic, precise, and sophisticated portrait of Naramata Bench terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of fresh Anjou pear, white peach, lemon curd, and green apple, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of roasted hazelnut, white flowers, lemon verbena, crushed chalk, and a subtle line of flinty stone minerality balanced by delicate toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of tart orchard fruit, citrus zest, and salted melon. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly cuts across its mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by a tactile, creamy texture gained from traditional lees contact that carries into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of toasted brioche, lemon oil, and lingering chalk.

title: Little Engine Gold Merlot 2020
bodyHtml: A concentrated and fruit forward nose of raspberry, huckleberry and warm bramble fruit welcomes you in. The florality of our Merlot is part of its signature and you’ll also find notes of cured meats and anise seed. The palate is lifted and bright showcasing floral notes, cranberry and currants with a herbal finish.

title: San Polino Brunello di Montalcino 2017
bodyHtml:
The history of San Polino goes back at least 1,000 years to when the gravel road that runs down past the farmhouse constituted the main road which connected the area of the Monte Amiata to Siena. It could be that the farmstead of San Polino was founded as early as in the 10th century, following the Barbaric invasions which had forced the inhabitants of the Etruscan city of Roselle to seek refuge in the protective areas of the rich and powerful Abbey of Sant’Antimo.

This Brunello di Montalcino comes from a lush loamy field on the northern slopes of Montalcino. Full-bodied and structured, it has been described in glowing terms as being fruity, opulent, corpulent, luxurious and delicious.

title: Dr. Loosen Urziger Wurzgarten Riesling Grosses Gewachs 2020
bodyHtml:
Erni Loosen has quickly established himself as one the premier GG producers in the Mosel Valley. This Urziger Wurzgarten GG is sourced from 100-year-old vines, is meticulously hand-picked, fermented bone dry from immaculate, botrytis-free fruit, and is fermented and aged in neutral oak, remaining on the lees for a full 12 months. Explosive aromas and flavors of ripe strawberries, fresh rhubarb, apricots and telltale baking spices.

Remarkable concentration and length, with a long, saline finish. Match it with a lightly seasoned veal chop, or mushroom risotto.

title: Yukon Artisan Gin
bodyHtml:
Yukon Artisan Gin is distilled in the Yukon and features a signature blend of botanicals. Over several years, they have refined the recipe which has resulted in an exceptionally smooth gin with a bold flavour profile.

Juniper envelops the palate with bright highlights of citrus derived from lemon and orange zest.

A subtle earthy spice on the finish establishes a well-balanced gin that is perfectly suited for a crisp winter evening or a beautiful summer day under the midnight sun.

title: Peyrassol Rose Le Clos Cotes De Provence 2025
bodyHtml:
With almost 800 years of existence, the Commanderie de Peyrassol is considered a landmark in the history of Provence. More than a winery, the Commanderie has thrived for centuries as a sanctuary for gathering travelers, all the while, holding true to its precious values of hospitality and conviviality.

With an extremely pale pink color, this emblematic cuvée cultivates elegance, finesse and concentration. Aromas of white cherry blossom, citrus and white fruits such as peach and pear. The fresh and generous palate immediately delivers a complexity typical of great wines. The aromas are gradually released and intermingle to offer all the expression of the grape varieties of Provence from their favorite terroirs. Built around the acidity of the fruit, very long on the palate, this wine is elegantly prolonged by bitterness and dosed salinity.

It offers a delicious accompaniment to a carpaccio of scallops with lime, braised prawns with Espelette pepper or grilled sea bream.

title: Poggio al Tesoro Vermentino 'Solosole' 2022
bodyHtml:
One of the Allegrini Group properties, Poggio al Tesoro is located in the prestigious area of Bolgheri, a premiere appellation situated in the upper part of Tuscany’s Maremma, south of Pisa and just two miles from the Tyrrhenian Sea. The estate consists of 173 acres divided into three vineyard lots: via Bolgherese, Le Grottine, and Le Sondraie. The perfect quantity of sunlight throughout the year, the proximity to the sea, and the uniqueness of Bolgheri’s terroir are reflected in the style of Poggio al Tesoro’s wines; ripeness, muscular body, and richness are effortlessly combined with complexity and elegance.

The radiance of the Vermentino varietal reflects intensely in the aromas of Solosole, a white wine that captivates with its intense hints of flowers and unexpected yellow fruit. The palate has a medium body, is succulent and highly enjoyable. The development of the wine in the glass suggests that it has the potential to evolve for a few years.

title: Cosa Salvaje Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Cosa Salvaje Anejo is aged for a year in the most carefully kept oak barrels to produce this divine product. Bottled in this striking red bottle, this anejo has wonderfully round, cooked agave notes, followed by a complex profile of sweet fruits. Hints of maple, butterscotch, and vanilla can be found throughout this long finish. Founded by country music legend Tanya Tucker, Cosa Salvaje produces some of the best tequila around.

Cosa Salvaje translates to “wild thing”.  This references the spirit of youth and attempting to channel that feeling of freedom and excitement into adulthood. It is the aim of Cosa Salvaje’s goal is to rejuvenate that feeling within every customer.

title: Penderyn Icons of Wales 'The Headliner'
bodyHtml:
Ninth in the Penderyn Icons of Wales series, this one is named 'The Headliner' after David Llyod George (1863-1945), the only Welsh Prime Minister and creator of the Immature Spirits Act 1915, which specified whisky must be matured for a minimum of three years.

Hints of red berries, strawberries and cream; a hint of cranberries, light oak and vanilla on the nose. Rich, sweet flavours of dried fruits, salted caramel, floral honey and a spicy kick of black pepper with a tannin dryness.

title: Patron El Cielo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Distilled four times to unlock 100% naturally sweet and subtle agave flavors, Patron El Cielo delivers an incomparable taste with an undeniably light, fresh, and ultra-smooth finish. Crystal clear, it pours with aromas of cooked agave and sweet fruit. Fresh, with sweet citrus fruit and cooked agave flavours on the ultra-smooth palate. 

Enjoy over ice with a slice of orange.

title: Pio Cesare Chardonnay 'Piodilei' 2022
bodyHtml:
Pio Cesare Chardonnay Piodilei originates from the Langhe DOC in the Piedmont region of Northern Italy. The winery, founded in 1881, remains in the hands of the fifth generation of the Pio family, who maintain a winemaking philosophy of minimal intervention to express the true individuality of the terroir. Conceived as a tribute to the influential women of the family, Piodilei was first released in 1985 as a pioneering effort to produce a white wine with the complexity and aging potential typically reserved for the region’s great reds.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a vibrant pale straw yellow colour with golden nuances. The nose is intense and complex, featuring aromas of sliced apples, white pineapple, and lemon rind layered with floral notes of acacia and hints of spicy vanilla. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and creamy, yet it retains a bright, crunchy focus with flavours of citrus, crushed seashells, and a touch of almond cream. It is characterized by a refined balance of freshness and structure, concluding with a long, persistent finish marked by elegant oak and minerality.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 95 points

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 92 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 90 points

Food Pairing

The wine’s creamy texture and vibrant acidity make it an excellent companion for rich seafood dishes such as lobster, seared scallops with porcini cream, or turbot. It also pairs beautifully with roasted guinea fowl, veal chops, or butternut squash and sage ravioli. For a cheese course, consider serving it alongside Gruyère or other mature, hard cheeses.

title: Number Juan Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Grace under pressure. A unique double barrel blend of French & American oak barrels aged 9 months to perfection create a superior Reposado with body & character in a class of its own.

title: Por la Gente Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
Por La Gente Tequila Reposado earns an elegant golden color during 6 months of aging in charred American white oak barrels from Tennessee whiskey. Its aroma is bright and refreshing with an agave base and hints of spices, oak, and vanilla. An incredibly smooth fine agave flavor excites the palate with smooth and sweet touches, enriched with hints of honey, fruit, and flowers. A pleasant sipping tequila that could be enjoyed on the rocks or in a deliciously crafted cocktail. 

Por La Gente 100% Blue Agave Tequila is made from specially selected, fully ripened blue weber agave that is carefully distilled in small batches at Hacienda la Capilla, a distillery with over a century of traditional tequila making history.

All our tequilas are produced by hand and double distilled in copper pot stills from 100% natural ingredients.

title: Patron Silver Tequila - 200 ml
bodyHtml: A handcrafted, small-batch tequila that's made using the finest blue weber agave. Crystal clear with lively aromas of fresh agave and citrus. Smooth and sweet on the palate followed by flavours of citrus, melon and cucumber with light pepper and briny notes on a lengthy finish. Great on its own or use in premium cocktails.

title: Jameson IPA Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
The next great IPA is… a whiskey. Introducing Jameson IPA Edition – a whiskey that is finished in IPA beer barrels for floral, crisp, hoppy notes.

Like craft beer? Well, why not try a whiskey that incorporates all the great flavours of an IPA. We matured Jameson Irish whiskey in Irish Pale Ale-seasoned barrels, and the end result is something people (well the guys at our Midleton Distillery for one) are calling the next great IPA…

So, if you’re a fan of beer, of trying something new, or simply want to be the first to introduce your mates to their ‘new favourite drink’, try Jameson IPA today! 

It’s a whiskey with a little extra hop.

title: Jameson Cold Brew Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Jameson Cold Brew is a meeting of Arabica beans from Brazil and Colombia with triple-distilled Jameson Irish Whiskey. You may know the Irish Coffee, but this is different. Jameson Cold Brew is best served chilled, over ice, with cola and a twist of orange. Some cracking tunes in the background, optional. Enjoy the perfectly balanced combination of the smoothest whiskey with the richness of coffee.

Intense rich coffee bean aromatics combined with vanilla nuttiness of Jameson on the nose. The taste is distinctive, bold and natural with refreshing cold brew coffee impact followed by charred wood from the pot still whiskey contribution on palate. Full bodied, smooth and warming on mouthfeel.

title: Number Juan Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: Number Juan's agave is allowed to mature the full seven years before harvest. Using only the natural spring water from the great volcano Tequila, a double distillation process is administered, delivering a superior smoothness with all the taste of Mexico.

title: Chateau Montrose 2020
bodyHtml:
Chateau Montrose 2020 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the Saint Estephe subregion. Classified as a Second Growth in the historic 1855 classification, the estate was managed for over a century by the Charmolle family before being taken over by brothers Martin and Olivier Bouygues. The winery's operational philosophy relies on a nucleus of excellence across its unique 95-hectare single-block vineyard, which sits majestically overlooking the Gironde estuary. This unique location yields gravel terraces over deep clay that provide natural drainage and a moderated microclimate, driving a rigorous selection process at each stage of production to craft powerful yet refined wines.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep purple or dark ruby garnet appearance with an opaque core and possesses a full-bodied, deep, and layered structure with an elegantly muscular profile. The sensory profile is highly vibrant, precise, and complex, opening with an expressive nose of violets, lavender, cassis, blackberries, and chocolate, intricately woven with tobacco leaf, licorice, black truffle, undergrowth, and lead pencil shavings. On the opulent, concentrated, and racy palate, it delivers deep flavours of black fruit and spice, seamlessly balanced by a juicy acidity structure and an intense vein of graphite minerality. The finish is remarkably long, resonant, and authoritative, leaving a lingering trail of black tea, savory fruit, and smoky accents framed by beautifully powdery, silky tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: A masterful Left Bank blend consisting of 71% Cabernet Sauvignon, 23% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc, and 1% Petit Verdot.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its purity, energy, and impeccable balance, beautifully combining a serious and structured classic frame with a generous, modern fruit definition. It was matured for 18 months in 60% new French oak barrels.

  • ABV: 13.7%.

  • Organic Status: Reflecting the estate's conscientious vineyard management, this vintage is crafted entirely from organically grown grapes.

Food Pairing

The structural concentration, dense tannic architecture, and rich dark fruit profile of this Saint Estephe make it a perfect match for hearty, upscale gastronomy.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with heavy red meat dishes such as roasted beef, veal cutlets, pork loin, lamb chops, or savory roasted poultry.

  • Game: Suggested pairings include wild game dishes, roasted duck breast, stewed venison, or hearty braised recipes.

  • Heavy Fare: Complements general meat courses, grilled specialities, or complex vegetable dishes with a rich, savory profile.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 vintage in Saint Estephe is regarded as an epic and highly successful year, resulting in a monument that ranks among the great recent successes of the estate. The growing season presented a very challenging set of contrasting weather conditions, starting with a mild winter and an exceptionally warm spring that triggered early vine development. Heavy spring rainfall created high mildew pressure, while a severely dry summer brought two intense heatwaves in July and August. The winemaking team's skill in crucial human intervention, combined with the excellent water-regulating deep clay soils of the vineyard, successfully mitigated water stress and lower cluster yields, allowing the grapes to achieve flawless ripeness.

title: Bruichladdich The Organic 2011
bodyHtml:
Mid Coul farm, located close to Inverness in the north of Scotland, provided our first crop of Organic barley back in 2003. A progressive 2,755 acre estate, Mid Coul has a closed-loop fertility system that generates electricity using an anaerobic digestor while allowing almost all waste material to be recycled as fertiliser.

With no artificial input, barley is fertilised from the ground up and is therefore the purest expression of its terroir – the soil, the climate and geographical location of where it is grown.

Working in harmony with nature, this sustainable spirit is the future of whisky and an important expression in our Barley Provenance series.  The delicate floral spirit is matured in classic American oak, bringing a wonderful combination of creamy vanilla and fudge with honeyed citrus notes, ripe fruit and delicate spices.

A forthright expression from Bruichladdich's Barley Provenance Series, this 2011 vintage showcases the clarity of flavour from organically grown barley when distilled slowly in our tall narrow necked stills. Rich and creamy, with a luxurious mouthfeel.

title: Basil Hayden's Red Wine Cask Finish Bourbon
bodyHtml: A blend of the classic Basil Hayden high-rye mash bill and bourbon partially aged in Californian red wine casks, this special release is ripe with cherries & dried fruit, while also delivering characteristic bourbon flavors of vanilla and charred oak. Perfectly balanced, Basil Hayden Red Wine Cask Finish is layered & complex, yet approachable & inviting.

title: Antiquity Blue Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Antiquity Blue Whisky is a premium blended spirit from India, primarily produced in the state of Karnataka. Launched in 1992 by Shaw Wallace, the brand was later acquired by United Spirits Limited (USL), a subsidiary of the global beverage giant Diageo. This spirit is noted for its heritage, utilizing copper pot stills and blending traditions that date back decades.

Spirit Description

This Scotch style whisky is a sophisticated blend of finest Indian malts and rare Scotch grain spirits, specifically sourced from the historic Cameronbridge Distillery in Scotland. The blend is matured and mellowed in imported white oak casks to develop its distinctive character.

  • Colour: The whisky features a rich hue inspired by antique gold.

  • Aroma: It offers a delicate and inviting aroma with pronounced malty and woody notes, complemented by gentle hints of peat and heather.

  • Palate: The palate is smooth and velvety, delivering a complex texture where oak wood flavours impose themselves on a mellow malt base with subtle hints of spice.

  • Body: It is characterized by a full bodied and smooth mouthfeel.

  • Finish: The finish is long, velvety, and carved out in detail, leaving lingering notes of oak and spice.

  • ABV: Antiquity Blue is bottled at 42.8%.

title: Alfred Giraud Heritage French Malt Whiskey
bodyHtml:
An intense and complex, yet elegant whisky, HERITAGE showcases complex and balanced flavors, the result of masterful blending and aging.

Three non-peated French malt distillates that matured in different casks, mostly in extra old cognac casks with a proportion in new French Limousin and American oak casks are blended together, then matured in extra old cognac casks.

title: Kraken Gold Spiced Rum
bodyHtml:
The Kraken's deep and watery keep is said to be filled with the only thing it loves more than darkness - gold. Oh, and rum. Obviously. 

Made to satisfy the beast's desire for gold this Caribbean spiced rum from the Dominican Republic is aged for two years. Rich with flavours of molasses and caramel, hints of vanilla and cinnamon and plenty of secret spices. Serve neat, over ice, or in a cocktail. Pairs well with a chocolate almond torte.

title: Ridolfi Brunello Di Montalcino 'Donna Rebecca' 2017
bodyHtml:
In a land of ancient civilizations – full of art and history, that the landscape characterizes with oaks, chestnut trees, olive trees, pines, vineyards, among hills dotted with cypresses – in Florence in 1290, three Ridolfi families stem from an ancient Tuscan lineage. One of these – the Ridolfi of Borgo - originated the Sienese branch called "dalla Contrada" , where it had its own estates.

For centuries, priors, gonfaloniers and illustrious celebrities distinguished themselves under its aegis. Nowadays that very coat of arms shines on the labels of a great winery. Two estates - Ridolfi in Montalcino and Tenuta Rocchetto in Larciano - over 54 hectares of land, 21 of which are cultivated vineyards.

And a persistent research for excellence, heritage of a noble Tuscan taste that has been handed on unaltered through history.

On the nose intense aromas of dark cherry, plum and boise, dry roses and a hint of black pepper, vanilla and cloves. On the mouth a powerfull elegance and a velvety tannin guide us to an harmonius sip. Long fresh and enveloping finish.

Great with long cooked stews, game meat, great with hard cheeses.

title: Ridolfi Rosso di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
In a land of ancient civilizations – full of art and history, that the landscape characterizes with oaks, chestnut trees, olive trees, pines, vineyards, among hills dotted with cypresses – in Florence in 1290, three Ridolfi families stem from an ancient Tuscan lineage. One of these – the Ridolfi of Borgo - originated the Sienese branch called "dalla Contrada" , where it had its own estates.

For centuries, priors, gonfaloniers and illustrious celebrities distinguished themselves under its aegis. Nowadays that very coat of arms shines on the labels of a great winery. Two estates - Ridolfi in Montalcino and Tenuta Rocchetto in Larciano - over 54 hectares of land, 21 of which are cultivated vineyards.

And a persistent research for excellence, heritage of a noble Tuscan taste that has been handed on unaltered through history.

Red mature fruits, on the nose with pleasant spicy aromas . The mouth is elegant and well balanced with a pecuiar freshness. Good persistence.

Pair with meat-based sauces, poultry dishes, risotti.

title: Fontanabianca Barbaresco Bordini 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy's renowned Piedmont region, specifically within the subregion of Neive, Fontanabianca Barbaresco Bordini represents the pinnacle of traditional Nebbiolo winemaking. Founded by Franco Pola and now guided by Matteo Pola, Fontanabianca has cultivated a reputation for crafting expressive, terroir-driven wines with minimal intervention.

Wine Description

The wine displays a medium ruby red colour with slight orange tinges along the rim. The nose is fragrant and complex, featuring aromas of dark Marasca cherry, cassis, violet, orange peel, and crushed stone, layered with subtle accents of forest floor, new leather, and star anise. On the palate, it is savoury, mid-weight, and elegantly structured, delivering flavours of juicy cherry, peppercorn, and sappy herbs supported by a vibrant backbone of acidity. This medium-bodied 100% Nebbiolo culminates in a long, robust finish with fine-grained, persistent tannins and lingering spice notes.

title: Jermann Pinot Nero 'Red Angel on the Moonlight' 2021
bodyHtml:
Jermann 'Red Angel on the Moonlight' is a captivating Italian wine that captures the imagination with its poetic name and exquisite flavor profile. Hailing from Friuli-Venezia Giulia, this red blend showcases the artistry of the Jermann winery.

With its deep ruby color, the wine entices with aromas of ripe cherries, blackberries, and a touch of floral notes. On the palate, layers of complexity unfold, revealing flavors of dark fruits, hints of spice, and a velvety texture.

The wine's well-integrated tannins and vibrant acidity create a harmonious balance, leading to a long and enchanting finish.

title: De Martino Tres Volcanes Chardonnay 2019
bodyHtml:
93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Tres Volcanes Chardonnay was produced with grapes from Traiguen in Malleco from the vineyards of Francisco Baettig. It fermented in used barrels with indigenous yeasts and matured in a 5,000-liter oak foudre and five barrels for five months. It has an expressive nose of yellow fruit and a honeyed touch, varietal and with very integrated oak. It has moderate acidity and notable acidity and freshness, a round palate with clean and focused flavors. 5,644 bottles and 100 magnums were filled in August 2020.

title: Chateau Marsyas Red 2016
bodyHtml:
Deeply rooted in the Levant, the Johnny R. Saadé family translates its passion for vines through the creation of Chateau Marsyas in the southern part of the Bekaa valley, Lebanon. Renowned for its wine culture, this ancient land reveals itself to be an exceptional place for the creation of a great wine in line with the highest quality standards.

Chateau Marsyas Red wine has a dark robe with a purple reflection. The nose exhales black fruits and fine pepper, with a hint of liquorice.

On the palate, the wine develops with power and sweetness. Thick, the tannins are tight and perfectly coated, leaving the sensation of a spherical and sensual form. The fruit, finished with purity, accompanies the wine until its finale.

title: Chateau Marsyas Cabernet Sauvignon Satyr 2019
bodyHtml:
Satyr de Marsyas refers to the single variety cuvee of the Chateau Marsyas estate.

Marsyas, as a satyr, is a mythical being of antiquity who distinguished himself by his absolute devotion to the god of wine. Produced from younger vines of Cabernet Sauvignon, this cuvée stands out by the complete absence of oak barrel aging. It allows all interested amateurs to appreciate the quality of an easier to drink wine.

title: De Martino La Blanca Semillon 2020
bodyHtml:
De Martino La Blanca Semillon is a captivating white wine that showcases the excellence of Chilean winemaking. This single vineyard expression offers a unique and refreshing take on Semillon varietals. With its pale golden color, the wine entices with aromas of citrus blossoms, ripe tropical fruits, and delicate herbal notes.

On the palate, it delivers a harmonious combination of zesty acidity and luscious fruit flavors, including lemon, pineapple, and hints of passionfruit. The wine's crisp and vibrant character is balanced by a smooth, lingering finish. De Martino La Blanca Semillon is a testament to the winery's commitment to crafting exceptional wines that capture the essence of their terroir.

title: De Martino Las Olvidadas Old Vine Series 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Chile, specifically from the historic Guarilihue sector of the Itata Valley. Founded in 1934 by Pietro De Martino, the family run winery is now managed by its fourth generation and has become a pioneering force for low intervention and sustainable winemaking in South America. The Las Olvidadas (meaning 'the forgotten ones') is part of their Old Vine Series, which pays tribute to ancestral viticulture by sourcing fruit from small, remote, dry farmed vineyards that have stood for over a century.

Wine Description

De Martino Las Olvidadas Old Vine Series 2021 presents a medium ruby colour with delicate clarity. The nose is perfumed and wild, offering an alluring bouquet of red berries, wild herbs, and dried florals with an intriguing 'sauvage' character and hints of graphite. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and intensely fruity, featuring vibrant acidity and textured tannins that provide a rugged, granitic structure. It is characterized by its tension and grip, leading to a long, deep, and layered finish. This rare field blend consists of 80% País and 20% San Francisco (a nearly forgotten variety), sourced from vines planted as far back as 1905. The wine was fermented with native yeasts and 100% whole clusters before aging for 14 months in neutral oak barrels. The ABV is 13%, and while the winery is a sustainability leader, this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from now through 2031.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker - 94 points.

  • Vinous - 94 points.

  • James Suckling - 91 points.

Food Pairing

The rustic charm and vibrant lift of this old vine blend make it an excellent partner for earthy and savory dishes. It pairs perfectly with wild mushroom empanadas, grilled pork tenderloin with rosemary and pink peppercorns, or charred eggplant with tahini and pomegranate. Its acidity also cuts beautifully through the richness of a roasted beet and goat cheese salad.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Chile is regarded as exceptional, characterized by a cool summer with no significant heat spikes, which allowed for a slow and steady ripening process. These conditions resulted in wines of superior tannin quality, great aromatic concentration, and a fresh, elegant profile. The winemaker’s decision to use 100% whole clusters for the first time in this vintage highlights their skill in capturing the precision and purity offered by this cooler year.

title: De Martino Viejas Tinajas Cinsault 2018
bodyHtml:
De Martino Viejas Tinajas Cinsault is a remarkable wine that showcases the ancient winemaking technique of clay fermentation and the unique character of Cinsault grapes. Made from old-vine Cinsault, this wine undergoes fermentation in traditional clay amphorae known as "tinajas," allowing the grapes to express their truest essence. With a vibrant ruby colour, the wine entices with aromas of red berries, floral notes, and a touch of earthiness.

93+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

There is a wild and rustic side to the 2019 Las Olvidadas Mezcla Tinta, even more noticeable in the 2020 I also tasted. It comes from their vineyard in Santa Cruz de Guarilihue where the ancient vines of País and San Francisco vines are intermixed in the field. 2019 was a dry vintage in Itata, but they managed to keep the wine at 13% alcohol and with mellow acidity. The grapes fermented together after being hand destemmed with a zaranda destemmer like the traditional Pipeño wines, without any additions. The wine was put in barrel for malolactic and 18 months of aging. It's perfumed and intriguing, light to medium-bodied and with a strong personality. 4,371 bottles and 50 magnums were filled in October 2020.

title: Jermann Vinnae Servus Cella Ribolla Gialla 2023
bodyHtml:
Jermann Vinnae is an exceptional white wine that transports the senses to the sun-kissed vineyards of Friuli-Venezia Giulia in Italy. This blend of Ribolla Gialla, Tocai Friulano, and Riesling grapes showcases the region's winemaking prowess.

With its pale straw color, the wine offers a bouquet of vibrant citrus fruits, white flowers, and a hint of minerality. On the palate, flavors of juicy peaches, ripe pear, and a touch of almond unfold, balanced by a refreshing acidity. Vinnae's silky texture and lingering finish leave a lasting impression.

This wine is a testament to Jermann's commitment to crafting expressive and elegant white wines that reflect the essence of their terroir.

title: Brancaia Cabernet Sauvignon 'No. 2' 2023
bodyHtml:
Brancaia Cabernet Sauvignon is a remarkable red wine that showcases the excellence of Tuscan winemaking. Crafted with precision and care, this Cabernet Sauvignon exemplifies the unique terroir of the region. With its deep garnet color, the wine offers enticing aromas of blackberries, cassis, and hints of cedar.

On the palate, it reveals a harmonious balance of rich flavors, including ripe dark fruits, chocolate, and subtle spice. The wine's velvety texture, well-integrated tannins, and a long, lingering finish make it a true delight to savor.

title: Villa Marchesi Prosecco Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Villa Marchesi Prosecco Rose is a delightful Italian sparkling wine that captivates with its elegant and vibrant character.

This rose showcases the fusion of Glera and Pinot Noir grapes, resulting in a charming and refreshing expression. With a delicate pink hue, the wine offers enticing aromas of fresh berries, floral notes, and hints of citrus.

On the palate, flavors of ripe strawberries, raspberries, and a subtle touch of sweetness dance across the taste buds, balanced by a crisp acidity. Villa Marchesi Prosecco Rose is a delightful choice for celebrations or simply indulging in sparkling bliss.

title: Janneau 18 Year Old Grand Armagnac
bodyHtml:
Janneau 18 Year Old Armagnac is a prestigious French brandy that exemplifies the pinnacle of craftsmanship and refinement. Aged for 18 years in oak barrels, this spirit reveals a deep mahogany hue and a captivating aroma of dried fruits, rich spices, and hints of toasted oak. On the palate, it offers a harmonious blend of flavors, including notes of caramelized figs, dark chocolate, and a touch of leather.
