The Armagnac's velvety texture, balanced sweetness, and lingering finish create a truly indulgent experience. Janneau 18 Year Old Armagnac is a testament to the art of aging and the mastery of Armagnac production, making it a true connoisseur's choice.

title: Janneau 12 Year Old Grand Armagnac
bodyHtml:
Janneau 12 Year Old Armagnac is a distinguished French brandy that exemplifies the craftsmanship and heritage of the Armagnac region.

Aged for 12 years in oak barrels, this spirit offers a deep amber hue and a complex bouquet of dried fruits, vanilla, and delicate floral undertones.

On the palate, it unveils a symphony of flavors, including caramelized apricots, roasted nuts, and a touch of cinnamon. The Armagnac's smooth and velvety texture, along with its lingering finish, make it a luxurious indulgence.

title: Atanasio Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Atanasio Blanco Tequila is an exquisite expression of the classic Mexican spirit, known for its purity and vibrant character. Carefully crafted using the finest blue agave plants, this tequila is distilled to perfection, resulting in a crystal-clear liquid that embodies the true essence of agave.

With its clean and crisp profile, Atanasio Blanco Tequila offers a refreshing experience with hints of citrus, herbal notes, and a touch of earthiness. Its smooth and silky texture glides effortlessly across the palate, leaving a lingering, invigorating finish. This tequila is a testament to the craftsmanship and dedication that goes into creating a premium spirit that embodies the spirit of Mexico.

title: Atanasio Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Atanasio Anejo Tequila is a premium Mexican spirit renowned for its exceptional quality and rich flavors. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, this tequila undergoes a lengthy aging process, typically lasting for at least one year in oak barrels. The result is a beautifully balanced and complex profile that captivates the senses.

Atanasio Anejo Tequila exhibits notes of caramel, vanilla, and toasted oak, accompanied by a smooth and velvety texture. With each sip, this tequila delivers a harmonious blend of agave sweetness and subtle spice, leaving a lingering, satisfying finish. It is a testament to the artistry and passion behind tequila production in Mexico.

title: Aberlour 18 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Aberlour 18 Year Old Single Malt is a magnificent whisky that exemplifies the artistry and tradition of Speyside distilleries in Scotland. With its rich amber hue, this whisky entices with a captivating aroma of dried fruits, warm spices, and a subtle hint of oak.

On the palate, layers of complexity unfold, revealing flavors of dark chocolate, caramel, honey, and a gentle nuttiness. The whisky's velvety texture and well-rounded character create a harmonious balance.

The Aberlour 18 Year Old Single Malt leaves a lingering, satisfying finish, inviting whisky enthusiasts to savor its depth and craftsmanship, making it a true connoisseur's delight.

title: Tierra Rica Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: The Coastal vineyards in Chile highlight the best of the Sauvignon Blanc grape. This expressive wine is produced using sustainable and organic practices, featuring aromas of citrus fruit, bell pepper and herbs with a crisp and refreshing minerality. Enjoy it on its own, or with seafood pasta and grilled vegetables.

title: Otronia 45 Rugientes Corte de Blancas 2019
bodyHtml:
Bodega Otronia is located in the heart of Patagonia on parallel 45 ́33, probably, the last southern frontier for cultivating vines. The heterogeneity of the soils, the permanent winds, the cold and dry climate, and the sunlight intensity gives a unique profile to their wines.

This wines aromas of tropical fruits, citrus peel and floral notes of jasmine due to the contribution of the Gewurztraminer. Upon opening, some mineral notes appear. Very fresh, with good acidity and long persistence.

94 Points - James Suckling

Lots of yellow nectarines with some tropical fruit, roasted pineapples, lychees and ginger. Some fine lees, too. Lots of green pineapple on the palate. Intense, with a slightly oily texture, but super bright and mouthwatering.

title: Otronia 45 Rugientes Pinot Noir 2019
bodyHtml:
Bodega Otronia is located in the heart of Patagonia on parallel 45 ́33, probably, the last southern frontier for cultivating vines. The heterogeneity of the soils, the permanent winds, the cold and dry climate, and the sunlight intensity gives a unique profile to their wines.

Red fruits such as cherries and strawberries aromas, combined with spicy notes as black pepper, cinnamon and mineral hints. Defined by its freshness and delicacy. Very complex, with medium structure and a long finish.

92 Points - James Suckling

Shows a savory and spicier aspect of pinot on the nose, with salted cherries, dried herbs and orange peel, as well as some dark spices and tree bark. Medium-bodied with a nice crunch of juicy red cherries and a chalky feel in the finish.

title: Otronia Chardonnay Block 3 & 6 2020
bodyHtml:
Bodega Otronia is located in the heart of Patagonia on parallel 45 ́33, probably, the last southern frontier for cultivating vines. The heterogeneity of the soils, the permanent winds, the cold and dry climate, and the sunlight intensity gives a unique profile to their wines.

Notes of white fruits such as peach and pear, combined with a hint of flowers. Aromas of herbs, chamomile tea and thyme are perceived, which recall the natural environment from which the grapes come. Defined by its freshness, depth, vitality, flavor and long persistence. The natural acidity of the Patagonian terroir gives it a very attractive character and tension.

title: Otronia Pinot Noir Block 1 2019
bodyHtml:
Bodega Otronia is located in the heart of Patagonia on parallel 45 ́33, probably, the last southern frontier for cultivating vines. The heterogeneity of the soils, the permanent winds, the cold and dry climate, and the sunlight intensity gives a unique profile to their wines.

Pinot Noir with great character, notes of raspberries and cherries combined with herbs such as oregano, thyme, truffle and flowers. Great complexity and finesse in this splendid Patagonian wine. Delicate and persistent structure. Silky tannins, combined with a firm natural acidity, that gives a unique vitality and depth. Of medium intensity, its great characteristics are finesse and complexity.

93 Points - James Suckling

Scented raspberries, stemmy cherries, sous-bois and some rose petals. A fresh and bright pinot with an agile, chalky mouthfeel, teeming with extremely fresh and vibrant acidity and soft tannins. Very dry, crunchy mid-palate, showing a bright, juicy finish. Lots of energy here.

title: Glenfarclas 35 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Multi-award winning Glenfarclas Single Highland Malt Scotch Whisky has been distilled on Speyside for six generations by one family – the Grants. The Glenfarclas Distillery was legally established in 1836, on the Recherlich Farm at Ballindalloch, in the heart of Speyside. In 1865, John Grant purchased the distillery for £511. Situated in the heart of Speyside – malt whisky country – Glenfarclas, translated from the Gaelic as “Glen of the green grassland”, nestles at the foot of the Ben Rinnes mountain.

This is an extremely limited 35-year-old single malt from Glenfarclas that was matured in Spanish oak ex-sherry casks for three and a half decades.

Presented in an eye-catching box, reminiscent of the distillery's iconic red warehouse doors, it offers aromas of roasted almonds, dark dried fruit and creamy toffee that fill the nose. The palate brings notes of sherry-soaked fruit cake, dark chocolate and raisins that linger in the finish, alongside cinnamon and cocoa powder.

title: Glenfarclas Family Cask 1994 (Cask 4323) Summer Release 2022
bodyHtml:
Multi-award winning Glenfarclas Single Highland Malt Scotch Whisky has been distilled on Speyside for six generations byone family – the Grants. The Glenfarclas Distillery was legally established in 1836, on the Recherlich Farm at Ballindalloch, in the heart of Speyside. In 1865, John Grant purchased the distillery for £511. Situated in the heart of Speyside – malt whisky country – Glenfarclas, translated from the Gaelic as “Glen of the green grassland”, nestles at the foot of the Ben Rinnes mountain.

In 1994, the course of Christmas playlists was forever changed when Mariah Carey and East 17 released their chart toppers, and in far more delicious news, this Highland single malt was distilled at Glenfarclas. The whisky matured in a single fourth-fill butt, and was bottled in 2022 for the summer release of The Family Casks series. Only 297 bottles of this one, at an easy-drinking 45.4% ABV.

title: De Martino Carignan 'Vigno' 2016
bodyHtml:
Founded in Isla de Maipo (Chile), since 1934, the De Martino family has specialized in producing wines that reflect their origin and the character of each vineyard, based on solid principles of sustainable farming and traditional winemaking techniques. 

Brigth ruby colour, with intense aromatics or ripe black cherries, blackberries and a mineral smoky note. Shows a fresh and juicy acidity backed with ripe fruit notes and firm, fine fine-grained tannins. Medium-bodied with remarkable length, intensity and complexity.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Single Vineyard la Aguada is no longer mentioned on the label of the 2016 Vigno, which is also part of the Old Vines series. This wine is nothing short of spectacular, with a complex nose intermixing aromas of smoked bacon, wildflowers and berries, earth and tree bark, in a rare combination of power and elegance that takes them to a completely different profile than the rest of the Vigno association. Other than the intoxicating nose, the palate also reveals strong minerality and the austere and serious tannins from the granite soils. This is not only among the best Vigno bottlings, it's also one of the finest wines from Chile. This Carignan-based field blend matured in 5,000-liter oak foudres for 24 months. It has to be the finest year for the De Martino Vigno, very varietal, pure, precise, elegant and powerful. 6,439 bottles were filled in April 2018. De Martino is one of the quality leaders from Chile, and they are still working in Itata, a project they started in 2011. And in 2017, they had a Chardonnay from Traiguén, in the Malleco Valley further south. Also, in 2017, they started using more concrete vats and less stainless steel.

title: Pian Delle Ginestre Brunello Di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
Intense ruby red. A rich bouquet. In the nose a smell of ripe blackberries and forest fruits, leather and tobacco. The taste is smooth, powerful with warm tannins and dark chocolate.

It is a full bodied red wine of immense finesse, balance and longevity.

Pair with red meat, wild boar, game and old cheese.

title: Jordan Chardonnay Russian River 2024
bodyHtml:
This white wine originates from the United States, produced in the California region within the Russian River Valley subregion of Sonoma County. Established in 1972, Jordan Vineyard & Winery was inspired by the great wine estates of France and created as an homage to the connection between food, wine, and hospitality. The winery remains independently owned by John Jordan, whose parents founded the estate. Their winemaking philosophy emphasizes European-style elegance, focusing on fruit and acidity rather than high alcohol, to ensure the wines complement a broad range of foods.

Wine Description

The Jordan Chardonnay Russian River displays a bright and lively character. The nose is aromatic, offering scents of white peach, pear, and lemon blossom, accented by notes of flint, wet stones, and delicate floral blooms. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and textural, featuring layered flavours of zesty lime, orange peel, and crisp red Bosc pear. It is characterized by its focused structure, refreshing acidity, and a silk-textured, mineral-driven finish. This 100% Chardonnay was aged for six months in 100% new French oak, with 47% fermented in stainless steel and 9% in concrete eggs to preserve its vibrancy.

Food Pairing

The elegant structure and crisp acidity of this Chardonnay make it a versatile partner for various cuisines. It pairs beautifully with seafood such as Dungeness crab, Tsar Nicoulai caviar, and Hawaiian blue prawns. It also complements roasted chicken, creamy pasta dishes like fettuccine alfredo, and mushroom risotto. For a more exploratory pairing, consider mild curries or a garden vegetable medley with hazelnut vinaigrette.

title: Blue Spot 7 Year Cask Strength Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Blue Spot's name was derived from Mitchell's practice of marking their maturing casks of whiskey with a mark or daub of coloured paint to determine the ageing potential of the whiskey.

Embodying the unmistakable qualities of Pot Still Irish Whiskey, Blue Spot is matured for at least seven years in Bourbon barrels, Sherry butts and Portuguese Madeira casks. Non-chill-filtered and bottled at cask strength, nothing is added or taken away, for a whiskey that is full flavoured and uniquely satisfying. As a colourful history would have it, this revered Blue Spot has remained underground until now and its introduction reunites the historical Spot Family for the first time in over 100 years.

Flavours of dried figs, dates, apricots and raisins along with roasted cashews and salted caramel. Rich flavours of chocolate and espresso form on the mid-palate into the finish, which has a warming heat.

title: Jermann Blau & Blau Rosso 2022
bodyHtml:
Medium ruby red. Vinous, harmonious bouquet with herbaceous and undergrowth notes on the nose. The flavour is dry, elegant, fairly full-bodied, and balanced.

It pairs well with dishes from our Central European cuisine. Very pleasant is the combination of a smoked pork loin with apple mustard, horseradish and vegetable compote.

title: Doble 9 Elixir de Cuba
bodyHtml:
Doble 9 is an authentic Cuban rum inspired by Cuban identity and culture.

Adding some spice and fruit notes to a robust rum, Elixir is booming in popularity thanks to its decadent taste and easy-sipping body. During aging, Elixir is stored in special barrels that add to its woody flavour, marked by subtle hints of vanilla, dried fruit, and coconut.

title: Black Sheep Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
Black Sheep Tequila provides a trusted and memorable luxury brand, for new and unsuspecting “Tequila” drinkers. At the same time, the connoisseur will appreciate the stand-alone style that is re-shaping the category.

Black Sheep premium tequila has a unique old-world approach to its preparation; slow fermentation, special filtration of the juice of the properly selected, slow baked, and 100% aged Blue Weber highland agave.

Gold in colour. Aromas of natural baked agave with hints of honey, vanilla, and caramel. The taste is incredibly smooth, with slight natural sweetness, light smokey oak with a natural baked agave caramel blend.

title: Black Sheep Tequila Anejo
bodyHtml:
Black Sheep Tequila provides a trusted and memorable luxury brand, for new and unsuspecting “Tequila” drinkers. At the same time, the connoisseur will appreciate the stand-alone style that is re-shaping the category.

Black Sheep premium tequila has a unique old-world approach to its preparation; slow fermentation, special filtration of the juice of the properly selected, slow baked, and 100% aged Blue Weber highland agave.

Intense amber in colour. Aromas of warm oak, natural sweet baked agave, and rich caramel. The palate is complex, with notes of toasted oak, roasted agave, and honey.

title: Black Sheep Tequila Blanco
bodyHtml:
Black Sheep Tequila provides a trusted and memorable luxury brand, for new and unsuspecting “Tequila” drinkers. At the same time, the connoisseur will appreciate the stand-alone style that is re-shaping the category.

Black Sheep premium tequila has a unique old-world approach to its preparation; slow fermentation, special filtration of the juice of the properly selected, slow baked, and 100% aged Blue Weber highland agave.

Crystal clear. Slightly sweet aromas of fresh and baked natural agave and light peppermint. The taste is incredibly smooth and complex, with notes of agave and white pepper and cream on the finish.

title: Village Cider - 18.5 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Village Cider is a cornerstone of the Village Brewery lineup, representing Calgary’s take on the traditional English-style cider. While the brewery is famous for its "social" ales, this cider was crafted to provide a gluten-free, crisp alternative that doesn't compromise on complexity. It is a "dry-style" cider, meaning it avoids the cloying, sugary sweetness found in mass-market brands. It is designed to be the ultimate refreshment—clean, natural, and evocative of an autumn harvest in the orchard.

Beer Description

Village Cider pours a brilliant, pale straw-gold with crystal clarity and a lively, champagne-like effervescence that produces a fleeting white head.

Aroma: The nose is bright and exceptionally "green." It leads with a dominant scent of freshly pressed Granny Smith apples and tart skin, followed by a subtle, floral hint of apple blossoms. There is a faint, earthy sweetness in the background, but the overall impression is one of crisp, orchard-fresh fruit.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied with a sharp, tingly carbonation. It leads with a vibrant tartness and flavors of green apple, which is quickly balanced by a delicate, natural fruit sweetness. Unlike many commercial ciders, it has a distinct tannic dryness on the finish, leaving the palate feeling clean and refreshed rather than coated in sugar.

Profile: It sits at a sturdy 5.5% ABV and, being a cider, has 0 IBU (no hops). It is naturally gluten-free.

Technical Notes: Village Cider is crafted using a blend of 100% Yakima Valley apples. The juice is fermented using a specific cider yeast that preserves the primary fruit aromatics while fermenting the sugars to near-dryness. It is filtered for high clarity and carbonated to a "brut" level, mimicking the mouthfeel of a sparkling wine.

title: Laurent Miquel Albarino Alaina 2021
bodyHtml:
French Albarino was born right in the heart of the Lanquedoc. So it's only appropriate that Laurent Miquel named this Albarino after their daughter Alaina, also born there.

Lemon peel, lime zest, green papaya and even a hint of lily.

title: Dorrance Rose 2020
bodyHtml:
Born and raised in France, Christophe Durand moved to Cape Town in 1995. Initially working as a supplier of premium French wine barrels, he became increasingly involved in winemaking, eventually combining his knowledge and passion for fine wines to create Dorrance Wines.

Smooth and elegant, this fresh wine is bursting with summer fruit flavours, complex and easily enjoyable at the same time. A touch of spices complements the nose of wild berries and fresh white peaches.

title: Reservoir Distillery Wheated Whiskey
bodyHtml: With a 100% wheat mash bill, our Wheat Whiskey is the softest of our three expressions and unique to any other American style whiskey on the market. Our wheat produces a buttery, savory, and smooth spirit that proves to be an excellent introductory whiskey.​

title: Reservoir Distillery Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml: In the crowded world of "High Ryes" on the market, we are proud to offer the highest with a 100% rye mash bill. Sourced from just outside Richmond's city limits, our rye provides an intense, sharply spiced profile that is not too sweet.

title: Moselland Riesling Pink Cat 2025
bodyHtml: Brilliant colour. Gorgeous bouquet with fresh apple, lime and mineral flavours. On the palate typical aromas of apple and excellent balance. This is a great gift, especially for collectors! Perfect pairing with lighter or spicy cuisine. For example delicious with smoked salmon, roast turkey or on its own.

title: Moselland Riesling Gold Cat 2024
bodyHtml: The wine is full flavored with pear and citrus aromas.  Stimulating on the palate, as well as fresh and fruity.  It has a nice sweetness balanced with the typical crisp Riesling acidity. It ideally pairs with lighter or spicy cuisine or simply on its own.

title: Ruffino Brunello Di Montalcino Greppone Mazzi 2019
bodyHtml:
In 1877, Illario and Leopoldo Ruffino laid the foundations of their dream to make the most known and loved Italian wines in the world from the heart of Tuscany. At their winery in Pontassieve, just outside of Florence, they began producing wines according to a strict quality standard and a rigorous technical research. Soon, Ruffino became an international symbol of the Chianti region, and won numerous awards, including the prestigious gold medal at the Bordeaux Wine Fair in 1895, affirming the quality of its wine.

Wine Description

Ruffino Greppone Mazzi Brunello di Montalcino is an intense ruby with garnet reflections. The bouquet is complex with hints of fruit, including plum, blackcurrant and cherry enriched notes with sweet tobacco and chocolate. An extremely elegant and persistent wine, characterized by intense spicy notes.

title: Disaronno Amaretto - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Disaronno Amaretto Originale is sweet and fruity. This Italian liqueur made from natural almonds, vanilla and pure caramelized sugar. Disaronno claims its originale amaretto's secret formula is unchanged from the year 1525, with roots embedded in the Renaissance era. This delectable liqueur can be served on the rocks, in shots, and a variety of cocktails, such as the Disaronno Sour.

title: Cointreau - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Cointreau is a 100% pure orange premium liqueur with a brandy base. It is crystal clear, making it an ideal and versatile ingredient for the most successful cocktails. Sweet and bitter orange peel combined.

title: Kahlua - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Originating in Mexico in 1936, Kahlua is a coffee liquor loved all around the world. Used in a range of different drinks, from coffees to cocktails, it goes hand in hand with many occasions. Classic cocktails, like the White Russian, Espresso Martini and Black Russian just wouldn’t be the same without it. With its enticing caramel colour, Kahlua coffee liquor boasts the deep, rich flavour of real black coffee, roasted chestnut and indulgent sweet butter.

title: Baileys - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Whether you’re baking, shaking or cocktail-making, why not use Baileys? From gooey Baileys Irish Cream Cheesecake to classy Baileys Espresso Martini, Baileys recipes hit the sweet spot every time. Why not have your cake, and drink it too? Baileys Original Irish Cream is the sweetest meeting of fine Irish whiskey and spirits, Irish dairy cream, rich chocolate and vanilla flavours. Complete deliciousness.

title: Frangelico - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
As a classic liqueur, Frangelico delights the senses prepared in any way. Its darker appearance is always ready to surprise with a sweet golden taste. 

For sheer sophistication, pour it over ice or for a twist, pour it over ice with a squeeze of fresh lime for the most tantalizing experience. To make it even more refreshing, mix Frangelico with soda, or chill it and enjoy as a shot. The possibilities are many, the flavor is just one.

title: Padre Azul Reposado Tequila - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml: This Reposado tequila is aged in French oak barrels for a minimum of 8 months after distillation. Complex notes of dried orange, smoked agave and caramel fill the velvety yet powerful palate. An exceptional spirit housed in a strikingly presented handcrafted bottle.

title: Great Plains 22 Year Old Cognac Finish Whisky
bodyHtml:
Great Plains Craft Spirits is an award-winning small producer based in Calgary, Alberta with the mission of crafting world-class, artisanal whisky. 

They source limited lots of well-aged Canadian whiskies, in-cask, at full-strength from local sources. They finish these in distilled spirits barrels that they’ve imported from the finest estates in Europe from regions like Cognac, Armagnac, and Andalusia. Finally, they taste, blend, and bottle at optimum proof. 

Aromatic dried fruit, floral notes, roasted chestnuts, vanilla. Warm, velvety mouth feel with a luxuriously smooth and lingering finish.

title: Sierra Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Sierra Reposado Tequila is a revered spirit that has garnered acclaim from critics who recognize its exceptional quality. One critic raves, "Sierra Reposado delights with its delicate balance of agave sweetness and oak notes, creating a harmonious and elegant flavor profile." Another reviewer commends its smoothness, stating, "This tequila glides effortlessly on the palate, offering a velvety texture and a lingering, satisfying finish." Critics also highlight its versatility, with one declaring, "Sierra Reposado shines in cocktails or simply savored neat, showcasing its rich agave character." It's clear that Sierra Reposado Tequila stands as a shining example of excellence in the world of tequila.

title: Komos Tequila Anejo Cristalino
bodyHtml:
Komos Anejo Cristalino has a stunning nose of sugared pineapple surrounded by bright agave freshness & lime zest. The mouthfeel is rich, with floral and delicate fruit notes from its time in the French oak. The finish is mineral driven and dry, with a delicate sweetness.

Aged for a minimum of 1 year in French oak white wine barrels. Dripped through a charcoal column after aging to remove impurities and resulting in a smooth and crystal clear Anejo.

Tequila Komos is made at the Orendain distillery in the town of Tequila and utilizes primarily wine barrels, for their ultra luxury aged Tequila expressions. All of the expressions are gently aerated in greek wine amphorae, tying the Mediterranean focus of the brand, back to the process itself. Each of the beautiful opaque ceramic bottles is handmade to preserve the aromas and flavors inside of it.

title: Tenuta Iuzzolini Ciro Rosso Classico 2023
bodyHtml:
Tenuta Iuzzolini, located in Calabria's Cirò Marina region, is renowned for its dedication to traditional winemaking and the cultivation of indigenous grape varieties. Their 2022 Cirò Rosso Classico exemplifies this commitment, offering a wine that reflects the rich heritage of the area.

Wine Description

The 2022 Cirò Rosso Classico is crafted from 100% Gaglioppo grapes, an ancient variety native to Calabria. This wine presents a bright ruby-red color. On the nose, it offers delicate, intense, and ethereal aromas. The palate is warm and full, pleasantly vinous, balanced, savory, and persistent. The wine is matured in stainless steel for five months, with a brief passage in barriques, and further refined in the bottle at controlled temperatures.

Food Pairing

This versatile red pairs excellently with all dishes, particularly red meats, game, and medium-aged cheeses.

title: Bigallet China - China Amer Liqueur
bodyHtml:
First produced in the French Alps in 1875, Bigallet Viriana China-China is an artisanal liqueur made from a blend of sweet and bitter orange peels which have been macerated and distilled in alembic stills. 

A selection of aromatic plants with a touch of sugar give this digestif its unique Amaro-like character.

title: Hennessy VS (Very Special) - 1.75 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Hennessy Very Special (V.S) is one of the most popular cognacs in the world. Matured in new oak barrels, Hennessy V.S is bold and fragrant. Its beguiling character is uniquely Hennessy, a timeless choice with an intensity all its own. Hennessy V.S offers toasted and fruit notes, with a rich, clearly defined palate and a welcoming exuberance.

Hennessy V.S expresses its vibrant and dynamic personality through unique artist partnerships and annual limited editions. Easy to enjoy, it’s a perfect cognac for high-energy occasions and sharing the moment.

The round and robust flavours of Hennessy V.S make it very versatile and ideal for any cocktail possibility, from classic recipes and sophisticated cocktail creations to easy mixed drinks.

title: Zuidam Framboise Liqueur
bodyHtml: Zuidam Liqueurs are handcrafted from fresh fruits and over 100 herbs and spices. They have over 50 years of combined experience in taking nature's best raw ingredients and turning them into the most beautiful liqueurs. They don't use any artificial flavourings or colourings.

title: Casey Jones Total Eclipse Moonshine - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Put yourself in the path of totality with Casey Jones Total Eclipse Moonshine. First created to commemorate the 2017 solar eclipse, Total Eclipse is a flawless blend of corn and cane. Enjoy it over ice or with your favorite mixer. 

Velvety, slight taste of sweet corn finishing in a nice “Kentucky Hug” from friendly heat.

title: Antinori Cont'Ugo 2022
bodyHtml:
This single varietal red wine originates from the Bolgheri DOC in the Tuscany region of Italy. Crafted by the historic Antinori family, whose winemaking legacy in Italy spans over 600 years, this wine is produced at the Guado al Tasso estate. The estate is situated in the 'Bolgheri Amphitheatre', a plain encircled by rolling hillsides where cooling Mediterranean breezes mitigate summer heat and maintain the aromatic freshness of the fruit.

Wine Description

The Antinori Cont'Ugo presents an intense ruby red colour in the glass. The nose delivers a rich and expressive bouquet of small ripe red fruits, such as red plums and cherries, accompanied by fresh balsamic notes of Mediterranean scrub, tobacco, and subtle spices like leather and graphite. On the palate, the wine offers a velvety entry with a medium to full body, showcasing vibrant flavours of blackberries, olives, and orange zest. It is distinguished by its roundness and well-integrated, chewy tannins that lead to a persistent, fruity finish with hints of coffee and earthiness.

title: The Prisoner Wine Co. - Prisoner Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from the United States, produced from vineyards in the Sonoma Coast appellation of California, specifically sourced from the Russian River and Carneros AVAs. The Prisoner Wine Company was established in 1998 and is currently owned by Constellation Brands, a major beverage company that has supported its growth since 2016. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a collaborative approach, where the winemaking team works with over 100 small-scale growers across California to source unique fruit for its bold and unconventional blends.

Wine Description

The Prisoner Pinot Noir displays a medium ruby hue in the glass. The nose is expressive and complex, offering aromas of black cherry, fresh cranberry, and pomegranate, accented by notes of cedar, clove spice, and dried herbs. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and structured, delivering layers of ripe red fruit, rhubarb, and black tea integrated with hints of cardamom, lavender, and cinnamon. It is characterized by its smooth, silken texture, bright orange acidity, and soft tannins that culminate in an elegant and balanced finish.

title: Kendall Jackson Chardonnay Low Calorie 2022
bodyHtml:
The new way to Chardonnay. Bright and balanced, the Kendall-Jackson Low Calorie Chardonnay displays flavors of grapefruit, pineapple and creamy lemon meringue, highlighted by delicate notes of white flower. Aged in small oak barrels, French cooperage gives this wine a touch of vanilla and hazelnut on the mid-palate that broadens through an elegant finish.

Each glass (5 oz. serving) contains only 85 calories, 3 carbs, and 0 added sugar per serving it’s the perfect wine to enjoy at the end of the day– gluten-free, sugar-free, guilt-free. This wine is also keto and vegan-friendly.

title: Fontanabianca Barbaresco 2022
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Neive village of Barbaresco, Piedmont, Italy, this wine is a quintessential expression of the region's unique terroir. The Fontanabianca estate was established in 1969 by Franco Pola and is currently managed by his son Aldo and grandson Matteo, who serves as the lead winemaker. The winery’s philosophy focuses on capturing the character of Neive by utilizing traditional methods, such as aging in large Slavonian oak barrels, alongside modern temperature controlled fermentation to preserve the elegance of their Nebbiolo grapes.

Wine Description

This Barbaresco displays a medium garnet red colour with bright reflections. The aromatic profile is elegant and harmonious, featuring lifted scents of red berry, wild strawberry, and rose petals, accented by nuanced hints of forest floor, star anise, and dark spice. On the palate, the wine is dry and powerful yet refined, with polished, fine grained tannins and a vibrant acidity that maintains a sense of freshness and balance.

Food Pairing

This powerful red wine pairs exceptionally well with hearty dishes such as roast beef, wild game, or rich stews. It is also an ideal companion for traditional Piedmontese cuisine, including truffle infused risotto or tajarin pasta with a robust meat ragù. For a cheese course, consider aged varieties like Parmigiano Reggiano, Castelmagno, or sharp Pecorino.

title: The Prisoner Wine Co. - Unshackled Sauvignon Blanc
bodyHtml:
Unshackled Sauvignon Blanc White Wine, created by the innovative winemakers of The Prisoner Wine Company, is characterized by bright and crisp fruit.

Opening with aromas of melon and tropical fruit, this delightfully unconventional sauvignon blanc wine makes its mark on the world. Flavors of peach, fresh citrus, lime, and tropical fruit grace this crisp white wine.

Sourced from the state's Central and North Coasts, this California white wine's delicious blend of sauvignon blanc, Chenin blanc, and Roussanne varietals offers brightness and texture. Enjoy a glass of wine on its own, or pair with artisanal cheeses at a wine and cheese party. For the best taste, chill this wine for two to two and a half hours before serving.

title: Bodegas Lan Rioja Reserva 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Bodegas Lan is located in the Rioja region of Spain, specifically within the subregions of Rioja Alta and Rioja Alavesa. The estate is renowned for its commitment to respecting the history of the land, utilizing select vineyard parcels with clayey-calcareous soils to produce wines that balance traditional Rioja character with modern precision.

Wine Description

This Reserva presents an intense and bright cherry red colour with elegant garnet hues. The nose offers a complex symphony of black fruits and berries, seamlessly integrated with aromas of smoky plum, blackberry, vanilla, and spices such as cardamom and dried sage. On the palate, the wine is wide and silky, displaying a firm structure with tobacco leaf depth and a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing

This wine is best enjoyed alongside grilled meats, such as a veal Porterhouse or a rack of BBQ ribs. It also pairs beautifully with roasted lamb, Spanish-style meatballs in tomato sauce, or aged cheeses.

title: Campagnola Ripasso 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Italy, Campagnola Valpolicella Classico Ripasso is a beautiful expression of the historic Veneto region. The Giuseppe Campagnola winery is a celebrated family-run estate that has been cultivating a passion for winemaking across five generations, passing down an enduring love for their land. Their winemaking philosophy centers on harmony and a deep connection to regional tradition, sourcing grapes from select hillside vineyards in the heart of the Valpolicella Classico zone.

Wine Description

This rich red blend is meticulously crafted from 80% Corvina and Corvinone alongside 20% Rondinella grapes. In the glass, it reveals an intense ruby red colour with delicate violet reflections. The aromatic profile is complex and inviting, leading with notes of ripe strawberries, mulberries, and a touch of jam, beautifully complemented by undertones of ground spices, dried flowers, and a hint of vanilla. On the palate, this medium-bodied wine shows remarkable freshness and concentration, driving a juicy texture framed by crunchy tannins and a racy acidity.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 91 points.

Food Pairing

The structural depth and balanced acidity of this Ripasso make it an exceptional partner for savory dishes. It pairs wonderfully with roasted or grilled meats, hearty autumn risottos, and medium to long-aged cheeses.

title: Campagnola Amarone della Valpolicella 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This rich, dry red wine is carefully made in the renowed Valpolicella Classico area. Selected grapes are dry until the January following the harvest, when they are pressed. Deep garnet in color, with a rich cherried fruit bouquet and gull bodied, dry and powerful palate.

Amarone is the ideal accompaniment to all red meats and old cheese. With increasing age this fine wine may throw a natural deposit.

title: Sidewood Estate Shiraz 2020
bodyHtml:
Displaying aromas of red fruits, blackcurrant, dark chocolate and an elegant spiciness which lead to a palate with generous flavours of white pepper, leather and raspberry. Rich and silky tannins linger on the palate with seamless persistence.

Delicious on its own or as a versatile partner to filet mignon or truffle and porcini pasta.

title: Halem Heights Pinot Noir 2018
bodyHtml: This Dundee Hills Pinot Noir enjoyed an extended season with many warm dry days. The extra hang time developed a complex palate of deep, dark colours and bold, ripe fruit.

title: Sidewood Estate Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml: The wine has tantalising aromas of jasmine and ripe lemon but with a round, velvety structure. The palate showcases crisp, mouth-watering flavours of grapefruit, apricot and white peach, finishing with lingering, crisp minerality. Serve chilled on its own or enjoy as an accompaniment to teriyaki salmon, roast pork or a mushroom risotto. Drinking beautifully now but will continue to evolve with careful cellaring.

title: Castello della Sala Muffato della Sala 2013 - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
A rich golden hue in the glass, the '13 Muffato Della Sala reflects its cool, classic growing year in its vivid acidity, precision, and breathtaking balance. Layers and layers of zesty citrus, luscious tropical, and crisp orchard fruits mingle with notes of honey, white wildflowers, and kisses of toasted nuts, pressed herbs, and saline minerals in this creamy wine's dreamy, complex palate.

Fresh and exciting, this Muffato Della Sala vintage feels clean and silky, unspooling across the palate with elegant minerality and kinetic energy as it builds to a succulent, sweet-tart finish. Derived primarily from grapes that have realized a considerable degree of concentration and been affected by noble rot, Muffato della Sala is mostly Sauvignon Blanc blended with Grechetto, Gewurztraminer, and Semillon.

title: Atanasio Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Lightly rested Reposado, spending only 3 months in American white oak barrels allowing pure agave flavors of the base Tequila to really shine.
 
Small batch, hand-crafted by Maestro Tequilero Rene Carranza.

title: Stoller Pinot Noir Reserve 2021
bodyHtml:
This 100% Pinot Noir originates from the Dundee Hills AVA within Oregon's Willamette Valley. Established in 1993, Stoller Family Estate is a pioneer in sustainable viticulture, notably becoming the first winery in the world to achieve LEED Gold certification. The family owned estate prioritizes a gravity flow winemaking philosophy to maintain the integrity of their fruit, which is sourced entirely from the largest contiguous vineyard in the Dundee Hills.

Wine Description

The Reserve Pinot Noir presents a dark and sophisticated sensory profile, opening with aromas of leather, cola, and dense dark berries, lifted by hints of cinnamon and a sweet touch of vanilla bean. On the palate, the wine is elegant and finely structured, offering a concentrated yet slender body characterized by layered flavors of cranberry, rhubarb, and black plum. The mouthfeel is defined by softly chalky, luxurious tannins and vibrant acidity, leading into a long, delicate finish with notes of flint and floral perfume.

title: Gabbas Cannonau di Sardegna Classico Dule 2016
bodyHtml:
Dule is produced from 100% Cannonau grapes, that came from one single vineyard. It is aged for 6 months in 60 and 120 French oak gallon barrels and it is released 24 months after the harvest.

Full-bodied and complex flavours, that goes well with red meats and dishes with rich sauces.

title: Bonanza Cabernet Sauvignon - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Bonanza Lot 7 is a California Cabernet Sauvignon crafted by Chuck Wagner, owner and winemaker of Caymus Vineyards. This wine reflects the "bonanza" of California's diverse vineyard sites, often overlooked, yet capable of producing quality Cabernet Sauvignon.

Wine Description

This full-bodied, smooth Cabernet Sauvignon presents an attractive dark ruby hue. On the nose, it offers aromas of chocolate shavings, blackberries, dark cherry, and sweet oak. The palate reveals flavors of ripe dark berries, coffee notes, and subtle hints of chocolate and coconut on the finish. The wine is well-balanced with silky tannins, making it both accessible and enjoyable over a meal.

Accolades

Natalie MacLean awarded Bonanza Lot 7 a score of 91/100, noting its suitability alongside roast beef, pasta, or meat lovers' pizza.

Food Pairing

This versatile Cabernet Sauvignon pairs well with a variety of dishes, including:

  • Grilled burgers
  • Grilled sausages
  • Dark chocolate studded with dried dark berries
  • Roast beef
  • Pasta dishes
  • Meat lovers' pizza

These pairings highlight the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

Vintage Quality

As a multi-vintage blend, Bonanza Lot 7 combines grapes from various vintages and regions across California. This approach allows the winemaker to craft a consistent and approachable Cabernet Sauvignon, reflecting the diverse terroir and climatic conditions of the state.

title: Ometeo Mexican Gin
bodyHtml:
This craft gin originates from Mexico, produced in the region of Jalisco. Crafted at Destilería Y Bodega Abasolo, the spirit is designed as a tribute to Mexican botanical and herbal traditions. Named in homage to the dual deity Ometeotl, the gin combines native plants with traditional distillation methods to highlight the rich natural biodiversity of the country.

Spirit Description

This clear spirit presents a bright and crystalline appearance in the glass. The nose opens with vibrant aromas of native Jalisco lime peel and fresh citrus zest, layered over herbal notes of wild lavender, mint, coriander seeds, and piney juniper. On the palate, it delivers a medium body with a surprisingly light, creamy, and smooth mouthfeel. Persistent flavours of tart lime, herbal green pepper, and delicate floral accents are well balanced by warmer underlying notes of cassia bark, black pepper, Tabasco pepper, and angelica root. The finish is clean, crisp, and spicy, leaving a lingering impression of citrus oils and exotic warmth. Bottled at an ABV of 42%, it offers a balanced yet distinctively complex Mexican expression.

title: Hendrick's Flora Adora
bodyHtml:
Within the walls of the Hendrick's Gin Palace Garden, a most magical party is flourishing! Butterflies and bees dance in dizzy reverie, feasting on a banquet of fragrant flowers laid out especially by Ms Lesley Gracie. Now their Master Distiller wishes to invite you to join in these enchanting celebrations and introduce you to this delectable limited release Scottish Gin.

Perfect for casual get-togethers, Hendrick's Flora Adora is buzzing with an enticing aroma of enchanting flowers and a fresh, herbal character that is classically Hendrick's in style. The juniper and coriander backbone is lengthened by lush green and wonderfully sweet floral characteristics, creating a wonderfully balanced gin.

Exquisite with tonic and a slice of cucumber, or perhaps try mixed long in a Wildgarden Cup – a medley of fresh mint, cooling cucumber and juicy raspberries lengthened with a refreshing lemon soda.

title: Buzzard's Roost Char #1 Bourbon Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Buzzard’s Roost Sipping Whiskey started in 2019, after Judy Hollis Jones and Jason Brauner met while doing a barrel pick. As the two got to know each other, an idea started to form. “Let’s start our own bourbon brand!” they said. They knew they wanted Buzzard’s Roost to be not just exceptional but unique. So they turned to a trusted barrel expert at Independent Stave Company, who worked with them to create proprietary barrels for secondary maturation. 

It was decided to use Char #1 on all their barrels, to let the whiskey access the oak influence more easily. It was also decided to season that oak for at least 18 months (6 months is the norm for other brands). And finally, they developed a series of exclusive toast profiles to coax out specific characteristics from the oak, bringing rare flavor combinations to every Buzzard’s Roost Sipping Whiskey.

Created from 4-year-old whiskey, and aged in their proprietary barrels, Char #1 Bourbon carries notes of cherry and dark fruit that stand out in any bourbon cocktail and is perfect for sipping and roosting.

title: Buzzard's Roost Char #1 Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Buzzard’s Roost Sipping Whiskey started in 2019, after Judy Hollis Jones and Jason Brauner met while doing a barrel pick. As the two got to know each other, an idea started to form. “Let’s start our own bourbon brand!” they said. They knew they wanted Buzzard’s Roost to be not just exceptional but unique. So they turned to a trusted barrel expert at Independent Stave Company, who worked with them to create proprietary barrels for secondary maturation. 

It was decided to use Char #1 on all their barrels, to let the whiskey access the oak influence more easily. It was also decided to season that oak for at least 18 months (6 months is the norm for other brands). And finally, they developed a series of exclusive toast profiles to coax out specific characteristics from the oak, bringing rare flavor combinations to every Buzzard’s Roost Sipping Whiskey.

Tastefully and carefully blended from only a few barrels in their stock, each batch is always different, always delicious.

title: Argyle Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the United States, the Argyle Chardonnay 2022 is crafted in the Willamette Valley, Oregon — a region renowned for its cool-climate viticulture. Argyle Winery, founded in 1987 by Rollin Soles, is celebrated for its pioneering work with sparkling and still wines. Their dedication to expressing the distinct terroirs of the Willamette Valley underscores their commitment to quality and innovation.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay displays a brilliant pale straw colour. On the nose, it reveals lifted aromas of fresh lemon zest, white peach, and subtle hints of brioche. The palate is vibrant and precise, offering flavours of crisp green apple, pear, and a delicate minerality that speaks to its cool-climate origins. Medium-bodied with a fine, elegant texture, it finishes with refreshing acidity and a touch of creaminess, showcasing balance and finesse.

Food Pairing

Pair this Chardonnay with grilled halibut, roasted chicken with lemon and thyme, or a creamy risotto. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, bringing out its citrus-driven vibrancy and graceful finish.

title: K Vintners Vino Rose 2021
bodyHtml: A refreshing and aromatic wine. Notes of watermelon, herbal, white pepper and lilac. On the palate it shows expansive citrus blossoms, cut straw and mineral laden rose.

title: Santa Margherita Rose 2024
bodyHtml: Santa Margherita Rose is lively and vibrant with fresh acidity and balance, with a pale pink hue and a uniquely light, floral taste derived from our meticulous vinification process. The perfect accompaniment to most any meal, Santa Margherita Rose pairs well with salads including classic Caesar and nicoise, appetizers, pasta and risotto dishes, grilled meats, seafood, and soft cheeses.

title: Woodford Reserve Distiller's Select Straight Bourbon Whiskey - 1.75 Litre
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Selected as the Official Bourbon of the Kentucky Derby and the historic Churchill Downs this thoroughbred races into the glass a medium amber colour. You'll be met with aromas of sweet vanilla, apricot, caramel and spice; soft and quite rounded with delicate vanilla and caramel flavours followed by a long complex finish.

title: Woodford Reserve Straight Wheat Whiskey
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Woodford Reserve Wheat is based on historical recipes but influenced by the iconic core Woodford Reserve Bourbon brand. With wheat as the dominant grain – at 52%, followed by malt (20%), corn (20%) and rye (8%) – this uniquely crafted whiskey boasts fruit and floral flavors.

title: Woodford Reserve Straight Malt Whiskey
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Unlike a typical 100% malt whiskey, Woodford Reserve is a Kentucky Straight Malt Whiskey crafted from 51% malt and aged in new charred oak barrels, making it the malt whiskey for bourbon drinkers.

The base of 51% malt results in a whiskey that is richly flavorful and complex and amplifies the nutty characteristics found in the original Woodford Reserve.

title: Rossville Union Rye Single Barrel (113.2 Proof)
bodyHtml:
It began in 1847 with a bold, satisfying taste that would make Indiana the rye capital of the world. For nearly 200 years, Lawrenceburg's master distillers and blenders have been perfecting the original handcrafted rye blends in one of America's last Prohibition-era distilleries. Rossville Union is a return to the golden age of rye with an authentic taste that could only come from Whiskey City.

This barrel exhibits soft baking spice, ripe orchard fruit and a wildflower honey aroma. On the palate, a biscuity, shortbread maltiness is interspersed throughout sharper rye spice notes. Candy corn finish.

title: Skyy Vodka - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Created to be the cleanest and purest vodka around, this is quadruple distilled and triple filtered. Clear in the glass, with a delicate bouquet of citrus, anise, and coriander. The palate offers a creamy body with smooth texture and a hint of pepper on the finish.

title: Colome 'Autentico' Malbec 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The 2019 Autentico Malbec is intense in color and full of aromas like cherries, blackberries, figs, cassis and cloves with elegant spice and mineral notes. The mouth is crisp and robust with a high concentration of ripe and round tannins.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The dark and brooding 2019 Autentico Malbec had to be harvested quickly because of a heat wave during the harvest. Eighty-five percent of the volume matured in stainless steel and the rest in concrete egg.

95 Points - Decanter

93 Points - Vinous

93 Points - James Suckling

title: Colome 'Autentico' Malbec 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The 2018 Bodega Colome Autentico Malbec is of intense color and full of aromas such as cherries, blackberries, figs, cassis and cloves, with elegant spices and mineral notes. Mouth is crispy and robust with a high concentration of ripe and round tannins, that express the terroir in an authentic and genuine way.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The raw and primary 2018 Autentico Malbec shows the wilderness of the northern vineyards, dark, concentrated, juicy, and full of wild herbs, flower and berry aromas, really showy and impressive. This is a pure expression of the grape following the Dávalos (previous owners of Colomé) tradition of unoaked wines. This matured in tank for ten months and a further ten months in bottle. I love this wine.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Offers a fine-grained texture, with precise red fruit and spice flavors that are well-structured and pure-tasting. The minerally finish features some peppery notes and plenty of verve.

92 Points - James Suckling

Very youthful and attractively raw fresh-fruit presence in the plum and blackberry zone. The palate has a very rich, concentrated feel with lithe, succulent tannins, carrying long and fresh.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A deeply saturated black-meets-purple color and cool aromas of herbal blackberry, cola and minerals open this lush Malbec from Salta. A sappy palate is dense and full bodied, while this tastes of wild berry, cassis and balsamic reduction. A thick and sappy finish is fitting even though this sees no oak.

title: Absolut Vodka - 200 ml
bodyHtml:
Absolut Vodka is known as one of the world's best Swedish vodkas. Made exclusively from natural ingredients with no added sugar, it showcases subtle flavours of grain and dried fruit. On the palate, it is full, rich and as smooth as vodka can be.

Enjoy straight or in one of your favourite cocktails, like the Vodka Soda.

title: Dom Perignon Brut 2017
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Dom Pérignon Brut is a vintage Champagne from France, originating in the Champagne region. The wine is a blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay grapes. The foundational philosophy of Dom Pérignon is an unwavering commitment to vintage Champagne, meaning it is only produced from the harvest of a single year. This creative constraint is used to bear witness to each year, capturing the unique essence of the harvest, and showcasing both the current expression and the potential for future development.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous pale gold colour with a vibrant, finely detailed mousse. The aromatic profile is complex, initially unfolding with notes of guava and spicy green grapefruit zest, evolving into stone fruit aromas of white peaches and nectarines. Further aromatic layers include floral notes of lime blossom and jasmine, toasted notes of brioche and almond, and a botanical freshness with hints of orange and green papaya.

On the palate, it has a horizontal, broad, and straight structure, with a tension that extends the finish. It is medium to full-bodied, enveloping the palate with clear, clean flavours like lemon leaves, Mirabelle plums, and grapefruit pith. The blend is composed of 51% Pinot Noir and 49% Chardonnay. Stylistically, the wine displays an excellent balance of richness and tension, with a refined, structured, and linear style. It concludes with a long, sapid, and chalky finish, featuring a subtle saline quality and a gastronomic bitterness. The wine has an alcohol by volume (ABV) of $12.5\%$. It is recommended for drinking now through 2035, with some critics suggesting it may age gracefully until 2045 or beyond.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 97 points

  • Wine Spectator - 96 points

  • Vinous - 96 points

  • Decanter - 96 points

  • Wine Advocate - 95 points

Food Pairing

The wine's distinctive character is well-expressed with choice seafood such as caviar, king crab, and langoustine. It also pairs perfectly with meats that have tangy notes, including pork, lamb, or duck. The complexity of the vintage is accentuated by exotic touches like kiwi and guava, or spices like green curry. Other suggested pairings include seared scallops with truffle foam, poached lobster with saffron beurre blanc, or a delicate sushi platter.

Vintage Quality

The 2015 growing year in Champagne was marked by exceptional contrasts. Following a particularly cold spring, a prolonged period of hot and dry weather lasted until late August, leading to concerns about water stress in the vines. Fortunately, the region's chalky soils had absorbed large quantities of water during the winter, which helped the vines cope. The harvest began in early September under brilliant sunshine, revealing grapes of exceptional generosity and balance despite the challenging vintage conditions. This successful result in a difficult, warm season is a dramatic credit to the winemaking team's meticulous selection and skill in adapting to the climate.

title: Absolut Vodka - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Absolut Vodka is known as one of the world's best Swedish vodkas. Made exclusively from natural ingredients with no added sugar, it showcases subtle flavours of grain and dried fruit. On the palate, it is full, rich and as smooth as vodka can be.

Enjoy straight or in one of your favourite cocktails, like the Vodka Soda.

title: Dos Primos Tequila Blanco
bodyHtml:
A premium Blanco made with 100% pure agave, estate-grown and hand-cut in the heart of tequila country.

This smooth sippin’ Blanco blends agave from Los Altos and the valley area of Jalisco to create an undeniably pure, earthy flavor.

Like a summer day at the lake, Dos Primos Blanco reminds you of good times spent with those who know you best. Sip it straight or mix into your favorite cocktail.

Cooked agave that opens with a bold, herbal flavor and finishes with smooth citrus. Aromas are earthy and herbal with hints of fresh citrus and wildflower.

title: Bibi Graetz Soffocone di Vincigliata 2019
bodyHtml:
Soffocone di Vincigliata is the only wine named by the vineyard of production: the idea is to underline the special link between this wine and the hill where Bibi Graetz started his project. The beautiful vineyard of Vincigliata is facing Firenze with one of the most romantic view of the city, from which Bibi took inspiration for the name and the unique label.

Hints of coffee, leather, and wild berries on the nose with a velvety, silky texture on the palate. The wine has very elegant tannins with a long and persistent finish.

Pair with rare steaks, wild boar and roasted game bird dishes.

title: Empress Elderflower Rose Gin
bodyHtml:
Inspired by their beautiful location in Victoria, British Columbia, Empress Elderflower Rose Gin pays homage to ‘The City of Gardens,’ where flowers blossom nearly year-round. The fresh, floral botanicals create a delicate spirit with a distinctive all-natural rose hue, adding a touch of their home to your next cocktail creation.

Nine beautifully blended botanicals create a delicate spirit with a stunning all-natural rose hue. Empress Elderflower Rose has a rich aroma and a surprisingly understated floral palate. With exquisite citrus and spice notes and a hint of sweetness, Elderflower Rose Gin allows each botanical to shine.

title: Colome Torrontes 2024
bodyHtml: Bodega Colome Torrontés offers the floral notes of roses, the citrus aroma of grapefruit and a spicy hint. In the mouth it is fresh, round and well-bodied with a long, elegant finish.

title: Clementino Della Piana Clemetine Liqueur
bodyHtml:
In the flat areas of Calabria, commonly called plains, grow the precious Clementine fruits born from the cross between bitter oranges and mandarines, which for this reason are locally called 'Mandarance'. The Caffo distillery is located just a few kilometers from the plain of Gioia Tauro (near the ancient Magna Graecia city Medma), where the best fruits used for this liqueur come from.

Clementino Della Piana is a delightful Italian liqueur that is made with fresh, sun-ripened clementines. It has a bright and zesty citrus flavor that is perfectly balanced with a touch of sweetness. This liqueur is perfect for sipping on its own or as an ingredient in a variety of cocktails.

title: Smoking Loon Pinot Grigio 2022
bodyHtml:
Smoking Loon wines display bold, exciting flavors that complement everyday adventures. Each wine is crafted to capture true varietal character, rewarding those willing to migrate beyond the ordinary. Smoking Loon wines have been widely recognized for their outstanding quality since 2001.

The Smoking Loon California Pinot Grigio offers pleasing aromas of freshly squeezed lemon, tangerine peel, and sweet orange blossom. It’s a very light straw color with almost a platinum hue. On the palate, flavors of lemon citrus, lime zest and a wet slate minerality lead to a refreshing and bright finish.

This is an incredibly versatile and food-friendly wine and will go well with a wide variety of dishes.

title: 1924 Buttery Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
1924 – The heart of the prohibition era and wine’s darkest hour when it was deemed illegal. It was also the year 1924's winery first planted vineyards in California and farmed grapes that were sold to friends and neighbors. Story goes some of these grapes might have been used to make wine. For those that dared to toil in the black-market of winemaking, full-bodied red wines were the wine of choice and a crowd favorite at speakeasies across the country. Crafted from the finest fruit grown in select Lodi vineyards, 1924 wines deliver dark, rich flavors in a style reminiscent of the prohibition era.

Golden in color with rich and creamy flavors of vanilla, honey, and butterscotch. Aged on a mixture of French and American oak to create a full-bodied, buttery wine with an opulent finish.

Enjoy this with a baked chicken, seafood risotto, and grilled salmon.

title: Dos Primos Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml:
A premium Reposado made from the finest ingredients, time-honored experience and just a little patience.

They start with their signature blend of 100% pure agave. Then it rests for a minimum of six months in used bourbon barrels to add a little depth and spice.

With warm notes of vanilla and caramel, Dos Primos Reposado is perfect for sharin’ stories around the campfire. Stands well on its own or adds a fancy touch to a cocktail.

title: Ardbeg 25 Year Old
bodyHtml: This release of Ardbeg 25 Year Old is a smoky single malt with layers of sweetness that was matured in ex-bourbon barrels. Aromas of cream, smoke, peppermint, toffee, fennel, pine resin, earthy bonfires and ripe bananas fill the nose, complemented by notes of white pepper, sherbet lemons, candied apples, oranges, pears, tar, carbolic soap, creamy toffee, aniseed, rich smoke and antiseptic throughout the palate.

title: Reservoir Founders Bourbon Batch No. 30
bodyHtml:
Barrel Bourbon Batch 030 began with a group of tropical fruit forward 5-year-old Indiana barrels, a group of stone fruit forward 10-year-old high-rye Tennessee barrels, and a group of nutty 6, 9, 11, and 15-year-old barrels. After mingling separately for a month, they were carefully blended together. Finally, wheated bourbon from Kentucky and Wyoming was added to enhance the complexity of the blend.

Bright and perfumed notes of French cider, inflected with quince and a touch of apple cider vinegar. As your nose adjusts, peach cobbler, pumpkin and fig take over. There’s an earthy side, displaying radishes and butter, tahini, and damp wool. The oak brings coconut macaroon, coriander, and peppermint, without smelling woodsy.

The palate has a sweet and tightly focused entry, tasting of coffee ice cream in an oatmeal raisin cookie sandwich. Basil, fennel seed, and a whole mug of chai round out the herb & spice register. Fruits are subtle but delightfully tropical, around orange curacao, pawpaw, and toasted coconut.

title: Black Stallion Syrah Limited Release 2016
bodyHtml:
Twelve years after arriving in America, in 1924, Gaspare Indelicato planted a vineyard in Manteca, California. With it, he planted the foundation of his eventual success in the California wine trade. Since that first vineyard flourished, Gaspare’s children, grandchildren and great-grandchildren have honored his legacy through dedication to his steadfast values of family, hard work and integrity.

Black Stallion Limited Release Syrah is a concentrated, full-bodied and fruity wine with a delicious velvety aftertaste. The intense aromas of blueberries, blackberries, and cedar compliment the flavors of dark cherries, cassis, and chocolate.

title: Skyy Blood Orange Vodka
bodyHtml:
Skyy Infusions Blood Orange is an alluring infusion of premium SKYY Vodka made with real blood orange, displaying the natural sweetness; deep, refined complexity; and mouth-watering juiciness of the sinful blood orange.

It has an enticing aroma of sweet orange zest followed by juicy real orange pulp and hints of spice and caramel.

title: Florentina Mango
bodyHtml:
Discover the taste of tropical mangoes intertwined with delicate bubbles.​

These beautiful and elegant sparkling wine beverages are inspired by an original Italian method of production. The aromatic complexity and density of perlage outline the core of this special collection. The manufacturing process has been done in such a manner as to preserve the freshness of taste and fruit bouquet.

title: Domaines Ott 'BY.OTT' Cotes de Provence Rose 2025
bodyHtml: Pale and pretty in crystal-clear pink with orange undertones. The nose is delicate and fruity with notes of white peach and apricot mixed with passion fruit and mango. The taste is full, fresh and crisp with echoes of the fruity aroma amplified by citrus zest and sweet spices (cinnamon and cardamom). All of the great Domaines Ott tradition in a friendly and elegant wine.

title: Alois Lageder Pinot Grigio 'Porer' 2023
bodyHtml:
Alois Lageder Porer Pinot Grigio is a white wine made from Pinot Grigio grapes grown in the Porer vineyard in Italy's Alto Adige region. The grapes are hand-harvested and fermented in stainless steel tanks to preserve their delicate flavors and aromas.

The resulting wine is a pale straw yellow with fresh aromas of white peach, pear, and citrus fruits, with subtle floral notes. On the palate, the wine is crisp and refreshing with a lively acidity and flavors of ripe peach and citrus, followed by a hint of almond and a long finish. This versatile wine pairs well with seafood, white meats, and salads, and is best served chilled.

title: F. Thienpont Causse Rouge 2019
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Georges Thienpont is a family heritage that has been flourishing since 1842. Every generation of heirs has helped to build their network among the vineyards of Bordeaux, and they now oversee twenty estates.

title: Decugnano Dei Barbi Mare Antico Orvieto 2023
bodyHtml:
The Mare Antico is a blend of the best fruit from the estate vineyards. The grapes are sourced from 25 year old vines grown in soils particularly rich with fossilized shells and oysters. The grapes are fermented separately and carefully blended. Mare Antico is a wine of great elegance, well balanced and very mineral: the best expression of Decugnano’s terroir.

A blend of Grechetto, Vermentino, Chardonnay and Procanico, this wine sees 5% french oak barrel fermented and the rest is done in stainless steel.

title: Ca'Secco Sparkling
bodyHtml:
Crafted in small batches from tantalizing white varietals and Pinot Noir, this Sparkling White dazzles with toasted brioche, caramel, and pear aromas. By using the Charmat Method (Metodo Italiano), they add a liqueur de tirage to their still wine in a sealed tank to induce a second fermentation with CO2 to invoke exceptional minerality that dances on the palate.

Pairs with... Herb fried chicken, four cheese pizza and homemade cannoli’s.

title: Paul John Pedro Ximenez Select Cask
bodyHtml:
This whisky takes its name from the famous Pedro Ximenez barrels that it rests for 2 years after 5 years in 1st fill ex-Bourbon barrels. Last year’s stunning Christmas Edition 2019 was obviously a sign for this bottle. PX casks that are used for this whisky are very very old PX Butts from Andalucia, Spain and matured in Goa, India under an angel’s share of 8-10%.

This is an incredible liquid with layers of flavors and quality. Starting from the nose, until the last feeling in the finish is sublime! Paul John PX Select Cask is definitely a ‘sit down and enjoy’ whisky. If you are a cigar smoker, it will even accompany your late-night cigar or reading.

title: Les Halos de Jupiter Chateauneuf du Pape 'Adrastee' 2020
bodyHtml:
Like Leo, noble and engaging, this cuvée is the quintessence of Chateauneuf du Pape, where Grenache is king, and “La Crau” is its secret garden.

Adrastee is rare -- the singular satellite of the Halos de Jupiter.

Very elegant and harmonious, this wine displays a perfect balance between power and finesse.

title: Florentina Peach
bodyHtml:
Florentina Peach Wine is a delicious fruit wine produced in the beautiful country of Moldova. Made from locally grown peaches, this wine has a vibrant golden color and a distinct peach aroma that is both sweet and inviting. On the palate, it is light-bodied and refreshing, with a delicate balance of sweetness and acidity that makes it a perfect wine to enjoy on its own or paired with light desserts or fruity salads.

Florentina Peach Wine is a great example of the quality and diversity of wines that Moldova has to offer, and it is sure to delight wine enthusiasts and casual drinkers alike with its unique flavor profile and refreshing taste.

title: Florentina Strawberry
bodyHtml:
Florentina Strawberry Wine is a delightful fruit wine produced in the beautiful country of Moldova. Made from locally grown strawberries, this wine has a vibrant pink hue and a luscious aroma of ripe strawberries that is both sweet and enticing. On the palate, it is light-bodied and refreshing, with a delicate balance of sweetness and acidity that makes it a perfect wine to enjoy on its own or paired with light desserts or fruity salads.

Florentina Strawberry Wine is a great example of the quality and diversity of wines that Moldova has to offer, and it is sure to delight wine enthusiasts and casual drinkers alike with its unique flavor profile and refreshing taste.

title: Gustave Lorentz Gewurztraminer 'Evidence' Organic 2023
bodyHtml:
Gustave Lorentz Gewurztraminer 'Evidence' originates from the Alsace region of France, where the Lorentz family has cultivated vines in the village of Bergheim since 1836. The estate is deeply committed to sustainability, having transitioned all of its owned vineyard property to organic viticulture beginning in 2009, with full certification achieved by 2012. The 'Evidence' line represents the winery’s dedication to producing wines that prioritize freshness, balance, and purity, reflecting the unique terroir of their clay-limestone hillside plots while avoiding the "heaviness" sometimes associated with the variety.

Wine Description

This white wine exhibits a clear, pale-to-golden yellow appearance in the glass, with a structure characterized by its ample, round, and full-bodied nature. The sensory profile is highly expressive and aromatic, featuring a classic, intense bouquet of lychee, rose petals, and delicate spices such as cinnamon. On the palate, it delivers a powerful, sophisticated experience that balances vibrant fruit flavors—including hints of citrus and mango—with a taut, fresh acidity that prevents the wine from becoming cloying. The finish is remarkably long and lingering, maintaining a consistent impression of exotic spice and floral purity.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Gewürztraminer.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is vinified to be off-dry (typically containing residual sugar between 16 and 25 g/L depending on the vintage), which provides a rich, opulent texture while maintaining gastronomic versatility.

  • ABV: Typically ranges from 14% to 14.6% depending on the specific harvest year.

  • Organic Status: Certified organic (FR-BIO-01).

title: Domaine William Fevre Chablis 'Montmains' Premier Cru 2022
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1959, Domaine William Fevre is at the very heart of the Chablis vineyards. Since its founding, Domaine William Fevre has been taken up with the desire to produce indisputable genuine and fine wines, bringing along a very personal experience in Chardonnay. All the efforts have but one goal – to finely express the subtle most variations in the greatest Chablis crus. Today, Domaine William Fevre is one of the most established and renowned estates in Chablis.

Consisting of roughly equal parts Montmains, Butteaux and Forets (the three sous-climats of Montmains), the Chablis 1er Cru Montmains offers up aromas of crisp green apple, white flowers, bee pollen and oyster shell. Medium to full-bodied, satiny and concentrated, it’s taut and precise, concluding with a saline finish.

title: The Gnu Normal London Dry Gin
bodyHtml: The Gnu Normal London Dry Gin was created to be a go-to gin that the whole herd can enjoy. Every small batch is made with Western Canadian juniper berries, grains from the Alberta prairies, and sun-dried orange and grapefruit peel which elevates the fresh, citrus taste, making it perfect for a dry martini, G&T, or your favourite cocktail.

title: Drappier Grande Sendree Brut 2015
bodyHtml: This wine offers a great balance between the rich, structured Pinot Noir and the mineral Chardonnay. From a very fine vintage, it reveals intense flavours, layers of ripe apple and a taut texture that promises further aging.

title: Dillon's Limoncello
bodyHtml:
Crafted using our 100% Niagara grape spirit base that fresh lemons and lemon peel are steeped in along with cardamon and lemon verbena.
Half the sweetness of a traditional Limoncello, think more like grown-up boozy lemonade than sweet, sweet Limoncello.
Makes the perfect after dinner treat or in a Limoncello Mule.

title: Main Divide Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: The wine is pale lemon in colour, with vibrant tropical fruit aromas of passionfruit and lychees. Layered beneath there are hints of gooseberry, citrus and dried herbs. The palate is generous, yet remains fresh and lively, with a satisfying crisp finish.

title: Slow Press Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from the United States, produced in the California region. Slow Press is a brand within the Corby Spirit and Wine Limited portfolio, with winemaking led by veteran winecrafter Blake Bomben. The winery's philosophy is captured by the mantra 'Quality takes time', serving as a homage to traditional craftsmanship through the use of gentle grape handling and a slowed fermentation process to generate a pure, concentrated fruit character.

Wine Description

The Slow Press Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep violet colour. The nose is aromatic and complex, offering scents of black cherry, blackberry, and cassis complemented by notes of vanilla, caramel, and toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and velvety, featuring layers of dark fruit, mocha, and liquorice balanced by soft tannins and a subtle oak sweetness. It is characterized by its robust structure and a long, satisfying finish with lingering notes of plum, cocoa, and warm spice. This wine is primarily composed of Cabernet Sauvignon grapes sourced from premium regions including Paso Robles, Lodi, and Monterey. The ABV is 13.5%, and while the wine is crafted from sustainable vineyards certified by the Lodi Rules program, it is not certified organic.

title: Chateau Le Rey Les Argileuses 2021
bodyHtml: This wine does not represent a usual Bordeaux bottle, but is more like Burgundy style with a terroir philosophy. To be served chilled, after 1 hour of aeration. The pureness of "Les Argileuses" is so beautiful with wonderful depth of fruit and balance. The wine is full bodied and reveals intense flavours of liquorice and black berries. Round and polished tannins. Resounding purity.

title: Midleton Very Rare Irish Whiskey 2025 Vintage Release
bodyHtml:
Midleton Very Rare 2025 Vintage Release is a prestigious blended Irish whiskey originating from County Cork, Ireland. This milestone edition celebrates the 200th anniversary of the Midleton Distillery, which has been a beacon of whiskey-making excellence since its establishment in 1825. Under the stewardship of Master Distiller Kevin O'Gorman, the distillery continues its philosophy of marrying traditional craftsmanship with modern innovation, meticulously selecting only the finest casks from the historic A2 Warehouse.

Whisky Description

The 2025 vintage presents a radiant golden hue, reminiscent of sunlit hay. The aromatic profile is complex and inviting, opening with sweet waves of caramelised apple, toffee fudge, and vanilla, which are gradually joined by delicate floral notes of lavender and freshly picked garden mint. On the palate, the whiskey is smooth and silky, revealing textured layers of sweet honeycomb, soft orchard fruits, and zesty citrus. These flavors are beautifully balanced by a gentle heat of white pepper and a hint of chilli oil, leading into a rich, lasting finish where the fruit notes slowly fade to leave a final impression of seasoned oak and pot still spices.

title: Two Stacks 'The Blenders Cut' Cask Strength Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Adopting the same complex blend that gives Two Stacks — The First Cut its distinct character, The Blenders Cut — Cask Strength showcases its true identity. Allowing each component to be rested in hand-selected casks, imparting a refined flavour and finish.

This limited and specially blended whiskey is given the time and patience required for that delicate balance—a perfect marriage of nature & nurture; a whiskey to be enjoyed neat & never rushed.

title: Graffigna Malbec Reserve 2023
bodyHtml: Profound and fruit forward aromas, with ripe red berries, sweet spices and a hint of black pepper backed by toasted notes from its oak aging. Structured and balanced, with ripe tannins and fresh acidity that leads to toasted and vanilla hints on the finish.

title: Bornholmer Akvavit
bodyHtml: Akvavit's name comes from aqua vitae, Latin for 'water of life'. The classic Bornholmer Akvavit is a clear spirit with a lingering finish of caraway and dill.

title: Johnnie Walker Black Label - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: As many as forty whiskies make up this satisfyingly complex blend. The nose and flavour are a wonderful combination of dry smokiness, with rich malt and peat overtones balanced by hints of cedar and fruit with trademark dark chocolate and vanilla sweetness.

title: Dictador Platinum Rum
bodyHtml:
Dictador Platinum Rum is made from the fermentation of unique virgin sugar cane honey, then distilled in a modern stainless steel alembic. It is then aged in pre-used quality oak barrels from Jerez and Port that now and again reburn to caramelize the interior to achieve sweet flavours from the oak.

By carefully hand selecting barrels from each year's vintage using the highest level of technology and our secret method, our master blender uses all his skills to create the most exquisite blended rum, which is then approved for bottling at the highest standard.


Colour Deep, noble mahogany shine, an unforgettable colour in the glass

Aroma Hypnotic aroma, intricately roasted honey, pure vanilla, royal toffee, mature oak and parfait caramel

Palate In the mouth, it is incredibly smooth with a range of exquisite flavours starting with fudge, intense vanilla, parfait caramel, and Colombian coffee. A long consistency is balanced with light oak, giving the sensation of extreme quality and satisfaction of sweetness and strength

Finish Long, rich finish

title: Liquidity Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Grown and picked specifically for Rose, the Pinot Noir for this wine comes from the estate vineyards in Oliver. The block was hand picked in two separate picks, each capturing a unique, rose-esque flavour profile.

The fruit was meticulously hand sorted and gently whole cluster pressed. A small amount of skin contact time allowed for the extraction of the beautiful peachy pink hues, and fermentation vessels were picked to match the flavour profile of each pressload. Stainless steel (70%) emphasized the crisp, citrus-driven aromatics; while, concrete tulip (30%) brings texture and minerality to the palate.

title: Kentucky Owl Takumi Edition Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Kentucky Owl Takumi Edition is a rare and exclusive small-batch whiskey that balances modern distilling techniques with classic Bourbon-making skills and traditional Japanese oak barrel maturation.

Kentucky Owl’s Takumi Edition started with a dream of blending whiskey by hand with Suntory’s Master Blender, Yahisa. This led to a partnership between the two distillers and created an extremely unique product.
