Kentucky Owl Takumi Edition Bourbon Whiskey is a blend of 4 year, 5 year, 6 year and 13 year old Kentucky straight bourbons with a mash bill containing corn, rye or wheat, and malted barley. It has a light rye bread note on the nose, and a caramel and hint of fruit on the palate. The finish is flavorful and long.

title: Kentucky Owl Batch No. 12 Bourbon
bodyHtml:
For Batch #12, Rhea blended very particular well aged, bold bourbons: 7- to 14-year-old bourbons are blended with two different 4-year-old bourbons to create this unique blend. 

The nose has sweet spice and caramel notes, with a hint of butterscotch and a long bouquet pleasant aroma. The taste is a pleasant rush of warm spice with a robust caramel and cream sensation that melts into hints of passion fruit and spicy citrus. The finish is long and pleasant, with the caramel and cream lingering.

title: Terralsole Brunello di Montalcino 2016 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This is a rare treat, very limited supply, aged to perfection.  This fruit-forward vintage has matured into a rich, opulent, decadent Riserva,

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Pressed rose, slightly dusty mineral shadings, spice and black fruit make up the bouquet of this elegant, harmonious wine. This expression is astringent and firm, with bright acidity and a solid tannic backbone. Let it soften with more cellar aging.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A beam of cherry is at the core, with spice and tobacco notes adding interest. This is rich and harmonious, as solid structure provides support. Fine length.

title: Terralsole Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2006
bodyHtml:
This 5-star vintage of our Brunello Riserva is powerful and bold yet remains balanced and very drinkable. Hitting its stride in 2015, this spectacular vintage will continue to develop and mature for many years to come.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

A beam of cherry is at the core, with spice and tobacco notes adding interest. This is rich and harmonious, as solid structure provides support. Fine length. 1,500 cases made.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Pressed rose, slightly dusty mineral shadings, spice and black fruit make up the bouquet of this elegant, harmonious wine. This expression is astringent and firm, with bright acidity and a solid tannic backbone. Let it soften with more cellar aging.

title: The Macallan 25 Year Old
bodyHtml:
This astonishing 25-year-old is one of the most revered whiskies in the world. It received a perfect 100 out of 100 score from the Beverage Testing Institute in Chicago in 1999. It also received a Gold at the International Spirits Challenge.

Very fruity, with notes of orange and pear on the nose. It also has a good dollop of sweet spices, which develop into an almost smoky character. The sherry on the nose is refined and well-balanced, with hints of honey and caramel. Textbook malt delivery gives way to a mouthful of dried apricots, prunes and figs. Hints of nutmeg and cinnamon weave in and out of an epic whack of honey that only a Speyside distillery of this kind of nobility can produce. A long, full finish that carries fig, spices, chewy oak and a touch of light smoke.

For more information, visit The Macallan Website.

title: Terralsole Brunello Di Montalcino 'Vigna Fonte Lattaia' 2015
bodyHtml: Cherry, berry, mineral and tobacco flavors hold court in this well-defined red. Borders on racy, courtesy of the vivid acidity, with well-mannered tannins running underneath. Shows terrific balance and complexity, featuring a long, savory aftertaste.

title: Kentucky Owl Wiseman Rye
bodyHtml: The Wiseman Straight Rye is a traditional Rye made with a mash bill of 95% Rye. A spicy nose progresses to the taste, filling the mouth and tickling the tastebuds. The long finish starts as fresh rye bread and moves slowly toward buttered cinnamon toast, ending with just a hint of English walnut.

title: Terralsole Grappa di Brunello - 500 ml
bodyHtml: This grappa is distilled exclusively from Sangiovese pomace, which comes from the production of Brunello di Terralsole. Winemaker Mario Bollag personally brings them to a small distillery in Tuscany, where they are distilled with great care. The grappa is then matured in used French oak barrels made from Troncais oak for at least 2 years before enjoying further bottle storage.  This is a very elegant and complex grappa with aromas of dried fruit, some tobacco and wood, orange zest, sweet spices, and a long-lasting finish.  Enjoy as a digestif or anytime!

title: Garrison Brothers Honeydew Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Garrison Brothers Honeydew Bourbon is a premium honey infused spirit from the United States, specifically crafted in the Texas Hill Country of Hye. Founded in 2006 by Dan Garrison, Garrison Brothers Distillery holds the distinction of being the first legal bourbon distillery in Texas and the first to produce bourbon outside of Kentucky. The family owned operation follows a grain to glass principle, managing every step of production on site under the leadership of Master Distiller Donnis Todd.

Spirit Description

This expression is built upon the distillery's Small Batch Texas Straight Bourbon, which is aged for at least three to four years in new American white oak casks. To achieve its signature profile, used bourbon barrel staves are cut into small cubes, immersed in Burleson's Texas Wildflower Honey, and then placed in a stainless steel tank with the bourbon for seven months to impart their flavours.

  • Colour: The spirit presents a deep golden amber or warm amber hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is complex and sweet, featuring aromas of elderberry syrup, wildflowers, and honey pineapple cake, alongside notes of toasted oak, caramel, and vanilla.

  • Palate: It delivers a creamy and smooth mouthfeel with layers of golden honey, elderberry, and caramel that give way to wood tannins, black pepper, cardamom, and apricots.

  • Body: The bourbon is characterized by a light and approachable body that balances artisanal sweetness with bold bourbon character.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long and silky finish marked by fresh flowers, sultana grapes, toasted bread, and a lingering warmth of white chocolate and espresso.

  • ABV: This bourbon is bottled at 40%.

title: Garrison Brothers Balmorhea Bourbon
bodyHtml: This magnificent Texas Straight Bourbon Whiskey is bold but majestically-crafted, having been aged four years in new American white oak barrels, then transferred to a second new American white oak barrel, and aged for one year. Simply put, this 2-time US Micro Whisky of the Year and San Francisco Double Gold winner is bourbon candy in a bottle.

title: Fattoria del Pino Brunello di Montalcino 2019
bodyHtml: Jessica Pellegrini of Fattoria Del Pino is a rising star in Montalcino. Her winery was born in 2000, two years after her father Nerio purchased 7 hectares of land in the Montosoli. She produces lovely wines from this small plot located in northern Montalcino.

title: Louis Guntrum Pinot Noir 2019
bodyHtml: Ruby red colour, beautiful play of colours, cherry and raspberry like flavours and aromas. A hint of oak from the barrique barrel ageing, well balanced, soft acidity and ripe finish.

title: La Capuccina Nebbiolo Colline Novaresi 'Opera 32' 2018
bodyHtml:
Italy’s Piedmont region, in the northwest of the country, is famed for its noble red wines, particularly those made from the Nebbiolo grape. Colline Novaresi, a subregion in the northern part of Piedmont, offers a cooler climate and volcanic soils that lend unique elegance to its wines. La Capuccina is a family-run estate with deep roots in sustainable agriculture and minimal intervention winemaking, preserving the authenticity of the terroir. Their 'Opera 32' line celebrates limited productions with expressive profiles and strong regional character.

Wine Description
This 2018 Nebbiolo displays a luminous ruby hue with garnet highlights, typical of the varietal. Aromas open with violets, dried roses, and tart red cherries, followed by subtle notes of earth, spice, and leather. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with vibrant acidity and firm, fine-grained tannins. Flavours of cranberry, wild strawberry, and orange peel lead to a savoury, mineral-inflected finish.

Accolades
Vinous – 91 points.

Food Pairing
Ideal with mushroom risotto, veal scaloppine, or aged cheeses such as Taleggio or Fontina. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Bodegas Breca Rose 2020
bodyHtml: An elegant Rosé produced from the original clones worldwide of the Garnacha grape, characterized by delicate floral aromatics.

title: Rocca di Montemassi Calasole Vermentino 2019
bodyHtml: Brilliant straw-yellow colour. Aromas of white flowers, with spicy notes and hints of just barely ripe fruit. The palate is substantial yet fresh, with citrus hints and almondy notes. The 2019 Rocca di Montemassi Calasole is a compelling and lovely white wine.

title: Adelsheim Chardonnay Staking Claim 2018
bodyHtml:
Established in 1971, Adelsheim is a family-owned and operated winery with estate vineyards located in Oregon's northern Willamette Valley. Over the past 41 years, the Adelsheim Vineyard estate has grown to include twelve exception vineyard sites throughout the Valley, totaling 237 acres. 

Company co-founder, David Adelsheim, has done work throughout the years to benefit both the Oregon and American wine industries: grape and wine research, wine labeling, industry education, and promotion. He is recognized for his 'outstanding service' to the industry and has played a vital role in building the Oregon wine industry and establishing its reputation worldwide.

There is a ton of perfect, ripe Bosc pear on the nose, accompanied by fragrant, spicy florals and an elusive note. The texture is luscious yet refreshing. This wine will pair well with a late spring picnic, dappled sunshine, and nothing else to do.

93 Points - James Suckling

This has a complex and composed feel with a well fitted array of peach and citrus, praline and honeysuckle. Smooth-honed palate that holds a long, fresh and linear shape. Gently stony notes to close. Fruit and oak so melted together.

title: Terralsole Rosso Di Montalcino 2018
bodyHtml: Terralsole is a small family-run winery that has 12 hectares (30 acres), combining two distinctive terroirs in Montalcino to create full-bodied, balanced wines. The Pian Bossolino vineyards surround the winery and Villa Terralsole. It sits at 1,200 feet on the southeastern slope of Montalcino, enjoying cooler weather and excellent ventilation. The vines ripen slowly and evenly, producing expressive aromas and elegant flavors in the wine.

title: Andeluna Cabernet Sauvignon 'Altitud' 2019
bodyHtml:
The grapes used for producing this wine were extracted from the vineyards in the Uco Valley, Mendoza, at 1.300 mt (4,300 ft.) above sea level. This area is characterized by its wide thermal amplitude, which allows for grapes of great intensity in colour, an important aromatic expression and excellent natural acidity.

FULL-BODIED, BLACK CHERRY, BLACKBERRY, CASSIS, GREEN HERBS, PEPPER, SPICE, OAK

Established in 2003 in the foothills of the highest part of the Andes, the name Andeluna became a poetic homage to the world's most extensive mountain range and to the "moon that baths it in light." Fleshy and intense, the Altitud is an authoritative wine with concentrated fruit, ripe tannins, and a lasting finish supported by necessary acidity.

title: Louis Cheze Cornas 2022
bodyHtml: The wine's intense garnet hue catches the eye, while the nose is greeted with a captivating bouquet of blackberry and chocolate aromas. On the palate, it is abundant and indulgent, with a pleasing fullness that satisfies the senses.

title: Terralsole Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva 2015 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Terralsole in Italian means ”Land Toward the Sun.” It was established in 1996 and is owned and operated by Mario Bollag and Athena Tergis.

Plum, leather, eucalyptus, violet and botanical herb aromas lead the nose on this fragrant red.

Try pairing it with wild boar pappardelle.

title: Robert Mondavi Fume Blanc To Kalon Oakville 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'historic' white wine originates from the United States, within the highly celebrated Oakville AVA of the central Napa Valley floor. Officially designated as "The Reserve," this expression honors the legendary pioneering vision of Robert Mondavi, who single-handedly coined the term "Fumé Blanc" in the late 1960s to completely redefine dry, oak-aged California Sauvignon Blanc. Sourced for this vintage exclusively from the prestigious Monastery Block within the grand cru-caliber To Kalon Vineyard, the estate operates under a philosophy of terroir precision. Rooted in deep, well-drained gravelly soils, the mature vines benefit from an ideal microclimate that naturally infuses the fruit with a perfect equilibrium of solar concentration and mineral tension.

Wine Description

Robert Mondavi 'The Reserve' To Kalon Vineyard Fumé Blanc presents a beautiful pale gold appearance with brilliant greenish highlights in the glass. Its sensory profile is powerful, tightly wound, and beautifully expressive, unfolding a high-toned bouquet of white orchard blossoms, fresh lemons, lime zest, and grapefruit layered with complex nuances of pastry shop, white pepper, warm croissant, and coconut. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and impressively structured, showcasing a rich, expansive core of juicy pear, melon, ripe fig, and mango. It is characterized by its outstanding, electric natural acidity that gives it brilliant focus and an almost chewy, phenolic texture. The mouthfeel is intricate and deep, driven by bracing saline accents and a smoky, crushed-stone minerality that glides into a lengthy, tightly sculpted finish highlighted by persistent notes of zest, flint, and fine wood spice.

title: Crown Royal - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Aging in both new and seasoned white oak barrels give Crown Royal its unique flavour profile that has garnered fans the world over. Light amber in colour the nose is lightly floral with corn, buttery/vanilla and peach aromas; on the palate look for light sweet peach flavour with wood spice on a dry finish.

title: Doudet Naudin Savigny les Beaune Premier Cru 'Aux Guettes' 2018
bodyHtml:
Located 3 km north of Beaune, which it borders, Savigny stretches out from a large valley which, through its multiple exposures, brings great richness and remarkable diversity to its wines. The Guettes plot, classified as a 1er Cru, is one of the most marked exposures of the village, in particular because of its southern exposure. It gives frank and fruity wines characterized by their long aging.

Its colour is a deep dark red with brown reflections. The nose is concentrated and rich, marked by aromas of blackberry, plum, kirsch cherries and wild nuances. On the palate, the wine is velvety, concentrated and silky, revealing fine, well integrated tannins and small spices that deepen the complexity and origin of its terroir.

title: Pieri Agostina Rosso di Montalcino 2022
bodyHtml:
This is one domain that takes great pride in its Rosso, treating it much like the Brunello. Pieri is the only producer ever to earn Gambero Rosso’s prestigious Tre Bicchieri score for a “mere” Rosso di Montalcino. That wine, the 1995, caused a sensation with its amazing concentration and persistance— it easily outpaced most Brunellos and set a new benchmark for the appellation. 

The Pieri Rosso seeks for the best balance between tradition and modernity. There’s always precocious Sangiovese fruit, but it is coupled with the modest color and substantial texture of the best traditional wines.

title: Rombauer Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Rombauer Vineyards is a Napa Valley based, family-owned winery founded in 1980 by Koerner and Joan Rombauer. Dedicated to providing gracious hospitality, the Rombauer family and staff take pride in creating joyful moments for their customers across the country and at their Napa Valley and Sierra Foothills tasting rooms.

The color is intense and beautiful, almost black with purple, reddish hues. Aromas of black cherry, cassis, piecrust, spice, and mint mingle and leap from the glass. The palate is full and concentrated with similar aromas but also featuring black currant and sweet red cherry with the mild presence of oak, seamlessly integrated. Signature finely structured tannins and balanced acidity give way to a long finish which continues to build after that last sip.

title: Rombauer Chardonnay Proprietor Selection 2023
bodyHtml:
Rombauer Vineyards is a Napa Valley based, family-owned winery founded in 1980 by Koerner and Joan Rombauer. Dedicated to providing gracious hospitality, the Rombauer family and staff take pride in creating joyful moments for their customers across the country and at their Napa Valley and Sierra Foothills tasting rooms.

A beautiful pale yellow, there are multifaceted layers of aromas including caramelized pineapple, lemon rind, baked green apple, toast, and vanilla. The densely concentrated palate features notes of powerful stone fruit, floral honey, baking spice, and vanilla, all building, with a fresh, mouthwatering acidity, to a long and lingering finish.

title: Montes Alpha Special Cuvee Chardonnay 2020
bodyHtml:
The nose features standout ripe tropical fruit aromas of pineapple and banana accompanied by white fruits that recall peaches, while the coastal climate makes itself felt in the subtle notes of artichoke hearts.

The palate is quite fresh, but with generous volume, very enjoyable acidity, and a wonderfully persistent finish.

title: Chateau Haut Brion 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Chateau Haut-Brion is the oldest and by far the smallest of the "Premiers Grands Crus" vineyards of the Gironde 1855 classification. Chateau Haut-Brion is one of the few remaining family-owned domains of the Bordeaux region with a history going back to the 16th century. It has been owned by the American Dillon family since 1935. Thanks to its long history as one of Bordeaux's most prestigious wines, the estate has left its mark on the region for centuries.

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2018 Haut-Brion is composed of 49.4% Merlot, 38.7% Cabernet Sauvignon and 11.9% Cabernet Franc. Deep garnet-purple in color, the wine needs a lot of swirling before it begins to release a whole complex melody of notes, one at a time to begin: tilled earth, followed by pronounced licorice, then crushed rocks, then the preserved plums. Eventually, it all comes together into a fascinating crescendo of intense crème de cassis, rose oil, wild blueberries and kirsch notes, giving way to quiet, persistent leitmotif scents of cinnamon stick, truffles and redcurrant jelly. The medium to full-bodied palate delivers all this and more, revealing tightly wound black fruit, red berry and exotic spice layers within a solid, wonderfully plush frame and seamless freshness, finishing with epic length and loads of earth and mineral sparks.

99 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of currants, leaves, fresh mushrooms, oyster shell, tobacco, and dried flowers, following through to a full body, yet ever so refined and polished and it grows on the palate. Lovely, energetic finish. Subtle and driven at the end of the palate. Drink in 2026 and onwards.

98 Points - Decanter

A beautiful Haut-Brion that combines generosity and elegance. It's rich, and velvety, with a vibrant ruby rim, all conveying structure and a sense of power. The flavour floods in through the mid-palate, displaying wonderfully vibrant blackberry, blueberry, slate, touches of blond tobacco, freshly cut herbs and exotic spicing. You can feel in the texture that it's a warm year, not holding back. It's powerful but elegant and unforced at the same time, with some brambled edges that give a welcome sense of acidity and a touch of bitterness.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

98 Points - Wine Spectator

96+ Points - Wine Enthusiast

title: Averill Creek Joue Rose 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Not for the faint of heart, a powerful, intense blend, full of bright fruit flavour, balanced with a dried-flower savouriness. This not-so-little number will entice you towards another bite of food, another sip of wine, and repeat. Pinot Noir and Foch were pressed-off, and destemmed whole berry Gewurztraminer and Pinot Gris were added to the red juice. A red ferment in essence, but with a cap of white berries. It was punched down about once daily, then pressed off, blended and left in the tank on primary lees until bottling. No yeast, nutrients, enzymes, or sulphites are added, unfiltered and unfined.

title: Poderi dal Nespoli Pinot Nero 2018
bodyHtml: From the Emilia-Romagna wine region, Poderi Del Nespoli is produced from 100% Pinot Nero. This is a full-bodied, rustic and concentrated red with a mouthful of dark cherry, dark plum, ripe red berry, blueberry and toasty oak spice aromas and flavours on the palate. A rich and generous Italian red with velvety tannins and excellent value.

title: Chateau Brane Cantenac 2015 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Established in the 18th century, at which time it was known as "Gorce", this large estate is located on the best gravelly outcrops of Cantenac. A century before the 1855 classification, it was considered one of the best second growths in the Médoc. In 1833, Baron de Brane (called "Napoleon of the Vines") sold his estate in Pauillac, Brane-Mouton, and bought Gorce, which he renamed "Brane-Cantenac", ten years later.

Lucien Lurton's grandfather acquired the estate in 1925, and was succeeded by his grandson in 1956. Lucien Lurton's son, Henri, currently manages the estate and puts all his efforts into producing a great Margaux in each and every vintage, reflecting Brane-Cantenac's superb vineyard soil.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Rich, fruity and with great potential, this ripe wine is also dense with firm tannins. Its juicy fruits are a part of a package with the concentrated tannins and smoky wood flavors that allow for long aging. This is an impressive wine from one of the Margaux properties owned by the Lurton family. 

94 Points - James Suckling

Quite impressive ripe dark plums and blackberries with sweet, earthy depth and cedary background oak on the nose. The palate has smooth, slick tannins that carry rich dark fruit long and fresh. This has terrific energy and depth. Really vibrant. Incredible length.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

This medium to full-bodied beauty excels on all accounts and gives up gorgeous notes of blackcurrants, lead pencil, spice and hints of toasted bread. Polished, impeccably balanced, concentrated, and with ripe tannin, it’s a rock star in 2015 that can be drunk young or cellared for 20-25 years. Bravo!

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Silky and refined, with seductive crushed plum and raspberry fruit that glides along, perfectly melded with singed alder and mesquite notes along with black tea and warm licorice details. A violet element hangs in the background, adding to the elegance.

93 Points - Decanter

Beautifully concentrated floral, fragrant fruit plus minerally depth with smoothness to come. A very fine wine from this on-form second growth.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2015 Brane-Cantenac is medium to deep garnet-purple in color with a nose of crushed black berries and chocolate-covered cherries with touches of fried herbs and tilled soil. Medium-bodied, refreshing and elegant in the mouth, with chewy tannins, it has an herbal lift on the finish.

title: Val di Suga Brunello di Montalcino 2016
bodyHtml:
A historical producer in Montalcino that dates back to the 1960’s. Val di Suga is a pioneer in the production of the terroir-driven Brunello and the only producer making three single vineyards in three different estates: Vigna del Lago in the North-East, Vinga Spuntali in the South-West and Poggio al Granchio in the South-East. Because of the different micro-climates, soils and winemaking styles, the wines show different expressions of Sangiovese.

This is a very concentrated Brunello that combines intense notes of blood orange with a hint of chinotto mixed with complex Mediterranean spices (Helichrysum Thyme and Broom Flowers). It is a wine with a strong nerve, a vibrant acid structure that sustains a concentrated mouthfeel, rich in silky tannins. The finish is extremely long and soft.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2016 Brunello di Montalcino has aromatics of menthol and medicinal herbs, brushed leather, and black cherry. The palate is dark fruited without weight, marked with dried blackberry, black tea, dried herbs, and classically balanced structure. It is sourced from three different vineyard sites of various exposition on the hill of Montalcino. This will be ready to drink a touch earlier and be great to check in on over the next 15 years. Drink 2022-2036

94 Points - James Suckling

Dusty notes with crushed gravel and dried tea leaves are a prelude to aromas of fresh button mushrooms and hints of fennel. Savoury mushrooms and olives, followed by a firm, fine-grained tannins. Structured and full-bodied.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Aromas of iron, blood and cherry lead off in this smooth and vibrant red, with a well of dark fruit—black cherry and blackberry—settling in on the palate. Offers a dusting of dark chocolaty tannins on the finish. Best from 2023 through 2043. 1,500 cases imported.

91 Points - Decanter

title: James Ownby Reserve Tennessee Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Most men live lives of quiet desperation, but James Ownby was not most men. Before there was an ‘America’, or a land called ‘Tennessee’, there was man, named James Ownby, who braved the unsettled frontier and forged an enduring family legacy. As a soldier, he was dedicated. His most notable service came as a member of the renowned ‘Overmountain Men’ regiment under the command of Colonel John Sevier in the Battle of Kings Mountain – a battle which Thomas Jefferson fittingly deemed "the turn of the tide of success."

As a pioneer, he was prolific. James set down roots in the area surrounding the Great Smoky Mountains and built a life for himself and his family. The Ownby’s became known as one of the original five families who significantly settled in the state we now call Tennessee and the acorns from his family tree have become a mighty grove of oaks across the once wild land.

Charcoal filtered using the Lincoln County Process and aged in virgin American charred oak barrels, James Ownby Reserve Tennessee Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a rich, warm, deep caramel, easy-sipping spirit with a distinctly southern soul.

title: Schiopetto Merlot 2020
bodyHtml:
The vinification in steel, the lower alcohol and extractive potential, combined with the freshness of the aromas make this a fresh and exciting red wine that well represents the characteristics of the Friuli area.

A bouquet of wild berries and gentle balsamic notes are the main characteristic of this young Merlot from Friuli. Soft palate with good voluptuous spices, berries and liquorices notes.

title: Alvear Amontillado
bodyHtml:
This fortified style wine originates from Spain, produced in the Montilla Moriles region within Andalusia. Founded in 1729, Bodegas Alvear is one of the oldest wineries in Spain and remains family owned. Made entirely from Pedro Ximénez grapes naturally high in sugar, the base wine achieves its alcohol strength naturally during fermentation before undergoing decades of aging in traditional American oak solera systems.

Spirit Description

This expression displays a deep mahogany and amber hue with brilliant copper clarity. The nose is intense and deeply complex, offering aromas of toasted hazelnut, roasted almond, caramel, and saddle leather, accompanied by subtle nuances of dried fig, marmalade, and sea salt. On the palate, it is bone dry and medium to full bodied with a sharp, vibrant acidity. Distinct flavours of walnut, orange zest, dried fruit, and saline minerality dominate the mouth, leading into a rich umami character. The finish is remarkably long, dry, and savory, leaving a persistent impression of toasted wood spice and dried nuts. Bottled at an ABV of 17%, it delivers impressive elegance, freshness, and structural complexity.

title: San Polino Brunello di Montalcino Helichrysum 2017
bodyHtml:
The history of San Polino goes back at least 1,000 years to when the gravel road that runs down past the farmhouse constituted the main road which connected the area of the Monte Amiata to Siena. It could be that the farmstead of San Polino was founded as early as in the 10th century, following the Barbaric invasions which had forced the inhabitants of the Etruscan city of Roselle to seek refuge in the protective areas of the rich and powerful Abbey of Sant’Antimo.

Taking its name from an aromatic wild herb, San Polino Brunello di Montalcino Helichrysum comes from the highest vineyards on the San Polino site. It is always elegant, opulent and structured.

title: Highland Park 15 Year Old 'Viking Heart'
bodyHtml:
Highland Park 15 Year Old Viking Heart is a single malt Scotch whisky from the Orkney Islands, a region known for its unique Scandi Scottish heritage. The distillery was founded in 1798 by Magnus Eunson, who was famously a butcher and church official by day and an illicit distiller by night. Today, the distillery is owned by Edrington and remains one of the few in Scotland to continue using traditional floor maltings for a portion of its production.

Spirit Description

This expression is matured in a combination of first fill sherry seasoned European oak casks, which contribute warm spicy notes, and first fill sherry seasoned American oak casks that provide sweet vanilla. A small proportion of refill casks is added to the marriage to soften the profile and allow the distillery's signature heathery peat smoke to remain present.

  • Colour: The whisky possesses a rich, 100% natural golden amber hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is rich and spicy with scents of crème brûlée, heather honey, and crumbled cinnamon, followed by fresh pineapple and lemon zest.

  • Palate: It delivers a creamy mouthfeel with notes of freshly baked sponge cake, warm vanilla, and toasted shards of cinnamon, balanced by zesty citrus.

  • Body: This single malt is multifaceted and full bodied, offering a complex yet balanced texture.

  • Finish: The finish is mellow and medium in length, characterized by lingering waves of aromatic peat smoke, delicate vanilla, and toasty spice.

  • ABV: Highland Park 15 Year Old Viking Heart is bottled at 44%.

title: Rebel 10 Year Old Single Barrel - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Rebel 10 Year Old Single Barrel (formerly Rebel Yell) is a premium Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey from the United States. The brand's history is deeply rooted in the Stitzel–Weller Distillery, where it was first produced in the 1930s with a wheated mash bill similar to other famous brands from that facility. Originally created by former Louisville mayor Charles R. Farnsley for exclusive distribution in the Southern United States, the brand was later acquired by Luxco (formerly David Sherman Corporation) and is now produced by MGP Ingredients. Since 2018, it has been distilled and aged at the Lux Row Distillery in Bardstown, Kentucky.

Spirit Description

This bourbon is a wheated whiskey, substituting rye with wheat for a softer, sweeter profile. Each bottle is drawn from a single charred oak barrel that has aged for a minimum of 10 years, ensuring that every batch or bottle has a unique character.

  • Colour: Light amber to medium caramel.

  • Aroma: The nose typically features rich caramel, vanilla, and soft oak. Some barrels exhibit more complex notes of dark fruits, citrus, peanut brittle, and even hints of pineapple or peach.

  • Palate: The palate is known for being velvety and sweet, often led by vanilla, caramel, and honey. These initial notes frequently transition into more robust flavours of toasted oak, baking spices, dark cherry, and cocoa powder.

  • Body: It is generally described as having a medium-to-full body with a thin-to-velvety mouthfeel.

  • Finish: The finish is warm and medium-to-long in length, characterized by a sudden burst of spice, citrus, and a lingering oaky sweetness.

  • ABV: It is bottled at 100 proof, or 50% ABV.

title: Corvezzo Prosecco
bodyHtml: An organic Prosecco DOC with a brilliant perlage. Intense hints of pear and white flowers on the nose. In the mouth, it is fresh, with an enveloping foam accompanying the drink towards a balanced and persistent finish. Perfect for every toast. Pair it with light raw fish appetizers.

title: Sattlerhof Sauvignon Blanc Sudsteiermark 2024
bodyHtml: The Sattler family has been growing wine in the village of Gamlitz since 1887, and they were one of the first in the region to bottle high quality dry white wines under their own name in the 1970s. Willi Sattler is the current family member in charge and has grown the estate to 35 hectares of biodynamically farmed vines in some of the region’s most famous vineyards. This comes from the steep quartz and limestone slopes of Südsteiermark. Sustainable viticulture, selective handling, and stainless steel vinification has preserved the punchy, steely white, with crunchy pink grapefruit, lemon, gooseberry, hedgerow, and ample mineral salts flooding the slick, medium bodied palate. Vibrant now in youth, and with time ahead.

title: Cakebread Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon Benchland Select 2021
bodyHtml:
95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

All Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Benchland Select comes from both Rutherford and Oakville fruit and spent 22 months in 56% new French oak. This brings another level of precision and focus compared to the Suscol Springs, and the wine has a stunning array of black raspberries, spicy oak, lead pencil shavings, and exotic baking spice and floral nuances. Medium to full-bodied, beautifully balanced, and elegant, it has ultra-fine tannins, perfectly integrated background oak, and a great finish.

93+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Cakebread's 2021 Cabernet Sauvignon Benchland Select blends five clones from two different vineyards to yield bold scents of black cherries, cassis and mocha but also some redder berries. It's medium to full-bodied, edging just past 14% alcohol while still seeming generous and silky in feel, finishing long and harmonious, with a dusting of fine-grained tannins.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Ripe and polished, with juicy underlying energy to the mix of black currant and blackberry fruit flavors. Light hints of violet, apple wood and warm earth peek through as this red's solid grip holds the finish.

title: Dalwhinnie Distillers Edition 'Oloroso Seasoned American Oak Casks'
bodyHtml:
Made in the highest and coldest working distillery in Scotland, with water from a loch at 2000 feet, Dalwhinnie whisky thrives on extreme conditions – creating a liquid as sweet and accessible as its highland home is remote.

Distillers edition is vintage-dated and finished in sherry cask. This has aromas and flavours of sweet malt, cooked fruit, dried flowers and light smoke, with herbal and creamy/buttery nuances.

The palate is rounded, with wood and peppery/spicy notes on the long and warming finish. Enjoy neat, or with a splash of water.

title: Lake Breeze Merlot 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Lake Breeze Vineyards is located in Canada, on the Naramata Bench within the Okanagan Valley of British Columbia. The MacIntyre family purchased the estate in 2001, supporting a winemaking philosophy focused on minimal intervention to let the natural expression of the fruit shine. Longtime winemaker Garron Elmes oversees the production, utilizing some of the oldest vines on the Naramata Bench—dating back to 1985—to create clean and fruit driven wines.

Wine Description

This Merlot is rich and ripe, presenting a deep profile characterized by flavours and aromas of blackberry, black cherry, and dark chocolate. Consistent with the terroir of the Naramata Bench, the wine is backed by a distinct herbal sage note. On the palate, it offers a clean and fruit driven style with a sense of freshness and complexity derived from the region's unique growing conditions.

Food Pairing

The wine’s dark fruit and herbal sage notes make it an ideal companion for grilled meats, such as rosemary-rubbed lamb or a classic steak frites. For a vegetarian option, it pairs beautifully with earthy dishes like mushroom risotto or roasted root vegetables.

title: Chateau De Laubade Bas Armagnac 2003
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Chateau de Laubade was built in 1870 and is today the premier Armagnac property, composed of 260 acres of single vineyard. It is located in Sorbets d’Armagnac, in the heart of the noblest area of the appellation: the Bas Armagnac. The Lesgourgues family has been running the estate since 1974. Since 1998, Arnaud and Denis Les-gourgues, as the third generation have been actively involved in the quest of excellence, to make Chateau de Laubade an undisputed reference in the Armagnac category.

Each vintage entirely comes from a single harvest and distillation year. Each vintage clearly expresses its age, which is a specificity of Armagnac and the signature of the house. More than 80 different vintages matured in Chateau de Laubade’s cellars. Currently, the oldest vintage is from 1888. Each Vintage tells a particular story. A story dealing with the ongoing climate changes, with the unique Cellar Masters know-how that has followed one another, along the generations. The casks quality and the cellars temperature participate to the vintage special identity as well. Finally, each vintage is a particular chapter of the estate and draws on its long history, rich know-how and dedication to quality from several generations of men and women’s high involvement.

Chateau de Laubade only releases its vintages after a minimum of 15 years of ageing in oak casks from Gascony.

title: Meinklang Gruner Veltliner 2024
bodyHtml: An Austrian family estate with the wind in its sails, everything is done according to the precepts of organics and biodynamics. Easy-drinking wine par excellence, this Gruner Veltliner isn't a cerebral wine, but rather convivial. With vivacity and a relaxed approach, it is reminiscent of green apple, peach, white pepper and lime.

title: Garzon Pinot Rose De Corte 2024
bodyHtml:
Garzón Pinot Rose De Corte originates from the Maldonado region of Uruguay, specifically from the coastal subregion of Garzón. Founded by Alejandro and Bettina Bulgheroni in 2016, Bodega Garzón was built with the vision of creating a modern emblem for Uruguayan winemaking. The winery emphasizes a terroir driven philosophy, utilizing a gravity flow design and sustainable practices to become the first LEED certified winery outside of North America.

Wine Description

This Provence style rosé presents an elegant pale salmon colour in the glass. On the nose, it is characterized by its delicacy and freshness, featuring intense notes of cherry, wild strawberry, and wildflowers. The palate is bone dry and well balanced, displaying a creamy texture from three months of lees contact in stainless steel tanks. It offers a strong acidity and a persistent mineral finish that reflects the ancient granitic soils of the estate.

Food Pairing

This fresh rosé is an ideal companion for summer appetizers such as anchovy bruschettas, niçoise salad, or prosciutto with melanzane. Its bright acidity also allows it to pair elegantly with seafood dishes, including crab cakes, grilled salmon, and sushi.

title: Famille Perrin Chateauneuf du Pape 'Les Sinards' 2022
bodyHtml:
Famille Perrin’s involvement in the wine trade can be traced back to 1909 with the purchase of Château de Beaucastel. Today the 5th generation of the family is involved in every aspect of the business. Famille Perrin’s range of wines enable you to discover the richness and diversity of the Southern Rhone Valley.

Beautiful deep color with garnet undertones. The nose reveals notes of very ripe fruit (blueberries, blackberries) and some mineral notes. On the palate, the Sinards is elegant, delicate, silky, and pure. It is already a very expressive and rich wine, aromatic and fruity, with hints of cassis. The finish is long and harmonious, expressing all the quality of this vintage.

title: Jin Zuan Xi Jiu - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Jin Zuan Xi Jiu is a premium Chinese baijiu originating from Xijiu Town in the Zunyi City of the Guizhou province. It is produced in the middle reaches of the Chishui River Valley, an area recognized as the core production zone for sauce aroma liquors. The spirit is crafted by the Xijiu distillery using high quality glutinous sorghum, wheat, and water, following traditional solid state fermentation processes.

Description

This spirit is a 'sauce flavour' (jiang-xiang) baijiu that presents a clean, fine, and transparent body. It features an outstanding and complex aroma profile characterized by notes of bouquet, yeast, and wild flowers. On the palate, it is mellow, plump, and smooth, offering a sweet profile that avoids excessive spiciness. The finish is notably long with a persistent fragrance that remains in the cup long after it has been emptied. It is bottled at an alcohol by volume of 53%.

Food Pairing

Jin Zuan Xi Jiu is best enjoyed at room temperature to allow its elegant character to fully unfold. Its prominent sauce aroma and smooth profile make it an excellent companion for rich, savoury Chinese dishes such as braised pork belly, Peking duck, or spicy Sichuan cuisine. It also pairs well with aged cheeses or grilled meats that can stand up to its high alcohol content and robust fragrance.

title: Luxardo Maraschino - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
The Luxardo Maraschino follows the original recipe from 1821, and requires four years to produce.

Cherries are harvested from Luxardo’s own trees and the solid components are then infused in larchwood vats for three years. The product is distilled in small copper pot stills and aged in Finnish ash wood for the remaining year. Finally, a combination of sugar and water is added before bottling

title: Concha y Toro Carmin de Peumo Carmenere 2018
bodyHtml:
Carmin de Peumo is Chile's first iconic Carmenere. A wine that faithfully reflects its origin, the terroir of Peumo, it has been widely praised by world critics. Carmín de Peumo boosts the development of Carmenere at the global level and positions Peumo as the best Chilean location for the production of this French grape variety.

The Peumo Vineyard is located 170 m above sea level and extended along the Cachapoal River on terraces of hills of the Coastal Mountains. The vines come from pre-phylloxera cuttings and are trellised to vertical shoot position and cordon pruned.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Once upon a time, Carmin de Peumo was your typical ripe and beefy Carmenere, but not here. This offering, harvested in late May (the equivalent of November in the Northern Hemisphere), deals tomato leaf, currant, cranberry and dried-herb aromas in front of a racy palate medium in weight. Spicy, leafy red-fruit flavours are oaky and come with notes of cocoa and coffee, while a dry and snappy finish is lean by previously set Carmenere standards.

title: Concha y Toro Gravas del Maipo Syrah 2019
bodyHtml:
Gravas del Maipo is born as a tribute by Concha y Toro to the majestic Andes and the hidden gravel from silently eroded, displaced and moulded soils year after year in the thousands of years old Maipo basin. It reflects the challenge of positioning Chile as a high-quality wine producer and the constant and passionate search to identify terroirs that faithfully express the character of a grape variety.

In the middle of the Maipo Valley, the vineyards for this Gravas were planted in the first half of the 2000s on the alluvial soils on the southern bank of the Maipo River. Aging lasted 14 months, with 26% new oak. A fruit-forward syrah with tremendous fruity expression. The extractions have been more moderate in recent vintages, and that's especially noticeable in this softer-bodied, lighter-textured version from a hot, dry year with lower yields and in which the fruit came straight from the vineyard loaded with flavour. A delicious Syrah to drink now or to cellar for years.

title: Dillon's Strawberry Gin
bodyHtml:
The distillery's traditional dry gin is infused with local Niagara strawberries and botanicals, then lightly sweetened. Expect notes of strawberry, juniper, and light pepper. Medium-bodied and fruity with a lengthy finish.

Craft a Strawberry Martini and serve it alongside light appetizers or fresh fruit salad.

title: Cantina Del Pino Barbaresco 2020
bodyHtml:
​Cantina del Pino's 2020 Barbaresco is a distinguished red wine hailing from the renowned Barbaresco region in Piedmont, Italy. Established in the 1920s, Cantina del Pino has been owned and operated by the Vacca family for a century, with a legacy of producing elegant, age-worthy Barbarescos.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo wine presents a delicate perfume with aromas of dark cherry and black pepper, complemented by a hint of fine cigar tobacco. On the palate, it is elegant and fully ripe, showcasing intense fruit flavors with wonderful structure and balance. Aged for two years in oak and one year in the bottle, it exhibits a satisfying chewiness that supports dark-cherry notes and black-tea flavors. Fresh acidity adds a lively touch, promising that this wine has the stamina to age beautifully over time.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 93 points

Food Pairing

This Barbaresco pairs excellently with rich dishes such as beef, lamb, pasta, and game meats like deer or venison. These pairings highlight the wine's depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Tolaini Picconero 2021
bodyHtml:
This superstar super-Tuscan is a blockbuster!

Rich, concentrated and muscular, yet wonderfully balanced with deep tiers of cherry, plums and wild berries, and nuances of spice and currants. A long flavourful aftertaste echoes with juicy fruit and mouthwatering tannins for minutes afterwards.

Pair with braised or stewed meat dishes, game, and blue cheeses.

title: Amelia Pinot Noir 2022 (by Concha Y Toro)
bodyHtml:
This Pinot Noir presents a brilliant garnet colour with youthful vibrancy. The nose is expressive with aromas of red cherry, cranberry, and raspberry, intertwined with orange peel, violet, rooibos tea, and delicate spices such as cinnamon and cardamom. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and precise, delivering juicy red fruits layered with earthy undertones, savoury herbs, and subtle mineral notes. The structure is defined by vibrant acidity and finely textured tannins, leading to a long, fresh, and elegant finish. Fermented with partial whole clusters and aged for twelve months in French oak (20% new), it achieves a refined balance of fruit purity and complexity. Optimal drinking is suggested from now through 2030. This wine is not classified as organic.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator – 93 points

  • Wine Enthusiast – 91 points

  • Falstaff – 95 points

Food Pairing
A versatile partner for a range of dishes, this Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with grilled salmon, seared tuna, or herb-crusted pork tenderloin. It also complements earthy vegetarian dishes such as lentils with roasted beets, or creamy cheeses like brie and aged goat cheese. Together, these pairings create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Siempre Reposado Rebel Cask
bodyHtml:
Each single barrel batch yields no more than 360 bottles, no single lot will ever taste exactly like another.  They use wild fermented Supremo Plata tequila and fill it into barrels at still-strength. The barrels are a range of rare and interesting ones, spanning from New French Oak, XO Cognac, Ex-Bourbon to Sauternes. This is arguably the world's smallest single barrel program. Catch a bottle if you can.

Aged 8 months exclusively in Bordeaux Sauternes casks.

title: Bumbu Craft Rum - 375 ml
bodyHtml: This craft spirit is made in small batches at a 19th century distillery in Barbados, using a 400-year-old recipe. Rumoured to be a favourite of sailors and seaside merchants in the colonial West Indies, its tropical fruit and spicy notes give it a distinctively Caribbean character.

title: Tito's Handmade Vodka - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Distilled from corn, this handmade vodka offers forward and yet delicate aromas and flavours of roasted grain, black pepper and citrus, with hints of fruit and smoke. It's lightly creamy and smooth on the palate with a subtle sweetness on the warm and rounded finish. Perfect on its own or use to create a fantastic cocktail.

title: Aperol Aperitivo - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Aperol is currently made in Italy, specifically in the Padua region. This vibrant orange liqueur is known for its distinct flavour profile, characterized by bittersweet notes of orange, herbs, and botanicals. Its refreshing and light taste has made it popular for classic Italian cocktails such as the Aperol Spritz. Critics praise Aperol for its balanced sweetness and bitter undertones, noting its versatility as both an aperitif and a mixer. Its bright and citrusy flavour, coupled with its iconic vibrant colour, has made Aperol a beloved choice for those seeking a taste of Italian indulgence.

title: Luksusowa Potato Vodka - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Distilled from potatoes. The result is a perfectly smooth vodka. Since its creation in 1928 in Poland, Luksusowa has maintained the highest production standards (its name literally means the highest quality spirit). 28 international gold medals crown its quality. Its perfect balance and smoothness make Luksusowa ideal for cocktails, such as a Classic Martini. Luksusowa, an authentic luxury Polish vodka.

title: Cono Sur Unoaked Chardonnay Bicicleta 2024
bodyHtml: Pale lemon colour, moderate aromas of apple, vanilla and spice, extra dry and light-medium bodied with flavours of baked apple, oak and spice with a creamy mouthfeel. Enjoy with salmon, salads and risottos.

title: Smirnoff Creamsicle Blast
bodyHtml: A refreshingly delicious Vodka with a retro, nostalgic design evocative of a favourite summer popsicle treat. The Smirnoff Creamsicle Blast is made with real vodka orange soda flavour, and a hint of vanilla flavour reminiscent of the orange creamsicle ice pop enjoyed as a kid.

title: Ernie Els Big Easy Chenin Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: The Big Easy is 100% Chenin Blanc from various low-yielding vineyards across the Western Cape. It opens with sun-kissed daisies, honey-suckle, cantaloupe and kumquat notes. This upbeat and complex nose leads to a more mineral and serious palate, that exudes elegance and poise. Two months of lees aging gives added depth, as well as contributes to a round, comforting and soft texture. Medium bodied with a racy finish, this Chenin Blanc is typically easy and rather delicious even in its youth.

title: Jabber The Winemaker Sauvignon Blanc 'The Blend' 2023
bodyHtml:
Hidden among the hills, constantly receiving the fresh air of the Pacific Ocean, this blend is the perfect combination of the three sub-valleys that make up the great Casablanca Valley. 

This Sauvignon Blanc shows a unique minerality and a pleasant freshness and acidity.

title: El Jolgorio Coyote Ancestral
bodyHtml:
El Jolgorio Ancestral Coyote is the first mezcal released by El Jolgorio that was distilled by a woman and first distilled in clay pots.

El Jolgorio Ancestral Coyote represents a new chapter in the El Jolgorio range of mezcals. This ancestral mezcal is produced by Maestra Mezcalera: Doña Justina Ruiz Perez in Sola de Vega, Oaxaca using clay pots. The inaugural batch was distilled in February 2021 using 14 year old Maguey Coyote (Agave americana). The agaves were cooked underground for 2 days, crushed by hand using wooden mallets, fermented for 6 days in wooden vats, and double distilled in clay pots.

title: Felsina Chianti Classico Berardenga 2021 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Ruby red with deep intensity and hue. Fruity, fine and elegant aromas dominated by wild berries, along with array of spicy notes. Fruity on the palate with good tannins and a lingering finish.

title: Veramonte Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Veramonte Pinot Noir originates from the Casablanca Valley in Chile. Founded in the 1990s by Chilean wine pioneer Agustín Huneeus, Veramonte was the first winery to invest significantly in the Casablanca Valley, a region now famed for its cool climate viticulture. Today, the estate is owned by the González Byass Group and is dedicated to organic and sustainable winemaking, focusing on producing authentic wines that reflect their unique terroir.

Wine Description

This medium bodied red wine displays a deep cherry hue and expressive aromas of raspberry, red cherry, and strawberry, often accented by notes of mushroom, spice, and dried herbs. The palate is delicate and smooth, featuring a silky texture, balanced tannins, and fresh acidity that leads into a vibrant finish with hints of firm minerality. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, the wine typically undergoes aging for eight to ten months in French and neutral oak barrels to enhance its complexity while maintaining its fresh fruit character. This wine is certified organic and is best enjoyed within four years of the vintage date.

title: Foppiano Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml: This red wine has an explosion of black fruit, ripe Santa Rosa plum, cinnamon, rose petals and dried herbs. The opulent nose gives way to a fully structured palate. Flavours of dark plum, blackberries, and blueberries. The lingering finish includes cranberries and spice.

title: Farmer's Botanical Small Batch Organic Gin
bodyHtml:
Farmer’s Organic Gin is handcrafted in small batches from carefully selected botanicals and the purest grains. Providing a pristinely clean palette for the artful infusion of botanicals, the distillate is made from sustainably farmed grain grown in the U.S. Certified organic by the USDA, Farmer’s Gin possesses a complexity and unique taste profile due to its remarkably balanced selection of botanicals, including juniper, elderflower, lemon grass, coriander, and angelica root.

In order to produce a flavorful organic gin, they sought out farmers dedicated to sustainability and preserving the earth. They found four farms growing organic crops that could help them create the highest quality organic gin.

title: Caballito Cerrero Azul Blanco 46 Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1950 by Don Alfonso Jimenez Rosales, a co-founder of Herradura who, after a family dispute, set off to start his own brand, Caballito Cerrero and is one of the oldest Tequila brands that is no longer included in the NOM that specifies it as a Tequila. Now recognized as “Destilado de Agave” or agave distillate, they use agave chato, a cousin of espadín, that was often used in Tequila production before the blue agave was specified.

Aromas of cooked agave, freshly cut herbs, and salinity. Fruity agave, pepper, dill, pickle brine, mustard, and grilled pineapple on the palate. The finish is juicy with a bit of salinity that will get your salivary glands going.

title: El Jolgorio Todos Santos Tobala Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Traditional artisanal mezcal forms an important part of rituals, ceremonies and festivities – known as 'Jolgorios' – in villages in their native homeland of Oaxaca, Mexico. 

Nine unique El Jolgorio Mezcals are made exclusively from different species and varieties of wild-harvested agave by masters in the local indigenous Zapotec Villages in Oaxaca, and are twice distilled in copper pot stills. On every bottle is inscribed the species of agave, the age at harvest, the village of production, the name of the master distiller, and the batch and lot number, so as to truly connect the drinker with the land, people, and plants at the heart and soul of their mezcal.

title: Tarima Hill 2019
bodyHtml:
92 Points - Wine Spectator

An aromatic underpinning of tarry smoke and medicinal herbs serves as a savoury counterpoint to ripe flavours of creme de cassis, blackberry preserves, licorice and espresso crema in this rich red. A frame of sculpted tannins and a  slightly tangy citrus peel acidity are well-knit to the expressive flavour range, resulting in a powerful, harmonious version. Monastrell. Drink now through 2029.

title: Bodegas Muga Prado Enea Gran Reserva 2016
bodyHtml:
odegas Muga Prado Enea Gran Reserva 2016 originates from Spain, within the Ebro Valley region and the prestigious Rioja Alta subregion. The estate was founded in 1932 by Isaac Muga and Martinez, establishing a deeply respected multi-generational legacy in Haro's Station District. The winery's philosophy focuses on preserving traditional Riojan craftsmanship, being one of the few houses to employ an in-house cooperage and maintaining a strict commitment to fermenting and aging entirely in oak vats and casks.

Wine Description

This red wine presents an attractive black-cherry appearance with a medium-to-deep density and possesses a medium-to-full body with a flawlessly balanced, vertical structure. The sensory profile is highly elegant, layered, and classic, opening with an architectural nose of forest fruits and dark plums, seamlessly intertwined with notes of violets, walnuts, leather, clove, cinnamon, and smoky tobacco. On the juicy, silky-smooth palate, it delivers deep flavours of black cherry, blackberry, liquorice, and cassis, beautifully supported by a line of fresh, well-integrated acidity and a crunchy mineral undertone. The finish is exceptionally long, precise, and pointed, leaving trailing memories of creamy vanilla, cocoa powder, lavender, and sweet wood spices wrapped in fine-grained, velvety tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional Rioja blend consisting of 80% Tempranillo, 10% Mazuelo, 5% Graciano, and 5% Grenache.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its incredible structural focus and seamless integration. The grapes are always the last to be picked during harvest and are sourced from high-altitude plots. The wine undergoes a minimum of 36 months of aging in French and American oak casks, followed by a light fining with fresh egg whites and an additional 36 months of bottle refinement before release.

  • ABV: 14.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate operates with a dedicated focus on environmental sustainability and became one of the first wineries in the region to earn specific environmental certifications, this commercial bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, broad mid-palate, and building tannic architecture of this Gran Reserva make it a magnificent companion for savory, rich, and slowly cooked culinary creations.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with a roasted rack of lamb, grilled beef tenderloin, pork loin, or traditional beef stews.

  • Hearty Fare: Suggested pairings include rich winter casseroles, traditional meat pies, or roasted game bird selections.

  • Cheese: Matches gracefully with structured artisanal platters of mature, hard cheeses such as a sharp white Cheddar.

Vintage Quality

The 2016 vintage in Rioja is regarded as an exceptional and legendary year, yielding a large harvest characterized by phenomenal volume and elite fruit purity. The growing season endured a challenging start, beginning with a mild winter and an intensely wet spring that delayed both budburst and subsequent flowering phases. However, a radiant, hot summer allowed the grapes to catch up and achieve optimal phenolic maturity, while cool evening temperatures preserved the mouthwatering natural acidity. The winemaking team's skill in executing a meticulous double fruit selection across their cooler, late-ripening plots successfully turned these climatic challenges into a brilliant triumph, resulting in a monumental Prado Enea release with an extraordinary capacity to evolve gracefully in the cellar through 2046.

title: Mi Familia Flores Reposado Cristalino
bodyHtml:
Mi Familia Flores Reposado Cristalino Tequila is an artisanal, ultra-smooth aged spirit originating from Amatitán in the Lowlands (Valles) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Produced by the Flores family at Selecto de Amatitán (NOM 1459) / Tequilera de la Barranca de Amatitán, the brand focuses on crafting traditional 100% agave tequilas with modern refinement. This expression delivers the depth and barrel complexity of a aged reposado paired with the brilliant visual clarity of an unaged blanco.

Spirit Description

Mi Familia Flores Reposado Cristalino is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave harvested at peak maturity. After traditional cooking, fermentation, and double distillation, the tequila rests in American oak barrels for two to six months to develop soft vanilla, oak, and caramel tones. Following maturation, the aged spirit undergoes a specialized activated charcoal filtration process that strips away the amber color while preserving the smooth oak texture and flavor complexity.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, brilliant, and luminous with subtle golden glints when caught in the light.

  • Aroma: Soft, delicate, and fresh. The nose opens with cooked agave, sweet vanilla, and light oak, complemented by subtle hints of citrus peel, honey, and marshmallow.

  • Palate: Exceptionally smooth, creamy, and approachable on the entry. Upfront notes of sweet caramel, vanilla, and honeyed agave transition into delicate baking spices, light orange flan, and gentle oak warmth.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a rounded, silky, and velvety mouthfeel that glides smoothly across the tongue.

  • Finish: Clean, crisp, and refined, closing with lingering notes of sweet agave, honey, and a soft touch of pepper spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Matua Lighter Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml: A Sauvignon Blanc with all the incredibly crisp, tropical Marlborough flavours and fewer calories. The nose is mouth-wateringly vibrant with gooseberry and tropical fruit characters. The palate doesn't skimp on flavour either, bursting with citrus and natural acidity all wrapped up in great structure and a lengthy finish. This is a lighter-style Sauvignon Blanc with less alcohol and calories. Cheers to that!

title: Ornellaia Eligo Dell'Ornellaia Grappa - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Eligo dell’Ornellaia Grappa Riserva illustrates Ornellaia’s philosophy that an uncompromising selection process in the vineyard, and indeed at every step in the production process is fundamental to creating the highest possible quality.

As autumn arrives and Ornellaia’s wines are placed into their French oak barrels for ageing, the fresh wine pomace is taken to an artisanal distillery hidden deep in the Tuscan countryside. Here the Master Distiller applies her unique savoir-faire and captures the delicate aromatic heart of the Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot grape skins.

Once painstakingly distilled in small copper stills, the grappa is aged for a minimum of 3 years in Ornellaia’s very own barrels (twice the required length of time to obtain the Riserva status) before being blended with older vintage reserves to achieve additional depth and character. Being distilled, aged, blended and bottled at the same distillery is the guarantee of a truly artisanal Grappa.

With its soft aromas, silky texture a,nd beautiful golden colour Eligo dell’Ornellaia Grappa Riserva is distinct in style, unique in origin, inspired by nature and crafted by man.

title: Gordon's Sunset Orange Gin
bodyHtml:
Introducing Gordon's Sunset Orange, a blend of Gordon's London Dry Gin with Orange taste that offers you a pleasantly unique experience. Enjoy this mouthwatering citrus gin, prepared from carefully chosen ingredients, to unwind after a long day. It is a great option for unwinding with while enjoying a late summer afternoon. Juicy orange flavors and the traditional juniper characteristics of a premium dry gin are abundant in it.

A smooth, refreshing beverage that is bursting with zesty orange flavor. Combine with your favorite tonic, a slice of lemon, a sprig of rosemary, and ice.

title: Marylebone London Dry Gin
bodyHtml:
Distilled in a small pot still in the heart of the 'Pleasure Gardens' in London, Mary-Le-Bone Gin is a delicate London Dry gin with hints of camomile, iris, and notes of sweet citrus with a beautiful spicy lingering finish.

A versatile gin equally at home in a refreshing G & T or a dry martini.

title: Mark Ryan Winery Lu & Oly Flowerhead Rose 2023
bodyHtml:
The fan-favorite rose label presents with an inviting peachy-pink hue, and gives delicate floral aromatics mixed with vibrant citrus and strawberry notes on the nose.

Cherry, peach, apricot, and lemon zest notes all mingle on the palate, combining with bright acidity hints of minerality. This full-bodied rose carries on with a lengthy finish, pairing perfectly solo or with a variety of cuisines & occasions.

title: Marques de Caceres Verdejo 2024
bodyHtml: Marques de Caceres was launched in Rioja in 1970 by Enrique Forner, who came from a family involved in the wine business. His daughter, Cristina Forner, now manages the business, which opened a separate winery in Rueda in 2014. Made from 100 percent Verdejo from its vineyards in Serrada and Le Seca, the wine offers baked lemon, flint, popcorn, almond and apricot flavours. It's light-bodied and slightly off-dry, with moderate acidity and has a refreshing finish.

title: Quarisa Johnny Q Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Winemaker John Quarisa spent 24 years making big-brand wines before creating his own label. 

The Johnny Q Cabernet Sauvignon is an intense red with purple hues. Fresh, complex cassis and mint fruit flavours with some well-integrated vanillin oak.

Full-bodied with dense ripe cassis fruit flavours balanced with vanillin oak but yet long and smooth. Try with chargrilled sirloin or a hearty minestrone. This wine has the flavour, structure and balance to be enjoyed now or offers added satisfaction from further cellaring.

title: Oxford Landing Sauvignon Blanc 2021
bodyHtml:
Fresh and zesty aromas of passionfruit, lemongrass and freshly cut hay. Light-bodied, showing layers of fresh citrus and papaya flavours.

Enjoy with grilled chicken and fresh leafy greens or tomato and grilled vegetable pasta.

title: Piper Heidsieck Essentiel Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut
bodyHtml:
Since its founding in 1785, the House of Piper-Heidsieck has proven its innovative prowess in selecting and blending wines of exception. A quest for excellence and open-mindedness are reflected in the entire range of champagnes created by Chief Winemaker Emilien Boutillat, serve as guarantor the Piper-Heidsieck style.

Essentiel Blanc de Blancs is sourced from the most magnificent Chardonnay vineyards in Champagne. A large proportion of reserve wines are harmoniously blended with wines of the year to ensure the purest expression of the varietal.

title: Hunter Laing's 'Old & Rare' Ben Nevis 31 Year Old (Distilled in 1991)
bodyHtml:
Bottled as part of Hunter Laing's Old and Rare Collection, this Single Malt was distilled at Ben Nevis in 1991.

Patiently maturing in a single Oloroso sherry cask for 31 years, only 540 bottles were produced from this outrun.

title: Barcelo Gran Anejo Rum
bodyHtml:
Fruit of the perfect blend of the finest Dominican rums, patiently aged for up to six years in ex-Bourbon oak barriques.

Barcelo Gran Anejo is a rum rich in depth and balanced nuances.

title: Le Serre Nuove Dell' Ornellaia 2021 - 3 Litre Bottle
Dalmore 21 Year Old
bodyHtml:
It takes time to attain full potential. But at 21 years old, and The Dalmore 21 is a true coming-of-age single malt.

Its the pinnacle of Dalmore's Principal Collection because it is the very epitome of whisky-making artistry, and the perfect prelude to their range of rare and aged single malts.

Making it takes meticulous care and craft but it is a labour of love.

Under the watchful eye of our Master Distiller Gregg Glass, Dalmore's talented team of whisky makers dedicate every ounce of their artistry to the creation of this lovingly handcrafted masterpiece of malt. They compose the perfect spirit in a symphony of idiosyncratic copper stills and hand-finish it in the exquisite sherry wood of rare 30 year-old Matusalem Oloroso casks, exclusive to The Dalmore.  Following its decades-long sleep, they bring it shining into the light, ready to release the antique qualities present in every precious drop.

title: Mate Merlot Mantus 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This expressive red wine originates from Italy, specifically the Tuscany region and the prestigious Montalcino subregion. The Máté family estate is a family-run winery nestled in the Santa Restituta area, situated on land that served as a Roman vineyard 2,000 years ago. Owned by author Ferenc Máté and his wife, artist and winemaker Candace Máté, the couple restored a 13th-century friary and transformed the surrounding 17 acres into an organic vineyard. The winery's philosophy emphasizes small-lot, organic viticulture with high-density planting to produce wines that authentically reflect the diverse, mineral-rich terroir of their private hills.

Wine Description

The 2022 Máté 'Mantus' Merlot presents a concentrated ruby colour in the glass. The sensory profile is plush and complex, offering territory-driven aromas of minerals, blackberry, and plum preserves, layered with hints of smoky wood, liquorice, and chocolate. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and mouth-coating, featuring a juicy core of dark fruit, cocoa, and baking spice.

This 100% Merlot is sourced from the estate's sandy-clay soils and is fermented with indigenous yeasts before aging for 18 months in French oak barrels. Stylistically, it is characterized by its firm, chalky tannins and a remarkable structural density that balances its natural opulence. The finish is long, harmonious, and aromatic, often described as 'near endless'. While enjoyable upon release, this well-integrated red has an optimal drinking window extending through 2032.

Accolades

  • 'James Suckling - 91 points.'

title: Cuatro Rayas Organic Tempranillo 2022
bodyHtml:
From the winery’s organic vine estates.  Cuatro Rayas is one of the longest serving producers in Rueda. Since their establishment in 1935, they’ve been pioneers in adopting new trends and innovations in viticulture and winemaking.

Bright and clean, ruby red colour with purple hue. On the nose there is an intense aroma with hints of ripe berries. Soft and velvety on the palate with a perfect balance between tannins and acidity. A round and long finish.

title: Petit Guiraud 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Apricot, marzipan, and dates excite the senses. Luscious rich palate of apricots and honey. This wine is organic.

title: Cuatro Rayas Organic Verdejo 2023
bodyHtml:
The largest winery in Rueda, Cuatro Rayas is a co-operative founded in 1935 that produces a wide range of wines in many styles from 300 vineyards, including some more than 100 years old. From the winery's organic line, this 100 percent Verdejo was fermented in stainless steel from grapes harvested at night.

Pale lemon in colour, it boasts aromas of pear, apple and fennel. The same flavours carry on to the palate, but with a touch of minerality and some of the pleasant bitterness often found with Verdejo. Try it with roast chicken, grilled shrimp or soft cheese.

title: Barcelo Anejo
bodyHtml: Golden amber color. Reedy and woody aromas of vanilla and toffee with a whiff of vapor. A sharp entry leads to a dryish medium-bodied palate with cherry, toffee, white pepper, charred wood and mineral flavors.

title: Domaine Gassier Nostre Pais Rouge 2020
bodyHtml: Very aromatic and fruity, with lovely flavors of fine herbs, basil, and spices.

title: Collard Picard Prestige Brut (NV)
bodyHtml:
The Prestige Cuvee is made by Olivier Collard and his wife Caroline Picard in the Marne Valley. This is predominantely grand cru Chardonnay with an equal blend of premier cru Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier. It is matured in 700 litre foudres for 15 months and aged for a further three years in bottle before disgorgement. 

The result is exquisite, with notes of melon and warm brioche. Lovely richness on the palate followed by ripe citrus and apple characters, with a hint of honey on the finish.

title: The Busker Irish Whiskey - 3 Bottle Gift Pack
bodyHtml:
This collection includes:

The Busker Single Grain

The Busker Single Grain is a light, pale straw colored whiskey. The taste begins by offering sweet caramel and moving to soft vanilla and oak notes. On the palate you will experience notes of caramel, vanilla, oak and hay. The finish is a long, dry and sweet.

The Busker Single Malt

The whiskey is distilled in large copper stills, then matured in two different woods to bring you a complexity that is waiting to be experienced. It begins with an arrangement of fruit, which gently leaves space to an explosion of pine essence and malt biscuit. The palate is very intense, with rich, chocolate notes. The whiskey concludes with a sweet and creamy finish.

The Busker Single Pot Still

The Busker Pot Still is a distinctive expression of Ireland with an exceptional character.  Made from barley the traditional way in copper stills, then matured and finished in ex bourbon and sherry casks, it opens with a rich and complex bouquet, consisting of fresh flowers, honey, oak, fudge, and clove oil. Taste buds kick off with some beautiful intense spices and peppery notes, balanced splendidly with some toffee as we reach a long, warm, rich spicy finish.

title: Millstone Peated American Oak Dutch Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
The Millstone Peated American Oak is a peated Dutch single malt whisky from Zuidam Distillers. It’s made from peated barley (50 PPM) and matured in American oak barrels. 

The first impression on the nose is of a subtle smokiness and surprising freshness. This develops into the citrus and tropical fruitiness with vanilla, coconut and a hint of spices. The palate is fruity and elegant smoke aromas with a rich honey sweetness, delicate spicy notes and it develops into bitter oranges and chocolate. A medium long and pleasant finish with peat smoke, orange and oak spices.

title: Domaine Jamet Cotes du Rhone Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Domaine Jamet Côtes du Rhône Blanc originates from France, within the Northern Rhône subregion of the Rhône Valley. Joseph Jamet founded the estate in the 1950s, though the winery only began bottling its own production in 1976. Today, the property is managed by Jean Paul and Corinne Jamet alongside their son Loïc, following a philosophy that emphasizes the traditional 'assemblage' (blending) of diverse terroirs to achieve a balance of power and elegance.

Wine Description

This white blend typically presents a translucent yellow colour, sometimes featuring light green reflections. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and complex, offering a nose of wild flowers, lemon blossoms, honeyed orchard fruits, and a hint of apricot. On the medium bodied palate, it is bright and textured with a 'crystalline' feel, delivering concentrated flavours of white peach, pear, and tangerine balanced by a refreshing tension and mineral freshness. The finish is clean and persistent, often revealing a floral quality and a subtle hint of smokiness or saltiness.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend primarily of Marsanne and Viognier, supplemented by Roussanne and Grenache Blanc.

  • ABV: Generally ranges between 12.5% and 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: The estate practices 'lutte raisonnée' (sustainable farming) and avoids systematic chemical treatments, though it is not typically certified organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is fermented and matured in a combination of stainless steel tanks, neutral 300 litre oak casks, and unlined amphoras to preserve its Northern Rhône character and fruit purity.

Food Pairing

The textured profile and vibrant acidity of this wine make it a versatile partner for diverse cuisines. Suggested pairings include seared pork chops, roasted chicken or turkey, and veal served in a white wine sauce. It also complements shellfish, braised butter beans, autumnal root vegetable bakes, and creamy butternut squash soups.

title: Nicolas Maillart Brut 'Platine' Premier Cru (NV)
bodyHtml:
Slow, gentle pressing using gravity-flow techniques. Vinification in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats and a period in the barrel for a certain volume of reserve wines. Average two-year maturing period in the bottle.

Golden in colour with a fine, lingering bead. 

Intense with notes of fruit and hazelnuts and a slight toastiness

The initial impact is wonderfully fresh and vinous, followed by great finesse.

title: Brecon Chocolate Orange Gin
bodyHtml:
This Chocolate Orange gin is bottled at 37.5% and is based on Penderyn's Brecon Gin.

Rich velvety chocolate swirls around this gin. Powdery cocoa and silky vanilla succumb to zesty, sweet orange bursts and an unmistakeably full-bodied juniper, Dry cassia bark balanced with smooth fresh cream lingers in the mouth. Best served with ice and chilled tonic water. Garnish with cinnamon and a twist of orange.

title: Nirvana Williams Pear Brandy
bodyHtml:
Destilerija Zaric Nirvana Pear is a special brandy made of pear, having a very rich fragrance and taste. It is produced from the most valued pear cultivar, 'viljamovka' containing a high percentage of sugar and very little acid, therefore its aromatic matters are fully exposed. 

One bottle of brandy is produced from 8-10 kilograms of pears. Brandy is stored exclusively in innox containers where it undergoes its aging process since wooden barrels would violate its fragrance.  

The aroma and the taste of the pears are so well preserved that it really feels like you have a piece of Williams pear in your mouth while drinking it. It is characterized by an extremely long aftertaste.

title: Michael Mondavi Pinot Noir 'Spellbound' 2020
bodyHtml:
The Spellbound Pinot Noir has an alluring color and inviting bouquet of rich raspberries, cherries and red currant, vanilla bean and roasted coffee, all in a remarkably approachable glass. The wine is crafted to unleash dark and luscious characteristics, while managing tannins to deliver an opulent and juicy Pinot Noir.

Enjoy this wine on its own or with expressive dishes including, grilled pork chops, roast chicken, lamb curry and even meatloaf with roasted vegetables, especially Brussels sprouts. Nutmeg and cinnamon are two of many spices that work well with this beautiful Pinot Noir.

title: Talo Primitivo di Manduria 2022
bodyHtml:
Talo, a surname, to collectively thank the farmers of San Marzano who, with their families, look after each vineyard as if it were their own garden. Talo, a collection of different varieties; a symbol of a community.

Made from grapes cultivated close to the sea, it is a full-bodied red wine where its minerality and balsamic components can be perceived, as well as the elegance of its tannins and the explosion of fragrant red fruit, typical of the best-known Puglian variety in the world.

title: Michael Mondavi Chardonnay 'Spellbound' 2021
bodyHtml:
Spellbound Chardonnay features bright and lush tropical fruit flavors with notes of vanilla and classic creme brulee. Its medium body and bright acidity make for a pleasant and lasting finish on the palate.

Enjoy this wine on its own or with a variety of cuisine from the Pacific Rim to the fiery Southwest. Blackened fish, Caesar salad, cream chowders and soft cheeses all make for delicious pairings.

title: Snow Allure Vodka
