vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml: The name Yeun Elez comes from an old peat bog located in the heart of the Natural Park of Armorique. This peated French single malt has aromatically intense medicinal peat (camphor, cloves) and is supported by fruity notes, bananas, cooked peaches, and cream pastry. It concludes with a lingering, iodized and spicy finish, ending with a warm wood fire.

title: Redwood Empire Grizzly Beast Bourbon
bodyHtml:
This rare whiskey was bottled under the strict tenents of the Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897. Aged in the temperate climate of the Northern California coast, the original distillate was altered only by the addition of pure water from the Russian River Valley aquifer. This is the purest expression of Redwood Empire’s craft.

The name Grizzly Beast is a combination of two trees: The Grizzly Giant, a giant Sequoia located in Yosemite National Park that has over two billion leaves, and the Mattole Beast, a massive 375-foot coastal redwood located in Humboldt Redwoods State Park.

On the nose, charred sugar, cherry cola, reduced red currant. Molasses, almond brittle, and reduced red currant in the mouth.

title: Revel Stoke Smoregasm Whisky
bodyHtml:
Revel Stoke Smoregasm toasted smores whisky is a masterful construction of brown sugar and maple syrup built into the structure of a Canadian whisky. Like a toasted marshmallow floating on top of a perfect cool smore, Revel Stoke.

If you love smores, then this is the whisky for you. Revel Stoke Smoregasm Canadian Whisky has all of the flavours of a tasty roasted marshmallow in a glass, plus some toasty tones from the charred oak and vanilla sweetness.

title: Othello 2021 (by Dominus Estate)
bodyHtml:
Othello is produced in the United States, originating from the Yountville subregion of the renowned Napa Valley in California. Established by Christian Moueix of the famous Bordeaux winemaking family, Dominus Estate is rooted in the historic Napanook Vineyard, which dates back to 1838. The winery focuses on meticulous, minimal-intervention viticulture, including organic and dry farming practices, to create wines that express a pure and balanced reflection of their unique terroir.

Wine Description

Deep garnet purple in color, this Bordeaux red blend opens with bright, forthcoming aromas of fresh blackberries, black currant, juicy plum, and soft earth, accompanied by delicate hints of graphite, lavender, and singed alder. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, showing exceptional freshness, a lively structure, and a silky mouthfeel shaped by soft, fine tannins.

title: Domaine Thibault Liger Belair Nuits Saint Georges 'La Charmotte'
Bodega Chacra Pinot Noir 'Cincuenta Y Cinco' 2023
bodyHtml:
Bodega Chacra, founded in 2004 by Piero Incisa della Rocchetta, is located in the Río Negro Valley of Patagonia, Argentina. Piero, the grandson of Marchese Mario Incisa della Rocchetta—creator of the renowned Sassicaia—set out to craft wines that reflect the purity and elegance of Patagonia’s unique terroir. The estate follows organic and biodynamic farming principles, working with ungrafted old vines to produce expressive and site-driven Pinot Noir.

Wine Description

The 2023 'Cincuenta y Cinco' Pinot Noir is sourced from vineyards planted in 1955 on pebble-rich riverbed soils. This wine presents a radiant ruby hue. The nose offers a vibrant bouquet of orange peel, orange blossom, cherries, and subtle rose stem. On the palate, it is sleek and racy, with fine, silky tannins and a long, energetic finish. Fermented whole cluster at low temperatures to enhance floral aromatics, the wine is aged for 11 months—50% in concrete tanks and 50% in second, third, and fourth-use French oak barrels.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 97 points
  • Tim Atkin – 94 points

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with roasted duck, grilled salmon, or mushroom risotto. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Patagonia saw some rainfall at the beginning of the harvest, resulting in wines that are lighter, elegant, and forward in style. Despite these conditions, 'Cincuenta y Cinco' maintains vibrant color, showcasing plum and black cherry flavors, delicate aromatic spices from 50% added stems, and a juicy, refreshing finish.

title: Domaine Thibault Liger Belair Chambolle Musigny Vieilles Vignes
bodyHtml:
The Liger-Belair surname carries some serious weight in Burgundy: The comte (count) Louis Liger-Belair was a Napoleonic General who acquired the Chateau de Vosne in 1815, and the family went on to amass an incredible collection of Burgundy’s best vineyards, including “La Romanee” and “La Tache.” More than a century later, in 1933, complicated inheritance laws forced the family to sell their vineyards at auction, although some were re-acquired by future generations. That was the point at which Thibault Liger-Belair’s forebears went their own way, focusing on vineyards primarily in Nuits-Saint-Georges.

This tiny-production Chambolle, a focused and elegant beauty with highly perfumed red and black cherry notes leading the charge, hails from five different lieu-dit parcels in the village, “Bourniques” (near Musigny Grand Cru), “Fremieres,” and “Gamaires.” Vinified using 40% whole grape clusters and aged 18 months in 30% new oak, this is a beautifully precise, high-toned wine that captures the ethereal essence of Chambolle-Musigny. Lay it down for a while for best result!

title: Wolf's Head 'Haymaker' Blend 2018
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Their Story... It all started with a crazy idea amongst a group of oenophile friends to start a winery in California. That crazy idea became a reality with the purchase in late 2012 of 120 acres of unplanted land in Napa. The Wolf's Head name came about when they realized that the perimeter of their land was shaped like a wolf's head! Their vision with the Wolf's Head family of wines is to produce something exceptional yet at a price point that anyone can afford.

Wolf's Head Wines are known for their fruit-forward style with characteristics of California ripeness, judicious use of French oak, and low-acid and soft, velvety tannins. Deep garnet in colour, with sweet aromas of red cherry, blackberries, violets, anise and dried herbs. Medium-bodied with flavours of blackberry pie, baker's chocolate, cedar cigar box and licorice with a long, dry finish. Pairs well with beef, lamb, game, poultry, and mature cheeses.

title: Cascahuin Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Cascahuin Blanco is characterized by a touch of minerality, a characteristic of El Arenal, Jalisco.  

Clean and bright giving a natural amber colour to the worn barrel. The fragrance of raisins and small aromas of almond, peach and golden peanut. Natural flavours are denoted to the wood (American oak barrels), and at the end, a sweet taste of cooked agave matured in the barrel. The dominant aromas and natural flavours of cooked agave are reminiscent of the brick ovens that allow the agave to hold on to the fresh citrus sensations.

title: Casamigos Blanco Tequila - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Double gold winner in 2014 at the San Francisco Spirits Competition, this tequila is made with 100% blue agave.

The nose is smoky with a mild sweet fruit note; the palate is medium-bodied and smooth with fruity character of honey, apple, pepper and florals followed by a medium length finish.

title: Faiveley Gevrey Chambertin 'La Combe Aux Moines' Premier Cru 2020
bodyHtml: This Cote de Nuits wine has a beautiful typicity. It is concentrated, floral and fresh with all the finesse of this grape variety. The intense ruby red colour and an attractive nose offer fresh red fruits, sweet spice, oaky notes and a touch of smoke. The palate is smooth and persistent with fruity, oaky notes that linger on the finish. A remarkably elegant wine with silky smooth tannins and a very distinctive finish. Goes well with beef, veal, game, and poultry.

title: Domaine Thibault Liger Belair Clos Vougeot Grand Cru 2018
bodyHtml:
The Liger-Belair surname carries some serious weight in Burgundy: The comte (count) Louis Liger-Belair was a Napoleonic General who acquired the Chateau de Vosne in 1815, and the family went on to amass an incredible collection of Burgundy’s best vineyards, including “La Romanee” and “La Tache.” More than a century later, in 1933, complicated inheritance laws forced the family to sell their vineyards at auction, although some were re-acquired by future generations. That was the point at which Thibault Liger-Belair’s forebears went their own way, focusing on vineyards primarily in Nuits-Saint-Georges.

A slight touch of reduction is present on the nose, but the palate is well-structured and strict and linear with good freshness.

93 Points - Vinous

The 2018 Clos Vougeot Grand Cru contains 40% whole cluster from the oldest parts of the vineyard, the younger vines de-stemmed. Apparently it struggled to complete its alcoholic fermentation and had to be transferred back into barrel, where it finally finished in June 2019. It has an intriguing bouquet with brown spices and black pepper infusing the vibrant red fruit that leaps from the nose. The palate is well balanced with fine, saturated tannins. The whole bunch is very well assimilated and lends complexity and precision on the finish. Superb.

93 Points - Decanter

The 2018 Clos de Vougeot shows a bit of the heat and the concentration of the year: the harvest was nearly 20% down on 2017. Liger-Belair used the same techniques in the winery: 30% whole clusters, a three-week cuvaison, and aging over two winters in cask, half new. The result, however, is even darker and concentrated than the previous year – one might say almost slightly porty. Impressive if a bit monolithic with its super-ripe black fruits, yet there is still enough balance that it should be lovely with time.

title: Pasqua Amarone della Valpolicella 2017
bodyHtml: This is a wine of great class, appreciated by enthusiasts for its majestic style and complexity. A deep red in color, it has an expansive bouquet with aromas of blackberries, cherries and violets. On the palate it displays spicy tones reminiscent of chocolate and freshly roasted coffee, as well as vanilla notes from its long maturation in wood. The mouthfeel is velvety and well-balanced with gentle tannins and a long finish.

title: J.M. Cazes - Pauillac de Lynch Bages 2021
bodyHtml: Truly a baby Lynch-Bages (well, the third wine) it is a wonder that this member of the Lynch-Bages Family is not more widely lauded.  That is to say it is pretty much a perfect expression of Pauillac, impressive and rich, all autumn, cedar and dark berries. It was first created in 2009 and is made entirely from the fruit of the property.

title: Barbi Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2016 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Intense, vivid ruby–red color with aromas of red and black berries, maraschino cherry and eucalyptus. The aromas repeat on the palate with added hints of liquorice and tobacco. Tannins are firm and tightly woven and the juicy fruit is refreshed by a lively acidity that leads to a long, persistent finish.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

95 Points - Wine Spectator

94 Points - James Suckling

title: Flor de Cana ECO 15 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
A 15-year-old Nicaraguan rum from Flor de Cana that is both carbon neutral and Fair Trade certified, this rum is distilled with 100% renewable energy.

Aromas of nutmeg, hazelnut, caramel and pepper fill the nose, complemented by notes of dark chocolate, vanilla, oak, caramel, roasted hazelnuts and cinnamon throughout the palate.

title: Burrowing Owl Athene 2022
bodyHtml:
Burrowing Owl Vineyards Athene originates from Canada, specifically from the Okanagan Valley subregion of British Columbia. The winery was founded by Jim Wyse, who is committed to creative viticultural and enological practices based on a philosophy of balance and environmental responsibility. 'Athene' is a unique blend that represents the estate's dedication to world-class winemaking in the heart of the Okanagan, a region known for its continental climate and temperature moderation provided by nearby lakes.

Wine Description

This red blend presents a full-bodied and intense character in the glass. The sensory profile is rich and layered, featuring inviting aromas of mixed berry pie, purple plum, sage, and dried thyme, underpinned by notes of coffee and black pepper spice. On the palate, the wine is textured and elegant, delivering flavours of black cherry, blackcurrant, and vanilla, complemented by fresh mint and dried herb notes. The structure is defined by ripe tannins and crisp acidity, which contribute to its significant ageing potential and lead to a long, persistent finish.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend of Syrah and Cabernet Sauvignon.

  • ABV: Recorded at 14.5%.

title: MacNair's Lum Reek 10 Year Old Cask Strength
bodyHtml:
Crafted from a combination of the finest Speyside and Islay Single Malts, including aged GlenAllachie, Batch 1 of our Lum Reek 10-year-old is the perfect balance between peat and rich, fruity character.

The spirit was laid to rest in premium Spanish sherry casks, wine barriques and virgin oak casks at The GlenAllachie Distillery. As time passes, the flavours marry and extract additional characteristics from the wood, creating a deliciously sweet yet subtly smoky flavour profile.

Batch 1 of our 10-year-old is bottled at natural cask strength of 55.4% ABV, with no colour added and non chill filtered for maximum flavour.

title: Le Chiuse Rosso di Montalcino 2023
bodyHtml:
On a hill north-east of Montosoli, 300 meters up in the air, Le Chiuse spans over a mere seven hectares, exclusively planted with Sangiovese Grosso, only one classified Rosso di Montalcino DOC. 

Managed by Simonetta Valiani and Nicolo Magneli, this estate is closely linked to the famous Biondi Santi family who, at the time, used certain property parcels to create its legendary "Reserva" cuvees in the Brunello di Montalcino appellation. 

Opening on notes of preserved cherry and dried flower notes, it also presents mild spice, cinnamon and undergrowth accents. A ready-to-drink wine evoking traditional Tuscan style.

title: Speri Amarone Sant' Urbano 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
A deep garnet red in colour, it has an ethereal bouquet of dried fruit. On the palate, it is full-bodied, warm, mouth-filling and dry. A substantial wine of rare elegance that lends itself well to ageing.

Excellent with richly flavoured main courses based on red meat, such as braised meats and game, and perfect with mature cheeses. It can also be enjoyed on its own at the end of a fine dinner.

94 Points - James Suckling

Dark cherries, blackberries, mussels, licorice, figs and some finely ground black chocolate, following through to a medium-to full-bodied palate with elegant berries and a bittersweet black-chocolate note. A refined, textbook Amarone that shows great poise and modern drinkability.

title: Corte Aura Franciacorta Brut
bodyHtml: A straw yellow wine with harmonious flavours, persistent and elegant bouquet with the known characteristics of fermentation in the bottle, hints of bread crust and yeast enriched by subtle hints of citrus and nuts (almonds, hazelnuts and dry white figs), tasty flavour, fresh, fine and harmonious. On the nose, it is floral and lightly fruity. Great with aperitifs and throughout the meal. It will perfectly go with dishes based on fish or vegetables, main and second coursed based on fish and raw fish, fried fish and vegetables, cold pork meats, white meat, white meat sauce, breaded veal cutlet, and ripe cheese.

title: Bien Nacido Pinot Noir 'The Captain' 2013
bodyHtml:
The 2013 Pinot Noir The Captain is the highest planting of Pinot on their property and a monopole block. They keep this fruit entirely for their estate program and 'The Captain' Cuvee. All other grapes in the vineyard are offered to other wineries, save for 'The Captain.' It is a really wind-scraped vineyard and the vines are highly stressed. This makes for a rich with wonderful balance.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2013 Pinot Noir The Captain offers a pretty, floral, raspberry, spice and forest floor-scented personality to go with medium-bodied richness, fine tannin, and beautifully integrated acidity. Completely destemmed and aged 18 months in 50% new French oak, it’s a flat-out beautiful wine, and the only downside is that there are only 98 cases produced. Drink it anytime over the coming decade.

title: Admiral's Old J Pineapple Spiced Rum
bodyHtml: Old J Pineapple infuses our special blend of 11 flavours into the finest Caribbean rum. The sweet kick of refreshing pineapple cuts through subtle hints of vanilla, creating a totally tropical all-year-round drinking experience. A fresh, tropical flavour profile with a fragrant pineapple aroma and gently accented with sweet notes; suitable for both everyday sipping and dynamic cocktail experiences. An exotic taste, the pineapple-infused rum is beautifully balanced with the crisp freshness of pineapple combined with the smooth vanilla notes that Old J is best known for.

title: Ken Wright Pinot Noir Eola Amity 2023
bodyHtml:
Ken Wright Pinot Noir Eola Amity 2023 originates from the United States, within Oregon's Willamette Valley region and the Eola Amity Hills AVA subregion. Founded in 1994 by winemaking pioneer Ken Wright, the winery focuses on site specific expressions that showcase the distinct soil types and microclimates of Oregon. The Eola Amity Hills regional bottling draws fruit from estate sites planted primarily in shallow volcanic Jory and Nekia soils, influenced by the cooling marine breezes that blow through the Van Duzer Corridor to produce wines with natural acidity and distinct spice.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a translucent, bright ruby colour. The nose is vibrant and lifted, offering aromas of tart red cherry, cranberry, and wild strawberry, complemented by floral hints of violet, crushed gravel, dried herbs, and subtle sweet baking spices. On the palate, it features a medium body with a sleek, energetic texture underpinned by vibrant, mouthwatering acidity and fine, firm tannins. Stylistically, the wine highlights regional freshness, bright fruit purity, and savory complexity, leading into a long, crisp finish with lingering notes of red fruit and crushed stone minerality.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Pinot Noir

  • Alcohol by volume: 13.5%

title: Appleton Estate Taster Pack - 3 x 200 ml Bottles
bodyHtml: The Appleton Estate Taster Pack brings together three superb rums produced in Jamaica for a heartwarming winter gift that is sure to delight any recipient! Included in the pack are three 200 mL bottles of Appletons rum, one rich-tasting Signature, one elegantly oaked 8-year-old, and one superbly complex 12-year-old.

title: Tenute Silvio Nardi Brunello di Montalcino 2018
bodyHtml: Tenute Silvio Nardi's classic Brunello is a blend of the finest grapes from the Manachiara and Casale del Bosco estates. Silvio Nardi follows the strict DOCG laws required of a classified Brunello di Montalcino. Yield is limited; only the top 70% of the grapes are used to make the wine. The fruit is carefully handpicked and sorted. Fermentation and maceration take at least 24 days (varies with parcel) at a controlled temperature of less than 86°F. Aged for 12 months in new and used French oak barriques (Allier) before 18 months in large Slavonian oak barrels. Bottle aged at least 12 months before release.

title: Bladnoch Alinta Single Malt Scotch
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
From the world's oldest privately owned Scotch Whisky Distillery comes a Single Malt reimagined. Bladnoch Distillery is their over 200 year old home where they craft the finest Lowland Single Malt Scotch Whisky.

For the first time since Bladnoch was reborn under David Prior’s ownership, we are adding a peated whisky to the range, which we have named ‘Alinta’.

This indigenous Australian word from several South East Australian language groups means ‘fire’ and ‘flames’, and evokes the notes of Campfire Embers found in each sip. 

Created by Master Distiller Dr Nick Savage, he explains that 'Alinta combines PX Sherry and ex-Bourbon casks to showcase the combination of these distinct flavours - it is an amazing balance of rich raisin-like sweetness and smoky campfire that sets it apart from anything else in Bladnoch’s selection of single malts.

title: Hardy Noces d'Or Sublime
bodyHtml:
A part of the sought-after Prestige collection, the Noces D'Or is an incredibly appealing Cognac. Made from a carefully assembled blend of over 40 different eaux-de-vie from the highly renowned Grande Champagne region. Dating back 30, 40, 50 and 60 years, every bottle has undeniable history and expertise. A sublime, rounded, balanced Cognac with a delightful blend of fresh and floral notes.

A true classic with a favourably unique blend, The Hardy's prestigious history of creating top-quality Cognac comes into its own in this creation. It's the perfect choice to be enjoyed on a special occasion worthy of a superior Cognac celebration.

Displayed in a delightful art nouveau decanter, the rarity of this delight is evident at first glance. Showcasing sleek lines, sophistication and superiority are beautifully communicated with style and grace. A hand-etched glass plaque featuring the house's coat of arms and the recognizable Hardy Rooster makes this a bottle you won't forget.

A beautifully complimented blend of mahogany and copper tones. The nose is well-balanced and delightfully pure. Floral aroma, with enticing notes of budding lilac. Freshness from the first hit on the palate, due to a lively alcohol onset, with a subtly of candied cherries to follow. Wonderfully balanced, with a perfect blend of fruity, flowery and slightly woody notes.

title: That Boutique-y Whisky Collection Set - 12 x 30 ml Bottles
bodyHtml:
Fantastic independent whisky bottler That Boutique-y Whisky Company and Drinks by the Dram have teamed up to create a stunning present for whisky fans, behold, That Boutique-y Whisky Company's 12 Dram Collection!

Behind each of its 12 windows awaits a different 30ml wax-sealed dram from That Boutique-y Whisky Company's fabulous selection. Perfect for enjoying some terrific treats with friends, this collection ought to impress indeed!

title: Hardy XO Rare Cognac
bodyHtml: The XO Rare draws you into a world like no other. Draped in its amber-tinted vermilion robe, its magical fresh rose petal, ripe date and cigar box scents are an enchantment. The silky texture that comes with the maturity of a great XO is equalled only by its incredibly long-lasting flavours.

title: Drinks By The Dram Premium Rum Tasting Set - 5 x 30 ml Bottles
bodyHtml: There's always time for rum! A tasting set containing 5 different 30 ml samples of premium rum.

title: Glenrothes 25 Year Old
bodyHtml: The Soleo Collection from Glenrothes takes its name from the process of sun-drying grapes for sherry making in Jerez, so you’re in for a sherried treat here. The range also eschews the vintages as seen on previous Glenrothes bottlings, instead featuring age statements on most of them. This one is a 25 year old expression, and features a high proportion of first fill sherry seasoned oak casks at its core. Aged in mostly first-fill sherry-seasoned casks, it has notes of tropical fruits, coriander seed and salted caramel.

title: Cusumano Alta Mora 'Guardiola' Etna Rosso 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Cusumano Alta Mora 'Guardiola' Etna Rosso originates from Italy, within the Sicily region and the Etna DOC subregion. The Alta Mora project was founded by brothers Diego and Alberto Cusumano alongside their father, Francesco, as a dedicated venture to explore the winemaking potential of Europe's largest active volcano. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the extreme quality and distinctive traits of the volcanic terroir. This specific cuvée is a single-vineyard expression sourced from a tiny parcel of incredibly rare, 150-year-old pre-phylloxera vines situated at a high altitude between 800 and 1,000 metres above sea level in the Guardiola contrada.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a luminous ruby red appearance with light brick garnet reflections and possesses a medium-to-full body with a remarkably smooth, flowing structure. The sensory profile is highly elegant, opening with a complex aromatic nose of red currants, blackberries, and wild rose, layered with underlying notes of forest floor, leather, and walnut husk, alongside mineral sensations of graphite and ash. On the precise and juicy palate, it delivers a vibrant perception of freshness supported by a satisfying saline component, unfolding into flavours of small red fruits, peppermint, and black pepper wrapped in dense, velvety tannins. The finish is long and well-structured, characterized by an articulate persistence and a lingering savory edge.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Nerello Mascalese.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its remarkable structure and poise, achieving its complexity through a 18-to-21-day maceration followed by malolactic fermentation in wood and extended aging in large 25-to-50-hectoliter oak barrels and tonneaux.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 14% and 14.5% depending on the vintage.

  • Organic Status: While the estate relies on traditional manual agriculture and gravity-flow architecture constructed from local lava stones to minimize environmental impact, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant mineral tension, fresh acidity, and fine-grained tannins of this Etna Rosso make it a highly adaptable companion for rich and savory cuisine.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with herb-seasoned pork, roasted chicken, grilled duck breast, or a classic bone-in ribeye steak.

  • Seafood: Suggested pairings include traditional grilled Sicilian tuna fillets, which beautifully complement the wine's volcanic salinity.

  • Savoury: Matches exceptionally well with rustic pasta dishes served with fresh tomatoes, wild mushroom sauces, or traditional meat ragù.

  • Cheese & Salumi: Complements platters of artisanal Italian salami or hard cheeses like mature Gruyère.

title: Fratelli Alessandria 'San Lorenzo di Verduno' Barolo 2020
bodyHtml:
This single-vineyard Barolo originates from Italy, within the commune of Verduno in the Barolo DOCG zone of Piedmont. Established in the early 19th century, the family-run Fratelli Alessandria estate is led by Vittore Alessandria alongside his parents Gian Battista and Flavia, and uncle Alessandro. The house is globally revered for capturing the signature finesse, ethereal floral aromatics, and haunting elegance unique to Verduno's northernmost Barolo terroir. The San Lorenzo vineyard sits at around 250 meters altitude on calcareous-clay soils rich in limestone and Marne di Sant'Agata marl, imparting a distinct mineral tension and spice profile to the wine.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2020 San Lorenzo displays a classic translucent garnet-ruby color with orange-tinted rim variations. The highly expressive nose opens with delicate aromas of dried red cherry, wild strawberry, and cranberry, interwoven with signature notes of crushed rose petals, white pepper, star anise, blood orange, leather, and wet chalky stone. On the palate, it is medium-to-full-bodied, characterized by silky precision, vibrant acidity, and refined, chalky Nebbiolo tannins. Crafted from 100% Nebbiolo, the grapes are hand-harvested, destemmed, and fermented in temperature-controlled stainless steel with traditional skin maceration lasting 20 to 25 days. The wine is aged for approximately 30 months in large Slavonian and French oak casks (botti grandi), followed by additional maturation in bottle before release. The alcohol by volume sits at 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The complex aromatic lift, firm tannic structure, and bright acidity of this Verduno Barolo make it a exceptional match for earthy, savory Piedmontese cuisine. It pairs brilliantly with dishes featuring white or black truffles, such as tajarin egg pasta with butter and shaved truffle or mushroom risotto. Excellent meat pairings include braised beef (brasato al Barolo), roasted rack of lamb, pan-seared duck breast with a sour cherry reduction, and roasted wild boar. For cheese pairings, opt for well-aged hard cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano, Castelmagno, or mature Fontina.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 vintage in Barolo produced fragrant, vibrant, and remarkably harmonious wines with lower alcohol and earlier accessibility than the warmer 2019 or hot 2017 vintages. A mild winter and balanced summer allowed Nebbiolo grapes to reach optimal phenolic ripeness while retaining essential acidity and aromatics. In Verduno, where soil conditions naturally favor elegance and floral perfume, the 2020 San Lorenzo shows exceptional balance and pure fruit expression. While it offers alluring charm and approachable drinking early with proper decanting, it possesses the structural integrity to cellar and evolve gracefully for 12 to 20+ years.

Accolades

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck: Pouring a jeweled ruby color, the 2020 Barolo San Lorenzo Di Verduno is a bit more reserved on opening, with notes of fresh red cherries, then takes a darker mineral tone aromatically, with a hint of black truffle, fresh crushed flowers, and fresh earth. The palate reveals more depth and richness while being light on its feet, with sweet tannins, more sapidity, a mouthwatering mineral tone, and a delicate glycerol richness. It has an approachable feel and is going to have a wide drinking window over the next 10-15 years.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast: Lifted aromas of high-toned red fruits, with fresh cherries, raspberries, and cranberries leading the charge mingle notes of clove, anise and cinnamon. Hints of thyme and rosemary, along with a touch of black tea, provide an intriguing shift to the nose as it opens. On the palate, the wine displays a balance between savory and fruit with a slightly herbal edge that adds to its allure. Fine tannins provide structure and support. Drink now - 2040.

93 Points - James Suckling: This is spiced and walnut-like on the nose with fresh red fruit, cloves, licorice and bark on offer. Medium- to full-bodied, tense and firm with compact tannins and vivid acidity. Shows impressive volume and length. Juicy and vibrant, too, with a lingering, zesty finish.

title: Paladin 'Drago Rosso' Merlot 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Merlot Drago Rosso has a deep ruby-red colour. The bouquet has a strong aromatic charge balanced by enveloping scents reminiscent of red fruit, such as cherry and blueberry, accompanied by light spicy notes. The palate is full and balanced with a good structure. The light tannins give a persistent and harmonious ending. Perfect to taste during a barbecue with red meat or game with friends. Try it also in pair with salami and or spicy cheeses.

title: Stina Cuvee White 2023
bodyHtml:
The winery is from the island of Brac, unique and famous for its white stone (Stina). Many famous Croatian poets, authors, sculptors and painters were born on Brac. 

Brac stone has always been a source of inspiration due to its beauty, but it is also a symbol of hardship when it comes to viticulture and viniculture. And that is where the inspiration for the name STINA comes from.  

The grapes for this wine come from the island of Brac, from younger and older vineyards inland of the island that is suitable for growing this variety. The harvest is done manually and selectively early in the morning, in order to preserve freshness and flavour in the grapes.

This is a blend of two indigenous Croatian grapes, Posip and Vugava with a small amount of Chardonnay added for structure and body.

title: Tormaresca Primitivo Neprica 2022
bodyHtml: Brilliantly ruby red in colour, the wine has aromas of fresh red fruit such as plums and cherries as well as floral notes of rose and violet. Excellent structure and is supple on the palate with an elegant return to the red fruit notes on the long finish.

title: Tolaini Valdisanti 2021
bodyHtml:
An elegant, structured and full-bodied wine with rich dark berry fruit and cassis aromas, the lush fruit framed by balanced oak. The elegant, structured tannins help to make this a cellar-worthy wine.

95 Points - James Suckling

Clove, vanilla, restrained cherry, milk chocolate and balsamic aromas. The attack is soft and velvety, with dense tannins, a savory character, a full body and crisp, refreshing acidity. Great mid-palate extraction and details. Embracing finish, long and consistent.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Focused like a laser, this racy red features black currant, black cherry, cedar, licorice and graphite aromas and flavors. A balanced version, with a light dusting of tannins shoring up the finish. Excellent length.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Made with equal parts Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc, the Tolaini 2021 Valdisanti is a lush expression with a big, upfront delivery of bold black fruit. On the palate, that intensity tapers off somewhat to reveal a silky and elegant mid to full-bodied approach. It shows great length and a softer texture than you might expect given the first impact of the bouquet.

93 Points - Vinous

title: Choya Umeshu Gold Edition - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Established in 1914 as a grape grower, Choya began producing its iconic umeshu in 1959 and has since become the world's leading producer of Japanese plum liqueur. The Gold Edition is a limited-run, ultra-premium expression designed to celebrate the marriage of Japanese tradition and French luxury. It is distinct for being one of the few liqueurs in the world to feature genuine 24K gold flakes, which are carefully pounded to 0.0001 millimeters in thickness to resemble plum blossoms dancing in the wind.

Description

This luxurious liqueur presents a deep amber colour with visible gold leaves shimmering throughout the bottle. The nose is remarkably complex and seductive, opening with the aroma of fully ripe Nanko ume and honey, followed by wood tones, caramel, and dried fruit. On the palate, it delivers a rich and silky mouthfeel, showcasing a bright symphony of tangy plum and the mellow, deep flavours of French brandy from the Cognac region. It is aged for over three years, allowing for a unique, multilayered taste with subtle notes of roasted almond, citrus, and marzipan. It contains no artificial additives, colourings, or preservatives. ABV 19%.

Food Pairing

The elegant sweetness and structural acidity of this umeshu make it an excellent partner for savory-sweet combinations. It pairs exceptionally well with rich Chinese cuisine, roast beef, and teriyaki-glazed meats. For a more delicate experience, try it alongside a cheese platter, fruit-based desserts, or even dark chocolate. It is traditionally enjoyed slowly in a brandy glass to highlight its fragrance, served either neat, chilled, or on the rocks.

title: Grosset Springvale Riesling 2024
bodyHtml:
Grosset is the go-to name for Clare Valley Riesling, so parcels of their wines are highly sought after. The Springvale vineyard is found at the region's highest elevation, and the red loamy soil produces an open and accessible style with delicate, fragrant characteristics.

Very light and pale colour with fragrant aromas of floral bouquets, lavender and lime zest. Dry, crisp and finely-structured citrus fruit with spine-tingling mineral notes. An ultra-clean, pristine, new-world expression of this classic grape variety.

title: Gallina de Piel Roca del Crit 2019
bodyHtml:
Roca del Crit is a red wine produced by Gallina de Piel Wines, D.O. Emporda.

Gallina de Piel Wines is the personal project of David Seijas, sommelier at the El Bulli restaurant for 13 years. With this project, David Seijas aims to bring wine closer to people from the sommelier’s point of view, enhancing different styles and profiles, and seeking the character and personality of the place where they come from.

David makes his wines together with the best producers, selecting the best vineyards and local grapes. He currently produces two wines, one in Emporda and the other in Valdeorras, two very special areas for him. Galicia, where he has his family roots, and the Emporda, where he has lived his best years as a sommelier in El Bulli.

Roca del Crit is a wine made with Grenache and Carignan. The Grenache comes from the Mas Mares area, it is 15 years old and is planted on granitic soils. The Carignan, on the other hand, comes from the area of ​​Rabos, it is over 80 years old and is planted on shale soils.

After the harvest, the Grenache is vinified in stainless steel deposits.10% ferments with the stems and ages on its lees for 6 months. The Carignan also ferments in stainless steel and is aged for 12 months in used barrels of different sizes, from 500 to 700 litres.

title: Leopold's Gin No.25
bodyHtml:
Leopold Bros. looked to the orange orchards on the rolling hills of Santa Catarina, Brazil to start. Green and Red Mandarin Oranges have grown in this region for centuries, and it is here that they found the flavours they were seeking. When this fruit is harvested in September, the Mandarin Orange is green in colour, yielding an aromatic peel used in cuisines around the world. When these same Oranges are harvested in late December, they yield a reddish fruit that has a floral and intense citrus aroma similar to its cousin, the Tangerine.

Leopold Bros. distills Santa Catarina’s Green and Red Mandarin Oranges separately, blending the two distillates together in the final gin. This allows the two contrasting flavours to work in concert, marrying citrus and floral notes to a piquant finish. In addition to the citrus, they finish the Gin with earthy and savoury notes using Orris Root, Juniper, Sri Lankan White Pepper, and South African Rooibos Tea.

title: La Gioiosa Prosecco Rose Millesimato 2023
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1974 by the Moretti Polegato family, La Gioiosa ("The Joyous") is named after the ancient name of the province where the wines are farmed and produced: Treviso, known in antiquity as a "joyous" region because of its lush farmland and widespread prosperity. Today, the winery produces a wide range of Proseccos, including classic Prosecco, low-calorie Prosecco, and organically farmed Prosecco. The winery is also a leader in the production of environmentally friendly wines and it strives to limit its carbon footprint by using alternative energy sources, including hydroelectric power generated by the nearby Piave river. 

The Prosecco Rose presents itself revealing a pomegranate nuance edged with soft pink reflections. The nose is subtle and fresh, offering hints of small red fruits. Notes of rose and pomegranate complete this elegant and intense aromatic profile. On the palate, it is silky and full, presenting a very pleasant balance between the fruity and floral notes. Excellent as an aperitif. Ideal with finger foods and Mediterranean first courses.

title: Piper Heidsieck Brut (NV) - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Piper-Heidsieck Brut champagne brings its own lively, vivacious and exuberant character to dry champagne’s traditional elegance and finesse. It combines 50 rigorously selected growths. Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier grapes give this cuvee its structure and elegance. Reserve wines from earlier years are used to create a more rounded blend and ensure the originality of the Piper-Heidsieck style. The wine’s harmony develops over the course of slow aging in Piper-Heidsieck’s chalk cellars.

Sparkling clarity, pale gold in color. On the nose, the very first impressions are of bright, fresh mornings. It is reminiscent of spring blossom such as hawthorn. They lead into more fruity notes such as summer apple and pear, then citrus, with hints of warm toastiness. The palate is lively and fresh. The citrus notes take on a certain maturity. There is passion with gentleness, lightness with spontaneity.

title: Fanti Brunello di Montalcino 'Vallocchio' 2021
bodyHtml: Fanti Brunello di Montalcino Vallocchio DOCG shows vibrant ruby red color with hints of garnet. Initially, there are powerful scents of ripe fruit that gradually evolve into fragrances of sweet spices, coffee, and licorice. The first sip immediately reveals the intricate complexity and robust structure of this particular selection. The fruity notes detected in the aroma seamlessly blend with the delicate tannins, which are noticeable but not overpowering. The finish is characterized by a smooth and persistent sensation. This vintage is further enhanced by its freshness and mineral qualities, highlighting the significance of this opulent and refined year, making it suitable for extended bottle aging.

title: S by Ray Signorello Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
This modern and opulent red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the premier Napa Valley region in California. The winery's philosophy for this specific bottling is to move beyond the boundaries of the home estate to produce a "plush and crowd-pleasing" expression of Cabernet that captures the diversity of Napa's top sub-appellations. The blend is particularly notable for the addition of fruit from the historic Pelissa Vineyard in Oakville, joining sources from St. Helena and Howell Mountain.

Wine Description

S by Ray Signorello presents an inky and saturated profile. The sensory profile is described as "an iron fist in a velvet glove," featuring an aromatic nose of blackberry compote, cassis, and black cherry, layered with sophisticated hints of cacao nibs, tobacco spice, and cedarwood. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and powerful, showcasing flavours of boysenberry and dark berry fruit interwoven with graham-cracker nuances. It is characterized by its "iron-clad" tannins and a long, focused finish with graphite-laced precision. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon typically reaches an ABV between 14.5% and 15% and was matured for 26 months in French oak (50% new). All vineyards are farmed with a focus on sustainable and site-specific purity.

title: Tenuta Mazzolino 'Noir' Pinot Nero 2022
bodyHtml:
Tenuta Mazzolino 'Noir' Pinot Nero originates from Italy, within the Oltrepò Pavese region of Lombardy. The family owned estate is built on a philosophy of respect for the land, focusing on organic cultivation and minimal intervention to allow the terroir to express itself. Historically, the winery emphasizes "not adding but elevating," striving to safeguard the purest expressions of the grape under the guidance of oenologists like Giovanni Angeli. The vineyard's clay-loam soil with veins of sandstone and a gypsum substrate provides a unique foundation for their high-density, low-yield vines.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Nero presents an intense and clear ruby red colour, often featuring elegant garnet reflections. The sensory profile is broad and complex, offering a refined bouquet of mature forest fruits like raspberry and strawberry, alongside nuanced notes of pomegranate, tree bark, and white pepper. On the medium to full bodied palate, the wine is silky and well structured, delivering flavours of dark cherry and balsamic accents balanced by noble tannins and a fresh acidity. The finish is harmonious and persistent, revealing lingering returns of spices and aromatic woods.

title: Tenuta Sette Cieli 'Indaco' Toscana 2018
bodyHtml:
Winemaker Elena Pozzolini is becoming one of the most talked about rising stars in Tuscany. Lauded by the critics, this exceptional blend is altogether powerful, age-worthy, and utterly delicious. This is an estate to watch.

A Bordeaux blend of Malbec, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, Indaco is super smooth, and open-knit to begin with, displaying ripeness and the warmth of this vintage, but also with more savoury notes, leather, and cedar, with some good grip, becoming more and more delicious. You can tell your friends this is the new Sassicaia. Drinking now and for many years to come.

title: Chateau La Mondotte 2019
bodyHtml:
La Mondotte is located on the eastern part of the Saint-Emilion plateau next to Troplong-Mondot. This 4.5-hectare vineyard is an absolute gem. Its outstanding terroir has all the natural qualities to produce very great wine. Excellent hydric regulation encourages the vines to sink their roots deep into the soil. The superb sun exposure and fine natural drainage due to the steep slope make this a very early-maturing terroir.

The vines are an average of 50 years old and the vineyard contains only premium grape varieties. Ripening, especially of Merlot, is almost invariably early and complete. The terroir, age of the vines, and infinite attention paid to viticulture and enology, combine to produce truly great wine at La Mondotte. The terroir also confers unparalleled finesse. This rare wine (maximum annual production of just 11,000 bottles) is always in very great demand.

99 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Mulled blackcurrants, darker cherries, tobacco leaf, chocolate, lead pencil, and burning ember-like nuances all emerge from this brilliant wine, and it's full-bodied, concentrated, and powerful, with good acidity, building tannins, and a great, great finish. It holds onto the more classic, focused style of the vintage, yet it's a beast of a wine that brings the goods. Hide bottles for a solid 7-8 years or more, count yourself lucky, and it's going to have 30-40 years of longevity.

97 Points - James Suckling

This has a fragrant nose of blackberries, red tea, cloves, bark, orange zest and dark chocolate. Sandalwood and tile, too. Full-bodied with chewy yet supple tannins and fresh acidity. Seamless and rich. Long and muscular. 

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This is a gorgeous display of fruit, with boysenberry, fig and mulberry notes rolling through, showing both muscle and refinement as they carry a punch while staying silky and lush in feel. There are sweet tobacco, sous bois and black tea flavours peeking in on the finish and this is remarkably fine-grained for the vintage. A clear classic. Merlot and Cabernet Franc.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Aromas of smoky blackberries, black truffles, pipe tobacco, loamy soil and rose petals introduce the 2019 La Mondotte, a medium to full-bodied, deep and velvety wine that's lively and gourmand, with a rich core of fruit that's framed by beautifully polished tannins. This Merlot-dominant Cuvee derives from vineyards on the plateau neighbouring Troplong-Mondot, but the soils are shallower here, without the same reserves of deep clay.

92 Points - Decanter

Concentrated big framed fruit flavours; attractive damson and black cherry, lashed in with licorice, chocolate and black truffle. No question that this is an impressive wine.

title: Chateau Talbot 2019
bodyHtml:
This imposing estate owes its name to Connetable Talbot, the English general and governor of the province of Guyenne who was defeated at the famous Battle of Castillon in 1453. Talbot's vines grow in an ideal location bordering an estuary, on some of the region's most highly prized gravel rises which alone produce great wine. Talbot is one of the oldest estates in the Medoc, and its reputation has been in the hands of experienced managers, and has always shown itself to be worthy of its inclusion in the 1855 classification.

94+ Points - Wine Enthusiast

A rich, spicy and smoky wine, this has generous tannins to balance the blackberry fruit flavours. The structure is already impressive, showing ripeness as well as density, which is promising for plenty of aging.

94+ Points - James Suckling

A juicy, fruity wine with lots of blue fruit, blackberries and dark chocolate. Pretty depth and structure to this. Polished and structured at the same time.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Well-built and rather refined for the vintage, with a deep well of red and black currant paste and plum reduction flavours supported by a deeply inlaid iron note, all of which run the length of the wine. Offers subtle savoury, tobacco and singed cedar notes that add range, with a savoury echo that leaves a mouthwatering feel in the end. 

93 Points - Decanter

St Julien's largest property at 110ha (up there with Lagrange if you're keeping track), has lovely plump black fruits on the nose. Takes hold right from the start, with a clear tannic build and a silky character to the tannins. This continues the run of good vintages that Talbot has been producing since 2016. Well balanced, with plenty of St Julien character.

93+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2019 Chateau Talbot is straight-up impressive, sporting a dense purple hue as well as a powerful nose of cassis, scorched earth, smoked tobacco, and spicy wood. Rich, black-fruited, medium to full-bodied, and structured, it's a rock-solid, balanced Saint-Julien that will benefit from 4-5 years of bottle age and age for 15-20 years.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Enthusiast

The 2019 Talbot is performing well, opening in the glass with aromas of earthy cassis, plums, burning embers and pencil shavings. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and succulent, with powdery tannins, lively acids and a savoury finish, it's Jean-Michel Laporte's second vintage at this sleeping giant of Saint-Julien. This will be an estate to watch closely going forward.

title: Hall Ranch Zinfandel 2019
bodyHtml: Black ruby colour. Aromas of ripe red strawberries, candied plum, ripe melons, and orange peel with a slightly chewy, crisp, fruity medium body and a seamless, interesting, medium-length. Chocolate-covered berry jellies, black tea, and toasted hazelnut finish with moderate oak flavour. A rock-solid red in a crowd-pleasing style.

title: Lucien Muzard Meursault 'Les Meix Chavaux' 2023
bodyHtml: Les Meix Chavaux in Meursault borders Auxey-Duresses and is a stony and cool parcel. The oldest vines were planted in 1935, and the grapes are kept on the vine longer to fully ripen. The wine is fermented and aged in both stainless steel and oak, of which a portion is new. A full-bodied and rich dry white, this sees lees aging and had a stony mineral focus.

title: Canadian Club Chronicles 45 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Canadian Club is an iconic brand that has propelled the Canadian whisky category to fame around the world for almost 160 years. CC’s success and longevity can be attributed not only to the brand’s renowned history, but also to the quality of the product inside its bottles. They have always prided themselves on making a superior whisky accessible to everyone who wished to enjoy it. This is what has allowed their award-winning whisky to endure the test of time, throughout history and changing trends and tastes. Today, Canadian Club continues to be the choice of savvy drinkers who are looking for a classic cocktail, or simply a great tasting whisky served neat.

CC’s pivotal role during Prohibition paved the way for it to be enjoyed by iconic characters in some of the most acclaimed films and TV series from the 1960s through to present day. With a past as storied as the characters who supped it, Canadian Club is a true global icon in its own right.

Savor the enticing aromas of warm pear, baking spices, and toffee with a hint of leather. Then enjoy the taste of espresso crema balanced with wine poached pear and nutty praline.

title: Antica Mountain Select Chardonnay 2020
bodyHtml: The name Antica originates from the words Antinori and California and represents the Antinori family's long-standing desire to craft exceptional estate wines that are a true expression of Napa Valley terroir. This wine opens on the nose with notes of chamomile, crisp apple, lemon peel and brioche. It has a vibrancy on the palate that lends itself to having a second glass. Flavours of pear, quince and wet stone exhibit the full range of complexity they garner from their estate in the elevated Foss Valley.

title: Chateau Malartic Lagraviere 2019
bodyHtml:
Since acquiring Château Malartic-Lagraviere in 1997, the Bonnie family has continued to work tirelessly, with passion and commitment, to perfect the estate’s wines and carry them to the highest level. Chateau Malartic-Lagraviere is one of the only six classified growths both for its red and white. Its wines are well known all over the world amongst the very best wines in the Pessac-Leognan appellation.

96 Points - James Suckling

Very complex aromas of dark berries, mushrooms, earth, flowers and incense. Crushed stone, too. Full-bodied with very fine, refined tannins that are caressing and beautiful. It’s very, very long and persistent in the finish with subtle and complex flavours. This will deliver beauty with age. 

96 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2019 Chateau Malartic-Lagraviere showed brilliantly, with an elegant, pure, flawlessly balanced style. Giving up ripe black cherry, currants, tobacco leaf, and spicy oak, with textbook Graves, and scorched earth, it hits the palate with medium to full-bodied richness, a beautiful layered, seamless mouthfeel, great tannins, and one heck of a great finish.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The Bonnie family has worked wonders at this estate, producing today one of the top wines of the appellation. This latest release, equally rich in tannins and fruit, is dense, powerful and also elegant. 

95 Points - Decanter

A successful and accomplished vintage at Malartic Lagraviere, this is concentrated and upfront in its dark berry fruits, great control from the tannins, and tons of Pessac character and finesse. An estate that has become a serious heavyweight in the appellation, showing here gourmet, saline, precise character.

94+ Points - Vinous

It has a lovely bouquet with disarming blackberry, briary and subtle marine scents, just a whiff of brine in the background from the distant Gironde estuary. The palate is medium-bodied with extremely fine tannins that frame the layers of blackberry, raspberry and orange rind notes. Satin-like in texture, this feels reassuringly long in the mouth with a dab of white pepper on the aftertaste. What an outstanding Malartic from the Bonnie family.

92+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of raspberries, blackcurrants, charcoal and forest floor preface the 2019 Malartic Lagraviere, a medium to full-bodied, fleshy and charming wine that's lively and elegant, built around bright acids and fine, powdery tannins. This has turned out nicely in the bottle and shows good potential for improvement in the cellar.

title: Adictivo Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Adictivo Whiskey is a new, unique 100% Single Malt Whiskey. Aged in new hand-picked American Oak casks and finished in Adictivo Tequila casks, this dark amber Whiskey has a flavour like no other. This is the first Whiskey produced by Adictivo, and what makes it so special is the finishing process in Adictivo Tequila Casks. This gives Adictivo Whiskey a flavour that other Whiskeys just can't compete with.

Notes of vanilla bean, sweet fruit and fresh mint on the nose. The palate is pleasantly woody with accents of spice, smoke and nutmeg. The finish is long, sweet and slightly toasty. Try it today and see for yourself why Adictivo Whiskey is quickly becoming a favourite among discerning whiskey drinkers.

title: Lalocura Tepeztate Espadin
bodyHtml: Lalocura Tepeztate is made with 15-year-old agave Tepeztate. The agave is cooked in an underground pit horno with Encino wood, mashed by hand with wooden mallets, and fermented with open-air yeasts in cypress tanks. Distilled in small clay pots, this Tepeztate is different from most others you'll find on the market as the clay pots soften the sharper notes, creating a more rounded and balanced experience.

title: La Maldita Garnacha Rose 2024
bodyHtml: An exclusive rose from vineyards located in Rioja Alta, in the areas of Briones Badaran. Garnacha ripens more slowly there, producing a subtle rose with aromas of red fruit, increased freshness and less colour concentration. Free-run methods produce this rose with a subtle colour and aromas of red fruit, which was kept over the lees in stainless steel for three months. Ruby ​​red in the glass. Fruity, ripe fruit, floral aromas and herbs on the nose. In the mouth, aromas are fruity with slightly bitter notes, and good acidity. Fresh and pleasant.

title: Domaine Nico 'Grand Pere' Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
This delicate red wine originates from Argentina, produced within the highly acclaimed Tupungato region of the Uco Valley in Mendoza. Domaine Nico was lovingly founded by Laura Catena to honour her grandfather through a series of elegant high altitude Pinot Noir bottlings. The family operates under a winemaking philosophy focused on traditional, gentle methods and micro terroir expression, farming the very first vineyard that the Catena family planted in the region back in 1993.

Wine Description

  • Colour: Pale ruby to garnet colour featuring copper shades at the rim.

  • Aroma: An intense, expressive nose delivering aromas of red bramble fruits, dried cherries, and raspberries, beautifully layered with accents of rose petals, pepper, oregano, and earthy mushrooms.

  • Palate: Juicy, incisive, and harmonious on the palate, carrying flavours of ripe red plum, tart cherry, and chocolate supported by a striking saline thread and subtle spices.

  • Body: Light to medium-bodied with an elegant, focused framework.

  • Finish: A lengthy, tight finish featuring fine, velvety tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir sourced from Dijon clones grown in a unique two hectare, shaded parcel characterized by stonier alluvial soils.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine shows magnificent tension, freshness, and nerve. Due to the high elevation of 1,100 metres and the shaded nature of the Grand Père plot, it exhibits a low perception of alcohol alongside an abundance of vibrant, snappy acidity.

  • Alcohol by Volume: 13.0%

  • Organic Status: Not certified organic, though minded with sustainable, gentle viticulture.

Food Pairing

  • Earthy mushroom risotto or a rich wild mushroom tart.

  • Classic herb roast chicken or roasted turkey dishes.

  • Creamy Bourgogne cheeses, cured charcuterie boards, or aged meats.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 vintage in Mendoza was characterized by a cooler growing season that yielded lower production across the Uco Valley. This unique climate proved highly beneficial for delicate varieties like Pinot Noir, allowing the grapes to retain high natural acidity, pristine aromatics, and a wonderfully focused, nervy flavor profile.

Accolades

95 Points - James Suckling: "Red nervy fruit, pepper and oregano on the nose. The palate is juicy but incisive, with red bramble fruit. The palate is saline, succulent and focused, with so much harmony. From a 2-hectare plot planted in 1993 in Villa Bastías."

title: Chateau Sansonnet
bodyHtml:
Chateau Sansonnet is located in the North East corner of Saint-Emilion in the heart of the Grands Classified Growths. The exceptional terroir is composed of a thin layer of clay on limestone. 

Winemaker Dominique Bordeneuve has great experience in winemaking after 20 years at Chateau Sansonnet, it allows the property to rely on a unique knowledge of its terroir and plot. Jean Trias, the technical manager, has always been passionate about the world of wine. He held positions and responsibilities in many properties before settling at Chateau Sansonnet in 2000 where he strives to develop the best wines.

96 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Another beautiful wine from the Lefevere family that does everything right, the 2019 Chateau Sansonnet has a textbook Saint-Emilion bouquet of chalky minerality, ripe red and black fruits, notes of truffle and flowers, medium to full body, and beautiful overall balance. In the past, this wine has had a glossy, slightly modern style (in a good sense), but 2019 has an incredibly classic feel with its oak nicely integrated and just a liquid rock-like minerality on the finish. It's a gorgeous wine that will benefit from 2-4 years of bottle age and keep for over two decades. 

94+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Opaque garnet-purple in colour, the 2019 Sansonnet comes skipping out of the glass with vibrant notes of Morello cherries, blueberry compote, mulberries and warm black plums plus hints of raspberry leaves, Sichuan pepper, cassia and cumin seed with a waft of tree bark. The full-bodied palate is packed with crunchy black and red fruits, framed by exquisitely ripe, rounded tannins and bold freshness, finishing very long and mineral-laced. Beautiful!

94 Points - James Suckling

Ripe blackberries, cherries, praline, walnuts and lavender on the nose. It’s medium-to-full-bodied with fine, plush tannins. Creamy and polished.

title: Lalocura Tobala Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Made with Agave Tobala in Santa Catarina Minas, Oaxaca. Eduardo "Lalo" Angeles cooks his maguey Tobala with Encino wood, mashes the cooked agave with mallets, ferments the agave in Mexican Cypress vats, and double distills the mezcal in small clay pots. His operation is small and there are only limited batches of his Tobala available.

Lalocura and their philosophy were born out of two guiding principles: the preservation of knowledge and tradition, and the sustainable use of their community's natural resources. They produce mezcal with the same materials and methods that their family has used for more than 100 years.

title: Tormaresca 'Calafuria' Salento Rosato 2025
bodyHtml:
Known as the name behind the Modern Renaissance of Puglia in the winemaking industry. The Tormaresca wine label was established in the year 1998 by the Antinori Family. A prime reason for establishing this brand was to bring out the maximum potential of the rich terroirs found in the Murgia Alo Salento regions in Apulia. It takes its name from the over 700 bays on the Apulian peninsula. The region has a long tradition in the production of Rose wines made with Negroamaro, a variety that best expresses its full potential near the sea. 

On the nose both intense and delicate with fragrant notes of peaches, roses, and violets. It is a fresh and balanced wine, highly savoury and with much aromatic persistence.

title: Chateau Doisy Daene 2019
bodyHtml:
Chateau Doisy Daene, Second's Cru Classe in 1855, located in Barsac in the Sauternes appellation, has been in the Dubourdieu family since 1924. For over eighty years three generations of vine growers have exercised talents to produce great sweet white wines: Georges (1924-1948), Pierre (1949-1999) and Denis since 2000.

96 Points - Decanter

I love this, the flavours are utterly moreish and mouth-filling, with tons of creamy lemon tart, and flaky pastry against rich nectarine, tart citrus and lime flavours. Clearly, this is a concentrated and gourmet year, but this has a delicious balance quality. Drinking Window 2022 - 2045.

94+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Doisy Daene has seriously intense notes of pineapple upside-down cake, ripe apricots and lemon marmalade with hints of acacia honey, paraffin wax, orange blossoms and preserved ginger plus a waft of marzipan. The palate is rich, unctuous and boldly decadent, featuring layer upon layer of exotic fruits and spices, finishing with that signature freshness. A powerhouse!

94+ Points - James Suckling

Full-bodied with very spicy, dried-pear and honey character. Mango and toffee as well. It shows lots of intensity.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This has weight, focus and freshness, with a mix of well-defined orange, lemon, peach and nectarine notes. The bright finish is laced with heather and honeysuckle, featuring nice underlying acidity that helps set it apart from the pack.

92+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

One of the more exotic, perfumed, and complex Sauternes in the vintage, the 2019 Chateau Doisy Daëne just about jumps out of the glass with its rocking nose of caramelized peach, ripe pineapple, honeyed orange, and floral aromas and flavours.

title: Rodney Strong Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Rod Strong was instrumental in recognising Sonoma County's potential for world-class wines, and the winery was the 13th bonded in the newly established Sonoma County wine industry. Since 1989, the winery has flourished under the leadership of the Klein family, fourth-generation California farmers committed to crafting premium wines and leading the way in sustainable farming and winemaking.

Wine Description

On the nose, it offers aromas of lemon curd, apple, and baked pear, with hints of toasty oak and baking spices. The palate provides a complex and balanced profile, showcasing tropical and citrusy fruit character. It is well-balanced, leading to a long and lingering finish with silky notes of fresh pear and pineapple.

title: Cascahuin Tahona Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
The Cascahuin Distillery is one of the most traditional and high-quality operations in the lowlands of Tequila. The name translates to "mountain of light," a reference to the mountain outside the town where it's located, El Arenal, which seems to attract lighting in every storm. Built in 1904 by the Rosales Family, nothing has changed since then. They did replace their traditional tahona press with a roller mill in the 1980s but recently reintroduced a tahona to the process to create a truly traditional tequila. 

This is the first release made with this old process and creates an exceptional product. 100% lowland agave, roasted in traditional brick ovens. Pressed on their new electric tahona wheel and fermented with bagasse in traditional ceramic vessels. Long, slow-to-proof distillation on tiny copper pots is one of the purest, most traditional expressions of lowland tequila on the market. The gorgeous aromas of roast cucurbita, deep earthy spice and citrus waft from the glass. Texturally rich and highly complex on the palate, this should be considered the benchmark lowland tequila from which all others should be compared.

title: Chateau d'Yquem 2019 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
All the conditions are there to grow exceptional grapes and achieve the finest noble rot, the famous botrytis cinerea.

Through a sublimation process, the grapes reach a level a richness in taste and aromas that is simply unique in the world. Yquem preciously protects its selective harvesting secret, carried out by a team of devoted highly experienced local pickers, who have received their ancestral knowledge from the generations that came before them. Therefore, only the best grapes sublimated by botrytis cinerea are picked, because this is the golden rule at Yquem: never look for simplification, or shortcuts, and accept the risk of losing everything.

This is the price to pay to achieve excellence.

Yquem is a perfect balance between freshness and concentration. The proportion of Sauvignon Blanc brings a floral element and a distinctive note of lemon verbena. This vintage is extremely seductive in its vibrant youth and will travel gracefully through time.

98 Points - Vinous

It has a highly-aromatic bouquet that is beguiling in purity, enticing aromas of honeysuckle and saffron, soon joined by camomile, white flowers and orange blossom. It has wonderful delineation and gains intensity with aeration. The palate is supremely well-balanced with fine bead of acidity. Very harmonious and armed with just the right amount of viscosity, this Yquem is surprisingly understated at first but gains presence, offering irresistible flavours of layers of honey, lemongrass, lemon thyme and orange pith. Yquem is so tempting in its youth, but I feel that this vintage will repay those with the nous to cellar for at least a decade.

97 Points - Decanter

The 2019 vintage of Chateau d'Yquem has the highest proportion (45%) of Sauvignon Blanc in any modern Yquem. The Sauvignon Blanc adds to the freshness, acting as a great balance to the succulent, sweet and voluptuous palate. Intense peach and apricot, combined with lemon and orange zest, make this highly appealing to drink right away – an ideal vintage with which to start Yquem’s ‘lighthouse’ project. However, it would be a shame not to give this 10+ years maturation to see how it develops. Very well, I suspect. 

97 Points - Wine Spectator

A special wine right from the start, this glistens with pure papaya, mango, white peach and mirabelle plum, joined by elder flower honey, toasted macadamia nut and orange blossom notes. Ends with a remarkably long finish. Semillon and Sauvignon Blanc.

96 Points - James Suckling

A juicy Yquem with tarte tartin, salted caramel and dried oranges on the nose and palate. Medium-to full-bodied and medium-sweet with a creamy and round texture. Bright and vivid. Lovely texture. Long. Evolves to caramel and burnt vanilla sugar. 55% semillon and 45% sauvignon.

title: Sterling Vintners Sauvignon Blanc 2021
bodyHtml: The Sterling Vintner Sauvignon Blanc offers vivid aromas of passion fruit, fresh pink grapefruit, lemon citrus and subtle fresh-cut grass notes. The nose leads to a mouth-watering palate where juicy flavors of citrus and stone fruit ring true. The wine offers pleasing fruit weight and balanced acidity leading to a lengthy, flavorful finish. A perfect accompaniment to fresh seafood and salads or enjoyed on its own.

title: Cava de Oro Cristalino Anejo
bodyHtml:
Cava de Oro is a tequila of exceptional quality and flavor. Artfully distilled and bottled in el Arenal, Jalisco, Mexico, under the careful guidance of the partidas family, third generation master distillers.

Aged for 24 months in French white oak barrels, obtaining the complexity of an Aged Tequila, and later filtered in a process with activated carbon, which gives it the perfect touch between its silky texture, luminous and crystalline tones. Brilliant nuances and silver tones shine through the bottle. On the nose, a multitude of fruity aromas and toasted oak. On the palate, the Añejo brings smooth fruit notes with a bold and long finish.

title: Fratelli Alessandria 'Gramolere' Barolo 2018
bodyHtml:
Gramolere is a cru in the municipality of Monforte d'Alba, situated between Gavarini and Bussia. Its structure and character are considered synonymous with the Barolo of Monforte. Alongside these characteristics, the wine from this particular hillside expresses delicate scents of aromatic herbs that blend with classic and complex notes of leather and licorice.

95 Points - Wine & Spirits

The Alessandria family’s wine from Monforte is red-fruited and lively, its crunchy cherry and berry flavors gaining verve and brightness as the wine sits in the glass. The tannins are like cool iron, gripping the red fruit tones as they pick up notes of soft herbs and white licorice on the long finish.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

With fruit from Monforte d'Alba, the 2018 Barolo Gramolere is linear and tight with etched aromas of crisp forest berry, iron ore, blood orange, blue violet and crushed stone. The wine is bright and expressive with time in the glass, but it takes a while to open fully. The tannins are firm but integrated. It should be interesting to retaste this Barolo after the 10-year mark.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Underbrush and camphor aromas mingle with whiffs of pressed rose. On the linear, focused palate, polished tannins and fresh acidity accompany dried cherry and star anise before closing on a hint of mocha.

title: Don Julio 70th Anniversary Anejo Claro Tequila
bodyHtml: Don Julio 70 Anejo Claro Tequila is the culmination of 70 years of knowledge, expertise and innovation that brings the smoothness of a Blanco tequila and the complexity of an Anejo tequila together for a totally unique tequila experience. It is aged eighteen months in American white-oak barrels and then carefully filtered to bring out its crisp agave flavour. Crystal clear with smooth and light character, opening with citrus. Notes of vanilla, honey and toasted oak lead to a smooth lasting finish. Enjoy neat.

title: Cascahuin Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
The Rosales Family and David Suro (Siembra Azul, Tequilas Philadelphia) behind Cascahuin believe that innovation in Tequila comes from digging back into its artisanal roots, focusing on raw, traditional flavours, and pure ingredients, without the use of additives.  Their profile of expressions is a direct representation of the traditionally made agave spirit from the El Arenal region of Tequila, loved by aficionados and newcomers craving transparency and purity in their purchasing power. 

Cooked agave followed immediately with notes of oak, cloves and cinnamon spice, and ripe bananas, the alcohol becomes present in the finish for a slightly dry/bitter punch. Ia cooling, creamy mouthfeel with licorice bits follow. Lasting, bright and creamy.

title: Cascahuin Plata 48 Tequila
bodyHtml:
Cascahuín Plata 48 Tequila is a high-proof, unaged artisanal spirit originating from El Arenal in the Valles (Lowlands) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Distilled at the legendary Cascahuín Distillery (NOM 1123) under the leadership of Master Distiller Salvador Rosales Trejo and his family, the brand carries a rich history dating back to 1955. The expression pays tribute to the distillery's founder, Salvador Rosales Briseño, showcasing an undiluted, still-strength presentation that celebrates traditional agave production.

Spirit Description

Cascahuín Plata 48 is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave slow-cooked in traditional masonry brick ovens. The agaves are crushed using a combination of a roller mill and a traditional mechanical roller, then fermented in open-air masonry tanks where wild yeasts contribute natural complexity. Double-distilled in stainless steel pot stills with copper coils, the liquid is bottled undiluted (or minimally adjusted) directly at 48% ABV without chill filtration, preserving its full spectrum of natural essential oils.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, luminous, and brilliant with dense tear drops on the glass.

  • Aroma: Vibrant, rich, and deeply expressive. The nose opens with intense cooked agave, wet stone minerality, fresh mint, and citrus zest (lemon and dried lime peel), complemented by black pepper, cardamom, and subtle hints of honey and tropical fruit.

  • Palate: Bold, full-flavored, and beautifully balanced despite the elevated proof. Upfront flavors of sweet roasted agave, spearmint, and lime blend seamlessly into earthy minerality, white pepper spice, fresh herbs, and light vegetal tones.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a rich, creamy, and mouth-coating viscosity that delivers a velvety texture.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and tingling, tapering off with lingering notes of cracked black pepper, sweet agave, crushed herbs, and refreshing mineral earthiness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 48% (96 Proof).

title: Cascahuin Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: Loads of tropical fruit on the nose, pineapple, coconut, and banana.  Black pepper, oak, and citrus also play a role in the aromas of this Anejo. With 14 months in American oak, the taste has a good deal of barrel influence with flavours of vanilla, coconut, caramel, and holiday spice. Tequila lovers will still find a good deal of cooked agave flavour present. The finish is medium-length, with oak and citrus being the show's stars.

title: Canoubier Caribbean Rum
bodyHtml:
Canoubier Caribbean Rum is made with a selection of high-quality traditionally grown sugar cane. It is created with care using the purest traditional methods. The rum finishes aging in their old cognac barrels. Their Cellar Master’s experience in the aging process makes for a unique rum.

Ideal for creating long and short cocktails. Complex nose with notes of flowers, fruit, tropical fruit, banana, coconut, and vanilla. A mature palate with aromas of coffee, nutmeg, and cinnamon with a long, spicy, and oaky finish.

title: Brenne Estate Cask Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Founded by a former ballerina turned whisky entrepreneur, Allison Parc, Brenne was started with Allison's small life savings and a big dream to show terroir, a sense of place in the smell and taste is possible when making great single malt whisky. She created Brenne from seed to spirit, with a third-generation Cognac maker at this family farm distillery in the heart of Cognac, France. First released in New York City in 2012, the award-winning whisky embodies the elegant nature of its French terroir. It brings an entirely new style of French single-malt whisky to the rapidly emerging world whisky segment.

The first single malt in the world aged exclusively in French Limousin Oak and Cognac casks, Brenne Estate Cask, is twice-distilled in a copper alembic still and aged for a minimum of six years. The whisky has perfumed fruit and French patisserie aromas with creamy and complex sugar notes of rich creme brulee and burnt caramel. On the palate, notes of banana, tropical fruits, and warm spices such as cinnamon and clove.

title: Bodega Astobiza Gin
bodyHtml: The Spanish are mad for gin and vermouth and this one is produced by the winery of the same name in Spain's Basque region. It's won numerous "best gin" awards and is made from local wild botanicals, including grape must as a base for the distillate, done in a Coffey still, along with ingredients that include wild strawberries, basil, mint and ginger. It's a smooth, flavourful gin with subtle hints of each of the components. It's fine in a G&T and even better in a martini.

title: Brancaia Stella Brut (NV)
bodyHtml:
Stella is characterized by an elegant bouquet, with delicate aromas of bread and almond notes, typical of the classic method. This brut sparkling wine is delicate and vibrant on the palate, with a fine and persistent perlage. Before the disgorgement, the wine is aged on the lees for at least 24 months. Stella's sparkling wine base is made from 100% Chardonnay grapes. To characterize it with Brancaia style, the liqueur de expedition is enriched by a few drops of Il Bianco. This sparkling wine is named after Barbara Widmer's daughter, Nina, who, as a child, loved to call sparkling wine bubbles “stars.”

Stella is ideal as an aperitif wine, but it is also perfect with fish crudites or vegetarian dishes. A favourite pairing: with tuna tartare.

title: Dirty Laundry Riesling 2025
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
This wine is picked from three different vineyards that span the Okanagan Valley. Each block of fruit is picked and then fermented separately in stainless steel at cool temperatures to retain fresh aromatics. 

You will find aromas of green apple, jasmine, lemon and lime. The palate boasts of green apple, fresh lime, lemon custard and a hint of herbal on the back palate. This well-balanced Riesling has a lingering finish and an acidic backbone. 

This Riesling is a very versatile wine when pairing it with food. A Thai noodle salad, grilled or poached white fish, crab legs or pair it with your favourite spicy dish. You could serve this wine with dessert as well, try peach pie or apple crumble. When looking at cheese pairings try some marinated feta or crumbly blue cheese.

title: Dirty Laundry Merlot 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Dirty Laundry Merlot originates from Canada, within the Okanagan Valley region and the Summerland subregion of British Columbia. Originally established as Scherzinger Vineyards in 1978, the property was purchased in the early 2000s by a partnership led by Bob Campbell and Neil MacGillivray, who rebranded the winery to reflect local folklore. The name 'Dirty Laundry' pays homage to a 19th-century Chinese laundry in Summerland that famously fronted for a gambling den and brothel.
