The winery focuses on crafting approachable, award-winning wines while maintaining a playful and unpretentious philosophy centered on fun and accessibility.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep and brilliant garnet red colour in the glass. The sensory profile is rich and expressive, featuring a nose of black cherry, plum, and raspberry, often accompanied by complex notes of dried rosemary, dark chocolate, and tobacco. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it delivers vibrant flavours of black currant, mocha, and blackberry, balanced by a medium-high tannin structure and subtle hints of cedar and barrel spice. The finish is smooth and very dry, with lingering notes of chocolate, spice, and savoury leather.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Merlot.

  • ABV: Typically ranges from 13.5% to 14.7% depending on the vintage.

  • Organic Status: While the winery emphasizes sustainable practices and a non-interventionist winemaking approach, this specific wine is not typically certified organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: A classic example of British Columbia Merlot, often aged in a combination of French and American oak for up to 18 months to achieve a bold and structured profile.

Food Pairing

The bold dark fruit flavours and structured tannins of this Merlot make it an ideal companion for hearty meat dishes and savoury vegetarian fare. Suggested pairings include roast beef with all the fixings, rib-eye steak, braised lamb shanks, or game meats such as bison burgers and elk tenderloin. It also complements smoked meats, sharp cheddar, or Gorgonzola cheese. For vegetarian options, consider a mushroom risotto with grilled asparagus or salty-sweet sweet potato fries.

title: Hidden Bench Estate Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
Hidden Bench produces some of the most structured, age-worthy Pinot Noirs in Niagara.  This wine is just getting better and better!

Densely packed with structure, trannins and deep flavours.  Delicous now with aeration but built for years to come.

title: Old Forester Whiskey 375 ml - 3 Bottle Gift Pack
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Includes one 375 ml bottle of each of the following:


Old Forester 1897 Bourbon Bottled in Bond

This 100-proof expression is the second release in their Old Forester Whiskey Row Series and was specially crafted to honour the U.S. Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897. After the U.S. Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897 to be labelled as Bottled-in-Bond, the whisky must be the product of one distillation season, one distiller and from one distillery. The concept behind the Act, the idea of "sealed-in quality" was something that Old Forester, America's First Bottled Bourbon introduced in 1870.

Old Forester 1910 Old Fine Whisky

1910 Old Fine Whisky, Old Forester's fourth and final expression in the Whiskey Row Series, is a double-barreled Bourbon creating a smooth mingling of sweet oatmeal raisin cookie and milk chocolate, caramel corn, and evolving spice that leads into a refined, charred oak finish.

NOSE: Interlaced layers of buttercream, sticky toffee, cedar, and apricot.

TASTE: Smooth, well-rounded mingling of sweet oatmeal raisin cookie and milk chocolate leading into caramel corn and evolving spice.

FINISH: Charred oak leads with a clean peripheral spice.

Old Forester 1920 Prohibition-Style Bourbon

This 115-proof expression is the third release in their Old Forester Whiskey Row series and celebrates the brand's continued distillation during Prohibition. For 13 years, the production, transport and sale of alcohol were strictly prohibited, however, Old Forester was granted a permit to continue distilling on Louisville's Whiskey Row. The 115-proof expression represents a barrel sample that company president Owsley Brown would have batched at the beginning of Prohibition.

title: Antinori Le Mortelle 'Vivia' Maremma Bianco 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine is from Italy, specifically the Maremma region on the Tuscan coast. It is produced by Tenuta Le Mortelle, an estate owned by the esteemed Antinori family. The Antinori family has been involved in winemaking for over six centuries, since 1385. Le Mortelle is a commitment by the Antinori family to invest in Maremma's potential, focusing on organic farming and the area's suitability for international and native grape varieties. The estate is named after the wild myrtle (or mortella) bushes that grow in the area.

'Vivia' is the estate’s signature white wine, reflecting the freshness and elegance of the Tuscan coast. The estate's name, 'Vivia,' means 'lively' or 'vivid'.

Wine Description

'Vivia' is a blend of Viognier, Vermentino, and Ansonica. The wine exhibits a bright, straw-yellow colour with greenish reflections.

The aroma is intense and elegant, opening with notes of white fruit, such as pear and white peach, combined with subtle citrus and floral hints of jasmine and orange blossom. Due to the blend composition, you may also find tropical notes of pineapple and banana.

On the palate, it is crisp, refreshing, and full of flavour. The body is balanced and soft, showing a fine structure. Flavours include yellow stone fruit, minerality, and a touch of the characteristic salinity from the proximity to the sea. The Viognier component provides a rich texture, while the Vermentino offers freshness and a pleasant bitterness. The finish is long and persistent, marked by its freshness and a clean mineral closure. Grapes are harvested by hand, and the wine is fermented in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks, followed by a short period of maturation on the fine lees. The optimal drinking window is over the next 2–3 years. This wine offers complexity balanced by vibrant freshness.

title: Piper Heidsieck Rose Sauvage
bodyHtml:
A charming wine with delicate and enchanting accents. It gives an impression of youth and vigour but also tenderness and serenity. Based on a blend of about fifty crus; the same approach to blending as that of the Brut Cuvee, with the addition of a proportion of red Champagne wine, which gives this wine not only a style typical of Piper-Heidsieck but also a distinctive colour and fruity taste. The blend's harmony develops during a long maturing process lasting at least thirty months in the Piper-Heidsieck chalk cellars.

On the eye: An intense colour, a clear and deep pink.

On the nose: The first impression is fresh, suggesting the high spirit and vivacity typical of the Piper-Heidsieck style. It has a strong aroma of red fruit, dominated by the Morello cherry. A fragrant harmony of citrus fruit, mandarins and blood oranges follows this. The final impression leaves a hint of cinnamon.

On the palate: A lively, generous and intense wine. Its freshness is expressed by the slight tartness of red fruit, which then mellows with the aromas of macerated fruit and red plums. The final sensation is exuberant and warm.

It can be enjoyed as an aperitif and served at a cocktail party, garden reception, an all-night party lasting until dawn, an intimate tête-à-tête or a gathering of friends. It is also ideal for a sophisticated dinner party. In the kitchen, it can be used to prepare fish and chicken and desserts based on red fruit.

title: Chateau Siran Rouge 2019
bodyHtml:
Chateau Siran is located in Labarde, the southernmost commune in the Margaux appellation. Siran is undoubtedly one of the Medoc's great historic estates.

Siran is one of the rare estates in Bordeaux to have belonged to the same family for over 150 years (the chateau was acquired in 1859 by the family who presently owns it). Representing the fifth generation, Edouard Miailhe has been at the helm of this unique estate since 2007. Helped by a new, young winemaking team, he is determined to perpetuate and enhance the chateau's fine reputation.

94 Points - James Suckling

Lovely, soft tannins with a juicy and flavorful palate of currants, slightly toasted oak and chocolate. It’s full-bodied and layered with a plush texture and a long, flavorful finish. Warm and rather flamboyant for the vintage. 

93 Points - Decanter

Tight and concentrated fruits, this is knitted down right now, more muscled than many in the appellation and will need a good few years to soften. Clear dark spice, the Petit Verdot is pulling its weight and making its presence felt not just in the fruit quality but the sappy nature of the tannins.

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

One of the finest vintages I've tasted from this chateau, the 2019 Chateau Siran has a great bouquet of ripe black cherries, blackberries, scorched earth, leather, and cedary herbs. With medium to full-bodied richness, polished tannins, and outstanding overall balance, it's going to benefit from 2-4 years of bottle age and drink nicely over the following 10-15 years. It's an impressive Margaux. 

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Seductive, showing warmed plum and blackberry compote notes that are lush in feel, with pretty violet and anise hints and a flicker of black tea through the finish. This is hard to lay off now because of its generosity. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc.

91+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Exhibiting aromas of rich currant fruit and creamy new oak, the 2019 Siran is medium to full-bodied, rich and fleshy, with lively acids and ripe, powdery tannins that assert themselves on the youthfully chewy finish. This is a flavorful, nicely balanced wine that will reward a bit of bottle age.

title: Sipsmith Gin
bodyHtml:
The first copper distillery to launch in London for nearly 200 years, on a mission to bring the art of uncompromising, small-batch gin distillation back to the capital where it all began. The result is sublimely sippable (and award-winning) spirits that are incredibly smooth, full of character and has an authentic intensity of flavour.

The Brits tend to cling to convention, and when it comes to producing gin, they followed a ruling set in 1823 decreeing it impossible for anyone to get a distilling licence for anything less than 1,800 litres. In 2008, the Sipsmith lads petitioned successfully to allow smaller distillers to get in on the act. This is classic London dry gin. The juniper is upfront, followed by smooth citrus notes. Martini and G & T compatible.

title: Koval Rye Bottled in Bond
bodyHtml:
Aged for a minimum of four years in Koval's federally bonded warehouse, bottled at precisely 100 proof. Ideal for those who like plenty of spice, and a single, unmalted grain expression. Not shying away from a complex flavour profile, grain-forward spiciness nuanced by cinnamon and ginger gives a nice kick to the entire drinking experience. 

Amber colour. Aromas and flavours of brandied cherries encased in milk chocolate, cinnamon and sugar on toasted and buttered rye bread, currants, and black licorice. A silky, dry, full body and an appealing, medium-long finish with notes of marble rye with hot butter, mesquite, apple, sage, cherry and raspberry.

title: El Enemigo Semillon 2020
bodyHtml:
The 2020 El Enemigo Semillón is a white wine from Mendoza, Argentina. Sourced from old-vine Semillón, this wine showcases the region’s unique terroir and the innovative winemaking of El Enemigo.

Vineyard and Production

The grapes come from a 70-year-old vineyard in Agrelo, Luján de Cuyo, located at 930 meters above sea level. The high altitude and calcareous soils contribute to the wine’s freshness and minerality. The grapes are hand-harvested and fermented with indigenous yeasts to preserve purity. The wine ages for 15 months in oak barrels, with 20% undergoing aging under a veil of flor, a winemaking technique that enhances texture and imparts saline and nutty characteristics.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Golden yellow with bright reflections.
  • Aroma: Intense notes of grilled pineapple, dried apple, green olive, salted butter, and smoked almond, layered with hints of citrus and waxed lemon.
  • Palate: Medium-bodied with a rich, textured profile. The wine delivers a toasty, saline character, balanced by vibrant acidity and a long mineral-driven finish.

Critical Acclaim

  • James Suckling: 94 points – Recognized for its layered complexity, bright acidity, and smoky, toasty elements.
  • Wine Enthusiast: 92 points – Praised for its almond, acacia, and citrus aromas, with a fresh yet structured palate.

Serving and Pairing

Best served at 10-12°C (50-54°F), this Semillón pairs beautifully with rich seafood, grilled shellfish, and roasted poultry. Its creamy texture and vibrant acidity also complement truffle risotto, soft cheeses, and earthy mushroom-based dishes.

title: Clement Cuvee Homere Rhum Agricole Vieux Dage
bodyHtml:
Clement Cuvee Homere is distilled from sugarcane juice as is typical in Martinique and proudly wears the "AOC Martinique" designation signifying an exemplary degree of expertise in every production stage.
 
Colour: Mahogany.
Maturation: An expert blend of the best ex-Bourbon barrels from 7-15 years old, chosen by cellar master Robert Peronet.
Nose: Warm biscuits and almond butter evolve into baking spice.
Palate: Very soft and balanced. Overwhelming notes of woody vanilla and toasted coconut.
 
This Rhum Agricole earned 97 points from Wine Enthusiast, who named it one of the Top 50 Spirits of the Year.

title: Ron Santisima Trinidad De Cuba 15 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Santisima Trinidad De Cuba 15 years old is the result of a sophisticated ageing process with 3 stages. Firstly, the rum rests in barrels for 4 years, then the different barrels are blended. In the second phase, the rum is aged for a period varying from 3 to 25 years, then again these rums of varying ages are blended together before entering the third period. The rum then rests again to obtain the desired harmonization and profile.

The nose opens with a light rum, perfumed with prune brandy. The toasted barrel has impregnated the rum to the core, leaving its roasted, even charred mark. The lightness of the rum brings out a handful of tangy fruits. The aeration coats the nostrils with a pinch of icing sugar, for a marshmallow-like sweetness. The caramelized nuts roll in with gusto. The palate is very light, with some red fruit gummies simmering. The sweets contain a little spice that swarms the tongue. A small veil of vanilla closes this spice march. The finish is somewhere between dry and sweet, with an eye-catching toasted wood and a sweet feel to it all.

title: Clarendelle Bordeaux Rose 2023
bodyHtml:
The first official rose wine in the history of Domaine Clarence Dillon, Clarendelle Bordeaux Rose is produced by a short maceration of Merlots and Cabernets and is notable for its finesse, strength and delicious flavour. This gastronomic rose has a fruity, fragrant personality blended with harmony and elegance.

The nose is robust, with beautiful hints of tropical fruit led by lychee and pomegranate. This is a solid, well-balanced wine framed by a smooth tannic structure. The palate is accented with menthol and licorice notes, accompanied by peppery overtones from the Cabernet and tropical hints of grapefruit. Without losing that beautiful, tangy freshness, the wine is rich and indulgent, lingering long on the palate.

title: Bladnoch Samsara Single Malt Scotch
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Samsara, meaning ‘rebirth’, is a full-bodied and fragrant blend of malts matured in ex-Bourbon and ex-Californian red wine casks.

COLOUR...Copper gold.
NOSE... Vanilla cream, floral with fresh-cut apples.
PALATE... Thick vanilla fudge, sweet floral grass.
FINISH... Rich, mouth coating, leading to refreshing citrus.

title: Tolaini Al Passo Toscana 2022
bodyHtml:
Spicy notes of oak rise above distinct aromas of cherry and berry. The palate has a backbone of Sangiovese, a roundness of Merlot and enhanced body from the Cabernet Sauvignon. The fruit purity and varietal signatures are testament to the meticulous care given to the vines. Note: Some sediment may occur in the bottom of the bottle as the wine is not filtered.

Blend: 34% Sangiovese, 33% Merlot, 33% Cabernet Sauvignon

title: Koval Bourbon
bodyHtml: With a mash bill of 51% corn and 49% millet, Koval Bourbon offers a drinking experience that is balanced, approachable, and unparalleled. The unusual grain combination provides notes of mango chutney and vanilla on the palate, with a peppery caramel finish.

title: Penfolds Bin 138 Grenache - Shiraz 2020
bodyHtml:
This full bodied and aromatic red wine originates from Australia, specifically from the premier Barossa Valley region. Penfolds is one of Australia's most historic wineries, founded in 1844, and Bin 138 represents a style inspired by the wines of the Southern Rhône. The winery's philosophy for this label focuses on utilizing fruit from well established, old Barossa vines, some exceeding 100 years of age, to create a blend where each variety is matured separately in seasoned oak to allow its individual character to shine.

Wine Description

Penfolds Bin 138 Grenache Shiraz Mataro (GSM) presents a deep and vibrant appearance. The sensory profile is complex and perfumed, featuring an inviting nose of cherry danish, fresh plum, and white strawberry, layered with sophisticated notes of cardamom, cinnamon, and hibiscus. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and 'luscious', showcasing a generous heart of dark brambly fruits contrasted by the elegant tension of Grenache and the earthy, savory undertones of Mataro. It is characterized by well integrated, slatey tannins and a balanced acidity that provides freshness and a persistent finish. This classic blend typically reaches an ABV of 14.5%. While the winery maintains high viticultural standards, this wine is not certified organic.

title: Freixenet Chianti 2023
bodyHtml: This Chianti is a superb red wine made from Sangiovese grown in the namesake region, nestled in the sunny vineyards of Tuscany. Its delicate bouquet has tones of wild berries, complemented by lightly spiced notes and violet aromas, crowned with a delicate finish. This wine matches perfectly with pasta dishes, pizza or meat platters.

title: Skyfall Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
Skyfall Vineyard was named for massive car-sized boulders scattered among the vines, appearing to have fallen from the sky. These glacial rocks were left in the wake of the ancient Missoula floods that cut the Columbia River. Floods deposited silty loam soil mixed with volcanic ash for soil conditions that create complex, elegant wines.

Wine Description

Toasted hazelnuts and Asian pear on the nose. Rich and creamy on the palate with apple, toasted almond and lingering notes of Meyer lemon and creme brulee.

title: Tesselaarsdal Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
Pinot Noir isn't the first wine you think of when you think of South Africa. Chenin Blanc, Sauvignon Blanc, Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon are better known. But in the cool hills of Hemel-en-Aarde, near the coast southeast of Cape Town, a small collection of artisan wineries is making very good wine from Pinot and Chardonnay.

Tesselaarsdal was started in 2015 by Berene Sauls, a long-time employee at Hamilton Russell Vineyards, another prestigious winery in the area. Sauls works with Hamilton Russell winemaker Emul Ross to produce her wines. The descendant of freed slaves, she named her winery after the small farming hamlet where she grew up and the man it was named after. Johannes Tesselaar was a former soldier who farmed the village's land. When he died in 1810, he bequeathed his farmland to nine former servants and slaves, including her ancestors. She has found sudden success with her spectacular wines. This Pinot Noir contains spices like cloves and nutmeg, with flint, raspberry, cherry, earth, cranberry and tea. It has moderate tannins and stunningly beautiful fresh acidity that carries the flavours on the palate for minutes. It's so well done.

title: Knotty Vines Chardonnay 2020
bodyHtml:
Knotty Vines is made for the modern wine drinker, to be shared with friends, or even with your knotty side. It's time to stop denying your dark side and seduce it instead. Stimulate your wickedness, enjoy the electricity, and experience how good it feels to be knotty.

A freshly balanced and flavourful Chardonnay that flaunts vibrant peach, green apple, and tropical notes, followed by a lively acidity and a rich, creamy vanilla finish.

title: Freixenet Rose 2024
bodyHtml: Following the great success of its premier Prosecco, Freixenet continues to demonstrate its expertise in wine-making with the new Freixenet Italian Rose sparkling wine. Glittering with stunning beauty and blushing pink hues, Freixenet Italian Rose is a delicious blend of the best Italian harvest of Glera and Pinot Noir grapes. Enjoy notes of fresh red berries and underlying hints of white flowers and apples. Pairs well with light salads, pasta and seafood.

title: Writers' Tears Mini Book 50 ml - 3 x 50 ml Bottles
bodyHtml:
A book full of Writers’ Tears! Writers often have to put blood, sweat and tears into the art they produce, and this is a testament to that. 

This book contains extracts from possibly the most perfect collection of short stories of all time, James Joyce’s Dubliners. Dubliners offers a real taste of Irish life, look closely at the lives of different characters in a short, concentrated form and the whiskey set reflects.

The whiskey itself is of a classic Irish pot still style, with a wonderful rich cereal sweetness and grassy malt flavour. James Joyce himself is a known whiskey fan, so we think he would have approved! 

A great gift for both the book lovers and whiskey fans in your life!

This Whiskey gift includes 3 x 5cl Miniatures of Writers' Tears: Cask Strength 2020, Copper Pot, and Double Oak.

title: Penfolds Bin 51 Riesling 2023
bodyHtml:
This elegant and refined white wine originates from Australia, specifically from the premier Eden Valley region in South Australia. Created in the 1990s as part of Penfolds' white wine development program, Bin 51 is designed to capture the distinct attributes of its high-altitude, cool-climate locale. Penfolds itself was founded in 1844 and has a storied history in South Australia, with Bin 51 now recognized as a definitive world-class Riesling that highlights the finesse and long-term cellaring potential typical of the Eden Valley.

Wine Description

Penfolds Bin 51 Riesling presents a brilliant appearance with a pale straw hue. The sensory profile is highly perfumed and expressive, featuring an aromatic nose of white citrus blossom, jasmine, and lime zest, layered with sophisticated notes of blackcurrant leaf, finger limes, and scented bath salts. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied yet powerful, showcasing a 'fresh and flavorful' texture with primary notes of lemon zest and just-squeezed lime juice. It is characterized by its chalky minerality, mouth-watering natural acidity, and a slightly salty, persistent finish. This 100% Riesling typically reaches an ABV of approximately 11.5%. While the winery adheres to high-quality technical standards, this bottling is produced via conventional methods and is not certified organic.

title: Domaine de Chevalier Rouge 2020
bodyHtml:
Deep dark red color in appearance, with a shiny black shimmer in the center. Great nose. Intense, flowerly expression mainly on the fruit. Black cherry, blackcurrant, blueberry. Delicately peppery and vanilla spices. Aromas of tannins and earth. On the palate, an impressive sensation of density of tannins, without any astringency. The flesh of the wine is fine, firm and freshly fruity. The fruit, precise and intense, is everywhere. Power, balance, maturity, concentration, length, freshness, tension. Everything is there for a great vintage to keep.

97 Points - James Suckling

Lots of blackcurrant, black cherry, lead pencil, ink, bark and black truffle on the nose. Full-bodied and very fine textured with silky tannins that are so layered and gorgeous. Fantastic length and depth. Clarity and transparency.

95+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Offering impressive cassis and darker berry fruits, it has complex notes of crushed flowers, violets, and damp earth-like nuances. Medium to full-bodied on the palate, with ultra-fine tannins and a silky, layered, seamless texture, it shines for both its richness and its balance.

95+ Points - Wine Enthusiast

This impressively rich wine is centered on great swathes of black fruits. The tannins, with their stylish swagger, are a fine complement to the fruit, giving the wine structure and the potential for elegant aging.

95+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Unwinding in the glass with aromas of minty blackberries and cassis mingled with notions of burning embers, spices, rose petals and orange rind, it's medium to full-bodied, fleshy and concentrated, with a deep core of fruit, powdery structuring tannins and a long, saline finish. 

95 Points - Decanter

Concentrated ruby red colour, a little subdued on the nose, built with structure and power, concentrated and should age well. Classical, powerful, not exuberant, an impressive Chevalier that has tannins and fruit and freshness, nothing shouting too loud. As it opens, you see a peony floral edge that is very attractive. Easily among the best in Pessac.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Well-built, pulling ample and weighty waves of cassis, plum reduction and blackberry preserves along, atop a broad spine of warm loam, smoldering tobacco and singed alder. Long and deep through the fine-grained finish, with a warm paving stone note that won't quit, thanks to well-buried acidity—not an easy feat in this vintage.

title: Chateau La Gaffeliere 2019
bodyHtml:
96 Points - James Suckling

 A vibrant, fragrant red with aromas of blackberries, currants, walnuts and mint chocolate. Medium-bodied with fine-grained tannins. Pretty walnut notes on the polished finish. Fantastic length. Driven acidity and focus. 

96 Points - Vinous

The 2019 La Gaffeliere has a wonderful bouquet of mineral-rich black and red fruit and sous-bois, a little tobacco and pencil box emerging with time. The palate is medium-bodied with supple tannins, fleshy and ripe. Perfectly balanced, leading to an almost Left Bank, graphite-tinged finish courtesy of the 40% Cabernet Franc, the 2019 continues the purple patch of this Saint-Emilion stalwart. No doubt a wine that will give 30 to 40 years of drinking pleasure. 

95 Points - Decanter

A rich and round nose, bursting with ripe fruit aromas. Plump and voluptuous on the palate all while having excellent acidity that really lifts it up, so you have depth but also this real aerial aspect. Tannins are smooth and really well framed and this is super fresh. Delicate yet deep, round yet layered with chalky minerality. Elegant and engaging.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 La Gaffeliere wafts from the glass with a rich bouquet of blackberries and cherries mingled with subtle hints of burning embers and loamy soil that's framed by a deft application of creamy new oak. Medium to full-bodied, deep and seamless, it's a concentrated, vibrant wine built around bright acids and fine, powdery tannins. Its vivid fruit tones and classical balance make this Cabernet Franc-rich blend a promising candidate for sustained bottle age. Anyone who has tasted the great wines this estate produced in the 1950s and 1960s knows how great this site can be; and with stricter selection as well as the elimination of fruit from vines growing on the plain from the blend, that potential appears to be being unleashed at last.

93+ Points Jeb Dunnuck

94 Points -  Wine Enthusiast

94 Points - Wine Spectator

title: Chateau La Fleur Petrus 2019
bodyHtml:
98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2019 Chateau La Fleur-Petrus is a stunning example of what makes a great Pomerol – richness without weight, incredible elegance, complexity, and length, all of which it has in abundance. Giving up darker, powerful aromatics of blackcurrants, darker cherries, tobacco, chocolate, and just hints of spring flowers, it hits the palate with full-bodied richness, a layered, concentrated, incredibly sexy mouthfeel, perfect tannins, and a great finish. It's one of the most opulent, seamless, impressive wines in the vintage, although it needs at least 7-8 years of bottle age. It should be a 30- to 40-year wine. Bravo!

96+ Points - James Suckling

This is a genuine, old-school Pomerol with blueberries, wet earth and black tea leaf. It’s full-bodied, yet balanced and beautiful. Traditional and so attractive with a modern tone.

95+ Points - Wine Enthusiast

Dark, dense and full of tannins, this is a powerful wine. The concentration in this wine gives it a dry, structured character, but the richness of the blackberry fruits and streak of acidity are likely to kick in attractively as it ages.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 La Fleur-Petrus dares to outshine Trotanoy this year, wafting from the glass with aromas of rich berry fruit, plum preserve, dark chocolate, cigar box and spices. Full-bodied, rich and enveloping, it's broad and layered, with beautifully polished tannins, a ripe core of fruit and a seamless, enveloping profile. This is an elegantly muscular, generous Pomerol whose sumptuous personality reflects the warm, dry vintage. 

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Seriously dark and winey, showing a deep core of black currant preserve, warmed fig paste and plum reduction flavors inlaid with racy graphite, mouthwatering tobacco and enticing singed alder, bay leaf and freshly plowed humus. Delivers density, grip and definition on the long finish. Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot.

title: Le Ragose Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2016
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Italy, within the Veneto region and the historic Amarone della Valpolicella Classico DOCG zone. Founded in 1969 by Arnaldo and Marta Galli, Le Ragose sits high in the hills of Negrar at elevations between 250 and 400 meters. The estate is celebrated as a traditionalist benchmark in the Valpolicella Classico area. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes classic high-elevation viticulture, traditional appassimento drying of native varietals in natural drying rooms, long fermentations with indigenous yeasts, and extended maturation in large Slavonian oak casks to craft wines of remarkable balance, elegance, and longevity rather than excessive sweetness or weight.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep, dark garnet color with ruby reflections. On the nose, it offers a complex, expressive bouquet of dried black cherries, baked plums, and wild blackberries, intertwined with notes of dark chocolate, sweet pipe tobacco, dried herbs, leather, and subtle balsamic undertones. On the palate, it exhibits a full body with a harmonious and concentrated texture, framed by firm, velvety tannins and an exceptionally vibrant natural acidity that brings balance to its richness. The finish is dry, savory, and remarkably persistent with lingering accents of dark fruit, bitter cocoa, and warming spices. The varietal composition is a traditional Valpolicella blend of 50% Corvina, 20% Corvinone, 20% Rondinella, and 10% other authorized native grape varieties. It has an alcohol content of 16% ABV and is not certified organic.

Vintage Quality

The 2016 vintage across the Veneto and Valpolicella is widely acclaimed as a benchmark, five-star year. A warm, sunny growing season was tempered by cool autumn evenings, allowing grapes to achieve optimal physiological ripeness and phenolic development while maintaining high natural acidity. These pristine harvest conditions allowed for a healthy, slow appassimento process, enabling the winemaker to produce an Amarone of exceptional structural depth, freshness, and profound cellaring potential.

title: Cinco Sentidos Espadin Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Eleuterio Perez Ramos, also known as "Tio Tello," produced this batch at his modest palenque in El Nanche, Oaxaca. Tio Tello harvests exclusively mature agave and maintains a tradition of hand mashing that is essentially lost in the region of Miahuatlan. 

This particular batch employs Espadin Capon, a process in which the stalk of the agave, is cut after it has sprouted. The plant is left in the field for an extended time to allow sugars within it to concentrate. The tropical and herbal flavours found in this bottling are captivating and harmonious.

Cinco Sentidos ("five senses") started as the house mezcal line at Oaxaca's acclaimed restaurant and mezcaleria El Destilado. These uncertified agave spirits highlight diverse, traditional production methods employed by small-batch producers who distill a variety of agave species. The range embodies the customs, traditions, and history behind the spirits and the people who make them.

Nose: wet clay, red apple skin, tropical.

Palate: dehydrated fruit, dried thyme.

Finish: roasted squash, black tea.

title: Cinco Sentidos Papalote Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Tomas Gutierrez Sales is a new addition to the lineup of extraordinary mezcaleros Cinco Sentidos sources from. Tomas produced this batch in the region of Tepehuixco, Guerrero, with the help of his son, Emiliano. Together, they harvested mature Papalote, scientifically known as agave cupreata in this particular region. While the production methods are seemingly conventional, the aromas and flavour attributes unfold beautifully after each sip.

Cinco Sentidos ("five senses") started as the house mezcal line at Oaxaca's acclaimed restaurant and mezcaleria El Destilado. These uncertified agave spirits highlight diverse, traditional production methods employed by small-batch producers who distill a variety of agave species. The range embodies the customs, traditions, and history behind the spirits and the people who make them.

Nose: cilantro, milk chocolate, coconut shrub

Palate: egg custard, arugula, cake frosting

Finish: spearmint, grassy

title: Penfolds Bin 98 California Quantum 2018
bodyHtml:
Penfolds Quantum Bin 98 is the continuation of a twenty-year endeavour from when Australian vine cuttings were planted in California soil. A Wine of the World encapsulating a bold blending alliance, Quantum reveals a wine that shows wisdom, crafted with conviction but also embedded in the "quality-first" philosophy that underpins Penfolds' flagships. The wine is the most powerful expression of their blending style and leads the charge in Penfolds' ambition to seek out parcels of intense flavour, structural tannins and equal parts grace and complexity. Northern and southern hemispheres bring prized Cabernet Sauvignon from Napa Valley and pedigreed Shiraz from South Australia, respectively, into each other's realm. Not adhering to expectations and de rigueur.

Rich malt, bone marrow, and a complex spectrum of dark berries make up the aromatic core. These slowly fuse with notes of blackberry, blueberry, and boysenberry complemented by sugared pastry, cinnamon apple, and piquant punches of mild horseradish cream and Dijon mustard. A blue-berried wash and glistening film cover the palate with a dense, supple texture and succulent acidity. Flavours of graphite and hazelnut provide an exotic intrigue, with a whisper of sweetness that grows over time with air.

AVA Blend: 87% Oakville Diamond Mountain District, 13% South Australia. Variety Blend: 87% Cabernet Sauvignon, 13% Shiraz.

98 Points - James Suckling

What sticks with you about this global blend of Napa and Southern Australian wine is the intense and transparent purple and blue fruit. Lots of blackberry and blueberry aromas with some stones and flowers, such as violets. It's a very layered and intense wine with refined, creamy and chewy tannins. Full and very impressive. Very Penfolds. Mouth-filling texture. It's made mainly from Napa grapes and predominantly from Oakville and Diamond Mountain. About one-fifth is from South Australia. It was aged 80% new American oak and 20% new French. Try after 2026.

98 Points - Wilfred Wong of Wine

The 2018 Penfolds Bin 98 Quantum Cabernet Sauvignon is truly a "wine of the world." This wine epitomizes what a wine of the future can be—a production of a Cabernet Sauvignon that belongs to wine lovers. Made from 87% Oakville and Diamond Mountain District AVAs and 13% South Australia, this wine is light years ahead of where we are today. This wine gushes forward with aromas and flavours of black fruit, chalk, and oak. The parts are all there for long-term cellaring. 

97+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The first release of this new iconoclastic label, the 2018 Quantum Bin 98, is labelled a "Wine of the World," although the AVA is the United States. Technically 87% is American wine (Cabernet Sauvignon from Napa Valley), while 13% is Australian ("Grade A1" Shiraz from South Australia). The wine spent 16 months in oak, 100% new, 80% American oak and 20% French. The wine is much like Grange in that it completes fermentation in new, mainly American oak barrels.

97 Points - Decanter

A Wine of the World is a big statement, and this blend of 87% Napa Valley Cabernet with South Australian Shiraz creates a purposeful bridge between two national styles. The Cabernet is typically Napa (from the Oakville and Diamond Mountain District AVAs): stern and solid, flexing powerful muscle as earth and iodine notes speak much louder than fruit sweetness. The addition of Shiraz (an elite component considered for Grange inclusion) isn't apparent. Yet, its influence is profound, with a hint of ripe plum adding a vivid burst of colour to the dark flavour spectrum. The two varieties strike a happy equilibrium on the mid-palate, wrapping generous layers of rich fruit and supple texture into a seamless weave.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The inaugural release of this red combines 87% Cabernet Sauvignon with 13% Shiraz, using grapes from Napa Valley and South Australia. Dark and brooding, it delivers a smooth, textured palate of bright red fruit and supple, integrated tannins with meaty undertones along a continuum of black pepper, graphite and leather.

title: Jaja Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: This remarkable Reposado won Double Gold at the 2019 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. Anticipate notes of vanilla, oak, cooked agave, honey and caramel. It's full-bodied and fruity with a lingering finish. Pair this fine tequila with pulled pork poutine, chocolate souffle or on its own before a meal.

title: James Gin Asian Parsnip
bodyHtml:
Motoring star James May (aka Captain Slow), once presenter of the BBC television show, Top Gear, and now co-host of Amazon Prime’s The Grand Tour with Richard Hammond and Jeremy Clarkson, has now turned his hand to distilling craft gin with the brand James Gin. 

“My gin really is Asian Parsnip. This is not mere marketing guff. Take a sip and you will genuinely experience notes of nutty, sweet parsnip, redolent of the damp soil of the English countryside, and that sparkle of spices that will have thrilled anyone who has travelled in India or South-East Asia, or had a takeaway."

It was inspired by both his love of Britain and his love of travelling. As the gin’s name suggests, it mixes spices usually found in Asian cuisine and most British vegetables, the parsnip, along with the quintessential gin ingredient: juniper, of course.

It has authentic parsnip notes that are nutty and sweet, with unique earthy tones. They are complemented by spice flavours from India and Southeast Asia and that rich juniper base that is so important to all gins. It is really unique and utterly delicious!

title: Bodegas Olivares Dulce 2017 - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The notes of tomato vine and black olives are always a giveaway for their sweet Monastrell, a sweet wine that has the tannin and structure of the dry red wines from the region balanced by some 230 grams of acidity and fortified to 16% alcohol. The tannins and alcohol make the wine come through as balanced and not as sweet as you might imagine given the amount of sugar it has. This is bottled unoaked and matured exclusively in bottle. It's the Mediterranean alternative to a young Ruby Port.

title: Lind & Lime Gin
bodyHtml:
Lind & Lime is a Scottish gin produced in the London Dry style by The Lind & Lime Distillery in Leith, Edinburgh. It has a classic taste: crisp, refreshing and utterly delicious. The concept behind the gin was to create a spirit that tells stories about the remarkable distilling, the industrial and scientific heritage of their home, which for centuries was Scotland’s gateway to the world.

Distilled with 100% green electricity.
Produced with 100% organic ingredients.
Packaged with 100% plastic-free materials.

title: Chateau Ferran Bordeaux Superieur Rouge 2021
bodyHtml:
Julien Ferran strives to craft expressive wines while sustaining plant and animal life in his vineyard through biodynamic farming.

Fresh dark fruits and spicy notes on the nose also come through on the palate of this Bordeaux Superieur, which will be the ideal companion for everyday meals.

title: Northern Keep Vodka
bodyHtml:
A proud tribute to the great expanses of Canada. Their vodka celebrates their northern home, a land of abundance that enables them to craft the finest spirit from ingredients grown in their backyard, sourced from local Canadian farms and crafted by artisans of Alberta Distillers, an award-winning distillery recently named Distillery of the Decade at the Canadian Whisky Awards 2020.

Each year, they gather the best Canadian grains our prairie lands offer. It's this bounty that shapes the great spirits they are known for. They mix 70% rye and 30% winter wheat, resulting in a distinctly Canadian taste. Northern Keep is well-rounded with hints of citrus and light spiciness from the finest rye, subtle sweetness from winter wheat and distilled five times for exceptional smoothness and a clean finish.

title: Chateau Trigant 2019
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This elegant red wine hails from France, specifically the Pessac Leognan subregion within the broader Graves area of Bordeaux. The estate was founded in 1783 by Philippe Trigant, an illustrious lawyer at the Bordeaux parliament, who built both the château and the original vineyards. Since 1860, the property has been under the stewardship of the Sèze family, who have managed the estate for eight generations. This boutique estate spans approximately 3.5 hectares of deep gravel and sandy soil, where the family follows a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes technical modernization while remaining faithful to the classic spirit of the appellation.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2019 Chateau Trigant displays a brilliant dark red colour. The nose is flattering and aromatic, offering a complex bouquet of red berries, cassis, and blueberry, layered with classic notes of tobacco, leather, and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and concentrated, showcasing a 'summer fruit' mix of blackberry and dark cherry.

The varietal composition for the 2019 vintage is 60% Cabernet Sauvignon and 40% Merlot. Stylistically, it is characterized by its finesse and velvety tannins, with a notable freshness and tension that balances its incredible richness. The finish is persistent, often revealing distinct empyreumatic notes of coffee and toasted cashew.

title: Ritual Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: An elegant wine with a greenish-yellow colour, with expressive aromas of quince, apple and hazelnut notes intermingled with subtle hints of oak and vanilla. Smooth, elegant and creamy texture with a long finish.

title: Mi Campo Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: This tequila begins as 100% Blue Weber Agave, matured for seven years. They gently squeeze the cooked piñas, illuminating the agave plant's natural honey characteristic and quelling any trace of bitterness. Reposado is double distilled, then fermented in open-air tanks, amid fragrant citrus trees, resting for three months in the same French oak barrels used for aging Napa Valley Pinot Noir and Cabernet Sauvignon, imparting an incredibly smooth taste. The fragrant nose opens with cooked agave, ripe banana, apple, chocolate and cappuccino, layered over aromas of vanilla, cinnamon, pumpkin and clove. On the palate, honey maple, peaches and cream, white chocolate and a thread of minerality segues to a dash of pepper and toasted oak finish.

title: Church & State Quintessential 2017
bodyHtml: This blend of 50% Merlot and 50% Cabernet Franc was hand selected by their winemaker from their premium barrels. Aged 14 months in French Oak, this Meritage blend has an open and expressive nose showcasing black cherries and blackberries. The aromas continue to open up with spicy notes of peppercorn and cedar. The mouthfeel is balanced with velvet ripe tannins. The palate opens on much of the same as the nose, dark berries, dark chocolate, fresh peppercorn and a long sultry finish. The wine will pair with a NY strip steak, oven-baked buttered potatoes and French-style green beans.

title: Brown Estate Chaos Theory Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
A favourite small production Zinfandel producer, Brown Estate, makes a fantastic red blend called Chaos Theory, a delicious mix of 50% Merlot, 25% Petite Sirah, and 25% Zinfandel that will delight all red wine fans.

The Brown Estate Chaos Theory Red has a dense crimson colour that leads to a fragrant nose of exotic Asian apple blossoms, crushed rose petals, and cloves. This wine delivers a mouthful of soft, silky texture that gives way to ripe, forward fruit balanced with layers of complexity. Cascading flavours of blackberries, black cherries, cappuccino, and tobacco lead to herbaceous earthiness with big game and fresh sage and rosemary undertones. This dark, deep, brooding, seductive wine glides over your palate toward a long, elegant finish. The perfect wine to pair with boldly seasoned grilled meats and garlicky potatoes with coarse ground mustard, or a comforting beef pot pie.

title: Montes Folly Syrah 2021
bodyHtml:
With the first Montes Alpha wine released in 1988, Montes became one of the first premium wineries in Chile. Their premise, a clear belief that Chile had an untapped potential as a producer of quality wines, made them a benchmark for other wineries to follow. Its original four partners' total involvement and the continuous help of the angels that decorate their labels were crucial to their success. 

Montes is Chile's fifth most important winery, where Aurelio Montes continues leading the winemaking area with the same passion as the first day. Hard work and total focus on quality have made Montes one of Chile's most successful and respected quality-driven wineries as they continue pioneering and breaking new ground in wine.

title: Santa Rita Sauvignon Blanc Secret Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
For more than 135 years, Santa Rita has worked ceaselessly to craft fine wines, earning it a vast experience that shines through in the quality of its products.

This wine has a brilliant yellow colour with green hues. Its intense aroma is a fragrant blend of citrus and passion fruit with a slightly herbal backdrop typical of this variety. On the palate, it is concentrated, with a pleasant acidity that highlights its freshness, firm structure and excellent persistence. Ideal as an aperitif or with marinated raw fish, shrimp cocktail, chicken and caviar.

title: Santa Rita Cabernet Sauvignon Secret Reserve 2022
bodyHtml: Excellent Cabernet Sauvignon from the Maipo Valley, a region known as one of the best for growing this variety. Aromas and flavours of ripe, black fruit and vanilla with notes of herb, cedar and cloves follow a ruby red colour. The palate is full-bodied and smooth with a fine structure. Match to a good burger or lamb.

title: Stroppiana Barolo Leonardo 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Cantina Stroppiana Barolo Leonardo originates from Italy, within the prestigious Piedmont region and the renowned Barolo DOCG zone. Managed by Dario and Stefania Stroppiana, the family estate named this specific Barolo after their son, Leonardo, harvesting from vineyard plots planted between 1996 and 2000 that are roughly the same age as him. The winery's operational philosophy emphasizes an approachable expression of the appellation. By carefully sourcing Nebbiolo fruit from dedicated family parcels in the villages of Verduno and Rivalta di La Morra, they successfully balance traditional local depth with refined, modern clarity.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a classic ruby red appearance with characteristic garnet highlights in the glass. It possesses a medium-to-full-bodied structure defined by an elegant, harmonious, and velvety texture. The sensory profile is highly intense, classic, and complex, opening with an expressive nose of forest floor, raspberries, and wild cherries, beautifully intertwined with notes of dried flowers, rose petals, anise, tobacco, and subtle cedary spice. On the dry, warm, and structured palate, it delivers deep, juicy flavors of leathery cherry fruit, red berries, licorice, and mineral undertones. These elements are supported by a firm, chewy, and fine-grained tannic backbone balanced by a bright, refreshing natural acidity. The finish is enveloping, remarkably long, and persistent, culminating in a clean, savory, and very pleasant aftertaste.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Nebbiolo.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its approachable complexity, bringing together excellent composure with an accommodating fruit structure. Following a mid-October harvest, the must undergoes controlled temperature fermentation for 10 to 15 days. It is then transferred to a combination of tonneaux and large French oak barrels to age for 24 months, followed by an additional 12 months of maturation in the bottle prior to commercial release.

  • ABV: Typically between 14% and 15% depending on the vintage.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '39' Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 1.8 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Produced by Asahi Shuzo, the Dassai 39 (also known as Sanwari Kyubun) is often described as the "skillful balance" of the Dassai lineup. It sits precisely between the approachable Dassai 45 and the ultra-premium Dassai 23. The "39" indicates that the Yamada Nishiki rice—the "king of sake rice"—has been polished down to exactly 39% of its original size, a level of refinement that removes impurities to create a more elegant and aromatic profile than lower-tier sakes.

Description

This sake is clear and light-bodied with a soft, velvety texture that some connoisseurs compare to a "nama" (unpasteurized) style due to its liveliness. The nose is incredibly fragrant, bursting with a "fruit basket" of aromas including honeydew melon, fresh pineapple, ripe pear, and green apple, with delicate floral hints of white flowers. On the palate, it is luscious and juicy with a nectar-like sweetness and a wine-like acidity that is slightly higher than its sister brews. It finishes clean and crisp with a refreshing dryness and a subtle lingering of honey. ABV 16%.

Food Pairing

Dassai 39 is designed for "tasting" and pairs excellently with clean, elegant flavors. It is a classic companion for sushi, sashimi, and poached white fish, but its higher acidity also allows it to stand up to richer dishes. It pairs surprisingly well with French and Italian cuisine, such as uni pasta, creamy dips, or mussels in a garlic broth. For a unique contrast, try it alongside spicy tapas or chorizo-stuffed dishes, as the fruitiness helps cool the palate. It is best served well-chilled (around 10–12°C) in a small wine glass to fully capture its complex floral bouquet.

title: Cotarella Merlot Lazio Sodale 2021
bodyHtml: With a red colour and purple reflections, Cotarella Sodale Merlot has inviting aromas of forest berries, sweet spice and vanilla bean. This red wine is round and harmonious on the palate with sweet tannins and a non-imposing finish. This Italian red wine was fermented in stainless steel and aged for 9 months in new and neutral French oak barrels. Pairs well with pork roast or cheesy gratin potatoes.

title: St. Innocent Pinot Noir Freedom Hill Vineyard 2021
bodyHtml:
Mark Vlossak fell in love with sparkling wine in the early 1980s, which led to wine classes and study. He saw Oregon as a bright spot to grow Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, the backbone grapes of Champagne. He founded St. Innocent Winery in 1988 when there were just 40 wineries in the state. Now there are more than 900. While he makes some sparkling wine, the primary focus at the small family winery is single-vineyard still wines, mainly from Pinot Noir. The goal of Vlossak is to capture the character of each of the individual vineyards.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir presents a dark ruby colour and opens with a complex, spice driven nose featuring aromas of dark cherry, plum, blackberries, and wet stones, accented by hints of balsamic and cocoa. On the palate, the wine is broad and robust, offering an explosion of dark raspberry and dried cherry flavours balanced by a stream of tantalizing acidity and velvety, ripe tannins. The body is medium to full, concluding with a long finish marked by spicy tension and red floral perfume notes.

title: Pio Cesare Fides Barbera D'Alba 2021
bodyHtml:
Pio Cesare has been producing wine for more than 100 years and through generations. The tradition began in 1881, when Pio Cesare started gathering grapes in his vineyards and purchasing those of some selected and reliable farmers in the hills of Barolo and Barbaresco districts.

At Pio Cesare, there has always been a conviction that great wine can come only from the finest grapes and the winery's output has always been limited through adherence to the highest standards. Pio Cesare limits its production by using only the most mature and healthy grapes. The ripening of the grapes is carefully monitored and the harvest is rigidly controlled with each grape selected by hand.

The Barbera grapes grown in the Barolo region produce a finished wine with a full structure and plummy, spicy, complex flavours. Pio Cesare’s Barbera plots are found in south or south-east facing vineyards rooted in limestone, clay, and sandstone. The sun and warmth captured at these sites produces fruit with well-developed skin tannins, colour, and flavour compounds. You’ll find blackberries in the aroma and a hint of toasted tobacco. This is a Barbera with the potential for a long life.

title: Santa Margherita Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore (NV)
bodyHtml:
Santa Margherita grows luscious, aromatic, Glera grapes in the gentle hills of Valdobbiadene. This town is synonymous with the finest Prosecco Superiore and DOCG status just north of Venice, the highest and most distinctive classification possible.

This bubbly favourite creates a celebration whenever it is enjoyed and is the ideal accompaniment to a lively dinner. Its aroma, freshness, and vibrancy make it a treasure that you will want to share again and again. Prosecco Superiore makes any gathering a memorable occasion.

This sparkling wine has fine, lively bubbles that dance within its bright straw-yellow colour and greenish reflections. Its lovely aromas include ripe pineapples, peaches, Rennet apples, and delicate florals. Its finish is bright and dry yet sweet on the palate. 

Perfect as an aperitif, it pairs well with seafood or cheese appetizers. It also adds flavorful sparkle to brunch classics or your favourite rich dessert. Even rich, creamy dishes such as pasta carbonara, fried favourites like calamari, or even grilled filet of beef will not overwhelm its vivaciousness.

title: Gruet Sauvage Blanc de Blancs (NV)
bodyHtml:
Gruet Sauvage Blanc de Blancs is a bone-dry sparkling chardonnay, pale straw in color with a delicate but persistent mousse. The aromas of bright mineral and citrus notes tickle the nose followed by touches of green apple, lemon, and grapefruit. The finish is structured, flavorful, and long. 

The bright acidity makes this wine a perfect pairing for oysters, sushi, and cream sauces.

90 Points - Decanter

Notes of ripe fruit, brioche and lees. Complex on the palate with mineral, mushroom and a hint of buttercream complementing the creamy mousse.

title: Gustave Lorentz Pinot Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Gustave Lorentz, a family-owned winery established in 1836, is situated in the heart of Alsace, France. With a rich history spanning over six generations, the estate is renowned for its commitment to producing high-quality wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region. Their dedication to sustainable viticulture and traditional winemaking techniques has solidified their reputation among wine enthusiasts worldwide.

Wine Description
The 2021 Gustave Lorentz Pinot Blanc presents a brilliant pale yellow color with green tints. On the nose, it exudes beautiful fruit aromas of white flowers and minerality. The palate offers a lively and frank attack, with notes of citrus and pink grapefruit, leading to a dry and mineral finish. This wine is approachable now and will continue to develop complexity over the next 3 to 5 years.

Food Pairing
This versatile Pinot Blanc pairs wonderfully with appetizers, mixed salads, quiches, sautéed pasta and rice with vegetables, fried legumes, fish and shellfish, as well as white meats. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

Accolades

  • 92 Points – Wine Enthusiast

title: Chateau Roques de Jean Lice 2018
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
This cuvee comes from a selected plot of vineyard of Chateau Roques de Jean Lice. Its location is on the limestone plateau of the Entre deux Mers region.

Thanks to their viticultural experience on this type of “terroir”, special care in vinification and maturation processes, and a greatly motivated winegrower, this Bordeaux Superieur wine is full, charming and well balanced.

This wine has a bright ruby color. The nose is lively and develops aromas of red fruits. In the mouth, the wine is expressive, full of fruits with hints of spices, and well structured with its ripe tannins. The finish combines fruit intensity and freshness.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai 45 Sparkling Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 360 ml
bodyHtml:
Asahi Shuzo Dassai 45 Sparkling Junmai Daiginjo is a premium sparkling sake originating from the Yamaguchi prefecture in Japan. It is produced by Asahi Shuzo Co. Ltd., a brewery founded in 1770 that has gained international acclaim for its innovative, 'Junmai Daiginjo-only' production model. The brewery is renowned for combining traditional handcrafted methods with modern technology to create its world-famous Dassai series.

Description

This sake is a 'nigori' style, meaning it is lightly filtered and naturally fermented in the bottle to create a lively, elegant 'fizz'. It presents a milky white, opaque appearance with a thick and creamy mouthfeel. The aroma is fragrant and fruity, featuring notes of white grape, cereal with milk, and toasted chestnut. On the palate, it offers refined flavours of almond milk, pear, and underripe melon, balanced by a full-bodied umami and a long, dry finish. It has an alcohol by volume of 13.5% and is best enjoyed well-chilled.

Food Pairing

The creamy texture and vibrant carbonation of Dassai 45 Sparkling make it a versatile partner for a variety of dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with rich or fried appetizers such as prawn tempura, baked brie, and deviled eggs. Its refreshing acidity also complements seafood pasta, steamed mussels, and poached white fish. For a sweet conclusion, it is a delightful match for strawberry cheesecake or fresh fruit tarts.

title: Submission Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
Now is the time to surrender, and experience, Submission wines. Submission Wine works with a family of growers throughout California, selecting fruit from the finest growing regions, so that every bottle of Submission highlights the amazing and diverse terroir that California has to offer.

Submission Pinot Noir is bright ruby red in colour, highlighting notes of raspberries, cranberries, and bing cherries with nuances of lavender and red roses. The palate is full and firm, with soft tannins and vibrant red fruit, leading to a soft, elegant, and perfumed finish.

title: Fabio Oberto Barolo 'F' 2016
bodyHtml:
Andrea Oberto grew up working on his family’s farm in the small town of La Morra just South of Verduno but spent the early part of his adulthood as a truck driver outside of the family business. When his father passed unexpectedly, he returned home to manage the farm and devoted his life to tending to the 3 ha of vineyards he inherited from his father. In 1978, Andrea shifted the estate’s focus from supplying fruit to the local co-operatives to making its own wines. After 22 years working with his father at the family winery, Fabio Oberto, Andrea's son, has started a business of his own: Fabio Oberto 'La Collina di Dioniso' gives continuity to the family's vision of making wine true to the great terroir of the area, shared by farmers with same ideals, ambitions and values.

The 2016 Barolo is fleshy, succulent and super-expressive, all of which make it an excellent choice for drinking now and over the next decade or so. Sweet red cherry, kirsch, cinnamon, mint and rose petals all flesh out in the glass, while soft, silky tannins give this forward Barolo plenty of near and medium-term appeal. This is such a delicious wine.

93 Points - James Suckling

Intense nose of fresh and dried red berries, together with dried leaves and dark, clove-like spice. Medium-bodied with firm tannins and a concentrated bead of bright fruit and minerals. The tannins pull hard on the finish for now, so wait for this one. It’s structured and layered and definitely built to last. Hold until 2024.

title: Gianni Brunelli Brunello Di Montalcino 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Gianni Brunelli, a man of many interests, established Sienas Osteria Le Logge (now one of the top restaurants of the city) in 1977. In 1987, he returned to Montalcino and purchased Le Chiuse di Sotto, an estate that had belonged to his father Dino, with 2 hectares of vineyards standing at 250 meters above sea level in the northern part of the region. Brunelli replanted most of the vines in 1989, but left untouched a small plot of older holdings dating back to his fathers original 1947 plantings. After Gianni passed away in 2008, his wife Laura, who was already working at the estate, took the reins, along with her brother, Adriano.

title: Kahlua - 1.14 Litre
bodyHtml:
Born in Veracruz, Mexico in 1936, Kahlua comes steeped in history, with a rich and colorful heritage.

Made with 100% Arabica coffee beans and rum, Kahlua coffee liquor is one of the main ingredients in many of the world’s favorite cocktails.

One of the best benefits of this liqueur is its versatility. Coffee liqueur is great as a drink straight up, mixed in popular cocktails or as a dessert aperitif. With its defining flavor and zing, no home bar is complete without it.

title: Tamnavulin 1979 Scotch Whisky
bodyHtml:
The Tamnavulin distillery is a producer of single malt Scotch whisky that was founded in 1966.

This is a 1979 Tamnavulin single malt, matured in a combination of first-fill sherry butts and bourbon barrels for 39 years, before being bottles for the distillery's Vintage Collection. 

Aromas of Mediterranean oranges, figs, almonds and freshly-baked ginger cake fill the nose. The palate offers tropical notes of pineapple, roasted coffee and Black Forest fruits. A brilliant scotch with just the right amount of smoke, very smooth overall with a great finish.

title: Sena Red Blend 2020 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
A deep and beautiful garnet-red color with violet hues, Sena presents complexity on the nose with multiple layers of fresh red-fruit aromas such as cherries and raspberries accompanied by violets and pleasing touches of dill and rosemary, all framed by light notes of sweet spices. The palate shows young fruits, more sweet spices, and smooth balsamic tones. It is fresh and juicy with elegant fine-grained tannins that create to a silky and pleasing sensation. The 2020 vintage of Seña shows elegance and balance with an ample and profound finish.

98 Points - James Suckling

Complex, with savory, spicy character, showing tobacco, salted plums, olives, black cherries, cassis and a hint of white pepper on the nose, followed by a refined, savory, balsamic accent. A full-bodied Sena with juicy fruit chiseling into the tight, extremely fine-grained tannins. Long, bright and still elegant from this warm vintage. 

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Sena is a blend of 53% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Malbec, 15% Carmenere and 7% Petit Verdot (a little higher in search of acidity) from grapes harvested early, the second week of March, and fermented mostly in stainless steel and 10% in concrete eggs. It has a moderate 13.5% alcohol and good freshness. It's subtle and layered, not only fruit but with more spice; it has polished tannins and very integrated oak after 22 months in barrique, 78% new, and with 10% of the volume in large Stockinger barrels. 

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Violets, ripe cherry and red-plum aromas are delicate. Light notes of cinnamon and dried herbs fill up the bouquet. This is one of Chile's iconic wines from a warm vintage in Aconcagua Valley that delivers good concentration of fruit on the ripe palate. Blackberry and cherry flavors are followed by light notes of oak spice. It has lively linear acidity and big tannins. It's good to drink now and promise a good future.

95 Points - Decanter

Beautiful fruit expression, clear and well defined, lovely texture, concentrated but smooth and round. This is full of sweet, juicy ripe fruits with a chalky, creamy texture underpinned by lifted acidity. It's bold and clearly powerful with a depth of ripe blackcurrants, black cherries, plums and raspberries alongside notes of freshly-cut flowers, herbs and sweet spices; rosemary, violets and cinnamon. Tannins are fine and well integrated and this feels well worked with finesse.

title: Domaine Jean Charles Fagot Chardonnay Bourgogne 'Les Loueres' 2020
bodyHtml: Bourgogne Chardonnay 'Les Loueres' from Domaine Jean-Charles Fagot is a white wine from the Burgundy region. This white wine is a powerful wine with a lovely freshness on the palate. This wine goes well with oily fish, seafood or mild cheese.

title: Domaine de l'Enclos Chablis 'Vau de Vay' Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml: Romain and Damien Bouchard began this Domaine a few years ago, but they already have access to some of Chablis' best sites, which they farm organically. Using only indigenous yeasts and minimal SO2, the brothers produce classy, terroir-expressive wines that offer very good value. One of Chablis’ coolest premier cru plots, ‘Vau de Vey’ sits on a very steep slope and faces east. Green apple, crushed oyster shells, tons of energy.

title: Domaine de l'Enclos Chablis 'Mont de Milieu' Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml: With its notes of acacia honey, nougat and white pepper, Mont de Milieu reveals a very original aromatic profile. Served by very skilful breeding, it offers an admirable scale which preserves its sap and its freshness.

title: Le C des Carmes 2020
bodyHtml:
Blended from Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, Pessac-Leognan wines are beautifully balanced with fine-grained structured tannins, and exhibit classic notes of tobacco, cassis, dark cherry, leather and tar, as well as a distinctive minerality.

With a nose so fresh, so floral, so seductive, you can almost smell the salinity, Les C des Carmes has a very fluid mouth, rolled up quite well with hints of ink. It is an opulent wine that needs a little time to open up. It ends with accents of blue fruits, sap and blackcurrant leaves.

title: Herradura Cristalino Ultra Anejo Tequila
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
The crisp taste of Herradura Ultra starts with one of our finest anejos filtered to remove color and enhance smoothness. Prior to filtering, a subtle hint of pure agave nectar is added giving Ultra subtle notes of cooked agave, caramel, and honey with toasted almonds and a finish that is beyond smooth. ULTRA is the perfect balance of our aged expressions.

Enjoy shaken hard with ice, strained neat in a shot glass to celebrate.

title: Egon Muller Wiltinger Braune Kupp Riesling 'Spatlese' 2021
bodyHtml:
The elegant Wiltinger Braune Kupp Riesling Spatlese from Germany is a single-vineyard wine, vinified from the Riesling grape variety. The Wiltinger Braune Kupp Riesling Spatlese is an Old World wine through and through, as this German wine breathes an extraordinary European charm that clearly underscores the success of Old World wines.

In the glass, the Wiltinger Braune Kupp Riesling Spatlese from the pen of Egon Müller shows a brilliantly shimmering light yellow color. After the first swirl, this white wine is characterized by an immense lightness that makes it dance lively in the glass. The bouquet of this white wine from the Moselle captivates with hints of grapefruit, nectarine, lemon, and grapefruit. If we trace the aromatics further, bitter chocolate, lovage, and cinnamon are added.

The finale of this white wine from the Moselle wine-growing region, more precisely from Wiltingen, finally impresses with a beautiful finish.

title: Punta Skala Crljenak 2016
bodyHtml:
Crljenak is the oldest recorded name for the variety, was a relatively obscure and almost forgotten Croatian grape until it was revealed that Crljenak was closely related to Plavac mali, the flagship Croatian grape and that it enjoys immense international popularity under its better-known synonyms, Primitivo in Italy and as Zinfandel in the United States. Crljenak hails from Dalmatia, where it was once a very common grape, but it almost disappeared from the region after phylloxera. The grape was probably transported to Italy in the 18th century, and then it was brought to the States, where it was introduced as Zinfandel.

The discovery of its parentage was made in 2001. Before that, it was mainly considered that Zinfandel is a signature American grape + native to the region. Despite the same genes, the grape creates different flavour profiles. Croatian Crljenak is a full-bodied wine, usually with an intense dark red colour. It is high in alcohol and tannins, with well-balanced acidity and notes reminiscent of red and dark berries such as blackberries and blueberries, along with some licorice and spice notes. These wines would pair well with red meat, and game and they could also work with tuna.

title: Domaine Michel Mallard et Fils Chorey Les Beaune 'Les Beaumonts' 2017
bodyHtml:
This Cuvee is produced at Les Beaumonts, which faces southeast overlooking the village of Chorey Les-Beaune. This parcel is situated on a gentle slope that leads toward the villages of Savigny-Les Beaune and Aloxe-Corton. The name of this locality is composed of two words, BEAU and MONT, evoking the fertility and richness of this earth.

On the nose, this Chorey-Les-Beaune is renowned for its gourmet aromas of Morello cherries, raspberry, blackberry and licorice. In the mouth, it can be defined by its flexibility and its roundness. It tells a tale full of crisp freshness!

title: Domaine Laroche Chablis Saint Martin 2024
bodyHtml:
The history of Laroche dates to 1850, when Jean Victor Laroche purchased his first parcel of land in Chablis. Since then, Domaine Laroche has led movements to raise the quality of the appellation with the creation of a charter of excellence for the Grand Cru producers. One of the most respected and largest landholders of premier and grand cru vineyards, the winery owns 90 hectares situated among the best crus.

Clear lemon color with a fruity, fragrant nose carrying hints of ripe white fruit and flowers. It has an intense freshness typical of the area. On the palate, its minerality gives a lingering finish and wonderfully distinct character.

Perfect as an aperitif or to pair with seafood, prawns or fish.

title: Argento Artesano Malbec White 2023
bodyHtml: This organic White Malbec is made 100% with Malbec Grapes sourced from their organic vineyard located in Alto Agrelo, Mendoza. Dry, acidic, ripe citrus notes, apricot notes, a hint of currant, light flowery notes. Artesano (Artisan in English), is an homage to the traditional silver and leather handcrafting of Argentina.

title: Averill Creek Joue Red Blend 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
An estate field blend that is bursting with freshness upon harvest.  

Juicy is the most apt descriptor. Cherries, red forest berries, vanilla, purple flowers, cedar and white pepper aromas develop into a bouncy and quaffable palate with high-toned red and purple fruit and a spiced finish. A charming red that deserves a slight chill before serving--you won't regret it!

title: Egon Muller Riesling 'Scharzhof' 2025
bodyHtml:
Egon Muller's vineyards are exposed to a northerly climate. Consequently, much depends on the vintage and on late harvesting. Regarding the winemaking process, however, Egon Muller's family's philosophy is based on the belief that the best wines are the ones that "make themselves". The Egon Muller-Scharzhof family lives in its own vineyards and oversees the day-to-day operation at the estate.

Vinified in stainless steel, the Riesling Scharzhof is clear, ripe and quite intense on the nose that displays a delicate flinty bouquet.

On the palate, this is an intensely fruity and quite rich Riesling that tastes nearly dry.

title: Egon Muller Wiltinger Braune Kupp Riesling 'Kabinett' 2021
bodyHtml:
Wiltinger Braune Kupp Riesling Kabinett is clear and very elegant on the nose where ripe and dense stone fruit aromas and fine flint notes are displayed.

Lush, mouthfilling and round on the palate, this is a crystalline, fine and elegant Kupp Kabinett that reveals a stimulatingly salty and a finely grippy finish.

title: Antoniolo Erbaluce di Caluso 2022
bodyHtml:
This iconic winery was established in 1940 by Mr. Mario Antoniolo. Mario strongly believed in the potential of the territory and, already at that time, built a small winery with a complete supply chain. Later, Mario was supported by his daughter Rosanna, one of the first female sommeliers in Italy and a master taster. Currently, his grandson Alberto is the winemaker. Even in the generational changes, the family business philosophy has remained unchanged: respect for the vineyard and its production without interfering in any way with the wine obtained. 

Grown in the hills of Alto-Piemonte, Erbaluce is a rare white grape variety that produces crisp wines with notes of melon fruits and wildflowers.

title: Mi Familia Flores Anejo Cristalino
bodyHtml:
Aged in American oak barrels for 18 months, acquiring woody and caramel notes and aromas. Aromatic herbs and cooked agave are perceived in their flavour. It gets its colour thanks to its double filtration.

Visuals: Crystalline with intense silver sparkles.

Aromatic: Strong aroma of cooked agave and honey.

Gustatory: Sweet tones with final notes of agave and honey.

title: Las Hermanas Crianza 2018
bodyHtml:
Intense aromas of red, and black fruit. Balsamic. Mediterranean herbs. Delicate and elegant on the palate. Spicy flavours. Cinnamon. Vanilla.

Pair with: Veal ragout. Roast lamb. Roast stuffed turkey. Fish. Tuna steaks. Goat cheese. Aged cheeses.

title: Domaine Henri Rebourseau Gevrey Chambertin 'Aux Corvees' 2019
bodyHtml: The emotion of Les Corvées reveals itself in the beauty of desire and the anticipation of the absolute. Stretching south beyond Gevrey-Chambertin, Les Corvées is situated in an area that is relatively flat with rich soils. This gives a taste of the finesse of the premiers crus which border its southern extremity. A deep garnet appearance with mauve highlights, producing a dark veneer in the glass. Purple tones with ruby glints, reminiscent of glorious years.

title: Frontonio Psicodelico 2022
bodyHtml: Bodegas Frontonio is the personal project of young gun Fernando Mora MW, hailing from the Valdejalón appellation of Aragón. These scintillating wines are some of the very best being made today east of Rioja and west of Conca. An authentic field blend with the taste of Aragon. Garnacha, Cribatinaja, Provechón, Garnacha Blanca, Cojón de Gato, Miguel de Arco and other castes come together to create this fresh and fluid wine with a light rustic touch.

title: Frontonio Garnacha Telescopico 2020
Frontonio Garnacha Microcosmico 2021
bodyHtml: A clean, high-toned nose of blood orange and pomegranate promise a fresh and invigorating Garnacha experience. The palate cleanses with juicy, saliva-inducing early-season strawberry fruit flavors and a peppery, lip-smacking finish.

title: Taylor Fladgate 50 Year Old Tawny Port 'Golden Age'
bodyHtml:
After half a century in cask, this exceptional wine has reached its "Golden Age" of maturity, the point at which it achieves perfect balance, a magical complexity and a seductive smoothness and density.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Mature, with dark chocolate nuances, this is rich, deep and sensationally delicious. The concentration is exceptional too. Then, there's the long, long finish, filled with fruit and sugar. It is irresistible, in addition to being nuanced and complex. It's young enough so that it is never just a curiosity. The fruit is certainly not cracking.

title: Chateau Livran 2016
bodyHtml:
Château Livran, located in Saint Germain d’Esteuil within the Médoc, has roots dating back to 1280. Once owned by the Goth family, whose legacy includes Bertrand de Goth—later Pope Clement V—the estate carries a rich heritage. In 2013, it was revitalized under the stewardship of Olivier Michon and Edwige Lurton-Michon, combining historical depth with modern winemaking vision.

Wine Description
This 2016 vintage presents a deep ruby hue with a vibrant, reflective clarity. The bouquet is complex, revealing blackcurrant, black cherry, fig, and subtle spice. On the palate, it shows impressive concentration with flavours of raspberry, mulberry, cassis, and crunchy black fruits. Well-integrated tannins support a structured body, leading into a long, fresh finish with nuances of mint, clove, and tobacco. The wine is balanced, expressive, and built for cellaring.

Accolades
Wine Enthusiast – 91 points
Decanter – 94 points
Falstaff – 92 points

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled lamb, roasted duck, beef stew, or venison. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

Vintage Quality
The 2016 vintage in Médoc is considered exceptional, marked by ideal weather conditions and even ripening. Wines from this year show clarity, precision, and excellent aging potential, with Château Livran standing out for its quality-to-value ratio.

title: Averill Creek Pinot Gris 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Canada is an infant in the global context of wine, and young regions cannot be blamed for mimicking their older brothers in their infancy, but at some point some intuitive winemaker has to throw out the recipe book and try responding to the fruit as it is, as it has emerged from that specific place on Earth. Only this way can that region begin creating wines that can only have come from where they were grown because they were vinified responsively, intuiting their direction.

This is why this Pinot Gris excites us. It speaks uniquely to this variety in this odd and wonderful little pocket of Vancouver Island. It shows that rare virtue of having a textured acidity, so admirable and so hard to find, not unlike an excellent Loire Chenin or cool-climate Chard. It’s a deeply cerebral wine with razor fine layers of complexity that slowly peel themselves away.
