It adds something delicious to the growing conversation of truly terroir driven Canadian wines, a must-try for anyone invested in the cause!

Brimming with energy, texture and intensity. Lees ageing builds mid-palate density and salinity that counterbalances the fresh fruit and tactile acidity. The freshness and tightness is carried across the palate with a persistent, generous finish.

title: Le Grappin Beaujolais Fleurie Poncie 2022
bodyHtml:
A micro-negociant with sustainable production at the heart of their vision, Le Grappin, headed up by Aussie husband and wife team, Andrew and Emma, makes wonderful wines from Burgundy, Beaujolais, and the Rhone Valley. Located in Beaune, Burgundy, they source from prime, responsibly farmed vineyards throughout the heart of France. 

Rich in colour with a pleasingly restrained nose and some red fruits intermingled with a rockiness. Soft, summer red fruits carry through to palate.

title: Mi Familia Anejo Supremo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Mi Familia Tequila is made of sunrises!

Sunrises of everyone who seeks to preserve the tradition in tequila production, seeking to make it as artisanal as possible. Everything starts from the moment they plant their agaves, taking care of them until the moment when their harvest arrives, taking care of them from inclement weather and all the obstacles they may face during their growth.

This spirit ages in American oak barrels, encouraging sweetness to develop from the agave. This aging period gives tequila an intense gold hue and toasted oak and caramel aromas. The palate is herbaceous and full of cooked agave flavour, with an ultra-smooth mouthfeel.

title: Cazottes Marcotte Rouge 2022
bodyHtml: This cuvée is made from a blend of Duras, Braucol, and Syrah. The former is a dark-coloured, peppery variety indigenous grown almost exclusively in the Tarn. Braucol, also known as Fer, is a traditionally tannic grape variety domesticated from a wild source in the region over three centuries ago.

title: Romero Dark Rum
bodyHtml: Distilled in a hybrid copper pot still and matured in once-used bourbon casks from Woodford Reserve in Kentucky. Spiced with vanilla, cardamom, nutmeg, clove, Sri Lankan cinnamon, and cracked pepper and back sweetened with a combination of fancy and blackstrap molasses. The spices and molasses combine to create a unique flavour that you have to taste to understand.

title: Eve & Michel Rey Pouilly Fuisse La Marechaude 2020
bodyHtml:
Aromas of citrus fruits, golden pear, vanilla, and a touch of honey. Delicious flavours of ripe peach, lemon zest, pastry dough, a touch of flint, and fresh herbs. Balanced yet lively acidity. Outstanding! Organic farming practices.

Pairing Suggestions: Shellfish, sushi and roasted chicken.

title: Mi Familia Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: Mi Familia Flores Anejo Tequila is a delicious tequila packaged in a beautifully unique bottle. This spirit spends 20 months aging in American oak barrels, encouraging sweetness to develop from the agave. This aging period gives the spirit an intense gold hue and aromas of toasted oak and caramel. The palate is herbaceous and full of cooked agave flavour, with notes of vanilla and chocolate on the finish.

title: Domaine Michel Mallard et Fils Savigny les Beaune 'Les Serpentieres' Premier Cru 2022
bodyHtml:
This Premier Cru from the esteemed ‘Les Serpentieres’ vineyard in Savigny les Beaune is a superb expression of Pinot Noir. In the glass, it reveals a bright ruby hue with subtle garnet reflections. Aromas of red cherries, wild strawberries, and violets lead the bouquet, accented by hints of earthy undergrowth and delicate spice. The palate is medium-bodied, offering an elegant structure with fine-grained tannins and vibrant acidity. Layers of raspberry, cranberry, and a touch of savoury minerality evolve into a lingering, silky finish. The wine showcases beautiful balance and purity, making it approachable now but promising further complexity with a few years of cellaring. Optimal drinking is suggested between 2024 and 2032.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points.

  • Vinous - 91 points.

Food Pairing

Pair this refined Burgundy with roast duck breast, herb-crusted lamb chops, or wild mushroom risotto. A perfect match to enhance the wine’s complexity.

title: Noble Vines 446 Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: 446 Chardonnay exhibits appealing aromas of ripe pear, pineapple and melon. Medium-bodied with a creamy mid-palate, this delightful wine offers flavours of peach and coconut, with hints of lemon and toasty vanilla spice. Enjoy this wine with friends, on its own or with soft cheeses, seafood, salads, pasta in wine or cheese sauce, or roast fowl.

title: Love You Bunches - So Fresh Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Precise and popping with bright energy, 2021 Love you Bunches Rose immediately wins you over in everything you want out of a scrumptious rose. Strawberry married with cool, firm peach. 

Breezy lemon-lime and lifting mint combine effortlessly through the light and playful palate. Smooth, with just a hint of refreshing tang as the curtain closes leaving you wanting more.

title: Love You Bunches - Carbonic Sangiovese 2023
bodyHtml: The “Love You Bunches” Carbonic Sangiovese from Stolpman Vineyards is a great example of the fun-loving, laid-back culture that permeates even the most serious Santa Barbara County wine projects. Meant to be drunk chilled, the nose here is juicy and grapey with a wonderful, perfumed funk hanging in the background. Flavors of raspberries, black cherries and slate. Simple in a delightful way, and at home with practically anything that could be on your dinner (or lunch) table.

title: Meurgey Croses Saint Veran 2021
bodyHtml:
It has been said that in partnership, the result is harmony. Through a lifetime of building relationships in the vineyards of Burgundy, Pierre Meurgey has proven this a steadfast rule. A native Burgundian, fourth-generation wine trader, and former director of operations of a well-known négociant in Beaune, Pierre enjoys friendships with the top vintners and vineyard managers in Burgundy to source the finest grapes for his two labels Pierre Meurgey and Meurgey-Croses, the latter, a tribute to his mother Marie-Thérèse Croses. Pierre is omnipresent in the vineyards from pruning to bud- break to harvest, offering his expertise in organic and biodynamic agriculture while working tirelessly with vineyard managers to oversee the plots destined to become his signature Cote d'Or and Mâconnais wines.

Wide, super-silky, super-mineral but with a sweetness that avoids austerity. This is simply excellent!

title: Claire Naudin Aligote 'Le Clou 34' 2022
bodyHtml: Aligote is the red-headed stepchild of Burgundian grapes. It lives in the shadow of the other Burgundy golden children Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. For years Aligote vines have been ripped out of the earth to be replaced by these more profitable grapes. But this wine, this Aligote, tastes like the static in silence. It shows pure potential, capable of subtle soft energy. Tastes like baked golden apples, bruised yellow pears and lavender skies. Creamy and elastic on the palate leaving no crease uncovered. Lingering. A magnificent wine!

title: 360 Huckleberry Vodka
bodyHtml:
Rare and delicious. The huckleberry is a kissing cousin of the blueberry but has a distinctly tart taste. 360 Huckleberry Flavoured Vodka gives cocktails a fresh twist with the subtly sweet tang of freshly gathered huckleberries.

Try a simple but stunning 360 Huckleberry flavoured Vodka and soda. Or stir it into a refreshing lemonade to add a satisfying splash of flavour.

title: Valdicava Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 'Madonna del Piano' 2016 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
Dry Creek Fume Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, this wine hails from the Sonoma County region of California. Dry Creek Vineyard was founded in 1972 by David S. Stare, who became the first person to plant Sauvignon Blanc in the Dry Creek Valley against the advice of local experts. Today, his daughter Kim Stare Wallace and her husband Don continue this legacy, maintaining a winemaking philosophy that emphasizes sustainable farming and minimal intervention to allow the healthy soil and vines to express themselves naturally.

Wine Description

Fumé Blanc displays a luminous yellow colour and a crystal clear appearance. The aromatic profile is intense and bright, leaping from the glass with citrus notes of lemon, lime, and pink grapefruit alongside tropical nuances of mango, tangerine, and honeysuckle. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and zippy, offering a complex blend of passion fruit, peach, and cucumber supported by a soft underlying minerality.

title: Grant's 12 Year Old Triple Wood
bodyHtml: Many whiskies take their flavour from just one cask, but they mature Grant’s Triple Wood 12 in three different types of wood: Sherry cask provides sweet spice robustness, American Oak lends subtle vanilla smoothness and Bourbon refill offers brown sugar sweetness, resulting in a rich, complex, vanilla taste.

title: Chateau Quinault L'Enclos 2020
bodyHtml:
95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2020 Chateau Quinault L'Enclos, which saw two thirds of the blend brought up in foudre, is another beautiful, seamless wine from this estate that offers both richness and elegance. Black cherries, smoked tobacco, chocolate, and a touch of scorched earth all flow to a medium to full-bodied, concentrated, finesse-driven Saint-Emilion that already offers pleasure. It will evolve for two decades.

94 Points - James Suckling

This is hyper fine and polished with currants, light chocolate and hazelnut aromas and flavors. Medium body. Fresh and very long. Extremely pretty and fine.

92 Points - Decanter

You find some traces of the solar nature of the summer on the nose, with eucalyptus, black pepper and rosemary spice, but there is freshness on the palate, well balanced and with density to the blackberry and black cherry fruits, finishing up with again the eucalyptus that is found in the aromatics, and a generous kick of spice. 

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This vineyard in the heart of the city of Libourne is now showing great quality. Ripe black fruits dominate the tannins, giving a wine of great freshness. It is succulent, with generous fruitiness while keeping an good structure.

title: Chateau Capbern 2021
bodyHtml:
Château Capbern is a distinguished winery located in the Saint-Estèphe appellation of Bordeaux, France. Established in 1894 by Georges Gasqueton, the estate remained under the stewardship of the Gasqueton family until 2012. In that year, it was acquired by Suravenir Insurance, marking a new era of investment and revitalization. The château is renowned for producing wines that embody the robust character and elegance typical of Saint-Estèphe.

Wine Description

The 2021 vintage of Château Capbern presents a medium crimson hue with subtle purple and ochre nuances at the rim. On the nose, it offers enticing aromas of raspberry, redcurrant, and plum, complemented by savory notes and hints of orange zest. The palate is juicy and elegant, showcasing fresh acidity and well-integrated tannins. Flavors of pure redcurrant pastille and red licorice are interwoven with fine graphite and savory oak nuances, leading to a chewy and prolonged finish. The wine underwent 18 months of aging in 40% new French oak barriques and has an alcohol content of 12.8%.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 93 points

  • Decanter – 91 points

title: Chateau Dompierre 2019
bodyHtml:
Chateau Dompierre is made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the grapes are carefully sorted. Harvest is done manually. Fermented and aged for 20 months in oak vats from Nadalie.

The smell itself is intoxicating - fruits, cherries, spices - it overwhelms your senses. And the taste matches the smell. Neither bold nor light - perfect balance to go with cheese and pasta. Savor it while it lasts!

title: Il Palazzo Chianti 2022
bodyHtml:
This red wine is made of Sangiovese and other grapes that are hallmarks of the Tuscan tradition. Intense deep ruby red colour. Interesting, strikingly fragrant and healthy fruit aromas of black fruits cherries and raspberries, violas, pansies and balsamic highlights. Velvety sweet tannin on the palate with a fruity aftertaste in the finish, making this a very lingering and extremely enjoyable wine. The Chianti is aged in steel.

This traditional Tuscan wine pairs beautifully with regional staples such as ragu pasta and a slice of toasted bread with olive oil.

title: J Boutin Crozes Hermitage 'Les Hauts Granite' 2023
bodyHtml:
Located in the northern Rhône Valley, J Boutin is a boutique producer founded by geologist-turned-winemaker Emmanuel Darnaud. His passion for terroir is reflected in his small-lot wines that emphasise purity, precision, and a clear sense of place. The 'Les Hauts Granite' bottling comes from vineyards rooted in granite soils, reflecting the mineral intensity of the region’s hillside parcels.  

Wine Description

This 100% Syrah displays a deep ruby colour with vibrant violet reflections. On the nose, it offers a striking mix of blackberries, black pepper, crushed stones, and a subtle floral lift. The palate is medium-bodied and elegant, with silky tannins and fresh acidity framing flavours of dark fruits, smoked meat, and a savoury, mineral edge. The finish is long and focused, delivering finesse and balance. While drinking beautifully now, it will continue to evolve over the next 5–7 years. The wine is not certified organic but is produced with sustainable practices and minimal intervention, preserving its authentic character.  

Food Pairing

Pair this refined Syrah with grilled lamb chops, pepper-crusted duck breast, or mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: 10,000 Hours Red Blend 2019
bodyHtml:
There’s a theory that says to become truly accomplished at something (karate, painting, the cello) it takes at least 10,000 hours of practice. This holds true for winemaking, too, where in this case the hours are counted in decades, and one thing is undeniable, there are no shortcuts. Their rich, complex 10,000 Hours reds are the culmination of that dedication. Each is deep, structured, and born of the famously exclusive Red Mountain terroir in eastern Washington, where the land and climate impart flavour characteristics like no other region in the world. This combination of patient toil and perfect sun, soil and rainfall conditions result in Cabernet Sauvignon and Red Blend experiences that are meant to be savored, not rushed. Will you be able to taste the decades of passion and master craftsmanship that go into each bottle? Instantly.

This Red Mountain gem was aged for 20 months in French oak barrels and can be enjoyed now or age in the bottle for 10+ years. Raspberry preserves, dried savoury herb and mocha on the nose with hints of liquorice, clove and vanilla. Expansive on the fore palate, building to a dense and rich mid palate with strong notes of ripe fruit and baking spices. Long, lingering finish with hints of toasty oak and vanilla.

63% Cabernet Sauvignon, 26% Merlot, 6% Petit Verdot, 3% Malbec and 2% Cabernet Franc from Red Mountain. Aged 20 months in 35% new French oak.

title: Lucien Muzard & Fils Santenay Vieilles Vignes 2023
bodyHtml:
Domaine Lucien Muzard & Fils is deeply rooted in the village of Santenay, with family origins tracing back to 1645. The modern domaine was founded by Lucien Muzard in the 1960s. Today, Lucien's sons, Claude and Hervé, lead the estate with a philosophy that balances traditional vinification with modern techniques, bottling the entire production of their 20.5 hectares, 80% of which is dedicated to red wine. They cultivate a passion for wine and a profound respect for the land, aiming to create exceptional wines that embody the authenticity of the Burgundy terroir.

Wine Description

The Santenay 'Vieilles Vignes' is made from 100% Pinot Noir. It displays a bright to deep ruby colour with garnet reflections. On the nose, it offers intense aromas of fresh red fruits, black fruits like blackberry and black cherry, violet, and sweet spices. The texture is velvety, supported by silky, well-present tannins. It is an authentic and refined expression of the Santenay terroir, showcasing lovely volume of red fruit, a sense of purity, and terrific length. The finish often reveals notes of liquorice, pepper, and warm stone.

Food Pairing

This Santenay 'Vieilles Vignes' is a great match for roasted or grilled red and white meats, such as a veal roast with herbs or a grilled pork chop with thyme. Its balance of fruit and structure also pairs well with mature cheeses or a truffle Brie.

title: Bocelli Sangiovese Rosso Toscana 2021
bodyHtml:
For over 180 years, long before Andrea Bocelli was famous for music, the Bocelli family has been known for wine. If there is one thing that Andrea, Alberto, and their family love to do, it is to share their special brand of Italian culture with friends around the world. Whether it is the music of "La Boheme," or the wine of la dolce vita, they understand the art of living well. 

This Sangiovese opens with aromas of red skinned berries, leather and underbrush. The bright palate offers red cherry, cinnamon and clove alongside velvety tannins.

title: Martin's Lane Riesling 'Simes Vineyard' 2023
bodyHtml: Simes is a cooler, steep, north-facing vineyard in East Kelowna. Its granite-based soils sit just a few kilometres south of the 50°N mark. The northern aspect adds a rare distinction to this site that remains cool even as climate change is warming up the west coast. It is the perfect home for the small amount of riesling that joins a vineyard predominately planted to pinot noir. The riesling fruit (Alsace clone 49) was hand picked using selective passes through the block on October 6. At the winery, it is meticulously hand sorted at the top of the six level, five movement winery. The juice is cold macerated for 24-48 hours, followed by stainless steel and ceramic fermentation that lasts one to two weeks before it ages on its lees for a minimum of six months. The ageing is in a mix of stainless steel and 1200 litre German foudres. The result is a knockout lemon-led riesling that, in the end, is bone dry, sporting a hum of electricity and minerality that speaks to East Kelowna riesling dusted in Okanagan desert scrub.

title: Rocca di Frassinello 'Le Sughere di Frassinello' 2021
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Maremma Toscana region of Italy, Le Sughere di Frassinello 2021 is the prestigious second label of the Rocca di Frassinello estate. The winery is a landmark joint venture between Castellare di Castellina and Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite), merging Italian tradition with French winemaking expertise. The estate features a striking cellar designed by renowned architect Renzo Piano, which serves as a 'cathedral of wine' dedicated to enhancing the quality of grapes grown in these historic Etruscan soils.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a deep ruby red colour and opens with a broad, intense bouquet of red berries, crushed flowers, and blackcurrant, accented by notes of eucalyptus, liquorice root, and tobacco. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and succulent, showing a lush structure of cherry and blackberry flavours supported by a mineral underpinning and hints of mocha. The mouthfeel is characterized by soft, round tannins and a fine balance that leads into a long, enveloping finish with a pleasant persistence.

Accolades

  • Vinous - 93 points

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points

  • James Suckling - 92 points

Food Pairing

This structured red is an ideal companion for full flavoured pasta and rice dishes, as well as roasted red meats and mature cheeses. It particularly excels when paired with game such as wild boar, deer, or hare, and is highly recommended with birds like wild duck.

title: Bruno Paillard Brut Assemblage 2012
bodyHtml:
Bruno Paillard was born in Reims in 1953 into an established family of Champagne "vignerons" and brokers. He started his own brokerage in 1975 and founded his own Champagne house in 1981. In fact, it is the youngest prestige house to be created since World War II. Bruno Paillard is synonymous with quality. One hundred and twenty-five acres of Grand Cru and Premier Cru vineyards provide the exceptional Pinot Noir, Pinot Munier and Pinot Chardonnay grapes which are used in the production of three luxury cuvees and one vintage Champagne. Each wine is produced in the traditional method and under the personal supervision of Bruno Paillard at his striking, state-of-the-art glass and stainless steel facility just outside Reims. Using only the first pressing of the grapes, Mr. Paillard is able to achieve the purest fruit flavours which then develop extraordinary balance during extended aging in the cellars. The Champagnes are all made with the dosage kept as low as possible in order to respect the authenticity of the wines. As a final note of the quality, every bottle carries its date of "disgorgement". Bruno Paillard is the only Champagne house to do so. The Champagnes of Bruno Paillard are rich, complex and dry but above all, elegant.

60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay

94 Points - James Suckling

Attractive nose of spiced apples, praline, toasted hazelnuts, dried mango and pastries. Medium-bodied with sharp acidity and very soft bubbles. Deliciously toasty with excellent length. 60% pinot noir and 40% Chardonnay. Drink now or hold.

title: Testalonga Follow Your Dreams Red 2024
bodyHtml:
Follow Your Dreams is a big bouncing ball of a Carignan, a world away from the heavier, more intense expressions you may link to the Languedoc or Priorat. Of all the Testalonga bush vines these are the youngest. They produce grapes with vigour, meaning less physiological ripeness and complexity, but big on the pure fruit juice. It's all red berries like raspberry and cherry with tart pomegranate and interesting herbaceous notes too. This is one to throw into the ice bucket and then pour out into generous glasses.  

After travelling extensively in Portugal and Austria learning his craft, Craig Hawkins returned to South Africa and became the winemaker at top Swartland estate Lammershoek. Craig now makes his own Testalonga wines from various small, organic vineyard sites in Swartland and makes everything naturally, with as little intervention as possible.

title: Troon Vineyard Biodynamic Red 'Druid's Fluid' 2020
bodyHtml:
50% Zinfandel, 25% Tempranillo, 25% Malbec.

The winemaking at Troon is an extension of their natural work in the vineyards. Indigenous yeast ferments, foot stomping, clay amphorae, old oak, and no fining or filtration. The wines are clean, pure, and alive.

92 Points - James Suckling

A medium-bodied red with lovely blackberry and cherry character. Medium tannins and a savoury finish. Some apples, too. From biodynamically grown grapes with Demeter certification. Drink now.

title: Mark Ryan Winery Mr. Pink Rose 2023
bodyHtml:
Their Philosophy... Always be authentic. Enjoy the ride. Surround yourself with good people. Invest in community, all boats will rise in the tide. Be vigilant. Give people your best. Maintain a ridiculous commitment to quality.

This Rosé opens with aromas of melon, white peach and crushed rose petal. The palate boasts explosive notes of tart citrus and bright peachy flavours mingling with hints of raspberry and subtle mineral notes. The wine’s finish is lined with buoyant, lip-smacking acidity that carries on well past the last sip.

title: Dillon's Dry Gin 7
bodyHtml: Gin 7 was engineered explicitly by Q to ensure a happier Bond at the Baccarat table. The result is a smooth, sophisticated "London-er" that's hit the country for the weekend. Perfection for the classic G&T and a jolly joy to the dry martini. Just wave the white vermouth over this gin, as it's all you'll need to sharpen your 'cheerio!'

title: Gordon & MacPhail Ardmore Single Malt 1994 'Connoisseurs Choice'
bodyHtml:
Distilled in 1994, this 26-year-old Ardmore matured in a Refill American Oak Hogshead before bottling at 53.1%.
 
NOSE: Vanilla and honeydew melon notes give way to subtle cured meats. Soft ripe pear leads to toasted oak and a hint of lemon.
 
TASTE: Sweet and creamy with apricot, apple and spicy pepper. Pineapple and citrus fruit notes come to the fore alongside soft floral notes.
 
FINISH: A medium-bodied finish with tropical fruit and smouldering smoke.

title: Le Bijou De Sophie Valrose Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
From sloping vineyards around Béziers, the southwestern community in France’s Languedoc-Roussillon region, this light pink bottle features pretty floral aromas, with notes of watermelon, raspberry and pear. The grapes for this wine are hand-harvested and fermented individually with native yeasts before being blended for the final wine. The palate is intriguing, with a definite salty tang balanced by soft fruit flavours of pear, orange, tangerine and a bit of cedar. It is both refreshing and interesting. It is dedicated to Sophie Valrose, a female vineyard worker who, in the 19th century, fought to improve the working conditions for the many women employed in the vineyards.

Steelhead trout, pork or shrimp would be great matches.

title: La Celia Pioneer Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
La Celia Pioneer Malbec originates from Argentina, specifically the renowned Uco Valley in the Mendoza region. Founded in 1890, Finca La Celia is the oldest winery in the Uco Valley and holds the distinction of being the first to plant Malbec vines in the area after founder Eugenio Bustos famously traded his finest horse for French cuttings. The estate’s winemaking philosophy, led by winemaker Andrea Ferreyra, focuses on expressing the unique high-altitude terroir of the valley through a commitment to elegance and purity.

Wine Description

This Malbec displays a vibrant and deep purple-red colour with shimmering violet reflections. The aromatic profile is intense and expressive, offering notes of fresh red berries, dark plum, and sour cherries in harmony with delicate floral scents of violets and lilacs. Subtle oak aging contributes complex layers of mocha, vanilla, and toffee, alongside a hint of balsamic and savoury spices. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied with a soft, elegant entry characterized by juicy fruit concentration and silky tannins. It maintains a fresh profile with well-defined acidity and a long, balanced finish.

Food Pairing

This Malbec is an ideal companion for grilled red meats such as traditional Argentine asado, marinated flank steak, or rack of lamb. It also pairs beautifully with savoury empanadas, mushroom-stuffed peppers, and pungent soft cheeses like Gorgonzola or aged Cheddar. For a sweet conclusion, it may be served alongside dark chocolate desserts or nougat.

title: Lost Peak Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: This wine is a tribute to the Cascade Range. Lost amongst the clouds for much of the year, its majestic peaks provide the 'rain shadow' that allows the vines to thrive and create bold, expressive flavour. This smooth Cabernet shows hints of black cherry and plum, with soft tannins and undertones of chocolate and coffee. Lost Peak showcases the award-winning flavours of McNary Vineyard in Horse Heaven Hills in Columbia Valley, Washington State.

title: 10,000 Hours Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
bodyHtml:
The 2018 10,000 Hours Cabernet Sauvignon from Red Mountain in Washington exemplifies the region’s structured and bold style. This wine, composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon, delivers rich flavors and firm tannins typical of Red Mountain terroir.

Colour: Deep ruby with dark reflections.
Aroma: Notes of blackberry, black cherry, herbs, and toasty oak.
Palate: Concentrated flavors of dark fruits with a touch of espresso and vanilla. The tannins are tightly wound, contributing to a dense, structured mouthfeel.
Body: Full-bodied with balanced acidity.
Finish: Long, with lingering black fruit and hints of toasted oak.

Accolades:
90 Points – Wine Enthusiast
91 Points – James Suckling

This vintage was aged in a combination of American and French oak to enhance complexity. With an ABV of 15%, it pairs exceptionally well with red meats such as ribeye or filet mignon. Decanting before serving is recommended to allow the flavors to open fully. Enjoyable now, it also has aging potential through 2031 for those looking to cellar it a bit longer.

title: Our Story Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml: Bright garnet in the glass with intense aromas of cassis, damson plums and dark chocolate. The palate is dry but fruity, with ripe tannins, refreshing acidity and complex flavours of blackberries, vanilla and subtle spice. The finish is savoury and flavourful with light grip from the tannins and lingering vanilla. Enjoy with grilled red meats, rich meaty pasta sauces or hard cheeses.

title: Craven Firs Syrah 2021
bodyHtml: Situated on a warm site in the Devon Valley, an area of Stellenbosch prized for intense red wines, this has deeper, darker, red clay soils. The wine was whole bunch, lightly stomped, gently handled, into old puncheons for native ferment and ten months' rest. Immensely powerful, yet finessed, with medicinal raspberry, cracked nutmeg, and waves of fine black pepper woven through the brooding wild cherry and raspberry.

title: Averill Creek Charme D'Ile Brut
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: A delightful Island sparkling wine produced in the classic Charmat Method. Citrus and floral aromas entice you towards a celebratory sip of this crisp-yet-creamy sparkling, which is bursting with texture and fruit-filled acidity.

title: Testalonga Baby Bandito 'Keep on Punching' Chenin Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Keep On Punching is Swartland Chenin, but not in the conventional sense. No buttery oak, this is all 100% stainless steel tank to keep that citrus twang just as clean as a whistle. Stylistically this wine fits more closely with the Chenins of the Loire valley as the fruit is apple and pear with some nice zippy white peach. The grapes come from old bush vines that yield small clusters of grapes with great concentration and acidity year on year. Craig's wines have a keen following, and for good reason.

After travelling extensively in Portugal and Austria learning his craft, Craig Hawkins returned to South Africa and became the winemaker at top Swartland estate Lammershoek. Craig now makes his own Testalonga wines from various small, organic vineyard sites in Swartland and makes everything naturally, with as little intervention as possible.

title: Blu Giovello Pinot Grigio 2022
bodyHtml: Produced in north-eastern Italy in the region of Friuli, it's a pale-coloured, clean and refreshing wine. The bouquet opens with distinct notes of quince, fruit blossom, nuts, spice and candy. Medium-minus body and fresh on the palate with more tree fruit flavours and hints of spice that add balance to a clean finish.

title: Dry Creek Old Vine Zinfandel 2021
bodyHtml:
First coined by Dry Creek Vineyard in 1987, the term “Old Vine” has special meaning to our family winery. For this bottling of our Old Vine Zinfandel, the vines average more than 100 years in age and in some cases, nearly 140 years old! 

This wine presents alluring aromatics of blackberry, boysenberry and fresh raspberry with notes of cocoa powder, cardamom, toasty cedar and nutmeg. On the palate, brambly layers of black cherry, blackberry and boysenberry come forward with nuances of coriander, marzipan and espresso. The wine is complex, with bright acidity complimented by a long, lingering finish. The tannins are structured but soft, and lend a round, rich mouthfeel that pairs excellently with pork, burgers, steak and Italian sausage.

title: Santa Rita Sauvignon Blanc Reserva 2019
bodyHtml:
A nose filled with intense herbal aromas, along with grapefruit, citrus fruit, apricot and guava in the background.

Fantastic concentration of flavor on the palate brings out the apricot and guava from the nose, with a touch of calamansi and green mango at the finish.

title: Chateau Lynch Bages 2019
bodyHtml:
100 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2019 Château Lynch-Bages is stunningly good, and it's going to be interesting to compare this to the 2018 over the coming decades. Based on 70% Cabernet Sauvignon, 24% Merlot, and the balance Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, brought up in 75% new French oak, its dense purple hue is followed by an incredible bouquet of pure crème de cassis, freshly sharpened cedar pencil, spring flowers, smoke, and graphite, with an almost liqueur of rocks-like minerality. A massive, incredibly concentrated Lynch-Bages, Jean-Charles has hit a home run in the vintage, and this sensational wine has building, perfect tannins, insane purity, and a finish that won't quit. It has the purity, finesse, balance, and depth to offer pleasure not only today but to evolve for 40 to 50 years. Smart money will hide these for a good 7-8 years, but wow, what a wine. Bravo. Best After 2029.

99 Points - Vinous

What a wine! Towering and vertical in its bearing, the 2019 is a total stunner. There is plenty of Lynch Bages charm, but what distinguishes the 2019 most is its spine of tannin and energy. Time in the glass brings out sweet red cherry, plum, blood orange and pomegranate and mint. The 2019 is a great, great, great Lynch Bages. It reminds me of the epic 1989, but with the youthful grip of this vintage. A towering Pauillac, the 2019 Lynch Bages will make a great addition to any cellar.

97 Points - Decanter

This takes hold from the first moment and powers along, delivering a ton of black brambly fruit, liquorice, grilled cedar and Pauillac confidence. The tannins are pretty chewy, really closing in on the end of play, giving no doubt that this is going to age slowly and for many decades, but there is a creaminess to the overall structure that is already evident.

97 Points - James Suckling

Fantastic blackberries, blackcurrants, lead pencil and violets. So Pauillac on the nose! Full-bodied with a dense, layered palate and tight yet plush tannins that give the wine layers and gravitas. Compact. Long finish. Silky. Reminds me of a modern, classic version of something like the wonderful 1985 Lynch. Best after 2026.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Gorgeous from the start, with lush and caressing cassis, dark plum and blackberry compote flavours that are substantial in feel although they seem to glide through, carried by a very refined structure that lets in alluring black tea, worn alder, floral and savoury details along the way. Features a vibrant, authoritative bolt of iron through the finish to keep it all grounded. Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Best from 2025.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A true classic from this estate, the 2019 Lynch Bages has turned out brilliantly, unwinding in the glass with aromas of cassis and sweet blackberry fruit mingled with licorice, mint, cigar wrapper and loamy soil. Full-bodied, rich and concentrated, it's a deep, multidimensional wine built around a chassis of rich, powdery tannins and succulent balancing acids. The last vintage produced in Lynch Bages old winery, it will be interesting to compare this benchmark wine with subsequent vintages over the coming years.

title: Loveblock Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: Distinctive, almost exotic, pure and ripe with aromas of lemons and grapefruit, white spice and wildflowers, apple and sweet herbs. The silky textured palate and fruit density give way to a youthful, refreshing line of acidity, soft herbs, notes of flowers, minerals and spices.

title: Veuve Clicquot Rich
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1772, Veuve Clicquot is one of Champagne’s most esteemed houses, celebrated for innovation and exceptional quality. After Madame Clicquot took the reins in the early 1800s, she became a pioneer in Champagne production, credited with inventing the riddling table, a key technique in traditional method sparkling wine. The house remains committed to quality and creativity, now part of the LVMH group.

Wine Description
Veuve Clicquot Rich is a unique take on Champagne, intentionally crafted to be mixed with fresh ingredients like citrus peel, cucumber, or tea. Pale gold in colour with persistent, fine bubbles, this wine is strikingly aromatic—expressing bright citrus, floral notes, and hints of tropical fruit. The palate is round, lightly sweet, and fresh, offering flavours of stone fruit, ripe pineapple, and a touch of minerality. It is medium-bodied with a smooth, lingering finish and a fine mousse. Comprised primarily of Pinot Noir (the house signature), blended with Chardonnay and Meunier, Veuve Clicquot Rich is approachable yet complex. Best enjoyed young and served over ice with garnishes to enhance its character.

Accolades
Wine Enthusiast – 90 points.

Food Pairing
Pair this Champagne with sushi, fruit-forward desserts, or creamy cheeses. The light sweetness and bright acidity work especially well with dishes featuring tropical or citrus elements. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Finca Monasterio Baron de Ley 2021
bodyHtml:
The winery is situated next to a 16th-century Benedictine Monastery in Mendavia, a historic estate where monks began making wine over 500 years ago. The winery's philosophy was ambitious, aiming to return to the essence of Rioja winemaking by specialising in Reserva and Gran Reserva wines and emphasising the significance of their estate vineyards.

Wine Description

The nose is rich and uplifting, dominated by aromas of black fruit such as blackberries and plums, black berry compote, and jam. These fruit notes are complemented by fine woods, black tea, coconut, licorice, balsamic oak, and hints of cocoa and clove. On the palate, the wine is structured, complex, and flavourful, with a full body. It presents as juicy and elegant, with well-integrated, glossy tannins and a profile that includes smoky, almost peaty notes.

Food Pairing

This full-bodied red wine is a versatile companion to hearty dishes like beef steaks, stews, and game. Its notes of black fruit, spice, and savoury smoked notes are also a perfect complement to rich, meaty pizza.

title: Mendel Cabernet Franc 2020
bodyHtml:
From Paraje Altamira, Cabernet Franc Mendel was aged for 12 months in 1/3 new French barrels. A vivid dark garnet in hue, the precise nose offers ash, blackcurrant, mint, herbs and jalapeño over a whiff of wood, while the intense palate has fine tannins, mild freshness and a compact flow. This is an elegant, old-world style red.

Mendel Winery embodies the partnership of one of Argentina's most respected and experienced winemakers, Roberto de la Mota, with an established Argentine family. Together they are dedicated to producing wines of unquestionable superior quality, expressing the quality and character of their ancient Malbec and Cabernet vineyards in Luján de Cuyo, Mendoza, Argentina. They choose the best lots from their vineyards and pay rigorous attention to every detail of the artisan winemaking process, from selecting parcels and picking grapes to fermentation in small tanks and aging wines in the finest French oak. Ancient vineyards, passionate people, experience and friendship, are blended to create Mendel's remarkable wines.

title: Mendel Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml:
Mendel Winery embodies the union of Roberto de la Mota, one of Argentina's most respected and experienced winemakers. with a nearly century-old Argentine family, whose sole objective is to produce wine of unquestionable, superior quality that expresses the character of their very old Malbec and Cabernet vineyards in Lujan de Cuyo, Mendoza, Argentina.

Mendel is the first name of the owner's father, a man who came to Argentina with nothing and ended up a successful businessman in different industries. He was also a man that loved the finest things that life had to offer, particularly wine. His daughter, Anabelle, honours her father by seeking perfection in her and Roberto's wines with his name on the label.

title: La Celia Pioneer Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml:
Founded 130 years ago, La Celia is the oldest winery in the Uco Valley, Mendoza, Argentina. It was the first winery in the region to plant the Malbec variety, which is currently the country's signature worldwide. Today, the tradition lives on in their wines, which express a terroir that is unique to the world.
 
La Celia Pioneer Cabernet Sauvignon is garnet red with deep ruby highlights, with outstanding aromas, such as black cherry and spicy and red flowers. For its aging in oak, there are outstanding spicy and toasted notes. Very good structure, with good concentration and softness in the mouth. Ideal for drinking with the meat of wild boar and a table of ripe and smoked cheeses. Serve at 16°C • 61°F.

title: Hine Cigar Reserve XO
bodyHtml: Hine Cigar Reserve XO was made as a collaboration between HINE and Hunters & Frankau of London, the UK's exclusive distributor of Havana cigars. It's made from a blend of 20 eaux de vie from Grande Champagne, Petite Champagne, and the Fins Bois aged over 15 years. This is the only expression of HINE to use Fins Bois in its blends. First introduced in Europe in 1996, it was released in the US as of December 2021.

title: Crown Royal - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Always delicious! Amber in colour the nose is lightly floral with corn, buttery vanilla and peach aromas. On the palate look for a light sweet peach flavour with wood spice on a dry finish.

title: Jameson - 375 ml
bodyHtml: A versatile and smooth blend of pot still and fine grain whiskeys. Bright pale amber in the glass, with subtle aromas of white flower, nectarine, ripe pear and clove. Mellow and approachable on the palate, with a gentle impression of alcohol and flavours that include spicy vanilla, wildflower honey and ginger.

title: Hine Antique XO
bodyHtml:
Hine's flagship brand is another Fine Champagne cognac, aged 'more than one generation' and with a subtle, delicate palate to delight the most discerning of cognac aficionados. Top stuff!

The depth of flavor presented in this XO Cognac make it the ideal digestif, served with a cheese course or chocolate orange, the creamy and citrus textures flawlessly contrast the fruity, earthy and sweet notes brought by Hine's Grande Champagne blend.

A true adventure for the senses and a wonderful way to finish a meal.

title: Mendel Malbec 2023
bodyHtml:
Mendel Winery embodies the union of Roberto de la Mota, one of Argentina's most respected and experienced winemakers, with a nearly century-old Argentine family, whose sole objective is to produce wine of unquestionable, superior quality that express the character of their very old Malbec and Cabernet vineyards in Lujan de Cuyo, Mendoza, Argentina. Mendel is the first name of the owner's father, a man who came to Argentina with nothing and ended up a successful businessman in different industries.
Wine Description
This wine is a deep, intense, bright red with a violet rim. The aroma is complex and intense, offering a perfect combination of fresh red fruits, such as black cherries, raspberries, and blackberries, alongside floral accents of violet. Delicate notes of sweet French oak, espresso, liquorice, vanilla, and caramel add further complexity. The palate is full-bodied, dense, deep, and chewy, showcasing flavours of black raspberry, plums, and roasted herbs, with a silky, velvety mouth-feel.
Food Pairing
Classic pairings include a nice ribeye steak or leg of lamb, which complement the wine's dark fruit and spice notes. It also pairs beautifully with aged cheeses like Cheddar or Gouda, as well as grilled vegetables.

title: Loch Lomond 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Loch Lomond 12 Year Old is a perfect representation of their signature style. It delivers delicious notes of peach and pear, layered with vanilla sweetness and a gentle hint of smoke on the finish.

Crisp green apple, ripe pear and refreshing citrus lemon with background notes of golden cereal. Orchard fruits and lemon meringue. The deep fruity character of pear leads into the citrus lemon, vanilla meringue and light biscuit sweetness. Medium in length with gentle wood smoke and a lingering tang.

title: Quintessa Estate Red Blend Rutherford 2019
bodyHtml:
For more than three decades, Quintessa has dedicated itself to deepening its relationship with this estate to better express its pristine beauty with elegance and finesse. They are committed to delivering the distinctive signature of the estate through the unique conditions of each growing season. Thanks to well-timed rains early in the year, the vines at Quintessa showed healthy growth throughout the slow and steady growing season. Even temperatures at ripening brought beautiful fruit into the winery. The result is a wine of nuance, depth, and great persistence. The 2019 vintage is the expression of thoughtful and attentive farming inspired by their devotion to the ongoing beauty of this estate.

100 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This is a winemaker's master class in blending and understanding of a long-standing site. Dried herb, cedar and pencil shavings accent lifted red fruit and brilliant acidity on the palate, with a supple yet still youthfully grippy texture framed by structured, graceful tannins. Enjoy from 2029–2039.

99 Points - James Suckling

So much earth and spice with walnut and wet earth. Like fog lying over the valley in the morning. Black fruit. Medium to full-bodied with super-fine tannins that are long and persistent, with graceful progression and length on the palate. So long, with real definition. From biodynamically grown grapes. Hard not to drink now, but it will age wonderfully.

97 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

I was blown away by the 2019 Red Blend from Quintessa, which is up with the crème de la crème of the vintage. Based on Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot and Carmenère, this full-bodied beauty has a perfectly balanced, seamless, yet expansive and classic 2019 style, as well as gorgeous aromatics of cassis, flowers, chalky minerality, and integrated oak. It's hard to resist already, but I have no doubt this will evolve for 20 years if stored properly.

96 Points - Decanter

From the heart of Rutherford, made with both organic and Demeter-certified biodynamic grapes. Pure, vibrant aromas of dark berry fruit, licorice, cassis, cardamom and rich earth. Penetrating to the core, satiny robes of mixed blue and black fruits, crème de cassis, and a rich tapestry of long, fine-grained tannins. A beautiful wine, drinking nicely now, and should be enjoyed over the next few decades.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Proprietary Red Wine is more open and effusive than the 2018 version, with gentle floral nuances set against a backdrop of black cherries and cassis and subtle notes of tobacco, cedar and vanilla. In the mouth, it's medium to full-bodied, streamlined, silky and lush, nicely balanced and elegant, with a long, softly dusty finish tinged with licorice and caramel and tasted twice, with consistent notes.

title: St Remy Signature
bodyHtml: St. Remy Signature is the new creation from their Master Blender, Cécile Roudaut. With this blend, she wanted to shape a new face for brandy by exploring new production processes and aromas while respecting St Remy's traditions and historical profile. To do so, she decided to introduce a double maturation process. The first maturation occurs in new oak casks (Quercus Petraea species with a fine grain) using medium and high heat. These casks will deliver spicy notes, indulgence, and vivacity. The second maturation occurs in traditional casks (Quercus Robur species with a large grain) using high heat only. These casks will deliver roundness, balance and sweetness and assert the same personality as their brandy. The result is a smooth and fruity taste. The perfect harmony makes it ideal for classic brandy cocktails or creations!

title: Jameson - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml: The perfect balance of spicy, nutty, and vanilla notes with hints of sweet sherry and exceptional smoothness.

title: Catena Appellation Semillon White Clay 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and mineral-driven white wine originates from Argentina, specifically within the Mendoza region and the Luján de Cuyo subregion. Bodega Catena Zapata, family vintners for over 100 years, is renowned for its pioneering role in high-altitude viticulture and for establishing the world-class reputation of Argentine wine. The winemaking philosophy for the White Clay label is to modernise an old Mendoza classic the Semillon and Chenin Blanc blend by highlighting the unique 'tensile' character derived from vineyards planted in 1983 on alluvial soils with rich clay topsoil.

Wine Description

Catena Appellation Luján de Cuyo White Clay presents a bright pale straw colour with subtle green and silvery highlights. The sensory profile features an herbal, tropical, and creamy nose with notes of honey, chamomile, yellow apple, and apricot, accented by hints of candied citrus and sea salt. On the palate, the wine is oily and concentrated at the attack, showcasing flavors of pear and candied orange peel before transitioning to a vibrant spine of crushed rock and salinity. It is a medium-bodied wine with impressive density and extract, defined by a fresh, succulent, and 'gently tensile' structure. This blend consists of 60% Semillon and 40% Chenin Blanc and reached an ABV of approximately 12.9%. While the estate utilizes sustainable farming and vegan-friendly practices, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Mendel Semillon 2021
bodyHtml: Enjoy fresh, clean citric and herbal notes. Flavours of citrus, tropical fruit, coconut, and caramel are elegant and soft on the palate. Try with shrimp ceviche, steamed muscles, fresh oysters or grilled lobster.

title: Smoke Lab Classic Vodka
bodyHtml:
Smoke Lab Vodka is India's first Premium Vodka made by one of the world's largest and most respected spirits producers. Smoke Lab Classic is a rice vodka made from the finest quality, locally sourced Basmati Rice and Pure Himalayan spring water. The Smoke Lab Vodka Classic is an ultra pure spirit, with a whole lot of intrigue. Enjoy it chilled as is or in your favourite vodka cocktail.
 
Smoke Lab Vodkas are:
 
5 X Distilled for superior taste and character.  
Two-Step Sparkle Filtered through Charcoal and Silver.
Gluten-Free and Vegan.  
Zero Carbon Footprint & Zero Waste.

title: Smoke Lab Aniseed Vodka
bodyHtml: Aniseed or saunf as it’s known in India, was first discovered in the Mediterranean. Every sip of the Smoke Lab Aniseed makes for a playful exploration of a much-loved Indian herb. Refreshing notes of fennel and liquorice will keep you coming back for more.

title: Bombarda Culverin Rum
bodyHtml:
Bombarda Rum comes from the decks of glory, and with an unruly spirit, Bombarda Rum pays tribute to the commanders and buccaneers who blazed a path to victory at sea. In search of the finest liquid gold treasure, their crew has scoured the West Indies settling only for the most infamous rums. Invading ports and raiding distilleries, their crew demands only the finest rums to be surrendered. Its befitting origins are Trinidad, Dominican Republic, Guyana, Jamaica, Barbados and Panama! After the heat of the battle, Bombarda's hand-selected rums are then inconspicuously hoisted deep from the cellars and further tropically aged in select white oak casks under the Caribbean sun.

Culverin is a blend of 5-8-year-old rum. It is sourced from three origins: Barbados, Dominican Republic and Panama. The nose is bold but subtly balanced with infusions of ripe yellow fruit, vanilla, toffee and a hint of tobacco.

title: Two Stacks Smoke and Mirrors Single Malt Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml: Smoke & Mirrors Peated Stout Cask Single Malt is like no other. An interesting combination consisting of 10% double malt and 30% triple peated malt, both matured in ex-bourbon, 60% triple distilled malt aged in ex-bourbon and ex-imperial stout casks. The result is a soft, rich whiskey with sweet notes of smoked chocolate. Colour free and non-chill filtered.

title: Plume Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Plume is the result of the Stewart family of Quails' Gate in the Okanagan Valley expanding to Napa Valley a decade ago.

Expect plush aromas of cassis and vanilla, plums and licorice, mocha, pencil shavings and tobacco. Freshness is in check, it has a supple weight and smooth palate. A very approachable red trailing spiced cocoa flavours on the finish.

title: Jura 1989 Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
A 1989 vintage single malt which hails from the Isle of Jura! After it was distilled, it was laid to rest in American white oak bourbon barrels, where it stayed until 2019. After that point, it was bottled at 53.5% ABV for the Rare Vintage series, with the limited 1,500 bottles accompanied by a very classy presentation box.

Did you know that on Jura, there are more deer than people?

title: Pierre Ferrand 1840 Cognac
bodyHtml: Probably the most celebrated French brandy, Cognac is the namesake of its place of origination in France. Aged to perfection, this pours out a deep amber and golden yielding a blend of aromas that practically resonate out of the glass. Rich and sweet, this drink goes down smooth with an elegant finish. It is at its best, sipped slowly after dinner neat or on the rocks and accompanied by a cigar.

title: Rust En Vrede Estate Red Blend 2020
bodyHtml:
The Estate blend is the emblematic wine of Rust en Vrede. The blend is made up of the proportions of varieties planted on Rust en Vrede, making it the most honest reflection of our terroir. 

Named to reflect the planting on the property, the grapes for this wine come from 22 hectares of Cabernet Sauvignon, 7 hectares of Syrah and 1 hectare of Merlot.

Rich cassis and mulberry with cedar and tobacco reveal Cabernet as the backbone to the blend, after which fresh red and black cherry with black pepper spice show the Syrah component. Intense fruit flavours are layered with mocha, Christmas cake, sandalwood and leather, bringing complexity to the wine. Fresh, fruity acidity balances the firm, coating tannins, culminating in a clean, dry finish that indicates good ageing potential.

title: Bret Brothers Pouilly Fuisse Premier Cru Climat Les Reisses 2024
bodyHtml:
The 45 to 55-year-old vines from the "En Carementrant" enjoy a full southern exposure at the foot of the majestic Roche de Vergisson cliff. 

Entirely produced and aged in 228-litre casks for 11 months, this cuvee offers contained wood which makes way for flavours of white fruits, butter, almonds and white fruits. Proof that great class is not only found on Côte de Beaune.

title: Fratelli Degani Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico 2020
bodyHtml:
Degani wines aptly reflect world-class terroir and winemaking skills. Valpolicella is the perfect place for the cultivation of vineyards. The terrain features a hilly area with forests that provide shade on summer days. The soil, microclimate, and other natural conditions allow the growth of high-quality, fruity grapes. The main grape varietal that grows here are the Corvina, Corvinone, and Rondinella. The workers further processed and handpicked the best grapes to make their award-winning red, white, and dessert wines.

This Amarone is Intense garnet red, rich, full-bodied and firm. Its perfume is clear and fresh. Its taste is velvety and lingering. Well structured and beautifully balanced.

title: Pusser's Gunpowder Rum
bodyHtml:
Pusser’s ‘Gunpowder Proof' is a traditional Royal Navy style rum produced at original Admiralty strength and in accordance with the Admiralty's blending recipe last used when the Royal Navy discontinued its daily ration on 31 July 1970.

Color: Clear, dark coppery amber with burnished copper highlights

Nose: Pungent molasses, treacle, toffee, honey and vanilla with oak, cinnamon, nutmeg and ginger

Body: Full-bodied with a more enhanced flavour profile than the lower proof Blue Label

Finish: Long finish, and despite its strength, smooth and mellow

title: Kaiyo 'The Kuri' Chestnut Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Kaiyo "The Kuri" No. 1 is a pioneering Japanese malt whisky that explores the rare use of Japanese Chestnut (Kuri) wood for maturation. Part of the distillery’s "Ariake Wood Collection," this expression is crafted from 100% malted barley. It is aged for seven years in first-fill Kuri barrels before undergoing the brand’s signature three-month ocean maturation voyage. This "ocean aging" subjects the barrels to constant movement and fluctuating temperatures, which enhances the interaction between the spirit and the unique chestnut wood, resulting in a profile that is distinctly softer and sweeter than traditional oak-aged whiskies.

Whisky Description

This whisky presents a bright amber-gold colour with faint chestnut hues. The nose is exceptionally vibrant and creamy, offering a bouquet of orange zest, lime juice, and white pear, underpinned by floral notes of lavender and a hint of eucalyptus. On the palate, the texture is luxuriously silky, delivering a complex array of flavours including vanilla shortbread, honey, persimmon, and kiwi. The Kuri wood imparts a delicate nuttiness and warming spices like clove and ground ginger without the heavy tannins associated with oak. The finish is long and refined, leaving a lingering sweetness of ripe raspberry and a gentle, incense-like woody warmth. It is bottled un-chill filtered at 46% ABV.

title: Bowmore Vault Edition 1st Release
bodyHtml:
Created using the finest hand selected ex-bourbon casks to create a refined liquid of greater depth, Bowmore Vault Edition Atlantic Sea Salt reflects the distinctive microclimate in the depths of the No.1 Vaults. Bowmore Distillery’s close proximity to the sea is vital in determining the final character of the spirit, and the Atlantic sea spray that washes against the iconic sea-facing wall of Bowmore’s legendary No.1 Vaults is a key note in this release.

On The Eye Bright gold

Breathe In The zest of sun-ripened fruits drizzled with the sea

Sip Salted honeycomb with zingy spiced cocoa and the tang of iodine-soaked blood orange

Savour The never-ending salt finish of ocean-spiced blackberry, sea-salt and lingering kumquat, going on and on like the depth of the ocean

title: Penderyn Ex-PX Sherry Single Cask
bodyHtml:
Nose: A warm honey aroma with dates, raisins and apricots alongside milk chocolate-coated almonds.
Taste: Plums, rum and raisins. A brown sugar sweetness with nutmeg and cinnamon spice. Toasted oak dryness with a hint of cloves.
Finish: the sweetness fades into dry oaky notes.

title: Penderyn Icon Of Wales Hiraeth Single Malt
bodyHtml:
The 8th in Penderyn's ‘Icons of Wales' series was launched in December 2021 and commemorates the wonderful Welsh word, 'Hiraeth.’ Difficult to translate into English, some say 'yearning' or 'homesickness.' Still, the BBC's Roy Noble summed it up nicely: "a longing for your homeland, your heritage and your very being." This whisky is an ex-Bourbon cask finish bottled at 46% abv. It is the first time Penderyn has released a core range single malt using mainly spirit from the pot stills, which they introduced in 2014.

Nose... Elegant and floral with light oak notes, vanilla, raisins, toffee apples, citrus peel and a hint of lime.

Palate... A delicate, smooth single malt with honeyed fruits, vanilla, cinnamon spice and a hint of nutmeg.

Finish... Soft honey and vanilla notes fade to a malty finish.

title: Motorhead Ace Of Spades Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Aged 4 years in charred oak barrels. A raucous rock 'n' roll blend of Straight Bourbon Whiskey boosting a high rye content and bursting with complex flavours. Produced using award-winning small batch distilling methods in North Dakota. Celebrating the loudest rock "n" roll band to ever grace our ears. Motorhead for life.

Flavour... Full-bodied and complex, oak, caramelized brown sugar and cocoa with a strong cinnamon finish.

Aroma... Hints of vanilla, spice, and sweet flavours with cinnamon, rye, black pepper and mint.

title: 818 Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
American model and socialite Kendall Jenner is behind 818 Tequila. The tequila gets its name from her area code in the San Fernando Valley, California. Enjoy with key lime pie, toasted coconut cookies or craft a Margarita.

Taste... Sweet agave and vanilla, with undertones of tropical and citrus fruit.

Aroma... Lemongrass, mild floral elements, chamomile and light minerality.

Body & Colour... Brilliant platinum, light body.

Finish... Ultra smooth with a bright and crispy finish, notes of almond, key lime pie, and toasted coconut.

title: 818 Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Aged in French and American oak barrels for a minimum of two months.

Taste... Ripe roasted agave flavor with notes of caramel and vanilla.

Aroma... Vanilla, meringue, honey, and fruit accents.

Body & Colour... Straw colour with golden hues and medium body.

Finish... Smooth caramel finish with notes of sweet cooked agave and pecan pie.

title: Tatenokawa Kodakara Yuzu Liqueur - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
A versatile liqueur for all seasons. Serve Tatenokawa Kodakara Yuzu Liqueur chilled, over ice or topped with soda in the summer months, or gently heated as a citrus winter warmer when things get cold.

Tatenokawa Kodakara Yuzu Liqueur is made with the brewery's exceptional Junmai Daiginjo sake, shochu (a Japanese distilled spirit) made with the lees (spent yeast) of the same sake, a touch of sugar and lots of yuzu (a sweet-sour citrus fruit that looks a bit like a knobbly grapefruit) from Kochi Prefecture. The result is pure pleasure, with the sweetness perfectly balanced by the tangy citrus. Sharp, sweet and deeply moreish, it's a taste like no other.

title: Los Danzantes Mezcal Arroqueno
bodyHtml:
Los Danzantes Aroqueno is produced with the homonymous variety of agave, or the Arroqeno, grown in Miahuatlán de Porfirio Díaz, Oaxaca.

The distillate produced by this plant can be floral, even vegetable, but it often seems to have a spicy and bitter chocolate note.

Aromas of mango, banana leaves, chocolate, and caramel. On the palate, notes of toasted seeds such as almonds. Tones of chocolate, pear, and butter.

title: J Maltus Collection 2019 - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml:
Le Dome 2019

96 Points - James Suckling

A rich, fragrant red with aromas of mulberries, dark plums, chocolate, cedar, cloves, mushrooms, and cigar box. Full-bodied with fine, creamy tannins. Polished and velvety with an intense, perfumed core of dark fruit. 

97 Points - Jed Dunnock

Blackcurrants, violets, spring flowers, and damp earth are just some of its nuances, and it hits the palate with medium to full-bodied richness, beautiful, seamless tannins, integrated acidity, and a great finish. 


Les Asteries 2019

94+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Medium to deep garnet-purple in color, the 2019 Les Asteries wafts seductively out of the glass with fragrant notes of Ceylon tea, potpourri, forest floor, and lavender over a core of Morello cherries, wild blueberries, and blackberry tart with a touch of bouquet garni.

94+ Points - James Suckling 

Real purity of fruit to this with a core of blue fruit and fine, ripe tannins. It's full-bodied, long, and energetic.


Le Carre 2019

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Spiced black cherries, dried herbs, incense, chocolate, and some obvious minerality all emerge from the 2019 Le Carre, a rich, full-bodied, brilliantly textured, and voluptuous effort. It's one of the most opulent and sexy in the Maltus lineup. 

94 Points - James Suckling

Lots of ripe dark and blue-fruit aromas with notes of violets and dried herbs, as well as some chocolate and licorice. Full-bodied, firm, and polished with layers of tannins, deep fruit, and a savory finish. 


Vieux Chateau Mazerat 2019

96+ Jeb Dunnuck

Another beautiful wine in the making, with beautiful ripeness in its blackcurrants, roasted herbs, chocolate, unsmoked tobacco, and damp earth-like aromas and flavors. Rich, full-bodied, and gorgeous on the palate, it has an incredibly seamless texture paired with plenty of opulence and texture as well as minerality on the finish. It's a gem of a wine.

95 Points - Decanter

Quite different in feel and weight than the others in the Maltus range, this is a little fresher, with higher Cabernet Franc that gives it a sense of reserve. As it unrolls in the glass, you see the complexity and tight blueberry and blackberry fruits.


Chateau Teyssier 2019

93+ Points - James Suckling

Tight, focused, ripe fruit with chewy, polished tannins. It's full-bodied with a lingering and precise finish. Extremely well-done. 

91+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2019 Chateau Teyssier reveals a dense purple color and a great bouquet of crème de cassis, red plums, unsmoked tobacco, damp earth, and spice. 


Chateau Laforge 2019

93 Points - Vinous

Black cherry, plum, chocolate, tobacco, licorice, and lavender build beautifully with some aeration. The 2019 is sumptuous, bold, and racy, Laforge is an absolute joy to taste today. This flamboyant, racy Saint-Emilion will be a jewel to drink now and over the next few years. 

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Medium-bodied aromas and flavors of savory red and black fruits, leafy herbs, iron, and tobacco. It has good acidity, ripe tannins, and, as with all of the releases from Malthus, is beautifully balanced. Drink this already complex, layered, seamless 2019 over the coming 15+ years.

title: Comte De Grasse N.44 Gin
bodyHtml:
From French distiller, Comte de Grasse comes its inaugural gin, 44°N! The spirit is inspired by perfume production methods and is made using ultrasonic maceration, vacuum distillation, and CO2 supercritical extraction. 

That all sounds very high-tech and fancy, but in fact, these techniques are also incredibly sustainable and efficient. The list of botanicals is extensive, with cade (a species of juniper), verbena, everlasting (a golden flower), horse parsley, samphire, lavender, mimosa, grapefruit, patchouli, and Sichuan pepper among a few of them. The gin is inspired by the Mediterranean, right down to its brilliant blue bottle.

title: Santa Carolina Sauvignon Blanc - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Lemon yellow colour with green reflections. Melon and pineapple nose with citrus overtones of lime and grapefruit. The palate is soft and fruity, with a medium body and balanced acidity. It pairs well with fish and pizza.

title: Santa Carolina Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot 2024 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Garnet red colour; aromas of cassis and black raspberries; medium-full bodied with ripe fruit flavour and light cedar spice on the finish.

title: Cune Cava Brut
bodyHtml: Back in the 19th Century, Rioja's Cune produced consistent quantities of sparkling wine to fill the void for the Champagne region, ravaged by phylloxera. Although the company evolved into being a still wine specialist, Cune Cava Brut represents a return to the future. The process is traditional méthode with long term bottle ageing and riddling by gyropalette. You can expect a delightful fizz with the same balance and acidity that is the hallmark of Cune. It has an appealing fresh fruit nose with a yeasty/almond undertone. The palate is creamy and bright with nutty, green apple fruit and a mostly dry finish. A perfect patio, party starter you can serve with what else, pinchos and tapas.

title: Bask Pinot Noir - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml:
Bask Pinot Noir has aromas of dark cherry and subtle notes of spice. A medium-bodied wine that's well balanced and perfect on its own or with a meal.

The New full-flavoured wine that's zero grams of sugar per serving!

title: Egly Ouriet Brut Les Premices (NV)
bodyHtml:
90 Points - Vinous

A new wine in the Egly range, the NV Brut Les Prémices is a Chardonnay/Pinot Noir/Meunier blend from Trigny. Bright floral notes and the natural richness of Pinots come together nicely in this entry-level bottling.

title: Chateau Langoa Barton 2021
bodyHtml:
The nectar shows firstly its dense and intense purple color. Then it reveals a dazzling nose of black fruits and black cherry with minty and spicy notes. The palate is powerful, structured and reveals the great precision of the tannins. The suppleness and roundness of the wine stretch the endless tasting.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Decorated with a label celebrating 200 years of the Barton family in Bordeaux, the wine has touches of toast aromas with smokiness. On the palate, tannins give a dry core to the wine. It is ripe, but with a great freshness.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

It offers a healthy purple/plum hue to go with impressive depth and richness in its darker currants, spicy oak, and cedar pencil/graphite-like aromatics. With medium-bodied richness, terrific mid-palate depth, and a broad, layered, mouth-filling texture, it deserves 4-6 years of bottle age and will cruise over the following two decades in cold cellars. It's another terrific wine from this chateau. Tasted twice with consistent notes.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2021 Langoa Barton offers up attractive aromas of dark berries and plums mingled with sweet spices and cigar box. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and seamless, it's polished and fleshy, with an enveloping core of fruit, beautifully refined tannins and well-integrated acids.

93 Points - Vinous

93 Points - Decanter

93 Points - James Suckling

title: Pierre Meurgey Savigny Les Beaune Les Bas Liards 2021
bodyHtml: Red cherry, raspberry, a flick of flint and a lick of vanilla unite into a most appetizing nose on this wine. Vanilla stays put on the palate where it envelopes the ripe, juicy fruit on a slender palate. This wine is rounded, ready and full of joy.

title: Kavalan Classic Single Malt
bodyHtml: Kavalan Classic Single Malt Whisky exemplifies the sheer quality of whisky from Taiwan. The craftsmanship of the distillery works with the humid Taiwanese climate to create diverse and complex whisky. Fresh and clean, the spirit is rich with silky smoothness and hints of tropical fruits, particularly mango.

title: Giacomo Fenocchio Barolo Bussia 2021
bodyHtml:
The color is deep garnet red and the bouquet is fine and pleasing, with intense scents of spiced rose and licorice. The flavor is dry, warm, full bodied and balanced with pronounced tannins and a persistent aftertaste. A wine particularly adapted for aging.

The Barolo Bussia, with its structure and body characteristics, pairs well with dishes of meat, game and aged cheeses, typical dishes of the local cuisine, as well as with many rich international dishes.

title: Flowers Chardonnay 'Sonoma Coast' 2023
bodyHtml:
Delicate aromas of white flower and coastal minerality frame a beautiful nose on this Chardonnay. Hints of Kaffir lime leaf, fresh herbs, and elements of citrus amplify the bright savory character. The firs sip offers a flourish of fresh fruit, which knits into artful integration with focused acidity and lovely chalky textures. As the wine opens in the glass, faint notes of almond skin balance gentle citrus and pear, lingering on a minerals rich finish.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This distinctive white features a lively, mouthwatering and energetic mix of pomelo, yuzu and lemon sherbet flavors, with hints of sweetgrass, apple blossoms and lime zest. There's also an appealing grip on the finish.

title: Fortunate Son Cabernet Sauvignon 'The Dreamer' 2019
bodyHtml:
Deep garnet-purple in colour, it bursts with flamboyant notes of redcurrant preserves, cassis, dark chocolate, violets and red roses, plus fragrant hints of Indian spices and camphor, with a suggestion of iron ore. The medium to full-bodied palate is fabulously velvety, delivering beautiful freshness and loads of spicy layers, finishing very long.

This wine is dark and brooding, a wine of elegance, fine and structured tannins, and basically the wine equivalent of a Wagner piece on a stormy night after unexpectedly making an enormous sum of money. In other words, it is fucking pure magic with rock bloody solid complexity on a very high level.

Sourced from small, family vineyards, (in some cases for 3-4 generations) that are farmed with great care and attention. Made in very small amounts and combined from blocks of vineyards where they make a perfect combination of power, complexity and layers that give the wine incredible character and elegance. 

96 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Coming from two vineyards, the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon The Dreamer sports a vivid purple hue to go with beautiful aromatics of darker currants, ripe cranberries, leafy tobacco, and spring flowers. I love its balance, it's medium to full-bodied, has gorgeous tannins, and a great finish.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of two undisclosed vineyards, Fortunate Son's 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon The Dreamer is darker, richer and warmer than the 2018 version, yet still balanced, delivering ripe black cherries, loamy earth and dried spices. It's medium to full-bodied, softly dusty and long on the finish.

title: Cut Point Benrinnes 13 Year Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Distilled 2008 and aged in Ex Bourbon Hogshead.

On the nose Vanilla custard pastries with an underlying cereal note. Medium mouthfeel with notes of thick cut lemon and orange marmalade.

title: Collective Arts Mediterranean Gin
bodyHtml:
Herbal and fresh, this Mediterranean Gin is like an overgrown seaside garden. Refreshing cucumber character combines with thyme, rosemary and basil, while a hint of cardamom delivers a clean, slightly earthy, finish.⁠

Botanicals: Juniper, Coriander, Thyme, Rosemary, Lemon Peel, Basil, Green Cardamom, & Cucumber.

title: Collective Arts Lavender & Juniper Gin
bodyHtml:
Beautifully blue, this Lavender & Juniper Gin is blended with unique herbs, heather, lavender and chamomile. With just a touch of bergamot and sweet almond, this gin finishes dry on the palate.

Botanicals: Juniper, Coriander, Lavender, Heather, Chamomile, Almond, Orris Root & Bergamot.

title: Elvis Straight Tennessee Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Elvis Presley was a man of many nicknames, including Tiger Man, the King of the Jungle. Some say it was his dad who first called him Tiger Man, some say it was a fan, either way the name was a perfect fit. Elvis first performed the song, Tiger Man in concert in Las Vegas in 1969 and continued playing it.

Gold in colour, with an aroma of toasted oak and sweet corn with a hint of citrus and apple. Flavour notes of sweet-toasted maple, roasted creme brulee, and subtle notes of a granny smith apple and caramel lead to a very balanced, long, soft, sweet and genuine great finish. Mash Bill: 80% Corn, 10% Rye, 10% Malted Barley.

title: Elvis Straight Tennessee Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Elvis Presley has long been hailed as the undisputed King of Rock & Roll. Beginning in 1954, his music, his style and his scandalous dance moves took the country by storm and continued to reign for decades influencing many other artists, including The Beatles.

“Nothing affected me until I heard Elvis. Without Elvis, there would be no Beatles”. ~ John Lennon

Soft amber in colour, with an aroma of sweet rye grassiness upfront, followed by hints of citrus and apple. Flavour notes of toasted oak, butterscotch, vanilla wafers and a soft hint of pepper lead to a beautiful, sweet, complex finish with creamy mouth feel. Mash Bill: 95% Rye, 5% Malted Barley. Elvis Rye is sourced and blended by an expert team of industry veterans and bottled in Tennessee, where Elvis began his career and called home. 90 Proof.

title: Chateau Grand Puy Lacoste 2019
bodyHtml:
96 Points - James Suckling

This is a very polished young wine with lemon-rind, blackcurrant, cedar and lavender character. It’s full, yet so refined and sophisticated, with floral undertones to the pretty fruit. The tannins are intense and prolonged. Give this at least five or six years to soften. Try after 2025.

title: Kaiyo 7 Year Old Mizunara Oak Finish Whisky
bodyHtml:
Kaiyo 7 Year Old "The Single" is an intriguing Japanese malt whisky that blends traditional craftsmanship with a unique "ocean maturation" process. The spirit is distilled on a Coffey still in Japan and aged for seven years in first-fill bourbon barrels. The defining characteristic of the Kaiyo brand is its final maturation stage: the casks are loaded onto a ship for a three-to-six-month voyage. The constant motion of the ocean and changes in air pressure are intended to accelerate the interaction between the whisky and the rare Mizunara oak (Japanese oak) casks used for the finish.

Spirit Description

This whisky presents a pale, straw-like gold appearance. The nose is exceptionally fragrant and typical of Mizunara influence, offering aromas of sandalwood, incense, and fresh tropical fruits like pineapple and melon, followed by a hint of grapefruit and green apple. On the palate, the texture is silky and medium-bodied, delivering flavors of honey, vanilla fudge, and coconut, which transition into a savory and spicy mid-palate featuring long pepper and ginger. The finish is medium-long and aromatic, characterized by fading spices, tangy orange, and a touch of sea spray. It is bottled at 48% ABV.

Food Pairing

The delicate, floral, and spicy notes of Kaiyo 7 Year make it a sophisticated partner for a variety of cuisines. It pairs beautifully with creamy desserts such as crème brûlée or a coconut panna cotta, which mirror the vanilla and tropical fruit notes of the spirit. For a savory option, try it with black cod miso or roasted pork belly; the Mizunara spice helps cut through the richness of the fat. Its "sea-aged" character also makes it a rare whisky that can stand up to pickled ginger or light, citrusy seafood dishes like scallop crudo.

title: Chateau Chasse Spleen Blanc 2021
bodyHtml:
The nose is fresh, fruity, and precise and offers a small concentration. It reveals notes of peach, pear and small notes of quince associated with touches of honeysuckle, a racy minerality as well as hints of celery, lemon, very discreet hints of lemon flowers and sweet spices.

The palate is fruity, well-balanced, full of precision/finesse and a beautiful finesse of the fat, suavity as well as energy/dynamism, and tension. On the palate, this wine expresses notes of lemon, small notes of quince associated with touches of peach flowers, verbena, and honeysuckle as well as a discreet hint of anise seed, a racy minerality and toasted oak.

title: Vouette et Sorbee Cuvee Blanc d'Argile Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut (NV)
bodyHtml: Mainly from a small parcel of Chardonnay in Briaunes supplemented with scattered plantings of Chardonnay in Bertrand’s other lieux-dits. Small in volume now, it will increase when the young vines in Vouette begin to come online. Mineral, nougat, salty and long –  basically a Grand Cru Chablis with bubbles.

title: Domaine Zind Humbrecht Gewurztraminer 'Roche Calcaire' 2020
bodyHtml: Clear pale citrus yellow colour. The wine displays classic citrus aromas (pink grapefruit, exotic fruits) and a complex spicy character. The delicate palate, and lovely sweetness, are perfectly balanced by the acidity and structure of the wine, which is quite remarkable. With some time, the wine develops smoky characteristics. The palate is long, intense and seems never to finish.

title: Robert Mondavi Pinot Noir Napa Valley 2019
bodyHtml: Aromas of red berries with toasty cinnamon and nutmeg, warming thyme and rose. Beautiful raspberry, plum, and red cherry, with dark, earthy notes on the palate. Juicy and playful at first, then increasingly brooding with lovely depth.

title: Matchbook Cabernet Sauvignon Red Gravel 2022
