bodyHtml: Matchbook Cabernet Sauvignon opens with classic Cabernet aromas of saddle leather, cigar box and a touch of earthy eucalyptus. Sumptuous flavours of blackberry, boysenberry, huckleberry and mocha are framed by sweet oak and vanilla from barrel aging. Fine-grained, dusty tannins add a plush structure to the finish.

title: Morgan Bay Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Experience the invigorating taste of Morgan's Bay Chardonnay. Enjoy the vivid and lively flavours of green apple and melon, balanced by a smooth and creamy texture. The clean and refreshing aftertaste will certainly leave you satisfied.

title: Chateau Pindefleurs 2020
bodyHtml: Seamless and charming, the 2019 Pindefleurs bursts with aromas of cherries and sweet berries, framed by a deft touch of new oak. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and supple, it's generous and nicely balanced.

title: Chateau Lassegue 2020
bodyHtml: Lassegue is the essence of opulent ripe, and rich Cabernet Franc, a wine of great elegance and finesse. Adding dense Merlot and a touch of Cabernet Sauvignon adds softness and roundness to the wine. With a voluptuous, layered and complex structure, the wine shows an accomplished character, reflecting the limestone and clay of the hillsides.

title: Robert Biale Zinfandel Party Line 2022
bodyHtml:
Party Line is a throwback to the old days of Zinfandel when California’s wine-growing families made wine for everyday consumption. The Biale Party Line Zinfandel is a fun and light-hearted red wine that is made to enjoy now. Layered with aromatics of dusty strawberries, red licorice, black cherries and raspberry taffy. The entry is soft and weighty with succulent mid-palate tannins that make for a long and juicy finish.

Perfecting the old California classics, Robert Biale Vineyards has become a revered standard of heritage Vineyard Zinfandel and Petite Sirah in Napa Valley. Napa natives, school chums, and winery founders Bob Biale and Dave Pramuk cherish the tradition of historic old vines (some dating to the 1880s!) and prize the small quantity of concentrated and intense fruit that they produce.

title: Chateau Moulin Saint Georges 2019
bodyHtml:
94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 has turned out brilliantly, offering up aromas of cherries, wild berries, violets, sweet spices and raw cocoa, followed by a medium to full-bodied, bright and vibrant palate with a concentrated core of fruit, tangy acids and beautifully refined tannins. From a seven-hectare, west-facing vineyard opposite Ausone that always ripens some ten days later than Ausone itself, it has come into its own in this warm, dry vintage, delivering a wine of considerable energy and finesse.

title: Chateau Haut Bages Liberal 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Bordeaux region and prestigious Pauillac subregion, Chateau Haut Bages Liberal is a Fifth Growth estate with a rich history dating back to the 18th century. Under the visionary ownership of Claire Villars-Lurton, the estate has become a pioneer in sustainable viticulture, featuring fully certified organic and biodynamic farming. The vineyard's unique terroir, composed of deep gravel over limestone, plays a vital role in imparting exceptional elegance, minerality, and structural purity to the winemaking philosophy.

Wine Description

Chateau Haut Bages Liberal presents a striking, deep ruby-purple colour with vibrant rim reflections. On the nose, it releases expressively complex aromas of cassis, dark berries, and red plum lifted by floral violets, graphite, pencil shavings, and subtle tobacco hints. The palate is medium- to full-bodied, suave, and fleshy, displaying remarkable energy balanced by chalky, powdery tannins and a lively core of mineral acidity. Aged across French oak barrels, concrete ovals, and terracotta amphorae, this vintage achieves an exquisite balance of freshness, tension, and depth, leading to a long, precise finish.

title: Remelluri 'Granja Remelluri' Gran Reserva Rioja 2012
bodyHtml:
96 Points - James Suckling

The DNA of Remelluri is here. Wild mountain herb character, structured and firm, these tannins are succulent and deeply expressive. Powerful and assertive red plums, wild cherries and roasting herbs with the oak sitting well. Power and balance. Try from 2021.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A blend of Tempranillo, Garnacha and Graciano, the 2012 Granja Remelluri Gran Reserva represents what they are aiming for with this wine, a classical expression of the place, the quintessence of the vineyards. The select their oldest vineyards and age the wine for a long time, coming back to those early years of a modern Rioja that has now turned into a classic. It has some dusty tannins, with good grip and length. It was bottled in 24,238 bottles after an élevage of 26 months. It has been in bottle since May 2015.

title: Xavier Gerard Condrieu Cote Chatillon 2022
bodyHtml:
From the estate’s finest holding, situated in the middle of the slope overlooking the Rhone, this cuvee from the famed “Cote Chatillon” lieu-dit has long been the flagship Condrieu of Domaine Gerard. 

After fermentation in cuve, the wine spends one year in a mix of 500L and 225L barrels, the vast majority of which are old. The richness of the fruit is placed in balance by bright acidity, in a masterfully-controlled wine. A liveliness and notes of spice carry through the pleasing finish.

title: JP Chenet Brandy XO
bodyHtml: A beautiful golden amber colour. Complex, warm, subtly woody flavours with a very smooth palate.

title: Protea Merlot 2022
bodyHtml:
The Protea Merlot originates from the Western Cape region of South Africa. This range is produced by the prestigious Anthonij Rupert Wyne, an estate committed to the spirit of sustainability and the conservation of its terroir. The winery prioritizes high-quality winemaking while ensuring environmental impact is reduced through upcycling initiatives, such as their distinctive, reusable bottle patterns.

Wine Description

This wine presents a vibrant sensory profile with deep aromas of black cherry, plum, and subtle hints of dark chocolate and tomato plant. On the palate, it is soft and succulent, featuring flavors of mulberry, Agen prune, and light spice highlights like cinnamon and nutmeg. It is a medium-bodied wine with a velvety smooth texture, well-integrated tannins, and a rewarding finish that displays notes of cocoa and earth.

title: Pusser's 15 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml: In late 2018, Pusser's relaunched it's fantastic 15 Year Old Navy Rum with a shiny new bottle to match! Previously this was made with a blend of rums from Trinidad and Guyana, though this newer edition is made exclusively with rum from Guyana aged for at least 15 years and bottled at 40% ABV. The name harks back to the days when sailors in the British Navy would be given a daily ration of rum (a tot, as it was affectionately known) by the ship's purser.

title: The Prisoner Wine Co. - Prisoner Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from the United States, primarily sourced from the Carneros district of California. The Prisoner Wine Company was established in 2000 by winemaker Dave Phinney and has been owned by Constellation Brands since 2016. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a collaborative approach, where the winemaking team works with a family of over 100 growers to source fruit from premier vineyards throughout California to create interesting blends of distinct character.

Wine Description

The Prisoner Chardonnay displays a medium yellow straw hue. The nose is aromatic and complex, offering scents of vanilla, apple pie, and pineapple, complemented by floral notes of honeysuckle and jasmine. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and layered, delivering concentrated flavours of baked apple, crème brûlée, and ripe pineapple integrated with toasted oak. It is characterized by its smooth texture, vibrant acidity, and a long finish that reveals grace notes of spices and buttery shortbread. This wine is predominantly Chardonnay, often featuring splashes of other varieties such as Viognier and Gewürztraminer.

title: Redstone Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine is from Canada, produced in the Niagara Peninsula region of Ontario. Redstone Winery was established in 2009 by Moray Tawse and is named for the specific red clay soil and large stones found throughout the 38-acre estate. The winery's philosophy focuses on capturing the precision of its terroir, particularly from the Limestone Vineyard in the Twenty Mile Bench subregion.

Wine Description

The Redstone Chardonnay displays a bright straw or light golden colour. The nose is delicate and pretty, featuring aromas of red apple, pear, and white blossoms (such as jasmine) with sweet hints of vanilla, caramel, and honey. On the palate, it is medium bodied and dry, offering a lush texture with flavours of orchard fruits, lemon curd, and baking spice. It is characterized by its vibrant acidity, well-integrated French oak, and a long, crisp mineral finish. This 100% Chardonnay typically has an ABV of 12% to 13% and is often aged for 12 months in a mix of new and seasoned French oak.

title: Hwayo X. Premium Rice Whisky - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Hwayo X. Premium is an ultra-premium rice whisky produced by the Hwayo Distillery in the Yeoju region of South Korea. Launched as part of the Kwangjuyo Group—a renowned ceramic arts company—Hwayo was created in 2003 to modernize the 700-year-old tradition of Korean soju. This "X. Premium" expression is crafted from 100% locally grown Korean Japonica rice and pure bedrock water from deep underground aquifers. It represents a significant evolution in Korean spirits, being the first spirit from the country to be marketed internationally as a single grain rice whisky, bridging the gap between traditional soju and aged Western spirits.

Spirit Description

This whisky presents a bright, polished amber colour. On the nose, it is highly aromatic and fruity, with distinct notes of vanilla, banana, and tinned peaches, balanced by a subtle herbal freshness of lemongrass and mint. The palate is rich, rounded, and remarkably smooth, delivering flavours of buttery caramel, brown sugar, and toasted grains, alongside a creamy hint of coconut. The finish is long and sophisticated, marked by lingering notes of blackcurrant, refined oak, and a delicate spicy warmth. It is single-distilled using a vacuum process at low temperatures to preserve the delicate rice esters, aged for five years in American oak barrels (ex-bourbon and virgin), and finished for six months in traditional Korean "onggi" (porous earthenware pots). It is bottled at 41% ABV.

title: Old Potrero 6 Year Old Straight Rye
bodyHtml:
Old Potrero is a bit of an iconic brand, it was a micro distillery opened out of the Anchor brewery in 1993! So, they were a bit ahead of the times.

Rich, spicy, fruity with loads of complexity on the nose. A dry spiciness comes through in the whisky. All the sweet dried fruit almost has you thinking “brandy”. Lots of caramel, dried fruit, oak, maple syrup, fennel, and intense sweet spices toward the finish which ride on waves of oak. The whisky has a good sense of “umami” to it, not in the salty savoury sense, but in the rich character that binds together all of its parts. The whisky develops great richness in the glass.

title: Stellum Bourbon
vendor: 300840 - Top Of My Glass Holdings Inc.
bodyHtml:
Stellum Bourbon finds its flavor in the tension of three Indiana Bourbon mash bills, two of which are high-rye, with the third being almost exclusively corn. Older barrels from both Kentucky and Tennessee are folded in slowly, through a multi-step blending process. This brings added layers of depth and complexity, ultimately allowing us to round out a uniquely Stellum flavor profile.

Appearance Amber gold.

Nose Intense clove and allspice immediately jump out of the glass, supported by creamy macadamia nuts and light tobacco. As the whiskey opens up, sweet aromas of honeysuckle, green apple, and nectarine begin to show, rounded off by toasted rye and oak.

Palate The tip of your tongue is met with a hint of vanilla, marshmallow, and cotton candy. The whiskey quickly transforms as it spreads across your tongue, revealing spicy notes of black pepper, cayenne pepper, and cinnamon baked apples. The spice is supported by tart underripe blackberry and apricot that contrasts perfectly against the initial sweetness.

Finish The spiciness of the palate carries over into the finish with candied ginger and more black pepper before slowly fading into a syrupy sweet honey. 

With the Addition of Water The strong pepper notes are more subdued, allowing for sweet cinnamon streusel and stewed apples to come to the forefront of the palate.

title: Stellum Rye
bodyHtml:
The identity of Stellum Rye is rooted in a tried and true 95% Rye Indiana mash bill. They incorporate more barley-forward rye and choice barrels from Kentucky and Tennessee to enhance this classic style. This brings a full, round mouthfeel and flashes of buttery sweetness to a spicy and tightly focused Rye Whiskey.

Appearance... Deep copper.

Nose... Stewed apples, peaches, and pears dominate the initial nose, along with an undertone of baking spices. Nutmeg and clove provide a counterbalance to the sweet fruits, while a light mint and licorice note brings further depth to the aroma.

Palate... Aniseed, cardamom, and coriander wake up your palate with an intense spice punch. Notes of lemon peel and tangerine from the rye grain provide an excellent citrus component to the overall spiciness. As the whiskey breathes in the glass, fresh green apples and spearmint arise, which offers just enough of a sweet component to engage all your taste buds.

Finish... Star anise, white pepper, and mint linger on the palate before fading into a honey-sweetened jasmine green tea.

With the Addition of Water... The citrus notes on the palate become more pronounced with candied lemon and orange peels, all supported by a simple mint syrup like you would find in a derby julep.

title: La Haubette Sancerre 2023
bodyHtml: This Sancerre is the result of a careful selection of the best terroirs of limestone in the Sancerre appellation. Intense aromas of exotic and white fruits, combined with great freshness in the mouth, make this wine ideal for an aperitif and as an accompaniment to seafood and fish.

title: Saigon Baigur Dry Gin
bodyHtml: Saigon Baigur is the first premium dry gin to be distilled in Ho Chi Minh City. It is a most extraordinary gin featuring fresh buddha's hand and vapour-infused lotus flower. 12 distinctive local botanicals combined with 4 classic gin ingredients present a drink that is a Vietnamese take on the classic dry gin. The unique combination of locally sourced botanicals gives Saigon Baigur a fresh and vibrant taste, inspired by the city it is distilled in. An adventurous and exciting gin.

title: Isle Of Wight Mermaid Gin
bodyHtml: Mermaid Gin at 42% ABV has been hand-crafted on the Isle of Wight since 2014 using ten ethically sourced botanicals. Presented in a stunning eco-friendly bottle, it is a smooth yet complex blend of fresh organic lemon zest, the peppery notes in grains of paradise and a hint of sea air from fragrant rock samphire. Refreshing and invigorating.

title: Angeline Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Angeline Vineyards’ Pinot takes advantage of California’s diverse growing conditions. Sourcing is not relegated to a single county or growing region, but rather chosen from around the state, from the warmer regions of the Central coast and the Northern Coast’s cool, foggy valleys.

The quality of Angeline’s Pinot Noir consistently over-delivers. A lively garnet colour, it opens with intense aromas of fresh cranberries, Bing cherries, and orange zest. The palate is round and juicy with lively acidity and bright flavours of fresh strawberry, cherry, raspberry, and ripe plum layered with vanilla, earth, black tea, and toasted oak. It's a great match with portobello mushroom burgers and other easy-going fare.

title: La Soufrandiere Saint Veran Climat La Bonnode 2022
bodyHtml: Neighbor to “Combe Des Roches,” “La Bonnode” is a superb parcel of 2 hectares, facing east at the foot of the Roche de Vergisson. The vines are mostly bordered by old brush: a sheltered, isolated situation that allows them to biodynamically cultivate the vines with ease. Working in this parcel, they can see across the Saône Valley all the way to the Mont Blanc in the distance to the east.

title: Alpha Tango Vodka Mission Kosmos
bodyHtml:
Welcome to the Alpha Tango universe. The first distillery in the world to use cattail in spirits. They create exceptional & unique spirits that will satisfy connoisseurs and enthusiasts around the world.

The most perilous missions demand perfection and boldness: water in its purest form, filtered and originating from a millennial esker, Canadian wheat with character expressing the rigour of the seasons. A world of possibilities arises from this crystalline odyssey. They have mastered vodka, what will you conquer?

Mission Kosmos Vodka won a double gold medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition. The highest possible distinction at this prestigious competition, therefore, makes Mission Kosmos one of the best vodkas in the world and one of the very few Canadian vodkas to receive this award.

title: Artingstall's Brilliant London Dry Gin
bodyHtml: Designed by Hollywood luminary Paul Feig, Artingstall's Brilliant London Dry GIn is a perfectly-balanced gin for aficionados and casual consumers alike. Its eleven carefully chosen botanicals all synchronize to make it as unique, refined and entertaining as its creator.

title: Domaine Michel Gros Nuits Saint Georges 'Les Chialots' 2023
bodyHtml:
Domaine Michel Gros Nuits Saint Georges 'Les Chialots' 2023 originates from the historic Côte de Nuits subregion of Burgundy in France. Based in Vosne Romanée, this prestigious family-run estate spans eight hectares and is celebrated for its ancestral expertise and commitment to expressing authentic Burgundy terroirs. Today, Michel Gros and his son Pierre continue to uphold the family's multi-generational winemaking tradition, ensuring that each vintage maintains the finesse and character that have defined the domaine for decades.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir presents a deep, intense red colour with vibrant purple highlights. On the high-toned nose, complex aromas of black cherries and raspberries are complemented by notes of licorice, sweet leather, fresh earth, and a delicate touch of vanilla and clove from well-integrated oak. The palate is medium-bodied and elegant, exhibiting a rich, toasty entry with fine, structured tannins and a balanced freshness that carries into a complex, persistent finish. Composed of 100% Pinot Noir, this single-parcel village wine offers an optimal drinking window of eight to ten years.

title: Chateau Ferran Rouge 2021
bodyHtml: Ruby red colour still in its youth, with some violet notes, of good intensity, clear and brilliant, beautiful aspect. A pleasant, fresh first nose, with a basket of red and black berries such as raspberry, strawberry, blackberry and cherry flesh, followed by notes of spices and a discreet touch of pepper. Mouth with a round and perfumed attack.

title: The Wild North Canadian Rye Whisky
bodyHtml: The Wild North originates from a judicious blend of 5 and 7-year-old whisky batches. Station 22 has selected the best ingredients the Great Canadian North can produce, spring water from Northern Quebec and barrels of white oak grown in North American forests. It takes as much passion and conviction to clear an unknown land as it takes to make a genuinely Canadian whisky.

title: Severo Plata Tequila
bodyHtml:
Severo Plata is a piercing crystalline, bold and flavorful tequila. Small-batch, hand-crafted, hand-numbered 100% Blue Weber Agave tequila. 6 months rested in Stainless Steel. Carefully guarded family recipe dating back nearly 100 years.

The nose exhibits deep aromas of simmering oats, framed by a striking citrus and floral background that leads to punches of grapefruit and licorice. The palate offers a creamy mouthfeel enhanced by pronounced, agave-forward acidity, followed by a lingering minerality in the long finish.

title: Mi Familia Reposado
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Mi Familia Flores Reposado is a premium tequila crafted in the heart of Jalisco, Mexico, where the Flores family has dedicated generations to the art of spirit production. Distilled at Tequilera de la Barranca de Amatitán (NOM 1473), the brand emphasizes traditional Mexican craftsmanship and a deep respect for heritage. The distillery's philosophy centers on creating a 'taste of tradition' by harvesting 100% blue weber agave at peak ripeness to ensure a balanced and authentic expression.

Spirit Description

This reposado represents a refined harmony between the vibrant character of mountain-grown agave and the subtle influence of wood aging.

  • Color: The spirit possesses a gentle golden hue with brilliant clarity, earned through its time spent resting in oak.

  • Aroma: The nose is captivating and sophisticated, led by primary notes of cooked agave and complemented by nuances of French oak. Enticing scents of vanilla, caramel, and honey emerge alongside soft floral tones and a touch of citrus.

  • Palate: It offers a smooth, slightly creamy mouthfeel with a rich foundation of cooked agave. Flavors of toasted oak and medium-roasted characters integrate with sweet butterscotch, cinnamon, and subtle hints of apple.

  • Finish: The finish is clean and ultra-smooth, leaving a warm sensation with lingering notes of sweet agave, vanilla, and a light peppery spice.

Aged in American oak barrels for a period typically ranging from two to six months, this tequila is bottled at 40% ABV. Its stylistic balance makes it versatile enough to be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as a premium base for cocktails.

title: Louis Latour Marsannay Blanc 2017
bodyHtml:
Maison Louis Latour is one of the most highly-respected négociant-éléveurs in Burgundy. Maison Louis Latour is the producer of some of the finest Burgundian wines but has also pioneered the production of fine wines from outside of the confines of Burgundy.

Bright and fresh white-peach and citrusy nuances here. This has great freshness. The palate delivers a very fresh, crisp and citrusy thread with great tension. Drink now.

title: Louis Latour Bourgogne Gamay 2024
bodyHtml: This wine has a bright ruby hue. The nose displays red berries and floral notes. Ample and fresh on the palate with cherry and spice aromas. This wine shows nice tannins on the finish.

title: Zaya Alta Fuerza Rum
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
An overproof rum whose flavor easily stands out in a cocktail, with a taste profile that’s ideal for sipping or enjoying over the rocks.

Aroma Intense aromatic spices; notes of maple & brown sugar

Flavor Strong spice, buttery maple & brown sugar sweetness

Color Deep brown with a hint of red

Finish Long & full-bodied with a touch of heat

title: Chateau Doisy Daene Blanc Sec 2019
bodyHtml:
Denis Dubourdieu was Bordeaux. Born in Barsac into a winemaking family, the late enologist put his stamp on the region as a professor at the University of Bordeaux, a consultant to the First Growths, a mentor to myriad winemakers, and a château owner and nowhere does his legacy live on like it does at Château Doisy-Daëne. Crafted by Dubourdieu’s sons, the 2019 Château Doisy-Daëne is a picture of Bordeaux Blanc purity that should be on the radar of all white-wine lovers. Grown on 50-year-old vines planted on a dedicated parcel, this singular wine shows exactly why Decanter said: “This is a family that knows exactly how to handle this grape.” 

Although now a common practice among Sauternes and Barsac producers, Doisy-Daëne was among the first to produce a dry white from the commune. Dubourdieu had been perfecting its formula with every vintage, no surprise, considering that Decanter once wrote that “Dubourdieu is to Bordeaux’s white wines what Michel Rolland is to its reds.” 

93 Points - Wine Spectator

The bright finish is laced with heather and honeysuckle, featuring nice underlying acidity that helps set it apart from the pack. Drink now through 2035. 

Pale gold in colour, reflecting a youthful green hue. Bold aromas of lemon, lemon curd, green apple, lemon zest, and honeysuckle stride confidently from the glass when swirling, joined by notions of toasted oak, yellow flowers, and allspice. The mouthwatering sharpness of citrus and green apple flavor on entry is tamed by a counterbalancing roundness of baking spice and vanilla notes, creating intricate, electrifying layers of texture. Hints of wild herbs, toast, and a crunchy minerality add to the complexity, and the wine finishes long and with power. Beautiful now for its youthful zeal, it will develop a weightier, richer, rounder mouthfeel and marzipan nuttiness after a few years in the cellar. Drink now–2029.

title: Cooperstown Select Blended Whiskey
bodyHtml: This unique American blended whiskey is made entirely from local New York State grains and patiently aged in hand-picked oak barrels. Made of nothing but 100% American whiskey, it is subtly matured and expertly blended to perfection. It is finished with French Oak for up to a year, conveying a very soft and graceful whiskey. Enjoy it neat or on the rocks for a truly unique sipping experience!

title: Cooperstown Select Straight Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml: This distinguished straight rye whiskey is hand-crafted from rye and other grains 100% locally grown in New York State. Aged two to three years, this rye begins its journey in new American oak barrels and is then finished for at least one year in used Cabernet Sauvignon barrels. Notably bottled at cask strength, this impressive rye is incredibly complex and compares favourably to even the most prestigious names in the category.

title: Cooperstown Select Single Malt Whiskey
bodyHtml: Made from 100% local New York malted barley, our single malt ages a minimum of two years in new American oak barrels before finishing in ex-sherry casks for six months. With rich notes of praline, candied apple, and burnt almond on the finish, this exceptional single malt rivals some of the finest Scotch whiskeys.

title: Chateau Montviel 2019
bodyHtml:
95 Points - James Suckling
This is a full-bodied and very rich Pomerol with loads of ripe-berry and chocolate character. Rich, velvety tannins and a long, muscular finish. Old style that makes me think of Pomerols from the 1950s.

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck
The 2019 Château Montviel is beautiful, with a pure, precise, incredibly elegant style as well as medium-bodied aromas and flavours of black and blue fruits, damp earth, and spring flowers. It shows the seamless, balanced style of the vintage in Pomerol nicely and will keep for 15+ years.

92 Points - Wine Spectator
Shows the ripe and warm feel of the vintage, with cassis, plum puree and blackberry compote notes, carried by a refined and silky structure and laced with subtle anise and black tea on the finish. Nicely done. Merlot and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2023 through 2036.

title: Cachaca 51
bodyHtml: The Cachaça 51, the most drunk of the whole Brazil, is produced by more than forty years, from the historic and famous distillery, Pirassununga, a fazenda, which, alone, produces in its 4,000 acres of land, more than 350,000 tons of sugar cane per year.You can enjoy smooth, alternating with layers of orange slices, but is simply perfect for the preparation of the Caipirinha.

title: Giffard Cachaca Thoquino Dark 2 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Cachaça Thoquino is an “Aguardente de cana”, created by fermentation and then distillation of the fresh sugar cane juice exclusively.

The Thoquino Cachaça 2 years, amber colored, has aged for two years in Jetiquibà casks (special Brazilian wood).

title: Hendrick's Neptunia Gin
bodyHtml:
The sea is everything! Invigorated by a bracing breath of fresh coastal air and entranced by the endless living mysteries of the sea, Ms. Lesley Gracie considered a bold possibility: She longed to express the glorious sensory delights of the coast, as a gin. And so began Neptunia Gin.

A limited release that captures the magic of the sea, in a gin. Master Distiller Ms. Lesley Gracie's creation is as refreshing as her muse, the mighty waves that lash the Ayrshire coast. Infused with an exquisite blend of locally sourced coastal botanicals and with a remarkable smooth citrus finish.

Hendrick's proudly supports Project Seagrass, an environmental charity devoted to the conservation and restoration of seagrass ecosystems. Their mission is to lead societal change to enable the global recovery of seagrass ecosystems which provide biodiversity, food security, and long term carbon storage.

title: North Star Secret Speyside 10 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml: Difficult to guess where this secret Speyside originated from, especially when it's drawn from an Oloroso cask. Expect hints of apricot, stewed apple, sugar coated pastries, butter and raisins. Non chill filtered.

title: Don Julio 1942 'Ultima Reserva'
bodyHtml:
Don Julio is one of Mexico’s most iconic Tequila producers. Since its founding by Don Julio González in 1942, the company has earned a reputation both for the quality of its Tequila and for its record of innovation. It was among the first producers to release an Añejo Tequila and was the first to release a clear Añejo Tequila, ushering in the new category of Cristalino Tequila.
 
The company released its latest Tequila expression: Ultima Reserva. The Tequila is crafted from the last crop of agave planted by Don Julio and his family and was finished in Madeira casks using a Solera-like maturation process. This is the first time that Don Julio has finished a Tequila in a sweet wine cask.
 
Tequila Don Julio Ultima Reserva is rested in oak barrels previously used to age bourbon and finished in seasoned Madeira wine casks. The team of experts at Tequila Don Julio implemented a Solera aging method, which combines and matures tequilas of different characteristics, allowing Don Julio González and his family’s final agave harvest to remain at the heart of this rare tequila. The result is an exceptional spirit beautifully golden in colour that begins with a nose of toasted oak and caramel, follows with hints of apricot and orange, and finishes with deliciously smooth honeyed agave that is best enjoyed neat.

title: Don Julio Blanco - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Don Julio is a 100% Blue Weber Agave Tequila made from agave grown in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. As a highland tequila, one can expect the Don Julio to exhibit fruity solid citrus notes and to have a little hot pepper in the finish. It works well as a shooting tequila and makes really lovely cocktails.

title: North Star Glasgow 5 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml:
A 5-year-old single cask from the Glasgow distillery bottled by North Star as part of Cask Series 17.

This was distilled January 2016 and bottled March 2021 as a 5-year-old. Matured in a refill barrel that yielded 278 bottles at 51.5%.

title: Martin Ray Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: Sourced from various sought-after appellations, they choose premier vineyard locations throughout the valley with distinct variances in climate, elevation, and soil type. Classic, labor-intensive, small-lot winemaking techniques implemented. Four day cold-soak, hand punch downs for two weeks in open top fermenters. Aged in 45% new French oak for 12 months. Deep notes of black currant, and touches of elderberry and vanilla. Fresh cherry throughout, with graphite, mountain sage and supple, integrated tannins.

title: Noilly Prat Extra Dry Vermouth
bodyHtml:
14 different herbs and spices are sourced all around the world to make Noilly Prat Extra Dry. Among them Chamomile, Coriander from Morocco, Bitter Oranges from Tunisia or Orris Root from Italy.

Noilly Prat Extra Dry is ideal for preparing a 50:50 Martini Cocktail.

title: Paarl Five Star Brandy
bodyHtml: Even in todays cocktail centered world, a good brandy still spells out class. It is a subtle and warming spirit with bold nuances of flavor. The best way to savor its complexity is to first take a sip, swish it around in your mouth and swallow slowly. This smooth, versatile liquor is a worthy addition to your liquor cabinet, fit to enjoy on any occasion.

title: Malfy Con Arancia Gin
bodyHtml:
A colourful burst of Italian sunshine. If you're craving that fantastic feeling of sunshine, we have the taste for you. Italian oranges combined with a selection of ripe Sicilian blood oranges are blended with the finest botanicals and handpicked juniper to create a succulent and vibrant flavour.

Colour... Deep ruby red.

Aroma... Orange blossom with a background of juniper.

Flavour... Rich bittersweet citrus with a long finish. Deliciously complex!

title: Drumshanbo Gunpowder Sardinian Citrus Gin
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Through the years PJ Rigney has taken many journeys. From the rural wilds of Drumshanbo to the mountains of Macedonia, to the Eastern Province of Zhejiang, China, where each of 12 intriguing botanicals were added to PJ Rigney's secret tabernacle.During his travels, The Curious Mind came upon the rustic Sardinian country village of Siniscola. The local people introduced him to the ""Sa pompia"" or Citrus monstruosa. The result of this discovery is a novel expression of Drumshanbo Gunpowder Irish Gin with subtle hints of Sardinian Citrus.

Nose... Gunpowder tea with Oriental botanicals are complemented by bright notes of Sardinian Citrus.

Palate... Delightfully fresh and rounded up front with refreshing notes of juniper and spice, followed by a burst of Sardinian Citrus.

title: Stags' Leap Winery Merlot 2023
bodyHtml:
With freshness exhibiting its southern Napa origins, this Merlot leaps from the glass with layers of ripe black cherry, blackberry, and dark raspberry, alongside baking spice notes of cinnamon spice, vanilla, and creme brulee.

Savory, chaparral notes of lavender, bay laurel, mint and thyme accompany succulent tones of cherry kirsch and bittersweet chocolate. Hints of anise and hazelnut play on the palate, a nod to the delicately interwoven oak integration. Opulent and plush with mouthwatering acidity, polished structure, and finesse, all framed by present, mouth-coating tannins, finishing with layers and depth, showcasing the balance, elegance, and grace of this exemplary Merlot.

title: Chateau d'Esclans Les Clans Rose 2020
bodyHtml:
Epitomizing a sophisticated, food-driven wine made from Grenache and Rolle (Vermentino), Les Clans (entirely fermented and aged in large French oak barrels) represents a particular disconnect with rosé in general as it is pretty remarkable with the potential to age or, if tempted, to enjoy with great pleasure sooner rather than later. This wine is both rich and exotic while being full-bodied and elegant.

94 Points - James Suckling

Very perfumed with sliced strawberries, crushed stone, cement and some dried flowers. Medium body and a fine, linear palate with licorice and slate. Complex and subtle. Tight, lingering finish with peaches and cream. Drink or hold.

title: Chateau d'Esclans Whispering Angel Rose 2024 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Very pale apricot-pink colour. Delicate aromas of sliced apple, pink grapefruit, peach, cream and stones follow through to a medium body and crisp acidity. Deliciously creamy and smooth. Drink and enjoy.

title: Louis Roederer Cristal Brut 2014
bodyHtml:
Uncompromising quality. Champagne Louis Roederer was founded in 1776 in Reims, France and is one of the rare family-owned companies which the Roederer family still manages. In 1833, Louis Roederer inherited the company from his uncle and renamed the company his namesake. Under his leadership, the company rapidly grew while remaining true to its philosophy of uncompromising quality.

98 Points - Wine Spectator

This vivid Champagne has an upfront and linear definition, with finely meshed flavours of ripe black cherry and mandarin orange fruit, raw almond, anise and cardamom spice, and a touch of honeycomb which all unfurl and expand on the delicate, creamy palate. Sleek acidity continues through to the finish, with additional racy character provided by a streak of minerally saline and chalk, which gains momentum through the mid-palate and rings out on the well-cut, lasting finish. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. Drink now through 2040.

97 Points - James Suckling

An enlightened expression from a season of extremes, this has intensity, ripeness and depth of fruit underpinned by chalk soil-derived structure and freshness. Complex nose with lemon and grapefruit aromas, closed red apple, blood orange, light biscuit spices and toasted hazelnuts. Super fresh. The palate starts pithy and fleshy with pink grapefruit, blood orange, red apple, sliced strawberry and nectarine. It is 60% Pinot Noir and 40% Chardonnay, 32% oak fermentation in those same proportions, no chaptalization, no malolactic, and a 7g per litre dosage. From organically farmed grapes. It is very complex, it strikes a natural balance and is very drinkable already, though it will develop well for more than a decade in the cellar.

title: Chateau d'Esclans Garrus Rose 2020
bodyHtml: Considered Chateau d'Esclans' finest wine, Garrus is made from a single vineyard of nearly 100-year-old vines. Entirely fermented and aged in new sizeable French oak barrels, the powerful and elegant Garrus was at the heart of Sacha Lichine's vision in 2006 to make rose grand. Today Garrus is firmly established as a world-class, iconic luxury rose.

title: Tullamore Dew Irish Whiskey 'XO Caribbean Rum Cask Finish'
bodyHtml: XO rum casks deliver sweet tropical flavours. Bringing delicious caramel and banana notes with hints of dates and raisins. Barrels are carefully selected that previously used to age Demerara Rum to impart their distinctive tropical fruit flavours. Tullamore D.E.W. XO Caribbean Rum Cask Finish pays tribute to the role of Irish Immigrants in the development of rum in the Caribbean in the 17th Century. Irish heart and Caribbean soul.

title: The Gladstone Axe 'The Black Axe' Whisky
bodyHtml: Every Gladstone Axe Black Axe batch is made from 100% malted barley and aged in oak barrels. The Black Axe is made from a selection of malt whiskies from 14 different Highland and Islay malt Distilleries. A higher percentage of Islay whisky, which is smokier and spicier, separates the Black Axe from American Oak. Spicy and peaty, the Black Axe is made with a portion of Islay malt whisky. The marriage of these different whiskies makes for a delicious flavour profile that can be enjoyed by scotch lovers, both new and old.

title: Tobermory Gin
bodyHtml:
Tobermory Gin starts life as a blank canvas.  The base spirit used has been distilled over and over until it is just that.  Clean, fresh and ready to take on a colourful array of flavour.

All of the hand-picked botanicals including heather, Hebridean tea, juniper and sweet orange peel, are steeped for a minimum of 24 hours in our base spirit.  This is made up of blank canvas (Grain Neutral Spirit) and spirit from the Tobermory whisky stills.

Nose Notes of fresh juniper balanced with citrus and coriander notes, with a touch of maltiness.

Palate Fresh juniper balanced with sweet orange and lemon, hints of coriander, gentle herbs and spices, with a luxurious, creamy mouth-feel and a subtle hint of sweet malt.

Finish Long and lingering, fresh and citrus

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '23' Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 1.8 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Asahi Shuzo Dassai '23' Junmai Daiginjo is a world-renowned sake originating from the Yamaguchi prefecture in Japan. It is produced by Asahi Shuzo Co. Ltd., a brewery founded in 1948 that gained legendary status by focusing exclusively on the production of premium Junmai Daiginjo. The '23' in its name signifies an extravagant rice polishing ratio where each grain of Yamada Nishiki rice is milled down to just 23% of its original size—a meticulous 168-hour process that removes 77% of the grain to ensure unparalleled purity.

Description

This sake presents a pale and translucent appearance with a highly refined and complex sensory profile. The nose is intensely aromatic, featuring a bouquet of white flowers, cherry, strawberry, and ripe melon, with subtle hints of cotton candy and fresh cucumber. On the palate, it is incredibly balanced and silky, offering a honey-like sweetness and elegant layers of pear, banana, and panna cotta. The experience concludes with a long, graceful finish that carries a clean, dry character and a touch of tropical fruit. It has an alcohol by volume of 16% and is best served chilled to preserve its delicate aromatics.

Food Pairing

The ultra-refined nature of Dassai 23 makes it a perfect match for delicate and fresh dishes that do not overpower its subtle nuances. It pairs exquisitely with high-quality sushi and sashimi—particularly fatty tuna, scallops, and yellowtail—as well as fresh oysters and steamed seafood. Its bright acidity and honey-like notes also complement soft, creamy cheeses like brie or camembert and light pasta dishes with olive oil and garlic. For a sophisticated pairing, serve it alongside lightly grilled sea bass or a fresh caprese salad.

title: Buzzard's Roost Barrel Strength Rye
bodyHtml:
These most prized barrels are offered to you uncut, unfiltered, straight out of the barrel. Only a select few barrels will meet the criteria to be offered at Barrel Strength. It's no wonder this four-year-old whiskey won a Gold Medal at the 2021 San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

The story of Buzzard’s Roost started nearly two decades ago with one man’s goal to educate people about whiskey. From the opening of Bourbon’s Bistro, a bourbon-focused bar, to pioneering the idea of barrel selection for restaurants, Founder and Master Blender Jason Brauner has always been at the forefront of whiskey.

After taking part in more than a 100 barrel selections over his career, Jason created Buzzard’s Roost Sipping Whiskey, a Rye he designed with the bourbon drinker in mind.

title: Buzzard's Roost Peated Barrel Rye
bodyHtml: Aged in lightly charred oak barrels smoked with the finest peat logs imported from Scotland. Like many of Buzzard's other ryes, Peated Barrel has a proof of 105, and is aged for four years to ensure exceptional flavor that will leave a lasting impression.

title: Buzzard's Roost Toasted Barrel Rye
bodyHtml: 3 to 3 1/2 years old; finished in “proprietary proprietary barrels that feature custom toast profiles.” Sweet and winey on the nose, underneath that showcasing some brooding notes of cloves, asphalt, and a touch of almost acrid black pepper. The palate is distinctly youthful with raw granary character, but it’s filtered through some interesting elements that lift it up — brown butter, Christmas spice, brandied cherries.

title: Tor Palisades Grenache 2015
bodyHtml: There is no mistaking the 2015 Grenache as anything other than what it is. The colour is a classic dark ruby red. On the nose are tons of candied, ripe red fruits, damp earth, bright spices and roasted meats. On the palate, you will find more red fruits, licorice and dark fruit liqueur. This is very simply the best Grenache we have yet released.

title: Deau Cognac VSOP
bodyHtml:
Introducing the deep and mature Deau Collection VSOP Cognac, presented in a traditional tasting bottle. Distilled following traditional methods of Cognac savoir-faire, this Very Superior Old Pale Cognac is assembled with eaux-de-vie from the finest terroirs of the Cognac region, resting for in French oak before it reaches optimal maturity for blending. The VSOP is typically aged for at least 4 years, but some parts of the blend are usually older.

Distilled in the Moisans Distillery, it respects the traditional method of the Charentais still. The vineyards overlook the Charente River, and the distillery is home to 12 copper pot stills. They own over 2000 barrels of Cognac to select and blend. Their balance between time, elegance and the utmost care is part of their tribute to Louis Deau. This Deau Cognac VSOP from the Moisans Distillery comes from a mastered elaboration of eaux-de-vie, distilled according to the traditional method of the Charentais still, and crafted with Ugni Blanc grapes.

Eye: A flamed, golden colour.

Nose: Bouquet of elegant, floral, and rich leathery aromas.

Palate: Velvety and smooth. The finish brings hints of roasted almonds that lingers on the palate.

title: Hardy VSOP Cognac
bodyHtml: The Hardy style, where smoothness is king, within the reach of every Cognac connoisseur. Hardy VSOP charms the eye with its bronze colour and deep, attractive tints, and the nose with its fresh pear scents, leading into warmer walnut notes and spicy cinnamon hints. The flavours on the palate are quite simply perfectly balanced.

title: Alfred Giraud Harmonie French Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Alfred Giraud's Harmonie blends together three French malt whiskies from different distilleries. The whisky has been aged in both new French Limousin oak and American white oak casks which previously held XO Cognac, and after this ageing it's then blended with a fourth French malt, though this one is lightly peated. This final liquid goes back into the Cognac casks for further ageing, and then it's bottled at 46.1% ABV.

Nose: A hint of aromatic peat smoke surrounds apple blossom, baklava and toasty oak.

Palate: Tangy apple sweeties, silky peat smoke and plums, followed by apple pie and sultana.

Finish: Tannic wood and lingering nutty Cognac influence, with a whisper of smoke.

title: Citadelle Gin Jardin d'Ete
bodyHtml: Citadelle Jardin d’Été is their newest creation. Inspired by the garden at the Château de Bonbonnet, a little nature preserve where flowers, fruit and herbs flourish, this twist on their signature gin takes you on a delightful olfactory and gustatory ramble. You’ll encounter accents of Charentais melon, whole lemons and yuzu and orange zest. What could be more perfect for a refreshing gin & tonic?

title: Black Tower Pinot Noir Dornfelder 2024
bodyHtml: This blend of two lighter-bodied red grapes is a style you can enjoy slightly chilled. There are ripe aromas of crushed cherries, fresh strawberry, and plum. The mouthfeel is soft, with a gentle tannic structure, a hint of sweetness, and a dry finish. Perfect for casual pizza nights, or paired with steak salad.

title: Ginetic Dry Gin
bodyHtml:
Ginetic's complexity lies in the separate distillation of each botanical in their Charentais stills, after maceration of the ingredients in 40° neutral grain alcohol. They keep their marvelous recipe a secret from jealous types, but they will reveal some of the botanical treasures that give Ginetic its subtle notes of berries, herbs and spices: juniper, Jamaican pepper, lemon peel, Spanish coriander, angelica and cinchona bark. Its unique flavours will surely inspire mixology enthusiasts.

Ginetic Dry Gin expresses fresh citrus, with heavy notes of juniper on the nose, as well as rose, pepper, botanicals, cinnamon, and cedar. The palate is supple with an explosion of flavours and a spicy finish. Enjoy it in a long drink and let the bubbles enhance the discovery.

title: Glendalough 7 Year Old Mizunara Oak Finish Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
The Glendalough team went and finished some fabulous Irish single malt whiskey in casks made from Japanese Mizunara oak! This seven year old expression was first matured in American oak bourbon casks before being moved over to the Mizunara casks, which are rather rare indeed. It's a somewhat difficult wood to work with for coopers, but the result is a whiskey that offers up some glorious, fragrant, complex notes. Well worth the effort, we'd say!
 
Nose: Sandalwood, orange zest, vanilla pod, and milk chocolate.
 
Palate: Chocolatey notes continue, with toasted cinnamon and five-spice, plus juicy apricot and nectarine.
 
Finish: Flaky pastry, brown sugar, lemon peel, anise.

title: Patron Extra Anejo
bodyHtml:
Patrón Extra Añejo Tequila is a luxury aged spirit produced in the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the historic Hacienda Patrón in Atotonilco El Alto (NOM 1492), the brand represents one of the world's most recognized premium agave producers. Introduced as a permanent addition to the core Patrón portfolio in 2017, this expression highlights extended barrel maturation, aging for at least three full years to bridge the gap between classic highland agave sweetness and the complex depth of aged brown spirits.

Spirit Description

Patrón Extra Añejo is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agaves slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens. The agave piñas are extracted using a combination of a two-ton volcanic stone tahona wheel and modern roller mills, then fermented in pine wood vats and double-distilled in copper pot stills. The distillate is aged for a minimum of 3 years (36 months) in small oak barrels. Patrón utilizes a unique multi-barrel aging program—blending liquid matured in American oak, French oak (Allier and Limousin), and Hungarian oak barrels—to build complex layers of wood and spice while maintaining core agave character.

  • Colour: Deep warm amber with bright golden glints.

  • Aroma: Intensely aromatic and warm, opening with rich toffee, vanilla bean, and toasted oak, followed by dried fruit, light smoke, roasted agave, and warm baking spices.

  • Palate: Silky, lush, and velvety on the entry. Upfront flavors of butterscotch, honey, and vanilla blend smoothly into dark chocolate, caramelized stone fruits, cinnamon, and nutmeg.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a soft, round, and mouth-coating viscosity.

  • Finish: Long, warming, and elegant, trailing off with lingering toasted oak, subtle cocoa, dried fruit sweetness, and gentle spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof) in Patrón's signature hand-blown glass decanter topped with a solid cork enclosure.

title: Jura 21 Year Old Tide Single Malt
bodyHtml: Up there with the most popular distilleries to emerge from Scotland, and Jura may just have outdone themselves with this 21 year old malt. Tide is firstly matured in American ex bourbon casks, finished in virgin American white oak casks to give it a spicy character and hint of cracked pepper

title: Poli Segretario Di Stato Whisky
bodyHtml:
Whisky aged 5 years and finished in Amarone barrels.

Its aroma reminds of a bowl of toasted nuts, raisins, plums, chocolate and smoked spices.

title: Tomintoul 16 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Pure ingredients and the natural environment add to smooth and mellow character of our award-winning Tomintoul Speyside Glenlivet Single Malt Scotch Whisky, “the gentle dram”.

Multi-award winning Tomintoul Speyside Glenlivet Single Malt Scotch Whisky Aged 16 Years has been lovingly crafted, from a selection of the finest bourbon casks, each aged for at least sixteen years.

title: Paul John Classic Select Cask
bodyHtml:
Explore tropical Goa in every sip of the Select Cask Classic. The lush freshness of this Single Malt envelops you from the very beginning. To give you this experience, we’ve matured it in selectively chosen cask profiles and bottled it without chill filtration, at cask strength. Relish the tropical rush, Goan style.

Nose Fruity, malty aromas are intertwined with honey. A hint of bourbon teases your senses.

Palate With the very first sip, flavours of malted barley greet you. A heady mix of bourbon and manuka honey-liquorice makes for an attractive spine. And while you relish this experience, the unexpected flavour of toasted honeycomb takes you by surprise.

Finish This Single Malt has an absolutely elegant finish, with juicy Demerara tones ensuring a soft, friendly finish.

title: Mas De Sainte Croix Tendresse D'un Climat Cotes Du Rhone 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction
From France’s southern Rhône Valley, specifically the Valréas area within the Côtes du Rhône Villages appellation, Mas de Sainte Croix is a family-run winery situated on south- and southwest-facing hillsides and plateaus between Valréas and Vinsobres at altitudes of 350 to 400 metres. The clay-limestone soils, combined with the cooling influence of the Mistral wind and cooler nighttime temperatures, help preserve freshness in the grapes. The estate is dedicated to crafting wines that balance tradition with a modern sensibility, producing cuvées that reflect the unique character of their terroir.

Wine Description
A blend of approximately 60% Grenache and 40% Syrah, the 2022 vintage presents a deep ruby colour. The bouquet offers dark cherries, blackberries, and ripe plums alongside notes of sweet spice, licorice, leather, and hints of dried herbs such as thyme and bay leaf. The palate is medium-bodied, juicy, and velvety, with chalky yet supple tannins framing flavours of ripe black fruit, cocoa, and subtle floral tones. Freshness and ripe fruit are in perfect harmony, leading to a flavourful and lingering finish.

Food Pairing
An excellent match for grilled or rare red meats such as T-bone steak or lamb, as well as herb-seasoned roasts and game meats. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Peyrassol Mediterranee Rose 2025
bodyHtml: Beautiful pale pink with distinct bluish hues. This expressive blend opens immediately with notes of small red fruits carried on a savoury undertone of garrigue. There is a refreshing touch of greenness on the palate, which gives this fresh, lively wine a truly thirst-quenching character. An accessible blend in the true style of Provençal Rosé. Delicate with flavours of white fruit and a hint of minerality.

title: Red Shank Irish Whisky
bodyHtml:
Red Shank is a single-grain Irish Whisky from outside Dublin, Ireland. Triple-distilled for exceptional smoothness.

Cocktail Recipe - GINGER MIST

1 1/2 oz Red Shank Irish Whisky
King of Mixers Ginger Ale
Slice Lime
Garnish: Lime
Glass: Highball Glass

Add Red Shank to a hightail glass full of ice. Fill with ginger ale and garnish with a lime slice.

title: Bodegas Salentein Chardonnay Reserve 2022
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
From Los Arboles, Uco Valley, Mendoza. The Chardonnay grapes were sourced from Salentein's La Pampa estate, located 4,265 feet above sea level.

Bright yellow colour with green hues. Aromas of citrus fruit and white peach with a hint of floral notes. Soft and refreshing palate with fruity and mineral notes. An ideal match for fish, chicken, roasted pork, stuffed turkey and roasted vegetables.

title: Bacardi Spiced Rum
bodyHtml: Made with aged rum and with a hint of smokiness from charred American oak barrels, Bacardi Spiced is a gluten free rum blended with natural flavours and spices for a bold, yet smooth taste. Bacardi Spiced rum’s liquid has both light and deep notes, making it perfect for mixing spiced rum drinks.

title: Container Deposit(s) $0.10
bodyHtml: Container Deposit(s) $0.10

title: Kettle Valley Pinot Gris 2025 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
The Kettle Valley Pinot Gris hails from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, specifically sourced from premium vineyards along the Naramata Bench, Penticton, and Okanagan Falls. Founded in 1987 by Bob Ferguson and Tim Watts, Kettle Valley Winery was the third licensed winery on the Naramata Bench and remains a family-owned operation dedicated to small-lot, high-quality production.

Wine Description

This unique Pinot Gris is famous for its distinctive copper hue and lovely pink tint, a result of the skin contact during the winemaking process. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and full-bodied, featuring a rich mouthfeel and a spicy finish. On the nose and palate, it offers a complex array of classic red and green apples, pear, citrus, and tropical fruit notes. Composed of 100% Pinot Gris, this wine is celebrated for its excellent structure and balance, offering a stylistic blend of freshness and weight.

title: Marani 'Alazani Valley' Sweet Red
bodyHtml: Alazani Valley Red is a medium-sweet wine. This dark-pomegranate-coloured wine with a violet hue is produced from Saperavi grapes. The nose reveals fresh black fruit and prune notes. The taste is full, soft, and spicy with a remarkably long and well-balanced finish. Drink alone as an aperitif or pair with sweet desserts and cakes.

title: Bonterra Rose 2022
bodyHtml: This delicate Grenache-based blend conjures aromas of ruby red grapefruit, red cherry, and watermelon, framed by a palate of pomegranate, red berries, a hint of peach and a suggestion of cotton candy. This beautifully dry Rosé boasts elevated acidity and a crisp, lingering finish. Organically farmed and masterfully crafted, Bonterra Organic Vineyards epitomizes wines that are perfectly in tune with nature.

title: Drappier Carte d'Or Brut
bodyHtml:
The Carte d'Or cuvée is the very expression of the Drappier style. With its very high proportion of Pinot Noir, one is almost tasting a Blanc de Noirs. Champagne with a fine aromatic richness, it opens with aromas of stoned fruits such as white vineyard peach. A spicy hint announces a powerful complex palate. A vinous Champagne of lovely complexity with a characteristic note of quince jelly. Ideal as an aperitif. At the table, it goes with white meats, rolled fish fillets, and Chaource cheese.

Blend: 75% Pinot Noir, 15% Chardonnay, 10% Meunier

title: Anciano Old Vines Garnacha 2022
bodyHtml: The Garnacha vines are old, averaging 35 years of age, and are grown over chalk and clay soils at an altitude of 600-900m in a very dry environment. Low yields = big flavours, and it's evident here. Only fifteen percent of the wine is matured in American and French oak for 120 days before bottling. Intense raspberry, and black cherry tumbles onto the palate cleanly with a pronounced spicy undercurrent and a lick of dryness in the back end. Rustic and as ready to drink as it will be. It will be fine with richer foods like grilled lamb.

title: Ken Forrester Chenin Blanc The FMC 2025
Periquita Reserva 2021
bodyHtml: Periquita is an international reference for Portuguese wine. The Periquita Reserva is a wine that joins tradition with a modern vision. Intense ruby ​​colour has aromas of blackberries, cassis, mineral, figs, liqueur and pepper. It features a fruity taste, subtle, well-balanced acidity and soft tannins with medium final proof.

title: Vecchia Romagna Brandy
bodyHtml: A bottle of the famous Italian grape brandy Vecchia Romagna, one of Italy's best-selling spirits and a historic brand that's been around for a very long time. Vecchia Romagna is distilled from the Trebbiano grape, known as Ugni Blanc in France, where it is the base grape for almost all of the world's best Cognacs.

title: Gorgo Bardolino Chiaretto Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This rosé hails from Italy, specifically the Veneto region in the Bardolino DOC, close to the shores of Lake Garda. Azienda Agricola Gorgo, founded in 1975 by Roberto Bricolo and now managed by his daughter Roberta, is renowned for its commitment to organic practices and expressive terroir-driven wines. The estate’s philosophy emphasizes respect for nature and minimal intervention, resulting in wines that reflect the unique character of their vineyards.

Wine Description

The Gorgo Bardolino Chiaretto Rose dazzles with a delicate pale pink hue reminiscent of spring blossoms. The nose is charmingly fragrant, offering notes of wild strawberries, white peach, and subtle hints of rose petals. On the palate, it is light-bodied yet vibrant, with flavours of juicy red berries and citrus zest, supported by a lively acidity that imparts freshness and lift. The finish is clean and refreshing, with lingering traces of mineral nuance..

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with grilled shrimp skewers, Caprese salad, or lightly seasoned sushi. Its bright acidity and delicate fruit notes also complement charcuterie platters with prosciutto and fresh cheeses. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Scarpetta Barbera Del Monferrato 2023
bodyHtml: Scarpetta Barbera del Monferrato is a bright plum red colour. Aromas of crushed berries and plums intermix with aromas of earth and porcini mushrooms. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied with bright acidity and low tannins, yet wonderfully balanced. The high acidity and low tannins let this wine work with everything from a pizza or homemade pasta to a piece of beef or pork.

title: Casaretti La Nogara Bardolino Classico 2023
bodyHtml: La Nogara is bright ruby ​​red, intense, fruity and slightly vinous.  Full, fragrant and harmonious.

title: Louis Roederer Collection 243 Blend (NV) - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
As the House practices sustainable viticulture that respects the living environment in order to fully express the qualities of the terroir, it also anticipates future seasons while adapting to the present. An uninhibited and bold approach was the only way Champagne Louis Roederer could take its perpetual quest for excellence to the next level and create a worthy successor to Brut Premier.

94 Points - James Suckling

Dried-lemon, apricot, green-apple, salted-almond, walnut and light caramel notes. Vinous and layered, with small and tight bubbles. Excellent focus and intensity.

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

It is ripe and balanced, with yellow flowers, honeycomb, and plum, and it has elegant concentration and underlying tension, precise mousse, and rich salinity, with lingering notes of croissant and delicate smoke.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

92 Points - Wine Spectator

title: Elio Altare Barolo 2021
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Italy, specifically the Piedmont region within the Barolo DOCG. The estate was established in 1948 by Giuseppe Altare, but it was his son, Elio Altare, who became a legendary visionary by disrupting regional traditions in the 1970s. Inspired by a trip to Burgundy, Elio introduced innovative techniques such as short macerations, the use of rotary fermenters, and aging in small French barriques—a 'modernist' approach that famously led him to take a chainsaw to his father's traditional large casks. Today, the winery is managed by Elio and his daughter Silvia Altare, maintaining a philosophy of minimal intervention, organic farming, and a deep respect for the land's unique terroir.

Wine Description

The 2021 Barolo is a classic expression of 100% Nebbiolo. It presents a youthful deep red color with garnet reflections. The nose is highly expressive and fragrant, offering a bouquet of candied cherries, cranberries, pressed roses, and fresh herbs, which evolve into deeper notes of licorice, spice, and a hint of butter biscuit. Unlike many of Altare's single-vineyard crus, this 'classico' bottling was raised entirely in used French barriques for 24 months to prioritize fruit purity over new oak influence.

On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, juicy, and racy. It shows remarkable energy with a spine of ripe acidity and refined, silky tannins. Tasters note a charming pop of dark raspberry and salty mineral accents on a long, persistent finish. Stylistically, it is a racy and succulent wine that balances the house's signature intensity with the refined, elegant nature of the vintage. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is suggested from 2026 through 2041.

Accolades

  • 'Jeb Dunnuck - 94 points'

  • 'Vinous (Antonio Galloni) - 92 points'

  • 'Wine Advocate - 94 points'

title: Forty Creek Copper Pot Old Fashioned Kit
bodyHtml:
Create the Classic Old Fashioned cocktail at home with the Limited Forty Creek Copper Pot Old Fashioned Kit.

750ml Forty Creek Copper Pot – 43% ABV

1 Rocks Glass

Use ½ Oz Jolly Cocktail Syrup

Add 2 oz of Forty Creek Copper Pot and Ice

Stir and enjoy

title: Jack Daniel's Triple Mash Blended Whiskey
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Jack Daniel's Triple Mash is a Bottled-in-Bond whiskey, which must be distilled by a single distiller during a single distillation season, matured in a government-bonded warehouse for at least four years, and bottled at 100 proof.  Barrels are hand-selected for their characteristics of deeper colour, flavour, and aroma, which deliver a darker, richer, and more oak-forward character. It's a big, bold Tennessee Whiskey at 100 proof with layered notes of caramel, rich oak, and spice giving way to a pleasantly lingering finish.

title: Jack Daniel's Bonded Tennessee Whiskey - 700 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Jack Daniel's Bonded Tennessee Whiskey is a premium spirit from the United States, produced at the Jack Daniel Distillery in Lynchburg, Tennessee. Officially established in 1866 as the first registered distillery in the US, the brand is currently owned by the Brown-Forman Corporation. This expression is part of the permanent Bonded Series launched in May 2022, adhering to the strict Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897, which requires the whiskey to be the product of a single distillation season by a single distiller and aged for at least four years in a federally bonded warehouse.

Spirit Description

Crafted from the distillery's classic mash bill of 80% corn, 12% malted barley, and 8% rye, this whiskey undergoes the signature Lincoln County Process of charcoal mellowing through ten feet of sugar maple charcoal before maturation.

  • Colour: It displays a brilliant, deep amber hue, often darker than the standard Old No. 7 due to time in hand selected barrels.

  • Aroma: The nose is rich and intense, featuring aromas of caramel, vanilla, and toasted oak, alongside the trademark Jack Daniel's scent of banana and hints of maple sugar.

  • Palate: It offers a full bodied and bold palate with layers of sweet brown sugar, rich oak, and baking spices like cinnamon and nutmeg.

  • Body: The spirit possesses a robust and velvety texture, with its higher proof amplifying its overall depth and character.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, robust finish that balances lingering caramel sweetness with a wave of spicy heat and gentle smoky warmth.

  • ABV: Jack Daniel's Bonded is bottled at 50% (100 proof).

title: Louis Roederer Collection 242 Blend (NV)
bodyHtml:
DRIVEN BY A NEW AMBITION AND FREEDOM. WRITING THE NEXT CHAPTER OF ITS STORY WITH THE CREATION OF THE COLLECTION.

The Collection 242 blend is dominated by Chardonnay which was of exceptional quality in the 2017 vintage. This wine has aromas of ripe, sweet fruit and subtle oaky notes. The palate is rich and ripe with a luxurious texture that coats the palate. The Pinot Noir and Meunier grapes from the Vallée de la Marne complete the wine's broad, luscious, smooth and juicy character. The finish is energetic and fresh.

As the House practices sustainable viticulture that respects the living environment to express the qualities of the terroir fully, it also anticipates future seasons while adapting to the present. As such, an expressive and bold approach was the only way Champagne Louis Roederer could take its perpetual quest for excellence to the next level and create a worthy successor to Brut Premier.

title: Crystal Head Vodka Pride
bodyHtml: The Pride bottle contains the Crystal Head original blend, distilled 4 times from the highest quality, locally-sourced Canadian corn. Silky smooth with a hint of sweetness and vanilla. Filtered through Herkimer diamonds and blended with pristine Newfoundland water. This pure spirit is completely free from additives and made with pride.

title: Shin Premium Yuzu Wine - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Japan, Saitama Prefecture, Moroyama. Produced by Asahara Shuzo, a brewery founded in 1882 that has long been celebrated for cultivating the high quality Katsuragi yuzu since the Nara period. The brewery operates with a philosophy of maintaining deep ties to the local agricultural community and preserving the natural spiciness and fragrance of Japanese citrus in its products.

Description

This premium fruit wine possesses a vibrant, pale straw colour. The aroma is complex and intense, featuring a rare blend of lime, lemon, and grapefruit with distinct floral overtones. On the palate, it delivers a refreshing and tangy acidity balanced by the mellow sweetness of yuzu zest and notes of mandarin orange. The body is light and crisp, leading to a clean, citrus driven finish that is both elegant and zesty. ABV 8%.

Food Pairing

The tangy acidity and bright citrus profile make this wine an excellent accompaniment to fresh seafood, particularly sashimi, poached fish, and seafood pasta. It also serves as a delightful dessert wine when paired with vanilla cake or fruit based sweets like apple tarts. For a savory contrast, it can be served chilled or on the rocks alongside fresh garden salads and spicy Asian cuisine.

title: Crystal Head Vodka John Alexander Series
bodyHtml:
The limited-edition, hand-decorated, John Alexander art bottle was launched in 2018. John Alexander is one of the founders of Crystal Head Vodka and the designer of the iconic skull bottle. His work has been widely exhibited at institutions such as the Corcoran Gallery of Art and the Smithsonian American Art Museum, both in Washington, D.C., and the Museum of Fine Arts, in Houston. His work is proudly owned by numerous celebrities and musicians around the world. Known as a painter of environmentally conscious landscapes and satirical figurative work, this evocative design is derived from John Alexander’s expressive paintings. His 1988 oil on canvas painting "Dancing on the Waterlilies of Life" can be found at the Dallas Museum of Art and is celebrated in this exquisite artist bottle. It took three years working with a small artisanal workshop in Milan, Italy to create 25,000 beautiful collectibles. Each bottle decoration is hand applied and numbered, emphasizing its scarcity. This bottle decorated in John Alexander's painting is both a beautiful keepsake and a unique opportunity to own his art.

Crystal Head Vodka is crafted from locally sourced, Canadian corn. It is distilled four times into a neutral grain spirit and blended with pristine water from Newfoundland, Canada. The vodka is filtered seven times, of which three are through layers of semi-precious crystals known as Herkimer diamonds. Crystal Head Vodka offers a clean, clear and colourless spirit. On the nose, neutral grain aromas with a delicate touch of citrus. Silky smooth with a hint of sweetness and vanilla. Ending with a sweet, creamy finish.

title: Godet Pineau Des Charentes Blanc 5 Year
bodyHtml:
Pineau des Charentes is one of Cognac's specialities and the Godet Pineau Vieux XO is an outstanding example of the quality of this fortified wine style. The wine, which is consumed by locals both as an aperitif and after dinner, is made by mixing lightly fermented grape must with Cognac eaux-de-vie. This blend is then placed in oak barrels and often matured for several years. The assignation ‘vieux’ indicates a maturation period of over five years. The result is an intense concentration of sun-ripened fruits combined with the richness of the Cognac terroir, creating a wonderfully fruity, sweet and soft liqueur.

Founded in 1782, the House of Godet ranges amongst the oldest Cognac houses. The Godet family has been based in the seaside town and former trading hub La Rochelle for 400 years and since the very beginnings of Cognac production, they have played an important role in perfecting this culture. Cognac Godet has been in the hands of the same family for an astonishing 15 generations, who have placed tradition and excellence at the heart of their business. Godet is also one of the few Cognac producers who focus on cultivating and using the Folle Blanche grape variety, the original Cognac grape. The Godet family's expertise in wine-making results in outstanding wine and Pineau de Charentes as well as Cognac - an excellent standing for a family-run company. The business is headed by Godet president Jean-Jacques Godet, assisted by his three sons Jean Eduard, Maxime and Cyril.

Shown in a tall, elegant bottle, this expression is simplicity itself. The gold foil and subdued colors on the label perfectly accentuate the liquid contained inside. Like most Pineau de Charentes, this is best served chilled as an aperitif or in cocktails.

title: Moet & Chandon Brut Imperial
bodyHtml:
Moët Impérial is the House’s iconic champagne. Created in 1869, it embodies Moët & Chandon’s unique style, a style distinguished by its bright fruitiness, its seductive palate and its elegant maturity.

Golden straw yellow with green highlights. A sparkling bouquet. The vibrant intensity of green apple and citrus fruit. The freshness of mineral nuances and white flowers.

title: Riecine Chianti Classico 2019
bodyHtml:
The Riecine Chianti Classico is well above the cut for the price and value. Fruit forward with a seamless and refined texture, it’s serious Sangiovese upon pulling the cork. Not solely a one-trick pleasure pony, the wine has extra gears and demonstrates its versatility and depth with more aeration, if it can be resisted long enough. More classically savoury characteristics of Chianti Classico begin to unfold with time open in its youth and surely with more maturation in the cellar, and are supported with the acidic snap from its high altitude and endowed with a sappy red fruit core. This limestone and clay vineyard Chianti Classico is aged in large old oak barrels to further highlight its purity and high-toned frequency.

Antonio Galloni says: "The 2019 Chianti Classico is soft, supple and inviting, all of which make it a fine choice for drinking now and over the next few years. Bright acids perk up a core of red Sangiovese fruit, spice and crushed flowers. This fruity, forward Chianti Classico is nicely done."

title: Shinobu Mizunara Lightly Peated Pure Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
The Shinobu Distillery is located in the Japanese seaside region of Niigata on the country’s western coast. The area is famous for its “Three White Treasures”: snow, rice and sake which have been cultivated for centuries. Shinobu Pure Malt whiskies are crafted by master blender, Mr. Usami Ken who blends malts aged in sherry and bourbon hogshead casks before finishing them in precious Japanese Mizunara Oak. Famous for imparting rich, luscious flavors of apples, pears, cloves and nutmegs, Mizunara Oak has been used in Japan since the 1930s and is now sought-after by whisky makers around the world. The Shinobu Lightly Peated Pure Malt Whisky blends shows a robust and profound body structure, with smoky and toasty oaks flavors. All Shinobu whiskies are created without chill-filtration nor added color to protect and enhance their complex and robust character.

Nose Minty and creamy with some light peat and a touch of lemon. Hints of charcoal ash and smoke.

Palate Moderate peaty flavor on the palate, mingled with toasted oak, charcoal ash, dry grass and a hint of saltiness.

Finish Lingering taste of toasted wood with lots of sweetness from roasted malt.

title: Antica Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml: They create wines that are the ultimate expression of Napa Valley, as envisioned and crafted by one of the world’s oldest and most highly respected wine producers: the Antinori family. This Cabernet Sauvignon grapes are ripened to attain that perfect balance of concentrated red and purple fruit characteristics, with the firm sweet tannins providing richness to the wine.

title: Mighty Moose Canadian Vodka
bodyHtml:
Mighty Moose says... We are to the core a Canadian brand, here to represent everything Canada stands for. We are not talking about maple syrup, Buffalo check and Muskoka chairs. We are talking about the pride and integrity we all carry as being Canadians. Like Canadians, The Mighty Moose is hardworking, confident, modest and optimistic.  It knows when it's time to put in work and when to break and enjoy the efforts that brought him there. Mighty Moose Canadian Vodka offers consumers high quality, ultra premium vodka without making them pay for fancy packaging, over the top marketing, or an un-authentic persona.

Designed by Canadians, for Canadians, Mighty Moose is 100% homegrown Canadian Vodka. Look for intriguing notes of citrus, wheat, grain, and a hint of pepper. A medium-bodied and smooth palate is capped by a long, warm and creamy finish. Serve well-chilled beside smoked salmon. Try it neat or in your favourite cocktail!

title: Jaisalmer Indian Craft Gin
bodyHtml:
Jaisalmer Indian Craft Gin is as royal and spectacular in it’s lineage as the name suggests. A triple-distilled neutral grain spirit, re-distilled in a traditional copper pot still, the recipe handcrafted in a time-honoured way.

Derived from the ancient Indian knowledge of herbs and retaining the classic gin flavour of juniper berries, a refreshing twist has been added with hand-picked Indian botanicals. Of the 11 botanicals used in the distillation, 7 have been sourced from all four corners of India. The Coriander and Vetiver, a complex spice with intriguing peppery notes, are grown in the fields around Jaisalmer in Northern India. The sweet orange peel, which complements the citrus and floral tones of the gin, comes from Central India. Cubeb Berries and Lemon Grass from Southern India, Darjeeling Green Tea leaves from Eastern India and Lemon Peel from Western India. Other botanicals include angelica roots, liquorice and caraway seeds lending a spicy, slightly anise-tinged flavour to the gin.

Jaisalmer Indian Craft Gin is like an oasis in the desert, with an elegant refreshing finish that lingers long after.

title: Marques de Riscal Baron de Chirel 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine is from Spain, specifically from the Rioja region. Barón de Chirel was first launched in 1986 following experimental trials to create a modern style of Rioja that blends traditional and Bordeaux-inspired techniques. The wine is produced by Marqués de Riscal, a legendary estate founded in 1858 that was the first in Rioja to implement the Bordeaux method of winemaking. The winery's philosophy for this label focuses on using only the highest quality grapes from century old bush vines, often 80 to 110 years old, situated on chalky clay and gravelly terraces.

Wine Description

The 2020 Barón de Chirel exhibits a deep cherry red colour with high intensity and a garnet rim. The nose is enormously expressive, offering a complex range of small black fruits like blackberries and blackcurrants, layered with notes of graphite, violet, tobacco, and cocoa. On the palate, it is powerful and dense with a silky texture and volume. It features lively yet ripe tannins and a magnificent acidity that balances its rich structure. This blend is composed primarily of Tempranillo (85%), with supporting amounts of Cabernet Sauvignon (10%) and Graciano (5%). It has an ABV of 15.2% and was aged for 17 months in French Allier oak barrels followed by at least 20 months in the bottle. The optimal drinking window extends well into the 2040s.

Accolades

  • Guía Proensa - 99 points

  • James Suckling - 95 points

  • Decanter - 93 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 92 points

Food Pairing

The structured and concentrated profile of this wine makes it a perfect match for grilled red meats and roasts. It pairs exceptionally well with feathered game such as partridge or pheasant, as well as big game hunting dishes like venison. Additionally, it complements Iberian ham and matured, spicy hard cheeses.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 vintage in Rioja Alavesa is considered one of the finest in recent years, characterized by a hot autumn and a growing cycle that promoted rapid vegetative development.
