Harvesting began selectively in mid-September, yielding grapes with high sugar levels and a deep concentration of colour and aromatics.

title: Rimauresq Classique Cru Classe Rose 2024
bodyHtml: This beyond-excellent rose is salmon pink in colour. Its nose is floral and delicate, fresh. The tasting reveals beautiful fruity notes and a nice mineral side. The long finish offers beautiful floral notes already felt on the nose. A great vintage from one of the star rosés of Provence. The Classic cuvée is an organic wine, blend of Grenache, Mourvèdre, Rolle, Syrah, Cinsault et Carignan.

title: Perrin La Vieille Ferme Rose 2025 - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml: Beautiful light pink colour, with pastel highlights. This lively and balanced wine offers a beautiful freshness, with delicate red fruits, flowers and citrus aromas. On the palate, this very aromatic wine shows fresh fruit notes with great persistence.

title: Bacana Sangria Rose (NV)
bodyHtml:
This Sangria is the perfect blend of small batch handcrafted wine with the perfect balance of fruit to create a refreshing, smooth and slightly frizzante drink. They pride themselves on using locally sourced products from the region and embrace the spirit of the Portuguese culture

Bacana Rosé Sangria is made from Aragonez, Castelão, Touriga Nacional and Alfrocheiro varietals. With lemon and lime it is amazing!

Pair with rind cheese, fruit, chicken and lamb.

title: Bacana Sangria Red
bodyHtml:
Bacana Red Sangria is produced locally from a family-run winery in Torres Vedras DOC Portugal, which has been creating wine for generations. The region lies near the coast north of Lisbon and has been shaped by 2,000 years of wine production. This Sangria is the perfect blend of small batch handcrafted wine with the perfect balance of fruit to create a refreshing, smooth and slightly frizzante drink.

Pairing it with strong cheese, grilled meats and root vegetables is simply perfect!

title: Calliope Figure Eight Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml: Calliope is a second label of wines produced by storied Okanagan Valley winery Burrowing Owl Estate. The Calliope wines, which use grapes from both the Okanagan and Similkameen Valleys, are meant to be fruit-forward and enjoyed young.

title: Viberti Chardonnay Filebasse 2025
bodyHtml: Tropical fruit flavours of banana and star fruit are complemented by crisp golden apple aromas. Notes of acacia further enhance the bouquet.  Produced from Estate-grown fruit, Viberti Chardonnay is vinified in stainless steel undergoing full malolactic fermentation. Uncork and savour.

title: Gerard Bertrand Cigalus Blanc 2022
bodyHtml:
One of the first and most important biodynamic estates in France. The fruit is clean and pure with good acidity. The wood, very well integrated, offers an impressive support to the wine.

Colour... Golden yellow, shiny and clear.

Nose... Intense and complex with ripe citrus, grapefruit, white peach, honey, dried fruit and toasted notes.

Mouth... Full and silky, ripe, ample with notes of vanilla, toast, butter and exotic fruits. Good length.

Enjoy with pan-fried scallops, fish in sauce or as an aperitif.

title: Bask Crisp Rose - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml: BASK Crisp Rose has subtle aromas of strawberry and peach - a perfect match for summer.

title: Etude Pinot Noir Carneros 2020
bodyHtml: Tony Soter, one of Napa's great winemakers, now oversees the production of this "Burgundian" styled Pinot that is proud of its California roots. Beautifully structured and lush, loaded with complex layers of cherries, spice and hints of earth, with a silky finish.

title: Speyburn 15 Year Old
bodyHtml:
A rich, vibrant, Speyside dram.

Fifteen years maturing in American oak and Spanish oak casks have allowed this bold whisky to embrace the rich, natural elements of Speyside. 

Colour Amber with gold highlights.

Nose Hints of rich dark chocolate with spicy notes of raisins, zesty citrus fruits and vanilla.

Taste On the palate there are notes of oranges, toffee, vanilla and leather, all wrapped together with a gentle spice. The long lasting finish has a warming spice which is sweet and creamy.

title: Chateau de Purcari Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Chateau Purcari Pinot Noir is as light and delicate as fine silk. Made from grapes harvested and selected by hand, and produced using traditional methods. Aged for 6 months in French oak barrique. The purplish red colour is accompanied by a layered bouquet of strawberries, raspberries and violets. Velvety taste, full, persistent, passing in an aftertaste with fine nuances of maturation. Try with lamb, mushroom and asparagus dishes, or gruyere cheese.

Château Purcari in the region of Stefan Voda is known to the whole world for its premium wines, which have received awards and praise from international competitions such as Decanter, Challenge International du Vin, Concours Mondial de Bruxelles.

title: Rum Rats Arco Seco 5 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Brought together by a mutual appreciation for good times and beach living in their adopted homes on the Latin American coast, the Rum Rats partnership of Shamus Hewitt & Jason Gardner, was solidified over a bottle of small batch, artisanal Panamanian Rum. From that initial discovery began a journey into the world of Latin American rums and a desire to create their own product that would capture the distinct character and unique flavour of the region.

Shamus and Jason are proud to be bringing their first rum release back to their native Canada, with Rum Rats’ signature expression, The ‘Arco Seco’. A product that offers a fresh perspective and pushes the boundaries of what people have come to expect from a typical rum. 

Deep in the heart of Southern Panama, lies the Arco Seco (or The Dry Arch). A unique Peninsula region, where the dry pacific air and the heat of the Caribbean unite, creating the perfect conditions for a distinct blend of sugar cane production and rum aging tradition that has remained largely undiscovered by North American audiences. At Rum Rats, they want to showcase their rums in their purest form. The natural flavours of the sugar cane, remain unobscured and are able to shine through, in their unadulterated form. A true rum, with 0% sugar, flavours or additives.

Their rum is proudly, BORN IN PANAMA, FINISHED IN CANADA.

title: Achaval Ferrer Finca Bella Vista Malbec 2015
bodyHtml:
Bright, medium ruby. Vibrant, strong aromas of blackberry, violet, dark raspberry and crushed stone. Very well built fine tannins, with super concentrated body plus a smooth noticeable graphite power. Utterly silky finish with a perfumed back end.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate    

There are wild berries, acidic strawberries, violets and some balsamic aromas that characterize the incredibly elegant and subtle nose. The palate reveals a silky texture and superb acidity with juicy fruit, sophisticated tannins, great balance and length.

95 Points - James Suckling  

This is a precise and sassy wine with blueberry and hints of hazelnut plus lots of citrus character. Full and tight with a long and persistent finish.

title: Barbi Brunello di Montalcino - 1.5 Litre Bottle
Kentucky Owl St. Patrick's Bourbon
bodyHtml: This unusual collaboration does well to blend the two worlds of Irish whisky and bourbon. A flavour profile that offers balance with just enough complexity. It starts with an approachable nose that offers moments of interest though it doesn't necessarily impress. The palate transitions to a fruit-forward and sweet trio of orange marmalade, vanilla custard, and caramel streusel that is approachable yet lacks overall potency. The finish continues with a welcomed contrast of spice and mild heat, putting drinkable and smoothness back and center.

title: Hwayo 41 Premium Soju
bodyHtml:
Hwayo 41 Premium is the flagship high-proof soju from the Hwayo Distillery in Yeoju, South Korea. While typical mass-market sojus are diluted with water and additives, Hwayo 41 is a "Honkaku" (authentic) style distilled spirit made from 100% premium Korean rice and pure bedrock water. Its name "Hwayo" is derived from the Chinese characters for "fire" (Hwa) and "noble" (Yo), symbolizing the noble spirit born from fire. This expression is widely considered the benchmark for modern premium soju, designed by the Kwangjuyo Group to provide a high-quality spirit worthy of being served in the world's finest Michelin-starred restaurants.

Spirit Description

This soju is crystal clear and remarkably pure. On the nose, it offers a clean and intense aroma of steamed rice, followed by delicate floral notes, hints of pear, and a subtle vegetal freshness reminiscent of cucumber and spruce. On the palate, despite its high alcohol content, it is surprisingly mellow and rich. It delivers a full-bodied umami sweetness from the rice, balanced by notes of grapefruit peel and a light nuttiness. The spirit is single-distilled using a vacuum method at low temperatures (around 40°C) to prevent burnt off-flavors, then aged for at least three months in traditional "onggi" (breathing earthenware jars) to soften the alcohol's edge. The finish is long, clean, and warming, with a lingering cereal sweetness. It is bottled at 41% ABV.

Food Pairing

Hwayo 41 was specifically designed to complement the bold, varied flavors of Korean "Hansik" (traditional cuisine). It is a perfect match for well-marinated or strong-flavored dishes such as smoked duck, braised short ribs (Galbi-jjim), or grilled eel. The high ABV and clean rice profile act as a palate cleanser for rich, fatty meats like pork belly (Samgyeopsal) or premium Hanwoo beef. For a non-traditional pairing, its "gin-like" clarity makes it an excellent companion for fresh oysters or spicy tuna tartare. It is best enjoyed at room temperature to appreciate its full aromatic complexity, though it also performs exceptionally well on the rocks or as a robust base for a "Hwayo Negroni."

title: Oremus Tokaji Dry Furmint 'Mandolas' 2023
bodyHtml:
Oremus Tokaji Dry Furmint 'Mandolas' originates from Hungary, within the historic Tokaj region and the Tokaj Hegyalja subregion. Established in 1993 by the owners of Spain's iconic Vega Sicilia, the winery symbolizes the rebirth of the region through a unique combination of ancestral tradition and modern technology. The estate's winemaking philosophy focuses on single-vineyard expressions that highlight the minerality and versatility of the region's noblest variety, Furmint, with ageing taking place in a labyrinth of underground cellars dating back to the 13th century.

Wine Description

This wine presents a bright, pale yellow or medium lemon colour in the glass. The sensory profile is fragrant and complex, featuring an aromatic nose of honeysuckle, acacia, and jasmine alongside fruity notes of green apple, apricot, and lemon zest. On the medium-bodied palate, it is dry and expressive, delivering a dense texture with flavours of pear, Galia melon, and pineapple balanced by a vibrant, 'mouthwatering' acidity and a distinct saline minerality. The finish is remarkably long and persistent, characterized by a refreshing stony or chalky character.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Furmint.

  • ABV: Typically between 13% and 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery utilizes sustainable agricultural practices, this specific wine is not typically certified organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is fermented in a combination of stainless steel (80%) and new Hungarian oak (20%), followed by six months of ageing in traditional 136-litre small barrels with weekly lees stirring to enhance complexity and structure.

Food Pairing

The racy acidity and mineral spine of this Furmint make it a versatile partner for a variety of elegant dishes. Suggested pairings include fresh seafood such as grilled sea bass or shellfish, as well as Asian-inspired fare like chicken satay or laksa. It also complements vegetarian options, including fresh vegetable salads, feta salad, or creamy pasta sauces, and works exceptionally well with mild goat cheese.

title: Bronc Beer - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Bronc Beer is a popular, straightforward American Lager brewed by Last Spike Brewery in Calgary, Alberta. While Last Spike is a major player in the "partner brewing" space (producing beer for many other brands), Bronc is their flagship in-house label. It is marketed with a rugged, "Spirit of the West" identity—designed to be an affordable, high-quality alternative to national macro-lagers. It is a "no-fuss" beer made by Albertans, for Albertans.

Beer Description

Bronc pours a brilliant, pale golden hue with a crisp, snowy white head and tight carbonation that keeps the beer looking lively in the glass.

Aroma: The nose is clean, subtle, and classic. It leads with light scents of cereal grains and sweet pale malt. Unlike craft-heavy IPAs, there is almost no hop aroma, focusing instead on a neutral, "fresh-baked bread" profile that is synonymous with a well-made lager.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-bodied and exceptionally smooth. It leads with a mild, grainy sweetness often described as biscuity or crackery with a very faint hint of corn-like sweetness that is characteristic of the American Lager style. The bitterness is minimal, providing just enough balance to ensure a crisp, clean finish with no lingering aftertaste.

Profile: It sits at a standard 5.0% ABV and a very low 15 IBU, prioritizing maximum "crushability" and refreshment.

Technical Notes: One of Bronc’s main selling points is that it is "adjunct-free," meaning it is brewed without the rice or corn fillers often used by massive international breweries to cut costs. It is brewed using 100% Alberta-grown barley, high-quality hops, and pure water, then subjected to a traditional cold-lagering process to achieve its signature smooth texture.

title: Bieler Family Cabernet Sauvignon Born To Run 2021
bodyHtml: When he was 22 Charles Bieler finished college early, painted a 1965 Cadillac Deville pink, and drove it straight into a wine industry he knew nothing about. For two years he lived out of his Caddy, touring the country and selling his father’s rosé out of the trunk. Over 20 years later and he still runs on that same passion and hustle. The result is a rich, soft California Cabernet Sauvignon. A gorgeous blend that’s all its own and more complex than its parts. So get in. Put the top down. And never look back.

title: El Mayor Blanco
bodyHtml: Some say a distillery is only as good as its blanco. That’s because without the influence of the barrel, the flavor of blanco tequila has the purest expression of the natural flavors of the agave itself. El Mayor 100% Blue Agave Blanco tequila delivers a crisp, light body, with a hint of pepper and a bevy of accolades to match.

title: El Mayor Cristalino
bodyHtml:
Blanco. Reposado. Añejo. Extra Añejo.

Any tequila lover would tell you these are the four main variants on shelves across the country. However, bar and restaurant owners – as well as those at home – are beginning to make room for one more: cristalino.

As you pour the remarkably transparent tequila into your favorite cocktail, neat or on the rocks, your mind tries to prepare you for a blanco experience. But when you taste the full-bodied oak notes with dry fruits and vanilla hue, and the fresh finish of herbal and citrus notes, you realize it all was just a welcomed misunderstanding.

Four generations led us to this point, where you take your first sip of El Mayor Cristalino and realize that there’s always more to discover.

title: Carpineto Brunello Di Montalcino 2021
bodyHtml:
There is a warmth to the ripeness in this red, like sunbaked earth or bricks, surrounding the core of cherry and berry flavours. Very fresh and long, with iron, tobacco and wild herbs lingering as the rugged tannins exert their influence.

The Carpineto winemaking style is to deliver wines that are full bodied, complex and fruity in character, with a round, supple tannin structure and a long, persistent, clean finish. Despite their approachability upon release, Carpineto's red wines are designed for long cellar aging of twenty years or longer.

title: Redstone Cabernet Franc 2021
bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Franc hails from Canada, specifically Ontario’s acclaimed Niagara Peninsula, nestled within the Beamsville Bench sub-appellation. Redstone Winery, owned by Moray Tawse of Tawse Winery fame, is celebrated for its organic and biodynamic vineyard practices. The estate gets its name from its red clay and limestone soils, which impart distinctive character to its wines. Redstone focuses on crafting terroir-driven wines that showcase both power and finesse.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2021 Redstone Cabernet Franc reveals a vibrant ruby hue. On the nose, it opens with lifted aromas of ripe raspberry, cassis, and subtle bell pepper, interwoven with graphite and hints of clove. The palate is medium-bodied, displaying juicy red fruit flavours, delicate herbal undertones, and a touch of minerality that reflects the Beamsville Bench terroir. Fine-grained tannins support a fresh acidity, leading to a persistent, elegant finish.

Food Pairing

Pair this Cabernet Franc with herb-crusted lamb chops, roasted duck breast, or a grilled portobello mushroom burger. The wine’s fresh acidity and fine tannins enhance savoury dishes, bringing out herbal and earthy nuances. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Spier Seaward Pinotage 2022
bodyHtml: Lovely balance of red and black fruit aromatics and oak spice. The palate is cool and broad, fresh and inense with tart blackberry fruit concentration and a long, sleek oak finish.

title: Choya Honkaku Umeshu - 1.8 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Choya Honkaku Umeshu is a premium Japanese plum liqueur originating from the Osaka prefecture. It is produced by Choya Umeshu Co. Ltd., a company that began as a viticulture farm in 1914 and started producing Umeshu in 1959. The term 'Honkaku' denotes that this is an authentic plum liqueur crafted solely from ume plums, sugar, and cane spirit, without the use of acidulants, flavourings, or colourings.

Description

This liqueur presents a clear, amber hue and features a rich, deep sensory profile derived from a long aging process of at least one year. It offers a complex aroma of ripe stone fruits and honey, leading to a palate that perfectly balances the intense sweetness of the plums with a sharp, refreshing acidity. The body is full and velvety, resulting in a smooth and lingering finish that showcases the natural essence of the Nanko ume. It has an alcohol by volume of 15%

Food Pairing

Choya Honkaku Umeshu is highly versatile and can be enjoyed straight, on the rocks, or mixed with soda water. Its robust sweet and sour profile makes it an excellent accompaniment to spicy dishes like black pepper beef or spicy tuna rolls. It also pairs well with salty appetizers such as blue cheese, prosciutto, or roasted nuts. For a dessert pairing, it is delicious served over vanilla bean gelato or alongside a dark chocolate tart.

title: Chum Churum Original Soju - 360 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Lotte Chilsung Beverage Co., Ltd., Chum Churum is one of Korea’s most popular and fastest-growing soju brands since its launch in 2006. The name translates to "like the first time," symbolizing a fresh and approachable character. It gained international fame as the world’s first soju produced using alkaline water, which accounts for roughly 80% of the final product and is credited with creating its signature smoothness.

Description

This clear distilled spirit is traditional in style but modern in execution, typically made from a blend of rice, barley, and sweet potatoes. The use of alkaline water, which features smaller mineral-rich particles, results in an exceptionally smooth mouthfeel and a soothing sensation on the throat. The nose is subtle and clean, with gentle aromas of fresh rice, spring water, and light floral notes. On the palate, it is light-bodied and velvety, offering a mild sweetness with faint hints of pear and jasmine. The finish is crisp and short, lacking the sharp medicinal edge found in some traditional high-proof sojus. ABV 16.5% (standard original version).

Food Pairing

Chum Churum Original is designed to be the ultimate companion for bold and savory Korean flavors. It is a classic partner for Korean BBQ, specifically samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly), where its crispness cuts through the fatty richness of the meat. It also pairs excellently with spicy dishes like kimchi jjigae (stew) or tteokbokki (spicy rice cakes), as the alkaline water and subtle sweetness help tame the heat. For seafood lovers, it is often served alongside Korean-style sashimi (hwe) or grilled eel. It can be enjoyed neat (chilled), on the rocks, or as a popular base for somaek (a cocktail of soju and beer).

title: Myoka Rangyoku Junmai Daiginjo Shizuku Genshu Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Myoka Rangyoku Junmai Daiginjo Shizuku Genshu is an ultra-premium sake originating from the Nihonmatsu domain in the Fukushima prefecture of Japan. It is crafted by the Daishichi Sake Brewery, a historic institution founded in 1752 that has remained under the ownership of the Ohta family for ten generations. The brewery is renowned for its steadfast commitment to the traditional 'kimoto' brewing method and its unique 'super flat' rice polishing technique, which removes impurities while preserving the essential character of the Yamada Nishiki rice.

Description

This sake presents a clear, 'heavenly' appearance and is only released in years when the highest quality is achieved, after being cellared for at least four years to reach its full maturity. It features an intoxicating and complex aromatic bouquet with notes of rose petals, cream, raisins, bananas, and cotton candy. On the palate, it is rich, full-bodied, and velvety, offering layers of ripe persimmon, marshmallow, nougat, and subtle woody elements. The mouthfeel is creamy with a subtle bite of alcohol at the finish, leading to a long and harmonious aftertaste. It is a 'genshu' (undiluted) sake with an alcohol by volume of 16%.

Food Pairing

Myoka Rangyoku is a monumental sake designed to enhance the most luxurious cuisines. It pairs exceptionally well with rich and flavorful dishes such as lobster a la vapeur in orange sabayon sauce, sea bass in a baked pie wrap, or Bresse chicken filled with foie gras and truffles. Its complex profile also complements game meats, smoked fish, and intense pastas. For a sophisticated Western pairing, it can be served alongside Iberian pork saute or a deep, savory wild boar stew with mushrooms. It is best enjoyed chilled in a large wine glass to allow its intricate aged aromas to unfold.

title: Yoshi No Gawa 'Inspiration' Sakagura No Awayuki Sparkling Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Yoshi No Gawa 'Inspiration' Sakagura No Awayuki originates from Nagaoka City in the Niigata Prefecture of Japan. As the oldest brewery in Niigata, founded in 1548, Yoshi No Gawa created this sparkling sake to blend their centuries-old craftsmanship with a modern, effervescent style. The name "Sakagura No Awayuki" translates to "light snow in the brewery," an evocative reference to the delicate mousse and soft bubbles that characterize this drink.

Description

This premium sparkling sake is produced through natural carbonation during fermentation, rather than being artificially carbonated like some mass-market alternatives.

  • Aroma: It features a bright, creamy, and rich fruity nose with specific notes of yogurt, honey, Asian pear, and banana.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it is remarkably light and soft, with a mouthfeel often described as "landing like a feather". It offers playful flavors of cotton candy, ramune (Japanese soda), and meringue.

  • Technical Profile: Brewed with local Niigata rice polished to 65%, it has a low alcohol content of 7.5%. It is a notably sweet sake with a Sake Meter Value (SMV) of -44 and a gentle acidity of 2.0.

Food Pairing

The high sweetness and low alcohol content of Inspiration Awayuki make it an ideal companion for salty appetizers and sweet desserts.

  • Savoury Appetizers: Pairs naturally with prosciutto served with fresh melons or figs, where the saltiness of the meat enhances the sake's fruitiness.

  • Creamy Textures: The lactic yogurt notes in the aroma make it a great match for cream cheese-based dips or mild brie.

  • Desserts: It is a classic partner for almond tofu, fruit tarts, or light meringues that mirror its cotton candy-like finish.

  • Serving Tip: It should be served well-chilled, ideally at around 5°C. Using a champagne flute or a tulip-shaped wine glass will help preserve the delicate bubbles while concentrating its tropical aromas.

title: Toko Fukuro-Tsuri Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Toko Fukuro-Tsuri Junmai Daiginjo is the ultra-premium masterpiece of the Kojima Sohonten brewery in Yamagata Prefecture. Established in 1597, the brewery is one of Japan's most historic, and this specific bottling represents the absolute peak of their technical ability. The term "Fukuro-Tsuri" (meaning "bag hanging") refers to a rare and labor-intensive method of separating the sake from the rice solids without the use of a mechanical press.

Description

In the Fukuro-Tsuri process, the fermented mash is placed into cloth bags that are hung from the ceiling. The sake is allowed to drip out slowly, drop by drop, using only the force of gravity. This prevents the harsh tannins and bitterness associated with mechanical pressing from entering the liquid.

  • Aroma: An incredibly pure and intense nose featuring notes of premium melon, ripe pear, and delicate white blossoms.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it is remarkably silk-like and elegant. It offers a "limitless" purity with flavors of nectarine and sweet cream, finished with a subtle, shimmering minerality.

  • Technical Profile: Brewed with 100% Yamagata-grown Yamada Nishiki rice polished to 35%. It is typically bottled at 16% ABV and reflects the "drip" method’s signature clarity and refined sweetness.

Food Pairing

This is a "meditation sake" designed for special occasions. Its extraordinary delicacy requires pairings that do not mask its subtle nuances.

  • Luxury Sashimi: Pairs perfectly with the highest grade of fatty tuna (otoro), sea bream, or sweet raw prawns (ama-ebi).

  • Delicate Umami: Enhances the subtle sweetness of snow crab, steamed abalone, or chilled silken tofu with a drop of white soy sauce.

  • Refined Appetizers: Complements light, fruit-based starters like a white peach and burrata salad or a mild yuzu-scented scallop carpaccio.

  • Serving Tip: It is essential to serve this chilled in a high-quality Burgundy wine glass. The large bowl allows the concentrated aromas of the "drip" process to breathe and fully express themselves.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Saika Daiginjo Sake - 1.8 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This premium sake hails from the Aichi Prefecture in Japan. It is produced by the Nakano Sake Brewery, an esteemed establishment founded in 1844 that has spent nearly two centuries perfecting the art of fermentation. The brewery is renowned for its commitment to 'Kunizakari', a philosophy centered on creating sake that reflects the prosperity and rich cultural heritage of the region.

Sake Description

Nakano Kunizakari Saika Daiginjo presents a brilliant, crystal-clear appearance in the glass. The aromatic profile is elegantly floral and fruity, characterized by delicate notes of melon, pear, and a hint of white blossoms. On the palate, this Daiginjo is light to medium-bodied, offering a silky texture and a refined balance of subtle sweetness and crisp acidity. The finish is clean, dry, and remarkably smooth, showcasing the complexity achieved through high polishing of the rice grains.

Food Pairing

This sophisticated sake pairs beautifully with light appetizers, such as sashimi, fresh oysters, or a delicate scallop carpaccio. It also complements lightly seasoned steamed vegetables and mild creamy cheeses.

title: Giusti Grappa Riserva
bodyHtml:
Giusti Riserva is our first trail of grappa aged in “barriques” previously used to hold local superior red wines and for which a new one-of-a-kind technique has been to treat the staves. Giusti Riserva grappa is a blend, that is, a grappa made up from several spirits made from different grape marcs of different vintages. In this case the grappa has been aged for 6 years. The one-wine Troncais oak barrels imaprt characteristic features to the product.

The fullness of the flavour is enhanced by chocolate made with 65% cocoa, or by a sprinkling of orange peel and for those who really want to spoil themselves, with a good Cuban cigar.

title: Tamanohikari Black Label Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Tamanohikari Black Label Junmai Daiginjo is a super premium sake originating from the Fushimi district of the Kyoto prefecture in Japan. It is crafted by Tamanohikari Sake Brewing Co., a historic brewery founded in 1673 that is renowned for being one of the first in the industry to focus exclusively on pure rice 'junmai' sake. This flagship 'Brilliant Soul' expression represents the pinnacle of the brewery's craft, utilizing the ancient and rare Bizen Omachi rice variety.

Description

This sake presents an exquisite, defined, and elegantly smooth sensory profile. It features a gorgeous aromatic bouquet with notes of muscat melon, western pear, ripe banana, and delicious apple. On the palate, it offers sophisticated layers of white grapes and lychee, reflecting the deep umami characteristics of the Bizen Omachi rice which is polished to an ultra-refined 35% using a special 'henpei' (flat) polishing method. The body is medium with a balanced acidity, leading to a refined finish. It has an alcohol by volume of 16.2% and is best enjoyed chilled to maintain its delicate floral top notes.

Food Pairing

The refined and complex nature of Tamanohikari Black Label makes it a perfect match for high-quality, delicate fare. Its fruity acidity and smooth texture complement premium seafood such as sashimi (fatty tuna, scallops), Chinese-style steamed fish, or lightly seared prawns with citrus. Surprisingly, its robust Omachi rice base also allows it to pair exceptionally well with rich Western dishes like prosciutto ham, filet mignon, or truffle risotto. For a lighter option, try it alongside a zesty melon salad to bridge the gap between the sake's floral notes and the dish's brightness.

title: Okunomatsu Sakura Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Okunomatsu Sakura Daiginjo originates from Nihonmatsu City in the Fukushima Prefecture of Japan. Produced by the historic Okunomatsu Shuzo (founded in 1716), this sake is a "Sakura Label" Daiginjo, crafted to be highly aromatic and refined. Unlike "Junmai" versions, this Daiginjo includes a very small amount of brewer's alcohol added during the final stages of fermentation, a traditional technique used to "lift" and intensify the floral and fruity aromatics.

Description

This sake is brewed using the regional Gohyaku Mangoku rice, which is prized for creating clean, light, and refreshing flavor profiles.

  • Aroma: An elegant and pronounced bouquet featuring notes of vanilla, tropical fruit, and toasted cashews, with floral hints of cherry blossoms (sakura) and a touch of anise.

  • Palate: It is medium-bodied and dry, offering complex layers of papaya custard, pineapple sorbet, and coconut water. It maintains a balanced sweetness that transitions into a salted, radish-tinged finish.

  • Technical Profile: The rice is polished to 50%. It has an alcohol content of approximately 15.4%, a Sake Meter Value (SMV) of +5 (indicating dryness), and an acidity level of 1.3.

Food Pairing

The dry and fruity nature of Sakura Daiginjo makes it an excellent match for a variety of refined and savory dishes.

  • Seafood: Pairs perfectly with garlic shrimp, fresh sashimi, and salmon steaks.

  • Rich Meats: The sake’s clean finish and subtle saltiness complement the richness of pork belly.

  • Appetizers: Excellent alongside fresh spring rolls or soft, creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert.

  • Pasta: Its balanced acidity also makes it a surprising but successful companion for light pasta dishes.

  • Serving Tip: It is best enjoyed well-chilled in a wine glass or a flute to fully capture the "Sakura" floral notes and tropical aromatics.

title: Okunomatsu Sakura Daiginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Okunomatsu Sakura Daiginjo is a premium sake originating from the Fukushima prefecture in the Tohoku region of Japan. It is produced by Okunomatsu Sake Brewery, which was founded in 1716 during the early Edo period. Originally founded by a samurai family that transitioned into merchants and then brewers, the company is now led by the 19th generation of the Yusa family, continuing over 300 years of brewing tradition.

Description

This Daiginjo sake is crafted with Gohyaku Mangoku rice polished to 50%, resulting in a clear and clean sensory profile. It features an elegant and full aromatic bouquet with notes of vanilla, nutty coconut custard, and tropical fruits like cherries and strawberries, accented by a hint of anise. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and medium-sweet, offering a balanced acidity with salty undertones and a delicate touch of umami. The finish is clean and dry, true to the refined Ginjo style. It has an alcohol by volume of 15.4% and is best enjoyed chilled in a wine glass to appreciate its floral top notes.

Food Pairing

The delicate and light nature of Okunomatsu Sakura Daiginjo makes it an ideal companion for pure dishes such as sashimi, garlic shrimp, and steamed mussels. Its fruit-forward profile and balanced acidity also pair exceptionally well with soft creamy cheeses like brie, and even Western fare such as pasta with seafood or pesto sauce. For more adventurous pairings, it can be served with garlic scape vichyssoise, five-cheese quiche, or a Hawaiian-style chicken salad.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Japanese Plum Umeshu - 2 Litre
bodyHtml:
Established in 1844 during the Edo period, Nakano Sake Brewery Co., Ltd. produces its traditional plum wine under the Kunizakari brand, a name chosen with the hope that the brewery would flourish alongside the nation. The brewery is unique for operating its own dedicated plum farm, the Kuni Zakari Farm, where employees meticulously cultivate and harvest approximately 3,000 trees to ensure the highest quality ingredients for their liqueurs.

Description

This classic umeshu presents a golden amber colour. The aromatic profile is inviting and fruity, featuring notes of caramel, lemon, and dark plum. On the palate, it delivers a rich and complex sensory experience where juicy sweetness is masterfully balanced by spicy and tart undertones with hints of marzipan. The body is smooth and flavourful, leading to a refreshing and slightly tannic finish that highlights the deep essence of the fruit. ABV 10.5%.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Gahoujin Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
Rampur Asava Indian Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Matured in American Bourbon barrels and meticulously perfected in Indian Cabernet Sauvignon casks for the first time in history resulting in a unique expression with an impeccable balance.

Nose... Tropical fruity note of Rampur with added notes of apricot, blackberry and plum followed with a faint hint of tobacco and spices.

Palate... Velvety, manuka honey sweetness highlighted by spicy oak, vanilla and balanced with dryness from Indian red wine.

Finish... The Indian trail lingers with a medium finish.

title: Gerard Bertrand Picpoul De Pinet 2024
bodyHtml: This wine, crafted 100% from the Picpoul grape variety, comes in a yellow colour with shimmering flashes. The intense, complex nose reveals notes of white fruit, citrus fruit, honey and white flowers. Full-bodied and lively on the palate, it offers a remarkable crisp freshness. This wine is ideally suited to accompany shellfish (Charentes mussel soup, stuffed clams) and crustaceans, but also goes well with fish.

title: Masottina Prosecco Rose 'Collezione 96' 2020
bodyHtml: This wine expresses all the elegance of Pinot Noir, from its bright pink colour to its aroma, which includes clear fragrant hints of wild strawberries, raspberries, red currants and cherries, enhanced by white pulp peaches, apricots and a floral touch. Fresh on the palate, where fruit predominates. This wine is elegant, pleasantly fruity and delicate, but full of personality.

title: Hainle Cuvee 2020
bodyHtml:
This 4 varietals blend consisting of Riesling from East Kelowna, Gewurztraminer from Kaleden, Chardonnay from Summerland and Sauvignon Blanc from Peachland was blended together on Dec.1th. The Riesling and Gewurztraminer fermented in a temperature controlled stainless steel tank to preserve the lively aromatics of each wine variety. The Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc fermentation was done on skins and aged shortly in barrel thereafter to provide further structure and depth.

Blend - 57% Riesling, 18% Gewurztraminer, 17% Chardonnay, 8% Sauvignon Blanc.

Hainle Vineyards Estate Winery is located in the sun-soaked Okanagan wine region of British Columbia and is B.C’s first certified organic winery. Hainle is dedicated to producing natural, chemical-free viticulture and handcrafted wines. They use only the best Estate grown grapes from their Peachland organic vineyards.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Peach Momo No Osake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1844 during the Edo period, Nakano Sake Brewery has spent nearly two centuries refining traditional techniques while pioneering modern production systems. The brewery is a respected leader in the Aichi region, consistently ranked among the top ten sake producers in the world for its commitment to quality and innovative fruit-based beverages.

Description

This premium liqueur displays an attractive orange hue and a luscious, viscous texture. The bouquet is intense and aromatic, featuring scents of fresh cut white peach, rose petal, and white grapefruit. On the palate, it delivers an exceptionally round and sweet profile, characterized by the flavours of ripened peach juice, honeycombs, and a bright touch of lemon. The experience is full-bodied and juicy, concluding with a clean and refreshing citrus-driven finish. ABV 7.3%.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Rose Umeshu - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Nakano Kunizakari Rose Umeshu is produced in Handa City, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. The Nakano Sake Brewery was established in 1844 during the Edo period and has been managed by the founding family for over 180 years. The brewery is renowned for its enterprising spirit, operating its own dedicated plum farm since 2008 to ensure the quality of the fruit used in its diverse liqueur range.

Description

This specialty liqueur is a fusion of traditional umeshu and the delicate essence of roses. It presents a vibrant pink colour and a fragrant aromatic profile featuring natural rose petals, rose hips, and elegant tangy plum. On the palate, it offers a harmonious and sweet sensory experience with a light tartness and flavours of berries and rose water. It is light bodied and refreshing, making it an accessible choice for those who enjoy floral profiles. The alcohol content is 9%.

Food Pairing

The sweet and floral character of this rose umeshu makes it an excellent accompaniment to fresh salads and light appetizers. It pairs beautifully with spicy Asian cuisine, where its sweetness helps balance the heat, or with savoury snacks such as nuts and cheese. For a dessert pairing, it is particularly delightful when served over vanilla ice cream or alongside fruit tarts. It is best enjoyed chilled, on the rocks, or mixed with a splash of soda water to highlight its delicate floral notes.

title: Quest Cabernet Franc 2024 (Austin Hope Winery)
bodyHtml: Quest aims to express the potential and excitement of Paso Robles. As makers and dreamers, their minds are never at rest. They are constantly in pursuit of the possibilities they have yet to create. Quest was born in this spirit and out of a love for American oak and Cabernet Franc. Cabernet Franc is one of the noble grapes of the world-famous Bordeaux region and yet was not widely planted in California, let alone Paso Robles. The fact is, Cabernet Franc is very particular when it comes to soil and temperature.

title: Calazan Ron Anejo 10 Year Old Reserva Rum
bodyHtml:
In Eastern Venezuela there is still talk of Rodolfo Esteban Gil. Although people do not know him by that name, they do know him by his nickname, Calazan. A nickname given by the loves that marked his youth, but the founders true passion was Venezuelan rum, a dream he never gave up. The legend began in Nueva Colombia, near Carúpano, with the country’s first large sugar cane farm. Rodolfo’s ingenuity and tenacity led him to create Calazan Premium Venezuelan Rum.

The Ron Anejo Calazan Reserva, born from a blend of Rums of more than 10 years old and is characterized by its delicate aroma, notes of red fruits and plum, in its maximum freshness and exquisite vanilla fragrance. It has pleasant oak tones and a distinctive flavour.

title: Lake Breeze Rose 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: The wines of Lake Breeze are known to be clean, crisp and fruit driven in style. They endeavour to take the natural expression of the grape and transfer it to the bottle with as little intervention as possible. Made from 100% Merlot. A juicy combination of fruity and savoury flavours with a dry and lingering finish.

title: Bottega Pistacchio Grappa Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Bottega is a creamy liqueur,  pleasantly sweet and with a moderate alcohol content,  characterized by an intense aroma of pistachio. Pistachios are the fruit of a plant native to the Middle East, now growing spontaneously on the Sicilian volcano Mount Etna. They have always been renowned for their nutritional properties. Pistachios, exclusively harvested in Sicily, are processed according to a traditional method and turned into a paste which preserves all their unique organoleptic characteristics. The paste is then expertly mixed with alcohol, water and sugar, creating a creamy, round, velvety liqueur with an intense an inebriating aroma of Sicilian pistachios. With a final touch of grappa, Pistacchio Bottega gains a particular aromaticity, making it unique and unmistakable.

Thanks to its moderate alcohol content, it is particularly suited for sweetening the palate. Best served cold, it is perfect after meals and any time of the day. It is ideal with panna cotta, pastry, desserts or ice cream.

title: Masi Amarone Costasera Riserva 2019
bodyHtml:
Masi Amarone Costasera Riserva is a red wine from Italy, produced in the Veneto region and the Valpolicella Classica D.O.C.G. appellation. The wine is made by Masi Agricola, a producer with a history dating back to 1772, when the Boscaini family acquired the Vaio dei Masi estate. Masi is recognized as one of the world's leading specialists in the ancient Venetian technique of appassimento (grape drying), which is essential to making Amarone. The 'Costasera' name refers to the winery's vineyards on the "evening side" of the hills, which receive the benefit of the setting sun, aiding the drying process. The 'Riserva' designation indicates a selection of the best grapes and extended maturation.

Wine Description

The wine is deep, intense, and impenetrable ruby red in colour. The aromatic profile is complex and mature, offering concentrated notes of baked fruit, plum, and raspberry jam. Further nuances include cocoa, cinnamon, black pepper, vanilla, and hints of mint.

The varietal composition is a blend of Corvina, Rondinella, and Molinara. The blend consists of 70% Corvina, 25% Rondinella, and 5% Molinara and Oseleta. It is a full bodied wine. The palate is smooth, powerful, and majestic, with excellent structure and concentrated, luscious flavours of cherry, plum, and chocolate. The fruit is balanced by a refreshing acidity and velvety tannins. Stylistically, it is a magnificent, intense, and elegant Amarone that is a textbook example of its appellation. The wine is aged for 38 months in new Slavonian oak barrels and then for a further 12 months in the bottle. The finish is long, persistent, and warm.

Food Pairing

This powerfully structured Amarone is an outstanding partner for rich, complex dishes. Suggested pairings include red meats, game, grilled fillet, roasts, and hard, aged cheeses.

title: Mars Shinshu Iwai Japanese Whisky - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Mars Shinshu Iwai is an entry-level blended whisky that serves as a tribute to Kiichiro Iwai, the visionary who designed the distillery's original pot stills. Produced at the Mars Shinshu Distillery in the Nagano Prefecture—the highest distillery in Japan—this expression is notable for its high corn content. Unlike the malt-driven Tradition expression, the standard Iwai is inspired by great American whiskies, offering a flavor profile that acts as a bridge between the worlds of Japanese blending and Kentucky bourbon.

Whisky Description

This whisky displays a bright gold color. The nose is lean and sweet, dominated by aromas of vanilla, corn, and light wood smoke, with a floral hint of honey and apricot. On the palate, the body is light and incredibly smooth, delivering flavors of pear, quince, and buttery toffee. The influence of the ex-bourbon barrels is clear, providing a sweet foundation of caramel and toasted oak. The finish is crisp and clean, with a refreshing touch of ginger and a lingering sweetness. It is a blend of approximately 75% corn and 25% malted barley, bottled at 40% ABV.

Food Pairing

The bourbon-like sweetness and light body of Iwai make it an ideal candidate for refreshing Highballs. It pairs perfectly with fried appetizers such as chicken karaage or tempura, where the spirit's crispness cuts through the richness of the batter. For a main course, it complements honey-glazed ham or BBQ chicken wings. If enjoying it neat, try it alongside vanilla fudge or shortbread biscuits to accentuate the spirit's sweet grain notes. It is a highly versatile whisky that performs well in a wide range of citrus-based cocktails.

title: Stella Rosa Rosso (NV)
bodyHtml: Stella Rosa Rosso, the timeless original Stella, is all about the classics. This semi-sweet, semi-sparkling red wine is the must-have at every and any occasion. Hints of fresh strawberry, and red berry. Pair with aged Gouda and Pepper Jack cheeses, spicy pasta primavera with garlic bread, beef enchiladas, chocolate-covered strawberries, cheesecake with berries.

title: Stella Rosa Moscato D'Asti (NV)
bodyHtml: Stella Rosa Moscato D’Asti keeps you on your A-game. This semi-sweet, semi-sparkling wine is the perfect choice for girls-nights and guys-nights, date nights, daytime activities, and you-time. Notes of peach, apricot, and honey. Pair with fresh fruit, salted nuts, fondue, Pad Thai, chicken Alfredo pizza, cheesecake.

title: Stella Rosa Watermelon
bodyHtml:
Stella Rosa Watermelon is crisp, refreshing, and making a splash among Stella Rosa lovers. Could this be your new favourite too? You won’t know unless you Taste The Magic for yourself.

This flavour pairs wonderfully with light salads, such as Greek or Caesar, as well as salty appetizers like Edamame or Jalapeño poppers. For dessert, you can pair it with coconut cream pie!

title: Taittinger Brut Reserve (NV) - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml:
Taittinger Brut Réserve is a blend of Chardonnay (40%), Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier (60%) wines from over 35 different vineyards and vintages matured to perfection. This high proportion of Chardonnay, unique among fine non- vintage champagnes, and a minimum ageing of three years in the cellars, where it reaches the peak of aromatic maturity, makes Taittinger Brut Réserve a delicately balanced champagne, known for its consistently excellent quality all over the world. Taittinger considers it an honour to produce a Brut champagne every year without exception.

The brilliant body is golden yellow in colour. The bubbles are fine, while the foam is discreet yet lingering. The nose, very open and expressive, delivers aromas of fruit and brioche. it also gives off the fragrance of peach, white flowers (hawthorn, acacia) and vanilla pod. The entry onto the palate is lively, fresh and in total harmony. This is a delicate wine with flavours of fresh fruit and honey. Taittinger Brut Réserve, which acquires its maturity during three and four years ageing in the cellar, offers excellent aromatic potential.

90 Points - Wine Spectator    Open-knit and lively, with ripe yellow plum, white cherry fruit, almond skin and candied lemon zest flavors, underscored by minerally smoke and chalk accents. Offers a clean-cut, lacy finish. Drink now through 2018. 1,000 cases imported. 

Robert Parker's Wine Advocate    Taittinger's Brut Réserve is the signature cuvée of the house and represents a large volume. It is an assemblage of 45% Chardonnay, 35% Pinot Noir and 20% Pinot Meunier; the recent disgorgement (dosage is pretty sweet with nine grams) is based on vintage 2011 and contains 30-35% reserve wines. It is a pretty intense Champagne with good body and structure, refreshing mineral tension and good grip in the finish. 

Wine Enthusiast    The nonvintage Taittinger cuvée, with its lively mousse, is soft and creamily fruity. While the bottle tasted was young, it had enough ripe white fruits and lime-juice flavors to balance out the freshness. Typically for Taittinger, Chardonnay is an important element in the blend, giving the wine its final mineral tautness.

title: Hall Ranch Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml: Deep purple colour. Aromas and flavours of spicy berry compote, olive and pepper relish, and persimmon with a supple, bright, dry-yet-fruity medium-to-full body and a graceful, compelling, medium-long finish with impressions of cassis tart and spicy praline with chewy, fine tannins and light oak flavour. A spot-on Cabernet with seamless structure and round, inviting flavours.

title: Casa Lupo Amarone della Valpolicella 2020
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Red color with dark garnet reflections. There are hints of ripe fruit with red berry as currants, blueberries, sour cherries and jam with a final bouquet of spicy vanilla perfume. Rich, refined, elegant, a wine of great structure. To be served at 16 - 18 C. Good match with traditional meat dishes such as braised meat, stews, wild game and aged cheese.

title: Castelvecchi Chianti Classico Capotondo 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Italy, this expressive red wine originates from the historic Chianti Classico DOCG region within Radda in Chianti, Tuscany. Premiata Fattoria di Castelvecchi boasts roots dating back to 1043, featuring ancient subterranean cellars built beneath the original castle foundations. Managed by the Paladin family since 2004, the estate focuses on sustainable viticulture across high-altitude terraced vineyards to showcase the authentic, mineral-rich character of Tuscan terroir.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep ruby red colour enhanced by delicate violet highlights. The bouquet opens with vivid floral aromas of red rose and violet, followed by ripe red fruit notes of wild berries, blueberry, cherry, and plum, wrapped in gentle baking spice. On the palate, it delivers a medium body defined by crisp acidity, vibrant freshness, and harmonious, well-integrated tannins leading to a long, balanced finish.

title: G.A. Schmitt Niersteiner Riesling Spatlese 2025
bodyHtml: A medium-bodied, clean, rich white with intense floral aromas. Lightly-sweet and balanced with bright acidity.

title: Lucien Muzard et Fils Santenay Maladiere 2021
bodyHtml: This family domaine, directed by brothers Claude and Hervé Muzard, dates back to the 1960's and today numbers among the more interesting, forward-thinking addresses in the southern Côte de Beaune. Replanting with high-quality selections massale, limiting yields, working the soils and farming organically, they seek balance without rusticity in their wines, using some whole-cluster fermentation followed by maturation in barrels and foudres. Muzard’s wines tend toward the elegant end of the spectrum, highlighted by crunchy, earthy red fruit.

title: Evesham Wood Pinot Noir Le Puits Sec 2023
bodyHtml: Evesham Wood was founded by Russ Raney in 1986 after training with the legendary Henri Jayer in Vosne-Romanée. The style of Evesham Wood has always been one of purity and precision. The winery expresses its core “small is beautiful” philosophy by obtaining optimally ripe low-yield fruit from the best possible distinct sites in the Willamette Valley, and then using minimal intervention in the winemaking process. Evesham Wood’s wines exemplify the finest traits of Pinot Noir: grace, complexity, silkiness, and supple tannins. They are powerful without a sense of heaviness, bursting with energy and drive. They represent the essence of great Willamette Valley Pinot Noir, telling the story of where they were grown and who made them in a clear, authentic way.

title: Lemelson Pinot Noir Thea's Selection 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Lemelson Vineyards began as a dream, a dream to create a winery that celebrates innovation in technology, sustainability through nature, and tradition in winemaking. Eric Lemelson started Lemelson Vineyards with the intention of building something that would not only serve their consumers, but also the longevity of the pristine state that he calls home. Utilizing organic farming methods and gravity flow production, they craft estate grown Pinot Noir, Pinot Gris, Chardonnay, and Riesling from some of the finest vineyards in the Willamette Valley.

As the house cuvee, Thea’s Selection is a blend of fruit sourced from all seven of their organic, estate vineyards that span three different Willamette Valley AVAs. As such, it is a wonderful representation of the vintage across all of their sites. The nose is inviting with blueberry and blackberry fruit that is nuanced by subtle spice notes of black licorice, black tea, cinnamon and graham cracker. The rich, silky tannins give in to a long and robust finish that leaves the taste of black cherries and dark chocolate lingering on the palate.

title: Stag's Hollow Simply Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Since 1995, Stag's Hollow has been a fixture in the Okanagan.  Known for unique varietals and boundary pushing wines.

The Simply Noir has always been a blend of Pinot Noir and Gamay, occasionally with small percentages of other varietals blended in. The Pinot Noir component dominates both the aromatics and palate, with notes of ripe cherries, cinnamon, raspberry and cola. The Gamay lends its typical juiciness, and the Merlot and Dolcetto a little extra body. It is an extremely versatile wine suitable for a wide variety of foods and situations, at the table or on the patio, slightly chilled.

Simply Noir shows an abundance of cherry, raspberry, red licorice and florals, balanced by an intoxicating earthiness. Juicy red fruit and dried herbs dominate the palate, which is complemented by the wine’s bright, acidity, gentle tannin structure, and enticing minerality. A great Bistro red that could be chilled a little before serving--the perfect spring and summer red, with or without food.

title: Taittinger Prelude Grand Cru Brut
bodyHtml:
Prelude Grands Crus Cuvee is composed of Chardonnay (50%) and Pinot Noir (50%) that Taittinger has selected exclusively from the top Grands Crus vineyards classified as “100%” in the Champagne system. Produced only using first press wines, this rare blend offers the finesse and structure that a great wine needs if it to be laid down for any length of time. On the palate, this wine strikes the perfect balance of the instantly minerally Chardonnay and the strongly expressive Pinot Noir. Aged for more than five years in the cellar, the Prelude cuvee is unique for its remarkable youth and great wealth of flavours.

The brilliant body is pale yellow with silver highlights, a sign of the high proportion of exceptional Chardonnays. The bubbles are fine and form a persistent and delicately creamy ring of foam. The wine is subtle and fresh on the nose. The initial mineral aromas quickly give way to green and then floral notes with the fragrance of elderflowers and spicy cinnamon undertones. The entry onto the palate is clean and lively, dominated by very exceedingly fresh citrus notes. These segue into much fuller, rounder and silkier flavours where white peaches in syrup predominate. The finish is rich, lingering and bursting with flavour. Prelude Grands Crus is a joyous blend of finesse and complexity. its balance of freshness and aromatic expression is outstanding.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast    Made from only Grand Cru vineyards, this ripe, full and wonderfully textured wine is rich and complex. It brings out tangy orange and lemon zest, a tightly mineral texture, fragrant fruit and acidity. Dense and concentrated, the wine would benefit from some bottle age to bring out all its flavors. 

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate    The NV Brut Prélude Grands Crus has a very clear, complex and fresh yet intense bouquet, currently with more Pinot and walnut/macadamia flavors rather than Chardonnay flavors. Almond biscuits and fine brioche aromas come through only on the second nose. Bottled in 2012, this should be based on the 2011 vintage. It is a full-bodied, fine and elegant but also very complex and persistent Prélude that was sourced in only grand cru vineyards. Disgorged in October 2016 (dosage: nine grams per liter), tasted in November 2017.

91 Points - Vinous    Pale gold. Vibrant, mineral-laced citrus and orchard fruit aromas are complemented by suggestions of buttered toast and honey. Toasty orange and pear flavors are braced by juicy acidity, picking up a suggestion of chamomile with air. Finishes dry and precise, with repeating mineral and toast notes. 

90 Points - Wine & Spirits    This is a substantial, full-bodied 50-50 blend of Chardonnay from Avize and Le Mesnil-sur-Oger with Pinot Noir from the Montagne de Reims. It balances savory, nutty aromas of yeast autolysis with bright, zesty orange and deeper, red fruit essences. The wine’s persistent acidity keeps its plump body firm.

title: Kiona Lemberger Red Mountain 2021
bodyHtml: For more than four decades Lemberger has been an important part of Kiona's tradition on Red Mountain. The grape thrives there, producing medium-bodied, fruit-driven wines that pair well with a wide array of foods. The 2020 iteration includes a healthy North Block Cabernet Sauvignon component, contributing structure, aromatic intensity, and colour. Lemberger is an uncommon grape that’s worthy of attention.

title: Kiona Chenin Blanc Columbia Valley 2022
bodyHtml:
Chenin Blanc grows exceptionally well in the Columbia Valley, where big temperature swings and ample sunlight ensure nice ripening and vibrant acidity. Strong demand and limited old-vine acreage keep Chenin Blanc in the hands of only a few top-notch producers, Kiona Vineyards included. Their plantings at the Kiona Estate vineyard date back to 1976. One of their favourite grapes.

With trademark bright, crisp, fruit-forward characteristic and immense food-pairability, Kiona Chenin Blanc is a definite crowd-pleaser. Texture and mouthfeel are an emphasis here. They included barrel ferments and clay amphora treatments in the final blend. Small amounts of Viognier and Roussanne add length and intrigue. A stalwart in the Kiona Vineyards portfolio since 1980, Chenin Blanc continues to impress.

title: Kiona Merlot Red Mountain Estate 2019
bodyHtml:
The Kiona Estate vineyard is the oldest on Red Mountain. They have 4 distinct blocks of Merlot here, the first was planted in 1976, the youngest in 1995. While these components obviously have much more in common than not, they continue to surprise, even after several decades of experience. All four blocks are included in the blend, along with components from their younger Heart of the Hill planting that has garnered a lot of attention in a short period of time.

Merlot from Red Mountain is special. Here it's a powerful yet elegant grape, capable of producing wines of profound depth and density of character. A gentle oak regimen that employs primarily 2nd-fill barrels ensures abundant fruit and geographical specificity are preserved in the finished wine.

title: Kiona Cabernet Sauvignon Red Mountain Estate 2019
bodyHtml: Hands down, the best value in 100% Red Mountain Estate Cabernet! This authoritative wine shows why Red Mountain has a reputation as a powerhouse Cabernet Sauvignon producer capable of going toe-to-toe with the world's best. Fine-grain tannin, pure red and dark fruit, and deep colour abound. Red Mountain produces balanced Cabernet Sauvignon with impeccable geographical specificity and intrinsic appeal.

title: Chateau Puybarbe Cotes de Bourg 2019
bodyHtml:
France’s Bordeaux region is home to Chateau Puybarbe, located in the Cotes de Bourg subregion on the right bank of the Gironde estuary. The estate is currently run by Anna and Riku Väänänen, a Finnish couple who took ownership in 2018 and have since focused on sustainable viticulture and precise winemaking. The vineyard, perched on one of the highest points in the region, benefits from exceptional sun exposure and clay-limestone soils, which contribute to the wine’s depth and structure.

Wine Description
This 2019 vintage presents a deep ruby hue with violet reflections. On the nose, it delivers an elegant bouquet of ripe blackcurrants, black cherries, and subtle violet, underpinned by notes of cedar, graphite, and sweet spices. The palate is medium to full-bodied, with polished tannins and a lively acidity that lends freshness. Flavours of blackberry, plum, tobacco, and dark chocolate evolve into a refined, persistent finish with a touch of minerality.

Accolades
James Suckling – 91 points.
Decanter – 90 points.

Food Pairing
Ideal pairings include grilled lamb chops, beef tenderloin, wild mushroom risotto, and aged Gouda. These choices complement the wine’s structure and highlight its layered complexity. A perfect match to enhance the wine's depth and character.

title: Chateau Pesquie Terrasses Red 2023 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This red wine signed Château Pesquié comes from a blend of the best red berried grapes of the Rhône Valley: Grenache and Syrah. The name is inspired by the characteristic terraces, Terrasses in French, which cover the wine-growing area of Ventoux.

Following the pressing of the bunches, the must is enriched in color and aromatic substances through a 15-day maceration. Then it stops for a long time in refinement, at the end of which it undertakes a natural process of clarification.

The color is deep ruby red. The sense of smell moves on spicy sensations, black pepper above all, and red berried fruits. The palate is fresh and balanced, with tannins characterized by a great softness.

Versatile in the food-wine pairing, it goes well with pizza and rustic cakes but also with grilled red meat.

title: Giffard Guignolet Cherry
bodyHtml: French aperitif made according to the traditional method of maceration of “griottes Montmorency” cherries in alcohol and darker and sweeter cherries to which was added a hint of kirsch.

title: Chivas Regal XV Blended Scotch
bodyHtml:
Raise a dram with Chivas XV. This 15-year-old whisky is selectively finished in cognac casks for a truly luxurious blended Scotch whisky. Get ready to elevate your night. Because success is a blend, in life and in Scotch.

Created in 2018 by Master Blender Sandy Hyslop, Chivas XV is a celebratory way to enjoy blended Scotch whisky. This blend is laid down to rest for a minimum of 15 long years, represented by the Roman numerals XV, so that rich flavours are ready for you to enjoy in an instant. Pairing this long maturation with a selective finish in cognac casks results in a truly luxurious and velvety finish. With notes of rich sultanas and touches of warm cinnamon, this is a blend worth toasting to.

title: Glenlivet 14 Year Old 'Cognac Cask Selection'
bodyHtml:
The Glenlivet 14 Year Old is matured in bourbon and sherry casks before being finished in the highest quality ex-cognac casks for at least six months. It's no ordinary single malt!

Nose... Sweet and fruity aromas of honey and apricot jam, with notes of sweet cinnamon bread and subtle sensation of spicy liquorice.

Flavour...  Succulent flavours of mandarins in syrup, ripe poached pears and chocolate-dipped raisins.

Finish...  Incredibly smooth and luscious.

title: Chateau Potensac 2021
bodyHtml:
The estate has been in the same family since time immemorial and has always been handed down by women. The current owner, Jean-Hubert Delon, inherited the estate from his paternal grandmother, Georgette Liquard. Although close to the river, Potensac is situated on a high point of land in North Medoc. Because of this position, the site has been populated since ancient times. The name "Medoc" in fact comes from "medio aquae" which means "in the middle of the waters"…
Planted on the best quality soils in the Ordonnac district, the vineyards now extend over 84 hectares on a terroir where the typical characteristics of each grape variety express themselves very distinctly and give the wine superb ageing potential.

title: Notaboo E.T. 51 Premium Amber Rum
bodyHtml:
Notaboo E.T.51 Premium Rum is a unique creation. Almost all rum distillers use the juice of sugar cane to produce heavy rums, commonly known as agricultural rums. As result of technological innovation, they use the sugar cane juice to ferment and produce a derivative of dense sugar cane, which is then distilled to produce a base spirit to make clear rum.

The master distillers of Notaboo, however, have creatively used pomegranate juice to make "dense pomegranate" first, which is skillfully paired with dense sugar cane to create a unique, more layered, and anticipated rum than light and heavy rums, with a hazy light pink colour, full of spirituality and a more fascinating flavour. They strive to allow consumers to feel enchanted and surprised, like entering an intergalactic orchard, a world away and unparalleled. It is true that the oak barrels have been settled over the years, overflowing with the splendid fragrance of the wine, the ultimate restraint of the connotation, but also reflect the excellence of Canada's charming and pure nature, and the diligent pursuit of artisanal simplicity. So much so that many tasters feel that this rum is about to become a flagship of Canadian rum. Its enchantingly user-friendly packaging also surpasses beauty.

The amber colour of Niagara Falls, the light amber colour of the glass, the light mist of fruit, the original sugar cane taste, but also the unmistakable taste of pomegranate.

title: Escorihuela Gascon 1884 Malbec 2023
bodyHtml: A vibrant red with violet tones. The aroma and palate of this Malbec are a delicate blend of forest fruits, plum and cherry. Smooth and concentrated tannins in the mouth result in a long and firm finish with minor hints of oak.

title: Pellegrino Fine IP Marsala
bodyHtml: A blend of grillo, catarratto and inzolia offers up a mix of maderised nutty, toffee flavours. The entry is dry and fresh with a warm spicy finish. Perfectly suited to recipes such a veal scaloppini Marsala or serve it chill with toasted almonds, Sherry-like, by the fireplace. It spends one-year in oak barrels.

title: Novaia Amarone Corte Vaona 2019
bodyHtml:
Azienda Agricola Novaia is situated on the ancient paved barnyard, or 'Corte Vaona,' which has been the property of the Vaona family since the mid-18th century. 

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep garnet red colour. It has an intense and complex bouquet, showcasing hints of ripe red fruit, jam, coffee, bitter chocolate, and tobacco. The palate is rich bodied, generous, and velvety, with a persistent finish that offers flavours of almond, cherry jam, spices, and tobacco. It exhibits a beautiful structure with high extract, well-balanced alcohol, and a particularly intense mineral note on the finish.

Food Pairing

This powerful, structured Amarone pairs wonderfully with equally robust and rich dishes. Traditional pairings include braised or roasted red meats, game, and stews.

title: Alvear Pedro Ximenez (PX) de Anada 2021 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Alvear, a winery with over 280 of history is currently under the ownership of the eighth generation of the same family. This sweet wine is made using only Pedro Ximénez (100%) grapes that are taken from vineyards planted on calcareous soils which are situated near the Sierra de Montilla y Moriles.

title: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Established well over a century ago, Grand Marnier is still made using the original recipe of Cognac blended with the essence of exotic, Caribbean-grown bitter oranges. Enjoy aromas and flavours of orange zest combined with the spicy and fruity notes of fine Cognac. Sip after a meal or use in classic cocktails.

title: De Martino Carignan 'Vigno' 2018
bodyHtml:
Since 1934 the De Martino family has specialized in producing wines that reflect their origin and the character of each vineyard, based on solid principles of sustainable farming and traditional winemaking techniques. The winery brings together the experience of the third generation of the family, represented by Pietro, Marco and Remo De Martino with the dynamism and vision of Marco Antonio and Sebastián De Martino, the fourth generation. De Martino labelled and exported Chile’s first Carmenere in 1996 and was a pioneer winery working century-old vineyards in the Itata Valley, incorporating old winemaking techniques that set a precedent in South America.
 
Bright ruby colour, with intense aromatics or ripe black cherries, blackberries and a mineral smoky note. Shows a fresh and juicy acidity backed with ripe fruit notes and firm fine grained tannins. Medium-bodied with remarkable length, intensity and complexity.

title: The Busker Triple Cask Blend Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml: The Busker Triple Cask Triple Smooth is an extraordinary Blend made with a high-quality Single Grain and a very high percentage of Single Malt and Single Pot Still. It is a beautiful yellow-gold coloured whiskey with an unmistakable rich body. The nose often leads off with tropical fruits and vanilla notes. The journey continues with notes of malt, sweetness and dark chocolate, while more subtle notes of toffee fudge and cinnamon add intensity. The whiskey concludes with a mellow, well-balanced, sweet finish.

title: Louis Roederer Carte Blanche (NV)
bodyHtml:
Carte Blanche reflects the traditional style of the fine wines from Champagne of the 19th century. It is a soft and creamy Champagne, releasing a pure fruit that gives it a lovely vibrant character. After a few years ageing in the cellar, it has reached perfect maturity and, thanks to the Louis Roederer art of blending, shows astonishing freshness and subtlety. Aged between 3 and 4 years in their cellars, Carte Blanche expresses itself with a rich, creamy texture that contrasts with its freshness. It unleashes a succession of delectable notes of cooked fruit, baked apple, white flowers, almond and frangipane. This lovely, well-balanced epicurean champagne is an instant hit.

A champagne with a luscious character that does not fade with the passing years.  - Jean-Baptiste Lécaillon, Cellar Master

91 Points - Vinous    The NV Demi Sec Carte Blanche is a beautiful wine in this style, with striking textural depth and nuance. Pear, apple, jasmine and mint notes abound in a very pretty, highly expressive Champagne to drink over the next few years. This is an impeccable wine in the Demi-Sec style. This release is based on the 2010 vintage. The higher level of sugar works beautifully to balance some of the austerity seen in other 2010s here such as the Rosé. Dosage is 38 grams/Liter. 

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast    The wine is only just off dry, giving a wine that is deliciously crisp and fruity. Ripe apple and creamed pear flavors are lifted by balanced acidity. The fruitiness and the just off-dry character make this a wine that would be just as good as an apéritif as with food. 

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate    The NV Extra-Dry Carte Blanche is based on the Brut Premier, but receives a higher dosage of 16 grams per liter. Even though the Carte Blanche naturally shows a bit more sweetness than the Brut Premier it also maintains considerable focus and energy. Here the expression of fruit tends towards brighter, more floral white fruits, green apples/pears. The wine's balance and length are first rate.

16.5/20 Points - Jancis Robinson    Pretty, aromatic nose. Medium dry and nicely balanced. Zesty. Lime flavours.

title: Poderi Dal Nespoli Prugneto Sangiovese di Romagna Superiore 2021
bodyHtml:
This vibrant red wine hails from Italy, specifically the Emilia Romagna region and the Forlì subregion. Poderi dal Nespoli is situated in the Bidente Valley, a locale noted for being the first 'Bio-Symbiotic District' in Italy. Founded in the late 1920s, the winery achieved a significant milestone in 1960 when the family transitioned from running a local trattoria to focusing entirely on high-quality viticulture. Today, the estate is led by the fourth generation of the Ravaioli family, who maintain a philosophy of communicating history and terroir through collaboration with esteemed winemakers like Riccardo Cotarella to showcase the true potential of Romagna Sangiovese.

Wine Description

The Prugneto Sangiovese di Romagna Superiore presents a brilliant and intense ruby red colour in the glass. The nose offers a generous and fruity bouquet dominated by aromas of cherry, plum, and red berries, layered with floral notes of violet and hints of dried flowers and black pepper. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and well-structured, where a lively freshness harmonizes with soft, silky tannins.

title: Kujira 5 Year Old Single Grain Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Kujira 5 Year Old is a distinctive single grain Japanese whisky produced by the Masahiro Distillery in Okinawa, Japan's southernmost prefecture. Established in 1883, the distillery draws on over 140 years of expertise in crafting Awamori (a traditional Okinawan rice spirit). This expression is part of the "Ryukyu Whisky" category, which utilizes 100% premium Indica rice and black koji for fermentation. The subtropical climate of Okinawa plays a vital role in its development, as the high heat and humidity accelerate the interaction between the spirit and the wood, resulting in a depth of flavor typically associated with much older whiskies.

Whisky Description

This whisky presents a bright amber colour. The nose is inviting and sweet, featuring dominant aromas of caramel, vanilla, and a touch of liquorice, supported by the woody structure of virgin oak. On the palate, the body is smooth and mellow, delivering flavors of sweet toffee, fresh vanilla, and dried fruits like plums and cherries. The use of first-fill white oak casks introduces attractive tannins and a gentle spice profile of pepper and oak shavings. The finish is persistent and sweet, leaving a lingering trail of baking spices and woody textures. It is bottled at 43% ABV.

Food Pairing

The smooth, caramel-forward profile of Kujira 5 Year Old makes it an excellent companion for savory and umami-rich dishes. It pairs particularly well with grilled squid with butter garlic sauce or oyster croquettes, where the whisky's sweetness balances the salty, oceanic flavors. Its tropical and woody notes also complement roasted poultry or glazed pork ribs. For dessert, try it alongside crème brûlée, vanilla-based puddings, or dark chocolate, which highlight the spirit's innate caramel and spice characteristics.

title: Kujira 10 Year Old Single Grain Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Kujira 10 Year Old Single Grain Whisky is a premium spirit from Japan, specifically originating from the subtropical island region of Okinawa. It is produced by Masahiro Shuzo (also known as Masahiro Distillery), which was founded in 1883 by Shobun Higa. The distillery has a long history tracing back to the Ryukyu Kingdom era, and it was the first to receive a license for producing Awamori, Okinawa's indigenous spirit.

Description

This single grain whisky is distilled from 100% premium Indica rice and utilizes black koji for saccharification and fermentation. It is matured for a decade in virgin American white oak casks, benefiting from Okinawa's humid climate which accelerates the aging process.

  • Colour: It possesses a deep amber hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is fresh and sweet, featuring scents of honey, nectar, and brown sugar accompanied by floral notes, soft oaky aromas, and sapwood spices reminiscent of bourbon.

  • Palate: It offers a buttery mouthfeel with flavours of soft caramel sauce, baked bread, liquorice, and warm spices such as cloves and cinnamon.

  • Body: The body is described as rounded and complex due to its tropical maturation.

  • Finish: The finish is long and spicy, with a slight pleasant bitterness that balances the initial sweetness.

  • ABV: This whisky is bottled at 43% alcohol by volume.

Food Pairing

The versatile tropical character of this whisky makes it an ideal companion for a range of dishes.

  • Seafood: Grilled prawns or sashimi can emphasize the subtle maritime and iodine notes of the spirit.

  • Meats: Its rich structure pairs well with roasted meats such as steak or lamb chops.

  • Spicy Cuisine: The warm spice profile complements curries and dishes featuring ginger or lemongrass.

  • Desserts: Tropical fruit desserts like mango sticky rice or passion fruit tart pair exceptionally well with its sweet notes.

  • Cheese: Mature cheeses like aged Gouda or blue cheese can smoothly carry out the whisky's complexity.

title: Wayne Gretzky 99 Proof Whisky
bodyHtml: The Great One's third spirit release is a small batch whisky matured in bourbon barrels for three years and finished in wine cask (Cabernet Sauvignon) for 100 days. An expansive nose of toffee, dried fruit,anise and sweet smoke leads to a palate of raisin, ginger, nut and liquorice root and ends in a long, lingering finish.

title: Havana Club Cuban Smoky Dark Rum
bodyHtml: In the world of rum lovers, the Havana Club Cuban Smoky can be considered a real rule-breaker. A rum base used in its liquid has been aged in malt whisky barrels from Islay in Scotland. This gives the Cuban Smoky added body, complexity and its signature smoky notes, which can be fully appreciated with a simple neat serve over ice. A great ingredient for a special cocktail! Are you ready to step up to Smoky?

title: Domaine Seguin Manuel Macon Villages 2022
bodyHtml: Pale gold colour. On the nose, it shows pure aromas of grapefruit and floral nuances. Very clean and straightforward on the palate, it develops a combination of honeysuckle and grapefruit aromas. The wine shows great purity.

title: Alain Geoffroy Chablis 'Domaine Le Verger' 2023
bodyHtml: West of Chablis, on the left bank of the Serein, Alain Geoffroy's estate occupies some fifty hectares where the whole family ensures its sustainability. Aged in vats to preserve the freshness of the fruit, this Chablis expresses itself through fruity, floral, vegetal and mineral notes in a tight and long palate. Satisfying as an aperitif and versatile at the table, it is the perfect candidate for a plate of fresh oysters.

title: Alois Lageder Pinot Grigio Riff 2025
