bodyHtml: Brilliant straw-yellow colour with a green tint. Fine, fruity, forward varietal aromas. Fresh, lively, precise, medium-bodied with a fresh mouth-watering finish, dry and crisp. Pair with starters, poultry, white meat and pasta.

title: Monasterio De Las Vinas Crianza 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Ruby colour with a garnet rim. It’s aromatic with sensations of blueberries, raspberries, cloves and smoke. The wine is smooth and well balanced and fills the mouth with flavors like raspberries and ground red pepper seeds.

title: Braida di Bologna Moscato d'Asti Vigna Senza Nome 2022 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: The 'Vigna Senza Nome' (no-name vineyard) has a highly aromatic nose which is characteristic of the Moscato d’Asti wi th delicate notes of grapes, orange blossoms, jasmine and elderflowers. Soft floral notes and the sweet primary grape aromas are translated well onto the palate. Pleasantly refreshing, with soft notes of orange blossom and honeyed stone fruit with a clean finish. A beautiful, high-quality Moscato for any occasion.

title: Brinley Gold Shipwreck Vanilla Rum
bodyHtml: Blended with natural Madagascar vanilla. Sweet, creamy, natural vanilla taste.

title: Summerhill Reserve Barrel Red Multi-Vintage
bodyHtml:
A masterpiece blend of organic Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Zweigelt, Syrah, and Pinot Noir grapes. Select reserve barrels from 2012, 2013, 2014 and 2015 vintages were carefully chosen and blended to express the best of warm and cool years in the Okanagan Valley. Extended barrel aging allowed each variety to mellow and harmonize before blending and bottling.

This elegant, medium-bodied red is bursting with notes of red plum, black cherry, cedar and licorice. Soft and bold on the palate with enticing flavours of ripe cherry, fig, mocha and star anise. Firm, round tannins and refreshing acidity lead to a lengthy finish. Delicious on its own or with barbecued meats, aged cheeses, and hearty bean dishes.

title: Bombay Sapphire - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Clear water white. Complex mix of herbs and juniper on the nose with crisp lemon peel and citrus flavours. Smooth and refreshing.

title: Argiano Solengo 2022
bodyHtml:
This prestigious Super Tuscan red wine originates from Italy, crafted in the southern district of Montalcino in Tuscany. Founded in 1580, Argiano is one of Montalcino's most historic and respected estates. In 1995, legendary winemaker Giacomo Tachis (the mastermind behind Sassicaia, Tignanello, and Solaia) collaborated with Argiano to create Solengo, which means "solitary wild boar" in local Tuscan dialect. While Argiano is world-famous for its traditional Brunello di Montalcino, Solengo represents the estate’s modern, internationally acclaimed expression, combining French grape varieties grown in the warm, Mediterranean-influenced clay and limestone soils of southern Montalcino.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2022 Solengo presents an opaque, deep purple-ruby color. The expressive and layered nose opens with dark fruit aromas of black currant, black cherry, and plum, interwoven with savory notes of cedar, sweet tobacco, crushed gravel minerality, dark chocolate, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, opulent, and dense, offering a lush mid-palate balanced by fine-grained, velvety tannins and a vibrant streak of natural acidity. The blend typically consists of Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Merlot, and Sangiovese. The hand-harvested grapes are vinified separately in temperature-controlled stainless steel before aging for roughly 18 months in French oak barrels (a high percentage of which are new). The alcohol by volume sits at approximately 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The deep fruit concentration, firm tannic backbone, and complex savory notes of Solengo make it an ideal partner for rich, structured cuisine. It pairs magnificently with prime cuts of grilled beef, such as Florentine steak (bistecca alla Fiorentina), roasted rack of lamb with herbs, slow-braised beef short ribs, and roasted wild boar or venison. It also pairs exceptionally well with rich pasta dishes featuring wild mushroom or truffle ragù, as well as mature hard cheeses like aged Pecorino Toscano, Parmigiano-Reggiano, or sharp Gouda.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 growing season in southern Montalcino was warm and dry, requiring careful vineyard management and canopy control. Warm summer days were tempered by cool night breezes off the Tyrrhenian Sea, allowing late-ripening varieties like Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot to achieve ideal phenolic maturity while retaining essential structural balance. The 2022 Argiano Solengo delivers impressive fruit density and immediate charm upon release after decanting, while holding the power, depth, and structure to age gracefully in the cellar for 15 to 20+ years.

Accolades

94 Points - James Suckling

"This wine shows bright and precisely defined aromas of cassis, leaves and raspberries. Jammy notes are supported by crisp acidity and a full body, with toasty flavors and elegant tannins. Drink or hold."

93 Points - Wine Spectator

"This is rich, dark and brooding, offering black currant, blackberry and plum fruit shaded by toasty oak. The new oak settles in with aeration, adding a resin note, while accents of iron and tobacco emerge on the finish. Shows fine balance and length. Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Merlot and Sangiovese. Best from 2027 through 2038."

title: J Lohr Cabernet Sauvignon Hilltop 2021 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
For two generations, the Lohr family and their team have been leaders in California wine growing. Founder Jerry Lohr and his three children Steve, Cynthia, and Lawrence oversee one of the country’s most successful and trusted fine wine labels. With first plantings in Monterey in 1972 and then in Paso Robles in 1986, the J. Lohr team helped write the book on sustainable wine growing on the Central Coast.

Dense and soft with elegant layers of black cherry, currants, and toasted pastry.  Delicious with rosemary-seasoned ribeye and garlic roasted potatoes with parsnips and fennel.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Baked black cherry, blackberry jam topped toast and light caramel aromas are well-integrated on the nose of this popular wine. Ripe black cherry flavors hold through the palate, where coffee bean and more caramel elements contribute to the familiar finish.

title: Frescobaldi Montesodi Toscana 2017
bodyHtml:
Frescobaldi, a distinguished name in Italian winemaking, has been crafting exceptional wines for over 700 years. The family's Castello Nipozzano estate, located in the heart of Tuscany's Chianti Rufina region, is celebrated for its rich history and unwavering commitment to quality. Within this estate lies the renowned Montesodi vineyard, known for its stony terrain and ideal conditions for producing Sangiovese of remarkable depth and complexity.

The 2017 Montesodi Toscana is a 100% Sangiovese wine that showcases the varietal’s elegance and structure. It presents an intense ruby-red color with tinges of purple, reflecting its concentration and vibrancy. The nose is expressive, with aromas of ripe red fruits and citrus, enhanced by subtle tertiary notes of spice and vanilla from aging. On the palate, the wine is rich and dense, with a refined texture, mature tannins, and a persistent, balanced finish that underscores its quality.

This wine pairs beautifully with grilled meats, particularly bistecca alla fiorentina, as well as rich pasta dishes or aged Pecorino cheese. Together, these pairings elevate the wine’s complexity and create an unforgettable dining experience.

The 2017 vintage in Tuscany experienced a warm growing season, which led to early ripening and a harvest that began in early September. Despite the heat, the Montesodi vineyard’s unique terroir allowed for the creation of a wine that maintains exceptional balance and expression, reflecting the skill and care of Frescobaldi’s winemaking team.

title: Dae Jang Bu 25 Soju - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Distilled from 100% premium Korean rice and milled 24%, Dae Jang Bu is manufactured with craftsmanship to achieve full bodied flavour with mildest taste.

title: Two Hands Shiraz Angels Share 2025
Mirada Organic Rose 2025
bodyHtml: Sedosa means silky, synonym of elegance, freshness and softness. A well rounded wine, balanced and made to enjoy quietly in relaxed environments. Pale pink, with aromas of fresh strawberry, citrus and rose petal, finishes nice acidity and minerality on the palate.

title: Chum Churum Mango Soju - 360 ml
bodyHtml:
South Korea, Seoul. Produced by Lotte Chilsung Beverage Co., Ltd., this mango-flavored expression (often labeled as Soonhari Apple Mango) is a major player in the fruit-soju category that revolutionized Korean drinking culture starting in 2006. The brand is famously the world’s first soju made with alkaline water sourced from Mt. Seoraksan, which is processed to have smaller particles and higher mineral content, contributing to its renowned smoothness.

Description

This clear, distilled spirit offers a refreshing twist on traditional soju by infusing it with tropical fruit extracts. The nose is bursting with the intense, aromatic fragrance of sun-ripened mango and apple. On the palate, it is light-bodied and velvety, delivering a well-balanced profile that is sweet but not cloying, with vibrant notes of fresh mango pulp and a subtle off-dry finish. Because it is made with alkaline water and natural flavors, it lacks the harsh medicinal bite of traditional higher-proof spirits, making it particularly popular among younger drinkers and those who prefer an easier-drinking alternative to vodka. ABV 12%.

Food Pairing

The sweet and tropical character of mango soju makes it an excellent partner for heat and spice. It is a classic companion for spicy Asian fare, such as fire chicken (buldak), spicy rice cakes (tteokbokki), or kimchi-based stews, as the fruitiness helps soothe the palate. It also pairs delightfully with salty, savory appetizers like Korean fried chicken, fried dumplings, or even a freshly baked apple pie for a dessert-style contrast. For a refreshing summer drink, serve it well-chilled, over ice, or mixed with sparkling water and a squeeze of lime to create a simple mango spritz.

title: Douglas Laing's The Epicurean 12 Year Old Blended Whisky
bodyHtml: The Epicurean is a marriage of some of the finest Lowland Malts; a marriage of the best that the East and the West of Scotland have to offer. His 12 Years Old Small Batch bottling is proudly offered at 46% alcohol strength, and is bursting with honeyed barley, ripe peaches and spice.

title: Douglas Laing's Rock Island 10 Year Old Blended Whisky
bodyHtml: Bottled at 46% alcohol strength and without colouring or chill-filtration, Rock Island 10 Years Old marries together Single Malts from Islay, Arran, Orkney & Jura, resulting in a Whisky that boasts wave after wave of sea salt, wood embers, gentle smoke and orange peel.

title: Lindores Abbey Distillery 'Aqua Vitae'
bodyHtml:
Aqua Vitae is a multi award-winning handcrafted botanical spirit, made on site using spices, dried fruit and locally grown green herbs such as Douglas fir and sweet cicely. With citrus notes and full of sweet and spiced flavours, Aqua Vitae is delicious as a mixed drink or a cocktail base.

The earliest Aqua Vitae was made at Lindores as long ago as 1494, and they’ve authentically recreated that recipe and reimagined it as an inquisitively versatile spirit.

Today, this Aqua Vitae is distilled in pot stills and then infused with a blend of spices and herbs, including cleavers, and sweet cicely, which grow in Lindores' gardens, amidst the grounds of the ancient Abbey. It is entirely natural, with no added sugars.

title: Kentucky Owl The Wiseman Bourbon
bodyHtml: Kentucky Owl's 4-year-old wheat and high-rye bourbons are blended with 5.5-year and 8.5-year-old Kentucky-sourced bourbons. The palate has a light, silky texture. Toasted oak comes through in a honeyed fashion. Freshly prepared oatmeal with a savory, buttery quality follows up. The finish returns to the nose with an artichoke-y vegetal feel, without really skewing bitter.

title: Writers' Tears Double Oaked
bodyHtml: Here, Writers Tears applies bourbon and French oak cognac barrels to the unique marriage of single pot still and single malt Irish whiskeys, arguably the most premium interpretation of the Irish blend. Aromas of dark berry fruit, cinnamon, fudge, milk chocolate, graham crackers, jellied fruit, and a smudge of dry spices. Compelling, well-structured whiskey with cinnamon, chocolate, dark toffee, pepper, and ginger; never cloying, nor overly sweet, just a richly rewarding glass.

title: Dillon's Rose Gin Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Traditional London-style gin infused with rose hips, rose petals, then sweetened. Excellent as an aperitif or in cocktails.

If James Bond could pause to enjoy his martinis, he’d probably demand it be made with Sloe Gin. Plucked from a time when the Britts ruled the world and drank elegantly from their tents in the middle of no where, Dillon’s Rose Gin recipe does it right by infusing seven botanical base with magical Rosehip and Rose petals in such a way that makes even M let her hair down.

title: Dillon's Rye Whisky Three Oaks
bodyHtml: Distilled in copper-pot stills and only produced in small batches, this 100% rye whisky is intensely flavourful, with notes of warm toffee, toasted grain, minty rye spice, coconut and green apple. The whisky takes its 'Three Oaks' name from its maturation process, which involves spending three years in three distinct oak casks.

title: Beso De Vino Garnacha Vinas Viejas 2023
bodyHtml: Ruby black color. Fruity aromas and flavors of blackberry candle, berry-pineapple smoothie, marzipan, hints of olive, and tobacco with a lightly tannic, crisp, fruity medium body and a tingling, refreshing, medium-length finish with firm tannins and light oak flavor. A fruit-forward Garnacha that will pair effortlessly.

title: Chateau La Nerthe Chateauneuf du Pape Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
Château La Nerthe, established in 1560, is one of the oldest estates in Châteauneuf-du-Pape, France. Spanning 227 acres, the vineyards surround the château and extend to the renowned La Crau plateau. The estate is certified organic, reflecting its commitment to sustainable viticulture.

Wine Description
It presents a deep ruby hue. On the nose, it offers aromas of blackberry, raspberry, wild strawberry, licorice, dried herbs, cloves, and hints of mint. The palate is full-bodied and concentrated, with lively acidity and velvety tannins, leading to a sapid finish. Aged for 12 months in French oak casks and barrels, this wine is expected to develop further complexity over the next decade.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with roasted lamb, beef stew with 'grand veneur' sauce, or duck fillet. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Angels & Cowboys Proprietary Red 2022
bodyHtml:
Crimson-rosewood in colour and bursting with deep berry fruit, the wine opens with juicy briar berry, cassis, and plum and rolls over the palate in waves of tart cherry, fig jam, and grenadine. Earthy dimensions of Syrah and Petite Sirah lend grounding savoury elements of pepper and anise, while the abundant fruit notes of Zinfandel and Grenache suggest strawberry and balsamic. This wine tapestry is woven with a continuity of French oak that brings sweet spice reminiscent of toffee and gingersnap. Medium-firm tannins lend mid-palate structure, and the finish is plush and warm.

Zinfandel-based with a supporting cast of Syrah, Carignane, Petite Sirah, and Grenache.

title: Casa E. di Mirafiore Barbera d'Alba Superiore 2020
bodyHtml:
The history of Casa E. di Mirafiore began in 1878 when it was founded by Emanuele Alberto Count of Mirafiore, the son of Italy’s first King. As a noble farmer-entrepreneur, he approached winemaking with a modern vision for his time, using his estates in Barolo and Serralunga. The winery's philosophy is rooted in the "unconditional tradition" of Piedmontese winemaking, combined with a contemporary approach for optimization.

Wine Description

The bouquet is complex, offering notes of crushed blackberries, ripe black plum, orange peel, cedar, leather, black licorice, and coffee. On the palate, the wine delivers a warm feeling of volume and body, with dark fruit flavours like black cherries, sour cherry, blackberry jam, and brandied black cherry. Subtle hints of mocha, earth, tobacco, cinnamon, and mint add complexity. This well-delineated red is supported by a refreshing acidity that blends marvellously with soft, yet present, velvety tannins.

Food Pairing

This full-bodied Barbera d'Alba Superiore, with its robust fruit and refreshing acidity, is a perfect match for rich dishes such as pasta, meat dishes, game, and grilled or baked red meats. It also pairs beautifully with fresh, medium, or mature cheeses.

title: Barsol Pisco Quebranta
bodyHtml:
Crafted in small batches and estate bottled, BarSol is the ultimate artisanal Pisco from Ica, Peru, distilled to bottle proof and neither water nor other ingredients are added to the sole grape juice that is fermented into a perfect wine before it is distilled, thereby creating an exceptional spirit of exquisite purity, clarity and smoothness. Highly awarded for its superior taste, BarSol is the perfect reward for all occasions.

Aroma: pear, red apples, fresh cut grass complimented with dry fruit and pastry notes, fresh cream and cacao, balanced with delicate citrus notes.

Taste: ripe pear, red apples, red grape, citrus notes, roasted almond, walnuts and pecan, dark chocolate, cereal, dried apricot and ripe dark berry fruit.

Finish: round, elegant, long.

title: Domaine Servin Chablis Vieilles Vignes 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This exemplary white wine originates from France, specifically the Chablis region of Burgundy. The Servin family has a storied history in the area, with roots in winemaking dating back to 1654. Today, the estate is directed by François Servin and Mark Cameron, who manage 37 hectares of some of the most famous slopes in Chablis. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a respect for tradition, such as the use of 'Sélection Massale' (uncloned Chardonnay) and hand-harvesting for top cuvées, while utilizing stainless steel to preserve the hallmark finesse and freshness of the Chardonnay grape.

Wine Description

The Chablis Vieilles Vignes displays a brilliant pale straw colour. The nose is airy and cool, offering pretty aromas of white orchard fruit, lemon-lime, and a distinct 'sea breeze' character, with a discreet application of wood that adds complexity without being toasty. On the palate, the wine is intense and medium-bodied with excellent volume. It delivers a 'fruit salad' of flavours including green apple, citrus zest, and peach, underpinned by a saline, mineral backbone and a touch of spice.

Produced from vines over 40 years old, this 100% Chardonnay is richly textured and generous. It is well-balanced, featuring a fine spine of acidity that leads to a clean, long, and youthfully austere finish.

title: Waterford The Cuvee Single Malt
bodyHtml:
The Waterford distillery rigorously applies the ancient terroir methodology to today’s verdant landscape of Ireland, home of the world’s finest barley. Now for the first time in single malt whisky, unashamedly inspired by the legendary châteaux of France, they have reached the apogee of this radical philosophy. The Cuvée, a synthesis of Single Farm Origins, an enigmatic gestalt, a milestone in the journey. 

Appearance: Golden sunrise with intense oils.

Nose: Red apples, fresh dry soil, breadcrust, green foliage, lavender, digestive biscuits, oranges, barmbrack, over ripe banana skin, a summer flower bed, fresh mint, coffee cake.

Taste: Clove sweets, white pepper, oily, grapefruit, lemon zest, dark chocolate, dry toast, cherries, granola bar, dried herbs, aniseed, green olives, 3 peel marmalade.

Finish: Pepper up front with oily spiciness that softens, starts dry but then gets mouth-watering and lingers where you close your eyes and relax!

title: Forty Creek Confederation Oak Reserve
bodyHtml: A celebration of both Canada’s 1867 Confederation, and Canadian ingenuity. This whisky is finished for up to 2 years in new Canadian Oak barrels, which have a tighter grain due to Canada’s colder climate, and impart a truly Canadian flavour profile.

title: Buccella Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
bodyHtml: An enticing nose of luxurious red fruit, plum and raspberry leaps from the glass. Complemented by darker notes of coco powder, blueberry and creamy vanilla makes this a multifaceted wine. Their signature crimson dark red colour makes their 2018 a visually stunning wine. Silky smooth tannins enhance the wine’s vibrancy and energy allowing immediate pleasure upon release but assure the potential for the development of aged complexity for the next 20+ years.

title: King's Lock Whiskyjack Rye
bodyHtml: King's Lock uses the same recipe as their Prescott White Rye, but here they age the spirit highlighting oaky spicy notes. Unbelievably smooth due to their double distillation process. Hints of the full-bodied rye grain remain to make this an incredible whisky on ice!

title: Chateau Vartely Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: Chateau Vartely Sauvignon Blanc is a generous bouquet of fresh aromas dominated by invigorating citrus notes. Its pleasant taste leaves a faint memory of black currant leaves. The grapes are harvested in vineyards in the heart of Moldova, Codru region.

title: 1573 National Cellar Guojiao Baijiu - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Luzhou Laojiao Co., Ltd., this prestigious spirit is crafted in fermentation cellars that have been in continuous use since 1573 AD during the Ming Dynasty. These 'National Treasure Cellars' are the oldest continuously operating baijiu cellars in the world and are recognized as a Cultural Relic of National Importance.

Description

This ultra-premium baijiu is colourless and transparent, representing the pinnacle of the strong-aroma (Nongxiang) style. The nose is floral and surprisingly mellow, offering inviting fruity scents of white peach, grilled pineapple, honey, and pine resin. On the palate, it delivers a velvety mouthfeel with a pure and intense burst of candied sweetness, complemented by umami notes of liquorice, sesame, and seaweed. The finish is long and refreshing, featuring a raisin-like quality reminiscent of fine grappa and a lingering, elegant fragrance. ABV 52%.

title: Domaine Delobel Pineau D'Aunis La Parenthese 2022
bodyHtml: Pineau d'Aunis, a little-known grape variety that nevertheless deserves to be! A wine that is both light and powerful, a curiosity. Remarkable long and peppery finish. Manual harvesting, optimal maturity and very gentle extraction give this Pineau d'Aunis typical aromas of spices and pepper with a nice roundness thanks to aging in oak barrels for a few months. Ideal accompaniment to charcuterie dishes, grilled beef, sweet/savoury Asian cuisine and cheese.

title: Black Market The Syndicate Red 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Canada, specifically from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. Black Market Wine Company is an artisanal winery based in Kaleden, founded by Rob Hammstra and Michelle Shewchuk. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on small lot production using traditional techniques to showcase the unique character of premium vineyards in the South Okanagan and Similkameen Valleys.

Wine Description

The Black Market The Syndicate Red displays a deep garnet colour. The nose is complex and inviting, featuring aromas of ripe plum, black cherry, and cassis, layered with notes of vanilla, tobacco, and dried herbs. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and well structured, offering flavours of dark berries, cocoa, and subtle baking spices. It is characterized by its balance of power and elegance, with firm but velvety tannins and a long, lingering finish. This Bordeaux style blend typically consists of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot. The ABV is approximately 14.2%.

title: Strathcona Spirits Badland Seaberry Gin
bodyHtml: Distilled in the traditional London dry style, this dynamic gin is the expression of 10 unique botanicals. A portion of the juniper used is wild foraged from the fossil-filled Badlands along the Red Deer River. To help balance some of the other botanicals they also employ the sour, bitter, tangy, native Seaberry which can be found growing all over the City of Edmonton, which is where they pick it.

title: The Gladstone Axe American Oak Whisky
bodyHtml: Every batch of Gladstone Axe American Oak is made from 100% malted barley and aged in American oak barrels previously used for bourbon production. Aging their scotch whisky in ex-bourbon barrels imparts mellow sweet notes to the blend of malt whiskies that compose this one-of-a-kind scotch. Gladstone Axe American Oak is made from a selection of malt whiskies from 14 different Highland and Islay malt distilleries.

title: Lingua Franca Estate Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
The Lingua Franca Estate Chardonnay is a 100% estate-grown wine from the Eola-Amity Hills subregion of the Willamette Valley, Oregon, USA. Co-founded in 2015 by Master Sommelier Larry Stone and renowned Burgundian winemaker Dominique Lafon, the winery was acquired by Constellation Brands in 2022 as part of its luxury Aspira portfolio. Winemaking is overseen by Thomas Savre, who focuses on organic and regenerative farming to capture the distinct character and mineral-driven tension of the vineyard's east-facing slopes.

Wine Description

This medium yellow-straw-coloured Chardonnay opens with a bright and lifted nose of lemon sherbet, kaffir lime, and nectarine, accented by notes of jasmine, flinty reduction, and crushed stone. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and concentrated, entering with crisp green apple and creamy lemon that evolve into complex layers of chamomile, ginger, and sea salt. It features a round, unctuous texture balanced by vibrant acidity and a persistent saline finish with notes of lime pith and hazelnut.

Food Pairing

The wine's rich texture and underlying energy make it an excellent accompaniment to subtle yet rich seafood dishes such as halibut with chanterelle sauce, lobster Newberg, or black cod with shellfish sauce. It also pairs beautifully with roasted chicken, creamy risottos, and cheese-rich dishes like fondue or lasagna.

title: Confucius Family Liquor Fu Cang 10 Year Baijiu - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Confucius Family Liquor Fu Cang 10 Year originates from Qufu in the Shandong Province of China. The Qufu Confucius Family Liquor Brewing Co. traces its heritage back to the private family mill of the Confucian Mansion, which began brewing liquor over 2,000 years ago. Historically, this spirit was considered so precious that it was reserved as an honorable liquor for emperors and high-ranking dignitaries. Today, the distillery is one of the largest in the Shandong province, maintaining over 7,200 ancient fermentation pits to preserve its "Chinese cultural liquor" status.

Description

As the flagship product of the Confucius Family range, Fu Cang 10 Year is a premium representative of the Strong Aroma (Nongxiang) style of baijiu. It is crafted using a multi-grain blend of sorghum, barley, wheat, and peas, mixed with purified water. The spirit is crystal clear and presents a marvelous, expressive nose with prominent notes of aniseed and warm, fermented tropical fruits. On the palate, it is surprisingly soft and mellow, offering delicate layers of banana, toasted rice, and subtle hints of soy sauce. It is bottled at 52% alcohol content.

Cultural Heritage

  • UNESCO Heritage Connection: The distillery is rooted in the history of the Temple and Cemetery of Confucius and the Kong Family Mansion, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

  • Intangible Cultural Heritage: The "Confucius Family Liquor Traditional Brewing Technique" is officially included in China's list of Provincial Intangible Cultural Heritage.

  • Ancient Craftsmanship: The production involves long-term fermentation in artificially propagated old cellars and meticulous blending to maintain the ancestral "Private Liquor Workshop" style.

Traditional Service: To best appreciate its heritage, it is traditionally served at room temperature in small glasses or cups during social toasts.

title: Chiyomusubi Shuzo Goriki 50 Junmai Ginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Chiyomusubi Shuzo Goriki 50 Junmai Ginjo is a premium sake from Tottori Prefecture, Japan. Founded in 1860, the Chiyomusubi brewery has remained under the dedicated stewardship of the Okazora family for several generations. The brewery is renowned for its commitment to traditional methods and its focus on local ingredients from the Sanin region.

Description

This sake presents a crystal clear colour and opens with an elegant aroma of white peach, melon, and soft floral notes. On the palate, it offers a medium body with a refined balance of subtle sweetness and refreshing acidity. The finish is clean and crisp, showcasing the unique complexity of the Goriki rice variety. It has an alcohol content of 16%.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and fruity profile of this Junmai Ginjo make it an excellent partner for fresh sashimi and nigiri. It also pairs beautifully with lightly battered vegetable tempura or grilled white fish seasoned with sea salt. For a local Tottori match, try it alongside snow crab to highlight its delicate savoury notes.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Kocha Tea Umeshu - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Nakano Shuzo, a brewery founded in 1844, this unique expression is part of the brewery's innovative effort to blend traditional Japanese plum wine with global tea culture. The brewery even operates its own plum orchard, "Kuni Zakari Farm," to ensure the quality of the fruit used in their liqueurs. This specific variant is an inspiring marriage of sweet-tart Japanese plums and 100% premium black tea (Kocha), often sourced from high-quality Ceylon or Darjeeling varieties.

Description

This liqueur features a deep, clear amber colour reminiscent of well-brewed tea. The nose is aromatic and sophisticated, lead by the elegant fragrance of black tea and ripe plums, with subtle undertones of apricot and a hint of almond. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with a creamy texture that beautifully balances the refreshing sweetness of the plums with the gentle tannins and slight bitterness of the tea. Unique secondary notes of green persimmon and even a touch of Cuban cigar add a layer of complexity rarely found in standard fruit liqueurs. The finish is clean and floral with a delicate spiced lingering. ABV 12%.

Food Pairing

The "tea-forward" profile and balanced sweetness make this umeshu an exceptional choice for both savory and dessert courses. It pairs wonderfully with a varied cheese platter, particularly aged or hard cheeses, and is a natural companion to fruit based desserts or spicy ginger cookies. For a savory contrast, try it alongside braised duck or roasted nuts. It is incredibly versatile in its serving style: enjoy it chilled neat, over ice, or mixed half-and-half with warm water in winter. For an inventive twist, some enthusiasts recommend mixing it with milk to create a rich, "tea latte" style liqueur drink.

title: Guizhou Guotai Liqour 15 Year Baijiu - 500 ml
Huadu Beijing Er Guo Tou Baijiu - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Huadu Beijing Er Guo Tou is a quintessential representative of Beijing's liquor culture, produced by the Beijing Hua Du Distillery, which was established in 1976. Er Guo Tou, which translates to "head of the second pot," refers to a traditional distillation process discovered during the Qing Dynasty. This method captures the "heart" of the second distillation cycle, ensuring a higher level of purity and a more refined spirit compared to the initial and final runs.

Description

This spirit belongs to the Light Aroma (Qingxiang) category of baijiu, known for being less pungent and more accessible than the "Strong" or "Sauce" styles found in southern China.

  • Aroma: It features a delicate and clean bouquet with distinctive notes of toasted nuts, roasted grains, and light floral hints of jasmine.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it is surprisingly nutty and sweet, with flavors of sorghum, green apple, and a touch of blackstrap molasses. Despite its clarity, it has a robust and intense mouthfeel.

  • Technical Profile: This 750 ml bottling is a high-proof spirit, typically found at 56% ABV. It is crafted from a base of sorghum, wheat, and purified water.

Cultural Heritage

  • The "Working Man's" Spirit: In Beijing, Er Guo Tou is often called the "Coca-Cola of baijius" because of its immense popularity across all social classes, from historical emperors to modern university students and the "hip" urban crowd.

  • Purity through Process: The distillery uses stone or steel fermentation vessels for short cycles (4 to 8 days), followed by resting in ceramic jars. This specific process results in a cleaner, milder aroma that is often compared to a high-proof Italian grappa.

Food Pairing

The "Light Aroma" style is particularly prized for its ability to pair with savory and salty foods without overpowering them.

  • Northern Chinese Cuisine: It is a traditional companion for Beijing staples like Peking duck, hearty meat dumplings (jiaozi), and "Zha Jiang Mian" (fried sauce noodles).

  • Grilled & Roasted Meats: The high alcohol content and clean finish help cut through the richness of grilled lamb skewers, roasted pork, and barbecue.

  • Salty Appetizers: Pairs excellently with salted peanuts, preserved vegetables, and cold-cut appetizers common in Chinese banquets.

  • Modern Mixology: Due to its floral and nutty profile, bartenders often use it as a base for cocktails that feature aromatic ingredients like green tea, cucumber, or lime.

title: Cafaggio Chianti Classico Grab Selezione Basilica Solatio 2017
bodyHtml:
The Cafaggio Chianti Classico Riserva Basilica Solatio is a superb red wine from the Chianti Classico region of Tuscany, Italy. Produced by the esteemed Cafaggio estate, this wine is made from a blend of Sangiovese and Canaiolo grapes and is aged for 24 months in French oak barrels and an additional 6 months in bottle before release.

It has a deep ruby red color and a complex aroma of ripe red fruits, vanilla, and spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied with firm tannins and a long, elegant finish. This wine has received critical acclaim for its balance, elegance, and complexity and pairs perfectly with hearty meat dishes and aged cheeses.

title: Instigator Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: Dark garnet colour. Aromas and flavours of cherry jam, tangerine, spiced peach cobbler, tar, and sage with a round, vibrant, dry-yet-fruity medium-full body and an even, intricate, very long finish that exhibits nuances of ripe strawberry and pencil shavings with light oak flavour. A flavour-packed Cabernet Sauvignon that sings on the palate.

title: Instigator Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml: Golden straw colour. Aromas and flavours of pineapple husk, herbs, marigold, hardwood charcoal, and rubber leaf and sap with a supple, bright, fruity medium body and a seamless, captivating, medium-length finish with notes of chestnut honeycomb, grilled apples, and smoked applewood with moderate oak flavour. A roasty, toasty oak-accented Chardonnay sipper.

title: Rocca Delle Macie Grappa Di Chianti Classico
bodyHtml:
Grappa di Chianti Classico is made from fresh pomace that results from the fermentation of Rocca delle Macìe’s Chianti Classico wine. Immediately after being extracted, the marc is transported to DOMENIS1898, an artisanal distillery in Civitale del Friuli in the north of Italy. The distillation process is performed the following day in a discontinuous copper pot still. The use of low temperature steam (slightly above 100°C) enables the extraction of volatile components from the best pomace without damaging them, especially the aromatic ones.

Color: crystal clear.

Bouquet: intense and clean with pleasant floral and fruity aromas, hints of apple, wild strawberries, ribes and violets.

Taste: warm, balanced and elegant with a fruity long lasting finish.

title: Cava De Oro Black Extra Anejo
bodyHtml:
Cava de Oro Black Extra Anejo Tequila is aged in sherry Oak Barrel to give it a smooth, yet dry finish. It's subtle oak character and delicate caramel, honey, & vanilla notes have been described as "hints of smoke and toasted almonds with cinnamon undertones. Aged for 24 months.

Drinking the best tequila should be enjoyed in style, that's why this bottle comes with a special presentation bottle. This Black extra Anejo tequila is Aged in Sherry Oak barrel, so rich and smooth and perfect for your next party or event.

title: Viberti Barolo Buon Padre 2021
bodyHtml:
Viberti, located in the village of Barolo in the northern Italian region of Piedmont, was founded in the early 20th century by Antonio Viberti, an innkeeper and restauranteur. Wine was produced from the estate vineyards exclusively for the patrons of the family restaurant, Trattoria al Buon Padre. 

In 1967, at a time when Barolo wines were gaining international notoriety, Antonio's son, Giovanni, joined the family business and realized the potential of the estate vineyards to produce superior quality, world-class Barolo. After selling wines to restaurant patrons, who came from far and wide to enjoy the local cuisine, the reputation of Viberti Barolo spread leading to demand beyond Piedmont. 

One hundred years after the creation of the Viberti winery, the family's connection to their beloved land of Barolo and its fine red wines remains unbroken as the 3rd generations of the Viberti family, GianLuca and Claudio, joined their father at the winery. Today, under the direction of Claudio, the winery produces varietally accurate, elegantly structured wines with fresh fruit aromas, bold tannins, and vibrant acidity that are approachable upon release, yet reward extensive aging.

Viberti Barolo Buon Padre is a garnet red color. Aromas of spices, undergrowth, game, dried fruit, and leather.

title: Plantation Isle Of Fiji
bodyHtml:
From the pristine lagoons to the lush jungles, Plantation Isle of Fiji is an ode to the beauty of the Fiji Islands. 

This delicious rum is made using traditional techniques and local Fijian sugar cane. First aged in this tropical climate in bourbon casks, the rum is then sailed to the southwest of France for a second maturation in French oak casks. 

This double ageing method paired with Fijian know-how creates a rum with warm notes of exotic fruits and raisin.

title: Shanky's Whip Irish Whiskey Liqueur
bodyHtml: This retro-looking bottle is an Irish whiskey liqueur called Shanky's Whip! A base of spicy Irish whiskey has been infused with vanilla and caramel, so it's super creamy, even though there's no actual cream in it, mind. Plus, the chap on the label is being pulled along by an ostrich. What's not to like?!

title: La Dame d'Angludet 2019
bodyHtml:
La Dame d’Angludet is the new name given to the second wine from Chateau Angludet. While it is true that the vines are young, the stock available today is of much better quality than previously. This makes for more “efficient” vine plants which are able to yield fruit more rapidly. 

This is why today more than ever, La Dame d’Angludet offers the best quality for price in the entire Margaux appellation, offering dazzling aromatic expression and gentle extract, which is sustained yet delicate. Thus renamed, it is a sincere tribute to the women who have contributed directly or indirectly to the history of our property dating from the 12th century.

A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot aged in French Oak.

title: Paul John Oloroso Select Cask
bodyHtml:
A special edition of Indian single malt from the sunny Goan coasts, the Oloroso is a sensational explosion of incredible flavours. With dark mahogany hues, this exquisite expression presents an aromatic tapestry of sherry influenced fragrances of peach and apricot with a light note of molassess and blood orange. Sublimely finished in Oloroso casks, its soft flavours are filed with a nutty chocolate and Melton Hunt cake. The long finish is intense and sweet with delicious heavy spices imbibed from the Oloroso casks and melded with a dash of coffee mocha and sumptuous dark chocolate.Nose :Peach, apricot and light notes of molassess and blood orange.

Taste: Soft and sweet, with nutty chocolate and Melton Hunt cake.

Finish: Long, intense and sweet with delicious heavy spices imbibed from the Oloroso casks, a dash of coffee mocha and sumptuous dark chocolate.

Balance: An intense and a complex single malt with a sensational explosion of incredible flavours.

Colour: Dark Mahogany.

title: Paul John Brilliance
bodyHtml: Produced by John Distilleries in Goa, India, the Paul John range of single malt whiskies named after their Chairman represents a move into premium spirits for a company that is already a big player in the Indian molasses whisky market. Made using Indian 6-row barley from the Himalayan foothills, Brilliance is matured in bourbon barrels for 3-5 years before bottling at cask strength. As with Amrut, the tropical climate cause greater evaporation, around 12-13% a year, but in turn, they show very well at younger ages.

title: Paul John Peated Select Cask
bodyHtml:
This Single Malt astonishes even a seasoned whisky aficionado. Unexpected flavours balance each other, offering the perfect tipple. It is a wholesome Goan experience, packed into every sip.

Nose: The smoky, sweet and earthy fragrances have mellow resonances of spice.

Palate: As the crisp Muscovado and Demerara sugars create layered nuances, the smokiness of the Single Malt sets in, creating a perfect balance. A hint of spice radiates from the hickory and Dominican-style cocoa.

Finish: The delicate finish of this Single Malt has notes of Dominican cocoa laced with the tart edge of marmalade.

Colour: Golden mahogany.

Pairing: This extremely complex whisky needs food that can complement it well. Tender, juicy steaks and blue cheese can help you unravel every nuance of this magnificent malt from Goa.

title: Glencadam 15 Year Old Highland Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Glencadam’s 15 year-old expression, like most of its releases, is aged exclusively in ex-bourbon casks to retain the distillery character. The whisky is not chill-filtered and has no added coloring, and is bottled (now) at 46% ABV.

Nose: Perfumed, and very floral. Rosewater, lilac, orange blossom, honeysuckle. Next, a wave of green banana, lime salt-water taffy, and kiwi. Exceedingly delicate, and all of the individual notes are ephemeral and fleeting. Underneath the perfume notes is a very thin foundation: very pale malt, mineral water, and banana leaves.

Palate: Medium body, not quite syrupy. A moderate tongue burn is followed by densely sweet honey, fondant, and buttercream frosting. Rosewater, again, with pistachio and nougat. Despite all the sugary notes, it is not cloying.

Finish: Medium-short. Still sweet, with a reprise of some of the floral notes from the palate (nice to see those come full-circle). Fades slowly with pear pastilles, bubblegum, and no bitterness at all.

title: Amrut Kadhambam Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Kadhambam means 'mixture' or 'combination', and this Amrut certainly lives up to its name: a vatting of normal and peated Amrut that started life in ex-oloroso casks before being transferred first into brandy casks, then into rum casks (both the rum and brandy having been produced at Amrut also). A curious mixture, this is a unique and thrilling whisky.

Nose : Rich and floral, honeyed, nutty, new oak, vanilla, lifted fruit aromas of citrus and tropical fruits;

Taste : Candied fruits, subtle oak with a light dusting of peat and integrated spice;

Finish : Warming and complex with a dry, long finish

title: J Lohr Pure Paso Proprietary Red 2023
bodyHtml:
Savoury varietal notes of Cabernet Sauvignon are layered with the dark fruit and spice character of Petite Sirah. The bouquet of cocoa powder, caramel, and anise works in harmony with the black cherry fruit signature of this wine. Bright and focused on the palate with a firm and appetizing finish. This Pure Paso Proprietary Red Wine highlights J. Lohr's house-style, which is acclaimed for its dense and focused fruit signature, coupled with a soft, approachable palate.

Serve with Santa Maria-style grilled tri-tip seasoned with a simple garlic, salt, and pepper rub, along with grilled French bread, fresh salsa, and stewed pinquito beans for a classic coastal California feast.

title: Mirafiore Langhe Nebbiolo 2023
bodyHtml:
From the Langhe, Piedmont wine region, Mirafiore Nebbiolo is dry, juicy and medium-bodied with bright red berries, dried fine herbs, orange zest and briny mineral flavours matched with brilliant acidity and firm tannins. Good now, but will continue to develop and improve with age in bottle. Drink or hold in cellar for 10-plus years.

Nebbiolo food pairings: roast boar, bison burgers, grilled game sausages, venison stew.

title: Massolino Barolo 2021 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Garnet red colour with variable intensity depending on the vintage. The grapes come from different sub-zones in Serralunga and this gives them a broad and variable spectrum of perfumes, ranging from tempting spicy notes to those of a sweeter, floral and fruity nature. A variety of sensations, with a full-bodied, classic and well structured wine which ages well and perfectly represents the important character of the land.

title: Caparzo Brunello di Montalcino 2020 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Founded in the late 1960s, Caparzo is one of the historic estates in Montalcino and was among the first to believe in the potential of Brunello as a world-class wine. Owned since 1998 by Elisabetta Gnudi Angelini, the estate combines tradition and innovation, drawing fruit from prized vineyards in various parts of the Montalcino appellation to express complexity and balance in its wines.

This 2020 Brunello is a classic expression of 100% Sangiovese. It opens with vivid aromas of red cherry, raspberry, and dried rose petals, supported by hints of Mediterranean herbs and subtle tobacco. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied, with lively acidity, finely textured tannins, and layers of wild berry fruit, citrus peel, and earthy spice.

Food Pairing

Enjoy with grilled lamb chops, wild boar ragù over pappardelle, or truffle risotto. These dishes elevate the wine’s savoury undertones and structured finesse.

title: Domaine Le Pive Gris Rose 2021
bodyHtml: Don’t be fooled by the tropical fruit in the nose. This pale pink wine, featuring four grapes, Merlot, Grenache Noir, Grenache Gris, Cabernet Franc, is actually a dry light blend. Perfect for enjoying outdoors on a summer’s eve.

title: Chateau Lagrange 2018
bodyHtml:
Château Lagrange 2018 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the historic Saint-Julien appellation on the Left Bank. Officially classified as a Third Growth (Troisième Grand Cru Classé) in the 1855 Classification, the estate features a large, continuous 118-hectare vineyard planted on deep quaternary gravel terraces over a clay-limestone subsoil. Owned by the Japanese Suntory group since 1983 and led by general manager Matthieu Bordes, Lagrange underwent extensive vineyard restructuring and technological modernizations—including optical sorting and plot-by-plot vinification—that significantly elevated its quality baseline. In the opulent 2018 solar vintage, Château Lagrange delivered a rich, powerful, and deeply concentrated expression of Saint-Julien while preserving its hallmark aromatic precision and freshness.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, opaque dark garnet-purple appearance in the glass with vibrant violet reflections at the rim. It possesses a full-bodied, dense, and muscular structure framed by a plush, velvety, and mouth-filling texture. The sensory profile is rich, expressive, and highly aromatic, opening with an inviting bouquet of crème de cassis, ripe black cherries, wild blackberries, and dark plum preserves, layered over signature Left Bank complexity including graphite, pencil lead, cedar chest, dried violets, cigar box, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, it delivers a dense, fruit-packed core supported by a thick wall of fine-grained, ripe, and silky tannins balanced by a lively line of natural freshness. The finish is remarkably long, structured, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of dark cocoa, licorice, and stony minerality.

  • Varietal Composition: 67% Cabernet Sauvignon, 28% Merlot, and 5% Petit Verdot.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes were harvested between September 20 and October 13 and optically sorted.Fermentation took place plot-by-plot in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats. The wine aged for approximately 21 months in French oak barrels (50% new oak), under the guidance of consultant oenologist Éric Boissenot.

  • ABV: 14.5% to 14.6%.

Food Pairing

The intense structural density, opulent fruit core, and firm tannic architecture of this warm-vintage Saint-Julien make it a superb companion to rich, high-end gastronomy.

  • Fine Meats: Pairs magnificently with grilled prime ribeye, roasted rack of lamb with garlic and rosemary, slow-braised beef short ribs, or tenderloin of beef with a dark red wine reduction.

  • Game & Fowl: Ideal when served alongside pan-roasted duck breast with blackcurrant sauce, venison loin, or roasted wild boar.

  • Earthy Dishes: Complements wild mushroom risottos, truffle-infused pastas, and roasted root vegetables with herbs.

  • Cheeses: Matches gracefully with mature, firm cheeses such as 24-month Comté, aged Gouda, or Beaufort.

Vintage Quality

The 2018 vintage in Saint-Julien was defined by a contrast between a wet spring and a hot, sunny, drought-like summer that extended through harvest. The well-drained gravelly soils over clay subsoils at Château Lagrange played a critical role in retaining subsoil moisture, protecting the old vines from extreme drought stress. This allowed the Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot grapes to achieve complete, uniform phenolic maturity with small berry sizes and concentrated sugar levels. Considered by many critics as one of the finest modern releases produced at the château, the 2018 Lagrange exhibits exceptional power and plush fruit depth. While showing incredible generosity in its youth, its muscular tannic frame guarantees a cellaring window of 30 to 40+ years.

title: Le Domaine d'Edouard Pinot Noir Les Collines de Vaux 2020
bodyHtml:
In the very north of Burgundy, right next to the world-renowned region of Chablis, lies the appellation of Côtes d'Auxerre and Domaine d'Edouard. Edouard Lepesme built his wine resumé as a marketer for negociants of Burgundy and Champagne. In 2011, he started to work in the vineyards and cellars of some of the great domaines in France and around the world. In 2014, he was able to purchase 33 acres in Côtes d'Auxerre, planted to Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Aligoté and Gamay on soils of chalky-limestone. All grapes are grown organically, hand-harvested and with fermented with indigenous yeasts. In the winery, Edouard uses very low amounts of sulfur and no oak, which, combined with the cool climate and careful farming, results in wines of purity, finesse and balance.
 
This wine has a cool edge. Stalky red-currant fruits leave a fresh feel that balances the light tannins and core of dryness.

title: Larimar Rum 5 Year Old 'Bourbon Cask Finish'
bodyHtml:
Larimar, ‘the jewel of the Caribbean’, is a rum honouring the precious stone, after which it is named, that is only found in the beautiful Dominican Republic. The colours in the larimar stone are said to resemble the sunlight dancing beneath the Caribbean Sea. The uniqueness and beauty of the Larimar stone is the inspiration behind the Ron Larimar range of rums.

Nose... Sweet vanilla and honey followed by soft nougat, toasted coconut and lemon zest hints.

Palate... Milk chocolate, cooked pineapple and vanilla pod mixed with sweet golden raisins and nutmeg spices.

Finish... Mellow and balanced with notes of mocha and cake spices.

title: The Fort Distillery Mountain Pass Canadian Whisky
bodyHtml:
Started in 2018, the Fort Distillery is a family-owned company that produces award winning spirits and treats their people like family. Their vision is to craft alcoholic beverages that introduce you to new, yet comfortable experiences.  They want you to try new things, but they also want their products to be easy for you to use.

Mountain Pass is the whisky of the Canadian North, a taste of this beautiful land. Their whisky pays homage to the North by using pure glacier water sourced from the Alpine region of the Canadian Rocky Mountains.

title: The Hess Collection Red Blend Lion Tamer 2022
bodyHtml: Lion Tamer Red Blend explores the relationship between some of the beloved and unusual varietals of Napa Valley. Malbec leads the blend, balancing rich layers of fruit with mouthwatering tannins. Flavors of cassis and boysenberry, subtle notes of milk chocolate, and a lingering finish.

title: Gold Bar Rickhouse Cask Strength Bourbon
bodyHtml: Bold, toasty and rich with pronounced vanilla, spice and smoke. Triple copper pot distilled straight bourbon whiskey, matured in extra charred new American Oak then raked over French oak staves to deliver a complex oak and smoke taste profile with lingering sweetness. Bottled at cask strength 103 proof, non-chill filtered.

title: Bower Hill Single Barrel Bourbon
bodyHtml: Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey with a high Rye mash bill rested in a #3 char new American oak barrel for 4 years or more.  Each barrel is hand selected and bottled one at a time.

title: Country Smooth American Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Country Smooth was developed by the first female founder and CEO of an American Whiskey company as a refined experience to be savoured on its own or enjoyed in cocktails.

Created to delight each of the senses, this Small Batch Straight Bourbon presents itself in medium amber glow, with honey, chocolate, and toasted oak aroma with a cinnamon introduction to the taste buds, followed by the savoury vanilla and caramel smooth finish. Designed to be completely satisfying down to the comforting tobacco scent of the ended glass. Aged at least two years.

title: Few Straight Bourbon Whiskey
bodyHtml: The three grain bourbon recipe unabashedly infuses generations of southern tradition with the spiciness of northern rye and a touch of malt for smoothness. Handcrafted in small batches and aged in charred oak barrels, it is a bourbon of uncommon complexity. Raise a glass to the quintessential American whiskey.

title: Redemption Bourbon Whiskey
bodyHtml: A truly easy-drinking whiskey distinguished by its subtle rye-forward flavour, their bourbon has a rye content of 21%, giving it a light but distinct hint of spice. Enjoy it on the rocks or mixed into your favourite bourbon cocktail.

title: Easy Rider Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml: Easy Rider is made for anyone who loves bikes and bourbon! Easy Rider is a classic Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey, aged 4 years in American White Oak barrels. It is bottled at 80 proof with glacier-fed spring water from Mt. Hood for an easy drinking, smooth and flavourful finish.

title: Bulleit Bourbon Frontier Whiskey - 1.75 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Bulleit Bourbon is inspired by the whiskey pioneered by Augustus Bulleit over 150 years ago. Only ingredients of the very highest quality are used. The subtlety and complexity of Bulleit Bourbon come from its unique blend of rye, corn, and barley malt, along with special strains of yeast and pure Kentucky limestone filtered water. Due to its especially high rye content, Bulleit Bourbon has a bold, spicy character with a finish that's distinctively clean and smooth. Medium amber in colour, with gentle spiciness and sweet oak aromas. Mid-palate is smooth with tones of maple, oak, and nutmeg. The finish is long, dry, and satiny with a light toffee flavour.

title: Chateau De Trinquevedel Tavel Rose 2024
bodyHtml: Expressive nose with notes of little red berries. On the palate, the wine is very balanced and in line with the nose. The palate is full with a long length. Good acidity provides a tense finale. Beautiful complexity, fine, fresh, fruity and elegant Tavel.

title: Yoshida Gassan Houjun Karakuchi Junmai Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Yoshida Gassan Houjun Karakuchi Junmai originates from Yasugi City in the Shimane Prefecture of Japan. The Yoshida Sake Brewery was established in 1743 and has been brewing sake for over 300 years, originally serving as the purveyors for the Hirose clan. The brand 'Gassan' is named after Mount Gassan, home to Tomita Castle, where the finest sake of the year was historically presented to the local Lord.

Description

This classic junmai sake is clear in appearance and is brewed using 100% sake rice, including Gohyaku Mangoku, polished to 70%. It is crafted with 'ultra soft' water, which is recognized as one of the softest brewing waters in Japan. The aromatic profile is refreshing and complex, featuring notes of white grapefruit, cucumber, and white mushroom. On the palate, it offers a mellow yet dry Izumo-style experience with flavours of musk melon, ginger, and mint. It is characterized by a rich, full umami and a crisp, clean finish. The alcohol content is 15% to 15.5%.

Food Pairing

The versatile and dry nature of Houjun Karakuchi makes it an excellent partner for a broad range of cuisines. It pairs exceptionally well with rich seafood dishes such as grilled lobster, seafood pizza, or carbonara linguini. Its umami profile also complements traditional Japanese fare, including sushi, grilled mackerel, and tempura. For meat-based meals, it is a fine accompaniment to yakitori or steak. This sake is unique for its ability to be enjoyed at various temperatures, from chilled at 10°C to warmed at 40°C.

title: Garmon Tempranillo 2021
bodyHtml:
The Garmón winery is a fitting addition to the portfolio of the García family, known for their dedication to quality winemaking. They source their grapes from small plots of old, low-vigour vines and indigenous clones located in high, cold, and continental areas. The winemaking philosophy is rooted in ancestral viticulture, aiming to produce wines that are elegant, refined, and show excellent fruit expression.

Wine Description

The aromatic profile is complex, offering notes of cherry, plum, and hints of violet, complemented by undertones of black tea and subtle ashy notes. Other reviewers detect sophisticated notes of plums, black cherries, cigar wrapper, and a touch of spiced meats.

Food Pairing

Classic regional Spanish pairings like Jamón Ibérico and tapas are well-suited. For a main course, consider grilled red meats such as steak or roast lamb, as the smoky flavours enhance the wine's inherent earthy notes.

title: Cincoro Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: Cincoro Blanco is made with 100% Weber blue agave and is exceptionally smooth on the palate and approachable. While most tequilas are made with agave from either the highland or lowland region of Jalisco, we use both types of agave. By combining agave from two distinct regions, our Blanco tequila is smooth on the palate with great flavor, complexity, and finish.

title: Cincoro Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: Cincoro Anejo gains its remarkable aromas and taste from a very unique aging regimen. Our barrels are imported from Kentucky, and were first used to age Bourbon. By aging Cincoro Blanco in these barrels, we highlight the smoothness of our Blanco, complimented by wood notes from aging 24-28 months in an underground cellar, considerably longer than the minimum 1 year required for Anejo. Subtle notes of toasted oak and maple on the nose, followed by sweet cooked agave, light butterscotch and baking spices on the palate. Remarkably long, elegant finish with lingering notes of dark chocolate.

title: Cincoro Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Cincoro Reposado gains its remarkable aromas and taste from a very unique aging regimen. The barrels are imported from Kentucky and were first used to age Bourbon. By aging Cincoro Blanco in these barrels, they highlight the smoothness of their Blanco with wood notes from aging 8-10 months in an underground cellar, considerably longer than the minimum 2 months required for Reposado. On the nose, Cincoro Reposado has amazing notes of vanilla, baking spices, and toasted oak. On the palate, sweet cooked agave, caramel, and white chocolate.

title: Yoshi No Gawa Toji No Banshaku 'Brewmaster's Choice' Honjozo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Japan, Niigata Prefecture, Nagaoka City. Founded in 1548, Yoshi No Gawa is the oldest brewery in the rice growing heartland of Niigata and the fifth oldest in Japan. For over 20 generations, the brewery has balanced deep-rooted tradition with modern innovation to create clean, elegant sake that serves as a trusted staple for locals.

Description

This Honjozo sake is colourless and displays a natural rice softness with a well-balanced, robust profile. The aromatic bouquet is complex and earthy, featuring notes of sweet bread, shimeji mushrooms, and white truffles. On the palate, it is smooth and rich with flavours of ripe apple, rice cake, toffee, and roasted nuts, complemented by a light minerality. The finish is clean and crisp, making it a highly versatile choice that can be enjoyed chilled or heated. ABV 15.5%.

Food Pairing

Modelled as the daily drink of brewmasters, this sake pairs effortlessly with a wide range of foods including BBQ cheeseburgers, fried chicken, and miso cod. Its creamy texture also makes it a fine companion for chicken Alfredo pasta, mushroom ramen, and fresh salads.

title: Okunomatsu Shuzo Adatara Ginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Okunomatsu Shuzo Adatara Ginjo originates from Nihonmatsu City in the Fukushima Prefecture of Japan. Established in 1716 by a samurai family, the Okunomatsu brewery has a history spanning over 300 years and is currently led by the 19th generation of the Yusa family. The sake is named after Mount Adatara, which provides the brewery with pure subsoil water that has filtered through the earth for roughly 40 years. The brewery’s brewmaster, Keiichi Tonokawa, is one of the most decorated living tojis in Japan.

Description

This Ginjo is designed to be an accessible, high-quality "every night" sake that balances traditional craftsmanship with modern innovation.

  • Aroma: A complex and lively bouquet featuring notes of honeysuckle, jasmine, peach, and distinctive ripe pear, with faint hints of dried pineapple.

  • Palate: It offers a satin-like, silky texture and a medium body. Expect flavors of ripe stone fruits, green apple, and melon, finishing with a subtle, clean crispness.

  • Technical Profile: Brewed using local Tohoku rice polished to 60%, it has an alcohol content of 15% to 15.

Food Pairing

Adatara Ginjo is highly versatile and is noted for its ability to pair with both light appetizers and savory main courses.

  • Seafood & Salads: Complements poached white fish, grilled oysters, steamed clams, and zesty Caesar or green salads.

  • Savoury Classics: Pairs exceptionally well with chicken yakitori, miso-based dishes, and vegetable tempura.

  • Cheese & Dips: Its bright acidity and fruit notes stand up well to creamy dips and a variety of hard cheeses.

  • Serving Tip: To fully appreciate its award-winning aromatics and silky mouthfeel, it is best enjoyed well-chilled in a wine glass or a traditional sake glass.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Citrus Mix Osake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Japan, Aichi Prefecture, Handa City. This vibrant liqueur is produced by Nakano Shuzo, a historic brewery established in 1844 that is celebrated for blending traditional Edo-period craftsmanship with modern innovation. Part of the brewery's popular fruit-based "Osake" series, the Citrus Mix is designed as an approachable, easy-drinking beverage that showcases the diversity of Japan's native citrus fruits.

Description

This fruit-based sake presents a clear and bright appearance in the glass. It is crafted using a complex medley of six different Japanese citrus fruits: yuzu, sudachi, lemon, Hassaku orange, summer mandarin, and Kiyomi orange. The nose is a "burst of sunshine," dominated by the tart and zesty aromas of yuzu and summer orange. On the palate, it offers a refreshing and lively profile with flavours of white grapefruit and the sharp, green citrus notes of sudachi. It strikes a masterful balance between juicy sweetness and crisp acidity, making it taste like freshly picked fruit. ABV 7%–7.5%.

Food Pairing

The high acidity and bright citrus medley of this drink make it an excellent palate cleanser and a versatile companion for lighter fare. It pairs beautifully with fresh salads, such as a Caesar or tossed green salad, and delicate seafood dishes like poached white fish or steamed mussels. Its tartness also complements creamy dips and hard cheeses. For a more casual pairing, enjoy it chilled alongside fried snacks or as a base for a refreshing long drink mixed with soda water and a splash of gin.

title: Nagashima Kenjo Dan Dan Imo Shochu - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Kenjo Dan Dan is a premium Imo (sweet potato) shochu produced by Nagashima Shuzo on Nagashima Island in the Kagoshima Prefecture. The brewery is unique for its collaborative structure, functioning as a cooperative of five different local distilleries that combine their spirits to create a consistent, high-quality house style. The name "Dan Dan" is a regional dialect term for "thank you," reflecting the distillery's gratitude to the local community and the farmers who grow the Satsuma-imo (sweet potatoes) used in production.

Spirit Description

This shochu presents a crystal-clear appearance with a velvety texture. On the nose, it offers the classic, earthy fragrance of roasted sweet potatoes, complemented by subtle notes of floral honey and a hint of steamed rice. The palate is rich and full-bodied, delivering a smooth, rounded sweetness followed by savory, chestnut-like flavors. Unlike more aggressive styles, Kenjo Dan Dan is known for its elegant balance, where the earthy "funk" of the potato is tempered by a clean, lingering finish. It is typically fermented using white koji, which contributes to its bright and refreshing character, and is bottled at 25% ABV.

Food Pairing

The savory-sweet and earthy profile of this shochu makes it a formidable partner for bold, umami-rich dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with Berkshire pork (Kurobuta) belly or grilled sausages, where the spirit's clean finish cuts through the fat. For a more traditional pairing, try it with Miso-marinated vegetables or "Satsuma-age" (fried fish cakes). It is highly versatile in serving style; enjoying it "Oyuwari" (mixed with hot water) emphasizes its sweet potato aroma, while serving it "Rokku" (on the rocks) brings out its crisp, floral undertones.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Jasmine Umeshu - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Nakano Kunizakari Jasmine Umeshu originates from Handa City in the Aichi Prefecture of Japan. Produced by the Nakano Sake Brewery, which was founded in 1844, this liqueur is part of the "Kunizakari" brand—a name that translates to "flourishing along with the growth of Japan". The brewery is unique for operating its own agricultural site, the Kuni Zakari Farm, where employees cultivate and harvest the plums used in their beverages to ensure total quality control from soil to bottle.

Description

This specialty umeshu is a fusion of traditional Japanese plum wine and aromatic jasmine tea. It is designed to offer a "noble fragrance" while balancing the natural sweetness of the plum with the floral astringency of the tea.

  • Aroma: A fragrant blend of sweet plum jam and fresh jasmine blossoms, with sophisticated undertones of tobacco and tea.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it provides a harmonious mix of sweet and tart black plum flavors and tangy plum brandy, complemented by the delicate notes of jasmine tea and hints of almond.

  • Technical Profile: It has a relatively low alcohol content of 9.5% ABV. The base is made from 100% Japanese ume fruits steeped in high-quality spirits and sugar.

Accolades

  • World Sakagura Ranking: The brewery was ranked 10th globally in 2021 and 8th in 2020.

  • Traditional Craftsmanship: The brewery is recognized for combining Edo-period techniques with modern innovation, particularly in the creation of elegant fruit-based liqueurs.

Food Pairing

The versatile sweet-and-tart profile of Jasmine Umeshu makes it an excellent partner for a wide range of dishes, from light appetizers to spicy main courses.

  • Light Fare: Pairs beautifully with Caesar or tossed green salads, deviled eggs, and creamy dips.

  • Seafood: Complements poached white fish, steamed clams, and pasta dishes featuring seafood or pesto sauce.

  • Savory & Spicy: Its floral jasmine notes help balance the heat of spicy Asian cuisine and the richness of braised meats like rabbit.

  • Serving Tips: This liqueur can be enjoyed straight and chilled, on the rocks, or mixed with soda or sparkling water for a refreshing "spritz". In colder months, it can even be mixed with hot water to amplify its floral aromatics.

title: Tamanohikari Gold Omachi Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Tamanohikari Gold Omachi Junmai Daiginjo originates from the historic Fushimi district in Kyoto, Japan. Founded in 1673 by the Nakaya family, the Tamanohikari Sake Brewing Company is currently led by the 13th generation of the founding family. The brewery is celebrated for its 1964 revival of the 'junmai' tradition, a commitment that led them to become one of the few breweries in Japan dedicated exclusively to the production of junmai ginjo and junmai daiginjo grades.

Description

This ultra premium sake is clear in appearance and is crafted using 100% Bizen Omachi rice, an ancient heirloom strain polished to 50%. The aromatic profile is complex and fruity, featuring notes of fresh rainwater, cherry leaves, wildflowers, and a subtle hint of anise. On the palate, it offers a rich and well-rounded body with a 'super soft' mouthfeel and flavours of sweet rice, persimmon, and rich vanilla. It possesses a deep umami character balanced by a refreshing acidity, concluding with a crisp and clean finish. The alcohol content is 16.2%.

Food Pairing

The robust umami and sophisticated structure of this Omachi sake allow it to pair with a wide array of international and Japanese dishes. It is an excellent match for seafood classics such as sushi, sashimi, smoked salmon, and steamed mussels or clams. Its rich profile also complements heavier fare, including cheese fondue, crab and artichoke dip, and pasta with pesto sauce. For a unique pairing, try it with braised rabbit or savoury snacks like bar mix to highlight its earthy undertones.

title: Nakano Kuni Zakari Handa Go Kobo 1801 Junmai Ginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Nakano Shuzo (founded in 1844), this sake is a specific showcase for Yeast No. 1801, a strain prized for creating exceptionally fragrant and floral ginjo aromas. Part of the brewery's "Handago" line, it is named after the historic brewing district of Handa, an area traditionally known for its robust food culture and maritime heritage. It is crafted using locally grown Wakamizu rice, a variety native to Aichi that is tailored to produce a rich, full-bodied umami profile.

Description

This Junmai Ginjo is clear with an "interesting contrast" between its highly aromatic nose and its deep, flavorful palate. The nose is characterized by a splendid ginjo bouquet of ripe pear, banana, jasmine, and white flowers, with subtle secondary notes of chestnut and cereal. On the palate, it is ample and well-balanced, offering a rich umami core with flavors of green apple, grapes, and sweet rice. The texture is silky with a refreshing acidity and a slightly dry, mouth-watering finish. It is brewed with rice polished to 55%. ABV 15%–15.5%.

Food Pairing

Handa Go Kobo 1801 is designed to achieve "synergy" with strong flavors and diverse cuisines. It pairs exceptionally well with traditional Japanese seafood and vegetable dishes such as grilled mackerel, vegetable tempura, and pickled onions. Its rich umami and balanced acidity also allow it to stand up to bolder international flavors, including pork curry with coconut milk, salmon tartare, and even semi-hard cheeses like Manchego. It is best served chilled in a wine glass to fully experience the delicate aromas provided by the 1801 yeast.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Lavender Umeshu - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Nakano Kunizakari Lavender Umeshu originates from Handa City in the Aichi Prefecture of Japan. Nakano Sake Brewery Co., Ltd. was established in 1844 and has continued a legacy of traditional sake brewing for over 180 years. The brewery is renowned for growing plums at its own Kuni Zakari Farm and is currently led by President Masami Nakano, maintaining a philosophy of 'creating a rich food culture through Japanese sake'.

Description

This specialty umeshu is handcrafted by infusing 100% Japanese ume plums with real lavender to create a noble and soothing fragrance. The aromatic profile is defined by a sweet floral bouquet with distinctive hints of mint. On the palate, it delivers elegant flavours of ripe plum, apple, and citrus, which are complemented by sweet herbaceous and earthy notes. The body is smooth and well balanced, leading to a lingering finish that harmonizes fruity sweetness with delicate lavender essence. It has an alcohol content of 9% to 9.5%.

Food Pairing

The floral and fruity characteristics of this lavender umeshu make it an excellent accompaniment to fresh Japanese cuisine such as sushi and sashimi. It serves as a refreshing aperitif and can be enjoyed straight, on the rocks, or mixed with sparkling water to balance the richness of fried dishes. For a dessert pairing, it complements fruit tarts or creamy sweets that highlight its sweet herbaceous notes. It is also highly versatile as a cocktail base, particularly when paired with ingredients like gin, lime, or mint to create a unique Umeshu Mojito.

title: Okunomatsu Junmai Daiginjo Sparkling Sake - 290 ml
bodyHtml:
Okunomatsu Junmai Daiginjo Sparkling is a premium effervescent sake from Nihonmatsu, Fukushima. Produced by the historic Okunomatsu Shuzo (est. 1716), this sake is notable for using a traditional second fermentation in the bottle—the same "methode traditionelle" used in Champagne. This process creates naturally fine, persistent bubbles rather than the coarse carbonation found in lower-end sparkling sakes.

Description

This 290 ml bottling is designed to be a sophisticated alternative to sparkling wine, offering the elegance of a Daiginjo with the refreshment of a sparkling beverage.

  • Aroma: A bright and fruity nose with specific notes of white chocolate, ume plum, toasted almonds, and apple jelly.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it features a frothy, light body with a subtle sweetness. It offers flavors of honey and melon that melt into a zesty, airy finish with hints of crisp apple and radish.

  • Technical Profile: Brewed with local Gohyaku Mangoku rice polished to 50%. It has a low alcohol content of 11% to 11.4% and is quite sweet, with a Sake Meter Value (SMV) of -25 and a lively acidity of 2.5.

Food Pairing

The "creamy" bubbles and high acidity of this sparkling Junmai Daiginjo make it a versatile palate cleanser and an excellent companion for fresh, high-quality ingredients.

  • Raw Seafood: Pairs perfectly with fresh oysters on the half shell, lobster rolls, and whitefish carpaccio.

  • Crispy & Fried: The effervescence cuts through the richness of shrimp tempura, calamari, or vegetable gyoza.

  • Light Starters: An ideal match for zesty melon salads, prosciutto with burrata, or a mild goat cheese tart.

  • Serving Tip: Before opening, gently turn the bottle upside down for one minute to distribute any natural sediment evenly. Serve well-chilled in a champagne flute or a narrow white wine glass to highlight the delicate bubbles and floral aromatics.

title: Bower Hill Barrel Reserve Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Award winning Bower Hill’s Barrel Reserve Bourbon is a classic example of this style of American whiskey. Sweet, but with hints of pepper, and lots of vanilla.

Appearance: Bright golden amber.

Aroma: Big oak, vanilla, smoky caramel.

Taste: Intense, tannin, dried fruit.

Finish: Long, intense and clean.

title: Lindores 'MCDXCIV' Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
ZYN is delighted to be stocking the first single malt Scotch whisky from Lindores Abbey Distillery, the Lindores Lowland Single Malt Scotch Whisky MCDXCIV. The launch of Lindores Lowland Single Malt Scotch Whisky reconfirms Lindores as a place of real significance in the History of The Scotch Whisky Industry. As the officially recognized site of the first recorded  distillation of  Scotch Whisky in 1494, which appears in the Exchequer Roll of the same year, Lindores is again taking its place in history with its, now commercially available, Single Malt Scotch Whisky. Over 500 years after Brother John Cor, a Lindores monk, was commissioned by King James IV to turn 8 bolls of malt into Aqua Vitae. Lindores are delighted to re-open the history book and invite you to be part of it.

Colour: Golden.

Nose: Elegant, soft, mellow vanilla, caramel notes playing with orchard fruits and sweet pear drops. Reminiscent of toffee apples!

Palate: Smooth with a creamy texture and a perfect balance of mellow vanilla, dried fruits, citrus touches with a hint of spice.

Finish: Medium length, delicate but lingering finish.

title: Luigi Righetti Valpolicella Ripasso 2019
bodyHtml: Medium ruby in colour. Intensely aromatic nose with strawberry, dried cherry, currants and hints of leather, autumn leaves and Asian spice. Dry, medium-bodied with classic Ripasso flavours, a ripe, round palate and some wood tannins bringing complexity to the long and satisfying finish. Best with roast or stewed red meat. Also, with pasta, risotto, calamari, and bolognese with mushrooms.

title: Sake One Momokawa Diamond Junmai Ginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Brewed by SakeOne, a pioneer in the American craft sake movement since 1992, Momokawa Diamond is often considered the standard-bearer of their lineup. It is crafted using soft water from Oregon's Willamette Valley and premium Calrose rice from the Sacramento Valley, blending Pacific Northwest resources with traditional Japanese techniques under the guidance of Master Brewer Takumi Kuwabara.

Description

This super-premium Junmai Ginjo is clear and medium-bodied, known for its exceptional balance between fruity notes and earthy minerals. The nose is fragrant and enticing, featuring aromas of melon, green apple, and a distinct touch of mild anise. On the palate, it delivers a crisp and refreshing experience with flavors of ripe pear, citrus, and honeydew melon, supported by subtle herbaceous notes of grass and bamboo. As a Junmai Ginjo, it is brewed purely from rice, water, yeast, and koji with no added alcohol, and the rice is polished to at least 58% to ensure a refined finish. ABV 14.8%, SMV +4.

Food Pairing

Momokawa Diamond is a highly versatile "daily drinker" that complements a wide range of cuisines beyond traditional Japanese fare. Its medium-dry profile and crisp acidity make it a perfect partner for sushi, sashimi, and grilled salmon.
