It also pairs remarkably well with savory Western dishes such as gourmet burgers, BBQ ribs, and roasted peppers. For a more adventurous pairing, try it with a charcuterie platter featuring duck liver pâté and aged cheeses like Jasper Hill Highlander, which helps release the sake's natural umami. It is best enjoyed well-chilled to maintain its refreshing, fruit-forward edge.

title: Kojima Sohonten Toko Genshu Junmai Ginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Established in 1597 during the Azuchi Momoyama period, Kojima Sohonten is one of the oldest breweries in Japan and historically served as the exclusive sake purveyor to the Uesugi samurai clan. The brewery is currently managed by the 24th generation of the Kojima family.

Description

This sake is an undiluted genshu that presents a rich and voluminous sensory profile. The aroma is characterized by pure ginjo notes of melon, nashi pear, and red apple, with subtle hints of hay. On the palate, it offers a juicy texture and a medium plus body featuring flavours of pineapple and ripened fruit. It possesses a deep umami character and a well balanced sweetness, leading to a long and satisfying finish. The alcohol content is 16%.

Food Pairing

The robust body and intense umami of this genshu make it a versatile partner for rich and savoury dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with deep fried chicken, sweet and sour pork, or braised beef. For a Western style pairing, consider serving it with creamy cheeses or tomato based dishes to complement its natural acidity and sweetness.

title: Ikekame Muroka Mukasui Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Ikekame Muroka Mukasui Junmai Daiginjo originates from Kurume City in the Fukuoka Prefecture of Japan. The Ikekame Shuzo brewery was founded in 1875 near the Chikugo River, utilizing the region's mineral-rich water. Known for its innovative spirit, the brewery was one of the first in Japan to use black koji (typically reserved for shochu) in sake production and is famous for its commitment to "Muroka Mukasui" style, which translates to unfiltered and undiluted sake.

Description

This premium Junmai Daiginjo is crafted with 100% Yamada Nishiki rice sourced from Itoshima, polished to 50%. It is fermented at low temperatures (below 10°C) for 40 days using the brewery's own self-cultured yeast.

  • Aroma: A vibrant and refreshing nose featuring notes of young green apple and bright floral scents.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it offers a powerful concentration with complex, spicy flavors and a smooth, honey-like sweetness. As a "Mukasui" (undiluted) sake, it maintains a rich and pure intensity.

  • Technical Profile: It has an alcohol content of 16% and is matured at -5°C to preserve its delicate aromatics. The finish is characterized by an "undecorated beauty"—clean, elegant, and refreshing.

Food Pairing

The concentrated umami and crisp acidity of this unfiltered sake make it an excellent partner for fresh, high-quality ingredients.

  • Premium Seafood: Its fruity apple notes and elegant sweetness enhance fatty tuna (otoro), salmon sashimi, and sweet shrimp.

  • Fried & Rich Starters: The undiluted power and acidity cut through the richness of fried oysters, vegetable tempura, and chicken teriyaki.

  • Modern Pairings: It pairs surprisingly well with creamy Western dishes, such as burrata with honey, mild goat cheese, or a zesty melon salad.

Serving Tip: Best enjoyed chilled in a wine glass to fully capture the complex aromatics and concentrated flavors provided by the lack of filtration and dilution.

title: Tomintoul Cigar Malt Oloroso Sherry Cask
bodyHtml:
A sherried single malt from Tomintoul, also referred to as Tomintoul Cigar Malt Parejo because it has been created to be the perfect ‘Parejo’ (Spanish for “partner”) to the world’s finest cigars. A no-age-statement Speyside whisky, which has been matured in Oloroso sherry casks, sourced from Andalucia.

The rich and sweet oloroso sherry notes, creamy malt profile and gentle peat smoke are finshed by warming, long notes of mocha, maple syrup and toasted oak lingering on the tongue.

title: Freixenet Italian Sparkling Rose (NV)
bodyHtml: Spanish bubbly master Freixenet now produces fabulous Italian sparklers. This Charmat method Glera/Pinot Noir blend is light and effervescent with notes of fresh red berries and hints of crisp apples. The finish is crisp and refreshing. Pair with salmon mousse or savoury appetizers. Its crystal-like bottle is a stunner!

title: Cabot Trail Maple Whisky
bodyHtml:
The beautiful Canadian Cabot Trail runs through a rugged landscape of forests, mountains and oceanside cliffs, offering breathtaking vistas. Inspired by Canadian tradition, the Cabot Trail Maple Whisky is a unique blend of aged Canadian rye whisky and pure premium maple syrup.

A lightly malted liqueur accentuated by caramelized notes. The mouth is balanced, flavourful, complex and smooth, with a distinct hint of rye. The bold, round finish delivers a hit of pure maple syrup.

title: Amiral De Beychevelle 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Amiral de Beychevelle 2022 is the esteemed second wine of Château Beychevelle, a Fourth Growth estate located in the Saint-Julien appellation of Bordeaux, France. The château's name originates from the Gascogne phrase 'Bêcha vêla' ('lower the sails'), a tradition where passing ships would lower their sails as a mark of respect for the estate's 16th-century owner, Admiral Jean-Louis Nogaret de la Valette. This nautical heritage is reflected in the estate's famous emblem—a ship with a griffin-shaped prow. The winery's philosophy emphasizes 'haute-couture' expertise, utilizing custom-built facilities and gravity-flow technology to produce wines that balance traditional elegance with modern precision.

Wine Description

The 2022 vintage presents a striking, deep ruby colour with subtle purple reflections. The highly aromatic nose is resplendent with notes of red cassis, black cherry, and blackberries, layered with spring flowers, violet, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and supple, offering a polished texture with flavours of sweet currants, ripe plums, and a judicious touch of chocolate and cocoa. The structure is defined by noble, velvety tannins and an astonishing freshness that provides a vibrant energy leading into a long, persistent finish. The varietal composition for this vintage is approximately 65% Cabernet Sauvignon and 35% Merlot. It has an ABV of 13.5% or 14% depending on the specific lot and is produced using sustainable viticulture practices.

Food Pairing

This versatile wine is an excellent match for all types of classic meat dishes, including roasted, braised, or grilled beef, lamb, and duck. Its refined structure also complements veal, pork, and game, as well as hearty poultry such as roast chicken. Beyond traditional meats, it pairs well with mushroom-based recipes, pasta, and aged cheeses. It can even accompany more substantial fish dishes like tuna or salmon if cooked with a rich red wine reduction.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage is described as one of paradoxes, characterized by a year of extreme heat and drought that nevertheless yielded wines of remarkable freshness and balance. A dry, cold winter led to an early budbreak on March 25th, followed by severe frost in early April that impacted some early-ripening terroirs. Record temperatures in May resulted in rapid flowering, while July was the driest month since 1960. Despite heat peaks of 40°C, the estate's old vines showed incredible resilience, producing small, concentrated berries with thick skins that have been compared in quality to the region's greatest years.

title: Yellow Rose Outlaw Bourbon Whiskey
bodyHtml:
True to its name, this one breaks all the traditional bourbon laws. Made from 100% Texas yellow corn and aged in small American oak barrels right here in Houston. The 15-20 degree temperature swings in this part of Texas give this bourbon unique characteristics that can only be achieved here. In fact, their angel share is 15% per year, making their whiskey extremely rare and valuable to them.

Outlaw Bourbon is full-flavoured with warm caramel and vanilla overtones. Their traditional pot still helps them produce a true small-batch whiskey. One sip and we think you’ll agree you’ve never had anything like it.

title: Vintage Ink Wine Whisky Aged Red Blend 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from Canada’s renowned Niagara Peninsula, Ontario, a region celebrated for its cool-climate varietals and innovative winemaking. Vintage Ink, part of the Arterra Wines portfolio, takes pride in crafting expressive wines that capture the vibrancy of the local terroir. The brand is known for pushing boundaries, often experimenting with barrel finishes to add unique character to their blends.

Wine Description

Deep ruby in the glass, this whisky-aged red blend reveals a bold aromatic profile with notes of ripe black cherry, plum, and subtle cassis intertwined with nuances of vanilla, toasted oak, and a faint whiff of caramel from its whisky cask maturation. On the palate, it is plush and medium to full-bodied, showcasing layers of dark fruit, baking spice, and chocolate, with a slight smoky edge. Fine-grained tannins and well-integrated acidity lead to a warm, lingering finish with a touch of whisky sweetness that accentuates its smooth texture.

Food Pairing

Pair this wine with char-grilled steak topped with a peppercorn sauce, smoked ribs, or an aged cheddar cheeseboard. The combination highlights the wine’s depth and character, while the whisky-inflected finish complements hearty, savoury dishes beautifully.

title: Bastille 1789 Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml: Bastille Single Malt sources its unique taste profile from the Limousin Oak cask style that previously aged some of the finest wines such as Sauterne, Burgundy, Sherry as well as a French Spirit. Its delicate aromas and smooth profile make Bastille 1789 Single Malt a “ONE OF A KIND” experience and a category on its own.

title: Basil Hayden's Kentucky Bourbon - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Aroma - Charred oak and sweet notes of vanilla & caramel with hints of dried fruit.

Taste - Charred oak flavour that is complemented with sweet brown sugar, a touch of black pepper, and dried fruit to round it out.

Finish - A pleasant, lingering charred oak finish with a touch of dried fruit.

title: Heaven's Door Straight Bourbon Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Bob Dylan set out to create a collection of small-batch American whiskeys that would tell a story. The result, Heaven's Door Whiskey, a brand of award-winning hand-crafted American whiskeys. Each bottle showcases the welded iron gates Dylan created in his metal working studio.

"Gates appeal to me because of the negative space they allow. They can be closed but at the same time they allow the seasons and breezes to enter and flow. They can shut you out or shut you in. And in some ways, there is no difference." Bob Dylan

Distilled and aged its entire life in Tennessee, this whiskey is non-chill filtered to preserve its mature flavours. The result is smooth and lasting with notes of vanilla and baking spices layered over a bed of toasted oak.

title: Heaven's Door Double Barrel Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Bob Dylan set out to create a collection of small-batch American whiskeys that would tell a story. The result, Heaven's Door Whiskey, a brand of award-winning hand-crafted American whiskeys. Each bottle showcases the welded iron gates Dylan created in his metal working studio.

"Gates appeal to me because of the negative space they allow. They can be closed but at the same time they allow the seasons and breezes to enter and flow. They can shut you out or shut you in. And in some ways, there is no difference." Bob Dylan

Placing their already-aged 6-Year whiskey in an alligator charred, new American oak, deepens the colour and fills our whiskey with flavours of dark toasted vanilla. The finished product came out so smooth they increased the bottling proof to 100.

title: Dai Shichi Kimoto Classic Junmai Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Dai Shichi Kimoto Classic Junmai originates from Nihonmatsu City in the Fukushima Prefecture of Japan. Founded in 1752, the Daishichi Sake Brewery has been managed by the Ohta family for ten generations. The brewery is world-renowned for its exclusive adherence to the Kimoto method, a labor-intensive, traditional starter-mash process that relies on natural lactic acid bacteria. Daishichi is also a pioneer of the Super-flat Rice Polishing technique, which removes undesirable proteins more effectively than conventional methods.

Description

This "Classic" expression was first released in 1999 to represent the "royal way" of fermented beverages, focusing on rich maturation rather than modern "dry and crisp" trends. It is matured for a full year to align its rich flavors and acidity.

  • Aroma: A complex, lactic nose featuring roasted nuts, toasted cereal, and earthy hints of Camembert cheese.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and mellow with umami-rich notes of vanilla, lychee, and shiitake mushroom.

  • Technical Profile: Brewed with Gohyaku Mangoku rice polished to 69%, it has a Sake Meter Value (SMV) of +3.0 and an alcohol content of 15%.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Glen Grant Single Malt 1962 'Archive Release'
bodyHtml:
Rich Sherry influences, dark fruits, dried figs and blackcurrant with spicy cloves. Thick treacle notes give way to polished oak and aged leather. The palate has fruitcake, intense spices , Seville orange and charred oak flavours. Morello cherries and liquorice give way to a charred edge and subtle coffee grounds. The finish is long and full bodied with plenty of spice and oak.

DISTILLED: 17th September 1962 BOTTLED: 18th September 2018 AGE: 56 Years Old CASK TYPE: 1ST Fill Sherry Butt CASK #: 4405 COLOUR: Darkest Mahogany STRENGTH: 54.6%

title: Bastille 1789 Hand Crafted Rare Whisky
bodyHtml: This whisky pours a bright pale gold. Intensely aromatic, with complex top notes of citrus peel, blossoms, toffee, herbs and vanilla. The liqueur-like palate is sweet initially, with honey, vanilla and herbal notes leading to a long warm finish.

title: Tinto Negro Malbec 'Finca La Escuela' 2019
bodyHtml: Tinto Negro celebrates the essence of Malbec in Mendoza. Known for its dark, almost black colour, this Malbec is definitely a Black Red.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Toro Melt Lychee - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Nakano Shuzo, a historic brewery established in 1844, the Toro Melt series represents a modern, indulgent take on fruit-infused sake. The name "Toro Melt" refers to the liqueur’s distinctive thick and velvety texture, designed to literally melt in your mouth. Unlike the brewery's "fruilia" series which focuses on juice-forward clarity, the Toro Melt line emphasizes a rich, pulp-like viscosity that provides a dessert-like experience.

Description

This liqueur is clear to slightly opaque with a notably "chewy" and rich viscosity. The nose is vivid and aromatic, bursting with sweet lychee and bright grapefruit, accented by delicate floral notes of rose and white blossoms. On the palate, it delivers a lush and indulgent mouthfeel featuring a "tropical party" of flavors: ripe lychee, mango, and grapefruit. It strikes a masterful balance between the intense sweetness of the fruit and a refreshing citrus acidity, with secondary hints of pear and watermelon in the finish. ABV 7.5%–9.5% depending on the specific bottling.

Food Pairing

The decadent sweetness and creamy texture of Toro Melt Lychee make it an exceptional choice for a dessert companion or a standalone treat. It pairs beautifully with light, fruit-based desserts, panna cotta, or even mild spicy appetizers where the sweetness can help tame the heat. For a unique twist, it is highly recommended as a topping for vanilla ice cream or shaved ice. It is best served well-chilled to maintain its refreshing edge, and it serves as a vibrant, thick base for creative tropical cocktails when mixed with soda water or gin.

title: Rey Sol Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Casa San Matías is committed to honouring the tradition and legacy that were transmitted to them by their predecessors. They are proud of being one of the oldest family tequila distilleries in Mexico. Their story began in 1886 in the town of Magdalena, Jalisco, where Don Delfino González began small-scale tequila production mainly for family and friends. His tequila quickly gained popularity in Mexico. In 1940, they relocated their distillery to Ojo de Agua in Los Altos de Jalisco. This region’s rich soil and natural spring water are fundamental to the superb flavour of all of San Matias' tequilas.

In 1993 Casa San Matias introduced the first Tequila Extra Añejo to the world, San Matías Gran Reserva. In 1998, they went even further with Rey Sol. For Rey Sol, two pieces of art merge into one. From the creation of the decanter, designed by famous Mexican artist Sergio Bustamante, to the traditional method of production and its 6 years of aging in new French Oak barrels in the Hacienda San Matias, Rey Sol provides one of the most sublime experiences to ever grace a tequila. Majestic in every sense.

100% Blue Agave, aged six years in new French Oak barrels. Intense bright amber with orange and copper highlights, with strong body and ever-so-slow forming legs. Initial aromas of oak, chocolate, vanilla, hazelnut, roasted almonds, and dried fruit. At the start of the palate, it is sweet and huge in body, where the oak notes are dominant, and delivers a long lasting finish of chocolate and almond flavours.

title: Limestone Branch Distillery 'Minor Case' Straight Rye Whisky
bodyHtml:
Minor Case is 90 proof and aged in cream sherry casks for an unforgettable flavour.  It is the winner of the SIP Awards 2018 Platinum Medal,  the San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2018 Gold Medal, the SIP Awards 2017 Gold Medal, and The Global Spirits Masters 2017 Master Award.

Minor Case shows earthy notes and sweet sherry on the nose.  The palate reveals a hint of butterscotch, followed by a smooth finish with hints of dried fruits. 

As seventh-generation distillers, Limestone has another favourite pastime: reminiscing. In 1871, M.C. Beam began his distilling career under the supervision of his Uncle Jack Beam. By 1883, he was a partner in his operation, where he brought his son Guy, Steve and Paul Beam's grandfather into the business.

Minor Case Straight Rye Whiskey is "what might have been" in a bottle, reawakening the stills of M.C. Beam that Prohibition silenced. "I always felt it was an unfinished chapter in our book," Steve says.

title: Spicebox Chocolate Spiced Rye Whisky
bodyHtml: Often, Canadian bootleggers would blend, age and transport Whisky in used cocoa barrels, after all Canada is famous for having invented the world’s first wrapped chocolate bar! The leftover cocoa husks would infuse the smooth rye with rich, warm chocolate flavours, creating something unique and delicious. The rye in this blend emerges on the palate with notes of pepper and fruit, and is complemented with hints of vanilla and dried spices. Exceptionally smooth on the palate with a long warm finish. Try it straight up, on the rocks, or with your favourite mix.

title: Pio Cesare Gavi 2025
bodyHtml: Fresh, clean and spicy aromas. Salty, with ripe fruit and rich, complex flavour. Great ageing potential. Sourced exclusively from hillside vineyards exposures, in a few selected locations of the Gavi area, from families who have been producing grapes under the strict control of the Pio Cesare Family for generations.

title: Gustave Lorentz Orange Wine Qui L'eut Cru 2025
bodyHtml: Gustave Lorentz has strived to reinvent the essence of wine. The estate unearths the secrets of nature with this orange wine, created by careful harvesting, a slow maceration of the grapes, and perfect mastery of the vinification allowing no yeast or sulfites to be added.

title: Faiveley Nuits St. Georges 'Les Porets St. Georges' Premier Cru 2020
bodyHtml: Deep ruby ​​colour. The nose expresses itself with notes of black fruits and woody, empyreumatic aromas. After a round and ample attack, the wine is robust and full-bodied. Well-balanced and with excellent hold, it has good aging potential.

title: Black Box Cabernet Sauvignon - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml: Black Box Wines Cabernet Sauvignon is full-bodied, displaying enticing aromas of black currant, toasty oak, and a hint of vanilla. Ripe blackberries and chocolate fill the palate with balanced tannins that lead to a soft, lingering finish.

title: Empress 1908 Gin - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Handcrafted in small batch copper-pot stills, Empress 1908 Gin is a collaboration between Victoria Distillers and the legendary Fairmont Empress Hotel in Victoria, British Columbia. 

A forward earthiness from butterfly pea blossoms and Fairmont Empress House Tea blend, followed by robust citrus notes from grapefruit peel, delicate floral hints from rose petal and warm spice from ginger and cinnamon.

title: Clos du Marquis 2015
bodyHtml:
95 Points - James Suckling     Extremely perfumed with blackberries, plums and bark. Lemon-rind undertones. Full-bodied, creamy, velvety and voluptuous yet focused and pinpointed. Intense dark-berry and chocolate flavours. Really well done.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast     Rich, ripe, and elegant, this wine comes from a separate parcel of Léoville las Cases that is treated as a distinct wine. With fine, dusty tannins and juicy acidity, it offers both richness and black currants from the Cabernet Sauvignon. It needs to age and should be ready to drink from 2025.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate     A blend of 66% Cabernet Sauvignon, 31% Merlot and 3% Cabernet Franc, the medium to deep garnet-purple coloured 2015 Clos du Marquis gives up expressive notes of warm mulberries, kirsch and blackberry pie with touches of sandalwood, potpourri, anise and charcuterie. The palate is medium to full-bodied with a great core of rich, spicy fruit framed by plush tannins and finishing with an invigorating lift.

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck     The 2015 Clos Du Marquis is gorgeous, but one of the more backward, closed wines in the vintage. Made from 66% Cabernet Sauvignon, 31% Merlot, and the rest Cabernet Franc, aged in 50% new oak, it’s deep purple colour is followed by promising notes of blackcurrants, smoked earth, tobacco and lead pencil. With full-bodied richness, a ripe, concentrated, structured feel, and impressive length, I wouldn’t touch bottles for at least 7-8 years, and it should last for two decades or more.

title: Gaja Grappa di Brunello di Montalcino Rennina - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Gaja Grappa di Brunello di Montalcino Rennina is a grappa from the country of Italy, specifically the region of Tuscany, and the subregion of Montalcino. The Gaja winery was established in 1859 by Giovanni Gaja in Barbaresco and is known for its high-quality Italian wines. The company's Brunello di Montalcino is produced at its Pieve Santa Restituta winery. Angelo Gaja, the current owner, has been instrumental in the winery's move to Tuscany, acquiring the Pieve Santa Restituta estate in 1994. The grappa is named 'Rennina' after one of the three single-vineyard bottlings of Brunello di Montalcino produced by the estate.

Spirit Description

This grappa is made from the pomace (grape skins) of the Sangiovese grapes used to produce the renowned Brunello di Montalcino wine. It is distilled in a continuous-cycle copper still. The resulting spirit is aged for 12 months in small oak barrels. The colour is bright, crystal clear, or light golden. On the nose, it offers a bouquet of mature red fruit, tobacco, spices, and a hint of vanilla. The palate is soft, warm, and persistent, with an elegant, dry, and balanced taste. It has a long finish. Gaja Grappa di Brunello di Montalcino Rennina has an ABV of 42.0%.

Food Pairing

This dry and elegant grappa is ideally served as a digestive. It is traditionally consumed neat at room temperature. The warm and spicy notes of this grappa would pair well with strong, aged cheeses. It can also be paired with dark chocolate or enjoyed alongside a cup of espresso.

title: Mezcal Union El Viejo
bodyHtml: Mezcal Union Viejo is made with maguey Espadin and Tobala. The Tobala is more rare but it gives the mezcal a unique texture and taste.

title: Casamigos Reposado Tequila - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
Smooth and clean with hints of caramel. Aged for seven months in American white oak casks that have been reconditioned after originally being used for premium-aged whiskey. Great served neat or on the rocks, and perfect base for premium cocktails.

AGAVE: The agaves are 100% Blue Weber, aged 7-9 years, from the rich clay soil of the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico.

COLOR: Golden honey

AROMA: Caramel with hints of cocoa.

FLAVOR: Notes of dried fruits and spicy oak with a touch of sweet agave.

WATER: Purified water from Casamigo's own well.

AGED: 7 months in premium American white oak barrels.

title: Gaja Grappa Gaia & Rey - 500 ml
bodyHtml: The Grappa Gaia & Rey is produced from the high-quality grape pomace of Gaia & Rey wine and is exclusively distilled from Chardonnay grapes and then aged in stainless steel tanks. It has a crystal clear colour and has inviting herbal aromas. It is full-bodied and open on the pallet. A long-lasting finish with fine notes of spices.

title: Gaja Grappa di Barolo - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Gaja Grappa di Barolo is a spirit from the country of Italy, originating in the Piedmont region and the subregion of Barolo. The Gaja winery was established in 1859 by Giovanni Gaja in Barbaresco. The family-owned estate is a globally recognised producer of Italian wine, known for quality and innovation. Current owner Angelo Gaja, the founder's great-grandson, is credited with introducing revolutionary winemaking techniques to the region, such as single-vineyard production and the use of French barriques.

Spirit Description

Gaja Grappa di Barolo is made from the fresh pomace (grape skins, seeds, and stems) of Nebbiolo grapes used to produce the famous Barolo wine. The distillation process is carried out slowly to preserve the varietal characteristics and aromas of the pomace, and the final spirit is obtained by selecting the 'heart' of the distillate. The grappa is aged for twelve months in wooden barrels, which gives it a soft and elegant structure. The colour is described as clear with a light golden shimmer or an intense yellow with a bronze tinge. It has a seductive nose of warm and aged wood, along with notes of raisins, red fruits, and dried herbs. The flavour is full-bodied and smooth, combining sweetness and fine bitters, with nuances of ripe berries, a subtle woody note, and an elegant and refined finish. The Grappa di Barolo has an ABV of 42.0%.

Food Pairing

Gaja Grappa di Barolo is an excellent digestif and is typically enjoyed neat at room temperature or with an espresso to fully appreciate its fine aromas. The rich, wood-aged character pairs well with strong or aged cheese and dark chocolate. It is also suggested to enjoy this grappa with fine pastries.

title: Chum Churum Blueberry Soju - 360 ml
bodyHtml:
South Korea, Seoul. Produced by Lotte Chilsung Beverage Co., part of the trendsetting "Soonhari" line, this expression helped spark the global fruit-flavored soju boom. Like the original version, it is crafted using alkaline water, which creates a softer, more approachable texture compared to traditional spirits. The brand name "Chum Churum" translates to "like the first time," emphasizing its focus on smoothness and a fresh drinking experience.

Description

This clear, fruit-infused spirit is a light and refreshing alternative to flavored vodkas. The nose is highly fragrant and unique, dominated by the distinct aroma of sweet, ripe blueberries. On the palate, it offers a velvety mouthfeel with a masterful balance of subtle sweetness and the intense essence of wild berries. Unlike many high-proof spirits, it is designed for easy sipping, providing a juicy and sophisticated flavor profile that remains crisp rather than cloying. ABV 12%.

Food Pairing

The sweet and fruity profile of blueberry soju makes it an ideal match for light, salty, or savory snacks (anju). It pairs beautifully with fried foods like Korean tempura or classic fries, as the fruitiness cuts through the salt and grease. For a more traditional experience, serve it alongside Korean-style pancakes (pajeon) or spicy tteokbokki, where the berry sweetness helps balance the heat. It is also highly versatile for dessert, working well with fruit-based tarts or even a simple scoop of vanilla ice cream. It is best enjoyed well-chilled, served neat or as a vibrant base for sparkling cocktails.

title: Segla 2015
bodyHtml:
93 Points - Vinous

The 2015 Ségla reveals baked cherries, hoisin and light cedar aromas on the nose, which is tightly wound at first but gains intensity with aeration. The oak is neatly integrated. The very well-balanced, medium-bodied palate features firm tannin, commendable purity, smooth texture and just a touch of white pepper and graphite toward the persistent finish. This is a classy Margaux!

title: Francois Voyer XO Premier Cru Cognac
bodyHtml:
This Cognac is exclusively from Grande Champagne Premier Cru. It is a blend of spirits from 10 to 25 years old that aged in new Limousin oak barrels for three years, then in older barrels.

The colour is light amber with aged gold hues. To the nose, fragrances of fruits like vine peach, quince jelly or stewed plum, and splendid shades of vanilla. A balance between fruits and wood. On the palate, we find the nose’s fruits combined with supple and powerful vanilla woods in an incredible smoothness. This Cognac would be perfect as a digestive with a cigar of your choice.

title: Kavalan Triple Sherry Cask
bodyHtml: Kavalan Triple Sherry Cask Single Malt Whisky is a rare combination of three exquisite sherry-aged casks, Oloroso, Pedro Ximénez, and Moscatel, with the dried fruits of Oloroso as its main character. Rich caramel and the sweetness of maltose are layered with the distillery's unique tropical fruits to create a delicate but distinct sherried whisky that can be enjoyed on easy-drinking occasions with friends.

title: Glen Garioch Renaissance 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Glen Garioch's The Renaissance series tells, in four chapters, about the differences that result from the maturing time.

The fourth and last chapter deals with the character of an 18 year old whisky.

The Glen Garioch 18 Years Old matures for 18 years in bourbon and sherry barrels, opening up a luxurious intensity of sweet-floral to spicy aromas.

title: Martell Blue Swift Cognac
bodyHtml: In 1783, Martell was the first Maison to ship cognac to America. Today, Martell celebrates this history with another first: Martell Blue Swift, the first-ever spirit drink made of cognac VSOP and then finished in bourbon casks. Through Martell’s signature distillation process, the eau-de-vie absorbs the rich aromatic tones of the bourbon cask. The result is Martell’s hallmark style, delicate notes of candied fruit and plum complemented by the subtle sweetness of vanilla and toasted oak from the casks. Exceptionally smooth, with a rounded taste and unique character.

title: Kobayashi Shuzo Hououbiden Akaban Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Akaban is made from the noble "Yamadanishiki" variety.  Aromas of juicy muskmelon and lychee fruit are delicious. Perfumed, but not overpowering, with a clear, crisp finish.  Only once pasteurised to maintain freshness and flavour concentration.

Origin:   Tochigi Prefecture  |   Rice: Yamada Nishiki    |   Rice Polished to:   40%   |   Alcohol:  16%

title: Fanti Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml: Intense ruby red, notes of ripe red fruit(cherry, black cherry) with aromas of coffee and pepper. To accompany floral notes of rose and rosemary, followed by strong hint of licorice. Pleasant sweetness on the attack recalls the scents perceived by the nose. Ripe but at the same time round tannins which makes the wine pleasantly silky with a good persistence on the finish.

title: Emmolo Sparkling Methode Traditionnelle (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
This elegant and 'serious' sparkling wine originates from the United States, specifically from several cool-climate coastal regions across California including Sonoma, Santa Barbara, and Monterey Counties. Introduced in 2019, this label is part of the Wagner Family of Wines and is crafted by owner and winemaker Jenny Wagner. Named after her maternal family who established a historic grapevine rootstock nursery in Napa Valley in the 1920s, the winery's philosophy for this cuvée is to create a richly developed character inspired by premium Champagnes while maintaining California freshness.

Wine Description

The Emmolo Methode Traditionnelle presents a luminous light gold colour, often with highlights of rose gold. The complex sensory profile features an expressive nose of daffodils, freshly cut pear, and green apple, layered with sophisticated notes of almond biscotti, toasted brioche, and a subtle hint of new leather. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and 'vibrant', showcasing a finely beaded mousse and bright citrus flavours of clementine, ruby red grapefruit, and lemon pith. It is characterized by a creamy, 'Nilla-wafer' texture and a saline, wet-stone minerality derived from extended aging on the lees. The finish is dry and savory, with lingering echoes of honeycrisp apple and apricot. This non-vintage blend typically consists of approximately 62% to 65% Chardonnay and 35% to 38% Pinot Noir, reaching an alcohol content (ABV) of 12.4% to 12.7%. While the Wagner family prioritizes hand-selection and meticulous winemaking, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Peat's Beast Batch Strength Single Malt
bodyHtml: You can feel its immense power as it pours onto your palate like a violent thunderstorm. You need to brace yourself. Its “natural strength” is untamed and ferocious. Yet, seconds later, this beastly peaty, fiery spirit is soon soothed by the warmth of your tongue. Almost immediately a calmness, a stillness pervades as seductive notes of moist banana cake, thick treacle, and mocha with whispers of sweet pineapple, ginger and cumin finally come into play to give you an unforgettable aftertaste. Everyone has a little beast in them, this one more than most. The packaging is pretty striking too, with a scary monster and a deliberately singed label.

title: Peat's Beast Batch Strength PX Finish
bodyHtml:
A cask strength release from Peat's Beast, this Batch Strength bottling spent nine months finishing in Pedro Ximénez sherry casks! As such, there are rich notes of dried fruit and dates among the smoky maritime notes of the Islay whisky, weighing in at a beasty 54.1% ABV.

Familiar hints of peppery peat smoke, damp burnt bracken and the salty notes of seaweed. But Peat's Beast Sherry gives you more. There are subtle sweet notes of dates and figs with the sweet hues of Spanish Sherry; an absolute juxtaposition between dry peat smoke and rum and raisin ice cream, a quite sublime dram. On the palate, real peat bite but wrapped in a gorgeous warm coat of dates, figs, hints of clove and vanilla. The peat fire stays at the back of the throat but there are strong notes of chocolate, sweet rum and raisin ice cream, and burnt caramel. Incredibly long finish.

Glows like a barley field of shimmering gold, but with hints of a darker burnished copper from the PX cask finish. The nose exhibits damp smoke, peat, TCP, and seaweed then morphing into sweet syrupy burnt sugar notes from the Sherry cask.

title: Domaine Thibault Liger-Belair Bourgogne 'Les Deux Terres'
bodyHtml: This wine offers a cool scent of black cherry and licorice and a noble rusticity to its very ripe, plush flavors of black raspberry and spices. There is good energy from its saline minerality and a note of granite. Broad tannins won’t prevent early enjoyment.

title: Crown Royal 18 Year Old Extra Rare
bodyHtml: This 18-year-old whisky is the oldest in Crown Royal’s current lineup. It is a rare blend of three of their most exceptional whiskies, handcrafted by their master blender, patiently aged to perfection for no less than 18 years. The result is layers of intensity that are both surprising and delightful. Enticing notes of vanilla and stone fruit greet you on the nose, followed by the velvety body of light oak tempered by caramel spice. Delicate notes of nougat linger in the full-bodied finish. This elegant, amber whisky is truly the jewel of their rare stock. Simply pour neat in a whisky tumbler with iced water on the side for a perfect serve.

title: Penfolds Bin 407 Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
Penfolds Bin 407 Cabernet Sauvignon originates from Australia, crafted as a multi-regional blend across South Australia's premium viticultural areas. Founded in 1844, Penfolds is an iconic estate owned by Treasury Wine Estates that has long been a beacon of innovation and quality. The winery's signature winemaking philosophy relies on multi-vineyard and multi-regional blending to masterfully capture distinct varietal definition and structure.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep, dense ruby colour in the glass. The nose reveals a textbook varietal aroma of intense blackcurrant, cassis, and dark plum, laced with subtle oak spice and herbal undertones. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied with a robustly structured core that highlights excellent balance and freshness driven by lively acidity. Composed of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, it features a complex, velvety mouthfeel supported by fine-grained tannins that carry through to a long, persistent finish. It boasts an impressive cellaring potential with an optimal drinking window of seven years or more.

title: Vincent Latour Corton Charlemagne Grand Cru 2019
bodyHtml:
Domaine Vincent Latour's Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru 2021 is a distinguished white wine from Burgundy's esteemed Côte de Beaune region, exemplifying the exceptional quality of Chardonnay from this grand cru vineyard.

Vineyard and Terroir
The Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru vineyard is renowned for its limestone-rich soils and optimal sun exposure, which contribute to the wine's distinctive minerality and complexity. The 2021 vintage faced challenges due to frost, impacting yields but often enhancing concentration in the surviving grapes.

Winemaking Process
Vincent Latour employs meticulous winemaking techniques, including hand-harvesting and gentle pressing of the Chardonnay grapes. Fermentation and aging typically occur in French oak barrels, with a portion being new, to impart subtle oak nuances while preserving the wine's intrinsic fruit character.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Pale gold with green highlights.
  • Aroma: Expressive notes of citrus fruits, white flowers, and a hint of toasted almonds.
  • Palate: Elegant and well-balanced, featuring flavors of lemon zest, ripe pear, and a pronounced minerality, complemented by a lingering, crisp finish.

Accolades
While specific reviews for the 2021 vintage by Vincent Latour may be limited, the Corton-Charlemagne appellation is highly regarded, with wines from this grand cru often receiving ratings above 90 points from critics.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs excellently with seafood dishes, such as lobster or scallops, creamy poultry entrees, and a variety of fine cheeses, enhancing the dining experience with its depth and elegance.

Serving Recommendations
For optimal enjoyment, serve chilled at 12-14°C (54-57°F). Decanting for about 30 minutes before serving can help the wine open up, revealing its full aromatic potential.

title: Foxglove Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Foxglove Chardonnay is produced in the Central Coast region of California, with much of the fruit typically sourced from the Edna Valley subregion. This label is the creation of brothers Bob and Jim Varner, who established Foxglove in 1991 to offer high-quality, approachable wines that serve as value-driven counterparts to their premium Varner label. Their winemaking philosophy emphasizes transparency and freshness, utilizing minimal oak to showcase the 'textbook Central Coast' character of the fruit.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay displays a bright gold to yellow colour and is known for a vibrant, fruit-forward sensory profile. The aroma features expressive notes of green apple, lemon zest, and white peach, often complemented by tropical hints of pineapple and honeydew melon. On the palate, the wine is typically medium to full bodied with a rich yet refreshing texture. Flavours of zesty citrus, tangerine, and ripe pear are supported by a distinct mineral edge and natural acidity. The wine is predominantly unoaked and does not undergo malolactic fermentation, ensuring a clean and crisp finish without heavy buttery notes. It is 100% Chardonnay with an ABV generally ranging between 13.6% and 13.8%. The vineyards are farmed using sustainable practices.

Food Pairing

The versatile structure and balanced acidity of this Chardonnay make it an ideal companion for a variety of dishes. It pairs perfectly with roasted chicken, grilled seafood such as lemon-herb salmon, and creamy pasta dishes like fettuccine Alfredo. Its freshness also complements lighter fare, including garden salads with citrus vinaigrettes and simple vegetable preparations.

title: Nickel & Nickel Cabernet Sauvignon 'John Sullenger' 2014
bodyHtml:
Nickel & Nickel is devoted to 100% varietal, single-vineyard wines, focused on Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon. Its winemaking excellence is highlighted in its selection of the very best vineyard locations and unique soil compositions required to make superior single-vineyard wines. Each Nickel & Nickel wine is a celebration of place and reveals how vineyards only miles apart, but of the same grape varietal, yield wines of unique character and distinction.

With its floral aromas mixed with plum and olive, the John C. Sullenger Cabernet Sauvignon blends juicy and savory notes into an impossible-to-resist perfume. On the palate, dark flavours of black cherry, tobacco, anise and toast are accentuated by a lively yet balanced acidity. These flavours are carried by a rich core of tannins that build on the middle palate, carrying the fruit into a long finish.

title: Gogi Pinot Noir 'Erinn' Santa Rita Hills 2017
bodyHtml:
The GoGi Pinot Noir 'Erinn' originates from the Santa Rita Hills AVA within Santa Barbara County, California. This boutique label is a personal project of actor Kurt Russell, who established the winery in partnership with Ampelos Cellars to reflect his passion for high-quality, Burgundian style wines. The winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the unique cool climate character of the Ampelos Vineyard, where sustainable and meticulous viticulture produces fruit with exceptional depth and complexity.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir presents a light and transparent ruby colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is complex and seductive, featuring tart red plum and sour cherry accented by dewy herbs, pine forest floor, and a hint of cedar reminiscent of brawny men's cologne. On the palate, the wine is fresh and lean with a snappy acidity, offering flavors of cranberry, raspberry, and orange rind decorated with eucalyptus tea and lightly cracked pepper.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points

  • Wine Enthusiast - 92 points

Food Pairing

The high acidity and bright red fruit profile of this Pinot Noir make it an ideal companion for roasted poultry, such as chicken or turkey, particularly when served with a cranberry glaze. It also pairs beautifully with earthy dishes like mushroom risotto or cedar-planked salmon, which complement the wine's forest floor and herbal notes.

title: Elk Cove Vineyards Pinot Noir La Boheme 2023
bodyHtml:
Elk Cove Vineyards Pinot Noir La Boheme originates from the United States, within the Yamhill-Carlton subregion of the Willamette Valley in Oregon. Founded in 1974 by Pat and Joe Campbell, Elk Cove is among the state's oldest wine producers. The La Boheme vineyard was planted in 1985 on a picturesque site rising to 800 feet, making it one of the highest elevation vineyard sites in the valley. It was named after both the family who previously owned the property and the founders' favourite Puccini opera. Today, the winery is led by second-generation winemaker Adam Campbell, who maintains a philosophy that combines art and science with a focus on estate-grown, cool-climate fruit.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir is known for a silky, lush, and sophisticated profile. In the glass, it typically presents a medium ruby to ruby-purple colour. The aromatic bouquet is deep and layered, offering scents of black cherry, raspberry, and strawberry, accented by forest floor, cedarwood, mushroom powder, and lavender. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied with a highly concentrated and detailed flavour profile including Damson plum, boysenberry, and toasted marshmallow. The structure is defined by muscular or baritone tannins and bright, energetic acidity, leading to a long finish with lingering notes of spicy cocoa, star anise, and minerals.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir, primarily the Pommard clone.

  • ABV: Recorded at 14.2% for recent vintages.

  • Ageing: Matured for 10 months in French oak barrels (approximately 28% to 29% new oak).

  • Organic Status: While the winery uses sustainable farming practices, this specific wine is not certified organic.

title: Flowers Pinot Noir Sonoma Coast 2022
bodyHtml:
Flowers' wine is made to express the land where it was farmed. Their coastal proximity and high-elevation vineyards give their wine its distinct minerality and fresh acidity. Farmed sustainably, fermented with 100% native yeast and crafted with minimal intervention in the cellar, Flowers Pinot Noir is a pure expression of the rugged and extreme Sonoma Coast.

93 Points - James Suckling

A fresh yet structured pinot with dried strawberry, orange peel and light caramel with dried stems. Medium body, flavorful, firm and bright at the end. Savory.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Aromas of sweet berries, cherry liqueur and cola dominate the nose of this Pinot, while the palate is loaded with cedar cigar box, coffee and maraschino cherry. The combination of freshness and grip feels very alluring, but it might need a few years to round into form.

92 Points - Decanter

Delicious, fresh, and savoury, this juicy Pinot Noir from the Sonoma Coast has violet and smoky flint aromatics buoyed by fresh red berries and a kiss of fresh mint. The palate is reflective, with flinty minerality coming to the fore. Pine sap, notes of fresh evergreen and lovely red fruits, clove and white peppery spice to finish.

title: Vincent Latour Meursault Rouge 'Vieilles Vignes' 2021
bodyHtml:
Vincent Latour began turning heads in Burgundy and has gained fame with the nominations of "Winemaker of the Year" and "The Best Young Winemaker" by the press.  In 2011, Burgundy wine expert, Allen Meadows, made his first visit to the Domaine and has returned every year since.

Dark garnet colour with a suggestion of red fruits in compote on the nose. Ripe and silky tannins on the palate.

title: Flavabom Vine Dried Shiraz 2022
bodyHtml: Flavabom keeps it's promise!  Just as the name suggests, our Flavabom Vine Dried Shiraz is a juggernaut of rich, juicy flavours with dark opulent berries, lashings of oak and smooth tannins. Our grapes are dried on the vine before being harvested to preserve the natural concentrated flavours and sugars in each berry. We’re not called Flavabom for nothing.

title: Hess Cabernet Sauvignon Allomi 2023
bodyHtml:
A pioneer by nature, Donald Hess was determined to defy convention and pursue winemaking in the far reaches of the Napa Valley. In 1995, he sought out the Allomi Vineyard with a vision to uncover its potential. Once a dormant beauty, the Allomi Vineyard now gives life to luxury Napa Valley wines. The estate vineyard is located in the gently rolling hills of northeastern Napa Valley. The 210-acre vineyard is focused into 35 unique growing blocks with six different Cabernet clones that add diversity of flavours and complexity to this wine.

The combination of steady heat and well-drained clay loam soils in their Allomi Vineyard allows fruit to ripen evenly, gaining welcomed complexity and layers of flavour. The Allomi Vineyard consistently delivers fruit of the highest quality, and this vintage was no different. On the nose, Allomi Cabernet offers enticing aromas of currant, blackberry and elegant expressions of lavender. These aromas are complemented by layered flavours of juicy black fruit, most notably black cherry and black plum. Plush, well-integrated tannins provide a round, delicious mouthfeel, and lead to elements of espresso supported by a subtle oak spice, adding to the personality of the wine and reminding us why this is one of their most popular Napa offerings.

title: Paladin Pinot Grigio 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
A straw yellow colour. Intense and elegant, with notes of acacia flowers and pear. The taste is dry, pleasant for the fresh and mild note. Good body and structure.

Pair with baked fish, oven or grill, tasty fish soups and risotto. Great also with crêpes, soufflé and white meat.

title: Hickinbotham Trueman Cabernet Sauvignon 2016
bodyHtml:
This high-altitude dry red wine originates from Australia, within the prestigious Clarendon subregion at the northern, elevated edge of McLaren Vale in South Australia. Originally planted in 1971 by Alan Hickinbotham, the historic Hickinbotham Clarendon Vineyard sits on steep, wind-swept slopes featuring ancient geological formations of shale and siltstone over clay. Acquired by Majestic Wine/Jackson Family Wines in 2012, the property was elevated to world-class status under the guidance of acclaimed winemakers Christopher Carpenter (renowned for his Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignons at Lokoya and Cardinale) and local winemaker Peter Fraser. Named in honor of Alan Hickinbotham's father, Trueman Hickinbotham, this bottling reflects a cool-climate, highly structured expression of Australian Cabernet Sauvignon.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2016 Trueman presents an opaque, deep garnet-purple color with bright crimson rim variations. The complex, lifted nose opens with classic dark fruit notes of crème de cassis, wild blackberry, and black cherry, interwoven with characteristic McLaren Vale nuances of crushed eucalyptus, dried mint, graphite, cigar box, and subtle baking spice from oak aging. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, intense, and tightly wound, displaying exceptional structural density and chalky, fine-grained tannins. A core of dark berry fruit is balanced by a vibrant, cool-climate streak of natural acidity that drives through to an extraordinarily long, savory finish. Crafted from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the hand-harvested grapes undergo careful sorting and small-batch open-top fermentation. The wine is aged for roughly 15 to 18 months in French oak barrels (approximately 50% to 60% new), resulting in an alcohol by volume of 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The muscular structure, firm tannic backbone, and cool herbal nuances of this high-elevation Cabernet Sauvignon demand rich, savory red meat dishes. It pairs magnificently with prime cuts of grilled ribeye, roasted rack of lamb with rosemary and garlic, slow-braised beef short ribs, and venison tenderloin with a dark fruit glaze. It also complements rich wild mushroom stew, roasted duck breast, and aged hard cheeses such as sharp Cheddar, Gouda, or aged Comté.

Vintage Quality

The 2016 growing season in McLaren Vale and Clarendon is widely regarded as an outstanding, benchmark vintage. Generous spring rainfall set up healthy vine canopies, followed by mild, steady conditions through summer and autumn that allowed Cabernet Sauvignon to achieve complete phenolic maturity while preserving vivid natural acidity and structural balance. The 2016 Hickinbotham Trueman represents a monumental, age-worthy Australian Cabernet that offers striking intensity and balance, capable of evolving gracefully in proper cellars for 15 to 25+ years.

Accolades

  • ​95 Points (James Suckling): Calls it a "stunning Cabernet," highlighting a fresh, fragrant nose of violets, dark rose, cassis, and blueberries anchored by "formidably strong tannins" that carry into a seamless finish.

  • 94 Points (Robert Parker's Wine Advocate): Dubs it a "super effort," praising its classic aromas of pencil shavings and cassis alongside rich waves of velvety, full-bodied fruit built to hit its absolute prime with age.

  • 94 Points (Wine Spectator): Highlights its "juicy and vibrant" core of raspberry and black cherry, calling out complex nuances of Earl Grey tea, violet, and toasted cumin with a creamy texture and effortless harmony (drink through 2035).

title: Elk Cove Vineyards Pinot Noir Mount Richmond 2023
bodyHtml: Elk Cove Vineyards is one of Oregon's oldest and most respected wine producers. Founded in 1974 by Pat and Joe Campbell, their focus has always been to produce handcrafted, estate-grown wines that can rival the best in the world.

title: Elk Cove Vineyards Pinot Noir Clay Court 2024
bodyHtml:
Elk Cove Vineyards Pinot Noir Clay Court originates from the United States, within the Chehalem Mountains subregion of the Willamette Valley in Oregon. Founded in 1974 by Pat and Joe Campbell, Elk Cove is one of Oregon's oldest and most respected family-owned wineries. The winemaking is led by Adam Campbell, who joined his parents in 1995 and continues their philosophy of estate-grown excellence and gentle gravity-flow processing to achieve the elegance and texture characteristic of fine Pinot Noir. The 15-acre Clay Court Vineyard, purchased by the winery in 2009, is situated on Parrett Mountain and is named for the founders' beloved tennis court located on the site.

Wine Description

This wine typically displays a bright ruby red colour and offers a complex sensory profile. The aromatic bouquet features red raspberry, ripe cherry, and floral notes of dried rose petals and orange blossom, often complemented by earthy undertones of tobacco, cinnamon, and saddle leather. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and fleshy, delivering concentrated flavours of cranberry, tart cherry, and plum balanced by a gravelly minerality and bright acidity. The structure is defined by fine-grained, tactile tannins that lead to a long, spicy finish with lingering notes of black tea and savory herbs.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir, specifically Pommard and modern Dijon clones 115 and 777.

  • ABV: Generally ranges from 13% to 14%.

  • Ageing: Matured for 10 months in French oak barrels, typically with 20% to 40% new oak.

  • Organic Status: While not specifically certified organic, the winery focuses on sustainable farming and gentle, natural handling of the fruit.

title: Gogi 'Goldie' Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml: Soft and creamy aromas of peach and apricot meet with daffodil and honeysuckle on the delicate but full nose of this bottling by actor Kurt Russell, named for his wife, Goldie Hawn. The first sip is surrounded by a chalky grip, offering fresh and generous flavours of white peach and cream.

title: Gallina de Piel Manar dos Seixas 2021
bodyHtml:
This wine is a tribute to the Galician origins of David Seijas. His last name comes from the term Seixas, which in Portuguese means brave pigeon. Its coat of arms is represented by 5 silver pigeons on green background. The Ribeiro area is full of hot springs or “burgas” that spring (manar in Spanish) from the ground. This wine represents the Manar of the Seixas.

Fresh and aromatic on the nose, this wine opens with notes of lemon, Granny Smith apples and chamomile. Trexiadura lends wonderful weight and pithy texture on the palate, which is balanced by nervy acidity and impressive length.

title: Fontanafredda Chardonnay Langhe 2019
bodyHtml: This is a beauty! No oak, cold climate. Acid is all in well rounded body. Pear, and lemon. Great bang for the buck!

title: Musella Amarone della Valpolicella 2020
bodyHtml:
The Musella estate, a historic property outside Verona, is owned by the Pasqua family. Musella’s winemaking philosophy is rooted in profound respect for nature and its laws, with the winery practicing certified biodynamic agriculture since 2009. 

Wine Description

The Musella Amarone della Valpolicella 2018 pours a dark ruby colour. On the nose, it is complex, offering notes of honey, black cherry, very ripe cherry, and blackberry. Secondary aromas include spicy notes like black pepper and nutmeg, and hints of vanilla. On the palate, the wine is full bodied, presenting a sweet and savoury, warm, and enveloping profile.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include grilled meats, risotto, or aged cheeses. It is also an excellent partner for game.

title: Clase Azul Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Clase Azul Tequila Reposado is an ultra premium spirit from Mexico, specifically produced in the Jalisco region with agave sourced from the Los Altos highlands. The brand journey began over 28 years ago, and it is currently produced by Clase Azul Mexico, a luxury house dedicated to celebrating Mexican culture and craftsmanship. This reposado is the brand's first icon and signature creation, distinguished by its iconic ceramic decanter that is hand-painted with cobalt blue feathered brushstrokes by local artisans.

Spirit Description

The spirit is made from 100% Blue Weber Agave that is slow-cooked in traditional stone ovens for 72 hours before undergoing double distillation. It is masterfully aged for eight months in hand-selected American whiskey casks to develop its complex profile.

  • Colour: This tequila presents a brilliant gold colour with bright yellow highlights.

  • Aroma: The nose is rich and expressive, featuring agave nectar, vanilla, and candied orange peel alongside toasted wood and light notes of hazelnut, cinnamon, and banana.

  • Palate: It delivers a smooth, refined taste with prominent notes of toasted hazelnut, vanilla, cloves, and cinnamon, balanced by a subtle hint of agave syrup. Some palates may also detect caramel, bittersweet chocolate, and ripe orange peel.

  • Body: The spirit is characterized by a medium to full body with a silky mouthfeel.

  • Finish: It concludes with an exceptionally smooth finish that is warmly spiced with lingering notes of clove and oak.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at 40%.

title: Matsui Gin The Hakuto Premium
bodyHtml: Exquisitely blended with a total of 14 carefully selected botanicals including Juniper berry, coriander seeds, orange peel, yuzu peel, Japanese sansho pepper, gyokuro, sakura (cherry blossom), black pepper, nashi pears, which is a speciality of Tottori Prefecture and five other premium botanicals. Matsui Gin ‘The Hakuto Premium’ is a gem proudly produced by Kurayoshi Distillery. Finished with spring water obtained from Mt. Daisen, the mixture of botanicals has created a spicy yet sweet and refreshing complex gin.

title: Bruno Paillard Champagne Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru
bodyHtml:
Very pale and shiny with green tints.  The effervescence is lighter than in the other Champagnes thanks to a less powerful bottle fermentation.  First aromas are citrus – lime and grapefruit – followed by white flowers.  While opening in the glass, a touch of almond and toast appears.  The entry is lively leading to a complex combination of citrus and white flowers.  The effervescence is extremely fine, silky and creamy.  The finish is fresh and long.

Exclusively made of Chardonnay grapes, this wine is also known as “the Lace of Champagne” because of its very fine and persistent white mousse

Blend:  First pressing Chardonnay, sourced exclusively from grands crus vineyards “Côte des Blancs”.

Reserve wines:  25 vintages, going back to 1985.

Ageing:  Four years sur lie, then ten months further ageing after disgorgement. The delicacy of the bubbles helps to tame the naturally mineral Grands Crus to offer a sensation that is both creamy and lively.

Specificity:  A very old winemaking method is used where fermentation in the bottle is less powerful than traditional champagne.

Dosage:  Extra brut, very low dosage: 5g/L


93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Adocate    Sourced from 36 parcels in Oger and Mesnil-sur-Oger, and kept on the lees for 48 months, the NV Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Extra Brut opens with an intense and complex, very mineral and Burgundian bouquet with chalky, toasty and bright fruit aromas intertwined with whole grain and even oyster flavors.  On the palate, this is terribly fresh and intense, very young and straightforward.  There is a rich and almost sweet extract on the palate that gives texture and length.  The finish, however, is cleansing, pure, fresh, and very, very long.  This is a great tensioned and chalky Blanc de Blancs from the Cotes des Blancs, and its aging potential should be enormous.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast    Grand Cru vineyards in Le Mesnil sur Oger and Oger contribute the majority of the Chardonnay fruit in this real representative of the Côte des Blancs. The wine is crisp, and textured, a panoply of white fruits and steeliness. This bottling is ready to drink although it will be even better from 2020 after more bottle age.

title: Veuve D'Argent Blanc De Blancs Brut (NV)
bodyHtml: Fruity and floral aromas with mineral notes and a hint of biscuit on the nose. The palate is fresh and elegant making this the perfect wine to serve with appetizers and to toast any special occasion.

title: Bumbu Creme
bodyHtml: Bumbu Crème is a perfect blend of Bumbu Rum, select spices, and rich, decadent, real dairy cream. It’s an irresistible creation that is perfect chilled, straight, on the rocks, or in a cocktail. Bumbu Crème shares the same heritage that has made Bumbu the world’s favorite craft rum maker.

title: Tenuta di Arceno Valadorna 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
Buffalo Trace Distillery Bourbon Cream
bodyHtml: A delicious blend of rich cream and award winning Buffalo Trace Kentucky Straight Bourbon whiskey. It's sweet, rich and creamy with flavours of vanilla complemented by smooth Bourbon notes. Enjoy it chilled, on the rocks, or added to coffee for an indulgent after-dinner treat. This liqueur is rich and sweet. The smooth taste of Buffalo Trace Bourbon complements the creamy vanilla flavor.

title: Sheep Dog Peanut Butter Whiskey
bodyHtml: Blending peanut butter with whiskey? They thought the idea sounded a little nutty too, but it's time a whiskey was bred to take the party to the next level. Grab a bottle of Sheep Dog Peanut Butter Whiskey, break away from the pack, and woof down the good times.

title: Tenuta di Arceno Arcanum Toscana 2015 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Arcanum is the pinnacle of the estate’s Toscana IGT offerings. Based on Cabernet Franc, the true signature of the estate, this remarkable wine is built to age yet is drinkable young, offering aromas of violets, roses and raspberries, with long and delicate spice notes; it is a wine that is seductive yet subtle. Arcanum is sourced primarily from the L’Apparita and Belvedere blocks of Cabernet Franc. With superb exposure and sandy clay soils, each year these blocks shine to produce the finest expression of the variety, and the leading wine of the estate.

Tasting Notes    During harvest, the Cabernet Franc grapes were picked throughout a three-week window on different blocks just a few kilometers apart — a representation of the Tenuta di Arceno estate’s diverse micro-climate and soil. This beautifully complex pure Cabernet Franc wine expresses the herbal signature of this variety, with aromas of ripe plums, sweet mint, sage and thyme. The luscious palate gives way to cherries, wild strawberries and licorice followed by hints of cedar and toast. The finish lingers with undertones of white pepper and truffle. A truly elegant wine to be enjoyed for years to come.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate     It would be impossible to exaggerate the grandeur and majesty of the overachieving 2015 Arcanum. The blend is 74% Cabernet Franc, 10% Merlot, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon and 6% Petit Verdot. This full-bodied wine is mostly defined by its texture that is exceedingly rich and smooth with significant infusions of blackberry, plum, spice, tobacco and cured leather. The wine achieves beautiful balance, yet it remains intense and powerful all the while.

93 Points - James Suckling     Aromas of lead pencil and currants with blueberries. Medium body, chewy tannins and a savory finish. Needs two or three years to soften.

93 Points - Wine Spectator     This shows fine purity to its black cherry, black currant and iron flavors, despite its dense texture and massive tannins. There is freshness, balance and a chewy feel to the finish.

title: Paolo Scavino Barolo 2020 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: This Barolo represents the history and tradition of blending different crus of Nebbiolo in order to create a house style. The same care and quality work are employed on this wine as for all of the cru Barolo. This wine is an opportunity for many clients to enjoy a great Barolo with an exceptional price-quality ratio.

title: Martin's Lane Riesling Naramata Ranch 2022
bodyHtml:
Martin's Lane Winery, located in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley, is renowned for its precision-crafted Pinot Noir and Riesling. The winery’s commitment to organic farming and minimal intervention winemaking has earned it acclaim for producing expressive, terroir-driven wines. Sourcing from distinct vineyards, Martin’s Lane showcases the unique character of the region.

The 2021 Naramata Ranch Vineyard Riesling is a standout expression of this dedication. Sourced from vines planted in 1976 on red granite and volcanic silty soils, the wine presents a pale straw hue with greenish reflections. Aromas of white peach, mango, and citrus are layered with elegant mineral undertones. On the palate, it is richly textured and opulent, with a perfect balance between ripe fruit and zesty acidity. The finish is long and citrus-infused, indicating its excellent aging potential.

This Riesling pairs beautifully with spicy Asian dishes, seafood, or aged cheeses, enhancing its vibrant character and complexity. Together, these pairings create a memorable dining experience.

The 2021 vintage benefited from a warm growing season, allowing the Riesling grapes to achieve optimal ripeness and complexity. Martin’s Lane’s focus on organic farming and minimalist winemaking has resulted in a wine that authentically reflects the unique terroir of the Naramata Bench.

title: Marques de Caceres Rioja Gran Reserva 2019
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Spain, within the prestigious Rioja appellation of North-Central Spain. Founded in 1970 by Enrique Forner with guidance from legendary Bordeaux oenologist Émile Peynaud, Marqués de Cáceres revolutionized Rioja winemaking by combining meticulous French oak maturation and temperature-controlled fermentation with a primary focus on fruit purity and terroir drive. Sourced exclusively from very old, low-yielding bush vines (averaging 65 to 85+ years of age) in choice high-elevation plots across Rioja Alta and Rioja Alavesa, the vines are rooted in chalky clay-limestone and gravelly alluvial soils. The unique mesoclimate where cooling Atlantic maritime influences merge with Mediterranean warmth allows Tempranillo and its blending partners to undergo an extended ripening cycle, accumulating intense phenolic density, complex skin tannins, and a remarkable, age-worthy natural acidity.

Wine Description

The 2019 Marqués de Cáceres Gran Reserva presents a deep, luminous garnet-ruby color in the glass with brick and dark mahogany highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering a masterfully refined and mature portrait of top-tier Rioja Gran Reserva. The bouquet opens with a soaring, multi-layered display of dried black plums, stewed dark cherries, and wild cassis, seamlessly integrated with complex underlays of sweet pipe tobacco, cedarwood, cured leather, dark cocoa, cigar box, crushed limestone, and a delicate touch of toasted French vanilla. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, muscular, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent core of dark stone fruits, blood orange peel, and dried Mediterranean herbs. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its rich mid-palate extract. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and supple, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of iron, roasted coffee, and dried spice.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 growing season across Rioja is officially rated as "Excellent" by the regulatory council. Characterized by a dry summer with warm daytime sunshine and cool nighttime breezes, the old-vine blocks yielded small, highly concentrated berries with extraordinary flavor depth, deep skin phenolics, and vibrant natural acidity. Marqués de Cáceres harvested clean, pristine fruit at peak physiological balance. The resulting 2019 Gran Reserva combines rich Spanish warmth and dark berry power with noble structural restraint, built to evolve and improve gracefully in a cellar over the next 15 to 25+ years.

title: Rochioli Chardonnay 2018
bodyHtml:
96 Points - Wine Enthusiast    This wine offers incredible aromatics of crème brûlée and brioche, rich, warming characteristics that lead to more mineral driven elements of oyster shell and stone. From several parts of the producer’s estate, including Little Hill and River Block, this is a juicy, lengthy and beautifully structured wine finishing in a swirl of grilled pineapple.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck    Readers looking for a classic Russian River Chardonnay that has the textbook richness of the appellation yet stays fresh and vibrant will love the 2018 Chardonnay Russian River Valley. Coming from a mix of the single vineyards and aged 8 months in French oak, its lighter gold colour is followed by a great nose of buttered pineapple, tart citrus, white flowers, and a kiss of honeysuckle. It's aromatic, has great purity, is medium-bodied, and finishes with bright acidity. In short, it's a terrific Chardonnay that will evolve for 5-7 years.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate    The 2018 Chardonnay Estate opens bright and fresh with scents of chamomile, quince, dried green herbs, baker’s yeast and a stony note. Light to medium-bodied, it’s bright and lifted in the mouth with fresh fruit character, a silken texture and uplifted finish.

title: Domaine Besson Chablis Grand Cru Vaudesir 2021
bodyHtml: Pale yellow. Complex nose of a harmonious blend of white flowers. Buttery and mineral. Softness and finesse, a balance between mineral and buttery notes.

title: Domaine Besson Petit Chablis 2024
bodyHtml: Pale yellow color. The nose is fresh, with aromas of citrus, lemon and grapefruit. The palate has a pleasant roundness with notes of citrus and a slight iodized finish.

title: Zonin Amarone della Valpolicella 2018
bodyHtml: This wine is a beautiful garnet red colour with brilliant ruby reflections. The bouquet is broad and nuanced, with scents of wild berries. The flavour is majestic and velvety with richly dried grape tones. A wine for accompanying refined dishes, especially prime cuts of meat and very mature cheeses. It can also be enjoyed on its own at the end of a meal.

title: Chateau Bellefont Belcier 2020
bodyHtml:
The blend of flowers and truffle on the nose gets you going. The fruit is ripe, sweet, round and soft. There is freshness, elegance and loads of ripe juicy, fresh fruits from start to finish. With an attention seeking nose of flowers, cherries, liquorice and cocoa, the medium/full-bodied, silky, soft textured wine leaves you with sweet, ripe, fresh, juicy plums.

95 Points - James Suckling

A dense, rich red, yet the tannins are so fine and integrated with beautiful texture and finesse. It’s full-bodied, showing pretty balance and refinement with lots of exotic fruit and richness.

94 Points - Decanter

Well-located on the limestone slopes near Pavie, this has been under the ownership of Peter Kwok since 2017. Here he delivers a measured wine that has plenty of limestone character in a saline twist through the finish, while maintaining that St-Emilion gloss. Chocolate pods and just the right kind of bite; feels confident and with potential ahead. 

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

I continue to love this Saint-Emilion, which hails from a 12.5-hectare vineyard located just beside Larcis Ducasse, on the Cote Pavie hillside. Based on 70% Merlot, 25% Cabernet Franc, and the rest Cabernet Sauvignon, the 2018 Château Bellefont-Belcier's deep purple hue is followed by a ripe, medium to full-bodied 2018 with loads of blueberry and currant bud-like fruits as well as notes of leafy tobacco, spring flowers, truffle, and earth.

93 Points - Wilfred Wong

92+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

title: Albert Grivault Bourgogne Chardonnay 'Clos du Murger' 2019
bodyHtml: This is a clean, pure, dry white Burgundy with fresh citrus notes and tropical fruits such as mango. It gives you a full mouth sensation with medium acidity and notes of butter and citrus flavours.

title: Bindi Sergardi Chianti Classico 'Ser Gardo' 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
Darioush Darius II Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
bodyHtml:
93+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Composed of 92% Cabernet Sauvignon and 8% Cabernet Franc, the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Darius II has a deep garnet-purple coluor and subtle scents of kirsch, Black Forest cake and warm cassis with hints of redcurrant jelly, camphor and forest floor plus a waft of lavender. The medium to full-bodied palate is elegantly styled with soft-spoken, quietly intense, mineral-laced black fruit layers supported by velvety tannins and seamless freshness, finishing long and fragrant.

title: Larmandier Bernier Les Chemins D'Avize Grand Cru 2013
bodyHtml:
An Extra Brut blended Champagne coming exclusively from the vineyard planted in Avize, Grand Cru Classé, in Chardonnay grape variety. The vines are around half a century old and the wine comes from two pieces of vines "Chemin de Plivot" and "Chemin de Flavigny" and it is with a discreet wink that this exceptional champagne has been named "Chemins d'Avize".

On the palate and on the nose, white spring flowers, acacia honey, viennoiserie and bergamot from southern Italy. The finish is airy, finely minty with a splendid minerality.

Pair with lobsters, sushi or smoked salmon maki, on grilled sea fish or on sea fish in sauce.

title: Dunville's 1808 Blended Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Drink Dunville's 1808 the traditional way, neat or in the company of a pint, or enjoy tradition with a twist and serve with a mixer or in a cocktail.

Nose... The initial burst of sweet vanilla leads to crisp orchard fruits, apples and pears. Then lemon curd, leading to candied Lemon peel over clean malt notes.
Palate... Soft and creamy mouthfeel, buttery, with ripened citrus and baked biscuit, coming together in a burst of fresh lemon meringue, followed by a wisp of char and white pepper.
Finish... Slight hints of dry smoke linger and intertwine with the juicier fruit notes, carrying through to a finish of sweet spice.

title: Antinori Montenisa Cuvee Royale Brut (NV)
bodyHtml: Presents a light-yellow colour along with a creamy foam and a fine and lengthy perlage. The nose is struck by the pleasurable notes of white peach, well balanced by sensations of bread crust and lees. The palate is harmonious and fully expresses the vivacity of a fine Brut.

title: Tierra Noble Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Tierra Noble Blanco is bright and crystal clear, with silvery sparkles. On the nose, strong presence of cooked agave, herbal notes to mint and citrus, with just a dash of anise. On the palate, soft and fresh with an increasing intensity, notes of raw agave, long finish, rich mouthfeel and balanced complexity.

title: Ganadero Tinto Garnacha 2020
bodyHtml:
This low intervention Garnacha is like the Méntrida countryside in a bottle. Crisp, fragrant and invigorating. This wine will transport you to a fresh mountainside forest before bringing you back home to comforting and lasting flavours. Good for taking your senses on a hike!  A fun and easy-drinking red made with 100% Garnacha grapes from salvaged 50-year-old vines, growing in the foothills of the Sierra de Gredos near Toledo, some 70 km south of Madrid. Bet you didn’t know Garnacha (Grenache in French) is native to Spain! 

Ganadero is smooth and well-rounded with juicy flavours and aromas of fresh mountain herbs. Fruity, bold notes of blueberries, blackberries, and black currant followed by earthy chocolate notes and a touch of vanilla.

Ganadero means rancher or farmer. The label depicts one of the most recognized icons of Spanish culture abroad, the bull, but with a playful twist, portraying it dressed as a ganadero, effectively making the bull the master of its own destiny, a very meta way of showing this wine’s low human intervention.

title: Dunville's Three Crowns Irish Whisky
bodyHtml:
Dunville's Three Crowns was an Irish whiskey produced by Dunville in Belfast years and years ago, though sadly the Dunville's brand was lost to the ravages of time in the 1930s. Fast-forward to 2016, and the Echlinville distillery (Northern Ireland's first licensed distillery in over 125 years) have revitalized the Dunville name and relaunched Dunville's Three Crowns!

This World of Whiskey category winner has sweet marmalade and subtle smoke on the nose. Peat and oak in flavour, with a hint of peppery spice.

title: Mollydooker Shiraz Blue Eyed Boy 2022
bodyHtml:
Who is the blue eyed boy? The Blue Eyed Boy is Sarah’s son, Luke. Stomping grapes as a kid and now heading up the Mollydooker Sales Team.

Black crimson in colour, this wine leaps from the glass with powerful aromatics of blueberries, fresh plum, licorice and nuances of chocolate biscuit. The seamless texture is laced with fresh berry fruit, coffee, vanilla cream and warm spice, giving us a full-bodied Shiraz with an endless depth of flavour and great length.

title: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old - 1.14 Litre
bodyHtml: One of the world's best-selling malts, the famous triangular bottle is a fixture in practically every bar on the globe. Light and easy-drinking stuff loved by millions.

title: Castello dei Rampolla Chianti Classico 2022
bodyHtml: The Rampolla winery, with its cellars dating back to the 13th century and its ancient Castle overlooking the Conca d’Oro’s valley, has been owned by the di Napoli for nearly three centuries. The 42 hectares of vineyard located on calcareous soils at about 360 meters above the sea level in the Chianti Classico locality of Panzano grow Sangiovese, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot, Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc.

title: Mollydooker Two Left Feet 2024
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the renowned McLaren Vale region of South Australia, Mollydooker is owned and operated by left handed winemaker Sarah Marquis. Founded in 2006, the winery quickly achieved global acclaim for its bold, high quality wines and its unique Marquis Vineyard Watering Programme, which ensures optimal fruit weight and flavor intensity.

Wine Description

Two Left Feet is a beautifully balanced red blend composed of 70% Shiraz, 15% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 15% Merlot.
