In the glass, it displays a deep, rich color that leads to an expressive bouquet of dark cherry, blackberry, and plum, layered with secondary notes of vanilla and mixed spices. The palate is characterized by a silky, satin-like fruit profile and ripe tannins that provide fantastic depth and a lingering finish.

title: St. George Baller Whiskey
bodyHtml:
“A California take on the Japanese spin on Scotch whisky.” So says master distiller Lance Winters of this unique and inspired spirit, which was created with Japanese-style whiskey highballs in mind (hence the name Baller).

100% American barley (predominately two-row pale malted barley, the remainder is lightly roasted). After distillation in eau de vie pot stills, the whiskey is aged in used bourbon casks and French oak wine casks, as well as filtered through maple charcoal. The whiskey is then finished in casks that had held house-made umeshu (a Japanese style of plum liqueur we made entirely from California-grown ume fruit).

Crisp and dry, with a touch of malt sweetness and a hint of lychee fruit and nutty almond character. The smoky finish lingers and builds with each sip. In addition to using in Japanese-style whiskey highballs, we also recommend Baller in a "Ballervardier," or in place of Scotch whisky in a Bobby Burns or Rob Roy.

title: Tomintoul 25 Year Old
bodyHtml: The Tomintoul 25 Year Old is from this Speyside based distillery which carries the tag line ‘the gentle dram’. Fans of their previous whiskies will not be disappointed, with this well aged single malt Scotch whisky having a soft fruity flavour with hints of floral tones.

title: Mauro Molino Barolo 2021
bodyHtml: Mauro, Matteo and Martina’s father, founded the estate. In 1973 Mauro graduated from enology school in Alba and then followed that with five years of winemaking experience in Emilia Romagna. In 1979 after his father’s passing, he returned home to the family farm in La Morra. 1982 was the first vintage from the famed family parcel in Conca dell’Annunziata and the rest is history. In 2003 Matteo joined the company and then in 2009, Matteo’s sister also joined the group. Today they manage approximately 12 hectares of vineyards, 50% dedicated to Nebbiolo for Barolo, and the rest Barbera and Dolcetto. This estate practices sustainable viticulture.

title: Riondo Amarone della Valpolicella 2019
bodyHtml:
Riondo Amarone della Valpolicella is an elegant, full-bodied, complex wine. A flavour of black cherry on the palate, with spicy notes of vanilla and a coffee finish.

A wine to accompany first courses with elaborate sauces made with truffles or perhaps pair with game, braised meats, roasts and tasty, well-matured hard cheeses.

title: Masi Amarone della Valpolicella Costasera 2019 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Deep ruby red with brilliant reflections. Intense and elegant aromas of cherry and plum jam with hints of cinnamon and cloves. Firm structure, but soft on the palate. Velvety tannins and round acidity. The wine boasts a long and full fruity finish with a soft spiciness at the end.

Amarone is a full-bodied wine for grilled or roasted red meats, game, and strong tasty cheeses.

title: Belle Glos Pinot Noir Eulenloch 2022
bodyHtml: Owner/winemaker Joe Wagner chose the name Belle Glos to honour his grandmother, Lorna Belle Glos Wagner. Lorna was a co-founder of Caymus Vineyards, an inspirational figure to Joseph and an avid lover of Pinot Noir. A rich and opulent wine offering flavours of dark stone fruit, white pepper, tart cherry, and ripe plum. This wine is well-rounded with bright acidity, velvety tannins and a mouthwatering, long finish.

title: Fonseca Vintage Port 2003 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Fonseca vintage ports are renowned for their great fruit richness and voluptuousness, and, while powerful and mouthfilling, for their breed and balance. In the context of each vintage, they combine the tannic dimension and "grip" which give great port its longevity with the structure and complexity that are Fonseca's hallmark. Among the Douro's first growths, Fonseca Vintage Port is clearly the "Pétrus" of Port.
 
94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate
 
The 2003 Vintage Port comes in with 92 grams per litre of residual sugar. This is a big boy in terms of voluptuous fruit, it is drinkable now, even if it still tightens noticeably as it sits in the glass. This rather dry Fonseca is big and fat, yet there is also some concept of balance. This very warm vintage wasn't exactly shy. The concentration easily counters the power, and it steadily acquired better balance as it sat and aired. Winemaker David Guimaraens told me that he thinks his grandchildren will be able to enjoy it, so there is no rush. Cellar this for another decade, at the least, more like 20 years if you like them softer and more complex.

title: Cliff Lede Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Cliff Lede Sauvignon Blanc 2023 is a vibrant white wine from Napa Valley, California, crafted by Cliff Lede Vineyards. This wine showcases the winery's dedication to producing elegant and expressive Sauvignon Blancs that reflect the diverse terroir of the region.

Blend Composition:

  • Sauvignon Blanc: 77%

  • Sémillon: 23%

Tasting Notes:

  • Aroma: Alluring scents of lime flower, grapefruit, and elderflower.

  • Palate: Flavors of kiwi and lychee transition into pear and white peach, leading to a creamy mid-palate with layers of orange marmalade.

  • Finish: Long and broad, featuring notes of toasted brioche, beeswax, and a crystalline minerality.

Winemaking Process:

  • Harvesting: Grapes are hand-harvested at night to preserve freshness.

  • Pressing: Gentle whole-cluster pressing extracts delicate juices.

  • Fermentation: Conducted in 86% French oak barrels (29% new) and 14% stainless steel tanks at cold temperatures to maintain fruit purity.

  • Aging: The wine is aged on its lees, with select lots undergoing bâtonnage to enhance texture and complexity.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Serve chilled at 8-10°C (46-50°F).

  • Food Pairings: Complements seafood dishes, goat cheese salads, and light poultry preparations.

title: Grgich Hills Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: Grgich Hills Estate is an iconic Napa Valley winery consistently producing world-class wines. Vintner Hall of Fame inductee Miljenko "Mike" Grgich first earned worldwide recognition when the 1973 Chateau Montelena Chardonnay that he crafted won the 1976 Paris Tasting, beating the best of France. Mike then partnered with Austin Hills to open their family-owned-and-operated winery in 1977. Committed to natural wine growing and sustainability, Grgich farms their five estate vineyards without artificial fertilizers, pesticides or herbicides, relies on wild yeast fermentation and uses their passion and art to handcraft food-friendly, balanced and elegant wines.

title: La Dame de Montrose 2021
bodyHtml: Established as a Second Growth in the 1855 classification, Chateau Montrose enjoys an exceptional geographical situation in Saint-Estèphe, facing the Gironde estuary. Its 95-hectare (235-acre) vineyard thus benefits from the moderating influence of the vast water mass nearby during very hot summers and harsh winters. The vineyard is in a single sweep, a rare and priceless advantage in the region. The soil, consisting of deep gravel over clay, favours natural drainage and ensures that the vines benefit from a slow and regular water supply from the water reserves in the subsoil.

title: Cotarella Brunello di Montalcino 'Le Macioche' 2020
bodyHtml: Intense ruby garnet in color, this wine contains aromas of ripe red fruit, Mediterranean scrub, spices, and tobacco. On the palate the wine is rich, fresh and well balanced with a lengthy finish.

title: 19 Crimes Snoop Dogg Cali Rose 2021
bodyHtml: 19 Crimes wines are defiant by nature, bold and always uncompromising, just like the D-O-double-G! This Rosé was created as a collaboration with entertainment icon Snoop Dogg. A Zinfandel-based blend with citrus, strawberry, pear and peach notes. It's light-bodied with a balanced finish. Pair with shrimp cocktail.

title: Flat Rock Riesling 2024
bodyHtml: This estate Riesling, from the northern-most parcel of the West Block in the Flat Rock Vineyard, represents great value year-in and year-out. It has such a vibrant nose of grapefruit, lime, pear, green apple and lovely chalky notes. It shows sweet tart stone fruits on the palate with gushing lime, grapefruit and stony minerals all leading to an energetic and lifted finish. Can cellar for 5+ years.

title: Whistlepig Piggyback Rye
bodyHtml: In the summer of 2018, the late, legendary Dave Pickerell returned to the Whistlepig barrel houses with one mission in mind: create the best Rye Whiskey for use in the world's best cocktails. He knew he wanted a mash bill of 100% rye to capture a full-flavoured spice. He just needed to land on the ideal age statement and bottling strength to realize his dream. It didn't take long for him to arrive at perfection: rye aged not less than six years, carrying a strength of precisely 96.56 proof. A sturdy thread of cinnamon and citrus binds it all together. Stir or shake as you choose. But always sip in good company.

title: Alipus Mezcal San Miguel XX Aniversario
bodyHtml:
Alipús was born in 1999, as a project of the Destilería Los Danzantes, with Don Joel Antonio and sons as the first producers, in San Juan del Río.
 
Alipus XX San Miguel Anniversario from Don Felix Garcia was made with maguey Tobala (Agave potatorum) in San Miguel, Sola de Vega, Oaxaca. It is a single-batch to celebrate 20 years of Alipus.
 
Amazing. There is a particular earthiness before you get to the citrus on the nose. The tepeztate jumps out right away and a lot of freshness from the tobala comes out. This is a very solid!

title: Tito's Handmade Vodka
bodyHtml:
Tito's uses old-fashioned pot stills and taste-test every batch. Their process, similar to that used to make fine single malt scotches and high-end French cognacs, requires more skill and effort, but they think it’s well worth it!

Tito’s Handmade Vodka is America’s Original Craft Vodka. In 1995, Bert “Tito” Beveridge obtained the first legal permit to distill in Texas and created Tito’s Handmade Vodka. They batch distill their corn-based vodka using old-fashioned pot stills and the vodka is naturally gluten-free. Tito’s Handmade Vodka is distilled and bottled by Fifth Generation Inc. in Austin, Texas on the very same land where the whole venture started.

title: Smokehead Islay Single Malt
bodyHtml:
'Wildly bold and not for everyone' 

Alluringly leftfield, enticingly off kilter, Smokehead is custom built for outsiders who will happily walk across fields of burning peat to find something real, something authentic, something unusual. Something that fits them perfectly. Salty and seaweedy, peppery and peaty, smoky and sweet, Smokehead is definitely that. An award winning Islay Single Malt Whisky that’s as bold in taste as it is in attitude. 

Visit Smokehead website here

title: Meukow VS 'Black Panther' Cognac
bodyHtml:
This special blend has been created by Meukow’s Cellar Master, Anne Sarteaux. Aged for over two years, Meukow VS Black Panther Limited Edition Cognac uses eaux-de-vie from several grape growing areas, with a high proportion sourced from Grande and Petite Champagne. The result is a fruity, silky VS Cognac with an abundance of vanilla notes. 

In order to always meet the high level of standard expected of Meukow Cognac, only the heart of the distillate is used for their eaux-de-vie. What follows is an aging process of at least two years in Limousin oak, lending rich woody flavors to the final product.

The history of Meukow dates back to the mid-19th Century, when brothers Gustav and August-Christophe Meukow from Silesia were sent to France in order to procure Cognac for the Russian Tsar Alexander II. After years of searching for the finest eaux-de-vie, they eventually decided to set up their own distillery in 1862. At first, their only customer was the Tsar himself, but the two brothers soon began to make Cognac of considerable quality, winning over the hearts of people around the world. Today, Meukow Cognac is available in over 80 countries. Cellar Master Anne Sarteaux has been with Meukow since 2007, preserving the traditional expertise that has been passed down from generation to generation. 

The signature panther motif has adorned Meukow Cognac bottles since 1995 and thus become their unmistakeable trademark. For this reason, it’s often referred to as the ‘jaguar spirit’.

title: Barcelo Imperial Onyx Rum
bodyHtml:
Barcelo Imperial Onyx is a blend of rums, aged for 10 years in ex-bourbon barrels with a "heavy char" grade (other premium rums are aged in barrels containing a "medium-light char" grade). Filtered though onyx stones, which give Barcelo Imperial Onyx the mysticism that characterizes this rum of unprecedented intensity. It is uniquely different from other Dominican rums because it is made from the fermented juice of sugar cane and not from molasses. The result is a smoother, more well-rounded taste that showcases the true characteristics of the sugar cane.

The sugar cane that is the source for Barceló Imperial Onyx is estate grown in the Dominican Republic (versus other rum producers who source sugar cane or molasses on the open market). This commitment to quality ensures that only the best and most brilliant sugar cane goes into Barceló Imperial Onyx.

title: Rodney Strong Rockaway Cabernet Sauvignon Single Vineyard 2019
L'Usine Pinot Noir Santa Rita Hills 2020 (Orin Swift)
bodyHtml: The blend exhibits darker aromatics of blueberry, raspberry, black pepper, vanilla crème and a slight funk. The entry is refined yet immense with notes of redcurrant, cherry tart and traces of spice that follow through to the mid-palate. The backbone of acidity and a lengthy finish sets up the wine to age for many years.

title: La Spinetta Barolo Garretti 2021
bodyHtml:
A pale ruby red in color, La Spinetta Barolo Garretti offers aromas of ripe red fruits, cinnamon and hydrangea. Fresh and silky, with elegant pomegranate and nutmeg notes on the palate. The finish is complex and generous.

94 Points - James Suckling

This has lovely ripe fruit, with rich plum and peach fruit on the nose, plus hazelnut, orange and bread crust too. It’s full-bodied, creamy and textured with melt-in-your-mouth tannins. Delicious finish.

title: Villon Spiced French Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Villon is a handcrafted spiced French liqueur produced in southwestern France. It is made from a blend of fine VSOP and XO Cognacs, spirits distilled from French wheat, and natural flavors, creating a smooth and complex profile. Inspired by the rebellious 15th-century French poet François Villon, this liqueur bridges the gap between tradition and modern innovation.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: Inviting aromas of vanilla, warm baking spices, and toasted oak.
  • Palate: Smooth and rich, with notes of caramel, dark fruit, cinnamon, and a touch of cocoa.
  • Finish: Long and velvety, with lingering spice and subtle sweetness.

Serving Suggestions

Villon is a versatile liqueur that can be enjoyed in multiple ways:

  • Neat or on the rocks: Sip slowly to appreciate its layered flavors.
  • Cocktails: Adds depth to classics like the Old Fashioned, Sidecar, or Espresso Martini.
  • Dessert Pairing: Complements dark chocolate, crème brûlée, or spiced pastries.

title: Grace O'Malley Blended Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
The Grace O'Malley brand is dedicated to the legendary Irish pirate queen, Grainne Ní Mháille/Grace O'Malley, also known as Granuaile. Born into Irish nobility in Co Mayo in 1530, she was a charismatic and natural leader. Gifted as a negotiator, she was a fearless mariner throughout her life and her great rebellious life should never be forgotten.

Grace O'Malley Irish Whiskey is a special blend, combining multiple batches of whiskey of varying age statements from three to 10 years old. Each batch of whiskey is matured in a range of barrel types, including French oak. Casks are hand selected according to each whiskey's characteristics, including grain whiskey aged in ex-bourbon casks and malt whiskey aged in ex-rum barrels. The resulting blend delivers a whiskey perfectly balanced between flavour, age character, complexity and smoothness.

NOSE... Caramel, bourbon vanilla, malty notes, dry almond, orange peel, honey.
PALATE... Smooth and well-balanced with round tannins and fruit overtones.
FINISH... Middle Eastern pastry, sweet spice and toasted notes.

title: Nicolas Feuillatte Terroir Premier Cru (NV)
bodyHtml:
Feuillatte Terroir Premier Cru is the richest blend of Premier Cru vineyards available on the market. Representing its region of origin, a blend of the three classic grape varieties in equal measure imparts balance and surprising potential to each of the component wines contained within, including the Premier Cru wines of Rilly-la-Montagne, Chigny-les Roses, Jouy-les-Reims, Sermiers, Champillon, Cuis, Cumières and Hautvillers.

The nose displays sweet notes of acacia honey, pear, white fruits and fresh citrus give way to full-flavoured notes. On the palate, spicy notes of Pinot Noir from the south of Montagne de Reims bring intensity and smooth structure to this finely-chiseled wine, caressed by the velvet-textured Meunier, which exudes finesse. Finally, a salty, vibrant burst of energy, together with great poise activate the taste-buds on the finish.

Pair it with scrambled eggs and fresh scones for brunch, salmon gravlax, prawns or other fresh seafood, spring vegetables or perhaps potato chips.

title: Peloton De La Muerte Criollo
bodyHtml:
The Pelotón de la Muerte label is the flag The Doliente Hidalgo, a banner that represented the insurgent army call “the squadron of death”, which sought revenge for the murder of the priest Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla. The red in the flag represents the blood of the leader, the black cross represents the mourning for the priest Dolores, and the bones honour his remains.
 
Pelotón de la Muerte Criollo is open-air fermented for five days before being double distilled, first in Arabic still and then the second pass in a filipino still with a wood hat, producing an intense mezcal with notes of light smoke.

title: Purlieu Cabernet Sauvignon Sugarloaf Vineyard 2018
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Ripe black raspberries, cassis, camphor, flowery incense, new leather and cedar spice notes emerge from the 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Sugarloaf Mountain Vineyard, another rich, full-bodied wine in their lineup. With plenty of minerality, this savoury, balanced 2018 offers a more spice-filled, savoury, almost red-fruited character compared to the darker valley floor sites.

title: Cotswolds Dry Gin
bodyHtml: This award-winning Cotswolds Dry Gin is a delectable blend of nine carefully considered botanicals, including local lavender from nearby Snowshill and freshly-peeled pink grapefruit and lime zest. Due to the unusually high volume of botanicals they use, their gin causes a beautiful pearlescent cloud to appear when ice or tonic is added. To make the ultimate Cloudy G&T, mix with premium tonic water, lots of ice and garnish with a bay leaf and a slice of pink grapefruit.

title: Anno Domini Prosecco Bio / Vegan Extra Dry 2024
bodyHtml: "Diamond" keepsake bottle organic and vegan Friendly. Dry and velvety, fresh, vibrant and fruity, full-bodied, harmonic, excellent acidity and alcohol, excellent long lasting finish!

title: Purlieu Cabernet Sauvignon Georges III Vineyard 2018
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
The nose unfolds into layers of fragrant boysenberry, black and red fruits, and a delicate touch of chervil. On the palate, ripe plum and juicy purple fruit give way to creamy notes of dark milk chocolate, before gliding forward again to support the long, satisfying finish. Well-integrated tannins offer a seamless structure to this elegant wine, and promise many more years of enjoyment to come.

Julien has established himself as one of Napa Valley’s most respected winemakers; producing California varietals with French finesse. His skills are showcased to their fullest in Purlieu; working exclusively with the most sought after fruit in the Valley (Beckstoffer vineyards and beyond) to produce age-worthy Cabernets of incredible depth and structure.

title: Peat's Beast Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Strong and bold with plenty of backbone and structure as this great monster unfolds its fiery fangs on your palate. This is not for the faint-hearted. Take a generous mouthful with a biting wind blowing furiously in your face. Hold it long in your mouth allowing the thick tar, peat smoke and creamy licorice to penetrate every part of your tongue. Time will tame it.

Straw yellow with glittering highlights.  On the nose, a rugged fusion of sea spray, bonfire smoke, damp earth and spicy cinnamon immediately arouses the senses.  These powerful aromas of peat moss and wet grass must be fully respected before seductive notes of crushed pear, apple and freshly baked bread provide the perfect finish to this memorable melody.

title: Mezonte Durango Tepe Aciano Mezcal
bodyHtml: Despite its name, Mezonte Tepe is NOT made with agave Tepextate. Instead this gets it’s name from the Tepehuano community where it’s produced, at the border of Jalisco, Nayarit, and Durango. This reclusive community insists on isolation from western culture ​and the specific location of this distiller is somewhat mysterious. This spirit is made with agave Cenizo (a. bovicornuta). The term Cenizo is used to describe a lot of different agaves, and in this case this agave is also commonly referred to as agave Lechguilla Verde. While we call this spirit a Raicilla for ease of use on this site, there are certain groups that consider this a completely different agave spirit outside of the world of Raicilla.

title: Coto De Imaz Reserva 2020
bodyHtml: A mouth-filling wine typical of the region, with a bouquet marked by American oak élevage. This dry, full-bodied and woody red displays a fresh acidity and fleshy tannins. A perfect pick for beef brochettes.

title: Compass Box Orchard House
bodyHtml:
What is more universally delicious than ripe fruit? Even the greatest chefs have been known to serve a simple dish of strawberries or a single, perfect peach as a dessert.

Orchard House gathers together some of the fruitiest malts Scotland has to offer, including whiskies from the Linkwood and Clynelish distilleries and what’s more, Compass Box has sourced many of these whiskies as new spirit and laid them down in their own oak casks. This, the monument to fresh fruitiness in Scotch whisky has been many years in the making.

When neat or poured over a large ice cube, Orchard House makes for an outstanding pre-dinner malt. It will ably partner amber and pale ales, as well as swathes of soft cheeses. Welcome to a home among the fruit trees ... the door is unlocked.

title: Champalou Vouvray 2023
bodyHtml: Catherine and Didier Champalou both came from vigneron families, yet their mutual sense of independence prompted the couple to brave it on their own. Since starting the Domaine in 1983, its label has become one of the most highly acclaimed in the appellation. Vouvray is home to the noble Chenin Blanc, more commonly known as Pineau de la Loire in their part of the world. The Champalou family farms 21 hectares of vineyards, embracing sustainable farming while integrating the use of the lunar calendar. Their soils are rich, deep, and aerated through regular plowing. The Champalou house style produces wines of great elegance and tenderness, highly aromatic with impeccable balance. No one comes close to copying their distinct style.

title: Freemark Abbey Cabernet Sauvignon 'Rutherford' 2019
bodyHtml: Sourced from Bosché, Sycamore, and Red Barn Ranch, this wine displays all the classic notes of the Rutherford AVA. It is deep garnet in colour and opens with aromas of brambly black fruits, cedar shavings, milk chocolate, graphite and forest floor. The palate is complex and richly textured with flavours of blackberry, coffee, cigar box, and cassis. The tannins are dusty yet well-rounded and integrated, making this wine lovely now with the ability to age gracefully for decades. This wine will give a Cabernet lover goosebumps!

title: Don Julio 1942 Tequila
bodyHtml: Aged for at least two and a half years in American white oak barrels, Don Julio pays tribute to the year that Don Julio González began his tequila-making journey. Distinguished and refined, this special Añejo is produced in small batches and reflects Don Julio González's lifelong passion for making the highest quality tequila. Its sweet and complex aroma complements an equally intriguing range of flavours, including hints of warm oak, pepper and cinnamon. Extraordinarily smooth, with astonishing depth, it is best enjoyed neat in a snifter.

title: Clos du Mont Olivet Chateauneuf du Pape Rouge 2019
bodyHtml:
Aromas of blackberry, red cherry and baking spices. Smooth, concentrated yet balanced; flavors of tart cherries, red plums and light licorice. Very long finish.

Pair this wine alongside grilled steak, lamb roasted with prunes, olive tapenade.

94 Points - James Suckling

Very ripe but restrained and subtle with black fruit, licorice and black olives, this is concentrated, spicy and focused. Compact, tannic core, then a very long, velvety finish with serious power and complexity.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Kirsch, linzer and cherry purée notes stream through in this vibrant and expressive offering, displaying a lovely, silky feel from start to finish. Light iron and shiso hints filter through at the very end, adding range and subtle persistence. Drink now through 2034.

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Moving to the classic 2019 Chateauneuf Du Pape, this little gem should be snatched up by readers, as it’s as textbook as they come. Ruby/plum-hued, with a medium to full-bodied, round, elegant mouthfeel, it has ample red and black fruits, notes of peppery herbs and licorice, supple tannins, and a great finish. A wonderful 2019, it will have two decades of longevity.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Much like the 2018 version, the 2019 Chateauneuf du Pape is a plushly textured, easy-drinking wine. Hints of garrigue and briary notes accent red raspberries on the nose, while the full-bodied palate is silky and expansive, easing into a lengthy finish.

title: Bellingham Bernard Series Chenin Blanc Old Vine 2025
bodyHtml:
This South African Chenin Blanc hails from the Coastal Region, where Bellingham Winery has earned a reputation for innovation and quality. The Bernard Series is a tribute to Bernard Podlashuk, a pioneering force in South African winemaking, known for his bold spirit and modernizing influence. The wine is sourced from old bush vines, reflecting both heritage and craftsmanship.

Wine Description
Brilliant golden in colour, this Chenin Blanc opens with expressive aromas of tropical fruit—pineapple, peach, and passion fruit—layered with honeysuckle, baked apple, and a touch of oatmeal and spice from judicious oak ageing. The palate delivers a rich, creamy texture balanced by zesty acidity, with notes of citrus marmalade and ripe stone fruit. Full-bodied and complex, the wine finishes long and vibrant, showcasing freshness and elegance.

Food Pairing

Ideal with crab cakes topped with lemon aioli, roast chicken with rosemary, grilled fish tacos, creamy mushroom pasta, or firm cheeses such as Gruyère.
Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Markham Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Markham Vineyards is a historic estate located in Napa Valley, California, and stands as the fourth oldest continuously operating winery in the county, having been founded in 1874. Originally established as Laurent Winery by Bordeaux immigrant Jean Laurent, the estate was purchased by Bruce Markham in 1977, who released his first Cabernet Sauvignon the following year. The winery is now part of Distinguished Vineyards & Wine Partners, maintaining a winemaking philosophy that emphasizes food friendliness and the sustainable expression of their 350 acres of estate vineyards across Calistoga, St. Helena, and Yountville.

Wine Description

The 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep ruby color and opens with inviting aromas of sweet hay, cherry, graphite, and warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine is lush and juicy, featuring ripe flavors of blackberry jam and cherry complemented by notes of cocoa, cedar, and tobacco leaf. It possesses a medium to full body with polished, chewy tannins that provide an elegant structure and lead into a long, flavorful finish marked by spice and graphite. This vintage is a blend of 86% Cabernet Sauvignon, 6% Petit Verdot, 4% Merlot, and 4% Cabernet Franc, aged for over 27 months in French oak. While approachable now for its primary fruit, it has the density and weight to evolve beautifully through 2030.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 94 points

  • James Suckling – 91 points

title: Lorenzo Sassetti Montecucco Rosso 'La Querciolina' 2023
bodyHtml: Fresh and fruity. Aromas of little red fruits, herbs and sweet spices. Well balanced. Made from 100% Sangiovese.

title: Daou Pessimist Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
In the golden, oak-studded hills of Paso Robles' fabled west side, there is a man with a vision. His name is Daniel Daou and he is devoting his life and every imaginable resource to creating, first and foremost, wine that rivals the very best in the world.
Gracefully perched atop a stunning promontory at 2,200 feet, the DAOU Spanish Colonial-style winery is embraced by a tangible serenity. Hawks wheel and bank while the all-day sun caresses close planted rows of lush, emerald green vines. The 100 percent calcareous soil makes no sound as it passes out nourishment, and only a gentle breeze flows up through the Templeton Gap from the Pacific. The quiet is bewitching, you want to lay down roots here, just as the four-year-old vines have done. But the sense of peace belies the serious industry at work on this 100 acre estate. No effort is spared to create the luscious varietals and blends that flow from this limited production winery. This kind of synergy happens rarely: superlative climate and terroir, super intensive vineyard culture, and cutting-edge viticultural practice. You're more likely to find it in Bordeaux than Central California. Coupled with the infectious passion and gracious, family-style hospitality of the Daou brothers, Georges and Daniel, the result is pure magic. The kind of magic that comes in a bottle.

title: Daou Eye of the Falcon 2018
bodyHtml:
The 2018 Daou Eye of the Falcon showcases the mutual power and synergy of Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot. The deep, concentrated color is just the beginning of this massive blend. A complex, sophisticated nose offers aromas of black currant, cassis, sweet cherry and blackberry, with underlying layers of graphite, tobacco leaf, leather and wet gravel. Stunningly bright fruit flavors cascade across the palate, with impressions of juicy boysenberry, fresh blueberries and black currant accented by cedar, black plum and dried herbs.

The opulent fruit core transitions seamlessly to a robust mid-palate showing black olive, licorice and eastern spices, all finishing long and elegantly with black cherry, cocoa and plum. Powerful and rich, and polished in style and structure, this is nothing short of a blockbuster vintage.

title: Daou Bodyguard Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml: Bodyguard is the latest masterwork from Winemaker Daniel Daou. Bold and brooding, it displays a dark purple hue. Aromas of ripe black and blue fruits, berry jam, tobacco and maple syrup reveal trailing scents of pepper, campfire and chocolate-covered red fruit. The palate entry is big and broad, displaying rich flavors of freshly crushed berries, cured meat and spice. Concentrated dark fruit flavors extend into a sleek, lengthy finish.

title: Domaine Chanson Pere & Fils Vire Clesse 2020
bodyHtml: A well-balanced wine with a crisp attack, beautiful minerality, well-integrated acidity and a linear, refreshing finish.

title: Argentiera Bolgheri Superiore 2022
bodyHtml: Argentiera, Doc Bolgheri Superiore, draws its strength and uniqueness from the magnificent territory in which it's generated. The grapes come from the estate's best vineyards of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. It is a wine with a rich and silky taste. A long maturation in French oak barrels, the structure of Cabernet Sauvignon and the unique terroir of Tenuta Argentiera make this wine one of the greatest expressions in the Bolgheri area.

title: Osoyoos Larose Grand Vin 2017 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Since its 2004 debut, BC's Osoyoos Larose has achieved Canadian cult status. This Merlot blend is dense and richly fruity with leather and chocolate. 
 
Cellar for 5+ years, or decant and enjoy with leg of lamb, beef ribs in red wine jus, or Roquefort cheese.

title: Clos Henri Sauvignon Blanc 'Otira' 2023
bodyHtml:
A fantastic expression of what Greywacke river Stones are capable of.

Elegant, sophisticated, ripe, varietal and inviting bouquet. Aromas and flavours of citrus fruits and white stone fruit, some pear, apple and pith. The herbaceous character expected of Sauvignon Blanc is a quieter more refined layer in this example. The minerality is a core component of both the aromas and flavour package. Light-weight, crisp, dry and refreshing with a long finish. Balanced, well made and youthful.

title: Tamnavulin Sherry Cask
bodyHtml: This may just be the first official bottling from Tamnavulin Distillery to hit Alberta. Tamnavulin resides in Speyside and is owned by Whyte and Mackay. The Sherry Cask Edition starts its life in American Oak barrels and is then finished in three different types of ex-Sherry casks before being bottled at 40% ABV. A classic revelation from the Speyside Valley.

title: Tamnavulin Double Cask
bodyHtml:
Tamnavulin Double Cask was the first release from the distillery since the 1990s! Over the past 20 or so years, the distillery changed hands from Invergordon Distillers to Whyte & MacKay, closed a few years later and reopened in 2007. Much of its single malt output is used in blends, but a few casks of single malt would sneak out as indie bottlings to allow one a rare taste of Tamnavulin, but now they've got their very own expression! They initially mature the whisky in American oak barrels before treating it to a finishing period in sherry casks.

Nose: Chocolate mousse, extra thick double cream with a dusting of brown sugar, stewed apples and blackberries.

Palate: Christmas pudding, chocolate brownies, yellow plum and toffee-coated barley.

Finish: Spiced rum sweetness lingers on the finish.

title: Faiveley Chardonnay Bourgogne 2022
bodyHtml: Faiveley Bourgogne Chardonnay is classic, rewarding, and nicely balanced. This wine offers aromas and flavours of dried leaves, earth, ripe apple, and dried bark. Serve with rotisserie chicken and wild mushrooms.

title: Penfolds Bin 23 Pinot Noir 2019
bodyHtml:
This is one of Penfolds' premium Bin range wines! This delicate yet nuanced Pinot Noir combines Australia's finest cool-climate locations. Bin 23 is a high-end Pinot Noir sourced from Adelaide Hills, Tasmania, and Victoria.

Bin 23 wafts of truffle and raspberry on the nose. Warm spice and wild thyme blossoms lead to luscious fruitiness, with hints of cranberry, wild strawberry, and sour cherry on the palate. The finish is succulent and appealing.

93 Points - James Suckling

This has a very perfumed nose with aromas of spiced bread, ginger, strawberries and red and darker cherries. The palate has plenty of rich, ripe cherry flavours with a very intense and profoundly flavoursome feel. Silky, long and cleverly extruded tannins here. Smooth, nutty phenolic flow at the finish. Drink or hold.

94 Points - Dan Murphy's Wine Panel

A sleek, rounded and expressive Pinot Noir exhibits violet and cherry aromas, while fleshy dark cherries and wild raspberry flavours fill the mouth sweetly and generously. A dusting of exotic spice, a hint of black forest cake and it's done, finishing with a silken flourish.

93 Points - Andrew Caillard MW

Medium crimson. Intense ripe strawberry, and red cherry fruits with roasted walnut notes. Supple, slinky textured wine with lovely ripe strawberry, red cherry, mulberry fruits, fine al dente/ chalky tannins, lovely mid-palate viscosity and underlying ginger oak. It finishes long and sweet. Lovely definition, density and freshness.

title: Still Austin The Musician Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Still Austin Whiskey Co. is an up-and-coming distillery you want to root for. Located in Austin, Texas, production is led by head distiller John Schrepel.

The Musician... When a musician combines chords, rhythms, and harmonies, the result taps into something deep inside us. Music has the ability to bring us all closer togetheR, to make us feel more free and alive. So does great whiskey.
 
Nose: Cinnamon, light citrus, pine and brown sugar. 
Palate: Maple sugar candy, caramel chews.
Finish: Intense spice, caramel, seasoned oak with medium overall length.

title: Smith & Cross Traditional Jamaica Navy Rum
bodyHtml:
Smith & Cross Jamaica Rum contains only Wedderburn and Plummer pot still distillates, famous for their notes of exotic fruits and spice. The incomparable complexity of this rum delivers a tour de force of flavour that historically made it a cornerstone of classic rum drinks. We have chosen not to chill filter this spirit in order to retain its full flavour.

The mark of Smith & Cross traces its lineage to one of England’s oldest producers of sugar and spirits. Its history dates back to 1788 with a sugar refinery located at No. 203 Thames Street, by the London Docks. Over time, the firm and its partners became prominent handlers of Jamaica rum, with extensive underground cellars along the River Thames.

title: Isle Of Raasay Single Malt
bodyHtml: Isle of Raasay Distillery is a lightly-peated whisky that was matured in a combination of first-fill rye whiskey barrels, fresh Chinkapin oak and first-fill Bordeaux red wine casks. The result is notes of dark berries, earthy smoke, fine sea salt and juicy plums throughout the palate.

title: Hugel Estate Gewurztraminer 2020
bodyHtml: This wine has an attractive and beautifully intense lemon yellow robe, bright, lively pistachio and lime tree highlights, and nice smooth but delicately narrow legs. The bouquet is perfect with a discreet expression of the Gewurztraminer grape character, which will please all connoisseurs of this wonderfully aromatic and flavoursome variety. They will be delighted by its harmonious and smooth hints of fresh roses, freesia, lily, passion fruit, lychee, mango, cardamom and orange blossom. On the palate, one is pleasantly surprised by the impression of a dry wine immediately accompanied by the beautiful rounded and fleshed generosity of the aftertaste, which explodes in the mouth with a multitude of aromas. It is well-balanced, smooth, soft and refined, a delight for those who love this kind of delicious wine, so filled with the taste of the Alsace region.

title: Aberlour 16 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The Aberlour Distillery is at the heart of Speyside, the country's premier whisky-making region. No fewer than half of Scotland's malt distilleries are located in Speyside, which is renowned for producing whiskies of subtle depth and elegance.

With the depth and complexity that comes from being matured for 16 years in a combination of American Oak casks and the finest Sherry butts, this expression’s warm and fruity notes are enriched by an engagingly spicy sweetness.

title: La Fiole Cotes du Rhone Villages Reserve 2021
bodyHtml:
La Fiole Côtes du Rhône Villages Réserve originates from France, within the Southern Rhône region and the Côtes du Rhône Villages AOP. The wine is a distinguished creation of the Brotte family, produced under the 'Père Anselme' signature, which honours Charles Brotte’s grandfather, a respected local winemaker. Founded in 1946, the winery gained global fame in 1952 with the creation of the signature 'La Fiole' twisted bottle—designed by Charles Brotte and ceramist René Contier to mimic the gnarled vines of Provence sculpted by the Mistral wind. The Réserve line was developed to extend this heritage beyond Châteauneuf du Pape, utilising meticulous curation from prime, low-yield sites across esteemed villages such as Cairanne, Laudun, and Vinsobres.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep ruby colour and a medium to full body with a caressing, velvety texture. The sensory profile is complex and mature, featuring an aromatic nose of ripe berries, morello cherry, and plums, interwoven with warm spices like cinnamon, clove, and nutmeg. Secondary aromas include truffles, pipe tobacco, leather, and cedar. On the palate, it is rich and fruity, delivering flavours of prunes, mulberries, and balsamic accents alongside notes of salted licorice and coffee. The finish is long, elegant, and racé, supported by a powdery tannin structure.

  • Varietal Composition: A classic blend typically consisting of approximately 60% Grenache and 30% Syrah, with the remaining 10% comprised of complementary varieties such as Mourvèdre, Cinsault, or Counoise depending on the vintage.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its remarkable concentration and balance; it is aged for 24 months in concrete vats and oak foudres to refine the tannins and develop complexity.

  • ABV: Recorded between 13.5% and 14.5% depending on the specific bottling.

  • Organic Status: While the estate focuses on high-quality fruit from selected low-yield sites, this bottling is not typically certified organic.

Food Pairing

The robust presence and spiced fruit profile of this Réserve make it an ideal partner for savoury, hearty dishes.

  • Meats: Pairs perfectly with grilled ribeye steak, rack of lamb, Peking duck, or slow-cooked braised meats and stews.

  • Savoury & Rich: Suggested pairings include succulent bean casseroles, ratatouille, or wild game such as venison and caribou.

  • Cheese & Dessert: Complements mature, aged cheeses and serves as a striking match for dark chocolate fondant.

title: Orin Swift Palermo Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Orin Swift Cellars, led by winemaker Dave Phinney, is a brand known as much for its creative and evocative expression of art on the front of the bottle as it is the bold, yet finessed styling within the bottle. Based out of Saint Helena, within the prized Napa Valley, Orin Swift features a wine portfolio that appeals to various senses.
 
A brooding red core with a rich cardinal-hued rim, the wine opens with classic Napa Cabernet Sauvignon aromatics, ripe cassis, sunburst raspberry and graphite surrounded by a balanced new oak frame. The bold aromatics translate onto the palate seamlessly with more cassis, red licorice, fresh fennel and mixed berry compote. Integrated yet prominent puckering tannins finish off the wine with a touch of lingering black tea. This label features a photo of a mummified 16th-century Cardinal in Palermo, Italy. The photo's sense of power, reverence and dignity reflects how their winemaker crafts Cabernet.

title: The Hilt Pinot Noir Santa Rita Hills 2018
bodyHtml:
Wines defined by place, style and time. In the southwest corner of Sta. Rita Hills AVA lies a rugged, windswept, coastal vineyard, called The Hilt Estate, an estate grower producer of stunning Pinot Noir and Chardonnay reflective of this dynamic corner of California. Pushing the limits in the farthest southwest reach of the Sta. Rita Hills AVA is home to Radian & Bentrock Vineyards, these vineyards dictate The Hilt style. The numerous microclimates and unique soils provide a multilayered backdrop to create 3 unique expressions: Estate, The Guards, and Single Vineyards. In 2014, Matt Dees, Ruben Solorzano & team took on operation and farming of Radian and Bentrock Vineyards and shifted to precise sustainable & organic farming to transform and revitalize the soil.

Savoury, dark and perfumed Pinot Noir. Lifted notes of rose petals, black cherry, dried tobacco, blood orange, sage, pomegranate and cracked white pepper. Bright and savoury red fruit with salinity, fresh herbs and focus. Lightness and charm on the palate with darker overtones of earth and dust. Gentle tannins with a vinous touch from minimal stem inclusion combine to make a finish that lingers. Ultimately a wine defined by elegance and precision.

title: Dana Estates Cabernet Sauvignon 'Helms Vineyard' 2018
bodyHtml:
The 2018 Dana Estates Helms Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon is a wine from the Rutherford appellation in Napa Valley, California. Renowned for its exceptional quality, this single-vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon reflects the unique terroir of the Helms Vineyard and the meticulous craftsmanship of Dana Estates.

Vineyard and Production

Helms Vineyard, located in the heart of Rutherford, is characterized by its well-drained, loamy soils and optimal sun exposure, providing an ideal environment for cultivating premium Cabernet Sauvignon grapes. The 2018 vintage experienced favorable weather conditions, contributing to balanced ripening and the development of complex flavors. The wine is crafted from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon and aged for 21 months in 100% new French oak barrels, enhancing its structure and aging potential.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Deep garnet-purple hue.

  • Aroma: Enticing scents of Morello cherries, blackcurrant pastilles, and mulberries, complemented by hints of chocolate mint, violets, forest floor, and a touch of cinnamon toast.

  • Palate: Full-bodied and elegantly structured, the palate reveals flavors of black cherry, mocha, and exotic spices. The refined tannins provide a velvety texture, leading to a lingering finish that showcases the wine's precision and poise.

Serving and Pairing

To fully appreciate its complexity, decant the wine for at least an hour before serving at a temperature of 16-18°C (61-64°F). This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs exceptionally well with rich dishes such as braised short ribs, grilled lamb chops, or aged cheeses. Its depth and structure also make it a suitable companion for hearty stews and roasted game meats.

title: Famille Perrin Ventoux 2024
bodyHtml: The Perrin family, also owners of the famous Château de Beaucastel, search for the most suitable terroirs to produce a fresh and fruity wine. Unpretentious, this is the archetypal pleasure wine, authentic, genuine and tasty. The vineyards are located on the slopes of Mont Ventoux. The altitude offers freshness, which provides a good acidity level to the grapes. The wine is therefore fresh, fruity and well balanced.

title: Duckhorn Merlot Three Palms 2021
bodyHtml:
This iconic red wine originates from the United States, specifically the Napa Valley region of California, and is a single-vineyard designate from the legendary Three Palms Vineyard in the Calistoga appellation. Duckhorn Vineyards was co-founded in 1976 by Dan and Margaret Duckhorn with a specific focus on crafting premium Merlot. The winery has been producing a vineyard-designate Merlot from Three Palms since its inaugural 1978 vintage, and the vineyard is revered as a benchmark for New World Merlot, known for yielding profoundly intense and age-worthy wine.

Wine Description

The 2021 Three Palms Merlot is an elegantly full-bodied and deep garnet-coloured expression. On the nose, it offers alluring aromas of huckleberry, fig jam, cranberry, cocoa, and rose petals. The palate is rich with flavours of blackberry, cherry, molasses, and a distinct wet slate minerality. It is a blend of 87% Merlot, 11% Cabernet Sauvignon, 1% Malbec, and 1% Cabernet Franc. The wine’s sumptuous structure is framed by fine, graceful tannins. It was aged for 18 months in 100% French oak, with 75% of the barrels being new. It is full-bodied and generous, displaying a seamless, silky smooth mouthfeel.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 94 points

  • James Suckling - 94 points

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points

Food Pairing

This exceptional Merlot is a perfect match for robust, flavourful dishes. Suggested pairings include filet mignon smothered with a classic red wine and mushroom pan sauce, roast beef covered with a mushroom gravy, and hearty red meats like Beef, Lamb, or Veal. The wine's rich, concentrated dark fruit and polished tannins stand up beautifully to the intensity of these meats. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Louis Jadot Savigny Les Beaune 'Clos des Guettes' Premier Cru Blanc
bodyHtml: Nicely balanced between acidity and rich body, Les Guettes has aromas and flavours of apples, white flowers and spices, and will develop in the bottle for 8 to 12 years. This wine will pair well with white meat, terrines and light cheeses.

title: La Soufrandiere Pouilly Vinzelles Climat 'Les Quartz' 2023
bodyHtml: From vines aged over 80 years old and located in the mid-slope sweet spot of this vineyard, this is beautifully balanced. The nose is a cocktail of apple, citrus and a touch of peach, while the palate is intensely fresh with spine-tingling acidity that emerges from the mid-palate and stretches the wine to a long, tangy, mentholated finish.

title: Chateau Lynch Bages 2018
bodyHtml:
Daring, innovative and with a reputation for often being the last to harvest, Jean-Charles Cazes defined the style of Lynch-Bages in the 1930's. The wine's distinctive character has earned it a place amongst Pauillac's greatest. It combines structure, finesse and elegance, offering generous aromas in its youth and developing deeper complexities with bottle age. The estate’s reputation as a top quality wine producer took off in 1945 after a series of exceptional vintages. Since then, Lynch-Bages has continued to produce excellent wines, even during years considered difficult in the Bordeaux region. The wine’s deep color and tannic backbone have become part of its signature style. Jean-Michel Cazes, grandson of Jean-Charles, has worked hard to develop and refine the wine’s supple and smooth structure over the years. Vintage after vintage, the estate’s precise and excellent winemaking techniques have served to firmly establish Lynch-Bages reputation for consistent quality.

98 Points - Jeb Dunnuck     One of the finest vintages I've ever tasted from this address, the 2018 Château Lynch-Bages has everything you look for in a great wine: incredible aromatics, richness without weight, perfect balance, and a purity of fruit that's just about off the charts. Dense purple, it reveals a glorious perfume of blackcurrants and blackberry fruits, a deep, unctuous mouthfeel, building tannins, and a complex array of cedar pencil, tobacco, wood smoke, and chocolate. A true blockbuster in every sense, with masses of fruit and tannin's as well as moderate acidity, it will probably merit a triple-digit score in a decade and is a 50+-year wine from this team. 

97 Points - James Suckling     Aromas of blackberries, cloves, licorice, dried leaves, graphite and black olives. It’s full-bodied with firm, tight tannins. Structured and tannic with beautiful austerity and a long, mineral and layered finish. The tannins grow on the palate. Try from 2026.

96 Points - Wine Enthusiast     The Lynch-Bages style is unmistakeable in this wine’s richness and the density of its structure and tannins. In addition it conveys a great sense of style, restrained power and opulence. Drink this wine from 2027. Cellar Selection

96 Points - Decanter     Deep, rich black fruits on the nose followed by a powerful punch of spice alongside a ferocious tannic structure that will benefit from the extra polishing of bottle ageing. Combines tannic heft with cassis, bitter chocolate shavings, sage, cardamom and smoke. This is impressive, with a solidly confident, classic Pauillac character and a great example of the confidence of Lynch-Bages right now. Drinking Window 2028 - 2048

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate     Composed of 72% Cabernet Sauvignon, 19% Merlot, 6% Cabernet Franc and 3% Petit Verdot, the 2018 Lynch-Bages was aged in 75% new barriques. Deep garnet-purple in color, it soars out of the glass with a magnificently expressive nose of blueberry compote, black cherry preserves and blackcurrant pastilles, plus suggestions of dark chocolate, licorice, tar and violets with a waft of hoisin. The medium to full-bodied palate is just as impactful as the nose, coating the mouth with juicy black berry and spicy layers, supported by firm, grainy tannin's and seamless freshness, finishing long with a refreshing earthiness coming through at the end.

95 Points - Wilfred Wong of Wine     The 2018 Château Lynch Bages is amazingly deceptive as it stays long and lasting on the palate. This wine shows sophisticated aromas and flavors of black fruit, spice, and hints of oak. Enjoy it with a grilled Porterhouse topped with triple cream blue cheese.

title: Ben Marco Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
BenMarco is all about viticulture. Having planted more than 3,000 acres of vineyards across Argentina’s diverse terroirs, Edgardo “Edy” Del Popolo, General Manager of Susana Balbo Wines in Mendoza and head winemaker for BenMarco, is Argentina’s most knowledgeable winegrower. He has tasted almost every piece of dirt!

BenMarco wines are made with minimal intervention to allow for the purest interpretation of what’s underground on the extreme sites where the grapes for BenMarco are grown. “I try to avoid adding my influence to BenMarco wines,” Edy says. “What I really like to see is what the vines can do, without any kind of winemaking influence.”

Edy grows three red wines from three distinct, high-elevation sub-zones of Mendoza: a Malbec from Los Chacayes, a Cabernet Sauvignon from Los Árboles, and Expresivo, a red blend from Gualtallary. Since the inaugural 1999 vintage, all three wines have consistently received outstanding scores from each of the four leading American wine publications.

BenMarco Cabernet comes entirely from alluvial soils in Los Árboles, Uco Valley. It is a floral, rich and concentrated wine. On the palate, notes of black fruits, black pepper and cassis are perfectly well balanced with fine grained tannins that give a nice tension to the wine.

title: Poliziano Rosso di Montepulciano 2023
bodyHtml: Rosso di Montepulciano has been a D.O.C. since 1989 and can be produced by simply declassifying the grapes registered for Vino Nobile. At Poliziano, vice versa, a uncompromising choice was made: they selected the most suitable vineyards to obtain a young, fruity, and full-bodied wine.

title: Fukuda Shuzo Capitan 10 Year Aged Barley Shochu - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Established in 1688, Fukuda Shuzo is a historic brewery located in Hirado, which was a major international trading hub during the 17th century. The name Capitan is the Portuguese word for 'captain' or 'pioneer', paying homage to the Portuguese missionary Xavier Capitan who began trade in Hirado during the 1550s.

Description

This premium barley shochu features a deep amber colour resulting from ten years of maturation in oak barrels. The aroma is thoroughly complex and woodsy, offering notes of butterscotch, charcoal, and campfire smoke that harmonize with earthy barley scents. On the palate, it provides a mellow and rich texture with a pleasant sweetness and a significantly deeper flavour profile than younger spirits. The finish is smooth and prolonging, showcasing a sophisticated balance of oak and cereal notes. ABV 35%.

title: Undurraga Red Field Blend 2022
bodyHtml: Undurraga recently developed a historic wine that draws on their long history dating back over 100 years to 1885. It is a limited production run of only 1,359 bottles and is produced from the classic field blend that the original grape growers and winemakers used long ago consisting of Malbec, Carignan, Cabernet, Cinsault and Pais. The bottles are individually numbered, sealed with a wax capsule and display a beautiful scene of the original estate vineyards.

title: Clos Bellane La Petite Cotes du Rhone Villages 2023
bodyHtml: The color is purple with intense purplish reflections, indicating exceptional maturity. The nose evokes wild blackcurrant, elderberry and green pepper with a touch of terroir evolving on the scrubland. In the mouth, the velvety tannins give an additional dimension. The structure is present and pleasant, but the grain of the tannin is quite exceptional by its discreet presence, ending on a finely distinguished fruity note.

title: Siro Pacenti Brunello di Montalcino 'Pelagrilli' 2020
bodyHtml:
Siro Pacenti bought his estate and planted his first vines in 1970, all of which still thrive today. The property is north of Montalcino, in Pelagrilli, and overlooks Siena with 22 hectares of Sangiovese in fresh, clay soils. In 1988, Giancarlo Pacenti took over operations at the winery, producing the first Rosso and Brunello di Montalcino that same year. At the beginning of the Nineties, the estate expanded to include land south of Montalcino (Piancornello) where Giancarlo’s grandfather had planted five hectares of Sangiovese in the 1960s.

Pelagrilli is characterized by clayey, sandy soils, sitting at 350 meters above sea level at the base of the Montalcino hill. The wines are elegant and aromatic. In Piancornello, the vineyards grow in more minerally and pebbly soils atop ground rock. The climate here is also hotter, resulting in more structured, potent wines with the sweet, round tannins typical of Sangiovese.

Lots of structure and true pedigree from the northern section of Montalcino. Higher tone red fruits enveloped by French oak accents of toffee and vanilla.

title: Callaway Cabernet Sauvignon Cellar Selection 2022
bodyHtml: Callaway Cellars was founded in 1969 by the late Ely Callaway of Callaway Golf fame. This blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Petite Sirah and Zinfandel was aged 90% in American oak and 10% in French oak for seven months. The resulting wine is lithe, with dark fruit wrapped in notable oak, cloves, cedar and smoke. A wine for grilled beef ribs or steak.

title: Callaway Chardonnay Cellar Selection 2024
bodyHtml:
The Callaway Chardonnay Cellar Selection originates from the coastal winegrowing regions of California, United States. Founded in 1973 by Ely Callaway, a pioneer in both viticulture and the golf industry, the winery has established a pedigree of over 50 years of winemaking. Now privately owned by the Lin family, the winery continues to honour its founder's philosophy of precision and passion by crafting fruit forward, approachable wines designed for everyday enjoyment.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a vibrant sensory profile, opening with forward aromas of green apple and butterscotch, complemented by notes of toasty oak and crème brûlée. The palate is medium to full bodied, featuring a rich layer of tropical fruit, ripe pear, and pineapple balanced by a creamy texture and vanilla oak spice. A crisp acidity provides freshness and leads to a smooth, lingering finish of toasted hazelnuts and roasted pineapple.

Food Pairing

The wine's rich texture and tropical notes make it an ideal companion for BBQ scallops, roast chicken, or grilled vegetables. It also pairs beautifully with creamy pasta dishes, seafood such as lobster with drawn butter, or mild cheeses like Brie and Monterey Jack.

title: Anna De Codorniu Cava Brut Reserva
bodyHtml:
Brilliant yellow colour with green reflections. Fine, persistent bubbles forming continuous beads. On the nose, it displays citrusy and tropical fruit notes along with more complex aging aromas (toast & brioche) that enrich the range of aromas. On the palate, it is creamy, wide and long-lasting. The result is a highly versatile wine, pairing with a great variety of food.

The freshness and delicacy of the Brut make it an ideal aperitif. It also goes well with shellfish and white fish. Suitable for sushi, sashimi or lightly spiced carpaccio.

title: Cristom Pinot Noir Louise Vineyard 2022
bodyHtml:
Cristom Vineyards is a family-owned and operated winery that has established itself as a top producer of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay in the Eola-Amity Hills district of Oregon's Willamette Valley.

Vintage after vintage, Cristom produces top quality wines, no matter how easy or challenging the elements make it. This consistency is a testament to the deep knowledge of the vineyard, the respect for the land, and a light touch in the cellar. Recognized globally as a leading producer in the beloved Willamette Valley, their wines continue to be a unique blend of tradition, modernity and finesse.

title: Bruno Giacosa Nebbiolo D'Alba 2023
bodyHtml:
The Bruno Giacosa Nebbiolo is subtle and elegant with notes of red fruit and dried roses. On the palate, the tannins are present, but fine and well-integrated, and the wine showcases excellent freshness and persistence of fruit. 100% Nebbiolo from 42 year old vines, aged 14 months in French oak.

A great pairing for braised or roasted dark meats and rich sauces.

title: Zuccardi Aluvional Gualtallary 2019
bodyHtml: The Zuccardi Aluvional Gualtallary Malbec is selected from the best alluvial soils in the Uco Valley and expresses the characteristics and very essence of the Gualtallary terroir. Grapes are hand harvested from old vines grown in the rich alluvial soils then fermented in concrete vats before ageing in barrel and then in concrete vats. The nose displays red and black fruit characters with notes of blackberry, cherry and plum complemented by fresh herbal and violet notes. The palate is juicy, with a lively acidity, mineral texture and elegant tannins.

title: Galius Saint Emilion Grand Cru 2020
bodyHtml: Deep purple colour. Aromas of blackberry jam, spearmint, bacon-wrapped dates, and butter with a slightly chewy, crisp, dry medium-to-full body and a hot, delightful, medium-length black cassis, sage, leather, caramelized mushrooms, and ground pepper finish with earthy tannins and moderate oak flavour. A warming, chewy Bordeaux to unwind in the cellar.

title: Tremblay Chablis Vaudesir Grand Cru 2023
bodyHtml: Aromas of smoke, pineapple, and cream on the nose. On the palate it is rich and warm, with bold flavours of golden pear, white flowers, and pine.

title: Poggio Scalette Chianti Classico 2022
bodyHtml:
This is a wine that expresses both the Chianti Classico terroir as well as the Sangiovese grape. The grapes for this wine are sourced from vineyards in the village of Ruffoli, located in Greve. Harvested at the peak of ripeness in October and fermented in concrete tanks, this wine is one of the finest examples of this classic Italian varietal.

Bright ruby red in colour, a lively bouquet of red fruits and blackberries complement undertones of ripe cherries and pomegranate seeds. On the palate, the wine is fresh and fruit-forward with silky tannins that evolve throughout the finish. A very food-friendly wine that can be paired with a number of dishes including rosemary roasted lamb, tomato based sauces, and hearty chicken stews.

title: Faiveley Bienvenues Batard Montrachet Grand Cru 2020
bodyHtml:
96 Points - Decanter

The pebbles of Bienvenues leaven the soil somewhat, introducing minerality and a bit more freshness into the wine. It is certainly still a ripe year, with aromas of apples, spice and a hint of butter, but it never tips over into heaviness. The texture is very creamy, yet there is plenty of finesse and elegance. This parcel of vines was acquired from Jean-Pierre Monnot in 2008. Drinking Window 2025 - 2050.

title: Paternoster Falanghina Vulcanico 2023
bodyHtml:
Volcanic wines are currently one of the hot topics in the wine world, and the Vulcanico Falanghina is having its moment in the sun. The name “Vulcanico” highlights the fact that the grapes are harvested from vineyards near the base of Mount Vulture, an extinct volcano. The Vulcanico combines the freshness, balminess and delicacy of the Falanghina grape with the brightness and generosity that one would expect from a white wine from southern Italy.

A straw yellow colour that contains brilliant green reflections. Intense and persistent aromas with sensations of delicate white flowers and fruit. Fresh and balanced, with a clean finish.

title: Bruno Giacosa Barbera D'Alba 2024
Coriole Chenin Blanc 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
The Lloyd family founded Coriole in 1967, and are considered pioneers in the McLaren Vale region, and visionaries in the planting of Italian and French varieties. Long before it was fashionable, Mark Lloyd developed vineyards of Sangiovese, Picpoul, Chenin Blanc, Nero d’Avola, and others, plus of course, Shiraz. They are considered one of the leading lights of the region.

It is a classic, traditional Coriole Chenin with a delicate filigree of autumnal fruits and spring florals. The nose displays red apple and pear, crisp white peach, honeysuckle, jasmine and quince flower and a hint of Leatherwood honey. A pleasant and clean palate which fills the mouth with moreish textural acidity. McLaren Vale Chenin is all about a clean, crisp and easy-drinking white, and delivers on all fronts. A rich baked salmon dish with green herb sauce would complement the palate roundness of this wine.

title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Brunello is the prince of Montalcino wines, produced exclusively from Sangiovese grapes picked by hand from the oldest vines in the farm. After being aged in wood, the wine is bottle aged: this is an essential process in guaranteeing the pleasantness and the complexity that have made the Brunello di Montalcino world-famous. Ruby red in color, with a very intense, persistent nose and with red fruit notes. Warm, balanced flavour with velvet-smooth tannins. Long-lasting aroma.

title: Benriach 12 Year Old The Smoky Twelve
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: A whisky that focuses on the richer side of Benriach's spirit, as well as it's darker smokier side. Aged for 12 years in a combination of bourbon, sherry and marsala casks, the peat smoke is complimented by dried fruit and vanilla from the bourbon and sherry casks, and rich, sweet fruit from the marsala.

title: Aberlour A'Bunadh Alba
bodyHtml:
The newest expression to join the A’bunadh family is Aberlour A’bunadh Alba (pronounced a-boone-ack alba). Alba means white, as in Quercus alba, American white oak. It is also used to refer to Scotland. The name can be translated into “the Scottish original” or a variant of that. 

A’bunadh Alba offers distinctive green fruit notes of sweet baked apple and pepper along with fresh citrus zest, matured in Bourbon oak barrels, batch no 4.

The color is a light gold. On the nose, it is sweet, with a pronounced aroma of ripe red apples. There is also some pear, some floral notes along with honey, vanilla and a hint of cinnamon.

On the palate, the whisky is sweet. There is a pronounced alcohol burn, along with a bitter note and a sharp pepperiness that builds quickly. As the whisky opens up elements of citrus zest, cinnamon and dried apple emerge. The whisky is smooth, with a creamy, oily texture and an obvious palate weight.

The finish is long, sweet, with a pronounced pepperiness.

title: Fantini Edizione Cinque Autoctoni
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy, Fantini Edizione Cinque Autoctoni is a unique blend sourced from the regions of Abruzzo and Puglia. The Fantini Group, established in 1994, has grown into one of Italy's leading wineries with a philosophy centered on crafting high-quality wines that showcase the rich viticultural heritage of southern Italy. By blending grapes from different regions, winemakers Filippo Baccalaro and Dennis Verdecchia aim to achieve a harmonious expression of 'five indigenous' varieties that transcends traditional regional boundaries.

Wine Description

This wine displays a very deep garnet red colour and an intense, persistent bouquet. The nose is complex, featuring prominent notes of cherry, blackcurrant, and prunes, complemented by spicy layers of cinnamon, cloves, cocoa, and liquorice, with a subtle mineral undertone. On the palate, it is full bodied and well structured, balancing alcohol with a lifted freshness and velvety, supple tannins. The finish is remarkably long and persistent, revealing additional hints of vanilla and chocolate.

title: Casamigos Reposado Tequila - 375 ml
bodyHtml: This Reposado brings all of the characteristics of the Blanco, but with a heavy dose of caramel. It is aged 7 months in American Oak. It has a smoother mouth feel in the front, but has a slightly rougher finish.

title: Terralsole Brunello Di Montalcino 2019
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Italy, produced in the Tuscany region within the Brunello di Montalcino DOCG. Terralsole, which translates to 'land toward the sun', was founded in 1996 by Mario Bollag and Athena Tergis. The winery's philosophy focuses on a 'micro-cru' approach, emphasizing sustainable viticulture and a deep respect for the diverse terroirs found within their estate vineyards.

Wine Description

The Terralsole Brunello Di Montalcino 2019 displays a brilliant ruby red colour with garnet reflections. The nose is aromatic and complex, offering scents of wild berry, dark cherry, and red plum, complemented by floral notes of violet and earthy hints of tobacco and forest floor. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and well structured, featuring layers of ripe fruit, liquorice, and leather integrated with firm, velvety tannins. It is characterized by its exceptional balance and vibrant acidity, leading into a long, persistent finish with mineral and spicy undertones. This 100% Sangiovese Grosso typically has an ABV of 14.5%. The estate is certified organic, reflecting a commitment to natural vineyard management. The optimal drinking window is from 2026 through 2045.

Accolades

Wine Enthusiast - 93 points.

James Suckling - 92 points.

Jancis Robinson - 17.5/20 points.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and vibrant acidity of this Brunello make it an ideal partner for savoury, protein-rich dishes. It pairs perfectly with braised short ribs, wild boar ragù, or roasted lamb, which enhance its firm tannins and deep fruit profile. It also complements earthy dishes like mushroom risotto or pasta with leek and Gorgonzola.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 vintage in Montalcino is considered a 'magical' and exceptional year, characterized by a steady growing season without extreme heat spikes. These ideal conditions, including timely rainfall, allowed for a slow and even ripening process that achieved optimal phenolic maturity and al dente fruit character.

title: Douglas Laing's Rock Island Sherry Edition Blended Whisky
bodyHtml: Here is the excellent Rock Oyster Blended Malt that we've loved so much with additional aging in high quality sherry butts from Jerez. The standard Rock Oyster takes our favorite Island malts, none of which cannot be named, from distilleries you know and love, blends them together thoughtfully and offers them at a very attractive price. That wonderful whisky highlights those special malts created Scotland's Island distilleries (think Jura, Islay, Skye, Arran and Orkney). Very little go together better than salty maritime malt and sherry.

title: Jura 18 Year Old
bodyHtml: This peated single malt spent its first 18 years of maturation in American oak, ex-bourbon barrels. The whisky then finished aging in former Premier Grand Cru Classé Bordeaux red wine barrels.

title: Wiser's 15 Year Old
bodyHtml: Deliciously smooth and aged for 15 years, this whisky needs to be sipped and savoured to appreciate the full depth of its flavour. Don’t wait 15 years to try this. This whisky is at its best when sipped neat, on the rocks, or with a few drops of water.

title: Chateau La Dauphine 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from France, within the prestigious Fronsac A.O.C. appellation on the Right Bank of the Bordeaux region. Produced by Château La Dauphine an historic estate whose origins date back to 1670 and which hosted Maria Josepha of Saxony, the Dauphine of France and mother of King Louis XVI this property stands today as one of Fronsac’s premier biodynamic icons. Sourced from 53 hectares of certified organic and biodynamic estate vineyards, the vines average over 30 years of age and are planted across a dramatic amphitheater of clay-limestone plateau and molasse soil terraces overlooking the Dordogne River. Fronsac's maritime-influenced temperate climate features long, sun-drenched growing seasons moderated by river currents, allowing Merlot and Cabernet Franc to achieve complete phenolic maturity, rich skin concentration, and noble structural balance.

Wine Description

Château La Dauphine presents an opaque, deep garnet-purple color in the glass with vivid crimson and violet reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and sophisticated portrait of Right Bank limestone terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crushed black plums, dark dark cherries, and wild blackberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh violets, pipe tobacco, crushed chalk minerality, cedar, and dark cocoa nibs. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of dark berry compote, licorice, blood orange zest, and graphite. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly across the mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, silky, and linear, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of iron, black pepper, and subtle oak spice.

title: Cava De Oro Plata Tequila
bodyHtml: Tequila Cava de oro Silver, intense and fun. With a luminous crystalline color, with silvery and straw-colored tones, it offers a warm flavor with spicy and herbaceous notes. Without a doubt an excellent tequila to be enjoyed alone or mixed.

title: Cenote Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: Master Distiller Arturo Fuentes and his dedicated team have crafted an appealing añejo. Vibrant amber in colour, it has delightful aromas and flavours of vanilla, cinnamon, chocolate and toasty oak. The finish is lengthy and warm, a perfect spirit to enjoy neat or over ice after dinner. Pair with tequila-infused truffles.

title: Cenote Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: A complex reposado, that's distilled from blue agave and rested for three months in American oak to round out and develop the fine character. Shows aromas and flavours of vanilla, wood, spice and ripe fruit with green herbal notes. The palate is creamy and rounded with a complex finish. Best savoured slowly on its own.

title: Domaine de l'Enclos Chablis 'La Fourchaume' Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
From the rolling limestone hills of northern Burgundy, France, comes this elegant Premier Cru Chablis by Domaine de l'Enclos. Based in the heart of Chablis, the domaine is led by the Bouchard brothers, Romain and Damien, who converted their family vineyards to organic farming and founded Domaine de l’Enclos in 2015. With a deep respect for terroir and minimal intervention, they aim to express the purity and minerality of Chablis in each bottle.

This 2023 ‘La Fourchaume’ reveals a pale gold hue with green reflections. The nose is vibrant and lifted, offering classic Chablis aromas of crushed oyster shell, white flowers, lime zest, and wet stone. On the palate, it is taut and precise, featuring a saline core wrapped in notes of lemon curd, green apple, and fresh herbs. The wine has a medium body with razor-sharp acidity and a lingering, mineral-driven finish. Made entirely from Chardonnay grapes grown on Kimmeridgian limestone soils, it captures the tension and energy typical of the Fourchaume climat.

Food Pairing
Ideal alongside freshly shucked oysters, grilled prawns with lemon butter, or a goat cheese tart. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Domaine de l'Enclos Chablis 'Montmains' Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine is from France, specifically from the Burgundy region within the Chablis Premier Cru subregion. Domaine de l'Enclos was founded by brothers Romain and Damien Bouchard on historical grounds once linked to the Pontigny Abbey. The estate operates out of a state-of-the-art gravity-fed cellar built in 2016, where the winemaking philosophy prioritizes minimal intervention and the preservation of unique plot characteristics.

Wine Description

The 2023 Domaine de l'Enclos Chablis 'Montmains' Premier Cru displays a clear, light gold colour with greenish highlights. The aromatic profile is intense and seductive, featuring notes of green apple, ripe stone fruits, and citrus, underscored by flinty minerality and saline iodine. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and firm, offering a crisp acidity that highlights flavours of lemon, lime, and fresh quince. It is characterized by its opulent yet vertical structure and a long, elegant finish marked by stony minerality. This 100% Chardonnay is certified organic and aged for 13 months on its lees in both oak barrels and stainless steel. The ABV is 13%, and its optimal drinking window is from 2026 through 2035.

title: Domaine de l'Enclos Chablis 'Beauroy' Premier Cru 2022
bodyHtml: Fleshy and spiced on the palate. There's a touch of musk on the finish.

title: La Venenosa Sierra Occidental
bodyHtml: Above ground cooking adds to the distinctive profile this plant offers.  Sierra Occidental de Jalisco has a lot of fruit taste notes like papaya and avocado. It has bracing acidity, which makes it one of a kind cocktail component.

title: Santo Fino Tequila Reposado
bodyHtml: This reposado begins in the barrel using Santo's amazing blanco to get the process started. The blanco is rested in lightly charred used American oak bourbon barrels for four to five months. After resting, the blanco is now transformed into reposado. This critical time in oak imparts incredible flavors which creates a smooth, easy drinking tequila. Sammy started out years ago with only a reposado and created a sensation with a great brand all of his fans and afficionados of tequila will surely remember. You’ll see he’s still got it when you taste this wonderful reposado.

title: Pavillon Rouge du Chateau Margaux 2018
bodyHtml:
95 Points - James Suckling

Blackberry, plum, light earth and undergrowth on the nose. Citrus, too. It’s full-bodied with rich, chewy tannins that turn energetic, fine and tight on the finish. Lively acidity. Second wine of Margaux.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This second wine of Chateau Margaux, grand in its own right, is powerfully dense. It displays its own style and balance between rich black fruits and the acidity that shines through the structure. The wine will age well, its ripeness and concentration likely to soften as it matures.

title: Brancaia Ilatraia 2021
bodyHtml:
Brancaia Ilatraia is a premium red wine from Italy, hailing from the Maremma region along the Tuscan coast. Since 1981, the Swiss Widmer family has guided Brancaia with a philosophy that blends Swiss precision with Italian tradition, emphasizing a deep respect for the unique terroir of their three estates.
