The winery is now led by Barbara Widmer, who maintains a commitment to producing elegant, high quality wines that authentically represent the character of the land.

Wine Description

This full bodied Super Tuscan presents a deep magenta color and an intense sensory profile. The nose is saturated with aromas of blackcurrant, plum, and blackberry preserves, layered with complex notes of iodine, toasted cedar, and pipe tobacco. On the palate, the wine is creamy and powerful yet balanced by a vivid freshness and fine, velvety tannins.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling - 96 points."

  • "Wine Advocate - 94 points."

  • "Vinous - 94 points."

  • "Wine Enthusiast - 94 points."

  • "Wine Spectator - 93 points."

  • "Jeb Dunnuck - 93 points."

Food Pairing

The wine's robust structure and intense flavours make it an ideal companion for rich meat dishes, such as roasted game, braised beef, or pigeon. It also pairs beautifully with fresh tagliatelle served with a hearty wild boar ragout.

title: The Newfoundland Distillery Seaweed Gin
bodyHtml:
Juniper, seaweed (we use dulse, from the Grand Banks) and a touch of savoury make a pure Newfoundland gin that has a hint of the ocean in it.  This is refreshing, like being enveloped in an ocean mist surrounded by a host of pure local botanicals. We've kept it very simple and very pure and we think this is a fine twist on the way gin should be!

Our Seaweed Gin won a double gold medal at the 2018 San Francisco World Spirit Competition.

title: Chateau Bouscaut Red 2018
bodyHtml:
The history of Château Bouscaut dates back to the 17th century. Still, it was not until 1979, and its acquisition by the Lurton family (owner of the famous Château d'Yquem), that Château Bouscaut became the genuine pearl of the Pessac-Léognan appellation. The Château Bouscaut vineyard comprises clay and gravel soils resting on a limestone base and extends over 47 hectares (40 hectares dedicated to red wines).

Château Bouscaut Red 2018 is dressed in a superb dark purple colour with ruby tints and distills a bouquet of candied blackberries and tertiary notes of forest soil and oak. In the mouth, Château Bouscaut 2018 is generous, rich and moderately full-bodied. The black fruit aromas line the palate, supported by a supple and velvety tannic structure, and offer a delicious and spirited finish.

title: Terralsole Brunello di Montalcino 2006
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in the prestigious Montalcino region of Tuscany, Italy, this wine is a classic expression of the land. Terralsole, meaning 'Land Toward the Sun', was founded in 1996 by Swiss born artist and entrepreneur Mario Bollag, who sought to blend his passions for art, music, and fine wine. The estate's winemaking philosophy is rooted in sustainable and organic practices, emphasizing high density planting and a meticulous 'micro-cru' approach that balances modern technology with a deep respect for traditional Montalcino terroir.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese Grosso displays a rich, radiant profile with a soft red fruit core. The bouquet is complex and aromatic, featuring scents of pressed rose, black cherry, and wild berries intertwined with 'sun roasted' notes of spice, tobacco, and subtle mint. On the palate, the wine is full and fleshy, offering a silky texture and a harmonious balance of bursting fruit tones and delicate coffee nuances. It is supported by a solid tannic backbone and bright acidity, leading to a long, structured finish that showcases elegant hints of dried fruits like sultanas. While highly approachable now with aeration, this wine has the structure for continued evolution through 2026 and beyond.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 93 points

  • Wine Enthusiast - 92 points

  • Wine Advocate - 91 points

  • Wine Spectator - 88 points

title: Chateau Carlmagnus 2020
bodyHtml: Home of the first remarkable Right Bank wines, dating back to the 1730s, Fronsac and Canon-Fronsac retained more fame than Pomerol well into the 19th century. Today these wines represent some of Bordeaux's best-hidden gems. Fronsac is a tiny region at an unusually high elevation compared to other Bordeaux appellations. Its vineyards unroll along the oak-dotted hills bordering the river's edge, making it perhaps Bordeaux's prettiest and most majestic countryside.

title: Wild Goose Autumn Gold White Blend 2023
bodyHtml:
One of Canada’s most popular white blends, Autumn Gold is equal parts Riesling, Gewurztraminer and Pinot Blanc. This is a clean, crisp, white wine that carries aromas of orchard fruit, spiced apple and citrus. The soft and round palate will taste spice, candied ginger, and a hint of rose balanced with crisp acidity.

The amazing fruit makes it the perfect wine to have on the patio with lots of family and friends, or at traditional festive gatherings where you are roasting a big bird!

title: Giusti 'Rosalia' Rose Prosecco Extra Dry 2023
bodyHtml:
Ermenegildo Giusti is a staunch supporter of vine-growing that respects both the environment and the beautiful surrounding countryside. Quality is the company's top priority, but it also has a strong sense of hospitality and strives to give everyone who visit its estates an experience they will not forget. These qualities are conveyed in every glass of Giusti wines.

Ermenegildo Giusti says... “Wine, like art, is matter, colour, light, satisfaction of the senses, madness and reason, patient research and endless passion.”

Pink peach blossom hue. The bouquet is pleasant and elegant notes of both yellow and red fruit, nectarine, pink cherry, and golden apple, with light floral scents. On the mouth, it’s fresh with an intriguing savoury undertone. Soft and frothy texture accompany the aroma of ripe peach that lingers with an elegant dry finish.

A very classy aperitif that can easily be paired with fish cruditée and seafood, Parma ham, spaghetti with a simple sauce of fresh grape tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil and basil.

title: Vina Cobos Malbec 'Cobos' 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Argentina, produced in the Mendoza region, specifically from distinguished vineyards in Luján de Cuyo and the Uco Valley. Viña Cobos was founded in 1999 by the world-renowned winemaker Paul Hobbs, who is often credited with pioneering the global rise of premium Argentine Malbec. The 'Cobos' label represents the winery's pinnacle flagship brand, reflecting a winemaking philosophy that combines intense study of Grand Cru sites with meticulous craftsmanship to produce a refined and powerful icon of the region.

Wine Description

The Viña Cobos Malbec 'Cobos' 2020 exhibits a brilliant inky appearance with a vibrant violet hue. The nose is multifaceted and intense, offering aromas of ripe gooseberry, fig, and rosemary, alongside deep notes of blackberry, red liquorice, and floral hints of lilac and lavender. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and well-structured, delivering a concentrated core of dark fruit, redcurrant, and blueberry. It is characterized by its tension and energy, featuring tight, chalky tannins and a long, fine-grained finish with subtle mineral and salty undertones. This 100% Malbec has an ABV of 15% and was aged for 18 months in French oak barrels, with 59% being new wood. The wine is not certified organic, and its optimal drinking window is from 2024 through 2042.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 95 points.

  • Vinous - 94 points.

  • Wine Spectator - 91 points.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and rich fruit density of this Malbec make it an ideal companion for high-quality meat dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled hanger steak served with chimichurri, braised short-rib in a Malbec reduction, or lamb chops with rosemary. The wine's complexity also complements savoury starters such as charcuterie featuring dry-cured jambon de Bayonne, and it is a classic match for aged cheeses like Mimolette or Parmigiano.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 season in Mendoza was marked by a significantly warm climate, resulting in the earliest harvest in the region's history. Despite the heat and a general lack of water, strategic harvest planning ensured the fruit remained exceptionally healthy, providing wines with great balance, freshness, and a high concentration of flavour.

title: Gorgo Chardonnay Verona Organic 2024
bodyHtml:
This organic white wine hails from Italy, specifically from the Veneto region within the Verona IGT. Established in 1973 by Roberto Bricolo near the village of Custoza, Cantina Gorgo is a family-run estate now led by his daughter, Roberta Bricolo. The winery is dedicated to organic viticulture and sustainable practices, managing 53 hectares of certified organic vineyards situated on the calcium-rich morainic hills east of Lake Garda.

Wine Description

The Gorgo Chardonnay Verona Organic presents an elegant, bright golden yellow colour in the glass. On the nose, it offers a refined and aromatic bouquet of fresh fruits, including golden apple, pear, and tropical notes of pineapple and mango, complemented by delicate white flowers. The palate is soft and fresh with a lively acidity and a medium-bodied, harmonious structure. It features a round, expressive texture with flavours of citrus and green apple, leading to a clean, persistent finish marked by a subtle salty minerality.

title: Elizabeth Rose Red Blend Chockablock 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: This wine offers incredibly perfumed aromas of rose, violet, strawberry, red cherry, black plum, and hints of white pepper, vanilla, chocolate, and coffee. On the palate, beautiful balance, medium body texture with firm fine-grained tannins resulting in an extraordinary mouthfeel. In addition, it displays an outstanding long finish with bright acidity.

title: Lot 40 Dark Oak Rye
bodyHtml: Lot 40 Dark Oak is a bigger, bolder version of Lot 40 rye whisky. Maintaining the core essence of Lot 40, 100% rye, distilled in a pot still, aged in new American Oak barrels. Dark Oak is finished in a second new oak barrel, this time heavily charred. This finishing in a new, char no. 4 barrel adds even more notes and colour from the barrel, resulting in a bolder and more intense rye whisky which is then bottled at an ABV of 48%.

title: Domaine Santa Duc Chateauneuf du Pape 'Habemus Papam' 2019
bodyHtml:
94 Points - Wine Spectator

Stylish and silky, relying on higher-toned red currant, cherry, and raspberry fruit aromas and flavors, with red tea, savory and subtle mineral details throughout. Features a late echo of worn leather, which adds nice contrast on the finish. Grenache and Syrah. Best from 2023 through 2038.

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Gorgeous blackberry and black cherry fruits, as well as peppery garrigue, camphor, violets, and spicy notes, all emerge from the 2019 Chateauneuf Du Pape Habemus Papam, a classic, balanced, pure, and elegant Chateauneuf that offers a beautiful sense of freshness and purity while still showing tons of character.

title: Wild Life Distillery Rundle Gin
bodyHtml: Wild Life Distillers has created the Rundle Gin. The gin features butterfly pea flower to create a vibrant purple hue when citrus and tonic is added, and is paired with flavourful botanical ingredients including juniper, coriander, lemon and grapefruit peel as well as angelica, orris and liquorice root, to create a perfectly balanced floral gin. The locally-distilled gin was recognized in the 2020 Alberta Beverage Awards and won Judges’ Selection in its category.

title: Livio Sassetti Brunello Di Montalcino 'Pertimali' 2020
bodyHtml: Intense ruby red with fruit aromas ripe red wine and spices. Very elegant and structured with good acidity and with pleasant and soft tannins.

title: Fontodi Chianti Classico Riserva 'Vigna del Sorbo' 2020 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Fontodi has belonged to the Manetti family since 1968. The family has been associated for centuries with another activity typical of the Chianti region, the production of its famous “terrecotte” tiles. And it is in the name of this strong link with the territory and a great passion for quality that the estate has moved successfully towards an ever more attentive cultivation of the vineyards and a more profound knowledge of the potential of Sangiovese in the zone of Panzano.

The type of agriculture practised is inspired by the principles of respect of nature and sustainability. Not only are no chemical products used but there is an effort to maximize the internal resources of the estate, thereby reducing the need for any external input. Respecting the environment means wines that are better, purer, and a truer expression of the grape and the territory.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

This red is tightly wound, linear in profile and full of black cherry, blackberry, blueberry, fresh loam and mineral flavors, supported by lively acidity and dense, suave tannins that integrate nicely with the tension and silky texture. Shows terrific length.

95 Points - Decanter

The 2020 is slow to reveal itself – even with coaxing, aromas aren’t completely forthcoming. Eventually, subtle hints of sundried tomato and grilled herbs evolve to darker tones of violet and liquorice. True to its western Panzano origins, the framework is firm and sturdy. Tight with a concentrated core but not overly dense, there's a richness to the tannins. Finishes with savoury black plum and toast.

94 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of stems, dried meat, berries and cherries with some dusty earth. The palate is firm and fresh with a brightness and chewiness. It shows some cement and stone texture to it. From organically grown grapes.

title: Lamborn Family Red Blend 2200' Howell Mountain 2018
bodyHtml: This dark, inky Cabernet blend offers alluring fragrances of blueberry, raspberry, and mocha chocolate. With a swirl in the glass the aromas erupt, a fitting tribute to their volcanic soil origins. Mid-palate fine tannins give way to rich and concentrated brambleberry, black currant, and blueberry, rounded out with the lushness of raspberry from the Lamborn’s prototypical mountain Zinfandel. This 2200′ blend showcases both power and finesse in a sumptuously captivating wine, dense with succulent fruits that will have your lips smacking for more. Cabernet/blend lovers rejoice!” – Heidi Barrett, winemaker

title: Chateau de Lamarque 2018
bodyHtml: There is a good balance of fruit and dense tannins in this wine. It has medium concentration, with a solid, dry background. In the front, the fruit is rich yet fresh.

title: San Polo Brunello di Montalcino 2018
bodyHtml:
In the glass, this Brunello has an intense ruby red colour with garnet hues. The typical aromas of violets and red berries are followed by hints of vanilla, cedar and coffee. On the palate, it is full-bodied and warm with a densely-woven texture and robust tannins, while the finish is persistent and rounded.

93 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of sour plums, cherry stones, bark and iodine, with some dried herbs. So fresh, tangy and flavorful, with bright berry fruit and savory moss notes. Fine and integrated tannins. Medium body. All about balance. From organically grown grapes.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A certified organic wine, the 2018 Brunello di Montalcino display a savory character that accompanies the wine from start to finish over the palate and then some. There is a core of black fruit, but the real takeaway is that spicy contour of dark chestnut husk, acacia honey, tilled earth and toasted rosemary that fills the balloon of your glass. This Brunello finishes on a tart note and shows tannins that could use a few extra years to soften.

title: Nikka Miyagikyo Single Malt Whisky - 700 ml
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Japan, Miyagi Prefecture, Sendai. Established in 1969, Miyagikyo is the second distillery founded by Masataka Taketsuru, who is widely considered the father of Japanese whisky. Owned by Asahi Group Holdings, the distillery was built in a lush valley to provide a complete contrast to the coastal Yoichi distillery, focusing on an elegant and fruity style using pot stills heated by indirect steam.

Description

This single malt displays a deep gold colour in the glass. The nose is rich and full flavoured, opening with concentrated iris and malted barley followed by exotic banana, liquorice, and a hint of burnt wood. On the palate, it is firm yet elegant, featuring core flavours of malted barley coated in herbaceous tones, ginger, cinnamon, and chocolate. The body is smooth and silky, leading to a long, soft finish that evokes wilted roses, tobacco, and stewed fruits like apple and damson. ABV 45%.

Food Pairing

The elegant fruitiness and sherry cask influence of this whisky pair beautifully with rich seafood such as sea urchin toast, grilled salmon, or scallops in cream sauce. It also complements savory poultry dishes like roast chicken or duck breast with honey and soy. For a sweet conclusion, try it alongside dark fruitcake, crème brûlée, or a fine milk chocolate.

title: Arboleda Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in Chile, this wine hails from the coastal Chilhué Vineyard within the Aconcagua Costa subregion of the Aconcagua Valley. Viña Arboleda was founded in 1999 by Eduardo Chadwick, a fifth-generation vintner who also co-founded the iconic Seña estate. The winery's name, meaning 'a grove of trees', serves as a tribute to the 1,450 hectares of native forest that surround and protect the sustainably managed, single-vineyard sites.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc presents a bright straw yellow colour with silver glints. The nose is highly aromatic, offering herbal notes of tomato leaf and lemongrass alongside citrus zest, passion fruit, and white flowers. On the palate, the wine is refreshingly crisp and linear, featuring a citrus profile of grapefruit and tangerine balanced by green apple and a distinct flinty minerality. It possesses a medium body with a creamy texture and a persistent, saline finish that reflects its maritime origin.

Food Pairing

The wine's vibrant acidity and herbal undertones make it an ideal companion for fresh seafood, particularly oysters on the half shell, ceviche, or grilled white fish with a citrus glaze. It also pairs beautifully with tangy goat cheese salads, asparagus, and dishes featuring fresh pesto or cilantro.

title: Gerard Bertrand Orange Gold 2023
bodyHtml:
From France’s sun-kissed Vin de France appellation, Gérard Bertrand crafts Orange Gold using an ancient winemaking technique that bridges tradition and innovation. Gérard Bertrand, a former rugby player turned renowned winemaker, is known for his commitment to biodynamic practices and his dedication to expressing the unique terroirs of the South of France. This wine embodies his philosophy of harmony between nature and craftsmanship, delivering both authenticity and elegance in the glass.

Wine Description

The aroma opens with a vibrant bouquet of white flowers, candied fruit, orange marmalade, apricot, honeysuckle, and white pepper, layered with subtle spice. On the palate, it is dry, medium-bodied, and texturally rich, offering notes of apricot jam, beeswax, citrus zest, and ginger balanced by fresh acidity and fine tannins. The finish is long and harmonious, leaving a savoury, slightly nutty impression.

Food Pairing

Orange Gold’s structure and aromatics make it ideal with cheese and charcuterie boards, especially hard cheeses. It shines with spicy Asian or Indian dishes, seafood such as scallops or bouillabaisse, grilled vegetables, and smoky barbecued meats.

title: Ca' del Bosco Franciacorta Cuvee Prestige 47th Edition (NV)
bodyHtml: Ca' del Bosco is on the leading edge of the exciting new wave of Italian wine producers, making absolutely top-quality sparkling and still wines. Maurizio Zanella founded the winery in 1968, and dedicated himself to distinguishing the sparkling wines of Franciacorta. The winery owns more than 230 acres in the region, with vineyards planted to Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Pinot Nero and other indigenous Franciacorta grapes. Ca' del Bosco's reputation for sparkling wines has been secured by the excellence of its cuvees.

title: Pierre Paillard La Grande Recolte Bouzy Grand Cru 2008
bodyHtml:
La Grande Récolte represents the quintessence of the Paillard's vineyards. La Grande Récolte is crafted from their finest parcels of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. Its combination of richness, complexity, and finesse demonstrates why Bouzy is a heralded Grand Cru.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Disgorged in January 2020 with one gram per litre dosage, the 2008 Extra-Brut Bouzy Grand Cru La Grande Récolte opens in the glass with notes of crisp Anjou pear, lemon curd, freshly baked bread and citrus pith. Medium to full-bodied, vinous and seamless, with racy acids, lovely depth at the core and a long, intensely saline finish, it's a mineral, elegant Champagne at the beginning of a long drinking window.

title: Decugnano dei Barbi 'Villa Barbi' Rosso 2022
bodyHtml: The Villa Barbi Rosso is a soft and pleasant wine sourced from estate vineyards grown in soils rich with fossilized shells and oysters. It is well balanced with intense flavours of cherry, plum, and leather backed by hints of clove and spice.

title: Liberty School Cabernet Sauvignon 2024 - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml: Deep garnet with brickish edges. Vanilla, fresh currants, light toasted oak with lush tannin's, dark fruit, clean acidity and a long finish with lingering sweet oak.

title: Laroche Chablis Premier Cru Les Vaillons Vieilles Vignes 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from France, produced in the Chablis region of Burgundy within the Les Vaillons Premier Cru vineyard. Domaine Laroche is a historic reference in Chablis, with roots dating back to AD 867 and headquarters based in the Obediencerie, a former monastery where wine has been crafted for over 1,000 years. The winery’s philosophy focuses on crystalline purity and the precise expression of the Chablis climats, utilizing a unique heritage of 90 hectares of estate vineyards. Since 2009, the domaine has been part of the Advini group.

Wine Description

The Laroche Chablis Premier Cru Les Vaillons Vieilles Vignes displays a bright, light gold colour. The nose is rich and complex, offering aromas of yellow fruits, citrus oil, and white flowers, often complemented by nuanced hints of saffron, oriental spice, and toasted nuts. On the palate, the wine is dense and opulent yet balanced by a linear acidity and a saline, mineral-infused character. It is characterized by its depth and persistent finish, which frequently features zesty citrus and flinty notes. This 100% Chardonnay is sourced from vines over 60 years old grown on Kimmeridgian limestone soils. The ABV is typically 12.5%. The wine is not certified organic, but the domaine holds Haute Valeur Environnementale (HVE) certification. Its optimal drinking window typically extends from 2025 to 2034.

Accolades

  • Decanter - 93 points.

  • Jasper Morris - 93 points.

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points.

  • Neal Martin (Vinous) - 92 points.

  • Wine Advocate - 92 points.

  • Burghound - 91 points.

  • Sommelier Wine Awards - Gold Medal.

Food Pairing

The richness and textured concentration of this Premier Cru make it an excellent companion for refined seafood and white meat dishes. It pairs ideally with seared scallops, veal in a creamy sauce, or roasted poultry. The wine's vibrant acidity and mineral profile also complement fresh goat cheeses and mature, ripened cheeses.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Chablis produced solar, dense wines with excellent phenolic maturity, resulting in a profile marked by ripe fruit and spice. For the 2023 vintage, the grapes achieved a fine balance of richness and verticality, allowing winemakers to showcase the classic tension and energy of the Vaillons terroir.

title: Penfolds Bin 704 California Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml:
This modern and refined red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Napa Valley region in California. Penfolds is an iconic Australian estate with a history dating back to 1844, and Bin 704 represents a key part of their inaugural California collection. The winery's philosophy for this label is to redefine Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon through the 'Penfolds lens', focusing on regional essence and silk-like textural definition. The name Bin 704 is a 'mirror image' of its Australian counterpart, Bin 407, highlighting the cyclical nature of winemaking across different hemispheres.

Wine Description

Penfolds Bin 704 Cabernet Sauvignon 2019 presents a saturated core with a luminous crimson rim. The sensory profile features a complex nose of dark fruits, glazed cherries, and Black Forest cake, layered with savory notes of bay leaf, wild thyme, and freshly baked olive bread. On the palate, the wine is powerful and polished, showcasing a 'silken' flow with flavours of dark chocolate-coated almonds and tart pomegranate-like acidity. It is characterized by its fine, mouth-coating tannins and a core of graphite and cedar that confirms its varietal identity. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon was matured for 17 months in French oak barriques (40% new) and has an ABV of 14.5%. While the winery employs high-quality viticultural standards, this wine is not indicated as organic.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and savory nuances of this Cabernet Sauvignon make it an ideal partner for rich and charred dishes. It pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye, braised short ribs, and rack of lamb. Its spicy and cedar undertones also complement savory charcuterie, truffle-infused dishes, and seared beef with a mild pepper crust. For a simpler pairing, it is an excellent match for aged cheeses such as sharp cheddar or Saint-Nectaire.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 vintage in Napa Valley is celebrated as 'exceptional' and 'stellar', benefiting from a near-perfect growing season. A rainy spring provided ample soil moisture, while a warm and steady summer allowed the grapes to reach full phenolic maturity without extreme weather stress. These ideal conditions resulted in balanced yields and a vintage noted for producing wines of outstanding depth, harmonious fruit intensity, and vibrant acidity.

title: Penfolds Bin 600 California Cabernet Sauvignon - Shiraz 2019
bodyHtml:
This modern and imaginative red wine originates from the United States, specifically within the California region and a blend of the Napa Valley and Paso Robles subregions. Bin 600 is intrinsically linked to the start of Penfolds' American journey, which began in 1998 when heritage vine cuttings from South Australia's famed Kalimna and Magill Estate were planted at the Creston '600' Ranch in Paso Robles. The winery's philosophy centres on a 'House Style' that transcends borders, blending the structure of Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon with the plushness of heritage-selection Shiraz grown in the Camatta Hills.

Wine Description

Penfolds Bin 600 Cabernet Sauvignon - Shiraz 2019 presents a garnet core with a bright cherry-red rim. The sensory profile is ample and indulgent, featuring a 'European' savoury nose of marinated olives, semi-dried tomatoes, and cured meats, layered with exotic notes of Thai red curry paste, lavender, and violets. On the palate, the wine is glossy and resolved, showcasing a luscious core of sweet dark fruits; such as medjool dates, goji berries, and black cherries, encapsulated by creamy chocolate-malt and toasted American oak. It is a medium to full-bodied wine characterized by supple, silky tannins and a structural 'flare' that provides great length and energy. This blend typically consists of 83% Cabernet Sauvignon and 17% Shiraz, matured for 17 months in American oak (40% new), and reached an ABV of approximately 14.5%. While the winery maintains rigorous quality standards, this bottling is not indicated as organic.

title: Rodney Strong Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve 2014 - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml:
Rich, lush and structured, the 2014 vintage displays intense aromas of black currant, cassis and crushed violet. This wine is velvety with a smooth, lingering finish of herbal notes, vanilla and cocoa. Enjoy this wine now with a grilled porter house, rack of lamb, braised beef short ribs, and a winter vegetable roast. 

96% Cabernet Sauvignon, 3% Petit Verdot, 1% Malbec

91 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

From Sonoma County and a blend of 96% Cabernet Sauvignon, 3% Petit Verdot, and 1% Malbec, the 2014 Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve reveals a saturated purple/ruby color as well as a beautiful bouquet of crème de cassis, plums, cedary spice, tobacco, and bay leaf. It's medium-bodied, has a pure, polished, elegant style, no hard edges, and rock-solid balance. In short, it's a terrific Cabernet Sauvignon.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2014 Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve is medium to deep garnet-purple in color and scented of crushed blackberries, wild blueberries and warm plums with touches of underbrush, bay leaves and tobacco leaf. Medium to full-bodied with an approachable frame of fine-grained tannins and lovely freshness, the palate reveals plenty of crunchy black fruits, finishing with great purity.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Juicy black cherry and blueberry wrap around big, expansive tannins in this hearty red that is sourced from several of the producer's best sites. With a backbone of structure and oak, it's toasty in character yet robustly fruity.

90 Points - Decanter

A high octane style with oak and intense black fruit on the nose. Shiny, posh and plush palate, with well-integrated oak and sweet ripe tannins.

title: Rodney Strong Cabernet Sauvignon Alexander Valley 2018 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: A powerful Cabernet Sauvignon from the hillsides of Alexander Valley has aromas of lush, red plum and dark berries that dominate the glass, while hints of cassis and milk chocolate play in the background. The dried fig and chewy tannins give this wine a strong backbone, while the 18 months of barrel aging have softened this bold wine just enough to enjoy now or with a cheese and charcuterie boar, filet mignon with grilled vegetables or a dark chocolate mousse. Drink over the next five to seven years.

title: Gotas de Mar Albarino 2024
bodyHtml: Brilliant pale lemon colour. Intense aromas of peaches, white flowers, minerals and a hint of fresh sea breeze. On the palate, a well-balanced prominent acidity with stone fruits and light minerality. Lingering finish, with a mouth-watering acidity and long complex persistence.

title: Equiano Rum
bodyHtml:
Equiano is the world’s first African and Caribbean rum. The multi-award winning liquid is one of the best rums in the world for the 8 – 10 years aged category.

Rich and deep flavours come from the barrels in which we tropically mature our liquid in.

title: La Venenosa Raicilla Costa de Jalisco (46.6% ABV)
bodyHtml: La Venenosa Raicilla Costa is produced by Maestro Tabernero Don Alberto Hernández in the village of Llano Grande of the coastal region Cabo Corrientes, 700 metres above sea level. The agave in this Raicilla varies widely from batch to batch. Certain batches are 100% Agave Rhodacantha (Mexicano) and others are an ensamble of Amarillo and Chicho Aguilar. It is roasted in a wood fired adobe oven. It is distilled two times in a Philippino still made out of copper and a hollowed out tree trunk. The flavor is complex, bouncing around between fruit, spice and herbs, eventually settling on sweet spice.

title: Waterford Single Farm Hook Head 1.1
bodyHtml:
The lighthouse at Hook Head stands resolute against the full force of the Atlantic Ocean on Ireland’s southern coast, 10 miles from the distillery – so close that Oliver Cromwell vowed to take Waterford 'by hook or by crook' in the 17th century. In its shadow, Martin Foley grows barley on clay/loam soils derived from limestone, belonging to the Elton Series. Exposed to the full range of salt-laden storms, sea mists & ocean breezes, it’s an extreme maritime terroir.

Nose: Earthy maltiness & fresh soil, citrus peel, breadcrust, clove, white pepper, caramel, milk chocolate, salted popcorn, barnyard, oak green foliage.

Taste: It's a spice bomb up front; with cloves, white pepper, salted caramel, liquorice, ginger biscuits, lemon zest, & chilli chocolate.

Finish: Dry, but it leaves a lasting oiliness that holds the spiciness for a long time.

title: Mollydooker Verdelho The Violinist 2024
bodyHtml: This gorgeous Verdelho, their only white wine, has a lovely, creamy texture, great acidity and long, persistent flavours of honeysuckle, pineapple and citrus. It's all the things they love about white wine. They hope you'll love it too. The Violinist is named for the days when Sarah was made to play the violin right-handed in school, so that she didn't poke her right-handed neighbours in the eye with her bow. Pairs with all seafood, chicken, veal, cheese and dried fruits.

title: The Dreaming Tree Crush Red 2022
bodyHtml: The Dreaming Tree Crush Red brings juicy red fruit with nice mid-palate weight from the Merlot, raspberry jam flavours from the Zinfandel, and dark fruit and structure from the Petit Sirah and Tannat. Its blend of coastal California varieties results in a tasty, complex wine with lots of fruit flavours, some vanilla and mocha, and a long, soft finish. This Crush Red Blend is a favourite for enjoying with friends or pairing with a nice meal. A wonderful wine, enhanced by such foods as pulled pork, Vietnamese-style pork sandwiches, or vegetarian stuffed poblano peppers.

title: Columbia Crest Merlot H3 2021
bodyHtml: This medium-bodied Merlot delivers aromas of spice, plum and blackberry with the perfect balance of earth, cocoa and ripe black cherry notes on the palate. The complex flavours are followed by a smooth, velvety finish. Turkey with citrus-based cranberry sauce, strong cheeses, and braised meats pair perfectly with this Merlot!

title: Stara Sokolova Quince Brandy
bodyHtml: Stara Sokolova Dunja is made from fully ripe quince and is double distilled in old copper stills ensuring a perfect harmony between sweetness and the natural tartness of quince.

title: Stara Sokolova Medovina Honey
bodyHtml: Every sip opens with the bright, natural sweetness of honey and is filled in by the full, fruity base of the underlying spirit. Perfect balance of sweetness and freshness for smooth drinking. It is best enjoyed chilled as a digestive or as desert on its own on a warm evening by the fire.

title: La Stoppa Ageno 2020
bodyHtml:
On the nose, this Malvasia di Candia skin contact blend from Emilia-Romagna smells like driving into Palm Springs from Highway 111 with the windows down, an intoxicating breeze of squishy peaches, lemon, hot asphalt, and freshly watered lawns. Sipping on “Ageno” tastes similarly warm, with notes of apricot, navel oranges and leather. 

It’s bold but with balanced acidity and finishes with sandy tannins that feel just swept off a dune.

title: Laroche Chablis Premier Cru Les Montmains 2019
bodyHtml:
Les Montmains is located on a spectacular slope in a widely open valley with abundant sunshine. A beautiful terroir for this excellent, racy Premier Cru.

Real sinuous and final aromas. This wine has enough personality to be served with spicy dishes or goat cheese.

title: Louis Roederer Vintage Champagne 2015
bodyHtml:
The Vintage 2015 from Louis Roederer is the perfect product from its terroir, in which finesse, purity, precision, and harmony highlight the qualities of a great vineyard.

Composed of around 71% Pinot noir and 29% Chardonnay, 25% of which is wine matured in oak tuns, the Vintage cuvée is generally matured on lees for 4 years and left for a minimum of 6 months after disgorging to attain perfect maturity.

The mouth is typical of Louis Roederer's vintages: a large, energetic attack that caresses the palate with a long, lingering finish.

This 2015 offers us a champagne with a greedy, generous and crisp texture.

title: Double Canyon Red Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2017
bodyHtml:
Red Mountain, the warmest and smallest American Viticultural Area in Washington State, is known for producing wines with a silky texture and wonderfully ripe tannins. The region, located 3.5 hours east of Seattle, sits on a southwest-facing slope, perfect for extended ripening. A persistent wind from the southwest minimizes disease pressure, leading to smaller grapes with more intense flavours.

The Double Canyon winery, formed in 2007, is located in Horse Heaven Hills, another highly regarded Washington AVA. Using grapes from different spots in Red Mountain, this supple and robust wine coats the mouth with ripe tannins and flavours of blackcurrant, blackberry, spice, plum and cherry. Dry and full-bodied, it is so refined you almost miss its powerful inner core of ripe fruit and plentiful tannins. It's a joy to drink. Enjoy it with a grilled New York strip steak, braised lamb shank or a hard cheese such as manchego.

title: Black Bull Peated Edition Blended Scotch
bodyHtml: Black Bull Fans can expect a powerful and robust full-bodied whisky with a big blast of dry smoke and is a perfect addition to the existing range. A Special Blend for all the fans of peated, smoky whisky this one is blend for you

title: Duncan Taylor The Politician Blended Scotch Whiskey
bodyHtml: This was originally released as an exclusive bottling to The Politician bar over in Eriskay, an island of the Outer Hebrides in northern Scotland. This golden whisky has a mild, slightly floral aroma. Hints of almond butter, pear and white flowers lead into a warming toasted coconut finish laced with plenty of tingly white pepper.

title: Tito's Handmade Vodka - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Tito's Handmade Vodka is a premier craft spirit originating from the United States, specifically distilled in Austin, Texas. Founded in 1997 by Bert Butler 'Tito' Beveridge II, the brand began as a small-batch operation in a shack on the outskirts of the city. Beveridge, a geophysicist by training, obtained the first legal distilling permit in Texas since Prohibition and built the distillery's first pot still himself using scrap metal and outdoor fryers. The company, Fifth Generation Inc., remains independently owned with its founder still at the helm.

Spirit Description

This vodka is meticulously crafted from 100% yellow corn, making it naturally gluten-free. It is distilled six times in old-fashioned copper pot stills—a method more commonly associated with high-end cognac or single malt scotch—to ensure a clean and smooth profile.

  • Colour: The spirit is crystal clear and pristine in appearance.

  • Aroma: The nose is subtle and clean, featuring gentle traces of sweet roasted grain, mineral notes, and a hint of black pepper.

  • Palate: It delivers a medium-bodied and smooth mouthfeel with delicate flavours of sweet corn and a touch of charcoal. Some tasters note forward yet delicate hints of citrus and smoke.

  • Body: The vodka possesses an oily, moderately viscous, and velvety texture that is robust yet refined.

  • Finish: It concludes with a clean, crisp, and rounded finish that lingers with a subtle sweetness and a soft, bacon-like richness.

  • ABV: Tito's Handmade Vodka is bottled at 40% (80 proof).

Accolades

Tito's Handmade Vodka has earned significant international recognition for its quality and craft.

  • Double Gold Medal: Unanimously awarded at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition in 2001, where it famously beat 70 other prestigious vodka brands in a blind taste test.

  • Best New Product: Named the best new product in the Frontier Duty Free Association Gold Standard Awards for the Canadian duty free industry in 2015.

  • Consumer Rating: The spirit maintains an impressive average rating of 4.9 out of 5 stars among enthusiasts, who frequently cite its 'best bang for your buck' value.

Food Pairing

The neutral, clean, and slightly sweet corn profile of this vodka makes it an exceptionally versatile companion for a wide array of culinary pairings.

  • Savoury: It pairs wonderfully with classic appetizers such as pickles, miniature tomatoes, and spinach dip. It is also a traditional match for smoked sausages and salty appetizers.

  • Main Courses: The spirit's smoothness complements spicy Asian flavours like ginger and soy sauce, as well as hearty dishes such as pepper pot soup.

  • Vodka Sauce: It is famously used to create rich tomato-based pasta sauces, where the alcohol helps to release flavours in the cream and Parmesan cheese.

  • Serving: While highly regarded for 'Tito's and Tonic' or a classic 'Martini', it is also refreshing when mixed with lemonade, grapefruit juice, or fresh lime juice and soda.

title: Bindi Sergardi Chianti Classico Riserva 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Bindi Sergardi is a historic estate located in Tuscany, Italy, with roots in the Siena region dating back to 1349. For 23 generations, the family has dedicated itself to winemaking, guided by a philosophy that balances ancient traditions with the evolution of their territory. The 'Calidonia' Chianti Classico Riserva is produced at the Tenuta Mocenni estate, situated on rocky soils of Alberese and Galestro that impart a distinct sense of place to their wines.

Wine Description

This 2020 Riserva presents an intense ruby red colour with garnet highlights. The sensory profile is complex, featuring a bouquet of black cherry, red plum, and currant layered with floral notes of rose petals and violet, alongside deeper accents of incense, leather, and spice. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and well structured, showing graceful, silky tannins and a vibrant acidity that leads to a long, persistent finish with notes of earthy minerality and dried herbs. Composed of 100% Sangiovese grapes, it offers a refined balance between fruit density and savory complexity. This vintage is drinking beautifully now but possesses the structure for development through 2030.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator – 94 points

  • James Suckling – 93 points

  • Vinous – 91 points

title: Foxglove Pinot Noir 2019
bodyHtml: Ripe, full and very alluring, this is Pinot Noir the Californian way! Made by the Varner brothers in California’s Central Coast. Along with ripe berry fruit, it has hints of spice and tobacco. Plenty of bang for the buck here.

title: J Lohr Cabernet Sauvignon Hilltop 2022
bodyHtml:
J. Lohr Vineyards & Wines was founded by Jerry Lohr, who, drawing on his agricultural roots, began an extensive search for ideal California grape-growing regions in the late 1960s. He pioneered premium winegrowing on the Central Coast, first planting in Monterey County in the early 1970s before recognizing Paso Robles' potential for Bordeaux varieties like Cabernet Sauvignon in the 1980s. The winery's philosophy centres on crafting vineyard-driven wines that are the finest examples of quality and flavour from their given appellations, utilizing sustainably farmed estate fruit.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon blend is deep in colour and offers a sensory profile of complex dark fruit and spice. The aroma displays 'blackberry and blueberry compote aromas garnished with crushed violet, cracked pepper, and black tea'. On the palate, expect 'plump fruit' and 'juicy layers of black and red currants'. It is full-bodied and has 'fine-grained tannins' which lead to a bright finish accented by pastry notes from the 16 months of aging in French oak.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include 'rosemary-seasoned ribeye, and garlic roasted potatoes with parsnips and fennel'. Other excellent matches are grilled steak, roasted lamb, and game meats. Aged, hard cheeses like aged cheddar or Gouda also pair well, as do Portobello mushrooms.

title: Batasiolo Barbaresco 2019
bodyHtml: Clear garnet red color with delicate orange tinges. Ethereal, pleasing, intense and persistent aroma, with hints of flowers, cooked fruit and spices. Dry, full-bodied, robust and alluring taste, with supple tannins and pleasant crispness.

title: Kim Crawford Sauvignon Blanc 2026
bodyHtml:
Kim Crawford produces one of Marlborough’s benchmark Sauvignon Blancs and has been named in the "Wine Spectator Top 100” four times. The secret to Kim Crawford’s success is serious attention to detail in the vineyards and winery, with a special focus on sustainable practices, individual vineyard block harvesting, and small lot fermentation.

Very pale yellow in colour, this is a classic Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc with aromas of lifted citrus, tropical fruit, and crushed herbs.  A fresh, juicy wine with vibrant acidity and plenty of weight and length on the palate. Ripe, tropical fruit flavour with passion fruit, melon, and grapefruit.  Pairs brilliantly with fresh oysters, asparagus, lobster, or summer salads.

title: Ste Michelle Cabernet Sauvignon Indian Wells 2021
bodyHtml:
Chateau Ste. Michelle is one of the few premium wineries in the world with two state-of-the-art wineries, one devoted to whites and another to reds. Their winemaking philosophy is to highlight the style, quality and expression of their Washington state vineyards. They strive to respect the varietal characters and individuality of each location, yet still craft each wine to give you a pleasurable, food friendly experience.

The Indian Wells Cabernet is their warm climate ripe, jammy ‘New World’ style of Cabernet Sauvignon. The wine offers dark fruit aromas and flavours. Syrah added an enhanced richness and concentration to the wine.

title: Dog Point Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Straw coloured. Fermented using natural yeasts this wine shows aromas of flint, lemon peel and ripe citrus fruits framed by toasty mineral nuances.

title: Douglas Laing's Scallywag Speyside Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
bodyHtml:
Scallywag was launched in 2013, its name inspired by a lineage of Douglas Laing family Fox Terriers. The dog that adorns the packaging is Binks, the Laing family’s pup who was missing a tooth on the right hand side.

A rich, spicy but sweet Speyside malt whisky, Scallywag is a blend of malts distilled at Mortlach, Macallan and Glenrothes distilleries, amongst others.  Matured in 40% first-fill ex-Sherry butts and 60% ex-Bourbon casks, the whisky has a richly spiced flavour with notes of vanilla, Christmas pudding, dark chocolate, nutmeg and cinnamon.

title: Tinhorn Creek Gewurztraminer 2023
bodyHtml: Soft yellow and emerald flecks in its youth. Nose is big ripe lychee, papaya and banana. Very expressive. Opens up to Turkish delight and spring flowers; honey suckle and daffodil. Absolutely beautiful! Palate is lush with exotic fruit, candied citrus and Manuka honey. Long and complex finish with a noticeable lifted sweetness

title: Bodegas Breca Garnacha De Fuego 2021
bodyHtml:
Located in the sleepy town of Munébrega, Bodegas Breca was founded by Jorge Ordóñez in 2010 with the mission of producing the finest Garnacha in Aragón. Garnacha de Aragón, the clone used to produce the wines of Bodegas Breca, is the most ancient and genetically untouched clone of Garnacha in the world. 

Garnacha de Fuego is a young, primary fruit expression of the oldest clones of Garnacha in the world, from the high altitude mountains of Calatayud. The altitudes, age of the vines, and slate dominant soils produce a wine of tremendous character and concentration, balanced by fresh acidity that provides balance and drinkability, and elegant minerality.

title: Mastrojanni Brunello di Montalcino 2021
bodyHtml:
Mastrojanni Brunello di Montalcino originates from Italy, specifically within Tuscany's renowned Brunello di Montalcino DOCG and the southern subregion of Castelnuovo dell'Abate. Founded in 1975 by Gabriele Mastrojanni and acquired by the Illy Group in 2008, the estate is celebrated for pioneering the southern, warmer slopes of the appellation. Their winemaking philosophy centers on non-invasive viticulture, respect for site diversity, and classic cask aging to preserve the purest expression of Sangiovese.

Wine Description

This wine presents a brilliant, deep ruby red color in the glass. On the nose, it reveals a complex bouquet of dark cherries, ripe red plums, and cassis, layered with nuances of dried flowers, licorice, rosemary, and subtle leather notes. The palate is medium to full bodied, balancing vibrant energy with a core of juicy red fruit, refined tannins, and a persistent finish marked by a distinct mineral saltiness and hints of spice.

title: Vajra Langhe Freisa Kye 2022
Howler Head Bourbon
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: A banana-infused bourbon that eschews convention by adding all-natural banana flavor and is a perfect base for various tropical cocktails. UFC's first ever flavoured whisky partner. 40% alc./vol.

title: Il Poggione Bianco Di Toscana 2022
bodyHtml:
Aromatic and expressive on the nose, with green apple, lime, and pear, complemented by notes of melon and pineapple. A floral note emerges with air, but the overall impression is that of ripe orchard fruit with a hint of citrus and tropical richness. If you're typically not a fan of Chardonnay, this blend might change your mind! Vermentino is a fantastic complement to Chardonnay, lending refreshing acidity and minerality to Chardonnay's fruit-driven weight. The absence of oak makes this bright and vibrant, with plenty of juicy fruit flavours and a hint of citrus zest.

This natural pre-dinner sipping wine doesn't need food, but it will pair beautifully with light salad courses or simple fish or shellfish dishes.

title: Amabuki Shuzo Junmai Ginjo Nama Strawberry Yeast Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Amabuki Shuzo Junmai Ginjo Nama Strawberry Yeast is an innovative Japanese sake originating from the Saga prefecture in the northern part of Kyushu. It is produced by Amabuki Shuzo, a historic brewery founded in 1688 during the Genroku era, which has been under the ownership of the Kinoshita family for generations. The brewery is renowned as a pioneer in the use of flower yeasts, a practice championed by the current representative Sotaro Kinoshita, who discovered their potential while studying at the Tokyo University of Agriculture.

Description

This sake is a 'nama' (unpasteurized) brew that utilizes yeast extracted from strawberry blossoms to create a uniquely expressive sensory profile. It features a rich and highly aromatic nose with scents of strawberry kombucha, rose water, and jammy strawberry preserves, layered over a delicate yeastiness reminiscent of aged Champagne. On the palate, it is medium bodied and rounded, offering a refreshing sweetness of juicy strawberries and ripened melons balanced by a vibrant acidity. Crafted with Omachi rice polished to 55%, it maintains a supple and plush texture with a clean finish. It has an alcohol by volume of 16% and must be kept refrigerated and served chilled.

Food Pairing

Amabuki's strawberry yeast sake is remarkably versatile, pairing well with dishes that share its rounded and slightly sweet or acidic profile. It is an excellent match for creamy appetizers such as scrambled eggs with truffles, brie, or cream cheese. Its fruitiness complements seafood carpaccio, steamed fish with light citrus sauces, and even savory grilled dishes like chicken breast or smoky grilled bangus. For a sweet pairing, it can be served alongside a berry salad with balsamic vinaigrette or desserts like strawberry shortcake and panna cotta.

title: Franz Haas Pinot Nero 2022
bodyHtml: Clear, pale ruby. Clean, medium intensity, primary aromas of delicious cranberry, raspberry, red cherry, strawberry with hints of green bell pepper. So delicate and elegant, premier cru level. Excellent balance in fruit, acidity, and alcohol. Tannins well integrated, complex in a subtle way. Delicate finish.

title: Cantina Lavis Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml:
Cantina Lavis, established in 1850 in the Trentino region of Italy, is a historic winery renowned for its dedication to quality and tradition. Over the years, it has evolved into a cooperative, uniting over 800 growers across 800 hectares of vineyards. The winery emphasizes the importance of matching the right vine to the right place, ensuring that each grape variety thrives in its ideal terroir.

Wine Description

The 2023 Cantina Lavis Pinot Grigio Trentino DOC displays an intense golden yellow hue. On the nose, it offers a warm and inviting bouquet rich in scents of ripe fruits and honey. The palate is characterized by a distinctive rich minerality, leading to a long and fruity aftertaste. This wine is best enjoyed young to fully appreciate its vibrant character.

Food Pairing

This Pinot Grigio pairs excellently with sea crustaceans, grilled swordfish, and fresh dairy products. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Ardmore Legacy
bodyHtml: The Ardmore Legacy celebrates the distillery’s unique location on the fringes of the Highlands, offering a lightly peated liquid that is sweet and uplifting. The gentle flavour fully captures the essence of this spirit’s stunning Highland home. The Ardmore Legacy will appeal to experienced peated malt drinkers and newcomers, alike. A mix of 80% peated and 20% unpeated malt, this is full-bodied, dry and spicy.

title: Billecart Salmon Brut Reserve - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
#18 Wine in VinePair's Top 50 of 2018.  Fine bubbles which rise slowly, persistent mousse. Straw-colored. A nose of ripe pear with some touches of cut hay. Full fruit, but clean in the mouth. This cuvée contains 40% Pinot Meunier, 30% Pinot Noir, 30% Chardonnay. All wines from the best sites in the department of the Marne, from more than twenty top vineyards in Champagne. The overall composition of this cuvée has not changed much for almost fifty years.

Fresh and long tasting, the Brut Réserve may be drunk on all occasions.

91 Points - Wine Spectator     A well-knit Champagne with a citrusy, orange peel overtone and a lithe backbone of acidity enlivening flavors of cherry and apricot fruit, grated ginger, pastry and minerally saline. Creamy finish. Drink now through 2023.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast    The cuvée from this great Champagne producer is dry, fruity with a fine line of minerality. That is balanced by the apple and crisp citrus-fruit flavors coming together in a vibrant, textured wine.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate    Based on the 2015 vintage and disgorged with nine grams per liter dosage, the latest release of Billecart's NV Brut Réserve contains fully 55% reserve wines and is showing very well, offering up complex aromas of warm bread, crisp green orchard fruit and citrus oil. On the palate, it's medium to full-bodied and charming but lively, with an elegantly textural attack, a fleshy core of fruit and lively balancing acids.

title: Noble Ridge Meritage Reserve 2020
bodyHtml: Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon blend, trellised to ensure full ripening and thus the full berry flavours of blueberry, dark cherries and blackberries. Those flavours are complimented with spice accents, leather and smoky tobacco flavours. The aromas of cherries and liquorice are rich and complex. Round, full-bodied mouth feel is complimented by soft yet firm tannins.

title: Poli Marconi 42 Gin
bodyHtml:
Gin Marconi is the result of a long tradition in distilling and of the innovative capacity of the Poli family, who has been distilling with an artisanal still since 1898 in Schiavon, near Bassano del Grappa, in the heart of Veneto. An Italian gin, artisanally distilled in small batches by Jacopo Poli with Crysopea, his vacuum bain-marie pot still: a unique method of distillation that enables intense scents, clean taste and a long-lasting aromatic persistence.

Marconi 42 is obtained with botanicals that recall the Italian Mediterranean bush's light, warmth and intense aroma. If you bring the glass close to your ear, you can hear crickets and cicadas. The nose has an aroma of sun and sea, thanks to rosemary, basil, thyme and mint. In the mouth, the juniper gives depth and harmony. The retro-olfactory perceptions overlap like waves that caress the palate with coriander, cardamom and fennel notes.

title: Giant Steps Chardonnay Yarra Valley 2023
bodyHtml: Located in the state of Victoria, about an hour east of Melbourne in southern Australia, the Yarra Valley is known for cool climate wines. Giants Steps, founded in 1998, has a particular focus on single-vineyard chardonnays and pinot noirs. These limited-production wines are harder to find, but the entry-level range offers higher quantities and impressive quality.

title: ***Giant Steps Pinot Noir Yarra Valley 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Australia, in the state of Victoria, this expression represents the celebrated Yarra Valley region. Giant Steps was established in 1997 by founder Phil Sexton, who moved to the Yarra Valley to pursue cool climate viticulture. The winery emphasizes site-specific winemaking, employing gravity-flow production and minimal intervention to highlight the distinct terroir of its estate vineyards.

Wine Description

Pouring a bright ruby crimson, this Pinot Noir opens with expressive aromas of satsuma plums, strawberry coulis, and red berries, complemented by savory notes of fennel seeds and star anise. On the palate, it delivers a vibrant core of ripe yet well-delineated fruit supported by firm, fine-grained tannins and bright, refreshing acidity. Made entirely of Pinot Noir, the wine demonstrates an impressive balance of concentration, freshness, and structural poise.

title: Chateau de Beaucastel Chateauneuf du Pape Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
France – Rhône Valley, Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Château de Beaucastel is one of the most iconic estates in the Southern Rhône, owned by the Perrin family since 1909. The property is renowned for its dedication to organic and biodynamic viticulture, its respect for tradition, and its masterful blending of all permitted grape varieties of the appellation. The estate’s white wine comes from a small seven-hectare vineyard, making it a rare and highly sought-after expression of the terroir.

Wine Description
The 2023 vintage is composed of approximately eighty percent Roussanne with the balance made up of Grenache Blanc, Clairette, Bourboulenc, Picardan and Piquepoul. Hand-harvested grapes are gently pressed, settled, and fermented for eight months, with thirty percent aged in oak barrels and the remainder in stainless steel to preserve freshness. The resulting wine shows a bright golden colour and an intensely aromatic bouquet of ripe pear, white flowers, almond, honey, subtle spice, and hints of fresh thyme. On the palate it is medium to full-bodied with a seamless, supple texture, lifted by a fine saline freshness and an elegant finish that lingers with notes of orchard fruit and citrus oil.

Accolades
Wine Advocate – 93 points.
Jeb Dunnuck – 95 points.

Food Pairing
This wine is a superb match for refined dishes such as turbot, lobster, truffled roast chicken, veal in cream sauce, or aged cheeses, where its depth and complexity are fully revealed. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Antinori Badia A Passignano Chianti 2003
bodyHtml:
The Antinori family of Florence, one of the world's oldest and most distinguished wine producers, has lived in Tuscany since the 14th century and celebrated its 625th anniversary as wine makers in 2010. Marchese Piero Antinori believes in the tradition that the primary role of wine is to accompany food and enhance the dining experience. In Florence, the Antinori family has led a "Renaissance" in Italian wine making by combining long traditions, a love of authenticity and a dynamic innovative spirit.

Badia a Passignano is ruby red in colour. On the nose it expresses aromas of red fruit, cherries and morello cherries combined with intense yet delicate floral notes and white chocolate. The palate is rich, lively and balanced with supple, velvety tannins that give the wine elegance, great character and excellent persistence of flavours.

title: Chateau de Beaucastel Roussane Vieilles Vignes 2023
bodyHtml:
France, Southern Rhône, Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Château de Beaucastel is one of the most iconic estates in the Rhône Valley, owned and managed by the Perrin family, who are known for their dedication to organic viticulture and traditional winemaking. The estate’s vineyards include a unique three-hectare plot of Roussanne vines aged between 65 and 100 years, producing one of the most sought-after white wines in France. Their philosophy is rooted in expressing the full character of each vintage while respecting the balance of the environment, resulting in wines of depth, elegance, and remarkable longevity.

Wine Description
The 2023 vintage reveals an intense, bright golden colour. The nose offers a complex medley of aromas including honey, apricot, stewed peach, and quince, complemented by citrus notes that bring freshness, along with hints of linden blossom and subtle herbal accents. The palate is generous and silky, displaying layers of honeyed quince, ripe orchard fruit, citrus zest, frangipane, and beeswax, all underscored by a sleek salinity. Full-bodied yet impeccably balanced, it finishes with remarkable length and elegance. Crafted without malolactic fermentation, this wine is aged equally in new and once-used oak barrels, enhancing its texture and structure.

Accolades
James Suckling – 98 points.
Vinous – 95 points.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with mushroom risotto finished with aged Parmesan, or with refined preparations of white meats and fish in rich, aromatic sauces. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Triennes Rose Mediterranee 2025 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: This is wine made in a partnership between Jacques Seysses of Domaine Dujac, Aubert de Villaine of Domaine de la Romanée-Conti and a mutual friend, Michel Macaux. Very serious wine makers with reputations to protect. This rosé is mostly Cinsault, with Grenache, Syrah and Merlot for seasoning. The pale colour, forward strawberry fruit and zingy finish make this the solution for any sunny occasion, but there is hidden depth here. Subtle spice notes and a juicy mid-palate make it ideal for spiced food. Its cleansing acidity and stony texture pair really well with all sorts of summer foods.

title: Douglas Laing's Timorous Beastie Blended Whisky
bodyHtml: Douglas Laing's Timorous Beastie is most certainly not for the fainthearted! This non-coloured, non-chill-filtered Small Batch bottling is a marriage of appropriately aged and selected Highland Malts - including, amongst others, those distilled at Glen Garioch, Dalmore and Glengoyne distilleries. 46.8% alc./vol.

title: Douglas Laing's The Gauldrons Blended Whisky
bodyHtml: The Gauldrons Campbeltown Malt Scotch Whisky tells the story of the eponymous dark, stormy coves on Campbeltown’s west shores, and literally means “Bay of Storms”. A marriage of the finest Campbeltown Malts, bottled in very small batches at 46.2% alc./vol. and proudly without colouring or chill-filtration. The Gauldrons is one of Douglas Laing's Remarkable Regional Malts.

title: Douglas Laing's The Epicurean Blended Whisky
bodyHtml: The Epicurean is a blend of some of the finest Lowland Malts; a marriage of the best that the East and the West of Scotland have to offer. This small batch bottling is proudly without colouring or chill-filtration and bottled at 46.2% alc./vol Zesty, fruity, fresh and vibrant, it's the life and soul of the party!

title: Douglas Laing's Rock Island Blended Whisky
bodyHtml: Douglas Laing's Rock Island bottles the epitome of the Scottish Islands. The blend marries a plethora of Island whiskies, with malts from Islay, Arran, Orkney and Jura. The blend was previously dubbed Rock Oyster, though the name was changed because it turns out there are an awful lot of people who don't like oysters. Not to worry, it's the exact same great maritime whisky!

title: Saint Lucia Chairman's Reserve The Forgotten Casks
bodyHtml:
Chairman’s Reserve The Forgotten Casks is an extra-aged sipping rum crafted to mimic rum found in the original forgotten casks of Chairman’s Reserve, which were preserved from St. Lucia Distillers horrific fire on May 2, 2007. The cellar master was forced to find unusual storage space for his rum barrels during the rehabilitation of the distillery, and these casks were misplaced during this time of confusion. These “forgotten casks” resulted in rum which was too old for the original Chairman’s Reserve blend, so it was decided that this rum would be released on its own and was received with worldwide acclaim. St. Lucia Distillers continues to hold back select Chairman’s Reserve for extra aging to offer a limited release of “The Forgotten Casks."

A blend of Coffey and pot stills. The original Chairman's Reserve recipe is matured an additional three years in ex-bourbon barrels after blending, for a soft elegant blend of rum from 8-11 years old. 

Rich, dark, gold mahogany color with an intense nose of sweet raisins, cigar tobacco, amber honey and vanilla. A warm palate offers grilled tropical fruit and candied walnuts rounded with soft spices that persist throughout a long wonderful finish.

title: Saint Lucia Chairman's Reserve
bodyHtml:
Chairman's Reserve is a premium rum produced on the island of Saint Lucia, specifically within the agriculturally rich Roseau Valley. The brand was first blended in 1999 under the supervision of the late Laurie Barnard, who served as the 'Chairman' of St. Lucia Distillers. St. Lucia Distillers was established in 1972 following the merger of the island's last two remaining rum estates and continues to produce spirits in accordance with the Saint Lucia Rum Geographical Indication.

2. Spirit Description

The flagship Original expression is a blend of aged rums distilled in both Coffey column stills and copper pot stills, which are married together and finished in oak vats.

  • Colour: The rum possesses a rich dark amber hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is defined by typical pot still richness, featuring whiffs of cooked banana, caramelized fruits, and spicy oak derived vanilla.

  • Palate: A well balanced mid palate provides structure for flavours of chocolate, golden raisin, tobacco, and clove.

  • Body: The spirit is known for its harmonious, well rounded finesse and tremendous character.

  • Finish: The experience dissipates over a long, creamy finish.

  • ABV: This rum is bottled at 40%.

title: Saint Lucia Chairman's Reserve Spiced Rum
bodyHtml:
Chairman’s Spiced Rum begins with the original Chairman’s Reserve steeped with “Bois Bandé,” a local Caribbean bark culturally known for its aphrodisiac qualities. Added to the rum are local spices and fruits such as cinnamon, clove, nutmeg, vanilla, allspice, lemon, and orange peels.

A blend of Coffey and pot still rums aged and finished with local fruits and spices.  Aged separately by batch and by type of still in ex-Bourbon barrels, then blended and rested in oak vats for an additional six months. Local fruits and spices are added over the final six months of finishing.

Deep mahogany color with a supple red hue. An expressive aroma of bitter orange, nutmeg, cinnamon, and sweet raisin lead to a sweet and rich mouthfeel bursting with exotic spices and balanced with crisp citrus character. An epicurean and complex spiced rum.

title: Xavier Gerard Cote Rotie 2021
bodyHtml:
Great Cote-Rotie tastes and feels like it was chiselled from stone. That’s because it is! The vineyards of Xavier Gerard cling to terraced hillsides of granite and schist, producing the most exquisitely perfumed examples of Syrah in the world. Superstar Xavier Gerard’s limited bottling is a tour de force!

A fully dimensional and illustrative nose of grilled meat, savoury herbs, bramble, black cherry, cured olive, and granitic minerals is both classic and precise. A deftly crafted palate shows generous, fine tannins. A Syrah lover's Syrah, it's at home with grilled lamb chops, seared duck breast, or medium-aged cheeses.

title: Romeo's Gin X
bodyHtml:
More than just another pink gin, Romeo’s Gin X explores the powerful symbolisms of the “X”, commonly used by Miss Me in her work. It offers a strong contrast between harmony and opposition, which perfectly reflects the collaboration between Romeo's Gin and Miss Me. A bold pink gin, charming and refreshing.

Watermelon and cucumber share the same aromatic molecules, as they are both from the cucurbit family. This is where the recipe for Romeo’s Gin X draws its inspiration. The watermelon distillate added to Romeo’s Gin and its aromas of juniper, cucumber, lavender, dill, lemon and almond, make Romeo’s Gin X a fruity gin, perfectly balanced and deliciously refreshing.

title: Roe & Co Blended Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml: Roe & Co distillery is the home of cocktail exploration and modern Irish whiskey. Nestled in the heart of the Liberties, new energy surges through the former Guinness Power Station, where fun and flavour come to life through a truly immersive experience. This is Irish Whiskey reimagined.

title: Gordon & MacPhail Mortlach Single Malt 25 Year Old 'Distillery Labels'
bodyHtml: Part of Gordon & MacPhail’s lauded Distillery Labels series, their take on the Mortlach label is almost as striking as the whisky itself. Almost but not quite, but it's hard to compete with this stunning 25-year-old Speyside malt and it’s sumptuous notes of coffee, chocolate and vanilla.

title: Carn Mor Mac-Talla Terra
bodyHtml: A peated single malt Islay whisky from an undisclosed Islay distillery bottled under the Mac-Talla label from Morrison. "Mac-Talla" translates to "echo" in Scottish Gaelic and the 46% alc./vol. Terra expression (meaning "earth") presents a fresh smokiness. Matured in American oak, non-chill filtered and no added colour.

title: Carn Mor Mac-Talla Mara
bodyHtml: The Mac-Talla Mara Cask Strength Islay Single Malt is an Islay single malt from an undisclosed distillery bottled by the independent bottler Morrison Scotch Whisky Distillers. The Mara is the cask strength release in this series and has a lot of maritime influences. It matured in American oak casks and was bottled at natural cask strength of 58.2% alc./vol., non chill filtered and with no added colour.

title: Gruber Roschitz Rose St. Laurent 2024
bodyHtml: Light salmon pink, inviting fragrance of fresh strawberries, some pink pomelo. Lively acid structure, repeated strawberry in the taste, sea buckthorn, white currant. Juicy and easy drinking!

title: Gran Appasso Primitivo Collezione 2021
bodyHtml: Intense expressions of wild dark berries, plum and chocolate, with hints of eucalyptus and mediterraean herbs. Huge fruit flavor and intensity, full bodied and tremendously well balanced, displaying complexity and concentration in a harmonious manner. Ending with a long persistent and truly memorable finish.

title: Stambecco Maraschino Cherry Amaro
bodyHtml:
Born in Italy, the home of the Amaro, Stambecco Amaro has put its stamp on the category for being the first to add maraschino cherries to its recipe. The name Stambecco is an homage to the lovely long-horned goats that can be seen jumping from mountain to mountain near the Alpine home of the distillery. Master Distiller, Beppe Ronco, works his magic at the Torino Distillati, in Piedmont, North-Eastern Italy.

Nose: Cherry candy – my favorite lollipop flavor – the cherry Tootsie pop, plus the warmth of cinnamon and cardamom following right behind

Taste: A great balance between sweet and bitter, subtle cherry hints with the artemisia adding that zing to make it bitter.

Finish: A velvety, smooth finish with a lingering taste of the cardamon and cinnamon to warm your palette

title: Adega de Penalva Rose Dao 2021
bodyHtml: Adega de Penalva is one of Dão’s leading co-operative wineries. Founded in 1960 by 43 growers, today the co-operative has 1000 members. On average, each of these growers owns a little more than one hectare of vines. This is the kind of Portuguese rosé you want. It’s dry, crisp and very refreshing. Pale pink in colour, it has aromas of light red cherry, ripe strawberry, grapefruit, cumin, and clove. On the palate, it is light-bodied with zesty acidity and savoury red fruit flavours. It’s a lovely and unshowy rosé with a persistent finish that brings you back for another sip.

title: Saint Cosme 'Les Deux Albion' 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the southern Rhône Valley region, specifically within the Côtes du Rhône Gigondas zone, Saint Cosme 'Les Deux Albions' represents a historic, benchmark expression of southern Rhône Syrah and Grenache. Crafted by Louis Barruol at Château de Saint Cosme—an estate with winemaking roots dating back to Roman times in 1410—'Les Deux Albions' takes its name from two historic family estates merged by the Barruol family. Sourced from high-elevation vineyards in Gigondas and surrounding terroirs planted on limestone, clay, and stony alluvial soils, the winemaking philosophy utilizes whole-cluster fermentation with native yeasts in concrete vats, followed by aging in concrete vats and wooden casks without heavy oak interference. The result is a deeply expressive, authentic wine characterized by dark fruit density, savory Mediterranean garrigue, and fine limestone structure.

Wine Description

The wine presents an opaque, deep dark ruby red colour with intense purple-garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, complex bouquet opens with opulent aromas of ripe dark plum, black cherry, wild blackberry, and cassis, interwoven with seductive notes of black pepper, crushed violet, tapenade, dried lavender, liquorice, and roasted coffee bean. On the palate, it is full bodied, dense, and mouth-filling, delivering concentrated flavours of dark berries, red fruit jam, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by rich, fine-grained limestone tannins and a deep mid-palate structure, it concludes with a remarkably long, persistent finish marked by lingering black fruit, wild herbs, and a chalky mineral grip. Composed primarily of Syrah blended with Grenache, Carignan, Mourvèdre, and Clairette, it combines Gigondas-level structure and density with pure southern Rhône generosity and charm.

title: Poli La Premiere 2008
bodyHtml: A majestic and solemn brandy that preserves the flavors of the classic Bordeaux blend and mixes them with pure Venetian passion. Made with grape-marc of Merlot, Cabernet and Petit Verdot from Chateau Lafite and aged 8 years in their barrels. Its aroma recalls a lavish banquet with ripe fruit, marzipan, dry and candied fruit. This grappa is like no other!

title: Antoniolo Gattinara Le Castelle 2020
bodyHtml: 100% Nebbiolo from the single vineyard' Le Castelle,' located near Gattinara's emblematic medieval tower. Aged in French oak barrique for 30 months followed by one year in bottle prior to release.

title: Laroche Chablis Premier Cru Les Vaudevey 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from France, specifically from the Chablis Premier Cru 'Les Vaudevey' subregion of Burgundy. Domaine Laroche is a historic estate based in 'L'Obédiencerie', a former monastery in the village of Chablis where wine has been made for over 1000 years. Technical director Romain Chevrolat focuses on a vineyard first philosophy, implementing sustainable viticulture practices without artificial pesticides or herbicides to achieve the purest expression of the terroir.

Wine Description

Laroche Chablis Premier Cru Les Vaudevey displays a pale gold or bright gold colour. The nose is complex and intense, offering aromas of bright citrus, green apple, and white fruit accented by hints of iodine, oyster shell, and stone fruit. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and energetic, featuring concentrated flavours of green plum and kumquat balanced by a steely, racy acidity. It is characterized by its remarkable tension and precision, leading to a long, persistent finish with a distinct saline or chalky mineral character. This 100% Chardonnay is aged on its fine lees for several months and typically has an ABV of 12.5% to 12.6%. The wine is produced following sustainable and organic farming principles.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and saline minerality of this Premier Cru make it an exceptional companion for a variety of seafood dishes. It pairs perfectly with raw oysters, smoked salmon, grilled lobster, or a traditional seafood platter. Its crisp profile also complements light cheeses, Asian cuisine, and delicate poultry dishes such as chicken crepes with lemon cream sauce or chanterelle mushroom stuffed chicken breast.

title: Dormilona Pinku Rose 2023
bodyHtml: The Dormilona house wines are just so straightforward and easy drinking. This rosé made from certified organic Merlot & Shiraz from Wilyabrup is super light, playful and crisp. A touch of skin contact then pressed straight to tank for ferment. Lots of batonnage (stirring settled lees back into wine) to check in some mid weight texture, full malo (softer-tasting acid), then racked off to settle before bottle.

title: Isle Of Harris Gin
bodyHtml:
The award-winning Isle of Harris Gin is made in the village of Tarbert, every drop distilled in a small copper gin still known as 'The Dottach', before being bottled and sealed by hand. A beautifully designed bottle captures the elemental nature of the Isle of Harris, while its contents reward the discerning gin drinker with refreshing maritime pleasures. The inclusion of local, hand-harvested Sugar Kelp speaks of the island's deep connections to the sea while working with eight other carefully chosen botanicals.

Refreshing, with a good balance between the bitter juniper and pine and the sweet fruit flavours of mango, grapefruit and orange.  A green herb flavour of crushed coriander develops.  Distinctive and smooth with a dry, flinty taste.

title: White Rock Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
St Francis Cabernet Sauvignon Sonoma County 2022
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, this Cabernet Sauvignon is sourced from the diverse terrains of Sonoma County, incorporating fruit from renowned regions such as Sonoma Valley, Russian River Valley, Alexander Valley, and Dry Creek Valley. Established in 1971 by Joe Martin, St Francis Winery & Vineyards began as a premier grower before opening its winery doors in 1979.

Wine Description

This deep and lustrous red wine presents a complex sensory profile, opening with robust aromas of ripe blackcurrant, cassis, and wild blackberries layered with savory notes of sage, black olive, and a hint of allspice. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and balanced, delivering expressive flavors of dark red fruits, milk chocolate, and black licorice. The structure is defined by firm, smooth tannins and well integrated oak spice from 16 to 18 months of aging in French oak barrels. It concludes with a long, elegant finish characterized by toasted cedar and tobacco.

Food Pairing

The bold structure and dark fruit profile of this Cabernet Sauvignon make it an ideal companion for hearty meat dishes such as grilled ribeye steak, roast lamb, or braised short ribs. It also pairs exceptionally well with aged blue cheese or savory game like venison and roast pork.

title: Luc Belaire Rare Luxe (NV)
bodyHtml: Indulge in true French luxury. Produced in Burgundy, France from 100% Chardonnay grapes. Blended with a special dosage of Chardonnay from Chablis and aged for six months in Burgundy oak casks. Packaged in a luxurious white and gold bottle.

title: Luc Belaire Gold
