bodyHtml: Produced in Burgundy, France from hand picked Chardonnay and Pinot Noir grapes, Belaire Gold is stunning inside and out. An elegant and balanced cuvee with aromas of stone fruit, ripe pear, and brioche. Notes of mango and limestone on the palate with a delicate and dry finish.

title: Chateau Lanessan 2020
bodyHtml:
Chateau Lanessan hails from the Haut Medoc appellation of Bordeaux, France. This historic estate traces its winemaking roots back to the late 18th century following its purchase by Jean Delbos, remaining in the hands of the Bouteiller family for eight consecutive generations.

Wine Description

Sporting a deep purple-black color, this wine opens with a highly attractive, expressive nose of blackcurrants, cassis, and black raspberries mingled with spring flowers, pencil lead, and light mint. The medium-bodied palate is wonderfully fresh, vibrant, and concentrated, displaying energetic red and dark berry profiles alongside graphite, a dab of black pepper, and subtle notes of tobacco and scorched earth.

title: Cristom Pinot Noir Eileen Vineyard 2021
bodyHtml: Eileen Vineyard, named after co-founder Eileen Gerrie, is situated at the highest elevation on the original Cristom estate rising to over 735 feet with commanding views of the Cascade Range to the east and the Oregon Coast Range to the west. Perched at the crest of the Eola Hills, Eileen Vineyard is defined by the cold, Pacific Ocean winds and dramatic volcanic soil variation from ancient basalt flows. Among the most geologically complex sites on the farm and Cristom's most wind-swept vines, the fruit from Eileen can be structured, vibrant and persistent.

title: Cristom Pinot Noir Marjorie Vineyard 2022
bodyHtml: Vintage after vintage, Cristom produces top-quality wines, no matter how easy or challenging the elements make it. This consistency is a testament to the deep knowledge of the vineyard, the respect for the land, and a light touch in the cellar. Recognized globally as a leading producer in the beloved Willamette Valley, their wines continue to be a unique blend of tradition, modernity and finesse.

title: Antoniolo Gattinara Riserva San Francesco 2018
bodyHtml: 100% Nebbiolo from 55 year old vines planted in morainic and volcanic soils. Maceration on the skins in cement vats for 14-16 days, pumping over with sprinklers, maturation for one year in 350-500 litre tonneaux and 18 months in large oak casks (20-25 Hl). Finishing in the bottle for one year.

title: Cenote Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: Cenote Blanco Tequila is made from 100% agave. The tequila briefly rests in American oak barrels for three weeks before bottling. Cenote [si-nō-tē] is a deep sinkhole in limestone which contains natural reservoirs of water, typically found in the Yucatán.

title: Il Poggione Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
One of the most highly regarded wineries in all of Tuscany, Tenuta Il Poggione makes incredibly powerful wines for collectors and everyday drinkers alike. Located in Sant' Angelo in Colle in the commune of Montalcino, Tenuta Il Poggione was established at the end of the 19th century by Lavinio Franceschi and is still owned today by the 5th generation of its founder, siblings Leopoldo and Livia Franceschi.

Ruby red in color, with a very intense, persistent nose and with red fruit notes. Warm, balanced flavor with velvet-smooth tannins. Long-lasting aroma.

title: Old Tub Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml: Jim Beam is bringing back the distillery's oldest brand nationally and making it the way it was more than 100 years ago. It will be distilled there without chill filtration, just like the original Old Tub recipe, according to a release. Chill filtration removes fatty acids. This version has a full-bodied authentic flavour. The bourbon tastes of warm caramel, with a nose of oak, grain and vanilla.

title: Nederburg Sauvignon Blanc The Winemasters 2023
bodyHtml:
Brilliant with a lime-green tinge. Lemongrass and tropical fruit aromas with hints of lime and lovely herbaceous flavours. A medium-bodied wine with concentrated flavours of lemongrass, ripe fig and undertones of minerality. The wine has a lingering finish with a fresh, crisp acidity.

Excellent with seafood, salads, chicken, veal and light meals.

title: Castarede Armagnac 2006
bodyHtml: The Armagnac Castarede comes from the Castarede family, who have been running their winery in the Armagnac region of France since 1832. The nose is rich with stewed fruits, cedary oak and enticing aromas of pecans, honey, plums and white pepper. After some time, sweeter notes of vanilla, sticky dates, and old muscat develop. The palate is silky and elegant with dried fruits, bread pudding, toffee and baking spices with gentle fine tannins on the finish. Great finesse and surprisingly delicate for an old Armagnac.

title: Penfolds Bin 389 Cabernet Sauvignon - Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml:
The Penfolds Bin 389 Cabernet Sauvignon Shiraz originates from South Australia, specifically drawing fruit from the renowned subregions of McLaren Vale, Padthaway, and the Barossa Valley. Penfolds, established in 1844, is widely recognized as a pioneer of modern Australian fine wine and is led today by chief winemaker Peter Gago. This particular bottling, first created in 1960 by the legendary Max Schubert, is famously known as 'Baby Grange' because it is matured in the same American oak barrels that previously held the winery’s flagship Grange.

Wine Description

This deeply inky red blend presents a complex sensory profile starting with bright aromas of black cherry, blackcurrant, and bergamot, layered with nuances of shaved dark chocolate, licorice, and aniseed. The palate is elegantly full bodied, featuring a seamless integration of blue and red fruits—such as mulberry and red currant—balanced by savoury notes of black olive, fennel, and toasted spices. Composed of 51% Cabernet Sauvignon and 49% Shiraz, the wine is supported by ultra-refined, chalky tannins and a touch of vanillin sweetness from its 12 months in American oak hogsheads.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and rich fruit profile of this wine make it an excellent partner for grilled steak, roast beef, or a rack of lamb. It also pairs exceptionally well with savoury, full-flavoured dishes such as beef Wellington, lamb shanks, or aged sharp cheddar.

title: Mazzei Philip Rosso Toscana IGT 2022
bodyHtml: Philip is a quintessentially Tuscan wine. It brings together the fragrance and elegance of wines produced in the famous area of Chianti Classico with the opulence and power of wines from the more recently discovered Maremma region. The combination of Cabernet Sauvignon from two different Tuscan estates creates aromatic complexity, depth of colour and powerful structure while simultaneously lending minerality, elegance and finesse to the wine. Philip is complex and exotic with waves of bittersweet chocolate, spices, cinnamon, clove and mint, mingled in a delectable dance of flavours. Rich and opulent yet supple and silky, it is full bodied with polished tannins and a fresh, long finish. Tuscan estates creates aromatic complexity, depth of colour and powerful structure while simultaneously lending minerality, elegance and finesse to the wine.

title: Emilia Romagna Dinavolo White 2020
bodyHtml: Apple, peach and citrus touches can be detected, as well as orange flowers and slightly spicy hints. On the palate, it is fresh, energetic and dynamic, with memories of what is perceived in the nose and intense mineral aromas. Ortugo, Malvasia di Candia, Marsanne and another forgotten variety from the Denavolo estate.

title: Primarius Pinot Gris 2021
bodyHtml:
With its diverse topography and rich terroir, Oregon provides the perfect palette to craft wines of elegance and balance. Primarius is a wine made for the people, by the hearts and hands of those who know Oregon Pinot best. With each blend, winemaker Sarah Cabot hand selects the best fruit to masterfully craft unique wines complex in structure and truly distinguished in style. Ever-changing vineyard sourcing promotes constant evolution in the winemaking technique to allow for unparalleled consistency from vintage to vintage.

Aromatics of gardenia, Piña colada, papaya, and honeysuckle introduce a palate full and juicy with notes of melon and a lingering finish.

title: Masi Amarone Costasera 2021
bodyHtml:
Masi Amarone della Valpolicella Classico Costasera originates from the historic Valpolicella Classica region in Italy. The Masi winery is owned by the Boscaini family, who have stewarded these lands for seven generations and are renowned for their expertise in the traditional 'appassimento' technique. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the unique character of sunset-facing slopes, where longer afternoon light and reflected brightness from Lake Garda foster optimal grape ripeness.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a very dark, bright ruby red colour. The nose is opulent and complex, revealing an intense bouquet of baked plums, ripe cherries, and dried figs layered with cocoa, coffee, and warm spices like cinnamon. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and powerful, offering a smooth texture with velvet-like tannins and a balanced acidity that prevents heaviness. The finish is remarkably long and savory, featuring lingering notes of dark chocolate and roasted coffee.

Food Pairing

This structured red is an ideal companion for grilled or roasted red meats, wild boar ragu, and game dishes like pheasant or quail. It also pairs exquisitely with well aged cheeses such as Parmigiano Reggiano or piquant Gorgonzola.

title: Borgo Scopeto Borgonero 2023
bodyHtml:
Borgo Scopeto Borgonero originates from the Tuscany region of Italy. The estate is owned by Elisabetta Gnudi Angelini, who also manages prestigious properties such as Altesino and Caparzo, with winemaking overseen by Massimo Bracalente. The Borgo Scopeto property near Castelnuovo Berardenga dates back to the year 1000 and was historically part of the agricultural holdings of the Bishop of Siena.

Wine Description

This 'Super Tuscan' presents a deep ruby red colour with violet hues. The aromatic profile is intense and complex, featuring ethereal scents of leather and tobacco alongside ripe black cherry, plum, and blackberry. On the palate, the wine is full bodied with an extraordinary structure and surprising softness, offering flavours of liquorice, earthy undertones, and subtle spice from oak aging.

title: Poderi Aldo Conterno Langhe Nebbiolo 'Il Favot' 2018
bodyHtml:
The grapes used to make "Il Favot" come from vineyards which have undergone periodical implantations, and so have a maximum age of 15 years. The skin contact is limited to 6-8 days so to extract few tannins and more colour from the skins themselves, with the result of getting a well-coloured wine with remarkable softness. A combination of strawberry, cherry, currant and iodine aromas and flavours are the hallmarks of this juicy, complex red. Firms up at the end, with a subtle length. Drink now.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

A combination of strawberry, cherry, currant and iodine aromas and flavors are the hallmarks of this juicy, complex red. Firms up at the end, with a subtle length. Drink now.

title: Dujardin VSOP Brandy
bodyHtml: A perfect union of French wine-growing tradition and German distillation result in this flavourful German brandy. Extensive maturation takes place in Limousin oak barrels, which impart an attractive golden colour, exquisite rich taste and aromatic bouquet.

title: Nikka Days Blended Japanese Whisky - 700 ml
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Nikka Days is a bright and vibrant blended whisky designed by Nikka's blending team to be an approachable, everyday spirit. Launched as a modern addition to the Nikka portfolio, it emphasizes a smooth, easy-drinking profile that works equally well neat or in cocktails. The blend is composed of over 100 different batches of malt and grain whiskies, including slightly peated malts from the Yoichi distillery and the fruity, floral malts from Miyagikyo, all balanced by the mellow grain whiskies produced in Nikka's Coffey stills.

Whisky Description

This whisky displays a pale straw color. The nose is fresh and fruity, offering an inviting array of white flowers, orange blossoms, pear, and citrus zest. On the palate, the texture is silky and light-bodied, delivering a gentle sweetness characterized by notes of toasted cereal, vanilla toffee, and roasted nuts. A very faint, nearly imperceptible whisper of peat smoke appears in the mid-palate, providing a touch of depth without the intensity found in the brand's single malts. The finish is clean and medium in length, leaving behind a refreshing aftertaste of lemon peel and light malt. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

Food Pairing

The light and zesty character of Nikka Days makes it a versatile companion for a wide range of light fare. It pairs exceptionally well with creamy seafood dishes like shrimp scampi or lemon-butter white fish. Its cereal sweetness also complements savory-sweet appetizers such as prosciutto-wrapped melon or a mild goat cheese. Because it was specifically designed for the "Highball" culture, it is a perfect match for salty izakaya snacks like edamame, gyoza, or lightly salted nuts. Served with sparkling water and a twist of lemon, it cuts beautifully through the richness of fried foods.

title: Novaia Ripasso Classico Superiore 2021
bodyHtml: From hillside vineyards in Novaia di Marano di Valpolicella, this classic blend of Corvina, Rondinella, Molinara was fermented and rested 10 months in steel, prior to release. Bright cherry, red cassis, is streaked with green herbal branch, and finishes snappy and briefly. Tannins are soft and fine, housing this to a pasty end. Best with meatballs.

title: Nikka Yoichi Single Malt Japanese Whisky - 700 ml
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Nikka Yoichi Single Malt is the flagship expression from the Yoichi Distillery, established in 1934 by Masataka Taketsuru, the "father of Japanese whisky." Located on the coast of Hokkaido, the northernmost island of Japan, the distillery was chosen for its environmental similarities to Scotland. Yoichi is world-renowned for its traditional production methods, most notably being the only distillery in the world that still uses direct coal-fired pot stills. This traditional technique results in a robust, powerful spirit that defines the Nikka house style.

Whisky Description

The whisky presents a bright gold color. On the nose, it is bold and complex, offering a signature balance of mellow peat smoke and briny sea air, layered with notes of candied orange peel and white flowers. The palate is full-bodied and oily, delivering a rich core of toasted oak, nutty cereal, and stewed fruits like yellow plum and peach. A distinct earthy smokiness runs through the experience, accented by hints of ginger and black pepper. The finish is long and satisfying, leaving a lingering trail of herbaceous peat and a salty maritime tang. It is bottled at 45% ABV and is non-chill filtered.

Food Pairing

The powerful, smoky, and salty character of Yoichi makes it an exceptional partner for rich and savory foods. It pairs perfectly with smoked meats, charcoal-grilled lamb chops, or a peppery ribeye steak. Its maritime influence also makes it a natural match for briny seafood like fresh oysters or smoked mackerel. For a unique dessert pairing, try it with dark chocolate-covered ginger or an aged Stilton cheese, which can stand up to the whisky’s intensity. It is best enjoyed neat or with a single large ice cube to slowly reveal its coastal aromatics.

title: Alvear Fino
bodyHtml:
General Information

From the small Andalusian town of Montilla comes this delicate and elegant Fino with fresh aromas of yeast and tropical citrus fruits. With its crisp, clean finish, it is an excellent aperitif and an ideal partner for tapas, those delightful Spanish finger foods.

title: Chateau Grand Village Bordeaux Blanc 2019
bodyHtml: Le Grand Village is the original Bordeaux home of the Guinaudeau family, better known as the producers of Château Lafleur in Pomerol. The same team and equal level of detailed attention are dedicated to winemaking in this chateau in Fronsac on the Right Bank. This results in a wine far outstripping their nominal Bordeaux Superieur status, creating some of the most exciting releases in the appellation. If one wants to glimpse savoir-faire, Grand Village is an unmissable addition to any cellar. This white wine shows a complex floral nose and great harmony between tension and texture on the palate. The finish is solid, creamy, long and elegant!

title: Campo Al Mare Bolgheri Rosso 2021
bodyHtml: The Folonari family has been making wine since the late eighteenth century. In 1825 the family-owned business took the name “Fratelli Folonari” and adopted the mission of developing, producing and distributing the finest Italian wines throughout the world.

title: Tenuta Sette Cieli Bolgheri NOI4 2023
bodyHtml:
Tenuta Sette Cieli Bolgheri NOI4 originates from the prestigious Bolgheri DOC in Tuscany, Italy. The estate is situated on high-altitude terraces 400 metres above sea level, overlooking the Tyrrhenian Sea between Bolgheri and Castagneto Carducci. Under the guidance of owner Ambrogio Cremona Ratti and his family, the winery maintains a philosophy of organic practices and meticulous vineyard management to preserve the heritage and unique microclimate of the estate.

Wine Description

This deep, purple-toned red presents an elegant sensory profile characterized by its richness and complexity. The nose reveals intense aromas of blackberry jam, candied lavender, and sweet Mediterranean herbs, underpinned by hints of espresso, dark chocolate, and incense. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and plush, offering a 'fresh and crunchy' texture with flavors of blackcurrant, tobacco, and licorice. It is remarkably balanced, featuring high natural acidity and firm, ripe tannins that lead to a savory finish with notes of tea leaves and menthol.

Food Pairing

The bold structure and concentrated fruit of this Bolgheri red make it an ideal companion for hearty meat dishes such as roast lamb, venison haunch, or a Shorthorn T-bone steak. It also pairs exceptionally well with territorial Tuscan specialties like wild boar with polenta or potato-stuffed Tortelli Mugellani served with a rich meat sauce. For a more contemporary match, consider pairing it with a Canadian tourtière or beef burgundy.

title: Inniskillin Chardonnay Unoaked
bodyHtml: Pale medium lemon with lifted aromas of yellow pear, white melon, vanilla and nuts. On the palate it is extra dry and medium-bodied with flavours that repeat the aromas and a hint of spice on the finish.

title: Cecchi Chianti Riserva 2020
bodyHtml: Established in 1893, Cecchi is one of the oldest and most prominent producers in Tuscany, pioneering the growth and development of the Sangiovese grape worldwide. Cecchi embodies Tuscan authenticity with an emphasis on innovation and sustainability, crafting wines that showcase the pure expressions of the family’s historic vineyards. The Cecchi Chianti Classico Riserva di Famiglia is the wine most representative of the Cecchi family’s winemaking philosophy of showcasing the purity and quality of the Sangiovese grape and is only produced in the best vintage years.

title: Wayne Gretzky Rose 2022
Old Perth Cask Strength
bodyHtml: A cask strength edition of the sherry-matured Old Perth blended malt, bolstering those earthy, spicy notes.

title: Old Perth Original
bodyHtml: The Original blended malt from the Old Perth range is an exclusively sherry-matured expression created to honour the legacy of blending houses in the region.

title: Boneshaker Zinfandel 2021
bodyHtml: Boneshaker is a label under Hahn Family Wines, a family of second-generation vintners in the Santa Lucia Highlands of Monterey County. They proudly make Hahn, Hahn SLH, Lucienne, Smith & Hook and Boneshaker.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '45' Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 1.8 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Produced by Asahi Shuzo, a brewery that transformed from near-bankruptcy to global fame, Dassai is renowned for producing exclusively premium Junmai Daiginjo grade sake. The name "Dassai" translates to "otter festival," a nod to local folklore and the brewery’s philosophy of continuous innovation rather than complacency with tradition. The "45" refers to the rice polishing ratio, where each grain of top-grade Yamada Nishiki rice is milled down to 45% of its original size to ensure purity and elegance.

Description

This world-renowned sake is clear and crystalline with silvery reflections. The nose is exquisitely rich and fresh, dominated by aromas of honeydew melon and white peach with subtle floral notes of jasmine and white blossoms. On the palate, it is light-bodied and silky, offering a "tropical party" of flavors including pineapple, mango, sweet apple, and a hint of almond. It strikes a masterful balance between subtle sweetness and mild acidity, finishing clean and crisp without any lingering aftertaste. ABV 15.5%–16%.

Food Pairing

The "clean, soft, and fruity" profile of Dassai 45 makes it an exceptionally approachable pairing for both Japanese and Western cuisines. It is classic alongside sushi, sashimi, and lightly fried tempura. For a unique combination, try it with savory-creamy dishes like chicken steak with tartar sauce, Caesar salad, or steamed mussels in a garlic broth. Its delicate acidity also allows it to pair surprisingly well with soft cheeses such as chèvre or even blue cheese.

title: Henriot Brut Blanc Souverain - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
93 Points ﻿- Wine Enthusiast

This is great Champagne, in the bottle-aged Henriot style. It’s a classic Chardonnay, ripe, creamy, packed with yellow fruits, and finely balanced with a great waft of toast. A high percentage of older vintages in the blend gives this wine richness, maturity, without ever losing its crisp edge.

100% Chardonnay, mostly from the vineyards of Mesnil sur Oger, Vertus, Chouilly and Trépail. 38% of the Cuvee is from reserve wines.

title: Domaine Gassier Viognier 2024
bodyHtml: From renowned producer Michel Gassier, this organically grown Viognier exhibits the hallmark peachy character of the variety along with a touch of mineral complexity. It'll make a fine partner for crispy pork belly sandwiches.

title: Yellowstone Select Bourbon 93 Proof
bodyHtml: This Bourbon from Kentucky is a smooth, skillfully selected whiskey with true ties to its family. The spirit is a masterful fusion of flavours from 7th generation distillers Paul and Steve Beam, and is a hand-picked blend of sweet, spicy and smoky Bourbons, each selected to give this exclusive whiskey a taste that celebrates its deep family origins, and is bottled at 93 proof.

title: High Coast Cinco Sherry Cask
bodyHtml: For Cinco, High Coast have used a number of barrels that previously matured five different styles of sherry. The five varieties are Oloroso, Fino, Pedro Ximénez, Amontillado and Palo Cortado. 50.5% alc./vol.

title: Grgich Hills Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' white wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Napa Valley A.V.A. in coastal Northern California. Produced by Grgich Hills Estate the legendary, family-owned winery co-founded in 1977 by Miljenko "Mike" Grgich, the master winemaker whose 1973 Chateau Montelena Chardonnay famously triumphed at the historic 1976 Judgment of Paris this bottling represents an iconic benchmark of world-class Californian Chardonnay. Sourced exclusively from estate-grown, certified organic and biodynamic vineyard blocks in cool-climate southern Napa Valley (primarily Carneros and American Canyon), the vines thrive in well-draining clay-loam and gravelly alluvial soils. The maritime microclimate features persistent morning fog sweeping in from San Pablo Bay and cooling afternoon Pacific ocean breezes, balancing sunny afternoon warmth to allow Chardonnay grapes to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining a laser-focused, age-worthy natural acidity without relying on malolactic conversion.

Wine Description

Grgich Hills Estate Chardonnay presents a brilliant, pale gold-straw color in the glass with bright chartreuse and lemon-yellow highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and noble portrayal of cool-climate Napa Valley terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of crisp Meyer lemons, green apples, and ripe yellow peaches, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of orange blossom, toasted almonds, lemon curd, pastry dough, and a subtle line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of spiced orchard fruit, citrus zest, and delicate pear. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly across the mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, supple, and linear, carrying into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by lingering notes of lemon peel, toasted brioche, and flint.

This high-definition Californian expression is 100% Chardonnay, harvested meticulously by hand during cool early morning hours to preserve pure primary fruit character. Following gentle whole-cluster pressing, the wine was fermented using indigenous natural yeasts in large French oak casks (foudres) and neutral French oak barrels (approximately 30% to 40% new oak). Crucially, in keeping with Mike Grgich's signature winemaking philosophy, the wine strictly avoided malolactic conversion, preserving its natural tartaric acidity, structural tension, and pure varietal fruit freshness. It matured on its fine lees (sur lie) with gentle stirring for 10 months prior to bottling. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5% to 14.0% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season in Napa Valley was widely heralded as a landmark vintage, marked by a cool, long, and late growing season with generous winter rainfall. These extended ripening conditions allowed Chardonnay grapes in cool southern Napa Valley to build complex skin flavor profiles gradually while preserving pristine natural acidity levels. Grgich Hills harvested clean, healthy fruit at peak structural balance. The resulting 2023 Grgich Hills Estate Chardonnay combines high-energy fruit purity with noble structural drive, built to drink beautifully today and evolve gracefully in a cellar over the next 10 to 15 years.

title: Michael David Lodi Red 'Don's Blend' 2021
bodyHtml: Fill your soul with this bistro-style red that pays homage to our Lodi Roots! Produced from some of the finest fruit in Lodi, Bing cherry, anise and cedar aromas interlace with flavors of blackberry, vanilla bean and spice. A medium bodied, food-friendly wine.

title: Brugal 1888 Double Aged Rum
bodyHtml:
General Information

Brugal 1888 Doblemente Anejado is a truly exceptional rum, produced in the Dominican Republic and combining the rich flavours of bourbon and sherry casks through a double-ageing process. With notes of vanilla, red fruits and toffee intertwined with cocoa and natural oak spice Brugal 1888 is a wonderfully inviting spirit that is smooth, full of flavour and perfectly balanced.

Reimagine your favourite stirred cocktail with Brugal 1888 to discover a Rum Negroni or Old-fashioned with a wonderful depth of flavour, or enjoy neat to discover a spirit that stimulates the senses and evolves in the glass.

title: Mercer Bros. Horse Heaven Hills Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
bodyHtml:
Mercer Bros. Will and Rob continue the independent spirit of their great-grandfather, who settled in remote eastern Washington's Columbia Valley in 1886 to begin the family farm. In 1972, the third-generation Mercers pioneered wine growing in the area, planting on the same land the vines that produced Washington's first 100-point wines from Robert Parker. The Mercers founded the Horse Heaven Hills AVA, now Washington's highest-scoring appellation for Cabernet Sauvignons. Mercer Bros. wines are predominantly estate-grown, including some of Washington's oldest Cabernet Sauvignon vines dating to 1972.

This wine gives aromas of ripe red fruit, blackberry pie, and dried cranberries with hints of brown sugar and warm baking spices. Powdery tannins lend structure to this wine while maintaining elegance and ending in a long lingering finish.

title: Chum Churum Yogurt Soju - 360 ml
bodyHtml:
South Korea, Seoul. Produced by Lotte Chilsung Beverage Co., this expression is one of the most unique and sought-after flavors in the "Soonhari" fruit-flavored soju lineup. Known for its "cult following," Yogurt Soju (often referred to as Yakult soju due to its similarity to the famous probiotic drink) combines the traditional smoothness of Chum Churum’s alkaline water base with the nostalgic, tangy-sweet flavor of a yogurt beverage. It is widely credited with making soju more accessible to those who find the original spirit too harsh.

Description

This soju presents a clear appearance, though it is packed with a creamy, lactic flavor profile. The nose is incredibly distinctive, offering a sweet and milky aroma reminiscent of yogurt candy and fresh citrus. On the palate, it is light-bodied and remarkably smooth, delivering a nostalgic burst of sweet, tangy yogurt followed by a subtle, clean finish. The balance of sweetness and tartness masks the alcohol almost entirely, making it an exceptionally easy-drinking spirit. ABV 12%.

Food Pairing

The creamy and sweet-tart nature of Yogurt Soju makes it a legendary partner for spicy Korean street food. It is the perfect antidote to the heat of fire chicken (buldak), spicy rice cakes (tteokbokki), or kimchi-based stews. It also pairs delightfully with salty snacks like honey butter chips or crispy fried chicken. For a more experimental pairing, try it alongside fruit tarts or as a "boozy" companion to brunch dishes. It is best served very cold, either neat in traditional small glasses or mixed with lemon-lime soda for a refreshing fizz.

title: Chum Churum Peach Soju - 360 ml
bodyHtml:
South Korea, Seoul, Gangnam gu. Produced by Lotte Chilsung Beverage, South Korea's second largest producer of soju, the Chum Churum brand was first introduced to the market in 2006. The distillery is renowned for being the first to use alkaline water in its production, a technique that brought a whirlwind of popularity due to the softer taste profile it provides.

Description

This flavoured soju, part of the Soonhari line, features a clear and colourless appearance. The aroma is fresh and fruity, dominated by natural, juicy peach scents. On the palate, it offers an exceptionally smooth and creamy texture with a refreshing, subtle sweetness that negates the typical sharpness of higher proof spirits. The finish is light and crisp, leaving a lingering fruit savor that is easy to drink. ABV 12%.

Food Pairing

The sweet and juicy character of this peach soju makes it a perfect companion for spicy Korean dishes like tteokbokki and kimchi jeon, where the sweetness helps balance the heat. It also pairs remarkably well with savory American staples such as BBQ ribs, as the peach flavor complements caramelized sauces. For a lighter option, serve it chilled alongside fresh fruit, grilled seafood, or even fried chicken to cleanse the palate between bites.

title: Paul Autard Chateauneuf du Pape 2020
bodyHtml: Chocolatey nuances to go with loads of cassis, black raspberry, tobacco leaf and wild herb-like aromas and flavors. Possessing a big, full-bodied profile on the palate, with a terrific, broad, expansive texture, it stays Proven√ßal and has loads of character.

title: Charles Smith Chardonnay Wines of Substance 2020
bodyHtml: A bouquet of blossoms. Tangerine, apple, pear and wisteria right to your face as Italian melon, Gala apple, clove, and lemon meringue soothes your mouth. A delicate cascade of minerals washes over the palate. Complex and complete as you swoon with satisfaction.

title: La Crema Sauvignon Blanc Sonoma County 2022
bodyHtml: Vibrant and exotic, this wine combines fresh aromas of guava, passionfruit and pineapple with subtle wet stone and grassy-herbaceous notes. In the mouth, ­flavours of ruby grapefruit, apricot and peach are accompanied by tropical notes of mango and honeydew melon.

title: Jura Journey Single Malt
bodyHtml: The entry point to Jura's range and the start of a symbolic journey through the flavours of the island's only distillery. Softly smoky, with citrus and orchard fruit notes. A great place to start your exploration of Jura.

title: Jura Seven Wood Single Malt
bodyHtml: You may have guessed it already from this expression's name, but the Isle of Jura Seven Wood is made with whisky from seven different casks. There's American white oak and six other French oaks, Limousin, Tronçais, Allier, Vosges, Jupilles, and Les Bertranges. Intriguing stuff, this is.

title: Silent Sam Vodka
bodyHtml: Clear and colourless; mineral aromas; light bodied with a bit of heat on the finish.

title: Cinco Sentidos Madrecuixe Mezcal
bodyHtml: Cinco Sentidos Madrecuixe is a small batch mezcal that is traditionally produced in Oaxaca, Mexico. The tahona used to crush the cooked agave is pulled by bulls.

title: Cinco Sentidos Tobala Jabali
bodyHtml:
Cinco Sentidos is a representation of small-scale maestro mezcaleros that produce agave spirits with complex flavors. We select high-quality distillates that represent the various production processes, agave diversity, and traditions and talents of Mexico's master distillers of agave. 

Every once in a while we come upon a rare, small batch that doesn’t quite fit in our line-up. We find these rare batches a home one of two ways: Support needs within communities in Oaxaca by donating a portion of sales from specific releases to Oaxacan-based non-profits, and support our friends who run small businesses in the U.S. by offering an exclusive release. 

Jabali-Tobalá is the result of Alberto Martinez’s first attempt to harvest, ferment and distill these two wild, high altitude agaves together. Double distilled in clay pot stills. Tasting events hosted by Chicago’s Quiote and CH Distillery, as well some proceeds from the sale of the bottle, allowed us to donate nearly $1,000 to S.A.C.R.E.D., who in turned used those funds to support earthquake victims in Huajuapan, Oaxaca.  Proceeds from a second batch were donated to the Zaachila Agave Project, an initiative that teaches middle school students how to grow agave from seed.

title: Cinco Sentidos Puntas de Espadin
bodyHtml: Cinco Sentidos is a representation of small-scale maestro mezcaleros that produce agave spirits with complex flavors. We select high-quality distillates that represent the various production processes, agave diversity, and traditions and talents of Mexico's master distillers of agave.

title: Lagrimas de Dolores Lamparillo Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Tough, fibrous, dry and rough on the surface. Lamparillo is a wild variety of agave. Asperrima grows specifically in arid conditions.  Its name translates to "rough," which is befitting considering it thrives in the driest parts of the Nombre de Dios and the Cuencame dessert.

Like most of the Lagrimas de Dolores range, this Mezcal is best enjoyed neat and in moderation. Every time you sip on this Mezcal, you will discover new aromas and notes that will make it a must for every special occasion where Mezcal is needed.

title: Lagrimas de Dolores Verde
bodyHtml:
This mezcal is made from A. salmiana crassispina, locally called Verde. This wild variety is rarely made into mezcal, likely due to the fact that it is difficult to distill. Gilberto is one of the very few maestro vinateros that works with this variety and is well known for making great mezcal from it. 

The agaves are cooked in an underground pit using mesquite wood, rather than the oak which is typical of the other Lagrimas De Dolores expressions. After machine milling, the mash is fermented in in-ground pine pits, then double-distilled.

The clean flavours tend toward the savoury side of the spectrum with woodsy notes that range from crisp pine to fresh untoasted oak with an earthy sweetness. One of the most compelling aspects is the texture, round, fat, and tongue tingling. Exceptional.

title: Old Pulteney 15 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Matured for 15 years, this is their most balanced and smooth single malt.  Balancing two different sides of the flavour spectrum, this single malt marries these perfectly whilst also reflecting their coastal home and its unwavering influence. On the one hand, this is an intense single malt, yet at the same time, it is truly balanced. Spice and sweetness unite in this naturally rich amber whisky to celebrate rich flavours, yet lighter, more refreshing coastal notes show another side of this single malt. 

APPEARANCE... Rich amber.

AROMA... Intense yet balanced. Bursting with rich dried fruit, ripe apples and citrus, honey sweetness and a great chord of creamy vanilla. Slightly chocolaty and floral in the background.

TASTE... Fragrant spices and Christmas cake, with layers of chocolate and a distinct dark toffee sweetness. There is a hint of salty sea air on the finish, a clear connection to the influence of the sea on this single malt.

title: Erath Pinot Gris 2022
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, this Pinot Gris is sourced from a collection of prime vineyard sites across Oregon, primarily within the Willamette and Umpqua valleys. Founded by Dick Erath in 1968, the winery is a pioneer of the region, having cultivated the land for over 50 years with a deep commitment to expressing the unique terroir of the Dundee Hills. Erath’s winemaking philosophy focuses on a disciplined yet progressive approach, aiming to reveal the best expression of classic Oregon fruit through intentional, handcrafted processes.

Wine Description

This sumptuous Pinot Gris presents a delicate sensory profile, opening with aromas of Nashi pear, green melon, and subtle hints of white stone. On the palate, it offers a bright and pleasingly plush mouthful of jasmine flower, Meyer lemon, and shortbread, leading to a finish that is both up-tempo and thirst-quenching. The wine is crafted in an unadulterated style with no wood or malolactic fermentation, preserving a light-to-medium body characterized by its freshness, vibrant acidity, and balanced complexity.

title: Erath Pinot Noir Leland 2019
bodyHtml: This purple-hued beauty boasts yeasty and meaty aromas that mingle with Mission fig, lavender and a touch of toasted coffee bean. The silky-smooth palate is awash with pomegranate, dark cherry and black tea. The satiny texture persists through the even, refined finish.

title: White Rabbit Riesling 2022
bodyHtml: This is a light and fresh Riesling with slight herbal grassy notes on the nose and on the palate, there are flavours of sweet tropical fruits that are balanced perfectly with acidity. A perfect wine to enjoy on its own or with any light snack or meal.

title: Antinori Brunello di Montalcino 'Pian delle Vigne' 2019
bodyHtml:
Pian delle Vigne has adopted the philosophy of aging in large casks that preserve the exceptional integrity of the Sangiovese berry and impart the characteristic vibrant elegance of Brunello to the wine. Brunello Pian delle Vigne is an extraordinary expression with great finesse.

94 Points - James Suckling

Sweet black cherries with some blackberries, as well as cherry blossom in both the nose and palate.

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

A rich ruby color, the 2019 Brunello Di Montalcino is ripe and floral with aromas of sweet cherries, mocha, candied flowers, and mossy earth. Medium to full-bodied, it brings snappy fresh acidity along with ripe tannins, a clean finish, and a touch of smoky incense on the back palate.

93 Points - Vinous

The 2019 Brunello di Montalcino opens with a dark and brooding bouquet that mixes plum sauce with dark chocolate and espresso beans. This blends velvety textures with ripe red and black fruits all over a core of juicy acidity while maintaining a lifted and energetic feel. 

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Iron and sanguine aromas and flavors define this muscular red, while plum cherry, menthol and tar notes join in on the chewy and expansive finish. Balanced on the side of the tannins for now, with fine length.

title: Invivo X Sarah Jessica Parker Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: Juicy and incredibly drinkable, with ripe apricot, candied ginger, melon and aromatic citrus zest highlights on a fleshy frame. It features a hint of honeysuckle that lingers on the long, expressive finish.

title: Maison Chanzy Bourgogne Pinot Noir Les Fortunes 2023
bodyHtml: Maison Chanzy was founded by Daniel Chanzy in 1974 in Bouzeron, located in the northern part of the Côte Chalonnaise region of Burgundy. In 2013, a group of Burgundy wine lovers purchased Chanzy with a group of investors and have since added a second holding in Côte Chalonnaise and Côte de Beaune for a total of 163 acres planted. With full control of production from vineyard to bottling, Chanzy’s impressive range spans 40 appellations in 8 villages of Côte Chalonnaise and Côte d’Or. The vineyards are farmed sustainably.

title: Carmel Road Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: The Carmel Road winemaking team seeks to capture the vibrant and rich flavor profile of California - where the triumvirate of fog, wind, and sun forge distinctive wines with vivid complexity, superb structure, and pronounced flavours. This Cabernet Sauvignon has aromas of blackberry and sweet oak that lead to a rich, yet structured palate with flavours of black cherry, blueberry, and notes of vanilla bean.

title: Antoniolo Gattinara Osso San Grato Riserva 2019
bodyHtml: This Nebbiolo comes from 5 hectares in the Osso San Grato cru. The vines were planted in 1960 and enjoy southern exposure. The soils are volcanic and moranic, owing their composition to prehistoric glacial activity. After being delicately pressed they are left to ferment with a 14-16 day period of maceration on the skins. Maturation begins in medium capacity oak barrels for 30 months, finishing in the bottle for 1 year before release. Just over 400 cases are produced each year!

title: Luigi Bosca La Linda Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: La Linda Cabernet Sauvignon is a red wine of deep red colour with ruby highlights, expressive and balanced aromas, with fresh spiced vegetal notes. It is straightforward and mature on the palate, with fine and robust tannins that provide structure. This is a juicy, full-bodied and jammy wine with a lingering aftertaste. Its varietal character is clear, while its typicity is unmistakable.

title: Pata Negra Tempranillo 2018
bodyHtml: Rioja may be the most famous region in Spain, but Ribera del Duero is no slouch. These classic wines are made mostly from the grape Tempranillo. Ribera del Duero wines are known for being strong, sensual, dark coloured wines filled with dark fruit, tobacco and vanilla flavours.

title: Sandhill Syrah Terroir Driven 2021
bodyHtml: Purple garnet colour with a lovely bouquet of black cherry, leather, earth, spice box and oak. This is a dry, full-bodied wine with soft tannins and a juicy, smooth mouthfeel. Blackberry and black cherry fruit accented by coffee and spice fill the mouth. The extra-dry lingering finish shows notes of blackberry, black currant, black coffee and spice. Enjoy with peppercorn steaks;, braised meats or saucy barbecued ribs.

title: Florio Vecchioflorio Marsala 2020
bodyHtml: Amber coloured with old gold highlights. Extremely fine with scents of raisins, licorice, dates and vanilla. Warm and full palate, with an after-taste of ripe fruit and raisins.

title: Castello Romitorio Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
This prestigious red wine comes from Brunello di Montalcino DOCG in Tuscany. Castello Romitorio is a historic estate owned by artist Sandro Chia and managed by his son, Filippo. The estate is located in the cooler, high-altitude hills of northwestern Montalcino, a terroir known for producing Sangioveses with exceptional aromatic depth, vibrant acidity, and mineral tension. The 2020 vintage is particularly celebrated as a breakout success for the estate, standing out for its balance and elegance in a globally challenging year.

Wine Description

The Castello Romitorio Brunello di Montalcino 2020 presents a clear, deep ruby red color with light garnet reflections. The nose is vividly fresh and focused, offering a seductive bouquet of dried strawberries, marasca cherries, and violets, layered with complex hints of minty herbs, shaved cedar, and a subtle smokiness. On the palate, the wine is silky and graceful, showcasing ripe red berry fruits complicated by a tactile mineral core and refreshing acidity. The structure is defined by ultra-fine, chalky tannins that lead to a medium-long, spicy, and savory finish. This 100% Sangiovese ages in oak for approximately 24 months followed by additional refinement in the bottle. It possesses an alcohol by volume (ABV) of 14.5% and is best enjoyed within a drinking window of 2024 to 2045.

Accolades

This vintage has received exceptional praise, often cited as a standout for the region:

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 96 points (Called it the one "village" Brunello to buy from the vintage).

  • Wine Spectator - 95 points.

  • Vinous - 93 points.

Food Pairing

This powerful yet elegant Brunello is an ideal match for rich, savory dishes. It pairs beautifully with braised or grilled red meats, wild game, and truffle-infused pastas like mushroom tagliatelle. It also complements aged cheeses such as Pecorino Toscano. For the best experience, serve it at a temperature of 16-18°C (60-64°F) and consider decanting it for about an hour to allow the complex aromatics to fully unfold.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 vintage in Montalcino is described as energetic and aromatic. For winemakers, the lockdowns of the COVID-19 pandemic provided a unique opportunity to spend more time in the vineyards, leading to meticulous management. Despite the warm summer, the high-altitude, cool clay soils of the Romitorio estate helped preserve the freshness and bright fruit concentration that define this vintage. The resulting wines are noted for their seamless mouthfeel and accessible nature compared to more austere years.

title: Padre Azul Xiaman Mezcal
bodyHtml: Crafted with an art handed down by five generations, this wild agave blend mezcal is a gift from ancient times. Sweet, aromatic and smokey, authentic, yet elegant, Xiaman Mezcal will appeal to all your senses. 50% (takes about 25 years to mature) Wild Tepextate and 50% Espadín.

title: De Venoge Rose Brut Reserve (NV)
bodyHtml: The Réserve Rosé Brut Champagne of Winery De Venoge is a sparkling wine from the region of Champagne. This wine is a blend of Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Noir. In the mouth this sparkling wine is powerful with a nice vivacity and a fine and pleasant bubble. Will go well with pork, rich, salmon or shellfish.

title: Volcan Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: Volcan De Mi Tierra Blanco Tequila is produced by Master Distiller Anna Maria Romero Mena who uses a blend of Los Altos (Highland) and Tequila Valley (Lowlands) agave for the tequila. Meaning "Land of the Volcano", this tequila is a joint venture between Moët Hennessey and the Gallardo family.

title: Volcan Anejo Cristalino Tequila
bodyHtml:
Cristalino is a style of tequila that some distillers (including Volcan, of course) are pushing to be included as a new category of tequila.

It’s an anejo or extra anejo tequila (or in this case a blend of the two), which is then filtered, usually through charcoal, to remove some of the color that it’s picked up in the barrel. Charcoal filtering is also usually the way most distillers filter vodka or bourbon, or whiskey to purify and concentrate the flavours.

In the case of Volcan’s Cristalino, their anejo and extra anejo tequila are blended has been aged in ex-whiskey barrels and the extra anejo in former cognac barrels.

Volcan Cristalino unveils its best aromas sipped neat or savored chilled on the rock.

title: Boulder Peated Single Malt
bodyHtml: This whiskey is built as an introduction to peated malted barley. The Peated Malt is distilled using the same slow methods as our New American Single Malt but instead using lightly peated malted barley before resting in virgin American Oak barrels in Colorado's semi-arid environment for at least three years.

title: Domaine Masse Bourgogne Aligote 'Granit Vieilles Vignes' 2023
bodyHtml:
On the nose, it offers a range of delicious aromas of white fleshed fruit, white blossom, peach, lemon, linden, acacia, hazelnut, green apple and citrus. On the tongue, it is always remarkably fresh, with hints of saline and a fruity acidity that ensures good length.

Ideal as an al fresco aperitif in the garden, with lunch on the riverbank, to accompany a barbecue.

title: Cuero Viejo Cenzio Mezcal
bodyHtml: Mezcal Cuero Viejo cenizo is representative of the Nombre de Dios region, Durango. Made with wild ash Agave by the maestro mezcalero Francisco Camacho. It is a sweet mezcal for the connoisseur with rich smoky citrus aromas. Mezcal Cuero Viejo Cenizo is an interesting mezcal due to the combination of aromas that come from the raw material and the tools with which it is made. 48% alc./vol.

title: Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve Whisky
bodyHtml: This sensational Caribbean reserve single malt from Glenlivet will remind you of the Caribbean upon the first sniff. Pours amber with pear, apple, and banana tones. The inviting palate offers caramel, toffee, citrus, vanilla, and melon notes. It's medium-bodied and mildly sweet with a long finish. Savour solo after a meal! 40% ABV

title: Ollitas Cristalino
bodyHtml: Triple-distilled, 100% Blue Agave Ollitas Cristalino is a careful marriage of Ollitas Reposado with Añejo & Extra Añejo tequila aged in new and used American white oak barrels, which is then charcoal-filtered resulting in a gleaming crystal clear colour and extraordinarily smooth finish. Fresh, delicate agave aromas on the nose. Soft but flavourful on the palate with cooked agave, citrus and vanilla notes, along with mild hints of herbaceousness and black pepper hearkening back to the blanco tequila at its base. Great for enjoying neat or on the rocks. 40% ABV.

title: Gift Card
bodyHtml:
Shopping for someone else but not sure what to give them? Give them the gift of choice with a ZYN gift card.

Gift cards are delivered by email and contain instructions to redeem them at checkout. Our gift cards have no additional processing fees.

title: Rey Campero Cuishe Mezcal
bodyHtml: Rey Campero is produced in the community of Candelaria Yegolé, Oaxaca by mezcalero Rómulo Sánchez Parada, who is committed to agave conservation with sustainable practices. The cuishe is matured 8-10 years before harvesting for this mezcal and roasted for 4-5 days. The cooked agave then rests for 5 days before being crushed by mule-pulled tahona. Fermentation occurs in the open air with wild yeast. Then it is double-distilled in a copper pot still and bottled without aging. 48.5% alc./vol

title: Rey Campero Tobala Mezcal
bodyHtml: Not often featured in the Rey Campero lineup, this is a special release of the highly coveted Tobala agave variety. Growing in the shade at high elevation, the small size and low sugar content of Tobala make it a complex variety to produce much mezcal with. A delicious and juicy iteration of the spirit, Romulo's Tobala is plush with salty notes of grilled pineapple, strawberries and lime zest. 48.5% alc./vol.

title: Rey Campero Tepeztate Mezcal
bodyHtml: Sweet and ripe on the palate, the fruity characteristics shine with tropical and berry notes. Artichoke and other vegetal flavours persist on the mid-palate before shifting to an ethereal white pepper finish. This begs for spicy and salty food pairings.

title: Rey Campero Madre Cuishe Mezcal
bodyHtml: Madre Cuishe is 100% agave karwinskii (growing at a range of 2,500-6,000 feet) roasted in earthen pits, stone-ground, fermented with the aid of natural yeasts in wood casks and double-distilled in a copper alembic. The Rey Campero line is produced primarily of wild agaves harvested and distilled in Candelaria Yegolé, Oaxaca by master mezcalero Rómulo Sánchez Parada. 48.9% alc./vol.

title: Rey Campero Espadin Mezcal
bodyHtml: The Espadin Mezcal from Rey Campero blossoms in a bouquet of green herbs on the palate with big notes of oregano and coriander. 48.4% alc./vol

title: Rey Campero Jabali Mezcal
bodyHtml: Jabalí is 100% agave Convallis harvested from craggy rocks and cliffs that is difficult to distill. The harvested agaves are roasted in earthen pits, stone ground, fermented with the aid of natural yeasts in wood casks and in a copper alembic still. Master Mezcalero Rómulo Sánchez Parada produces the Rey Campero line which is produced primarily of wild agaves harvested and distilled in Candelaria Yegolé, Oaxaca. 48.6% alc./vol.

title: Rey Campero Sierra Negra Mezcal
bodyHtml: Maguey Sierra Negra, is a maguey that is located in the state of Oaxaca, it is cultivated and difficult to reproduce; It takes between 15, 18 or more years to mature depending on the region and climate where it grows, it is one of the largest agaves in size and weight. 49.2% alc./vol.

title: Rey Campero Mexicano Mezcal
bodyHtml: Rey Campero Mexicano is produced from 100% Agave Rhodacantha harvested at high altitudes in pine and oak forests. The agaves are roasted in earthen ovens, ground in mule-powered stone mills, fermented in wooden casks and double-distilled in a copper alembic still. 48.5% alc./vol.

title: Moet & Chandon Brut Imperial - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Moët Impérial is the House’s iconic champagne. Created in 1869, it embodies Moët & Chandon’s unique style, a style distinguished by its bright fruitiness, its seductive palate and its elegant maturity.

The delicious sumptuousness of white-fleshed fruits (pear, peach, apple) is on the palate. The alluring caress of fine bubbles. The soft vivacity of citrus fruit and nuances of gooseberry.

title: Domaine de la Navarre Sacrifice Rose 2021
bodyHtml: Its nose of white fruits evolves towards notes of citrus and pepper. Its lively and fresh palate underlined by a spicy character has a beautiful length on aromas of citrus and peaches with a touch of grapefruit peel for depth.

title: Mionetto Prestige Prosecco Rose DOC 2021
bodyHtml:
This Extra Dry Millesimato Prosecco is obtained through soft pressing of the Glera and Pinot Nero grapes which have been left in contact with the skins to macerate for several days to give this Rosé its pale pink hue. Secondary fermentation (Charmat method) in temperature-controlled stainless steel for a prolonged maturation of 60 days gives it its honey and bread crust aromas.

Fruity bouquet with evident notes of honey, berries and citrus. Well-balanced acidity with refreshing notes of red berries and grapefruit with elegant fine bubbles.

title: 19 Crimes Snoop Dogg Cali Red
bodyHtml: 19 Crimes wines are defiant by nature, bold and always uncompromising, just like the D-O-double-G! Cali Red was created as a collaboration with entertainment icon Snoop Dogg, who embodies all these qualities, and more, through hard work and perseverance. Snoop Dogg is a culture creator, innovator, and leader in pop culture. This red blend exhibits bold and uncompromising dark berry fruit, spice and toasted oak tones, with a powerful yet smooth finish. Pair with everything BBQ'd!

title: Vincent Latour Saint Aubin 'Cuvee Thomas' 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine Vincent Latour is a small, family-run estate based in Meursault, Burgundy, with deep roots in the Côte de Beaune. Since taking over from his father in 1998, Vincent Latour has gained recognition for his meticulous vineyard work and his restrained, terroir-expressive winemaking style. The estate is known for crafting elegant, mineral-driven white Burgundies that reflect their climats with clarity and finesse.

Wine Description

The 'Cuvee Thomas' Saint Aubin 2022 displays a luminous pale gold hue with green reflections. On the nose, it opens with vibrant aromas of citrus blossom, fresh pear, crushed limestone, and a hint of toasted hazelnut. The palate is crisp and linear, showing precise acidity and a medium body, layered with notes of lemon zest, white peach, and wet stone. There is an elegant tension throughout, culminating in a long, saline finish that showcases the village's chalky soils. Crafted entirely from Chardonnay, this cuvée reflects the hallmark freshness and purity of Saint Aubin whites. Best enjoyed now through 2029.

Food Pairing

Ideal with dishes that echo its mineral and citrus notes, such as seared scallops with lemon butter, roast chicken with herbes de Provence, or a goat cheese and arugula salad. A perfect match to enhance the wine’s complexity.

title: John Walker & Sons King George V
bodyHtml:
John Walker & Sons King George V commemorates the granting of the Royal Warrant on 1 January 1934.

It is created using only the finest whiskies from distilleries that were operating during George’s twenty-five-year reign (1910 – 1936), some of which, like the famed Port Ellen, no longer exist. They are blended together to reflect the distinctive Johnnie Walker style of the era.

title: Old Forester 1870 Original Batch
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Old Forester 1870 Original Batch was the first release in the Old Forester Whiskey Row series that was first released back in 2015. This expression is a tribute to the year when George Garvin created the Old Forester brand in Louisville's famous Whiskey Row by batching barrels from three different distilleries to create a consistent, quality product.

title: Antinori Castello 'Bramito' Della Sala Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This elegant Chardonnay hails from Italy, specifically from Umbria’s Orvieto area within the Castello della Sala estate near the village of Ficulle. Castello della Sala, owned by the Marchesi Antinori family since 1940, is renowned for producing some of Italy’s finest white wines. The estate reflects Antinori’s centuries-old commitment to marrying tradition with innovation, showcasing meticulous vineyard practices and a dedication to expressing terroir.

Wine Description

Bramito is a luminous straw-yellow wine with greenish highlights. On the nose, it reveals layered aromas of crisp apple, ripe pear, and subtle notes of citrus blossom, accented by hints of vanilla and light toast from partial barrel aging. The palate is vibrant and fresh, balancing a creamy texture with bright acidity, offering flavours of white peach, Meyer lemon, and a delicate minerality that speaks of the volcanic soils of Umbria. Medium-bodied, it finishes with elegance and a lingering sensation of citrus zest.

Food Pairing

Try pairing this Chardonnay with grilled chicken in a lemon-herb sauce, creamy risotto with asparagus, or seared scallops. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character, drawing out its freshness and gentle oak nuances.

title: Domaine Ramonet Macon Peronne 2019
bodyHtml: One of the Macon villages, Peronne is located between Pouilly-Fuisse and Saint-Veran appellations to the south and Vire-Clesse to the east. Jean-Claude Ramonet is one of the legacy producers in Burgundy - famously Pierre Ramonet’s 1934 Chassagne-Montrachet Premier Cru Ruchottes was the first estate-bottled white Burgundy imported into the United States.

title: Frapin VSOP
bodyHtml: Produced exclusively from the wine-making estate at the heart of Cognac’s Premier Cru, this VSOP benefits from the age-old traditional expertise of the Frapin family. Harvested, distilled over lees and aged on the Domaine, it writes a new chapter of its history with a new decanter bringing elegance, refinement and roundness.

title: Spinelli Pinot Grigio 2021
bodyHtml:
General Information

Cantina Spinelli produces DOC and IGT Abruzzo wines. Rural tradition has it that grapes should be crushed with bare feet. They keep the tradition alive in their love and respect of their land and its products. 

Colour ... Soft straw yellow colour.

Aroma ... Delicate, characteristic fruity nose with floral notes and hints of melon and lemon.

Flavour ... Fresh, pleasant, harmonic palate.

Food Pairing ... All seafood, but also delicate meat dishes and starters. An excellent aperitif.

title: Trapiche Pinot Grigio 'Varietals' 2024
bodyHtml: Straw yellow in colour, this wine exhibits intense citrus aromas. Fruity and mild in the palate with a balanced acidity that highlights the freshness. Elegant and mineral finish. Enjoy with Mediterranean food, white cold meats and seafood.

title: Nonino Il Moscato Grappa
bodyHtml:
Grappa is the oldest and most traditional spirit in the North of Italy and is obtained by distilling the solid part of the grape: the marc. On the 1st of December 1973, Benito and Giannola Nonino created the first single varietal Grappa, Monovitigno Nonino, by distilling the marcs of Picolit grapes, thus revolutionizing grappa's production method, promotion and bottling, not just in Italy but around the world. This spirit has been so successful over the years that other Italian and foreign distilleries follow Nonino's model.

Grappa Nonino Il Moscato is made from the marc of Muscat grapes, collected when it is soft and fresh. It ferments in stainless steel tanks under vacuum at a controlled temperature. It is distilled in traditional steam stills and aged for six months to a year in stainless steel tanks.

title: Oban Distillers Edition
bodyHtml:
Oban Distillers Edition is a single malt Scotch whisky from the Oban Distillery, located in the coastal town of Oban, Scotland. Established in 1794, the distillery is renowned for producing whiskies that bridge the gap between the Highland and Island styles. The Distillers Edition is a special release that undergoes a unique double maturation process, enhancing its complexity and depth.

Production Process

  • Double Maturation: After an initial aging period, the whisky is finished in Montilla Fino sherry casks, imparting distinctive dry and nutty characteristics.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Golden honey hue.
  • Nose: Inviting aromas of honey, raisin, and cinnamon, with subtle hints of green apple.
  • Palate: Flavors of honey, raisin, and cinnamon dominate, complemented by notes of green apple and a touch of spice.
  • Finish: Smooth and long-lasting, with a rich oily mouthfeel, leaving impressions of dark fruits, buttery caramel, brown sugar, oak, and a lingering pepper spice.

Alcohol Content

Bottled at 43% ABV (86 proof).

Accolades

The Oban Distillers Edition has been praised for its harmonious balance and depth, making it a favorite among whisky enthusiasts.

Serving Suggestions

  • Neat: Enjoying it straight allows the intricate flavors to shine.
  • With Water: Adding a few drops of water can open up additional aromatic layers.

title: Hine Rare Original Cognac
bodyHtml:
Hine Rare VSOP Cognac is an exceptional spirit originating from the prestigious Cognac region in France. Crafted by the esteemed House of Hine, this VSOP expression reflects the mastery and dedication to quality that defines their cognacs.

Hine Rare VSOP Cognac delights the palate with its refined flavours and inviting tasting profile. It showcases enticing notes of ripe fruits, including apricots and peaches, complemented by hints of honey and floral undertones. The cognac's maturation in French oak barrels lends it a velvety texture and a subtle complexity.

Critics have acclaimed Hine Rare VSOP Cognac for its exceptional craftsmanship. Wine Enthusiast describes it as "a shining example of a superb VSOP, with a vibrant and harmonious flavour profile." The Spirits Business commends it for being "elegant and beautifully balanced, showcasing the finesse and expertise of the House of Hine."

Hine Rare VSOP Cognac stands as a testament to the House of Hine's heritage and commitment to producing exquisite cognacs. It offers a sophisticated and memorable experience, making it a choice selection for those seeking a refined and flavourful cognac journey.

title: Spinelli Montepulciano D'Abruzzo 2024
bodyHtml:
The Spinelli winery, launched in 1973 by Vincenzo Spinelli, has seen steady and dramatic growth in its 49-year history. Located in Abruzzo, almost directly east of Rome near Italy’s east coast, the winery has seen more and more family members join the fold through the years. Today, Vincenzo’s sons, Carlo and Adriano, manage the business and its production of about 580,000 cases of wine per year.

Montepulciano is the key red grape of Abruzzo. It produces approachable and plucky wines with plenty of fruit. Deep ruby in colour, this version entices with flavours of cherry, strawberry and red licorice, plus notes of cedar, vanilla, raspberry and a hint of all-spice. It’s juicy and lively, with ripe tannins and enough acidity to nicely balance the touch of sweetness. A great weekday wine.

title: Capensis Chardonnay 2020
bodyHtml: The ancient soils, dramatic landscapes and historic vineyards of Stellenbosch, Overberg and Robertson are the foundation for this Chardonnay, which honours the greatness of South Africa. Winemaker Graham Weerts has carefully selected the finest Chardonnay vineyards within the Western Cape to create this expressive wine.

title: Togouchi Pure Malt Japanese Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Togouchi Pure Malt is a blended malt whisky produced by the Sakurao Brewery and Distillery (formerly Chugoku Jozo) in the Hiroshima Prefecture. A unique aspect of Togouchi's production is its maturation process; while the distillery is located near the Seto Inland Sea, the whisky is aged in a decommissioned railway tunnel in the mountains of Akiota. This tunnel maintains a constant temperature of 14°C and a humidity of 80% year-round, providing an ideal environment for slow, consistent maturation. As a pure malt, this expression is a blend of various malt whiskies that have been married together to achieve a specific house style.

Whisky Description

This whisky presents a bright golden appearance. The nose is clean and fresh, offering aromas of vanilla, chocolate, and a faint hint of ripe apricot. On the palate, the body is light to medium, delivering a gentle sweetness characterized by notes of butterscotch, honey, and cereal grains. The influence of the oak is subtle, providing a soft nutty background and a delicate peppery spice. The finish is short to medium in length, ending with a refreshing crispness and a lingering touch of sweet malt. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Redwood Empire Emerald Giant Rye
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Emerald Giant is a 3+-year-old 90-proof rye whiskey with a mash bill of 95% rye and 5% malt barley.

Colour... Amber.

Nose .. The nose hits with the classic rye notes but a refreshing apple crisp note. Subtle notes of sweet brown sugar also come through on the nose.

Palate... The front of the palate is coated with a unique rye spice which is quickly replaced with a creamy mouthfeel and a crisp citrus note. On the third sip came notes of delicious rye spice and honey, and cinnamon.

Finish... The finish was a crisp apple note that hit the top of the mouth and the edge of the palate. It was on the shorter side but evolved as you sipped.

In Closing... Let this one sit in the glass for a few minutes. You will be surprised by the number of flavours that come out. This will make a great cocktail rye whiskey, but it can stand by itself.

title: Redwood Empire Lost Monarch Rye / Bourbon Blend
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Lost Monarch is a blend of bourbon and rye, aged for no less than 3 years. The blend is 60% rye whiskey (95% rye, 5% malted barley which was aged between 3-5 years) and 40% bourbon whiskey (75% corn, 21% raw rye and 4% malted barley that was aged between 5-12 years). Redwood Empire included some of their own distillate in the mix, which is why the age statement is fairly low. This expression is named after the world's largest coast redwood by volume, standing at 320 feet tall and 26 feet in diameter. 

Colour... Yellow gold.

Nose... The first thing you will notice on the nose is a faint scent of corn. This obviously comes from the bourbon in the blend. You will also pick up on beautiful notes of orange curaçao creme brûlée, vanilla, darker baking spices and a hint of rye spice. Very complex and rich.

Palate... The palate is medium-bodied, with a very nice corn and vanilla sweetness up front in combination with very light notes of orange. The spice from the rye becomes noticeable on the mid-palate, as well as notes of caramel, vanilla and light syrup. For being such a high rye blend, the bourbon is far more prominent and it is not very spicy. Great complexity and depth.

Finish... The finish is medium-long and filled with rich, sweet flavours of caramel, vanilla, syrup and a hint of spice. The sweet notes coat the entire palate and stick there for a good while.

In Closing... This was fantastic!

title: Elk Cove Pinot Gris 2024
bodyHtml:
This Pinot Gris is hand-harvested from select hillside vineyards in the northern Willamette Valley. Pinot Gris has long been a focus at Elk Cove. Their Estate Vineyard boasts some of the oldest Pinot Gris vines in Oregon, dating back to 1985. Three of their estate vineyard sites are also planted with Pinot Gris, including 50 acres on steep sloped Mount Richmond Vineyard in the Yamhill-Carlton AVA. Planted in a high-density format, all our Pinot Gris undergoes shoot and crop thinning for low yields to maximize quality and concentration.

With ripe pear, honey and citrus on the nose, this wine opens lush and juicy with white peach, lemon curd and honeydew melon leading to an elegant finish of lemongrass and slate.

title: Daydreamer Amelia 2022
bodyHtml: This wine is a co-fermentation of Syrah and Viognier. It has aromas of violets, peppercorns, prosciutto and blackberries. It spent 11 months in predominately older French barriques allowing the spicy, high toned and savoury qualities to shine.

title: Biggar and Leith Starlino Arancione Aperitivo
bodyHtml: Biggar and Leith Starlino Arancione Aperitivo, hailing from Italy, is a delightful addition to the aperitivo scene. Handcrafted with precision, this vibrant spirit is produced by Biggar and Leith, an esteemed spirits company. Made using a blend of bitter oranges, Sicilian bergamot, and other botanicals, Starlino Arancione offers a refreshing and zesty flavour profile with a delightful balance of sweetness and bitterness. Its notes of citrus and herbs make it a perfect choice for aperitivo cocktails. Critics praise Starlino Arancione for its complexity, smoothness, and versatility, making it a must-have for those seeking a unique and satisfying aperitivo experience.

title: Laphroaig 10 Year Old Sherry Oak
bodyHtml: Laphroaig is excited to announce the launch of Laphroaig's 10-Year-Old Sherry Oak Finish. The unique expression combines the unforgettable flavour of the Laphroaig Distillery's iconic 10-year-old whisky with the sweet, aromatic flavour from Oloroso Sherry casks. The marriage of casks creates a rich, full-bodied flavour with notes of Manuka honey, bacon, and maple syrup alongside the classic smoke, seaweed, and hint of salt that Laphroaig is best known and loved for.

title: Jane Eyre Gevrey Chambertin 2020
bodyHtml: Firm and fresh with floral raspberry fruit and a touch of herbiness. Supple and pure with appealing raspberry and cherry fruit on the palate, showing precision and elegance. Dense with nice focus, and this has a stern side, too.

title: Gran Orendain Extra Anejo 7 Year Old
bodyHtml: The pinnacle of the Gran Orendain range, this seven-year-old extra Anejo brings together all of the family's experience and expertise, built since opening their Tequila distillery in 1926. The agave piña is cooked in traditional masonry ovens, fermented with the Orendain yeast, triple distilled and then aged for seven years in French white oak casks. The result is rich and complex, with a careful balance of sweet and savoury agave notes. Aged in French oak barrels for 84 months or more, bottled at 40% alc./vol in a French decanter, and placed in a commemorative gift box. Intense flavours and aromas of cooked agave, maple, and vanilla, with wood and herbal nuances, a considerable mouthfeel, and a long, beautiful finish.

title: Teremana Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Teremana Reposado Tequila is a premium small-batch Mexican spirit produced in the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. Co-founded in 2020 by global icon Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson alongside Dany Garcia, Jenna Fagnan, and Ken Austin, the brand operates under a strategic partnership with Mast-Jägermeister SE. Distilled at Destilería Teremana de Agave (NOM 1613) in Jesús María, the spirit focuses on sustainable, small-batch crafting methods designed to honor traditional tequila-making.

Spirit Description

Teremana Reposado is crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves harvested at peak maturity in the mineral-rich red soil of the Jalisco Highlands. The agaves are slow-roasted in traditional brick ovens for 3 days before being crushed using an open-air roller mill. After open-air fermentation in small tank batches, the liquid is double-distilled in handmade copper pot stills designed by local artisans. The spirit matures in ex-bourbon American white oak barrels to achieve a balance between sweet oak and bright agave.

  • Colour: Light gold with luminous pale straw highlights.

  • Aroma: Inviting and aromatic, opening with sweet cooked agave, warm vanilla bean, and light oak, complemented by subtle hints of lemongrass, citrus zest, and brown sugar.

  • Palate: Smooth, rich, and well-rounded on the entry. Upfront flavors of roasted agave, vanilla custard, and light caramel yield to notes of toasted oak, tropical fruit sweetness, and gentle baking spices.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a soft, clean, and velvety texture that coats the palate cleanly.

  • Finish: Crisp, medium-to-long, and warming, closing with trailing notes of sweet vanilla, soft oak spice, and a touch of light pepper.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Domaine Latour Giraud Meursault 'Genevrieres' Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
Domaine Latour Giraud Meursault Genevrieres Premier Cru 2023 originates from France, within the Burgundy region and the Côte de Beaune subregion. Nestled in the heart of Meursault, the estate represents an iconic family property celebrated for achieving a perfect alliance between tradition and modernity. Under the precise direction of winemaker Jean-Pierre Latour, the estate follows a winemaking philosophy focused on crafting full-throttle, classically styled white Burgundies that display a remarkable finesse and purity.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a bright mid-yellow appearance in the glass and possesses a medium-to-full body with a broad-shouldered structure. The sensory profile is exceptionally complex and multi-layered, opening with a naturally exotic and succulent nose of jasmine tea, gardenia, delicate fresh apples, and smoked apple, complemented by citrus nuances of lime and verbena blossom. On the super-sleek and strikingly textured palate, it delivers deep flavours of pear, lemon, and quince, layered with a fine-boned framework of ginger spice, precise acidity, and a notable concentration. The finish is remarkably long, bone-dry, and persistent, exuding an appealing, lively bead of minerality and a lightly austere character.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its structural harmony and impeccable balance, exhibiting an intelligent use of integrated oak that supports the rich, tactile fruit without introducing an overwhelming wood effect.

  • ABV: 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the domain manages its premier crus with meticulous care to protect the health and transparency of the site, this bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The immense concentration, rich texture, and vibrant mineral drive of this Premier Cru make it a masterful match for rich, full-bodied gastronomy.

  • Poultry: Pairs phenomenally well with classic roasted chicken, roasted turkey, or rich poultry prepared in a cream sauce with mushrooms.

  • Seafood: Suggested pairings include decadent dishes such as lobster or crab served with drawn butter, as well as poached salmon.

  • Savoury: Matches gracefully with a premium wild mushroom risotto or rich foie gras, which beautifully mirror the wine's textured breadth.

  • Cheese: Complements a fine selection of mild, soft cheeses.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 Burgundy vintage is highly regarded, with growing conditions yielding grapes of exceptional fruit purity and structural depth. A relatively benign winter rolled into a tumultuous spring that fluctuated between unseasonably warm and chilly periods, which demanded careful management in the vineyards. The winemaker's skill in navigating these climatic shifts and picking at perfect ripeness allowed the fruit to achieve its optimal potential, resulting in a beautifully crafted Genevrieres release with a tightly wound core and an extensive cellaring capacity up to 2037.

title: Umani Ronchi Pecorino 2025
bodyHtml:
Umani Ronchi is a family-owned estate founded in 1957, with vineyards stretching across Marche and Abruzzo. Now led by the Bernetti family, the winery is renowned for its focus on indigenous grapes and sustainable farming practices, playing a key role in reviving native varietals such as Pecorino.

Wine Description
This Pecorino presents a pale straw-yellow colour with greenish reflections. The nose opens with fragrant notes of citrus, stone fruit, and white flowers, layered with hints of herbs and almond. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, fresh, and vibrant, showing flavours of lemon zest, pear, and peach, with a saline mineral edge and creamy texture from lees ageing. The finish is long and balanced, leaving a subtle nutty and mineral impression.

Food Pairing
Ideal with seafood pasta, shellfish, and grilled white fish, as well as light vegetable dishes and fresh cheeses.

title: Louis Jadot Beaune 'Les Boucherottes' Premier Cru 2018
bodyHtml: Beaune vineyards are the most extensive of the Côte de Beaune, between Savigny to the North, and Pommard to the South. There are no Grands Crus vineyards in this commune, but 42 Premiers Crus. 'Les Boucherottes' vineyard lies at the southern end of the commune, partially bordering Pommard and covering approximately 21 acres.  In 'Boucherottes', the deep soil adds a lush quality to the wine.  The grapes, characterized by very black berries, are destemmed and vinified in open vats for about 4 weeks, thus fully revealing all the subtlety of this terroir. After devatting, the wines are barreled in oak barrels in our cellars, and aged for 18 months.

title: Giusti Valpolicella Ripasso Superiore 2019
bodyHtml:
Ermenegildo Giusti is a staunch supporter of vine growing that respects both the environment and the beautiful surrounding countryside. These qualities are conveyed in every glass of Giusti wines.

Colour: Ruby red, tending to garnet with aging.

Bouquet: Intense with hints of spice and red fruit.

Taste: Velvety and full-bodied with soft tannins and elegant.
