Serving Suggestions: Excellent with first courses, roasts and red meats.

title: Spottswoode Lyndenhurst Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: Fresh notes of crushed bramble, cassis, and red cherries underpin subtle aromas of lavender, cedar, and spruce. Mineral nuances of wet slate add structure, while the tannins remain silky and supple despite the wine’s youth. A beautiful wine to be enjoyed now and for years to come.

title: Campbell Kind Wine Syrah 2018
bodyHtml:
General Information

An absolutely stunning value, this delivers complex suggestions of dark cherry, date, fig, tilled earth and a sprinkling of cracked pepper. Fine tannins, spicy fruit, a touch of prickly heat and a chewy finish. Nice elegance and restraint, especially given the boldness of the flavours. At its peak now through 2024, this will go well with beef-and-eggplant lasagna or freshly made cheeseburgers. Carbon-zero certified.

title: Billecart Salmon Brut Rose - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
This iconic and elegant sparkling wine originates from the Champagne region of France, produced by the independent house of Billecart Salmon in Mareuil sur Ay. Founded in 1818 by the marriage of Nicolas François Billecart and Elisabeth Salmon, the house has remained family-owned for seven generations. The winery's philosophy is defined by "finesse, balance, and elegance," achieved through a signature cold fermentation technique (pioneered in the 1950s) that preserves the fresh, ethereal fruit aromas of the grapes.

Wine Description

The Billecart Salmon Brut Rosé presents a pale, radiant pink colour with warm gold glints and a slow, delicate stream of bubbles. The sensory profile is remarkably precise, featuring an aromatic bouquet of red berries (raspberries and wild strawberries) and citrus zest. On the palate, the wine is light and elegant, showcasing a refreshing acidity and a creamy texture that carries flavours of fresh fruit and subtle floral notes. It is characterized by its "ethereal" nature and a clean, persistent finish. This blend typically consists of Chardonnay, Pinot Meunier, and Pinot Noir (vinified as white), with approximately 7% Pinot Noir vinified as red wine from old vines to provide its signature hue and structure. It has an ABV of 12% and a dosage of 9 g/L.

title: Menage A Trois Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: This full-flavoured Cabernet Sauvignon has forward aromas and flavours of ripe plum, chocolate and vanilla, followed by cedar and spice. The wine is full-bodied and smooth with a long, luscious finish. Enjoy with a bacon-wrapped barbecued steak and French fries or pizza with your favourite toppings.

title: Spier Pinotage Signature 2025
bodyHtml:
Classic South African Pinotage with a medium weight and a nicely rounded body.

Pinotage is South Africa's home grown grape variety and, in good hands like here, makes excellent wines. After fermentation in stainless steel 20% of the wine was matured in French oak barrels for 8 to 10 months with the remainder in stainless steel. The result is a wine with generous flavours reminiscent of sweet cherries and summer berries. There's a touch of smoke and smooth spice held together with attractively smooth tannins which lead to nicely long finish.

An easy going Pinotage, but with enough oomph to pair well with pork, lamb chops, or burgers from the barbie.

title: Veuve Clicquot La Grande Dame Rose 2015
bodyHtml: Intense colour with copper glints. Very small, sparkling bubbles. The initial nose reveals a saline, mineral background, then notes of red fruits, Morello cherry, wild strawberry, redcurrant and some more toasted notes of hazelnut, cocoa bean and sweet spices. When agitated, these characteristics are accentuated, while the aromatic complexity of the great Pinot Noirs is ever-present. In the mouth, it is plump and full of substance. The texture is crisp and silky. The tannins are still present, calling for a cuisine with texture to bring out the best in this wine. The finish is long and coats the palate. The tannins are already very well integrated and can be expected to blend in still further over the coming years.

title: Zonin Prosecco Rose Brut (NV)
bodyHtml:
Zonin is one of the most acknowledged and distinguished Italian wine brand both at national and international stage, thanks to the passion and commitment that seven generations of the Zonin Family have dedicated to vine growing and wine making. The Zonin Family has maintained a strong link with its roots in the land and vineyards on the hills of Gambellara, a small village in the heart of Veneto Region, between Venice and Verona, where vines have grown for centuries and where Zonin produces a selected range of still and sparkling wines from the most prestigious appellations, DOC and DOCG, of this territory, including Prosecco.

Thanks to its distinctive style, today Zonin Prosecco is one of the leading brands in its category.

A lightly-coloured sparkling Rosé with a fine and seductively delicate perlage. Pleasant, intense and fruity, evoking memories of wisteria flowers and Renetta apples. Well blended and delightful. On the palate it is soft and smooth with floral notes and a hint of almond.

title: Penfolds Bin 169 Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml: Created to reflect Penfolds contemporary wine-making approach, emphasizing both regionality and maturation of cabernet sauvignon in fine-grained French oak. A style that is immediately Penfolds, whilst simultaneously illustrative of its ongoing search for diversity and style separation. An honest reflection of the region bearing testament of Penfolds longstanding commitment to the vineyards of Coonawarra.

title: Telmo Rodriguez 'Corriente' 2022
bodyHtml:
Telmo Rodriguez 'Corriente' originates from Spain, specifically from the village of Lanciego within the Rioja Alavesa subregion of Rioja. The wine's name is a tribute to an unofficial early 20th-century classification where 'Corriente' (common) referred to approachable, everyday village wines, as opposed to the more formal 'Selecto' styles. Co-owned by winemaker Telmo Rodriguez and Pablo Eguzkiza, Compañía de Vinos Telmo Rodríguez was founded in the mid-1990s with a mission to recover forgotten vineyards and work exclusively with native varieties. Their philosophy embraces a return to ancestral 18th-century winemaking traditions, focusing on terroir-driven wines that authentically reflect their regional culture.

Wine Description

This red blend typically presents a vibrant cherry-red or purple-red hue. The sensory profile is fresh and aromatic, featuring a nose of ripe cherries, strawberries, and blackberries, often accented by notes of wild herbs, sweet spices, vanilla, and a subtle peppery undertone. On the medium-bodied palate, it is light, fleshy, and well-concentrated, delivering juicy red and black fruit flavours balanced by refreshing acidity and firm, fine-grained tannins. The finish is persistent and pleasant, often showing mineral, floral, or slightly balsamic hints.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional Rioja blend predominately featuring Tempranillo (often around 70%), supplemented by Graciano and Garnacha.

  • ABV: Recorded at 14%.

  • Organic Status: The wine is organically produced from estate vineyards and long-term partners, utilizing manual harvesting and indigenous yeast fermentation.

  • Ageing: Unlike the winery's 'LZ' label, 'Corriente' is aged for approximately one year in a mixture of concrete tanks, oak barrels, and foudres of various ages.

Food Pairing

The fresh acidity and balanced tannins of 'Corriente' make it a versatile partner for a wide range of savoury dishes. Suggested pairings include:

  • Meats: Grilled lamb, beef steak with herb butter, roast beef, and slow-braised brisket.

  • Savoury Fare: Charcuterie, cured meats, and sautéed mushrooms with garlic.

  • Global Cuisine: Flank steak with cumin and peppercorn, Greek pastitsio, Mexican-style chicken, or Indian tandoori lamb.

  • Cheeses: Aged Comté, matured Manchego, or British Cheddar.

title: Domaine du Pegau Chateaneuf du Pape Cuvee Reserve 2023
bodyHtml: The flagship of the Domaine du Pegau, the Cuvée Réservée represents the Domaine over the years. A blend of 13 grape varieties, mainly Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre, the Cuvée Réservée reveals the typical characteristics of the Châteauneuf-du-Pape soils

title: Rocca di Montemassi 'Le Focaie' 2017
bodyHtml: Intense ruby red, with violet shadings. Intense and full, the flavor offers pleasant scents of violets, cherries and wild berries. Good structure with a fresh, soft, and persistent finish. A harmonious wine that accompanies preserved meats of the Tuscan tradition, savory introductory dishes, grilled red meats and moderately aged pecorino cheeses.

title: Edetaria Via Terra Blanco 2021
bodyHtml:
This wine is made from Garnacha Blanca from their vineyards located in la Plana de Gandesa. It is a combination of two harvests ... an earlier harvest provides all the freshness and fruit flavours, and a second harvest, about two weeks later, which provides Grenache structure to the wine. After fermentation assemblage is made and wine is aged on its own natural lees thereby obtaining delicacy and fineness.

Aromas of fresh fruit, pear and melon. Powerful entry, along with overwhelming fruit, lush with a citrus finish granting persistence to the wine.

title: Edetaria Via Terra Red 2024
bodyHtml:
This expressive red wine hails from the Terra Alta region in Catalonia, Spain. Edetària is the personal project of winemaker Joan Àngel Lliberia, who founded the winery in 2003 with a focus on expressing the unique terroir of his family’s ancestral vineyards through native grape varieties. The estate’s philosophy centers on sustainable, organic farming and precise, plot-by-plot vinification to capture the authentic character of the Gandesa plain.

Wine Description

The Edetaria Via Terra Red is an intense ruby red with youthful violet hues. On the nose, it offers a vibrant bouquet of fresh-picked garden strawberries, raspberries, and morello cherries, accented by subtle hints of rose petal and wild grass. This medium-bodied wine is crafted from 100% Garnacha Tinta (Red Grenache) and features a palate stuffed with plummy red fruit flavours and sweet, integrated tannins. The finish is refreshing and long, marked by a delicate spicy note and a hint of chili-pepper.

title: Biggar and Leith Starlino Rose Aperitivo
bodyHtml:
General Information

Starlino Rosé is a delightful and refreshing Aperitivo made by blending Rosé wine, spirit, pink grapefruit peel, orange peel and 8 other botanicals including Wormwood and Coriander. Delicious served over ice with a premium tonic or sparkling water and delicious as a Spritz!

title: Miraval Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This iconic rosé originates from France, specifically from the Côtes de Provence appellation in the heart of Provence. Located in the village of Correns, the historic Château Miraval estate covers approximately 600 hectares and was famously purchased by Hollywood stars Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie in 2011. The winemaking is expertly overseen by the famille Perrin, one of the Rhône Valley’s most prestigious wine families, who apply the same standards and environmental respect used for their legendary Château de Beaucastel. The winery's philosophy is rooted in organic viticulture and agroecology, utilizing certified organic practices and natural biodiversity to preserve the unique character of the Mediterranean terroir.

Wine Description

The Miraval Rose presents an elegant, clear pale rose gold colour with vibrant silver highlights. The nose is intense and refined, revealing a superb aromatic bouquet of fresh peaches, hibiscus, and amaryllis, alongside notes of freshly cut currants and spring roses. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and fleshy with a silky texture, offering gourmet flavours of crunchy fruit and citrus peel.

title: Moet & Chandon Rose Imperial
bodyHtml:
Rosé Impérial is a spontaneous, radiant, romantic expression of the Moët & Chandon style, a style distinguished by its bright fruitiness, its seductive palate and its elegant maturity.

The assemblage reflects the diversity and complementarity of the three grapes varietals:

The intensity of Pinot Noir, the roundness of Pinot Meunier and the elegance of Chardonnay.

title: Spy Valley Rose Of Pinot Noir 2020
bodyHtml: Pretty pale apricot pink in the glass. This Rosé presents a fresh bouquet of citrus flowers, strawberries and melons. Sweet red fruit and cherry flavours with medium-bodied structure, with a crisp and dry finish. The perfect pink!

title: Hendrick's Orbium Gin
bodyHtml:
General Information

Orbium is a reimagining of Hendrick's Gin by our Master Distiller, Lesley Gracie. Instilled with additional extracts of Quinine, Wormwood and Blue Lotus Blossom, the result is an oddly exquisite gin that sits roundly on the palate.

title: Origen Raiz Chacaleno
bodyHtml: The great variety of Agaves that exist in the country is reinforced by the diversity of ecosystems that make up Mexico and it is not surprising that in a state like Durango, they find in the areas of difficult access agaves that show them the wealth of this state. In their quest to bring all of you the essence of Mexico and Durango through their mezcals, they arrive at Las Quebradas and together with the Vinateros of the region they offer this Mezcal Chacaleño. This Chacaleño mezcal expresses a character as bold as its origin, a true representation of the Origen Raíz del Espíritu family.

title: Mark Ryan The Vincent Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Mark Ryan McNeilly founded Mark Ryan Winery in 1999 to make the best wines in Washington State. Largely self-taught, Mark honed the craft of winemaking through rigorous study and the welcomed advice of some of the area's most experienced producers. Decades later, Mark Ryan Winery has grown in size, earned acclaim from wine lovers and critics, and garnered respect from the state's elite producers. The goal, however, remains the same. Make delicious wines representing the vineyard from which they come, making every vintage better than the last.

The Vincent White offers bright apple, kiwi, and stone fruit aromas. The palate brings acidity and bright citrus flavours accompanied by a luscious mouthfeel with hints of meringue and tart notes. The finish is lengthy and pleasing and pairs with an array of dishes.

title: Matsui Kurayoshi Pure Malt 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Matsui Kurayoshi 12 Year Old is a premium blended malt produced by the Matsui Shuzou distillery in the Tottori Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1910, the distillery is located near Mount Daisen, drawing on the mountain's volcanic-rock-filtered spring water to achieve its signature clean profile. In line with the "World Malt" tradition, this expression is a blend of malt whiskies sourced from Scotland and Japan, which are then married and aged for at least 12 years in ex-bourbon white oak barrels. This long maturation in the varied climate of the Sea of Japan coast allows the spirit to develop a depth and complexity that belies its "pure malt" classification.

Whisky Description

This whisky presents a rich golden amber colour. The nose is fragrant and multi-layered, featuring flamed orange peel, lemongrass, and toasted almonds, with a soft undertone of rye bread. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and well-balanced; an initial burst of aromatic barley and floral notes evolves into a fruity core of red apple, white grape, and dried raisins. The oak influence is evident through smooth vanilla and hazelnut flavours, accented by a very faint, wispy hint of smoke. The finish is long and elegant, leaving behind a refreshing trail of lime, ginger spice, and a touch of dark cocoa. It is bottled at 43% ABV (or 46% in certain markets) and is non-chill filtered to preserve its natural oils.

title: Kurayoshi 8 Year Old Japanese Whisky - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Kurayoshi 8 Year Old is a premium blended malt from the Matsui Shuzou distillery in the Tottori Prefecture. As part of the Kurayoshi "World Malt" series, this expression is a marriage of carefully selected malt whiskies from Scotland and Japan. The spirit is proofed using the famous spring water from Mount Daisen, which is naturally filtered through volcanic rock to provide a soft and pure character. This eight-year maturation represents the entry point into the aged core range, focusing on a balance between fresh cereal notes and the developing influence of white oak.

Whisky Description

This whisky presents a light amber-gold appearance. The nose is fresh and inviting, offering scents of sweet malted barley, dried orange peel, and a distinct floral honey note. On the palate, the body is smooth and mellow, delivering flavors of toasted nuts, vanilla, and a hint of white pepper. There is a delicate sweetness reminiscent of light caramel and orchard fruits like green apples. The finish is clean and medium in length, characterized by a refreshing citrus zest and a gentle, dry oakiness. It is bottled at 43% ABV (or 46% depending on the market) and is non-chill filtered to maintain its textural depth.

Food Pairing

The bright, malty, and slightly citrusy profile of the 8 Year Old makes it an excellent match for lighter savory dishes. It pairs particularly well with lemon-herb roasted chicken, grilled white fish, or vegetable tempura. For a snack pairing, try it with salted almonds or a mild white cheddar. If you are looking for a dessert match, it complements lemon tart or vanilla bean shortbread, which highlights the whisky's citrus and grain sweetness. Like many Matsui spirits, it also performs exceptionally well in a highball with a thin slice of ginger.

title: National Cellar 1573 Spirit Of China - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
National Cellar 1573 Spirit of China originates from Luzhou in the Sichuan Province of China. The Luzhou Laojiao Distillery dates back to 1573 during the Ming Dynasty and is recognized as the oldest continuously producing baijiu distillery in the world. This commemorative spirit is crafted within the 'National Treasures Cellars', which were built in 1573 and have remained in continuous use for over 450 years. The distillery is a state-owned enterprise and its traditional brewing techniques are honored as part of China's National Intangible Cultural Heritage.

Description

This ultra-premium baijiu is colourless and transparent, representing the pinnacle of the strong aroma (Nongxiang) style. The nose is floral and surprisingly mellow, offering inviting scents of white peach, grilled pineapple, honey, and pine resin. On the palate, it delivers a velvety mouthfeel with a pure and intense burst of candied sweetness, complemented by umami notes of liquorice, sesame, and seaweed. The finish is long and refreshing, featuring a raisin-like quality and a lingering, elegant fragrance. It is bottled at 52% alcohol content.

title: Glenfiddich 14 Year Bourbon Barrel Reserve
bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 14 Year Old Bourbon Barrel Reserve is a single malt Scotch whisky produced by Glenfiddich Distillery in Dufftown, Speyside, Scotland. Owned by William Grant & Sons, Glenfiddich is one of the world's most famous single malt distilleries. Created by Master Malt Distiller Brian Kinsman, this expression pays homage to the historic relationship between Scotch whisky and American bourbon making, pairing traditional Speyside orchard fruit with rich, charred American oak sweetness.

Spirit Description

Glenfiddich 14 Year Old begins with Glenfiddich's classic Speyside single malt distillate, produced using malted barley and pure water from the Robbie Dhu spring, distilled in small copper pot stills. The spirit is aged for 14 full years in ex-bourbon American oak casks. Following this primary maturation, the whisky undergoes a signature finishing period in deep-charred new American oak barrels supplied by the Kelvin Cooperage in Louisville, Kentucky. This secondary aging in heavily charred virgin American oak infuses the Scotch with vibrant bourbon-style notes of vanilla, caramel, and warm oak spice.

  • Colour: Rich golden amber with bright bronze highlights.

  • Aroma: Intensely sweet and wood-forward, opening with rich vanilla bean, butterscotch, and toasted oak, followed by ripe Speyside green apple, pear, summer berries, and warm baking spices like cinnamon and nutmeg.

  • Palate: Smooth, rich, and full-flavored on the entry. Upfront flavors of sweet caramel, vanilla cream, and woody spice blend seamlessly into notes of ripe pear, candied orange peel, toasted almonds, and subtle charred oak.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a creamy, velvety, and mouth-coating texture.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and lingering, trailing off with persistent sweet oak tannins, vanilla, subtle peppery spice, and a crisp, dry fruitiness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 43% ABV (86 Proof).

title: Imagery Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Imagery Sauvignon Blanc hails from the expansive California region in the United States. The winery was founded by Joe Benziger and is currently led by his daughter, Jamie Benziger, who has been recognized as a '40 Under 40' tastemaker by Wine Enthusiast. Imagery Estate Winery is dedicated to an expressive winemaking philosophy that explores 'traditional varieties with a little twist', often blending uncommon varietals to enhance the character of their wines.

Wine Description

This golden-coloured wine opens with a delicate bouquet of citrus blossom and subtle honeysuckle aromas. The palate is crisp and zesty, featuring vibrant notes of lemon lime, grapefruit, and passionfruit with a hint of tropical fruit sweetness. It is a medium-bodied wine that maintains a bright mid-palate and a smooth, soft finish.

Food Pairing

This wine's bright acidity and citrus profile make it a natural companion for fresh seafood such as grilled shrimp, mussels, or pan-seared scallops. It also pairs beautifully with tangy goat cheese, fresh garden salads with citrus vinaigrettes, and light Asian or Mediterranean cuisine.

title: Giusti Asolo Prosecco Extra Brut (NV)
bodyHtml: This Prosecco with controlled and guaranteed designation of origin is made with the best Glera grapes coming from vineyards located in the Veneto region in the hilly area of Montello and the Asolo hills. The nose is clean, with intense notes and elegant fruity hints. First, the scent of pear and green apple, followed by underripe white peach and wild spring flowers. The mouth has a crisp mouthfeel at first, savoury and fresh with notes of white and yellow pulp fruits, especially peach and pear, good lasting finish of apple and pear skin and pulp.

title: Legado Munoz Garnacha 2022
bodyHtml:
This Garnacha has a very lively cherry color with a violet rim and an intense aroma with a predominance of very ripe, red fruit accompanied by spicy touches (cloves, pepper) mixed with vanilla notes and coffee. Fleshy mouth, fruit and well-blended oak, with well-polished tannins. Good fruit weight. Spiced. Persistent.

This wine is ideal to drink with grilled, roasted or stewed meats, pastas and not overly cured cheeses. Perfect accompaniment with tapas.

title: Demuerte Deluxe 2021
bodyHtml:
Demuerte Deluxe originates from the Yecla DO in Murcia, Spain. The wine is produced by Winery On Creations, a boutique project founded by Pablo Cortés and Karel Eissner that merges high-quality viticulture with avant-garde, innovative design. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on the Mediterranean flagship Monastrell variety, sourced from old, low-yield vineyards to ensure maximum concentration and expressive power.

Wine Description

This rich, full-bodied red displays an intense cherry-red colour with elegant garnet highlights. The nose offers a complex bouquet of ripe red berries, black cherry, and plum, set against a sophisticated backdrop of smoke, vanilla, and Mediterranean herbs. On the palate, the wine is smooth and velvety, featuring juicy dark fruit flavours and well-integrated oak that contributes notes of toast and chocolate.

title: Turley Juvenile Zinfandel 2024
bodyHtml:
Turley Juvenile Zinfandel is a vibrant red wine from California, United States, produced by the iconic Turley Wine Cellars. Founded in 1993 by former emergency room physician Larry Turley, the winery is dedicated to preserving California’s winemaking heritage by focusing on historic, old vine vineyards. While most Turley wines are single vineyard designates, Juvenile is a unique blend crafted from younger vines—ranging from 6 to 25 years in age—replanted within 27 of the estate's most prestigious old vine sites across 11 different counties.

Wine Description

This 100% Zinfandel presents a bright red and purplish hue, offering an exuberant and expressive sensory profile. The nose is generous and fragrant, bursting with aromas of dark cherry, ripe raspberry, and blueberry, layered with floral notes of lavender and violets, plus a hint of savory 'thanksgiving spices'. On the palate, the wine is mid weight and juicy, displaying a succulent texture with flavors of blackcurrant, red plum, and cracked pepper. It is well structured with soft, silken tannins and a lively acidity that provides exceptional balance to its 15.2% alcohol content. The finish is snappy and persistent, marked by a touch of briar and spice. This wine was fermented with native yeasts and aged for 12 months in a mix of 80% French and 20% American oak (95% used).

title: Bumbu Craft Rum
bodyHtml:
In Barbados, rum isn’t just another spirit, it's the original rum island, where rum was first created some 400 years ago. They have spent the last few centuries perfecting the art of distilling and blending their country’s most famous export. At Bumbu Rum Company, they handcraft their rums from a blend of the finest sugarcane from across the West Indies. Their rum is exceptionally balanced and smooth, without sacrificing the richness and complexity that makes their Barbados rum the world’s best.

An authentic Caribbean legend, their flagship Original Bumbu is blended from fine Barbados rum and hand-selected spices that evoke the rich and colourful history of the West Indies. Distilled in small batches and blended by hand, Bumbu reveals its heritage and craftsmanship with every sip.

title: Gut Oggau Josephine 2023
bodyHtml:
Gut Oggau Josephine originates from Austria, specifically from the Burgenland region. The estate was founded in 2007 by Eduard and Stephanie Tscheppe-Eselböck, who restored a 17th-century winery in the town of Oggau. Their winemaking philosophy is rooted in biodynamic viticulture and natural processes, which is reflected in their 'family tree' of wines where each label features a fictional personality. Josephine is introduced as the second wife of Timotheus and stepmother to Winifred, described as an unconventional and easy-going woman who radiates vitality.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a dark, inky purple colour with a powerful depth. The sensory profile is intense and spicy, featuring aromatic notes of blackberries, wild berries, and red plums, complemented by hints of peppery spice, rosemary, leather, and mushrooms. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it is juicy and well-structured, offering flavours of dark cherry and beet purée balanced by a zingy acidity and smooth, velvety tannins. The finish is long and persistent, showcasing a refined internal energy.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend of Roesler and Blaufränkisch.

  • ABV: Typically 11% to 12.5% depending on the vintage.

  • Organic Status: Certified biodynamic (Demeter) and organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is spontaneously fermented in used oak barrels and matured for approximately eight months; it is bottled without batonnage, fining, filtration, or added sulphur.

title: Domaine Carneros Rose Brut
bodyHtml: The wine's aroma, delivered on a delicate mousse, hints at wild strawberry, raspberry, peach, apricot, honeysuckle and exotic spices. Despite what its colour may suggest, it is a true Brut, completely dry.

title: Veuve Clicquot Rose Brut
bodyHtml:
'Veuve Clicquot Brut Rosé' is a Champagne from the historic Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin house, founded in 1772 in Reims, France. In 1818, Madame Clicquot pioneered the blended rosé Champagne by adding still red wine to the traditional Yellow Label blend, showcasing the house's innovative legacy.

Tasting Notes
This Champagne presents a luminous pink hue with elegant rosy highlights. The bouquet offers enticing aromas of red and black fruits, including cherry, raspberry, and blueberry, enhanced by subtle notes of white pepper and saffron. On the palate, it is beautifully balanced, featuring fresh fruit flavors complemented by hints of biscuit, croissant, and toast, leading to a refined, lingering finish.

Serving Suggestions
Serve chilled at 8–10°C in a Champagne flute to enhance its vibrant aromas and lively effervescence. 'Veuve Clicquot Brut Rosé' pairs wonderfully with seafood, charcuterie, or light desserts, such as raspberry tart, making it a versatile companion for any occasion.

Accolades

  • Bettane + Desseauve - 92 points
  • Wine Spectator - 91 points

title: Frey Riesling Hangen Weisheim 2017
bodyHtml: Intense bouquet of mellow peaches and orange peel. A complex shift between ripe fruit and gripping acidity balances this wine.

title: Tommy Bahama Mango Vodka
bodyHtml:
Luscious Mango from the tropics, sweetened with pure cane sugar in this ultra smooth vodka. Tommy Bahama Mango Vodka is crafted for versatility and brings personality to any cocktail. Added notes of island coconut and citrus fruits bring a tango to this Mango.

Naturally rich mango meets ultra smooth Vodka for the perfect amount of citrus. The light, sweet flavour is crafted for versatility and brings personality to any cocktail.

title: Daou Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the United States, specifically the Paso Robles region of California. DAOU Vineyards was founded by brothers Georges and Daniel Daou, who sought an unrivaled terroir to produce Cabernet Sauvignon, a quest that led them to DAOU Mountain in the Adelaida District of Paso Robles. Their vision is to create California 'first growth' wine, fulfilling the district's destiny as a world benchmark for Bordeaux varieties. The winery is also a founding member of the Paso Robles CAB Collective, championing the region's potential for ultra-premium Cabernet Sauvignon.

Wine Description

The 2023 DAOU Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep ruby-purple color. It is a powerful, complex, and layered wine that exemplifies Paso Robles. The nose is highly perfumed, with intense aromas of black cherry, cassis, plum, currant, black cherry jam, and blackberry jam, complemented by dark chocolate, tobacco leaf, cedar, and eucalyptus. Secondary nuances include desert sage, sandalwood, dusty minerality, cigar box, leather, and black olive. On the palate, it is rich and weighty, full-bodied, and structured firmly around a solid core of boysenberry and cherry fruit. Flavours of black raspberry, spicy currant, blueberry compote, cherry preserve, and fig meld seamlessly with crushed herbs and cranberry. It features excellent structure and harmony between the pure fruit core and a firm, supple backbone of ripe, fine-grained tannins. The finish is impeccably balanced, flowing effortlessly and leaving lingering notes of boysenberry, rhubarb, graphite, and dried thyme. The wine is primarily Cabernet Sauvignon (plus Petit Verdot, Merlot, and Cabernet Franc) and is fermented with proprietary native yeast, made from 100% free-run juice.

title: Siduri Pinot Noir Santa Barbara County 2021
bodyHtml:
Each vineyard section was vinified separately, with pumpovers being used on the Santa Maria Valley fruit and punch downs on the Sta. Rita Hills.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Toasted spices and herbs give depth to the plush black-cherry aromas on the nose of this county-wide cuvee. Roasted cherry, mace and star anise flavors align on the engaging palate.

90 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2021 Pinot Noir Santa Barbara County is an up-front, total charmer offering attractive red and black cherry fruit, some spicy, herbal nuances, medium body, and a soft, elegant texture.

title: Appleton Estate Rum 12 Year Old Rare Casks
bodyHtml:
General Information

This expression from the extraordinary Jamaican rum range is truly fantastic stuff. Matured for at least a dozen years in oak casks, this expression displays a marvellous flavour profile of ripe fruit, rich chocolate, molasses and more.

title: Robert Weil Dry Riesling Rheingau 2023
bodyHtml: This riesling is a blend of fruit from high-altitude sites—including the brilliantly named Sandgrub vineyard—dotted around the village. There’s a good dollop of wine from Wasseros too, a steep, southwest-facing vineyard that abuts the Grafenberg vines. The soils of these sites are typically composed of stony, fragmented phyllite interlaced with loess and loam. Even at a refreshing 12%, the riesling has excellent depth for this level. The layered, peachy fruit beautifully complements the wine’s vibrant, quenching acidity and saline length.

title: Courvoisier Avant-Garde 'Bourbon Aged Cask' Cognac
bodyHtml: The limited-edition Courvoisier Avant-Garde Bourbon Finish is a VS expression finished in Kentucky bourbon casks. The extra ageing gives the expression an elegant and velvety finish with tasting notes of vanilla, honey and sweet marmalade. On the palate, it is described as having notes of soft smoky leather and sweet orange.

title: Zinck Cremant d'Alsace Brut
bodyHtml:
Zinck Crémant d'Alsace Brut originates from France, within the Alsace region and the Eguisheim subregion. The estate was established in 1964 by Paul Zinck and is currently managed by his son, Philippe Zinck, representing the fourth generation of this family business. The winery's philosophy is to produce authentic wines that fully reflect their origins, with Philippe expanding the estate to approximately 14 hectares. Since 2021, the vineyards have been fully certified biodynamic, reinforcing a commitment to sustainable and traditional winemaking ethics.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine typically presents a golden tinge and a medium body with a soft, present mousse. The sensory profile features fresh aromas of green apple, peach skin, pear, and citrus rind, accented by hints of nuts, spice, and brioche. On the palate, the attack is fruity and creamy, delivering flavours of ripe yellow and red apple, melon rind, and peach pit. The structure is crisp and fresh with plenty of depth and a light bite of spicy notes, leading to a long finish characterized by bright lemon pith and creamy minerals.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional blend of 60% Pinot Noir, 30% Chardonnay, and 10% Pinot Blanc.

  • Stylistic Notes: Crafted using the traditional method, the wine includes 20% reserve wine and spends 18 months on the lees to develop its restrained richness and complexity.

  • ABV: 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: The estate is a leader in organic and biodynamic production, with full biodynamic certification as of 2021.

title: Franzia Chillable Red (NV) - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml: A light-bodied red that is made to be served chilled. More body and flavour than blush wine, softer than traditional red wines. Pairs well with lighter foods.

title: Jackson Triggs Sauvignon Blanc Proprietor's Select - 4 Litre Box
bodyHtml:
Aromas of crushed passion fruit seeds, dried mangos, notes of frangipani and candied melon. A fine, chalky acidity and mineral-driven slate on the palate follows a long and elegant tropical fruit finish on the nose.

Pairs well with prosciutto-wrapped melon, fruit salad or grilled Korean sticky chicken thighs.

title: Copper Moon Pinot Grigio - 4 Litre Box
bodyHtml: A cool, fresh taste that captures the mystery of the night itself. Beautiful aromas of citrus, green apple, and ripe pear.

title: Copper Moon Malbec - 4 Litre Box
bodyHtml: An appealing deep red colour and a bouquet of vanilla, chocolate and field berries. Smooth medium body with a complex flavour profile encompassing dark red berries, cherry and black currant.

title: Frontera Cabernet Sauvignon - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml: Deep ruby colour. Light cassis, plum, cherry, currant, raspberry, chocolate, earth and mint aroma. Dry, medium bodied, with good berry flavour, through to a pleasant fruity finish.

title: Jackson Triggs Merlot Proprietors' Selection - 4 Litre Box
bodyHtml: This Merlot is rich in fruit and has a soft, full-bodied elegance. The velvety texture and bouquet of berries and herbs are uniquely characteristic of this grape variety.

title: Chateau Lafon Rochet 2021
bodyHtml:
92+ Points - James Suckling

 A firm and linear wine with blackberry and blackcurrant character. Medium body. Creamy. Focused for the vintage. Turns to plums and citrus at the end. From organically grown grapes.

 92 Points - Vinous

 The 2021 Lafon-Rochet is very good, although there are some rustic contours that are impossible to look past. Dark fruit, spice, lavender and licorice are some of the notes that open in the glass. 

 91 Points - Decanter

 Super ripe and perfumed on the nose. Bright, almost searing on the palate then chalky with a crystalline mineral edged finish. Clean and precise, lacks a touch more density on the mid palate, but this is well worked with balance and a long salty finish.

 91 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

 The last vintage made by Basile Tesseron and 69% Cabernet Sauvignon, 26% Melot, and the rest Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, the 2021 Chateau Lafon-Rochet is outstanding stuff that clearly does well in the vintage. Cassis, graphite, lead pencil, and ripe tobacco notes all give way to a medium-bodied Saint-Estephe with fine tannins, solid concentration (especially in the vintage), and a balanced, layered, seamless profile that will evolve nicely for two decades. The tannin quality here is terrific.

 90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

 The 2021 Lafon-Rochet offers up aromas of cassis, licorice and pencil shavings, followed by a medium-bodied, supple and charming palate that's seamless and harmonious, framed by soft, powdery tannins, concluding with a minty finish.

title: Kah Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
The word KAH translates to "life" in the ancient Mayan language. Its' bottle and spirit are reflective of the “Day of the Dead”. The 3,000 year old Meso-American ritual honoring deceased loved ones. KAH's packaging is inspired by traditional Calaveras (sugar skulls) used in “Dia de Muertos” rituals to symbolize death and rebirth. Every bottle is an individual, hand-crafted work of art, no two bottles are the same. While the bottle captures the enduring spirit, so does the Tequila inside.

Initially sweet but is quickly followed with a peppery spice. Silky and delicate, leaving a sachet of spices on the palate. This particular skull represents a particularly macabre Bolivian tradition of the “Day of the Dead” celebration.

title: Kah Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
The word KAH translates to "life" in the ancient Mayan language. Its bottle and spirit are reflective of the “Day of the Dead”. The 3,000 year old Meso-American ritual honouring deceased loved ones. KAH's packaging is inspired by traditional Calaveras (sugar skulls) used in “Dia de Muertos” rituals to symbolize death and rebirth. Every bottle is an individual, hand-crafted work of art, no two bottles are the same. While the bottle captures the enduring spirit, so does the Tequila inside!

Tasting Notes... Powerful and viscous. Ultra smooth tequila with a full body and intense Agave flavour. Matured for 10 months in French Limousin Oak casks, it acquires subtle hints of vanilla and caramel that complement the intense agave flavour.

title: Kah Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
The word KAH translates to "life" in the ancient Mayan language. Its bottle and spirit reflect the "Day of the Dead," The 3,000-year-old Meso-American ritual honouring deceased loved ones. KAH's packaging is inspired by traditional Calaveras (sugar skulls) used in "Dia de Muertos" rituals to symbolize death and rebirth. Every bottle is an individual, hand-crafted work of art, and no two are the same. While the bottle captures the enduring spirit, so does the Tequila inside.

Distinctive by robust agave flavours, accompanied by chocolate, tobacco and coffee flavours. Matured for two years in American Oak casks. The Nicaraguan "Day of the Dead" traditions inspire the bottle.

title: Francis Ford Coppola Cabernet Sauvignon Archimedes 2019
bodyHtml:
One of the greatest minds of all time, Archimedes of ancient Greece was a physicist, astronomer, engineer, and inventor. Legend has it that he defeated the Roman fleet by creating enormous reflective devices which used the sun’s rays to ignite and burn their ships. Admiring this great innovator, Francis Ford Coppola’s grandfather, Augusto, named his first son Archimedes. With this wine we pay homage to Uncle Archimedes, who loved math and mechanics as much as his namesake.

Crafted for the true connoisseur, Archimedes is produced in very limited quantities from the vintage's most impressive lots of Cabernet Sauvignon. Dark and dramatic with a lush, velvety texture framed by chewy tannins, this year's vintage features sweeter spice notes and less earthiness than its predecessor. Scents of black raspberries, cassis, clove, gingerbread, and toasted woods are followed by juicy flavours of plums, boysenberries, and star anise. A touch of minerals emerges on the finish, adding to the complexity of this stunning and sophisticated wine.

title: Castarede Armagnac 1986
bodyHtml:
Castarede Armagnac 1986 is a premium vintage spirit produced in the Armagnac region of France. Established in 1832, Maison Castarede is recognized as the oldest trading house of Armagnac still in operation. The company is currently managed by Florence Castarede, representing the sixth generation of the family. The spirit is distilled from white wine made from high acidity, low alcohol grapes and is aged in 400-liter handmade oak barrels in the family's century-old cellars located on the banks of the Baïse River.

2. Spirit Description

This 1986 vintage expression is defined by its refined complexity and balanced character.

  • Colour: The spirit presents a pale, clear appearance.

  • Aroma: An inviting bouquet unfolds with simmered fruits, cedar-kissed oak, and nutty pecans. Hints of honey, juicy plums, and a subtle kick of white pepper lead into indulgent notes of creamy vanilla and sticky dates.

  • Palate: The entry is smooth and elegant, confirming the complex nose. Flavours of dried fruits are followed by the warmth of bread pudding and molten toffee, with baking spices providing a gentle lift.

  • Body: It is characterized as light and pleasant with a poised finesse that avoids overwhelming heat.

  • Finish: The exit is marked by soft, refined tannins and a clean, satisfying sensation.

  • ABV: This Armagnac is typically bottled at 40%.

title: Teeling Single Malt Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Double Gold Winner at the 2020 World Spirits Competition, San Francisco!  Through innovative cask maturation and finishing techniques, this distillery has crafted a unique, award-winning Teeling Irish Single Malt Whiskey full of flavour.

Made with Irish Whiskeys distilled from 100% malted barley, matured and finished in casks that impart the influence of five wine casks (Sherry, Port, Madeira, White Burgundy, Cabernet Sauvignon). This Irish Single Malt Whiskey delivers a unique fruit-forward flavour profile that is complex, yet balanced and has often been described as “a symphony” of flavour.

Vibrant with aromas of melon, figs, toffee and lemon pushing through on the nose, whilst the palate gives notes of dried fruits, citrus, vanilla, spice and cloves. This Whiskey finishes with a long sweetness in harmony with dry tannins from the wood.

title: Kavalan Distillery Select No. 2 Single Malt
bodyHtml: Kavalan's Distillery Select series showcases the fine art of blending and the exquisite cask selection of Taiwan's premier distillery. This No. 2 edition is an enticingly smooth drop, intensely aromatic with an irresistible floral and herbal complexity that delivers the delicious tranquillity of the forest.

title: Agavero Orange Tequila Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Agavero Orange Tequila Liqueur is a premium spirit that artfully blends 100% blue agave tequila with the essence of oranges and pure agave nectar. This combination results in a refreshing liqueur that can be enjoyed straight, on the rocks, or as a vibrant addition to cocktails.

Tasting Notes
On the nose, Agavero Orange presents a juicy sweet-orange scent. The palate is initially powerfully sweet, finishing refreshingly clean with a tingle of pepperiness.

Serving Suggestions
This liqueur is versatile and can be enjoyed in various ways:

  • Straight or On the Rocks: Savor its rich flavors neat or over ice.

  • Cocktails: Enhance margaritas by adding a splash of Agavero Orange for an incredibly refreshing twist. It also elevates gin rickeys and can be used to create unique cocktails like the "Día de los Muertos," which combines Agavero Orange with cinnamon-dusted orange slices.

title: Dr. Zenzen Riesling Piesporter Michelsberg 2024
bodyHtml: Notes of peach, apple and stone fruit alongside honey, citrus, lime and minerals. This Riesling has a bit of sweetness and and touch of acidity. Low alcohol - only 9.5%.

title: Dr. Burklin Wolf Villa Burklin Cuvee Weiss 2017
bodyHtml: This white wine from the renowned Dr. Bürklin-Wolf accessible, wonderfully fresh and fruity. Ripe tropical fruit on the palate, lovely and fresh. Villa Burklin is a blend of Riesling, Sauvignon Blanc and Scheurebe.

title: Tocornal Cabernet - Merlot - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml: Dry, soft plum berry character. Light to medium-bodied with little evidence of oak or tannin.

title: Teremana Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Teremana Blanco Tequila is an unaged small-batch Mexican spirit originating from the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. Co-founded in 2020 by global icon Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson alongside Dany Garcia, Jenna Fagnan, and Ken Austin, the brand operates under a strategic partnership with Mast-Jägermeister SE. Distilled at Destilería Teremana de Agave (NOM 1613) in Jesús María, the spirit focuses on sustainable, small-batch crafting methods designed to honor traditional tequila-making.

Spirit Description

Teremana Blanco is crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves harvested at peak maturity in the mineral-rich red soil of the Jalisco Highlands. The agaves are slow-roasted in traditional brick ovens for three days before being crushed using a roller mill. After open-air fermentation in small steel tanks, the liquid is double-distilled in handmade copper pot stills built by local artisans. The unaged distillate is bottled directly to preserve the bright, raw character of highland agave.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and clean.

  • Aroma: Fresh, vibrant, and inviting, opening with sweet cooked agave, bright grapefruit, fresh lime zest, and subtle notes of lemongrass, salted lime, and light vanilla.

  • Palate: Crisp, clean, and agave-forward on the entry. Upfront flavors of roasted agave, sweet lemon peel, and melon blend with gentle notes of herbal earthiness, white pepper, and light almond sweetness.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a soft, fresh, and slightly oily texture that glides smoothly across the tongue.

  • Finish: Clean, refreshing, and crisp, tapering off with lingering citrus zest, sweet cooked agave, and a gentle spark of white pepper.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Domaine Gerard Duplessis Chablis 'Montmains' Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml: Duplessis undertakes a slightly unorthodox approach to aging, with the premier and grand crus aged in vat for six months for the malolactic fermentation, followed by six months in oak barrels (up to 10% new) and then six months back in stainless steel. In this way he ensures that the barrels are always full, as the previous vintage is always racked and transferred into vat just before the next harvest.

title: Bepi Tosolini Smoked Grappa - 500 ml
bodyHtml: A noble blend of selected Friulian red grapes, aged in French oak barriques, inside the traditional cellars of the Tosolini Family. The oak casks have gone through a toasting process with "Kentucky" tobacco leaves for a deep and intense smoked Grappa. The peated taste reminds one of a single malt-aged whiskey, with harmonious spicy notes with a light smoke finish.

title: Bepi Tosolini Grappa Distillery Edition - Barrique Ex-Sherry
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Bepi Tosolini Grappa Distillery Edition - Barrique Ex-Sherry is a top quality artisanal spirit from Italy, specifically produced in the Friuli Venezia Giulia region. The distillery was founded in 1943 by Bepi Tosolini, a visionary who transformed grappa from a rustic spirit for labourers into a refined distillate celebrated by connoisseurs. Today, the business remains a family owned luxury house located in Povoletto, near Udine, and is currently managed by the founder's grandchildren, Giuseppe, Bruno, and Lisa.

Spirit Description

This exclusive Distillery Edition is crafted from a blend of noble Friulian grape marc, which is distilled in traditional, manually operated steam stills to preserve the fresh aromatics of the harvest. The grappa is then matured in American oak barrels that previously held Oloroso Sherry, a process carried out in the family's own cellars.

  • Colour: The spirit displays an intense yellow colour with coppery orange hues.

  • Aroma: The nose is complex and fragrant, featuring waxy citrus and Christmas spices alongside enveloping notes of raisins, sweet vanilla, and hazelnuts.

  • Palate: It delivers a soft and velvety palate rich with flavours of vanilla, sweet spices, and raisins, balanced by subtle vegetal notes and a pinch of salt.

  • Body: This grappa is characterized by a rich and very complex body.

  • Finish: It concludes with a nutty and spicy finish, a hallmark of its time in Sherry casks.

  • ABV: This edition is bottled at 40%.

title: Aba Pisco - 500 ml
bodyHtml: A very fragrant Pisco, all jasmine flowers, tangerine and honey and, with your eyes shut, you’d think it was a Muscat-based dessert wine rather than a Muscat-based spirit. The palate is soft, silky and as sweet as syrup with the flavour of orange blossom honey.

title: 689 Master & Servant Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Similar to the interwoven numbers in their logo, their wines reflect separate elements coming together into one balanced and harmonious whole. Their Napa Valley wines strive for this harmonious balance rich, expressive, and approachable reflecting characteristics of this world-famous growing region. They hope that every glass that’s enjoyed as a  toast and as a  smile will be passed along with it to your friends and family. 

Rolling effortlessly into the glass with vibrant scents of freshly crushed black cherries, plums and blueberry, leading to notes of cassis, and chocolate. The densely laden, full-bodied wine is jam-packed with blackberry and notes of exotic spice. Velvety tannins highlight fresh dark fruit, the wine finishes with exceptional length and richness.

title: Avignonesi Vino Nobile Di Montepulciano 2022
bodyHtml: The wine shows garnet red hues, intense aromas of ripe, red berry fruit, such as red plum, pomegranate and red vine peach, sweet spices and Mediterranean herbs. On the palate the wine is well balanced, with generous pulp, seamless tannins and an endless finish.

title: Glendronach Port Wood
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: GlenDronach Port Wood was crafted by Master Blender Dr. Rachel Barrie. The single malt initially aged in Pedro Ximénez and oloroso sherry casks before finishing its aging in port casks for three years for a total of 10 years of maturation. Bottled without chill-filtration or added colour. Aromas of huge helpings of dried fruit are mixed with aromatic oak and strawberry jam. The taste consists of brandied cherries, blackcurrant and chocolate biscuits.

title: Benriach 10 Year Old The Smoky Ten
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: In the early 1970s, Benriach broke convention in Speyside by returning to distilling batches of whisky in the old, 19th-century style, using malted barley smoked with Highland peat. This wood-rich Highland peat imparts distinctly sweet and smoky notes into Benriach peated whiskies. Benriach The Smoky Ten has been crafted from a combination of unpeated and peated spirit and three casks matured for at least ten years in a combination of bourbon barrels, Jamaican rum casks and toasted virgin oak. The whisky is then expertly married together to create sublimely smooth layers of sun ripe fruit, aromatic smoke and toasted oak spice, lingering into the perfectly balanced sweet and smoky finish.

title: Quady Elysium Black Muscat 2021 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
In the San Joaquin Valley in 1983, a nearby grower brought Andrew Quady some Black Muscat grapes that were previously destined for sacramental wine at a local church. When the church ceased operations, the grower was left with truckloads of ripe, unwanted Black Muscat. The grower heard through the grapevine that newcomer Quady had some success with Orange Muscat, so he knocked on Quady’s door, and the rest is history.

An aroma of roses accompanies dark fruit, cherry and strawberry balanced with fruit acidity to finish clean. Elysium makes stunning spritzers and cocktails. Elysium is wonderful with cheeses, especially goat cheese or Gorgonzola; with desserts containing red fruits, such as English Summer Pudding, with dark chocolate and with cream desserts and cheesecake. Elysium poured onto vanilla ice cream is an effortless favourite.

title: Terralsole Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2016
bodyHtml:
Terralsole in Italian means ”Land Toward the Sun.” It was established in 1996 and is owned and operated by Mario Bollag and Athena Tergis.

In 2018 they received organic certification for their entire estate. The Terralsole Riserva Brunello di Montalcino has notes of cherry, blackberry, tobacco, and cloves.

title: Chateau Doisy Dubroca Sauternes by Lucien Lurton 2011 - 500 ml Bottle
bodyHtml:
Chateau Doisy Dubroca is a Second Growth estate located in France, within the Barsac subregion of the Sauternes appellation. Once part of a larger single estate that included the three modern 'Doisy' properties, the chateau was purchased by Lucien Lurton in 1971 and later managed by his son, Louis. The estate is celebrated for being the smallest classified growth in the 1855 classification of Sauternes and Barsac, maintaining a traditional winemaking philosophy focused on the purity of the Semillon grape.

Wine Description

This 2011 Sauternes presents a bright golden-straw hue in the glass. The aromatic profile is enticing and lively, featuring a bouquet of pear, peach, and mango underscored by delicate floral notes of honeysuckle. On the palate, the wine is intensely flavoured and fresh, offering defined layers of ripe white stone fruit, lime oil, and tropical notes like pineapple. It possesses a medium to full body with a viscous entry, balanced by a vibrant acidity that prevents the sweetness from becoming heavy. The finish is clean and persistent, with subtle hints of soil and coconut.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator – 95 points

  • James Suckling – 94 points

  • Vinous – 92 points

Food Pairing

The lush and balanced profile of this wine makes it an excellent companion for fruit-based desserts, such as apple tarts or banana-themed sweets. It also pairs beautifully with rich, savoury starters like duck liver crème brûlée or classic foie gras, where the wine's acidity cuts through the fat. For a cheese course, consider a pungent Dolcelatte or other blue cheeses to create a sophisticated sweet-and-salty contrast.

title: Chateau Lilian Ladouys 2021
bodyHtml: On the soil of Saint-Estephe, the vines of Lilian-Ladouys are to be found where the roads meet, a stone's throw from the Graves of Cos d'Estournel and the Chateau Lafite-Rothschild.

title: Mark Herold Cabernet Sauvignon 'Coombsville' 2019
bodyHtml: The Coombsville AVA is located in the south of Napa Valley. Cooling Petaluma Gap winds sweep this AVA contributing to the cooler climate, resulting in an extended ripening window that leads to highly pigmented, well developed grapes at harvest.

title: Freixenet Cordon Negro Brut Cava - 200 ml
bodyHtml: A light, modern Cava with a very refreshing style and lots of bubbles that really last. When you taste it, you’ll pick up hints of citrus fruit and an aroma that reminds you of both apple and pear as well as peach, melon and pineapple, along with light yeasty and minerally notes and lively effervescence.

title: Butternut Chardonnay
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Butternut was created by Napa power-duo Orin Swift's Dave Phinney and Whitehall Lane's Tony Leonardini. The Butternut brand was thoughtfully made after an "experiment" with 5 barrels from the Orin Swift cellar to create the perfect Chardonnay, "your Mother's Chardonnay". It was beautiful, buttery, oaked but they didn't have a name for it. It was Tony Leonardini's wife who walked in with a box of freshly harvested butternut squash in the California sun and a light went off and Butternut was born.

Butternut wines are the perfect affordable, any day of the week wines!

Aromatics of peach, hazelnut and spiced candied apple. The palate is a luxurious with a blend of fig, butterscotch and oak along with a refreshing finish. 100% new French oak to create a buttery and irresistible Chardonnay.

title: Butternut Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Ripe, juicy boysenberry, black cherry, and currants with undertones of cassis further intertwined with white pepper and layers of espresso and mocha. On entry, a burst of ripe blackberries will greet the senses. The mid-palate gives way to soft velvety tannins with a long lingering finish.

Pair with short ribs braised with mushrooms, grilled pork tenderloin or chocolate mousse.

title: Butternut Pinot Noir 2020
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Butternut wines are the perfect affordable, any day of the week wines!

Grown in Napa Valley, Sonoma and Monterey they all come together to create a medium-bodied and silky Pinot Noir. Aromatics of red and dark fruit, berries, a touch of menthol and cassis. Elegant and balanced.

title: Drouhin Vaudon Chablis 2025
bodyHtml: A dry and fruity wine, easy to drink. Its colour is pale gold with greenish hues. Very fresh aromas reminiscent of citrus (lemon or grapefruit), and small pleasant touches of fern or coriander are also found. On the palate, dry and fruity, with mineral notes. Friendly and has a long aftertaste.

title: St Remy VSOP - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

St Remy VSOP is a premium French brandy produced in the Loire Valley, France. The distillery was established in 1886 by Paul Emile Rémy Martin II in the village of Machecoul after phylloxera damaged the vineyards in Charente. Currently owned by the spirits company Rémy Cointreau, St Remy launched its original 'Fine St Remy' recipe in 1917 and has since grown to become the top selling French brandy globally.

Spirit Description

This brandy is crafted from a selection of red and white grapes sourced from prestigious French wine regions, including Burgundy, Champagne, and Bordeaux. The spirit is distilled using a traditional continuous copper column process and matured in small French oak barrels.

  • Colour: It features an amber yellow hue lit with glints of gold.

  • Aroma: The nose begins with a vivacity that yields to fruity notes of apricot, peach, gooseberry, and wild strawberry, accented by subtle tones of vanilla and wood.

  • Palate: The palate provides a delicate and balanced mouthfeel with fruit and wood flavours, delivering what the nose promises.

  • Body: It is light to medium bodied with a smooth, velvety texture.

  • Finish: The experience concludes with a grand vanilla finale and a long, lingering finish of dried fruits and spices.

  • ABV: St Remy VSOP is bottled at 40% alcohol by volume.

title: Luxardo Sambuca - 375 ml
bodyHtml: This classic Italian liqueur has been family-owned for generations. The use of essential oils from the star anise seed provides intense aromatics and concentrated flavours that are balanced by light bitterness and velvety smooth texture on the palate.

title: Clase Azul Ultra Aged Tequila
bodyHtml:
Clase Azul Ultra Añejo is the pinnacle of luxury in the Clase Azul tequila lineup, representing the brand's dedication to exceptional craftsmanship and quality. This ultra-premium extra añejo tequila is produced in limited quantities, making it a coveted choice among collectors and connoisseurs.

Production Process
The journey of Clase Azul Ultra Añejo begins with 100% organic Tequilana Weber Blue Agave, harvested at peak maturity. The agave piñas are slow-cooked in traditional brick ovens for 72 hours, allowing for the development of rich, complex flavours. After cooking, the agave is crushed, and the juice undergoes fermentation with a proprietary yeast strain. The tequila is distilled twice in copper pot stills to achieve a refined spirit. Aged for five years, the process begins in American whiskey casks and finishes in Spanish sherry casks, imparting unique depth and character to the tequila.

Tasting Notes
Clase Azul Ultra Añejo presents a deep amber hue, indicative of its extended aging. The nose offers a harmonious blend of dried fruits, toasted oak, and dark chocolate, complemented by subtle notes of vanilla and caramel. On the palate, it is exceptionally smooth and full-bodied, with flavours of rich toffee, roasted coffee, and a hint of spice, leading to a long, elegant finish.

Packaging
The presentation of Clase Azul Ultra Añejo is as remarkable as the tequila itself. Each decanter is handcrafted and adorned with precious metals, including pure platinum, sterling silver, and 24-karat gold accents. The intricate design and meticulous attention to detail make it a stunning addition to any collection.

title: Benriach 12 Year Old Three Cask Matured
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: To make Benriach Twelve, Benriach whisky is three casks matured for at least twelve years in sherry casks, bourbon barrels and port casks. The whisky from each cask is then expertly married together to create a smooth, sherry-rich single malt layered with baked fruit, maple honey and cocoa, perfectly balanced with a lingering sultana and spiced mocha finish.

title: Sauza Hacienda Silver Tequila
bodyHtml: Fresh and fruity, Sauza Silver is an ideal addition to fruit-based cocktails. Pouring colourless, it offers subtle aromas of citrus, agave and light malty notes. The palate is fresh and lively with flavours of citrus, agave and pepper on a medium body that finishes with a touch of bitter citrus.

title: Redemption Rye Whisky
bodyHtml:
A straight rye whiskey made with a mash bill of 95% rye for intensity and spiciness. Aged for over two years and bottled at 46%, this is bold stuff! Perfect on its own or in a cocktail.

See More USA Whisky

title: Talbott Kali Hart Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Talbott Kali Hart Chardonnay 2024 originates from the United States, within the California region and the Monterey County subregion of the Central Coast. Renowned for crafting estate-grown Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, Talbott Vineyards was built on inspirations drawn from Burgundian traditions. The winery's current operational philosophy centers on letting the fruit guide the way with minimal intervention, utilizing grapes grown in cool-climate settings to optimize regional clarity and freshness.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a clear white appearance and possesses a smooth, full-bodied structure with a luscious, inviting palate. The sensory profile represents the most fruit-forward expression in the producer's portfolio, opening with an aromatic nose of rich Madagascar vanilla, warm brioche, and ripe stone fruit. On the vibrant palate, it delivers intense flavours of Bosc pear, tangerine, pineapple, papaya, and mango. The finish is remarkably soft, clean, and persistent, balanced by refreshing acidity, a hint of minerality, and trailing hard spice notes.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its buttery complexity and bright mouthfeel, achieving structural harmony by balancing standard Californian oak elements against a core of lively, crisp fruit.

  • ABV: Recorded between 14% and 14.3%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate relies on precision viticulture across its premium Monterey holdings, this commercial bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The fruit-forward intensity, round texture, and bright acidity of this Chardonnay make it an excellent partner for rich seafood dishes and earthy fare.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with high-end selections such as lobster with drawn butter, garlic shrimp, pan-seared crab cakes, or tuna tartare.

  • Savoury: Suggested pairings include dishes highlighted by wild mushrooms, which beautifully echo the wine's underlying hard spice and mineral notes.

  • Light Fare: An ideal match for vegetarian pasta creations, roasted summer vegetables, or simple porch-side sipping.

title: Laventura Lanave Tinto 2020
bodyHtml: Bryan MacRobert began his career in the late 2000s at The Sadie Family Wines in the Swartland region of South Africa, and Terroir al Limit in Priorat, Spain. Under the Bryan MacRobert Wines label, he released the first vintage of his own wines in 2010. Bryan's wines were pioneering, and they were instrumental in Swartland's repositioning as a quality wine region. Bryan met a 'Riojan' winemaker on his travels, fell in love, and moved to Rioja in 2013. He founded Laventura, which means 'The Adventure,' and has been shaking up the traditionally conservative Rioja wine scene ever since.

title: Luigi Bosca Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in Argentina, this wine hails from the high-altitude vineyards of the Uco Valley and Luján de Cuyo within the Mendoza region. Luigi Bosca is a historic family-owned winery founded by the Arizu family in 1901, with a legacy spanning four generations. Their winemaking philosophy centers on a deep respect for the land and a commitment to expressing the unique character of Mendoza's terroir through traditional craftsmanship and sustainable practices.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents an attractive yellow-golden colour with bright highlights. The aromatic profile is elegant and expressive, featuring notes of pear, ripe apple, and citrus, layered with tropical hints of pineapple and mango, as well as delicate floral undertones. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and creamy, offering a broad, rounded texture balanced by a vibrant acidity. Flavours of white fruit and honey lead into a long, clean finish marked by subtle nuances of vanilla and toasted bread from partial oak aging.

title: Warre's Warrior Reserve - 375 ml
bodyHtml: The nose shows a lot of complexity with chocolates, dates, figs, raisins, plums, red liquorice, blackcurrants, mulberry and black cherry with a nice oak integration and a spicy/mint finish.

title: Merryvale Chardonnay 'Silhouette' 2022
bodyHtml: Silhouette Chardonnay has an intense nose filled with exotic fruit notes including pineapple, stone fruit and tangerine, and a fragrant vanilla finish. The mouth is very round with a nice sweetness and very clean minerality. The wine is dense and ample with a touch of sweetness and citrus finish. A very balanced and elegant wine with a stylish touch of oak and a beautiful finish.

title: La Magia Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2019
bodyHtml: La Magia's Riserva embodies classic Brunello's defining characteristics only produced in exceptional years from the very best grapes. Aged in new casks for three and a half to four years, this magnificent wine with its extraordinary harmony and elegance guarantees fine drinking for years to come.

title: E. Guigal Crozes Hermitage Rouge 2019
bodyHtml: Crozes-Hermitage can be considered the gateway to the red and white wines of the Northern Rhône Valley. The reds, which are the majority of production, have wonderful warm flavours of red and black fruit, and typical Syrah pepper, spice and savoury notes.

title: Glen Scotia 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
General Information

Initially aged in American oak casks and treated to a finishing period in Oloroso sherry casks, this is a delicious 18 year old single malt from the Glen Scotia Distillery in Campbeltown. Shows off a good balance between fruity sweetness and classic Campbeltown salinity. Lovely golden presentation box to match the whisky's handsome golden hue, too. That's style.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Ardbeg An Oa
bodyHtml: The first addition to Ardbeg's ongoing range for a decade when introduced in 2017, An Oa is a combination of spirit aged in Pedro-Ximenez sherry casks and bourbon barrels. Married in a French-oak marrying vat, this is rounded and smoky with toffee, aniseed, date, and banana notes.

title: Elizabeth Rose Chardonnay 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Enticing aromas of stone fruits and tangerine predominate, followed by hints of citrus blossom and lemon zest. The lively acidity creates excellent balance, and the neutral oak aging and lees contact adds weight to the mid-palate. Yet, the overall mouthfeel is clean and bright with a flinty minerality, leaving a mouthwatering finish.

title: Doi Shuzo Kaiun Iwaizake Tokubetsu Honjozo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Established in 1872 during the Meiji Restoration, the Doi family transitioned from being village headmen and landlords to sake brewers using rice given to them as tribute. The brand name 'Kaiun' translates to 'to welcome luck', and this flagship Iwaizake expression, symbolized by a lucky rake on the label—is traditionally gifted for celebratory occasions like weddings and the New Year.

Description

This premium Tokubetsu Honjozo presents a clear, colourless appearance in the glass. The aromatic profile is bright and fruity, featuring dominant scents of melon, pear, and banana accented by a subtle, buttery fragrance. On the palate, it offers a refined and complex experience with a crisp, dry taste that is balanced by a discreet acidity and a hint of sweetness. The texture is smooth and fresh, highlighting the purity of the soft spring water used in its production. ABV 15.5%.

title: Louis Jadot Gevrey Chambertin 'Lavaux St. Jacques' Premier Cru 2014
bodyHtml:
"Lavaux St Jacques" is situated at the beginning of the split of Combe de Lavaux, which faces the south. "La Combe" is an ancient evacuation canal and we can notice the likeness between the soil of Premier Cru (for example "Lavaux St Jacques) and Grands Crus situated on the slope (Chambertin, Mazis Chambertin...).

Gevrey Chambertin "Lavaux St Jacques" has a magnificent deep color. The smell is pure and you can find small black fruits, leather and spice aromas. Powerful and concentration go with a good tannic structure. Its lasting in the mouth is surprising.

This powerful and perfumed wine requires elaborate and strong tasting food: leg of mutton, boeuf bourguignon, stew and strong cheeses (except blue cheese).

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate    The 2014 Gevrey Chambertin 1er Cru Lavaux St Jacques has a Morello cherry and crushed strawberry-scented bouquet with hints of undergrowth and pine in the background. The palate is well balanced with ripe, quite bold tannin. It does not quite have the tension or the finesse of the 2014 Cazetiers, a little stocky and rugged on the finish.

title: Castle Rock Pinot Noir Cuvee 2019
bodyHtml: This Pinot Noir is elegant and medium-bodied, offering aromas of cherry, tea and herbal spice. On the palate, the wine gives flavours of black cherry, plum and spice. It is smooth with a silky texture and mild tannins. This versatile wine pairs well with lamb, chicken, veal, salmon and light pasta dishes.

title: Grant's - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Scotland's oldest continuously family-run blending house uses the knowledge of five generations to create this approachable dram.

title: Brunel de la Gardine Cotes du Rhone 2023
bodyHtml: Juicy, supple and very well balanced. An easy drinking wine that will please all crowds. Pairs well with BBQ steak, burgers, vegetarian dishes such as ratatouille, stuffed vegetables and pesto soup.

title: Luxardo Amaretto - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: This slightly drier version of amaretto shines a brilliant deep amber colour. Look for classic aromas and flavours of sweet almonds, followed by hints of vanilla. Well-rounded with a velvety texture on the palate and just the right amount of sweetness.

title: Spottswoode Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This exceptional white wine originates from the United States, specifically across the premier North Coast regions of Napa County and Sonoma County. Established by Mary Weber Novak, Spottswoode has been a family-owned estate dedicated to crafting wines of extraordinary poise and intention since 1982. Known for an unwavering commitment to organic farming and a philosophy of restraint, the winery is highly celebrated for producing its 'Super Sauvignon', a term coined to describe the world's finest expressions of this noble grape.

Wine Description

Spottswoode Sauvignon Blanc presents a beautiful pale straw colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is expressive and complex, bursting with citrus blossoms, white grapefruit, and lemongrass, accented by hints of white flowers, sage, and wet stone. On the palate, this medium-bodied wine reveals a brilliant balance of succulent texture and lively, tightwire acidity. Flavours of ripe peach, pear, and orange peel unfold beautifully, carrying through to a long, silky finish enriched by a crystalline hint of lemon salt and lingering minerality.

title: Summerhill White Blend Alive Organic 2021
bodyHtml: A juicy blend of organic Gewurztraminer, Riesling, Muscat, Chardonnay, and Ehrenfelser grapes. This masterpiece blend gives aromas of ripe apple, nectarine, orange blossom and spice. Delight in flavours of golden apple, spiced pear, white peach and lime. Deliciously off-dry! Pair with grilled chicken, seafood, or a sunny patio.

title: Masi Modello della Venezie Rosso - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml: The Modello is a medium-bodied red made from Refosco and Raboso, two intriguing local varietals. Fresh aromas of liquorice and fruity blackberries and raspberries. Similar, well-balanced flavours are supported by lively acidity in this easy-to-drink wine. This versatile wine pairs with various dishes such as soups, pasta, and risottos, as well as simple and substantial red-meat dishes or fresh cheeses.

title: House Wine Original Red Blend 2019
bodyHtml:
Created in 2004 in Walla Walla, Washington, House Wine was conceived by ex-rock n’ roll manager and award-winning Washington winemaker Charles Smith. Inspired by the everyday table wines of Europe, Smith's vision was to create a delicious wine at maximum value and quality with an iconic yet simplistic label. 

Fruit-forward wine with intense Blackberry aromatics and a refined oak profile. Full-bodied wine with soft, approachable tannins. Lingering berry fruit flavours round out the finish with good weight.

title: Chronic Cellars Suite Petite Sirah 2021
bodyHtml: Buckle up for a Petite Sirah that’s equally elegant and powerful. A seductive stunner, Suite Petite brings sultry flavors of bursting blackberries, blueberries, anise and a delightfully subtle hint of cacao and baking spices. With balanced tannins and a full mouthfeel, this is one you won’t soon forget!  85% Petite Sirah, 8% Syrah, 7% Grenache.

title: Maker's Mark 101
bodyHtml: The signature Maker's Mark family recipe is brought to you at a higher proof. The front-of-the-tongue, delicious bourbon flavour is there thanks to the soft red winter wheat. It's richer and more intense at a higher proof because everyone cannot visit their little distillery in Loretto, Ky. They've bottled this exclusive 101-proof edition so you, too, can experience the bolder side of their refined wheat whisky.

title: Attems Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
This premium white wine originates from Italy, within the renowned Friuli Venezia Giulia region under the Friuli DOC. The history of the Attems winery dates back to 1106, establishing it as one of the most historic winegrowing dynasties in the area. In 2000, ownership was acquired by the acclaimed Frescobaldi family, ensuring the preservation of the estate's rich viticultural heritage while enhancing its focus on terroir driven quality.

Wine Description

The Attems Pinot Grigio displays a soft straw yellow colour in the glass. The nose is fine and richly detailed, offering inviting aromas of white plum and lime blossom accompanied by a delicate dash of vanilla. On the palate, this medium bodied wine delivers a refreshing profile that strikes a perfect balance between vibrant citrus acidity and a velvety structure. The finish is remarkably clean, crisp, and refreshing.

title: Chateau Tour Bayard 2023
bodyHtml:
This classic Right Bank dry red wine originates from France, produced in the prestigious Montagne-Saint-Émilion satellite appellation of Bordeaux. Owned by the Richard family since 1928 and currently managed by winemaker Nicole Richard, Château Tour Bayard sits on a prominent clay-limestone plateau (argilo-calcaire) directly overlooking the Saint-Émilion valley. Spanning roughly 15 hectares with vines averaging 35 to 40 years of age, the estate is widely regarded as one of the benchmark properties of Montagne-Saint-Émilion, crafting structured, terroir-expressive wines that rival neighboring Saint-Émilion Grand Cru bottlings in depth and longevity while offering remarkable value.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2023 vintage displays a deep, luminous ruby-garnet color with bright purple reflections near the rim. The expressive nose opens with classic Right Bank aromas of ripe black plum, crushed blackberry, and dark cherry, interwoven with nuanced notes of dried violet, graphite, forest floor, sweet tobacco leaf, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, supple, and finely structured. A generous core of dark berry fruit is framed by polished, chalky tannins—characteristic of its limestone plateau terroir—and a vibrant streak of natural acidity that carries through to a clean, mineral-driven finish. Crafted from a traditional blend dominated by Merlot (typically 70% to 75%), complemented by Cabernet Franc (15% to 20%) and Malbec (around 10%), the hand-harvested grapes undergo traditional temperature-controlled fermentation in concrete and stainless steel vats. The wine is aged for approximately 12 to 15 months in French oak barrels (around 25% to 30% new wood) to integrate structure while preserving pure fruit expression. The alcohol by volume sits around 13.5% to 14.0%.

Food Pairing

The velvety Merlot fruit, chalky tannic backbone, and fresh acidity of this Montagne-Saint-Émilion make it a versatile and classic companion at the dining table. Excellent culinary matches include roasted rack of lamb with herbs de Provence, grilled entrecôte steak with Bordelaise sauce, pan-seared duck breast, and slow-braised beef short ribs. It also complements earthy dishes such as wild mushroom risotto, roasted pork tenderloin, and aged hard cheeses like Comté, Mimolette, or Saint-Nectaire.

title: Borgo Scopeto Chianti Classico 2023
