bodyHtml:
Borgo Scopeto Chianti Classico originates from Italy, specifically within the Chianti Classico region of Tuscany and the subregion of Castelnuovo Berardenga. This historical estate, which dates back to the medieval era, was once a fortified settlement that flourished for centuries under the noble Sozzini family. Today, the property is owned by Elisabetta Gnudi Angelini, who maintains a winemaking philosophy focused on elegance and a deep connection to the estate's unique Tuscan landscape.

Wine Description

This red wine presents deep ruby tones with light burgundy reflections. The aromatic profile is intense and complex, featuring notes of small wild berries, cherries, and flowery hints, complemented by secondary scents of noble wood, vanilla, and cocoa. On the palate, it is well balanced and pleasant, showing a soft mouthfeel supported by a firm tannic texture and bright acidity. The body is medium to full, leading into a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing

This Chianti Classico is exceptionally versatile and pairs beautifully with traditional Tuscan recipes, such as gnocchi with sun-dried tomato pesto or bucatini with sausage and peas. It also serves as an excellent companion to grilled meats, including beef skewers, veal, and roasted vegetables.

title: Absolut Mandrin Vodka
bodyHtml: Clear and colourless; aromas and flavours of sweet, lightly candied, mandarin fruit; the palate is dry, smooth and clean on the finish.

title: Westland Garryana 4|1
bodyHtml:
Westland Garryana 2019 Edition 4|1 is a celebrated release in Westland Distillery's Native Oak Series, which highlights the distinctive influence of Quercus garryana, or Garry oak, a rare oak species native to the Pacific Northwest. This American single malt whiskey is a blend of spirits aged in a combination of cask types, including ex-Rye barrels (29%), ex-Bourbon barrels (29%), new Garry oak casks (19%), Pedro Ximénez sherry hogsheads (16%), and refill Garry oak barrels (7%). The maturation periods range from 44 to 75 months, resulting in a complex and layered whiskey.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: Rich aromas of figgy pudding and creamy pear custard are complemented by notes of crisp apples, cocoa, and a touch of peppermint.
  • Palate: A harmonious interplay of milk chocolate, honey, blueberries, and refreshing peppermint, balanced by the earthy character of oak.
  • Finish: Long and warming, with lingering flavours of dark fruit and gentle spice.

Production Details
This whiskey is bottled at 50% ABV and represents the distillery’s dedication to innovation and regional character in American single malt whiskey. The 2019 release comprised 3,750 bottles, making it a sought-after and limited-edition offering.

Food Pairing
The robust and nuanced profile of Westland Garryana makes it an excellent pairing for grilled meats, rich cheeses, or dark chocolate desserts.

title: Mazzei Badiola di Fonterutoli 2021
bodyHtml: An 'Everyday Super Tuscan', this red blend has a deep, inky purple color. On the nose, intense aromas of red berries and cocoa. Soft and smooth on the palate, with flavors of wild blackberries and raspberries; well balanced, with great depth and a long finish.

title: Gabbiano Bellezza Chianti Classico 2018
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the esteemed Chianti Classico D.O.C.G. appellation of Tuscany (specifically the San Casciano in Val di Pesa sub-zone). Produced by the historic Castello di Gabbiano estate whose winemaking heritage in the heart of Chianti Classico dates back to 1124 "Bellezza" represents the top tier of the region's quality pyramid as a Gran Selezione. Sourced entirely from a single, prized 12-hectare vineyard plot (Vigna Bellezza), the vines are rooted in stony, well-draining soils composed of calcareous marl (galestro) and clay-limestone (alberese). Positioned at an elevation that captures generous daylight balanced by cool nightly breezes off the Tuscan hills, this singular site yields low quantities of concentrated Sangiovese with exceptional phenolic maturity, structural tension, and age-worthy minerality.

Wine Description

Castello di Gabbiano "Bellezza" Chianti Classico Gran Selezione presents an intense, deep ruby-garnet color in the glass with subtle brick shimmers along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, offering an expressive single-vineyard portrayal of classic northern Tuscan terroir. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of ripe red cherries, dark plums, and wild strawberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of sweet pipe tobacco, leather, dried lavender, ground spices, and a distinct whiff of flint and crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, compact, and precisely focused, delivering a succulent core of red stone fruits, blood orange zest, and cocoa. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a lively, mouthwatering vein of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad yet athletic, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into a long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of cedar, dried herbs, and earth.

title: Il Paradiso di Manfredi Rosso di Montalcino 2018
bodyHtml: Il Paradiso di Manfredi produces some of the finest Brunello di Montalcino available. They are a small, family-owned winery that works in a distinctively low-tech manner, organically and biodynamically farming a mere 2.5 hectares of Sangiovese wines. The Rosso di Montalcino has incredible freshness, lovely fruit character, and perfect balance.

title: Markham Merlot 2021
bodyHtml: Markham Estate Vineyards provide the backbone to this Napa Valley Merlot. Aromas of plum jam and coffee emerge from the glass, enhanced by toffee and cedar notes from oak aging. Juicy black cherry flavours on the palate meld beautifully with a rich, velvety dark chocolate character on the long, round finish.

title: Marques De Riscal Rioja Gran Reserva 2019
bodyHtml: Marqués de Riscal Gran Reserva is a timeless wine that represents almost two centuries of the winemaker’s skill. It has the traditional style of the Rioja Alavesa, recalling the aspirations of the founders of the bodega back in the 19th century. The experience and know-how of the bodega ensure that the best vintages of this wine will keep for 50 years or more in the bottle, preserving a delicious flavor for sure. A wine for eternity. Marqués de Riscal wines have been honoured with the highest international distinctions, as well as numerous awards.

title: Old Ballantruan Speyside Glenlivet
bodyHtml: Old Ballantruan is a single malt distilled at the Tomintoul Distillery in Speyside. Unusually for the region, this is a heavily-peated whisky. Ballantruan is the name of the water source the distillery utilizes. This is bottled at 100 proof and is not chill-filtered.

title: Z. Alexander Brown Uncaged Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
The brainchild of Grammy Award winning musician Zac Brown, the Z. Alexander Uncaged is a powerful, full-bodied red with supple tannins and a long, silky finish. Made in partnership with the Delicato Family, Zac and his winemaker John Killebrew have access to some of the best vineyards in California, including sites in Napa Valley. 

Rich aromas of black cherry, cola and mocha. Bold tannins frame a powerful mid-palate layered with mouth-filling flavours of ripe blackberry, black currant and chocolate covered cherry, as well as subtle hints of baking spice. Smooth balanced, an elegant finesse defines the long and lingering finish. Pairs well with grilled Fillet Mignon, robust pasta, blue cheese.

title: Wakefield Clare Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
The wine has an aroma of rich blackcurrant, subtle spice, tomato leaf and a touch of eucalypt. French oak maturation is also evident with subtle aromas of cedar and dark chocolate.

This is a wine of great intensity. It has distinctive blackcurrant and cassis fruit flavours. Subtle oak characters of cedar cigar box and spice are also evident. The tannins are fine and elegant – a hallmark of the varietal. The palate is well balanced, complex and fulfilling and lingers on the finish.

title: Duckhorn Pinot Noir Migration 2022
bodyHtml: Migration is dedicated to crafting wines from the finest cool-climate wine-growing regions highlighting lush fruit, bright acidity and impeccably balanced oak. This dedication has taken us to the storied vineyards of California's Sonoma Coast, where clockwork fog and Goldridge sandy loam soils have contributed to a Pinot Noir with beautiful high-tone red fruit flavours of cherry, cranberry and strawberry and enticing hints of orange-cinnamon spice.

title: Balblair 25 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Balblair 25 Year Old Single Malt

Balblair 25 Year Old is a distinguished single malt Scotch whisky from the Balblair Distillery, one of Scotland's oldest distilleries, located in the Highlands. This expression has matured for over a quarter of a century, developing a rich and complex character that reflects the distillery's commitment to quality and tradition.

Maturation Process

  • Initial Aging: Matured in American oak ex-bourbon casks, imparting vanilla and subtle oak flavors.
  • Secondary Maturation: Further aged in Spanish oak butts, enhancing the whisky with depth and complexity.

Tasting Notes

  • Color: Hot copper.
  • Aroma: Indulgent overripe apricots and dark liquorice stand out against polished oak and a touch of saddle wax.
  • Palate: Full-bodied with oily citrus, chocolate praline, and a faint note of fresh tobacco leaf.
  • Finish: Warming with smooth chocolate and blood oranges.

Alcohol Content

Bottled at 46% ABV, non-chill filtered, and natural color, preserving the whisky's authentic character.

Serving Suggestions

  • Neat: Enjoying it straight allows the intricate flavors to shine.
  • With Water: Adding a few drops of water can open up additional aromatic layers.
  • Food Pairings: Complements rich desserts like dark chocolate torte or spiced fruitcake.

title: Louis Roederer Cristal Brut 2012 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
In 1876, Tsar Alexander II, already a great lover of Louis Roederer wines, asked Louis Roederer to "take the exercise still further" and create a cuvée for his personal use which was unique, in terms of both its style and the bottle. So Louis Roederer offered him an exceptional crystal bottle, holding the fruit of vines selected from the seven great crus on his estate. The Chardonnay and Pinot Noir grapes provide the subtle, precise balance that has now become synonymous with the leading prestige cuvee of Champagne.

Amber hue with green and orange tints. Fine, even and lively sparkle. Complex and intense bouquet disclosing candied citrus, yellow fruit, Williams pear, pollen, and toasted almond. The delicately seductive bouquet shows intensity and well-honed precision. The wine is powerful, full yet tight, on entry to the palate.

title: Chateau de Purcari Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Chardonnay de Purcari will always remain the king of white wines: gorgeous, distinguished, and intense. It has an open golden colour, with shades of amber. The intense aroma is dominated by flowers and exotic fruits. The full, opulent taste is complex, with notes of almond and vanilla, followed by a long aftertaste dominated harmoniously by shades of ripening. 100% Chardonnay. Made from grapes harvested and selected by hand, produced using traditional methods. Aged for 6 months in French oak barrique. Fresh cheese, salads, grilled turbot fillet with black rice.

title: Chateau de Purcari Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
This crisp and refreshing Pinot Grigio is crafted from hand-harvested grapes which are vinified using traditional local winemaking techniques. To preserve the natural aromatics and freshness of the grape variety the wine is fermented in stainless steel tanks and bottled while still youthful.

The result is a bright and vivacious white wine which is bursting with notes of lemon zest, orchard fruits and hints of dried herbs and floral fragrance. On the palate there is a mouthwatering freshness, light body and pure, clean finish which makes this a great match for seafood, grilled fish and chicken, sushi and leafy salads. It’s also a great choice to enjoy on a hot summer’s day as an aperitif in the garden or by the pool, perhaps alongside a platter of cheeses or charcuterie.

title: Grizzly Paw Grumpy Bear Honey Wheat - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Grumpy Bear Honey Wheat is one of the most beloved year-round offerings from Canmore’s Grizzly Paw Brewing Company. Despite its intimidating name, this beer is famously easygoing and sweet-natured. It belongs to the American Wheat Ale family, but with a distinctly Albertan twist: the addition of local honey. It is designed to be a "comfort beer" soft, smooth, and subtly sweet making it a favorite for those who want a bit more body and "soul" than a light lager provides.

Beer Description

Grumpy Bear pours a hazy, pale straw-yellow typical of unfiltered wheat beers with a frothy white head and a soft, inviting glow.

Aroma: The nose is delicate and "sunny." It leads with the scent of freshly baked bread and sweet clover honey, followed by a light, floral perfume. There is a faint, spicy note from the yeast and hops, but the dominant impression is one of natural, unrefined sweetness.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a creamy, "pillowy" mouthfeel provided by the high wheat content. It leads with a gentle, honey-drenched grain flavor, followed by a soft malt backbone. The bitterness is almost non-existent, serving only to keep the honey from feeling syrupy. The finish is smooth and clean, with a lingering hint of wildflower sweetness.

Profile: It sits at an ABV of 5.0% and a very low bitterness of 14 IBU, ensuring maximum "crushability."

Technical Notes: This beer is brewed using a significant proportion of malted wheat, which gives it its signature hazy appearance and silky texture. The "secret ingredient" is 100% pure Alberta honey, added during the brewing process. Unlike honey-flavored sodas, the yeast ferments most of the sugar in the honey, leaving behind the complex floral aromatics and a subtle "honey-kissed" finish rather than a heavy, cloying sweetness.

title: Old Pulteney 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
General Information

Matured for 18 years, this is indulgent and spicy thanks to the casks selected for maturation.

Taking its character and colour entirely from the casks within which it has been nurtured, this is a deeply warming whisky.  The indulgence extends through this single malt with chocolate and spice defining the character but allowing for the influence of more vibrant zesty flavours. 46% alc./vol.

title: Diebolt Vallois Blanc de Blancs 'Prestige'
bodyHtml:
General Information 

The Diebolt-Vallois Champagne "Blanc de Blancs Prestige" is made entirely from vines of Grands Crus Côte des Blancs. Fermentation in thermostatically controlled vats. This is a blend of three years' wines aged in oak casks. These reserve wines bring richness, complexity and roundness.

title: Travaglini Gattinara 2015 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
#54 Wine Spectator Top 100 of 2020!  Gattinara best expresses the classic qualities of the appellation; it is a wine with marked minerality and complexity. Deep ruby red in color with garnet reflections. On the nose, aromas of red fruit, blackberry, plum and licorice with hints of vanilla and leather. Full-bodied palate, with intense flavors of cherry, raspberry and spice culminating in a long and smooth finish. Outstanding with red meat, game, and hard cheeses. 

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast    Aromas of underbrush, camphor and dark spice shape the nose along with a whiff of blue flower. The firmly structured, medium-bodied palate offers dried black cherry, star anise, clove and tobacco framed in tight, close-grained tannins. Drink 2023–2030.

92 Points - Wine Spectator    Bursting with sweet, ripe cherry and plum fruit, this Gattinara also evokes salty licorice, loam, leather and rose hip notes. Firm and balanced, with a minerally aftertaste. Drink now through 2028.

title: D'Arenberg The Stump Jump White 2021
bodyHtml: Lively and expressive with lovely white floral notes, white peach and lychee. Stunning and refreshing. This Australian white wine is a blend of Riesling, Sauvignon Blanc, Marsanne and Roussanne grapes. Mouth-watering acidity makes it a terrific food companion for dishes such as grilled chicken.

title: Merryvale Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: Bright, fresh and vibrant while rooted with a savory core, this is pure Napa in a glass. Aromas of leather, tobacco, cassis, and dried herbs dance with savory spices and blue fruits. The wine unfolds in layers, showcasing a finesse that belies its power. Medium-bodied with bright acidity that perfectly complements the fine grain tannins.

title: Black Stallion Chardonnay Los Carneros 2023
bodyHtml: Aromas of yellow pear, lemon curd, jasmine and a hint of oak lead to citrus, chamomile, orange blossom and brown butter flavours. A rich mid-palate weight creates a complex wine with a lingering finish. Delicious as an aperitif and excellent with "frutta del mare": crab, lobster or grilled shrimp.

title: Johnnie Walker Green
bodyHtml: Their only Scotch blended entirely with single malts. Johnnie Walker Green Label is a hidden gem with vibrant secrets to reveal, and with malts from the four corners of Scotland, aged for at least 15 years, it captures the distinct flavours of each landscape in perfect balance. A whisky that’s in harmony with nature.

title: Raymond Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve Selection 2021
bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon opens with a beautiful bouquet of blackcurrants, espresso, and notes of violet. An array of dense dark fruit flavours of rhubarb, dark cherry, and blackberries are layered with blackcurrants, clove, and orange peel. This is a full-bodied and structured wine with well integrated and supple tannins and a richly textured finish that coats the palate.

title: Old Pulteney 25 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Aged firstly in American oak, its spicy sweetness was later granted depth and colour by casks of Spanish oak. Elegant and charismatic, this wonderful whisky embodies both Wick’s spirit of endurance and Pulteney Distillery’s devotion to its craft.

Bitter chocolate and creamy vanilla with hints of toffee, followed by a long and spicy finish.

46% alc./vol

title: Henry Of Pelham Baco Noir 2023
bodyHtml: Deeply coloured, spicy, blueberry compote flavours with natural currant and briar patch fruit. Displays startling intensity that will increase in complexity over the next five years.

title: Bunnahabhain 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: A giant leap forward for Bunnahabhain 12yo, this edition was launched in the summer of 2010 with a jump in strength to 46.3% and a declaration of no chill-filtration and no added colouring. The producers deserve enormous credit for giving punters what they want without jacking up the price too much and we earnestly hope that this will be a massive success. Bravo!

title: Labruyere Moulin a Vent Le Carquelin 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This exceptional red wine comes from France, specifically the Beaujolais region and the Cru appellation of Moulin-à-Vent. 'Le Carquelin' is a single-parcel selection (sélection parcellaire) from Domaine Labruyère, one of the oldest wineries in the Moulin-à-Vent appellation. The estate was established in 1850 by Jean-Marie Labruyère in the hamlet of Les Thorins. Since 2008, Edouard Labruyère has imbued the estate with a new dynamic, convinced that their plots are located on the best terroirs of the region, and the Domaine is today considered a spearhead of the Beaujolais region. Domaine Labruyère is also under the same ownership as Domaine Jacques Prieur in Meursault on the Côte de Beaune.

Wine Description

The wine presents a beautiful, intense ruby colour with purple reflections. The aroma is fresh, discreet, and saline, with a touch of rose and juicy red cherry. With time, the nose opens up with more intensity and an interesting hint of sapidity, revealing crunchy wild berries, a 'foxy' touch, and undergrowth. Other reviewers note aromas of mulberries, violets, cloves, and purple plums.

The wine is 100% Gamay. It is medium-bodied, cool, and juicy on the palate. Notes include cherry, blackberry, and wild strawberry, or black fruit, cocoa, dark chocolate, and liquorice. It is also described as fresh and fruity, silky and floral, or having a velvety, silky mouthfeel with excellent balance and freshness. The tannins are supple, refreshing, and digestible, or saline and persistent, but measured. The finish is persistent until the end, often showing a note of leather, blackberry skin, and undergrowth. The optimal drinking window is now up to 2029, and it can also repay ageing.

The single-parcel 'Le Carquelin' spans 1.75 hectares. The terroir features a light, sandy clay and acid soil that is poor in organic matter and presents the typical pink colour of the Cru. The subsoil is highly altered granite. The 50-year-old vines (on average) are hand-harvested and 100% destemmed. The wine is aged partly in demi-muids and the rest in 228 L oak barrels for 12 months, followed by 6 months in a concrete vat.

title: Glenfarclas 17 Year Old Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
A delicious, richly sherried Glenfarclas aged for 17 years and launched for the travel retail market. Loads of character and depth, just what we've come to expect from the distillery. 

Nose: Complex and sophisticated, notes of buttery toffee, malt sherried peels, dates and even a hint of peat!

Palate: Full-bodied and rich, it fills and coats the palate with warming nutmeg, sherried fruits, cinnamon and mixed peels.

Finish: Long, spicy and sweet with just a hint of smoke on the tail.

title: Sterling Vineyards Platinum 2012
bodyHtml:
Sterling's first step in making Platinum is to select the best fruit. The second step is to respect that fruit, using a restrained hand in winemaking. They hand-harvested the fruit at the peak of maturity, then put it through a multi-level sorting process, keeping the berries fully intact. In this way, they started their wine with perfectly ripe berries, balanced acids and mature tannins.

The use of small lot fermentation in a majority of stainless steel captures the inherent flavors in the fruit to maintain freshness, and color. The wine was aged for 21 months in French oak barrels, 60 percent new, to impart a gentle dusting of spice and depth of flavor.

91 Points - Wine Spectator     Smooth, complex and layered, offering mocha-scented oak, ripe, snappy blueberry and blackberry fruit, with anise, cedar and espresso notes, all sailing along on the finish. The balance of acidity, tannins and fruit is evident. Cabernet Sauvignon and Malbec. Drink now through 2024.

90 Points - Wilfred Wong of Wine     The 2012 Sterling Vineyards Platinum Red Blend offers a sturdy and multi-layered example of a Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon. Showing beautiful black fruit, with a hint of dust and tar, this wine is well suited for braised meats. Drinking quite well now.(Tasted: May 9, 2016, San Francisco, CA)

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast     Thick like a chocolaty malt, this full-bodied, robust wine is big and rich, concentrated and layered in tobacco and jam. Despite its size, it is drinkable now, with well-integrated tannins and a complete finish.

title: Glenmorangie Signet
bodyHtml: Signet begins with our precious chocolate malt spirit, made just once a year in our giraffe-high stills. Its espresso-like intensity fills our Distillery with aromas more familiar in an Italian coffee bar. Over the years, we temper its power with rare and treasured casks. Bourbon for creaminess. Sherry for sweetness. The spice of virgin charred oak. All balanced by some of the oldest whisky we own. The result? A velvet explosion of flavour. Bursts of bitter mocha, sizzling spice and waves of dark chocolate, mellowed by smooth butterscotch. Whisky, as you have never tasted it before.

title: Redbreast 21 Year Old
bodyHtml: The oldest expression from Redbreast so far, this is a combination of malted and unmalted barley matured in a mixture of bourbon barrels and first-fill oloroso casks, resulting in a rich and complex whiskey.

title: Masciarelli Montepulciano D'Abruzzo 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine is from Italy, produced in the Abruzzo region within the Montepulciano d'Abruzzo appellation. Masciarelli Tenute Agricole was founded in 1981 by Gianni Masciarelli, a pioneer who transformed the reputation of Abruzzese wines by introducing innovative vineyard management and high density planting to the region. The winery's philosophy emphasizes 100% estate production, with vineyards farmed sustainably across all four provinces of Abruzzo to express the unique diversity of the local terroir.

Wine Description

The Masciarelli Montepulciano d'Abruzzo displays a deep ruby red colour. The nose is intense and complex, offering aromas of dark cherry, blackberry, and redcurrant alongside subtle floral notes of violet and savory hints of tobacco and leather. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with a fleshy texture, featuring flavours of ripe wild berries, plum, and attractive smoky or spicy notes. It is characterized by its vibrant acidity, elastic tannins, and a long, fresh finish. This 100% Montepulciano wine typically has an ABV of 13.5% and is intended to be consumed in its youth, generally within 3 to 5 years of the vintage.

title: Tesseron XO Lot No. 53 Perfection Cognac
bodyHtml:
The wonderful, heady aromatic tang, borne of long wood ageing is immediately compelling, giving way to hints of wood, dried fruits & tobacco. An extremely appetizing cognac, opulent, rounded, yet vivacious. Pepper and spices emerge initially before revealing dark chocolate and fresh herbs. Complex, it shows supreme finesse, supple opulence and very good length.

See More Cognac

title: Felsina Fontalloro Toscana 2018
bodyHtml: Ruby red color with rich and intense tones. Variety of aromatic herbs accentuated with generous notes of tobacco and wet earth (dry earth, as well), black currant, and licorice. The palate manifests good consistency of medium-smooth tannins to ensure lengthy aging. Rich structure and weight and elegant breed on the finish. Optimum cellar life in all vintages.

title: Aizu Homare Banshu Yamada Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
The Homare Sake Brewery was established in 1918 by Kosaku Karahashi and has remained under the leadership of the Karahashi family for generations. Situated at the foot of Mount Iide, the brewery is celebrated for its award winning craftsmanship and its picturesque 4,000 square metre Japanese garden.

Description

Often referred to as the 'Black Label', this premium sake is brewed using high quality Yamada Nishiki rice from the Banshu region, polished down to 40%. It presents an intense aromatic style with a sensory profile featuring refreshing mango, jackfruit, and tropical cassis. On the palate, it is described as soft, round, and highly viscous with a creamy texture reminiscent of 'velvet personified'. The finish is well balanced with integrated sweetness and a refreshing clarity. It has an alcohol content of 16%.

Food Pairing

The clean and elegant structure of this Junmai Daiginjo makes it a superb match for delicate seafood such as sashimi tuna, sea urchin (uni), and pink shrimp. Its tropical notes and soft sweetness also allow it to complement richer dishes like uni pasta or even spicy tantanmen. For a balanced experience, it is best served chilled in a white wine glass to fully appreciate its complex 'ginjo-ka' aromas.

title: Bruno Rocca Langhe Nebbiolo 'Fralu' 2021
bodyHtml: The Langhe Nebbiolo of Bruno Rocca Fralu is a wine produced with Nebbiolo grapes cultivated in the youngest wine yards of this winery. After refinement of 8-12 months in French oak barriques, the wine became elegant and harmonic, with a great ruby red color. The aroma has an intense, full and fruity bouquet, with strawberry, ripe cherry and plum notes. The Fralu has a good structure and important tannins; it has a pleasant taste, and persistent. It is perfect if drunk with fresh pasta and meat sauce, roasted and braised meats and aging cheeses.

title: McGuinness Creme de Menthe Green
bodyHtml: With its cool mint aromas and flavours, McGuinness Crème de Menthe Green is both delicious and refreshing. Dark green with intense mint aromas and flavour, this is a key ingredient in the classic Grasshopper cocktail.

title: Yellow Spot Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Under the hustle and bustle of cobbled Dublin streets in the early 1900s, a rare whiskey was quietly making a name for itself. The simple act of marking barrels with spots of coloured paint would not only signify their age potential, but would become the namesake for this coveted whiskey, bonded and bottled by The Mitchells, a seventh generation family business.

Rather than being simply a ‘finished’ whiskey, Yellow Spot is special in that it contains whiskey that has been matured for a full 12 year period in three oak cask types: American bourbon barrels, Spanish sherry butts, and uniquely, Spanish Malaga casks. The Malaga cask brings an exotic sweet note to the whiskey making it a truly delightful taste experience. Only extremely limited quantities of Yellow Spot have been bottled making it a whiskey to seek out and savour as a true rarity.

title: Cruzan Black Strap Rum
bodyHtml: A mixologist favorite, Cruzan Black Strap Rum features robust licorice and molasses flavors that add an exotic element to you tropical favorites. Its most popular pairings include flavors such as lemon, lime, ginger and pineapple. Best enjoyed as a finishing element, or floated on tropical Tiki cocktails. It’s also great for adding color to drinks with its deep black hue.

title: Elio Sandri Langhe Nebbiolo 2022
bodyHtml:
Elio Sandri is a small, organic-certified producer, or 'boutique grower,' located in Monforte d’Alba, home to the Cascina Disa estate. The winery maintains an ultra-traditional, low-intervention philosophy that results in elegant, terroir-driven wines.

Wine Description

The Elio Sandri Langhe Nebbiolo displays a brilliant ruby red colour that can evolve into a garnet hue within a year. The aromatic profile is lovely, bright, and nuanced with notes of crushed flowers, mint, tobacco, spice, and cedar. Other common aromas include rose, liquorice, and wild cherry. On the palate, the wine is elegant and structured, with a velvety texture, showing flavours of bold cherry, spice, and liquorice.

Food Pairing

This structured and gutsier Langhe Nebbiolo is superb for pairing with hearty, meaty dishes, game, truffles, and strong Piemontese cheese.

title: Cade Cabernet Sauvignon Howell Mountain 2018
bodyHtml:
The resulting wine is fantastic with aromas of clove, cranberry, raspberry, coffee, cinnamon, black pepper, and coco nibs. Gloriously pure notes of boysenberry, graphite, blackberry, coffee, and dark chocolate soar from the glass and cascade over the palate. The wine is full-bodied, with an opulent, velvety texture, pure, rich with firm tannins and bold structure that is classic Howell Mountain.

95 Points - Jeb Dunnuck 

The 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Estate comes all from the estate on Howell Mountain and is 87% Cabernet Sauvignon, 6% Malbec, and the balance Merlot and Petit Verdot. More blue fruits, bay leaf, candied violets, orange blossom, and floral notes emerge from this full-bodied beauty, which reveals a rounded, sexy texture, polished tannins, and a great finish. Give bottles just a few years in the cellar and it's going to keep for 15+.

95 Points - Vinous

The 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Estate is a sumptuous Howell Mountain Cabernet. It offers up an exciting mélange of dark red/purplish fruit, rose petal, spice, game, mint and blood orange. More than anything else, the Estate Cabernet delivers plenty of Howell Mountain richness, with nicely softened tannins that make it a total pleasure to taste.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This has both grippy mountain fruit characteristics as well as a sleekness, with racy-edged black currant, fig and blackberry fruit lined with bramble, apple wood and licorice snap notes. Features a strong finishing kick of fruit at the end, too. Best from 2023 through 2035.

title: Domaine Faiveley Mercurey 'La Framboisiere' 2022
bodyHtml: This wine reveals a powerful, fruity nose combining rich notes of red and black fruits and a subtle hint of oak. La Framboisière offers a powerful palate dominated by crunchy red fruits. Its velvety tannins and exceptional length make it a pleasure to drink. Serve with beef wellington, game stew with chestnuts, capon with morel mushrooms, lemon and chocolate cake.

title: Castello di Bossi Chianti Classico 2018
bodyHtml:
Deep, ruby-red in color, this Chianti Classico offers aromas of ripe cherries and red plums, with subtle notes of toasted vanilla beans and purple flowers. On the palate, the wine displays a superbly structured character with bright acidity and a pleasantly savory finish.Pair this wine with grilled steak tips and ratatouille.

92 Points - James Suckling     A lively Chianti Classico with aromas and flavors of black cherries, as well as some sour-cherry and burnt-lemon notes. It’s medium-bodied with fine tannins and a fresh, vivid finish. Just the right amount of bitterness at the end. Drink or hold.

title: Redbreast 12 Year Old Cask Strength
bodyHtml:
Redbreast 12-Year Old Cask Strength Irish Whiskey is one of only a few cask strength Irish Whiskeys out there today, a far cry from the Scotch world. It may have something to do with the fact that Redbreast is owned by Irish Distillers, the company that also owns Jameson, Midleton, and Powers, making it by far the largest and most influential Irish whiskey producer. Redbreast 12-Year-Old Cask Strength Edition isn't simply the excellent Redbreast 12-Year-Old bottled at a higher ABV, the whiskeys used for each batch are specially selected for these superb natural cask strength releases. A must-try.

Redbreast 12 takes off with a medium to dark orange, apple, date, and prune fruitiness rounded out by honey, vanilla, toasted oak, fresh grassiness, cinnamon, and licorice. Because of the fairly prominent caramel, toasted oak, and cinnamon notes, this smells more like a fruitier bourbon than a single malt whiskey. There is some alcohol kick, but it’s not noteworthy. Swirling wafts more caramel and citrus first, followed by vanilla, apple, date, and berry then fragrant toasted oak, cinnamon, and hay. It’s an interesting dance of bright and dark sweetness between apple, date, and berry. The scents generally have a nice roundness, richness, and definition between fruit, oak, and spice that are wonderful to smell.

title: Renato Ratti Barolo Marcenasco 2020
bodyHtml: Noble and generous, the glory of old Piedmont, a wine suitable for long aging. Barolo is the absolute master of the table. It conquers the palate with the conviction of strength, harmony and fullness and holds its sway at length. Full-bodied and elegant with traces of liquorice and tobacco. Barolo Marcenasco has ancient origins. There are historical documents from the "Rigestum Communis Albae" that bear witness to the cultivation of the Nebbiolo wine in the "Marcenascum" area already back in the 12th Century. Red meats on the spit or grilled, game, "grande cuisine" white and red meat dishes and aged cheeses.

title: El Petit Bonhomme Red 2023
bodyHtml: Sweet and rich plummy generous red fruits on the nose with a hint of toasted oak. Clean and freshly balanced on the palate, full bodied and soft rounded tannins. Long intense spicy and liquorice smooth finish.

title: Caorunn Gin
bodyHtml: Carefully handcrafted in the Scottish Highlands, Caorunn expertly infuses five locally foraged gin botanicals. Artisanal and small batch, beautifully mixing the rugged charm of Speyside with the urban sophistication of modern Scotland.

title: Valenciso Rioja Reserva 2019
bodyHtml: Produced by the Valenciso winery, one of the most prestigious names of modern Rioja, Valenciso Reserva is a varietal Tempranillo. The grapes are sourced from low-yielding vines with clay-limestone soils located in Ollauri, Briones, Rodezno, Haro and Villalba, and Rioja Alta. It is worth mentioning that this Spanish red wine from La Rioja has won considerable public and critical acclaim over the last few years. So much so, that its classy blue label decorated with a silver leaf has already become a quality trademark.

title: Tapiz Malbec 'Black Tears' 2021
bodyHtml:
Tapiz Black Tears Malbec is a distinguished wine from Argentina's Uco Valley, crafted exclusively from Malbec grapes sourced from the San Pablo Estate. This single-vineyard selection reflects the region's unique terroir and the meticulous winemaking practices of Bodega Tapiz.

Tasting Notes

  • Color: Intense purplish-red hue.

  • Aroma: Ripe red fruits, dried plums, figs, and fruit compote, with subtle floral and menthol nuances.

  • Palate: Rich flavors of dark chocolate and roasted coffee, complemented by sweet, ripe tannins, leading to an elegant and balanced finish.

Food Pairing

This Malbec pairs well with grilled meats, hearty stews, and aged cheeses, making it a versatile choice for various cuisines.

title: Barcelo Imperial Rum
bodyHtml: An excellent Dominican rum, Barceló Imperial was awarded a Gold Medal and also the coveted "Best In Category" title at the 2008 International Cane Spirits Festival. This is aged for between 4 and 10 years, and offers a superb flavour profile.

title: Domaine des Lambrays Morey St Denis 2013
bodyHtml: Very mild reduction doesn't completely mask the floral and earth nuances though it does push the fruit to the background. There is fine detail and a really lovely texture to the middle-weight flavours that possess plenty of underlying tension on the dusty, balanced and lingering finish. This is a very good Morey Villages and worth a look.

title: Poli Sarpa Big Momma Grappa - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: A big bouquet of roses, jasmine, and other heady summer blooms upon entry, plus a whiff of summer Concord grapes. On the palate, it's delightfully waxy and grapey, giving way to spiced notes and mint tea on the finish.

title: Twomey Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml: Floral, tropical passionfruit and guava, citrus, mandarin, kumquat and lemon lime. Refreshing acidity, rosehips, ginger, hazelnut, candied orange. Pair with Prosciutto wrapped cantaloupe or perhaps halibut with a thyme butter sauce.

title: Pahlmeyer Merlot 2021
bodyHtml:
This opulent and structured red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the premier Napa Valley region in California. Founded in 1986 by Jayson Pahlmeyer, the estate is renowned for its "Proprietary Red" and its exceptional work with Merlot, which Jayson famously insisted be "world-class" from the very first vintage. The winemaking philosophy, currently led by winemaker Katie Vogt, focuses on high-elevation mountain vineyards to produce a wine that balances the varietal's natural plushness with a sophisticated, structural intensity.

Wine Description

Pahlmeyer Merlot presents a flamboyant and generous profile. The sensory profile features a "dynamic interplay" of intensity and vibrancy, with an aromatic nose of brambly blackberry, black cherry, and wild raspberry, layered with hints of crushed peppercorn, fresh sage, and forest floor. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and "velvety," showcasing a rich core of dark plum and fresh fig underpinned by savory notes of tobacco leaf, cocoa nib, and mocha. It is characterized by its plush tannins and a long, lifted finish carried by a touch of violet and warm spice.

title: Megahertz Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.

title: Craggy Range Pinot Noir 'Te Muna Road Vineyard' 2024
bodyHtml: In the cool-climate region of Martinborough, the 81.5 acres terraced Te Muna Road Vineyard is planted with eight clones of Pinot Noir in more than 40 different parcels. On the vineyard's two distinct terraces, stony soils produce exceptional Pinot Noir.

title: Sand Point Family Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon is bold and flavoursome with aromas and flavours of fresh dark cherry and ripe raspberry. You’ll enjoy a juicy mouthfeel balanced by soft spice notes from oak aging.

title: Gosset Blanc de Blancs
bodyHtml:
Pale golden yellow; the fine, steady bubbles rise gracefully. The nose is both mineral and floral, revealing aromas of flowers, white fruits, apricots, Mirabelle plum and light notes of lemon, citrus fruit, quince jelly and honey. White flowers mingle with a hint of toastiness. There is a silky and harmonious sensation for this crisp, structured champagne.

The Grand Blanc de Blancs Brut makes the perfect apéritif; its freshness also makes it ideal for pairing with many dishes, including scallops, crab remoulade or gougères.

title: Jean Marc Brocard Chablis 'Montmains' Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml: White gold colour with a green reflection. On the nose, hints of citrus, grapefruit and anise. The mouth is salt, chopped, dense, lemony and refreshing with an excellent length.

title: Barrel Burner Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Ripe cherry and blackberry aromas dominate with classic Cabernet hints of cassis, cedar and cigar box. On the palate, broad, fruity and mouth-watering entry with persistent blackberry fruit, and balanced, intense mid-palate and firm finish. A crowd-pleasing glass of wine with or without food, but a table will match beautifully with hearty stews, grilled meats, steaks, vegetables or ripe cheese.

title: Bollinger Special Cuvee (NV) - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
A golden colour, distinctive of black grape varieties. Wonderful bubbles. On the nose, it has a beautiful aromatic complexity, ripe fruit, and spicy aromas, with hints of roasted apples, apple compote and peaches. On the palate, there is a subtle combination of structure, length, and vivacity. The bubbles are like velvet. Flavours of pear, brioche and spicy aromas, notes of fresh walnut. Pair with all fish, especially sushi and sashimi, shellfish such as shrimp, prawns, crayfish and grilled lobster, poultry and white meat, cashews, parmesan or prosciutto.

96 Points - Decanter

60% Pinot Noir, 25% Chardonnay, 15% Meunier sourced from more than 300 crus, including 85% Grands and Premiers crus; 15% fermented in old oak barrels. The complexity and richness of Special Cuvée are unparalleled among the entry non-vintage blends of every Champagne house, short of ascending to the mesosphere of Krug. Its grand recipe explains why built on the incredible depth of 50%-60% reserves. Triumphant complexity is a given at Bollinger, but the dynamic freshness and vitality set it apart as one of the most affordable Champagne benchmarks.

title: Trapiche Malbec Gran Medalla 2022
bodyHtml: Blueberries, dried herbs, cedar and espresso on the nose. It's full-bodied with firm, velvety tannins. Intense and creamy with a polished, chocolatey finish. Very precise at the end. Enjoy the energy now.

title: Borgogno 'No Name' 2022
bodyHtml: 'No Name' is a structured, intense and elegant red wine, born in Barolo area with aging for 36 months in big oak barrels. The aromatic profile is rich and complex, with scents of red flowers, violets, aromatic herbs and red fruits. The taste is long, savoury and fresh, with smooth tannins. A wine you won't soon forget! A Nebbiolo with a great structure. It goes perfectly with the great classics of Piedmontese cuisine, such as wild game meat and braised meat.

title: Laphroaig Quarter Cask
bodyHtml:
Because the second maturation takes place in smaller, quarter-sized casks, the spirit has more contact with wood. This lends hints of coconut, banana and vanilla to the instantly recognizable Laphroaig flavour of smoky peat complemented by a surprising sweetness.

It should be enjoyed alone, over ice or with a splash of water to fully pay tribute to the unique flavour. Laphroaig Quarter Cask begins its maturation in ex-bourbon barrels and, while still aging, is transferred to small quarter casks. Aging in smaller barrels revives an old tradition, paying tribute to the master distillers who have perfected the Laphroaig process over two centuries.

title: Pol Roger Cuvee Sir Winston Churchill 2018
bodyHtml:
The Cuvee Sir Winston Churchill, a prestigious cuvee from Maison Pol Roger, was created in homage to Sir Winston Churchill, with references to the qualities he appreciated in Champagne: robustness, structure and maturity. Even if its exact composition is a secret jealously guarded by members of the Pol-Roger family, it is undeniable that it is based on a formula that its dedicatee would not have denied.

"My tastes are simple, I am easily satisfied with what is best", he liked to say...

Composed exclusively of grapes from the Grands Crus of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay already in production under the era Churchillian, it is only made in the best vintages. The predominance of Pinot Noir undoubtedly ensures the structure, fullness and robustness of the whole, while Chardonnay gives it elegance, finesse and impertinence.

96 Points - Vinous

The 2018 Cuvée Sir Winston Churchill is an elegant, polished wine very much in the gracious, lighter style of the year. Subtle citrus inflections, white peach, flowers, mint and white pepper are all beautifully delineated in the glass. Clean mineral notes infuse the vibrant finish. This is an especially airy Churchill, a Champagne built more on finesse and persistence than size. Drink: 2026-2048

title: Clynelish 14 Year Old
bodyHtml: A coastal and peaty single malt, the flagship expression from Clynelish boasts a fabulous flavour profile filled with its distinctive waxy notes. Clynelish is the successor to Brora, which closed in 1983 and is built opposite. A well-rounded Highlander, though this expression is a bit less peaty than the Brora bottlings of yore.

title: Dalmore 25 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Dalmore 25 Year Old is an ultra premium single malt Scotch whisky from the Highland region of Scotland. The Dalmore Distillery was established in 1839 by Alexander Matheson and is situated on the banks of the Cromarty Firth. Currently owned by Whyte & Mackay, which is part of the Asian company Emperador Distillers Inc., the distillery is iconic for its 12 pointed Royal Stag emblem—a symbol granted to the Mackenzie family in 1263 for saving King Alexander III. This 25 year old expression is part of the distillery's Principal Collection and represents a hallmark of the house style.

Spirit Description

Master Distiller Richard Paterson meticulously crafted this expression using a complex, multi stage maturation process. The spirit begins its journey in American white oak ex bourbon casks before being divided for secondary aging in rare 25 year old Palomino Fino sherry butts and first fill bourbon barrels. These whiskies are later married in bourbon barrels before a final finishing period in Tawny Port pipes from Portugal.

  • Colour: A deep amber with copper highlights.

  • Aroma: The nose is exotic and luxurious, featuring notes of citrus, marzipan, vanilla pods, treacle toffee, and fig cake with a hint of sweet balsamic.

  • Palate: It delivers a silky and full bodied mouthfeel with flavours of orange peel, chocolate truffles, liquorice, sweet damsons, and sherry soaked raisins.

  • Body: Dense and unctuous, the texture is often compared to a 'mohair touch' due to the wide stills that produce a rich, oily spirit.

  • Finish: The experience concludes with a long, warm finish of maple syrup, dark chocolate, and spiced gingerbread.

  • ABV: Dalmore 25 Year Old is bottled at 42%.

title: Lugny Cremant de Bourgogne 2022
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1927, Cave de Lugny was a driving force behind the success of the Maconnais region. For four decades they have produced sparkling wine under the Cremant de Bourgogne AOC.

Made from a 50/50 blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, this well priced sparkling wine is a great alternative to champagne.

title: El Enemigo Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
El Enemigo Chardonnay is a white wine from the Gualtallary region in Mendoza, Argentina. Crafted by winemakers Alejandro Vigil and Adrianna Catena, this Chardonnay exemplifies the unique terroir of high-altitude vineyards and innovative winemaking techniques.

Vineyard and Production

Sourced from vineyards situated at approximately 1,400 meters above sea level in Gualtallary, the vines are over 20 years old and thrive in calcareous soils. The grapes are hand-harvested and fermented using wild yeasts in 500-liter French oak barrels, 35% of which are new. The wine undergoes a 12-month aging process under a veil of flor, a technique reminiscent of Fino Sherry production, imparting distinctive saline and nutty characteristics.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Bright green-gold hue.

  • Aroma: Aromas of peaches and pears with a hint of cashew and a slightly oaky backdrop.

  • Palate: Dry and lean, the palate lingers with a chalky mouthfeel.

title: Old Ezra Brooks 7 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Aged 7 years, it is bottled at a barrel proof of 117 proof. Aged in new, charred white oak.

NOSE... A very traditional set of bourbon scents consisting of vanilla, caramel, brown sugar, and oak. It's mild for a high-proof bourbon and its aromas are straightforward with no frills.

PALATE... A surprisingly lively burst of flavour that ranges from sweet fruit to rich caramel and spicy oak. Its heat can get in the way of the flavours at times but doesn't muddle or suppress them to a detrimental degree. This is a full-flavoured affair, with adequate complexity and a very satisfying impact.

FINISH... Oak, spice, and dark cherries ride the finish out to its natural conclusion. There is a nice pop of vanilla and candied apple near the end that is short, but beneficial.

title: Venta Las Vacas Ribera Del Duero 2022
bodyHtml: The nose at first is white pepper spicy, then vanilla and the indication of plenty of oak. There are herbal and floral aromas with the dark cherry and blackberry, then a hint of cocoa. The palate is rich and creamy with mature cherry, raspberry and dark fruit. Very mouth coating.

title: Burrowing Owl Malbec 2021
bodyHtml:
Burrowing Owl Estate Winery, established in 1993, is located in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley. The winery is renowned for its commitment to sustainable viticulture and producing premium VQA wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region.

Wine Description

The Burrowing Owl Malbec is a deep, brooding purple wine with intense aromas of blackberry, crunchy yet ripe raspberry, baked plum, black cherry, blueberry, and notes of pepper, paprika, thyme, clove, and shortbread. The palate is bold, fruity, and intense with a full body, crisp acidity, medium ripe tannins, and flavors of ripe summer berries, blackberry, and sun-dried tomato, complemented by complex notes of pink peppercorn, cocoa, rosemary, pipe tobacco, and dried black olive on the long finish. This wine is approachable now and will continue to develop complexity over the next 5+ years.

Food Pairing

This Malbec pairs wonderfully with braised short ribs or vegetables and lamb grilled over charcoal. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: El Jolgorio Sierrudo Mezcal
bodyHtml: El Jolgorio Sierrudo is made with wild maguey Sierrudo (Agave Americana) by José Cortés in Santiago Matatlan, Oaxaca. As of 2019, Don José Cortés was the oldest living member of the Cortés family and the inspiration for the entire El Jolgorio range. He is mostly retired from making mezcal but will produce a special batch occasionally. The maguey Sierrudo is seldom used in Mezcal. It’s closely related to maguey Arroqueno, Sierra Negra, and Coyote. This agave is enormous. It generally takes 13-15 years to mature in this region and can grow up to 1,000 pounds in weight. Sierrudo has a high concentration of sugars, meaning a single agave can yield around 20-25 bottles of mezcal. The agaves for the introductory release (ed. 1) were cultivated in a wild environment (i.e. semi-cultivated) in Agua del Guaje, San Pedro Lachigoba, San Carlos Yautepec.

title: The Dirty Pure Project F Bomb Red 2019
bodyHtml: Fresh cracked black pepper, white flowers and cigar box followed by a deep and brooding core of blackberry jam, ripe strawberry and velvety textures with purity, concentration and a long, seamless finish.

title: Soldeica Pisco
bodyHtml: Soldeica Pisco is made from the Quebranta grape and gets its name from the conical pottery in which it was originally aged in. A Peruvian speciality, enjoy this in an array of cocktails or with mixers.

title: Pares Balta Pink Cava (NV)
bodyHtml: Made using the traditional method developed in Champagne, this terrific Pares Balta Pink Cava is quite stunning, and it is by far the best rose Cava for the price.

title: Sazerac Rye
bodyHtml: Aromas of clove, vanilla, anise and pepper. Subtles notes of candies spices and citrus. The big finish is smooth with hints of licorice.

title: Chateau Canon La Gaffeliere 2015
bodyHtml:
These organic wines are classy, remarkably well-structured, complex, pure, and always elegant.

97 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate     Composed of 55% Merlot, 38% Cabernet Franc and 7% Cabernet Sauvignon and aged in French oak, 55% new, for 17 months, the 2015 Canon la Gaffeliere features a deep garnet-purple color and a cedar-laced nose to begin, giving way to fragrant underlying scents of roses and violets with a core of crushed black currants, blackberries and Bing cherries plus hints of fallen leaves and dusty earth. Medium to full-bodied, the seductively perfumed red and black fruit fills the mouth, framed with plush tannins and plenty of freshness, finishing very long and minerally.

97 Points - Vinous    The 2015 Canon La Gaffelière is deep, powerful and explosive. Seamless and captivating in the glass, it possesses magnificent richness, volume and intensity in every dimension. The Cabernet Franc, usually such a strong signature, is nearly buried by the sheer intensity of the Merlot fruit. Espresso, mocha, licorice and plum infuse the racy finish. The 2015 is going to need the better part of a decade to be expressive. Tasted two times. 

96 Points - James Suckling    The aromas of violets and rose petals are prevalent here with blue fruits as well. Full body, integrated and firm tannins and a long finish. Structured yet fine and shows such finesse. Give it five or six years to come together. 

96 Points - Wine Spectator    *#2 WINE OF THE YEAR* Still youthfully tight and backward, with a well-roasted frame of alder and juniper holding sway for now, but the core of cassis, blackberry and plum fruit waits in reserve, showing prodigious depth. When the toast and fruit melds, the backdrop of tobacco, singed iron and chalky minerality will get a turn to show. There's a lot here. Built for the cellar. Best from 2025 through 2040.

title: Gratavinum 2PiR 2022
bodyHtml:
Gratavinum winery was founded in 2003 as a Priorat project by the Cusiné family, who also own the Parés Baltà winery. The winery's name is a contraction of the village name 'Gratallops' (where the winery is located) and 'Vinum' (Latin for wine). Gratavinum follows the Cusiné family philosophy of winemaking, with all its wines certified organic since 2004.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep purple colour with ruby tinges. The aromatic profile is complex, showing explicit presence of preserved red fruit, such as ripe berries, red plums, and pomegranates, balanced with toasted notes from the oak, fruit tea, scrubland, and earthy undertones. On the palate, the wine is described as powerful and chewy with rich fruit, exhibiting a good volume and acidity. It has a soft entry that evolves to show ripe, slightly unpolished tannins.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 90 points

Food Pairing

An ideal match for lamb, grilled red meats, bull meat, poultry, roasted foods, cold meats, and semi-cured cheese.

title: L'Usine Pinot Noir Annapolis 2019 (Orin Swift)
bodyHtml: Nuance and intrigue characterize the wine, starting with a dark crimson and a ruby rim but manifested by the aromatics: white pepper, nutmeg, cinnamon, clove, pine resin and crème de menthe. An entry dominated by a bright acidity, the mid-palate explores characteristics of rhubarb, savory and a hint of wild strawberry with a long finish indicative of graceful aging.

title: Alex Gambal Chassagne Montrachet La Maltroie Premier Cru 2016
Lagrimas de Dolores Mezcal Joven Maguey Castilla
bodyHtml:
This maguey has been cultivated in the Southern parts of Mezquital municipio, a mainly indigenous community of Tepehuanes and Huicholes in Huazamota. It takes around 6 years to reach maturity at sizes of up to 2.5 metres and can be found in lower elevation areas in Durango. Although it comes from the same family as Oaxaca's "Espadín" this agave differs greatly in appearance and taste. The distillation methods are similar to those used in the fascinating description of Cenizo Colonial Temoaya.

This particular batch was personally chosen for export to Canada at a small distillery in southern Mezquital by our founder Eric Lorenz. His notes: "Delightfully herbaceous and earthy with a candy-like sweetness. Lightly grassy with a pronounced 'zing' at the end that lingers nicely, and finally light smoke that elegantly emerges only after swallowing the last drop."

title: Travaglini Gattinara Riserva 2019
bodyHtml: Bright ruby red color with orange reflections, attracting the eye with its delicate transparency. Great complexity and concentration, dominated by liquorice spices and juniper berries, balsamic sandalwood and abundant toasting. This is followed by a fruity flavor reminiscent of fruit preserved in spirits, strawberry and blackberry jam, finished off with hints of wilting flowers. Elegant on the palate, with a vigorous and dominant tannin that takes on its full character as the years go by. Flavor and freshness dominate the palate, with a long and tasty persistence that continues to evolve.

title: Adelsheim Pinot Noir Breaking Ground 2021
bodyHtml: Deliciously layered black cherry and raspberry aromas lift out of the glass, followed by exotic spice notes and a dark, rich loamy quality. This wine is like satin in the mouth—so supple. It toes the line between ethereal and ponderous in the most delightful way.

title: Castello di Monsanto Chianti Classico Riserva 2022
bodyHtml:
Ruby red tending towards garnet. Rich, intense and complex with notes of black cherry and spice. Full bodied with rich red berry fruit flavors complimenting a backbone of tannin.

Open in advance and allowed to breathe. Decanting is preferable. An exceptional compliment to red meats, roasts and game.

title: Ken Wright Pinot Noir Canary Hill 2024
bodyHtml:
Ken Wright Pinot Noir Canary Hill 2024 originates from the United States, within Oregon's Willamette Valley region and the Eola-Amity Hills AVA subregion. Founded in 1994 by winemaking pioneer Ken Wright, the estate focuses on single-vineyard Pinot Noir expressions that showcase the distinct volcanic and sedimentary terroirs of the region. Canary Hill Vineyard, planted in 1983 on Jory volcanic clay soils, is one of the estate's founding sites and is celebrated for producing bright, red-fruit-driven wines with distinctive floral complexity.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a translucent, vibrant ruby colour. The nose is highly aromatic and lifted, presenting scents of red cherry, wild raspberry, and pomegranate intertwined with violet flowers, star anise, forest floor, and subtle sweet spice. On the palate, it features a medium body with a silky, delicate texture balanced by bright, juicy acidity and finely integrated, velvety tannins. Stylistically, the wine emphasizes freshness, site specificity, and elegance, concluding with a long, graceful finish that carries notes of red fruit and crushed stone minerality.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Pinot Noir

  • Alcohol by volume: 13.5%

title: Bernheim Kentucky Wheat Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Bernheim was the first straight wheat whiskey to be launched on the US market and is bottled at seven years of age.

See More USA Whisky

title: Balblair 15 Year Old
bodyHtml: The relaunch of Balblair's core range in early 2019 saw the distillery say "So long!" to vintages and "Hello there!" to age statements. This particular expression is the Balblair 15-Year-Old, which is initially matured in ex-bourbon casks before being moved over to first-fill Spanish oak butts. A deeper concentration of fruit notes compared to the 12-year-old and joined by some yummy chocolatey elements too.

title: Banfi Aska Bolgheri Rosso 2023
bodyHtml:
This structured and "sartorial" red wine originates from the Bolgheri DOC on the Tuscan coast, Italy. Aska represents the "adventure" of the legendary Castello Banfi (historically famous for Montalcino) in the Bolgheri area, where they apply their expertise to the maritime-influenced Bordeaux blends of the region. The winery's philosophy for this bottling is to capture the elegance and concentration of the coast, delivering a "serious" wine that balances Mediterranean freshness with robust structure.

Wine Description

The Banfi Aska Bolgheri Rosso presents an intense ruby red colour with distinct violet reflections. The sensory profile is focused and "linear," featuring a primary nose of ripe blackberries, blueberries, and plum jam, layered with sophisticated notes of dried violets, wet stones, tobacco, and cocoa. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied and juicy, showcasing firm, lightly grainy tannins and a vivid acidity that keeps the ripe fruit agile. It is characterized by its powerful structure and "mellow" mouthfeel, leading to a long, persistent finish with hints of chocolate, coffee, and pepper.

title: Lagrimas de Dolores Mezcal Joven Maguey I'Gok
bodyHtml: Long cultivated by the Tepehuan and Huichol peoples of southern Mezquital, I'GOK is the same species as Oaxaca's Arruqueño, growing to similar heights of 2 metres and up, but again with a drastically different flavour profile. Notes of caramelized butter, light smoke, sweetness that stretches all the way into the back of the sinuses and a woodiness not reminiscent of aging but rather of cooked agaves. Very complex.

title: Tantalus Old Vine Riesling 2021
bodyHtml: This wine exhibits all the lovely attributes that Riesling fans have come to expect from Tantalus. Not because it tastes the same from year to year, but rather because we allow the climatic growing conditions to shape the character of each vintage. Pale lemon in colour, the aromatics are at once intense, yet subtle and complex. A myriad of aromatics, from lemon zest to wet slate to white flowers are present. The palate is diverse and developed, a result of the wine being aged in bottle for 2 years before its release. Apples, pineapple, intense lime and mandarin all play their part. Carrying the signature crisp acidity of our Block 5 1978 plantings, this is a wine that is more about texture and complexity. A true expression of the earth it is grown in.

title: Faustino 1 Gran Reserva 2016
bodyHtml: Tempranillo, Graciano and Mazuelo, the three classic Rioja grape varieties. Graciano provides a very lively color and high acidity; Mazuelo flavour and abundant tannin, both together with Tempranillo are the perfect coupage for long ageing wines. True to Rioja, true to its origins. Cherry red developing to an intense ruby color. Intense and complex. Well integrated sweet and warm hints with ripe fruit, notes of vanilla and sensations of cinnamon, blond tobacco and cocoa. Elegant in the mouth, structured and with good acidity. The finish is sweet and surprising for a Rioja Gran Reserva. There is an aftertaste of the blend of very ripe fruit, vanilla and roasted notes.

title: Amrut Two Indies Rum
bodyHtml:
East meets West in the production of Amrut Two Indies Rum that blends Caribbean rum with Indian rum made from "jaggery," a concentrated form of cane juice used in the making of candy and other sweet treats. West Indies rum from Jamaica, Barbados, and Guyana are sent to the Amrut distillery in Bangalore, India where it is blended. This is bottled at 42.8% ABV.

Colour : Golden Amber;

Nose : Almond with freshly cut sugarcane, tropical fruits with a hint of ripened banana;

Taste : Sugarcane with a dash of tropical fruits and honey and running slightly dry;

Finish : Sweet and dry finish

title: Gran Orendain Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: This gorgeous Extra Anejo is aged for 40 months or more in French oak barrels before bottling at 40% ABV. A rich, golden amber colour with aromas of honeyed spice cake, toasted meringue, peppers, and dried fruits. On the palate, a silky mouthfeel, dry-yet-fruity at the outset, medium-to-full body, and a long and warming cola, peppery, vanilla toffee, and mineral accented finish. This beautiful sipping Anejo is excellent on its own or paired with a fine cigar.

title: Louis Jadot Volnay Premier Cru Clos de la Barre 2019
bodyHtml:
A dense, concentrated version that borders on muscular. The cherry and berry flavours are pure and accented by a touch of earth. Vibrant and long.

92 Points - Decanter    The Clos de la Barre is one of the highlights of the Jadot portfolio this year, wafting from the glass with a bouquet of raspberry, red cherry, candied peel and raw cocoa, elegantly framed by new oak. On the palate the wine is medium-full and supple, cool but open-knit. It's a giving and texturally refined Volnay. Drinking Window 2022 - 2040.

title: Schramsberg Blanc De Blancs
bodyHtml: Blanc de Blancs in the Schramsberg style is dry and crisp. For increased complexity, small amounts of malolactic and barrel-fermented wines are added. Prior to disgorgement, the wine is matured in the bottle for over two years on the yeast lees. This sparkling wine will keep its freshness, structure, and refined finish for many years, if not decades, after its first release, thanks to its lively, fruity, and crisp nature.

title: Gran Centenario Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Gran Centenario Reposado Tequila is a 100% blue agave spirit crafted in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. The brand traces its origins to 1857, when Lázaro Gallardo, considered the first Maestro Tequilero, pioneered a method of tequila-making. The house uses a proprietary 'Selección Suave' (soft selection) process, which blends younger rested tequilas with smoother, older reserves, highlighting a winemaking (distilling) philosophy focused on achieving perfect balance and smoothness.

Description

This reposado tequila is rested in new American oak casks, imparting a smooth and balanced character. It provides a touch of fruit on the nose, complemented by light wood notes. On the palate, there are sweet tones of cooked agave, along with subtle hints of vanilla, toasted almonds, oak, and clove. It is a medium bodied, smooth spirit that offers a complexity of oak spice and nutty flavours, including toffee and cinnamon, leading to a long, aromatic, and smooth finish.

title: Grand Marnier Cuvee du Centenaire (100th Anniversary)
bodyHtml: An exceptional blend of fine X.O. cognacs and exotic bitter orange liqueur.  Created in 1927 to celebrate the 100th anniversary of La Maison Marnier Lapostolle, this cuvée is a beautiful expression of quality and craft. Medium amber tinged with copper in colour, this liqueur possesses aromas of bergamot essences and candied peel. The palate is refined, with complex flavours of orange and aged cognac with delicate hints of tobacco and balsamic.  Enjoy it neat or on the rocks.

title: Varnier Fanniere Grand Cru Brut (NV)
bodyHtml: Its color is fresh, a pale yellow with hints of jade. The nose brings out aromas of lemon mixed with hints of ripe fruits, apricots and green apples. On the palate the first mouthful is fresh and lively, the finesse of chardonnay gives it an extra dimension, finishing with a touch of minerality.

title: Dalmore 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Sumptuous, velvety and elegant, this scotch was aged 14 years in bourbon casks, then four more years in Mathusalem sherry casks from the renowned Spanish bodega González Byass.

Delicate and complex, the bouquet reveals scents of orange zest, honey, cinnamon, pine and chocolate.

A well-known Highlands distillery, Dalmore has been producing whiskies since 1839, enjoying an ideal location enveloped by the cool sea air of the Cromarty estuary.

title: Villa Antinori Chianti Classico Riserva 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Villa Antinori Chianti Classico Riserva originates from Italy, specifically from the Tuscany region within the Chianti Classico DOCG. The estate is owned by the historic Marchesi Antinori family, whose winemaking heritage spans over six centuries; the Villa Antinori label itself dates back nearly 100 years, with the first vintage produced in 1928. The winery's philosophy bridges tradition and innovation, reinterpreting this Tuscan classic into a premium wine that pays homage to its heritage while embracing modern quality standards.

Wine Description

This red wine typically presents a ruby red colour with vibrant clarity and a full bodied structure. The sensory profile is fresh and complex, featuring an aromatic nose of red cherries, pomegranate, and plums, often accompanied by floral notes of lavender and rose petals alongside balsamic accents of white musk. On the palate, the entry is savory and flavorful, delivering intense fruit integrated with elegant nuances of vanilla, tobacco, cocoa, and spice. The finish is long and expansive, characterized by supple, well structured tannins and refreshing acidity.

  • Varietal Composition: Predominantly Sangiovese blended with complementary varieties such as Cabernet Sauvignon.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is aged for at least 12 months in French oak barrels to enhance its depth, complexity, and harmonious balance.

  • ABV: Typically ranges between 13% and 14%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate emphasizes sustainable research, certain recent vintages have been produced by Antinori as a certified sustainable winery under the Equalitas standard.

Food Pairing

The elegant structure and savory profile of this Chianti Classico Riserva make it a versatile companion for traditional Italian and hearty meat dishes.

  • Meats: It pairs excellently with grilled lamb marinated in herbs, beef tenderloin with a red wine reduction, and game such as deer.

  • Savoury and Rich: Suggested pairings include pasta with a rich ragù or wild boar stew and hearty mushroom dishes.

  • Cheese: Complements mature hard cheeses such as Parmesan, Pecorino, or aged cheddar.

  • Appetizers: Matches well with fine antipasti platters featuring grilled vegetables and olives.

title: El Dorado 25 Year Old Demerara Rum
bodyHtml:
General Information

Heralded as the gem of Guyana's sugar cane-rich Demerara region, the El Dorado distillery created this limited-edition rum to celebrate the turn of the millennium. A quarter century spent aging in the tropics gives it a character of bitter chocolate meets smoke and spice. The decanter-shaped bottle adds to the allure.

title: E. Guigal Gigondas Rouge 2020
bodyHtml:
The E. Guigal Gigondas Rouge is a robust red wine from the renowned Rhône Valley, crafted primarily from Grenache (70%), with Syrah (20%) and Mourvèdre (10%) enhancing the blend. The vines, averaging 40 years of age, are rooted in ancient alluvial soils of red clay and gravel on the slopes of the Gigondas appellation. Following a traditional extended maceration, the wine is aged for 24 months in oak casks, half of which are new.

Colour: Deep, intense purple hue.
Aroma: Notes of ripe stone fruits, licorice, and wild Mediterranean herbs (garrigue).
Palate: Full and powerful with flavors of ripe rhubarb, wild strawberry, blackberry, and savory herbs, leading to a refined, saline finish.
Body: Full-bodied and balanced, providing a rich and structured experience.
Finish: Long and sophisticated, with a smooth, well-integrated tannin profile.

Food Pairing Suggestions: Ideal with hearty dishes such as red meats, game, and aged cheeses.

This wine is a fine representation of the Rhône region, showcasing the area’s distinctive character and depth.

title: Demuerte Red 2021
bodyHtml: Herbaceous, cedar, stone and spice on the nose. Extra dry and full-bodied with high acidity and tannins. Flavours of cherry, vanilla, spice, smoke, and a hint of oak.

title: Farina Amarone della Valpolicella 2023
bodyHtml: Few wine styles are as universally beloved as Amarone. Bold, layered, powerfully expressed flavours, great depth and a luxurious, velvety mouthfeel have seen Amarone take its place alongside Barolo and Brunello as an iconic Italian expression. Pair with steak or ribs.

title: Berta Distillery - Amaro D'Erbe - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Berta Distillerie Amaro d'Erbe Il Duca originates from Italy, within the northwest region of Piedmont in the subregion of Monferrato. Founded in 1947 by Paolo Berta in the hillside village of Mombaruzzo, the historic distillery built a world-renowned reputation through premium artisanal grappa and liqueur production. Today, the family-run enterprise is managed by the second and third generations of the Berta family, marrying regional distillation mastery with traditional herbal infusions.

Spirit Description

This herbal digestif presents a brilliant amber appearance with rich mahogany reflections in the glass. The sensory profile features a layered, aromatic nose led by wild alpine herbs, gentian root, bitter orange peel, and rhubarb, laced with subtle hints of sweet vanilla and licorice. On the palate, the body is smooth, silky, and elegantly balanced, presenting an initial wave of sweet citrus and botanicals followed by a structured, refined herbal bitterness. The finish is remarkably long, dry, and persistent, leaving lingering warmth accented by dark baking spices and refreshing herbaceous undertones. This artisanal amaro is traditionally bottled at an alcohol by volume of 28%.

Food Pairing

The complex bitterness and citrus undertones of this amaro make it an exceptional post-meal digestif. It pairs brilliantly with dark chocolate desserts, hazelnut tortes, or traditional espresso-flavoured biscotti that mirror its roasted herbal notes. For a savoury match, it serves as a wonderful companion to an aged cheese board featuring Gorgonzola, Castelmagno, or sharp Pecorino alongside roasted nuts.

title: Tommasi Cabernet Sauvignon 'Poggio al Tufo' 2022
bodyHtml:
Tommasi is a family viticultural company founded in 1902. Tommasi is located in Pedemonte village in the heart of Valpolicella Classico region, on a small piece of land in the northwest part of Verona, between the Lessini mountains and their plains near Lake Garda. From grandfather Giacomo's tiny vineyard, the Tommasi estate has grown steadily over the course of years and today extends over 135 hectares of vineyards blessed by mother nature not only by a magnificent landscape, but more importantly, by its perfect suitability for grapes. The estate is run by the 4th generation of the Tommasi family, 6 members working together in complete harmony.

Poggio al Tufo Cabernet Sauvignon is a wine with an exuberant and decisive character that clearly reflects the Tuscan coastal terroir from which the grapes are sourced. The Rompicollo vineyard is located in the town of Pitigliano and benefits from a Southern exposure and volcanic soil rich in tufo, a particular type of volcanic rock, which lends a marked minerality to the wine.

title: Benromach 21 Year Old
bodyHtml: Matured in the finest hand-selected first-fill oak casks, the twenty-one-year-old single malt delivers sweet Sherry aromas. Subtle spice, Seville orange and raspberry follow with a soft smoky finish.

title: Tantalus Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Winemaker David Paterson has been transitioning his Rosé to a lighter hue of salmon-pink while keeping the juicy, savoury notes that make it so attractive. It’s a blend of 65 per cent Pinot Noir from younger vines and older-vine Pinot Meunier, a grape often used in sparkling wine. The Pinot Noir was harvested early to keep it fresh and lively. Then smaller amounts of both Pinots were fermented with wild yeast in neutral oak barrels. Finally, the juice was aged on its lees for a couple of months.

The process has created a bright and pretty wine, with rose petal, cherry and raspberry aromas and flavours of cherry, raspberry, spice, orange and light ginger. It is dry and finely balanced, with bright acid and a long, mouth-filling finish. Salmon, chicken tagine or bahn mi pork burgers should pair well.

title: Bodegas Salentein Malbec Reserva 2020
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Established in the late 1990s, Bodegas Salentein is a privately-owned estate of almost 5,000 acres, of which 1,124 acres are planted to vine. Located in Mendoza’s famed Uco Valley, Salentein produces a remarkable collection of wines from vineyards planted in some of the highest elevations on the planet.

This Malbec displays a very intense purplish red colour. In the nose, it is intense and complex with outstanding aromas of red fruits, black berries, as well as delicate floral notes. In the mouth, its entry is sweet and mild. It is a fruity and fresh wine with good intensity. In the middle mouth, it is wide with a lingering finish.

title: El Jolgorio Todos Santos Tobasiche
bodyHtml:
Todos Santos (All Saints) is a profoundly important event in Mexican culture: a three-day celebration of friends and loved ones who have passed on. The third and final day, the Day of the Dead marks the moment these dearly departed can cross back over into our living world, joyfully reuniting families, friends, and lovers for a brief moment. An altar is built for the visiting spirit, called an “Ofrenda,” and adorned with offerings of the things most beloved by that person in life: cherished objects, favorite foods, favorite candies, and often a glass of mezcal.

Tobasiche is a subvariety of the Karwinskii species of agave. Unlike most agave, whose leaves (or “pencas”) grow outwards from a central heart or core which remains close to the ground, Agave Karwinskii develop as a long vertical stem or trunk, with the sugar concentrated near the top where the "pencas" remain green and spiky.

title: Prunotto Barbera d'Alba 2024
bodyHtml:
Winery Background

Established in 1923 by Alfredo Prunotto, the Prunotto winery has been a pioneer in Piedmont's winemaking landscape. Now under the stewardship of the Antinori family, Prunotto continues to honor its legacy by producing wines that reflect the region's rich terroir and the family's dedication to excellence.

Sensory Profile

  • Color: Lively ruby red with subtle purple highlights.

  • Aroma: The nose is greeted with vinous aromas, showcasing remarkable freshness and fruity notes.

  • Palate: On the palate, the wine is pleasant and extremely easy to drink, thanks to its outstanding freshness. The finish is elegant and supple.

title: Tapatio Excelencia Gran Reserva Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tapatío Excelencia Gran Reserva Extra Añejo Tequila is a distinguished spirit from the La Alteña distillery in Jalisco, Mexico, renowned for its exceptional quality and craftsmanship. This Extra Añejo tequila is aged for approximately four years in deeply charred American white oak barrels, imparting rich flavors and complexity.
