Tasting Notes:

  • Nose: Opens with aromas of hot caramel apples, intense cooked agave, and subtle floral notes.

  • Palate: Features an explosion of earthy flavors, brown sugar, traditional tequila spiciness, and a hint of chocolate, all enveloped by the mellow influence of oak maturation.

  • Finish: Exhibits an extremely long and rich finish, leaving a lasting impression.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Neat: Best enjoyed neat to fully appreciate its complexity and depth.

  • On the Rocks: Alternatively, serve over a large ice cube to slightly mellow the flavors.

title: Amrut Naarangi Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Naarangi yet another innovative release from Amrut. The name is Hindi for 'orange' and the whisky was aged in an ex-oloroso-sherry cask, which was then seasoned with wine and orange peel for three years. A three-year-old whisky was then finished in the cask for a further three years, producing a whisky with extra Orangey notes.

Nose : Lightly toasted oak. Orange peel (duh). Dry leaves. Rich sherry. Chocolate. Mint leaf. Cinnamon. Nutmeg. Jute bag. Vanilla. This is a super rich nose and the orange is quite prominent, though, thankfully it does not overpower. Amrut noses are seldom flawed and neither is this one. 

Taste : Good weight. Nice body. Coats the mouth with chocolate. Cinnamon. There’s that orange again. But more of an orange cake this time. Oak. Black pepper. Ginger. This is a nice twist. Makes me want to bust out my Compass Box Orangerie and conduct a head to head. 

Finish : Extremely long. Oily. Lip smacking cinnamon.

title: Bertani Amarone della Valpolicella 'Valpantena' 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Valpantena subregion of the Valpolicella area in Veneto. Bertani was founded in 1857 by brothers Giovan Battista and Gaetano Bertani, and it remains a symbol of classic Veronese winemaking. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a respect for tradition, famously producing Amarone that is meant to be elegant, long lived, and reflective of the unique marl and limestone soils of the Valpantena valley.

Wine Description

The Bertani Amarone della Valpolicella Valpantena displays an intense red colour with violet reflections. The nose is rich and complex, offering unmistakable notes of black cherry, plum, and raspberry, interwoven with spicy hints of vanilla, cinnamon, and pepper. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and vigorous, featuring flavours of red fruit preserves and cocoa. It is characterized by its balanced structure, supple tannins, and a long finish that echoes the spicy and fruity notes found on the nose. The varietal composition typically consists of 80% Corvina Veronese and 20% Rondinella. The ABV is approximately 15.5%. While not certified organic, the winery focuses on sustainable practices to maintain the health of the historic vineyards.

title: Louis Roederer Blanc de Blancs Brut 2016
bodyHtml:
Bright yellow hue with slightly green tints and bubbles that are soft, creamy, fine and delicate. The bouquet is precise and mineral with notes of ripe citrus fruit and white, almost vanilla-like blossoms (pollen) and notes of freshly harvested wheat and almonds. The freshness of the bouquet comes through in the form of minty and iodised aromas (sea spray) which slowly evolve towards warmer notes of smoke, hot butter and toast.

The palate is creamy and soft yet concentrated on entry. The wine, underpinned by the delicate bubbles, unfolds majestically. It offers us the sensation of ripe, concentrated juice carried by an incredibly powdery texture with a distinctly saline finish. Oaky and smoky notes continue to draw out the wine, giving it extra length and concentration, an indication of its exceptional cellar-ageing potential. The finish is pure, refreshing and mouthwatering.

title: Thibault Liger-Belair Corton 'Les Renardes' Grand Cru 2019
bodyHtml:
95 Points -  Decanter

Made with fruit purchased from a 0.32ha parcel planted in 1956, below Le Corton. 40% whole clusters and 60% new casks give a deeply aromatic wine, with abundant aromas of ripe blackberry, menthol, mineral and violets. On the palate, the texture is silky and very fine, yet there is a core of very firm tannins and great length. This has everything one wants in a Corton, from abundant fruit to firm structure and an immense finish.

title: San Matias Tahona Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: Named for the tahona stone used to crush the agave piñas, this blanco has an astonishing purity to it. Pleasingly peppery on the nose and palate, backed by a hint of vanilla, roasted jalapeño emerges midpalate before finishing clean and crisp, with a lemon-zest note.

title: Aberfeldy 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: A fruity, clean and polished malt with a touch of honey and spice, Aberfeldy 12 Year Old is an excellent introduction to this Highland distillery.

title: Patz & Hall Pinot Noir Chenoweth Ranch
bodyHtml: Chenoweth Ranch is planted to a mix of Dijon clones that deliver one of the juiciest, richest wines in our single vineyard lineup. Generous aromas of cinnamon, five spice powder, dried cranberry and licorice and damp forest floor leap from the glass. Dark chocolate, fresh lavender and cedar introduce supple, rich tannins that make for an exceptionally full, mouth filling, wine while maintaining a sleek purity. The 2018 will reward patient cellar aging, though, this wine’s immense charm will make it hard to resist.

title: Tamdhu 12 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml: Matured in ex-sherry casks for 12 years, this rich, elegant Tamdhu holds aromas of cinnamon rolls, orange candy, fresh oak, raisins and faint traces of mint. The palate offers notes of banana, raspberry jam, malty biscuits and toasted oak before developing into ground cinnamon, dried fruit and Scottish tablet flavours that linger in the finish.

title: Hendry Ranch Pinot Noir 2019
bodyHtml: Pale ruby-garnet. Aromatics of butterscotch, dried cherry, cranberry and soft spice. Bright, tangy and bittersweet on the palate, with cherry, cranberry, and lingering acidity on the finish.

title: Shea Cellars Pinot Noir Shea Vineyard 2021
bodyHtml: Always the best example of Shea Vineyard as a whole in a given vintage, the Estate draws you in with lush red fruit and honey aromatics. The palate is beautifully balanced with savory flavors and smooth tannins. This wine brings it all to the table.

title: K Vintners The Creator 2020
bodyHtml:
K Vintners 'The Creator' 2020 originates from the United States, specifically from the Walla Walla Valley region of Washington State. Winemaker Charles Smith, a former rock band manager who founded K Vintners in 1999, remains the visionary behind the label, which is part of his House of Smith portfolio. The winery operates with a philosophy of indigenous fermentation and a hands-off approach in the cellar to let the terroir of the estate vineyards speak for themselves. This specific wine is sourced entirely from the Powerline Estate Vineyard, located over 1200 feet in elevation on well-drained cobblestone river rocks and silt soils.

Wine Description

This red blend presents a big, bold, and smooth profile with a dark ruby colour. The sensory profile features a complex nose of ripe black cherries, currants, and blue plums, layered with savory notes of old leather, pipe tobacco, sagebrush, and peppery herbs. On the full-bodied and broad-shouldered palate, it delivers gobs of dark fruit tones and sweet oak flavours, balanced by silky, polished tannins and a mineral-focused expression. The finish is remarkably long and intense, showcasing a great deal of finesse and precision.

  • Varietal Composition: A co-fermented blend of 70% Cabernet Sauvignon and 30% Syrah.

  • ABV: Recorded at 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate focuses on sustainable viticulture and native yeast fermentations, this specific wine is not typically certified organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine was aged for 22 months on its lees in 65% new French oak barriques to enhance its depth and texture.

Food Pairing

The rich structure and bold intensity of 'The Creator' make it an excellent partner for hearty, well-seasoned dishes. Suggested pairings include:

  • Meats: Grilled sirloin steak, ribeye served rare to medium-rare, or lamb kreatopita (Greek meat pie).

  • French Cuisine: Boeuf en croûte (beef fillet in pastry) with a mushroom sauce.

  • Savoury & Cheese: Aged Manchego cheese, or a rich mushroom risotto featuring portobello or shiitake varieties.

  • Vegetarian: Eggplant Parmesan or smoked tofu served with stewed lentils to balance the wine's prominent tannins.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 vintage is described by winemaker Charles Smith as potentially the best in Washington State history, characterized by a long and temperate growing season that allowed fruit to ripen evenly. Despite some regional concerns regarding smoke and drought in the Pacific Northwest, the Walla Walla Valley produced wines with incredible tension, balance, and focused fruit concentration. The low-yielding vines at Powerline Vineyard resulted in small berries that contributed to the wine's remarkable depth and satisfying complexity.

97 Points - Robert Parker: The 2020 The Creator is a blend of 70% Cabernet Sauvignon and 30% Syrah. The nose is big, bold and smooth with a juicy, round and mineral-focused expression, offering gobs of dark red and black fruit tones. Full-bodied, the palate explodes with pleasure, showing soft herbal tones with sweet oak flavors that ride with blackberry and dark cherry flavors, compounding complexity while displaying layers of finesse and precision. The wine concludes with a food-friendly finish, emphasizing intense juicy flavors. The wine spent 22 months on the lees in 65% new French oak barriques. You'll want to set your calendars for this one when it's released in the fall later this year. Almost 25,000 bottles produced.

title: Caymus California Zinfandel 2022
bodyHtml:
Caymus Vineyards, established in 1972 by the Wagner family in Napa Valley, California, is renowned for producing high-quality wines that reflect the region's rich viticultural heritage. The winery remains family-owned and operated, with a commitment to crafting wines that showcase the unique characteristics of their vineyards.

Caymus Zinfandel is a testament to the winery's dedication to varietal expression. This wine presents a deep ruby color and offers an expressive bouquet featuring notes of blackberry, plum, and dark cherry, complemented by hints of vanilla and oak. On the palate, it is full-bodied with a smooth and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing flavors consistent with the nose, including ripe black fruits and subtle spice. The finish is long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

This Zinfandel pairs beautifully with grilled meats, such as pork ribs or beef burgers, as well as hearty pasta dishes and aged cheeses, enhancing the wine's depth and complexity.

title: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Grand Marnier's signature expression, created in 1880 by Louis Alexandre-Marnier Lapostolle by combing the character of cognac with the intensity of bitter orange.  It has brilliant amber and topaz tones and aromas with vanilla cognac nuances and hints of candied zest.  Bitter orange flavours are balanced by cognac notes of hazelnuts and toffee, followed by a long, harmonious finish.

title: Eau Claire Christmas Gin
bodyHtml:
When Master Distiller Caitlin Quinn turned her mind to a Christmas seasonal, the thought was: what would be the best to represent the true gift of Christmas. Every year, Eau Claire looks forward to sharing their Christmas Gin, a special spirit that celebrates the holidays with Frankincense and Myrrh, two of the three wise men's gifts and this year, they decided it was time to add the third gift from the three wise men, gold!

Specially formulated for the holiday season, the ancient spices of Frankincense and Myrrh were viewed as both priceless and flavourful, so they decided to make their traditional London-style Gin with these two unique botanicals. The unique flavour notes brought by these ancient spice resins, give the gin a beautiful mouthfeel, with a hint of almost lemony, balsamic taste. With every pour, your glass will sparkle with 24 karat gold flakes, whether you have the spirit on its own, in a martini or topped with Prosecco. Eau Claire Distillery presents you with a gift fit for a queen or king. Be sure to stock your bar for the holiday season with this festive Gin.

title: Wray & Nephew White Overproof Rum
bodyHtml: Since 1825, this crystal-clear rum has been legendary in its home Jamaica, where it is an integral part of the culture, tradition, and daily life. It is by far the most popular rum in the country. It is the world's best-selling and award-winning high-strength white rum outside of Jamaica's borders. Wray & Nephew White Overproof Rum has a strong 63 percent abv (126 proof) and is great for cocktails, punch drinks, and flambe in the kitchen. Due to its high proof, this transparent rum is robust and full-bodied, with a sweet impression and smooth texture on the palate, as well as a strong clean aftertaste.  Intense fruit aromas with brown sugar and spice notes. Full-bodied with sweet notes on the palate and a long finish.

title: Darroze Les Grandes Assamblages 30 Year Old Armagnac
bodyHtml:
For several generations, the Darroze family has scoured Gascony in the Grands Crus centre of the Bas Armagnac region. Thousands of centuries-old treasures are held in stock at the Darroze house. This diversity in crus, vintages, grape varieties and styles has allowed Marc Darroze to work on this range known as 'Les Grands Assemblages' (The Great Blends). Chosen for their complementary characteristics, the selected Armagnacs in each blend are of different ages. Each age on the bottle indicates the age of the youngest Armagnac in the blend.

The fruity aromas in the younger blends, with flavours of chocolate and coffee for the older eaux de vie, change to notes of spices and candied fruits at around 30 years old; the aromatic palette evolves naturally over the years. You can discover this evolution in each blend. Many years of ageing in 400 litre oak barrels have conferred suaveness and roundness on the tannins so that each 'Grand Assemblage' reveals its own proper balance between the alcohol, the aromas and the tannins.

Darroze's Grand Assemblages collection features this fully matured, peppery 30 year old Bas Armagnac. Maturity begins at 30. The fresh fruit is transformed into dried and candied fruit, the spicy character asserts itself, the first aromas of rancio appear and the alcohol is perfectly mellow. The fiery youth softens and relents. This Grand Assemblage is the perfect example of magnificent balance that one finds in eaux de vie of this age.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast     Maple syrup in color, this has a toffee aroma and flavor, along with notes of dry cocoa, espresso, spice and dried orange peel on the finish.

title: Glenlivet 21 Year Old 'The Sample Room Collection'
bodyHtml: Finished in first-fill Oloroso Sherry, Troncais Cognac and Colheita vintage Port casks, The triple cask finish on this precious Single Malt brings extra layers of depth, smoothness and intriguing spiciness to The Glenlivet’s iconic smooth and fruity style. Luscious notes of caramelized pears and juicy sultanas intertwine with fragrant nutmeg and warming cinnamon deriving from the Cognac cask influence.

title: Monte Antico Toscana 2020
bodyHtml: A Tuscan classic! Deep ruby colour with garnet reflections, its elegant bouquet of leather, black cherries, liquorice and plums preludes a medium to full-bodied palate where ripe red fruit and subtle notes of vanilla and violets harmonize and linger, interlacing with the soft tannins and silky texture. Firm backbone, perfect integration of acidity and fruit, well rounded, medium finish.

title: Uccelliera Rapace IGT 2020
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Uccelliera is not only famous for its outstanding Brunello every year, but the Rapace, which has become an icon in the meantime, also shows the high quality with which the winery has been delighting wine connoisseurs all over the world for decades. 

A strong dark ruby red, the aroma spectrum is skilfully balanced by a mix of dark red cherries, plums, liquorice, smoke, spices and menthol. The beautifully cherry-like primary fruit is embedded in a warm texture, the silky tannin skillfully takes over on the sidelines and the wine storms into a long, nuanced and delicately mineral finish.

title: The Arran Sauternes Cask Finish
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Arran Sauternes Cask Finish is a premium single malt Scotch whisky from the Isle of Arran, Scotland, produced at the Lochranza Distillery. Founded in 1995 by Harold Currie, the distillery is currently owned by Isle of Arran Distillers Ltd., a private group of shareholders. This expression was one of the earliest experimental wood finishes released by the distillery and has since evolved into a core range staple featuring a new bottle design introduced in 2020.

Spirit Description

This unpeated single malt undergoes a double maturation process, initially aging in traditional ex-bourbon oak casks for approximately eight years before being finished in Sauternes wine casks sourced from an artisan producer in Bordeaux, France.

  • Colour: The spirit possesses a warm, golden amber hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is very sweet and fragrant, opening with acacia honey, honeysuckle, and vanilla pastry, followed by bright notes of tinned pineapple, banana, melon, and citrus blossoms.

  • Palate: It delivers a rich, honeyed mouthfeel balanced by a lively zestiness and warm spices. Flavours of creamy vanilla, sultanas, and marzipan emerge, framed by toasted oak and a subtle salty edge.

  • Body: The whisky is characterized by a thick, syrupy, and smooth texture with a well integrated woody warmth.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long and candied finish, where lingering notes of apricot, melon, and honeysuckle are toned down by dry spices like ginger and white pepper.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at 50%.

title: Elderton Shiraz 2022
bodyHtml:
After time spent working in Saudi Arabia, Neil and Lorraine Ashmead moved to the Barossa. The Ashmead's believed this would be a great place to raise their family. The homestead, in the heart of the township of Nuriootpa, was surrounded by extremely old Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon vines. At a time when demand for Australian table wine was negligible, the vineyard had become derelict. After years of no interest, the real estate agent eventually offered Ashmead's 72-acre vineyard as a bonus, as part of the sale of the homestead. Three years later, after restoring the vineyard, Elderton Wines was born.

The second generation, Cameron and Allister, took the reins of the business and today work together to run Elderton Wines, with Lorraine. Cameron and Allister believe very strongly in continuing the traditions that began a generation earlier, in the Nuriootpa vineyard. Wanting to take the family company to the next level, they together devised a plan to buy great vineyards in other significant sub-appellations of the Barossa. Through using sustainable practices, the hope is that the next generation of the Ashmead family has a lot to work with when they are at the helm.

A rich and vibrant dark purple. Black forest fruits, dark chocolate and vanilla with hints of coconut and creme caramel. Plum and berries, chocolate and a spice finish. Full-bodied, rich, classic. On the palate dark plum fruits and chocolate with subtleties of anise and spice. A seamless tannin profile elevates the fruit providing depth and length to the finish. Drink now or cellar confidently for 10 to 15 years from vintage.

title: The Old Malt Cask Speyburn 13 Year Old
bodyHtml:
General Information

An unusually sweet, sherried Speyburn 13 Year Old Single Cask from Hunter Laing & Co, bottled under their much respected Old Malt Cask Range.

Tasting Notes

Nose : Vanilla, caramel, butterscotch and pineapple notes.

Palate : Wonderfully malty with oranges and a touch of menthol.

Finish : Long, satisfying and drying with lingering notes of black tea.

title: The Prisoner Wine Co. - Prisoner Red Blend - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Could The Prisoner Red Blend be in the proverbial "sweet" spot? Since its arrival into the marketplace in 2000, this wine became an instant star, albeit controversial in some of the wine world because of its perceived sweetness. Many of my closest wine pals also decried that the wine was too extracted. While the wine flirts a bit beyond the standard threshold residual sugar level, this wine is pretty tasty and dry in a New World way. The 2019 vintage is the wine's best effort to date, and it signals its long journey to become a wine that everyone can wrap their palate around.

This wine brings the force of bold, black fruit, savoury spices, and oak onto the palate. Pair it with grilled baby back ribs.

title: Batasiolo Barolo 2021 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Garnet red colour; rye bread, lifted, spicy red plum and cherry aromas and flavours; tar, licorice, savory and spicy; extra dry, medium to full bodied, excellent balance of fruit and plentiful tannins with a long, complex finish.

title: Domaine William Fevre Chablis Premier Cru Les Lys 2020
bodyHtml: Super-expressive. Bright citrus, grapefruit, lime, slate and rosemary all jump from the glass in a focused, pedigreed Chablis full of potential. This is an impressive Les Lys. Yields in this sheltered, north-east facing site were just 18 hectoliters per hectare.

title: See Ya Later Ranch Pinot Noir 2025
bodyHtml: A bigger and broader style of Pinot Noir with impressive violet floral notes atop raspberry, beetroot, cherry and oak tones. Great concentration of red fruit and a firm tannic structure. Well-made and impressive from beginning to end.

title: Dos Maderas 5 + 5 PX Rum
bodyHtml:
To produce Dos Maderas 5+5, the Caribbean-aged spirit is aged in barrels previously used to age 20-year-old Palo Cortado. This one-of-a-kind sherry imparts a unique character to the rum, adding complexity, and notes of dried fruits and walnuts.

The casks of the sweetest sherry wine adds another dimension to Dos Maderas 5+5, providing smoothness, as well as flavors of raisin and prune. These exquisite rums are transformed through the solera aging process with casks that previously aged very sweet 20-year-old Pedro Ximénez. These highly sought-after casks are over 80 years old, adding wonderfully complex flavors.

Dark amber in color, this intriguing rum offers fig and raisin notes at first, leading to rich, ripe fruit on the palate. This is seasoned by some tropical spice and wrapped in sherry notes, with wisps of smoky oak and a touch of tobacco leaf.

title: Tenuta Sette Ponti Oreno 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Ruby red with violet hues. Intense and broad aromatics, where notes of succulent red fruits initially emerge and then give way to spicy characters of licorice and roasted coffee. Powerful and structured, with velvety tannins in balance with a vibrant, crisp character. Finish of remarkable length and savoriness.

98 Points - James Suckling

Blackcurrants and black cherries with lovely flowers on the nose. Medium-bodied with ultra fine tannins that give focus and tension to the wine.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Fruity, floral aromas of dried cherries, raspberries and violets on the nose open up into more savory notes of pencil shavings and hot tar before a palate of more mixed berries rolls over savory, earthy notes, with a hint of orange pith adding astringency through a long, umami-rich finish.

title: Masi Modello Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Masi Modello Pinot Grigio originates from Italy, specifically from the Veneto and Friuli-Venezia Giulia regions within the Delle Venezie DOC. For over 250 years, the Boscaini family has operated under the Masi label, maintaining a philosophy that blends deep-rooted Venetian tradition with modern innovation. The winery is a benchmark for the Trevenezie area, utilizing specialist vineyards such as the 'Stra' del Milione' estate to produce wines that emphasize territorial heritage and sustainability.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a pale straw-yellow colour, sometimes featuring light golden highlights. The sensory profile is elegant and intensely fruity, with an aromatic nose of pear, pineapple, and grapefruit complemented by floral overtones and hints of fresh-baked bread. On the light-bodied palate, it is dry and well-balanced, offering bright flavours of green apple, lemon zest, and white peach accented by a delicate minerality and a slightly viscous, oily texture. The finish is clean, crisp, and refreshing, defined by a streak of zingy acidity that provides impressive length.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Grigio.

  • ABV: Typically 12%.

  • Stylistic Notes: Vinified in stainless steel vats to preserve pure varietal freshness and fruit intensity.

  • Organic Status: Not certified organic, though the winery adheres to 'Give Wine a Future' sustainability principles.

title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label
bodyHtml:
Johnnie Walker Blue Label is an unrivalled masterpiece, an exquisite combination of Scotland's rarest and most exceptional whiskies. Only one in every ten thousand casks has the elusive quality, character and flavour to deliver the remarkable signature taste. An extraordinary Whisky for extraordinary occasions!

NOSE... Take in the wonderfully mellow, rounded nose replete with dry smokiness artfully mixed with the sweetness of raisins.

PALATE... Serving a velvety combination of vanilla, honey and rose petals before broadening out to include a zesty orange flavour with hazelnut, sherry and dark chocolate notes.

FINISH... Signing off with a rich and luxuriously long finish showcases Johnnie Walker's trademark smokiness in the most sophisticated way.

title: Rabl Zweigelt Rose 2024
bodyHtml: A fresh and uber-affordable rosé from Austria. Rabl has been in business since the mid-1700s, so the team knows a thing or two about making great wines. Pair this refreshing pink - made from the Zweigelt grape - with a variety of cuisine. Perfect for hot days in summer, or for roast chicken or turkey dinners, too! Serve chilled.

title: H. Billiot Fils Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
Billiot's NV Brut Rosé Grand Cru is powerful and tightly wound, with a great interplay of tension and Ambonnay power. Cranberry, chalk, white pepper and mint are some of the signatures, but it is the wine's persistence and overall palate presence that makes it most distinctive.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate     The NV Brut Rose Grand Cru is a deeply colored, powerful wine that showcases the richness of Ambonnay at its finest. The Rose needs some time in the glass to find its inner balance, but when it does the fruit gains delineation and intensity through to the dramatic, sweeping finish. The NV Brut Rose Grand Cru is predominantly Pinot Noir (including 6% still Pinot) with a dash of Chardonnay from the estate’s oldest vineyards. This is Lot L 02, disgorged June, 2010. Anticipated maturity: 2010-2016.

92 Points - Wine Spectator     An undercurrent of minerality supports ripe black cherry and black raspberry flavors, with hints of pastry, cream and candied grapefruit peel. Finely meshed and focused by vibrant acidity. Disgorged March 2011. Drink now through 2016.

92 Points - Stephen Tanzer's International Wine Cellar     (75% pinot noir and 25% chardonnay; 50% of the wine is from 2009, 25% from 2008 and 25% from 2007; disgorged June, 2011): Light orange. High-pitched aromas of redcurrant and strawberry, with deeper rhubarb and rose oil nuances and a hint of white pepper. Bright and nervy on the palate, showing tangy red berry and blood orange flavors that gain flesh and weight with air. Closes on a chalky note, with very good energy and lingering spiciness.

90 Points - Vinous     Billiot's NV Brut Rosé Grand Cru is powerful and tightly wound, with a great interplay of tension and Ambonnay power. Cranberry, chalk, white pepper and mint are some of the signatures, but it is the wine's persistence and overall palate presence that make it the most distinctive of these three wines. Hints of orange peel and dried leaves add further shades of nuance. There is a lot to like.

title: Penfolds Bin 128 Coonawarra Shiraz 2020
bodyHtml:
The famous red soils of Coonawarra might be more famous for the distinctive Cabernet Sauvignon they produce, but Shiraz grown there is equally as unique and delicious. So, don’t overlook this little beauty. The cool climate and use of French oak add a Rhône-like touch, although it remains staunchly Aussie. The flavour profile is more red fruit-dominated than one might expect, so tangy cranberry, sweet pomegranate, red plum jam and ripe raspberry mingle with blackberry, vanilla, peppery juniper, mint, creamy tiramisu and dried herbs. First made in 1962, Penfolds Bin 128 Coonawarra Shiraz is still going strong some 57 years later, and it makes a fine choice for bringing a little sunshine to cold winter evenings. Highly recommended with comfort food.

Wine Description

This is a single-varietal Shiraz. It pours a dense colour with a lovely dark ruby hue or a black cherry core with ruby highlights. The aroma presents a savoury profile, with suggestions of cocoa powder, blackboard chalk, and white peppercorns, alongside cool fruit notes of mulberries and blueberries. Scents also include black fruit, like blueberry, leather, chocolate, and garrigue scrub.

Accolades

  • 'Decanter' - 95 points.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for this intense, yet elegant Shiraz include game or beef dishes. Its flavour profile is well-suited to grilled or roasted meats, such as fresh lamb with rosemary, or braised beef.

title: Vajra Barolo Ravera 2022
H. Billiot Fils Cuvee Laetitia Brut (NV)
bodyHtml:
The first of H. Billiot's Prestige Cuvées, Cuvée Laetitia is a blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay whose secret remains jealously guarded. A perpetual Cuvée whose vintages from 1983 to 2014 fill its aromas with subtle and refined notes.

To be enjoyed as an aperitif to appreciate all its complexity and voluptuousness…

92 Points - Wine Spectator     Ripe flavors of candied cherry and currant, quince paste and honey are layered with subtle notes of blood orange, vanilla and almond in this exuberant Champagne, which shows good balance and an appealing juiciness that pushes through to the long, mouthwatering finish.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast     With a strong, mousse-like feel in the mouth, this is a lively offering. It's yellow fruit is layered with toastiness. It has a rich feel, very much in the Billiot style, and a complex, compact character. It is ready to drink.

title: San Matias Tahona Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Vivrant, lush, tropical and deeply enjoyable with potent aromas and flavourings of green plantain leaves, smoked pineapple, orange peel, dried lime, cooked bananas, burnt caramel, bruised papaya, smoked cactus, hibiscus flowers, fresh tobacco leaf, cut grass and grilled wood.

title: Ricasoli 'Castello di Brolio' Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2021
bodyHtml:
The Ricasoli family has been integral to the history of Chianti wine for over 800 years, with the Castello di Brolio serving as the centre of their winemaking legacy.

Wine Description

The Ricasoli 'Castello di Brolio' Chianti Classico 2021 is a powerful yet elegant wine with great richness and depth. It presents an intense bouquet of small red berries, violets, and spices, along with aromas of dark cherries, bark, and a floral quality. On the palate, the wine is described as medium bodied, featuring a core of ripe cherry, plum, and pomegranate notes.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 97 points

  • Decanter - 96+ points

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 96 points

  • Wine Spectator - 95 points

  • Vinous - 95 points

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include red meat such as veal chops, as well as spaghetti and meatballs or chicken parmesan.

title: Barbi Rosso di Montalcino 2021
bodyHtml: Barbi Rosso di Montalcino has the same characteristics as Brunello but in a more youthful and disengaged version. It comes from the same type of Sangiovese grapes from younger vineyards, which give aromatic and elegant wines, less tannic and full-bodied than Brunello. This wine is ideal for less demanding occasions and for those who want to enjoy the pleasure of a good glass every day.

title: Royal Jamaican Gold Rum
bodyHtml:
Meticulously blended in small batches and personally crafted in every sense of word, each bottle is drawn and bottled by hand. 

A captivating amber color and silky smooth rich taste offer you endless possibilities to savor this rum neat, or use as a preferred mixer.

title: Flor De Cana 25 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
An impressive, well aged Flor de Caña single estate rum. A stunning, radiant hue makes it a wonder to look at, and it tastes as good as it looks. Top shelf rum from the Nicaraguan producer.

Nose: Fragrant, floral sweetness up front, with a touch of fresh sugarcane thrown in too. Slowly develops savoury notes of rye bread, thyme and cayenne pepper.

Palate: Very creamy. Much fruitier than the nose suggests, with papaya, kiwi and ripe pear. Oak-y cigar box notes appear later on.

Finish: Soft spices, fried banana and peach, very slightly oily. Goes on and on.

title: Santa Teresa 1796 Rum
bodyHtml:
A superb single estate Venezuelan rum, Santa Teresa 1796 is made using the solera method, used more famously in the production of Spanish sherry. The rums in the blend are aged for between five and 35 years, resulting in a smooth, dry and balanced spirit that is perfect for sipping or serving in an Old Fashioned.

Nose: Caramel sweetness, toffee brittle, pepper. Cooked apple, foam banana sweets.

Palate: Vanilla and rich notes of butterscotch, molasses and chocolate. More of those banana sweet notes. Hints of Calvados, surprisingly...

Finish: Long, fruity finish with caramel and nuts.

title: Chateau Lynch Bages 2020
bodyHtml:
#4 Wine Spectator Top 100 of 2023

Overlooking the Gironde estuary at the entrance to Pauillac, the vines of Lynch-Bages are located on the Bages plateau, on one of the finest gravelly rises in the appellation. The estate once belonged to the famous Lynch family, of Irish origin, and was acquired by Jean-Charles Cazes in 1934.

99 Points - James Suckling

A beautifully layered red with blackcurrant, hazelnut and lead-pencil character and fine, velvety tannins. Full-bodied and reserved. It’s like a tightly knit ball of polished tannins that are cashmere in texture. So very long and impressive. Give this time. A terrific Lynch.

98 Points - Wilfred Wong

The 2020 Chateau Lynch-Bages is a complete wine with substantial and enduring richness. This wine shines with aromas and flavors of bold blackberries and boysenberries balanced with excellent oaky nuances. Enjoy it with slow-grilled, lightly seasoned short ribs.

96+ Points - Wine Enthusiast

Bold black fruits and dense, textured tannins are very much in the style of the estate. What is new in this vintage is the extra precision that lifts the wine, bringing together the beautiful black currant flavors of ripe Cabernet Sauvignon with a refined texture of sophisticated tannins. This is an impressive wine, sure to age over many years.

96 Points - Decanter

The lowest amount of Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend on recent record but the signature of Lynch Bages is very much in play here - tons of liquorice, grippy and charismatic cassis and blueberry fruit with a velvety texture layered with blackcurrant pastilles and rich dark chocolate. This is easily one of the best Pauillacs that I have tasted in the vintage, totally gorgeous.

96 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2020 Chateau Lynch-Bages brings even more density and depth and is another vin de garde in the vintage. A blend of 61% Cabernet Sauvignon, 31% Merlot, 5% Petit Verdot, and the rest Cabernet Franc, aged in 75% new barrels, this inky hued beauty boasts a ripe, powerful, full-bodied style that carries serious concentration as well as building, ripe, velvety tannins. 

96 Points - Wine Spectator

Gorgeous from the start, with cassis and violet notes leading off, followed by additional waves of black cherry and blackberry fruit as well as sweet tobacco and iron. Shows subtle savory and cedar hints that stay in the background, as the iron note pierces through the fruit on the finish.

95+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The vintage that inaugurated the estate's new state-of-the-art winery, the 2020 Lynch-Bages has turned out very nicely, offering up aromas of creme de cassis and blackberries mingled with notions of pencil shavings, spices and classy new oak. Medium to full-bodied, deep and layered, with good concentration, ripe, powdery tannins and a seamless, integrated profile for such a young Lynch-Bages, it shows considerable promise.

title: Kavalan Concertmaster Port Cask Finish
bodyHtml:
Taiwanese whisky has been a 'thing' for a while now, since 2008, in fact, but the highly-regarded Kavalan whiskies are now finally available! This single malt whisky utilizes Ruby Port, Tawny Port, and Vintage Port casks from Portugal to finish whiskies initially matured in American oak. Kavalan Concertmaster was named Best in Class at the 2011 International Wine & Spirit Competition.

See More International Whisky

title: Billecart Salmon Blanc de Blancs Brut
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' sparkling wine originates from France, within the world-renowned Champagne AOC. Maison Billecart-Salmon, situated in the Grand Cru village of Mareuil-sur-Aÿ, is an iconic family-owned house founded in 1818 by the marriage of Nicolas François Billecart and Elisabeth Salmon. This cuvée is an absolute celebration of Chardonnay, sourced exclusively from the prestigious Grand Cru villages of the Côte des Blancs: Avize, Chouilly, Cramant, and Le Mesnil-sur-Oger. Operating under a winemaking philosophy of precision, purity, and strict site transparency, the house masterfully leverages these distinct limestone terroirs to construct a Blanc de Blancs that marries intense mineral drive with an ethereal, weightless elegance.

Wine Description

The Billecart-Salmon Le Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru presents a stunning, luminous yellow-gold appearance in the glass, enlivened by delicate greenish reflections and an ultra-fine, persistent stream of elegant bubbles. Its sensory profile displays a pure and high-toned mineral intensity, unfolding a sophisticated bouquet of fresh lemons, confit citrus oil, white orchard fruits, and white flowers, beautifully layered with rich nuances of warm brioche, fresh butter, and fresh almonds. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, pillowy, and remarkably incisive, showcasing a creamy meringue-like texture balanced by a razor-sharp, flinty tang. It is characterized by its outstanding, laser-focused natural acidity and a high-definition chalky structure. The finish is exceptionally chiseled, long, and persistent, culminating in a pristine wave of citrus zest and a distinctive, mouthwatering saline minerality.

This 100% Chardonnay is vinified at strictly controlled low temperatures in stainless steel tanks to safeguard the pristine fruit definition and protect it from premature oxidation. The non-vintage blend incorporates a generous 30% to 40% of aged reserve wines to ensure a flawless signature continuity. Following secondary fermentation, the bottling undergoes an extended maturation on its fine lees in the house's deep chalk cellars for 4 to 5 years far exceeding the legal requirement. It is finished with a precise, low dosage (ranging from 1.7 to 3.9 grams per litre depending on the base disgorgement), keeping its profile piercingly fresh and dry, and reaches an alcohol content (ABV) of 12.0%. Guided by a strict respect for nature, the house incorporates sustainable agricultural practices across its grand cru holdings.

title: Suntory Hibiki Harmony Whisky
bodyHtml:
Launched in 1989 to commemorate Suntory's 90th anniversary, Hibiki is a premium blend produced by Suntory Global Spirits, a subsidiary of Suntory Holdings. The whisky is a meticulous 'harmony' of malt and grain whiskies sourced from Suntory's three main distilleries: Yamazaki in Kyoto, Hakushu in Yamanashi, and Chita in Aichi.

Description

This bright amber whisky offers a seductive and subtle sensory experience. The nose is blossoming with notes of rose, lychee, rosemary, and mature woodiness, balanced by hints of sandalwood and honey. On the palate, it delivers a honey-like sweetness and a silky texture, featuring flavours of candied orange peel, white chocolate, and apricot with a touch of cinnamon spice. The finish is subtle and long, leaving behind tender traces of Mizunara oak and citrus peel. It is a full-bodied and balanced expression designed to reflect the 24 seasons of the traditional Japanese calendar, which are represented by the 24 facets of its iconic bottle. ABV 43%.

title: Frank Family Zinfandel Napa Valley 2021
bodyHtml: This Napa Valley Zinfandel has a deep scarlet hue. On the nose, the wine has a savory quality of pepper, leather, brambly fruit and dried orange rind. This vibrant, medium-bodied Zinfandel has a silky and enveloping mouthfeel, offering abundant notes of red raspberries and dark berries, and a long, layered finish.

title: De Forville Barbaresco 2022
bodyHtml: Obtained from Nebbiolo grapes cultivated in the vineyards of Loreto, Ovello and Cavanna in the commune of Barbaresco. It is a full-bodied wine, with balanced tannins and texture. It matures for two years in wooden casks to express its velvety taste and perfumes after some years in the bottle.

title: Lagrimas de Dolores Mezcal Joven Maguey Masparillo
bodyHtml: Maguey Masparillo is a rare, wild form of Agave maximiliana. It is one of the rarer breeds of agave, and due to its scarcity, Masparillo mezcal is challenging to produce. After roasting over volcanic stones in an underground fire pit by the de la Cruz and Flores families in San Miguel Temoaya, the cooked agave hearts are crushed by hand using machetes, no tahonas or horses! It is then fermented in open pine vats and double-distilled in a conical wooden still.

title: Sangster's Jamaica Rum Cream
bodyHtml: Born on the island where the rum comes from, Sangster’s Jamaica Rum Cream is a superb blend of premium aged Jamaican rum and rich cream, with just a hint of exotic Jamaican fruits and spices.

title: D'Arenberg The Stump Jump GSM 2021
bodyHtml:
A brooding concoction of dark, sweet and savory notes. Plum, dark cherry, game, earth, and black pepper. The palate adds mulberry and raspberry with beautiful lifted spice and mineral grit. There's no shortage of flavor here.

Blend: 39% Grenache, 38% Shiraz, 23% Mourvedre

title: Eau Claire Saskatoon Honey Gin
bodyHtml: Eau Claire Distillery Saskatoon Honey Gin as an ode to the Canadian prairies! The infused spirit incorporates flavours of the Canadian prairies to pay homage to the distillery’s Alberta home. Eau Claire Distillery’s Saskatoon Honey Gin is an Alberta version of a British-style sloe gin and is infused with locally sourced honey, Saskatoon berries, rose hips and Alberta malted barley, in addition to classic gin botanicals.

title: Domaine Pattes Loup Chablis Premier Cru Butteaux 2020
bodyHtml:
The 2019 Chablis Premier Cru Butteaux is a white wine from Domaine Pattes Loup, located in Courgis, within the renowned Chablis region of Burgundy, France. Established by Thomas Pico in 2005, the estate has garnered acclaim for its commitment to organic viticulture and meticulous winemaking practices. Pico's dedication to low yields, hand harvesting, and extended élevage has positioned Domaine Pattes Loup among Chablis's most exciting producers.

Wine Description
This 100% Chardonnay wine exhibits a pale gold hue with shimmering highlights. The nose is subtle yet complex, revealing aromas of redcurrant and flint. On the palate, it is full-bodied and perfectly balanced, showcasing good consistency and pronounced minerality. The wine's texture is creamy and enveloping, leading to a long, saline finish that underscores its elegance.

Food Pairing
This Chablis Premier Cru Butteaux pairs exquisitely with fine seafood dishes such as sole, sushi, and trout. The wine's depth and character are highlighted when enjoyed alongside these delicacies, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

Vintage Quality
The 2019 vintage in Chablis was marked by a mild winter and a cooler spring, leading to reduced yields. Despite these challenges, the resulting wines are concentrated and opulent, yet racy and intensely saline, reflecting the winemaker's skill in adapting to the year's conditions.

title: San Felice Chianti Classico Riserva 'Il Grigio' 2022
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the heart of Tuscany in Italy, San Felice Chianti Classico Riserva 'Il Grigio' 2022 is a masterful expression of the region's historic terroir. The San Felice estate, steeped in a rich winemaking history dating back centuries, balances traditional Tuscan heritage with modern innovation to craft exceptional estate grown wines. Their philosophy centers on elevating indigenous grape varieties while strictly respecting the nuances of their calcareous Galestro and Alberese limestone soils.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese displays a deep ruby red color in the glass. The nose opens with an intense, rich bouquet redolent of violets and wild red berry fruits, beautifully interlaced with complex undertones of black plums, eucalyptus leaves, and a touch of dark chocolate. On the palate, it is full-bodied, lean, and firm, delivering an austere yet highly harmonious balance between succulent, mature tannins and a tangy, vibrant acidity. Linear tension and a graceful structure guide the wine into a long, savoury finish marked by notes of cherry, mahogany, and a subtle hint of salt.

Food Pairing

This classic Tuscan red is an excellent match for rich, meat-sauced first courses, roast pigeon, or a premium grilled steak. The wine's strict tannin axis and refreshing acidity cut right through the richness of hearty, grilled red meats and aged cheeses.

title: Mount Riley Pinot Gris 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Mount Riley Pinot Gris 2024 is an off-dry white wine from the Marlborough region of New Zealand. It is produced by Mount Riley Wines, a family-owned estate established in 1992 that focuses on creating high-value wines that capture the specific terroir of the Wairau and Awatere Valleys. This specific vintage was shaped by a shift to strong El Niño weather patterns, resulting in a dry, windy growing season that produced exceptionally clean fruit with intense aromatics.

Wine Description

  • Appearance: The wine displays a pale straw colour in the glass.

  • Aroma: It features a bright, elegantly fragrant bouquet of Asian pear, Gala apple, and rockmelon, underscored by fresh herbal notes and a hint of spice.

  • Palate: On the palate, it is medium-bodied and just off-dry, offering a rich, fleshy texture balanced by vibrant natural acidity.

  • Technical Details: The wine is made from 100% estate-grown Pinot Gris. While most of the juice is fermented in stainless steel at cool temperatures to retain freshness, approximately 10% is fermented in old French oak barrels to add weight, complexity, and texture.Specifications: It typically has an alcohol content of 13.5% ABV and a residual sugar level of 6.0 g/L.

Food Pairing

The "smooth nature" and off-dry profile of this Pinot Gris make it an excellent partner for dishes that balance spice or creaminess:

  • Meats: Pairs well with white meats like chicken or veal, as well as roast pork.

  • Asian Cuisine: Its slight sweetness and acidity are a "game-changer" for Thai cuisine, Indian appetizers, and Vietnamese pork stews.

  • Seafood: Suggested matches include Ebi (prawn) tempura and smoked fish.Cheese: Complements a variety of cheeses, particularly soft-ripened styles or Ossau-Iraty sheep milk cheese.

title: Wolfburn Morven Single Malt
bodyHtml:
This lightly peated whisky is made from malted barley infused with smoke during the drying process. The flavour imparted by the smoke is a reflection of Wolfburn’s history – the original 19th Century distillery was largely fired by peat. Gentle distillation is followed by maturation in our purpose-built warehouses. The result is a beautifully smooth and rounded whisky. Non chill-filtered at 46% alc./vol.

The nose is initially smoky with hints of fruit and fresh sea air, accompanied by vanilla and oak wood shavings.  Floral notes abound in the mouth, followed by raisins and light spices. Malty flavours open up on the palate, with soft honey sweetness

title: Bollinger 'La Grande Annee' 2014
bodyHtml:
Tinted with golden glints that reflect the wine’s maturity and Bollinger vinification techniques. A precise and fruity nose with a slight scent of sea-air. Aromas of cherry and lemon mingle with quince and bergamot. Then notes of hazelnut and almond, peach and mirabelle plum complete this wine’s range of aromas. The initial sensation is a fine and intense effervescence, followed by a wonderful vinosity, and then balanced with delicate acidity. Its very fine texture and sea-air finish bring excellent length on the palate, accompanied by a delicate minerality and the complex flavours of orchard fruit and citrus. This wine unfurls gradually, revealing its full potential and intensity.

95 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Offering up complex aromas of crisp yellow orchard fruit, confit citrus, frangipane, walnuts, dried white flowers and subtle hints of iodine, Bollinger's 2014 Brut La Grande Année is medium to full-bodied, pillowy and vinous, with an elegantly fleshy core of fruit that's underpinned by racy acids and complemented by a pretty pinpoint mousse. Concluding with a long, chalky finish, this is a charming but precise Grande Année that's more giving and demonstrative than its immediate predecessor, 2012, but which attains a very similar level of quality in a more challenging vintage, testimony to the serious viticulture that underpins Bollinger's contemporary excellence.

97 Points - Wine Spectator

Racy acidity drives this mouthwatering Champagne, enlivening the rich panoply of flavours. Features a fine and creamy mousse that's still a lively springboard for aromas and flavors of crème de cassis, glazed tangerine, roasted hazelnut, ground coffee, pickled ginger and white blossoms. Long and satiny, with minerally salt and chalk notes gaining momentum on the lasting finish. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.

title: Glenfarclas 105 Cask Strength
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Glenfarclas 105 Cask Strength is a historic single malt Scotch whisky from the Speyside region of Scotland. Produced by the Glenfarclas Distillery, which was officially founded in 1836 by Robert Hay, the distillery has been owned and managed by the Grant family since 1865. In 1968, George S. Grant released the first commercial barrel proof single malt whisky as a Christmas gift for friends; originally named 'Glenfarclas 105', the name refers to its alcohol content in British Proof.

Spirit Description

This uncolored expression is crafted by marrying various casks—typically aged between 8 and 10 years—to achieve a consistent and powerful strength without the addition of water. It is matured primarily in a combination of ex-sherry and ex-bourbon barrels, though the distillery character is heavily influenced by Oloroso sherry butts.

  • Colour: The spirit displays a deep, coppery amber or amber gold hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is complex and assertive, featuring rich notes of dark toffee, honey on toast, and sherried fruits like raisins and cranberries, complemented by crisp apples, pears, and a hint of smoky coffee.

  • Palate: It offers a dry and silken arrival that rapidly develops into a rich spiciness of peppery oak, cinnamon, and cloves, layered with almond, praline, and boozy Christmas cake.

  • Body: The whisky is full-bodied and robust, possessing an intense concentration of flavours that many find challenging but rewarding at full strength.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, smooth, and warming finish characterized by peppery oak, dried fruits, and a lingering, well-rounded smokiness.

  • ABV: Glenfarclas 105 is bottled at a constant 60% (105 British Proof).

title: Bibi Graetz Casamatta Bianco 2019
bodyHtml:
Like most of Bibi Graetz wines, the name is very evocative -  'CasaMatta' means 'Crazy-House'.  Casamatta Bianco comes from Argentario, on the southern Tuscan coast, home of traditional vines and old vineyards.  A fresh, crunchy, and sapid blend that brings with it the sea breeze.

The first impression of this wine is the zesty aroma, orange and peach flowers, then citrus and acidity from Vermentino, pear, exotic fruits, balance and body from Trebbiano and Ansonica.

Blend: 60% Vermentino, 30% Trebbiano, 10% Ansonico

title: Simonnet Febvre Chablis Les Clos Grand Cru
bodyHtml: It is a wine of unique character - mineral and concentrated, with developing aromas of honey, citrus fruits and spices including cinnamon. It is always very complex on both the nose and palate, and has a clear golden-green color. Initially very closed, this wine always develops exceptionally well over time without losing its minerality. It is the most masculine and uniquely characterful of the Grand Cru wines that require aging. The king of the Grands Crus appellation: a rich, luscious wine with great complexity of flavors. The wine, above all other, for keeping.

title: Kanonkop Red Blend 'Paul Sauer' 2021
bodyHtml: This powerful yet elegant Bordeaux blend is a true South African classic. It exhibits intense aromas and rich flavors of cassis, plum and licorice, with underlying notes of leather and tea leaf. Enticing hints of violets, underbrush, and cigar box linger on the long, silky finish.

title: Two Hands Shiraz Bella's Garden 2021
bodyHtml:
This premium red wine originates from the Barossa Valley in South Australia. As part of the "Garden Series" by Two Hands Wines, Bella's Garden is designed to be the definitive expression of Barossa Shiraz, sourced from over 25 premier vineyard sites across the region’s diverse sub-districts, including Ebenezer, Gomersal, and Marananga. Founded in 1999 by Michael Twelftree and Richard Mintz, the winery operates with a "quality without compromise" philosophy, employing a rigorous barrel-selection process where only the finest components make the final blend for the Garden Series.

Wine Description

The Two Hands Bella's Garden Shiraz typically presents an opaque, deep purple-to-black colour. The sensory profile is a hallmark of "power and poise," offering an intense bouquet of blueberries, blackberries, and dark chocolate, layered with complex notes of black pepper, woodsmoke, and lavender. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and voluminous, showcasing a rich, plush texture and a "molten" core of dark fruit balanced by a fresh acidic lift. It is characterized by building, structural tannins and a long, savory finish featuring hints of graphite and toasted spices.

title: Pegasus Bay Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
From the Waipara Valley in North Canterbury, New Zealand, Pegasus Bay is a family-owned winery established by the Donaldson family, pioneers of the region’s modern wine movement. Their philosophy blends traditional methods with innovative techniques, focusing on low yields, sustainable practices, and expressing the unique terroir of their estate vineyard.

Wine Description
The 2022 Pegasus Bay Pinot Noir displays a deep ruby hue with garnet reflections. On the nose, it opens with vibrant red cherry, blackberry, and ripe plum, underpinned by earthy tones, wild herbs, and a touch of floral lift. The palate is lush and silky, with finely integrated tannins and a juicy acidity that carries notes of dark berries, black tea, and subtle oak spice. Full-bodied and complex, the wine finishes with lingering savoury nuances and mineral depth. Crafted entirely from estate-grown fruit, this vintage showcases exceptional balance and structure. Enjoy now or cellar confidently for 7–10 years.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 95 points

Food Pairing
Perfectly suited for dishes like duck breast with cherry glaze, wild mushroom risotto, or roast lamb with rosemary and garlic. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Louis Jadot Beaune Premier Cru Celebration 2020
bodyHtml: The strength of the Beaune appellation is grounded in its 337 hectares of premier cru vineyards, which offer great stylistic diversity. Founded in Beaune in 1859, Maison Louis Jadot has always focused on the terroirs of these premier crus, emphasizing their huge potential. When presented with a truly great vintage Jadot takes the opportunity to create a Celebration of the Beaune premier crus. This is drawn from selected lots across Jadot’s holdings in 17 Beaune premier crus, including Clos des Ursules, Boucherottes, Aux Cras, Clos des Couchereaux, Bressandes, Theurons, Grèves, Avaux, Chouacheux, Cent Vignes, Toussaints, Vignes Franches, Pertuisots, Aigrots, Clos du Roi, and Reversées. These terroirs are featured on the unique front label.

title: Bottega 'Pesca' - Grappa Peach Liqueur
bodyHtml: Natural fruit juice, obtained from peaches grown in ideal conditions, is expertly mixed with grappa, alcohol and sugar to create a sweet, appealing liqueur with an unmistakable taste. The excellent quality of ingredients, combined with a natural extraction process, leads to a product which is particularly suited for a healthy lifestyle.

title: Pernod
bodyHtml: Electric deep yellow with lime tinges, the nose suggests medium aromas of fennel seeds and soft black licorice. It is viscous and creamy ending with a slight sweetness and tones of fennel seeds, herbs and light licorice.

title: Anselmi San Vincenzo 2023
bodyHtml:
A superb iconic white wine from famed Italian winemaker Roberto Anselmi's Cru vineyards, and a Wine Spectator Top 100 wine!

Vincenzo is an expressive white, creamy and lightly juicy throughout, offering flavors of blood orange granita, fresh tarragon, yellow peach and mineral, set in a light-bodied frame. The finish is juicy.  70% Garganega, 30% Chardonnay/Sauvignon Blanc growing on horizontal spurred cordons. Pairs well with sautéed mussels and other rich seafood preparations.

title: The Old Malt Cask Craigellachie 14 Year Old
bodyHtml:
General Information

A sufficiently sherried Craigellachie, distilled back in May 2006. The single malt's next 12 years were spent in a single sherry butt, adding oodles of fruity notes to the single malt. In 2019, Hunter Laing yielded 285 bottles from the cask, bottled at 50% ABV for the Old Malt Cask series.

title: Di Arie Se Zinfandel 2018
bodyHtml: This richly aromatic wine has strong blackberry aromas which carry over to the palate along with adding savoury, smoky and spicy notes. The palate will show elegant flavours of plum and dark cherries along with layers of cocoa, spice and vanilla and the finish brings nuances of black pepper.

title: Tamdhu Batch Strength No. 007
bodyHtml: Tamdhu's dedication to Oloroso Sherry casks is ever present in the latest edition of its multi-award-winning 'Batch Strength’ series. Produced using the finest seasoned Oloroso Sherry casks from the bodegas of Jerez, Spain, batch Strength 007 has a deep, signature, natural copper hue. The descendant of the gold-awarded 6th addition, this 7th release delivers a complex flavour profile and an enduring finish. You'll discover a chorus of berries, roasted nuts, caramels, citrus, and spice within this full-bodied liquid. A genuinely unique bottling.

title: Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label Brut
bodyHtml:
'Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label Brut' is the flagship Champagne of the renowned Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin house, founded in 1772 in Reims, France. Known for its distinctive yellow label and consistent quality, this non-vintage Champagne embodies the house’s commitment to tradition and innovation.

Tasting Notes
A brilliant golden-yellow hue with a fine stream of bubbles, this Champagne opens with aromas of ripe yellow fruits such as pear and apple, intertwined with hints of vanilla and freshly baked brioche. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious blend of peach, citrus, and toasty notes, culminating in a crisp and lingering finish.

Serving Suggestions
Serve chilled at 8–10°C in a Champagne flute to highlight its aromatic complexity and vibrant effervescence. It pairs beautifully with a variety of dishes, including fresh seafood like salmon or tuna tartar, light appetizers such as blinis with crème fraîche and caviar, or even mild cheeses.

Accolades

  • Decanter - 94 points
  • James Suckling - 92 points
  • Bettane + Desseauve - 94 points

title: Guy Amiot Chassagne Montrachet Premier Cru Les Vergers 2012
bodyHtml:
General Information

Guy and Thierry Amiot continue to please the consumer and the press alike. They produce classic Chassagne Montrachet that expresses their varied "terroir", enhanced by approx. 25% new oak. These are very pure wines with a subtle balance of fruit, acid and minerality typical of the appellation. Amiot has avoided the trend, seen elsewhere, of trying to make New World wines by harvesting ultra ripe fruit. Rather than being full of tropical fruit with a lesser structure, these are brilliant, finely chiseled wines of true Burgundian character. The domaine offers a superb collection of Premier Cru sites that reflect the different terroirs found throughout the appellation.

title: Foppiano Pinot Noir Russian River 2019
bodyHtml: This Pinot Noir shows a depth of colour, aroma and flavour to rival the best producers in the Russian River Valley. A beautiful garnet colour leads to aromas of red currant, earl grey, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cherry cedar. The flavours seamlessly match the aromatics.

title: Koyle Carmenere Gran Reserva 2019
bodyHtml:
Vinas Koyle is situated in a Mediterranean microclimate on the Andean foothills. Their vineyards are influenced by the constant and fresh breezes that come down from the mountains and their well-drained soils have a clay texture with volcanic rocks and colluvial stones that deliver unique minerals giving the right balance to their vines. Both are key factors of optimal terroir for the production of high quality red wines.

The soil presents a matrix of rocks in different states of decomposition, mainly as fragmented alterites, which give the balance sought between vigour, productivity and quality. Mineral notes are expressed because of the balanced extraction through the deep roots.

This wine has a lovely and lively fragrance with aromas of raspberry, plum, cherry, white pepper, and cedar. This wine has a lovely, velvety texture and vivid tart cherry, raspberry, cranberry, and plum flavours on the palate, with vibrant acidity and a wonderful, velvety texture. The finish is lengthy, with red cherry flavours that linger.

title: Podere 414 Morellino Di Scansano 2022
bodyHtml: Intense and deep ruby ​​bone, perfume characterized by primary aromas of red fruit that integrate with spice perceptions, a discreet complement to the woody note. On the palate it is clear, wide and round, however lively, thanks to a balanced acidity. It is a 'gastronomic' wine suitable to accompany in the best way the cuisine of the Tuscan tradition and in particular, of the Maremma.

title: Bollinger Vieilles Vignes Francaises
bodyHtml:
The Bollinger Vieilles Vignes Françaises is an extraordinarily rare and historic Champagne, produced from ungrafted Pinot Noir vines in the Grand Cru village of Aÿ. Champagne Bollinger, founded in 1829, has long been renowned for its rich and structured wines. This cuvée is crafted exclusively from two pre-phylloxera plots, Chaudes Terres and Clos St. Jacques, which are cultivated by hand using traditional methods.

Wine Description

Vieilles Vignes Françaises presents a deep golden hue, exuding richness and depth. The nose is highly expressive, with aromas of quince jelly, mirabelle plum, and dried fruits, accented by notes of mocha and toasted brioche. The palate is opulent yet precise, delivering layers of ripe orchard fruit, spice, and mineral-driven complexity. The finish is exceptionally long, with a saline edge that enhances its elegance. Made exclusively from Pinot Noir, this Blanc de Noirs Champagne has a dosage of 4 grams per liter and was cellar-aged for more than twice the time required by appellation standards, resulting in a wine of remarkable depth and refinement.

Food Pairing

This rare Champagne pairs beautifully with luxurious dishes such as white caviar and Alba truffle, which highlight its depth and complexity. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Tawse Riesling Niagara Peninsula VQA 2021
bodyHtml: Greenish yellow in colour, this white boasts a medium nose exuding floral and fruity aromas. Discover this medium-bodied wine expressing lively acidity and offering a unctuous texture. It also unveils a medium mouthfeel that leads into a medium finish.

title: Rocca delle Macie 'Sasyr' Rosso Toscana IGT 2023 - 5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Colour... intense ruby red.

Bouquet... very intense and complex, with fruity  aromas of cherry, blackberry and raspberry. 

Taste... smooth with a good structure, it has  a pleasant freshness and a long persistent aromatic finish.

A very versatile wine, it combines well with many different courses based on meats and cheeses.  It is a very pleasant wine to enjoy on its own as well.

title: Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label Brut - 375 ml
bodyHtml: One of the best-known and most enjoyed Champagnes. Full-bodied and richly flavoured, it is one of the finest Champagnes available. Aromas of apple, pear, toast and brioche; the palate is extra-dry and medium to full body with flavours that match the aromas.

title: Siro Pacenti Rosso Di Montalcino 2019
bodyHtml:
Siro Pacenti bought his estate and planted his first vines in 1970, which still thrive today. The property is north of Montalcino, in Pelagrilli, and overlooks Siena with 22 hectares of Sangiovese in fresh, clay soils. Giancarlo Pacenti took over the winery in 1988 and produced the first Rosso and Brunello di Montalcino the following year. The estate grew to incorporate territory south of Montalcino (Piancornello) in the early 1990s, where Giancarlo's grandfather had planted five hectares of Sangiovese in the 1960s. Pelagrilli, at 350 metres above sea level and the foot of Montalcino Hill, is known for its clay and sandy soils. The wines are refined and fragrant. Vineyards develop in more minerally and pebbly soils on ground rock at Piancornello. The temperature is also hotter here, resulting in more structured, robust wines with Sangiovese's signature sweet, round tannins.

91 Points - Vinous

Wild raspberries, hints of clove and sweet minty herbs lift up to form an inviting bouquet as the 2019 Rosso di Montalcino opens up in the glass. While silky in feel, there's tremendous concentration here, motivated by brisk acids, drenching the palate in tart wild berries and minerals. Grippy tannins linger long, making for a lightly structured and penetrating finale. This full-throttle yet balanced Rosso is showing beautifully.

title: Animus Tinto Douro 2023
bodyHtml: Explore your dark side with Animus. Cedar brush and wild tart black raspberry are on the nose of this full-bodied Portuguese red wine. Smooth and supple. Great price.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '23' Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Asahi Shuzo, Dassai 23 (Ni-wari San-bun) is a world-renowned icon of the "polishing race," where breweries compete to reach the lowest possible rice polishing ratio. Launched in 1992, it was the first sake to achieve a 23% polishing ratio, meaning 77% of each Yamada Nishiki rice grain is painstakingly removed over seven days to leave only the starchiest white core. It is a "People’s Choice" favorite and was famously selected by former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe as a gift for official state banquets.

Description

This ultra-premium sake is crystalline and elegant, with a slightly higher viscosity than standard brews. The nose is a sophisticated "bouquet of luxury," featuring well-defined aromas of muscat grapes, fresh-cut pineapple, wild flowers, and honeydew melon. On the palate, it is exceptionally silky and weightless, offering a delicate honey-like sweetness and flavors of white peach, pear, and a hint of vanilla. Despite its luscious fruitiness, it maintains a clean, ethereal structure with refreshing acidity and a persistent, mineral finish. ABV 16%.

Food Pairing

Dassai 23 is widely considered the ultimate "sipping sake," but its purity also makes it a brilliant companion for delicate, high-end cuisine. It is a flawless match for premium sashimi (especially fatty tuna or scallop), raw oysters, and lightly poached shellfish. Its unique acidity also allows it to bridge into Western cuisine, pairing beautifully with mild cheeses like Parmesan, creamy pasta, or chicken with white wine sauce. To fully experience its complex aromatics, serve it slightly chilled (10–12°C) in a small white wine glass rather than a traditional ceramic cup.

title: Darroze Les Grandes Assamblages 12 Year Old Armagnac
bodyHtml:
A boisterous 12 year old Bas Armagnac blended and bottled by the incomparable Darroze as part of their Grands Assemblages range. Hints of liquorice and cinnamon. This really blossoms after a minute or two breathing in the glass.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Allow this bright amber brandy some air exposure, and the reward is a dried fruit aroma and a vanilla flavour, with touches of cinnamon and clove.

title: Domaine Chanson Pere & Fils Pouilly Fuisse 2022
bodyHtml: Pale yellow colour. Very fresh aromas of white peach mixed with almond. Subtle minerality. Well-balanced structure. Deep texture. Delicate minerality. Tense acidity. Long and generous finish.

title: Sand Point Family Vineyards Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml: An immediately approachable wine, offering aromas and flavors of dense ripe strawberry and cherry cola. With French and American Oak aging, there is a hint of soft spice that melds into the opening notes, creating a smooth and balanced wine that is easy to enjoy.

title: Chartron & Trebuchet Pouilly Fuisse 2023
bodyHtml:
Chartron & Trébuchet Pouilly Fuissé 2023 originates from France, specifically from the Burgundy region and the Mâconnais subregion. Founded in 1984 in Puligny Montrachet, the winery is historically situated in the 'Golden Triangle' of the Côte de Beaune—Meursault, Puligny Montrachet, and Chassagne Montrachet. The estate's winemaking philosophy centers on a contemporary interpretation of classic Burgundy, utilizing a stringent selection of the best terroirs and expert aging to express the aromatic richness and purity of the Chardonnay variety.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a pale gold colour with green highlights and a medium body. The sensory profile is elegant and mineral driven, featuring a nose of flint, lemon, grapefruit, and apricot, accented by delicate notes of white flowers and roasted peanuts. On the rich and tense palate, it delivers flavours of green apple, pear, and melon, supported by high acidity and a fine salinity. The finish is long and persistent, dominated by a distinct minerality and subtle citrus tones.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: Sourced from vines planted in Jurassic era clay and limestone soils, the wine is celebrated for its linear structure and 'Meursault like' richness.

  • ABV: Recorded at 13%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate follows demanding standards of vinification and typicity, this specific bottling is not typically certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and mineral profile of this Pouilly Fuissé make it a versatile partner for rich seafood and creamy dishes. Suggested pairings include:

  • Seafood: Grilled salmon, lobster with brown butter sauce, scallops, and halibut with a trio of sauces.

  • Poultry: Creamy chicken dishes, Bresse chicken with morel mushrooms, or grilled chicken with a nectarine barbecue sauce.

  • Savoury & Rich: Seafood macaroni, sweetbreads in cream, or a wild mushroom risotto.

  • Cheese: Pairs well with Roquefort, Beaufort, Epoisses, and Comté.

title: Dalmore 15 Year Old
bodyHtml: A favourite expression in the Dalmore stable, this 15-year-old is elegant and smooth, with lip-smacking texture and the flawless balance one would expect from blending maestro Richard Paterson.

title: Vouette & Sorbee Fidele Brut Nature (NV)
bodyHtml: The Fidele (Extra Brut) is Vouette & Sorbee Estate's main cuvée, a blanc de noirs (grown on Kimmeridgian soils) with dried cherry fruit and a savory, herbal intensity.  Made from 100% Pinot Noir from biodynamically farmed estate vineyards in the Aube,  Fidele is fermented in neutral oak, bottled and aged sur latte for 20 months. Very minimal sulfur added. Amazing elegance and depth of flavors.

title: Cloudy Bay Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Hailing from New Zealand, Cloudy Bay Pinot Noir 2022 originates in the renowned Marlborough region, specifically the southern valleys where the climate is ideal for cool-climate varietals. Founded in 1985, Cloudy Bay was one of the first five wineries in Marlborough and is now part of the LVMH group, known globally for its luxury brands. The winery has a pioneering spirit and a deep respect for terroir, consistently producing wines of finesse and expression.

Wine Description
This vintage reveals a radiant ruby hue in the glass. On the nose, it offers enticing aromas of ripe red cherries, wild strawberries, dried herbs, and subtle earthy undertones with a whisper of spice. The palate is silky and layered, showcasing flavours of cranberry, plum, and baking spices supported by well-integrated tannins and vibrant acidity. Medium-bodied and beautifully balanced, the finish is long and elegant, with a lingering note of savoury oak. Composed entirely of Pinot Noir, this wine is approachable now but will continue to evolve gracefully over the next 5–7 years.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 94 points

  • Wine Enthusiast – 93 points

  • Decanter – 92 points

Food Pairing
An ideal partner for roasted duck, mushroom risotto, or grilled salmon. Its freshness and complexity also complement herb-crusted lamb or charcuterie platters. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Bella Sparkling Chardonnay Methode Ancestrale - 1.5 Litre
Sandeman Ruby Port
bodyHtml: Originating in Portugal's Douro Valley, Port is the world's most renowned fortified wine. Luxurious and sweet flavours of plums, chocolate and poached figs, smoky and spicy tones, with full rich flavours and fine balance. Ready to drink, this ruby Port pairs with chocolate-based desserts, berry pie, mature cheeses or paté.

title: Burrowing Owl Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Burrowing Owl Estate Winery, located in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley, has been producing premium VQA wines since its establishment. The winery is committed to sustainable practices and meticulous vineyard management, ensuring the highest quality in their offerings.

The 2022 Pinot Noir is a ripe-flavoured and silky-textured wine. The nose shows ripe black cherry, blackberry, blueberry pie, vanilla, cinnamon, and clove notes with a lilac floral complexity. The medium-bodied palate is smooth-textured, light in tannin, balanced by crisp acidity, and very fruit-driven with flavours of blueberry, lingonberry, and raspberry alongside some Mexican chocolate and a slight bacon, meaty note on the long, silken finish. This wine is expected to develop further complexity over the next three years and beyond.

This Pinot Noir pairs beautifully with a roasted beet salad, barbecued pork ribs, or a Portobello mushroom burger. Together, these pairings enhance the wine’s depth and create an unforgettable dining experience.

The 2022 growing season in the Okanagan Valley was notable for its very late start and remarkable finish, allowing for an abundance of quality grapes and fine wines. An uncharacteristically cool spring resulted in bud break occurring in early May. With delays in fruit development by as much as three weeks, careful vineyard management and cooperative conditions were needed to reach proper sugar levels and ideal natural acidity. The summer months were spectacular, offering the perfect amount of heat and sunshine to allow for the largest yield of grapes to date, followed by an unbelievable fall heading into a condensed harvest that began in October.

As Rhys Pender, Master of Wine, noted, this Pinot Noir is "a ripe flavoured and silky textured Pinot Noir" with a "long, silken finish."

title: Tenuta Argentiera Poggio ai Ginepri Bolgheri 2020
bodyHtml: “Poggio ai Ginepri"– Bolgheri DOC – is composed of 40% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Cabernet Franc, 30% Merlot and 10% Petit Verdot vinified separately and extracted by soft pressing. A nice wine with defined structure and pronounced concentration. The wine’s olfactory panorama is ample and profound while at once immediate and present. An intense structure characterizes this wine, but with a beautiful softness and a remarkably clean finish.

title: Long Weekend Wine Co. Rose
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Back in 2013, sitting around a campfire up north with a glass in hand, we decided to launch an delicious easy drinking wine collection perfect for the cottage, pool-side sipping and any days ending in y. Our Long Weekend wines are fruit-forward, VQA blends that deliver incredible quality for a reasonable price.

title: Bouchard Pere & Fils Beaune Marconnets Premier Cru 2022
bodyHtml: Summer forest floor with cedar on the beautiful, full bodied nose. The nose out performs the wine, because it's a little immature and slightly angular with tannin outweighing the light red fruit. Still, good classic Pinot that can be really enjoyed. Long finish lasts at least a minute and nose maintains in the glass.

title: El Dorado 21 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
Made from rums of between 21 and 25 years of age, matured in 45 gallon oak casks, within six degrees of the equator in Guyana. 

Nose: Buttery, with chocolatey notes of Rolos behind it. Ripe banana and fruity Christmas cake. Hints of tobacco and sandalwood, leading into spent match smokiness.

Palate: Sultanas, dates, blackcurrant and macadamia nuts. A touch of rosewater, too. The mid-palate brings dark chocolate and nutmeg too.

Finish: It just keeps going! There's fried banana and handfuls of raisin notes right through to the end, with just a little hint of spicy cinnamon.

title: Tiberio Montepulciano D'Abruzzo 2022
bodyHtml: Intense aromas and flavours, refined and elegant, with hints of sour red cherry, blueberry, violet and flint. Smooth tannins, full-bodied and a long fresh finish. Try pairing it with tomato and/or meat pasta dishes, poultry and wildfowl, red meats, venison and cheese.

title: Quails' Gate Rose 2023
bodyHtml: A classic summer sipper, this wine is fresh and fruit-forward. Made in a versatile dry style, this wine delivers exceptional flavour and value. A delicate pale salmon colour, anticipate notes of raspberry, strawberry and grapefruit with hints of rhubarb. The wine is crisp and refreshing on the palate with flavours of watermelon and red berries that lead to a long, dry finish. The perfect patio, poolside or picnic pairing, this wine is incredibly versatile.
