Try pairing with simple fare such as pizza, fresh Caprese salad, melon and prosciutto and spinach and strawberry salad.

title: Faustino V Reserva 2019
bodyHtml:
Bodegas Faustino is situated in Oyón within the prestigious Rioja Alavesa subregion of Rioja, Spain. Founded in 1861, this family-owned estate brings over 160 years of winemaking heritage and international acclaim to Rioja's iconic vineyard landscapes. The winery emphasizes a harmonious blend of traditional oak maturation and expressive terroir to produce refined, age-worthy wines.

Wine Description

Faustino V Reserva presents a bright cherry red colour that gently transitions toward maroon hues at the rim. The nose is intense and expressive, revealing ripe red cherries, plums, and subtle dark spices balanced by sweet oak, vanilla, and toasted cocoa. On the palate, this medium-to-full-bodied wine offers smooth layers of dark fruits, cracked black peppercorn, and earth, all framed by fine-grained tannins and vibrant acidity.

title: Glendronach 12 Year Old
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The GlenDronach 12 Year Old is a classic Highland single malt Scotch whisky produced at the GlenDronach Distillery near Huntly, Aberdeenshire. Founded in 1826 by James Allardice, it is one of Scotland's oldest licensed distilleries and is currently owned by Brown-Forman. This expression is renowned for its traditional sherry cask maturation, a signature style that the distillery has maintained for nearly two centuries.

Spirit Description

This 'Sherry Cask Highland Single Malt' is matured for at least 12 years in a combination of the finest Spanish Pedro Ximenez and Oloroso sherry casks. It is bottled at its natural colour without the use of chill filtration.

  • Colour: The whisky displays a deep, sparkling amber red gold hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is sweet and creamy, featuring notes of autumn fruits, ginger, and spiced mulled wine, complemented by hints of pear and vanilla.

  • Palate: It offers a rich, silken, and buttery mouthfeel with flavours of sun dried raisins, soft fruits, and oaky tannins, balanced by spicy ginger and honeyed sweetness.

  • Body: The spirit is full bodied and opulent, providing a well rounded and concentrated texture.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, full, and firm finish that is slightly nutty with lingering notes of spice and dried fruit.

  • ABV: The GlenDronach 12 Year Old is bottled at 43%.

title: Ardbeg Uigeadail
bodyHtml: A marriage of Ardbeg from bourbon barrels and sherry butts gives a sweet and smoky finish to this malt. Uigeadail is the loch from which all Ardbeg water flows. A stunning whisky, and following the demise of Airigh nam Beist, this probably represents the best value in the core range.

title: Sangre De Vida Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Aged at least 12 months in American oak barrels. Full, agave forward aromas transport you from the noises of the world outside inviting you to take a moment of reward experiencing this lovely, complex añejo. Sip this with time to enjoy the many nuances and rich flavors of Sangre de Vida. 100% Blue Agave, 40% ABV.

Delicate scents of oak, caramelized honey, mahogany, sweet potato, vanilla, stewed flowers and pear all held together by baked agave are evocative. The flavors cleanly follow suit with a soft palate that is elegant and rich adding a touch of coffee & chocolate (just a touch). The finish is layered, iterate and supple with a rich lengthy show of all the flavors and adding some earthiness to all the richness.

title: Poema Cava Brut Rose (NV)
bodyHtml: The wine shows aromas and flavours typical of Trepat, with fresh and elegant notes of strawberry, raspberry and rose petals. Balanced acidity keeps the wine light and fresh. A great match with cold cuts, barbecue, small game and lightly smoked fish.

title: Jermann Bianco 'Where Dreams Have No End' 2022
bodyHtml: Jermann Dreams is a straw-yellow color. To the nose it offers charm and complexity, with aromas of rare elegance and refinement. Exotic hints of ripened fruit, melted butter, vanilla and pastry prevail. In the mouth it keeps all the promises made to the nose, follows through on them, and embellishes them with gentle flavors and aromatic nuances that are fresh and persistent.

title: Havana Club Anejo 7 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
“The very essence of Cuban rum” as described by its creator, the late great Don José Navarro. Havana Club 7 Años perfectly demonstrates the versatility of high-quality Cuban rum, as well as the deep commitment and expertise of the Havana Club Rum Masters to a complex ageing process. To be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in cocktails, but always in good company!

Crafted for sipping, to be enjoyed on the rocks and ideal for rich cocktails: Havana Club 7 Años is highly versatile. This dark rum, matured in ex-Bourbon barrels, showcases the rich natural flavours of Cuba. The liquid unveils the tastes of the Cuban terroir: aromatic tobacco, sweet tropical fruits, molasses, spices, and vanilla from the continuous ageing process, enhanced by the slow release of aromas.

title: Hogwash 75 Wine Company Rose 2021
bodyHtml:
Rose is often about fun in the warm summer months, but Hogwash was created for year-round, on-the-go enjoyment. The design is as simple as the winemaking itself, with basic components, clear expression, and the simple satisfaction of that very first sip.

Hogwash and 75 Wine Company are crafted by winemaker Shawn Johnson and managed by Partner and Chief Operating Officer, Nathaniel Dorn, and a small team of seasoned wine sales and hospitality professionals. Hogwash California Rosé, sourced predominately from the Clarksville AVA, is a blend of Pinot Noir, Grenache and Tempranillo crafted for a house style that is consistently refreshing and appealing.

The wine shows coral/bright copper hues and offers floral and mandarin aromas with savoury berry notes.

title: Saget La Perriere Sancerre 2024
bodyHtml: Yellow with pretty grey tints. The nose is intense with notes of citrus and exotic fruit (mango, grapefruit, lemon). On the palate, the wine is very fruity, powerful and generous, with a light citrus freshness on the end palate. The wine is well-balanced and harmonious and is perfectly served as an aperitif or paired with poultry, fish in beurre blanc or goat’s cheeses.

title: Sandhill Rose 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in Canada, this vibrant rosé originates from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, with fruit typically sourced from vineyards in Oliver and Osoyoos. Sandhill is a member of the Andrew Peller Limited portfolio and is defined by a 'non-interventionist' winemaking philosophy led by head winemaker Sydney Valentino. The winery’s approach is centered on the belief that great wine starts in the vineyard, utilizing a 'gentle touch' to allow the natural fruit flavours and unique BC terroir to shine through in every bottle.

Wine Description

This rosé typically displays a pale salmon pink or delicate coral hue. The nose is highly aromatic and summer-pretty, featuring fragrant notes of wild strawberry, raspberry, and pomegranate, often accented by white peach, crab apple, and rose petals. On the palate, the wine is crisp and refreshing with a silky texture, offering flavours of tangy red berries, watermelon, and Rainier cherry. The experience concludes with a clean, dry finish that often reveals subtle lingering notes of citrus, black tea, and a touch of spice.

title: El Tesoro Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
General Information

Truly unique, and steeped in history, El Tesoro is one of the last known tequilas to fully embrace the traditional tequila making process. A tequila crafted with knowledge passed down through centuries and infused with the passion of its makers, El Tesoro honors Don Felipe Camarena, the man who established La Altena Distillery in 1937. Today his grandson, Carlos Camarena, oversees production. Just like his grandfather, he is passionate about agave and fiercely protective of his traditional methods. Every decision, every part of the painstaking process, is done in celebration of this unique treasure. Shunning efficiency in favor of a commitment to meticulous care and attention to detail - El Tesoro is a precious tequila, waiting to be discovered.

title: Maestro Dobel Diamante Tequila
bodyHtml: Maestro Dobel Diamante (Diamond) Tequila is the world's first multi-aged clear tequila.  A rule-defying blend of extra-añejo, añejo and reposado tequila, aged in the finest European oak barrels, the tequila is double filtered to produce a crystal clear liquid renowned for its character and smoothness.  Enjoy neat or on the rocks.

title: Dalmore Cigar Malt Special Edition
bodyHtml: The second coming of the Dalmore Cigar Malt, relaunched in an eye-catching red box. Fans of the previous edition will definitely want to get their hands on this.

title: Chateau Perron Lalande de Pomerol 2022
bodyHtml: Rich, powerful and many-layered nose of red fruits, dark spice, fresh oak and cocoa. Supple, velvety palate with fine, crisply elegant tannins. Fresh lingering finish with menthol flavours. A charming, easy-to-drink wine which will go down well with any fine food.

title: Hakutsuru Sayuri Nigori Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Hakutsuru Sayuri Nigori is a unique 'unfiltered' sake produced in the Nada district of Kobe, Hyogo prefecture, Japan. It is crafted by Hakutsuru Sake Brewing Co. Ltd., using selected rice, koji, and the famous 'Miyamizu' spring water from the Rokko Mountains. The name 'Sayuri' translates to 'little lily' in Japanese, reflecting the soft and delicate nature of this floral brew.

Description

This nigori sake is distinct for its creamy, milky white appearance, resulting from a light filtration process that leaves some of the rice sediment in the bottle. It offers a refreshing and semi sweet sensory profile with lush aromas of white grape and cherry blossoms. On the palate, it is smooth and velvety with a naturally sweet taste that features notes of cream, strawberry, and a hint of vanilla. It has an alcohol by volume of 12.5% and should be shaken gently before serving chilled.

Food Pairing

The creamy texture and gentle sweetness of Hakutsuru Sayuri Nigori make it an excellent pairing for spicy cuisines, such as Thai green curry or spicy tuna rolls, as it helps to soothe the heat. It also complements savory, salty dishes like yakitori, miso-glazed sea bass, and tempura. For dessert, it pairs beautifully with fresh fruit tarts, panna cotta, or even slightly spicy chocolate truffles.

title: Montes Purple Angel 2021
bodyHtml:
With the release of the first Montes Alpha wine back in 1988, Montes became one of the first premium wineries of Chile. Their premise, a clear belief that Chile had an untapped potential as a producer of quality wines, made them a benchmark for other wineries to follow.

Impressive deep purplish-red in color. Features outstanding aromas of ripe red and black berries, sweet spices, dark chocolate, and mocha notes. The palate is structured with soft, ample tannins. Acidity from the Petit Verdot lends juiciness and enable excellent and exceptional aging potential. The remarkable finish is elegant and intensely complex.

Highly recommended with red meats, lamb chops with rosemary, pork ribs, and cannelloni.

title: Reserve de la Comtesse 2016
bodyHtml:
The Pichon Longueville estate goes back to 1688-1689. In 1850, Virginie de Pichon Longueville, Countess de Lalande, and her two sisters inherited three-fifths of the vineyard from their father. This took on the name of Chateau Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande. In 1978, May-Eliane de Lencquesaing, daughter of Edouard Miailhe, in turn inherited this beautiful property and devoted herself entirely to continuing the tradition of quality wine.

94 Points - James Suckling

The stunning, ripe dark berries and plums on the nose are attractively dressed and deliver a wealth of assertively rich and juicy dark-fruit flavors on the palate, in balanced and elegant yet powerful style. 

92 Points - Decanter

An incredibly luscious, gorgeously balanced and rich Reserve de la Comtesse. They picked right up until the light October rain, waiting until it had passed before continuing. Those extra few days have contributed to the particularly soft and silky quality of the tannins in the Cabernet Sauvignon, which have a gorgeous density to them. 

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

From a vintage compared to 1996 and 2009, both terrific yet different vintages, the 2016 Reserve de la Comtesse is a beauty with a classic Cabernet nose of blackcurrants, graphite, lead pencil, and flowers. It's medium-bodied, supple, incredibly elegant, and seamless on the palate, with loads of charm and character.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

title: Compass Box Flaming Heart
bodyHtml:
General Information

The 2018 bottling of Flaming Heart blended malt from Compass Box is a powerful expression, filled to the brim with smoke and deliciousness. Those of you with very well-trained noses will catch notes of Caol Ila, Clynelish and Deanston within this one, with a few more unnamed whiskies hiding within. 15,050 bottles were produced.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Maculan Pinot Nero 2023
bodyHtml: Strongly influenced by Bordeaux wines, Fausto Maculan created an essential figure in the wine world with his estate in Breganza, in northern Veneto. Here is his Burgundy rendition produced without cask élevage. A fruity, spicy, mineral Pinot Noir with a palate culminating in a supple and persistent ensemble.

title: Vietti Barolo 2021
bodyHtml:
Italy, Piedmont, Barolo. The Vietti winery was founded in the late 19th century by Carlo Vietti in the medieval village of Castiglione Falletto. Under the later leadership of Alfredo Currado and Luciana Vietti, the estate became a pioneer in the region, famously being among the first to vinify single vineyard 'crus' and resurrecting the nearly extinct Arneis grape. Today, the winery continues its legacy of blending tradition with careful experimentation to produce wines with a strong, individual identity.

Wine Description

This Barolo Castiglione 2021 presents a medium intensity ruby red colour. The nose is explosive and opulent, offering a complex bouquet of dried roses, red cherry, plum, and blackberry, intertwined with notes of liquorice, tobacco, and truffle. On the palate, the wine is rich and powerful yet elegant, featuring flavours of alpine herbs, strawberries, and spice that lead into a long, savoury leather finish. It is a full bodied red with a vibrant backbone of acidity and silky, well integrated tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Nebbiolo.

  • Optimal Drinking Window: While drinkable now with decanting, it is best enjoyed from 2027 through 2042.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its balance, freshness, and haunting complexity, showing a deep, layered profile that approaches the level of single vineyard crus.

  • Organic Status: Vietti follows organic methods in their production to ensure rich flavours and distinct aromatic structure.

Accolades

  • Robert Parker - 98 points.

  • James Suckling - 96 points.

  • Vinous - 96 points.

  • Decanter - 95 points.

  • Wine Advocate - 94 points.

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points.

Food Pairing

  • Hearty stews and game meats like venison.

  • Roast red meats seasoned with herbs.

  • Rich dishes containing truffles or wild mushrooms.

  • Sharp, aged cheeses such as Castelmagno or Pecorino. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Elderton Shiraz Command 2021
bodyHtml: Elderton Command Shiraz is a bold, rich, structured and elegant. With a deep crimson hue, lifted aromas of spiced plum with hints of roasted coffee bean. The palate has spiced summer pudding flavours, brooding with cloves and an undertone of graphite. Silken layers of tannin carry the fruit to a long and seamless finish.

title: Elio Grasso Dolcetto D'Alba dei Grassi
bodyHtml:
Elio Grasso's Dolcetto vineyard is 1.5 hectares 280 metres above sea level, southeast facing on relatively loose-packed calcareous soil. Guyot trained at 4,500 vines per hectare.  The vinification process includes fermentation for 5-6 days in stainless steel tanks with daily pumping over.  After malolactic fermentation, the wine stays in stainless steel until bottling in May.

Dark garnet to deeper purple hues. Berries, plums, with bright hits of berries and cocoa.  Soft tannins give way to great acidity accompanied by stewed red fruits.  Excellent with pizza, pasta, roasted meats and hard cheeses.

title: Francois Mikulski Saint-Aubin Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This dry white wine originates from France, produced in the Saint Aubin appellation of the Côte de Beaune region in Burgundy. Domaine François Mikulski was established in 1992 by François Mikulski after he inherited plots in Meursault from his uncle, Pierre Boillot. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a pursuit of authenticity, purity, and elegance, achieved through meticulous biological balance in the vineyard and terroir minded ageing practices that typically limit new oak use to about 20% to avoid masking the wine's natural expression.

Wine Description

The François Mikulski Saint Aubin Blanc presents a luminous, translucent light gold robe with subtle green highlights. The nose is delicate and fresh, offering aromas of white fruits such as Comice pear and white peach, alongside hints of vanilla, soft spices, and a precise limestone minerality that provides verticality. On the palate, the wine is extremely juicy and well fruited, featuring notes of golden apple, mandarin, and grape jelly, integrated with a strong empyreumatic element and peppery tones. It is characterized by its medium body, upright structure, and a powerful, long lasting finish. This 100% Chardonnay is sourced from a small 0.1868 hectare plot originally planted with Pinot Noir in 1993 and overgrafted in 2008. The ABV is typically around 12.5% to 13.0%. While the vineyard is cultivated using non-certified organic farming methods, it is often described as practicing organic.

title: Occhipinti SP68 Terre Siciliane White 2024
bodyHtml:
Occhipinti SP68 Terre Siciliane White originates from the Vittoria region of Sicily, Italy. Founded in 2004 by Arianna Occhipinti, the estate is rooted in a deep respect for the land and biodynamic principles. Arianna, who began her winemaking journey at 16 under the tutelage of her uncle Giusto Occhipinti of COS, emphasizes a minimal intervention philosophy that seeks to express the authentic character of the Sicilian terroir.

Wine Description

This aromatic white wine displays a brilliant straw yellow hue with golden reflections. The nose is complex and fragrant, offering a bouquet of white flowers, chamomile, and white peach, alongside exotic notes of lychee and pink grapefruit. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and fresh, showcasing a vibrant minerality and a slightly herbaceous quality. The finish is dry and persistent, often leaving a subtle hint of almond bitterness.

title: Lightfoot & Wolfville Ancienne Pinot Noir 2020
bodyHtml:
This wine shines a pale ruby-red colour in the glass. Subtle, elegant and refined with notes of brambleberry, brown spice, dark cherry and sandalwood. Fine, grippy tannins that will soften over time in the bottle are framed by bright acidity and red fruit flavours. 

Pairing suggestions include Peking/BBQ duck, roasted pork, richer fish such as tuna and grilled vegetables with romesco sauce.

title: Bunnahabhain Toiteach A Dha
bodyHtml: People love a good sequel if the movie industry has proven anything besides Tom Hanks being a treasure. Well, that idea is coming over to the whisky world. This right here is Bunnahabhain's Toiteach a Dhà, which means "Smoky Two" in Gaelic. It's the sequel to their popular peaty treat Bunnahabhain Toiteach, featuring a much more up-front core of sherried spice shining out between the smoky plumes.

title: Estampa Viognier Chardonnay Reserva 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Bright and clear with some yellow and green hints. Citric fruits, figs and freshly cut grass. The dominant flavours are fruity and specifically lime but this is complimented with subtle herbaceous notes. There is also a hint of figs and the wines pleasant acidity helps enhance all these flavours. On the palate the crispness is complimented with an element of creaminess and a lingering finish, thus making this wine a great aperitif and an even better accompaniment for seafood or fish.

title: Crown Royal Salted Caramel
bodyHtml:
Natural flavourings are infused with the classic Crown blend for a smooth and sweet, yet balanced profile. Intensely aromatic with caramel candy aromas. The palate is round but not cloying with the whisky back notes brightening the salted caramel flavour. Easy to sip or consider serving over ice cream for a unique treat.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Pasote Anejo Tequila
vendor: 300840 - Top Of My Glass Holdings Inc.
bodyHtml:
General Information

Aromas of roasted agave, vanilla and sweet coconut, accompanied by mellow agave flavours with hints of roasted oranges and cinnamon. A long, warm finish.

title: Talento Ecologico Monastrell 2023
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Bright red violet colour. Strong in nose, intense ripe fruit notes. Well balanced and structured with a correct acidity. Soft and pleasant tannins. Modern cut wine with a potential of 2-3 years. Intense cherry and bramble fruit flavours. The Syrah adds a delicious peppery note making this great with red meats and stews, even hard cheeses such as parmesan.

title: Hetszolo Tokaji Aszu 5 Puttonyos 2014 - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Hétszőlő 5 Puttonyos is a Tokaji Aszú wine produced by the Tokaj-Hétszőlő estate in Hungary. Established in 1502, the estate boasts seven exceptional vineyards, reflected in its name, which means "seven parcels of vineyard" in Hungarian. Under the ownership of Michel Reybier, also known for Château Cos d'Estournel in Bordeaux, this wine embodies a commitment to excellence.

Winemaking and Aging

This wine is crafted from handpicked, botrytized Furmint grapes, meticulously selected to achieve the "5 Puttonyos" sweetness level. The Aszú berries are macerated in fresh must, followed by a slow fermentation and aging process in oak barrels for two years. This traditional method produces a wine of exceptional complexity, richness, and balance.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: A radiant golden hue with an alluring viscosity.
  • Nose: Captivating aromas of apricots, citrus zest, candied orange peel, and a hint of honeyed spices.
  • Palate: Full-bodied and opulent, with vibrant flavors of dried tropical fruits, ripe peaches, and citrus marmalade. The wine’s sweetness is perfectly counterbalanced by a zesty acidity, leading to a long, elegant finish with hints of vanilla and caramel.

Serving and Pairing

Hétszőlő 5 Puttonyos is best served chilled at 50–54°F (10–12°C). It pairs beautifully with foie gras, blue cheeses, fruity desserts, or can be enjoyed on its own as a decadent dessert wine.

title: Penfolds Bin 28 Shiraz 2021
bodyHtml:
This ripe and robust red wine originates from Australia, specifically from the South Australia region. First produced in 1959, Bin 28 was the first wine in the Penfolds portfolio to bear a bin number, named after the famous Kalimna vineyard in the Barossa Valley purchased by the winery in 1945. While originally a single-vineyard wine, it has evolved into a multi-region, multi-vineyard blend that serves as a showcase for warm-climate Australian Shiraz, with the Barossa Valley consistently well represented in its composition.

Wine Description

Penfolds Bin 28 Shiraz presents a vibrant, dense plum red colour. The sensory profile is generous and lifted, featuring a complex nose of blackberries and ripe plums layered with savory notes of aniseed, black liquorice, and a 'formic' lift. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and plush, showcasing rich flavours of chocolate, espresso, and dark berries underpinned by subtle notes of baking spices and roasted game. It is characterized by an energetic, juicy acidity and fine structural tannins that contribute to an enduring, balanced finish. This 100% Shiraz wine reached an ABV of 14.5% and was matured for 12 months in used American oak hogsheads to ensure the fruit's vibrancy remains at the fore. While the grapes are cultivated using respectful agriculture, this wine is not certified organic.

title: Fukumitsuya Kuroobi 'Do-Do' Yamahai Junmai Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1625, Fukumitsuya Sake Brewery is the oldest sake producer in Kanazawa city and has been managed by the same family for generations. The brewery is dedicated to the pure Junmai style, utilizing exceptionally pure water fed by snowmelt from Mount Hakusan and traditional brewing methods passed down through centuries.

Description

This sake is brewed in the traditional Yamahai style using a blend of Yamadanishiki and Kinmonnishiki rice varieties. It presents a complex aromatic profile filled with notes of mushroom, leather, star anise, and steamed rice, with subtle hints of milk chocolate and salted plum. On the palate, it is bold and expressive, offering a symphony of flavours including dashi, cocoa powder, butterscotch, and white pepper, supported by a massive umami backbone. The body is rich yet oddly refreshing, leading to a crisp, clean, and dry finish. It has an alcohol content of 15% and a rice polishing rate of 65%.

Food Pairing

The robust character and layered umami of this Yamahai sake make it an exceptional partner for deeply savoury and salty dishes. It pairs perfectly with traditional Japanese fare such as sushi, tuna sashimi, grilled mackerel, and sukiyaki. It also complements earthy ingredients like mushrooms and grilled meats, as well as Western options like aged cheeses or black garlic risotto. For the best experience, this sake can be enjoyed chilled to highlight its floral notes or warmed to 40°C to bring out fuller rice flavours and sweetness.

title: Ken Wright Pinot Noir Willamette Valley 2024
bodyHtml: Floral notes of magnolia, rose, and candied red fruits play with gentle touches of cinnamon and clove on the nose. Flavours of generous red cherry, raspberry, and plum swirl with subtle notes of vanilla cream. This wine graces the entire palate with smoothly textured tannins and leaves it with a lusciously clean finish.

title: Chateau Potensac 2019
bodyHtml:
Chateau Potensac originates from France, within the renowned Bordeaux region and the Medoc subregion. The estate has been passed down through generations of the same family and is today managed by Jean-Hubert Delon, who inherited it from his paternal grandmother. Under his leadership, the winery maintains a commitment to producing classic, age-worthy wines that reflect the pure expression and gravelly terroir of the northern Medoc.

Wine Description

Displaying a deep garnet purple colour, this wine opens with fresh aromas of dark berries, cassis, pencil shavings, and subtle hints of dried herbs and wild sage. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full body loaded with crunchy red and black fruits, supported by fine, powdery tannins and a racy streak of freshness.

Accolades

  • Decanter - 94 points.

  • James Suckling - 94 points.

  • Vinous - 92 points.

  • Robert Parker Wine Advocate - 90 points.

Food Pairing

Pairs wonderfully with roasted leg of lamb, slow cooked beef short ribs, duck breast, or aged hard cheeses. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Undurraga Sauvignon Blanc Sibaris 2022
bodyHtml: Pungent and vibrant, full of green herbs, bell pepper, white grapefruit and a brined seas-side quality. The acidity on this Sauvignon Blanc is sharp on a straight and lean palate. Secondary layers have notes of crab apple with a hint of balancing juicy peach and melon.

title: Terrazas de los Andes Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Terrazas de los Andes Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva is produced in the Mendoza province of Argentina, with fruit primarily sourced from high altitude estate vineyards in Luján de Cuyo and the Uco Valley. Founded in 1996 by Moët & Hennessy on the site of a historic 1898 winery, the estate pioneered precision viticulture by matching specific grape varieties to optimal elevations between 980 and 1,250 metres. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes elegance over power, utilizing a mosaic of over 200 parcels to capture the fresh, vibrant spirit of the Andes mountain terroir.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep red colour with purple highlights. The sensory profile is fresh and expressive, featuring aromas of ripe blackcurrant and blackberry layered with spicy notes of white pepper, dark chocolate, and tobacco. On the palate, it offers a juicy mouthfeel with a full bodied mid palate and flavours of redcurrant and plum. The finish is long and persistent, defined by firm, chalky tannins and a clean, mineral tension. Composed of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, the wine typically has an ABV of 13.5% to 14% and is aged for 12 to 14 months in French oak barrels. The estate is currently in transition to organic certification for its high altitude vineyards.

title: The Arran 25 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The retired Arran 25 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky originates from Scotland, in the Island region on the Isle of Arran at the Lochranza Distillery. Established in 1995, the distillery marked a historic rebirth of legal whisky distilling on the island after more than a century of inactivity. Owned by Isle of Arran Distillers Ltd., an independent operator, the estate continues to utilize traditional distillation methods and pure mountain rain water sourced from Loch na Davie.

Spirit Description

This flagship single malt displays a rich mahogany, warm copper appearance in the glass. The aromatic nose reveals a complex bouquet of rich oak, nutmeg, baked ripe figs, sultanas, and dark cherries, accented by subtle hints of leather and marzipan. On the palate, the full-bodied texture is remarkably creamy and balanced, offering layered flavours of rich fruit cake, toasted almonds, cinnamon, juicy mandarin orange, manuka honey, muscovado sugar, and a delicate touch of white pepper. The finish is long, warm, and spicy, leaving trailing notes of dark chocolate, toasted walnuts, and dark fruit compote. This expression is matured in a combination of ex-sherry and ex-bourbon casks before being finished in first-fill and refill sherry hogsheads, and is bottled at an alcohol by volume of 46%.

Accolades

As the pinnacle age-statement expression in the distillery core portfolio, this quarter-century single malt has achieved notable critical recognition. It received an outstanding score of 93 points from Whisky Advocate in 2023, reflecting its standing among international whisky connoisseurs.

title: El Dorado Rum Gift Pack - 3 x 375 ml Bottles
bodyHtml:
For true connoisseurs of Demerara Distillers rum produced a magnificent gift, a set of the best rums 12, 15 and 21 years of aging. Each of them has its own character and flavour, but they all share the highest quality "Premium" class.

1 Bottle (375 ml) - El Dorado 12-Year-Old has a very smooth texture and typical Demerara rums with soft sweetness on the palate.

1 Bottle (375 ml) - El Dorado Special Reserve 15-Year-Old is intriguing and complex, one of the best in its class. Its flavour is distinguished by a special depth and strength of character, richness and complexity, and the fragrance captures the richness and saturation.

1 Bottle (375 ml) - El Dorado 21-Year-Old with stunning delay has a warm velvety taste with hints of caramel and tropical fruits and lush aroma.

The El Dorado Special Reserve 12-Year-Old, 15-Year-Old, 21-Year-Old is an exquisite gift with unsurpassed quality and a variety of tastes.

title: Elderton Shiraz 'E Series' 2022
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Australia's world-renowned Barossa Valley, this wine is a benchmark of the region's rich viticultural heritage. The Elderton estate was originally planted in 1894, but it was not until 1982 that the Ashmead family produced the first wines under their own label. Today, the second generation—brothers Cameron and Allister—lead the winery with a commitment to sustainability and a 'micro-cru' philosophy, sourcing fruit from three distinct estate vineyards in Nuriootpa, Greenock, and Craneford.

Wine Description

This 100% Shiraz displays a vibrant dark purple colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is complex and heady, featuring a waft of ripe red berries, spiced plums, and blackberries framed by distinctive notes of eucalyptus, chocolate, and mocha. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and opulent, delivering generous layers of black forest fruits and redcurrant with a 'gamey' depth and touches of spicy cloves and liquorice. Its structure is defined by a firm acid seam and fine-grained, silky tannins that provide a seamless, tight close. For optimal enjoyment, this wine has significant cellaring potential, with a drinking window typically spanning from 2024 through 2039.

title: Don David Malbec Reserve 2023
bodyHtml: Vivacious red with profound violet sparkles. Sweet aromas of raisins and plum jam outstand. Elegant touch of smoke, pipe tobacco and vanilla notes dominate the nose. Very well balanced with sweet and soft tannins offers an harmonious bouquet. Fruity attack full of plums and chocolate notes combined with sweet and soft tannins. Dry fruits such as almonds and nuts appear at the end giving a very pleasant finish.

title: Domaine Seguin Manuel Pommard 'Petits Epenots' 2022
bodyHtml: With a brilliant ruby ​​colour, the expressive nose develops powerful notes of red fruits embellished with toasted notes from the oak. Structured and firm on the palate, it develops a classy tannic structure. Its underlying minerality gives the wine great length.

title: Amarula - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Made from the exotic marula fruit that is grown exclusively in Africa. This rich and delicious liqueur pours a light creamy coffee colour and offers aromas and flavours of sweet toffee, vanilla and fresh marula fruit with a velvety texture.

title: Johnnie Walker Blue Label - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml: An unrivalled masterpiece, an exquisite combination of Scotland's rarest and most exceptional whiskies. Only one in every ten thousand casks has the elusive quality, character and flavour to deliver the remarkable signature taste. An extraordinary whisky for extraordinary occasions.

title: Glenfarclas 15 Year Old
bodyHtml: A wonderfully sherried 15 year old dram from Glenfarclas, boasting oodles of dried fruit notes. It’s bottled at 46% ABV simply because this was the strength that George Grant’s grandfather preferred it at. Happily, this also results in the Speysider boasting a big, juicy, Christmas cake profile. A fabulously complex Scotch while also being easily drinkable.

title: Patron Gran Burdeos Tequila
bodyHtml:
This Patron tequila is made with the finest 100% Weber Blue Agave, aged in American & French oak barrels, then it's distilled again and racked in vintage Bordeaux barrels. A luxury Anejo tequila!

COLOUR: Dark amber.

AROMA: Rich Bordeaux wine.

TASTE: Notes of oak wood, vanilla & raisins.

FINISH: Velvety smooth.

title: Casa Castillo Grenache El Molar 2020
bodyHtml: Excellent garnacha, with high robe. It has aged for 14 months in oak barrels. Smooth and silky, with fruit and hints of soil, minerals and herbs. The aging gives it complexity and smoothness.

title: Taittinger Brut Prestige Rose
bodyHtml:
Taittinger's Brut Prestige Rose Champagne, made from Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier grapes, is succulently fruity, supple, and fragrant, with delicate bubbles and a crisp, refreshing finish.  The hue of Taittinger Cuvée Prestige Rosé is a deep cherry-pink, with small, persistent pinpoint bubbles rising in delicate strands to the wine's surface. Its characteristic Pinot aromas of red raspberries and strawberries are balanced with exquisite, subtle floral and earth notes. The rich, robust berry notes are exuberant yet refined on the palate, carefully balanced by a fresh acidity that carries through to a crisp and refreshing long finish.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate     

The latest release of Taittinger's NV Brut Prestige Rosé is showing very well, revealing inviting aromas of red berries, plums, orange zest, crisp orchard fruit and freshly baked bread. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy but incisive, this bottling is based on the Brut Réserve, yet the addition of still red wine—much of which is produced in house—imparts structuring phenolics that complement the wine's generous core of fruit to great effect. Readers should not that this cuvée's clear glass makes it vulnerable to light strike, so it's especially important to buy properly stored bottles.

91 Points - James Suckling     

Darker color. Lots of fruit and a creamy texture with cooked apples and cherries and strawberry undertones. Medium to full body. Delicious finish that is dry and fruity. Drink now.

91 Points - Decanter     

Vanilla and red fruit nose. Crisp, refreshing palate with notes of cherry, vanilla, almond, patisserie and a soft mousse.

90 Points - Wine & Spirits     

A swirl of bubbles carries fresh raspberry flavors along with a lively green edge of acidity. The flavors are persistent and clean, the wine mouthwatering.

title: Rodney Strong Cabernet Sauvignon Brothers Ridge
bodyHtml: Deep and dense wine bursting with complex dark red fruits like cassis, cherry and plum. Hints of tobacco are followed by a round and seductive mid-palate and a long, structured finish.

title: Casillero Del Diablo Devil's Red
bodyHtml: Dark and deep purple color. Ripe, densely packed with black cherry, currant, chocolate and cedar flavors. Round, mouth-filling with ample soft and sweet tannins, finishing with lively acidity to balance the intense range of flavors.

title: Poli Mirtillo Grappa - 500 ml
bodyHtml: Lively as the blueberry jam spread on toasted bread for breakfast. Grappa-based sweet liqueur with natural infusion of blueberries. Its intense aroma recalls a basket with fresh blueberries and juicy wild berries.

title: Hedges Family Chardonnay CMS 2020
bodyHtml: Light straw colour. Aromas of pear and apple with hints of banana, pineapple, lychee, straw, licorice and custard. The palate is full with fruit sweetness and nicely rounded viscosity balanced by crisp acidity and pear and apple fruits with a caramel note. No buttery oak here. A clean and pure expression of Chardonnay fruit.

title: Luigi Bosca La Linda Rose de Malbec 2021
bodyHtml: La Linda Rose de Malbec is a rose with pink salmon hues. The lively and expressive nose is reminiscent of red fruits (strawberries, plums) with subtle floral notes. Fresh, cool and medium-bodied on the palate, it gives way to clean floral and red fruit flavors. Excellent acidity, delicate finish and savoury.

title: Bottega Crema Gianduia Grappa - 500 ml
bodyHtml: It is a creamy liqueur, pleasantly sweet and with a moderate alcohol content, characterized by an intense aroma of Gianduia chocolate. This was created in Piedmont, in 1806, when the high cost of cocoa inspired local pastry chefs to replace part of it with toasted grounded nuts. This gave origin to an elegant and intense chocolate, with a typical bouquet of cocoa and nuts. These hints are also present in Gianduia Bottega, a cream with a velvety sweetness which satisfies even the most demanding palates. With a final touch of grappa, Gianduia Bottega gains particular aromaticity, making it unique and unmistakable.

title: Bodegas Olivares Rosado 2022
bodyHtml: This Spanish rose offers up hints of strawberry and white pepper. Soft and dry on the finish, making this immensely appealing. Vibrant, expansive strawberry and tangerine aromas, carry a suave floral overtone. Juicy and seamless in texture, offering gently sweet red fruit flavours that become livelier with aeration. Smoothly blends depth and energy and finishes long and sappy, featuring a building floral echo and a spicy jolt of white pepper. This pink wine has the richness to work with full-flavoured foods and the nerviness to enjoy all by itself. It's an outstanding value to boot.

title: Poggio di Sotto Rosso di Montalcino 2013
bodyHtml: Rosso di Montalcino Poggio di Sotto is actually a 3 years old Brunello (Brunellino) which shows to be ready to be bottled up earlier than its bigger Brother Brunello. Grapes are managed in vineyars and cellar in the same way as a Brunello. The only difference is after two years of aging, we taste each cask and select some of them to be bottled as Rosso di Montalcino, and some as Brunello. It has the same ability to age as a high end Brunello. Intense, spicy fruit with complexity on the nose: blackberry jam, vanilla, cinnamon, chestnut flour, nutmeg. Vibrant, juicy fruit on the palate, tannins a bit raw, with lots of oak to absorb. One to keep.

title: Laurent Perrier Cuvee Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
The Cuvee Rose from Laurent Perrier is the most recognized rosé Champagne in the world. The house uses its proprietary maceration technique, and the wine is crafted for fragrance and not mixed for colour. Held in an elegant bottle inspired by King Henri IV, it has been widely acknowledged for its consistent high quality for more than 40 years, and it is the benchmark for rosé Champagne worldwide. 

96 Points - Connoisseurs' Guide

Elegant and fruity at the same time with a quick invitation from bright, pure cherry notes and then filled out handsomely by whiffs of chalky soils and well-integrated, rich and uplifting yeast-driven scents, this wine manages to be both vigorous and layered at the same time. Its bubbles are insistent and finely carved, adding to the early sensations of lightness and energy yet carrying the wine long into a balanced, refined finish. Its latter palate grip is exactly what one should expect from the genre. Serving with light foods would be our first choice. However, this Champagne has the beauty of standing alone.

title: The Arran 10 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Arran 10 Year Old Single Malt encompasses the unique taste of the beautiful island they call home and is one of the best single malt whiskies Scotland has to offer!

Nose: Herbal, biscuity, hedgerow greenness and dried grass, like a long English summer's afternoon.

Palate: Sweet. Quite malty, digestive biscuits, followed by green fruits and Cox's apple peel.

Finish: Slightly bitter, maltiness.

title: Glencadam 10 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The new Glencadam 10 year old, released at the end of 2008 by (relatively) new owners Angus Dundee. This is styled as 'The Rather Delicate Highland Malt'. Unchill-filtered, with no coloring and bottled at 46% - this is what we like to see.

A tangy and fresh nose with aromas of tropical fruits and citrus bound by a soft vanilla sweetness and baking spices.  The palate is bright and grassy with layers of pineapple, lemon curd and brioche with citrus zest highlights.  Clean and crisp finish with notes of yellow fruits, vanilla pod and nutmeg spices.

title: Tate Cabernet Sauvignon Spring Street 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: The Spring Street Cabernet Sauvignon is medium to deep garnet-purple with lovely black cherry and blackberry notes and an undercurrent of red currant and Provence herbs, with touches of forest floor and cedar chest. Medium-bodied, firm and elegantly played with fine, grainy tannins and plenty of freshness, it finishes long and earthy.

title: Small Gully 'Black Magic' Shiraz 2019
bodyHtml:
Small Gully 'Black Magic' Shiraz is a premium Australian wine hailing from the Barossa Valley in South Australia. Founded in 1999 by grapegrowers Robert Bader and Darren Zimmerman alongside winemaker Stephen Black, the winery is situated in a 'small gully' on Roennfeldt Road in Marananga. The winery’s philosophy focuses on producing bold, intense wines that reflect the distinctive character of their estate-grown fruit through meticulous vineyard management.

Wine Description

This flagship Shiraz presents an opaque, deep purple hue and offers an intense sensory profile. The nose is greeted with lifted aromas of licorice, dark chocolate, ripe blackberries, and dark plums, underpinned by subtle notes of spice. On the palate, the wine is rich and full bodied, displaying depth and complexity with generous fruit-driven flavours and a plush, velvety texture. Balanced acidity and smooth tannins lead into a long, persistent finish.

title: Gekkeikan Black & Gold Junmai Sake - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Established in 1989, Gekkeikan Sake (USA), Inc. is the first and only overseas production facility for the historic Kyoto-based brewery, selected specifically for the high quality and mineral content of Folsom's water. The brewery utilizes locally grown Calrose rice from the Sacramento Valley and combines state-of-the-art technology with traditional methods that have been refined by the Okura family for nearly 400 years.

Description

This premium sake is a unique blend of two distinct varieties, including a choice selection of sakes brewed in Folsom to create a rich and complex profile. It features a clear, colourless appearance with an aromatic bouquet of banana, overripe nectarine, honeydew melon, and papaya. On the palate, it is full-bodied and exceptionally smooth, offering layered flavours of tropical pineapple, mango, anise, and roasted nuts. The texture is well-balanced and creamy, leading to a long, clean finish with subtle notes of cherry and almond milk. ABV 15.6%.

Food Pairing

The versatile and robust nature of this sake makes it an ideal partner for savory dishes such as roasted duck, grilled chicken, and pork. It also complements seafood beautifully, particularly steamed mussels, scallops, and traditional sushi or sashimi. For a unique combination, try it alongside zesty salads, marinades, or spicy Asian cuisine.

title: Clase Azul Reposado Tequila - 375 ml
bodyHtml: World-renowned with an iconic and stunning, handmade and hand-painted decanter. This ultra-premium spirit is made from organic agave and aged for eight months in used American oak barrels. The palate is smooth with notes of pineapple, agave, caramel, hot peppers and a pleasant salty note on the long finish.

title: Clase Azul Silver Tequila
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Clase Azul Tequila Plata is a super premium unaged spirit from Mexico, specifically produced in the heart of the Los Altos de Jalisco region. Founded in 1997 by Arturo Lomelí, Clase Azul México is an independent, privately held luxury house dedicated to showcasing Mexican culture and artisanal craftsmanship. The distillery's agaves grow in reddish soils at high elevations, where unique mineral and climatic conditions impart distinct properties to the plants.

Spirit Description

This pristine spirit is crafted from 100% organic Tequilana Weber Blue agave that is slow cooked in traditional brick ovens for 72 hours. After distillation, the tequila is bottled without aging to faithfully capture the natural, fresh notes of the agave plant.

  • Colour: The spirit is crystal clear and brilliant with bright silver highlights.

  • Aroma: The nose features fresh and herbal fragrances of lemongrass, mint, and green tea, layered with citrus scents of orange peel and lemon as well as hints of vanilla and green apple.

  • Palate: It offers a smooth taste of cooked agave, Meyer lemon, and green guava, complemented by enduring herbal notes and a touch of sweetness.

  • Body: This tequila is characterized by a light to medium body with a notably large mouthfeel.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, crisp citrus finish that is often described as sweet.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at 40%.

title: Uccelliera Brunello Di Montalcino 2020
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.

title: Sandrone Barbera D'Alba 2022
bodyHtml:
Barbera is a delicate and demanding grape varietal. A meticulous search throughout the area for the very best soils, agronomical decisions and particular attention to vinification enable Sandrone to reveal the very best qualities of this wine. Barbera d’Alba is made to be a medium-weight wine that will drink well for a decade. It shows delicious and plump berry and black fruits. As Barbera possesses almost no natural tannins, the use of tonneaux gives the wine some much-needed structure. It is a perfect match with rich winter dishes as the bright acidity keeps it from being too heavy. 

Barbera should be an excellent match with rich foods like roast pork or a lasagne with béchamel. It is a precise, focused Barbera of great purity.

title: Van Gogh Pineapple Vodka
bodyHtml: Our Van Gogh Pineapple vodka is an irresistible blend of tropical flavors. Handcrafted with sweet pineapple and a hint of orange, this premium vodka adds intense citrus flavor to your favorite summer cocktail.

title: Azelia Barolo 2021
bodyHtml:
Azelia Barolo 2021 is a classic and deeply expressive red wine that blends the elegance of Castiglione Falletto with the power of Serralunga d'Alba.

The wine is produced by Azienda Agricola Azelia, where the Scavino family (Luigi, Lorella, and Lorenzo) manages 16 hectares of vineyards with a philosophy of artisanal precision and minimal intervention. The "normale" (classic) Barolo is a key bottling for the estate, crafted from a meticulous blend of seven different single-vineyard sites. By sourcing grapes from both the white calcareous soils of Castiglione (30%) and the heavier clay soils of Serralunga (70%), Azelia achieves a superlative balance of aroma and body.

Wine Description

The 2021 vintage presents a lustrous ruby colour and a vibrant, detailed sensory profile.

  • Aromas: The nose is an engaging mix of fresh rosehip, cranberry, and pomegranate, layered with darker notes of cherry, blackcurrant, and licorice. Subtle hints of pine, mint, and nutmeg add complexity.

  • Palate: Medium-to-full-bodied and "vivacious," it offers a succulent core of fruit sweetness balanced by a bright, tangy acidity. It is characterized by ripe, well-integrated tannins that provide a firm grip without being overpowering, leading to a long, fresh finish with earthy and savory undertones.

The wine is 100% Nebbiolo from vines that average 50 years of age. Vinification involves fermentation with indigenous yeasts for approximately 40 to 45 days using a "submerged cap" technique to ensure a gentle and deep extraction. Following tradition, the wine is aged for two years in large oak casks (rather than small barriques) to preserve the purity of the fruit and the nuances of the terroir.

Accolades

  • 93 Points – Decanter (Michaela Morris): "Classy and immediately satisfying... Underlying brightness and tangy acidity keep this vivacious."

  • 93 Points – James Suckling: "A fine-tannined and very pretty Barolo... bright finish."

  • 93 Points – Wine Spectator: "Focused and accessible... ripe and balanced, with a long, fresh and firm finish."

  • 92 Points – Wine Advocate: Noted for its impeccable balance and traditional character.

  • 17+/20 – Jancis Robinson: Praised for its impressive minerality and great acidity streamlining the red fruit.

Food Pairing

This Barolo’s firm structure and high acidity make it a natural match for rich, savory dishes:

  • Meats: Excellent with roasted lamb, rib-eye steak, or braised beef (brasato).

  • Regional Specialities: A classic companion for dishes featuring white truffles, such as tajarin pasta or a buttery mushroom risotto.

  • Game: Complements wild boar stew, venison steak, or roasted duck breast with a red wine reduction.

  • Cheese: Pairs best with mature cheeses like Castelmagno or Gorgonzola.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage is being hailed by critics as a modern legend, often compared to the iconic 2010 and 2016 years. It is a return to a more "traditional" style, marked by a snowy winter and a long, balanced growing season that allowed for full tannin development while maintaining low pH levels (high acidity). While the 2021 Azelia is approachable in its youth with proper aeration, its concentrated fruit and vibrant backbone suggest a long drinking window, likely peaking between 2026 and 2045.

title: Laphroaig 10 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Laphroaig 10 is a full-bodied, smoky gem with a residual sweetness and a hint of salt amid the seaweedy, peaty characters before a long, warming finish. A classic dram.

Nose: Huge smoke, seaweedy, medicinal, with a hint of sweetness.

Body: Full-bodied.

Palate: Surprising sweetness with hints of salt and layers of peatiness.

Finish: Lingering.

title: Bollinger Special Cuvee Brut - James Bond Gift Box
bodyHtml:
In 1829, Champagne Bollinger introduced an instantly recognizable, dry, toasty style that connoisseurs around the globe have coveted ever since. Six generations of the Bollinger family have maintained that trademark style, and Bollinger is one of the rare Grande Marque houses to be owned, controlled and managed by the same family since it was founded. 

Bollinger is renowned for its stringent quality standards. It adheres to traditional methods, including individual vinification of each marc and cru, barrel fermentation (it is the last Champagne house to employ a full-time cooper) and extra-aging on the lees before disgorgement.

Members of the British Royal Court were among the first to embrace Bollinger's unmistakable quality, and Queen Victoria made Bollinger the exclusive purveyor to the Court by Royal Warrant in 1884. Besides royalty, loyal devotees have included heads of state, celebrities and even famous fictional characters: Agent 007, James Bond, demands the exclusive Champagne Bollinger.

92 Points - James Suckling

Fine bubbles combine nicely with the cooked apples, pie crust and lemon rind. Some biscuit, too. Full body. Layered and creamy with a crisp finish. Always delicious. Drink now.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

There's a pleasing, snappy quality to the acidity framing this elegant Champagne, enlivening accessible flavours of currant, Marcona almond and orchard blossom, with a minerally touch of a saline-laced oyster shell that lingers on the finish.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Disgorged in the second half of 2019, the latest release of Bollinger's NV Brut Special Cuvée is based on the 2015 vintage, complemented by around 60% reserve wines. The wine is still quite tightly wound after its recent disgorgement, opening in the glass with notes of crisp yellow orchard fruit, freshly baked bread, clear honey and orange peel, with little sign of the nuttiness to come with bottle age. On the palate, it's medium to full-bodied, muscular and incipiently textural, with a deep core, ripe acids and a pinpoint mousse.

title: Batasiolo Moscato D'Asti 2025
bodyHtml: Straw-yellow colour, clear and brilliant. Very intense and clean aromas of rose, peach, white fruit, apricot, figs and orange flowers. Gentle in the mouth but not boring, properly fresh, wide-ranging and of great elegance.

title: Barons de Rothschild Brut Rose
bodyHtml:
Barons de Rothschild Rose shows assertive finesse in a blend of Champagne's greatest Chardonnays and its top Pinot Noir. The high proportion of Chardonnay makes this exceptional Rose fine and vivacious, while Pinot Noir makes it delicately, harmoniously complex, a delight to the senses. The first taste is fresh and precise, melting into the palate like silk, with slight raspberry undertones. It features fine, subtle aromas, reminiscent of spring, alongside the fragrance of rose petal, wild strawberry, and a hint of citrus zest. The fine thread of bubbles ends in a thin, enduring foam, and its light colour offers the slight shimmer of salmon pink. This wine is long, balanced and full of delicious body.

The harmony of the fruit and the lightness of this champagne bear a complexity the most experienced palates are sure to appreciate and distinctively embody the Rothschild family's winemaking values: perfection, constancy and a spirit of excellence and refinement, all given the utmost of care. Blend: 85% Chardonnay, 15% Pinot Noir.

title: Chateau Pey La Tour 2023
bodyHtml:
Chateau Pey La Tour is located in France, within the Bordeaux region. Since 1990, the estate has been under the ownership of the renowned négociant Dourthe, who initiated an extensive investment programme to elevate the vineyard and winery to new heights of quality. The property is considered a model estate for the region, focusing on a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes balance and the expression of its unique terroir.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep ruby or garnet colour with purple reflections. The aromatic profile is rich and alluring, featuring notes of ripe red fruits like raspberries and blackberries alongside hints of plums, cherries, and delicate floral touches. On the palate, the wine is supple and well-balanced, displaying a juicy character underpinned by fine-grained, delicate tannins.

Food Pairing

This Bordeaux blend pairs exceptionally well with classic meat dishes such as roasted beef, grilled steak, or rack of lamb. It also complements poultry, meat pies, and full-flavoured cheeses like sharp cheddar. For a more adventurous match, consider serving it with Asian dishes or rich fish courses like tuna.

title: Gran Clos Solluna Priorat 2021
bodyHtml: Blueberries on granite, dark chocolate notes oak and medicinal. The nose and palate are very harmonized in this simple yet powerfully flavourful Priorat. It's dry, with a light to medium body, higher acidity, and low tannin. Medium finish.

title: Jules Rose Cotes de Provence
bodyHtml: A blend of Cinsault, Grenache, Syrah, and Rolle. Peachy colour. The nose is complex and intense with aromas of exotic fruits, strawberry and cherry with a hint of spice. The mouth is full, the fruit persistent and the finish is salivating. Great expression. Pairs beautifully with sushi, ceviche, salads, pasta with clams, crab roll, gazpacho.

title: Stara Sokolova Pear Brandy
bodyHtml: Stara Sokolova Viljamovka is made entirely from noble Williams pear, valued for its muted sweetness and soft, subtle flavors. Carefully double distilled in old copper stills to produce a spirit that is both refined and sophisticated, with light, crisp nose and floral notes.

title: SoNa Cabernet Sauvignon 2016
bodyHtml: Small vineyards in Coombsville and the foothills southeast of downtown Napa are where SoNa is derived. These cool-climate vines encourage the wine's peppery aromas and characteristics. A wine's balance and elegance come from resolved tannins brought on by the colder growth conditions. The fruit may be expressed to its fullest potential with minimal maceration and prudent use of new French oak.

title: Terrunyo Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
While the Peumo Vineyard Carmenère achieved iconic status for the label, Terrunyo Cabernet Sauvignon represents Concha y Toro’s focused exploration of high-altitude Chilean Cabernet Sauvignon. Sourced from the prestigious Pirque Vineyard in the Maipo Valley—one of the world's premier terroirs for the variety—this wine showcases the signature Chilean Cabernet character: vibrant red fruit, intense structural elegance, and distinct cool-climate herbal complexity.

Guided by the legendary Ignacio Recabarren and the modern technical team, Terrunyo Cabernet Sauvignon isolates the finest blocks of Andean-influenced alluvial soils to craft a single-vineyard bottling that balances Old World structure with New World fruit purity.

Wine Description

The Terrunyo Pirque Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon pours a deep, radiant ruby-garnet color with dark purple undertones. The aromatics are intensely expressive and refined, opening with classic Maipo aromas of cassis, black cherry, red currant, and cedar, wrapped in subtle notes of menthol, fresh mint, dried herbs, pencil lead, and a touch of roasted coffee bean from its oak aging.

On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied with incredible linear tension. Brilliant natural acidity cuts through layers of bright red berry fruit and dark plums, while ultra-fine, gravelly tannins provide a solid, structured backbone. Accents of dark chocolate, tobacco leaf, and crushed stone emerge on the mid-palate, leading to a long, precise, and savory finish.

Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon (often rounded out with a small percentage of Cabernet Franc), the wine undergoes gentle fermentation in stainless steel followed by approximately 16 to 18 months of aging in French oak barrels (around 30–40% new).

title: Simonnet Febvre Cremant De Bourgogne
bodyHtml:
A harmoniously balanced wine with fine bubbles, a persistant foam and a wonderful length in the mouth. It is fresh and powerful on the nose with aromas of citrus.

Drink this crémant as a chilled aperitif, as it comes or with a liqueur such as crème de cassis, and why not even drink it throughout a whole meal.

title: Ardbeg Wee Beastie 5 Year Old
bodyHtml: An untamed young single malt from Ardbeg, Wee Beastie has spent five years in a combination of ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks before being unleashed. Fresh, herbal aromas of pear, cracked black pepper, pine needles, vanilla, and honey glazed ham mingle on the nose with aniseed, green apple, leather and coffee. The palate offers notes of dark chocolate, hot tar, smoked bacon, aniseed and eucalyptus that linger on the finish.

title: Sammy's Beach Bar Red Head Rum
bodyHtml:
General Information

Sammy's Beach Bar Rum Red Head is another expression from "The Red Rocker" Samuel Roy Hagar, who has already launched his own spirits series with success. The American singer, guitarist, and songwriter previously convinced spirits fans with his tequila and his first rum.

This new rum is a fabulous blend with the taste of sun-ripened macadamia nuts from Hawaii, and stands at 35% abv. The red rum from the rocker is based on Maui Gold sugar and tastes wonderfully aromatic. Incidentally, the nickname "The Red Rocker" is due to Sammy's preference for red clothing. No wonder that a rum in his favourite colour was chosen to complete his spirits range!

title: Dunes & Greene Brut
bodyHtml: On the nose, this Chardonnay Pinot Noir blend imparts delicate aromas of lemon zest, fresh strawberries and cream. On the palate, Chardonnay offers subtle citrus notes and fresh acidity. Pinot Noir complements this by adding richness and texture. The result is a full flavoured sparkling wine with a refined finish.

title: Pendleton '1910' 12 Year Old Rye
bodyHtml:
Pendleton '1910' 12 Year Old Rye is a rare 100% rye whisky from the country of Canada. While it is distilled and aged in Canada, it is imported and bottled by Hood River Distillers in Oregon, which is owned by the Mexican beverage conglomerate Becle, S.A.B. de C.V.. The spirit is named in honour of the inaugural year of the Pendleton Round Up, a legendary outdoor rodeo held in Oregon for over a century.

Spirit Description

The sensory profile of this super premium rye is shaped by a minimum of 12 years of oak barrel aging and finishing with glacier fed spring water from Mt. Hood.

  • Colour: This whisky displays a golden amber hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is well rounded and full bodied, offering notes of nutmeg, cloves, and maple, with hints of dried pineapple and sweet vanilla.

  • Palate: It features a complex and weighty flavour profile with rich notes of tobacco, charred oak, and butterscotch alongside a spicy rye kick. Muted tropical notes, apples, and dried cherries are balanced by nutty toffee undertones and the smoothness of maple.

  • Body: The spirit is described as having a lively, medium body with a rich and oily texture.

  • Finish: It concludes with a medium dry finish that is tingling and complex, displaying lingering accents of tart cherry, wood spice, and a smooth maple exit.

  • ABV: This rye is bottled at 40%.

title: The Irishman The Harvest
bodyHtml: Previously known as Founder’s Reserve, this is a truly unique take on traditional Irish whiskey. Triple distilled, Single Malt and Single Pot Still. This is a marriage of heavenly proportions. The original signature blend was created by Bernard Walsh. Matured entirely in American Oak Bourbon barrels.

title: Aldegheri Amarone
bodyHtml: Ruby red with garnet tones. The nose shows tertiary oaky and nutty notes and hints of cranberry and marasca cherry.  Full-mouthed and round with a good structure and a tannic finale with an aftertaste of cherry and marasca under spirit.  Excellent with roasts and game, also ideal with very mature and/or piquant cheeses.

title: Yellow Rose Straight Rye
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Yellow Rose Straight Rye is a premium spirit from the United States, specifically associated with Houston, Texas. Founded in 2010 by neighbors Ryan Baird, Troy Smith, and Randy Whitaker, Yellow Rose Distilling holds the distinction of being the first legal whiskey distillery in the city of Houston. In 2017, the distillery was acquired by the Zamora Company, a family owned Spanish drinks business, which has since worked to expand the brand's presence on a global scale. The 'Yellow Rose' name pays homage to the legendary Emily West Morgan, a folk hero whose bravery is credited with helping Texas secure its independence in 1836.

Spirit Description

This straight rye is a small batch production created to emulate the flavour profile of American rye whiskies from the pre prohibition era. It is produced with a high rye mash bill consisting of 95% rye and 5% malted barley. While matured in the hot and humid climate of Houston to accelerate the aging process, this specific expression is a sourced whiskey that is hand selected, blended, and bottled at the Texas facility.

  • Colour: The spirit displays a liquid copper or deep golden amber hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is mild and sweet, featuring scents of vanilla, pine, and brown sugar alongside herbal notes of fresh mint and caramel.

  • Palate: It offers a slightly sweet and refreshing palate with primary flavours of spearmint, mild pepper, and maple. Secondary notes include honey, red apple skin, and a touch of peppery heat.

  • Body: The whiskey possesses a medium body with a creamy and velvety mouthfeel.

  • Finish: It concludes with a medium finish that is notably less peppery than typical rye whiskies, leaving behind gentle fragrant spice and a hint of oak.

  • ABV: Yellow Rose Straight Rye is bottled at 45%.

title: Rippon Pinot Noir Mature Vine 2019
bodyHtml: The Rippon Pinot Noir, as vigneron Nick Mills describes it, is the voice of his vineyard. It's the wine that year in, year out delivers the clearest picture of what happened on this small patch of land during that growing year. It's invariably a beautiful wine. Elegant and beautifully poised. Lovingly grown, and expertly crafted, it's no wonder this is one of the more unique Pinot Noirs of the famous Central Otago region.

title: Jermann Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
Jermann Winery has established itself as one of Italy's premier producers in the Friuli-Venezia Giulia region, dedicated to crafting wines that authentically express their terroir. The Jermann Pinot Grigio exemplifies this commitment, offering a harmonious balance of richness and elegance.

Colour: Pale straw yellow with a bright, clear appearance, indicating its freshness and vibrancy.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring notes of ripe orchard fruits such as pear and apple, followed by hints of tropical fruits like pineapple and mango.

Palate: Medium-bodied and well-balanced, with lively acidity and a consistent flavor profile of ripe fruits and a subtle hint of nuttiness.

Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both depth and elegance.

Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

title: Chateau Chasse-Spleen 2018
bodyHtml:
94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This structured wine is firm, with dark tannins that promise to age. The fruit hints at delicious black currant flavours and balanced acidity. It will be a stylish wine, but wait to drink until 2026.

title: Tromba Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
General Information

With almost 40 years of experience in the tequila industry, Marco Cedano is one of Mexico's most respected master distillers. When he created his own independent tequila, he named it tromba which translates to big rain, after the seasonal rains that help water the agave fields throughout the highlands. Tequila Tromba Añejo is the aged version of Tromba tequila. After harvesting 7 to 12 year old blue weber agave grown in Los Altos, Jalisco region of Mexico, the agave juice is double distilled and aged over 20 months in white oaks casks previously used to mature American whiskey. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

title: L'Ecole No. 41 Columbia Valley Syrah 2023
bodyHtml:
Crafted in the United States, this Syrah hails from Washington State's Columbia Valley. L’Ecole No. 41, established in 1983 by Baker and Jean Ferguson, is a family-owned winery situated in the historic Frenchtown Schoolhouse in Walla Walla Valley. As the third winery in the valley, it has garnered acclaim for producing high-quality wines that reflect the unique terroir of Washington State. Currently managed by second-generation owners Marty and Megan Clubb, with involvement from the third generation, the winery emphasizes sustainable farming and traditional winemaking techniques.

Wine Description

Columbia Valley Syrah exhibits a deep purple hue. On the nose, it offers aromas of black cherry, blackberry, blueberry, violets, licorice, and wet stone. The palate reveals flavors of raspberry, plum, cherry, mocha, and pepper, complemented by a plush mouthfeel and silky tannins. This wine is a blend of 80% Syrah, 18% Grenache, and 2% Mourvèdre, hand-harvested and fermented in small stainless steel fermenters. It was aged for 18 months in 100% small oak barrels, predominantly neutral, allowing the varietal character to shine through. With an alcohol content of 15% and good acidity (pH 3.6), it presents a medium-plus body and a moderately long finish.

Food Pairing

This Syrah pairs well with a variety of dishes, including beef, lamb, wild game such as venison, pork, poultry, and cedar-plank salmon. It also complements intense cheeses like cheddar, Roquefort, Gorgonzola, Pecorino, Camembert, and Brie. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character.

title: Tenuta Fanti Rosso di Montalcino 2022
bodyHtml:
The 2020 Fanti Rosso di Montalcino is a bright ruby red. Aromas of cherry and raspberry gives sweet and elegant notes. Decisive attack with sweet notes of small red fruits previously perceived by the nose. The tannins are fine and the acidity which accompanies the drink makes it fresh and pleasing.

91 Points - James Suckling

Juicy cherry, strawberry and raspberry notes here with some walnut and chocolate orange. Medium-bodied with lightly grainy tannins and bright acidity. Crunchy finish.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2020 Rosso di Montalcino shows a dark and almost spicy quality of Sangiovese, shaped by hot-vintage conditions. It offers a smooth ride with dark fruit, cherry, earth and iris root. It also shows hints of white pepper, cinnamon and cured tobacco. Those savory tones are discreet, but it feels like they are coming from the fruit as much as from oak aging (in botte and barrique for a brief six months).

title: Cascina Adelaide Barolo 2019
bodyHtml: A vineyard blend from 4 separate plots, producing a ruby red color with brick reflections. On the nose, wild cherry and raspberry nectar fruit aromas combine with oak and spice nuances. It is aged in large barrels. The palate is wonderfully balanced with dark cherry and berry fruit flavors, oaky spice and firm tannins that leads to a long, dry finish.

title: Bunnahabhain Stiuireadair
bodyHtml: Stiuireadair is a sherried release from Bunnahabhain, intended as a partial replacement for the 12-Year-Old. A typically creamy and coastal whisky with notes of caramel, nuts, dried fruit, and hints of spice.

title: Elderton Chardonnay 'E Series' 2022
bodyHtml:
Based in the town of Nuriootpa in the Barossa Valley, Elderton Wines was created by Neil and Lorraine Ashmead in 1980. The property itself was first planted to vine in 1894 by a pioneer family of German descent. In 1916 it was sold to Samuel Elderton Tolley, who built a large homestead. By the time the Ashmead’s purchased the property, most of the 29 hectares of vines were overgrown and neglected. It took Neil and Lorraine three years to rehabilitate the vineyard and release their first vintage. Since 2003 the winery has been managed by their sons, Cameron and Allister, who purchased additional vineyards in Craneford and Greenock. Their top wine, the Elderton Command Shiraz, is an icon of the Australian wine industry. 

The Elderton Unoaked Chardonnay is made from grapes harvested from vineyards in the Barossa Valley. Medium-bodied and uncomplicated, it’s a great everyday white wine.

title: Braida Bricco dell'Uccellone 2018
bodyHtml: Intense ruby red with purple hues. Notes of red berries, mint and vanilla. The bouquet is rich, aromatic and complex with a remarkable intensity and multilayered concentration. The wine is generous, voluptuous and full-bodied with a multi-dimensional structure, perfectly balanced between the grape characteristics and high quality oak, with a persistent long finish. Pair with roasts, also seasoned meat dishes and aged cheeses.

title: Stoller Rose Willamette Valley 2025
bodyHtml: Being a cornerstone of Stoller's production for over a decade, the aromatics of this Pinot Noir Rosé consistently leap with grapefruit zest and orange peel. A bracing acidity is flirtatious with juicy strawberry and lime. That electric vibrancy buzzes as the wine fades into white tea and delicate florals.

title: Fantini 23 Edizione Cinque Autoctoni Collection Limited Release
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy, the Farnese Fantini 23 Edizione Cinque Autoctoni Limited Release is a remarkable red blend crafted from vineyards in Abruzzo and Puglia. The Fantini Group, established in 1994 by Valentino Sciotti, has a philosophy of producing high-quality wines that showcase the vast heritage of Italy's indigenous vines. The winery's history is tied to the Farnese name, dating back to the late 1500s when Princess Margherita of Austria began producing quality wines on these lands.

Wine Description

This limited release presents a very deep garnet red colour with beautiful violet reflections. The nose is intense and persistent, featuring complex aromas of cherry, blackcurrant, and blackberry, alongside notes of dried herbs, cinnamon, cloves, cocoa, and liquorice. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and opulent with rich flavours of berries and dark chocolate, balanced by a lifted, elegant freshness and velvety tannins. The varietal composition is a traditional blend of 33% Montepulciano, 30% Primitivo, 25% Sangiovese, 7% Negroamaro, and 5% Malvasia Nera. While ready to drink now, it has a long finish and an aging potential that allows it to develop for several years.

title: Umberto Cesari Sangiovese - Cabernet Sauvignon Liano 2022
bodyHtml: The character of Sangiovese and the fascination of Cabernet Sauvignon together yield an intense wine, with scents of sour black cherry and subtle hints of vanilla and spice.

title: Ken Wright Pinot Noir Shea 2024
bodyHtml:
Ken Wright Pinot Noir Shea 2024 originates from the United States, within Oregon's Willamette Valley region and the Yamhill Carlton AVA subregion. Founded in 1994 by winemaking pioneer Ken Wright, the winery focuses on single vineyard bottlings that highlight the unique soil profiles across northern Oregon. Shea Vineyard, planted in ancient marine sedimentary soils (Willakenzie series), is one of the premier vineyard sites in the Pacific Northwest and is celebrated for producing Pinot Noir with great structural depth, dark fruit profiles, and intense floral complexity.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a translucent, deep garnet ruby colour. The nose is open and complex, delivering aromas of dark plum, wild blackberry, and black cherry alongside floral violet accents, crushed rock minerality, black tea, and warming sweet spices. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full body with a plush, velvety texture, balanced by vibrant acidity and fine grained, persistent tannins. Stylistically, the wine delivers exceptional power and structural harmony, concluding with a long, elegant finish filled with dark berry compote, savory earth, and cocoa.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Pinot Noir

  • Alcohol by volume: 13.5%

title: Volpaia Chianti Classico Riserva 2020
bodyHtml: The vineyards of Volpaia, located between 1000 and 1750 feet, are between the highest of the Chianti region. This is one of the reasons why this Chianti Classico is renowned for its elegance and freshness with a rich bouquet of red fruits and spices.

title: Chateau Providence 2011
bodyHtml: Another brilliant wine from Christian Moueix, the 2011 La Providence exhibits copious aromas of black raspberries, forest floor and a hint of spring flowers in its full-bodied, surprisingly rich, dense, creamy-textured personality. Long and opulent, this impressive Pomerol is a great success in this vintage. Consume it over the next 15+ years.

title: Patron Gran Platinum Tequila
bodyHtml: Gran Patron is triple distilled then aged to perfection, and it is a true connoisseur’s silver tequila. With claims of being the smoothest sipping tequila ever produced, the Patron Spirits Company’s Gran Patron Platinum Tequila is created using hand selected Weber blue agave grown in the hills of Jalisco, Mexico. The agave is pruned, steam baked, triple distilled and aged to provide a superior taste. Each 750 ml bottle is a piece of art, handmade from crystal and polished, hand signed and numbered with an etched label.

title: Elio Altare Langhe Nebbiolo 2024
bodyHtml: Intense ruby color. Delicate, fresh aromas of rose petals and red fruits. Nice tannins, but not dry. Intense taste of red fruits and good acidity.

title: Elio Grasso Langhe Nebbiolo Gavarini 2020
bodyHtml:
The Nebbiolo Gavarini of Elio Grasso is made with grapes deriving from vineyards situated in Monforte. It has a great structure, with a beautiful ruby red colour. Its aromas are fruity and fragrant with blackberry, raspberry, cherry, plum and violet notes. The taste has a good correspondence with the nose.

This wine is fresh, dry, elegant and soft, with a persistent aftertaste. It is perfect if enjoyed with first and second meat courses, medium aging cheese and all things BBQ'd.

title: J Lohr Cabernet Sauvignon Carol's Vineyard 2022
bodyHtml:
J Lohr Cabernet Sauvignon Carol's Vineyard originates from the St. Helena subregion of Napa Valley, California. Named in honour of Jerry Lohr's late wife, Carol Waldorf Lohr, this 35-acre estate vineyard is situated along the Napa River where gravelly, sandy loam soils provide ideal drainage. The winery’s philosophy for this site focuses on producing richly textured, luxury-quality fruit while supporting the 'Touching Lives' initiative, which donates three dollars from every bottle sold to the National Breast Cancer Foundation.

Wine Description

This deeply pigmented Cabernet Sauvignon displays an opulent sensory profile. The nose is expressive with aromas of blackcurrant, cassis, and ripe black cherry layered with hazelnut, sweet tobacco, violets, and patisserie notes.
