On the palate, the wine is concentrated and polished, featuring dark berry flavours, opulent tannins, and a juicy mouthfeel accented by hints of coffee bean, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cocoa.

Food Pairing

This wine's robust structure and deep fruit profile pair exceptionally well with rich, savoury dishes such as grilled ribeye steak with rosemary and shallots or a porcini-crusted pork tenderloin. It also complements pasta served with a mushroom cream sauce or hard, aged cheeses like gouda and cheddar.

title: Masi Campofiorin 2019 - 3 L
bodyHtml:
With an intense, ruby-red color and violet traces, the wine shows generous, ripe aromas of plum and cherry jam, with hints of spice. Bold and rich flavors of bitter cherries and berry fruits stand out on the palate, with good acidity, balance, and velvety tannins.

This very versatile wine is perfect with many different foods, including pasta with rich meat or mushroom-based sauces, grilled or roasted red meats, game, and mature cheeses.

title: Ricasoli Chianti Classico Colledila Gran Selezione 2021
bodyHtml:
#50 Wine Spectator Top 100 of 2024

The Ricasoli estate, established in 1141, is Italy’s oldest winery and a cornerstone of Chianti Classico winemaking. Situated in Gaiole in Chianti, the Colledilà vineyard represents one of the most prestigious single-vineyard expressions of Sangiovese. Known for its limestone-rich alberese soils, the site produces wines of remarkable elegance and structure, reflecting both the region’s history and Ricasoli’s commitment to quality and innovation.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese wine displays a brilliant ruby red hue with subtle garnet reflections. The nose is expressive, offering aromas of rose hips, blood oranges, ripe cherries, and red peach, layered with delicate floral undertones. The palate is polished and vibrant, showcasing juicy red fruit, refined minerality, and a fresh, elegant structure. Silky tannins and bright acidity contribute to its finesse, leading to a long, persistent finish. The wine is aged for 22 months in 500-litre tonneaux, with 30% new oak and 70% second-passage barrels, achieving a perfect balance of complexity and harmony.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 97 points

  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 95 points

  • Wine & Spirits - 94 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 94 points

  • Falstaff - 97 points

Food Pairing

Ideal with rich and flavorful dishes such as beef, veal, and pasta with meat-based sauces. It also pairs beautifully with aged cheeses and cured meats, enhancing the wine’s depth and character.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 vintage experienced a warm growing season, contributing to the wine’s ripe fruit expression. Despite the heat, the Colledilà vineyard’s limestone soils preserved freshness, allowing for an elegant and balanced final product. The winemaking team’s expertise ensured that the wine retained its signature structure and longevity, making it an exceptional vintage for aging.

title: D'Arenberg Grenache The Custodian 2021
bodyHtml: Grenache has always been a cornerstone of d'Arenberg's red wines and this is one of the benchmarks of the variety. Produced from old low yielding vines it is a wine of great character and intensity. This wine is all about elegant, savoury spice.

title: Graceland Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
Blackberries wrapped in dark chocolate are abundant in this most elegant and stylish Cabernet, with superior fruit expression and structured tannins. A well-defined, European style Cabernet, from the best area in Stellenbosch, South Africa.

Intense colour and long finish bookend this exceptional wine. Fifteen months in French oak barrels, 20% new oak. 

 Pair well with rib roast, venison stew, or lamb chops with a balsamic reduction.

title: Vasse Felix Chardonnay Filius 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from Australia, specifically from the Margaret River region in Western Australia. Vasse Felix, established in 1967 by regional pioneer Dr. Tom Cullity, holds the distinction of being Margaret River's founding wine estate. Since 1987, the winery has been owned and guided by the Holmes à Court family, who maintain an unwavering commitment to quality and sustainable viticulture. The 'Filius' range, meaning 'son of' in Latin, is crafted in a contemporary house style designed for earlier drinking while reflecting the elegance and purity of the estate's premier Chardonnay parcels.

Wine Description

Vasse Felix Chardonnay Filius displays a bright pale straw colour with gold and green tinges. The nose is open and fragrant, featuring an inviting bouquet of citrus blossom, white nectarine, and lemon sorbet, complemented by subtle nuances of apple pie crust, toasted cashew, and arrowroot biscuits. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and vibrant, showcasing flavours of fresh peach, mango, and green apple balanced by a creamy texture and a 'mouth-watering' natural acidity. It is characterized by its elegant structure, featuring a fine saline minerality and a persistent finish with a delicate chalky texture. This 100% Chardonnay was 100% wild fermented and matured for approximately 8 months in French oak barriques (with a small percentage of new oak) and large format foudres. The ABV is 12.5%, and the winery utilizes organic and sustainable farming practices. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is from now through 2031.

title: True Myth Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

True Myth Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the Paso Robles American Viticultural Area (AVA) in California, United States. This winery is part of the Niven Family Wine Estates, a three-generation family-owned group that pioneered grape planting in the region during the early 1970s. Their winemaking philosophy centers on the belief that 'the one True Myth is Mother Nature', focusing on creating authentic, soulful wines that reflect the rich, fertile soils of the Central Coast.

Wine Description

This wine presents a dark, deep colour and opens with a polished sensory profile. The aroma features notes of blueberry, cherry, and vanilla bean, complemented by hints of smoke and sweet spices. On the palate, it is full bodied and rich yet smooth, offering flavours of dark red fruits, black currants, mocha, and caramelized oak. The finish is long and expressive, characterized by velvety, well-integrated tannins and a lingering touch of cocoa powder. The varietal composition for the 2022 vintage is 86% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Syrah, 3% Petite Sirah, and 1% Petite Verdot. This Cabernet Sauvignon has an ABV of 14.7% and is crafted using SIP Certified sustainable practices.

Food Pairing

The structured tannins and rich fruit profile make this wine an ideal companion for hearty red meats such as grilled steaks, lamb chops, or roasted venison. It also pairs effectively with savoury dishes like grilled game sausages, porchetta, and even vegetarian pizza or aged cheeses such as Manchego.

title: Liger Belair Moulin a Vent 2019
bodyHtml: Moulin a Vent Vieilles Vignes has a sorbet-fresh bouquet with kirsch and orange blossom coming through. The palate is structured and masculine, but it would be enhanced by more flesh to come through on the austere finish.

title: Escorihuela Gascon 1884 Syrah 2023
bodyHtml: Built in Mendoza city in 1884 that is now also home to a fantastic restaurant called Francis Mallmann. Certainly more Syrah than Shiraz it is a wine with bright red fruit and wild herbal aromas followed by chocolate and vanilla, a burst of blueberry and a core of savoury char-grilled tones. It is medium-bodied with plenty of juicy red berry flavours albeit lacking some depth. Expect a wine that's quite delicate on the palate, with a fine powdery texture and smooth finish.

title: Illuminati Riparosso 2018 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Deep ruby. Cherry and plum aromas with sweet spicy notes. Balanced fruit and oak flavours. Medium to full-bodied.

title: D'Arenberg Cabernet Sauvignon High Trellis 2021
bodyHtml:
Planted in the late 19th century, the High Trellis vineyard was the first d'Arenberg vineyard to be trained above knee height. For the past four decades, a Cabernet Sauvignon has been produced from the vineyard to critical acclaim, even winning the Jimmy Watson trophy in 1969. Something that d'Arry reminds current winemaker, and son, Chester about often!

This wine screams Cabernet!  A deep dark presence in the glass. Blackcurrant, cedar, paprika and leafy notes tell the story of classic McLaren Vale Cabernet Sauvignon. The palate follows the nose with harmonious blackcurrant, capsicum, and stewed mulberries. The multitude of ﬁne persistent tannins.

title: Courvoisier L'Essence Cognac
bodyHtml: A super-luxury Courvoisier, L'Essence is blended from over 100 ancient eaux-de-vies from Grande Champagne and Borderies and is presented in a Baccarat teardrop decanter suspended in a frame complete with a finely crafted crystal stopper, inspired by the signet rings given by Napoleon Bonaparte to commanders in his army in recognition of noble acts.

title: Jean Marc Brocard Chablis Montee de Tonnerre Premier Cru 2021
bodyHtml:
Brocard reveals a deep straw-yellow in the glass that pops with silver and slight green reflections. The nose bursts with impressive salinity that comes in the form of crushed oyster shells and sea spray, closely followed by lemon curd, white peach, freshly sliced white pear, lees, honeysuckle, acacia, lime blossoms, yellow apple skin, and bracing chalk minerality.

93 Points - Decanter

Intriguing smoky character on the nose, Brocard's Montée de Tonnerre captures the essence of this top premier cru. Compact and concentrated on the palate, there is a fine combination of white flowers on the nose, stone fruit on the palate, powerful acidity and minerality.

title: Chateau Croix Mouton 2018
bodyHtml:
Croix Mouton produces wines intended for pleasure, and excellent while still young. Entirely Merlot-driven, they are full-bodied and rich in flavour, easy to drink but with finesse, and have a stunning display of fresh red fruit on the palate. After the release of its first vintage, Château Croix Mouton was very quickly recognized by Bordeaux wine experts as being excellent value for money. The 'M' on Château Croix Mouton's label is special. It changes shape and colour each year to reflect the personality of each vintage.

 The 2018 Croix-Mouton is a dark, pliant Bordeaux Superieur. Black cherry, licorice, spice and creme de cassis give this sumptuous, racy wine striking texture and depth. The purity of the fruit and the wine's freshness are notable.

89 Points - Wine Spectator

Lightly steeped damson plum and black cherry notes are expressive, while fine-grained structure pulls in light humus and cedar details through the finish. Drink now through 2022.

title: West Cape Howe Shiraz 2019
bodyHtml: Ripe plum with a dark chocolate level on show, layered beautifully with sweet and savoury spice, enhanced by the light, smoky oak characters picked up during maturation. A really delicious Shiraz that can be enjoyed right now and over the next few years.

title: Chateau Villa Bel-Air Rouge 2022
bodyHtml: Gooseberry and flowers, citrus and anise. Very pretty nose, earthy aromas. Great fruit, round and weighty, good length and some toasted notes of oak, raspberry, and vanilla. High acidity, soft tannins. Smooth wine. Lots of flavour, lots of fruit.

title: Taittinger Nocturne (NV)
bodyHtml:
The night is more beautiful with Nocturne!  Taittinger Nocturne is a sweeter 'sec' champagne, made from 40% Chardonnay and 60 % Pinot Noir and Meunier from 35 vineyards. It is the result of several harvests undertaken when the fruit had reached perfect maturity. The uniqueness of its mix and its long maturation period in the cellars gives it its fullness and smoothness. It works well as an accompaniment to dessert, or simply as a digestif on its own after a meal.

The body is pale yellow in colour with shimmering highlights.  The bubbles form a delicate ring of fine foam. The subtle and delicate bouquet reveals the delightful aromas of yellow peaches and dried apricots. The entry is smooth and creamy, yet very crisp. The palate gives way to flavours of raisins and fruits in syrup. The long and smooth finish is distinctively sweet and full of flavour. A mature, rich and round wine, 

90 Points - Vinous     Bright yellow. Deeply perfumed aromas of poached pear, melon, nectarine and lemon curd are complemented by suggestions of buttered toast, anise and chamomile. Plush and broad on the palate, offering ripe citrus and pit fruit flavors with a touch of chalky minerality adding cut and lift. A floral quality builds slowly with air and carries through the spicy, sappy, gently sweet finish. I like this Champagne's balance of fruitiness and vivacity and there's no way that I'd have guessed that its dosage was so high.

title: Poli Cleopatra Moscato Grappa
bodyHtml: An attractive bottle encloses this special grappa. It's packed with aromas of orange, lime, grapefruit and oak. Additional notes of cumin and caraway are present on the palate, leading to a bold and fruity yet spicy and elegant finish. Serve over ice with lemon-infused Panettone.

title: Torbreck The Steading 2023
bodyHtml:
The Steading is very much the heart and soul of Torbreck, the wine that exemplifies their philosophy and beliefs, protecting and nurturing the old vine resources of the Barossa Valley is paramount to Torbreck and this wine. It is sourced from Grenache, Mataro and Shiraz vines that survived the worldwide phylloxera outbreak of the 1880s, and a century later, the vine-pull scheme in the Barossa in the 1980s.

The Steading is a collection of 45 different sources of fruit, some from their own vineyard estates as well as from growers on a share-farming basis. These precious grapes are vinified separately and blended once their individual virtues have been assessed. The Steading’s generous and supple flavours combine with its silken texture in a wine that defines what is possible only in the Barossa.

title: Speri Valpolicella Classico 2022
bodyHtml: A red wine that preserves the soul of the land from which it is born. Distinguished by fragrant aromas and fresh flavours, it is suitable to accompany a variety of cuisine.

title: Ken Wright Pinot Noir Bryce 2024
bodyHtml:
Ken Wright Pinot Noir Bryce 2024 originates from the United States, within Oregon's Willamette Valley region and the Ribbon Ridge AVA subregion. Founded in 1994 by winemaking pioneer Ken Wright, the winery focuses on single vineyard expressions that showcase the distinct soil profiles of northern Oregon. Bryce Family Vineyard, planted on ancient marine sedimentary soils (Willakenzie series), is known for producing deeply structured, dark fruit driven Pinot Noir with notable power, spice, and savory complexity.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a dark ruby red colour with subtle garnet highlights. The nose opens with rich, brooding aromas of ripe Marionberry, dark plum, and black cherry, accompanied by nuances of cocoa, black tea, dried herbs, and warm baking spices. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full body with a plush, structured texture, supported by fine grained tannins and balancing, lively acidity. Stylistically, the wine combines dark fruit depth with earthy mineral undertones, concluding with a long, savory finish carrying notes of dark berry compote and subtle spice.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Pinot Noir

  • Alcohol by volume: 13.5%

title: Bodegas Olivares Altos De La Hoya Monastrell 2019
bodyHtml: Ripe, powerful scents of red and dark fruits, minerals and spices. Finishes fresh and long, with a repeating dark fruit note. An exceptional combination with red meats and stews. Blend: 90% Monastrell, 10% Grenache.

title: Faustino Tempranillo Rioja VII 2023
bodyHtml: Clean, bright, cherry red colour developing to maroon. Pleasant on the nose, ripe red fruits touch and sweet barrel hints. Balanced. Elegant and fresh with a medium finish. Pair with any kind of meat. It matches with grilled or fried potatoes, mushrooms or ham. Some tasty or oily fish such as tuna and all kind of pasta.

title: Masciarelli Trebbiano D'Abruzzo 2024
bodyHtml:
The Masciarelli winery honours the legacy of its founder, Gianni Masciarelli, crafting wines that reflect the soul and unique terroir of Abruzzo. Masciarelli is the only producer in Abruzzo to own land in all four of the region's provinces, sourcing grapes for this wine from diverse sites with calcareous clay and lime soils across various altitudes.

Wine Description

This wine is a delightful and expressive white, made from 100% Trebbiano D'Abruzzo grapes. It presents a limpid, straw yellow colour with greenish reflections. The aroma is refined and intense, offering an elegant fragrance of white flowers, apples, apricot pie, lemon juice, and other citrus fruits. On the palate, it showcases a medium body and is fine and fruity with a seamless representation of the aromas. It is often described as a light and crisp, modern style, possessing good acidity and a fresh, easy-going character.

Food Pairing

The wine's good acidity and fresh, fruity profile make it ideal for light summer dishes. Suggested pairings include seafood, shellfish, and simply prepared chicken, pork schnitzel, or veal dishes, as the acidity helps cut through any oiliness.

title: Speri Amarone della Valpolicella Classico Sant'Urbano 2017
bodyHtml: From one of the top estates producing Amarone, known for creating wines that are highly structured and complex with scents of crushed violets, plum cake and exotic spices. Speri's Amarone consistently delivers doles of ripe blackberry, raisin, licorice and finishes with velvetly tannins.

title: Cabo Wabo Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Originally created by legendary rocker, Sammy Hagar. A golden colour pours into the glass and instantly filled with a bouquet of bright citrus aromas. Aged from four to six months in American oak barrels develops bold flavours of citrus, fresh herbs and refreshing mint with a smooth and lasting peppery finish.

title: Torbreck Shiraz The Factor 2022
bodyHtml: The Factor is predominantly from the Gomersal and Marananga sub-regions of the Barossa, providing dense texture and richness to the palate with subtle notes of olive tapenade, saddle leather and minerals. Ripe aromas of Satsuma plum, wild blackberries, dark chocolate and five spice entwined with a dark core of espresso roast, ripe mulberries and saltbush. Brooding and densely packed, this lavish wine has ample generosity to cellar for more than 20 years, where it will slowly unravel its beguiling riches.

title: El Tesoro Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
General Information

Truly unique, and steeped in history, El Tesoro is one of the last known tequilas to fully embrace the traditional tequila making process. A tequila crafted with knowledge passed down through centuries and infused with the passion of its makers, El Tesoro honors Don Felipe Camarena, the man who established La Altena Distillery in 1937. Today his grandson, Carlos Camarena, oversees production. Just like his grandfather, he is passionate about agave and fiercely protective of his traditional methods. Every decision, every part of the painstaking process, is done in celebration of this unique treasure. Shunning efficiency in favor of a commitment to meticulous care and attention to detail - El Tesoro is a precious tequila, waiting to be discovered.

title: Domaine Latour Giraud Meursault Charles Maxime 2023
bodyHtml: Come hither peach and pear notes folded gently into toasted almond and hazelnut. So alive, so seductive. Full-bodied but not heavy. A gorgeous Chardonnay. Very versatile and works well on first dates and twentieth wedding anniversaries. Pair this Chardonnay with a variety of chicken dishes.

title: Kill Devil Navy Style Dark Rum
bodyHtml:
General Information

This blended Caribbean rum is a dark and rich blend of the finest Guyana and Jamaica rums, aged for added smoothness and depth in selected white oak casks. Bottled at a powerful 57% ABV in a nod to the Royal Navy's old 'gunpowder strength' qualification, it's perfect in cocktails or served over ice.

The nose is intense and tropical with blackened banana, pineapple, peaches and citrus zest. The palate brings more caramelized banana and pineapple, with chocolate and coffee bean flavours emerging.

title: Stags' Leap Winery Petite Sirah Ne Cede Malis
bodyHtml:
While famous for its Cabernet Sauvignon, Stags' Leap Winery has also gained high acclaim for its Petite Sirah. The intriguing varietal was planted on the property before the winery was established in 1893, and today it remains an essential part of the Estate's winemaking legacy. Petite Sirah has become synonymous with Stags' Leap and for decades has cultivated devote fans of the winery. NE CEDE MALIS (pronounced Ne KAY Day Mah LEES) comes from the Latin phrase 'Don't give in to misfortune,' the family motto of Stags' Leap founder Horace Chase.

This wine is amazingly concentrated, full-bodied mouthfeel, and stunning purity and depth, this is a wine for 30-40 years of cellaring.

title: Marchese Antinori Chianti Classico Riserva 2022 (by Tenuta Tignanello)
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the historic heartland of the Chianti Classico DOCG region in Tuscany. The Marchesi Antinori family can trace its winemaking history back to 1385, spanning 26 generations of direct management. The winery's philosophy balances a deep respect for Tuscan tradition with a pioneering spirit, notably reinterpreting this historic label—first produced in 1928—as a premium Riserva that showcases the quality and elegance of the Sangiovese grown at their famed Tenuta Tignanello estate.

Wine Description

Marchese Antinori Chianti Classico Riserva displays an intense ruby red colour, occasionally showing subtle garnet reflections with age. The nose is expressive and layered, offering aromas of red fruit such as black cherries and raspberries, alongside floral notes of violets and rose petals. The complex bouquet is further accented by integrated notes of toasted wood, tobacco, white chocolate, and sweet spices like cinnamon. On the palate, the wine is smooth and supple, featuring vibrant, fine-grained tannins and a balanced structure that delivers flavours of plum, cherry, and iron. It is characterized by its elegant minerality and a lengthy, sapid finish.

title: Miner 'Gary's Vineyard' Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml: Founded in 1988 by Dave Miner, president of Oakville Ranch Vineyards, along with his wife Emily and his parents, Ed and Norma, Miner Family Vineyards produces small lot, handcrafted wines using fruit from Oakville Ranch, Ed and Norma's vineyard and other carefully selected California vineyards. Best known for their Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay, they also produce limited quantities of other varietals using a combination of old-world winemaking techniques and modern technology. Their focus is on producing high-end, reserve-style wines that reflect the unique characteristics of individual vineyards or terrior where those specific varietals grow best.

title: Bulliat Morgon
bodyHtml: Aromas of cherry, plum, cedar, and minerals. Medium body, good acidity, with flavors of black cherry, plum, leather, orange peel, and mineral. Fruity, not too complex, but enjoyable. Pair with simply done pork chops and collard greens.

title: Planeta Alastro Grecanico Bianco 2023
bodyHtml: Derived from the name of the wildflower that grows around our winery, Alastro is a Grecanico blended with two notably aromatic varieties, Grillo and Sauvignon Blanc. Splendidly aromatic, delicately structured, with aromas of tropical fruit, fresh citrus and white flowers.

title: Perrier Jouet Grand Brut
bodyHtml:
Perrier-Jouët Grand Brut originates from France, within the Champagne region and the Épernay subregion. Maison Perrier-Jouët was founded in 1811 by Pierre-Nicolas Perrier and Adèle Jouët, establishing a legacy that combines a passion for botany with meticulous winemaking. The house is renowned for its инноватор approach to Chardonnay, which serves as the flagship variety and provides the floral elegance that has become the brand's signature over more than two centuries.

Wine Description

This champagne presents a silvery gold colour in the glass and possess a medium to full body. The sensory profile is vibrant and stylish, featuring an aromatic nose of spring blossoms, yellow orchard fruits, and honeyed citrus, rounded out by hints of buttery brioche, warm biscuits, and vanilla. On the palate, it delivers a lively and focused experience with layers of lemon, green apple, and peach supported by a frothy mousse and crisp acidity. The finish is clean, persistent, and uncomplicated, often revealing a touch of candied ginger and mineral tension.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend typically consisting of 40% Pinot Meunier, 35% Pinot Noir, and 25% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its harmonious balance and rounded texture, achieved through full malolactic fermentation and aging for twice the minimum required duration.

  • ABV: Typically 12% to 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the house is committed to sustainable development and the preservation of its exceptional terroir, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The generous character and delicate floral notes of Grand Brut make it a highly versatile partner for both simple and sophisticated dishes.

  • Seafood: Pairs exceptionally well with fresh oysters, seared Pacific sea bass with saffron aioli, and rock shrimp rolls.

  • Meats and Poultry: Suggested pairings include roasted chicken, lean beef stew with a white wine base, and roasted turkey.

  • Light Fare and Cheese: Complements fresh garden salads, goat cheese, and homemade crusty bread.

  • Savoury: Matches well with braised artichokes, lemon shortbread, and dishes featuring ground ginger.

title: Glengoyne 15 Year Old Highland Single Malt
bodyHtml:
"Every winter, the hill behind out distillery becomes a beacon for migrating flocks of geese, which is why our home on the Highland border is known as The Glen of The Geese or, in Gaelic, Glen Guin. But our guests have inspired more than just our whisky's name. In a world that seems to spin faster every day, we're proud to be the slowest whisky distiller in Scotland.

In the stillness of our quiet glen, we know that patience is rewarded. Nothing is rushed and every stage of our whisky making process is given as long as it needs. Uniquely-shaped stills nurse the simmering wash during the longest distillation of any Scottish whisky, prolonged contact with the copper coaxing sweet and fruity notes from the gently rolling vapours. That's why our barley is only ever dried by air, allowing the true Glengoyne spirit to shine through.

From here the precious spirit is transferred to casks made to order from European and American oak, themselves prepared for six years before they're ready to carry our whisky to maturity. The natural colour of the whisky is testament to decades within the wood alone. Nothing else is added, this is how we craft a whisky unlike any other. This is the Glengoyne way."

Glengoyne 15 Year Old     Glengoyne's new 15 year old is a rich, rounded single malt, completely devoid of peat smoke thanks to air-drying the barley. It is aged in both bourbon and first-fill sherry casks, with some refill cask whisky thrown in for good measure.

title: Domaine Seguin Manuel Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
The barrel-aged Bourgogne Pinot Noir from the Burgundy winegrowing region presents itself in a brilliantly shimmering light red in the glass. When swirling the wine glass, this red wine is characterized by a fascinating lightness that makes it dance nimbly in the glass. The first nose of the Bourgogne Pinot Noir shows nuances of roses, violets and blueberries. The fruity notes of the bouquet are joined by notes of barrel ageing and even more fruity-balsamic nuances.

The Bourgogne Pinot Noir from Seguin-Manuel is exactly the right wine for all wine drinkers who like as little sweetness as possible in their wine. However, it is never meagre or brittle, but round and smooth. Light-footed and complex, this silky red wine presents itself on the palate. Due to its vital fruit acidity, the Bourgogne Pinot Noir is impressively fresh and lively on the palate. The finish of this red wine from the Burgundy wine-growing region, which is capable of maturing well, finally convinces you with a beautiful aftertaste.

title: Domain Gerard Duplessis Chablis Les Vaillons Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from France, this wine hail from the esteemed Chablis region within the Premier Cru subregion of Les Vaillons. Lilian Duplessis currently oversees the domaine, which was established by his grandfather and further developed by his father, Gérard. The estate's winemaking philosophy focuses on organic cultivation and long aging periods of at least 18 months to ensure exceptional aging capacity and a true expression of the Kimmeridgian limestone terroir.

Wine Description

This Premier Cru presents a classic sensory profile with a pale lemon yellow colour and green reflections. The nose is aromatic and complex, offering bright citrus and nectarine fruits layered with notes of acacia, white flowers, and a distinct oyster shell minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium full bodied and energetic, displaying a silky texture and 'classic' brisk acidities that provide tension and a sharp, clear cut first impression.

Food Pairing

The wine's sharp acidity and mineral depth make it an excellent partner for smoked salmon, trout, or delicate freshwater fish. It also pairs beautifully with white meats in light sauces and creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert.

title: San Matias Gran Reserva Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: 100% Blue Agave, 40% ABV. Aged three years in new French Oak barrels. Bright amber with an orange hue, with strong body and slow forming legs. Initial aromas of butter and ripe fruits and notes of chocolate and toasted almond and intense hazelnut, with notes of crust of rye bread and red flowers. On the palate, natural sweetness and savoury notes, light acidity. Ideally paired with fatty meats and poultry.

title: Torbreck The Struie Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml: Lifted aromatics of black and blue fruits such as blackberry, blueberry compote and milk chocolate, with graphite and mineral like complexity from granite and schist soils in the Eden Valley. The full-bodied and silken textured mouthfeel exhibits plushness of fruit along with mouth coating ripe Shiraz tannins that are full yet soft. The oak is barely noticeable and will give way after a year or two in bottle to its density and freshness of fruit.

title: L'Hospitalet de Gazin 2019
bodyHtml:
95 Points - James Suckling

A perfumed nose of mulberries, plums, chocolate orange and cloves. Hints of toffee, too. Medium-to full-bodied with firm, ripe tannins. Caressing, velvety and rich core of dark fruit. So supple and polished. 88.5% merlot, 7% cabernet sauvignon and 4.5% cabernet franc. Drink after 2024.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

While the 2019 Château Gazin isn't going to match the 2018, it's an elegant, solid Pomerol delivering spicy red and black cherry fruits, notes of cedary herbs and flowers, medium-bodied richness, silky yet building tannins, and an excellent finish. This elegant, nicely structured, balanced beauty will benefit from 3-5 years of bottle age and keep for 15-20 years—best after 2025.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2019 Gazin is a fleshy, dramatic wine that wafts from the glass with aromas of ripe berry fruit mingled with subtle hints of truffle and violets, its new oak already entirely integrated. Medium to full-bodied, velvety and seamless, it's broad and textural, with lively acids, powdery tannins and fine length on the finish—best after 2025.

title: Gabbiano Chianti Classico Riserva 2013 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Created from the estate's oldest vineyards, this Riserva Chianti Classico keeps the most typical organoleptic characteristics of this old tradition wine, emphasized by balanced ageing in wood.

On the nose, this wine offers lovely red fruity notes with hints of strawberries, red cherry and baking spice. A fruit-filled palate of red cherry, tobacco with additional earthy and spicy notes. The firm tannins are balanced by fresh acidity and good complexity.

title: Charles Heidsieck Brut 2012
bodyHtml:
94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Disgorged in 2019 with eight grams per litre dosage, the 2012 Brut Millésimé offers up aromas of crisp orchard fruit, white flowers and clear honey, complemented by hints of toasted bread and citrus zest and linden. Medium to full-bodied, elegantly fleshy and nicely concentrated, with lively acids and a pinpoint mousse, it's more generous and demonstrative than the 2008. Still, it will nonetheless reward a bit of bottle age.

title: Ledaig 10 Year Old
bodyHtml: Peaty whisky from Tobermory on the Isle of Mull, named after a previous incarnation of the distillery. Maritime and smoky, this rivals some of the Islay drams for power, and the 10 year old balances the intensity of youth with rounded, well-aged spirit.

title: Demuerte Gold Red Wine Blend 2023
bodyHtml:
Demuerte Gold is a full-bodied Spanish red wine blend from D.O. Yecla (Murcia).

Deep cherry to garnet color with aromas and flavors of ripe red and dark fruit, black pepper, cloves, nutmeg, and subtle oak spice, finishing with ripe, silky tannins.

title: Tawse Riesling Quarry Road 2022
bodyHtml: Quarry Road Riesling is destined to impress. The nose is a delightful experience dosed in fresh green apple and honeysuckle, with the quintessential yet delicate petrol character. The palate is packed with flavours of mandarin and citrus zest, that are complemented by a creamy mouthfeel, a spark of minerality, and a crisp finish. This Riesling dances on the palate and encourages the second glass with ease. Pairing food with this Quarry Road Riesling will be best expressed with spicy dishes, such as traditional Paella, or a fresh mango salad with lemon juice and cayenne pepper.

title: Navigator Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml: Sourced from multiple vineyards across California, the Navigator Cabernet Sauvignon is a complex yet easy drinking wine. Flavors of dark red fruit with notes of baking spice and cocoa envelop the palate and lead to a soft yet lengthy finish.

title: Original 16 Pale Ale - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Original 16 Pale Ale is a premium Canadian ale brewed by Great Western Brewing Company in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. The "Original 16" name is a tribute to the 16 founders, all former employees of a large national brewery, who pooled their resources to save the brewery from closing in 1989. This Pale Ale is their flagship, designed to be a "step up" in quality and flavor from mainstream domestic brands while remaining incredibly smooth and easy to drink. It is a quintessential Prairie classic.

Beer Description

This Pale Ale pours a brilliant, clear deep copper-gold with a thick, frothy white head and fine, steady carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is clean and subtly complex. It leads with a distinct toasted grain and bready malt scent, followed by a delicate, floral hop aroma. There is a faint, sweet hint of caramel and dried fruit (like golden raisins) that adds a layer of depth not typically found in standard lagers.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a remarkably smooth, "velvety" mouthfeel. It leads with a balanced malt sweetness notes of biscuit and honey which is quickly met by a gentle, earthy bitterness. The finish is clean and dry, with a soft, lingering warmth that feels substantial yet refreshing.

Profile: It sits at an ABV of 5.0% and a moderate bitterness of approx. 15–18 IBU, prioritizing malt balance over hop intensity.

Technical Notes: The hallmark of Original 16 is its "double-aging" process. The beer is matured for a longer period than most commercial ales, which allows the flavors to fully integrate and results in an exceptionally smooth finish. It is brewed using 100% Saskatchewan-grown barley (specifically two-row malt) and five different varieties of choice hops, ensuring a consistent and high-quality "Western Canadian" flavor profile.

title: Sottano Malbec Judas 2021
bodyHtml:
Sottano Malbec Judas originates from the Perdriel district within the Luján de Cuyo region of Mendoza, Argentina. The winery was founded by Italian immigrant Fioravante Sottano in 1890, and today it remains a family affair led by the fourth generation: brothers Diego, Pablo, and Mauricio Sottano.

Wine Description

This wine displays an intense, brilliant red colour with black hues. Its great complexity and aromatic intensity show notes of cherries, spices, tobacco, cassis, white pepper, and cloves with touches of mint and chocolate. It has a good structure and marked acidity. Velvety and sweet tannins are given by the wood. It is voluminous and full-bodied in the mouth and has a long and persistent finish.

title: Schramsberg Blanc De Noirs 2023
bodyHtml:
This rich, medium-bodied brut sparkling wine is made mostly from Pinot Noir. In 1967, Schramsberg Vineyards introduced the Blanc de Noirs style to the United States, creating the first such sparkling wine in the country. Our sourcing of pinot noir grapes from a wide range of cool-climate vineyards is important to crafting this Blanc de Noirs. Pinot Noir from the Carneros and Anderson Valleys is blended with fruit from low-yielding Sonoma and Marin coast vineyards to create a sparkling wine with a wide range of fruity aromas and flavours. The blend's freshness and backbone come from select Chardonnay lots.

Schramsberg Vineyards Blanc de Noirs is particularly well-suited to serve with a variety of foods, including soft and nutty cheeses, macadamia nut-crusted halibut and pork tenderloin with fresh rosemary and lemon thyme.

title: Elio Grasso Barbera D'Alba Vigna Martina 2019
bodyHtml: The vinification procedure for Barbera d’Alba Martina involves alcoholic fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks, with daily pumping over. After malolactic fermentation, the wine is aged in 50% new French barriques and 50% one year old.

title: Pablo Claro Cabernet Sauvignon Graciano 2023
bodyHtml:
The Dominio de Punctum estate is owned by the Fernanadez family and is located in La Mancha, one of Spain's most important wine areas. Dominio distinguishes itself from other wineries in the region by focusing solely on the creation of world-class organic and biodynamic wines. The vineyards cover 200 hectares and produce both young and matured white and red wines using ancient Spanish techniques combined with current sustainable agriculture and winemaking.

Pablo Claro is a unique Cabernet Sauvignon and Graciano blend. Graciano is primarily grown in Rioja, but it can also be found in other parts of the world. Graciano is a highly interesting varietal with a really interesting composition. It's not a high-producing varietal or one that can be found on its own. It's typically used to elevate other varietals in blends because of its robust acidity and brooding flavours. Cabernet Sauvignon in this case. 

A very deep, dark cherry color. Brings to the nose aromas of spice, vanilla and ripe fruits. Very well structured, with sweet tannins, full body, harmonious and long finish. Roast beef or filet mignon can be great partners for this wine.  Enjoy today at 18 C or keep for a few years to let the flavours blend.

title: Pikesville Straight Rye Whisky
bodyHtml: At 6 years old and 110 proof, this Pikesville Straight Rye Whiskey comes to us from Heaven Hill Distillery in Kentucky. A little bit different than its Rittenhouse Rye sibling - Pikesville shows more candied rye notes plus vanilla, toffee and butter scotch along with the more typical Rye spice notes such as cloves and cinnamon/nutmeg. This big and bold yet sweet rye drinks well on it's own or in cocktails.

title: Chateau Fleur Cardinale 2020
bodyHtml:
96 Points - James Suckling

Attractive aromas of blueberries and mulberries with graphite, dark licorice and crushed stones. Dark chocolate, too. Full-bodied. Impressive quality to the tannin structure that starts gently and glossy and continues to build, gaining power throughout the palate. Deep and dense with a velvety dark-fruited core. 

94 Points - Decanter

A ton of depth and body to this wine, you feel the cool blue fruit of a later-ripening terroir, plenty of tannic grip and bite, curls up with graphite, cigar box, liquorice root and a tiptoe balance of slate and baked earth. Plenty of juicy acidity on the finish, this is precise and elegant with a punch, and continues the run of successful vintages at Fleur Cardinale.

93+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Composed of 77% Merlot, 18% Cabernet Franc and 5% Cabernet Sauvignon, with an alcohol of 14.5% and a pH of 3.57, the deep purple-black colored 2020 Fleur Cardinale bursts from the glass with powerful notes of crushed blackberries, stewed black plums and Morello cherries, plus suggestions of star anise, pencil shavings and black truffles. The medium to full-bodied palate is chock-full of softly textured, juicy black fruits, countered by fantastic tension, finishing with great length and loads of earthy layers.

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

From healthy yields of 43 hectoliters per hectare, with malolactic fermentation in tank followed by 13 months in 90% new French oak, it has a juicy, pure, medium to full-bodied style that shows the classic, elegant style of the vintage beautifully. Offering lots of cassis-like fruit, notes of truffly earth, spring flowers, and violets, well-integrated acidity and tannins, and just a beautifully balanced mouthfeel, it's going to benefit from just 2-4 years of bottle age.

title: Two Hands Gnarly Dudes 2022
bodyHtml: Named for the fierce and twisted looking old vines from which the grapes are sourced, Gnarly Dudes is a tightly focused wine with intense notes of roasted fruits, plum and blackberry. Big and bold, it's a finely crafted powerhouse wine. Enjoy with grilled steaks.

title: Chateau d'Esclans The Beach Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Château d'Esclans The Beach Rosé originates from France, within the Provence region and the Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence subregion. Located northeast of St. Tropez, the magical estate was acquired in 2006 by Sacha Lichine, who is widely regarded as the architect of the 'Rosé Renaissance'. The winery's philosophy focuses on crafting the greatest rosés in the world, with this particular cuvée introduced as a fresh, playful, and approachable sibling to the famed Whispering Angel.

Wine Description

This rosé wine presents a clear, pale pink or soft coral hue and possesses a light-bodied structure. The sensory profile is highly expressive and forward, opening with an aromatic nose of red currants, wild strawberries, and white peaches, balanced by light floral undertones and subtle hints of lime and melon. On the palate, it delivers a refreshing, dry, and crisp experience where juicy red berry and citrus fruit flavours are supported by a vibrant energy and balanced acidity. The finish is clean, round, and persistent, leaving a lingering mineral-driven and peach-forward aftertaste.

  • Varietal Composition: A Mediterranean blend of Grenache, Cinsault, and Syrah.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its modern, easy-drinking complexity and ecological mindfulness, featuring an forward-thinking approach to environmental responsibility that utilizes lighter glass bottles to limit its carbon footprint.

  • ABV: 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate is dedicated to environmental responsibility and partnerships with ocean preservation organizations like the Surfrider Foundation, this commercial bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The crisp minerality, balanced acidity, and delicate fruitiness of The Beach Rosé make it an exceptional match for light, warm-weather gastronomy.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with grilled shrimp skewers, smoked salmon salad, raw oysters, and light Mediterranean fish dishes.

  • Light Fare: An ideal choice for poolside sipping, it complements fresh arugula and avocado salads, antipasto platters, and light pasta dishes.

  • Cheese: Matches gracefully with mild charcuterie selections and soft cheeses.

title: Tierra Noble Exquisito Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tierra Noble Exquisito Extra Añejo is a premium tequila crafted in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. This exceptional spirit is produced from 100% blue Weber agave and aged for up to 85 months in French oak barrels, resulting in a complex and refined profile.

Appearance: Intense dark amber color with reddish hues, clean and bright, exhibiting great adherence in the glass, forming legs and tears indicative of its full body. 

Aroma: A harmonious blend of cooked agave, vanilla, prunes, chocolate, and toasted almonds, with subtle notes of apricot and tobacco, all balanced elegantly with oak, reflecting its extensive maturation.

Palate: Smooth and well-balanced, offering flavors of bitter chocolate, dried fruits, berries, light tobacco, and spices, leading to a lengthy, persistent finish.

Body: Full-bodied with a velvety texture, showcasing the depth and complexity achieved through prolonged aging.

Finish: Long and enduring, leaving a lasting impression of its rich and intricate flavors.

Accolades:

  • Gold Medal – San Francisco World Spirits Competition
  • 95 Points – Tequila Matchmaker

Tierra Noble Exquisito Extra Añejo is best enjoyed neat or with a splash of water to fully appreciate its intricate flavors and aromas. It pairs excellently with dark chocolate, rich desserts, or a fine cigar, making it an ideal choice for special occasions or as a luxurious gift. The meticulous production process, from selecting mature agave plants to the extended aging period, reflects the dedication to quality and tradition inherent in this exquisite tequila.

title: Glengoyne Cask Strength
bodyHtml:
"Every winter, the hill behind out distillery becomes a beacon for migrating flocks of geese, which is why our home on the Highland border is known as The Glen of The Geese or, in Gaelic, Glen Guin. But our guests have inspired more than just our whisky's name. In a world that seems to spin faster every day, we're proud to be the slowest whisky distiller in Scotland.

In the stillness of our quiet glen, we know that patience is rewarded. Nothing is rushed and every stage of our whisky making process is given as long as it needs. Uniquely-shaped stills nurse the simmering wash during the longest distillation of any Scottish whisky, prolonged contact with the copper coaxing sweet and fruity notes from the gently rolling vapours. That's why our barley is only ever dried by air, allowing the true Glengoyne spirit to shine through.

From here the precious spirit is transferred to casks made to order from European and American oak, themselves prepared for six years before they're ready to carry our whisky to maturity. The natural colour of the whisky is testament to decades within the wood alone. Nothing else is added, this is how we craft a whisky unlike any other. This is the Glengoyne way."

title: Domaine Lafage Centenaire White Blend 2024
bodyHtml:
Domaine Lafage Centenaire White Blend originates from France, specifically the Roussillon region within the Côtes Catalanes subregion. Established in 1996 by Jean Marc and Eliane Lafage, the estate is rooted in a winemaking legacy that dates back to 1798 and spans seven generations. The winery's philosophy emphasizes regenerative agriculture and a deep respect for the diverse Mediterranean terroirs, aiming to restore soil vitality while producing authentic, site-driven wines.

Wine Description

This aromatic dry white wine presents a brilliant pale green to pale straw colour with green reflections. The nose is characterized by a refined symphony of citrus, white blossoms, and ripe orchard fruits such as pear and white peach, underscored by mineral notes of wet stone and a subtle hint of vanilla. On the palate, the wine is rich and ample with a silky texture and vibrant acidity that provides a beautiful sense of tension.

Food Pairing

This wine's elegant structure and mineral backbone make it an excellent companion for grilled sea bass, lemon sole, or seafood ceviche. It also pairs beautifully with roasted poultry in creamy herb sauces, herbed goat cheese salads, and traditional Mediterranean dishes like ratatouille or paella.

title: Pol Roger Brut Reserve 'White Foil'
bodyHtml:
Pol Roger is one of the few remaining family-owned grande marque Champagne houses. Their grande marque status was guaranteed at the turn of the century when about 20 producers banded together to establish strict quality controls for Champagne. Pol Roger also was the Champagne of choice of British dignitary Sir Winston Churchill, who said of Champagne, "In victory I deserve it, and in defeat I need it!".
 
92 Points - James Suckling
One of the great, all-around NV offerings in a classically styled, soft and silky package. Berries, biscuits and smooth, vinous texture in the mouth. Easygoing with broad appeal. Drink now.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '39' Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Asahi Shuzo, the Dassai 39 (San-wari Kyu-bun) is often described as the "skillful balance" of the Dassai lineup. It sits precisely between the approachable Dassai 45 and the ultra-premium Dassai 23. The "39" indicates that the Yamada Nishiki rice—the "king of sake rice"—has been polished down to exactly 39% of its original size. This meticulous refinement removes outer proteins and fats to ensure a cleaner, more elegant flavor profile than standard sakes.

Description

This premium sake is clear and light-bodied with a soft, silky texture. The nose is delicate and refined, bursting with a "fruit basket" of aromas including ripe melon, pineapple, honeysuckle, and fresh pear. On the palate, it offers a harmonious balance of sweetness and acidity, with flavors of lychee, apple, and mango intertwining with subtle underlying notes of steamed rice and light umami. It finishes crisp and smooth, leaving behind a nuanced trace of minerality reminiscent of a clear mountain stream. ABV 15%–16%.

Food Pairing

Dassai 39 is highly versatile and designed for "tasting," making it an ideal companion for clean, fresh flavors. It is a classic partner for sushi, sashimi, and poached white fish, but its acidity also allows it to pair beautifully with fresh salads, green vegetables, and light tapas. For a Western twist, try it alongside creamy dips, mussels in garlic broth, or even a cheese plate featuring semi-hard varieties. It is best served chilled (around 10–12°C) in a wine glass to fully capture its complex floral and fruity bouquet.

title: Campagnola Pinot Grigio 2025 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Campagnola Pinot Grigio is a beautiful Italian white wine that showcases the unique character of the Pinot Grigio grape. The wine's straw-yellow color with greenish reflections is stunning and inviting, giving a hint of the fresh and vibrant flavors that are to come.

On the nose, this wine offers an intense bouquet of juicy pear, crisp apple, and zesty citrus fruit, with delicate floral and mineral notes adding complexity and depth. These aromas are beautifully expressed on the palate, where the wine's fresh and fruity taste is complemented by a well-balanced acidity that makes it a perfect companion for a variety of dishes.

With its light to medium body and smooth finish, Campagnola Pinot Grigio is an incredibly versatile wine that pairs well with many different foods, including seafood, salads, white meats, and vegetarian cuisine. It is also a delightful wine to enjoy on its own, whether as a refreshing aperitif or a perfect companion to a warm summer day.

title: Bottega Gold Rose Brut
bodyHtml:
Colour and Appearance - Brilliant, subtle pink colour, fine and persistent perlage.

Bouquet - Intense, elegant, complex, characterized by floral and fruity notes, mainly mixed berries, currants and wild strawberries.

Taste - Fresh, delicate, soft, structured, with balanced acidity and a pleasant and persistent aftertaste.

title: Mollydooker Cabernet Sauvignon Maitre D 2023
bodyHtml: The deep blend of red and purple colours and abundant aromas introduce the depth of this Cabernet. Rich and complex in flavour with notes of cherry and blackberry transition to green herbs, bramble and mocha all the while maintaining a dimension of sweet fruit. Soft and smooth on the palate, the Maitre D' balances flavour and structure perfectly.

title: Nonino Lo Chardonnay in Barriques Grappa
bodyHtml: Lightly amber after a maturation from 8 to 10 months in barriques, refined and elegant, it has a scent reminiscent of bread, vanilla and pastry. On the palate there are notes of chocolate and newly shelled almonds. The pomace, collected when it is fresh and soft, is selected from Chardonnay grapes.

title: Two Hands Cabernet Sauvignon Sexy Beast 2024
bodyHtml: Founded in 1999 by Michael Twelftree and Richard Mintz, Two Hands Wines has earned an international reputation for crafting bold, expressive wines that showcase regional diversity. Based in Barossa Valley but sourcing grapes from across Australia's premium regions, the winery’s philosophy revolves around minimal intervention and highlighting varietal and site character. ‘Sexy Beast’ is part of their Picture Series, known for its approachable yet high-quality offerings.

title: Massolino Barolo 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Garnet red color with variable intensity depending on the vintage. The grapes come from different vineyards and this gives them a broad and variable spectrum of perfumes, ranging from tempting spicy notes to those of a sweeter, floral and fruity nature. A variety of sensations, with a full-bodied, classic and well structured wine which ages well and perfectly represents the important character of their land.

It achieves its best expression when served with red meats, particularly game, and with dishes dressed with truffle. It is also excellent with fresh egg pasta and meat sauce, and with risotto, as well as medium-mature cow’s milk and goat’s milk cheeses.

title: Failla Chardonnay Sonoma Coast 2021
bodyHtml: This Sonoma Coast Chardonnay, with its spine of sappy brightness and crystalline salinity, displays all the dense, bright and savoury appeal of the Sonoma Coast in this singular vintage. At once more textural and more filigreed, this is a laser focused expression of coastal fruit with citrus, coastal bay and a mineral depth that carries the mid-palate to a refreshing finish.

title: Wayne Gretzky Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
This classic white wine originates from Canada, specifically the Niagara Peninsula region of Ontario. Established in 2017 through a partnership between hockey legend Wayne Gretzky and Andrew Peller Ltd., Wayne Gretzky Estates operates on a philosophy of hard work and excellence, aiming to create quality Canadian wines that consumers will enjoy repeatedly.

Wine Description

This Pinot Grigio is clear and bright, presenting a clean, fresh aroma profile of tangerine, white peach, melon, and white flowers. On the palate, this light to medium bodied wine offers juicy flavours of citrus—specifically Meyer lemon and tangerine—alongside peach and tropical fruit. The finish is refreshing and off dry, featuring lingering notes of apple, lime, and golden kiwi. Stylistically, the wine achieves a fine balance between fruity sweetness and juicy acidity, maintaining a crisp and smooth profile throughout.

title: Joseph Drouhin Pouilly Fuisse 2022 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: A seductive wine and a really nice expression of the Chardonnay grape! The colour is golden, with some green reflections. Among the floral and fruity aromas, almond and ripe grapes dominate. On the palate, the wine is refreshingly pleasant, ethereal in its lightness. Long and refreshing aftertaste.

title: Alta Vista Atemporal Red Blend 2020
bodyHtml: Atemporal means "without reference to time". Their French heritage inspires them to produce a blend with different varieties from the same origin: Malbec, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Petit Verdot from the Albaneve vineyard (Valle de Uco). Aged in French oak for 12 months, it presents aromas of red fruits, spicy notes, good structure and elegance.

title: Glenfarclas 25 Year Old
bodyHtml: From a long-time family-owned distillery, this 25-year-old single malt from Glenfarclas spent its days in 100% Oloroso sherry casks. It’s complex and delicately sherried, a whisky that’s sure not to disappoint. The price for a similar 25-year-old whisky is typically double or triple what this bottle costs making this an extraordinary value.

title: Graham's 10 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml: This has a zesty, sweet floral aroma, with delicate, well-spiced flavors of apple tart, flan and cocoa powder. The plush, mouthfilling finish of cream, vanilla and raspberry is fresh and balanced. Drink now.

title: Old Forester 1920
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
The Volstead Act of 1920 which initiated Prohibition in the USA granted permits to six distillers in Kentucky to continue to bottle bourbon for medicinal purposes. Through one of these permits, Old Forester continued to be produced as medicinal whiskey on Louisville's famed Whiskey Row. It is the only bourbon continuously sold by the same company that has been available for sale before, during and after Prohibition.

During this time, all whiskies had to be bottled at 100 Proof. With a barrel entry proof of 100, the "angel's share" would have created a 115-proof whiskey after maturation. To pay homage to this era, Old Forester presents 1920 Prohibition Style Bourbon at 115 proof to represent the rich flavour profile this bourbon had nearly 100 years ago.

title: Argento Malbec Reserva 2024
bodyHtml: Deep purple in colour with aromas of purple plum, black cherry, vanilla and spice. On the palate, it is dry, structured and full-bodied with flavours of blackberry and vanilla.

title: The Macallan 12 Year Old Sherry Oak
bodyHtml:
Every Macallan single malt reveals the unrivalled commitment to the mastery of wood and spirit for which The Macallan has been known since it was established in 1824. It is an expression of their enduring desire to go beyond ordinary, to seek out the extraordinary, and create peerless single malts.

Their reputation for the extraordinary is characterized by the exceptional oak casks for which The Macallan is renowned. Sourced, crafted, toasted and seasoned under the watchful eye of the Master of Wood, the hand-picked casks are delivered to the demanding specifications of the Whisky Mastery Team. It is the oak that makes the greatest contribution to the quality, natural colour and distinctive aromas and flavours at the heart of this single malt whisky.

When matured exclusively in Oloroso sherry seasoned oak casks from Jerez, Spain, their rich, fruity and full bodied ‘new make’ spirit is transformed into a classic single malt. Once filled, the maturing spirit remains undisturbed in the same casks for 12 years and is brought together in this rich and complex whisky characterized by spice and dried fruit and a natural rich golden colour.

title: Marcel Lapierre Morgon 2025
bodyHtml:
In the northern hills of Beaujolais lies the pastoral Villie-Morgan, one of the ten cru villages permitted to print its name on the bottle, and also considered home of one of the best wines in Beaujolais. An hour from Lyon, the second largest city in France, Villie-Morgan is a century away in atmosphere. It is also home to a group of groundbreaking and sometimes controversial winemakers known in the US as the Gang of Four.

This group, informally spearheaded by Marcel Lapierre, strives to make wines as naturally as possible, in the vineyard and in the winery. Lapierre's vines average 40 years of age, and his grapes are always picked at the latest possible moment in order to obtain the ripest possible fruit. No pesticides or chemicals are used in the vineyards and no sulphur or yeast is added during fermentation. The resulting wines are pure and fruity, not overly alcoholic, and always a pleasure to drink.

The Morgan has three flavors dominant: Cherry, licorice and violet.

title: Marquis De Villard VSOP Cognac
bodyHtml: Named for the charming wife of the original cellar master, Odette Villard, this brandy is an ode to the warmth she exuded. Fragrant with aromas of sweet cooked apple/pear, vanilla, and caramel with hints of spice. Rounded on the palate, with flavours of vanilla, baked fruit, and spice, replaying on the finish.

title: Wiser's Old Fashioned (Cocktail Whisky)
bodyHtml: Ready to drink, J.P.Wiser's Old Fashioned Whisky Cocktail is crafted from whisky, orange essence and natural flavours. It shows aromas and flavours of caramel, orange, cinnamon and cloves. The finish features a hint of rye. Pour it over ice and garnish with an orange twist, and voilà, an old-fashioned at your service.

title: Togouchi 15 Year Old Japanese Blended Whiskey - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Togouchi 15 Year Old is an elegant, well-aged blended expression produced by the Sakurao Brewery and Distillery. Continuing the brand's signature maturation style, this whisky is aged in the decommissioned railway tunnel in Akiota, where the temperature is a constant 14°C. At 15 years, the interaction between the spirit and the oak has become much more pronounced than in the younger expressions, resulting in a blend that showcases a sophisticated balance between the spicy malt components and the mellow, sweet grain whiskies.

Whisky Description

The whisky presents a deep golden color, reflecting its long rest in the cool mountain tunnel. On the nose, it is rich and complex, offering aromas of toasted nuts, dark chocolate, and a hint of dried yellow fruits like apricot and plum. The palate is velvety and full-bodied, delivering a deep sweetness of maltose and vanilla, quickly followed by the spicy warmth of white pepper and cinnamon. A refined, earthy peat smoke weaves through the background, providing a mature depth that lingers into the finish. The aftertaste is long and drying, with notes of spicy oak and a faint citrus zest. It is bottled at 43.8% ABV, a slightly higher proof that carries the aged flavors with more intensity.

title: Falasco Amarone Della Valpolicella 2016
bodyHtml: Run by Luca Degani since 1995, the Cantina di Valpantena is now one of Italy's best co-operatives, with 700 hectares of vineyard producing excellent quality fruit. A solid wine with a noted tannin structure that supports and accentuates the concentrated, dried-cherry and chocolate fruit character.

title: Unicum Zwack - 500 ml
bodyHtml: Unicum is made from a herbal liqueur made from a blend of more than 40 different herbs and spices. Some of the herbs and spices are distilled, some are macerated, then blended together and aged in oak casks at the factory in Budapest for over 6 months. This bitter, bold herbal liqueur (the same family as the Amari of Italy) is mainly consumed as an aperitif before meals or a digestif after meals.

title: Elderton Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
#97 Wine Spectator Top 100

Deep and layered with cassis, blackberry and dark chocolate, this acclaimed Barossa Cabernet is sourced from two distinct vineyard sites and aged 18 months in French oak.﻿

title: Darroze Les Grandes Assamblages 20 Year Old Armagnac
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

A full-bodied 20yo blended Bas Armagnac from Darroze, bottled as part of their Grands Assemblages range, this is showing real maturity and complexity after two decades of ageing, while still retaining impressive freshness and bite.

See More Armagnac

title: Gran Centenario Plata Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: Blended in oak to achieve a subtle wood note and an incredibly smooth taste that is unusual for a white tequila. The Plata contains fruit-forward notes of pear, lime, and citrus with a touch of black pepper.

title: Ardbeg Corryvreckan
bodyHtml: Powerfully peaty and immensely satisfying, Ardbeg's Corryvreckan is what happens when the distillery of Islay's Kildalton Coast aims to make a whisky with a particularly medicinal style than its usual expressions. Aptly named after a nearby whirlpool, Corryvreckan is an intense dram.

title: Berta Distellery - Elisi Grappa - 500 ml
bodyHtml: Clean, warming, and intense, the Elisi Grappa wafts with scents of chocolate-wrapped cherry, orchard fruits, caramel, toasted nuts and a kiss of spice. This Grappa feels silky and rich in the mouth, suffusing the palate with flavor notes, elegant alcohol, and just a touch of sweetness--it’s a finely balanced liqueur that caps a delicious dinner with deft balance and perfect heat. Crafting the non-vintage Elisi is a two-step process; first, Berta distills the component grape pomaces in copper pots and ages the component wines in oak, and then the distillery assembles a blend of 50% five-year-old Barbera grappa with 25% each eight-year-old Nebbiolo Grappa and three-year-old Cabernet Sauvignon Grappa; after the blend has been composed, the Elisi Grappa ages for a year in oak.

title: Talenti Rosso Di Montalcino 2023
bodyHtml: Made from 100% Sangiovese grapes coming from different vineyards located on the south-east/west side of Montalcino, at altitudes varying from 250 to 400 m MSL. The southeast soils are made up of sandy loam, with limestone plates and plenty of heavy stone. The wine ages for several months in French and Slavonian oak barrels, and in bottle.

title: Thibault Liger Belair Chambolle Musigny Premier Cru 'Les Gruenchers' 2013
bodyHtml: 92 Points,  Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - The 2013 Chambolle-Musigny 1er Cru les Gruenchers is the first vintage where Thibault has used 20% whole-cluster fruit. It has a precise, again, quite mineral-driven, tensile bouquet that is very expressive. The palate has a keen thread of acidity, citric and linear, a more streamlined Chambolle, perhaps less flamboyant than a typical Gruenchers, but with killer salinity on the finish. This has great potential.

title: Giffard Blueberry
bodyHtml: Powerful aroma of blueberry. Finely spiced notes. Very smooth mouth in attack, an aromatic body close to the sweet juice of ripe blueberries.

title: Vajra Dolcetto d'Alba 2025
bodyHtml:
G.D. Vajra is located in Piedmont, Italy, in the Barolo region’s highest village of Vergne. Founded in 1972 by Giuseppe Domenico Vajra and now run by his son Aldo along with his wife Milena and their children, the estate has been a pioneer in organic viticulture since 1971. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on precision and transparency, treating each vineyard parcel as a micro-garden to highlight the natural elegance and purity of the fruit.

Wine Description

The Vajra Dolcetto d'Alba is a 100% Dolcetto that displays a vibrant ruby-purple color. The nose opens with an expressive burst of blueberry, violets, and marasca cherries, layered with subtle hints of white pepper and fresh thyme. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and generous, featuring a juicy core of red berries and plums supported by fine, crunchy tannins and a refreshing acidity. The finish is elegant and persistent, marked by a characteristic touch of almond and sweet spice.

title: Ardbeg 10 Year Old
bodyHtml: For peat lovers, Ardbeg 10 Year Old is probably the highest-quality 'entry-level' single malt on the market and the distillery many Islay connoisseurs would choose as their favourite. A whirlwind of peat and complex malty flavours.

title: Domaine Drouhin Chardonnay 'Arthur' Dundee Hills 2023
bodyHtml: A fresh, floral nose of acacia and magnolia blends beautifully with almond note sand a hint of anise. Elegant and refined, the texture has density without weight.Flavors of pear, lychee and a touch of lemon custard present a complex,harmonious picture now, but the lively balance means you can easily cellar.

title: Quinta das Maias Tinto 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Portugal, specifically from the Dão region within the foothills of the Serra da Estrela mountain range. Established in 1893, Quinta das Maias is named after the 'Maias', the local name for the yellow Weaver's Broom plant that blankets the estate's slopes. The winery is under the same ownership as the renowned Quinta dos Roques and is led by winemaker Luis Lourenço, who is considered a pioneer in the Dão. The estate's philosophy focuses on capturing the distinct high-altitude terroir through minimal intervention and traditional winemaking practices.

Wine Description

Quinta das Maias Tinto displays a deep, brilliant ruby red colour. The nose is spicy and aromatic, offering an intense bouquet of black fruits such as blackberries, prunes, and cassis, layered with notes of violets, licorice, and vanilla derived from its time in oak. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and robust, featuring a supple texture and a dense core of blackcurrant and sloe flavours. It is characterized by its fresh acidity, elegant tannins, and a long, savoury finish that reflects the estate's granitic soils. This blend is typically composed of Jaen (known as Mencia in Spain), Touriga Nacional, Alfrocheiro, and Tinta Roriz. The ABV is approximately 13.0% to 13.5%. This wine is certified organic and is also vegan-friendly. The optimal drinking window is from release through the next 5 to 8 years.

title: Koch El Mezcal Artesanal de Oaxaca Espadin
bodyHtml: Koch Espadin has sweet, fruity tones and a light taste of coconut mixed with herbs and spices. It’s made with 100% farm-grown agave Espadin.

title: Rodney Strong Cabernet Sauvignon Alexander Valley 2021
bodyHtml: A robust Cabernet Sauvignon from the hillsides of Alexander Valley has aromas of lush, red plum and dark berries that dominate the glass, while hints of cassis and milk chocolate play in the background. The dried fig and chewy tannins give this wine a strong backbone, while the 18 months of barrel aging have softened this bold wine just enough to enjoy now or with a cheese and charcuterie board, filet mignon with grilled vegetables or a dark chocolate mousse.

title: Summerhill Pinot Gris 2023
bodyHtml:
The Cipes family converted their own vineyards to certified organic status shortly after acquiring the property, and the home vineyard in Kelowna was BC’s first Demeter-certified biodynamic vineyard in 2012. The winery's philosophy centres on organic and biodynamic practices, viewing their plots as 'vineyard ecosystems' to produce authentic, terroir-driven wines, which are famously finished in a replica of the Great Pyramid on site.

Wine Description

Textural and unique with refreshing notes of lemon verbena, green almond, lime zest and white flowers and a hint of savoury green olive on the finish. Pair this refreshing white wine with Mediterranean inspired chicken thighs, pan seared fish with fresh herbs, or garden salads. 

Food Pairing

Pairs well with lighter dishes like seafood salads.

title: Nikka Coffey Grain Japanese Whisky - 700 ml
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Nikka Coffey Grain originates from Japan and is primarily produced at the Miyagikyo Distillery in Sendai. The Nikka Whisky Distilling Company was founded in 1934 by Masataka Taketsuru, who is widely regarded as the 'father of Japanese whisky' after studying the craft in Scotland. Today, the brand is owned by Asahi Group Holdings and remains a cornerstone of the Japanese spirits industry.

Spirit Description

This whisky is distilled predominantly from corn using traditional Coffey stills, which were imported from Scotland in the 1960s to produce a rounder, more flavourful grain spirit. It features a bright golden hue and a medium body with a notably smooth, creamy texture. The aroma is fresh and enticing, offering notes of vanilla, coconut, and exotic fruits like mango and papaya, alongside a hint of citrus. On the palate, it is juicy and sweet, delivering flavours of caramel, toffee, and popcorn, balanced by subtle spices like cinnamon and clove. The finish is long and pleasant, characterized by lingering notes of pear, oak, and a touch of marmalade. It is bottled at 45% ABV.

Accolades

Nikka Coffey Grain has received widespread international acclaim for redefining the grain whisky category. It was named 'Japanese Grain Whiskey of the Year' at the 2020 World Whiskies Awards and consistently earns high ratings, including a 94.5% score in Jim Murray's Whisky Bible. It also secured a Gold Medal at the International Spirits Challenge in 2020.

Food Pairing

The sweet and fruity profile of this whisky makes it an excellent companion for a variety of cuisines. It pairs beautifully with Japanese dishes such as fresh sashimi or scallop tempura, where its creamy texture complements the seafood. For a savoury match, it stands up well to glazed pork belly or roast chicken with honey and sesame. It is also a superb choice for dessert, particularly when served alongside vanilla bean panna cotta, apple tart, or a light Japanese style cheesecake.

title: Submission Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Submission family of wines features a California Cabernet Sauvignon, Red Wine, Chardonnay and Rose cellared and bottled by 689 Cellars Napa Valley, California. They work with a family of growers throughout California selecting fruit from the finest growing regions. Every bottle of Submission highlights the amazing and diverse terroir that California has to offer.

You know those bottles that bring you to your knees? This is one of them. With a crushed velvet mouth feel, all polished on top and plush underneath, this wine draws you in with flavours of ripe mixed berries, cafe latte, smoked plum, milk chocolate, toasted tobacco and vanilla cream. Elegant yet slightly brooding, this wine is a steal. Experience Submission!

title: Aia Vecchia Vermentino Toscana 2025
bodyHtml:
In the glass, the wine is straw yellow with pale green hues. The bouquet is fresh with zesty aromas of freshly cut grass, grapefruit and hints of salt air. On the palate, the wine has a creamy and round mouthfeel with bright acidity accompanied by hints of limestone and a slight earthiness. The finish is lengthy, dry and refreshing.

Recommended as an aperitif or an accompaniment to fresh seafood, summer salads and poultry.

title: Warre's Otima 10 Year Old Tawny
bodyHtml:
General Information

Well-honed, with a touch of sweetness add to the plush flavours of butterscotch, pear tart, almond and vanilla. Orange peel and dried ginger accents emerge on the seductively spicy finish.

title: Torbreck Woodcutter's Shiraz 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'muscular' red wine originates from Australia, within the world-renowned Barossa Valley region of South Australia. Produced by Torbreck Vintners an iconic estate established in 1994 by David Powell and named after a forest in Scotland where he worked as a woodcutter this cuvée serves as the essential introduction to Torbreck’s world-class, Rhône-inspired winemaking portfolio. Sourced from dense, low-yielding Shiraz blocks across northern and central Barossa Valley sub-regions (including Marananga, Greenock, Ebenezer, and Seppeltsfield), the vines range from young plantings to historic old vines rooted in ironstone, red clay, and gravelly loam soils. The Barossa Valley’s warm Mediterranean climate brings intense solar radiation during the day, balanced by cool evening breezes descending from the Eden Valley, allowing Shiraz grapes to achieve complete phenolic maturity, rich skin concentration, and plush structural texture.

Wine Description

The Torbreck Woodcutter's Shiraz presents an opaque, deep garnet-purple color in the glass with vivid crimson and magenta highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and expressive portrait of classic Barossa Valley Shiraz. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe black plums, crème de cassis, and wild blackberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of dark chocolate, sweet liquorice, black pepper, cured meats, espresso bean, and a subtle line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, muscular, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of dark berry compote, blood orange peel, dark cocoa nibs, and savory spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly elevates its rich mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and linear, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of black pepper, iron, and subtle oak spice.

title: Tomatin 12 Year Old 'Bourbon & Sherry Casks'
bodyHtml: The Tomatin 12-Year-Old is classically smooth, having been matured in traditional Scotch Whisky, ex-Bourbon and ex-Spanish Sherry casks. Aromas of wild heather, pine and cedar soon sweeten to reveal notes of crème caramel with apples, pears and mango before a full-bodied and buttery finish, the 12-year-old is a distinguished sherry cask whisky with a little something different.

title: Neleman Chardonnay - Muscat 2020
bodyHtml:
The Chardonnay in this wine was late picked to achieve an advanced point of ripeness, the Muscat was harvested early to retain crisp acidity levels and subtle floral notes.

Fresh floral aromas on the nose follow through to the palate with notes of white peach and citrus. Well balanced with a fresh finish. Bottled with a helix cork which acts as a `cork screw cap`.

title: Castle Rock Petite Sirah 2019
bodyHtml: This fruity wine is deep purple in color with flavors of blueberries and ripe cherries, with moderate tannins and a long harmonious finish.  Makes an excellent accompaniment to beef, game, spicy grilled foods, or charbroiled meats.

title: KWV The Vinecrafter Chenin Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: This lively and fresh Chenin Blanc shows prominent aromas of apple, limes and guava with underlying hints of tropical and floral characters. On the palate, the wine is juicy, round and flavourful with a viscous and lingering finish.

title: Eric Texier Adele Blanc
bodyHtml: This wine is named after a French fantasy film, The Extraordinary Adventures of Adele Blanc-Sec. The white wine is predominately made with Clairette from the Saint-Julien area in the Ardeche on the west side of the Rhone River. Wonderful fall/winter white wine with a bit of weight on the palate and rich fruits while still maintaining freshness.

title: Frias Family Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml: In 1977, the Frias Family purchased 100 acres in the iconic Spring Mountain District of Napa Valley.  They planted just 5 acres in 1985 and launched FRIAS Family Vineyard with their first vintage in 1987.  FRIAS now has 13 acres of hillside vineyards planted to Cabernet Sauvignon.  They source premium fruit from Oakville & Yountville AVAs.  Second generation brothers Fernando and Manny Frias Jr. are at the helm of this artisanal family winery. Todd Heth has been their winemaker since 2004.

title: Sauza Tres Generaciones Plata Tequila
bodyHtml: Our Plata Tequila is an un-aged, crystal clear tequila made from 100% blue agave. It is triple-distilled, giving it a unique, pure agave taste and smoothness. Aromas of mild fleshy agave with hints of citrus and sweet floral notes. Initial spiciness on a background of herbs and fresh agave. It is exceptionally well balanced with no bite or burn on the palate. Lingering white pepper, finishing clean and cool.
