title: Mount Veeder Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Mount Veeder Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 is a red wine from the United States, produced in the Napa Valley appellation of California. The winery is a champion of mountain viticulture, drawing fruit from its estate vineyards rooted deep in the Mayacamas Mountains, specifically the Mount Veeder AVA (American Viticultural Area). Winemaking on Mount Veeder dates back to the 1860s, with the modern era beginning when Michael and Arlene Bernstein first planted vines in 1965. They were among the first in California to plant all five classic Bordeaux varieties, and their 1973 Cabernet Sauvignon was the first wine to bear the Mount Veeder designation. The winery's philosophy is to craft wines that express the exceptional quality, character, and spirit of the storied mountain, with a dedication to reflecting the wild beating heart of the rugged appellation.

Wine Description

The wine has a deep, dark magenta hue. The aromatic profile is expressive, offering notes of baking spices, cedar, fig, and black cherry. It also features robust, deeply scented aromas of mulberries, blackcurrants, pine needles, and spices. Critics also note earthy aromas of bay laurel, forest loam, and a hint of wild blackberry.

The blend is 82% Cabernet Sauvignon and 18% Merlot for the Napa Valley bottling, though the exact percentage varies slightly by label, with some blends being 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. A significant portion of Merlot is included in the 2022 vintage, which adds freshness, bright red fruit notes, and a plush texture. The wine is full-bodied. The palate is soft yet structured, with brooding red fruit flavours that are concentrated and pure. It features plush, firmly integrated tannins and moderate to bright acidity, giving notes of mocha, dark cherries, tapenade, and dried herbs. The aging process for this cuvée involves 19 months in oak, with 42% new French oak, 21% new American oak, and 37% used French oak. Stylistically, it is balanced, pure, and layered, conveying tons of Mount Veeder character in its red-toned fruit and earthy notes. The finish is long, lingering with notes of black tea and bramble. The ABV is 14.6%. The wine is structured and built for extended ageing, with a potential to see its 20th birthday in fine form.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 93 points

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs excellently with robust dishes such as grilled ribeye steak, braised short ribs, or a hearty mushroom risotto. The wine's depth and character are highlighted when accompanied by rich, savoury flavours.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage was marked by a challenging, prolonged heat wave around Labour Day, which accelerated harvest at many sites. However, this was immediately followed by much cooler weather and a bit of rain. This refreshing slow-down allowed the remaining grapes to hang longer, yielding beautifully balanced fruit and polished tannins. The overall vintage is described as having fresh, pure, and concentrated flavours. The winemakers adapted to the challenging vintage, resulting in expressive aromatics, generous fruit, and soft tannins that are enjoyable upon release.

title: Appleton Estate 15 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml: The 15 Year Old Black River Casks is Appleton Estate's premium expression of aged rum. Created by Master Blender Joy Spence, a luminary in the spirits world who celebrates her 40th anniversary this year at the distillery, Appleton Estate 15 Year Old Black River Casks reveals aromas of toasted almond and delicate hazelnut followed by notes of intense orange peel, rich vanilla and subtle hints of medium roasted coffee and molasses. This expression presents a coppery hue with a honey gold ring of age, ending with a creamy lingering finish.

title: Il Pino Di Biserno 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'authoritative' red wine originates from Italy, within the prestigious Toscana I.G.T. designation of the upper Maremma region, bordering Bolgheri. Il Pino di Biserno serves as the iconic second wine of Tenuta di Biserno, an elite estate established in 2001 by Marchese Lodovico Antinori—the legendary founder of Ornellaia and Masseto. The property operates under a winemaking philosophy that marries New World precision with coastal Tuscan identity, executing a site-specific viticultural strategy overseen by master consultant Michel Rolland. The mature vines are rooted in a complex terroir matrix of silt, alluvial clay, and Bolgheri conglomerate gravels, where the maritime breezes of the Tyrrhenian Sea naturally moderate summer temperatures to lock in remarkable varietal complexity.

Wine Description

Il Pino di Biserno presents a deep, opaque ruby-purple appearance with bright violet reflections shimmering at the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally complex, rich, and extroverted, opening with a pronounced bouquet of dark black cherries, crème de cassis, and wild blackberries, beautifully layered with fragrant notes of Mediterranean scrub (macchia), freshly roasted espresso beans, dark cacao, and a distinct crack of black pepper. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, dense, and seamlessly layered, showcasing a voluptuous core of dark plum preserves and wild mountain berries. It is characterized by its outstanding, vibrant backbone of mineral acidity that perfectly lifts the rich fruit extraction. The mouthfeel is muscular yet beautifully polished, driven by fine-grained, velvety tannins that glide into a lengthy finish highlighted by lingering notes of graphite, cedarwood, and smoky tobacco leaf.

title: The Macallan 18 Year Old Double Cask
bodyHtml:
The Macallan Double Cask 18 Years Old, a perfectly balanced single malt whisky matured for 18 years in both American and European sherry seasoned oak casks. Sherry seasoned American oak adds delicate vanilla to the subtle spice of European oak, delivering a whisky with a sweeter, warmer taste and character. 43% alc./vol.

For more information visit The Macallan Website.

title: Fontanafredda Raimonda Barbera d'Alba 2023
bodyHtml:
Fontanafredda Raimonda Barbera d'Alba originates from Italy, specifically from the Piedmont region within the Barbera d'Alba DOC. The estate's history is deeply intertwined with Italian royalty, having been established in 1858 by Vittorio Emanuele II, the first King of Italy, as a gift for his beloved 'Bela Rosin'. The winery's philosophy emphasizes the preservation of biodiversity and traditional Piedmontese heritage, managing over 120 hectares of certified organic vineyards. The Raimonda cuvée is sourced from vineyards located in the hills of the Langhe, characterized by marl, clay, and sand soils that provide a distinct structural elegance to the Barbera grape.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep ruby red colour that evolves into garnet with age. The sensory profile is intense and characteristic, featuring a floral and fruity nose of blackberries, plums, and cherries, accented by subtle spicy notes of cinnamon and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and robust, delivering a dry, savory flavour with a refreshing acidity that balances its rich fruit core. The finish is persistent and harmonious, reflecting the wine's well integrated structure.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Barbera.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is aged for approximately 12 months, with a portion matured in French oak barriques and the remainder in large Slavonian oak casks to achieve a balance between fruit freshness and spice complexity.

  • ABV: 14%.

  • Organic Status: Produced by a winery committed to organic viticulture; Fontanafredda has been the largest certified organic estate in Piedmont since 2018.

title: Domaine des Perdrix Nuits Saint Georges 2023
bodyHtml:
Domaine des Perdrix Nuits Saint Georges originates from the prestigious Burgundy region of France, specifically from the northern edge of the Nuits Saint Georges appellation. Owned by the Devillard family since 1996, the estate has quickly risen to prominence through rigorous vineyard management and a philosophy that emphasizes the unique expression of each terroir. The winery is particularly noted for its high-quality holdings, including nearly the entirety of the 'Aux Perdrix' Premier Cru, and is recognized as one of the best producers of 'Grands Vins de Bourgogne'.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir presents a bright ruby-red colour that is both shiny and pure. The nose is intense and complex, revealing earthy characteristics typical of the terroir alongside aromas of black cherry, blueberry, and blackcurrant, accented by subtle leather and fresh ginger spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and velvety, showing a frank and ample attack that leads into a midpalate of refined, silky tannins. Its structure is rich yet well-integrated, balanced by a lively, taut freshness that carries through to a long, fruity finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 94 points

Food Pairing

This Nuits Saint Georges is an excellent accompaniment to rich, savory dishes such as beef bourguignon, lamb tagine with candied lemons, or roast leg of lamb. For a more delicate pairing, it also complements truffle scrambled eggs or a fine spinach gratin with almonds.

title: Jack Daniel's Sinatra Select - 1 Litre
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Jack Daniel's Sinatra Select has been created in honour of this friendship with Old Blue Eyes. The bold, smooth qualities of the Sinatra Select come from the specially made Sinatra barrels in which part of the whiskey was aged. Deep grooves were cut into the staves of the casks, increasing the amount of exposure the whiskey had to the wood. It is then married with Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 and bottled at 45% abv, which is how Sinatra would have enjoyed it back in the day.

See More USA Whisky

title: Stroppiana Dolcetto D'Alba 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Sappioana's Dolcetto d'Alba is an intense ruby ​​red with violet reflections.  The nose holds fresh, fragrant, fruity notes, with hints of cherry, strawberry, and raspberry.  The palate is full, dry, harmonious in the alcohol, acidic and tannic components, a pleasantly soft and persistent finish with a pleasant aftertaste.

Pairs well with seasoned cheeses, dishes such as Taglierini with livers, Agnolotti al plin, rabbit, and feathered game.

title: Toshimori Shuzo Sakehitosuji Jungin Black Junmai Ginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Toshimori Shuzo Sakehitosuji Jungin Black originates from Akaiwa City in the Okayama Prefecture of Japan. Toshimori Shuzo, founded in 1868, is a highly respected brewery famous for its role in reviving the legendary Akaiwa Omachi rice variety, which had nearly gone extinct. The brewery is deeply committed to traditional methods and local agriculture, cultivating their own rice to ensure the highest quality for their "Sakehitosuji" (meaning "Only Sake") brand.

Description

The "Jungin Black" is a modern, high-polish expression of the Omachi grain, which is known for producing deeper, more complex, and earthier sake compared to the more common Yamada Nishiki rice.

  • Aroma: It presents a sophisticated and mellow nose with notes of ripe melon, steamed rice, and a characteristic Omachi earthiness.

  • Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a signature velvety texture. It offers a rich umami core with flavors of white peach and a soft herbal undertone, balanced by a clean, refreshing acidity.

  • Technical Profile: This Junmai Ginjo is brewed with 100% Akaiwa Omachi rice polished to 55%. It typically has an alcohol content of 15.5% and is designed to showcase the "robust elegance" that Omachi fans crave.

Food Pairing

Because Omachi sake is naturally richer and more savory, it can handle bolder flavors that might overwhelm a lighter Niigata-style sake.

  • Grilled & Savoury: Pairs beautifully with grilled pork belly (yakitori), miso-glazed cod (gindara), or roasted root vegetables.

  • Rich Seafood: The umami profile is an excellent match for uni (sea urchin), buttery lobster, or seared scallops with a touch of soy sauce.

  • Western Cuisine: Its earthy depth makes it a surprising but successful companion for mushroom risotto, herb-crusted lamb, or aged hard cheeses like Manchego.

  • Serving Temperature: This sake is incredibly versatile. While delicious chilled (10°C) to highlight the melon notes, it truly shines at room temperature (20°C) or even slightly warmed, which allows the rice-forward umami and velvety texture to fully expand.

title: Terrunyo Block 27 Carmenere 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced by Concha y Toro under the guidance of visionary winemaker Ignacio Recabarren, Terrunyo (derived from the Spanish word terruño, meaning terroir) represents a watershed moment in South American viticulture. The Terrunyo line was created to isolate and highlight single vineyard blocks capable of expressing pure varietal character and world-class quality.

The Terrunyo Carmenère from Block 27 of the historic Peumo Vineyard is widely recognized as the benchmark expression of Carmenère globally. It was this specific plot in the Cachapoal Valley that proved Carmenère—long misidentified in Chile as Merlot—was not only distinct, but capable of producing profound, age-worthy wines that rival the finest Bordeaux varietals.

Wine Description

The Terrunyo Peumo Vineyard Carmenère pours a deep, opaque violet-plum color. On the nose, it offers an expressive and complex bouquet of ripe black plum, dark chocolate, sweet spice, and tobacco leaf, beautifully integrated with subtle savory green pepper, crushed graphite, and cedar notes.

On the palate, the wine is rich, plush, and voluptuously textured, yet kept impeccably balanced by vibrant acidity and fine-grained, velvety tannins. Flavors of blackberry jam, fig, and dark cherry fold into nuances of espresso, mocha, black pepper, and dried herbs.

Food Pairing

The luxurious texture and herbal-spicy complexity of this Carmenère make it a brilliant match for rich, savory, and spice-infused dishes. Excellent pairings include slow-braised short ribs, grilled lamb chops with rosemary, roasted duck breast, or Chilean empanadas de pino. It also handles roasted venison, pork tenderloin with a plum reduction, and dishes featuring caramelized onions, roasted bell peppers, or aged cheeses like Gouda and Manchego.

title: Reserva del Senor Premium Almendrado Tequila
bodyHtml: Reserva del Senor Premium Almendrado is elaborated through a careful distillation process in dedicated stainless steel tanks using a seven-month-old Reposado Tequila. Select natural almond flavouring is added during the second distillation, thus creating a desirable aroma and flavour profile. With the second distillation, these aromas and flavours are refined to obtain the unique quality of Reserva del Senor Premium Almendrado. This unique process creates a delicate, pleasant blend of essence that results in a well-balanced and palatable product. Many have tried to copy Reserva del Senor Premium Almendrado, but none have come close.

title: Duckhorn Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
This white wine originates from the United States, specifically the North Coast region of California, which includes sources like Napa Valley, Sonoma County, Lake County, and Mendocino County. Duckhorn Vineyards was co-founded in 1976 by Dan and Margaret Duckhorn in St. Helena, Napa Valley, and quickly established itself as a premier producer of Bordeaux varietal wines. The winery is recognized as one of the first 40 Napa Valley wineries and is known for its commitment to quality, its pioneering role in elevating American Merlot, and its philosophy of crafting elegant, site-driven wines, adding Sauvignon Blanc to its portfolio in 1982.

Wine Description

Sauvignon Blanc is a crisp and expressive wine. From the first swirl, it captivates with aromas of candied pineapple and guava, layered with a delicate flourish of key lime blossom. On the palate, vibrant notes of fresh melon take centre stage, balanced by a lively acidity that lends energy and precision. The texture is silky, and it carries the wine to a focused finish with a hint of minerality and finesse.

title: Ken Wright Pinot Noir McCrone 2024
bodyHtml:
Ken Wright Pinot Noir McCrone 2024 originates from the United States, within Oregon's Willamette Valley region and the Yamhill Carlton AVA subregion. Founded in 1994 by winemaking pioneer Ken Wright, the winery focuses on single vineyard bottlings that highlight the distinct soil profiles across northern Oregon. McCrone Vineyard, planted on ancient marine sedimentary soils (Willakenzie series), sits right adjacent to the famous Shea Vineyard and is celebrated for producing Pinot Noir with remarkable structural power, dark fruit intensity, and savory floral complexity.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a translucent, deep ruby colour with garnet reflections. The nose is open and complex, delivering lifted aromas of black cherry, dark plum, and marionberry alongside notes of violet flowers, forest floor, black tea, and warming sweet baking spices. On the palate, it exhibits a medium to full body with a plush, velvety texture, supported by fine grained, firm tannins and balancing, lively acidity. Stylistically, the wine combines dark fruit depth with distinct marine soil minerality, finishing with exceptional length and lingering notes of spice and dark berry compote.

  • Varietal composition: 100% Pinot Noir

  • Alcohol by volume: 13.5%

title: Nicolas Feuillatte Reserve Exclusive Brut
bodyHtml: This iconic Champagne is from France, specifically the Champagne AOC region. The house of Nicolas Feuillatte is a unique and inspiring story born from the 1986 partnership between the audacious businessman Nicolas Feuillatte and the Centre Vinicole de la Champagne, a major cooperative founded by Henri Macquart. Today, it is the youngest of the great Champagne Houses and the top-selling brand in France, representing a massive collective of over 4,500 winegrowers and more than 80 cooperatives. The house philosophy focuses on a 'mosaic of soils,' drawing grapes from across the entire appellation to create a consistent, vibrant style that celebrates the diversity of the region.

title: Mount Gay XO Rum Triple Cask Blend
bodyHtml: Beautiful, round, and complex. This extra old, small batch reserve rum is blended carefully from selected mature rums. Aged in American whiskey, bourbon, and cognac casks, you'll notice a perfect balance of vanilla, oaky, and dried spice notes on the nose. Tasting salted caramel, baked fig and cloves, and dark chocolate on the palate. Ending with a round, smooth, creamy richness with a lasting finish.

title: Pierre Gimonnet & Fils Brut Cuis Premier Cru
bodyHtml: Offering up aromas of citrus oil, fresh peach, clear honey, white flowers and oyster shell, it's medium to full-bodied, pillowy and elegantly fleshy, with crisp acids, elegant mousse and chalky back-end grip.

title: Domaine de la Vougeraie Pinot Noir Terres De Famille 2023
bodyHtml: Dark colour. Very redcurrant and raspberry nose. Elegant tannins coupled with persistent fruit and acidity. Lovely wine.

title: Garnier & Fils Chablis 'Mont de Milieu' Premier Cru 2021
bodyHtml: Subtle notes of pollen exude from a vanilla perfume. Its fatty attack leads to a core of fleshy yellow fruit. Straightforward and saline, this wine is the epitome of its terroir and will be for a long time.

title: Grizzly Paw Beavertail Raspberry Ale - 20 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Beavertail Raspberry Ale is one of the most famous fruit beers in Western Canada and a legendary staple of Canmore’s Grizzly Paw Brewing Company. For nearly three decades, this beer has been a "must-try" for visitors to the Rockies. It is designed to be a fruit-forward crowd-pleaser that balances the sweetness of an ale with the natural tartness of real berries. While many fruit beers can feel syrupy or artificial, Beavertail is celebrated for its authentic fruit profile and its vibrant, "summer-in-a-glass" personality.

Beer Description

Beavertail pours a striking, slightly hazy reddish-pink reminiscent of a pale rosé with a fizzy, light-pink head that recedes quickly.

Aroma: The nose is an absolute bouquet of fresh-picked raspberries. It is incredibly aromatic, smelling like a basket of sun-ripened berries with a subtle, underlying sweetness of honey and biscuit malt. It smells fresh and "jammy" without being overly sugary.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a lively, "prickly" carbonation. It leads with a burst of natural raspberry juice, followed by a soft, bready malt middle. The finish is remarkably balanced; the natural acidity of the raspberries provides a clean, slightly tart "snap" that prevents the beer from being cloying.

Profile: It sits at a sessionable 5.0% ABV and a very low bitterness of 10 IBU, ensuring the fruit remains the undisputed star.

Technical Notes: The beer starts as a clean, well-balanced Wheat Ale base, which provides a soft, slightly creamy mouthfeel. Grizzly Paw then adds a massive amount of pure raspberry purée during the fermentation process. Using a wheat base is a classic choice for fruit beers, as the proteins in the wheat help carry the fruit flavors and provide a stable structure for the berry aromatics.

title: Cantina del Pino Barbaresco 'Ovello' 2019
bodyHtml: Violet, star anise, woodland berry and camphor aromas lead the way on this elegant, firm red. The savoury, linear palate delivers juicy Marasca cherry, pomegranate, licorice and orange zest while taut, fine-grained tannins provide support. It's focused and balanced, with fresh acidity.

title: Whatchamacallit Red 2021
bodyHtml: Whatchamacallit Red Blend Wine is a product of some of the finest grapes in the region of United States is the epitome of tradition and quality. With a juicy yet dry finish, this wine is a favorite among most. The wine has a fresh, clean fragrance and leaves the palate a very balanced well-rounded flavor. This wine is well-structured and sophisticated, a perfect choice for entertaining as well as a quiet evening at home.

title: Siddiqui Brown Rum
bodyHtml: Siddiqui Brown Rum is a spirit that sips like a whisky and parties like a rum and tastes like no other spirit. It has a distinctive whisky-like smoky and oaky note, but it is rounded with a short finish as you'd expect from a quality rum. Matured in American oak casks to create notes of caramel, oaky spice, and soft smoke throughout the palate.

title: Matusalem Gran Reserva 23 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml: Matusalem 23 Gran Reserva Rum is aged in a traditional solera system. Produced in the Dominican Republic, the company’s history goes back to 1872. A rich and toasty rum that’s perfect for sipping by the fire on a cold evening.

title: Penderyn Myth Whisky
bodyHtml: Myth is the sister whisky to Legend from Wales' Penderyn. Aged entirely in ex-bourbon casks, this is full of dried fruit and sweet flavours.

title: Penderyn Madeira Finish Whisky
bodyHtml: Penderyn is a Welsh whisky distilled once in a unique Faraday copper still with an added purifier and rectification column. A spell in bourbon barrels and it is finished in Madeira casks for extra smoothness. Launched in 2004, Penderyn has built on its early promise and carved a niche.

title: El Tesoro Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: This Blanco tequila is unaged and bottled immediately after distillation to capture the essence of our highland blue weber agave. Giving it a crystal clear appearance. The minerality of our soil and water shines through in this traditional, agave-forward tequila. The aroma is fresh agave mixed with honey and a touch of green olive. You can taste the balanced flavor of agave with white pepper and subtle green notes. The finish is sweet with hints of pepper.

title: Sandhill Syrah 'Small Lots' 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Sandhill Syrah 'Small Lots' originates from Canada, specifically within the British Columbia region and the Okanagan Valley subregion. The winery follows a philosophy that great wine starts in the vineyard, utilizing a 'light hand' in winemaking to allow the natural fruit flavours and terroir to shine. The Small Lots Program is an ever-evolving initiative that identifies distinctive barrels, experimental vineyard blocks, or innovative techniques—such as yield reduction and hand pruning—to showcase wines with exceptional character.

Wine Description

This full-bodied red wine presents a striking deep purple-black or deep garnet colour. The sensory profile features a complex and ever-changing bouquet of baked blue plum, black cherry, and cassis, interwoven with notes of violet, charred oak, vanilla extract, and earthy forest floor. On the palate, it is rich and juicy, delivering concentrated flavours of dark fruits and dark chocolate supported by firm, drying tannins and a great structure. The finish is long and warming, with lingering nuances of black tea, cocoa powder, spice, and leather.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Syrah.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes undergo a warm fermentation with daily pump-overs to achieve deep colour extraction, followed by full malolactic fermentation to round out the mouthfeel; the wine is typically aged for 14 months in a combination of American (60%) and French (40%) oak barrels.

  • ABV: Recorded between 13% and 14.7% depending on the vintage.

  • Organic Status: While the winery emphasizes natural fruit expression and precise vineyard management, this specific program is not typically certified organic.

title: Zenato Ripassa 2021
bodyHtml:
The Zenato winery is linked to the richness of its local history and culture and continues to develop this connection today. The estate is based in a territory that surrounds Lake Garda, with an extraordinary microclimate that allows for an optimal growing season. Cherishing a ‘frank and simple’ approach to life, Zenato is committed to producing affordable wine of exceptional quality.

Ripassa wines are fondly referred to as "baby Amarone" by some. Zenato's baby is bigger and richer than most, with intense flavours of blackberry jam, cocoa, dried fig, espresso, blueberries and raisins. Pair it with risotto with gorgonzola or grilled meats and grilled vegetables.

title: Telmo Rodriguez Al-Muvedre Monastrell 2022
bodyHtml:
Telmo Rodriguez is a collaboration between long-time friends Telmo Rodrguez and Pablo Eguzkiza. They have worked relentlessly for the past 30 years to promote Spain's varied regions, with a concentration on historic vineyards and indigenous varietals. Despite the fact that they work with a huge number of sites, they make it a point to manufacture each parcel to the greatest possible standard. 

Monastrell (also known as Mourvedre or Mataro) is grown along Spain's east coast, south of Catalua. The wine is made from bush vines growing in sandy loam soil at high altitudes.  Al-muvedre is a monovarietal wine from Monastrell, which represents the spirit of the Mediterranean, this more southern and luminous expression which Monastrell manages to offer in a unique way.

Al-Muvedre has a fine and polished nose - floral, figgy, and gently meaty, it’s a delicate and perfectly varietal expression of Monastrell. Soft, wide tannins start the mouth off and a long roll of ripe acid in the back half really straightens things out. Almuvedre has long been one of the bargain wines of the world and the style-quality-value amalgam continues to boggle the mind.

title: Siempre Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
General Information

This award-winning distillery ages this reposado for 6 months in American oak whiskey barrels. Taste alluring notes of oak, fruity undertones, honey, and vanilla underpinned by cooked agave. On the palate, there is a smooth harmony not unlike what shows in some very fine bourbons.

title: Fontanafredda Barolo 2022
bodyHtml:
The results of lengthy ageing, above all on account of their natural qualities, these robust, well-bodied wines are packed with structure and are well capable of withstanding the test of time. Barolo has an attractive ruby-red colour with garnet highlights which become orange with the passing of time. Its bouquet is clean, full and intense, with the wine’s typical traces of withered flowers, dry leaves and underbrush.

Ideal with rich red meats, varying according to the wine and vintage, and medium and mature cheeses, they are also perfect after-dinner wines.

title: Astral de Chateau Puybarbe 2020
bodyHtml:
Château Puybarbe is located in the Côtes de Bourg appellation of Bordeaux, France, perched at the highest elevation overlooking the Gironde estuary on the right bank. The 41-hectare vineyard, primarily planted with Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, is managed by owners Anna and Riku Väänänen. Committed to sustainable viticulture, the estate is Biocyclic Vegan certified and in the final stages of organic conversion, avoiding herbicides and chemical fertilizers.

Wine Description

The Astral de Château Puybarbe 2020 is a Bordeaux-style red blend, predominantly Merlot with 20% Cabernet Sauvignon. This young wine presents dark fruit and tobacco aromas, complemented by rich blackcurrant flavors. On the palate, it is full-bodied with abundant fruit, balanced acidity, and grippy tannins. The finish is rich and juicy, indicative of its aging potential.

title: Quarisa Caravan Petite Sirah 2022
bodyHtml: This wine is deep, dense, dark red with dark purple hues. It is a full bodied, generous wine showing fresh and lively ripe dark plum and dark berry fruits, with hints of spice, herb and chocolate and clear notes of toasted oak. Great smooth and soft tannins.

title: Mansion House Bay Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced by Whitehaven Wine Company in New Zealand, this wine is sourced from the prestigious Marlborough region, specifically utilizing fruit from the Wairau Valley, Awatere Valley, and Southern Valleys. The Mansion House Bay range is deeply personal to co-founders Greg and Sue White, named after the historic property on Kawau Island where Greg proposed. Whitehaven is dedicated to crafting wines with 'honesty and integrity' that reflect the distinct subregional diversity of Marlborough.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc presents a vibrant, light straw appearance with a subtle green hue. The bouquet is lifted and expressive, featuring aromas of stone fruit, grapefruit, and green plums, complemented by delicate herbal notes and hints of tropical guava. On the palate, the wine is zesty and medium bodied, displaying excellent fruit purity and a juicy core of citrus and melon. Its structure is defined by a refreshing, crisp acidity that carries the tropical flavours through to a long, clean finish.

Food Pairing

The wine's bright acidity and herbaceous profile make it an exceptional partner for sustainably sourced seafood, such as grilled sea bass with citrus butter or fresh oysters with a mignonette sauce. It also pairs naturally with tangy goat cheese, vibrant summer salads featuring fennel and basil, or light poultry dishes seasoned with rosemary.

title: Shot in the Dark Shiraz - Petite Sirah 2019
bodyHtml: Shot in the Dark Shiraz - Petite Sirah is a big friendly red from Oz that dials down the acidity and revs up the rich, smoky, ripe fruit flavours. This silky smooth wine has long been a favourite with the Advantage Faithful and comes very highly recommended.

title: Skrewball Peanut Butter Whiskey
bodyHtml:
General Information

On one side, you have good ol’ whiskey, a bold, loud and strong partner-in-crime who exudes confidence. On the other, you have peanut butter, a rich, smooth and irresistible spread that’s as dependable as they come for all your late night cravings. Little did you know, these two blend together quite phenomenally.  In fact, they go together so well, they make PB&J jealous. But we have to warn you, a night with Skrewball is bound to get a little nutty.

title: Pasote Blanco Tequila
vendor: 300840 - Top Of My Glass Holdings Inc.
bodyHtml: Utterly clean and clear, with an exquisitely soft mouthfeel, the first impression of this beautifully balanced agave tequila is that you’re drinking liquid light. Crisp, zesty citrus dominates the foreground, unfolding mid-palate to pure succulent blue agave. A surprisingly long finish that’s decidedly clean. The distinctive agave taste deliciously lingers on, flecked with hints of white pepper.

title: Pasote Reposado Tequila
vendor: 300840 - Top Of My Glass Holdings Inc.
bodyHtml: The use of natural spring and pure rainwater results in a herbal and flavourful reposado that is delicately balanced with notes of ripe coconut and sweet American oak. On the palate it is fruit-forward with citrus and tropical notes mingling with florals and intriguing on the finish. This is a tequila for sipping solo.

title: Paul John Nirvana Unpeated Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml: A fruity, lively unpeated single malt from Indian distillery Paul John. Aromas of fruitcake, honeycomb, and caramel fill the nose, and the palate offers notes of apricots, raisins, honey, apples, and salted caramel.

title: Carmen Syrah Gran Reserva 2024
bodyHtml: A highly expressive wine with layers of violets, spices, exotic mocha, stewed plums and earthy currant. The fine-grained tannins are smooth and penetrating, and the wine is vibrant from start to finish.

title: Trimbach Riesling 'Cuvee Frederic Emile' 2019
Vajra Langhe Rosso 2024
bodyHtml:
The Langhe Rosso is a hug from Piedmont. It’s an invitation to explore its different varieties and to get to know its personality. From young vineyards, it is a fruity delicately complex wine: an ideal companion at the table. Predominately Nebbiolo, Barbera, and Dolcetto and smaller quantities of Freisa, Albarossa, Pinot noir. Each vineyard is harvested when it reaches the perfect ripeness. The varieties are vinified one by one, to express their personality and uniqueness.

Red colour with violet hues refers to the sweetness of dark fruit with refined elegance. Intense and rich on the nose, it is both concentrated and harmonious: flowers and fruits give way to hay, tobacco, spices. Bright summer berries on the palate with graphite veins lead to the discovery of a series of sensations.

title: Penderyn Rhiannon
bodyHtml:
Rhiannon is the 7th chapter in Penderyn's Icons of Wales Series. Finished in sherry wood, the whisky is named after Rhiannon, an enchantress and horse goddess who could outrun any pursuer while riding slowly. Rhiannon in Welsh means 'Great Queen' or 'Divine Queen.'

On the nose, soft notes of raspberries and strawberry liqueur, as well as some melted butter, cassis, and candy canes. Hints of peanut skins and pastries. Needless to say, it is very sweet. The taste has more sweetness on arrival and is pretty much a continuation of the nose. Plenty of berries, but also some caramel sweetness. The wood has also infused some spiciness. The finish has a lingering sweetness and is somewhat drying.

title: Glendalough Pot Still Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml: Aged in ex-bourbon barrels for 3 years then finished in, sustainably harvested virgin Irish oak casks. Shows aromas and flavors of creamy vanilla, banana custard, spice and herb, with cinnamon, maple, citrus and charry oak tones. The palate is smooth and creamy with a spicy, warm lingering finish.

title: Remy Martin XO Cognac - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Rémy Martin XO is a Fine Champagne Cognac, meticulously crafted by blending up to 400 eaux-de-vie sourced predominantly from the Grande Champagne (85%) and Petite Champagne (15%) crus. This exceptional blend embodies the Cellar Master's artistry, resulting in a Cognac renowned for its aromatic complexity and opulent character.

Tasting Notes:

  • Aroma: A rich spectrum of late summer fruits, such as ripe plums and candied oranges, complemented by floral notes of jasmine and hints of hazelnuts and cinnamon.

  • Palate: An opulent progression of flavors, including ripe plum, candied orange, spices, and hazelnuts, leading to gourmet notes of roasted cocoa beans and honeyed gingerbread.

  • Finish: Smooth, full-bodied, and long-lasting, leaving a harmonious and enduring impression.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Neat: Enjoy at room temperature to fully appreciate its aromatic richness and depth.

  • On the Rocks: Serving over ice enhances its smoothness and reveals additional layers of flavor.

  • Cocktails: While traditionally savored neat, Rémy Martin XO can elevate classic cocktails, adding depth and complexity.

title: The Macallan 15 Year Old Double Cask
bodyHtml: The union of the two worlds of Sherry-seasoned oak, American and European, creates an extraordinary fusion of toffee and subtle spice. The Macallan Double Cask 15 Years Old features delicate flavours of honey and vanilla in exquisite balance with baked apple, sweet raisin, and rich oak spice.

title: Zuccardi Tito Red Blend Paraje Altamira
bodyHtml:
The Zuccardi family’s approach to sustainability starts with the environment and people before any product. They’re dedicated to producing the highest quality wines through sustainable practices such as a focus on nurturing biodiversity, organic farming, efficient irrigation practices, composting, water treatment, comprehensive waste and recycling efforts, and the use of solar energy. The winery itself is designed to be naturally energy efficient by maximizing natural light and minimizing electricity consumption.

As a third generation family-owned winery, the Zuccardi’s take seriously their responsibility to protect the environment, support the land, the farmers and uplift the local community. 

A blend of the best grapes from Altamira, the wine is a complex with excellent structure, with mineral aromas and ripe black fruits.

Blend: 85% Malbec and 15% Cabernet Franc

title: Chateau Pontet Canet 2008
bodyHtml:
Very intense colour. On the nose, both refined and complex, it is dominated by an expressive fruit of great purity. On the palate, the tannins have great amplitude characterized by finesse and a rare precision. The vibrant quality of this wine gives it an all together other emotional dimension.

Cabernet Sauvignon 65%, Merlot 30%, Cabernet Franc 4%, Petit-Verdot 1%.

96 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A candidate for the “wine of the vintage,” Pontet Canet’s 2008 boasts an opaque purple colour as well as copious aromas of sweet blueberries, blackberries and black currant fruit intertwined with lead pencil shavings, subtle barbecue smoke and a hint of forest floor. Full-bodied, with fabulous richness, texture and tremendous freshness, this first-growth-like effort is more developed than the uber-powerful 2010. Give it 5-8 years of cellaring and drink it over the following three decades. Bravo!

93 Points - James Suckling

I love the nose of sweet tobacco, currants, minerals, flowers, and stones. Full-bodied, with dark chocolate flavours, silky tannins, and beautiful fruit. Long and beautiful, with a succulent finish and a great overall balance. Best in three or four years.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Quite dense, but pure and fresh, with the core of fig, damson plum and mulled cherry fruit already well-defined and the back end of rounded loam and roasted cedar grip fully integrated. The finish is long and powerful. Best from 2013 through 2020.

title: Plantation Xaymaca Special Dry Rum
bodyHtml:
General Information

Plantation's take on traditional Jamaican rum, packed with funky fruitiness. It's a blend of rums from two distilleries on the island, distilled on the John Dore pot-still at Long Pond and Clarendon's Vendome-made pot, balancing the character of each. The palate offers notes of banana, apricot, pineapple, cashews and ginger, as well as hints of sweet coconut.

title: Guado Al Tasso Rosato Scalabrone 2023
bodyHtml: Three grape varieties, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and a touch of Syrah, produce a Rosé with decisive and intense aromas that reflect the characteristics of Bolgheri's territory. The wine and vineyard take their name from a bandit named Scalabrone who roamed this area in the 18th century. Vineyards thrive on clay-loam based soils, mainly of alluvial origin, with rocky deposits.

title: Kilbeggan Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml: Exclusively matured in ex-Bourbon barrels, the Kilbeggan Single Pot Still comprises unmalted barley, malted barley and 2.5% oats which were double distilled through two copper pot stills at Ireland's oldest licensed distillery. The mash bill was inspired by recipes from the Kilbeggan Distillery in the late 1800s when oats would have been grown across the Midlands region in Ireland. Warming flavours of citrus and herbaceous notes followed by a creamy, oily pot still spice.

title: Jameson 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
You've landed on something special here. Jameson 18 Years was made to make any occasion memorable. This is an 18-year-old whiskey, the kind of thing you only pull out for best mates. And if you want to impress them just throw this line into the conversation: It's a unique blend of three signature distillates matured in the finest oak for almost two decades and is given a final marrying period of at least 6 months in a fresh American oak barrel, adding a unique complexity and elegance. Ok, that is a mouthful. Just let the bottle do the talking.

Aromas of spice, toffee and apricot followed by flavours of fudge and nuttiness. A lasting finish, pair with toffee apple cake.

title: Choya Kokuto Umeshu - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Founded by the Kondo family in 1914, Choya originally focused on viticulture before pivoting to the commercial development of traditional umeshu in 1959. Today, the company is recognized as a global leader in the category, working directly with Japanese plum growers to ensure the quality of their ingredients.

Description

This authentic umeshu features a rich amber colour and a deep, complex sensory profile. The aroma is characterized by intense notes of black sugar (kokuto), plum, and dried apricot, complemented by the mellow fragrance of dark rum. On the palate, it delivers a unique balance of caramel like sweetness and tart plum flavours, with a smooth, viscous body and subtle smoky undertones. A hint of black vinegar adds a unique twist that enhances the overall complexity. It typically has an alcohol content of 14% to 15%.

Food Pairing

The deep, caramelised sweetness of Choya Kokuto makes it an exceptional after dinner drink or dessert accompaniment. It is particularly delightful when drizzled over vanilla ice cream or served alongside creamy desserts to highlight its rich brown sugar profile. For a unique experience, it can be mixed with milk for a smooth cocktail or enjoyed on the rocks to pair with savory snacks like blue cheese. Its robust structure also allows it to be served hot or mixed with soda for a refreshing contrast.

title: Don Papa Rum
bodyHtml:
Over a decade ago, Stephen Carroll, former global marketing director at Remy Cointreau, visited Negros Occidental in the Philippines and saw all the sugarcane haciendas. As a man of intellect, he asked the logical question: “Where's the rum?”

When he received no accurate response, he decided to do something about it. The result? A fine rum fit for neat drinking.

The rum uses a noble cane native to Southeast Asia and is considered the best sugarcane. Prized for its high sugar content and soft rinds, they're harvested from October to May. The harvest is then milled by existing ages-old Negros sugar mills, where the juices are extracted and concentrated into molasses, what Carroll calls Don Papa's "black gold." After the molasses are distilled, the resulting distillate is then aged for at least seven years in two kinds of casks: ex-bourbon barrels and proprietary sanded, toasted, and roasted American oak casks. The combination of first-fill ex-bourbon casks and their exceptional sanded, toasted and roasted casks really help bring out the fruit and vanilla notes in the wood. These casks, in particular, bring a lot of natural colours. The molasses-based rum benefits from added complexity, and the vanilla notes inherent in American oak are enhanced with these. The sweltering and humid climate expedites maturation, producing dark, intense, decadent rums.

title: Benvolio Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml: Vibrant on the palate. A crisp acidity with notes of peach, almond, and light floral aromas. Great as an aperitif, or when paired with summer salads, snapper, sole, sushi, grilled chicken, and risotto-based dishes.

title: Culmina Hypothesis 2019
bodyHtml:
Culmina Family Estate Winery is located in the Golden Mile Bench sub-appellation of the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. Founded by the Triggs family, the estate is the culmination of decades of experience and a philosophy focused on crafting wines that express the unique terroir of their high altitude benches.

Wine Description

This flagship red blend presents a deep garnet colour in the glass. The nose offers an intense and complex aromatic profile featuring notes of dark plum, black cherry, and subtle hints of dried herbs and spice. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and well structured, displaying a harmonious balance between ripe fruit flavours and refined tannins. The finish is long and elegant, marked by a refreshing acidity that underscores its sophistication.

title: Castello ColleMassari Rosso 'Rigoleto' Montecucco 2019
bodyHtml: A Sangiovese with an easy approach. It is a smooth and charming wine along with a fresh touch of Sangiovese combined with red berries notes and a delicate spicy touch of black pepper. It is a ready to drink wine. A ripe and very well balanced expression of Sangiovese from the South of Tuscany.

title: La Rioja Alta Vina Ardanza Reserva 2020
bodyHtml: Intense garnet red color, with a clear rim. Outstanding aromatic intensity on the nose, with spicy and balsamic licorice, clove, nutmeg and black pepper notes, enveloping a subtle hint of ripe red fruit: brandied cherry and raspberry jam. The palate is well-balanced, fresh, with a broad range of flavors and soft, round tannins, leading to a spicy, balsam-like aftertaste on the finish. A Vina Ardanza in its prime and with a long life ahead of it.

title: Sumac Ridge Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: Lively and fragrant aromas of freshly cut grass, gooseberry and lemon are followed by flavours of grapefruit and citrus and zest making for a nice clean finish. Enjoy with your favourite salads, chicken and seafood dishes. Great with lobster bisque or sea bass with mango salsa.

title: Don Julio Blanco Tequila - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml:
Using the finest blue agave plant and a time honored distillation process, Don Julio Blanco Tequila is tequila in its truest form.

Don Julio Blanco Tequila is the base from which all of our other variants are derived. Commonly referred to as “silver” tequila, its crisp agave flavor and hints of citrus make it an essential component to a variety of innovative drinks including margaritas. It can also be enjoyed neat or on the rocks. 100% blue agave plant.

title: Miyasaka Shuzo Masumi 'Aka' Yamahai Junmai Ginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Miyasaka Brewing Company, the "Aka" (Red) is a flagship expression named after the vermillion color of official stamps used throughout Asia. It belongs to Masumi's signature four-color palette lineup, which is designed for daily enjoyment. This sake is brewed using the traditional yamahai method, a labor-intensive process that allows natural lactic acid bacteria to thrive, resulting in a more complex and savory profile than modern methods. It exclusively features the brewery's legendary "Association Yeast No. 7".

Description

This yamahai sake is clear in appearance but possesses a "rare amplitude" and depth. The nose is bright and fragrant, showcasing aromas of banana, red plums, and stone fruits, complemented by subtle dairy notes of yogurt and cream. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with a smooth, velvety texture. Flavors of tropical fruit and chestnut are underpinned by a refreshing lactic acidity and a robust savory umami. It is crafted from a blend of Yamada Nishiki and Miyama Nishiki rice polished to 55%. ABV 15%.

Food Pairing

Masumi Aka is specifically designed to bring the flavors of rich, well-seasoned foods into "sharp relief". Its high acidity and structural umami make it an exceptional match for Western-style meat dishes and aged cheeses. It pairs brilliantly with sukiyaki, grilled mushroom risotto, or even pizza with plenty of vegetables and cheese. For a more traditional experience, serve it alongside braised pork or hearty stews. This sake is highly versatile across temperatures: enjoy it chilled to highlight its fruity top notes, at room temperature for balance, or gently warmed to expand its creamy umami.

title: E. Guigal Cote Rotie 'Brune et Blonde de Guigal' 2018
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine hails from France, specifically from the renowned Côte Rôtie appellation in the northern Rhône Valley. E. Guigal, founded in 1946 by Etienne Guigal, is one of the most respected producers in the Rhône. Now under the stewardship of Marcel and Philippe Guigal, the estate is celebrated for its meticulous vineyard management and dedication to expressing the character of each terroir.

Wine Description

The 2018 'Brune et Blonde de Guigal' reveals a deep ruby hue with garnet highlights. The nose is expressive and layered, offering aromas of ripe blackberry, dark cherry, violet, smoked meat, and subtle oak spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied yet remarkably balanced, featuring flavours of blackcurrant, plum, pepper, and hints of leather, supported by fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity. The finish is long and savoury, marked by delicate notes of licorice and minerality.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 94 points.

  • Vinous - 92 points.

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 94 points.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs beautifully with herb-crusted lamb, duck breast with cherry sauce, or aged hard cheeses. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Gut Oggau Theodora 2023
bodyHtml: Gut Oggau winemakers Stephanie & Eduard Tscheppe are deeply adored by natural wine lovers the whole world over and deserve every last iota of praise & reverence they receive! The fabric of the wines hinges upon the existence of a fictional family, with every vineyard plot being characterized by one of its members. Theodora is the youngest member of the Gut Oggau fam, representing the most recently planted vines. This field blend of mostly gruner veltliner & welschriesling is softly structured, cavernous like a deep, wet well, with gunpowder reduction, playful violet aromatics, a silky pearl texture, uplifting melon tea, sprawling mushroom gills & chalk tracings.

title: Yalumba Y Series Shiraz - Viognier 2022
bodyHtml:
Yalumba Y Series Shiraz - Viognier originates from Australia, within the South Australia region. Established in 1849, Yalumba is the oldest family-owned winery in the country, with the Hill-Smith family guiding the estate for six generations. The winemaking philosophy behind the Y Series collection combines authentic Australian winemaking practices with a minimalistic, modern approach that emphasizes wild fermentation and human intervention only when necessary.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a bright to deep crimson purple colour and possesses a full, round body. The sensory profile is highly exotic and expressive, opening with a fragrant nose of ripe cherries, boysenberry, and wild blueberries, seamlessly complemented by the white pepper, musk, and violet aromatics provided by the Viognier grape. On the approachable palate, it delivers lush flavours of dark cherry, plum, and spiced fruit cake, layered with a sweet hint of Turkish delight. The finish is long and velvety, showing excellent harmony between the two co-fermented varieties.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional blend dominated by Shiraz, enhanced with a small percentage of Viognier grapes co-fermented with as many whole berries as possible.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its structural harmony and bright fruit purity, utilizing cool stainless steel tank fermentations with naturally occurring indigenous yeasts and no oak aging to keep the fruit character lively and fresh.

  • ABV: Typically recorded at 14.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery prioritizes strict environmental management and sustainable viticulture under Entwine Australia certifications, this specific bottling is not certified organic; however, it is officially certified as vegan-friendly.

Food Pairing

The vibrant fruit profile, smooth texture, and exotic aromatics of this Shiraz - Viognier blend make it a fantastic match for seasoned, protein-rich dishes.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with grilled beef skewers, slow-braised pork belly, or lamb chops.

  • Savoury: Suggested pairings include Moroccan spiced grilled eggplant covered in a rich tomato and chili sauce, or falafel wraps stuffed with fresh cucumber, tomatoes, and hummus.

  • Game: Complements rich wild game options such as venison or roasted duck.

title: Meinklang Weisser Mulatschak
bodyHtml:
Meinklang Weisser Mulatschak is a natural, skin-contact white wine (often referred to as an orange wine) from Austria, made by the Meinklang estate in the Burgenland region.

Key Characteristics:

  • Style: Orange wine / skin-contact white
  • Grapes: Typically a blend of Welschriesling, Pinot Gris (Grauburgunder), and Traminer
  • Winemaking:
    • Spontaneous fermentation with native yeasts
    • Extended skin contact (hence the orange hue)
    • Unfiltered and unfined
    • Minimal or no added sulphur

Tasting Notes:

  • Colour: Cloudy amber or deep orange, due to skin maceration
  • Aromas: Floral, spicy, with hints of stone fruit, herbs, and citrus peel
  • Palate: Dry, textural, slightly tannic with refreshing acidity and funky, savoury notes
  • Finish: Zesty, with lingering spice and phenolic grip

Serving Tips:

  • Slight chill (around 12–14°C)
  • Best served in a white wine or universal glass
  • Great with fermented foods, spicy dishes, charcuterie, or vegetarian meals

title: La Maison du Whisky Artist Collective 3.5 Miltonduff 9 Year Old
bodyHtml: A 2009 Miltonduff single malt from French indie bottler La Maison du Whisky, matured in a first-fill bourbon barrel for nine years before being bottled as part of its Artist Collective series. Aromas of apples, pears, acacia honey, banana and passion fruit mingle with black pepper, chilli, rosemary and honeysuckle on the nose. The palate offers notes of mustard seeds, acacia honey, poached pears, cocoa, barley malt and savoury porridge.

title: La Maison du Whisky Artist Collective 3.6 Ardmore 9 Year Old
bodyHtml: This version of Ardmore is aged in ex-bourbon casks and has a mineral and malty character while offering a nice punch of floral peatiness.

title: Domaine Deliance Givry Premier Cru 'Clos De La Servoisine' 2023
bodyHtml: A refined and elegant Bourgogne Pinot Noir from a 60-year-old vineyard, facing south. Hand-picked grapes aged for 1 year in oak barrels. Deep red with a gorgeous ruby hue. Flamboyant and dense. Rich aromas of black cherry jam, dark chocolate, smoky spice, and earthy oak, layered and complex. The attack is generously textured with a good weight dominated by blackberry and licorice with notes of spice. Silky tannins and a lovely, lingering finish.

title: Fukucho Seaside Junmai Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Imada Shuzo, this sake is a tribute to the coastal region's heritage of soft-water brewing. Its creator, Miho Imada, is one of the few female owner-winemakers (Toji) in Japan. Known for her experimental spirit, she designed "Seaside" to evoke the freshness of the Seto Inland Sea, specifically intending it to be the ultimate companion for seafood. This expression is crafted through secondary fermentation in the bottle, creating natural bubbles similar to the traditional method used in Champagne.

Description

This sparkling sake is slightly cloudy and features a fine, frothy effervescence. A key innovation is the use of white koji, which produces natural citric acid to mimic the tartness of the lemons and limes grown in the Seto region. The nose is bright and "Brut-like," offering a tight collection of aromas including yogurt, fresh cream, lemon-lime, and crisp apple. On the palate, it is refreshingly light-bodied and remarkably dry, showcasing flavours of pear, green apple, and melon with a subtle briny, oceanic lift. It is brewed using Nakate Shinsenbon rice polished to 70%. ABV 13%.

Food Pairing

True to its name, this sake is specifically engineered to pair with "all things that come from the sea". Its high acidity and crisp bubbles make it a perfect match for raw West Coast oysters, caviar, and sashimi. The citrus notes also complement richer or spicier seafood dishes, such as lobster, scallops in butter sauce, or spicy shellfish. Beyond seafood, it serves as a sophisticated aperitif or a refreshing accompaniment to fruit-based desserts and creamy cheeses. For the best experience, serve well-chilled in a Champagne flute to preserve its delicate tingle.

title: Yamaguchi Shuzo Niwa No Uguisu Tomari Umeshu - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Yamaguchi Shuzojo, an eleven-generation family brewery established in 1832, this umeshu is named "Niwa no Uguisu" (Nightingale’s Garden). The name honors the birds that frequent the brewery's garden to drink its exceptionally pure water. This "Tomari" expression is distinct for its use of kasutori shochu—a spirit distilled from sake lees—rather than the neutral spirits often found in commercial plum wines.

Description

This premium umeshu presents a refined, dry-tasting profile that sets it apart from mass-market versions. It is crafted by steeping hand-selected green plums (typically Ome or Oshuku varieties) in the brewery's own shochu for roughly 10 months. The nose is fragrant and elegant, offering scents of sweet almond and fresh, tart plums. On the palate, it is silky and finessed, balancing the natural acidity of the fruit with a rich plum extract and a clean, lengthy finish. ABV 12%.

Food Pairing

The dryness and bright acidity of Tomari Umeshu make it an incredibly versatile "foodie's best friend". It pairs elegantly with rich appetizers like foie gras, charcuterie, and aged cheeses. For main courses, it complements savory-sweet glazes such as Hoisin-based ribs or glazed chicken. It also shines alongside traditional Japanese desserts like almond tofu or French-style clafoutis. It is best served chilled, on the rocks, or as a highball mixed with soda water to emphasize its crisp tingle.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Indigo Wind Sparkling Junmai Sake - 200 ml
bodyHtml:
Nakano Kunizakari Indigo Wind Sparkling Junmai is a refreshing Japanese sparkling sake originating from the Aichi prefecture. It is produced by the Nakano Sake Brewery (Nakano Shuzo), a historic establishment founded in 1844 on the Chita Peninsula. The brewery is renowned for its signature 'Kunizakari' brand, which blends traditional Edo-period craftsmanship with innovative cutting-edge technology to create a wide range of premium sake and fruit-based beverages.

Description

This bubbly Junmai sake presents a clear appearance with soft, creamy bubbles that provide a gentle effervescence on the palate. It offers an elegant sensory profile with aromas of green apple, vanilla, marshmallow, and a hint of citrus fruit. The palate is characterized by a satisfying balance of sweetness and acidity, featuring flavours of strawberry, Ambrosia apple, rice pudding, and sweet rice. With an alcohol by volume of 6%, this light and refreshing sake is exceptionally easy to drink and serves as an excellent aperitif.

Food Pairing

The bright acidity and creamy texture of Indigo Wind make it a versatile companion for a variety of snacks and light meals. It pairs exceptionally well with traditional Japanese sides like edamame and grilled squid, as well as Western comfort foods such as French fries and potato chips. Its sparkling nature also makes it a perfect match for spicy Thai or Asian dishes, where the sweetness helps to balance the heat. For a savory combination, it can be served alongside garlic scape vichyssoise or egg'n'cheddar rolls.

title: Daishichi Minowamon Kimoto Junmai Dai-Ginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
The Daishichi brewery was established in 1752 and has been managed by the Ohta family for ten generations. They are world renowned for their strict adherence to the traditional kimoto brewing method and their pioneered super-polishing technique.

Description

This sake displays a brilliant, clear appearance and an aroma characterized by mellow notes of melon, pear, and a touch of creamy yogurt. The palate is silky and medium bodied, offering a sophisticated balance of umami and natural freshness. It concludes with a long, elegant finish that reflects the depth of the kimoto process. The alcohol content is 15%.

Food Pairing

The velvety texture and complex acidity of this sake make it a superb match for rich seafood dishes such as lobster thermidor or pan seared scallops. It also complements traditional Japanese cuisine, particularly fatty tuna sashimi or salt grilled wagyu beef. For a unique pairing, consider serving it with a mild, creamy cheese to enhance its lactic notes

title: Tenzan Shichida Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Tenzan Shichida Junmai Daiginjo is a super-premium sake produced by the Tenzan Sake Brewery on the island of Kyushu, Japan. Founded in 1875, the brewery originally began as a flour and noodle milling business before transitioning into sake production. Under the leadership of the 6th generation of the Shichida family, the brewery has gained international acclaim for its "modern yet timeless" approach. This specific expression is part of the Shichida line, which focuses on a "juicy" mouthfeel and robust umami, utilizing the medium-hard groundwater from Mount Tenzan and the nearby Gion River—a site famous for its fireflies, a natural indicator of water purity.

Spirit Description

This sake is an elegant, highly aromatic expression that balances sophisticated fruit notes with a silky texture. The nose is characterized by an "enthralling" bouquet of white flowers, violets, pineapple, and musk melon. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and smooth, offering a refined acidity and a complex profile of white peach, tropical fruit cocktail, and sweet rice cake. Unlike many delicate Daiginjos, the Shichida house style ensures a rich, clean finish with a distinctive umami backbone, often attributed to the brewery’s decision to avoid charcoal filtration (muroka) for this series. It is crafted from Yamada Nishiki rice polished to 45% and is typically bottled at 16% ABV with a Sake Meter Value (SMV) of +1.6 to +2.

title: Kobayashi Shuzo Hououbiden Higeban Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
Faustino Crianza Art Collection 2022
bodyHtml:
Clean, bright, medium layer. Beautiful cherry red color with garnet evolution. Intense. Barrel notes are very present. Sweet sensations, lightly toasted. Very well integrated with notes of slightly ripe fruits of the forest. Pleasant in the mouth. The tannins are very well integrated, round. Medium finish marked by toasted barrels.

It matches with any kind of meat and mushrooms rice. Some tasty or oily fish such as tuna or cod. Medium-aged cheese such as emmenthal or gruyere.

title: Ogier Heritage des Caves des Papes Cotes du Rhone 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from France, specifically from the Rhone Valley region within the Cotes du Rhone appellation. Founded in 1859 by Antoine Ogier in Chateauneuf du Pape, Maison Ogier possesses over 160 years of history and has established itself as a key reference in the southern Rhone. The winery's philosophy is based on a sustainable viticulture approach and meticulous vineyard management to faithfully express the diversity of the region's terroirs, blending centuries-old tradition with modern innovation.

Wine Description

Ogier Heritage des Caves des Papes Cotes du Rhone displays a deep ruby red colour with bright reflections. The nose is expressive, elegant, and complex, offering aromas of small ripe red fruits such as cherry, raspberry, and strawberry, interlaced with notes of licorice, violet, and spicy touches. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and generous, with a silky texture and round, well integrated tannins that provide a fine structure. It is characterized by its harmonious balance between power and freshness, leading to a persistent finish marked by spices and a hint of vanilla. This blend is typically composed of Grenache, Syrah, and Mourvedre, with an ABV of approximately 14.5%. While the house is committed to sustainable development, this specific cuvee is generally not certified organic. The optimal drinking window extends from release through approximately five years.

title: Exem Merlot - Cabernet Bordeaux Blend 2019
bodyHtml: Aromas are of ripe red and black fruits with no green notes found in ‘old fashion’ Bordeaux reds. The palate is rich and harmonious with tannins that are soft and elegant. You will find with Exem a new style of Bordeaux, profiling perfectly ripe fruit.

title: Tiamo Barbera Organic 2021
bodyHtml:
The lovely Tiamo Barbera is a lighter, fresher red wine that has delightful aromas of raspberries. It is dry but full of fruit and a perfect every day Italian red.

Perfect with all pasta dishes, pizza, chicken, lamb, beef and soft cheeses.

title: Phillips Peppermint Schnapps - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Phillips Peppermint Schnapps is a classic American liqueur produced by the Phillips Distilling Company, based in Princeton, Minnesota. Introduced in 1935, it holds the distinction of being America's first schnapps brand and remains the product for which the distillery is most well known. The original recipe was developed by salesman Al Dorsch, who observed patrons in Minnesota saloons dropping peppermints into unaged bourbon to smooth its rough taste; today, the distillery is managed by the fifth generation of the Phillips family.

Wine Description

This peppermint schnapps is celebrated for its bold and invigorating profile, crafted from premium ingredients and distilled for purity.

  • Color: The liqueur is completely clear and colorless.

  • Aroma: It features a crisp, cool, and highly aromatic peppermint bouquet that is both refreshing and sweet.

  • Palate: Often described as 'liquid candy cane', it delivers an intense minty flavor with a smooth and slightly sweet mouthfeel.

  • Body: It is a medium-bodied liqueur with a clean and bold peppermint profile.

  • Finish: The finish is clean and cool, leaving a pleasant, lingering minty aftertaste on the palate.

title: Kin & Cascadia Cabernet Sauvignon 2017
bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon is grown in the famed Columbia Valley near the edge of Red Mountain. The Wahluke Slope area has one of the driest, warmest climates in the state, allowing nearly complete control of vine vigour and ripening through irrigation. Elegant and refined with aromas and flavours of mocha and black cherry.

title: Great Plains Brandy Cask Finish 18 Year Old Whisky
bodyHtml: A curious Canadian whisky made from a Corn/Rye Whisky sourced from the Potters Distillery in Kelowna. It was matured 17 years in ex-Bourbon and finished in 15 months in Jerez Brandy barrels from Osborne (Andalusia, Spain). Bottled at 54.5%, the spirit was made from a mash bill of 91.5% corn and 8.5% rye.

title: Spirit of Hven Backafallsbyn Organic Aquavit
bodyHtml:
General Information

Spirit of Hven's Aquavit uses its vodka as a starting point. It is redistilled along with caraway, lemon and orange peel, St John's wort and rhubarb and aged in wood. Each batch is made up of 30 casks, of which a third each is aged for two, four and six years.

title: Bridgeland Distillery Moscato Brandy - 375 ml
bodyHtml: On the nose, this brandy has distinct aroma of Creme brulee & beachwood. The palate is balanced between sweetness and acidity that matches the Moscato grapes this delicate brandy was made from. A sweet, spicy, warming finish brings it home, with a subtle lingering licorice flavour.

title: Prairie Organic Gin
bodyHtml: Our organic gin is smooth and ready for anything. Whether you’re going for a simple gin ‘n’ tonic, or mixing up something classic like a Sidecar, this gin is a smooth way in. Bursts of herbs, sage, juniper and exotic spices, complement a dry and refreshing taste with a long delicate finish.

title: Matsui Peated Single Malt Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1910, Matsui Shuzo has a long history in the production of sake and shochu before receiving its whisky distillation licence in 2015. The distillery is situated in a natural environment near Mount Daisen, utilizing the mountain's fresh snowfall and mineral-rich groundwater to reduce the spirit to proof.

Description

This single malt is distilled in copper pot stills and matured in American white oak bourbon barrels. It presents a light amber colour and an aromatic profile of freshly cut malted grains, vanilla, and a slightly camphorated peatiness. On the palate, the whisky is fresh and herbaceous, offering notes of toasted oak, brown sugar, and creamy vanilla enveloped in a smoky, minty touch. The finish is characterized by lingering peat smoke and fresh apple notes. It is bottled at 48% ABV without chill filtration or added colouring.

Food Pairing

The smoky and peaty character of this whisky makes it an excellent partner for rich, savoury dishes that can stand up to its bold profile. It pairs particularly well with smoked seafood, such as grilled mackerel (saba shioyaki) or raw oysters, which complement its iodine and marine notes. For meat pairings, consider braised or smoked meats, or even spicy Asian dishes like ramen and curry. It also serves as a fine accompaniment to strong cheeses like blue cheese or aged cheddar, and dark chocolate desserts that highlight its smoky complexity.

title: Kaiyo Japanese Mizunara Oak Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Kaiyo Japanese Mizunara Oak (often simply called the "Black Label") is the standard-bearer for the Kaiyo brand. This expression is a teaspooned malt whisky, meaning it is primarily sourced from a single unnamed Japanese distillery with a trace amount of malt from another, which classifies it as a blended malt. It is uniquely matured in rare, handmade Mizunara oak casks—a wood known for being difficult to cooper but highly prized for its aromatic influence. Following its initial aging, the barrels undergo a three-month ocean voyage from Osaka, which uses the natural motion of the sea to encourage deeper interaction between the wood and the spirit.

Whisky Description

This whisky presents a pale, straw-like gold color. The nose is exceptionally fragrant and typical of the Mizunara influence, offering aromas of sandalwood, incense, and fresh tropical fruits like pineapple and coconut, followed by a hint of jasmine and orange peel. On the palate, the body is smooth and medium-weight, delivering flavors of honey, vanilla sponge cake, and green apple, which transition into a savory mid-palate featuring black tea and alpine herbs. The finish is long and warm, characterized by fading baking spices, cinnamon rolls, and a refined woody sweetness. It is bottled un-chill filtered at 43% ABV.

title: Gerard Bertrand Source of Joy Rose 2022
bodyHtml: Youthful and elegant, an organic rose from the Languedoc region of France. Gourmet notes of strawberry and cherry.

title: Taylor Fladgate Vintage Port 2017
bodyHtml:
Opaque at the center with a narrow purple rim. The nose is threaded with fine, linear fruit, heady and complex but restrained by a graphite minerality. Signature fragrance of violets, which hangs like a scented veil over the wine with discreet terroir notes of citrus and wild herbs. The nose is reserved but there is impressive depth and background. The palate is held in place by lithe, muscular tannins, firm and grippy on the finish, and ends with a powerful surge of crisp, pure berry fruit. A beautifully delineated wine, with poise and definition and the tantalizing promise of pleasures still to come.

Robert Parker - 100 Points 

The 2017 Vintage Port, not quite bottled when seen but the final blend, is a field blend aged for approximately 20 months in wood. It comes in with 100 grams of residual sugar. A step up (or two) on the 2016, this shows fine depth, more focus, vivid fruit and serious power. It's not particularly thick, austere or astringent, but this is built for the long haul. It is potentially a great Taylor's, effortlessly combining brilliant fruit and structure. It tastes great now (today, it is far more vivid than its Vinha Velha sibling), but the power makes this hard to drink today. So, have some patience. It will need some time, probably a lot more than indicated, and will likely last longer than indicated as well. As noted in the accompanying article, I don't see much point to impossibly long drinking windows. At some point, reevaluation is required.

At the moment, it seems to be a step up on the Vinha Velha, although that is far more closed. I'd pick this today, but in time, both undoubtedly will have more tales to tell. Great young Ports go through many phases, and both are great young Ports. When ten-year anniversary tastings are done, this will have to be on the shortlist of greats to reconsider to determine how the best in the vintage are meeting expectations.

title: Laurent Miquel Vendanges Nocturnes Rouge 2023
bodyHtml:
Laurent Miquel Vendanges Nocturnes Rouge is a distinguished red wine from the Languedoc-Roussillon region in southern France. Crafted by the Laurent Miquel winery, this wine is produced from a blend of Carignan, Syrah, Grenache, and Merlot grapes, showcasing the rich diversity of the region's viticulture.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Deep ruby red with vibrant hues.

  • Aroma: Opens with aromas of ripe red fruits such as cherry and raspberry, complemented by subtle hints of spice and earthy undertones.

  • Palate: Medium-bodied with a harmonious balance of fruit-forward flavors and soft tannins. The wine exhibits a smooth texture with a touch of spiciness.

  • Finish: Clean and refreshing, with a lingering fruity aftertaste.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Food Pairings: Pairs well with dishes such as grilled meats, pasta, and mild cheeses.

title: Bruno Rocca Barbaresco 2021
bodyHtml: This small family-owned vineyard is one of the top producers in Piedmont is of the most importance. Since the early eighties, more and more of the best Piedmont producers have begun to make single-vineyard wines, and Bruno Rocca is one of the stars.

title: Sandro Fay Valtellina Superiore Valgella 2022
bodyHtml: A fresh nose of raspberry and cherry coupled with rose petal and tobacco. Fine and silky in the mouth, with good detail and a lingering savory finish.

title: Mauro Molino Roero Arneis 2024
bodyHtml: Intensive delicately fruity nose with hints of lychee and green apple, mineral and Rescher acidity, refreshing and very lively on the palate.

title: San Michele Pinot Grigio
bodyHtml:
General Information

Expressive Pinot Grigio made from organic grapes with a short skin contact and extended lees aging. This wine has a medium body & notes of lemon, orange & peach. It'g great with fish, shellfish or pasta & rice dishes. Great value!

title: Athenaeum Merlot Napa Valley 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: This Merlot takes a good hour to open, when it does it’s very aromatic. Flavours are fairly bold - blueberry, dark plum, cherry, black currant, coffee, and herb hints in a dark ruby colour. It leans pretty close to dry with a long mouthfeel that’s quite intense and full-bodied.

title: Septima Malbec Emblema 2023
bodyHtml: Aromatically, the wine shows notes of plums and figs, with an overlay of vanilla oak enhancement. On the palate, expect forward fruit (blackberry) and density, with an attractive minerality. Long and persistent finish.

title: Cava De Oro Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
General Information

Cava de Oro Reposado is produced with the highest standards of quality and under supervision by the Council Regulator of Tequila. The tequila is an aromatic and tasteful tequila. Cava de Oro Reposadois is made out of 100% Agave and is rested in oak barrels for up to one year. Cava de Oro Reposado Tequila is made with 100% Blue Weber Agave and Bottled in Mexico.

title: Tamdhu 15 Year Old Single Malt
bodyHtml: From your first sip of the 15-year-old expression, you'll fully appreciate that time maturing exclusively in the finest sherry oak casks. You'll taste the intense burst of vibrant summer fruits on the palate and enjoy the rewardingly long finish it delivers. Bottled at 46% volume, natural colour and un-chill-filtered.

title: The Arran Single Malt Barrel Reserve
bodyHtml: Barrel Reserve is a fresh, light and elegant no-age-statement Single Malt Scotch Whisky. It is 100% matured in Bourbon Barrels and will become your go-to dram for every occasion - to be served neat, with ice or in a long drink or cocktail.

title: The Arran Sherry Cask 'The Bodega'
bodyHtml:
Sherry Cask 'The Bodega' is a stunning addition to The Arran core range of whiskies and is the perfect choice for someone who enjoys their Single Malt with plenty of body and complexity. Matured in some of the finest casks in the whisky industry, this cask-strength 100% Sherry matured Single Malt is luxurious and elegant with layers of rich sweet spice and oak. Their Master Distiller has worked with producers in some of the most prestigious Sherry Bodegas in Jerez, Spain, to select only the best quality casks to be filled with their precious spirit. This bottling is a return to the style of some of the earliest Arran Single Malt, predominantly matured in Sherry Casks. During a tasting, this expression is the perfect partner to their Quarter Cask 'The Bothy' as it showcases the skill and expertise of their Master Distiller in his work with different wood types and supreme cask selection.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: Aromas of chocolate-covered raisins, mandarin oranges, and a hint of spice, indicating a robust character.
  • Palate: Chewy and warm, with flavors of ripe figs and sweet cherries, achieving a balance between the sherry cask influence and the distillery's spirit.
  • Finish: Long and powerful, featuring notes of pink pepper, hazelnuts, and toasted oak, culminating in an elegant conclusion.

title: Remy Martin Louis XIII Cognac - Mini 50 ml
bodyHtml:
A blend of more than 1200 Eaux-de-vie coming exclusively from the Grande Champagne First Growth of Cognac and aged between 40 to 100 years old.

Louis XIII is contained in a Baccarat Crystal Decanter, replica of a gourd found where the battle of Jarnac took place.

title: Felsina Chianti Classico Riserva 'Rancia' 2019
bodyHtml: Ruby red appearance with rich, intense tones. Spicy nose with floral notes and hints of wild berry (red and black), accompanied by mineral impressions and light toasted notes. Spice re-appears on the palate, which displays firm but supple tannins, and the finale is vigorous and taut. Overall, the wine is compelling for its flavor-rich mid-palate and supporting acidity.

title: Meukow VSOP Superior Cognac
bodyHtml: Awarded double gold at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition, this Cognac shines a brilliant amber colour in the glass. Delicate aromas of spice, caramel, and dried flowers greet your nose. On the palate, a touch of dried orange zest, wood and cocoa blend elegantly and combine on a smooth and warm finish.

title: Peloton de la Muerte Mezcal
bodyHtml:
