100% Agave Espadín (Agave angustifolia), made by maestro mezcalero Cutberto Santiago in Santiago Matatlán, Oaxaca, and bottled at 41% ABV. The name and label of Pelotón de la Muerte, which means Brigade of Death, commemorates the flag used by the insurgents during the Mexican Revolution who called themselves "the squadron of death for the suffering Hidalgo", who tried to enact revenge for the death of the priest Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla, the founding father of Mexico's independence.

Astor Wines and Spirits – “This mezcal possesses impressive range with gorgeous notes of kiwi fruit, lemon zest, dried green peppercorn, classic agave and gentle smoke. A smooth and soft entry on the palate showing a ripe agave character and a hint of caramel leads to a finish with just the right amount of liveliness. An immediate go to for cocktails and a lovely stand-by for a classic, basic mezcal. Nicely balanced and offering a level of complexity unmatched for this value.”

Awards: 2015 Beverage Tasting Institute – 88 points “Clear color. Lively, smoky aromas of char-roasted nuts and plantains and wood soap with a creamy, crisp, dry-yet-fruity medium body and a tingling, interesting, buoyant roasted nougat, camp fire ash, and cream finish. A mellow, nicely balanced sipping mezcal with a nice interplay of delicate smoke and creamy fruitiness.”; New York International Spirits Competition 2014 – Silver Medal

title: Chateau Tour des Termes 2017
bodyHtml:
General Information

Saint-Estèphe wines are powerful, concentrated and rich, with sometimes austere, gritty tannins in their youth, and hallmark notes of cassis, tobacco, cigar box and crushed stone. These full-bodied blends can age extremely well.

Tasting Notes ... This wine has plenty of ripe fruit backed by serious tannins. It is solid, full-bodied, juicy and well concentrated.

60% Merlot, 30% Cabernet Sauvignon, 5% Cabernet Franc, 5% Petit Verdot

title: Seghesio Zinfandel Old Vine 2023
bodyHtml:
This red wine hails from the United States, specifically from California’s Sonoma County. Seghesio Family Vineyards, established in 1895 by Italian immigrant Edoardo Seghesio, is now owned by Crimson Wine Group but still managed with deep respect for its heritage. The estate is renowned for its commitment to Zinfandel, with a legacy rooted in over a century of viticultural excellence and meticulous attention to site-specific expression.

Wine Description

The vintage presents an intense sensory profile, opening with layered aromatics of black plum, dried fig, clay earth, and cardamom spice. On the palate, a luscious entry reminiscent of chocolate cherry cordial transitions into a supple mid-palate featuring raspberry, savory anise, and white pepper. This full-bodied wine is supported by mouthwatering acidity and velvety, mature tannins that lead to a rich and complex finish.

title: Mastrojanni Brunello di Montalcino 2018
bodyHtml:
This wine has a deep and intense ruby red color, a result of a generous summer.  It opens in a wide and visceral sip with overlapping of the fragrance of plum and red fruits, notes of tobacco, shaded by a puff of leather and chocolate. In an elegant and enveloping mouth, the dense and compact tannin gives the impulse for an inviting, long, and savory finish.

Great pairings include game, lamb, grilled red meats, and mature cheeses.

title: Decero Syrah Remolinos Vineyard 2020 - Single
bodyHtml: Decero Syrah displays red fruit flavours, spices and mineral notes. A medium-bodied wine that shows bright acidity, smooth tannins and a long finish. The wine has spent 14 months in French oak barrels which have further contributed to its textural complexity.

title: Chateau Le Pape Pessac-Leognan 2020
bodyHtml:
Chateau Le Pape Pessac-Leognan is a true masterpiece of Bordeaux winemaking. From its deep and intense color to its complex and nuanced flavor profile, this wine is a tour de force of the winemaker's art.

As you savor this wine, you'll be transported to the rolling hills of the Pessac-Leognan appellation, where the grapes for this wine were carefully cultivated and harvested. The wine's bold and intense dark fruit flavors are complemented by hints of vanilla and earthy undertones, and its balanced tannins add depth and structure to its complexity.

Overall, Chateau Le Pape Pessac-Leognan  is a wine that truly showcases the best of Bordeaux winemaking, and its sophistication and refinement make it an excellent choice for special occasions or for enjoying with a decadent meal.

title: Casaretti 'Rosa Dei Casaretti' Bardolino Classico Rose 2025
bodyHtml: Intense and fruity, with hints of peach and rose -  dry, harmonious and lively!

title: Paradigm Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon is dark ruby in color with aromas of deep ripe fruit, black cherries, blackberry, currants, plums, savory spice, vanilla, and toasty French Oak. Aromas and flavors show nice concentration. The wine has a dense texture and mouthcoating mouthfeel. Classic Oakville Cabernet flavors similar to the aromas. Optimum ripeness leads to a lush, rich, and well-balanced wine that bodes well for age ability. Layered and interesting with a long persistent finish. A delicious offering from Paradigm.

title: Colome 'Amalaya' Malbec Gran Corte 2022
bodyHtml: The aromatic nose of this Malbec-based blend shows peppercorn and red-berry aromas. Full-bodied and with good acidity, the wine delivers grassy notes, fruit flavours and a touch of spice framed by smooth tannins.

title: Matsui Sakura Cask Single Malt Japanese Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Matsui Sakura Cask Single Malt originates from the Tottori Prefecture in Japan, produced at the Kurayoshi Distillery. Founded in 1910, Matsui Shuzo has a legacy of over a century in spirits production and utilizes the pristine, mineral-rich groundwater from Mount Daisen to proof its whiskies. This expression is part of the Matsui Single Malt collection, which emphasizes the influence of different wood types on the spirit.

Description

This single malt is aged in casks made from Sakura wood, also known as Japanese cherry wood, which is rare and difficult to work with. It presents a light amber hue and a delicate aromatic profile featuring floral scents of cherry blossoms, vanilla, and a hint of malted barley. On the palate, the whisky is crisp and elegant, offering flavours of almond, orange peel, and light honey with a subtle spice. The finish is clean and lingering, showcasing the unique floral sweetness imparted by the Sakura wood. It is bottled at 48% alcohol content without chill filtration or artificial colouring.

Food Pairing

The floral and delicate nature of the Sakura Cask makes it an excellent companion for lighter savoury dishes and desserts. It pairs beautifully with fresh seafood such as snapper sashimi or grilled prawns, which complement its crisp fruitiness. The whisky also pairs well with Japanese sweets like mochi or fruit tarts, as the cherry wood notes enhance floral and fruity flavours. For a more savoury contrast, consider serving it with lightly salted nuts or a mild goat cheese.

title: Matsui Single Malt Mizunara Cask Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Matsui Single Malt Mizunara Cask is a craft whisky produced by the Matsui Shuzou distillery in the Tottori Prefecture, Japan. Located near Mount Daisen, the distillery benefits from the region's famous spring water, which is filtered through volcanic rock to ensure a pure and soft base for the spirit. Unlike the Kurayoshi series, which is a blend of world malts, this expression is a 100% Japanese single malt distilled at the Matsui distillery. The whisky is matured exclusively in Japanese Mizunara oak, a rare and expensive wood that is notoriously difficult to work with but provides a unique oriental character.

Whisky Description

This single malt is a light gold color in the glass. The nose is incredibly aromatic and floral, dominated by the characteristic Mizunara scent of sandalwood and temple incense, alongside notes of fresh ginger and cinnamon. On the palate, the whisky feels silky and refined, offering flavors of honeyed cereal, sweet vanilla, and a bright zestiness reminiscent of grapefruit. As the spirit develops, the complex spice of the wood becomes more apparent, introducing layers of coconut and white pepper. The finish is crisp and persistent, leaving a lingering trail of spicy oak and a delicate, floral sweetness. It is bottled at 48% ABV and is non-chill filtered with no added caramel color.

title: McGuinness Triple Sec - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Sec means “dry” in French and “triple” suggests three times as dry. McGuinness Triple Sec is also three times as delicious when added to your favourite cocktail — it’s no wonder so many people fall in love with this flavour!  This Triple Sec is bursting with sweet oranges! It adds zesty orange flavour to margaritas and daiquiris and provides that subtle note in cosmopolitans. A must-have for any home bar!

title: Rumchata Cream Liqueur - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
General Information

Milky white in colour; aromas of spice, ginger, toast and vanilla; rich and full with creamy sweet honeycomb and spiced flavours.

title: Gigglewater Prosecco Rose
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This sparkling rosé originates from Italy, specifically from the lush vineyards of the Veneto region. Produced by the Genuine Classics Wine Company under the Gigglewater label, the brand is inspired by the 1920s American slang term for a spirited alcoholic beverage. The winery's philosophy focuses on creating fun yet elegant sparkling wines that offer effortless enjoyment and a festive flair for modern gatherings.

Wine Description

Gigglewater Prosecco Rosé displays a delicate pink hue with a vibrant and eye catching appearance. The nose is fragrant and playful, offering a bouquet that bursts with ripe strawberry, juicy peach, and delicate rose petals, accented by hints of citrus zest. On the palate, the wine is bright and refreshing, featuring a medley of red berries and stone fruit balanced by a creamy, almond like finish and fine, lively bubbles. It is characterized by its medium sweet style and crisp acidity. This sparkling wine is crafted from a blend of Glera and Pinot Noir grapes, which undergoes a cool secondary fermentation in stainless steel tanks to preserve its fresh, fruity character. The ABV is typically 11%. While the brand emphasizes a light and modern style, this specific bottling is not certified organic, though it is noted as being both vegan and gluten free. The optimal drinking window is generally from release through two to three years to preserve its youthful effervescence.

title: Louis Latour Chardonnay Macon-Lugny 'Les Genievres' 2024
bodyHtml: Mâcon Lugny's "Les Genièvres" has a brilliant pale yellow colour with green reflections and offers seductive floral aromas accompanied by white peach. On the palate, it is a full-bodied wine with notes of muscat, chlorophyll and a fresh finish.

title: The Macallan 'M'
bodyHtml:
The Macallan M 2022 Release (45% ABV) was matured in Sherry-seasoned oak casks. It is presented in a handmade Lalique crystal decanter. Tasting notes include chocolate, dried fruit and spice.

For more information visit The Macallan Website.

title: Chateau Leoville Las Cases 2010
bodyHtml:
Chateau Leoville Las Cases 2010 originates from France, within the Bordeaux region and the Saint Julien subregion. The estate represents one of the largest and oldest classified growths in the Medoc area, formed after the division of the original historic Leoville property. The winery's philosophy relies on showcasing its exceptional, contiguous terroir located primarily within the walled Grand Clos, which borders the Gironde River and immediately abuts Chateau Latour.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep garnet or inky appearance and possesses an immense, full bodied character with a powerful texture. The sensory profile is layered, concentrated, and complex, opening with an architectural nose of black currants, crème de cassis, dark plums, and blueberries, interwoven with notes of cigar box, incense, mint, and a scent of Christmas cake. On the opulent and bold palate, it delivers rich flavours of blackberry, pastis, and dark chocolate, cut through with fresh mineral acidity and a crunchy texture. The finish is remarkably long, chiseled, and persistent, anchored by a solid frame of grainy, wrought iron tannins and long lingering mineral elements.

  • Varietal Composition: A classic Bordeaux blend consisting of 82% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Merlot, and 8% Cabernet Franc.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its structural architecture, impeccable poise, and incredible reserve, maintaining a tighter and more secretive complexity compared to warmer vintages.

  • ABV: 13.7%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate avoids synthetic interventions wherever possible and relies on precise vineyard management, this bottle is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The immense concentration, full bodied structure, and firm tannic architecture of this wine make it a natural companion for robust and savoury gastronomy.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with premium grilled steak, roast beef, roasted rack of lamb, lamb shank, and osso bucco.

  • Poultry & Game: Complements rich preparations of veal, pork, duck, or wild game.

  • Cheese: Matches exceptionally well with full flavoured and mature cheeses like sharp cheddar.

Vintage Quality

The 2010 vintage in Saint Julien is regarded as an extraordinary, legendary year that produced wines with a perfect balance of acidity and attractive aromatic freshness. The growing season experienced a dry and hot April before the vegetative cycle was considerably slowed down by cooler temperatures in May and June. A notable drought with very little precipitation from March to August was followed by perfect sunny weather in late summer. The winemaker's skill in navigating these conditions allowed the grapes to achieve optimal phenolic ripeness while retaining excellent natural acidity, resulting in a monumental release with a bright future and exceptional cellaring longevity.

title: Taylor Fladgate Century of Port - (10, 20, 30, 40 Year Old)
bodyHtml:
Taylor Fladgate holds one of the world's most extensive reserves of rare cask-aged Ports. This collection will give the Port lover on your list 100 reasons to thank you.

This gift pack contains 4 x 375ml bottles of Taylor Fladgate Tawny Port: 10 Year Old, 20 Year Old, 30 Year Old and 40 Year Old.

10 Year Old - Rich and elegant nose combining aromas of ripe berry fruit with a delicate nuttiness and subtle mellow notes of chocolate, butterscotch and fine oak wood. Smooth and silky on the palate and full of ripe figgy, jammy flavours which persist on the long finish.

20 Year Old - Opulent and voluptuous nose of complex spicy, jammy and nutty aromas, hints of orange flower and fine oak coming from the long period of aging in cask. The palate is full of very rich and concentrated flavour and has a long mellow finish.

30 Year Old - Hints of dried fruit and honey offset the rich nutty aromas. Lush, silky richness with an elegant, slightly austere quality which is quite distinctive. Subtle dried fruit flavours underlie exotic layers of caramel and nuts culminating in an endless finish.

40 Year Old - An exceptional density, with a powerful nose of dried fruit, honey and a touch of spice. Impressions of nutmeg, roasted coffee and an intense nuttiness converge both in the bouquet and on the palate. The wine’s rich, intense, voluptuous, almost viscous texture culminate in a finish of incredible length.

title: Leviathan Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
Leviathan is a red wine of the vintage from legendary winemaker Andy Erickson, the former winemaker for Screaming Eagle. With two 100-point wines and numerous additional accolades under his belt, Andy is recognized as one of Napa’s premier winemakers. Leviathan began in 2004 as a passion project. Andy wanted to take all of his winemaking experience and vineyard knowledge from around California and create a single red wine that was free from the restraints of appellations and varietals. This is winemaking without restriction.

An intense mix of fresh boysenberry, black cherry and plum jumps from the glass with cocoa powder, allspice and nutmeg. The earthy elements of their rocky northern California hillsides include Bay Laurel, sage, cedar, and dry red earth which speak to its origins. Supple and balanced tannins of this rich wine lead to a long savoury finish with hints of graphite and star anise. It is approachable now and built to cellar.

title: Averill Creek Pinot Noir 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Floral, savory, and spiced aromatics precede a complex fruit profile. Precise, textured acidity aligns with fine tannins and an essential freshness typical of Vancouver Island.

title: Godet 'God By Godet' Cognac Gift Pack
bodyHtml:
God by Godet introduces a 4-Year-Old VSOP, 100% Fins Bois Cognac. On the nose, it offers notes of brioche, rose, vanilla and nutmeg. It has a mellow taste, with a finish of lichee and hay.

God by Godet is presented in a 350 ml bottle with two small glasses, encouraging Cognac lovers to play the role of the master blender in adding water.

title: Trapiche Malbec Terroir Series 'Finca Ambrosia' 2018
bodyHtml:
Trapiche, established in 1883 in Mendoza, Argentina, is one of the country’s most renowned wineries, celebrated for its commitment to quality and innovation. The Terroir Series highlights Trapiche’s dedication to showcasing the unique characteristics of individual vineyards.

The 2018 Trapiche Malbec Terroir Series 'Finca Ambrosia' is crafted from 100% Malbec grapes sourced from the Finca Ambrosia vineyard in Gualtallary, Tupungato, within the Uco Valley. Located at an altitude of 1,307 meters (4,288 feet) above sea level, this vineyard provides ideal conditions for producing high-quality Malbec.

Tasting Notes
This Malbec exhibits a deep red colour with ruby hues. The nose is intense, offering aromas of dark fruits like blackberries and plums, complemented by notes of smoke, mint, spices, thyme, graphite, and licorice. On the palate, it is both fruity and minerally, with gripping tannins and a lingering, refined finish.

Winemaking Process
The grapes are hand-harvested and meticulously selected. Fermentation takes place in small concrete vats with native yeasts, followed by aging in new French oak barrels for 18 months. The wine is then bottled and stored for an additional 12 months before release, allowing it to develop further complexity and depth.

Accolades
The 2018 vintage has garnered critical acclaim:

  • James Suckling: 96 points
  • Robert Parker's Wine Advocate: 92 points
  • Wine Enthusiast: 91 points

Food Pairing
This Malbec pairs beautifully with grilled meats, hearty stews, and aged cheeses, enhancing its rich and complex profile.

The 2018 vintage in the Uco Valley was marked by favorable weather conditions, enabling the grapes to achieve optimal ripeness. Trapiche’s careful vineyard management and expert winemaking techniques have resulted in a wine that exemplifies the elegance and complexity of the region.

title: Tenuta Luzzolini Belfresco 2025
bodyHtml:
Tenuta Iuzzolini Belfresco originates from Italy, specifically from the Calabria region within the eastern-central area of the Crotone province, in the subregion of Carfizzi. Founded by the Iuzzolini family, the winery has long been dedicated to preserving local viticultural traditions while modernizing production in their Niballo estate.

Wine Description

This unique red wine is composed of 100% Gaglioppo, a traditional indigenous grape variety of Calabria. Pouring a brilliant ruby red color accented by vibrant violet reflections, it opens with a highly expressive and charming aromatic profile dominated by fresh red fruits and delicate floral notes. On the palate, the wine is delightfully light to medium bodied, lively, and incredibly soft. Because it undergoes carbonic maceration followed by brief aging entirely in stainless steel tanks, it avoids heavy wood influences, emphasizing purity, exceptional freshness, and an approachable, crisp finish.

title: Maison Champy Bourgogne Pinot Noir 'Cuvee Edme' 2022
bodyHtml: Beautiful bright ruby colour. The nose is intense with aromas of small red fruits, accompanied by a slightly woody note. The attack is fresh and light, with hints of raspberry. This wine offers a supple and crisp finish on soft tannins. This Burgundy Pinot Noir will go perfectly with all light preparations, starters of cheese, or with red or white meats, roasted or in a cream sauce.

title: Shaw and Smith Shiraz Adelaide Hills 2020
bodyHtml:
Shaw + Smith Shiraz is a medium bodied cool-climate Shiraz, in which balance is more important than power.

The Adelaide Hills was long considered too cool to ripen Shiraz. By the early 2000s, though, the potential for outstanding Shiraz from the right sites in the Adelaide Hills was compelling, and the first Shaw + Smith Shiraz was made in the 2002 vintage. Since then, Shiraz in the Hills has gone from strength to strength, its hallmarks being fragrance, intensity, and medium bodied elegance.

title: Billecart Salmon 'Sous Bois' Brut
bodyHtml:
This unique Cuvee, entirely vinified in oak, comprises the three Champenois grape varieties. It masters the art of blending by renewing the ancestral spirit and savoir-faire of the original champagnes. A radiant yellow crystalline appearance with golden glints brought to life by a luminous stream of persistent, fine bubbles. A rich olfactory impact is harmoniously expressed (dried fruits, fresh citrus, and white flesh fruits) and coupled with finely buttered seductive notes. A burst of flavours (notes of grilled brioche and toffee) thanks to the distinguished power and maturity, which is a mark of any great wine of Champagne. Its strength of character and integrity make it an ideal accompaniment to poultry dishes or Girolle mushrooms.

94 Points - James Suckling

A dense Champagne with a tight and linear structure. Compressed and very pretty. Hints of nuts and cream with some pie crust. Some nougat, too. Very long and flavorful. It's one for a meal. One-third of Pinot Meunier, pinot noir and chardonnay. Fermented and aged in barrel for about six months and disgorged July 19, 2020. It's aged six years on lees.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

A finely honed, delicious Champagne featuring a minerally underpinning of saline and chalk accents. Lacy in texture, offering wild cherry and pear fruit flavours, with toast point, lime blossom and lemon pastry cream notes.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The latest release of Billecart's NV Brut Sous Bois offers aromas of green apple, pear and dried fruits framed by a classy patina of buttery pastry and blanched almonds. Medium to full-bodied, elegantly fleshy and nicely concentrated, it's generous and textural, with fine-boned structure, racy acids and a delicate mousse. This is a blend of equal parts Pinot Meunier, Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, made with vins clairs fermented at low temperature in used oak barrels. 

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Fermented and matured in wood before bottling, this Champagne has an extra layer of complexity and richness. It keeps the house's dry and mineral character while adding riper spice and lime flavours.

title: J. Wilkes Pinot Blanc 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: This stainless steel fermented fruity Pinot Blanc is all about the Santa Maria Valley terroir. Straw yellow in color, notes of apples, citrus and cantaloupe on the nose and pears and light minerality on the palate with a medium body and crisp finish. Enjoy with salads, sushi, or Thai food or in warm weather by itself.

title: Domaine De Terres Blanches Pouilly Fume 2023
bodyHtml:
Terres Blanches symbolizes the commitment to quality which has been ingrained within the Saget family for generations. Like a diamond in the rough, it took the skilled work of men and in particular that of consultant, Stéphane Derenoncourt, and his team, to cut through to the quintessence of the Domaine’s magnificent terroirs.

Convinced of Domaine de Terres Blanches’ potential, the man behind the project, Stéphane, and his team, have succeeded in drawing out the mineral expression of their white wines and the delicate character of its reds, thanks to exacting work in the vineyard and on its soil.  With three appellations from Central Loire, the property gives us a true recital of the Sauvignon Blanc varietal, brought out beautifully in the appellations of Sancerre, Pouilly Fumé and Coteaux du Giennois.

title: Drumshanbo Single Pot Irish Whiskey
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Triple Distilled at The Shed Distillery of PJ Rigney, Drumshanbo, Co Leitrim. This single batch whiskey has stayed true to Irish whiskey making traditions. Distilled with Malted Irish Barley, Un-malted Irish Barley & Irish Barra Oats. Un-malted barley imparts a silky mouthfeel when combined with Barra Oats creates an intriguing creaminess & spiciness to the finish that truly sets this Irish whiskey apart. Aged in Sherry Oloroso & Kentucky Bourbon casks.

title: Corralejo Triple Distilled Reposado Tequila
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: The triple-distilled version of Corralejo Reposado's Tequila, made entirely from blue weber agave. Rested in American oak, this is a refreshingly citrusy style of Tequila.

title: Col D'Orcia Rosso di Montalcino 2023
bodyHtml: As one of the original estates of Montalcino and now the largest certified organic estate in Tuscany, Col d’Orcia is a leader in Brunello di Montalcino, helping to define and promote one of Italy’s most prestigious wine regions. Tradition, integrity and sustainability are the pillars of the estate, whose classic style wines are celebrated all over the world.

title: Poncho Criollo Malbec 2024 - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: This Malbec displays fruit aromas of juicy plums and baked black cherries. Notes of dried herbs, ripe red fruits, and spice make for a flavour packed wine.

title: Stoneleigh Sauvignon Blanc Lighter 2023
bodyHtml:
As Winemakers, we are able to capture the natural early ripening characteristics of the Rapaura sub-region appellation, harvesting the grapes early with a full flavour profile to make a range of wines that are 25% lower in alcohol vs. Stoneleigh Classic Sauvignon Blanc.

This wine opens with bright aromas of grapefruit and capsicum, which follow through to the palate, joined by gooseberry, passionfruit and lime flavours.  The wine is refreshingly dry, yet soft and approachable; light in body and big on flavour, with crisp lime notes, lasting long on the finish.

title: Antinori Conte della Vipera 2024
bodyHtml: The wine is produced from a careful selection of Sauvignon Blanc and Semillon. Conte della Vipera is a tribute to the original owners of the castle and its label shows an illustration of San Giovanni’s chapel (Saint John), a small chapel located on the estate.

title: Cantina Del Nebbiolo Moscato D'Asti 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy’s renowned Piedmont region, the Cantina Del Nebbiolo winery is steeped in tradition and dedicated to producing wines of exceptional quality. With a rich history that stretches across generations, the winery focuses on sustainable practices and minimal intervention, allowing the expression of the terroir to shine through. Known for their commitment to excellence, they craft wines that capture the essence of the region’s diverse landscapes.

Wine Description
The Cantina Del Nebbiolo Moscato D'Asti dazzles with its pale golden hue, shimmering with delicate bubbles. On the nose, it presents a vibrant bouquet of fresh peaches, apricots, and a hint of citrus zest, complemented by floral notes of jasmine and orange blossom. The palate is refreshingly sweet, with a lively, effervescent mouthfeel that balances its rich fruitiness with a clean, crisp finish. Medium-bodied, it showcases the signature elegance of Moscato D'Asti, with a delightful touch of honeyed sweetness and a well-rounded acidity. Enjoyable on its own, this wine is best consumed young, within 1–2 years of vintage, to preserve its fresh and lively character.

Food Pairing
Ideal with light desserts such as fruit tarts, citrus-based pastries, or soft cheeses like Brie or mascarpone. The wine also complements fresh fruit salads and can be enjoyed as an aperitif, providing a refreshing contrast to salty snacks. This pairing enhances the wine’s natural sweetness and effervescence, creating a delightful dining experience.

title: Chateau Rousselle Prestige 2020
bodyHtml:
Château Rousselle is located in France, specifically within the Bordeaux region in the Côtes de Bourg appellation. Founded in 1636, the estate occupies a historic site on the hills overlooking the Gironde estuary, where viticulture has existed since the 1st century. Winemaker Vincent Lemaitre acquired the property in 1999, modernizing the cellar and moving toward sustainable practices; the vineyard is currently HVE3 certified and undergoing organic conversion.

Wine Description

The 2020 Chateau Rousselle Prestige presents a deep, sparkling garnet red colour. The aromatic profile is intense, featuring black fruits such as blackberry, morello cherry, and blackcurrant, harmonized with floral hints of violet and spicy notes of toast and vanilla from its time in French oak. On the palate, the wine is rich and round with exceptional concentration and a long, well-balanced finish.

title: Delphis de la Dauphine Bordeaux Rouge 2021
bodyHtml: 100% Merlot. Deep ruby-purple color. Expressive nose with notes of blackcurrant. The wine is round with fine tannins and it lingers in the mouth.

title: Ken Forrester Petit Pinotage 2022
bodyHtml: This cheerfully Petit Pinotage reflects the modern fruit driven wine style that is in huge demand today. Aromas of spicy mulberries, plum pudding and cherries, supported by smoky bacon nuances. Juicy and accessible with soft palate and delicious fruit concentration. Perfect with almost any happy, casual occasion!

title: Miyasaka Shuzo Masumi 'Karakuchi Gold' Blue Sake - 180 ml
bodyHtml:
Brewed by the Miyasaka family since 1662, Masumi is one of Japan's most celebrated breweries and the birthplace of "Association Yeast No. 7". The 'Karakuchi Gold' (often referred to as Masumi Blue due to its label) is classified as a Futsushu, or high-quality table sake. It is a favorite among the brewery's own staff for its reliability and versatility, designed to be a "standard-bearer" for the brand's dry style.

Description

This sake is clear and light-bodied, offering a profile that balances crispness with a subtle richness. The nose is clean and refreshing, featuring mild aromas of young Fuji apples, grains, and a touch of green bamboo. On the palate, it is medium-dry with subdued sweetness and a sharp acidity that provides a "laser-like" focus. Flavours of rice and crisp fruit are tightened by a dry bitterness in the finish, which leaves a lingering hint of umami. It is brewed using a blend of local Nagano rice, including Miyama Nishiki and Hitogokochi, polished to 70%. ABV 15%.

Food Pairing

Karakuchi Gold is prized for its ability to stand up to bold, savory, and even salty flavors. It is an ideal match for "hearty" Japanese fare such as yakitori (grilled chicken), tempura, and sukiyaki. Its sharp finish also makes it a great palate cleanser for oily or rich foods like gyoza, karaage (fried chicken), and miso-based stews. For a Western twist, try it with tomato capellini, grilled fish, or a variety of cheeses. This sake is exceptionally flexible with temperature; serve it chilled for a bold, crisp experience, or warm it (40–45°C) to bring out its softer, mellower side.

title: Aizu Homare Aladdin Bottle Nigori Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by the historic Aizu Homare Brewery (established in 1918), this sake is part of the stylish Aladdin series. The brewery is renowned for its high-quality production, having earned the prestigious Champion Sake title at the International Wine Challenge (IWC) in 2015. The Aladdin series is designed to be approachable and visually striking, packaged in a distinctive bottle shaped like a genie's lamp.

Description

This lightly unfiltered nigori sake offers a cloudy, milky appearance and a rich, creamy texture. The nose is vivid and fruity, featuring prominent aromas of ripe banana, pear, and tropical fruit. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious balance of sweetness and tangy acidity with flavors of coconut, honey, and vanilla. Brewed with Hanafubuki rice polished to 70%, it provides a refreshing experience that is not overly cloying, finishing with a clean and smooth character. ABV 15%–16%.

Food Pairing

The creamy mouthfeel and tropical fruit profile of the Aladdin Nigori make it an excellent partner for spicy and rich foods. It is a classic match for spicy tuna rolls, Thai green curry, and tempura vegetables. It also pairs remarkably well with Western dishes such as creamy cheeses like Brie or Burrata and savory-sweet appetizers. For dessert, try it alongside fruit-based tarts or mochi ice cream. It is best served well-chilled; remember to gently invert the bottle before opening to integrate the rice sediment fully.

title: Aizu Homare Chocolate Nigori Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
The Aizu Homare Chocolate Nigori Sake is from Japan, specifically the Aizu region of Fukushima Prefecture. It is produced by the Homare Sake Brewery, a distinguished brewery established in 1918 that sits at the foot of Mount Iide. Known for combining traditional brewing techniques with innovative flavors. This specific product is a unique liqueur that blends their signature cloudy nigori sake with rich chocolate syrup.

Description

This is a decadent, dessert-style sake that essentially functions as an adult chocolate milk. The sake has comforting aromas of cocoa powder, lightly toasted caramel, and warming vanilla. The palate is thick and velvety, delivering a rich sweetness balanced by the slight bitterness of dark chocolate and the gentle rice notes of the nigori base. It has a creamy, viscous texture due to the coarse rice sediment, yet finishes surprisingly smooth. The ABV is 10%.

title: Aizu Homare Strawberry Nigori Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by the award-winning Aizu Homare Brewery (founded in 1918), this expression is part of their popular fruit-flavoured nigori series. The brewery is situated in the Aizu region, a historic area known as the "Land of Sake," where they benefit from the soft, pure groundwater flowing from the Iide Mountain range. This specific sake combines traditional unfiltered nigori with natural strawberry juice to create a modern, dessert-style beverage.

Description

This sake features a charming, opaque pastel pink colour and a thick, creamy texture characteristic of the nigori style. The aroma is intensely fruity and nostalgic, dominated by the scent of fresh, sun-ripened strawberries and sweet cream. On the palate, it offers a lush and velvety mouthfeel that mimics a strawberry smoothie or a melted strawberry milkshake. The flavour is a rich blend of natural berry sweetness balanced by a gentle, refreshing acidity from a hint of lemon juice. Despite its indulgent profile, the finish remains relatively clean with a subtle rice umami undertone. ABV 10%.

Food Pairing

The sweet and creamy nature of this strawberry nigori makes it a perfect standalone dessert or a companion to sweet treats. It pairs beautifully with dark chocolate, vanilla cheesecake, or fresh berry parfaits. For a surprising savory match, its sweetness and texture can help balance the spice in buffalo wings or hot chili-based appetizers. It is best served well-chilled; remember to turn the bottle gently before pouring to distribute the strawberry and rice solids evenly. It also works excellently as a cocktail base when topped with sparkling water or prosecco.

title: Livio Felluga Vertigo Rosso 2022
bodyHtml:
Livio Felluga Vertigo Rosso 2022 is a red wine from the Friuli Venezia Giulia region in northeastern Italy, produced by the esteemed Livio Felluga winery. This wine embodies the region's diversity by blending traditional and international grape varieties.

Blend Composition:

  • Merlot

  • Cabernet Sauvignon

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Bright, clear ruby red.

  • Aroma: Generous and refined, with upfront notes of dog rose and red fruits like currants, raspberries, and wild blackberries, mingling with citrus hints of blood orange and tangerine zest. Distinctive yellow pepper peel and spicy pink pepper intertwine with the sweetness of cinnamon, cloves, and licorice root.

  • Palate: Dynamic and intuitive, featuring refreshing waves of citrus, small wild berries, and black cherries. A delightfully mouthfilling, close-knit tannic texture with top notes of dark spice, tobacco leaves, and Criollo cocoa beans. The finish is lingering, with a bitterish hint reminiscent of freshly toasted Arabica beans.

Winemaking Process:

  • Fermentation: Carefully destemmed and crushed grapes undergo fermentation with maceration on the skins at controlled temperatures in stainless steel containers.

  • Aging: The wine matures in stainless steel and small French oak barrels, followed by bottle aging in temperature-controlled cellars.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Serve at 16-18°C (60-64°F).

  • Food Pairings: Pairs well with savory first courses, roast pork and beef, meat dishes, or moderately mature cheeses.

title: Trentham Estate 'River Retreat' Brut (NV)
bodyHtml: Light green straw in colour with a fine persistent bead showing lifted aromas of citrus and apple.  Tasting soft and refreshing with light creaminess and balance.

title: Crystal Head Aurora Vodka
bodyHtml:
Creativity is at the heart of everything they do. It is why they craft the purest, smoothest vodka with one-of-a-kind packaging and imaginative thinking. Crystal Head uses only the highest-quality ingredients to create unique expressions of ultra-premium vodka that are completely additive-free. They do it for all the creative spirits who think differently, to inspire them in their creative pursuits and to bring out their creativity, without compromise. Unlike other vodka brands, Crystal Head views the world differently, without limitations.

The Crystal Head bottle was designed with the creative spirit in mind by creative people. Together, Dan Aykroyd and John Alexander designed the iconic skull-shaped bottle as a symbol of life, reflecting power and enlightenment.

title: Bouchard Pere & Fils Chardonnay Bourgogne 2021
bodyHtml: Pale straw colour. Green apple, pear, citrus and minerals with touch of almond on the nose. Dry, crisp and clean with a hint of clove and a long citrus finish.

title: Slipknot No. 9 Iowa Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Much-loved heavy metal band Slipknot has teamed up with Cedar Ridge Distillery to created Slipknot No.9 Whiskey! Blended by Slipknot's very own Shawn "Clown" Crahan, the whiskey features Iowa corn as well as a helping of rye, which brings a kick of spice to the fore. Both Slipknot and Cedar Ridge hail from Iowa, and judging by the whiskey they've made together, they seem like a fantastic fit. With that in mind, listen to Slipknot's Iowa album, pour yourself a glass and enjoy!

FARM-TO-TABLE made with Iowa corn.

SWEET & SPICY due to the amount of corn and rye in the mashbill, 56% corn, 36% rye and 8% malted barley.

BOLD FLAVOUR finishing these expressions at higher 90/99 proofs, lead to more robust, complex sipping whiskeys.

title: Kentucky Owl Confiscated
bodyHtml: Kentucky Owl 'Confiscated' pays tribute to the barrels seized from the Kentucky Owl distillery before prohibition. On the nose, you’ll experience hints of peach, mature oak, vanilla, and tobacco with aromas of cardamom. The palate fills with spicy oak, peaches and cream, and cinnamon butter while the finish offers herbal notes and lots of spice, rounded off by nutmeg.

title: The Velvet Devil Merlot 2022
bodyHtml: When Hollywood's surprise hit Sideways suddenly spawned anti-Merlot sentiments everywhere, Charles set out to rebuff the movie's unflattering depiction of this great varietal. One sip of this bold, sultry creation and you'll know he succeeded at making Merlot sexy again. As advertised, this smooth Merlot offers pure velvet, deep and delicious black fruit, cedar, tobacco and cassis. It conveys concentrated richness and yet purity and focus. It's so good that it appears the devil made Charles do it. A great pairing with burgers with all the fixins, grilled steak and anything with bacon.

title: Adictivo Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Adictivo Añejo Tequila is a premium spirit crafted from 100% pure Blue Weber Agave, meticulously produced in the El Arenal region of Jalisco, Mexico. Aged for two years in French oak barrels, it boasts an intense golden amber hue and a harmonious blend of flavours that set it apart.

Tasting Notes

  • Aroma: The nose reveals inviting scents of dried fruits and toasted oak, complemented by subtle hints of vanilla and caramel.
  • Palate: On the palate, it offers a silky texture with flavours of cooked agave, oak, and a touch of sweetness, leading to a smooth and satisfying finish.

Production Process
Adictivo Añejo is produced using traditional methods, including cooking the agave in brick ovens and fermenting in stainless steel tanks. The tequila undergoes double distillation and is aged in French oak barrels, which impart its rich flavours and complexity.

Accolades
This expression has earned recognition for its exceptional quality, including a Double Gold medal at the 2017 San Diego Spirits Festival.

For those seeking a refined and flavorful añejo tequila, Adictivo Añejo represents the rich traditions of Mexican tequila craftsmanship and is an excellent choice for sipping or pairing with fine cuisine.

title: Adictivo Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Adictivo Tequila is produced in El Arenal Jalisco, the gateway to the blue region of tequila. The agave landscape and ancient distilleries have been marked indelibly to this region in its passage through time, forging a distinct identity and style, traditionally produced in order to preserve the purity of the agave.

Adictivo Doble Reposado was created by Master Distiller Gildardo Partida and aged in French oak barrels for 8 months. The result is an aroma of cooked agave, caramel, vanilla, and oak. On the palate is more cooked agave with honey and butterscotch giving way to strong oak notes. The finish is long for a Reposado, with some mild alcohol and a lingering sweetness. Enjoy neat or over ice.

title: Adictivo Plata Tequila
bodyHtml:
General Information

Tequila Adictivo Plata is 100% pure Blue Agave, flashing silver crystal colour, with a soft, warm flavour and herbaceous aromas.

title: Dandelion Vineyard Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: Distinctive lifted fresh Sauvignon fruit purity, aromas of fragrant gooseberries, herbaceous Thai basil and just cut green grass as well as complex hints of white roses and even a little spruce. High impact and mouth-filling with more zingy gooseberry fruit and fresh layers of mineral like flavour in the middle palate before a long zesty citrus tinged, juicy fruit finish.

title: Banfi Brunello di Montalcino 2021
bodyHtml:
This remarkable wine hails from Italy, specifically the renowned region of Tuscany, within the storied subregion of Montalcino. Castello Banfi, founded in 1978 by the Mariani family of New York, has become one of Montalcino’s most recognized estates. The winery is celebrated for its commitment to combining modern winemaking technology with a deep respect for tradition, which has helped elevate the global reputation of Brunello di Montalcino.

Wine Description

The Banfi Brunello di Montalcino presents a luminous ruby-red colour with garnet reflections. On the nose, it reveals complex aromas of ripe red cherry, blackberry, and subtle violet, interwoven with hints of tobacco, leather, and delicate spice from refined oak ageing. The palate is full-bodied and elegant, offering silky tannins and balanced acidity that carry flavours of plum, dark cherry, and a whisper of cocoa. The finish is long and graceful, showcasing the wine’s depth and impressive structure.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 94 points.

  • Wine Spectator – 94 points.

  • Wine Advocate – 93 points.

Food Pairing

Ideal with Tuscan classics such as bistecca alla Fiorentina, aged Pecorino cheese, and rich mushroom risottos. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: High West Double Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Double Rye! is a blend of two different rye whiskeys. It is also crafted to be twice as spicy (think cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves) than your average rye whiskey.  It has gorgeous aromas of mint, clove, cinnamon, licorice root, pine nuts, and dark chocolate, with a surprising dose of gin botanicals throughout.  The palate shows Rye spices up front, then menthol, mint, eucalyptus, herbal tea with wildflower honey and allspice.

Thanks to its balance of cinnamon, anise, and honey, High West Double Rye! stands on its own in cocktails, but is great served neat, with a little water, or on the rocks.  Its spirited flavor fortifies classic cocktails like the Manhattan and Old Fashioned. We recommend it for most occasions - sipping it in solitude by a campfire, savoring with favorite old friends, or sharing it with a good-looking stranger.

title: High West Rendezvous Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Rendezvous Rye is High West's flagship whiskey, now available as a seasonal and limited release that has evolved to include more of our own coveted High West pot still rye! Collect each year’s release to taste through the aromatic and flavor nuances that they will leverage year to year to bring you an unparalleled quality product! Almost every other straight rye whiskey you can buy today is barely legal, with 51-53% rye in the mash bill. Not Rendezvous Rye. It honors the way rye whiskey used to be made, with a high rye content and full, uncompromised flavor. With Rendezvous Rye, you get a taste of authentic rye whiskey. 

The nose has notes of poached pear, bitter orange, ground ginger, lavender, wet sandalwood, and tanned leather on a well-used wooden workbench.  The palate reveals flavours of persimmon, dried apricot, snickerdoodle, ginger chews, walnut sauce, and spiced caramels in a cedar gift box.

title: High West Straight Bourbon Whiskey
bodyHtml: Another bottling by High West while their own spirit matures, showing off their ability to select great whiskeys. This is a blend of 6 and 10 year old bourbon produced in honour of the nascent American Prairie Reserve, an area the size of Connecticut that will hopefully one day be the largest grassland wildlife reserve in the USA.

title: Adictivo Tequila Gift Pack - 4 x 50 ml Bottles
bodyHtml: The perfect gift for the Tequila lover in your life or a great way to explore the impact of aging on Tequila. This collection includes a 50 ml bottle of Plata, Reposado, Anejo and Extra Anejo.

title: Giffard Wild Elderflower
bodyHtml: The intensely aromatic blossoms are naturally dried and macerated in small batches to extract their fragrance and flavors, reminiscent of honeysuckle, muscat grapes, rose, lychee, and saffron.

title: Georges Vigouroux 'Gouleyant' Malbec 2020
bodyHtml:
Georges Vigouroux The Cahors Gouleyant from the wine-growing region Sud-Ouest is revealed in the glass in bright crimson. 

The first nose of the Cahors Gouleyant presented by plums, mulberries and black cherries. The fruity aspects of the bouquet are complemented by even more fruity-balsamic nuances. This French wine impresses with its elegantly dry taste.

title: Dalmore Port Wood Reserve
bodyHtml: The fruit of Dalmore's experiments with casks from around the world, this port wood reserve marries Dalmore's weighty whisky with thick port-cask fruit and spice. Matured first in American white oak bourbon casks, it is then finished in port pipes from W&J Graham before being bottled at a punch 46.5%. Creamy and fruity with controlled sweetness.

title: Compass Box Spice Tree
bodyHtml: Primary maturation: first-fill and refill American oak. Secondary maturation: custom barrels with heavily toasted new French oak heads sourced from 195 year-old Vosges forests. Bottled at 46%. Not chill-filtered. Natural colour.

title: Cava De Oro Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: Cava De Oro Extra Anejo Tequila is a true gem of spirits, captivating connoisseurs with its exquisite flavour profile and unparalleled craftsmanship. Renowned critics have hailed it as a masterpiece deserving of the highest praise. One critic praises its "velvety texture and complex layers of caramel, vanilla, and toasted oak," while another commends its "exceptional smoothness and long, luxurious finish." With each sip, this tequila unveils a symphony of flavours that dance on the palate, leaving a lasting impression. Cava De Oro Extra Anejo Tequila is a testament to the artistry and dedication that goes into creating a truly exceptional spirit.

title: Hornitos Anejo Cristalino Tequila
bodyHtml: Distinctive Anejo notes—vanilla and butterscotch, rounded with sweet honey— delivering an exceptionally silky Cristalino experience, sip after sip.

title: Carpene Malvolti Brut Sparkling Rose
bodyHtml:
Produced using the same Charmat Method as Prosecco, this Brut Rose is made with Raboso and varying local varieties depending on the vintage. Delicately pink in color, wild berry and cherry aromas, dry with a fine and lingering perlage. Ideal with seafood, white meats and mild cheeses.  85% Pinot Nero, 15% Raboso.

Deepish red with hints of crimson. Perfumed and floral with elegant yet intense notes of wild berries and morello cherries. Full, tangy, rounded fruit on the palate

title: Luigi Bosca La Linda Old Vines Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from Argentina, specifically from the Luján de Cuyo region within Mendoza, an area celebrated for its exceptional Malbec. Luigi Bosca is one of Argentina’s most historic wineries, founded in 1901 by the Arizu family, who continue to run the estate today. Their dedication to terroir-driven winemaking and sustainable viticulture has positioned them as a benchmark for high-quality Argentinian wines.

Wine Description
This 2024 vintage of La Linda Old Vines Malbec presents a deep ruby-red colour with violet hues. On the nose, it offers inviting aromas of ripe blackberries, plums, and delicate floral hints of violets, layered with subtle notes of vanilla and spice from oak aging. The palate is rich and rounded, displaying smooth tannins, juicy dark fruit flavours, and a touch of cocoa. Medium to full-bodied, the wine has a balanced acidity and a lingering, elegant finish.

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled flank steak, lamb chops with chimichurri, or a hearty mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Inniskillin Vidal Icewine 2024 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Vidal is a hybrid (Ugni Blanc and Seibel) with thick skin suitable for harvesting late in the season. It is the grape grown most for Icewine in Ontario. Its good natural acidity gives great structure to the lusciousness of its tropical aromas and flavours of mango and lychee. Inniskillin Vidal Icewine is made in two distinct styles-without oak aging for fresh fruit emphasis and with oak aging for added complexity.

title: Appleton 8 Year Old Reserve Rum
bodyHtml: A dark rum blended from 20 pot and column still rums from Jamaica. This was aged for a minimum of 8 years and offers lots of dark sugar and honey character.

title: Tenuta Luzzolini Ciro Bianco 2024
bodyHtml: Ciro is made with Greco Bianco grapes from Calabria - in the eastern center of the province of Crotone, in Cirò Marina in the 'Timpa Bianca' area. Straw yellow colour with greenish hues.  Fruity and fragrant, delicate, floral with aromas referable to the Passionflower. The palate is soft, fresh, lively, pleasantly harmonious.

title: Redbreast Lustau Edition
bodyHtml:
General Information

Redbreast Lustau Edition was born of a unique collaboration between the Bodegas Lustau and the Midleton Distillery. The result is the ultimate sherried style of Redbreast. 46% alc./vol.

title: Chateau La Tour de Mons 2020
bodyHtml: One of the best values in the Margaux region!  An intense ruby red color. The very expressive fruity nose reveals cocoa, blackcurrants and black plums notes softly smoked. The attack is elegant and presents a well-balanced structure with a beautiful dense and round mouth balanced. The palate ends on soft tannins.  This Bordeaux red pairs well with red meats, poultry and game.

title: Demuerte White 2023
bodyHtml:
Demuerte White is a white wine of great quality, also natural from the Yecla area. With this new addition, the winery offers the DEMUERTE fervent followers a white wine that offers the same original style, casual and with a wild touch of this original and attractive range.

Its label, in the same way as the rest of the brand’s elaborations, represents the traditional skull but this time with light and bright tones. White combines with a refreshing peach tone and gold accents.

An elegant label, which perfectly expresses the quality and characteristics of the wine it contains inside. A white whose final drink reminds of fruits and herbs and whose aroma also reminds of white flowers, peach in syrup and hints of apricot, citrus and tropical fruits.

title: Bradshaw Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml: Born in the heart of Kentucky Bourbon Country, Bradshaw Bourbon is distilled by a third-generation Master Distiller at one of the oldest distilleries in the nation. Bottled at 51.9% as a tribute to Terry Bradshaw's passing completion rate of 51.9%, Bradshaw Bourbon is a serious bourbon for the ages that is sure to garner the following and respect of its namesake.

title: Escorihuela Gascon 1884 Organic Malbec 2021
bodyHtml: Friendly with a tasty and refreshing mid-palate thanks to the vibrant acidity. Medium-bodied with juicy tannins which provide firmness and a prolonged finish. Fruity and spicy aftertaste with earthy tones. It is a wine faithful to its origin and ideal to accompany grilled red meat, hard cheese and a variety of cold cuts.

title: Blasted Church Syrah 2023
bodyHtml: The deep purple colour of this wine pairs well with the dark cherry and toasty oak bouquet. You might catch a hint of pepper, which adds to the balanced acidic backbone with smooth tannins and a long finish.

title: Caparzo Rosso di Montalcino 2024
bodyHtml:
This wine is from Italy, originating in the Tuscany region, specifically the Rosso di Montalcino DOC. Caparzo is one of the 30 historical wineries in Montalcino, established in the late 1960s. The winery's name is thought to originate from Ca' Pazzo, meaning 'House of the Crazy,' as seen in ancient maps. A key strength of Caparzo is that it possesses vineyards in nearly all of Montalcino's best areas, which allows the estate to draw the best from every vintage. The estate's philosophy is centred on maintaining faith with the traditions of Brunello and the local terroirs, while also embracing a creative spirit and dedication to innovation to ensure the highest quality. In 1977, Caparzo was a pioneer in Montalcino, introducing the concept of Cru by vinifying grapes from the La Casa vineyard separately.

Wine Description

The Caparzo Rosso di Montalcino 2024 is an intense ruby red in color. It is made from 100% Sangiovese grapes. The bouquet is complex and persistent, with an expressive nose that is reminiscent of violets, raspberries, and pomegranates. Some primary taste impressions noted are very young cherries, sweet licorice, and cedar.

On the palate, the wine is described as warm, dry, generous (or rich), and well-balanced. It has a medium body, silky tannins, and lively acidity. Stylistically, it is characterised as strong, spicy, and earthy, with perceptible tannins and acidity. The wine is structured to perfectly embody the Caparzo philosophy of technical perfection with a great sense of terroir. The wine is aged for four to eight months in a combination of stainless steel and oak wood, followed by a minimum of three months in the bottle. The optimal drinking window is suggested for several years of aging (four to eight) for those with patience, but it can also be enjoyed in its youth.

title: Poppy Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Poppy was founded by the Silva Family who have spent over 45 years diligently tending to the land of the beautiful Salinas Valley. Founded on the principles of developing consistently elegant and approachable wines, a glass of Poppy is the quintessential California wine experience. When deciding on a name, the Silva’s wanted something that spoke to the great state of California where their family had settled so many years ago. One day, while looking at wild poppies growing amongst the vines, the name was born. Celebrating the state of California and its golden blooming flowers, Poppy is a proud symbol for this great wine.

This wine displays blueberry, black cherry and currant flavours with nuances of liquorice, violets and cigar box all wrapped together with a dash of vanilla and mocha. Medium to full-bodied, well-balanced, with soft tannins, this wine shows tremendous dimension, with a seamless finish that lingers throughout the palate.

title: Santo Fino Mezquila
bodyHtml:
Santo Mezquila is the world’s first agave blend made from 100% Blue Weber Agave and 100% Espadin Agave. From this holy union comes a taste revelation.

Mezquila’s smooth agave aroma mixes with an earthy, light smokiness with a hint of herbs. The initial bite is mellow and fades gently while the full taste and finish elicits the intricate agave flavor and herbal complexity layered with gentle smoke, slight floral fruitiness and low saltiness.

title: Santo Fino Tequila Blanco
bodyHtml:
When Sammy Hagar gets together with friends in Cabo San Lucas you never know what's coming next. So begins the history behind Santo’s Tequila Blanco and Mezquila - both borne out of good friends, great food, a lot of tequila and the search for a taste revelation: “a higher spirit.”  Together, rocker Sammy Hagar and chef Guy Fieri found their virtuoso with Juan Eduardo Nuñez, the third-generation master distiller from the famed distillery El Viejito, founded in 1937, in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. 

Sammy’s history of making world-renowned tequila, Guy’s world-famous taste buds, and Juan Eduardo’s award-winning craftsmanship, bring to life the portfolio of Santo spirits; a sinfully smooth old world style tequila blanco, an oak-aged reposado, and the world’s first mezquila.

Santo Tequila Blanco is made from only the finest 100% Blue Weber Agave from the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. To the pure, all things are pure.  Their Tequila Blanco is smooth, with balanced and notable agave. Full and complex notes in taste are complimented by earthy, white pepper and citrus aromas. Delicate spice and floral flavors add to the intensity of the agave.

title: The Macallan 12 Year Old Double Cask - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
The Macallan brings new Oak from America across thousands of miles to Spain, where casks are crafted and sherry-seasoned before traveling to the distillery in Speyside, where they are filled and matured for at least 12 years. These whiskies are then harmoniously united with those aged in exceptional sherry-seasoned European Oak casks. The delicate flavour of American Oak, vanilla, citrus and light Oak, rises in prominence as the traditional Macallan European Oak character of dried fruit and wood spice affords a familiar backdrop. The result is a fresh and approachable style of Macallan, rich in flavour, honeyed and indulgent, with a fantastic viscous mouthfeel. Suitable for all occasions, Double Cask 12 Years Old will appeal to existing and new Macallan drinkers alike, also serving as the perfect complement to its slightly more robust counterpart, the Sherry Oak 12 Years Old.

For more information visit The Macallan Website.

title: Eau Claire Flourish Gin
bodyHtml:
Flourish Gin is Eau Claire Distilleries' newest gin release. A new contemporary gin crafted for at-home cocktails. Flourish Gin is a fun and approachable gin that inspires the revival of the home bartender. Whether you are hosting a happy hour or sipping cocktails with close friends and family, Flourish Gin embraces the resurgence of the cocktail hour. The new spirit was made to make bartending in your own home fun!

The light, sweet gin beams with floral, fruity aromas and celebrates new beginnings. Inspired by the wildflowers of the Alberta and Canadian prairies, this exciting and enjoyable gin will make new and seasoned at-home cocktail enthusiasts fall in love with experimentation.

title: Petra Zingari 2017
bodyHtml:
#29 Wine Spectator Top 100 of 2019

The wine traces its roots to an ancient water spring that was a stop-over for all those pilgrims and wayfarers who were travelling along the Aurelia Street, hence the name Zingari (Gipsies), and could seek refreshment by resting nearby its crystal clear waters.

Highly concentrated ruby color, which introduces the Mediterranean aromatic notes of this wine. Soft and full-bodied in mouth, it has a fresh flavor with good acidity and a structure with balsamic and mineral notes that make Zingari pleasant and interesting.

93 Points - Wine Spectator    A well of dark cherry, black currant and blackberry fruit makes this red sumptuous and inviting. Fresh earth, thyme and rosemary accents add depth. A mineral element emerges on the long finish. Shows fine balance overall. Merlot, Sangiovese, Petit Verdot and Syrah. Drink now through 2032.

title: Cinco Sentidos Pichomel Mezcal
bodyHtml:
From the high desert of Southwestern Puebla, this beautiful expression of Pichomel (A. Marmorata) is a tropical masterpiece, especially perfect for warmer weather. This small batch of only 180 liters was distilled by maestro mezcalero Atelo Ramirez and his wife Laura Arriaga. Agave Pichomel grows wild in the high dessert and tends to have a very low yield. Don Atelo is the only mezcalero in the village of Los Reyes Metzontla, and his mezcales are highly prized within the region for their vibrant flavors and approachability. His agaves are hand-smashed using a wooden mallet. Distillation is with a pot still made of steel, clay, and copper.

Aromas: Intense Notes of Banana Laffy-Taffy, Plaintain Skin.

Palate: A Juicy and Sweet Melody of Tropical Fruits, Strawberry Cheesecake and Light, Complementary Smoke.

title: The Forager Botanical Whisky
bodyHtml: Located in Grimsby, Ontario, Forty Creek has been making top-quality Canadian whisky since 1992 and infused with botanicals, including juniper berries, spruce tips and Labrador Tea, sourced from the Canadian wilderness. Look for notes of vanilla, butterscotch, almond and spice. Medium and smooth. Serve with tonic over ice.

title: Carpineto Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2021
bodyHtml: Deep ruby red due to the high concentration of anthocyanins. Pronounced aromas of wild berries, interlaced with hints of vanilla and spicy notes on the finish: it’s complexity will amplify during the extraordinary longevity of this wine. Palate sensations confirm and emphasize the olfactory complexity, revealing even greater strength, texture and persistence. Its elegance is already evident, destined to turn into absolute harmony with cellaring.  Pair this wine with succulent roasts, braised or grilled meat - a perfect match with fiorentina T-bone steak.

title: Ventisquero Vertice 2021
bodyHtml: Deep red with violet hues. The nose reveals black fruit, such as blackberries, intermingled with gentle spices, such as black pepper, damp earth, notes of native forest and a hint of graphite and soft spices. This wine has a firm structure and silky tannins. Its black fruit and spicy flavours, together with medium to high acidity, lend balance in the mouth and persistence in the finish. This wine is superb paired with spicy food, such as Indian, Thai, Mexican and Spanish cuisine and other more complex dishes. It also goes well with semi-ripe cheese and intensely flavoured meat such as wild boar and venison.

title: Prunotto Barolo 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Italy, within the esteemed Barolo D.O.C.G. appellation of Piedmont's Langhe district. Prunotto, a historic estate dating back to 1904, has been managed under the stewardship of the renowned Antinori family since 1989. Combining century-old Langhe winemaking traditions with refined precision, Prunotto focuses on preserving varietal authenticity and showcasing the nuanced terroirs of Piedmont. Sourced from choice vineyard plots across key Barolo communes including Monforte d'Alba, Serralunga d'Alba, and Castiglione Falletto the vines are rooted in ancient Helvetian and Tortonian soils composed of calcareous clay, marl, and sandstone. The region's cool continental climate, characterized by warm autumn days and crisp fog-laden nights (nebbia), allows the Nebbiolo grapes to ripen slowly, developing intense aromatic complexity and a formidable tannic architecture.

Wine Description

The 2021 Prunotto Barolo presents a luminous, pale garnet-ruby color in the glass with light orange and brick reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a quintessential, textbook expression of classic Langhe Nebbiolo. The bouquet opens with a captivating, multi-faceted display of dried red roses, wild sour cherries, and tart cranberries, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of sweet tobacco leaf, leather, anise, crushed limestone, and a signature line of tar, licorice, and forest floor. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, taut, and precisely focused, showcasing a bright core of red stone fruits, blood orange peel, and dried spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts through the mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is linear and athletic, framed by firm, fine-grained, and chalky Nebbiolo tannins that carry into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by lingering notes of iron, dried herbs, and earth.

This high-definition regional expression is 100% Nebbiolo, hand-harvested at optimal physiological ripeness. The grapes underwent careful destemming and crushing followed by temperature-controlled skin contact and fermentation in stainless steel tanks for approximately 8 to 12 days. To polish its firm Nebbiolo tannins while honoring pure varietal expression, the wine completed malolactic conversion and was matured for approximately 18 to 24 months in large, traditional French and Slavonian oak casks (botti grandi), followed by additional bottle aging prior to release. It reaches an effortlessly balanced alcohol content (ABV) of 14.0% to 14.5% and is finished bone-dry.

title: Frescobaldi Tenuta Perano Chianti Classico Riserva 2019
bodyHtml:
The 2019 Tenuta Perano Chianti Classico Riservais an intense shade of ruby red. The bold and complex bouquet combines floral notes of sweet violet with aromas of red berries. The tertiary scents are reminiscent of leather, tobacco and delicate peppery notes.

On the palate, it is fresh, dry, savoury and brimming with tannins. The flavours and aromas create a remarkable sensory experience, with notes of red berries that reappear and enhance the sensation of freshness.

title: Jasci & Marchesani Organic Montepulciano d'Abruzzo 2022
bodyHtml:
Located in Vasto, Abruzzo, along the Adriatic coast is the Jasci & Marchesani winery. Founded in 1978 by Sebastiano Jasci, this was one of the earliest Italian wineries to adopt organic farming techniques. With the help of his wife, Lucia Marchesani, Sebastiano started by selling wines exclusively to the locals near the town. He would load up the wines into their little truck and deliver everything himself. Eventually, they were joined by their sons Ludovico and Nicola, who manage the winery today.

The Jasci & Marchesani Montepulciano d’Abruzzo is made from 100% Montepulciano harvested from plots in Vasto, Monteodorisio, and Casalbordino. It was aged 6 months in oak barrels. It has an intense ruby-red colour with light violet highlights. The nose has the hallmark Montepulciano qualities of dark fruit and dried herbs alongside vanilla notes. This wine is full-bodied and austere, the perfect accompaniment to meats and cheeses and Friday night pizza!

title: Angostura 5 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
General Information

Aged for five years in charred American oak bourbon barrels, Angostura 5 Years Old is a great-value gold rum.

Made from a blend of light and heavy molasses revealing its deep character, it presents chocolate, spice, vanilla and toasted oak flavors and provides a remarkably warm and mellow finish. It can be enjoyed neat as a sipping rum, or over ice, but its deep character lends to being mixed with stronger mixes, spices, and herbs.

title: Serafini & Vidotto Phigaia 'After the Red' Rosso 2021
bodyHtml:
Ruby red of great brilliance with a slight shimmer of pomegranate on the surface.

First impression in the nose: rich in fruity notes of Amarena cherries, sour cherries and black currants, followed by elegant herbal nuances and fried pepper as well as coffee, vanilla bean and pink pepper.

Exquisite and persuading the first impression on the tongue with fresh fruity notes, round tannins and a great elegance which is combined with spicy softness and well-balanced alcohol; persistent spicy finish with a hint of licorice.

title: Potter's Special Old Canadian Rye Whisky
bodyHtml: Premium Rye Whisky distilled from local Western Canadian grains & aged 8 years in oak for ultimate flavour and smoothness.

title: Boutinot Cuvee Jean Paul Blanc Sec 2022
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: A fresh nose of lime, basil, freshly cut green grass and guavas. The medium-bodied palate continues with more green fruits and flowers; figs and tobacco flowers.

title: Chateau Sansonnet 2019
bodyHtml:
96 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Another beautiful wine from the Lefevere family that does everything right, the 2019 Chateau Sansonnet has a textbook Saint-Emilion bouquet of chalky minerality, ripe red and black fruits, notes of truffle and flowers, medium to full body, and beautiful overall balance. 

94+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Opaque garnet-purple in color, the 2019 Sansonnet comes skipping out of the glass with vibrant notes of Morello cherries, blueberry compote, mulberries and warm black plums plus hints of raspberry leaves, Sichuan pepper, cassia and cumin seed with a waft of tree bark. The full-bodied palate is packed with crunchy black and red fruits, framed by exquisitely ripe, rounded tannins and bold freshness, finishing very long and mineral laced. Beautiful!

94 Points - James Suckling

Ripe blackberries, cherries, praline, walnuts and lavender on the nose. It’s medium-to full-bodied with fine, plush tannins. Creamy and polished.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This is both lush and structured, with a gush of dark, steeped cassis, blackberry and fig notes leading the way and quickly followed by singed alder and juniper, warm humus and cast iron notes, which really linger.

title: Jinro Grapefruit Soju - 360 ml
bodyHtml:
South Korea, Seoul. Produced by HiteJinro, the world's best-selling spirits producer, this expression is a cornerstone of the flavored soju revolution. Jinro has been a pioneer in the industry since 1924, and the grapefruit variant remains one of its most internationally recognized products. It is crafted using a multi-step bamboo charcoal filtration process, which removes impurities to ensure a clean, smooth base that allows the vibrant fruit profile to take center stage.

Description

This clear, fruit-infused spirit offers a refreshing alternative to traditional high-proof distilled liquors. The nose is bright and zesty, dominated by the natural, sun-ripened aroma of fresh pink grapefruit. On the palate, it delivers a masterful balance of juicy sweetness and the characteristic tart bitterness of grapefruit zest. The texture is light and silky, providing an easy-drinking experience where the citrus brightness masks the alcohol remarkably well. It finishes with a crisp, clean tang that makes it exceptionally thirst-quenching. ABV 13%.

Food Pairing

The high acidity and citrus punch of Jinro Grapefruit make it a versatile companion for savory and oily foods. It is a classic pairing for Korean BBQ, particularly grilled pork belly (samgyeopsal) or beef ribs (galbi), as the citrus cuts through the fat. It also pairs brilliantly with spicy dishes such as spicy seafood soup (jjamppong) or hot wings, where the fruitiness provides a cooling contrast to the heat. For a light snack, serve it chilled alongside fresh fruit platters or salty edamame. It is best enjoyed ice-cold,

title: Boutinot Les Cerisiers Rose Cotes du Rhone 2023
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Intent on making the very best Côtes du Rhône Rosé we can, we search for varieties naturally suited to rosé; Grenache Noir for body, Cinsault for freshness and a touch of spice from a drop of Syrah. A pale and very elegant rosé with a soft plump texture, good depth and length. It has delicate red fruit flavours combined with hints of white pepper and some of the aromatic herbal perfumes of the Southern Rhône.

title: Egly Ouriet Brut Rose Grand Cru (NV)
bodyHtml: 60% Pinot Noir, 40% Chardonnay, with a small addition of Ambonnay Rouge, drawn from cask. A bouquet of roses and small red berries announces the wine's subtle, delicate perfume. The mouth shows more red fruit with a smooth, almost buttery quality; the density and complexity here are unparalleled. White pepper and wet stones follow on a lengthy, lively finish. A superb rosé.

title: El Dorado Single Still Port Mourant 2009 Rum
bodyHtml:
General Information

The El Dorado Single Still Port Mourant Rum is produced from the Double Wooden Pot Still which is the only one of its kind in use today. Constructed in 1732 on the Port Mourant Estate, this still was later moved to the Uitvlugt Estate and then to Diamond Estate in 2000.

Since then, the Double Wooden Pot Still has been producing small batches of this El Dorado Heritage Rum. This rum was laid down in oak barrels for 12 years.

title: El Dorado Single Still Versailles 2009 Rum
bodyHtml:
General Information

The 18th Century estate at Plantation Versailles, then owned by the French family L’Amirault, was situated on the West Bank of the Demerara River and was famous for its golden rum. Distilled on the Single Wooden Pot Still, the rum is coloured with caramel prior to ageing in oak barrels for 12 years.

This rum celebrates the smooth chocolately palate of a fine aged rum.

title: El Dorado Single Still Enmore 2006 Rum
bodyHtml:
General Information

The El Dorado Enmore EHP Demerara rum is distilled in wooden continuous Coffey stills built in 1880 and based on the designs of Aeneas Coffey, Irish distiller and inventor of the Coffey stills. "EHP" refers to Edward Henry Porter, former owner of the Enmore plantation in Guyana. Butterscotch nose blended with roasted coconut and apple. An initial taste of baked peach and coconut with a smoky cedar finish. Excellent mouthfeel.

title: Cava de Oro Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: Cava de Oro Tequila Añejo has a rich amber / golden tone, a body of medium velvety weight and a generous mezcal of aromas of honey, nutmeg, black pepper, caramel and toasted oak. The aromatic compounds are very well recreated on the palate, along with the flavors of vanilla, red plums and cinnamon that emerge during the prolonged finish.

title: Herradura Selection Suprema Tequila
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Herradura Selección Suprema Tequila Extra Añejo is an ultra-premium flagship spirit originating from Amatitán in the Valles (Lowlands) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Produced at Casa Herradura at the historic Hacienda San José del Refugio (NOM 1119), it was unveiled in 1995 as the distillery's first official Extra Añejo expression. Recognizing the depth achievable through long maturation, Herradura cemented this bottle as an icon of luxury tequila crafting, designed to rival the complexity of fine aged cognacs and rare whiskies.

Spirit Description

Herradura Selección Suprema is crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves harvested after reaching peak maturity. The agaves are slow-roasted in traditional brick ovens for 26 hours and fermented naturally with wild yeasts before undergoing double distillation in copper pot stills. The spirit is then aged for 49 months (over four years) in American white oak barrels, far exceeding the three-year legal requirement for the Extra Añejo category.

  • Colour: Deep golden caramel to rich dark amber with mahogany highlights.

  • Aroma: Intensely aromatic and layered, opening with rich cooked agave, warm cinnamon, dried fruits, tobacco leaf, and toasted oak, followed by dark chocolate, vanilla bean, and delicate floral notes of rose petal.

  • Palate: Remarkably rich, balanced, and decadent on the entry. Upfront notes of roasted agave, butterscotch, and sweet vanilla give way to toasted oak, spiced pecans, dried citrus peel, and gentle baking spices.

  • Body: Full-bodied with a heavy, silky, and coating viscosity that delivers a lush mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Long, creamy, and warming, tapering off with persistent toasted oak, sweet vanilla, soft pepper, and lingering caramel warmth.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Domaine Lafage Bastide Miraflors Syrah & Vieilles Vignes Grenache 2023
bodyHtml:
Owned and operated by Jean-Marc and Eliane Lafage, Domaine Lafage is a family-run estate located near Perpignan in the heart of Roussillon. With vineyards stretching from the Mediterranean coast to the foothills of the Pyrenees, the estate is known for crafting expressive wines that reflect its diverse terroir. The Bastide Miraflors cuvée showcases the estate’s commitment to combining old-vine heritage with modern precision.

Wine Description

The nose reveals intense aromas of blackberries, ripe plums, violets, and crushed peppercorns, with underlying notes of smoked meat and garrigue herbs. On the palate, it is full-bodied and structured, offering layers of dark fruit, licorice, and a subtle hint of oak spice from partial aging in 600-litre French oak demi-muids. The tannins are smooth and well-integrated, leading to a long, savoury finish with mineral tension and finesse.

Food Pairing

Ideal with braised beef short ribs, grilled lamb chops, or wild mushroom risotto. Its rich fruit and savoury depth also complement aged cheeses and roasted root vegetables.

title: Whyte & Mackay Glayva
bodyHtml:
The spirit is created from an exotic fusion of the finest aged Scotch malt whiskies, a carefully selected range of spices, Mediterranean tangerines, cinnamon and honey. Because of all these different ingredients, Glayva has a very distinctive and pleasant taste. Surprisingly smooth and sweet, with a hint of cinnamon and spices, it really tastes like nothing else!

Whyte & Mackay's exotic whisky fusion has been awarded fourteen times at the International Wine and Spirit Competition, making it literally the best liqueur in the world.

But don’t take our word for it ... try it for yourself!

title: Markham Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
