From the United States, the 2021 Chardonnay by Markham Vineyards hails from the renowned Napa Valley in California, with grapes sourced primarily from the Oak Knoll District. Markham Vineyards, founded in 1874 and one of Napa’s oldest continuously operated wineries, is deeply rooted in sustainable viticulture and estate-grown winemaking. The winery is now part of Distinguished Vineyards, a portfolio that supports high-quality, sustainably focused producers.

Wine Description
This Napa Valley Chardonnay showcases a golden straw hue and an expressive bouquet of ripe pear, lemon curd, and vanilla bean, underpinned by subtle toasted oak and wet stone. On the palate, it delivers generous flavours of Golden Delicious apple, Bartlett pear, and crème brûlée, with creamy layers that unfold gracefully. The wine has a medium to full body with a round, polished texture and a lingering, silky finish.

Food Pairing
Ideal with dishes such as roasted chicken with lemon and herbs, creamy mushroom risotto, or seared scallops.

title: Chateau Duhart Milon 2016 - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml:
96 Points - James Suckling    Enticing aromas of crushed berries, blackcurrants, sweet tobacco, hot stones and licorice follow through to a full body, chewy and dusty tannins and a long, flavorful finish. A juicy and savory young 2016. Try after 2024.

95 Points - Decanter    I remember how delicious this was at en primeur, and it remains a stately, elongated, perfectly poised Pauillac. It's austere, certainly, but is also full of rich fruit pared down by a slate texture, the sense of minerality scraping along the palate as you approach the blackcurrant leaf and tobacco finish. It's excellent quality, and clearly a vintage that suits the personality of Duhart - juicy but restrained. Matured in 50% new oak.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck    Ranking with the finest vintages of this wine to date, the 2016 Château Duhart Milon shows how successful the Médoc was in 2016. About as pure class as it gets, with full-bodied notes of red and black currants, tobacco leaf, graphite, and leafy herbs, this beauty hits the palate with sweet tannins, a stacked mid-palate, and a layered, deep, powerful texture. It’s about as sexy as Pauillac can be and has 2-3 decades ahead of it.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast    This bottling shows the vastly improved quality of this estate that still represents good value for the appellation and for its provenance as part of the Lafite-Rothschild stable. The wine is structured while full of ripe berry fruits. It has weight and density, rich with swathes of delicious fruits as well as tannins. It will develop well; drink from 2023.

93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate    Blended of 67% Cabernet Sauvignon and 33% Merlot, the 2016 Duhart-Milon has a deep garnet-purple color and features plums preserves, wild blueberries and cassis scents with touches of violets and underbrush with a waft of tobacco. Medium-bodied and elegant, with a backbone of finely grained tannins and oodles of freshness, it has a great core of perfumed black fruit, finishing on an earthy note.

93 Points - Wine Spectator    This is very vivid, with racy violet, cassis and plum aromas and flavors coursing through, laced with a mouthwatering anise note and leading to a long, focused finish. Displays a terrific iron underpinning. Best from 2024 through 2038.

title: La Magia Rosso di Montalcino 2024
bodyHtml: Produced from the same grapes as our La Magia's Brunello, but with a different vinification process and aged for only six months in ‘third use’ casks, this youthful wine possesses personality in abundance, typified by lively fruit and a fresh appeal that makes it suitable for all occasions, formal and informal.

title: Vinologist Chenin Blanc 2021
bodyHtml: With scents of fig, melon, and greengage, as well as gentle whiffs of citrus flower, jasmine, and chamomile, the nose is delicate yet multifaceted. On the palate, you'll find nectarines, white peaches, pineapple, and yellow apples, all of which are powerful and well-balanced.

title: Casa Silva Sauvignon Blanc 'Cool Coast' 2023
bodyHtml: Pale yellow with green hues, clean and brilliant. High aromatic intensity, with notes of orange blossom, lemon yellow, white pear, fresh pineapple and bay leaves. The palate is high, fresh, good acidity volume and character appear herbaceous and citrus flavors with a slight hint of salinity at the end.  The finish is balanced and floral. Ideal with grilled sole fish with mini green salads.

title: Domaine Chanson Pere & Fils Chablis 2023
bodyHtml: Pale gold in colour, with delicate floral fragrances mixed with aromas of citrus fruit and pale fleshed fruit. Refreshing mineral finish.

title: Mazzei Rose Belguardo 2024
bodyHtml: Intense and fresh, cherry flower flavours, smooth, mineral and pleasantly lasting taste. Perfect all year long! Pair with appetizers, tomato-based pasta, pizza, steamed fish and vegetables.

title: Mastrojanni Rosso di Montalcino 2022
bodyHtml: A wide and rich scent, characterised by robust notes of juicy red fruits and garnished with balsamic and spicy suggestions, is revealed by an intense and bright ruby hue. With a rich and compact tannic body, the generous and enveloping taste leads to a pleasantly lingering finish with fragrant fruity overtones.

title: Chateau Tanunda Cabernet Sauvignon Grand Barossa 2019
bodyHtml: Lifted aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry and vanilla are accompanied by vibrant, dark berry fruits on the palate. The finish is long with fine-grained tannins from sixteen months maturation in a combination of new and older French oak hogsheads.

title: Greenwing Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine is a premium expression of the Columbia Valley in the United States. As part of the prestigious Duckhorn Portfolio, Greenwing honours both the rich history of its parent company and the specific winemaking traditions of Washington State. Founded with a philosophy of making top-tier growing regions accessible, the winery focuses on crafting wines that balance expressive character and craftsmanship with an approachable style.

Wine Description

The Greenwing Cabernet Sauvignon is brisk and bright, presenting a vivid dark ruby colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is highly expressive, featuring notes of wild strawberry, Rainier cherry, and ripe plum, supported by subtle layers of baking spice and rustic earth. On the palate, the wine delivers a dynamic rush of pomegranate and raspberry, harmonized by the deeper sweetness of candied fig. It is a medium-plus bodied wine with integrated acidity and a perfect weight that carries through to a lovely, enduring finish.

title: Domaine Chanson Pere & Fils Pinot Noir Bourgogne 2022
bodyHtml: A great value everyday Burgundy! Dark ruby colour with purple nuances. Intense aromas of ripe blackberries mixed with spices and licorice. Crunchy and generous. Complex and deep texture. Well-crafted tannins. Long and fruity aftertaste. Ideal with braised and roasted meats, and pasta with meat sauce.

title: Wapisa Pinot Noir 2020
bodyHtml: Classic Pinot Noir aromas of fresh cherry, cranberry, and pomegranate leap from the glass, and as the wine opens up further with air, there are amazing layers of wood smoke, dry leaves, and savoury balsamic.

title: William Fevre Chablis 'Champs Royaux' 2023
bodyHtml: Very fresh bouquet with notes of citrus and white fleshed fruit, with a very slightly oaky finish. Fresh and supple, the wine is marked by mineral notes that are typical of the appellation.

title: Francois Le Saint Sancerre Calcaire 2023
bodyHtml:
This 100 percent Sauvignon Blanc is cultivated in Calcaire soils under the organic label of Domaine Fouassier (the largest landholder in Sancerre). The free-run juice from the pneumatic press is gravity-fed into stainless steel tanks for indigenous yeast fermentation. To enhance complexity, the Sancerre is matured on fine lees for a short time. Dry, medium-bodied, with fresh acidity and few phenolics; green straw colour with decent legs; dry, medium-bodied, with fresh acidity and minimal phenolics. Sancerre with juicy citrus and tree fruit flavours and a delicate mineral character. With layers of flavour, it's textured and dimensional.

François le Saint is a line of wines from one of Sancerre's most revered names. Established in 1749 in the heart of Sancerre, Domaine Fouassier is one of the oldest wine-growing families in the Loire Valley with a history that spans 10 generations. This Sauvignon Blanc is certified organic and biodynamically farmed, from 30-45-year-old vines grown on a 6.26ha plot of calcareous soils. After a native ferment in stainless, it rests there for a brief time on lees prior to bottling. Perfumed white blossoms, lemon peel, tangerine, fragrant melon, and creamy pear stream the slender palate, finishing with a dusting of almond spice.

title: Hugel Pinot Noir Classic 2021
bodyHtml: This wine has a pleasant red current and cherry colour with the slightest hints of bronzed ruby which develop over time accompanied by a wonderful shimmer and transparency. It has an open, smooth, tender and elegantly fruity nose with hints of black cherry, raspberry, crushed wild strawberry, alcoholic fruit jam, tobacco and woodland floor. On the palate this is a classic, elegant, refined and smooth Pinot Noir wine, the flavour is structured by the tannin which is not too hard, making it easy to approach and thirst-quenching.

title: Chateau St Jean Pinot Noir California 2020
bodyHtml: When founded, Chateau St. Jean was conceived as a truly fine wine estate in the European style, where wines from individual vineyards were kept separate to fully capture the individual character of each site. The wines received immediate critical acclaim, and Chateau St. Jean was soon recognized as a leader in single vineyard-designated wines. This attractive and well-made wine offers a nice combination of red cherry and light fresh herb flavours that are accented by hints of wood smoke. It's a medium-bodied, palate-cleansing and easy-to-enjoy wine.

title: Casoni Limoncello 'Il Limone'
bodyHtml: A traditional lemon liqueur created from the alcoholic infusion of the top-quality lemon peels from the Sorrento peninsula.  It has a distinctive aroma that is both rich and fresh.

title: Renato Ratti Ochetti Langhe Nebbiolo 2021 - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml:
The Renato Ratti Ochetti Langhe Nebbiolo 2021 is a distinguished red wine hailing from the Langhe region in Piedmont, Italy. Crafted entirely from 100% Nebbiolo grapes, this wine exemplifies the elegance and refinement characteristic of the varietal.

Winery Background

Renato Ratti, a pivotal figure in Piedmont's winemaking history, established his winery in the 1960s after returning from Brazil. He was a pioneer in producing single-vineyard Barolo wines and played a significant role in mapping the region's historical crus. Today, his son Pietro Ratti continues the legacy, maintaining the family's commitment to quality and innovation.

Wine Description

  • Color: Pale ruby red.

  • Aroma: The bouquet is fine and persistent, with delicate notes of wild strawberries and raspberries.

  • Palate: On the palate, it presents a pleasantly bitterish taste, velvety texture, and a harmonious balance between lightness and fullness.

  • Body and Finish: Medium-bodied with fine tannins and a persistent minerality, leading to a refined finish.

Accolades

  • James Suckling: 90 points.

  • Wine Enthusiast: 89 points.

title: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Apple Liqueur
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Apple has the unique character of Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey coupled with real crisp green apples for a fresh and rewarding taste. Blended with Old No.7, it's bold, refreshing, and exceptionally smooth.

title: Beronia Rioja Reserva 2020
bodyHtml: Deep red-violet in colour, this wine has aromas of cassis, dark chocolate and oregano. Mellow tannins bolster flavours of pomegranate, cherry, roasted red pepper and buttered popcorn that culminate in a tangerine finish.

title: Luca Malbec Old Vine 2023
bodyHtml:
Luca Winery was founded by Dr. Laura Catena in 1999, who is dedicated to preserving Mendoza's old vines and highlighting the region's viticultural heritage. The winery's philosophy focuses on artisan quality, small quantities, and expressing individual terroirs by working with small-scale family growers who maintain traditional practices.

Wine Description

This 100% Malbec displays an incredible deep purple-red colour. The sensory profile is complex, with aromas of spice, black and red cherry, and notes of chocolate or cocoa. On the palate, vibrant berry fruit flavours pop, alongside plum, violet, and sage, complemented by underlying mocha and espresso notes. The wine is full-bodied, yet balanced by lively, vibrant acidity, resulting in a flexible and concentrated style. It presents ripe, approachable, and silky tannins that lead to an incredibly long finish.

Food Pairing

This Malbec pairs well with a variety of rich foods, including grilled red meats such as steak and lamb. It is also an excellent match for venison, wild game, pork, and quail, as well as medium-strong cheeses.

title: Carpineto Vino Nobile di Montepulciano Riserva 1995
bodyHtml:
Winemaker Notes:

Color: brilliant ruby red with a tendency to garnet.

Bouquet: ethereal, extraordinarily elegant with hints of violet and wood.

Flavor: dry, harmonic, and velvety with an elegant texture and long finish.

title: Green Spot Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml: Green Spot is a fabulous single pot still whiskey and much loved by the critics. This Irish whiskey has come far from the days when it was only sold in Mitchell's grocer shop in the heart of Dublin, though its flavour profile is still just as robust. The whiskey has matured in a combination of first and second fill bourbon casks as well as sherry casks.

title: Les Auzines Alaina Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Domaine Les Auzines is a unique family run estate in the Corbières Appellation, South of France. Isolated on a rocky plateau, at 1200 feet altitude, in the heart of some of the most beautiful, untouched countryside in France, the vineyards have been cultivated organically since the early 90’s. This allows the grapes to express their true character and mature in ideal conditions where the vineyards grow in true harmony with nature. The resulting wines express freshness, elegance and finesse.

Made by Laurent Miquel and his Irish wife Neasa, this delicious rosé is the perfect example of ripe, summery Languedoc fruit and a crisp balancing acidity that keeps the wine refreshing, elegant and ideal for all types of foods. The fashionably pale colour is a result short skin contact with the red Syrah, Grenache and Cinsault grapes in the blend. This wine is also certified Vegan and bee friendly.

title: Chateau Gassier Sables d'Azur Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This rosé wine originates from France, specifically from the Côtes de Provence region. Situated at the foot of the iconic Sainte Victoire mountain, Château Gassier has been owned by the Jeanjean and Gassier families since 2004. The winery's philosophy focuses on capturing the pure expression of its unique clay and limestone terroir through environmentally conscious viticulture and innovative cellar practices.

Wine Description

Chateau Gassier Sables d'Azur Rose presents a luminous robe with delicate peach and salmon highlights. The nose is elegant and expressive, revealing aromas of white fleshed fruits such as peach and nectarine, associated with citrus notes of pomelo, clementine, and white flowers. On the palate, the wine is round and balanced, offering a 'gourmet' palette of strawberry, apricot, and papaya supported by a lively acidity and a chalky mineral finish with accents of yuzu zest. This blend typically consists of Grenache, Cinsault, Syrah, and Vermentino (Rolle).

title: Giulio Straccali Pinot Grigio 2022
bodyHtml: Bright straw with copper highlights. Elegant and intense with notes of fruit and flowers. Well-balanced with great structure and a pleasant finish. Great with Mediterranean dishes, especially fish and shellfish.

title: Giulio Straccali Chianti 2024
bodyHtml: Vibrant ruby red in colour, this wine offers bright, youthful aromas of ripe red fruit. It is velvety and refreshing with good structure.

title: Casoni 1814 l'Aperitivo Liquore - 1 Litre
bodyHtml:
That 'aperitivo moment' — as the Italians call it — has always typically been regarded as one of conviviality and pleasure. Named after the year Casoni was established, 1814 l'Aperitivo is inspired by company traditions while staying innovative in the modern market.  Perfectly suited for the conviviality that is certain at a dinner amongst friends, 1814 - l’Aperitivo comes from an original recipe from the Casoni family.  The selection of (locally) harvested herbs and expertly blended Mediterranean fruit and seeds make this a unique product, ideal for the preparation of the finest cocktails.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast     This rosy-bright aperitivo is similar to Aperol, although it's more delicate and complex. It's bold and juicy-sweet on the palate, with a faint grapefruit-like bitterness and a floral touch on the long, elegant finish. Made in the Emilia-Romagna region.

title: Justin Rose 2023
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Justin Rosé is a dry, aromatic, refreshing wine that reminds you that while Rosé is great on a hot summer day, it is also a versatile wine worth reaching for all year long. A Rosé of mostly Syrah that is whole cluster pressed and fermented like a white wine, it shows a beautiful salmon colour in the glass with bright red fruit, crisp apple and subtle herbal notes.

It’s a perfect match for a wide variety of pairings or just on its own and is a wine that is meant to be enjoyed at the table, poolside, beach-side, outside, but especially with someone by your side.

title: Finca Las Moras PAZ Cabernet Sauvignon - Cabernet Franc 2019
bodyHtml:
Finca Las Moras PAZ Cabernet Sauvignon - Cabernet Franc originates from Argentina, specifically within the San Juan region. The vineyards for this blend are situated in the Pedernal Valley and Tulum Valley at altitudes ranging between 650 and 1,350 metres above sea level. Finca Las Moras is recognized as a distinguished and innovative winery dedicated to excellence and the spirit of Argentine winemaking. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a harmony between tradition and modernity, utilizing manual harvesting in small containers followed by a meticulous selection of berries to ensure high quality.

Wine Description

This premium red wine displays a deep purple-red or deep red colour in the glass. The sensory profile is rich and sophisticated, offering an aromatic nose of ripe black fruits, blackberries, and red pepper, intertwined with scents of green pepper, soft chocolate, and well-integrated oak. On the medium-bodied palate, it is described as rich and intense with a delicate structure of fine, silky tannins and flavours of blackcurrant, dark chocolate, and dried herbs such as sage and rosemary. The finish is persistent, balanced, and elegant.

  • Varietal Composition: A balanced blend consisting of 50% Cabernet Sauvignon and 50% Cabernet Franc.

  • ABV: Typically ranges between 13.5% and 14.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery focuses on precision and care in its renowned vineyards, this specific wine is not typically noted as certified organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: This 'Bordeaux Blend' style wine is aged for 15 months in new French oak barrels to enhance its complexity and velvety texture.

title: The Old Malt Cask Caol Ila 9 Year Old
bodyHtml:
General Information

A super 9 year old release of a peated Islay single malt from the Caol Ila distillery that has been aged in a single hogshead cask.

title: Michael David 7 Deadly Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml: Do you dare an exploration into the dark unknown? This sinfully delicious red wine just might set you down a path of gluttonous pleasure. Crafted from the diverse and hallowed soils of the Lodi Appellation, where greedy winemakers hunger to craft not just wine, but also a lifestyle of sin. Here for six generations, we’ve tempted evil’s wrath and are eternally damned to deliver decadent wines like our Seven Deadly Red.

title: Shinobu 15 Year Old Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Shinobu 15 Year Old Pure Malt is a complex blended malt produced by the Shinobu Distillery in Niigata, Japan. The distillery was founded by Mr. Ken Usami, who also established the Niigata Beer company. In line with the transparent "World Malt" category, this expression is a "pure malt" (or blended malt), consisting of high-quality whiskies sourced from around the world—primarily Scotland—which are then married and aged for 15 years in ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks. The hallmark of the Shinobu range is the final maturation period in precious Japanese Mizunara oak, which takes place in the seaside environment of Niigata, imbuing the spirit with a distinct oriental elegance.

Spirit Description

This whisky displays a rich amber gold colour. The nose is deep and aromatic, featuring a complex blend of salted caramel, old leather, and campfire embers, followed by sweeter notes of maltose, blueberry cheesecake, and old oak. On the palate, the body is oily and mouth-filling, delivering a balanced profile of ripe orchard fruits, lemon zest, and milk coffee, underpinned by the spicy influence of the Mizunara oak. Flavours of ginger root, cinnamon sticks, and dark chocolate-covered espresso beans provide a sophisticated depth. The finish is long and drying, characterized by persistent oakiness, floral woody scents, and a touch of sweet malted barley. It is bottled at 43% ABV with no added colouring.

title: Shinobu 10 Year Old Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Shinobu 10 Year Old Pure Malt is a balanced and refined expression from the Shinobu Distillery in Niigata. As a pure malt, it consists of a blend of malt whiskies that have been matured for at least a decade. The spirit undergoes a final finishing period in Japanese Mizunara oak, the distillery's signature technique. The cool, coastal climate of Niigata allows for a stable maturation, while the porous Mizunara wood imparts the characteristic oriental spice that distinguishes the Shinobu range from traditional Highland or Speyside malts.

Whisky Description

This whisky displays a deep mahogany gold color. On the nose, it is notably sweet and woody, offering aromas of honey, maltose, and citrus peel, accompanied by the distinct sandalwood scent of Mizunara oak. The palate is smooth and medium-bodied, featuring flavors of buttery toffee, roasted nuts, and a touch of dried ginger. The ten years of aging provide a well-integrated structure where the sweetness of the malt balances the spicy, peppery notes of the wood. The finish is long and slightly dry, leaving behind a lingering taste of incense, clove, and sweet oak. It is bottled at 43% ABV and is non-chill filtered.

title: Village Wit - 18.5 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Village Wit is the flagship white wheat ale from Calgary’s Village Brewery. While the "Wit" style (meaning "white") originated in Belgium, Village has put a distinctly local spin on it, creating one of Alberta's most popular patio beers. It is designed to be a "social" beer—unfiltered, cloudy, and incredibly easy to drink. For the 18.5 Litre Keg (commonly known as a Corny or "Sixth Barrel" keg), it is the gold standard for home bars or small gatherings, offering approximately 37–40 pints of fresh-from-the-tap citrus refreshment.

Beer Description

Village Wit pours a hazy, pale straw color with a dense, creamy white head. Because it is unfiltered, it maintains a beautiful "luminous" glow in the glass.

Aroma: The nose is bright, zesty, and inviting. It leads with a dominant scent of sweet orange peel and fresh lemon, followed by the classic Witbier "spice" of crushed coriander. There is a soft, bready aroma from the wheat that provides a comforting, "bakery-fresh" foundation.

Palate: On the tongue, it is medium-bodied with a silky, "fluffy" mouthfeel that is characteristic of high wheat content. It leads with a refreshing burst of tangerine and citrus zest, followed by a gentle, peppery spiciness. The bitterness is kept very low, allowing the crisp, "tangy" finish of the yeast and citrus to provide the refreshment.

Profile: It sits at a sessionable 4.5% ABV and a very low bitterness of 12 IBU, making it accessible to almost every palate.

Technical Notes: This beer is brewed with a significant portion of unmalted wheat, which provides the signature proteins for its hazy appearance and smooth texture. Village adds bitter orange peel and coriander during the boil to achieve its aromatic complexity. It is fermented with a specific Belgian-style ale yeast that contributes subtle notes of clove and fruit without becoming overpowering.

title: Gerard Bertrand Cote des Roses Rose 2025 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the sun-drenched Languedoc region of southern France, this elegant rosé is a tribute to the Mediterranean lifestyle. The estate is led by Gérard Bertrand, a former rugby star turned visionary vintner who took over the family torch in 1987 and has since become a global leader in biodynamic viticulture. His winemaking philosophy centers on a deep respect for biodiversity and the 'Art de Vivre', aiming to capture the unique energy and terroir of each of his 17 estates.

Wine Description

This wine presents a soft, pale, and brilliant pink robe with subtle bluish highlights that may evolve into orange shades over time. The expressive nose offers a delicate bouquet of summer fruits, including cassis, redcurrant, and strawberry, complemented by floral notes of rose and hints of grapefruit. On the palate, the wine is fresh and full, demonstrating great aromatic persistence and a fine balance between its lively acidity and smooth texture. The finish is crisp and persistent, often revealing light notes of candy.

title: Louis Guntrum Riesling 2021
bodyHtml: Delicate fragrance of white peaches, apricot and juicy pears. Impressive mouthfeel, lasting flavors. The classical Riesling in expression and elegance.

title: Terre Cevico Sangiovese Romagna Appassimento 2022
bodyHtml:
Terre Cevico Sangiovese Romagna Appassimento originates from Italy, situated within the renowned Romagna region of Emilia-Romagna. Founded in 1963 as a collective of local viticulturists, Terre Cevico has grown into one of Italy's most respected cooperative wine groups, deeply rooted in preserving regional winemaking traditions. The winery's philosophy balances respect for the land with modern cellar techniques, focusing on expressing the rich, authentic terroir of Romagna through sustainable and collaborative winemaking.

Wine Description

This deep garnet-red wine presents an inviting visual profile with luminous reflections in the glass. Aromas of plum jam, ripe dark cherry, and rose pedals emerge on the nose, complemented by nuances of cocoa, clove, and sweet oak spices. The palate is full, round, and enveloping, featuring plush flavours of blackberry compote, dried fig, and dark chocolate supported by silky, well-integrated tannins.

title: Glencadam 'Origin 1825' Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Glencadam Distillery opened in 1825, and since then, little has changed. A very special collection of casks were chosen for the Origin 1825 edition. The final selection consisted of a unique marriage of whisky matured in first-class American white-oak bourbon barrels with whisky "finished" in the finest Spanish Oloroso Sherry butts. 

The nose has wafting aromas of sweet orchard fruits and blossom honey mingled with baked apples and hints of cinnamon. The palate shows layers of fresh banana and pear fruit followed by sweet barley sugars, dried pineapple and soft cake spices. The finish is mellow with fruity notes of pear drops, lemon drizzle cake and candied peels.

title: Maison Champy Bourgogne Chardonnay 'Cuvee Edme' 2023
bodyHtml: Bright colour, yellow gold with golden highlights. Strong aromatic intensity. The nose is rich and well opened, with notes of exotic fruits and white flowers, notes of caramel and vanilla on a background of toasted bread. Fresh on the palate, an opulent body, smooth and round. At the finish, a good aromatic persistence of the fruit, united with a good balance between the acidity and the roundness.

title: Louis Michel & Fils Chablis Premier Cru Montee De Tonnerre 2022
bodyHtml: After being aired, this wine offers a perfect balance between mineral freshness and very ripe fruit. The palate is warm, mouthwatering and saline, with a spicy cinnamon finish.

title: Casal Garcia Rose Vinho Verde (NV)
bodyHtml:
A blush version of the immensely popular Vinho Verde Branco from Casal Garcia, this has plenty of crowd-pleasing charm. Soft red berry aromas and flavors are accompanied by a delicate spritz on the palate.

86 Points - Wine Spectator     Presents fresh pink colour and a clear appearance. This is a very fruity wine enhanced by notes of raspberries and strawberries. On the palate the red berries aroma is also evident, well balanced with a nice acidity which characterizes this wine with a great freshness, a solid structure and a harmonious final with a soft persistence.

84 Points - Wine Enthusiast     With caramel and red-fruit flavors, this is a crisp wine with a touch of sweetness. It is feather-light and ready to drink now.

title: Hess Select Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: Hess is situated on Napa Valley's Mount Veeder and is home to one of the world's greatest privately owned collections of modern art. Their Cabernet is smoky, with cassis, blackberry, sweet spice, and great structure and character. Pair it with rare steak or roast beef dinners.

title: Bread & Butter Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: This expressive Sauvignon Blanc shines with the bright aromas of lemon zest and a hint of tropical fruit. Lively flavours of fresh citrus lead to a rich texture that is complemented with enticing minerality and a clean, refreshing finish. Goes well with prosciutto-wrapped peaches, goat cheese arugula salad and the welcomed simplicity of staycations.

title: Botijo Garnacha Tinto 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Botijo Garnacha Tinto 2024 originates from the Valdejalón region in Aragón, Spain. Produced by Bodegas Frontonio, this 'garagista' project was founded by Fernando Mora, a Master of Wine, and Mario López, whose family has owned the vineyards for generations. The winery's philosophy emphasizes minimal intervention and a commitment to reviving the prestige of ancient Garnacha vines through organic and sustainable farming practices.

Wine Description

This wine typically displays a lovely pomegranate or ruby red colour. The sensory profile is fruit driven and intense, offering aromas of wild strawberries, cherries, and blackberries, elegantly interwoven with floral violets and spicy notes of black pepper. On the palate, it is fresh and medium bodied, delivering vibrant flavours of red fruit and a pleasing minerality supported by well-balanced tannins. The finish is clean and dry with lingering hints of spice and licorice. This 100% Garnacha varietal generally has an ABV of 14% and is produced from dry-farmed, hand-harvested vines that are certified organic.

Food Pairing

The balanced acidity and moderate tannins of this Garnacha make it a versatile choice for a wide range of dishes. It is considered a perfect 'barbecue wine', pairing exceptionally well with grilled meats, burgers, and tacos. Suggested pairings also include spicy meat dishes seasoned with pimentos, roasted lamb, tomato-based pasta, and Spanish cheeses such as Manchego.

title: Monte Piazzo Valpolicella Classico Superiore 2017
bodyHtml:
Elegant, original, with good structure and complexity. This is the archetype of Valpolicella as described by Hemingway, "as friendly as the house of a favourite brother".

Made on the historic estates belonging to the Conti Serego Alighieri, who for more than 650 years have been part of the tradition and the culture of the Valpolicella region. The personal aristocratic style of this wine is enhanced by the use of the exclusive Serego Alighieri clone of Molinara and by maturation in cherry wood casks. Excellent with grilled red meat, roasts and mature cheeses.

title: Tobermory 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: Matured exclusively in ex-bourbon casks, Tobermory's 12-Year Old has a vibrant, fruity, spicy character with a subtle, salty edge.

title: Domaine du Salvard Cheverny 2024
bodyHtml:
The Cheverny appellation stretches from Sologne to the outskirts of Orleans along the Loire's left bank. The castle of Cheverny, built in the style of Louis X111, is its icon. The Delaille family has owned Domaine Salvard since the 1890s, with the current generation masterfully maintaining their 30 hectares through a programme of conscientious (a.k.a. semi-organic) vineyard management. This white wine is made up of 85 percent Sauvignon Blanc and 15% Chardonnay. After the grapes are gathered, they are macerated for a short time before being pressed. Before bottling, the wine is left on its fine lees for up to 12 months after fermentation. Cheverny Blanc is a junior Sancerre with great gooseberry freshness, according to the winemaker.

A pale lemon-yellow in the glass. Delicate, fragrant aromas of citrus fruits, green orchard fruits and hazelnuts.  On the palate, dry yet expansive with a reasonably full body. The flavors are clean and refreshing leading to an aromatic finish. The balance between the zesty Sauvignon and the rounder Chardonnay works very well. Great food wine. drink with crayfish with strips of Dover sole in a saffron sauce, chicken piccata or asparagus mousse.

title: Famille J.M. Cazes Saint Estephe 2019
bodyHtml: Jean-Michel Cazes' family has owned Lynch-Bages for decades now. This highly affordable wine over-delivers for the price, with chiselled dark cherry, graphite, gravels and an undercurrent of brooding black plum and violet. Tannins are smooth, and the finish is snappy, making it prime for drinking now.

title: Domaine Des Senechaux Chateauneuf du Pape Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
France’s Southern Rhone region is home to the renowned Chateauneuf du Pape appellation, celebrated for its rich winemaking history and distinct terroir. Domaine des Senechaux is one of the oldest estates in the area, with roots stretching back to the 14th century. Acquired in 2006 by the Cazes family, renowned owners of Bordeaux’s Chateau Lynch Bages, the estate undergoes meticulous vineyard management and modern winemaking practices that honor classic Rhone traditions.

Wine Description

This white wine opens with a pale yellow color with shimmering golden hues. The nose displays vibrant aromas of zesty citrus, crisp yellow apple, pear, and subtle white blossoms, complemented by a touch of toasted almond and mild spice. On the palate, it delivers a medium to full body with a harmonious balance of rich texture and refreshing acidity, leading to a long, clean finish marked by a hint of minty herbs and sapid minerality.

Accolades

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 91 points.

  • Vinous - 90 points.

title: L'Ostal Cazes Estibals Minervois 2021
bodyHtml: A juicy, ripe Syrah-Carignan-Grenache-Mourvedre blend from the youngest vines on one of the domaine’s finest parcels. Silky palate with inky red- and black-berry fruit, garrigue herbs and oak spice, enlivened by fresh acidity.

title: Chateau Villa Bel-Air Blanc 2020
bodyHtml: ﻿The wine is a pale yellow color with green glints. Delicate aromas of tropical fruits, grapefruit, and litchi complement the subtle notes of vanilla and butter caramel, endowing the palate with a perfect balance between fat and acidity. The elegant finish is marked by fresh lemony notes.

title: L'Ostal Cazes Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
General Information

A light spice note of cinnamon or anise. Youthful. Dry. Nectarine with peach, lemon honey, pear, and melon. Med body with refreshing acidity. Overall, a lovely balance with good weight and texture, refreshing citrus zest, and delicious persistence to a long finish.

title: Cantina Lavis Cabernet Sauvignon Trentino 2024
bodyHtml:
Cantina Lavis is a historic winery located in the heart of the Trentino subregion in Italy. Originally founded in 1850 by the Cembran family, it has operated as a cooperative since 1948 and now unites hundreds of local growers dedicated to preserving the rich biodiversity of the Avisio Hills. The winery’s guiding philosophy is centered on its 'vine zoning' project, which meticulously matches specific grape varieties to their most suitable terroir to ensure each wine reflects its unique territorial identity.

Wine Description

The Cantina Lavis Cabernet Sauvignon Trentino presents a deep ruby red colour accented by violet hues. The bouquet is intense and distinctive, blending rich sensations of blackberry and plum with complex notes of vanilla, chocolate, and toasted hints. On the palate, the wine is dry, well structured, and balanced, showing a lasting finish with supple tannins. Composed primarily of Cabernet Sauvignon, this red offers a refined profile that balances freshness with a savory mineral undertone typical of its alpine origin.

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon is a versatile partner for a range of hearty dishes, particularly grilled meats, roasts, and game. It also pairs excellently with aged cheeses, such as cheddar or smoked Gouda, and rich pasta dishes.

title: Jacopo Poli Torcolato Grappa - 500 ml
bodyHtml: This grappa is made from the pomace of Vespaiolo, the same grape as those used in Fausto Maculan’s famous Torcolato dessert wine. During the drying process the grapes are attacked by "noble rot" which creates compounds that concentrate the flavours and add depth and complexity to the grappa.

title: Bocca di Lupo 'Trentangeli' 2019
bodyHtml: Trentangeli is intensely ruby red in color. On the nose, it expresses fruity sensations of plums and cherries followed by sweet spices perfectly balanced with hints of candied oranges and mint. Its palate is rich, soft, full-bodied with lively persistent tannins.

title: The Crusher Pinot Noir 2017
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes... The Crusher Pinot Noir is a brilliant, ruby-red colour with fresh aromas of strawberry, raspberry, rhubarb and subtle pepper spice. This expressive wine is smooth and graceful on the palate with juicy cranberry fruit, black tea and violet candy flavours. The wine is well-balanced with robust fruit, fine grained tannins and good acidity which leads to a flavourful and lengthy finish. The Crusher Pinot Noir was aged with 100% French oak for 10 months giving excellent integration.

The Crusher Pinot Noir gets along well with a variety of cuisine. invite a bottle to your next family dinner!

title: Cafaggio Chianti Classico 'Single Estate' 2019
bodyHtml: Dark ruby, medium-bodied Chianti with black cherry and plum notes, tart cherry and chocolate finish. Paired well with corn and sausage chowder.

title: Cantina Lavis Pinot Grigio Rose 2024
bodyHtml: Its coppery colour is defined by a straw-yellow with delicate reflections. An intense bouquet of citrus fruits and flower aromas are the typical organoleptic traits of Pinot Grigio Rose. Strong sensation of minerality on the palate. Harmonious taste with soft and silky tannins.

title: Borsao Tres Picos Garnacha 2021
bodyHtml: Very intense cherry red colour with tones of purple. Great concentration of aromas of ripe red fruit with floral nuances on the nose. In the mouth, it is a well-structured rich wine that evokes tastes of blackberry, plum and tones of leather and vanilla, with soft and silky tannin. Mountain vineyards with an age of 35 to 60 years situated at an altitude of 600-700 meters, on stony, slimy soils with clay and limestone.

title: Terre Di Marca Prosecco Organic (NV)
bodyHtml:
General Information

From the centuries-old passion for viticulture, and sincere love for the land comes a product that identifies the present and the future of the Family Corvezzo. Extremely fine, and for this reason even more valuable, Terre di Marca Prosecco contains Bio the true taste of nature lovers with passion and guards its precious fruits.

title: Caymus Suisun Grand Durif 2021
bodyHtml:
Chuck Wagner founded Caymus Vineyards with his parents in 1972 in Rutherford, California, in the centre of Napa Valley. Now, Caymus is putting down roots in a neighbouring wine region called Suisun Valley. Only a 30-minute drive southeast of Napa, Suisun Valley is less well known than its more famous neighbour but shares a similar maritime climate and superb soils. Chuck likes to say that Suisun Valley reminds him of Napa Valley in the 1960s, full of open space, small family farms, meandering waterways lined with native oaks, and exceptional vineyards. Known more for its production of stone fruits, Suisun Valley is increasingly being recognized for its wines.

For the past several years, Chuck has been producing Caymus-Suisun Grand Durif. Durif is synonymous with Petite Sirah, one of the varietals that thrive in Suisun Valley. Chuck feels privileged to include "Suisun" in a Caymus wine and believes that people will come to know and appreciate the region more and more. The family looks forward to inviting people to explore the unique character of a place they consider a "hidden gem."

This midnight purple-coloured Petite Sirah from Caymus is impressive. It opens with a fragrant lilac, blueberry and acai berry bouquet with a hint of plum. This wine is medium-bodied, balanced and very smooth on the palate. The flavour profile is tasty milk chocolate and stewed red plum blend with notes of blueberry. You will detect some hints of toasted oak mixed in. The finish is dry, and its moderate tannins build up, linger, and last for a while. Enjoy it with wood-smoked short ribs, and bring a good appetite to the table.

title: Tomintoul 14 Year Old
bodyHtml: This 14-year-old has been bottled at a higher strength to previous Tomintoul releases. This has helped bring out more of the flavor, and the character of the dram.

title: Filarino Sangiovese Rose 2024
bodyHtml: Pale pink colour. The nose is delicate, and fine but firm with wild rose shades, pomegranate and blood orange. It's a lively wine, fresh and balanced, with an intense and persistent taste.

title: Ridolfi Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml: Red berry, crushed mint, camphor and toasted notes aromas form the nose. The austere, linear palate features sour cherry, coffee bean and a hint of clove set against fresh acidity while close-grained, drying tannins leave a grippy finish.

title: Villa Sparina Barbera Piemonte 2023
bodyHtml: A red wine full of dark berries and slate aromas. Full-bodied, loads of fruit and a long, flavourful finish. A refined and transparent style.

title: Stoller Pinot Noir Willamette Valley 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, specifically within Oregon's renowned Willamette Valley, this Pinot Noir is a hallmark of the Stoller Family Estate. Founded by Bill Stoller in 2001 on his family's former turkey farm, the estate has grown into the largest contiguous vineyard in the Dundee Hills. The winery is a pioneer in environmental stewardship, notably becoming the first in the world to achieve LEED Gold certification for its gravity-flow production facility.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep crimson hue in the glass. The nose offers a sophisticated sensory profile, with aromas of ripe cherry and cedar accented by hints of Tahitian vanilla and warm baking spice. On the palate, the wine is supple yet structured, revealing vibrant flavors of pomegranate, red berries, and cacao nibs. Stylistically, it is celebrated for its quiet elegance and a bright line of acidity that carries through to a long, graceful finish of fresh cedar and Luxardo cherry.

title: Villa Wolf Pinot Noir Rose 2024
bodyHtml: The Villa Wolf Pinot Noir Rose is made with fruit from vineyards farmed expressly for the purpose of producing a true Rose, called Weissherbst in German. Only perfectly ripe, healthy grapes are selected. Upon harvest the  fruit is given a brief maceration to extract a lovely salmon colour from the Pinot Noir grapes. They call this their “Jolly Rancher Rose” as it exudes explosive aromas and flavours of Jolly Rancher Strawberry, Jolly Rancher Watermelon, along with plums and raspberries. A tantalizing touch of sweetness makes this an irresistible wine.

title: Cigar Box Old Vine Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Chile, primarily from the cool climate subregions of the Casablanca Valley and the Leyda Valley within the Aconcagua region. Cigar Box is a brand dedicated to crafting varietally correct wines from hand harvested old vines that reflect the unique terroir of Chile's coastal valleys. The winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the bright, juicy fruit of the grapes while integrating subtle complexity through the judicious use of French oak.

Wine Description

Cigar Box Old Vine Pinot Noir presents a medium intensity purplish red or translucent garnet colour. The aromatic profile is expressive, featuring fresh cherries, raspberries, and strawberries mingled with notes of violets, mocha, and cinnamon. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and silky, showing flavours of juicy red fruits, plum, and a hint of smoky spice or leather. It is characterized by vibrant acidity, soft tannins, and a savory, herbal finish. This 100% Pinot Noir has an ABV of 13.5% and is best enjoyed within its optimal drinking window of now through 2030. While the wine is crafted from hand harvested grapes, it is not certified organic.

title: Varichon & Clerc Privilege Sparkling Rose Dry (NV)
bodyHtml: Fruity, bitter and slightly dry. Tastes like an Aperol spritz. Very nice. Grapefruit peel, ripe peach and a touch of blueberries. Nice smooth bubbly mouthfeel and slightly tart acidic finish. Great value!

title: Domane Wachau Gruner Veltliner Smaragd Terrassen 2024
bodyHtml:
Open and approachable on the nose, highlighted by ripe yellow apple, white pepper and underlined by delicate citrus peels with a touch of smoky tobacco; on the palate beautifully balanced with a crisp acidity which results in an elegant and powerful body, juicy exotic fruit flavors, plenty of spices and dry herbs dominate the palate that is long and full. Smaragd wines are dry, full-bodied, and complex wines with plenty of finesse and great aging potential.

Served well chilled directly from the fridge, Gruner Veltliner Smaragd Terrassen is a versatile companion. It goes well with characterful Mediterranean dishes such as fish Paella or Asian cuisine such as Thai Satay Gai (chicken skewers with peanut sauce). This wine is already very accessible in its youth but can also be aged for 3 to 5 years.

title: Triennes 'Les Aureliens' Rouge 2018
bodyHtml: This wine shows the hallmark characteristics of its two blending components, Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah. Like biting into a ripe plum, it is juicy with bright acidity and fine tannins. It marries well with all sorts of dishes.

title: Joie Farm Quotodien Brut 2022
bodyHtml:
JoieFarm Quotidien Brut is a sparkling wine from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. The name "Quotidien," meaning "daily ration," reflects the winery's inspiration to create an accessible, everyday sparkling wine.

Blend Composition:

  • Chardonnay: 48%

  • Riesling: 39%

  • Viognier: 13%

Vinification:

Each varietal is harvested and pressed separately, with a 48-hour settling period in tanks before racking off heavy lees. The Chardonnay undergoes fermentation in both neutral oak and stainless steel, while the Riesling and Viognier are fermented entirely in stainless steel. Different commercial yeasts are selected to enhance the specific aromatics of each varietal. Post-fermentation, the wines age on fine lees for four months before blending and carbonation.

Tasting Notes:

  • Appearance: Bright and clear with fine bubbles.

  • Aroma: Inviting notes of orchard fruits and blossoms.

  • Palate: Bright and invigorating acidity with flavors of orchard fruits, leading to a quenching citrus-tinged finish.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Serve well-chilled at 6-8 °C (43-46 °F).

  • Food Pairings: Complements a variety of dishes, including seafood, light salads, and soft cheese.

JoieFarm's Quotidien Brut is designed for everyday enjoyment, offering straightforward refreshment with its bright acidity and fruit-forward profile. It's an excellent choice for casual gatherings or as an aperitif.

title: Chateau La Nerthe Chateauneuf du Pape 2013 - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml:
Dark red, with a purple border. The nose is rich, pure and complex, with black fruits and sweet spices. On the palate, lots of roundness, with nice refined tannins. Finish is very long, with notes of black cherry and black berry, with a silky touch on the tongue. A feeling of youth and freshness emerges. The aromas given by the ageing in oak are still visible, with hints of spices and roasting, but they will be soon integrated into the wine and will make it really complex. A wine with a great cellaring potential and with an impressing aromatic expression.

92 Points - Wine & Spirits    This is youthful and undeveloped, the focus on rich and toasty scents and broad, creamy texture. What make it compelling is the sleekness of its structure and the clarity of its white fruit flavors. It feels fresh and lively, already classy, poised to take on more detail with another five to ten years in the cellar.

91 Points - Wine Spectator    A beam of raspberry pâte de fruit and warm plum confiture stretches from start to finish, with light licorice, warm fruitcake and gently singed apple wood notes filling in along the way. A bit forward in style, but will certainly win fans for the alluring fruit and spice. Drink now through 2023. 12,000 cases made.

title: Novaia Valpolicella Classico 2023
bodyHtml: Ruby red color. On the nose, the notes of fresh red fruits, not too heavy. On the palate, quite light in comparison to others, more like a Pinot Noir. Lots of smoky leather and blackberry. Dry, medium tannins and medium body. Quite smooth and not overly complicated.

title: Powers Single Pot Three Swallows
bodyHtml:
In true Pot Still style, an initial taste delivers smooth mouth-coating barley followed by an eruption of green apple and citrus notes. Herbs and spicy flavour are complemented by a touch of cedar wood for extra complexity.

Pot Still spice combines with crisp barley character. Delicate herbs give way to green banana and grapefruit while a nutty note of marzipan reflects the wood contribution of specially selected casks.

Spicy sweetness gives way to Pot Still barley character balanced with a hint of sherry and leading to a crisp cereal finish with toasted oak notes.

title: Domaine Tollot Beaut Chorey Les Beaune 2020
bodyHtml:
Domaine Tollot Beaut Chorey Les Beaune is a classic expression of Pinot Noir from France, specifically grown in the Chorey-les-Beaune appellation within the Côte de Beaune subregion of Burgundy. The Tollot family represents a long lineage of winegrowers dating back to the late 1880s, and the domaine was among the first in the Côte d'Or to start bottling its own wines in 1921. Currently managed by fifth-generation cousins Nathalie, Jean-Paul, and Olivier Tollot, the estate is renowned for its traditional methods, including tilling the soil by hand and avoiding all fertilizers to best express the particularities of each individual plot.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a vivid sensory profile, characterized by a bright ruby colour and a bouquet of small red cherries, blueberry fruit, and hints of crushed strawberry. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and supple, displaying a juicy, smooth flow of dense, ripe fruit including raspberries and black cherries. It is well structured with lithe tannins and a refreshing acidity that carries notes of orange peel and tangerine toward a gentle, persistent finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 91 points

  • Vinous - 90 points

Food Pairing

The high acidity and earthy character of this Pinot Noir make it an exceptionally flexible partner for the dining table. It pairs beautifully with roasted game birds, grilled duck breast, or dishes featuring earthy mushrooms and black truffles. For a more casual pairing, it complements charcuterie and soft cheeses, which allow the wine's vibrant red fruit to shine.

title: Rocca Delle Macie Roccato 2020
bodyHtml: Deep ruby red with garnet reflections. Rich in bouquet and persistent, with hints of red berries and spices like cocoa, vanilla and coffee. Tastes warm and well-balanced, with a consistent structure of tannins which support the long finish of the wine.

title: Maison Chanzy Chardonnay Bourgogne Les Fortunes 2023
bodyHtml:
White Burgundy is typified by aromas and flavors of green apple and lemon and is defined by its structure and expression of minerality. White Burgundy vinified in stainless-steel tanks will emphasize its freshness, while aging in French oak barrels can lend accents of toast and vanilla. 

With its rich texture and toasted flavors, White Burgundy pairs well with white fish and shellfish, and its naturally high acidity can counterbalance cream-based sauces. Oak-aged Chardonnay from warmer climates lends itself well to grilled fish, starches, butter, and toasted nuts.

title: Blasted Church Viognier 2024
bodyHtml: Apricot, peach, mango, and pear. Beautiful balance between Viognier’s characteristic viscosity and acidity through the mid-palate and into the refreshing finish where a very subtle bitter note carries through, which is a hallmark of the variety.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Asian Pear Nashi No Osake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Established in 1844 as the Marunaka Sake Brewery, Nakano Sake Brewery Co., Ltd. is a historic producer on the Chita Peninsula that officially transitioned to its current name in 1990 while expanding into premium fruit liqueurs. The brewery is renowned for blending traditional Edo period craftsmanship with innovative technology and was recently ranked among the top ten sake breweries in the world.

Description

This fruit based sake possesses a clear, blond appearance. The aroma is remarkably intense and pure, showcasing 100% Asian pear alongside notes of Gala apple, lemon, and a subtle hint of melted butter or buttercream. On the palate, it delivers a crisp and lively texture with refreshing flavours of Anjou pear, grated apple, and citrus fruit. The body is smooth and flavourful, leading to a clean, fresh finish that mimics the experience of biting into freshly picked fruit. ABV 7.5%.

title: Montes Alpha M 2020
bodyHtml: The production of Montes Alpha M is extremely limited, and vintages are only released if head winemaker, Aurelio Montes, considers the quality of the wine to be of a good enough standard. Production starts by selecting individual grapes at harvest time. This wine, from Colchagua Valley, is one of the best and most awarded Chilean wines.

title: Alain Geoffroy Chablis 'Fourchaume' Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from France, specifically from the Chablis Premier Cru appellation in the Burgundy region. Established in 1850 by Honoré Geoffroy, the estate has evolved from humble beginnings into a prominent family domain spanning 50 hectares under the dedicated stewardship of Alain Geoffroy and the current generation. The winery maintains a traditional philosophy that emphasizes the 'typicity' of the Chablis terroir, utilizing stainless steel vinification to preserve the vibrant mineral character and crystalline fruit purity for which the region is world renowned.

Wine Description

Alain Geoffroy Chablis 'Fourchaume' Premier Cru displays a brilliant pale light gold colour with subtle greenish glints. The nose is an elegant and expressive combination of white flowers, fresh acacia blossoms, and citrus fruits, layered with fine notes of freshly baked brioche and tender vegetal scents. On the palate, the wine is powerful and rich yet retains a graceful weightless quality, featuring concentrated flavours of yellow fruit, ripe apple, and pear. It is characterized by its remarkable tension and a razor sharp backbone of chalky minerality, leading to a very long, lively finish that lingers with a saline touch. This 100% Chardonnay is fermented and aged in temperature controlled stainless steel tanks to ensure maximum freshness. The ABV is 13%, and while the winery follows sustainable practices, this wine is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window for this Premier Cru is from 2024 through 2034.

title: Revel Stoke Nutcrusher Peanut Butter Whisky
bodyHtml: With buttery nutty notes and the mild spice of Canadian whisky, the combination is exactly what you never knew you needed. Move over Jelly, Peanut Butter has a new partner in crime…Revel Stoke Whisky.

title: Chateau Cambon La Pelouse 2019
bodyHtml:
The 60 hectare Haut Medoc vineyard of Chateau Cambon La Pelouse is planted to 52% Merlot, 44% Cabernet Sauvignon and 4% Petit Verdot. The current vineyard plantings show a change in their makeup, as all the Cabernet Franc has now been removed.

The vineyard is well placed in the commune of Macau, not far from Chateau Cantemerle and Chateau Giscours. On average, the vines are 25 years of age. The vines are young because the majority of the vineyard was replanted in 1975.

title: Silvia North Coast Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: This wine is a blend of the best Cabernet Sauvignons in their North Coast vineyards coming from their growers of Mendocino Valley, Alexander Valley and Suisun Valley. The 2018 was blended with a splash of Merlot and Malbec. The nose has a touch of plum and a touch of dark mocha. On the palate, layers of soft tannins with light oak presence. This wine is fruity and elegant with a vibrant long mouth-feel. The finish is long with good structure. This wine will pair with everything from pasta, vegan dishes or classic meats.

title: Bench 1775 Paradise Ranch Late Harvest Merlot 2022 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Bench 1775 (formerly known as Paradise Ranch Wines Corp.) is one of the only two Okanagan Wineries producing icewine and late harvest wine since 1997. Under their “Bench 1775” “Paradise Ranch” and “Whistler” brands, they are one of the largest producers and exporters of icewines from BC.

Bench 1775 takes great pride in producing icewine within the strict BC VQA standards — a recognition of the highest level of quality attainable for over 25 years in beautiful British Columbia. Their icewine fruit that was carefully grown over the hot summer months is left to hang and concentrate as they raison on the vines. The fruit must be frozen, and the air temperature must be– 8 °C or lower at the time of harvest to pass through the BC VQA assessment. The resulting wine is high in natural sugar, low in alcohol, has an amazing acidity level, and is intensely sweet and flavourful.

title: Nikka Coffey Malt Japanese Whisky - 700 ml
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Established in 1934 by Masataka Taketsuru, known as the 'Father of Japanese Whisky', Nikka Whisky operates the Miyagikyo Distillery where this unique expression is produced. Unlike most malt whiskies distilled in pot stills, this is made from 100% malted barley and distilled in traditional Coffey stills—typically reserved for grain whisky—to create a distinctively rich and silky profile.

Description

This whisky features a vibrant gold, amber colour. The nose is lively and aromatic, offering a complex blend of fresh lemon, pear, and banana with warming notes of cinnamon, vanilla, and milk chocolate. On the palate, it delivers a robust, dense texture and a silky mouthfeel with sweet flavours of toffee, golden syrup, and brioche balanced by spicy nutmeg and clove. The finish is long and creamy, leaving behind a delightful decline of rich oak, tobacco, and mild chocolate. ABV 45%.

title: Glen Breton 14 Year Old
bodyHtml: A specially handcrafted single malt whisky from the award-winning Canadian distillery. Vibrant gold in the glass with alluring aromas of ripe apple, honey, and maple. The palate offers flavours of sweet vanilla, chocolate, and a kiss of oak. Best served neat to truly appreciate the craftsmanship.

title: Lucky Bastard Dill Pickle Vodka
bodyHtml: Premium Dill Pickle Vodka, distilled 7 times for good luck! Two-time People's Choice Award Winner at the Rocky Mountain Wine & Spirit Festival. Lucky Bastard Vodka gets naturally infused with real dill pickle flavour using Elman's award-winning dill pickles and brine to create a true Saskatchewan favourite, and the almighty Caesar's new best friend!

title: Ellena Giuseppe Barbera d'Alba 2019
bodyHtml: In the glass a dark ruby red colour. On the nose intense aromas of red fruit, flowers and light notes of herbs and spices. On the palate medium-bodied, nicely balanced and warm in the mouth with soft tannins. Long and persistent aftertaste.

title: Gramercy Cellars Lower East Syrah 2020
bodyHtml: It immediately hits you with savoury notes of bacon fat, roasted meat, black olives, tar and black peppercorn, backed by fruit notes of marionberry, ripe bing cherry, black currant and wild mountain berries. Subtle hints of fresh thyme and violets. On the palate, this wine is all about mouthfeel. There are no hard edges. It's smooth and silky. Tannins pick up a bit on the back end, and the acid compliments the palate weight to give this wine a seamless finish.

title: Honoro Vera Blanco Rueda
bodyHtml: Adorned in yet another Gil Family Estate's stunning labels, this Verdejo shows aromas of peaches and yellow apples, lemons and straw flowers with strong undertones of barnyard. It has effusive citrus in the mouth with layers of wild herbs. Creamy in weight, it is a robust and straightforward white with rustic tendencies.

title: Hopes End Red Blend 2021
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
A wine inspired by the true story of thousands of 19th-century free travellers who willingly journeyed by sea from London to the far side of the world in 1886. Instead, they arrived at Port Misery, South Australia, a dark swamp-like place of lawlessness, low morals and high vice, far from the promising new beginnings they sought. At that moment they thought, if HOPE had brought them here, to this dismal place, then surely this was ‘Hopes End.” And so it was named.

Among these free travellers was a young doctor, who had the remarkable idea to make a new kind of tonic for his patients, wine. With this new idea came new beginnings, so at that moment they stopped always hoping for a better tomorrow and decided to live for the day. HOPES END celebrates the courage of those willing to go on a journey of uncertainty and encourages the embracing of the unknown

The Hopes End Red Blend is a voluptuous red wine blend that abounds in vibrancy and finishes with a dark heady swoon. Composed of 49% Shiraz, 30% Grenache, 14% Malbec and 7% Petit Verdot, this dry red wine showcases aromas of foraged berry jam. Flavours of wild dark fruit, earthy vanilla and hints of oak and chocolate give way to a soft, silky, smooth finish. This Australian wine is a great complement to a variety of foods, including barbecue sticky pork ribs, pizza and pasta dishes.

title: Rocca di Montegrossi Chianti Classico Vigneto San Marcellino 2018
bodyHtml: Vigna San Marcellino is both youthfully fresh and maturely complex. It includes a healthy dose of the deeply coloured Pugnitello grape. Licorice, tarragon and broom interlace with exuberant plum and understated toasted nuances that are seductive. Laden with black cherry and rich, velvety tannins, the palate is creamy in texture, while underlying chalkiness and saline minerality lend energy, leading to a sappy, refreshing finish.

title: Carpano Antica Formula - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Carpano's Antica Formula, from the original recipe developed by Antonio Benedetto Carpano in 1786, is a sweet vermouth of the highest quality. This distinctive and powerful aromatized wine should be considered a standard component in any respectable bar. It can be served chilled as an aperitivo, a digestivo or a welcome addition to your favourite cocktail.

title: Killepitsch Premium Herbal Liqueur
bodyHtml: This traditional herbal liqueur dates back to the mid 1800s. The spirit is anything but bitter with dried raisin, dates and figs as its base and spicy cinnamon, nutmeg spice, cracked pepper finish. Although a digestif, it would pair well with a dark chocolate and dried fruit galette.

title: Blue Sauvignon Cellier Des Chartreux 2020
bodyHtml: Dry, fruity, fresh, harmoniously round, and clean, with flavours of tropical fruits and tangy lime. Perfect everyday house wine sipper, aperitif, or an accompaniment to shellfish.

title: 400 Conejos Joven Mezcal
bodyHtml: 400 Conjejos is a joven mezcal made with 100% espadín, a type of agave whose name means small sword and which is among the main types of agave used for mezcal. Joven means young, therefore unaged and clear. Unlike unaged tequila, called silver, joven mezcal has a distinct flavour and is far superior to its tequila counterpart. It's an artisanal mezcal, produced in small batches with traditional methods.

title: Josh Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Josh Cellars was created in 2007 by vintner Joseph Carr as a tribute to his dad, Josh. The brand started with one varietal, Cabernet Sauvignon, and today features a diverse portfolio of well-balanced and delicious wines made to exacting standards. Sourced from across California's great wine-growing regions, every vintage represents a labour of love, a commitment to quality, and a personal promise to make great wine in honour of Josh.

This red wine has the fruit sourced throughout California's Mendocino, Napa and Sonoma counties. It is ruby red in colour with ripe aromas and flavours of plum, floral notes, jam, candied fruit and baking spices. The palate is rich and round, with velvety tannins and flavours of plum jam and licorice on a long finish.

title: Josh Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve Paso Robles 2022
bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon is a 'Reserve' selection from the United States, specifically the Paso Robles appellation within California's Central Coast region. Josh Cellars was founded in 2007 by vintner Joseph Carr as a personal tribute to his father, Josh, a military veteran, lumberjack, and volunteer firefighter. The winery's ethos is built on hard work and a commitment to quality, ensuring their wines are well-balanced and delicious. Winemaker Wayne Donaldson, who joined in 2009, has achieved numerous 90+ scores for the brand, including for the Paso Robles Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon.

Wine Description

This red wine, made from Cabernet Sauvignon, is a bold, full-bodied, and well-rounded selection from a region known for its intense midday sun and cool morning fog. The colour is deep and rich. The aroma profile features notes of bright blueberry and red fruits backed by powerful scents of black peppercorn and aromatic earthy tones. On the palate, it is juicy and robust with flavors of raspberry, coffee, plum, and blackberry. The structure is defined by bold tannins that are smooth and velvety, a medium body, and a long, satisfying finish with hints of smoky spice and vanilla. For the 2020 vintage, critics noted the aromas of black cherry cream and brown spice, with more dark cherry and oak flavours on the palate, wrapped in soft tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: Cabernet Sauvignon

  • Optimal Drinking Window: Enjoy now (The 2017 vintage was suggested to drink between 2021-2024)

  • Organic: Not explicitly stated, but the wines are crafted to exacting standards

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 2021 American Winery of the Year (Award for the winery)

Food Pairing

The robust nature of this wine pairs excellently with red meats, such as grilled steaks or lamb chops. Other suggested pairings include a charcuterie board, aged cheeses like cheddar or gouda, or a rich Bolognese sauce. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Josh Cellars Rose 2021
bodyHtml:
Josh Cellars Rosé 2021 hails from the United States, specifically California, a region known for its versatile and expressive wines. The winery was founded by Joseph Carr, who named the label in honour of his father, Josh. Built on a legacy of family values and dedication, Josh Cellars has grown to become one of the most trusted wine brands in North America, with a philosophy centred on quality, approachability, and heartfelt craftsmanship.

This rosé presents a soft, blush pink colour in the glass. On the nose, it opens with inviting aromas of white peach, strawberries, and citrus blossom, accented by a hint of melon. The palate follows with vibrant red berry fruit, juicy citrus zest, and a delicate floral character. Light to medium-bodied, it offers a refreshingly crisp acidity and a dry, elegant finish. The wine is crafted from a blend of grape varietals including Barbera and Syrah, among others, selected to deliver bright fruit and balance. Best enjoyed within two years of vintage to capture its fresh and lively nature, it delivers a polished and clean style that is both accessible and refined.

Food Pairing
Ideal pairings include grilled shrimp skewers, goat cheese salads, or prosciutto-wrapped melon. The bright acidity and subtle fruit tones also pair well with sushi or Mediterranean-style chicken. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Leaping Horse Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml: Medium-bodied with a delightful pale-yellow hue, the Leaping Horse Vineyards Chardonnay is bright and crisp from start to finish. It has citrus highlights to green apples, pears and tropical fruit aromas and flavours. The finish hints to a bit of lemon zest and a tight minerality that is enjoyable and refreshing.

title: Leaping Horse Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Born from a love of horses, Leaping Horse is aptly named. The Kautz family have been involved in many generations of riders and are passionate about their equine friends and partners. From an artist rendition to today’s look, Leaping Horse is about unpretentious and contemporary wine styles.

The Leaping Horse Cabernet Sauvignon is a luscious Cabernet with deep red-purple hues and flavours of black currant and cherry with hints of blueberry jam, eucalyptus and mint with lovely vanilla and coffee notes. It is smooth, rich and deliciously enjoyable. Ideal for hearty stews, beef soups, grilled or barbecued red meats, pasta dishes with tomato-based sauces, strong cheeses or grilled chicken. It is also fabulous with a rich chocolate dessert.

title: Carmen Chardonnay Gran Reserva
bodyHtml: Handpicked from the El Rodrigo estate vineyard in Casablanca. This is a very fine chardonnay with a complex bouquet of fruits, wood, vanilla, and butter; pleasant in the mouth, with great body and length.

title: Paolo Scavino Barbera d'Alba 2021
bodyHtml: Barbera lovers rejoice! Scavino delivers again and again with this approachable, fruity variety. Vinification and aging occur in stainless steel to purely deliver its character. Floral, elegant and expressive aromatics, high toned texture, harmonious and lively acidity.

title: Robert Mondavi Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley 2021
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine originates from the United States, specifically crafted within California's renowned Napa Valley. Founded in 1966, Robert Mondavi Winery was established with the pioneering vision to create Napa Valley wines that could stand company with the finest in the world. Robert Mondavi fundamentally shaped the region's modern wine industry by combining traditional European winemaking philosophies with innovative, state of the art Californian techniques.

Wine Description

In the glass, this wine displays a deep, intense red color. The expressive bouquet opens with powerful kirsch, black cherry, and wild blackberry aromatics, lifted by nuances of warm baking spices, sweet toasty oak, and a subtle herbal undertone. On the palate, the wine is full bodied, plush, and layered, packing a core of juicy dark plums, fresh dark fruit, and dark chocolate. It exhibits an elegant freshness and remarkable complexity, showing seamless balance between its velvety, fine grained tannins and mineral tension.

Food Pairing

This rich and structured Cabernet Sauvignon pairs beautifully with grilled New York strip loin, filet mignon, or a hearty lamb Bolognese. It also serves as an excellent complement to mature hard cheeses such as aged gouda.

title: Paolo Scavino Barolo 2021
bodyHtml: Paolo Scavino is a historical winery in the Barolo region. It was founded in 1921 in Castiglione Falletto by Lorenzo Scavino and his son Paolo. Farming has always been a family tradition and passion. Enrico Scavino and the daughters Enrica and Elisa, the fourth generation, run the family Estate. He started to work full-time in the winery in 1951 when he was ten years old. A young winemaker who inherited the passion and devotion for the land he belongs to. Through over 60 years of experience, his focus has been to invest in Nebbiolo's important cru to show each terroir's uniqueness. The love and respect inspire their work for their territory. They pursue purity of expression, complexity and elegance for their wines from the three local grapes Dolcetto, Barbera and Nebbiolo. These values and culture have been carried on and never changed. This Barolo comes from the best plots of their seven crus. The diversity of soils, exposure and altitude characterize this small but very important terroir. Unifying these diversities, the Barolo offers harmony and complexity with an overall character of the zone.

title: Shannon Ridge Buck Shack Bourbon Barrel Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Shannon Ridge is dedicated to crafting luscious, fruit-driven wines that express the distinct characteristics of fruit grown in the high valley region of Lake County, California. Family-owned and operated, Shannon Ridge was founded in 2001. The vineyards hug the mountain rims along the southeast edge of High Valley AVA. Surrounded by dramatic landscapes and pristine wilderness, the story of High Valley is visible from their property. At 2,200 feet, on top of the Terre Vermeille vineyard, look to your south. You'll see the deep blue waters of Clear Lake that provide cooling winds throughout their long summer days. Turn to the west, and you can distinguish where the lava flows give way to the alluvial fan of the ancient lake bed on the valley floor. From the north, you can feel the cold night winds from Snow Mountain and the peaks of the Mendocino National Forest.

Aging Cabernet Sauvignon in bourbon barrels shows off the natural ripe fruits while softening the tannins and adding an aged balance to the wine. Each sip resonates with rich hints of bourbon.

title: Shannon Ridge High Elevation Zinfandel 2021
bodyHtml: This Zinfandel has ripe fruit characters of blackberry and plum. The mid-palate is an explosion of spices and fruit, balanced with soft oak notes and a structured finish. This delicious, smooth and nicely ripe wine is saturated in black plums and strawberries that fill out the full body. Light tannins and good concentration combine for a tasty, gulpable wine.

title: Stave & Steel Cabernet Sauvignon Bourbon Barrel Aged
Three Finger Jack Old Vine Zinfandel 2023
bodyHtml:
Three Finger Jack was a legendary bandit and gunslinger who roamed central California during the early days of the Gold Rush during the mid-1800s, when thirsty miners first began growing grapes and making wine in the present-day appellations of Lodi, California Like Jack, Zinfandel is a daring and brash wine that is quintessentially California. These old vines, up to 110 years old, have stood the test of time and today make some of the richest and most complex Zinfandels in the world.

 Three Finger Jack has aromas of rich black fruits, spice and vanilla which invites daring tasters to the exciting region of Lodi. The palate continues the experience with intense flavours of ripe blackberry, plum, and spice but with a touch of leather and cedar. This is a full-bodied wine which pairs with many diverse cuisines from the traditional American backyard barbecue to Korean-style Bulgogi.

title: Tom Gore Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
A well-priced, medium-bodied Chardonnay, easy to enjoy chilled on its own or paired with roast turkey or chicken.

Bright on the palate with ripe apple, stone fruit, dried pineapple, dulce de leche flavours finishing smooth and creamy.

title: Wente Pinot Noir Riva Ranch 2023
bodyHtml:
Wente Vineyards, established in 1883 and still family-owned, is a pioneering winery in California’s Livermore Valley. The Riva Ranch Vineyard in Arroyo Seco, Monterey, is a prized estate location where the cool maritime influence and gravelly soils create ideal conditions for growing expressive Pinot Noir. The Wente family’s commitment to sustainable viticulture and traditional winemaking practices underscores their dedication to quality and heritage.

This Pinot Noir presents a luminous ruby red colour. Aromas of ripe cherry, raspberry, and cranberry meld with notes of baking spice, rose petals, and a subtle hint of earth. The palate is medium-bodied, offering a smooth texture and layers of red fruit, clove, and a touch of vanilla from oak ageing. Silky tannins and vibrant acidity lead to a long, elegant finish. Crafted entirely from Pinot Noir, this wine showcases balance and finesse, with an optimal drinking window from 2024 to 2028.

Food Pairing
Pair this elegant Pinot Noir with mushroom risotto, roasted duck breast, or herb-crusted salmon. The wine’s acidity and refined fruit profile also complement soft cheeses and charcuterie. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: J Lohr Sauvignon Blanc Flume Crossing 2024
bodyHtml: The Flume Crossing Sauvignon Blanc is pale yellow in colour, highlighted by aromas of honeysuckle and daffodil, grapefruit, sweet herbs, and key lime. These aromas are complemented on the palate by the bright flavours of grapefruit, lime, and lemongrass, with the rich texture and long finish provided by the acacia barrels. Serve as an aperitif with goat cheese, oysters, arugula salad, or paired with an entrée of sushi or grilled swordfish with fresh lime and herb marinade.

title: Ironstone Petite Sirah 2021
bodyHtml: This Petite Sirah is a must-try for lovers of bold and flavorful reds. Succulent & rich, its deep purple colour leads way to bold aromas of warm berry pie and loads of blueberry mixed with vanilla and light pepper spice. Full flavours of lush berries mixed with dark chocolate, warm cedar, and vanilla give way to a delightfully smooth finish with moderate tannins. This wine is a perfect companion with dishes like veal saltimbocca or braised beef with winter vegetables. Any dish with mushrooms is sure to be a palate pleaser.

title: Hahn Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml: Subtle touches of vanilla and toasty oak join aromas of red and dark cherry, raspberry and strawberry. The palate is medium-bodied with silky tannins, a soft round mouthfeel, excellent acid balance and notes of earthiness on a long, lingering finish.

title: Exitus Bourbon Barrel Red Blend 2017
bodyHtml:
This Bourbon barrel aged red wine is fermented in American stainless steel and then aged for 3 months in Kentucky Bourbon barrels. This bold blend of Zinfandel, Petit Verdot, and Cabernet Sauvignon provide a deep ruby colour with aromas of blackberry compote, leather and dusty dark chocolate.
