Bourbon barrel aging offers aromas of fire-toasted oak, baking spices, caramel and loose leaf tobacco.

On the shelf, you may notice that Exitus doesn’t look like your typical bottle of red wine. That’s because they don’t hide behind tinted glass. Why should you have to wait until your first pour to experience the rich crimson hue of their Bourbon barrel aged blend? Instead of traditional shaded bottles that mask the colour of the wine inside, they insisted on doing things their way. Exitus bucks tradition with a clear glass bottle that showcases what matters most.

title: Cycles Gladiator Zinfandel 2021
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, this Zinfandel originates from the renowned Lodi region of California. Cycles Gladiator was founded with a philosophy focused on celebrating the 'wine artisan' and the authentic expression of the vineyard. The winery emphasizes crafting wines that offer a high quality-to-price ratio, ensuring their bottles reflect the unique nuances of their origin rather than mass-produced styles.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep, dark ruby red colour in the glass. The bouquet is rich and aromatic, featuring sweet notes of black cherries, strawberries, and plums, complemented by subtle hints of baking spices and smoke. On the palate, it is a medium to full bodied Zinfandel with jammy fruit flavours and a touch of peppery spice. It is beautifully structured with silky tannins and balanced acidity, leading to a smooth, fruit-driven finish.

Food Pairing

The bold fruit and spicy undertones of this Zinfandel make it an ideal companion for grilled meats such as BBQ pork ribs, lamb chops, or a hearty steak. It also pairs exceptionally well with rich, tomato based pasta dishes and wood fired pizzas.

title: Cycles Gladiator Pinot Noir 2020
bodyHtml:
Since its inception in 2005, Cycles Gladiator Wines have celebrated and championed women’s empowerment. Inspired by the women’s suffrage movement, the brand draws its name from the 19th century French bicycle manufacturer, the Gladiator Cycles Company, and honours their powerful original artwork on the wine label. 

Over a century later, Cycles Gladiator’s striking label still resonates with wine lovers across the country. Adam LaZarre, acclaimed and multiple award-winning winemaker, is at the helm, and has been since the brand’s beginning. Having lived in Paso Robles for more than twenty years, Adam is extraordinarily connected to his community and the winegrowers in the area. 

Find beautiful aromatics of cherry with a hint of sexy toasted oak. The flavours are lush and sweet with notes of black cherry, pomegranate, and strawberry. The acidity is well balanced and helps preserve the sensation of velvet well into the finish.

title: Tenuta San Jacopo Chianti Riserva Poggio Ai Grilli 2020
bodyHtml: Poggio Ai Grilli Riserva is characterized by a warm and fruity taste, round yet good tannic structure, with a sapid touch in the closing. The bouquet remembers sour cherry combined with sweet spices, tobacco, leather, and balsamic notes.

title: Aquinas Pinot Noir 2018
bodyHtml: Earthy tones are dominant with notes of black currant and toasted clove. A remarkably round wine with bright raspberry, blueberry and blackberry flavors reminiscent of a berry mélange. Napa Carneros fruit shines through with smoky flavors and a lingering, beautiful finish.

title: Quilt The Fabric Of The Land 2024
bodyHtml:
As a fifth-generation Napa Valley winemaker, Joe's roots run deep in these rich soils. At 19 he started working alongside his father at Caymus Vineyards. Then, in 2001, created Belle Glos, with a focus on vineyard-designated Pinot Noirs from California's best coastal regions. His love for Napa wine and the singular fusion of natural elements, history, and spirit found in the Napa Valley are the foundation for Quilt.

Wine Description

The Quilt The Fabric Of The Land presents a deep plum colour with scarlet red highlights. On the nose, it offers expressive aromas of black cherry, raspberry, and ripe plum, complemented by hints of pepper, licorice, and black pepper. The palate is full-bodied, rich, and complex, showcasing flavours of tart raspberry, blackberry, dark chocolate, and light notes of spice.

Food Pairing

 Suggested pairings include lamb, or other hearty meats that can stand up to the wine's full body and suede tannins.

title: Sea Sun Pinot Noir 2022 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
This expressive and 'layered' red wine originates from the United States, specifically from premier coastal regions within the state of California. Sea Sun is a label under the Wagner Family of Wines, produced by winemaker Charlie Wagner, whose family founded the iconic Caymus Vineyards and has roots in Napa Valley winemaking dating back to the 1850s. The winery's philosophy is rooted in an ongoing exploration of California's diverse coastal lands, where the 'sea' breezes from the Pacific Ocean balance the bright 'sun' to create an extended growing season.

Wine Description

Sea Sun Pinot Noir presents a deep and intense ruby colour. The sensory profile is 'strikingly soft' and aromatic, featuring a nose of baked cherries, dark plum, and red licorice, layered with sophisticated notes of vanilla, brown sugar, and toasty oak spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and 'lush', showcasing rich flavours of ripe strawberry, blueberry, and milk chocolate underpinned by subtle hints of violet and truffle. It is characterized by its silky mouthfeel, fine-grained tannins, and a balanced acidity that prevents the jammy fruit character from being overwhelming. This 100% Pinot Noir typically reaches an ABV of approximately 14.4%. While the Wagner family utilizes the unique natural forces of coastal vineyard sites, this wine is not certified organic.

title: Treana Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 (Austin Hope Winery)
bodyHtml: Treana is your quintessential Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon.  From the depth of color and intense nose, this wine is made with structure and purpose.  On the palate, flavors of beautiful rich blackberry, warm vanilla, toasted coffee and black cherry are finished with firm but refined tannins.

title: Chateau Peyrassol Cuvee des Commandeurs Rose Cotes de Provence 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This rose wine originates from France, specifically from the Cotes de Provence appellation. The Commanderie de Peyrassol is a landmark estate with a history dating back to 1256, when it was founded by the Knights Templar. Currently owned by Philippe Austruy, the winery is managed with a philosophy of cultivating the 'art of wine', focusing on precision and an elegant expression of the diverse clay and limestone terroirs of the Massif des Maures foothills.

Wine Description

Chateau Peyrassol Cuvee des Commandeurs Rose displays a soft, pale pink colour reminiscent of rose petals or lychees. The nose is expressive and charming, offering a perfumed mix of blood orange, peach, and jasmine, alongside wild berries like gooseberry and raspberry. On the palate, the wine is silky and crisp, delivering a lively mix of citrus, white currant, and orchard fruit flavours supported by a spine of juicy acidity. It is characterized by its refreshing tension, a delicate mineral touch, and a subtle saline finish. The varietal composition typically includes approximately 40% Grenache, 30% Cinsault, and 15% Syrah, with small amounts of Vermentino (Rolle) and Mourvedre. The ABV is approximately 12.5% to 13%, and the vineyard is certified organic by Ecocert. The optimal drinking window is from release through the next two years to preserve its freshness.

title: Chateau Peyrassol Cotes de Provence Rose 2024
bodyHtml: Pale in color, with soft rose-tinted overtones, Château Peyrassol radiates freshness. Its subtle nose of citrus, vine peach, apricot and delicate florals is inviting. It has a dense palate, poised and lively, and is notable for its balance, punctuated by a long, fruity finish.

title: Francis Ford Coppola Cabernet Sauvignon Director's Cut 2023
bodyHtml: Full-bodied with sturdy tannins, deep, layered fruit character, and a lushness on the palate, Director's Cut Cabernet Sauvignon boasts a melange of red and black berry flavors, cherries, cassis, notes of lavender, and a broad range of spices and toasted oak.

title: Remy Martin Louis XIII Magnum (1.5 Litre Crystal Decanter)
bodyHtml:
A legendary Cognac from the prestigious house of Remy Martin, containing Grande Champagne eau-de-vie aged between 40 and 100 years and packaged in a gorgeous Baccarat decanter.

Nose: Very floral, with honeysuckle, and sweet, with delicately perfumed fruit – melon and peaches. There is also a hint of flowery honey and a marzipan nuttiness.

Palate: Cinnamon, almonds, peach, orange and orange blossom, and woody spice. The brief note in my notebook says, 'like eating twigs and sweet flowers'.

Finish: Delicate grape, sweet oak spice, melon and lingering floral notes.

title: Leacock's Rainwater Madeira
bodyHtml:
General Information

Leacock’s Rainwater is fined and does not require decanting. It has been bottled when ready for drinking and will keep for several months after opening.

Topaz colour with golden reflections. Characteristic Madeira bouquet of dried fruits, orange peels and notes of wood. Medium dry at first, followed by an attractive freshness of citrus flavours, with a long, luxurious finish.

title: La Playa Estate Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: A delicate pale gold. On the nose, aromas of lemon, fresh pineapple with hints of lavender. It is a bright well balanced wine with a clean minerality and touch of lime on the finish.

title: Pietradolce Archineri Etna Rosso 2020
bodyHtml:
Founded in 2005, Pietradolce is a boutique estate located on the northern slopes of Mount Etna in Sicily, Italy. Owned by the Faro family, the winery is dedicated to preserving the heritage of old-vine Nerello Mascalese grown in the region's unique volcanic soils. Their vineyards, particularly in Contrada Rampante at high elevation (approx. 850 m), are home to pre-phylloxera bush-trained vines, some over 90 years old, embodying the essence of Etna’s winemaking tradition.

This 100% Nerello Mascalese is a striking expression of its volcanic terroir. Ruby-garnet in colour, it opens with lifted aromas of wild red berries, dried herbs, violets, and flinty minerality. The palate is refined and layered, offering notes of red cherry, raspberry, dried rose petals, and earthy spice, framed by vibrant acidity and firm yet silky tannins.

Food Pairing
This elegant Etna Rosso pairs beautifully with grilled lamb chops, wild mushroom risotto, or eggplant parmigiana. The wine’s tension and minerality complement savoury dishes, while its floral and red fruit notes balance earthy, umami-rich ingredients.

title: Primarius Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
With its diverse topography and rich terroir, Oregon provides the perfect palette from which to craft wines of elegance and balance. Primarius is a wine made for the people, by the hearts and hands of the people who know Oregon Pinot best. Primarius = Latin for Distinguished. With each blend, winemaker Sarah Cabot hand selects the very best fruit to masterfully craft wines complex in structure and truly distinguished in style. Ever-changing vineyard sourcing promotes constant evolution in the winemaking technique to allow for unparalleled consistency from vintage to vintage.

This Pinot Noir is a blend of all of their vineyard sources throughout Oregon and is representative of one of Oregon's great vintages. Aromatics suggest brambly cane berries and Bing cherries accented by some subtle notes of cinnamon and clove. The palate carries these aromas on and compliments them with lively acidity and just a hint of oak sweetness. The mouthfeel is round and pleasant and yields some further depth suggesting Morello cherries and nutmeg. The finish lingers with soft, silky tannins and leaves an aftertaste of sweet red and black fruits and Christmas spice.

title: North Star Girvan 26 Year Old #008
bodyHtml:
General Information

North Star Girvan 26 years old 1992 is an older Lowlands single grain bottled by the independent bottler North Star Spirits. This release in the Cask Series 008 was distilled in September 1992 and matured in a bourbon barrel. It was bottled in March 2019 at natural cask strength of 53.5% ABV, non chill filtered and with no added colour. This is a limited single cask release of 180 bottles.

title: Cadenhead Tomatin 10 Year Old
bodyHtml: Distilled in 2008 and aged in bourbon casks before being bottled at 55.5% alc./vol in 2018.

title: Los Danzantes Still Proof Mezcal Artesanal
bodyHtml:
Artisanal Mezcal produced in Destileria Los Danzantes in 2018. Single batch of Maguey Cuishe, Mexicano, Lumbre and Espadin cultivated in Cerro El Coquito in Santa Cruz Mixtepec, Oaxaca.


See More Mezcal

title: La Vita E Bella Malbech 2020 - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: A gem of forgotten vines can be found hidden among the gorgeous hills of Veneto. Three generations of the Savian family have cared for these 65-year-old Malbec vineyards. Both the eyes and the nose are enticed by the crimson colour, which is laced with bluish-purple hues and aromatics of wild strawberry and black pepper powdered cranberries. On the tongue, there is plenty of black fruit with enough freshness to keep you coming back for another glass. Red fruits, jam, baking spices, vanilla, milk chocolate, tobacco, low tannins, and medium alcohol.

title: Black Hills Estate Winery Alias 2017
bodyHtml:
A wide array of intense fruit aromas is the hallmark of the Alias blend, and the 2017 version does not disappoint. No less than seven different grape varieties combine to produce an impressive range of aromas - lemon curd, fresh flowers, green apple, lime juice, ginger and exotic spices all leap out of the glass. On the palate fresh acidity combines seamlessly with a hint of sweetness, and the long finish shows further complexity through pineapple and honey flavours. A fantastic appetizer wine, Alias is best enjoyed chilled while in its youth.

2017 was a great vintage for Okanagan white wines. The warm and dry summer resulted in concentrated and ripe berries, while the cool August and September helped the grapes retain crisp natural acidity and high aromatic intensity. The aromatic white wines present in Alias all show the benefits of these seasonal influences.

Blend:   24% Chasselas, 18% Riesling, 17% Muscat, 15% Gewurztraminer, 12% Pinot Blanc, 9% Pinot Gris, 5% Schonburger

92 Points - Natalie Maclean      A lovely, fragrant, floral BC white wine blend of Riesling and other aromatic grapes. Aromas of lime blossom, lychee, golden apple and honeydew. Pair with mild and medium curries and spices.

title: Marchesi di Barolo Barbaresco 2020
bodyHtml: This Barbaresco moves over the palate with direct and silky intensity. Along the way, the wine imparts delicate tones of forest berry, wild cherry and rosehip. There are subtle hints of tar, button mushroom, and tilled earth at the back. This is a simple and easy-drinking Barbaresco to pair with your favourite pasta dishes.

title: Cockburn's Late Bottled Vintage Port 2017
bodyHtml: This is a wine so elegant, sophisticated and complex that it really is a bit magical. A real crowd pleaser meant to be shared and enjoyed.  Made from a single vintage, only the ripest, juiciest, most intensely flavoured grapes are selected for the winemaking process. This involves large oak vats, smaller oak barrels, and up to six years of maturation. All completely worth it, we think you’ll agree.

title: Thibault Liger-Belair Bourgogne Rouge 'Les Grands Chaillots'
Fukumitsuya Kagatobi Gokken Junmai Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Fukumitsuya Kagatobi Gokkan Junmai originates from Kanazawa in the Ishikawa Prefecture of Japan. Founded in 1625, Fukumitsuya Sake Brewery is the oldest sake producer in Kanazawa and is currently led by 13th generation owner Matsutaro Fukumitsu. The brewery operates as a 'Junmai Gura', meaning it exclusively produces pure rice sake without added alcohol, utilizing exceptionally pure water fed by snowmelt from Mount Hakusan.

Description

This sake takes its name from the legendary, tough firefighters of the historic Kaga mansion and is brewed specifically during the coldest winter months (Gokkan) to ensure optimal fermentation. It is clear in appearance and offers a gentle aroma of ripe fruits such as banana and apple, alongside notes of steamed rice, mushroom, and fresh herbs. On the palate, it provides a silky attack with a harmonious balance of fresh acidity and rich umami, followed by a slight, agreeable bitterness. It is a dry and sharp sake with an alcohol content of 15% and a rice polishing rate of 65%.

Food Pairing

The dry and sharp profile of Kagatobi Gokkan makes it an exceptionally versatile companion for a wide range of dishes. It pairs seamlessly with Japanese staples such as sushi, gyoza dumplings, ramen, and fried shrimp. Its earthy umami notes also complement Western style appetizers like fish escabeche, oil sardines, and mushroom risotto. This sake is unique for its ability to be enjoyed at various temperatures, from chilled at 10°C to highlight its fruitiness, to warmed at 45°C to enhance its savoury rice characteristics.

title: Chateau de Berne Rose Inspiration 2023
bodyHtml: Bring the sunshine and the taste of Provence to your table with this distinctive square bottle which is as stunning as the wine itself, looking impressive wherever it’s poured. So grab a bottle, drink one with friends, celebrate with it, or give it as a gift and share your love of Inspiration. Classic Provence. Floral, clean, fresh berries first, followed by fresh herbs and flowers, like walking through a Provence lavender field on an early summer morning. Pair with classic roasted chicken with lemon and Herbs de Provence, grilled lobster. An incredible wine for the holiday table with its visual appeal and ability to pair with a variety of challenging cuisine.

title: Hakutsuru Superior Junmai Ginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Hakutsuru Superior Junmai Ginjo is a premium Japanese sake produced in the Nada district of Kobe, within the Hyogo prefecture. It is crafted by Hakutsuru Sake Brewing Co. Ltd., a historic brewery founded in 1743 that has grown to become one of Japan's leading sake producers. The brewery utilizes traditional methods alongside modern technology, sourcing natural spring water from Mt. Rokko to create its signature refined profile.

Description

This sake is characterized by its flowery and elegant sensory profile, presented in a distinctive aqua blue frosted bottle. It features a delicate aroma of ripe strawberry and melon, complemented by notes of blueberry and sweet rice. On the palate, it is smooth, well balanced, and crisp, offering flavours of pear and cantaloupe with a hint of nutty rice. The body is light and dry, leading to a refined and rounded finish. It has an alcohol by volume of 14.5% and is best served chilled or at room temperature.

Food Pairing

The light and floral nature of Hakutsuru Superior Junmai Ginjo makes it an excellent companion for delicate seafood such as sashimi, steamed clams, and light fish like scallop or crab. It also pairs gracefully with savory vegetable dishes, including edamame, tempura, and sauteed vegetables. Beyond traditional Japanese fare, it complements Western options like fresh goat cheese, salads with fruit, or simple roasted nuts. For a unique combination, try serving it with grilled king oyster mushrooms to match its balanced acidity.

title: Hakkaisan Tokubetsu Honjozo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Established in 1922, Hakkaisan Brewery is situated at the foot of Mount Hakkai, where it utilizes exceptionally soft spring water known as 'Raiden-sama no Shimizu'. The brewery, currently led by third-generation president Jiro Nagumo, is dedicated to the 'Tanrei Balanced' philosophy—creating high-quality, dry, and crisp sake that complements meals without being tiring to drink.

Description

This signature 'special' Honjozo features a clear and colourless appearance. The nose is delicate and fresh, offering subtle notes of yeast and highly polished rice. On the palate, it delivers a smooth and mellow texture with a light-bodied, grainy character and a quiet complexity. Its flavour profile is clean and refined with a touch of alcohol warmth and a refreshing, dry finish. Crafted using locally grown Gohyakumangoku and Todorokiwase rice polished to 55%, this sake is exceptionally versatile; chilling brings out its crispness, while gentle heating enhances the rich umami and savory characteristics of the koji rice. ABV 15.5%.

title: Carlo Pellegrino Ulysse Etna Rosso 2014
bodyHtml:
This warm and embracing wine is called “Ulysse” in honour of the ancient legend where Ulysse landed in this part of Sicily. This wine is still produced from grapes grown in small vineyards scattered around the slopes of the Etna.

A blend of Nerello Mascalese and Nerello Cappuccio grapes, Ulysse is ruby red with garnet reflections.  Its nose is intense and persistent with hints of red fruits and spices, redcurrant, plum, cloves and vanilla.  A dry red that's soft and well-balanced.

title: Chateau Angludet 2019
bodyHtml:
Made from a blend of 43% Merlot, 45% Cabernet Sauvignon and 12% Petit Verdot, the ageing of this wine has changed in recent years and is now half in amphoras, with 30% new oak and 20% used oak, for 12 months. The result is a deep ruby-purple colour and evocative and seductive aromatics of blue fruit and bramble. The palate is smooth and silky, with soft and integrated tannins allowing the fruit to shine. There is a freshness of acidity on the back end that lifts the palate to add some floral.

92 Points - James Suckling

A dense, layered red with chocolate, hazelnut and redcurrants. It's medium-to full-bodied. Chewy tannins at the end.

title: Red Rooster Merlot Reserve Rare Bird Series 2018
bodyHtml: A Merlot with a bouquet and flavours of cherry, plum, red licorice, spice and oak. Showing an ever-changing bouquet of red cherry, plum and wild strawberry fruit, accented by notes of red licorice, baking spice and smoky oak. This is a full-bodied Merlot with firm tannins and a balanced structure. Ripe fruit flavours of cherry and plum mingle with spice notes on the palate. The finish shows black tea, spice, earth, red currant and cherry notes.

title: Bacardi Gold Rum - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Hand blended, charcoal filtered and aged for two years in American white oak barrels. This rum brings depth and character to classic rum cocktails while maintaining balance. Expect vanilla, butterscotch and lemon zest aromas; light fruit and toffee flavours and a lightly spicy warm finish.

title: Whitehaven Sauvignon Blanc 2024 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: A delicious wine! Pale yellow-green, with star bright clarity. Lifted passionfruit, grapefruit, gooseberry, and peach fruit flavours, with complexing hints of jalapeno, nettle, boxwood and blackcurrant leaf. A full-flavoured, medium-bodied wine, with an abundance of regionally typical blackcurrant and gooseberry flavours that linger on the dry, clean finish. This wine is a perfect accompaniment to summer salads, poultry and mussels. Also, try it with lobster and white fish.

title: Rabl Gruner Veltliner Loss 2024
bodyHtml:
This crisp white wine hails from Austria, specifically the prestigious Kamptal region. Weingut Rabl is a historic family estate in Langenlois with winemaking roots dating back to 1750. Currently managed by Rudi Rabl, the winery focuses on ecological balance and has been certified by Sustainable Austria since 2015, emphasizing a philosophy that combines traditional values with modern cellar techniques to express the unique loess and primary rock terroirs of their 80 hectare estate.

Wine Description

The Rabl Gruner Veltliner Loss displays a bright, youthful appearance. The nose is penetrating and aromatic, featuring a bouquet of tropical fruits, blossom, and lime. On the palate, the wine is dry and zesty, showcasing a slender to medium body with vibrant flavours of fresh pear, tart apple, and starfruit. These fruit notes are underpinned by a fine herbal complexity and a signature hint of white pepper. The finish is precise and juicy, leaving a lingering mineral note.

title: Los Danzantes Mezcal Sierra Negra
bodyHtml: Sierra Negra is a name for a rare variety of the same species of agave that contains Espadín - however, this name can also be given to a variety of Agave americana. This special edition batch of Agave angustifolia var. Sierra Negra was produced by Maestra Mezcalera Karina Abad at Los Danzantes in Matatlan, from agaves grown for 10 years at 900 metres of elevation in San Juan Lajarcia, Yautepec, Oaxaca in sandy, eroded limestone soils. Notes of mild chile pepper, candied sweetness, light and heady smoke, and a warm tingle on the tongue with a medium to long finish. 100% Agave Sierra Negra.

title: Los Danzantes Mezcal Pechuga
bodyHtml: This artisanal mezcal is distilled three times in copper pot stills, the last with seasonal fruit, spices and a creole hen – and then dyed red with Grana Cochinilla - an insect which has been providing rich crimson dye for generations. Aroma: Wafts of anise and citrus, where orange is prevalent, with notes of tamarind. Palate: Its fresh flavor contains traces of grated oranges and lemon juice; its pomegranate red color is clean and brilliant. Pairing: This mezcal is a special type of digestif that smoothly accompanies desserts with its spiced notes, similar to European digestifs spiced with herbs. Try with crème brûlée, chocolate and vanilla.

title: DeLoach Pinot Noir Russian River 2021
bodyHtml: A delightful ruby color in the glass, this Russian River Valley Pinot Noir offers aromas of sweet red fruits with hints of vanilla. Flavors of cherry, raspberry, plum and clove mingle upon the palate, displaying balanced structure, medium body and moderate tannins. Made to be immediately enjoyable, this wine is a perfect accompaniment to wood-fired pizza or mushroom risotto.

title: Barrel Burner Chardonnay 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Seducing aromas of brown sugar, caramel, toasted almonds, and baked apples get released with every glass swirl. Big, rich, and full-bodied with flavours of toffee, butterscotch, and toasted oak with a long finish.

title: Messias Colheita Port 1963
bodyHtml: 94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate     The 1963 Colheita Port is an old vines field blend bottled in 2014 with a long cork. Fresh, rich and bright on the finish, this has a whiff of brandy, but it is surprisingly clean and youthful for its age. It lingers nicely, finally showing all of those old Tawny flavours. It's sweet caramel nuances are especially delectable on the juicy finish, but they weren't so defined and nuanced early on. I wasn't as thrilled on the first tastes, but by the fourth day, its beautiful acidity took over and made it multidimensional. Sexy yet ultimately crisp, this should be a crowd-pleaser and then some. As always, the end-date drinking window is just a placeholder. This should hold indefinitely, barring cork failures.

title: San Matias Tahona Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
A ripe wheat Tequila that's clean and transparent, with great brilliance and golden sparkles as well as greenish hue, slow cup runoff, and medium-high body.  It has an intense citrate aroma of lemon leaf, pear-type green fruit and pineapple and vanilla; deep notes of dry leaves like Laurel and snuff, aroma of bread crust and honey, the retro nose is discovered pink pepper; orange peel and sweet cinnamon.  The taste is sweet, slightly sapid with great minerality, moderate acidity and no bitterness.

Excellent flavor to be paired with chocolate and vanilla dessert.

title: Choya Yuzu Liqueur
bodyHtml: Famously cultivated in the Shikoku island of Japan, thorny yet beautiful yuzu citrus infuses. This liqueur with floral wonders and its refreshing citrus taste brings out the best of this luxury drink.

title: Devil's Candy Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml: Fruit sourced from a several Napa Valley vineyard locations, including Calistoga, Oakville, St. Helena, Coombsville and Pope Valley. Each region contributes unique characteristics to the wine, with it all coming together to create a rich, bold and expressive wine with multiple layers of complexity.

title: Balvenie 14 Year Old The Week Of Peat
bodyHtml: One of three releases in The Balvenie Stories range is a peaty 14-year-old single malt Scotch whisky inspired by distillery manager Ian Millar installing a peat burner at Balvenie. For one week each year, the distillery created peated whisky using Speyside peat, resulting in expressions that introduce fragrant smoke notes to the classic Balvenie flavour profile.

title: Balblair 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
General Information

Balblair 18 Year Old is the third whisky in the Balblair Collection and has been matured in ex-bourbon casks before being finished in first-fill Spanish oak butts. The result is a charismatic single malt with a rich toffee and pear aroma, with a hint of warm spices and leather. The palate offers notes of ripe apricots and raisins balanced by toasted oak and vanilla custard, before a long, warming finish filled with hints of cinnamon and nutmeg.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Glenallachie 15 Year Old
bodyHtml: A 15-year-old Glenallachie single malt, matured in a combination of Pedro Ximenez and oloroso sherry casks, creating a smooth, rich character. Aromas of raisins, butterscotch and sweet spices fill the nose, and the palate offers notes of dark chocolate, orange peel, banana, raisins and caramel.

title: Mortlach 15 Year Old Game of Thrones 'Six Kingdoms'
bodyHtml: Matured in first-fill Sherry-seasoned casks and finished in American oak ex-Bourbon casks. 46% alc./vol.

title: Cavaliere D'Oro Terre Siciliane Rosso 2017
bodyHtml:
Winemaker Notes

Ruby color. Aromas and flavors of black tea, forest fruit scone, chocolate chips, marjoram, and eucalyptus with a vibrant, fruity full body and a medium-long finish with notes of caramel-laden nuts. A chewy Sicilian red with nice complexity to complement the meal.

title: Villa Antinori Toscana Bianco 2024
bodyHtml: A straw yellow with greenish highlights in color, the wine shows elegant and subtle floral aromas with notes of citrus fruit. The taste is balanced with a fine persistence on the mineral-laced finish.

title: Chateau Bouscasse 2020
bodyHtml:
Chateau Bouscasse is located in the Madiran appellation in Southwest France and is owned by visionary winemaker Alain Brumont. Revered as a pioneer of modern Madiran wines, Brumont brought international acclaim to the Tannat grape through meticulous vineyard management and innovative aging techniques, transforming Chateau Bouscasse into a flagship estate of the region.

Wine Description
This 2019 vintage presents a deep, inky purple hue in the glass. The nose unfolds with intense aromas of blackberries, cassis, and dried violets, supported by undertones of spice, cedar, and a hint of graphite. On the palate, it is full-bodied and structured, offering layers of dark plum, licorice, and roasted coffee with refined tannins and vibrant acidity. The finish is long and mineral-driven, showcasing remarkable freshness and age-worthy balance.

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled lamb chops, beef bourguignon, or duck confit. Its bold tannins and dark fruit complement rich, savoury dishes, while its acidity cuts through fat beautifully. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Beaulieu Vineyard Rutherford Cabernet Sauvignon 2015
bodyHtml:
This Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon reflects the superb vintage with its deep, saturated blackberry, black cherry and ripe plum aromas and plush, saturated flavours. Hints of violet, toast and mocha add complexity.

91 Points - James Suckling

A soft and juicy red with a blackberry and black-olive character. Dark chocolate, too. Some green olives. Medium to full body, firm tannins and a flavorful finish. Drink or hold.

title: Whitley Neill Rhubarb & Ginger Gin
bodyHtml: Whitley Neill Rhubarb & Ginger Gin is currently made in England, where it is crafted with great care and attention to detail. This gin offers a delightful flavor profile that combines the tartness of rhubarb with the warmth and spiciness of ginger. The result is a balanced and refreshing gin with a unique twist. Critics have praised Whitley Neill Rhubarb & Ginger Gin for its smoothness, vibrant flavours, and versatility in cocktails. It has been commended for its ability to add a touch of sweetness and tanginess to mixed drinks, making it a popular choice for gin lovers seeking a distinct and invigorating experience.

title: Whitley Neill Raspberry Gin
bodyHtml: Whitley Neill Raspberry Gin is currently made in England, where it is carefully crafted to capture the essence of ripe raspberries. This gin boasts a vibrant and fruity flavour profile that showcases the natural sweetness and tanginess of raspberries. It is delicately balanced with hints of other botanicals, resulting in a refreshing and well-rounded gin. Critics have praised Whitley Neill Raspberry Gin for its smoothness, authenticity, and the burst of raspberry flavour it brings to cocktails. It has been commended for its versatility and ability to add a luscious and aromatic touch to mixed drinks, making it a popular choice among gin enthusiasts seeking a fruity twist.

title: Whitley Neill Blood Orange Gin
bodyHtml:
Whitley Neill Gin is a premium handcrafted artisanal gin range and an established English brand with a heritage dating back to 1762. Whitley Neill Gin is distilled at the multi-award-winning City of London Distillery, the first, and still the only, gin distillery in The City of London in 200 years.
 
A SWEET FRUIT BURST OF SICILIAN BLOOD ORANGES... A handcrafted gin of exceptional quality, that's bursting with a sweet citrus fruit flavour of Sicilian blood oranges. Bright, zesty aromas head up a clean, citrus gin and in every drop, a smooth, crisp taste of the Mediterranean sun.

title: The Irishman 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: This whisky is deep amber in colour with pale gold highlights. Aged in bourbon casks, there are intricate aromas of toasty oak, vanilla, toffee, sage and a hint of fresh cut grass. On the palate you'll find inviting flavours of baking spice, plum and malt leading to a full-bodied, lingering finish; a silky, smooth whisky.

title: Bacardi Coconut Rum
bodyHtml: Bacardi rum and coconut. What could taste more like summer sun and sandy beaches? The perfect blend of white rum and essence of real coconut will transport you to a tropical paradise, even when it’s raining outside.

title: Austin Hope Cabernet Sauvignon 2024 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: The Austin Hope Cabernet displays a beautiful ruby hue. Enticing aromas of fresh black cherry, burnt sugar and a slight smokiness fill your glass. On the palate, flavors evolve with vanilla foam, ripe dark fruit, roasted coffee & nuances of spice. This full-bodied wine is rounded out with smooth supple tannins that are brightened with a touch of acidity to balance this crowd pleasing Cabernet Sauvignon.

title: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Maturation in American and European oak casks gives this classic fragrant tree fruit and honey aromas with hints of oak and smoke. Richly textured, smooth and mellow on the palate, flavours of oak, vanilla, sweet malt, white fruit and butterscotch with a touch of sweetness and light smoke on the lingering, elegant finish.

title: Chateau La Nerthe Chateauneuf du Pape Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This exceptional white wine originates from France, specifically the Châteauneuf du Pape region in the Southern Rhône Valley. Château La Nerthe is one of the oldest estates in the appellation, with a winemaking history dating back to 1560 and a reputation for being among the first to bottle and export its own wines. Since 1985, the estate has been owned by the Richard family, who have focused on precise viticulture and restoring the property's glorious past. The winery's philosophy centres on a deep respect for nature, having been a pioneer of organic farming in the region and receiving Ecocert certification in 1998.

Wine Description

Châteauneuf du Pape Blanc presents a pale golden colour with delicate green reflections. The bouquet is complex and multi-layered, initially revealing aromas of ripe orchard fruits, lemon zest, and fresh almond, which are followed by floral notes of jasmine, honeysuckle, and acacia. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, offering an opulent and fleshy texture with flavours of spiced apples, blanched almonds, and honeyed citrus.

The varietal composition for this vintage is approximately 44% Roussanne, 41% Grenache Blanc, 11% Clairette, and 4% Bourboulenc. Stylistically, it demonstrates a masterful balance of lushness and freshness, featuring integrated oak nuances and a persistent, slightly minty finish.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling - 91 points."

title: The Old Malt Cask Fettercairn 15 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Established in 1824, Fettercairn Distillery is one of Scotland’s oldest licensed distilleries, situated at the foothills of the Grampian Mountains. Renowned for its innovative cooling ring distillation technique, Fettercairn produces whiskies celebrated for their tropical fruit character and refined balance.

Whisky Description:

This limited-edition single malt was distilled in May 2008 and matured for 15 years in a wine hogshead cask, bottled in October 2023 by Hunter Laing to commemorate the 25th anniversary of the Old Malt Cask series.

  • Nose: Aromas of milk chocolate, ripe raspberries, and vanilla.

  • Palate: Flavours of crisp apples, juicy peaches, and zesty lemon.

  • Finish: A long, lingering spice.

This expression showcases a harmonious balance between fruitiness and spice, offering a complex and elegant profile.

title: Du Grappin Beaujolais Villages 2023
bodyHtml: A micro-negociant with sustainable production at the heart of their vision, Le Grappin, headed up by Aussie husband and wife team, Andrew and Emma, makes wonderful wines from Burgundy, Beaujolais, and the Rhone Valley. Located in Beaune, Burgundy, they source from prime, responsibly farmed vineyards throughout the heart of France.

title: Balblair 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: The elegant and approachable Balblair 12-Year-Old is the first whisky in the Balblair Collection and has been matured in a combination of double-fired American oak casks and ex-bourbon casks. The result is a whisky with a warm, complex character and a sweet, citrusy aroma. The palate offers notes of oranges, honey and cinnamon before a long, creamy finish with hints of vanilla and leather.

title: Yves Cuilleron 'Les Vignes d'A Cote' Gamay Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
The vines are located in the municipality of Bessey. It is located on the heights of Chavanay in the Northern Rhone. Famous in its predilection’s region in Beaujolais, this grape variety expresses itself with a lot of freshness on our soils.

Fruity wine with an intense nose, dark and red fruits aromas.  Soft on the palate with dense fruit. Fresh finish with small crispy tannins.  Can age up to 3-4 years.  Pair with charcuterie, grills, braised ham.

title: Marca Negra San Martin Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Marca Negra Sanmartin is manufactured entirely from maguey Sanmartin, an agave Karwinskii related to Cuishe and Cirial that is farmed entirely on the estate. Basilio Pacheco makes this mezcal in La Noria Seccion 13, Ejutla, Oaxaca. It smells like river bed dirt and tastes like cocoa beans, figs, hay, and moss. It has a faint banana and wild mint aftertaste.

Mezcal Marca Negra was created for anyone who wants to learn more about the historical traditions of mezcal. The handprint on the bottle signifies the master distillers' painstaking efforts and the old wisdom that distinguishes each batch. Marca Negra is on a mission to find the purest and most diversified manifestations of this magnificent energy, no matter where they may be found. The product line is continually changing due to limited batch production. New mezcal variants emerge, while others fade out. Because the mezcal is bottled at the alcohol level favoured by the maestro mezcaleros, Mezcal Marca Negra has a 48 percent ABV or higher.

title: Stone Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: The Stone Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon is an immediately approachable and quaffable wine that offers great value. Aromas of cocoa and vanilla are enhanced by the rich flavours of currant and dark ripe fruits. Pleasing flavours of cassis and cola along with cinnamon and nutmeg fill out this smooth wine that is a great pick for any occasion.

title: Dewar's Double Double 21 Year Old - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Dewar's Double Double 21 Year is a blended scotch crafted by master blender Stephanie Macleod which is aged in a "four stage aging process." The first step involves single malts and single grains which have been aged separately at least 21 years. Next, the single malts are blended together and rested in exhausted casks. This process is also done for the single grains. Then, the blended single malts and blended single grains are blended together and again rested in exhausted casks. Finally, the blended scotch finishes its maturation in sherry casks. For the 21 year, it is finished in ex-oloroso sherry.

title: Tesseron Cognac Mini Collection - 4 x 50 ml Bottles
bodyHtml:
This gift set from Tesseron contains a miniature bottle of four XO Cognacs, one each of Lot 29, 53, 76 and 90. A superb way to try a range of aged brandies.

See More Cognac

title: Kaiyo Cask Strength Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Kaiyo Cask Strength is a high-proof, "teaspooned" malt whisky that highlights the brand's unique maritime maturation process. Distilled in Japan and overseen by Master Blender Jeffrey Karlovitch, the spirit is matured exclusively in rare, handmade Mizunara oak casks. A defining feature of Kaiyo is its "ocean maturation"—the casks spend three months on a sea voyage from Osaka, where the constant motion, changes in air pressure, and maritime environment accelerate the interaction between the wood and the whisky. While it is distilled and aged in Japan, the "teaspooned" blending method (adding a trace amount of malt from a second distillery) and the time spent at sea mean it is often labeled as "Japanese Oak Whisky" rather than "Japanese Whisky" under strict industry regulations.

Whisky Description

This whisky presents a light golden honey colour in the glass. The nose is highly aromatic and complex, offering signature Mizunara notes of sandalwood, incense, and cedar, layered with fresh stone fruits, orange blossom, and a hint of salted chocolate. On the palate, the body is oily and viscous, delivering a robust burst of salted caramel, dark chocolate, and plums. The higher proof amplifies a spicy, peppery kick of ginger and cloves, which is softened by undertones of vanilla and a unique marshmallow-like sweetness. The finish is long and warming, leaving a lingering trail of toasted oak, dried fruits, and a faint, briny whisper of the sea. It is bottled at a natural cask strength of 53% ABV and is non-chill filtered.

Food Pairing

The intense spice and savory-sweet profile of this cask-strength whisky make it a formidable partner for rich and bold flavors. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled meats like peppery ribeye steak or braised pork belly, where the Mizunara oak spice cuts through the fat. For a more traditional pairing, try it with black cod miso or smoked salmon to highlight its subtle maritime influence. For dessert, it is an excellent match for dark chocolate truffles, sea salt caramels, or a spiced apple tart, all of which complement the spirit’s notes of cocoa, fruit, and toasted wood.

title: Tesseron VSOP Composition Cognac
bodyHtml:
This is a very good sipping Cognac. Certainly one that will stand up to the most rigorous of connosieur taste tests. Being Fine Champagne means it's a blend of both Grande Champagne and Petite Champage, with at least 50% of the eaux-de-vie coming from the premier cru. It provides a round, complex, yet totally balanced drinking experience that you can enjoy neat, on the rocks, or mixed in a cocktail if you so choose.

See More Cognac

title: Kilbeggan Small Batch Rye
bodyHtml: An exciting limited edition release from the Kilbeggan distillery, the Kilbeggan Small Batch Rye! This is the first expression to be entirely distilled and matured at the distillery and is comprised of malt, barley and approximately 30% rye. A style of Irish whiskey that was very popular in the late-1800s.

title: Glen Garioch Virgin Oak No.2
bodyHtml:
General Information

Glen Garioch use virgin North American white oak casks for the entirety of the maturation for their Virgin Oak release. Using brand new barrels for whisky is becoming quite a trend, and the big, bold flavours that come from this release surely show why.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Wild Turkey Longbranch
bodyHtml: Wild Turkey's Longbranch starts with their eight-year-old bourbon and refines it with Texas mesquite and charcoal to give a deeper, more complex profile. Aromas include toffee, oak toast, and spice, then round out to caramel, citrus and smoke flavours.

title: Tesseron XO Lot No. 90 Ovation Cognac
bodyHtml:
Tesseron Lot 90 Ovation XO Cognac owes its freshness and purity to the vivacity of Tesseron's eaux-de-vies. It displays an especially attractive combination of vigor and complexity, which several ice cubes bring out perfectly – a first encounter with a great cognac. Made from the finest terroirs in Cognac – Grande Champagne, Petite Champagne and Fins Bois – Lot 90's unique character comes from long aging in oak barrels, which adds richness and complexity. This cognac is an attractive golden color. On the nose, very fresh pear and quince notes on attack, give way to herbaceous elements, dried fruits and nuts, fresh, with intriguing hints of almond. The palate is firm, focused and powerful, reflecting the aromatics presented by the nose – typical, young, quality cognac.

See More Cognac

title: Bien Nacido Estate Pinot Noir 2013
bodyHtml:
The classic spicy black teas, iron, and dark fruit aromas jump out of the glass with cardamom and pepper. The palate has bright acid, with moderate tannins that balance out the richness very nicely.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast    The spicy and earthy nose on this sprightly bottling from the iconic vineyard is superb: pressed mulberry, beet and rhubarb aromas lifted by thyme, star anise and bay leaf. The palate is slightly mellower, with rounded pomegranate and cherry notes cut by pine needle-like spice.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate     Leading off the reds, the 2013 Pinot Noir Bien Nacido Vineyard offers lots of mushroom, smoked meats, earthy, forest floor characteristics on the nose, but shows a lot more fruit and richness on the palate. Medium-bodied, deeply colored and nicely textured, this rock solid Pinot Noir was fermented with 20% whole clusters and spent 18 months in 33% new French oak. Drink bottles through 2023.

title: Mission Hill Meritage Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
Mission Hill Family Estate has been recognized as Canada’s only five-time winner of Winery of the Year and received multiple best varietal awards on the international stage.  Mission Hill continues to draw inspiration from the valley and the vineyards they tend to. For them, the journey is just beginning.

Mission Hill Family Estate was founded with a vision for the future of wine.  Continuing their pioneering history, they use sustainable, organic farming practices. By supporting these practices with modern technology, their varietals thrive in the valley’s diverse soil profiles. Then, they are carefully aged with new and Old World techniques, leaving you with wines that echo the terroir of the valley.

title: Clarendelle Bordeaux Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: Clarendelle Bordeaux Blanc is a clear and brilliant pale-yellow color. On the nose, there is a complex array of aromas dominated by floral notes of hawthorn, lime blossom and honeysuckle. Tropical fruit and citrus flavors come to the fore on the palate. Notes of lemon, pineapple and grapefruit emerge, mingled with nuances of fleshy fruit such as pear and lychee. Very delicious, round and opulent, with wonderful minerality. The incredibly long aftertaste showcases the complexity of this wine, with ripe fruit flavors balanced out by a lovely vivaciousness. All in all, this Clarendelle Bordeaux Blanc is a gourmet, refined wine with a great deal of tension and elegance.

title: Nonino il Merlot Grappa
bodyHtml: Clear and colourless. Slightly peppery, hay nose with some pear notes. Fairly dry, harmonious, medium-bodied, very faintly sweet, somewhat grassy, pear flavours with a lingering, crisp, slightly peppery finish.

title: Burwood Distillery Honey Liqueur Medica
bodyHtml:
One of this distillery's specialties - Burwood Medica is proofed to 28.0% ABV & sweetened with raw Alberta Honey from their family farm for a mild sweetness. This process brings about a light golden color and an incredible depth of aromas and flavor. This liqueur lends itself quite well to sipping on it’s own (think digestif, port, sherry, etc…), and mixing with other drinks (similar to sweet vermouth in a martini, boulevardier, or negroni).

Try Medica with sweet desserts, including locally produced honey cakes (known locally in Europe as Medovnik). Can be steeped with chamomile tea and other herbs to add further complexity as a soothing night-cap.

title: Poggio al Tesoro 'Il Seggio' Bolgheri Rosso 2023
bodyHtml:
The Seggio river is the largest watercourse in the municipality of Castagneto Carducci. This Bolgheri Rosso is produced with typical grape varieties, carefully harvested and vinified to ensure density and concentration but also to create a very fresh and easy-drinking style of wine. Blend: 50% Merlot, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Cabernet Franc, 10% Petit Verdot.

Intense ruby red in colour. The nose exhibits lovely fresh, crunchy fruit, enriched with mineral and spicy notes. The palate is medium bodied with hints of red berries. The elegant, silky tannins are wholly enveloping and velvety-soft. The finish is pristine, clean, and vivacious.

title: Penfolds Max's Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and complex white wine originates from Australia, specifically from the premier cool-climate Adelaide Hills subregion in South Australia. Penfolds Max's Chardonnay is a tribute to former Chief Winemaker Max Schubert (1948–1975), an iconic figure in the winery's history whose constant pursuit of excellence revolutionized Australian winemaking. The winery's philosophy for this label is to provide a contemporary expression of Chardonnay that balances elegant fruit with the textural, nutty complexity derived from careful oak management and lees contact.

Wine Description

Penfolds Max's Chardonnay presents a brilliant light straw appearance. The sensory profile is notably perfumed and aromatic, featuring a nose of yellow peach, nectarine, and citrus, layered with sophisticated notes of jasmine, white rose petals, and a hint of ginger spice. On the palate, the wine is rich and textural a result of regular yeast lees battonage during maturation showcasing flavours of white stone fruits and nougat underpinned by a tight mineral edge. It is characterized by a creamy mouthfeel, balanced by a flinty, "wet stone" acidity and a subtle crème brûlée influence from French oak. This 100% Chardonnay typically reaches an ABV of approximately 13%. While Penfolds follows high production standards, this wine is not certified organic.

title: Chateau de Berne Rose Romance 2025
bodyHtml: This wine is straight from the sun-drenched shores of the Mediterranean. Its soft and light pink colour looks like rosy cheeks after a first kiss. Beautiful floral and berry aromas awaken your senses. And freshly picked summer peaches and strawberry cream dance around your palate. It’s unique bottle features a glass stopper and reveals bubble style indentations as you drink the wine.

title: Bread & Butter Rose 2023
bodyHtml: Based in California, Bread & Butter makes approachable wines for everyday occasions year-round. This refreshing rosé has lovely notes of fresh strawberry and melon, with hints of hibiscus and rose petals. Juicy red fruit flavours are complemented by balanced acidity on the lively finish. Enjoy with pasta salad.

title: Bache American Oak Cognac
bodyHtml: A Cognac aged in Tennessee oak barrels, in addition to the more usual French casks. The American oak adds rich notes of coconut and pineapple to accompany the traditional French-cask flavours of vanilla, roasted nuts and chocolate.

title: Auchentoshan 1988 Pedro Ximenez (PX) Cask
bodyHtml:
The Auchentoshan 1988 PX Sherry Cask Finish, The facility’s famed triple distillation process comes to the fore here, demonstrating a nuanced complexity of rich yet approachable whisky flavour: dark chocolate, caramel, oranges, and raisins, not to mention some sherry sweetness. Aged for 29 years in Spanish oak casks and seasoned with Pedro Ximénez sherry, this iteration of the Auchentoshan 1988 PX is sure to warm up the late winter days.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Orin Swift Blank Stare Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: A glowing pale straw with a striking touch of chartreuse sits in the glass. Aromatically, the wine pops with lime zest, gooseberries, ripe passionfruit, fresh cut grass and lemon bars. On the entry, the acidity acts like a belt, constraining the voluptuousness, similar taste profiles to the nose plus crispy green apples and the faintest hint of fresh sage abound. The finish is reminiscent of ripe kiwi and limoncello, teetering on a beam of lingering acidity.

title: Chateau Timberlay Rouge 2023
bodyHtml: Superb ruby-red colour, with a complex nose of blackberry, blackcurrant, strawberry and attractive woody and spicy overtones. Soft and full-bodied, with good structure and acidity, as well as very elegant tannin. It is long on the palate, with hints of vanilla and cinnamon.

title: Hartfield & Co. Bourbon
bodyHtml:
The taste profile of this Bourbon is sweet and spicy, smokey and smooth. Deep flavours of stone fruits play on the front end with an incredibly long finish reminding most of an excellent Scotch Whiskey.

See More USA Whisky

title: Scarabus Islay
bodyHtml:
Scarabus an Islay Single Malt for those with a curious mind and an eye for detail. A whisky bold and honest about its origins and just a little mysterious about everything else. The brand creates a sense of mystery and discovery through the tagline "only those who seek shall find" and the intentionally ambiguous symbols incorporated on the label. Scarabus is a mystical area on the Isle of Islay, and the name dates to the 13th century and translates to "a rocky place" in Old Norse. Bottled at the perfect drinking strength of 46% ABV and proudly without colouring or chill-filtration from refill, ex-bourbon and virgin oak casks.

Nose: Classic notes of maritime peat smoke, sea spray and sea salt, with a subtle hint of vanilla and oak spice.

Palate: Oak char, old leather, stewed orchard fruit and vanilla sweetness returning among the smoky peat.

Finish: Lingering bonfire smoke, salted caramel and fresh berries.

title: Wakatsuru Saburomaru Junenmyo Rouge Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Wakatsuru Saburomaru Junenmyo Rouge is a distinctive blended Japanese whisky produced by the Wakatsuru Saburomaru Distillery in the Toyama Prefecture. The Saburomaru Distillery is famously the only distillery in the Hokuriku region and is renowned for its traditional use of a cast-iron pot still, named "Zemon," which is a rarity in modern distilling. The "Junenmyo" name is an homage to a local village near the distillery once famous for its vast canola fields used for lamp oil; the whisky is intended to "warm the heart like a gentle lamp light." The Rouge expression is a carefully crafted blend of peated malt from Saburomaru and aged grain whiskies.

Spirit Description

This whisky presents a pale gold colour with warm highlights. The nose is characterized by a refined balance of gentle coastal smoke and earthy peat, followed by sweet layers of honey, malted barley, and lightly toasted grains. On the palate, it delivers a bold and impactful first impression of ashy peat and smouldering embers, which quickly mellows into smooth flavours of caramel, vanilla, and candied orange peel. The mouthfeel is notably silky with a maritime saltiness and a subtle herbal bitterness. The finish is medium-long and balanced, leaving a lingering warmth of sweet malt and refined wood smoke. It is bottled at 46% ABV and is composed of a blend containing over 50% malt whisky.

title: Voga Prosecco (NV)
bodyHtml: Voga Prosecco Brut DOC is well-balanced and medium-bodied with a rich fruity bouquet. Aromas of under-ripe nectarine, toasted marshmallow with lemon curd and sea salt with a supple, crisp, effervescent, dryish light-to-medium body and tingling, breezy chalk, Italian orange peel, roasted almond and lime sorbet finish.  This wine is perfect alone as an aperitif or as a delightful complement to appetizers such as prosciutto or mild cheeses.

title: Shannon Ridge High Elevation Wrangler Red 2017
bodyHtml: Shannon Ridge High Elevation, Collection Wrangler Red, is a delicious red wine. This wine is bright and sassy. Its perky aromas and flavours of red and black fruit should pair beautifully with oven-baked roast pork.

title: Shannon Ridge High Elevation Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml:
Shannon Ridge is a family-owned vineyard and winery located on the steep mountain slopes of Lake County, California. They are dedicated to sustainable farming practices, thus producing the finest mountain fruit possible. The distinctive terroir of each of their hillside vineyards or high-elevation ranches gives their winemakers a full flavour palette from which they create these robust, food-friendly 'High Elevation Collection' wines.

Notes of lemongrass, mango, tangerine, and gooseberry, with a steely crispness, nice tropical fullness, depth, and a complex long finish.

title: Shinobu Japanese Blended Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Shinobu Japanese Blended Whisky is a premium spirit from the Niigata prefecture of Japan. The distillery was founded in 2017 by master brewer Ken Usami, who also established the Niigata Beer Co.. The name 'Shinobu' translates to 'forbearance' in Japanese, symbolizing the patience and persistence required to craft great spirits. While the distillery initially experimented with blending and finishing whiskies from around the world to match Japanese flavours, it aims to produce its own local single malt whiskies.

Spirit Description

This blended expression is typically composed of 50% malt and 50% grain whiskies that are first aged in ex sherry and ex bourbon casks before receiving a final finish in rare Japanese Mizunara oak.

  • Colour: The liquid presents a very pale gold, almost water like appearance due to the lack of added colouring.

  • Aroma: The nose is soft and inviting, featuring notes of butter, coconut candy, mint, and grass, layered with jellied pear, honeysuckle, and the elegant scent of Mizunara oak.

  • Palate: It delivers a smooth and slightly oily mouthfeel with initial flavours of black pepper and clove that give way to ripe citrus fruit, baked apples, vanilla, and a hint of Chinese incense.

  • Body: The whisky is characterized by a unique fusion of flavours that is both dynamic and easy to drink, offering a velvety texture and refined oriental refinement.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, smooth finish marked by sandalwood, vanilla, and lingering oak.

  • ABV: Shinobu Japanese Blended Whisky is bottled at 43%.

title: Chateau de Terrefort Quancard 2022
bodyHtml:
Château de Terrefort Quancard is part of the historic Cheval Quancard estate, a family-owned winery established in 1891. Located near Fronsac, the château blends traditional Bordeaux craftsmanship with modern winemaking techniques, producing wines that reflect the rich heritage and terroir of the region.

Wine Description
The 2022 vintage of Château de Terrefort Quancard Bordeaux Supérieur presents a deep garnet hue with ruby highlights. The bouquet offers delicate aromas of bracken, candied fruit, and subtle spices. On the palate, it is full-bodied and ripe, featuring mellow tannins and a generous, delightfully fruity finish. The wine is crafted predominantly from Merlot, complemented by Cabernet Sauvignon, showcasing a harmonious balance and refined structure.

Food Pairing
This wine pairs excellently with red meats, such as roast lamb or beef, and also complements soft cheeses. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character.

title: Canevel Prosecco 'Setage' Extra Dry
bodyHtml:
From the start, this Prosecco has been the crown gem of Canevel: an extraordinary wine for elegance and balance, with powerful aromas of apples, wisteria, and acacia blossoms.  It hails from the Valdobbiadene region, where steep hillsides, stony soils, and chilly Adriatic breezes create a temperate temperature and optimal growing conditions. This ideal climate also produces fresh, vivid grapes with high acidity, which are ideal for cultivating Glera.

"This is an extra dry (sweetish) Prosecco that has rivlets of acidity to match the 12-17 g/l RS it carries. This is from the classico, or heartland of the Prosecco region (DOCG). White flowers, white peaches, candy necklace on the finish. A lovely, different take on Prosecco, well suited for brunch." - Anthony Gismondi

title: Fattoria del Cerro Manero Rosso
bodyHtml: This Sangiovese blend is crafted under the supervision of world-renowned oenologist Riccardo Cotarella. The wine is made from Sangiovese and Merlot. It has an intense, ruby red color and good concentration. A fragrant aroma with notes of wild berry, spices and vanilla. Dense, round, decisive flavor with excellent persistence. Best served with roasted red meats, red meat stews and aged cheeses.

title: Lake Sonoma Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: Stewart Family Estates is one of the rare Canadian wine companies to have ventured abroad, in this case to Sonoma. The brand is still operationally based in the Okanagan, though, and this Sonoma County Cabernet Sauvignon shows some consistency with the Quails' Gate wine-making style. The fruit is ripe and dark, with ample oak spice and toast, while maintaining the inherent structure. The firm, medium-grained tannins lead to a decidedly dry finish. Decant and serve with a beef roast.

title: Kopke 10 Year Old White Port - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Like their more familiar aged tawny counterparts, aged white Ports take on color as they age. This 10-year-old is pale gold in the glass. While its fruitiness remains, it's beginning to show more woody, spicy character. Like all aged Ports, it's ready to drink now.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The NV 10 Year Old White Port is a Douro field blend of typical white grapes bottled in 2016 with a bar top cork and 118 grams per liter of residual sugar. Tight and tense, this is a focused white with a dry-ish finish, but nothing close to austere. It is the good acidity that keeps this in balance, preventing the sugar from making it too cloying. That ultimately gives this just a little distinction to go with its sweet edge. As I let it sit on the tongue, I began to like it more and more. It is very pretty for a 10, although of course it does not have the same concentration as older ones.

title: Decoy Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
With a reputation for delivering excellent quality at a great price, Decoy has established a loyal following for its distinctive style, emphasizing ready-upon-release wines capable of expressing their full charm and complexity in their youth. Building on this foundation, Decoy has evolved from being a single wine that supported the Duckhorn Vineyards brand to being a renowned winery in its own right.

The great Rosés of Provence inspired Decoy Rosé. Unlike many Rosés, made as a by-product of bleeding off juice from red wine fermentations, the grapes for this wine were harvested explicitly at lower Brix to make a dry Rosé. It was fermented entirely in stainless steel to preserve further the wine's beautiful aromatics, pure fruit flavours and crisp, refreshing mouthfeel.

Crisp and generous, the Syrah and Pinot Noir Rosé wine blend is full-bodied with dark cherry, ripe strawberry, baking spice and delicate herb flavours on the palate. A serious Rosé looking for food. Enjoy it with chicken, pork side ribs or salmon steaks.

title: Templeton 6 Year Old Rye
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
An unmistakable rye whiskey, Templeton Rye is smooth and spicy with a clean finish. There's a reason people call it "The Good Stuff." Rise and taste Iowa's most notorious whiskey.

See More USA Whisky

title: Masahiro Okinawa Gin
bodyHtml: Made by the Masahiro distillery, which has been making Awamori for over a century, the Masahiro Okinawa gin is the very first to come out of the island. Perfectly capturing the tropical climate of the Southern Japanese island, the botanical list features a variety of local ingredients. Shequasar, guava leaves, and Balinese long pepper. The recipe also includes goya, the anti-aging, cucumber-shaped bitter melon from Okinawa and a type of hibiscus called roselle. 47% ABV

title: Magic Box Wondrous Chardonnay 2018
bodyHtml: Magic Box wines come from a place 'where sipping is believing,' also known as Casella Family Brands. This wonder from down under boasts aromas of vanilla, toast, fresh fig, pear and citrus.  On the palate, there are flavours of ripe fruit, vanilla, and toast and a clean, refreshing finish. Enjoy with grilled seafood, chicken and creamy pasta dishes.

title: Fukumitsuya Kazeyo-Mizuyo-Hitoyo 'Wind Water Man' Junmai Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Fukumitsuya Kazeyo-Mizuyo-Hitoyo 'Wind Water Man' Junmai originates from Kanazawa in the Ishikawa Prefecture of Japan. Founded in 1625 during the Edo period, Fukumitsuya is the oldest brewery in Kanazawa and is currently operated by the 13th generation of the Fukumitsu family. The brewery is a 'Junmai-only' establishment, dedicated to traditional brewing using only rice, water, and microorganisms, and is famous for its 'Hyakunensui' (100-year-old water) drawn from wells fed by Mount Hakusan.

Description

This sake is specifically designed as an approachable, 'fresh and easy-to-sip' introduction to the Junmai style. It is almost colourless with a very pale lemon tint and a delicate nose that produces notes of tropical fruit, honeydew melon, light florals, and a touch of anise. On the palate, it is light-bodied and lithe, offering a smooth mouthfeel with flavours of spring water, fresh sweet herbs, and crisp umami. The finish is long and refreshing, showcasing light acidity and lingering floral elements. It has a lower-than-average alcohol content of 9% to 12% and a rice polishing rate of 65% to 70%.

Food Pairing

The clean profile and refreshing acidity of 'Wind Water Man' make it a highly versatile 'everyday food wine' that rinses the palate between bites. It pairs exceptionally well with lighter dishes such as seafood carpaccio, white fish sashimi, or a roasted squash salad. Its subtle sweetness and crispness also complement fried comfort foods like French fries, karaage, and tempura, as well as salty appetizers like prosciutto and melon. For the best experience, it should be served chilled at approximately 8°C or at room temperature.

title: Crowded House Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Crowded House's philosophy is simple - source outstanding fruit from exceptional vineyard sites. They believe the most critical decision in winemaking is deciding when to pick. Once harvested, their role is to simply steer the fruit in the right direction in order to best express the vibrant fruit flavours that Marlborough is renowned for while respecting the subtle differences of each site. These wines are about fruit purity, and their aim is for them to be equally enjoyable to drink by themselves amongst friends, as they are paired with a variety of foods.

Mineral stone, freshly squeezed lime juice, orange blossom and wild mint create intriguing aromatics, while the palate is soft on entry; vibrant and refreshing flavours of passionfruit and lemongrass carry through to a satisfying and lengthy finish.

title: Giusti Amarone della Valpolicella 2019
bodyHtml:
The 2019 Giusti Amarone della Valpolicella is a distinguished red wine from the Veneto region of Italy, crafted predominantly from Corvina Veronese, Corvinone, and Rondinella grapes. This Amarone exemplifies the traditional appassimento process, where grapes are air-dried to concentrate their flavors, resulting in a rich and opulent wine.

Colour: Intense ruby red with garnet reflections, indicating depth and maturity.

Aroma: A complex bouquet featuring notes of dried fruits, particularly plum, red cherry, and black cherry, complemented by evident hints of licorice and pepper.

Palate: Full-bodied and round, offering a warm sensation with soft, elegant tannins. The flavors mirror the aromatic profile, showcasing dried fruits and subtle spice.

Body: Full-bodied with a velvety texture, providing a harmonious balance between richness and elegance.

Finish: Long and persistent, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

This Amarone pairs excellently with game, braised meats, mature cheeses, and sweet and sour dishes. It's also delightful as a contemplative wine to enjoy by the fireplace. For optimal enjoyment, it's advisable to uncork the bottle at least one hour before serving at a temperature of 17-19°C.

title: Fratelli Alessandria Verduno Pelaverga 'Speziale' 2022
bodyHtml:
“There are only about 20 hectares of Pelaverga vineyards in existence, almost all of them concentrated in the Piedmontese village of Verduno. This lightweight, spicy red is an unusually delicious ‘must-try’ for Italian wine lovers.  Alessandria’s “Speziale” Verduno Pelaverga is a regional benchmark.” - David Lynch, Sommelier

Aromas of wild strawberries, raspberries, rosemary flowers, light pepper. Suave and juicy, with light tannins. The red Pelaverga grape is native to Verduno; there are less than a dozen local producers who craft pure Pelaverga wines. Often served with a light chill.

title: Glen Scotia Victoriana
bodyHtml:
Victoriana is made with whisky drawn from casks specially selected by their master blender, finished in heavily charred oak casks..

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Robert Biale Zinfandel Black Chicken 2023
bodyHtml:
The "Black Chicken" Legend

  • The Secret Business: In 1943, following the death of his father, 14-year-old Aldo Biale began making homemade Zinfandel to help his mother support their family farm in Napa Valley. Because they didn't have a commercial license to sell alcohol, Aldo had to sell his wine "under the table."

  • The Party Line: During that era, the Biale family used a "party line" phone system, meaning neighbors could pick up their receivers and listen in on conversations. To avoid being caught by nosy neighbors or government authorities, Aldo needed a password.

  • The Code: Since the farm was known for its white leghorn chickens, Aldo told customers to ask for a "Black Chicken" (Gallina Nera in Italian) when they wanted a jug of his inky-dark Zinfandel.

  • The Delivery: Customers would call and order "a dozen eggs and a black chicken." Aldo would then deliver the produce along with the clandestine jug of wine in his 1940 blue Studebaker.

Legacy and Honors

  • The Smithsonian: The story is so central to Napa Valley's history that Aldo’s original "punch-down stick" (used to stir the fermenting grapes) and an old grape-picker's box are part of the Smithsonian Institution’s permanent collection at the National Museum of American History.

  • Legal Production: The wine was first produced legally under the "Black Chicken" label in 1999 as a tribute to Aldo’s resilience and the family's heritage.

title: Wapisa Malbec 2024
bodyHtml: Bright red colour with intense violet tints. Aromas of red fruits, such as black cherries and mineral touches, stand out. The oak provides spicy and vanilla aromas. On the palate, it presents mature tannins and balanced acidity. A with excellent structure.

title: Convento da Gloria Touriga Nacional Reserva 2021
bodyHtml: This single variety from the Lisbon region of Portugal is made from Touriga Nacional, the most famous Portuguese grape today, which generates a red full of character and typicity, deep ruby ​​colour, aromas of plum and blueberry in compote, very balanced, an excellent quality-price ratio. It goes well with dishes based on red meats, assorted cheeses and the traditional Gomes de Sá cod.

title: Redbreast 15 Year Old
bodyHtml: Redbreast 15 is richer, earthier and more robust than its 12-year-old sibling, a sumptuous single pot still whiskey with a great degree of ageing. An essential part of any whiskey drinker's education.

title: Three Thieves Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml: The Thieves love a good Pinot Grigio, so they set out to craft a wine that would impress. The wine first undergoes 100% non-malolactic fermentation before being cold fermented at 50°F. These processes enhance and preserve the bright aromas, fresh fruit flavours and crisp, refreshing acidity that make Pinot Grigio so darned delicious. A pale, sunshine colour in the glass, with bright aromas of citrus with subtle floral notes, this Pinot Grigio offers vibrant juicy pear, green apple and citrus flavours that bring your palate to life.

title: Cruzan Aged Light Rum
bodyHtml:
A blend of rums aged one to four years in ex-bourbon barrels and filtered for a full-bodied taste. Light in color, this classic showcases the smooth flavor Cruzan is known for.

This rum has light notes of oak from aging. It's slightly sweet, with hints of Chardonnay.  The taste is smooth and dry with vanilla overtones and a pleasant finish. The island spirit shines through in each smooth sip. With no burn or bite, Cruzan Aged Light Rum can be enjoyed neat or as the perfect base for most traditional rum cocktails.

title: Summerhill Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml: Notes of strawberry, violet and green tobacco delight the nose and carry through the palate where flavours of red cherry and crushed gravel deepen and refresh. Lifted acidity, fine tannins and a long finish round out this beautifully balanced Pinot Noir.

title: Nugan Estate Pinot Grigio Annelise 2020
bodyHtml: This cool climate Pinot Grigio pours a delicate straw with accents of youthful green. The nose is layered with aromas of pear, apple and floral. The palate is crisp and dry, followed by a crisp and clean finish.

title: Domaine De La Noblaie Chinon Les Blancs Manteaux 2022
bodyHtml:
This expressive red wine hails from the Chinon appellation in the Touraine region of France's Loire Valley. Domaine de la Noblaie is a historic family estate located in the Vau Breton, a valley famously celebrated by Rabelais as the home of Cabernet Franc. The Manzagol family acquired the property in 1952, and over three generations, they have expanded the vineyard to 24 hectares while maintaining a steadfast philosophy of producing organic, site-specific wines that reflect the unique limestone terroirs of Chinon.

Wine Description

The Les Blancs Manteaux is a pure Cabernet Franc sourced from 65-year-old vines planted on a prominent limestone (tuffeau) hillside. In the glass, it displays a vibrant ruby color leading to an elegant nose of spiced cherries, red berries, and dried herbs. The palate is medium bodied and supple, characterized by a succulent core of sour cherries and redcurrants balanced by bright acidity and fine, silky tannins. This wine is crafted through a gentle, slow infusion process rather than harsh extraction, resulting in a complex and fresh profile with a refreshing, zesty finish.

title: Writers' Tears Red Head Irish Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Orange-tinged medium deep yellow colour. Somewhat peppery, slightly spicy, dusty, dried apple-lemon-plum nose. Dry, medium-bodied, peppery, spicy, vanilla-tinged, ripe, plum-lemon-apple flavours with a lingering, high acid, nutty, caramel-tinged finish. 

See More Irish Whisky

title: Michel Gassier Lou Coucardie Rouge 2017
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the Costières de Nîmes appellation in the southern Rhône Valley, France, this cuvée is produced by Domaine Gassier. Michel Gassier, a fourth-generation winemaker, manages the estate alongside his wife Tina with a philosophy rooted in organic and regenerative agriculture to preserve the unique terroir. The estate's vineyards are situated on terraces of ancient Rhône river pebbles (galets) overlooking the Camargue, where the family acts as caretakers for future generations.

Wine Description

The Lou Coucardie Rouge presents a dark, nearly black colour, signaling its significant concentration. The nose is powerful and complex, offering intense aromas of blackberry, plum, and black cherry layered with vanilla, spices, and distinct notes of eucalyptus and garrigue. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and velvety, delivering flavours of dark berries, licorice, and warm spice. Its structure is defined by firm yet silky tannins and a finish that remains aerial and fresh despite its richness.

Food Pairing

The wine's robust structure and aromatic depth make it an ideal companion for grilled game sausages, venison, or beef served with a wild mushroom sauce. It also pairs beautifully with Osso buco or hard, aged cheeses.

title: Piper Heidsieck French Riviera Edition
bodyHtml: Piper-Heidsieck launched a new style for enjoying champagne in 2006, created under the sunny skies of Cannes and St Tropez, Piper-Piscine, a champagne to be served on ice. Considered a trendsetter at the time, the House today pays tribute to this heritage with Piper-Heidsieck Riviera and celebrates an art de vivre inspired by the French Riviera. Initial fruity notes of pear and yellow peaches give way to heady scents of honeysuckle before yielding to mouth-watering sweet aromas of crisp caramel in the nose. Elegant and invigorating, with notes of vanilla and orange blossom on the palate.

title: Glendalough Wild Botanical Rose Irish Gin
bodyHtml: A DISTILLER'S TRIBUTE MADE WITH DEPTH & MEANING... This fresh, rose-petal gin was first made to honour their head distiller's Mom, Rose, at his little brother's wedding. Rose had recently passed away, and this was his way to have her there in spirit, literally. Carefully-tended flowers, from her rose garden, are slowly vapour distilled with wild roses and plants from the mountains around the distillery to make this an intensely floral gin. After distilling, the gin is then further infused with even more roses to deepen the flavours and give it its lovely pink hue. This is not "just another pink gin", far from it. The depth and complexity really need to be tasted to be understood. Floral, fragrant and flavourful, it is some of the best, most interesting gin we've made and comes after a lot of experimenting with plants, fruit, spices and flowers.

title: Yoshi No Gawa Goku Jo Ginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Yoshi No Gawa Goku Jo Ginjo is a representative of the signature "tanrei karakuchi" (crisp and dry) style of Niigata Prefecture. Produced by the oldest brewery in Niigata, founded in 1548, this "Gokujo" (meaning excellent or superb) bottling is crafted to showcase the local terroir and traditional techniques passed down through 20 generations.
