The 300 ml size is a popular choice for personal service or as an introduction to the brewery's premium range.

Description

This Ginjo sake is clear and elegant, utilizing 100% local Niigata rice, with the premium Gohyakumangoku variety used specifically for the koji to ensure purity and finesse.

  • Aroma: A delicate and fragrant nose featuring notes of fennel, fresh herbs, and licorice, accented by orange blossom and apple mint.

  • Palate: It is lean and tight on the palate with a silky, smooth mouthfeel. Expect flavors of Fuji apple and nectarine balanced by soft acidity and a subtle hint of anise.

  • Technical Profile: The rice is polished to 55%, and the sake is fermented with Niigata Ginjo yeast. It has a very dry Sake Meter Value (SMV) of +7 and an alcohol content of 15.5%.

Food Pairing

The crisp acidity and dry finish of this Ginjo make it an ideal partner for light and savory appetizers.

  • Seafood: Complements raw oysters, bacon-wrapped scallops, and steamed clams or mussels.

  • Savoury & Rich: Pairs exceptionally well with fig and prosciutto pizza, carrot-ginger soup, and creamy dips.

  • Cheese: Its subtle complexity and dry profile stand up to soft cheeses like Camembert or hard aged cheeses.

  • Serving Tip: To best preserve its delicate fruit and herbal aromatics, it should be served well-chilled (around 10°C).

title: Domaine Philippe Bouzereau Bourgogne Côte-d'Or Rouge 2023
bodyHtml:
This elegant dry red wine originates from France, produced within the regional Bourgogne Côte-d'Or appellation in Burgundy. Headquartered in Meursault, Domaine Philippe Bouzereau is a historic family estate spanning nine generations, managed today by Philippe Bouzereau Jr. While Meursault is world-renowned primarily for its Chardonnay, the estate also farms old-vine Pinot Noir plots situated on gentle, east-facing slopes rich in limestone and clay marl near the borders of Meursault, Auxey-Duresses, and Puligny-Montrachet. Benefiting from organic farming practices and low-intervention winemaking, this cuvée offers a classic, site-driven expression of Burgundian Pinot Noir featuring vibrant red fruit purity and refined earthy complexity.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2023 vintage exhibits a brilliant, translucent ruby color with bright garnet highlights. The nose opens with an inviting and aromatic bouquet of wild red cherry, tart raspberry, and red currant, interwoven with subtle floral notes of crushed rose petals, forest floor, subtle game, and delicate toasted oak spice. On the palate, the wine is light-to-medium-bodied, lithe, and elegant. A core of crunchy red berry fruit is framed by supple, fine-grained tannins and a bright, refreshing streak of natural acidity that carries through to a long, chalky mineral finish. Crafted from 100% Pinot Noir (from vines averaging 40+ years of age), the hand-harvested grapes undergo strict sorting and partial whole-cluster fermentation in open-top vats using indigenous yeasts. The wine is aged for roughly 12 to 14 months in French oak barrels (using a judicious 10% to 15% new wood) to build structural refinement while preserving pristine fruit freshness. The alcohol by volume sits at 13.0%.

Food Pairing

The lithe structure, fine tannic frame, and bright red fruit purity of this Côte-d'Or Pinot Noir make it an extraordinarily versatile partner at the dining table. Excellent culinary matches include herb-roasted chicken, pan-seared duck breast with cherry reduction, roasted pork tenderloin, and braised rabbit. It also pairs wonderfully with seared salmon or tuna, wild mushroom risotto, and mild French cheeses such as Comté, Gruyère, Delice de Bourgogne, or Brie de Meaux.

Vintage Quality

The 2023 growing season across the Côte de Beaune yielded Pinot Noirs defined by generous fruit expression, smooth structural integration, and excellent natural freshness. Warm summer days enabled complete phenolic maturity, while cool night breezes preserved essential acidity and aromatic lift. The 2023 Philippe Bouzereau Bourgogne Côte-d'Or Rouge offers delightful immediate charm and elegance upon release after brief decanting, while holding the structural balance to evolve gracefully over the next 4 to 8 years.

title: Canadian Club 20 Year Old
bodyHtml: Twenty years in barrel has yielded one of the finest expressions of Canadian Club whisky. Deep gold in colour, with pronounced aromas of caramel, vanilla baking spice and rye grain. A sip reveals full body with a smooth mouthfeel and satisfying fruitcake and vanilla flavours. Serve with grilled steaks or solo over ice.

title: Patron Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Patron Reposado Tequila is a super premium spirit from Mexico, specifically handcrafted in the rolling hills of the Los Altos highlands in Jalisco. The brand was founded in 1989 by entrepreneurs John Paul DeJoria and Martin Crowley with the goal of creating the world's first ultra premium tequila. Originally produced at the Casa 7 Leguas distillery, production moved in 2002 to the Hacienda Patron, and in 2018, the Patron Spirits Company was acquired by Bacardi Limited for 5.1 billion dollars.

Spirit Description

This reposado is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave that is slow roasted in traditional small brick ovens for 79 hours before being crushed using both roller mill and ancient tahona stone methods. It is aged for at least two to four months in a variety of barrel types, including new French, American, and Hungarian oak, as well as used American whisky barrels.

  • Colour: The spirit presents a marvellous shade of light amber or a bright golden hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is complex and inviting, featuring oak wood and fresh agave mingled with citrus, honey, and vanilla.

  • Palate: It offers a smooth, balanced taste of fresh agave and oak, complemented by notes of caramel, fruit, and light spice.

  • Body: This tequila is characterized by an exceptionally high quality and velvety mouthfeel with opulent depth.

  • Finish: It concludes with a warm glow and a long finish that reveals light floral notes, vanilla, and a hint of pepper.

  • ABV: Patron Reposado is bottled at 40%.

title: Casamigos Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Longtime friends George Clooney, Rande Gerber and Mike Meldman love Casamigos. On the rocks, by the shot, at times, straight from the bottle. Tequila filled nights with friends is how Casamigos was born. Their idea was to make the best tasting, smoothest Tequila and Mezcal that didn’t have to be covered up with salt or lime. So they did. They are delighted that consumers and Tequila and Mezcal connoisseurs alike enjoy and appreciate the authenticity of Casamigos. This is quality you can taste, so raise a glass with their award winning spirit. The name Casamigos comes from the Spanish casa (house) and amigos (friends), thus "house of friends."

COLOUR: Crystal clear.

AROMA: Fragrant herbal and fruit, with hints of smoke.

FLAVOUR: Notes of smoke and black pepper lead to long silky finish.

RESTS: Up to 2 months.

HERITAGE: Produced in Oaxaca by a 4th generation family of Mezcaleros.

title: Fonseca Tawny Port
bodyHtml: Tawny-red colour fading to brick on the rim. The seductive nose displays aromas of apricot and plum with mellow undertones of butterscotch and spice. On the palate, the rich jammy flavours are lifted on the finish by an attractive crisp acidity.

title: Domaine Gautheron Chablis Vieilles Vignes 2024
bodyHtml:
Chablis 1er Montmains is a 1er Cru from the left bank.  The name of this climate evokes "the middle mountain", that which is at an intermediate altitude between two higher coasts.  The orientation is south-east, the slopes can reach 20%. 

The soils are fairly shallow and the Kimmeridgian limestone does not take long to appear. The soils are stony and well draining. 

In this open and airy valley, our 80-year-old Old Vines give all their expressions.

title: Gabbas Lillove Cannonau di Sardegna 2020
bodyHtml: This fresh, juicy red shows notes of red berry fruit and soft earthy tones on the nose. Soft tannins and a long finish with spicy and floral nuances. Very representative of the grape and terroir. Pair with red meat dishes, roast pork, and charcuterie.

title: Evel Douro Red 2021
bodyHtml: An aromatic wine with smooth tannins. The Evel Red is considered a typical Douro reference, with aromas of red fruit and green notes, typical for the region. It reveals itself as very balanced, flavourful and round with a good structure and a fruity, persistent finish.

title: Ikekame Shuzo Ginyuka Daiginjo Yuzushu - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Ikekame's Ginyuka is a luxurious blend of 20% natural yuzu juice from Kyushu, Japan combined with daiginjo sake.  With low alcohol and no additives, this refreshing yuzu beverage is versatile as an aperitif, as a cocktail ingredient, or with a meal.

Origin:  Fukuoka Prefecture  |  Alcohol:  7%

title: Sileni Estates Cellar Selection Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: Aromas and flavours of ripe passionfruit and tropical fruit, with gooseberry undertones. The palate is balanced, has a beautiful freshness and lengthy finish. Delicious with oysters, soft goats cheese or a tomato and basil salad.

title: MacNair's Lum Reek Blended 12 Year Old Small Batch
bodyHtml: MacNair's Lum Reek, a 12 year old blended malt Scotch whisky, drawn from bourbon, red wine and Pedro Ximénez sherry casks. Created by GlenAllachie master distiller, Billy Walker. Peated Islay and Speyside malts, blended with GlenAllachie whisky, then left to mature for a further period in specially selected casks at the GlenAllachie distillery. Finally vatted, then bottled up at 46% vol. The packaging has been inspired by founder of MacNair's, Harvey MacNair.

title: Meinklang Prosa Frizzante 2024
bodyHtml:
Nestled in the heart of Austria’s Burgenland region, Meinklang is a family-run estate located near the Hungarian border. Operated by the Michlits family, the winery is a model of biodynamic farming and self-sufficient agriculture. Their philosophy embraces holistic vineyard stewardship, integrating livestock, ancient grains, orchards, and vines, creating a thriving ecosystem that expresses itself through their natural wines.

This vintage of Meinklang Prosa is a gently sparkling rosé (frizzante), crafted primarily from Pinot Noir with occasional inclusion of Zweigelt and Blaufränkisch, depending on vintage conditions. Pale salmon-pink in colour with a soft orange hue, it opens with vibrant aromas of wild strawberries, raspberries, and red currants, underpinned by a faint floral note and hints of garden herbs. On the palate, it’s refreshingly crisp with fine bubbles and lively acidity, offering flavours of juicy berry fruit, rose petal, and a subtle minerality.

This frizzante style strikes a beautiful balance between elegance and energy, showcasing Meinklang’s dedication to low-intervention winemaking and biodynamic purity.

Food Pairing
Pairs wonderfully with fresh salads, grilled shrimp, charcuterie, or creamy goat cheese. The delicate sparkle and bright acidity also make it a delightful aperitif.

title: Lopez de Haro Gran Reserva 2016
bodyHtml:
The López de Haro Gran Reserva is a red wine from Spain, produced in the Rioja DOCa (Denominación de Origen Calificada) region. The wine is made by Hacienda López de Haro, which is located in the area of San Vicente de la Sonsierra in Rioja Alta. San Vicente de la Sonsierra is situated in a privileged location, sheltered from the cold Cantabrian Sea winds by the Toloño mountain range, with the Ebro river to the south providing necessary moisture, creating an ideal microclimate. The winery's philosophy aims to craft "contemporary classics": delightful wines that draw inspiration from the past while capturing the vibrant spirit of La Rioja. The Gran Reserva expression represents the winery's unwavering dedication to the winemaking traditions of the region.

Wine Description

This grand wine has a bright cherry-red colour with garnet tones on the rim, showcasing great vivacity and brightness. It possesses a high aromatic intensity. Complex on the nose, it features notes of black fruits, along with coffee, vanilla, roast, and balsamic nuances integrated into an intense bottom note of ripe fruit. Aromas of black fruits predominate, accompanied by balsamic and mineral notes that give it great depth. An interesting touch of liquorice and a sweet, primary background with notes of ripe fruit compote also stand out. It is described as a true mosaic of spices, making it enormously complex.

The wine is made from Tempranillo and Graciano grapes. The Gran Reserva is aged for 30 months in French and American oak barrels. The wine is full-bodied. The palate is fresh, elegant, and round, with a velvety attack followed by a pleasant acidity and a silky and full-bodied aftertaste. It is well balanced, with a very enveloping nature. The fine, noble, and ripe tannins are the result of its slow evolution throughout the extensive aging period. The persistent finish is harmonious and elegant.

title: The Hilt Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml:
Wines are defined by place, style and time and in the southwest corner of Sta. Rita Hills AVA lies a rugged, windswept, coastal vineyard called The Hilt Estate, an estate grower-producer of stunning Pinot Noir and Chardonnay reflective of this dynamic corner of California.

Golden peach and lemon oil. Touch of flinty complexity. Freshly baked brioche with apricot. Chamomile notes and candied ginger. Stone fruit and acacia honey on the suave and generous palate. Luminous acidity forms the perfect balance to the notes of sweet cream that emerge on the long and luscious finish. Elegant, refined and full of the tantalizing energy that makes Chardonnay from this area so singular and remarkable.

title: Venge Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 'Silencieux' 2023
bodyHtml:
The Venge Vineyards 'Silencieux' Cabernet Sauvignon is a distinguished red wine from Napa Valley, California. Crafted predominantly from Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, this wine exemplifies Venge Vineyards' dedication to producing wines of exceptional quality and character.

Colour: Deep, opaque ruby red, indicating its concentration and youthfulness.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring notes of sweet cassis, anise, blackberries, roasted coffee, blue herbs, and barrel vanillin.

Palate: Full-bodied and extracted with ripe black fruit, blueberries, charred caramel, and a delightful hint of fresh herbs that concentrate into a lengthy finish.

Body: Full-bodied with a rich and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and persistent, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

This wine exemplifies Venge Vineyards' dedication to producing wines that are both expressive and true to their terroir, offering a delightful experience for Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon enthusiasts.

title: Guy Charlemagne 'Les Coulmets' Blanc de Blancs Champagne 2014
bodyHtml: Full of poise and finesse with some pressing white flower fruit and a tropical subtext, with sure-footed acidity very much in concert with ripe fruit. Very impressive.

title: Liquidity Dividend 2022
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from Canada, specifically from the Okanagan Falls subregion of the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. Founded in 2008 by a group led by Ian Macdonald, Liquidity Wines is situated on the historic Allendale vineyard, which has been growing grapes since the 1970s. The winery's philosophy is centred on a fusion of passion and precision, often integrating contemporary art and design into the winemaking experience.

Wine Description

Liquidity Dividend displays a dark, deep, and rich red colour. The nose is expressive and complex, offering aromas of juicy red strawberry, liquorice, and freshly chopped fennel, alongside notes of bramble fruit and cedar. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and rich, delivering flavours of black cherry, raspberry leaf tea, and blackcurrant balanced by a juicy acidity and soft, elegant tannins. It is characterized by its Bordeaux-style power and finesse, leading to a lengthy and complex finish with smoky nuances.

title: Pagodes de Cos 2016
bodyHtml:
The joy and spontaneity of moments shared with loved ones. An impromptu lunch with friends is the perfect occasion to open a bottle of Pagodes de Cos. It is reminiscent of the simple pleasures of life, like homemade blackcurrant syrup, a bowl of just-picked red cherries or a freshly opened jar of citrus jam. Pagodes de Cos is at once indulgent, comforting and vivacious, like a carefree conversation with family or friends in a familiar place.

94 Points - James Suckling

A red with very deep and intense fruit character, yet rich tannins to back it all up. Full-bodied, layered and powerful. The second wine of Cos d’Estournel is serious again in 2016. Try from 2025.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Dense and full of dark fruits, this second wine from Cos d’Estournel comes from specific parcels. With blackberry fruits and rich, generous tannins, the wine has weight and concentration. The freshness at the end is so typical of the vintage. Drink from 2023.

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The second wine of the estate is no slouch. The 2016 Pagodes de Cos has some grand vin character in its cassis and graphite aromas and flavours. Showing more incense, graphite, and hints of flowers with air time, this medium to full-bodied, rounded, beautifully textured effort is well worth a case purchase. Drink this beauty, the equal to most estates’ top wines, while you wait on the grand vin to come around.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2016 Les Pagodes de Cos is blended of 50% Cabernet Sauvignon, 46.5% Merlot, 3% Petit Verdot and 0.5% Cabernet Franc. It has a deep garnet-purple colour and opens with notions of warm cassis, black cherries and smoked meats giving way to scents of charcoal, underbrush and cloves plus a waft of new leather. Medium to full-bodied, it fills the palate with generous black fruits and some compelling red fruit sparks, supported by ripe, grainy tannins and finishing long and spicy.

title: Terlan Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml: By far the driving force of South Tyrol, Cantina Terlano specializes in crafting white wines of high caliber, which make up 70% of the estate’s production. Featuring saline notes and exemplary freshness, this Pinot Gris releases lovely notes of citrus, white fruits and camomile. A breaded veal cutlet drizzled with lemon or nachos with fruity salsa will create a perfect match with this Italian white.

title: Gerard Bertrand Saint Chinian Syrah Mouvedre 2022
bodyHtml: Full, fat body on the palate lends it a remarkable elegance. Notes of roasted coffee, blackcurrant and prunes. The finish is long and mineral fresh.

title: JJ McWilliam Shiraz Cabernet 2020
bodyHtml:
The McWilliam family has 140 years of winemaking experience in Australia's New South Wales. Expect generous aromas and flavours of black currant, cherry and plum, finishing with spicy vanilla and eucalyptus notes and a smooth, balanced texture.

Perfect with barbecued meats, aged cheeses and savoury appetizers!

title: Codigo 1530 Blanco Rosa Tequila
bodyHtml:
Codigo 1530 Rosa begins with the purity of their Blanco, then is rested for 1 month in un-charred Napa Cabernet French White Oak barrels. The result is a refined spirit with a natural colour as beautiful as its taste. Codigo 1530 Rosa has rested just long enough in fine Cabernet barrels to enrich the natural agave juice, without overpowering its delicate floral notes.

Leads with bright agave character and finishes with the soft red wine notes of Cabernet.

title: Codigo 1530 Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Código 1530 Blanco Tequila is a high-end, unaged artisanal spirit originating from Amatitán in the Valles (Lowlands) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Produced at the VNS distillery (NOM 1605), the brand was created by Ron Snyder, Federico "Fede" Vaughan, and country music icon George Strait. For generations, the liquid was produced solely as an unlabeled private batch ("El Tequila Privado") for a select group of Mexican families and friends in Los Bajos before commercially launching as Código 1530—named in honor of the year Amatitán was officially recognized as a city with a royal coat of arms.

Spirit Description

Código 1530 Blanco is crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves harvested after maturing for at least seven years in the mineral-rich volcanic soil of the Jalisco Lowlands. The agaves are cooked in low-pressure stainless steel autoclaves and extracted using a roller mill. Fermentation takes place in open-air stainless steel tanks utilizing an organic family baker's yeast from Amatitán. Double-distilled in custom handmade copper-lined pot stills and blended with fresh well water, the spirit is bottled unrested without ever touching wood to preserve its raw agave core.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and luminescent with dense silver flashes in the glass.

  • Aroma: Clean, floral, and deeply herbaceous. The nose opens with fresh raw agave, crisp mint, lemongrass, and bright citrus peel (lemon and lime), backed by earthy minerality and a soft hint of blossom sweetness.

  • Palate: Crisp, balanced, and expressive on the entry. Upfront flavors of sweet roasted agave, citrus zest, and spearmint give way to a structured mid-palate driven by wet stone minerality, crushed herbs, and fresh green pepper.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a light, silky, and clean viscosity that glides smoothly across the tongue.

  • Finish: Crisp, dry, and invigorating, tapering off with lingering notes of cracked black pepper, bright citrus peel, and gentle agave sweetness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Alois Lageder Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Very rich, complex, still quite closed aroma. Burgundian style with a delicate creaminess, some toasty oak and ripe tropical fruit. Touches of vanilla and roasted almonds. Quite rich, well structured though elegant flavour, harmonious, with a pungent, fresh acidity to match the depth of the fruit and the oaky backbone.

Spring flower, white stone fruit and bread crust aromas glide over to the elegant medium-bodied palate along with a hint of honeydew melon and white peach. A citrus note lingers on the tangy finish.

title: Rehilete Papalote Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
ABV: 40%
Appearance: Light caramel
Aroma: Sweet, earthy, dried fruit, and nuts
Palate: Well rounded, honeyed agave, dark cherry and oak
Finish: Smooth finish, ends with oak and stewed agave

Rehilete Papalote is Aha Yeto’s diffusion line-up of tequilas. They are designed to be versatile both in cocktails and as straight sippers. Rehilete Papalote is harvested and distilled at the same estate as Aha Yeto.

The branding behind Rehilete Papalote is a tribute to Mexican culture that is renowned for its rich cultural events and colorful traditions; red sandstone flooring, stained blue agave while a multicolored pinwheel joins to the wind to let the gusts take away bad luck.

title: Avua Amburana Cachaca
bodyHtml:
General Information

Avuá Amburana Cachaça is aged in Amburana wood, found only in the forests of Latin America.  Resting in this indigenous wood produces a stunning mix of WARM and SAVORY notes on the nose and palate that provides a truly unique taste experience for cocktail experimentation or sipping neat. Discover and enjoy our unique hand crafted Avuá Amburana Cachaça cocktails...

PAN AM - 2oz Avuá Cachaça Amburana, 1oz Curaçao, 1oz Dry vermouth, Orange bitters, stirred with an Orange twist

Amburana Twist - 2oz Avuá Cachaça Amburana, 1oz Cocchi Americano, Orange bitters, stirred with an Orange twist and rim

A note on batching
As with fine wine, our product is produced in an annual growing season and will exhibit differences from batch to batch due to differences in water retention, cane composition and harvest factors.  Each of our batches is clearly numbered on batch and bottle numbers – and once they are gone they are gone forever.  We stand behind every bottle that we put into the market as being of the highest quality cachaça to be found throughout the world.

title: Chateau Patache d'Aux Cru Bourgeois Medoc 2018
bodyHtml: The Chateau Patache d 'Aux Cru Bourgeois Médoc Contrôlé from the Bordeaux wine-growing region, aged in barrels, offers itself in a glass in bright crimson. Slightly slanted, the red wine glass reveals a charming garnet red tone on the edges. After the first swirl, you can perceive a first-class balance with this red wine, because it is neither watery nor syrup-like or liqueur-like on the glass walls. The bouquet of this Bordeaux red wine captivates with nuances of mulberry, blackberry, blueberry and blackcurrant. If we continue to feel the aroma, bitter chocolate, oriental spices and cinnamon are added.

title: Black Sage Vineyard Cabernet Franc 2023
bodyHtml: The Black Sage Vineyard Cabernet Franc is produced from tenacious vines that for over 20 years have thrived in the rugged South Okanagan desert. Aged in French and American oak for more than 14 months, it offers ripe berry and strawberry flavours mingled with earthy notes and hints of vanilla and spice. The nose has pleasant notes of red berries, some red currants, dried strawberries, and smoky mocha notes. The flavours on the nose carry over to the palate with bright red fruits, mocha and vanilla, and some hints of spice on the finish. The acidity is lively and the tannins are firm yet approachable.

title: Kavalan Distillery Select No. 1 Single Malt
bodyHtml:
This elegant, quintessential single malt celebrates the craftsmanship of Kavalan's master blender released after his hat trick of top prizes: the Icons of Whisky's 2018 "Distillery of the Year" and its 2017 "World Whisky Brand Ambassador," as well as the World Whiskies Awards' 2015 "Distillery Manager and Master Distiller of the Year." In this unique drop, Master Blender Ian Chang has set out to create the purest and creamiest whiskies to satisfy both the beginner drinker and the whisky connoisseur.

See More International Whisky

title: Red Puro Organic Malbec 2025
bodyHtml:
This expressive Malbec hails from Argentina, specifically the renowned Agrelo district within the Mendoza region. Produced by Dieter Meier and family, the winery is rooted in a philosophy of bold, natural, and sustainable viticulture, utilizing 100% bio-certified grapes to create wine in its 'purest form'.

Wine Description

Red Puro Organic Malbec presents a dense, purplish hue with vibrant ruby shades. The nose is remarkably open and bright, offering a complex bouquet of red fruit, prune, and morello cherry, layered with delicate floral notes of violet and a touch of oriental spice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and silky, delivering a rich core of blackberry and plum fruit balanced by integrated French oak notes of vanilla and dark chocolate. It maintains a fresh, balanced structure with polished tannins and a long, mineral-inflected finish that reflects its sandy, high-altitude terroir.

title: Togouchi 9 Year Old Japanese Blended Japanese Whiskey - 700 ml
bodyHtml:
Togouchi 9 Year Old is a distinctive blended expression from the Sakurao Brewery and Distillery in Hiroshima. Like other spirits in the Togouchi range, this whisky is famous for its unique maturation in a former railway tunnel carved into the mountains of Akiota. The tunnel provides a constant, cool temperature and high humidity, which slows the aging process and allows the spirit to develop a mellow, refined character over its nine-year sleep. This blend consists of both malt and grain whiskies, creating a balanced and accessible profile that highlights the distillery's blending expertise.

Whisky Description

This whisky shows a bright, pale amber color. The nose is fresh and citrus-forward, offering scents of yellow plum, orange peel, and a distinct herbal note reminiscent of grassy meadows. On the palate, the influence of the grain whisky provides a smooth, light-bodied entry, followed by flavors of sweet honey, vanilla, and a subtle dry nuttiness. A delicate hint of peat smoke lingers in the background, adding a layer of complexity without being overpowering. The finish is clean and persistent, ending with a touch of spice and a crisp, mineral quality. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Codigo 1530 Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: This Reposado is aged for six months in fine French white oak barrels, previously used to mature Napa cabernet. Anticipate aromas and flavours of vanilla, toasted caramel, sweet agave, oak and cocoa powder. Full-bodied and fruity, with a warm, balanced finish, this great for pan-fried cod with chipotle-lime coleslaw.

title: Black Market Secret Society White
bodyHtml: Only the Secret Society knows the blend inside the bottle. The grapes all come from vineyards in Okanagan Falls and Osoyoos. A mysterious blend of 3 aromatic varietals. Tropical fruit dominates with lychee, a touch of orange blossom and mineral undertones. A hint of sweetness balanced by crisp acidity.

title: Pasqua 11 Minutes Rose 2025
bodyHtml: The name 11 MINUTES refers to the duration of the skin contact, the pressing of grapes. In this optimal length of time they extract the most noble qualities of the grapes and obtain the slightly rosy shade that characterize this wine. Once the precious must is created, it is cooled and transferred to a steel tank where it remains for about 11 hours, the necessary time for the more solid parts to decant.

title: Jam Cellars Butter Chardonnay (NV)
bodyHtml:
JaM Cellars Butter Chardonnay is produced in the United States, originating from select vineyards across California. The winery was founded by second-generation Napa Valley vintners John and Michele Truchard, whose initials form the 'J' and 'M' in JaM. Growing from a small project to a national success, the winery is rooted in a philosophy of creating 'super-approachable' wines that are easy to appreciate and enjoy for any occasion.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a rich, pale yellow colour and a bold sensory profile. The nose is medium-high in intensity, offering a creamy bouquet of vanilla, baked apple, and toasted oak, accented by hints of butterscotch and lemon curd. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and lush, delivering ripe flavours of peach, pineapple, and stone fruit. Its signature 'melt in your mouth' texture is achieved through cold fermentation and aging in a unique blend of oak, leading to a long, creamy finish with lingering notes of toffee and vanilla.

Food Pairing

  • Seafood: Pairs perfectly with indulgent dishes like lobster bisque or skate served with brown butter and capers.

  • Poultry: Complements roasted chicken or a classic lemony chicken Milanese.

  • Pasta: A natural match for creamy chicken fettuccine or other rich pasta recipes.

  • Snacks: Enhances casual pairings such as soft cheeses and buttery popcorn.

title: Poplar Grove Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml: Light gold in colour with immediate aromas of tropical fruit and yellow apple followed by subtle floral notes. Elegant flavours of pineapple and melon are knitted with bursts of citrus. Light French oak barrel aging adds hints of butterscotch and toastiness to the palate. Well balanced acidity gives this Chardonnay a long, silky finish.

title: Fielding Estate Winery Cabernet Franc 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: This wine has expressive notes of ripe raspberry and cherry on the nose along with notes of thyme, rosemary and graphite. The ripe fruit notes follow through to the palate filled with more spice, earth and dried herbs, while remaining fresh, rich and well-balanced. It is medium to full in body with mouthwatering acidity and outstanding structure.

title: St. George Spirits Bruto Americano
bodyHtml:
General Description

Ready for a bigger, better, bitterer bar? Say hello to Bruto Americano! With a bracing dose of bitterness, a bright pop of citrus, and intriguing sylvan notes inspired by distiller Lance Winters’ formative experiences growing up in California in the 1970s, Bruto is a bitter aperitivo liqueur that makes us as proud as it does thirsty. 

Bruto is made from a variety of herbs, roots, and other botanicals. Though the exact number of ingredients and formulation are proprietary, we will say that the bitterness comes primarily from gentian root; the citrus notes mostly from California-grown Seville orange; and the woodsy notes from balsam fir and Cascara sagrada (bark from the California buckthorn).

title: La Posta Tinto Red Blend 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Argentina in the South American region, specifically within the high-altitude Uco Valley appellation in Mendoza, La Posta 'Tinto' Red Blend represents an energetic, fruit-forward, and accessible expression of classic Argentine red varieties. Created by pioneer Dr. Laura Catena alongside winemaker Estela Perinetti, La Posta celebrates small-scale artisanal grape growers across Mendoza, with each bottling named in honour of local vineyard families and their traditions. Sourced from high-elevation vineyards situated along the alluvial foothills of the Andes Mountains on well-drained gravelly clay and limestone soils, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes sustainable viticulture, hand harvesting, temperature-controlled stainless steel fermentation, and gentle barrel aging in French oak (approximately 10% to 15% new) for eight months. The result is a vibrant red blend that highlights pure dark fruit character, supple texture, and effortless everyday drinkability.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear dark ruby purple colour with bright violet reflections along the rim. An expressive, fruit-driven bouquet opens with generous aromas of wild blackberry, dark plum, red cherry, and crushed blueberry, interwoven with subtle notes of cocoa powder, violet petals, sweet baking spices, and light toasted oak. On the palate, it is medium bodied, smooth, and lush, delivering ripe flavours of dark berries, red fruit jam, and subtle mineral earth, all balanced by a bright, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by soft, fine-grained tannins and a rounded mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, persistent finish marked by lingering berry fruit, gentle spice, and a hint of dark chocolate. Composed primarily of Malbec blended with Bonarda and Syrah, it showcases Mendoza's high-altitude sunshine and fruit purity with approachable charm, balance, and versatility.

title: Tapatio Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: The 100% estate-grown blue agave for this Anejo is roasted for 4 days and fermented with a proprietary yeast culture that dates back 75 years. It's double-distilled in copper pot stills, aged 18 months in ex-bourbon barrels and undiluted to retain natural flavors.

title: Tapatio Blanco 110 Tequila
bodyHtml: A special release of Tapatio's unaged blanco Tequila, bottled at a higher strength of 55% (110 proof). A more concentrated flavour, with pepper and fruit, which works well when sipped but can also hold up to other strong flavours in cocktails.

title: Tapatio Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
General Information

Aged for four months in ex-bourbon casks, two months longer than the law dictates. Tapatio Reposado is best enjoyed in a wine glass to fully bring out the honey and spicy character.

title: Pelee Island Lola Sparkling Rose 2024
bodyHtml: This blush sparkling wine has hints of strawberry and blood orange flavours, serve chilled. Pair with: beet risotto, puff pastry tomato torte, cranberry brie bites or strawberry tarts.  95% Vidal Blanc/ 5% Chambourcin. Charmat Method.

title: Yalumba Cabernet Sauvignon Sanctum Coonawarra 2018
bodyHtml: Deep and dark with intense, rich berry flavours, this popular pick reflects the unique characteristics of this Australian region in the best possible way.

title: Proper Twelve Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Created by UFC star Conor McGregor, Proper Twelve pays tribute to where it all began for Conor, Dublin 12. This triple-distilled blend has been aged in ex-bourbon barrels, giving it smooth notes of vanilla, honey and toasted oak. Enjoy this smooth and balanced whiskey neat or with your favourite mixer.

See More Irish Whisky

title: Santa Julia Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
This refreshing white wine hails from Mendoza, Argentina, with grapes primarily sourced from the Santa Rosa and Maipu subregions. Bodega Santa Julia was established in the early 1990s by José Alberto Zuccardi in honour of his daughter, Julia, and remains a third generation family owned estate.

Wine Description

The Santa Julia Pinot Grigio presents a pale yellow colour with subtle green highlights. The nose is delicate yet expressive, offering aromas of ripe pear, green apple, and melon, complemented by tropical notes of pineapple and banana with a faint floral lift. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and fruit driven, showcasing a smooth texture and vibrant acidity that leads to a crisp, refreshing finish.

title: Josh Cellars Legacy Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
The nose shows aromatic blueberry and plum backed by pepper and vanilla. On the palate, the wine shows good body, with baked plums and dark cherries, with secondary notes of roasted almonds, toasted cedar, and hazelnuts, finishing long with fine, soft tannins. A rich, velvety red blend that's delicious and well-balanced, made to exacting standards.

Pair this wine with BBQ ribs, leg of lamb, and grilled skirt steak.

title: Josh Cellars Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: This Chardonnay is a great balance of bright citrus and honey with a touch of oak character and hints of juicy peach. Crafted with care so that no single flavour overpowers another, this wine is simply delicious. Pairs beautifully with shrimp, steamed mussels, creamy pastas, roasted chicken, and grilled vegetables.

title: Domaine de Terres Blanches Sancerre Rouge 2023
bodyHtml: On the nose, the wine expresses red fruit aromas. On the palate, the wine is firm and long, with some light, smooth tannins, which will give the wine a few years' aging potential.

title: Casa Silva Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml: Appealing aromas of fresh apricot and mango have a subtle honey backbone on the palate. Hotter climate stone and tropical fruits on the nose and the palate. Medium to high acidity. The Silva family originates in the Colchagua Valley and projects its work to the world daily. Its wines reflect its commitment and each family member's passion for them and the earth. Casa Silva is a 100% family-owned company that seeks to transfer its roots' pride and respect for nature and its people to the world and future generations.

title: Pezat Bordeaux Blanc 2022
bodyHtml: Made by one of the true geniuses of Bordeaux, Jonathan Maltus, this is a blend of 85% Sauvignon Blanc with a little Semillon and Muscadelle. The grapes have minimal skin contact with a very soft press to ensure that the wine is full of zest, fresh and bright. Herbaceous, crisp and fruity, this fresh wine has citrus juicy apples, a hint of yellow fruits, and bright acidity. Great on its own, but try it with fish, shellfish and poultry dishes.

title: Villa Conchi Cava Brut Seleccion
bodyHtml: This award-winning Spanish sparkler from Villa Conchi is bright gold in colour and has aromas and flavours of crisp green apple, citrus, baked bread, white flower and lightly toasted nuts. Medium-bodied with lively acidity and a refreshingly clean finish, this is perfect as a starter or enjoy with light appetizers.

title: Talbott Pinot Noir Sleepy Hollow Vineyard 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'crystalline' red wine originates from the United States, within the cool-climate Santa Lucia Highlands A.V.A. of Monterey County, California. Produced by Talbott Vineyards; a benchmark producer celebrating over three decades of cool-climate Burgundian varieties, this bottling highlights one of California's most revered estate sites: the Sleepy Hollow Vineyard. Planted in 1972 on elevated benchlands, the vines are rooted in deep, gravelly loam, granite-rich soils, and sandy alluvial subsoils. Positioned just miles from Monterey Bay, the vineyard experiences extreme maritime influences, where morning fog and cold afternoon winds sweep down from the Pacific Ocean. This intense marine exposure creates a lengthened growing season, allowing Pinot Noir to develop profound fruit concentration and complex skin phenolics while locking in a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

Talbott Sleepy Hollow Vineyard Pinot Noir presents a luminous, deep ruby-garnet color in the glass with vivid magenta reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering a masterfully focused, expressive, and layered portrayal of Santa Lucia Highlands terroir. The bouquet opens with an inviting display of dark black cherries, wild forest strawberries, and ripe red plums, seamlessly integrated with delicate underlays of clove, cinnamon spice, dried rose petals, vanilla pod, damp forest floor, and a subtle line of crushed granite minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full-bodied, sleek, and precisely focused, showcasing a succulent, mouth-coating core of stone fruit reduction, blood orange peel, and dark cocoa. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that cuts cleanly through the rich mid-palate fruit density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and athletic, driven by supple, fine-grained, and chalky tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and savory finish accented by persistent notes of dark berry skin, toasted cedar, and baking spice.

title: Hiedler Rose 2021
bodyHtml: A Kamptal Rosé from the indigenous Zweigelt grape, with an unusual hint of the northern most Sangiovese grown in Europe. This makes the wine unique in Austria, not only in terms of taste. With his juicy, delicately fruity and light-hearted nature, this Rosé is the perfect after-work wine. Have a glass, relax and enjoy life!

title: Rivera Puer Apuliae 2015
bodyHtml: Intense and elegant blackberry and violet notes that are supported by a rich and full-bodied palate with a long and lingering finish.

title: Sherwood Estate Sauvignon Blanc Stratum 2025
bodyHtml: Produced by the famed Sherwood Estate, the Stratum Sauvignon Blanc is made from grapes grown in the Waipara Valley in the heart of Marlborough and from some estates in Waipara further south on the South Island's east coast. Harvested in the cool of the night to protect the grapes, the fruit was cool fermented over the course of four weeks to retain freshness and aromatic fruit characteristics. Sherwood Estate focuses on quality and value. Their wines are made to be enjoyed on any occasion from picking up a great bottle to enjoy with friends, to something a little more refined for a special occasion.

title: Il Colombaio San Cirino Chianti Colli Senesi 2022
bodyHtml:
San Cirino, Chianti Colli Senesi DOCG, where Sangiovese regains the authentic complexity that has made it famous all over the world, aged in small oak barrels giving it captivating spice while keeping the grape vein intact.

Delicate aromas of black cherry, violet, currant and strawberry. The taste is soft, balanced and enveloping.

title: Justin Justification Red Blend 2022
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Dark ruby purple core with blue/black secondary hue, a medium rim with thick tears showing slight staining on the glass. Aromatic and complex with ripe red cherry, black currant and a little berry with vanilla, cinnamon and licorice spice, cedar and graphite notes, oak, leather, dried autumn leaves and a minty hint of camphor. Moderate plus to full bodied, dry, with ripe cherry and cassis mixed with baking spice on entry joined by cedar and oak on the mid-palate with complex savory, herbal elements. The finish is long, balanced and clean, with returning red and black fruit and perfectly proportioned, fine, mouth-filling tannins.

title: Schladerer Himbeergeist (Raspberry) - 350 ml
bodyHtml: Schladerer fruit brandies are best served slightly chilled and neat in an Armagnac glass or Champagne flute. They make an excellent digestif after a meal. Although the delicate nature of Schladerer brandies makes them ideal on their own, they can be mixed with Champagne or sparkling wine, then garnished with the corresponding fruit makes a delightful cocktail.

title: Zonin Valpolicella Ripasso Superiore 2021
bodyHtml:
This Ripasso Superiore was born within the heart of the famous area of Valpolicella.

This wine is mainly made with Corvina grapes and Rondinella and Molinara grapes, meticulously harvested by hand. Following the traditional Ripasso technique, the must is passed on the freshly pressed Amarone pomace. This technique slightly increases the alcohol content and enriches the organoleptic potential of the wine, which subsequently matures 12 months in 30 HL Slavonian oak barrels.

Ripasso Superiore by Zonin has an intense ruby red color. The nose comes nuanced and complex, with vinous tones and well-defined notes of cherry and cocoa. In the mouth, it shows a good structure, with a pleasantly fruity aftertaste with light spicy notes.

Perfect with first courses and well-aged cheese.

title: Takara Yuki Nigori White Peach Sake - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Delightful aromas and flavours of perfectly ripe white peaches in cream, and almond, with a sweet, full-bodied palate.  Sweet and mouth-watering with a surprisingly clean finish.  Enjoy on its own, mixed into iced tea for a refreshing summery accent, or pour over fruit-based desserts.

Kosher Certified  |  Gluten Free  |  Sulphite Free  |  ABV: 10%

title: Canard Duchene Smooth Rose (NV)
bodyHtml:
Dedicated to the the most chic and trendy places, the Cuvee Charles VII Smooth Rose sublimates the most beautiful evenings. A Champagne of pleasure and seduction. A rich and original blend of thirty of the best crus, aged to a perfect maturity in the Canard-Duchene cellars, offers the flavour and the soft roundness of a great Rose de Champagne. 

On the eye: Pink subtle coppered hue and delicate abundant mousse.

On the nose: Soft and harmonious flavors of red fruits including raspberries.

On the palate: The attack is supple and smooth, while still very fresh. The finish is tasty, smooth and fruity.

title: Malfy Gin Rosa
bodyHtml:
Nowhere encapsulates the spirit of Italy quite like the Amalfi Coast. In this stylish, sun-soaked enclave, life moves at a different pace. Inspired by this Amalfi lifestyle, Malfy Gin embodies the essence of ‘La Dolce Vita’ and ZYN invites you to sit back and enjoy with every sip.

Italian juniper, rhubarb, pink grapefruit, plus five other botanicals combine harmoniously in this stylish pink-hued gin. A joyous burst of pink grapefruit and juniper with hints of lemon and white pepper embody the aromas and flavours of the Rosa. The crisp finish is invigorating. Pair with goat cheese or smoked salmon.

title: Deep Eddy Sweet Tea Vodka
bodyHtml:
General Information

10 x distilled vodka with whole-leaf Indonesian Black Tea and sweeten with a hint of organic honey from a local Texas Hill Country apiary.

title: Gorgo Pinot Grigio delle Venezie 2025
bodyHtml:
Located close to the village of Custoza, Cantina Gorgo was started by Roberto Bricolo in 1973. Starting off with 22 hectares of vineyards, the estate has grown to include 60 hectares of vines in the Bianco di Custoza and Bardolino production areas. Joined at the winery by his daughter Roberta, Roberto has converted his vineyards over to organic viticulture. The farming is done using traditional techniques and hand harvesting, which can take up to 45 days to complete. 

This light-bodied white wine is crisp and refreshing. In the glass, you’ll find vibrant acidity and notes of lemon, melon, mango, and bitter almond.

title: Clarendelle Bordeaux Rouge
bodyHtml:
Clarendelle Bordeaux Rouge originates from France, within the prestigious Bordeaux region. The wine brand was established in 2005 by Prince Robert of Luxembourg, great-grandson of Clarence Dillon, as a tribute to the family's legacy in the area. As part of the Domaine Clarence Dillon family, which includes the legendary Château Haut Brion, Clarendelle is crafted by the same expert winemaking team to reflect the high standards and elegance of its historic cousins.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep garnet or ruby colour, often featuring violet hues at the rim. The sensory profile is highly aromatic, offering notes of ripe blackcurrant, cherry, and plum, layered with hints of cedar, tobacco, liquorice, and chocolate. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied and silky smooth, displaying a refined structure with velvety tannins and an admirable freshness. The varietal composition is a traditional Bordeaux blend typically dominated by Merlot, with Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc added to provide structure, complexity, and floral elegance. It generally has an ABV ranging from 12.5% to 14% and is produced using sustainable viticulture.

title: The Grinder Cabernet Sauvignon - Shiraz Blue Moose 2023
bodyHtml: Enjoy in front of a cosy fire in the winter and in front a campfire in the summer.A red blend that offers berry and stewed fruit notes but also nuances of cigar box, leather and a hint of nuttiness coupled with the spice from the Shiraz component.

title: Animus Vinho Verde 2025
bodyHtml: Animus Vinho Verde refers to the fact that these are young wines meant to be drunk early. This wine is light, fresh and delicious, get ready to be surprised.

title: Gremillet Gold Special Cuvee (NV)
bodyHtml: Champagne Gremillet is a small, but beautifully formed family-owned Champagne house. Due to its southern latitude the grapes achieve a greater ripeness which leads to a richer fruit, and classic 'baked-biscuit' flavours mixed with characteristic toasty yeast overtones. This champagne shows fine mousse in the glass and fresh floral aromas, with a crisp citrus finish. Great for celebrations, but even better when you feel like a spot of lurid self-indulgence. Go on, treat yourself!

title: Attems Pinot Grigio Ramato Rose 2022
bodyHtml:
Attems, a historic winery in Italy's Friuli-Venezia Giulia region, has been producing wines since 1106. The estate spans 110 acres of south-facing terraced slopes, benefiting from diverse soils and a favorable climate, ideal for cultivating Pinot Grigio.

Wine Description
The 2023 Attems Pinot Grigio Ramato Rosé continues a traditional method of producing Pinot Grigio in the province of Venice. The term "ramato," meaning "coppery," describes the pink hue of the wine resulting from slight contact with the grape skins before pressing and fermenting. This rosé boasts a rich, fruity bouquet and opens full on the palate with multi-faceted flavors. The wine was fermented in stainless steel tanks at 15–17 °C for 15 days and aged on the noble lees for four months, enhancing its complexity and texture.

Food Pairing
This Pinot Grigio Ramato pairs wonderfully with sweeter cured meats and prosciutto, as well as pasta with vegetable sauces or shellfish.

title: Tommasi Il Sestante Amarone della Valpolicella 2021
bodyHtml:
Il Sestante Amarone is elegant, smooth and never overpowering - the hallmark traits of Tommasi's flagship wine.  Careful grape selection and the company’s great experience in drying the grapes are the secret of Amarone Il Sestante, a wine that exemplifies the Tommasi family’s passion for the Valpolicella region.

Using their Appassimento technique, Tommasi places selected grapes onto traditional Arele and then left to rest for minimum 110 days in a large dedicated open room, where a ventilation system maintains an elevated and constant airflow. During this period the grapes are constantly checked for mildew with an eye for perfectly healthy grapes.  

This Amarone is deep ruby red in color.  On the nose it offers intense scents of ripe cherries and plums, which give way to lightly floral and ethereal aromas. On the palate, it is full-bodied and well-structured. The soft tannins enhance the richness of the fruit, which is nicely balanced by the tangy and persistent finish.

title: Ferrari Carano Pinot Noir 2018
bodyHtml:
This wine has everything you would expect a great California Pinot Noir to deliver. Great structure and very well balanced. Drinks super smooth with strawberry and raspberry, cinnamon, vanilla, and gravelly river bed. Medium to light-bodied, low tannins, medium high acidity, beautiful garnet red in colour.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast     Rich, dark and full bodied, this expansive wine is full of black-fruit flavors and smoky oak, all wrapped in a velvety texture that helps coax black-cherry and dark-spice notes into a lingering finish.

title: Fukuda Shuzo Nagasaki Bijin Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Established in 1688, Fukuda Shuzo is a historic 15th generation brewery located in one of Japan's first open ports, where Dutch and Portuguese traders once thrived. The brewery operates with the founding philosophy that 'Sake brewing is done with heart, and nurtured by the wind'.

Description

This premium Daiginjo features a clear appearance and a vividly aromatic bouquet of pineapple, lychee, and Fiji apple. On the palate, it expands into a multilayered feast of exotic fruit, including notes of clementine and pear, supported by a well structured umami richness. The texture is extremely light and tropical, transitioning into a refreshing acidity and a clean basil finish. It is crafted from locally grown Yamada Nishiki rice polished to 38% and fermented slowly at low temperatures. ABV 17%.

title: Arcanum Valadorna 2019
bodyHtml: Arcanum Valadorna hails from Italy, produced in the Toscana IGT appellation within Tuscany. Nestled in the hills of Chianti Classico, Tenuta di Arceno is an ancient Tuscan estate managed under the vision of Jackson Family Wines and legendary winemaker Pierre Seillan. The winemaking philosophy focuses on micro terroir farming, matching international grape varietals to individual soil blocks to capture the distinct depth and minerality of the estate.

title: Old Pulteney Huddart
bodyHtml:
General Information

This non-age-statement single malt has been finished in barrels that previously held peated whisky, giving it mellow smoke notes alongside the classic Pulteney character. 46% alc./vol.

title: Treana Blanc Central Coast 2021 (Austin Hope Winery)
bodyHtml: Treana Blanc is a stunning full-bodied new world Rhone blend with aromas of orange blossom honey, peach nectar and a hint of tropical passion fruit. All of those aromas continue on the palette and evolve into rich roasted pineapple, dried apricot with notes of honeysuckle. The finish is long and weighted with a creamy texture that is brightened with a touch of acid. This wine is crafted to be enjoyed with food and is very versatile.

title: Brave Step Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml: This Pinot Noir has a bright cherry red colour. Intense nose of strawberry and spiced wood. Smooth and round on the palate with excellent structure and very well balanced.

title: Chalk Hill Chardonnay Sonoma Coast 2024
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1972, Chalk Hill Estate is located in the northeastern corner of Sonoma County and is renowned for its namesake volcanic white ash soils. Now owned by Foley Family Wines, the winery is celebrated for its commitment to sustainable viticulture and crafting wines that reflect the distinct terroir of the region.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a brilliant pale gold colour in the glass. The nose opens with layered aromas of crisp apple, ripe peach, lemon zest, and subtle floral notes, interwoven with undertones of vanilla, baking spice, and a touch of toasted oak. On the palate, it is medium bodied with a creamy texture and vibrant acidity, revealing flavours of stone fruit, green apple, and hints of honey and hazelnut.

Food Pairing

This Chardonnay is a versatile partner to food, pairing beautifully with pan-seared scallops, roasted chicken with herbs, creamy pasta primavera, or brie and triple cream cheeses.

title: Petrolo Galatrona - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml:
Galatrona is Petrolo's most acclaimed wine, a Merlot cru made exclusively with grapes from the Galatrona-Feriale vineyard planted in various phases during the 1990s with low vigor Bordeaux clones. The unique microclimate allows the concentration of the noble components of the grapes that are fundamental for the great structure, elegance, balance, and persistence that has made Galatrona one of Italy's most coveted wines.

98 Points, Robert Parker's Wine Advocate -  This is the flagship wine from Luca Sanjust's Petrolo estate located not too far from Arezzo in the Valdarno area of eastern Tuscany. The 2016 Galatrona is indeed a masterpiece to behold. This wine offers thick layering and deep intensity with aromas that offer an incredible range, starting off with luscious dark chocolate on one side and ending with fragrant white truffle on the far end of its long aromatic trajectory. You get plummy fruit, spice, sweet tobacco and tilled earth packed tight in between. This full-bodied Merlot is softly textured and succulent with long-lasting flavor intensity on the close. Petrolo's Merlot is planted in a ten-hectare parcel distinguished by thick clay soils. I have been watching Galatrona's evolution for years and have tasted the wine on occasion in various vertical tastings. This is my favorite vintage made thus far.

title: Sheringham Akvavit
bodyHtml: A traditional Nordic spirit of tranquil unsung fortitude. Notes of dill, caraway, anise and citrus with a hint of the ocean from locally harvested winged kelp.

title: Montelvini Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml: Pleasant and uncomplicated. Apples, peaches, honeydew melon, and watermelon on the finish. Nice on a hot day or any day!

title: Campagnola Della Casa Bianco - 2 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
A blend of Chardonnay, Trebbiano, and Garganega hand-harvested from vineyards of the Veneto region in Northern Italy.  Light straw yellow color. Fresh, light fragrant bouquet. Dry and harmonious taste.  

Ideal as an aperitif, or try with appetizers, hors d‘oeuvres, pizza, light meals, eggs, fish dishes.

title: Port Askaig 8 Year Old
bodyHtml: This eight-year-old whisky is warming and smoky with notes of limestone, licorice and dark peat.

title: Gemma Di Luna Prosecco (NV)
bodyHtml: Gemma Di Luna elevates the ordinary to the extraordinary. Crafted from grapes grown in the hilly vineyards of Italy's famed Prosecco DOC region in the Extra Dry style, Gemma di Luna Prosecco is a perfect symphony of fruit, tingly acidity and subtle sweetness. Persistent perlage with a stand out floral bouquet. Nicely savoury and complex palate with a mineral finish.

title: Aguardiente Antioqueno Sin Azucar
bodyHtml: Colombia's national alcoholic beverage is Aguardiente. There are different versions of aguardiente, or 'firewater', all over South America. In Colombia aguardiente is an anise flavoured spirit made from sugar cane. It has a 29% alcohol content. Colombians usually drink it straight, in shots.

title: Lake Breeze Roussanne Alize 2020
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: This Northern Rhone Variety shows a complex mix of citrus, apricot, and chamomile. The palate is rich and textured with good acidity and a long finish.

title: Quails' Gate Pinot Noir Stewart Family 2022
bodyHtml: The Stewart Family Pinot Noir is their flagship red wine at Quails Gate. The fruit is sourced from their finest blocks on the Boucherie slopes just across from the winery. It is made in limited quantities and only in vintages of exceptional quality. Expect an inviting mix of ripe red fruits, such as cherry, raspberry and cranberry that lift the palate, along with undertones of earth, allspice and clove. The tannins are evident and will soften beautifully with time. Suave, with an effortless elegance, they recommend serving at 15 C to enhance your tasting experience. Try pairing with duck, turkey, pork, seared BC salmon and rack of lamb served with a ragout of French lentils. Delightful!

title: Altos de Rioja Tempranillo 2022
bodyHtml: Nice violet red colour. Good aromatic intensity with berry fruits (blueberry) and a touch of herbs and grass. Fresh, medium bodied with flavours in line with the nose, showing fresh fruit and the herbaceous character common to many Alavesa reds. This wine goes well with vegetable soups, pastas, fresh vegetables, most kind of tapas and young cheeses.

title: Michael David Freakshow Zinfandel 2023
bodyHtml:
A new act has joined their band of Freaks, The Dazzling Fire Mistress which is a Freakshow Zin! The third installment in the Freakshow lineup, following a Cabernet Sauvignon and a Red Blend, this wine pays homage to its roots in Lodi, a region known for exceptional Zinfandel.

Typically known as a bold varietal, the FireMistress shows the softer, sexier side of Lodi Zin, focusing on the distinctive bright fruit and spice characteristics for which their heritage varietal is known.

This Zinfandel spotlights the variety's blazing red berry, cherry and dark fruit while flirting with pepper and spice notes. Medium-bodied and graceful with fine tannins, toasted oak and a lingering spice-laced finish.

title: Rocca delle Macie Chianti Classico Gran Selezione Sergio Zingarelli 2019
bodyHtml: This is truly the wine that could fully encapsulate the terroir and could take its place at the very top of the company's quality pyramid. With the introduction of the Gran Selezione, promoted by the Consortium, the fruit of this commitment has found its natural positioning within the new category. To produce the Gran Selezione we chose the most typical indigenous varieties of the Chianti Classico zone (90% Sangiovese, 10% Colorino) which in this wine express the best of their potential and of the terroir where they come from.

title: Glenrothes 18 Year Old
bodyHtml: This 18-year-old whisky is part of The Soleo Collection: a range of five whiskies from Glenrothes, ranging from 10 to 25 years old, which pay homage to the grapes from which some sherries, such as Pedro Ximenez, are made.

title: Glenrothes 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: Part of the Soleo Collection, this range takes its name from the process of sun-drying grapes in Jerez for sherry production.

title: Kinokawa Nigori Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1839, the brewery underwent a significant transformation in 1980 when four local Nagasaki breweries—Chogoya, Reimei Shuzo, Unzen, and Kuretake—merged to form the modern Kinokawa. Managed by representative Shinsuke Seto and master brewer Hirotaka Tanaka, the brewery is dedicated to crafting sakes that celebrate local Nagasaki ingredients and pair seamlessly with the region's abundant seafood.

Description

This premium cloudy sake presents an opaque straw colour with visible rice solids that provide a signature milky appearance. The nose is aromatic and layered, revealing scents of Granny Smith apple, nectarine, and sliced banana alongside savory hints of pound cake, marinated mushrooms, and graham cracker. On the palate, it features a satiny, off-dry medium body with a bright and creamy texture. The experience concludes with a medium-length finish characterized by refreshing notes of aloe, cucumber cordial, and horchata. ABV 15%.

Food Pairing

The creamy and slightly fruity profile of this nigori makes it an excellent match for spicy East Asian cuisine, where the rice solids help mellow the heat of chilies. It also pairs well with savory dishes like grilled chicken or pork, and serves as a delightful companion to desserts such as mochi ice cream, dark chocolate, or fruit-based tarts. For a local experience, serve it chilled alongside fresh Nagasaki seafood.

title: Gran Orendain Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: This is a Blanco tequila from the Gran Orendain range, produced by the Orendain family with specifically agave grown on the hill of Tepecoste, harvested at the peak of maturity. Mineral-forward, with earth agave shining through cleanly. A hint of ripe orchard fruit brings sweetness, think green apple and soft pear.

title: Gran Orendain Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Pure golden colour. Aromas of dried flowers, tropical fruit custard tart and marinated cucumber with a supple, medium to full body. Finishes with notes of dates, figs, sweet roasted pineapple and powdered sugar. Lovely, fruity agave-driven tequila that is perfect for sipping.

title: Chateau d'Esclans Whispering Angel Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Whispering Angel is today’s worldwide reference for Provence Rosé. Made from Grenache, Cinsault and Vermentino, its pale colour is pleasing to the eye and draws one in. The rewarding taste profile is full and lush while being bone dry with a smooth finish. Highly approachable and enjoyable with a broad range of cuisine, Whispering Angel is a premium Rosé that you can drink all day, any day!

Created by Sacha Lichine following his acquisition of Château d’Esclans in 2006, his vision was to create the greatest rosés in the world igniting the “Rosé Renaissance”. Sacha introduced new and innovative winemaking techniques to Provence which revolutionized the styles of Rosés being produced from this region. This led to the creation of Whispering Angel, a world class Rosé which presents both ease and accessibility making for enjoyment and pleasure.

As Sacha says... “In the Esclans Valley angels whisper. If you drink this wine, you might hear them… If you visit us, you might see them.”

title: Hakkaisan Sparkling Nigori Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hakkaisan Sparkling Nigori originates from Minamiuonuma City in the Niigata Prefecture of Japan. Hakkaisan Brewery was founded in 1922 and is situated at the foot of Mount Hakkai, which provides the 'Raiden-sama no Shimizu' spring water used in all aspects of production. The brewery was established by Koichi Nagumo and has been managed by the Nagumo family for several generations, with Masato Nagumo appointed as the current President and CEO in 2025.

Description

This premium Junmai Nigori is bottle fermented to create a natural, sophisticated effervescence. It presents a lightly cloudy appearance with gentle bubbles and an aromatic profile featuring subtle notes of dairy, pineapple, lychee, and tropical fruits. On the palate, it offers a round and creamy mouthfeel balanced by a bright, refreshing acidity and a light sweetness. The finish is clean and layered, showcasing the 'tanrei' (crisp and dry) style for which the brewery is famous. It has an alcohol content of approximately 14.5% to 15%.

Food Pairing

The creamy texture and sparkling nature of this nigori make it an excellent aperitif or an accompaniment to a variety of cuisines. It pairs exceptionally well with rich or spicy dishes, such as Thai curry or tom kha gai, where the bubbles and sweetness help balance the heat. Its acidity also complements fresh seafood like raw oysters, yuzu marinated salmon sashimi, and fatty fish rolls. For a dessert match, try serving it well chilled alongside fresh fruits or creamy grazing platters to highlight its subtle fruit notes.

title: Alberta Premium Rye - 750 ml (Plastic Bottle)
bodyHtml: The authentic flavour of prairie rye and careful barrel ageing gives this whisky a golden amber colour and an aromatic sweet bouquet of banana, toffee, and light spice. The flavour is mellow and slightly smoky with a lively woody edge on a medium weight palate that finishes with a hint of hot cinnamon spice.

title: WhistlePig 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Unveiled in mid-2015, the WhistlePig Old World is an exciting 12 year old straight rye whiskey which has been finished in a selection of wine casks, 63% Madeira, 30% Sauternes and 7% Port. It's inspired by the techniques of the "old world", with a particular reverence for Scotch whisky.

See More USA Whisky

title: Doi Shuzo Kaiun Iwaizake Junmai Ginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1872 during the Meiji Restoration, Doi Shuzo was established by Yasuichi Doi, a former village leader who transitioned from being a landlord to a sake brewer. The brewery is renowned for its use of soft spring water from near the ruins of Takatenjin Castle, which contributes to a lively fermentation and a distinctively 'melting' quality in their sake.

Description

This 100% pure rice Ginjyoshu is clear and colourless, featuring a lively and layered sensory profile. The nose is fragrant and youthful, offering a complex bouquet of banana, watermelon, and pink grapefruit alongside floral notes of cherry blossom and rose petal. On the palate, it is full-bodied and smooth with a creamy texture, showcasing a delicate balance of sweetness and acidity with flavours of wild strawberry and yuzu zest. The experience concludes with a medium complexity and a slightly savoury, clean finish characterized by high astringency. ABV 16%.

title: Kooksoondang Bekseju - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Kooksoondang Bekseju is a traditional Korean herbal rice wine, often referred to as a spirit, originating from the country of South Korea. Kooksoondang Brewery was founded by Bae Jung-ho in 1983. The company is dedicated to preserving and developing traditional Korean alcoholic beverages and uses a traditional nurook fermentation starter, an ancient technique known as Ihwaju (or 'rice wine for making rice wine'), to craft its brews. The name Bekseju translates to 'One Hundred Year Wine,' referring to the legend that drinking it can help one live up to 100 years.

Description

Bekseju is brewed using glutinous rice and a blend of twelve different traditional herbs and spices. These botanicals typically include ginseng, ginger, Schisandra berry, liquorice root, and Solomon's seal. The wine is made using the traditional nurook fermentation starter, which is a key part of Kooksoondang's technique. The colour is described as a golden or yellow hue. The aroma is rich, with a dominant scent of ginseng. On the palate, it has a harmonious and sweet taste with a bitter-spicy kick from the herbs and a refreshing finish. It is bottled at 13.0% ABV.

Accolades

Bekseju has received recognition for its quality and traditional significance. It was designated a 'Grade A Traditional Liquor' by the Korean Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries. It has also received awards in various international competitions, including a Gold Medal at the 1999 Monde Selection in Belgium. The Korean government has selected it as the 'Official Toasting Wine for APEC'.

Food Pairing

Bekseju is traditionally consumed with various types of food, especially rich or spicy Korean dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled meats, such as Korean barbecue, as its sweetness and herbal notes help cut through the fat. It is also recommended to enjoy Bekseju with spicy Korean stews (jjigae) or deep-fried foods like Korean pancakes (jeon).

title: Bread & Butter Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: California has a world-class reputation for outstanding Cabernet Sauvignon. This rich example shows why. It brims with aromas of toast, nuts, dark fruit and chocolate that lead to flavours of ripe dark fruit and chocolate-covered plums and ends in a smooth finish with a hint of spice. Enjoy with grilled steak or on its own.

title: Domaine D'Or White Blend - 4 Litre Box
bodyHtml: An easy drinking white wine with citrus, apple and pear flavours.

title: Santa Rita Secret Reserve Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This expressive red wine is produced in Chile, primarily sourced from the Leyda Valley with a portion from the Casablanca Valley within the broader Central Valley region. Founded in 1880 by Don Domingo Fernández Concha, Viña Santa Rita is one of Chile's oldest and most historic estates, once serving as a refuge for 120 soldiers during the Chilean War of Independence. Today, the winery is part of Grupo Claro and operates under the expert guidance of winemaker Sebastián Labbé, following a philosophy that blends deep heritage with a modern focus on sustainability and technical innovation.

Wine Description

The Santa Rita Secret Reserve Pinot Noir presents a moderately intense violet-red colour with brilliant clarity. The nose is aromatic and complex, revealing notes of raspberries, cherries, and fresh flowers, complemented by sweet undertones of vanilla, caramel, and a hint of clove from aging in French oak. On the palate, the wine is silky and medium-bodied, showcasing juicy red fruit flavours like strawberry and pomegranate alongside subtle hints of roasted coffee and spice.

Stylistically, this wine is designed for balance and freshness, featuring a refreshing acidity and smooth, fine-grained tannins that make it very approachable. The finish is long and polished with a succulent fruit profile.

title: Veramonte Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: Located in the renowned Colchagua Valley, their vineyards are situated among the rolling hills of Marchige. An intense, aromatic Cabernet Sauvignon with notes of ripe black fruit, black pepper and a touch of spice. A satiating long finish makes this wine perfect for pairing with a barbecue among friends or a traditional empanada.

title: Knob Creek Twice Barreled Rye
bodyHtml: Knob Creek Twice Barreled Rye takes the standard Knob Creek Straight Rye and finishes it in new, charred American oak barrels. It is available nationwide and is bottled at 50% ABV.

title: Bumbu XO Rum
bodyHtml: The XO is aged up to 18 years in bourbon barrels and finished in Spanish white oak sherry casks to achieve a beautifully balanced, endlessly sippable rum.  40% alc./vol.

title: Crown Royal Peach
bodyHtml: Crown Royal Peach Flavoured Whisky is a Limited Edition from Crown Royal, bringing some juicy sweetness to your summer season. To create this extraordinary blend, Crown Royal whiskies are carefully selected by their master blender and infused with the juicy flavour of fresh Georgia peaches. The result is a vibrantly delicious whisky, bursting with the luscious flavour of peach and the distinctive smoothness of Crown Royal. Enjoy Crown Royal Peach Whisky on the rocks or mixed with iced tea for a refreshing tasting cocktail.

title: Janneau 25 Year Old Armagnac
bodyHtml:
25 year old Armagnac from Janneau's Single Distillery range, made with Ugni Blanc grapes and matured in Limousin casks. The oldest in the range, this 25 year old expression exudes intense though refined aromas effortlessly, and delivers a gamut of superb notes of dark fruit, rancio and fragrant oak on the palate with elegance and a bit of oomph behind it with the 43% ABV. It pairs rather well with a fine cigar, too.

See More Armagnac

title: Sella & Mosca Cannonau di Sardegna Riserva 2021
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'historic' red wine originates from Italy, within the Cannonau di Sardegna D.O.C. appellation of the Mediterranean island of Sardinia. Sourced from the historic Sella & Mosca estate founded in 1899 by two visionary Piedmontese professionals, engineer Erminio Sella and lawyer Edgardo Mosca the property spans a massive, contiguous vineyard footprint in the Alghero region of northwest Sardinia. The estate operates under a winemaking philosophy that marries proud island traditions with modern technological precision, utilizing low-intervention farming to amplify site transparency. The old vines are rooted in unique, ancient soils composed of alluvial clay, wind-blown sand, and iron-rich trachyte limestone that naturally control vine vigor to concentrate structural depth within the fruit.

Wine Description

The 2021 Sella & Mosca Cannonau di Sardegna Riserva presents an intense ruby-red appearance with brilliant garnet highlights at the rim. Its sensory profile is wonderfully warm, complex, and Mediterranean, opening with an expressive bouquet of ripe red cherries, wild raspberries, and plum preserves, beautifully layered with classic notes of macchia (wild island scrub), myrtle berries, leather, and sweet oak spices. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, generous, and texturally rich, showcasing a deep core of dark stone fruits and savory herbs. It is characterized by an outstanding structural balance, showing a vibrant backbone of acidity that seamlessly lifts the wine's natural power. The mouthfeel is velvety and warm, driven by firm, fine-grained tannins that glide into a long, dry, and persistent finish detailed by lingering notes of crushed stones, white pepper, and tobacco leaf.

title: Glen Grant 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
A 12 year old Glen Grant single malt, launched in mid-2016 with a rather sleek and handsome new bottle design. Still shows off the classic Glen Grant style - honey'd malt, sugared almond and ripe apple notes galore!

See More Scotch Whisky

title: 1000 Stories Zinfandel 2021
bodyHtml: 1000 Stories Bourbon Barrel Aged Zinfandel is a harmonious balance of Zinfandel grapes from Mendocino and Sonoma counties which are bursting with aromatic red fruit scents and complex black fruit flavours. A touch of Petite Sirah and Syrah enhance those flavours even more with bold black and white pepper spices. The batch is then rounded out with a layer of smokiness derived from the new bourbon barrel aging.

title: Our Daily Red 2025
bodyHtml: Daily Red is a lighter-style, fruit forward red blend with a hint of violets on the nose and loaded with black fruit on the palate.

title: Glenrothes Whisky Makers Cut
bodyHtml: A rich non-age-statement whisky matured entirely in first-fill sherry casks with orange, vanilla, nutmeg and oak notes. It is part of The Soleo Collection, a range of five whiskies from Glenrothes, ranging from 10 to 25 years old, which pay homage to the grapes from which some sherries, such as Pedro Ximenez, are made. The red label on this bottle reflects the colour of the grape just before it begins to ripen.

title: Clos du Caillou Chateauneuf du Pape Les Safres 2023
bodyHtml:
Clos du Caillou Chateauneuf du Pape Les Safres originates from France, within the Southern Rhone region in the renowned Chateauneuf du Pape appellation. The estate traces its roots back to 1895 when it was initially used as a hunting reserve, which uniquely excluded its land from the original Chateauneuf du Pape boundary classification. Managed by the Pouizin-Pouzin family for generations and today led by Sylvie Vacheron, the winery focuses on organic viticulture and minimally invasive winemaking to highlight its distinct terroir.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a brilliant ruby red colour with vivid reflections. The nose reveals a fragrant bouquet of ripe red berries, wild strawberries, and cherries intertwined with liquorice, warm spices, and subtle floral touches of rose petals and violet. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, offering a supple texture filled with flavours of dark berries, blood orange, and delicate herbal notes. Fine, velvety tannins and lively acidity provide brilliant balance, leading to a long, ethereal finish.

Accolades

• Wine Advocate - 94 points

• Vinous - 94 points

• James Suckling - 93 points

• Wine Spectator - 93 points

• Jeb Dunnuck - 93 points

title: Julian Reynolds Grande Reserva 2016
bodyHtml: Smooth with aromas of freshness and fruit in a perfect marriage with wood, which are revealed in the month with fine and elegant tannins, a nice long set of persistence. A pure and natural red wine to enjoy with appetizers of strong and intense flavour or any red meat.

title: Barossa Valley Estate GSM 2024
bodyHtml:
Barossa Valley Estate wines are a contemporary expression of the wines that made the Barossa Valley great. They capture the distinctive elegance, finesse and vibrant fruit flavours of one of the world's most celebrated wine regions. Small in size, the Barossa Valley is regarded as one of the most significant red wine regions on earth.
