Its unique ancient friable red clay loam soils and warm climate combine to create wines of extraordinary varietal character.

Located in the heart of the Barossa Valley, Barossa Valley Estate focuses exclusively on premium red wines from the Barossa Valley. Barossa Valley Estate produces a range that represents the wine styles that made the Barossa great, Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon and GSM. Grenache, Shiraz, and Mourvedre (GSM) is a beautiful combination of these three wonderful grape varieties perfected in a true Barossa Valley style. Fragrant violets with a burst of fresh red berry fruits, juicy blackberry, and the cherry on a silky, velvet texture.

title: St Supery Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: This is a bright crisp sauvignon blanc with citrus zip, flavors of lemon, lime, yellow grapefruit, and lime zest combined with a fennel and caper vibrancy. Green and yellow hues present in this wine with exotic aromatics of pink grapefruit, green lime zest, lemon citrus along with undertones of fennel, and green olive.

title: Oyster Bay Rose 2025
bodyHtml: This distinctive, highly satisfying wine is from Pinot Noir, grown in the Wairau Valley. Full of personality, it is pale pink with an enticingly scented bouquet. Full-bodied and fleshy, it has robust and vibrant red-berry and plum flavours, with a gentle touch of tannin giving backbone and a lasting, dry finish. Excellent value.

title: Cusumano Benuara Sicilia 2022
bodyHtml: Cusumano winery is run by two brothers, who operate closely with their father, Francesco Cusumano, and expert winemaker, Mario Ronco. Together their artistic excellence and passion, embrace the diversity of the land in each wine, creating a bright explosion of modern, innovative, dynamic wines. Benuara, named after the small red flowers that blossom near the vineyard, is a rich red, fruit forward blend whose jam-filled profile pairs well with rich, grilled meats.

title: Primus Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Primus Cabernet Sauvignon originates from Chile, specifically from the Maipo Valley region. The winery was founded over 20 years ago by Agustin Huneeus, who was a pioneer in creating premium Chilean blends. The estate is now part of the Gonzalez Byass portfolio and is closely associated with Veramonte. The winery's philosophy focuses on a non-interventionist, 'natural' approach, with a strong commitment to organic and biodynamic viticulture to promote a healthy, living ecosystem in the soil.

Wine Description

This red wine typically presents a very dark ruby or deep crimson colour. The sensory profile is rich and layered, featuring inviting aromas of blackcurrant, blackberry, and dried cherry, often intertwined with notes of vanilla, cedar, and tobacco. On the medium to full-bodied palate, it delivers flavours of dark plum, blueberry, and mocha, complemented by savory hints of black olive and loam. The mouthfeel is characterized by a smooth, silky texture with well-integrated, fine-grained tannins and a balanced acidity.

  • Varietal Composition: Primarily 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, though some vintages may include a small percentage of Petit Verdot (e.g., 15%).

  • ABV: Typically recorded at 13.5% to 14%.

  • Organic Status: All farming practices are organic, with vineyards often undergoing conversion to biodynamic methods.

  • Ageing: The wine is matured for approximately one year in French oak barrels and large foudres, with only a small portion (roughly 18%) being new oak to maintain a balance of fruit and wood.

title: Santa Rita Cabernet Sauvignon Medalla Real Gran Reserva 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Santa Rita Cabernet Sauvignon Medalla Real Gran Reserva 2022 is a red wine from Chile, produced in the Maipo Valley appellation. The wine is part of the Medalla Real line from Viña Santa Rita, a historic winery founded in 1880. The 'Medalla Real' (Royal Medal) name commemorates the award the wine received in the 19th century. The Gran Reserva designation signifies a wine of specific quality, requiring certain aging and alcoholic strength. The grapes for this wine are 100% sourced from the highly regarded Alto Jahuel vineyards in the Alto Maipo Valley.

Wine Description

The wine has a deep ruby-red or very deep purple ink colour.

  • Varietal Composition: 92% Cabernet Sauvignon and 8% Cabernet Franc. Some sources may cite slightly different percentages or include a minor amount of Petit Verdot.

  • Aromatic Profile: The nose is rich and full of dark blue fruit like blueberries, blackberries, and dried figs, with notes of black currant and cherry. These are complemented by hints of black olive, pepper, cigar box, and mild spice from the oak.

  • Body and Palate: Full-bodied, with a sweet attack and a rich mid-palate. The palate is a generous mix of red and black fruits, with flavours of blackberry and cassis, often with a subtle savoury or earthy undercurrent.

  • Structure: The mouth has intense, well-rounded, and ripe tannins that create a prominent backbone. The tannins are polished and well-supported by the juicy flow of the wine.

  • Aging: The wine is aged in oak barrels to develop its complexity, with notes of toasted oak and vanilla frequently detected.

  • ABV: Typically 13.6% or 13.5%.

  • Optimal Drinking Window: Recommended for drinking from 2023 to 2036.

Food Pairing

This rich and structured Cabernet Sauvignon is a perfect companion for hearty meat dishes. Suggested pairings include:

  • Red Meats: Grilled red meat, steak, and hamburgers.

  • Pork: Pork dishes.

  • Other Dishes: Hard cheese and venison.

title: Rivetto Barolo Serralunga d'Alba 2021
bodyHtml: Bright ruby red with orange reflexes, gentle bouquet of roses, violets, mature fruits and spice. The palate is soft and elegant with delicate tannins. Pairs well with tasty risotto, tajarin with salsiccia raga, tagliata of veal, delicate braised cheek, finanziera entrails and ravioli.

title: Chateau d'Aiguilhe 2018
bodyHtml:
Juicy loganberry and black currant fruit form an inviting core, while light bay, tobacco and violet notes fill in around the fruit. It offers a fleshy edge but emphasizes cut and drive through the finish.

93 Points - James Suckling

The purity of fruit to this is beautiful, with blue fruit, blackberries and flowers on the nose and palate. Medium-bodied with fine tannins, a solid core of fruit and a long, attractive finish.

92 Points - Decanter

Austere, textbook limestone flavours are given a plump mid-palate by damson and black cherry fruits and owned by Stephan von Neipperg.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate   

Medium to deep garnet-purple in colour, 2018 d'Aiguilhe jumps out of the glass with exuberant notes of plum preserves, Black Forest cake and blackberry pie, plus hints of potpourri, hoisin and forest floor. The medium to full-bodied palate has a soft texture and oodles of freshness supporting the mouth-coating black fruit preserves, finishing with loads of exotic spice layers.

91 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Readers looking for a beautiful Bordeaux that will not break the bank should check out the 2018 Château D'Aiguilhe. Coming from the cooler Castillon region to the east of Saint-Emilion, this beauty offers a terrific perfume of ripe black raspberries, cherries, roasted herbs, sweet mulch, and spring flowers. It has a fresh, crunchy quality to its fruit, nicely integrated acidity, ripe yet present tannins, and the class to keep for 10-15 years.

title: Teeling Small Batch Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Produced by the Teeling Whiskey Company, this is a delicious small-batch blend with a very high malt content. Interestingly enough, it's also been matured in rum casks for added spice.

See More Irish Whisky

title: Bruno Giacosa Dolcetto d'Alba 2023
bodyHtml: This traditional estate, founded by Carlo Giacosa in 1890 in the municipality of Neive, is one of the pillars of Piedmont and one of the region's key figures. This very characteristic version of what the Dolcetto variety can offer is a good example of an "iron fist in a velvet glove". Provided with a somewhat firm tannic structure, its explosive fruity mass in the making is already a delight. Scents of strawberry, cherry, black berries, and a touch reminiscent of blood orange pulp already complement each other to perfection. Without a doubt, a decanting into a carafe will magnify its aromatic expression

title: Beringer Q Red Blend 2020
bodyHtml: Aromas of black fruits and preserves are accented by notes of herb, oak spice and dried fruits. Rich and expressive, round and full in the mouth with evident tannins that will lead to continued development as the wine ages. Savoury and chewy upon entry, enjoyable now but will show well for 10-15 years.

title: Crown Royal Vanilla
bodyHtml:
To create this extraordinary blend, Crown Royal whiskies are carefully selected by their master whisky blenders and infused with the rich flavour of Madagascar Bourbon Vanilla. The result is a uniquely sophisticated whisky, bursting with the bold flavour of vanilla and the distinctive smoothness of Crown Royal.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Liquidity Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
This Canadian white wine originates from British Columbia in the Okanagan Valley, specifically the subregion of Okanagan Falls. Liquidity Wines is a modern destination winery in Okanagan Falls that focuses on an artisan approach to winemaking.

Wine Description

The Liquidity Chardonnay 2022 is a white wine crafted from the Chardonnay varietal. Notes of mandarin, lemon poppyseed cake, and papaya define the aroma and sensory profile. On the palate, the wine is described as bright, fresh, and vibrant with beautiful acidity. It exhibits textural complexity and maintains the characteristic richness of the Chardonnay variety. This is a full-bodied and rich white wine with ripe fruit flavours, vanilla oak notes, and a creamy texture, with a hint of spice on the finish.

Food Pairing

The wine's rich and full-bodied nature, coupled with its creamy texture and spice finish, makes it ideal for pairing with richer shellfish dishes.

title: Meinklang Burgenland Weiss 2024
bodyHtml: The wine has a charming nose with notes of white fruits and orange blossom. Very dry and lively on the palate, it is an airy wine, light in alcohol and digestible which can't displease.

title: Tamanohikari Karakuchi Junmai Ginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Japan, Kyoto Prefecture, Fushimi. Founded in 1673, Tamanohikari Sake Brewing Co., Ltd. is a historic brewery renowned for leading the industry in reviving the traditional junmai style in 1964. Based in the ancient capital region of Fushimi, they are celebrated for their commitment to using no added alcohol or sugar and for utilizing unique techniques like henpei flat rice polishing.

Description

This sake presents a clear appearance and a beautifully balanced, dry profile. The aromatic bouquet is herbaceous with distinct notes of tofu, fresh rice cake, and bamboo, complemented by subtle hints of peach and rice candy. On the palate, it offers a smooth texture with a medium body, showcasing a clean umami flavour and a touch of peach. The finish is exceptionally dry and crisp, highlighted by a natural acidity that provides a refreshing and sophisticated experience. ABV 15.4%.

Food Pairing

The dry and herbaceous profile of this sake makes it an excellent companion for lightly seasoned dishes such as salt and pepper chicken wings, edamame, and vegetable tempura. It also pairs elegantly with chilled silken tofu topped with ginger and soy sauce, as well as delicate seafood including sushi, sashimi, and grilled king oyster mushrooms.

title: Requiem Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: Sourced from a quartet of top-tier, biodynamically farmed vineyards, Champoux, Wallula, SeVein and Loess, Requiem Cabernet Sauvignon has a very impressive pedigree. From the moment the first drop hits your palate, the structure and complexity of this Cabernet are striking and the fruit is absolutely explosive! Look for flavours of black cherry, blackberry, cassis and black plum fruits followed by classic tobacco leaf, cedar, graphite, chocolate and baking spice notes. This bright, full and authentic Cabernet starts out really great but then, as it breathes, just gets better and better!

title: Mars Shinshu Distillery Iwai Tradition Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Mars Shinshu Iwai Tradition is a malt-driven blended Japanese whisky produced at the Mars Shinshu Distillery in the Nagano Prefecture. Situated in the Japanese Alps at an elevation of over 2,600 feet, it is Japan's highest whisky distillery. The spirit is named in honour of Kiichiro Iwai, a silent pioneer of Japanese whisky who designed the distillery's original pot stills and was the direct mentor to Masataka Taketsuru (the founder of Nikka). While the entry-level "Iwai" expression is corn-dominant and bourbon-like, the "Tradition" is a more complex, malt-heavy blend that pays homage to the classic Scottish styles Iwai-san admired.

Whisky Description

This whisky presents a bright bronze-gold colour. The nose is aromatic and complex, offering notes of wildflower honey, clove, and baked apple, with a very faint, earthy whiff of peat smoke. On the palate, the body is rounded and harmonious, delivering flavours of ripe pear, toffee, and milk chocolate, balanced by a gentle nuttiness and a touch of black tea. The finish is medium-long and clean, characterized by a soft ginger spice and a lingering sweetness of cinnamon and orange peel. It is a blend of approximately 70% to 75% malted barley and 25% to 30% corn, aged in a medley of ex-bourbon, sherry, and wine casks. It is bottled at 40% ABV.

Food Pairing

The balanced, fruit-forward profile of Iwai Tradition makes it a versatile companion for both Western and Japanese cuisine. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled steak or yakitori, where the charred savoury notes of the meat complement the whisky's subtle smoke and sweetness. For a dessert pairing, try it with dark chocolate or toffee-based biscuits to highlight the nougat and caramel undertones. Its soft, alpine character also makes it an excellent match for creamy cheeses like Brie or aged Gouda, as well as a refreshing accompaniment to a classic highball served with a twist of lemon.

title: Marolo Dco. Ulrich Amaro
bodyHtml:
Amaro Ulrich was first made in 1854 to a recipe by Dr Domenico Ulrich, and is now produced in a revised version by the Marolo Distillery, which has years of experience in liqueur and spirit making.

Amaro Ulrich contains the active ingredients of 19 herbs, flowers, fruits and roots, making it an effective and reinvigorating digestif. Top note flavours among the various ingredients are wormwood, gentian and anise, and it is precisely the natural nature of the formula that gives it its unique, unmistakable character. The entirely traditional method of production keeps the active and aromatic substances that typify the product unaltered.  It may be served straight or "on the rocks". It can also be used in a wide variety of cocktails.

title: Westland American Single Malt Peated Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Westland Peated American Single Malt Whiskey is a distinctive expression from Seattle's Westland Distillery, showcasing a harmonious blend of peated and non-peated malts to create a balanced and nuanced profile.

Production Process

This whiskey is crafted using a combination of peated malt and the distillery's signature five-malt barley bill, which includes Washington Select Pale Malt, Munich Malt, Extra Special Malt, Pale Chocolate Malt, and Brown Malt. The peated malt is sourced from Scotland, imparting a smoky character, while the diverse malt bill adds depth and complexity. Fermentation is carried out with Belgian brewer's yeast, enhancing fruity and floral notes. The spirit is then aged for a minimum of 24 months in a combination of new American oak and first-fill ex-bourbon barrels, allowing the flavors to mature and integrate.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: A delicate interplay of smoke and sweetness, with aromas of pear, marzipan, milk chocolate, and charred brown sugar.

  • Palate: The smoke becomes more pronounced, accompanied by flavors of black pepper, allspice, cloves, smoked paprika, and leather.

  • Finish: Medium-long, with lingering smoky notes and a touch of earthy spices.

Food Pairing

This whiskey pairs well with smoked meats, aged cheeses, and dark chocolate desserts, complementing and enhancing their rich flavors.

title: Westland American Single Malt 'Sherry Wood' Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Westland Sherry Wood American Single Malt Whiskey is a distinguished expression from Seattle's Westland Distillery, embodying the artistry of American whiskey-making combined with traditional sherry cask maturation. This unique single malt reflects a commitment to innovation and quality, showcasing the potential of American single malts.

Production Process
Crafted from a carefully selected five-malt barley bill, the whiskey is fermented with Belgian brewer's yeast, enhancing its fruity and complex profile. It is aged in a combination of ex-Oloroso and ex-Pedro Ximénez sherry casks, as well as new American oak barrels. This diverse cask selection contributes layers of richness and depth to the spirit.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: Aromas of dried apricot, brown sugar, custard, vanilla, chamomile tea, and stone fruit, with a subtle wisp of smoke.
  • Palate: Chocolate-covered cherries, roasted coffee beans, and cocoa nibs, complemented by hints of black licorice and fresh anise.
  • Finish: Medium-short, with drying notes of dusty cocoa and fruit leather, leaving a gentle sweetness and herbal freshness.

Accolades
Westland Sherry Wood American Single Malt Whiskey has been lauded by critics, with a score of 93 points from Wine Enthusiast, praising its balance and fresh complexity.

Food Pairing
This whiskey pairs beautifully with dark chocolate, roasted nuts, or smoked meats, enhancing its rich and layered profile.

title: Roku Japanese Gin
bodyHtml: The first gin from Japan's legendary Suntory, Roku Gin. This expression is made using a selection of botanicals, including six Japanese botanicals that provide a whistle-stop tour of the four seasons. These include sakura leaf and sakura flower for spring, sencha tea and gyokuro tea for summer, sansho pepper for autumn and yuzu peel for winter. Traditional gin botanicals also featured include the likes of juniper, orange peel, lemon peel, coriander and cinnamon, among others.

title: Westland American Single Malt 'American Oak' Whiskey
bodyHtml: Westland American Oak American Single Malt is distilled in Seattle using 100% malted barley. The malted barley, 90% sourced from Washington State, is comprised of 5 different types: Munich malt, extra exceptional malt, brown malt, pale chocolate malt, and Washington Select pale malt. Additionally, a strain of Belgian brewer's yeast is used. This matured a minimum of 36 months in Cooper's Select new American oak, Cooper's Reserve new American oak, and first-fill ex-bourbon barrels.

title: Tenuta di Arceno Chianti Classico Riserva 'Strada al Sasso' 2020
bodyHtml: Strada al Sasso is their flagship, single-vineyard, single-block Sangiovese. Planted in 1998, this exceptional micro-cru is located in a wind-swept corner of our estate. It features high-density spacing, careful matching of rootstocks and clones to the soils, and low yields. This is the most intense, brooding, concentrated, complex wine they produce at Tenuta di Arceno. The aromatics are saturated with dark fruit, dark-roasted coffee beans and violets. The palate is dense and commanding with dried plums, nutmeg, earth, wet slate, firm acids and fine tannins. While this wine drinks well in youth, it is built to evolve and improve over the next decade or more.

title: Underwood Rose 2022
bodyHtml: Straight from the Rose City! Drinkable, unpretentious and travel ready, this is the perfect wine for action lounging, such as poolside shindigs, outdoor music festivals, backyard BBQ's with friends or anywhere that calls for serious lounging. It's set to become your favourite spring and summer staple. Think strawberry, watermelon and peach!

title: Malfy Originale Gin
bodyHtml: While Malfy Gin Con Limone showcases Italian coastal lemons, their Originale expression showcases a juniper-forward flavour profile. Using wild Italian juniper alongside five further botanicals, the Malfy Gin distillers bring Originale down to bottling strength using water from the Monviso mountain extracted at the village of Crissolo.

title: Masterson's 10 Year Old Straight Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml:
General Information

Complex aromas of rye grain, linseed oil, earth, floral notes and leather. Fascinating on the palate with vanilla, earth, hot pepper and sweet/spicy ginger notes. Long earthy/floral finish.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Tomatin 30 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Matured in a combination of ex-Bourbon and traditional oak casks.  The Tomatin 30 Year Old delivers fresh aromas of soft fruits, golden honey and smooth white chocolate. On the palate, a fusion of tropical fruits and creamy buttered vanilla mingle in an explosion of sensational mixed spices.

46% alc./vol

title: Siempre Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Siempre Añejo Tequila is a high-end, barrel-aged spirit founded by Mexican-Canadian partners Monica Sanita and Alex Lacroix. Crafted in the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico with production transitioning to the acclaimed Feliciano Vivanco distillery (NOM 1414) in Arandas under Master Distiller Sergio Cruz—the brand was established as a homage to traditional, additive-free agave craftsmanship.

Spirit Description

Siempre Añejo is produced from 100% blue Weber agave harvested at peak maturity from mineral-rich highland fields. The agaves are slow-cooked and double-distilled in traditional copper pot stills before undergoing extended aging in hand-selected oak barrels (combining American white oak ex-bourbon casks and cognac barrels). This patient wood maturation imparts rich dessert-like notes while retaining the underlying sweetness of cooked agave.

  • Colour: Deep golden amber with bright copper highlights.

  • Aroma: Rich and inviting, opening with toasted oak, salted caramel, and vanilla bean, complemented by dark chocolate, dried fruit, candied orange peel, and warm baking spices.

  • Palate: Lush, rounded, and complex on the entry. Upfront flavors of cooked agave, butterscotch, and sweet caramel transition into dark cacao, roasted nuts, vanilla, and gentle barrel spices.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a smooth, velvety viscosity that coats the palate evenly without aggressive alcohol burn.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and comforting, tapering off with lingering notes of dark chocolate, sweet oak spice, subtle peppercorns, and roasted agave.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Chateau Fontenil 2016
bodyHtml:
The improbable vintage! An almost perfect climatic sequence. Harvests in very good conditions, with fine grapes from north to south. This is undoubtedly the most accomplished vintage since 2009 and 2010. Behind a dark purple colour, exuberant aromas of wood, red fruits, black cherry, raspberry, and mocha. The wine is opulent on the palate, still in power and the tannins are present but without firmness.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Sleek in feel, with racy acidity pulling the raspberry and plum fruit along from the get-go. The chalky minerality is well-embedded in the finish. Solid.

93 Points - James Suckling

Extraordinarily aromatic and bright with raspberry, currant and dried-flower character. Full-bodied, yet soft and velvety with a flavorful finish. Already gorgeous.

title: Quilt Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Quilt wines is the creation of fifth-generation Napa Valley winemaker Joseph Wagner. Wagner’s winemaking philosophy for Quilt is to 'layer cool and moderate climate vineyards' from across the Napa Valley to create a balanced, yet classic style, allowing the 'fruitful nature of the patchwork' to shine.

Wine Description

This is a varietal wine made from 100% Chardonnay grapes. The Quilt Chardonnay is typically a medium-bodied wine. On the nose, it offers rich notes of butterscotch cream, pecan, and toasted wheat bread. The palate is round bodied and luscious, with flavours of baked apple, pineapple-mango cream, buttered toast, salty popcorn, and lemon curd, alongside nectarine and cantaloupe. Stylistically, it's described as a complex and well-balanced Napa Valley Chardonnay with a smooth, creamy finish.

Food Pairing

Pair it with Manchego and Parmesan cheeses, croquettas de queso (cheese croquettes), chicken wings, or creamy pasta dishes like mushroom risotto.

title: Great Big Friggin' Red (NV)
bodyHtml:
General Information

A dark red wine with aromas of spice and ripe red fruits. Supple, full and easy drinking, this wine was aged with Canadian oak and maple wood which gives it a distinct aromatic style (caramel, mocha, toast and maple). A perfect wine to drink alongside the BBQ.

title: Mortlach 16 Year Old
bodyHtml:
This single malt Scotch Whisky is inspired by the iconic and rewarding first bottling of the 16-year-old released in 1992. It has been matured in only Sherry casks to impart rich, fruity, and fragrant notes atop the beasty complexity synonymous with Mortlach.

This deep amber whisky is palate-coating, robust, and full.  The nose is bold and complex with notes of stewed black orchard fruits with earthiness and spice.  The palate is full, with leathery spiciness and notes of apricot and honey.  It's sweet and savoury with a dark, full, and rounded intensity.

title: Glengoyne Highland Single Malt 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
"Every winter, the hill behind out distillery becomes a beacon for migrating flocks of geese, which is why our home on the Highland border is known as The Glen of The Geese or, in Gaelic, Glen Guin. But our guests have inspired more than just our whisky's name. In a world that seems to spin faster every day, we're proud to be the slowest whisky distiller in Scotland.

In the stillness of our quiet glen, we know that patience is rewarded. Nothing is rushed and every stage of our whisky making process is given as long as it needs. Uniquely-shaped stills nurse the simmering wash during the longest distillation of any Scottish whisky, prolonged contact with the copper coaxing sweet and fruity notes from the gently rolling vapours. That's why our barley is only ever dried by air, allowing the true Glengoyne spirit to shine through.

From here the precious spirit is transferred to casks made to order from European and American oak, themselves prepared for six years before they're ready to carry our whisky to maturity. The natural colour of the whisky is testament to decades within the wood alone. Nothing else is added, this is how we craft a whisky unlike any other. This is the Glengoyne way."

Glengoyne 12 Year Old    Lemon zest, toffee apples – and a scent of coconut. Hand-selected sherry casks help create this paradise of flavours and rich, golden colour. It’s the taste of Scotland’s slowest distillation, and our insistence on barley dried by air – never peat.

title: E. Guigal Cotes du Rhone Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

E. Guigal Cotes du Rhone Rouge is a prestigious red wine from the Cotes du Rhone region in the Southern Rhone Valley of France. Founded in 1946 by Etienne Guigal in the village of Ampuis, the estate has risen to global prominence under three generations of family leadership. The winery's philosophy is rooted in the motto 'Nul bien sans la peine' (no good without pain), reflecting an obsessive dedication to quality, low-yield farming, and exceptionally long barrel aging.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a deep, dark red colour with a shiny appearance. The aromatic profile is intense and fresh, featuring notes of black raspberry, blackberry, and dark cherry layered with spices like black pepper and liquorice. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and racy, displaying a rich core of fruit balanced by rounded, smooth tannins and a touch of earthiness or black olive. It is characterized by its remarkable consistency, power, and elegance, leading into a long, self-confidently dry finish. The varietal composition is typically 50% Syrah, 40% Grenache, and 10% Mourvedre. The ABV is approximately 14.5% to 15%, and while not certified organic, the family avoids pesticides and chemicals in their vineyards. The optimal drinking window is from release to approximately 8 years after the vintage.

Accolades:

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

"The Cotes Du Rhone is smoking good, offering up blackberries, pepper, and garrigue in a round, supple, medium to full-bodied style. Based on 50% Syrah, 40% Grenache, and 10% Mourvèdre, partially aged in oak foudres, this impressive effort shows remarkable quality for the appellation."

title: Sake One Moonstone Asian Pear Infused Junmai Ginjo - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Sake One Moonstone Asian Pear is a premium infused Junmai Ginjo sake originating from Forest Grove, Oregon, in the United States. It is produced by SakéOne, America's first successful craft sake brewery, which was founded in 1992 and began brewing its own labels in 1997. Under the guidance of Brewmaster Takumi Kuwabara, the brewery utilizes natural spring water from the Oregon Coastal Range and exclusive Calrose rice grown in California's Sacramento Valley to craft this innovative infusion.

Description

This sake presents a clear appearance and features a fresh, fruit forward sensory profile. It offers a pronounced aroma of fresh Asian pear, apricot, and a hint of slate. On the palate, it is delicately sweet and smooth, showcasing flavours of ripe pear, green melon, and agave syrup balanced by a crisp Ginjo character. The body is light to medium with a polished mouthfeel, leading to a smooth and lightly dry finish. It has an alcohol by volume of 12% and is best enjoyed well chilled or as a base for expressive cocktails.

Food Pairing

The versatile and approachable nature of Moonstone Asian Pear makes it an ideal match for a wide range of cuisines. Its sweetness and fruitiness perfectly complement spicy dishes such as ramen, Thai noodle broths, and spicy tuna tataki salad. It is also a popular companion for casual fare like gourmet pizza—particularly Hawaiian or veggie options—and grilled meats. For a lighter pairing, consider serving it with fresh salads containing fruit, prawns, or mild pork dishes.

title: Castarede Armagnac 1965
bodyHtml: The Armagnac Castarede comes from the Castarede family, who have been running their winery in the Armagnac region of France since 1832. The nose is rich with stewed fruits, cedary oak and enticing aromas of pecans, honey, plums and white pepper. After some time, sweeter notes of vanilla, sticky dates, and old muscat develop. The palate is silky and elegant with dried fruits, bread pudding, toffee and baking spices with gentle fine tannins on the finish. Great finesse and surprisingly delicate for an old Armagnac.

title: Pillitteri Estates Vidal Icewine Reserve 2016 - 200 ml
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Pillitteri Estates Winery, based in Niagara-on-the-Lake, Ontario, is a family-owned winery renowned for being the world’s largest estate producer of Icewine. Established in 1993 by Gary Pillitteri, the estate remains dedicated to crafting premium wines rooted in tradition and innovation. The winery’s reputation is built on meticulous vineyard care and a philosophy that balances respect for the land with a passion for creating world-class Icewines.

Wine Description

The 2016 Reserve Vidal Icewine displays a golden straw hue, with an expressive bouquet of ripe pear, candied citrus peel, lychee syrup, and delicate floral notes. On the palate, it reveals layers of peach, apricot, tropical fruits, and hints of baking spice. The luscious sweetness is expertly balanced by refreshing acidity, giving the wine remarkable structure and elegance. Medium- to full-bodied, it finishes with a lingering richness and vibrant freshness. Crafted entirely from Vidal grapes harvested frozen on the vine, this wine showcases the depth and concentration for which Niagara Icewine is celebrated. Optimal enjoyment is expected to extend for at least 10–15 years from vintage.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 91 points

  • Decanter – 90 points

Food Pairing

This Icewine pairs beautifully with bold cheeses such as blue or aged cheddar, as well as citrus-based desserts and tropical fruit tarts. It also shines when served as an indulgent aperitif or alongside foie gras. Together, these pairings create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: La Sangre de Jonata Syrah 2009
bodyHtml:
99 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

Meaning the blood of Syrah, the 2009 Jonata Winery La Sangre de Jonata is aptly named and represents the sheer essence of Syrah. A blend of 98% Syrah and 2% co-fermented Viognier, it’s thrillingly dense and rich, with spectacularly deep, classy aromas of blackberry, charcoal, blood, lavender, and violets that literally soar from the glass. Incredibly concentrated and rich, this hits the palate with a full-bodied, dense, layered texture that partially conceals the massive underlying structure and tannin of the wine.

94 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

The 2009 La Sangre de Jonata is very awkward at first, but gradually opens up to reveal huge fruit backed up by equally imposing, masculine tannin. If opened today, the wine will require quite a bit of air. Ideally, it is best left alone for several years. At this stage, the aromas and flavors are very much primary. It is the wine's textural elegance and layered personality that impress above all else. With air, the wine truly begins to blossom. In 2009, there is just a touch (1%) of Viognier in the blend. Anticipated maturity: 2014-2021.

92 Points - Wine Spectator

Dark and condensed, with a rich, focused core of supple-textured mineral and fresh earth—laced blackberry and wild berry flavors. Gains depth and holds its focus, with a long, persistent finish. Syrah. Best from 2013 through 2024. 800 cases made.

title: La Flor de Jonata Sauvignon Blanc 2019
bodyHtml:
Sophisticated, complex and utterly satisfying vintage of Flor. Explosively aromatic with notes of honeysuckle, lemon grass, candied ginger, white rose and lemon bar. The palate weight is luxurious with nuances reminiscent of honeycomb and loquat and large, crunchy flakes of sea salt. Suave and expansive. Feels like a silk pillowcase. Lovely convergence of fruit density, saline notes, buoyant and refreshing acidity and pure Jonata/Flor power. Gravel driveway after a rainstorm. Compact and powerful vintage. Compelling and complete. A texturally and structurally towering white wine. One of the great Flor bottlings.

Blend: 97% Sauvignon Blanc, 3% Sémillon.

94 Points - Jeb Dunnuck 

The very lightly hued, Sauvignon Blanc dominated 2019 Flor (there's 3% Semillon) offers up a gorgeous, Bordeaux Blanc-like bouquet of ripe pineapple and citrus fruits interwoven with notes of brioche, honeyed almonds, and chalky minerality. It has bright acidity, medium-bodied richness, and a concentrated yet precise, focused style on the palate that bodes well for a good decade of longevity, if not longer.

title: Glenfiddich Project XX Experiment Series
bodyHtml:
With its deep golden hue, Project XX embodies the warm, fruity character of a classic Glenfiddich with hints of apple blossom, summer fruits and ripe pear. Its multiple personalities are revealed with hints of sweet candy floss, cinnamon spice, almonds and rich port tannins with the odd whisper of liquorice. Deep and mellow, the finish is long lasting with a lingering sweet oakiness.

Their second experiment of the series took place privately at their Conval warehouse. Shrouded in secrecy, Malt Master Brian Kinsman invited 20 whisky experts from around the world to select any expression of their choosing from thousands of stacked casks. The final 20 chosen malts, matured in everything from port pipes to virgin bourbon barrels, have created an unusual, untraditional and unexpected whisky, one that has exceeded even their expectations.

title: Arran 'The Bothy' Quarter Cask
bodyHtml:
This single malt Scotch whisky was selected by Arran for the fourth batch of The Bothy series. It was initially matured in first-fill ex-Bourbon barrels before being transferred for secondary maturation into American oak smaller casks for a minimum of 18 months. It was bottled at a natural cask strength 56.2% ABV without chill-filtration or additional colouring.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Old Pulteney 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: Matured in ex-bourbon casks for 12 years, this Old Pulteney malt was a Double Gold winner at the 2006 San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

title: Gran Emotivo Rosso 2021
bodyHtml: An Italian gem! Flavours of ripe fruits, such as plums and raisins with pleasant notes of spices and vanilla. Rich and bold palate with very ripe, red fruit flavours. A solid structure and beautiful balance between soft tannins and lifted acidity. This is a great wine for roasts, red meats and hard cheese.

title: Remy Martin VSOP Cognac
bodyHtml:
Rémy Martin VSOP is a distinguished Fine Champagne Cognac, representing a harmonious blend of eaux-de-vie sourced exclusively from the Grande Champagne and Petite Champagne crus. This expression embodies the Cellar Master's art of blending, resulting in a cognac renowned for its balance of powerful and elegant aromas.

Tasting Notes:

  • Aroma: An aromatic harmony of powerful elegance with notes of vanilla, dried apricot, and candied pear.

  • Palate: A balance of aromatic dried fruits and delicate liquorice, offering a complex flavor experience.

  • Finish: Structured and layered, with a rounded harmony of dried fruits, providing a satisfying mouthfeel and silky texture.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Neat: Enjoy at room temperature to fully appreciate its aromatic richness and depth.

  • On the Rocks: Serving over ice enhances its smoothness and reveals additional layers of flavor.

  • Cocktails: Versatile in mixology, Rémy Martin VSOP elevates classic cocktails such as the Rémy Ginger, showcasing its elegance and fruity aromas.

title: Roberto Voerzio Barbera d'Alba Riserva Pozzo dell'Annunziata 2012 - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml: Voerzio's 2012 Barbera d'Alba Riserva Vigneto Pozzo dell'Annunziata is dark, polished and inviting. Dark cherry, plum, smoke, licorice, menthol and new leather meld together in an intense, ample wine that delivers considerable intensity and power. As time goes by and cask gradually replaces barriques here and elsewhere, French oak-aged Barbera seems to stick out more and more.

title: Canadian Club Barley Batch
bodyHtml:
Canadian Club celebrated its 160th birthday in 2018 with this limited edition release. In this unique and flavourful expression, an aged malted barley whisky has been blended with Canadian Club Original 1858. This brings the toasted grain character of barley to the foreground, supported by notes of molasses, plum and oak.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Castellare Chianti Classico 2024
bodyHtml:
Castellare di Castellina Chianti Classico originates from Italy, within the Tuscany region and the heart of the Chianti Classico DOCG zone near the village of Castellina in Chianti. Founded in 1977 through the merger of four estates by Paolo Panerai, Castellare is renowned for its steadfast commitment to native Tuscan grape varieties and environmental conservation. The vineyard plots sit at high altitudes (around 350 to 400 meters) on natural amphitheater slopes featuring limestone-marl (albarese) soils. Instantly recognizable by its iconic label featuring rare native birds—symbolizing the estate's strict prohibition of synthetic chemicals—Castellare’s winemaking philosophy fuses organic integrity, high-elevation freshness, and classical Tuscan Sangiovese character.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a luminous, translucent ruby-red appearance in the glass with subtle garnet highlights toward the rim. It possesses a medium-bodied, linear, and elegantly structured profile defined by a silky, fluid, and mouth-refreshing texture. The sensory profile is fragrant, precise, and classic, opening with an inviting bouquet of fresh red cherries, wild raspberries, and tart red plums, interwoven with delicate secondary aromas of dried violets, wild thyme, leather, cedar, and crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it delivers a focused, energetic core of crunchy red fruit balanced by a bright, mouthwatering thread of natural acidity and fine-grained, firm tannins. The finish is remarkably clean, dry, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of licorice, savory herbs, and sour cherry.

  • Varietal Composition: 90% Sangioveto (the traditional local name for Sangiovese) and 10% Canaiolo. Notably, Castellare strictly excludes international varieties like Cabernet Sauvignon or Merlot from its Chianti Classico.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes are hand-harvested from high-altitude hillside plots. Fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats with traditional maceration on the skins. The wine undergoes aging for approximately 7 to 12 months in used French oak barrels (barriques and tonneaux) to soften tannins while preserving pure varietal aromatics and vibrant freshness, followed by several months of bottle maturation.

  • ABV: Typically 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: Produced using organic and eco-friendly viticultural methods with zero synthetic pesticides, herbicides, or systemic fungicides to protect local bird species, though this standard bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant natural acidity, firm tannic structure, and bright red fruit profile of Castellare Chianti Classico make it a quintessential partner for classic Tuscan and Italian cuisine.

  • Meats & Pasta: Pairs magnificently with traditional Tuscan dishes like Tagliatelle al Ragù di Chianina, herb-crusted grilled pork chops, pan-seared veal cutlets, or roasted chicken with rosemary.

  • Italian Classics: Ideal alongside stone-baked margherita or prosciutto pizza, eggplant parmesan, and charcuterie boards with Prosciutto di Parma and Finocchiona salami.

  • Earthy Dishes: Complements mushroom risottos, pasta with porcini sauce, and Tuscan white bean stews with sage and olive oil.

  • Cheeses: Matches gracefully with medium-aged Italian cheeses such as Pecorino Toscano, young Parmigiano-Reggiano, or Fontina.

title: Ad Libitum Tempranillo Blanco 2024
bodyHtml: The Tempranillo Blanco variety genetically coincides 97% with the Tempranillo Tinto variety. The leaves and the shape of the grape cluster are identical, as is its sensitivity to diseases and pests. Both varieties have short ripening cycles, which allows them to be grown in any subarea of Rioja, even in areas where ripening is later. The vineyards of Tempranillo Blanco have a medium-high vigour and an average yield of 6,000 kg of grapes per hectare. The bunches of grapes are small in size and of low average weight.

title: Masi Campofiorin 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: This is the original Super-venetian created by Masi in 1964, an internationally recognized of stupendous body and complexity. This red blend is full bodied, smooth and velvety, but approachable and versatile in its food pairings.

title: Zuidam Cassis Liqueur
bodyHtml: A very tasty blackcurrant liqueur from the exciting and versatile Zuidam distillery. This Dutch dram is made with natural blackcurrant flavourings, and has a thick, viscous mouthfeel. Cassis offers up notes of sweet blackcurrant, slight dried fruits, blackberries and jammy plum.

title: Cristom Pinot Noir Jessie Vineyard 2022
bodyHtml:
Vintage after vintage, Cristom produces top-quality wines, no matter how easy or challenging the elements make it. This consistency is a testament to the deep knowledge of the vineyard, the respect for the land, and a light touch in the cellar. Recognized globally as a leading producer in the beloved Willamette Valley, their wines continue to be a unique blend of tradition, modernity and finesse.

Aromatically the wine has notes of red berry fruits, Chinese five-spice, dried flowers, and damp topsoil. On the palate, it is juicy with a combination of ripened of black and red fruits, warm spices, rose petals, and youthful tannins.

title: Domaine Thenard Givry Premier Cru Clos Saint Pierre 2022
bodyHtml:
Domaine Thenard Givry Premier Cru Clos Saint Pierre hails from France, situated in the Côte Chalonnaise sub-region of Burgundy. The Thenard family has a rich winemaking heritage in Givry dating back to the 1700s, crafting traditional expressions of Pinot Noir with minimalist intervention and long-standing ancestral techniques. The Clos Saint Pierre vineyard is an exclusive monopole of the estate, perched high on the slope with ideal exposure that yields red fruit elegance and signature minerality.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir presents a vibrant ruby color in the glass. On the nose, it offers an inviting array of fresh red cherries and crushed berries accented by earthy undertones and subtle kitchen spices. The palate is focused, pure, and medium-bodied, balancing concentrated red fruit flavors with refined tannins, crisp acidity, and a distinct mineral tension. Matured in a combination of oak barrels and large traditional foudres, it closes with a long, fresh, and complex finish.

title: Jack Daniel's Winter Jack - 750 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: A seasonal blend of apple cider liqueur, Jack Daniel's Old No. 7 Tennessee Whiskey and holiday spices. Best served warm. Enticing aromas of apple cider, orange peel, cinnamon and Jack Daniel's. Reminiscent flavours of apple pie with a toasted oak and vanilla finish.

title: The Pinot Noir Project 2021
bodyHtml: The Pinot Project has reached its goal of becoming one of California's best red wine values. Handcrafted from high-quality Sonoma County, Monterey, and Central Coast vineyards. Cool garnet in color with aromas of pomegranate and fresh roses, this Pinot Noir is balanced on the palate with notes of black cherry and five spice with a smooth, lingering finish.

title: Summerhill Baco Noir 2022
bodyHtml: Deep red with balanced acidity and intense flavours. Very smooth and hearty with notes of chocolate, tobacco, blackberry, black currant and integrated oak.

title: Borgogno Langhe Nebbiolo 2021
bodyHtml: Made of Nebbiolo, this Langhe is sort of a baby Barolo. Aged for 10 months in Slavonian oak barrels, it doesn't disappoint, thanks to its aromatic intensity as well as its rich and harmonious palate. Its aromatic profile evokes dried rose, cigar box, licorice, cherry, and nutmeg.

title: Chop Shop Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Chop Shop is produced under the Winc/ABG Wines portfolio, a company dedicated to crafting expressive, approachable, and food-friendly wines. The winemaking philosophy centres on the belief that wine should be easy to enjoy any time, sourcing fruit from trusted California growers and employing thoughtful techniques to maintain the varietal's integrity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep ruby appearance with a garnet rim. On the nose, it is rich and expressive, offering notes of ripe blackcurrant, blackberry, and cherry, layered with hints of vanilla, cocoa, toasted oak, dried herbs, and a whisper of spice. It is a full-bodied Cabernet Sauvignon with a smooth, approachable texture on the palate. Flavours of dark berries are dominant, balanced by undertones of plum, dark chocolate, and a touch of black pepper.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include smoky barbecue ribs, juicy burgers, or grilled steak, as the wine’s bold flavours and dry finish complement savoury, umami-rich dishes.

title: Pievalta Perlugo Zero (NV)
bodyHtml: A distinctive classic-method sparkling wine made with Verdicchio grapes. On the nose, aromatic herbs, Helichrysum, and almond mallow; flavorful and lingering in the mouth.

title: Zuidam Oude Genever Gin - 1 Litre
bodyHtml:
This genever is made from a malt-wine produced from a triple-distillation of equal parts corn, rye, and malted barley. Part of it is then distilled a fourth time with botanicals including juniper, licorice and aniseed. These two components are then blended and aged in 200-liter, new American oak barrels for 3 years. These are single-barrel releases and is sold at 38% ABV in Europe, primarily in the Netherlands and Germany.

Made with a base of “malt wine” (essentially a grain eau de vie), and flavoured with botanicals, Genever can be thought of as gin’s weird older sibling. This particular offering is made with a mashbill of equal parts rye, corn and malted barley. The mixed grains ensure a base which is at once spicy, sweet and textured. The grains are milled by traditional windmills, with this method of processing ensuring the cereals stay cool and retain their subtle flavours and aromas. This Genever has been distilled in traditional pot stills, and flavoured with a secret blend of herbs and spices, including juniper, liquorice and aniseed. This spirit is then aged in oak casks for a time, producing a complex and characterful final product.

Zuidam Oude Genever serves up flavours of bittersweet juniper, forest floor, vanilla, earthy spice, cracked black pepper, liquorice root and star anise. A fascinating spirit, this Genever is best sipped neat, but would work wonderfully in cocktails.

title: Domaine Clavel Copa Santa Red Wine 2015
bodyHtml: The nose feels equally dense with bold, concentrated and rather sweet aromas of blueberries, ripe blackberries, some strawberries, a little bit of peppery spice, a hint of inky character and a touch of jammy red fruits. The wine is full-bodied, concentrated and rather powerful on the palate, with flavours of very ripe dark berries, blackcurrants, brambly blackberries, some bitter stony minerality and a hint of inky character. The wine is quite structured with moderately grippy tannins and a rather high acidity, contributing to the wine's chewy texture.

title: Barone Pizzini Franciacorta Rose 2019
bodyHtml:
From its origins until today the work of Barone Pizzini has followed a path marked by sustainability, to produce wines that represent the territory in which they are born.  With over twenty years of practicing organic viticulture, these attentions are not directed only to the vineyard, but to all the steps in the winemaking process and to the impact on the environment. Their approach to organic farming is global, and concerns all factors: from agricultural methods to the bio-architecture of the cellar, designed to fit harmoniously into the context of Franciacorta.  

Made from grapes grown in vineyards that lie on the edge of the woods, this sensual and idyllic expression of Pinot Noir is transformed into notes of underbrush, currant, and blueberry together with hints of black cherry in the glass. The structure and balance of this wine are interwoven in a lingering tension between its rich flavor and acidity.  80% Pinot Noir, 20% Chardonnay.  Ideal with main courses, fish, white meats, cheeses and salami.

title: Foradori Teroldego Sgarzon Vigneti delle Dolomiti IGT 2019
bodyHtml:
Forodori's Sgarzon is made of 100% Teroldego, a grape that produces bold-but-juicy red wine with notes of blackberries, sweet anise, orange peel, and sweet tobacco smoke. 

“Sgarzon” literally means shoot in the Campo Rotaliano. The vines that grow in the Sgarzon vineyard are particularly active and benefit from the cooler climate that characterizes this site. Teroldego’s character changes, it is enriched with an unusual freshness. The eight months spent in amphorae (Tinajas from Villarrobledo, Spain), with skin contact preserves and intensifies the diversity. Together with the Morei vineyard, Sgarzon noticeably expresses the great variability that this variety can express.

title: Morgan Bay Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
This dry and purplish red colored red showcases a complex Nose releasing woody, spicy and fruity scents.

You will be charmed with this medium-bodied wine revealing a broad texture, fleshy tannins and a medium Finish.

title: Pasquiers Grenache Cinsault Rose 2023
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: This luscious and textural blend is very much a food wine. Rich currant flavours provided by Grenache and tangy raspberry and spice from Cinsault before a dry and fresh finish. Pair with pasta dishes, barbecues and grilled chicken salads.

title: Henry of Pelham Baco Noir Speck Family Reserve 2023
bodyHtml: Baco Noir is grown virtually exclusively in Canada, and Henry of Pelham is home to some of the very best expressions. This example is concentrated and generously flavoured, with dancing floral and smoky dark fruit supported by fresh rye bread, and black olive richness. This wants big meaty meals, think barbecued flank steak, bison burgers or lamb kebabs.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '45' Nigori Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Asahi Shuzo, this is the cloudy or unfiltered version of the brewery's world-famous Dassai 45 flagship sake. As with all sakes in the Dassai lineup, it is a Junmai Daiginjo, crafted using 100% top-grade Yamada Nishiki rice polished down to 45% of its original size. While many nigori sakes are known for being heavy or rustic, this expression is celebrated for maintaining the premium elegance and refined character for which the Dassai brand is globally recognized.

Description

This nigori sake presents a milky, off-white appearance due to the presence of fine rice solids (sake lees). The nose is aromatic and delicate, featuring scents of cream, rose water, muscat grape, and Japanese chestnuts. On the palate, it offers a soft and supple texture that is lighter and more graceful than many other cloudy sakes. It strikes a beautiful balance between juicy fruit notes of apple, pear, and melon and a mellow sweetness reminiscent of almond and honey. The finish is remarkably clean and refreshing, lacking the cloying heaviness often associated with the nigori style. ABV 13.5%–16% depending on the specific bottling.

Food Pairing

The creamy mouthfeel and fruit-forward profile of Dassai 45 Nigori make it an excellent partner for rich or spicy dishes where the rice solids can help soothe the palate. It is a fantastic match for Southeast Asian cuisine such as Pad Thai or tandoori chicken, as well as spicy Mexican fare. For a more Western-style pairing, try it alongside strawberry cheesecake, creamy pasta dishes, or a variety of soft and hard cheeses. It is best served well-chilled and should be gently turned (not shaken) before pouring to incorporate the rice sediment.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Mandarin Mikan No Osake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Nakano Shuzo, a brewery founded in 1844, this vibrant liqueur belongs to the "fruilia" series, which emphasizes the pure and rich flavors of domestic Japanese fruits. Mikan No Osake (meaning "Mandarin Orange Drink") is crafted with a exceptionally high concentration of real fruit—often containing up to 80% all-natural Japanese mandarin orange juice. This series represents the brewery’s mastery in blending traditional sake-making techniques with the fresh, approachable profiles of modern fruit liqueurs.

Description

This liqueur is clear with a bright golden-orange hue. The nose is an intense burst of fresh-squeezed citrus, featuring dominant aromas of mandarin orange peel and orange blossom, complemented by sweet notes of passion fruit and white flower honey. On the palate, it delivers a rich, juicy, and velvety texture that mimics the experience of biting into a perfectly ripe mikan. Flavours are sweet and vivid, showcasing spiced cantaloupe and tangy mandarin pulp with no artificial additives or colors. The finish is remarkably natural, refreshing, and crisp. ABV 7%–7.5%.

Food Pairing

The high fruit content and vibrant acidity of Mikan No Osake make it a versatile pairing for both savory and sweet dishes. It is a fantastic companion for spicy Thai food or shrimp with mayonnaise, as the citrus helps cut through spice and richness. For a unique vegetable pairing, try it with a carrot râpée. It is also widely enjoyed as a dessert topping for vanilla ice cream or shaved ice (kakigori). This liqueur is best served well-chilled, either neat, over ice, or mixed with soda water to create a refreshing "Mikan Spritz".

title: J Bouchon Sauvignon Blanc Reserva 2023
bodyHtml: Clean, bright pale yellow with some green hues. The nose is a pleasant freshness with aromas of citrus and tropical fruits. The palate confirms the nose, very fresh, tropical with grapefruit acidity. Body is long enough until your next sip.

title: Tridente Tempranillo 2021
bodyHtml:
Tridente is located in Castilla y Leon and is a 100% Tempranillo which has matured for 15 months in French oak. The Tempranillo grapes used to produce this wine come from very old vines with very little production in the areas of Villanueva de Campeán and El Pego, in the province of Zamora. These vineyards were planted a long time ago on a top layer of gravel with sandy soils so the vines have to work. The fermentation is carried out in stainless steel tanks and then the wine matures for about 15 months in French oak barrels.

On the nose, you will smell aromas of toasted oak, graphite, balsamic, incense and black fruit. On the palate, the wine is medium-to-full bodied and has a firm finish with some toasted bread and nuts in the finish.

title: Clyde May's Alabama Whiskey
bodyHtml: Clyde May's is an Alabama-style whiskey made in Kentucky. Made with a bourbon mash bill of 55% corn, 30% rye and 15% barley, this is aged five to six years in charred American oak barrels. The Alabama style comes from adding apple juice, resulting in hints of apple and cinnamon.

title: De Bortoli Emeri Sparkling Pink Moscato
bodyHtml:
A lot of fun, light in alcohol (8%), cheerful hues, pretty musk and rose petal fragrances, creamy texture packed with bubbles and lively strawberry flavors. The perfect aperitif on it's own or enjoy with fresh fruits or seafood.

88 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Fresh, floral aromas lead the way on this wine, backed by flavors of berries and spice. The moderate alcohol level and balance of sweetness and acidity make this easy to drink.

title: Spier Chenin Blanc '21 Gables' 2021
bodyHtml: Made with thick-skinned grapes from old vines, this full-bodied Chenin Blanc was fermented and matured for 14 months in French oak barrels. It offers ripe, baked apples and apple pie spice on the nose. The rich and complex palate is characterized by yellow fruits, opulent caramel, vanilla cream and toasted cashew all framed by beautifully balanced acidity and supported by a sumptuously textured mouthfeel.

title: Lab Red Wine 2023
bodyHtml: Very aromatic with notes of ripe black and red fruits. On the palate, juicy plums and dark berry fruit flavour with plenty of fresh yet fine tannins that take over at the finish, along with flavours of spice and licorice.

title: Gekkeikan Traditional Junmai Sake - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Japan (Kyoto) and USA (California). Founded in 1637 by Jiemon Okura in the Fushimi district of Kyoto, Gekkeikan is one of the world's oldest and most iconic sake breweries. The brand name translates to "Crown of Laurel," a symbol of victory and glory adopted in 1905. While the brewery is deeply rooted in 14 generations of Japanese heritage, this "Traditional" expression is also brewed in Folsom, California, using American water and ingredients to cater specifically to the North American market while maintaining authentic quality standards.

Description

This signature Junmai is a classic, versatile sake known for its balanced and approachable profile. In the glass, it is clear and light-bodied. The nose is surprisingly bright, featuring aromas of fresh green apples, sweet banana, and juicy apricot, accented by hints of custard and a light earthiness. On the palate, it is smooth and mellow with a herbaceous character and notes of grapefruit and minerals. It offers a clean, well-balanced acidity and a gentle umami undertone that leads into a crisp, dry finish. As a Junmai-shu, it is brewed purely from rice, water, yeast, and koji with no added alcohol. ABV 14.6%–15.6%.

Food Pairing

Gekkeikan Traditional is celebrated for its exceptional versatility at various temperatures. Its clean, dry profile makes it an ideal match for classic Japanese fare such as sushi, sashimi, and tempura. It also pairs remarkably well with more robust dishes, including grilled yakitori, roasted meats, and coconut-based Asian curries. For a unique combination, try it alongside mature cheeses or mushroom risotto to highlight its earthy umami. It can be served chilled (highlighting fruit notes), at room temperature, or warmed (enhancing body and acidity).

title: Paul Mas Valmont Languedoc Roussillon Rouge 2024 - 1 Litre
bodyHtml: Paul Mas wines are the result of symbiotic harmony between an extraordinary region for producing wines, passion for the vineyard, respect for the grapes during vinification, and great blending and aging knowledge: the Paul Mas style. Aromas of blackcurrant, cherry, green pepper, violet.

title: Laurent Miquel Vendanges Nocturnes Rose 2025
bodyHtml: Elegant pale pink colour. Fresh raspberry aromas and a hint of citrus. Crisp on the palate with a soft fruity finish. A fresh and delicate wine that will pair well with salads and barbecues.

title: Castell'in Villa Chianti Classico 2020
bodyHtml:
Castell'in Villa's property was purchased by Princess Coralia Pignatelli della Leonessa and her spouse in 1968. The estate, which is located in the southern portion of the Chianti Classico area, is famed for producing some of Italy's most traditional and age-worthy wines. However, it took a step further to set itself apart from other producers by gradually releasing stocks into the market after they were declared ready to drink. Consumers can now enjoy superb wines that have reached a specific level of maturity as a result of this process.

Castell'in Villa is known for its superb Chianti Classico and Chianti Classico Riserva (100 percent Sangiovese) wines, as well as a delicate Super-Tuscan "Santacroce" combination of Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon.

title: Inniskillin Ice Wine 50 ml Mini - 3 x 50 ml Bottles
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in Canada, this luxury collection originates from the Niagara Peninsula in Ontario, a region renowned for its optimal icewine conditions. Inniskillin, Canada's first estate winery, was founded in 1975 by Donald Ziraldo and Karl Kaiser after they were granted the first winery licence since Prohibition. The winery's philosophy is defined by a commitment to extreme winemaking, leaving grapes on the vine into the frigid winter months to naturally concentrate sugars and acids. Inniskillin gained international prominence in 1991 when its Vidal Icewine won the Grand Prix d'Honneur at Vinexpo in France, a pivotal moment that placed Canadian wine on the global map.

Wine Description

This variety pack offers a curated tasting experience of three distinct premium icewines, each presenting a unique sensory profile:

  • Vidal Icewine: A golden-hued wine with a thick skin that thrives in late harvests. It features luscious tropical aromas of mango and lychee, balanced by a rich palate of peach and orange with a crisp acidity.

  • Riesling Icewine: A classic vinifera expression defined by its elegance and high natural acidity. It offers intense aromas of apricot, lemongrass, and honeydew melon, with lively citrus flavours of lemon and lime on the palate.

  • Cabernet Franc Icewine: A rare red icewine with a deep colour derived entirely from pressing rather than skin contact. It displays robust juicy aromas of strawberry, raspberry, and rhubarb, mirrored by a concentrated red-berry palate.

title: Bearface Elementally Aged Triple Oak
bodyHtml:
BEARFACE Elementally Aged Triple Oak is a Canadian whisky that undergoes a unique maturation process involving three distinct types of oak casks, resulting in a complex and flavorful profile.

Production Process

  1. Initial Aging: The whisky begins with a 7-year maturation in ex-bourbon American oak barrels, imparting foundational flavors of honey, butter, and vanilla.

  2. Secondary Maturation: It is then aged in French oak red wine casks, which contribute notes of dried fruits and a rich, reddish hue.

  3. Final Finishing: The final stage involves air-dried virgin Hungarian oak casks, toasted to three different levels, adding unique spice characteristics and a gentle smokiness.

This process, termed "Elemental Aging," involves maturing the whisky in repurposed shipping containers exposed to the Canadian wilderness, allowing the extreme climate to influence the interaction between the whisky and the wood.

Tasting Notes

  • Nose: Aromas of crème brûlée, vanilla custard, and black currants, offering a rich and inviting scent.

  • Palate: Flavors of maple sugar candy, light milk chocolate, and a hint of raspberry, delivering a sweet and silky mouthfeel.

  • Finish: A lingering sweetness with subtle spice, dark cherry, and maple syrup notes, reminiscent of a dessert in a glass.

title: Cabo Wabo Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: Colourless, but full of flavour. Enough spice to give a kick, but goes down so clean, you'll want another. Cabo Blanco is pure, no-holds-barred, Thick Cut tequila. They turn 100% Weber Blue Agave into tequila the way it was meant to be, with full on agave you can taste. It's never influenced by barrel wood, only by hard work, passion and dedication without apology.

title: Adelsheim Pinot Noir Willamette Valley 2022
bodyHtml: With its broad array of origins and clones, this Pinot noir displays aromas of cocoa, pomegranate, and raspberry on the nose and the palate as well as a light touch of nutmeg, cinnamon, and allspice. True to our house style, it is elegantly textured with seamlessly integrated, silky, polished tannin.

title: Adelsheim Chardonnay 2019
bodyHtml:
The United States is the country of origin for this wine, hailing from Oregon in the Willamette Valley region and Chehalem Mountains subregion. Founded in 1971 by David and Ginny Adelsheim, Adelsheim Vineyard stands as a true pioneer of Oregon winemaking. The winery is dedicated to sustainable viticulture and cool-climate winemaking, aiming to showcase the expressive, high-elevation terroir of its estate vineyards through minimal intervention and precise craftsmanship.

Wine Description

Adelsheim Chardonnay 2019 displays a brilliant pale lemon gold colour in the glass. The intricate bouquet reveals aromas of fresh orchard fruits like green apple and crisp pear, layered with honeysuckle, lemon oil, toasted almond, and subtle flinty minerality. On the medium bodied palate, this 100% Chardonnay delivers sleek elegance and a rounded texture, balanced by vibrant, snappy acidity and delicate sea salt notes through a fresh, persistent finish. Crafted with a commitment to purity and balance, it offers a Burgundian freshness and refined structure. The optimal drinking window spans from present drinking through 2028.

Food Pairing

This bright and expressive Chardonnay pairs wonderfully with pan seared halibut, sautéed garlic shrimp, roasted poultry, or soft cheeses.

A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 vintage in the Willamette Valley was a cool, traditional Oregon growing season with late-summer rains that challenged harvest timelines. Thanks to attentive vineyard care and disciplined harvesting decisions, the winemakers successfully captured grapes with brilliant natural acidity, modest alcohol, and intense aromatic clarity.

title: Feudi di San Gregorio Rosato 2023
bodyHtml: A Rose of the southern Italian grape Aglianico from Irpinia, hand picked, de-stemmed and treated to a 12-hour maceration. The wine aged for four months in stainless steel prior to release. The result is a medium salmon colour with a peppery, flowery, saline aspect. The body has more tannic structure than expected, and overall the wine feels serious and quiet. Whereas much Rose is meant to partner with the fresh, raw, and youthful, this one works with savoury fare, especially aged and washed-rind cheeses, rare meat, dark poultry.

title: Layer Cake Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
Layer Cake works directly with the farmers that grow their grapes to exacting standards in some of the most diversely-layered vineyards around the world. They are handpicked, separated and fermented with care, then aged in French Oak. The character of each Layer Cake wine is influenced by the vineyard soil, which is layered like a cake…every layer tells a story.

The Layer Cake Pinot Noir comes to life with aromas of savoury herbs, licorice, mint, plums and black cherries. Layered flavours of dark berries, ripe plums and big juicy black cherries wrapped in a glycerol creamy mouthfeel.

title: Trentham Estate Shiraz 2018
bodyHtml: Dark vibrant red in colour with lifted aromas of black cherry and chocolate. On the palate concentrated dark fruit flavours are complimented by subtle oak characters of mocha and spice. Full bodied and well-structured with firm ripe tannins providing balance and length. Excellent match with any grilled red meat, slow cooked lamb shoulder or a rich saucy casserole.

title: La Vie en Rose 2024
bodyHtml: La Vie en Rose is a beautifully elegant wine with packaging to match. A lovely pink rose petal colour. A very fresh nose deliciously scented with raspberry aromas. Complex and tasty in the mouth with notes of cherry and grenadine. and a fleeting brush of subtle, spicy wood, this is a supremely balanced, savoury food-friendly wine.

title: Glendalough Wild Botanical Irish Gin
bodyHtml: This extraordinary gin is produced with wild plants that are sustainably foraged each day in the mountains, then slowly distilled in small batches. The unique combination of botanicals including elderflower, clover and bell heather creates a complex yet mellow gin that turns a simple martini into a symphony of flavour.

title: Lamb's Palm Breeze Rum (Plastic Bottle)
bodyHtml:
Alfred Lamb produced his fine products in the tradition of the greatest Caribbean rums, using only the finest sugar cane. Lamb’s Palm Breeze Amber Rum continues the tradition to this date. 

Aroma: Natural sweet cane and butter-rum. 

Taste: Complex blend of sweet island spice and molasses with subtle oak. Finish: Warm and lingering spicy dry finish.

title: Weszeli Gruner Veltliner Langenlois 2024
bodyHtml:
The Weszeli Gruner Veltliner Langenlois is a vibrant expression of the Kamptal region in Austria. Weingut Weszeli, with a tradition dating back to 1679, is currently under the leadership of Davis Weszeli, who follows a 'Terrafactum' philosophy. This approach focuses on the vineyard as a living ecosystem, utilizing biodynamic and organic farming practices to support the balance of flora and fauna.

Wine Description

This wine presents a crisp and refreshing sensory profile characterized by a bright, medium body and a zesty finish. On the nose, it offers an inviting bouquet of grapefruit, lemon pith, and white peach, accented by notes of meadow herbs and a hint of white pepper. The palate is taut and elegant, delivering flavors of lime, Granny Smith apple, and a distinct chalky minerality derived from the local loess soils.

Food Pairing

The high acidity and mineral-driven profile of this Gruner Veltliner make it exceptionally versatile at the table. It pairs beautifully with fresh oysters, goat cheese salads, and classic Austrian dishes like Wiener Schnitzel. Its spicy undertones also allow it to complement Asian-fusion cuisine, particularly Thai dishes featuring lemongrass and ginger.

title: Boutinot Les Coteaux Cotes du Rhone Villages 2023
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Instantly appealing tones of warm fully ripe southern Rhône fruit, lifted by nuances of oak, flow into layers of supple and smooth textures and roll forward to a full-flavoured sumptuous finish.

title: Astobiza Txakoli 2024
bodyHtml: The Astobiza Txakoli comes from the upper reach of the Alava zone at about 650 feet above sea level. Nestled within the rolling hills of the Basque country, the local varietals are adapted to the continental climate with a heavy Atlantic influence. The local grapes called Ondarrabi Zuri were hand harvested into small baskets from the organically farmed estate vines and after a cold and slow fermentation, the wine was kept in stainless steel until it was bottled as the estate’s flagship wine. This white wine has delicious and brightly fresh ripe fruit while retaining the classic brilliant acidity that Txakoli has always been known for. Aromas of white pear, young peach, green apple, and fresh grapefruit lead to an extremely fresh palate that is balanced with minerality, acidity, and persistence.

title: Dusted Valley Boomtown Pinot Gris 2022
bodyHtml: Crisp and refreshing with notes of pink apple flavours make the Pinot Gris your go-to white wine that’s right for any occasion. Goes well with creamy pastas or smoked foods.

title: Di Majo Norante Sangiovese 2021
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from the Molise region of Italy, specifically the Terre degli Osci subregion. Di Majo Norante has been producing wine since the 19th century, with a history rooted in the ancient cellars of Campomarino. The winery is currently led by Alessio Di Majo, who maintains a philosophy centered on traditional, bio-organic viticulture and the preservation of Mediterranean winemaking characteristics.

Wine Description

The Sangiovese presents a rich profile with a deep ruby colour and an aromatic nose featuring ripe plums, cherries, blueberries, and subtle notes of vanilla. On the palate, the wine is full bodied, offering a chalky and powdery texture complemented by sweet spice on the finish.

title: The Fableist Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
The Fableist is a collaboration between winemakers Curt Schalchlin and Andrew Jones. Curt, owner and vintner of the heralded winery Sans Liege, is known for his critically acclaimed Rhone varietal wines. Andrew, winemaker of Field Recordings, spends his days planning and planting vineyards and has stood foot in just about every vineyard on the Central Coast. Together, they produce The Fableist, a collaboration that gives special attention to the craft and story behind each wine.

Each bottle has been artfully designed and inspired by one of Aesop’s many fables. Just as each of his timeless vignettes has a moral, they believe that every blend has its own story to tell, its own lessons to teach. There’s something profound about wine as it can inspire, bring loved ones together, fill hearts with warmth. As you enjoy each glass, they hope these stories spark a desire to ponder what really matters in life and may they encourage you to find the wisdom within yourself.

Vibrant black currant, cedar and vanilla hit your tongue, as you're warmed by the comforts blackberries and cherries. A strong finish wraps you in a fond embrace.

title: Villa Wolf Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
Germany is the world’s third largest producer of Pinot Noir, after France and the U.S. Villa Wolf captures the German style perfectly with medium bodied aromas and flavors of ripe black plums, raspberries, shortbread and hint of spice. The emphasis is on juicy fruit, not oak. 

Drinks like a Beaujolais with true Pinot Noir character, a perfect foil for poultry and pork dishes.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Obaachan's Yuzu - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Established in 1844, Nakano Sake Brewery is a historic producer located on the Chita Peninsula that specializes in fusing traditional Edo period craftsmanship with innovative technology. The brewery is highly regarded for its expertise in creating elegant fruit based beverages, utilizing high quality ingredients to produce sakes that are respected both locally and internationally.

Description

This vibrant yuzushu features a yellow, cloudy appearance from the use of all natural Japanese yuzu juice. The nose is aromatic and refreshing, bursting with citrus scents of lemon, white grapefruit, and mandarin orange. On the palate, it offers a well balanced profile of sweet and tart acidity with a touch of umami richness that mellows the sharp citrus qualities. The body is smooth and creamy, finishing with a pleasant kiss of peel bitterness and a lingering zesty savor. ABV 7.5%.

Food Pairing

The bright acidity and sweet citrus notes of this yuzu sake make it an ideal companion for sushi, sashimi, and spicy donburi dishes. It also pairs effectively with heavier summer fare such as octopus ceviche, Kalua pork, or spicy dry rub barbecue, where the citrus acts as a natural flavour enhancer. For a unique treat, serve it chilled or on the rocks alongside fresh fruit salads or drizzle it over vanilla ice cream and fruit tarts.

title: Grange Philippe Gipsy Rose 2021
bodyHtml: Wine with a deep pink color, exuding floral and red fruit notes. Bold and round, it lines the palate before ending on a smooth finish without bitterness.

title: Dusted Valley Boomtown Chardonnay 2019
bodyHtml: This beautifully crisp, clean Chardonnay was fermented in a stainless steel tank to preserve the bright fruit characters. The Boomtown is an excellent choice for poultry, salads, and cream-based pasta dishes.

title: Monte Creek Hands Up White 2024
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Canada, specifically the Thompson Valley subregion within the British Columbia interior. Monte Creek Winery is a family owned estate known for its commitment to regenerative agriculture and sustainable viticulture, holding certifications such as Salmon Safe and Biosphere Committed. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on minimal intervention and holistic farming to produce high quality wines that accurately represent the unique terroir of the South Thompson valley.

Wine Description

The Hands Up White is a vibrant, off dry blend typically composed of Frontenac Blanc, La Crescent, and Riesling. In the glass, it displays a bright, pale straw colour, leading to a fragrant nose filled with tropical aromas of pineapple and mango, alongside notes of ripe pear and wild sage. The palate is crisp and medium bodied, offering a slight viscosity balanced by a refreshing cool climate acidity that carries through to a long, clean finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile white wine is an ideal companion for a variety of bright and fresh dishes, such as summer salads, curry dishes, or seafood croquettes. It also pairs beautifully with roasted chicken served with fennel and carrots or a platter of fresh oysters.

title: Belvedere Vodka - 3 Litre Bottle (No Light)
bodyHtml:
The world's first super premium vodka, Belvedere, represents the pinnacle of the Polish vodka-making tradition. Belvedere Vodka is the true expression of luxury vodka, which is distilled exclusively from the finest Dankowskie Gold Rye and quadruple distilled to create the perfect balance of character and purity. Completely additive-free and diluted with water from Belvedere's own artesian well, this vodka combines over 600 years of vodka-producing expertise with an uncompromising commitment to quality and heritage. Nose: Faint hint of vanilla along with gentle characteristics of soft cream. Palate: Full and round with a medium body and a naturally smooth, rich, velvety texture. Some light vanilla notes swaying between sweet and savoury, with a hint of white pepper and spice. Finish: Good length with notes of almond, clotted cream, and some faint Brazil nut characteristics.
