PLEASE NOTE: THIS PRODUCT DOES NOT COME WITH A LIGHT, AS ALBERTA LIQUOR AND GAMING  COMMISSION DEEM THIS TO BE A HAZARD AND REMOVE IT BEFORE SHIPPING.

title: Uma Malbec 2024
bodyHtml: Varietal aromas of red fruits, cherries and plums. Barrel ageing provided good intensity and delicate smoky bouquet. Persistent and balanced palate, easy to drink.

title: Yoshi No Gawa Kome Dake No Sake 'Classic' Junmai Sake- 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in Japan, this authentic Junmai sake originates from the Niigata prefecture, a region celebrated for its pristine water and premium rice. Yoshi No Gawa, founded in 1548, stands as the oldest sake brewery in the renowned Niigata region and represents over 470 years of brewing expertise. The brewery's philosophy focuses on traditional techniques and the use of local ingredients, specifically water from the 'Tenka-ama-no-mizu' (Heavenly Gift Water) spring and locally grown rice, to produce sake of exceptional purity.

This 'Classic' Junmai presents a crystal clear appearance in the glass. The nose is clean and inviting, offering subtle aromas of steamed rice, toasted cereal, and a delicate touch of honeyed citrus. On the palate, the sake is smooth and well balanced, delivering rich flavours of creamy rice and subtle nuttiness, complemented by a light, refreshing acidity. It possesses a medium body and a soft mouthfeel, leading to a clean, dry finish that is characteristic of the Niigata brewing style.

title: Barbi Chianti 2024
bodyHtml: Ruby red, with light purplish highlights. The bouquet has a strong aroma of red berries, with a delicate hint of cut flowers. On the palate, it feels fresh, clean and expresses a sense of youth and endurance.

title: Grey Goose Vodka - 4.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Using only the finest ingredients, Grey Goose is renowned for its smooth and silky character. 

Expect subtle aromas of sweet citrus and white flowers; the palate is soft with a gentle and subtle sweetness that envelops your mouth; warm and spicy on the finish.

title: Red Truck Lager - 50 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Road Trip Classic Lager is the flagship brew from Vancouver’s Red Truck Beer Company. Since the brewery's relocation to its iconic "Truck Stop" location in the Brewery Creek district in 2015, this beer has become a staple of British Columbia’s craft scene. Built on a philosophy of "honest craftsmanship," it is a traditional European-style lager that avoids the shortcuts of mass-produced brands. It is designed to be a reliable, high-quality "utility" beer equally at home at a summer concert or a backyard barbecue.

Beer Description

Red Truck Lager pours a brilliant, clear light gold with a medium-sized white head that leaves light, streaky lacing as it recedes.

Aroma: The nose is clean and nostalgic. It leads with a scent of freshly baked bread and grainy malt, followed by the classic herbal and spicy aroma of Noble hops. There is a subtle hint of honey-like sweetness that adds a pleasant softness to the bouquet.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a crisp, refreshing carbonation. It leads with a smooth, balanced flavor of biscuity malt and toasted grain. This is followed by a delicate, spicy hop bitterness that provides a clean "snap" without lingering. The finish is remarkably dry and thirst-quenching.

Profile: It sits at a standard 5.0% ABV and a restrained 16 IBU, prioritizing balance and drinkability above all else.

Technical Notes: This beer is a showcase of traditional methods and premium ingredients. It is brewed using 100% Canadian Prairie two-row malted barley and authentic Saaz hops imported from the Czech Republic. To achieve its refined clarity and smooth profile, Red Truck utilizes a "slow" brewing philosophy, including a cool fermentation and an extended cold-storage (lagering) process that lasts for several weeks.

title: Egan's 10 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whisky
bodyHtml:
A single malt from an undisclosed distillery bottled by revived Irish whiskey brand Egan's. The whiskey has been aged for a minimum of 10 years in ex-bourbon American oak casks, before being bottled at 47%.

See More Irish Whisky

title: Hakkaisan Yoroshiku Senman Arubeshi Kome Shochu - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Hakkaisan Yoroshiku Senman Arubeshi is a premium "Honkaku" (authentic) rice shochu produced by the renowned Hakkaisan Brewery in the Niigata Prefecture of Japan. The name, which translates roughly to "Best Wishes for Your Boundless Fortune," reflects the distillery's roots in Japanese sake culture. Unlike standard shochu, this expression is crafted using the same high-quality ingredients and labor-intensive techniques as Hakkaisan’s world-class sake, including the use of yellow koji and a three-step brewing process (sandan-jikomi). It is matured for at least two years to achieve a refined, mellow profile that bridges the gap between sake and spirits.

Description

This rice shochu is clear and bright in appearance. On the nose, it offers a delicate and clean aroma reminiscent of high-grade ginjo sake, featuring notes of fresh steamed rice, white flowers, and a faint hint of melon. The palate is smooth and light-bodied, delivering a gentle umami sweetness and a clean grain character that reflects its pure mountain water source. The distillation process, conducted under low pressure (vacuum distillation), preserves the elegant, fruity esters of the rice without the harshness often found in higher-proof spirits. The finish is crisp and refreshing, leaving a subtle, lingering sweetness. It is typically bottled at 25% ABV.

Food Pairing

The clean, umami-driven profile of this shochu makes it an exceptionally versatile companion for a wide range of Japanese and international cuisines. It pairs beautifully with delicate seafood such as sashimi, nigiri, or grilled white fish (shioyaki), where the spirit's subtle sweetness enhances the natural flavors of the sea. It is also an excellent match for light appetizers like edamame, chilled tofu (hiyayakko), or vegetable tempura. For a more robust pairing, try it alongside yakitori or pickles (tsukemono), as the shochu's crisp finish cleanses the palate. It is traditionally enjoyed on the rocks, mixed with cold water (mizuwari), or with a splash of hot water (oyawari) to further unlock its aromatic depth.

title: Jaboulet Chateauneuf du Pape Les Cedres 2019
Chateau Cantenac Selection Madame 2022
bodyHtml: A classic, classy wine with old-school character. Intense black plum and cherry on the nose, with oaky, sweet vanilla on the palate and just a touch of stony minerality.

title: Marani Alazani Valley White Blend
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from Georgia, specifically from the Kakheti region within the Alazani Valley. Produced by Telavi Wine Cellar under the Marani brand, the winery was founded in 1915 and is situated just outside the city of Telavi. The winery's philosophy bridges nearly a century of innovation with deep historical roots, maintaining the ancient traditions of Kakhetian winemaking while utilizing modern methods to suit a global palate.

Wine Description

Marani Alazani Valley White displays a bright pale greenish yellow or light straw colour. The nose is intriguing and aromatic, offering a bouquet of toasted nuts, ripe apples, and white flowers layered with touches of quince and melon. On the palate, the wine is fresh and medium bodied, featuring flavours of candied melon, white peach, and tangerine balanced by a mild acidity. It is characterized by its rounded, gentle sweetness and dominant notes of candied quince peel, leading to a smooth finish. This wine is typically a blend of 90% Rkatsiteli and 10% Mtsvane grapes, though some releases may be 100% Rkatsiteli. The ABV is generally 12%. While the winery utilizes traditional qvevri for certain premium lines, this regional range is produced using modern temperature controlled stainless steel to preserve freshness and is not typically certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through two to three years.

Food Pairing

The natural sweetness and crisp acidity of this medium sweet white make it an excellent partner for spicy dishes and light appetizers. It pairs perfectly with spicy Asian takeout, vegetarian cuisine, or creamy green bean soup. Its fruity and nutty profile also complements mushrooms, mild soft cheeses, sweet biscuits, and fresh fruit desserts.

title: L'Ostal Cazes Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
A beautifully pale and bright pink colour with salmon touches, then deliciously juicy on the nose with white fruit aromas (white peach) and citrus notes. 

Fresh and smooth on the palate with a wonderful, delicately saline touch that invigorates the taste buds. Like biting into crisp, fresh fruit!

title: Brave Step Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: This Sauvignon Blanc has a bright, pale yellow colour with green highlights. Intense nose of citrus and green apples, with a hint of grassiness. Crisp mouth entry, light bodied, with a very fresh finish.

title: El Jolgorio Arroqueno Mezcal
bodyHtml: El Jolgorio Arroqueno Mezcal is a true gem in the world of artisanal mezcal. This extraordinary spirit is part of the exclusive El Jolgorio Special Release series, a testament to the craftsmanship of the Vasquez family, led by the legendary maestro mezcalero Pedro Vasquez and his sons, Librado and Pedro Jr. This mezcal is a tribute to the arroqueño agave, a species once abundantly used in mezcal production but now increasingly rare due to its long maturation period of 15-20 years.

title: Blazon Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Blazon Pinot Noir 2022 is an elegant red wine from California, United States, primarily sourced from the renowned Lodi region. The wine is produced by Oak Ridge Winery, which holds the distinction of being the oldest operating winery in Lodi, originally built in 1934 and run as a cooperative before being acquired by the Maggio and Reynolds families in 2002. The winery's philosophy emphasizes the production of variety-specific wines that reflect the unique terroir of California's sustainably farmed, family-owned vineyards at an accessible price point.

Wine Description

This medium bodied Pinot Noir presents a vibrant garnet colour and a complex sensory profile. The nose is bright and expressive, featuring aromas of dark plum, red currant, and allspice, interlaced with notes of cherry blossoms and toasted oak. On the palate, the wine offers a harmonious blend of raspberry-pomegranate, cranberry, and pink grapefruit zest, balanced by savory undertones of black pepper, dried herbs, and star anise. The varietal composition for the 2022 vintage is 80% Pinot Noir, enhanced with 12% Petite Sirah, 5% Zinfandel, and 3% Primitivo for added depth. It was aged for 6 months in 80% French and 20% Hungarian oak, resulting in a smooth, dry finish with silky tannins and refreshing acidity.

title: Rib Shack Red Blend 2024
bodyHtml: Rib Shack Red is a stellar wine out of South Africa. Robust, yet smooth Rib Shack Red wine out of South Africa's Western Cape is a very versatile wine that pairs well with both meat and poultry. The rich dark berry flavours meld beautifully with a slightly smoky oak spice from wood maturation. Rib Shack Red, known as the official BBQ wine, is a perfect pairing with a chicken curry stir-fry complementing the spicy flavours with its sumptuous smoothness.

title: Mission Hill Pinot Blanc Reserve 2022
bodyHtml: Fresh orchard pear and yellow apple with a hint of spice compliment the broad texture and juicy acidity.

title: Matua Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml: At Matua, they think that New Zealand Pinot Noir has the potential to be the next big thing. Marlborough creates incredibly bright and smooth Pinot with red fruit flavours. For their Marlborough Pinot Noir, they pick parcels from various sites to maximize regional fruit expression and mature it in oak just enough to compliment the incredible fruitiness. Simply moreish. Enjoy it with a lightly seasoned steak from the grill. Sip, eat and repeat!

title: Lolea ROSE Frizzante (NV)
bodyHtml: A sophisticated rosé wine cocktail made from Grenache and Tempranillo grapes, with hibiscus flower scents and a spicy ginger background taste that ends with a sparkling touch that’s floral, sweet, and surprising. Flowers, fruits and spices, they mix together in this sophisticated, fragrant cocktail with an attractive soft pink color in a “Coté de Provence” style. Definitely elegant. Low tannin content, fresh and pale colour, with the exact acidity touch accompanied by a silky fine bubble that results in an intriguing sip.

title: Liquidity Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Liquidity Pinot Noir is an elegant red wine from the Okanagan Falls subregion of the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. The winery, established as a modern destination in the heart of Okanagan Falls, was acquired in 2020 by Anthony von Mandl and is now a member of the Iconic Wineries of British Columbia. Liquidity is renowned for its artisan approach and its unique location, sharing borders with esteemed neighbours such as Blue Mountain and Noble Ridge. The estate winemaking philosophy, led by New Zealand born winemaker Amy Paynter, focuses on creating site expressive wines that highlight the cool climate synergy between Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.

Wine Description

This medium bodied Pinot Noir presents a sensory profile defined by both elegance and terroir driven complexity. The nose offers vibrant aromas of red berry fruit, red cherry, and raspberry, layered with black cherry, thyme, and earthy notes of beetroot and gravel. On the palate, the wine is silky and refined, featuring flavours of black currant and blackberry complemented by subtle baking spices, cola, and a hint of vanilla. Stylistically, it showcases a balance of fruit forward intensity and delicate floral nuances, leading to a long, persistent finish. While varietal composition is 100% Pinot Noir, the estate also produces a Reserve tier which utilizes specific Burgundy clones such as 667 and 115 to add further rich texture and savoury depth.

title: Pio Cesare Langhe Nebbiolo 2022
bodyHtml: Intense and ripe berry fruit along with mild and almost sweet tannins give this wine structure, fragrance and longevity. The wine is rich, full-bodied, with a hint of gentle toasting.

title: De Bortoli DB Family Selection Traminer Riesling 2020
bodyHtml: Pale straw in colour, lifted perfumed aromatics of musk, spice and ripened citrus. A generous and balanced palate of sweet rosewater and Turkish delight complemented by the crisp acid Riesling component adding a zesty finish.

title: Prophecy Rose 2024
bodyHtml: Silvery pink colour. Aromas and flavours of watermelon relish and diced heirloom tomato with a soft, bright, dryish light body and a tingling, swift finish with nuances of fennel, hot rubber, basil, and parsnip with no oak flavour. A solid rose quaffer.

title: Radio Coteau Pinot Noir La Neblina 2017
bodyHtml: The La Neblina Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir is a wine both spry and enticing in its youth yet with graceful aging potential. Ripe red cherry and raspberry bound out of the glass, balanced by bright strawberry and cranberry notes. A spice melange envelops the nose, first with vanilla and allspice tones and finishing with a hint of sarsaparilla. Violets weave their fragrance in and out of the fruit as the wine shifts toward more earthy hues. The La Neblina finally returns to earth with the slightest hint of button mushroom and forest floor, while round, yet grippy, tannins linger on the palate.

title: Fernet Branca Menta - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Fernet Branca Menta, often referred to simply as Brancamenta, is a refreshing amaro from the country of Italy, specifically the Lombardy region in Milan. It was created in the 1960s by the Fratelli Branca Distillerie after they observed fans of the opera singer Maria Callas adding mint syrup to their standard Fernet Branca. The family owned company, founded by Bernardino Branca in 1845, remains guided by the motto 'Novare Serbando' (Renew but Conserve).

Spirit Description

This liqueur is based on the secret proprietary recipe of Fernet Branca, which includes over 40 herbs, roots, and spices from four continents, matured for one year in oak vats. To this complex base, sugar and high quality Piedmontese peppermint oil are added to create a more accessible and cooling profile.

  • Colour: It possesses a deep balsamic brown or dark mahogany colour and is largely opaque.

  • Aroma: The nose is intensely minty, yielding scents of sharp spearmint and menthol softened by delicate notes of anise, liquorice, and milk chocolate.

  • Palate: It features a rich and clean palate of fresh peppermint and menthol, balanced by the herbal bitterness of the original Fernet blend and notes of citrus.

  • Body: The spirit is medium bodied with a smooth, syrupy gloss that carries flavours without feeling cloying.

  • Finish: It concludes with a persistent, cooling menthol finish accompanied by subtle hints of liquorice and a restrained, clean bitterness.

  • ABV: This liqueur is typically bottled at 28% to 30%.

title: Padre Azul Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Padre Azul Añejo Tequila is a super-premium aged tequila produced in Jalisco, Mexico, within the Tequila Valley (Lowlands) region. The brand was founded in 2014 by Austrian entrepreneur Hans Peter Eder and his friends following his marriage into a Mexican family, building a bridge between Austria and Jalisco. Crafted under the guidance of Master Distiller Erika Sangeado, the name "Padre" is inspired by the popular Mexican phrase "que padre" (meaning how fantastic or wonderful). The brand is instantly recognizable by its striking, hand-blown bottle clad in a laced leather jacket and crowned with a heavy, solid-metal skull stopper.

Spirit Description

The tequila is made from 100% blue Weber agave grown in the Tequila Valley for up to 10 years before harvest. The agave hearts are slow-cooked in traditional masonry brick ovens, fermented spontaneously, and double-distilled at low temperatures in stainless steel pot stills. To qualify as an Añejo, the spirit is matured for at least 18 months in hand-selected, charred oak ex-bourbon barrels.

  • Colour: Rich yellow-amber with bright golden-orange reflections.

  • Aroma: Decadent and dessert-like, the nose is heavily dominated by coffee bean, burnt caramel, sweet vanilla, and caramelized nuts, which give way to sweet dried cherry, apricot, and faint cooked agave.

  • Palate: Velvet-smooth, rich, and heavily texturized. The palate mirrors the confectionery notes of the nose, delivering distinct layers of dark chocolate, cinnamon spice, creamy vanilla, and dried fruits.

  • Body: Heavy-bodied and viscous with a noticeably thick, mouth-coating texture.

  • Finish: Extremely long, sweet, and smooth with a warming trace of baking spice and toasted oak wood.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Padre Azul Silver Tequila
bodyHtml:
Padre Azul Super Premium Blanco (Silver) Tequila is an unaged artisanal spirit produced in Jalisco, Mexico, within the Tequila Valley (Lowlands) region. The brand was launched in 2014 by Austrian entrepreneur Hans Peter Eder and his partners, inspired by his marriage into a Mexican family and a desire to merge high-end Austrian luxury design with traditional Mexican heritage. Crafted under the direction of Master Distiller Erika Sangeado at NOM 1466, the name "Padre" is derived from the popular Mexican slang phrase "que padre" (meaning how fantastic). The bottle is a visual standout, instantly recognizable by its hand-stitched leather jacket and heavy, solid-metal skull stopper.

Spirit Description

This silver tequila is made from 100% blue Weber agave harvested at peak maturity from fields in the Lowlands. The agave hearts are steam-cooked in traditional masonry brick ovens, fermented in stainless steel tanks, and double-distilled in stainless steel pot stills before being bottled unaged to lock in the primary flavors of the agave.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and completely transparent.

  • Aroma: Highly sweet, expressive, and fruity. The bouquet opens with strong notes of baked fruit compote, heavy vanilla bean, cooked agave, and hints of pear and banana, accented by a very soft hint of mint.

  • Palate: Velvet-smooth and uncharacteristically sweet for a standard silver tequila. It delivers prominent flavors of sweet marshmallow, sugar syrup, and cooked squash, which blend into a mid-palate layer of tropical fruits and a light herbal undertone.

  • Body: Medium-to-heavy-bodied with a soft, smooth, and viscous mouth-coating texture that offers a completely minimal alcohol burn.

  • Finish: Moderately long, incredibly clean, and sweet, trailing off with a gentle touch of white pepper and a faint herbal freshness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Avignonesi Rosso Cantaloro Toscana IGT 2024
bodyHtml: A versatile, young red wine with a ruby red colour and a bouquet characterized by inviting aromas of black cherry pie, blackberries, thyme, red pepper grains, and exotic spices. The taste is medium-bodied, fruity, and smooth with a long lingering, dry finish, reminiscent of undergrowth, with an underlying hint of menthol.

title: The Wild Olive Chenin Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: The Wild Olive Chenin Blanc offers a refined well balanced wine with touches of peach, gooseberry and apple. It provides a long finish with elegance to boot.

title: Long Little Dog White 2024
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine originates from France, classified as a Vin de France, with the grapes sourced from across the South of France, including the Languedoc area. The winemakers strive for consistent style and quality through careful blending of multiple parcels of wine from this sun-drenched region. The resulting wine is bottled young, without oak, to let the pure fruit flavours shine and capture the freshness and brightness of the south.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, light colour. On the nose, it offers ripe apple notes streaked with fresh, 'zingy' citrus characters. The palate shows pleasing fullness and weight, which is then rounded off with a 'zesty' note in the finish. This is an approachable, crisp white blend with an uplifting acidity and a lovely balance of fruit and freshness. It is best enjoyed young and fresh to highlight its vibrant fruit.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings also include summer salads and light fish or chicken dishes.

title: Bottega White Gold
bodyHtml:
Bottega White Gold is a Venezia DOC wine obtained from the vinification of Glera, Chardonnay and Pinot grapes. With its great character, this Brut sparkling wine is fresh and elegant, representing an expression of the territory where grapes are grown, among the provinces of Treviso and Venice.

This wine is soft and captivating, on the palate it creates a perfect balance between the freshness of Glera grape, the body of Chardonnay grape and the acidity of Pinot grape.

title: Brave Step Cabernet Sauvignon 2025
bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon has a ruby red colour with bright red highlights. Intense strawberry and raspberry on the nose with a hint of cacao. Pleasant and lively on the palate, medium-bodied with well-forged tannins on the finish. This wine can be a great companion for a BBQ steak.

title: Dusted Valley Boomtown Merlot 2021
bodyHtml:
A nod to the Dusted Valley family's unquenchable thirst for adventure, Boomtown is crafted for those unafraid to step out and leave their comfort zones. Boomtown by Dusted Valley allows our family the opportunity to share a fantastic Dusted Valley wine with a larger audience. Winemakers Chad Johnson and Corey Braunel control the process from vineyard to bottle and source 100% of the fruit from Columbia Valley in Washington State.

A delicious Merlot with chocolate and berry character, medium body, soft and round tannins and a juicy finish.

title: Masi Costasera Amarone 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Deep purple ruby colour. Rich, ripe, dark fruit aromas and flavours with hints of licorice, toast and chocolate. Full-bodied and smooth with a firm, long finish.

title: Aia Vecchia Lagone 2023 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
In the glass, the wine is deep ruby with purple hues. On the nose, the wine is delicate with notes of cherry, vanilla, raw beef and herbs. On the palate, it is dry, structured and elegant with flavors of plum, ripe cherries, wild berries and a hint of spice, followed by a lengthy and smooth finish that begs for food.

This wine is very versatile and would pair well with both red and white meats, various pasta dishes and hard cheeses.

title: Village Blonde - 18.5 Litre Keg
bodyHtml:
Village Blonde is the cornerstone of Calgary’s Village Brewery, a brand built on the philosophy of community and "small-town" connection. Launched in 2011, this Golden Ale was one of the first beers to help bridge the gap between mass-produced domestic lagers and the burgeoning craft beer movement in Alberta. It is designed to be the "everyman" craft beer—sophisticated enough for the enthusiast but approachable enough for someone’s first step away from a "Big Beer" brand.

Beer Description

Village Blonde pours a brilliant, clear golden-straw color with a tight, frothy white head and moderate carbonation.

Aroma: The nose is clean, welcoming, and subtly sweet. It leads with the scent of honeyed biscuits and fresh grain, followed by a delicate, floral hop aroma. There is a faint, fruity hint of lemon or pear that comes from the ale yeast, adding a layer of brightness that you won't find in a standard lager.

Palate: On the tongue, it is light-to-medium bodied with a smooth, well-rounded mouthfeel. It leads with a gentle malt sweetness and a touch of caramel, which is quickly balanced by a mild, earthy bitterness. The finish is crisp and clean, with a subtle "snap" that leaves the palate refreshed.

Profile: It sits at a very accessible 4.5% ABV and a low bitterness of 15 IBU, making it the definition of a "sessionable" ale.

Technical Notes: This beer is a showcase of regional quality, brewed with Alberta-grown malted barley and a touch of wheat to enhance the head retention and mouthfeel. It is hopped with a combination of European and North American varieties to provide a balanced, "noble" character without any aggressive bitterness. Unlike a lager, it is fermented at slightly warmer temperatures, which allows the yeast to contribute its signature soft fruitiness.

title: Rodano Chianti Classico Vigna Viacosta 2019
bodyHtml: Fattoria di Rodáno is a top source for classically made, user-friendly and complex Chianti. Located in Castellina in the heart of the Chianti Classico district, the estate dates back as a wine-producing property to the sixteenth century. Rodáno has belonged to the Pozzesi family since that time. Vittorio Pozzesi had been in charge of the estate since they first began to bottle wine in 1967, but now his son, Enrico, handles the winery management. The domain's former winemaker was Giulio Gambelli, who passed away in 2012. Gambelli was one of the most legendary winemakers in Chianti, consulting for such estates as Montevertine and Gianfranco Soldera. Rodáno is quite a large estate, with over a hundred hectares under vine, and is one of the best-kept secrets in Tuscany.

title: Pietradolce Etna Rosso 2024
bodyHtml: Pietradolce Etna Rosso is bright red in color with notes of berries and brushwood. Elegance, minerality and excellent persistence on the palate. From young vineyards, characterized by lively freshness and approachability. This wine is ideal as an entry-level Nerello Mascalese, step one to the enjoyment and appreciation of Etna terrain.

title: Portillo Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: The Bodegas Salentein Portillo has an aroma that consists of dark fruits with floral hints. On the palate it is full-bodied, fruity and smooth with flavours of cassis, blackberry, mint and notes of black pepper.

title: High Dive Red Blend 2015
bodyHtml:
A 'Left Bank' Bordeaux-styled blend, High Dive is a proprietary red that is an homage to the classic Napa Valley blends of the 1970s. Dark berries and black cherry aromatics lead to a dense core of cassis. Field ripe strawberries, crushed blackberries and brooding blue tones encapsulate powerful textural highlights. Fantastic density and weight, with an expanding midpalate that turns to purity and uplift in finishing. Blend: 68% Cabernet Sauvignon,16% Merlot, ?14% Cabernet Franc, 2% Petit Verdot.

94 Points - Wilfred Wong of Wine    The 2015 High Dive Napa Valley Red Blend is impressive. This wine is dramatic from the beginning to the end. It's bold aromas and flavors of black fruit, a medley of ripe berries, earth, and oak stays long and lasting on the palate. Pair with a thick ribeye and dollop of strong blue cheese.

91 Points - Decanter    A lovely rich structure with smoky cassis, tobacco, spiced plum and chocolate notes. Velvety tannin, wonderfully balanced oak flavours and a lingering, smooth finish.

90 Points - Jeb Dunnuck    The 2015 Red Blend checks in as 68% Cabernet Sauvignon, 16% Merlot, 14% Cabernet Franc, and 2% Petit Verdot. It shows the ripe, powerful style of the vintage in its plum, ground herbs, licorice, mulling spices, and chocolaty aromas and flavors. These flow to a ripe, full-bodied wine that has solid palate presence. Drink it over the coming 7-8 years.

title: Vietti Moscato d'Asti 2024
bodyHtml:
Vietti Moscato d'Asti is crafted in Italy's prestigious Piedmont region, specifically from small vineyards located in Castiglione Tinella. Founded in the late 1800s by Carlo Vietti and later transformed by Mario Vietti in 1919, the winery is now owned by the Krause family. The estate is celebrated for its artisanal, non-invasive winemaking philosophy that prioritizes the unique expression of individual terroirs through organic farming practices.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine displays a bright straw yellow colour with golden reflections and a gentle mousseux. The nose is aromatically seductive, offering intense aromas of ripe yellow fruit such as peach and apricot, alongside floral notes of rose petals and a refined touch of fresh ginger. On the palate, it is delicately sweet and slightly sparkling with balanced acidity, displaying good complexity and a persistent finish characterized by fresh apricots.

title: Monasterio De Las Vinas Gran Reserva 2020
bodyHtml: Gently spiced plum and currant aromas come with a sprinkle of dusty earth. This blend of Garnacha, Tempranillo and Carignan feels tight and juicy, with acidity driving the palate. Lightly salty flavours of red plum and currant are fiery and come with an accent of oregano prior to a lean finish. Perfect with steak!

title: Poderi Colla Langhe Riesling Ranera 2022
bodyHtml: A Rhenish Riesling planted in Cascine Drago in the 1980s: with fresh citrus flavours in the first year, it later develops the classic complex notes of this grape variety, still with fresh acidity, which gives it good ageing potential. Straw yellow with greenish reflections, elegant nose with mountain flowers, pervasive and continuous minerality, strong citrus flavour. In the mouth, acid flavour, complexity, volume and length. Possible improvement over time.

title: Cune Reserva Red Wine 2020
bodyHtml:
A classic among classics, Cune Reserva from La Rioja is crafted by one the oldest and most prestigious wineries of the region: the Compañía Vinícola del Norte de España, better known as CVNE or Cune, established in 1879 in the town of Haro, La Rioja's wine capital. It is made from a traditional blend of 85% Tempranillo and 15% of Mazuela, Graciano and Grenache.

After a meticulous selection process, the grapes were destemmed and cold-soaked for 10 days in stainless steel tanks. After finishing alcoholic and malolactic fermentations, this Spanish red wine was put into French and American oak barrels and aged for 18 months.

title: Flavio Fanti Brunello di Montalcino 'La Palazzetta' 2020
bodyHtml: Cultivating his vineyards organically, Flavio Fanti is a traditionalist who somewhat straddles the fence. While only utilizing large Slovenian and French oak for his Brunello, he chooses to use various size barrique for his rosso in order to create a wine that is characteristic of Sangiovese Grosso, but incredibly approachable upon release. Beginning with fruit that is ripe and mature Flavio makes Brunello wines that are big in structure, powerful and pure. Staying true to Tuscany, he favours Sangiovese while avoiding international varieties, and now that his daughter Tea has recently completed her Doctorate in Oenology, they work together in the cellar, ensuring that this winery remains a family affair.

title: Lightfoot & Wolfville Chardonnay Ancienne 2020
bodyHtml:
This family-owned winery in Nova Scotia’s Annapolis Valley is dedicated to certified organic and biodynamic agriculture alongside Old World winemaking techniques.

A radiant golden yellow hue glows in the glass. Fresh aromas of Meyer lemon and yellow pear are deepened by white truffle and hazelnut undertones. The palate is gracefully balanced between texture and acidity, and the finish between lushness and invigorating citrus-pith zest. A wine that pairs naturally with roasted poultry, fish, warm vegetable dishes and cream sauces.

title: Lightfoot & Wolfville Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Nova Scotia’s ocean influenced terroir and cool climate provides the ideal conditions for a style of rosé characterized by delightful fruit flavours, refreshing acidity, vibrancy and balance. Our L&W Rosé is fermented in stainless steel to preserve that natural freshness and primary fruit character.

A pale, yet brilliant salmon hue shines from the glass. On the nose, wild strawberry blossom and cherry-eucalyptus aromas captivate and provide a sense of freshness. On the palate, white cranberry and cloudberry notes impart a juicy, yet tart, fruitiness, which is accented by chalky minerality and harmonized by refreshing acidity.

Enjoy on its own or paired with cured meats, salty cheeses, fresh tomato salad or a wide range of lighter fare.

title: Moselland Ars Vitis Riesling 2024
bodyHtml:
Moselland was formed in 1969 by a union of local growers, which has since grown to become one of the world's most significant producers and marketers of Riesling. The winery's philosophy centres on a careful winemaking process, including meticulous grape selection and gentle pressing, which is essential to preserve the delicate flavours and aromas characteristic of Mosel Riesling.

Wine Description

On the nose, it offers a pronounced and youthful bouquet of citrus, apple, and floral notes. The palate is off-dry and refreshingly low in alcohol. Flavours include ripe peaches, green apples, apricots, pear, and citrus fruits, complemented by mineral undertones. Stylistically, it is celebrated for its perfect balance of light sweetness and crisp, lively acidity, resulting in an elegant and fresh profile.

Food Pairing

A great match for grilled fish, shellfish, and spicy food, such as spicy ribs, spicy tuna sushi, or Thai curry.

title: La Rioja Alta 'Vina Alberdi' Reserva Tinto 2021
bodyHtml: Bright, deep ruby color with dark cherry hues on the rim of the glass. It stands out for its intensity, with red fruit aromas (strawberries, raspberries, redcurrant and cherry) leading to elegant notes of vanilla, toffee, coffee cream, cinnamon, brioche and hazelnuts. The balance between acidity and alcohol stands out on the palate, with soft, sweet, rounded tannins and a pleasant final sensation.

title: Bruichladdich Port Charlotte 10 Year Old
bodyHtml: Bruichladdich Port Charlotte 10-Year-Old is currently crafted at the Bruichladdich distillery, nestled on the Isle of Islay in Scotland. This heavily peated single-malt Scotch whisky is celebrated for its robust and smoky flavour profile. It presents a symphony of maritime influences, with notes of peat smoke, iodine, sea salt, and hints of vanilla and tropical fruits. Critics laud Bruichladdich Port Charlotte 10-Year-Old for its impeccable balance, depth, and complexity. It is often praised for its well-integrated flavours, silky texture, and long, satisfying finish. Whisky enthusiasts seeking a bold and memorable Islay experience will find Port Charlotte 10-Year-Old to be an excellent choice.

title: Rock Town Arkansas Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml:
This whiskey is made by a grain-to-glass distillery in Little Rock, Arkansas, where the rye is grown within 125 miles. It's bottled at 46% ABV and distilled from a mash bill with 52% rye, 38% corn and 10% malted barley. This differs from an earlier recipe which used 88% rye and 12% malted barley.

See More USA Whisky

title: Coriole Shiraz Mclaren Vale 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Shiraz has been Coriole’s principle variety and flagship wine since the first bottling in 1970. Coriole Shiraz is 100% Estate grown and the average vine age is 50 years old.

The Estate Shiraz beautifully demonstrates the mixture of fruitfulness and savoury elements that these vineyards provide.

This wine is made in the traditional manner; fermented in open tanks, hand plunged, and matured in French oak hogsheads. The Estate Shiraz has impressive fruit intensity, yet is elegant and will reward further cellaring.

title: Michael David Freakshow Red 2022
bodyHtml:
Known for taking the road less travelled, Michael David Winery has always stood apart from the crowd. Whether it be their outlandish brands and packaging or their quirky personalities, Michael and David are definitely on a stage of their own and this wine showcases just that. The fruit for this wine comes from the original “super freak” himself, Michael Phillips’ vineyard located only a medicine ball toss away from the winery.  

Step right up for an experience like no other, the amazing brawn and finesse of the Strongest Man on Earth! The first star in their Freakshow series, this Cabernet Sauvignon opens the show with black cherry, strawberry and toasted hazelnut aromas. He is larger-than-life, medium in body and showcases flavours of plum, chocolate truffle and butterscotch with an oak-inspired finish that will surely have you coming back for the second act.

title: Padre Azul Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Padre Azul Super Premium Reposado Tequila is an aged artisanal spirit produced in Jalisco, Mexico, within the Tequila Valley (Lowlands) region. The brand was established in 2014 by Austrian entrepreneur Hans Peter Eder and his partners, inspired by his marriage into a Mexican family and a desire to merge premium Austrian design with traditional Mexican craftsmanship. Produced under Master Distiller Erika Sangeado at NOM 1466, the name "Padre" stems from the popular Mexican slang expression "que padre" (meaning how fantastic). Visually striking, the bottle features a hand-stitched leather jacket and a heavy, solid-metal skull stopper.

Spirit Description

Crafted from 100% blue Weber agave harvested after growing for up to a decade in the Lowlands, the agave hearts are steam-cooked in traditional masonry brick ovens, fermented in stainless steel tanks, and double-distilled in stainless steel pot stills. The distillate is then matured for at least eight months in hand-selected, medium-char ex-bourbon oak barrels.

  • Colour: Pale straw yellow or light gold, with a thick, viscous coat that clings to the glass.

  • Aroma: Highly sweet and confectionary. The bouquet opens with strong notes of vanilla cupcake, warm caramel, and butterscotch, with a faint background of cooked fruit compote and a muted hint of raw agave.

  • Palate: Velvet-smooth and intensely sweet on the tongue. It delivers heavy, upfront flavors of vanilla bean, maple syrup, and liquid caramel, which evolve into mid-palate layers of baked apricots and mild milk chocolate.

  • Body: Medium-to-heavy-bodied with a soft, syrupy, and mouth-coating texture that minimizes any alcohol burn.

  • Finish: Long, sweet, and smooth, closing with a delicate touch of black pepper, baking spices, and lingering vanilla.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Basil Hayden Two By Two Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml: Two by Two Rye is a blend of two Kentucky straight rye whiskeys and two Kentucky straight bourbon whiskeys. As for the two rye whiskeys, one is a 5-year-old, and another is a "high-rye" 7-year-old. The two bourbons consist of a 13-year-old and a 6-year-old. It is bottled at 80 proof.

title: Casisano Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
Italy, Tuscany, Montalcino. Casisano is a storied estate located in the southeastern hills of Montalcino, acquired by the Tommasi family in 2015. With roots tracing back to Verona, the Tommasi family brings generations of winemaking experience to this Tuscan gem, blending traditional and modern techniques while preserving the elegance and terroir expression of Brunello.

Wine Description
This 100% Sangiovese wine pours a deep garnet red with brick hues at the rim. The nose reveals an enticing bouquet of ripe cherry, dried rose petals, balsamic herbs, and a hint of leather and sweet spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied yet refined, showing flavours of black cherry, tobacco, and forest floor, all framed by firm tannins and vibrant acidity. The wine displays excellent balance and depth, with a long, savoury finish layered in mineral and spice.

Food Pairing
Pair this elegant Brunello with rosemary-crusted lamb chops, wild mushroom risotto, or aged pecorino cheese. The wine’s structure and savoury depth shine with robust, earthy dishes. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: The Arran Port Cask Finish
bodyHtml:
Finished in a selection of Port casks sourced from an artisan producer of the iconic Portuguese fortified wine. A Single Malt full of charm, complexity and quality.

50% alc./vol

title: Louis Bernard Cotes du Rhone Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Louis Bernard Côtes du Rhône Blanc originates from France, within the Southern Rhône subregion of the Rhône Valley. The winery was founded in 1976 by Mr. Bernard, who travelled the region to establish partnerships with winegrowers committed to authentic expressions of their terroir. Based in the village of Gigondas, the winemaking team, led by Sylvain Jean, focuses on a 'Louis Bernard style' that emphasizes fruit-forward, generous wines while maintaining close alliances with more than 20 vineyard owners.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a pale gold colour with distinct green highlights in the glass. The sensory profile is expressive and fresh, opening with a floral bouquet of spring blossoms, lilac, and rose combined with fruity aromas of pear, white peach, and pineapple. On the light to medium-bodied palate, it is lively and well-balanced, delivering crisp flavours of apple, citrus zest, and lemon peel alongside a subtle mineral undertone. The finish is clean and dry, often revealing a refreshing stony character.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional Southern Rhône blend typically featuring Grenache Blanc, Bourboulenc, and Roussanne, sometimes including Clairette or Viognier.

  • ABV: Generally ranges between 12% and 12.5%.

  • Stylistic Notes: To preserve its aromatic potential and freshness, the wine is fermented at low temperatures in stainless steel vats and aged for six months before bottling without oak influence.

  • Organic Status: While this standard bottling is not certified organic, the winery is recognized as 'Exemplary' in Sustainable Development and produces a separate organic red label. It is also noted as being vegan-friendly.

title: Tenuta di Castellaro Pomice Bianco 2019
Domaine de Beaurenard Chateauneuf du Pape 2022
bodyHtml: Domaine de Beaurenard’s flagship wine is a quintessential blend, reflecting all the diversity of the terroir and the perfect purpose that exists between the soils and the grapes. It offers a supple and refined texture associated with a delicate aromatic palette that is the result of a constant quest for freshness.

title: Stina Posip White Wine Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
Posip is one of the Croatian white varieties with the greatest potential. This wine comes from Korcula, the old vineyards that are traditionally the best micro-location for growing Posip. The winery is on the island of Brac, unique and famous for its white stone, Stina. Many famous Croatian poets, authors, sculptors, and painters were born in Brac. Brac stone has always been a source of inspiration due to its beauty, but it is also a symbol of hardship when it comes to viticulture and viniculture. And that is where the inspiration for the name Stina comes from. In the Dalmatian dialect, this word means stone, the strongest symbol of the island of Brac.

Full wine with ripe flavours, and a rich and layered scent. It has the dominant aromas of tropical fruit, peach, Mediterranean herbs and vanilla. Composed acidity gives it a lovely balance and juiciness. It goes great with fish, and because of its fruitiness and fullness, it can be a great companion to meat such as veal or marinated poultry.

title: Mauro Vannucci Piaggia Riserva 2021
bodyHtml: Very intense, almost impenetrable, clear ruby red colour. Aromas of ripe fruit, embellished with elegant hints of tobacco, chocolate and sweet spices. On the palate it expresses a powerful structure but also, with a measured balance, soft fruit against the round and mature tannins. The finish is long and fruity. This wine goes well with red meat and game, extra mature cheeses and quality cured meats.

title: Helios Distillery Kura 'The Whisky' Pure Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Japan, Okinawa, Nago City. Founded in 1961 by Tadashi Matsuda, Helios Distillery originally focused on rum and awamori production before expanding into whisky in the late 1990s. The distillery is situated in the northern area of Okinawa and is known for emphasizing the preservation of the island's natural environment and resources in its production processes.

Description

This pure malt whisky features a pale gold, straw-like colour. The aromatic profile is complex and sophisticated, highlighting heather honey and yuzu citrus blended with floral notes, toasted oak, and a touch of moss. On the palate, it delivers a smooth and creamy texture with flavours of butterscotch and vanilla joined by Japanese citrus notes, brown sugar, and a hint of lime marmalade. The finish is long and refreshing, offering hints of caramel, tropical fruits, and a touch of bitter grape. It is a well-balanced and approachable whisky that showcases a unique terroir from Japan's southernmost distillery. ABV 40%.

Food Pairing

This whisky's citrus and honey notes make it an ideal partner for fresh seafood, particularly sashimi and grilled fish. It also pairs exceptionally well with creamy cheeses like Camembert or mild goat's cheese. For a sweeter combination, try it alongside vanilla-based desserts, apple tarts, or milk chocolate-coated nuts.

title: Bertani Sereole Soave 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Bertani Sereole Soave Classico is a highly regarded white wine from Italy, produced in the Veneto region, specifically within the Soave Classico D.O.C. (Denominazione di Origine Controllata) appellation. The wine is a single-vineyard expression, sourced exclusively from the Sereole vineyard, which is considered a cru site located between the municipalities of Soave and Monteforte d'Alpone. Bertani, the producer, is a pillar of viticulture in Veneto, renowned for skillfully combining traditional methods with modern techniques.

Wine Description

The wine has an intense straw-yellow colour, often with golden or greenish reflections.

  • Grape Variety: 100% Garganega. Garganega is the most elegant local white vine from Verona.

  • Aromatic Profile: The appealing nose offers a rich bouquet of citrus (lime, lemon), white flowers (broom blossoms, elderflower), white-fleshed fruit (melon, apple, pear), and a hint of apricot or pineapple. There is also a subtle, characteristic mineral lift.

  • Body and Palate: It is a medium-bodied wine that is dry, clean, fleshy, and well-balanced. The palate is often described as caressing and complex, combining fruit sweetness (honeydew, stone fruit) with a lovely creamy note.

  • Vinification and Aging: Unusually for Soave, this wine is typically lightly oaked. The wine is fermented and aged on the lees for 4–6 months in large French oak vats (or barrels). This maturation adds softness, complexity, and creaminess to the texture.

  • Structure: The acidity is crisp, lively, and refreshing. The characteristic marl-limestone soil of the Sereole vineyard contributes a sapid (savoury) and mineral edge that exalts the structure.

  • ABV: Typically around 12.0% to 13.0%.

  • Optimal Drinking: Best enjoyed young to benefit from its freshness, though it has good aging potential.

Accolades

  • WineAlign (John Szabo) - 90 points (2023 vintage)

  • Natalie MacLean - 90 points (2023 vintage)

  • James Suckling - 90 points (2023 vintage)

Food Pairing

This sophisticated, dry, and mineral-driven white wine is very versatile. Suggested pairings include:

  • Appetizers and Seafood: Light appetizers, hors d'oeuvres, shellfish, and warm fish appetizers.

  • Pasta and Mains: Pasta with light sauces, pasta with seafood, or risottos with vegetables.

  • Meat: White meat (e.g., roast chicken, baked mushroom stuffed quail).

title: Chateau de Tracy Pouilly Fume 2023
bodyHtml: This tightly structured wine offers herbal flavours and layers of green fruits. From an ancient estate, the wine is dense from long-term aging on the lees, giving form and minerality.

title: Masciarelli Marina Cvetic Montepulciano d'Abruzzo 2019
bodyHtml:
The Montepulciano Marina Cvetic is the spearhead of the line designed by Gianni Masciarelli's wife and represents the faithful expression of one of the historical vines of Abruzzo, whose magnitude can not ignore the strong link with its roots. Produced since 1997, this wine provides a blend of Montepulciano grapes in purity, from eight municipalities in three different provinces, with altitudes ranging from 200 to 400 meters above sea level. 

Intense ruby red with garnet reflections. Fruity, spicy with hints of red fruit, red berries, mulberries. Intense, complex, full.

title: Casa Silva Pinot Noir 'Cool Coast' 2022
bodyHtml: Dominated by red fruits on the nose, think strawberries, cherries and pomegranate, with subtle notes of cinnamon that add aromatic complexity.  Juicy and refreshing on the palate, this wine has sweet raspberries and wild forest fruit flavours. Its cool coastal origin at Paredones adds a refreshing acidity, soft tannins and an elegant long finish.

title: Tinto Nero Malbec Mendoza 2023
bodyHtml:
From the heart of Argentina, this Malbec hails from the celebrated Mendoza region, renowned for its high-altitude vineyards nestled against the Andes Mountains. Tinto Nero is produced by a family-owned winery committed to sustainable viticulture and minimal intervention winemaking, reflecting both tradition and innovation in every bottle.

This 100% Malbec presents a deep ruby colour with violet hues. On the nose, it bursts with ripe blackberry, plum, and hints of violets, accented by subtle notes of cocoa and sweet spices. The palate is full-bodied and plush, delivering layers of dark fruit, mocha, and a touch of earthiness. Fine-grained tannins and vibrant acidity lead to a long, harmonious finish. Ideal for drinking now through 2028, the wine shows excellent structure and balance, with freshness that elevates its intensity.

Food Pairing
Pair this Malbec with grilled lamb chops, mushroom risotto, or a smoky eggplant parmigiana. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Chateau Petit Vedrines Sauternes 2019 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This sweet white dessert wine originates from France, specifically from the Sauternes appellation in Bordeaux. Chateau Petit Vedrines is the second label of Chateau Doisy Vedrines, a prestigious Second Growth estate in the 1855 Classification. The winery is located on the clay and limestone plateau of Haut Barsac and has been owned by the Casteja family since the mid 19th century. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes a balance of traditional methods, such as manual harvests in multiple passes to select botrytis affected grapes, and modern techniques to ensure trademark richness and finesse.

Wine Description

Chateau Petit Vedrines Sauternes presents a brilliant golden colour with a luminous clarity. The nose is intense and complex, offering a fragrant bouquet of honey, apricot, and mango, layered with candied citrus fruits and subtle notes of honeysuckle and ginger. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and luscious, displaying a honeyed richness and tropical fruit flavours that are perfectly offset by a precise, refreshing acidity. It is characterized by its energetic structure and a fine mineral streak that leads to a long, elegant finish. This wine is typically a blend of 80% Semillon, 15% Sauvignon Blanc, and 5% Muscadelle, with an ABV of 13%. While the estate follows traditional sustainable viticulture, it is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from now through 2045.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and unctuous sweetness of this Sauternes make it a versatile partner for both savory and sweet dishes. It pairs perfectly with classic foie gras, blue veined cheeses like Roquefort, or chicken liver pate. Its honeyed and tropical fruit profile also complements fruit tarts, lemon mousse, and apricot based desserts. For a modern pairing, it is surprisingly effective with spicy Asian dishes where the sugar helps balance the heat of ginger and chili.

title: Mildiani Kindzmarauli Red Semi-Sweet Wine 2021
bodyHtml: Vintage after vintage, this soft, ripe, quite intense semi-sweet wine never fails to impress. Plentiful plum, berry jam and sweet cranberry make it an easy match for mature cheeses, dried fruit and roasted nuts, but it will also delight when paired with grilled duck with a rich cherry or plum sauce.

title: Domaine de Bachellery Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml: A delicious and affordable Pinot Noir! The wine is aged in large oak casks, the result is a wine with soft, red fruit and mild earthy undertones.

title: Chateau Clos du Roy 2019
bodyHtml:
The Clos du Roy is a family-owned 15-hectare wine estate whose wines fully express the richness and complexity of the greatest Fronsac vines. The Clos du Roy is naturally strong and prone to ageing and its winemaking process is led by a constant care for balance and delicacy.

92 Points - James Suckling

Lots of blue fruit with slate and lavender character. Medium to full body. Chewy tannins.

92 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple coloured, the 2019 Clos du Roy has quite an oaky/cedary nose to begin, soon giving way to vibrant black cherries, warm plums and ripe blackberries scents with touches of tobacco leaf and new leather. Full-bodied, big, rich and concentrated (15% alcohol), the palate exudes black fruit preserves and spicy accents, framed by firm, ripe, rounded tannins and plenty of freshness, finishing on a minty note.

title: Ken Forrester Renegade Red Blend 2019
bodyHtml: One of the very first Rhône style blends in South Africa. This elegant Rhône blend displays Old World Style with New World fruit. Hint of Grenache’s earthy rusticity and Shiraz’s noble spice with hints of nutmeg and salty black olive on the finish. Balanced with soft integrated tannins.

title: Damilano Barbera d'Alba 'Lablu' 2021
bodyHtml: A 100% Barbera vineyard that pleases the nostrils with an ample and complex scent, with fruit notes of blackberry and cherry, as well as spice notes of cinnamon, vanilla, and green pepper, with a fully body and a pleasant freshness and salinity.

title: Kettle Valley Great Northern Vineyards Viognier 2020
bodyHtml: It's a fragrant offering of yellow apples and guava, apricots and pomelo with honey and citrus blossoms. The palate is juicy with tree fruit flavours and plenty of tangy citrus. Stylish with nice restraint.

title: Gouffier Mercurey Village 'Les Murgers' 2019
bodyHtml: 100% Pinot Noir. A wine with a strong colour, a nose of black fruits and spices but not without a hint of minerality, it reveals itself in the frank and straightforward mouth, in the purest style of its appellation. An ideal partner for beef in all its expressions.

title: Ken Forrester Petit Rose 2024
bodyHtml: This very elegant Rosé overwhelms the nose with aromas of freshly picked strawberries, rose petals and cherry flavours. It follows through on the palate with delicious ripe raspberries and a delicate finish.

title: Stellenbosch Moederkerk Chardonnay Reserve 2024
bodyHtml:
The Stellenbosch Reserve Moederkerk Chardonnay is rare venture into white wine production for the team at Rust en Vrede.  A distinctive Chardonnay with an inviting nose of lime, lemon curd and buttered popcorn. 

The palate shows complex citrus aromas, from fresh lemon and lime to orange zest with a hint of mint. Flavours of walnuts and brioche add depth, balanced by a lively acidity that lifts a creamy softness on the mid-palate. A dry, savoury finish begs for another sip!

title: Ken Forrester Petit Chenin Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: A perfect everyday drinking wine. A youthful fresh wine with quince and pear drop flavours. Earlier picked freshness shows on palate with crunchy green apple and grapefruit. Good mouthfeel and appetizingly tangy finish. Made with 100% Chenin Blanc. Serve with light al fresco summertime meals.

title: Glenfiddich Fire & Cane
bodyHtml: Glenfiddich Fire & Cane is a bold fusion of smoky and sweet notes. By marrying peated whisky and malts matured in bourbon barrels and finishing in Latin rum casks, they created an exquisite whisky with campfire smokiness and toffee sweetness. Fire & Cane is inspired by the early innovation of Glenfiddich Malt Master Brian Kinsman, who, in 2003, first ran peated spirit through the Glenfiddich stills, birthing the concept of what would become the innovative Experimental Series. As the fourth expression of the Experimental Series, Fire & Cane fuses the brand's smoky whisky with malts that had been maturing side-by-side in bourbon casks, showcasing Glenfiddich's sweet and fruity signature style. Taking it a step further, all the whiskies were finished in Latin rum casks to produce a surprising overlay of added caramel toffee sweetness.

title: Licor 43 Horchata
bodyHtml:
The delicate fusion of the traditional Horchata from Valencia & Licor 43 Original makes a deliciously light, silky Spanish liqueur: the extraordinary Licor 43 Orochata. Vegetable-based. Cream free. Low calorie. Gluten free.

Aromas of cinnamon, vanilla, white chocolate, hazelnuts, tiger nuts and nutmeg. With a silky mouthfeel, Orochata is slightly sweet with light spice nuances, cinnamon, nutmeg, and faint milk chocolate.The delicate fusion of the traditional Horchata from Valencia & Licor 43 Original makes a deliciously light, silky Spanish liqueur: the extraordinary Licor 43 Orochata. Vegetable-based. Cream free. Low calorie. Gluten free. Aromas of cinnamon, vanilla, white chocolate, hazelnuts, tiger nuts and nutmeg. With a silky mouthfeel, Orochata is slightly sweet with light spice nuances, cinnamon, nutmeg, and faint milk chocolate.

title: Brigaldara Amarone della Valpolicella 2018 - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml: Amarone Riserva is a wine that interprets the Valpolicella region respecting timings and techniques. The grapes are selected from the best vineyards of the winery to synthesize and express the maximum potential of our land. The drying of the grapes is characterized by the seasonal post-harvest trend. A very elegant wine that expresses a neat balance between fruit and pulp, characterized by deep and complex tertiary notes.

title: Brigaldara Amarone della Valpolicella 'Case Vecie' 2018
bodyHtml: Bright and elegant, this lightly fleshy, medium- to full-bodied red offers flavours of candied cherry and dried strawberry fruit, with accents of woodsy spice, dried thyme and black liquorice. Delivers a long, supple finish.

title: Laphroaig Lore
bodyHtml:
Created by Distillery Manager John Campbell, Laphroaig Lore is said to be the richest ever Laphroaig! Named after the skills passed down over the generations, this permanent addition to the range is matured in a combination of casks including first fill Sherry butts and quarter casks and is said to contain some of their "most precious stock".

48% alc./vol

title: Jean Paul and Benoit Droin Chablis 2023
bodyHtml:
Domaine Jean Paul & Benoît Droin is one of the oldest and most respected family estates in Chablis, with winemaking roots tracing back to 1620. Now under the stewardship of Benoît Droin, the 14th generation, the domaine is renowned for its precise and expressive wines that reflect both tradition and innovation. Their philosophy centres on expressing Chablis’ unique terroir through sustainable viticulture and minimal intervention in the cellar.

Pale straw in colour with greenish highlights, this 2023 Chablis opens with vibrant aromas of green apple, lemon zest, crushed oyster shells, and a subtle floral edge. On the palate, it delivers a racy, mineral-driven profile supported by lively acidity and a core of citrus and orchard fruits. The texture is elegant and linear, with a light to medium body and a chalky, saline finish that lingers with freshness. Crafted entirely from Chardonnay, this wine embodies purity and precision. Best enjoyed over the next 3–5 years, it offers a youthful yet refined style typical of Droin’s approach.

title: Station 22 Barista Cold Brew Coffee Liqueur - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Barista is the exquisite combination of premium cold brew coffee and classic Caribbean rum.  Here at Station 22, we are great lovers of exceptional coffee and seek to form partnerships on a local level. That’s why we invited Montréal-based micro-roastery Barista to create and roast the perfect blend for our coffee liqueur.  Enhance your cocktails with our superior blend!

Barista cold brew coffee liqueur, with its silky-smooth texture, features the sumptuous flavour of roasted coffee with a touch of dark chocolate, supported by the long and satisfying finish of amber rum.

title: Louis Latour Chardonnay Grand Ardeche 2023
bodyHtml: This wine has a rich lemon-gold hue and a ripe open nose of fresh tropical and citrus fruits with some smoky vanilla oak notes. The mouth is warm and creamy, with layers of ripe fruit balanced by freshness and a long smooth finish.

title: Fontodi Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 'Vigna del Sorbo' 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This exceptional red wine is from Italy, specifically the heart of the Chianti Classico region in Tuscany. It is produced by Fontodi, a highly respected estate known for its uncompromising approach to quality and its focus on organic viticulture. 'Vigna del Sorbo' is a single-vineyard wine and is considered Fontodi's flagship bottling, having been relabeled as a 'Gran Selezione' since the 2010 vintage. The vineyard is located directly in front of the winery, on a southwest-facing slope at 450 metres. It lies in the sun-drenched Conca d'Oro basin of Panzano, an area known for distinguishing itself with its vines. This historic wine is a selection of fruit from an approximately nine-hectare plot with vines that are over 50 years old.

Wine Description

The 2022 Fontodi 'Vigna del Sorbo' is a powerful yet refined expression of Sangiovese. It is predominantly Sangiovese, crafted from 100% Sangiovese grapes. The wine is a darker expression of Sangiovese.

The aromas are deep, opening with notes of black cherry, plum, violet, and graphite, layered with hints of tobacco, balsamic herbs, and warm spice. Reviewers also note clear and fresh aromas of black cherries and citrus rind with some blood orange undertones. It is described as having a supple nose with dark red fruits and a little iron tinge.

On the palate, it delivers blackberry, black currant, plum, tar, and sweet spice flavours. It has a polished texture and a long, intense finish. The wine is unevolved at this stage, showing plenty of fruit that needs to come together with the structural components. It features thick, beefy tannins that are very fine but are still very young. The mouthfeel is plump, medium-bodied with a solid fruit core, and a very long, lingering finish. Subtle notes of earth, cocoa, and savory minerality build through the mid-palate. It is extremely structured and delivers a long, focused, and elegant finish. The vines are planted atop Galestro (shale) soils. The wine ages in barrique and French oak foudre for 24 months. The optimal drinking window is suggested to be from 2027 or 2028 through 2036 or 2045.

Accolades

  • 'James Suckling – 95 points'

  • 'Wine Spectator – 95 points'

  • 'Monica Larner, Wine Advocate – 95 points'

  • 'Michael Godel, Wine Align – 96 points'hows some cement and stone texture to it.

title: Paolo Scavino Langhe Nebbiolo 2023
bodyHtml:
Paolo Scavino Langhe Nebbiolo is a premium red wine from Italy, specifically produced in the Piedmont region within the Langhe DOC. The historical winery was founded in 1921 in Castiglione Falletto by Lorenzo Scavino and his son Paolo. Today, the family estate is run by the fourth generation, Enrico Scavino and his daughters Enrica and Elisa, who manage 30 hectares of proprietary vineyards across eight communes in the Barolo area.

Wine Description

This wine is crafted from 100% Nebbiolo grapes, often sourced from declassified crus in the village of La Morra, such as Bricco Manescotto and Annunziata. It undergoes a short maceration and low-temperature fermentation in stainless steel to ensure soft extraction, followed by approximately 8 to 10 months of aging in neutral oak and then time in stainless steel to preserve freshness.

  • Colour: It displays a bright ruby red hue with delicate garnet shades.

  • Aroma: The nose is delicate and complex, redolent of bright cherry, tart plum, and crushed flowers, accented by notes of licorice, cedar, mint, and tarry smoke.

  • Palate: It offers a vibrant and elegant palate with flavors of macerated red cherry, kirsch, and orange zest, complemented by hints of white pepper, incense, and dried herbs.

  • Body: The wine possesses a lean to medium body with striking inner perfume and striking clarity.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long finish marked by harmonious acidity, floral overtones, and soft, resonant tannins.

  • ABV: This expression is typically bottled with an alcohol content of 14% to 14.5%.

title: Chateau Recougne White Bordeaux 2024
bodyHtml: Light and openly fruity, the wine with its apple crispness and tangy acidity is attractive and ready to drink.

title: Oyster Bay Sparkling Rose
bodyHtml: A beautiful blend of 20% Pinot Noir and 80% Chardonnay. Fragrant cherry and fresh strawberry aromas, accentuated by a finely bubbled palate with a crisp, refreshing finish.

title: Glenallachie 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The signature GlenAllachie rich, robust spirit in harmony with the heather and butterscotch notes. Bottled at 46%, non chill filtered and natural colour.

Colour

Intense Chestnut.

Nose

Layers of heather honey, toffee and muscovado sugar, with dark chocolate, caramel and dried sultanas.

Taste

Bursting with fruit cake, butterscotch and wild Scottish honey, followed by layers of blackcurrant, almonds and soft oak spice on the finish.

title: Glenallachie 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The GlenAllachie 12 Year Old is a flagship Speyside single malt from Scotland. Established in 1967, the GlenAllachie Distillery was revitalized in 2017 when it was acquired by a team led by industry veteran and Master Distiller Billy Walker. Under Walker’s leadership, the distillery transitioned from producing spirit for blends to focusing on a premium core range, emphasizing a 'quality over quantity' philosophy that includes reduced production and exceptionally long fermentation periods of up to 160 hours.

Whisky Description

Presented at a natural bronze or deep mahogany hue without added colouring or chill filtration, this 12 year old malt offers a rich and complex sensory profile. The nose is generous with aromas of heather honey, dark chocolate, and mocha, complemented by notes of sultanas and cinnamon. On the palate, it delivers a full, oily mouthfeel with layers of treacle, butterscotch, and orange zest, followed by warming spices like nutmeg and ginger. This unpeated whisky is matured in a combination of Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso sherry casks, alongside red wine barriques and virgin oak, providing a balanced and multi-dimensional finish that lingers with notes of cocoa and dried fruit.

title: Dutcher Crossing Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
Great wine happens only with teamwork. Farming their own premium fruit as well as sourcing from renowned growers gives their winemakers the quality fruit that is needed to begin the journey of turning grapes into wine. From there, there the team meticulously takes a hands-on approach and the concept of being shepherds of the fruit from the fermentation stage to barreling, blending, all the way through bottling. Their end concept is to be mindful of their three “V’s” ... staying true to each vintage, vineyard and varietal.

Opulent happiness, ripe bright lushness that envelops your mouth and lasts and lasts. Outstanding for the price!

title: The Cicada Red Blend 2023
bodyHtml:
The wine is crafted by Domaine Chante Cigale, a family estate with deep roots in the nearby Châteauneuf-du-Pape appellation. The estate has been owned by the Sabon Favier family for several generations and is named for the famed 'singing cicadas' of Provence. Winemaker Alexandre Favier, part of a new generation, combines modern technical expertise with time-honoured winemaking practices.

Wine Description

On the nose, it offers fresh, ripe red berries and notes of a forest floor with a touch of subtle spice. The palate delivers robust flavours of red and black cherries, along with a pinch of spice. It presents a well-balanced structure with lovely acidity and soft, smooth tannins.

title: Bodega Gaintza Txakolina White Blend 2024
bodyHtml:
Txakoli is a wine with character and quite distinct from others. It can be compared with other so-called 'green’ wines, now found in just a few parts of Europe. The designations of origin for txakoli allow a diverse variety of grapes to be used, but one, Hondarribi Zuri, is more prevalent than others, followed by its red version Hondarribi Beltzand to a lesser extent Petit Manseng, Petit Courbu, Chardonnay and others.

Pale yellow with hints of green. Bright and clean in the glass. Fine bubbles due to the low-temperature elaboration method. A blend of fresh aromas with herbal notes. White fruit is prominent, such as green apple with lemon citrus undertones. Lightly sparkling with well-integrated acidity on the palate. Pleasant in the mouth leaving a fresh sensation with citrus notes. Gaintza txakolina is a traditional and authentic wine. This expressive txakolina has a low alcohol content and balanced acidity. It is made with grapes from the best vineyards in the region, and its unique character makes it our most expressive wine, with an unmistakable touch of Atlantic salinity.

title: Raul Perez Ultreia Saint Jacques Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml: Floral, spicy aromas with hints of underbrush. Juicy, well-structured red fruit with great vibrancy and length on the palate. A long finish is marked by hints of herbs, coffee bean, and tomato leaf.

title: Lyric Pinot Noir Monterey County 2022
bodyHtml:
Bright and youthful, with a lovely shimmering red ruby colour, this Pinot Noir is fresh and vibrant. Fruit-forward aromas of ripe strawberry, red raspberry and Bing cherry sit alongside baking spice notes of cinnamon, clove and vanilla, with a hint of floral perfume. On the palate, red fruits drive the flavour profile with notes of macerated strawberry, red currant, dark raspberry and red cherry, supported by soft tannins and a silky finish.

This wine exemplifies the perfect balance of freshness and acidity, with fresh fruit and delicate oak, making this a perfect crowd-pleaser to accompany a variety of cuisines.

title: Mauro Vannucci Carmignano Il Sasso 2022
bodyHtml: Marasca cherries jump from the glass with elegant hints of balsamic and spice. The wine is full and enveloping on the palate with a charming elegance.

title: Cherry Pie Three Counties Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in the United States, this wine is a distinct Californian blend that sources fruit from three premier counties: Monterey, Santa Barbara, and Napa. The Cherry Pie winery was founded in 2008 by visionary winemaker Jayson Woodbridge, also known for Hundred Acre and Layer Cake. The brand's name and iconic label were inspired by an oil painting by artist TR Colletta, which Woodbridge felt perfectly captured the rich, approachable, and 'all-American' style of Pinot Noir he aimed to create.

Wine Description

The Cherry Pie Three Counties Pinot Noir presents a classic burgundy colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is concentrated, leaping from the glass with scents of macerated cherries, cranberries, and dark oolong tea, accented by sweet toasty oak and a hint of blueberry. On the palate, the wine offers a juicy 'attack' of Bing cherries and raspberries, supported by a delicate frame of tightly woven tannins and lifting acidity. Stylistically, it is a medium-bodied red that balances rich fruit intensity with subtle notes of baking spices and dried herbs. The experience concludes with a long, silky smooth finish. While vibrant and approachable now, it is generally intended for consumption within three to five years of its vintage.

title: Mollydooker Miss Molly Sparkling Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml: Miss Molly Sparkling Shiraz inspires fun and enjoyment from the first sip, the mouthfeel a symphony of bright delicate bubbles. Cherry and fresh plum dance delicately with cocoa and liquorice on the palate. Fragrant oak adds layers of complexity and a hint of vanilla to this generous spectrum of flavours creating a Shiraz that is full of sparkle!

title: Chateau Grand Corbin Manuel 2013
bodyHtml: The wine is well-structured with a deep crimson colour. It is a strong representation of the appellation due to its harmony and strength. This wine is full-bodied, richly coloured, and polished. Furthermore, candied apple aromas start to emerge.

title: Bandistas Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Yellow in colour with medium intensity and a wonderful balance of oak, vanilla and cinnamon notes. Harmonious and elegant, it conforms the fullness in the mouth, leaving you to feel its silkiness.

title: Bandistas Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

A medium dark yellow colour, its intensity with a nice balance of slightly vanilla, cinnamon, cocoa and oak notes. This confirms the greatness of a silky finish.

title: Bandistas Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: Medium-bodied with a smooth agave aroma and presents a soft note of cooked agave. Its colour is white crystal and taste confirms the blue agave, delicate citric with sweet notes.

title: Belle Glos Pinot Noir Las Alturas 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Deep purple garnet in colour, this wine has overflowing aromas of sun-ripened cherries, sweet plums, hints of cola, and white pepper. The palate is complex and rich, packed with dark fruit flavours of blackberry and cherry. This wine is a full and intense expression of Pinot Noir, well balanced with toasted oak and vibrant acidity on the finish.

title: Old Soul Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, this Chardonnay is sourced from the Lodi region within California's Central Valley. The Old Soul label is part of the Oak Ridge Winery portfolio, which is the oldest operating winery in Lodi, originally built in 1934. Owned by the Maggio family since 2002, the winery is led by third-generation patriarch Rudy Maggio and his three daughters, who continue a farming legacy that began when Angelo Maggio planted the family's first Lodi vineyards in 1928.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a brilliant golden straw colour and opens with enticing aromas of lemon meringue, ripe stone fruit, and white peaches. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied and succulent, featuring a 2% splash of Sauvignon Blanc for added vibrancy. Flavours of spiced vanilla custard, grilled pineapple, and apricot are supported by a creamy texture and balanced acidity. The wine is aged for 10 months using a combination of French oak staves and American oak chips, which lends subtle notes of crème brûlée and toasted oak to a long, satisfying finish.

Food Pairing

This Chardonnay pairs exceptionally well with rich seafood such as lobster with drawn butter, pan seared scallops, or grilled salmon. It is also a natural accompaniment to roasted poultry, creamy pasta dishes like fettuccine Alfredo, or butternut squash risotto. For a sweet finish, consider serving it alongside a classic apple pie or creamy desserts.

title: Old Soul Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml:
Old Soul Pinot Noir originates from the United States, within the California region and the Lodi AVA subregion. The wine is produced by Oak Ridge Winery, the oldest operating winery in Lodi, which has been owned and farmed by the Maggio family since 1934. The winery's philosophy bridges multi-generational estate farming with contemporary production practices, operating under a commitment to craft highly expressive, fruit-forward wines that offer exceptional everyday value.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a bright ruby appearance in the glass and possesses a light-to-medium body with a soft, lush mouthfeel. The sensory profile is highly approachable and forward, opening with an aromatic nose of ripe black cherries, raspberry jam, and cherry cola, balanced by hints of fig and baking spice. On the plush palate, it delivers a generous, sweet-fruited stream of dark summer berries, plum, and brambleberry, layered with a touch of mocha and warm vanilla bean. The finish is smooth and easy-drinking, leaving a clean, lingering impression of toasted oak and soft chocolate-covered berries.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically a robust Californian blend dominated by 77% to 85% Pinot Noir, routinely co-fermented and structured with small percentages of Petite Sirah, Petit Verdot, Malbec, or Zinfandel depending on the vintage.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its crowd-pleasing, plush style and smooth integration; it is matured for up to 14 months in 100% French oak barrels to soften the tannins while maintaining an approachable fruit core.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 13.5% and 14.5% vol.

  • Organic Status: While not certified organic, the estate vineyards are fully certified sustainable under the rigorous Lodi Rules Green Sustainable Winegrowing program.

Food Pairing

The supple structure, sweet fruit profile, and gentle oak spices of this Pinot Noir make it an incredibly food-friendly and versatile option for everyday dining.

  • Poultry & Meats: Pairs beautifully with classic roast chicken, grilled duck breast, herb-crusted pork chops, or lean cuts of lamb.

  • Seafood: Suggested pairings include pan-seared or grilled salmon fillets, which complement the wine's balanced acidity.

  • Savoury: Complements a rich portobello mushroom risotto, caramelized onion flatbreads, or everyday staples like a standard cheeseburger.

  • Cheese: Matches gracefully with mild, semi-soft options such as Gouda or creamy Brie.

title: Cos Cerasuolo di Vittoria Classico 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction
