This red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Cerasuolo di Vittoria Classico DOCG region in southeastern Sicily. Azienda Agricola COS was founded in 1980 by three friends—Giambattista Cilia, Cirino Strano, and Giusto Occhipinti—whose last initials form the winery's name. The winery is a pioneer of 'pre-industrial' and natural winemaking in Sicily, focusing on traditional methods such as spontaneous fermentation with indigenous yeasts and the use of ancient-style aging vessels like clay amphorae and large Slavonian oak barrels.

Wine Description

The COS Cerasuolo di Vittoria Classico 2021 is a medium intensity ruby red wine with garnet highlights. The nose is hauntedly expressive, offering a complex bouquet of wild red cherries, pomegranate, and blackberries, layered with savory notes of terracotta, fennel, dried flowers, and a distinct sea-salt minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and serene, featuring silky tannins and vibrant, citrus-laced acidity that balances flavors of black raspberry, wild herbs, and sweet smoke. It is characterized by its remarkable energy and textured finesse, leading to a long, classically dry finish with a whisper of spice and earth. This blend consists of 60% Nero d'Avola and 40% Frappato, with an ABV of 12.5%. The wine is certified organic and follows biodynamic principles. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is from 2024 through 2035+.

title: Deanston Virgin Oak
bodyHtml:
Deanston Virgin Oak is made with young whisky, finished in brand new oak casks from Kentucky. Always a pleasure to have Deanston single malt Scotch whisky around, as they are certified by the Organic Food Association and power their distillery using hydro energy, so you can always feel good about the delicious dram in your hand.

title: Knob Creek Cask Strength Rye
bodyHtml:
Rich medium amber with pale gold highlights. Invitingly fragrant, with notes of caramel, freshly cut vanilla bean, pepper, tangerine and dried herbs. Forward on the palate, you'll experience toffee, plum, sweet oak and spice flavours. The alcohol is elegantly balanced with a sweet, spicy, and warm finish.

title: Tyrconnell 10 Year Old Sherry Cask
bodyHtml:
A 10-year-old from the Cooley distillery and an Irish single malt finished in sherry casks, this is a limited edition Tyrconnell.

title: Nikka Coffey Gin
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml: Nikka Coffey Gin's complexity is achieved through the perfect balance between 11 selected botanicals and the silky texture of Coffey distillates. The bright and zesty aroma originating from four kinds of Japanese citruses, Yuzu, Kabosu, Amanatsu and Shequasar, compliments the traditional gin botanicals of juniper berries, angelica, coriander seeds, lemon and orange peels. There is also a touch of apples, a fruit deeply related to the history of Nikka, followed by pleasantly tangy hints of green Japanese Sansho pepper on the finish.

title: Tapiz Cabernet Sauvignon Alta Collection 2019
bodyHtml: Understated, with a clean finish? Try Tapiz's Alta Collection Cabernet Sauvignon for your upcoming occasion. A wine with lots of depth and fruit with dark berry and dark chocolate character. Full-bodied, velvety tannins and a long and flavourful finish. A great wine!

title: Tapiz Malbec Alta Collection 2023
bodyHtml: Garnet red. The aromas and flavors of fresh red fruits such as blackberries and plums are interspersed with aromas of flowers and spicy notes. The oak aging provides vanilla and toasted almond notes. Balanced and voluminous.

title: Armand de Brignac Gold Brut  (Ace of Spades) - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Armand de Brignac Ace of Spades Gold Brut originates from France, within the Champagne region. The brand is produced by the Cattier family, 13th-generation viticulturists who have cultivated family vineyards in the tiny village of Chigny-les-Roses since 1763. The winemaking philosophy relies on absolute exclusivity and a strict multi-vintage blending masterclass, which is currently overseen by Patriarch Jean-Jacques Cattier alongside a highly restricted artisan team. Each metalized bottle is individually finished, polished, and fitted with French pewter labels completely by hand, ensuring that no two releases are identical.

Wine Description

This sparkling wine presents a beautiful golden or pale lemony appearance in the glass and possesses a rich, complex, and full-bodied structure with an exceptionally creamy and foamy mouthfeel. The sensory profile is marvelously expressive, fresh, and lively, opening with a vaulted nose of peach, apricot, and red berry fruits, seamlessly layered with orange blossom, crystallized citrus, white flowers, and light brioche accents. On the sumptuous and opulent palate, it delivers powerful concentrations of cherries, exotic fruits, lemon, and a touch of vanilla, beautifully intertwined with honey and spun sugar. The finish is remarkably long, silky, and precise, driven by a sharp spinal cord of natural acidity and subtle mineral tension.

  • Varietal Composition: An iconic assemblage traditionally composed of 40% Pinot Noir, 40% Chardonnay, and 20% Pinot Meunier.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its perfect structural balance of old-world concentration and modern finesse, utilizing a signature 'trio of vintages' concept featuring the 2009, 2010, and 2012 harvests. It gains its luxurious weightless texture from a unique oak-aged liqueur de dosage that is matured for a full year in French oak casks before being introduced.

  • ABV: 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the domain relies on meticulous, non-interventional hand labor and low-yield parcel monitoring to preserve terroir transparency, this commercial 1.5-litre magnum bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The intense structural layers, vibrant acidity, and creamy effervescence of this prestige Brut magnum make it a spectacular match for high-end gastronomy.

  • Seafood: Pairs phenomenally well with pan-seared or poached scallops, seafood salads, smoked salmon, freshwater fish, or fresh oysters on the half shell.

  • Poultry & Game: Suggested pairings include roasted quail, a luxury chicken sandwich, or delicate white meats prepared in rich butter or mushroom reductions.

  • Cheese & Heavy Fare: Complements soft-ripened cheeses, rich pasta dishes finished with cream sauce, or light baked white fish.

title: Rocca delle Macie Chianti Classico Riserva di Fizzano 2019
Rooster Rojo Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Abrica de Tequilas produced and distilled this blanco Tequila using agave cooked for 10 hours in steam-powered autoclaves. After the addition of special yeast, the batch was then fermented and moved into stainless steel pots for double distillation. To blend this blanco, Rooster Rojo used water filtered through Mexican silver, creating its sumptuously smooth profile.

Nose: Cracked black pepper adds depth to the light and floral opening, with a helping of lime zest. Vanilla pod notes, menthol and lemon pith are also present.

Palate: The palate adds herbaceous tones of vegetal agave, tomato leaf and whispers of oak influence among hazelnuts, more vanilla and bruised pears.

Finish: The peppery agave returns, flanked by touches of icing sugar.

title: Aia Vecchia Sor Ugo Bolgheri Superiore 2022
bodyHtml: In the glass, the wine shows colours of red garnet accompanied by a bouquet of cherries, menthol and a hint of rosemary. On the palate, the wine is round and rich without being overpowering. It is spicy on the mid-palate and lively on the back-end, with flavours of blackcurrant, liquorice and coffee, followed by a long-lasting finish that is slightly minty and boasts a juicy mouth-watering sensation.

title: Romain Duvernay Cote du Rhone Blanc 2022
bodyHtml: This is a delicious Cote du Rhone, with good fruitiness and minerality. Great value!

title: Los Danzantes Mezcal Joven Espadin
bodyHtml: Delicate nose with wisps of smoke from the mesquite wood used during roasting. Faint aromas of asparagus, brazil nuts. Slight hint of sweetness to a lightly smoked palate with a touch of vanilla and lime. Long, dry, delicately, peat-like smoky finish.

title: Los Danzantes Mezcal Reposado
bodyHtml: Los Danzantes Resposado starts with the Joven, which is put into new French oak barrels from the forests of Nevers and Limousin and aged for 11-12 months. The mesquite smokiness becomes focused to something resembling peat in an Islay malt. Clean, refined, well-structured, and elegant, with a deep long finish.

title: Montelobos Mezcal Joven
bodyHtml:
Double Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2022. Montelobos was created with the aim of showing the complex but perfect balance between the four basic flavour profiles in artisanal mezcal: green agave, cooked agave, smoke and wild fermentation.

Nose: Damp earth, freshly cut grass, honey, citrus, asparagus and smoke.

Taste: Perfect balance between cooked and green maguey, nuts and smoke.

title: Los Danzantes Mezcal Anejo
bodyHtml: Very limited production: approximately 350-400 bottles/year.  16-24 months in new French oak from Nevers and Limousin. Soft, gentle, lingering finish. Beautifully mature, with plenty of rich flavor and a very long finish. Herbal, mocha coffee and cacao nose with brazil nutty oak and faint wafts of smoke. Sweet delicately smoked palate with great balance between oak influence and vegetal agave. Dark chocolate and cedar wood finish with lingering delicately oaky smoke.

title: Enmascarado 45 Joven Mezcal
bodyHtml:
The Enmascarado, or 'Masked Hero', is a Silver Mezcal made using organic agave plants baked in an underground oven before the juice is double distilled in copper pot stills by master craftsman Don Guillermo Abad Hernandez. Mezcal was for a long time seen as inferior to Tequila however, in recent years, higher-quality Mezcals have been entering the market and winning awards at international spirit competitions.

Nose: Big citrus notes underpinned with smoking charcoal and salty toffee.

Palate: Applewood smoke, lime juice and salt crystals.

Finish: Lots of wood smoke, salted caramel and lime zest.

Overall: This is a salty and smoky offering with tangy lime notes to spice it up!

title: Alipus San Miguel Tio Leonardo Mezcal
bodyHtml: Alipús Mezcal comes from a range of remote pueblos in Oaxaca's mezcal region, bottled to showcase the extraordinary regional differences between mezcals even when using 100% Espadín agave (Agave angustifolia) for all production. Alipús Mezcals share in common: craft production in artisanal family palenques (rustic distilleries), agaves wood-roasted in conical below-ground earthen fire-pit ovens, slow stone-milling by horse or mule-drawn tahona, fermentation with exclusively wild native yeasts in open wooden vats, and double-distillation in small wood-fired copper pot stills.

title: Alipus San Baltazar Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Nose: Gentle smoke and agave distillate with a mineral, tinny edge.

Palate: Great mouthfeel, more roasted agave and balanced with sweetness. Earthy, but not particularly vegetal at all.

Finish: Sugar cane smoke.

title: Castarede Armagnac XO
bodyHtml:
Florence Casterède's XO is aged for 20 years. This results in a full-bodied and powerful Armagnac with notes of plums, nutmeg and wood spice.

See More Armagnac

title: Zonin Pinot Grigio Ventiterre 2020
bodyHtml: The bouquet is delicately fruity, relatively full and refined. It offers an ensemble of aromas of great finesse. The flavour is lightly dry and extremely fresh dry yet extremely fresh. It also offers a delicious reminder of the original grape. Its light and elegant structure makes this an unusually refined and aristocratic wine. It pairs particularly with delicate appetizers, pasta courses with light sauces and white meats. In addition, it makes a fine aperitif and is highly suited to every occasion outside meals.

title: Penfolds Max's Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: Plum red in colour. On the nose, cumin, fresh clove, paprika and cardamom. Aromas of roasted spring vegetables in olive oil, with lamb and rosemary, round out the offer. Classically varietal rhubarb vibrancy and flavour profile, with earthy freshly grated beetroot, cranberry sweetness, and lush summer pudding.

title: Glen Carlou Chardonnay Quartz Stone 2023
bodyHtml: On the nose the wine showcases distinct notes of citrus, green apple and stone fruits. Butterscotch and lime notes on the mid-palate follow through to an extended aftertaste of citrus marmalade and a delicate almond finish.

title: 19 Crimes Hard Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml: The Hard Chardonnay honours the brave contributions of the women banished to Australia. It also shows in the glass displaying a brilliant yellow colour with aromas and flavours of vanilla, hazelnuts, oatmeal, honey and pear. Medium-plus-bodied and rich with a lengthy finish. Enjoy with the lobster tail dipped in a lemon butter sauce.

title: Gran Orendain Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: Añejo tequila produced by Orendain family and released as part of their very handsome Gran Orendain range, all of which are made with agave grown on the hill of Tepecoste. This particular expression spends 20 months maturing in French oak barrels before being bottled, resulting in a complex and powerful flavour profile.

title: Giusti Amarone Della Valpolicella 2019 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: An elegant, full bodied Amarone with silky smooth tannins. On the sweet side, this wine screams maraschino cherries and chocolate. Black Forest cake if you will. Subtle hints of vanilla and toast.

title: Bodacious Smooth Red - 4 Litre Box
bodyHtml: Medium ruby in colour; aromas of sweet plum, nutella, blood orange, and candied berries; medium-sweet with the same flavours as on the nose.

title: Sheringham Distillery Seaside Gin
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the fragrant rose bushes, the rustling forest and ocean on a water front stroll. The owner's of Sheringham Distillery thought ... "We have to get this feeling into a bottle".

Seaside Gin's distinctive flavour profile comes from a local and sustainably harvested winged kelp, leaving a unique brininess to the gin. Alongside the kelp, its flavour profile comes from juniper, rose and lavender, citrius, coriander and cardamom. 


AWARDS

  • BC FOOD AND BEVERAGE AWARDS PRODUCT OF THE THE YEAR GOLD MEDAL, 2020
  • WORLD GIN AWARDS WORLD’S BEST CONTEMPORARY GIN 2019

title: Talisker Port Ruighe Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Double matured in port casks, this malt is a toast to the Scottish traders who braved the high seas and were instrumental in the foundation of the port wine trade. Port Ruighe, pronounced ‘Portree’ is the Gaelic spelling of the once-bustling trading port on Skye. The port finish combines Talisker’ s powerful maritime character with succulent sweet notes of rich berry fruits for a superb taste experience.

45.8% alc./vol

title: Rooster Rojo Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Produced and distilled in the heart of Tequila, Mexico, by Fabrica de Tequilas, this Reposado was made with blue agave that was cooked in autoclaves using steam for 10 hours. A special yeast is then added to the agave juices before fermentation, which lasts as long as 72 hours before distillation. Rooster Rojo Reposado is subsequently double pot distilled in stainless steel pot stills before being 'rested' in oak. Water filtered through Mexican silver is added to blend the product to a measured 38% ABV.

Nose: A slightly woody aroma leads with touches of caramel, orange rinds and cassia bark. Baked agave, cedar and pipe tobacco fill the backdrop.

Palate: Toasty spices rise through blackberry, cooked peppers and exotic citrus. Among green wood, there's a little coffee bean, vanilla, popcorn and more earthy caramel and cooked agave.

Finish: Cedar and subtle mineral notes blend with soft oak warmth.

title: Rooster Rojo Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: This Añejo Tequila was made with blue agave, using the Fabrica de Tequilas method of cooking the piña with steam in autoclaves for 10 hours. A special yeast is added to the agave juices prior to fermentation, before Rooster Rojo Anejo is double pot distilled in stainless steel pot stills and aged in oak.

title: Gran Passione Bianco 2023
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Gran Passione Bianco is a beautifully crafted white wine from Italy, hailing from the sun-drenched vineyards of the Veneto region. This label is produced by Casa Vinicola Botter, a historic winery founded in 1928 that has spent generations mastering the distinct terroirs of Northern Italy. Driven by a winemaking philosophy that pairs regional tradition with modern innovation, the winery focuses on expressing the authentic soul and 'grand passion' of Veneto viticulture.

Wine Description

In the glass, this wine showcases a bright, straw-yellow colour with delicate golden reflections. The elegant bouquet is immediately expressive, offering a fragrant blend of acacia blossoms, crisp citrus fruits, and ripe peach, all subtly complemented by a soft hint of sweet vanilla. On the palate, it is dry, wonderfully creamy, and medium-bodied, striking a flawless balance between its refreshing, crisp acidity and its plush fruit profile. Flavours of tropical fruits and honey unfold into a pleasantly long, clean, and mineral-kissed finish.

Food Pairing

This white blend pairs beautifully with grilled poultry, delicate seafood risottos, or fresh fish appetizers. It is also a delightful match for vegetable-driven pasta dishes and soft, creamy cheeses.

title: La Stella Fortissimo 2022
bodyHtml:
La Stella Fortissimo originates from the Osoyoos Lake District in British Columbia’s Okanagan Valley, Canada. Established in 2006 by Sean and Saeedeh Salem, the winery is inspired by Italian winemaking traditions and the starry nights of Osoyoos. Winemaker Severine Pinte focuses on a philosophy of low-intervention viticulture and the use of large-format Hungarian and Slavonian oak to ensure the unique desert terroir remains the focus of every bottle.

Wine Description

This medium-dark ruby red blend presents an intricate sensory profile defined by its savoury depth. The nose is highly aromatic, featuring notes of black fruit, tobacco, and desert scrub, alongside hints of floral lift and smoked meat. On the palate, layers of Bing cherry and plum mingle with dried herbs and a touch of over-steeped black tea. The body is structured and balanced, offering supple tannins and a lingering, dry finish.

Food Pairing

The wine’s robust structure and savoury profile make it an ideal companion for rich, protein-heavy dishes such as grilled flank steak with mushroom tapenade or traditional osso buco. It also pairs beautifully with hearty pasta dishes like spaghetti nero with octopus or aged cheeses.

title: Santos da Casa Rose
bodyHtml: This wine has a delicate colour of light rose petals and the aroma of fresh strawberry and peach fruit. In the mouth a crisp taste with very good acidity, palate with pleasant lightness.

title: Signal Hill Canadian Whisky
bodyHtml: This premium whisky represents adventure, innovation, and longevity. A location that bears the stories of histories past. Signal Hill Whisky is a reminder to unplug and reconnect with history, nature, and great taste. Signal Hill Whisky is made from two types of grain. Corn whisky is double distilled through a two-column still to produce a light and smooth characteristic. The barley whisky is pot distilled to bring out a subtle bready, nutty or malt flavour. Multiple layers of flavour are preserved through non-chill filtration, resulting in a fuller mouthfeel and smoother finish.

title: Drumshanbo Gunpowder Irish Gin
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Drumshanbo Gunpowder Irish Gin is an oriental-inspired spirit from The Shed Distillery in Co Leitrim. Taking its name from one of the signature botanicals, slowly dried Gunpowder tea, the recipe also includes lime, lemon and grapefruit. This will work best with Mediterranean tonic water.

title: Rocca delle Macie Chianti Classico Riserva 2022 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This fine red wine originates from Italy, within the renowned Chianti Classico DOCG subregion of Tuscany. Founded in 1973 by film producer Italo Zingarelli, Rocca delle Macie is a family owned estate located in Castellina in Chianti. Driven by a commitment to quality and environmental sustainability, the Zingarelli family blends traditional Tuscan winemaking heritage with modern techniques across their estate vineyards.

Wine Description

Rocca delle Macie Chianti Classico Riserva exhibits a deep ruby red colour with garnet reflections. The nose opens with an intense bouquet of ripe cherry, blackberry, plum, and subtle notes of tobacco, spice, and forest floor. On the palate, this full bodied wine offers rich fruit concentration balanced by fresh acidity and firm, well structured tannins that lead into a long, savoury finish.

title: Gemma Di Luna Moscato (NV)
bodyHtml: A favourite at ZYN! Gemma di Luna presents a charmingly seductive sparkling wine meticulously crafted from carefully harvested Italian Moscato grapes in its distinctive blue bottle. Perfect for everyday enjoyment, you will love how the bubbly, sweet flavours of peach, orange blossom and nectarine explode on your palate.

title: Grant Burge Shiraz Barossa Ink 2025
bodyHtml:
This expressive Shiraz hails from Australia’s celebrated Barossa Valley, a region synonymous with bold, richly structured wines. Grant Burge Wines, founded in 1988 by fifth-generation Barossa vigneron Grant Burge, is renowned for combining traditional winemaking values with modern techniques, showcasing the region’s exceptional fruit. The estate’s dedication to site selection and vineyard sustainability underscores its commitment to crafting wines of distinction.

Wine Description

Grant Burge Shiraz Barossa Ink pours a deep, inky purple, living up to its evocative name. On the nose, it bursts with aromas of ripe blackberry, black cherry, and plum, interwoven with dark chocolate, vanilla, and subtle spice from oak maturation. The palate is plush and full-bodied, delivering layers of dark berry compote, mocha, and hints of clove, all framed by velvety tannins. A long, satisfying finish carries nuances of toasted oak and sweet spice, enhancing the wine’s luxurious mouthfeel.

Food Pairing

Pair this opulent Shiraz with grilled ribeye steak, rosemary lamb chops, or a hearty beef stew. For a vegetarian option, try it alongside mushroom risotto or eggplant parmigiana. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience, amplifying the wine’s depth and velvety richness.

title: Grant Burge Cabernet Sauvignon Barossa Ink 2022
bodyHtml: Grant Burge Barossa Ink Cabernet Sauvignon originates from Australia, hailing from the renowned Barossa Valley in South Australia. Founded in 1988 by fifth-generation winemaker Grant Burge, the winery builds upon a family winemaking legacy in the Barossa that dates back to 1855. Grant Burge Wines is dedicated to crafting bold, plush red wines that reflect the rich terroir and generous character of the region's premium vineyards.

title: Casa Noble Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: The clean, crisp taste of our Blanco tequila celebrates the fresh flavor of the noble Blue Weber Agave. Enticing aromas set the palate for flavors of honey, buttery-sweet cooked agave and a hint of citrus. Triple distilled for a well-balanced and smoother-than-glass finish, this Blanco is in a class by itself.

title: Cono Sur Sauvignon Blanc 2024 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: This wine has a nice bright yellow colour with green hues. Its nose is mineral and citric, with herbal hints and notes of white flowers and melon, which anticipate a balanced and refreshing mouth that culminates in a long, mineral finish. Overall, this is an expressive, delicate, juicy and balanced Sauvignon Blanc.

title: Remy Martin Louis XIII Le Jeroboam  (3 Litre Crystal Decanter)
bodyHtml:
Rémy Martin Louis XIII Le Jeroboam is an exceptional Cognac presented in a 3-liter crystal decanter, embodying the pinnacle of the Louis XIII collection. Crafted from up to 1,200 eaux-de-vie sourced exclusively from the Grande Champagne cru, each aged between 40 to 100 years, this Cognac epitomizes the heritage and craftsmanship of the House of Rémy Martin.

Decanter and Presentation:

  • Design: The decanter is a masterpiece, handcrafted by Europe's finest crystal artisans and individually numbered. Its distinctive silhouette is inspired by a 16th-century flask discovered at the site of the Battle of Jarnac in France. The creation of such a large crystal decanter requires exceptional skill and precision.

  • Limited Production: The Jeroboam is released in very limited quantities each year, reserved for a few privileged aficionados.

  • Coffret: The decanter is presented in an opulent wooden case, accompanied by four exclusive glasses, a display, a book, a letter from the Cellar Master, an invitation to Cognac, and a spear (pipette) – a tool traditionally used by generations of Cellar Masters to extract the Cognac with the lightest touch as part of a unique tasting ritual.

Tasting Notes:

  • Aroma: A complex bouquet featuring notes of myrrh, honey, dried roses, plum, honeysuckle, and leather.

  • Palate: An intricate tapestry of flavors, including figs, passion fruit, and ginger, with subtle nuances of cigar box and nutmeg, leading to a harmonious and enduring finish.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Serve at room temperature to fully appreciate its aromatic complexity.

  • Glassware: Use the accompanying exclusive glasses to enhance the tasting experience.

  • Ritual: Employ the traditional pipette to extract the Cognac, mirroring the practices of the Cellar Master.

title: Bollinger 'La Grande Annee' Rose 2015
bodyHtml: La Grande Année Rosé is another expression of La Grande Année, featuring all the traditional expertise of Champagne Bollinger: vinification in barrels, riddling and disgorging performed entirely by hand. All this rigorous work and craftsmanship come together to make La Grande Année Rosé a truly handmade cuvée.

title: Wolf Blass Yellow Label Pinot Grigio 2022
bodyHtml: With alluring fruit flavours of lemon, lime, pear and apple, a gentle spray of honeysuckle and hints of pebbly minerality, this Pinot Grigio is at once refined and complex. Its intriguing palate lends itself to great matches with fish, shellfish and vegetables, especially those flavoured with fresh herbs.

title: Alvarinho Pouco Comum 2024
bodyHtml: The Meirles family has long owned vineyards around Vila da Lixa, selling their fruit to others, but in 1886 they decided to start making their own wines. They hired well-known oenologist Carlos Teixeira in the early 2000s to over see the project. They now have 52 hectares of vines across 6 estates. This cuvée is named Pouco Comum, translating as 'unusual'. Though fermented and aged in stainless, this alvariñho from Minho has seen additional time on lees, giving a very creamy feel to the palate. Baked pear, yellow apple, green melon glides along the palate, finishing with gentle spiced notes. Try this if you're looking for an albariño with more body, but still with a great deal of freshness, to partner with your white fish or spring risottos.

title: G Joy Junmai Ginjo Genshu - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
G Joy Junmai Ginjo Genshu is a premium craft sake originating from the United States, specifically brewed in Forest Grove, Oregon. It is produced by SakéOne, America's first commercially successful craft sake brewer, which was founded in 1992. This sake is handcrafted using ancient Japanese techniques blended with American sensibilities, utilizing exclusive California Calrose rice and natural spring water from the Oregon coast range.

Description

This sake is a 'genshu', meaning it is undiluted and bottled at its full natural strength, resulting in a bold and powerful character. It presents a clear appearance and features a rich, velvety, and dense body. The aromatic profile is full and fruity, offering notes of ripe melon, cherry, and orchard fruits like pear and plum, accented by hints of coconut and bread dough. On the palate, it provides creamy layers of fruit flavours balanced by earthy tones and a touch of tropical spice. The finish is long and lingering with a distinctive hint of black pepper. It has an alcohol by volume of 18% and is best served chilled.

Food Pairing

Due to its high alcohol content and bold structure, G Joy pairs exceptionally well with rich and flavourful dishes. It is a natural match for Japanese favourites like sushi, tempura, and king oyster yakitori. Its complex profile also allows it to complement Western and fusion cuisines, such as gourmet burgers, chipotle spiced ribs, and rosemary crusted lamb. Additionally, it stands up well to spicy Thai dishes and a selection of rich, mature cheeses like gorgonzola or aged cheddar.

title: Oimatsu Shuzo Enma 3-Year-Old Barrel-Aged Shochu - 720 ml
Cembra Pinot Nero Trentino 2024
bodyHtml:
The Pinot Nero grape variety, originating from Burgundy, flourishes best in territories characterized by sharp fluctuations in temperature during the grape ripening period. The Valle di Cembra climate with its characteristically chilly currents rising up off the nearby alpine mountain chains favors and enhances the typical aromas of this grape variety.

Cembra Pinot Nero, of a ruby-red colour, has a delicate aroma evoking forest fruits and cherry. On the palate it is soft, with a full, pleasant sapid sensation which emphasizes its persistency.

title: Henschke Keyneton Estate Euphonium 2019
bodyHtml: Deep crimson with bright crimson hues. Intense aromas of ripe, spicy red currant, Satsuma plum, rhubarb, boysenberry and blackberry with lifted hints of cassis, violets, sage, bay leaf, black pepper, baking spices and cedar. The palate has excellent depth and structure with plush, ripe dark fruits and a balanced acid line driving the mid-palate long and finishing with savoury spice and dried herbs in unison with the elegant, fine-grained tannins.

title: Ben Marco Expresivo 2022
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: The area of Gualtallary in Mendoza is well known for its chalky alluvial soils which allow adequate water drainage. The result in BenMarco Expresivo is a wine with deep, bright ruby colour. It has chalk, earthy, floral, peppercorn tree fruits notes. It is a vertical wine with ultra-fine-grained tannins, a long aftertaste and great ageing potential. This wine was hand-picked and aged for 14 months in 100 % new French oak barrels. Great when paired with grilled meats, veal, medium-strong cheeses and spicy sauces.

title: Deanston 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: A relaunch in fancy packaging for Deanston's single malt, previously famous as the whisky used in the much-missed Wallace whisky liqueur. Trivia snitched from the Malt Whisky Yearbook: Deanston is the only distillery in Scotland that is self-sustaining for electricity, being equipped with a dam and a turbine.

title: Franzia Crisp White - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml: A medium-bodied white wine with floral aromas and fruit flavours. Enjoy with fresh vegetables and light pasta plates.

title: Cave Spring Riesling Select Late Harvest 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: On the nose, classic Bartlett pear and lemon meringue aromas emerge overtop notes of candied orange peel, golden raisins and allspice. The palate is sweet and full in body yet not cloying, echoing in flavour the aromas of the nose along with notes of black tea, honeycomb and brown sugar. Crisply structured throughout, the wine's brilliant acidity provides a clean, elegant finish reminiscent of orange marmalade and creme brulee.

title: Delirium Tremens Strong Blond Beer - 30 Litre Keg
bodyHtml: Delirium Tremens is slightly malty with a nice touch of alcohol and spice. Feels like the sound shot of alcohol is igniting the mouth. In reality the tongue and palate are warmed. The taste is characterized by its roundness. The aftertaste is strong, long-lasting and dry bitter.  8.5% ABV.

title: Masi Modello Prosecco Brut (NV)
bodyHtml: Produced from Glera, this sparkler is bright and lithe with delightful white flower tones on the nose alongside peach, apple, pear and a brisk lemon citrus note. Crisp, with a fresh, uplifting finish. This superb value from a noted producer would make a great aperitif and would also shine alongside a seafood main course.

title: Jack Daniel's - 3 Litre Bottle
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Set up in 1866, Jack Daniel's became the US's first registered distillery, it soon became a legendary American whiskey. Shows aromas and flavours of caramel, vanilla, nut and oak with smoky tones. The palate is smooth and sweet with light spicy finish. Serve neat or use in a cocktail.

title: Lake Breeze Macintyre Heritage Reserve Ardua 2018
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.

title: Noble Ridge Meritage 2022
bodyHtml:
The Noble Ridge Meritage originates from the Okanagan Falls subregion of the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. Founded by Jim and Leslie D’Andrea in 2001, the winery is named for the 'noble' grape varieties it produces and the prominent glacial ridge that divides its estate. The winemaking philosophy focuses on quality over quantity, utilizing small-lot, hands-on techniques and a gravity-fed cellar to preserve the authentic character and terroir of the vineyard.

Wine Description

This Meritage presents a deep garnet colour and offers explosive aromas of plush plum, dark cherry, and blackcurrant, accented by hints of graphite, dried sage, and cocoa. On the palate, the wine is supple and structured, showcasing a rich profile of field berries and black forest cake. It is a medium to full bodied red with fine-grained tannins and well-integrated oak from 12 months of aging in a combination of French and American barrels.

Food Pairing

This structured red blend pairs beautifully with hearty dishes such as shepherd's pie, pizza with rich toppings, and grilled meats like steak or lamb. It also complements savoury options such as a steak baguette with Dijon mayonnaise or roasted venison.

title: Fabien Jouves Haute Cote de Fruit 2023
bodyHtml:
Fabien Jouves Cahors Haute Côte de Fruit is a monovarietal natural Malbec red wine classified as a Vin de France, in the area of Cahors, and produced by Mas del Périé Fabien Jouves. Mas del Périé Fabien Jouves is a winery located on the slopes of Trespoux, in Cahors. Its plots are cultivated biodynamically in order to fully respect nature, the vine and its surroundings. It is run by Fabien Jouves, a young winemaker who founded it in 2006 and who makes the wines naturally, without oenological contributions, and accompanying the wine until maturity, fermenting it and ageing it in concrete tanks, foudres and barrels. The vineyards for Fabien Jouves Cahors Haute Côte de Fruit have an average age of 25 years. They are cultivated biodynamically, their total area is about 3 hectares and they are harvested manually.

Fabien Jouves Cahors Haute Côte de Fruit is a natural fruity red, with silky tannins and a deep finish.

title: Brewer Clifton Pinot Noir Santa Rita Hills 2022
Chateau Mauvesin Barton 2015
bodyHtml:
General Information

The fifth vintage from this estate since its purchase by the Barton family of L√©oville Barton in Saint-Julien, this is a generous, structured wine. It has ripe black fruits in profusion that are held together by the serious layer of tannins. Rich and concentrated, the wine will age for many years. Drink from 2024.

title: Lolea RED Sangria
bodyHtml:
Sangria is a traditional and popular drink in many Spanish towns. It's an integral part of the country's culture, especially in summer because it's a refreshing drink, synonymous with the beach, sun and sea.

Each household in Spain has its own sangria recipe and at LOLEA they have their own secret blend, fully artisan, a perfect combination of wine and fruit with a frizzante touch. LOLEA brings a sophisticated touch with style and taste.

LOLEA sets itself apart from all other sangrias. It smells like a fresh, young wine with notes of cherry, orange peel, lemon drops, cinnamon and sour strawberry. Its intense, pleasant aromas are married with crisps nuances of grapes and sweet fruit. But the best has yet to come. Full-bodied and ample on the palate, followed by the experience of a wide array of ripe red berries and blue flowers, where you appreciate the noblest part of the wine and tannins.

title: Gerard Bertrand Cote des Roses Rose 2023 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: It's time to go big! A soft, pale, brilliant pink with bluish tints developing over time towards more orangey nuances. The bouquet releases aromas of summer fruits, cassis, and redcurrant. Floral notes of rose along with hints of grapefruit complete the picture. The finish is fresh, offering notes of candy. On the palate, the impression is fresh and full, with great aromatic persistence and balance.

title: Crown Royal XO
bodyHtml:
Fifty of the finest whiskies are finished in cognac casks to develop this exquisite expression of Crown Royal. Pouring a rich gold it opens with a chorus of vanilla and light oak. The palate is balanced with dried fruit and caramel followed by a medium-length and smooth finish that replays the delicate vanilla notes.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Castarede Armagnac 1976
bodyHtml: The Armagnac Castarede comes from the Castarede family, who have been running their winery in the Armagnac region of France since 1832. The nose is rich with stewed fruits, cedary oak and enticing aromas of pecans, honey, plums and white pepper. After some time, sweeter notes of vanilla, sticky dates, and old muscat develop. The palate is silky and elegant with dried fruits, bread pudding, toffee and baking spices with gentle fine tannins on the finish. Great finesse and surprisingly delicate for an old Armagnac.

title: Volver Tempranillo Single Vineyard 2018
bodyHtml:
Intense purple color. Aromas of tobacco, licorice and blackcurrants. Full-bodied with hints of toast and mature fruit. Long balanced finish.  Volver Single Vineyard, the finest wine produced in La Mancha, is the expressions of the unique terroir of Finca Los Juncares, an old Tempranillo vineyard planted in some of the poorest soils in Spain.

92 Points - Vinous    Saturated violet. Powerful aromas of dark berry liqueur, potpourri and vanilla, plus woodsmoke and mineral overtones. Juicy and seamless on the palate, offering intense blackberry and bitter cherry flavors that become sweeter with air. Finishes with sharp clarity and very good length, leaving lavender, mocha and cola notes behind.

title: Bodegas Aroa Le Naturel Red Blend 2024
bodyHtml: Clean and bright wine where beautiful raspberry tones dominate, which is surprising for a red wine. It is fresh and sound on nose, with a good intensity; notes of blackberries and violets stand out. On palate it has a fresh, fruity attack that is proof of its origin from high-altitude vineyards. It has a very pleasant mid-palate, and it is a light and very easy-drinking wine.

title: Tanqueray Flor De Sevilla Gin
bodyHtml: A sun-kissed gin made with Seville oranges and orange blossom, giving it delicious flavours of the Mediterranean. Try pairing this with Mediterranean tonic, or using it to give a citrus twist to classic gin cocktails. Flor de Sevilla comes in the iconic Tanqueray bottle that was originally inspired by a three-part cocktail shaker.

title: Summer Water Rose 2023
bodyHtml: Fresh and crisp aromas of melon, pink rose petals, citrus peel and strawberry pop on the nose, while the palate picks up a lightly rocky minerality before fresh citrus cuts into emergent stone fruit flavours on the finish.

title: Planeta Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Planeta Rose originates from Italy, within the Sicily region and the Menfi subregion. The estate was established in 1995 and is currently guided by head oenologist Alessio Planeta. The family's winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the vibrant essence of a Sicilian summer by utilizing sustainable viticulture and exploring diverse territories across the island.

Wine Description

This rosé wine presents a delicate pearl pink or soft sunset pink appearance and possesses a light-to-medium body with a supple, smooth texture. The sensory profile is incredibly fresh, lively, and expressive, opening with an aromatic nose of hibiscus, dog rose, wild strawberries, and pomegranate, backed by deeper hints of currants, melon, and pineapple. On the soft, round palate, it delivers crisp flavours of wild berries, grapefruit, and pale-fleshed peaches mixed with a subtle hint of savory meringue and a salty mineral edge. The finish is clean, fruity, and delightfully tangy, leaving a refreshing trail of lime and inner flowers.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional blend of 50% Nero d'Avola and 50% Syrah, occasionally supplemented with a minor touch of Sauvignon Blanc depending on the label restyling.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its friendly, easy-drinking character and remarkable balance. Crafted similarly to a white wine, it undergoes a very brief skin maceration of about one hour for delicate colour extraction before fermenting and refining entirely on its fine lees in stainless steel tanks to emphasize pure fruit vibrancy.

  • ABV: 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: This estate bottling is officially certified organic and follows the strict criteria of the local SOStain sustainability protocol.

Food Pairing

The bright acidity, smooth texture, and elegant red fruit notes of this Sicilian rosé make it a marvellously versatile selection for warm weather dining.

  • Snacks & Starters: A perfect match for summer afternoon snacks, toasted almonds, quality potato chips, and Nocellara del Belice olives.

  • Seafood: Suggested pairings include fried seafood, vegetable tempura, raw fish, fresh sushi, or a warm octopus and potato salad.

  • Light Fare: Complements fresh garden salads, light pasta dishes, tapas, and traditional Sicilian street foods.

title: Mascota Santa Ana Unanime 2021
bodyHtml: This wines tannins are soft and supple, notes of savoury fruits, ripe with black liquorice, black cherries, toasted cedar and a slightly resinous finish. Pairs well with barbecued meats.

title: Santa Ema Cabernet Sauvignon Gran Reserve 2022
bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon comes from the Maipo Valley. Its aromas show red fruits, such as sour cherries and prunes, mingled with notes of mint, tobacco and toast. On the palate the wine has a great structure with ripe tannins and a long persistence. It pairs perfectly with grilled red meats, spicy dishes and ripe cheeses.

title: Pittnauer Rose Koenig 2024
bodyHtml:
Gerhard Pittnauer took over the reins of his family's winery in Gols at a difficult time with the unexpected death of his father. Only 18 years old and figuring things out as he went, Gerhard had to learn fast as Austria was in the midst of a devastating wine scandal that had rocked the Austrian wine industry. Consumer confidence was low, so young Gerhard needed to focus on finding a clear direction. He decided from the onset to experiment with Austria’s local varieties. Impressed by the great wines of France, he set out to apply sustainable and biodynamic methods. Manually farming 15 hectares of vines (half of which are rented) and joined by his wife Brigitte, Gerhard strives to create what he calls “living wines”. Combining old-fashioned elbow grease and current technology, in the cellar, the couple use a modern pneumatic press and temperature-controlled steel tanks to preserve the purity of their fruit.

The Pittnauer Rosé is made from Zweigelt. Light and dry, it has spicy red fruit aromas and zesty flavours.

title: Bread & Butter Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from the United States, produced in the California region. Bread & Butter Wines, now a brand under the WX Brands portfolio, operates with the belief that good things in life should be honest and uncomplicated. The winery emphasizes a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes simple pleasures, creating thoughtful wines meant to be enjoyed without overthinking.

Wine Description

The Bread & Butter Pinot Noir displays a translucent ruby colour. The nose is undeniably juicy, bursting with aromas of ripe cherries, raspberries, and a touch of cassis, balanced by delicate hints of cedar and bay leaf. On the palate, the luscious fruit bouquet continues into a rich mouthfeel joined by soft flavours of oak and savoury notes. This medium bodied wine is characterized by its unctuous texture and a beautifully long, smooth finish.

title: Longshot Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Longshot Cabernet Sauvignon is a great red wine choice for the moments we crave in life. Open a bottle and enjoy during a relaxing night, whether you’re watching your favourite TV show or planning your next journey.

This Cabernet Sauvignon is a simply delicious California red wine that bursts with flavours. An intense yet balanced blend of dark fruit aromas with notes of toasted oak and a smooth finish make Longshot Cabernet Sauvignon a bold choice. Follow Your Own Path.

title: Patricius Tokaji 6 Puttonyos 2018 - 500 ml
bodyHtml: Nice aromas of botrytized berries followed by an enormous, high structure and full body. Long, smooth, endless taste and exceptional deepness of peach, apricot and fig character.

title: St. Supery Cabernet Sauvignon Estate Bottled 2022
bodyHtml:
St Supery Estate Vineyards and Winery is a 100% Estate Grown, sustainably farmed winery located primarily in the renowned Rutherford growing region in the heart of Napa Valley. The winery was established by third-generation French vintner, Robert Skalli, who purchased the 1,531-acre Dollarhide Ranch in 1982. St Supery is committed to continuous quality improvement while maintaining Napa Green Winery and Vineyard certifications to protect the environment for future generations.

Wine Description

Opulent purple and red hues are present in this wine. Cassis, black plum and anise aromas combine with subtle vanilla from the toasted oak. Juicy blackberry and black currant flavours mingle with black licorice, espresso and toasted oak in this structured yet elegant Cabernet Sauvignon with velvety tannins.

title: Donna Laura Bramosia Chianti Classico 2023
bodyHtml: With a ruby colour and intense aromas of cherry and red fruit, this Chianti Classico balances ripe fruit and acidity with well-integrated accents of wood and spice. A great match with roasted meats and vegetables and typical Italian cuisine from pizza to pasta.

title: Hakkaisan Yoroshiku Senman Arubeshi Kasutori Shochu - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hakkaisan Yoroshiku Senman Arubeshi Kasutori Shochu is a type of shochu (a distilled spirit) from Japan. It is produced by Hakkaisan Brewery Co. Ltd., a highly regarded brewery founded in 1922 in Niigata Prefecture, which is known for its clean and precise sake. The name 'Yoroshiku Senman Arubeshi' is an old phrase from China meaning 'unlimited fortune'. This particular shochu is a Kasutori type, meaning it is distilled from sake lees (kasu), a by-product of sake production. The brewery applies its premium sake-making craftsmanship to its shochu production.

Shochu Description

This shochu is 100% distilled from only fresh sake lees produced from making Hakkaisan's premium sakes. It is a luxurious, rich-tasting spirit that is matured and mellowed for over three years.

The spirit is distilled through a low-pressure distillation method (reduced-pressure distillation). This technique is typically used to capture delicate aromas. The resulting shochu has a good combination of rich and mellow tastes. It features an aroma and delicate fragrance that is characteristic of Japanese sake. The sensory profile includes perfumed aromas of lychee and pear with a herbal undertone. The palate is earthy and leads to a lingering, creamy, and balanced finish. The ABV (alcohol by volume) is 40%.

title: Longshot Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml: Carefully selected grapes from premier California vineyards give this popular white wine varietal a crisp, elegant taste. This easy-to-sip wine has its own distinct delicate flavour making it famous for its endless pair-ability. A light Pinot Grigio wine with subtle notes of apple and citrus are complemented with hints of lemon resulting in a soft elegant finish.

title: Domaine De Terres Blanches Sancerre Le Vallon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
This white wine originates from France, specifically within the Sancerre appellation in the Loire Valley. Domaine de Terres Blanches is a historic estate located in the village of Bué, now part of the Saget La Perrière family portfolio. The winery is known for its collaboration with the renowned consultant Stéphane Derenoncourt, whose team focuses on precision and highlighting the specific mineral signatures of the region's diverse soils.

Wine Description

The Domaine de Terres Blanches Sancerre Le Vallon Blanc presents a brilliant, light golden color with subtle green reflections. The nose is powerful and frank, characteristic of a high-quality single-vineyard Sauvignon Blanc. It opens with vibrant aromas of citrus fruits, white peach, and green apple, often accompanied by a distinct flinty or smoky minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and well-balanced, showing a rounded, "fat" texture that is offset by a crisp, lively acidity. The finish is remarkably long and clean, leaving a lingering impression of stones and fresh zest. This wine is made from 100% Sauvignon Blanc grown on "caillottes" soil (stony limestone), which enhances its floral and mineral character.

Food Pairing

This wine is a versatile partner for a range of delicate and flavorful dishes. It is a classic match for Crottin de Chavignol goat cheese, as the wine's high acidity cuts through the creamy texture of the cheese. It also pairs exceptionally well with grilled white fish, raw oysters, and sushi. For more adventurous pairings, consider serving it with tandoori chicken or a zesty ceviche, as its mineral backbone and fruit intensity can stand up to light spice and citrus marinades.

title: Saget La Perriere Blanc Fume De Pouilly 2023
La Petite Perriere Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: A shining Sauvignon with sharp green brightness. The nose is elegant without over exuberance, a fair and harmonious expression of white flowers, elder flowers and acacia, balanced with a light minerality. After a silky attack, the middle of the palate wakes up in a pleasant freshness, finishing with fruity notes of white peaches and lychees.

title: Trim Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml: The Trim Chardonnay has aromatics of nectarine, pineapple, lemon blossom and tropical fruit that jump from the glass and are rounded by hints of almond and vanilla. The wine has a lively acidity with stone fruits, buttered apple and brioche that last on the palette. Pair this with creamy pastas, meaty fish, pork, chicken, brie, power-lunches, hammocks, and good books.

title: Malivoire Lady Bug Rose 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Malivoire Wine Company is located on the Beamsville Bench within the Niagara Peninsula of Ontario, Canada. Founded in 1995 by Martin Malivoire, a former motion picture special effects director, the winery is known for its deep commitment to sustainability and its use of gravity flow winemaking. The estate's philosophy focuses on producing uniquely Canadian wines that reflect the specific cool climate terroir of the Niagara Escarpment.

Wine Description

Lady Bug Rose is a dry, medium to full bodied wine with a bright salmon pink colour. The nose is highly aromatic, bursting with notes of fresh strawberry, cherry, and watermelon, along with hints of pink grapefruit and rhubarb. On the palate, the wine is round and juicy, featuring flavours of ripe red berries, pomegranate, and crisp green apple leading to a long, fresh, and herbal finish. It is traditionally crafted from a blend of Cabernet Franc, Gamay, and Pinot Noir, with the exact proportions varying slightly by vintage to maintain its signature crisp and fruity style. This rose is intended for early consumption to capture its vibrant freshness.

title: St Supery Rutherford Merlot 2019
bodyHtml:
St Supéry Estate Vineyards and Winery is a family-owned estate located in the heart of Napa Valley’s Rutherford subregion. Known for its commitment to sustainable farming and estate-grown wines, the winery produces exceptional single-varietal offerings that express the unique character of its vineyards.

This 2019 Merlot is a deep ruby red with aromas of ripe plum, black cherry, and hints of cocoa and dried herbs. On the palate, it offers rich layers of red berry fruit, mocha, and a touch of vanilla from well-integrated oak. The wine is medium to full-bodied with supple tannins and a smooth, lingering finish. Crafted predominantly from Merlot, it is approachable now but has the structure to evolve beautifully over the next 6–8 years. The balance between ripe fruit, acidity, and tannin underscores its finesse and elegance.

Accolades
Wine Spectator – 91 points.
James Suckling – 92 points.

Food Pairing
Enjoy this Merlot with grilled lamb chops, mushroom risotto, or a hearty beef stew. A perfect match to enhance the wine’s complexity.

title: Herradura Silver Tequila
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Despite being made in one of the region's largest distilleries, Herradura tequilas are made from agaves roasted in traditional clay ovens and fermented with ambient yeast. The unusual greenish-straw colour is due to a brief 45 day period of aging in well seasoned American oak barrels.

This is something unusual, a "white" tequila with distinct wood-derived notes, not aged for long enough to be a reposado. The brief aging complements the agave character nicely; rather than smoothing off some of the rough edges, the barrel spice actually accentuates the raw, vegetal character of this tequila, contributing notes of black pepper, coriander and sandalwood.

title: Woodford Reserve Rye
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Rye makes up 53% of the grains in crafting this award-winning traditional Kentucky whiskey. Aromas of rye grain, black pepper, cedar and cinnamon lead to a spicy and complex palate. Notes of ripe apple, mint and black pepper lead to a long and satisfying finish.

See More USA Whisky

title: Louis Jadot Beaune Clos Des Ursules Premier Cru 2020
bodyHtml:
#85 Wine Spectator Top 100 of 2021!  A full, firm, rich wine, Clos des Ursules has aromas of earth and red fruit and perfectly balances elegance and power. It will develop in the bottle for 10 to 15 years. Serve with delicate meat dishes or cheeses.

 95 Points - James Suckling    A tight, savory red with ripe strawberry, cherry and raspberry character. Some chocolate and hazelnut undertones. It’s full-bodied and layered with chewy tannins and a flavorful finish. White pepper just at the end. Better after 2022.

 93 Points - Wilfred Wong of Wine    The 2018 Domaine des Héritiers Louis Jadot Beaune Clos des Ursules shows excellent class and persistence. This wine offers satisfaction on the palate, with its depth and black fruit/forest floor flavors. Pair it with rosemary and garlic-infused roast leg of lamb. 

 93 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate    The 2018 Beaune 1er Cru Clos des Ursules (Domaine des Héritiers Jadot) is showing very well in bottle, unwinding in the glass with a pretty but youthfully reserved bouquet of sweet red berries, plums and cassis, mingled with hints of dark chocolate, warm spices and coniferous forest floor. Medium to full-bodied, supple and enveloping, it's elegant—even polished—with a succulent core of fruit, lively acids and a nicely defined finish. At maturity—which will demand a decade's patience, even if this can be approached sooner—this will be an especially sumptuous Clos des Ursules.

 93 Points - Burghound    This too is quite generously wooded with ample amounts of menthol suffusing the mostly dark berry fruit aromas. The attractively punchy and well-detailed medium weight flavors are notably more refined while offering a subtle minerality on the firmly structured finish. Patience suggested.

 93 Points - Wine Spectator    A lithe, well-defined red, exhibiting cherry, raspberry, earth and spice aromas and flavors. It's balanced and long, with the promise of more charm in 2-3 years. Best from 2024 through 2038.

title: Eigashima Shuzo Shin White Oak Aged Whisky Umeshu - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Eigashima Shuzo Shin White Oak Aged Whisky Umeshu is a plum liqueur from the country of Japan, specifically the region of Hyōgo Prefecture, in the city of Akashi. The producer, Eigashima Shuzo, is one of Japan's oldest family-run distilleries, with a history of making traditional Japanese alcoholic beverages such as sake for over three centuries. Founded in 1888, the company holds Japan's first whisky license, issued in 1919. The distillery is also known as the White Oak Distillery, which overlooks the Seto Inland Sea.

Spirit Description

This product is a sophisticated plum liqueur, an umeshu, which is made using 100% Japanese plums. The process involves brewing the plums with shochu (a Japanese distilled rice beverage) and then maturing the liqueur over time in white oak casks. It is then finished with Akashi whisky. On the nose, it offers rich notes of raisins, plums, and toffee. The palate is described as soft, rich, and sweet with notes of plums, a well-balanced flavour of citrus, and vanilla. The aftertaste features a lingering wooden aroma and distinctive notes of whisky, leading to a short, sweet finish. The Shin White Oak Aged Whisky Umeshu has an ABV of 20.0%.

Food Pairing

This sweet and fruity liqueur, which is a playful twist on a Japanese classic, is versatile for serving. It can be enjoyed neat, served on the rocks, mixed with soda, or used as a modifier in cocktail recipes that call for fruit liqueurs or rich sherry. The rich, well-balanced flavour of citrus and vanilla also suggests a pairing with desserts, as the sweetness and fruit notes would complement a variety of lighter sweets.

title: Akashi White Oak Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Japan, Hyogo Prefecture, Akashi City. Produced at the Eigashima Distillery (formerly White Oak Distillery), this facility is one of Japan's oldest family run distilleries and obtained the nation's first whisky license in 1919. The distillery is unique for being the closest to the sea in Japan and is operated by its ninth generation of owners, who traditionally produce sake and shochu for much of the year.

Description

This blended whisky features an orange amber gold colour and a light, approachable body. The nose offers a malty and citrusy aroma with scents of black cherry, toffee, and warm bread dough. On the palate, it reveals a smooth texture with notes of vanilla, pine nuts, and mild sweetness, alongside subtle hints of spice and cherry bakewells. The finish is medium in length and balanced, leaving a soft warmth with lingering oak and dried stone fruits. ABV 40%.

Food Pairing

The coastal influence and light peat of this whisky make it a natural match for grilled seafood, sushi, and sashimi. It also pairs well with roasted poultry or savory dishes like salted caramel desserts and chocolate peanuts. For a classic Japanese experience, serve it as a highball to complement izakaya style snacks such as fried chicken or edamame.

title: Lolea WHITE Sangria
bodyHtml: A different sangria made with Macabeo and Airen frizzante white wine, Mediterranean citrus and a touch of vanilla. Clear, neat, bright and attractive with a fine constant bubble. Keeping its fresh wine essence, with a touch of vanilla, jasmine and apricot. Perfect balance between bitterness and sweetness.

title: Don Simon Sangria 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml: Sangria is the traditional drink of Spain, made ​​from red wine and natural fruit extracts without preservatives and dyes. Dark red colour and fresh taste. Served cold, it is the ultimate year-round drink.

title: Klinker Brick Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon exhibits dark garnet color with leather aromas accompanied with hints of subtle cinnamon and smoked cherry wood. On the palate, notes of lingonberry and dark cherry. Fully integrated and well balanced, this wine has great tannin with a long, lingering finish.

93 Points - Wine Enthusiast

title: Catena Alta 'Historic Rows' Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Produced in Argentina, this wine is sourced from the prestigious Mendoza region, specifically from high altitude vineyards in the Luján de Cuyo and Uco Valley subregions. Founded in 1902 by Nicola Catena, Bodega Catena Zapata is a family owned estate now led by fourth generation physician and vintner Dr. Laura Catena. The winery is globally recognized for its pioneering research into high altitude viticulture and its philosophy of 'extreme' terroir to produce wines with deep concentration and natural elegance.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep garnet color with vibrant purple highlights. The bouquet is highly aromatic, revealing intense notes of currant marmalade, ripe raspberries, and cassis, layered with complex undertones of pepper, clove, and subtle cedar. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and rich, offering a supple flow that balances bold, velvety tannins with a taut acidity. The finish is long and flavorful, showing integrated notes of tobacco and leather.

title: Giffard Caribbean Pineapple
bodyHtml: Liqueur made from a subtle blend of fresh pineapples ripened under the Caribbean sun infusion, reinforced by a candied pineapples infusion, all enhanced by a 7-year-old Caribbean Rum and some spices.

title: Ancho Reyes Verde
bodyHtml: Though made from the same poblano chile, the Verde uses early-harvested green chiles, whereas the original uses the late-harvested ones dried in the sun. As a result, Ancho Reyes Verde is vibrant and fresh-tasting, more "green pepper" than smoky pepper — but with a heat that spicy cocktail fans will love.

title: William Fevre Petite Chablis 2023
bodyHtml: Cool and crisp lime and peaches with a very polished feel to it. There's a handy array of crisp peaches and lime citrus on offer with an easygoing, crisp and tangy palate with lime.

title: Errazuriz Don Maximiano Founder's Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' red wine originates from Chile, within the prestigious Aconcagua Valley A.O. appellation. Produced by Viña Errázuriz an iconic founding estate established in 1870 by Don Maximiano Errázuriz and celebrated worldwide as a pioneer of world-class Chilean viticulture "Don Maximiano Founder's Reserve" serves as the winery's flagship flagship icon wine. Sourced from choice, hillside estate vineyard blocks (Max I, Max II, Max V) rooted in deep, well-draining soils of volcanic and colluvial origin with high granite and gravel content, the vines benefit from a ideal Mediterranean microclimate. Warm, sun-drenched days are tempered by cool afternoon breezes blowing directly off the Pacific Ocean and descending off the Andes Mountains, enabling late-ripening Bordeaux varieties to achieve complete phenolic maturity while preserving a razor-sharp natural acidity and noble structural poise.

Wine Description

The 2022 Errazuriz Don Maximiano Founder's Reserve presents an opaque, deep black-ruby color in the glass with vivid magenta and purple reflections along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally bold, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and regal portrait of the Aconcagua Valley's hillside terroir. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of ripe cassis, wild blackberries, and dark cherry compote, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of fresh violets, cigar box, graphite, cedar, dark chocolate, dried herbs, and a distinct line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, athletic, and linear, showcasing a succulent core of dark berries, blood orange peel, and savory spices. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and an incisive, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its mid-palate fruit concentration. The mouthfeel is broad, weightless, and silky, framed by firm, fine-grained, and polished tannins that glide into an extraordinarily long, dry, and mineral-driven finish accented by persistent notes of tobacco leaf, cocoa nibs, and toasted cedar.

This high-definition Chilean expression is a classical Bordeaux-style assemblage dominated by Cabernet Sauvignon:

  • Cabernet Sauvignon (~65%–70%): Formulates the primary architectural core, contributing dark cassis purity, structural volume, graphite focus, and age-worthy tannic grip.

  • Malbec, Cabernet Franc, & Syrah (~30%–35%): Malbec adds lush black fruit density and violet lift, Cabernet Franc supplies herbal perfume and silky tannic refinement, while Syrah imparts subtle savory spice and dark plum flesh.

The hand-harvested fruit underwent rigorous manual sorting followed by temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats with extended skin contact to extract rich color and noble phenolics. To polish its structural frame while imparting sweet oak warmth, the wine completed full malolactic conversion and was matured for 20 to 22 months in select French oak barrels (approximately 65% to 70% new wood) before master blending and bottling. It reaches an effortlessly integrated, food-friendly alcohol content (ABV) of 13.5% to 14.0% and is finished bone-dry.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 growing season in the Aconcagua Valley was characterized by dry, cool-to-moderate temperatures that permitted an extended, slow ripening phase. This allowed Cabernet Sauvignon and its blending partners to achieve perfect seed maturity, balanced sugars, and high natural acidity with immaculate fruit purity. Errázuriz’s hillside vineyards and masterclass in French oak aging crafted a wine of exceptional finesse and structural longevity. The 2022 Errazuriz Don Maximiano Founder's Reserve offers immediate, high-energy drinking pleasure upon release and possesses the structural depth to cellar and evolve gracefully over the next 20 to 30 years.

title: Santa Rita Cabernet Sauvignon Casa Real 2021
bodyHtml:
Santa Rita Cabernet Sauvignon Casa Real originates from Chile, specifically from the Maipo Valley and the Alto Jahuel subregion. First launched in 1989, this label represents the 'icon' wine of Viña Santa Rita, one of Chile's most historic wineries. The winemaking philosophy for Casa Real focuses on capturing the unique character of the estate's oldest vineyards, producing a wine with profound aging potential that reflects the Mediterranean climate and gravelly alluvial soils of the Maipo Valley.

Wine Description

This red wine is a flagship expression of Chilean viticulture, typically displaying a deep and concentrated ruby colour. The sensory profile is elegant and multi layered, featuring an aromatic nose of blackcurrants, cherries, and plums, often accompanied by notes of cedar, graphite, tobacco, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, it is full bodied and powerful yet refined, with a structural balance provided by firm, well integrated tannins and a refreshing acidity. The finish is exceptionally long and persistent, highlighting the fruit purity and mineral depth of the terroir.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is aged for approximately 16 to 20 months in new French oak barrels, a process that enhances its complexity and longevity while maintaining varietal focus.

  • ABV: Typically ranges between 14% and 14.5%.

  • Organic Status: While Santa Rita employs sustainable viticulture across its holdings, this icon wine is specifically focused on traditional, high quality production from ancient vine plots.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and intense fruit profile of Casa Real make it an ideal companion for high intensity, savoury dishes.

  • Meats: It pairs excellently with grilled ribeye steak, herb crusted rack of lamb, or roasted venison.

  • Savoury and Rich: Suggested pairings include beef Wellington or traditional hearty Chilean stews like 'cazuela'.

  • Cheese: Complements mature hard cheeses such as aged Manchego or extra old cheddar.

title: Twomey Pinot Noir Russian River 2022
bodyHtml:
Twomey was founded by the Duncan Family of Silver Oak to make dynamic, vineyard-focused wines. Brothers David, Tim, Kevin and Mike founded Twomey Cellars as a Duncan family venture in 1999. Proprietors David and Tim oversee day-to-day operations at the winery. Over the years, their passion for Pinot Noir opened exciting new doors to cool-climate vineyard opportunities.
 
With each vineyard, the goal is always to craft wines that reflect a delicate balance among a vineyard’s unique micro-climate, soil profile and the human hand, all while capturing the classic character of their respective growing regions. Farming with long-term respect for the environment plays a critical role in fruit character and quality. With wines focused on capturing the essence of a place, their farming techniques focus on proven methods, from advanced water conservation technologies to cover crops, fish-friendly farming and integrated pest management that protect the land for future generations.
 
Ruby red in appearance. Aromas of red and black cherry, rose, and cedar exude from the glass. Broad, lush and juicy upon entry with silky, supporting tannins on the mid-palate. Rich, fine tannins that culminate into a spicy and savoury finish.

title: Rodney Strong Cabernet Sauvignon Alexander's Crown 2017
bodyHtml: Alexander’s Crown exhibits ripe flavours of black currant, blackberries and violets. The wine is voluptuous, and has a rich mouthfeel, soft tannins and a long lingering finish with notes of dried herbs and a touch of mocha.

title: The Naked Malt
bodyHtml: Double matured in 100% first-fill sherry casks with a blend of  3 Iconic Award Winning Single Malt Whiskies: The Macallan, Highland Park and Glenturret. Bursting with flavours of currants, chocolate, and baked apples.

title: Cafaggio Chianti Classico 2020
bodyHtml: A deliciously concentrated example of Chianti Classico, this has dark ruby colour and rich notes of black cherry, fruitcake and plum on the palate. Serve this wine at room temperature. It makes a versatile partner for lots of savoury dishes, but do try it above all with meaty pasta dishes, roast game or poultry and mature cheeses. This wine has been released ready to drink.

title: Undurraga T.H. Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml: A cedary and expressive Cabernet Sauvignon, with aromas of ripe blackcurrants and fresh berries, graphite notes and the subtle herbal hints characteristic of Cabernet Sauvignon wines from cool areas in Maipo. Refined and soft on the palate, the wine has tense, structured tannins and a subtle influence of fine oak.

title: Stina Cuvee Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
Stina Winery opened on Broc Island in 2009 when Jako Vino rented a building from the Agricultural Cooperative of Bol, on the Dalmatian coast. Wine had been made in the building, “The first Dalmatian Wine Cooperative” since 1901.

A beautiful medium body red, with a harmonious balance of fruity, acidity and structure. The taste is dominated by fresh dark berries and a blend of intriguing Mediterranean herbs aromas and spice. Great companion for charcuterie platters, lighter meat and tomato-based meals.

title: Bread & Butter Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Bread & Butter Chardonnay originates from the United States, within the California region. The brand operates under the guiding belief that good things do not need to be complicated, focusing on creating honest, simple, and delicious selections meant to be easily enjoyed. The winemaking process is led by veteran winemaker Linda Trotta, who uses her decades of domestic and international experience to shape an unapologetically classic and approachable style.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a vibrant golden appearance in the glass and possesses a heavy, full-bodied structure with a lush, creamy, and silky mouthfeel. The sensory profile is highly expressive, rich, and decadent, opening with an intense nose of ripe yellow peaches, baked apples, and tropical mango, beautifully framed by rich aromas of warm vanilla bean, sweet cream, and toasted brioche. On the indulgent palate, it delivers deep flavours of Meyer lemon, stone fruit, and lemon curd, merging effortlessly into a mid-palate reminiscent of crème brûlée, caramel, and pie crust. The finish is long, smooth, and persistent, leaving a lingering, sweet impression of butterscotch, vanilla, and toasted oak presence.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its crowd-pleasing familiarity and bold flavor delivery, balancing its rich oak-driven notes with a structured, soft acidity. To achieve its signature round and creamy framework, the wine undergoes a partial malolactic fermentation followed by careful aging in a combination of American and French oak barrels.

  • ABV: 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery prioritizes clean, straightforward fruit selection to capture the familiar profile consumers crave, this commercial release is not certified organic.

title: Michele Chiarlo Nivole Semi-Sparkling Moscato D'Asti 2024
bodyHtml:
Michele Chiarlo Nivole Semi-Sparkling Moscato d'Asti is a sweet, lightly sparkling wine from the Piedmont region in northern Italy. Crafted by the esteemed Michele Chiarlo winery, this Moscato d'Asti is celebrated for its aromatic complexity and refreshing character.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Pale straw yellow with a delicate effervescence.

  • Aroma: Opens with inviting aromas of ripe peach, apricot, and citrus blossoms, complemented by subtle hints of honey and white flowers.

  • Palate: Light-bodied with a creamy texture, offering flavors of juicy stone fruits, citrus zest, and a touch of tropical pineapple. The gentle sparkle enhances its refreshing quality.

  • Finish: Clean and crisp, with a lingering sweetness balanced by bright acidity.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Serve chilled, around 8-10°C (46-50°F), to fully appreciate its aromatic complexity.

  • Glassware: Use a tulip-shaped glass to concentrate the aromas.

  • Food Pairings: Pairs excellently with fresh pastries, fruit-based desserts, and soft cheeses. Also delightful as an aperitif or with light appetizers.

title: Laurent Miquel Vendanges Nocturnes Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
​The Laurent Miquel Vendanges Nocturnes Blanc is a distinguished white wine from the Languedoc region in Southern France. Crafted by Laurent Miquel, a winemaker representing the eighth generation of his family, this wine embodies a harmonious blend of tradition and innovation. The Miquel family's commitment to quality and sustainable viticulture is evident in their practice of harvesting grapes at night—'Vendanges Nocturnes' translates to 'Night Harvest'—to preserve the grapes' freshness and aromatic potential.

Sensory Profile

This wine presents a light, crisp, and steely character, with a cascade of citrus notes flooding the senses. Aromas and flavors of lemon, lime, Fiji pear, and apple intermingle, creating a vibrant and refreshing experience. A subtle creamy mouthfeel with a hint of banana adds complexity, making it an ideal midweek refresher.

title: Tinto Nero Malbec Calizo 2022
bodyHtml: Purplish red in colour, this red boasts an intense nose exuding woody, empyreumatic, spicy, floral and fruity aromas. Discover this full-bodied wine expressing lively acidity and offering a broad texture and fleshy tannins. It also unveils an intense mouthfeel that leads to a long finish.

title: Colossal Reserva Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml: Big, bold and spicy, living up to its name, this is a powerful wine influenced by the rich Alicante Bouschet in the blend. The wine has weight, concentration and further aging potential.

title: Carpineto Dogajolo Rosso 2021 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: The Dogajolo Rosso is a bright and intense ruby red, which swirls in the glass with good body and consistency. The excellent anthocyanin concentration of Sangiovese is pleasantly recognizable here. The finesse of the olfactory scents is further confirmed by the retro-nasal scents. Each sip is full-bodied and satisfying. The tannin is well dosed and pleasantly accompanied by a freshness that contributes to making this wine decidedly balanced and persistent. The Dogajolo Rosso pairs with well-seasoned meats, roasts, and regional Tuscan cuisine, from game to grilled meats. The Dogajolo Rosso is the perfect companion for multiple traditional Italian dishes thanks to its pleasant fruitiness as well as full-bodied character.

title: Pingus PSI Tempranillo 2022
bodyHtml: PSI is the 23rd letter in the Greek alphabet and is the name of Peter Sisseck's of the coveted Pingus and Flor de Pingus utopian wine from Ribera del Duero. Peter has sought out the best independent vineyard growers in Ribera and is incentivizing them to improve viticultural practices and shun chemicals, lower yields and practice biodynamics by paying them increasingly for the fruit as they improve. The result is a "give back" to the region wine that also expresses the "soul" of Ribera.

title: Roger Perrin Cotes du Rhone Villages Vieilles Vignes 2019
bodyHtml:
Intense garnet color. Scents of garrigue, red and black fruits, peppered spices, with slight scents of blond tobacco and fur. The entry has presence of fruits, scents of garrigue, and dominant peppers. The middle of the mouth is generous and ample, the finish is long and persistent.

Blend: 75% Grenache, 20% Syrah, 5% Mourvedre

title: Bleasdale Cabernet Sauvignon Mulberry Tree 2023
bodyHtml: Established in 1850 by Frank Potts, Bleasdale is the spiritual home of Langhorne Creek, proud of its independence, endeavour and belief in the virtues of the region. The philosophy of the Bleasdale winemaking team is to capture the essence of what makes Langhorne Creek red wines so attractive ... vibrancy, harmony and texture.

title: Terre Del Barolo 2020
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Made from the Nebbiolo grape, it possesses brisk acidity, somewhat fierce tannins, and plenty of body. Scents of dried flowers, plum and cherry fruit, liquorice and a classic note of tar adorn the nose. The flavours are similar, with high raspy acidity, very chewy firm tannins and a long finish that has a bite. What you need to do is enjoy some great savoury food, like cured meat, aged parmigiano reggiano, osso buco, or risotto with mushrooms. This wine is transformed by food! This is an outstanding value for Barolo.

title: Frey Assemblage Red Blend 2016
bodyHtml:
Frey Assemblage is a powerful and bold blend of Cabernet Sauvignon & Merlot.
Big structure with flavours of dark chocolate and tobacco. Hints of smoke and toasty aromas

title: Ruffino Chianti Classico Riserva Gran Selezione Ducale Oro 2021
bodyHtml: Ruby red with garnet hues. The wine expresses a distinctive Tuscan bouquet of violet, cherry, and plum, with aromas of chocolate and spice. Intense aromas of violet, blackberry, cherry, and ripe plum with intriguing notes of cinnamon and clove. Classic elegance and structure in which the fruit, tannins, and spices form a tightly woven balance, with a lingering finish of chocolate and coffee.

title: Izadi Reserva Red 2020
bodyHtml:
