Bodegas Izadi was established by Gonzalo Antón and friends in 1987, born from a passion for gastronomy and a great appreciation for the nature of Rioja Alavesa. The winery’s name, Izadi, means 'nature' in Basque, which reflects its core philosophy of respecting the environment and the fruit.

Wine Description

The wine is medium to full bodied and smooth, revealing layers of juicy dark berries and plush chocolate nuances on the palate. It is well-structured with balanced acidity and creamy, refined tannins. The finish is long, elegant, and tightly structured, lingering with notes of cherry, plum, toasted hazelnut, chocolate, and orange peel. 

Food Pairing

The Izadi Reserva is full-bodied with a structure that pairs well with hearty meals and rich flavours. Suggested pairings include grilled red meats, roast lamb, and aged, hard cheeses such as Manchego.

title: Frey Riesling 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from the Rheinhessen region of Germany, specifically the subregion of Ober-Flörsheim, this wine is a product of the historic Frey winery. For four generations, the family has cultivated vines in this high-elevation municipality, with viticultural roots stretching back to the 18th century. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on expressive, site-specific wines that reflect the unique character of the highest elevated village in the region.

Wine Description

This Riesling presents a pale, clear straw colour with an expressive aromatic profile of lime cordial, green apple, peach, and apricot. On the palate, it is vibrant and well-balanced, featuring layers of honeydew melon and zesty citrus. The body is light yet structured, leading to a crisp finish with a slight hint of tartness that provides excellent freshness.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs exceptionally well with roasted root vegetables or seasoned squashes.

title: Cordero Montezemolo Langhe Nebbiolo 2023
bodyHtml: Bright violet of medium intensity; aromas of raspberry, strawberry and violet. Fresh and robust, full flavor and soft tannins. Excellent to pair with agnolotti (small ravioli) with ragu, flavorful risottos, fettuccine, meat stews, meat dishes from veal chops to lamb or roasted goat or fowl with mushrooms, rabbit with peppers.

title: Castoro De Oro Merlot 2020
bodyHtml:
They’ve been around awhile in the winery business. They started the winery in January of 2006, and opened their wine shop a few months later in April. They have seen a lot, done a lot, worked a lot and enjoyed a lot of wine. Family owned, they are true vignerons. They make wine from grapes they grow. Simply, they are farmers who like to make good wine.

Beautiful rich colour, this Merlot has notes of plum, boysenberry, raspberry, black cherry, clove, nutmeg and vanilla. This complexity lends to the wine’s ability to age extremely well.

title: Chateau Brande Bergere Cuvee O'Byrne 2015
bodyHtml: Deep red in colour, well structured, round, and very elegant. Beautiful attack, ample, with a hint of acidity. The aromas are of blackberry and raspberry, and there is a nice sweetness in the finish.

title: Tandem Casual Rose 2024
bodyHtml: Tandem Casual shows a beautiful pale pink colour with a light violet rim. Complex nose with exuberant red fruit, candy, and red rose petal. A mouth-filling palate, fresh with a long finish.

title: Cannonball Merlot 2021
bodyHtml:
Cannonball Merlot originates from the United States, primarily within the California region and the Mendocino County subregion. Founded in 2006 by entrepreneur Yoav Gilat and winemaker Dennis Hill, the winery was established with a vision to create approachable, high quality wines that over deliver for their price point. The winemaking philosophy focuses on an uninhibited and fun style, symbolized by the iconic 'cannonball' child on the label, while maintaining a commitment to sustainable and responsible farming practices.

Wine Description

This wine typically presents a medium to deep ruby colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is fruit forward, featuring scents of fresh huckleberry, ripe plum, and cherry, accented by notes of cocoa, black tea, and toasty French oak. On the medium to full bodied palate, it is lush and sophisticated, delivering flavours of raspberry jam, dark stone fruits, and baking spices such as clove and cardamom. The structure is defined by soft, supple tannins and a refreshing acidity that leads to a long, savoury finish.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically a blend dominated by Merlot, often 85% to 100%, sometimes including small amounts of Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, or Petite Sirah to enhance colour and structure.

  • ABV: Generally ranges between 13.5% and 14.5% depending on the vintage.

  • Organic Status: While the winery is committed to sustainable farming, this specific wine is not typically certified organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: Matured for approximately 20 months in French oak with a 'light touch' of 20% new oak to preserve fruit purity and complexity.

title: Case Paolin Cabernet Sauvignon Veneto 2023
Moon Curser Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml: Dry, medium to full-bodied red wine with deep ruby colour. The nose consists of cassis, blackberry and licorice. The palate follows the nose with blueberry, some mint characteristics and a little spice. The wine has good structure, soft ripe tannin, and a textured palate weight creating an elegant mouthfeel.

title: Luigi Bosca La Linda Malbec 2025
bodyHtml: Malbec has been grown in the high valleys of the Andes for a long time today the old vines producing complexity and richness. The nose has a mix of black fruits rich and ripe the palate black plum, black truffles and dark chocolate the tannins are fine and integrated the mid palate supple, fleshy with velvet smoothness. Bilberry towards the back balances the richness but it finishes with a mix of fleshy black fruits. The decision is easy beef, venison and duck.

title: Protea Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
The Protea Cabernet Sauvignon is a vibrant red wine from the Western Cape of South Africa, with grapes primarily sourced from the Groenekloof ward in the Darling region. Produced by Anthonij Rupert Wyne, the estate was originally owned by the late Anthonij Rupert before being taken over by his brother, Johann Rupert, in 2003. The winery is dedicated to combining high-quality viticulture with a philosophy of sustainability and conservation, often highlighted by their iconic floral-inspired packaging.

Wine Description

This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep ruby colour with youthful purple highlights. On the nose, it offers inviting aromas of blackcurrant, ripe plum, and blackberry, layered with complex notes of dark cocoa, tobacco leaf, and subtle spice. The palate is medium to full-bodied and supple, featuring juicy dark fruit flavours of cherry and cassis complemented by nuances of cedar and graphite. It is well-integrated with a firm backbone and fine tannins that lead to a long, harmonious finish.

Food Pairing

This wine's robust structure and dark fruit profile make it an excellent companion for grilled red meats, such as beef steak, lamb chops, or burgers. It also pairs exceptionally well with hearty comfort foods like beef lasagne or aged cheddar cheese.

title: Gerard Tremblay Chablis Vieilles Vignes 2025
bodyHtml: Gérard Tremblay is the 5th generation owner of this Domaine in Chablis. Under his ownership, the property has grown from 30 acres to 100 acres, 30 acres being first cru and Grand Cru sites. Gerard is very passionate and a purist. He uses “Lutte raisonnée” sustainable viticulture and takes a lot of care in plowing to preserve the terroir. This gives the Chardonnay a special, vibrant personality due to the subsoil (Kimmeridgian limestone/fossilized shells).

title: Tinhorn Creek Syrah Reserve 2020
bodyHtml: Enjoy a striking combination of fruit and spice aromas on the nose with fresh prune plums, blueberries and hints of black pepper. Layers of raspberry compote, mocha and toasty oak come through next, showing the richness of the wine. The palate is soft and textured with more plum jam and a berry medley coming through in a fresh lifted style. A smooth drinkable style with a savoury Okanagan finish of olive tapenade and smoked, cured meats.

title: Protea Chenin Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: Aromas of fresh apricot and nectarine mingle with ripe quince notes. Juicy and bright, the palate offers up succulent nectarine, melon and vibrant lemon. Approachable, light and succulent, there is great harmony between the fruit and acidity. The appeal continues with satisfying length and gentle pear drop nuance on the finish.

title: Protea Dry Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Protea Dry Rose originates from the Western Cape of South Africa, specifically sourced from vineyards in the Swartland and Franschhoek Valley. Originally owned by the late Anthonij Rupert, the estate was taken over by his brother Johann Rupert in 2003, who constructed a state of the art facility that modernized their production. The winery is committed to sustainability and the conservation of its terroir, producing the Protea range as a tribute to South Africa's national flower and the unique floral diversity of the region.

Wine Description

This elegant rose presents a pale pink to subtle blush hue in the glass. The bouquet is impressively fruity, offering vibrant aromas of strawberry, raspberry, and peach, complemented by nuances of apple blossom and grapefruit pith. On the palate, the wine is juicy and fresh, displaying flavors of ripe berries, citrus peel, and a hint of Turkish Delight. It is medium bodied with a creamy texture and a lively acidity that leads into a clean, spiced finish with notes of orange peel and pink peppercorns.

Food Pairing

This dry rose is an excellent accompaniment to seafood dishes such as braised salmon, white fish, or grilled shrimp with lemon. It also pairs beautifully with soft cheeses like Brie or Camembert and light summer salads.

title: Achaval Ferrer Quimera 2022
bodyHtml:
Quimera is architecture and design; it is a unique warm-blend that was conceived at the vineyard. Every year Santiago and Roberto look for the meaning within the earth in the search for the impossible wine, making it unique year after year. This resulting in a wine with deep shades, aromas that range from stony and earthy, of dark fruit, up to delicate rosemary hints. It is ample in the palate, with delicious and almost feminine acidity.

Wine Description

The wine presents a dark, medium-ruby colour. The sensory profile is complex, offering aromas of ripe blackberries, black plum, chocolate, tobacco, and coffee, with stony, earthy, and delicate rosemary accents. On the palate, it is described as plush, broad, rich, and juicy, with concentrated dark-plum and dark berry flavours that are nicely integrated.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for 'Quimera' include roasted meats, roast lamb, grilled poultry, hearty stews, and strong or mature cheeses.

title: Bodegas Salentein Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve 2023
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Aromas and flavours of Cabernet Sauvignon, with pronounced accents of black pepper and blackcurrant. Fleshy, with fine tannins and elegant structure as well as a pleasant, lingering finish. Great with Portobello mushroom burger or lamb chops.

title: River Retreat Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
River Retreat Chardonnay originates from the Murray Darling region of Australia, specifically within the Big Rivers zone of New South Wales. Produced by Trentham Estate, this range is part of a dedicated initiative to raise awareness and support for the unique, fragile wetlands of the Murray Darling Basin. The winery's philosophy emphasizes sustainable practices, with proceeds from every bottle donated to the Murray Darling Wetlands Working Group to help maintain these vital inland ecosystems.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a light straw colour in the glass. The nose is greeted with enticing aromas of stone fruit and melon, offering a vibrant and fresh introduction. On the palate, the wine is soft and fruit-driven, showcasing plentiful flavours of nectarine and peach. It is characterized by its excellent balance and length, providing a smooth, approachable style that highlights the varietal's natural freshness.

title: Folk Machine Parts and Labor Red Blend 2018
bodyHtml: Since 2002, The Folk Machine has been a family-owned and independently operated winery based in the historic Roseland neighbourhood of Santa Rosa. Stylistically, The Folk Machine makes artisanally crafted wines of integrity and charm that respect their role at the table. This means they are true to character and origin, generally moderate in alcohol, and noticeable in acidity. In this vintage, there is a good amount of whole cluster and carbonic maceration through the lots keeping everything fresh and fun. As always, the blend was made immediately after harvest and the wine was aged in a combination of French oak foudres and stainless steel tanks.

title: Tandem Macula Red 2012
bodyHtml: A wine with a deep burgundy red colour, of good intensity. A very complex nose with delicate notes of spices: cloves, black pepper. Mineral, hints of mountain vegetation and scrubland, balsamic and dark chocolate notes.  Powerful on the palate and rounded at the same time, with nuances of the Yerri Valley’s distinctive terroir where vines, woodland flowers and violets are found growing. A long finish, very elegant and fresh.

title: Wolfburn Single Malt Northland
bodyHtml:
The smooth and warming flavours present in Northland come from the unhurried way in which the spirit is made, and from the maturation, which takes place in American oak quarter casks. Non chill-filtered, matured, and bottled on site at 46% ABV, Northland represents the first chapter in the history of Wolfburn.

The nose is initially sweet with notes of fruit and fresh sea air. In the background you’ll find citrus freshness and hints of cereal, and just a trace of peat smoke.  The palate is sweet - nutty tones come to the fore, with hints of grapes and honey in the background. Floral flavours abound, enhanced with just a hint of dried fruit and spice.

title: Flor De Cana Clasico 5 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
A 5-year-old rum with toasted amber colour, full-bodied and smooth as silk. Enjoyed in traditional cocktails as well as mixed with soda. This rum is winner of 12 international medals.

Flor de Caña is a super premium, 5th generation single family estate rum from Nicaragua. Enriched by an active volcano, naturally aged without sugar, additives or artificial ingredients and distilled with 100% renewable energy. Flor de Caña rums are aged 4 to 25 years and are present in over 40 countries.

title: Paddy's Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Paddy is triple-distilled and matured in an oak cask for four to seven years. Appearing bright, light gold, its aromas of sweet orange, vanilla wafers and golden sultanas yield savoury flavours of toasted grain and malt. The finish merges toasted notes with a kiss of vanilla. Serve on the rocks paired with Dubliner Cheddar.

See More Irish Whisky

title: Radikon Slatnik White Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
Slatnik by Radikon is a full-bodied, complex white wine made mostly of Chardonnay grapes (80%) and Friulano grapes (20%), vinified in red in wooden vats and matured in oak barrels for 18 months. With undertones of golden exotic fruit and resin, the scents are intense. It has a smooth, fresh mouthfeel with tannic and salty aromas.

"In our vineyards the yields are very low (4 to 5 bunches for each vine), and the grapes are harvested by hand in small boxes only at optimal ripeness. In the cellar, the grapes are de-stemmed and left on their skins in wooden vats for a long time. During this maceration we do 3 to 4 stirrings per day. In other words, we use the same vinification process for white wines as those used for red wines. The material extracted during this maceration allows us to produce wines without preservatives, so we are absolutely certain that they are 100% wine. The wine is aged for three years in large wooden barrels and then for one more year in bottle. It may be slightly unclear because it is not filtered in any way. Because of the skin maceration, it is deeply and intensely colored. For tasting our wines at their best, we suggest drinking the wines at 15° C/ 59 F, and do not place them in the refrigerator for a longer period." - Stanislao (Stanko) Radikon, Winemaker

title: 19 Crimes The Uprising Red 2021
bodyHtml: A portion of this wine is aged in rum barrels, as an homage to Australia's Rum Rebellion of 1808. Upfront aromas of fig jam, candied fruit and a hint of spice. The palate is dry, with balanced acidity and supple tannins. Flavours of fig jam and spice, with a brown sugar note on the finish. Serve with steak, ribs or burgers.

title: Cono Sur Brut Rose (NV)
bodyHtml: This Sparkling Rose has soft aromas of fresh red raspberries and notes of blueberries. The palate is juicy, refreshing and mineral with a smooth character and persistent finish. Enjoy on its own or with appetizers, sea food and desserts.

title: Denavolo Catavela Bianco 2023
bodyHtml:
Half of the grapes from this wine are directly pressed while the other half spend six days on their skins. Strong floral aromas on the nose with a ton of character on the palate. Medium-plus tannin yet still quite light.

25% Malvasia di Candia, 25% Ortrugo, 25% Marsanne, 25% Other Local Grapes.

title: Monteci Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
This refreshing white wine originates from Italy, specifically the delle Venezie DOC region in Northern Italy. The Monteci winery, nestled in Valpolicella, has a legacy spanning over a century, with its foundation laid in 1964 by Giovanni and Dalia Righetti in Sion, Arcè di Pescantina. For five generations, the family has upheld a strong bond with their land, creating a wine collection that balances tradition with modern winemaking techniques, all while respecting biodiversity in their vineyards.

Wine Description

The Monteci Pinot Grigio is a lighter bodied wine that is typically straw yellow in colour with a greenish hue. It is made from 100% Pinot Grigio grapes. On the palate, this wine is expected to be fresh, crisp, and clean. Primary aromas often include delicate white flowers and fruit, particularly green apple, pear, and hints of Meyer lemon. In terms of style, it is known for its crisp acidity and minerality, which balance its soft character to create a pleasantly easy to drink wine.

Food Pairing

This light and refreshing white wine is exceptionally versatile with food. It is a natural pairing for light dishes such as appetizers, salads, or fish.

title: Boulard Calvados Pays d'Auge XO Brandy - 500 ml
Erbaluna Barolo 2020
bodyHtml:
The Erbaluna estate is situated in La Morra, in the heart of the Langa hills. The Oberto family, now in its fourth generation of winemaking, decided to farm their fifteen hectares of vineyards organically in the mid-1980s. Their philosophy is driven by a deep respect for the area's climate and the natural predisposition of the Langa soils, producing fine organic wines in a traditional style.

Wine Description

Made from 100% Nebbiolo grapes, the wine presents a deep ruby red colour, which will tend to take on more orange highlights as it matures. The bouquet is expansive and warm, offering characteristic scents of rose, violet, truffle, and tobacco. On the palate, the wine is dry yet harmonious, full, and velvety.

Food Pairing

Excellent pairings include roast and braised red meats, game (such as venison or wild boar), and stews. It also pairs beautifully with hard, mature cheeses like Parmigiano-Reggiano, or with truffle and mushroom-based dishes.

title: Dusted Valley Boomtown Syrah 2021
bodyHtml: Boomtown by Dusted Valley offers classic Washington State wines with one goal, to over-deliver. This is a really delicious Syrah with grilled meat, dark berries and hints of walnuts on the nose and palate. It's full-bodied with soft tannins and a long, flavourful finish. Refined, yet rugged, the wine offers wonderful cherry fruit and balancing acid while giving you the rustic complexity of freshly crushed herbs.

title: Villa Marchesi Prosecco (NV)
bodyHtml: A floral and vibrant style of prosecco. Expect notes of white blossom, grape, citrus and apple. To be paired with soft cheese, salad, chicken and even pork.

title: El Dorado 8 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml: A more recent part of the El Dorado range, this is aged in bourbon barrels and offers a heavier body than the 5 year old, but still not as heavy as the 12 and 15, making this a great mixing rum, though not a bad sipping spirit either!

title: Les Jamelles Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Composed of grapes from five carefully selected terroirs, Les Jamelles Sauvignon Blanc derives its freshness and minerality from the Thau lagoon basin, the dried-up marsh of Marseillette, the Upper Aude Valley near Limoux, and the western Aude department. A lovely pale colour, Les Jamelles Sauvignon Blanc is taut and aromatic with flavours of fruit (passion fruit, wild strawberry), citrus (pink grapefruit, lemon) along with vegetal notes (green tomato).

Serve well chilled (8°C) as an aperitif, with seafood or summer cuisine. We particularly recommend pairing it with sea bream ceviche or a shrimp, grapefruit and avocado salad, or grilled cod with a citrus sauce.

title: Ruffino Lumina Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Ruffino is a historic Italian producer founded in 1877 by cousins Ilario and Leopoldo Ruffino in Pontassieve, near Florence. For over 140 years, the winery has maintained a philosophy of balancing century-long Tuscan traditions with modern technical advances to create wines that represent the Italian lifestyle. Now part of the Constellation Brands portfolio, Ruffino continues to be a global ambassador for Italian viticulture, emphasizing clean and balanced wines that respect the land.

Wine Description

Lumina, meaning 'illumination of the moon' in Latin, is a bright, straw-yellow Pinot Grigio with brilliant reflections. The bouquet is fresh and complex, opening with notes of meadow flowers, pears, and golden apples, followed by refined hints of sage and mint. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied, lively, and elegant, featuring a harmonious blend of pear, green apple, and citrus peel flavours. It is characterized by an elegant minerality and a long-lived finish with subtle scents of freshly baked bread. Typically crafted from 100% Pinot Grigio grapes sourced from the Veneto and Friuli-Venezia Giulia regions, this wine is best enjoyed within one to two years of release to maintain its crisp, aromatic profile.

title: Wolf Blass Cabernet Sauvignon Yellow Label 2023
bodyHtml:
Wolf Blass Yellow Label Cabernet Sauvignon is a red wine from South Australia's renowned wine regions. Established in 1966 by Wolfgang Blass, the winery has evolved from humble beginnings into an internationally acclaimed producer, exporting to over 50 countries. Wolf Blass is celebrated for crafting wines that embody quality, character, and consistency.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep red hue with purple undertones. The bouquet offers enticing aromas of plum, blackberry, and cassis, complemented by subtle leafy notes characteristic of the varietal. On the palate, rich flavors of dark plum and blackcurrant integrate seamlessly with understated oak influences, resulting in a well-structured and flavorful experience. A hint of leafiness adds freshness, while the savory oak contributes to a prolonged finish. The wine is medium to full-bodied, showcasing a harmonious balance between fruit intensity and tannin structure.

title: Mouton Cadet Bordeaux Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml: From France's leading wine family, a wine that has been the world's introduction to the Bordeaux region since 1930. Merlot is dominant, contributing forward berry fruit. Cabernet Sauvignon brings structure and Cabernet Franc adds elegance and finesse. Serve with pork tenderloin, duck breast or a selection of cheeses.

title: Alkoomi Black Label Shiraz Frankland River 2022
Aldegheri Ripasso Santambrogio 2019
bodyHtml: This is a prestigious red wine for ageing with a deep garnet red colour, produced using grapes picked in the hilly area of Sant’Ambrogio di Valpolicella and subsequently refermented on the marc of classic Recioto and Amarone. The marked aromas of plum and cooked marasca cherry stand out from the complex bouquet and make the first pleasurable impact, followed by perception of perfect harmony of the full robust body.

title: Alain Geoffroy Chablis 'Beauroy' Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1850, Domaine Alain Geoffroy is a historic, family-owned estate in Chablis, now under the stewardship of the fifth generation. Renowned for its dedication to expressing Chablis’ unique terroir, the estate meticulously cultivates Chardonnay vines on the region’s famed Kimmeridgian limestone soils, emphasizing precision and purity in its winemaking.

Wine Description

This Premier Cru Chablis shines with a pale straw-yellow hue and subtle green reflections. The nose reveals delicate aromas of white flowers, crisp green apple, and a touch of flint, underpinned by citrus zest. On the palate, it offers a refined interplay of ripe orchard fruit and vibrant acidity, accented by hints of saline minerality that echo its limestone-rich origins. Medium-bodied and elegantly textured, the wine concludes with a lingering, chalky finish that highlights its crystalline purity.

Food Pairing

Perfect alongside freshly shucked oysters, lemon-infused scallops, or grilled prawns, this wine also pairs beautifully with creamy goat cheese or a light poultry dish accented by herbs. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Alkoomi Cabernet Sauvignon Frankland River 2021
bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the Frankland River subregion of the Great Southern in Western Australia. Alkoomi was founded in 1971 by pioneers Merv and Judy Lange, who planted their first vines on a fourth generation family farm. Today, the estate remains family owned and operated by their daughter Sandy and husband Rod Hallett, who continue a winemaking philosophy focused on creating elegant wines that authentically reflect their cool climate origin.

Wine Description

The wine presents a vibrant crimson hue with maroon and ruby tones. The aromatic profile is complex, offering notes of cassis, blackcurrant, and leafy blackberry interwoven with nuances of leather, cold tea, and aniseed. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, delivering a harmonious blend of dark berries, ironstone, and dark chocolate supported by a fine, chalky tannin structure. Matured for fourteen months in new French oak, it displays excellent focus and a refined, silky finish.

title: Matua Rose 2020
bodyHtml: Refreshingly fruity, this Rose is like a sip of summer all year long. It's packed with deliciously ripe summer fruits. We're talking fresh strawberries, mandarin and a hint of cranberry flowing through to a crisp, dry finish. Mouth-wateringly good!

title: Gibault Sauvignon Blanc Touraine 2024
bodyHtml:
Vignoble Gibault is a family-run estate with around 30 hectares of vineyards rooted in the historic soils of the Cher Valley. Straddling Berry, Touraine, and Sologne, the estate takes pride in its sustainable viticulture, certified Terra Vitis. Their Sauvignon Blanc reflects the estate’s dedication to freshness, precision, and regional character.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc pours a pale yellow with green highlights. The nose is aromatic and expressive, offering scents of white flowers, citrus zest, elderflower, and subtle tropical fruit. On the palate, it is supple and lively, marked by flavours of grapefruit, lemon, and passionfruit, with hints of blackcurrant bud and fresh herbs. The wine is medium-bodied with crisp acidity and a clean, mineral-driven finish that lingers gracefully.

Food Pairing

Ideal with goat cheeses such as Valençay or Selles-sur-Cher, this wine also complements seafood dishes — from oysters and shrimp to grilled white fish — and vegetable-forward plates like asparagus risotto or zucchini carpaccio.

title: Scarpetta Frico Bianco 2024
bodyHtml: Friuli-Venezia Giulia, the northeast corner of Italy, is home to great aromatic whites. The light, gravel soil of the western part of Friuli is perfect for producing light, aromatic, crisp white wines. This white blend of Friulano and Chardonnay is the perfect crisp, lightweight Italian white.

title: Ogio Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: Aromas of citrus and melon lead to perfectly balanced flavours of natural citrus rich fruit with hints of honeydew melon. Dry, soft and well balanced. Perfect on its own, or with seafood salad in a citrus dressing.

title: Scarpetta Frico Sangiovese 2024
bodyHtml: Tuscany has had a love affair with the Sangiovese based blends for centuries. While Sangiovese is planted all over central Italy, it reaches its highest highs in Tuscany. Frico Rosso is based on a blend of Sangiovese and small amounts of the indigenous grapes Canialolo, Ciliegiolo, and Colorino. This is the perfect balance of crisp tart cherry and the wonderful herb notes found in great Tuscan red wine. Frico Rosso pairs extremely well with grilled meats, hard cheeses and salami.

title: Botijo Garnacha Blanco 2024
bodyHtml:
These really are handmade wines. They’re made in extremely small batches in traditional concrete vessels in a tiny winery in the special region of Valdejalón, located in Aragón between Campo de Borja and Calatayud. This is the perfect terroir for the Garnacha grape and Botijo Rojo is an outstandingly fresh and fruity expression of both the red and white variants of the grape. It is produced by associate winemaker Fernando Mora MW who oversees every detail from start to scratch. Everything about these wines is premium – including the label which has been designed by award-winning Spanish label designer Marta Lojo.

Pale yellow white wine with intense aromatic Azahar, lime and minerality. Dry, crisp acidity, moderate body, intense floral and lemon peel flavours. Long length. Fresh, vivid and serious.

title: Illahe Pinot Gris Willamette Valley 2024
bodyHtml:
This Pinot Gris hails from the United States, specifically the renowned Willamette Valley in Oregon. Illahe Vineyards was founded by Lowell and Pauline Ford, who began planting grapes in the region in the late 1970s and early 1980s. Today, their son Brad Ford serves as the winemaker, maintaining a philosophy of minimal intervention and traditional methods, including the use of draft horses for vineyard work and a human powered bicycle pump to move wine in the cellar.

Wine Description

The Pinot Gris presents an enticing nose featuring aromas of baked pear, fresh lemon zest, chamomile, and a distinct graham cracker pie crust note. On the palate, the wine transitions into a profile of flinty minerality and salinity, a direct reflection of the marine sedimentary soils found in the estate's vineyard. It is medium bodied with lively acidity and a rich, textured mouthfeel achieved through fermentation on the lees and the use of large oak foudres.

Food Pairing

This wine's opulent fruit and rich texture make it an excellent partner for roasted white fish, such as halibut, or a spicy crab salad. Its mineral edge and salinity also pair beautifully with garlic and butter herbed mussels or a classic pesto pasta.

title: Rocca di Frassinello Poggio alla Guardia 2023
bodyHtml:
Rocca di Frassinello Poggio alla Guardia 2023 is a red wine from Italy, specifically originating from the Maremma Toscana region of Tuscany. The winery is a joint venture established by Paolo Panerai of Castellare di Castellina and Baron Eric de Rothschild of Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite), representing a unique partnership between Italian tradition and French expertise. Designed by world renowned architect Renzo Piano, the state of the art cellar is nestled in an area where vines have flourished for three millennia since the time of the Etruscans.

Wine Description

This expressive Tuscan red presents an intense ruby colour often marked by purple reflections. The aromatic profile is rich and spontaneous, featuring notes of black cherry, plum, and blueberry alongside complex hints of chocolate, Mediterranean herbs, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and elegant, delivering a concentrated core of lush red fruit balanced by soft tannins and a refreshing mineral freshness. It is a blend composed of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Sangioveto (Sangiovese), with some variations also including a touch of Syrah. The wine has an alcohol content of 14% ABV and is best enjoyed within an optimal drinking window extending from now through 2028. While the estate follows eco friendly practices, it is not certified organic.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 91 points

  • James Suckling - 91 points

  • Luca Maroni - 92 points

  • Vinous - 90 points

title: Gigglewater Prosecco
bodyHtml: Inspired by the 1920’s American term for an alcoholic beverage, Gigglewater offers a Prosecco DOC. Playful and colloquial, this fragrant Prosecco is perfumed with acacia flowers, crunchy Bartlett pears, apricot, honey and a generous spritz of tangerine. It is fine-boned and juicy and doles out crisp orchard fruits and citrus flavours. A completely agreeable fizz, a nice addition to the lineup of the world’s most quaffed sparkling category. The tempting packaging alone is an open invitation to get your giggle on.

title: Dusted Valley Boomtown Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Winegrowers Chad Johnson and Corey Braunel work with the vineyard managers from McNary Vineyard in the Horse Heaven Hills AVA and Two Gun Vineyard in the Ancient Lakes AVA to control and guide the process for Boomtown wines at each and every step - from vineyard to bottle.

Bright, fresh and exuberant, this Cabernet Sauvignon has nicely focused, vivid currant and spice flavors, hinting at coffee on the expressive finish.

title: Checkmate Chardonnay 'Fool's Mate' 2020
bodyHtml:
Spencer Kelly’s first taste of wine-industry recognition came from some of the most iconic and prestigious wineries in Napa Valley. With each harvest and each season, he perfected his track record for coaxing the finest vintages out of distinguished vineyards.

CheckMate’s success had rippled all the way down to California, and the opportunity to join one of Canada’s most ambitious and celebrated wineries was irresistible. Some of the Okanagan’s most exceptional soils, old vines approaching 50 years of age and a commitment to making the highest quality wines aligned precisely with Spencer’s values as a Canadian winemaker.

A complex wine with aromas of Asian pear and peach backed by hints of graphite. The palate has a rich entry with flavours of pear and nectarine. There is tension across the mid palate followed by long lasting herbal, wet stone and mineral elements.

title: Nakano Kunizakari Japanese Plum Umeshu - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Nakano Sake Brewery Co., Ltd. was established in 1844 during the Edo period and has been managed by the Nakano family for over three centuries. The brewery is unique for operating its own dedicated plum farm, Kuni Zakari Farm, where employees cultivate approximately 3,000 trees to ensure the quality of the fruit.

Description

This classic umeshu presents a golden amber colour. The aromatic profile features inviting notes of caramel, lemon, and dark plum. On the palate, it delivers a rich and complex sensory experience where juicy sweetness is balanced by mild spicy and tart undertones with hints of marzipan. The body is smooth and flavourful, leading to a refreshing and slightly tannic finish. It has an alcohol content of 10.5%.

Food Pairing

The versatile sweet and tart profile of this umeshu makes it an excellent aperitif or dessert accompaniment. It pairs exceptionally well with savoury, salt forward snacks like nuts, beef jerky, or blue cheese. For a full meal, it complements spicy dishes such as Szechuan chicken or curry, as the sweetness helps balance the heat. It can also be served on the rocks or mixed with soda water to pair with fried comfort foods like chicken karaage or tempura.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '45' Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Produced by Asahi Shuzo, the Dassai 45 is the brewery's most popular entry-level premium sake and the successor to the famous Dassai 50. In 2019, the brewery upgraded their standard from a 50% rice polishing ratio to 45% to achieve even greater clarity and refinement. Like all Dassai sakes, it is crafted exclusively from Yamada Nishiki rice, often called the king of sake rice, and falls into the highest official category of sake: Junmai Daiginjo.

Description

This sake is clear and light-bodied, prized for its clean, soft, and subtle character. The nose is highly aromatic and fruity, featuring a classic ginjo bouquet of green apple, pear, melon, and wild flowers. On the palate, it is smooth and round, delivering a delicate sweetness balanced by a refreshing, vibrant acidity. Notes of succulent citrus and a hint of tropical fruit lead into a crisp, dry finish with a lingering grace. Despite being an entry-level Daiginjo, it maintains the complex, high-quality structure that has made the Dassai brand a global icon. ABV 16%.

Food Pairing

Dassai 45 is remarkably versatile, designed to complement a wide range of international cuisines. Its fruity acidity and clean finish make it a perfect match for sushi, sashimi, and lightly grilled seafood. It also pairs exceptionally well with richer dishes that feature creamy or buttery elements, such as scallops in butter, creamy pasta, or vegetable tempura. For an unconventional pairing, try it with savory appetizers like salted nuts or fresh oysters. To maximize the experience, serve it chilled (10–12°C) in a white wine glass to help the delicate fruit aromas open up.

title: Gekkeikan Japanese Plum - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Gekkeikan Plum Wine, also known as Umeshu, is an authentic Japanese fruit wine originating from the Fushimi district in the Kyoto prefecture. It is crafted by Gekkeikan Sake Brewing Co. Ltd., a historic brewery with a legacy dating back to 1637. This specialty wine is produced by fermenting and aging the choicest nanko plums sourced from the world-renowned orchards of Wakayama in central Japan.

Description

This plum wine presents a beautiful amber yellow colour and a rich, full-bodied sensory profile. It features a complex bouquet with juicy sweet aromas of ripe peach, nectarine, and tart ume plum, accented by notes of baking spices, honey, and toasted almonds. On the palate, it is mellow and slightly syrupy, offering an exquisite balance of intense plum nectar sweetness and a refreshing tart acidity. The finish is long and clean, leaving a pleasant fruity residue without being cloyingly sweet. It has an alcohol by volume of 13%.

Food Pairing

Gekkeikan Plum Wine is a versatile companion for both savory and sweet dishes. Its natural sweetness and acidity make it an excellent match for spicy cuisines, such as Szechuan chicken or Thai curry, as it helps cut through the heat. It also pairs well with rich, savory items like Hoisin-glazed ribs, roast beef, and blue cheese. For dessert, it can be enjoyed as a 'dessert wine' alongside fruit tarts and chocolate, or even drizzled directly over vanilla ice cream and yogurt.

title: Torres 20 Year Old Brandy
bodyHtml: A long aged Spanish grape brandy, made from Parellada and Ugni Blanc grapes and aged in Limousin oak barrels for a deep colour and rich flavour.

title: Broc Cellars Love Red 2022
bodyHtml: Broc Cellars is a self-identified natural winery based in Berkeley, California, home to food and wine icons like Kermit Lynch and Alice Waters. This is a Southern France-inspired blend of Carignan (72%), Valdiguié (20%), and Syrah (8%) from 70+ year old vines in Solano and Mendocino Counties. Using a combination of whole cluster and destemmed fruit, this is aged in neutral French oak and concrete tanks. It shows bright, juicy black fruits with some spice and sappy notes. It has a directness and purity to the fruit that makes this really appealing. The acidity is crisp, and tannins fine, making this a perfect barbecue wine to serve with a light chill.

title: Ste Michelle Merlot Cold Creek 2018
bodyHtml: Cold Creek's 40-year-old vines deliver a big, concentrated Merlot. This wine offers black fruit flavours with layers of complexity. This is an intense Merlot with great age ability.

title: Sin Piedad Mezcal Joven
bodyHtml: Clear with an herbal nose. Silky and spicy with rich and herbal flavours. Toasted agave and intense earthiness. Long and smooth.

title: Chateau Ste Michelle Cabernet Sauvignon Ethos 2018
bodyHtml:
This vintage provided an immaculate backdrop of warm summer sun and cool fall nights. Combine that with hand crafted artistry and extreme attention to detail, and you have the perfect example of what makes Washington State and Chateau Ste. Michelle truly special.

93 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon Ethos is also all Cabernet and was brought up in 49% new French oak. It has impressive cassis and darker black raspberry fruits intermixed with spicy oak, lead pencil, and subtle background tobacco and spice. I love its texture, and it's medium to full-bodied, with ripe, polished tannins, beautiful balance, and a great finish.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Offers a beam of lively fruit framed by spirited acidity and tannins, with blackberry, dusty mocha and graphite accents.

title: Aia Vecchia Lagone Toscana 2024
bodyHtml: In the glass, the wine is deep ruby with purple hues. On the nose, the wine is delicate with notes of cherry, vanilla and herbs. On the palate, it is dry, structured and elegant with flavours of plum, ripe cherries, wild berries and a hint of spice, followed by a lengthy and smooth finish that begs for food. This wine is very versatile and pairs well with both red and white meats, various pasta dishes and hard cheese.

title: Ricasoli Rose Albia 2024
bodyHtml: This Sangiovese and Merlot blend comes from the historic Ricasoli estate, in the heart of Chianti Classico. A short stint in stainless preserves the bright fruit. Pouring a very pale peach hue, with the dry, silken palate led by strawberry, and plums kissed with tangerine, pink florals, and a very fine rasp of spices. Quite elegant, as befits the brand legacy.

title: Amaro Punico
bodyHtml: Amaro Punico is a unique and intriguing liqueur produced in Sardinia, Italy. Made with a blend of local botanicals and traditional herbs, it embodies the essence of the island's rich herbal tradition. Its flavour profile showcases a harmonious balance of bitter and sweet notes with hints of citrus, herbs, and spices. Critics applaud Amaro Punico for its exceptional quality and distinctive taste, often describing it as a refined and complex amaro. With its smooth texture and lingering finish, it is enjoyed as a digestif or used to add depth and complexity to cocktails. Amaro Punico is a remarkable choice for those seeking a taste of Sardinian craftsmanship.

title: Dubonnet Rouge
bodyHtml: Dubonnet Rouge, currently made in the picturesque city of Paris, France, is a timeless aperitif that enchants the palate with its complex and enticing flavour profile. This iconic red elixir unveils a deep ruby hue, captivating the eye with its richness. The aroma is a symphony of herbal and spice notes intertwined with hints of red fruit and exotic botanicals. With the first sip, a delightful blend of bittersweet flavours unfolds, where the robustness of fortified wine harmonizes with the subtle sweetness of fruit and a touch of aromatic spices. The velvety texture coats the tongue, leaving a lingering, pleasantly bitter finish. Dubonnet Rouge captures the essence of French sophistication, offering an indulgent and classic aperitif experience that stands the test of time.

title: Alize Bleu
bodyHtml:
Alizé Bleu Passion is an infusion of delectable passion fruit, fresh cherries and a hint of ginger blended with premium French vodka.  This unique combination is bold and bursting with vivid passion fruit, ripe cherries and a hint of spice.

Alizé Bleu Passion’s distinct and delicious flavors can be savored on the rocks or in unique, colorful cocktails like the Bleu Royal.

title: El Dorado Rum Cream
bodyHtml: Very inviting nose packed with spice, rum and toffee. Full creamy texture with seductive roundness and extremely smooth flow across the palate. Flavours of spice, toffee and rum fill the mouth with an ongoing release of flavours and aromatics in a very long, well sustained finish. Absolutely delightful!

title: McGuinness Peach Schnapps - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Fresh market peaches are available from May through September. McGuinness Peach Schnapps bottles up the fresh fruit flavour so it can be enjoyed all year round. It's clear with aromas and flavours of ripe peaches with a sweet, medium-long finish.

title: McGuinness Triple Sec - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Sec means “dry” in French and “triple” suggests three times as dry. McGuinness Triple Sec is also three times as delicious when added to your favourite cocktail — it’s no wonder so many people fall in love with this flavour!  This Triple Sec is bursting with sweet oranges! It adds zesty orange flavour to margaritas and daiquiris and provides that subtle note in cosmopolitans. A must-have for any home bar!

title: Miro Red Vermouth - 1 Litre
bodyHtml: Miro Red Vermouth enchants the palate with its captivating blend of aromatic herbs and luscious fruits. A symphony of flavours unfolds as the velvety liquid dances on the tongue, revealing layers of botanicals and spices. Sweet notes of red berries and cherries intertwine with hints of warm vanilla and exotic spices, creating a harmonious balance between richness and vibrancy. Miro red Vermouth entices with its smooth and lingering finish, leaving a delightful warmth and a touch of elegance. This exquisite Vermouth is currently made at the Miro distillery in Reus, a city nestled in the Catalonia region of Spain, renowned for its centuries-old tradition of Vermouth production.

title: Dr McGillicuddy's Peach Schnapps
bodyHtml: Dr. McGillicuddy's Peach Schnapps, crafted in the United States, is a delightful and flavorful liqueur. Produced with precision, this peach schnapps captures the essence of ripe, juicy peaches. Its flavor profile is characterized by a luscious sweetness, balanced by a refreshing tartness, reminiscent of biting into a succulent peach. Critics have praised Dr. McGillicuddy's Peach Schnapps for its vibrant and authentic peach flavor, making it a versatile ingredient in various cocktails and mixed drinks. Whether enjoyed in a classic Bellini or used to add a fruity twist to a cocktail creation, this schnapps delivers a burst of summer in every sip.

title: Giffard Vanilla Madagascar
bodyHtml:
Giffard Vanille de Madagascar is a liqueur crafted from natural vanilla extracts sourced exclusively from Madagascar, renowned for producing some of the world's finest vanilla. This liqueur captures the rich, warm, and intense character of the vanilla pods, offering a versatile addition to various beverages.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Golden liqueur with fine amber and copper hues.

  • Aroma: Delicately sweet, enhanced by a touch of alcohol, bringing an enchanting freshness reminiscent of pine tree and eucalyptus.

  • Taste: Sweet with a strong aroma of very pure vanilla seeds, complemented by subtle roasted, milky, and spicy notes.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Neat: Enjoyed on its own, served over ice, to fully appreciate its aromatic complexity.

  • Cocktails: Enhances a variety of cocktails, adding depth and a rich vanilla flavor.

title: Bols Cherry Brandy
bodyHtml: Bols Cherry Brandy is made using concentrated cherry juice and some brandy. Bols Cherry Brandy liqueur is infused with natural botanicals.

title: Gantous & Abou Raad Arak
bodyHtml: Gantous production involves using the best grapes, choosing premium aniseeds, repeated distillation, and aging before bottling. These features distinguish Arak Gantous & Abou Raad and ensure its good taste and smoothness.

title: Absente Absinthe
bodyHtml: 110 proof, hypnotic emerald green liqueur made with a full measure of wormwood and other exotic botanicals. The stories of Absinthe are that of legend with those who have written of seemingly hallucinogenic experiences with the "green fairy". Traditionally, absinthe is poured into a small glass of water over a sugar cube resting on the provided slotted spoon, the spoon is included in this set.

title: Cocchi Vermouth Di Torino
bodyHtml:
General Information

The original recipe of Giulio Cocchi calls for the use of herbs such as Cinchona and rhubarb which lightly colour of brown the beautiful clear wine. In order to emphasize its amber tone, the addition of sugar browned on fire emphasizes its amber tone, giving together with colour also a special note to the taste: crunchy and cotton candy able to round all the bitter tastes without using vanilla. A thrilling vermouth, rich in sensations: among the herbs and the aromatizing spices, Artemisia and citrus are the protagonists with their balanced bitter and citrusy notes which characterize Cocchi style. A rich taste with vibrant notes of cocoa and bitter orange. From the infusion of some noble and balsamic woods, we have in the end light aromas of camphor and rosemary notes. Among the minor ingredients, herbs and woods with unique perfumes such as sandal, musk, myrrh and nutmeg.

title: Phillips Butter Ripple Schnapps
bodyHtml: Full, rich, butterscotch taste; not too sweet or cloying.

title: Martini Rosso Sweet Vermouth - 1 Litre
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Martini & Rossi Rosso Sweet Vermouth is an iconic Italian aromatized wine originating from Pessione, near Turin in the Piedmont region. Founded in 1863 by Alessandro Martini, Teofilo Sola, and Luigi Rossi, the company is defined by Rossi’s creative herbalism and a commitment to traditional Italian botanicals. Now a flagship brand under Bacardi Limited, the distillery maintains its historical roots at Casa Martini, where it continues to produce spirits that blend 19th-century artistry with a global 'Spirit of Independence'.

This classic 'Rosso' is crafted from a base of Italian white wines, including Trebbiano and Catarratto, which are infused with a secret blend of more than 40 botanicals.

  • Color: The vermouth features a clear, deep amber or red-brown appearance, achieving its rich scarlet hue through the addition of natural caramel.

  • Aroma: The nose is highly perfumed and complex, offering a bouquet of ginger, prunes, and dried red fruits. Subtle notes of tobacco leaf, bay leaf, and aromatic herbs like sage and savory provide an earthy depth.

  • Palate: Supple and medium-bodied, the palate displays a vibrant balance between sweetness and herbal bitterness. Key flavours include dried red cherries, dark cherry syrup, and a 'cola-like' fruitiness, underpinned by spices such as cinnamon, liquorice, anise, and nutmeg.

  • Body and Finish: It possesses a smooth, velvety texture with a bittersweet finish that is rich, delicately spicy, and persistent, often revealing final hints of leather and sweet tobacco.

The spirit is bottled at 15% ABV and is recognized for its stylistic balance and versatility, making it a foundational element for both simple aperitifs and complex cocktails.

title: Chambord - 750 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Chambord is a super premium liqueur, hand crafted in the Loire Valley in France. Chambord black raspberry liqueur is hand crafted with raspberries, blackberries, Moroccan citrus peel, Madagascar vanilla, honey, XO cognac, herbs and spices. The result is unprecedented level of complexities in colour, aroma and flavour.

title: Bols Amaretto
bodyHtml: This golden brown liqueur is deeply rooted in the Italian tradition and presents a beautiful array of toasted almond and apricot notes. Nutty and aromatic, Bols Amaretto liqueur will add layers of caramelly warmth to both simple mixers and crafted cocktails.

title: Ceili's Cream Liquor
bodyHtml: This Irish cream blends traditional flavours and an age old recipe to create a smooth creamy drink that is perfect over ice.

title: Sweet Sippin Maple Whisky
bodyHtml:
Fine Canadian Maple Syrup blended with high-quality Canadian Rye. The finish, driven by maple sugar is long and sweet.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Boudier Creme De Cassis - 350 ml
bodyHtml: Boudier Crème de Cassis, hailing from Dijon, France, is a luxurious blackcurrant liqueur that delights the senses. Handcrafted by Boudier, a renowned distillery known for its artisanal spirits, this Crème de Cassis offers an exquisite flavour profile. Bursting with the natural essence of ripe blackcurrants, it perfectly balances the sweetness and tartness with subtle floral undertones. Critics praise Boudier Crème de Cassis for its exceptional quality and authenticity, commending its rich, velvety texture and vibrant fruit flavours. This liqueur is a sophisticated choice for any cocktail aficionado, ideal for classic cocktails like the Kir Royale or simply as a delightful addition to sparkling wine.

title: Cynar - 1 Litre
bodyHtml: Cynar, an intriguing Italian amaro, delights the taste buds with its unique and bittersweet flavour profile. This dark and velvety liqueur offers a complex medley of herbal and earthy notes. A symphony of artichoke leaves infused with a blend of botanicals and spices delivers a pleasantly bitter yet surprisingly smooth taste. Cynar carries a subtle sweetness that balances the herbal intensity, leaving a lingering warmth on the palate. Crafted with passion and expertise, Cynar is currently made in Italy, where the art of amaro production has been perfected over generations, capturing the essence of Italian tradition in every bottle.

title: Bols Creme De Cacao White
bodyHtml: This aromatic liqueur presents beautiful milk chocolate notes, with hints of vanilla and apricot. Distilled with natural ingredients only, Bols Cacao White liqueur has a slightly milder palate than its brown cacao sibling, making it a good subtle base for a varied range of cocktails to create at home.

title: Bols Apricot Brandy
bodyHtml: This amber-colored liqueur owes its rich and nutty flavor to a careful blend of crushed apricot kernels, fresh apricot juice, and brandy. Presenting hints of cognac and almond, with a beautiful base of juicy ripe apricots, Bols Apricot Brandy Liqueur tastes amazing in various cocktails to create at home.

title: Baja Rosa Strawberry
bodyHtml: Baja Rosa Strawberry Cream Liqueur is made with a combination of imported tequila, strawberry flavors and rich cream. Baja Strawberry is extremely versatile and can be mixed up as a shot, sipped over ice or blended to make a delicious cocktail.

title: Phillips Rootbeer Schnapps
bodyHtml: Phillips Root Beer Schnapps is an American original. With frosty mug root beer taste, Root Beer Schnapps became an instant hit in 1984 led by the popularity of the Phillips Root Beer Barrel (Drop a shot glass of chilled Root Beer Schnapps into a cold mug of beer).

title: Yukon Jack
bodyHtml:
Rugged. Untamed. Fearless. That's the personality of Yukon Jack. The Yukon Jack lineup of Fire, Apple, Honey, Snakebite and Original is legendary.

Try a Snakebite shot made with Yukon Jack Original and lime juice. It's known as the shot that bites back.

title: Tia Maria - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Tia Maria is a sweet liqueur with a strong coffee character and a complex aromatic structure. By using cold brew extraction, Tia Maria ensures that the coffee liqueur has a distinct taste thanks to three significant elements: coffee 100% arabica provides the distinctive roasted, full-bodied rich taste, vanilla responsible for the soft and velvety back notes and Jamaican Rum that gives Tia Maria is body, depth and structure.

title: Campari
bodyHtml:
Campari is a globally recognized red apéritif originating from Novara, Italy, where it was invented in 1860 by Gaspare Campari. The brand is the flagship of the Campari Group, an Italian company that has grown into the sixth-largest spirits group worldwide and is currently headquartered in Sesto San Giovanni. Ownership transitioned from the founding family to the Garavoglia family in the 1970s, under whom the company launched a series of strategic acquisitions to build a portfolio of over 50 premium brands.

Description

Crafted from a secret infusion of herbs, aromatic plants, and fruit macerated in alcohol and water, Campari is still made according to its original 1860 recipe.

  • Colour: Vivid scarlet or crimson red; famously, the natural carmine dye derived from cochineal insects was replaced with artificial colouring in 2006 for most markets.

  • Aroma: Intense and herbaceous with a touch of citrus, particularly grapefruit peel, and subtle floral notes.

  • Palate: Bright and bitter-sweet with a complex medicinal character featuring notes of bitter orange, herbs, and mild spices like cinnamon.

  • Body: Lighter in body than many liqueurs, offering a supple and refreshing mouthfeel.

  • Finish: A bracing and slightly spicy exit with lingering herbal bitterness.

  • ABV: Depending on the international market, the alcohol by volume typically ranges from 20.5% to 28.5%, with North American bottles often at 24% or 25%.

title: Pimm's
bodyHtml: Pimm's, currently made in the heart of London, England, is a quintessentially British aperitif that transports you to the lush gardens of the English countryside with its refreshing and vibrant flavour. This iconic libation unveils a beautiful amber hue reminiscent of a golden sunset. The aroma entices with a medley of citrus fruits, fragrant herbs, and a hint of spice. With the first sip, a harmonious fusion of fruity sweetness, botanical undertones, and a subtle bitterness dances on the palate. The velvety texture envelops the tongue, leaving a delightful and invigorating sensation. Pimm's captures the essence of British tradition and summer gatherings, offering a taste experience that is both refreshing and timeless.

title: Baileys Almande
bodyHtml: 100% dairy-free, vegan-friendly Baileys Almande is for those days when you want something a little spirited but sweet. You can enjoy this delicious blend of almond and vanilla flavour as well as other ingredients and flavours straight over ice or whipped into a spiced chai latte.

title: Amarula - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Made from the exotic marula fruit that is grown exclusively in Africa. This rich and delicious liqueur pours a light creamy coffee colour and offers aromas and flavours of sweet toffee, vanilla and fresh marula fruit with a velvety texture.

title: Midori Melon Liqueur
bodyHtml:
'Midori' is Japanese for green. The emerald green found in Japanese nature is where Midori was born.  Midori is the original melon liqueur enhanced by premium Japanese muskmelons that can be enjoyed with juices, spirits and other liqueurs - a fruity sensation of fresh melons.

Midori Melon Liqueur’s quality and delicious taste come from the blending of the juices of premium muskmelons — which are extremely rare in Japan. Grown in only one region of Japan, they are incredibly hard to find. Because of this, they can sell for as much as US $20,000 in their first harvest. In addition to their rarity, both musk melons are cultivated in rich soils to create the tastiest melons. By extracting the essence from two different Japanese melons using two different production methods, a premium melon flavor is born.  20% ABV.

title: Carolans Irish Cream - 750 ml
bodyHtml: A creamy, indulgent, delicious blend of rich double cream, natural honey, fine Irish spirits and Irish Whiskey. Carolans is Ireland's superior tasting, genuine Irish Cream Liqueur.

title: Bols Creme De Banane
bodyHtml: Bols Crème de Banane, crafted in the Netherlands, is a luscious and indulgent liqueur. Produced by Bols, a renowned distillery with a legacy of fine spirits, this banana liqueur captivates the taste buds. Its flavor profile offers a delectable combination of ripe, sweet bananas with subtle hints of caramel and vanilla. Bols Crème de Banane has received praise from critics for its authentic and intense banana taste, making it a perfect ingredient for tropical cocktails and dessert-inspired drinks. With its smooth texture and rich flavor, this liqueur adds a touch of tropical paradise to any mixology creation.

title: Pere Magloire Calvados Fine VS Brandy
Drambuie
bodyHtml: A unique blend of aged Scotch whisky with a secret combination of spices, heather honey and herbs which matches its rich flavours.

title: Cocchi Rosa
bodyHtml: Bright, lively, and gently bittersweet, the Italian-made Cocchi Rosa is an ideal bottle for Aperol fans who are looking to branch out. The cousin of Cocchi Americano, it’s an aromatized wine aperitivo, but made with red wines from Piedmont along with different botanicals including gentian, citrus peel, and rose petal.

title: Disaronno Amaretto - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Disaronno Amaretto, crafted in Saronno, Italy, is an exquisite liqueur cherished by many. This iconic amaretto showcases a distinct flavor profile that beautifully combines the essence of sweet almonds with a hint of marzipan and a touch of vanilla. Critics worldwide have applauded Disaronno Amaretto for its rich and velvety texture, praising its versatility in both cocktails and desserts. With its smooth and indulgent taste, it adds a delightful nutty character to classic drinks like the Amaretto Sour or can be enjoyed neat over ice. Disaronno Amaretto truly embodies the essence of Italian craftsmanship and is a beloved choice for discerning palates.

title: Carpano Antica Formula Vermouth - 1 Litre
bodyHtml: Carpano Antica is an Italian vermouth. Made from white wine, Piedmontese muscatel and the rich wines of southern Italy, its taste comes from carefully selected brewed mountain herbs, although its most prominent feature is its vanilla bouquet, matched by notes of spices and dried fruit such as star anise, orange peel and dates.

title: Luxardo Sambuca - 750 ml
bodyHtml: This classic Italian liqueur has been family owned for generations. The use of essential oils from the star anise seed provide intense aromatics and concentrated flavours that are balanced by light bitterness and velvety smooth texture on the palate.

title: Graffiti Creme De Cacao - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
From cacao and vanilla beans comes this Crème de Cacao delight.

As a long time standard liqueur in our family, it has benefited over the years from our commitment to perfection (and testing!).

title: Cointreau
bodyHtml: Cointreau, an iconic orange liqueur, captivates the senses with its exquisite flavour profile. A harmonious blend of sweet and bitter orange peels, the liqueur bursts with vibrant citrus notes that dance on the tongue. The essence of juicy oranges is balanced by a subtle hint of zesty bitterness, creating a symphony of refreshing and complex flavours. With a silky-smooth texture, Cointreau entices with its lingering warmth and delicate sweetness. This iconic liqueur is currently made at the Cointreau distillery in the picturesque town of Angers, France, where the spirit of innovation and craftsmanship has thrived since its inception in 1849.

title: Grand Marnier Louis Alexandre
bodyHtml: A tribute to our founder, Louis-Alexandre Marnier Lapostolle, who disrupted the status quo of cognac by combining it with bitter orange liqueur.  An exceptional cuvée with VSOP cognac, rich in character and complexity.  An inviting warm amber colour with tints of copper leads to a nose wafting of bergamot essences and candied peel. Intense flavours of cognac and macerated citrus combines with nuances of pine and Earl Grey tea for a long, warm finish.

title: Soho Lychee Liqueur
bodyHtml: Soho Lychee Liqueur, currently crafted in the bustling city of Paris, France, embodies the essence of exotic flavours in a harmonious elixir. This captivating liqueur takes you on a sensory journey through the beautiful nature of lychee fruit. It entices the senses with an alluring aroma of ripe lychee, delicately mingled with floral notes. Each sip unveils a luscious fusion of sweet lychee, balanced by a subtle hint of tanginess, creating a symphony of flavours that dance on the palate. Its velvety texture glides smoothly, leaving a lingering and delightful sweetness. Soho Lychee Liqueur captures the spirit of sophistication and indulgence, offering a taste experience that is both exotic and refined.

title: McGuinness Cherry Whisky
bodyHtml: Its sweet cherry flavour blended with whisky makes McGuinness Cherry Whisky the most popular flavour. Talk about putting the cherry on top of your favourite cocktail or dessert!

title: Ouzo 12
bodyHtml: Ouzo 12, produced in Kalamata, Greece, is a renowned and authentic anise-flavoured liqueur. Crafted with tradition and expertise, this spirit represents the essence of Greek culture. Its flavour profile is characterized by the distinct taste of anise, accompanied by notes of herbs, citrus, and a touch of sweetness. Critics praise Ouzo 12 for its smoothness and authentic Mediterranean flavour, often describing it as a delightful digestif. Whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks or mixed into refreshing cocktails, Ouzo 12 offers a unique and memorable drinking experience. It is a beloved choice for those seeking to savour the flavours of Greece.

title: Quady Vya Sweet
bodyHtml: Quady Vya Sweet, currently made in the scenic region of Madera, California, is a luscious fortified wine that enchants the senses with its rich and indulgent flavour profile. This captivating libation unveils a deep amber hue reminiscent of sun-kissed golden raisins. The aroma is a delightful bouquet of dried fruits, caramelized sugar, and a hint of warm spices. With the first sip, a symphony of flavours unfolds, where notes of ripe figs, toffee, and honeyed sweetness are beautifully balanced with a subtle touch of bitterness. The velvety texture caresses the palate, leaving a luxurious and lingering finish. Quady Vya Sweet is a testament to the craftsmanship of California winemaking, offering a decadent and captivating wine experience that delights the senses.

title: Giffard Pink Grapefruit
bodyHtml: Liqueur (crème de fruits) made from infusion of pink grapefruit zests. Intense aroma, typical of grapefruit juice, slightly zesty and floral.  Very aromatic taste, good balance between bitterness, acidity and fruity, with a zesty note at the end.

title: Bols Advocaat
bodyHtml: Advocaat is a traditional Dutch liqueur, much like eggnog. Made from a combination of eggs, sugar and brandy; this decadent liqueur is a bright creamy yellow colour, with rich egg custard aromas and flavours that are balanced by light brandy notes that come through on the palate.

title: Rocca delle Macie Sasyr 2019 - 3 Litre Bottle
Bols Blue
bodyHtml: Bols Blue, originating from the Netherlands, is a vibrant and iconic liqueur. Crafted by Bols, a renowned distillery with a rich heritage, Bols Blue is a favorite among cocktail enthusiasts. Its mesmerizing electric blue hue and tropical aroma make it instantly recognizable. The flavor profile of Bols Blue is a delightful combination of citrus, tropical fruits, and a hint of vanilla. Critics commend its smoothness and versatility, as it adds a unique and refreshing twist to a wide range of cocktails. Whether mixed with citrus juices or used to create visually stunning drinks, Bols Blue brings a burst of flavor and visual appeal to any occasion.

title: Rossi D'Asiago Limoncello
bodyHtml: Rossi D’Asiago Limoncello is made according to an original recipe that has been handed down from generation to generation. No artificial colouring or preservatives are added. Rossi D’Asiago Limoncello is a favourite among the best Italian restaurants. It is best served chilled and is also excellent for sorbets, as topping for ice cream and in preparing cocktails and long drinks.

title: Pama Pomegranate Liqueur
bodyHtml: Pama Pomegranate Liqueur, currently made in California, USA, is a seductive elixir that entices the senses with its vibrant and enticing flavour profile. This exquisite liqueur unveils a deep ruby-red hue reminiscent of juicy pomegranates. The aroma is a tantalizing blend of ripe fruits, floral notes, and a hint of citrus zest. With the first sip, a symphony of flavours unfolds, where the tartness of pomegranate intertwines with a subtle sweetness and a touch of herbal complexity. The velvety texture coats the tongue, leaving a delightful and lingering sensation. Pama Liqueur captures the essence of Californian craftsmanship, offering a versatile and captivating liqueur experience that adds a touch of elegance and indulgence to any occasion.

title: Giffard Coffee
bodyHtml: Creme Yvette, a liqueur, was originally produced in the US in the late 19th century. By the mid-20th century, it was out of production altogether. The formula was revised recently, and is now produced in France. The liqueur is based on a mixture of four berry fruits and violets, and is the base for many cocktails, the most notable of which might be the Aviator.

title: Galliano Vanilla - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Vanilla comes from the vanilla orchid, which is the only one out of more than 25,000 species that produces edible fruit. The vanilla orchid can only be harvested in a few spots around the globe and is the second-most expensive spice. The taste and scent of vanilla is one that many people know. It has a sweet, soft, and versatile flavour with rich and warm tones. In the world of alcohol, vanilla is an exciting flavour because of how many different directions you go in. For example, you can include it in warm drinks for the fall or cold desserts in summer. Vanilla liqueur is an all-year-round favourite for many.

title: Frangelico - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Frangelico, created in the Piedmont region of Italy, is an indulgent and captivating liqueur. Crafted with meticulous care, this Italian hazelnut liqueur entices the senses. Its flavour profile is characterized by the rich, nutty essence of toasted hazelnuts, complemented by hints of vanilla and cocoa. Critics have praised Frangelico for its velvety smoothness and its ability to seamlessly blend into a variety of cocktails and desserts. With its delightful sweetness and unmistakable hazelnut flavour, it adds a touch of elegance and sophistication to any libation. Frangelico is a beloved choice for those seeking a unique and delectable liqueur experience.

title: Dolin Vermouth de Chambery Blanc
bodyHtml:
The Dolin Vermouth de Chambéry Blanc is a refined, slightly sweeter vermouth from the only vermouth-producing region with an official AOC designation in France—Chambéry. Known for its floral and balanced profile, this vermouth is crafted from a base of white wine, fortified with sugar, and infused with a blend of more than 50 herbs and botanicals native to the Alpine region.

Colour: Clear, with a subtle golden tint.
Aroma: Delicate notes of elderflower, citrus peel, and alpine herbs, with hints of honey and white flowers.
Palate: Lightly sweet and floral, with flavors of candied fruit, lemon balm, and subtle herbs. It has a smooth texture, offering a gentle sweetness balanced by mild bitterness.
Body: Medium-bodied, with a soft, elegant mouthfeel.
Finish: Refreshing, with lingering notes of citrus and herbs.

The Dolin Blanc is often enjoyed as an aperitif on its own, served chilled or over ice with a twist of lemon. It also pairs well in cocktails that call for a sweeter vermouth, such as a reverse martini or with sparkling water for a simple spritz​

This vermouth, like other Dolin expressions, relies on natural infusions of herbs and flowers rather than pre-made extracts, contributing to its nuanced and complex flavor profile. With an ABV of 16%, it’s versatile for a range of drinks and occasion

title: Sour Puss Blue Liqueur
bodyHtml: Sour Puss combines secret and exotic natural flavours to create a curiously sweet and sour taste sensation. With it's turquoise blue colour, Sour Puss Blue wafts sweet and tart aromas of blue popsicle along with spicy, candied cinnamon.

title: Cocchi Vermouth Amaro Dopo Teatro
bodyHtml: It’s a rare “evening vermouth” called Dopo Teatro on the wake of Piedmonts tradition to drink a small cup of cool vermouth with lemon zest in the evening, maybe after watching a performance in one of the historic theatres of the Savoy capital.

title: Aperol Aperitivo
bodyHtml:
The name says it all: Aperol is the perfect aperitif.

Its unique bittersweet taste and bright orange color derive from a secret and original recipe, that has remained unchanged over time as a result of a hard work of 7 years of experimentation. An infusion of selected primary components including oranges, herbs and roots in a perfectly balanced combination.

title: Canton Ginger Liqueur
bodyHtml: This golden-hued liqueur emanates a delightful and refreshing aroma of freshly harvested ginger, transporting you to lush spice gardens. The first sip reveals a harmonious fusion of zesty ginger, subtly balanced with the sweetness of honey and a hint of citrus. Its velvety texture envelops the palate, leaving a warm, lingering sensation that gracefully unfolds. Crafted with utmost precision, Canton Ginger Liqueur embodies the essence of Asian tradition and innovation. Its captivating symphony of flavours makes it a versatile companion for indulgent cocktails and refined sipping moments.

title: Roserock Pinot Noir by Domaine Drouhin Oregon 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, this Pinot Noir originates from the Eola Amity Hills subregion of Oregon's Willamette Valley. Domaine Drouhin Oregon was established in 1987 by the Drouhin family of Burgundy, seeking to combine French winemaking soul with Oregon soil. The family expanded their legacy in 2013 by purchasing the Roserock vineyard, a site renowned for its ancient volcanic soils and cool climate influence from the Van Duzer Corridor.

Wine Description

This wine presents a vibrant and poised sensory profile, capturing the characteristic purity and tension of the Eola Amity Hills estate. On the nose, the wine reveals complex aromas of lavender, violet, and cherry pie, underscored by warm baking spices and an earthy undertone. The palate is supple yet firmly structured, offering bright flavours of strawberry, plum, and marionberry complemented by exotic notes of cassis and cardamom.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs exceptionally well with roasted duck breast, where the bright red fruit and crisp acidity cut through the richness of the meat. It is also a sophisticated companion for a sausage cassoulet or a herb crusted rack of lamb.

title: Roserock Chardonnay by Domaine Drouhin Oregon 2021
bodyHtml: Drouhin Oregon Roserock continues a four-generation story that began in 1880 when Joseph Drouhin moved from Chablis to Beaune in the heart of Burgundy. In Oregon, as in Burgundy, the Drouhin Family farms singular, expressive parcels of land. The Roserock Vineyard sits at the southern tip of the Eola-Amity Hills in Oregon's Willamette Valley and is marked by volcanic soils, cooler temperatures and an ideal elevation range. Farmed by Phillipe Drouhin, Roserock is certified sustainable.

title: Pierre Ferrand Dry Curacao - 700 ml
bodyHtml: Pierre Ferrand Dry Curaçao is currently made in the Cognac region of France. This artisanal orange liqueur showcases a refined and complex flavour profile. It offers vibrant and zesty citrus notes with a delicate balance between sweetness and bitterness. The blend of orange peels and spices creates a harmonious and aromatic experience. Critics praise Pierre Ferrand Dry Curaçao for its authenticity and superior quality. It is often regarded as a benchmark in the world of orange liqueurs, with critics noting its versatility in cocktails and its ability to elevate the flavours of mixed drinks. Connoisseurs appreciate its depth and elegance, making it a beloved choice for discerning palates.

title: Giffard Lichi Li
bodyHtml: With the delicate, soft flavour of lychees, this great liqueur from Giffard has a fresh, floral aroma and a tropically fruity flavour. Very good indeed.

title: Giffard Creme de Cacao White
bodyHtml: Clear, transparent colour. Very strong aroma of cocoa with a slight note of coffee, coated with vanilla and caramel. Very sweet and sugary taste at first, then powerful aromas of dark chocolate and coffee. Very buttered finish.

title: Luxardo Amaretto - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
The almond flavor is given from the essential oils contained in the pits of cherries, peaches and apricots.

Well-rounded in taste, a fragrant aroma and a hint of vanilla in the end are all characteristics that distinguish Luxardo Amaretto. Brilliantly suited to use in classic cocktails such as Amaretto Sour it can also be enjoyed neat or over ice as an after dinner drink.

title: Giffard Ginger Of The Indies
bodyHtml:
Liqueur made from the maceration of ginger roots balanced by a touch of vanilla, orange flower water and coriander.

Straw-coloured liqueur. On the nose, balance between the power of ginger and coriander, the sweetness of vanilla, and the vivacity of the orange blossom. Gentle mouth at first, then very quickly the spices intensify the peppery and slightly citrusy taste of ginger. This liqueur truly plays on the contrasts of fire (spices), sweetness (sugar), power (alcohol), and lightness (freshness of the acidity).

title: Lysholm Linie Aquavit
bodyHtml:
Lysholm Linie Aquavit is produced in Norway, with its historical roots and traditional point of origin in Trondheim. The brand’s heritage dates back to 1821 when it was founded by Jørgen B. Lysholm, a pioneer in Norwegian spirits production. The distillery is famous for a unique maturation tradition that began accidentally in 1805; a shipment of potato spirit sent to Indonesia went unsold and returned to Norway, where it was discovered that the sea voyage and equatorial heat had significantly enhanced the flavour. Today, the brand is part of the Arcus portfolio, and every drop still undergoes a four month sea journey that crosses the equator twice.

2. Spirit Description

This potato based spirit is distilled in pot stills with a secret blend of Nordic herbs and spices, most notably caraway and star anise. It presents a clear, golden amber or bright buttercup hue. The aroma is complex and intriguing, featuring prominent caraway, aniseed, and orange peel alongside delicate hints of vanilla, fennel, and wood chips. On the palate, the spirit is extraordinarily smooth and well balanced, delivering leading notes of caraway-seeded rye bread, toasty oak, and liquorice, with finer hints of sherry and peppery spice. The body is moderately oily and rich, leading to a long, dry, and warming finish with lingering notes of herbal spices and old sherry. Lysholm Linie Aquavit is bottled at 41.5% ABV.

title: Mcguinness Creme de Menthe White
bodyHtml: Clear and colourless, Crème de Menthe White is a favourite ingredient in many dessert-style cocktails

title: Averna Amaro - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Averna Amaro, crafted in Caltanissetta, Sicily, is an iconic and well-loved Italian amaro. Made with a secret blend of herbs, roots, and citrus, this liqueur captures the essence of Sicilian tradition. Its flavour profile offers a harmonious combination of bitter and sweet notes, with hints of orange, caramel, and spices. Critics acclaim Averna Amaro for its balanced and complex taste, often describing it as smooth and velvety with a long-lasting finish.
