Its versatility can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or used as a key ingredient in classic cocktails. Averna Amaro is a cherished choice for those seeking a taste of Sicilian heritage.

title: Boudier Creme De Cassis - 700 ml
bodyHtml: Boudier Crème de Cassis, crafted in Dijon, France, is a refined blackcurrant liqueur that tantalizes the taste buds. Made by Boudier, a renowned distillery celebrated for its artistry, this Crème de Cassis offers a captivating flavour profile. It showcases the essence of sun-ripened blackcurrants, striking a perfect balance between sweetness and tanginess, accompanied by delicate floral notes. Critics applaud Boudier Crème de Cassis for its impeccable craftsmanship, applauding its velvety texture and vibrant fruit character. Whether used in classic cocktails like the Kir or as a luscious topping for desserts, this liqueur exemplifies sophistication and is a cherished choice for discerning palates.

title: Lillet Blanc
bodyHtml: Lillet, currently crafted in the enchanting region of Podensac, France, is a captivating aperitif that delights the senses with its sophisticated and nuanced flavour profile. This exquisite blend of wine and fruit liqueur reveals a vibrant golden hue, enticing the eye. Aromas of citrus blossoms and sun-ripened fruits waft from the glass, creating an immediate sense of freshness. The first sip offers a harmonious fusion of zesty citrus, herbal undertones, and a hint of honeyed sweetness. The velvety texture glides across the palate, leaving a refreshing and invigorating sensation. Lillet encapsulates the spirit of French elegance and craftsmanship, offering a refined and versatile aperitif experience that can be enjoyed on its own or mixed into enticing cocktails.

title: Profumi Della Costiera Costa d'Amalfi Limoncello
bodyHtml:
A very fragrant and proudly Campania limoncello, an extract of joy and happiness born from Amalfi lemon peels, which are washed with cold water and peeled in order to obtain a very thin lemon zest, which is left to macerate in alcohol in containers of stainless steel for a period that can vary from 7 to 10 days. A syrup of water and sugar is then prepared, which will then be mixed with the alcohol from which the lemon zests were previously extracted. Mix and leave to rest.

Radiant yellow in color, it exudes sweet citrus aromas and on the palate it has a marked lemon flavor, wonderfully fresh, an invitation to spring and summer.

Perfect as a digestive at the end of a meal, it is ideal to be enjoyed mixed with tonic water on ice cream and fresh fruit salads.

title: Brovo Amaro 04
vendor: 300840 - Top Of My Glass Holdings Inc.
bodyHtml: Brovo Amaro 4, currently crafted in Woodinville, Washington, USA, is a remarkable liqueur that delights the senses with its complex and enticing flavour profile. This artisanal amaro unveils a deep mahogany hue, capturing the allure of its carefully selected botanicals. The aroma is a captivating blend of warm spices, earthy herbs, and a hint of citrus zest, inviting you to explore its depths. With the first sip, a symphony of flavours unfolds, where notes of bitter orange, aromatic herbs, and a touch of caramelized sweetness dance on the palate. The velvety texture coats the tongue, leaving a lingering and satisfying finish. Brovo Amaro 04 showcases the craftsmanship of American distilling, offering a unique and memorable taste experience that embodies the spirit of innovation and artistry.

title: Ricard Pastis
bodyHtml: A traditional French liqueur perfect for sitting on a patio and contemplating the day. Served with a few drops of water, the clear amber turns slightly milky, revealing intense anise/licorice and herbal spice. Slightly sweet with a black licorice flavour and a warm, herbal finish.

title: McGuinness Blue Curacao
bodyHtml: With its wild neon blue colour, McGuinness Blue Curaçao is crafted to enhance the visual appeal of any drink, making it a fun, colourful and tasty cocktail option. Bring on the drink umbrellas!

title: Giffard Banane Du Bresil Liqueur
bodyHtml: Liqueur made from the slow maceration of bananas mostly from Brazil, spirit of bananas for an intense aroma, enhanced by a hint of Cognac.  The colour is canary-yellow with golden shades. A heady tropical nose, laden with strong flavours of ripe and dried banana. The taste is sweet, butter-fried banana blazed with an oak-aged alcohol (rum or cognac). 25% ABV.

title: Cinzano Extra Dry - 1 Litre
bodyHtml: Cinzano Extra Dry is a captivating Italian vermouth with a crisp and refreshing flavour profile. The delicate pale yellow liquid tantalizes the palate with its aromatic blend of botanicals and citrus notes. Its dryness is perfectly balanced, offering a harmonious combination of subtle bitterness and a zesty freshness. Cinzano Extra Dry leaves a clean and invigorating finish, making it an excellent choice for aperitifs and cocktails. This exquisite vermouth is currently made in Italy, where the renowned Cinzano brand continues to uphold its legacy of craftsmanship and quality since its founding in Turin in 1757.

title: Baileys Salted Caramel
bodyHtml: Creamy opaque mocha colour with rich aromas of caramel, toffee, vanilla and dairy cream; full-bodied and sweet, with a creamy texture and flavours of salted toffee, caramel and chocolate; finishes with a light saltiness and distinct whiskey notes.

title: Giffard Menthe Pastille
bodyHtml:
Created in 1885 by Emile Giffard, then a pharmacist in Angers, who transformed his pharmacy into a distillery. White mint liqueur, transparent, obtained from essential oils of peppermint (Mitcham type).  On the nose, very nice peppermint aromas. The whole is very pleasant thanks to the fresh and spicy breath that emanates from it. Fresh and balanced mouth. The flavor of peppermint invades the palate leaving an extreme sensation of freshness.

Master Medal 2014 – Liqueur Masters by The Spirit Business Magazine.

Gold Medal – Liqueur Masters 2016 by the Spirits Business Magazine.

title: Rumchata Cream Liqueur - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
General Information

Milky white in colour; aromas of spice, ginger, toast and vanilla; rich and full with creamy sweet honeycomb and spiced flavours.

title: Giffard Blackberry Creme de Mure
bodyHtml: Deep purple colour. Frank and powerful olfactory attack. Impressions of puree of fresh fruit and jam. Round and pleasant mouth bring by the freshness of the fruit. Aromatic power of the blackberry. Bitterness of seeds at the end.

title: Martini Bianco - 1 Litre
bodyHtml: Martini Bianco, crafted in Pessione, Italy, is a classic and timeless vermouth. Made with meticulous attention to detail, this Bianco vermouth captures the essence of Italian elegance. Its flavour profile is a delicate balance of herbal notes, gentle spices, and a subtle sweetness. Critics praise Martini Bianco for its smoothness, versatility, and ability to elevate classic cocktails. With its light and refreshing character, it adds depth and complexity to drinks like the Martini & Rossi cocktail. Whether enjoyed as an aperitif or mixed into a variety of cocktails, Martini Bianco embodies the artistry and sophistication of Italian vermouth.

title: Trader Vic's Macadamia Nut Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Trader Vic’s Macadamia Nut Liqueur hails from the United States and is a creation of the legendary tiki icon Victor “Trader Vic” Bergeron. Known for pioneering Polynesian-inspired cocktails and global tiki culture, Trader Vic’s legacy includes a commitment to rich flavours, island-inspired indulgence, and top-quality ingredients. This liqueur reflects the brand’s flair for transporting drinkers to a tropical escape.

This luxurious nut liqueur pours a deep golden amber and offers aromas of toasted macadamia nuts, warm vanilla, and a hint of caramel. On the palate, it is rich and creamy, with buttery macadamia notes balanced by a smooth sweetness and soft tropical undertones reminiscent of roasted coconut and subtle spice. Full-bodied yet smooth, it finishes with a lingering warmth and velvety mouthfeel.

Food Pairing
Ideal with vanilla ice cream, dark chocolate cake, pecan pie, or creamy desserts. It also elevates coffee drinks and tiki cocktails alike.

title: Ancho Reyes
bodyHtml: Pleasantly sweet, followed by chile with moderate heat and slight acidity. Hints of spices, tamarind, plum, cacao, apple and almonds, then subtle notes of fine herbs. A pleasantly lingering pungent taste on the finish.

title: Goldschlager
bodyHtml:
Shimmering and bold, Goldschlager is a favorite cinnamon liqueur with real gold flakes stirred in. The German word Goldschlager refers to the gold-leaf makers who beat bars of soft gold into wafer-thin sheets.

These feather-light, palatable gold flakes add an exciting visual experience to the flavorful taste experience of Goldschlager in a cocktail or as a chilled or straight shot.

title: Giffard Peach
bodyHtml: Liqueur (crème de fruits) made from an infusion of peaches. Yellow colour with golden shades. Fresh and pleasant aroma. Smell of freshly picked ripe fruit. Bright and fruity tasting notes. Aromatic intensity marked by stewed notes of fresh fruit. The stone of the fruit is very noticeable at the end of tasting.

title: Sheridan's Original Coffee Liqueur
bodyHtml: Sheridan's Original Coffee Liqueur, produced in Dublin, Ireland, is a captivating and indulgent liqueur. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, this unique liqueur showcases a distinctive two-layered design, with one side featuring rich coffee liqueur and the other containing smooth white chocolate. Its flavour profile is a harmonious combination of rich coffee notes and creamy chocolate, resulting in a luxurious and velvety taste. Critics praise Sheridan's Original Coffee Liqueur for its exceptional quality and unique presentation, often describing it as a decadent treat for the senses. Its exquisite flavours and an eye-catching design make it a beloved choice for those seeking a premium coffee liqueur experience.

title: Luxardo Sambuca Passione Nera
bodyHtml: A variation of the traditional Sambuca dei Cesari Luxardo. It is aromatized with licorice, with a production recipe entailing several levels of successive infusions to blend the different ingredients. The predominant taste is star anise, combined with a new velvety sensation on the palate of lightly spicy hints of cardamom and coriander and an aftertaste dominated by licorice aromas. It is neither an ordinary licorice digestivo nor a commonplace coffee-sambuca.

title: Bols Melon
bodyHtml: This emerald-green liqueur carries the taste of freshly sliced honeydew melon. Its palate releases crip melon notes, with a pleasant sweetness and a wonderfully fruity finish. Made with natural ingredients by our Bols master distiller and celebrated by cocktail lovers all over the globe.

title: McGuinness Melon
bodyHtml: With its bright green colour and gentle melon flavour, McGuinness Melon is a delicious and fun way to celebrate St. Paddy's day, and is the key ingredient in the famous melon ball shot.

title: McGuinness Apricot Brandy
bodyHtml: With its apricot aromas and all natural sweet apricot flavour, cocktails that include McGuinness Apricot Brandy taste out of this world!

title: Schladerer Kirschwasser (Black Forest Cherry) - 350 ml
bodyHtml: Distilled from black, fully ripened cherries of the Black Forest, Kirschwasser is naturally aromatic and has a distinct fruity flavor. Known thoughout the world as Kirsch, this product is genuine only when it is distilled from cherries native to the Black Forest.

title: Amaro Montenegro
bodyHtml:
Amaro Montenegro is a traditional amaro distilled in Bologna, Italy. It is made using over 40 herbs, including vanilla and orange peels, bottled at 23%vol. This amaro was first produced by Stanislao Cobianchi in the late 19th century and is named after Princess Elena of Montenegro. Amaro (plural "Amari") is Italian for "bitter", a type of drink the Italians didn't invent, but have made into an art form.

Amari are commonly drunk as after-dinner digestifs and usually have a bitter-sweet flavor, sometimes syrupy, with an alcohol content between 16% and 40%. Amari are typically made by macerating herbs, roots (often gentian), flowers, bark, and/or citrus peels in alcohol, either neutral spirits or wine, mixing the filtrate with sugar syrup, and allowing the mixture to age in casks or bottles. Many commercial bottlers trace their recipe or production to the 19th century. Recipes often originated in monasteries or pharmacies. Amari are typically drunk neat, sometimes with a citrus wedge. We are big fans.

title: Jagermeister - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Every German masterpiece contains equal parts precision and inspiration. Bold, yet balanced, our herbal liqueur is no different. Blending 56 botanicals, our ice-cold shot has always been embraced by those who take originality to the next level.

title: St Germain Elderflower
bodyHtml:
This liqueur originates from France. The brand was established in 2007 by third generation distiller Robert Cooper and was later acquired by Bacardi. Inspired by the iconic Saint-Germain-des-Prés quarter of Paris, the spirit is crafted using fresh, handpicked elderflowers harvested once a year in the late spring along the foothills of the French Alps.

Spirit Description

This liqueur displays a bright, translucent gold colour with brilliant clarity. The aroma is highly aromatic and floral, dominated by fragrant fresh elderflower, juicy white peach, passion fruit, and pear, accompanied by soft citrus accents. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied with a silky, syrupy texture, delivering vibrant flavours of Meyer lemon, lychee, grapefruit, and subtle tropical fruits balanced by a refreshing fruit acidity that prevents excessive sweetness. The finish is clean, floral, and elegant, leaving behind a lingering note of citrus zest and honeysuckle. Bottled at an ABV of 20%, it offers exceptional freshness and aromatic balance, making it a versatile cocktail staple.

title: Southern Comfort - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Southern Comfort Liqueur, originally crafted in New Orleans, Louisiana, is a beloved and iconic spirit. Made with a unique blend of fruits, spices, and whiskey, it embodies the spirit of the American South. Its flavour profile offers a harmonious balance of sweet and tangy fruit notes, complemented by warm spices and a touch of caramel. Critics have praised Southern Comfort for its smoothness and versatility, noting its ability to be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or mixed into a variety of cocktails. With its distinct flavour and rich history, Southern Comfort remains a timeless choice for those seeking a taste of Southern hospitality.

title: Miro Dry Vermouth - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Miro Dry Vermouth entices with its captivating blend of botanicals and crisp elegance. With a delicate pale gold hue, this vermouth offers a refreshing and invigorating taste experience. The first sip reveals a lively combination of herbal notes, showcasing hints of zesty citrus and a subtle bitterness. A nuanced interplay of flavours unfolds, featuring a delicate balance of aromatic herbs and spices, complemented by a touch of floral elegance. Miro Dry Vermouth leaves a clean and vibrant finish on the palate, perfect for crafting classic cocktails or enjoying it neat. This refined vermouth is currently crafted at the Miro distillery in Reus, Catalonia, Spain, a region renowned for its vermouth-making heritage.

title: Licor 43
bodyHtml: Inspired by a golden elixir produced during Roman times, Licor 43 is made from a secret combination of herbs, fruit and citrus. The result is a delicious golden liquid, with an aromatic bouquet of vanilla, citrus and orange blossoms that instantly transports you to the Mediterranean.

title: Southern Comfort - 750 ml
bodyHtml: This is whiskey at its most laid back. Smooth. Satisfying. With that just-right balance of sweetness and spice. Southern Comfort Original is the one-of-a-kind taste you’ll keep coming back to.

title: Phillips Peppermint Schnapps
bodyHtml: Phillips Peppermint Schnapps is a strong, peppermint-flavored liqueur. It was the first peppermint schnapps to hit America when it began production in 1937.

title: Kahlua - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Originating in Mexico in 1936, Kahlua is a coffee liquor loved all around the world. Used in a range of different drinks, from coffees to cocktails, it goes hand in hand with many occasions. Classic cocktails, like the White Russian, Espresso Martini and Black Russian just wouldn’t be the same without it. With its enticing caramel colour, Kahlua coffee liquor boasts the deep, rich flavour of real black coffee, roasted chestnut and indulgent sweet butter.

title: Fernet Branca - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Fernet Branca is an iconic and intensely bitter amaro from the country of Italy, specifically the Lombardy region in Milan. It was first formulated in 1845 by self-taught herbalist Bernardino Branca, who co-created the liqueur as a medicinal remedy alongside his parent company, Fratelli Branca. Still owned and managed by the Branca family through the holding company Branca International, the distillery continues to follow a secret proprietary recipe that has remained largely unchanged for over 180 years.

Spirit Description

The spirit is crafted from a complex blend of approximately 27 to 40 different herbs, roots, and spices sourced from four continents, including saffron, myrrh, rhubarb, and chamomile. The botanicals are infused in a grape based base spirit and matured for at least one year in oak vats to develop its signature depth.

  • Colour: It possesses a dark, opaque coffee brown or deep mahogany hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is profoundly herbal and medicinal, featuring sharp notes of peppermint, menthol, and anise alongside bitter orange, saffron, and earthy roots.

  • Palate: It is intensely bitter and bold on the palate, dominated by flavours of espresso, unsweetened chocolate, and menthol. These are layered with citrus marmalade, butterscotch, and a strong herbal character resembling tree bark.

  • Body: The spirit is medium to full bodied with a rich, syrupy, and viscous texture.

  • Finish: It concludes with a powerful and clean finish that is both spicy and sweet, marked by lingering notes of espresso, campfire smoke, and a brisk menthol cooling.

  • ABV: This amaro is typically bottled at 39% or 40%.

Food Pairing

The intense herbal bitterness of Fernet Branca makes it a powerful palate cleanser and a traditional after dinner digestivo.

  • Savoury: It pairs remarkably well with salty or rich foods such as olives, lobster butter, and gamey meats like pork or lamb.

  • Cheese and Snacks: Sharp aged cheeses or blue cheese provide a strong counterpoint to the liqueur's herbal depth.

  • Dessert: Its minty and cocoa notes complement dark chocolate, mascarpone, and sweet pastries like coconut macaroons or gingerbread.

  • Serving: While it can be enjoyed neat or on the rocks, it is a key ingredient in classic cocktails such as the 'Hanky Panky' and 'Toronto'. It is also famously served as a 'Fernet con Coca' (with cola), a popular preparation in Argentina.

title: Baileys - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Baileys is currently made in Dublin, Ireland, where it originated. This creamy liqueur is renowned for its rich and indulgent flavour profile. Combining the smoothness of Irish whiskey with the lusciousness of fresh cream and a hint of cocoa and vanilla, Baileys offers a delightful balance of sweetness and depth. Critics often commend Baileys for its luxurious and velvety texture, praising its versatility in both sipping on its own or as an addition to coffee or dessert cocktails. Its iconic taste and smooth finish have made Baileys a beloved choice for those seeking a decadent and comforting indulgence.

title: Manos Negras Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
The eternally fussy Pinot Noir is a challenging grape to grow. However, Argentina is finding that the cool climate of its Patagonian region is perfect for growing this much-coveted grape.

Argentinian Pinot Noir exudes cherry, strawberry and vanilla, and tends to be high in acidity due to the high elevation, cool climate it's grown in. Being lighter in body and higher in acidity than many other red wines, Pinot Noir should be paired with something like bruschetta, roast chicken, or a nice vegetarian pizza.

title: Savian Pinot Grigio Venezia - 1 Litre
bodyHtml: There is a richness to the pale straw colour in the glass. Followed by notes of citrus, pale peach and white flowers on the nose. Refreshing with a dry crispness, the mouth is filled with flavors of ripe pear and finishes with a velvety apricot note.

title: Villa Marchesi Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Italy, specifically the Friuli Venezia Giulia region within the Friuli Grave subregion, Villa Marchesi is crafted to showcase the authentic, crisp character of Northern Italian white wines. The winery emphasizes a philosophy of balance and terroir, producing approachable wines intended to provide immediate drinking pleasure without being overly heavy.

Wine Description

This Pinot Grigio presents a light straw yellow colour with subtle green tints. The aromatic profile is delicate and refreshing, featuring notes of acacia flowers, green apple, and pear, underpinned by a hint of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is dry and light bodied with a zesty, clean acidity that leads into a crisp finish often marked by a touch of blanched almond.

title: Casa Silva Cabernet Sauvignon Coleccion 2024
bodyHtml: Intense dark red with violet hues. On the nose; plums, strawberries, dark cherries. Fresh acidity balanced with light tannins. A perfect match to enjoy with lamb chops and mint sauce or meat dishes complimented with nutmeg.

title: Produttori del Barbaresco - Langhe Nebbiolo 2024
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
The Produttori del Barbaresco Langhe Nebbiolo originates from the Langhe DOC in the Piedmont region of Northern Italy. Founded in 1958, this historic cooperative is composed of 54 families who collectively tend 100 hectares of premium vineyards to produce exclusively Nebbiolo based wines. Their winemaking philosophy centers on a dedication to the heritage of the Barbaresco commune, ensuring that even their entry level Langhe Nebbiolo offers an immediate and authentic expression of the grape's personality and the unique terroir.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo presents a ruby red colour with a medium body. The aromatic profile is defined by intense red fruits, specifically strawberries and ripe cherries, accented by spicy notes of white pepper, anise, and tea leaves. On the palate, the wine is balanced and fresh, featuring bright fruit flavours supported by medium tannins and a lingering, spicy finish.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and firm tannins of this Nebbiolo make it an excellent companion for savoury Italian dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with pastas featuring simple meat sauces, wood fired pizzas, or a classic porcini mushroom risotto.

title: Dancing Crow Vineyards Sauvignon Blanc Lake County 2022
bodyHtml: Aromas of white alpine strawberry, spring flowers and white pineapple. On the palate there is a freshness and nuance with flavors of fresh Bartlett pear, white peach and guava. This wine balances a crisp brightness with a full mouthfeel, accentuated by layers of complexity and minerality; pairing exquisitely with oysters, shellfish, seafood pastas and goat cheeses.

title: Glen Carlou Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: This Glen Carlou Cabernet Sauvignon consistently over-delivers on expectations with great structure and complexity. An intriguing combination of dark fruit, plums, cherry and cigar box notes. The tannins, fruit and oak on this Noble example is perfectly integrated resulting in a balanced and full-bodied wine, with a seamless finish.

title: Casa Silva Carmenere Coleccion 2024
bodyHtml: Gorgeous aromas of black and red fruits with a hint of tobacco. Plenty of sweet fruit, cherries and blackberry notes on a soft, rounded palate. The finish gives you soft tannins, balanced acidity and a lingering aftertaste. The wine pairs nicely with a wide range of dishes from meaty fish, white and red meat, game and poultry. A broad range of herbs and spices such as mint, nutmeg, garlic and chives can be used to draw out the flavours of this wine.

title: Castello Di Albola Chianti Classico 2020
bodyHtml: Ruby-red in colour, advancing to garnet, this wine is bursting with notes of strawberry, red berries, sage, spice cake and subtle earth on the nose. It is vibrant and medium-bodied, revealing lively cherry and exotic spice and leading to polished tannins and a delicate finish.

title: Garzon Cabernet De Corte 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine comes from Uruguay, specifically the Maldonado region on the country's Atlantic coast. Bodega Garzón is a flagship winery for the nation, founded by Alejandro Bulgheroni and directed by the world-renowned consultant enologist Alberto Antonini. The estate is famous for its sustainable practices, being the first winery outside North America to pursue LEED certification. The name "Corte" refers to a blend, and this specific bottling is designed to be a fresh, approachable entry into the estate's high-caliber portfolio.

Wine Description

The Garzón Cabernet de Corte 2021 is a vibrant and fruit-forward red blend that highlights the influence of the nearby Atlantic Ocean.

  • Appearance: Deep and intense ruby red.

  • Nose: An aromatic profile dominated by spices, freshly cut herbs, and green pepper, layered with notes of ripe blackberries and soft black fruits.

  • Palate: Gentle and silky on the entry, the wine is medium-bodied with velvety tannins. It offers a core of blackcurrant and berry flavors balanced by a delicate acidity and savory herbal undertones.

  • Technical Details: The 2021 blend is primarily 80% Cabernet Franc, rounded out with 10% Tannat, 5% Merlot, and 5% Marselan. It is fermented in stainless steel tanks to preserve its varietal character and aged on its lees in the same tanks (no oak is used for this specific "Estate" tier). The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 12.5%.

Food Pairing

This wine's fresh acidity and herbal character make it exceptionally food-friendly. It is an excellent match for roasted pork or poultry curry with tomato-based sauces. It also pairs well with grilled meats, vegetable quiches (especially spinach or rocket), and roasted eggplant. For cheese, try it with creamy or semi-hard varieties like Camembert, Goat cheese, or Fontina.

title: Crudo Catarratto Zibibbo 2024
bodyHtml:
Bright yellow colour with an aromatic scent with hints of tropical fruit, pineapple, elderflower and citrus. Fresh and fruity with balanced sweetness, hints of ripe tropical fruits, pineapple, mango, white flowers and lime.

Crudo pairs well with light and spicy Asian dishes, seafood, and fresh salads. It is also a perfect wine just as an aperitif.

title: West Cape Howe Shiraz Two Steps 2018
bodyHtml: This has lovely mouth filling, juicy, dark plum fruit flavours typical of our cool climate grown Shiraz. These generous, sweet fruit flavours are balanced by the slightly charry, lightly drying tannins picked up during its oak maturation. There are lifted, lightly spicy characters with a hint of pepperiness, which sit well with the wine’s gentle acidity. It is a fragrant, well flavoured wine that was bottled relatively early to retain its fresh fruit characters, then matured in bottle for over 12 months to become well integrated. Very approachable now and will also reward further cellaring, eg 2 – 6 years. Serve with an Asian style beef dish.

title: Baccolo Rosso Veneto 2022
bodyHtml:
This unique Red Blend is partially blended with dried grapes, a technique known as Appassimento. This allows for a more concentrated flavor from the grapes.
This spicy red has ripe red fruits and pepper overtones with a dark ruby color.

title: Charles Smith Cabernet Sauvignon Wines of Substance 2022
bodyHtml:
This Cab is from Charles Smith, the dynamic, self-taught guru of Washington wines. He turned from a life as a rock band manager to rock the world of wine. The Wines of Substance Cabernet Sauvignon is loaded with blueberries, cassis, scorched earth and spice in a rich, full-bodied, balanced package.

"Dark chocolate, nutmeg, sage and blackcurrants on the nose, followed by a full-bodied, focused and juicy palate. Firm yet ripe tannins. Drink or hold." 92 Points - James Suckling

title: Attilio Ghisolfi Langhe Nebbiolo 'Sbardaja' 2022
bodyHtml: Brilliant ruby red in colour, this Nebbiolo presents a decidedly floral and broad bouquet. Hints of cherry and plum return, combined with liquorice and a hint of spice. In the mouth, it is warm, savoury and velvety, thanks to a moderate tannic charge. To do it justice on the table, it needs to be paired just right. Excellent with first courses with meat sauces, such as classic agnolotti al brasato.

title: Bostavan Bastardo (Medium Sweet Red)
bodyHtml:
Bostavan Bastardo is a semi-sweet red wine produced by Vinăria Bostavan, a prominent winery in Moldova's Etulia region. Crafted from the Bastardo grape variety, traditionally associated with Portuguese Port wines, this Moldovan expression offers a unique and approachable profile.

Tasting Notes

  • Color: Dark ruby red.
  • Aroma: Aromas of black cherry and violets.
  • Palate: Smooth and well-balanced, with flavors of wild sour cherries and a subtle touch of tannin, leading to a velvety finish.

Alcohol Content

Approximately 12% ABV

Serving Suggestions

  • Temperature: Serve at 16-18°C (60-64°F).
  • Food Pairings: Complements beef or veal dishes.

title: Radikon Oslavje 2018
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s Friuli Venezia Giulia region, Radikon is a pioneering winery located in the village of Oslavia, near the Slovenian border. Founded in 1948 and now led by Saša Radikon, the estate is celebrated for its uncompromising commitment to natural, organic viticulture and extended skin-contact winemaking. Radikon has been instrumental in redefining the character of white wines through traditional methods and minimal intervention.

Wine Description
The 2018 Oslavje is a captivating blend of 50% Chardonnay and 50% Sauvignon Blanc, produced from organically cultivated vines with an average age of 30 years. This amber-hued wine reveals aromas of dried apricot, orange zest, herbal tea, and subtle oxidative notes. On the palate, it is richly textured yet vibrant, offering layers of stone fruit, honeycomb, and a fine mineral streak, all supported by a well-integrated acidity. The wine undergoes a three-month maceration on the skins, spontaneous fermentation with native yeasts, and ages for 42 months in large Slavonian oak barrels, followed by an additional 18 months in bottle. It is bottled without added sulphites or filtration, resulting in remarkable purity and complexity.

Accolades
Vinous – 94 points.

Food Pairing
Pair this structured and aromatic wine with aged cheeses, roasted poultry, or rich vegetable dishes such as mushroom risotto or eggplant parmigiana. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Talbott Kali Hart Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from California’s renowned Santa Lucia Highlands, this Pinot Noir is crafted by Talbott Vineyards, a winery celebrated for its dedication to producing exceptional wines. The winery, known for its innovative approach, focuses on minimal intervention in the vineyard and cellar, allowing the natural terroir to shine through. With a philosophy rooted in sustainable practices, Talbott’s wines reflect the unique characteristics of this cool-climate region.

Wine Description:
The wine presents a deep ruby color, offering a vibrant expression of the Pinot Noir varietal. On the nose, delicate aromas of red cherry, raspberry, and subtle earthiness intertwine with hints of spice and light oak. The palate is smooth, with a medium body and refreshing acidity, supported by ripe fruit flavors of strawberry and pomegranate. The finish is long and silky, showcasing the wine's elegance and balance, with a touch of floral notes lingering.

Accolades:

  • James Suckling - 92 points

Food Pairing:
This Pinot Noir is an ideal companion to dishes like roasted chicken with herbs, grilled salmon, or a mushroom risotto. Its balanced acidity and subtle tannins enhance the flavors of these dishes, creating a harmonious and memorable dining experience.

title: Nespolino Sangiovese - Merlot 2023
bodyHtml:
Poderi dal Nespoli, established in 1929 in Emilia-Romagna, Italy, is a family-owned winery renowned for its dedication to producing wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region. With a commitment to quality and tradition, the winery has become a symbol of excellence in Italian winemaking.

The 2021 Nespolino Sangiovese-Merlot blend presents an intense ruby red colour. On the nose, it offers fresh and approachable aromas, with notes of cherry and violet, typical of Sangiovese, complemented by herbal and chocolate nuances from Merlot. The palate is dry, harmonious, and well-balanced, making it a versatile choice for food pairing.

This wine pairs beautifully with pasta dishes, roasted meats, or aged cheeses, enhancing the depth of both the wine and the meal. Together, these pairings create an unforgettable dining experience.

The 2021 vintage in Emilia-Romagna benefited from favourable conditions, resulting in wines of remarkable freshness and balance. Nespolino Sangiovese-Merlot exemplifies the region's ability to produce approachable yet elegant wines.

title: Montecchiesi Preziosaterra Sangiovese 2022
bodyHtml:
Montecchiesi Preziosaterra originates from Italy, within the Central Italy region, specifically the Tuscany region and the Cortona subregion. Owned and operated by the Dal Cero family since 1980, the estate has dedicated its operations to producing high-quality red wines inspired by prestigious Tuscan winemaking traditions. The winery's operational philosophy centers on combining traditional regional methods with contemporary expertise. Recognizing the exceptional hydrogeological potential of the Cortona lands—characterized by balanced clayey sands, marly sandstones, and shales—the estate utilizes the manual "alberello" (bush-trained) method of cultivation. This practice avoids chemical additives and maximizes light exposure, ensuring a natural, spontaneous development of the vines that emphasizes a deep connection to the land, which inspired the wine's name ("precious earth").

Wine Description

This red wine presents an intense ruby red or deep crimson appearance in the glass and possesses a medium-to-full-bodied structure with a well-rounded, smooth, and chewy texture. The sensory profile is notably vibrant, fruity, and welcoming, opening with an expressive nose of ripe fruits, including sour cherries, fresh raspberries, and dried plums, seamlessly backed by hints of spice, tobacco, and earthy undertones. On the supple, flavorful palate, it delivers a balanced, dry profile defined by a bright fruit core, featuring layers of blackcurrant, red berries, and light herbal undertones. These flavors are held together by a supportive backbone of firm, integrated tannins and a refreshing natural acidity. The finish is remarkably long and savory, leaving a persistent impression of dark fruit fruitiness, delicate spice, and a subtle edge of cocoa.

  • Varietal Composition: A thoughtful Tuscan blend consisting of 50% Sangiovese and 50% Syrah.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its effortless versatility and pure varietal character, beautifully marrying the regional typicity of Tuscan Sangiovese with Syrah, the grape variety par excellence of the Cortona area. To round out its structural depth, the wine undergoes a light refinement in wood, which pleasantly softens the palate while preserving its upfront fruit charm.

  • ABV: 13.5% to 14% (varies slightly by vintage).

title: Noelia Ricci Sangiovese Eromagna Godenza 2018
bodyHtml:
From Sangiovese grapes, handpicked in the historic Vigna Godenza, is born a wine, that goes back to the origins of the traditions of this vineyard and the territory of Predappio.

This wine has an intense ruby red color. The nose is rich in cherry and wild berries tones with herbaceous and hints of resiny underbrush. The palate is juicy and pleasant, medium-bodied; a rich and savory confirmation of the nose.

It pairs well with fresh pastas, Bolognese, beef, wood-grilled pork tenderloin, veal, game and hearty cheeses, and could easily be the wine of choice for an entire meal of foods from the region. It also works with Chicken Tagine and savory curry dishes.

title: J. Baumer Riesling Rhein 2024
bodyHtml: Everyone agrees that Riesling is one of the most elegant varietals on the planet, and at J.Bäumer, they wish to popularize its vibrant and aromatic side. Behind this modern packaging stands a perfect balance between liveliness and the delicate touch of sweetness, in which typical scents of lime, honeydew and mineral notes shine.

title: Wente Merlot Sandstone 2022
bodyHtml: Straightforward cherry flavors with hints of vanilla and coffee bean filling out the aromas. Direct, ripe berry fruit through the palate, and mild tannins on the finish. Certified Sustainable.

title: Hewitt Cabernet Sauvignon Rutherford 2017
bodyHtml:
Hewitt Cabernet Sauvignon is opulent with a modern sensibility and approachability. There are layers of depth with incredible generosity and unctuousness on the palate. The alluring vibrant aromas and flavors invite you to enjoy macerated blackberry, black cherry and black currant characters, supported by hints of dark cola bean, vanilla, espresso, and rum-raisin. Multi-layered and complex, on the palate you’ll find rich, ripe, dense, dark blueberry, dark plum and blackberry fruit, finishing with a mouthwatering line of acidity and a focused persistence and density. 

Incredibly drinkable now but also age worthy, this is a wine that truly exemplifies the personality of Hewitt Vineyard. The finish is long and inviting with plush velvety-textured tannins. Hewitt Cabernet Sauvignon is crafted to be cellar-worthy, however, if you can’t wait to enjoy a glass, we recommend decanting to allow the fullest expression to evolve and reveal itself within the glass.

94 Points - James Suckling

A very typical Napa red with blackcurrant, chocolate and some cedar. Medium to full body with creamy tannins. Round. Dusty. Fruity and juicy. Very drinkable now, but give it a year or two.

94 Points - Vinous

The 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon is a big, plush wine. Raspberry jam, white chocolate, blood orange and sweet spice give this unctuous, flamboyant Cabernet tons of immediacy and overall appeal. This is an especially extroverted Cabernet done in a style that turns the volume up to eleven, or more.

92+ Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple in color, it bursts from the glass with bold scents of crème de cassis, Black Forest cake and blackberry pie with hints of licorice, tar, new leather, Indian spices and potpourri plus a touch of clove oil. The full-bodied palate is a peddle-to-the-metal blockbuster, exploding with baked black fruit and exotic spices, framed by velvety tannins and plenty of freshness, finishing fantastically long and spicy. 

91 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon from Hewitt does well in the vintage and has a classic, elegant, satisfying style. Lots of red and black currants, tobacco, cigar box, and cedar notes emerge from the glass, and it’s medium to full-bodied, with a balanced, understated profile, moderate yet firm tannins, and outstanding length.

title: Tenuta di Castellaro Ossidiana Nero 2016
bodyHtml:
This wine has a strong and decisive character, lit by the sunsets of Lipari like the fire of volcanoes.

The first, great classic red wine of Aeolian Islands with an enveloping and decisive structure.

title: Torbreck GSM Old Vines 2023
bodyHtml: Almost Burgundian in style, the palate offers a soft latent richness and silken like texture with subtle notes of crushed cherries, black plum and earth, all neatly wound by a taught spine of acidity and ripe supple tannins.

title: Dry Creek Heritage Zinfandel 2022
bodyHtml: This Zinfandel presents enticing aromatics of raspberries, cherry and a hint of toast and black pepper. On the palate, brambly flavors of ripe boysenberry and spicy dark chocolate come forward. The wine is complex, with bright acidity complimented by notes of berry syrup and mocha. The tannins are silky and smooth to lend a round, rich mouthfeel. From start to finish, this remarkable wine offers refreshing acidity paired with excellent structure.

title: Bolla Valpolicella Classico 2021
bodyHtml: Bolla wines reflect true Italian style, and express the terroir of the Veneto region. Made from hand-harvested grapes, and aged for two months in oak. Enjoy aromas and flavours of toasted oak, spice, plum and other red fruit notes. Serve with pizza, pasta or roast chicken with pomegranate glaze.

title: Beaulieu Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley 2019
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the United States, this expressive red wine highlights the signature depth of California's renowned Napa Valley. Founded in 1900 by Georges de Latour, Beaulieu Vineyard holds a legendary position in the region as a historical pioneer of premium Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon. The winery is deeply rooted in a philosophy of classic, structured winemaking, relying on meticulous blending and diverse microclimates to shape its enduring estate style.

Wine Description

The Beaulieu Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon displays a rich, dark burgundy and russet red hue in the glass. The soft, alluring bouquet reveals layered aromas of red currant, raspberry, Bing cherry, and cassis, seamlessly accented by notes of mocha, cedar, and holiday spices. On the palate, this medium to full bodied wine is plush and inviting, delivering juicy flavors of ripe red berries, cherry compote, and black currant. This fruit core is framed by fresh acidity, a velvety mouthcoating texture, and fine, dusty tannins that lead to a lengthy, dry finish with subtle hints of violet and black pepper.

title: Alois Lageder Lagrein Alto Adige 2022
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and "authentic" red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Alto Adige DOC (South Tyrol) in the foothills of the Alps. Alois Lageder, established in 1823 and now in its sixth generation, is a pioneer of sustainable viticulture in the region. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a deep respect for nature; while their estate vineyards have been biodynamic for decades, as of the 2024 harvest, 100% of their partner vineyards (totaling 140 hectares) are now also farmed using organic or biodynamic methods. This Lagrein represents the "Classic" line, designed to showcase the pure, varietal character of one of Alto Adige’s most cherished native grapes.

Wine Description

Alois Lageder Lagrein presents a deep cherry-red color with ruby and violet reflections. The sensory profile is rich and fruity, featuring an aromatic nose of ripe berries, plums, and violets, layered with sophisticated hints of spices, leather, and cocoa. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and "structured," showcasing a fresh acidity and noticeable tannins that are balanced by a soft, persistent finish. This 100% Lagrein reached an ABV of 11.5% to 12%. To preserve its "mountain freshness," the wine underwent malolactic fermentation and was matured for approximately 12 months in a combination of stainless steel and concrete tanks.

title: Pievalta Verdicchio Tre Ripe 2024
bodyHtml: Made from bio-dynamically grown grapes, this bright, elegant white offers delicate scents of spring wildflowers, orchard fruit and toasted nuts. The fresh, tangy palate offers white peach and tangerine flavours while a hint of almond-like bitterness backs up the finish.

title: Cable Bay Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: This wine grabs you from the moment it enters the glass. You are firstly hit with a flintiness as if two river stones have been smashed together, which gives way to the fruit hidden beneath. The alluvial gravel and ocean-influenced terroir of this site gives a chalky mineral element to the wine which is reminiscent of lime sorbet, the salinity fits in with the well-directed crisp acid for a long finish. Lees ageing contributes further complexity and weight to the palate. All of these elements come together for a refreshingly complex and in balance Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc.

title: Rocca delle Macie Chianti Vernaiolo 2020
bodyHtml: Deep ruby colour; coffee, floral, dark fruit and sweet licorice aromas; dry, medium-bodied with ripe dark fruit and spice flavours, well balanced and a dry finish.

title: Chronic Cellars Pink Pedals 2021
bodyHtml: Strap in for fresh melon and dried strawberry aromas the float on the breeze. Then, coast towards minerality and lively flavors of high cherry notes with mouth watering acidity and clean finish. This is a rose that stays true to style and lets you ride along nicely.

title: Evolution Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Evolution Pinot Noir is a vibrant red wine originating from the United States, crafted in the renowned Willamette Valley region of Oregon. Produced by Sokol Blosser Winery, a pioneering family owned operation founded in 1971, this wine embodies a deep commitment to sustainable viticulture and innovation. The winemaking philosophy behind the Evolution line focuses on creating highly approachable, expressive, and fruit forward wines that authentically reflect the dynamic terroir of the region.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir presents a bright ruby colour and opens with an expressive bouquet of fresh picked cherries, crushed raspberries, sweet basil, and a hint of warm baking spices. On the palate, it delivers a medium body packed with juicy red fruit, blackberry, and a subtle undertone of savory mushroom. The wine shows wonderful tension between its bright fruit profile and savory elements, balanced by soft tannins, a silky yet tense texture, and a gentle acidity.

title: Noelia Ricci Il Sangiovese Romagna 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hailing from Italy, this wine is produced in the Emilia Romagna region within the historic Predappio subregion. The Noelia Ricci project was launched in 2010 within the historic Tenuta Pandolfa estate, which has been in the Ricci family since 1941. Today, fourth-generation vintner Marco Cirese continues the vision of his grandmother, Noelia, focusing on a contemporary 'micro-cru' philosophy that honours local traditions and the unique calcareous clay soils of the Rabbi Valley.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese presents a bright ruby red colour that reflects its classic, unmanipulated style. The bouquet is expressive and floral, featuring notes of red rose petals, hibiscus, and lavender alongside ripe red berries, cherry, and a hint of eucalyptus. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and energetic, offering juicy flavours of Morello cherry, cassis, and raspberry complemented by savoury herbal undertones and a distinct salty mineral vein. It is defined by a fine, lithe tannic structure and a fresh, stinging acidity that ensures high drinkability.

title: Vina Tarapaca Cabernet Sauvignon Gran Reserva 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine range expresses the essence of terroir at the El Rosario Estate, and embodies Viña Tarapacá's tradition of "savior faire". Crafted with meticulousness and deep insight, the wines are contemporary and versatile, and strive to faithfully reflect the origin of each of its grape varieties.

Deep ruby with aromas of blackberry and cassis, chocolate, and herbal notes of dill, bay leaf, and lavender.  The palate is balanced with smooth ripe tannins and followed by a finish with excellent persistence.

Pair with game meats, well-seasoned pastas, and mushroom risotto.

title: Red Schooner Voyage 12 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
This bold and 'transoceanic' red wine originates from grapes grown in the Andes Mountains of Argentina's Mendoza region. Produced by the Wagner family of Caymus Vineyards, Red Schooner Voyage 12 follows a unique production method where the fruit is harvested, chilled, and transported by sea to their Napa Valley winery in California for vinification. The winery's philosophy for this 'Red Wine of the World' is to apply signature Caymus winemaking techniques; typically reserved for Napa Cabernet, to international varietals, creating a style that is dense, dark, and supple.

Wine Description

Voyage 12 presents a deep, dark appearance and is produced from 100% Malbec grapes. The sensory profile features an intense nose of ripe currants, cherries, and plums, layered with earthy notes, spice, and a hint of mocha. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and 'strikingly smooth', showcasing flavours of dark fruit, blueberries, and milk chocolate. It is characterized by fine, textural tannins and a rich, seamless mouthfeel that leads to a long, polished finish. This wine reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.2%. While the Wagner family emphasizes hand-selection and meticulous craftsmanship, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Attilio Ghisolfi Barolo Bussia 2019
bodyHtml: The colour is a ruby red, almost garnet, with a flowery, rich and expansive nose. The taste is well-balanced, mature, deep and nicely tannic, with a long finish. This wine is excellent for drinking from an early age.

title: L'Ora Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
From the picturesque vineyards of Italy’s Trentino-Alto Adige region, L'Ora Pinot Grigio 2024 reflects the alpine purity and terroir-driven elegance that defines northern Italian whites. Produced by Mezzacorona, a cooperative winery founded in 1904 and now one of the most respected names in the region, this wine is a product of sustainable viticulture and precise, modern winemaking.

Pale straw yellow in the glass with shimmering green highlights, the wine opens with delicate aromas of pear, white peach, and citrus blossom. The palate is dry and crisp, with flavours of green apple, lemon zest, and a subtle mineral note reminiscent of mountain spring water. Light-bodied yet persistent, it finishes clean and refreshing with a touch of salinity.

Food Pairing

An excellent partner to grilled shrimp, light pasta dishes with olive oil and herbs, or fresh mozzarella and tomato salad. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Rodney Strong Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve 2021
bodyHtml: Rich, lush and structured, the vintage displays intense aromas of black currant, cassis and crushed violet. This wine is velvety with a smooth, lingering finish of herbal notes, vanilla, and cocoa. Made with 100% Cabernet Sauvignon.

title: Donna Laura Ali Toscana 2024
bodyHtml: Italian word for "wings", Ali is also the name of Lia Tolaini-Banville's daughter. Made from Sangiovese, the cuvee is not aged in a cask to preserve much of the authenticity and fruit of the varietal. Notes of cherry, cocoa, flowers and spices melt in a generous mouth.

title: Ex Nihilo Night 2020
bodyHtml: Perfectly balanced with rich aromas of cassis, tobacco, and black cherry. The palate boasts flavours of raspberry, vanilla beans, and dark chocolate while the tannins ignite your senses. The Merlot and Malbec express fruit-forward and robust characters, whilst the Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon bring depth and tannin structure. The gorgeous Petit Verdot adds floral complexity.

title: Reserve De La Ronciere Cotes du Rhone 2022
bodyHtml: Dark red in colour, while blackberry is the foremost fruit on the nose. Its Grenache is ripe and well presented. The palate gives plum fruit in the Grenache style. It is a wine of easy access, but its depth is thorough, so its length is secure and sustained. It has lots of drive and ends with a flourish.

title: Cantina de Negrar Ripasso Classico Superiore 2022
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Cantina Valpolicella Negrar was established in 1933 and is one of the oldest wineries in the area. The winery's philosophy centres on preserving the heritage and traditions of the Valpolicella appellation. The winemakers view themselves as 'gardeners of the land', committed to quality, a short supply chain, and defending the Valpolicella landscape.

title: Stags' Leap Winery The Investor Red Blend 2020
bodyHtml:
Warm, rich, and inviting, with exuberant notes of dark blackberry, black cherry, blueberry cobbler, and dark plum, alongside spiced notes of cinnamon, clove, allspice and vanilla. Alluring notes of black pepper, graphite, and floral violet are interwoven with delicate savory notes of fresh thyme, lavender and wild sage. 

The plush mouthfeel is silky and inviting with round tannins that envelope the palate, leading to a long, mouthwatering finish with fresh acidity and vibrancy. Accompany alongside any dish to enliven any celebratory meal.

Blend: 39% Merlot, 32% Petite Sirah, 19% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Malbec

title: Masseria Dei Carmelitani Gavi di Gavi 2025
bodyHtml: The Gavi di Gavi Masseria Dei Carmelitani from the Piedmont wine-growing region offers itself in the glass in brilliantly shimmering platinum yellow. The nose of this white wine reveals all kinds of apples, pears, Nashi pears and quinces. As if this were not already impressive, cinnamon, garrigue and oriental spices are added due to the expansion in stainless steel. This Italian wine impresses with its elegantly dry taste. It was placed on the bottle with only 4 grams of residual sugar. This is a real quality wine that stands out clearly from simpler qualities and so this Italian naturally enchants with the finest balance in all dryness. Excellent taste does not necessarily require a lot of sugar. Light-footed and multi-layered, this crisp white wine presents itself on the palate. Thanks to the balanced fruit acidity, the Gavi di Gavi Masseria Dei Carmelitani flatters with a soft palate, without missing out on juicy liveliness at the same time. The finale of this maturable white wine from the Piedmont wine-growing region, more precisely from Gavi DOCG, finally convinces with good reverberation. The finish is also accompanied by mineral hints of limestone-dominated soils.

title: Luigi Baudana Langhe Bianco Dragon 2025
bodyHtml: A pale and bright yellow enriched by dry stone, flowers, and summery grass perfumes. Dry and slightly savoury on the palate, a warm taste well balances its stinging freshness.

title: Ikekame Fuwatoro Pineapple Nigori Liqueur - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Ikekame's Fuwatora Pineapple is bursting with refreshing pineapple that's coarsely filtered, giving it a creamy texture.  With its sweet and sour notes, and fruity goodness, this liqueur is the perfect accent mixed in a cocktail or sipped chilled!

Origin:  Fukuoka Prefecture  |  Alcohol:  7%

title: Langmeil Shiraz Hangin' Snakes 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Langmeil Shiraz Hangin' Snakes is a premium red wine from Australia, specifically sourced from the renowned Barossa Valley in South Australia. The winery's history dates back to 1842, and it is currently owned by the Lindner family, who have been part of the Barossa community for six generations. The name 'Hangin' Snakes' originates from a local dialect known as 'Barossa-Deutsch' and was a frequent exclamation used by late grower Wally Krieg during the heat of the vintage.

Wine Description

This wine is primarily a Shiraz, though it historically included a small percentage of Viognier (typically 1% to 4%) to lift the aromatics and brighten the mid-palate. The wine is matured for approximately ten to fifteen months in a combination of seasoned American and French oak barrels.

  • Colour: It displays a medium to deep ruby or crimson colour with vibrant purple hues.

  • Aroma: The nose is rich and lifted, featuring intense aromas of Satsuma plum, mulberry, and blueberry mingled with hints of rosemary, black olive, and sweet spice.

  • Palate: It offers a medium to full-bodied palate with flavours of juicy blackberry jam, dark chocolate, and mocha.

  • Body: The wine is characterized by a velvety texture and supple tannins that provide an approachable and fleshy structure.

  • Finish: It concludes with a lengthy and peppery finish, balanced by lingering notes of briary spice and vanilla.

  • ABV: Langmeil Shiraz Hangin' Snakes is typically bottled with an alcohol content of 14.5%.

title: Wayne Gretzky The Great Red 2022
bodyHtml: Juicy, fruit flavours of blue plum, black cherry and black currant are accented by notes of vanilla and cedar. Juicy, fleshy black fruits, leather and sweet spice linger on the smooth finish.

title: Cirelli La Collina Trebbiano D'Abruzzo 2020
bodyHtml:
The 2020 Trebbiano d'Abruzzo by Francesco Cirelli offers a contemporary view of the Abruzzo appellation. With ripe yellow fruit, it is reminiscent of apricot pits and peach peel and is delicately citrusy with orange zest. Herbaceous and balanced by notes of laurel, sage and light tobacco, it promises authentic drinking pleasure with a clear character of origin.

On the nose, the Trebbiano is juicy with fine phenolic-like tart contouring guardrails. The wine is clearly low in sulphur and shines on the palate with agile vitality. The acidity acts moderately in the background and is fuelled by the animating bitter notes that also characterize it haptically on the palate. Transparent and clear with a delicately saline finish thanks to the open chalky soils.

title: Ironstone Obsession Symphony White 2024
bodyHtml: Pale lemon; aromas of stone fruit, with floral ripe peach, ripe apple, lychee and tropical notes; off-dry, light-bodied, balanced fresh acidity; grapey flavours of delicious apple, peach, floral rose and tropical fruit.

title: Wolf's Head Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon has lifted, perfumed notes of orange blossom, plums, cassis, and some cedary spice and incense notes as well as medium to full-bodied richness on the palate. It’s an opulent, up-front, fruit-forward Cabernet. Deep garnet in colour, with sweet aromas of red cherry, sarsaparilla, Santa Rosa plum, cinnamon and dried herbs. Flavours of blackberry pie, baker’s chocolate, cigar and licorice with a long, dry finish. Fermented in small format stainless steel tanks. Cold soaked 4 days prior to fermentation. Temperature maintained below 80 degrees and a post-ferment extended maceration of an additional 5 days. Malolactic fermentation occurred in barrels with aging on lees for at least a year. 100% Cabernet Sauvignon.  30% New French Oak, and 70% Neutral French Oak.

title: E. Guigal Cotes du Rhone Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
E. Guigal Côtes du Rhône Rosé originates from France, within the Southern Rhône region and the Côtes du Rhône appellation. The estate was founded in 1946 by Etienne Guigal in Ampuis, a village with a winemaking history spanning over 2,400 years. Today, the domain is managed by Marcel and Philippe Guigal, who uphold a philosophy of rigorous selection and traditional winemaking to produce wines that exemplify the high standards of the Rhône Valley.

Wine Description

This rosé presents a clear, brilliant pink colour and a medium body. The sensory profile is highly expressive, featuring an aromatic nose of redcurrants, raspberries, and wild strawberries, accented by subtle floral notes and hints of citrus. On the palate, it is fresh and well balanced, delivering a fruity intensity supported by a crisp acidity and a fine mineral backbone. The finish is long and refreshing, leaving a persistent impression of ripe red berries and stone fruits.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically a blend of Grenache, Cinsault, and Syrah.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is crafted using the 'saignée' (bleeding) method and short skin contact to ensure a delicate balance between fruitiness, structure, and elegance.

  • ABV: Approximately 14%.

  • Organic Status: While the Guigal family practices sustainable viticulture and meticulous vineyard management, this specific wine is not typically certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and fruit forward nature of this rosé make it a versatile partner for a variety of summer and Mediterranean dishes.

  • Meats: It pairs excellently with grilled poultry, such as lemon herb chicken, and cold meats like charcuterie or ham.

  • Seafood: Suggested pairings include grilled fish, Provencal style bouillabaisse, and lightly spiced shrimp.

  • Light Fare: Complements fresh salads, Niçoise salad, and Mediterranean appetizers like olives and tapenade.

  • Cuisines: Matches well with mildly spicy Asian dishes or a classic paella.

title: Dirty Laundry Hush Rose 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Aromas of strawberries, rhubarb and watermelon with subtle hints of candied fruit. The palate boasts of bright red apple, watermelon rind, and blood orange. This wine is very versatile, from sipping it on its own, to Thanksgiving or Christmas dinner and everything in between. Hush is incredibly food friendly.

 The Hush Rose is comprised of several varieties, mainly Pinot Gris and Cabernet Sauvignon. The juices are processed separately, and also at different times of the vintage season, to provide complexity and flexibility with the style. The Pinot Gris is de-stemmed and crushed, and allowed to soak on their skins overnight in the cool night temperatures to allow all those luscious pear & peach flavours to soak into the juice, along with that trademark dark fuchsia colour their Pinot Gris fruit gives them. The Cab Sauv is also de-stemmed, crushed and pressed immediately. They have the capability on their crush pad to fill their press while simultaneously pressing off the juice, which gives a delicate pink colour and extracts berry flavours like the classic strawberry profile of Hush.

title: Mirabeau En Provence Rose 2025
bodyHtml: On the nose, ripe wild strawberries and raspberry compote, with a gentle spice note brought on by the Syrah. On the palate, a feast of red summer fruits, and a hint of pepper, with complexity, length and a fresh saline finish. A joyful rosé that will partner with many dishes, especially spicy and aromatic Mediterranean foods.

title: Podere Sapaio Volpolo 2022
bodyHtml:
Italy ... Tuscany ... Castagneto ... Corducci ... Bolgheri. A unique land, an exceptional terroir, a DOC designation celebrated all over the world. A place where wine breathes the sea air and the breeze whispers poems. Cypress trees and beaches, hills and pine groves, stories of art and great deeds. This is where Podere Sapaio wines have been born since 1999.

94 Points - James Suckling

Brambleberries with licorice root, slightly leafy eucalyptus and integrated graphite. Full body with elegant, velvety tannins, crisp acidity and a tight-knit structure. Power and extraction here, but a good, toasty finish with a sweet-tobacco aftertaste. One of the best examples of 2022. Drinkable now, but best in 10 years.

title: Tamanohikari Gold Omachi Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Tamanohikari Gold Omachi Junmai Daiginjo originates from Fushimi, Kyoto, the ancient capital of Japan. The Tamanohikari Sake Brewing Co., Ltd. was established in 1673 and has been under the leadership of the founding family for 13 generations. A pioneer in the industry, the brewery led the revival of the pure 'junmai' style in 1964, a commitment that remains central to their identity as they produce only junmai ginjo and junmai daiginjo grades.

Description

This ultra premium sake is clear in appearance and is crafted using 100% Bizen Omachi rice, one of Japan's oldest and rarest rice strains, polished flat to 50%. The aromatic profile is complex and fruity, featuring notes of cherry leaves, wild flowers, melon, and passion fruit with subtle hints of coconut. On the palate, it offers a full, well-rounded body with a delicate yet fatty texture and flavours of sweet rice, rich vanilla, and persimmon. It is characterized by a refined richness and a balanced acidity that leads to a crisp and clean finish. The alcohol content is 16.2%.

Food Pairing

The deep umami and rich profile of this Omachi sake make it a versatile partner for both traditional Japanese and European cuisines. It pairs naturally with sushi and sashimi, particularly fatty tuna or salmon, as well as lightly battered vegetable tempura. Its refined acidity also allows it to complement fish-based Italian and French dishes, smoked salmon, or soft, creamy cheeses like Brie and Camembert. For the best sensory experience, it is recommended to be served chilled to enhance its crispness and fruity Ginjo aromas.

title: Yoshi No Gawa Goku Jo Ginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Yoshi No Gawa Goku Jo Ginjo originates from Nagaoka City in the Niigata Prefecture of Japan. Established in 1548, Yoshi No Gawa is the oldest sake brewery in Niigata and the fifth oldest in all of Japan. The brewery has been managed by the founding family for nineteen generations and is currently led by owner Koji Kawakami.

Description

This Ginjo sake is clear in appearance and is crafted using 100% select local Niigata rice, with Gohyakumangoku used for the koji. It presents a refreshing and elegant aromatic profile with hints of peach, nectarine, and orange blossom, complemented by subtle notes of licorice and apple mint. On the palate, it is lean and tight with a smooth, transparent mouthfeel featuring flavours of Fuji apple, fennel, and fresh herbs. The finish is clean, dry, and crisp with a lingering silkiness. It has an alcohol content of 15.5% and a rice polishing rate of 55%.

Food Pairing

The delicate and light structure of this Ginjo makes it an ideal partner for fresh seafood such as raw oysters, steamed clams, and bacon-wrapped scallops. It also pairs exceptionally well with creamy or savoury dishes like carrot ginger soup, Camembert cheese, and fig and prosciutto pizza. For a refreshing vegetable match, consider serving it with a zesty melon salad or king oyster yakitori. It is best enjoyed chilled to maintain its crisp acidity and fragrant fruit notes.

title: Takara Sho Chiku Bai Premium Junmai Ginjo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Takara Sho Chiku Bai Premium Junmai Ginjo is a high quality sake originating from the United States, specifically produced in Berkeley, California. It is crafted by Takara Sake USA Inc., a leading producer that combines traditional Japanese brewing techniques with modern technology and pure snowmelt water from the Sierra Nevada Mountains. This premium expression is brewed using highly polished Calrose rice, a variety known for its suitability in crafting refined Junmai Ginjo styles.

Description

This sake presents a clear appearance and features a delicate, fruity, and floral sensory profile. It offers an aromatic bouquet with notes of fresh pear, melon, and green apple, accented by a hint of anise. On the palate, it is smooth and well balanced, providing a subtle sweetness that is complemented by a crisp, clean acidity. The body is light to medium, leading to a dry and refreshing finish. It has an alcohol by volume of 15% and is best served chilled to maintain its elegant aromatics.

Food Pairing

The refined and crisp nature of Takara Sho Chiku Bai Premium Junmai Ginjo makes it an excellent companion for a wide array of dishes. It pairs beautifully with delicate seafood such as sashimi, sushi, and grilled sea bass, as well as light poultry dishes. Its balanced acidity also allows it to complement savory appetizers like edamame, vegetable tempura, and fresh salads. For a unique pairing, try it with mild cheeses or lightly seasoned pasta dishes.

title: Yoshi No Gawa Gensen Karakuchi 'Kome Dry' Honjozo Sake - 300 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This sake is produced in Japan, in the Niigata prefecture. The Yoshi no Gawa Sake Brewery is the oldest brewery in the celebrated sake-producing region of Niigata, and the fifth oldest operating sake brewery in Japan, having been founded in 1548. The sake is produced using traditional methods, including fermentation in stainless steel tanks.

Wine Description

The sake is colourless. The aroma has soft notes of tropical fruits and subtle earthy notes, with hints of cypress, raisin liqueur, and fig also mentioned. The style is extra dry, as 'Karakuchi' means 'dry' and 'Gensen' means 'specially selected'. On the palate, it has a tight structure with notes of citrus, vanilla, green apple, and tapioca. The flavour profile is well balanced, clean, and crisp, with a savoury aspect and mild sweetness. It is a Honjozo sake, meaning a small amount of brewer's alcohol is added to enhance the aroma and texture. The rice used is grown in Japan, specifically Niigata rice, and it is polished to approximately 65%. The sake has an alcohol by volume (ABV) of around 15%. The finish is long and dry. The sake is ready to drink upon release, and can be served chilled, at room temperature, or warm. This product is not specified as organic in the sources.

title: Tamanohikari Yamahai 'Classic' Junmai Ginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Tamanohikari Yamahai 'Classic' Junmai Ginjo is a traditional and deeply expressive sake produced by the Tamanohikari Sake Brewery in the Fushimi ward of Kyoto. Founded in 1673, Tamanohikari is a historic pioneer in the sake industry, famously leading the revival of the additive-free Junmai style in 1964. This "Classic" expression utilizes the labor-intensive Yamahai brewing method, a traditional technique that relies on natural lactic acid bacteria from the brewery's environment rather than added lactic acid. This process takes twice as long as modern methods, resulting in a sake with remarkable umami depth and a "gamey" complexity.

Spirit Description

This sake is clear with a rich, pillowy texture. The nose is distinctly savory and complex, offering aromas of shiitake mushroom, buckwheat noodles, and nougat, with subtle hints of cream cheese. On the palate, it delivers a full-bodied experience with a well-balanced acidity and flavors of Brazil nuts, custard cream, and a slight earthy funk characteristic of the Yamahai style. It is crafted from premium Yamada-Nishiki rice polished to 60% and is fermented using the soft, famed groundwater of Kyoto's Momoyama Hills. It is typically bottled at 16% to 16.5% ABV with a Sake Meter Value (SMV) of +1 to +1.5, leaning towards a rich, semi-dry profile.

title: Asahi Shuzo Dassai '45' Junmai Daiginjo Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
The Asahi Shuzo brewery, which has a history spanning over 200 years, underwent a significant restructuring to focus exclusively on the production of premium Junmai Daiginjo grade sake. The name 'Dassai' translates to 'otter festival', a reference to the many otters that once inhabited the nearby rivers in Iwakuni.

Description

This premium sake is clear in appearance and is brewed using Yamada Nishiki rice polished down to 45% of its original size. It presents a graceful and elegant aromatic profile with notes of ripe melons, green apples, and delicate floral hints. On the palate, it is light-bodied and well-balanced, featuring a subtle sweetness and vibrant acidity with flavours of muscat grapes, pineapple, and mango. The experience concludes with a clean, dry, and refreshing finish. It has an alcohol content of 16%.

Food Pairing

The fruity and aromatic nature of Dassai 45 makes it an exceptionally versatile companion for a variety of fresh and light dishes. It pairs naturally with Japanese staples such as sushi, sashimi, and chilled duck, as well as vegetable tempura and pickles. Its balanced acidity and sweetness also complement Western fare including fresh salads, crudités, and soft creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert. For a more savoury match, consider serving it alongside grilled seafood or white fish.

title: Fukumitsuya Kazeyo-Mizuyo-Hitoyo 'Wind Water Man' Junmai Sake - 720 ml
bodyHtml:
Fukumitsuya Kazeyo-Mizuyo-Hitoyo 'Wind Water Man' is a Junmai sake originating from Kanazawa in the Ishikawa prefecture of Japan. It is crafted by Fukumitsuya Sake Brewery, the oldest brewery in Kanazawa, which was founded in 1625 during the Edo era. Currently run by the 13th-generation owner, the brewery transitioned to a 'Junmai-only' production model in 2001, focusing exclusively on pure rice sake brewed with centuries-old spring water from Mt. Hakusan.

Description

This sake presents a clear, light-bodied, and exceptionally smooth sensory profile designed for easy sipping. It features a delicate and fresh aroma with notes of tropical fruit, honeydew melon, mild florals, and a hint of anise or cedar. On the palate, it offers a mild sweetness balanced by moderate acidity and crisp umami, leading to a clean, refreshing finish. While some versions are bottled at 12% alcohol by volume, certain expressions are designed at a lower 9% ABV for a gentler experience.

Food Pairing

'Wind Water Man' is a versatile sake that pairs beautifully with a wide range of cuisines, from traditional Japanese dishes to Western favourites. Its refreshing acidity and light umami make it an ideal match for white meat fish sashimi, seafood carpaccio, and steamed clams. It also complements savory Western snacks like French fries, fried chicken, and prosciutto with melon. For more structured meals, try it alongside paella, yakitori, or a fresh caprese salad.

title: Chateau d'Esclans Rock Angel Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Château d'Esclans Rock Angel Rosé originates from France, within the Provence region and the Côtes de Provence appellation. The estate, located in the heart of the department of Var, was acquired in 2006 by Sacha Lichine, who set out to create a world class rosé brand. The winery's philosophy revolves around the concept of 'The Renaissance of Rosé', utilizing advanced techniques such as temperature-controlled fermentation and large oak barrel ageing to produce a wine that bridges the gap between a refreshing aperitif and a complex, food friendly white wine.

Wine Description

This rosé presents a pale pink colour with a medium body and a rich, creamy texture. The sensory profile is elegant and complex, featuring an aromatic nose of red berries, strawberries, and raspberries, accompanied by floral notes and subtle hints of citrus and green apple. On the palate, it is fresh and well balanced, delivering vibrant fruit flavours integrated with a fine mineral tension and a touch of spice. The finish is long and persistent, characterized by a refined silky mouthfeel and a clean, stony exit.

  • Varietal Composition: Primarily Grenache and Rolle (Vermentino), with a portion of Cinsault.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is partially fermented in large French oak barrels (demi-muids) to provide additional depth, roundness, and structure without overwhelming the delicate fruit.

  • ABV: Approximately 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate practices precision viticulture and sustainable management, this specific bottling is not typically certified organic.

Food Pairing

The structured and complex nature of Rock Angel makes it a highly versatile partner for a wide range of Mediterranean and international cuisines.

  • Seafood: Pairs excellently with grilled sea bass, lobster, seared scallops, and classic bouillabaisse.

  • Meats: Complements roasted poultry, such as lemon herb chicken, and lean veal dishes.

  • Savoury and Rich: Suggested pairings include truffle-infused pasta, mushroom risotto, or a sophisticated Niçoise salad.

  • Cuisines: Matches well with mildly spicy Asian dishes, such as sushi or Thai curry, which highlight the wine's fruit and acidity.

title: Domaine Houchart Cotes De Provence Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Domaine Houchart is located in the heart of the Côtes de Provence appellation in France, specifically within the Sainte Victoire subregion at the foot of the Montagne Sainte Victoire. Purchased in 1890 by Aurélien Houchart—a friend of the painter Paul Cézanne—the estate is now managed by the fifth generation of the family, including Geneviève Quiot. The winery's philosophy emphasizes traditional cultivation and soil preservation to express the unique, well drained clay limestone terroir that has been farmed since Roman times.

Wine Description

Domaine Houchart Cotes De Provence Rose presents a bright, fairly sustained salmon pink colour. The nose is delicate and fragrant, offering a 'basket of red fruits' such as strawberry and raspberry, alongside peach, grapefruit, and subtle floral or white peppery notes. On the palate, the wine is dry and medium bodied, characterized by a lively freshness, citrus aromas, and a rounded texture. It is a classic Provençal blend typically featuring Cinsault, Grenache, Syrah, and Cabernet Sauvignon. This wine is best enjoyed while young to fully appreciate its youthful acidity and mineral finish.

title: Borsao Rose Seleccion 2021
bodyHtml: This crisp and lush Rose from the Campo de Borja region in northeastern Spain is 100% Garnacha. This Rose is fermented in stainless steel and sees no oak aging, preserving the vibrantly youthful characteristics of the fruit. Red luminescent colour with a warm glow of copper salmon. It has a strong aroma of berries and white flowers. Very young and fresh in the mouth, well balanced with its acidity, and rich in floral nuances and spices. Hints of tangerine and Asian pear. Ideal for appetizers, salads, grilled vegetables, seafood, fish tacos and light casual fare.

title: Joie Farm Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Pinot Noir and Pinot Gris for their rosé was hand-harvested, sorted, and de-stemmed before undergoing a 12-hour overnight soak at 12 degrees Celsius. The must was then gravity-fed into the pneumatic press where the juice was pressed off the skins slowly and gently. The glycol chilling system allowed them to maintain a clean and controlled ferment that lasted about ten days in stainless steel. The Merlot and Malbec were de-stemmed and sent straight to the press for a short one-hour soak to avoid over-extraction.

Pinot Noir lends this wine rhubarb and Montmorency cherry flavours, coupled with a lively and fresh mouthfeel. The skin-contact Pinot Gris adds a creamy strawberry note to the mid-palate, and they added a dash of Merlot and Malbec to bring in some spice.

title: Belle Glos Rose Oeil De Perdrix 2023
bodyHtml: A delightful wine that exudes elegance and sophistication. On the nose, it offers a complex bouquet of ripe strawberries, raspberries, and watermelon, along with floral notes of rose petals and orange blossom. The fruit aromas are complemented by a subtle hint of spice, which adds a layer of depth to the wine. On the palate, it is crisp and refreshing, with vibrant acidity that balances the wine's sweetness. The flavours of fresh red berries are pronounced, with a slightly tart finish that lingers on the tongue. The wine has a medium body and a silky texture that makes it easy to drink.

title: Bodegas Muga Rose 2024
bodyHtml: Bodegas Muga is a family firm founded in 1932 by Isaac Muga and Aurora Caño. The first wines were made in an underground cellar until in 1968 they decided to set up their own winery in a beautiful old 19th-century townhouse situated in the city of Haro. The Bodegas Muga outstanding feature is that it always uses the finest materials, combining tradition with the latest advances in winemaking so as always to give its wines the very best quality without losing authenticity. Indeed, it is the only wine cellar in Spain which employs its own master cooper and coopers, who make all the vats for the cellar as well as the oak casks. The winery remains true to traditional winemaking methods such as racking the casks by gravity and fining the wine with fresh egg whites.
