Bodegas Muga has succeeded in combining the purest family tradition with an updated vision of the future which has allowed them to preserve their own personality and character.

title: Chateau Pesquie Terrasses Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Château Pesquié is located in France, within the Ventoux appellation of the Southern Rhône Valley. For three generations, the Chaudière family has stewarded the estate, with brothers Alexandre and Frédéric currently leading the family adventure. Their winemaking philosophy centers on biodynamic and organic practices to express the unique terroir of Mont Ventoux, which is defined by high-altitude limestone soils and a cool microclimate.

Wine Description

Terrasses Rosé presents a very pale, bright, and limpid pink hue. The nose is highly aromatic, wafting with scents of small fresh red berries, such as raspberry and strawberry, complemented by citrus notes and delicate floral undertones. On the palate, the wine is light bodied and dry, offering a refreshing balance of sweet tart fruit and a lift of minerality.

title: Perrin La Vieille Ferme Rose 2025
bodyHtml: Beautiful light pink colour, with pastel highlights. This lively and balanced wine offers a beautiful freshness, with delicate red fruits, flowers and citrus aromas. On the palate, this very aromatic wine shows fresh fruit notes with great persistence.

title: Birichino Vin Gris Rose 2020
bodyHtml: Coral or pale salmon perhaps best describes the tint, suggesting a gentle, delicate, wispy rose in keeping with the gentle, delicate sensibilities of the house's founders. The initial scent, as well, might lead one down the primrose path of frivolous expectations, effusively perfumed as it is of flowers and Asian fruits.

title: Marques De Caceres Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
This rose wine originates from Spain, specifically from the Cenicero and Rioja Alavesa areas within the Rioja DOC region. Founded in 1970 by Enrique Forner, Marqués de Cáceres is a family owned winery that was established with a vision to combine Spanish tradition with French winemaking expertise gained in Bordeaux. The winery's philosophy emphasizes the French concept of 'terroir' and innovation, having pioneered a move away from traditional oxidation and heavy oak use in Rioja to produce vibrant, fruit forward wines.

Wine Description

Marqués de Cáceres Rosado displays a luminous and pretty pale coral pink colour. The nose is delicate and floral, offering a bouquet of wild strawberries, raspberries, and blackberries layered with hints of aniseed, white blossoms, and fresh herbs like sage. On the palate, the wine is light to medium bodied and refreshing, delivering luscious summer flavours of red apple skins, watermelon, and citrus nuances balanced by a crisp acidity. It is characterized by its lively structure, refined elegance, and a classic dry finish with mineral undertones. This wine is typically a blend of 96% Tempranillo and 4% Garnacha Tinta, though compositions can vary slightly by vintage. The ABV generally ranges between 12.5% and 13.5%. While the winery employs sustainable practices and manual harvesting, this specific wine is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through two years to enjoy its youthful freshness.

title: Le Petit Chat Rose 2025
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: From its eye of the partridge colour to its fresh, floral strawberry and citrus nose, this is a delight to sip all afternoon and evening on a sunny patio. A Provence-style dry rosé, full of juicy strawberry, and raspberry with a twist of garrigue spicing. Pair with tomato and cheese pasta dishes, crab, pork, or chicken.

title: Whitehaven Rose 2024
bodyHtml: Intense fresh strawberry, raspberry and melon fruit flavours, with candy floss and floral notes. A medium-bodied wine, with clean acidity and intense red fruit flavours that linger on the long, dry finish. This is a dry Pinot Noir Rose suited to pairing with food. Try serving with smoked fish, or fresh green salads. Mild, hard cheeses such as Edam, Gouda or Gruyere will also work well.

title: Juan Gil Rose Honoro Vera 2024
bodyHtml: A refreshing wine, with aromas of cherries, watermelon and fresh herbs. A rose wine ideal for a wide variety of dishes and simply sipping!

title: Louis Bernard Cotes du Rhone Rose 2025
bodyHtml: Pink colour. Aromas of red berries mixed with floral notes and sweet spices. Its mouth is round, ample and rich with aromas of red berries. It matches perfectly with fish in sauce, cold cuts, grilled white meats, tapas, aperitif with friends, pizza or with Mediterranean cuisine.

title: The Ned Rose 2024
bodyHtml: A sensitively handled blend of two Pinot varieties, one where the Noir delivers a long, saturated core of pure berry fruit flavour with crisp acid edges and a lightly drying tannin tail whilst the Gris provides the perfect juxtaposition, a subtle richness that lends fruit sweetness, flesh and palate texture. Gently pressed to minimize colour and tannin pick up, the resulting juices are fermented in temperature-controlled, stainless steel tanks with select yeast strains, chosen for their ability to capture and enhance aromatic intensity whilst contributing positive palate texture attributes. A highly versatile wine that neatly bridges the gap between stand-alone, afternoon sipper and being enjoyed alongside a broad range of diverse food styles.

title: Matua Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: An inviting Pinot Gris from an award-winning winery. Pale straw, with aromas and flavours of baked pear, white peach, citrus, and white flower. It's light-bodied and crisp with a refreshingly clean finish. Try with rotisserie chicken alongside fingerling potatoes or seared scallops with a lemon butter drizzle.

title: La Petite Perriere Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
La Petite Perriere Rose is produced in France as a Vin de France, primarily sourced from the Saget family's estate vineyards in the Touraine district of the Loire Valley. The Saget family began their winemaking legacy in 1790, and today Saget La Perriere remains one of the few estates in the region to enjoy over two centuries of continuous family ownership. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on achieving a meticulous balance between the vibrant acidity of northern fruit and the richness of grapes from the south.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir rose presents a brilliant, pale pink robe accented by raspberry highlights. The bouquet is an expressive explosion of red fruits, featuring aromas of fresh raspberry, morello cherry, and redcurrant, complemented by delicate notes of rose petals. On the palate, the wine is fresh and lively, showcasing a supple texture where fruity and floral notes are supported by a distinct mineral backbone. It is a light-bodied, dry style with a crisp acidity and a clean, refreshing finish.

title: Spier Rose 2025
bodyHtml: A wine for all occasions. This sweet Rose offers irresistible fruit flavours on the nose. The fruit carries through to a medium-bodied palate that lingers with every sip.

title: Poplar Grove Rose 2025
bodyHtml:
Medium light rose petal pink. Aromas of fresh raspberries and apricot combine with an enticing hint of blood orange. A robust palate of ripe nectarines and cantaloupe is well-balanced with delicate citrus notes. 

Enjoy as a light, fresh opener to an evening or as a stand-alone aperitif.

title: Torres Rose Las Mulas 2025
bodyHtml: An outstanding Chilean Rose! Delicate cherry colour. Fresh aromas are reminiscent of red and black fruits. Intense palate with delicate acidity. Fresh, lingering aftertaste.

title: Charles & Charles Rose 2022
bodyHtml: The colour is a pale salmon, copper pink with flashes of fuchsia. The aromatics lead with notes of wild raspberry and cherry, giving in to bright citrus, Herbs de Provence and lavender. There's a strong note of rose petals as well. All this carries through on a light and dynamic palate with a tangy bright finish.

title: Mateus Rose
bodyHtml:
Mateus Rosé is perhaps the most famous Portuguese wine in history. Created in 1942 by Fernando Van Zeller Guedes, the founder of Sogrape, it became a global cultural icon in the 1960s and 70s. It is instantly recognizable by its unique flask-shaped bottle, which was inspired by the canteens used by soldiers during World War I. At its peak, it accounted for nearly 40% of all Portuguese wine exports and was famously enjoyed by icons like Jimi Hendrix, Steve Jobs, and even the Queen of England.

Wine Description

The Mateus Rosé Original is a light, young, and fresh wine known for its slight "pétillance" (fizz).

  • Appearance: A bright and appealing salmon-pink hue.

  • Nose: Fresh and seductive with an intense bouquet of young red fruits—think raspberries, strawberries, and red currants—mixed with floral hints of rose petals.

  • Palate: Well-balanced and tempting, it offers a soft, creamy texture with a refreshing acidity. The signature slight sparkle (fizz) gives it a lively, "mouth-filling" sensation and a clean finish.

  • Technical Details: A blend of traditional Portuguese red grapes, including Baga, Rufete, Tinta Barroca, and Touriga Franca. It typically has a low alcohol content of 11% ABV and around 15 g/L of residual sugar, giving it a semi-dry (off-dry) profile.

title: Penfolds Club Tawny Port
bodyHtml: The Penfolds Club Tawny is a delicious fortified wine. The wine shows aromas and flavours reminiscent of Portos from Portugal. One may not even recognize the difference and could be surprised that this wine is a New World effort. The wine's cream, pruney, and rancio characters. Rancio is a recognized flavour descriptor that is often found in many Sherries and adds additional nuances that make the wine stand out. Drinks well now, and would be perfect with chocolate mousse or a mild cigar.

title: Lustau Pedro Ximenez (PX) San Emilio Solera - 375 ml
bodyHtml: With piercing aromas of raisin pudding, molasses and spice, this rolls out the welcome mat and more. Luscious is probably as tame as you can put it, as this is a ribald sweet wine with acidic backbone and hugely intense flavours of baked brown sugar, cinnamon cake and molasses. Powerful but still racy due to bracing acidity.

title: Ramos Pinto Tawny 10 Year Old Quinta de Ervamoira
bodyHtml:
Made from high-quality wines of the Quinta de Ervamoira by blending harvests of different years.  The new wines make it robust and fresh, while the oldest wines give it complexity and 'lineage'.  A well-rounded generous aroma, with balance and a hint of wine.  Fruit aromas include orange, apricot, and plum. Vanilla and old Port wine casks make up its woody aromas.  This is a fruity tawny variety.  The attack on the palate is smooth and full-bodied.  Following the initial oily feel, a fresh, soft fruitiness appears which finishes with a slightly acidic, woody note.  A good structure and perfect balance between fruit and alcohol.  

92 Points - Wine Spectator     Redolent of cherry tart, dried black fig and plum pudding flavors, with accents of hazelnut. The fruity finish is loaded with Asian spice and dark chocolate notes

92 Points - Decanter     Rich, warm caramel and dried plum aromas lead to a soft mouthful of red fruits with striking peppery notes, nuttiness and coffee.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate     The NV Quinta da Ervamoira Tawny RP 10 Year Old Port comes in at 106 grams per liter of residual sugar. This is the new 2015 bottling. Beautifully focused and balanced, this has fine mid-palate weight for the category and a complex medley of concentrated flavors on the finish. Quite gripping, it is beautifully done and rather impressive, while always remaining graceful and impeccably balanced. There is very respectable tension on the finish, too, that enlivens the wine. Taste this in isolation and you'll think my score is pretty stingy, but remember that there does need to be some headroom when we step up to the long-aged Tawny treasures. This may have been my favorite 10 Year Tawny this issue.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast     From the farthest reaches of the upper Douro, Quinta da Ervamoira has produced this sun-drenched wine, with great raisin flavors that vie with a fruity red-berry character. Both sweet from the dried fruits and dry from the intense acidity, with a light cocoa aftertaste, it is a balanced wine that can be drunk now.

90 Points - Wilfred Wong of Wine     A fiery wood-style port, the Ramos Pinto 10 year Tawny shows a nice juxtaposition of red fruit and creamy wood. The wine's medium to full bodied palate and lively aftertaste make an excellent choice with a milk chocolate mousse topped with fresh whipped cream.

title: Chateau Montifaud Vieux Pineau Des Charentes
bodyHtml:
Pineau des Charentes is the result of stopping the grape juice fermentation within hours of the pressing by blending it with cognac that is at least one year old — a process that originally occurred by mistake in 1589. This leaves an unmistakable sweetness tempered by a fresh fruit character.

Dominant tones range from fresh to gilded straw, then honey, with the gold becoming more intense with age. These are followed by hues of apple green, silver or gold. Pineau are limpid and of great brilliance. Aromas of white and yellow fruit, honey and acacia blossom. Ageing in wooden barrels gives notes of "rancio": ripe and dried fruit, hazelnut, grilled almond, vanilla and buttered toast.

When used as an aperitif, serve at between 8 and 10 degrees Celsius, and add an ice cube if required. Delightful as an Apéritif but can work equally well with fruit based deserts and cheese.

title: Graham's 30 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
Light, orange-tinted amber color, magnificent perfumed nose with great class showing an array of dried fruits. Outstanding mature concentrated palate with full honeyed fruit, gorgeously mellowed. Simply delicious with an aftertaste that lasts and lasts. An excellent alternative to Vintage Port at less formal occasions. Will keep for some weeks after opening.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Remarkably, this is able to show age and long cask aging, but the flavor is still here: figs and honey, balanced out with burnt caramel aged acidity and a rich (but not sweet) finish. Excellent, top quality aged tawny.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Broad in feel and dark in profile, with walnut and hazelnut notes leading the way, followed by brown bread, dried fig, bitter orange, singed almond and juniper notes. A lovely flash of green tea adds sparkle and detail on the finish, but this stays reliant on its bass line throughout. Drink now. From Portugal.

94 Points - Decanter

The intensity and luxuriousness of this Port is a real treat. With an average age of 30 years, there has been plenty of time for the component wines to concentrate down and develop incredible complexity. Rich, syrupy and immediately nutty on the palate, sweet spices follow with a wave of cleansing acidity. Notes of dried orange peel, dried fruits, cinnamon and caramel flood the long finish. Very well balanced and surprisingly fresh.

title: Fonseca Ruby Port
bodyHtml: Ruby port is the traditional style of port and Fonseca have been shipping Ruby since the company was founded over 150 years ago. Fonseca take great pride in their Ruby which has remained consistent in quality for over a century and a half. The wine is aged for three years in large wooden vats where they soften and develop without losing their fresh, intense fruity character.

title: Fonseca Terra Prima Reserve Port
bodyHtml: A wonderfully rich, concentrated organic Port with great flavour and texture. It has an opulent black fruit nose which is followed through on the palate showing layers of intense berry, plum and cherry fruit flavours supported by firm, but well integrated tannins. This is a deliciously textured Port wine, which is velvety, smooth, succulent and plump.

title: Dow's 10 Year Old Tawny
bodyHtml:
Dow's 10 Year Old Tawny Port is a distinguished fortified wine from the Douro Valley in Portugal. Crafted predominantly from Touriga Nacional grapes, this wine exemplifies Dow's dedication to producing ports of exceptional quality and character.

Colour: Deep russet with amber hues, indicating its extended aging process.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring notes of red cherry and almonds, complemented by subtle hints of peppery spice and marmalade.

Palate: Full-bodied and well-structured, offering flavors of dried fruits, nuts, and a touch of caramel, complemented by a rich, fleshy texture.

Body: Full-bodied with a rich and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and persistent, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

Accolades:

  • 90 Points - Wine Spectator

title: Warre's Otima 20 Year Old Tawny
bodyHtml:
General Information

Dark toffee coloured. A great end to a great night of wine. carmel, toffee, nutty, coffee, sweet but not cloying.

title: Dow's Late Bottled Vintage 2020
bodyHtml: Full-bodied, rich and perfectly balanced, Dow’s Late Bottled Vintage Ports are carefully selected to reflect the unique characteristics of each vintage, and are only bottled in the best years. Dow’s 2016 Late Bottled Vintage Port shares the same provenance with Dow’s legendary Vintage Ports, the iconic Douro properties of Quinta do Bomfim and Quinta Senhora da Ribeira. Aged in seasoned oak vats four to six years before bottling and release, and carrying Dow’s distinctive drier finish, this is an LBV worthy of attention.

title: Fonseca 20 Year Old Tawny
bodyHtml: Fonseca Twenty Year Old Tawny Porto is deep amber in colour with russet highlights. Its superb bouquet is a complex marriage of ripe, plummy, mature fruit, warm spicy overtones of cinnamon and butterscotch and subtle oak nuances. Full-bodied and voluminous on the palate, its smooth, velvety texture is carried into a long clean, elegant finish. Tawny Ports of age will not improve once bottled; they should be served at room temperature or barely cool at the end of a meal with nuts or not overly-sweet desserts.

title: Fonseca 10 Year Old Tawny
bodyHtml: Refined, with bright flavours of dried berry, plum compote and cherry tart that are long and lush. Very creamy on the finish, which features chocolate mousse.

title: Ramos Pinto Late Bottled Vintage Port 2018
Taylor Fladgate First Estate Port
bodyHtml: This First Estate is an outstanding Reserve Port blend made at Taylor's first property in the Douro Valley, Lugar das Lages. This sweet wine shows fresh, rich black cherry and cassis aromas. On the palate, it has a well knit structure, with a velvety, luscious mouthfeel and smooth tannins.

title: Taylor Fladgate Fine White Port
bodyHtml: White port is aged in a barrel, so the shade is honey gold, not white. This Port has a soft, elegant nose of corn syrup, baked almond, honey and vanilla. It's medium to full-bodied, very sweet, smooth and creamy with considerable licorice and warmth on the finish.

title: Taylor Fladgate 20 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml: Taylor Fladgate can rightly claim to be masters at their craft. This ready-to-serve aged Tawny is close to perfection. Rich apricot and dried-fruit flavors and lengthy, nutty, honeyed finish. Just as with the 10-year-old version, once opened this will last for several weeks. Serving Chilled Tawny Port Enjoy chilled tawny port during the summer months. Simply put the bottle in the refrigerator for an hour or so before serving. Optionally add ice, as it may dilute the flavour. A chilled Tawny, savoured as a pre-dinner drink is a great way to whet the appetite. There is also nothing nicer than sipping it slowly, lounging in the garden, reading a good book. A contemplative, relaxing wine, perfect for summer sipping.

title: Dry Sack Sherry
bodyHtml:
General Information

Medium amber orange colour; aroma of walnuts, butter almond, toffee with citrus/lemon peel; off-dry taste, warm nutty core, with lemon and alcohol warm, dry finish.

title: Brights 74 Tawny Port
bodyHtml: Medium brick colour; baked fruit and toffee aromas; warm nutty flavours and finish.

title: Illahe Pinot Noir Bon Sauvage 2022
bodyHtml:
The 'Bon Sauvage' is a premium Pinot Noir from the United States, specifically the Willamette Valley in Oregon. Illahe Vineyards, whose name is a Chinook Jargon word meaning ‘earth’ or ‘land,’ was established in 2000 by Lowell Ford, who has been growing Oregon grapes since 1983. The winery’s philosophy is to make wine as naturally as possible, working by hand on small plots and avoiding the use of enzymes or additives.

Wine Description

This 100% estate grown Pinot Noir is a barrel selection of the winemakers’ favourite barrels. The wine offers a nose with notes of bright red cherry, cola, orange peel, and graham cracker crust, alongside coastal cabin aromas of salt and rock. On the palate, the wine is light yet intense, with flavours of cranberry, orange zest, and subtle baking spice that glide across silky tannins. Characteristically, the 'Bon Sauvage' is more earth and spice driven. This wine is made with 100% native yeast fermentation and ages for sixteen months in French oak, with 25% of the barrels being new. It is a complex, structured wine with gripping acidity, fine tannins, and a velvety finish that makes it suitable for enjoying now or for cellaring four to eight years. Illahe Vineyards is LIVE certified and Salmon Safe, indicating a commitment to sustainable farming practices.

title: Siduri Pinot Noir Willamette Valley 2021
bodyHtml:
The 2021 Siduri Willamette Valley Pinot Noir comes from vineyards in two distinctive appellations within the Willamette Valley: Yamhill-Carlton and Eola-Amity - plus a third vineyard in the Southern Willamette Valley, Maple Grove, that adds structure and richness. These three areas all bring different attributes to the blend and give us a broad range of flavors to blend to create a wine that is simultaneously rich and zippy–the best of all possible worlds.

Aromas of blackberry, black tea and autumn mulch alongside flavors of cherry pit, licorice and espresso.

94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

While this is Siduri’s “regular” Pinot, it’s a real standout. Charming fruit and spice aromas seem perfectly aligned with the complex, layered, intricate flavors that follow. The wine is firm textured, concentrated and impressive, offering everything from bright raspberries to rich black cherries to cedar and clove accents.

91 Points - Wine Spectator

Snappy and generous, with raspberry and blueberry flavors accented with clove and other dusky spices as this builds tension toward the vibrant finish. Drink now through 2030.

title: Illahe Pinot Noir Willamette Valley 2024
bodyHtml: The aromas of the Illahe Vineyards Willamette Valley Pinot Noir begin with strawberry, tamarind, and blackberry then broaden along the palate to include chalk, tobacco leaf, chocolate, and earth. The acid supports a complete yet not overwhelming tannin balanced between skin and oak. The wine retains its velvet mouthfeel through a process of clarification by racking.

title: La Crema Pinot Noir Willamette Valley 2021
bodyHtml:
This graceful and site-specific red wine originates from the United States, specifically within the Oregon region and the renowned Willamette Valley AVA. Established in 1979, La Crema has spent decades exploring the premier cool-climate growing regions of the West Coast. The winery's philosophy for its Oregon expansion is to highlight the unique volcanic and sedimentary soils of the valley, utilizing small-batch fermentation and careful oak ageing to produce a Pinot Noir that captures the region's signature tension and elegance.

Wine Description

La Crema Willamette Valley Pinot Noir 2024 presents a brilliant ruby colour with delicate violet reflections. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and 'earthy', featuring a nose of red cherry, pomegranate, and wild strawberry, layered with sophisticated notes of star anise, violet, and forest floor. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and 'silky', showcasing flavours of raspberry, blueberry, and spicy black plum underpinned by a hint of flinty minerality. It is characterized by its fine-grained tannins and a bright, lingering acidity that leads to a persistent finish with notes of black tea and toasted oak. This 100% Pinot Noir typically reaches an ABV of 13.5%. While the estate follows strict sustainable practices, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: 14 Hands Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: The 14 Hands Cabernet Sauvignon is a rich, juicy red with aromas of dark cherry, black currant, coffee and subtle hints of spice. These flavours compliment spicy oak and are emphasized by refined tannins. It pairs well with Tomato-basil bruschetta, eggplant parmesan, herb-crusted prime rib, grilled beef steak, and hearty venison stew.

title: 14 Hands Hot to Trot Smooth Red Wine Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in the United States, this polished red wine is a signature offering from the Columbia Valley in Washington State. 14 Hands Winery draws its inspiration from the wild mustangs that once freely roamed the hills of eastern Washington, standing a mere '14 hands' high; this untamed spirit is reflected in their bold and fruit-forward winemaking philosophy. Long part of the Ste. Michelle Wine Estates portfolio, the winery transitioned to local family ownership in late 2025 when it was acquired by the Wyckoff family, longtime Washington grape growers dedicated to championing the region's unique terroir.

Wine Description

Hot to Trot Smooth Red Blend presents a deep ruby or dark garnet colour in the glass. The nose is generous and complex, offering aromas of cherry, red currant, and dark stone fruits, complemented by a subtle whiff of black tea and a hint of baking spice. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and 'fleshy', delivering flavours of cherry pie, ripe berries, and plums. It is characterized by a smooth, velvety mouthfeel supported by refined tannins and a persistent finish that leaves a lingering note of mocha and spice.

This versatile blend is predominantly composed of Merlot and Syrah, often bolstered by smaller amounts of Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, or Petite Sirah. To preserve its fresh fruit character and soften the structure, the wine is aged for roughly ten months in a combination of stainless steel tanks and neutral French and American oak. While it offers immediate accessibility and mass appeal as an easy-drinking 'sipper', it maintains enough weight and structure to be enjoyed over a short-term cellaring window of three years.

title: Sokol Blosser Evolution Big Time Red 2020
bodyHtml: Rich garnet colour. Sweet, pure fruit aromas of maraschino cherries, strawberry preserves and red plums. Notes of tangy cranberries, ripe raspberries and loganberries. Evolution Red has a bright pomegranate and blood orange edge, with hints of warm earth and cinnamon. The overall mouthfeel is lighter-bodied with fine tannins, finishing smooth and juicy.

title: Columbia Crest Cabernet Sauvignon H3 2020
bodyHtml: Columbia Crest H3 wines were created to celebrate the winery's rich heritage in the Horse Heaven Hills as well as its innovative spirit with regards to winemaking and viticulture practices. Grapes from this AVA produce bold, well-balanced and seductive wines. This bold Cabernet opens with flavours of black cherries and blackberries with a touch of currants and vanilla, complemented by earth and mineral notes. Deep berry flavours lead to a soft tannin cocoa finish.

title: Cristom Pinot Noir Mt. Jefferson Cuvee 2024
bodyHtml: Showcasing the traditional winemaking techniques that are the hallmarks of Cristom's house style - whole-cluster fermentations by native yeast, extended aging in French oak barrels, and no filtration - Cristom's flagship Pinot Noir offers tremendous complexity of flavor, approachability in its youth, and unparalleled value.

title: Charles Smith Pinot Grigio Vino 2021
bodyHtml: Following up on the hugely successful Kung Fu Girl Riesling, Charles Smith is back with a great Pinot Grigio providing lots of fruity pleasure. Another example of his solid self-taught instinct for winemaking. There's Pinot Grigio and then there's depth. This wine has it in spades. From the aroma to the palate. Lilac, tangerine, alpine strawberry, golden straw, and Italian melon. With density to spare. Minerally, long and lingering. An Italian tour de force.

title: Acrobat Pinot Gris 2023
bodyHtml:
Acrobat Pinot Gris originates from the United States, specifically from the Oregon region, which spans the Willamette, Umpqua, and Rogue Valleys. Originally established as a sister label to King Estate, the brand is now part of the Foley Family Wines portfolio. The winemaking philosophy is centered on 'approachable purity,' aiming to produce high-quality wines that consistently pair with casual meals and everyday adventures through sustainable winemaking practices.

Wine Description

This white wine is described as fresh and brilliant, offering a medium-bodied mouthfeel. The sensory profile features a fruit-forward nose of pear, passion fruit, and honeydew melon, which carries through to the palate. It is characterized by pleasant minerality and nicely balanced acidity, concluding with a crisp and spirited finish. Some critics also note complex aromatic layers of cut grass, guava, and warm banana bread.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend of 96% Pinot Gris and 4% Chardonnay.

  • ABV: 13%.

  • Organic Status: While Acrobat emphasizes sustainable winemaking and works with marquee vineyard sites, this specific bottling is generally classified as sustainably produced rather than certified organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is designed to capture the best attributes of Oregon, focusing on bright acidity and a shiny, mineral-rich tone from start to finish.

title: Charles & Charles Double Trouble 2021
bodyHtml:
Charles & Charles Double Trouble is a bold red blend from the Columbia Valley in Washington, United States. The winery is a collaboration established in 2008 between two iconic figures: Charles Smith, a self-taught winemaker known for his rock-and-roll approach, and Charles Bieler, an early champion of American rosé. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on minimal intervention and sustainable farming, aiming to express the unique power and complexity of Washington's high-latitude vineyards.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep ruby appearance with purple edges. The nose is fruit-forward and complex, offering aromas of black cherry, blackberry, and plum interlaced with savory notes of white pepper, black licorice, and hints of smoked meat. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, featuring lively flavors of raspberry, espresso, and brambly berry anchored by firm yet balanced tannins. The finish is long and energetic, building with subtle floral notes and spices.

Food Pairing

The savory, meaty profile and bold structure of this Syrah-dominant blend make it an ideal companion for grilled meats, BBQ ribs, or hearty beef stews. It also pairs excellently with lamb dishes or rich pasta with red sauce.

title: Kung Fu Girl Riesling 2023
bodyHtml: Fresh and bright aromas of jasmine, apricot, white peach and honeysuckle jump out of the glass. Incredible focus on the palate, with beautifully balanced acidity and sweetness. Minerality, citrus and honey round out the flavours.

title: Long Shadows Riesling Poet's Leap 2023
bodyHtml: Poet's Leap Riesling is a fresh and vibrant wine with fragrant jasmine and citrus peel aromatics combined with flavours of white peach, kumquat and ripe stone fruits. The wine's racy natural acidity and a pleasant streak of minerality provide a balanced mouthfeel and long, clean finish.

title: Long Shadows Pirouette Red Blend 2018
bodyHtml:
Pirouette is an expressive wine that opens slowly to reveal oak spice and a kaleidoscope of red and black fruit aromas and flavors that become more vivid as the wine develops in the glass. Textured and richly concentrated on the palate, the wine's voluptuous mouthfeel and refined tannins stretch across a long, satisfying finish.

95+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2018 Pirouette checks in as 68% Cabernet Sauvignon, 22% Merlot, and 10% Petit Verdot aged 22 months in 85% new French oak. Deep purple-hued, it's a young, unevolved yet incredibly promising red with smoking good notes of ripe black and blue fruits as well as tobacco, graphite, and chocolate. 

92 Points - James Suckling

Aromas of black fruit, herbs, spices and dried earth. It’s full-bodied with chewy tannins. Dense and full with a dusty, chalky texture and a firm finish. A blend of 68% cabernet sauvignon, 22% merlot and 10% petit verdot.

title: Long Shadows 'Feather' Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml:
Long Shadows Vintners, based in Washington's Columbia Valley, is renowned for its collaborative approach, partnering with esteemed winemakers to craft exceptional wines. The 'Feather' Cabernet Sauvignon is a collaboration with Randy Dunn, a legendary Napa Valley vintner known for his expertise with Cabernet Sauvignon. This partnership brings together Dunn's winemaking prowess and the unique terroir of Washington State.

Wine Description

The 2019 'Feather' Cabernet Sauvignon is a 100% varietal wine showcasing the depth and elegance of Columbia Valley fruit. Aged for 22 months in 85% new French oak barrels, it presents a deep, concentrated ruby hue. The nose is complex, offering aromas of cassis, graphite, scorched earth, and crushed stone. On the palate, it is full-bodied and concentrated, with flavors of dark fruits, mocha, and a touch of mint, supported by fine-grained tannins and a vibrant acidity. The finish is long and structured, indicating excellent aging potential.

Accolades

  • Jeb Dunnuck – 95 points

  • Vinous – 94 points

  • Wine Spectator – 93 points

  • James Suckling – 92 points

Food Pairing

This robust Cabernet Sauvignon pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, or aged cheddar cheese. The wine's depth and structure complement hearty dishes, enhancing the overall dining experience.

title: Erath Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
The Erath Pinot Noir originates from Oregon, United States, drawing fruit from the Willamette, Umpqua, and Rogue Valleys. Founded by Dick Erath in 1968, the winery is a pioneer of the Oregon wine community and was instrumental in establishing the Dundee Hills as a world-class growing region. Now owned by Ste. Michelle Wine Estates, Erath remains committed to a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes balance, fruit-forward expressions, and authentic connections to the land.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a transparent medium ruby or pale garnet appearance in the glass. The nose is explosively aromatic, offering a primary bouquet of ripe red berries, crushed flowers, and forest spice, with specific notes of cranberry, sour cherry, and warming nutmeg. On the palate, the wine is light to medium-bodied and straightforward, featuring crunchy red fruit flavours like black cherry and pomegranate accented by an herbal riff of cut leaf tobacco. It is well-balanced with refreshing acidity and firm, 'furry' tannins that lead into a long, spicy, and clean finish.

Food Pairing

This wine's bright acidity and supple structure allow for versatile pairings with various dishes. It matches exceptionally well with roasted poultry, such as chicken or turkey, as well as earthy vegetarian options like mushroom risotto or roasted red peppers.

title: Argyle Pinot Noir Willamette Valley 2023
bodyHtml: Ranging from juicy red cherry to blackberry and evolving with exotic spices such as star anise, peppercorn and black tea, the Willamette Valley Pinot Noir displays the true nature of place. In part of fermenting in small vessels, we extract pillowy and refined tannins while preserving the striking acidity of the cool climate, youthful and age-worthy Pinot Noir.

title: Sokol Blosser Evolution White 2023
bodyHtml: Evolution White is both complex and approachable, with an intensely aromatic and flavorful blend of white varietals that create a wine with depth of interest and versatility in pairing. Spicy and floral on the nose, Evolution is lush and tropical on the palate, with a soft and round sweetness that is tempered by a burst of citrus, leaving the finish clean and crisp. We may dare to say that Evolution goes with just about anything, but especially shines when sipped alongside Thai curry, Tandoori chicken, spicy tuna rolls, or a poolside on a hot day.

title: Sokol Blosser Pinot Noir Dundee Hills 2023
bodyHtml:
On the nose, this wine shows notes of black cherry and pomegranate, complemented by an earthy blend of truffle, wet forest floor, and baking spices. On the palate, the fruit remains the same, but is joined by fresh raspberry, as well as cedar and dry leaf.

This wine pairs beautifully with seared salmon and fondant potatoes, as well as spiced lamb burgers or carnitas.

title: Stoller Pinot Noir Dundee Hills 2024
bodyHtml:
The Stoller Pinot Noir Dundee Hills originates from the renowned Dundee Hills subregion of the Willamette Valley in Oregon, USA. Bill Stoller founded the estate in 2001 on property his family has farmed since 1943, transforming a former turkey farm into a world class vineyard. The winery is a pioneer in sustainability, notably being the first in the world to achieve LEED Gold certification, a commitment that reflects their philosophy of preserving the land for future generations.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir presents a medium ruby colour and opens with an aromatically complex bouquet of crushed rose petals, baking spice, and dense layers of juicy cherry. The palate is lush and soft, featuring a mosaic of red berry fruits, cranberry, and raspberry supported by melted but firm tannins. Stylistically, the wine is bright and vivid, balancing a silky texture with a touch of minerality and a seamless finish.

Accolades

  • "Wine Enthusiast - 92 points."

  • "Wine Spectator - 91 points."

  • "Vinous - 91 points."

Food Pairing

This wine is an exceptional companion for roasted chicken, rack of lamb, or salmon teriyaki. It also pairs beautifully with earthy dishes such as mushroom risotto or savoury lentils.

title: Maui Splash Passion Fruit Wine
bodyHtml: A sweet pineapple wine made from 100% Maui Gold pineapples with a touch of passionfruit. Who can resist?

title: Domaine Carneros Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml: Rich and beautifully balanced, this classic Pinot Noir is a seductive taste of the Domaine Carneros Estate vineyards. Luscious notes of black cherry, currant, chocolate, toast and clove end in a long, silky finish.

title: Woodward Canyon Chardonnay 2019
bodyHtml:
92 Points - Wine Enthusiast

The aromas pull you in, with notes of pear, yellow apple, star fruit and kisses of pineapple and spice, showing an appealing purity. The palate has concentration and richness but also exquisite balance and dexterity. Lemony notes persist on the finish. The acid balance is spot on, and as always with this producer, it's all about grace.

title: King Estate Pinot Gris 2023
bodyHtml:
Floral aromas of honeysuckle and jasmine greet the nose along with notes of ripe Asian pear, lemon, grapefruit, peach skin, and honey. On the palate, discover flavors of Bartlett pear, Meyer lemon, white peach, kiwi, honeysuckle, and damp slate. The mouthfeel is voluptuous, full of fruit with excellent balance and integration. Vibrancy on the palate leads to a refreshing and lingering finish.

90 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Pretty classic 100% stainless-steel Willamette Valley Pinot Gris that aged sur lie for four months. Aromas of watermelon drizzled with sea salt, rosemary and pine needles lead to flavors of lime, Marcona almonds and lemony Citra hops. Brisk acidity and a crisp mouthfeel.

title: King Estate Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml: The wine is an enticing deep ruby colour. On the nose find aromas of dark cherry, strawberry, blueberry, rose, toast, clove and black tea. Supple yet firm up front, the wine boasts a rich mid-palate with flavours of fresh strawberry, black cherry, red plum, forest floor, tea and rose hips. On the finish, tannins are well integrated and complemented by buoyant acidity, resulting in a balanced wine with a lingering finish.

title: Ste Michelle Merlot Indian Wells 2021
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, this wine hails from the Columbia Valley in Washington state. Established in 1934, Chateau Ste. Michelle is the oldest winery in Washington and has recently returned to local ownership under the Wyckoff family. The winery's philosophy focuses on highlighting the unique expression and quality of Washington state vineyards, combining 'New World' innovation with a deep respect for varietal character.

Wine Description

Indian Wells Merlot presents a dark, dense color and a luscious sensory profile defined by intense energy. On the nose, it offers generous aromas of blackberry, black cherry, and ripe plum, accented by delicate hints of vanilla, spice, and subtle cocoa. The palate is full bodied and velvety, featuring jammy fruit flavours and a harmonious balance of refined tannins.

title: L'Ecole No. 41 Columbia Valley Merlot 2019
bodyHtml:
L’Ecole N° 41 is recognized as one of Washington State’s top producers of premium Merlot and this wine delivers with great structure, color, and balanced acidity.

Exhibiting complex layers of raspberry, plum, and black cherry, accented by crushed roses, pencil shavings, and smoky cedar nuances, this full-bodied, vigorous Merlot bursts with flavors of macerated berries, coffee, and kirsch. Charming and ripe, it firms up to finish with a satisfying longevity.

title: Columbia Crest Grand Estates Merlot 2020
bodyHtml:
This Merlot has a rich aromatic profile with notes of chocolate and dark cherries. The complex fruit flavors are followed by a smooth, velvety finish.

Pair this wine with blue cheese, duck, beef, veal and dark chocolate.

title: Intrinsic Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: This vintage of Intrinsic has an herbal and floral nose, complemented by aromas of black cherry. The flavours are layered with tones of dried cherries, pomegranate and cocoa. The texture is rustic, yet silky, with a unique savoury and long finish.

title: Chateau Ste Michelle Riesling 2022
bodyHtml:
Chateau Ste. Michelle sources Riesling from warmer and cooler parts of the Columbia Valley, providing a range of flavours and styles in the Riesling.  The warmer sites add more tropical flavours, while the cooler sites bring more pear and lemon-lime notes.

The wine offers crisp apple aromas and flavours with subtle mineral notes. This is an 'everyday Riesling' that is a pleasure to drink and easy to match with various foods. Try it with light pasta and rice dishes, grilled fish, and a wide array of cheese.

title: Johanneshof Reinisch Rotgipfler White Blend 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Austria’s renowned Thermenregion south of Vienna, Johanneshof Reinisch Rotgipfler White Blend offers a classic expression of one of the country's most celebrated indigenous grape varieties. Founded in 1923 in Tattendorf, the estate is currently managed by the fourth generation of the Reinisch family.

Wine Description

This wine displays a sparkling green gold color. The bouquet opens with expressive aromas of ripe white peach, yellow pear, and light tropical fruit accented by floral notes and gentle spice. Creamy and full on the palate, it delivers rich flavours of gooseberry, melon, and subtle almond alongside distinct mineral nuances. It features a medium to full body with a harmonious structure, leading to a crisp and elegant finish driven by balanced, vibrant acidity.

title: Vranac Pro Corde 2020
bodyHtml: This Montenegro red wine is made from the indigenous Vranac grape. The Pro Corde (For Heart) is produced only in good vintages and in small quantities. Deep red, blackberry and supple cherry notes dominate the nose, bursting into a pleasurable harmonious experience on the palate. This medium to full-bodied red is great with BBQ, sausages, cheese and of course a nice cut of steak.

title: Dr Loosen Dry Riesling 2025
bodyHtml:
This white wine originates from Germany, specifically from the steep slopes of the Middle Mosel subregion in the Mosel valley. The Loosen family has been cultivating Riesling for over 200 years, with current owner Ernst 'Erni' Loosen taking over the estate in 1988. Under his leadership, the winery has gained an international reputation for high-quality production, following a philosophy that balances dry paternal traditions with the sweet Prädikat styles of the maternal family line. This 'Dr. L' Dry Riesling serves as a regional ambassador, produced from grapes grown in traditional slate-soil vineyards by contracted growers who adhere to the estate's strict quality standards.

Wine Description

Dr. Loosen Dry Riesling displays a bright, pure, and luminous gold colour. The nose is aromatic and expressive, offering scents of citrus, white flowers, and honeysuckle layered with notes of peach, green apple, and melon. On the palate, the wine is light to medium-bodied and refreshing, featuring zesty flavours of pink grapefruit, apricot, and lime juice supported by a crisp, 'electric' acidity. It is characterized by its elegant and racy structure, delivering a vibrant mouthfeel with a fine mineral edge and a clean, steely finish. This 100% Riesling typically has an ABV of 12.0% and is fermented in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks to preserve its primary fruit character. While the winery employs sustainable viticulture according to strict environmental regulations, this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through the next three to five years.

title: Chateau de Purcari 'Rosu De Purcari' 2019
bodyHtml:
Rosu de Purcari is a revelation for wine lovers: ripe, rich, and full of flavour. Red like fire, passionate as the first love, irresistible as a beautiful woman. It has a brick-red colour and a complex aroma of forest fruits, cranberries, and dried plums revealing delicate sweet nuances of vanilla. The fruit flavour surprises through its refinement, deepness and smoothness, ensuring a long lasting aftertaste. Made from grapes harvested and selected by hand, produced using traditional methods. Aged for 18 months in French oak barrique.

Venison, lamb, spicy Parmesan and Cheddar cheese pair well.

50% Cabernet-Sauvignon, 40% Merlot, 10% Malbec

title: Chevalier Dyonis Pinot Noir
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Romania, specifically from the Dealu Mare region within the Walachia area. Produced by S.E.R.V.E. (Société Euro-Roumaine de Vins d'Exception), the winery was founded in 1994 by Count Guy de Poix and is recognized as a pioneer in modern Romanian viticulture. The winery's philosophy is based on producing elegant wines from the high-quality clay and limestone soils of the Dealu Mare hills, a region situated on the same latitude as Burgundy, France.

Wine Description

Chevalier de Dyonis Pinot Noir displays a shiny ruby red colour. The nose is aromatic and bright, offering scents of cherries, raspberries, and red currants, accented by subtle earthy and delicate spice notes. On the palate, the wine is light to medium bodied and fresh, delivering flavours of sour cherry and raspberry supported by fine tannins and a vibrant acidity. It is characterized by its fruit-forward elegance and a clean finish, achieved through vinification intended to preserve its youthful charm without significant oak ageing. This 100% Pinot Noir typically features an ABV of 13%. While the producer emphasizes meticulous hand harvesting and attention to detail, the wine is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through three to five years.

title: Chateau de Purcari 'Negru De Purcari' 2022
bodyHtml:
Purcari is putting Moldova on the world wine map with this famous noble blend ordered by the Royals of Europe for many years. A complex conversation wine that is serious but approachable, elegant but ripe for drinking tonight while the rest of the case reaches its peak in the cellar. 

Noble with a rich structure and a generous bouquet, it truly has a regal palate. Intense ruby colour with a garnet hue. This wine seduces you with a velvety taste, balanced with oak and fruit tones. The bouquet surprises with fine shades of plums, chocolate, and figs and develops, revealing the fine aromas of vanilla and saffron. Negru de Purcari fascinates with a noble and magnificent taste, its value continuously increasing each year.

title: Boutari Moschofilero White 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in Greece, this vibrant white wine originates from high-elevation vineyards in the Mantinia region of the Peloponnese. Founded in 1879, the Boutari winery has played a pivotal role in rescuing the Moschofilero variety from obscurity, establishing it as an international benchmark for Greek viticulture.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a brilliant, crystal clear yellow-white colour with distinctive green tints. The nose is remarkably expressive, featuring a strong varietal bouquet dominated by white rose, orange blossom, and citrus fruits like grapefruit and lemon. On the palate, the wine is fresh and well balanced, offering a full texture with flavours of melon, green apple, and white peach. It concludes with a long, aromatic finish marked by lingering floral and citrus notes.

title: Lafazanis White Selection 2025 - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: This is a wine from selected vineyards of the Peloponnese with a soft white-yellow colour with green highlights. Fine citrus aroma, with a balanced taste and aftertaste that lasts.

title: Gunderloch Fritz's Riesling 2024
bodyHtml: Perfect balance of aromatics, a fruity acidity and the typical minerality of the slaty soils of the Grape-Berry. Harmony between concentration, liveliness and a strong mineralistic deepness.

title: Nik Weis St Urbans Hof Riesling Old Vines 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Nik Weis, the third-generation proprietor of Weingut St. Urbans-Hof, continues his family's legacy of producing exceptional Rieslings in Germany's Mosel Valley. The estate is renowned for its dedication to traditional viticulture and crafting wines that authentically express the region's unique terroir.

Wine Description
The 2023 Nik Weis St. Urbans-Hof Riesling Old Vines is a testament to the quality derived from mature vineyards. This wine presents a bright, pale straw color. On the nose, it offers enticing aromas of crisp apple, elderflower, chamomile tea, and hints of white cherry. The palate is lithe and mouthwatering, with a graceful profile that combines crisp apple notes with a mineral tang akin to a fruit-flavored vitamin. Off-dry in style, it should drink well through 2025.

Food Pairing
This versatile Riesling pairs wonderfully with a variety of dishes, including pork, shellfish, poultry, spicy foods, and cured meats. Its balanced acidity and subtle sweetness complement both casual and formal dining experiences.

title: Villa Wolf Riesling 2024
bodyHtml:
This modern-style dry Riesling is sourced from vineyards throughout the Pfalz region and reflects the fresh and balanced taste that all Villa Wolf wines strive to achieve. It beautifully captures the peachy fruit and stony structure that are characteristic of Rieslings grown in the sandy loam soils and warm, sunny climate of the Pfalz.

Refreshing and delicious on its own, it also pairs well with cheeses, savory vegetarian dishes, and anything involving fish, chicken or pork.

title: Schloss Gobelsburg Gruner Veltliner Kamptal 2024
bodyHtml: From Austria's Niederosterreich, Kamptal wine region, Domane Gobelsburg Gruner Veltliner is a medium-bodied, mouth-watering with ripe yellow apple, stone fruit, lemon-lime zest, pepper and baking spice flavours vibrant on the palate.

title: Peter Mertes Piesporter Michelsberg Kabinett 2023
bodyHtml: Semi-sweet with subtly fruity acidity. Salted caramel and key lime pie on the nose. Pairs well with pork, rich fish like salmon and tuna, poultry, spicy food and sweet desserts.

title: Dr Loosen Riesling Dr L 2025
bodyHtml: This top-selling Loosen Bros. wine is Ernst Loosen's "ambassador" for the Mosel region and for the Riesling variety. It embodies the delicate and racy style that is characteristic of Riesling grown in the slate-soil vineyards of the Mosel valley. Best of all, it delivers this uniquely delicious and invigorating taste at a very affordable price for everyday enjoyment. It is a bright, refreshing, fruit-driven wine, with a juicy mid-palate and a crisp, drying finish.

title: Nik Weis Urban Riesling 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Cutting yellow peach and tangerine flavours are restrained in ripeness but nuanced by delicate hints of earth and crushed slate. Off dry and light in body, this is a spine-tingling, zesty Riesling with a salty crushed mineral finish.

title: Landlust Riesling 2023
bodyHtml: Notes of honeysuckle, blossom, citrus and white peach on the nose. On the palate, lively notes of Asian pear, red apple and peach are balanced with lemon and lime notes and are framed by an intense & refreshing minerality leading to a long, harmonious finish.

title: Pieroth Riesling 2024
bodyHtml: An elegant Riesling wine with a characteristic bouquet and animating vitality. The Riesling fruit perfectly completes the lively acidity with aromas of vineyard peach, juicy apricot and a touch of citrus fruits. On the palate, it convinces with its delicate structure and a long finish.

title: Vranac 2022
bodyHtml: Medium garnet in colour with lifted, plum, smoke and liquorice aromas. Plum fruit flavour with a hint of spice.

title: Dunavar Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml: It is a medium bodied, soft and fruity wine, the fruit dominated aromas with citrus and tropical impressions. Fresh and lively acidity with hints of Co2.

title: Rabl Riesling Kamptal Langenlois 2022
bodyHtml: Delicate grassy pepper spice with mineral undertones, beautiful fruit, lime, Reinette apples, lemon balm; crystal clear structure, elegant, with remarkable length.

title: Moselland Riesling Piesporter Michelsberg 2022
bodyHtml: Piesporter Michelsberg is an elegant wine that is beautiful golden in the glass with a green edge. The scent is fresh with citrus and freshly cut grass. The taste is wonderfully refreshing with a delicious fresh fruit character. Serve the wine with salads, Asian dishes or mild cheese.

title: Dr. Zenzen Riesling Spatlese 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in Germany, this Riesling Spatlese hails from the Mosel region, where the Einig Zenzen family has cultivated a legacy of winemaking since 1636. Now in its 13th generation, the winery balances centuries of tradition with modern production techniques to create expressive wines that highlight native German varietals. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the purity of the fruit and the distinct minerality provided by the region's steep, slate-rich slopes.

Wine Description

This Spatlese presents a pale straw colour and opens with a delicate fragrance of honeyed apples, mangoes, and pineapple. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, offering a lush profile of tropical fruit and stone fruit balanced by a zesty, fresh acidity. The finish is clean and persistent, with a distinct mineral edge typical of the varietal.

Food Pairing

The wine’s natural sweetness and acidity make it a perfect match to enhance the wine’s complexity when paired with spicy Asian cuisine or fragrant curries. It also complements lighter fare such as roasted chicken, fresh seafood, and cream-based pasta dishes.

title: Max Ferd. Richter Riesling Spatlese Wehlener Sonnenuhr 2022
bodyHtml: Driven by intense and ripe yellow fruit flavours. Harmonious balance of luscious texture, mineral richness and lean, spicy fruit acid. Long lasting aftertaste. Elegant and seductive style.

title: Lafazanis Red Selection 2023 - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Bright red colour with purple reflections, inviting aromas of red fruits –cherries and plums, with black pepper notes. Good body with soft and round tannins and a long finish.

title: Josef Drathen Riesling Bernkastel 2024
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Germany, this Riesling is produced in the renowned Mosel region, specifically within the Bereich Bernkastel subregion—an area celebrated for its steep slate vineyards and cool climate ideal for cultivating expressive Rieslings. Josef Drathen, a family-run winery with deep roots in the Mosel valley, combines traditional winemaking with modern precision, producing wines that reflect both regional typicity and artisanal care.

Wine Description

The Josef Drathen Riesling Bernkastel 2024 pours a pale straw hue with brilliant clarity. Aromatically, it opens with vibrant notes of lime zest, green apple, white peach, and hints of floral blossoms and wet stone minerality. On the palate, it is fresh and lively, displaying flavours of crisp citrus, stone fruit, and a touch of honeyed sweetness that is beautifully balanced by racy acidity. Light-bodied and refreshing, the wine finishes with a lingering minerality and gentle fruit echo.

Food Pairing

This off-dry Riesling is an exceptional companion to lightly spiced Asian cuisine, grilled prawns, sushi rolls, or pork schnitzel with a squeeze of lemon. The interplay of sweetness and acidity also makes it ideal with creamy cheeses or dishes with a touch of heat.

title: Boutari Naoussa Grand Reserve 2013
bodyHtml: The wine is moderate in its fruitiness, balanced more toward fresh mushroom than cherry. The earthy and herbal notes give it a complexity that's riveting for minutes after each sip; the tannins are firm but fine, giving the wine a gauzy finesse.

title: St. Ursula Goldener Oktober 2023
bodyHtml: White wine with a fruity nose and well balanced residual sugar content. Fragrant, tropical fruit notes with citrus flavors and a medium finish.

title: Deinhard Piesporter Riesling
bodyHtml: Fragrant, green apple, spicy, fruity, mineral notes, piquant Riesling of the central Mosel area. This outstanding wine goes best with lightly seasoned food like fish, seafood and all Asian cookery.

title: Boutari Naoussa 2020
bodyHtml: Deep red in colour, with a strong personality. It gives off a rich bouquet of ripe red fruit that comes with aging (cinnamon, wood). Full-bodied, well-balanced, with good structure and soft tannins in its finish.

title: J Lohr Cabernet Sauvignon Seven Oaks 2023 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: An exceptionally dark colour with a bright hue at release. Intense fruit aromas of black cherry, plum and blueberry are accented by a barrel bouquet of hazelnut, dark chocolate and toasted pastry. Sturdy tannins strike the palate and finish with the high toned fruit signature that typifies the Paso Robles appellation.

title: Isole E Olena Chianti Classico 2019 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This complex red is produced by highly regarded winemaker and winery owner Paolo de Marchi, who has been upgrading his winery and vineyard for 40 years. Fermented with indigenous yeast, this dry red is aged for 12 months in 43-hectolitre and 23-hectolitre wooden vats followed by six months in bottle.

Look for ripe, darker fruit flavours of black cherry, strawberry, truffle, mushroom, leather and cedar in this medium-full bodied red with lots of acids and a long finish. A very lovely wine. Try it with wild boar ragu, beef stew or lamb chops.

title: Chateau d'Esclans Whispering Angel Rose 2025 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Whispering Angel is today’s worldwide reference for Provence rosé. Made from Grenache, Cinsault and Rolle (Vermentino), its pale colour is pleasing to the eye and draws one in. The rewarding taste profile is full and lush while being bone dry with a smooth finish. Highly approachable and enjoyable with a broad range of cuisine, Whispering Angel is a premium rosé that you can drink from mid-day to midnight.

title: Zenato Ripassa - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Ripasso wines are fondly referred to as 'baby Amarone' by some. Zenato's baby is bigger and richer than most, with intense flavours of blackberry jam, cocoa, dried fig, espresso creme, blueberries and raisins. Pair it with risotto with gorgonzola, or grilled meats and grilled vegetables. This wine is constructed by using Corvina Veronese 80%, Rondinella 10% and 10%, and Sangiovese grapes. Beautifully balanced.

title: Carlo Rossi Sangria - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Sangria is traditionally a social wine. You can enjoy its bright flavor as is or add slices of your favorite fruit. Sangria is paired perfectly with spicy food or soft cheese.

title: Folonari Pinot Grigio 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: The Italian classic! Cool, crisp and vibrant. Folonari Pinot Grigio is perfect for any occasion, whether paired with dinners out or takeout at home. It is an easy-drinking and versatile glass of white wine, great for days at the beach or barbecues throughout the summer. Pale yellow in colour, this Pinot Grigio has a fragrant bouquet of fresh florals on the nose, accompanied by a dry, crisp palate showing notes of green apples. Clean finish. Try it with fresh salads, seafood, fried appetizers, mozzarella, pasta with pesto or creamy sauce.

title: Pasqua Sangiovese 2025 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Intense ruby red colour, a full-bodied wine with intense fruity perfumes, soft, supple tannins and a long finish. Excellent with Mediterranean specialties such as rich pasta dishes, grilled swordfish and grilled red meat.

title: Jackson Triggs Sauvignon Blanc Proprietors' Selection - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada in the famous Niagara Peninsula region of Ontario, Jackson Triggs Sauvignon Blanc represents a crisp, vibrant expression of cool-climate white winemaking. Founded in 1993 by Allan Jackson and Don Triggs, Jackson Triggs is one of Canada's most celebrated and recognizable winery brands. Sourced from estate vineyards and partner grower sites across Ontario, the winery's philosophy focuses on capturing maximum aromatic freshness, bright acidity, and pure varietal character through cool stainless steel fermentation without oak intervention.

Wine Description

The wine presents a pale straw colour with clear, greenish reflections in the glass. An inviting and intensely aromatic bouquet opens with fresh aromas of pink grapefruit, passion fruit, and lime zest, interwoven with herbal nuances of lemongrass, fresh cut grass, and green pepper. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied, zesty, and refreshing, delivering vibrant flavours of citrus fruit, green apple, and subtle tropical guava, all driven by a lively, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Finishing clean and crisp, it leaves a lingering impression of citrus and subtle flinty minerality. Composed of 100% Sauvignon Blanc, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2028. Stylistically, it combines Niagara cool-climate brightness and zesty citrus aromatics with effortless, food-friendly freshness.

title: Frontera Cabernet Sauvignon - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Fruit forward with red plum and varietal characteristics. Medium dry, medium body and harmonious with a good finish. This wine marries two of the classic Bordeaux grape varieties: Cabernet Sauvignon offers character, complexity and longevity, while Merlot adds softer tannins and elegance.

title: Carlo Rossi Red Blend - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in the California region, specifically within the California AVA appellation, Carlo Rossi Red Blend 3 Litre Bottle represents an unpretentious, accessible, and legendary house staple of American winemaking. Founded by Charles "Carlo" Rossi in 1975 under E. & J. Gallo Winery, the brand became a cultural icon known for its honest approach to table wine and its signature ring-handle jug format. Sourced from sun-drenched vineyards across California’s Central Valley, the grapes benefit from warm growing conditions that promote uniform ripening and rich fruit development. The winemaking philosophy focuses on consistency and smooth drinkability, utilizing temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats to preserve bright fruit flavours and soft tannins. Presented in a generous 3 Litre glass jug format, it offers unmatched value and effortless everyday versatility.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, pale ruby red colour with bright garnet reflections along the rim. An approachable, fruit-forward bouquet opens with inviting aromas of candied plum, wild blackberry, ripe red cherry, and strawberry jam, interwoven with subtle notes of sweet vanilla, caramel, and floral hints. On the palate, it is light-to-medium bodied, smooth, and easy-drinking, delivering charming flavours of ripe berries and citrus fruit notes, supported by balanced natural acidity. Framed by soft, gentle tannins and a supple mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, crisp finish marked by lingering red fruit and sweet spice. Composed of a proprietary blend of traditional California red grape varieties, this non-vintage bottling combines simple fruit generosity and light body with approachable, smooth everyday appeal.

title: Woodbridge Cabernet Sauvignon - 1.5 Litre
bodyHtml: Deep garnet red with wild red berry and cassis aromas. Flavours of blackberry and tobacco give this wine excellent balance, with oak aging adding a toasty, caramelized quality. With a smooth finish, Woodbridge Cabernet Sauvignon is approachable and delicious with a variety of foods. Enjoy this wine with grilled lamb chops, barbecued ribs, or spicy Bolognese pasta.

title: Tocornal Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot 2025 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Deep purple ruby colour with a dry, soft red fruit character and a hint of cedar. Extra dry and medium-bodied with balanced acidity and ripe, supportive tannins.

title: Folonari Valpolicella 2021 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Ruby red colour; light cherry and spice aromas; light bodied with soft berry flavours.

title: San Antonio Pinot Grigio 2020 - 1 Litre
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
General Information

A great example of Pinot Grigio. Delicate colour, this light bodied Pinot Grigio has a ripe fruit aroma with pear and melon flavours on the palate. Crisp and dry, it has balanced acidity with a long lingering finish.

title: San Antonio Sangiovese 2020 - 1 Litre Bottle
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: A soft and supple red laden with juicy black cherry fruits and a velvety feel throughout.

title: Campagnola Della Casa Rosso 2023 - 2 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: A red blend of predominantly Merlot, hand-picked and selected.  Ruby red color. Fresh, light and fragrant bouquet. Dry taste, vinous, harmonious.  Ideal with pasta, pizza, light meals, meats, and cheeses.

title: Tocornal Chardonnay - 3 Litre Box
bodyHtml: An attractive white wine made from Chardonnay grapes. Fresh, clean and fragrant, it is the perfect aperitif wine, suitable for both everyday use and for special occasions.

title: Villa Barbi Orvieto Classico 2023
bodyHtml:
With its marine origins, this wine expresses the mineral character of Decugnano dei Barbi's terroir, offering a pleasant and refreshing taste that never disappoints.
This traditional wine is a true explosion of flavors and aromas that will leave you breathless from the first to the last drop!
And don't worry about aging, because this wine reaches its peak after 3-4 years from the harvest.

title: Massolino Langhe Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Piedmont region, specifically within the Langhe DOC appellation, Massolino Langhe Chardonnay 2022 represents a fresh, mineral driven, and sophisticated expression of white winemaking from a house renowned for its benchmark Barolos. Established in 1896 by Giovanni Massolino in Serralunga d'Alba, the family estate applies its uncompromising attention to detail to international white varietals. Sourced from high-altitude vineyard plots in Serralunga d'Alba, Monforte d'Alba, and Alba planted on chalky limestone and clay-marl soils, the vines benefit from cool diurnal breezes that preserve vibrant acidity and intense aromatics. The winemaking philosophy under winemakers Franco and Roberto Massolino involves protective pressing under inert gas, followed by maturation in a combination of stainless steel vats, large oak casks, French barriques, and concrete vessels for approximately 6 to 9 months with gentle lees stirring. The result is a refined Chardonnay that strikes a harmony between creamy texture, bright citrus fruit, and distinct Piedmontese limestone minerality.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale straw yellow colour with bright greenish-gold reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with fresh aromas of golden apple, crisp nectarine, lime zest, and white peach, interwoven with subtle notes of citrus blossom, hazelnut, vanilla bean, coffee cream, and crushed limestone. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silky, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of green apple, grapefruit curd, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by a textured, satiny mid-palate derived from fine lees contact and subtle oak integration, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering citrus peel, toasted almond, and a clean chalky mineral grip. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, this 2022 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2024–2032. Stylistically, it effortlessly combines Burgundy-like precision and aromatic tension with the rich structure, warmth, and mineral depth of the Langhe terroir.

title: Attems Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Attems, a historic winery in Italy's Friuli-Venezia Giulia region, has been producing wines since 1106. The estate spans 110 acres of south-facing terraced slopes, benefiting from diverse soils and a favorable climate, ideal for cultivating Sauvignon Blanc.

Wine Description

The Attems Sauvignon Blanc displays a soft, lustrous straw-yellow color. On the nose, it offers captivating aromas of boxwood, lily of the valley, and pomelo. The palate is light and smooth, featuring notes of citrus, Fuji apple, and a pronounced salty finish, particularly notable in this vintage. The wine was fermented in stainless steel tanks at 18–20 °C for 15 days and aged on the noble lees for four months, enhancing its complexity and texture.

Food Pairing

This Sauvignon Blanc pairs wonderfully with chilled shrimp, creamy cheeses, calamari, rustic breads, and vegetable dips.

title: Caposaldo Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the Delle Venezie DOC in northeastern Italy, Caposaldo Pinot Grigio is produced from estate vineyards situated 25 km north of the Adriatic Sea and 20 km west of the Slovenian mountains. The vineyards benefit from a fresh, dry, and breezy climate, with soils composed of pebbles, silt, and clay, ideal for cultivating Pinot Grigio grapes.

Caposaldo blends a handcrafted, artisanal approach to winemaking with modern quality standards and techniques. The winery emphasizes producing varietally correct wines that reflect the character of their region.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Grigio wine presents a pale straw-yellow color with green highlights. The bouquet offers delicate aromas of crisp green apple, pear, and citrus notes, complemented by subtle floral undertones. On the palate, it is bright and crisp, with vibrant acidity highlighting fresh fruit flavors, leading to a clean, refreshing finish.

title: Giusti dei Carni Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml: Beautiful straw yellow colour with greenish glints. Intense bouquet, fruity and flowery with typical notes of Chardonnay. Fresh with excellent structure, full and persistent on the palate. Pairs well with starters, soups, and risottos made with greens as well as fish and egg-based dishes.

title: Giusti Longheri Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml: Straw yellow with bright reflections. The nose is intense, fruity, with notes of pear and banana. Longheri Pinot Grigio is fresh with good structure, and persistently flavoursome on the palate.

title: Lupi Reali Trebbiano 2023
bodyHtml: Aromas of lemon, lime, galia melon, white flowers, peach and pear drops. Dry and light in body with well balanced acidity. Flavours of pear and peaches with a citrus touch and some creaminess towards the finish.

title: Case Paolin Manzoni Bianco Venezie 2018
bodyHtml: Made from the Manzoni grape, which is a cross between Pinot Bianco and Riesling, Santi Angeli has a lovely fragrance of pear, apple and stone fruit that carry over to the palate along with citrus and spice. It 's long and linear with a crisp finish.

title: Cordero di Montezemolo Langhe Arneis 2024
bodyHtml: Nice dry white wine. Bright straw color, hints of apricots with a floral nose. Great finish and crispness, clean taste, easy drink-ability.

title: Masi Passo Blanco 2023
bodyHtml: An explosion of elegant and concentrated aromas and fresh tastes. Its body and exuberance come from the local grape variety, Torrontes, while the Pinot Grigio grapes, lightly dried, give it class and the style of a top Venetian white wine. Blend of Torrontes and Pinot Grigio.

title: Tormaresca Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml:
The Tormaresca estate is part of the esteemed Antinori family’s Italian wine legacy. Tormaresca combines classic winemaking with modern viticultural techniques to craft exceptional wines from 100% estate grown fruit, a rarity in Puglia. The estate is composed of two properties: Masseria Maime, located on the Salento peninsula in Southern Puglia, and Bocca di Lupo in the Castel del Monte DOC of northern Puglia.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay is unoaked and presents a straw yellow colour with persistent greenish reflections. The aroma profile is intense and fragrant, dominated by notes of white pulp fruit, such as apple and pineapple, complemented by citrusy and floral sensations of orange blossom and jasmine. On the palate, the wine is savory and fragrant with a soft entry. It displays a balanced freshness and zippy acidity, a characteristic of its stainless steel fermentation and ageing.

Food Pairing

The unoaked, crisp, and fruity profile of this Chardonnay makes it exceptionally versatile. Suggested pairings include fresh seafood and shellfish, such as grilled fish or sea bass carpaccio. It is also a delightful match for appetizers, light pasta dishes, risotto, and fresh or soft cheeses.

title: Mazzei Belguardo Vermentino Toscana IGT 2023
bodyHtml: The purity of this important Vermentino reflects the production philosophy of the Marchesi Mazzei.  Vermentino is an indigenous grape variety that has its home by the Tyrrhenian sea coast, with its minerality and sapidity, shows great identity, juiciness, and freshness.

title: Roeno Pinot Grigio Tera Alta 2024
bodyHtml:
Roeno Pinot Grigio Tera Alta is a white wine produced by the Roeno winery located in the Vallagarina Valley of Trentino-Alto Adige, Italy. This wine is made from 100% Pinot Grigio grape variety, which is grown on the winery's estate vineyards.

On the nose, this wine has a bouquet of white flowers, citrus fruits, and green apple, with a subtle minerality. On the palate, it is fresh and well-balanced, with crisp acidity and a long finish. The flavors of citrus fruits and green apple are dominant, with a hint of peach and apricot.

title: Santa Cristina Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Santa Cristina Pinot Grigio originates from Italy, specifically within the delle Venezie DOC region in the northeastern part of the country. The Santa Cristina winery, based in Cortona near Siena, was established in 1946 and has long been a symbol of Tuscan winemaking tradition, though it now sources grapes from other renowned Italian regions for its varietal wines. Owned by the historic Antinori family, the winery follows a philosophy that highlights the deep connection between the vineyard, the terroir, and human craftsmanship, aiming to produce approachable wines that maintain high quality and accessibility.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a bright straw yellow colour and a light body with an elegant presence in the glass. The sensory profile is delicate yet intense, featuring a nose of green apples, citrus fruits, and bananas, alongside floral hints of orange blossoms and white flowers. On the palate, it is well balanced, soft, and savoury, delivering flavours of lemon peel, pineapple, and peach. The finish is clean and graceful, characterized by vibrant acidity and a lingering aftertaste of fresh fruit and subtle mineral undertones.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Grigio (Pinot Gris).

  • Stylistic Notes: Known for its crispness and fruit driven personality, the wine is shaped by an alpine tempered climate and fertile soils, resulting in a refreshing and easygoing character.

  • ABV: Typically ranges between 12% and 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery utilizes state of the art technology and sustainable research to respect the surrounding territory, this specific wine is generally not certified organic.

title: Brigaldara Soave 2025
bodyHtml: Aromas and flavors of whites raspberries and pineapple with a lightly spicy, mineral bed. Medium-bodied, fresh and spicy to the end.

title: Tenuta di Corte Giacobbe Ramato Pinot Grigio 2023
Fontanafredda Gavi di Gavi 2023
bodyHtml: Ample nose, with an intense bouquet featuring floral notes, vanilla, lemon and apples. On the palate, dry, full-bodied, well-balanced and elegant. Excellent as an aperitif, and delicious with hors-d'oeuvres, shellfish and chicken dishes.

title: Lumo Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: Crisp and fresh Pinot Grigio. This wine is medium in body.

title: Damilano Langhe Arneis 2023
bodyHtml:
Straw yellow in color, the bouquet is delicate, fresh, and fruity. The palate is dry, fresh and elegantly harmonic with moderate acidity.

Pairs with light appetizers, fish courses and white meats.

title: Suavia Soave Classico 2022
bodyHtml:
This vibrant dry white wine originates from Italy, within Veneto and the historic Soave Classico appellation. Suavia is an estate managed by the Tessari sisters—Meri, Valentina, and Alessandra—whose family has cultivated vines in the high altitude volcanic hills of Fittà since the late nineteenth century. Dedicated exclusively to native white grape varieties, the estate operates under certified organic farming principles, focusing on sustainable viticulture that highlights the distinct basaltic soils and cool microclimate of their northern Soave Classico vineyards.

Wine Description

This 2022 vintage displays a brilliant straw yellow colour with subtle green reflections in the glass. The nose offers an inviting, aromatic bouquet of fresh white flowers, jasmine, green apple, and white peach, accompanied by delicate vegetal undertones and a distinct volcanic mineral character. On the palate, it is crisp, juicy, and beautifully balanced, offering flavours of ripe yellow citrus, pear, and subtle orchard fruit. A vibrant acidity and soft texture are anchored by a savoury, saline minerality that leads to a clean, refreshing finish. Crafted as a 100% Garganega single varietal expression, the hand harvested grapes underwent temperature controlled fermentation in stainless steel, followed by 5 months of aging on fine lees. The wine carries an alcohol by volume of 12.0% and is certified organic.

Food Pairing

The bright acidity and refreshing minerality of this Soave Classico make it a versatile pairing choice.
