It serves as an ideal aperitif and pairs effortlessly with fresh seafood, pan seared scallops, grilled white fish, and octopus. It also complements lighter vegetable dishes, pea risotto, gnocchi, light poultry, and fresh goat cheese or soft cheeses.

title: Massolino Moscato d'Asti 2025
bodyHtml: Winemaker Franco Massolino has done a wonderful job of marrying change with a respect for tradition, something that sets him apart from most of the younger producers in Barolo today. This is in part dictated by the nature of the vineyards that the Massolino family owns in the commune of Serralunga d'Alba. Massolino Moscato is bright yellow in colour with fine and persistent perlage. Fresh and intense aromas of fruit, with notes of sage. On the palate, it has a refreshing acidity to balance the natural sweetness of this wine. The aroma of Moscato grapes dominates the palate and it has a very long and delicious finish.

title: Collazzi Otto Muri Bianco 2024
bodyHtml:
This exceptional white wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Toscana IGT subregion of Tuscany. The historic Collazzi estate, located near Florence in the heart of Chianti Classico, spans 400 hectares and features an iconic villa originally designed by Michelangelo. Owned by the Marchi and Frescobaldi families, the winery operates independently with a dedicated winemaking philosophy centred on meticulous, sustainable practices and gentle, hand-harvested vineyard management.

Wine Description

The Collazzi Otto Muri Bianco presents a rich, straw yellow colour accented by beautiful greenish reflections. On the nose, it reveals a complex and variegated bouquet of orchard blossoms, white stone fruit, and fresh hay, underscored by hints of crushed stone and blanched almonds. The palate is medium bodied and beautifully structured, delivering an intense profile of ripe yellow peach, mango, and a characteristic note of toasted hazelnuts. Crafted entirely from 100% Fiano grapes grown on eight terraced vineyard walls, the wine achieves its remarkable waxy, tactile texture and complexity through extended aging on the lees until spring. It shows excellent balance, balancing its persuasive richness with a crunchy, sapid acidity and a long, focused mineral finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile white wine pairs elegantly with lean white fish, shellfish, and simply prepared garlic shrimp. It is equally delightful alongside lighter poultry dishes, traditional Italian Cacio e Pepe, or an autumn mushroom risotto where the wine's inherent earthiness can truly shine.

title: Bortoluzzi Sauvignon Blanc Venezia Giulia IGT 2025
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy, specifically within the Venezia Giulia IGT region, this wine is a product of the Bortoluzzi estate. Founded in 1982 by Giovanni Bortoluzzi, the winery is a family-run operation located in Gradisca d'Isonzo, near the mineral-rich soils of the Isonzo River. The family's winemaking philosophy centers on manual care and respecting the naturalness of the product, utilizing a unique microclimate where vines are sheltered by mountains from cold northern winds.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc presents a pale straw yellow colour with distinct greenish reflections. The bouquet is refined and immediate, offering typical varietal aromas of bell pepper, peach, and sage leaves. On the palate, the wine is full, fresh, and enveloping, showcasing complex sensations that reflect the gravelly, mineral-rich terroir of the region.

Food Pairing

This wine is a superb companion for flavourful first courses such as asparagus risotto, herb-driven vegetable dishes, or spicy oriental cuisine. It also pairs effectively with fresh salads topped with goat cheese or delicate fish dishes.

title: Voga Moscato 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy, VOGA Moscato is a contemporary expression of the Pavia region within Lombardy. VOGA Italia was established with a 'Made in Italy' philosophy that marries innovative design with traditional craftsmanship, aiming to deliver an icon of Italian style to the modern consumer. The winemaking approach focuses on capturing the natural fruity aromas and vibrant character of the grapes to create a quaffable, fashion-forward wine.

Wine Description

This Moscato presents a straw yellow colour with shimmering gold highlights in the glass. The bouquet is intense and aromatic, featuring notes of spiced peach, golden raisin, and honeysuckle, balanced by a distinct muskiness and a hint of sage. On the palate, the wine is vibrant and spritzy with a 'frizzante' character, offering flavours of ripe apricot, fresh citrus, and grape. It possesses a moderately sweet, light to medium body and a refreshing acidity that leads to a medium length finish with nuances of green apple and white nuts.

Crafted from 100% Moscato grapes, the wine undergoes a fermentation process where carbon dioxide is retained to create its signature bubbles. While intended for immediate enjoyment to appreciate its freshness,

title: Scarpetta Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Scarpetta Pinot Grigio originates from Italy, within the Friuli-Venezia Giulia region. Established in 2007 by Master Sommelier Bobby Stuckey and Chef Lachlan Mackinnon-Patterson, the winery was born from a desire to celebrate the food and wine culture of Friuli. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on showcasing the best of the region by sourcing fruit from light, gravelly soils in the Grave region for minerality, as well as steep hillsides in the Colli Orientali for body and acidity.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a light straw colour with just a hint of salmon. The sensory profile features an aromatic nose of stone fruits and melon, accented by floral notes of acacia, lavender, and white flowers, as well as hints of honey. On the medium-bodied palate, it is light on its feet yet complex, delivering crisp and dry flavours of pear, lemon, and green apple supported by veins of minerality and bright acidity. The finish is clean, zesty, and refreshing.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Grigio.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its balanced freshness and vibrant character; it is fermented in stainless steel after 12 hours of skin contact and aged for six months on its lees to enhance its aromatic clarity and texture.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 12% and 12.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery focuses on meticulous craftsmanship and high-quality vineyard sites, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The versatility and crisp minerality of Scarpetta Pinot Grigio make it an excellent partner for a wide range of light and fresh dishes.

  • Seafood: Pairs exceptionally well with light grilled fish, sashimi, pesce crudo, ceviche, and seafood risotto or spaghetti.

  • Light Fare: An ideal aperitivo on its own, it also complements fresh salads, vegetable-based pasta, and light poultry dishes.

  • Cheese: Suggested pairings include lighter varieties like mozzarella, ricotta, mascarpone, or gruyere.

title: Umani Ronchi Casal di Serra Verdicchio 2024
bodyHtml: This is a white wine with a beautiful personality thanks to the prolonged contact with the yeasts. The nose is fruity, of golden apple and yellow peach, wildflowers and mineral veins. On the palate, it is soft, fresh, savoury and with an enveloping heat perceptible at the sip, to give vivacity.

title: Castello del Poggio Moscato
bodyHtml: Straw yellow with golden reflections. Intense and very inviting nose with delicate scents a little sweet, well balanced refined fruitiness. Excellent at the end of a meal with dessert or fruit. Great with fruit salad.

title: Campagnola Della Casa Bianco 2024
bodyHtml: Light style Italian blend that represents the terroir very well. Pale yellow with a greenish shadow. Excellent with shellfish!

title: Colterenzio Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the northern region of Trentino-Alto Adige, specifically within the cool mountain valleys of the Alto Adige DOC subregion, Colterenzio Pinot Grigio Alto Adige DOC represents a fresh, terroir-driven expression of Alpine winemaking. Founded in 1960 by a small group of visionary winegrowers, the Colterenzio cooperative (Schreckbichl) today unites over 300 winegrowing families dedicated to sustainable farming. The winery’s philosophy focuses on single-lot selection and high-altitude viticulture to craft crisp, aromatic, and mineral-precise wines that capture the distinct alpine-mediterranean climate of northern Italy.

Wine Description

The wine displays a brilliant pale straw yellow colour with subtle copper highlights in the glass. An inviting, fragrant bouquet opens with crisp aromas of Conference pear, white peach, and green apple, complemented by fresh notes of jasmine, lemon blossom, and subtle crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it is medium bodied, dry, and elegantly textured, offering juicy flavours of ripe orchard fruit, grapefruit zest, and delicate almond, all supported by a vibrant backbone of mouthwatering acidity. Fermented and aged in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks with brief lees contact, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2024–2028. Stylistically, it effortlessly balances high-altitude mountain freshness and clean minerality with a smooth, rounded mouthfeel and pure fruit purity.

title: Voga Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: VOGA Pinot Grigio is an opulent, elegant example of what authentic Italian white wine can and should be. VOGA Pinot Grigio is delicious as an aperitif, pairs well with light seafood and chicken breast and has the structure to stand up to rich, creamy pasta and full-flavoured dishes.

title: Giorgio & Gianni Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Giorgio & Gianni Pinot Grigio is an authentic expression of Northern Italy, specifically hailing from the renowned Delle Venezie region. The brand is produced by EnoItalia, one of the country's most innovative winemakers founded in the 1970s and based in Bardolino. The winery is celebrated for its commitment to high-quality, modern winemaking, focusing on sustainable practices that remain as close to natural cultivation as possible for each unique origin.

Wine Description

This wine presents as a bright and zesty white wine, displaying a pale straw yellow hue with brilliant reflections. The sensory profile opens with a fragrant bouquet of summer fruits, featuring crisp green apple, white pear, and delicate hints of citrus blossom. On the palate, the wine is light bodied and refreshing, balancing soft citrus and orchard fruit with a subtle, clean minerality and a touch of almond on the finish.

title: Donnafugata Anthilia Sicilia 2024
bodyHtml:
The 2022 Anthilia presents a luminous straw-yellow hue. Its aromatic profile is fresh and fragrant, featuring notes of white-fleshed fruits like peach, complemented by hints of wildflowers . On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied with evident fruity notes, refreshed by a pleasant sapidity, leading to a finish with good persistence.

Varietal Composition:

Predominantly Lucido (a synonym for Catarratto), complemented by other indigenous and international varieties.

Accolades:

  • James Suckling – 91 points

  • Wine Enthusiast – 90 points

Food Pairing:

This versatile wine pairs excellently with lightly smoked fish, crustaceans, anchovies, and baked first courses. It's also delightful with tuna or Caesar salad and spring rolls . These pairings highlight the wine's depth and character.

title: Campagnola Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Campagnola Pinot Grigio is a beautiful Italian white wine that showcases the unique character of the Pinot Grigio grape. The wine's straw-yellow color with greenish reflections is stunning and inviting, giving a hint of the fresh and vibrant flavors that are to come.

On the nose, this wine offers an intense bouquet of juicy pear, crisp apple, and zesty citrus fruit, with delicate floral and mineral notes adding complexity and depth. These aromas are beautifully expressed on the palate, where the wine's fresh and fruity taste is complemented by a well-balanced acidity that makes it a perfect companion for a variety of dishes.

With its light to medium body and smooth finish, Campagnola Pinot Grigio is an incredibly versatile wine that pairs well with many different foods, including seafood, salads, white meats, and vegetarian cuisine. It is also a delightful wine to enjoy on its own, whether as a refreshing aperitif or a perfect companion to a warm summer day.

title: Barone Montalto Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: Barone Montalto, established in 2000, is a family-run winery located in Santa Ninfa, western Sicily. The estate focuses on producing consumer-friendly wines that reflect the unique terroir of Sicily. Their commitment to quality and innovation has positioned them as a notable producer in the region.

title: Guado Al Tasso Vermentino 2025
bodyHtml:
Tenuta Guado al Tasso Vermentino originates from the prestigious Bolgheri DOC, located on the coast of the upper Maremma in Tuscany, Italy. The estate is owned by the Antinori family, who have been pioneers in Italian winemaking for 26 generations since 1385. They began producing Vermentino at this site in 1996, driven by a philosophy of reintroducing indigenous varieties and capturing the unique maritime terroir of the Bolgheri amphitheatre.

Wine Description

This 100% Vermentino displays a luminous straw yellow colour with subtle greenish highlights. The aromatic profile is intense and captivating, offering a fragrant range of citron zest, Annurca apples, and tropical fruit, accented by floral notes of elderflower and hawthorn blossoms. On the palate, the wine is remarkably fresh and savory, showing excellent balance and a persistent mineral finish typical of its coastal origins.

title: Lunae Vermentino 2025
bodyHtml: Straw-yellow colour with youthful greenish highlights. Intense, persistent, sophisticated aroma of great elegance, with hints of hawthorn, grapefruit, rennet apple, white peach and a pleasing undertone of acacia honey. Fresh and properly balanced on the palate, it rewards us with interesting developments of taste.

title: Duckhorn Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and complex white wine originates from the United States, specifically from the premier Napa Valley region in California. Founded in 1976 by Dan and Margaret Duckhorn, Duckhorn Vineyards has established itself as an iconic producer with a focus on blending fruit from both estate vineyards and independent growers to achieve a consistent house style. The winemaking philosophy for this Chardonnay, led by winemaker Renée Ary, emphasizes a "terroir-driven" approach, utilizing site-specific fruit to capture a "sublime example" of the Napa Valley floor and its cooler coastal influences.

Wine Description

Duckhorn Chardonnay presents a brilliant straw yellow appearance. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and "inviting," featuring a nose of ripe pear, fresh lemongrass, and a delicate touch of ginger. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and "silky," showcasing vibrant layers of citrus, white peach, and creamy crème brûlée underpinned by a subtle hint of salinity. It is characterized by its balanced complexity, a round mouthfeel with notes of vanilla and butter, and a long, juicy finish.

title: Fattoria Di Magliano Pagliatura 2020
bodyHtml:
The name Pagliatura, meaning “hay,” references the golden color of the wine.  White peach, apple, and pear aromas abound, while floral notes further enhance the bouquet.  A hint of mint adds an interesting component to the flavor profile.

White peach, apple, and pear aromas abound, while floral notes further enhance the bouquet. A hint of mint adds an interesting component to the flavor profile Vinified in stainless steel to allow maximum fruit expression, the wine is refined on the fine lees for 3 months.

title: Feudi Di San Gregorio Falanghina 2025
bodyHtml:
Feudi di San Gregorio was established in 1986 in Sorbo Serpico, a tiny village in Campania's Irpinia region near Mount Vesuvius. It is one of Campania's premier winemaking estates, a modern expression of a centuries-old tradition of passion and dedication to the land. Feudi is a joint venture between the Ercolino and Capaldo families of Irpinia. The proprietors of this family-run estate have selected the finest vineyards to nurture this region's unique, indigenous varietals. Owner and winemaker Enzo Ercolino work closely with consultant Riccardo Cotarella, one of Italy's foremost enologists.

The straw yellow colour contains brilliant green reflections. Floral notes, like white blossoms and delicate apples and pears. Medium intensity, crisp minerality, with hints of spice, light almond and a slightly bitter orange peel character. The pretty floral notes and soft fruit flavours are fresh through the finish in perfect balance with the mouthwatering acidity.

title: Alpha Zeta Pinot Grigio 2022
bodyHtml: Clean, crisp and fresh but still with plenty of character, this wine is lively and aromatic, with the classic freshly baked bread crust perfumes and ripe, juicy pear character.

title: Feudi Di Romans Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: The Sauvignon Blanc I Feudi Di Romans is a decidedly varietal wine in which all the classic herbaceous aromas of the grape stand out. Yet another gem proposed by I Feudi di Romans, that is not to be missed!

title: Kris Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1993, Kris is a modern Italian wine label produced by the Franz Haas winery, one of Alto Adige’s most respected family-run estates. Known for its vibrant, fruit-forward expressions, Kris crafts approachable wines that showcase the terroir of northern Italy with precision and elegance. Their Pinot Grigio stands as a signature example of their commitment to quality and clarity in winemaking.

Wine Description

Kris Pinot Grigio 2024 displays a pale straw colour with greenish highlights. The bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of acacia flowers, citrus blossom, lime zest, and tangerine, followed by subtle hints of almond and apricot. On the palate, it offers a crisp and refreshing profile with flavours of green apple, pear, lemon, and a slight mineral edge. Light to medium in body, the wine has a silky texture supported by bright acidity that carries through to a clean, refreshing finish.

Food Pairing

This Pinot Grigio is a versatile companion to fresh seafood dishes such as grilled shrimp, calamari, or lemon-garlic sole. It also pairs beautifully with light pastas, caprese salad, or a creamy risotto primavera.

title: Lagaria Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml: Lagaria Pinot Grigio is straw yellow in colour, with pleasant floral and fruity aromas of apple, apricot and pear. Medium-bodied, with refreshing fruit, distinct character and balance.

title: La Spinetta Moscato D'Asti 2025
bodyHtml: Yellow colour with green reflections. Sweet and sexy, dried apricots and crisp pineapple this wine surprises with its remarkable freshness and brilliant fruit flavours, bright acidity and a zingy finish. Outstanding balance and a light sparkle make this traditionally dessert wine an appropriate choice for an aperitif or a refreshing splash with brunch.

title: Masi Masianco Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in Italy, this refined white wine is a contemporary expression of the Veneto region, specifically within the Delle Venezie subregion. The winery was founded in 1772 when the Boscaini family acquired vineyards in the 'Vaio dei Masi' valley, and it has since become a global ambassador for Venetian winemaking. Masi's philosophy centers on the Appassimento technique—the traditional method of drying grapes on bamboo racks—which they have innovatively applied to create this 'Supervenetian' white wine.

Wine Description

Masi Masianco presents a deep straw yellow colour with golden and greenish reflections in the glass. The nose is filled with a sophisticated bouquet of citrus fruits and white flowers, accented by delicate hints of honey, vanilla, and ripe apples. On the palate, the wine is refreshing and vibrant, offering primary flavours of lemon, peach, and apricot, which are balanced by an attractive honeyed sweetness and a touch of almond. It is medium-bodied with a smooth, weightier texture on the mid-palate and a long, clean finish characterized by a citrus twist and mineral salinity.

title: Gabbiano Pinot Grigio Cavaliere d'Oro 2022
bodyHtml: An Italian Pinot Grigio that is light, crisp, and clean with flavours of lime zest and lemon on the palate and finish. This is a refreshing aperitif that pairs well with fresh seafood, salads, and shellfish because of its racy acidity.

title: Livio Felluga Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Friuli Venezia Giulia region within the Colli Orientali del Friuli DOC. The winery was founded by Livio Felluga, who is widely considered the 'patriarch' of Friulian viticulture and was instrumental in reviving the region's reputation after World War II. The estate's philosophy focuses on a deep connection to the land, famously represented by the historic map of the family's hillside vineyards featured on every label.

Wine Description

Livio Felluga Pinot Grigio displays a brilliant straw yellow colour with subtle copper highlights. The nose is complex and elegant, offering aromas of acacia flowers, yellow peach, and melon layered with notes of white flowers and a hint of flint. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and well structured, featuring a creamy texture balanced by a vibrant mineral acidity. It is characterized by its remarkable freshness and harmony, delivering flavours of golden apple and pear that lead to a long, savory finish. This 100% Pinot Grigio typically has an ABV of 13% to 13.5%. While the winery employs sustainable practices in their hillside vineyards, this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through the next three to five years.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 93 points.

  • James Suckling - 92 points.

  • View From the Cellar (John Gilman) - 91 points.

  • Vinous (Eric Guido) - 90 points.

  • Wine Spectator - 89 points.

title: Feudi Di San Gregorio Greco di Tufo 2024
bodyHtml: Spring blossom, wild herb and cantaloupe aromas waft out of the glass on this lovely white. Bright and polished, the tangy palate offers ripe pear, Meyer lemon and a hint of almond alongside a mineral vein of saline.

title: Feudi Di San Gregorio Fiano Di Avellino 2024
bodyHtml: Delicate, yet fresh floral notes of chamomile are layered with peach and candied orange aromas. The soft palate is enveloped with a lovely freshness through to a vibrant spicy and mineral finish.

title: Bucci Verdicchio Classico 2022
bodyHtml: Deep straw yellow. Pleasingly fruity with a persistent bouquet, showing notes of Golden Delicious apples and almonds. Good body and silky texture on the well-balanced and elegant palate. Ideal as an aperitif, or with pasta, fish risotto, white meat, and mild cheese.

title: Bollini Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: Bollini Pinot Grigio is styled to show intense varietal aromas with an especially fragrant bouquet and elegant, delicately focused white fruit flavours. Straw yellow in colour, clear-cut and delicate on the nose, with scents of acacia flowers, minerals and pear. The fresh natural acidity supports the wine.

title: Zenato Lugana Sergio Riserva 2022
bodyHtml:
The result of an authentic passion, this Lugana Riserva is the fruit of the history of the Zenato family.

The grapes come from the oldest vines of ‘Podere Massoni’ with a slightly late harvest, towards the middle of October. Fermentation takes place for about 70% in oak barrels and 30% in steel.

The colour is light gold with brilliant reflections; the bouquet is intense and multifaceted, with floral and citrus notes, spices, white plum and vanilla. The flavour is full, with great depth and balance. It can be enjoyed even after years.

title: Pieropan Soave Calvarino 2023
bodyHtml:
Pieropan Soave Calvarino is an organic white wine from the Soave Classico DOC in the Veneto region of northeastern Italy. Established in the 1890s by Leonildo Pieropan, the estate is a pioneer in the region and was the first to use the 'Soave' name on its labels. The Calvarino vineyard, acquired in 1901, is the oldest family plot and is situated on volcanic, basalt-rich soils that are notoriously difficult to work, earning it the name 'little calvary'.

Wine Description

This wine presents a brilliant pale straw-yellow colour with greenish reflections in its youth. The sensory profile is fresh and complex, featuring an aromatic bouquet of elderflower, almond blossom, marzipan, and lemon, with additional hints of pear and white peach. On the palate, it is dry, well-balanced, and elegant, showing a silky texture and a distinct smoky, flinty minerality. The structure is enhanced by a zesty acidity that leads to a long, saline finish.

title: Ca' Preella Lamberti Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Lamberti wines reinterpret the classic style of the terroir with a modern slant, the infinite nuances of their fragrances and colours encapsulating Lake Garda’s multifaceted nature in each glass.

Lamberti Pinot Grigio has a well-developed nose with beeswax and wild honey blossom characteristics that are distinctive of Pinot Grigio. On the palate, it's refreshingly sharp, with a creamy, mineral texture and flavours that are perfectly reflective of the aromas.

title: Villa Teresa Organic Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
The Villa Teresa brand was established more than 40 years ago. It was one of the first producers to focus on organic wines, foreseeing a shift toward sustainable practices. The winery's philosophy centres on minimising pollution, eliminating the use of pesticides in the vineyard, and conducting the entire harvest manually.

Wine Description

This lovely organic Pinot Grigio is a pale straw colour and has a ripe apple nose that carries through on the palate. It has flavours of cooked pear, lemon citrus and mineral with hints of orange and melon fruit. Perfect first sip on the patio!

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include fresh seafood, such as oysters, smoked salmon, and ceviche, as well as lighter fish appetizers, fish soup, or baked white fish in butter sauce.

title: Collestefano Verdicchio Di Matelica 2024
bodyHtml: Made with organically farmed grapes, this delicious white opens with aromas of citrus blossom and white stone fruit. The tangy, medium-bodied palate offers a lovely depth of flavors that include juicy tangerine, lime, white peach, bitter almond and mineral. Crisp acidity brightens the rich flavors and carries through to the clean finish.

title: Zenato San Benedetto Lugana 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Zenato San Benedetto Lugana originates from Italy, within the Veneto region and the Lugana DOC. The estate was founded in 1960 by Sergio Zenato, a pioneer who recognized the immense potential of the Trebbiano di Lugana grape on the southern shores of Lake Garda. Today, the family legacy is carried forward by his children, Alberto and Nadia, who maintain a winemaking philosophy focused on quality, passion, and a deep respect for the unique morainic soils of the San Benedetto vineyard.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a pale straw yellow colour with greenish reflections and possesses a medium body. The sensory profile is highly appealing, featuring an aromatic nose of peaches, citrus fruits, and white flowers, accented by subtle notes of tropical fruit and herbs. On the palate, it is fresh and well balanced, delivering crisp flavours of green apple and pear supported by a distinct mineral backbone and bright acidity. The finish is clean and persistent with a pleasant almond hint.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Trebbiano di Lugana (Turbiana).

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its elegance and complexity, achieved through soft pressing and fermentation in stainless steel to preserve its vibrant varietal character.

  • ABV: 13%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate emphasizes sustainable viticulture and meticulous vineyard management, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and mineral drive of San Benedetto Lugana make it an exceptionally versatile partner for light and fresh cuisines.

  • Seafood: Pairs excellently with freshwater fish from Lake Garda, grilled sea bass, and shellfish.

  • Light Fare: An ideal accompaniment to summer salads, cold white meats, and delicate vegetable based appetizers.

  • Cuisines: Matches well with sushi, sashimi, and light pasta dishes served with lemon or herb sauces.

  • Cheese: Complements fresh, soft cheeses such as mozzarella or mild goat cheese.

title: Argiolas Costamolino Vermentino Di Sardegna 2025
bodyHtml: This Vermentino often shows the fragrance of macchia, the mix of evergreen shrubs and herbs that typifies the Sardinian landscape. Costamolino hints at aromas of pine and mint coupled with ripe stone fruit and sweet citrus. The palate is at once vibrant and textural and finishes with lingering acidity.

title: Zenato Chardonnay Santa Cristina 2020
bodyHtml:
In the glass, the Santa Cristina Chardonnay from Zenato reveals a bright golden yellow colour. The nose of this white wine from Veneto impresses with notes of perfume rose, jasmine, nashi pear and lily. This dry white wine from Zenato is perfect for people who prefer 0.0 grams of sugar in the wine. The Santa Cristina Chardonnay is already quite close to this since it was vinified with just 5.5 grams of residual sugar. On the tongue, this balanced white wine is characterized by an incredibly crisp texture. Santa Cristina Chardonnay is exceptionally fresh and lively on the palate thanks to its fruity acidity. In the finish, this storable white wine from the wine-growing region of Veneto finally inspires with considerable length. Again, there are hints of fruit bread and lavender

Experience this white wine from Italy ideally chilled at 8 - 10°C as an accompaniment to coconut lime fish curry, leek tortilla or leek soup.

title: Alois Lageder Terra Alpina Pinot Grigio Vigneti delle Dolomiti 2024
bodyHtml: Aromatically the wine has notes of wildflowers, melons, orchard fruits and a hint of warm spices. On the palate the wine surprisingly medium bodied with a slightly waxy mouth feel, with ripe fruit flavors and a lingering flavor of white pepper.

title: Bolla Pinot Grigio Delle Venezie 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from the delle Venezie DOC in Italy, Bolla Pinot Grigio 2024 is a classic expression of the Veneto region's celebrated white winemaking tradition. Founded in 1883 by Abele Bolla, the winery began as a humble family venture dedicated to showcasing the authentic flavours of local grapes. Today, the estate maintains a steadfast winemaking philosophy focused on freshness and structural balance, utilizing well drained alluvial soils across select vineyards to craft accessible, traditionally styled wines.

Wine Description

This wine displays a lovely pale straw yellow colour in the glass. The bouquet offers lively floral aromas, wild flowers, and notes of honey, complemented by fruity hints of pear, crisp green apple, and melon. On the palate, it exhibits a light and crisp body with a slightly more imposing structure than its northern counterparts, balancing a soft, rounded mouthfeel with fresh, thirst quenching acidity.

title: Banfi Le Rime Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: Pale straw yellow. Hints of pear and white flowers. Well balanced with an unusually lively acidity. A splendid aperitif and a delightful complement to antipasto, pasta, and light meals.

title: Tommasi Pinot Grigio Le Rosse 2025
bodyHtml:
A bright straw yellow with pale green reflections on the nose, it offers notes of ripe pears and golden apples, evolving in the glass with delicate hints of hay and almonds. 

It is dry and well-balanced on the palate, with a remarkably fresh, tangy finish.

title: Mezzacorona Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml: A delightful, pale straw colour. Pinot Grigio to be enjoyed for its aromatic crisp green apple, fresh, berry, cantaloupe and fruity pear nose with a touch of spice.

title: Folonari Pinot Grigio Delle Venezie 2024
bodyHtml: Pale lemon colour, with inviting aromas of bread dough, nuts, citrus and light floral notes. Juicy on the palate with fresh fruit flavours matched by balanced acidity and hints of minerality that lead to a clean finish.

title: Corte Giara Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml: This wine expresses a freshness and integrity of aromas of the most typical Venetian grapes, vilified exclusively in stainless steel to delicately conserve its intensity. Corte Giara wines are young, soft, and engaging in style.

title: Pasqua Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: A pleasant, fruity wine with notes of pear and apricot and floral hints. Fresh, harmonious and well balanced. Ideal with starters, delicate first course dishes, fish, and white meat.

title: Donini Trebbiano-Chardonnay 2024 - 1 Litre
bodyHtml: This is a blend made from grapes grown in the Rubicone area, between Bologna and San Marino, on the Adriatic coast. Fresh mushroom scents and flavours, spice, and elevated mineral notes - chardonnay adds presence, while trebbiano lightens the body and aromas. Serve with grilled fish or mild pasta dishes after chilling.

title: Santa Margherita Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Santa Margherita pioneered the modern winemaking methods of Pinot Grigio and are proud to be known as a benchmark of quality and innovation for the category. In 1960, their winemaker was inspired by traditional sparkling wine vinification techniques used to ferment Pinot Grigio without skin contact. Driven to capture the delicate fruit and floral notes, he realized that by moving away from the then-standard “Ramato” method, the precious aromas and flavors could be preserved as they were meant to be tasted. 

Let the clean, dry, and versatile Pinot Grigio that inspired an entire generation of Italian white wines complement your next picnic, dinner party, or spontaneous gathering.

A clean, lovely aperitif to start any food occasion. Santa Margherita's Pinot Grigio goes wonderfully with fresh cheeses, white meats, and soufflés. Pair it with seafood for an extraordinary experience, including shellfish and seafood-based pastas and rice dishes. Its varietal typicity makes it extremely versatile and food-friendly.

title: Cavit Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Italy, specifically the Trentino-Alto Adige region in Northern Italy. The grapes are sourced from the foothills of the Dolomite Alps, primarily within the Trentino, Friuli, and Veneto areas. Cavit (Cantina Viticoltori del Trentino) is a leading cooperative consortium established in 1950. It unites 11 separate cellars and over 5,250 grape growers, representing 60% of Trentino's total wine production. The winery was a pioneer in the 1970s, helping to introduce and popularize the Pinot Grigio varietal on the international stage.

Wine Description

The Cavit Pinot Grigio 2024 is a classic expression of 100% Pinot Grigio. It presents a bright straw gold colour and is characteristically dry, light-bodied, and crisp. The sensory profile features delicate and pleasing floral and fruit scents, with specific aromas of citrus, green apple, and pear. Some tasters also note hints of peach, spiced melon, and almond skin on the finish.

On the palate, the wine is refreshing and well-balanced with a mouthwatering acidity.

title: Michele Chiarlo Gavi Le Marne 2022
bodyHtml: The fruit for this wine comes from vineyards near the town of Gavi, where calcareous clay, volcanic, iron and chalky limestone soils together with the area’s mediating Mediterranean breezes and cool mountain winds create an ideal microclimate for growing the Cortese grape to optimal ripeness. The 100% Cortese grapes are pressed without crushing, and the must is cold settled before undergoing a low-temperature fermentation. The wine is aged on the lees in stainless steel tanks until bottling.

title: Santa Cristina Orvieto Casasole Amabile 2024
bodyHtml: Refined, elegant Orvieto showing typical floral aromas. The palate is fruity and well-balanced with some sweetness on the finish.

title: Ruffino Orvieto Classico 2023
bodyHtml:
This crisp white wine hails from Italy, specifically the historic Orvieto Classico region in Umbria, renowned for its picturesque hilltop vineyards and medieval charm. Ruffino, founded in 1877 in Tuscany, has long been recognized for its dedication to traditional Italian winemaking, expanding thoughtfully into neighbouring regions like Umbria. The estate combines modern techniques with a deep respect for regional terroir, aiming to craft wines that reflect authenticity and finesse.

Wine Description

Pale straw yellow in colour with delicate greenish reflections, Ruffino Orvieto Classico 2023 reveals a fresh, inviting bouquet of ripe pear, green apple, and white flowers, underscored by subtle hints of citrus zest. On the palate, it is light to medium-bodied, showcasing lively acidity that carries flavours of crisp orchard fruits, lemon, and a whisper of almond. The finish is clean and refreshing, marked by a gentle minerality that speaks to the volcanic soils of the Orvieto hills.

Food Pairing

Pair this Orvieto Classico with seafood risotto, grilled shrimp, or a simple Caprese salad with fresh basil. Its bright acidity and subtle complexity also complement mild cheeses and vegetable antipasti. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Fazi Battaglia Verdicchio Titulus 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in Italy, this quintessential white wine comes from the Classico zone of the Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi DOC within the Marche region. Fazi Battaglia was established in 1949 by the union of the Fazi and Battaglia families, though it was later transformed into an international icon by Francesco Angelini, who introduced the world-famous emerald-green amphora bottle in 1953. The winery's philosophy is centered on promoting the identity of Italy's native varieties, maintaining a balance between traditional craftsmanship and modern innovation to serve as a great interpreter of the Marche territory.

Wine Description

Titulus presents a brilliant straw yellow colour with delicate greenish highlights. The nose is remarkably fresh, offering a bouquet of green apple, pear, and peach, further enriched by floral notes of broom and a hint of aniseed. On the palate, the wine is rich and tangy with a light to medium body, featuring flavours of citrus, quince, and apricot balanced by a sharp mineral acidity. It concludes with a pleasant and persistent finish of bitter almond, a hallmark characteristic of the noble Verdicchio grape.

Crafted from 100% Verdicchio grapes, the wine undergoes a soft pressing followed by fermentation in stainless steel at controlled temperatures. It is aged for four months on its fine lees to enhance its natural crispness and sapid mineral character. While designed for immediate enjoyment as an 'easy drinking' classic, its naturally high acidity allows it to remain fresh for several years.

title: Santa Cristina Campogrande Orvieto 2022
bodyHtml: Straw yellow in color, the wine offers inviting aromas of ripe apples, apricots and peaches. The palate is dry and full of fruit character with a nice finish.

title: Avignonesi Grifi Rosso Di Toscana IGT 2021
bodyHtml:
The assembly of two such different personalities such as Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon blend together, giving this wine a unique character. Dark ruby red in color with purple reflections, the nose opens with notes of blueberries, blackberries and incense going up to sandalwood and graphite. In the mouth it is dense and complex with hints of blackberry jam and cinnamon.

It then evolves like a balsamic explosion supported by good acidity. The lively tannin all over the palate accompanies the savory and persistent finish.

title: Musella Ripasso 2020
bodyHtml: Musella are one of the 'Twelve Amarone Families," a group of the very best producers in the region and it is easy to see why. This is easily one of our richest, most satisfying Ripassos. Absolutely dense with dark cherry fruit, silky smooth but still finely structured.

title: Brigaldara Ripasso Superiore 2023
bodyHtml: Dark lustrous ruby colour with a hint of garnet. Ripe raspberries and cherries on the nose, beautiful precision, layered with a delicate savoury note. Exciting and compact on the palate.

title: Giusti Augusto Recantina 2016
bodyHtml: Smooth and intense, this full-bodied wine has a hint of minerals that gives it a touch of freshness. It is produced from a single variety, native Recantina grapes, a rare and precious treasure of the Montello.

title: Cantina Santadi Shardana 2020
bodyHtml: An epic red blend from Sardinia, this wine boasts huge density and pulpy notes of blackberry, black olive, licorice, leather and spice. It offers silky tannins, with loads of ripe fruit on the finish.

title: Vajra Langhe Nebbiolo 2025
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Piedmont region of Italy, this wine is a pure expression of the Langhe DOC, with fruit sourced from high-elevation vineyards in Barolo, Novello, and Sinio. The G.D. Vajra estate was revitalized in 1972 by Aldo Vaira, who became a pioneer of organic viticulture in the region. Today, the winery remains a family affair, guided by a philosophy of 'recipe-free' attention and a deep commitment to biodiversity and the authentic preservation of Piedmontese traditions.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo is celebrated for its 'varietal truth', displaying a lively light garnet colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is expressive and ethereal, featuring a bouquet of dried rose petals, crushed violets, and mountain raspberries intertwined with notes of lavender, mint, and citrus peel. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and energetic, offering a 'pulpy' texture with flavours of sour cherry, strawberry, and cranberry balanced by a chalky minerality. It is defined by its silky, well-integrated tannins and a lifted, savory finish. While designed to be enjoyed young for its freshness, it possesses the structure for a graceful evolution over the next decade.

title: Lupi Reali Montepulciano D'Abruzzo Organic 2022
Passi Reali 2023
bodyHtml: Oak, smoke, earthy, black fruit, cherry, minerals, plum, very grippy and full-bodied. Nice value for an organic red.  A really enjoyable wine.

title: Farmers Of Wine Red 2020
bodyHtml:
General Information

A smooth blend of Negroamaro and Zinfandel, locally known as Primitivo, which represent the quintessence of Puglia. Deep ruby red. Intense and bright aromas in the grapes, with a fruity and flowery bouquet. Mouth filling and well balanced sweetness and acidity. The finish is characterized by sweet fruit. Excellent served with red meat, barbecues and burgers and also vegetarian dishes. Farmers of wine is also a perfect match served with pastas accompanied by earthy sauces and aged cheeses.

title: Pasqua Passimento Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Italy, produced in the Veneto region within the Eastern Valpolicella production area. Pasqua Vigneti e Cantine is a historic family-owned winery established in 1925 in Verona, a city famously known as the setting for Romeo and Juliet, which serves as the inspiration for the 'PassioneSentimento' label. The winemaking philosophy centres on the traditional 'appassimento' method, where hand-harvested grapes are air-dried in wooden trays for one month to lose approximately 30% of their water content, concentrating the sugars and flavours before fermentation.

Wine Description

The Pasqua Passimento Red Blend exhibits a deep ruby red colour. The nose is intense and lingering, offering aromas of red berries, black cherry, and prune layered with spicy overtones of vanilla, cinnamon, and sweet tobacco. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and balanced, delivering concentrated flavours of tart red cherry, dried strawberry, and blackberry with hints of leather and coffee grounds. It is characterized by its velvety tannins, vibrant acidity, and a soft, round finish that provides persistence. The varietal composition is a blend of 40% Merlot, 30% Corvina, and 30% Croatina. The wine typically features an ABV of 13.5% to 14% and is matured for 3 months in oak tonneaux.

title: Cantina Del Pino Dolcetto d'Alba 2023
bodyHtml: Cantina del Pino Dolcetto has a splendid perfume with ruby and garnet colours and an interesting nose along with jammy flavours and a hint of black pepper and a soft background of minerals. A bouquet of fresh summer fruit with good acidity and a full round finish makes this wine a perfect one to pair with food.

title: Cusumano Nero D'Avola 2023
bodyHtml: Cusumano Nero d'Avola is a deep ruby red, with violet reflections. Fresh aromas of red and black berries. Fruit-forward with firm tannins and plummy spice flavours on the palate.

title: Cusumano Syrah 2024
bodyHtml: Cusumano Syrah is a warm, pleasant, velvety and well-balanced expression from Sicily, vinified and aged in steel tanks. Its perfumes evoke the wild berries in jam, the ripe fruits and wild spices. On the palate it is smooth, warm and velvety, with a long fruity persistence. A well priced wine from Italy!

title: Fontanafredda Barolo Serralunga D'Alba 2020
bodyHtml: The colour is garnet-red with ruby highlights that take on a slightly orange tone over time. It has a clear-cut, intense nose with overtones of vanilla, spices, withered roses and underbrush. The taste is dry, but soft, full-bodied, velvety and well balanced and is very long-lasting. Ideal with big red meat dishes and medium or mature cheeses, it can also make for pleasant after-dinner company.

title: Umberto Cesari Sangiovese Reserve 2022
bodyHtml: Sangiovese Riserva in its most traditional version, this wine is produced from only the best clusters of grapes. The nose shows notes of intense cherry, violets, chocolate, vanilla, spice, and roasted coffee. Dry and full-bodied, with an appealing suite of elegant tannins.

title: Uccelliera Rosso Di Montalcino 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Luminous dark red. Lively aromas of redcurrant, red licorice, and mint, plus complicating nuances of balsamic oils and violet. Juicy, spicy flavors of red berries and cherries are very deep and pure. In a cooler, low-fat style than usual for this wine, with harmonious acidity nicely extending the flavors on the long juicy, and perfumed back end. A declassified Brunello, this is a really outstanding Rosso di Montalcino.

title: Giusti Valpolicella Ripasso Classico Superiore 2022
bodyHtml: Fennel salami, candied cherries and raspberry gummies in this lighter, brighter Valpo. Medium bodied and light tannins mean you can (and should!) chill this slightly and serve with lighter fare -think pizza or charcuterie. A blend of corvina, corvinone, rondinella.

title: Stroppiana 'Altea' Barbera D'Alba Superiore 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Intense garnet red colour with purple reflections, the nose has hints of cherry and very ripe red fruits; cocoa, vanilla and spicy aromas characteristic of wood, which elegantly coexist with the natural fruit of the grape. In the mouth the wine is full and persistent; black fruits and acidity are mitigated by the passage in wood.

title: Tenuta Di Arceno Chianti Classico 2022
bodyHtml: Tenuta di Arceno is an ancient Tuscan estate with a diverse portfolio of the highest quality wines across two classification levels, three wines centred on the native Sangiovese grape in the Chianti Classico DOCG collection; and three wines celebrating the estate’s international varieties under the Toscana IGT designation. The estate is situated at the southernmost edge of Chianti Classico in the butterfly-shaped commune of Castelnuovo Berardenga, closest in proximity to Siena and rightfully referred to as ‘the most Senese Chianti Classico. It’s home to other world-renowned producers and stylistically distinct from its counterparts to the north.

title: Gran Passione Rosso 2025
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Italy, produced in the Veneto region under the Veneto IGT appellation. Gran Passione was founded in 1928 by Carlo Botter, and the winery has since grown into a thriving producer managed by the Botter family. The winemaking philosophy centres on honouring the traditions of the land, specifically using the 'appassimento' method. This ancient technique involves naturally drying the grapes on the vine for approximately 15 days, which causes about 50% of their weight to vaporise, resulting in a unique concentration of sugars and flavours.

Wine Description

The Gran Passione Rosso displays an intense purple or deep red colour that may move towards shades of amber with ageing. The nose is instantly appealing, offering abundant aromas of black cherry, plum, and blackberry, layered with spicy notes of vanilla, clove, and toasted mocha. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and solid in structure, delivering a rich core of ripe dark fruits, chocolate, and fresh tobacco leaf. It is characterized by a fine balance between soft, integrated tannins and fresh acidity, leading to a long finish with savoury mineral tones and a hint of warm spice. The varietal composition is a blend of 60% Merlot and 40% Corvina. The ABV is typically between 14% and 14.2%. While not certified organic, the wine is noted as being vegan-friendly. The optimal drinking window is generally up to 4 years from the vintage.

title: Il Fauno di Arcanum 2022
bodyHtml:
This expressive Super Tuscan red wine originates from Italy, produced in the southern hills of the Chianti Classico zone within the municipality of Castelnuovo Berardenga, Tuscany. Tenuta di Arceno is an ancient estate with winemaking roots dating back to the 16th century, managed today under the ownership of Jackson Family Wines alongside renowned international winemaker Pierre Seillan (of Château Lassègue in Saint-Émilion and Vérité in Sonoma). Named after the mythological statue of Faunus located on the property, Il Fauno di Arcanum is crafted as a classic Bordeaux-style blend with a Tuscan soul, grown on diverse estate soils ranging from clay-limestone (albarese) to stony river gravels and sandstone.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2022 Il Fauno presents a vibrant, deep ruby-purple color. The expressive nose opens with enticing aromas of ripe red plum, wild blackberry, and black cherry, interwoven with notes of crushed violets, dried thyme, tobacco leaf, cocoa, and subtle toasted oak spice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, smooth, and supple, offering a lush entry dominated by dark fruit flavors that transition into a structured mid-palate framed by fine-grained, velvety tannins and a bright streak of natural acidity. The blend typically features Merlot and Cabernet Franc, complemented by smaller percentages of Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot. Hand-harvested micro-lots are vinified separately in temperature-controlled stainless steel before aging for approximately 10 to 12 months in French oak barrels (around 20% to 30% new). The alcohol by volume sits at 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The supple fruit volume, fine tannic structure, and savory Tuscan herbal character of this Bordeaux blend make it an exceptional table companion. It pairs magnificently with grilled ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb with rosemary, Tuscan-style wild boar ragù over pappardelle, slow-braised beef short ribs, and duck breast with a berry reduction. It also harmonizes beautifully with eggplant parmesan, wild mushroom risotto, and aged cheeses like Pecorino Toscano, Parmigiano-Reggiano, or sharp Gouda.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 growing season in Castelnuovo Berardenga was warm and dry, favoring early-to-mid-ripening varieties like Merlot and Cabernet Franc, which achieved complete phenolic maturity while retaining good natural acidity. The vineyard team's careful canopy management protected the fruit from extreme heat, resulting in wines with rich fruit concentration and polished, approachable tannins. The 2022 Il Fauno di Arcanum offers immediate charm, lush texture, and expressive aromatics upon release after decanting, while holding the structural balance to age comfortably in the cellar over the next 8 to 12 years.

title: Tormaresca Primitivo 'Torcicoda' 2022
bodyHtml: The Torcicoda Primitivo exhibits an intense ruby red color. The nose has fruity aromas of plums, and cherries fused with vanilla and chocolate. On the palate, the wine has a complex structure with good tannins and a spice note that continues long into the finish.

title: Pieropan Valpolicella Superiore Ruberpan 2018
bodyHtml: This red is both elegant and structured. Rich and concentrated on the nose, it has a good depth on the palate, with flavours of red berry fruit, black cherries and blackberries balancing fresh vivacious fruit with silky tannins. Perfect with starters such as stuffed pasta, or tomato sauces, particularly good with roast poultry, grilled meat, game birds and mature cheese.

title: Caparzo Sangiovese 2024
bodyHtml:
This Sangiovese is produced in the Tuscany region of Italy, drawing fruit from vineyards across three distinct estates in Montalcino, Castelnuovo Berardenga, and Magliano. Established in 1970 as one of the original 13 wineries in Montalcino, Caparzo—a name derived from 'Ca’ Pazzo' meaning 'place touched by the sun'—was a pioneer in site-driven winemaking. Today, the estate is owned by Elisabetta Gnudi Angelini, who acquired the property in 1998 and has since modernized the cellars while maintaining a philosophy that balances tradition with innovation.

Wine Description

The Caparzo Sangiovese displays an intense ruby colour highlighted by violet reflections. The bouquet is vibrant and fruity, offering an aromatic profile of currants, pomegranate, dried blood orange, and rose hips, complemented by notes of ripe blackberries, wild strawberries, and a touch of vanilla spice. On the palate, this medium to full-bodied red is sleek and juicy, featuring a persistent finish that echoes the soft fruit and spice found on the nose.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling - 90 points."

Food Pairing

This versatile Sangiovese is an ideal companion for classic Italian fare, such as tomato-based pasta dishes like pasta marinara, Italian sausage, or a fresh caprese salad. It also pairs exceptionally well with pizza and hearty meat-based ragu.

title: Sartori Amarone 2019
bodyHtml: Shimmering ruby. Bouquet of dried fruits, raisins, and cherry compote with cocoa notes. Round and full-bodied; deep fruit flavours, and supple tannins. A cinnamon spice finish. Ideal with roasts, stews, grilled meats, and aged cheese.

title: Rodano Chianti Classico 2021
bodyHtml:
The style of the Rodáno Chianti bottlings is quite traditional, with Sangiovese playing a dominant role in all of the estate’s various bottlings. The Chianti Classico “normale” is aged entirely in large Slovenian “botte,” and the Riserva is a combination of these large casks and used barriques. Like all great traditional Sangiovese-based wines, the Rodáno wines offer up lovely, bright acidity that adds freshness and focus on the palate, and makes them outstanding partners at the table. The heart and soul of their vineyard holdings is the beautifully situated vineyard of Viacosta, which is a perfect, south-facing bowl of old vines, that average between thirty-five and forty-five years of age. In top vintages, the Rodáno Riserva Chianti bottling is made from the Viacosta vineyard.

The Classico is made of 90% Sangiovese and 10% Canaiolo & Colorino (two local grapes used traditionally for Chianti), from certified organic vineyards in Castellina in Chianti.  The orientation of the vines is south, southwest and the soils are limestone. All the grapes are hand-picked.

title: Speri Valpolicella Ripasso 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Speri is a historic family-owned winery located in the heart of the Valpolicella Classica zone. Their Ripasso is classified as a Valpolicella Ripasso Classico Superiore D.O.C. The winery has practiced sustainable agriculture for many years and achieved organic certification for all their vineyards starting with the 2015 vintage, meaning the Ripasso is produced from organically grown grapes.

The Ripasso Method

The term "Ripasso" literally means "repassed" and refers to the traditional winemaking technique used to create this style of wine:

  • The base Valpolicella Classico wine is produced and fermented normally.

  • Around early March, this finished wine is "repassed" or poured over the still-moist, spent grape skins (pomace) leftover from making Amarone della Valpolicella.

  • This second, brief maceration and re-fermentation imparts greater structure, alcohol content, depth of color, and complex flavours (like dried fruit and spice) that bridge the gap between simple Valpolicella and the powerful Amarone.

Wine Description

The following describes the typical characteristics of recent Speri Valpolicella Ripasso vintages:

  • Color: A deep, intense ruby red.

  • Grape Varieties: Primarily indigenous grapes from the Valpolicella Classica region: Corvina Veronese (about 70%), Rondinella (about 20%), and Molinara and other native varieties (about 10%).

  • Aromatic Profile: The nose is complex, offering hints of red fruit (like red cherry and dried raspberry), spices (clove, black pepper), and cocoa or chocolate. Some vintages show a savoury side with notes of blood orange, dried flowers, or dried thyme.

  • Palate: The wine is warm and smooth on the palate, with a medium to full body. It is distinguished by its appealing roundness, balanced acidity (often a tangy orange peel or plum skin note), and concentrated fruit flavours.

  • Structure: Well-balanced by rounded, silky tannins that are vigorous yet not intrusive. It finishes with a good complexity of fruity aromas, savoury tones, and often a mineral-driven note.

  • Aging: The wine is typically aged for 12 months in large Slavonian oak barrels (botti) of 20 hectoliters, followed by 6 months of bottle refinement.

  • ABV: Typically 13.5%.

title: Mauro Molino Barbera d'Alba 2024
bodyHtml: Deep violet red colour, fine and fruity bouquet with scents of ripe red berries and minerals. A fresh wine, mellow and persistent.

title: Locations 'IT'
bodyHtml: To make the best possible wine from a given Location. When it comes down to it, we all know that great wine starts in the vineyard, so why not seek out the best vineyards regardless of appellation, varietal, or vintage? Dave Phinney created this portfolio to explore the possibility of what could happen when all of the stereotypical constraints and regional rules were pushed aside, allowing him to focus on one task: making great wine.

title: Querciabella Mongrana Maremma 2022
bodyHtml: The charm of Mongrana does not take long to reveal. Well-defined aromas of ripe fruit, morello cherry, blackberry and blueberry jump out of the glass, anticipating a complex bouquet of kirsch, ivy, and pine needles, enriched by a touch of licorice. On the palate, it offers a juicy, fresh sip with soft tannins. The long finale is savory, with a mineral note that persists in the mouth.

title: La Poderina Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
Ruby red color with garnet notes. Intense, concentrated nose of black cherries, wild berries and vanilla. On the palate it is rich, full bodied, quite tannic in youth, soft and persistent.

Perfect with roasted white or red meat, poultry, game and aged cheeses.

title: Castello Del Terriccio Tassinaia 2022
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the northern Maremma area of the Tuscany region in Castellina Marittima. Castello del Terriccio is one of the largest and most historic estates in the area, with roots stretching back to the Etruscan era and a winemaking history spanning millennia. Under the leadership of the late Dr. Gian Annibale Rossi di Medelana, the estate achieved international fame by drawing inspiration from the success of great Bordeaux blends on the Tuscan coast. The winery's philosophy is based on respecting the natural ecosystem and enhancing the unique terroir, which is characterized by mineral-rich soils and the cooling influence of Tyrrhenian Sea breezes.

Wine Description

Castello del Terriccio Tassinaia displays an intense and luminous ruby red colour. The nose offers a broad and complex bouquet with notes of blackberry, blackcurrant, cherry, and plum, enriched by scents of Mediterranean scrub, lavender, and sweet spices such as cocoa and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, rich, and enveloping, featuring flavours of small forest berries and a pleasant freshness. It is characterized by its elegant structure, featuring well-integrated tannins and a mineral vein that leads to a long and persistent finish.

title: Querciabella Chianti Classico 2021
bodyHtml:
Querciabella, in Italian, means “beautiful oak” and our vineyards in Ruffoli and Radda are surrounded by them. A beautiful balancing act of crisp, inviting acidity, pure varietal fruit flavor and character deriving from sourcing the grapes from top sites in three of the the denomination’s best sub-zones. A wine and food lovers’ delight.

Querciabella is a perfect food wine, pairing naturally with all sorts of Mediterranean cuisine and beyond. It is best enjoyed alongside flavors of tomato and olive oil and doesn’t fear coming close to herbs and spices.

title: Mazzei Chianti Classico Fonterutoli 2022
bodyHtml: Red cherry on the nose but more tart raspberry and a nice level of acidity on first taste. Not as dry as expected from a chianti bit enough to draw out some sweetness of the berry and a touch of smoke. Lighter finish and very nice!

title: Speri Pigaro Amarone 2020
bodyHtml: An awesome Italian red wine with aromas of cherry liqueur, blackberry jam and dark spices. Round, rich and powerful wine with a smooth texture and superb length. It shows fine tannins and pleasing nuances of bitter almond. Pair with slow-braised lamb shanks in red wine, roast beef, bison burgers.

title: Feudo Maccari Nero D'Avola Nere 2022
bodyHtml: With a dark red ruby color, this wine shows expressive red berry aromas with herbal and fruity notes. On the palate, the flavors are structured and given balance by bright, cleansing acidity, a characteristic of Nero d'Avola grown in this area. This wine pairs well with grilled red meats and BBQ.

title: Roscato Rosso Dolce
bodyHtml:
Roscato Rosso Dolce is a delicately sweet, gently fizzy red wine from Italy's Lombardy region. Crafted from native grape varieties including Teroldego, Croatina, and Lagrein, it offers a unique and approachable profile.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Brilliant ruby red.

  • Aroma: Intense aromas of blackberries and ripe wild berries.

  • Palate: Fresh and lively with a soft lingering finish, featuring flavors of cherry and strawberry.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Serve chilled at 8-10°C (46-50°F).

  • Food Pairings: Versatile with tomato-based sauces, classic Italian dishes, spicy foods, and desserts.

With an alcohol content of approximately 7% ABV, Roscato Rosso Dolce is a delightful choice for those seeking a lower-alcohol wine option. Its balanced sweetness and slight effervescence make it suitable for various occasions, from aperitifs to complementing richly flavored dishes.

title: Ruffino Modus 2022
bodyHtml:
Ruffino, a historic Tuscan winery founded in 1877, is renowned for its commitment to producing expressive wines that honour both tradition and innovation. Owned by Constellation Brands, Ruffino combines classic winemaking techniques with modern precision, drawing from a rich legacy rooted in the heart of Chianti.

Wine Description
Ruffino Modus presents a deep ruby red colour, hinting at its bold structure. Aromas of blackberries, cherries, and plums intertwine with notes of tobacco, sweet spices, and hints of vanilla from oak ageing. On the palate, it is full-bodied and velvety, delivering ripe dark fruit balanced by refreshing acidity and well-integrated tannins. Layers of mocha, liquorice, and balsamic emerge on the long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with herb-crusted lamb, Tuscan-style steak, or aged Pecorino cheese. The richness of the wine complements bold, savoury dishes, while its freshness adds vibrancy to each bite. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Il Bruciato 2024
bodyHtml:
Il Bruciato is a red wine from Italy, produced in the Tuscany region and the Bolgheri D.O.C. appellation. The wine is made by Marchesi Antinori, one of Italy's most historic and innovative wine producers, with a history spanning 26 generations. Il Bruciato is the second wine of the renowned Guado al Tasso estate in Bolgheri. The estate's philosophy is centred on the exploration of Bordeaux varietals, which thrive in Bolgheri's unique coastal terroir, expressing an elegant, modern, and powerful style.

Wine Description

The wine has an intense ruby red colour. The aromatic profile is noted for its beautiful freshness and fragrance, offering notes of ripe red fruits, especially cherry and plum, along with subtle hints of liquorice and mint. Further aromatic notes include vanilla, coffee, toast, and spicy cedar.

The varietal composition is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Syrah. Specifically, it is 65% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Merlot, and 15% Syrah. It is a medium bodied wine. The palate is harmonious and well balanced, with a velvety and smooth texture. Flavours are fruity and fresh, echoing the nose with red berries and plum, supported by soft, integrated tannins. Stylistically, it is a pleasant, balanced, and approachable wine, designed to be drunk young while still possessing the elegance of the Bolgheri terroir. The wine is aged for eight months in barriques and then for a further four months in the bottle. The finish is long and pleasant.

Food Pairing

This wine is versatile and pairs well with rich, savoury dishes. Suggested pairings include roasted and grilled red meats, game, and aged cheeses.

title: Umani Conero Cumaro 2021
bodyHtml:
Umani Ronchi Cumaro originates from the Conero Riserva DOCG subregion within the Marche region of Italy. Founded in 1957 by the Bianchi-Bernetti family in Cupramontana, the winery has spent more than half a century expanding its footprint while remaining deeply rooted in the traditions of the local terroir.

Wine Description

This 100% Montepulciano wine exhibits a dark, deep ruby red colour with distinct garnet hints. The nose reveals a complex and intense bouquet characterized by aromas of ripe plum, blackcurrant, and morello cherry, layered with notes of sweet tobacco, vanilla, black pepper, and subtle toasted oak. On the palate, it is full bodied, soft, and enfolding, offering finely polished tannins that provide a strong backbone balanced by warm spices, mocha, and dark fruits. The finish is remarkably long, dry, and elegant, showing a touch of chocolatey complexity.

title: Paolo Conterno Langhe Nebbiolo A Mont 2023
bodyHtml:
The winery, Casa della Ginestra, was founded by Paolo Conterno in 1886 and was dedicated to producing Nebbiolo, Barbera, and Dolcetto. Conterno was one of the first growers in the Langhe area to sell barrels of wine directly to consumers, which helped the independent estate prosper over five generations. Today, Giorgio Conterno manages the winery, which follows a philosophy rooted in tradition, including extended macerations and long ageing in large French oak barrels, respecting the essence of their long-established family tradition.

Wine Description

The Paolo Conterno 'A Mont' Langhe Nebbiolo has a bright garnet red colour. The aroma presents a flowery nose, showcasing roses and fruity sensations. On the palate, the wine is described as mouth-filling and elegantly structured, with complex, slightly spicy flavours that linger.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include pasta dishes with robust sauces, such as 'tagliolini' with meat sauce, main courses of meat served with sauces, or medium-mature cheeses.

title: Zenato Cresasso 2017
bodyHtml: Cresasso has a rich garnet colour that sticks to the rim. On the nose, one senses red fruits such as tart black cherries, plum and tobacco characteristic of the Corvina grape. On the palate, the wine is soft and elegant, with Zenato's trademark balance.

title: La Spinetta Barbaresco Bordini 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine is a Barbaresco DOCG from the Piedmont region of Italy. La Spinetta was founded in 1977 by the Rivetti family, who had emigrated to Italy with the aspiration of producing great wines. The winery's name comes from 'la Spinetta' (hilltop) in Castagnole Lanze, where the family settled. The family, including brothers Carlo, Bruno, and Giorgio Rivetti, prioritizes the vineyard, dedicating most of their efforts to treating their vines with respect, using organic farming, and promoting indigenous varietals like Nebbiolo.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo wine presents a pale ruby red colour. The aroma offers an explosion of fresh perfumes with nuances of raspberry and rose. On the palate, red fruit flavours combine well with aromatic, light, and delicate nuances. The wine is characterized by an extraordinary balance between freshness and structure, with hints of small red fruits, ginger, and wild fennel. It is noted for its elegance, fine tannins, and a persistent, ample finish.

Food Pairing

Traditional Piedmontese cuisine, or a strong, aged cheese like Castelmagno or Fontina.

title: Brigaldara Amarone della Valpolicella 2019
bodyHtml:
The Brigaldara Amarone della Valpolicella 2019 hails from the heart of the Valpolicella Classica region in Veneto, Italy. Owned by the Cesari family since 1928, the estate is currently managed by Stefano Cesari, whose winemaking philosophy focuses on a clean, rigorous style that emphasizes drinkability and aromatic balance.

Wine Description

This Amarone presents an intense garnet red colour with bright ruby highlights. The bouquet is complex and restrained, featuring clean aromas of red cherry, raspberry, and dried plum, accented by floral notes of dusty rose and savoury hints of cedar, cocoa, and black pepper. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and enveloping with a velvety texture, balancing significant warmth and power with fresh acidity and fine-grained tannins.

title: Brigaldara Valpolicella Classico DOC 2024
bodyHtml: An extraordinary and unique bio-diversity, a real agricultural organism that Brigaldara has decided to respect and enhance through sustainable practices, both in the vineyard and in the cellar. Brigaldara interprets Valpolicella in its most authentic nuances. Bright ruby. Vibrant aromas of redcurrant, blackberry and candied violet on the knockout nose. Quite juicy on the palate, with floral red berry flavours given laser-like precision by lovely harmonious acidity. Very well-balanced wine, clean and clear.

title: Villalta Single Vineyard 'I Comunali' Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2020
bodyHtml: Villalta's I Comunali Amarone has a deep ruby-red color with an intense, full and rich bouquet. Rounded on the palate with classic black cherry flavors and a long, complex finish. Ideal with roasts, game and cheese, but also a great wine to sip slowly in company.

title: Bolla Ripasso Classico Superiore 2022
bodyHtml: An intense ruby ​​red colour with garnet reflections in the glass. It spoils you with a fruity-spicy bouquet of dark fruits, such as blackcurrant, blackberry and plums, combined with spices like liquorice and cinnamon as well as a touch of chocolate. The soft texturized palate develops a balanced feeling and develops a fruity, fine-bodied taste with pleasant tannins and a delicate sweetness. A lively fruit acid gives freshness. Wild berries accompany the beautiful finish.

title: Collazzi Liberta Toscana 2023
bodyHtml: Libertà is made with grapes from the Collazzi estate. This wine expresses a great balance between the soft tannins of Merlot, the aromatic complexity of Cabernet Franc and the elegant spiciness of Syrah. The wine owes its name to a donation that the City of Florence made to eight local families, among which were the former owners of Collazzi, who had valiantly fought for the city’s freedom.

title: Feudi San Gregorio Taurasi 2020
bodyHtml:
Brilliant ruby red with garnet reflections, fragrant perfumes of maraschino cherry, cinnamon and nutmeg, vanilla, and anise. The taste is full and balanced with sweet and soft tannins that have good aromatic persistence.

An excellent wine for drinking with the finest roasted red meats and poultry.

title: Layer Cake Primitivo 2021
bodyHtml:
Layer Cake, established in 2007, is part of Hundred Acre Winery where Jayson Woodbridge makes serious California cult Cabs. He’s been called “one of California’s most flamboyant, talented, contrarian wine producers”, “crazy cult wine hero”, and “dedicated and devoted to value and excellence”.  Although he was happy with Hundred Acre’s success, Woodbridge wanted to show that he could make affordable wines that seriously over deliver.

He did just that with Layer Cake, sourcing grapes in some of his favourite wine regions in the world including Australia, Argentina, Italy, Spain, and California, knowing that he would find great value. Using the same winemaking techniques that he uses for One Hundred Acre cabs ensures quality and wines that reflect their origin. These carefully crafted Layer Cake wines are affordable luxuries.

title: Adalia Amarone della Valpolicella 2016
bodyHtml:
Pronounced seductive and complex nose with notes of dried but also ripe red fruit, raisins, spices and some minerality. Rich and sultry in the mouth with lots of ripe fruit, nicely dosed wood, and a long finish with refined acids.

40% Corvinone (Corvina Grossa), 40% Corvina, 20% Rondinella

title: Cantina Tramin Pinot Noir 2020
bodyHtml: Ancient sources testify that already in the early Middle Ages this was a famous vine-growing and wine-producing area: the Retii (established in these parts around the first millennium BC) were familiar with wine-making, and the Romans probably drew from their experience (it appears that they learned the use of wooden barrels from them). This splendid strip of Alto Adige, consisting today of the towns of Tramin, Egna, Montagna and Ora, has since antiquity provided the ideal requirements to produce great wines. Such requirements are the result of the successful combination of human industry and favourable environmental factors, which include sunny slopes with varying soil types, specific microclimatic zones and an altitude that varies between 250 and 700 meters above sea level. These elements make Tramin a place of harmonious beauty, where the vineyards are an integral part of the enchanting landscape.

title: Feudi Di San Gregorio Primitivo 2024
bodyHtml:
Hailing from Italy's southern region of Apulia (Puglia), the Feudi di San Gregorio Primitivo Puglia is a testament to the winery's commitment to showcasing indigenous varietals. Established in 1986 in Sorbo Serpico, Campania, Feudi di San Gregorio has become one of Southern Italy's most esteemed wineries, known for blending tradition with innovation. Their architectural elegance and dedication to quality winemaking have positioned them as pioneers in the revitalization of Southern Italian wines.

Wine Description

This 100% Primitivo wine presents a deep ruby red hue. On the nose, it offers pronounced aromas of cherry and strawberry, complemented by subtle sweet spices. The palate is medium-bodied, revealing fresh fruit flavours intertwined with hints of minerality. Elegant tannins and well-integrated acidity contribute to a balanced and juicy profile, culminating in a finish that echoes notes of cinnamon and ripe fruit.

Food Pairing

The vibrant fruitiness and balanced structure of this Primitivo make it an excellent companion to a variety of dishes. It pairs well with grilled meats, hearty pasta dishes, and aged cheeses. For a regional touch, consider serving it alongside orecchiette with tomato-based sauces or roasted lamb seasoned with Mediterranean herbs. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Fuligni Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
Fuligni Brunello di Montalcino is an esteemed red wine from the Montalcino region of Tuscany, Italy. Founded in 1923 by a descendant of the Venetian Fuligni family, the estate is currently led by Maria Flora Fuligni and her nephew Roberto Guerrini Fuligni. Their winemaking philosophy centers on enhancing the natural elegance of Sangiovese through meticulous vineyard selection and a focus on the unique terroir of their eastern-facing, high-altitude vineyards.

Wine Description

This deep ruby red wine opens with a fragrant and complex bouquet of Marasca cherry, wild berries, and violet, accented by notes of star anise, mint, and subtle cedarwood. On the palate, it is mid to full-bodied and impeccably balanced, offering a layered profile of ripe red fruit, licorice root, and a distinctive salty minerality. The structure is defined by fine-grained, velvety tannins and a refreshing acidity that leads to a long, polished finish with hints of blood orange and spice.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator – 93 points

  • Vinous – 95 points

  • Decanter – 95 points

  • James Suckling – 95 points

Food Pairing

This structured and elegant Brunello is an ideal accompaniment to rich, savoury dishes such as roasted game, wild boar ragout, or a classic Chianina rib steak. It also pairs beautifully with aged cheeses like Pecorino di Pienza or mature Parmigiano Reggiano.

title: Villa Matilde Aglianico 2017
bodyHtml: Appearing a shimmering red with purplish highlights, this Aglianico offers intense, long-lingering impressions of spice, wild blackberries, and ripe redberry fruit. The palate is warm, full-bodied, and velvet-smooth. This full-bodied wine, modern in style, demonstrates appealingly and convincingly its intimate bond with its terroir of origin.

title: Allegrini Palazzo Della Torre 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine is elegant and well balanced, with a good structure and aroma. Ruby red in color with purple hues, it offers light hints of raisins, sophisticated notes of vanilla, black pepper, cloves and cinnamon. It has a long, velvety finish and soft tannins.

Palazzo della Torre easily pairs with various Italian dishes, above all risottos, especially those flavored with saffron, porcini mushrooms and pork; classic dishes such as pasta with Amatriciana and Carbonara sauces, baked lasagna, gnocchi with gorgonzola cheese and walnuts; grilled meats and roasts. It also excels when matched with Parma ham and fine-cured Zibello pork loin, as well as medium-matured cheeses, especially Parmigiano Reggiano (Parmesan), pecorino and Monte Veronese.

Allegrini, one of the most prestigious wine producers in the Veneto region, is a family-run estate with deep historical roots in Valpolicella. The estate has been instrumental in elevating the profile of the region's wines globally, combining traditional practices with modern innovation. Their commitment to excellence is showcased in this single-vineyard wine, which draws inspiration from the ancient ‘ripasso’ method.

title: Tenuta Sette Ponti 'Crognolo' 2023
bodyHtml:
Tenuta Sette Ponti Crognolo originates from the heart of Tuscany, Italy, within the central Tuscan region.
