This historic estate was revitalized in the late 1990s by architect Alberto Moretti Cuseri, whose family philosophy emphasizes organic viticulture and a deep respect for age old winemaking traditions.

Wine Description

This wine presents an intense ruby red colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is complex and vibrant, offering a bouquet of ripe cherries, strawberries, and wild berries layered with delicate floral notes of violet, hibiscus, and orange peel. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied and beautifully balanced, featuring a core of red and dark fruits accompanied by hints of sweet spices, cedar, and graphite. The structure is defined by firm, polished tannins and a refreshing acidity that leads to a long, juicy, and persistent finish.

title: Damilano Langhe Nebbiolo 'Marghe' 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine is from Italy, specifically the Langhe region of Piedmont, an area famous for its noble Nebbiolo grape. It is produced by Damilano, a historic winery that has been dedicated to Nebbiolo for four generations. The Damilano family has deep roots in the municipality of La Morra. The winery is recognized for its meticulous approach to winemaking and its focus on single-vineyard expressions of Barolo.

The Langhe Nebbiolo 'Marghe' serves as the entry point to the estate's Nebbiolo offerings. It is an approachable expression of the varietal, crafted to be enjoyed young, while still retaining the structure and elegance characteristic of the grape. The name 'Marghe' is derived from a family connection.

Wine Description

'Marghe' is 100% Nebbiolo. It presents a bright garnet-red colour.

The bouquet is delicate, yet intense, offering classic Nebbiolo aromas of red fruit like raspberry and cherry, complemented by floral notes of rose and violet. Subtle hints of anise, rhubarb, and tar may also appear.

On the palate, it is dry, harmonious, and full-bodied. It provides a full, silky mouthfeel. The flavours are consistent with the nose, featuring tart red cherry, liquorice, and dried herbs. It is characterized by notable freshness and firm, well-integrated tannins that provide structure. The finish is long and persistent. The grapes are sourced from various vineyards in the Langhe area. The wine is aged for 12 months in large French oak barrels (traditionally 20-30HL barrels), followed by 6 months in bottle. It is meant to be drunk young, but it offers complexity and great balance.

title: Vietti Nebbiolo 'Perbacco' 2022
bodyHtml: Medium deep ruby color. Quite intense and generous fruity nose (red berries) along with floral and spicy notes, a hint of menthol and hard candy. On the pallet medium bodied, showing notable intensity while retaining an essentially mid-weight style. Strong, intense and quite powerful when young, evolving to a complex and elegant, very well balanced wine with ageing. The tannins are harmoniously integrated in the fruit structure of the wine. Long lasting aftertaste with good freshness.

title: Poggio Al Tesoro Mediterra Toscana 2017
bodyHtml: The flavour of Mediterra fully reflects the characteristics of Bolgheri, displaying an extraordinary harmony between the freshness of its aromas and its warm, powerful flavours. The spicy note lent by the Syrah varietal makes the wine intensely enjoyable as well as easy to drink. Ruby red in colour with purple tints, this is a fragrant and intensely fruity wine, in which blackberry, plum and cherry are underpinned by spicy notes of white pepper and elegant herbaceous aromas. On the palate, it is fresh, intense, and surprisingly persistent.

title: Sartori Valpolicella Ripasso 2021
bodyHtml: Intense garnet red colour. Red berry and mature cherry aromas, full body and long, velvety aftertaste. Rich flavoured food such as pasta or rice with meat sauce, game, roasted or oven cooked red meat, and aged cheese.

title: Campagnola Amarone della Valpolicella 2021
bodyHtml:
Originating from France in the Veneto region, specifically within the Amarone della Valpolicella DOCG appellation in northeastern Italy, Campagnola Amarone della Valpolicella represents a rich, prestigious, and deeply concentrated expression of classic Italian winemaking. Produced by Giuseppe Campagnola, a historic family-owned winery established in 1886 and now managed by its fifth generation, the estate combines century-old traditions with modern ecological viticulture. Sourced from selected hillside vineyards situated on clay-limestone soils across the Valpolicella zone, the winemaking philosophy centers on the traditional appassimento method, where hand-harvested grapes undergo natural drying in wooden crates for up to four months to concentrate sugars, flavours, and extracts. Following a slow winter fermentation, the wine is aged for over two years in large Slavonian oak casks to develop exceptional complexity, structural richness, and cellaring power.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep, clear dark ruby garnet colour with rich crimson and terracotta highlights along the rim. An intense, intoxicating bouquet opens with opulent aromas of dried cherry, raisin, and dark plum jam, interwoven with sophisticated notes of dark chocolate, sweet tobacco, espresso bean, dried violet, and toasted cinnamon oak spice. On the palate, it is full bodied, velvety, and expansive, delivering luxurious layers of sweet dark berries, fig, and cocoa powder, all supported by a firm, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by smooth, fine-grained tannins and a rich, warming mid-palate, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering notes of dried fruit, licorice, and savory earthiness. Composed of a traditional blend of Corvina, Corvinone, and Rondinella, it combines the iconic power and dried-fruit richness of Amarone with refined balance and timeless elegance.

title: Campagnola Ripasso 2023
bodyHtml:
The Campagnola winery is located in the heart of the Valpolicella region of Italy, near Verona. Founded in 1886 by Carlo Campagnola, the winery has a long and proud history of producing high-quality wines using traditional methods.

Today, the winery is run by the fourth generation of the Campagnola family and has expanded its production to include a wide range of wines, including both red and white wines. The winery's focus remains on producing wines that are true to the region's heritage and showcase the unique characteristics of the local terroir.

Campagnola Ripasso is a wine that is truly exceptional in its depth and complexity. The wine's deep ruby color and enticing aroma give way to a flavor profile that is both rich and balanced, with notes of dark fruit, spice, and vanilla. The wine's ripasso method adds an intensity and depth to its flavor, while its blend of Corvina, Rondinella, and Molinara grapes provide a foundation for a wine that is both robust and elegant.

The wine's tannins are firm and provide structure to the wine's flavor intensity, but they are also balanced and do not overpower the wine's other flavors. The wine's smooth finish leaves a pleasant and lingering sensation on the palate, making it an excellent wine for sipping on its own or for pairing with rich and flavorful dishes.

title: Campagnola Valpolicella Classico 2023
bodyHtml: This Valpolicella is a great everyday wine. The same care that goes into their Amarone goes into this Valpolicella. On the palate it is medium-bodied and tannic with sour cherry notes. An excellent choice to have with burgers, pizza and pasta.

title: Fontella Chianti 2024
bodyHtml: Medium ruby colour, with aromas of chestnut, red currant and spice, floral and citrus notes. The palate is extra dry, with a solid structure of tannin and acidity. Expect flavours of tart cherry, with earthy and vegetal notes.

title: Fontanafredda Barbera Briccotondo 2024
bodyHtml: The nose is packed with black fruit, especially blackberries and plums, with slight spicy overtones hinting at black pepper and cinnamon. Sweet, soft tannins come together in a closely-woven texture that combines with great fruit character and crisp freshness on the palate.

title: Travaglini Gattinara Tre Vigne 2018
bodyHtml: In the glass the Tre Vigne is very clear, of a garnet red color. On the nose it is fine and complex with aromas of plum, cherry, leather, tobacco, roots and spicy hints, all perceived in a framework of great harmony. The taste is fresh, full, articulated, with well-polished tannins and a long, savory finish. The great balance gives it an uncommon drinkability for a red of this structure and intensity. It goes well with red meats: roast, braised, boiled and many other preparations.

title: Gabbiano Alleanza Red Wine 2020
bodyHtml:
Gabbiano Alleanza is produced in the heart of the Chianti Classico region in Tuscany, Italy. The historic Castello di Gabbiano estate dates back to 1480 and follows a winemaking philosophy that emphasizes the 'alliance' between the land and the vine to express the unique Tuscan terroir. Winemaker Federico Cerelli prioritizes elegance, drinkability, and food compatibility over sheer power, ensuring each bottle reflects the estate's 900 year history.

Wine Description

This crimson red wine is clear and vibrant in the glass. The aromatic bouquet is young and intense, offering sweet notes of blackcurrant, dark plum, and cherry-vanilla, accented by spicy hints of clove, cinnamon, and pink pepper. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and well balanced, featuring rich flavours of blackberry and chocolate layered with subtle herbaceous undertones of thyme and sage. The structure is defined by soft, well integrated tannins and a fresh acidity that leads to a long, persistent finish.

title: Gabbiano Chianti Classico 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Gabbiano Chianti Classico originates from the historic heart of the Tuscany region in Italy. The Castello di Gabbiano estate has a storied winemaking legacy dating back to the 12th century and is recognized as one of the oldest and most respected producers in the region. Their winemaking philosophy centers on "consistency of the tradition," blending ancient heritage with modern techniques to craft an authentic expression of the Chianti Classico terroir.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep ruby red colour in the glass. The sensory profile is highly fragrant, offering aromas of violets, red berries, and black fruit, with distinct undertones of spice and tobacco. On the palate, it is medium bodied and balanced, delivering flavours of bright red cherry, plum, and licorice, accented by notes of white pepper and nutmeg. The structure is characterized by firm tannins and a juicy acidity that provides a refreshing, mouth-watering finish. The varietal composition is predominantly Sangiovese, often blended with small amounts of other traditional grapes such as Canaiolo or Merlot to add complexity. This wine typically has an ABV of 13% to 13.5%.

Food Pairing

This food-friendly Chianti Classico is an excellent match for traditional Italian cuisine, particularly tomato-based pasta dishes like spaghetti Bolognese or lasagna. It also pairs effectively with grilled or roasted meats, such as Bistecca alla Fiorentina (Florentine steak), roasted pork, or rosemary-garlic roasted chicken. For a cheese course, it complements aged varieties like Pecorino Toscano or Parmesan.

title: Barone Ricasoli Chianti 2024
bodyHtml:
Barone Ricasoli is a historic producer from Italy, located in the Chianti region of Tuscany. The winery is widely recognized as the oldest in Italy, with the Ricasoli family linked to Brolio Castle since 1141. Baron Bettino Ricasoli is famously credited with developing the original formula for Chianti wine in 1872, a legacy that continues today through a focus on sustainable vineyard practices and innovative winemaking.

Wine Description

This vibrant red wine displays a bright ruby red colour in the glass. The nose is fragrant and pleasant, offering aromas of red cherry, ripe raspberry, and wild strawberry, accompanied by delicate hints of violet, lavender, and balsamic notes. On the palate, it is medium bodied and beautifully balanced, featuring juicy flavours of fresh plum and cherry skin supported by a lively line of acidity and velvety, fine tannins.

title: Michele Chiarlo Barbera D'Asti Le Orme 2023
bodyHtml:
Barbera grapes from a selection of several vineyards in the South of Asti, with particular reference to the vineyards of La Court Estate and Montemareto in Castelnuovo Calcea, La Serra in Montaldo Scarampi and Costa delle Monache ad Agliano.

Colour: Ruby red with hues of violet

Nose: Elegant and intense, with notes of fresh mature red fruit, such as cherry and currant

Taste: Harmonious, with good structure and roundness, beautiful savoury finish

title: Arceno Chianti Classico Riserva 2020
bodyHtml:
Tenuta di Arceno is an ancient Tuscan estate with roots tracing back to the pre-Roman Etruscan civilization. Currently owned by Jackson Family Wines, the estate is situated in the commune of Castelnuovo Berardenga, where winemaking tradition spans nearly 3,000 years. The property operates under a 'micro-cru' philosophy, led by the long-standing collaboration of winemakers Pierre Seillan and Lawrence Cronin.

Wine Description

This Riserva presents a deep ruby red colour with a magenta hue and a tinge of purple. The aromatic profile is complex and expressive, featuring classic notes of cypress, black cherry, and vanilla, layered with subtle spice, rose petals, and earthy nuances. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and well-balanced, displaying a core of tart raspberries, plum, and blueberry framed by focused acidity and serene, velvety tannins. Hints of white pepper, tobacco, and licorice lead into a persistent finish marked by orange peel and warm spice.

Accolades

  • "Wine Spectator - 94 points."

  • "James Suckling - 93 points."

  • "Jeb Dunnuck - 92 points."

  • "Decanter - 91 points."

Food Pairing

The wine’s structured tannins and high acidity make it an exceptional partner for rich, savoury dishes such as roast lamb with rosemary, wild boar ragù, or a classic Bistecca alla Fiorentina. It also pairs elegantly with aged Pecorino cheese or earthy mushroom risotto.

title: Tenimenti D'Alessandro Syrah Rosso Toscana 2021
bodyHtml: A ready-to-drink Syrah originating from younger vines, a wine with ageing potential of at least 5-6 years. Deep shiny red; fragrant brushwood nose; blackberry, balsamic and spicy notes, licorice root (reglisse), silky tannins and fresh length.

title: Bortoluzzi Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: Brilliant ruby in color, with an intense, spicy and herbaceous nose with notes of wood and abundant fruit and brushwood; velvety and elegant on the palate.

title: Elio Altare Dolcetto d'Alba 2024
bodyHtml:
Deep purple in color with elegant aromas of violet and red fruits. Dry and soft on the palate with intense flavors of red fruits.

Pairs well with white meats and pizza.

title: Corte Giara Amarone 2016
bodyHtml: Corte Giara is the negociant label of Allegrini. The wines are made by Allegrini from fruit brought in from outside their own vineyards. They have a similar stamp of quality that sets them apart from most of the Veronese wines produced at this level. Pronounced aromas and flavours of blackcurrant jam, baked cherries with coffee, liquorice and chocolate notes. Dry and well balanced. This get better hours and days later.

title: Frescobaldi Nipozzano Mormoreto 2018
bodyHtml:
Behind every Frescobaldi wine lies the passion of agronomists and oenologists, who know their vineyards and terroirs down to the finest detail. Their art, of creating quality wines, requires the iron rule of respect. Respect for tradition even in the midst of innovation or avant-garde solutions. Respect for Tuscany, the living land, to be cultivated in harmony and serenity. Respect for each individual terroir, borne of a unique combination of soil, altitude and microclimate, each giving us a wine with its own matchless personality.

Mormoreto 2017 is warm, enveloping and enigmatic, like the season that produced it. It boasts an intense yet clear ruby-red colour that is beautifully rich and concentrated. It is pleasantly fresh with a bouquet that hints of blackberries, blueberries and raspberries. On the palate, balsamic and minty notes balance out beautifully with hints of bergamot and jasmine. Spicy notes of clove and vanilla are just around the corner. Tertiary aromas of tobacco, cocoa powder and coffee bean are remarkably well-integrated. The taste is smooth yet wonderfully fresh, with silky, well-rounded tannins. The finish is long and persistent.

95 Points - James Suckling 

A big, rich red with blackberry, chocolate and walnut aromas and flavours. It’s full and layered. It reflects the ripeness of the vintage yet shows energy.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Sangiovese and Petit Verdot, this opens with aromas of black plum, mocha and kitchen spice. The structured palate offers prune, roasted coffee beans and tobacco alongside fine-grained tannins.

title: Damilano Barolo Lecinquevigne 2020
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Barolo DOCG region in Piedmont. Founded in 1890, the Damilano winery is a historic family estate currently managed by the fourth generation, Paolo, Mario, and Guido Damilano. The Lecinquevigne bottling reflects a unique philosophy of blending Nebbiolo grapes from five distinct vineyards across the municipalities of Barolo, Grinzane Cavour, La Morra, Monforte d'Alba, and Novello to create a harmonious expression of the terroir.

Wine Description

Damilano Barolo Lecinquevigne 2020 displays an intense ruby red colour with traditional orange reflections. The nose is rich and complex, offering an elegant bouquet of roses, violets, and ripe cherries layered with tertiary notes of leather, tobacco, and subtle balsamic hints of eucalyptus. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and well structured, featuring vibrant acidity and dense, silken tannins that provide excellent balance and freshness. The finish is long and persistent, marked by a savory mineral quality. This 100% Nebbiolo was aged for 24 months in large oak casks and has an ABV of 14.5%. While the winery employs sustainable practices, this wine is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is from 2025 through 2045.

Accolades

Wine Spectator - 94 points.

James Suckling - 93 points.

Luca Gardini - 97 points.

Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - 91 points.

Kerin O'Keefe - 92 points.

Food Pairing

The complex structure and refined tannins of this Barolo make it a natural partner for rich, savory dishes. It pairs perfectly with roasted game birds, beef braised in Barolo, or a classic lamb leg with porcini mushrooms. Its floral and earthy undertones also complement truffle infused risottos, hearty mushroom pastas, and aged hard cheeses like Parmigiano Reggiano or Castelmagno.

Vintage Quality

The 2020 vintage in the Langhe is considered of high quality, characterized by a stable summer and cool autumn nights that allowed for healthy, aromatic grape ripening. These conditions resulted in wines that are more accessible and graceful in their youth compared to more austere years, while still possessing the structural integrity for significant aging.

title: Masi Bardolino Frescaripa 2024
bodyHtml:
Masi Bardolino Frescaripa originates from the Bardolino Classico zone in the Veneto region of Italy. Owned by the Boscaini family for seven generations, Masi is a leader in the Venetian winemaking tradition, blending historic techniques with contemporary style. The winery is celebrated for its 'Venetian Values' philosophy, focusing on indigenous grapes and the unique microclimate influenced by the cooling breezes of Lake Garda.

Wine Description

This light red wine presents a vibrant violet red colour in the glass. The nose is intense and inviting, featuring prominent aromas of cherries, blackcurrants, and subtle hints of pepper. On the palate, it is fresh and attractive, delivering flavours of 'marasca' cherries and delicate vegetable notes supported by a lively acidity. The body is light and elegant, leading to a refreshing finish with a lingering trail of fruit.

Food Pairing

This wine is highly versatile, pairing beautifully with arugula penne, veal and onion casserole, or Mediterranean pasta dishes. It is also an excellent companion for summer picnics featuring cold cuts, salads, and mild cheeses.

title: Ruffino Il Ducale Toscana 2022
bodyHtml:
The founders were among the first in Tuscany to acknowledge that the best wines originate from the finest vineyards, a philosophy Ruffino honours today through meticulous selection of vineyard sites and a commitment to non-interventionist practices in the vineyards and winemaking.

Wine Description

The bouquet is often described as intense and complex, showcasing notes of cassis, cherry jam, and plum from the Sangiovese and Merlot, with the Syrah contributing pleasant spicy notes. Additional aromatic descriptors include hints of vanilla, black pepper, eucalyptus, tobacco, and other spices.

On the palate, the wine is typically dry with a medium body. It is described as fruit-forward and smooth, featuring bright, fruity opening notes and round, elegant tannins. It is noted for its balance and freshness. The finish is long and satisfying, with refined notes of ripe fruit, black pepper, and vanilla.

title: La Spinetta Il Nero Di Casanova 2021
bodyHtml: Deep ruby red. Hints of black cherry, licorice and Mediterranean scrub are present on the bouquet. Hints of blackberry plum blend with floral and spicy notes are present on the palate. Upon tasting it is structured and precise, also with a surprising minerality.

title: Alpha Zeta Ripasso 2023
bodyHtml: Ruby red in colour, with a concentrated perfume of red and black cherries, with the ripasso adding a dried cherry intensity. Full-bodied on the palate, with a lovely balance between opulent cherry-pie character and supple structure. Good length with a mouthwatering bitter-cherry twist on the finish.

title: Tenuta Monteti Toscana 2019
bodyHtml:
Tenuta Monteti is located in the southern part of the Tuscan Maremma, near the historic town of Capalbio in Italy. This family owned estate is deeply committed to biodiversity and sustainable agriculture, holding a V.I.V.A. certification for its eco-conscious vineyard management. The winery focuses on producing complex, estate grown red blends that express the unique, Mediterranean influenced terroir of the region.

Wine Description

The Tenuta Monteti reveals a dark ruby red colour with brilliant purple reflections. The nose is intricate and concentrated, opening with aromas of blackberry, wild blueberry, and crushed violet, layered with sophisticated notes of Mediterranean scrub, graphite, and sweet spice. On the palate, it exhibits an exceptional balance between freshness and deep concentration, showcasing flavours of fresh cherries, tobacco, and dark berries.

title: La Spinetta Langhe Nebbiolo 2025
bodyHtml: Bright ruby red with notes of wild strawberries, cloves, and dark chocolate on the nose. Its elegant and fresh taste illustrates floral and fruitful notes. The tannins are smooth and velvety. Paired with a decisive acidity, they define a complex and powerful finish.

title: Mazzei Zisola Sicilia Noto Rosso DOC 2022
bodyHtml: Zisola is made only from traditional "Alberello" (bushy) vines grown near Noto, an area of rare beauty. The proximity of the sea and the soil rich in limestone allow to best balance the natural Nero d'Avola exuberance, with a great freshness. Well built, forest fruits and sunny orange peel flavors give a long and layered taste.

title: La Spinetta Barbera Ca Di Pian 2024
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s celebrated Piedmont region, the La Spinetta winery is based in Castagnole Lanze, within the Monferrato and Langhe areas of Piedmont. Founded by the Rivetti family in the 1970s, La Spinetta is renowned for its dedication to expressing terroir through meticulous vineyard care and minimal intervention winemaking. Their philosophy balances modern techniques with deep respect for tradition, resulting in wines of distinctive character.

Wine Description

This 100% Barbera wine displays a vivid ruby red hue. On the nose, it offers a fragrant bouquet of ripe red cherries, wild strawberries, and hints of violets, underpinned by subtle spice and earthy undertones. The palate is medium to full-bodied, lively with fresh acidity that highlights juicy red fruit flavours, complemented by nuances of licorice and delicate oak. The tannins are polished and fine, leading to a long, vibrant finish that underscores the wine’s purity and elegance.

Food Pairing

Delightful alongside roasted pork tenderloin with herbs, mushroom risotto, or aged cheeses such as Parmigiano Reggiano. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character, allowing its bright acidity to cut through rich dishes while enhancing its expressive fruit notes.

title: Batzella Pean Bolgheri Rosso 2021
bodyHtml: This solid blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah opens with aromas of ripe black plum, mocha and coconut. The dense, brawny palate offers raisin, espresso and tobacco alongside chewy tannins.

title: Fontodi Chianti Classico 2022
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the famous Tuscany region, specifically within the premier Panzano in Chianti subregion, Fontodi Chianti Classico represents an organic benchmark for estate grown Sangiovese. Owned and operated by the Manetti family since 1968, the estate is situated in the heart of the amphitheatre shaped valley known as the Conca d'Oro. Fontodi's winemaking philosophy relies on strict organic farming, biodynamic principles, low yields, and traditional spontaneous fermentation to produce authentic, single terroir expressions of remarkable purity and age worthiness.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous, deep ruby red colour with subtle garnet highlights in the glass. An inviting and complex bouquet opens with classic aromas of dark Marasca cherry, wild red plum, and crushed violet, layered with subtle accents of dried oregano, leather, tobacco leaf, and wet stone minerality. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied, vibrant, and precise, delivering rich flavours of black cherry, blood orange, and dark cocoa supported by a spine of mouthwatering natural acidity. Framed by firm, fine grained tannins and an elegant mineral grip, it concludes with a long, energetic finish. Composed of 100% Sangiovese sourced entirely from certified organic estate vineyards and aged in French oak troneaux and barriques, it combines high altitude Tuscan freshness, firm structural power, and polished fruit depth.

title: Collosorbo Brunello di Montalcino Riserva 2019
bodyHtml:
A consistent critic favourite, Collosorbo's Brunello di Montalcino is obtained from the meticulous selection of Sangiovese grapes from the estate’s best vineyards. It is the product of diligent and thorough fieldwork and of focused operations in the wine cellar which preserve the essence of the Sangiovese grape and exalt the qualities of a wine that every bottle reflects over history and time.

95 Points - James Suckling

Reductive at first, but that soon blows off and will fade with time. What’s left is very transparent red-plum and red-cherry aromas. Hints of rhubarb and hibiscus. Tightly strung tannins suspend blood-orange and peach flavors in a hammock of gently weaving acidity. Drink from 2022.

95 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Sunbaked earth, underbrush, leather and baked plum aromas emerge on this full-bodied red. Round and enveloping, the delicious, concentrated palate doles out juicy Morello cherry, fleshy black raspberry, licorice and baking spice alongside velvety tannins. It’s already almost accessible but will also provide years of drinking pleasure. Enjoy through 2030.

93 Points - Wine Spectator

Rich, boasting fleshy black cherry, plum, earth and graphite aromas and flavors. Chunky tannins provide support as this persists through the lingering finish. Fine balance. Best from 2023 through 2042.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

I tasted this wine right after the 2018 Rosso di Montalcino from the same producer, and the fruit profile of the two wines is completely different, thus illustrating the exuberant character of the 2015 vintage against the more reserved nature of 2018. This wine is plump and soft with robust notes of candied cherry, purple plum and tangy spice. The tannins are soft and velvety, and the role of the acidity is somewhat downplayed.

title: Rocca di Montegrossi Chianti Classico 2022
bodyHtml:
In the glass it is lively ruby, with bright violet reflections, and on the nose displays the rich fruity aromas typical of the varietals, particularly forest berry fruit and sour cherries. On the palate it is harmonious and well structured, with nice tannins and savory notes.

93 Points - Decanter

Deep violet in colour and equally youthful on the nose, it exudes wild berries, black plum, and hints of wood spice. Tangy dark red cherry fills the mouth, buoyed by rambunctious acidity and framed by suede-textured tannins. Winter mint and liquorice root linger on the finish. 

91 Points - James Suckling

A chewy and savory Chianti Classico with aromas of red plums, herbs, mushrooms and some citrus peel. Medium-bodied with plenty of bite from the chewy tannins. From organically grown grapes. 

91 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2021 Chianti Classico is ripe with youthful primary red fruit, revealing cooling and lifted aromas of menthol, pine, and pure cherry. It has wonderful concentration on the palate, with generous and ripe wild raspberry, dried earth, herbes de Provence, and refreshing salinity. Although ripe, it has a spine of fresh acidity that seams it all together.

90 Points - Wine Spectator

Boasting black cherry, blackberry, violet and earth flavors, this rich, dark red shows fine balance, with a light grip of tannins on the finish. This is more about the fruit, so very drinkable now. Sangiovese, Canaiolo and Colorino.

title: Collosorbo Rosso Di Montalcino 2023
bodyHtml: A traditional, fresh velvety wine, Rosso di Montalcino comes from the Estate’s best vineyards, the same that produce Brunello; 100% Sangiovese with persistent, fruity aromas and considerable structure. This is a very versatile wine suitable for average periods of aging.

title: Roberto Voerzio Barbera d'Alba Il Cerreto 2013
bodyHtml: Aromas of black cherries, plum skin, hints of mocha, warm leather. Deep and savory, great length. Pair with grilled chicken; salumi with truffles; pasta with game sauce.

title: Masi Refosco Grandarella 2018
bodyHtml:
The historical Masi winery is nestled in the Valpolicella area, and is renowned for producing elegant wines across the Veneto and Friuli regions. Established in 1772, the Masi family is dedicated to viticulture, creating wines that embody the spirit and character of the region, including mastering the ancient Appassimento technique of drying grapes.

Wine Description

Masi Refosco Grandarella is a complex, full-bodied, and robust red wine. It showcases a dark, opaque red colour. On the nose, it offers firm aromas of blueberries and plums, along with sweet hints of vanilla and cocoa. It is also described as having hints of dry and aromatic herbs and baked plums with vanilla and cloves. The palate is full-bodied, complex, and well-balanced, presenting attractive hints of cherry jam and flavours of cooked fruit and cherries preserved in spirit. 

Food Pairing

This complex, full-flavoured wine goes well with grilled or roast red meat and game. It is an excellent pairing for full-flavoured and mature cheeses or strong cheeses.

title: Agostina Pieri Brunello di Montalcino 2020
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the Piancornello area in the southern part of the Montalcino region in Italy, Agostina Pieri is a family run estate that began bottling its own wines in 1994. Currently managed by Jacopo and Francesco Monaci, the winery emphasizes a philosophy that blends traditional methods with modern technology to capture the true expression of the local terroir.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese pours a transparent medium ruby colour with a slight garnet rim. The aromatic profile is highly floral, featuring focused notes of candied roses, violets, and sweet herbs alongside ripe raspberries, blood oranges, and strawberry preserves. On the palate, the wine is mid-weight and balanced, offering a supple fruit core supported by ultra-fine, firm tannins and a crisp acidity. The finish is clean and persistent, revealing hints of ripe orange, aromatic herbs, and a touch of saline.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 93 points

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 91 points

Food Pairing

The wine’s robust structure and vibrant acidity make it an ideal partner for rich meat dishes such as roast lamb, chianina rib steak, or wild boar ragout. It also pairs beautifully with aged cheeses like Pecorino or mature Parmigiano Reggiano.

title: Torre del Falasco Valpolicella Ripasso 2020
bodyHtml: This is the little brother to the excellent Falasco Amarone. A very tasty Ripasso that stands a little bit taller than most Ripasso. Same chocolate, bitter cherry and fruit cake as the big brother but with a lighter touch.

title: Collazzi Toscana 2021
bodyHtml: Deep, rich red. Balsamic aromas arise from the Merlot. In the mouth, the wine is enveloping with soft tannins, leaving the palate in exemplary balance. Complex and long without being impetuous.

title: Carpineto Dogajolo 2022
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates in Italy, from the Tuscany region, a prestigious wine area known globally for its centuries-old winemaking traditions. The Carpineto winery, established in 1967 by Giovanni C. Sacchet and Antonio M. Zaccheo, was founded with the vision of creating world-class Chianti Classico, a radical departure from the common style of the time. Their philosophy marries tradition with innovation, applying modern viticultural and winemaking methods to deliver wines that are full bodied, complex, and fruity.

Wine Description

The Carpineto Dogajolo 2022 is a young 'Super-Tuscan' style blend, combining the power and deep colour of a young wine with the elegance and balance imparted by wood aging.. On the nose, this wine is very fruity and intense, often displaying hints of cherry, coffee, vanilla, and spice. It is medium-bodied with a clean, vibrant character and a soft feel on the palate. Tasting notes include red-toned fruit, cherry, black currant, earth, and a tomato leaf flavour, supported by a juicy acidity and firm, well-developed tannins that lead to a dry finish.

Food Pairing

Pair with grilled or roasted meats, cured meats, and Tuscan regional specialities.

title: Villa Antinori Toscana Red 2023
bodyHtml:
Villa Antinori was first crafted in 1928 by Marchese Niccolò Antinori, Piero Antinori’s father, as the Antinori family’s signature wine; an exceptional wine that can represent the family’s history, identity and continuity like no other. 

Villa Antinori is a full-blooded Tuscan red which grapes are grown, mature and are harvested from our Tuscan estates and then fermented and aged in the Antinori family estates.

title: La Spinetta Barbera Gallina 2022
bodyHtml: Silky, elegant, persuasive. This Barbera offers lavish amounts of floral and balsamic notes, followed by gentle acidity and an unexpected tannic texture.

title: Poggio Salvi Brunello di Montalcino 2021
bodyHtml: Aromas of cedar, leather and star anise with the barest whiff of blue flower form the rather subdued nose. The lean, assertive palate lacks fruit richness, recalling prune, ground clove and bitter notes set against close-grained tannins that leave an astringent, drying finish. Drink sooner rather than later to capture the remaining fruit.

title: Rocca Delle Macie Chianti Classico Riserva Sergioveto 2018
bodyHtml: Ser Gioveto was conceived in 1985 by Italo as a tribute to his son Sergio, who began working alongside him at the helm of the winery in that year. That said, the given name of this wine is also a reference to the archaic name of Sangiovese – ‘Sangioveto’ – which was the main grape chosen to make the new wine. 10% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Merlot are blended with the noble native vine to create a wine of great structure and character, produced from a selection of the winery’s finest grapes. Aging in French oak barriques for 9-14 months enriches the wine’s aromatic complexity with an enhanced sense of balance and elegance. Bright ruby-red in color, Ser Gioveto releases a warm, attractive aroma of black cherry, plum and blackcurrant syrup, followed by balsamic notes with a spicy finish of leather and sweet tobacco, and can hold its own with full-flavored dishes thanks to its assertive tannic note.

title: Banfi Cum Laude 2023
bodyHtml:
This prestigious and "super-Tuscan" red wine originates from the Montalcino region of Tuscany, Italy. Produced by the legendary Castello Banfi, the name "Cum Laude" (Latin for "with honors") reflects the estate's academic and meticulous approach to viticulture. The winery's philosophy for this bottling is to create a modern, international blend that highlights the versatility of the Montalcino terroir beyond traditional Sangiovese.

Wine Description

The Banfi Cum Laude presents a deep, intense ruby red colour. The sensory profile is exceptionally complex and "dense," featuring an aromatic nose of ripe blackberries, dark plums, and blackcurrants, layered with sophisticated notes of tobacco, black pepper, and dark chocolate derived from its oak aging. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and powerful, showcasing velvety tannins and a balanced acidity that provides a long, structured mouthfeel. It is characterized by its "modern and cosmopolitan" style, leading to a persistent finish with hints of licorice and roasted coffee beans.

title: Brancaia Tre 2024
bodyHtml:
TRE stands for its three grape varieties Sangiovese, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon as well as for its three Tuscan vineyards (Maremma, Castellina and Radda in Chianti). The assemblage is dominated by Sangiovese with 80 percent, but Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon also bring their charm with ten percent each. This well-structured, medium-bodied wine is aged for twelve months before it is bottled. Two thirds of the expansion takes place in French tonneaux and one in cement. This elegant, well-structured wine offers plenty of drinking pleasure now or later and goes well with every kitchen. “There is no better entry-level wine than this,” says Monica Larner for Robert Parker.

Really delicious, really juicy, with wonderful aromas of red fruits.  Ideal with: pasta and rice dishes, light roasted or sautéed meat, poultry, fried or grilled fish.

title: Gabbiano Chianti 2024
bodyHtml: The wine offers aromas of violet and red berries. On the palate, the wine has flavours of bright red cherry, notes of white pepper and nutmeg and a savoury character that is classic Sangiovese. It has firm tannins and bright acidity.

title: Gabbiano Chianti Classico Riserva 2022
bodyHtml:
A deep, ruby red in colour, this wine offers lovely red fruity notes with hints of strawberry, citrus, and tobacco. The flavors continue across the fruit-filled palate complemented by earthy and spicy notes. This complex wine is balanced and elegant, with fresh acidity, a vigorous structure, and firm tannins.

Serve with roasted red meats, game with rich sauces, and aged cheeses.

title: Feudi Di San Gregorio Rubrato Aglianico 2022
bodyHtml:
This vibrant red wine originates from southern Italy, within the mountainous Irpinia DOC of the Campania region. Feudi di San Gregorio, founded in 1986 in Sorbo Serpico, is a powerhouse estate globally credited with leading the modern renaissance of Campania's indigenous grape varieties.

Aglianico is famously nicknamed "The Barolo of the South" due to its intense, age-worthy tannins and high acidity. However, the "Rubrato" cuvée is deliberately envisioned as a more youthful, accessible, and energetic expression. By steering clear of oak barrels, the winery showcases the grape's bright, wild fruit personality without sacrificing its classic southern complexity.

Wine Description

The Feudi di San Gregorio Rubrato 2022 is an exuberant, fresh, and beautifully balanced red wine that trades heavy wood extraction for pure varietal character and drinkability.

  • Appearance: An intense, brilliant ruby red with clear violet glints at the rim.

  • Nose: Strikingly fragrant and expressive. The bouquet opens with an enticing blend of wild black berries, dark sweet cherries, and crushed raspberries, layered gracefully with complex undertones of licorice, forest floor, walnuts, and a distinctive, cooling balsamic or mentholated finish.

  • Palate: Balanced, dense, and beautifully textured on the palate. The entry is dominated by flavors of sour cherry and wild blueberry flesh, which transition seamlessly into a spicy, savory mid-palate. Thanks to the absence of heavy oak, the tannins are incredibly silky and supple, supported by a vital, refreshing acidity that leaves the palate feeling clean, dry, and thoroughly refreshed.

  • Technical Details: 100% Aglianico. The grapes are sourced from estate parcels characterized by high-altitude volcanic soils in the Irpinia hills. The fruit is hand-harvested and undergoes fermentation and maceration in stainless steel tanks for approximately 2 to 3 weeks. To maintain pure fruit clarity and freshness, the wine is matured for 8 to 10 months completely in stainless steel vats, followed by an additional 6 months of refining in the bottle before release. The alcohol level sits at a well-balanced 13.5% ABV.

Accolades

The 2022 vintage has earned outstanding marks from international critics for its purity and exceptional quality-to-price ratio (QPR):

  • James Suckling: 92 Points. Praised for its "pretty aromas of blackberries and walnuts with hints of dried flowers... a solid core of fruit and a spicy finish. Love the intensity."

  • Gambero Rosso: 2 out of 3 Glasses (89/100).

  • Italian Wine Community: Highly celebrated as a textbook "weeknight hero" red, offering genuine volcanic complexity for an everyday price point.

Food Pairing

Because of its bright acidity, smooth tannins, and deep dark fruit profile, Rubrato is an elite pairing wine—particularly for traditional southern Italian cuisine. It is a spectacular match for eggplant parmigiana, lasagna, pasta with rich ragù sauce, or Campanian sartù di riso (a baked savory rice dome filled with meat and cheese). Its refreshing finish also allows it to cut cleanly through grilled or roasted white and red meats, and it pairs effortlessly with mature, semi-hard cheeses like Pecorino or Provolone.

Service Tip

To allow the wild berry and sweet licorice aromatics to completely open up, serve this wine at a slightly cool room temperature (between 16°C and 18°C) in a large, wide-bowled red wine glass. While it is drinking beautifully right now, it possesses the structural integrity to cellar and evolve gracefully over the next 4 to 5 years.

title: Argiolas Korem Isola Dei Nuraghi 2023
bodyHtml:
The Argiolas winery, located in Serdiana, Sardinia, is celebrated for its dedication to showcasing the island’s native grapes. 'Korem' is a more elegant counterpart to the winery's flagship 'Turriga' wine, and its label features an ancient Greek coin discovered in the Argiolas estate vineyards.

Wine Description

The wine presents a decisive and vibrant ruby red hue. The aromatic profile is complex and persistent, offering encompassing sensations of black cherry and cloves, which intermingle with notes of violet and pipe tobacco. Hints of blackberry, wild berries, graphite, dark chocolate, and leather may also be perceived.

Food Pairing

It is an excellent match for braised game meat and spicy cheeses. The 'Korem' also pairs well with meals that feature antipasti and pasta, such as semolina gnocchi with basil and pecorino or ravioli stuffed with chard and ricotta.

title: Isole E Olena Chianti Classico 2021
bodyHtml:
This complex red is produced by highly regarded winemaker and winery owner Paolo de Marchi, who has been upgrading his winery and vineyard for 40 years. Fermented with indigenous yeast, this dry red is aged for 12 months in 43-hectolitre and 23-hectolitre wooden vats followed by six months in bottle.

Look for ripe, darker fruit flavours of black cherry, strawberry, truffle, mushroom, leather and cedar in this medium-full bodied red with lots of acids and a long finish. A very lovely wine. Try it with wild boar ragu, beef stew or lamb chops.

title: Avignonesi Desiderio Toscana Merlot 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in the iconic region of Tuscany, Italy, this wine is a distinguished expression of the Toscana IGT. The Avignonesi estate, one of the most renowned in the region, passed into the hands of Belgian industrialist Virginie Saverys in 2008, who spearheaded a complete transformation toward organic and biodynamic viticulture. Named after 'Desiderio', a legendary bull that lived on the estate over a century ago and helped define the local Chianina cattle race, this wine reflects a winemaking philosophy centered on the natural balance between vine and soil.

Wine Description

This 100% Merlot displays an intense, deep ruby red colour with slight garnet reflections. The bouquet is explosive and complex, offering a wide array of aromas including cherry and plum jam, black tea, rhubarb, and graphite, with final touches of cardamom, liquorice, and dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is bursting and deep, characterized by the silky, linear tannins typical of a Tuscan Merlot. It is tastefully juicy, layering flavours of blackberries and blueberries with savoury notes of black pepper, coconut, and balsamic-tinged black cherries. This medium- to full-bodied red is well-structured and refined, with a long-lasting finish that highlights a persistent mineral vein. It is best enjoyed from 2026 through 2037.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 93 points

  • Vinous - 92 points

  • Wine Spectator - 91 points

title: Santadi Grotta Rossa Carignano Del Sulcis 2021
bodyHtml: 100% Carignano. Santadi Carignano del Sulcis “Grotta Rossa” DOC has an intense crimson color, lovely, fruity bouquet with a licorice finish, elegant palate, good depth, structure and texture.

title: Ricasoli Chianti Classico Riserva Rocca Guiciarda 2022
bodyHtml: Intense ruby red color. On the nose aromas of cherries, apricot with oaky notes. Excellent entry on the palate, well-balanced structure. Persistent and fragrant finish.  Blend: 90% Sangiovese, 5% Merlot, 5% Canaiolo.

title: Luigi Einaudi Dolcetto di Dogliani 2023
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1897 by Luigi Einaudi, who later became Italy's second president, Poderi Luigi Einaudi is one of the most historic and respected estates in the Dogliani region. The winery is renowned for its dedication to traditional Piedmontese varietals, particularly Dolcetto, and for producing wines that reflect the unique terroir of the Langhe hills.

Wine Description

The 2023 Luigi Einaudi Dolcetto di Dogliani is a vibrant expression of the Dolcetto grape. It displays a deep ruby red colour with violet hues. On the nose, it offers fresh aromas of raspberry, cherry, and wild strawberry, complemented by subtle notes of underbrush and a hint of almond. The palate is medium-bodied and dry, featuring juicy red fruit flavours, lively acidity, and soft tannins that lead to a pleasantly lingering finish with a characteristic almond note. This wine is crafted from 100% Dolcetto grapes sourced from estate vineyards surrounding the village of Dogliani, situated on calcareous marl and clay soils with south to southwest exposures. Fermentation occurs in stainless steel tanks at controlled temperatures, followed by malolactic fermentation and a brief period of ageing before release.

title: Felsina Chianti Classico Berardenga 2021
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1966, Fèlsina is a benchmark estate located in the southern part of the Chianti Classico zone, near Castelnuovo Berardenga. Under the stewardship of Giuseppe Mazzocolin and winemaker Franco Bernabei, the winery has become renowned for crafting ageworthy and expressive Sangiovese wines that capture the spirit of Tuscan tradition and terroir.

Wine Description

The 2021 Felsina Chianti Classico Berardenga pours a vibrant ruby red with garnet hues at the rim. Aromas of wild red berries, sour cherry, dried rose petals, and subtle spice leap from the glass, followed by earthy tones of leather and forest floor. On the palate, it is medium bodied and energetic, with finely structured tannins, bright acidity, and layered notes of raspberry, cassis, cinnamon, and tobacco.

Food Pairing

Enjoy this classic Tuscan red with rich pasta dishes such as pappardelle al cinghiale, grilled steak, or aged pecorino cheese.

title: Marcarini Barbera D'Alba Ciabot Camerano 2022
bodyHtml:
Marcarini, a historic winery located in La Morra within Italy's Piedmont region, has been producing esteemed wines for six generations. Their dedication to traditional winemaking techniques and the unique terroir of the Langhe area is evident in their offerings.

Wine Description

The 2022 Barbera d'Alba "Ciabot Camerano" is crafted from the Barbera grape, an ancient indigenous variety of southwestern Piedmont. This wine presents an intense garnet color with warm ruby-red reflections, indicating its richness and robust structure. The bouquet is characteristic, complex, and persistent, offering aromas of ripe red fruits and subtle spicy notes. On the palate, it is austere and warm, with a considerable full body, balanced acidity, and a harmonious finish.

Food Pairing

This Barbera pairs wonderfully with rich pasta dishes, roasted meats, and aged cheeses. Its balanced acidity and full body complement hearty meals.

title: Paolo Conterno Barolo Ginestra 2020
bodyHtml:
Dark garnet colour. Elegant and harmonious in the aromas with persistent fruity, spicy, balsamic and mineral notes. Warm and strong body, balanced in flavours and powerful in aromas. Long and intense finish. It lends itself to long aging even for more than fifteen years.

Pairings: roast veal, rib of beef in Barolo wine, aged cheeses.

title: Paolo Conterno Barbera d'Asti Bricco 2022
bodyHtml: Deep ruby red. Shows excellent finesse and elegance, with appealing hints of spices and fresh red fruit, such as cherry and cranberry. Very attractive taste, soft and structured, with the refreshing, tangy acidity that’s typical of the variety. Enjoy with hot and spicy hors-d’oeuvres and appetizers, and white meats.

title: Braida Il Baciale 2020
bodyHtml: Il Bacialé ”, in Piedmont dialect means the matchmaker and describes the person who arranged marriages between members of noble families in the area. This wine in fact originates from the perfect marriage of Barbera and other grape varieties. Strong punch of black fruit with a smooth finish. Pairs excellently with red meat, especially a fine steak!

title: Enzo Boglietti Barbera d'Alba 2024
bodyHtml: Brilliant ruby red with purple nails. The nose is intense with notes of red and dark fruit and spices. The palate reveals an outstanding balance between fruit aromas and savory notes. It has excellent drinking, elegance, and fine tannins, and is simultaneously silky and sharp.

title: Enzo Boglietti Langhe Nebbiolo 2024
bodyHtml:
The Enzo Boglietti Langhe Nebbiolo is a distinguished red wine hailing from the renowned La Morra region in Piedmont, Italy. Crafted entirely from 100% Nebbiolo grapes, this wine reflects the rich heritage and meticulous winemaking practices of the Boglietti family. The vineyards are situated with east to southeast exposures, thriving in silty clay soils interspersed with limestone and rocky patches, contributing to the wine's unique character.

Sensory Profile

In the glass, the Langhe Nebbiolo presents a ruby red hue of medium intensity. The nose is greeted with delicate aromas of cherries, floral notes, and subtle spices. On the palate, it offers a harmonious balance, showcasing clear flavors of red fruits and flowers, supported by fine tannins and a refreshing acidity.

Food Pairing

This Nebbiolo pairs exceptionally well with dishes such as beef, lamb, poultry, and game meats like venison or chamois. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character, creating a memorable dining experience.

title: Corte Sant'Alda Ca' Fiui Valpolicella 2021
bodyHtml: Ca’ Fiui is a hillside place known since Antiquity where, amidst vines and olive trees, Corte Sant’Alda has set up its cellar. Sunny, well-exposed vineyards produce well-ripened grapes ensuring the body and equilibrium for this impressive Valpolicella. All their grapes have organic certification and in recent years the vineyards have been managed on the basis of biodynamic agriculture principles. The harvest, in keeping with tradition, is performed entirely by hand in early October. Fermentation takes place in oak vats and is spontaneous (native yeasts); rack and return, manual wine-crushing, malolactic fermentation and retention of this wine in fermentation vats for at least six months all ensure excellent complexity where spices and austerity prevail over fruit.

title: Altesino Rosso Toscana 2024
bodyHtml:
Altesino Rosso Toscana is a red wine from Italy, produced in the Tuscany region and the Montalcino subregion. Altesino is one of Montalcino's most famous Brunello producers. The winery was a pioneer in the region, being the first to introduce the 'Cru' concept in 1975, the first to experiment with barriques in 1979, and the first to release Brunello futures in 1985. The winery's philosophy combines an essential respect for tradition with a forward-looking perspective, resulting in wines that retain the unique and high quality reputation of Brunello.

Wine Description

The wine presents itself in a lively ruby red or purple red colour. The aromatic profile is fresh and very fragrant, with hints of violets and wild berries. Specific aromas include ripe red and blue fruit, touches of black olives, and notes of minerals and stones.

The varietal composition is predominantly Sangiovese, blended with Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. Sources indicate the blend is 80% Sangiovese, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 10% Merlot. It is a medium bodied wine. The flavour is dry, spicy, sapid, and decisive, with persuasive drinkability. The palate is smooth and juicy, with lively fruit in the middle. Stylistically, it is balanced and focused, crafted for accessibility and ready to be enjoyed upon release. The wine is matured for six to eight months in stainless steel tanks. The ABV is 13.0%. The optimal drinking window extends past 2029. Information on the organic status of the wine is not available in the sources.

Food Pairing

This Rosso Toscana is a wonderful everyday wine that is perfect for pasta dishes with meat sauces. It is also recommended with roasted white meats, poultry, or barbecued chorizo and other sausages.

title: Altesino Alte D'Altesi 2018
bodyHtml: This wine shows an intense purple red colour. It has pleasant, refined and elegant aromas that start with hints of black cherry, plum and blackberry followed by aromas of black currant, violet, vanilla and hints of menthol and clove. Full flavour and well balanced by alcohol, a rich body and elegant tannins.

title: Altesino Brunello di Montalcino 2021
bodyHtml:
Altesino Brunello di Montalcino originates from Italy, within the Tuscany region and the prestigious Brunello di Montalcino DOCG appellation. Housed in the historic 14th-century Palazzo Altesi, the estate has long been recognized as an innovator in Montalcino, famous for pioneering the single-vineyard concept in the region (cru Montosoli) in 1975. The estate controls approximately 50 hectares of prime vineyards spread across varied microclimates in the northern, eastern, and southern sectors of Montalcino. Altesino’s winemaking philosophy blends respect for traditional Sangiovese purity with modern refinement, utilizing a combination of large Slavonian oak barrels (botti) and French oak to craft a flagship Brunello lauded for its aromatic elegance, structural finesse, and long-term aging potential.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep, luminous ruby-garnet appearance in the glass, developing subtle amber reflections near the rim as it ages. It possesses a full-bodied, highly refined, and well-proportioned structure defined by a silky, mouth-coating, and supple texture. The sensory profile is classic, fragrant, and multi-layered, opening with an inviting bouquet of wild red cherries, crushed plums, and ripe raspberries, interwoven with complex secondary notes of dried violets, tobacco leaf, leather, Mediterranean herbs, sweet spices, and crushed stone minerality. On the palate, it delivers an energetic core of vibrant red fruit supported by a fine thread of natural acidity and polished, fine-grained tannins. The finish is long, clean, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of licorice, dark cocoa, and savory herbs.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Sangiovese (locally known as Brunello).

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes are hand-harvested from several estate vineyards to create a complete and balanced regional expression. Fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel vats. Per DOCG regulations, the wine ages for a minimum of two years in oak casks—utilizing traditional 50-to-100-hectoliter Slavonian oak botti alongside smaller French oak barrels—followed by at least four months of bottle aging prior to release.

  • ABV: Typically 14.0% to 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The vibrant natural acidity, firm tannic structure, and complex savory-fruit profile of Altesino Brunello di Montalcino make it an exceptional match for rich, savory Italian and classic global gastronomy.

  • Fine Meats: Pairs magnificently with Bistecca alla Fiorentina (grilled T-bone steak), roasted rack of lamb with rosemary, pan-seared duck breast, or braised beef short ribs.

  • Game: Ideal when served alongside wild boar ragù (ragù di cinghiale), venison tenderloin, or roasted pheasant.

  • Earthy Specialties: Complements mushroom risottos, pasta tossed with fresh black truffles, and hearty Tuscan bean or vegetable stews cooked with herbs.

  • Aged Cheeses: Matches gracefully with mature, firm cheeses such as Pecorino Toscano, Parmigiano-Reggiano, or 24-month Comté.

title: Carpineto Chianti Classico Riserva 2020
bodyHtml:
#25 Wine Spectator Top 100 2025

Carpineto Chianti Classico Riserva originates from Italy, specifically from the Tuscany region and the Chianti Classico subregion. Co-founded in 1967 by Giovanni Carlo Sacchet and Antonio Mario Zaccheo, the winery was established with a mission to produce world-class red wines that could restore the region's historical prestige. The estate follows a winemaking philosophy that marries modern viticulture with deep respect for Tuscan values, maintaining carbon-neutral estates and focusing on high-quality, sustainably farmed fruit.

Wine Description

This wine presents an intense ruby red colour with garnet reflections that develop further as it ages. The sensory profile is elegant and 'beefy', featuring a complex nose of black cherry, blackberry, and raspberry, interwoven with notes of vanilla, wild herbs, iron, and earth. On the full-bodied and warm palate, it delivers a dense texture with concentrated flavours of dark fruits and muscular tannins. The finish is remarkably long, spicy, and persistent.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional blend of 80% Sangiovese and 20% Canaiolo.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its classic elegance and tightly woven balance between fruit, tannins, and acidity, showing excellent aging potential through 2043.

  • ABV: Recorded at 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: While not specifically certified organic, the wine is produced from sustainably farmed, carbon-neutral estates following eco-friendly production codes.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and savory depth of this Riserva make it a versatile partner for rich and flavourful dishes. Suggested pairings include grilled red meats, Bistecca alla Fiorentina (Florentine-style steak), roast lamb with rosemary, and wild boar stews. It also complements traditional Italian preparations like lasagna, hearty pasta with meat sauce, and aged cheeses such as Pecorino Toscano or Parmigiano Reggiano.

title: Massolino Langhe Nebbiolo 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Piedmont region, specifically within the Langhe DOC appellation, Massolino Langhe Nebbiolo represents an exceptionally pure, elegant, and aristocratic expression of Nebbiolo. Founded in 1896 by Giovanni Massolino in Serralunga d'Alba, the estate is renowned for its benchmark Barolos. This Langhe Nebbiolo is crafted from a thoughtful blend of estate fruit in Serralunga d'Alba, combined with parcels in Monforte d'Alba and Alba planted on chalky limestone and sandy-clay soils. The winemaking philosophy involves gentle extraction, temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats, and maturation in large traditional Slavonian oak casks for over a year. The result is a wine that bridges the structural elegance of Barolo with early-drinking charm and vibrant red fruit freshness.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, luminous pale ruby red colour with bright garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of wild strawberry, tart red cherry, raspberry coulis, and blood orange, interwoven with subtle notes of crushed rose petals, pipe tobacco, cedar, dried anise, and sweet spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, silky, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of fresh red berries, cherry curd, and saline mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by fine, chalky, seamlessly integrated tannins and a harmonious mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruit, subtle graphite minerality, and a clean limestone grip. Composed of 100% Nebbiolo, it offers a refined profile with impressive aging capability over several years. Stylistically, it combines Serralunga's structural nobility with high-altitude floral aromatics and effortless drinking pleasure.

title: Geppetti Poggio Valente 2022
bodyHtml:
Fattoria Le Pupille Poggio Valente originates from Italy, specifically within the Morellino di Scansano subregion of Tuscany. Often referred to as the 'Lady of Morellino', Elisabetta Geppetti has spearheaded the winery since the late 1970s, transforming it from a small family farm into a benchmark estate of the Maremma region. Her winemaking philosophy centers on expressing the unique voice of the Sangiovese grape through meticulous vineyard management and a shift toward using larger oak 'botte' to preserve fruit purity.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep and luminous ruby red hue. The nose is complex and intense, offering a Mediterranean-influenced aromatic profile of tart cherry, pomegranate, and myrtle, layered with notes of blue flower, lavender, and crushed stone. On the palate, it is full bodied and compact, displaying a sleek structure with firm yet refined, open-grained tannins.

title: Pieropan Amarone della Valpolicella Riserva 2018
bodyHtml: Full bodied and on the sweeter side of the scale, this Amarone smells of tobacco and smoke, red fruits, vanilla and toast. Nice long finish with smooth, well integrated tannins.

title: Rocca Delle Macie Sasyr 2023
bodyHtml: Sasyr is a highly quaffable wine that is fruity and polished on the palate, with no sharp edges. Well-rounded, sinuous, and immensely drinkable. It has character and personality, making for a complete, well-balanced wine. Sasyr is a very versatile wine that works well with all manner of dishes, but is also very pleasant on its own, accompanied only by some great music.

title: Antinori Chianti Classico Peppoli 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in the heart of Italy, this wine hails from the renowned Chianti Classico region of Tuscany. The Antinori family has a storied winemaking heritage spanning 26 generations and over 600 years, having officially joined the Florentine Vintners' Guild in 1385. The historic Pèppoli estate, where vineyards have existed since the Middle Ages, reflects a philosophy of crafting approachable, fruit forward wines that authentically represent the local terroir.

Wine Description

Pèppoli displays a bright ruby red colour. The nose is vibrant and expressive, featuring fresh notes of cherries, raspberry jelly, and pomegranate juice, complemented by floral hints of violets and geraniums. On the palate, the wine is lively and dynamic with a juicy mid-palate and an energetic entry. It is medium bodied with soft, sweet tannins and a long, savory finish.

Food Pairing

This versatile Chianti Classico is ideally suited for classic Italian fare such as pasta with Bolognese sauce, homemade pizza, or lasagna. It also pairs exceptionally well with grilled vegetables and cured meats.

title: Toscolo Chianti Classico 2022
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy, within the renowned Tuscany region, Toscolo Chianti Classico 2022 hails from the heart of the Chianti Classico subregion. The winery was established in 1990 by Neil and Maria Empson, representing a 'labour of love' born from their long-standing passion for the Tuscan landscape. Under the guidance of star oenologist Franco Bernabei, the winemaking philosophy focuses on sourcing fruit from a cross-section of the region's finest vineyards to create wines that capture the authentic spirit of Tuscany.

Wine Description

This wine presents a brilliant ruby colour and opens with an elegant bouquet featuring notes of violets, iris, and vibrant berry fruit. On the palate, it is supple and well balanced, showing a medium body with flavors of tart cranberries, rose hips, and tangerine peel, complemented by savory undertones of thyme and dried meats. The structure is defined by fine grained tannins and a refreshing acidity that leads into a clean, harmonious finish.

title: Pasqua Valpolicella Ripasso Superiore 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the Valpolicella region in the province of Verona. The Pasqua family established the winery in 1925, starting as wine traders before the brothers began crafting their own labels. Celebrating its 100th anniversary in 2025, the estate is one of Italy's largest family owned brands and maintains a philosophy of innovative research and international expansion.

Wine Description

Pasqua Valpolicella Ripasso Superiore displays an intense ruby red or deep garnet colour. The nose is assertive, featuring aromas of Morello cherry, blueberries, and redcurrants, complemented by secondary notes of mocha, licorice, and toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and velvety, with rich flavours of plum, strawberry, and dark chocolate. It is characterized by its smooth balance, soft tannins, and persistent finish that reveals complex roasted hints. The typical varietal composition includes 60% Corvina, 20% Rondinella, 10% Corvinone, and 10% Negrara. This wine has an ABV of 13.5% and, in some specific vineyard selections like Cascina S. Vincenzo, the grapes are organically grown.

Food Pairing

The structured and savory profile of this Ripasso makes it an excellent companion for hearty meat dishes. It pairs perfectly with braised lamb, grilled ribeye steaks, or beef kebabs. Its fruit forward character also complements wild mushroom risotto, pasta with rich meat sauces or lasagna, and aged hard cheeses like Parmigiano Reggiano.

title: Poliziano Nobile di Montepulciano 2022
bodyHtml: Vino Nobile di Montepulciano is the principal wine of Poliziano. Revered by nobility through the centuries, Vino Nobile was often hailed as "the wine of kings." Today, Vino Noble is still considered to be special, thanks to the Prugnolo Gentile clone of Sangiovese that is grown in the Montepulciano area. Poliziano uses 85% Prugnolo Gentile in their blend, along with two traditional Tuscan varieties, Colorino and Canaiolo, and a bit of Merlot. The complementary varieties add colour, depth, and complexity to the elegance of the Sangiovese.

title: Rivera Il Falcone Riserva 2020
bodyHtml:
Produced in Italy, this distinguished red originates from the Castel del Monte DOCG within the Puglia region. Founded by Sebastiano de Corato in the late 1940s, the Rivera winery was established with a vision to showcase the viticultural potential of the Murgia hills. Now managed by the third generation of the de Corato family, the estate remains a benchmark for the region, focusing on a winemaking philosophy that balances local traditions with elegant, international quality.

Wine Description

This wine presents a dense garnet red colour and a multi-layered bouquet featuring ripe wild red berry fruit, leather, pipe tobacco, and warm spices. The palate is rich and austere, displaying a full body with robust tannins and mineral tension that lead into a long, well-balanced finish.

title: Argiano Rosso Di Montalcino 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Montalcino region of Tuscany, Italy, Argiano is a viticultural institution with history dating back to 1580. Under the leadership of CEO and winemaker Bernardino Sani, the estate follows a 'Janus-like' philosophy that honours its four-century heritage while embracing organic-regenerative viticulture and minimal-intervention winemaking.

Wine Description

This 100% Sangiovese presents a lively ruby red colour with a sensory profile defined by its freshness and elegance. The nose offers enticing aromas of red cherry, wild berries, and violets, layered with subtle notes of Mediterranean scrub, spice, and a hint of smoke. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and direct, featuring juicy red fruit, saltiness, and a piercing mineral vein. It is well-balanced with integrated, chalky tannins and a clean, lingering finish showing hints of herbs and tobacco.

Food Pairing

The wine's bright acidity and savoury earthiness make it an excellent companion for pasta with tomato-based sauces, roasted meats such as veal or grilled poultry, and aged cheeses. It also pairs exceptionally well with classic Italian bruschetta.

title: La Braccesca Rosso Di Montepulciano 'Sabazio' 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in the heart of Tuscany, Italy, within the Rosso di Montepulciano appellation, this wine is a testament to the storied heritage of the Marchesi Antinori family, who acquired the La Braccesca estate in 1990. The winery spans over 1,250 acres across Montepulciano and Cortona, focusing on a philosophy that balances the historical tradition of the region with modern winemaking techniques.

Wine Description

Sabazio presents a vibrant ruby red colour and opens with an expressive bouquet of fresh red fruits, notably cherries and raspberries, complemented by floral hints of violets and subtle balsamic sensations. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and smooth, featuring a juicy, crunchy core supported by silky tannins and a bright acidity that lends a refreshing character. The finish is persistent and savoury, echoing the fruity and floral notes found on the nose.

Food Pairing

This wine serves as an ideal companion for Tuscan-style cured meats, pasta with meat sauce, or herb-roasted chicken. For a more adventurous pairing, try it with stuffed bell peppers or veal liver with balsamic vinegar, as these dishes beautifully enhance the wine's vibrant fruit and acidity.

title: Frescobaldi Chianti Castiglioni 2024
bodyHtml:
Castiglioni Chianti has a beautiful, vibrant ruby-red color. On the nose, it is fruity, with hints of berries, such as cranberry and blackberry, currant and strawberry tree. It also has a pleasant floral note, reminding us of dog rose and violet. A delicate spiciness follows. On the palate, it is very lively and at the same time soft and elegant. The fruity notes return to the palate giving a rich and satisfying finish. This wine has a distinct but smooth tannic texture.

91 Points - James Suckling

A delicious, juicy and well-rounded Chianti with aromas of strawberries, red currants and some forest berries. Medium-bodied with soft tannins. Mellow and fruit-driven with a satisfying finish.

title: Masi Modello Merlot 2021
bodyHtml: The Masi Modello red wine has fresh aromas of liquorice and fruity blackberries and raspberries. Similar, well-balanced flavours are supported by lively acidity in this easy-to-drink wine. Pair with various dishes (soups, pasta and risottos), as well as simple and substantial red-meat dishes or fresh cheeses.

title: Vignamaggio Monna Lisa Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2017
bodyHtml: The wine is only produced in the best vintage years, with grapes from the farm's prime southwest grape growing areas. It is a deep ruby red color. The aroma is very intense, persistent, delicate, with hints of tobacco, oak, and berries. A full, long, warm mouth feel.

title: Lucente Toscana 2022
bodyHtml:
Lucente Toscana originates from the Tuscany region of Italy, specifically from the high-elevation vineyards of Montalcino. The estate, Tenuta Luce, was founded in 1993 as a visionary partnership between the Frescobaldi family and Robert Mondavi, aiming to create a unique expression of Montalcino terroir. This winemaking philosophy focuses on the harmony between the structure of Sangiovese and the roundness of Merlot, reflecting the 'light of the vine' through meticulous vineyard management.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep ruby red colour. The nose is intense and expressive, offering a bouquet of blackberry, pomegranate, and Parma violets, underscored by subtle notes of cedar, toasted vanilla, and spice. On the palate, Lucente is broad and enveloping, featuring a medium to full body with ripe cherry and wild berry flavours balanced by a savoury freshness. The tannins are finely integrated and silky, leading to a long, vibrant finish with a hint of chocolate.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling - 94 points."

  • "Wine Spectator - 90 points."

  • "Wine Advocate - 90 points."

Food Pairing

Lucente Toscana pairs exceptionally well with hearty dishes such as grilled ribeye, wild boar ragu, or roasted lamb. Its structural balance also makes it an excellent companion for truffle pasta, pizza, or aged Pecorino Toscano.

title: Mazzei Chianti Classico Gran Selezione Castello Fonterutoli 2019
bodyHtml:
Mazzei Castello Fonterutoli Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2019 exhibits an intense and profound colour. On the nose, it reveals distinct aromas of blackberries, cherries, violets, and flowers, with a hint of nougat. On the palate, it is a full-bodied wine with a captivating sweetness and smooth tannins. Its flavour is intense and concentrated, delighting the senses. The finish is long and full of elegance, leaving a lasting and sophisticated impression.                      

Beautiful combination of elegance, structure and minerality, with orange peel, red fruits and a touch of licorice. 

Pair with savory game dishes, stews, truffles and aged, strong tasting cheeses.

title: Fantini Sangiovese 2024
bodyHtml: The ever-popular Fantini Sangiovese is the epitome of everyday enjoyability. Expressive ripe fruit, supple tannins, and well-balanced acidity contribute to an inviting and versatile wine, making it an easy choice any night of the week. Serve it alongside braised meat dishes or with tomato-based pasta dishes.

title: Travaglini Gattinara 2021
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Piedmont region of northern Italy, this wine originates from the historic Gattinara appellation. Established in the 1920s by Clemente Travaglini, the winery remains a family-run estate known for its commitment to traditional winemaking and its iconic, curved bottle designed to naturally trap sediment. The family focuses on expressing the unique volcanic soils of the region through the Nebbiolo grape, creating wines that balance power with elegance.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo presents a bright ruby red colour with delicate garnet reflections. The aromatic profile is complex and refined, offering notes of rose petals, violets, and wild strawberries alongside deeper hints of licorice, leather, and stony minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with a racy acidity and firm, noble tannins that provide a sophisticated structure. Flavours of cherry and raspberry are complemented by subtle spicy and balsamic undertones, leading to a long, savory finish.

title: Castellare Chianti Classico Riserva 2023
bodyHtml: This wine is bright ruby red in colour with purple highlights. Thanks to the harmony of the tannins, combined with the delicate complexity of aromas and the final note of sweetness, it has an excellent balance in the mouth. A very versatile wine, ideally paired with structured main dishes. It also goes well with stewed dishes and medium-aged cheeses.

title: Masi Amarone Serego Alighieri Vaio 2017
bodyHtml: An elegant, impeccably balanced red, layering sculpted tannins with finely knit flavors of plumped black cherry, plum sauce, cured tobacco, dark chocolate and woodsy spice. A rich vein of smoky minerality sings on the lasting finish.

title: Vicchiomaggio Ripa Delle More 2022
bodyHtml:
Vicchiomaggio Ripa Delle More originates from the Greve in Chianti subregion of Tuscany, Italy. The wine is produced by Castello Vicchiomaggio, a historic estate spanning 140 hectares that has been meticulously managed by the Matta family. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on a dedication to tradition and the expression of their unique Mediterranean climate and south-facing vineyards.

Wine Description

This Super Tuscan presents an impenetrable ruby red colour with a violet rim. The intense bouquet offers an ample profile of mint, blackcurrant, and blueberry, layered with dark chocolate, juniper, and toasted coffee. On the palate, the wine is full, enveloping, and vigorous, featuring silky, polished tannins and a long-lasting finish.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs exceptionally well with grilled meats, particularly roast lamb seasoned with rosemary or a classic Bistecca alla Fiorentina. It also complements rich, tomato-based dishes such as wild boar ragu served over pappardelle.

title: Folonari Ripasso della Valpolicella Classico Superiore 2021
bodyHtml:
Folonari was founded in 1825 in the Veneto region of northeast Italy by Francesco Folonari. From the very beginning, the founders wanted to create exceptional wines for everyday occasions.  Nearly two centuries later, Folonari is enjoyed around the world. The wines are celebrated for their easy-drinking and fruit-forward personalities.

The Folonari lion symbol on our labels conveys the unique spirit of the brand. Inspired by the original lion illustration from the Veneto flag with a fresh twist to the Lion of St. Mark, it boldly celebrates the history of the brand paying homage to its origins.

Light to medium ruby colour; intense spicy bouquet, cassis, chestnut and cedar flavours; dry, medium bodied, smooth, nutty, spicy berry flavors; well balanced, rich, dry finish

title: Mastrojanni Toscana San Pio 2021
bodyHtml: San Pio is a hearty and approachable red wine that would taste great next to a succulent cut of beef. The wine ages in oak for 18 months and consequently delivers a full offering of aromas that spans from bright cherry fruit to exotic spice. There are some budding tertiary tones of cola and crushed mineral as well that add complexity. The finish is firm and long-lasting.

title: Marchesi di Barolo 'Barolo' 2021
