bodyHtml: This classic Piedmont house created Barolo's famed wine as we know it today. Their large estate located in the village of Barolo encompasses some of the finest vineyards in the region. Their Classici Barolo is made for earlier consumption than some of their other Barolos. Fruit selection comes from a wide range of their vineyards around the town of Barolo.

title: Marchesi di Barolo Dolcetto d'Alba BOSSET 2023
bodyHtml:
"Bosset" Dolcetto d'Alba by Marchesi di Barolo is the daily red par excellence from the Piedmont people. Vinified in steel vats and aged in vitrified concrete tanks, it is characterized by a fruity and vinous olfactory bouquet, with cherry, aromatic herbs and raspberry in the foreground. The sip is animated by rusticity and freshness, dry, refreshing and harmonious.

Ruby red with purple nuance. Vinous and fruity with cherry and raspberry tones and aromatic herbs. Dry, refreshing and pleasant with a sapid and fruity closure.

Delicious with the whole meal. Because of its freshness, combined with its good body and fragrant harmony, it is an ideal accompaniment for hors d'oeuvres, delicate first courses, soups, tasty dishes and fresh cheeses as well.

title: San Felice Brunello di Montalcino 'Campogiovanni' 2021
bodyHtml: Deep ruby red. Offers up aromas of well-ripened wild berries, blackberry preserves, tobacco leaf, and tanned leather. An expansive, generous palate displays a rich mouthfeel, developing into a lengthy finale marked by fruit liqueur. Pairs perfectly with a wide range of meats, particularly game and boar, and with aged pecorino cheese.

title: Maculan Brentino Merlot - Cabernet 2022
bodyHtml: An uber-classic Italian blend, elegant and juicy simultaneously, offering ripe berry and cherry aromas, followed by notes of fresh spices and light toast. It finishes dry, with balanced acidity and firm tannins. Perfect for pasta with wild boar ragout or roasted game.

title: Zenato Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico 2020
bodyHtml:
Amarone della Valpolicella has exploded in the wine world as wine lovers are falling head-over-heals for this opulent, flavourful, high alcohol red wine. Canadians are at the top of that list, importing more Amarone than anywhere else in the world!

The Zenato winery possesses a strong link to the richness of its local history and culture, and continues to develop this connection today. The estate is based in a territory that surrounds Lake Garda, with an extraordinary microclimate that allows for an optimal growing season. Cherishing a ‘frank and simple’ approach to life, Zenato is committed to producing affordable wine of exceptional quality. 

From a quality-focused family winery, this is big and powerful, even for an Amarone. Rich and plush-textured with luscious chocolate, liquorice, prune, nutty and floral flavours. Demands a hearty meal such as barbecued back ribs, rack of lamb or steak.

title: Zenato Valpolicella 2022
bodyHtml:
Zenato Valpolicella Superiore originates from Italy, within the Veneto region and the historic Valpolicella Classico zone situated in the hills north of Verona. Founded in 1960 by Sergio Zenato, the family estate—now directed by his children, Alberto and Nadia—controls roughly 95 hectares across top terroirs in both Lugana and Valpolicella. Operating with a philosophy rooted in the expression of indigenous Venetian grape varieties, Zenato crafts its Valpolicella Superiore from select hillside plots near Sant'Ambrogio. The winemaking approach balances the bright, vibrant fruit character of Corvina with traditional oak maturation, yielding a wine renowned for its structural harmony, versatility, and classical Venetian charm.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a luminous, deep ruby-red appearance in the glass with vivid purple and garnet reflections. It possesses a medium-bodied, supple, and well-balanced structure framed by a silky, mouth-coating texture. The sensory profile is highly aromatic and fruit-driven, opening with an inviting bouquet of fresh red cherries, wild raspberries, and red plums, seamlessly interwoven with subtle notes of crushed violet blossoms, black pepper, tobacco leaf, and toasted almond. On the palate, it delivers a lively, concentrated core of bright red fruits, supported by a line of refreshing natural acidity and fine-grained, smooth tannins. The finish is clean, harmonious, and persistent, leaving lingering echoes of red berry fruit, cocoa, and gentle oak spice.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically 80% Corvina, 10% Rondinella, and 10% Oseleta.

  • Stylistic Notes: Hand-harvested from select hillside vineyards in the Valpolicella Classica zone. Following temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel vats with systematic pumping over to extract color and soft tannins, the wine undergoes aging for approximately 12 months in large traditional Slavonian oak casks (botti), followed by bottle maturation prior to release.

  • ABV: Typically 13.5%.

title: Marchesi di Barolo Barbera D'Alba Peiragal 2022
bodyHtml: Aromas suggesting black-skinned berry, vanilla and a lightly toasted note lift out of the glass. On the palate, fine-grained tannins lightly support black currant, powdered sage, white pepper and a hint of oak.

title: Antinori Badia A Passignano Chianti Classico Gran Selezione 2021
bodyHtml:
The Antinori family has been committed to the art of winemaking for over six centuries since 1385 when Giovanni di Piero Antinori became a member of the "Arte Fiorentina dei Vinattieri," the Florentine Winemaker's Guild. Throughout its twenty-six generations, the Antinori family has managed the business directly, making innovative and sometimes bold decisions while upholding the utmost respect for traditions and the environment.

Today, Albiera Antinori is the president of Marchesi Antinori with the continuous close support of her two sisters, Allegra and Alessia, all actively involved in first person in the business. Their father, Marchese Piero Antinori, is the current Honorary President of the company. Tradition, passion, and intuition drove Marchesi Antinori to establish itself as one of the most important winemakers of elite Italian wine. The company is one of the Founding Members of the "Associazione Marchi Storici d'Italia," an association for protecting, supporting and promoting Italian historical brands.

title: Carpineto Vino Nobile Di Montepulciano Riserva 2020
bodyHtml:
This classic red wine hails from Italy, specifically Tuscany’s Montepulciano region, one of the most historic areas for producing noble wines. Carpineto was established in 1967 by Giovanni Carlo Sacchet and Antonio Mario Zaccheo with the goal of producing modern, world-class wines from traditional Tuscan varietals. Today, Carpineto is recognized for its sustainability efforts and unwavering commitment to quality across its five estates.

Wine Description
Vino Nobile Di Montepulciano Riserva presents a deep ruby red hue, with garnet reflections indicating its careful aging. On the nose, it offers an elegant bouquet of ripe cherries, dried plums, violet, and subtle notes of tobacco and spice. The palate is full-bodied and refined, with layers of dark berry fruit, earthy undertones, and a hint of balsamic. Firm yet polished tannins provide structure, while vibrant acidity ensures a long and balanced finish. Crafted predominantly from Sangiovese (locally known as Prugnolo Gentile), it may include small amounts of complementary varietals. Best enjoyed between 2025 and 2034, this Riserva reflects both the tradition and finesse of Carpineto’s winemaking.

Food Pairing
Ideal with rich, hearty dishes such as osso buco, wild boar ragù over pappardelle, or aged pecorino cheese. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Carpineto Cabernet Sauvignon Farnito 2020
bodyHtml: On the nose, it expresses complex yet clean aromas of black fruits, spices, licorice, vanilla, and cherry. it is full-bodied, rich, and persistent, with elegant tannins and a structured finish. Ideal to accompany grilled steaks, roasted rack of lamb, or lamb chops. It is also excellent with aged Tuscan cheeses.

title: Banfi Col Di Sasso 2024
bodyHtml: An intense ruby-red, with purple hues. Black cherry and spice aromas. Rich taste with soft tannins, delivering persistent black-fruit flavors and subtle hints of smoke, with a lingering finish.

title: Illuminati Riparosso 2022
bodyHtml: Bright aromas of ripe red cherry and blackberry blend with accents of cinnamon, clove and chopped herbs. It's supple in feel on the palate, driven by juicy berry flavours and supported by soft, rounded tannins. It's an enjoyable entry level wine to the Montepulciano variety.

title: Rocca Delle Macie Chianti Classico 2023
bodyHtml: Young by Italian standards, this winery was founded in 1973 - so it's no wonder their take on Chianti Classico is modern. Food-friendly with floral, red plum, cedar and licorice notes with a chestnut element. It sings with fine fare like meat lasagna, antipasti or veal scaloppini.

title: Maculan Cabernet Sauvignon Palazzotto Di Breganze 2021
bodyHtml: "Palazzotto" by Maculan is an intense and full-bodied red wine coming from the Breganze area, in the Veneto province of Vicenza. Aged for 12 months in new and used barriques and expresses aromas of licorice, blackberries and ripe fruit well ripe, revealing a full and balanced mouthfeel, supported by dense tannins.

title: Banfi Centine Rosso 2020
bodyHtml:
Intense ruby red. Bouquet is fragrant, with dark fruit and floral nuances. Medium-bodied, with black cherry and plum flavors and hints of spice.

Ideal with a wide range of dishes such as roasts, game, pastas and cheese.

title: Rocca Delle Macie Chianti Riserva 2021
bodyHtml: One of Italy's most famously food-friendly red wines, Chianti is a welcome guest at any table. This wine shows layers of sour cherry, chestnut, smoke, leather and chestnut. A brilliant choice with eggplant parmigiana sandwiches or grilled beef and mushroom kebabs.

title: Masi Bonacosta Valpolicella Classico 2024
bodyHtml:
Masi Bonacosta Valpolicella Classico originates from the Veneto region of Italy, specifically within the historical Valpolicella Classico subregion. The Masi winery is a family-run business with a history dating back to 1772, when the Boscaini family acquired their first vineyards in the 'Vaio dei Masi' valley.

Wine Description

This wine displays a medium intensity cherry red colour with youthful reflections. The nose offers an intense bouquet of ripe cherries and raspberries complemented by notes of violets, sweet spices, and a hint of vanilla. On the palate, the wine is fresh and vivacious, showing a medium body with well-balanced acidity and soft, silky tannins. The dominant flavours of cherry and red berries are accompanied by subtle touches of cloves and cinnamon, leading to an aromatic and juicy finish.

title: San Felice Chianti Classico 2022
bodyHtml: San Felice Chianti Classico is a medium-bodied Chianti Classico with a distinguished personality and notable for its elegance. Luminous ruby red. Scents of cherry, raspberry, and sweet violets. Dry on the palate, showing subtle tannins and a fresh, crisp acidity. At its best when partnered with antipasti, full-flavoured first courses and most red meats.

title: Barone Montalto Nero d'Avola - Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
This red blend originates from Italy, specifically the island of Sicily, within the Sicilia DOC. Barone Montalto began its winemaking journey in 2000 in Santa Ninfa, located in the province of Trapani. The winery's philosophy centres on producing authentic modern style wines that capture the 'Sicilian soul'. Their goal is to put this strong, wealthy land in the public eye and introduce its distinctive, authentic wines to be appreciated worldwide.

Wine Description

This wine has an intense ruby red colour, with matching highlights of ruby and crimson. The aromatic profile is highly aromatic and phenolic, offering a rich bouquet full of spices, dark fruit, and pronounced touches of caramel. On the palate, the wine showcases an elegant structure with soft tannins and sweet vanilla.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include roasted and barbecued meats, such as grilled steak or roast beef. It also complements full-flavoured or aged cheeses like Pecorino.

title: Batasiolo Barolo 2021
bodyHtml: Garnet red colour with rye bread, lifted, spicy red plum and cherry aromas and flavours. Tar, licorice, savoury and spicy. Extra dry, medium to full-bodied, excellent balance of fruit and plentiful tannins with a long, complex finish.

title: Allegrini Valpolicella 2024
bodyHtml: Inviting aromas of red-skinned berry, violet and dark spice emerge from the glass. The savoury, bright palate offers ripe red cherry, nutmeg and star anise alongside polished tannins and fresh acidity.

title: Masi Campofiorin 2023
bodyHtml:
Masi Campofiorin originates from Italy, within the Veneto region and the Veronese IGT appellation. The wine was created in 1964 by Guido Boscaini, who sought to bridge the gap between the simple approachability of Valpolicella and the complex power of Amarone. Still owned by the historic Boscaini family, Masi Agricola is credited with inventing the 'Supervenetian' category and the modern 'double fermentation' technique. This winemaking philosophy combines deep Venetian heritage with continuous research and innovation, positioning Campofiorin as a timeless icon of Italian style.

Wine Description

This red wine displays an intense ruby red colour and a medium to full body. The sensory profile is rich and velvety, featuring an aromatic nose of ripe red cherries, plums, and sweet spices. On the palate, it is extra dry and smooth, delivering concentrated flavours of cherries and berry fruit complemented by notes of cocoa, vanilla, and dried figs. The wine is characterized by a soft tannin structure and balanced acidity, leading to a persistent finish with lingering fruit and gentle spice.

title: Frescobaldi Remole Toscana 2023
bodyHtml: Deep ruby colour; fruity cherry, berry aromas with touch of spice on the palate; dry, medium bodied with good acidity.

title: Campo Maccione Vermentino 2024
bodyHtml:
This refreshing white wine originates from the Maremma Toscana DOC in Italy, specifically from the coastal district of Maremma in the province of Grosseto. The Tenuta Campo Maccione estate is owned by the Zingarelli family, the renowned producers behind Rocca delle Macie, who expanded into this region in 1998 to explore its ancient winemaking roots. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on sustainability and preserving the vibrant, natural character of the fruit through gentle pressing and temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel.

Wine Description

The Campo Maccione Vermentino presents a bright straw yellow colour with subtle silver highlights. The nose offers a floral and fruity bouquet, featuring aromas of acacia blossom, broom, and lime zest, alongside delicate notes of apple, pear candy, and pineapple. On the palate, the wine is dry, light bodied, and fresh, showing a sophisticated restraint with flavours of white stone fruits and a marked marine trail. It is defined by a crisp acidity and a savory, chalky finish that leaves a slight almond aftertaste.

Food Pairing

This wine is an excellent match for fresh Mediterranean cuisine, particularly fish-based pasta or rice dishes and grilled white meats. Its saline notes and crisp acidity also pair beautifully with seafood like scallops with herb butter or kingfish ceviche.

title: Antinori Santa Cristina Red Wine Toscana 2020
bodyHtml: Ruby red color with violet tinges. It has a full and intense fragrance with hints of red fruit which bring to mind cherries and raspberries. On the palate the wine is smooth and well-balanced.

title: Sansonina Merlot 2020
bodyHtml:
Deep ruby-red in color, with concentrated notes of crushed black cherries, cocoa, dried herbs, and a touch of balsam. Broad, velvety, and mouth-filling on the palate, it strikes a perfect balance between strong tannins and elegant acidity.

Pair this wine with steak, grilled tenderloin, baby back ribs, or hearty veal stew.

title: Cantina di Negrar Amarone Valpolicella Classico 2021
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This opulent red wine hails from Italy, specifically the Valpolicella Classica region in Veneto. Cantina Valpolicella Negrar has a storied history spanning over 90 years, embodying the excellence and traditions of its native terroir. The winery's philosophy is rooted in technical innovation and the preservation of heritage, famously credited with the "discovery" of Amarone when a forgotten barrel of Recioto fermented completely dry. Today, the cooperative manages approximately 700 hectares of vineyards, maintaining a deep focus on sustainability and the traditional Appassimento method to showcase the region's premier varietals.

Wine Description

The Amarone Classico presents a dense and compact ruby red colour, often evolving into garnet with age. The aromatic profile is intensely persistent and ethereal, revealing a complex bouquet of cherries in spirits, dried prunes, and blackberries dusted with cinnamon and clove. As the wine develops, layered scents of dried flowers, dark chocolate, tobacco leaf, and leather emerge. On the palate, it is powerful yet smooth, delivering a harmonious balance between its rich endowment of velvety tannins and savory notes of figs and cocoa.

The varietal composition is a traditional blend of 70% Corvina, 15% Corvinone, and 15% Rondinella.

title: Prunotto Barbaresco 2023
bodyHtml: Prunotto Barbaresco is produced from vineyards in Treiso and Neive in the Barbaresco area, it’s the elegant expression of Nebbiolo. An aristocratic wine yet accessible and pleasant. It is aged in large oak barrels of varying capacities to enhance balance and softness on the palate.

title: Ricasoli Chianti Classico Brolio 2023
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Tuscany region, specifically within the Chianti Classico DOCG appellation, Barone Ricasoli 'Brolio' Chianti Classico 2023 represents an authentic, refined, and historic expression of Tuscan winemaking. The Barone Ricasoli estate is the oldest winery in Italy, with origins dating back to 1141 at the Castello di Brolio in Gaiole in Chianti. It was Baron Bettino Ricasoli who formulated the official historic recipe for Chianti wine in the 19th century. Sourced from estate vineyard sites planted between 260 and 500 metres above sea level, the vines grow in a complex soil mosaic of sandstone (macigno), galestro limestone, alberese, and alluvial gravel deposits. Under general manager Francesco Ricasoli and head winemaker Massimiliano Biagi, the winemaking philosophy emphasizes fruit purity and terroir drive, utilizing temperature-controlled fermentation in small stainless steel tanks followed by maturation for 9 months in second- and third-fill French oak barrels. The result is a balanced, structured Chianti Classico brimming with vitality and mineral tension.

Wine Description

The wine presents a luminous pale ruby red colour with delicate garnet reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly perfumed bouquet opens with noble aromas of wild cherry, red raspberry, pomegranate, and cranberry, interwoven with subtle notes of iris, dried violets, black pepper, eucalyptus, and warm spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, crisp, and energetic, delivering concentrated flavours of red berry fruit, blood orange, and savory mineral earth, all supported by a bright, mouthwatering spine of natural acidity. Framed by silky, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant mid-palate structure, it concludes with a long, persistent finish marked by lingering red fruits, dried herbs, and a clean chalky mineral grip. Composed predominantly of Sangiovese complemented by small amounts of Colorino, this 2023 release offers an optimal drinking window of 2025–2032. Stylistically, it combines Brolio's historic nobility with the crystalline freshness and effortless drinkability typical of Gaiole’s high-elevation vineyards.

title: Folonari Valpolicella 2024
bodyHtml: Bold flavours of currants and blackberries finished with notes of vanilla on the palate.

title: Domaine Servin Chablis 'Les Vaillons' Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml:
The Chablis Vaillons AOC Premier Cru by Domaine Servin wraps itself in a brilliant robe with grey-green reflections.

The complex, full bouquet reveals floral and mineral aromas as well as notes of white fruits and citrus.

The aromas of the bouquet can also be perceived on the powerful, finesse rich palate. A long, rich and balanced finish rounds off this drop. Enjoy with fish with butter sauce, seafood and chicken with creamy sauces or lamb.

title: Domaine Sangouard Guyot Pouilly Fuisse 2022
bodyHtml: This Chardonnay comes from particularly old vines from the Burgundian top appellation Pouilly-Fuissé. It glows light yellow in the glass and its slightly smoky and roasted scent, reminiscent of herbs, blossoms and yellow and white fruits, makes you want more. The palate impression of the 'Terroir' is expressive and persistent, with aromas of Mirabelle plums, citrus fruits, pears and white peaches, herbal and spicy tones, hints of roasted nuts and caramel, fine acidity, pronounced, slightly smoky minerality, delicate enamel and a juicy and at the same time a solid finish. A wine for top-class menus with fish and crustaceans, mushrooms, poultry and/or veal, which also holds its own as a soloist.

title: Novellum Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml: Chardonnay shows up in some remarkably diverse places but few as breathtaking as the Roussillon, where the Pyrenees meet the Mediterranean. From vineyards, just a stone’s throw from the beach and within view of the historic Mont Canigou, Eric Solomon and Jean-Marc Lafage have created Novellum, a refined, aromatic, and elegant Chardonnay that is aged in tank and neutral French barrels.

title: Domaine de la Potardiere Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This crisp white wine hails from France, specifically the IGP Val de Loire region near the town of Loroux Bottereau in the Loire Valley. Domaine de la Potardiere has been managed by the Couillaud family for several generations, with a winemaking lineage that stretches back to the 1880s.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc presents a pale gold appearance with subtle green reflections. On the nose, it offers an inviting and intense bouquet of citrus fruits, gooseberries, and floral notes, often underlined by a distinctive stony minerality. The palate is dry and refreshing, delivering flavors of white stone fruit and grapefruit with a supple entry and excellent balance.

title: Alain Geoffroy Petit Chablis 2024
bodyHtml: West of Chablis, on the left bank of the Serein, Alain Geoffroy's estate occupies some fifty hectares where the whole family ensures its sustainability. Aged in vats to preserve the freshness of the fruit, this Chablis expresses itself through fruity, floral, vegetal and mineral notes in a tight and long palate. Satisfying as an aperitif and versatile at the table, it is the perfect candidate for a plate of fresh oysters.

title: Servin Chablis 'Les Pargues' 2023
bodyHtml: Chablis Les Pargues is a very pretty, exotic wine. Sweet floral notes, passion fruit, mint and lemon confit give the wine a decidedly exotic flair to play off its airy, lifted personality. Apricot, mint and light tropical notes add character to this very pretty, expressive Chablis that is a bit tight on the finish but will open up nicely with time.

title: Hugel Pinot Gris Classic 2024
bodyHtml: Rich and full but still dry. The most discreet of all varieties in primary aromas, it enjoys the best aging potential. The bouquet is soft and supple, intense, characteristically open and expressive, with fully ripe fruit notes, apricot, greengage, liquorice, a touch of buttery brioche, sesame seed, pistachio and fresh hazelnut. The wine fills the mouth and is well constructed, suave, velvety, soft and almost juicy, with a nice long aromatic finish.

title: Ambroisie Vouvray 2023
bodyHtml: The wine is light golden in colour with an attractive shine. The taste of the wine is soft, delicate, lively, harmonious, and fruity, with an excellent balance of honey sweetness and fresh acidity, a pleasant, sweetish aftertaste. The multifaceted aromas of the wine have notes of stone fruit, white flowers and honey. The wine can be served with fish dishes, seafood with white sauce, soft cheeses, desserts, fruit salads, and almond cakes.

title: Chateau Laulerie Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This crisp white hails from France, produced in the Bergerac region of southwest France, neighbouring Bordeaux. Château Laulerie is owned by the Dubard family, who have cultivated the estate since 1977. Under the guidance of François Dubard, the estate has become renowned for crafting expressive wines that reflect the unique terroir of the Dordogne valley.

Wine Description

The 2024 vintage of Château Laulerie Sauvignon Blanc presents a pale straw colour with green highlights. On the nose, it offers a vibrant bouquet of citrus fruits, notably grapefruit and lime, accented by hints of white flowers and freshly cut grass. The palate is lively and refreshing, with zesty acidity framing flavours of lemon, green apple, and subtle tropical notes. Medium bodied, it finishes clean and mineral, emphasizing its crisp, dry character.

Food Pairing

Pair this Sauvignon Blanc with fresh oysters, goat cheese salads, or herb roasted chicken. Its lively acidity and citrus notes make it equally delightful alongside grilled asparagus or seafood pasta. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Domaine De Majas Blanc 2020
bodyHtml: Very aromatic with gobs of white peaches, flowers, and citrus. Well balanced with refreshing acidity, tons of minerality and a long finish. Transports you back to that shaded patio in the South of France with the view down the mountains to the ocean. One bottle will not be enough - its going to be a long hot afternoon.

title: Wally Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: This Sauvignon Blanc is zesty with lively acidity, hints of passionfruit and gooseberry with great balance and a clean finish. The residual sugar in the wine is just enough to give it a touch of richness on the palate without giving any added sweetness. This wine is made with 100% Sauvignon Blanc grapes from vines that average 25 years old. These vines are planted on two different types of soil, one being carboniferous rock and schist located on the northern part of the area, and the second type being a whiter, limestone-rich soil located in the southern and western side of the appellation.

title: Louis Jadot Macon Villages Grange Magnien Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: Dry and easy to drink, fruity with a floral scent, it can be enjoyed chilled, as an aperitif, It goes very well with hors d'oeuvres, fried or grilled fish, sea food, goat's milk cheese, cold cuts and poultry.

title: Domaine Delaporte Sancerre Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
Vineyard and Terroir
The vineyards are located in Chavignol, a village renowned for its exceptional terroir. The vines benefit from a unique mix of limestone and clay soils, which impart a signature minerality and complexity to the wine. Sustainable vineyard practices further enhance the quality and purity of the fruit.

Winemaking Process
The grapes are hand-harvested at optimal ripeness to preserve their aromatic intensity. Fermentation takes place in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks to retain fresh fruit flavors and aromatic precision. The wine is then aged on fine lees to develop its texture and enhance its depth.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Pale straw with a greenish tint.

  • Aroma: Aromas of citrus fruits like grapefruit and lemon, mingled with notes of green apple, white flowers, and subtle flint.

  • Palate: Crisp and vibrant, showcasing fresh citrus and orchard fruit flavors balanced by lively acidity and a long, mineral-driven finish.

Food Pairing
This Sancerre Blanc pairs beautifully with seafood, particularly oysters, prawns, and white fish, as well as goat cheese and light, herbaceous salads. Its refreshing acidity makes it a versatile companion to a variety of dishes.

title: Gerard Tremblay Petit Chablis 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Gerard Tremblay Petit Chablis originates from the Chablis region in Burgundy, France. The estate, Domaine Gerard Tremblay, is a family run winery currently managed by the fifth generation, including Gerard, his wife Helene, and their children Vincent and Eleonore. They believe in producing distinctive wines that reflect their specific terroir, utilizing a gravity-flow winery to avoid unnecessary manipulation of the fruit and juice.

Wine Description

This wine presents a pale yellow colour with sparkling brilliance. The sensory profile is light and lively, featuring characteristic aromas of white flowers, citrus fruits, and fresh mint with a subtle hint of liquorice. On the palate, it is fresh and supple, offering notes of grapefruit peel, green apple, and a persistent mineral finish. Crafted from 100% Chardonnay, this unoaked wine undergoes both alcoholic and malolactic fermentation in stainless steel to maintain its clean, steely personality. It has an ABV of 12% and is produced using 'Lutte raisonnee' sustainable viticulture methods rather than certified organic farming.

Food Pairing

The crisp acidity and mineral undercurrent make this Petit Chablis a perfect aperitif. It partners naturally with fresh seafood dishes, such as oysters on the half shell, grilled trout, crab, and lobster. It also complements mild and soft cheeses, gougeres (savoury cheese puffs), and light pasta dishes with shellfish.

title: Gerard Tremblay Chablis 'Fourchaume' Vieilles Vignes Premier Cru 2023
bodyHtml: Pale, greenish straw yellow. Aromas of lemon and yeast lead to flavours of Granny Smith apple, lemon and a hint of banana. Medium-bodied with crisp, almost tart, acidity and a long finish.

title: Chai du Grand Vaudasniere Vouvray Demi Sec 2024
bodyHtml: This is a demi-sec Chenin blanc. It is medium sweet, well balanced, a very deep yellow gold in the glass, notes of apple, pear, and minerals, especially on the nose.

title: Chapoutier Bila Haut Le Roussillon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
From Cotes Du Roussillon, Bila Haut Blanc is produced by M. Chapoutier. So much happening here and a great value!

Pale yellow colour with green tints. The wine exhibits citrus aromas (lemon, grapefruit) with smoky notes. Fresh and very aromatic attack. The palate is round, with a great acidity, coming from the later ripening sites at higher altitude. A lot of freshness on the finish mixed with salty notes, which express the minerality of the wine.

A scrumptious seafood wine!

title: Paul Mas Viognier 2024
bodyHtml:
Paul Mas Viognier originates from the Languedoc Roussillon region in the south of France, specifically produced under the Pays d'Oc IGP. Domaines Paul Mas was established by Jean Claude Mas, who champions a philosophy of 'Luxe Rural', blending ancestral winemaking traditions with modern technology to highlight the simple pleasures of life.

Wine Description

This Viognier presents a bright, golden yellow colour with subtle green undertones. The nose is rich and elegant, offering a quintessence of peach, apricot, and white flowers, accented by hints of honey and a touch of vanilla. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and supple, where lush tropical fruit flavours of pineapple and mango meet a fresh acidity and a smooth, creamy texture. The finish is long and persistent, marked by toasted notes and a gentle spice.

title: Le Jaja De Jau Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine is from France, produced in the Languedoc Roussillon region within the Pays d'Oc or Côtes de Gascogne designations. The Château de Jau, which produces the 'Le Jaja de Jau' label, was originally founded in the 12th century by Cistercian monks. Since 1974, the estate has been the residence of the Dauré family, who have restored the property to showcase its diverse history and noble appearance. The 'Jaja' range is designed to be a fun, youthful, and uncomplicated 'everyday wine' that leverages the historical winemaking expertise of the premier estate.

Wine Description

Le Jaja de Jau Sauvignon Blanc displays a bright lime-yellow or lemon-green colour. The nose is intense and aromatic, offering scents of white flowers, grapefruit, citrus, and hawthorn, often accented by notes of fresh cut grass or green herbs. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied and exceptionally crisp, featuring flavours of lime, green apple, and honeyed grapefruit. It is characterized by its zesty acidity, a mouthwatering 'lip-smacking' attack, and a clean, refreshing finish with mineral or sea salt undertones. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc is typically fermented in stainless steel for six months to maintain its freshness and sees no wood aging. The ABV generally ranges between 11% and 13%, and it is produced using sustainable farming practices. Its optimal drinking window is immediate, usually within one to two years of the vintage.

title: Hugel Gentil 2024
bodyHtml: This wine revives an ancient Alsace tradition that wines assembled from noble grape varieties were called "Gentil". Gentil "Hugel" allies the suave, spicy flavour of Gewurztraminer, the body of Pinot Gris, the finesse of Riesling, the grapiness of Muscat and the refreshing character of Sylvaner.

title: Guy Saget Muscadet De Sevre Et Maine 2023
bodyHtml: This Muscadet is sumptuous with its delicate pale gold colour, with green reflections. Fruity with its peach and lemon nose, it opens into a fine and lively mouth with a lot of persistence in which echoes the aromas of flowers and yellow fruits. This "low price" Loire Valley wine will not disappoint you!

title: Chapoutier Cotes du Rhone Belleruche Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine is from France, specifically the Rhône Valley region, and falls under the generic Côtes-du-Rhône appellation. It is produced by M. Chapoutier, one of the Rhône Valley's most highly regarded and dynamic producers. The history of the Chapoutier family in the Rhône Valley dates back to 1808. Michel Chapoutier, who took the reins in 1990, is celebrated for his commitment to biodynamic and organic viticulture and for his intense focus on expressing the purest terroir.

The 'Belleruche' range, which includes both red and white wines, represents the diversity of the Rhône Valley, sourcing grapes from various terroirs across the appellation. The name 'Belleruche' (Beautiful Hive) evokes the notion of a place of harvest, and it aims to deliver excellent value and consistent quality every year.

Wine Description

The Chapoutier 'Belleruche' Blanc presents a beautiful brilliant golden yellow colour with bright green reflections.

This wine is a blend of several white grape varietals traditional to the Rhône Valley, predominantly Grenache Blanc and Clairette, with other possible additions like Bourboulenc, and Roussanne.

The nose is complex and expressive. It offers intense notes of white peach, apricot, and lemon peel. Further aeration reveals hints of aniseed, mint, and white flowers such as acacia.

On the palate, 'Belleruche' Blanc is round, balanced, and fresh. It is a medium-bodied white wine with a pleasant fullness. The flavours echo the nose, featuring peach, citrus, and a subtle herbaceousness. The texture is smooth and velvety. It is characterized by excellent freshness and minerality, which provide lift and a lively mouthfeel. The finish is clean, persistent, and aromatic. The grapes are grown on clay-limestone soils with round stones. The wine is fermented in stainless steel tanks, and malolactic fermentation is blocked to preserve freshness. The optimal drinking window is over the next 3–4 years.

title: Bouchard Pere & Fils Beaune du Chateau Blanc Premier Cru 2019
bodyHtml:
Bouchard Père & Fils Beaune du Château Blanc Premier Cru 2019 is a distinguished white Burgundy from the Côte de Beaune region in France.

Produced since 1907, this cuvée is an exclusivity of the House and is crafted to demonstrate the diverse facets of the Beaune terroir. The winery's philosophy involves blending several Premier Cru vineyards, specifically Les Aigrots, Les Tuvilains, Les Sizies, and Sur les Grèves, which are vinified separately to preserve their individual 'climat' characters. The estate utilizes its ancient cellars at the Bastions of the Château de Beaune, where 7-metre thick walls provide naturally stable conditions perfectly adapted for aging Premier Cru wines.

Wine Description

This 2019 vintage presents a pale gold colour with subtle green shades. The nose is energetic and complex, featuring aromas of white-fleshed fruits like pear and peach, candied citrus, and honeysuckle, accented by hints of brioche, gingerbread, and smoky oak. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, associating a rich and enveloping texture with a vibrant core of lemon peel and lime. It is characterized by its lovely depth, subtle oak integration, and a long, salty mineral finish.

The wine is 100% Chardonnay, harvested manually and carefully sorted. Following pressing, it is matured for 9 to 10 months in French oak, with up to 15% new oak depending on the vintage, and a further 3 to 4 months in stainless steel vats to refine its purity. The 2019 release typically possesses an ABV of approximately 13.5% to 14% and has significant aging potential of five years or more.

Food Pairing

The richness and subtle spice of this Premier Cru make it an ideal companion for finely cooked white meats, poultry, and meat pies. It pairs elegantly with traditional French delicacies such as warm pâté or snails (escargot). Its vibrant acidity and citrus profile also complement seafood dishes like grilled fish or creamy shellfish pastas.

Vintage Quality

The 2019 vintage in Burgundy was marked by hot and dry summer conditions, resulting in lower yields but exceptionally high-quality, concentrated fruit. While the weather was warm, many vineyards, including those for the Beaune du Château, retained a surprising level of acidity and energy. Critics have lauded the vintage for its 'vibrancy and purity,' with wines that are mouth-filling yet balanced by refined textures and impressive complexity.

93 Points - James Suckling: Attractive sliced cooked apple with vanilla and light toast aromas follow through to a medium body with firmness and freshness. Bright and flavorful.

title: Paul Zinck Riesling Grand Cru Pfersigberg 2020
bodyHtml: This Riesling is characteristic of the aromatic expression of lemon, and lime with some hints of green apple and minerality in the background. Fresh and lively attack, with lemon flavours balanced by a great minerality.

title: Domaine Weinbach Pinot Blanc 2022
bodyHtml: Very perfumed on the nose with intense pear notes which carry onto the palate. Also some butter and rum raisin notes with lots of juicy acidity. Very long on the palate for the varietal with a contrast of sweet honey and salty minerality. It finishes with racy zippiness. A very versatile wine that is great with appetizers and lighter dishes but also nice as an aperitif.90 Points - Wine SpectatorThis lithe Pinot Blanc is fresh and zippy, with flavours of ripe Anjou pear, grated ginger and stone, underscored by a pleasing waft of spring forest. Drink now.

title: Chateau Fuisse Pouilly Fuisse Tete De Cuvee 2024
bodyHtml:
An excellent example of the true potential of the wines of Pouilly-Fuisse and a great introduction to the wines of Chateau Fuisse.

The wine is rich and robust in the mouth, but retains it’s lean acidity and freshness throughout.

title: Chateau de Sancerre Cuvee du Connetable 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Chateau de Sancerre Cuvee du Connetable originates from France, within the Sancerre appellation of the Loire Valley. The chateau is situated in the heart of the Sancerre vineyards and is historically significant as one of the few French wine estates bearing the name of an appellation. Since 1919, the estate has been developed by the Marnier-Lapostolle family, who have focused on maintaining its 55 hectares of vines and producing exclusive estate-bottled wines that emphasize the region's diverse flint and chalky-clay soils.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a bright, golden appearance in the glass. The sensory profile is refined and expressive, featuring aromas of pomelo, lemon, lime, and white flowers, often complemented by elegant oaky notes of toasted nuts and vanilla. On the palate, it is full-bodied and well-balanced, delivering flavours of apricot, yellow peach, and citrus zest with a persistent finish that reveals hints of grapefruit, butter, and cake. The wine is a 100% Sauvignon Blanc varietal, crafted from a selection of the estate's old vines. It typically has an ABV of approximately 13.5%. While the estate has held HVE Level 3 certification for sustainable methods since 2018, it began a formal conversion to organic farming starting with the 2020 vintage.

Food Pairing

The complex structure and lively acidity of this cuvee make it suitable for fine dining and various savoury pairings. Suggested dishes include seafood platters, white-fleshed fish like grilled halibut or salmon, and white meats such as veal in sauce or roasted poultry. It is also a traditional match for local specialties like Crottin de Chavignol goat's cheese.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 vintage in Sancerre is regarded as exceptional, with some experts calling it possibly the best in thirty years due to optimal phenolic and sugar ripeness. Despite a small crop with reduced yields, the growing conditions resulted in wines of high quality characterized by rich fruit and preserved acidity. The 2023 vintage also showed promise, yielding supple and fruity dry white wines that maintain the estate's emblematic character.

title: Guy Saget Vouvray 2024
bodyHtml:
This elegant white wine hails from the Vouvray appellation in the Touraine district of France's Loire Valley. The Saget family has been perfecting the art of winemaking for nine generations, with roots in the region dating back to 1790. Under the guidance of Jean-Louis Saget and his sons, Arnaud and Laurent, the winery operates with a philosophy of 'signature' winemaking that seeks to reveal the full, authentic potential of the Loire’s diverse terroirs through traditional fermentation techniques.

Wine Description

Crafted from 100% Chenin Blanc, the Guy Saget Vouvray displays a rich golden yellow hue with bright lemon reflections. The nose is delicate and flowery, offering a complex bouquet of almond, jasmine, and lime, underpinned by notes of pear, nectarine, and a hint of honeycomb. On the palate, the wine is dry and refreshing with a medium body and a crisp, mouthwatering acidity that provides a beautiful balance to its tropical fruit nuances. The finish is long and balanced, highlighted by a characteristic flinty minerality that reflects the clay-siliceous soils of the Vouvray hillsides.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and honeyed stone fruit profile of this Vouvray make it a superb companion for vegetarian dishes, such as a root vegetable gratin, or classic poultry preparations like chicken baked with carrots. It also pairs exquisitely with seafood, white fish, or spicy Thai cuisine where its touch of residual sugar can balance the heat.

title: Paul Zinck Gewurztraminer 2019
bodyHtml: Off-dry, with a balancing freshness that brings the flavours to the fore. This Gewurztraminer shows the fruit character of pear, rose petal and lychee enhanced with exotic notes of spice and a pinch of peppermint. The vineyards are planted to an altitude of 280 metres and have a south-easterly aspect, ideal for ripening grapes.

title: Paul Zinck Pinot Gris 2024
bodyHtml: Highly aromatic exhibiting fresh flowers, lychees and white peaches. Great freshness in the mouth.

title: Wolfberger Pinot Gris Alsace 2023
bodyHtml: A superb, sustained yellow coloured wine that moves towards amber, this Pinot Gris is delicate on the nose and has different aromas such as mushrooms, apricot, honey, gingerbread and forest underbrush that work together to make a complex, perfect balanced wine.

title: Wolfberger Gewurztraminer Alsace 2023
bodyHtml: Very aromatic, with rose petal, peach and honeysuckle aromas. Full-bodied, bright, zesty and crisp, this wine is extravagant and extroverted. Try it with aged Munster cheese and raisin-walnut bread.

title: Sirius Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: This is a serious wine showing textured fruit and vanilla flavours. There's concentration and richness, but it also retains freshness. There is a strong mineral edge to this full-bodied, dense wine.

title: Wolfberger Gewurztraminer Steingrubler Alsace Grand Cru 2021
bodyHtml: The wine is intense yellow in colour with hints of gold, which is a result of the dark pink grapes. The scent is an explosion of tropical fruits, citrus and spices, all blending into a fragrance that is both powerful and complex.

title: Garnier & Fils Chablis 2024
bodyHtml: Crisp and bright fruit is deftly balanced with creamy lees in this stony Chablis. Green apple, cream and lemon.Very crisp and zesty fruit, taut and apple freshness and that wonderful saline finish that goes on.

title: Pfaff Gewurztraminer 2023
bodyHtml:
A rich and exuberant aromatic palette characterizes this Gewurztraminer.

The bouquet is intense and complex, offering an explosion of exotic fruits (lychee, passion fruit, pineapple, mango), flowers (notably rose), citrus (orange peel), and spices (gingerbread, peppermint, cloves, and pepper).

Frequent aromas of honey and ripe fruits give this wine an incomparably rich nose.

Intense fruit flavours, like pineapple or litchi, and in most cases, notes of rose petal. The spices generally evoke nutmeg or white pepper—bright, limpid golden yellow colour.

title: Pierre Sparr Alsace One 2024
bodyHtml: Soft, light yellow hue in the glass. On the nose, Alsace One is fresh and minerally, with light, fruity notes of lychee, hints of firestone and grass, paired with exotic aromas of pineapple and papaya. The palate follows with fresh fruit flavors; a dynamic acidity plays around the tongue, balanced with plenty of extract and a pleasantly light, racy body.

title: Pascal Jolivet Sauvignon Blanc 'Attitude' 2024
bodyHtml: Pascal Jolivet is one of the most respected names in the Loire Valley, celebrated for his dedication to natural winemaking and precise expression of terroir. Founded in 1987, his domaine focuses on producing pure, elegant wines that showcase the character of Sauvignon Blanc. The ‘Attitude’ range reflects Jolivet’s philosophy of minimal intervention and precision viticulture, emphasizing freshness and balance.

title: Fat Bastard Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml: A rich, golden yellow colour with complex aromas of vanilla and honeysuckle layered with subtle nuances of oak. On the palate, this wine has a full body with an eruption of tropical fruit flavours that develop into a long, toasty finish.

title: Wolfberger Riesling Alsace Eichberg Grand Cru 2022
bodyHtml: The colour is pale yellow with crystalline tints. On the nose, it is refined, with fresh aromas of mint, eucalyptus and verbena. On the palate, the attack is straightforward. It is racy and well-balanced. There are the same flavours of mint in retro olfaction. A mineral, precise Riesling from the limestone soils of the Eichberg Grand Cru with excellent ageing potential.

title: Ogier Cotes du Rhone Blanc Heritages 2018
bodyHtml: Floral, aromatic nose with hints of pear and grapefruit. On the palate it's got plenty of texture and is somewhat mouth-coating; flavors of pear, white peach and clove, good acidity.

title: Louis Jadot Chablis 2024
bodyHtml:
This pristine and bright white wine originates from France, specifically within the northern Burgundy region and the world-renowned Chablis subregion. Founded in 1859 by Louis Henry Denis Jadot, the house has grown into one of Burgundy's most respected names, now stewarding over 528 acres of vineyards. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a non-interventionist approach, utilizing a 'lightest possible hand' in winemaking to ensure that each bottle serves as the purest expression of its unique terroir.

Wine Description

Louis Jadot Chablis presents a bright and fresh appearance with a polished character. The sensory profile is defined by citrus and mineral aromas, featuring exotic notes of tangerine alongside green apple and fresh pear. On the palate, the wine is tight, precise, and 'racy', showcasing a wealth of high acidity and a briny mineral streak. To preserve its complex structure and the distinct minerality of the Kimmeridgian limestone soils, the wine is aged in stainless steel tanks with very light fining and filtration. This 100% Chardonnay reached an ABV of 13%. While the house follows sustainable principles and uses natural yeasts when possible, this wine is not certified organic.

title: Louis Jadot Pouilly Fuisse 2024
bodyHtml: Louis Jadot Pouilly-Fuisse opens with aromas of fresh red apples, honey and white flowers with elegant and rich flavours of toasted nuts and citrus. One of the purest expressions of this typical Burgundian grape. Pair this wine alongside roasted salmon, shellfish, or creamy cheeses.

title: Jean Marc Brocard Chablis 'Sainte Claire' 2025
bodyHtml: Some twenty years ago, Jean-Marc Brocard chose to establish his estate in Préhy, a small village near the town of Chablis. At that time, one of his in-laws, Louis Petit, taught him about the vine and at the same time instilled a deep sense of tradition and respect for nature. Boosted by this knowledge and determined to dedicate himself to a vineyard, Jean-Marc Brocard planted a hectare of vines within the appellation of Chablis. As a perfectionist, Jean-Marc Brocard naturally erected his purpose-built cellars in the centre of his vineyard to give the grapes his constant attention. Such dedication together with the best quality Chablis soil produce an exceptional wine with a typical mineral style. It is elegant and full of character. Jean-Marc Brocard’s boundless dedication to wine has borne fruit: the Brocard estate now comprises 80 hectares of vines, 65 of which are adjacent to the cellars.

title: Pierre Sparr Pinot Gris Reserve 2022
bodyHtml: Nice gold color. Expressive, elegant and complex nose of white flower, bush peach and grilled bread notes. The wine is well-structured, full-bodied, warm, powerful and generous. This Pinot Gris is slightly softened by a hint of sugar which gives an unctuous and fleshy side even if it stays medium-dry. With its excellent length, this wine will be appreciated by all wine lovers.

title: Louis Jadot Bourgogne Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and balanced white wine originates from France, specifically within the Burgundy region. Founded in 1859, Maison Louis Jadot is one of the most revered wine houses in the Côte d'Or, now stewarding over 528 acres of vineyards. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a non-interventionist approach, utilizing the 'lightest possible hand' in winemaking to ensure each bottle serves as the purest expression of its unique terroir.

Wine Description

Louis Jadot Bourgogne Chardonnay presents a lovely pale colour in its youth. The sensory profile features a bright and expressive nose of green apple, pear, and citrus fruits, layered with floral notes and a touch of stony minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, showcasing a rich yet fresh texture with flavours of apricot, pineapple, and a whisper of toasted oak spice. It is characterized by an excellent balance between ripe fruit and fresh acidity, leading to a lingering, mineral-rich finish.

title: Perrin La Vieille Ferme White Blend 2025
bodyHtml: If you enjoy quaffable wines, this one is ideal as an aperitif or paired with any meal. Pretty pale yellow colour with lime-green undertones. The nose is very aromatic and seductive with aromas of ripe fruit such as peaches, pears and citrus notes. The palate is ample, developing beautiful fruity notes with a nice balance.

title: Chateau de Sancerre Sancerre Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in France, this quintessential white wine is the only bottling permitted to bear the exclusive name of its appellation, Sancerre, located in the Central Vineyards of the Loire Valley. The estate's history is deeply rooted in the region, with the original castle ruins replaced in 1874 by a mansion built in the Louis XII style. In 1919, the property was acquired by Louis Alexandre Marnier Lapostolle, the famed creator of Grand Marnier liqueur, who was instrumental in establishing the global reputation of Sancerre wines. Today, the winery continues its commitment to excellence with Level 4 High Environmental Value certification, overseeing 55 hectares of vines planted across a unique mosaic of four different soil types.

Wine Description

Chateau de Sancerre Sauvignon Blanc presents a bright yellow colour with elegant golden and silver highlights. On the nose, it offers a harmonious and intense aromatic profile, featuring classic Sauvignon Blanc notes of grapefruit, citrus, and white flowers, alongside hints of boxwood. The palate is fresh, lively, and well structured, delivering a fleshy mouthfeel with flavours of lemon, peach, and fresh fruit. It is characterized by a crisp acidity and a distinct mineral undertone that leads to a long, clean finish.

This wine is crafted from 100% Sauvignon Blanc grapes grown on rolling hills with a semi-continental climate. To preserve its natural freshness and vibrant fruit character, the wine is typically fermented at low temperatures and aged on its fine lees in stainless steel, with no malolactic fermentation.

title: Le Paradou Viognier 2025
bodyHtml: Paradou displays lightly with golden colour, clear and bright. Nose of flowers and white fruits. Freshness and balance mouth with aromas of citrus, white fruit and beautiful minerality.

title: Louis Latour Chardonnay Ardeche 2023
bodyHtml: Louis Latour Ardeche Chardonnay is one of the world's best values in this omnipresent grape variety. This wine offers ripe fruits and notes of chalk in its aromas and flavours. Enjoy it with sauteed Petrale sole in a mix of stir-fried broccoli.

title: Chateau Cailleteau Bergeron Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: This dry and straw yellow coloured white showcases a simple nose releasing fruity and vegetal scents. You will be charmed with this light-bodied wine revealing a broad texture and a medium finish.

title: Louis Latour Chardonnay Bourgogne 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from France, produced in the renowned Chablis region of Burgundy. Levert Frères is a historic winery known for its commitment to traditional winemaking practices that aim to highlight the unique persona of the Chablis terroir. The winemaking philosophy centres on preserving the classic characteristics of the region—freshness, purity, and elegant mineral expressions.

Wine Description

The Levert Frères Chablis presents a bright pale straw colour in the glass. The nose is aromatic and gently complex, offering a 'hazelnut-tinged' bouquet of ripe lemon-apple meringue, grapefruit, and lemon pith. On the palate, the wine is dry and medium-bodied with a lively, harmonious texture featuring flavours of lemon, apple, and melon meringue. It is characterized by its crisp acidity, balanced structure, and a lingering, lightly saline, minerally finish. This 100% Chardonnay typically has an ABV of 12.5%. While some producers in the region are moving toward organic certification, this specific wine is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is generally from release through 2028.

title: Joseph Drouhin Pouilly Fuisse 2023
bodyHtml:
A seductive wine and a really nice expression of the Chardonnay grape! The color is golden, with some green reflections. Among the floral and fruity aromas, almond and ripe grapes dominate. On the palate, the wine is refreshingly pleasant, ethereal in its lightness. Long and refreshing aftertaste.

Pair with hors d'oeuvres, delicately flavored charcuterie, oysters, mussels and any other shellfish.

title: Willm Pinot Blanc Reserve 2020
bodyHtml:
General Information

A nice fruity Pinot Blanc with refreshing acidity. Grapefruit and lemon notes, green pear and yellow plum on a very slender, dry body. Elegant structure on the palate.

title: Joseph Drouhin Macon Villages 2024
bodyHtml: The colour of the wine is bright and limpid. The nose is floral and fruity. Very straightforward and direct on the palate, as if biting into a grape. Fresh and light, with a very pleasant aftertaste. With open kiwi and apple flavours, this wine is immediately attractive. Its mineral touch and zesty acidity keep it fresh, textured and lively.

title: Mouton Cadet Bordeaux Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: A flourish of lemongrass, elderflower and white peach which gather momentum and infuse with clusters of delicious citrus fruit. Wonderfully crisp and zippy with an energizing finish.

title: Chateau Pesquie Artemia 2018
bodyHtml: Clean dark fruit on the nose with a rich dusty nose. Palate of ripe dark fruit, medium plus acidity and medium soft tannin. All nicely integrated. Pleasant medium long finish.

title: Domaine de la Ferte Givry 2023
bodyHtml: Lovely and bright garnet colour with purple tints. It opens on fresh fruits aromas and express a fine generosity. The wine is tasty, pleasant with a great volume. Persistent aftertaste. It will perfectly match with grilled meats or in a sauce as a grilled entrecote with bearnaise sauce, as well as fresh cheeses as Brillat-Savarin.

title: Manoir Du Carra Coteaux Bourguignons 2022
bodyHtml: Ruby-garnet colour, with plum, raspberry, cherry, violets and dried leaves. Medium juicy body with low tannins and pleasant acidity.

title: Jaboulet Cotes du Rhone Parallele 45 Rhone Red Blend 2023
bodyHtml:
Paul Jaboulet Aîné, established in 1834, is a renowned winery in the Rhône Valley, France. The 'Parallèle 45' Côtes du Rhône derives its name from the 45th parallel north, which runs just south of the winery's cellars. This latitude is often associated with the production of exceptional wines.

Wine Description

'Parallèle 45' is a blend of 53% Grenache, 37% Syrah, 5% Mourvèdre, 3% Marselan, and 2% Carignan. In the glass, it exhibits a deep garnet-red hue. The nose is expressive and rich, offering aromas of ripe red fruits such as strawberry and raspberry, complemented by floral and spicy notes.

title: Saget La Petite Perriere Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
In 1790, the Saget family embarked upon a long history dedicated to vines and wine. Generations of their family have worked to create their signature Saget La Perrière wines, melding the perfect balance, a blend of richness and elegance via the meticulous selection of grapes expertly crafted by their skilled winemakers for the La Petite Perrière wines. The new designation of Vin de France allowed them to explore and discover the ideal balance between the fruitiness of those varieties grown in the south and their acidity when produced in the Loire region. Thus La Petite Perrière wines were created. The Vin de France designation is utilized for the entire La Petite Perrière range. La Petite Perrière Pinot Noir is largely sourced from their estate vineyards in Touraine, and a part of the blend is sourced from the South of France through their long-term partners.

All Saget La Perriere vineyards are certified HVE3, which encourages vineyards to focus on increasing biodiversity, decreasing the negative environmental impact of their phytosanitary strategy, managing their fertilizer inputs and improving water management.

This Pinot Noir has a very bright garnet robe with purple shades. A very Burgundian earthiness opens to notes of wild cherry. It's an outburst of freshness on the palate, a body full of momentum and tension ending in a hint of vanilla.

title: Tessellae GSM Old Vines 2023
bodyHtml: Jean-Marc and Eliane Lafage farm 160 hectares of vines located just south of the capital of French Catalonia, Perpignan. Some of their vineyards are situated a few kilometres from the Mediterranean while others can be found in the foothills of the Pyrenees. Benefiting from a warm, dry climate, the estate is farmed organically. They grow primarily Grenache, Syrah, Mourvedre, Carignan, Marsanne, Roussanne and Chardonnay with a significant proportion of the vines well over 50 years old.

title: Chateau Le Puy 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from France, specifically from the Francs Côtes de Bordeaux appellation on the Right Bank. Owned by the Amoreau family since 1610, Château le Puy is a historic estate where Jean Pierre and his son Pascal represent the 14th and 15th generations of family winemakers. The winery is a pioneer of organic and biodynamic viticulture, maintaining a philosophy of minimal intervention and a deep respect for the natural ecosystem of their 50 hectare vineyard.

title: Chateau La Nerthe Cotes du Rhone Villages 'Les Cassagnes' 2022
bodyHtml: Power, structure and colour are the signatures of this vintage. In appearance, a very deep purple with violet hints. On the nose, it's very expressive with notes of small red and black berries along with floral and spice notes. On the palate it is very round, dominated by the Syrah's spicy notes. Thanks to the tannins it shows excellent maturity and very good length with full ripeness. Additionally it's well balanced with significant aging potential.

title: Yves Cuilleron Crozes Hermitages Labaya 2023
bodyHtml:
Syrah at its best! Dynamic and demanding like no other, Yves Cuilleron brilliantly heads this estate today covering over 50 hectares, including six crus in northern Rhone.

Laya, a local name for an area of the Tain-l'Hermitage commune, is made from two vine hectares on the Malfondiere parcel.

This Crozes-Hermitage offers superb aromatic definition of ripe black fruits, meat, black olives, pepper, violet and wood.

title: Chateau du Bois de la Salle Julienas 2023
bodyHtml:
Grippy and serious in style, with an appealing density of dark fruit paired with hints of graphite and bolstered by structured tannins.

Pair with red meats, roast poultry and soft cheese.

title: Lavau Envyfol GSM 2022
bodyHtml:
Maison Lavau, established in 1964 by the Lavau family originally from Bordeaux, has deep roots in the Rhône Valley. Today, brothers Benoît and Frédéric Lavau manage the estate, collaborating with over 350 growers across France to produce wines that marry tradition with accessibility. The Envyfol range, inspired by a label discovered in their grandfather's cupboard from 1967, embodies a spirit of conviviality and shared moments.

Wine Description

The 2022 Lavau Envyfol GSM is a blend of 45% Grenache, 40% Syrah, and 15% Mourvèdre. It presents a deep ruby hue and offers aromas of ripe red fruits, spices, and subtle floral notes. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied yet supple, with fine tannins and a lingering finish that showcases its GSM character.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 90 points,

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with grilled meats, hearty stews, and aged cheeses. Its rich fruit and spice notes complement dishes like lamb tagine or beef bourguignon, enhancing the wine's complexity.

title: Chateau Boutisse Grand Cru 2022
bodyHtml:
Château Boutisse is known for being among the best of Saint-Émilion Grand Crus. These vineyards are planted on the plateau of Saint-Émilion. The limestone in the area allows for wines to be produced with the consistent quality that Château Boutisse is known for. The vines have to work hard to find nutrients and water, creating a lower yield, which is what winemakers are looking for! Saint-Émilion is known for this terroir, which is why such high quality grapes are found in this region.

Jeb Dunnick says this wine gives up a vibrant bouquet of blueberries, jammy black cherries, graphite, and earth. It's rich and powerful on the palate, yet displays a beautiful elegance and purity of fruit as well as fine tannins. It's an impressive wine.

title: Labruyere Moulin a Vent Coeur de Terroirs 2019
Jean Bourdy Cotes du Jura Rouge 2022
bodyHtml:
From the Jura region in eastern France, specifically the Côtes du Jura appellation. Domaine Jean Bourdy is one of the oldest family-owned wineries in France, dating back to the 15th century, with 15 generations of continuous stewardship. The estate has been farmed biodynamically since 2006, reflecting a deep respect for tradition, terroir, and sustainable viticulture.

Wine Description
Côtes du Jura Rouge is a blend of Pinot Noir, Trousseau, and Poulsard. It shows a translucent ruby colour with aromas of wild strawberry, cranberry, and red plum layered with earthy notes of forest floor, dried flowers, and subtle sandalwood spice. The palate is medium-bodied, lively, and perfumed, with bright acidity and silky tannins framing flavours of juicy red fruit, sweet herbs, and mineral undertones. Finishing with freshness and finesse, this wine captures the rustic elegance and authenticity of Jura reds. With 12.5% alcohol and a balanced structure, it can be enjoyed now or cellared for added complexity over the next 5–7 years.

Food Pairing
This elegant red is a superb partner to coq au vin, roast duck, or charcuterie and aged Comté cheese. For a vegetarian pairing, try it alongside mushroom terrine or lentil and root vegetable stew. These combinations highlight the wine’s savoury depth and its delicate, earthy character.

title: Clos Des Lunes 'Lune D'Argent' 2023
bodyHtml:
Pale gold colour with green hues reflecting youth, freshness and energy. The nose perceives the fine qualities of Semillon and Sauvignon Blanc with mineral complexity and slight vanilla notes coming from partial aging in barrels. The palate is full and very tasty with great aroma and taste power. The wine is pure, radiant, fresh and energetic. Very nice balance and beautiful long finish.

Blend: 70% Sémillon, 30% Sauvignon Blanc

title: Gerard Bertrand Cotes Du Roussillon Villages Tautavel 2022
bodyHtml: From a village in the Pyrenees foothills in the deep southeast corner of France comes a mid-weight, ripe and pleasant red with a certain roundness and ripeness typical of the hot Roussillon region. Look for generous if soft aromas of blackberry, plum, violet and pepper. It is quite smooth with some alcohol heat and fine tannins. The length is very good.

title: Chateau de Fuisse Vincent Julienas 2022
bodyHtml: Ripe, refined, soft, and elegant, this wine shows an incredibly bright and plush core of red fruit. A delicate spiciness and a juicy acidity give it a liveliness from the very first sip. Light bakery notes, hints of ground coffee, and white pepper then come together with red currant, red plum, and strawberry, creating a very enjoyable and captivating drinking experience.

title: Chapoutier Les Gadilles Rasteau 2020
bodyHtml: Very deep crimson red, fine and powerful. We find numerous ripe fruit aromas (currant, blackcurrant, raspberry). This wine presents a good structure and great potential.

title: Yves Cuilleron 'Les Vignes d'a Cote' Syrah 2022
bodyHtml:
Vignes d’à Côté refers to the geographical location of the vines located next to the Grands Crus of Rhône Valley. The vines are located in the great terroir in Chavanay.

Pleasant and aromatic wine. An expressive nose on the small red fruits. Nice fresh red fruits and delicate spices give a lovely expression to the Syrah.

Pair with charcuterie or grilled meat.

title: Bulliat Chiroubles Pompe A Soif 2024
bodyHtml:
Domaine Bulliat Chiroubles Chatenay 2024 hails from the Chiroubles cru of Beaujolais, France, which is the highest of the ten crus in the region. The estate is a family operation now run by Noël Bulliat and his son Loïc, who represents the seventh generation of vine growers. Founded in its current form in 1978, the domaine emphasizes a winemaking philosophy rooted in organic practices and a deep respect for the land, aiming to produce wines with stunning complexity.

Wine Description

This wine presents a limpid and brilliant ruby red colour in the glass. The sensory profile is marked by fine floral aromas, specifically peonies and violets, layered over a vibrant core of red berry flavours like raspberry and wild strawberry. On the palate, it is supple, elegant, and harmonious, offering a balanced structure with velvety sensations and a refreshing mineral edge. Composed of 100% Gamay Noir, this light-bodied wine features silky tannins and a lingering, aromatic finish.

Food Pairing

This Chiroubles is an ideal accompaniment to delicate meats such as roast poultry, smoked ham, or a classic Lyon andouillette. Its bright acidity and fruit-forward profile also make it a versatile partner for vegetarian options like a zucchini lasagna or savory cheese gougères.

title: Manoir Du Carra Beaujolais Villages 2023
bodyHtml: From granitic and sandy soils, Manoir Du Carra Beaujolais-Villages has an intense color with cherry or garnet, and reveals a nose of red fruit aromas which are blackcurrant and strawberry.

title: Chante Cigale Chateauneuf du Pape 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in France within the Southern Rhône’s prestigious Châteauneuf du Pape appellation, this wine is a benchmark of the region. Domaine Chante Cigale is a historic family owned estate dating back to the late 19th century, now led by the talented Alexandre Favier, who is recognized as a rising star in the Rhône.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep and vibrant profile, characterized by its elegance and fresh fruit expression. The aroma is rich with fresh strawberries, red plum, and violets, accented by notes of licorice, white pepper, and spice. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and polished, offering sweet cherry and dark plum characters supported by supple, creamy textures and lively acidity.

title: L'Ostal Cazes Grand Vin 2021
bodyHtml: Deep purple in hue. Ripe and powerful aromas of blackberry and black cherry are cut through by flourishes of black liquorice, smoke, spiced cake, cocoa, and espresso. Broad in mouthfeel but precise in structure, the fine tannins balance the rich fruit in a way that is dangerously easy to drink. Loaded with a complex array of blackberry, mulberry, lavender, cracked pepper, tilled earth, and exotic spicy flavours, it displays a richness akin to the Southern Rhône, a muscularity and spice reminiscent of Northern Rhône, and a precise structure that tells the story of La Livinière.

title: La Ferme Du Mont Chateauneuf du Pape Vendange 2021
bodyHtml: This Chateauneuf du Pape Vendange features notes of raspberry and orange zest on the nose. About 80% Grenache, with the rest a mix of Mourvèdre and Syrah, it's full-bodied and velvety in the mouth but retains crisp acidity, which gives it terrific length on the finish.

title: Paul Mas Malbec Reserve 2023
bodyHtml: Powerful and complex aromas of plum, blackcurrant, mocha, and spices. Medium to full-bodied, this Malbec reveals ripe tannins supported by a good fruit concentration and layers of sweet spices.

title: Domaine les Cotes de la Roche Descombes Julienas 2019
bodyHtml: Ruby with a touch of purple. Ebullient fruit, but wrapped in a rather sophisticated package. Boysenberry and red grapes. Fruit filled with a cranberry like tartness but kind of serious.

title: Louis Bernard Chateauneuf du Pape Rouge 2022
bodyHtml: Deep garnet red colour. This expressive wine opens up to berry fruits underscored by hints of forest undergrowth, spices and balsamic notes. On the palate, it has a nice balance between complexity and roundness. The finish is long with stewed fruity notes.

title: Chapoutier Bila Haut Le Roussillon Rouge 2021
bodyHtml: From the legendary Michel Chapoutier, this is a consistently highly-rated wine that reliably delivers big flavour in an intense yet elegant package. Look for bold red and dark fruit with earth and spice notes. Great for burgers, ribs, or lamb.

title: Domaine Houchart Cotes De Provence Rouge 2018
bodyHtml: Red berry and pepper aromas. Dark berries on the palate, with a lovely, well-balanced tannin structure. Perfect with BBQ meat or robust Italian dishes.

title: Chateau Rousselle 2019
bodyHtml:
This Merlot-dominant Bordeaux is concentrated, rich, and full-bodied, dominated by notes of licorice and enhanced by aromas of dry herbs such as thyme and rosemary.

Ideal with red meats, game, and well-made cheeses, it can also be enjoyed uniquely with a pastry.

title: J Boutin Saint Joseph 'Parcelle de Jean' 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This elegant red wine originates from France, specifically the Saint Joseph appellation in the northern Rhône Valley. The estate is led by Stéphane Vedeau, who named the winery J. Boutin in honour of his mother, Jeannine Boutin. Vedeau follows a winemaking philosophy of 'purity and grace,' utilizing gravity-fed cellars and organic practices to express the distinct character of his tiny parcels perched on steep, granite-rich slopes.

Wine Description

The 2024 'Parcelle de Jean' is crafted primarily from 100% Syrah grapes sourced from 50+ year old vines in the 'Les Combes', 'Les Moures', and 'Les Cotes' sectors. In the glass, it reveals a deep red colour with an aromatic profile dominated by blackberry, black pepper, and aromatic herbs. On the palate, the wine is powerful yet velvety, featuring juicy notes of black cherries and minerals supported by a solid, medium-bodied grip. The finish is long and smooth, often revealing savoury, charcuterie-like nuances and a refreshing acidity. While approachable in its youth due to its harmonious fruit sweetness, it is a wine built for aging, with a typical drinking window extending well over a decade.

title: J Boutin Cote Rotie 'Bonnevaux' 2021
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the prestigious Cote Rotie appellation in the Northern Rhone valley of France, this wine is produced by the esteemed domaine of J Boutin. The estate is currently managed by Stephane Vedeau, who took over operations from his mother and continues a winemaking philosophy centered on expressing terroir through organic practices and minimal intervention. Vedeau emphasizes that 'the vines have to see the Rhone to make good wines', focusing on high-altitude, steep granite slopes that foster deep complexity and freshness in the fruit.

Wine Description

This 100% Syrah is sourced from 70 year old vines situated in the Cote Blonde subregion, known for its limestone and granite soils that impart elegance and floral character. In the glass, the wine presents a rich, deep colour, leading into an aromatic profile of blackberry, dark plum, and dark cherry, accented by classic Cote Rotie notes of violet, cloves, and pink peppercorn. The palate is round and silky with fine tannins and a fresh, well-balanced structure that highlights both spicy red fruit and a distinct minerality.

title: La Ferme Du Mont Cotes du Rhone Premiere Cote 2024
bodyHtml:
Wine virtuoso Stephane Vedeau launched La Ferme du Mont in 2010. Hailing from a family of winemakers, his passion for the industry runs deep in his veins.  A truly exceptional winemaker, experts such as Robert Parker have lauded him and his wines. He pays close care to the vineyard, ensuring that it is managed in the most natural way possible. La Ferme du Mont began producing their grapes without pesticides or fertilizers in 2011, relying solely on biodynamic principles ever since.

 The La Ferme du Mont Première is a sleek and refined Côtes du Rhône classic, made up of 60% Grenache, 30% Syrah, and 10% Mourvedre grape varietals. This robust and balanced wine is bright red in colour, with aromas of wild herbs, red berries, and spice. On the palate, there are flavours of sweet fruit and delicate tannins, as well as elegance and freshness.

title: Chateau de Carles 2016
bodyHtml: Rock solid, with a core of dark fruit. Offers a roasted feel, with a ganache edge running alongside the core of crushed plum, fig paste and warm blackberry coulis flavors. The finish shows good grip.

title: Les Jamelles Syrah 2022
bodyHtml: With a very dark color, the Syrah Les Jamelles has a rather syrupy appearance. Its aromas of wild fruits (raspberry, redcurrant, blackcurrant) and floral (violet) combine with flavors of spices, vanilla and cinnamon, with a touch of mint. It is a very rich wine in the mouth, fat, with a certain minerality as well as a long and silky finish, of a rare complexity. Beautiful persistent note of liquorice in the finish.

title: Chapoutier Bila Haut Occultum Lapidem 2018
bodyHtml: Complex, mysterious and spectacular! Full-bodied, juicy, layered and smooth. Endless finish. I love the Braille label, plus the name includes a nice dose of Latin. Aromas of baked black fruit yet dry.

title: Chapoutier Cotes du Rhone Belleruche Rouge 2023
bodyHtml: Garnet red, aromas of red fruits (mainly morello cherries) and spices (liquorice, grey pepper). This wine has a great structure with firm and silky tannins.

title: Chateau Montfaucon Cotes du Rhone 2021
bodyHtml:
Château de Montfaucon Côtes du Rhône originates from France, within the Southern Rhône subregion of the Rhône Valley. The estate's history dates back to the 11th century when its first tower was built strategically along the Rhône River. Owned by the same family since 1766, the winery has been managed since 1995 by Rodolphe de Pins, a UC Davis graduate and former member of the winemaking staff at the esteemed Domaine du Vieux Télégraphe. The estate covers over 60 hectares of vines, and its winemaking philosophy focuses on preserving natural heritage by utilizing a diverse selection of 15 different Rhône grape varieties to create well-balanced, harmonious wines.

Wine Description

This red blend typically presents a dark ruby or deep garnet colour with a purple hue. The sensory profile is rich and fragrant, featuring aromas of ripe dark cherry, raspberry compote, and red currant, often accented by notes of lavender, violets, cracked pepper, and earthy forest floor. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied and well-balanced, delivering flavours of dark plum and dried tobacco leaf with vibrant acidity and velvety, integrated tannins. The finish is long and persistent, frequently revealing hints of liquorice and spicy garrigue herbs.

  • Varietal Composition: Primarily a blend of Grenache (typically 50% to 60%), Syrah, Carignan, Cinsault, and Counoise.

  • ABV: Ranges from 13.5% to 14.5% depending on the vintage.

  • Organic Status: The estate is certified organic and is also noted as being vegan-friendly.

  • Stylistic Notes: Fermented and matured in cement tanks for approximately 18 to 20 months to emphasize fruit purity and freshness.

Food Pairing

The versatility and food-friendly acidity of this Côtes du Rhône make it a smart addition to the dinner table. Suggested pairings include:

  • Meats: Grilled sausages, roast chicken with herbs, duck confit, and beef brisket or burgers.

  • Hearty Fare: Sausage cassoulet, lamb chops, or game meats like pheasant and venison.

  • Savoury Dishes: Ratatouille, mushroom risotto, and wild mushroom stuffing.

  • Cheeses: Complements a variety of aged or strong cheeses.

title: Perrin Rasteau 2022
bodyHtml:
The Rasteau L'Andeol is a delightful wine that will pair well with traditional hearty cuisine. You can age it for 6-7 years. Rasteau benefits from the peculiar Southern Rhone climate. For the most part the Grenache is facing south and protected from the mistral, enabling it to mature particularly well.

The wine develops aromas of figs, dark chocolate and a texture typical of the appellation.
