title: Chateau Argadens 2020
bodyHtml: Full of complex blackberry and blackcurrant fruit, gentle tannins and rounded off by a smooth, silky finish, it is a delight!

title: Chateau Ollieux Romanis Cuvee Prestige 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from the Corbieres Boutenac region in Languedoc, France. The Bories family has owned and maintained the estate for 200 years, with current proprietor Pierre Bories revitalizing the property starting in the 1980s by focusing on preserving the vineyard's exceptionally old vines. The winery follows a philosophy of sustainable and organic viticulture, utilizing indigenous yeasts and minimal intervention to reflect the unique Mediterranean red sandstone and limestone terroir.

Wine Description

Deep ruby in colour, this red blend opens with an alluring bouquet of wild black raspberry, sun-dried cherry, and dark wild berries, complemented by savory notes of leather, tobacco, and Mediterranean garrigue. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with a supple, silken texture and well-integrated tannins. Flavours of plum, liquorice, and baking spices lead into a long, layered finish that balances richness with a vertical, mineral freshness.

Food Pairing

This wine is an excellent companion to herb-crusted lamb, duck confit with cherry compote, or rosemary beef skewers. It also pairs beautifully with hearty stews, grilled eggplant with romesco sauce, or a charcuterie board featuring aged cheeses.

title: Ollieux Romanis Cuvee Classicque 2022
bodyHtml: Rich red and black fruit flavours are balanced by the more savoury notes of rosemary, alongside hints of tobacco leaf and pepper.

title: Jean Louis Chave Saint Joseph 'Offerus' 2023
bodyHtml:
France’s Northern Rhône Valley is celebrated for its exceptional Syrah, and the Saint Joseph appellation is a key contributor to this legacy. Jean-Louis Chave, whose family roots in winemaking trace back to 1481, crafts the ‘Offerus’ under the label JL Chave Selection. Unlike the domaine wines grown on their own historic Hermitage and Saint Joseph parcels, Offerus is a négociant project where Jean-Louis carefully selects grapes from top growers, ensuring the wine embodies both his exacting standards and the distinctive character of Saint Joseph.

Wine Description

A vivid ruby in the glass, the 2023 Offerus captures the essence of Northern Rhône Syrah. The nose is lifted with notes of ripe blackberries, crushed violets, cracked pepper, and subtle hints of smoked meats. On the palate, it delivers layers of dark fruit, olive tapenade, and a mineral streak that speaks to the granitic soils. Medium-bodied with fine, powdery tannins, it shows impeccable balance and freshness. The finish is long and savoury, with lingering spice and floral nuances.

Food Pairing

Try it with grilled lamb chops with rosemary, peppered duck breast, or a hearty mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character, enhancing the interplay between its savoury notes and refined tannins.

title: Perrin Vinsobres Les Cornuds 2022
bodyHtml: The Perrin family, of Château de Beaucastel fame, began their négociant La Famille Perrin business in 1997. Established by François Perrin and his brother Jean-Pierre, Pierre's father, now run by Pierre since 1999. They produce a range of wines that express the richness of the Southern Rhône Valley with the aim of showing terroir diversity. Using the same expertise and the passion as with Château de Beaucastel, the family prides itself in bringing out the true character of each vineyard plot. The Famille Perrin way makes each wine using organic and biodynamic approaches, mastering the art of blending and bringing out the freshness of the Southern Rhône aromas.

title: Chateau Callac Graves 2020
bodyHtml: This is a wine of fine complexity and intensity, with some rustic earthy funk and decent length. This is a delicious, charming and exact young Graves that catches the pine, herbal, currant character.

title: Chateau Pesquie Quintessence 2022
bodyHtml: This distinctive Rhone blend is excellent value for the price. This wine splashes lovely darker berries on the nose and palate and has a decent finish.

title: Chateau Pesquie Terrasses Red 2022
bodyHtml: Profoundly anchored in the Ventoux terroir, Grenache and Syrah express themselves here, with brilliance, indulgence and suppleness. A deep ruby colour and an intense nose with spicy notes (especially black pepper) and red berries. This very balanced wine offers very round tannins and fresh berries aromas, with some floral and spicy flavours. Very easy to match. With simple dishes such as pizzas, kebabs, charcuterie, vegetable pies or salads to more ambitious cuisine like terrines, poultry, roasted or grilled meats.

title: Sirius Rouge 2018
bodyHtml: Beautifully brilliant wine with deep purple tints. Harmonious, chewy attack opens up to reveal an elegantly structured, smooth wine with crunchy fruit and a hint of vanilla and coffee on the back of the palate.

title: Clos de l'Oratoire Chateauneuf du Pape 2023
bodyHtml:
The heart and soul of the Châteauneuf du Pape terroir is revealed here in its purest expression by Edouard Guerin.

Intense ruby robe with beautiful reflections of old rose petals. Frank and spicy with black pepper and licorice, surprising floral notes of grass and acacia, evolving onto more classic notes of strawberry, cherry and fresh blackcurrant, and subtle notes of camphor and menthol.The attack is frank and ample, reflecting the gourmand and delicate characteristics of the estate and magnificently held by fine tannins with a silky length, strengthened by the freshness of the menthol and scents of the garriques.

title: Louis Latour Pinot Noir Valmoissine 2024
bodyHtml:
This Pinot Noir is a product of France, hailing from the region of Var in the South-East, specifically the Indication Géographique Protégée (IGP) Var Coteaux du Verdon. Maison Louis Latour, a highly respected family-owned producer since 1797, established the Domaine de Valmoissine in 1989 with the goal of creating a high-quality, affordable Pinot Noir. The vineyards are located on the site of an ancient monastery, benefitting from clay and limestone soils at 500 meters above sea-level, which ensures cool nights despite warm, sunny days. This unique location and the application of Burgundian vineyard management techniques ensure a wine of elegance and finesse.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Noir presents a deep ruby-red colour. The nose is distinctive, offering aromas of red fruits, notably cherry and nutmeg. The palate is round and fresh, revealing notes of cherry, blackberry, and liquorice. It is a balanced and subtle wine, with strong tannins that are beginning to mellow and a nice tannic finish. The winemaking involves traditional fermentation in open steel tanks, followed by ageing for ten to twelve months in stainless steel vats to preserve the fruit's purity.

title: Delas Freres Cotes du Rhone Saint Esprit 2022
bodyHtml: The Saint-Esprit's deep colour has a dark, plum-like hue. The nose is classical Syrah, with berry fruit, violet, liquorice and spices. It has a full, rounded palate with delicate tannins.

title: Perrin Vacqueyras Les Christins 2023
bodyHtml: A classy and well balanced, firmly structured Vacqueyras from the Perrin Family. A complex nose that nicely balances mixed wild, brambly berries with pretty floral notes.

title: Louis Bernard Cotes du Rhone Red Blend 2023
bodyHtml: Sultry notes of crème de cassis and preserved plums introduce this rich, softly tannic blend of Grenache and Syrah sourced from the villages of Sablet and Signargues. Pertly balanced in acidity but plush, almost creamy, in texture, it's an easy-drinking wine.

title: Fat Bastard Syrah 2023
bodyHtml: Deep ruby red colour with raspberry, cherry, and herbal aromas with spice notes. Dry, full-bodied, sweet fruit core of flavour with notes of white pepper and spice, well-balanced acidity and soft tannins.

title: Delas Crozes Hermitage Les Launes 2021
bodyHtml: A delicious Crozes, with lovely black and red fruit, black pepper and smoky wood, cool minerality, a pure and clean Syrah character, gentle tannins, perfectly judged extraction, juicy and fresh, red meat, energetic and well-balanced, good length.

title: Louis Jadot Chateau des Jacques Moulin A Vent 2023
bodyHtml: Rich and powerful, this wine displays the essence of its appellation with elegant fruit, supple tannins, and freshness. This wine will be an excellent companion to all sorts of dishes: meat, fish, cheese, vegetables, etc.

title: Clos La Coutale Malbec Cahors 2023
bodyHtml:
Clos La Coutale Malbec originates from France, within the Southwest France region and the Cahors appellation. The estate is a historic property that has been managed by the Bernède family for six generations, with Philippe Bernède currently at the helm. The vineyard’s philosophy focuses on a blend of traditional expertise and modern innovation, such as the invention of the famous Coutale corkscrew and a revolutionary 'pigeur' (punch-down device) by Philippe to enhance wine structure. The 100-hectare estate sits on alluvial soils composed of gravel and clay-limestone silica, specifically positioned with southwest exposure to protect the vines from extreme cold.

Wine Description

This red wine is recognized for its deep purple colour and a medium to full body. The sensory profile features a rich and complex nose of dark plum, damson, and raspberries, interwoven with herbal notes of rosemary, dried herbs, and mint, alongside hints of black pepper and licorice. On the palate, it is fresh and juicy, delivering a concentrated core of blue and black fruits supported by firm yet velvety tannins and a distinct chalky minerality. The finish is medium-long and refreshing, showcasing an elegant balance between fruit intensity and earthy undertones.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional Cahors blend typically consisting of 80% to 85% Malbec (locally known as Côt) and 15% to 20% Merlot.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is aged in oak barrels and wooden casks for 12 to 18 months, a process that refines the tannins and adds complexity to the bouquet while softening the Malbec’s natural intensity.

  • ABV: Typically ranges from 13% to 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: Clos La Coutale commenced its conversion to organic agriculture in 2019.

title: Chateau Beaumont 2022
bodyHtml:
This elegant red wine hails from France, specifically the Haut Medoc region on the Left Bank of the Gironde estuary. The estate traces its winemaking history back to 1824, with its striking Renaissance-style château constructed in 1854. Today, it is co-owned by the Castel Group and the Japanese company Suntory under the 'Grands Millésimes de France' umbrella, the same group behind the celebrated Château Beychevelle. The winery's philosophy blends Médoc tradition with technical innovation, practicing sustainable viticulture since 2004 with Terra Vitis certification to produce high-quality grapes with deep respect for the environment.

Wine Description

The 2022 Chateau Beaumont is deep garnet-purple in colour with an impressive, powerful bouquet. The nose is fragrant and open, bursting with aromas of cassis, black cherries, mulberries, and plum preserves, layered with delicate notes of violets, menthol, cardamom, and a touch of smoky cedar. On the palate, this medium-bodied wine is richly textured and concentrated, offering a juicy core of blackcurrant and red berry fruit.

The varietal composition for this vintage features a higher than normal proportion of Cabernet Sauvignon at 65%, complemented by 30% Merlot and 5% Petit Verdot. Stylistically, it is balanced and fresh, supported by firm yet ripe, velvety tannins and a distinct mineral, graphite-infused structure. The finish is savory and cohesive with outstanding length. This wine is approachable in its youth starting around 2026, with an optimal drinking window extending through 2036.

Accolades

  • 'James Suckling - 92 points'

  • 'Jeb Dunnuck - 92 points'

  • 'Wine Enthusiast - 90 points'

  • 'Vinous - 90 points'

title: Chapoutier Chateauneuf du Pape La Bernardine 2023
bodyHtml:
This prestigious wine originates from France, specifically the Rhône Valley and the celebrated subregion of Chateauneuf du Pape. M. Chapoutier, with roots dating back to 1808, is one of the Rhône Valley’s oldest companies. The family motto, 'Fac et Spera'—'do and hope'—encapsulates the patience and care the art of winemaking demands.

Wine Description

The 'La Bernardine' exhibits an intense crimson red colour. The nose is complex and subtle, opening with aromas of blackcurrant and plum, followed by notes of roasted coffee, cinnamon, and cherry. The wine is a blend of the region's classic Southern Rhône varietals, predominantly Grenache Noir, with smaller proportions of Mourvèdre and Syrah. On the palate, it is full bodied, concentrated, and opens into spicy (often liquorice) and fruity characters. It is described as succulent, well balanced, and structured. 

Accolades

  • 'James Suckling' - 93 points

  • 'Robert Parker’s Wine Advocate' - 92 points

  • 'Vinous' - 91 points

Food Pairing

Grilled and roasted red and white meats, such as leg of lamb or garlic roasted chicken. Also an excellent match for beef stew, rabbit with olives, and vegetarian moussaka with lentils.

title: Louis Jadot Beaujolais Villages 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and expressive red wine originates from France, specifically within the northern region of Beaujolais and the Beaujolais Villages DOC subregion. Founded in 1859 by Louis Henry Denis Jadot, Maison Louis Jadot is one of Burgundy's most revered wine houses, stewarding over 500 acres of prestigious vineyards. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a non-interventionist approach to vinification, utilizing traditional Burgundian methods rather than the common carbonic maceration to focus on the purest expression of the granite and sandy terroirs.

Wine Description

The Louis Jadot Beaujolais Villages presents a strong red-purple colour with deep glints. The sensory profile is fruit-forward and juicy, featuring an elegant bouquet of strawberries, raspberries, and dark cherries, layered with sophisticated notes of grey pepper, liquorice, and a touch of rose flower. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and well-structured, showcasing a 'fresh and crunchy' texture with smooth, muted tannins and a lively acidity. It is characterized by its remarkable consistency and balance, leading to a smooth, pleasant finish. While the estate employs sustainable viticulture and natural yeasts, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Clos des Menuts 2020
bodyHtml: Rather deep ruby-red colour. Pure nose offering fresh wild berry notes, a mild spiciness and discreet oak. Medium weight with a youthful texture, rather high extraction, discreet young fruit and a fairly long finish. A youthful example needing time to soften.

title: Chateau Roc Taillade Bordeaux Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml: This blend of Cabernet and Merlot is made in the true Bordeaux tradition. A light flavour, with blackberry, black fruits, wood, and other notes. A rich ruby shade that is delightfully drinkable.

title: Louis Bernard Cotes du Rhone Villages Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml: Since 1976, Louis Bernard has united winemakers of the Rhone Valley in a common project: to devote the best of their wine and savoir-faire to producing great wines. With production throughout the Cotes du Rhone region, Louis Bernard remains dedicated to showcasing the unique characteristics of each terroir while producing exquisite, world class wines.

title: Chateau Camarsac Rouge
bodyHtml: A Merlot dominant wine that proves you don't have to spend a ton of money to enjoy Bordeaux wine. Lush violet aromas, wrapped around rich plum and black cherry flavours, that develop a cedar spice towards the finish. With smooth cocoa like tannins and a medium body it is a great companion to white meats like turkey, or pork.

title: Chateau des Laurets 2018
bodyHtml: This has a dense nose of black berries, mocha and rich Puisseguin-Saint Emilion earth. The body is full and somewhat unexpected from this region as there must be a higher percentage of Cabernet Franc in this blend. It's so thick and ripe that it's quite chocolaty complemented by flavors of ripe currant, licorice, espresso, and vanilla. Finishes long with a hint of spice, loamy earth, and herbs.

title: Bouchard Pere & Fils Pinot Noir Bourgogne 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from France, specifically from the historic Burgundy region. Founded in 1731 in Beaune by Michel Bouchard, Bouchard Pere & Fils is one of the oldest wine estates in Burgundy, spanning nearly three centuries and nine generations of history. The winery's philosophy centres on a meticulous 'vine to bottle' approach, striving to understand each terroir and master every vine to ensure the most faithful expression of the land. As one of the largest landowners in the Côte d'Or, the estate manages its vast mosaic of vineyards using sustainable viticulture practices to bring out the full potential and authenticity of its wines.

Wine Description

Bouchard Pere & Fils Pinot Noir Bourgogne 2021 displays a bright crimson-ruby red colour. The nose is fine and subtle, offering a very aromatic bouquet of small ripe red fruits such as cherry, raspberry, and currant, accented by hints of earthiness and subtle spice. On the palate, the wine is light to medium-bodied and supple, featuring refreshing acidity and soft tannins that blend pleasantly with flavours of plum, strawberry, and a touch of oak. It is characterized by its harmonious balance, round texture, and a lingering, vibrant finish. This 100% Pinot Noir has an ABV of 12.5%. While the estate follows sustainable management practices, this specific regional bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window for this vintage is from release through 2026

title: Perrin Cotes du Rhone Reserve 2023
bodyHtml:
France’s Rhône Valley is home to some of the world’s most cherished wine traditions, and Famille Perrin is among its most celebrated producers. Based in the southern Rhône, the Perrin family has been crafting wine for over a century and owns the esteemed Château de Beaucastel. Their philosophy combines a respect for terroir with organic practices, yielding expressive and authentic wines.

Wine Description
Perrin Cotes du Rhone Reserve pours a vibrant ruby red with purple undertones. On the nose, it offers inviting aromas of ripe red berries, plum, dried herbs, and a touch of peppery spice. The palate is smooth and medium-bodied, displaying juicy flavours of cherry, blackberry, and liquorice, accented by notes of garrigue and subtle mineral tones. Well-integrated tannins and bright acidity create a pleasing structure, finishing with freshness and finesse.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with herb-roasted chicken, grilled lamb chops, ratatouille, or lentil stew. Its balance of fruit, spice, and savoury depth makes it versatile at the table. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Coudoulet Beaucastel Cotes du Rhone Red 2022
bodyHtml:
Produced by the famed Famille Perrin, this wine is often regarded as the 'baby Beaucastel', as the Coudoulet vineyard is located just east of the prestigious Château de Beaucastel on soil that is virtually identical. The Perrin family, renowned for producing some of the most age-worthy red wines in the Southern Rhône, adheres strictly to organic farming and a winemaking philosophy that values natural methods and elegance, faithfully upholding the tradition of making wine naturally with Mourvèdre as a significant component of the blend.

Wine Description

This red blend features a clear, elegant deep ruby colour with purple undertones. The aromatic profile is seductive and multifaceted, delicately mixing notes of fresh red fruit like raspberry and wild strawberry, with nuances of spices, licorice, dried herbs, baking spices, and a hint of cypress. On the palate, the wine is powerful, full-bodied, and defined by a surprising freshness. It is shaped gently by soft, velvety tannins that contribute to a balanced and round profile.

title: E. Guigal Chateauneuf du Pape 2022
bodyHtml:
The Guigal domain was founded in 1946 by Etienne Guigal in the ancient village of Ampuis, home of the wines of the Cote-Rotie. In these vineyards that are over 2400 years old, you can still see the small terraced walls characteristic of the Roman period.

Deep dark red. Spices and mature red fruits on the nose. Round tannins with powerful complexity. A rich unctuous wine with notes of mature plums, hazelnuts, and red fruit.

title: Louis Jadot Pinot Noir Bourgogne 2023
bodyHtml:
This classic and elegant red wine originates from France, specifically within the Burgundy region. Founded in 1859, Maison Louis Jadot is one of the most prestigious names in the Côte d'Or, maintaining a reputation for consistency across its vast portfolio of vineyards. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a 'terroir-driven' approach, utilizing traditional Burgundian winemaking techniques and long macerations to ensure the wine captures the authentic character of the diverse soils found throughout the region.

Wine Description

Louis Jadot Bourgogne Pinot Noir presents a bright ruby red colour. The sensory profile is highly aromatic, featuring a nose of fresh red berries, such as strawberries and raspberries, layered with sophisticated notes of cherries and a hint of earthiness. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and 'silky', showcasing a harmonious balance of fruit and soft, well-integrated tannins. It is characterized by its graceful structure and a refreshing acidity that leads to a clean, lingering finish with subtle spicy undertones.

title: Louis Latour Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
The result of a long history, Burgundy and its wines are known worldwide. Pinot Noir is a native grape variety of the area. Bourgogne Pinot Noir is the regional appellation whose wines can come from any part of Burgundy. This wine exhibits the characteristics of the great red Burgundies.

Of a bright deep ruby hue, this Bourgogne Pinot Noir offers nice cherry aromas on the nose. The palate is fresh and round with blackcurrant bud notes. A gourmet wine with silky tannins. Pairs perfectly sipping with family and friends, a lakeside happy hour or after a hike in the mountains!

title: Perrin La Vieille Ferme Rhone Red Blend 2024
bodyHtml:
Perrin La Vieille Ferme Rhone Red Blend originates from France, specifically produced within the Ventoux and Luberon regions of the Southern Rhone Valley. Established over 35 years ago by Jean Pierre Perrin, La Vieille Ferme was created to offer an authentic and honest expression of Rhone winemaking. Today, the Famille Perrin continues this legacy, utilizing their centuries of expertise to craft consistent, value driven wines that are celebrated in some of the world's finest restaurants.

Wine Description

This red blend displays a pretty purple colour with bright, shiny reflections. The nose is seductive and aromatic, revealing a bouquet of red fruits, morello cherries, and spices, with subtle floral notes of violet and a hint of peppermint. On the palate, the wine is full of freshness and well balanced, showing pure, crisp fruit flavours of cherries and blackcurrants. It features a velvety texture with very soft, well integrated tannins and a long finish punctuated by delicate notes of dark chocolate.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs exceptionally well with spontaneous meals such as roasted poultry, grilled pork, or Mediterranean dishes featuring garlic and black olives. It also complements heartier fare like burgers, pizza, and spiced Vietnamese cuisine. For a sweet conclusion, try it alongside a red fruit pavlova or a chocolate fondant.

title: Les Halos De Jupiter Cotes du Rhone 2024
bodyHtml:
La Balance, charismatic and pure, offers us a Cotes du Rhône of unique finesse and great balance. The complementarity of the terroirs of the two banks of the Rhone (Signargues, Cairanne and Rasteau) reveals an exemplary character of Grenache, richly perfumed and generous. This great expression of fruit and pleasure carries the colors of the Cotes du Rhône high.

The selected terroirs come from both banks of the Rhone. On the right side, the large pebbles of the Signargues plateau give powerful and spicy wines, while on the left bank, those of Cairanne and Rasteaux bring finesse and brilliance. 

Although it can be enjoyed young, this wine will develop its character much later. It will keep its freshness for at least 5 years after bottling.

title: Saint Cosme Cotes du Rhone 2024
bodyHtml:
Saint Cosme, located north of the village of Gigondas, is the most ancient estate in the region. There is even evidence of a Gallo-Roman villa on the site date to 1416! The diversity of soils and cool micro-climates encourages slow, even and late ripening of grapes. The dedication at Saint Cosme is total. They want to best express the extraordinary potential of the terroir. Years of experience, old vines and organic viticulture are also key contributing factors to the high quality of Saint Cosme wines and their elegant house style. A true treasure of the Rhone region!

Wine Description
The nose opens with a lovely floral violet, followed by dark berries, tobacco and charcoal notes. The palate echoes the nose and there is a pleasing grip on the finish. This is a well structured Cotes du Rhone, with excellent purity of fruit and vibrancy.

title: Jean Louis Chave Cotes du Rhone 'Mon Coeur' 2024
bodyHtml: A superb interpretation of the Côtes du Rhône in Grenache Major and Syrah Minor by tenor Jean-Louis Chave. He draws from the harvests of a handful of “select” growers a fruity, floral and spicy cuvée. Comforting served with a beef or lamb stew.

title: George Duboeuf Beaujolais 2023
bodyHtml: This Beaujolais-Villages displays a shiny garnet color, and is superbly fruity, with aromas of red and black berries, with hints of cherry marmalade. Structured and generous mouthfeel with unctuous texture with silky tannins. Balanced.

title: Perrin Cotes du Rhone Villages 2022
bodyHtml:
It is no coincidence that Famille Perrin is the leading organic wine grower of the Southern Rhône Valley, where they occupy the region’s best terroirs. Their values have given them a worldwide reputation for excellence, absolute respect for the soil, a commitment to manual method and a deep belief that organic viticulture is the only way to express the true essence of the terroir. Nature and tradition are key to the Famille Perrin approach, which has continued seamlessly over five generations.

Elegant deep crimson-red dress. On the nose, this wine reveals a beautiful aromatic complexity with notes of black fruit, pepper and "garrigue". Smooth, well structured and perfectly balanced, the palate offers aromas of blackberries, plums and liquorice with a good length on the finish.

title: Baron Carl Red Bordeaux 2019
bodyHtml: Wild berry aromas reminiscent of blackberry and bilberry, fruit flavours on the palate develop over fine tannins that will mature with ageing, building to an attractively firm and well-structured finish. Substantial alert and well-structured on the palate, its very soft tannins are perfectly enfolded in rich cherry-stone, spice, leather and blackcurrant flavours.

title: Chateau Cheval Brun 2020
bodyHtml: Black cherry liqueur and richness, depth and concentration yet balanced and dry. Layers of black plum, espresso, anise and cedar brush complete with a long finish. The three main varieties on this wine come together and complement each other to magnify the whole. Merlot brings fruity, when Cabernet Sauvignon gives tannins and Cabernet Franc spicy notes.

title: Joseph Drouhin Bourgogne Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml: A wine full of charm. Bright ruby colour and a nose rich with aromas of red fruit, raspberry, red currants, wild strawberry. On the palate, the wine is pleasant, fruity and refreshing, with light tannins and great elegance.

title: Chateau Magnol 2023
bodyHtml: On the nose it develops an elegant and fruity bouquet, favoured by the blackcurrant notes of the Cabernet Sauvignon and the redcurrant notes of the Merlot. On the palate the wine is full bodied, with soft silky tannins, and a long spicy aftertaste.

title: Bouchard Aine & Fils Beaujolais 2024
bodyHtml: Ruby red colour; cherry and slightly jammy raspberry aromas; dry with light body; cherry flavour and a clean finish.

title: Chateau de Saint Cosme Gigondas 2021
bodyHtml:
The wine shows intense blackberry and fig fruit with licorice, violets, and charcoal on the finish. It is remarkably fresh and finessed given the sun and warmth of the southern Rhone. The unique micro-climate combined with 60-year-old vines and traditional winemaking make Château de Saint Cosme Gigondas the benchmark wine of the appellation.

Grenache is the pale-colored, red-fruited, and potpourri-scented red grape variety of the southern Rhone and can be paired with both rustic and sophisticated dishes. Full-bodied Grenache-based wines are ideal with stews, braises, and grilled meats, while lighter versions can work well with dark fish and tomato-based dishes such as ratatouille.

94 Points - James Suckling

This rich and impeccably balanced Gigondas has everything we look for in the wines of this appellation. What a wide spectrum of aromas with everything from raspberry to candied orange, plus a slew of delicate spicy notes and fresh Mediterranean herbs. I love the interplay of richness, fine tannins and lively acidity on the generous, but not expansive palate. Very long, refined finish.

94 Points - Wine Spectator

Powerful, with steeped plum and cherry coulis merging with potpourri and charred garrigue on a ripe, lush palate. Packs a wall of iron that provides a ballast for the ripe fruit, while refined tannins build in intensity. Long and complex, with a gorgeous expression of place. 

92+ Points - Vinous

90+ Points - Jeb Dunnuck

title: Joseph Drouhin Beaujolais Villages 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from France, specifically from the Beaujolais Villages appellation in the Beaujolais region. Founded in 1880 by Joseph Drouhin, Maison Joseph Drouhin is an iconic family owned estate currently led by the fourth generation: Frédéric, Véronique, Philippe, and Laurent Drouhin. The winery is renowned for its commitment to 'terroir' expression and was a pioneer in organic and biodynamic viticulture, managing its estate vineyards under these principles since the late 1980s.

Wine Description

Joseph Drouhin Beaujolais Villages displays a brilliant raspberry colour with a luminous hue. The nose is both refined and intense, offering a fragrant bouquet of violets, peonies, and red fruit syrup, accented by subtle earthy and spicy notes. On the palate, the wine is fresh and silky with a medium body, featuring juicy flavours of strawberry, red cherry, and raspberry. It is characterized by its remarkable balance and a long, persistent finish that maintains a lively fruitiness. This 100% Gamay wine has an ABV of 12.5% to 12.6% and is produced using grapes from estate vineyards that have been certified organic since 2009. The optimal drinking window for this vibrant and approachable red is from now through 2030.

title: La Fiole du Pape Chateauneuf du Pape
bodyHtml:
Introduction

La Fiole du Pape is a non-vintage red blend from the Châteauneuf du Pape appellation in the Southern Rhône Valley, France. First created in 1952 by Charles Brotte, it is renowned for its distinctive 'twisted' bottle design, which represents a gnarled vine struggling against the Mistral wind. The winery's philosophy is inspired by the Champagne region; by blending several vintages—including reserve wines aged up to 10 years—they ensure a consistent house style and a wine that offers a 'perfectly aged' character immediately upon release.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep and bright ruby red colour. The aromatic profile is open and powerful, featuring scents of ripe berries, morello cherry, and warm spices like cinnamon and clove, alongside complex undertones of truffles and cedar. On the palate, it is elegant and well-balanced, offering a fleshy and powerful texture with flavours of prunes, liquorice, and roasted game. The wine is primarily composed of Grenache (70%), which provides fruit and sweetness, complemented by Syrah, Mourvèdre, and Cinsault for freshness, tannins, and structure. It finishes with a long, persistent impression of fruit and spice. While intended for immediate enjoyment, it maintains a cellar aging potential of approximately 3 to 5 years.

title: Zenato Recioto 2020 - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This decadent red dessert wine originates from Italy, specifically the Veneto region within the heart of the Valpolicella Classico zone. Founded in 1960 by Sergio and Carla Zenato, the winery began with a pioneering spirit on the banks of Lake Garda and has since grown into a benchmark producer of northern Italy. Now led by the second generation, Alberto and Nadia Zenato, the family maintains a philosophy of "quality, passion, and tradition," emphasizing a deep respect for indigenous varieties and the unique mineral-rich "Terra Rossa" soils of their Costalunga estate.

Wine Description

The Zenato Recioto presents a deep garnet red colour with brilliant clarity in the glass. The nose offers an elegant and spicy bouquet, characterized by intense aromas of black cherry, Marasca cherries in alcohol, and plum, layered with notes of dried fig, cocoa, and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is luxuriously sweet and medium-bodied, where a 'fruit salad' of ripe blackberry and raisin flavours is balanced by soft, silky tannins and a refreshing acid line.

Crafted from a traditional blend of 80% Corvina Veronese, 10% Rondinella, and 10% Oseleta, the wine is produced using the appassimento method, where hand-picked grapes are dried for several months to concentrate their sugars and flavours. It is aged in tonneaux for 24 months followed by a further 12 months in the bottle. Stylistically, it is celebrated for its distinctive balance and velvet-like texture, offering a long, complex finish with hints of chocolate and sweet spice. It has a longevity of 10–15 years, making it an excellent candidate for the cellar.

title: Chocolate Shop Red
bodyHtml: Inviting black cherry and dark chocolate aromas entwine and continue on the palate surrounded by hints of cocoa powder. Nuances of red wine and residual sugar linger on the smooth finish. Sweetening the tongues for centuries, chocolate and red wine have been the most reliable pairing in history. Chocolate Shop takes this pairing to the next level, marrying chocolate flavour with red wine to create a great drink. Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled.

title: La Spinetta Moscato d'Asti 2024 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Moscato wine is famous for its sweet flavours of peaches and orange blossom. The word Moscato is the Italian name for Muscat Blanc, one of the oldest wine grapes in the world! 

This Moscato d'Asti is yellow in colour with slight green hues. On the nose, hints of mandarin, white peach and sage. It is fresh and mineral, with hints of citrus fruit, aromatic herbs and green apple on the palate.

For food pairing, two words: “Asian Food”. If you had to choose just one wine for pairing with sichuan, Thai and Vietnamese cuisine, it’d be Moscato. It handles spicy foods with grace since alcohol levels tend to be low and sweetness tends to be high. Moscato loves aromatic spices like ginger, cinnamon, cardamom and chile peppers. For proteins, try lighter meats like chicken and light flaky fish. That said, a sparkling Moscato would also match with BBQ Pork.

title: Donnafugata Ben Rye 2022 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Donnafugata is one of Italy's finest wineries, owned by the Rallo family, who have over a century of experience in the wine business. The name 'Ben Ryé' comes from the Arabic term for 'Son of the Wind,' a nod to the constant, fragrance-carrying winds that sweep the island's vineyards. Donnafugata is dedicated to 'heroic viticulture' on Pantelleria, a challenging yet rewarding practice involving working on terraced slopes supported by 40 km of drystone walls and cultivating vines in hollows using the traditional low bush vine alberello pantesco.

Wine Description

Brilliant amber, Ben Rye surprises with it freshness and complexity. The bouquet is intense and fragrant with aromas of apricots and candied citrus zest combined with balsamic scents of Mediterranean scrub and sweet notes of honey and fresh figs. The palate is well defined and intense, with pleasant sweetness well balanced by a fresh vein of acidity. It finishes with a lingering persistence. A captivating Passito di Pantelleria, one of the most appreciated Italian sweet wines in the world.

title: Inniskillin Ice Wine Cabernet Franc 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: The red berry characteristics of Cabernet Franc translates an ice wine into strawberry like aromas and flavours. This ice wine is completely different from the white Icewines. The colour comes from pressing only as there is no skin contact during fermentation. The earlier it is harvested, the darker the colour and the deeper the flavours.

title: Vineland Vidal Icewine 2017 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: This delicately balanced sweet nectar clearly demonstrates why Canadian Icewine is undisputedly considered a world class luxury. The concentrated shadowed essences of sponge toffee, buttered dates and candied blood orange are highlighted by impressions of fresh citrus, peach, apricot and warmed pear. This wine comes full on with a rich sweetness and then playfully dances away as the balancing acidity refreshes each sip. Still, the wine never really leaves you as the aftertaste is long and graceful and the memory every enduring.

title: Quady Essensia Orange Muscat 2021 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Essensia is a full-bodied sweet wine made with Orange Muscat grapes. The experience of Essensia is unmistakable: a rich gold in the glass is accompanied by spicy orange-apricot-pear flavours and aromas, balanced with perfect fruit acidity to finish clean, tempting you for one more sip. Essensia and dessert are sensational together. Pair with chocolate, almond, peach, apricot and apple desserts, or cheesecake. Dip in biscotti, moisten cakes, and add to truffles. Drink it alongside fresh goat cheese and enjoy the interplay between the sweet and sour flavours.

title: Clos Du Soleil Syrah 2022
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Similkameen Valley of British Columbia, this Syrah is a standout from the Keremeos and Cawston subregions. Clos Du Soleil is an artisanal winery co-owned by Managing Director and Winemaker Michael Clark, who applies a philosophy of minimal intervention and biodynamic viticulture. The winery is dedicated to producing ageable, elegant wines that reflect the unique, stony terroir of the Similkameen.

Wine Description

This single vineyard wine displays a deep purple colour in the glass. The perfumed nose is highly aromatic, featuring freshly crushed raspberries, plums, and violets, layered with subtle notes of wild sagebrush and forest undergrowth. On the palate, the wine is rich and complex, offering flavours of wild raspberries, black currants, and pomegranate, accented by black pepper and savory spice. It possesses a full mouthfeel supported by fine grained, stony tannins and a fresh, linear acidity.

title: Jackson Triggs Pinot Grigio
bodyHtml:
Jackson Triggs Pinot Grigio is produced in Canada, primarily within the Niagara Peninsula of Ontario. Founded in 1993 by Allan Jackson and Don Triggs, the winery has grown into one of the country's most recognized and awarded wine brands. The winemaking team is dedicated to a philosophy of craftsmanship and tradition, aiming to harvest grapes at peak ripeness to create approachable wines that express a 'new world' spirit.

Wine Description

This wine pours a pale lemon colour and offers a vibrant sensory profile. The nose features zesty aromas of lime, green apple, and pear, often accompanied by delicate floral notes and hints of cantaloupe or ginger. On the palate, it is light to medium bodied with a crisp, refreshing acidity that highlights flavours of bright citrus and tropical fruit. This extra dry wine concludes with a clean, brisk finish and typically possesses an ABV ranging from 12% to 12.5%.

title: Osoyoos Larose Le Grand Vin 2022
bodyHtml:
A flagship estate of the Canadian wine scene, Osoyoos Larose is a single-block vineyard overlooking the magnificent Osoyoos Lake. This jewel of the classic Bordeaux grape varieties has the substance and aromatic definition of the wines of this famous French region. Perfect with a 5-star meal featuring either beef tenderloin or a steak of venison.

Merlot dominant, with plush black cherries, and blackberries, on a velvet palate, structured via the Cabernets, and raging with chewy tannins. The fruit is very ripe and dense, with ample impact and intensity at this youthful stage, and will reward with time in the cellar. Le Grand Vin has certainly grown into its name, and is perennially one of BC's top reds!

title: Inniskillin Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml: Pale straw colour. Waxy, citrus, candy, herbs and cantaloupe aromas. Dry, medium-bodied with nutty, citrus fruit and melon flavours leaving one with a fresh, clean finish.

title: See Ya Later Rover 2022
bodyHtml:
See Ya Later Ranch is situated high above the Okanagan Valley on Hawthorne Mountain, reaching an elevation of nearly two thousand feet. Founded in 1919 by Major Hugh Fraser, the winery is named after the cheeky three-word note his London bride left for him upon seeing the rustic surroundings of the ranch.

Wine Description

Rover presents a deep cherry colour with an aromatic profile of ripe red fruits and intense dark berries. On the nose, perfumy floral notes from the Viognier component intermingle with spiced cherries, mocha, and a distinct hint of coarse ground black pepper. The palate is rich and full-bodied, featuring layers of creamy cassis, ripe plums, and spiced rum cake balanced by firm tannins and fresh acidity.

title: Sumac Ridge Merlot Private Reserve 2022
bodyHtml: Plums, red cherries, red currants, and a hint of spice on the nose. The palate has lots of plums, cranberries, and red currants with a subtle undertone of oak notes. The acid is lively with medium to soft tannins and a medium finish. This versatile, medium-bodied Merlot pairs well with hearty stews and chili dishes and delicious Italian favourites.

title: Sumac Ridge Cabernet - Merlot Private Reserve 2023
bodyHtml: Plenty of fresh ripe fruits on the nose with a slight hint of spice and toasted vanilla and mocha. The palate has similar flavors with lots of bright red fruit and some spice and vanilla. The finish is medium a nd the tannins are soft and approachable.

title: See Ya Later Ranch Ping Meritage 2024
bodyHtml:
See Ya Later Ranch is located in the Okanagan Valley of British Columbia, within the subregion of Okanagan Falls. The winery is part of the Great Estates Okanagan collective and is situated on a historic ranch originally established by Major Hugh Fraser, a colorful character in the valley's history. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the unique terroir of the elevated Hawthorne Mountain vineyards to produce expressive, award-winning VQA wines.

Wine Description

Ping Meritage presents a deep, dark red colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is a complex blend of cassis, dark tree fruits, and red berries, underpinned by notes of baking spice, toasted oak, and a hint of mocha. On the palate, this full-bodied Bordeaux-style blend offers rich flavours of black cherry and plum compote, balanced by medium acidity and semi-firm, luscious tannins.

title: Le Vieux Pin Petit Rouge 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in the South Okanagan Valley near Oliver, British Columbia, this red blend hails from one of Canada's most renowned wine regions. Le Vieux Pin, which released its first vintage in 2005, is celebrated for combining traditional French winemaking techniques with the bold character of the New World. The winery is dedicated to low-input viticulture and a non-interventionist winemaking philosophy, often being recognized as a leading producer of Syrah in the country.

Wine Description

Petit Rouge presents a deep and fragrant profile, featuring aromas of dark damson plum, wild blackberry, and perfumed cassis, seasoned with notes of cracked peppercorn and tart thorns. On the palate, this medium-bodied red is lively and harmonious, offering plush dark fruit, gentle spice, and a dusting of dried desert scrub. The wine is structured with lightly furry, polished tannins and a tangy acidity that keeps the finish fresh and duskily spiced.

title: Lake Breeze Spice Jar White 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Lake Breeze Winery, nestled on the picturesque Naramata Bench in British Columbia’s Okanagan Valley, is recognized for crafting expressive wines that capture the unique terroir of the region. Owned and operated by the Lake Breeze family since the early 1990s, the winery emphasizes minimal intervention to allow the vineyard's character to shine through each bottle.

Wine Description
The Lake Breeze Spice Jar White 2021 is a bright, aromatic blend showcasing a pale straw colour with silver highlights. On the nose, it bursts with inviting floral notes, mingled with citrus zest, ripe peach, and subtle tropical hints. The palate follows through with lively flavours of melon, green apple, and a touch of ginger spice, carried by a medium body and crisp acidity. The finish is clean and refreshing, leaving a delicate whisper of stone fruit. This vintage artfully balances freshness and aromatic complexity.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with lightly spiced Thai curries, lemongrass chicken, or fresh summer rolls. The gentle spice and aromatic lift of the wine complement fragrant dishes beautifully. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Long Weekend Wine Co. Chardonnay - Pinot Grigio
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine is from Canada, specifically from the Niagara Peninsula region in Ontario. Long Weekend Wine Co. is a brand of the family-owned Fielding Estate Winery, which was established by Heidi and Curtis Fielding. The 'Long Weekend' collection was launched in 2013 with a philosophy of creating delicious, easy-drinking VQA blends that deliver high quality at an approachable price point, intended for casual enjoyment such as cottage or poolside sipping.

Wine Description

The Long Weekend Wine Co. Chardonnay - Pinot Grigio presents a pale straw or yellow-green colour. The nose is aromatic and forward, featuring scents of ripe pear, melon, and white peach, complemented by notes of lemon zest, fresh herbs, and nuts. On the palate, the wine is light to medium bodied and extra dry, offering flavours of citrus fruit, green apple, and nectarine. It is characterized by its crisp, well-balanced acidity and a flavourful, lingering finish. This white blend is cool-fermented in stainless steel to preserve its fresh fruit character and is sealed with a screw cap. The ABV is 12.5%.

title: Synchromesh Riesling 2023
bodyHtml: With fruit from four vineyards Synchromesh works with Bob Hancock, Thorny Vines, Four Shadows on the Naramata Bench and the home Storm Haven Vineyard in Okanagan Falls. Bright, easy, and friendly, with green apple, sweet pear, and a swell of juicy acidity. Excellent value!

title: Mission Hill Merlot Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
In 1981, the Okanagan was largely undiscovered as a wine region, instead, it was renowned for the quality of its stone fruit orchards. Grape growers were just beginning to take risks, planting vines in unproven terrain. Despite these risks, the glacier-formed valley offered varying soil profiles, long, hot growing days, and diverse microclimates. These distinct subregions posed an opportunity to cultivate wine with unmistakable terroir. This potential inspired Mission Hill Family Estate’s vision for the future of Okanagan wine. After being recognized as Canada’s only five-time winner of Winery of the Year and receiving multiple best varietal awards on the international stage, they continue to draw inspiration from the valley and the vineyards they tend to. For them, the journey is just beginning.

Full-bodied and well structured, this wine is introduced with elegant notes of wild blackberry and dark cherry on the nose. The palate is rich with ripe dark fruits, refined tannins and a persistent finish.

title: Le Vieux Pin Syrah 'Cuvee Violette' 2021
bodyHtml:
Cuvee Violette, as the name suggests, displays the perfumed and floral side of this noble grape variety. The palate is silky smooth thanks to a gentle co-ferment with  under 1% Viognier. The focus is on the feminine and graceful qualities of Syrah coming to the foreground. In the cellar we kid around and call this wine a Syrah for Pinot Noir lovers. Crunchy bramble fruit and purple flowers mingle with pepper and spice. Red bramble fruits burst on the nose and on the palate.

This cuvee is ready to be enjoyed and savoured upon release. It can be aged for the mid-term (5-7 years). It will most likely continue to improve past that age too. Pair with duck breast with a lavender honey gastrique or steak with a flambe of rrème de violette and cassis moutarde is a match made in heaven as well.

title: 50th Parallel Pinot Noir 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
The Estate series, our flagship Pinot Noir, retains the qualities it has been defined by for a decade.

Dark ruby red hue with aromas of black cherry, anise and hazelnut. Flavours of dark ripe berries, dark cocoa and peppercorn with silky tannins with wet stone textures.

title: Moon Curser Syrah 2022
bodyHtml: South Okanagan is recognized as a producer of world class, elegant and powerful Syrah. Our delicious Syrah displays the signature notes of spices, dark fruits and floral notes, all backed up by lush and approachable tannins.

title: Mission Hill Syrah Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
Reserve Syrah was grown on their estate vineyard along the Black Sage Bench.

A diverse vineyard, with more than 60 different individual blocks affording them an amazing array of premium quality fruit. Its arid benchlands and warm climate allow the grapes to completely ripen for a full, complex flavour.

title: Black Cellar Blend 11 Pinot Grigio
bodyHtml:
Black Cellar is a popular Canadian wine brand produced by Arterra Wines Canada, which operates several historic wineries across the country. The 'Blend 11' series is crafted with a focus on consistency and accessibility, aiming to provide a reliable flavour profile that appeals to a wide range of palates. The winemaking philosophy centres on creating balanced, food friendly blends that celebrate the ease of casual social gatherings.

Wine Description

The Black Cellar Blend 11 Pinot Grigio is a light, crisp white wine with a pale straw colour. The aromatic profile is fresh and inviting, featuring delicate notes of green apple, citrus zest, and ripe pear. On the palate, the wine is light bodied and refreshing, offering clean flavours of lemon, white peach, and a touch of honeyed sweetness. It exhibits a vibrant acidity and a smooth, easy drinking finish with subtle floral undertones. While primarily composed of Pinot Grigio, the 'Blend 11' designation indicates a curated selection of grapes designed to enhance the wine's fruitiness and balance. It is best enjoyed chilled and within a year of purchase to maintain its youthful character.

title: Meyer Family Pinot Noir McLean Vineyards 2023
bodyHtml:
From Canada’s premier wine region, British Columbia’s Okanagan Valley, this Pinot Noir is crafted by Meyer Family Vineyards, a boutique winery based in Okanagan Falls. Established by JAK and Janice Meyer, the winery has built a strong reputation for producing small-lot wines with a Burgundian focus. Their McLean Creek Road Vineyard is a flagship site, known for its diverse slopes and soils that contribute to nuanced expressions of Pinot Noir.

This 2023 Pinot Noir showcases a vivid ruby hue, offering lifted aromas of red cherry, raspberry, and subtle wild herbs with an undercurrent of earthy spice. On the palate, it is elegantly textured, medium bodied, and vibrantly fresh, delivering flavours of cranberry, pomegranate, and forest floor. Gentle oak integration adds hints of vanilla and clove, with silky tannins leading into a lingering, refined finish.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with duck confit, wild mushroom risotto, or herb-roasted chicken. These dishes amplify the wine’s savoury elements and finesse. A perfect match to enhance the wine’s complexity.

title: Vineland Cabernet Sauvignon-Merlot 2020
bodyHtml: Vineland's value Cabernet-Merlot is one of the great bargains of Ontario wine year-in and year-out. Black cherry, cedar-vanilla and raspberry are all smells you'll pick out; while red fruit, hints of cedar and oaked-raspberry will be the flavours, all ending with a touch of vanilla on the finish.

title: Black Sage Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in Canada, this Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the Black Sage Bench, a prestigious subregion of the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. Black Sage Vineyard was established in 1992 by visionaries Harry McWatters and Bob Wareham, who defied skepticism by planting late-ripening French vinifera vines in the rugged, sun-scorched terrain of the northern Sonoran Desert. Today, under the guidance of winemaker Jason James, the winery is renowned for its 'boldness redefined' philosophy, producing robust reds that capture the intense spirit of this unique, arid landscape.

Wine Description

This full-bodied and robust red wine displays a deep, dark color characteristic of its bold profile. The nose offers alluring scents of lush cherries and vibrant raspberries, layered with hints of vanilla, mocha, and a touch of earthy notes. On the palate, it reveals enticing flavors of dark cherries, cassis, and rich dark chocolate, complemented by baking spices and a distinct minerality. The structure is defined by firm yet approachable tannins and a bright acidity that leads to a long, lingering finish.

Food Pairing

  • Grilled steak or roast beef, where the meat’s protein helps mellow the wine's firm tannins.

  • Rack of lamb or a hearty lamb stew seasoned with rosemary and thyme

title: Dirty Laundry Bordello 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: An exotic swirl of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot with a dash of Cab Franc sourced from the Okanagan & Similkameen Valleys. This wine is silky, velvety, and full-bodied. A big red wine with aromas of meat spice, cocoa, vanilla, blackberry, blackcurrant and anise. Firm tannins, finishes dry with lingering flavours of anise, cherry, toffee and tobacco. Pairs perfectly with grilled and BBQ, rare to medium rare cuts of meat such as lamb and venison.

title: Laughing Stock Pinot Gris 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Laughing Stock Pinot Gris originates from Canada, specifically the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. The winery, Laughing Stock Vineyards, was founded in 2003 by David and Cynthia Enns, who transitioned from careers in the financial industry. The name of the winery is a playful reference to the risky nature of starting a winery, a sentiment often heard from their former financial colleagues. The winemaking philosophy is based on producing high-quality, hand-crafted wines, with an emphasis on staying out of the way of over-processing the fruit. The winery is located on the prestigious Naramata Bench.

Wine Description

This is a white wine made from the Pinot Gris varietal, which is the most planted white grape in the Okanagan Valley. It consistently produces an enjoyable, fruit-forward, and food-friendly wine. The Alcohol By Volume (ABV) is 13.00 percent.

title: Black Hills Red Blend Bona Fide 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Canada, specifically from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. Founded in 1996, Black Hills Estate Winery is a pioneer of the Black Sage Bench, one of the most arid and sun drenched sites in the country. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a 'pre industrial' approach, utilizing small batch fermentation and traditional methods to capture the authentic expression of its unique desert terroir.

Wine Description

The Black Hills Bona Fide 2024 is a vibrant, deep crimson red with a complex sensory profile. The nose offers pure, expressive notes of sappy blackberry, red plum, and wild raspberry, elegantly framed by perfumed aromatics of white peppercorn, anise, and lavender. On the palate, the wine is juicy and full bodied, featuring a 'masterful balance' of fruit concentration and a distinct stony minerality. It is characterized by its polished, supple tannins and a beautifully textured finish. This blend typically consists of Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Malbec, and Sangiovese. The wine was fermented with wild yeasts and matured for 10 months in concrete and French oak barriques. The ABV is 13.5%. While the estate follows sustainable practices and has transitioned to organic farming for its vineyards.

title: Blasted Church Big Bang Theory 2024
bodyHtml:
Blasted Church Vineyards is an award-winning winery in Okanagan Falls. Their name and inspiration come from a piece of local folklore: in 1929, a small church was successfully dismantled and moved using a controlled dynamite blast to loosen the nails. They focus on creating high-quality, expressive wines that reflect their terroir, while having fun doing it.

Wine Description

The Big Bang Theory is a joyful blend of six different varietals. Floral notes introduce the wine followed by strawberries, raspberries, cherries, plums and a hint of chocolate. Dried cherries and cranberries open the attack with plum, blueberry and mint carrying through the mid-palate as the tannin builds through the finish.

Food Pairing

Its richness and structure make it suitable for red meats, grilled sausages, rich mushroom dishes, lasagna, or any pastas with red sauce.

title: Haywire Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml: Haywire is the flagship brand of Okanagan Crush Pad Winery, founded by Christine Coletta and Steve Lornie, who transitioned from 'city slickers to farmers to winery owners'. Winemakers Matt Dumayne and Kat D'Costa approach the Okanagan's unique terroir with a 'less is more' philosophy, favouring a simple, almost hands-off winemaking style, often utilizing state-of-the-art concrete tanks.

title: Black Hills Estate Viognier
bodyHtml: Candied peach hits the nose on an initial sniff of this ever-so-slightly off-dry Viognier. Fragrances of white flowers and pear follow and linger in the background. Fruity notes carry through onto the palate showing juicy stone fruit notes and light minerality with a crisp finish. This white wine pairs beautifully with fresh seared scallops garnished with herbs and lemon.

title: Road 13 Fifth Element 2020
bodyHtml: A gentle giant where spice and smoke meet balanced fruit and oak. Aromas of black cherry and leather balance beautifully with notes of blackberry compote and baking spices. This full-bodied red is fruit-forward and plush with silky tannins and a refined finish.

title: Hester Creek Cabernet Franc Old Vine 2022
bodyHtml:
Made from our 50-year-old vines, this Cabernet Franc reflects the elegance and finesse that only develops from vines perfectly suited to their terroir. 

The heady aromas show fresh fruit characters of blackberry and cherry, which meet cocoa and vanilla bean on the nose. A succulent and persistent palate follows of ripe raspberries and blackberries, supported by mild toasty notes. 

Well-crafted and complex, this vintage pairs beautifully with beef tenderloin or try duck breast with a raspberry jus.

title: Tantalus Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml: Showcasing bright floral notes alongside cocoa, red berries, and cedar. The palate is beautifully complex and nuanced, with swaths of red currant, cherry, and fig spun together with a unique mineral expression. Aged in oak barriques for 15 months.

title: Ruby Tuesday Red Stiletto
bodyHtml: Notes of red and black fruits, light in tannins with a smoky nose. A blend of Syrah, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Pinot.

title: Poplar Grove Cabernet Franc 2020
bodyHtml: Aromas of red berry fruit and cedar. The palate begins with blueberry and dark chocolate flavours and finishes with hints of vanilla and dried herbs.

title: Noble Ridge Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml:
This refreshing white wine hails from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, specifically from the Okanagan Falls subregion. Founded in 2001 by Jim and Leslie D’Andrea, Noble Ridge Vineyard & Winery began with only 3.5 acres of vines and has since grown into a prestigious 24-acre estate known for its 'noble' varieties. The winery’s philosophy centers on a minimalistic approach and sustainable practices, aiming to coax the ultimate expression of their unique, mineral-rich glacial till terroir into every bottle.

Wine Description

This Pinot Grigio presents as a clean and dry expression of the varietal with a light straw hue. The nose is greeted by refreshing aromas of green apple, pear, and citrus, layered with hints of white peach, honeysuckle, and a touch of minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and well-balanced, delivering vibrant fruit flavours and a crisp, lingering finish characterized by zesty citrus and mineral notes. Fermented primarily in stainless steel to preserve its bright, delicate fruit character, this wine showcases a focus on freshness and purity.

title: Tawse Pinot Noir Growers Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
The 2021 Tawse Pinot Noir Growers Blend, sourced from the Niagara Peninsula, offers a classic expression of Ontario Pinot Noir. This vintage reflects a blend of estate-grown and sourced fruit from the region, showcasing the complexity and elegance of Niagara’s terroir.

Colour: Bright ruby red.
Aroma: Earthy with notes of raspberry, red plum, and subtle hints of tea leaves and oak spice.
Palate: Medium-bodied and dry, featuring vibrant raspberry and blackberry flavors alongside smoky and mineral undertones.
Body: Light to medium-bodied with moderate tannins, creating a smooth mouthfeel.
Finish: Balanced with a lingering, rounded finish.

Accolades:
90 Points – Wine Club Canada
Bronze Medal – 2023 National Wine Awards of Canada

Aged for 12 months in French oak barrels, this wine is ready to drink now but can develop with further aging through 2026. It pairs wonderfully with dishes such as beef Bourguignon, grilled chicken, salmon, or charcuterie platters, making it a versatile choice for many occasions. With an ABV of 12.5%, this wine embodies the elegant and approachable style that Tawse Winery is known for across its portfolio.

This blend reflects the winery's commitment to sustainable viticulture and thoughtful winemaking practices, delivering a wine that’s expressive yet approachable.

title: Poplar Grove Pinot Gris 2025
bodyHtml: Pale straw in colour. Intense aromas of fresh white peach, lime zest, and melon. Flavours of yuzu and nectarine create a soft, fruity finish. A light-bodied wine balanced with medium acidity. This is an exceptional expression of this very popular varietal.

title: Mission Hill Pinot Noir Reserve 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Mission Hill Family Estate is a pioneering winery located in West Kelowna, British Columbia, within the world-renowned Okanagan Valley. Founded by Anthony von Mandl with a vision to establish the region on the global stage, the winery follows a philosophy of sustainable and regenerative farming, utilizing modern technology alongside traditional Old World techniques. The Reserve Collection is crafted from hand-selected blocks across five distinct subregions, reflecting the diverse soil profiles and microclimates that define the valley's unique terroir.

Wine Description

The Mission Hill Reserve Pinot Noir is a charming and classic expression of the Okanagan, displaying a medium ruby colour with magenta glints. The aromatic profile is complex, front-loading notes of fresh strawberries, raspberries, and dark cherries, layered with savoury undertones of rainforest floor, leather, and herbal spice. On the palate, the wine is elegant and fresh, featuring juicy red fruit flavours nicely offset by a firm wood structure and a seasoning of desert sagebrush and anise. It is medium bodied with delicate, supple tannins and a persistent, balanced finish. Crafted from 100% Pinot Noir and aged for 10 months in French oak, this wine is approachable now but is suitable for further aging.

title: Cave Spring Cabernet Franc 'Estate' 2020
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from our Cave Spring Vineyard, nestled on a gently sloping terrace of the Niagara Escarpment overlooking Lake Ontario known as the Beamsville Bench. This hillside terroir, with its combination of limestone-clay soils, elevation and moderating onshore breezes, provides ideal conditions for Cabernet Franc, yielding a robust wine with a spicy, mint-berry character unique to our site.

Medium ruby in colour. The nose is complex, integrated aromas of cherry-menthol, cedar, graphite and black licorice, with forest floor and eucalyptus in behind. Palate medium bodied with firm, fine-grained tannins and macerating cherry fruit up front; the tannic grip loosens and broadens, melding with saturated cassis and black raspberry flavours in the middle; the finish is elegant and layered, with persistent notes of berry compote, blacktop, charcoal and peppermint.

title: Pelee Island Premium Merlot 2018 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Deep red in colour. Rich, full-bodied and intense. It’s lively and tangy on the palate with savoury herb, pomegranate, red currant and racy red cherry. Genuine depth on the finish. Roasted savoury chicken, rich lamb, hearty beef stew with root veggies or vegetarian chili.

title: Lake Breeze Sauvignon Blanc 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Characteristic flavours and aromas of grapefruit, gooseberry and citrus are followed by underlying hints of asparagus and fresh cut grass.

title: Lake Breeze Pinot Noir 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Lots of juicy red fruit, ripe strawberry and raspberry with a slightly floral and savoury undercurrent. The fruit for this wine is 100% estate grown.

title: Tinhorn Creek Merlot Reserve 2021
bodyHtml: Tinhorn Creek has always been known for its Merlot. The Oldfield Reserve is full and expansive with mocha, smoked blackberry, resin and dark, fertile soils, overridden with a sweet, vanilla wood spice and rough hewn wood structure. This is on the rustic, rough and ready for a BBQ side!

title: Noble Ridge Pinot Noir Reserve 2022
bodyHtml: This Pinot Noir exhibits a deep ruby colour and complex nose featuring bright red fruit aromas of strawberry and cherry. The palate follows with ripe red fruit, subtle vanilla and anise with a touch of earthiness. A wine in harmonious balance, the structure and intensity indicate a Pinot Noir of such quality that it will age gracefully for another 5 to 6 years.

title: Lake Breeze Pinot Gris 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Lake Breeze Pinot Gris originates from Canada, within the British Columbia region and the highly acclaimed Naramata Bench sub-appellation of the Okanagan Valley. Founded in the mid-1990s and featuring estate vine plantings dating back to 1985, Lake Breeze Vineyards operates with a philosophy centered on expressing the pure maritime microclimate created by Okanagan Lake. Winemaker Garron Elmes focuses on preserving the classic cool-climate vitality of the benchland. By prioritizing gentle fruit handling and minimal intervention in the cellar, the winery yields a vibrant, approachable white wine that celebrates regional fruit clarity, bright natural acidity, and textural elegance.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a clear, pale straw appearance in the glass with bright yellow-green highlights. It possesses a light-to-medium-bodied structure that balances a round, supple mouthfeel with a clean, crisp overall texture. The sensory profile is fragrant and fruit-forward, opening with expressive aromas of ripe juicy peach, orchard nectarine, Asian pear, quince, and candied green apple, backed by delicate white floral blossoms and subtle lemon peel citrus notes. On the lively palate, it delivers crisp tree fruit flavors and melon notes interwoven with a characteristic hint of white pepper spice and subtle herbal undertones. The finish is remarkably clean, refreshed by vibrant, well-balanced natural acidity that leaves a lingering impression of crunchy green fruit and flinty minerality.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Gris.

  • Stylistic Notes: Hand-picked to maintain fruit integrity, the grapes undergo cool stainless steel fermentation without oak contact to retain maximum freshness and varietal purity. The wine is crafted in an off-dry to dry style with very low residual sugar (typically around 4.0 g/L), yielding a crisp, thirst-quenching character.

  • ABV: Typically 13.5% to 14.0% depending on the vintage.

  • Organic Status: While Lake Breeze employs sustainable viticultural techniques, manual canopy management, and eco-conscious water practices, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Sandhill Sangiovese 'Small Lots' 2017
bodyHtml:
Garnet colour with a wonderful, warming bouquet of red cherry, earth, savoury herbs, oak, spice and cedar chest. This medium to full-bodied wine has soft drying tannins, wonderful texture and food-friendly acidity. Lovely flavours of red cherry, plum, warm spice and oak unfold on the palate. The lingering finish shows notes of red cherry, dark plum, earth and savoury spice.
 
Pairs well with meaty cheesy lasagna, slow-cooked stew with a side of polenta.

title: Blasted Church Pinot Gris 2024
bodyHtml: Straw in colour. Peach, nectarine, lemon, honey, Granny Smith apple, pear on the nose. The palate is a terrific reflection of the nose. Rich stone fruit on the attack through into the beautifully textured mid-palate. The pear, apple, and citrus pile on into the vibrant finish.

title: Blasted Church Hatfield's Fuse 2024
bodyHtml: Hatfield's Fuse is a cornucopia of flavours made with 11 different grape varietals. The wine opens with an abundance of stone fruit - apricot and peach - followed by spicy floral notes, green apple, lemon and orange blossom that carry to a bright, well-balanced finish. Enjoy with everything from sushi and halibut to curry dishes, roasted chicken and creamy pastas.

title: Blasted Church Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot 2019
bodyHtml: Breathe in. Breathe out. Now sip. Cassis, blueberry and leather relax into chocolate and cocoa notes. You can get your yoga pants on because Friday plans are flexible.

title: Black Hills Nota Bene 2023
bodyHtml: Nota Bene opens with intense and ripe fruit aromas, with plum, raspberry and black cherry to the fore. On the palate, the ripeness and richness of this fruit is beautifully balanced by crunchy red currant flavours, while notes of milk chocolate and clove spice integrate seamlessly into the wine. A savory element adds another dimension, with subtle rosemary and cedar flavours. The tannins are fine and elegant, and the wine finishes strongly with fresh acidity and a silky texture. A powerful yet refined wine with impressive ageing potential.

title: Poplar Grove The Legacy 2018
bodyHtml: The Legacy is a singular wine defined by the sum of its parts. Elegant and refined, this version marries power and finesse, with serious density and grip. Bordeaux-inspired perhaps, but with the suppleness and freshness that is purely Okanagan.

title: Painted Rock Syrah Skaha Bench 2022
bodyHtml:
Painted Rock Estate Winery was purchased in 2004 by John and Trish Skinner, who envisioned it as a family legacy dedicated to crafting ultra-premium Okanagan wine. The 56-acre bench, overlooking Skaha Lake in Penticton, was selected for its ideal terroir, and the winery operates under an uncompromising pursuit of quality, believing in the Okanagan Valley's potential to be an internationally recognized wine region.

Wine Description

It pours an inky black colour and presents a tightly wound set of aromatics. The richly fragrant nose features notes of dark plums, almonds, and cracked pepper, with lingering hints of eucalyptus and violets. The palate is dense, broad, and brooding, showcasing concentrated dark fruit and blackberry leaf, along with flavours of cassis and cured meat, adding depth and complexity.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include grilled pork loin, steak and fries, beef stew, or any mushroom dishes. The winery's Wine Club Manager suggests aged gouda and bresaola, often served on their charcuterie plates.

title: Quails' Gate Chardonnay Stewart Family Reserve 2023
bodyHtml: As the flagship white wine at Quails' Gate, their Stewart Family Reserve Chardonnay has a reputation for its quality and consistency. It is rich with a palate bursting with vibrant orchard fruit and an elegant creamy charm.

title: Quails' Gate Old Vines Foch 2023
bodyHtml: Dark and inky in colour this big jammy brute of a wine combines powerful aromatics of brooding black fruit, smoky cigar box and earthy savoury complexities that are only found in Marechal Foch. Interspersed with cloves, allspice and plummy ripe confectionary, the palate is rich and round with soft lush tannins. Tempt your taste buds and pair this wine with porcini and red wine risotto or braised lamb shanks.

title: Clos Du Soleil Fume Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: The wine spends a little time in oak and thus is a well-managed, fuller white, with racy freshness and a distinct smoked stone character. The semillon was whole cluster pressed, while the Sauvignon Blanc spent a few hours on its skins before pressing. They were blended just prior to bottling. Linear and tight with nervy grapefruit laced acids, Asian pear crunchiness and a thick cushion of lees. A thread of smoke throughout, though less so than in previous years, taking back seat to the white asparagus, herbal and lemon thistle notes.

title: Red Rooster Pinot Noir 2025
bodyHtml:
Red Rooster Winery, is not afraid to make bold choices. Through precise techniques and an innovative approach, such as concrete tanks and natural fermentation, their wines showcase the best that the Okanagan Valley has to offer.
An aromatic presence reveals black cherry, dark plum, sweet vanilla extract, oak and spice. This extra-dry, medium to full-bodied Merlot has soft drying tannins and fruit flavours of blue plum, and black cherry accented by spice and cocoa powder notes. Black tea, blackberry, cherry, spice and coffee bean notes linger on the finish.

title: Sandhill Pinot Gris 2023
bodyHtml: Clear and bright with fresh, clean aromas of Bartlett pear, melon, yellow apple, and a touch of banana and apricot. This medium-bodied Pinot Gris has a smooth, slightly rich mouthfeel. Wonderful flavours of pear, melon and tropical fruit fill the mouth. Refreshing notes of green apple, citrus and white currant linger on the finish. Serve lightly chilled at 14 to 15˚C (to enhance the rich mouthfeel). Pairs well with leek and mushroom quiche, sautéed scallops, crab cakes with mayo dipping sauce and coconut shrimp.

title: Kettle Valley Pinot Gris 2023
bodyHtml: That’s right! It’s a lovely pink! It’s also flavourful, aromatic, and full-bodied with good structure, a rich mouthfeel, and a spicy finish. One of the most classic BC Pinot Gris, and the one that started the trend for a pretty copper hue. This beauty of a Pinot Gris shows classic red and green apples, pear, citrus, and tropical notes. Drink this when you eat any white fish or salmon.

title: Kettle Valley Pinot Noir Reserve 2021
bodyHtml: The inspiration for the Kettle Valley Winery's name is the famed Kettle Valley Railway which ran through Naramata between 1915 and 1961, connecting the Southern Interior of British Columbia to the markets of the Pacific Northwest. Passion and a dedication to excellence were requirements for building the railway, and at Kettle Valley, they feel that same passion and dedication for their red wines which are known for their elegant and well-structured natures and their white wines that are flavourful and aromatic with a rich mouth feel. Pinot Noir is always perfect for a wide variety of cuisine.

title: Jackson Triggs Reserve Okanagan Estate Shriaz 2022
bodyHtml:
This bold red wine hails from Canada’s renowned Okanagan Valley, British Columbia’s most prestigious wine-growing region. Jackson Triggs, a cornerstone of Canadian winemaking, is part of Arterra Wines Canada and has consistently garnered acclaim for its innovative yet terroir-driven approach. Their Reserve line emphasizes expressive varietals grown in the Okanagan’s unique microclimates, reflecting the vineyard's dedication to quality and sustainability.

Wine Description
The 2022 Shiraz reveals a deep ruby hue with flashes of violet at the rim. On the nose, rich aromas of blackberry, cracked pepper, and smoky oak unfold alongside subtle notes of dark chocolate and baking spice. The palate is full-bodied and supple, delivering layers of ripe black fruit, plum compote, and savoury spice. Fine tannins and well-integrated oak provide structure and balance, while the long finish leaves a lingering touch of vanilla and mocha.

Food Pairing
Pair this Shiraz with slow-braised beef short ribs, grilled lamb chops with rosemary, or smoked gouda and charcuterie. The wine’s bold character and peppery nuance stand up well to robust dishes, enhancing both the wine’s intensity and the food’s savoury appeal. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Sandhill Merlot 2021
bodyHtml:
Harvested from Sandhill Estate and Hidden Terrace vineyards in the Okanagan Valley and Vanessa Vineyard in the Similkameen Valley this Cabernet Merlot blend features 60% Merlot, 22% Cabernet Sauvignon, 18% Cabernet Franc. 

This is a full-bodied wine with firm drying tannins and good structure. Flavours of ripe black fruits, spice, oak, and vanilla extract fill the mouth. The extra-dry lingering finish shows notes of black tea, black currant, blackberry, and sweet spice, with an added note of vanilla and roasted coffee bean.

title: Cedar Creek Crafted In BC Pinot Gris 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

CedarCreek Crafted In BC Pinot Gris 2024 is a unique white wine from the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia, Canada, produced under a special regulatory exemption. Founded in 1988, CedarCreek is a pioneer of the British Columbia wine industry and is currently owned by the von Mandl family, who have championed a winemaking philosophy of minimal intervention and sustainable viticulture. This 'Crafted In BC' edition was necessitated by a severe 2024 winter freeze that destroyed nearly all local fruit, leading the winery to source premium grapes from the Willamette Valley in Oregon to be processed at their Kelowna estate.

Wine Description

This 100% Pinot Gris presents a straw-yellow colour and a sensory profile that balances fresh acidity with generous fruit concentration. The nose is defined by inviting aromas of Golden Delicious apple, ripe pear, and white flowers, with subtle hints of almond and spice. On the palate, the wine is lively and 'friendly', offering flavours of fleshy white peach, cantaloupe, and green apple.
