It features a supple mid-palate and a round, vibrant finish with a touch of mineral character. To add depth and texture, 90% of the wine was fermented in stainless steel while 10% was fermented in neutral oak. This vintage has an ABV of 13% and approximately 7.3 grams per litre of residual sugar, and while the home estate is certified organic, this out-of-province fruit is not.

title: Hester Creek Pinot Gris 2025
bodyHtml: Nearly transparent in the glass, with a lightly effervescent pink grapefruit opening, followed by pear and apple with a puckery lemon finish. A crisp delight with a lemony caesar salad or roasted snapper or cod with limes and fennel.

title: Kettle Valley Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml: This Chardonnay shows rich tropical fruit flavours of pineapple and ripe stone fruit on the palate. Crisp acidity, medium body, and hints of vanilla. This wine has not gone through malolactic fermentation.

title: Kettle Valley Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml: The inspiration for Kettle Valley Winery's name is the famed Kettle Valley Railway which ran through Naramata between 1915 and 1961, connecting the Southern Interior of British Columbia to the markets of the Pacific Northwest. Passion and a dedication to excellence were requirements for building the railway, and at Kettle Valley, they feel that same passion and dedication for their red wines which are known for their elegant and well-structured natures and their white wines that are flavourful and aromatic with a rich mouth feel.

title: Kettle Valley Merlot 2022
bodyHtml: The inspiration for  Kettle Valley Winery's name is the famed Kettle Valley Railway, which ran through Naramata between 1915 and 1961, connecting the Southern Interior of British Columbia to the markets of the Pacific Northwest. Passion and a dedication to excellence were requirements for building the railway, and at Kettle Valley, they feel that same passion and dedication for their red wines, which are known for their elegant and well-structured natures and their white wines, which are flavourful and aromatic with a rich mouth feel. This is a satisfying Merlot, with ripe tannins and flavours of black currants and blackberries. 100% Merlot. Pairs well with jambalaya, barbeque, lamb and meat sauces.

title: Kettle Valley Old Main Red 2018
bodyHtml: The flagship red wine from Kettle Valley Winery is the Bordeaux blend, Old Main Red, named for the vineyard where most of the grapes are grown. The wine is popular among those who collect and cellar red wines from the Okanagan. The winemaking style at Kettle Valley is well suited to collectible wines.

title: Jackson Triggs Chardonnay Reserve 2023
bodyHtml:
This Chardonnay comes from Canada’s celebrated Niagara Peninsula in Ontario, a region renowned for its cool-climate viticulture. Jackson-Triggs, founded in 1993 and named after its founders Allan Jackson and Don Triggs, is one of Canada’s most recognized wineries. The winery prides itself on producing expressive wines that showcase the unique terroir of their vineyards.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay displays a bright straw colour with golden reflections. On the nose, it reveals enticing aromas of ripe pear, crisp apple, and hints of toasted vanilla. The palate is medium bodied with layers of orchard fruit, subtle citrus zest, and well-integrated oak nuances that bring notes of cream and gentle spice. The finish is smooth and lingering, underscored by balanced acidity that lends freshness.

Food Pairing

Enjoy this wine with roast chicken and herbed potatoes, creamy mushroom pasta, or a selection of semi-soft cheeses. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Sandhill Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Clear and bright with a straw-yellow hue and a bouquet of red apple, lemon, toasty oak, spice, vanilla bean and lemon custard. A full-bodied Chardonnay with a smooth, slightly rich mouthfeel, and flavours of apple, pear, citrus and biscuit. The long lingering finish has flavours of grilled lemon, spice and delicate oak. Serve not overly chilled at 14 to 16°C with baked halibut, mushroom risotto, and creamy pasta with smoked salmon.

title: Sandhill Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Sandhill Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot is a red wine from Canada, produced in the British Columbia region and the Okanagan Valley appellation. Sandhill Wines, established in 1997, is a pioneer in producing premium VQA wines from both the Okanagan and Similkameen Valleys. The winery's philosophy is to craft wines that are approachable in style, using classic varietals, and ensuring each bottle reflects the distinct character of the site where the grapes were grown.

Wine Description

The wine has a deep garnet colour. The aromatic profile features a lovely bouquet of blackcurrant and dark plum fruit, mingling with spice box, smoke, and oak. Other notes include black cherry and blue plum.

The varietal composition is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. One source indicates the blend is 15.00% Merlot, while another refers to the style as a Bordeaux Blend Red. It is a full bodied wine. The palate is full of flavours of black cherry, blackcurrant, oak, and spice. It has soft drying tannins and good structure. Stylistically, it is a bold and structured red blend, with fruit forward flavours. The wine was aged for 24 months in 30% French and 70% American oak barrels, with 10% new French oak used to add complexity. The finish is an extra-dry, lingering one, showing notes of black tea, cocoa powder, blackcurrant, blackberry, spicy oak, and smoke. The ABV is either 13.9% or 15.0%. The optimal drinking window is potentially through 2028. Information on the organic status of the wine is not available in the sources.

Food Pairing

This Full Bodied & Robust red wine is a great pairing for steaks, barbecue fare, and full-flavoured cheeses. Recommended pairings also include beef, lamb, and game.

title: Dirty Laundry Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
On the nose, you will find aromas of pink peppercorn, black cherry & cedar. The palate is full bodied, with round, mouth filling tannins and flavours of blackberry, graphite, red plum and mocha.

Braised beef short rib, roasted lamb chops, elk tenderloin or a marinated portobello mushroom cap with grilled asparagus will be excellent with this wine!

title: Tinhorn Creek Merlot 2023
bodyHtml: Opaque dark purplish red hue. Nose is rich with chocolate covered cherries, blueberries, leather and vanilla bean. Palate is dense with lots of fresh fruit, sweet oak that builds up the tannins and gives the wine great texture. Smooth and powerful.

title: Tinhorn Creek Cabernet Franc 2024
bodyHtml:
Tinhorn Creek Vineyards, established in 1993, is situated in the Okanagan Valley of British Columbia, Canada. Known for its commitment to producing premium wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region, Tinhorn Creek has become a benchmark for quality in Canadian winemaking.

Wine Description

Tinhorn Creek Cabernet Franc presents a deep purple hue, indicative of its youthful vibrancy. On the nose, it offers aromas of black cherry, strawberry, and rhubarb pie, complemented by subtle notes of cocoa powder and pie crust. The palate is greeted with flavors of redcurrant and rhubarb, supported by fine tannins and bright acidity. This structure provides a tactile experience reminiscent of a well-crafted Chianti, yet showcases the fresh red fruit characteristics typical of New World wines.

Food Pairing

This full-bodied and robust Cabernet Franc pairs excellently with grilled steak, roast beef, rack of lamb, lamb shank, osso buco, and sharp cheddar cheese. These pairings enhance the wine's depth and character, creating a memorable dining experience.

title: Tinhorn Creek Pinot Noir 2025
bodyHtml: Dark in colour with a deep red, purple hue. The wine has aromas of black cherries and dried herbs. The palate has great intensity and shows warmth with round mid-palate layers of fruit and spice. It has an interesting bergamot, black tea edge to it and also shows some bitter orange in the finish.

title: Tinhorn Creek Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: A soft, ripe, easy-drinking Chardonnay with a mix of peach fruit and green apple. Enjoy this wine with poached salmon!

title: Tinhorn Creek Pinot Gris 2025
bodyHtml: This Pinot Gris is one of their most luscious and vibrant to date, bursting with fresh lively aromas of citrus mixed with tropical fruit. The grapes once harvested, were de-stemmed and gently pressed. Fermentation with native and cultured yeasts in a cool environment releases and preserves the fresh fruit flavours. This wine is dry and can be enjoyed on its own or paired with seafood or light meat dishes.

title: Hester Creek Cabernet - Merlot 2022
bodyHtml: Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot combine to make a concentrated red blend that speaks to the terroir of the South Okanagan. This red wine is full-bodied and robust. Pair with grilled steak, roast beef, rack of lamb and sharp cheese.

title: Painted Rock Red Icon 2021
bodyHtml: Dark and rich blackberry, cassis, dark cherry, and chocolate aromas. The palate is full and structured with black fruit and baking spices with mouth-filling ripe tannins and high acidity. Tuck this one in your cellar for the ultimate reward.

title: Gray Monk Chardonnay Unwooded 2025
bodyHtml:
The Gray Monk Chardonnay Unwooded 2025 originates from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. Established in 1972 by George and Trudy Heiss, the winery is a pioneer of the British Columbia estate winery program and is now owned and operated by Andrew Peller Limited. The estate features 75 acres of vineyards overlooking Okanagan Lake, maintaining a winemaking philosophy focused on pure fruit expression and cool-climate excellence.

Wine Description

This unwooded Chardonnay is clear and bright, displaying a straw yellow hue. A clean, fresh aroma of yellow apple, Bartlett pear, golden kiwi, and quince rises from the glass. This smooth yet refreshing, medium bodied wine offers a medley of orchard fruit and melon flavours on the palate. Notes of citrus (lemon and lime), apple, and pear linger on the finish.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs exceptionally well with roasted chicken, mushroom quiche, or poached salmon. It is also a wonderful match for creamy potato salad and soft cheeses like Brie.

title: Lake Breeze Ehrenfelser 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: The wines of Lake Breeze are known to be clean, crisp and fruit driven in style.  They endeavour to take the natural expression of the grape and transfer it to the bottle with as little intervention as possible. Packed with flavours and aromas of dried peach and apricot. The acidity balances the slight sweetness and makes it a perfect match for spicier food.

title: Hester Creek Merlot 2022
bodyHtml: This pure expression of Merlot opens with enticing scents of Italian plum, cherry, malt, sage and mocha. A mouth-filling and expansively round palate follows of plum, earth, dark chocolate and alfalfa. Smooth, rich and delicious, this premium Reserve Merlot pairs nicely with grilled rib eye and a corn and blue cheese polenta.

title: Pelee Island Pinot Noir Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Pelee Island Pinot Noir Reserve VQA is a medium-bodied red wine from the country of Canada, specifically the Pelee Island appellation in Ontario. It is produced by Pelee Island Winery, which operates the southernmost vineyards in Canada, where the island's long, sun-drenched growing season allows Pinot Noir grapes to ripen with finesse while retaining fresh acidity. As a VQA (Vintners Quality Alliance) wine, it adheres to strict standards regarding origin and production.

Description

This Pinot Noir is a "Reserve" expression, meaning it receives more significant oak influence and selection than the standard bottling.

  • Maturation: Typically 50% barrel-aged in French and European oak for a period of 6 months, which adds complexity, structure, and subtle spice.

  • Colour: Medium ruby red.

  • Aroma: Perfumed and expressive, featuring aromas of cherry, vanilla, and earth, with underlying hints of chocolate and smoke.

  • Palate: Medium-bodied and fruity. It delivers layers of sweet red berries, plum, and sour cherry, complemented by notes of mushroom, herbs, and baking spices.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a silky texture and well-balanced acidity.

  • Finish: Moderate to long, with a clean and harmonious exit.

  • ABV: Typically ranges from 12.5% to 13.5% depending on the vintage.

title: Summerhill Gewurztraminer 2022
bodyHtml: On the nose this wine is bursting with stone fruit, lychee, rose petal, ruby red grapefruit and orange blossoms. On the palate it is full-bodied with a long floral finish and subtle hints of baking spice. Clean, fruity, floral, and delicious. Classic Gewurztraminer.

title: St Hubertus Chasselas 2022
bodyHtml: This is the quintessential wine, perfect for your fondue or raclette party at the ski chalet or anywhere. Delicate and refreshing, with grassy floral notes on the nose, it is light-bodied and finishes with the freshness of lemon zest. Great as an aperitif with salads, cheeses or try it with sushi and sashimi.

title: Vineland Estates Elevation Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: Layers of mature fruit, seasoned cedar, chocolate nib and a hint of espresso bean are all underpinned by crumbled dry earth on warm limestone. The vivid acidity and resolved but sturdy structure bring a focus to this ample array that provides a dramatic but elusive image. It is like a bold outline in shadow.

title: Jackson Triggs Merlot Proprietor's Selection
bodyHtml:
Originating from Canada in the famous Niagara Peninsula region of Ontario, Jackson Triggs Merlot Proprietor's Reserve represents an accessible, classic expression of everyday Canadian winemaking. Founded in 1993 by Allan Jackson and Don Triggs, Jackson Triggs has grown into one of Canada's most recognized and celebrated wineries. Sourced from estate and select grower vineyards across the Niagara region, the winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing ripe fruit character, gentle oak integration, and approachable structural balance to craft food-friendly, dependable varietal wines.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, medium ruby red colour with soft garnet highlights in the glass. An inviting and fresh bouquet opens with aromas of dark cherry, wild plum, and ripe blackberry, layered with delicate notes of cocoa, subtle cedar, and toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, smooth, and fruit-forward, delivering approachable flavours of black cherry, red berry jam, and chocolate supported by a balanced streak of natural acidity. Framed by soft, rounded tannins and a clean texture, it finishes smoothly with lingering notes of dark fruit and gentle spice. Composed of 100% Merlot, this release offers an optimal drinking window of 2026–2028. Stylistically, it offers an easy-drinking, harmonious balance of smooth fruit texture and versatile food appeal.

title: Quails' Gate Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Founded in 1956 and owned and operated by the Stewart family, Quails' Gate is one of Canada's most important family-owned wineries. This Chardonnay is round and rich, with yellow plum, black olive, smoky oak, butter and citrus elements. Great with roast chicken, or baked fish in a lemon-cream sauce.

title: Dirty Laundry Red Dangerous Liaison 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
A wine shop favorite, this approachable & fruit forward blend of Merlot & Malbec is sourced from very hot sites in Osoyoos. 100% stainless steel fermentation allows for the most direct expression of ripe fruit flavours.

On the nose you will get notes of bright raspberry, chocolate covered raisins and black cherry. The palate boasts of ripe plums, cherry and mocha. This wine is bright and bold with a very fruity finish.

This unpretentious, easy to drink red can easily be enjoyed all on its own. Try it with your favorite pizza, spaghetti, or BBQ burgers with all the fixings.

title: Gehringer Brothers Pinot Gris 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Gehringer Brothers Estate Winery is a family owned and operated estate located on the Golden Mile Bench in Oliver, British Columbia, Canada. Founded in 1981 by brothers Walter and Gordon Gehringer following a seven year micro-climate evaluation by their father and uncle, the winery produced its first vintage in 1985. The winemaking philosophy is a unique 'symbiosis' of Old World European training and New World technology, with both brothers having earned specialized degrees in viticulture and oenology in Germany.

Wine Description

The Gehringer Brothers Pinot Gris is vinified in a 'true Pinot Grigio style,' resulting in a wine that is dry, delicate, and aromatic. In the glass, it often shows bright, pale hues. The sensory profile features a mellow bouquet of crisp pear, sweet floral notes, and nectarine, layered with subtle hints of honey and earthy minerality. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and vibrant, offering rich flavours of green apple and zesty lemon balanced by a crisp, palate cleansing acidity. This wine typically has an alcohol content of approximately 13% and is designed for freshness; its optimal drinking window is generally within one to three years of the vintage to preserve its lively fruit character.

title: Mission Hill Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
This premium red wine originates from Canada, specifically the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. Mission Hill Family Estate was founded with a pioneering vision to define the future of Okanagan wine through a blend of modern innovation and traditional practices. Under the guidance of Chief Winemaker Taylor Whelan, the winery focuses on sustainable farming and precision viticulture across its diverse estate vineyards to produce wines that authentically echo the valley’s unique terroir.

Wine Description

Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon presents vibrant aromas of black currant and raspberry that burst from the glass, complemented by nuances of black plum, tobacco leaf, and a touch of clove. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and robust, revealing layers of dark berry, cigar, cedar, and vanilla. It is characterized by a bold, prevalent tannin structure and lively acidity that leads to a rich and lingering finish.

title: Gray Monk Riesling 2024
bodyHtml:
With a hue of burnished lemon gold, this wine has a squeeze of fresh lime in its full fruity aroma. It is lively and fresh on the palate, with flavours of green apples and limes. The clean, tangy finish is persistent. Serve this versatile wine chilled on its own or with a wide range of foods from salads to sushi.

Clear and bright with pure fruit aromas of yellow apple, tangerine, white peach and a note of floral. This light-bodied, refreshing white wine is off-dry with great balancing acidity and flavours of juicy peach, melon and sweet citrus. Fresh, clean notes of citrus, apple and peach linger on the finish.

title: Gray Monk Gewurztraminer 2023
bodyHtml: Yellow green in hue, this wine has distinctive and powerful aromas of herbal spice, fresh melon and ripe peaches. The flavours are exceptionally complex, showing notes of lychee, melon, tropical fruits and even a suggestion of Earl Grey tea. The finish is crisp and fresh, with notes of spice that linger on the palate. Serve chilled, this wine is appealing on its own, with salads or Asian cuisines.

title: Trius Riesling 2024
bodyHtml:
The Trius Riesling is a classic expression of the Niagara Peninsula in Ontario, Canada. Trius Winery is a Canadian winemaking pioneer with over 40 years of history, known for being the first to have a Canadian vintage recognized as the 'Best Red Wine in the World' in 1991. Currently led by Winemaker Emma Garner, the winery focuses on blending art and science to craft award-winning wines that reflect the unique, rich terroir of the region.

Wine Description

This light and refreshing Riesling presents a clear and bright appearance in the glass. The aromatic profile is clean and fresh, featuring notes of white peach, green apple, and a touch of floral and tropical fruit. On the palate, it is slightly off-dry and juicy, offering a mouthwatering balance of natural sweetness and crisp acidity with flavours of Meyer lemon, pink grapefruit, and orchard fruits.

Food Pairing

The wine’s balance of acidity and residual sugar makes it an ideal partner for lightly spiced Thai or Indian curry dishes, as well as savoury Asian vegetable preparations. It also pairs beautifully with fresh seafood such as sushi, oysters, or halibut, and creamy cheeses like Brie and Camembert.

title: Road 13 Red Honest John's Crafted In BC 2024
bodyHtml:
This accessible and fruit-forward red wine originates from Canada, specifically within the British Columbia region and the Okanagan Valley subregion. Road 13 Vineyards is located on the historic Golden Mile Bench in Oliver and was named the Number 1 Winery in Canada in 2018. The winery's philosophy is centred on 'Honest' winemaking that celebrates the rugged spirit of the valley, and the 'Honest John's' series is named after John Oliver, a straightforward 19th-century Premier of British Columbia.

Wine Description

Road 13 Honest John's Red 2024 presents a deep ruby colour. The sensory profile is remarkably aromatic, featuring an intense nose of blackberries, red cherries, and plums, layered with sophisticated notes of black pepper, sage, and a hint of smoky oak. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and 'crunchy', showcasing supple tannins and a juicy acidity that provides a fresh and approachable mouthfeel. It is characterized by its balanced structure and vibrant fruit character, leading to a smooth finish with lingering notes of dark fruit and savory spice. This complex blend is primarily composed of Merlot, Syrah, and Cabernet Sauvignon, typically reaching an ABV of approximately 13.5%. While the winery employs sustainable farming techniques, this wine is not certified organic.

title: Cave Spring Estate Riesling 2022
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from their Cave Spring Vineyard, nestled on a hillside of the Niagara Escarpment overlooking Lake Ontario, known as the Beamsville Bench. Along these gentle slopes, the combination of limestone-clay soil, elevation and moderating on-shore breezes produces a dry Riesling with a distinctive mineral quality that is the signature of this noble variety in their terroir.

Medium straw in colour. Subtle yet complex, with scents of white pepper, yellow grapefruit and white flowers over top hints of liquorice and chalk. Dry and medium-bodied, with bright yellow plum fruit and crisp acidity up front, a rich yet stony middle and a long, intense finish of grapefruit essence and spice. Tightly structured throughout, the wine shows tremendous tension and vibrancy.

title: Castoro De Oro Heart Of Gold
bodyHtml: Heart of Gold white blend brings together Pinot Blanc, Vidal, Siegfried and Viognier. It exhibits a wide variety of fruit flavours, with a slight cotton candy note at the end.

title: Inniskillin Pinot Noir 2025
bodyHtml: Ruby red colour; lifted aromas of smoky oak, black plum reduction, nuts, earthy with a touch of spice; extra dry, medium bodied; shows good varietal character.

title: Cave Springs Chardonnay Estate 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from Canada, specifically from the Beamsville Bench sub-appellation of the Niagara Peninsula in Ontario. Founded in 1986 by the Pennachetti family and winemaker Angelo Pavan, Cave Spring Vineyard is a pioneer of noble European varietals in the region. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a deep commitment to terroir and sustainable practices, managing 72.5 hectares of prime vineyards nestled along the Niagara Escarpment.

Wine Description

Cave Spring Vineyard Chardonnay Estate 2023 displays a bright and fresh sensory profile. The nose is highly attractive, offering aromas of orchard fruit such as pear and yellow plum, accented by citrus, anise, and vanilla notes. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and well-balanced, featuring flavours of ripe peach and apple interplay with lemon yoghurt and subtle hints of spice. It is characterized by its remarkable freshness, delicate barrel influence, and a lasting dry finish that replays notes of anise. This 100% Chardonnay has an ABV of 13.0% and a residual sugar level of approximately 2.0 g/L. While the winery is a leader in environmental stewardship and is certified by Sustainable Winemaking Ontario (SWO), this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through the next three to five years.

title: Gray Monk Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml: This Pinot Noir has a bright ruby red colour and a bouquet of red cherry and red currant fruit, accented by notes of earth, oak and a touch of spice. The light to medium-bodied frame is supported by soft elegant tannins and food-friendly acidity.  Juicy cherry and red berry flavours evolve on the palate and linger on the finish, with an added note of earth and delicate spice. Pairs perfectly with veal.

title: Cave Spring Riesling Medium Dry 2023
bodyHtml:
Cave Spring Cellars, established in 1986, is a family-owned winery situated in the heart of the Niagara Peninsula. Renowned for its dedication to crafting premium Rieslings, the winery emphasizes sustainable viticulture and minimal intervention winemaking. The Beamsville Bench subregion, characterized by its limestone-rich soils and unique microclimate, provides an ideal terroir for producing expressive and balanced wines.

Wine Description
The 2022 Cave Spring Riesling Medium Dry presents a pale straw hue. On the nose, it offers fragrant aromas of pineapple, honey, and spiced pear, complemented by nuances of rose water and white flowers. The palate is medium-bodied and off-dry, initiating with grapefruit pith and transitioning into a round, viscous mid-palate that envelops a firm, chalky core. Delicate acidity enhances the wine's freshness, leading to a finish marked by citrus, almond, and allspice notes.

title: Vineland Estates Riesling Semi-Dry 2022
bodyHtml: Classic citrus with peach, green apple and apricot. A striking seam of acidity with mild sweetness. This beloved Semi-Dry Riesling is a wine forged within their fiery passion for the varietal plus the unique place that gives it form. High flying and venerable this offering renews with every vintage providing greater depth and richness to the developing story.

title: Cave Spring Gamay 2023
bodyHtml: Light ruby red colour; lots of fresh red and black plum aromas with notes of citrus, berries and nuts on the nose; extra dry, medium-plus bodied, with round, ripe plum and berry fruit flavour and fresh finish.

title: Cave Spring Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml: Straw colour. Soft peach, pear fruit and vanilla aromas and flavours with spicy notes. Dry, light to medium-bodied, balanced acidity with soft vanilla and spice on the finish.

title: Fielding Estate Pinot Grigio 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: This Pinot Grigio has vibrant aromas of lemon zest, lime, grapefruit and green apple. The citrus fruit notes are abundant on the palate, which is light, fresh and incredibly easy to drink, with a crisp and refreshing finish due to its bright acidity.

title: Clos Du Soleil Celestiale 2022
bodyHtml: On the palate the wine is remarkably rich and layered, with flavours of black cherries, ripe raspberries, plums and savoury grilled notes. The wine is elegant and perfectly balanced, and with its fresh acidity and fine lively tannins this is a perfect food wine. Aged for 15 months in French oak barrels, this wine is delightful to drink now but will also continue to develop with age in the coming years.

title: Pelee Island Gamay Zweigelt Ruggles Run 2017
Meyer Family Gewurztraminer 2025
bodyHtml: The wine was crafted from a southwest-facing heritage block of vines planted on our estate McLean Creek Road Vineyard in 1994 with cuttings hailing from Germany. The vineyard is comprised of alluvial and glacial deposits making up a mix of gravel and sandy loam and is well-suited to this variety, allowing us to craft a beautifully aromatic, food-friendly Gewürztraminer.

title: Gehringer Brothers Ehrenfelser 2023
bodyHtml: A real intense bouquet, apricots and hints of late harvest characters. A full mouthfeel with a long lingering finish. This wine pairs with spiced foods, chicken, turkey, pasta and salads. Great as an aperitif as well.

title: Cedar Creek Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot 2020
bodyHtml:
Sometimes a wine is greater than the sum of its parts. The team at Cedar Creek tasted hundreds of barrels one by one, thoughtfully blending to capture the best of two vineyards.

Some blueberry and dark cherry on the nose, with underlying Cabernet notes of cassis and tobacco. On the palate this wine has nice structure and tannin density, making it a great food wine.

title: Fielding Estate Riesling 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Crafted in Canada’s Niagara Peninsula, the 2023 Fielding Estate Riesling hails from the Beamsville Bench subregion, renowned for its mineral-rich soils and cool climate. Fielding Estate Winery, a family-run establishment since 2005, is celebrated for producing small-lot, award-winning wines that reflect the unique terroir of their estate vineyards. Their commitment to quality and sustainability has positioned them as a standout in Ontario’s wine scene.

Wine Description

This Riesling presents a brilliant pale straw hue. On the nose, it offers expressive aromas of fresh-squeezed lime, pink grapefruit, peach, and apricot jam. The palate is vibrant and fruit-forward, showcasing citrus-fruit notes complemented by a rich mouthfeel and bright acidity. Fermented cool in stainless steel, the wine achieves a harmonious balance between its natural sweetness and refreshing acidity. With an alcohol content of 10.2% and a residual sugar of 16.0 g/L, it is slightly off-dry, making it both approachable and versatile.

Food Pairing

This Riesling pairs exceptionally well with a variety of dishes. Its bright acidity and slight sweetness complement spicy cuisines, such as Thai spring rolls or curries. It also enhances the flavours of roasted poultry, pork, and vinaigrette-based salads. For cheese lovers, it matches beautifully with goat cheese and robust blue cheeses. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character.

title: Sumac Ridge Gewurztraminer Private Reserve 2023
bodyHtml: It offers a very intense bouquet of dark berries, mulberry and dark plum, dried pressed flowers developing with time. The palate is very well-balanced, placing a gentle but insistent grip on the palate. The oak is very well-integrated.

title: Joie Farm A Noble Blend 2025
bodyHtml: JoieFarm makes A Noble Blend in the spirit of Edelzwicker, a traditional aromatic blend made in France for centuries. This wine was created out of respect for old world traditions while learning how to make wine in our relatively young, new world winemaking region. A Noble Blend is a classic blend of Gewürztraminer, Riesling, Pinot Auxerrois and Muscat.

title: Pelee Island Gewurztraminer
bodyHtml: Pale straw/yellow colour; floral, ripe peach, honey and lychee fruit aromas; off-dry, light to medium bodied, softly structured with balanced acidity, flavours of honeysuckle, rose water, pear, citrus and lychee; hints of spice on the finish.

title: Summerhill Riesling Vispering Vines Vineyard Organic 2022
bodyHtml:
This 100% organic Riesling hails from the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, specifically sourced from the Whispering Vines Vineyard in Okanagan Falls. Summerhill Pyramid Winery, established by the Cipes family in 1986, is a pioneer of organic and biodynamic viticulture in Canada. The winery is famous for its 'Pyramid Cellar', where wines are finished in a structure built with sacred geometry to enhance their clarity and aromatic profile.

Wine Description

Whispering Vines Riesling presents a vibrant, off-dry profile characterized by a pale straw colour and an aromatic bouquet of lemon lime, peach, and green apple. On the palate, it is bright and fresh with zippy acidity and a distinct stony minerality that balances its natural sweetness. This light to medium-bodied wine features a long, clean finish with subtle notes of pear and ginger spice.

title: Lake Breeze Meritage 2021
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
From Canada’s Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, this red blend hails specifically from the acclaimed Naramata Bench subregion. Lake Breeze Vineyards is celebrated for its elegant, fruit-forward wines that reflect minimal intervention winemaking. The winery’s philosophy emphasizes purity of fruit and terroir expression, earning it a strong following among Canadian wine lovers.

Wine Description
In the glass, it reveals a deep ruby hue with complex aromas of ripe black cherry, plum, and hints of smoky oak. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and richly layered, offering supple tannins, dark berry flavours, and a touch of spice. The structure is firm yet refined, suggesting excellent aging potential over the next five to ten years. This vintage is unfiltered and expressive, with a long, savoury finish that speaks to its balance and finesse.

Food Pairing
Ideal pairings include grilled ribeye, rosemary lamb chops, or roasted portobello mushrooms. The wine’s depth and ripe tannins enhance the flavours of these robust dishes.

title: Henry Of Pelham Sibling Rivalry Red
bodyHtml:
General Information

Clear ruby red colour; blackberry and raspberry aromas with a touch of oak spice; dry, ripe berry flavour, medium finish and soft tannins.

title: Bench 1775 Pinot Gris 2025
bodyHtml: Found in the heart of wine country in beautiful British Columbia, Bench 1775 is located on the southern shore of Lake Okanagan. Named after the address of the winery, 1775 Naramata Road, along the beautiful Naramata Bench, Bench 1775 Winery is a celebration of land and place. Wines from Bench 1775 are produced with the unique expression of fruit grown in the Okanagan Valley from three vineyard locations, Oxbow Vineyard, on the original Golden Mile in Osoyoos, South Okanagan and at Paradise Ranch Vineyard and Soaring Eagle Vineyard in the Central Okanagan. A Pinot Gris with a juicy mid-palate but a crisp finish, this appeals with aromas and flavours of citrus, apple and melon.

title: Castoro De Oro Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
This elegant red wine hails from Canada, specifically produced in the renowned Golden Mile subregion of the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. Castoro de Oro Estate Winery is a family owned operation established in 2006 by Bruno Kelle and Stella Schmidt, who emphasize a 'down to earth' winemaking philosophy focused on creating high-quality, 100% BC wines.

Wine Description

The 2023 Pinot Noir presents a medium dark crimson red colour with a classical, delicate texture. The nose is aromatic and lifted, featuring distinct notes of spicy cherries, rhubarb, and black tea, underscored by a touch of spicy cedar. On the palate, the wine is soft and medium bodied, displaying a harmonious blend of strawberry and cherry flavours with a hint of cloves. It is characterized by a refreshing acidity and fine, subtle tannins that contribute to the classic silky texture expected of the varietal.

title: Peller Estates Cabernet Sauvignon-Merlot Reserve 2020
bodyHtml: Ruby purple; aromas and flavours of black fruit and cocoa, with notes of fresh herb; dry, medium bodied, with crisp but balanced acidity.

title: Volcanic Hills Magma Red 2022
bodyHtml: On the palate it's a mix of dark fruit, spice, dried herbs, plum, mocha, and smoke with just a touch of pepper on the finish. A great BBQ wine!

title: Blasted Church Merlot 2022
bodyHtml: Aromas of ripe plum, cola, chocolate, blueberry, and blackberry, leaning towards stewed fruit and jam with a well integrated oak profile. On the palate, ripe plum, chocolate, and dark berries lead the way, supported by a plush, unctuous mouthfeel. Through the mid-palate, the tannins build and persist through to the balanced finish. The ripe character of this wine would be an ideal pair for grilled steaks and roasted mushrooms. A rich tomato-based pasta would also play extremely well.

title: Frog's Leap Zinfandel 2022
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'sophisticated' red wine originates from the United States, within the prestigious Napa Valley region of California, with the vast majority of the fruit farmed in St. Helena and a smaller portion in Rutherford. Frog's Leap was founded in 1981 by John Williams on a historic property that originally served as a commercial frog farm in the late 19th century. Guided today by John and Rory Williams alongside Pablo Polanco, the winery operates under a strict winemaking philosophy focused on freshness, balance, and elegance, consciously keeping alcohol levels restrained to ensure the wine draws its power from sophistication rather than raw heat.

Wine Description

Frog's Leap Zinfandel presents a rich, dense appearance with an intense red-black colour in the glass. Its sensory profile is remarkably deep and 'meaty', opening with an explosive bouquet where intense floral aromas pop out on top, seamlessly layered with notes of intense red-black fruit and a subtle touch of structural warmth. On the palate, the wine is uncommonly dense and significantly more tannic than typical years, showcasing a full-weighted, savoury fruit core. It is characterized by an elegant olive-mineral signature native to Napa terroirs that slices directly through the density, providing a classic balance, a lively tempo, and a beautifully lifted finish.

This expression is crafted in a classic California field blend style, consisting of 85% Zinfandel, 14% Petite Sirah, and 1% Carignane. To achieve a smoother and more gentle extraction of flavours, the winemakers co-fermented the varieties together after cold-soaking the Petite Sirah, which adds vital 'bones' and structure to the final blend. The wine reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and was aged using a restrained 5% new oak combined with extensive 60% maturation in small concrete cubes to preserve its absolute freshness. The fruit is 100% certified organic and dry-farmed, rooted in the gravelly loam soils of the White Barn, Molinari, and Gonzalez vineyards.

title: Trim Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
TRIM Cabernet Sauvignon hits right on the spot! Stuff­ed with cherry and bright red fruit, baking spices, perfumed wood nuances, the wine invites you right in. Soft, supple tannins make this immediately approachable with versatility playing into its every sip.

This wine pairs with red meats, burgers, tomato-based pastas and BBQ.

title: Bliss Pinot Noir 2020
bodyHtml: This Pinot Noir has aromas of dried cherries and Christmas spice, followed by fruit-forward flavours. Notes of sweet cranberry highlight the elegant finish. This ripe and relaxed wine smells and tastes like red and stewed cherries and has a broad mouth-filling texture and light tannins for a bit of grip. It's easy to drink and is a crowd-pleaser.

title: Liberty School Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
Varietally on target, reliable year after year, Liberty School consistently over-deliver value wines of outstanding quality. Liberty School wines are made in a traditional style. Fruit-driven, they are crafted to reflect true varietal character. The wines are barrel-aged, employing very little new oak. Oak is used as a building component rather than a flavouring agent.

A big brand, made by a small, close family, Liberty School is the home of delicious wines that are easy to enjoy.

This storied wine has been a staple on dinner tables for more than 40 years. With a beautiful deep ruby hue and brackish edge, aromas of fresh vanilla, cedar and black currants fill the glass. On the palate, a touch of wet leather, black pepper, savoury herbs, black cherry and sweet oak are framed by approachable silky tannins making this wine very food friendly.

title: Prophecy Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Prophecy Wines is dedicated to capturing the essence of each varietal's best expression from around the world. For this Pinot Grigio, they source from select vineyards that highlight the grape's optimal characteristics. The label is inspired by The Star from the tarot, symbolizing inspiration and combining intuition (a foot in the water) with practical abilities (a foot on the ground)—traits their winemakers utilize. The flowing water also reflects the crisp and refreshing winestyle that is a hallmark of Italian Pinot Grigio.

Wine Description

In the glass, it presents a straw yellow colour. The nose offers a delightful tapestry of delicate floral aromas alongside notes of crisp green apple, pear, and citrus. On the palate, it is a light-bodied wine with crisp acidity and flavors of light citrus, tropical fruit, and mineral notes. The style is refreshing and clean, leading to a crisp finish that leaves a lingering sense of refreshment.

title: Quilt Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from the United States, produced in the California region within the renowned Napa Valley. Quilt is an innovative creation by Joseph Wagner, a fifth generation Napa Valley winemaker whose family founded the iconic Caymus Vineyards. The winery's philosophy is centred on representing Napa Valley as a patchwork of diverse terroirs, sourcing fruit from premier sub-AVAs such as Oakville, St. Helena, and Howell Mountain to create a blend with exceptional complexity and consistency.

Wine Description

The Quilt Cabernet Sauvignon displays a dark ruby red or deep plum colour. The nose is expressive and fragrant, featuring exuberant aromas of dark cherry strudel, ripe blackberry, and cocoa nibs, complemented by hints of toasted oak and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is bold and opulent, delivering rich flavours of blackberry pie, chocolate cherry, and Malabar plum with a hint of clove. It is characterized by its full body, plush mouthfeel, and vibrant acidity, leading into a long, smooth finish with velvety tannins.

title: Arrowood Cabernet Sauvignon Knights Valley 2019
bodyHtml: Since 1986, the winery has produced high-quality wines from sustainably and organically farmed vineyards west of the Mayacamas Ridge. This area is particularly well-suited to Cabernet Sauvignon, Arrowood's signature wine.

title: Tuli Pinot Noir Sonoma County 2023
bodyHtml: Joe Wagner has garnered a reputation for building some crowd-pleasing Pinot Noir. His latest venture, "Tuli Pinot Noir," is aged for eight to nine months in French oak barrels It is a dark scarlet red with bing cherry and blackberry pie aromas that support lively flavours of dark berry fruit, vanilla, anise and dried herbs. The lingering finish is smooth and velvety. Savoury dishes like portobello mushroom stuffed with sausage, beef stroganoff or a pizza with a creamy white sauce topped with chicken and artichoke hearts work well with this wine.

title: Killer Drop Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
Killer Drop brings together fruit from several distinct growing areas of Northern California: Napa Valley, Mendocino, Sonoma, Sierra Foothills, and Lodi. Each region contributes unique characteristics to the final blend, all coming together to create an expressive wine with multiple layers of complexity and balance.
Dark and luscious, Killer Drop bursts from the glass with captivating aromas of ripe cherries and dark chocolate with hints of dried herbs and spice. The wine is full-bodied, rich and juicy on the palate, with expansive flavours of black cherry and dark plum. Soft, silky and balanced tannins lead to a wonderfully long finish. Pour a Drop and live life to its fullest.

title: Gnarled Vine Zinfandel 2021
bodyHtml:
This robust red wine originates from Lodi, a renowned subregion within California's Central Valley, often celebrated as the 'Zinfandel capital of the world'. The fruit is sourced from sustainably farmed, family owned estate vineyards managed by Oak Ridge Winery, which is the oldest operating winery in Lodi.

Wine Description

Gnarled Vine Zinfandel presents a deep dark ruby red colour with vibrant purple highlights. On the nose, it offers an expressive bouquet of dark berries—specifically blackberry and blackcurrant—mingled with notes of plum, vanilla, and black pepper. The palate is full bodied and rich, mirroring the aromatic profile with layers of spiced damson jam, dried fig, and toasted oak. Despite its boldness, the wine maintains a fresh acidity and a velvety tannin structure, leading into a long finish characterized by warm baking spices and mocha.

title: Robert Mondavi Private Selection Cabernet Sauvignon Bourbon Barrels 2024
bodyHtml:
Vint Cabernet Sauvignon Bourbon Barrels originates from the United States, within the California region and specifically the Monterey County subregion. The winery was established in 1966 by Robert Mondavi, a pioneer who transformed the Napa Valley and wider Californian wine industry with a vision to create world class wines that rival the best European crus. The Vint collection—part of the Robert Mondavi Private Selection—reflects a philosophy of innovation and accessibility, utilizing unique ageing techniques to craft bold wines for modern social rituals.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon pours a deep ruby or garnet red colour with noticeable viscosity. The sensory profile is rich and layered, featuring an aromatic nose of blackberry cobbler, ripe cherries, and milk chocolate, accented by brown sugar, coffee, and a hint of smoke. On the full bodied palate, it is velvety and plush, delivering concentrated flavours of blueberry pie, praline, and vanilla custard alongside sweet tobacco and mocha. The finish is remarkably long and warming, characterized by soft tannins and persistent notes of caramel and toasted oak.

  • Varietal Composition: A blend predominantly consisting of 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, though some releases may include small amounts of Petite Sirah, Cabernet Franc, and Syrah to add depth.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is aged for at least three to ten months in a combination of new oak and used bourbon barrels sourced from a renowned Kentucky distillery, which imparts deep undertones of char and sweet vanilla.

title: Rodney Strong Cabernet Sauvignon Knights Valley 2022
bodyHtml: This Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon is deeply coloured and bursting with aromas of crushed blackberries, spicy dark plum, dusty cocoa powder, cassis and wild raspberry. The complex layers of spice, red fruit and chocolate on the palate are framed in rich, velvety tannins with a long lingering finish. Enjoy this Cabernet Sauvignon now with braised short ribs, beef ravioli or lamb shanks.

title: William Hill Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
William Hill Estate Winery was founded in 1976 by visionary vineyard developer William Hill and is located on an exceptionally unique 200-acre parcel at the foot of Atlas Peak on the Silverado Bench. With nearly 40 years of experience growing wine, William Hill winemakers have used their expertise, knowledge, and instinct to deliver extraordinary fruit that showcases the distinctive characteristics of our site. Each variety, each wine and each tier has been skillfully crafted to meet their high standards. This disciplined approach to producing excellent wine is apparent in every glass of William Hill Estate wine.

This Chardonnay is medium-bodied and food-friendly, featuring ripe notes of honeydew melon, juicy pear and apple crumble. Backed by delicate hints of Meyer lemon and nutmeg, this elegantly structured white wine is smooth and well balanced, with crisp acidity and a creamy mouthfeel.

Chardonnay food pairings: roast chicken, shrimp tempura, grilled whitefish, turkey.

title: William Hill Cabernet Sauvignon North Coast 2023
bodyHtml:
William Hill Estate Winery, established in 1978, is located on the Silverado Bench in southern Napa Valley, California. The winery is renowned for its commitment to crafting rich and expressive wines, particularly focusing on Bordeaux varietals sourced from select vineyards in Napa Valley and California’s premier growing regions.

Wine Description
William Hill Estate North Coast Cabernet Sauvignon greets you with an appealing bouquet of luscious blackberry compote and Mission plum. The palate is opulent and silky, revealing ribbons of black cherry and molasses layered with subtle hints of toasted oak and crushed dried rosemary. Sourced from Lake and Sonoma County, this Cabernet Sauvignon offers a smooth, rich, and fruit-forward palate. The wine is approachable now and will continue to develop complexity over the next 3 to 5 years.

Food Pairing
This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted lamb, or a hearty beef stew. It also complements aged cheddar or gouda cheeses. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Stonestreet Estate Vineyards Chardonnay 2020
bodyHtml: This Chardonnay exhibits buoyant fruit‚ Bartlett pear, peach and golden delicious apple with honeysuckle, sweet baking spices and an oceanic note shading the background. The palate mirrors that exuberant tree fruit within a rich, generous texture and walks a tightrope into balancing citrus pith, and a thrilling stony note.

title: The Dreaming Tree Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
The Dreaming Tree Pinot Noir 2023 hails from California, a region renowned for producing expressive and approachable expressions of this varietal. This label is a creative collaboration between South African-American musician Dave Matthews and award-winning winemaker Sean McKenzie, who shared a vision of making high-quality, sustainable wines accessible to a broad audience. The winery emphasizes environmental stewardship, utilizing Certified California Sustainable growing practices, lightweight bottles, and recycled paper labels to reduce its ecological footprint.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir presents a bright ruby colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is defined by ripe cherry, wild strawberry, and vanilla, complemented by subtle hints of caramel and toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is juicy and soft, featuring well-integrated tannins that provide a delicate structure. This medium-bodied red offers a balanced complexity with a long, smooth finish highlighted by notes of spice and toasted wood.

Food Pairing

The versatile structure and fruit-forward nature of this wine make it an excellent companion for a variety of dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with grilled salmon, roast lamb, and mushroom risotto, where its acidity cuts through rich textures. For more casual fare, consider serving it alongside portobello burgers or a selection of soft cheeses such as Brie or Camembert.

title: Belle Glos Pinot Noir Dairyman 2024
bodyHtml:
The Belle Glos Dairyman Vineyard Pinot Noir is sourced from the southern alluvial plains of Russian River Valley, where the proximity to the Pacific Ocean creates cool morning fog and afternoon breezes resulting in an uncommonly long growing season. Once an old dairy farm and pastureland, this site has since realized its true potential as a prime Pinot Noir vineyard. 

The colour is quite striking, with the brilliant red ruby hue hinting at the luscious fruit to come. The aromas are abundant with bright cherry, cranberry and brown spice, reminiscent of warm cinnamon toast topped with plum jam. On the palate, the bright cherry opens the show, then evolves into a lush, sweetly spiced plum pudding, coating the mouth with a velvety richness. The acidity is as vibrant as the colour, lifting the medley of fruit to lavish heights and augmenting the spicy tones. The wine then develops an intense mineral note, adding yet another dimension, lending way to silky tannins and a lengthy finish that will leave you wanting more.

title: Belle Glos Pinot Noir Clark & Telephone 2023
bodyHtml: Deep ruby red in colour with scarlet highlights, Clark & Telephone opens with bountiful aromas of red fruits of cranberry and raspberry jam, laced with clove, cedar, and holiday baking spices. Bold and complex flavours of crushed ripe cherry, cranberry and blueberry pie linger on the palate. The texture is rich and lively and leads into a warm and structured finish.

title: Belle Glos Pinot Noir Las Alturas 2021
bodyHtml: Scarlet red with an aromatic medley of gooseberry, raspberry, and cranberry with hints of ginger, black pepper, and shaved milk chocolate. Dark fruit on the palate with flavours of wild berries, milk chocolate, toffee, black cherry, and ground nutmeg. Rich and structured, this wine has beautiful acidity that lingers to a long, mouthwatering finish.

title: Elouan Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml: Dark magenta, this wine opens up with aromas of dark chocolate, dried plum, marionberry, and a hint of white pepper and clove. The palate is well-balanced and robust, with tart cherry, raspberry, wild bramble, and crushed violet notes. The remarkable depth and concentration complement rich tannins and lead to a smooth, medium finish. Pair with roasted pork loin with thyme and garlic, caramelized mushroom flatbread, or tuna tartare.

title: Woodwork Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: The nose of this Cabernet Sauvignon is powerful with ripe black fruit, chocolate covered cherries and warm nuts. On the palate, it is rich, fruity and has a touch of sweetness. Try it with a t-bone steak on the BBQ.

title: Chronic Cellars Red Blend Purple Paradise 2021
bodyHtml:
Paint your paradise purple with this Zinfandel-dominated blend that rolls out with jammy blackberry fruit, cherry cola, and the loveliest whispers of mocha and lavender. Alluringly deep and dark in color, the wine paints the perfect landscape for balanced acidity and mild tannins that floats on to a blissful finish.

91 Points - Wine Enthusiast

This bottling always overdelivers. Elderberry, black plum, scorched earth, crushed rock and tar aromas show on the nose, while the palate proves heavy but well-structured. Flavors of roasted blackberry, toasted sage and asphalt complete the picture.

90 Points - James Suckling

This is deep and dark-fruited with toasted spices, smoked cedar, nut shell and earth. Full-bodied, and compact with juicy acidity and polished tannins. Deep and lengthy fruit character with notes of blueberry jam.

title: True Myth Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Taking advantage of Mother Nature’s gift of rich and fertile soils on the Central Coast of California, True Myth wines seek to delight and inspire while maintaining the exceptional quality they are known for. True Myth presents an authentic experience that only Mother Nature can express. One of depth, wonder and a little bit of magic.

Wine Description

Displaying aromas of pear, pineapple, tangerine and vanilla, this classic Chardonnay from the Edna Valley shows flavours of tropical fruit with a hint of minerality and a creamy texture. Refreshing acidity keeps the wine lively and fresh from start to finish, a signature of Paragon Vineyard, and is topped off with the excellent accompaniment of vanilla bean and toasted oak.

title: Meiomi Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Meiomi Wines, established in California, is renowned for its approach of blending grapes from distinct coastal regions to craft wines with rich character and balance. The name "Meiomi" translates to "coast" in the language of the native Wappo tribe, reflecting the winery's connection to the coastal vineyards of Monterey, Santa Barbara, and Sonoma counties. 

The 2021 Meiomi Chardonnay is a blend sourced from these three regions, each contributing unique characteristics to the wine. This vintage presents a pale straw color and offers an expressive bouquet featuring notes of ripe tropical fruit, honey, and baking spices. On the palate, it is smooth and opulent, with layers of stone fruit and hints of citrus and apple, leading to a well-balanced and rich finish. 

Optimal Drinking Window: The 2021 Meiomi Chardonnay is crafted for immediate enjoyment and is best consumed within 1-2 years of its release to fully appreciate its fresh and vibrant flavors.

Food Pairing Suggestions: This Chardonnay pairs well with roast chicken, lobster on buttered toast, cold turkey sandwiches, and other poultry dishes.

title: Inglenook '1882' Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from the United States, specifically the Rutherford AVA in Napa Valley, California. Inglenook is one of Napa's most historic and legendary estates, originally founded in 1879 by Finnish sea captain Gustave Niebaum. Today, it is owned by filmmaker Francis Ford Coppola, who spent decades painstakingly reuniting the original property.

The "1882" Cabernet Sauvignon pays tribute to the first vintage ever produced by Niebaum, the same year he dug the estate's historic caves. Positioned as an approachable, estate-grown alternative to their flagship Rubicon, this wine offers classic Rutherford character at an incredible value.

Wine Description

The Inglenook "1882" Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 is a remarkably vibrant, fresh, and beautifully textured mountain-and-benchland red.

  • Appearance: Deep, inky ruby red with dark garnet reflections.

  • Nose: Highly attractive and expressive. It opens with aromas of ripe cassis, black cherry, and dark plum, intricately layered with cocoa powder, tobacco leaves, cedar, and subtle hints of smoke and violets.

  • Palate: Immediately round and supple upon entry. It delivers a solid core of juicy blackberries, black cherries, and dark chocolate. The mouthfeel boasts excellent volume and density, perfectly balanced by a striking, vibrant acidity and fine, well-polished tannins that lead to a lengthy, focused finish with a touch of savory vanilla oak.

  • Technical Details: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. The fruit was entirely estate-grown, sourced from the Chateau, Cohn, and Red Barn vineyard blocks. It was aged for 18 months in French oak barrels (11% new and 89% neutral) to emphasize the pure, organically farmed fruit over heavy wood character. The alcohol content is 14.5% ABV.

Accolades

The 2018 vintage is widely celebrated across Napa Valley as a legendary year, and the 1882 bottling earned exceptional critical praise:

  • James Suckling: 94 points (Noted as "solid... juicy and intense").

Food Pairing

This wine’s refined tannin structure and savory-sweet dark fruit profile make it incredibly food-friendly. It pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb with rosemary, or duck breast. Thanks to its traditional roots, it also stands up excellently to hearty, rustic dishes like braised beef stews, wild boar ragout, or savory mushroom tarts. For a cheese pairing, select mature, hard options like an aged Gouda or sharp white Cheddar.

Vintage Quality

The 2018 growing season in Napa Valley was practically picture-perfect, yielding a generous crop of flawless quality. A cool, steady spring followed by a moderately warm summer allowed the grapes to achieve long, slow, and perfectly even ripening. This long hang-time provided the 2018 "1882" with spectacular aromatic complexity and an innate freshness. While it has softened beautifully and is drinking fantastically right now, it has the structural integrity to easily cellar and evolve through 2032.

title: Ultraviolet Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Ultraviolet Wines, founded by winemaker Samantha Sheehan, is a heartfelt tribute to the California climate where she was raised. Samantha Sheehan's vision for Ultraviolet is to produce high-quality, accessible wines using organically farmed grapes and minimal additives, creating wines that can be enjoyed casually any day of the week.

Wine Description

This wine is an expression of classic California Cabernet. It presents elegant aromas of cocoa powder and violets, along with notes of pie spice and bramble. The palate is silky and rich with flavours of blackberry and black cherry, boysenberry, black currant confiture, and dark chocolate. It is characterized by soft, round, velvety tannins and bright acidity, giving it a beautifully balanced and lively style.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include spare ribs or any red meat, sausage pizza, and pasta bolognese.

title: Oakville Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
The Oakville Winery Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the heart of the Napa Valley in the prestigious Oakville subregion of the United States. The winery is situated in an area historically significant as a water refueling stop for the railroad, eventually named for its dense groves of valley oaks. Its winemaking philosophy focuses on utilizing the district's ideal combination of warm days and cool evenings to produce wines that express the unique rocky and volcanic soils of the eastern Oakville benches.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep red colour and a harmonious aromatic profile featuring rich dark fruits such as black cherries and blackberries. The nose is further accented by subtle notes of fresh roses, cassis, vanilla, and black pepper. On the palate, the wine offers a full bodied mouthfeel with satiny tannins and vibrant acidity that supports a long, complex finish.

Accolades

  • "Wine Spectator - 94 points"

Food Pairing

This wine's bold structure and dark fruit profile pair exceptionally well with grilled lamb chops or a rich wild boar ragu. For a vegetarian option, truffle mushroom risotto provides an earthy complement to the wine's subtle notes of black pepper and vanilla.

title: Black Stallion Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley 2023
bodyHtml:
From the heart of the United States, this Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon hails from California’s renowned wine-growing region. Black Stallion Estate Winery is situated on the Silverado Trail in Napa’s Oak Knoll District, a subregion celebrated for its balanced climate and ideal terroir. Once a historic equestrian center, the winery was transformed into a modern estate where small-lot winemaking and precision viticulture are central to its philosophy.

Wine Description
Black Stallion Cabernet Sauvignon unveils a deep garnet hue with inviting aromas of blackberry, cassis, and violet, accented by hints of cocoa, clove, and toasted oak. On the palate, the wine delivers concentrated dark fruit flavours—black cherry, plum, and currant—layered with vanilla, espresso, and a trace of graphite. Full-bodied with supple tannins and a lingering finish, it displays excellent balance between power and finesse. Made predominantly from Cabernet Sauvignon with small percentages of Petit Verdot and Malbec, this wine is best enjoyed from 2026 to 2032 to appreciate its evolving complexity.

Food Pairing
This bold yet elegant Cabernet pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye, rosemary-crusted lamb chops, or mushroom risotto topped with shaved parmesan. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Hayes Valley Chardonnay Central Coast 2020
bodyHtml:
Located in the northern Central Coast of California, the lore of Hayes Valley extends back to the days of missionaries and the historic El Camino Real. The land was planted with wine grapes in the late 1800’s, but the vineyards eventually succumbed to Prohibition. Agriculture was restored to the Valley in the late 1990’s with the planting of new vines. The Hayes Valley is an ideal climate for growing grapes, cool, foggy nights followed by warm sunny days.

Hayes Valley Wines are grown and produced at Clos LaChance Estate Vineyards and Winery in California’s Northern Central Coast, which was one of the first 17 certified sustainable wineries in California. The winery is committed to producing the best quality wine possible while protecting the environment and conserving natural resources. As a family-owned and operated winery, it is important for Clos LaChance to maintain the long-term viability of the land for future generations.

title: OZV Zinfandel Old Vines 2022
bodyHtml: A robust Zinfandel from the region's signature 50-100 year-old vines. Jammy with raspberry, milk chocolate and mocha flavors, soft tannins and a supple mouth feel.

title: Beringer Chardonnay Luminus 2022
bodyHtml:
Beringer Luminus Chardonnay originates from the United States, within California’s distinguished Napa Valley AVA, specifically sourced from the cool-climate Oak Knoll District sub-appellation. Introduced as a focused exploration of single-terroir Chardonnay, "Luminus"—derived from the Latin for "light"—was created to showcase a brighter, more linear, and mineral-driven counterpart to Beringer’s classic, opulent Private Reserve style. Situated in the southern portion of Napa Valley, the Big Ranch Vineyard in Oak Knoll benefits from cool ocean breezes and morning fog off San Pablo Bay. Operating under the winemaking leadership of Ryan Rech, the estate’s philosophy for Luminus centers on preserving natural acidity, highlighting crisp orchard fruit, and utilizing seasoned oak to craft an elegant, fresh, and modern expression of Napa Valley Chardonnay.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a pale, bright straw-gold appearance in the glass with shimmering green reflections. It possesses a medium-bodied, sleek, and lively structure defined by a crisp, silky, and clean texture. The sensory profile is energetic, aromatic, and refined, opening with an inviting bouquet of green apples, crisp Anjou pears, lemon zest, and white peach, interwoven with delicate floral notes of white jasmine, wet stone minerality, and subtle toasted almond. On the palate, it delivers a focused, mouthwatering core of citrus oil and stone fruit, balanced by a bright, vibrant acidity that drives the wine into a crisp, refreshing finish touched by light oak spice and a clean mineral trail.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: Hand-harvested in the cool early morning, the whole clusters are gently pressed before undergoing fermentation. To balance freshness with textural complexity, approximately 80% to 90% of the wine undergoes malolactic fermentation. It is aged for 9 to 10 months in French oak barrels, with a low proportion of new oak (typically 20% to 25%), accompanied by periodic lees stirring (bâtonnage) to build subtle mid-palate weight without masking its crisp acidity.

  • ABV: 14.1% to 14.3%.

title: Michael David Cabernet Franc Inkblot 2022
bodyHtml: This broad-textured, deeply fruity wine is also generously spiced with oak. It shows tempting black-cherry and blackberry flavours, as well as plentiful vanilla, nutmeg and milk chocolate accents. These flavours are housed on a richly tannic texture and lead to a spicy finish.

title: St Supery Sauvignon Blanc Dollarhide 2022
bodyHtml:
#27 Wine Spectator Top 100 of 2024

St. Supéry Estate Vineyards and Winery is a 100% Estate Grown, sustainably farmed winery located in the renowned Rutherford growing region. The winery's history dates back to 1982 when French vintner Robert Skalli purchased the vast, mountainous Dollarhide Ranch. St. Supéry continues its mission of continuous quality improvement while maintaining Napa Green Winery and Vineyard certifications, demonstrating a strong commitment to environmental protection and land stewardship for future generations.

Wine Description

The 100% Sauvignon Blanc presents brilliant hues of pale yellow and green. Fresh aromas of grapefruit, kiwi, and fennel are intertwined with a subtle vanillin thread, indicative of the element of new French oak. On the palate, yellow grapefruit and lime zest flavours follow, along with the essence of ripe pear. The wine is medium-bodied with a dense middle palate, offering a round, rich mouth feel due to toasted oak qualities and the subtle creaminess of sur-lies maturation. The style is described as crisp yet rich, displaying a sense of grapefruity freshness on the finish.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include dishes that complement the wine's crispness and rich flavour profile, such as shellfish, vegetarian dishes, and goat cheese. It is an excellent match for preparations like oysters on the half shell, grilled fish or shrimp, and cured salmon.

title: Davis Bynum Pinot Noir Russian River 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from the United States, specifically the Russian River Valley in Sonoma County, California. Founded in 1973, Davis Bynum was the first winery to produce a single vineyard Pinot Noir from the Russian River Valley, a region now celebrated for its world-class Pinot Noir. Today, the winery is part of the family-owned Rodney Strong Wine Estates, continuing Davis Bynum’s legacy by focusing on small-lot winemaking that emphasizes terroir and site expression.

Wine Description

Davis Bynum Pinot Noir presents a brilliant ruby hue in the glass. Aromas of ripe red cherry, raspberry, and wild strawberry are layered with subtle hints of rose petal, baking spice, and a delicate earthiness. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with supple tannins and bright acidity that deliver a lively structure. Flavours echo the nose, with additional notes of pomegranate, tea leaf, and a whisper of vanilla from careful oak aging.

Food Pairing

Pair this wine with dishes that complement its vibrant fruit and refined texture, such as roasted duck with cherry glaze, wild mushroom risotto, or grilled salmon. A perfect match to enhance the wine’s complexity.

title: Silvia Zinfandel 2018
bodyHtml: Cool aroma profile of blueberry, red currants, earthy dustiness and mineral nuances. This wine shines through immediately with silky smooth tannins and a firm grip of natural acidity and balance.

title: Ballard Lane Pinot Noir 2023
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Ballard Lane Pinot Noir originates from the United States, within the California region and the Central Coast subregion. The winery represents a family legacy backed by five generations of California farming. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the distinct character of the Central Coast by working with carefully selected vineyards that benefit from cool coastal climates and diverse soils.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a bright ruby or dark crimson colour and possesses a medium-bodied structure. The sensory profile is highly fruit forward, opening with an aromatic nose of ripe black cherries, strawberries, and cranberries, coupled with a confectionary edge of strawberry shortcake and baking spices like clove. On the fleshy and approachable palate, it delivers rich flavours of maraschino cherries and peppered raspberries, layered with darker chocolate notes, vanilla, and cocoa nibs. The finish is smooth and graceful, leaving a lingering impression of earthy tones, toasted French oak, and coffee.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically a blend of 91% to 98% Pinot Noir, occasionally rounded out with a small percentage of Petite Sirah.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its balance and smooth texture, achieving a harmony between fresh acidity, soft tannins, and subtle oak integration after aging for 4 to 5 months on French oak.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 13.5% and 14.3%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate focuses on traditional, premium viticulture, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Ballard Lane Chardonnay
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
A former Wells Fargo stagecoach stop, the town of Ballard was founded in 1880 with lofty dreams of being a future metropolis. Ballard was named for William Ballard, who ran the Wells Fargo station from 1862 to 1870. Although Ballard served as the connection point between rural and seaside communities, it never grew in mass like its neighbour Santa Barbara and is now much as it was over 100 years ago. Ballard is a combination of a sleepy village and an upscale bedroom community. The surrounding area is noted for its thriving and well-respected wine industry and was featured in the Academy Award-nominated film "Sideways." Vineyards, coastal bluffs and ranches merge seamlessly through roads the locals call "lanes." Ultimately, many of these paths end up in Ballard. 

The Ballard Lane wines reflect the Miller Family, a Central Coast family that has farmed the area for five generations. Their proprietary knowledge of the climate and terroirs of the Central Coast are reflected in each bottle of Ballard Lane wine.

Aromas of green apple, buttery pie-crust, white flowers, fig and lime zest. Full-body with excellent balance on the palate, finishing with just enough structure. Pair with fried chicken, pasta with cream cheese sauce, snack foods like chips or cheese puffs, or grilled white fish.

title: ***J Lohr Petite Sirah Tower Road 2023
bodyHtml: This is an exuberant wine, showing the sunny warmth of a Paso summer and all the fleshy fruit that good Petite elicits. It smells of blackberries and clove, a hint of cardamom, with a juiciness that’s refreshing. The flavours are big and velvety, with firm but silky tannins, simple and irresistible for a plate of ribs.

title: Jonata Todos Ballard Canyon Red Blend 2020
bodyHtml: Boysenberry and chocolate nibs. A medium rare steak. Wonderful interplay between sweet and savory. Big fruit and bold personality. Blueberry, clove and bacon. Well-built Todos blend thanks to ample sunshine during the growing season and harvest. It is not a shy Todos, but the best secret of this wine is that it stays in balance thanks to the length of the structure and the Ballard Canyon acidity. The tannins are so fine and mouthcoating, like a fine powder. Along the journey, this Todos crosses from black to red and then from blue to green. A fascinating cascade of flavors, aromas and most importantly, textures.

title: The Paring Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml:
The vineyard and winemaking team behind Jonata & The Hilt Estate present The Paring, a focused collection of wines with a goal to craft an honest and delicious bottle of wine for every occasion and table. In kitchens around the world, the Paring knife has become a chef’s staple for its versatility. The Paring wines were created with this same intent. Full of vibrance, complexity, and versatility, the wines are a perfect compliment to every occasion.

The Paring Wines are sourced primarily from their estate vineyards in Ballard Canyon and Santa Rita Hills and trusted vineyards in Northern California to produce wines that are a true expression of classic California style. Blocks from the select vineyards are designated for The Paring ahead of harvest and made with the same intention and care that goes into the wines of Jonata and The Hilt Estate.

title: Conundrum Red 2023 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
This serious yet approachable red wine originates from the United States, specifically from premier winegrowing regions across California. Launched in 2011, Conundrum Red is part of the Wagner Family of Wines, the same family behind the iconic Caymus Vineyards. The winery's history dates back to 1972 when Charlie Wagner Sr. co founded Caymus; he inspired the Conundrum label by his radical habit of blending wines at the dinner table to find the 'perfect glass' for his meal. Today, his grandson Charlie Wagner II continues this legacy, sourcing fruit from famed and off the beaten track counties including Napa, Monterey, Santa Barbara, San Benito, Solano, and Tulare.

Wine Description

Conundrum Red presents a deep ruby colour and a rich, appealing sensory profile. The nose is complex and almost floral, offering aromas of ripe plums, lavender, and dark mixed berries, layered with earthy undertones of cocoa, baking chocolate, and subtle mesquite smoke. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and 'plush', showcasing immediate flavours of black cherry and sweet plum that transition into concentrated notes of dried dark fruit and dark chocolate. It is characterized by a 'defining texture' produced from round yet grippy tannins and a balanced acidity that ensures a silky mouthfeel. The finish is remarkably long, carrying lingering impressions of cocoa powder and gentle smokiness. While the exact varietal composition is a proprietary secret, it is primarily a blend of Petite Sirah, Zinfandel, and Cabernet Sauvignon.

title: Sterling Pinot Grigio Vintner's Collection 2021
bodyHtml:
Sterling Vineyards, located in Napa Valley, California, is known for its commitment to producing high-quality wines that embody the unique characteristics of the region. The winery’s philosophy blends tradition with innovation, offering wines that speak to both the terroir and the artistry of winemaking. Established in 1964, Sterling Vineyards has long been recognized for its dedication to excellence and its striking hillside estate.

Wine Description
The Sterling Pinot Grigio Vintner's Collection 2021 is a pale golden wine with crisp clarity. On the nose, it offers vibrant aromas of citrus fruits like lemon and grapefruit, intertwined with delicate floral notes. The palate is refreshing, with zesty acidity, balanced by hints of green apple, pear, and subtle minerality. Light-bodied and smooth, the wine has a clean, dry finish that lingers softly. This Pinot Grigio, made from 100% Pinot Grigio grapes, is perfect for drinking young, ideally within the next two to three years to preserve its fresh character.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 90 points

  • Wine Spectator - 88 points

Food Pairing
This wine pairs beautifully with light seafood dishes such as grilled shrimp or citrus-marinated scallops. It also complements fresh salads, goat cheese, and vegetable-based pasta dishes. Together, these pairings highlight the wine’s crispness and refreshing qualities, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Justin Sauvignon Blanc 2024
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Bright and clear with moderate tears and a pale straw color with silver highlights in the glass. Aromatic with ripe lemon, green apple, peach, citrus blossom, and fresh herbal notes. Medium-bodied and dry with bright lemon and Granny Smith apple on entry and pineapple with fresh-cut herbs toward the midpalate. The moderately long finish is very clean and textured with sustained fresh citrus fruit, herbal, and mineral notes.

title: Dutcher Crossing Syrah Proprietor's Reserve 2021
bodyHtml: True to the nature of this wine, the Proprietor's Reserve Syrah's colour is purple right to the very core. The nose boast aromas of plums and berries, accented by sweet tobacco, worn saddle leather, white pepper and a touch of cream de menthe. When drank, you are first stuck by powerful red fruits. That is soon an afterthought as the rich textures of this wine engulf your palate counterbalanced by lively acidity enabling this offering to have a long and drawn out finish.

title: The Dreaming Tree Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
The award-winning Dreaming Tree Cabernet Sauvignon offers classic aromas of blackberry, cherry, and dry herb notes wrapped by toasted vanilla and soft, mouth-filling tannins. It's elegant and supple.

An exciting collaboration between musician Dave Matthews and seasoned winemaker Sean McKenzie, The Dreaming Tree captures the spirit of California’s wine country. United by their shared passion to make quality wines accessible to everyone, the two friends set out on a journey to discover the unique characteristics and rich flavours that give the region its rare charm.

title: The Dreaming Tree Chardonnay 2024
