bodyHtml: An exciting collaboration between musician Dave Matthews and seasoned winemaker Sean McKenzie, The Dreaming Tree captures the spirit of California’s wine country. United by their shared passion to make quality wines accessible to everyone, the two friends set out on a journey to discover the unique characters and rich flavours that give the region its rare charm.

title: Michael David Earthquake Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Michael David Earthquake Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold and complex red wine produced by Michael David Winery, a family-owned winery in Lodi, California. The winery was founded by two brothers, Michael and David Phillips, who come from a long line of grape growers and winemakers. Earthquake Cabernet Sauvignon is named after the 1906 earthquake that struck Lodi and the surrounding region. The wine is made from Cabernet Sauvignon grapes grown in the Phillips family's vineyards, which are known for their unique soil composition and microclimate.

This full-bodied wine is characterized by its deep, dark fruit flavors, such as blackberry and cassis, and its notes of chocolate, espresso, and spice. It has a rich and silky texture with a long and persistent finish.

title: Hartford Court Pinot Noir Russian River Valley 2022
bodyHtml:
Hartford Court Pinot Noir Russian River Valley originates from the United States, within the California region and the Russian River Valley subregion. Hartford Family Winery was founded in 1994 by Don and Jennifer Hartford, driven by an appreciation for the unique vineyards near their Sonoma County home. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes 'character through adversity,' focusing on small, low-yielding vineyards in difficult locations to produce expressive, high-personality wines.

Wine Description

This red wine typically displays a bright ruby to saturated ruby colour and possesses a medium to full body. The sensory profile is complex and layered, featuring an aromatic nose of black cherry, blueberry, and pomegranate, accented by notes of allspice, forest floor, and fresh wildflowers. On the palate, it delivers concentrated flavours of wild raspberries and dark berries supported by a crushed rock minerality and a juicy, velvety mouthfeel. The finish is long and flavorful, characterized by silky tannins and subtle earthy or spiced notes.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its balance and varietal focus, utilizing artisan techniques such as hand-sorting, indigenous yeast fermentations, and aging in French oak barrels without fining or filtration.

  • ABV: Typically recorded at 14.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate emphasizes meticulous, hand-harvested vineyard management, this specific bottling is not generally specified as certified organic.

Food Pairing

The versatile acidity and nuanced fruit profile of this Pinot Noir make it an ideal companion for a wide range of savoury dishes.

  • Meats: Pairs excellently with grilled steak, roasted chicken, and barbecue pork ribs.

  • Seafood: Suggested pairings include meaty grilled salmon, tuna steak, or salmon teriyaki.

  • Savoury: Matches well with mushroom risotto, grilled polenta with mushrooms, and pepperoni pizza.

  • Cheese: Complements Brie, Gouda, and Manchego cheeses.

title: Hartford Court Chardonnay Russian River 2024
bodyHtml: Bright, fresh and nuanced, this Chardonnay has so much to offer. The Russian River Chardonnay is a distinctly mid-weight wine built on expressive citrus and floral character. It also happens to be the hidden gem in this range.

title: Michael David Cabernet Sauvignon Freakshow 2022
bodyHtml:
“Michael” and “David” are Michael and David Phillips, brothers whose family has farmed fruits and vegetables in the Lodi region since the 1850s and cultivated wine grapes for nearly a century. Michael and David constitute the 5th generation of grape growers in the Phillips family, with the 6th generation now joining the family business.

The Phillips family likes to emphasize the importance of quality wines with unique and fun labels. Wine makers Adam Mettler, Derek DeVries and Jeff Farthing specialize in producing Lodi’s famous Old Vine Zinfandels, as well as Rhone varietals such as Ancient Vine Cinsault and Syrah for Michael David Winery. 

Farming with future generations in mind, the Phillips have adopted some of the most progressive sustainable farming practices in the state. All 800 acres of the family’s vineyards are third-party certified, and the state’s first per ton bonus was issued for contracted growers to follow in the family’s footsteps.

title: Cannonball Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Cannonball Chardonnay continues to be a perennial favourite, expressive with ripe apple, lemon custard, ripe pear, buttered toast and well-integrated oak spice flavours that are generous and smooth on the palate. The Chardonnay grapes for this vintage were sourced from coastal vineyards in Mendocino, Monterey, San Luis Obispo and Sonoma. Chill and enjoy with roast chicken.
 
Additional Chardonnay food pairings: barbequed salmon, barbequed pork roast on a spit, and roast chicken dinner with all the trimmings.

title: Pine Ridge Chenin Blanc - Viognier 2024
bodyHtml:
#27 Wine Spectator Top 100 of 2025

A consistent winner in the value sweepstakes, this offering from winemaker Michael Beaulac is a blend of 80% Chenin Blanc and 20% Viognier. This dry white offers a stunning aromatic display of honeydew melons, spring flowers, pears and cantaloupe. The sumptuous perfume is followed by a wine with crisp, zesty acids, medium body, and abundant purity as well as freshness. The Viognier component no doubt pushes this delightful white toward an exotic, tropical fruit-flavored style.

title: Decoy Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: This crisp and refreshing Sauvignon Blanc draws you in with tantalizing aromas of pineapple, Meyer lemon, green apple, lime zest, and flint. On the palate, lovely underlying acidity enlivens the zesty citrus flavours, culminating in a bright and energetic lemon-lime finish.

title: Ramsay Merlot 2022
bodyHtml: The 2018 Ramsay Merlot is a product of the constant search for perfect grapes. It is big, lush, full of that lovely Merlot fruitiness. It has succulent mouthfeel and, quite simply, is a lovely wine.

title: Hahn Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Hahn Family Wines is a family owned estate located in the Santa Lucia Highlands of Monterey County, California. Founded in 1980 by Nicky and Gaby Hahn, the winery was instrumental in establishing the Santa Lucia Highlands as a premier American Viticultural Area (AVA) in 1991. The Hahn winemaking philosophy focuses on producing expressive, cool climate wines that highlight the unique terroir of their estate vineyards, characterized by rocky, well drained soils and maritime influences from Monterey Bay.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay displays a bright, light gold appearance and opens with an aromatic bouquet of tropical fruit, citrus peel, and vanilla. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied with a creamy texture, offering vibrant flavours of pineapple, stone fruit, and Meyer lemon, complemented by subtle notes of honeysuckle, butter, and toasty oak. The finish is clean and lingering, marked by a touch of baking spice and refreshing acidity. Typically crafted from 100% Chardonnay, the wine undergoes secondary malolactic fermentation and aging in French oak to achieve its signature balance of richness and brightness. It is best enjoyed within three to five years of the vintage to preserve its fresh fruit character.

title: William Hill Chardonnay North Coast 2024
bodyHtml: William Hill Estate Winery, located in California's North Coast region, has a longstanding reputation for crafting expressive and elegant wines. The North Coast Chardonnay continues this tradition, showcasing the winery's commitment to quality and the unique characteristics of the region.

title: William Hill Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: This well-balanced Cabernet Sauvignon has a rich palate of dark fruit flavors, with subtle hints of caramel and cocoa.

title: Crossbarn Pinot Noir 2022 (by Paul Hobbs)
bodyHtml: Revealing a translucent medium ruby colour as well as textbook Pinot Noir notes of ripe cherry and mulberry fruits interwoven with sappy herbs, sous bois, and scorched earth, it hits the palate with medium-bodied richness and plenty of mid-palate depth as well as a racy, vibrant spine of acidity.

title: Wente Cabernet Sauvignon The Nth Degree 2017
Ramsay Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Kent Rasmussen truly believes that the North Coast has the perfect terroir for growing Cabernet Sauvignon. He spent years searching the appellation for the best "vineyards farmed by really engaged farmers who value quality above all else".

With a deep purple-black colour, this Cabernet Sauvignon has a rich noise of cedar, mint and black fruit. Full-bodied and structured, the wine bursts with layers of blackberry, boysenberry and blueberry. The wine has nice intensity, highlighting rounded tannins and a spicy earth-laced finish. This wine is the perfect partner for rich grilled meats, peppery sauces and dishes full of flavour!

title: Orin Swift Abstract Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
Orin Swift Abstract Red Blend originates from the United States, within the California region. The brand was founded by creative winemaker Dave Phinney, who established Orin Swift Cellars with a signature approach to expressive, artfully labeled bottles. The winery's current operational philosophy relies on a patchwork concept of blending hundreds of distinct wine lots sourced from diverse regions across California, including Napa, Sonoma, and Lodi. Each individual vineyard block is vinified separately and trial-blended multiple times, working under the belief that every lot tells its own story but unifies to create a complex and cohesive final blend.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a dark purple core with an electric, neon ruby rim in the glass and possesses a heavy, full-bodied structure with an opulent, mouth-coating, and plush texture. The sensory profile is incredibly intense, complex, and hedonistic, opening with a broody and expressive nose of ripe black plum, cacao, black pepper, and cedar wood, beautifully complemented by hints of dried porcini mushrooms, forest floor musk, sweet oak, and baking spices. On the generous and rich palate, it delivers a deeply concentrated, flooding stream of blueberry preserves, tarragon, anise, and dark chocolate, layered with black currant and black cherry jam. The finish is remarkably long, lifting, and persistent, leaving a savory, umami-laced trail akin to eggplant yakitori alongside robust, chewy tannins and a gently dusty oak character.

  • Varietal Composition: A proprietary and kaleidoscopic California red blend dominated by Grenache, supported by Petite Sirah and Syrah, with occasional dollops of Zinfandel or Cabernet Sauvignon depending on the vintage.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its powerful balance, bold extraction, and polished fruit vibrancy, trading lean textures for a broad, concentrated, and layered style. To achieve its signature seamless integration, the final assembly is aged for eight months in French oak barrels, utilizing 31% new oak to add sweet spice and toasty nuances.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 15.1% and 15.3%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate relies on rigorous manual tasting trials and precision selection to capture the finest attributes of each vineyard site, this commercial release is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The intense structural layers, full-bodied extraction, and robust tannic backbone of this bold red blend make it a spectacular companion for hearty, rich, and high-protein gastronomy.

  • Meats: Pairs beautifully with premium cuts of grilled steak, roasted meats, a juicy pork tenderloin, or slow-cooked beef brisket.

  • Game & Poultry: Suggested pairings include a roast venison dinner, meat-driven game ragùs, or a rich roasted turkey served with savory trimmings.

  • Savoury & Heavy Fare: Complements intense dishes such as venison au poivre, wild mushroom reductions, or comforting winter stews that align with the wine's dark pepper and umami profile.

title: Louis Martini Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley 2019
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the United States, specifically the prestigious Napa Valley of California, this wine represents a nearly 90-year legacy of superior craftsmanship. Founded in 1933, Louis M. Martini was one of the first wineries to open in the region following Prohibition, driven by a pioneering vision that Napa Valley held the potential to produce world-class Cabernet Sauvignon.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep burgundy colour and a complex sensory profile that opens with aromas of black plum, blackberry, and blackcurrant, accented by wisps of fennel, sage, and smoky cedar. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and concentrated, revealing layers of dark cherry, cassis, and chocolate-covered cherry, underscored by hints of black licorice, cocoa, and a gravelly earthiness.

title: Layer Cake Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Layer Cake, established in 2007, is part of Hundred Acre Winery where Jayson Woodbridge makes serious California cult Cabs. He’s been called “one of California’s most flamboyant, talented, contrarian wine producers”, “crazy cult wine hero”, and “dedicated and devoted to value and excellence”.  Although he was happy with Hundred Acre’s success, Woodbridge wanted to show that he could make affordable wines that seriously over deliver.

He did just that with Layer Cake, sourcing grapes in some of his favourite wine regions in the world including Australia, Argentina, Italy, Spain, and California, knowing that he would find great value. Using the same winemaking techniques that he uses for One Hundred Acre cabs ensures quality and wines that reflect their origin. These carefully crafted Layer Cake wines are affordable luxuries.

title: Cherry Pie Pinot Noir 'San Pablo Bay' 2022
J Lohr Pinot Noir Falcon's Perch 2024
bodyHtml: J. Lohr Falcon's Perch Pinot Noir is bright and alive. This wine offers aromas and flavours of tart red fruit, dried spices, and a note of minerality. Try it with lightly-grilled salmon.

title: J Vineyards Pinot Gris 2023
bodyHtml:
The bright J California Pinot Gris offers layers of generous fruit characteristics and a zesty finish for a delightfully approachable sip. The juicy palate bursts with notes of crunchy pear, fresh-picked white peach, lemon, lime and tart pineapple, while hints of jasmine and minerality add appealing texture and depth. Crisp, mouth-watering acidity at the finish cleanses the palate, making this an ideal partner for food.

Pair this appealing Pinot Gris with grilled fish or chicken, or whitefish ceviche with jicama, mango and avocado. For a cheese pairing, try creamy chèvre topped with citrus marmalade.

title: Calera Pinot Noir de Villiers 2017
bodyHtml: Once again, de Villiers Vineyard has yielded one of Mt. Harlan’s most luxurious and robust Pinot Noirs, with deep, penetrating flavors of ripe plum, black cherry and cassis. As it unfurls, the wine reveals beautiful underlying complexity, with fine-grained tannins and hints of white pepper, sassafras and cigar box lingering on the finish.

title: Bliss Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml: This Chardonnay has aromas of fresh white nectarines and notes of vanilla. A touch of cream soda follows bright fruit flavours. A rich, round mouth complements them feel and lingering tropical flavours. The finish is balanced with good acidity and is sure to please!

title: Bliss Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml: This Cabernet leads with aromas of bright red fruit and cinnamon. An easy-to-drink wine with an outstanding balance between tannins and fruit with a long tobacco cherry finish. Versatile enough to pair with everything from everyday meats to classic cuts. Perfect with hearty meatballs, grilled cheeseburgers, or beef tenderloin.

title: Murphy-Goode Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml: Our Pinot Noir sources grapes throughout the coast of California. From the marine-influenced vineyards of Sonoma County down to hills of the idyllic Santa Barbara. Cool conditions in these prime growing spots keep grapes at a perfect balance between vibrant dark fruit character and bright acidity. Notes of vanilla from aging in French and American oak add complexity to the intense black cherry aromas and flavors.

title: Murphy-Goode Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Founded by friendship in 1985, Murphy-Goode is a serious winery built around a common concept: don’t take life so seriously. Tim Murphy, Dale Goode, and Dave Ready began their winemaking adventure by pooling their collective talents. Both Tim Murphy and Dale Goode were the growers of the team. They helped to pioneer Alexander Valley by bringing wire trellising, broad-scale drip irrigation, and leaf pulling to the area. Tim Murphy is also considered the father of Sonoma Sauvignon Blanc. Dave Ready was the marketer of the trio, bringing a fun personality to the winery, which it is still known for today. Murphy-Goode still puts that same passion of its founders into every vintage. Murphy-Goode is led today by winemaker Dave Ready, Jr., the son of one of the winery’s founders.

This wine is made with the thought of coming home from work, putting your feet up, and relaxing with a refreshing glass in hand. This Chardonnay is fruit-forward, clean and benefits from barrel aging that helps round the wine and add a touch of richness.

title: Murphy-Goode Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Founded by friendship in 1985, Murphy-Goode is a serious winery built around a common concept: don’t take life so seriously. 

Tim Murphy, Dale Goode, and Dave Ready began their winemaking adventure by pooling their collective talents together. Both Tim Murphy and Dale Goode were the growers of the team. They helped to pioneer Alexander Valley by bringing wire trellising, broad scale drip irrigation, and leaf pulling to the area. Tim Murphy is also considered the father of Sonoma Sauvignon Blanc. Dave Ready was the marketer of the trio, bringing a fun personality to the winery, which it is still known for today.

Over 30 years later, Murphy-Goode still puts that same passion of its founders into every vintage. Murphy-Goode is led today by winemaker Dave Ready, Jr., the son of one of the winery’s founders.

title: Decoy Zinfandel 2022
bodyHtml: Since the inaugural vintage of the Decoy Napa Valley Red Wine more than a quarter century ago, Decoy has taken an important place in the Duckhorn Portfolio of wines. With a reputation for delivering great quality at a remarkable price, Decoy has established a loyal following for its distinctive style, which emphasizes ready-upon-release wines that are capable of expressing their full charm and complexity in their youth. Building on this foundation, Decoy has evolved from being a single wine that supported the Duckhorn Vineyards brand to being a renowned winery in its own right.

title: Decoy Merlot 2023
bodyHtml:
The Decoy Merlot is a refined expression of California winemaking, primarily sourced from premium vineyards within Sonoma County and Mendocino County. Established in 1985 by legendary vintners Dan and Margaret Duckhorn, Decoy began as a single red blend before evolving into a dedicated winery known for its 'everyday luxury' philosophy. Today, under the guidance of acclaimed winemaker Dana Epperson, the winery utilizes both prestigious estate sites like Ridgeline and Brownell in the Alexander Valley and fruit from top independent growers to maintain its high standards of quality and distinction.

Wine Description

This vibrant Merlot presents an inviting sensory profile, leading with aromas of fresh black cherry, ripe boysenberry, and leather, accented by notes of black olive, peppercorn, and sweet baking spices. On the palate, the wine is opulent and well-balanced, featuring silky tannins and bright red fruit flavors that harmonize with subtle hints of toasty oak. The varietal composition is predominantly Merlot, often blended with a small percentage of Cabernet Sauvignon for added structure, and it undergoes aging in 100% French oak barrels to achieve a long, cherry-spice finish.

Food Pairing

The structured yet supple profile of this Merlot makes it an ideal companion for hearty dishes such as beef bourguignon, rosemary balsamic pork chops, or roasted lamb shanks. It also pairs remarkably well with savoury fare like ham and cheese sliders or a rich pork ragù served over polenta.

title: Chasing Lions Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: The Chasing Lions Cabernet Sauvignon is bright with ripe red cherries leaping out of the glass, complementing aromas of boysenberry and spicy red plum in the mouth. This juicy and inviting wine shows flavours of milk chocolate, sweet red berries, and a slight oaky smokiness, all harmoniously blended in a matrix of soft and supple tannins. The delicate vanilla finish lingers long after the last sip is gone. Enjoy this crowd-pleasing wine with grilled hanger steak served with rosemary roasted potatoes and garlic broccoli rabe.

title: Kenwood Cabernet Sauvignon Jack London
bodyHtml: Aromas of dried bing cherries, blackberry jam, clove and black currant are underscored by subtle notes of peppercorn. The palate is bold and full-bodied with flavours of raspberry, savoury pastry, balanced tannins and a long finish.

title: Spring Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
bodyHtml:
Belly up to this mouth-wateringly delicious Spring Mountain Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon with a generous pour.

95 Points - Wine Spectator

Features black currant, blackberry and boysenberry reduction flavors that are tightly coiled for now, carried by well-embedded acidity and racy graphite notes. The long finish pumps out fruit, with extra anise and sweet tobacco elements checking in. This should evolve well in the cellar. Best from 2022 through 2040.

title: Franz Haas Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml: The Pinot Grigio has an intense straw yellow color, a floral aromatic bouquet reminiscent of acacia, sage and hay, almonds and sandalwood, and is enriched with aromas of lime blossom and honey after an adequate period in the bottle. On the palate, the wine conquers with its finesse and elegance and the fresh richness / profusion.

title: Zentini Rose Pamplemousse (NV)
bodyHtml: Zentini Rose Pamplemousse is served chilled or better yet, pour over ice. Gently sparkling, it overflows with candied lemon rind and sweet pink grapefruit flavours. At 8 per cent alcohol by volume, it might be the perfect breakfast wine.

title: La Storia Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
The Trentadue family arrived in Sonoma County long before the region gained a reputation as the Wine Country. Life-long, hands-on agriculturists, Evelyn and Leo Trentadue contributed significantly to the advancement of their region over the years. In 1959, they decided to flee the developers encroaching on their apricot and cherry orchards in Sunnyvale, the area known today around the world as Silicon Valley. To preserve their way of life, these hard-working Italian ranchers purchased 208 acres of land in Sonoma County's then-remote Alexander Valley.

They have been growing premium wine grapes, with some vines dating back to 1886. Their farming practices reflect their commitment to exceptional fruit quality and their stewardship of the land from which it comes. They strive to balance the traditions of the area’s early Italian growers and the ever-evolving viticulture industry. Sustainable agriculture is practiced, as they are stewards of their land and utilize all of the elements available to put the most they can offer into each bottle of wine while retaining the viability of their Estate for generations to come.

This dark and juicy wine hits the nose and tongue with notes of blueberry, blackberry, cassis, black cherry and black licorice. As it opens, it also reveals leather, iron, herbs, ripe olives and hints of vanilla, cocoa dust and toast.

title: Benedictine
bodyHtml:
Distilled and aged in a flamboyant palace, built in Fécamp in tribute to this unique liqueur, Benedictine is a subtle alchemy of 27 different plants and spices.

The production process takes place at Le Palais Benedictine, located in the heart of Fécamp, where its secrets have been passed down from generation to generation for over 500 years.

Benedictine is united by a quest to achieve the extraordinary that begins with benedictine monk Dom Bernado Vincelli and the Abbey of Fécamp in Normandy, France.

title: B & B (Benedictine & Brandy)
bodyHtml: B & B, a delightful fusion of Benedictine liqueur and fine brandy, embodies a symphony of rich and complex flavors. The vibrant amber liquid caresses the palate with notes of honey, herbs, and warm spices, harmoniously balanced with the velvety smoothness of aged brandy. A subtle hint of citrus adds a refreshing twist, while the lingering finish leaves a lingering warmth and contentment. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, B & B is currently made at the historic Benedictine Abbey of Fécamp in Normandy, France, where centuries of tradition and expertise are infused into every bottle.

title: Burrowing Owl Syrah 2022
bodyHtml:
Burrowing Owl Estate Winery, established in 1993 in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley, is renowned for its commitment to sustainable viticulture and producing premium VQA wines. The winery's dedication to quality and environmental stewardship has solidified its reputation in the Canadian wine industry.

Wine Description
Burrowing Owl Syrah presents a dense, deep purple hue. On the nose, it offers intense and complex aromas of ripe damson plum, dried blueberries, blackberry, custard, toasty oak, espresso, and pepper, accompanied by charred meat and bacon notes. The palate is full-bodied with a rich texture, firm ripe tannins, and flavours of dried berries, silky toasty oak, a touch of game meat with thyme, pepper, and paprika on the long finish.

Food Pairing
This Syrah pairs wonderfully with BBQ brisket, Devils on Horseback, or a classic rich beef stew. These pairings highlight the wine’s depth and character, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Quails' Gate Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Quails' Gate is a pioneer in viticulture and winemaking in Canada, with vineyards dating back to 1961. Family-farmed since 1956, the winery’s philosophy is predicated on quality over quantity. They are dedicated to producing world-class Pinot Noirs that express the distinct characteristics of their premium wine growing region.

Wine Description

Expect inviting notes of cherry, wild strawberry, sage, and black tea on the nose. The palate is medium-bodied and well structured with a rich tannin profile, presenting flavours of cherry and cocoa. The wine is often described as having an elegant structure and seamless integration of its components, characteristic of a well-regarded Pinot Noir from the Okanagan.

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir is an ideal match for late-season mushrooms or squash risotto. Its structure also pairs beautifully with seared game meats or creamy wild mushroom pork chops. The wine's rich tannin profile and cherry notes complement the savoury umami of mushrooms and the richness of pork.

title: Burrowing Owl Merlot 2022
bodyHtml:
Burrowing Owl Estate Winery, situated in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley, has been producing premium VQA wines since its establishment. The winery is committed to sustainable practices and meticulous vineyard management, ensuring the highest quality in their offerings.

The 2022 Merlot is a complex, intense, and ageable wine. Deep ruby in colour, it presents a powerful nose of black plum, baked blueberry, mint dark chocolate, violet, black licorice, vanilla, and clove. The palate is full-bodied, richly textured, and nicely balanced with fresh acidity and firm, ripe tannins. Flavours of ripe raspberry, shortbread, espresso, nutmeg, paprika, and sage linger through the long finish. This wine is expected to develop further complexity over the next five years and beyond. 

This Merlot pairs beautifully with grilled ribeye accompanied by a red wine demi-glace or roasted portobello mushrooms with herb butter. Together, these pairings enhance the wine’s depth and create an unforgettable dining experience.

The 2022 growing season in the Okanagan Valley was notable for its very late start and remarkable finish, allowing for an abundance of quality grapes and fine wines. An uncharacteristically cool spring resulted in bud break occurring in early May. With delays in fruit development by as much as three weeks, careful vineyard management and cooperative conditions were needed to reach proper sugar levels and ideal natural acidity. The summer months were spectacular, offering the perfect amount of heat and sunshine to allow for the largest yield of grapes to date, followed by an unbelievable fall heading into a condensed harvest that began in October.

As Rhys Pender, Master of Wine, noted, this Merlot is "a complex, intense and ageable Merlot" with a "long finish."

title: Cannonball Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Cannonball Cabernet Sauvignon originates from California, United States, primarily sourcing fruit from the North and Central Coast appellations. The brand’s philosophy is rooted in the idea that wine should be approachable, fun, and uninhibited, symbolized by the iconic image of a child jumping into water to make a splash.

Wine Description

This wine presents a lively, dark ruby to deep black cherry colour. The aromatic profile is concentrated with notes of boysenberry, plum, and dark berries, accented by sophisticated layers of vanilla cream, mocha, and subtle sandalwood from French oak. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and lush, delivering flavours of black currant, red plum, and mulberry, with a touch of Belgian cocoa and violet. The structure is defined by supple, polished tannins and a well balanced acidity that leads to a smooth, long finish.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and dark fruit profile of this Cabernet Sauvignon make it an ideal companion for grilled red meats like ribeye steak, smoky ribs, or gourmet burgers. It also pairs beautifully with earthy dishes such as mushroom risotto or hearty eggplant parmesan, where the wine's acidity cuts through the richness.

title: La Crema Pinot Noir Monterey 2023
bodyHtml:
The La Crema Pinot Noir Monterey hails from the Monterey region in California's Central Coast, United States. Originally named La Crema Vinera, or 'best of the vine', this family-owned winery has specialized in cool climate appellations since 1979. Their winemaking philosophy centers on exploring unique regions where the influence of the Pacific Ocean produces expressive and elegant wines.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a bright garnet-like colour and a deeply aromatic profile. The nose opens with a blend of boysenberry, black plum, and rhubarb, layered with subtle undertones of tobacco leaf, earth, and toasted spice. On the palate, the wine is luxurious and richly textured, featuring flavours of pomegranate, red plum, and black tea.

title: La Crema Chardonnay Monterey 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and coastal-inspired white wine originates from the United States, specifically from the California region and the Monterey AVA subregion. Established in 1979, La Crema Winery is a family-owned estate that initially gained its reputation in the Russian River Valley before expanding its focus to other premier cool-climate sites. The winery's philosophy is centred on handcrafted, Burgundian-style winemaking that highlights the unique marine-based soils and windy climates of California's coast.

Wine Description

La Crema Chardonnay Monterey presents a brilliant straw yellow colour. The sensory profile features an expressive nose of baked apple, brioche, and pineapple, layered with sophisticated notes of citrus blossom and oak spice. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and 'rich yet refreshing', showcasing flavours of Asian pear, lemon curd, and Meyer lemon concentrated alongside hints of toasted vanilla and smoky spice. It is characterized by its balanced acidity and an elegantly long, zesty finish with notes of minerality. This 100% Chardonnay typically reaches an ABV of 13.5%. While the estate has supported sustainable farming since 1999 and is a certified 'green business', select retail listings also describe this specific bottling as organic.

title: Paul Hobbs Pinot Noir Russian River 2023
bodyHtml: Estate-born from their high-density plantings in the western reaches of the appellation, this wine displays translucent ruby and entices with freshly picked violets, wild cherry, and scents of sage. The palate is framed by a supple texture and well-integrated tannins that opens with layered notes of crushed pomegranate seeds, blood orange extract, and lightly steeped Rooibos tea. This is an elegant and graceful wine with bright acidity, leading to a long and pure finish.

title: Sterling Pinot Noir Vintner's Collection 2021
bodyHtml: The Sterling Vintner’s Collection Pinot Noir offers notes of black cherry, raspberry, pomegranate, vanilla and tobacco spice on the nose. The concentrated palate is rich with good depth and complex flavours of dark berries, black tea, cocoa dust and warm vanilla. The tannins are silky and well-integrated and lead to a flavourful finish. The diverse nature of Pinot Noir makes it a perfect accompaniment to many foods including grilled meats, cheeses and even salmon.

title: Davis Bynum Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: This Chardonnay has beautiful aromas of baked Fuji apples, lemon custard and white flowers. On the palate, the wine opens up with toasty brioche, hazelnut and baking spices, with a lush finish that is balanced with acidity and a rich creaminess. Enjoy with creamy cheeses, vegetable risotto or grilled halibut.

title: The Prisoner Wine Co. - Saldo 2024
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from the United States, primarily sourced from premier vineyards across California’s renowned Zinfandel regions, including Dry Creek Valley, Lodi, and the Sierra Foothills. The Prisoner Wine Co. was founded two decades ago by winemaker Dave Phinney and is currently owned by Constellation Brands. The winemaking philosophy is rooted in a collaborative approach, where a team led by Director of Winemaking Chrissy Wittmann partners with more than 100 growers to source exceptional fruit unrestricted by traditional regional boundaries. The name 'Saldo' is derived from the Italian word meaning 'I join or I weld', reflecting the winery's technique of welding together grapes from diverse, high-quality sites to create a singular, cohesive expression.

Wine Description

The Prisoner Wine Co. 'Saldo' displays a deep dark ruby colour. The nose is bold and expressive, offering intense aromas of black licorice, black pepper, cherry, and warm baking spices. On the palate, the wine is rich, mouthwatering, and full-bodied, featuring smooth flavours of dark cherry and chocolate integrated with soft, velvety tannins. It is characterized by its opulent texture and a voluptuous, lingering finish. The varietal composition is predominantly Zinfandel, typically blended with Petite Sirah and Syrah to add depth, color, and structural complexity. The ABV is typically 15% to 15.5%. While the winery sources from some certified organic sites, such as Grist Vineyard in Dry Creek Valley, the 'Saldo' California blend itself is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is generally within 3 to 5 years of the vintage to enjoy its vibrant fruit-forward character.

title: Ghost Pines Merlot 2020
bodyHtml:
At the heart of every glass of Ghost Pines is the notion that world-class wines are made from quality grapes – grapes that span many appellations. An unconventional view against today's backdrop of single-appellation wines, the Ghost Pines philosophy is a modern take on visionary winemaker Louis M. Martini's approach to winemaking.

This Merlot blend is layered with flavors of dark berries, licorice and espresso alongside lots of richness, full-bodied structure, and desirable length. In addition to these flavors, hints of cigar paper, cocoa, caramel and nutmeg are wrapped around a remarkably smooth mid-palate full of velvety texture and depth. On the long finish, suggestions of toasty oak make it through the palate with mouth-filling black fruit aromas and hints of cola framed by plush tannins.

title: Mandolin Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml: With its maritime influence, California’s Monterey region has an extended growing season that yields wines with full flavor development and great acid balance. Mandolin Pinot Noir is a rich wine that features bright cherry and raspberry fruit with hints of spice, leather and cedar.

title: Stags' Leap Winery Viognier 2022
bodyHtml: This white wine is fresh and lively, showcasing classic stone fruit and citrus blossom characteristics, with hints of lemon meringue and white pepper. This wine has racing acidity and a steely minerality which adds to the wines crispness and complexity. Layers of white peach, hints of lemongrass and raw almond, are plentiful on the palate, leading to a very long elegant, delicately floral spiced finish. This Viognier is a mouthwatering expression of Viognier that is perfect for warm weather occasions offering a silky texture and roundness on the palate that invites you to take another sip, again and again

title: Chateau St Jean Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1973, Chateau St. Jean was conceived as a truly fine wine estate in the European style, where wines from individual vineyards were kept separate to fully capture the individual character of each site. The wines received immediate critical acclaim, and Chateau St. Jean was soon recognized as a leader in single vineyard-designated wines.

This wine offers the classic Chateau St. Jean signature: big fruit intensity. Vivid aromas of blackberries, fresh plum and chocolate follow through to rich flavours of black cherries, fresh berry pie and notes of black tea. Well structured with a juicy mouthfeel and a full, lingering finish.

title: Chateau St Jean Cinq Cepages 2022
bodyHtml:
Chateau St Jean Cinq Cepages 2022 originates from the United States, within the Sonoma County region of California. Founded in 1973 by the Goff family, the winery rose to prominence for its commitment to single vineyard wines and its flagship Bordeaux style blend, Cinq Cepages, first introduced with the 1990 vintage. Since 2021, the estate has been owned by Foley Family Wines, which continues the winery's legacy of blending Old World elegance with California craftsmanship. The winemaking philosophy centres on selecting the finest fruit from across Sonoma's diverse sub appellations to create a wine that expresses the best of the region's terroir.

Wine Description

This iconic red blend presents an inky black carmine or deep purple hue. The sensory profile is complex and alluring, opening with sultry aromas of dark plum, blackberry, cassis, and lavender, accented by hints of cedar, vanilla, and baking chocolate. On the full bodied palate, the wine is plush and layered, delivering flavours of ripe black cherry, crème de cassis, dark chocolate, and graphite. The structure is defined by velvety, well integrated tannins and a fresh tension, leading to a long, graceful finish with nuances of cocoa nibs and fall spices.

  • Varietal Composition: 73% Cabernet Sauvignon, 11% Malbec, 9% Merlot, 4% Cabernet Franc, and 3% Petit Verdot.

  • ABV: Typically ranges between 14.5% and 15.1%.

  • Organic Status: This wine is not certified organic, but it is classified as sustainably produced.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine was aged for 20 months in French oak barrels (70% new) and is built for significant ageing, with a cellaring potential of 10 to 15 years.

title: Bonterra Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml: Intense grapefruit, citrus, kiwi, and fresh-cut grass aromas greet the nose. As you drink, the crisp acidity gives the wine a fresh, vibrant feel with flavours of grapefruit, lime zest and grass that closes with flavours of melon and a nice tart finish.

title: Whatchamacallit Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Caramel, pineapple and pear aromas with mineral, oak spice and citrus notes. Toasty flavours, light spice citrus and tropical flavours vanillin oak, crisp yet rounded on the palate with a fresh finish. Easy drinking with good California Chardonnay structure.

title: Freemark Abbey Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml: Light greenish straw in colour, this Chardonnay expresses fruit aroma of ripe pineapple, ripe banana, guava, apricot, peach and tropical fruit cocktail. Adding to the complexity, the oak aging is fairly integrated adding spice like nutmeg, light toast, and the nuance of angel food cake. This wine has great viscosity, depth and an intriguing long finish. The flavours are lively on the palate with pear, citrus, lemon lime, green apple and fleshy peach. This wine shows great complexity, creaminess, and elegance to compliment many foods.

title: Noble Vines 337 Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: Cabernet Sauvignon 337 vine stock originated in Bordeaux, France. With its rich, dark fruit flavors and fine tannins, Noble Vines Cabernet Sauvignon 337 displays the traits that earned the 337 stock its famous reputation. Black cherry and coffee take the lead with flavors of blackberry and spice leading to a long finish.

title: Foppiano Petite Sirah 2021
bodyHtml: This Petite Sirah is a balanced and complex example of the varietal. A touch of dried rose petals, white pepper, ripe fruit and liquorice aromas followed by a very satisfying mid-palate with midseason plum, black tea, baked cherry and huckleberry. The wine finishes with fruit and spice with supple tannins.

title: Coppola Cabernet Sauvignon Diamond Collection 2022
bodyHtml:
Diamond Collection Cabernet Sauvignon is a distinguished red wine from California, primarily sourced from the Paso Robles appellation within the Central Coast. Founded by acclaimed filmmaker Francis Ford Coppola, the winery established its current home in Geyserville during the late 2000s, though the family’s winemaking traditions date back generations. The Diamond Collection is a collaborative effort under Delicato Family Wines, focusing on a philosophy of appellation-specific sourcing and meticulous fruit selection to create approachable, high-quality wines.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon presents a bold sensory profile, opening with a dark ruby colour and purple reflections. The nose is expressive, featuring delightful notes of black cherry, peppercorn, blackberry, and subtle hints of vanilla and tobacco. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and intense, revealing concentrated flavours of plum, boysenberry, and baking spices. It maintains an opulent body with supple tannins and a long, sophisticated finish.

title: Rock & Vine Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml: Rock & Vine is a Bordeaux-style blend consisting of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Malbec, and Petit Verdot . Each component is aged separately for 16 months in a combination of French and American oak before blending. The fruit was selected from three ranches located in: Lake County, Mendocino, and Napa Valley that showcases why the North Coast is the leader in California for growing Bordeaux varieties. The Lake County grapes highlight the rich and ripe black fruit flavors, while Napa Valley grapes provide the backbone: rich textures and firm well-integrated tannins. Finally the Mendocino grapes tend toward dried herbs and a wonderful spice component that rounds out this intensely rich wine.

title: The Prisoner Wine Co. - Prisoner Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml: The Prisoner Red Blend was inspired by the wines first made by the Italian immigrants who originally settled in Napa Valley. The Prisoner is now the most recognized red blend, leading the resurgence of interesting blends by incorporating Zinfandel with the unlikely mix of Cabernet Sauvignon, Petite Sirah, Syrah, and Charbono. Bright aromas of ripe raspberry, vanilla, and coconut give way to flavors of fresh and dried blackberry, pomegranate, and vanilla, which linger harmoniously for a smooth and luscious finish.

title: Carmel Road Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Crisp, tangy coastal acidity brings balancing freshness to the rich, ripe flavors of nectarines and peaches. Suggestions of breadfruit, guava, golden mango, tangerine and golden apricot. There is a honeyed sweetness, but the finish is dry.

title: Four Vines Zinfandel The Biker 2021
bodyHtml: Paso Robles Zins are bold, full-bodied wines with jammy fruit and pepper spice. Biker roars out of the glass with heady aromas of blackberry, black currant and spice. Flavours of wild bramble, sweet black cherry and jam follow while the finish is intense, layered and long. Biker will not disappoint when paired with pasta and red sauce, meat lover's pizza or braised short ribs.

title: Mer Soleil Silver Unoaked Chardonnay 2022 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and 'fresh' white wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Monterey County subregion of the Central Coast in California. Founded thirty years ago by Chuck Wagner of Caymus Vineyards, Mer Soleil was born from a search for ideal Chardonnay land along the California coast. Today, the estate is led by his son, winemaker Charlie Wagner, who spent time in the vineyards as a child and eventually spearheaded the creation of 'Silver'. The winery's philosophy emphasizes the unique coastal terroir of the Santa Lucia Highlands and Monterey, where morning fog and intense afternoon winds allow for a long growing season and vibrant acidity.

Wine Description

This 100% Chardonnay presents a pale yellow hue and is defined by its complete lack of oak exposure. The sensory profile features an inviting nose of creamy citrus, lemon zest, and Meyer lemon blossoms, layered with a distinct minerality that evokes wet granite. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and 'round', showcasing flavours of sweet clementine, mango, and pink grapefruit underpinned by a crisp, racy acidity. It is characterized by an intriguing mid-palate of lemon meringue and quince that carries through to a clean, mouth-watering finish. To preserve its natural fruit purity and 'awakened' freshness, the wine is fermented and aged in a combination of stainless steel and small concrete tanks imported from Burgundy.

title: Crossbarn Cabernet Sauvignon 2021 (by Paul Hobbs)
bodyHtml: Capturing the diversity and complexity from the region, this vintage displays a dark ruby hue with aromas of crushed violets, boysenberry, and blackberry compote. A burst of dark black fruits is revealed on the palate carried along by dried herbs, graphite, and cacao. Enveloping fine-grained tannins complement the soft textured body along with a lively acidity that gives the wine a clean, lingering finish.

title: Paul Hobbs Chardonnay Russian River 2022
bodyHtml: Crafted with precision from six pedigreed sites, the newest vintage shines with an opalescent, pale straw hue. Aromas of red apple skin, Asian pear, and Meyer lemon zest entices the nose, followed by delicate notes of gardenia. Lively flavors of apricot and nectarine emerge on the palate, giving way to lemon meringue and baking spice. Bright and energetic with a vibrant acidity, this graceful wine ends with a long, seamless finish.

title: Carmel Road Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Carmel Road is nestled in the foothills of the Santa Lucia Mountains, inland from Monterey's rugged coastline, yet directly in the path of the relentless, cooling ocean influences. The winery's philosophy centres on capturing the vibrant, bright flavour profile of Monterey, where the interplay of fog, wind, and sun creates distinctive wines.

Wine Description

This medium bodied red wine is known for its bright, silky, and crisp nature. It offers bright cherry aromas layered with notes of wild strawberries and black tea. The palate presents juicy black cherry flavours, notes of cola, and hints of vanilla and toasted oak. It has well balanced tannins and a silky texture that leads to a long finish. It is a medium bodied wine with vibrant acidity and supple texture.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include grilled salmon, duck, and mushroom dishes. Its bright acidity and red fruit flavours perfectly complement earthy flavors such as mushroom risotto or roasted chicken with Brussels sprouts.

title: Rutherford Ranch Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
This Cabernet Sauvignon opens with aromas of black cherry, black current, and dark plum layered upon notes of toasty caramel. On the palate, this full-bodied silky wine has flavours of blackberries and Mission figs intermingled by notes of clove and well-integrated tannins.

This rich and opulent Cabernet Sauvignon complements a variety of dishes including mushroom and goat cheese tartlets, braised short ribs, or a herb-crusted lamb shank.

title: Rombauer Zinfandel 2022
bodyHtml:
Exceptional wines made by lovers of wine!

Founded in 1980, by Koerner and Joan Rombauer, Rombauer Vineyards has been producing acclaimed wines from Napa Valley and the Sierra Foothills ever since. Still family owned and operated, their winery is known for its high quality wines, exceptional vineyard sites and family style hospitality.

When poured, this classic California Zinfandel is a purple-ruby colour with a bright crimson hue. On the nose, there are concentrated aromas of dried cherries that meld with warm vanilla, mocha, and mulling spices. Lush flavours of ripe plum and raspberry jam flood the palate, followed by touches of dark chocolate in the background. Subtle and round tannins add length for a fresh and enticing finish.

title: Rombauer Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This white wine originates from the United States, produced in the California region within the Carneros subregion that spans both Napa and Sonoma valleys. Rombauer Vineyards was founded in 1980 by Koerner and Joan Rombauer, and the estate released its first Chardonnay in 1984. In August 2023, the winery was acquired by E. & J. Gallo's Luxury Wine Group, though it remains a family-focused operation. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes producing 'California-style' wines that are bold and fruit-driven, specifically balancing rich fruit intensity with fresh, lively acidity.

Wine Description

The Rombauer Chardonnay presents a luminous straw-yellow colour. The nose is expressive and layered, offering aromas of ripe yellow peach, melon, and Meyer lemon interspersed with scents of chamomile, clove, and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and concentrated, featuring flavours of tropical fruit, apricot, and baked apple integrated with notes of creamy vanilla and buttery brioche. It is characterized by its signature bright acidity and a rich, fleshy texture that leads into a long finish marked by hints of spice and pie crust.

Food Pairing

The rich texture and vibrant acidity of this Chardonnay make it a versatile partner for a variety of savoury dishes. It pairs beautifully with roasted poultry, such as chicken pot pie or roast chicken with potatoes, and seafood like dungeness crab rolls, lobster, and grilled salmon. It also complements creamy pasta dishes like fettuccine alfredo, mushroom risotto, and mild corn chowder. For a unique pairing, consider serving it with buttered popcorn or a caramelized pear filled with cheese fondue.

title: Menage A Trois Red Blend 2023
bodyHtml: Menage a Trois Red wine exposes the fresh, ripe, jam-like fruit that is the calling card of California wine. Add pink to your cheeks with bold blackberry, ripe raspberry flavours, and firm tannins. A blend of Zinfandel, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. To add complexity and retain character, each variety was fermented separately, then blended before bottling. Forward, silky, and soft, this delicious dalliance makes the perfect accompaniment for grilled meats and chicken.

title: Kunde Estate Sauvignon Blanc 2021
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
For over a century, five generations of the Kunde Family have farmed their 1,850 acre estate in the Sonoma Valley – a truly remarkable legacy in the modern age of California winemaking. A fervent, forward thinking vision of land stewardship and sustainability began over 100 years ago and has been shaped with each successive generation.

Today, Kunde Family Winery is still family owned and operated with a hands-on team of 4th and 5th generation family members at the helm. Every decision they make, every wine they craft, and every experience they provide honors the legacy of Great Grandfather, Louis Kunde. Kunde remains committed to innovation in their vineyards and winery while maintaining a deep, personal commitment to sustainable winegrowing and preserving the land for generations to come.

title: Schug Chardonnay Sonoma Coast 2024
bodyHtml:
The Sonoma Coast Chardonnay is produced without new oak, allowing the bright varietal character to shine through. Harvested from select vineyards in the Sonoma Coast AVA, including the cooler microclimates of western Carneros, the elegant aromas of fresh citrus, grapefruit, and white peach with hints of stone fruit abound. The juicy palate offers delicate flavors of Meyer lemon, yellow apple, kiwi, and nuances of honeysuckle, finishing with vibrant acidity and mineral-driven notes.

Pair with aged cheeses such as gouda or manchego or delicate seafood dishes, soups, and pasta dishes.

title: McManis Petite Sirah 2024
bodyHtml:
McManis Petite Sirah is a wine that truly embodies the essence of California winemaking. This wine is crafted with care and expertise by the McManis family, who have a long history of farming in the Central Valley region. The wine's rich and bold flavors of blackberry and blueberry are complemented by hints of vanilla, oak, and spice, creating a wine that is both complex and well-balanced.

The firm tannins and smooth, lingering finish make McManis Petite Sirah a standout wine that can be enjoyed on its own or paired with a variety of foods. The wine is aged in French and American oak barrels, which adds depth and complexity to the wine, making it an exceptional choice for any wine lover seeking a high-quality and versatile wine.

title: Bogle Phantom Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml: From the finest field lots, they select only the highest-quality grapes to create Phantom Red. Full-bodied and jammy, Phantom's origins of Petite Sirah and Zinfandel emerge from the glass. Spicy pepper and juniper tantalize your senses, while black plums and blueberries emerge on the palate. After aging for over 24 months in 1 & 2-year-old American oak, pipe tobacco and clove settle around the finish, long and lingering, like the Delta fog.

title: Frei Brothers Cabernet Sauvignon Sonoma Reserve 2021
bodyHtml: Frei Brothers Reserve Alexander Valley Cabernet Sauvignon is a classic expression of a deftly balanced Cabernet from this acclaimed region. Aromas of blackberries and dark cherry open in the glass. On the palate, this wine is medium bodied with silky tannins and great structure. Brimming with layers of Mission plum and cassis, this Cabernet Sauvignon reveals touches of caramel and cocoa that complement a long, detailed finish.

title: Waterstone Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Waterstone Winery was formed in 2000 with the simple concept of creating luxury wines at affordable prices. Bringing together previously established relationships with Napa Valley growers and vintners, the winery set out to develop balanced wines of varietal character through intelligent sourcing. Preferring to focus on the wine itself rather than the accumulation of land and facilities, Waterstone owns no vineyards, nor does it own the facility where their wines are made. Dedicated winemaking, strong relationships with top growers and long-term grape contracts are the keys to Waterstone’s quality and success.

This Cabernet Sauvignon showcases layers of sweet black cherry, warm baking spices, lead pencil shavings and mocha. Elegantly structured with plush mouth-filling tannins, fine dusty tannins, and a bright fruit expression; the wine finishes with notes of black currant and cassis.

title: Hartford Zinfandel Old Vine Russian River 2022
bodyHtml:
#39 on Wine Spectator’s Top 100 Wines of 2025

Hartford Russian River Valley Zinfandel is showing aromas of ripe plum, blackberry, and black cherry which are highlighted with hints of white pepper and allspice. Blueberry, red raspberry, nutmeg and mocha flavors lead into a long, bright finish with supple tannins.

title: Michael David Syrah Sixth Sense 2022
bodyHtml: Ripe black plum, cherry and blackberry jam aromas waft immediately out of the glass, complemented by chocolate, fresh tarragon, fennel and black pepper spice. On the palate of this wine, these flavors come together, woven by soft, plushy tannins and a solid dose of acidity.

title: The 7 Deadly Zins Old Vine 2022
bodyHtml: This Zinfandel explodes with sweet plums and pepper dominates on the nose along with blueberries, ripe raspberries, vanilla and sweet spices on the palate. It is full, rich and jammy with soft velvety tannins and lots of flavour.

title: Sebastiani Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml: The palate is rich, yet compact, with elegant blackberry fruit flavours followed by Cabernet spice and savoury herbs. It finishes with bright berry fruit and a touch of sweetness from the oak influence. The tannins are ripe and round, affording early drinkability.

title: Ridge Vineyards Three Valleys 2024
bodyHtml: This exceptional red wine originates from the United States, specifically the Sonoma County region of California. Ridge Vineyards was founded in 1962 by four engineers from the Stanford Research Institute, and it has since become world-renowned under the long-standing guidance of winemaker Paul Draper. While the winery is famous for its single-vineyard focus, Three Valleys is a unique exception, crafted as a master blend from several distinct Sonoma vineyards to represent the finest of the region's diverse terroir.

title: Truchard Chardonnay Carneros 2023
bodyHtml: Truchard Vineyards is a small, family-owned winery in the Carneros region of Napa Valley. Proprietors Tony and Jo Ann Truchard have managed a successful vineyard and grown exceptional grapes for nearly 40 years. Through their hard work and devotion to this unique property, they helped pioneer grape growing in the Carneros region of Napa. In 1989, the Truchards established a winery and began producing wines using only their estate-grown fruit.

title: McManis Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml:
McManis Cabernet Sauvignon is a red wine from the Lodi region in the Northern Interior of California, United States. Founded in 1990 by fourth generation family farmers Ron and Jamie McManis, the company has been growing grapes in the area since 1938. Their winemaking philosophy is centered on producing quality wines at an honest price by utilizing small-winery techniques, such as whole-cluster pressing and small-lot handling, at a larger scale.

Wine Description

This wine exhibits a dark garnet colour with a bouquet that is full of blueberry, black cherry, and blackberry notes. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with a juicy and creamy texture, featuring flavours of dark berries, blackcurrant, and a touch of mocha or chocolate. It is characterized by its rounded tannins and integrated oak influence, which contributes a hint of smoke to the finish. The typical varietal composition includes approximately 75% to 77% Cabernet Sauvignon, rounded out with Petite Sirah, Petit Verdot, and occasionally Teroldego for added body and texture. The ABV is 13.5% and the wine is produced using sustainable farming practices certified under the Lodi Rules program. Its optimal drinking window is while it is young and fresh, usually within 1 to 5 years of the vintage.

title: Smoking Loon Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml:
When it comes to wine, Smoking Loon believes in spreading your wings and experiencing the best the world has to offer—sip by sip. Smoking Loon wines display bold, exciting flavors that complement everyday adventures. Each wine is crafted to capture true varietal character, rewarding those willing to migrate beyond the ordinary.  Why Fly When You Can Soar?  

Smoking Loon wines have been widely recognized for their outstanding quality since 2001.  The winery has won 29 Wine Enthusiast "Best Buy" awards, as well as 15 Wine Spectator "Best Value" awards.

title: Truchard Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This elegant red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Carneros region in southern Napa Valley. Truchard Vineyards is a family-owned estate founded in 1974 by Tony and Jo Ann Truchard, who were pioneers in developing the Carneros AVA for grape growing. The winery's philosophy emphasizes small-production lots crafted exclusively from its 400-acre estate, which features a diverse topography of rolling hills and unique soils ranging from volcanic ash to sandstone. The family considers themselves 'a big vineyard with a small winery,' hand-selecting only the best fruit for their own labels while selling the majority of their grapes to other premier Napa producers.

Wine Description

The 2023 Truchard Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep colour and a layered sensory profile typical of the estate's hillside parcels. The nose offers elegant aromas of raspberry, plum, and cassis, complemented by subtle touches of cedar and vanilla. On the palate, the wine is rich and complex, featuring intense flavours of ripe cherries, red currants, and berry jam.

This wine is typically a blend, with the estate often incorporating small amounts of Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot, and Malbec to provide additional softness and structural complexity. Stylistically, it is noted for its balance and refinement, where ripe tannins focus the palate and lead to a lengthy finish of spice and red fruit.

title: Truchard Syrah 2023
bodyHtml:
Truchard Vineyards is a small, family-owned winery in the Carneros region of Napa Valley. Proprietors Tony and Jo Ann Truchard have managed a successful vineyard and grown exceptional grapes for nearly 40 years. Through their hard work and devotion to this unique property, they helped pioneer grape growing in the Carneros region of Napa. In 1989, the Truchards established a winery and began producing wines using only their estate-grown fruit.

Wine Description

Truchard's Syrah reveals a rich nose of cassis, black cherry, and ripe plum; with a touch of vanilla, leather, and white pepper. The mouth is layered with jammy flavours of blackberry, boysenberry and red currants; followed by mineral and cracked black pepper.

title: Truchard Roussanne 2024
bodyHtml:
Truchard Vineyards is a small, family-owned winery in the Carneros region of Napa Valley. Proprietors Tony and Jo Ann Truchard have managed a successful vineyard and grown exceptional grapes for nearly 40 years. Through their hard work and devotion to this unique property, they helped pioneer grape growing in the Carneros region of Napa. In 1989, the Truchards established a winery and began producing wines using only their estate-grown fruit.

This white varietal has been traditionally associated with the Northern Rhone, where it is blended with Marsanne to make white Hermitage wines. In 1998, three acres of Roussanne were planted on the southern end of the Truchard Estate Vineyard. Floral aromas of pineapple, honeysuckle, and jasmine with highlights of brioche and vanilla. The mouth is crisp, with clean flavours of fresh pear, honeydew melon and apricot. Bright acidity provides a lengthy finish of citrus, mineral, and spice.

title: Buehler Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
John Buehler, Sr. and his son, John, began the renovation of the property that would become Buehler Vineyards in 1971. Located six miles east of St. Helena and nestled in the mountains above Conn Valley, Buehler Vineyards encompasses some 300 acres of Napa Valley hillside terrain.

The wine is brimming with fruit aromas and flavors biased to the black fruit end of the Cabernet spectrum: plums, blackberry, and black currant. Rich and full-bodied on the palate, this Cabernet drinks well on release but will soften and develop with additional age.

title: Buehler Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Buehler Vineyards Chardonnay originates from the United States, within the California region and the world-famous Russian River Valley subregion of Sonoma County. The estate itself is an idyllic family-owned property established in 1971 by John Buehler Sr., located in the mountains east of St. Helena in Napa Valley. The winery's current operational philosophy relies on the belief that less intervention is better when dealing with a delicate variety like Chardonnay. Although their hillside estate focuses on red varieties, they have been sourcing Chardonnay from the cooler maritime climate of the Russian River Valley since 1993, highlighting balance, proportion, and regional authenticity over heavy winemaking manipulations.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a clear, bright, and golden-yellow appearance in the glass and possesses a medium-to-full-bodied structure with a creamy, velvety, and mouth-filling texture. The sensory profile is highly elegant, expressive, and balanced, opening with an abundant nose of white flowers, honeysuckle, ripe peach, and apricot, intricately woven with mineral lime, citrus blossom, and toasty notes of graham cracker. On the rich, supple, and vibrant palate, it delivers concentrated flavours of yellow pear, crisp apple, lemon, and pineapple, seamlessly balanced by a refreshing, lively natural acidity. The finish is remarkably long, clean, and crisp, leaving a lingering impression of baking spice, light vanilla, and subtle orchard fruit.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay sourced from the Wood Vineyard on River Road and the River Vineyard on East Side Road.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its classic buttery yet complex profile, perfectly combining lush fruit definition with traditional cellar techniques. To maximize mouthfeel and texture, it undergoes sur-lie aging, regular lees stirring, and full secondary malolactic fermentation, tempered by the measured use of new French oak alongside stainless steel tank fermentation.

  • ABV: Typically 13.9%.

title: Esser Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
bodyHtml:
Esser wines are produced from the cool Central Coast Region of California and crafted from sustainably farmed vineyards. These wines express the fruit, the climate, the terroir and water into a poetic expression of flavors long sought by wine connoisseurs from around the globe.

Esser Vineyards' Cabernet Sauvignon emits deep aromas of black cherry, plum, dark chocolate and oak. Mouth filling flavors of dark fruits, cocoa and vanilla are balanced with tannins and a lingering finish of sweet fruit and subtle spices.

86 Points - Wine Enthusiast    Gamy aromas meet with dark berry on the slightly sour nose of this bottling. Tangy black fruits and dark strawberry show on the sip, where the gamy, dried meat flavors also show.

title: Seghesio Zinfandel 2023
bodyHtml: Aromas of wild blueberry, briary raspberry patch and baking spice give way to a palate of juicy, ripe blackberry and black plum. Soft tannins, a rich mouthfeel and focused acidity lead to a long finish, creating a delightful wine to pair with red sauces, pizza, and barbeque, as well as sopressata and dry jack.

title: Meiomi Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml: The wine owes much of the complexity to its varied upbringing, unifying grapes from California's most notable winegrowing regions. Meiomi Pinot Noir brings you structure and depth seldom seen in a Pinot Noir wine, thanks to its unique and meticulous aging process. Aged for six months in French oak barrels, this California red wine's juicy strawberry flavour and notes of dark berries and toasted mocha add complexity and depth to the palate.

title: Murrieta's Well Sauvignon Blanc 2020
bodyHtml: This wine delivers appealing aromatics and a complex palate. Our Sauvignon Blanc brings a unique perspective due to the terroir of Murrieta’s Well estate vineyards. The Aromatics are quick yet lasting and enticing, showing passion fruit, lime, and apple with a hint of lychee. This is complemented by a touch of vanilla and lightly toasted oak. The palate is medium-bodied with a crisp finish. This wine would do well as an aperitif, or paired with a pear and gorgonzola salad, goat cheese on toast, or freshly shucked oysters.

title: Schug Pinot Noir Sonoma Coast 2023
bodyHtml:
This 100% Pinot Noir cuvee reflects the cool and windy microclimate of the Sonoma Coast AVA. The climate and terroir here provide ideal conditions for low yields (equating to more flavor intensity) and longer hangtimes (allowing Pinot Noir grapes to reach maturity while retaining their natural acidity and preserving the bright flavors of red cherries and raspberries). Schug ensures the elegant expression in this Pinot Noir by aging in large neutral oak casks, stainless steel, and older French oak barrels to keep new oak flavors to a minimum.

Lively acidity on the finish makes it an ideal accompaniment to grilled fish and fowl or barbecued meats.

title: Paraduxx Proprietary Red 2022
bodyHtml:
Paraduxx Proprietary Red Wine originates from the United States, within the renowned California region and the premier Napa Valley subregion. Founded in 1994 by Dan and Margaret Duckhorn, Paraduxx stands as the only Napa Valley winery exclusively devoted to crafting stylish, innovative Napa Valley blends. The estate's operational philosophy centers on combining the structural grandeur and elegance of Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon with the robust, vibrant fruit character of California's native Zinfandel. Under the modern winemaking guidance of Cardiff Scott-Robinson, each vineyard block from four acclaimed estate properties and select elite growers is harvested and aged separately to preserve its unique, fingerprint-like terroir identity before final blending.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a dark ruby, deep, and luxurious appearance in the glass and possesses a medium-to-full-bodied structure with a silky, velvety, and mouth-filling texture. The sensory profile is highly expressive, bold, and complex, opening with an alluring nose of blackberry, cassis, and black raspberry pie, intricately woven with hints of violet, sandalwood, cocoa powder, licorice, and warm baking spices like cinnamon and clove. On the voluptuous and potent palate, it delivers deep, concentrated layers of blackberry jam, spiced blueberry, and dark cherry, seamlessly balanced by a lively natural acidity and robust, well-behaved tannins. The finish is remarkably long, generous, and persistent, leaving a lingering trail of savory spice, sweet tobacco leaf, anise, and a touch of dried earth.

  • Varietal Composition: While the exact blend varies by vintage to satisfy the modern palate, it is crafted around a dominant Cabernet Sauvignon core. For example, the 2021 vintage is composed of 51% Cabernet Sauvignon, 15% Zinfandel, 13% Malbec, 10% Merlot, 6% Syrah, and 5% Petite Sirah.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its distinctly Californian personality, taking full advantage of the region's ability to ripen multiple varieties to perfection. To integrate its bold fruit and develop supple, polished tannins, the wine is typically matured for 18 months in a combination of French and Hungarian oak barrels, utilizing roughly 40% new and 60% neutral wood.

  • ABV: 14.5%.

title: Schug Chardonnay Carneros 2022
bodyHtml:
This classic Carneros Chardonnay was grown primarily on the Schug Estate vineyard with additional barrels from the Wildcat Vineyard and Thornton Ranch. It was fermented and aged on the lees (sur-lie) in small French oak barrels, with judicious new oak introduced. Malolactic fermentation was not induced, allowing the wine to retain its natural acidity and varietal focus.

The result is a rich and powerful wine, while refreshing and elegant on the finish. It has a ripe, spicy tropical bouquet with flavours that suggest citrus, pear, and spiced apples. Well-balanced acidity gives it a crisp, clean finish, making it an excellent wine with food. Try it with cream soups, rich seafood, fowl, veal, and pasta dishes.

title: Schug Pinot Noir Carneros 2022
bodyHtml: This classic Carneros region Pinot Noir offers a wide range of flavours and aromas, in the tradition of the finest red Burgundies of France. “Clonal diversity” is achieved by carefully blending several vineyard lots, each retaining its own unique clonal signature in the blend. The result is a complex wine with a rich bouquet of cherries, berries and hints of spicy new oak. It has flavours reminiscent of black cherry, currant and strawberry, followed by a rich, spicy texture and a long silky finish. This wine pairs nicely with lamb, duck, even grilled fish.

title: Treana Red Blend 2022 (Austin Hope Winery)
bodyHtml:
Experience the richness and complexity of the Treana Red Blend, a true masterpiece from the esteemed Hope Family. This wine is a perfect example of the family's passion and dedication to producing premium wines that are full of character and finesse.

The Treana Red Blend is a masterful blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah, with each grape varietal contributing to the wine's exceptional depth and complexity. Upon opening the bottle, the aromas of cassis, clove, and vanilla bean tantalize the senses, setting the stage for an unforgettable experience.

title: Fess Parker Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml: Ripe banana, coconut, mango and guava aromas make for a showy entry in this bottling, but citrusy freshness keeps it in check. The palate show a clean line of lemony acidity that sears into the finish, cutting through hints of more tropical fruit.

title: Ridge Vineyards Estate Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml: Golden straw colour, notes of citrus, vanilla and apple on the nose. Medium to full-bodied on the palate with pear fruit, good minerality, a hint of honey, and a long clean finish.

title: Sterling Vintner's Collection Merlot 2022
bodyHtml: The Sterling Vintner's Collection Merlot boasts vivid aromas of fresh mixed berry jam, red cherry, milk chocolate and baked spice. The wine is round and with good weight and generous flavours of blackberry bramble, sweet toasted oak and mocha. The wine is full-bodied with great concentration, silky tannins and a lengthy finish. Another example of the excellent recent wines in Sterling's Vintner's Collection.

title: Sterling Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Central Coast region of California. Founded in 1964 by Peter Newton, Sterling Vineyards is a landmark of Napa Valley known for its iconic Mediterranean style architecture and pioneering role in establishing the area as a world class wine destination. The winery's philosophy focuses on producing polished, fruit forward wines that capture the diverse characteristics of California's most prestigious coastal vineyards.

Wine Description

Sterling Chardonnay Vintner's Collection 2022 displays a medium to deep yellow straw colour in the glass. The nose is aromatic and layered, offering scents of Gala apple, Bartlett pear, and hints of pineapple accented by toasty vanilla and pie spices. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and luscious, featuring a round, creamy texture balanced by a refreshing citrus lift. It is characterized by its rich complexity and a smooth finish that replays notes of honey and toasted oak. This 100% Chardonnay has an ABV of 13.5% and was aged in a combination of French and American oak to enhance its 'buttery' mouthfeel. While the estate adheres to high quality standards, this specific bottling is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through 2027.

title: Sterling Cabernet Sauvignon Vintner's Collection 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This bold and approachable red wine hails from the United States, specifically from the Central Coast and broader California appellations. Sterling Vineyards was founded in 1964 by Peter Newton, a British expatriate who established the winery near Calistoga in Napa Valley and famously modelled its architecture after the white-stucco villages of Mykonos. Now owned by Treasury Wine Estates, the winery maintains a philosophy of crafting distinctive, hand-crafted wines meant for everyday enjoyment. The Vintner's Collection is designed as a high-value tier, utilizing premium grapes from diverse vineyards to deliver a signature style that is both elegant and full of depth.

Wine Description

The Sterling Vintner's Collection Cabernet Sauvignon showcases a deep ruby appearance. The nose is captivating and intense, parading aromas of blackberry, cassis, and dark cherry accented by rich notes of caramel, mocha, and toasted oak spice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and velvety, offering a balanced expression of plum, blackberry pie, and toffee, with integrated hints of vanilla and cocoa.

title: Rodney Strong Symmetry Red Meritage 2021
bodyHtml:
The Rodney Strong Symmetry Red Meritage hails from the Alexander Valley within Sonoma County, United States. Founded in 1959 by wine pioneer Rodney Strong, the winery was the 13th bonded facility in the county and is now helmed by the Klein family, who have prioritized sustainable farming and estate quality since 1989. The vineyard's philosophy focuses on capturing the essence of diverse Sonoma terroirs through innovative, small lot winemaking in their state of the art Artisan Cellar.

Wine Description

This deeply hued red blend offers an opulent sensory profile with intense aromas of black cherry, plum, and rose petals, underscored by complex notes of Tahitian vanilla and sweet tobacco. On the palate, it is harmonious and elegant, featuring silky layers of black fruits, baking spices, and a touch of minerality that leads to a vibrant, lingering finish.

Food Pairing

This wine is a superb companion for rich, marbled meats such as braised lamb shanks, grilled ribeye, or slow cooked beef stew. It also pairs elegantly with roasted root vegetables or a savory grilled pork tenderloin.

title: Ravenswood Old Vine Zinfandel Lodi 2022
bodyHtml: Pleasant and subtle with dried fruits and hints of hazelnut. Full-bodied with good fruit and fine tannins as well as a fresh finish. Pretty and refined for a perfectly priced Zinfandel.

title: J Lohr Merlot Los Osos 2022
bodyHtml: J. Lohr Estates Los Osos Merlot is medium-dark in colour with a ruby hue. Varietal aromas of black plum, black currant, and violet are elevated by a light barrel signature of baking spices and toasted pastry. 14% Malbec in the blend contributes aromatic notes of pomegranate and hibiscus flower while bringing juiciness to the palate. This versatile wine pairs well with grilled sausage and veggie shish kabobs or creamy spinach and tomato tortellini.

title: Rodney Strong Pinot Noir Russian River Valley 2020
bodyHtml: Russian River Valley is among the world's finest areas outside of Burgundy for growing Pinot Noir. This wine is intense, with lifted black cherry, toast, vanilla and nutty flavours. Pair with thick grilled pork chops, rotisserie chicken or grilled tuna steaks.

title: Rodney Strong Sauvignon Blanc Charlotte's Home 2023
bodyHtml: Fresh, bright and crisp, this Sauvignon Blanc is a wine of balance, richness and aromatic complexity.
