Leading with zesty citrus notes of grapefruit, Meyer lemon and a light grassiness, this wine gives way to more tropical fruit and melon characteristics. This classic Sonoma County style Sauvignon Blanc ends with clean, refreshing acidity and pairs beautifully with toasted brie, seared scallops, oysters with mignonette and fresh pasta with sweet peas and a lemon cream sauce.

title: Coppola Diamond Collection Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
"When we began to develop the idea for this winery, we wanted it to be a wonderland...a place to celebrate the love of life." FRANCIS FORD COPPOLA
 
This Chardonnay shows buttered popcorn, pear, orange, melon, apple, pineapple and grilled mango framed by well-integrated, balanced oak spices. Vibrant, fresh and toasty. A winner with barbecued chicken or Cornish hen.

title: Coppola Merlot 2020
bodyHtml:
"When we began to develop the idea for this winery, we wanted it to be a wonderland...a place to celebrate the love of life." FRANCIS FORD COPPOLA

This Merlot combines fruit from Napa, Sonoma and Monterey. The flavours and textures unique to each region harmonize perfectly to create a wine that has dark succulent fruit balanced by natural acidity. Intense aromatics of raspberry and blueberry lead to flavours of crushed berries, vanilla and leather, which are wrapped up in a soft, smooth tannin structure.

title: Bonterra Zinfandel 2021
bodyHtml: This full-bodied, bold wine is packed with ripe blackberry, dried plum and boysenberry flavours that ride a smooth, slightly tannic texture. It's jammy and exuberant.

title: Coppola Diamond Collection Claret 2022
bodyHtml:
Coppola Diamond Collection Claret originates from the United States, specifically from various vineyard sites across the California region. The winery was established in 2006 when filmmaker Francis Ford Coppola purchased the historic Château Souverain property in Sonoma County. Inspired by his Italian heritage and a desire to create a 'wine wonderland', Coppola focuses on producing high quality wines that celebrate the love of life, food, and family. The Claret serves as the flagship or 'crown jewel' of the Diamond Collection, with a distinctive gold netting on the bottle that pays tribute to European traditions of signifying outstanding quality.

Wine Description

This red blend presents a dark ruby or deep crimson colour with purple reflections. The sensory profile is rich and aromatic, offering a fragrant nose of blueberry, black cherry, and cassis, complemented by notes of clove, vanilla, and toasted oak. On the full bodied palate, it is luscious and sophisticated, delivering flavours of blackberry, plum, and black pepper alongside layers of cocoa and baking spices. The structure is defined by firm yet velvety tannins and a supple texture, leading to a long, satisfying finish with hints of anise and spice.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically a Cabernet Sauvignon based blend, often including Merlot, Petit Verdot, Malbec, and Cabernet Franc.

  • Stylistic Notes: Portions of the wine are aged for up to 12 months in a combination of French and American oak to enhance complexity and character.

  • Organic Status: While the winery emphasizes sustainable practices and earth friendly production, this specific wine is not typically certified organic.

Food Pairing

The bold character and balanced acidity of this Claret make it an ideal companion for hearty and savoury dishes. Suggested pairings include grilled ribeye steak, rack of lamb, and porcini mushroom risotto. It also complements spicy BBQ ribs, grilled hamburgers, and pasta served with rich red sauces. For a cheese course, it pairs well with strong, aged varieties such as sharp cheddar or gouda.

title: Rutherford Hill Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: Rutherford Hill Cabernet Sauvignon is an outstanding example of the bold personality and unbridled flavour characteristics of a Napa Valley Cabernet.

title: Emmolo Sauvignon Blanc 2022 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and refined white wine originates from the United States, specifically from the North Coast AVA of California, with fruit sourced from both the Suisun Valley and Napa Valley. Emmolo is a label within the Wagner Family of Wines, the producers behind Caymus Vineyards, and is owned and operated by winemaker Jenny Wagner. Named after her maternal family who established a rootstock nursery in Napa in 1923, the winery's philosophy is guided by the idea that 'less is more', focusing on creating non-herbaceous, minerality-driven wines through precise vineyard management.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc presents a fresh and clean appearance with a palate that is dry and juicy. The sensory profile features an expressive nose of white peach, citrus notes, and wet stone, complemented by aromas of Meyer lemon, yuzu, and lemon blossoms. On the palate, the wine is light to medium-bodied, showcasing additional echoes of peach, tangerine, and a 'crunchy' apple texture. It is characterized by a mouthwatering finish with hints of grated ginger and a subtle saline minerality. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc reached an alcohol content of 12.8%. While the winery employs sustainable farming techniques to manage canopy sunlight and eliminate herbaceous character, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Emmolo Merlot 2021 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
This rich and 'expansive' red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Oak Knoll district of the Napa Valley in California. Emmolo is part of the Wagner Family of Wine, with current owner and winemaker Jenny Wagner leading the estate on land her family has farmed for generations. Named after her maternal family, who founded a leading grapevine nursery in Napa in 1923, the winery's philosophy focuses on achieving the 'full potential' of the varietal through extended hang time and meticulous crop thinning.

Wine Description

The Emmolo Merlot presents a deep, dark colour and a lush sensory profile. The nose features intense aromas of black cherry, ripe cassis, and crushed blackberry, layered with complex notes of mocha, espresso, and subtle leather. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and 'plush', showcasing flavours of dark berry compote, figs, and cocoa powder underpinned by a fresh earthiness. It is characterized by its velvety, leathery tannins and a dense, layered texture derived from aging in French oak. The finish is long and smooth, trailing off with savory impressions of vanilla, sandalwood, and a hint of smoky spice. This 100% Merlot is notably concentrated, with recent vintages reaching an ABV between 15.1% and 15.2%. While the estate utilizes sustainable viticulture on its gravelly Napa soils, this bottling is not certified organic.

title: Stags' Leap Winery Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml: Distinct aromas of lemon zest, tart white peach and crisp pear show generously in this refreshing and focused cool climate Chardonnay. On the palate, vibrant citrus fruit flavours are balanced by a wet stone core and pleasant undertones of light smoke. Driven by wonderful fruit intensity, lasting lemon minerality and bright acidity, the Stags' Leap Winery Chardonnay walks the ideal line between delicacy and weight.

title: Mark West Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml:
Medium-bodied with black cherry, cola, strawberry, plum, and soft tannins. No wonder this Pinot is a favorite. 

Pair with pastas with light tomato-based sauces, a juicy cheeseburger, grilled salmon, roasted pork tenderloin, or if you're not a cook, drink it on its own.

title: Edmeades Zinfandel 2022
bodyHtml:
The Mendocino County Zinfandel begins with concentrated aromas of baking spices including; cinnamon and cloves. Those spices give way to aromas of blackberries, black currants, and dried sage. The texture is round, and the fruit expression is focused and lush. Subtle and integrated tannins accentuate the richness of the wine, while pleasant acidity keeps it fresh on the finish.

Pair with char-broiled burgers, barbeque chicken or eggplant parmesan.

title: Justin Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Justin Cabernet Sauvignon is a widely acclaimed red wine from the Paso Robles subregion of the Central Coast in California, United States. Founded in 1981 by Justin Baldwin, the winery was a pioneer in the region, established with the goal of creating world-class Bordeaux style blends in a then-unproven territory. The winemaking philosophy emphasizes the unique limestone rich soils and dramatic diurnal temperature shifts of the estate, utilizing hand harvesting and small barrel aging to ensure high quality and varietal expression.

Wine Description

This wine typically displays a bright ruby red colour with moderate concentration. The nose is expressive and aromatic, offering notes of ripe red raspberry and black cherry layered with vanilla, toasted oak, and hints of dried herbs like oregano. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and dry, featuring a supple texture with flavours of juicy red plum, blackcurrant, and spicy nuances of cinnamon and cocoa. It is characterized by its balanced structure, well integrated tannins, and a clean, savoury finish with a touch of cedar. The varietal composition is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, and it typically features an ABV of 14.5%. While not certified organic, the estate employs sustainable farming practices. The optimal drinking window is generally within 1 to 5 years of the vintage to capture its vibrant fruit character.

title: Justin Isosceles 2019
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Justin Vineyards & Winery was founded in 1981 by Justin Baldwin, who left a career in international banking to pursue his dream of crafting premium wines that rivalled the great Bordeaux châteaux. The winery's philosophy marries traditional Old World techniques, such as hand-harvesting and small-barrel ageing in French oak, with New World technology.

Wine Description

Bright with a dark purple/black core and a lighter ruby purple rim showing slowforming, moderately stained tears on the glass. Attractively aromatic and complex with ripe black and red cherry, black currant, new book leather, cedar, tobacco, vanilla bean, licorice, and oak. 

Full-bodied on the palate with ripe complex cherry, cassis, and a subtle red berry fruit on entry, with vanilla and licorice baking spice leading into the midpalate, which shows complex savory notes of cedar, tobacco leaf, and leather. The very long, complex, and continually changing finish is a progression of sustained ripe cherry fruit accented by baking spice and oak notes, with smooth chewy tannins and balanced acidity, adding depth and freshness.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and rich, ripe black fruit profile of the Isosceles make it an excellent partner for deeply flavoured dishes. Suggested pairings include roasted black plum aromas meet with tobacco leaf on the nose or slow-cooked beef short rib braise, filet mignon, or venison steak. The wine also pairs beautifully with rich, robust dishes such as a seared New York strip steak alongside sautéed wild mushrooms.

title: Mer Soleil Chardonnay Reserve 2023 (By Caymus)
bodyHtml:
This rich and 'dramatic' white wine originates from the United States, specifically from the Santa Lucia Highlands subregion of Monterey County in California. Founded in 1988 by Chuck Wagner of Caymus Vineyards, Mer Soleil was one of the pioneering estates in a region previously dedicated to cattle grazing and row crops. Since 2001, the winery has been led by Chuck's son, winemaker Charlie Wagner, whose philosophy focuses on utilizing the area's extreme coastal conditions, intense sunlight and cooling Pacific breezes, to foster a longer growing season and greater varietal complexity.

Wine Description

The Mer Soleil Chardonnay Reserve presents a clear and golden yellow colour. The sensory profile is highly expressive, featuring a nose of Meyer lemon curd, honeysuckle, and lemon blossoms infused with the warmth of vanilla and a hint of sea breeze. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, round, and 'lush', showcasing flavours of ripe peach, lemon meringue pie, Anjou pear, and tropical notes of mango and pineapple. It is characterized by a creamy, silky texture and integrated medium acidity that balances its rich mouthfeel. The finish is dry and refreshing, with lingering impressions of toasted almonds, custard, and a subtle touch of oak. This 100% Chardonnay reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and was matured for 12 to 15 months in French oak barrels to achieve its signature unctuosity. While the Wagner family emphasizes sustainable vineyard practices, this wine is not officially certified organic.

title: Cline Zinfandel Old Vine 2021
bodyHtml: Cline Old Vine Lodi Zinfandel is a challenging and rewarding wine to make. Amazing old vine fruit, detailed selection criteria and master blending show in the final wine. A wide array of jammy strawberry and plum aromas followed by black cherry, strawberry and vanilla flavours lead to a smooth and lengthy finish.

title: Cline Viognier 2022
bodyHtml: Fruity, spicy aromas and flavours of peach cobbler and creme Anglaise with a silky, bright, fruity medium body and a smooth, stimulating, medium-long spiced yellow apple, nougat and nectarine skin finish with fine, fruit tannins and a suggestion of oak. A very tasty, round and satisfying Viognier pleaser.

title: Kendall Jackson Cabernet Sauvignon Grand Reserve 2021
bodyHtml: This Cabernet has distinct flavours of blackberry, blueberry, plus both red and black currants with enticing fragrances of mocha and nutmeg. Subtle notes of chocolate and toasty vanilla add to the richness and length of this bold Cab, and are accompanied by fine grained tannins on a lengthy finish.

title: Stags' Leap Winery Petite Sirah 2018
bodyHtml: This wine exemplifies Stags' Leap Winery's dedication to producing wines that are both approachable upon release and capable of aging gracefully over time.

title: Bogle Petite Sirah 2022
bodyHtml:
Concentrated and lush, this opaque and inky wine starts with touches of cacao and roasted coffee bean on the nose. The decadent aromatics are followed by dark and jammy flavors of boysenberry, blackberry and blueberries, picked ripe off the vine.

Silky and luxurious in texture, the wine embraces your senses with a cozy familiarity. And the finish, ample and complex after aging in American oak for 12 months, is full of spicy vanilla and sweet clove lingering long after the last sip.

This versatile wine pairs well with a variety of foods like smoked lamb shoulder with rosemary, braised short ribs with blackberry barbecue sauce and smoked gouda cheese.

title: Bogle Merlot 2021
bodyHtml: Gorgeous in the glass with rich hues of garnet, the first impressions entice with aromas of sandalwood, vanilla and black cherry. The mouthwatering entry is full of red plums and cherries, while the middle palate of the wine softens with touches of cola and a smooth and silky mouthfeel. Notes of baking spices and mocha are left behind by the 12 months in American oak, leading to a lingering, luxe finish.

title: Bogle Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the diverse vineyards of California, the Bogle Cabernet Sauvignon is a testament to over six generations of farming heritage in the Sacramento River Delta. The Bogle family, who planted their first wine grapes in 1968 near Clarksburg, maintains a deep-rooted philosophy of being involved in every detail of the winemaking process.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep ruby colour, offering a sensory profile rich with aromas of black cherry, cassis, and earthy undertones. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and lush, featuring layers of black plums and currants complemented by nuances of cherry compote, dark chocolate, and leather.

title: Ridge Vineyards Geyserville 2023
bodyHtml: Ripe cranberry and cassis on the nose. Focused dark bramble fruit on the palate, layered with cocoa and clove. Vibrant acidity balances beautifully with opulent fruit and carries through to a long and elegant finish.

title: J Lohr Syrah 2023
bodyHtml:
The J. Lohr South Ridge Syrah is a celebrated red wine from the Paso Robles region in California, United States. Founded in 1974 by Jerry Lohr, this family owned and operated winery has spent over five decades focusing on a sustainable, 'stewardship of the land' philosophy. Today, the second generation of the Lohr family continues this legacy, managing thousands of acres of estate vineyards across the Central Coast to produce wines known for their consistency and quality.

Wine Description

In the glass, the wine presents a deep, dense colour with vibrant purple hues. The sensory profile is led by varietal aromas of black cherry, blueberry, and anise, which are lifted by notes of black tea and a hint of floral lilac. On the palate, the wine is bold yet smooth, featuring flavours of blackberry, chocolate, and toasted oak. It displays a lean structure with a touch of white pepper and baking spice on the finish.

title: St Francis Merlot 2023
bodyHtml: The grapes come from estate vineyards in the Sonoma and Russian River valleys, as well as from growers in Sonoma County and other top appellations, including Alexander Valley and Rockpile. All grapes are hand harvested, gently destemmed and crushed before cold soaking to extract optimal colour and flavour. The wine is matured in oak barrels. This Merlot is smooth and elegant with classic flavours and aromas of cherry, chocolate and plum. Its silky structure is balanced by soft tannins and a bold, lengthy finish.

title: Chateau St Jean Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml: This enticing Chardonnay opens with bold aromas of ripe tropical fruit, accented by flavours of crème brûlée, spiced apple and lemon meringue on the palate. It is full-bodied and buttery with a beautiful, creamy sweetness balanced by natural acidity and oak integration delivering a long, toasty vanilla finish.

title: Michael David Petite Petit 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Michael David Winery Petite Petit is a bold red blend from the United States, produced in the California region and the Lodi appellation. The wine is made by Michael David Winery, where the Phillips family has been farming the Lodi soil since the 1860s and cultivating wine grapes since the early 20th century. Founders and brothers Michael and David Phillips are fifth-generation grape growers, and their philosophy emphasizes family legacy, quality wines, and sustainable farming practices certified by the Lodi Rules Program. The wine's label features two imposing elephants, symbolizing the 'larger-than-life' and substantial nature of the wine.

Wine Description

The wine is a blend of Petite Sirah and Petit Verdot. For example, the 2022 vintage is 87% Petite Sirah and 13% Petit Verdot, The aromatic profile includes show stopping aromas of rich plum, boysenberry jam, and black cherry. Other notes include blackberry jam, black licorice, blueberry, cocoa, vanilla spice, and subtle hints of honey. It is a dense, full-bodied, and substantial wine. The palate showcases rich, velvety flavours of blackberry compote, cacao nibs, and vanilla spice. It is loaded with pure black fruit and vanilla flavours that coat the palate, offering remarkable richness. Stylistically, it is a dark, robust, and deeply satisfying wine. The wine is aged in a mix of French and American oak. The finish is long and smooth, revealing a slightly dry texture that seems to linger. The ABV is typically 15% or sometimes 14.5%. The optimal drinking window is often suggested for enjoyment a few years after bottling, such as best from 2028 for the 2020 vintage. The wine is certified sustainable under the Lodi Rules Program.

title: Bogle Zinfandel Old Vine 2022
bodyHtml:
Bogle Old Vine Zinfandel originates from the United States, within the California region and the Clarksburg subregion. The Bogle family wine pedigree began in the late 1960s when the family first planted twenty acres of wine grapes on their home ranch in Clarksburg, leading to the creation of their first official bottle under the Bogle name in 1978. The winery's current operational philosophy centers on crafting affordable, reliable, and expressive wines through generational commitment, drawing high quality fruit from historical vineyards where dry farmed, head trained vines have stood for decades.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a medium to deep ruby and purple red appearance in the glass and possesses a full bodied structure with a plush, velvety, and mouth filling texture. The sensory profile is highly expressive, warm, and intensely fragrant, opening with a bold nose of black currants, juniper berry, and raspberry jam, seamlessly integrated with notes of new leather, black pepper, and spicy nutmeg. On the rich, supple, and rounded palate, it delivers deep flavours of cranberries, ripe fruits, and spiced chocolate, balanced by a bright, energetic natural acidity and a firm peppery backbone. The finish is remarkably long, smooth, and toasty, leaving a persistent impression of berry jam, savory herbs, pipe tobacco, and sweet American oak.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically a classic California blend consisting of 91% Zinfandel, 7% Primitivo, 1% Petite Sirah, and 1% Merlot depending on the vintage.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its approachable, crowd pleasing fruit concentration and balanced oak complexity. To develop its signature velvety mouthfeel, the winemakers age the juice for 12 months in two year old American oak barrels, which lends a delicate sweetness and structural depth without overshadowing the fruit.

  • ABV: 14.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate is family operated under a verified commitment to eco-responsible farming as a certified sustainable vineyard, this commercial release is not certified organic.

title: Wente Cabernet Sauvignon Charles Wetmore Vineyard 2022
bodyHtml:
This deep and structured red wine originates from the United States, within the Livermore Valley region of California. Wente Vineyards is a historic family-owned winery whose portfolio reflects the legacy of pioneering viticulture in the region. Named after one of the valley's most prominent pioneers, Charles Wetmore, who famously planted vine cuttings from top Bordeaux Châteaux in the 1880s, the wine highlights a historical lineage of exceptional viticulture. The winery operates under a philosophy of sustainable land stewardship, cultivating descendants of these original French vines across well-drained estate parcels.

Wine Description

The 2022 Wente Charles Wetmore Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon opens with an aromatic sensory profile of black currant and cassis, beautifully complemented by a unique hint of 'Livermore Dust'. Creamy oak influences introduce inviting layers of roasted cocoa nibs and hardwood complexity. On the palate, the wine delivers full-bodied layers of ripe black cherry and plum. While initially supple, it transitions smoothly into a deep, rich profile balanced by a firm tannin structure and velvety acidity that ensures excellent aging potential. The finish is remarkably long and satisfying.

This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon was fermented in stainless steel tanks with pump-overs performed at least twice daily to maximize flavor extraction. It reached an alcohol content (ABV) of 14.5% and was aged for 18 months in a barrel program consisting of 40% new French oak and 60% second and third-use French oak barrels. Rooted in the gravelly loam soils between the Arroyo del Valle and Arroyo Mocho streams, the vineyard blocks are certified sustainable.

title: Wente Chardonnay Riva Ranch 2024
bodyHtml:
Wente Vineyards is recognized as the oldest continuously operated, family-owned winery in the U.S.. The family has been cultivating their Arroyo Seco vineyards since the early 1960s, pioneering winegrowing in the district, which is now one of California's premier terroirs for Chardonnay. The winery is committed to sustainable winegrowing and is certified sustainable in both vineyard and winery operations, reflecting a philosophy of environmental stewardship and social responsibility.

Wine Description

The sensory profile is rich and complex, opening with aromatics of toasty oak, baked apple, and freshly cut pineapple. The palate echoes these notes, featuring ripe apples, caramelized pineapple, melted caramel, and toasted brioche. Stylistic notes include a subtle hint of creamy oak, suggesting notes of crème brûlée, along with a dollop of buttery richness that extends into a long, lengthy finish.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings that complement this rich and complex Chardonnay include aged white cheddar and sourdough baguette, lobster tails with clarified butter, smoked chicken quesadillas, and mushroom risotto.

title: Cline Zinfandel Ancient Vines 2022
bodyHtml:
Cline Family Cellars is a family-owned and operated winery founded by Fred and Nancy Cline in 1982 in Oakley, CA. The winery facilities were relocated in 1991 to the Sonoma Valley, on a 350-acre estate in the Carneros district. The Cline winery and vineyards are built on a foundation of deeply rooted respect for the land and love of winemaking. Recognized for its rich portfolio of wines, Cline is one of the pioneers of California’s Rhone Rangers movement, and the largest holder of 100+ year-old-vine vineyards in California.

The Ancient Vines Zinfandel shows the sumptuous big strawberry character that California Zinfandel is known for. Smooth, well-balanced tannins and fresh acidity, with a touch of vanilla and light toast flavour, make for a very special glass of wine.

title: Beringer Chardonnay Private Reserve 2024
bodyHtml:
Beringer Private Reserve Chardonnay originates from the United States, within California’s world-renowned Napa Valley AVA. First crafted in 1977 by legendary winemaker Myron Nightingale, this bottling was created to demonstrate that Napa Valley could produce a world-class, age-worthy Chardonnay capable of standing alongside the finest White Burgundies. The fruit is sourced primarily from prime, cool-climate vineyard sites in the Gamble Ranch in Yountville and select plots in Carneros. Operating with a commitment to parcel-by-parcel selection, Beringer’s philosophy for the Private Reserve Chardonnay focuses on barrel fermentation, lees stirring, and full malolactic conversion to create a benchmark expression of classic, decadent Napa Valley Chardonnay.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a brilliant, deep golden-yellow appearance in the glass with bright yellow-green highlights. It possesses a full-bodied, rich, and voluptuous structure defined by a creamy, mouth-coating, and supple texture. The sensory profile is opulent, fragrant, and layered, opening with a bold bouquet of ripe yellow peaches, baked red apples, Meyer lemon curd, and tropical pineapple, interwoven with rich secondary notes of toasted brioche, melted butter, vanilla bean, roasted hazelnuts, and warm baking spices. On the broad palate, it delivers a dense core of stone fruit and citrus oil, balanced by a fine thread of natural acidity that keeps the wine vibrant and fresh despite its weight. The finish is remarkably long, warm, and luxurious, leaving lingering echoes of toasted oak, crème brûlée, and sweet spice.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes are hand-harvested at night to preserve freshness, gently whole-cluster pressed, and transferred directly to French oak barrels for fermentation using selected yeast strains. The wine undergoes 100% malolactic fermentation along with regular bâtonnage (lees stirring) over 8 to 10 months of barrel aging in approximately 75% to 80% new French oak, enhancing its rich texture and complex spice profile.

  • ABV: 14.5% to 14.8%.

title: Robert Mondavi Cabernet Sauvignon Private Selection 2024 (by Robert Mondavi)
bodyHtml: Robert Mondavi's Private Selection Cabernet Sauvignon is crafted with fruit from California’s cool-climate Central Coast vineyards, where slow ripening encourages complexity and depth of flavor. Blended with a touch of Syrah, Carignan, Malbec, Petite Sirah and Petit Verdot, this wine shows decadent aromas of black cherry, blackberry, vanilla, toasty oak and coffee. Ripe and elegant, with soft red and black fruit flavors and gentle tannins, this wine was aged in a combination of American and French oak.

title: Hess Select Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml: Lemon-lime and a touch of apple flavours, tantalizing tropical notes and crisp acidity with just a bit of toasty oak keep this Chardonnay in balance.

title: Cambria Pinot Noir Julia's Vineyard 2021
bodyHtml: Bright red fruit dominates the nose along with pomegranate, dried cranberries, and black cherry. Spice notes of cinnamon, sage and clove complement the balanced tannins that add structure and a long finish to the wine. Made with 100% Pinot Noir.

title: Kendall Jackson Cabernet Sauvignon Vintner's Reserve 2023
bodyHtml: Aromas of lush, bright black cherry, blackberry and cassis draw you in. Round, rich seamless tannins provide a robust backbone and supple mid-palate. Notes of cedar, vanilla and a hint of mocha linger on the finish.

title: Kendall Jackson Sauvignon Blanc Vintner's Reserve 2024
bodyHtml: Luscious honeysuckle, ripe pear and fresh lemongrass intertwine in this medium-bodied Vintner's Sauvignon Blanc. Hints of fresh tropical grapefruit complement the subtle mineral quality while added layers of fig and honeysuckle round out this crisp, aromatic wine.

title: Kendall Jackson Chardonnay Vintner's Reserve 2023
bodyHtml:
Kendall-Jackson was established in 1982 by Jess Jackson and his family, debuting with the release of the 'Vintner's Reserve' Chardonnay. The Jackson family's winemaking philosophy, which founder Jess Jackson called 'Flavor Domaine', involves planting individual grape varieties to suit their ideal terroir to promote the best attributes of each grape. Kendall-Jackson is renowned as a family-owned and run business that remains committed to quality, stewardship of the land, and sustainable practices.

Wine Description

The 'Vintner's Reserve' presents a pale straw yellow colour with hints of gold and a bright, clear finish. The bouquet is complex, opening with aromas of tropical fruit like pineapple, mango, and papaya, alongside notes of citrus and green apple. These fruit flavours are beautifully complemented by vanilla, honey, a hint of toasted oak, and butter, owing to its aging in French and American oak barrels. On the palate, this medium to full-bodied wine is fruit-forward, featuring vibrant flavours of ripe pear, pineapple, and mango, balanced by a creamy texture and moderate acidity. 

Food Pairing

Recommended pairings include roasted chicken, creamy pastas, mushroom risotto, or richer shellfish dishes like lobster and crab with drawn butter. For a lighter option, pair it with poultry, seafood, or even fish tacos.

title: La Crema Pinot Noir Sonoma 2023
bodyHtml: This elegant and expressive red wine originates from the United States, specifically within the California region and the cool-climate Sonoma Coast subregion. Established in 1979, La Crema has become a benchmark for cool-climate viticulture, focusing on regions where ocean winds and fog allow for an extended growing season. The winery's philosophy centres on terroir-driven winemaking, utilizing boutique-style techniques such as hand-harvesting and gentle extraction to produce wines that exemplify balance, purity, and finesse.

title: Sebastiani Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Sebastiani Vineyards & Winery, a cornerstone of Sonoma winemaking tradition, was established in 1904 by Italian immigrant and stonemason Samuele Sebastiani. The winery has been credited with producing some of the first varietally labelled Cabernet Sauvignon in Sonoma County and holds a historic landmark status on its Mission Vineyard. After flourishing through multiple generations of the Sebastiani family, the winery was purchased by Bill Foley in 2008 and today crafts approachable, full-bodied wines that reflect the diverse terroir of Sonoma’s appellations, including Sonoma Valley, Carneros, and the Russian River Valley.

Wine Description

 Sebastiani's Sonoma Chardonnay is a full-bodied and aromatic expression of the varietal. It typically exhibits a pale straw colour with shimmering golden hues. The wine opens with an inviting sensory profile of baked apple, Asian pear, and pineapple, complemented by creamy notes of vanilla and hints of brioche. On the palate, expect layers of rich butterscotch and baking spice flavours, along with citrus and tropical fruits. The texture is round, smooth, and creamy, with a balanced finish that may show lingering notes of vanilla and oak.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for this chardonnay include creamy pastas, grilled seafood, herb-roasted chicken, or meaty fish.

title: Sonoma Cutrer Chardonnay Russian River 2023
bodyHtml:
Sonoma-Cutrer Chardonnay Russian River originates from the United States, within the California region and the Sonoma County subregion, incorporating prestigious fruit from the cool-climate Russian River Valley. Founded in 1981, the winery has established itself as a benchmark producer with an exclusive focus on crafting world-class Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. Their winemaking philosophy centers on marrying traditional Burgundian methods with northern California precision, relying on cooling maritime breezes and morning fog to preserve the natural structure of the grapes.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a beautiful pale straw appearance with a slight greenish hue and possesses a medium-to-full body with a creamy, mouth-coating texture. The sensory profile is elegant and fruit-forward, opening with an aromatic nose of lime zest, Meyer lemon, green apple, and Bosc pear, accented by delicate notes of white flowers, toasted almonds, and white pepper. On the crisp and juicy palate, it delivers vibrant citrus brightness mixed with flavours of pineapple, lemon curd, and a touch of green melon. The finish is remarkably long, balanced, and velvety, leaving subtle trails of barrel spice, mineral tension, and light vanilla toast.

title: Murphy Goode Sauvignon Blanc
bodyHtml:
Founded by friendship in 1985, Murphy-Goode is a serious winery built around a common concept: don’t take life so seriously. 

Tim Murphy, Dale Goode, and Dave Ready began their winemaking adventure by pooling their collective talents together. Both Tim Murphy and Dale Goode were the growers of the team. They helped to pioneer Alexander Valley by bringing wire trellising, broad scale drip irrigation, and leaf pulling to the area. Tim Murphy is also considered the father of Sonoma Sauvignon Blanc. Dave Ready was the marketer of the trio, bringing a fun personality to the winery, which it is still known for today.

Over 30 years later, Murphy-Goode still puts that same passion of its founders into every vintage. Murphy-Goode is led today by winemaker Dave Ready, Jr., the son of one of the winery’s founders.

title: Ravenswood Zinfandel Vintners Blend 2022
bodyHtml: Aromas of wild blackberry and spice lead to a silky palate marked by notes of black plum, raspberry, strawberry and cherry. Hints of chocolate and subtle black pepper and depth and nuance.

title: Lake Sonoma Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This elegant white wine hails from the United States, specifically from the prestigious Russian River Valley within Sonoma County. Lake Sonoma Winery is part of a storied winemaking tradition in the region, where the philosophy focuses on showcasing the unique terroir of Sonoma's most celebrated subregions. The winery emphasizes high quality fruit sourcing and precise winemaking to create wines that reflect the character and history of the land.

Wine Description

Lake Sonoma Chardonnay presents a bright and fresh sensory profile, opening with vibrant aromas of ripe pear, golden apple, and citrus zest. On the palate, the wine is powerful yet graceful, featuring flavors of stone fruit and pineapple framed by subtle notes of vanilla, warm spice, and a hint of flinty minerality. This medium bodied Chardonnay is characterized by its smooth, silky texture and a balanced acidity that ensures a clean, lingering finish.

title: Ferrari Carano Fume Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Family owned and operated since 1985, Ferrari-Carano has been a leading producer of world class, nationally acclaimed wines. Don and Rhonda Carano's success is based on their commitment to quality as well as the dedication of the vineyard and winemaking teams to make the finest wines, vintage after vintage.

This wine has delicious aromas and flavours of pineapple, pink grapefruit, lemongrass, lychee, peach, pear, honeydew melon, orange blossom, guava and a touch of minerality. This Fumé Blanc has bright acidity and crisp freshness from the cool, stainless steel tank fermentation, while the subtle oak character from neutral French oak barrels adds body, complexity and depth.  Fumé Blanc pairs well with seafood and poultry dishes, and also holds up nicely with veal and pork. This wine has lively flavours that go well with spicy and ethnic cuisines as well.

title: Beringer Cabernet Sauvignon Knights Valley 2022
bodyHtml:
Beringer Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon originates from California, within the Sonoma County region and the designated Knights Valley AVA. Recognized as one of California's most historic wine estates, Beringer Vineyards began farming in Knights Valley in the mid-1960s after recognizing the ideal volcanic, gravelly alluvial soils of the area. Beringer was instrumental in establishing Knights Valley as an official AVA in 1983. The estate's philosophy behind this bottling focuses on crafting an approachable, Bordeaux-style Cabernet blend that highlights the rugged, warm microclimate of northern Sonoma while maintaining balance, structure, and intense fruit concentration.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep garnet and inky dark purple hue in the glass. It exhibits a full-bodied, opulent, and supple structure supported by a smooth, velvety texture. The sensory profile is highly expressive and layered, opening with a bold bouquet of ripe boysenberry, black currant (cassis), and dark cherry, accented by nuanced aromas of wild sage, dried herbs, mocha, roasted coffee, and subtle baking spices. On the palate, it delivers rich flavors of dark stone fruit, plum, licorice, and dark chocolate, framed by plush, fine-grained tannins and a vibrant line of natural acidity. The finish is remarkably long, silky, and elegant, ending with lingering accents of cedar, spice, and dark berries.

  • Varietal Composition: Typically modeled as a classic Bordeaux blend dominated by Cabernet Sauvignon (around 85–90%), complemented by small percentages of Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Petit Verdot, and Malbec.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine receives an extended maceration to extract deep color and polish tannic structure. It ages for approximately 14 to 15 months in French oak barrels (around 20% to 25% new) to integrate savory spice notes while preserving primary fruit purity.

  • ABV: Typically ranges between 14.1% and 14.8% depending on the vintage.

  • Organic Status: While Beringer employs sustainable vineyard practices, canopy management, and water conservation throughout its Knights Valley holdings, this bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The plush tannins, rich blue and black fruit core, and savory herbal undertones of this Sonoma Cabernet make it an ideal partner for robust, hearty dishes.

  • Red Meats: Pairs exceptionally well with grilled ribeye steak, prime roast beef, braised short ribs, or rack of lamb infused with rosemary and garlic.

  • Poultry & Game: Suggested pairings include roasted quail, duck breast with dark berry reduction, or pan-seared venison.

  • Savory Entrees: Complements wild mushroom risottos, truffle-infused pastas, and rich beef stews.

  • Cheese: Matches gracefully with sharp, aged cheeses such as aged Gouda, Beemster, or mature cheddar.

title: Honig Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
The Honig Family purchased their 68-acre vineyard in Rutherford in 1964, and sold the grapes they grew to neighbouring wineries. In 1980, the family tried their hand at producing their own Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc, to great acclaim. Michael Honig took over management of the winery in 1984, at the age of 22. In 1987, the Honigs made their first Cabernet Sauvignon. Under Michael, Honig's direction, the winery has grown from a small "garage winery" to a 25 person operation. Using solar power and sustainable farming methods, winemaker, Kristin Belair focuses on two varietals: Sauvignon Blanc and Cabernet Sauvignon. This focus allows her to produce handcrafted wines that are a true expression of the vineyard.

An enticing mix of honeysuckle, peach and tropical fruit aromas to a luxurious blend of floral, stone fruit and a mélange of citrus flavours on the palate. The wine is simultaneously elegant and rich, perfectly balanced from the gorgeous nose all the way through the lengthy, layered finish.

title: Fetzer Gewurztraminer
bodyHtml: This crisp white hits the mark with spicy foods and sipping on its own alike. Enjoy honeyed apricot and peach flavours in the glass, and breathe deeply to capture aromas of rose petals and honeysuckle.

title: Beringer Chardonnay Napa Valley Vineyards 2023
bodyHtml:
Beringer Vineyards is located in the Napa Valley region of California, United States. Founded in 1876 by brothers Jacob and Frederick Beringer, it is the oldest continuously operating winery in Napa Valley and is recognized as a historic landmark. Currently owned by Treasury Wine Estates, the winery maintains a philosophy of blending traditional methods with modern innovation, focusing on crafting wines that express the unique terroir of their extensive estate holdings.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a vibrant golden hue and opens with perfumed aromas of lemon confit, yellow apples, and grilled pineapple, accented by notes of white flower blossom and subtle baking spices. The palate is full bodied with a creamy, lush texture balanced by bright, mouthwatering acidity that carries flavors of grapefruit, Asian pear, and lemon meringue. Complex undertones of toasted brioche, vanilla, and a hint of mineral lanolin emerge on the long, focused finish.

Food Pairing

The wine's rich character and vibrant acidity make it a natural companion for succulent dishes such as buttered lobster, grilled halibut, or roast chicken served in a creamy mushroom sauce. It also pairs elegantly with autumn-inspired sides like roasted butternut squash or a rich parmesan risotto.

title: Duckhorn Merlot 2023
bodyHtml:
This benchmark-setting red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the premier Napa Valley region in California. Founded in 1976 by Dan and Margaret Duckhorn, Duckhorn Vineyards is widely credited with elevating Merlot to a world-class standalone varietal in North America. The winery's philosophy is rooted in meticulous vineyard sourcing across the valley’s diverse microclimates; from the cooler southern reaches to the warmer northern hills allowing winemaker Renée Ary to craft a "wonderfully complex composition" that captures a balanced, classic Napa style.

Wine Description

Duckhorn Merlot presents a deep ruby colour with an inviting and sophisticated profile. The sensory profile features luxurious aromas of crushed black cherries, plums, and raspberries on the nose, layered with subtle undertones of cedar, sweet tobacco, and orange peel. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and "silky," showcasing flavours of ripe plum jam, chocolate, and blueberry underscored by baking spices like clove and a hint of pencil lead. It is characterized by fine-grained, firm tannins and a balanced acidity that provides a long, elegant finish. This blend typically includes small percentages of Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc to enhance structure, reaching an ABV of 14.5%. While the estate is a leader in sustainability and utilizes organic fertilizers, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Bonterra Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Pronounced notes of yellow plum, ripe pear, vanilla, honeydew melon and nuts. This is a smooth, creamy Chardonnay. Bonterra's organic practices help express the vibrancy of the fruit. Pair with grilled shrimp, chicken tourtière or lobster with butter sauce.

title: Bonterra Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: Bonterra has been crafting organic wines for 20+ years. This focused Cab shows spicy dark fruit, dried herbs, chocolate and smoky oak flavours. Pair with grilled portobello mushroom burgers or organic rare steaks with roasted potatoes.

title: Benziger Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Benziger Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the United States, within the California region and the Sonoma County subregion. The winery was founded with a deep commitment to revealing the true character of the vineyard, the varietal, and the vintage. As a pioneer in eco-conscious viticulture, Benziger Family Winery focuses heavily on vineyard health and biodiversity to ensure their practices protect the local ecosystem.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a dark, inky purple colour and possesses a rich, full body. The sensory profile is highly polished and approachable, opening with an aromatic nose of ripe blackberry, plum, and wild cherry, layered with mocha and warm spice. On the dry and smooth palate, it delivers a generous core of dark berry flavours and berry cobbler, complemented by hints of dark chocolate, coffee, and subtle herbal tones. The finish is long, dry, and balanced, characterized by chalky, round tannins and an integrated touch of cedar and espresso.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its structural harmony and elegant oak integration, having been aged for 15 to 16 months in barrels to allow the tannins to soften without overwhelming the fruit.

  • ABV: 14.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the estate is a pioneer in biodynamic farming, this specific bottling is typically produced under their Certified Sustainable grape growing program.

title: Starmont Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: Grown in top vineyards across the Napa Valley, Starmont Cabernet lots were hand selected for their rich, robust flavours and fine tannins. Very dark red in colour, with aromas of dark berries and some herbs with background notes of baking spices. Fruit flavours along with subtle toasty oak are framed by well balanced acidity and well resolved tannins. The finish shows great structure with well integrated and resolved tannins. This is a restrained style Napa Cab, not over-ripe or overly extracted. Meant to be balanced and approachable on its own, and also pair well with food.

title: Sterling Merlot Napa Valley 2020
bodyHtml: Sterling Vineyard's Napa Valley Merlot is a vivid ruby-red colour in the glass with aromas of blackberry fruit, plum and ripe black cherry. The appealing bouquet leads to a mouth coating, rich palate where additional red and black fruit flavours mingle with notes of graphite and dried spice. The viscous mouthfeel of the wine is plush and the ripe tannins are refined and polished. The Napa Valley Merlot is well balanced and elegant, offering true varietal characteristics and a sleek, flavourful finish.

title: J Lohr Valdiguie Wildflower 2024
bodyHtml:
Crafted in the style of Beaujolais wines. This light-bodied red wine from Monterey is perfect when served chilled and can pair with a wide variety of foods.

Served slightly chilled, displays inviting fresh raspberry, cranberry, and pomegranate aromas, with a bit of black pepper and hibiscus. Flavors of brambly, bright red berry with a touch of spice, mid-palate acidity lead to a juicy, mouthwatering finish.

title: Bogle Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Bogle Vineyards, based in Clarksburg, California, is a family-owned winery with deep agricultural roots dating back to the late 1800s. Today, the Bogle family continues to uphold a commitment to sustainable farming and traditional winemaking practices, producing approachable and characterful wines that have earned recognition worldwide.

Wine Description
This Chardonnay presents a golden hue in the glass. Aromas of green apple, pear, and stone fruit are layered with hints of tangerine and citrus zest. On the palate, it reveals a creamy, silky texture with flavours of vanilla, nutmeg, and baking spice, derived from time in oak. Full-bodied yet balanced, it carries a smooth, lingering finish with a touch of freshness that complements its richness.

Food Pairing
Roast chicken with cream sauce, buttery white fish such as petrale sole, or creamy pasta dishes are excellent matches for this wine.

title: St Francis Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
St Francis Chardonnay hails from the diverse terroirs of Sonoma County, California. Established in 1971 by founder Joe Martin, St Francis Winery & Vineyards has spent over 50 years championing sustainable viticulture in Sonoma Valley. Today, winemakers Katie Madigan and Chris Louton continue a family owned legacy of crafting elegant, fruit driven wines that highlight the unique characteristics of the region's certified sustainable estate vineyards.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a bright straw yellow hue and a supple, inviting profile. The nose is lifted with zesty aromatics of salted citrus, lemon peel, and white flowers, accented by hints of honeydew melon and a touch of butterscotch. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and refreshing, revealing layers of crisp apple, juicy pear, and orange blossom honey. A silky mouthfeel, achieved through traditional batonage, is balanced by a vibrant acidity and a delicate mineral streak that carries through to a long, smooth finish.

title: Sterling Cabernet Sauvignon Heritage Collection 2020
bodyHtml:
Sterling Vineyards, one of Napa Valley's premier winery destinations, offers an array of distinct and beautifully crafted wines from its home appellation. The Sterling Vineyards Napa Valley wines show the depth, strength and incredible quality representative of California's most famous wine region. The grapes for Sterling Vineyards Napa Valley wines are grown in 14 diverse and premium vineyards throughout the valley, from the cool southern Carneros region to the warm and rugged northernmost reaches of the valley near Calistoga. These incredible vineyards give Winemaker Harry Hansen some of the best Napa Valley fruit to select from and craft these unique, intensely flavoured and expressive wines.

The power of Napa shows in the rich, deeply red garnet colour with aromas and flavours of dark red and black fruits, including black cherry, raspberry, blackberry and ripe plum. Notes of mocha, oak spice and cassis are accented with sea salt caramel and vanilla bean. Intense and full-bodied, the wine is balanced and well-structured with seamless acidity and evident but pleasing tannins.

title: Kendall Jackson Pinot Noir Vintner's Reserve 2021
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This classic Pinot Noir hails from the United States, specifically California, drawing fruit from multiple coastal regions including Monterey, Santa Barbara, Sonoma, and Mendocino counties. Kendall-Jackson is a family-owned California winemaking benchmark, established in 1982 by Jess Jackson. The winery is committed to quality, crafting wines with signature rich layers of flavour and delicate balance, and is a pioneer in sustainable winemaking, with all its estate vineyards being certified sustainable.

Wine Description

This Vintner's Reserve is a dark garnet gem. It delivers bright cherry, strawberry, and raspberry fruit aromas and flavours, complemented by elegant, earthy notes infused with cola and mild spice accents. The wine is a varietal expression of 100% Pinot Noir. Oak aging in mostly French oak adds a hint of vanilla and a soft, toasty finish, providing complexity and a smooth texture. This wine strikes a balance, offering a full-bodied, rich profile with good acidity and a solid finish. The wine is designated as sustainable by the Certified California Sustainable Winegrowing program.

title: Cambria Chardonnay Santa Maria Valley 'Katherine's Vineyard' 2022
bodyHtml: A campfire smoke scent kicks off and dominates the nose of this wine, along with the dried lemon peel, toasted cashew and a tangerine rind touch. It's very familiar and easy to enjoy with its dominant citrus and stone fruit-laced smoke flavour.

title: J Lohr Riesling Bay Mist 2025
bodyHtml: J. Lohr Estates Bay Mist White Riesling is pale straw in colour, offering aromas of daffodil, ripe apple, Meyer lemon and lychee. These delicious aromas are complemented on the palate by cool climate minerality, rich texture, and a spritz of natural carbonation on the finish.

title: Wente Cabernet Sauvignon Southern Hills 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Wente Southern Hills Cabernet Sauvignon is a distinguished red wine from the Livermore Valley in the Central Coast region of California, United States. Founded in 1883, Wente Vineyards is the oldest continuously family owned and operated winery in the country, currently managed by the fourth and fifth generations. The winery focuses on sustainable farming across their estate vineyards, utilizing heritage clones originally brought from Bordeaux by pioneer Charles Wetmore in the 19th century.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep ruby colour with a garnet rim. The aromatic profile is inviting and expressive, featuring notes of ripe blackberry, dark cherry, and plum, complemented by oak inspired scents of vanilla, cedar, and tobacco. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and smooth, offering flavours of black currant, black raspberry, and subtle hints of chocolate and gingerbread. It is characterized by a well polished balance, integrated tannins, and a persistent, slightly savoury finish. The blend typically consists of approximately 87% Cabernet Sauvignon, supplemented by Petite Sirah, Petit Verdot, and Malbec. The ABV is 13.5%, and the wine is certified sustainable. The optimal drinking window is generally three to five years from the vintage date.

title: Gnarly Head Old Vine Zinfandel 2022
bodyHtml: Gnarly Head Old Vine Zinfandel is made using grapes sourced from gnarled 35-80 year old head trained vines. As some of the oldest vines in California, the fruit produced is exceptional, intense and full flavoured. This intrepid Old Vine Zinfandel has a gnarly core of rich, jammy blackberries and mocha flavours with layers of spice and vanilla balanced by complex French and American oak toast. Excellent with braised short ribs, chicken enchiladas or dark chocolate.

title: Ferrari Carano Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
This structured and 'aristocratic' white wine originates from the United States, within the celebrated Sonoma County A.V.A. in coastal Northern California. Produced by Ferrari-Carano Vineyards and Winery an iconic estate founded in 1981 by Don and Rhonda Carano this bottling represents a quintessential, benchmark expression of Sonoma Coast and Russian River Valley Chardonnay. Sourced from choice estate vineyard blocks across prime cool-climate sub-appellations (including Alexander Valley, Russian River Valley, and Sonoma Coast), the vines thrive in gravelly loam and sandy alluvial soils. The coastal microclimate brings persistent morning fog from the Pacific Ocean and cool marine breezes, balancing warm afternoon sunshine to allow Chardonnay grapes to achieve lush tropical richness while locking in a crisp, mouthwatering natural acidity.

Wine Description

The Ferrari-Carano Chardonnay presents a luminous, brilliant gold color in the glass with bright lemon-yellow and chartreuse highlights along the rim. Its sensory profile is exceptionally fresh, high-toned, and complex, delivering an expansive, precise, and luxurious portrayal of Sonoma County Chardonnay. The bouquet opens with a soaring display of golden delicious apples, ripe yellow peaches, and sweet Meyer lemon curd, seamlessly layered with complex underlays of roasted hazelnuts, brioche, toasted brioche, vanilla bean, crème brûlée, and a subtle line of crushed stone minerality. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, supple, and athletic, showcasing a succulent core of tropical pineapple, spiced orchard fruits, and lemon cream. It is characterized by its outstanding inner energy and a bright, mouthwatering backbone of natural acidity that effortlessly lifts its opulent mid-palate density. The mouthfeel is broad, velvety, and creamy, framed by seamless oak integration gained from lees stirring (bâtonnage), carrying into an extraordinarily long, dry, and buttery finish accented by lingering notes of toasted oak, citrus peel, and warm baking spices.

title: Calera Pinot Noir Mills 2019
bodyHtml: Planted in 1984 at 2,200 feet in elevation, this vineyard consistently yields gloriously fragrant Pinot Noir driven by ripe, red-berry aromas with ample spice nuances. Pomegranate and marmalade meet wild mushrooms and fresh-cracked black pepper in a juicy, complex wine.

title: Benziger Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml: Bright citrus and floral aromas introduce this Sauvignon Blanc. In the mouth, it is fresh and enduring, providing a good, but not heavy, volume. This Old World-style Sauvignon Blanc offers subtle minerality and notes of grapefruit and lime. The wine's acid is both balanced and integrated, giving it an elegant softness.

title: Dry Creek Chenin Blanc 2022
bodyHtml: Fermented in 100% stainless steel barrels, this beautiful wine is wonderfully bright and consistent vintage after vintage. At first swirl, aromatics of honeydew, watermelon and mango spring forward from the glass with floral notes of jasmine and orange blossom. On the palate, the wine has refreshing flavors of peach, Meyer lemon and cucumber with hints of geranium, white tea and white pepper. The mouthfeel is soft but inviting, with a voluptuous texture. This classic, Loire Valley-style wine is excellent when paired with fresh oysters, seafood, or just about anything.

title: Calera Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: Beautiful ripe peach, star fruit and pink rose notes waft from this smooth and flavourful Central Coast Chardonnay. Flavours of tropical fruits, honey crisp apple, nectarine, honeydew melon and hints of sweet oak accent the soft, velvety texture and continue through a delicious, lingering round, bright finish.

title: Rodney Strong Zinfandel Old Vines 2019
bodyHtml:
This classic Zinfandel originates from the renowned Sonoma County in California, drawing fruit from several key subregions including the Russian River, Alexander, and Dry Creek Valleys. The winery was founded in 1959 by Rodney Strong, a former professional dancer who became a pioneer of Sonoma County winemaking and was the 13th person to bond a winery in the region. Since 1989, the estate has been family owned by the Kleins, fourth generation California farmers who have maintained a deep commitment to sustainable farming and modern artisan winemaking.

Wine Description

'Old Vines' Zinfandel displays a deep garnet colour and opens with expressive aromas of black cherry, ripe raspberry, and creamy vanilla. On the palate, the wine is rich and silkily textured, featuring a complex profile of dark plum, boysenberry, and black pepper. This medium to full bodied red is characterized by its excellent balance, refined tannins, and a long, inviting finish layered with notes of dark fruit and subtle oak.

title: Calera Pinot Noir Central Coast 2022
bodyHtml:
The Calera Pinot Noir Central Coast originates from the sprawling Central Coast region of California, specifically sourced from premier vineyards across San Benito County, Monterey County, San Luis Obispo, and Santa Barbara. Founded in 1975 by legendary pioneer Josh Jensen, Calera—Spanish for 'lime kiln'—was established high in the Gabilan Mountains with a vision to produce Burgundian-style Pinot Noir from limestone-rich soils.

Wine Description

This vintage is a vibrant and beautifully expressive Pinot Noir, presenting a deep ruby hue in the glass. The sensory profile opens with alluring aromas of ripe blackberry, cedar, and nutmeg, complemented by nuances of raspberry and sweet tobacco leaf. On the palate, the wine is supple and energetic, featuring layers of black cherry, wild strawberry, and cola that glide across silky, fine-grained tannins.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 93 points

  • Vinous - 91 points

  • Decanter - 91 points

  • James Suckling - 91 points

  • Wine Advocate - 90 points

Food Pairing

This Pinot Noir’s bright acidity and earthy complexity make it an exceptionally versatile companion for the dinner table. It pairs beautifully with roasted duck, grilled salmon, or savory mushroom-based dishes, and also complements soft cheeses such as Brie or Camembert.

title: J Lohr Chardonnay Riverstone 2023
bodyHtml: Opulent aromas of ripe pear, gardenia, apple and coconut show on the nose of this bottling. It's racy with acidity on the sip, where a tart lemon flavour leads into apple blossom, poached pear and pineapple, with a slight butter tone on the finish.

title: Stag's Leap Wine Cellars Chardonnay 'Karia' 2024
bodyHtml: This is a graceful Chardonnay with aromas of citrus and subtle tropical fruit notes along with apricot, toasted almonds and orange blossom. Medium to full-bodied, the wine has a silky texture and a refreshing and flavourful finish with a touch of minerality. Try pairing this Chardonnay with grilled chicken with lemon aioli, salmon with a cucumber, tomato and fresh dill salsa or roast chicken breast stuffed with spinach and feta cheese.

title: Chateau Ste Michelle Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: We craft our Columbia Valley Cabernet to highlight concentrated Washington red fruit in an accessible style. This is an inviting Cab with plenty of complexity and structure with silky tannins. It’s also very versatile with food.

title: Rodney Strong Cabernet Sauvignon Sonoma County 2022
bodyHtml:
Rodney Strong Vineyards was established in 1959 by dancer-turned-winemaker Rod Strong, who settled on Sonoma County for its world-class quality and diversity of wines. Since 1989, the winery has been owned by the Klein Family, fourth generation California farmers committed to sustainability in both the vineyards and the winery.

Wine Description

It opens with a bouquet of black currant, ripe plum, and aromatic spices. On the palate, it presents a warm, rich profile of black cherry and black plums, mixed with a hint of milk chocolate, black pepper, and oak spice. The flavour profile also suggests dark chocolate and espresso notes. It is known for its velvety mouthfeel, supple and warm, dense tannins, and a long, elegant finish.

Food Pairing

The wine's bold tannins and rich fruit flavours make it an excellent partner for hearty, savoury dishes such as barbecue favourites like ribs or pulled pork with sweet and tangy sauces or rich pasta dishes, such as spaghetti bolognese.

title: Rodney Strong Chardonnay Chalk Hill 2020
bodyHtml: Founded by wine industry pioneer Rod Strong in 1959, Rodney Strong Vineyards is now owned by the Kleins. This farming-based family prides itself on land stewardship and a relentless push for superior wine quality from Sonoma County. After purchasing the company in 1989, Tom Klein began the endeavour that today brings together excellent vineyards, the industry's finest winemaking equipment, and exceptional talent. The winery farms and sources grapes from vineyards throughout Sonoma County, focusing on Alexander Valley, Russian River Valley and Chalk Hill. Rodney Strong Vineyards is best known for its estate-bottled and vineyard-designated wines. It is also recognized for its sustainable and Fish Friendly Farming, dedication to solar energy production and becoming carbon neutral.

title: Robert Mondavi Sauvignon Blanc Napa Valley 2022
bodyHtml: This iconic Napa expression is intense with a rich mouthfeel. It features toast, vanilla and roasted fruit tones along with ripe, bright apple, melon, lemon zest and tropical notes. The addition of roughly 15% Semillon adds a gorgeous silkiness to the texture. An intriguing classic, it will have good versatility at the dinner table and will work equally well with turkey dinner or grilled fish and each mouth-watering sip calls for another!

title: Wente Chardonnay Morning Fog 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, Wente Chardonnay Morning Fog hails from California’s Central Coast, specifically the Livermore Valley. Founded in 1883, Wente Vineyards is recognized as America's longest continuously operated, family owned winery, now managed by the fourth and fifth generations of the Wente family. The family is credited with pioneering California Chardonnay; approximately 80% of all Chardonnay currently planted in the United States can be traced back to the historic Wente Clone.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a bright sensory profile featuring aromas of crisp Gala apple, fresh cut pear, and lemon curd, seamlessly integrated with subtle oak nuances of sweet cream and vanilla. On the palate, it offers a medium body with hallmark weight and depth, balanced by a refined acidity and a lithe finish that reveals a soupçon of almond.

title: Joel Gott Old Vine Zinfandel 2023
bodyHtml:
Joel Gott Wines was founded in 1996 by Joel Gott, a fourth-generation California vintner and entrepreneur. The winery's philosophy is to craft complex, balanced, and flavourful wines at affordable prices by blending grapes from a diverse range of carefully selected vineyard sites across California, Oregon, and Washington.

Wine Description

The Joel Gott Zinfandel presents a dark ruby and purple hue. The nose is aromatic, offering scents of ripe blackberries, currant, clove, tea, and sandalwood. On the palate, the wine reveals dark fruit flavours of black cherries, plums, and vanilla. It has concentrated, round flavours of caramel and cola on the mid-palate, followed by velvety, supple tannins that lend structure and depth. It is a fruity yet taut and youthful style, showing good balance and length due to ample acidity. The finish is long with a hint of spice.

Food Pairing

This Zinfandel’s bold dark fruit and spice notes make it an excellent partner for hearty meat dishes such as grilled ribeye steak, game, and roast lamb.

title: Dutcher Crossing Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml: This is a great example of Chardonnay from the Russian River Valley region, hitting on all cylinders. It pours golden yellow in colour and offers notes of fresh butter, golden delicious apple, and a touch of lemon on the nose. On the palate it really comes alive, hitting first with bright acidity followed by juicy lemon, pear, honeysuckle, and gentle, oaky butter, all coupled with a creamy mouthfeel. Light, golden delicious apple follows along with a touch of black pepper, and minerality enters on the medium to long finish. This is a flavourful, complex wine that demonstrates a great balance between notes of fruit, acidity, and oak. For fans of California Chardonnay, it’s a winner.

title: Bliss Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: Pale straw colour. Aromas and flavours of banana and rice cake, lemon sauce, and parsley with a round, racy, dryish medium body and an attractive, medium-long lemon zest, Italian sweet herbs, brine, and dill finish with fine, fruit tannins and no oak. A Sauvignon Blanc with outstanding salinity for easy pairings.

title: Joel Gott Unoaked Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in the United States, this Chardonnay is sourced from premier vineyards across California, specifically within the marine-influenced regions of Monterey and Santa Barbara. Founded by Joel Gott, the winery is known for a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes expressive fruit and balanced structure through meticulous site selection and blending. By focusing on fruit from diverse cool-climate AVAs like Arroyo Seco and the Santa Maria Valley, the winery produces a consistent, food-friendly style that reflects the best of California's coastal terroir.

Wine Description

This unoaked Chardonnay presents a bright straw colour and a vibrant sensory profile. The nose is highly aromatic, featuring layers of pear, sweet-tart apple, and mango, complemented by delicate notes of citrus, honeysuckle, and jasmine. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied with a round mouthfeel, opening with bright tropical fruit and citrus flavors followed by a distinct, crisp minerality. It is characterized by a fresh, well-balanced acidity and concludes with a long, clean finish.

title: Edge Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Edge Cabernet Sauvignon originates from the Alexander Valley subregion of Sonoma County in the United States. Established in 2001 by proprietor Ray Signorello Jr., the brand was created to offer high quality Cabernet Sauvignon from premium vineyard sites at an approachable price point. Signorello, who also owns the prestigious Signorello Estate in Napa Valley, manages the winemaking with a philosophy focused on producing rich, luscious, and age worthy wines that are accessible 'by the glass'.

Wine Description

This wine presents an inky, blackish red colour and a tantalizing bouquet of dark red and black berry aromas, accented by notes of espresso, cedar, and mint. The full bodied palate is textured and concentrated, featuring a mélange of black cherry, plum, and blackberry flavours complemented by hints of mocha, licorice, and vanilla. Composed primarily of 97% Cabernet Sauvignon with 1.5% Malbec and 1.5% Cabernet Franc, the wine is framed by smooth, moderate tannins and a backbone of lively acidity that leads to a vibrant, bone dry finish with a whisper of dark chocolate.

Accolades

  • Decanter - 93 points

  • James Suckling - 92 points

  • Vinous - 90 points

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs excellently with rich, savoury dishes such as grilled ribeye steak, smoked brisket, or barbecue ribs, where the meat's fats help soften the wine's tannins. For vegetarian options, a wild mushroom risotto or a hearty lasagna with aged cheddar provides the necessary depth to match the wine's structure.

title: Woodbridge Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml: Deep garnet red with wild red berry and cassis aromas. Flavours of blackberry and tobacco give this wine excellent balance, with oak aging adding a toasty, caramelized quality. With a smooth finish, Woodbridge Cabernet Sauvignon is approachable and delicious with various foods. Enjoy this wine with grilled lamb chops, barbecued ribs or spicy Bolognese pasta.

title: Wente Louis Mel Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
Wente Vineyards is the United States' longest, continuously operated family-owned winery, founded in 1883.  Blending traditional and innovative winemaking practices, they draw from their estate vineyards in the Livermore Valley and Arroyo Seco, Monterey appellations to create an outstanding portfolio of fine wines.

Louis Mel Sauvignon Blanc displays a youthful exuberance that gives this vintage a lot of appeal. It is as lively as it is polished with varietally-typical aromas of fresh honeydew melon, minerals, citrus, and a hint of grass.

title: Kim Crawford Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml: Kim Crawford is renowned for its Sauvignon Blanc, but it also produces this smooth and delectable Pinot Noir. Releasing aromas of cherry and flowers, it's a delightful match for tuna with toasted sesame seeds, or pork chops with sun-dried tomatoes.

title: Wirra Wirra Shiraz Catapult 2022
bodyHtml: The palate shows stylish, medium-bodied structure while offering generous volumes of flavour and texture. A heady mix of blue fruits, damson plum, anise and peaty, savoury notes is countered with bright acidity and silky, plush tannins. This elegant balance produces a long and supple palate that continues to invite another taste.

title: Barossa Valley Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Barossa Valley Estate wines are a contemporary expression of the wines that made the Barossa Valley great. They capture the distinctive elegance, finesse and vibrant fruit flavours of one of the world's most celebrated wine regions. Small in size, the Barossa Valley is regarded as one of the most significant red wine regions on earth. Its unique ancient friable red clay loam soils and warm climate combine to create wines of extraordinary varietal character.

Located in the heart of the Barossa Valley, Barossa Valley Estate focuses exclusively on premium red wines from the Barossa Valley. Barossa Valley Estate produces a range that represents the wine styles that made the Barossa great, Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon and GSM. A highly expressive, wonderfully complex, beautifully bold, commanding wine style.

title: 19 Crimes The Warden Red 2017
bodyHtml: Don't let this masterful blend escape you. Each powerful note brings you one step closer to a night filled with mischief and fun. The Warden is a Shiraz-based red blend with tons of richness and complexity. On the nose, there is ample plum, currant, and cherry intermixed with vanilla and cinnamon spice. The same flavour profile is evident in the mouth, picking up some licorice notes.

title: 19 Crimes Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml: Bright red to crimson hues, this wine confidently takes charge with intense lifted vanilla aromatics balanced with red currants, violets, and mulberry fruits. Firm and full on the palate with a subtle sweetness giving a rich mouth feel. The vanilla aromatics carry through on the palate and complement subtle flavours of red currants, dark cherries, and chocolate. The palate is filled with dark berry fruit, and the soft tannins provide a lingering finish.

title: Victoria Park Cabernet Sauvignon 2016
bodyHtml: Deep purple core with medium cherry edges and lighter rim. An array of dark fruit, very clean and precise nose that is dominated by berries. There is a touch of light spice, green pepper and menthol. Very consistent to the nose, lots of dark berries. The spice is subtle, maybe mellowed by the introduction of a cocoa nib chocolate note. Medium to light-bodied for a Cabernet, with fresh acidity and slick tannins. The alcohol is well balanced and there is no 'heat' coming from the palate. The finish is clean and lingers just slightly. A crushable wine, with a bit more depth if you give it 15 minutes and a few good swirls. Enjoy with a hearty stew or simply enjoy on its own!

title: Victoria Park Chardonnay 2019
bodyHtml: The grapes for this premium wine have been sourced from sustainably managed vineyards within South Australia. This Chardonnay is pale gold with vibrant green hues. Flavours are reminiscent of citrus, honeydew and white peach with a hint of nougat and cinnamon. The palate finishes with a creamy texture and persistent mineral acidity.

title: McGuigan Pinot Grigio Black Label 2024
bodyHtml:
McGuigan Pinot Grigio Black Label originates from Australia, specifically from the South Eastern Australia region. The McGuigan family has a rich history spanning four generations and over 100 years of winemaking heritage, earning the title of 'International Winemaker of the Year' four times. Their winemaking philosophy is built on the belief that quality wine should be approachable and enjoyed without pretence or snobbery. The fruit for this specific label is primarily selected from various vineyards in the Murray Darling region, where hot sunny days and cooler nights are leveraged to produce vibrant fruit profiles.

Wine Description

This white wine is typically pale straw in colour with subtle green hues. The sensory profile features distinct varietal aromas of ripe pear, passion fruit, and green apple, accented by delicate floral perfumes and hints of tropical fruit like peach and pineapple. On the light bodied and crisp palate, it delivers refreshing fruit flavours balanced by a bright acidity. The finish is clean and dry with a persistent citrus character.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Grigio.

  • Stylistic Notes: Crafted in a clean, modern style, the wine is intended to be light, refreshing, and easy drinking.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 11% and 12.5% depending on the bottling.

  • Organic Status: This wine is not certified organic.

title: Layer Cake Shiraz 2021
bodyHtml:
Layer Cake, established in 2007, is part of Hundred Acre Winery where Jayson Woodbridge makes serious California cult Cabs. He’s been called “one of California’s most flamboyant, talented, contrarian wine producers”, “crazy cult wine hero”, and “dedicated and devoted to value and excellence”.  Although he was happy with Hundred Acre’s success, Woodbridge wanted to show that he could make affordable wines that seriously over deliver.

He did just that with Layer Cake, sourcing grapes in some of his favourite wine regions in the world including Australia, Argentina, Italy, Spain, and California, knowing that he would find great value. Using the same winemaking techniques that he uses for One Hundred Acre cabs ensures quality and wines that reflect their origin. These carefully crafted Layer Cake wines are affordable luxuries.

title: Nugan Estate Shiraz Alfredo Second Pass 2019
bodyHtml: Deep ruby with a purple hue. The nose suggests aromas of kirsch, black pepper and mint; on the palate it is dry and medium-full bodied with flavours of dried red berry, pepper, smoke and new leather.

title: Penfolds Bin 311 Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml:
The Penfolds Bin 311 Chardonnay is a premium white wine from Australia, primarily sourced from the cool climate regions of the Adelaide Hills, Tasmania, and Tumbarumba. Founded in 1844, Penfolds is one of Australia's most historic wineries, renowned for its 'multi-regional' blending philosophy that seeks out the highest quality fruit to maintain a consistent house style.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a pale straw colour with delicate lime green hues. The nose is complex and exhilarating, featuring aromas of struck flint and steely minerality alongside white nectarine, grapefruit, and a hint of exotic Tahitian lime zest. On the palate, the wine is elegant and medium-bodied, driving flavours of honeydew melon, white peach, and lemon curd. These fruit notes are supported by a creamy texture and savory nuances of toasted almond, cashew, and nougat from maturation in quality French oak. The finish is remarkably taut and long, defined by a zippy mineral line of acidity and a mouthwatering phenolic grip.

Food Pairing

The wine’s vibrant acidity and citrus-driven profile make it an exceptional match for fresh seafood, particularly oysters with finger lime or fatty tuna sushi. Its creamy mid-palate also complements richer dishes like toasted cheese ravioli or grilled poultry with a lemon butter sauce.

title: 19 Crimes Shiraz - Grenache - Mataro 2021
bodyHtml: The Shiraz is the brooding component that brings the core of dark fruits, licorice and round ripe tannins. The Grenache is focused on the red and blue fruits spectrum and delivers plushness to the final blend. Last but definitely not least the Mataro brings spice and finer tannins, pulling the structure together and giving the wine drive. The resulting wine is complex and layered in a soft approachable style.

title: Saint Clair Pinot Noir Pioneer Block 2020
bodyHtml: A rounded luscious Pinot Noir with aromatic floral notes combined with red berries and a subtle earthy richness. Full-bodied on the palate, with Morello cherry flavours and a fine silky structure showing fresh vanilla pod, blackberry and blueberry with spice on the finish.
