This Pioneer Block Pinot Noir is perfectly matched with spring lamb, sweet potatoes and roast vegetables.

title: Oyster Bay Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
As a founding member of Sustainable Winegrowing New Zealand, Oyster Bay has consistently recognized nature as the true producer of their wines. Situated in New Zealand's most established wine-growing region, the beguiling beauty of our elevated terraced vineyards in Hawke's Bay creates an enchanting Pinot Grigio that captures the delicate aromatic flavours of the variety while retaining its natural vibrancy and purity.

Warm days and cool nights create an extended growing season. The fruit ripens slowly, developing ﬂavour intensity and hallmark aromatic characteristics. Its perfumed notes and soft hints of spice introduce a soft yet delicate style with fresh citrus vitality. A unique cool climate expression of this beautiful varietal. Elegant, crisp and altogether refreshing.

title: Small Gully Mr Black's Little Book Shiraz 2021
bodyHtml: Rich and full-bodied with fleshy ripe blackberry, mint and black olive aromas on the nose. Smooth, with polished tannins and a long finish. Terrific mouth watering juiciness. You put on the jazz music and ZYN will pour the wine, deal? Shiraz food pairings, pork, pasta in meat sauce, steak, lamb cutlets, beef brisket, peppercorn steak.

title: Shinas The Guilty Shiraz 2020
bodyHtml:
Shinas Estate is situated in the northwest region of Victoria. This region is known for its Mediterranean-like climate, classic wines and great food. The first vines were planted in the region in 1886 and by 1898 vine planting commenced on the estate. With eight generations of grape growing and wine-producing experience, as well as George Shinas' passion for perfection, he draws on time-honoured traditions to produce premium hand-crafted wine.

Who is this George Shinas character? None other than your standard night court judge by evening and winemaker turned partying rockstar by day/weekend. The honourable George Shinas is truly the international man of mystery, especially when partnered with his dynamic duo brethren and de facto winemaker, Stephen Black of Small Gully.

The Guilty is produced from premium vineyards. Due to its limited production, only a lucky few will ever get to taste it. Made from low-yielding old vines dating back to 1898 and aged in older French oak, the fruit is sourced from Mildura on the northwest Victorian border. A ripe shiny blackberry red colour, with voluptuous cherry, vanilla and peppery spice aromas. This full-bodied wine is packed with smoky vanilla oak, cherry and strawberry fruits, chocolate and mocha all wrapped up in a big, rich, velvety smooth package. With juicy, bold tannins this is an outstanding Australian Shiraz.

title: Shinas The Executioner 2018
bodyHtml: The Executioner is a blend of Shiraz 55%, Cabernet Sauvignon 43% and Viognier 2% it’s produced from our premium vineyard and is our Flag Ship wine. This wine receives 2 years of barrel aging and 1 year of bottle aging prior it’s release. The Executioner is a wine worth dying for, production is so small it’s a crime punishable by death.

title: Shinas The Verdict Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Shinas Estate is situated in the northwest region of Victoria. This region is known for its Mediterranean-like climate, classic wines and great food. The first vines were planted in the region in 1886 and by 1898 vine planting commenced on the estate. With eight generations of grape gowing and wine producing experience, as well as George Shinas' passion for perfection, he draws on time honoured traditions to produce premium hand crafted wine.

Who is this George Shinas character? None other than your standard night court judge by evening and winemaker turned partying rockstar by day/weekend. The honourable George Shinas is truly the international man of mystery especially when partnered with his dynamic duo brethren and de facto winemaker, Stephen Black of Small Gully.

Rich red fruit and and creamy chocolate on the nose, with spice in the middle and some tobacco and floral notes at the end. Rich and juicy on the palate, with some bright red fruit and spice. There's a little chocolate on the mid-palate and it has a good floral finish.

title: Jacob's Creek Moscato 2025
bodyHtml: Since 1847, Jacob's Creek has been one of the leaders in Australia's Barossa Valley. This aromatic, light bubbly white wine is brimming with floral and ripe pear aromas, with nutty, berry and citrus notes. Medium sweet, easy-drinking, with citrus, pear and tropical fruit flavours. Sip with fruit salad or light desserts.

title: McGuigan Moscato Black Label 2024
bodyHtml: What a revelation! A Moscato marvel! McGuigan's Black Label Moscato will not only have light, sweet wine fans cooing with admiration, it will delight the senses of any true wine lover! Light, lemony and fresh with natural fruit sweetness, it features a wonderful mix of citrus, gin and tonic botanicals and light, sweet Turkish delight. Highlighted by the slight spritz that lifts the wine and enhances the crisp refreshing finish. Simply delicious!

title: 19 Crimes Shiraz - Durif 2020
bodyHtml: The men featured on the wine labels are not those of fiction, they were flesh and blood. Criminals, artists and scholars. In history, they share a bond, receiving "punishment by transportation" for violating one of 19 crimes and becoming the first settlers of a new nation. The wine is deep ruby with a purple hue and aromas of black cherry, cassis and pepper: medium acidity and medium-high tannin.

title: Whitehaven Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
Whitehaven Sauvignon Blanc 2024 hails from Marlborough, New Zealand, one of the world’s most renowned wine-producing regions. Whitehaven was founded by the O’Mara family, who have been crafting exceptional wines since 1994. Their dedication to producing high-quality, sustainable wines is evident in the pristine care they take in their vineyards and winemaking techniques.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc presents a brilliant pale straw color with subtle green hues. On the nose, it offers a vibrant bouquet of fresh citrus, ripe gooseberries, and hints of passionfruit. The palate is crisp and refreshing, with lively acidity that balances the vibrant fruit flavors of lime, green apple, and a touch of herbaceousness. It has a medium body with a clean, zesty finish that lingers with a refreshing, mineral character. The wine is crafted from 100% Sauvignon Blanc and is best enjoyed within 2-3 years of release to capture its freshness and youthful exuberance.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator – 92 points

  • Decanter – 90 points

Food Pairing

Pair this Sauvignon Blanc with light seafood dishes such as grilled shrimp or seared scallops. Its crisp acidity and fruit-forward profile also complement fresh salads, goat cheese, and light poultry dishes. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Greywacke Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This premium red wine originates from New Zealand, specifically from the Marlborough region and the Southern Valleys subregion. Greywacke was established in 2009 by Kevin Judd, the founding winemaker of Cloudy Bay, as a family-owned project focused on a 'keep it simple and hands-on' ethos. The winery's philosophy centres on minimal-intervention winemaking and sustainable viticulture, often utilizing wild yeast fermentations to enhance texture and savoury complexity. The name itself pays homage to New Zealand’s prolific grey bedrock, found throughout the vineyard soils.

Wine Description

The 2023 Greywacke Pinot Noir is deeply coloured and highly aromatic. The nose is complex and perfumed, revealing scents of spiced blackcurrant, dark cherry, and bramble berries, layered with floral notes of violet and lilac alongside hints of hay, pumpernickel, and smoky oak. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and tactile, offering flavours of wild cherry, tamarillo, and grilled nectarine underpinned by a fine, linear acidity.

This 100% Pinot Noir is primarily sourced from hillside plantings in the Brancott and Omaka Valleys. Stylistically, it is celebrated for its finesse and 'seductive' texture, featuring polished, 'sinewy' tannins and a long, driven finish. It was matured in French oak barriques (approximately 30-40% new) for 11 to 12 months.

title: Greywacke Sauvignon Blanc Wild 2023
bodyHtml: A vibrant mix of nectarines, yellow peaches and cassis combines with the bright fragrance of lemon zest laced with musky, jasmine-like floral nuances. The palate is packed with ripe stone fruit, melons and mandarin creating a succulent tropical-fruited style with that classic Marlborough zing.

title: Kim Crawford Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml:
Founders Kim and Erica Crawford established the winery in 1996 and quickly grew it into an iconic brand. The current winemaking philosophy aims to be true to type, showcasing the variety and the region in a fresh, vibrant, and approachable style.

Wine Description

The palate is clean and fresh, featuring flavours of Braeburn apple and florals. This is a soft, medium-bodied wine with a distinctly oily texture, offering orchard fruit, citrus zest, and fine herb notes. It is well-balanced with a touch of minerality and crisp, zesty acidity. It has a smooth, dry finish with a persistent flavour.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include antipasto, fresh seafood, and Southeast Asian cuisine. It also complements light seafood, salads, creamy pasta dishes, roasted chicken with herbs, or a fresh arugula salad with pear and goat cheese.

title: Whitehaven Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
The Whitehaven Pinot Noir hails from the Marlborough region of New Zealand, with fruit specifically sourced from the Southern Valleys (64%) and the Awatere Valley (36%). Established in 1994 by Sue and Greg White, Whitehaven remains a family owned winery dedicated to the pursuit of 'quality without compromise'. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on using 100% Marlborough fruit to consistently create premium wines that express the unique maritime climate of the region.

Wine Description

This medium purple Pinot Noir offers a bright clarity and a lifted bouquet of red plum, dark cherries, and aniseed, complemented by notes of cocoa, thyme, and subtle wood smoke. On the palate, it is medium bodied and elegant, featuring juicy flavours of black raspberry and cherry entwined with dark herbs, cinnamon, and five spice. The wine displays a silky, rounded mouthfeel supported by fine grained, polished tannins and a long, broody finish.

Food Pairing

The wine's bright acidity and earthy undertones make it an excellent match for lamb koftas, lamb ribs, or herb roasted duck. It also pairs beautifully with mushroom based dishes, grilled salmon, or mild hard cheeses like Gruyere.

title: Whitehaven Pinot Gris 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant and elegantly pure white wine originates from New Zealand, specifically within the renowned Marlborough region at the top of the South Island. Established in 1994 by Greg and Sue White after they sailed the Pacific, Whitehaven Wine Company remains an independent, family owned winery currently headed by Sue White. The winery's philosophy is centred on a pursuit of 'quality without compromise', consistently crafting premium wines from 100% Marlborough fruit that showcase the region's distinctive maritime climate.

Wine Description

Whitehaven Pinot Gris presents a very bright appearance with a translucent polished gold hue. The sensory profile features a bouquet and palate led by pomaceous fruits such as yellow apple, red apple, pear, and quince, layered with a mix of lees, white spice, and suggestions of sweet Asian pear. On the palate, the wine is just off-dry with a touch of residual sweetness, showcasing a crunchy and refreshing character from a decent line of acidity that accentuates the spice and warmth of alcohol. It is a well-made, medium-bodied wine with a silky flow and a fine-textured mouthfeel. This 100% Pinot Gris typically reaches an ABV of approximately 13.5% and is suitable for vegans. While the estate is a member of Sustainable Winegrowing New Zealand, this specific wine is not certified organic.

title: Opawa Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
The Opawa Pinot Noir is a bright and elegantly balanced wine from the Marlborough region of New Zealand. Named after the 'smoky river' in Māori, the Opawa vineyard is situated on the historic stony riverbed of the Opawa River, which provides the unique soil profile essential for the wine's aromatic intensity. The winery is committed to the preservation of this wetland ecosystem and its endemic birdlife, employing a winemaking philosophy of minimal handling and gravity flow to maintain the fruit's purity.

Wine Description

This medium bodied Pinot Noir presents a vibrant crimson hue in the glass. The fragrant nose is a complex bouquet of ripe plums, wild blackberries, and cherries, interwoven with delicate floral notes of violets and savoury hints of cardamom and clove. On the palate, the wine is juicy and poised, displaying supple red fruit flavours and a silky texture supported by soft, fine tannins. Its elegant structure and refreshing acidity lead to a refined, lingering finish.

Food Pairing

The wine's bright acidity and earthy undertones make it an exceptionally versatile partner for the dining table. It pairs beautifully with herb roasted chicken, mushroom risotto, or seared tuna steak. For a more adventurous match, consider serving it with Peking duck or grilled salmon to highlight the wine's fruit-forward character and svelte tannins.

title: The Ned Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
The Ned Pinot Noir originates from New Zealand, specifically within the Marlborough region. The wine is produced by Marisco Vineyards, which was established in 2006 by proprietor and chief winemaker Brent Marris. The brand is named after one of Marlborough's famous peaks, which served as a playground for Marris during his youth. The winery's philosophy is captured by the ethos 'Young At Heart', aiming to deliver a grassroots winemaking expression that embodies the energy and adventure of the local landscape.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir presents a deep ruby red colour, often featuring a vibrant purple rim. The aromatic profile is fruit driven and fragrant, highlighted by scents of raspberry, wild strawberry, and red plum. These are frequently underpinned by savoury notes of green tea, dried oregano, and a touch of smoky French oak toast. On the medium bodied palate, the wine is fleshy and expansive with opulent tannins and bright, focused acidity that enhances the mouthfeel. The finish is long and juicy, often showing hints of spice and a floral, black tea like astringency.

title: Dog Point Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
Almost since its inception, Dog Point has been recognized as among the very top, arguably the very top wine producers in New Zealand. Dog Point’s focus on pruning, soil health through organic farming, use of native yeasts and for one wine selected neutral commercial yeasts, all point to a quality and detail-obsessed producer intimately familiar with its region. 

A bright perfumed, supple expression of Marlborough Pinot Noir from clay hill slopes. The fruit is supported by bright florals of rose and violets with crunchy red berry fruit and dried herb notes. The palate is succulent with alluring red cherry, brown spices and silky fine boned tannins. This wine has all the makings of a long lived Marlborough pinot noir and matches perfectly with duck, red meats, particularly venison and lamb, and mushroom dishes.

title: Jim Barry Shiraz The Lodge Hill 2022
bodyHtml: This wine is a deep red with a bright magenta hue. Vibrant aromatics of red and black berry fruits, a lift of violet florals, clove spice and mixed garden herbs. The palate is dominated by a lively burst of berry fruits, which are well framed by fine, powdery tannins. Juicy plum and blackberry flavors persist through the finish, with sweet spice to close.

title: Dog Point Sauvignon Blanc Section 94 2021
bodyHtml: A fuller bodied, textural style of Sauvignon Blanc. This single vineyard parcel is situated within the Dog Point Vineyard, using the same low cropping level from vines planted in 1992. Fruit is hand-picked, whole bunch pressed and fermented and aged in older French oak barrels for 18 months. Bottled without fining.

title: Greywacke Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: A delicious combination of ripe summer fruits and delicate floral perfume-citrus blossom and elderflower entwined with nectarines and white peaches, mandarins, and cantaloupe with a twist of lemon. Intensely flavored, succulent and crisp with a delicate herbal infusion - quintessential Marlborough.

title: Dandelion Vineyards Shiraz Lionheart Of The Barossa 2021
bodyHtml: This is sourced from old vines, many over 100 years of age, planted in some of the oldest soils on earth. Medium-bodied, concentrated and rich with sophisticated aromas of smoke, chocolate, prune with herbal and cedar tones. A big, bold wine for big, bold meat dishes.

title: Satellite Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Citrus, stone fruit with notes of apple and pear.  Juicy and crisp, this wine is layered with stone fruit giving generous length of flavour.

Harvested at peak flavour maturity from our estate and grower vineyards across Marlborough. Gentle juice extraction, cold settled and fermented in stainless steel tanks with a range of aromatic yeasts.

title: Langmeil Shiraz Orphan Bank 2023
bodyHtml:
Langmeil Shiraz Orphan Bank originates from Australia, within the Barossa Valley region. The winery is home to a historic preservation project where ten rows of pre-1860 Shiraz vines were rescued from local developers and replanted at the estate. Chief Winemaker Paul Lindner follows a philosophy of minimal intervention to express the purity of these old vines, which now average over 100 years of age.

Wine Description

This wine typically displays a deep crimson colour with purple hues and possesses a full, rich body. The sensory profile features an aromatic nose of blackberry compote, blue fruits, and violets, accented by sophisticated notes of cedar and baking spices. On the palate, it is concentrated and lush, delivering flavours of juicy raspberries and plums supported by velvety, fine grained tannins and a savory hint of mocha. The finish is long, elegant, and balanced with a refined structural flow.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Shiraz.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its polished complexity and depth, having been matured for 24 months in French oak hogsheads.

  • ABV: Typically recorded between 14.5% and 15%.

  • Organic Status: The estate focuses on sustainable viticulture and biodiversity, though this specific bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The opulent fruit and structured tannins of this Shiraz make it an ideal partner for savoury, protein rich dishes.

  • Meats: Pairs excellently with roast duck, grilled lamb shanks, or hearty beef burgers.

  • Game: Complements wild game dishes such as venison or rabbit stifado.

  • Savoury: Matches well with rich mushroom risotto or matured hard cheeses.

title: Cloudy Bay Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: Cloudy Bay Sauvignon Blanc put New Zealand on the map with its captivating flavour. This Sauvignon Blanc is enticing and appealing, with notes of honeydew melon, passionfruit, citrus and blackcurrant leaf.

title: Jip Jip Rocks Chardonnay 2021
bodyHtml: A nice pale straw and lemon color, a bouquet of white peach fruits. Long and generous fruity flavors blend harmoniously with a silky mouthfeel. This is a very pleasant, friendly style of wine.

title: Small Gully Mr Black's Concoction Shiraz - Viognier 2015
bodyHtml:
This has a lovely aromatic lift from the Viognier component. Asian spices, game, incense, and blueberry aromas are followed by a medium- to full-bodied wine with layers of ripe fruit, excellent balance, and a pure, fruity finish.

91 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate... The full-bodied 2015 Mr Black's Concoction Shiraz-Viognier tips the scales at 15.9% alcohol, giving bargain hunters plenty of literal bang for their buck. Despite that, the alcohol isn't overwhelming. Raspberries and apricots join deeper, darker fruit flavors, all supported by ample weight, supple tannins and a long, mouthwatering finish.

title: Starborough Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: Bright, approachable and refreshing, Starborough Sauvignon Blanc from Marlborough, New Zealand is like wind-whipped seagrass on a warm summer day. It’s the perfect pairing for a casual catch-up and a quick bite. Touched with hints of fresh guava, sweet kiwi, zesty citrus, and tropical passion fruit.

title: First Drop Shiraz Mother's Milk 2022
bodyHtml:
Proudly Barossa! The team at First Drop produces wines with flavour, texture and just a splash of funk. Not a sledgehammer style, this Barossa Shiraz is made for drinking. Soft, slurpy and textured it is balanced with good acidity, which refreshes the palate and makes you go back for a second glass. Drink up!

Garnet red with purple hues. A complex nose of dark cherry and blackberry aromas with a hint of forest floor and spice. Vibrant dark cherry and blackberry, allspice, balanced with an even, textural palate with soft, supple tannins.

title: Yangarra Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml: Intense dark fruit, bright spice, and supple tannins tell the story in this impeccably balanced wine. The finish is long and persistent with perfect tannin balance and more dark fruit and liquorice.

title: Yangarra GSM 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Yangarra GSM originates from Australia, within the Blewitt Springs subregion of McLaren Vale in South Australia. The estate was established in 2001 when the Jackson family purchased the historic Lalla Rookh property, which features priceless old vines planted as early as 1946. Under the guidance of winemaker Peter Fraser and viticulturist Michael Lane, the winery operates with a philosophy of producing single-vineyard estate wines that reflect an authentic sense of place through biodynamic and regenerative farming practices.

Wine Description

This red blend presents a deep ruby or dark ruby colour, often featuring purple reflections. The sensory profile is fragrant and layered, opening with aromas of ripe red berries, blueberry, and dark cherry, accented by dried herbs, lavender, and a hint of spice or peppercorn. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it is rich and plush, delivering juicy flavours of blackberry, plum, and raspberry balanced by a vibrant acidity and elegant, fine-grained tannins. The finish is long and lingering with savoury notes of earth, salted liquorice, and a touch of oak influence.

title: Villa Maria Pinot Noir 'Private Bin' 2024
bodyHtml: Clear ruby red colour. Raspberry, beetroot and red fruit aroma with an herbal and earthy touch. Extra dry, medium-plus body. Soft berry with a touch of spice in flavour, and medium finish.

title: Jip Jip Rocks Shiraz - Cabernet 2021
bodyHtml: It's gorgeously ripe and perfumed on the nose showing blackberry, sweet cherry, vanilla and hazelnut characters with a touch of pepper spice. The palate displays lovely weight and plump mouthfeel, leading to a lengthy supple finish. Brightly expressed and immediately appealing.

title: Mollydooker Merlot Scooter 2023
bodyHtml:
Mollydooker Wines was founded in March 2006 by Sarah and Sparky Marquis. The name 'Mollydooker' is an Aussie slang term for a 'left-hander', a fitting choice as both founders are left-handed. The winery is driven by the philosophy, 'We make wines that make people go WOW, through attention to detail and commitment to excellence'.

Wine Description

This 2023 vintage is described as fragrant and silky smooth. It offers a nose full of cherries and forest fruits. The palate opens with fresh plum and sweet berries, followed by a gentle hint of nutmeg and cinnamon spice.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for this Merlot, which exhibits rich plum and berry fruit with spice notes, include duck confit, various mushroom dishes, herb-crusted pork, or soft ripened cheeses like brie. It is also suggested to pair well with beef, deer, or lamb.

title: Yalumba Viognier Eden Valley 2023
bodyHtml: Pure aromas reminiscent of fresh apricots, lifted ginger, saffron and fresh white flowers. A long, rich and luscious palate, with intense and expressive stone fruit flavours finishing with an alluring citrus freshness. This wine will continue to grow and develop in the bottle, firstly showing enhanced apricots and spice, then after a couple of years developing honey flavours and toast complexity. A wonderful food wine that complements spiced dishes. Try it with Moroccan tajine and spiced couscous or pork dumplings with ginger and chilli oil dipping sauce. Vegan and vegetarian friendly!

title: Mud House Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
This vibrant white wine hails from New Zealand, specifically the Marlborough region at the northern tip of the South Island. Mud House was founded by a courageous couple who, after sailing the world, fell in love with New Zealand and ended their journey to build a home out of the local earth—the very 'mud house' that gave the brand its name. Now led by winemakers Cleighten Cornelius and Krystal Palmer, the winery's philosophy is one of minimal intervention, aiming to express the unique character, freshness, and vibrancy of their sustainably managed vineyards in the Wairau and Awatere Valleys.

Wine Description

In the glass, the Mud House Sauvignon Blanc presents a clear, pale lemon to straw green colour. The nose is lifted and aromatic, bursting with snow pea, nettles, and tropical guava, complemented by intense notes of passion fruit, grapefruit, and citrus blossom. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied and beautifully balanced, offering a 'fruit salad' of flavours including melon, green apple, and ripe tropical fruits.

This 100% Sauvignon Blanc is characterized by its crisp, grapefruit-like acidity which provides a refreshing, juicy texture. A subtle hint of minerality adds purity to the mid-palate, leading into a long, mouth-watering finish. While designed for immediate, youthful enjoyment, this wine will continue to drink well for the next three to four years.

title: Mud House Pinot Noir 2021
bodyHtml: Ruby red. On the nose, fresh cherry and red berries are complemented by a hint of baking spice and earthy aromas. Fresh fruit, sweet dried herbs and savoury oak notes on the palate combine to impart texture, while the long finish highlights the elegant tannins and bright acidity.

title: Nugan Shiraz Third Generation 2020
bodyHtml: The Nugan family history in Australia spans three generations. The Third-Generation label represents the family’s tradition of quality and excellence. These wines are made in their state-of-the-art winery presenting true varietal characters both on the nose and the palette. Another fine example of overdelivering on both quality and value. Deep purple in appearance with youthful crimson hues. Lifted ripe berry fruit aromas, with hints of earth, pepper and dark chocolate complimented by sweet red berry fruit flavours with spice and silky tannin finish. A perfect partner with red meat dishes. Try with a peppered beef fillet with fresh asparagus and horseradish cream.

title: Nugan Chardonnay Third Generation 2020
bodyHtml: This great Australian Chardonnay is a fresh, fruit driven style. Appealing fresh flavors of melon, peach and tropical fruit with a lovely crisp, dry finish. Enjoy with a wide range of dishes including seafood, poultry, white meat and pasta.

title: Villa Maria Pinot Gris 'Private Bin' 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from New Zealand, produced from vineyards across the East Coast of the North Island and the renowned Marlborough region. Villa Maria is a historic family owned winery founded in 1961 by Sir George Fistonich, and it has remained at the forefront of the New Zealand wine industry for over 60 years. The winery's philosophy is centred on a commitment to quality and sustainable viticulture, utilizing professional viticulturists to ensure vines are resilient and capable of producing consistently superb fruit.

Wine Description

The Villa Maria Pinot Gris 'Private Bin' exhibits a pale straw colour with delicate yellow hues. The nose is aromatic and enticing, offering fresh scents of ripe pear, crunchy red apple, and floral blossoms such as honeysuckle, accented by a sprinkling of baking spice. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied with a rich and silky mouthfeel, showcasing flavours of juicy stone fruits, nashi pear, and hints of ginger or almond. It is characterized by a delicate balance between refreshing acidity and a delicious off dry finish. This 100% Pinot Gris typically features an ABV of 13% to 13.5% and is fermented in stainless steel tanks with a brief period of ageing on yeast lees to enhance texture. While Villa Maria produces an organic range called EarthGarden, the Private Bin is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is while the wine is young and fresh, generally within 2 years of the vintage.

title: Mollydooker Shiraz The Boxer 2024
bodyHtml:
Mollydooker The Boxer Shiraz is an exceptional red wine hailing from Australia, specifically sourced from twelve premium vineyards across the renowned regions of McLaren Vale and Langhorne Creek. Established by Sarah and Sparky Marquis, Mollydooker is celebrated for its unique winemaking philosophy, particularly its emphasis on the 'Marquis Fruit Weight' system, which measures the percentage of the palate covered by velvety fruit flavours.

Wine Description

This 100% Shiraz displays a deep, opaque red color in the glass. The aromatic profile is incredibly vibrant, leaping forward with a plethora of fresh plum, blackberry, and black cherry, beautifully complemented by undertones of mocha, licorice, and toasted oak. On the palate, it is full bodied and richly fruited, delivering an elegant yet powerful mouthfeel with layers of summer pudding, dark chocolate, clove spice, and a hint of vanilla cream. The wine maintains an impressive freshness and complexity, supported by well-measured, balanced tannins that guide it toward a smooth, beautifully extended finish.

title: Small Gully Robert's Shiraz The Formula 2020
bodyHtml: A big full flavoured Shiraz produced from 50+ year old vines grown at Robert’s vineyard on the Adelaide Plains. Well balanced and textured, this wine shows savoury notes of tar, leather and spice intermingled with chocolate and raisins. Soft persistent tannins and excellent length.

title: Schild Estate Shiraz 2022
bodyHtml:
Nestled in the heart of the Barossa Valley, Schild Estate is a family-owned winery with deep roots in Australian viticulture. Founded by Ben and Alma Schild in 1952 and now guided by second- and third-generation family members, the estate is known for its commitment to traditional techniques and meticulous vineyard care. Schild Estate’s holdings include some of the oldest Shiraz vines in the region, offering wines of exceptional concentration and character.

A deep, inky purple in the glass, the 2022 Shiraz showcases an expressive nose of ripe blackberry, dark cherry, and plum compote, interwoven with notes of mocha, cracked pepper, and warm spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied and plush, with velvety tannins and a core of dark fruit balanced by hints of vanilla and toasted oak. A long, smooth finish carries echoes of spice and earth, offering both power and finesse.

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled lamb chops, slow-braised beef short ribs, or a hearty mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Sileni Pinot Noir 2020
bodyHtml: In the glass, this wine shimmers in a bright cherry red with ruby red reflections. The nose is enchanted by an intense, varietal aroma and juicy red berry fruits are revealed, complemented by ripe heart cherries and finely spicy hints. On the palate, this New Zealand red wine convinces with a lively personality that can be skilfully ingested by the silky tannins. The finale comes in with a pleasant length.

title: Babich Sauvignon Blanc Black Label 2025
bodyHtml:
Babich Black Label Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc was first produced in 2005. The Black Label Sauvignon Blanc showcases the perfumed and crisp characteristics that set Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc apart, combined with unique depth and complexity on the palate.

Wine Description

Black currant and boxwood. Lime, gooseberry and smoky herbals are also apparent. Fleshy and fruit-sweet entry heavy with passionfruit and a little blackcurrant. Underling this we have complex herbal and citrus notes. Mineral and spice on the finish. Nice breadth and length.

title: Wither Hills Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: The palate is refined and elegant with superb natural fruit weight providing a juicy core of layered fruit, entwined with a salty textural acidity, vibrant citrus pith and a moreish dry chalky finish. A perfect match with plump oysters, mussels or perhaps prosciutto.

title: Seven Terraces Pinot Noir 2020
bodyHtml:
General Information

A reliable Pinot Noir with a cool, spicy demeanour. The nose is floral with rhubarb, strawberry and ginger notes. The palate is light and silky with more dried herbs and a savoury, herbal, strawberry, carrot compost note. A very solid mid-week red you can serve with simply prepared salmon.

title: Villa Maria Sauvignon Blanc 'Cellar Selection' 2024
bodyHtml:
Capturing the essence of Marlborough, this Cellar Selection Sauvignon Blanc is a blend of selective parcels from both the Wairau and Awatere Valleys. Pungent aromas of fresh herbs and spring blossoms lead into a juicy palate bursting with grapefruit, lemons, and limes. The wine finishes with fresh balanced sherbet like acidity and mineral flinty tones.

The Sauvignon Blanc grapes destined for this Cellar Selection wine were harvested in cool night temperatures to protect the aromatics. Clear juice is slowly fermented in stainless steel tanks using selected aromatic yeast strains. The wine is left to mature on yeast lees for a period of time to build palate weight and texture into the wine, without compromising freshness. Vineyard blocks from the warmer Wairau Valley are chosen to express concentrated riper tropical Sauvignon Blanc notes, whereas the cooler windier Awatere Valley takes longer to ripen producing dominant herbal and bell pepper characters.

title: Nugan Shiraz Mclaren Parish 2022
bodyHtml: This is an old school style of South Aussie Shiraz, all power and ripeness, but there's plenty to like in the juicy plum and bramble berry, chocolate, mint and other herbal notes. Tannins are chewy but supportive of all that supple fruit on the muscular palate. Mealy, chocolaty oak is a little prominent, but the varietal character still wins out.

title: Twin Islands Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: With a lively fragrance and crisp palate, citrus flavors and hints of fresh herbs lead to a zesty, mouth-watering finish. Ideal on its own or with seafood, Asian flavors and anything fresh, zingy or bold, this is a very food-friendly wine.

title: Seven Terraces Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
This Sauvignon Blanc hails from New Zealand’s renowned Marlborough region, situated at the northeastern tip of the South Island. Seven Terraces is a label known for producing fresh, expressive wines that reflect Marlborough’s unique terroir and maritime climate. The winery sources grapes from carefully selected vineyards that showcase the area's crisp, clean style and intense varietal character.

Wine Description
Seven Terraces Sauvignon Blanc pours a pale straw yellow with greenish hues. On the nose, it bursts with vibrant aromas of passionfruit, gooseberry, and freshly cut grass, layered with hints of citrus zest and elderflower. The palate is zesty and invigorating, offering notes of lime, green apple, and tropical fruit balanced by a minerally backbone. Light to medium-bodied, it finishes crisp and refreshing with lingering citrus and herbal nuances. Crafted entirely from Sauvignon Blanc grapes, this wine is best enjoyed young to capture its vivid aromatics and lively acidity.

Food Pairing
Ideal with fresh goat cheese, oysters, or a Thai green curry. Its bright acidity and herbal lift also make it a fantastic match for asparagus or grilled prawns. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Spy Valley Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: This Sauvignon Blanc offers aromas of grapefruit, mango, passionfruit and melon. On the palate, the wine's texture is smooth and inviting with classic Marlborough flavours including ripe bell pepper and tropical fruit. Crisp acidity rounds off an elegant structure. Pairs perfectly with seafood, salads and lemon vinaigrette dressings.

title: D'Arenberg Roussanne The Money Spider 2024
bodyHtml: D'Arenberg is well-known for offering great value wines, and this extroverted white is a perfect example. It's great fun, not a subtle or particularly complex wine, but bursting with exotic, juicy fruit perfect for a casual gathering with friends or a night in front of the TV. The name comes from the thousands of money spiders that covered the first crop of Roussanne in 2000. It's said that if you show them kindness, they will bring you luck, and so the decision was made to leave them be. By the following vintage the spiders had relocated and the first wine was made. There's no oak or malolactic here, just fresh and fleshy stone fruit flavours, with a good weight and length. Dangerously gluggable.

title: Alkoomi Riesling Frankland River 2022
bodyHtml: Brilliant pale straw with emerald flecks. Delicate yet intense flavours of lemon, lime and musk. Bright, sherbet and lively on the palate with a lingering mineral acidity.

title: Hugo Shiraz 2020
bodyHtml:
Hugo wines are a family owned and operated winery with fifth generation member John Hugo in charge ably assisted by winemaker Renae Hirsch. Fruit for the 2018 Hugo Shiraz was sourced from two estate blocks planted in 1972 and 1988 respectively. Maturation took place in a mix of 75% French and 25% American oak hogsheads, 20% of which were new, for a period of 18 months.

A superb amalgam of richness and refined opulence. Impenetrable inky black in colour with a very deep dark purple black hue. Wafting from the glass is an intense bouquet of blackberry, liquorice and dark plum fruits which are followed by vanillin oak, a whiff of dark chocolate and peppered fennel like notes. Rich, full and opulent, lavish blackberry, dark plum and liquorice fruits are layered across the palate like silk sheets. Lurking beneath are elements of vanillin cedar, mocha and pepper. Excellent power with velvet smooth tannins and a long seductive conclusion.

title: Hugo Cabernet Sauvignon
bodyHtml: St Hugo is named after Johann’s grandson Hugo Gramp a key figure at Orlando Wines. It is the very best Jacob’s Creek Cabernet Sauvignon and is part of their most premium range. This is a full-bodied wine displaying a rich, textured palate of concentrated cassis and berry fruit flavours with well-integrated tannins. Perfect with pan-cooked eye fillet of beef, served with beef jus and Boulangere potatoes!

title: Shingleback Shiraz Red Knot 2024
bodyHtml: Deep ruby/garnet in colour with rye bread, dark fruit and chocolate aromas. Extra dry, medium-to-full bodied. Dark berry, herbs and spice flavours and balanced acidity with ripe medium tannins and medium length finish. Pair with a BBQ!

title: Shingleback Red Knot Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: Aromas of black cherry and cassis swirl through the senses revealing a touch of savoury oak. Generous amounts of ripe strawberry are presented mid palate which is enhanced with toasty oak nuances and a lengthy finish. A fine choice for roasted or grilled foods.

title: Oyster Bay Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
Produced in the renowned Marlborough region of New Zealand, Oyster Bay is owned by Delegat's Wine Estate Limited, a family owned winery with a history spanning over 60 years. The winery focuses on capturing the distinctive cool climate character of New Zealand through a winemaking philosophy that prioritizes elegant, assertive fruit flavours and a deep respect for the land.

Wine Description

This Pinot Noir presents a radiant ruby red hue with a bright, clear appearance. On the nose, it offers a fragrant bouquet of ripe cherries, raspberries, and strawberries, accented by subtle floral notes and a whisper of dried orange peel. The palate is medium bodied and smooth, featuring a juicy core of dark cherry and black plum supported by silky, rounded tannins. It displays a refined balance and complexity, finishing with a lingering touch of spice and gentle oak.

title: Felton Road Chardonnay Bannockburn 2023
bodyHtml: Elegant and complex, immediately enticing with a bouquet of subtlety and finesse, layers of fresh white fleshed stone fruits and citrus, layers of fragrant spices and minerals, then gently toasty barrel qualities with a whisper of gun-flint. Complexity on the palate builds as the wine opens up. There's purity and finesse seamlessly woven into the satin saline texture. Flavours of white-fleshed fruit and citrus, baking spices and core mineral qualities speak volumes about this wine.

title: Torbreck Woodcutter's Semillon 2024
bodyHtml: Medium-bodied with a pristine lemon hue, this youthful Semillon offers delicate scents of calamansi, limestone, candle wax, and toasted brioche. The copper pink skins of this robust, age-old Madeira Clone flesh out the palate, lending notes of almond kernels, soft pineapple, roasted cashew and white peach. Underlying notes of citrus oil and minerals maintain the wine's freshness whilst a crisp spine of razor-like acidity neatly laces together the finish.

title: Bleasdale Verdelho 2022
bodyHtml: There aren't many white wines coming out of Langhorne Creek, but this Verdelho is a good one, offering crisp, citrusy notes of pear and pineapple, medium body and a clean, refreshing finish. Drink now.

title: Main Divide Riesling 2023
bodyHtml: Main Divide Riesling is an aromatic white wine with fragrances of stone fruit, citrus, floral notes and hints of spice. On the palate, it’s fruity, generous and full. A wine with a refreshing acidity, elegant minerality and a persistent and pleasant finish.

title: Angus The Bull Cabernet Sauvignon 2025
bodyHtml: The philosophy behind this Australian Cabernet Sauvignon was to create the perfect pairing for beef. They succeeded! Deep ruby colour, with aromas and flavours of chocolate, cedar, black plum, floral and herbal notes. Medium to full-bodied and smooth, with a long finish, this is made for grilled steak and roasted potatoes.

title: Tait Ball Buster 2022
bodyHtml:
Tait Wines is a family-owned winery located in the famous Barossa Valley, in South Australia. The Tait name has been involved in the wine industry for more than 100 years, practising the art of cooperage. Tait Wines is continuing this involvement by producing premium quality wines. The inspiration behind Tait Wines was Giovanni Tait (1927-1997). Giovanni Tait migrated to Australia from Italy in 1957 to take up work as a cooper in the Barossa. His high skill and craftsmanship in his chosen trade led him to B Seppelts and Sons where he took an active role in the production and maturation of wine in oak casks. He learnt cooperage from his father and grandfather before migrating to Australia. It was not until his sons grew older that his dream came to reality.

With his sons, he founded a small winery called Tait Wines. His vision for Tait Wines was to be a traditional winery using all the old winemaking methods to produce hand-crafted wines that were powerful in-depth, flavour and taste. Each year, the family acknowledges their father's vision by dedicating the estate-grown Cabernet Sauvignon in his honour. This wine reflects all of Giovanni's qualities of age, depth of character and fullness of life. Now Bruno with his wife Michelle and brother Michael continue to produce premium boutique wines.

title: Main Divide Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml: Beautifully expressive and highly enjoyable, this shows excellent fruit power yet the wine is elegantly balanced and varietal pure. A fabulous combination of fruit intensity and elegant savoury complexity. At this price you would be hard to find a better example of Pinot Noir from just about anywhere.

title: Shaw & Smith Chardonnay M3 Vineyard 2024
bodyHtml:
Aiming for elegance, restraint and the ability to age, Shaw + Smith's M3 Chardonnay's acid is bright and there's generosity of flavor. Typically it shows white flowers, citrus, and nectarine notes.

This is a flavorful and intense Chardonnay, with lovely ginger and orange zest notes as well as nectarine flavors. A vintage to age, and to drink straight away.

title: Shaw & Smith Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml: Aromatic, fresh and lively. Typically, this wine shows a pink grapefruit character, which reflects the carefully selected sites and hand harvesting during the small window of perfect ripeness. It is true to style with accentuated florals and very bright natural acidity. Great as an aperitif or with seafood.

title: Thorn Clarke Shiraz Shotfire 2020
bodyHtml:
The Shotfire Shiraz pays tribute to a family pioneer who worked the Barossa goldfields in the late 1800's. He had the hazardous job of being a 'Shotfirer', one who handled the explosives to be used in finding that rich vein of gold.

Thorn Clarke Shotfire Shiraz is made from 100% Shiraz. Striking deep red-purple in colour. A rich, voluptuous wine with aromas of blackcurrant and mulberries accompanied by notes of smokey oak and hints of cloves. The palate is filled with dark fruits and chocolate backed up by taut tannins and lingering oak.

title: Thorn Clarke Quartage Shotfire
bodyHtml:
Thorn-Clarke Shotfire Quartage 2018 is a distinguished red blend from Australia's Barossa Valley, produced by the family-owned Thorn-Clarke winery, renowned for its rich history and commitment to quality winemaking.

Blend Composition:

  • Cabernet Sauvignon: 47%

  • Cabernet Franc: 31%

  • Merlot: 14%

  • Petit Verdot: 8%

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Deep, inky purple.

  • Aroma: Ripe plum and sweet oak.

  • Palate: Rich and juicy with black fruit, fine tannins, and an attractive rounded mouthfeel.

Accolades:

  • James Suckling: 92 Points

  • Vinous (Josh Raynolds): 91 Points

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Serve at 16-18°C (60-64°F).

  • Food Pairings: Complements beef, lamb, and game dishes.

This wine is approachable now and can be enjoyed over the next several years.

title: Nugan Estate Durif Riverina 2018
bodyHtml:
Durif is a rich and robust red grape variety that revels in the warm and dry conditions of Manuka Grove at Hanwood, New South Wales. Upon reaching optimum ripeness, the parcel was harvested and destemmed without crushing, to retain whole berry during ferment. Fermentation was undertaken in rotary fermenters, which were rolled twice daily for 8 days ahead of pressing to new and seasoned American oak hogsheads for maturation.

Deep garnet in appearance with youthful crimson hue. Aromas of dark cherry and blood plum over milk chocolate oak. The palate displays rich and generous flavours of black cherry, plum pudding and dark chocolate melded with earth and vanillin notes. The final result is a delicious, full-bodied red wine with generous fruit intensity, balance and structure. Enjoy with seared Lamb rump, or caramelized veal shanks with polenta, or aged cheddar cheese.

title: Grant Burge The Holy Trinity GSM 2021
bodyHtml: The Holy Trinity is a Grenache, Shiraz and Mourvedre blend sourced from old vines and five different vineyards. The wine receives no new oak so the pedigree of fruit is on display and offers vibrant raspberry, rose petal and orange peel aromas with nuances of spice box and underbrush. Full-bodied and richly fruited in the mouth, it has a medium to firm level of velvety tannins, crisp acid and a long spicy finish. Enjoy it now or keep for a few years.

title: Langmeil GSM Three Gardens 2023
bodyHtml:
Langmeil Winery has a rich history dating back to 1842, and the Lindner family, who took over the neglected property in 1996, now runs the operations. The winery is celebrated for preserving some of the world’s oldest surviving Shiraz vines, and their winemaking philosophy blends time-honoured techniques with modern methods, focusing on minimal intervention to showcase the unique terroir of the Barossa. Old Barossa vignerons referred to their vineyards as 'gardens', inspiring the name for this blend.

Wine Description

The nose reveals notes of blueberries, black cherries, blackberries, plums, and mulberries, complemented by hints of smoked meats, vanilla, and oriental spices from 12 months of ageing in French and American oak barrels. On the palate, the wine has an incredibly dense and velvety texture. It offers ripe red and dark fruits like forest-berry jam, raspberries, and blueberries, balanced by pepper, white spice, and clove, with a touch of a floral edge.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include braised chicken in red wine, vegetable couscous with beef meatballs, goose breast with ginger red cabbage, or rich tomato pasta dishes.

title: D'Arenberg Shiraz The Footbolt 2023
bodyHtml: Classic McLaren Vale Shiraz. Crimson-purple in color. Aromas of dark plum, boysenberries, subtle black pepper and a touch of licorice. On the palate is where the wine becomes fascinating. Rich and opulent black plums, blackberries and boysenberries are intertwined with savory spices, mocha and a plush coat of red cherries. Tannins are ripe and velvety. Acidity, alcohol and oak are finely tuned, and their balance enhances length on the finish.

title: D'Arenberg Shiraz - Viognier The Laughing Magpie 2018
bodyHtml: Another impeccably good offering from Chester Osborne combining rich and voluptuous McLaren Vale Shiraz with lifted fragrant Viognier. D'Arenberg is one of the pioneers of this style and the 'Magpie' continues to go from strength to strength.

title: Torbreck Cuvee Juveniles 2024
bodyHtml:
This red blend comprises 48% Grenache, 28% Mataro (Mourvèdre), 13% Carignan, 6% Counoise, and 5% Shiraz, sourced from dry-grown, low-yielding vines, some up to 150 years old. The wine presents a medium-bodied profile with lifted aromas of wild blackberries, raspberries, violets, ground pepper, and sage. On the palate, it offers juicy red fruit flavours—red cherry, pomegranate, and red currant—complemented by savoury notes of star anise, fennel seeds, and black peppercorns. The mouthfeel is shaped by ferruginous tannins, providing structure and a lingering finish.

Food Pairing

This wine pairs excellently with grilled lamb, duck confit, or mushroom risotto. Its balance of fruit and savoury elements enhances the complexity of these dishes, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: D'Arenberg Shiraz Dead Arm 2019
bodyHtml: Old, extremely low-yielding McLaren Vale vines are responsible for D'Arenberg's Dead Arm Shiraz, a wine of enormous power, intensity and real complexity, an absolute must for any serious wine cellar and D'Arenberg lover. One of the flagships for McLaren Vale for many years, this wine continues to shine with a balance between tradition and Chester Osborne driven innovation.

title: Yellow Tail Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: Pinot Grigio is an Italian grape variety that grows very well in Australia's warm climate, creating wines of not only great drinking, but excellent for matching with food. This wine shows classic characters of pear, green apples and floral notes with a hint of pineapple, but better still, it makes you feel like you've made a little trip to Italy when you drink it, without the long haul flight.

title: Akarua Rua Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine hails from New Zealand, specifically Central Otago—a premier subregion known globally for its Pinot Noir. Akarua is an esteemed estate founded in 1996, nestled in Bannockburn. It is owned by the Edmond de Rothschild Heritage group, a name synonymous with excellence in winemaking. The vineyard's elevated, schist-rich soils and sustainable practices play a crucial role in shaping its elegant, expressive wines.

Wine Description
The 2023 Rua Pinot Noir pours a vibrant ruby red with a youthful edge. The nose is fragrant and complex, offering aromas of red cherry, raspberry, and wild strawberry, layered with hints of thyme, dried rose petals, and subtle baking spice. On the palate, it is supple and juicy with a silky texture and finely grained tannins. Flavours of red berry fruit dominate, supported by notes of savoury herbs and a touch of oak-derived vanilla. The wine is medium-bodied with refreshing acidity and a lingering, mineral-driven finish. Crafted entirely from Pinot Noir, it is best enjoyed from now through 2028, though short-term cellaring will enhance its finesse.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator – 90 points.

Food Pairing
Perfectly suited to herb-crusted lamb chops, grilled salmon, or mushroom risotto. The wine's earthy undertones and bright acidity make it versatile enough to complement both meat and vegetarian dishes. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Yellow Tail Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml: A blend of selected parcels of fruit from some of Australia's best growing areas, this wine reveals citrus and honeydew flavours nuanced by subtle oak aromas. The palate is soft yet fresh, with balanced acidity and a smooth, creamy finish. A great party wine!

title: Yalumba Y Series Viognier 2023
bodyHtml: Yalumba has pioneered the growing and making of Viognier in Australia. In 1980, the first commercial vines were planted in the Eden Valley, and since then, they have had nearly 40 years of viticultural and winemaking experience working with this alluring variety. Bright straw in colour with green hues. Aromas of orange blossom, fresh ginger, and hints of honeysuckle and white flowers. Fresh apricot, white tea, dried figs and fennel lead to a creamy mid-palate with a silky, textural finish. The wild fermentation and lees aging gives the wine an extra level of complexity on the palate that belies its age.

title: Pewsey Vale Dry Riesling Eden Valley 2025
bodyHtml: Pale straw in colour with green hues. Intense aromas reminiscent of fine dried herbs, white flowers, lemons and limes. Shows great length and depth on the palate with grapefruit and limes, fresh rosemary, white pepper and a hint of tropical fruit. The wine finishes with a soft natural acidity which balances the flavour intensity and a minerality that will reward medium to long-term cellaring. Enjoy with seared scallops, salt and pepper squid, or a Thai noodle salad.

title: Stoneleigh Pinot Noir 2020
bodyHtml:
Plums and spice greet the nose from this lively and distinctive wine. More primary red fruits abound on the palate, which is light to medium-bodied and carries beautifully supple tannins. A gentle touch of nutmeg spice and white pepper, with some vanilla oak, complete the picture and stay for a lingering finish.

Try this versatile wine on the weekend with a classic slow-cooked retro dish such as coq au vin or beef bourguignon. If a more speedy meal is in order then fire up the grill for a seared tuna steak or Portobello mushrooms topped with melting cambozola cheese and fresh thyme.

title: Pirramimma Petit Verdot 2022
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine hails from McLaren Vale, South Australia. Founded in 1892 by Alexander Campbell Johnston, Pirramimma remains a family owned and operated estate, with grandson Geoff Johnston currently at the helm as owner and chief winemaker. The winery is a pioneer of the variety in Australia, having researched the grape for eleven years before releasing the country’s first single varietal Petit Verdot in 1994.

Wine Description

This wine presents an inky, deep profile characteristic of the varietal. On the nose, it exhibits intense aromas of violets, cherries, and cedary oak, supported by red floral tones and earth. The rich, full bodied palate delivers layers of juniper, plum, blackcurrant, and mocha, all framed by 24 months of maturation in French oak.

Food Pairing

The wine’s dense structure and spicy notes make it a perfect match for grilled steak, roast beef, or slow cooked short ribs. It also pairs beautifully with hearty lamb shanks and sharp cheddar cheese.

title: Pirramimma Shiraz 2022
bodyHtml:
This exceptional red wine originates from Australia, specifically from the prestigious McLaren Vale region in South Australia. Established in 1892 by Alexander Campbell Johnston, Pirramimma is one of the oldest family owned wineries in the area, with its name translating to 'the moon and the stars' in the local Aboriginal language. Across generations, the Johnston family has maintained an intimate relationship with their estate, focusing on sustainable viticulture and a winemaking philosophy that marries time honoured traditions with modern innovation to truly capture the distinctive character of their ironstone soils.

Wine Description

The Pirramimma Shiraz displays a deep, intense maroon hue in the glass. On the nose, it reveals a complex and lively bouquet of Satsuma plum, black cherry, and raspberry, intricately woven with nuances of vanilla bean, chocolate box, and warm mocha. The dense, full bodied palate delivers luscious, rich flavours of blackberry, spicy mulberry, and boysenberry, beautifully complemented by hints of pepper, coconut, and integrated toasty oak.

title: Pirramimma Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the McLaren Vale region of South Australia, this wine is a classic expression of one of Australia's most historic family owned estates. Founded in 1892 by Alexander Campbell Johnston, Pirramimma—an Aboriginal phrase meaning 'the moon and the stars'—has been operated by the Johnston family for over 130 years.

Wine Description

This Cabernet Sauvignon presents a deep maroon hue with vibrant dark red edges. The nose is complex and highly aromatic, offering a bouquet of blackcurrant, blackberry, and bay leaf, accented by hints of truffles, cigar box, and toasty nutmeg spice. On the palate, the wine is full bodied yet elegant, delivering intense flavours of briary black fruit and red currant. It exhibits a linear style with sleek tannins and fine acidity, leading to a focused, structured finish with impressive length.

Food Pairing

This robust Cabernet Sauvignon is best paired with hearty, savoury dishes such as grilled steak, roasted lamb with rosemary, or braised beef brisket. For a vegetarian alternative, it pairs beautifully with mushroom risotto or eggplant Parmesan, where the wine's acidity cuts through the richness of the cheese and earthiness of the vegetables.

title: Jim Barry Cabernet Sauvignon The Cover Drive 2022
bodyHtml: This wine is a deep ruby red with a crimson hue. Classic Cabernet notes of berry compote and dark cherry combine with nuances of olive leaf and lifted red florals. The palate is lively with bright red berries and dark cherry fruit. The wine has an even pull through the palate with fine tannins and a moreish finish.

title: Penny's Hill Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml: Sweetly fruited and perfumed, the wine shows Black Doris plum, mulberry, clove and cedar characters on the nose. It's succulent and beautifully rounded on the palate, displaying richly textured mouthfeel and seductive complexity. Wonderfully harmonious and lingering.

title: Yealands Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: The nose is generous with ripe tropical and citrus notes, alongside flowering herbs and blackcurrant leaves. The delicious palate is layered with green tropical fruits and balanced with a refreshing crisp mineral finish. Enjoy with seafood, grilled chicken, salads, and pasta.

title: Babich Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
This classic white wine comes from New Zealand, produced in the world-renowned Marlborough region. Babich Wines is New Zealand's most experienced family-owned winery, established in 1916 by Josip Babich. Now in its fourth generation, the family maintains a winemaking philosophy rooted in sustainable craft, innovation, and a deep-seated passion for sharing the unique character of their estate vineyards.

Wine Description

The vintage displays a brilliant pale straw colour with vibrant green-gold highlights and excellent clarity. The bouquet is intensely aromatic and sweet, bursting with notes of passion fruit, grapefruit, mandarin, and lantana, followed by subtle hints of slate, nettles, and citrus blossom. On the palate, a 'fruit salad' of flavours explodes—including green tropical notes, crisp citrus, and lime zest—complemented by a finely textured rush of mineral and spice.

This 100% Sauvignon Blanc is produced in a fuller, riper, and softer style that offers a pristine balance between juicy fruit intensity and a salivating backbone of acidity.

title: Mount Riley Sauvignon Blanc 2025
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml: Pale straw with green hues. A complex and expressive nose showing pink grapefruit, passionfruit and lime with nuances of nettles and crushed herb. A wine of striking fruit purity and concentration with fresh but balanced acidity and a great length of flavour.

title: Mount Riley Pinot Noir 2024
vendor: 300747 - South By Southwest Wine Imports Inc.
bodyHtml:
This family winery ages their Pinot Noir for nine months in French barriques. 

Deep-red with garnet and ruby hues. Aromas of ripe cherry and plum characters are supported by hints of savory spice and dried herbs. An approachable with soft tannins and intense fruit flavor. Silky texture and great length.

Excellent as an aperitif or with savory tomato or mushroom-based dishes, salmon, red meat, or pasta.

title: Jacob's Creek Shiraz Reserve
bodyHtml: Each wine in Jacob's Creek's Reserve range is made by selecting premium quality fruit from one of Australia’s best wine regions for each region to make wines with great varietal expression.

title: Nobilo Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml: Fresh, crisp and clean with zesty flavors of ripe tropical fruits, especially passionfruit and pineapple with subtle hints of green herbs. The wine is intensely flavored with balanced mouthwatering acidity and a generous finish.

title: Bleasdale Malbec Second Innings 2022
bodyHtml: Malbec is renowned for its value in blends but not often found as a varietal. This fine example from Bleasdale is considered a benchmark for the style. Soft, smooth, toasty oak with great depth of complexity.

title: Yalumba Bush Vine Grenache Barossa 2022
bodyHtml: The Barossa Valley is home to some of Australia's oldest and prestigious Grenache vineyards. Grenache is producing some of Australia's most interesting wines. The Yalumba Old Bush Vine Grenache is the perfect example with its lifted fruit character that shows a freshness and interest that is quite remarkable. Remember, it's all about the fruit.

title: Wolf Blass Shiraz Yellow Label 2024
bodyHtml:
Wolf Blass Yellow Label Shiraz is a quintessential red wine from South Australia. Established in 1966 by Wolfgang Blass, the winery grew from a humble tin shed in the Barossa Valley into an international icon of modern winemaking. The estate is celebrated for its philosophy of creating highly drinkable, soft, and plush wines that emphasize quality and consistency across every vintage.

Wine Description

This Shiraz presents a deep crimson-red colour with vibrant purple hues. The nose is highly aromatic, featuring fragrant red and blue berries complemented by subtle notes of cedar spice, pepper, and eucalyptus. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied, delivering a juicy explosion of dark fruit flavours like plum and mulberry. It is structured with fine, velvety tannins and a touch of creamy oak, leading to a smooth, lingering finish.

title: Wynns Cabernet Sauvignon Black Label 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in the Coonawarra region of South Australia, this landmark wine originates from the storied Terra Rossa vineyards. First crafted in 1954, Wynns Black Label has become a benchmark for Australian Cabernet Sauvignon under the stewardship of Wynns Coonawarra Estate, a winery originally revitalized by Samuel and David Wynn in 1951.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep concentration of ripe black fruit, featuring a sensory profile of blackberry, cassis, and black cherry layered with violets, anise, and crushed herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium weight and generous, opening with buoyant red cherry and plum that transition into savoury notes of moss, earth, and fine cedary oak. It is characterized by a seamless undercurrent of firm, pliable tannins and a succulent acidity that drives a long, clean finish.

title: Yalumba Cabernet Sauvignon The Menzies Vineyard 2019
bodyHtml: Established in 1849, Yalumba is Australia’s most historic family-owned wine company. It remains fiercely independent and extremely progressive through the generational ownership by the Hill-Smith family. Yalumba’s longevity and success are a result of patience, collaboration and progressive thinking. There is foresight to embrace the natural terroir to craft wines with individual character and a sense of purpose, a spirit to reinvest in the land upon which it operates and knowledge to behave as a leader in the industry. It is committed to sharing stories of provenance gathered over more than 168 years of history of family winemaking.

title: Coldstream Hills Pinot Noir 2022
bodyHtml: Ripe characters of dark cherry, raspberry, wild strawberry, and blood plum are enhanced by whole bunch spice and savoury French oak. Medium bodied in style, the palate is vibrant, textural, and complex. Dark cherry and raspberry characters dominate with underlying nuances of stalk spice, mineral graphite, and beautifully integrated French oak. Fine chalky tannins give the wine structure and length. One for the cellar.

title: Dog Point Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
Dog Point Sauvignon Blanc hails from the Wairau Valley in the Marlborough region of New Zealand. As one of the oldest privately established vineyards in Marlborough, this family owned estate is a pioneer in organic viticulture, holding the country's largest certified organic vineyard area. The winery operates with a low interventionist ethos, focusing on hand picking and indigenous yeast fermentations to produce wines that authentically reflect their unique silty loam and clay soils.

Wine Description

This wine presents a pale straw colour with a vibrant, perfumed bouquet featuring freshly squeezed citrus, dried herbs, and the estate’s signature flinty, smoky reduction. On the palate, it is medium bodied and finely textured, offering a juicy core of lemon, grapefruit, and white stone fruit balanced by a distinctive saline acidity and a mineral backbone. Composed of 100% Sauvignon Blanc, the wine is bottled without fining and exhibits a complex, layered finish with great concentration.

title: Nautilus Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: Nautilus Sauvignon Blanc displays intense lifted aromas of passionfruit and citrus peel and hints of honeydew melon. The palate introduces a delightful citrus based mouth-watering intensity and finishes with a strong textural component. The high acidity and fresh flavours pair well with a wide range of seafood and vegetarian dishes. The flavour intensity can stand up to some chilli and the herb notes in the wine compliment Thai ingredients such as basil or lemongrass.

title: Oyster Bay Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml: Oyster Bay Marlborough Chardonnay is cool climate at its best. Fresh and vibrant with aromas of white peach, crisp citrus, a touch of oak and an elegant, creamy texture.

title: McGuigan Shiraz Black Label 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This iconic red wine is produced in Australia, specifically within the broad South Eastern Australia region, sourcing fruit from notable areas such as the Riverland, Murray Darling, and Limestone Coast. McGuigan Wines is a cornerstone of the Australian wine industry with over 100 years and four generations of winemaking heritage in the Hunter Valley. The winery's philosophy is centred on a passion for 'The Love of Wine', a commitment that has seen them crowned International Winemaker of the Year a world-record four times at the International Wine & Spirits Competition (IWSC).

Wine Description

The McGuigan Shiraz Black Label presents a deep cherry red colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is lifted and fruit-forward, featuring dominant notes of ripe blackcurrant, plum, and red berry fruits, accented by hints of spice, mint, and subtle toast. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and rich, delivering intense flavours of blackberry jam, spicy plum, and cherry.

Stylistically, this 100% Shiraz is crafted for consistency and approachability, offering a well-rounded mouthfeel with smooth tannins and balanced acidity. The addition of vanilla and caramel notes adds depth, leading to a long, persistent, and satisfying finish. While designed for immediate enjoyment, its robust fruit character allows for a short drinking window over the next two to three years.

title: Penfolds Chardonnay Koonunga Hill 2023
bodyHtml:
This accessible and balanced white wine originates from Australia, specifically from the South Eastern Australia region, often sourcing fruit from cooler subregions like the Adelaide Hills, Padthaway, and Robe. Established in 1844, Penfolds is one of the most storied names in Australian wine, and the Koonunga Hill line was introduced in the 1970s to offer quality and consistency at an affordable price. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a 'multi-region, multi-vineyard' blending approach, allowing winemakers to select the best parcels of fruit to maintain a reliable house style regardless of vintage variations.

Wine Description

Penfolds Koonunga Hill Chardonnay presents a vibrant pale straw colour with light green hues. The sensory profile is fruit-driven and inviting, featuring aromas of yellow apple, white peach, honeydew melon, and citrus, supported by subtle notes of vanilla, creamy nougat, and toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is light to medium bodied with a 'fleshy' yet fresh texture, showcasing flavours of stone fruit, lemon curd, and lime zest. It is characterized by its balanced acidity and a fine mineral streak that provides a clean, textured finish. This 100% Chardonnay is typically matured in a combination of stainless steel and seasoned French oak to preserve its varietal character, reaching an ABV of approximately 13% to 13.5%. While the estate follows high production standards, this wine is not indicated as organic.

title: Oyster Bay Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: It all starts in their Marlborough vineyards, in the region famous for introducing elegant, cool-climate New Zealand wines to the world. Marlborough’s warm days and cool nights create an extended growing season allowing the grapes to develop strong, intense varietal characteristics whilst maintaining a balanced, crisp natural acidity. The result is a distinct wine that is always crisp, elegant, and refreshing. Uniquely Marlborough and undeniably Oyster Bay.

title: Wolf Blass Shiraz - Cabernet 2021
bodyHtml: So Wolf Blass from start to finish so if you are a fan then this wine is a must. Made with fruit from McLaren Vale, the Barossa and Adelaide Hills it is a deep almost opaque ruby colour before launching into slick and pristine aromas of blackberry, mulberry, new leather and licorice with more than a dash of sweet oak in the background. The palate follows suit thanks to a riot of dark berry fruits with a firm bed of mouth-coating tannins in support. It is a rock-solid Wolf Blass red and will age well.

title: Matua Hawke's Bay Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
ntroduction

Matua Hawke's Bay Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant white wine from New Zealand, produced in the Hawke's Bay region on the North Island. Matua holds historical significance as the winery that produced New Zealand's very first Sauvignon Blanc in 1974. While the Marlborough region is famous for the style, the Hawke's Bay expression offers a distinct profile, often noted for being slightly riper, more textural, and possessing a characteristic minerality.

Wine Description

The wine is made from 100% Sauvignon Blanc grapes. It is classified as a dry, medium-bodied white wine with lively acidity.

  • Aromatic Profile: The nose is highly aromatic, opening with prominent characteristics of passion fruit and gooseberry, complemented by notes of citrus (lemon, lime, grapefruit) and subtle hints of lime leaf, spice, and fresh herbs.

  • Palate: The palate is textural and richly layered, with flavours of lemon, grapefruit, and tropical fruit, underpinned by a brisk, clean acidity. Compared to its Marlborough counterpart, this wine may offer a slightly richer mouthfeel, or more roundness.

  • Structure and Finish: It is an energetic and well-balanced wine. The finish is long and refreshing, marked by a lovely minerality that is characteristic of the Hawke's Bay terroir.

  • Style: Vibrant, fruity, and elegantly dry.

  • ABV: Typically ranges from 12% to 13%.

  • Sweetness: Dry (0–5 g/L residual sugar).

Food Pairing

The wine's crisp acidity and clean finish make it highly versatile for food pairing. Suggested pairings include:

  • Fresh Seafood: Oysters, prawns, and seafood salad.

  • Poultry and Vegetarian: Baked white fish, vegetarian dishes, and chicken sandwiches.

  • Cheese: Goat cheese, feta, and soft-ripened cheeses.

title: Rosemount Shiraz Diamond Label 2023
bodyHtml: Alive with a rich medley of dark berries, plums and liquorice, complemented by subtle milk chocolate and nutmeg notes. This wine bursts onto the palate with sweet juicy plums and dark berries, before unfolding into luscious milk chocolate and liquorice.  A subtle spice note joins in, as this delicious wine meanders towards a long and mouth-watering finish.

title: Jacob's Creek Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml: An intense mix of citrus and melon underpinned by toasty notes. The well-rounded and creamy palate showcases vibrant fruit flavours and toasty oak. Enjoy on its own or with white fish or creamy chicken pasta.

title: Penfolds Shiraz - Cabernet Sauvignon Koonunga 2024
bodyHtml: Crimson with a ruby-red brightness at the rim. Undoubtedly Cabernet, there is no denying the DNA. Steely graphite, pomegranate liveliness and seared pepper-crusted beef. Dried herbs aromatically circle around the varietal Cabernet fruit. White cherries and cranberry follow aromatic pomegranate, bringing an associated succulence that borders on austerity. Fine silky tannins, a steely core, and graphite provide shape. A solid framework for the fruit and tannins to hinge upon.

title: Wolf Blass Chardonnay Yellow Label 2025
bodyHtml: Wolf Blass Yellow Label Chardonnay is a soft, generous white wine packed with enticing aromas of stone fruits, following through to a generous, medium-bodied palate with a soft creamy texture, subtle oak and a lingering finish.

title: The Black Chook Shiraz - Viognier 2022
bodyHtml: Bright aromas of red cherry, berries and plum fruits with hints of licorice, mocha and spice. Give this wine a brief stay in a decanter to help blow off some of the tarry notes and it should be fine. It's full-bodied and creamy, with mocha and black-fruit flavors that finish plush and soft. A soft, round shiraz with great fruit length, generosity and drinkability.

title: Wakefield Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml: The medium-high intensity nose is fresh with herbal, leafy, mint and spice layered over black cherry, plum, and gentle oak aromas. The medium-full bodied palate offers well-integrated oak spice, black cherry, plum, and peppery spice flavours supported by smooth, fine-grained, and sweet tannins. It has fresh, juicy acidity. Pleasantly dry, undeniably Shiraz and well-balanced overall with a touch of chocolate on the long finish.

title: Lindeman's Chardonnay Bin 65 2025
bodyHtml:
Loved around the world, Lindeman’s Bin Series wines are approachable in style, consistent in quality with global appeal. Designed to be opened, enjoyed and shared time and time again, these are wines people simply love to drink. Lindeman’s most well-known range began with the iconic Lindeman’s Bin 65 Chardonnay, which was first launched in 1985 in response to the popularity of Lindeman’s approachable and fruit-driven style of wines in the northern hemisphere.

Lindeman’s Bin 65 Chardonnay features aromas of peach, fig, tropical fruit and toasty oak, with a medium-bodied, fresh, crisp finish.

title: Wine Men of Gotham Shiraz 2019
bodyHtml: Full-bodied and overflowing with explosive Shiraz flavours, crammed with blackberries and red fruit flavours.

title: Lindeman's Cabernet Sauvignon Bin 45 2024
bodyHtml:
Lindeman's was founded in 1843 by Dr Henry Lindeman, who planted the winery's first vines in the Hunter Valley of New South Wales. Driven by a philosophy that focused on quality over quantity, Dr Lindeman was determined to produce only matured, pure wines that would offer health and civilizing benefits to his customers. Today, the winery is a global icon known for its approachable and consistent Bin Series, which aims to bring people together to enjoy and share wine.

Wine Description

This medium to full bodied Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep ruby core with plum edges. The expressive bouquet features cassis and bramble fruit aromas melded with dark fruit notes and subtle hints of spiced oak. On the palate, it reveals layers of dark berry and blackcurrant flavours complemented by chocolate, mint, and well integrated tannins. Stylistically, the wine is smooth and balanced with a juicy freshness that leads into a long, stylish finish.

Food Pairing

The wine’s bold structure and firm tannins make it an ideal companion for grilled meats, such as a New York strip or ribeye steak, where the acidity cuts through the fat. For a more rustic option, pair it with slow cooked beef cheeks or a roasted leg of lamb seasoned with rosemary and thyme. It also serves as a wonderful match for hearty vegetarian dishes like eggplant parmesan or mushroom risotto, as well as a selection of aged, full flavoured cheeses.

title: Wyndham Cabernet Sauvignon Bin 444 2025
bodyHtml: Deep garnet colour. Dry and medium-full bodied with aromas and flavours of cocoa, cassis and eucalyptus. Medium tannins. Long finish.

title: Peter Lehmann Layers White 2022
bodyHtml: This dry and greenish-yellow coloured white showcases a simple nose releasing floral and fruity scents. You will be charmed with this light-bodied wine revealing a slender texture and a short finish.

title: Wyndham Estate Chardonnay Bin 222 2022
bodyHtml: Lemon yellow colour with fragrant aromas of tropical fruit, pineapple, peach and vanilla oak. Dry, medium to full-bodied with soft fruit flavours. Citrus and spice on the finish.

title: Kono Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
Established in 1998, Kono is recognized as the first Māori owned wine business in the world and operates as part of the Wakatū Incorporation, which represents over 4,000 Māori shareholding families. The winery is guided by a 500 year intergenerational plan called Te Pae Tawhiti, focusing on the cultural value of 'kaitiakitanga' or guardianship of the land. This philosophy ensures that vineyards in the Waihopai, Awatere, and Rapaura subregions are managed with a commitment to sustainability and preserving the environment for future generations.

Wine Description

This Sauvignon Blanc presents a bright golden appearance with subtle green reflections in the glass.
