The nose is intensely aromatic, featuring a vibrant fruit driven profile of citrus zest, grapefruit, and passionfruit, complemented by herbaceous notes of lemongrass and fresh bell pepper. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and crisp, offering luscious flavours of ripe lemon, lime, green apple, and pineapple. It is finely balanced with a zesty acidity and an underlying minerality that leads to a long, persistent, and dry finish.

Food Pairing

This wine's lively acidity and tropical profile make it an ideal companion for fresh seafood, particularly oysters, scallops, mussels, and baked white fish. It also pairs beautifully with summer salads, vegetable-based dishes, and tangy cheeses like goat's cheese or feta.

title: Yellow Tail Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml: Cabernet Sauvignon is known for its elegance, soft, fruit driven in style and with feathery tannins. Cassis, violets, crushed herbs and a long, soft finish is what you will find with this wine.

title: Bleasdale Red Blend Broad Side 2021
bodyHtml:
This is the great Australian red blend of Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon, with a touch of Malbec. The wine displays plum, blackcurrant, chocolate and boysenberry spice. A juicy palate with persistent flavour and smooth velvety tannins.

Enjoy with a summer BBQ or slow cooked dishes.

title: Colome Malbec 2023
bodyHtml: Colome Estate is a Malbec based blend with Cabernet Sauvignon and Tannat. The signature red varietal of Argentina, Malbec excels in the warm, dry climate, producing exceptional wines with dark, spicy aromas and succulent texture.

title: La Posta Malbec Pizzella 2024
bodyHtml:
La Posta translates to “the tavern,” where the farmers meet to discuss their soils, vines, quest for superior flavours, and passions for life. In collaboration with wine pioneer Laura Catena and esteemed winemaker Luis Reginato, La Posta expresses the hard work and skill of the people behind the wines. 

It is a beautiful red and purple colour with aromas of black cherries, dark fruits, dark chocolate and baker’s spice. On the palate, the wine shows dense, dark berry and plum flavours, along with hints of sandalwood and spice and even a hint of violets in the finish. This is a full-bodied, well-structured wine that is incredibly full of life and born to be enjoyed with food and friends.

title: Bousquet Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve 2024
bodyHtml: Violet colour with ruby tones. The nose shows strawberries and flowers aromas with spicy and mineral notes. On the mouth is refined, stylish red, showing scented oak, fine, savoury tannins and bright acidity. Blend: 85% Cabernet Sauvignon, 15% Malbec.

title: Achaval Ferrer Malbec 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Produced in Argentina, this benchmark red wine originates from the prestigious Mendoza region. Achaval Ferrer was established in 1998 by a group of Argentine and Italian friends with the singular mission of producing world class, terroir driven wines. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a deep respect for nature and the preservation of heritage, focusing on low intervention winemaking and the use of centennial, ungrafted vines to create wines of exceptional purity and elegance.

Wine Description

The 2022 Malbec presents a bright violet colour with youthful brilliance in the glass. The nose is fresh and intensely floral, offering a captivating bouquet of blackberry, juicy plums, and violets, accented by hints of herbs and a peppery edge. On the palate, the wine is potent yet velvety, displaying a soft and rounded texture with flavours of dark cherries, strawberries, and a touch of dark chocolate. It possesses a medium to full body with a noticeable mineral salinity and fine grained tannins, leading to a long, smooth finish.

This wine is 100% Malbec, typically sourced from various vineyards across Luján de Cuyo, the Uco Valley, and Medrano to provide a comprehensive reflection of the province. It is aged for 9 months in neutral French oak barrels to emphasize freshness and varietal tipicity. While this young wine is intentionally bottled to be approachable and soft upon release, it remains structured enough to be enjoyed over a drinking window of roughly four to six years.

Accolades

  • Vinous - 93 points

  • James Suckling - 92 points

  • Tim Atkin - 91 points

title: Trivento Malbec Golden Reserve 2023
bodyHtml:
Trivento Golden Reserve Malbec is a red wine from the Luján de Cuyo region in Mendoza, Argentina. Established in 1996, Bodega Trivento is named after the three winds—Polar, Zonda, and Sudestada—that influence the region's terroir. Under the guidance of winemaker Magdalena Viani, the winery is dedicated to crafting wines that embody the rich viticultural heritage of Mendoza.

Wine Description

This 100% Malbec showcases a vivid red color with violet tones. The nose is complex and intense, featuring aromas of red fruits such as raspberries and strawberries, complemented by subtle hints of vanilla and coconut from oak aging. On the palate, it offers a sweet entry with persistent and vibrant tannins, leading to an energetic, long finish. The wine is aged for 12 months in oak barrels, followed by additional bottle aging, resulting in a balanced integration of fruit and oak flavors.

Food Pairing

This Malbec pairs exceptionally well with rich dishes such as roasted lamb, beef, and sausages. Its depth and character are enhanced when enjoyed alongside spicy turkey burgers or tacos, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Bramare Malbec Lujan de Cuyo 2023
bodyHtml:
This wine originates from Argentina, specifically the Luján de Cuyo region within Mendoza. Viña Cobos was established in 1998 by the renowned American winemaker Paul Hobbs, who is widely recognized as a pioneer in elevating Argentine Malbec to international fame. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a deep exploration of terroir, utilizing sustainable farming and meticulous winemaking to produce authentic expressions of the land. The name 'Bramare' is Italian for 'to covet or yearn for,' reflecting the ambition and determination that have driven the estate since its challenging early years.

Wine Description

The Bramare Luján de Cuyo is a 100% Malbec that presents an intense ruby or violet red color. The aromatic profile is rich and layered, featuring sour cherry, cassis, and strawberry alongside notes of caramel, white pepper, graphite, chocolate, and subtle hints of menthol and rosemary. On the nose, it also displays floral accents and sweet spices like cinnamon and clove.

On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, round, and balanced, with a remarkably broad and enveloping mouthfeel. It features sweet, juicy, and elegant tannins that are firm yet refined, transitioning into a powdery and persistent finish. Stylistically, this Malbec is prized for its plushness, depth, and fresh acidity, often showing great minerality and complexity.

Food Pairing

This full-bodied Malbec pairs exceptionally well with grilled or slow-roasted red meats, such as lamb or beef, and is a perfect match for dishes featuring mushrooms. It also complements aged cheeses and rich dishes served with a reduction sauce.

title: Santa Ema Merlot Gran Reserva 2022
bodyHtml: Santa Ema Gran Reserva Merlot is ruby red-violet in color with aromas of plum and blackberry together with intense and unmistakable aromas of caramel, vanilla, and chocolate. It’s smooth on the palate with ripe tannins, good structure, and very good balance, making it perfect for red and white meat, pasta, fowl, and cheese.

title: Santa Ema Sauvignon Blanc Select Terroir Reserva 2023
bodyHtml: Santa Ema Select Terroir Sauvignon Blanc is a crystalline yellow color with green tones. The predominant aromas are of citrus fruit with notes of pear and apple. The wine is young and fresh on the palate with balanced, easy acidity. It’s ideal for white fish, shellfish, ceviche, and King crab.

title: Achaval Ferrer Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml:
The profound relationship between the sun and the altitude of the Andes inspired Achaval-Ferrer to explore other paths. They wish to share the expression of a mythical variety, whose echoes of freshness and seduction make it stand out for its elegance.

An accurate reflection of its variety, Cabernet Sauvignon delivers a strong and direct message where the fruit overcomes the mineral nuances. Originating from small patches of vineyards located in Mendoza's first area, this wine with minimal production highlights a juicy texture filled with black and red fruitiness. Far from abstractions, it allows for a lovely walk toward that pleasure. Cabernet Mendoza is an expression of spontaneity and vitality resulting from its youthfulness.

title: Cocodrilo Red Blend 2024
bodyHtml: This Bordeaux-style blend is composed of 72% Cabernet Sauvignon, 22% Cabernet Franc, 5% Malbec, and 1% Syrah. In the glass, it presents a deep ruby red hue with dark undertones. The aromatic profile is complex, featuring notes of sweet spices, roasted red pepper, clove, and dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is balanced and juicy, showcasing sweet tannins and culminating in a long, satisfying finish. The medium-bodied structure is complemented by firm tannins, indicative of its aging potential.

title: Emiliana Novas Cabernet Sauvignon Gran Reserva 2020
bodyHtml:
Black cherry red with intense fruity notes of blackcurrant and strawberries that give way to a light touch of black pepper, tobacco leaf and chocolate.

The palate presents medium body and very smooth, lush tannins. This wine is very easy to drink and stands out for its great balance and fresh finish.

title: Undurraga Pinot Noir Gran Reserva Sibaris 2024
bodyHtml:
Chile, San Antonio Valley, Leyda Valley. Founded in 1885 by Don Francisco Undurraga, Viña Undurraga is one of Chile's most historic and pioneering wineries. The winery focuses on expressing the distinct terroir of individual vineyard sites, with the Sibaris line specifically crafted for those who appreciate the 'good life' and refined, classic styles.

This elegant Pinot Noir displays a ruby red colour of medium intensity. The nose is expressive and fresh, bursting with aromas of morello cherry, strawberry, and cranberry, layered with notes of wild herbs, forest floor, and a hint of vanilla from oak ageing. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and juicy, featuring flavours of pomegranate and tart red berries balanced by savoury hints of leather, spice, and tobacco. It possesses a smooth, silky texture with gentle tannins, refreshing acidity, and a persistent, clean finish.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir.

  • Stylistic Notes: Balanced, fresh, and complex with classic 'pinosity' and well integrated oak.

title: Santa Isle Pinot Noir Gran Reserve 2019
bodyHtml: Ruby red color. On the nose there are plums with lavender and violet. Strawberry and a nice balance of oak on the palette.

title: Norton Malbec Privada 2020
bodyHtml:
Originally reserved for the family's private cellar, this exclusive high-end blend is a result of a request by the Swarovski family to create the best wine to enjoy among their friends. Its grapes come from the winery's oldest vineyards, between 50 and 90 years old. 

A truly unique wine, it is a special selection of the best barrels of Malbec, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, which results in a harmonious, complex and elegant blend. A deep red blend with rich aromas of blackberries. Rich, smooth and elegant. With a lingering finish given by the integration of its three blends.

title: Ritual Pinot Noir Casablanca Valley 2021
bodyHtml: A medium-bodied Pinot Noir with remarkable floral, cherry and raspberry aromas. In the mouth, bright fruit flavors with a wonderful texture and extraordinary acidity. Smooth and balanced with a long, silky and velvety finish.

title: La Mascota Malbec Mendoza 2022
bodyHtml: La Mascota Malbec shows an intense purple red colour with ruby hues. Aromas of black fruits, jam and vanilla, with a subtle liquorice touch. Sweet attack and full bodied tannins. Long and pleasant finish. Ideal to match with grilled meats or strong cheeses.

title: Alamos Malbec Seleccion 2021
bodyHtml: This full-bodied Malbec wine begins with complex aromas of juicy dark fruits and hints of floral violet and wildflowers. On the supple palate, abundant fruit flavours of ripe black currant and plum are framed by hints of black pepper and baking spices, leading to a lingering, luscious finish.

title: Santa Carolina Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml: Deep garnet colour; Bell pepper and cassis on the nose with hints of leather; full and ripe with blackberry fruit nuances; long, supple finish.

title: Lagarde Malbec Primeras Vinas 2020
bodyHtml: This old-vines Malbec is ripe to the max as it teeters towards raisniny but pulls back with the help of graphite and mild herbal aromas. The palate is big and forward, with a slight acidic bite that keeps it fresher than some hefty Argentine Malbecs. As for flavors, look for a mix of oak, plum, blackberry, tomato and herbs in front of a complex finish.

title: El Enemigo Malbec 2023
bodyHtml:
El Enemigo Malbec originates from the high-altitude vineyards of Mendoza, Argentina, specifically sourced from the prestigious Adrianna Vineyard in the Uco Valley. Established in 2008, the winery is a joint venture between Alejandro Vigil, chief winemaker at Bodega Catena Zapata, and Adrianna Catena, daughter of Nicolás Catena. Their winemaking philosophy centers on capturing the era when European immigrants first settled in Argentina, aiming to create wines with exceptional refinement and a profound sense of place.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a deep ruby-red colour with violet glints. The nose offers an inviting and complex bouquet of ripe black fruits, plum, and fresh cherry, interwoven with floral notes of lavender and violet, alongside subtle hints of asphalt and toasted wood. On the palate, the wine is full bodied yet precise, featuring a rich and fluid texture with flavours of blackberry, black cherry, pepper, and spice. It is well balanced with refreshing acidity and firm, grippy tannins that lead into an intensely savoury, earth-tinged finish.

Food Pairing

The robust structure and rich fruit profile of this Malbec make it an ideal companion for grilled or roasted red meats, such as steak, lamb, or barbecued ribs. It also pairs excellently with earthy flavours like grilled portobello mushrooms or aged cheeses such as Cheddar and Manchego. For a unique finish, consider pairing it with dark chocolate.

title: Marques De Casa Concha Carmenere 2022
bodyHtml:
Founded in 1883, Vina Concha y Toro is Latin America's leading wine producer and occupies an outstanding position among the world’s most important wine companies.

Deep dark red in colour with intense notes of ripe plums, black currants and dark chocolate, along with a firm tannic structure and pronounced acidity. Carménère makes an excellent everyday food pairing wine for several reasons. For one, the naturally high acidity makes for excellent pairing next to foods with higher acidity sauces. Another benefit is Carménère’s herbaceous peppercorn-like flavour that often embellishes roasted meats, from chicken to beef. Finally, the lower tannin in Carménère makes it a friendly option for lighter, less fatty dishes. In short, this is one to keep around for just about everything.

title: Norton Malbec Barrel Select 2025
bodyHtml:
Bodega Norton is a prestigious Argentine winery situated in the Mendoza region, established in 1895 by English engineer Sir Edmund James Palmer Norton. In 1989, the estate was acquired by Austrian businessman Gernot Langes-Swarovski, and it is currently operated by Michael Halstrick under a philosophy that blends high-quality winemaking with deep respect for the traditional Argentine process. The winery is celebrated for its commitment to innovation and its significant role in establishing Mendoza’s high-altitude vineyards as a premier source for world-class Malbec.

Wine Description

The Norton Malbec Barrel Select displays a clear, medium ruby colour with vibrant violet hues. The nose is expressive and rich, offering a bouquet of ripe plum, blackcurrant, and figs, complemented by hints of anise, black pepper, and spicy vanilla. On the palate, the wine is dry and full bodied with a firm structure, featuring balanced acidity and friendly, well-integrated tannins. Flavours of lush black fruit and sweet spices lead into a persistent, medium-length finish marked by notes of toasted oak.

title: Norton Sauvignon Blanc Barrel Select 2024
bodyHtml: Perfect for patio sipping or anytime sipping! Norton's Barrel Select wines achieve a delicate balance between fruit and wood tones, a reflection of the fact that part of each wine is aged in French oak. This allows the fruit aromas of each varietal to combine harmoniously with the toasted notes of the oak, giving the wine complexity and structure. Greenish yellow with golden hues. Aromas of green apples and tropical fruit. Complexity given by notes of vanilla and coconut.

title: Colome 'Amalaya' Malbec 2025
bodyHtml: Brilliant ruby colour with violet edges. Strawberries, raspberries and ripe fruit with a touch of pepper and spices aromas and elegant floral notes. In the mouth, flavours of red fruit, spice and hints of vanilla from aging in French oak. Very nice freshness. Round, soft tannins lead to a delicate, lingering finish.

title: Emiliana Novas Carmenere - Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml: This ruby-red wine offers a fruit nose with the predominant aromas of strawberries and some toasted and dark chocolate notes. The concentrated palate shows velvety ripe tannins along with tremendous balance and harmony.

title: Argento Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml: Floral and stone fruit aromas. Vibrant apricot, peach and nectarine flavours with chamomile and slate notes. Finishes with crisp acidity. Pair with an array of appetizers or light seasonal salads.

title: Finca La Florencia Malbec 2019
bodyHtml: Intense red fruit aromas, with delicate touches of spice and pepper. On the palate, its soft and ripe tannins let you enjoy a long-lasting and substantial finish.

title: Zorzal Pinot Noir Terroir Unico 2021
bodyHtml: Good intensity for the variety, with violety tones. Here we find a Pinot Noir that is very intense on the nose, a result of their terroir. Aromas of blackberries, strawberries and earth, with mineral notes. Direct, clear, vertical, it flows in the mouth with plenty of life and smoothness. It has good volume and great acidity, making it very fresh, with a long, sweet finish.

title: Zuccardi Q Malbec 2023
bodyHtml: The Zuccardi family’s approach to sustainability starts with the environment and people before any product. They’re dedicated to producing the highest quality wines through sustainable practices such as a focus on nurturing biodiversity, organic farming, efficient irrigation practices, composting, water treatment, comprehensive waste and recycling efforts, and the use of solar energy.

title: Escorihuela Gascon 1884 Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Argentina, specifically from the Agrelo district of Luján de Cuyo within the Mendoza region. Established in 1884 by Miguel Escorihuela Gascón, the winery is one of the oldest in Mendoza and is celebrated for its historic cellars and commitment to high altitude viticulture. The winery's philosophy focuses on capturing the exceptional typicity and aromatic expression of its terroir through a blend of traditional methods and modern winemaking techniques.

Wine Description

Escorihuela Gascón 1884 Cabernet Sauvignon displays a deep ruby red colour with bright purple highlights. The nose is expressive and classic, offering intense aromas of blackcurrant, plums, and wild berries layered with spicy notes of black pepper, vanilla, and cedar. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and velvety, featuring a juicy core of cassis and dark cherry fruit supported by polished tannins and a hint of mint. It is characterized by its balanced acidity and a long, savoury finish that showcases notes of dark chocolate and tobacco. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon was aged for eight months in French oak and has an ABV of 13.5%. The wine is not certified organic. The optimal drinking window is from release through 2030.

title: Koyle Cabernet Sauvignon Gran Reserva 2018
bodyHtml: This wine is fruit-driven and straightforward, clean and juicy. It has contained ripeness, keeping good freshness for the conditions of the year. Pair with beef, roast duck, or lamb-based dishes.

title: The Show Malbec 2022
bodyHtml: The Show Malbec is a delicious wine with flavours of blackberry, cranberry, white pepper and spice, with toasty vanilla and violets. The wine has smooth tannins, a velvety texture and a long, lingering finish.

title: Graffigna Pinot Grigio 2023
bodyHtml: Pale straw yellow colour. Aromas of fragrant melon, apple, citrus and honey with light pear and floral tones. Dry, light to medium-bodied, soft with balanced acidity, flavours of citrus, apple, pear fruit and citrus flavours with a nice stream of acidity and a lovely finish.

title: Cono Sur Sauvignon Blanc Organic 2024
bodyHtml:
Cono Sur Vineyards & Winery was founded in 1993, with the vision of producing expressive and innovative wines that convey the spirit of the New World. Right from the start, Cono Sur applied new ideas and technology to traditional winemaking methods. The main goal is to create wines, applying sustainable practices with special care for the environment making each sip a masterpiece.

A bright, clean and young Sauvignon Blanc made from organically grown grapes. The nose is intense, displaying aromas of grapefruit, lime, lemon, yellow pepper, white flowers and herbs. There is good concentration on the palate: fresh, with excellent acidity and minerality. Pair with seafood, chicken, spices, yogurt and citrus sauces, nuts, cheeses and vegetarian dishes.

title: Vina Chela Malbec 2021
bodyHtml: It is a savoury wine with red fruit, brown spice, roasted herbs, bittersweet chocolate and coffee flavours. It has a medium weight and good acidity making it a suitable dinner partner for meat and tomato-based pasta or grilled beef.

title: Sottano Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve 2024
bodyHtml: On the nose, there is an array of complex aromas of coffee, cassis, tobacco and spices. In the mouth, this wine has great volume that are balanced with a touch of oak and soft ripe tannins.

title: Sottano Malbec Reserve 2024
bodyHtml: Excellent colour, fine varietal expression, of a wide complexity of red and black fruits, spices such as white pepper and clove on the nose. Sound structure and ripe tannins, well integrated to the wood. Long and persistent.

title: Alta Vista Malbec Vive 2021
bodyHtml:
The 2021 Alta Vista Vive Malbec is a distinguished red wine from Mendoza, Argentina. Crafted exclusively from Malbec grapes, this wine exemplifies Alta Vista's dedication to producing wines of exceptional quality and character.

Colour: Intense red with violet hues, indicating its concentration and youthfulness.

Aroma: An expressive bouquet featuring notes of plum, black cherry, and exotic spices, complemented by subtle hints of coffee and vanilla from oak aging.

Palate: Fresh and intense flavors with good structure and soft tannins, leading to a full and concentrated finish with spice notes.

Body: Medium-bodied with a rich and velvety mouthfeel, showcasing both power and elegance.

Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

title: Vina San Pedro 1865 Cabernet Sauvignon Selected Vineyards 2023
bodyHtml: Intense, deep ruby red with purplish tones. This wine demonstrates a strong bouquet, marked by elegant and intense aromas of ripe red fruit like cherries, plums and blueberries, in addition to cassis blended with notes of chocolate, mocha and cedar. Very dense and concentrated, with mature and noticeable tannins. In addition, the wine displays a very good balance between the tannins, acidity and oak.

title: Terrazas de los Andes Malbec Reserva 2022
bodyHtml: Bright red color with purple shades. Intense floral and fruity notes on the nose with the presence of violets, ripe black cherry and plum aromas. This wine reveals a toasty and spicy character of black pepper and chocolate. Its sweet and juicy mouthfeel delivers finesse, delicate tannins and an elegant finish of black fruits.

title: Casa Viva Pinot Noir 2019
bodyHtml:
Celebrating Valparaiso’s unique spirit, Casa Viva or “Living House” is sourced from the neighbouring Casablanca Valley, Chile’s first and foremost coastal cool climate wine growing region.

Tasting Notes... Medium ruby red in colour, on the nose lifted aromas of sweet red cherries, orange peel and cinnamon dominate. In the mouth ample flavours of strawberry and nutmeg combine with a fresh acidity and lush tannins to give good length. Light and fresh, making it perfect for before dinner sipping!

title: Santa Julia Malbec Organic
bodyHtml: As the #1 Organic producer in Argentina, Bodega Santa Julia's decision to farm organically is inspired by their connection to the land and strong desire to protect the environment. In 2001 they received their first Organic Certification and with each passing year have certified more vineyards prompted by the high quality of the wines and increased health of the soils. Santa Julia is also Fair for Life Fair Trade Certified meeting their high standards for maintaining responsible supply chains and Corporate Social Responsibility. Fruity medium body, balanced, with very round tannins and very expressive fruit.

title: AR Guentota Malbec 2019
bodyHtml:
This wine is crafted by Belasco de Baquedano, a winery that is part of the Spanish group La Navarra, which began its operations in 1831. The Belasco family, led by Juan Ignacio Belasco, initiated this ambitious Argentine project in the early 2000s, focusing exclusively on Malbec. Their winemaking philosophy centres on maximizing the exceptional qualities of Malbec from their very old, high-altitude vineyards.

Wine Description

The AR Guentota Malbec displays a deep ruby red colour with bright purple tones. The wine offers an intense and complex bouquet with notes of wild berries and ripe red fruit along with hints of resiny oak and cedar from barrel ageing. On the palate, it is full-bodied and well-structured, with flavours of ripe red plums, currants, and berries. This Malbec presents soft, smooth-honed tannins, a velvety mouthfeel, and is well balanced. It finishes with an elegant, persistent, and dry long finish. 

Food Pairing

This rich and full-bodied Malbec is an ideal accompaniment to hearty dishes. Suggested pairings include grilled meats, aged cheeses, or hearty stews.

title: Emiliana Adobe Sauvignon Blanc Reserva 2025
bodyHtml: Brilliant pale yellow with a green hue. Pronounced aromas of herbs, citrus, minerals, bell pepper and spice. On the palate, it is light to medium-bodied and fresh, with flavours of herbs, zesty lime and bell pepper on a clean and refreshing finish.

title: Emiliana Adobe Carmenere Reserva 2024
bodyHtml: The aroma reflects ripe fruit perfectly balanced with sweet and toasted notes given by wood and a touch of spices, the main characteristic of the Carmenere. This wine has soft and well balanced volume with ripe tannins that leave a delightful flavour and persistence.

title: Luigi Bosca De Sangre Malbec 2023
bodyHtml: A deep and bright red violet wine with balanced aromas and red fruit and sweet spice notes. It is refreshing and voluptuous in the mouth, with fine and gentle tannins, while it is clean and expressive on the palate, with a strong character, typicity and a deep finish with soft smoked hues as a result of its ageing in oak barrels. It is a great exponent of the variety and the terroir, with good ageing potential.

title: Pascual Toso Malbec Reserva 2022
bodyHtml: Italian-born, Pascual Toso settled in Argentina and established his Mendoza winery in 1890. This wine shows flavours of chocolate, floral note and plum with hints of smoke and spice. Medium-plus body with soft tannins and a good mouthfeel, it will complement leaner cuts of beef like sirloin or filet as well as lamb or duck.

title: Falernia Carmenere Gran Reserva 2021
bodyHtml:
Viña Falernia is situated in the Elqui Valley, Chile's northernmost wine-producing region. Founded in 1998 by Aldo Olivier Gramola and his cousin, the Italian oenologist Giorgio Flessati, the winery was a pioneering venture that transformed semi-arid desert land into high-altitude vineyards. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on innovation and the use of modern technology to express the unique potential of this extreme, cool-climate territory.

Wine Description

The Falernia Carmenere Gran Reserva displays a brilliant and deep inky violet colour. The nose is remarkably intense, offering a complex bouquet of brambly black fruit, espresso, white chocolate, and sweet pepper, accented by notes of vanilla and spice. On the palate, the wine is robust and full-bodied, featuring a richly textured, velvety structure with super-smooth tannins. It is characterized by vibrant blackcurrant fruit and a persistent finish with hints of smoky leather and cracked pepper.

Food Pairing

This rich and spicy Carmenere is an ideal accompaniment to grilled meats, roasted lamb, and pork loin. Its structured profile also complements pasta dishes with hearty meat-based sauces, spicy Indian curries, and full-flavoured cheeses like sharp cheddar.

title: Andeluna 1300 Malbec 2023
bodyHtml:
The Andeluna 1300 Malbec 2023 is a distinguished red wine hailing from the Uco Valley in Mendoza, Argentina. Produced by Andeluna Cellars, a winery established in 2003, this wine reflects the unique terroir of vineyards situated at an elevation of 1,300 metres above sea level. The winery is renowned for crafting premium mountain wines that embody the character and charm of the Andes region.​

Sensory Profile

  • Colour: Intense, bright purple hue.​

  • Aroma: Initial floral notes of violets, followed by a vibrant expression of fresh fruits such as red plum, strawberry, and blackberry.

  • Palate: Fresh and balanced with a smooth texture, complemented by subtle mineral undertones.

  • Body: Full-bodied yet harmonious, showcasing the varietal's typical characteristics.

  • Finish: Long and satisfying, leaving a lasting impression of its fruity and floral notes.

title: Domaine Bousquet Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
Domaine Bousquet Malbec originates from Argentina, specifically from the high-altitude Gualtallary district in the Tupungato region of the Uco Valley in Mendoza. The winery was founded in the late 1990s by Jean Bousquet, a third generation French winemaker who moved from Carcassonne to Mendoza after discovering the ideal terroir for organic viticulture. Today, the estate is owned by Jean's daughter, Anne Bousquet, and her husband Labid Al Ameri, who lead the winery with a firm philosophy centered on 100% organic farming, environmental sustainability, and a New World vision refined by French sensibility.

Wine Description

This Malbec presents a deep, bright violet colour with reddish tones. The sensory profile is fruit forward and intense, featuring aromas of blackberry, plum, and red currant, often layered with floral notes of violet and hints of spice, chocolate, and mountain herbs. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied and well balanced, delivering lush flavours of dark cherry, fig, and cassis. The structure is defined by soft, elegant tannins and a fresh acidity that leads to a long, persistent finish. This 100% Malbec varietal typically has an ABV of 13% to 14% and is fermented in stainless steel tanks without oak contact to preserve its pure varietal expression. The wine is certified organic and 100% vegan.

Food Pairing

The vibrant fruit and smooth tannins of this organic Malbec make it an exceptionally food friendly choice. It pairs perfectly with grilled red meats, such as seared steak, BBQ burgers, or traditional Argentine asado. It also complements pasta served with meat or tomato based sauces, roasted pork, and spicy Tex-Mex dishes like fajitas. For a cheese course, it is best enjoyed with sharp cheddar, manchego, or mild aged varieties.

title: Errazuriz Cabernet Sauvignon Max 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Dark ruby red colour. Smoky, chocolate, cassis, cedar and floral nose. Extra dry, medium to full-bodied, well structured, with complex chocolate, cassis and cedar flavours, balanced acidity, soft tannins and a long finish.

title: Trivento Malbec Reserve 2023
bodyHtml: Big and bold with aromas of black fruit plus a hint of pepper and spice. Well balanced with soft tannins on the finish.

title: Vina Tarapaca Natura Plus Gran Reserva 2018
bodyHtml:
The Natura Plus Gran Reserva 2018 is composed of 31% syrah, 29% cabernet franc, 25% carménère, and 15% cabernet sauvignon, all from organic vineyards at the Fundo Tarapacá estate in Isla de Maipo. 

Deep reddish-purple in colour. Plum and blackberry notes, dried berries and liquorice. Rich black fruit, dried apricots and black cherry. A long finish with licorice berry and spicy cherry notes with sweet tannins and balanced acidity.

title: Joffre Gran Malbec Uco Valley 2021
bodyHtml: Well balanced. Dark fruits. Black berry and plum blended with leather and tobacco aromas. On the palate expect dark berries with dark chocolate. Smooth. Pair it with beef!

title: Zolo Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml:
Zolo Cabernet Sauvignon originates from Argentina, specifically from the Mendoza region and the high-altitude subregions of Luján de Cuyo and Maipú. The winery was founded by Patricia Ortiz, a prominent figure in South American viticulture who focuses on producing wines with elegance and a distinct terroir identity. The brand name is a playful tribute to her husband, who was often left 'solo zolo' while she worked at the estate. Under the technical guidance of renowned winemakers Fabián Valenzuela and Jean Claude Berrouet—the former winemaker of the legendary Petrus—the winery emphasizes sustainable practices and estate-grown fruit.

Wine Description

This red wine typically presents a deep red or ruby colour in the glass. The sensory profile is fruit-forward and expressive, featuring a nose of ripe red berries, plums, and cassis, often accented by a hint of black pepper and vanilla. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it is described as complex and balanced, delivering flavours of juicy berry fruit and cassis supported by sweet, smoothly rendered tannins. The finish is satisfying and persistent, showcasing subtle notes of oak and spice.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon.

  • ABV: Typically 13.8% to 13.9%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery is committed to sustainable and environmentally friendly practices, this specific wine is generally noted as sustainable rather than certified organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is crafted in a New World style that retains freshness; the Reserve tier undergoes approximately eight months of oak ageing to add complexity and polished tannins.

title: Tapiz Malbec 2025
bodyHtml: Tapiz produces its beautiful wines with vineyards located at different altitudes ranging from 920 to 1,400 meters above sea level and embraced by the impressive Andes mountain range. Due to its bioclimatic characteristics, this special geographical location makes their wines unique and different from the rest of the world.

title: Coyam Emiliana 2022
bodyHtml: Cherry-red in color with raspberry-colored borders and medium intensity. This year the wine shows a complex range of aromas including fruit like blueberry, black cherry, blackberry, and fig, to floral notes of lavender and violet, to hints of spice like sweet tobacco, cedar, and licorice. The palate is juicy and friendly with a creamy texture.

title: Errazuriz Carmenere Reserva 2019
bodyHtml: Deep ruby coloured with aromas of ripe blackberry and smoke. Full-bodied and round with smoky flavours of spicy blackberry.

title: Altas Cumbres Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: Lagarde is one of the oldest wineries in the Mendoza region, dating back to 1897, with Malbec vines over 100 years old, Today, the winery and estate are run by third generation Pescarmonas, sisters Sofia and Lucila Pescarmona. Under their direction, Lagarde creates exceptional terroir character wines that reflect a strong sustainable commitment to the land and its people. Case in point: this exceptional Cabernet Sauvignon, named Altas Cumbres for the high elevation peaks that surround the vineyards. Featuring red fruits, plums, bell pepper, graphite, and spicy notes, the wine slays on its own or alongside meats, farro salad and more.

title: Lagarde Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
Bodega Lagarde is located in the Mendoza region of Argentina, primarily within the prestigious Luján de Cuyo subregion. Founded in 1897, it is one of the oldest wineries in the area and has been owned by the Pescarmona family since 1969. The winery is now managed by the third generation, sisters Sofía and Lucila Pescarmona, who focus on a philosophy of sustainability and innovation while honoring the estate's centennial vines.

Wine Description

Lagarde Malbec exhibits an intense violet red colour with bright ruby tones. The aromatic profile is complex and fresh, featuring clear notes of ripe red fruits such as plums, blackberries, and raspberries, complemented by floral hints of violet and subtle spicy undertones of white pepper or cedar. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with a juicy entry and a smooth, well structured texture defined by silky tannins. It offers a balanced acidity that leads to a clean, persistent finish with notes of dark chocolate and fresh herbs. Composed of 100% Malbec, this wine is typically ready to enjoy upon release but possesses the structure to age gracefully for three to eight years depending on the specific tier.

title: Santa Julia Malbec Reserve 2023
bodyHtml: Deep red purple colour with aromas of plum, blackberry and cassis, with notes of honey, chocolate and blood orange. Dry, medium-plus bodied, rich and plush on the palate, with balanced tannin structure, flavours of ripe black plum with notes of black currant, honey, coffee and citrus.

title: Vina Cobos Felino Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Viña Cobos Felino Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is a red wine from Argentina, produced in the Mendoza region. The wine is made by Viña Cobos, a winery co-founded by American winemaker Paul Hobbs in 1999. Paul Hobbs is a pioneering winemaker who has been instrumental in elevating Malbec and Argentine wines onto the international stage. The winery's philosophy is rooted in meticulous vineyard management and respect for terroir, creating complex, elegant, and authentic wines. The 'Felino' line is intended to be an introduction to the authenticity and varietal purity of the Mendoza terroir.

Wine Description

The wine is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. It has a deep ruby red colour with black tones. The aromatic profile is intense, offering scents of red pepper and fresh red fruit. Further notes include tobacco, cocoa, and spices like nutmeg.

It is a medium bodied wine. The palate is juicy and concentrated, with supple red fruit flavours. It is round and smooth, with juicy, sinewy tannins that are plush and well balanced. Stylistically, it is a well balanced and impressively delicious wine from Paul Hobbs and his team. The grapes are sourced from both Luján de Cuyo and Valle de Uco, combining the warm and cool, lower and higher elevations of Mendoza. The wine is aged for nine months in American oak barrels, with roughly 10% new oak. The finish is smooth, fairly long, and resonates with fresh red fruit. The ABV is 14.5%. The optimal drinking window is now through 2034. The winery employs sustainable farming methods and uses organic principles in its viticulture.

Accolades

  • Jeb Dunnuck - 94 points

  • James Suckling - 92 points

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs very well with grilled steak or other beef dishes. Suggested pairings include lamb, and marinating a skirt steak in soy, garlic, aromatic herbs, and balsamic vinegar before grilling it with a fresh, garlicky chimichurri. It also complements aged cheeses.

title: Vina Cobos Felino Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
From Argentina’s renowned Mendoza region, this Malbec is crafted by Viña Cobos, a winery co-founded by Paul Hobbs together with Andrea Marchiori and Luis Barraud. Known for its focus on terroir expression, Viña Cobos sources grapes from high-altitude vineyards in Luján de Cuyo and the Uco Valley, producing wines of elegance and character.

Wine Description
Deep red-purple in the glass with violet reflections, Felino Malbec reveals expressive aromas of blackberry, blueberry, and plum, layered with hints of violet, spice, and graphite. The palate is medium-bodied, juicy, and fresh, with flavours of boysenberry, black cherry, and savoury spice.

Food Pairing
This Malbec pairs beautifully with grilled beef, roasted lamb, sausages, or hearty stews. Its fresh fruit character and savoury spice also complement bison burgers or charcuterie. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Cono Sur Chardonnay Organic 2025
bodyHtml:
Cono Sur Vineyards & Winery was founded in 1993, with the vision of producing expressive and innovative wines that convey the spirit of the New World. Right from the start, Cono Sur applied new ideas and technology to traditional winemaking methods. The main goal is to create wines, applying sustainable practices with a special care of the environment making each sip a masterpiece.

This Chardonnay, made from organically grown grapes, bears the spirit of the estate workers, pedalling their way to the vineyards each day. From the start this is an engaging wine, with its yellow colour and golden hues and refreshing nose and very citric with fruity aromas and light mineral notes. The palate is seductively complex, very fresh, with a well balanced acidity. This Chardonnay is undoubtedly super food friendly!

title: Cono Sur Organic Pinot Noir 2025
bodyHtml:
Cono Sur Pinot Noir Organic originates from Chile, with fruit primarily sourced from the Colchagua Valley within the larger Central Valley region. Founded in 1993, Cono Sur Vineyards & Winery was established with a vision to produce expressive and innovative wines that convey the spirit of the New World. The winery is a pioneer in South American sustainability, having launched its 'Pinot Noir project' in 1999 and achieving B Corp certification to reinforce its commitment to environmental and social responsibility.

Wine Description

This organic red wine is noted for its rich and deep bright red colour. The sensory profile features a complex nose dominated by sweet wild fruit aromas, including cherries and raspberries, enhanced by subtle toasty hints and earthy undertones. On the medium-bodied palate, it offers a silky texture and a well-balanced structure with soft tannins and bright red fruit flavours. The finish is smooth, fresh, and persistent, often revealing gentle notes of spice.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Pinot Noir.

  • ABV: Typically 13.5% to 14%.

  • Organic Status: Certified organic by ECOCERT, reflecting a non-interventionist approach that avoids artificial fertilisers.

  • Stylistic Notes: Approximately 70% of the wine is aged in barrels and 30% in stainless steel for eight months to achieve a balance of complexity and varietal purity.

title: Kaiken Malbec Ultra 2022
bodyHtml:
Kaiken Malbec Ultra originates from Argentina, specifically within the Mendoza region and the renowned Uco Valley. Founded in 2001 by Chilean winemaker Aurelio Montes, the winery takes its name from the 'Caiquén', a wild goose that flies across the Andes between Chile and Argentina, reflecting the founder's own journey to rediscover Mendoza's terroir. The estate follows a philosophy of innovation and sustainability, utilizing biodynamic practices to produce wines that genuinely express the high-altitude attributes of their specific vineyard sites.

Wine Description

This red wine presents an intense, bright red colour with deep violet and blue hues. The sensory profile is highly expressive, featuring an aromatic nose of blueberry, ripe plum, and blackberries, elegantly intertwined with floral notes of violet and lavender and spicy hints of black pepper, clove, and rosemary. On the full-bodied palate, it offers a smooth and silky entry with rounded, well-integrated tannins and a refreshing acidity. The structure is defined by a 'gravelly' texture and mineral undertones, leading to a long, persistent finish with subtle notes of licorice, dark chocolate, and black tea.

title: Kaiken Cabernet Sauvignon Ultra 2020
bodyHtml: Vibrant deep red colour typical of this variety, this wine displays great elegance and balance in the nose. Ripe fruit aromas evoke prunes, strawberries, and cherries intertwined with spicy notes, such as black pepper, tobacco, and sweet red pepper. The palate reveals an exceptionally powerful wine with characteristic round and opulent tannins from grapes grown in this unique terroir. A pleasant and persistent finish displays more red fruit notes, but this time, intertwined with vanilla and chocolate from oak aging.

title: Ben Marco Malbec 2019
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Introduction

BenMarco Malbec 2019 originates from the prestigious Uco Valley in Mendoza, Argentina, specifically from the Los Chacayes subregion. A dedicated project of Susana Balbo Wines, BenMarco is under the direction of Edgardo 'Edy' Del Popolo, one of Argentina’s most experienced viticulturists. The winery’s philosophy centres on minimal intervention and a 'vineyard-first' approach, aiming to provide the purest interpretation of the unique, high-altitude alluvial soils found in the region.

Wine Description

The 2019 BenMarco Malbec presents a dense purple-red colour and an expressive, floral bouquet. The nose is showy and aromatic, featuring fresh black fruits like blackberry and blueberry alongside notes of violets, black pepper, and aromatic herbs. On the palate, this medium-bodied wine is balanced and polished, showcasing a refined texture with firm, fine-grained tannins and a bright thread of acidity. Composed of 100% Malbec, the wine was aged for 11 months in second-use French oak barrels to preserve its fruit purity. The finish is long and elegant, accented by hints of graphite, minerals, and dark chocolate. Its optimal drinking window is estimated from 2022 through 2029.

Accolades

  • James Suckling – 93 points

  • Wine Advocate – 92 points

  • Tim Atkin – 92 points

title: Masi Passo Doble Tupungato 2020
bodyHtml: Medium deep red cherry colour with lifted aromas of wild honey, black plum jam and citrus. Dry, light to medium-bodied, rich, with sweet dried fruit flavours, medium balanced acidity and supporting tannins, long finish.

title: Kaiken Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: Kaiken Cabernet Sauvignon 2018 displays deep, ruby-red colour. The nose exhibits a great array of fruity notes, among which fresh red berries stand out, intertwined with aromas of eucalyptus and menthol. In the mouth, a genuine expression of the typical flavours of a Cabernet Sauvignon is perceived, combined with unusual and extraordinary softness.

title: Kaiken Malbec 2022
bodyHtml:
The Kaiken Malbec is a smooth, full-bodied red wine from the Andes mountains. The grapes come from vineyards in the Agrelo zone, 60 kilometres from the city of Mendoza and at an altitude of 950 metres above sea level.

The region’s climate is warmer than that of the Uco Valley, which allows Kaiken to obtain grapes with more fresh fruit aromas and flavours as well as very ripe, soft tannins. 

The wine was naturally fined and gently filtered before bottling. This Malbec is deep purple in colour. On the nose there are aromas of red fruits such as plums and blackberries, complemented by notes of chocolate and tobacco. On the palate this wine displays extraordinary balance, freshness and soft tannins.

title: Cono Sur Chardonnay 20 Barrels 2024
bodyHtml: Its most distinguishing feature is its well-achieved balance between citrus notes and complex minerality, both in nose and mouth. Quite an extraordinary wine, this Chardonnay has a bright, golden colour with fresh citrus aromas and a crisp, mineral palate. Refined and full of grace.

title: Cono Sur Cabernet Sauvignon - Carmenere - Syrah Organic 2023
bodyHtml: Made from organically grown grapes, this reddish-purple wine offers an expressive and very fruity nose, with notes of plums, berries and nutty hints. In the mouth, this juicy blend has a delightful concentration of red and black fruits, which are in complete harmony with soft tannins.

title: Casa Silva Carmenere Los Lingues
bodyHtml: Tasty and savoury with dark toasty fruit. Full-bodied and smooth. Concentrated, intense aromas and flavours of black fruit dipped in racy, dark spices. An expansive peacock spread of flavours on the palate of glorious, fleshy fruit. A natural wow wine!

title: Casa Silva Cabernet Sauvignon Los Lingues 2023
bodyHtml: Big and fleshy with plush plums and berries that elbow each other for your attention. Loaded with flavour and pleasure. Very smooth and finishing with cedar brush and tart woodland blackberries.

title: Casillero Del Diablo Carmenere 2023
bodyHtml: Expressive and fruity, featuring luscious berries and plum aromas, alongside hints of coffee and spice, with polished tannins that lead towards a long, satisfying finish. Medium-bodied with natural acidity, Carmenere pairs beautifully with game meats, roasted or grilled vegetables, and bean dishes.

title: Santa Rita Triple C 2022
bodyHtml:
This prestigious, icon-tier red blend originates from Chile, crafted in the renowned Maipo Valley subregion. Founded in 1880 by Domingo Fernández Concha, Viña Santa Rita is one of Chile's most historic and internationally celebrated wineries. The name Triple C represents the three foundational grape varieties that compose this super-premium blend: Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Carmenère. Sourced primarily from high-quality vineyards in the upper Maipo Valley (such as the famed Alto Jahuel estate), the vines sit at the foot of the Andes Mountains, where gravelly alluvial soils, intense high-altitude sunlight, and cool alpine winds create an ideal microclimate for producing structured, cellar-worthy Bordeaux-style reds.

Wine Description

In the glass, the 2022 Triple C presents a deep, dark ruby-violet color with intense depth. The complex and expressive nose opens with aromas of ripe black currant, dark plum, and cassis, seamlessly integrated with floral violet notes, crushed dried herbs, tobacco leaf, graphite, and subtle toasted oak nuances of dark chocolate and cedar. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied, rich, and sophisticated. Cabernet Franc provides a fragrant, fresh structural backbone; Cabernet Sauvignon supplies power, weight, and fine-grained tannins; and Carmenère imparts a lush, velvety mouthfeel alongside ripe black fruit and subtle herbal complexity. The hand-harvested grapes undergo meticulous sorting and small-batch temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks, followed by approximately 14 to 18 months of maturation in French oak barrels (a high percentage of which are new). The alcohol by volume sits at 14.5%.

Food Pairing

The muscular structure, rich fruit concentration, and savory herbal undertones of this Chilean blend make it an exceptional partner for hearty, high-end gastronomy. Excellent culinary matches include grilled prime ribeye steak, roasted rack of lamb with rosemary and garlic, slow-braised beef short ribs, and roasted duck breast with a dark fruit reduction. It also complements traditional South American grilled meats (asado), game meats like venison, wild mushroom ragù, and aged hard cheeses such as sharp Gouda, Manchego, or mature Cheddar.

Vintage Quality

The 2022 growing season in the Maipo Valley featured classic warm days and cool Andean nights, allowing late-ripening varieties to achieve complete phenolic maturity while retaining essential natural freshness and acidity. This diurnal temperature swing protected the aromatic freshness of the Cabernet Franc and preserved the velvety texture of the Carmenère. The 2022 Santa Rita Triple C is an age-worthy, deeply concentrated bottling that offers impressive generosity and polish upon release after decanting, while holding the structural balance to evolve gracefully in cellars for 10 to 15+ years.

title: Arboleda Chardonnay 2020
bodyHtml:
Arboleda Chardonnay originates from the Aconcagua Costa region of Chile, specifically from the Chilhué vineyard. Viña Arboleda was founded in 1999 by Eduardo Chadwick, a fifth-generation vintner of the Errázuriz family, with a vision to create sustainable, single-vineyard wines. The winery's philosophy focuses on delivering the purest expression of the Aconcagua Valley's unique terroirs, reflected in its name which means 'a grove of trees'.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents a bright straw yellow colour with subtle greenish flecks. The complex nose offers an array of citrus fruits and orange blossom, complemented by notes of white peach, tropical pineapple, and a touch of toasted almond and dried fruit. On the palate, the wine is juicy and medium to full bodied, featuring a creamy texture balanced by vibrant, crisp acidity and a distinct saline minerality. The finish is long and persistent, showing notes of pear and a hint of vanilla.

Food Pairing

This wine's structure and creamy texture make it an excellent companion for rich, buttery dishes such as pan seared halibut, lobster with drawn butter, or roast chicken with a savory cream sauce. It also pairs beautifully with vegetarian options like wild mushroom pasta or a creamy butternut squash risotto.

title: Arboleda Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Arboleda Cabernet Sauvignon is a red wine from the Aconcagua Valley region of Chile. Viña Arboleda was founded in 1999 by Eduardo Chadwick, a fifth-generation winemaker from the family behind Viña Errázuriz and the creator of iconic Chilean icon wines like Seña. The estate’s name, meaning 'grove of trees', is a tribute to the more than 1,450 hectares of native forest that surround and protect the biodiversity of its sustainably managed vineyards.

Wine Description

This wine displays a bright and deep ruby-red colour with violet shimmers. The sensory profile features a complex aromatic bouquet of cherries, plums, strawberries, and blackcurrant, accompanied by spicy balsamic notes and hints of tobacco, cloves, and nutmeg. On the palate, it is full-bodied and well-structured, offering flavours of red fruits, raspberries, and bitter chocolate with soft touches of vanilla and pastry. The structure is defined by firm yet polished, fine-grained tannins and a juicy, fresh acidity that contributes to an elegant texture and a long, persistent finish.

title: Los Cardos Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
Intense purplish red colour. Sweet, spicy and intense aromas, with notes of red fruits and herbs (such as Herbes de Provence). In the mouth, this wine is soft, velvety, fresh, and well-balanced.

Pair with Mendocinean empanadas stuffed with skirt steak and served with Criolla sauce. A classic dish of Argentine cuisine but with the variation of the skirt steak as its main ingredient.

title: Finca Los Primos Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
Located in San Rafael, Argentina's semi-arid Mendoza province, the family-owned winery has been producing high-quality wine for the past 90 years. The fourth-generation winery has long been known for its exceptional value and its special terroir and when you unpack the unique topography and winemaking conditions, it's easy to see why.

The result is a lively and aromatic wine with a depth of Malbec flavour that can compete with some of its more expensive Mendoza cousins. Heavily aromatic, Finca Los Primos Malbec has a nose of blackberry before popping with cherry and plum flavours on the first sip, giving way to a lightly herbaceous finish.

Pair with red meats, spicy food and some of your stinkier soft cheeses or just good company around the table at your next dinner party.

title: Dona Paula Malbec Seleccion de Bodega 2021
bodyHtml:
The Selección de Bodega Malbec is crafted from grapes grown in the Alluvia Vineyard, situated at 1,350 metres above sea level in Gualtallary. The vineyard's poor, well-drained soils, composed of alluvial rocks with calcium carbonate, sand, and chalk, contribute to the wine's distinctive character.

This Malbec displays a deep violet hue. On the nose, it offers complex aromas of berries, graphite, black cherries, and spices. The palate reveals great concentration, firm tannins, fresh acidity, and a long finish . Aged for 20 months in 50% new French oak barrels, it possesses a robust structure and is suitable for aging up to 15 years.

Food Pairing

Ideal with veal ribs flavoured with Malbec, accompanied by bacon, green beans, and Andean potatoes. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Dona Paula Malbec 'Estate' 2025
bodyHtml: Made in Mendoza! Intense violet colour. On the nose, aromas of black fruits, violets and spices. Mineral and graphite notes. Great balance and freshness in the mouth, with good concentration and medium structure. Soft tannins and persistent finish.

title: Manos Negras Malbec Stone Soil 2021
bodyHtml:
Sourced from the Altamira district of San Carlos county, located in the southern Uco Valley at an elevation of 4,000 feet. Altamira has Mendoza's most unique soil profile, with a patchwork of sandy, silty and stony soils all present in the same vineyard. The stony soils contain a high content of surface stones and round rocks that are literally painted white with calcium carbonate. These patches of stony soil are very low in organic material and very high in mineral content. Their poor profile naturally brings down yields for an exceptional concentration of aromas and flavours. Their rocky character imparts a stony texture to the Malbec wines. The Manos Negras Stone Soil Select Malbec is made entirely from select Malbec grapes from these patches of stone soils.

Ripe on the nose, deep and inviting. Silky texture with a racy flash of acidity on the finish. Excellent plum fruit, herbal hints and wonderful structure with fig flavours on the long finish.

title: La Posta Malbec Angel Paulucci 2024
bodyHtml:
Argentina’s Mendoza region, specifically Luján de Cuyo, is renowned for producing some of the country’s most expressive Malbecs. La Posta is a project created to highlight small, family-owned vineyards, showcasing the character of growers like Angel Paulucci, whose vines were planted in 1972. The winery philosophy is rooted in authenticity, letting each grower’s parcel reflect its unique terroir.

Wine Description
This Malbec displays a deep ruby colour in the glass. The nose opens with aromas of fresh raspberries, red cherries, and plums, layered with violet florals and subtle toasty oak. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, showing lively berry fruit with hints of vanilla, spice, and caramel from partial oak ageing. The tannins are firm yet approachable, lending structure without overwhelming. A balanced acidity keeps the wine vibrant, finishing with lingering notes of fruit and gentle oak spice.

Food Pairing
Perfect alongside grilled steaks or lamb, this Malbec also complements mushroom dishes and tomato-based pasta. Mild to medium cheeses make an excellent pairing as well.

title: Montes Syrah Alpha 2023
bodyHtml:
Montes Alpha Syrah originates from Chile, specifically from the Apalta and Marchigüe zones of the Colchagua Valley within the larger Rapel Valley region. Founded in 1988 by Aurelio Montes and Douglas Murray, Viña Montes was a pioneer in Chilean viticulture, famously introducing the Syrah variety to the country in 1993. The winery's philosophy emphasizes high quality through precision viticulture, such as the Water Saving Winegrowing system which reduces irrigation by 65% while concentrating fruit quality.

Wine Description

This red wine presents a deep ruby-red to violet colour in the glass. The sensory profile is intense and expressive, featuring a nose of ripe blackberries, figs, and crème de cassis, layered with notes of leather, dark chocolate, and subtle hints of graphite or black pepper. On the full-bodied palate, it is well-balanced and smooth, delivering flavours of dark cherries and plums complemented by sweet oak-driven aromas of vanilla, cinnamon, and dulce de leche. The finish is long, complex, and elegant, characterized by silky, fine-grained tannins.

title: Veramonte Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: Grapes are harvested at night in order to maintain fresh and bright acidity. The fruit goes straight to the press, where the juice sits for 24 hours, then it is racked and separated from its gross lees and fermented clean at low temperatures in stainless steel tanks, ensuring multilayers of aromas and flavours. Vibrant and aromatic, with citrus aromas of lime and tangerine, blended with subtle floral notes. Smooth and fresh, this Sauvignon Blanc has a great mouthfeel and a long finish.

title: Casillero Del Diablo Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml: Citrus fruit, pears, pears and some tropical fruits, gooseberries and subtle minerals. Very fresh, full bodied, long with a mineral and citric persistence.

title: Cono Sur Viognier Bicicleta Reserva 2024
bodyHtml: Tropical fruit aromas with melon, peach and orange blossom notes. Dry, medium bodied, with great acidity and flavours of grapefruit, peach, green apple and pineapple. Good length on the finish.

title: Bodega Piedra Negra Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: Clear straw colour with lifted, yellow berry and fruit, cantaloupe, citrus and spice aromas. Extra dry, medium body. Soft berry and melon flavour and medium finish.

title: Cono Sur Cabernet Sauvignon 20 Barrels 2019
bodyHtml: This wine has a beautiful, concentrated ruby red coloring and intense aromas of plum, cassis and blueberries, which combine gracefully with softer earthy traces and end with hints of mocha and smoke. A full, complex and intense palate with persistence and an elegant finish.

title: Cono Sur Pinot Noir 20 Barrels 2019
bodyHtml: An elegant and voluptuous Pinot Noir with a bright ruby red coloring. The nose presents amazing finesse and complexity, where notes of fresh cherry, strawberry, raspberry and plum, mingle with background hints of leather and smoke. Outstanding extraction and a deliciously long and soft finish. This sophisticated and complex wine is the result of New World fruit vinified according to traditional Burgundy methods.

title: Catena Alta 'Historic Rows' Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Catena Alta is an assemblage of historic rows within the Catena family state vineyards. The blend of these historic rows gives a highly aromatic and elegant wine that speaks for the terroir and the vines that have been tended by the four generations of the Catena Family. "Alta" means high in Spanish. This refers to the high-altitude vineyards from where the grapes are sourced and to the high-end wines produced with these special grapes.

This Chardonnay presents an intense greenish-yellow colour. The nose offers ripe white fruit aromas such as pears and peaches that are interwoven with delicate citrus and floral notes, such as Jasmine. The palate shows rich and concentrated ripe pear, apple and apricot flavours with a light note of minerality. The wine finishes long and complex with crisp, mineral acidity.

Food Pairing: Marinated chicken, seafood, or simply sipping!

title: Catena Malbec 2024
bodyHtml:
Catena Malbec originates from Argentina, specifically within the Mendoza region. Founded in 1902 by Italian immigrant Nicola Catena, Bodega Catena Zapata is Argentina's oldest winery still managed by its founding family, now in its fourth generation under Dr. Laura Catena. The winery's philosophy is rooted in pioneering high-altitude viticulture in the Andean foothills, a revolution spearheaded in the 1980s by Nicolás Catena Zapata to prove that Argentine wines could compete with the world's best.

Wine Description

This wine is a 'microclimate blend' sourced from four unique high-altitude estate vineyards—ranging from 920 to 1,450 metres above sea level—to achieve natural balance and complexity.

  • Colour: It typically presents a saturated dark violet colour with ruby or purple reflections.

  • Aroma: The nose is intense and layered, featuring ripe red and dark fruits (blueberries, cassis, and black plum) joined by delicate notes of violet, lavender, vanilla, and mocha.

  • Palate: It offers a rich, concentrated mouthfeel and a soft texture. Flavours include dark berries, chocolate, and roasted hazelnuts, balanced by bright acidity and flinty minerality.

  • Finish: The finish is persistent and 'palate-staining', dominated by sweet black and blue fruits with well-integrated, silky tannins.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Malbec.

  • ABV: Generally ranges between 13.5% and 14.0%.

  • Organic & Sustainable Status: The estate vineyards are Certified Sustainable, and the winery follows a philosophy where quality and sustainability are inextricably linked.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine undergoes extensive cold maceration for five days to extract aromas and is aged for 12 to 14 months in French oak barrels (approximately 35% new).

title: Alamos Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml: Alamos has more than 100 years of experience and is one of the biggest names in Mendoza. They specialize in winemaking at lofty Andean heights, and this Chardonnay is made up to 5,000 feet above sea level. Here, intense sunlight and cool evening temperatures transform into pristine flavours. Think tropical fruits, vanilla and sweet spices that are best with fish cakes.

title: Alamos Malbec 2025
bodyHtml:
This Malbec is produced in Argentina, specifically within the renowned Mendoza region. Bodega Alamos belongs to the historic Catena Zapata group, a family-owned operation often credited with leading the viticultural renaissance in Argentina. The winery focuses on capturing the purity of the Andes Mountains, sourcing fruit from high-altitude vineyards situated between 3,000 and 5,000 feet.

Wine Description

The Alamos Malbec presents a dark, blackish purple colour with distinct violet hues. The nose is highly aromatic, featuring layers of dark cherry, blackberry, and ripe plum intertwined with crushed violet, white pepper spice, and subtle vanilla. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied, offering remarkable concentration of black raspberry and currant flavours accented by hints of chocolate and sweet spices from oak aging. It is characterized by a supple, velvety mouthfeel and balanced, silky tannins that lead into a long, persistent finish.

Food Pairing

This Malbec pairs exceptionally well with lean red meats such as sirloin or hanger steak, as well as roasted pork and robust pasta dishes with strong sauces. It is also a striking match for pungent soft cheeses like blue cheese or gorgonzola, which highlight the wine’s fruit intensity.

title: Alamos Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml: Alamos Cabernet Sauvignon expresses the deep, rich dark berry fruit notes that are hallmarks of the variety, complemented nicely by slight herbal characteristics. Firm tannins and oak aging merge to add complex layers of vanilla, clove and black pepper to the wine.

title: Montes Sauvignon Blanc 2024
bodyHtml:
With the release of the first Montes Alpha wine back in 1988, Montes became one of the first premium wineries of Chile. Their premise, a clear belief that Chile had an untapped potential as a producer of quality wines, made them a benchmark for other wineries to follow. Its original four partners' total involvement and the continuous help of the angels that decorate their labels was key to their success.

Two decades later, Montes is the fifth most important winery of Chile where Aurelio Montes continues leading the winemaking area with the same passion as the first day. Hard work and total focus on quality has led Montes to be one of the most successful and respected quality-driven wineries in Chile as they continue pioneering and breaking new grounds in wine.

With a rich creaminess and juicy acidity, this is a Sauvignon Blanc that's very much focused on the fruit, and there's a very pronounced herbal side, especially on the palate. The finish has crisp acidity that invites another glass.

title: Montes Cabernet Sauvignon Classic Series 2023
bodyHtml:
With the release of the first Montes Alpha wine back in 1988, Montes became one of the first premium wineries of Chile. Their premise, a clear belief that Chile had an untapped potential as a producer of quality wines, made them a benchmark for other wineries to follow. Its original four partners' total involvement and the continuous help of the angels that decorate their labels was key to their success. Two decades later, Montes is the fifth most important winery of Chile where Aurelio Montes continues leading the winemaking area with the same passion as the first day. Hard work and total focus on quality has led Montes to be one of the most successful and respected quality-driven wineries in Chile as they continue pioneering and breaking new grounds in wine.

Winemaker Notes... Ruby-red in colour, with violet at the rim. The nose is generous; red and black fruit aromas are perfectly balanced with smooth notes of spice. Aromas are strawberry, cassis, nutmeg and cinnamon, with vanilla, and mocha from the wine’s time in French oak, which also lends a sensation of sweetness on the mid-palate. In the mouth it’s balanced, with smooth tannins and rich, fresh acidity that makes the wine juicy. The finish has medium fruit in line with the aromas perceived on the nose.  Highly recommended with braised beef with french fries, paella, and lasagna.  Blend: 85% Cabernet-Sauvignon, 15% Merlot

title: La Playa Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva 2020
bodyHtml:
La Playa wines have always been farmed sustainably. Our early motivation in using these green practices was easy: Sustainable grapes yield the cleanest and more pure varietals.

A deep elegant scarlet color.  This Cabernet Sauvignon has notes of ripe black currant and mocha, with structured tannins and a supple finish.

title: Carmen Carmenere Gran Reserve 2024
bodyHtml: This classic Chilean red wine is savoury, dark and complex with a chewy, full-bodied mid-palate. Layers of black fruit with a long finish. Superbly crafted for this price. Great structure and persistence of flavours on the finish.

title: Catena Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml:
Catena Chardonnay originates from Argentina, specifically within the Mendoza region. Founded in 1902 by Italian immigrant Nicola Catena, Bodega Catena Zapata is a pioneer in high-altitude viticulture and is currently managed by fourth-generation vintner Laura Catena. The winery’s philosophy focuses on single-varietal assemblages from various high-mountain estate vineyards, blending the unique strengths of different elevations—ranging from 950 to 1,450 metres—to achieve natural balance, concentration, and complexity.

Wine Description

This Chardonnay presents an intense greenish colour with yellow notes. The sensory profile is highly aromatic, featuring a nose of honey, white flowers, and tropical fruits like pineapple and banana, alongside notes of citrus, pear, and peach. On the medium-to-full-bodied palate, it is rich and expressive, delivering flavours of stone fruit, golden apple, and a delicate hint of vanilla and sweet spices. The wine is characterized by a creamy texture and fresh, crisp acidity, leading to a long and balanced finish with strong mineral nuances.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • ABV: Typically ranges from 13.3% to 13.9% depending on the vintage.

  • Organic Status: While the winery's vineyards are Certified Sustainable, this specific bottling is generally produced under sustainable practices rather than being certified organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: To preserve fruit purity and add complexity, the wine undergoes cold settling and is fermented with wild yeasts; it is aged for approximately 6 to 10 months in French oak barrels (ranging from first to third use), with a portion often remaining in stainless steel to maintain vibrancy.

title: Catena Cabernet Sauvignon 2023
bodyHtml:
From Argentina’s Mendoza region, the Catena Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 is crafted by Bodega Catena Zapata, a historic family-run winery established in 1902. The Catena family pioneered high-altitude viticulture in Argentina, mapping vineyard parcels in the Andes foothills to produce elegant, expressive wines that balance tradition with innovation.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep ruby colour with youthful vibrancy. On the nose, it opens with red berries, cassis, and subtle herbal notes, layered with hints of white pepper and savoury spice. The palate is medium-bodied and juicy, with well-structured tannins and flavours of ripe red fruit, tamarind, and mineral undertones. It finishes with a linear, stony length that reflects its high-altitude terroir .

Food Pairing

This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs beautifully with grilled steak, roast lamb, or gourmet burgers, where its firm tannins complement the richness of the meat. It also works well with hard cheeses and poultry dishes with herb-based sauces.

title: Casillero Del Diablo Merlot 2023
bodyHtml: Deep, ruby in colour this wine offers aromas and flavours of red berry, plum, and cedar. The palate is medium-bodied and smooth with similar and a soft, balanced finish.

title: Bodega Piedra Negra Malbec Alta Coleccion 2024
bodyHtml: Bright ruby colour. On the nose red summer fruit aromas dominate with a slight touch of black pepper. On the palate, there is an attractive concentration of ripe red fruits which gives volume to the wine. It has a good structure and the tannins are soft and smooth. Its finish is long with notes of coffee.

title: Luigi Bosca Pinot Noir 2024
bodyHtml:
As a tribute to the land and to those who work it, Luigi Bosca has worked for more than 110 years to understand the intention of the vine. The passion of four generations of the same family, shown in Bodega Luigi Bosca’s collection, reflects the result of an ambitious effort started many years ago: the wish to express the thorough version of the essence of Argentine wine.

Sourced from Bosca’s east-facing El Paraiso vineyard in Lujan de Cuyo- Maipo. Vines average 45 years and sit at an elevation of 780 meters. Soils here are well drained and shallow based on a mix of limestone and silt. Grapes are hand harvested and meticulously sorted and destemmed upon arrival at the winery. Fermentation occurs at cool temperatures in stainless steel tanks followed by 12 months of aging in new and second-use French oak. The wine is lightly filtered prior to bottling.

title: Luigi Bosca Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml: Deep ruby red colour, with aromas of ripe red fruit, spices and black pepper. The palate intensity is complemented by the softness and sweetness of tannins. Full-bodied and well structured. Pair with grilled or broiled red meat, deer, or hard cheese.

title: Carmen Sauvignon Blanc Gran Reserve 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Carmen Sauvignon Blanc Gran Reserve 2025 comes from the Casablanca Valley in Chile. Viña Carmen is Chile's first and oldest winery, established in 1850 by Christian Lanz, who named it in honour of his wife. The winemaking philosophy involves interpreting the character of places and a respectful, low-intervention management of the vineyard. The winery is recognized as a benchmark in Chilean winemaking, known for its extensive history and continuous pursuit of excellence.

Wine Description

This is a single varietal wine made from 100% Sauvignon Blanc. It is a lively and fruity white wine. On the palate, it is described as clean, crisp, and smooth with a refreshing and vibrant acidity. Its intense and lingering bouquet offers citrus and stone fruit flavours with notes of thyme, pink grapefruit, and passionfruit. Stylistic notes include a good structure, finesse, and complexity. It has a medium finish of herbs. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is approximately 13.00%. This wine is not specifically indicated as organic in the available information.

Accolades

Accolades for the Gran Reserva range's Sauvignon Blanc vintage 2024 include:

  • Descorchados - 92 points.

Food Pairing

Suggested food pairings are tailored to the wine's crispness and acidity:

  • Shellfish and oysters.

  • Dishes that are herbaceous, such as a salad with a citrus vinaigrette or herb-based dishes like asparagus risotto.

  • Goat cheese and soft cheeses like Brie or feta.

  • White fish served with a lemon-butter sauce.

Vintage Quality

The 2025 vintage in regions like Leyda Valley (which shares cool-climate characteristics with Casablanca Valley) was atypical, marked by variable weather. The season saw an increase in winter rainfall, which improved soil moisture. The harvest was generally later than the previous season. For high-end Sauvignon Blancs, the 2025 vintage is noted as exceptional, delivering wines that show fruit purity, pronounced aromatic intensity, and the characteristic vibrant, fresh acidity of the cool-climate coastal valleys.

title: Carmen Merlot Gran Reserva 2023
bodyHtml: Savoury, dark and complex with a chewy, full-bodied mid-palate. Layers of black fruit with a long finish. Superbly crafted for this price. Great structure and persistence of flavours on the finish.

title: Carmen Cabernet Sauvignon Premier Reserva 2024
bodyHtml: Leafy plum and blackberry aromas are fairly full but not agile. A ripe-feeling palate matches the wine's colour and nose, with some heaviness shrouding toasted black-plum flavours. A dash of spice protrudes from a basic finish.

title: Pascual Toso Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml: This fuller red carries a swath of green through its downy plum, blackberry and blackberry fruit. Roasted coffee, leather sticky tannins and a warn finish welcomes pairing with simple foods like burgers or meatballs. Ready to drink now.

title: Weinert Cavas De Weinert 2013
bodyHtml: Deep ruby tone with purple sparkles springs up its stable and vigorous structure. Its tannic richness guarantees its longevity, but discreet ripe fruit prevails. A balanced full-bodied wine that has reminiscent fragrances of oak on the long finish. A blend of Malbec and Merlot.

title: Montes Chardonnay Alpha 2020
bodyHtml: The intense, complex nose offers tropical fruit aromas such as pineapple, banana, and ripe mango, while pleasing notes of peaches and pears round out the fruity profile. The coastal climate is very much present in the subtle notes of grapefruit and white asparagus. Smooth attack on the palate with perfectly balanced acidity, resulting in a very fresh wine that also has generous volume. This Alpha Chardonnay ends with a long and elegant finish that invites another glass.

title: Cono Sur Cabernet Sauvignon Bicicleta Reserva 2023
bodyHtml: Cono Sur is a leader in sustainable wine production. Bicicleta Cabernet Sauvignon is deep ruby in the glass, with aromas of cassis, black cherry and raspberry. You will taste cassis, plum and ripe berry fruit. Barrel ageing adds the toasty and spicy notes of oak. Serve with grilled meats, pasta or a selection of cheeses.

title: Carmen Cabernet Sauvignon Gran Reserva 2023
