bodyHtml: Carmen Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon is a deep and intense ruby-red in color. The nose presents aromas of black currants, blackberries, and spice with smooth, elegant cedar notes. The palate is very rich and generous yet fresh and vibrant at the same time. The wine has abundant fruit and firm tannins that lend structure and depth.

title: Trapiche Malbec Reserve 2024
bodyHtml: Beautiful, intense red colour with violet hues. Sweet aromas of blackberries and plums. Elegant touch of smoke and vanilla. Velvety texture and a sweet, long aftertaste. Ideal to serve with cheeses, red meats, mushrooms, stew and with the typical Argentinian "asado".

title: Marques De Casa Concha Chardonnay 2022
bodyHtml: The color is a pale, glossy yellow, combining richness with elegance and vitality. Its aromas include ripe white fruit aromas such as pear, white flowers, toasted hazelnut, and mineral notes. Slightly thick with a silky texture and layers of ripe fig, pear, and mineral flavors. Finishes with a long, vibrant character.

title: Cono Sur Pinot Noir Bicicleta 2022
bodyHtml: This is a voluptuous Pinot Noir with rich fruit notes of cherry, raspberry, plum and strawberry, a red fruit party, enhanced by subtle smoked hints. In mouth sweet fruit notes stand out, and its fine tannins give it a great texture and a mouth-filling structure.

title: Trapiche Malbec Alaris 2023
bodyHtml:
A rich, red-colored wine with violet hues, reminiscent of plums and cherries. Round in the mouth with a touch of truffle and vanilla.

Alaris was born from the expression of young varietals. This wine does not know about schedules, rules, or stereotypes. It is joyous, laid-back, and made with the same freedom with which it is enjoyed. Its versatility makes it ideal to be paired with any daily event.

The ideal wine for grilled meat. It also pairs well with pasta, mild to spicy cuisine and semi-hard cheeses such as gouda, wdam, or gruyere.

title: Santa Carolina Sauvignon Blanc Reserve 2024
bodyHtml: Santa Carolina Reserva Sauvignon Blanc is a pale yellow color. Expressive nose of pink grapefruit and subtle hints of herbs and stones. The palate is juicy and fresh and exhibits nice balance between citrus fruit, peach, and passion fruit, as well as an intense mineral character. Its creamy texture makes it a superb pairing wine.

title: Marques De Casa Concha Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml: Deep red with lush cherry, black currant, and blackberry aromas with a touch of tar and smoke. The texture is smooth, almost silky and masks the firm tannic structure that lies below and only appears on the lingering finish.

title: Trapiche Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve 2024
bodyHtml: Dark garnet colour with aromas of plum, raspberry, blackberry with tobacco tones. Dry, medium to full bodied, with currant, plum and vanilla flavours. A round rich palate.

title: Montes Cabernet Sauvignon Alpha 2023
bodyHtml: With the first Montes Alpha wine released in 1988, Montes became one of the first premium wineries in Chile. Their premise, an apparent belief that Chile had an untapped potential as a producer of quality wines, made them a benchmark for other wineries to follow. Its original four partners' total involvement and the continuous help of the angels that decorate their labels were crucial to their success. Montes is the fifth most important winery in Chile, where Aurelio Montes continues leading the winemaking area with the same passion as the first day. Hard work and total focus on quality have made Montes one of the most successful and respected quality-driven wineries in Chile as they continue pioneering and breaking new ground in wine.

title: Santa Rita 120 Chardonnay Reserva Especial 2024
bodyHtml: A delicate yellow tint with somewhat green overtones characterizes this bright and vibrant young wine. It boasts exquisite tropical overtones with delicate undertones of maracuyá, guava, mango, and pineapple in its flavour and aroma. It has an exquisite, lingering persistence due to its lovely acidity. It has a pleasant warmth to it that goes well with a variety of dishes. Casseroles, salads, shellfish, fish, cheese, and white meats are all recommended.

title: Dona Paula Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml: Intense violet colour. In the nose, aromas of black fruits, violets and spices. Mineral and graphite notes. Great balance and freshness in the mouth, with good concentration and medium structure. Soft tannins and persistent finish.

title: Santa Carolina Chardonnay Reserva 2024
bodyHtml: On the nose, it presents a soft expression of toasted almonds, juicy citrus fruits and an attractive minerality. A slightly creamy texture in the mouth, with citrus flavors that are enriched with notes of pears and mangoes. Touches of tropical fruits and nuances of toasted hazelnuts persist on the finish.

title: Errazuriz Merlot Reserva 2024
bodyHtml:
Errazuriz Merlot Reserva is produced in Chile within the Aconcagua Valley. Founded in 1870 by Don Maximiano Errazuriz, the winery is built on a philosophy of 'from the best land, the best wine', a vision now carried forward by fifth-generation owner Eduardo Chadwick. The estate is recognized as a pioneer in the Aconcagua Valley, utilizing a Mediterranean climate and ocean breezes to craft wines that emphasize terroir and elegance.

Wine Description

This Merlot presents a brilliant ruby red colour with youthful highlights. The aromatic profile features fresh red fruits like cherries and plums, layered with herbal, balsamic, and subtle roasted pepper notes. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and soft, offering flavours of ripe berries, vanilla, and mocha, framed by smooth, well-integrated tannins and bright acidity.

Food Pairing

The soft texture and fruit-forward profile of this Merlot make it an ideal companion for grilled red meats, savory stews, and pork tenderloin with a fruit glaze. It also pairs exceptionally well with tomato-based pasta dishes, roasted vegetables, or medium-aged cheeses like Gouda and Cheddar.

title: Errazuriz Cabernet Sauvignon Max Reserve 2018
bodyHtml: Very attractive fleshy blackberry on the nose, which is fresh and enticing without any heavy oak present. Balanced and layered on the palate, with a full-bodied weight and richness, but again not ponderous. Long finish.

title: Errazuriz Estate Sauvignon Blanc 2023
bodyHtml:
This Sauvignon Blanc hails from Chile's Aconcagua Valley, a region renowned for its coastal vineyards influenced by Pacific breezes and morning fog. Viña Errázuriz, established in 1870 by Don Maximiano Errázuriz, remains family-owned and is celebrated for its commitment to sustainable viticulture and producing wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region.

Wine Description

The 2023 vintage presents a pale yellow hue with greenish reflections. On the nose, it offers vibrant aromas of lime, tangerine, and tropical fruits, complemented by subtle herbal notes. The palate is medium-bodied, showcasing flavours of mandarin, passion fruit, and fresh-cut grass, all balanced by a refreshing acidity and a persistent finish. Crafted from 100% Sauvignon Blanc grapes, this wine is fermented in stainless steel to preserve its crisp and lively character.

title: Santa Rita 120 Merlot 2023
bodyHtml:
According to legend, 120 patriots, exhausted after a long, hard battle during the fight for Chile's independence, reached the lands belonging to Santa Rita. On that fateful night in 1814, these forces of liberty found refuge in the estate cellars. Today, within these same cellars, this award-winning 120 wines are crafted to pay tribute to  their heroic character.

120 Merlot is smooth with aromas of strawberry, plum and vanilla. Flavors of red berry and notes of spicy oak build into a stylish finish.

title: Errazuriz Cabernet Sauvignon Estate Series 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Chile, specifically from selected vineyards in the Aconcagua and Maipo Valleys. Founded in 1870 by Don Maximiano Errázuriz, Viña Errázuriz is a historic family-owned estate currently led by fifth-generation president Eduardo Chadwick. The winery's philosophy emphasizes a deep respect for 'terroir', aiming to produce world-class wines that capture the essence of the grapes and the spirit of the Chilean soil.

Wine Description

Errazuriz Cabernet Sauvignon Estate Series displays a classic ruby red colour with violet hues. The nose reveals a vibrant profile of red fruits like sour cherries and strawberries, intermingled with spicy notes of black pepper, tobacco, and subtle hints of vanilla and cloves from oak ageing. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and juicy, featuring fresh acidity and round, friendly tannins. It is characterized by its excellent balance between fruit intensity and a certain degree of complexity, leading to a pleasant and lingering finish. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon typically has an ABV of 13.5% and is aged for approximately six months in French and American oak barrels. While the estate practices sustainable wine production and cultivates organically where possible, this specific series is not typically certified organic.

title: Santa Carolina Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva 2023
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine is from Chile, produced in the Rapel Valley within the Central Valley region. Santa Carolina is one of the oldest wineries in Chile, established in 1875 by Luis Pereira and named after his wife, Carolina Iniguez. The winery's heritage is preserved through its historical cellars in Santiago, which are a National Monument, while its winemaking philosophy focuses on the 'Living Heritage' project to explore and revive ancestral Chilean viticulture.

Wine Description

The Santa Carolina Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva displays a bright ruby red colour with violet hues. The aromatic profile is expressive, featuring scents of ripe red fruits, blackcurrants, and cherries alongside notes of vanilla, cedar, and tobacco from oak aging. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and well balanced, offering flavours of red berries, plums, and a touch of sweet spice. It is characterized by its smooth texture, ripe tannins, and a persistent finish with hints of dried herbs. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon has an ABV of 13.5% and is best enjoyed within 3 to 5 years of the vintage.

title: Caliterra Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva 2024
bodyHtml: Wiry plum and green-tobacco aromas transition to red-fruit scents as this breathes. A fresh, forward palate is medium in body, while a mix of spice, green herb, olive, plum and berry notes comprise the flavor package. A tight, juicy palate maintains the wine's core flavors.

title: Pascual Toso Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva 2020
bodyHtml: This wine shows complete harmony between colour, aroma, flavour and finish. Ripe, juicy raspberry fruit, with lovely boysenberry and plenty of vanilla, spice and chocolate, come through on both the nose and palate. Fairly round and inviting. Excellent to pair with pasta, either red or white meat and dishes with a creamy sauce.

title: Colome 'Amalaya' White 2024
bodyHtml:
Shiny gold, very limpid colour. Citrus notes of grapefruit and lemon skins dominate the nose. In mouth, delicate and silky yet fresh and crisp with good acidity and a distinctive mineral note.

Pairs with wine to begin cooking, as an aperitif, Chinese cuisine, soft cheeses, dried pasta with vegetables and tacos.

title: Zuccardi Q Tempranillo 2020
bodyHtml:
Zuccardi Q Tempranillo originates from Argentina, specifically within the Mendoza region. The Zuccardi family legacy began in 1963 when Alberto Zuccardi planted the first vines in Maipú; today, the third generation, led by agronomist Sebastián Zuccardi, continues to pioneer high-quality viticulture. The 'Q' in the name stands for 'Quality', indicating that the grapes are sourced from carefully selected parcels of old vines. The winery follows a philosophy where 'place is more important than the winemaking process', utilizing research and development to deeply understand the diverse soils and climates of their vineyard sites.

Wine Description

This red wine displays an intense ruby red colour. The sensory profile is rich and layered, featuring an aromatic nose of ripe fruits such as figs, cherries, and plums, which are well-integrated with spicy notes derived from oak ageing. On the palate, the wine is superbly structured with a soft entry, offering firm tannins and a balanced acidity alongside flavours of red berries, tobacco leaf, and hints of chocolate. It has a good volume and a persistent, long finish.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Tempranillo.

  • ABV: Typically between 13.5% and 14.5%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery emphasizes sustainability and natural development of the vines, this specific wine is generally classified as sustainably produced rather than certified organic.

  • Stylistic Notes: The grapes are sourced from old vines in Santa Rosa at an altitude of approximately 620 metres. The wine is matured for one year in a combination of French and American medium-toasted oak barrels.

title: Escorihuela Gascon Malbec 1884 Limited Production 2021
bodyHtml:
Bright and concentrated violet red with purplish tones. Aromas of ripe fruits such as plums, cherries and blueberries- Fresh violets and wild berries over earthy, smoked undertones and hints of spice. 

Wide and juicy palate. Sudden sweet and fruity savor that evolve to the midpalate dry, fresh and flavorful. Young, velvety tannins that allow a long and intense finish, fruity and fragrant.

title: Zorzal Malbec Climax 2011
bodyHtml:
Founded in 2007 by the Michelini brothers (Gerardo, Matias, and Juan Pablo) alongside Canadian partners, Zorzal Wines sits high in the sub-region of Gualtallary within Mendoza's Uco Valley. Situated at an extreme elevation of over 1,300 meters, Zorzal is widely recognized as a pioneer in shifting Argentina away from heavy, over-extracted Malbecs toward precise, mineral-driven, and high-acid Alpine styles.

Climax sits at the absolute pinnacle of Zorzal's hierarchy. Produced only in exceptional years through micro-vinifications, the Zorzal Malbec Climax 2011 represents an unrepeatable snapshot from the estate’s unique, chalk-rich, calcareous soils.

Wine Description

The Zorzal Malbec Climax 2011 opens with a deep, dark garnet color, reflecting its age and intensity. Unlike typical warm-climate Malbecs, the nose is dark, austere, and deeply complex, wafting aromas of blackberry, dark plum, graphite, and lavender, underscored by striking notes of dried herbs, eucalyptus, licorice, and tobacco leaf.

On the palate, the wine balances high-altitude freshness with muscular depth. The chalky, granite-rich terroir of Gualtallary imparts fine, textured tannins and a firm backbone, preventing any sense of jamminess. Crisp Alpine acidity cuts through dark berry fruit and spice, carrying into a long, mineral, and slightly saline finish.

Aged in neutral and seasoned French oak barrels to preserve varietal purity, the 2011 Climax is now fully mature and drinking beautifully.

title: Pascual Toso Estate Malbec 2023
bodyHtml:
When Pascual Toso set out towards Argentina from his home town, Canale D’Alba, in Italy, he could not have imagined that he would become the founder of a winery, which is today one of the oldest and most prestigious wineries in Argentina.

When he arrived in Argentina, he settled in Mendoza. As he had been closely involved in the development of his family wine business in Piedmont, he promptly saw the promising future for winemaking in the region and decided to use his expertise. Thus, in 1890, Pascual Toso established his first winery in San José, Guaymallén.

Tasting Notes ... This wine shows flavours of chocolate, floral note and plum with hints of smoke and spice. Medium-plus body with soft tannins and a good mouthfeel, it will complement leaner cuts of beef such as sirloin or filet as well as lamb.

title: Clos De Los Siete 2022
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from Argentina, produced in the Vista Flores district of the Uco Valley in Mendoza. Clos de los Siete is an ambitious project initiated in 1998 by the world renowned consultant enologist Michel Rolland. He partnered with several French families, owners of prestigious Bordeaux chateaux, to establish a unique vineyard at the foot of the Andes Mountains. The winemaking philosophy is centred on a 'blend of blends,' where select batches of grapes from four different estate wineries—including those owned by the Bonnie and Parent families—are meticulously combined by Rolland to create a single, consistent wine that expresses the exceptional terroir of the region.

Wine Description

The Clos de los Siete displays a deep ruby red colour with purple tints. The nose is expressive and complex, offering intense aromas of ripe blackberry, black plum, and dark cherry, layered with floral notes of violet, wild herbs, and spicy hints of vanilla and dark chocolate. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and well structured, featuring a fleshy, round texture with flavours of blackcurrant, minerals, and cocoa. It is characterized by its polished, silky tannins, vibrant acidity, and a long, elegant finish. The varietal composition is Malbec dominated, typically including around 55% to 59% Malbec, complemented by Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Petit Verdot, and Cabernet Franc. The ABV is approximately 14.5%.

title: Perez Cruz Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva 2023
bodyHtml: This popular Cab consistently over-delivers due to a fabulous price and excellent quality. Elegant and beaming with cassis, floral notes, berry melange, minty and spicy notes. A reliable partner for burgers, blackened chicken or herb-encrusted roasted lamb.

title: Decero Amano 2020
bodyHtml: Each year, the wine is masterfully blended using the most distinctive parcels from the Remolinos Vineyard. A blend of Malbec, Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot and Tannat, the wine is characterized by its warm aromas of leather, liquorice and baked black plum.

title: Decero Petit Verdot 2019
bodyHtml: The 2019 vintage was a second consecutive stellar vintage in Mendoza. It was characterized by a slightly cooler spring than usual with a welcome light rainfall level followed by a warm, dry summer with lower than average rainfall, leading to optimal health and maturation conditions at the Remolinos Vineyard. The wines of this vintage show excellent concentration of flavour, colour and aromas.

title: Decero Malbec Remolinos Vineyard 2021
bodyHtml: Decero Malbec continues in the style that characterizes the Remolinos Vineyard, displaying intense violet aromas over a core of red fruits with notes of cherries and raspberries. Slightly richer in body than the previous vintage yet still a very well-balanced wine with fresh acidity, it shows supple and elegant tannins that benefit from 14 months of maturation in French oak barrels.

title: Emiliana Adobe Chardonnay Reserva 2025
bodyHtml:
This organic white wine originates from the Aconcagua Valley region, specifically the Casablanca Valley subregion of Chile. Founded in 1986 by the Guilisasti family, Emiliana is a global pioneer in sustainable viticulture and stands as the world's largest organic and biodynamic winery. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on a deep respect for the environment and people, aiming to produce high-quality wines that reconnect consumers with nature through eco-balanced practices.

Wine Description

The Adobe Chardonnay Reserva presents a bright pale yellow colour. The nose is refreshing, featuring citrus aromas of grapefruit and lime that intermingle with subtle tropical notes of pineapple, mango, and a hint of herbs. On the palate, the wine is fresh and balanced with a velvety texture and a persistent finish. It is a medium-bodied, fruit-forward wine characterized by its purity and vibrant acidity.

title: Finca Los Primos Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml: The taste of Cabernet Sauvignon is always so regal, showing lots of currant berry fruit partnered with oak barrel complexities. Check out this top-selling Argentinian Cabernet and match it to beef, lamb or grilled veggies.

title: Bramare Malbec Valle de Uco 2023
bodyHtml: Deep violet purple. On the nose, aromas of black fruit, violets and white pepper. Fresh, with good structure, balanced acidity and fine-grained tannins.

title: Undurraga 'U' Cabernet Sauvignon 2024
bodyHtml: This Cabernet Sauvignon has an intense ruby red colour with well defined varietal fruit characters on the nose. The palate shows rich, ripe berry flavours in harmony with vanilla and light mild coffee notes from oak aging.

title: Arboleda Carmenere 2023
bodyHtml:
A fine and silky wine with great typicity. Year after year, this Carmenere presents elegant tannins in perfect balance with its fresh acidity. Its classic black fruits and balsamic notes come from exceptional fruits of high concentration from Las Vertientes Vineyard, where they undergo a long, slow ripening process. This complex wine achieves its excellent structure, rounded character and depth during its aging in French oak barrels.

A deep cherry-red colour with black tints, this Carmenere displays tremendous aromatic intensity and complexity, with standout notes of ripe black and red fruit such as figs, strawberries and cherries, along with balsamic tones and spices such as pepper, nutmeg and bay leaf, along with notes of smoke, bitter chocolate and mocha from the barrel aging.

title: Vina Cobos Felino Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Originating from Argentina in the South American region, specifically within the high-altitude Valle de Uco appellation in Mendoza, Viña Cobos 'Felino' Chardonnay represents an aromatic, precise, and fresh expression of New World Chardonnay crafted with European restraint. Founded in 1999 by visionary American winemaker Paul Hobbs alongside Argentine partners, Viña Cobos is celebrated for elevating Mendoza terroirs to global acclaim through meticulous vineyard management and non-interventionalist winemaking. Sourced from select high-elevation vineyards situated between 990 and 1,200 metres above sea level on gravelly, limestone-rich alluvial soils, the winemaking philosophy combines hand harvesting, cold whole-cluster pressing, native yeast fermentation, and partial barrel aging in French oak (approximately 15% to 20% new) alongside stainless steel tanks. The result is a vibrant Chardonnay that highlights pure white stone fruit, bright citrus tension, and delicate mineral energy.

Wine Description

The wine presents a brilliant, clear straw yellow colour with luminous pale green reflections along the rim. An expressive, highly fragrant bouquet opens with inviting aromas of green apple, white peach, fresh pear, and lemon curd, interwoven with subtle notes of jasmine, white flowers, crushed limestone, brioche, and delicate toasted oak spice. On the palate, it is medium bodied, crisp, and beautifully balanced, delivering concentrated flavours of crisp orchard fruit, citrus zest, and tropical mango, all anchored by a bright, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Framed by a satiny texture derived from gentle lees stirring and a focused mid-palate structure, it concludes with a clean, persistent finish marked by lingering white fruit, citrus peel, and a refreshing mineral grip. Composed of 100% Chardonnay, it effortlessly marries Mendoza's high-altitude sunshine and fruit purity with Paul Hobbs' signature precision, balance, and elegance.

title: Zorzal Sauvignon Blanc Terroir Unico 2023
bodyHtml:
This Sauvignon Blanc is born from the mixture of three different vineyards implanted in Gualtallary, with different soils and heights, which are around 1,300 to 1,600 meters above sea level and combine sand, stones and calcium carbonate. To make it, 5 harvest stages are carried out, from veraison to maturity, achieving the right balance in acidity and volume in the mouth. Some crops are fermented separately in different stainless steel vessels and then the cut is made.

At sight it appears delicate and bright, with steely green tones. On the nose it is complex and of great refreshing intensity, mineral, with notes of wet stones, herbs and rue. In the mouth it is intense and with good nerve. Its natural acidity makes it a very fresh wine with a very long finish.

title: Adobe Emiliana Reserva Syrah
bodyHtml: Intense ruby-red in color, with aromas of blackcurrant, fresh cherries, and notes of smoke and spices, especially black pepper. On the palate, it presents good volume, soft texture and mouth-filling tannins. A complex wine that is easy to drink with a long and pleasing finish.

title: Ernie Els Red Blend Big Easy 2022
bodyHtml: Purple in colour. Aromas of black fruits and spice. The shiraz offers complex notes of rosemary and cured meat whilst the Cabernet Sauvignon adds a beguiling structure and sweet cherry fruit core. A spicy edge along with a fragrant, almost honeycomb-like finish.

title: The Grinder Pinotage 2024
bodyHtml:
The Grinder Pinotage originates from South Africa's Western Cape, specifically sourced from dryland bush vines in the Swartland and Voor Paardeberg subregions. The winery is part of the Grape Grinder project, which focuses on creating contemporary, varietal-specific wines that highlight South Africa's unique terroir while maintaining an accessible, modern winemaking philosophy. This specific label is celebrated for its distinctive approach to Pinotage, aiming to showcase the grape's capability for rich, "coffee-style" profiles through careful oak integration.

Wine Description

This wine displays a deep ruby brick colour in the glass. The nose is sumptuously rich, featuring upfront aromas of mocha, roasted coffee beans, and leather, complemented by notes of prune, black cherry, and spice. On the palate, it is medium to full bodied and extra dry, offering a lush and complex profile of wild berries, candied cherries, and dark chocolate. The structure is defined by silky tannins and a refreshing acidity that balances the intense mocha characteristics, leading to a generous and long finish.

Food Pairing

The smoky and robust profile of this Pinotage makes it a natural companion for coffee-rubbed ribs, grilled portobello burgers, or barbequed meats. Its spicy undertones also allow it to pair effectively with flavorful dishes such as spicy Indian curries or pan-fried fillet with a pepper crust.

title: Bellingham Bernard Series Pinotage 2023
bodyHtml:
This premium Pinotage originates from the Coastal Region of South Africa, specifically sourced from unirrigated bush vines in Stellenbosch (66%) and Darling (34%). The Bellingham story began in 1693, but it was the visionary "maverick" Bernard Podlashuk and his wife Fredagh who pioneered the estate's modern renaissance after purchasing the farm in 1943. Today, the winery remains a steward of innovation, focusing on minimal intervention to produce contemporary, structured wines that offer a clear expression of their unique terroir.

Wine Description

The wine presents a deep ruby colour and an elegant sensory profile that highlights the red fruit character of its parent varieties, Pinot Noir and Cinsault. The nose is layered with aromas of bright cherry, plum, and raspberry, complemented by subtle notes of dark chocolate, spice, and an earthy minerality. On the palate, the wine offers a perfect balance of richness and vibrancy, featuring flavours of mulberry and black cherry supported by fine, silky tannins and well-integrated oak.

title: Two Oceans Pinot Grigio 2024
bodyHtml: Brilliant with green flecks. Upfront fruit flavours including dried peach and apricot as well as a hint of lychee. A crisp wine with a touch of fruit and a fresh, lingering finish. An ideal sipping wine for a warm day, also excellent served with light salads and cold meats.

title: Rust En Vrede Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
bodyHtml:
Rust en Vrede, founded in 1694, is proud to be a part of a three-hundred-year-old wine tradition. The Engelbrecht family has focused on the production of red wine exclusively since 1977, with an emphasis on Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Merlot. Rust en Vrede has worked hard to establish itself as one of South Africa's premier red wine estates, producing full-bodied, nuanced wines that represent the terroir's individuality.

Opaque in colour with prominent aromas of cassis, blackberry, bramble and mulberry. The dark fruit is layered with savoury notes of cured meat and dried herbs. Rich fruit follows on the palate, sustained by fresh acidity and fine, mouth-coating tannins. Flavours of sandalwood, allspice, worn leather and pencil shavings add complexity and depth to this classically styled Stellenbosch Cabernet Sauvignon.

title: Ernie Els Proprietor's Blend 2018
bodyHtml: The Proprietor's Blend is once again impressive and serious in 2016. Medium to full-bodied, it is strewn with black fruits, exotic spice and shards of dark chocolate. Sweet, spicy oak melts into a dense, powerfully-fruited and structured core. The majority Cabernet Sauvignon gives a cassis purity and salty edge, while the Shiraz component adds a meaty, savoury and spicy edge. The blend is rounded off by the remaining Bordeaux cultivars in a complexity explosion from start to finish. It is exquisitely textured and finely tuned. The 2016 will open ip over the next 5 years and age for a decade or more.

title: Boekenhoutskloof The Chocolate Block 2023
bodyHtml:
The Chocolate Block is a renowned red blend from South Africa, specifically sourced from the Swartland region. Established in 1776, Boekenhoutskloof came under its current ownership in 1993, at which point a significant vineyard restoration and cellar revamp began. The winery's philosophy, led by winemaker Marc Kent, emphasizes a sustainable approach to viticulture and a commitment to expressing the purity and elegance of Swartland fruit.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a rich and intense aromatic profile featuring blackberry, mulberry, and pomegranate, accented by notes of black olive, tea leaf, and violet. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied with a juicy, vibrant entry showing flavours of red liquorice, bramble, and exotic spices like coriander seed and white pepper. The structure is defined by svelte, velvety tannins and a lively acidity that leads to a long, pure, and dry finish.

Food Pairing

The wine's bold fruit character and spicy complexity make it an ideal companion for grilled lamb, beef steaks with mushroom sauce, or rich stews like Hungarian goulash. It also pairs exceptionally well with hard cheeses such as aged cheddar or gouda.

title: Boekenhoutskloof The Wolftrap Red Blend 2024
bodyHtml: The Wolftrap Red from Boekenhoutskloof is an easy drinking red blend at a very pocket friendly price. A blend of Shiraz, with added Mourvedre and Viognier, give this wine a concentrated red colour with an edge of purple. The nose is delightfully fruity with aromas of black fruits and black and red berries. The palate is smooth with further fruitiness present, expressed as cherries and wild strawberries.

title: Nederburg The Winemasters Shiraz 2019
bodyHtml: Packed with plum, black cherry and a touch of leather. Dried herbs and fynbos follow through to a velvety mouthfeel with a modest tannin grip. Elegantly structured andrewardingly long.

title: Two Oceans Shiraz 2024
bodyHtml:
At the tip of Africa where two oceans collide, extraordinary grape growing conditions exist. Under sunny skies grapes soak up the summer heat and then the fresh ocean breeze cools them. This ripens and sweetens the grapes, and inspires Two Oceans to craft exceptional wines. Whether along the coast or further inland, the presence of the oceans is never far away. Cooling sea breezes and mists can lower temperatures during the lead-up to the harvest , slowing down ripening. Grapes aren’t hurried but develop in their own time with flavours that are balanced, intense and plentiful.

Bright and vibrant red, Two Oceans Shiraz has complex aromas of red berries with cloves and spice, hints of white pepper and a subtle vanilla background as a result of careful oaking. Juicy and soft on the palate with red berry fruit flavours and spicy, peppery nuances. The tannins are soft and mouth-filling with a lingering spicy finish. Excellent served with red meat, game and pasta dishes.

title: Spier Chenin Blanc 2025
bodyHtml: This wonderful Chenin Blanc is both crisp and fruity with green guava, pear, apple and hints of litchi on the nose. A well-balanced palate and with a long finish.

title: Goats Do Roam Red Blend 2022
bodyHtml:
Respected South African winery Fairview owner/vintner Charles Back has built a single red blend named Goats do Roam into a full-fledged wine company offering a range of top-quality, blended wines widely available throughout the wine-drinking world. Fruit for the wines is sourced from vineyards in the Paarl, Malmesbury and Stellenbosch areas, where Back owns farms or buys fruit from selected wine growers. Regardless of their origins, grapes are selected based on inherent fruit quality and flavour characteristics required for each respective blend in the range.

Goats Do Roam is a red blend which shows red berries, plums and mixed baking spice on the nose, while the youthful palate is rich with generous berry fruit and spice, balanced with integrated oak nuances. The palate is smooth with firm tannin and a long fresh finish.

title: Boschendal Chardonnay 2024
bodyHtml:
Boschendal, whose name means 'bush and dale' in Dutch, is one of South Africa's oldest wine estates, nestled in the picturesque valleys between Franschhoek and Stellenbosch in the Western Cape. With a winemaking tradition spanning over 340 years, Boschendal’s philosophy is to balance tradition and experience with contemporary innovation to produce classic wines that express a 'measured modern new world attitude'.

Wine Description

This is a striking wine that over-delivers at this price. It's bold and impressive, with upfront nutty, citrus and peppery fruit, and remains buttery and complex through to the finish. It will be great with grilled or roasted chicken.

title: Porcupine Ridge Syrah 2023
bodyHtml:
Porcupine Ridge is a range of delicious, everyday wines and is a firm favourite on tables throughout the world, offering great value and superb drinking. It is proudly named after the Crested Porcupine, a most unique and fascinating inhabitant of the farm. Marc Kent is the owner, chief winemaker, and driving force behind the Porcupine Ridge label. A maverick spirit, Marc is unafraid to experiment with the unconventional, but his principal commitment is to quality on every level and in every detail.

The wine is vivid purple on appearance, and the nose shows a classic abundance of violets and spice. Intense aromas of blackberries, black cherry, ripe plums, and brambles create an intriguing nose. The dark berry fruit of the nose follows through onto the mid-palate, with notes of black pepper, cloves, black cardamom, and sweet tobacco. The wine is balanced and focused, elegant yet juicy, with grippy tannins and integrated acidity.

title: Robertson Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml: This full-bodied wine shows freshly crushed black pepper aromas with hints of cinnamon and cloves on the nose with lots of brambly red berry fruit, rich mulberry and well integrated vanilla tones. Enjoy now with roast beef, stews, lamb, venison, pasta and steak.

title: Robertson Sauvignon Blanc 2021
bodyHtml: Always delicious when it is fresh, youthful and inviting. The wine is a full-bodied wine with powerful varietal flavours of passion fruit, green apple and freshly cut grass. Good structure with lovely balancing acidity. Enjoy with seafood, smoked salmon, roast chicken or pork.

title: Two Oceans Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
This popular white wine hails from South Africa, with fruit primarily sourced from the Western Cape province. The brand takes its name from the Indian and Atlantic oceans that converge at the Cape, creating a temperate climate cooled by daytime maritime breezes that allow grapes to ripen slowly. All vineyards supplying Two Oceans subscribe to the progressive Integrated Production of Wine (IPW) system, a sustainability initiative focused on environmentally sound farming and cellar practices.

Wine Description

Two Oceans Sauvignon Blanc presents a pale straw colour and is celebrated for its elegant and crisp character. The sensory profile features a vibrant bouquet of fresh citrus, gooseberry, and stony minerals, complemented by a hint of green fig and grassiness. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and refreshing, showcasing ripe tropical fruit flavours like passion fruit, grapefruit, and lemon.

title: Boekenhoutskloof The Wolftrap White 2022
bodyHtml: Aromas and flavours of fruit blossom, dried fruit and spice. It has a rich, creamy texture with some minerality and elegant oak nuances. It is balanced by natural acidity and concentrated white fruit flavours that linger on the palate.

title: KWV The Vinecrafter Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
bodyHtml: File this vino under best-kept wine secrets. Made by KWV, one of South Africa's oldest wineries, this cabernet sauvignon delivers aromas of cassis, floral notes, cedar, bell pepper and mint. Flavours of cassis, cedar and bell pepper meet the soft, smooth finish with a hint of spice. Enjoy with beef short ribs or lamb chops.

title: KWV Roodeberg Red Blend 2020
bodyHtml: This famous red blend shows aromatic layers of fresh red fruit, cassis, and dark fruit with an undertone of sweet spices and dark chocolate. The palate is elegant and soft with cedary oak nuances and dark plums end off with a vanilla finish and elegant silky tannins.

title: Frescobaldi Nipozzano Chianti Riserva 2020 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
The emblematic wine of Castello Nipozzano, the historic Frescobaldi estate located a few miles northeast of Florence, Nipozzano Riserva is symbolic of the Tuscan wine making tradition and the continuing link with the terroir.

Deep red with garnet colour. Floral aromas of red plum and berries, blood orange fruit with cedar notes. Extra dry, medium to full-bodied, with balanced fruit flavours, red fruit and citrus with a touch of spice and leather. Balanced with a long finish.

When you think of pairing Chianti with food, most people think of pasta with a red sauce but there is so much more that you can pair with Chianti. It’s a great compliment to strong tasting poultry dishes, spiced lamb, or even beef, as long as it's not overly fatty. If you are looking for a wine with pizza, Chianti is your choice.

title: La Spinetta Langhe Nebbiolo 2024 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
La Spinetta Langhe Nebbiolo hails from the Piedmont region of Italy, specifically sourced from the prestigious subregion of Neive. Founded in 1977 by the Rivetti family, the winery is currently led by owner and winemaker Giorgio Rivetti, who has become a prominent force in Piedmontese winemaking. Rivetti's philosophy centers on the belief that 'an exceptional grape' is the only secret to great wine, leading the estate to utilize organic farming and focus on indigenous varieties to produce expressive, fruit forward wines that remain approachable upon release.

Wine Description

This 100% Nebbiolo presents a bright ruby red colour and opens with a sophisticated sensory profile. The aroma is defined by a beautiful delineation of dried rose petals, violets, and fresh berries, including wild strawberries and blueberries, accented by savory hints of menthol, licorice, and graphite. On the palate, the wine is balanced and powerful, revealing a medium body with flavors of red cherry, plum, and tobacco leaf. It is characterized by a fresh spine of acidity and smooth, velvety tannins that lead into a complex and persistent finish.

title: Masi Campofiorin 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Italy, specifically from the stream-filled valleys of the Veronese hills in the Veneto region, produced under the Rosso del Veronese I.G.T. appellation. Founded in 1772 by the Boscaini family, Masi Agricola is a historic estate renowned for its mastery of the ancient Venetian appassimento (grape drying) technique. Masi created Campofiorin in 1964, pioneering a new category of "Supervenetian" wines that bridge the gap between the simple approachability of a Valpolicella and the complex intensity of an Amarone.

Wine Description

Masi Campofiorin displays an intense ruby red colour. The nose is rich and intriguing, offering aromas of ripe cherries, plums, and sweet spices such as black pepper and tobacco. On the palate, the wine is medium to full-bodied and robust yet harmonious, featuring intense flavours of berry fruit and dried figs balanced by a delicate acidity. It is characterized by its smooth, velvety texture and firm but soft tannins that lead to a long finish with notes of dark chocolate. This blend is composed of approximately 70% Corvina, 25% Rondinella, and 5% Molinara grapes. It typically features an ABV of 13% to 13.5% and is produced using a double fermentation method where fresh wine is refermented with 25% to 30% whole, semi-dried grapes. The wine is matured for a minimum of 18 months in wood. While Masi utilizes sustainable practices and manages several organic estates, this specific wine is not generally certified organic.

title: Duckhorn Merlot 2022 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
This luxurious and benchmark-setting red wine originates from the United States, specifically from the premier Napa Valley region in California. Founded in 1976 by Dan and Margaret Duckhorn, Duckhorn Vineyards is widely credited with elevating Merlot from a mere blending grape to a world-class standalone varietal in North America. The winery's philosophy is rooted in meticulous vineyard sourcing across the valley’s diverse microclimates, allowing winemaker Renée Ary to craft a "wonderfully complex composition" that captures a balanced, classic Napa style.

Wine Description

Duckhorn Merlot presents a deep ruby colour with an inviting and sophisticated profile. The nose offers luxurious aromas of crushed black cherries, plums, and raspberries, layered with undertones of cedar, sweet tobacco, and orange peel. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and "silky," showcasing flavours of ripe plum jam, chocolate, and blueberry underscored by baking spices like clove and a hint of pencil lead. It is characterized by fine-grained, firm tannins and a balanced acidity that provides a long, elegant finish. This blend typically includes small percentages of Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc to enhance structure, reaching an ABV of 14.5%. While the estate is a leader in sustainability and utilizes organic fertilizers, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

title: Zenato Amarone 2020 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Zenato is a family-owned estate founded in 1960 by Sergio Zenato, pairing modern winemaking with a devotion to local grapes. The winery operates on 95 hectares split between Lugana and Valpolicella Classica, with the latter's Costalunga hills providing well-drained marl soils that give the family’s red wines their characteristic depth.

Wine Description

In the glass, the wine presents an intense ruby red colour, which can deepen to a garnet hue with age. Intoxicating aromas of dried black cherries, cassis, truffles, and chocolate fudge leap out, complemented by bay leaf, dried prunes, blackberry jam, leather, and a hint of sweet spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied, rich, and plush-textured. You'll find concentrated dark fruit, mocha, chocolate, liquorice, and savoury spice notes. It boasts a silky, luscious, and complex feel.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include osso bucco, wild boar ravioli, or braised beef short ribs.

title: Duckhorn Sauvignon Blanc 2024 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Enticing aromas of grapefruit, melon, and lime leap from the glass, followed by tropical notes of lychee, pineapple, and passionfruit. On the palate, this Sauvignon Blanc is juicy and bright, with silky layers of fruit balanced by lovely natural acidity and a vibrant streak of minerality. Hints of zesty citrus and subtle baking spices linger throughout a long, focused finish.

title: Penfolds Chardonnay Koonunga 2024 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: A wine that presents itself on the palate with fresh, creamy and well-balanced fruity notes of melon and baked apples sprinkled with cinnamon. A fruity wine has a distinctive style with distinctive primary fruit notes, sustained intensity and moderate tone of the wood.

title: Penfolds Shiraz - Cabernet Sauvignon Koonunga Hill 2024 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Penfolds Shiraz Cabernet Sauvignon Koonunga Hill originates from South Australia, with fruit sourced from premium vineyards across the Barossa Valley, McLaren Vale, and Coonawarra. Founded in 1844, Penfolds is Australia's most storied winery, renowned for its pioneering winemaking and global prestige.

Wine Description

This vibrant plum coloured wine offers a perfumed nose of white pepper, sumac spice, and pomegranate molasses, layered with blackcurrant and a mineral flint note. On the palate, it is full bodied and generous, featuring flavours of dark berries, plum sauce, and pepper crusted pastrami, complemented by green olives and black bean beef. The structure is defined by fine, focused tannins and a succulent acidity that provides balance and poise through to a smooth, lingering finish.

title: La Crema Chardonnay Sonoma 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: This wine opens with layered aromas of fresh Meyer lemon, shortbread and ripe pear. On the palate are flavours of baked, locally grown, Gravenstein apple framed by hints of sweet spice and white peach. The end result is a broad, juicy, and beautifully balanced mouthfeel.

title: La Crema Pinot Noir Sonoma Coast 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Cherry pie, cocoa, and black tea aromas. Pomegranate, plum and orange zest flavours. All in all a broad, concentrated and lingering wine.

title: Schug Pinot Noir Carneros 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Schug Pinot Noir Carneros originates from the renowned Carneros region of California, a premier subregion spanning both Napa and Sonoma counties. Schug Carneros Estate Winery was founded in 1980 by Walter Schug, the pioneering founding winemaker of Joseph Phelps who helped establish the Carneros AVA in 1983. Today, the family legacy is carried forward by Walter’s children and German American winemaker Johannes Scheid, who maintains a winemaking philosophy focused on European-styled elegance and low-intervention techniques.

Wine Description

This vintage presents a bright ruby red hue and a complex sensory profile that balances ripe fruit with savory depth. The nose is dramatic and earthy, offering aromas of tilled earth, mineral tones, black tea, and wildflowers, alongside notes of cranberry cocktail and cinnamon. On the palate, the wine is medium bodied and lush, featuring juicy layers of black cherry, plum, raspberry, and forest floor. A refreshing spine of ripe acidity and fine, silky tannins provide an elegant structure that leads into a long, flavorful finish marked by hints of spice and new leather.

title: Starmont Chardonnay 2018 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Both barrel and stainless-steel fermented, this bright, balanced white wine shows a juicy core of pear and apple. Lively and weighty, it has substance and style within vibrant acidity and earthy stone.

title: Kettle Valley Chardonnay 2021 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: This Chardonnay has a wonderful mouth-filling quality and is perfectly balanced with a buttery texture and fresh acidity. For the price point of this wine, it should be a go-to for a very well made Chardonnay from the Valley.

title: Masi Amarone Costasera 2017 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Deep purple ruby colour with rich, ripe, dark fruit aromas and flavours with hints of liquorice, toast and chocolate. Full-bodied and smooth with a firm, long finish.

title: Wolf Blass Cabernet Sauvignon Yellow Label 2022 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Australia, specifically from the South Australia region. Founded in 1966 by Wolfgang Blass in the Barossa Valley, Wolf Blass has grown from a small operation into one of the largest and most awarded wineries in Australia. The winery's philosophy is centred on the art of blending premium fruit from multiple South Australian regions to ensure consistency, quality, and approachable elegance. Today, the estate is owned by the Treasury Wine Estates conglomerate.

Wine Description

Wolf Blass Cabernet Sauvignon Yellow Label displays a deep crimson or garnet colour with purple hues. The nose is aromatic and lifted, offering scents of dark plum, blackberry, and cassis fruit accented by varietal leafiness and subtle hints of cedar, vanilla, and spice. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and smooth, delivering rich flavours of blackcurrant and dark plum integrated with nuances of chocolate, tobacco, and savoury oak. It is characterized by its generous structure, fine tannins, and a long, textured finish. This 100% Cabernet Sauvignon typically features an ABV of 13.5% to 14.5% and has a very low sugar content of approximately 3 g/L.

title: Kendall Jackson Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Deep ruby-purple, it opens with cassis, grilled black plum, blueberries, vanilla bean and pie spices with red fruit sparks. Medium to full-bodied, it offers great flavour intensity, a grainy frame and juicy acidity to lift the long finish. This is approachable right out of the gate and great value.

title: Kendall Jackson Chardonnay Vintner's Reserve 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
America's #1 selling Chardonnay for 30 years and counting! It's no wonder Vintner's Reserve Chardonnay is our most popular release.

Handcrafted in small vineyard lots throughout the entire winemaking process, our grapes are from California’s cool, coastal growing regions.

Vintner's Reserve Chardonnay is fruit-forward, divinely complex, approachable and exceptionally food-friendly.

title: J Lohr Chardonnay Riverstone 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: The J. Lohr Riverstone Chardonnay exhibits youthful hues of light straw. The enticing aromas are reminiscent of ripe orange, fresh nectarine, and hazelnut, which are complemented by the palate flavors of apricot, ripe peach, and honey. The rich texture and balance on the palate from aging sur lie gives way to flavors of vanilla, citrus cream, and a hint of oak on the long finish.

title: J Lohr Cabernet Sauvignon Seven Oaks 2022 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: There's a reason this Cabernet is one of the most popular red wines out there. It's full-bodied and packed with black cherry, blackcurrant, cedar, vanilla and spice. Equally at home with a burger or a thick rib eye steak. Just in time for BBQ season or any season!

title: Santa Margherita Pinot Grigio 2025 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Santa Margherita pioneered the modern winemaking methods of Pinot Grigio and are proud to be known as a benchmark of quality and innovation for the category. In 1960, their winemaker was inspired by traditional sparkling wine vinification techniques used to ferment Pinot Grigio without skin contact. Driven to capture the delicate fruit and floral notes, he realized that by moving away from the then-standard “Ramato” method, the precious aromas and flavors could be preserved as they were meant to be tasted. 

Let the clean, dry, and versatile Pinot Grigio that inspired an entire generation of Italian white wines complement your next picnic, dinner party, or spontaneous gathering.

With its straw-yellow hue, clean intense aroma, and crisp, well-balanced taste, Santa Margherita's Pinot Grigio is as authentic as it is refreshing. For those who love a dry white wine with the delightful aroma of Golden Delicious apples, their signature Pinot Grigio is unparalleled. It will impress even the most astute connoisseurs with its flavorful personality.

A clean, lovely aperitif to start any food occasion. Santa Margherita's Pinot Grigio goes wonderfully with fresh cheeses, white meats, and soufflés. Pair it with seafood for an extraordinary experience, including shellfish and seafood-based pastas and rice dishes. Its varietal typicity makes it extremely versatile and food-friendly.

title: Joseph Drouhin Beaujolais Villages 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
A truly convivial wine. Owing to the careful blending of various terroirs, the result is a wine of great charm. It has a lovely raspberry color and a brilliant hue. The nose is both refined and intense, with notes of violet, peony and red fruit syrup. As you drink it, it feels fresh and silky. Both freshness and fruit remain for quite a long time on the palate.

The nose is floral and offers complex suggestions of raspberry jam, fresh strawberry and plum, with some grapey tones and a hint of licorice. Soft and approachable, this is vibrant and balanced with a touch of spritz. Bing cherry and red fruit notes of candied strawberry and cranberry emerge alongside the juicy dark berry.

title: Kettle Valley Pinot Noir Reserve 2021 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
The inspiration for Kettle Valley Winery's name is the famed Kettle Valley Railway which ran through Naramata between 1915 and 1961, connecting the Southern Interior of British Columbia to the markets of the Pacific Northwest. Passion and a dedication to excellence were requirements for building the railway, and at Kettle Valley they feel that same passion and dedication for their red wines which are known for their elegant and well structured natures and their white wines that are flavourful and aromatic with a rich mouth feel.

Wine Description

On the nose, it offers an intriguing profile full of plum, black cherry, and raspberry 'fruit leather'. The palate is equally rewarding with bold flavours, bright acidity, and silky tannins. It is a medium bodied wine, with a steady balance and structure.

title: Folonari Valpolicella 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Uniquely Italian, with bold flavours of currants and blackberries finished with notes of vanilla on the palate. One sip and you will feel transported to the hills of the Valpolicella region.

title: Massolino Moscato D'Asti 2025 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Massolino is a historic family-operated estate located in the heart of Serralunga d'Alba within Italy's Piedmont region. Founded in 1896 by Giovanni Massolino, the winery is now managed by the fourth generation of the family, including oenologists Franco and Roberto Massolino. Their winemaking philosophy is deeply rooted in tradition and respect for the territory, aiming to preserve the authentic personality of indigenous grape varieties while implementing modern techniques to ensure precision and elegance.

Wine Description

This Moscato d'Asti presents a bright straw yellow colour with a fine and persistent perlage. The bouquet is intense and fresh, dominated by seductive notes of white peach, apricot, orange blossom, and honey, with a clear aromatic predominance of sage and mint conveyed by the calcareous 'terroir'. On the palate, the wine is expansive and enveloping without being overly sweet, offering a refreshing acidity and delicate effervescence. Crafted from 100% Moscato Bianco grapes, it features a long, clean, and persistent finish.

title: Cono Sur Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
From Chile’s Central Valley, this Cabernet Sauvignon is produced by Cono Sur Vineyards & Winery, founded in 1993 and now part of the Concha y Toro group. The winery is known for its commitment to sustainable and organic practices, incorporating modern techniques while expressing the diversity of Chile’s terroir.

Wine Description

In the glass, this Cabernet Sauvignon shows a deep ruby red colour. The aromas reveal blackcurrant, plum, and cherry, complemented by subtle notes of vanilla, spice, and cocoa from oak ageing. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, with ripe fruit flavours balanced by smooth tannins and fresh acidity. The finish is lingering and harmonious, showcasing both fruit vibrancy and structure.

Food Pairing

Pairs beautifully with grilled meats, roasted lamb, hearty pasta dishes, or aged cheeses.

title: Saint Clair Sauvignon Blanc 2022
bodyHtml: Opulent and complex with concentrated layers of bright citrus and tropical fruit. The palate is crisp and full, with a salty mineral texture and a lingering finish.

title: Ste Michelle Merlot 2018
bodyHtml: Complex yet approachable, Chateau Ste Michelle's Merlot offers aromas of black cherry, leather, and spice with layers of rich dark red fruit and a long, smooth, sweet finish. A touch of Syrah adds a jammy fruit character.

title: The Ned Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Ned Sauvignon Blanc is produced in the Marlborough region of New Zealand, with fruit primarily sourced from the Waihopai River Vineyard on the southern side of the Wairau Valley. The brand was launched in 2003 by Brent Marris, a Marlborough native whose family estate, Marisco Vineyards, is situated on the banks of the Waihopai River. The label's winemaking philosophy, captured by the ethos 'Young At Heart', emphasizes grassroots winemaking that aims to preserve the vibrant energy and aromatic purity of the fruit.

Wine Description

This wine typically displays a clear pale straw or lemon colour with light green-gold highlights. The sensory profile is punchy and explosive, featuring aromas of lemon and lime citrus, passion fruit, gooseberry, and pink grapefruit, often underpinned by a subtle mineral note of warm river stones. On the palate, it is crisp and fruit-focused with a fleshy mid-palate that reveals flavours of tropical fruits, crisp green apple, and white grapefruit. The finish is long and zesty, driven by a seam of lively Marlborough acidity. This wine is 100% Sauvignon Blanc and typically has an ABV of 13%. It is produced using sustainable practices and is Vegan Certified.

title: Stoneleigh Sauvignon Blanc 2025
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This vibrant white wine is a quintessential expression of New Zealand, specifically from the Marlborough region. The Stoneleigh story began in 1980, and the winery owes its unique character to the ancient, stone-studded Rapaura soils deposited by the Wairau River thousands of years ago. These 'sunstones' capture heat during the day and release it into the vines at night, fostering the development of intense, rich flavours. Stoneleigh’s winemaking philosophy centres on minimal intervention, ensuring the natural, exuberant fruit profiles of the vineyard are captured authentically in every bottle.

Wine Description

The Stoneleigh Sauvignon Blanc is light straw in colour with subtle green highlights. It features a fresh and exuberant sensory profile, with a bouquet dominated by lifted aromas of passion fruit, lime zest, and grapefruit, accented by hints of lemongrass and garden herbs. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and packed with tension and texture, delivering layered flavours of tropical fruit, guava, and pink grapefruit.

This 100% Sauvignon Blanc demonstrates mouth-watering acidity and a distinct mineral edge that leads to a long, lingering finish. Stylistically, it is celebrated for its vibrancy and crisp, clean structure. The wine is designed for immediate enjoyment and has an optimal drinking window of 0–3 years from the vintage date.

title: Zenato Pinot Grigio 2025
bodyHtml:
From Italy’s northeastern Veneto region, this Pinot Grigio hails from the delle Venezie DOC, a denomination celebrated for fresh, vibrant whites. Zenato, a family-owned winery established in 1960 by Sergio Zenato, is renowned for marrying traditional techniques with modern precision. The estate’s commitment to expressing terroir and varietal clarity shines across its portfolio.

Wine Description
Zenato Pinot Grigio pours a pale straw yellow with greenish highlights. On the nose, it offers delicate aromas of white peach, citrus blossom, and a hint of almond. The palate is crisp and light-bodied, delivering flavours of green apple, lemon zest, and subtle mineral notes. Its lively acidity and clean finish make it refreshingly well-balanced.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with seafood antipasti, grilled chicken, or light pasta dishes such as linguine with lemon and herbs. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

title: Summerhill Ehrenfelser 2023
bodyHtml: 100% Ehrenfelser. Luxurious texture and wildly delicious layers of flavours and aromas. Notes of apricot, gooseberry, citrus, honeysuckle, orange blossom, cantaloupe, and peach, with undertones of tropical fruits. This celebrated rare grape variety thrives in the Okanagan. Grapes from the hot, southern Okanagan region of Osoyoos at Inkameep Vineyards provide richness, depth, and tropical undertones. Grapes from Summerhill Vineyard in the northern Okanagan region of Kelowna add vibrant freshness and stone fruit character.

title: Kim Crawford Sauvignon Blanc 2026 - 375 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This white wine originates from New Zealand, specifically from the Marlborough region on the South Island. Founded in 1996 by Kim and Erica Crawford, the winery began by purchasing grapes from contract growers and quickly became an iconic brand that helped establish New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc as a global category. While the founders have since moved on, the winery is currently owned by Constellation Brands and remains one of Marlborough's most internationally recognized producers. The winemaking philosophy focuses on showcasing the regional terroir through fresh, vibrant, and aromatic wines that are true to their varietal type.

Wine Description

Kim Crawford Sauvignon Blanc displays a bright, pale straw colour with green highlights. The nose is aromatic and exuberant, offering intense scents of lifted citrus, passion fruit, and melon layered with characteristic herbaceous notes of crushed herbs and fresh-cut grass. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and juicy, delivering a vibrant core of pineapple, grapefruit, and stone fruit flavours supported by a taut backbone of zesty acidity. It is characterized by its remarkable freshness, refined minerality, and a long, persistent finish. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc typically features an ABV ranging from 11.6% to 13%, depending on the specific tier and vintage. While the winery is increasingly focused on sustainable practices, the standard release is not typically certified organic, though an organic version is produced in select vintages. The optimal drinking window is from release through two to three years to fully enjoy its youthful fruit character.

title: Yellow Tail Shiraz 2023
bodyHtml: While some Shiraz can be over the top, this wine offers some seriously easy drinking, even when the wine is young. Red fruits dominate the nose and mouth, but subtle spice and a hint of dusty tannins join in for good measure.

title: The Show Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
bodyHtml:
Originating from the United States in California, sourced from premier coastal and inland vineyards across regions like Mendocino, Lodi, and Paso Robles, The Show Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold, approachable expression of classic Golden State winemaking. Created through a collaboration between Joel Gott Wines and Three Thieves, the brand celebrates the vibrant spirit and larger-than-life character of California wine country. The winemaking philosophy focuses on blending fruit from distinct microclimates to craft a rich, expressive Cabernet Sauvignon that offers maximum flavor, smooth texture, and outstanding value.

Wine Description

The wine displays a deep, dark ruby purple colour in the glass. An expressive and dark-fruit-driven bouquet opens with lush aromas of black cherry, wild blackberry, and crushed plum, layered with sweet accents of vanilla bean, cocoa powder, toasted oak, and a touch of brown spice. On the palate, it is medium-to-full bodied and round, delivering generous flavours of ripe dark berries, dark chocolate, and roasted espresso, supported by soft, velvety tannins and gentle acidity. Composed predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon blended with small portions of Petite Sirah and Merlot to enhance color and structure, it combines ripe, sunny California fruit power with plush, easy-drinking drinkability and subtle oak warmth.

title: Kim Crawford Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml: From the popular Kim Crawford estate, here's an ample Chardonnay with scents of orange peel, apple and toast. A must!

title: Enzo Boglietti Barolo Brunate 2020
bodyHtml: Fine bouquet of violets, red and black fruits with some oak. A full-bodied, racy Barolo of huge structure with nice, medium acidity that delivers a very long and elegant finish. General InformationThe Brunate "Cru" is a true archetype of high class Barolo. This La Morra vineyard spills over into the actual township of Barolo on a long slope which varies from 260-405 meters above sea level. Exposure is predominantly south to southeast. Enzo loves making wine from this site as it has the rare ability to deliver perfumed elegance and power in equal parts.

title: Graham's 40 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
Golden amber with a pale green tinge at the rim which denotes great quality and class. Very complex on the nose with a powerful fragrance that belies its age. The palate is a gamut of flavours, ranging from delicate fruit and raisins to burnt toffee and chocolate. The persistent aftertaste is sheer pleasure. An excellent alternative to Vintage Port at less formal occasions. Will keep for some weeks after opening.

96 Points - Wine Spectator

A warm, lush style, with brown bread, fig compote, ginger marmalade and date flavors coating the palate before streaks of bitter orange and almond kick in, imparting cut and enlivening the finish. A note of incense weaves around it all, adding intrigue. Drink now.

96 Points - James Suckling

Fantastic old tawny with a tight and lively palate of dried fruit, figs, bark and walnuts. Custard and some salted nuts, too. It’s full, sweet and glorious. Lovely candied fruit at the end. Drink now.

title: Umani Ronchi Montepulciano d'Abruzzo 'Jorio' 2022
bodyHtml:
This expressive red wine hails from the Abruzzo region of Italy, specifically within the Montepulciano d'Abruzzo DOC. Umani Ronchi is owned by the Bianchi Bernetti family, who have been dedicated to highlighting the best of the Montepulciano varietal since 1957. The 'Jorio' label was first created in the mid-nineties as a collaboration with dedicated local growers to showcase the potential of vineyards in particularly favourable areas of the region.

Wine Description

'Jorio' presents a deep ruby red colour in the glass. The nose is characterized by intense aromas of plums and red cherries, underscored by balsamic notes, salty undertones, and a hint of ripe liquorice. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and vigorous, featuring a core of red and black berries with soft, well-integrated tannins that verge on plumpness. It finishes with a long, intense trail of fruit, oak spice, and a light touch of chocolate.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 92 points

Food Pairing

This wine's structure makes it an excellent companion for hearty dishes such as pasta with meat sauce, grilled red meats, or roasted game. It also pairs beautifully with dark poultry and medium-aged cheeses.

title: Santa Cristina Chianti Superiore 2021
bodyHtml: Chianti Superiore Santa Cristina is ruby red with purplish highlights. On the nose it is complex with fruity notes of morello cherries, dried plums and hay. Its palate is soft, mouth filling with velvety tannins and a long savory finish.

title: Flechas de los Andes Gran Malbec 2020
bodyHtml: This ripe and bold Malbec has some serious muscle to it, not to mention a good deal going on with the wine. Dark berries, some tar and a hint of the oak frame, this is a smooth and silky wine. Lovely floral lift with intense, smooth, chocolatey black fruit. Especially flavorful with rack of lamb or full-flavored chicken and veal.

title: Mission Hill Chardonnay Reserve 2023
bodyHtml:
Mission Hill Family Estate was founded in 1981 by Anthony von Mandl, who was a wine seller in Vancouver and saw the potential for the region. The winery is dedicated to combining modern innovation with traditional practices, focusing on sustainable farming to allow their varietals to thrive in the valley’s diverse soil profiles.

Wine Description

On the palate, it is described as mouth-filling and buttery, with flavours of fresh yellow apple, pear, melon, tropical fruit, creamy citrus, and baking spice. The aroma is complemented by notes of orchard apple, citrus, and pear. The wine offers a tremendous balance of texture, acidity, and freshness, with a hint of spice in the finish.

Food Pairing

Roast chicken, creamy pastas and risottos, or richer shellfish dishes like lobster, crab, or scallops with brown-butter sauce. The wine's richness and vibrant acidity also make it a great match for sesame-crusted salmon or sweetbreads in puff pastry.

title: Benziger Chardonnay 2023
bodyHtml: A medium-bodied, well-balanced Chardonnay with mouth-watering fruit and lively acid. Flavours of lemon, apple, pear and apricot pop on the palate, before subtle, creamy butter and meringue notes and a luscious, refreshing finish.

title: Mollydooker Enchanted Path 2023
bodyHtml: A mouthful of red fruit, cherries, wild berries and fresh plum greet you upon tasting this year's harmonious blend of Shiraz and Cabernet. The two compliment each other seamlessly as vanilla and dark chocolate integrate with cinnamon spice and notes of mocha to form the perfect balance. Silky tannins give this enjoyable wine phenomenal length, allowing your taste buds to continue to dance long after the last sip.

title: Oyster Bay Merlot 2023
bodyHtml: The Hawke's Bay wine region is arguably the most exciting find in recent times for the cultivation of Merlot in New Zealand. Ancient alluvial river terraces provide for a superb mix of soils over gravelly, free draining subsoils, with an abundance of pure river water or irrigation. With a temperate maritime climate, the vines are warmed by strong clear sunlight during the day and cooled at night by the sea breezes of the Pacific Ocean. This is the unique environment in which Merlot produces its vibrant, fully-ripened varietal flavours. Essentially, Oyster Bay Hawke's Bay Merlot is about elegance and intensity of fruit. The hero is always freshness of ripe fruit, spice and soft tannins on the palate.

title: Joya Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Vibrant aromas of red fruits and strawberries and just a smidge of residual sugar. Extremely lively, crisp, and fresh. 

It's a light pick to pair with salads, seafood, spicy oriental food, and goat cheese.

title: Langmeil Shiraz Valley Floor 2023
bodyHtml:
The Barossa is famous for its viticulture, history and winemaking dating back to the 1840s. At its heart is the Valley Floor, a highly-prized strip of viticultural land which is the very foundation and forms the essence of this wine. A true taste of the Barossa.

Rich and lifted aromas of Satsuma plum, mulberry and floral notes mingle with sweet spice, chocolate and savoury hints.  Plumy fruit and sweet spice balanced by soft velvety tannins. A complex, medium to full-bodied wine showing hints of mocha, bramble and vanilla which flow through to the lengthy, fruity, peppery and spicy finish.

title: Villa Maria Sauvignon Blanc 'Private Bin' 2025
bodyHtml: Villa Maria Private Bin Sauvignon Blanc is an iconic New Zealand wine. With the crack of the screw cap, taste it for yourself as you unleash the essence of Marlborough and the vibrant flavours of passionfruit and fresh Kaffir lime.

title: Sinfarosa Zinfandel Primitivo di Manduria 2019
bodyHtml:
Agricola Felline's Sinfarosa Zinfandel is a wine that expresses all of the characteristics of the typical Primitivo di Manduria. However, unlike the other wines made from the famed grape type grown in the north of Salento, this is one of its clones, namely the vine known in California as Zinfandel. This wine is made from grapes grown on a special type of soil known as black earth. This soil is alluvial in origin and is characterised by the erosion of more superficial rocks. It is made composed of organic material deposits, such as ancient forests.

This wine is ruby red in colour with violet reflections and has hints of ripe fruit, nearly jam, with obvious aromas of red and black fruits, followed by delicate spicy notes like black pepper on the nose. It has a rich and powerful flavour in the mouth, with firm tannins and a substantial body. The lingering aromatic taste is a result of the tannin emitted by the barrique.

title: Jim Barry Shiraz McRae Wood 2022
bodyHtml: The Jim Barry McRae Wood Shiraz has received much critical acclaim over the years with each promising vintage. This wine shows notes of blood plum, cherry and dark berried fruits. Black olive, spice and cherry oak also play a supporting role. The palate is restrained in its youth, whilst having the concentration and depth the McRae Wood is famous for. Maraschino cherry and blackberry fruit complements the tar and aniseed savouriness. While showing fantastic drive and power, the soft integrated tannins add a lengthy finish.

title: Red Rooster Chardonnay 2025
bodyHtml:
Red Rooster Chardonnay originates from Canada, within the British Columbia region and the Okanagan Valley subregion. The winery, located on the Naramata Bench, was established in 1990 and has built a reputation for crafting wines with a distinct sense of place and minimal intervention. Their winemaking philosophy focuses on capturing the natural vibrancy of the Okanagan fruit through a combination of traditional techniques and modern precision, ensuring each wine reflects the unique character of the vineyard.

Wine Description

This white wine displays a bright straw colour and possesses a medium body with a creamy yet balanced texture. The sensory profile is expressive, featuring an aromatic nose of golden apple, pear, and tropical pineapple, accented by subtle notes of vanilla, toasted oak, and a hint of lemon zest. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious blend of ripe orchard fruit and citrus, supported by a delicate buttery richness and well integrated spice. The finish is clean and persistent, with lingering notes of fruit and soft oak.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Chardonnay.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its balance between freshness and complexity, often undergoing partial malolactic fermentation and ageing in French and American oak to enhance its mouthfeel.

  • ABV: Typically recorded at 13%.

  • Organic Status: While the winery emphasizes sustainable viticulture and careful land management, this specific bottling is not certified organic.

Food Pairing

The versatility and balanced acidity of Red Rooster Chardonnay make it an excellent partner for a range of West Coast inspired dishes.

  • Seafood: Pairs exceptionally well with grilled salmon, seared scallops, and creamy seafood pasta.

  • Poultry: Suggested pairings include roasted chicken with lemon and herbs or turkey with traditional stuffing.

  • Vegetarian: Complements roasted butternut squash, mushroom risotto, and dishes featuring corn or chickpeas.

  • Cheese: Matches well with soft, creamy cheeses such as brie or camembert.

title: Ruffino Chianti 2024 - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Purple/red colour with aromas and flavours of red berry and cherry fruit. Spicy notes and a touch of pepper. Dry, medium body, with balanced tannin on a gently firm finish.

title: Norton Malbec Reserva 2023
bodyHtml: Deep red colour with hints of purple. Expressive on the nose with notes of ripe black fruits, violets, and tobacco. Long finish.

title: 689 Red Blend 2023
bodyHtml:
Similar to the interwoven numbers in their logo, 689 wines reflect separate elements coming together into one balanced and harmonious whole. Their Napa Valley wines strive for this harmonious balance rich, expressive, and approachable reflecting characteristics of this world-famous growing region.

689 Red is drop-dead gorgeous. This wine bursts from the glass with aromas of sweet cherries, dark blackberries and plum, with hints of licorice and spice. The wine reveals freshness and vibrancy on the palate. This wine is medium to full-bodied, packed with black and red fruit and earthy layers that highlight a long-perfumed finish.

title: Taylor Fladgate 40 Year Old Tawny Port
bodyHtml:
Taylor Fladgate is one of the oldest of the founding Port houses, with a legacy spanning over three centuries since its establishment in 1692 by Job Bearsley. The company has remained fiercely independent, with family members playing a leading role in all areas of the firm's activity. Taylor Fladgate is entirely dedicated to the production of Port wine, combining a respect for its historic legacy with a pioneering spirit, and is regarded as the benchmark for Vintage Port.

Wine Description

The bouquet is powerful, complex, and intense, with impressions of dried fruit (dates, figs, and raisins), honey, spice, and an intense nuttiness like hazelnut and walnut. Notes of caramel, roasted coffee, butterscotch, nougat, and marzipan also converge on the nose. On the palate, the wine has a rich, voluptuous, and almost viscous texture, leading to a smooth, silky feel. The concentrated flavour is layered with maturity, offering notes of toffee, dried ginger, grilled peaches, and candied citrus peel.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings highlight the wine's rich, nutty, and caramel notes. It pairs excellently with desserts featuring figs, almonds, caramel, or butterscotch, such as crème brûlée, almond tart, or pecan pie.

title: Tussock Jumper Pinot Noir 2023
bodyHtml: Pinot Noir is known for its elegance and refinement. It possesses an exotic bouquet along with a velvety, mouth-filling texture. Tussock Jumper Pinot Noir exhibits flavours of ripe red fruit, cherry, chocolate, toast and spices. Ideal with chicken, turkey and grilled salmon or delicious on its own.

title: Vineland Cabernet Franc 2022
bodyHtml: Blackberry and cassis lead the way, with red currant and raspberry filling in. A tiny hint of smoked black pepper keeps the rich fruit notes forward and focused. Lively on the plate, this wine is like a treasured old friend. It is both contentious and comforting and in the right measure.

title: Giusti Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2019
bodyHtml:
The Giusti Amarone della Valpolicella Classico is a distinguished red wine from the Veneto region of Italy, crafted predominantly from Corvina Veronese, Corvinone, and Rondinella grapes. This Amarone exemplifies the traditional appassimento process, where grapes are air-dried to concentrate their flavors, resulting in a rich and opulent wine.

Colour: Intense ruby red with garnet reflections, indicating depth and maturity.

Aroma: A complex bouquet featuring notes of dried fruits, particularly plum and cherry, complemented by evident hints of licorice and pepper.

Palate: Full-bodied and round, offering a warm sensation with soft, elegant tannins. The flavors mirror the aromatic profile, showcasing dried fruits and subtle spice.

Body: Full-bodied with a velvety texture, providing a harmonious balance between richness and elegance.

Finish: Long and persistent, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors and refined structure.

This Amarone pairs excellently with game, braised meats, mature cheeses, and sweet and sour dishes. It's also delightful as a contemplative wine to enjoy by the fireplace. For optimal enjoyment, it's advisable to uncork the bottle at least one hour before serving at a temperature of 17-19°C.

title: Ernie Els Signature Stellenbosch 2016
bodyHtml: As a leading South African ambassador and one of the most recognizable faces in the world of sports, Ernie Els has long demonstrated a passion for excellence.
