Focus, discipline and commitment have led to his extraordinary golf success. These same qualities are evident in Ernie Els Wines, a quest to produce premium wine that was born in 1999. Els naturally chose Stellenbosch, South Africa's most storied wine region, to produce his wines and brought on the award-winning Louis Strydom to oversee winemaking. In 2000, the first grapes were crushed for the inaugural vintage of Ernie Els Signature. In 2004, a 178-acre property on the slopes of Helderberg Mountain was chosen as the home of Ernie Els Wines.

title: Caparzo Brunello di Montalcino 2020 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This acclaimed red wine hails from Italy, specifically the Tuscany region, with its subregion being Brunello di Montalcino DOCG. Established in 1970, Caparzo is counted among Montalcino’s historic wineries that significantly contributed to the legend of Brunello.

Wine Description

Made from 100% Sangiovese, this wine presents a ruby colour that tends toward garnet with age. The bouquet is described as penetrating, ample, and very complex, with intense and fragrant aromatic notes reminiscent of wild berry fruit. On the palate, the wine is typically dry, warm, firm, harmonious, and persistent, offering a full and juicy mouthfeel with ripe fruit, herbs, and a leathery note.

Accolades

  • James Suckling - 97 points

  • Wine Spectator - 95 points

  • Wine Advocate - 94 points

  • Vinous - 94+ points

  • Decanter - 93 points

Food Pairing

Given its robust and intense flavours, this Brunello is best paired with dishes that can counterbalance its vigorous tannic structure. Excellent matches include rich, roasted, or grilled red meats.

title: Croft Vintage Port 2011
bodyHtml: Effusively juicy, rich and concentrated, showing plenty of snap to the crisp and well spiced flavours of wild berry, dark currant and plum tart. Orange infused chocolate notes linger on the exotic, mocha-filled finish.

title: Belle Glos Pinot Noir Clark & Telephone 2022 - 1.5 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the United States, this Pinot Noir is produced in California’s Santa Maria Valley, a subregion of Santa Barbara County renowned for its cool climate and ocean influences. Belle Glos is part of the Wagner Family of Wine, celebrated for crafting expressive California wines. Established by Joe Wagner, the winery focuses on showcasing unique coastal sites that bring out the distinctive character of Pinot Noir.

Wine Description

This vintage pours a deep ruby red with vibrant edges. On the nose, it reveals lush aromas of ripe cherry, blackberry, and cranberry, intertwined with hints of cedar, vanilla, and sweet spice. The palate is opulent and silky, brimming with layers of red berries, dark plum, and mocha, complemented by undertones of cinnamon and baking spice. Medium to full-bodied, it offers a smooth, velvety texture balanced by lively acidity and framed by fine-grained tannins, leading to a long, supple finish.

Accolades

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points.

Food Pairing

Pair this expressive Pinot Noir with herb-crusted pork tenderloin, roasted duck with cherry compote, or wild mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Chateau d'Esclans Whispering Angel Rose 2025 - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Whispering Angel is today’s worldwide reference for Provence Rosé. Made from Grenache, Cinsault and Vermentino, its pale colour is pleasing to the eye and draws one in. The rewarding taste profile is full and lush while being bone dry with a smooth finish. Highly approachable and enjoyable with a broad range of cuisine, Whispering Angel is a premium Rosé that you can drink all day, any day!

Created by Sacha Lichine following his acquisition of Château d’Esclans in 2006, his vision was to create the greatest rosés in the world igniting the “Rosé Renaissance”. Sacha introduced new and innovative winemaking techniques to Provence which revolutionized the styles of Rosés being produced from this region. This led to the creation of Whispering Angel, a world class Rosé which presents both ease and accessibility making for enjoyment and pleasure.

As Sacha says... “In the Esclans Valley angels whisper. If you drink this wine, you might hear them… If you visit us, you might see them.”

title: Eisele Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
bodyHtml:
Intense and sophisticated, the Cabernet Sauvignon unveils with deep aromas of blue fruits, Bigarreau cherries and violets followed by subtle notes of rosemary and pencil lead. The mouthfeel is silky smooth, with incredible definition and finesse. Perfectly ripe and tight-knit tannins support the youthful energy of the fruit, layered with wild blueberry coulis. The very long finish lingers with mineral notes of graphite and volcanic soil, laced with aromas of Madagascar vanilla, cinnamon and wilted roses. This wine is beautiful, evocative and complex. Still, so much has yet to be revealed with bottle age. This is the quintessence of the Eisele Vineyard terroir.

100 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

Deep purple-black in color, the nose of the 2019 Cabernet Sauvignon slowly unfurls to reveal a gorgeous perfume of violets and roses over a core of kirsch, boysenberries and cassis, plus hints of redcurrant jelly and menthol, emerging into wafts of pencil lead and truffles. Medium to full-bodied, the palate is built like a brick house, featuring very firm, wonderfully ripe, grainy tannins and bold freshness to support the vivacious, tightly wound black and red fruit layers, finishing long and mineral laced. It's a stunning, evocative, singular wine that so beautifully captures the long, slow-maturing grace of the 2019 vintage.

100 Points - James Suckling

This is sophisticated and intellectual, with an incredible wall of fine tannins that take you deep down into the soul of the wine. Full-to medium-bodied, tight and soulful. Tar, ash and volcanic-soil flavors. White pepper, too. Great length. Shows the first-growth quality of the vineyards, harking back to the wines of the mid-1970s. From biodynamically grown grapes with Demeter certification. This needs at least six to seven years of bottle age. Best after 2028.

title: Grun Riesling Rheingau 2020
bodyHtml: The colour is a very light straw gold, enjoy looking at those super tiny bubbles when swirled. The nose here skews almost but not quite tropical (kiwi?), but there is melon, green apple, peach and perhaps nectarine. None of the oiliness which is typical for a Riesling. Those bubbles that you can see give a bit of effervescence giving it a taste like summer, and a small amount of residual sugar but it is a very dry Riesling which would pair great with spice! A fairly consistent mouthfeel with extremely high acidity. Those same fruits show through on the palate as well. No balance issues, not exceedingly complex but almost unbeatable at this price point. Pair with an Asian dish with some spice to compliment the high acidity and palate-cleansing nature of the bubbles. This wine would also compliment a dish with a little bit of heat, the sweetness offsets the spiciness. Perfect for Thai food!

title: Luigi Bosca De Sangre Red Blend 2021
bodyHtml: A bright burgundy red wine with ruby shades. It has subtle and balanced aromas, with herby and spicy notes. It is voluptuous and expressive in the mouth, with incipient tannins and a persistent finish. It is clean, full-bodied, vivacious and fresh on the palate, with a gentle character. Anytime there is a BBQ, this is the wine to enjoy!

title: Can Sumoi Rose La Rosa 2024
bodyHtml: Rose wine made using Sumoll, Parellada and Xarel-lo grape varieties, by Can Sumoi winery located in the region of Penedes, in Pla de Manlleu (Barcelona).

title: Torres Altos Ibericos Crianza 2019
bodyHtml:
Altos Ibericos is a new take on La Rioja. The wine has the same cellaring potential, but in contrast to the classic toasted and spicy notes found in earlier crianza wines, here the essence of Tempranillo shines through in all its beauty.  This exemplary varietal represents a region that is looking to interpret wine and tradition in a new way. No small task when you're the leading DOC in Spain.

In a tweet, Bodegas Torres could describe Altos Ibéricos Crianza as “a contemporary red with soft tannins and lots of fruit. Versatile to the ninth degree, it exemplifies a new kind of Rioja.”  New gastronomic trends and circumstances demand new wines that go hand in hand with a new culinary reality. This idea took shape after conversations with restaurant industry professionals and eventually gave birth to Altos Ibéricos Crianza. This is a wine for people who seek something different, but still want a Spanish wine. And it is a wine that builds closer ties to a new, modern and creative kind of gastronomy. An authentic and unpretentious way to enjoy tapas. The silky tannins of Altos Ibéricos Crianza combine particularly well with tapas made from fresh ingredients like red meat, oil-rich fish, cheese and all kinds of cured meat and sausages.

Opaque cherry red. Rich fruit aromas with green peppercorn and smoky notes. Intense, warm, with firm tannins nicely structured by oak aging and a backbone of subtle fruit acidity. Designed to pair perfectly with new trends in avant-garde cuisine. Excellent with all kinds of tapas prepared with fresh ingredients, red meat, oil-rich fish and cheeses. Equally exquisite with cured Iberico pork.

title: Montecillo Crianza 2021
bodyHtml:
This classic red wine originates from Spain, specifically the Rioja region and the Rioja Alta subregion. Founded in 1870 by Celestino Navajas, Bodegas Montecillo is the third oldest winery in Rioja and was the first established in the town of Fuenmayor. In 1973, ownership passed to the Osborne family, another historic Spanish wine dynasty, who have continued the winery's philosophy of 'reverential respect for the silent work of time'. Their winemaking approach focuses on technical innovation, such as cold fermentation, while remaining faithful to traditional Rioja methods to produce elegant, long-ageing wines.

Wine Description

Montecillo Crianza displays a clean and brilliant cherry red colour with a bluish rim. The aromatic profile is intense and complex, featuring expressive notes of ripe red berries, plum, and strawberry jam, interwoven with sweet patisserie notes of vanilla, toffee, and toasted oak. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied and smooth, offering a 'fruit salad' of red cherry and blackberry flavours balanced by zesty acidity and fine-grained,

title: Ilurce Rio Madre Red 2021
bodyHtml: Rio Madre is the result of the efforts of Jorge Ordóñez and Bodegas Ilurce to produce a 100% Graciano wine from D.O.C. Rioja. Mostly known for its role in adding complexity to the wines of Rioja Alta and Alavesa, Graciano is a varietal that thrives in Rioja Baja due to the hotter climate. Graciano is a late ripening variety with a particularly long vegetative cycle, so it cannot ripen fully in Rioja Alta and Alavesa. As a result, although most northern Rioja wineries claim their blends include Graciano from their vineyards, most of them source their Graciano from Rioja Baja. Ordóñez discovered the quality of vineyards and Graciano in Rioja Baja, and partnered with Bodegas Ilurce to produce a 100% Graciano wine, which are very rare.

title: Atteca Garnacha Old Vines 2022
bodyHtml:
Sourced from average 65-year-old estate vines planted on rocky slate soils at 3,000 ft. above sea level. Vineyards are dry-farmed without use of pesticides or herbicides and then hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel before aging for 10 months in French oak. 

The Bodegas Ateca "Atteca" is a deep cherry color. Intense aromas of red ripe fruit combine perfectly with the spicy notes of cacao, vanilla and licorice which correspond to a noble aging. It is very fresh and fruity in the mouth. It has a notable finish where fruity and spicy aromas come back via retro nasal. It is a magnificent expression of an elegant Garnacha from Aragon. Rich morello cherry and plum flavors are accented by mint, orange peel and sassafras notes in this expressive red, which has soft tannins, juicy acidity and a smoky finish.

title: Luis Pato Baga 2025
bodyHtml:
Luis Pato is one of Portugal’s most renowned winemakers, often called the ‘Rebel of Bairrada’ for his innovative spirit. Since the 1980s, his estate has been at the forefront of showcasing the Baga grape, combining traditional practices with modern techniques to craft expressive, ageworthy wines.

Wine Description
It pours a deep ruby colour with violet reflections. On the nose, it reveals aromas of fresh berries, violets, and subtle smoky notes with hints of chocolate. The palate is medium-bodied, with lively acidity and structured tannins, balanced by red fruit purity and floral undertones. The finish is long and elegant, showing both freshness and finesse.

Food Pairing
Pair this wine with roasted meats, charcuterie, or mushroom-based dishes. Its bright acidity and structured tannins make it a versatile companion to hearty Portuguese fare.

title: Telmo Rodriguez Gago Red 2019
bodyHtml:
Telmo Rodriguez Gago 2019

Introduction

Produced in Spain, this distinguished red wine comes from the Toro region within the province of Zamora. The winery, Compañía de Vinos Telmo Rodríguez, was founded in 1994 by Telmo Rodríguez and Pablo Eguzkiza with a philosophy centered on recovering native varieties in their original terroirs. Gago is considered the winery's most representative wine from the area, crafted from old bush-vines sourced from several families of growers who have partnered with Rodríguez since the late 1990s.

Wine Description

The 2019 Gago displays a deep cherry red colour with garnet tones. The nose is intense and complex, revealing aromas of ripe black fruits like blackberries and cassis, layered with notes of dark chocolate, smoke, and balsamic undertones. On the palate, the wine shows a medium to full body with a lush, juicy texture and abundant grainy tannins that provide a firm structure. Flavours of black cherry and plum are balanced by a lively acidity and mineral salinity, leading to a long, perfumed finish with hints of spice and cacao.

The wine is primarily composed of Tinta de Toro (a local variant of Tempranillo) with a small addition of Albillo Mayor. It was fermented using native yeasts in both wooden and stainless steel tanks before aging for 14 months in large foudres and oak barrels. While showing remarkable finesse and drinkability now, this wine is built to evolve and has an optimal drinking window that can extend through 2030.

Accolades

  • Wine Advocate (Robert Parker) - 92 points

  • Vinous - 91 points

title: Radio Boka Tempranillo 2024
bodyHtml:
Young and powerful! Call it ripened red fruits, cinnamon, vanilla or just call it simply pure Rock and Roll, tattoos and experience! A powerful chorus for demanding palates only!

Deep purple color. Aromas and flavors of blackberry, boysenberry, olive, hints of caraway, tobacco, and black pepper with a satiny, crisp, fruity medium body and a smooth, interesting, medium-length finish with notes of sour cherry, tomatoes, and tarragon with light oak flavor. A silky-smooth Tempranillo with kisses of sweetness.

title: Vintae Proyecto Garnachas de Espana Salvaje del Moncayo 2021
bodyHtml: A wine that is surprising due to its roundness and youth. After 5 months of aging in new French oak barrels, this wine expresses all the qualities of the Garnacha in this area of the Ebro Valley. A fruity, fresh and sweet tannin wine capable of satisfying the enthusiasts of this variety. Medium-deep garnet colour with bright red edge. Intense and elegant red berry fruit character, with tobacco and herbs notes. Rich and fruity with well-balanced freshness. Elegant, with unique varietal characteristics and a long aftertaste.

title: Niepoort Docil Vino Verde 2024
bodyHtml: On the nose it shows Loureiro's classic floral and talc/bath salt notes but, with a citrus undertow, there's a sense of depth too. Sure enough a well-focused palate reveals juicy, ripe, rolling, limey acidity and finishes long and sapid with an airy, mineral, saline wash of vegetal flavours.

title: Borsao Red Seleccion Garnacha 2022
bodyHtml: This wine has a deep ruby colour, a big sweet kiss of licorice, kirsch liqueur and darker currants, and cherry red with violet nuances. Has a ripe fruit nose with floral tones. It is medium-bodied, refreshing, exuberant and fruity, pure and lusty spiciness and with a complex and long aftertaste.

title: Telmo Rodriguez Verdejo Basa 2024
bodyHtml: An elegant wine with notes of white flowers, citrus and a beautiful minerality. Goes well as an aperitif, with vegetarian dishes, goat cheese or a fennel and olive oil salad.

title: Bitch Grenache Calatayud 2021
bodyHtml: The bouquet of red berry fruits dominates this Grenache, which is lively and luscious. The taste is medium to full-bodied, with red and black cherries, raspberry, and fruit cake spice, and is rich and flavorful. The palate lingers for a long time, with beautiful, soft tannins.

title: Numanthia 2020
bodyHtml:
Numanthia 2020 originates from Spain, specifically from the Toro region within the Castilla y León subregion. The estate is a living tribute to the ancient city of Numancia, whose residents heroically resisted Roman invasion in 134 B.C.. Currently owned by LVMH, Bodega Numanthia is celebrated for its historic, ungrafted Tinta de Toro vines—some reaching 200 years old—that survived the phylloxera plague due to the region's sandy soils. The winemaking philosophy centers on revealing the potential of this "timeless" terroir by crafting wines that balance the extreme intensity of Toro’s climate with refined elegance and structural depth.

Wine Description

This red wine presents an intense, deep purple colour with reddish and violet rims. The 2020 vintage is noted for being fresher and livelier than its predecessors.

  • Aroma: A sophisticated bouquet of forest berries and ripe cranberries intertwined with dried flowers, cocoa, and sweet spices like cinnamon and nutmeg. Subtle notes of smoke, balsam, rosemary, and dry earth emerge with aeration.

  • Palate: Expansive and silky, delivering concentrated flavours of blackcurrants and forest fruits supported by fine, well-integrated tannins. It maintains a solid structure with a fresh acidity that lends a sense of refinement.

  • Finish: Long and persistent, with a distinct mineral touch of graphite and lingering notes of smoke and warm spices.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Tinta de Toro (Tempranillo) from vines aged 50 to 120 years.

  • ABV: 15.5%.

  • Organic Status: Certified Organic since 2020; the wine is made from ungrafted, low-yielding vines.

  • Stylistic Notes: Aged for 16 to 18 months in new French oak barrels with rackings every four months to ensure balance and soft texture.

title: Bodegas Muga Seleccion Especial 2020
bodyHtml: A deep, very dense black-cherry color.  The nose reveals ripe, red berry fruit aromas together with notes of spices (pepper) and forest floor against a backdrop of coffee variations, such as milk coffee toffee and roasted coffee beans mingling with subtle well-integrated oak.  Silky on the palate with tannins showing through, indicating the wine’s youth and good aging potential and providing an elegant and balanced structure.

title: Casa De Compostela Vinho Verde 2024
bodyHtml:
Casa Agricola de Compostela is situated in the region between Douro and Minho, in the parish of Requiao. The winery was founded in the 1960s by Manuel Gonçalves, and it remains family owned and operated, with a philosophy that has consistently pursued the highest standards of excellence. They produce their wine in the estate’s cellar, utilising modern processes including automation and control.

Wine Description

Casa De Compostela Vinho Verde is typically a white wine with a pale straw colour, sometimes showing subtle greenish hints, reflecting its characteristic freshness. The varietal composition for the Vinho Verde often includes a blend of indigenous grapes like Loureiro, Arinto, and Trajadura. Other varieties sometimes used are Alvarinho, Pedernã, and Fernão Pires. The wine is fresh, harmonious, and fruity. On the palate, it offers a refreshing burst of flavour with primary notes of citrus fruits, such as lemon and lime, alongside floral nuances and sometimes a touch of seaside.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings include seafood, particularly fish tacos with mango salsa, lighter grilled chicken dishes, and spicy food.

title: Luis Pato Vinha Pan 2018
bodyHtml: Wonderful, complex nose with oak, licorice and sweet red fruits. The taste is dry with medium body, good acid, and velvety tannins. Has flavours of ripe red fruit, as well as some tobacco. It is very complex with a long aftertaste. A bit like a modern Nebbiolo with a touch of burgundy, great stuff!

title: Luis Pato Vinhas Velhas White 2024
bodyHtml:
This exceptional white wine originates from Portugal, specifically from the Beira region within the Bairrada subregion. The story of the estate began in 1970 when João Pato became the first producer to bottle wines after the official demarcation of Bairrada. His son, Luis Pato, took over the family business in 1980, bringing his background as a chemical engineer to modernize winemaking practices while remaining fiercely dedicated to local terroir and indigenous Portuguese grape varieties.

Wine Description

Luis Pato Vinhas Velhas White 2024 displays a soft, bright lemon gold colour in the glass. The aromatic profile is highly expressive, offering notes of subtle lime, orchard fruits like apple and pear, and a touch of fennel blended with delicate herbal and white flower undertones. On the palate, this medium to full bodied wine delivers an incisive, well integrated structure showcasing citrus and melon flavours underscored by a distinct saline minerality and a hint of savory macadamia.

title: Bodegas Lan Edicion Limitada 2019
bodyHtml:
The 2019 Edición Limitada from Bodegas LAN is a distinguished red wine from Spain's renowned Rioja region. This limited edition blend comprises 82% Tempranillo, 10% Mazuelo, and 8% Graciano, sourced from 35 to 40-year-old vines in the Viña Lanciano estate. The wine undergoes meticulous vinification, including malolactic fermentation in new French oak barrels, followed by aging for 8 months in new French oak barriques and an additional 7 months in new Russian oak barrels.

Colour: Ripe cherry red, deeply colored and bright. 

Aroma: Intense aromas of ripe, almost candied black fruit such as plum, blackberry, and blackcurrant, complemented by notes of cocoa, toffee, black tobacco, spices, and a mineral streak characteristic of the Viña Lanciano estate.

Palate: Warm and velvety, with a round, ripe profile. The wine exhibits a very tannic yet elegant structure, offering flavors that mirror its aromatic profile. 

Body: Full-bodied with a robust and harmonious structure, showcasing both power and finesse.

Finish: Long and harmonious, leaving a lasting impression of its complex flavors. 

Accolades: 

93 Points - Wine Spectator

This wine exemplifies Bodegas LAN's commitment to quality and innovation, offering a modern expression of Rioja's rich winemaking heritage.

title: Bodegas Lan Crianza 2021
bodyHtml: Spending a year or more in oak before mellowing at least 12 more months in bottle prior to release, this Spanish beauty made from 100% Tempranillo delivers floral, vanilla and red plum fruit with sandalwood and strawberry preserve elements. A tremendous value, it will delight with smoked meats or ribs.

title: Finca El Puig 2022
bodyHtml: Well-balanced with a big structure and texture of fruits, delicate and ripe tannins and well-integrated wood with high acidity. Explosive fruit on the palate complements the complex aromatic expression of the nose with hints of liquorice, wild herbs and minerals. Long and very aromatic finish.

title: Aveleda Casal Garcia Vinho Verde (NV)
bodyHtml: One of the classic brands of Vinho Verde, this is still one of the best. It has great fruitiness and crisp acidity, only just off dry. Lemon sherbet and fresh orange zest give a delicious lift to the finish.

title: Breca Grenache Old Vines 2018
bodyHtml:
Breca is a richer, more concentrated, yet still balanced Garnacha with lots to love. Blackberries, licorice, roasted herbs, and hints of mulled cherries all emerge on the nose, and it's medium to full-bodied, with a great mid-palate, present tannins, and a terrific finish.

92 Points - Jeb Dunnuck

The 2018 Breca is a richer, more concentrated, yet still balanced Garnacha with lots to love. Blackberries, licorice, roasted herbs, and hints of mulled cherries all emerge on the nose, and it's medium to full-bodied, with a great mid-palate, present tannins, and a terrific finish.

92 Points - Wilfred Wong

The 2018 Breca Garnacha is formable and impressive. This wine shows up with aromas and flavors of bold and dense red and black fruits that stay long into the wine's finish. Enjoy it with grilled lamb kebabs.

title: Vintae Matsu El Picaro 2025
bodyHtml:
This red wine originates from Spain, produced in the Toro region of the Castilla y Leon province. Matsu is part of the Vintae luxury wine group, a project founded by Jose Miguel Arambarri Moeo and currently led by his sons, Ricardo and Jose Miguel. The winery's philosophy is rooted in a deep respect for nature and tradition, represented by the name 'Matsu', which is Japanese for 'to wait'. El Picaro, meaning 'the rogue' or 'the rascal', is the youngest wine in a trilogy that features different generations of viticulturists on its labels to reflect the age and personality of the wine within.

Wine Description

Vintae Matsu El Picaro displays an intense violet colour with great depth. The nose is expressive and powerful, offering aromas of ripe blackberries and raspberries layered with floral notes and subtle hints of mineral and cocoa. On the palate, the wine is medium to full bodied and fleshy, delivering concentrated fruit flavours that are balanced by a pleasant freshness and rounded tannins. It is characterized by its youthful energy and a long, persistent finish that echoes the dark fruit notes found on the nose. This 100% Tinta de Toro (Tempranillo) is sourced from old vines between 50 and 70 years of age and typically has an ABV of 14.5%. The wine is produced following biodynamic viticulture techniques and is not certified organic.

title: Marques De Caceres Reserva 2020
bodyHtml: Brilliant ruby. Robust smoke, spice-accented cherry, and red berry scents take a darker turn, picking up a floral nuance with air. Smooth and smoky on the palate, offering bitter cherry and rose pastille flavours plus hints of vanilla and licorice. The long gentle tannic finish repeats the cherry note.

title: Montecillo Gran Reserva 2019
bodyHtml: Deep cherry with russet rim. Clean and brilliant. Spicy notes on the nose, with vanilla and black fruit, balanced by an elegant touch of oak. Spice and notes of fine aging on the palate. Good structure, elegant tannins and a pleasant, lingering finish.

title: Marques de Murrieta Reserva 2021
bodyHtml:
The history of Marqués de Murrieta is deeply intertwined with the very origin of Rioja winemaking. Don Luciano Murrieta, an immigrant who trained in Bordeaux, applied his knowledge to craft the first Bordeaux oak-influenced Rioja wine in 1852. His vision was to create a fine, age-worthy Rioja wine for export, making his legendary 1852 vintage the first fine Rioja wine shipped abroad.

Wine Description

On the nose, it is truly expressive with multiple layers of ripe red fruit, such as cherry, red plum, and strawberry, complemented by notes of black pepper, red tea, sandalwood, and gentle ageing. The palate is flavourful and fresh, offering a full-bodied experience where rich fruit balances bright acidity. Hints of cedar, tobacco leaf, earthiness, and spice add complexity. The wine exhibits supple and silky tannins that frame the structure. It is a balanced, curated, and elegant red with a long, fresh finish that leaves a lasting impression of structure and spice.

Food Pairing

This Reserva pairs beautifully with hearty dishes that complement its structure, such as milk-fed lamb chops with buttermilk, or a suckling pig confit with its crunchy skin and caramelized apple.

title: Evodia Old Vine Garnacha 2023
bodyHtml:
This 100% Garnacha offers a lovely perfume of spice box, mineral, and wild cherry. This perfectly balanced mix of flavors lends itself to an intensely fruity wine with loads of taste, a smooth texture, and a pure, fruit-filled finish.

Pairs well with white and red meats roasted or grilled, big game, meat casseroles and stews, complex sauces, foie gras and legumes or blue and cured cheeses.

title: Laya Almansa Red Blend 2024
bodyHtml:
From Spain’s Castilla-La Mancha region, specifically the Almansa DO, this red blend is crafted by Bodegas Atalaya, part of the Gil Family Estates. Established to highlight the potential of Garnacha Tintorera and Monastrell in high-altitude vineyards, the winery has become known for producing bold yet approachable wines that express both tradition and innovation.

Wine Description

Deep cherry-red in colour with purple hues, the wine opens with aromas of ripe dark berries, violets, and Mediterranean herbs, accented by subtle mocha and spice. On the palate, it is juicy and fruit-forward, with polished tannins and lively acidity that give balance to its medium body.

Food Pairing

This wine’s ripe fruit and supple tannins make it an excellent companion to grilled meats, roasted lamb, hearty stews, and tomato-based pasta dishes. It also pairs well with aged cheeses and mushroom risotto. Together, they create an unforgettable dining experience.

title: Sogrape Vinhos Grao Vasco Dao Red 2023
bodyHtml: Ruby garnet red in colour with plumy, berry fruit aromas and flavours with leather nuances. Medium- to full-bodied with a prolonged finish.

title: Familia Conesa Finca La Sabina Cabernet Sauvignon Gran Reserva 2021
bodyHtml:
Familia Conesa is a distinguished winery situated in El Bonillo, Albacete, within the exclusive Denominación de Origen Pago Guijoso—one of only 18 such designations in Spain. The estate spans 3,000 hectares at an elevation of 1,100 metres, characterized by clay-loam soils rich in gravel. This unique terroir, coupled with significant diurnal temperature variations, fosters the production of wines with exceptional character and complexity .

Wine Description
The 2021 Finca La Sabina Cabernet Sauvignon Gran Reserva presents a medium-deep, intense Bordeaux-red hue with brick-red and ruby reflections. On the nose, it offers a complex bouquet featuring well-integrated French oak, ripe compote fruit, spices, and a floral hint reminiscent of violets. The palate is marked by a harmonious balance, showcasing mature and expressive tannins that contribute to its fleshy texture. As it evolves, the wine reveals a flavourful and expressive mid-palate, culminating in a satisfying finish .

Food Pairing
This robust Cabernet Sauvignon pairs excellently with grilled red meats, aged cheeses, and hearty stews. Its depth and complexity are further enhanced when accompanied by rich, savoury dishes, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

title: La Doncella Tempranillo 2022
bodyHtml: La Doncella is 100% Tempranillo from La Mancha, the region due south of the capital city of Madrid. The fruit is fresh and mildly spiced from the brief passage in oak casks.

title: Hacienda Lopez De Haro Blanco 2024
bodyHtml: Translucent light yellow in colour with a nose of stone fruit. Off dry, medium acidity, and medium body. On the palate, stone fruit, tropical fruit, and a good citrus backbone leading to a fresh finish. Matches well with smoked fish and vegetables.

title: Alianca Vinho Verde 2020
bodyHtml: Pale straw yellow colour; fresh, pronounced aromas of green plum, minerality and grapefruit; comes across as extra dry with intense and focused fruit and mineral flavours, crisp acidity and spritzy citrus finish.

title: Mas Marer Montsant 2018
bodyHtml: A blend of Cabernet, Merlot and Syrah, this wine is powerful yet velvety in texture, with strong aromas of red and black fruits and hints of tobacco and mocha. The flavours are just as rich and intense, but go down silky smooth and finish with a pleasant earthiness.

title: Descendientes de J. Palacios 'Petalos' Vinas Viejas 2022
bodyHtml:
Descendientes de J. Palacios 'Pétalos' originates from Spain, within the Castilla y León region and the Bierzo D.O. subregion. The winery was founded in 1999 by cousins Alvaro Palacios and Ricardo Pérez Palacios, who were drawn to the region's ancient vineyards and dramatic landscape. Their winemaking philosophy centers on a passionate commitment to biodynamic farming and gravity-flow production to capture the true spiritual and territorial essence of the local hillsides.

Wine Description

This red wine displays a clear, luminous ruby appearance and possesses a medium-to-full body with a polished, slightly angular structure. The sensory profile is highly fragrant and expressive, opening with an aromatic nose of fresh red fruit, ripe red cherries, black olives, and blue flowers, accented by subtle hints of undergrowth and baking spices. On the juicy palate, it delivers a lively bead of refreshing acidity mixed with flavours of wild berries, plums, and a light earthiness, supported by fine-boned, sandy tannins. The finish is long, persistent, and savory, leaving lingering mineral memories and fruit purity.

  • Varietal Composition: A traditional blend primarily composed of 85% to 93% Mencía, co-planted and supplemented with minor regional red varieties like Alicante Bouschet and white varieties including Jerez and Malvasía.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its incredible delicacy and transparency, undergoing fermentation with native yeasts in wooden and stainless steel vats before aging for roughly 8 to 10 months in mostly older French oak barrels.

  • ABV: 13.5%.

  • Organic Status: The entry-level cuvée is crafted entirely from sustainably managed plots and is certified biodynamic and organic.

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity, savory edge, and versatile structure of Pétalos make it a fantastic match for an array of rustic and flavorful dishes.

  • Meats: Pairs excellently with roast beef, barbecued meats, grilled lamb chops, hamburgers, or a peppery steak.

  • Game: Complements rich wild game options such as roasted venison or veal.

  • Savoury: Suggested pairings include traditional legume stews, wild mushroom risotto, or pizzas topped with pepperoni and spicy sausage.

  • Cheese: Matches wonderfully with mature, hard Spanish cheeses like Manchego.

title: Can Sumoi Xarel-lo 2023
bodyHtml: 100% Xarel·lo fermented with indigenous yeasts in tank. Twice-weekly batonnage for a further 3 months in tank before bottling. No additives; unfined and unfiltered.

title: Can Sumoi Perfum 2021
bodyHtml:
Moscatel 50 percent, Macabeo 30 percent, Parellada 20 percent Can Sumoi is Pepe Raventós and Francesc Escala's newest initiative, a hidden gem high in the Penedès mountains where they fulfill their vision and ambitions amid the amazing terrain and passion for natural wines. Freshness, vivacity, and identifiable floral aromatics characterize this Perfum with no sulphur added. A wine with a lot of character.

Pale yellow color. Delicate nose of white flowers, unripe peaches, grapefruit, lemon, and yeast with a subtle volatile typical of natural wines. The palate is fresh with medium acidity, flavors of yellow apples, cheese and bitter almonds.

title: Convento Da Gloria Tinta Roriz 2022
bodyHtml: This wine shows pronounced aromas of licorice, cola, chocolate and plums. The palate is medium to full bodied with distinctive chalky tannins and well integrated oak nuances.

title: Bodegas Ego El Goru 2022
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.

title: Mas Martinet Venus 2019
bodyHtml: Dark ruby in color, it is elegant and spicy on the attack and offers dark red berry fruit aromas with slate, black pepper and earth notes.

title: Bodegas Muga Blanco 2024
bodyHtml:
Bodegas Muga Blanco originates from the Rioja Alta subregion of the Rioja region in Spain. Founded in 1932, the winery is located in Haro’s historic Barrio de la Estación and is renowned for being the only winery in Spain with its own cooperage to handcraft all their barrels and vats. The family-owned estate emphasizes traditional winemaking techniques, such as gravity-fed racking and egg white fining, while maintaining a forward-looking vision for quality.

Wine Description

This wine presents a pale straw yellow colour with green reflections and fine tears in the glass. The aromatic profile is intense and complex, offering notes of white blossom, stone fruit, and citrus, nuanced by a slight hint of vanilla and fine pastry from its time in oak. On the palate, it is dry, silky, and well-balanced, featuring a lively acidity and a creamy texture that combines richness with energy. The finish is long and persistent, leaving a fresh and elegant sensation of salinity and citrus.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling - 92 points."

  • "Vinous - 92 points."

Food Pairing

The wine’s balanced acidity and complex profile make it an excellent companion for grilled fish, shellfish, seafood, and various rice dishes. It also pairs exceptionally well with smoked fish, roast chicken, and creamy cheeses like Brie or Camembert.

title: Numanthia Termes 2021
bodyHtml: Numanthia is located in the Toro region of Spain. Its four vineyards are located along the south bank of the Duero River. The wine is named after a legendary Spanish city that was destroyed (after 20 yrs of resistance) by Roman legions. It is to Spain what the hilltop village of Masada is to Israel: a monument of history. Its 40 hectares of land are covered with an abundance of elements derived from the disintegration of Pliocene grit, clay and limestone. Numanthia's first vintage was produced in 1998 and received a 95-point rating from Robert Parker. Since then, the Toro region has been producing wines that have begun to rival those of Spain's richest wine-producing regions of Ribera del Duero, Rioja and Priorat.

title: Mas Martinet Martinet Bru Priorat 2022
bodyHtml:
Martinet Bru is the door to Priorat. It is a wine of the times, more accessible in every sense. The estates where it comes from receive the south-west wind called garbinada, a humid sea breeze known for cooling the last hours of the hottest summer afternoons and helping to obtain slower and more extended ripening.  A modern, nice, appetizing and fresh wine, but with the typical structure and minerality of our region. The most drinkable slope in Priorat.

Concentrated bouquet with dark berry fruits, some herbs and spices and pleasant oak. On the palate also a good concentration, dark berries, sweet licorice, chocolate and sweet spices. Good acidity and tannin.

title: Roquette & Cazes Duoro 2022
bodyHtml:
Roquette & Cazes Douro is an exceptional red blend from the Douro Valley in Portugal, a UNESCO World Heritage site. This wine is the result of a celebrated partnership formed in 2002 between two friends: Jorge Roquette of the historic Quinta do Crasto in the Douro and Jean-Michel Cazes of the renowned Château Lynch-Bages in Pauillac, Bordeaux. Their winemaking philosophy centers on combining the natural power and indigenous grape varieties of the Douro with the elegance and technical expertise of Bordeaux.

Wine Description

This wine is a blend of traditional varieties, typically comprising 60% Touriga Nacional, 25% Touriga Franca, and 15% Tinta Roriz. It displays a deep violet to purple colour and offers an intense sensory profile. The nose is complex, featuring fresh aromas of wild berries, plum, and red fruits layered with elegant notes of violet, baking spices, and a hint of cocoa from oak aging. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and well structured, balanced by a fresh acidity and fine, velvety tannins. It was aged for 18 months in French oak barrels, resulting in a concentrated yet polished wine with a long, persistent finish.

title: Rioja Bordon Gran Reserva 2014
bodyHtml:
Made from Tempranillo, Graciano and Mazuelo from vineyards in the 3 sub-areas in Rioja with different soil types: Rioja Alta, Rioja Alavesa and Rioja Oriental, northward-facing in the foothills of the Sierra de la Demanda. The wine is aged in new and second-year medium-roasted white American (Ohio) and French oak barrels for 30 months, with decanting every 6 months to facilitate the natural filtering process. It then stays in the bottle for 36 months for refinement.

Ruby red in colour with russet hues. Complex in the nose, good intensity, balsamic, spicy, leathers, tobacco; all of this over a delightful candied fruit backdrop. A very enticing combination. In the mouth, elegant, tasty, highly aromatic, voluptuous tannins still present in the classical style and lasting through the aftertaste.

title: Rioja Bordon Crianza 2018
bodyHtml:
It is made from Tempranillo and Red Garnacha from vineyards in the three sub-areas in Rioja with different soil types: Rioja Alta, Rioja Alavesa and Rioja Oriental, northward-facing in the foothills of the Sierra de la Demanda. The wine is aged in medium-roasted white American (Ohio) and French oak barrels for 14 months, decanting every four months to facilitate natural filtering. It then stays for six months in the bottle for refinement.

Cherry red with a ruby rim and red fruit overtones. It is smoky with hints of licorice. In the mouth, it is clean, tasty, fresh and balanced. It has a lengthy finish, both fruity and spicy. Leathery black plum and currant aromas include a note of vanilla on a primarily harmonious and familiar Rioja nose. This Crianza feels juicy and solid. Plum, wild berry and mild oak flavours finish steady and direct, with smooth tannins.

title: Altano Red Wine 2023
bodyHtml:
Produced in Portugal's renowned Douro Valley, this wine hails primarily from the prime Cima Corgo and Douro Superior subregions. Altano is crafted by the Symington family, whose winemaking roots in the Douro span five generations since 1882, with an ancestral heritage dating back to the 17th century. Their philosophy focuses on vineyard ownership and sustainable viticulture, managing the largest collection of individual vineyards in the region to ensure a unique expression of the Douro's indigenous grape varieties.

Wine Description

This red blend presents a deep crimson or ruby-crimson colour. The aromatic profile is beautifully scented with notes of Mediterranean maquis vegetation, eucalyptus, and pine needle, layered with black plum, damson, and floral hints of rock rose. On the palate, the wine is full and silky, revealing fresh red fruit flavours of brambly boysenberry and cherry, balanced by peppery tannins and a mineral finish.

title: Hacienda Lopez de Haro Reserva 2019
bodyHtml:
All Bodega Hacienda López de Haro wines share something in common: grapes from the best wine regions of La Rioja, the dedication with which their winemakers work the vineyard and the affection that their winemakers devote to the elaboration of each wine.

This wine is ruby red in colour with a roof tile rim, which denotes its long barrel ageing and its peaceful bottle ageing. Powerful on the nose with primary aromas of ripe fruit accompanied by complex spicy and balsamic notes and a slight touch of vanilla. Balanced on the palate, it is a round and unctuous wine with ripe and sweet tannins, providing the wine with a long aftertaste. An elegant Rioja classic.

title: Torres Sangre De Toro
bodyHtml: Ruby red with garnet rim. Complex aromas of ripe cherry, black raspberry, chocolate and oak. Dry and medium-bodied with cherry, plum and sweet vanilla oak flavours and a slightly tannic finish.

title: Marques De Riscal Verdejo Rueda Blanco 2025
bodyHtml: One of Spain's most historic wineries, Marques de Riscal, started in Rioja in 1858. In 1862, it was the first winery to bottle Rioja. The winery continued to grow and expand through the years, producing verdejo in Rueda in 1972 and bringing Sauvignon Blanc to the area in 1974.

title: Bodegas Muga Reserva 2022
bodyHtml:
The wine has a bright ruby-red colour with medium depth and a garnet rim. Intense and complex on the nose, where you can find primary fruit aromas of raspberry and blackberry, secondary aromas of vanilla and licorice and a subtle hint of tertiary aromas such as chocolate and ripe fruit. Very well-balanced on the palate, with good acidity and soft tannins. The finish is long and fruity. Perfect for enjoying now, but also thanks to its great balance and structure, a wine you can lay down for a number of years.

This wine will make an excellent match for meat dishes, such as T-bone steak, and also with charcuterie and all kinds of casseroles.

title: Campo Viejo Rioja Reserve 2020
bodyHtml:
Spain’s renowned Rioja region is the birthplace of Campo Viejo Reserva. Located in the subregion of Rioja Alta, Campo Viejo is one of the most recognized producers in the country, known for blending tradition with modernity. The winery, part of the Pernod Ricard portfolio, has a long-standing reputation for expressive, fruit-forward wines shaped by sustainable winemaking practices and innovative cellar techniques.

Wine Description

This Rioja Reserva showcases a deep ruby red hue with garnet highlights that hint at its maturation. On the nose, it opens with layers of ripe blackberries, cherries, and plum, wrapped in nuanced notes of clove, black pepper, vanilla, tobacco leaf, and a touch of coconut. The palate is smooth and elegant, offering medium to full body with refined tannins and balanced acidity. Rich red and dark fruit flavours integrate with well-handled oak, leading to a long, harmonious finish.

Food Pairing

This structured yet fruit-driven wine is an excellent partner for herb-crusted lamb, grilled portobello mushrooms, or aged Manchego cheese. The smoky oak and savoury undertones make it equally suitable for braised beef dishes or roasted Mediterranean vegetables.

title: Fento Wines 'Bico da Ran' Albarino 2025
bodyHtml:
Zárate Bico da Ran originates from Spain, within the coastal Galicia region and the prestigious Rías Baixas appellation. Produced as part of the innovative Fento Wines project led by acclaimed winemaker Eulogio Pomares of Bodegas Zárate—an estate whose winemaking pedigree in the region dates back to 1707—the wine reflects a deeply rooted regional expertise. The operational philosophy behind this label focuses on capturing pure varietal character and vibrant energy. By sourcing fruit from prime, small plots across the historic Val do Salnés subregion, the project exalts the crisp, saline identity of coastal Galicia through natural, low-intervention viticulture.

Wine Description

This white wine presents a bright straw-yellow appearance with subtle, shimmering green highlights in the glass. It possesses a light-to-medium-bodied structure characterized by a zippy, crisp, and remarkably refreshing texture. The sensory profile is highly expressive, fruity, and aromatic, opening with an intense nose of zesty citrus fruits, passion fruit, and white peach, intricately woven with delicate notes of fresh fennel and an exotic tropical lift. On the vibrant, lively palate, it delivers a juicy wave of flavors reminiscent of biting into a ripe green apple and pear, seamlessly balanced by a bracing, electric natural acidity and a distinct vein of saline minerality. The finish is remarkably clean, long, and persistent, leaving a lingering impression of citrus peel, leafy freshness, and crunchy orchard fruit.

  • Varietal Composition: 100% Albariño.

  • Stylistic Notes: The wine is celebrated for its textbook varietal purity and thirst-quenching style. To retain maximum aromatic freshness, the grapes are hand-harvested early in the morning, followed by a cool fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks. The wine is cold-stabilized and filtered before bottling without any oak maturation, ensuring a crisp, unadorned expression of the fruit.

  • ABV: 12.5%.

title: Bodegas Lan Rioja Reserva 2019
bodyHtml: Bright, ripe cherry red. Intense and complex in aromas. Aromas of ripe red fruit, enveloped in white flowers, almond blossom and broom. Touches of cinnamon and resinous notes. Velvety on the attack, smooth and delicate. It is elegant, balanced and harmonious on the palate. A long finish, leaving a pleasant aftertaste that encourages you to take another sip.

title: Gazela Vinho Verde
bodyHtml: Pale yellow straw colour; light fruit aromas with citrus and mineral notes; dry, light bodied, with delicate fresh fruit flavours; tart and refreshing with a spritzy finish.

title: Zestos Garnacha Old Vines 2020
bodyHtml:
'Zestos' means 'basket' in English. Not too many years ago, baskets like the ones depicted on these labels were used to transport grapes from the vineyard to the wineries. If you love red wines of tension that exhibit purity and finesse or white wines of complexity and tremendous value you will find Bodega Zestos to be your new love. In the words of Robert M. Parker, Jr, the most influential wine critic in the world, Zestos is "A staggering value".

Vivid ruby. Lively red and dark berry aromas show good clarity and a touch of candied flowers. Supple and seamless in texture, offering juicy black raspberry and cherry flavours given spine by a gentle mineral nuance. Finishes fruity and broad, with a touch of white pepper adding lift and cut.

title: Muriel Vendimia Seleccionada Reserva 2018
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: This has a rich and dense nose with sweet and savoury dark red fruit aromas, well-concentrated with earthy chocolate elements and subtle oaking. Beautifully refined on palate, rich and sweet black fruit flavours are surrounded by silky tannins.

title: Mionetto Il Prosecco (NV)
bodyHtml: Medium straw colour with lively bubbles; medium-intensity citrus, pear and melon notes; dry, light-body, crisp, refreshing style.

title: Henriot Blanc de Blancs (NV)
bodyHtml:
Sparkling, crystalline pale gold with slight green highlights. Abundant effervescence, with fine, delicate bubbles. Pure, concentrated and expressive, with floral (honeysuckle, orange flower, linden), fruity (lemon, dried apricot, almond) and pastry aromas, followed by spicy notes. The attack is dynamic, full and powerful, with aromas of lightly toasted brioche, quince jelly, and acacia honey. The clean, delicious finish develops on a light menthol note and shows excellent length. Lovely as an aperitif or as an accompaniment to dishes such as foie gras terrine, roasted chicken, lobster rolls, smoked salmon or sushi.

93 Points - James Suckling     A rich and flavorful Blanc de Blancs with grilled pineapple, lemon curd, toasted sourdough, chalk, puffed rice and hints of balsamic on the nose. It’s medium-bodied with silky bubbles and fresh acidity. Delicious spice notes at the end. Chardonnay. 2015 base vintage with 35% reserve wines. 6g/l dosage. Disgorged May 2019. Drink now or hold.

93 Points - Decanter     Subtle notions of toast have a lovely tinge of lemon and roasted hazelnut on the nose. Lively mousse on a tender palate bubbles with toasty, nutty autolysis. As it warms up, the mousse softens and shows a sunny roundness of yellow stone fruit that sits well with the toasty yeast notes. Drinking Window 2020 - 2025

92 Points - Wine Spectator     A toasty edge of roasted hazelnut and subtle smoke is enmeshed with flavors of Asian pear, lemon sorbet and candied ginger in this elegant Champagne. Fresh and mouthwatering, with a finely detailed mousse. Drink now through 2023.

92 Points - Wine Enthusiast     Chardonnay from the Côte des Blancs yields up its typical crisp and mineral texture over the ripeness of the Henriot style. The Champagne is balanced, fruity with fine acidity to match and the bottling is ready to drink.

90 Points - Wine & Spirits     This wine’s light chamomile scent and spiced apple flavors give it a pure chardonnay profile. That, plus its powerful leesy grip, led one taster to describe it as “Chablis on steroids.” It’s rich and creamy, taking on fresh depths of pale chalk and pea-tendril flavors as it opens. The blend, including 40 percent reserve wines, is seamless.

90 Points - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate     The latest rendition of Henriot's NV Blanc de Blancs is showing well, opening in the glass with notes of nectarine, citrus oil, toasted bread and light reduction. Medium to full-bodied, fleshy and enveloping, with a generous core of fruit, lively acids and a pretty pinpoint mousse, it concludes with a saline finish. This is a comparatively rich iteration of this cuvée, and it should pick up additional complexity with age. Rating : 90+

title: Piper Heidsieck Brut
bodyHtml:
Make every moment even better with Piper-Heidsieck! Steeped in history, Piper-Heidsieck was born out of a love story that began in 1785 with German-born founder, Florens-Louis Heidsieck, crafting a wine to seduce his lover. It has become the most awarded Champagne House of the century and is celebrated for its innovative ideas and commitment to excellence.

Pale lemon with fine bubbles. Pronounced aromas of rye bread toast, hazelnuts and lemon tart with a hint of spice. Extra-dry and light to medium body with resonating flavours and a creamy texture.

title: Lanson Rose (NV)
bodyHtml: Lanson Rose Label has a beautiful pure colour with pale salmon touches. Aromas of roses and fruit predominate, with discrete notes of red berries. The initial impression is tender, well-rounded and fresh. This wine has a harmonious balance and good length on the finish. Delicious served with fresh red berry desserts or simply on its own.

title: Cleto Chiarli Vecchia Modena Lambrusco (NV)
bodyHtml: Light in color, dry, very pleasing bouquet and fine bubbles. ZYN loves it! This highest quality clone of Lambrusco has a tendency to drop its flowers which reduces yields and concentrates flavors because of sun exposure.

title: Martini & Rossi Asti (NV)
bodyHtml: Light green gold colour, delicate bubbles, lively sparkle; flowery aroma with apricots, peaches and lemon candy aromas; balanced acidity, sweet fruit flavour and finish.

title: Liebart Regnier Chardonnay Brut Blancs de Blanche (NV)
bodyHtml: 100% Chardonnay. The colour is a pale yellow colour with a hint of green and marvellous effervescence. The bouquet is light and delicate with an aroma of blossom and white fruit, and slightly buttery. A fine and well balanced palate.

title: Bellenda S.C. 1931 Metodo Classico Pas Dose (NV)
bodyHtml: By gently pressing Glera grapes, they produce a very complex and stylish base for spumante. The Champagne-method bottle fermentation then brings out the fragrant aromas and character to the fullest.

title: Charles Heidsieck Brut Reserve
bodyHtml:
A deep golden robe. Delicate vivacious and long-lasting bubbles are the result of more than 36 months of ageing in chalk cellars. With 40% of reserve wines (the maximum possible amount), the blend offers a complex, voluptuous nose with notes of freshly baked brioche and the richness of roasted coffee beans. A precise selection of wines, purposely limited to 60 crus, ensures the Charles Heidsieck Brut Reserve a deliciously sophisticated harmony. An opulent selection of ripe, sun-drenched fruits such as mango, apricot, and greengage plum combines with dried fruits, pistachio and almond. The texture is reminiscent of a crisp layer of nougatine on a velvety cream pastry filled with plump red plums and ripe cherries. The reserve wines, some dating back ten years give the wine lushness. The depth of the thousand-year-old chalk quarries where the wine matures offers a touch of praline along with notes of amber and vanilla.

Wine Spectator - 93 Points

This vibrant version shows a range of toasted brioche, baked cherry, crystalized honey, and grated ginger and coconut flavours, remaining light-footed and lively throughout. Beautifully balanced, with a lasting, mouthwatering finish.

title: Jean Louis Blanc De Blancs Charles De Fere (NV)
Norton Brut Rose Cosecha Especial
bodyHtml:
Made by selecting the best Chardonnay grapes in our vineyards, this sparkling wine´s splendid harmony and complexity are enjoyed through a soft and refined flavor that leaves memories of dry fruits with toasted bread and butter touches. Cosecha Especial Vintage pays tribute to 10 years creating Bodega Norton’s first high-end sparkling wine. It is made using the Traditional Method, which gives it an intense aroma and elegant acidity.  50% Chardonnay; 50% Pinot Noir.

Fresh, young and persistent in the mouth, with delicate notes of strawberry and cranberry. An elegant and effervescent finish.

title: Armand de Brignac Gold Brut (Ace of Spades)
bodyHtml:
The Brut Gold remains the most iconic cuvee in the range. Rich with the old-world traditions of champagne blending, it is a trio of vintages from some of the most lauded terroirs in the region, resulting in a prestige cuvée that expresses vibrant fresh fruit character and layers of complexity.

Peach, apricot and red berry aromas are followed by crystalized citrus, orange blossom and hints of brioche. The palate is rich with cherries, exotic fruits and a touch of lemon, vanilla and honey. The mouthfeel is soft and creamy, with a hint of toastiness, from the unique Armand de Brignac dosage, aged for one year in French oak barrels. Drinking beautifully now or can be rested under ideal cellaring conditions until 2025.

Ideal as an aperitif or pairs perfectly with seared scallops, roasted quail and freshwater fish.

Blend: 40% Pinot Noir, 40% Chardonnay, 20% Pinot Meunier.

title: Billecart Salmon Extra Brut Reserve
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This sparkling wine originates from France, produced in the heart of the Champagne region in the village of Mareuil-sur-Aÿ. Founded in 1818 through the marriage of Nicolas François Billecart and Elisabeth Salmon, Maison Billecart Salmon remains one of the few significant Champagne houses to be independently family owned, now managed by the seventh generation. The winery's philosophy is defined by a revolution in quality initiated in the 1950s, which introduced longer fermentations at lower temperatures and cold settling to preserve the characteristic freshness, finesse, and purity of their wines.

Wine Description

The Billecart Salmon Brut Reserve, often referred to as 'Le Réserve', displays a straw-gold colour with a persistent mousse and fine, slowly rising bubbles. The nose is aromatic and precise, offering scents of fresh pear, apple blossom, and citrus zest, layered with subtle floral notes and hints of biscuit or brioche. On the palate, the wine is light and harmonious, featuring a delicate texture with flavours of white flesh fruits such as crunchy apples and stone fruits. It is characterized by its remarkable balance, fresh acidity, and a long, persistent finish marked by minerality and a touch of roasted nuts. The varietal composition typically consists of 40% Pinot Meunier, 30% Pinot Noir, and 30% Chardonnay, often incorporating up to 50% to 60% reserve wines from 15 different vintages. The ABV is 12%. While the house emphasizes sustainable and meticulous vineyard management, this wine is not certified organic.

title: Antech Blanquette De Limoux Brut Reserve 2022
bodyHtml:
This family-owned producer is one of the most prolific in the Languedoc. Antech (pronounced AWN-tesh) is an incredible value, a beautiful, well-balanced sparkling wine that is a wonderful alternative for anyone who doesn't have the budget for Champagne. 

A blend of mostly Chardonnay, with some Chenin Blanc and Mauzac, this beauty is aged on the lees and has gorgeous honeyed apple and peach notes.

title: Henkell Rose (NV)
bodyHtml:
French cuvee craft meets German artisanal production: finely beaded Henkell Rosé is a refreshing, elegant sparkling wine created from selected red grape varieties. Its distinguished, gently fruity, berry-like flavour is the pinnacle of enjoyment for anyone who appreciates rosé with an international, dry character. Henkell Rosé’s finely arranged, harmonic composition makes for a well-rounded, complete taste experience.

Natural, strong salmon pink with orange reflections. Finely beaded mousse, lingering. Fresh aroma of red berries, underpinned by a hint of strawberry. Harmonious interplay between sweet and sour, berry-like fruity body, lingering finish.  Perfect as an aperitif, with light finger food, but also between fish and seafood courses, as a perfect all-rounder.

title: Ayala Brut Majeur (NV)
bodyHtml:
Pale gold in color with a fine mousse, the wine is aromatic on the nose. On the palate, it is well balanced and shows great finesse and complexity.

Pinot Noir and Chardonnay from the best grand- and premier crus bring vinosity and delicacy together in a very harmoniously balanced blend.The complement of Pinot Meunier adds a charming touch of fruitiness and liveliness.

Delicious as an aperitif, Brut Majeur is also the perfect wine to serve throughout a meal. It will pair perfectly with sea food, scallops, lobster, crab, fresh or grilled fish, fish terrines, salmonor beef carpaccio, as well as with sushi and Asian cuisine.

title: Bruno Paillard Rose Premiere Cuvee
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Bruno Paillard Rosé Première Cuvée is a multi vintage sparkling wine from France, specifically originating from the Champagne region. Founded in 1981 by Bruno Paillard at the age of 27, the house is the youngest in the region and remains an independent, family managed estate now led by his daughter, Alice. The winery is dedicated to a philosophy of purity and elegance, being the first producer in 1983 to display the disgorgement date on every bottle to provide consumers with transparency regarding the wine's development.

Wine Description

This refined Champagne presents a pink copper colour with hints of raspberry that evolves toward salmon with extended aging. The nose is complex and evolving, opening with initial aromas of redcurrant and red fruits that transition into morello cherry, wild strawberry, and violet as it breathes. On the palate, it reveals a creamy texture and captures red fruits at their peak freshness, balanced by racy acidity and an elegant, fine boned core. The finish is clean, bright, and remarkably long with persistent citrus and mineral notes. The blend is predominantly first pressing Pinot Noir—produced through both quick pressing for a white juice and prolonged maceration for a red wine—with a 'secret' amount of Chardonnay added for vivacity. It has an alcohol content of 12% ABV and is aged for a minimum of three years on the lees followed by at least five months after disgorgement. While the winery is certified organic and avoids the use of weedkillers or pesticides, this specific cuvée is often noted for its sustainable viticulture practices. The optimal drinking window is over the next 1 to 5 years.

Accolades

  • Wine Advocate - 93 points

  • Wine & Spirits - 94 points

  • Decanter - 93 points

  • James Suckling - 92 points

  • Wine Spectator - 92 points

  • Vinous - 92 points

Food Pairing

The vibrant acidity and savory fruit profile of this Rosé make it a sophisticated partner for both light and flavorful dishes. It pairs exceptionally well with fine Italian charcuterie, sushi, and tuna tartare. Its structural intensity also complements poultry such as duck breast or roasted chicken, as well as fresh red fruit salads and berry desserts. For cheese courses, it is best suited to soft options like Brie or aged Parmesan.

Vintage Quality

As a multi vintage blend, this cuvée draws on a 'sensory archive' of up to 25 different years stretching back to 1985 to ensure a consistent and vibrant house style. The house specifically utilizes reserve wines for half of the final blend, allowing the winemaker to adapt to annual climatic variations and maintain the trademark purity and minerality of the Champagne terroir.

title: Wolfberger Cremant d'Alsace Brut
bodyHtml: Cremant d'Alsace is great as an aperitif, alone or with appetizers.  It is delicious at the dinner table, particularly with seafood, salmon, shellfish, white meat and game, and harmoniously adapt to most desserts, cheese and majestically crowning a meal.

title: Segura Viudas Heredad Cava
bodyHtml:
Reserva Heredad was created to express style, in the world of top of the range sparkling wines. We make it with the objective of offering an elegant, versatile Cava. To do this, we select only the very best wines from each vintage, which will then age in bottle, in contact with the lees, for more than 24 months. This ageing ends when the winery expert gives every bottle the magic touch with the last “poignettage” or shake of the wrist, which intensifies the contact of the lees with the wine, and creates a more complex bouquet.

Straw yellow in colour, with a small, fine, plentiful mousse. The opening aromas are of the ageing on lees, lightly smokey, with touches of biscuit or bread, which are followed by hints of honey, fruit and flower petals. The palate is excellent, fruity and full of flavour, with dried fruits from the lees ageing, but very elegant, giving the drinker a delightful sense of abundance

title: Freixenet Cordon Negro - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Cordon Negro Brut is a crisp, clean and well-balanced Cava sparkling wine. The fresh palate of apple, ripe pear and bright citrus flavours combine with a long finish and an exciting touch of ginger. This brilliant, versatile Cava goes well with just about everything.

title: Veuve Du Vernay Rose (NV)
bodyHtml: Nice rose colour with a persistent mousse followed by numerous fine bubbles. On the nose, this wine sports forward red fruit scents combined with citrus fruit aromas. Well balanced and fleshy, this beautiful Rose shows on the palate the same fruity flavours as on the nose. Some acidulous notes on the finish give it a pleasant freshness. A really enticing wine!

title: Mionetto Pergolo Prosecco Spumante (NV)
bodyHtml:
General Information

A lovely Prosecco with light floral aromas and flavours of ripe apple and pear.

title: H. Billiot Fils Brut Reserve (NV)
bodyHtml: Located in the village of Ambonnay, H. Billiot Fils is overseen by Laetitia Billiot. The domaine was established in 1937, and today holds 5 hectares of vines. It is made from a blend of 75% Pinot Noir and 25% Chardonnay, and is aged 24 months sur-lattes. One of our favourite Grower Champagne producers! This classy sparkling wine offers round and textured notes of ripe red apple, poached pear, and baking spice.

title: Lanson Brut Black Label
bodyHtml:
Black Label Brut owes its iconic name to Victor Lanson, who gave it in 1937, as a proof of openness to the world and a tribute to the Royal Court of England, which Lanson has been supplying since 1900. Its freshness and elegance will seduce both the sprightly enthusiast and the most seasoned connoisseurs. Black Label Brut perfectly compliments an aperitif for a precious moment shared with those who matter and for those small pleasures of everyday life.

EYE... The colour is light and clear with amber highlights and a smattering of fine bubbles.

NOSE... Fruity notes of William pear, apple and citrus fruits compliment the aromas of freshly baked pastries.

PALATE... Bouquets of ripe orchard fruit, tangerine, lemon and grapefruit freshen the palate delivering a fresh sensation. Notes of brioche and dried fruit add a touch of maturity.

title: Andres Baby Duck (NV)
bodyHtml:
Launched in the 1970s, Baby Duck once dominated Ontario's burgeoning wine market. It still holds its own, with forward sweet fruit and lively bubbles.

Enjoy aromas and flavours of sweet table grapes and ripe pear. Serve well-chilled with Asian cuisine, jerk chicken or smoky barbecue.

title: Raventos Blanc de Blancs Brut 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This sparkling wine originates from Spain, specifically from the Conca del Riu Anoia subregion within the Penedes region of Catalonia. The Raventos i Blanc estate has a documented winemaking history dating back to 1497, representing one of the longest family-owned viticultural traditions in Europe. In 1872, Josep Raventos Fatjo produced Spain's first traditional method sparkling wine on this estate, and in 2012, the family made the decision to leave the Cava DO to focus on their unique terroir. The winery's philosophy is centred on biodynamic viticulture and a deep commitment to maintaining a self-sufficient ecosystem where nature and man work in synchrony.

Wine Description

The Raventos i Blanc Blanc de Blancs Brut displays a pale and bright colour, often featuring youthful green tints. The nose is fresh and mineral-inflected, offering a Mediterranean bouquet of green apple, citrus, fennel, and aromatic herbs, with subtle hints of brioche and honey. On the palate, the wine is clean and structured, delivering a spark of freshness with a lacy texture and fine bubbles. It is characterized by its tension and balance, presenting flavours of stone fruit and lemon curd underscored by a distinct salty or chalky minerality in the finish. This blend typically consists of Xarel-lo, Macabeu, Parellada, and a small percentage of Malvasia de Sitges.

title: Bernard Massard Cuvee de L'Ecusson Brut Rose (NV)
bodyHtml:
This elegant sparkling rosé originates from the Moselle region of Luxembourg. Founded in 1921 by Jean Bernard Massard, a winemaker trained in the prestigious Champagne region, the winery remains a family-run business dedicated to the traditional method of sparkling wine production. Over its 100-year history, Bernard Massard has become the official supplier to the Grand Ducal Court of Luxembourg, a testament to its commitment to quality and the refined winemaking philosophy established by its founder.

Wine Description

The Cuvee de L'Ecusson Brut Rose presents a brilliant, intense pink colour with subtle ruby-red tints and a fine, persistent bead. The nose is inviting and fragrant, redolent with an abundant bouquet of red berries—specifically raspberry, cherry, and wild strawberry—complemented by light floral undertones and a hint of green herbs. On the palate, the wine is fresh and lively with a silky, rounded texture and a delicate mousse. Flavours of strawberries and cream, cantaloupe, and orange pith are supported by a balanced acidity and a subtle mineral quality that leads to a long, zesty finish.

title: Henkell Trocken Sekt 375 ml
bodyHtml: This widely recognized sparkler has become much more tropical and ripe in recent years, the aromas are caramel, honey, roasted yellow apples, melon and vanilla atop smoke and mushroomy notes. Tropical fruits, marzipan, vanilla caramels and citrus peel lounge on a creamy and sweeter-style palate.

title: Bollinger Rose Brut
bodyHtml: A very pleasing and elegant Rose Champagne from The House of Bollinger that is made from a blend of 62% Pinot Noir, 24% Chardonnay and 14% Meunier grapes, mainly from Grand and Premier Cru vineyards. This pretty rose has rich notes of red cherries, red currants and wild strawberries. The high percentage of red wine offers soft tannins and a good structure to the wine. Its highly refined and velvety bubbles are smooth and vibrant with good length. Sip on its own or pair with a wide variety of dishes, from fresh salads to poached lobster and red berry fruit tarts.

title: La Scala Spumante
bodyHtml:
'La Scala Spumante' is an Italian style, medium sweet sparkling wine originating from Canada, specifically the Ontario appellation. It is often produced by Andrew Peller or Peller Estates. This vibrant sparkler is renowned for its lively, refreshing character and is perfect for casual sipping or as a base for a summer wine cooler.

Wine Description

This sparkling white blend is known for its light, refreshing, and lively character. It presents fresh, fruit-forward aromas, including juicy grapes and ripe melons. Other notes of grapefruit and floral hints may also be present. The flavour profile is a bright expression of white grapes and tropical fruits, balanced with just the right amount of sweetness, making it a medium sweet wine. Some descriptions also mention notes of green apple, pear, and citrus.

Food Pairing

Suggested pairings for 'La Scala Spumante' are tailored to its medium sweetness and vibrant, fruity profile. It pairs beautifully with seafood, such as seafood salad, smoked salmon, oysters, prawns, and scallops.

title: Louis Roederer Rose Brut 2016
bodyHtml: A great rose champagne must be made from very ripe grapes, which are sometimes difficult to obtain in the Champagne climate. As a result, Louis Roederer has chosen to invest in one of the earliest Champagne crus, Cumieres, for which the steeply-sloping, shallow clay and limestone soils face south and benefit from the additional light reflected from the river Marne, enabling phenolic maturity to be achieved. In these select terroirs, Louis Roederer applies the precise winemaking methods required for the production of a saignee rose. The style of this rose is elegant, full-bodied and with delicate fruitiness (red fruits). Louis Roederer Brut Rose is 100% estate-bottled from the grapes of the historic family-owned vineyards.

title: Dr Loosen Sparkling Riesling (NV)
bodyHtml: Dr. L Sparkling Riesling is 100% pure Riesling, the crisp, fruity grape that has made German wine famous for centuries. It is made using the Charmat method, where the second fermentation is done in a pressurized tank to keep the bubbles in the wine. This method produces bright, clean sparkling wines in a more affordable way, which makes it possible to offer this charming wine at a very nice everyday price.

title: Bellavista Cuvee Brut Franciacorta Alma (NV)
bodyHtml:
Bellavista is considered among the finest of Italian sparkling wine producers and boasts 200-hectares of vineyard planted to chardonnay and pinot noir. The winery lies within western part of the Franciacorta and pulls fruit from across 10 communes and 103 parcels. Alma Gran Cuvee is made in the traditional method with some 15 percent of the wine being fermented and matured for seven months in small oak barrels. The final assemblage includes reserve wine from six to nine years old before it all spends 30 months on the lees. The result is a stylish bubble with floral undertones, green fruits and dried herbs enveloped in a stream of acidity that runs from the front to the back. The blend is 80/20 chardonnay/pinot noir with a mere one percent of pinot bianco to respect its Italian heritage.

91 Points - James Suckling

Pretty aromas of bread dough, lemon and cooked apple. Fresh. Medium to full body, tangy acidity and a fruity finish. Always an outstanding sparking wine.

title: Piper Heidsieck Brut - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Vibrant acidity and flavours of toasted brioche, crushed blackberry, candied ginger and salted almond ride the fine, satiny texture of this harmonious Champagne, which features a fresh, graphite-tinged finish.

title: Henkell Trocken Sekt
bodyHtml: This widely recognized sparkler has become much more tropical and ripe in recent years, the aromas are caramel, honey, roasted yellow apples, melon and vanilla atop smoke and mushroomy notes. Tropical fruits, marzipan, vanilla caramels and citrus peel lounge on a creamy and sweeter-style palate.

title: Bottega 'Petalo' Il Vino dell Amore Moscato
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the Colli Euganei area, Bottega Petalo Moscato represents a sweet, highly aromatic, and elegant expression of Italian sparkling winemaking. Known as Il Vino dell'Amore or The Wine of Love, this cuvée is produced by Bottega SpA, a family-owned winery established by Aldo Bottega in 1977. Sourced from estate and contract vineyards grown in nutrient-rich volcanic soils, the winemaking philosophy focuses on soft pressing of the grapes, cold storage of the unfermented must, and a single temperature-controlled fermentation in pressurized stainless steel autoclaves using the Italian Martinotti-Charmat method. The fermentation is intentionally stopped at a low alcohol level to preserve the natural sugars, vibrant fruitiness, and delicate floral bouquet of the Moscato grape.

Wine Description

The wine presents a clear, pale straw yellow colour with luminous golden highlights and a fine, persistent perlage in the glass. An extraordinarily expressive and sweet bouquet opens with fragrant aromas of yellow peach, candied apricity, and sweet orange blossom, interwoven with distinctive notes of wild rose petal, honeysuckle, acacia honey, and ripe melon. On the palate, it is light-bodied, velvety, and deliciously sweet, delivering rich flavours of white nectarine, citrus marmalade, and subtle elderflower, all balanced by a soft streak of natural acidity and a delicate, creamy effervescence. Finishing smooth, aromatic, and refreshingly sweet, it leaves a long, memorable impression of fresh rose petals and juicy orchard fruit. Composed of 100% Moscato, it effortlessly combines low alcohol lightness with intense floral aromatics and balanced residual sweetness.

title: Moet & Chandon Brut Imperial (NV) - 375 ml
bodyHtml: Pale straw in colour with a fine mousse and defined aromas of apple, pear, citrus and fresh baked bread. The palate is extra-dry and medium body with lovely replay of flavours from the nose with a mineral note on a clean finish.

title: Yellow Tail Bubbles Rose (NV)
bodyHtml: Pale pink colour with fine bubbles. Soft aromas of strawberry, raspberry and a subtle citrus undertone. Cheers!

title: Moet & Chandon Nectar Imperial (NV)
bodyHtml:
Nectar Imperial is a delicious expression of the Moet & Chandon style, a style distinguished by its bright fruitiness, its seductive palate, and its elegant maturity.

The captivating density of exotic fruits (pineapple, mango).  The silky firmness of stonefruits (mirabelle plum, apricot).  The brisk freshness of grapefruit notes.

title: La Tordera X Dry Prosecco Alne 2022
bodyHtml: Beautiful bright straw yellow color with greenish hues. The nose offers fragrant fruity and floral scents that recall the aromas of green apple, pear, wisteria and acacia. On the palate it is fruity, a glass characterized by high acidity supported by a creamy effervescence.

title: Villa Sandi Il Fresco Rose Brut (NV)
Adami Bosco Di Gica Prosecco (NV)
bodyHtml: A straw yellow colour. Creamy mousse and delicate, long-lasting bead. On the nose, it is rich, with excellent fruit, releasing scents of yellow apple and peach, with notes of wisteria and acacia blossom. Wonderful balance and elegance complement a pleasurably crisp spiciness. The palate holds a delicious vein of acidity, displaying a crisp, savoury mouthfeel. Generous, lingering flavours nicely mirror the nose and achieve perfect balance.

title: Costadila Col Fundo Prosecco (NV)
bodyHtml:
General Information

Upfront orange zest, mildly bitter on the palate, earthy and vanilla undertones.

title: Pares Balta Cava Brut
bodyHtml: Pares Balta Cava Brut is a deliciously dry, sparkling wine made in the Champagne method yet with plenty of bright, soft fruit flavours. It has a medley of white peach, apple, pear, melon and lime fruit on the nose, with a gentle creamy smokiness from the time this Cava spent on its lees. Rich flavours of apple, honeydew, peach and mineral notes on its fruit-forward and nicely balanced palate, with a clean, tropical fruit-infused finish.

title: Cazadores Blanco Tequila
