bodyHtml: Tequila Cazadores Blanco is 100% Blue Agave and is a smooth, easy-going Tequila. It tastes as clean as it looks and plays well with others. The slightly sweet taste and soft finish make it highly versatile and perfect for mixing in cocktails. Tequila Cazadores, Spanish for "hunters", symbolizes Señor Jose Maria's constant pursuit to create the world's finest premium Tequila.

title: Zacapa Centenario Rum
bodyHtml:
A firm favourite at ZYN, this is a truly superb Guatemalan rum, blended using the solera system. Sublime stuff. This was matured in a mix of bourbon and sherry casks.

Nose: Very sweet and nutty, honey and chocolate. Dark brown sugar, gentle smoke. Pipe tobacco.

Palate: Very sweet and soft. Dark brown sugar, molasses, rounded, so gentle.

Finish: Thick, medium length, hint of smoke on the tail.

title: Dewar's White Label
bodyHtml:
This was first created over a century ago by the Dewars master blender. White Label contains around 40 different whiskies in the blend, with Aberfeldy at its heart.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Hangar One Straight Vodka
bodyHtml: Sweetish, thick,and slightly oily on the tongue, with a plump, round taste to it. A wonderful, round mouthfeel to it; almost creamy in texture. A damn near perfect blend of wheat and grape distilates that form a wonderful balance of tastes from both. A slight warming of alcohol as it goes down the throat, more like a caress, not the burn like you get from a lot of other vodkas.

title: Kilbeggan Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Kilbeggan is a fine blend of malt and grain whiskies assembled to produce a smooth whiskey with a warming finish. With of aromas of honey, vanilla and heather and subtle flavours of vanilla, cereal, oatmeal and spice, each sip is a wonder to savour. The finish plays gently on the tongue. Enjoy neat, or in an Irish coffee.

See More Irish Whisky

title: Captain Morgan White Spiced Rum
bodyHtml:
We’ve got ourselves a party staple. Understated, smooth, but never dull, this Captain is the perfect addition to any party. This blend of Puerto Rican rum and tropical spices tastes great in a variety of cocktails. If you’re looking for a complimentary spirit, you’ve found it. Stir it u!

Tasting Notes

Strong vanilla aroma with a hint of cassia, light bodied, with a rounded vanilla character.

title: Lemon Hart Rum
bodyHtml: Lemon Hart & Son Original 1804 is the classic British-style black rum, cherished by rum drinkers around the world for its bold, rich flavour, full-bodied complexity and exceptionally smooth finish. Original 1804 is the perfect example of a rum that shows pronounced flavour when mixed with cola. A premium blend of select single estate rums, distilled, Bourbon barrel-aged and blended on the East Bank of the Demerara River in the lush tropical Caribbean country of Guyana. Rum always.

title: Laphroaig Select
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Laphroaig Select is a single malt Scotch whisky from the Isle of Islay, Scotland. The distillery was founded in 1815 by brothers Donald and Alexander Johnston and is now owned by Beam Suntory. Laphroaig is famous for being one of the most flavourful and peaty whiskies in the world, even earning a Royal Warrant from the Prince of Wales in 1994. This specific expression was created as a collaborative project, where the final blend was chosen by the 'Friends of Laphroaig' fan community from several potential recipes.

Spirit Description

The whisky has a sparkling gold appearance with layered tones. On the nose, it offers a forward aroma of medicinal peat smoke, followed quickly by ripe red fruits and a hint of citrus. The palate is initially sweet and full-bodied, giving way to the distillery's signature dry, ashy, and smoky character with notes of seaweed and soft vanilla. The finish is long and lingering, featuring floral notes and subtle hints of marzipan and lime. Bottled at 40% ABV, it is a blend of whiskies matured in five different cask types: Oloroso sherry butts, Pedro Ximénez hogsheads, first-fill bourbon barrels, quarter casks, and new American oak.

title: Smirnoff Vodka - 750 ml (Plastic Bottle)
bodyHtml: Smirnoff Vodka is the largest vodka brand in the world. It is an ultra smooth vodka with a classic taste that has inspired other varieties of vodkas worldwide.

title: Alberta Pure Vodka - 1.14 Litre Bottle (Plastic Bottle)
bodyHtml:
Alberta Pure vodka has a sparkling clarity and clean smooth character. Clear, water-like; clean, neutral with some sweet notes and a long finish with some heat. 

Gold Medal, International Wine & Spirits Competition 2018.

title: Ballantine's Finest - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Ballantine's Finest is the oldest recipe in the current range, created in 1910 by the Ballantine family. It is blended for balance and pours a brilliant golden colour. The nose is fragrant with barley grain and light peat aromas, while the palate is soft, round and slightly sweet with dried fruit and grain flavours.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Jim Beam Double Oak
bodyHtml:
Jim Beam Double Oak is first aged in charred oak barrels and then poured into a second barrel for further maturation. Enjoy forward aromas and flavours of caramel, burnt sugar, vanilla and charred oak. Soft and smooth, with a long, sweet and spicy finish. Superb in a Manhattan, or pair with woodfire-grilled steaks.

See More USA Whisky

title: Casamigos Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Longtime friends George Clooney, Rande Gerber and Mike Meldman love Casamigos. On the rocks, by the shot, at times, straight from the bottle. Tequila filled nights with friends is how Casamigos was born. Their idea was to make the best tasting, smoothest Tequila and Mezcal that didn’t have to be covered up with salt or lime. So they did.

They are delighted that consumers and Tequila and Mezcal connoisseurs alike enjoy and appreciate the authenticity of Casamigos. This is quality you can taste, so raise a glass with their award winning spirit. 

The name Casamigos comes from the Spanish casa (house) and amigos (friends), thus "house of friends."

Golden honey. Caramel with hints of cocoa. Notes of dried fruits and spicy oak with a touch of sweet agave. Purified water from their own well.

title: Crown Royal - 1.75 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Amber in colour the nose is lightly floral with corn, buttery vanilla and peach aromas. On the palate look for a light sweet peach flavour with wood spice on a dry finish.

title: Crown Royal Black
bodyHtml:
Matured in charred oak casks and blended at a higher proof to deliver a more concentrated, full-bodied flavour, it pours a dark copper and offers aromas of orange peel, bruised apple, vanilla and cinnamon. The palate is creamy with flavours of sweet spice with toffee and dried apple followed by a warming finish.

title: Captain Morgan Spiced Rum
bodyHtml:
When it comes to making your night legendary, the Captain knows that there are no mistakes. His Original Spiced Rum is certainly no exception. This versatile blend works well in any scenario. Is tonight your time to try it?

Mixed spices, special fruit flavours and heavy vanilla notes come together with a slight spiciness and heavy body to create a perfectly balanced spirit with a smooth finish.

bodyHtml:
Alberta Pure vodka has a sparkling clarity and clean smooth character. Clear, water-like; clean, neutral with some sweet notes and a long finish with some heat. 

Gold Medal, International Wine & Spirits Competition 2018.

Ballantine's Finest is the oldest recipe in the current range, created in 1910 by the Ballantine family. title: Tomatin 14 Year Old Portwood Highland Single Malt
bodyHtml: Aged in bourbon casks then finished in tawny port pipes. Brilliant copper with a rose hue. The nose is fragrant with aromas of toffee, pepper, dried fruit, berry and toasted nuts. The palate is luscious and warming with flavours of fruitcake, cigar, chocolate and red fruit on a long, spicy finish. Enjoy neat or on ice.

title: Auchentoshan 12 Year Old Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
This Auchentoshan 12-year-old expression replaced the old 10 year-old when the range was totally revamped. Elegant and refined, with those classic Auchentoshan notes of vanilla and almonds.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Amrut Peated Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
According to Indian Mythology, when Gods and Rakshasas – the demons – churned the oceans using the mountain Meru as a churner, a golden pot sprang out containing the Elixir of Life. That was called the “Amrut”. The great founders of the distillery aptly named it Amrut Distilleries.

Nose : Unusually dry peat; not dissimilar to peat reek absorbed by an old leather armchair; a hint of citrus, too;

Taste : Despite the nose, the immediate sensation is one of being caressed by molassed sugar and then a ratching up of the peat notes. As they get more forceful, so the experience becomes that little bit drier and spicier, though not without the molasses refusing to give way;

Finish : You can tell the quality of the distillate and the barrels it has been matured in by the crystalline depth to the finish. Everything is clear on the palate and the butterscotch vanillas wrap the phenols for a comfortable and clean finale

title: Wild Turkey 101 - 750 ml
bodyHtml: This bottling of Wild Turkey has been aged for at least 6 years before coming out of the barrel at 109 proof. It is only diluted slightly before bottling at 101 proof with plenty of pep.

title: Seagram's VO - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The 'VO' stands for very own and was first released in 1913 to celebrate the marriage of Thomas Seagram. A blend of more than 20 whiskies, it pours a brilliant golden amber colour and offers aromas and flavours of dried apricot, hazelnut and a touch of vanilla. Balanced and smooth it finishes dry with delicate floral notes.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Cragganmore 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
A complex Speyside single malt whiskey praised for its depth and complexity. John Smith designed Cragganmore distillery around unique flat-topped stills to deliver complex flavours. It is a true designer malt.

APPEARANCE... Gold.

BODY... Firm, rounded, light to medium.

NOSE... A combination of sweet floral fragrances, riverside herbs and flowers with some honey and vanilla.

PALATE... A strong malty taste with hints of sweet wood smoke and sandalwood.

FINISH... A long, malt-driven finish with light smoke and hints of sweetness.

Serve on the rocks in a tumbler or tulip glass to concentrate its flavour, and add a splash of water to release more of its complexity.

title: Cachaca Jamel - 1 Litre
bodyHtml: Jamel Cachacas consider themselves one of the very first cachacas produced in Brazil. Made from the press of sugar cane--and called "sugar cane brandy.

title: Jameson - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
A versatile and smooth blend of pot still and fine-grain whiskeys. Bright pale amber in the glass, with subtle aromas of white flower, nectarine, ripe pear and clove. Mellow and approachable on the palate, with a gentle impression of alcohol and flavours that include spicy vanilla, wildflower honey and ginger.

See More Irish Whisky

title: Bacardi White Rum - 1.14 Litre Bottle (Plastic Bottle)
bodyHtml: Bacardi Superior Rum is the original Bacardi rum, dating back to 1862 when Don Facundo Bacardi Massó purchased his first rum distillery in Cuba. 150 years later, Bacardi Superior is now manufactured in Puerto Rico, but the recipe remains largely the same. A unique strain of yeast discovered in the Cuban sugarcane fields is used to produce Bacardi Superior rum. The rum is filtered through charcoal, a process pioneered by Bacardi, before and after it is aged in oak barrels for at least one year.

title: Highwood Pure Canadian Vodka - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml: Our flagship Vodka is tripled distilled resulting in a wonderfully pure classic vodka. What makes a crowd stand out is it is distilled from locally grown Canadian wheat then blended with pure natural Rocky Mountain water. Highwood is among the few who use wheat, instead of corn, for some of our vodkas. Resulting in a crisp, clean, soft, natural vodka of superb integrity.

title: Nikka From The Barrel - 500 ml
vendor: 300407 - Enoteca Bacco Importers Of Fine Wines &
bodyHtml:
Nikka From The Barrel is a blended whisky. The development of this expression started with an aim to deliver full flavours and richness of whisky like "from the barrel", which only blenders can sniff and taste. The secret behind its gorgeous flavour is the unique combination of complex blending, higher ABV 51.4% and the "marriage" process.

The iconic square bottle reflects its concept "a small block of whisky" and embodies the intense and rich flavours of the whisky inside. Long after its launch, this bottle is still timeless and recognized for its ultimate simplicity.

The complex formula is created by blending more than 100 different batches of malt and grain whiskies. After blending, the whisky is filled into used barrels and matured for another few months. This "marriage" process harmonizes all components in the formula, resulting in a mellow taste. Bottling is controlled at 51.4% ABV, almost equivalent to 90 British proof, that Nikka blenders determined through repeated experiments to achieve the ideal taste profile.

title: Famous Grouse - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
One of the world's most popular blends, and the best-selling Scotch whisky in Scotland, Famous Grouse is a very nicely balanced, malty blend which was first made in 1896. In fact, it was created by Matthew Gloag's company after he was asked to supply wines for a royal banquet with Queen Victoria in attendance. His son, William, perfected a blend named The Grouse, renaming it The Famous Grouse in 1905. Around eighty years later, the company was awarded a Royal Warrant. The blend represents great value for money, and it also works beautiful in whisky-based cocktails. Delicious.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Tullibardine 225 Sauternes
bodyHtml: Distilled at Tullibardine in the Highlands, this is a very tasty whisky which was finished in a 225-litre cask, thus the name which previously held maturing Sauternes dessert wine from Chateau Suduiraut. The result is a golden-coloured single malt with a deliciously creamy, fruity flavour.

title: Glenlivet 15 Year Old French Oak Reserve
bodyHtml: Glenlivet 15-Year-Old French Oak Reserve is currently made at the Glenlivet distillery, nestled in the Speyside region of Scotland. This single-malt Scotch whisky is celebrated for its exquisite flavour profile. It showcases a delicate balance of fruity and spicy notes, with hints of ripe apples, cinnamon, and rich toffee. The maturation in French Limousin oak barrels imparts subtle vanilla and nuttiness, adding depth and complexity to the whisky. Critics frequently applaud Glenlivet 15-Year-Old French Oak Reserve for its smoothness, elegance, and well-integrated flavours. It is often deemed a sophisticated and refined choice for whisky enthusiasts seeking a memorable Speyside experience.

title: Highland Park 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Highland Park 12 Year Old Viking Honour is the core flagship single malt from the Highland Park Distillery, located in Kirkwall on the Orkney Islands, Scotland. Founded in 1798 by Magnus Eunson, a direct descendant of Vikings and a legendary illicit distiller known as the 'Whisky Priest', it is one of the ten oldest working distilleries in Scotland. Today, the distillery is owned by The Edrington Group, which also manages other iconic brands such as The Macallan and Glenrothes.

Spirit Description

This iconic expression is matured predominantly in first-fill, sherry-seasoned European and American oak casks, creating a profile that balances maritime influence with mellow warmth.

  • Colour: The whisky pours a glowing natural golden amber.

  • Aroma: Fresh and clean on the nose, featuring floral notes of heather, Manuka honey, and light peat smoke, accented by citrus fruits like lemon and grapefruit.

  • Palate: Rather full and rounded with sweet flavours of Seville oranges, spiced fruitcake, and toasty notes of burnt orange and jasmine.

  • Body: A well-rounded, medium to full body that mingles fruit, sweetness, and earthy notes.

  • Finish: A long and sultry finish that settle with notes of heather, peppery spice, and a subtle aromatic kick of Orkney heathered peat smoke.

  • ABV: Typically bottled at 40% or 43% depending on the market.

Accolades

Highland Park 12 is a globally celebrated whisky, frequently recognized in spirits competitions for its consistent quality.

  • 96 Points: Received the 'Tried & True Award' at the Ultimate Spirits Challenge 2019.

  • Gold Medal: The Fifty Best Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2018.

  • 92 Points: Highlighted by 'Whisky Advocate' for its complexity and balanced maritime profile.

title: Plantation Pineapple Rum
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

A rich and delicious bouquet, accented by smoky notes and aromas of tropical fruit, pineapple, citrus peel and a touch of clove. The palate opens with a structured, pleasant sensation of ripe banana, pineapple and spices layered in a smoky finish.

title: Alberta Pure Vodka - 750 ml (Glass Bottle)
bodyHtml: Alberta Pure is a clear, grain-based vodka and tends to be smooth and fruity.

title: Stolichnaya Blueberi Vodka
bodyHtml:
Plump ripe berries lead the nose, with blueberry, black currant and lemon fruits, and to the back, a medicinal hint of juniper.

Stoli® Blueberi™ offers a mouth feel that is smooth and creamy, with a buttery grain character and an aromatic note of eucalyptus.

title: Jose Cuervo 'Reserva De La Familia' Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
José Cuervo Reserva de la Familia was introduced in 1995 to celebrate the 200-year anniversary as the world’s leading producer of tequila. Each bottle is handmade, numbered, dated and sealed in wax. Every year the Cuervo family commissions a different Mexican artist to design the new collectible box for Jose Cuervo Reserva de la Familia collection. José Cuervo. Only 17,000 bottles of Reserva De La Familia are produced each year, in collectors boxes designed by Mexican artists.

This Extra-Añejo tequila is aged in oak barrels for an average of 3 years. The final blend includes Tequila from reserves aged over 30 years. Only the estate’s finest 10-year-old agaves are hand-selected. Only the most flavourful inner portion of the agave’s piña (heart) is used. Vibrant, with a full, mellow flavour combines floral, agave, vanilla and Cognac like flavours.

title: Bowmore 15 Year Old
bodyHtml: Bowmore 15-Year-Old is currently crafted at the Bowmore distillery on the Isle of Islay in Scotland. This single-malt Scotch whisky is highly regarded for its exceptional quality and craftsmanship. Its flavour profile offers a delightful balance of smoky and sweet notes, with nuances of dark chocolate, citrus, and a hint of sea salt. Critics frequently applaud Bowmore 15-Year-Old for its complexity, elegance, and smoothness. The whisky has garnered praise for its well-integrated flavours, with a gentle peat smoke that adds depth and character. It is cherished by whisky connoisseurs seeking a refined and memorable Islay experience.

title: Kraken Black Spiced Rum
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

An excellent spiced rum, with utterly brilliant packaging! It has an extraordinarily rich, spicy flavour. Named for the legendary sea monster, Kraken is a blend of Caribbean rums that should certainly suit any fans of rich, navy-style rum.

title: Bacardi Reserva Ocho Aged 8 Years Rum
bodyHtml:
The Bacardi brand was established in 1862 by Don Facundo Bacardí Massó in Santiago de Cuba, and it revolutionized rum production by introducing innovations like charcoal filtration, controlled fermentation, and aging in white oak barrels.

Rum Description

This is a complex golden or warm amber rum with golden hues. The aroma is rich with notes of prune, apricot, and vanilla, complemented by a hint of nutmeg. The palate is described as smooth and velvety, with flavours of stone fruits, spices, and oak, alongside a touch of toffee. It is known for its mellow flavour and full body, crafted from a selection of rums aged for a minimum of eight years in American oak barrels. The final blend is smooth, rich, and very full of flavour.

title: Aberlour A'Bunadh
bodyHtml:
General Information

Meaning 'the original' in Gaelic, A'bunadh is made in homage to Aberlour's founder, James Fleming and has achieved a cult following among malt lovers. Deep rich amber colour with copper highlights. Heady aromas of toffee, smoky brine and peach compote. Creamy, sweet and laden with warm toffee and baked fruit notes. 61.5 ABV.

title: Ryan's Irish Cream - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
Ryan's Irish Cream is made with dairy-fresh cream, rich chocolate, natural vanilla, and the finest imported Irish Whiskey for a critically-acclaimed taste.

Granted a gold medal from the International Spirits tasting panel for Smoothest Liqueur, Ryan's is an indulgent treat sipped neat, chilled, in hot or cold coffee or in an after-dinner cocktail.

title: Cazadores Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

This small batch handcrafted tequila goes through double fermentation and double distillation then aged for twelve months in virgin American oak barrels. Pours a golden colour into the glass with vibrant notes of dried fruits, spices such as cinnamon, vanilla and fresh oak. The finish is long with silky smooth texture.

title: Alberta Springs 10 Year Old Rye
bodyHtml:
A well-priced, versatile Canadian rye whisky showing aromas of toffee and oak that finishes with a peppery kick.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Redbreast 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: This elegant single pot still whisky pours a brilliant golden/amber colour; on the nose expect complex aromas of floral, honey, sweet fruits and lime; full-bodied and robust on the palate with a creamy mouth-feel and flavours repeated from the nose followed by an enduring finish reminiscent of butterscotch.

title: Tierra Noble Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Intense dark amber colour with a hint of red. On the nose this Tequila is very smooth and pleasant with a range of aromas from fruity and sweet to vanilla, prunes, chocolate and toasted almonds along with hints of apricots and tobacco and soft oak notes. On the palate you'll be delighted with a smooth and balanced Tequila that is filled with flavours of bitter chocolate, dried fruits, betties light tobacco, spices, hints of toasted almonds and vanilla. Elegant and balanced.

title: Highwood Pure Canadian Vodka - 1.14 L Bottle
bodyHtml: This flagship Vodka is triple distilled, creating a wonderfully pure classic vodka. What makes a crowd stand out is it is distilled from locally grown Canadian wheat and then blended with pure natural Rocky Mountain water. Highwood is among the few who use wheat, instead of corn, for some of their vodkas, resulting in a crisp, clean, soft, natural vodka of superb integrity.

title: Jim Beam Devil's Cut
bodyHtml:
A devilish twist on Jim Beam's regular bourbon, blending their 6-year-old whiskey with spirit extracted from the wood of the cask itself, where it's soaked in over the years of maturation. This gives a robust and hefty bourbon with a nice added chunk of woody richness.

title: Sauza Tres Generaciones Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Our Anejo Tequila has a rich, 100% blue agave flavor enhanced by 12 months in toasted American oak barrels where it gains its delicate amber hue, an array of subtle flavors, and its unique smooth, smoky finish. On the nose, strong toasted oak, light-cooked agave and a hint of caramel-vanilla sweetness. The taste is 

full and balanced. It starts with brown sugar, then fades soft oak and clean agave. Warm oaky finish.

title: Sauza Gold Tequila
bodyHtml: Made using the finest, fresh blue agave at the storied La Perseverancia distillery, this classic tequila offers aromas of lime zest, vanilla and hints of anise and spice with apricot/peach and pepper notes. Dry and smooth with flavours of caramel, herb and lime, followed by soft vanilla and stone fruit notes on the finish.

title: Lamb's Dark Navy Rum
bodyHtml:
Lamb's Dark Navy Rum hails from the Caribbean, blending rums sourced from Trinidad and Tobago, Guyana, and Barbados. The Lamb's brand was founded in 1849 by Alfred Lamb in London and has remained a classic choice in naval rum, celebrated for its British heritage and traditional rum-making methods. Now produced by Corby Spirit and Wine Limited in Canada, Lamb’s continues to honour its original maritime character and robust style.

Rum Description
Lamb’s Dark Navy Rum pours a deep, mahogany brown with copper highlights. On the nose, it offers aromas of molasses, brown sugar, dried fruit, and baking spice, underpinned by hints of oak and toffee. The palate is rich and full-bodied, delivering smooth layers of caramel, spiced fruitcake, and licorice, followed by a long warming finish with a slightly smoky edge. A blend of 18 different Caribbean rums, it is aged and then blended in Canada, achieving complexity and a bold, well-balanced profile. Best enjoyed neat, over ice, or in classic cocktails like the Dark ‘n’ Stormy or Rum Punch.

title: Gosling's Black Seal Rum
bodyHtml:
Gosling's Black Seal Rum, made from a 150-year-old Gosling family recipe, uses the finest distillates aged in charred American oak casks, to achieve a remarkably smooth taste.

First exported to the US in 1980, Goslings Black Seal Rum is now Bermuda’s largest export product. 

Dark ‘n Stormy®, the national drink of Bermuda and a trademarked cocktail, is made with Goslings Black Seal Rum and Goslings Stormy Ginger Beer, with a lime garnish.

title: Alberta Pure Vodka - 750 ml (Plastic Bottle)
bodyHtml:
Alberta Pure vodka has a sparkling clarity and clean smooth character. Clear, water-like; clean, neutral with some sweet notes and a long finish with some heat. 

Gold Medal, International Wine & Spirits Competition 2018.

title: Wyborowa Vodka
bodyHtml: Crystal clear; fairly neutral with a delicate hint of anise on the nose; smooth with a spicy/hot finish.

title: Tito's Handmade Vodka - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Tito's uses old-fashioned pot stills and taste-test every batch. Their process, similar to that used to make fine single malt scotches and high-end French cognacs, requires more skill and effort, but they think it’s well worth it!

Tito’s Handmade Vodka is America’s Original Craft Vodka. In 1995, Bert “Tito” Beveridge obtained the first legal permit to distill in Texas and created Tito’s Handmade Vodka. They batch distill their corn-based vodka using old-fashioned pot stills and the vodka is naturally gluten-free. Tito’s Handmade Vodka is distilled and bottled by Fifth Generation Inc. in Austin, Texas on the very same land where the whole venture started.

title: Johnnie Walker Black Label - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Jim Murray, author of the Whisky Bible , considers Black Label the Savoy, the Everest of deluxe whiskies . With a privileged access to Scotland's most prized distilleries, Johnnie Walker expertly blends powerful west coast malts with more subtle east coast flavours to create a 12 Year-Old that is smooth and complex, with flavours of cooked fruit, toffee and orange peel, culminating into a slightly peaty finish.

title: Sortilege Maple Syrup Whisky - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
Sortilege follows a traditional recipe that strikes the perfect balance between the strength of Canadian whisky and the rich, golden flavour of pure maple syrup. The result is a fine liqueur that is truly Canadian. Indulgent with maple, toffee and caramel aromas and flavours, medium sweet and perfect in hot beverages.

title: Wiser's 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
General Information

A single grain whisky that is dominated by aromas of green apple in part due to the unique aging conditions in Southern Ontario. It pours a medium golden amber with additional aromas of caramel, orange peel and spice; the palate is round and medium-bodied with a silky texture and a smooth vanilla driven, finish.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Glenlivet 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
General Information

A malt whisky of unmistakable honey-rich maturity and depth. Glenlivet 18yo is the winner of two Gold medals in the International Wine and Spirit Competition (IWSC) and remains one of the best-value expressions of sherried Speyside. Thick and fruity, with cream, stewed apple, candied orange and sweet vanilla.

title: Jose Cuervo Especial Silver Tequila
bodyHtml:
The epitome of smoothness, Jose Cuervo Especial Silver Tequila is a treat for the discriminating customer. An authentic silver tequila, Especial Silver is masterfully balanced to bring out its caramel, agave and herbal tones.

Since Jose Cuervo Especial Silver has a clean, light taste, it's great for shots, especially if you want to follow it up with a chaser. The best way to enjoy Especial Silver, however, is in a cocktail. Use it to make the brand's delicious Cuervo Margarita, which is two parts Especial Silver, ice and one part each of triple sec and lime juice. Talk about delicious!

title: Garrison Brothers Small Batch Bourbon
bodyHtml: The first and oldest legal whiskey distillery in Texas prides itself on producing a unique wheated-bourbon using locally sourced, organic ingredients, some they grow themselves. The exception is the barley that hails from the Pacific Northwest and Canada. Aged three years in full-sized barrels, this is a small batch straight bourbon.

title: Havana Club 3 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
The essential ingredient for your classic Cuban cocktails. 100% made and aged in Cuba from local sugarcane molasses, this light aged white rum combines the fresh, green notes of sugarcane with the fruity notes of Caribbean rum. Havana Club 3 is the go-to rum for cocktail lovers in search of authentic Cuban Mojitos and Daiquiris!

Freshness from the continuous distillation of sugarcane molasses and character from ageing: a winning combination! Havana Club 3 Años has a pale, golden straw colour that reveals its age: every single drop has aged for a minimum of three years. The nose is a full bouquet of smooth aromas, with hints of oak, molasses and sugar cane. The taste is well-balanced and complex: a sweet, mild, fruity flavour with a light hint of citrus.

title: Chivas Royal Salute 21 Year Old
bodyHtml: Launched as a tribute to honour Queen Elizabeth's Coronation in 1953, this refined, complex blend of grain and malt whiskies is aged 21 years. Medium amber in colour and finely structured, with satiny notes of dried fruit, nuts, spices and leather, it's an elegant, luxurious sipper.

title: Glenlivet Founder's Reserve
bodyHtml: To truly capture the essence of George Smith's vision, The Glenlivet Founder's Reserve has been created using the time-honoured distillation methods that he introduced so long ago. Made with water from the same crystal-clear mountain streams, in the same cold, pure air, The Glenlivet Founder's Reserve is as smooth and fruity as the whisky that first ran from the original copper pot stills. These unique, lantern-shaped copper stills, designed by the man himself, are not the only important tools in our distilling legacy. The traditional oak casks in which we mature the whisky give each expression its own distinct characteristics. When George Smith began distilling, The Glenlivet had no age statements and he selected whisky from casks of a range of ages. They have replicated this freedom with The Glenlivet Founder's Reserve, selecting whisky from a variety of traditional aged oak casks. Then, to lend a modern twist to the flavour of the expression, Master Distiller Alan Winchester marries together a selection of aged oak casks and American first-fill oak casks. American first-fill oak casks are those that have never before been used to mature whisky. Selective use of these casks provides a smooth, creamy sweetness that mingles harmoniously with the delicate flavours and complex fruity tones already present in the whisky.

title: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This is aromatic with notes of wild herbs, heather, honey and orchard fruits. The palate is round and creamy with a full, rich taste of honey and ripe apples, with vanilla, hazelnut and toffee flavours followed by a rich and lingering finish.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Malibu Rum Liqueur
bodyHtml: Malibu Rum is sunshine in a bottle with a smooth fresh flavour. It's clear in appearance with a sweet coconut aroma and flavour, Malibu is perfect for creating tropical cocktails that transport you to a tropical paradise. It's best enjoyed mixed with your favourite fruit juice, such as orange or pineapple.

title: WhistlePig 10 Year Old Straight Rye Whiskey
bodyHtml: WhistlePig 10-Year-Old Rye Whiskey is currently crafted in Vermont, USA. This exceptional rye whiskey offers a distinct flavour profile that combines boldness and complexity. It presents a harmonious blend of spicy rye, sweet caramel, and vanilla, with hints of oak and baking spices. The 10-year aging process enhances the depth and richness of the whiskey. Critics consistently praise WhistlePig 10-Year-Old Rye Whiskey for its exceptional quality and craftsmanship. It is often lauded for its robust flavours, smoothness, and long, satisfying finish. Whiskey enthusiasts seeking a high-quality rye with character and depth will find WhistlePig 10-Year-Old to be an outstanding choice.

title: Cruzan Single Barrel Rum
bodyHtml: Cruzan's typical light wood and vanilla dominate the nose, though a touch of cocoa makes itself apparent. Heat, wood and woody spice characterize the palate where the initial cocoa turns faintly bitter and some grassy cane struggles to assert itself. The finish emphasizes heat and vanilla. Pretend it's Scotch and add a drop or two of water.

title: Tullibardine 500 Sherry Cask Finish
bodyHtml: Matured in first-fill ex-bourbon barrels and then in 500 litre Pedro Ximenez Sherry Butts, which gives this Tullibardine its nutty brown colour. There are intense toffee apple notes on the nose with a hint of oatmeal. These notes combine with a viscous spicy feel and sweet dates on the finish.

title: Marca Negra Espadin Mezcal
bodyHtml:
The Marca Negra Espadín Mezcal is crafted from 100% Espadín agave, sourced from Oaxaca, Mexico. Known for showcasing the terroir and complexity of the Espadín variety, it is produced using traditional artisanal methods. The agave hearts are roasted in earthen pits, crushed with a stone tahona, naturally fermented, and double distilled to achieve its rich character.

  • Colour: Crystal clear.
  • Aroma: Bright notes of roasted agave, citrus, and light smoke, with hints of herbs and earth.
  • Palate: Smooth flavors of cooked agave, pepper, and subtle smoke, balanced by citrus and herbal undertones.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with a clean, silky texture.
  • Finish: Long and warming, with lingering smoke and hints of spice.

This mezcal is versatile, ideal for sipping neat or incorporating into craft cocktails. Its balanced profile makes it a great introduction to artisanal mezcal for newcomers while still appealing to seasoned enthusiasts.

title: Flor De Cana Centenario Gold 18 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml: A luxurious golden rum from celebrated Nicaraguan distillers Flor de Cana, aged for 18 years in small white oak casks. Marvelously mellow stuff, with notes of nuts, caramel, vanilla and spice followed by a lingering finish.

title: Glen Scotia Double Cask
bodyHtml: Ooh, looks like the Glen Scotia range has had a bit of a redesign! They've gone for quite a classic, refined design this time and have even introduced a selection of new expressions, including the Glen Scotia Double Cask! This Campbeltown single malt is finished in a combination of first-fill bourbon barrels, and Pedro Ximénez Sherry casks.

title: Johnnie Walker Double Black
bodyHtml:
Palate: The flavour is full bodied and complex with the signature Johnnie Walker peat smoke shining brightly through rich raisins and sultanas. Apples, pears and orange zest bring freshness while creamy vanilla and spice bring a softness and sweetness to the tongue.

Finish: The long warming finish combines spicy oak tannins and lingering smoke.

title: Dictador 20 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
Dictador 20 Years Rum is made from the fermentation of virgin sugar cane honey, distilled partly in copper alembic and partly in steel continuous column, to achieve a medium body rum.

It’s then aged in pre-used oak barrels and finally bottled under the highest quality control to ensure all the secrets are contained in the liquid flavour.

Very soft mouthfeel, overly smooth and very delicious flavours of smooth caramel, vanilla and roasted honey.

title: Smirnoff Vanilla Vodka
bodyHtml: Clear water-white; pronounced aromas of creamy vanilla bean frosting; on the palate it is lightly sweet and medium bodied, with warm vanilla flavours.

title: Dzama White Prestige Rum
bodyHtml: A fruity and round white rum with a hint of lemongrass. The barrels for the white rums are washed with water laden with citrus fruit, neutralizing the stronger flavors of the scotch whisky previously aged in the barrels. This imparts subsequent citrus aromas and acidity to the white rums.

title: Talisker Storm
bodyHtml: Nose: Rich and unexpectedly honeyed initially. Then some pleasing singed oaky notes and bandagey aromas. Now bonfire smoke comes through. There even seems to be some milk chocolate and appley fruit lurking in the rear. Everything in place; all very promising. Palate: Medium-full, the usual Diageo polished mouthfeel, with initial honey and then a very decent dose of hot smoke. The oak is there too, with vanilla and some (actually quite polite) peppery spices. The young whisky component is well-masked and the whole is rather more restrained in terms of mouthfeel than I expected, but the flavour intensity is, in my opinion, unarguably greater than the standard Talisker 10, which to be honest I have found surprisingly tame of late. Gets sweeter towards the death as the pepper lingers, counterpointed with unexpected sweet fruit and even a note of strawberry liquorice which somehow works very well. Finish: Woody and spicy without becoming bitter. Good length. Sweetness returns at the death.

title: Ketel One Vodka - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Ketel One Vodka shows light peppery aromas and flavours that are balanced with a hint of citrus. The profile is very round and unctuous on the palate, with a clean finish.

title: Tromba Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Owned by a Canadian, Tromba is as close to Canadian tequila as you'll get.The Reposado is aged for six months in American whiskey barrels for added smoothness. Look for flavours of cacao, toasted nuts, orange and pineapple followed by a long finish that develops into smoky, woodiness. Well-crafted and harmonious.

title: Patron Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Patron Anejo Tequila is a luxury aged spirit produced in the Highlands (Los Altos) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the historic Hacienda Patron in Atotonilco El Alto (NOM 1492), the expression was created to offer a refined, oak-matured agave profile designed for sipping. Produced under Bacardi, Patron Anejo combines centuries-old artisanal production techniques with delicate barrel aging, bridging the gap between bright highland agave sweetness and warm, woody complexity.

Spirit Description

Patron Anejo is crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves slow-cooked in small brick ovens. The cooked piñas are crushed using both a traditional volcanic stone tahona wheel and modern roller mills, fermented in pine wood vats, and double-distilled in small copper pot stills. The distillate is then aged for a minimum of 12 to 15 months in a combination of small French oak, Hungarian oak, and used American bourbon barrels. Master distillers blend these distinct aging lots prior to bottling in Patron's signature hand-blown glass bottle.

  • Colour: Warm amber with bright golden reflections.

  • Aroma: Complex and inviting, opening with toasted oak, sweet cooked agave, and vanilla bean, complemented by light dried fruit, raisins, honey, and subtle baking spices.

  • Palate: Smooth, rich, and well-rounded on the entry. Upfront flavors of roasted agave, butterscotch, and sweet vanilla give way to toasted oak, light caramel, dried apricots, and delicate cinnamon spice.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a soft, silky, and coating texture.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and elegant, tapering off with lingering notes of sweet oak, subtle cocoa, vanilla, and a gentle black pepper warmth.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Espolon Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Espolòn Reposado Tequila is a popular, high-value aged spirit originating from the Los Altos (Highlands) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the Destilería San Nicolás (NOM 1440) in Arandas, the brand was created in 1996 by late Master Distiller Cirilo Oropeza. Now under the ownership of Campari Group, Espolòn is widely recognized for its artistic bottle labels featuring Posada-inspired skeletal art that pays tribute to Mexican history and culture, paired with an accessible, high-quality liquid.

2. Spirit Description

Espolòn Reposado is produced from 100% Blue Weber agave harvested from high-altitude fields in Los Altos. The agaves are slow-cooked in autoclaves, extracted via roller mill, and double-distilled using a combination of column and copper pot stills to balance bright fruit flavors with earthy depth. The spirit matures for 2 to 5 months in light-to-medium toasted American oak barrels before bottling.

  • Colour: Pale straw gold with warm caramel highlights.

  • Aroma: Inviting and sweet, opening with cooked agave, vanilla, and caramel fudge, layered alongside tropical fruit, mild oak, and subtle baking spices.

  • Palate: Smooth, rounded, and approachable on the entry. Upfront flavors of roasted agave, butterscotch, and sweet vanilla give way to ripe plantain, light citrus peel, and warm oak spice.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a soft, creamy, and easy-drinking texture.

  • Finish: Clean, warm, and medium in length, tapering off with lingering caramelized sugar, soft oak, black pepper, and a faint touch of spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Polar Ice Vodka
bodyHtml:
Vodka so pure, only the Artic could capture its essence.

Polar Ice is crafted from the purest water and grains, quadruple distilled and triple-filtered for a legendary clean, smooth taste. 

Enjoy it with your favourite mixer, shaken, or stirred over ice.

title: Marca Negra Tobala Mezcal
bodyHtml:
After a name change and a little rebranding Marca Negra is back and as true as ever to its mission of bringing traditional mezcals to the world. Made at a traditional palenque in San Luis Del Rio using a tiny, rare and wild species, tobalá. This wild agave is small, low yielding but very high in sugar. They take an unusually long time to mature especially considering their size, however they pack a lot of character and an unmistakable flavour.

Like all good tobalá mezcals it is rich, briny and sweet. The nose is loaded with caramel, mustard, saltwater, walnut shells, mustard, and a hint of apple cider vinegar. It has a rich, decadent body and displays a myriad of flavours such as brown sugar, lemon pith, caramel, strawberries, and chalk and grape skins. It leave a slight tannic drying sensation on the sides of the mouth but is all-in-all quite alluring.

title: Bundaberg Rum
bodyHtml:
First distilled in 1888, Bundaberg Rum is as Australian as it gets. Made from 100% sugar cane then matured to perfection for a smooth and mellow flavour.

To make the perfect "Bundy" and cola, take a highball glass, fill with ice, add 30 ml of Bundaberg Original rum and top with cola. Garnish with a wedge of lime. Delicious!

title: Appleton 21 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml: Jamaica - To the nose, nutty and rich. Vanilla, marmalade, chocolate and pepper. On the palate, thick, full, nutty, cocoa, stewed fruits, demerara sugar, and oak. The finish is long and thick.

title: El Dorado 15 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

This was rated the best rum in the world at the International Wine and Spirit Competition four years running. This is pot-distilled and matured in bourbon barrels.

Nose: Dark brown sugar and thick, gooey toffee, notes of stewed stone fruits, prunes and molasses.

Palate: Sweet and syrupy with notes of sweet spices, thick notes of dark brown sugar and molasses, treacle, toffee and prunes.

Finish: Long, creamy and thick, dark spices.

title: Arran Robert Burns Blended Scotch Whisky
bodyHtml:
From the Arran distillery, this was blended in honour of Scotland's favourite poet - Robert Burns and this is officially endorsed by the World Burns Federation no less.

Nose: Fresh, apple peels, some blossom and spice, vanilla cream and juicy pear.

Palate: Fruity, notes of custard and warm pastry, more orchard fruit, some tart citrus.

Finish: Apple peels and vanilla spice.

title: El Jolgorio Cuishe Mezcal
bodyHtml: Traditional pit-roasted, mule-drawn tahona-crushed, open fermented, double-distilled mezcal from 100% wild-harvested Agave Cuixe (Agave karwinskii var.) harvested at 13 years of age, bottled at 47% ABV. Produced in Santiago Matatlan, Oaxaca, by mezcalero Gregorio Martinez Jarquin. The rare, wild agave Cuixe – like its relatives Madrecuie and Barril – grows a single stalk, with leaves spreading at the top. It is difficult to work with and requires extensive experience to achieve and optimal mezcal. The result is a spirit of great intensity.

title: Talisker 10 Year Old
bodyHtml:
A massive success as the island representative in Diageo's 'Classic Malts' series, Talisker 10yo's profile keeps increasing as more fans discover its intense coastal spicy, peaty character. A truly elemental malt.

Nose: Powerful peat smoke with sea-water saltiness, the liquor of fresh oysters, a citrus sweetness.

Body: Full.

Palate: A rich dried-fruit sweetness with clouds of smoke and strong barley-malt flavours, warming and intense. At the back of the mouth is an explosion of pepper.

Finish: Huge, long, warming peppery finish with a delicious sweetness.

title: Johnnie Walker Gold Label Reserve
bodyHtml:
Nose: Honeyed oats, malty with creamy vanilla, toffee popcorn and a touch of gingerbread. A herby note punches through. Really pleasant.

Palate: Sweet, smooth caramel fudge. Butterscotch. Quite waxy with honey and vanilla coming in waves.

Finish: This finishes more on the heavier side of things with sticky fruits (maybe a bit of trifle?) and faint woodsmoke.

Overall: A really well balanced blend from the House of Johnnie Walker. Something to crack open with friends on a summer’s evening and pass around whilst the sun goes down.

title: Stolichnaya Vodka - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml: Stoli Vodka is the original premium vodka that combines modern distilling of the highest quality spirit with century old traditions to create its bold character.

title: Ciroc Red Berry Vodka
bodyHtml: Clear water white with aromas of red berries with hints of red licorice and strawberry Jello-O. Diddy, the singer, songwriter, rapper, record producer, and entrepreneur got behind the Ciroc Vodka brand and the rest is history!

title: Glenmorangie 16 Year Old 'The Nectar' Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Glenmorangie 16 Year Old The Nectar is a premium single malt Scotch whisky originating from the Highland region of Scotland. Established in 1843 by William Matheson, the distillery is home to the tallest copper stills in Scotland and is currently owned by the French luxury group Louis Vuitton Moët Hennessy (LVMH). This expression replaces the former Nectar d'Or, offering four additional years of maturation and a significantly more complex finishing process designed to evoke the aromas of a French patisserie.

Spirit Description

The spirit undergoes an initial 14 year maturation in ex bourbon American white oak casks before being finished for two years in a unique combination of sweet wine barrels, including Sauternes, Monbazillac, Moscatel, and Tokaji.

  • Colour: The whisky presents a rich yellow gold or golden honey appearance.

  • Aroma: The nose is decadent and heady, featuring notes of baking brioche, vanilla pudding, and baked apricot, alongside toasted almond, chestnut, and hints of chocolate truffle.

  • Palate: It offers an unctuous and syrupy texture balanced by lemon zestiness, leading into flavours of honeycomb, vanilla crème anglaise, orange scone, and warm raisin bread.

  • Body: The whisky is medium bodied, elegant, and balanced, showing a supple oaky backbone throughout the tasting experience.

  • Finish: The finish is long, warming, and sweet, with lingering notes of ginger spice, buttercream icing, and honeycomb.

  • ABV: Glenmorangie 16 Year Old The Nectar is bottled at 46%.

title: Brugal Anejo Rum
bodyHtml:
Brugal Añejo is matured in carefully selected American oak casks that are medium toasted to provide a smooth taste, with beautifully light aromas of wood. 

Our Añejo rum is dry in an overall sense and buttery in the mouth with a slight hint of caramel and tannin. Brugal Añejo is a perfect rum for mixing in a refreshing premium serve and sharing with friends.

title: Glenmorangie The Lasanta 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: The nose is creamy and of caramel, creme anglaise and chocolate raisins, quite dry with notes of mixed sweet spices. The mouth feel is very thick as you chew through honeyed raisins. There is a little sweet beeswax, melted vanilla ice cream as the sherry weaves gently through the palate, a very buttery expression. Much more of that honey in the creamy finish, it has a slight oaky dryness and a dusting of cocoa powder. 43% alc./vol.

title: Rum Nation Demerara Solera No 14
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

An easy rum, excellent to start with and leads beginners toward the fascinating country of British Guyana.

Appearance: Amber colour, lively orange reflections.

Nose: Very harmonious; besides the primary molasses scents, it suggests white chocolate, banana, candid fruit notes, ending up with meddlesome balm scents.

Palate: Though the alcohol is rather persistent, a fresh herbaceous nuance lies gently.

Finish: The primary attack is dry and straight, with scents of woods, it fades then into the typical sweetness of the sugar cane and
molasses.

title: Kilchoman Sanaig
bodyHtml: Named after a rocky inlet North West of the distillery, Sanaig, has a predominantly sherry cask influence owing to the significant time spent in Oloroso sherry casks. These aged Oloroso casks contribute a drastically transformed depth of colour and character compared to the mostly Bourbon cask matured Machir Bay. ‘Cask Influence’ bars now feature on the packaging of both Sanaig and Machir Bay to illustrate the differing flavour profiles of the two core expressions. Anthony Wills, Kilchoman Founder and Managing Director; says: “Sanaig represents another significant step forward for Kilchoman, it is important to be able to offer customers consistently available releases, until now Machir Bay has been performing that leading role, Sanaig will now share the spotlight.”

title: Pike Creek 10 Year Old Whisky
bodyHtml:
Pike Creek is a Windsor, Ontario, suburban home to Hiram Walker's warehouses. The whisky made its celebrated return to store shelves in 2012 when it was re-released with the previously extinct Lot 40. The Canadian release of Pike Creek is a 10-year-old rye whisky aged in white oak barrels and then finished in port pipes. This Pike Creek expression takes that same 10-year-old rye whisky, jacks up the ABV to 42% and adds a splash of rye to the corn whisky blend. Then, instead of port pipes, it's finished in rum barrels.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Benromach Organic
bodyHtml:
General Information

The world’s first certified organic single malt whisky since 2006. UK Soil Association accredited from start to finish, Benromach Organic is matured in Virgin American Oak and gives sweet, malty notes with creamy pepper, banana, coffee and cocoa flavours. 43% alc/vol.

title: Jim Beam Rye
bodyHtml:
Great value rye whiskey from Jim Beam. It's a favourite of whisky bible author Jim Murray. The label was redesigned in 2016, changing from a yellow label to this rather stylish green one.

See More USA Whisky

title: Bulleit Bourbon 10 Year Old Frontier Whiskey
bodyHtml: A step up from the regular. Selected and extra-aged for a minimum of 10 yrs. Moderate amber colour. The nose is reticent but complex with notes of cream, caramel/vanilla, burnt wood, new oak and spice. The palate is smooth and rich with flavours of vanilla, dried fruit, apricot and leather. Sweet spicy notes on the long finish.

title: Cutty Sark Prohibition
bodyHtml:
General Information

A small-batch edition of Cutty Sark, Prohibition celebrates the fact the brand was smuggled into America in the 1920s by Captain William McCoy. This is bottled at 50% and is presented in a black glass bottle with a cork seal, which was typical of bottles during the era.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Jefferson's Straight Bourbon Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Jefferson's Straight Bourbon Whiskey originates from the historic distilling grounds of Kentucky, United States. Founded in 1997 by Trey Zoeller and his father, Chet Zoeller, a renowned bourbon historian, the brand was established to honor Thomas Jefferson's legacy of curiosity and experimentation. Drawing from a deep lineage that traces back to Trey's eighth-generation grandmother—one of the earliest documented women in the American distilling trade—the company focuses on marrying artful blending with innovative barrel maturation techniques to push the boundaries of traditional spirit profiles.

Spirit Description

This Kentucky straight bourbon presents a brilliant honey-amber color in the glass. The sensory profile opens with an inviting aroma of brown sugar, toasted oak, and fresh sweet corn, accented by a subtle hint of citrus and orchard fruits like peach and apple pie. On the palate, it delivers a smooth, light, and highly approachable body featuring flavors of vanilla, caramel, and delicate toffee, all balanced by a gentle undertone of rye spice and cinnamon heat.

title: Tullibardine Sovereign
bodyHtml: Adorned with golden detailing, Tullibardine Sovereign is a delicious creamy single malt which was aged in first-fill bourbon barrels before bottling. Expect plenty of vanilla and spice from this Highland Dram. A little mixed peel with notes of pear cider, allspice and creamy chocolate. A core of rich malt with hints of maple syrup. Spiced, creamy finish. Plenty of vanilla and cinnamon. Overall, a creamy whisky from some truly delicious casks!

title: Sortilege Prestige Maple Syrup Whisky
bodyHtml:
The coming of spring brings in the year's first harvest: maple syrup. Sugar shacks will be opening and the sap running this March. Bring the fun home with a bottle of Sortilege Prestige, a uniquely Canadian blend of 100 per cent rye whisky aged seven years in white oak barrels mixed with first run Quebec maple syrup (category one, extra clear, considered the finest). From Maison des Futailles, it's sweet, but not too, with true maple syrup flavours balanced by good whisky power throughout.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Johnnie Walker 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Appearance: A rich honey amber with reddish hues in the deeper recesses of the glass. Medium legs.

Nose: Malty, with sweet cream, vanilla, notes of candied almonds, lightly medicinal. Very subtle nose.

Palate: Sweet and easy to drink. Creamy and dry. Delicate. Notes of sweet cream, warm cinnamon rolls, grapefruit zest. Smoke arrives quite late. The finish is soft, slow with light smoke and lingering malt notes as well as a hint of pipe tobacco.

title: J & B - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: J. & B. stands for Justerini and Brooks, a wine and spirits merchant based in London since 1749. In the 19th century, the company starts bottling a blended scotch named J. & B. Club, which became the blend we now know in 1930, renamed J. & B. Rare. Made with no less than 42 whiskies, including Speyside malts which lend it character, this versatile blend displays herbaceous and floral notes.

title: Johnnie Walker Black Label - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
Black Label boasts superior depth and complexity, with a smokier, fuller flavour than other deluxe blends. Its distinctive character stems from its use of a remarkably diverse range of 12+ year old malts, drawn from over 700 casks. One whisky in particular, Cardhu, was considered so vital that the Walker family bought the distillery in 1893 so that its characteristic silkiness would lie at the heart of the blend.

Black Label retains the authenticity of its creator and currently outsells every other deluxe blended Scotch whisky around the globe. That it's stood the test of time is a testament to the pioneering spirit and the skills of the House of Walker.

title: Bushmills 16 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
This quintessential Irish whiskey originates from the village of Bushmills in County Antrim, Northern Ireland, produced at the historic Old Bushmills Distillery. Renowned for its distinctive triple-wood maturation program, Bushmills 16 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey is crafted from 100% unpeated malted barley and triple-distilled in traditional copper pot stills using mineral-rich water drawn from Saint Columb’s Rill. The whiskey spends its initial aging period of roughly 15 to 16 years maturing separately in two distinct cask types: charred American oak ex-bourbon barrels and Spanish Oloroso sherry butts. These two aged components are then married together and transferred into port wine pipes (seasoned fortified wine casks) for an additional finishing period of roughly 6 to 12 months. It is bottled at 80 proof (40.0% ABV) in the standard North American 750 ml format.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a warm ruby-tinged amber hue with polished copper reflections and medium, graceful tears along the glass. On the nose, it is fragrant, sweet, and fruit-driven, opening with lifted notes of ripe red berries, juicy cherries, and dark honey, supported by toasted almonds, vanilla cream, and a gentle wood spice. On the palate, the triple distillation delivers a characteristically silky, smooth, and approachable mouthfeel. An immediate wave of sweet summer fruits, caramelized peaches, and dark prunes gives way to richer mid-palate notes of milk chocolate, toffee, cinnamon bark, and a soft, nutty dry oak structure imparted by the Oloroso and port wood. The finish is medium-to-long, clean, and gently warming, trailing off with lingering impressions of berry compote, sweet roasted nuts, cocoa dust, and a delicate wine-tannin dryness.

title: Glengoyne Highland Single Malt 10 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Every winter, the hill behind their distillery becomes a beacon for migrating flocks of geese, which is why their home on the Highland border is known as The Glen of The Geese or, in Gaelic, Glen Guin. But their guests have inspired more than just their whisky's name. In a world that seems to spin faster every day, they're proud to be the slowest whisky distillery in Scotland.

In the stillness of the quiet glen, they know that patience is rewarded. Nothing is rushed, and every stage of their whisky-making process is given as long as it needs. Uniquely-shaped stills nurse the simmering wash during the longest distillation of any Scottish whisky, prolonged contact with the copper coaxing sweet and fruity notes from the gently rolling vapours. Their barley is only ever dried by air, allowing the true Glengoyne spirit to shine.

From here, the precious spirit is transferred to casks made to order from European and American oak. They prepared for six years before they were ready to carry their whisky to maturity. The natural colour of the whisky is a testament to decades within the wood alone. Nothing else is added. This is how they craft a whisky unlike any other. This is the Glengoyne way.

A soft, sweet 10-year-old single malt from the Glengoyne distillery and a winner of a Gold Medal at the 2007 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. Slightly herbal, big bourbon influence has brought a wonderful "high note." White milk bottle sweets are more creamy than fruity. Barley rich, with more bourbon influence. Clean and dry.

title: Benromach Single Malt Peat Smoke Bourbon Cask Matured
bodyHtml: Small batch made with heavily peated barley. Benromach Peat Smoke is matured in first-fill bourbon barrels. It offers fragrant vanilla notes, which lead to lemon sherbet and apricot, finishing with smoky bonfire embers.

title: Canadian Club - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
General Information

The legend of Canadian Club began in 1858 and grew to become one of the world's most iconic whiskies. Pouring a medium gold you will find aromas of roasted almond, vanilla and pepper; with spicy vanilla, cornflakes and a faint nutty flavour on a medium weight palate with a long finish.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Ileach Islay Single Malt
bodyHtml:
The Ileach is a peaty single malt from a secret Islay distillery, this has received rave reviews from whisky critics and has a solid core of peat and malt.

Nose: Youthful peat, herbal notes, oak, grassy, notes of the coast.

Palate: Sublimely smooth malty notes, peat, peppery spices, tannins, a touch of fruit.

Finish: Faint iodine. Coastal notes, malt.

title: Johnnie Walker Red Label
bodyHtml: Johnnie Walker Red Label is their Pioneer Blend, the versatile one that has introduced their whisky to the world. Crafted from the four corners of Scotland, it crackles with spice and is bursting with vibrant, smoky flavours, followed by a mellow bed of vanilla, a fresh zestiness and the Johnnie Walker signature of a long, lingering, smoky finish.

title: Chivas Regal 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
General Information

Chivas is known globally for creating rich and indulgent blends and this is no exception. Multi-layered aromas with hints of dried fruits, buttery toffee and dark chocolate on the nose with a velvety, dark chocolate palate yields to floral notes and a wisp of sweet, mellow smokiness followed by a warm, long finish.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Glenfiddich 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The Master distiller says:

"We use fine Spanish Oloroso wood and American oak to mature this rich, intriguingly fruity and robust oak expression, but there are many more reasons why this expression is special.   

Every batch is individually numbered and carefully watched over. Each has extraordinary consistency and character from an intense marrying period and a warming, distinguished finish.   

A truly exceptional single malt, the result not just of eighteen years of care and attention but of whisky-making craft and knowledge passed down through the generations."

title: Gibson's Finest Venerable 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Deep amber colour. Vanilla and dried apricot aromas. Smooth and mellow palate with a warm finish.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Lagavulin Distillers Edition
bodyHtml: Lagavulin double-matured in ex-bodega Pedro Ximenez cask wood for an intense, raisiny sweetness that marries beautifully with the smoky power of the regular release to create a massive, rich tasting power-house of a malt.

title: Booker's Bourbon
bodyHtml: In 1992, Booker Noe introduced his own signature bourbon, Booker's True Barrel Bourbon. Inspired by a 200-year-old tradition, Booker's is the first bourbon bottled straight-from-the barrel, uncut and un- unaltered. First created as a holiday gift for his special friends, Booker's whiskey was so well-received that he decided to make it available to bourbon lovers worldwide, much to the joy of spirit connoisseurs everywhere. Unlike anything you have ever tasted, Booker's is one of the only uncut, un-unaltered, straight-from-the-barrel, bourbons available today. It's bottled at its natural proof of between 121 and 127, and aged between six and eight years.

title: Jack Daniel's - 1.75 Litre Bottle
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: A legendary American whiskey. It shows aromas and flavours of caramel, vanilla, nut and oak with smoky tones. The palate is smooth and sweet with a spicy finish.

title: Centennial Ltd Edition Canadian Whisky 10 Year
bodyHtml:
Centennial Limited Edition 10 Year Old Canadian Whisky is a premium aged expression produced by Highwood Distillers in High River, Alberta, Canada. Known for utilizing pure glacier water sourced from the nearby Rocky Mountains and locally grown western Canadian grains, Highwood Distillers crafted this limited-edition release to showcase extended oak maturation within classic Canadian blending traditions. Aged for a full decade, Centennial 10 Year Old offers an elevated, ultra-smooth profile compared to standard 100% rye or wheat-based Canadian mixing whiskies.

2. Spirit Description

Centennial 10 Year Old is distilled primarily from high-grade wheat and rye grown in western Canada, distilled using continuous column stills to create a clean, elegant spirit. The whisky is matured for a minimum of 10 full years in charred American oak barrels in the dry, high-altitude climate of southern Alberta. Master blenders at Highwood then artfully marry select barrels to achieve a harmonious balance of soft vanilla sweetness, light baking spices, and smooth grain depth.

  • Colour: Bright amber-gold with polished copper reflections.

  • Aroma: Light, sweet, and approachable, opening with notes of vanilla cream, butterscotch, and toasted oak, followed by subtle orchard fruits (apple and pear) and a light hint of rye spice.

  • Palate: Exceptionally smooth, light, and silky on the entry. Upfront flavors of caramel, sweet corn, and toasted oak give way to soft cinnamon, honey, and subtle dried fruit.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a soft, clean, and rounded mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Crisp, medium-length, and clean, leaving trailing notes of sweet oak, vanilla, and a gentle peppery warmth.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Gentleman Jack
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Double charcoal mellowing is what gives this gentleman his smooth and refined character. In the glass, this shows aromas of caramel, vanilla, peach and light spice. The palate is elegant with sweet fruit and vanilla flavour followed by a touch of warmth on a long, smooth finish. Enjoy neat, on ice or with a splash of water.

See More USA Whisky

title: Bell's Extra Special - 750 ml
bodyHtml: The fresh, sweet malts of Speyside and the smoky sea salt of the Islands come together and are matured in selected oak casks for a rich flavourful blend. A light amber colour, mildly smoky and nutty nose and smooth light flavours of smoke, dried fruit and malt are the calling cards of this classic blend.

title: Oban Little Bay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
bodyHtml:
1. Introduction

Oban Little Bay is a single malt Scotch whisky that originates from Scotland, specifically the West Highland region in the town of Oban. The Oban Distillery, one of the oldest licensed distilleries in Scotland, was established in 1794 by the brothers John and Hugh Stevenson. The distillery is one of the smallest in Scotland. It is uniquely positioned beneath a steep cliff overlooking Oban Bay, leading to its description as a "bridge between the Highlands and the Islands".

2. Spirit Description

The 'Little Bay' expression is a non-age statement single malt that is named after the smallest bay in Oban. It is crafted through a unique process of double maturation. The whisky is initially matured in rejuvenated American oak casks. It is then finished in smaller, 200-litre second-fill American oak ex-bourbon quarter casks and finally, a selection is finished in European oak sherry casks. This maturation process in different cask sizes and wood types is designed to intensify the flavour.

  • Colour: Bright amber.

  • Aroma: The nose is quite fragrant and complex. It features notes of dark fruit, dried apples, honey, banana, treacle tart, malt, and a sea-salty edge.

  • Palate: The palate is full-bodied and soft, with a buttery texture. The taste is complex, featuring Christmas spices, orange zest, nutmeg, cinnamon, and a subtle smokiness.

  • Body: Smooth, silky, and rich.

  • Finish: The finish is long and dry, with notes of lingering spice, dark fruit, and dark chocolate.

  • Stylistic Notes: This is a rich, intense expression with a bold and complex flavour profile. The smaller casks increase the interaction between the wood and the spirit, creating a whisky that is deeper and richer than the standard 14-year-old expression.

  • ABV: The alcoholic strength is 43% ABV.

3. Accolades

Oban Little Bay has received high praise in major competitions:

  • Double Gold Medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition (SFWSC) in 2017.

  • Silver Outstanding at the International Wine & Spirit Competition (IWSC) in 2017.

4. Food Pairing

The whisky's complex spice and dark fruit notes make it a good complement to rich foods.

Suggested pairings include:

  • Rich Seafood: Smoked salmon or pan-seared scallops.

  • Dark Meats: Pair with roast venison or other game meats.

  • Desserts: The spicy and rich notes of the whisky pair excellently with gingerbread or dark chocolate mousse.

title: Grey Goose Vodka - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Using only the finest ingredients, Grey Goose is renowned for its smooth and silky character. 

Expect subtle aromas of sweet citrus and white flowers; the palate is soft with a gentle and subtle sweetness that envelops your mouth; warm and spicy on the finish.

title: Park Distillery Vanilla Vodka
bodyHtml: Made from 100% organic Alberta triticale grain, naturally flavoured with a vanilla bean, and distilled with glacier freshwater right in Banff National Park.

title: Tullibardine 228 Burgundy
bodyHtml: Finishing for 12 months in red Burgundy wine casks from Chassagne Montrachet adds a layer of complexity to this intriguing Tullibardine. Fragrant with red berry, vanilla and toasted oak. On the palate vanilla, apple peel, crushed berry, and lightly dried floral are followed by a lengthy finish of toasted allspice and plum.

title: Smirnoff Green Apple Vodka
bodyHtml:
Smirnoff Green Apple is infused with the tart but sweet flavor of green apples. For simple cocktails, this spirit pairs best with soda water, lemonade or pineapple juice. 

For a more complex cocktail, add to a martini for a tangy twist. Smirnoff Green Apple is Kosher Certified and gluten free.

title: Marca Negra Tepeztate Mezcal
bodyHtml:
Marca Negra Tepeztate Mezcal is an artisanal spirit made from the rare and wild Tepeztate agave, which takes 20 to 30 years to mature. Crafted by maestro mezcalero Jorge Méndez in San Luis del Río, Oaxaca, this mezcal reflects the unique terroir of the region. With its long maturation period and intricate production process, this small-batch mezcal offers a deeply complex flavor profile.

  • Colour: Clear with a slight viscosity, hinting at its rich texture.
  • Aroma: Earthy notes of damp soil and sweet mold, complemented by hints of smoked chipotle and green herbs like asparagus.
  • Palate: A layered experience featuring minerality, green peppers, and lemon zest, balanced by a subtle tartness from pomegranate.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth, structured mouthfeel.
  • Finish: Medium in length, with lingering spice and earthy tones.

This mezcal stands out for its rarity and complexity, making it a coveted choice among enthusiasts of artisanal spirits. Its balance of savory, herbal, and mineral notes makes it ideal for sipping neat, allowing the flavors to unfold with every sip.

title: Red Tassel Vodka - 750 ml
bodyHtml: A Canadian favourite for over 30 years, McGuinness Red Tassel Vodka is a neutral flavoured vodka with subtle character on the palate and a slightly spicy warming finish. It goes well with your favourite mix and makes a great cocktail!

title: 1800 Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: This tequila is crafted using 8-12-year-old 100% Weber blue agave and is matured in American and French Oak barrels for no less than six months. This rich tequila has notes of buttery caramel, mild spices and a touch of smokiness, which is imparted by the finishing process. It mixes perfectly in a cocktail or on the rocks.

title: 1800 Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: Using 100% Weber Blue Agave, picked at their peak, anywhere from 8-12 years old, Añejo is aged in French Oak barrels for a minimum of 14 months. Its finish is described as spicy and well-rounded, with flavours of toasted oak, vanilla and butterscotch. This deep, luxurious tequila is ideal for sipping.

title: Clase Azul Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Clase Azul Añejo Tequila is an ultra-premium spirit from Mexico, specifically produced in the Los Altos region of Jalisco. Founded in 1997 by Arturo Lomelí, Clase Azul Mexico is a privately held luxury house that focuses on celebrating Mexican heritage through artisanal craftsmanship. The añejo expression, also known as 'Edición Indígena-Mazahua' (Mazahua Edition), is presented in a handcrafted ceramic decanter that pays tribute to the Mazahua indigenous culture and features traditional brushstrokes painted in 24-karat gold.

Spirit Description

The spirit is made from 100% organic Blue Weber agave, which is slow-cooked in masonry ovens for approximately 72 hours before undergoing double distillation in copper stills. It is then aged for 25 months in American whiskey casks, often specifically noted as bourbon barrels.

  • Colour: This tequila presents a deep copper hue with intense golden highlights or a rich amber with copper reflections.

  • Aroma: The nose is intense and layered, offering scents of Mexican vanilla, toffee, and roasted hazelnut alongside orange marmalade, apple preserves, and warm spices like cinnamon and clove.

  • Palate: It delivers a silky smooth, luxurious texture with a complex symphony of flavours including nutmeg, clove, candied orange peel, and black pepper. Prominent notes of toasted oak from the extended aging process add significant depth.

  • Body: The spirit is characterised by a great, full body that is velvety on the palate.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, silky finish that is both sweet and spicy, featuring toasted and spiced notes that linger.

  • ABV: This expression is bottled at 40%.

title: 1800 Coconut Tequila
bodyHtml: 1800's signature double-distilled Silver Tequila is infused with natural, ripe coconut flavour. With its slightly sweet and medium-bodied tropical taste, this versatile tequila is delicious on the rocks. It tastes great mixed with pineapple juice or replacing regular tequila in your favourite cocktail.

title: El Jolgorio Mexicano Mezcal
bodyHtml: Traditional pit-roasted, mule-drawn tahona-crushed, open-fermented, double-distilled mezcal from 100% semi-wild Agave Mexicano (Agave rhodacantha) harvested at 10 years of age, bottled at 47% ABV. Produced in Santiago Matatlan, Oaxaca, by mezcalero Valentín Cortes. Agave Mexicano, a rare varietal of A. Rhodacantha that prefers to grow in moist areas, lower in elevation. The agave is very large, often with black thorns, and has highly concentrated sugars. The resulting mezcal is extremely powerful and complex with a long finish.

title: Grand Mayan Extra Aged Tequila
bodyHtml: This intriguing Extra Aged tequila is aged for a minimum of four years in ex-Bourbon barrels. It offers notes of oak, hazelnut, caramel, toasted agave, dark chocolate and citrus. It's medium-bodied and spicy with a long-lasting finish. Pair with chocolate soufflé, and charcuterie or serve in a snifter as you would a fine Cognac.

title: El Jolgorio Barril Mezcal
bodyHtml: Traditional pit-roasted, mule-drawn tahona-crushed, open-fermented, double-distilled mezcal from 100% semi-wild Agave Barril harvested at 10 years of age, bottled at 46.4% ABV. Produced in La Compañía Ejutla, Oaxaca, by mezcaleros Gregorio and Gonzalo Hernandez. Barril is a subspecies of the Karwinsinskii Family of agaves that grows in the hilly areas. It grows a long stalk, resembling a tree and creates a mezcal of great complexity, balancing sweetness and citrus.

title: Jose Cuervo 'Reserva De La Familia' Platino Tequila
bodyHtml: Clear with a faint straw cast. Deep, multilayered, and evolving aromas of suede, cheese, cedar, dried flowers and stone fruits. An exceptionally smooth and effortless entry leads to a silky, dry yet fruity full body of creamy vanilla bean, roasted pineapple, nuts, figs, leather, and grilled yellow peppers. Finishes with a very long and spicy fade of honey, salt, exotic peppercorns, and green herbs. Elegant, vibrant, and delicious with a superbly smooth texture and a very complex agave character supported by a kiss of spicy oak. A truly unique blanco tequila.

title: Milagro Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Produced from 100% Highlands-grown blue agave, Milagro's triple-distilled reposado is packaged in an attractive, shaded-copper bottle. The spirit's own colour is pale straw despite the spirit's ageing for six months in American oak whiskey barrels.

Milagro's Reposado offers less heat and agave on the nose than their Silver but punches up the roasted agave sweetness. The pickle barrel funk reappears, too, even more aggressively, but vanilla and butterscotch caramel fight back. The spirit finishes with some returning heat and spice and a farewell hint of bitterness.

title: Tromba Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tequila Tromba Blanco is a premium artisanal silver tequila produced in the Highland region of Los Altos in Jalisco, Mexico. The brand was founded in 2010 through an international partnership between legendary Mexican Master Distiller Marco Cedano (formerly the original master distiller and distillery manager for Don Julio), Canadian entrepreneur Eric Brass, and Australian partners Nick Reid and James Sherry. The name 'Tromba' translates to the intense, localized rainstorm that hits the Los Altos highlands every spring, providing vital nourishment to the region's rich red clay soil.

Spirit Description

Tromba Blanco is crafted from 100% blue Weber agave harvested at peak maturity. The agave hearts are slow-cooked, extracted, and small-batch distilled in traditional copper pot stills before being bottled unaged to preserve the vibrant highland terroir.

  • Colour: Crystal clear and bright.

  • Aroma: The nose is highly expressive, greeting the senses with fresh raw agave, sweet caramelized cooked agave, and a bright overlay of citrus fruit, lime zest, and soft mint.

  • Palate: Remarkably smooth and oily on the tongue, it balances vegetal, earthy notes with the sweetness of boiled squash and grilled pineapple. A distinct mid-palate fruitiness reminiscent of cantaloupe emerges alongside baking spices.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a slight, pleasant viscosity that coats the mouth evenly.

  • Finish: Clean, refreshing, and moderately long, tapering off with a characteristic highland black pepper kick, mineral elements, and lingering sweet melon.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof) for the North American market.

title: Herradura Anejo Tequila
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Herradura Añejo Tequila is a historic, premium aged spirit originating from Amatitán in the Lowlands (Valles) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Produced at Casa Herradura at the historic Hacienda San José del Refugio (NOM 1119)—a site where tequila has been distilled since 1870—the expression was first introduced to the world in 1962. The brand, now under the stewardship of Brown-Forman, is famous for its commitment to extended wood maturation, aging its tequilas far beyond official category minimums.

Spirit Description

Herradura Añejo is crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves slow-roasted in traditional brick and clay ovens.
