The juice is fermented naturally using wild yeast strains native to the surrounding fruit orchards before undergoing double distillation in copper pot stills. While Mexican law requires an añejo to age for a minimum of 12 months, Herradura rests this spirit for 25 months (over two full years) in American white oak barrels, imparting rich wood influence while retaining cooked agave sweetness.

  • Colour: Deep golden amber with copper highlights.

  • Aroma: Complex and inviting, opening with toasted oak, cooked agave, dried fruits, and vanilla bean, complemented by toasted nuts, cinnamon, and subtle citrus zest.

  • Palate: Rich, smooth, and texturized on the entry. Upfront notes of roasted agave, buttery caramel, and toasted almond yield to warm baking spices, dried cherry, oak tannins, and hints of dark chocolate.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a plush, mouth-coating viscosity.

  • Finish: Long, warming, and elegant, tapering off with lingering cinnamon spice, subtle cedar, toasted oak, and gentle agave sweetness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Ron Millonario XO Rum
bodyHtml: Taste the greatness! A complex rum distilled slowly with old stills to retain the warm, sugary and tropical aromas, then aged up to 20 years. Its soft character, creamy body and rich but delicate bouquet are appreciated by connoisseurs, for a warm and embracing sensory experience.

title: Ron Abuelo 7 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
This rum is from a family-run distillery located in the country of Panama. 

The family grows and hand harvests its own sugar cane, and ages this rum in Bourbon casks for seven years. Balanced and layered, it has notes of nutmeg, sugary baking spice, and golden pastries.

title: English Harbour 5 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml: A sumptuous rum from Antigua, made from molasses in copper-piped continuous stills, English Harbour has been showered with awards since it arrived on these shores.

title: Flor De Cana Centario 12 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
This amber ultra-premium rum is regal, elegant, and semi-sweet, with a crimson hue. It's great straight up, on the rocks, or with a dash of soda or water. In 2016, it was awarded a Gold Medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition. With its exquisite elaboration, the Flor de Cana 12 Year is making history.

Nougat, almond butter, molasses, and sherry abound in this stately and semisweet confection. Peppery spice, dark caramel, and charred oak fade on the finish.

title: Matusalem 15 Year Old Gran Reserve Rum
bodyHtml: Aromas of woody tannins, dry citrus and rich caramel. Notes of oak, tropical fruits, particularly bananas and papaya, dates and raisins on the palate. Finishes with touches of chocolate, caramel and citrus.

title: Lemon Hart Rum - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Lemon Hart & Son Original 1804 is the classic British-style black rum, cherished by rum drinkers around the world for its bold, rich flavour, full-bodied complexity and exceptionally smooth finish. Original 1804 is the perfect example of a rum that shows pronounced flavour when mixed with cola. A premium blend of select single estate rums, distilled, Bourbon barrel-aged and blended on the East Bank of the Demerara River in the lush tropical Caribbean country of Guyana. Rum always.

title: Popov Vodka - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
Popov is carefully distilled and then filtered through selected charcoal to create neutral and smooth vodka. 

A good vodka for making cocktails or for gatherings.

title: Hangar One Mandarin Vodka
bodyHtml: Mandarin orange blossoms are incredibly fragrant and provide a delicate intensity that suggests the experience of peeling a fresh mandarin.

title: Casa Noble Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: Patience is the secret ingredient of their acclaimed Añejo. Aged for a full two years in French white oak barrels, the complex aromas of dried fruits and spice complement flavours of toasted oak, butterscotch, vanilla and sweet cooked agave.

title: Milagro Silver Tequila
bodyHtml: Milagro Silver Tequila is renowned for its smoothness and is meant to be sipped. It can also be used in a margarita with fresh juices. Milagro Silver Tequila has citrus and herbs on the palate with grassy notes. Milagro Silver Tequila is triple-distilled with the finest estate grown Blue agave that are 8 to 12 years old, adding complexities to the flavour of this agave-forward tequila.

title: Mezcal Union
bodyHtml: Mezcal Unión is produced and distilled in San Baltazar Guelavila, Oaxaca. It is a blend of two different types of agave and is produced by a group of families. The families that form part of the Union of mezcal each have more than three generations of producing mezcal as their main craft in their tiny artisanal palenques. Their Espadin Agave grows for 6-8 years before harvesting, their Cirial for 20 years, and their Tobalá for 14+ years. Once the Agave is harvested, and the piñas are ready to be roasted, a fire is started in the base of an earthen pit, with river stones placed on top. Once the rocks are red-hot, the piñas, which have been cut in halves or in quarters, are placed in the pit. The entire pit is then covered with agave leaves, fibre, and straw mats, piled up with earth and left to roast for four days. The roasted agave is crushed by a Tahona, pulled via horse or mule. Once extracted, the mash is placed in wooden barrels with water and left to ferment for several days. After the fermentation, the mash is double-distilled in copper pot stills, then bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Barbancourt 8 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml: Unlike industrial rum made from the fermentation of molasses, a by-product of the production of cane sugar, Rhum Barbancourt is an agricultural rum, rum made from fermented sugar cane juice. Rhum Barbancourt is aged in Limousin oak barrels in the Domaine's chais, and it is in these oak barrels that Rhum Barbancourt expresses its unique flavor and bouquet; a subtle blending of Haiti's sun and soil.

title: Amrut Fusion Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
According to Indian Mythology, when Gods and Rakshasas – the demons – churned the oceans using the mountain Meru as a churner, a golden pot sprang out containing the Elixir of Life. That was called the “Amrut”. The great founders of the distillery aptly named it Amrut Distilleries.

Nose : Heavy, thickly oaked and complex: some curious barley-sugar notes here shrouded in soft smoke. Big, but seductively gentle, too;

Taste : The delivery, though controlled at first, is massive! Then more like con-fusion as that smoke on the nose turns into warming, full blown peat, but it far from gets its own way as a vague sherry trifle note (curious, seeing how there are no sherry butts involved) - the custard presumably is oaky vanilla - hammers home that barley - fruitiness to make for a bit of a free-for-all; but for extra food measure the flavours develop into a really intense chocolate fudge middle which absolute resonates through the palate;

Finish : A slight struggle here as the mouthfeel gets a bit puffy here with the dry peat and oak; enough molassed sweetness to see the malt through to a satisfying end, though. Above all the spices, rather than lying down and accepting their fate, rise up and usher this extraordinary whisky to its exit

title: Wild Turkey Rare Breed
bodyHtml:
Initially introduced in 1991, this barrel-proof whisky has aromas and flavours of toffee, vanilla, baking spices and sweet corn. Added notes of caramel, butterscotch and orange peel are capped off by a full-bodied and mouth-coating palate with a warm and harmoniously balanced finish. You can try it with a saucy beef brisket sandwich.

See More USA Whisky

title: Suntory Toki Japanese Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Blended from Suntory's three distinct distilleries, Yamazaki, Hakushu, and Chita, this whisky is a modern expression of the house's century-long craftsmanship. Founded in 1899 by Shinjiro Torii, Suntory opened Japan's first malt distillery, Yamazaki, in 1923. Toki, meaning 'time' in Japanese, was introduced in 2016 to bridge the gap between traditional heritage and innovative spirit, specifically highlighting Hakushu single malt and Chita grain whisky.

Description

This blended whisky features a clear, pale gold colour. The nose is fresh and herbal, characterized by notes of green apple, basil, and wild honey. On the palate, it offers a light and silky body with bright citrus flavours of pink grapefruit and green grapes, underscored by peppermint and thyme. The finish is clean and subtly sweet, with a lingering spicy touch of white pepper, ginger, and vanilla oak. ABV 43%.

Food Pairing

Designed for versatility, Suntory Toki is the quintessential choice for a Japanese highball, which pairs excellently with light appetizers like edamame or vegetable tempura. Its orchard fruit and honey notes complement savory dishes such as soy-mirin tuna tartare, hard-fried Gochujang chicken, and miso-glazed black cod. For a sweet pairing, it balances poached lychees or fruit-based desserts with its refreshing acidity.

title: Johnnie Walker Red Label - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Crafted from the four corners of Scotland, it crackles with spice and is bursting with vibrant, smoky flavours, followed by a mellow bed of vanilla, a fresh zestiness and the Johnnie Walker signature of a long, lingering, smoky finish.

title: Glen Scotia 15 Year Old
bodyHtml: Glen Scotia 15-Year-Old is matured in bourbon barrels. This has notes of ginger, vanilla, sea spray and spice.

title: Glenmorangie 18 Year Old The Infinita
bodyHtml: A wonderfully creamy and thick 18 year old dram, matured for 15 years in ex bourbon casks before being finished in Oloroso sherry casks. An exquisite, tropical-fruit driven Glenmorangie. Creamy honey and Greek yoghurt, grapefruit, exotic spice, berry compote. Big oak, citrus peels.

title: Elijah Craig Small Batch Bourbon
bodyHtml: This can justifiably be considered the first 'small batch' bourbon, although it predates the introduction of that term. Elijah Craig is a classic Bourbon with sweet, mature aromas of caramel, vanilla, spice and honey, plus a sprig of mint. Rich, full-bodied and rounded on the mellow palate, with caramel, malt, corn, rye and a hint of smoke. Sweet oak, licorice and restrained vanilla dominate the finish.

title: Russian Prince Vodka - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml: This light bodied Vodka is triple filtered for purity, clarity and smoothness to create a clean, smooth taste.

title: Bacardi Black Rum - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Some might call it black magic. Dark in colour, light-medium in body, and rich and robust in taste, Bacardi Black Rum imparts impressions of tropical fruit and molasses with a smoky finish.

title: Forty Creek Barrel Select - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Forty Creek is often credited for the renewed interest in quality Canadian whisky. The original pours a medium amber and offers complex aromas and flavours of apricots, caramel, spice, vanilla, ginger and toasted oak, ending in a long smooth finish.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Crown Royal - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Light amber in colour, the nose is lightly floral with corn, buttery vanilla and peach aromas. On the palate, look for a delicate sweet peach flavour with wood spice on a dry finish.

title: Paltrinieri 'Radice' Lambrusco di Sorbara
bodyHtml:
This bone-dry, ancestral-method sparkling rosé originates from Italy, produced in the heart of the Emilia-Romagna region within the Lambrusco di Sorbara DOC zone north of Modena. Founded in 1926 by Achille Paltrinieri, Cantina Paltrinieri is an artisanal family estate located in Sorbara, nestled between the Secchia and Panaro rivers. Today, third-generation winemaker Alberto Paltrinieri, alongside his wife Barbara, leads the winery as a pioneer in highlighting the elegance and high acidity of the Sorbara grape. The 'Radice' (meaning "roots") cuvée is crafted using the ancient rifermentato in bottiglia (ancestral method / rifermentazione naturale in bottle) technique, symbolizing a return to traditional winemaking prior to modern pressure tanks.

Wine Description

In the glass, 'Radice' presents a hazy, pale salmon-pink to coral hue with a delicate, lively fine effervescence and spent yeast sediment at the bottom of the bottle. The nose is extraordinarily fresh and lifted, opening with vibrant aromas of tart red currant, wild sour cherry, grapefruit, and rhubarb, complemented by subtle notes of pink peppercorn, crushed stone, and a yeasty, doughy bread crust nuance. On the palate, the wine is light-bodied, bone-dry, and intensely refreshing. It features a razor-sharp beam of high natural acidity, vibrant red berry flavors, and a saline, chalky mineral texture that carries through to a long, mouthwatering finish. Crafted entirely from 100% Lambrusco di Sorbara, the grapes are gently pressed and undergo spontaneous alcoholic fermentation in stainless steel with indigenous yeasts. The wine is then bottled without dosage or disgorgement to complete secondary fermentation naturally in the bottle, leaving the fine sediment behind. The alcohol by volume sits at 11.5%.

Food Pairing

The piercing acidity, bone-dry profile, and gentle effervescence of this ancestral Lambrusco make it an exceptional palette-cleanser and table partner for rich Italian cuisine. It pairs seamlessly with classic Emilian cured meats like Prosciutto di Parma, Mortadella, and Culatello served with fresh gnocco fritto. It also excels alongside seafood, including fresh oysters, fried calamari, sushi, tuna tartare, and grilled prawns. Structurally, its vibrant acidity easily cuts through rich, creamy cheeses like fresh Mozzarella di Bufala, Ricotta, and medium-aged Parmigiano-Reggiano.

title: Roscato Sparkling Sweet Red (NV)
bodyHtml:
General Information

Roscato is an irresistible, delicately sweet, frizzante wine from the northern Italian region of Lombardy. Made from a blend of Moscato and Chardonnay, Roscato makes a wonderful aperitif and is also incredibly food-friendly. Roscato seamlessly combines a long held grape growing tradition with the flair of modern winemaking techniques and style. The result is a wine of enticing character that perfectly meets the surging demand for sweet, slightly sparkling wines. With a low alcohol of 8% and a touch of sparkle to flawlessly balance the sweetness, Roscato is the ideal complement for today's cuisine. Enjoy it with white meats, classic Italian dishes, spicy foods and more.

title: Borsao Berola 2019
bodyHtml:
Bodegas Borsao is one of the most prominent wineries in the Campo de Borja region of Aragón, Spain. Founded in the 1950s and later consolidated in 2001, Borsao is a cooperative that brings together more than 700 growers. The winery has become internationally recognized for its expertise with the Garnacha grape, producing wines that are both expressive and affordable.

Wine Description
A bold and structured red wine, the 2019 Berola displays a deep ruby colour with violet hues. On the nose, it delivers enticing aromas of ripe blackberries, plums, vanilla, and a touch of smoky oak. The palate is rich and layered, offering notes of dark fruit compote, spice, and chocolate, balanced by velvety tannins and a supple mouthfeel. This full-bodied blend is composed of 80% Garnacha and 20% Syrah, aged for 14 months in French oak barrels.

Accolades
Wine Enthusiast – 90 points
James Suckling – 91 points

Food Pairing
Ideal with grilled lamb chops, beef stew, or aged Manchego cheese. Its robust structure also pairs well with barbecued meats and mushroom risotto. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Case Paolin Col Fondo Prosecco 2023
bodyHtml:
Sunny. Fresh. Delicious. Expand your definition of Prosecco with this well made wine this is just a touch natural. It's made from old vine Glera within the Asolo DOCG, and it is completely different from the mass-marketed wines that this category has become associated with. 

"Col Fondo" means an older, more labor intensive style of production that undergoes a second fermentation in the bottle, and is a lot more nuanced and delicate. Something like Prosecco x Champagne method x Pet Nat profile. This bottle from Case Paolin is a dusty goldenrod color with notes of yellow apple, asian pear and wheat grain. A delightful aperitivo.

title: Paltrinieri Solco Lambrusco dell'Emilia 2025
bodyHtml: Deep red-to-purple, with fine perlage. Intense notes of ripe fruits, cherries and sour cherries. Pleasantly delicate, fresh, light, with good acidity. Excellent as an aperitif, or paired with salami, tagliatelle, or pastries such as sour cherry tart.

title: Hito Cepa 21 Tempranillo 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This red wine originates from Spain, specifically the esteemed Ribera del Duero region. The wine is produced by Bodegas Cepa 21, a winery founded in 2005 by José Moro. Cepa 21 embodies a vision that successfully unites generational heritage with an innovative approach to winemaking. Located in Castrillo de Duero, the winery is a beacon of modern Ribera del Duero, surrounded by 50 hectares of estate vineyards. The 'Hito' bottling is a testament to the estate’s forward momentum and deep respect for its roots. The word 'Hito' means a stone post, often used to mark boundaries or directions, and this wine is a young expression introduced to complete the modern range.

Wine Description

'Hito' pours a deep Picota cherry hue with violet edges, appearing clean and bright. The wine is 100% Tinto Fino (Tempranillo). The nose is expressive and true to the varietal, showcasing primary aromas of ripe blackberries, violets, and red fruits. Subtle hints of liquorice and fine toast from the time spent in oak are also present.

The palate is round and inviting, displaying a juicy black fruit core wrapped in elegant spice and subtle notes of vanilla and chocolate. The mouthfeel is balanced and smooth, with an intense and honest character. The tannins are velvety and firm, providing structure without overwhelming its youthful charm. This is a medium-bodied red with vibrant freshness and an approachable nature. The finish is long, balanced, and punctuated by spicy fruit and mineral nuances that echo its high-altitude terroir. The wine is made from grapes harvested from the lowest parts of the estate's young vineyards, grown in chalky, clayey, and stony soils. Fermentation occurs in stainless steel for 12 days, followed by malolactic fermentation, and then the wine is aged in French oak barrels. The optimal drinking window is now or over the next four to five years.

title: Torres Salmos 2020
bodyHtml:
Spain – Catalonia, Priorat
Familia Torres is a renowned family-owned winery with a history dating back to 1870. In the 1990s, the Torres family reintroduced viticulture to Priorat, inspired by the Carthusian monks who cultivated the land in the 11th century. Their Salmos project honours this legacy, showcasing the rugged landscape and steep, slate-rich slopes of Porrera.

Wine Description
This expressive red blend, composed of 56% Cariñena and 44% Garnacha, presents a deep cherry red colour. Aromas unfold with layers of raspberry preserves, dried figs, and plum, intertwined with subtle hints of coconut and marzipan. On the palate, the wine is rich and structured, with polished tannins and remarkable length. Secondary notes of toasted oak and cedar add complexity. The balance and freshness of the wine underscore its elegance and depth.

Accolades
Decanter – 92 points
Robert Parker's Wine Advocate – 91 points
Guía Peñín – 93 points

Food Pairing
Ideal with wild game, roasted lamb, grilled red meats, and aged Manchego cheese. This pairing highlights the wine’s depth and character.

title: Taittinger Brut Reserve
bodyHtml:
Taittinger Brut Reserve comes from France, in the Champagne region. The Taittinger family has been producing wine for nearly a century, and today it remains one of the few top Champagne houses still family-owned. Their philosophy emphasizes elegance, finesse, and a high proportion of Chardonnay in their blends, which has become a hallmark of their style.

Wine Description

This Champagne shows a pale golden colour with fine, persistent bubbles. The nose is fresh and expressive, revealing notes of peach, citrus, white flowers, and subtle brioche. On the palate, it is lively and balanced, offering flavours of apple, pear, citrus, honey, and light almond, supported by a delicate mousse. The finish is long and elegant, with mineral and lightly toasty undertones.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast – 90 points

  • Wine Spectator – 91 points

  • James Suckling – 92 points

Food Pairing

This Champagne pairs beautifully with oysters, scallops, lobster, or smoked salmon. It also complements creamy cheeses and light poultry dishes.

title: Torres Vina Esmeralda 2025
bodyHtml: Pale straw in colour. Perfumed bouquet of floral, honey, spice, peach and lychee. The palate is off-dry with fresh acidity and resonating flavours from the nose. Very easy drinking.

title: Lamarca Prosecco
bodyHtml:
Originating from Italy in the Veneto region, specifically within the Prosecco DOC appellation, Lamarca Prosecco represents a quintessential, sparkling, and refreshing expression of Italian Glera. Produced by La Marca Trevigiana, a highly respected cooperative of growers in northeastern Italy founded in 1968, the brand has become a global standard for premium Prosecco. Sourced from sun-drenched vineyards across the rolling hills of Treviso, the winemaking philosophy focuses on gentle pressing of the grapes followed by a controlled secondary fermentation in stainless steel pressure tanks using the Charmat method. This process preserves the grape's delicate aromatic compounds, bright fruit acidity, and vibrant natural effervescence, creating a clean, crisp, and refreshing sparkling wine suitable for any celebration.

Wine Description

The wine presents a pale straw yellow colour with delicate greenish reflections and a fine, persistent stream of lively bubbles. An inviting, highly aromatic bouquet opens with fresh notes of green apple, white peach, and juicy Meyer lemon, interwoven with delicate nuances of white flowers, honey, and subtle citrus blossom. On the palate, it is light bodied, crisp, and lively, delivering refreshing flavours of crisp orchard fruit and lemon zest supported by a vibrant, mouthwatering core of natural acidity. Finishing clean, dry, and invigorating, it leaves a pleasant, lingering impression of sweet apple and subtle mineral freshness. Composed predominantly of Glera, it offers an exceptionally versatile, food-friendly, and uplifting sparkling wine profile with broad global appeal.

title: Mionetto Prosecco Brut Treviso
bodyHtml:
General Information

This well-structured sparkling Prosecco stands out for its luminous straw yellow hue and for its emphatic yet stylish mousse. The bouquet is redolent of Golden Delicious apple, while the palate is appealingly marked by aromatic notes of honey, black liquorice, and acacia blossom.

title: Lopez De Haro Tempranillo 2022
bodyHtml: The palate is medium-bodied with fine tannins. Tart red berried fruit, laced with tobacco and dried herbs on the dry, crisp finish. This is a superb Tempranillo.

title: Juan Gil Silver Label 2023
bodyHtml: Bodegas Juan Gil selected Monastrell grapes from old vineyards with low yields, planted on limestone and very stony soils that are farmed in an environmentally friendly way. The result is a wine with a deep red colour, abundant ripe fruit aromas and a long spicy, well-balanced finish, with toasted notes provided by the French wood.

title: Nino Franco Prosecco Rustico
bodyHtml: Nino Franco's non-vintage sparkling Rustico Prosecco is unquestionably the world's finest value in a high quality, Champagne look-alike. The non-vintage, light-bodied Prosecco di Valdobiaddene Rustico offers gorgeously elegant, fresh, lively fruit, notes of bread dough and citrus and persistent effervescence.

title: Torres Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva Gran Coronas 2022
bodyHtml: This luscious, full-bodied red gets is deep purple hue and fruity aromas from a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Tempranillo grapes. Deeply opaque cherry red wine with garnet highlights. Intensely fruity with spicy nuances against a backdrop of balsamic woodland undergrowth. Silky on the palate, with very fine tannins displaying a touch of fruit and undertones of toast.

title: Monasterio De Las Vinas Reserva 2020
bodyHtml: It's Tuesday night, and what's in your glass? ZYN suggests a medium-bodied Spanish red, Monasterio de las Vinas Reserva. No shortage of luscious dark fruit, as well as warm baking spices, toasted oak, cherries and vanilla. Smooth as silk!

title: Las Hermanas Monastrell 2024
bodyHtml:
This wine is from Spain, specifically the Jumilla DOP region, located in Murcia in the southeastern part of the country. Las Hermanas is produced by Bodegas Luzón, which has a history of winemaking dating back to the 19th century. Bodegas Luzón is known as a master of Monastrell (Mourvèdre), which finds its best expression in the highlands of Jumilla. The winery was pioneering, being run by the women of the founding family until nearly the end of the 20th century. The winery’s philosophy is centred on its four indispensable elements: the Monastrell varietal, the calcareous-sandy soils, the climate which helps the grapes ripen healthily, and a dedicated team. The vineyards are managed sustainably, using techniques that respect biodiversity.

Wine Description

The Las Hermanas Monastrell 2024 shows an intense cherry red colour with a purple hue. It is made from Monastrell (also known as Mourvèdre) grapes. Many vintages of Las Hermanas are produced from organically grown grapes and are certified vegan. On the nose, it offers very intense aromas of red ripe fruit and floral hints, with some sources noting high-pitched aromas of red berries, spices, and a subtle note of violet.

The palate is described as very fruity and fresh, smooth, and tasty. It is a simple and juicy wine. The wine features sweet and mature tannins and a balanced acidity. It is spicy and energetic on the palate, offering flavours of red berry and cracked pepper that gain weight and sweetness with air. It has a fruit-driven finish, which is clean and nervy, showing good clarity and a hint of bitter cherry.

title: Marques de Riscal Reserva 2021
bodyHtml: Intense black-cherry color with good depth of colour and hardly any signs of evolution. Very expressive aromas on the nose with notes of licorice, cinnamon and black pepper, with just a subtle hint of the long cask-ageing, thanks to its great complexity and ripe, concentrated fruit. Fresh and easy to drink on the palate, good backbone and lovely, polished tannins. The long, persistent finish leaves gentle balsamic reminders of the finest quality.

title: Canella Prosecco Valdobbiadene Conegliano 2024
bodyHtml: The youthful freshness, its relatively low alcohol content and easy, crisp style make it ideal for an evening with friends. Prosecco’s classic versatility also makes it a fine accompaniment for an entire meal, particularly fish first courses, caviar and prawns.

title: Torres Celeste Crianza 2022
bodyHtml: Dark cherry red with intense garnet highlights. Aromas of black fruit and delicate toasted coffee notes with nicely oak-aged undertones. Serious and warm with very fine, juicy, velvety tannins. Given its tannic and fruit properties, it pairs well with a wide variety of meat dishes, including roasts and wild game.

title: Raventos De Nit Rose 2024
bodyHtml:
Introduction

This sparkling rosé wine originates from Spain, specifically from the Conca del Riu Anoia region in the Alt Penedes. The Raventos i Blanc estate has been in the same family since 1497, representing one of the longest documented viticultural traditions in Europe. In 1986, Josep Maria Raventos i Blanc founded the modern winery to focus on high-quality estate production, and in 2012, his grandson Pepe Raventos withdrew from the Cava DO to champion the specific terroir of the River Anoia Valley. The estate follows a polyculture philosophy, utilizing biodynamic principles and traditional Catalan farming practices, such as horse ploughing, to ensure maximum authenticity and life within the vineyard.

Description

Raventos De Nit Rose presents as a pale, elegant pink with crystalline aromas of light citrus, red flowers, and white fruit. The palate is clean and precise with a smooth, voluminous texture, fine bubbles, and a dry, chalky finish. It displays sophisticated balance and freshness, featuring subtle notes of fennel, esparto grass, and a faint mineral undertone. The varietal composition is a blend of indigenous white grapes—typically 50% Xarello, 34% Macabeo, and 11% Parellada—with approximately 5% Monastrell added to provide its delicate colour and a touch of red fruit character. This extra brut sparkling wine is aged on its lees for at least 18 months, has an ABV of 12% to 12.5%, and is produced from certified biodynamic and organic vineyards.

Food Pairing

The structured elegance and vibrant acidity of this sparkling rosé make it a versatile partner for many different cuisines. It pairs perfectly with salty snacks like marinated olives or caviar, and more substantial dishes such as grilled seafood, shellfish, or meaty fish like salmon and tuna. Its mineral tension and fresh fruit profile also complement tapas, charcuterie, lightly spiced Asian dishes, and soft French cheeses like Brie or Camembert.

title: Villa Teresa Organic Prosecco
bodyHtml: Organic, delicious and a fantastic value. A family business, Vini Tonon was founded in 1936 in the Veneto wine region of northeastern Italy. Only organic agriculture was used in the production of this wine. This Prosecco is Italy's answer to a well made sparkling wine at a reasonable price. Light straw in colour with small bubbles and a crisp clean taste.

title: Emilio Moro Tempranillo 2023
bodyHtml:
Bodegas Emilio Moro is one of the oldest leading quality producers in Ribera del Duero. The history of the family goes back 3 generations. 1st generation Emilio Moro was born in 1891 and 2nd generation Emilio Moro in 1932. Both were born in a viticulture environment surrounded by vineyards and grew up treading grapes and racking wine in their native village of Pesquera de Duero, in the province of Valladolid. Emilio Moro taught his son, Emilio how to make wine but also to love it and he taught his children, Rubi, Jose, Fabiola, and Javier. The winery is currently run by the third generation while the fourth is beginning to join the Family. 

The vineyards were grafted with the purest clone of Tinto Fino, commonly known as Tempranillo, recovered from the oldest vineyards that the family owns, Valderramiro and Resalso. Currently the family owns more than 200 hectares. They are located between 2,400 to 3,000 feet of elevation.

title: Bodegas Montecillo Rioja Reserva 2020
bodyHtml: Montecillo's excellent Rioja Reserva is a medium-bodied, harmonious red with supple tannins and a long, rich finish. The nose shows alluring aromas of licorice, black cherry and leather, while the palate displays chocolate, plum and smoke flavours. This Spanish red would pair well with traditional shepherd's pie.

title: Cinzano Prosecco (NV)
bodyHtml: Fresh, fizzy and fruity, with flavours reminiscent of apple and pear. It has a sweet scent and a soft touch in the mouth and as such, it is perfect as an aperitivo, or for blending in cocktails such as the Aperol Spritz.

title: Quinta do Crasto Reserva 2021
bodyHtml: Elegant entry, evolving into a structured, full-bodied wine with velvety tannins and a balanced, persistent finish. Flavors of red berries, spices, and subtle oak provide extraordinary depth and harmony.

title: Pasqua Prosecco
bodyHtml:
Sparkling wine produced with the glera grape variety native to the Treviso area. In this countryside there are the best soils and climate conditions that grant a wine unique characteristics. The sparkling process is made with charmat method in steel autoclave in compliance with the regulation of the materia obtaining an extra dry young wine exciting and perfect in all occasions.

The wine pours a bright straw yellow colour with some greenish hints; the nose is pleasant and fruity with good intensity. It has a fresh flavor and to the palate is pleasant and harmonious. An ideal aperitif wine, it goes well with appetizers, white meats, and fish.

title: Real Compania De Vinos Garnacha 2019
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
Long ago, a grape variety with strong local character dominated the red grape vineyards in Spain, a variety denominated Garnacha, friend of the sun and earth, has a passionate and distinguished personality. It represents our tradition and today, after a determined recovery, it represents our brightest future. With it, we compose a complex and fruity red wine, with great structure and at the same time easy to drink.

This wine has a vivid colour of dark, very mature fruit tones. The aromas are characteristic of this garnacha variety: red fruits, plums and peaches. On the palate, the same fruity sensations coupled with the characteristic acidity arise, conferring freshness. Pairs perfectly with Iberian cold meat starters, roasts, and grilled red meats.

title: Aalto Crianza 2021
bodyHtml:
Established in 1999 by Mariano García, the celebrated former winemaker of Vega Sicilia, and Javier Zaccagnini, Aalto has become one of Ribera del Duero’s benchmark producers. The winery is devoted to expressing the complexity of the region’s old-vine Tempranillo through careful site selection and minimal intervention winemaking. With a focus on precision and balance, Aalto works with small plots from over 200 hectares of vines, many between 40 and 80 years old, to craft wines of depth and elegance.

Wine Description

Aalto Crianza 2021 presents a deep garnet colour with vibrant purple highlights. The nose is expressive and layered, offering aromas of black cherry, ripe plum, and wild berries, accented by subtle notes of liquorice, cedar, and sweet spices from its time in French and American oak. On the palate, this 100% Tempranillo is medium to full-bodied, showcasing a harmonious blend of concentrated dark fruit, polished tannins, and refreshing acidity. The wine reveals a silky texture with excellent balance, leading to a persistent, elegant finish with hints of cacao and clove. Ideal for drinking from 2024 to 2032, this vintage delivers both approachability in its youth and the structure for graceful ageing.

Accolades

  • "James Suckling - 94 points."
  • "Wine Advocate - 93 points."
  • "Vinous - 93 points."

Food Pairing

Aalto Crianza 2021 pairs beautifully with roasted pork tenderloin, grilled lamb skewers, or manchego cheese. The wine’s refined tannins and vibrant fruit complement a range of savoury dishes. A perfect match to enhance the wine's complexity.

Vintage Quality

The 2021 vintage in Ribera del Duero experienced cooler temperatures and increased rainfall, which contributed to wines of remarkable freshness and aromatic clarity. Thanks to precise vineyard management, Aalto achieved excellent ripeness and balance, producing a vintage that will be remembered for its finesse and ageing potential.

title: Ferrari Perle 2016
bodyHtml: Aromatic richness of extraordinary expressiveness, the scene is dominated by hints of Reinette apples and citrus fruits, accompanied by tones of white peach, almond blossom and toast-like notes. Elegant and harmonious, with the unmistakable fruity, aromatic sensations that are typical of Chardonnay. These are followed by a slight almond finish of great persistence, the result of long ageing on the yeasts. A sparkling wine of pronounced finesse. Perfect served as an aperitif or with lighter dishes, especially seafood.

title: Joya Tinto 2021
bodyHtml: Casa Santos Lima has created a wonderful great value red. This wine presents red ripe fruits and cinnamon notes. It's well-balanced and has silky tannins, with a mild and long persistence in the mouth. It has a rich finish with wood notes.

title: Vivanco Crianza Red 2021
bodyHtml:
Bodegas Vivanco is a fourth generation family-run winery located in the sought-after area of Briones. Vivanco is one of Rioja's most important and innovative wineries, renowned for its strong defence of wine culture, and it boasts one of the world's most significant wine museums.

Wine Description

The nose is intensely aromatic, showing an ample presence of ripe red fruit such as cherries and raspberries, alongside liquorice, vanilla, cocoa, and subtle spicy, toasty, and smoky notes. On the palate, the wine is expressive, juicy, and smooth, with a luscious freshness and good acidity. It is medium bodied and balanced, offering notes of red fruits and spices, supported by well-integrated, round tannins. The finish is long, persistent, and harmonious.

Food Pairing

It pairs perfectly with heartier red meat dishes, such as beef and most cuts of pork. Other excellent matches include charcuterie and aged cheeses.

title: Jacob's Creek Reserve Chardonnay - Pinot Noir Cuvee - 6 Bottles
bodyHtml: The refreshing lemon citrus aromas of Chardonnay are in harmony with the red currant characters of Pinot Noir. Generous citrus fruit flavours are enhanced with creamy nutty yeast characters providing both richness and structure. The wine finishes soft, crisp and clean. Well paired with seafood dishes such as oysters or lobster.

title: Niepoort Tinto Douro Dialogo 2023
bodyHtml: Very vivid ruby color, of medium concentration. Vibrant in the nose, scented with a fresh and very expressive aroma in the wild fruit notes. Spices and tea leaves harmoniously linked with a balsamic profile, originate a complex and captivating aroma. In the mouth, more elegant than the previous edition, has a markedly mineral profile. With a good mouth volume, young, with good acidity and soft tannins.

title: Bellenda Treviso Prosecco Extra Dry (NV)
bodyHtml:
General Information

Delicate aromas of white spring flower, citrus and exotic fruit lead the nose. The off-dry palate offers white peach, nectarine and candied almond alongside fresh acidity.

title: Castillo de Monseran Garnacha 2024
bodyHtml:
You'll be in love with this wine from the first sip!

This Garnacha packs a lot of oomph into each bottle. It oozes plush raspberry and blueberry jam aromas with chocolate, cola spices, sarsaparilla and rose petals. A supple palate lends itself well to generous berry flavours wrapped in mocha, floral and blueberry tea. It is fresh and smooth and gulp-able.

A wine for most grilled foods but also for pizza, red sauced pasta and more traditional tapas!

title: Mas Martinet Menut Priorat La Tribu 2022
bodyHtml: An elegant, sophisticated nose. The medium bodied palate offers balanced acidity and firm tanning with good depth of fruity notes of mulberry, dark plum and cinnamon with underlying notes of fresh ginger and blueberries towards a bold, focused finish.

title: Campo Viejo Tempranillo 2023
bodyHtml: A cherry red colour, suggestive of a vibrant Tempranillo wine. On the nose, it's rich aromas have a pronounced intensity with an initial scent of ripe red fruit followed by gentle sweet notes of vanilla and spices. The palate is perfumed, soft and fresh with a long finish with notes of fruits, vanilla and cocoa.

title: Bodegas Lan Gran Reserva 2017
bodyHtml:
Bodegas LAN Gran Reserva 2017 is an esteemed red wine from the Rioja Alta subregion of Rioja, Spain. Founded in 1972, the winery takes its name from the initials of the three provinces that form the Rioja Designation of Origin: Logroño, Álava, and Navarra. The estate's winemaking philosophy focuses on a deep respect for the land and the use of artisan oak barrels, maintaining a legacy of precision and elegance that defines the classic Rioja style.

Wine Description

This wine presents a deep black cherry colour with a garnet rim. The nose is intense and elegant, offering aromas of ripe red and black fruits, such as plum and blackberry, integrated with notes of sweet spice, pastry, and roasted coffee from its extensive oak aging. On the palate, the wine is full bodied and well structured, featuring layers of dark fruit, liquorice, and tertiary notes of vanilla and cedar. It is characterized by its remarkable balance, fine grained tannins, and a long, persistent finish that highlights its complexity and freshness. The blend consists of 95% Tempranillo and 5% Mazuelo, with an ABV of 14%. It was aged for 24 months in French and American oak barrels followed by 36 months in the bottle. The optimal drinking window is from 2024 to 2037.

Accolades

  • Wine Enthusiast - 93 points.

  • James Suckling - 92 points.

  • Decanter - 91 points.

  • Vinous - 91 points.

Food Pairing

The structured and complex nature of this Gran Reserva makes it a perfect match for rich and savoury dishes. It pairs beautifully with grilled red meats, roasted lamb, and feathered game such as pheasant or partridge. Its spicy and earthy undertones also complement hearty stews, legume based dishes, and matured cheeses like Manchego or Idiazabal.

Vintage Quality

The 2017 vintage in Rioja was one of the most challenging on record due to a severe late April frost that significantly reduced yields across the region. However, the remaining grapes benefited from a hot, dry summer, allowing the fruit to achieve exceptional concentration and phenolic ripeness. This resulted in wines of great character and intensity, showcasing the resilience of the vines and the skill of the winemaking team.

title: Clos Tafall Priorat 2024
bodyHtml: Dark ruby with a brownish rim, a pungent nose of stewed black fruit, plums licorice and alcohol. On the palate, intense cassis, plums, licorice and a lot of heat, fine tannins, medium acidity, a long finish due to high alcohol content.

title: Beso De Vino Syrah & Garnacha 2022
bodyHtml: Deep purple colour with aromas of plum, spice, liquorice and blackberry. Dry and medium-bodied with honts of dark berry fruit, plum and spice. Delicious from Spain for an enjoyable "go to" wine!

title: Paltrinieri Piria Lambrusco di Sorbara 2024
bodyHtml:
The Paltrinieri family has been producing Lambrusco grapes for over three generations near the city of Modena. Their method is considered sustainable, with a preference for natural winemaking. The Piria is a big funnel fashioned from half-oak barrel pieces that has been utilised in every generation up to the present day. In the Modena Cathedral, the Piria is represented in the cycle of bas-reliefs dedicated to the months. The label's design was inspired by one found in the Paltrinieri family's collection of agricultural implements.

Wine Description

This Lambrusco is gentle and balanced, with light texture and a touch of earthy appeal; a perfect entrée to these pleasing wines, combining the pale fragrant flavour of Salamino with the punch of textural fruit from Sorbara. This flexible, low-alcohol Lambrusco is simply a treat, with cutting acidity and tart red fruits, as well as a healthy dose of minerality. Bright, approachable, and ideal as an aperitivo, or as you grill marinated chicken, sausages, and shrimp skewers on your BBQ, it will keep you company from start to end.

title: Yellowglen Pink Sparkling (NV)
bodyHtml: Yellowglen is Australia's premier house of sparkling wine and we are proud to have been a part of countless joyful moments of celebration and spontaneous rallying of friends for over forty years. Pink Rose blushes with elegant refreshing flavours full of luscious berries. Best enjoyed with the girls and a punnet of fresh strawberries.

title: Luc Belaire Rare Rose (NV)
bodyHtml: A dramatically beautiful sparkling Rose with a rich, vibrant pink colour. A rich red fruit bouquet precedes an elegant palate of strawberry and blackcurrant, resulting in a perfect harmony of aroma, taste, body,and finish. Refreshing but not too sweet. A delicious, delicate blend of three of France's most famous Rose grapes: Syrah, Cinsault, and Grenache, aged for the perfect effervescence and blended with a 100% Syrah dosage.

title: Glenfarclas 12 Year Old Single Malt Whisky
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Glenfarclas 12 Year Old is a classic Highland single malt whisky produced in the Speyside region of Scotland. The distillery was founded in 1836 by Robert Hay and was later purchased in 1865 by John Grant for £511.19. It remains one of the few family owned and operated distilleries in Scotland, currently managed by the sixth generation of the Grant family, who proudly use the slogan 'The Spirit of Independence'.

Spirit Description

This expression is matured for 12 years in 100% Oloroso sherry casks, serving as a vibrant and bold introduction to the distillery's signature sherried style. The production process utilizes traditional direct fired copper pot stills, which are among the largest in Speyside, to create a robust and concentrated distillate.

  • Colour: It possesses a vibrant amber gold or deep golden honey yellow hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is fresh and light, featuring sherried fruit, honey, and Manuka honey combined with a tempting spicy sweetness and hints of sappy oak and pine resin.

  • Palate: It delivers a full bodied and smooth palate with delightful layers of sherried fruit, walnut cake, date, and delicious sweet sensations, occasionally accompanied by a touch of smoke and earth.

  • Body: The whisky is characterized by a rich, weighty, and velvety texture with a lovely viscosity.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long and flavoursome finish marked by a lingering spiciness, orange zest, and warming notes of cinnamon, cloves, and allspice.

  • ABV: Glenfarclas 12 Year Old is bottled at 43%.

title: Hangar One Makrut Lime Vodka
bodyHtml:
The Hangar One Makrut Lime Vodka offers a distinct and aromatic experience, crafted with the bold flavors of the makrut lime, commonly used in Thai cuisine. This vodka stands out for its nuanced profile, balancing vibrant citrus with subtle complexities.

Colour: Pure and crystal clear.
Aroma: Bright, with prominent notes of lemongrass, ginger, and lime zest.
Palate: Fresh and slightly dry, featuring bold lime flavors with undertones of wood, white pepper, and cucumber.
Finish: Lingering and crisp, leaving a dry, clean aftertaste.

This vodka is celebrated for its complexity, making it an excellent choice for cocktails that highlight citrus flavors, such as martinis or gimlets. Its aromatic qualities also allow it to shine in mixed drinks, adding depth without overpowering the other ingredients. With an ABV of 40%, it’s a versatile option for any bar setup.

Hangar One’s use of natural ingredients, including real makrut limes and leaves, ensures that each bottle captures the unique essence of this exotic citrus, setting it apart from more conventional flavored vodkas.

title: Stolichnaya Vanilla Vodka
bodyHtml: Stoli Vanil offers elegant aromas of Vanilla pod, crème anglaise, and chocolate, with undertones of toasted buttery grain, but without the heavy cloying sweetness of some Vanilla vodkas. Stoli® Vanil™ palate brings a creamy sweetness to the fore, but it is light and balanced, with cocoa powder, white pepper and sweet spicy notes.

title: Olmeca Altos Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Master distiller Jesús Hernandez produces Olmeca Altos tequila using traditional methods, from slow-cooking the piñas in a brick oven to crushing the cooked piñas with a tahona and distilling with small copper pot stills. Olmeca Altos also touts their use of cultivated yeast, rather than “wild or commercial yeast that is often used by competitors.” The reposado is aged 8-10 months in used bourbon barrels.

Sweet and fruity on the nose with cooked agave, citrus, vanilla and oak. The rounded, smooth palate offers more agave, as well as allspice, nutmeg, crème brûlée and oak. The long finish features caramel, agave, orange peel and a whisper of smoke.

title: Captain Morgan White Rum
bodyHtml: On the nose, it's hugely aromatic, with sweet notes of coconut, cane sugar and even toffee. On the mouth, it also runs "sweet" in the open, with a mild, round and viscous mid-weight mouthfeel. On the finish: Coconut, menthol and papaya.

title: Malibu Mango Rum Liqueur
bodyHtml: Mouthwatering mango and creamy coconut create a taste so fresh that the good times will be flowing before you know it. Perfectly balanced flavours for those warm summer days by the pool with friends.

title: Corralejo Blanco Tequila
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: Unaged tequila from Corralejo in Mexico. Bottled after it has come from their copper pot still, this Blanco is referred to as "The Truth" by Don Leonardo, founder of Corralejo as it truly captures the character of the agave. Spicy and herbal with a touch of peppermint, the truth certainly tastes good.

title: Planteray 3 Stars White Rum
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Plantation 3 Stars is a crisp, tasty white rum made by blending spirit produced in Jamaica, Trinidad and Barbados. 

Nose: Hints of dried coconut and guava. A little honey too, and soft spice.

Palate: Spiced palate entry. Creamy vanilla custard, fresh sugar cane honey and even a hint of agave.

Finish: Floral finish. Zingy spices.

title: Ron Millonario 15 Year Old Reserva Especial Rum
bodyHtml: Lovely to drink. A rich, persistent nose of candied-fruit, prunes and cloves. Tasting of butter toffee and sultanas, Demerara sugar and even cola. The well-balanced sweetness first coats the mouth but then fades away slowly, leaving the palate clean.

title: Crystal Head Vodka
bodyHtml:
Dan Aykroyd, a Canadian actor and comedian known for his Blues Brothers role, launched his original premium "clean" vodka in 2008. It's produced from "peaches and cream" sweet corn blended with water from St. John's, Newfoundland. Cool detail: It's distilled four times before being filtered seven times. Their iconic skull-shaped bottle is produced in Europe, where bits of crystal is melted into the glass to ensure absolute clarity.

Crystal Head Vodka offers a clean, clear and colourless spirit. On the nose, neutral grain aromas with a delicate touch of citrus. Silky smooth with a hint of sweetness and vanilla. Ending with a sweet, creamy finish.

title: Grey Goose Vodka - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
Using only the finest ingredients, Grey Goose is renowned for its smooth and silky character. 

Expect subtle aromas of sweet citrus and white flowers; the palate is soft with a gentle and subtle sweetness that envelops your mouth; warm and spicy on the finish.

title: Marca Negra Meteoro Mezcal
bodyHtml:
The Marca Negra Meteoro Mezcal is an artisanal spirit crafted from 100% Espadín agave, sourced from Oaxaca, Mexico. This mezcal embodies the traditional methods of production, with agave hearts slow-cooked in an earthen pit for over a week, crushed using a mule-drawn stone tahona, and naturally fermented before double distillation.

  • Colour: Crystal clear.
  • Aroma: Delicate smoke intertwined with herbal notes and hints of roasted agave.
  • Palate: Balanced flavors of agave sweetness, mild earthiness, and a subtle smokiness, accompanied by light citrus undertones.
  • Body: Medium-bodied with a smooth mouthfeel.
  • Finish: Long and clean, with lingering herbal notes and a touch of minerality.

This mezcal is known for its versatility, making it enjoyable both as a sipping spirit and in cocktails. Its traditional production methods and complex flavor profile offer a unique taste of Oaxaca’s mezcal heritage.

title: Bacardi White Rum (Glass Bottle)
bodyHtml: Bacardi Superior Rum is the original Bacardi rum, dating back to 1862 when Don Facundo Bacardi Massó purchased his first rum distillery in Cuba. 150 years later, Bacardi Superior is now manufactured in Puerto Rico, but the recipe remains largely the same. A unique strain of yeast discovered in the Cuban sugarcane fields is used to produce Bacardi Superior rum. The rum is filtered through charcoal, a process pioneered by Bacardi, before and after it is aged in oak barrels for at least one year.

title: The Macallan 12 Year Old Double Cask
bodyHtml:
Introduction

The Macallan 12 Year Old Double Cask is a single malt Scotch whisky from Scotland, specifically from the Speyside region. The Macallan distillery was founded in 1824 by Alexander Reid, initially operating as the Elchie's distillery on the pre-existing Macallan farm buildings. Roderick Kemp brought much-needed stability to the distillery when he took control in 1892, and his family retained ownership for over a century. The distillery is currently owned by the Edrington Group.

Spirit Description

The whisky has a colour described as 'Harvest Sun'. The aroma offers creamy butterscotch, hints of toffee apple, candied orange, vanilla custard, and newly felled oak. Notes of fudge with candied orange and lemon, alongside vanilla and soft spice are also present on the nose. On the palate, it is described as deliciously honeyed, with wood spices such as ginger and nutmeg, citrus, caramel, raisins, and resinous notes. It has a creamy mouthfeel with flavours of marmalade and baking spices. The finish is medium to long, with a sweet and drying quality as oak lingers. This single malt is known for its perfect balance, which is achieved by maturing the spirit for a minimum of 12 years in a marriage of sherry-seasoned American and European oak casks. The American oak contributes sweeter, vanilla notes, while the European oak provides rich, spicy notes. The alcohol by volume (ABV) is 40%.

title: Gooderham & Worts Whiskey
bodyHtml:
A blend of corn, rye, wheat and barley and bottled at 44.4% ABV, this pours a golden/amber. On the nose, look for notes of honey, toffee, dried flowers, and bubble gum. The palate is rich and complete with a smooth, viscous mouthfeel and flavours of sweet floral and stone fruit, followed by a medium-length spicy finish.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Balvenie 12 Year Old DoubleWood
bodyHtml:
The Balvenie 12 Year Old DoubleWood is a hallmark Speyside single malt Scotch whisky produced at the Balvenie Distillery in Dufftown, Scotland. Founded in 1892 by William J. Grant, the distillery remains independently owned by the family company William Grant & Sons Ltd.. Balvenie is distinguished for maintaining traditional production methods, including growing its own barley, operating its own floor maltings, and employing on-site coopers and coppersmiths. Launched in 1993, the DoubleWood expression was pioneered by Malt Master David C. Stewart and is credited with popularising the 'wood finishing' technique in the whisky industry.

Spirit Description

The spirit gains its name and character from a dual maturation process: it spends at least 12 years in refill American oak ex-bourbon casks before being transferred to first-fill European oak Oloroso sherry butts for a final nine months of finishing. It is then married in large oak vessels known as 'tuns' for three to four months before bottling.

  • Colour: Information not explicitly provided, though its sherry finishing typically imparts a warm amber or golden hue.

  • Aroma: Sweet and inviting, featuring layers of honey and vanilla intertwined with Oloroso sherry notes, sultanas, and a supple nuttiness.

  • Palate: Mellow and smooth with a rich body. Flavours of nutty sweetness and cinnamon spiciness are balanced by delicate sherry depths and hints of dried apricot.

  • Body: Medium-bodied and well-integrated, known for its approachable and 'sessionable' quality.

  • Finish: Long, warming, and slightly drying while maintaining its characteristic sweetness.

  • ABV: Typically bottled at 40% (some markets may see 43%).

title: Skyy Vodka
bodyHtml: SKYY is now made using water with Pacific Minerals, sourced from the San Francisco Bay Area and is filtered through California Limestone. A taste as smooth as the tide rolling out to sea.

title: Connemara Peated Irish Single Malt
bodyHtml:
Connemara Peated Irish Single Malt is an Irish whiskey that sets itself apart by incorporating peat—a characteristic more commonly associated with Scotch whiskies. Produced at the Cooley Distillery in County Louth, Ireland, Connemara is renowned for its unique smoky flavor profile.

Tasting Notes:

  • Color: Lightly golden.

  • Aroma: Opens with sweet barley notes, complemented by wafts of peaty smoke, kippers, and well-baked apple crumble.

  • Palate: Lightly sweet honey with subdued, clean smoke, along with peaty vegetal notes, sweet barley water, light spice, and vanilla oak.

  • Finish: Clean and crisp, with a lingering smoky aftertaste.

Serving Suggestions:

  • Temperature: Serve at 16-18°C (60-64°F) to fully appreciate its aromatic complexity.

  • Glassware: Use a tulip-shaped glass to concentrate the aromas.

  • Food Pairings: Pairs excellently with dishes such as smoked salmon, grilled meats, and strong cheeses.

Accolades:

  • Wine Enthusiast: 92 Points.

  • International Wine & Spirit Competition (IWSC): Gold Medal.

  • Whisky Advocate: 90 Points.

title: Smirnoff Vodka - 1.14 Litre Bottle (Glass Bottle)
bodyHtml: Founded in 1864 by Pyotr Arsenievich Smirnov, what we now call Smirnoff was the first vodka to use charcoal filtration in the distillation process. This charcoal filtration produces a spirit that is ideal for mixing because of its smooth and clean palate; perfect in a Moscow Mule.

title: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
The Glenfiddich 12 Year Old Single Malt is a timeless expression from one of Scotland’s most renowned distilleries, nestled in the heart of Speyside. Crafted by the pioneering family-owned Glenfiddich Distillery, this whisky epitomizes their dedication to quality and tradition. Aged in American oak and European oak casks, the 12-year maturation process imbues this single malt with a distinct character that reflects both heritage and innovation.

Tasting Notes
Golden in hue, this whisky greets the senses with aromas of fresh pear and subtle oak. On the palate, it reveals a harmonious balance of creamy malt, orchard fruits, and a touch of butterscotch, culminating in a smooth, mellow finish with lingering notes of sweetness and oak.

Serving Suggestions
Best enjoyed neat or with a splash of water to enhance its delicate flavours, Glenfiddich 12 Year Old is ideal for sipping from a tulip-shaped glass. Pair it with mild cheeses, fresh fruit, or light desserts like shortbread to complement its elegant profile.

title: Mitre Joven Espadin Mezcal
bodyHtml: Miter Joven is a 100% handmade elixir that pays homage to the ancient shaman warriors, precisely embodied in the bottle's design. Originally from Santiago Matatlán, Oaxaca. Made with double distillation that results in a mezcal that seduces with its flavour, thanks to the Agave Espadín blend.

title: Gran Patron Piedra Extra Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Made with the finest 100% Weber Blue Agave and presented in a distinctive crystal bottle and aged for over three years for a rich and balanced taste.

COLOR: Deep mahogany

AROMA: Fresh fruit & mushroom with hints of toasted French oak

TASTE: Sweet yet complex with notes of agave, vanilla & mushroom

FINISH: Smooth, long-lasting

title: Marca Negra Ensamble Mezcal
bodyHtml: This un-aged mezcal is highly aromatic, campfire, pine needles, pineapple, roasted oranges and fresh earth. Bright herbal flavours of sweet grass, white pepper and juniper, are quite lively aromatically and on the palate. The first taste is hot but pleasantly so with lots of sweet honey and roasted figs with the earth and smoke. Long warm sweet finish that keeps me coming back for more.

title: Glenmorangie Quinta Ruban 14 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Dr Bill, our Director of Whisky Creation, was born with a taste for adventure. And with this single malt he sought to create a whisky as unpredictable as his travels. Quinta Ruban is a whisky journey into the wild – a dark and delectable forest where the wind whistles with gusts of peppermint and dark swirls of chocolate can happen at any moment. 

In our giraffe-high stills, it begins soft and fruity, then gets darker and deeper as we let it age for 14 years in bourbon casks and port casks from Portugal. The finished whisky is a thicket of voluptuous flavour combinations. Walnut and black pepper. Mandarin orange and melted marshmallow. Dark chocolate bar and peppermint. And, like stepping into a chocolate-minty-orange unknown, the journey is as delicious as the destination.

title: Ron Abuelo Grand Reserve 12 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

A smooth and rich tasting rum from Panama where Abuelo grows its own sugar cane which from which they extract molasses for their rums. This is highly rated amongst rum enthusiasts.

title: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
This is a great introduction for those looking to experiment with Scotch whisky. It is aromatic with notes of wild herbs, heather, honey and orchard fruits. The palate is round and creamy with a full, rich taste of honey and ripe apples, with vanilla, hazelnut and toffee flavours followed by a rich and lingering finish.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Evan Williams Single Barrel Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Crafted in Kentucky, USA, Evan Williams Single Barrel Bourbon is produced by the historic Heaven Hill Distillery, one of America’s largest and most respected independent family-owned distilleries. This expression stands out as the only vintage-dated single barrel bourbon on the market, with each bottle hand-labeled with the barrel number, date of distillation, and bottling date. This transparency underscores the distillery’s commitment to craftsmanship and traceability.

Description
In the glass, Evan Williams Single Barrel displays a warm amber hue with golden highlights. The nose offers inviting aromas of roasted corn, charred oak, vanilla bean, and hints of citrus and tobacco leaf. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and well-balanced, revealing flavours of dark caramel, toasted oak, and baking spice, finishing with notes of cocoa and a touch of orange zest. The bourbon’s refined texture and integrated sweetness are a testament to careful aging and single barrel selection. While not labelled with an exact age, most vintages rest between seven and nine years in new American oak.

title: Compass Box Great King Street Artist's Blend
bodyHtml: A rich, round, fruity whisky made for demanding single malt drinkers and discerning bartenders. Artist's Blend is a tribute to the blenders of the late 19th century. These individuals used artistry, creativity and craft to pioneer a spirit that became one of the world's most famous and desirable drinks. The combination of flavorful single-malt whiskies and delicate single-grain whiskies produces one of the most invigorating and pleasurable styles of Scotch whisky. They drew on archive recipes from the golden era of whisky making. They applied their own 21st-century cask maturation techniques to create whiskies with a high single malt content, delivering compelling flavour and complexity while maintaining the versatility of a Blended Scotch. Soft, full and fruity on the palate, with flavours of baked apple, vanilla, spices and toasted oak.

title: Dalmore 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: Dalmore 12 is aged for the first nine years in American white oak ex-bourbon casks before half is transferred to ex-oloroso sherry casks for the final three years. The result is a whisky with a combination of sweetness and rich, sherry flavours.

title: Don Julio Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: Pure tasting tequila is made only from quality agave. Pours clear with lively aromas of fresh agave, lemon, lime, and grapefruit. Smooth on the palate with light agave sweetness, delicate grassy notes and a hint of black pepper leading to a clean finish.

title: Cruzan Aged Rum
bodyHtml: An exquisite blend of rums aged 2-4 years in charred oak casks, Cruzan Aged Dark Rum delivers a smooth, medium-bodied, aromatic taste with every slow sip. Rich in color and texture. Exceptionally clean and robust taste. Spend quality time with this one on the rocks, or mixed with tonic or cola.

title: El Dorado 3 Year Old White Rum
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

This classic white rum offers aromas of toasted coconut, vanilla bean with hints of caramel and spice. Dry with flavours of sweet creamed coconut, vanilla, caramelized banana and a slight cocoa bean note on the finish. Elegant enough for sipping neat or used in upscale cocktails.

title: Craigellachie 13 Year Old
bodyHtml:
A range of Craigellachie single malts was released for the first time in 2014. The distillery is known for its meaty character, and the 13-year-old is sweet, spicy and slightly smoky.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Canadian Club Blackberry Whisky
bodyHtml:
Produced in Windsor, Ontario, Canadian Club Blackberry Whisky is a fruit-forward expression of Canada's oldest surviving whisky brand. Founded in 1858 by Hiram Walker, the distillery established a legacy of innovation by pioneering barrel aging and blended whisky techniques. Currently owned by Suntory Global Spirits, the brand continues to emphasize its historic 'terroir' on the banks of the Detroit River, where it famously supplied a significant portion of the spirits smuggled during the Prohibition era.

Wine Description

This flavoured whisky features a vibrant profile infused with the juice of ripe blackberries, resulting in a smooth and approachable character. On the nose, it presents fresh aromas of bright blackberries and sweet vanilla, underpinned by soft notes of oak and almond. The palate is medium-bodied and juicy, delivering an intense combination of berry sweetness, caramel, and light toffee, balanced by a subtle rye whisky spice and a touch of pepper. It concludes with a clean, warming finish that lingers with notes of berry compote and gentle oak. Bottled at 40% ABV, this spirit maintains the classic Canadian Club smoothness while offering a contemporary, sweeter stylistic note.

title: Tito's Handmade Vodka - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml: Tito's Handmade Vodka is designed to be savored by spirit connoisseurs. It is crafted in an old-fashioned pot still, like fine single malt scotches and high-end French cognacs. This method of distillation requires more skill and effort than modern practices, but it's well worth it.

title: Rough Rider Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Long Island Spirits named their whiskeys after the First United States Volunteer Cavalry, the "Rough Riders," initially organized by Long Island's own Teddy Roosevelt in 1898 to fight in the Spanish-American War. The whisky, sourced from LDI, is a mash bill of 60% corn, 35% rye and 5% malted barley. After initial aging in new charred oak, It is finished in merlot and chardonnay casks from local wineries. The wine casks are washed in local brandy before the bourbon goes in for final aging.

See More USA Whisky

title: Bushmills 21 Year Old Rare Single Malt Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
This premier aged Irish whiskey originates from the village of Bushmills in County Antrim, Northern Ireland, produced at the historic Old Bushmills Distillery. Bushmills 21 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey represents the pinnacle of the core age-stated range, crafted from 100% unpeated malted barley and triple-distilled in traditional copper pot stills using water drawn from Saint Columb’s Rill. The whiskey spends a minimum of 19 years aging separately in charred American oak ex-bourbon barrels and Spanish Oloroso sherry butts. These two aged components are married together and transferred into first-fill Madeira fortified wine casks for a final finishing period of two full years. Hand-bottled in limited, numbered batches at 80 proof (40.0% ABV) in a 750 ml decanter-style bottle, it is non-chill filtered and bottled at natural color.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a deep, polished mahogany hue with vibrant amber and dark gold highlights, forming thick, slow-creeping tears along the glass. On the nose, it is rich, elegant, and deeply aromatic, opening with ripe dark raisins, dried figs, dates, and candied orange peel, followed by layers of honeyed malt, dark toffee, hazelnut praline, and seasoned cedar wood. On the palate, the triple-distilled spirit delivers an exceptionally silky, velvety, and unctuous mouthfeel. Initial waves of rich dark chocolate, sweet dried fruit, and poached pears give way to complex mid-palate notes of toasted pecans, vanilla bean, roasted coffee beans, and warming baking spices (nutmeg and allspice). The two-year Madeira cask finish imparts a distinctive caramelized nutty sweetness without drying out the delicate orchard malt core. The finish is remarkably long, mellow, and satisfying, trailing off with lingering impressions of sweet pipe tobacco, dark fruit compote, roasted walnuts, and gentle wood spice.

title: Young's Old Sam Demerara Rum
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Young, rambunctious and strong of nose and taste. It’s not meant for taking neat, but as a mixer?

title: Zaya Gran Reserva Rum
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml: The seductive nose is juicy, with ripe, fruity aromas of baked apple, baked pear, nutmeg, vanilla bean, cardamom and dried orange peel. Flavour is firm, bittersweet, focused and more maple-like than sugary. Ends moderately oily and keenly bittersweet.

title: Maker's Mark Kentucky Straight Bourbon - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Using red winter wheat instead of rye produces a noticeably sweeter, less bitter, less harsh whisky. Pouring a rich golden amber colour with an enticing nose of butterscotch and vanilla bean, the palate is smooth with delectable toffee and milk chocolate flavour followed by a lightly spiced finish.

title: Coruba Dark Rum
bodyHtml:
General Information

Coruba Dark is a staple in the field of tropical mixology. Inexpensive, assertive, and funky, it would be difficult to miss in most mixed drinks. Coruba is often used to provide a "bottom end" in tiki drinks, and manages to stand up to strong citrus flavors. It is a blend of pot and column still rum that's been aged at least two years in American oak barrels.

title: Knob Creek Rye
bodyHtml:
Knob Creek Rye is a premium straight rye whiskey produced by Knob Creek, a brand under the Jim Beam family, known for its robust and full-flavored spirits. Introduced in 2012, Knob Creek Rye has gained recognition for its quality and craftsmanship.

Tasting Notes

  • Color: Deep amber.
  • Aroma: Expressive notes of fresh cracked rye grain, green apple, and charred oak, with underlying hints of smoky syrup.
  • Palate: A balanced blend of light rye grain, white pepper, citrus rinds, vanilla, and pine, offering a slightly spicy yet smooth sipping experience.
  • Finish: Lingering notes of light rye spice, sweet vanilla, and oak, culminating in a satisfying and mellow conclusion.

Alcohol Content

Bottled at 100 proof (50% ABV), Knob Creek Rye delivers a bold and robust character.

Accolades

  • Awarded "Best Rye Worldwide Whiskey" at the 2016 International Wine and Spirits Competition, highlighting its global recognition and excellence.

Serving Suggestions

  • Neat or On the Rocks: Enjoy straight or over ice to fully appreciate its complex flavor profile.
  • Cocktails: Ideal for classic rye-based cocktails such as the Manhattan or Old Fashioned, where its spice and depth enhance the overall experience.

title: J & B - 750 ml
bodyHtml: J&B Rare uses a blend of 42 malt and grain whiskies and includes more single malt whisky than any other blended Scotch. A mixable whisky that's perfect for those exploring the Scotch category. Golden amber colour, light peat, smoke/iodine nose and flavour. A dry, clean style, crisp finish.

title: Auchentoshan American Oak
bodyHtml: From the Auchentoshan distillery in the Scottish Lowlands comes a triple distilled single malt Scotch whisky aged entirely in first fill American oak casks. A light, bright whisky with plenty of vanilla sweetness at its centre - great as an aperitif dram.

title: Bowmore 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Hailing from the rugged shores of Islay, Bowmore is one of Scotland’s most historic distilleries, established in 1779. With over two centuries of expertise, Bowmore has mastered the art of balancing peat smoke with refined complexity. The 12 Year Old expression is a testament to this legacy, offering a well-rounded and approachable introduction to Islay whisky.

Whisky Description

Bowmore 12 Year Old pours a warm amber hue, reflecting its time in oak casks. On the nose, delicate floral notes and a touch of honey are intertwined with signature Islay peat smoke. The palate unfolds with layers of sweet vanilla, ripe citrus, and a subtle maritime salinity, underscored by a gentle smokiness. Medium-bodied with a silky texture, it finishes long and warming, with lingering hints of dark chocolate and soft spice.

Accolades

  • Whisky Advocate - 90 points
  • International Spirits Challenge - Gold Medal

Food Pairing

This whisky pairs beautifully with smoked salmon, aged cheddar, or dark chocolate truffles. Its balance of sweetness and smoke also complements roasted nuts and charred meats.
"A perfect match to enhance the whisky's complexity."

title: Havana Club Especial Rum 37.5 %
bodyHtml: Havana Club Reserva is a savoury and exceptionally smooth blend of carefully crafted aged rums, selected to combine a smooth flavour with a light aroma. A warm and radiant amber. Integrated aromas of pear and light tobacco introduce a more robust bouquet of wooden notes, as a result of natural ageing.  Light to medium-bodied, very refined and elegant on the palate, with balanced flavours of caramel, pecan, sweet spice, and mineral with some spicy/peppery, smoky notes on the finish.

title: Forty Creek Barrel Select Niagara Whisky
bodyHtml:
Forty Creek is often credited for the renewed interest in quality Canadian whisky. The original pours a medium amber and offers complex aromas and flavours of apricots, caramel, spice, vanilla, ginger and toasted oak, ending in a long smooth finish.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Barbancourt 15 Year Old Estate Reserve Rum
bodyHtml:
This Haitian rum is produced using fresh sugarcane juice. Originally this was reserved for friends and family, but in the 1960's Barbancourt released this product for sale. Their rums are aged in French Limousin oak barrels.

It leads with aromas of straw, cane syrup, tea, honey, caramel, dried peaches, almond and oak that are elegant and inviting. The palate reveals tannins, toffee, nuts and cinnamon in an oily, smooth mouthfeel that lingers to reveal stewed fruits. The finish is soft, mellow and displays of all of these flavours in a slow fade.

title: Gibson's Finest Rare
bodyHtml:
This full flavoured Canadian whisky exhibits depth by virtue of its barrel-aged character, its defining feature. It excels as an ultra-smooth whisky with vanilla-sweet oakiness that carries through to the finish. Best enjoyed neat or on the rocks.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Glendalough Double Barrel Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml: Glendalough Double Barrel Irish Whiskey is a single grain Irish whiskey, initially matured in American bourbon barrels before enjoying a finishing period of six months in Spanish Oloroso Sherry casks. This comes bottled at 42% ABV, brought down to this strength by Wicklow mountain water. A rather tasty release presented by Glendalough, rich in vanilla, caramel, Christmas spices and dried fruit notes.

title: Patron Silver Tequila
bodyHtml:
Patrón Silver Tequila is an unaged ultra-premium spirit produced in the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted at the historic Hacienda Patrón in Atotonilco El Alto (NOM 1492), the brand was founded in 1989 by John Paul DeJoria and Martin Crowley. Now under the stewardship of Bacardi, Patrón Silver is widely credited with establishing the luxury tequila category globally, combining traditional hand-crafted production methods with strict quality standards to deliver a smooth, agave-forward profile.

Spirit Description

Patrón Silver is crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves slow-cooked in small brick ovens for 79 hours. The cooked agaves are crushed using two distinct methods: a traditional two-ton volcanic stone tahona wheel and modern roller mills. The resulting juices are fermented in open-air pine wood vats and double-distilled in small, custom copper pot stills. Unaged and bottled straight from the still, the spirit is presented in Patrón's signature hand-blown glass bottle topped with a natural cork.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and pristine.

  • Aroma: Fresh and inviting, opening with bright raw and cooked agave, crisp citrus zest (lemon and lime), and subtle white pepper spice, complemented by light floral notes and fresh herbal undertones.

  • Palate: Smooth, clean, and sweet on the entry. Upfront flavors of sweet roasted agave, fresh lime, and grapefruit yield to a light minerality, gentle earthiness, and subtle white pepper.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a soft, supple, and rounded texture.

  • Finish: Crisp, smooth, and refreshing, with lingering light citrus, sweet agave, and a gentle pepper spark without harsh heat.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Canadian Club 100% Rye
bodyHtml: Canadian Club 100% Rye is medium amber gold in colour. Complex aromas of cereal, vanilla, rye bread, sweet fruit, herb and spice, with notes of vanilla, toffee, pepper, cedar smoke and banana; sweet, creamy and warm, balanced by rye spice, clove, cinnamon, sweet oak, vanilla and caramel flavours; lingering finish shows dried fruit, honey and ginger.

title: Bulleit Bourbon Frontier Whiskey
bodyHtml:
High rye concentration and limestone filtration along with highly charred barrels give this whisky a clear golden amber colour and aromas of rich toffee, roasted grain, spice and smoky oak notes. The palate is full body and smooth with flavours of vanilla, apple, sweet spice and smoky oak, followed by a long finish.
