title: Alberta Premium Rye - 750 ml
bodyHtml: The authentic flavour of prairie rye and careful barrel ageing gives this whisky a golden amber colour and an aromatic sweet bouquet of banana, toffee, and light spice. The flavour is mellow and slightly smoky with a lively woody edge on a medium weight palate that finishes with a hint of hot cinnamon spice.

title: Olmeca Gold Tequila
bodyHtml: Olmeca Tequila is hand-crafted using authentic, traditional methods in the heart of Los Altos, Mexico. Pouring a pale straw colour, the nose is expressive with white pepper, grain and floral notes. The palate is full and powerful with distinctive coconut balanced by flashes of hot cinnamon on the finish.

title: Don Julio Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Aged for eight months in white American oak barrels, this is a fine example of a reposado. Golden in colour with an enticing bouquet of citrus, stone fruits and spice. Smooth and elegant on the palate with flavours of pear, dark chocolate, vanilla, hints of cinnamon and dried fruit notes coming through on a warm silky finish.

title: Amrut Indian Single Malt Whiskey
bodyHtml:
According to Indian Mythology, when Gods and Rakshasas – the demons – churned the oceans using the mountain Meru as a churner, a golden pot sprang out containing the Elixir of Life. That was called the “Amrut”. The great founders of the distillery aptly named it Amrut Distilleries.

This intense, complex and most unusual single malt is not made in Scotland, but rather in the south of India.  Acclaimed the world over, including in the UK, it is made from barley grown at the foot of the Himalayas, and glacier water from the same mountaintops.

Nose : Distinctly confidant liquorice-bourbon notes with near perfect bitter-sweet balance; burnt honeycomb and toffee also abound;

Taste : Outstanding richness and sheen to the enormous barley-oak sweetness; again there is a big bourbony cut to the cloth with all the liquorice and molassed sugar normally associated; but the barley adds that extra dimension;

Finish : Long, wonderfully layered oak offering variations of a sweet dry theme; a touch silky with some cream toffee at the death

title: Wiser's Deluxe - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
In the mid-1800s, J.P. Wiser set out to create a whisky that pleased the nose, tongue and eye, and the result is this bright golden whisky that offers aromas of sweet caramel, dried fruit, and vanilla. The palate is rich with toasted grain, sweet cornmeal and vanilla flavours, followed by a smooth and creamy finish.

title: Camarena Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Familia Camarena 100% Blue Agave Reposado Tequila is rested in American oak barrels for 60 days before bottling. The barrel aging process lends a touch of soft spice to the natural sweetness of the agave. The result is a smooth, refined barrel aged tequila with an elegant, robust finish

title: Cazadores Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Cazadores Reposado Tequila is a historic, widely popular aged spirit originating from Arandas in the Highlands (Los Altos) region of Jalisco, Mexico. Originally created in 1922 by Don José María Bañuelos, the brand name "Cazadores" translates to "Hunters," honoring the highland deer that roamed the agave fields during its creation. Produced under Bacardi at the Tequila Cazadores de Arandas distillery (NOM 1487), the expression is celebrated globally as an accessible, high-value staple for both casual sipping and cocktail crafting.

Spirit Description

Cazadores Reposado is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave grown in the red, iron-rich soil of the Jalisco Highlands. The agaves are cooked, fermented while playing classical music (a long-standing tradition at the distillery intended to soothe the yeast), and double-distilled in copper pot stills. The tequila rests for up to 12 months in small, virgin American oak barrels, which imparts a vibrant balance of fresh wood and agave sweetness.

  • Colour: Pale gold to light amber with bright straw highlights.

  • Aroma: Inviting and sweet, opening with cooked agave, toasted oak, and vanilla bean, complemented by light citrus zest, melon, and floral notes.

  • Palate: Smooth, approachably dry, and spice-forward. Upfront flavors of roasted agave, light caramel, and sweet vanilla give way to subtle tropical fruit, cracked black pepper, and faint herbal dill.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a soft, clean, and velvety texture.

  • Finish: Crisp, warm, and medium in length, tapering off with lingering oak spice, light pepper, and soft vanilla.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Camarena Silver Tequila
bodyHtml: Notes of toasted agave, fresh green herbs and vibrant citrus. Soft and smooth on the palate with hints of sweet vanilla, savory brown spices, and black pepper with a warming finish.

title: Alberta Premium Rye - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The authentic flavour of prairie rye and careful barrel ageing gives this whisky a golden amber colour and an aromatic sweet bouquet of banana, toffee, and light spice. The flavour is mellow and slightly smoky with a lively woody edge on a medium weight palate that finishes with a hint of hot cinnamon spice.

title: Casamigos Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml:
Longtime friends George Clooney, Rande Gerber and Mike Meldman love Casamigos. On the rocks, by the shot, at times, straight from the bottle. Tequila filled nights with friends is how Casamigos was born. Their idea was to make the best tasting, smoothest Tequila and Mezcal that didn’t have to be covered up with salt or lime. So they did.

They are delighted that consumers and Tequila and Mezcal connoisseurs alike enjoy and appreciate the authenticity of Casamigos. This is quality you can taste, so raise a glass with their award winning spirit. 

The name Casamigos comes from the Spanish casa (house) and amigos (friends), thus "house of friends."

Crystal clear. Hints of citrus & sweet agave. Fruit forward with notes of vanilla and grapefruit. Purified water from their own well.

title: Glenfiddich 15 Year Old Solera
bodyHtml:
Glenfiddich 15 Year Old Solera Single Malt Scotch Whisky is an iconic Speyside expression produced by Glenfiddich Distillery in Dufftown, Banffshire, Scotland. Owned by William Grant & Sons, the distillery made whisky history in 1998 when Fifth Master Malt Distiller David Stewart introduced the pioneering Solera process to Scotch single malts. Inspired by the traditional sherry bodegas of Spain, Glenfiddich matures three distinct cask styles before blending them in a massive, handcrafted Oregon pine Solera Vat. The vat has remained at least half full since 1998, ensuring a continuous, multi-layered depth of flavor that defines this globally celebrated whisky.

Spirit Description

Glenfiddich 15 Year Old is crafted using single malt distillate made from 100% malted barley and spring water from the Robbie Dhu spring, distilled in small copper pot stills. The spirit is aged separately for at least 15 years in three types of oak casks: European oak ex-sherry casks, American oak ex-bourbon casks, and new virgin American oak barrels. The aged liquids are then married in the 35,000-liter Solera Vat, where they harmonize and continuously absorb the mature depth of previous batches. Finally, the whisky is settled in smaller Portuguese oak Solera Tun barrels prior to bottling, resulting in a rich, warm, and dark-fruit-forward profile.

  • Colour: Golden amber with warm ruby and reddish highlights.

  • Aroma: Intensely fragrant and complex, opening with sweet honey, vanilla fudge, and dark dried fruits (raisins, figs, and dates), complemented by marzipan, cinnamon, and subtle toasted oak.

  • Palate: Silky, smooth, and full-flavored on the entry. Upfront notes of sherry-soaked raisins, dark plum, and candied orange peel yield to sweet honey, baking spices (clove and nutmeg), dark chocolate, and a rich wood depth.

  • Body: Medium-to-full-bodied with a velvety, rounded, and mouth-coating viscosity.

  • Finish: Long, warm, and comforting, trailing off with persistent sweet sherry, dark fruit cake, gentle spice, and a dry oak warmth.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% ABV (80 Proof).

title: Wiser's Deluxe
bodyHtml: In the mid-1800s J.P. Wiser set out to create a whisky that pleased the nose, tongue and eye, the result is this bright golden whisky that offers aromas of sweet caramel, dried fruit, and vanilla; the palate is rich with flavours of toasted grain, sweet cornmeal and vanilla followed by a smooth/creamy finish.

title: Tarantula Azul Tequila
bodyHtml:
Tarantula Azul is a vibrant, citrus-infused tequila liqueur originating from Mexico. Produced by McCormick Distilling Co. (crafted in Jalisco, Mexico by Destilería Leyros), the spirit was designed as a sweet, approachable party spirit and cocktail modifier. It combines 100% blue agave tequila with natural citrus liqueur to deliver a smooth, fruit-forward profile without the traditional sharp burn of standard tequila shooters.

Spirit Description

Tarantula Azul blends high-quality blue agave tequila with crisp natural citrus flavors and a distinctive electric-blue color. The formulation balances the earthy sweetness of agave with bright, tangy citrus peel to create an easy-drinking, party-ready spirit.

  • Colour: Striking neon cobalt blue with brilliant turquoise highlights.

  • Aroma: Bright and aromatic, opening with sweet blue curaçao citrus, tart lime zest, and subtle undertones of cooked agave and floral blossoms.

  • Palate: Sweet, mild, and fruity on the entry. Upfront flavors of candied citrus, lime, and orange peel give way to light herbaceous agave, soft pepper spice, and a mild tartness.

  • Body: Light-to-medium-bodied with a smooth, glossy, and nectar-like viscosity.

  • Finish: Crisp, sweet, and clean, trailing off with lingering blue raspberry/citrus sweetness and a refreshing, mild warm touch without heavy heat.

  • ABV: Bottled at 35% (70 Proof).

title: Cutty Sark
bodyHtml: Named for the historic ship, Cutty Sark is a blend that's been around since 1923. It has whisky from Glenrothes at its core along with whisky from all over Scotland to give a rounded blend with a little bit of smoke.

title: Lemon Hart Rum - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Lemon Hart & Son Original 1804 is the classic British-style black rum, cherished by rum drinkers around the world for its bold, rich flavour, full-bodied complexity and exceptionally smooth finish. Original 1804 is the perfect example of a rum that shows pronounced flavour when mixed with cola. A premium blend of select single estate rums, distilled, Bourbon barrel-aged and blended on the East Bank of the Demerara River in the lush tropical Caribbean country of Guyana. Rum always.

title: Bushmills Original Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
This cornerstone blended Irish whiskey—commonly referred to in trade and consumer circles simply as "Bushmills White Bush"—originates from the village of Bushmills in County Antrim, Northern Ireland, produced at the historic Old Bushmills Distillery. Serving as the foundational everyday flagship of the brand, Bushmills Original Irish Whiskey is built around triple-distilled single malt whiskey aged for a minimum of five years in charred American oak ex-bourbon barrels, blended with an approachable, aromatic Irish grain whiskey. Bottled at 80 proof (40.0% ABV), it stands as the traditional introduction to Bushmills' historic low-temperature triple-distillation style.

Spirit Description

This whiskey pours a light, radiant golden-straw hue with pale amber reflections and clean, nimble legs in the glass. On the nose, it is light-bodied, fresh, and invitingly sweet, leading with crisp green apples, ripe pear skins, and honeyed cereal grains, accompanied by subtle nuances of vanilla blossom, elderflower, and soft charred oak. On the palate, the triple distillation ensures an exceptionally smooth, accessible, and clean mouthfeel. An initial rush of sweet clover honey, vanilla wafer, and sweet corn gives way to mid-palate notes of fresh orchard fruit, malt biscuit, and gentle baking spice (cracked white pepper and light nutmeg). Devoid of heavy tannins, aggressive ethanol bite, or peat smoke, the profile emphasizes pristine drinkability. The finish is short to medium, clean, and crisp, lingering with impressions of dried apple peel, sweet cereal malt, and a light, drying touch of toasted oak.

title: Evan Williams Black Label Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Evan Williams was Kentucky's first commercial distillery. In operation since 1783, it continues to produce premium American whiskey. Charred barrels give this whiskey a copper colour and aromas of toffee, caramel, oak and ginger. Rich and smooth with flavours of dried fruit and vanilla leading to a warming finish.

title: Wild Turkey Bourbon
bodyHtml: An 81-proof (40.5%ABV) bourbon crafted by Wild Turkey associate distiller Eddie Russell, son of master distiller Jimmy. It's a high rye mash matured in heavily charred casks for big flavour at a more approachable ABV than the 101.

title: El Dorado 12 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Lush tropical fruit and spice nose with hints of honey and dark sugar. Round, mellow, full bodied palate with rich flavours of fruit and spice. The finish is delightful, elegant and dry.

title: Giffard Cachaca Thoquino
bodyHtml: Sugar cane eau de vie produced in Brazil. This spirit appeared in the 15th century when Portugueses came with alambics to distill sugar canes. Since that time, Cachaça is the national spirit of Brazil. The Cachaça Thoquino is a ” arguadente de cana ” obtained by fermentation and then distillation of the fresh juice of sugar cane. It is produced by the family distillery Thomaz de Aquino (created in 1906), which carries out all the production process itself from its own sugar cane plantations, which guarantees a regularity in the quality of the product.

title: Flor De Cana Gran Reserva 7 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml: Aged in Jack Daniels barrels, this rum pours a deep amber colour and is fragrant with pronounced aromas of honey and caramel. On the palate it is medium-bodied and warming with flavours of banana, caramel and a hint of wood smoke on a long finish.

title: Lamb's Spiced Rum
bodyHtml: The true character of Alfred Lamb is reflected in this bold but smooth vanilla spiced rum.

title: Captain Morgan Spiced Rum - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

When it comes to making your night legendary, the Captain knows that there are no mistakes. His Original Spiced Rum is certainly no exception. This versatile blend works well in any scenario. Is tonight your time to try it?

Mixed spices, special fruit flavours and heavy vanilla notes come together with a slight spiciness and heavy body to create a perfectly balanced spirit with a smooth finish.

title: Polar Ice Vodka - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Polar Ice Vodka is a premium, contemporary spirit from Canada, primarily produced in Windsor, Ontario. Introduced around 1984, the brand is owned by Corby Spirit and Wine Limited and is manufactured at the Hiram Walker & Sons distillery, which is the largest distillery facility in North America. As the top-selling Canadian vodka brand and the fourth largest overall in the country, it is crafted using Canadian corn and local water resources.

Spirit Description

Crafted from high-quality grains, Polar Ice undergoes a quadruple distillation and triple filtration process—including a unique chill filtration at 6°C for certain expressions—to ensure a clean and smooth character.

  • Colour: The spirit is perfectly clear and crystal clear in the glass.

  • Aroma: It features a clean and neutral nose with a subtle hint of grain sweetness. Some evaluations note mineral notes with delicate touches of toffee, vanilla, and caramel.

  • Palate: The palate is smooth and crisp with a light, refreshing mouthfeel. It can display herbaceous qualities with a tangy, citrus-driven profile of apple and pear.

  • Body: The spirit has a well-rounded body that is refined and versatile for various uses.

  • Finish: It concludes with a clean, pure finish that leaves a soft, cooling sensation, occasionally followed by a slight hint of black pepper.

  • ABV: The original Polar Ice Vodka is bottled at 40% (80 proof).

Accolades

Polar Ice is a globally recognized spirit with a significant history of wins at prestigious blind-tasting competitions.

  • 95 Points: Awarded by the International Wine & Spirit Competition (IWSC) in 2022.

  • Gold Medal: Won at The Spirits Business Vodka Masters annually from 2017 to 2019, and again in 2021.

  • Double Gold Medal: Awarded to Polar Ice 90° North at the 2017 San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

  • Silver Medal: Earned at the 2017 San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

  • IWSC Gold Outstanding: Awarded to the Polar Ice Arctic Extreme variant in 2020, naming it one of the world's 10 best vodkas.

title: Canadian Club - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
The legend of Canadian Club began in 1858 and grew to become one of the world's most iconic whiskies. Pouring a medium gold, you will find aromas of roasted almond, vanilla and pepper, with spicy vanilla, cornflakes and a faint nutty flavour on a medium-weight palate with a long finish.

title: Compass Box Peat Monster
bodyHtml: A top-quality vatting of the peated Speysider Ardmore with some choice Islay malt, Peat Monster is never less than excellent. Pitch-perfect balance and delicious chewy complexity.

title: Crown Royal Apple
bodyHtml: Made from a blend of hand-selected Crown Royal whiskies and infused with gala apple flavours, the result is a bright amber colour with aromas of sweet crisp apple and spice; full-bodied on the palate with slightly tarter apple flavours and added notes of caramel and spice; finishes smooth and balanced.

title: Benromach 10 Year Old
bodyHtml: The newly released 10 year old from Gordon and MacPhail's Benromach distillery. This was matured for the first nine years in 4/5 bourbon and 1/5 sherry casks before a year in sherry casks.

title: Jack Daniel's - 750 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Set up in 1866, Jack Daniel's became the US's first registered distillery, it soon became a legendary American whiskey. Shows aromas and flavours of caramel, vanilla, nut and oak with smoky tones. The palate is smooth and sweet with light spicy finish. Serve neat or use in a cocktail.

title: Woodford Reserve Double Oaked Bourbon

This imparts an added depth of sweet oaken character to the bourbon and develops the fruit, vanilla and caramel notes.

title: Gibson's Sterling - 1.14 Litre Bottle

Medium-bodied, with an approachable and silky mouthfeel; flavours of toasted grains, citrus, spice and baked apple come together on an elegant finish.

title: Sailor Jerry Spiced Rum
bodyHtml:
Sailor Jerry Spiced Rum is a bold, high-proof spirit with roots in the Caribbean. The brand is owned by the Scottish family-owned company William Grant & Sons and was created to honour the legacy of Norman 'Sailor Jerry' Collins, the legendary father of old-school tattooing. The rum's production philosophy follows the authentic maritime tradition of sailors who improved their on-board rations by blending high-quality Caribbean rums with natural spices to create a smoother, more palatable liquid.

Rum Description

This spirit presents a medium amber colour with a distinct reddish tinge. The nose is rich and warm, offering a medley of aromatic spices including delicate cinnamon and nutmeg, layered over toasty oak, toffee, and heavy vanilla. On the palate, the rum is dry and medium to full-bodied with a rich, oily texture. Flavours of warm sweet spiced fruit, caramel, and chocolate lead to a complex finish marked by a long, warming peppery note.

Food Pairing

The deep vanilla and caramel notes of this spiced rum make it an ideal companion for rich, smoky barbecue, such as jerk chicken, pork ribs, or grilled steak. It also pairs naturally with desserts that mirror its spice profile, including pumpkin pie, gingerbread cookies, or dark chocolate torte. For a savoury contrast, consider serving it alongside spiced nuts or hard, salty cheeses.

title: El Jimador Reposado Tequila
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Barrel rested for two months for smoothness and complexity, this hand-crafted tequila pours a delicate pale straw colour. Aromas of sweet spice and lime greet you on the nose while the palate is smooth and creamy with a hint of spice on the finish.

title: Jim Beam - 750 ml
bodyHtml: With seven generations of distilling history, the name Jim Beam has become synonymous with Kentucky Straight Bourbon. The white label pours a golden amber colour and offers aromas of light floral, citrus, spice and creamed corn. The palate is medium-bodied with flavours of vanilla and caramel, followed by a clean finish.

title: Hornitos Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml: Named after the 'little ovens' used to roast agave, Hornitos was introduced to the world in 1950. Lead by aromas of light smoke, earth, and spice, with herbal, vanilla and dried fruit. A rich textured palate with initial sweet flavours of baking spice and vanilla, then pepper, vegetal and smoked pepper notes on the finish.

title: Captain Morgan White Rum - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
General Information

Made from a selection of some of the finest Caribbean rums, this light and crisp party favourite is perfect for mixing in summer cocktails. Pouring crystal clear, this offers burnt sugar, soft melon, and slight nutty aromas and flavours followed by a dry finish.

title: Glenlivet 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: One of the most famous malts in the world. Glenlivet 12 has a soft smooth balance of sweet summer fruits and the floral notes of spring flowers. Grassy and floral, with a delicate perfume. Soft citrus notes of lemon and grapefruit, joined by nutty notes of almond and hazelnut. Soft mouthfeel with elegant orange and lemon notes, then some vanilla and toffee adding richness, but this is a delicate, fine-boned single malt with lovely balance and a refreshing character.

title: Kraken Black Spiced Rum - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

An excellent spiced rum, with utterly brilliant packaging! It has an extraordinarily rich, spicy flavour. Named for the legendary sea monster, Kraken is a blend of Caribbean rums that should certainly suit any fans of rich, navy-style rum.

title: The Lash Spiced Rum
bodyHtml:
General Information

This rum is created in the West Indies. It is aged in used bourbon cask for four years and is a blend of natural spices and bourbon vanilla extract. It has a dark walnut color with ruby hues in the bottle and lightens in the glass. The rum has light particulate suspended in it.

title: Casa Noble Reposado Tequila
bodyHtml:
Casa Noble is aged in French white Limousin oak for 364 days which is the maximum time allowed for aging and still be labeled a reposado. Another proponent of Casa Noble's dedication to quality leads them to be one of a handful of organically produced and available tequilas on the market.

Super rich vanilla nose with a little bit of fruit and little cooked agave. It has a buttery rich texture with some roasted tropical fruits in addition to notes of toffee and caramelized orange peel. It ends just as fruity as it started with just a little bit fresh green pepper added. It's a very drinkable tequila that has all the smoothness you would ever want.

title: Grand Duke Vodka
bodyHtml: A premium vodka distilled using the finest traditions.

title: Spicebox Canadian Spiced Whiskey
bodyHtml: Aged in seasoned oak with natural spice extracts this pours a brilliant amber with gold highlights. Very pronounced vanilla bean aromas are underscored by apple pie spices and toasty grain whisky notes. Medium sweet and round on the palate with flavours of vanilla and spice on a medium-length finish.

title: Leblon Cachaca
bodyHtml: Very pale, almost clear, straw colour; intense vegetal aromas with notes of aloe, cucumber, fresh oak shavings and cedar; dry, light to medium bodied, crisp and spirity on the palate, with a distinctively heady finish.

title: Newfoundland Screech Rum
bodyHtml:
Long before any Canadian liquor board was created, the Jamaican rum that was eventually to be known as Screech was a mainstay of the traditional Newfoundland diet. At this time, salt fish was being shipped to the West Indies in exchange for rum. This resulted in fish becoming the national dish for Jamaicans and rum becoming the traditional drink for Newfoundlanders.

An award-winning Jamaican rum, steeped in history – crafted in Newfoundland. Sweet taste of caramelized sugars, ripe fruits, vanilla and oak. A smooth, balanced blend with no sugar added.

title: Seagram VO - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
The 'VO' stands for very own and was first released in 1913 to celebrate the marriage of Thomas Seagram. A blend of more than 20 whiskies, it pours a brilliant golden amber colour and offers aromas and flavours of dried apricot, hazelnut and a touch of vanilla. Balanced and smooth it finishes dry with delicate floral notes.

title: Corsairs White Rum - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml: The spirit is front and center of everything they do, from the grains they use or how they are treated, to their innovative production processes. Corsairs White Rum is light-bodied and has a sweet taste.

title: New Amsterdam Vodka
bodyHtml: Born from an uncompromising passion for great vodka. From the water they use to the grains they select to their distillation process, a determined spirit flows through everything they do. This commitment to excellence delivers a great-tasting vodka with a crisp, clean taste and unparalleled smoothness.

title: Finlandia Vodka - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Golden suomi barley and pure glacial spring water give the vodka a dry, light and smooth taste with a gentle aroma.

title: Auchentoshan Three Wood
bodyHtml:
General Information

The ever-popular Auchentoshan 3 Wood is matured initially in bourbon casks before being finished in Oloroso then Pedro Ximénez casks for an extra layer of rich, sweet fruitiness.

title: Belvedere Vodka
bodyHtml:
THE FIRST SUPER-PREMIUM VODKA THAT STANDS FOR TASTE AND CHARACTER!

NOSE: Faint hint of vanilla along with some gentle, soft cream characteristics.

PALATE: Full, round with a medium-bodied weight and a rich, velvety texture. Some vanilla swaying between sweet and savoury with a hint of white pepper and spice.

2 oz. Belvedere Vodka

title: Jameson Caskmates - Stout Edition
bodyHtml:
General Information

Jameson Caskmates sees the reuse of old whiskey barrels. Nothing new in that, but in between, they've been used to age stout from Cork's Franciscan Well brewery. This has added notes of cocoa, coffee and butterscotch to this classic Irish whiskey.

title: Herradura Reposado Tequila
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
With the agave hearts roasted in traditional clay ovens, and fermented using only the local wild yeasts native to the casa, Herradura Reposado is aged after distillation in American oak barrels for 11 months to allow the flavours of this tequila to mature.

This light golden tequila offers up classic aromas of agave, vanilla, and caramel along with a mild hit of alcohol burn and light notes of orange peel and cedar. On the palate, this is a pleasantly medium bodied tequila, lightly coating the tongue and showcasing a mélange of spice notes, light oak and agave along with vanilla and a slight earthy flavour. The finish is light, with more baking spice flavours and vanilla before ending with a very pleasant agave note.

title: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
This is an excellent introduction for those looking to experiment with Scotch whisky. It is aromatic with notes of wild herbs, heather, honey and orchard fruits. The palate is round and creamy with a rich taste of honey and ripe apples, with vanilla, hazelnut and toffee flavours followed by a rich and lingering finish.

title: Stolichnaya Salted Caramel Vodka
bodyHtml: Stoli hits one out of the park with its new Salted Karamel, an unctuous vodka with decadent flavours of soft English toffee balanced with a light saltiness. Perfect on the rocks, it will stand up to any dessert!

title: Highwood Canadian Rye Whiskey - 750 ml
bodyHtml: High River, Alberta played the role of Smallville in "Superman III", but the real superhero from this town is the whisky distilled at Highwood Distillers. Alberta, Canadian prairie rye and wheat were mashed, distilled and aged in charred oak barrels separately, then blended together to create this flagship Highwood Canadian Rye. Only available in Canada.

title: Appleton Estate Signature Rum
bodyHtml: Produced in the heart of Jamaica, this signature blend combines rums of different styles and ages. The result is a brilliant golden amber colour, complex aromas of sweet fruit, citrus, dried apricots, fresh peach, hints of molasses and oak. These aromas flow onto a full-bodied palate with a soft, subtle finish.

title: Absolut Lime Vodka
bodyHtml: The perfect complement to the core range of Absolut flavours. Fresh and fruity aromas jump from the glass; on the palate, there is a distinct note of freshly pressed limes providing a hint of acidity and sweetness that will be complemented in a lime mojito.

title: Slaughter House Whiskey
vendor: 300575 - Vintage West Wine And Spirits Inc.
bodyHtml:
David Phinney is the winemaker of California's Orin Swift Cellars and the procurer of whiskey released by his spirits company, The Splinter Group. This American whiskey is made from a mash bill of 85% corn, 8% wheat, 6% rye, and 1% malted barley. After aging 9 years in American oak, this whiskey finishes for an undisclosed time in barrels that previously held the winery's proprietary Bordeaux blend, Papillon. Slaughter House American Whiskey was released in 2015 and is a follow-up to the company's first product, Straight Edge Bourbon.

See More USA Whisky

title: Hornitos Anejo Black Barrel Tequila
bodyHtml:
General Information

Our most highly awarded tequila, Hornitos Black Barrel, starts as a premium, aged Añejo, then spends four months in deep charred oak barrels to give it rich, smoky flavor and a golden amber color. It spends an additional two months in specially toasted barrels for more depth and distinct complexity.

title: Lagavulin 8 Year Old
bodyHtml:
General Information

Big and smoky on the nose with notes of sweet spice, dried dark fruit, caramel, tar, brine and toasted nut. Palate is rich, sweet and smooth with bold flavours of smoky campfire, cumin, molasses and peat with notes of apple crumble and spice.

title: Hornitos Plata Tequila
bodyHtml:
Hornitos Plata Tequila is an unaged, mass-market 100% Blue Weber agave spirit produced in Tequila, Jalisco, Mexico. Created in 1950 by Don Francisco Javier Sauza to commemorate Mexican Independence Day, Hornitos ("Little Ovens") was introduced to deliver a pure agave taste by bypassing wood aging entirely. Produced under Tequila Sauza S.A. (NOM 1102) now part of Beam Suntory it is widely distributed worldwide as a accessible, high-volume workhorse silver tequila.

2. Spirit Description

Hornitos Plata is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave grown in Jalisco. Modern diffuser extraction methods and column-still double distillation are utilized alongside traditional cooking to produce a crisp, light, and uniform distillate. Unaged and bottled directly to retain its clean visual presentation, it focuses on crisp, high-strung herbal notes and citrus brightness.

  • Colour: Crystal clear with brilliant silver highlights.

  • Aroma: Bright and herbal, opening with floral blossoms, fresh citrus (lime and grapefruit peel), raw agave, and a sharp touch of white pepper and light alcohol heat.

  • Palate: Crisp and lively on the entry. Upfront flavors of raw agave, sweet lemon-lime zest, and green bell pepper blend into herbal notes of mint and jasmine, accompanied by a quick peppery bite.

  • Body: Light-to-medium-bodied with a clean, slightly thin viscosity.

  • Finish: Short, warm, and dry, leaving trailing notes of citrus peel, subtle earthiness, and cracked black pepper spice.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Lemon Hart Overproof 151 Rum
bodyHtml: Lemon Hart Overproof 151 Rum is currently made in Guyana, a country renowned for its rum production. This powerful and robust rum offers an intense flavour profile. It is characterized by rich molasses, tropical fruits, spices, and a noticeable kick of alcohol due to its high proof. Critics often praise Lemon Hart Overproof 151 Rum for its bold and authentic Caribbean character. It is considered a staple in Tiki cocktails, known for adding depth and potency to mixed drinks. However, due to its high alcohol content, it is recommended to use with caution. Rum enthusiasts appreciate its strong and distinctive flavour, making it a popular choice for those seeking an authentic Caribbean rum experience.

title: Bushmills 10 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
This benchmark Irish whiskey originates from the village of Bushmills in County Antrim, Northern Ireland, crafted at the historic Old Bushmills Distillery. Serving as the foundational gateway to the distillery's age-stated single malt lineup, Bushmills 10 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey is made from 100% unpeated malted barley and triple-distilled in traditional copper pot stills using water drawn from Saint Columb’s Rill. The spirit matures for a minimum of ten years predominantly in charred American oak ex-bourbon barrels, complemented by a smaller proportion of seasoned Spanish Oloroso sherry casks. It is bottled at 80 proof (40.0% ABV) in Bushmills' classic embossed bottle (available in standard 700 ml and 750 ml formats), presenting an approachable, fruit-forward snapshot of pure Irish single malt distillation.

Spirit Description

This single malt displays a bright golden-honey hue with soft straw highlights and light, nimble tears in the glass. On the nose, it is remarkably fresh, crisp, and clean, leading with pronounced aromas of green apple, ripe pear, and honeyed malt, followed by gentle accents of vanilla blossom, toasted oak, banana, and a faint kiss of milk chocolate. On the palate, the triple distillation creates a delicate, light-to-medium-bodied, and silky mouthfeel. An immediate wave of fresh orchard fruit, sweet clover honey, and vanilla custard rolls across the tongue before giving way to subtler mid-palate notes of toasted almond, light wood spice (nutmeg and white pepper), and soft biscuit grain. Free of aggressive ethanol bite or heavy wood tannins, the profile is exceptionally balanced and accessible. The finish is crisp, clean, and refreshing, leaving trailing impressions of dried apple chips, floral honey, sweet cereal grain, and a gentle touch of dry oak.

title: Olmeca Altos Plata Tequila
bodyHtml: Olmeca Altos is made up of tahona-crushed agave which adds complexity. Clear and colourless with moderately intense aromas of smoky bacon, citrus, and white pepper; the palate is full and warming with floral and citrus flavours followed by a long lime-like finish.

title: Tierra Noble Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: Tierra Noble Blanco is bright and crystal clear, with silvery sparkles. On the nose, strong presence of cooked agave, herbal notes to mint and citrus, with just a dash of anise. On the palate, soft and fresh with an increasing intensity, notes of raw agave, long finish, rich mouthfeel and balanced complexity.

title: Caol Ila 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: Caol Ila 12 Year Old is currently made on the Isle of Islay, in Scotland. This single-malt Scotch whisky showcases the signature peat smoke and maritime character for which Islay whiskies are renowned. Its flavour profile is characterized by a balance of smoky and briny notes, with hints of citrus, honey, and a touch of vanilla. Critics often praise Caol Ila 12 Year Old for its well-rounded and complex nature, noting its smoothness and the way the flavours unfold on the palate. With its distinct Islay character, it is cherished by whisky enthusiasts seeking a peaty and flavorful experience.

title: Crystal Head Vodka - 1.75 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This vodka is produced from "peaches and cream" sweet corn blended with water from St. John's, Newfoundland. Cool detail: It's distilled four times before being filtered seven times. Their iconic skull-shaped bottle is produced in Europe, where bits of crystal is melted into the glass to ensure absolute clarity.

Crystal Head Vodka offers a clean, clear and colourless spirit. On the nose, neutral grain aromas with a delicate touch of citrus. Silky smooth with a hint of sweetness and vanilla. Ending with a sweet, creamy finish.

title: Balvenie 14 Year Old Caribbean Cask
bodyHtml:
Balvenie 14 Year Old Caribbean Cask offers a journey of flavours, where the sweetness of the rum cask intertwines with the smoothness and complexity of our single malt, leaving a lasting impression." - Kirsten Grant Meikle, Head of Marketing at Balvenie.

"This whisky embodies the artistry and craftsmanship of Balvenie, seamlessly blending the warmth of the Caribbean with the traditional character of Speyside." - David Stewart, Malt Master at Balvenie Distillery.

Notable quotes associated with Balvenie 14 Year Old Caribbean Cask:

  • The Balvenie 14 Year Old Caribbean Cask entices with its enticing flavours of rich toffee, vanilla, and subtle spices, complemented by the luscious sweetness and tropical fruit notes derived from the rum cask. The whisky strikes a perfect balance between the traditional character of Balvenie and the exotic nuances bestowed upon it during the finishing period.
  • Balvenie 14 Year Old Caribbean Cask is a remarkable single malt Scotch whisky hailing from the Balvenie Distillery in Dufftown, Scotland. This expression undergoes a unique maturation process, where it is initially aged in traditional oak casks and then transferred to casks that previously held Caribbean rum. The result is a whisky that showcases a delightful marriage of Scotch and tropical influences.

Balvenie 14 Year Old Caribbean Cask stands as a testament to the distillery's dedication to innovation while maintaining the core values of traditional whisky-making. It provides a captivating experience for whisky enthusiasts, delivering a harmonious blend of flavours that transports them to both Scotland and the sun-soaked shores of the Caribbean.

title: Tullamore Dew Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Patiently aged in a combination of ex-bourbon and sherry casks, this whiskey is known worldwide for its smooth and gentle complexity. Pale amber in colour, one can expect soft aromas of caramel and sweet grain with spice and sweet barley flavours on a smooth and creamy palate that finishes gently with a soft and fruity character.

See More Irish Whisky

title: Wiser's Deluxe - 3 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
In the mid-1800s J.P. Wiser set out to create a whisky that pleased the nose, tongue and eye, the result is this bright golden whisky that offers aromas of sweet caramel, dried fruit, and vanilla; the palate is rich with flavours of toasted grain, sweet cornmeal and vanilla followed by a smooth/creamy finish.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Rittenhouse Rye
bodyHtml:
Produced in the tradition of the classic Pennsylvania or 'Monongahela' rye whiskeys, this pours light amber and is perfumed with sweet corn, vanilla, brown sugar and spice aromas. The flavours match aromas with additional floral and spices in the background and repeat on the long smooth finish.

See More USA Whisky

title: Monkey Shoulder Blended Scotch
bodyHtml: Medium amber in colour. Forward sweet malt, vanilla, marmalade and crème brulee aromas with notes of toasted nut, marzipan, butter, cream and light oak. On the palate, light and fresh, approachable, smooth and elegant, followed by malty, creamy, toasted barley flavours and notes of fruit, nutmeg, clove oil, sweet nut and spicy oak.

title: Lagavulin 16 Year Old
bodyHtml: Lagavulin is a classic example of how smoke isn't a blunt instrument that covers everything in a fog but an element that works with all the flavours produced in distillation and maturation. Lagavulin isn't 'smokey.' Its peat moves into a weird territory of Lapsang Souchong tea, pipe tobacco, fish boxes and kippers. It smells of laurel and light cereal but is always sweet. The palate shows more creosote, with hints of kelp and a little touch of iodine. Very complex.

title: Phillips Canadian Whisky - 1 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Introduced in 1970 and known as "The Big Canadian," Phillips Canadian Whisky is distilled from carefully selected Canadian grains and aged in oak casks for no less than three years, resulting in a wonderfully smooth and mixable whisky.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: High West Campfire Whiskey
bodyHtml:
During a visit to Islay, David Perkins enjoyed a breakfast at a B&B near Bruichladdich, which included a delicious syrup made from sugar and peated whisky poured over honeydew melon. Taking this experience back to America, he set about blending sweet bourbon from Lawrenceburg with peaty Islay single malt, with some spicy Rye for good measure!

High West Campfire is the world’s finest blend of scotch, bourbon and rye whiskeys. A very unusual, distinctive, yet delicious whiskey.  Campfire reveals a complex nose of floral, fruity, bright and spicy, caramel, butterscotch, light smoke and smoldering wood from a campfire the morning after, jasmine, chai tea, sandalwood, leather, tobacco, pine resin, and toasted bread.  The palate is outstanding, with flavours of vanilla, honey, toffee with some nice fruit, blueberries and black cherries, chai spices - nutmeg, cinnamon, orange zest, salty caramels, tobacco, and gentle smoke!
