title: Singleton 12 Year Old Dufftown
bodyHtml: A straightforward, nutty and malty single malt from Speyside, the Singleton of Dufftown was released to replace the Singleton of Auchroisk. It’s aged in a high proportion of European oak casks.

title: Dalwhinnie 15 Year Old
bodyHtml: Dalwhinnie Distillery, named after the eponymous Highlands village where it is located, was actually called Strathspey when it started its activities in 1898 but was renamed the same year after a change of ownership. The 15-Year-Old is a single malt that is full of character with its aromas of pear and exotic fruit completed by smoky notes.

title: Knob Creek 9 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Knob Creek 9 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a premium American whiskey produced at the Jim Beam distillery in Clermont, Kentucky. Introduced in 1992 by sixth-generation Master Distiller Booker Noe, it was created to restore the standards of pre-prohibition style bourbon, which was typically aged longer and featured a bigger, fuller flavour. The brand is part of the Beam Small Batch Bourbon Collection and is currently overseen by Master Distiller Fred Noe, son of the founder.

Spirit Description

This flagship expression is aged for nine years in new American white oak barrels that receive the deepest level 4 char.

  • Colour: It pours a brilliant golden amber or copper bronze hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is fragrant and robust, featuring rich aromas of toasted nuts, oak, and grain, layered with maple sugar, caramel, vanilla, and a touch of sweet apricot.

  • Palate: It offers a full-bodied and bold palate with a base of rich oak and distinctive sweetness. Flavours include vanilla, caramel, brown sugar, and toasted nuts, complemented by green peppercorns and sweet oak spice.

  • Body: The bourbon is undeniably big and rich with a density that can feel intense for beginners but remains well-rounded.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, warm, and glowing finish characterized by lingering notes of leather, aged oak, and warming rye spice.

  • ABV: This bourbon is bottled at 50% (100 proof).

Accolades

Knob Creek 9 Year Old has consistently earned high praise and top honors in global spirits competitions.

  • 98 Points, Gold Medal: Awarded at the 2022 International Wine & Spirit Competition.

  • Gold Medal: Earned at the 2021 San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

  • Gold Medal: Won at the 2021 International Spirits Challenge.

  • World Whisky Masters Master: Awarded in 2014.

  • Consumer Rating: It holds a 4.6 out of 5-star average among many reviewers, with 93% of respondents recommending it.

Food Pairing

The bold, spicy notes and deep oak character of this aged bourbon make it a versatile partner for rich and fatty foods.

  • Savoury: It pairs exceptionally well with smoked salmon, as the smokiness of the fish enhances the deep, oaky flavours of the bourbon. It is also recommended with robust BBQ dishes like pork ribs or pulled pork sandwiches with vinegar based sauces.

  • Cheese: Savoury aged cheeses such as Parmesan, Asiago, or sharp cheddar scream for well-aged bourbons, while mild blue cheese provides a creamy contrast to the spice.

  • Nutty and Sweet: Dark chocolate (at least 70% cocoa) and caramelized pecans enhance the bourbon's complexity.

  • Serving: This expression is best enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as a base for premium classic cocktails like an Old Fashioned or a Manhattan.

title: Smirnoff Raspberry Vodka
bodyHtml: Clear water-white; pronounced aromas of sugared raspberries and raspberry jelly; on the palate it is lightly sweet and medium bodied, with flavours that echo the aromas.

title: Park Distillery Espresso Vodka
bodyHtml:
General Information

Just like a rich cup of coffee brewed over an early morning campfire. But with vodka — so even better.

title: Glenkinchie 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
General Information

The nose is quite light, yet fragrant. Notes of fresh cereal and grist, some barley sweetness and a nutty note. Acacia honey creeps in with gentle warmth. The palate is very fruity with notes of Madeira and sweet stewed fruits. A hint of calvados and tannic oak lining the mouth. There is a freshness and roundness to this dram. The finish is of medium length with notes of cereal and a fresh greenness.

title: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Select - 750 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Select is a premium Tennessee whiskey produced at the Jack Daniel Distillery in Lynchburg, Tennessee. Established in 1866, it is recognized as America's oldest registered distillery and is currently owned by the Brown-Forman Corporation. This expression is meticulously crafted by selecting only one in every hundred barrels from the upper reaches of the maturation warehouses, where extreme temperature changes encourage deeper interaction between the whiskey and the toasted oak.

Spirit Description

This whiskey is characterized by its robust and bold nature, offering a more intense experience than the flagship Old No. 7. It is filtered through ten feet of sugar maple charcoal before aging in hand-made American white oak barrels for a minimum of four years.

  • Colour: It displays a deep amber or light molasses hue.

  • Aroma: The nose is rich and sweet-smelling, featuring vanilla bean, toffee, and toasted oak, with bright fruit notes like peach and banana.

  • Palate: It offers a full-bodied palate with layers of rich caramel, brown sugar, and butterscotch, balanced by spicy oak, leather, and a touch of barrel char.

  • Body: The spirit has a high viscosity that coats the mouth, providing a smooth, velvety, and well-integrated texture.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long and lingering finish of spicy fruit, dark chocolate, and fading honeyed sweetness.

  • ABV: This expression is typically bottled at 45% (90 proof) or 47% (94 proof) depending on the market.

title: Tin Cup American Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Pale amber colour with aromas of toffee, spicy rye bread, anise, oak shavings and new leather, with notes of toasted nut, vanilla and sweet corn. Oak tannins and sour rye notes balance lightly sweet, very smooth, spicy, sweet oaky flavours. A slightly sweet finish shows hints of maple sugar, cinnamon, rye spice and malt.

See More USA Whisky

title: Captain Morgan White Rum - 1.75 Litre (Plastic Bottle)
bodyHtml:
Captain Morgan White Rum hails from the Caribbean, primarily distilled in Puerto Rico, a region renowned for its rich rum-making heritage. Owned by Diageo, one of the world’s largest beverage companies, the Captain Morgan brand draws inspiration from the legendary 17th-century privateer Sir Henry Morgan. The distillery blends traditional Caribbean rum craftsmanship with modern techniques to produce consistently smooth and versatile spirits.

Spirit Description

Captain Morgan White Rum is a crystal-clear spirit offering a light to medium body. On the nose, it presents delicate aromas of sweet vanilla, citrus zest, and subtle tropical fruits. The palate is smooth and crisp, unveiling flavours of fresh cane sugar, a touch of coconut, and hints of green banana, finishing with a clean, refreshing note. This rum is crafted from fine Caribbean sugar cane, distilled five times to ensure purity and exceptional smoothness. Enjoyable neat, on the rocks, or as a vibrant base for cocktails, it shines best when served chilled to highlight its clean, bright character.

Food Pairing

Pair this white rum with citrus-marinated grilled shrimp, tropical ceviche, or coconut chicken to amplify its bright, lightly fruity notes. This pairing highlights the rum’s freshness and subtle complexity, creating a lively and memorable dining experience.

title: Sauza Silver Tequila - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Fresh and fruity, Sauza Silver is an ideal addition to fruit-based cocktails. It offers subtle aromas of citrus, agave and light malty notes. The palate is fresh and lively with flavours of citrus, agave and pepper on a medium body, finishing with a hint of bitter citrus. Serve with avocado toast topped with grilled turkey.

title: Crown Royal Northern Harvest Rye
bodyHtml:
Awarded Best Canadian Whisky in Jim Murray's 2020 Whisky Bible and also earned Whisky of the Year in 2016! Its aromas of baking spice, apple/pear, rye, caramel and apricot lead to flavours of sweet spice, pepper, vanilla, toasted nut and caramel with oak, marmalade and anise on a warm, elegant finish.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Jose Cuervo Tradicional Tequila
bodyHtml: This 100% blue agave rested tequila is aged in oak barrels for a minimum of two months, giving it smooth and subtle complexity. Look for aromas of earthy agave, roasted pineapple and vanilla followed by light spices like cinnamon and pepper.

title: Royal Reserve - 750 ml
bodyHtml: This classic brand rose to fame in the 60's and 70's when cocktails were all the rage; with a renewed interest, bartenders are once again turning to whiskies like this for their subtle character and mix-ability. Hints of honey, burnt almond and sweet caramel on the nose prepare you for a palate that is light and smooth.

title: Gibson's Finest Bold
bodyHtml:
Named for its more intense flavour profile, this bold version will spice up your rye & cola. Pouring a medium gold, the nose opens with vanilla, spiced apple and subtle oak aromas. The palate is rich and sweet with a bold, rich rye character followed by a long spicy finish.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Knob Creek 9 Year Old Single Barrel
bodyHtml:
This robust bourbon hails from the United States, distilled in Kentucky at the Jim Beam Distillery under Suntory Global Spirits. It is part of the prestigious Small Batch Bourbon Collection introduced in 1992. The Knob Creek brand was one of Beam’s four high‑end small batch bourbons, created to emphasise full‑flavour, aged offerings. The Single Barrel Reserve reflects this philosophy—selected barrel by barrel, bottled at 120 proof after nine years’ maturation.

Bourbon Description

  • Colour: Deep, dark amber with henna hues.

  • Aroma (Nose): Rich vanilla, caramel, toasted oak, plus brown sugar and a hint of smokiness.

  • Palate: Bold and complex—rich caramel and toasted oak lead, followed by vanilla and subtle rye spice, delivering a creamy, intense sip.

  • Body & Finish: Full‑bodied and warming, with lingering caramel, oak, leather and a touch of rye spice—heat that lasts well over 30 seconds.

Food Pairing Suggestions

Rich desserts such as pecan tart or crème brûlée complement the bourbon’s caramel and vanilla richness. A charcuterie board with smoked meats or aged cheeses balances its smoky oak and bold spice.

title: Olmeca Silver Tequila
bodyHtml: Olmeca Blanco brings the unexpected to your party with a fresh herbal and green pepper scent with soft citrus notes at the end. Directly from Los Altos highlands of Jalisco, Mexico, it carries a naturally sweet freshness to make any cool moment even cooler.

title: Park Distillery Vodka
bodyHtml:
General Information

Made from 100% organic Alberta triticale grain and distilled with glacier fresh water right in Banff National Park. Crisp, cold nose, slightly sweet, buttery finish. 100% Sustainably farmed Alberta triticale grain. Their grain is sourced from high altitude family farms in the Alberta foothills.

title: Gibson's Finest Rare - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This full-flavoured Canadian whisky exhibits depth through its barrel-aged character, its defining feature. It excels as an ultra-smooth whisky with vanilla-sweet oakiness that carries through to the finish. Best enjoyed neat or on the rocks.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Highwood Canadian Rye Whiskey - 1.75 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: This whisky is distilled from rye and wheat and is the flagship whisky for Highwood. The grains are distilled and aged separately, with wheat as the base, before being blended in a typical Canadian style.

title: Ciroc Bluestone Vodka
bodyHtml: Ciroc Ultra Premium Vodka is distilled from fine French grapes for an exquisitely smooth, fresh vodka experience. It is smooth, lightly sweet and enriched by the natural character of grapes. It is crisp and clean.

title: Bacardi Black Rum
bodyHtml: Bacardi Black rum is a medium-bodied black rum crafted passionately by the Maestros de Ron Bacardi. Bacardi Black's rich, dark flavours develop in heavily charred oak barrels. Some might call it black magic. Dark in colour, light-medium in body, and rich and robust in taste, Bacardi Black Rum imparts impressions of tropical fruit and molasses with a smoky finish.

title: Lamb's White Rum - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
General Information

Crystal clear; hints of green banana and vanilla bean on the nose and palate; clean, crisp finish.

title: Evan Williams Bottled In Bond
bodyHtml:
In 1783, the Evan Williams opened Kentucky’s first distillery on the banks of the Ohio River. Many years and barrels later, they still produce Bourbon the right way, using traditional, time-honoured methods. Evan Williams Bottled-in-Bond is aged under government supervision and meeting the exact requirements for a Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon. It has all the kick you expect—but still goes down smooth. 

Complex aromas and flavours of stone fruit, caramel, vanilla, and oak; expected kick of heat comes through on the dry finish. 

The full flavours of this spirit can be enjoyed in a variety of ways. Try it neat, on the rocks or mixed in your favourite bourbon cocktail.

title: Baker's 7 Year Old Bourbon
bodyHtml: An excellent small batch bourbon, named for the grand nephew of Jim Beam, Baker Beam. This is a well-aged expression that makes use of a special strain of jug yeast which the Beam family have made use of for over 60 years. 53.5% alc./vol.

title: Compass Box Great King Street Glasgow Blend - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
General Information

Aromas of sherry and smoke permeate the streets of Glasgow. In his 1930s book ‘Whisky’, Aeneas MacDonald teaches us that Glaswegians historically preferred fuller bodied and more flavour-packed whiskies than people in other parts of the world. So what better name for a whisky such as this? Glaswegians are also famed for their sense of humour, which is why the city’s Wellington statue – traditionally dressed down with a traffic cone – is featured on the front label.  Like Artist Blend, Glasgow Blend boasts a high single malt content. Inclusion of malt whisky matured in Oloroso Sherry-seasoned butts, and an Islay single malt of a powerfully peaty nature, has made this a blended Scotch whisky like no other. Full, rich and smoky on the palate, with notes of sticky toffee pudding, Sherry wine character and impressions of a coal fire, Glasgow Blend shines in combination with rich cheeses and cured meats.

title: Wiser's Special Blend - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Wiser's Special Blend is a quintessential Canadian whisky produced in Ontario, Canada. The brand carries the legacy of J.P. Wiser, who began distilling in 1857 and established a philosophy of high-quality, long-aged spirits that persists at the Hiram Walker & Sons Distillery today. This blend is crafted to maintain the traditional 'Wiser's' profile, focusing on a smooth, approachable character that has made it a staple in Canadian households for generations.

Spirit Description

This whisky presents a bright, golden amber colour in the glass. The aroma is inviting and sweet, featuring prominent notes of caramel, toasted grains, and a hint of dried fruit. On the palate, it is light-to-medium-bodied with a soft texture, offering flavours of vanilla and mellow oak spice that lead into a crisp, clean finish. As a blended Canadian whisky, it exhibits excellent balance and a straightforward freshness that makes it highly versatile for various serving styles.

Food Pairing

Wiser's Special Blend pairs exceptionally well with savoury snacks like aged cheddar cheese, smoked nuts, or grilled barbecue dishes that complement its caramel undertones. It is also a natural companion for ginger ale or cola in a classic highball.

title: Finlandia Vodka - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Golden suomi barley and pure glacial spring water give the vodka a dry, light and smooth taste with a gentle aroma.

title: Jefferson's Ocean - Aged at Sea
bodyHtml: Barrels of 'Jefferson’s Ocean Aged at Sea® Bourbon travel aboard ships that visit ports all around the globe. The constant motion of the sea churns the whiskey, increasing its interaction with the wood of the barrel. Extreme weather ranging from the coldest of coldest to the warmest of temperatures hyper-ages the liquid in ways no rickhouse could. Jefferson’s Ocean Aged at Sea® Bourbon is Aged At The Mercy of The Sea. Experience a voyage yourself.

title: St George Absinthe
bodyHtml: A heady, herbaceous smack to the senses. It opens with spicy black licorice and then slowly evolves into citrus and grass profiles with a dose of sarsaparilla. Because of the abundance of essential oils, it's rich and viscous on the palate, even at 120 proof (60% alcohol).

title: Lot 40 Copper Pot Still Rye Whisky
bodyHtml:
Lot 40 Rye is a legendary Canadian rye whisky that is produced in a single copper pot still. At some point during the 2000s, Lot 40 Rye was discontinued, which caused quite a stir among whisky enthusiasts who considered it to be one of the best Canadian whiskies out there.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Amrut Old Port Rum
bodyHtml:
General Information

Amrut, the Sanskrit word for "nectar of the gods," was established a year after India claimed independence from the United Kingdom. Since 1948, they have mainly been producing whiskies, but also release limited edition rums such as this rum distilled from 100% Indian cane sugar. It's bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Wild Turkey Russell's Reserve 10 Year Old
bodyHtml:
This Kentucky straight bourbon is selected from barrels at least ten years old by master distillers Jimmy & Eddie Russell of Wild Turkey Distillery. This small batch bourbon is bottled at 90 proof. Jimmy & Eddie's signatures are proudly displayed on each bottle.

See More USA Whisky

title: anCnoc 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
This lip-smacking 12-year-old anCnoc is a top-quality proponent of the non-sherried Speyside style, showing polished malt and a delicious spiciness throughout a warm, complex palate and lasting finish.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Canadian Club - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: A giant of Canadian whisky, it was created in 1858 and spent six long years in oak before bottling for the smoothest possible flavour.

title: Grant's - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Scotland's oldest continuously family-run blending house uses the knowledge of five generations to create this approachable dram. On the nose are aromas of cereal grain, white citrus, honey and brown sugar. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and warming with flavours of butterscotch, oatmeal, vanilla and honey.

title: El Jimador Silver Tequila
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
El Jimador tequila, produced at Casa Herradura, is a 100% agave tequila that has become the #1 selling tequila brand in Mexico since its launch in 2000. A classically styled Lowlands tequila, El Jimador Blanco is a value priced spirit that offers great quality at an affordable price. This versatile mixer will make great cocktails without breaking the bank.

The bouquet has a slight alcohol burn, with aromas of grapefruit, white pepper and agave discernible. On the palate, grapefruit and lemon temper the sweetness of agave, while a subtle spice note rounds out the flavour profile. The finish is quick and smooth followed by citrus fruit and white pepper.

title: Jefferson's Reserve Bourbon - 750 ml
bodyHtml: The oldest and most robust bourbon whiskey in the core of Jefferson's family, their Reserve is a perfect example of the artistry of blending. This small batch blend of mature bourbons exhibits incredible nuance and complexity of flavours that only a masterful blender can unlock. The end result is a big, sophisticated bourbon whiskey with a bold, substantial palate and a long, delicious finish. It's robust enough to satisfy even the most discerning bourbon snob and smooth enough for the whiskey novice. A truly quintessential bourbon whiskey.

title: Woodford Reserve Kentucky Bourbon - 750 ml
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml:
Woodford Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a premium whiskey from the United States, originating from Woodford County in Kentucky. The distillery site has a heritage of production dating back to 1812, making it one of the oldest distillery sites in the state and a designated National Historic Landmark. While the site has a long pedigree, the Woodford Reserve brand itself was introduced in 1996. Today, the distillery is owned by the Brown Forman Corporation, which acquired the property in 1941 and later repurchased it to launch the current brand.

Description

This bourbon is crafted using a grain recipe of 72% corn, 18% rye, and 10% malted barley, which is fermented for an industry leading six days and triple distilled in copper pot stills. The whiskey is matured in new charred oak barrels and is characterized by a complex balance of more than 200 detectable flavour notes.

  • Colour: A clean and brilliant honey amber or deep amber hue.

  • Aroma: Heavy with rich dried fruit and hints of mint and oranges dusted with cocoa, followed by faint vanilla and tobacco spice.

  • Palate: Rich, chewy, and rounded with complex notes of citrus, cinnamon, toffee, caramel, and chocolate.

  • Body: Full bodied and smooth with a robust character that adds depth.

  • Finish: Silky smooth and almost creamy at first, leading into a long, warm, and satisfying tail.

  • ABV: Woodford Reserve is typically bottled at 45.2%.

title: Edradour 10 Year Old
bodyHtml: A tiny distillery in Perthshire is home to Edradour, one of Scotland's most endearingly different malts. Delicious honey notes are complimented by an oily mouthfeel and a stylish finish.

title: Kilchoman Machir Bay
bodyHtml: Kilchoman's Machir Bay is an excellent single malt Scotch whisky from the isle of Islay. The distillers use whisky which has been matured in ex-bourbon barrels and Oloroso Sherry butts, resulting in a well-balanced flavour profile, with highlights of vanilla biscuits, light fruit and wafts of warm peat smoke.

title: Jack Daniel's - 1.14 Litre Bottle
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Set up in 1866, Jack Daniel's became the US's first registered distillery, and it soon became a legendary American whiskey. Shows aromas and flavours of caramel, vanilla, nut and oak with smoky tones. The palate is smooth and sweet with a slightly spicy finish. Serve neat or use in a cocktail.

title: 1800 Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: This tequila is from 100% Weber blue agave, aged 8-12 years and harvested at their peak. The spirit is double distilled, and a unique selection of white tequilas is blended together for added complexity and character. The result is a premium tequila with a smoother, more interesting flavour than most. The clean, balanced taste with hints of sweet fruit and pepper is perfectly sipped neat, on the rocks, as a shot or in a cocktail.

title: Red Tassel Vodka - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml: A Canadian favourite for over 30 years, McGuinness Red Tassel Vodka is a neutral flavoured vodka with subtle character on the palate and a slightly spicy warming finish. It goes well with your favourite mix and makes a great cocktail!

title: Jamesons Black Barrel
bodyHtml:
General Information

Charred bourbon barrels deliver more concentrated spice, nutty notes and vanilla sweetness, while the sherry casks add flavours of nectarines, apricot and ripe apple. It pours gold and offers pronounced aromas of cereal, toffee, and citrus peel; smooth palate with flavours of toffee, citrus and toasted oak; long finish.

See More Irish Whisky

title: Absolut Citron Vodka
bodyHtml: Pronounced lemon custard, lemon oil/zest and meringue aromas and flavours with a dry, crisp and clean finish.

title: Maker's Mark 46
bodyHtml: From the legendary bourbon maker, Makers 46 is noted for its process of adding seared oak planks to the barrels for additional aging. The result is more pronounced caramel, spice and vanilla flavours with a big finish.

title: Miguel Torres Pisco El Gobernador
bodyHtml: Colorless, bright, flashing silver, made ​​with grape varieties Rosé Muscat and Muscat of Alexandria. Pisco has a lush floral scent with notes of rose and jasmine, plus shells candied citrus fruits. In the mouth is tasty, round greedy, and even creamy, with a long, lingering finish.

title: Lemon Hart Blackpool Spiced Rum
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Awarded the Chairman’s Trophy at the Ultimate Spirits Challenge, Blackpool is a beautifully crafted overproof British-style single estate distilled spiced rum. Mastery of art expertly balances Blackpool’s naturally occurring Bourbon barrel notes of exotic dried fruit, island spices and vanilla bean with an all natural spiced infusion resulting in the definitive rum experience. Over ice, simply sublime. Mixed, adventurously awakening. Tribute to the provenance of the iconic Lemon Hart & Son brand and honour to the passion of rum craft passed down through the generations at Lemon Hart & Son since 1804.

title: Appleton Estate Signature Rum - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Produced in the heart of Jamaica, this signature blend combines rums of different styles and ages. The result is a brilliant golden amber colour, complex aromas of sweet fruit, citrus, dried apricots, fresh peach, hints of molasses and oak. These aromas flow onto a full-bodied palate with a soft, subtle finish.

title: Milagro Reposado Barrel Reserve Tequila
bodyHtml:
Milagro Select (formerly known as Milagro Select Barrel Reserve) Reposado Tequila is an ultra-premium, small-batch spirit produced in the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. Crafted under parent company William Grant & Sons (NOM 1559 / NOM 1618), the "Select" line was introduced to elevate the brand's core offerings by showcasing meticulous distillation techniques, hand-selected oak aging, and visually striking hand-blown glass bottles featuring a blown-glass agave plant sculpted inside the base.

Spirit Description

Milagro Select Reposado is crafted from 100% estate-grown Blue Weber agaves slow-roasted in traditional brick ovens for 36 hours. Unlike most tequilas which undergo double distillation, Milagro utilizes a triple-distillation process in a combination of stainless steel pot stills and copper alembic stills to produce a remarkably clean distillate. The spirit matures in a mix of American oak and French oak barrels typically; for 2 to 6 months, striking a balance between bright highland agave sweetness and dry, refined wood tannin.

  • Colour: Brilliant golden straw with pale amber and platinum highlights.

  • Aroma: Inviting and aromatic, opening with cooked agave sweetness, warm cinnamon spice, and vanilla bean, complemented by light oak tones, dried citrus peel, and faint floral undertones.

  • Palate: Smooth, rounded, and dry-leaning on the entry. Upfront flavors of roasted agave, butterscotch, and sweet vanilla yield to dry toasted oak, baking spices (allspice and cinnamon), white pepper, and subtle peach.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a soft, silky, and clean viscosity.

  • Finish: Crisp, dry, and elegant, closing with lingering notes of warm cinnamon spice, light oak, sweet agave, and a gentle pepper spark.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Ketel One Vodka
bodyHtml: Using carefully selected European wheat and a combination of modern and traditional distilling techniques, we produce an exceptional product, both crisp to taste and soft on finish. Here, the 4Fs – Fragrance, Flavour, Feel and Finish – help to define what makes Ketel One Vodka so unique.

title: Mount Gay Amber Eclipse Rum
bodyHtml: Brilliant golden amber in colour, Eclipse bears a luxuriously complex aroma whose rich, seamless harmony is interwoven with distinctive floral and fruity notes of apricot and banana, with hints of vanilla and a subtle smokiness imparted by the Kentucky oak barrels in which the rum is patiently aged.

title: Knob Creek Smoked Maple
bodyHtml:
Full-bodied, inviting maple notes that lift to smoke and are complemented with rich vanilla and caramel.

See More USA Whisky

title: Smirnoff Blueberry Vodka
bodyHtml: Clear water white; intense blueberry aromas and flavours; on the palate it is smooth and velvety, with a hint of sweetness.

title: Flor de Cana Extra Seco 4 Year Old Rum
bodyHtml: A sugar-free 4-year old premium rum that is sustainably produced (Carbon Neutral & Fair Trade certified). From a 5th generation family estate, it is naturally aged without artificial ingredients, distilled 100% with renewable energy and KOSHER certified. A light-bodied rum with a long and smooth finish that lingers in the palate. Perfect for classic white rum cocktails and refreshing drinks.

title: Don Julio Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml: Don Julio Anejo Tequila is currently made in Mexico, specifically in the highlands of Jalisco. This premium aged tequila offers a refined and complex flavour profile. It is aged for at least 18 months in American white oak barrels, resulting in a smooth and rich character. Don Julio Anejo Tequila exhibits notes of caramel, vanilla, toasted oak, and a hint of agave sweetness. Critics consistently applaud its exceptional quality and craftsmanship. It has been praised for its smoothness, depth of flavour, and well-balanced profile. Tequila enthusiasts appreciate its elegance and the remarkable aging process that enhances its distinctive character.

title: Old Grand Dad Bourbon
bodyHtml: A go-to bourbon for cocktails and occasional sipping. Named in honour of whiskey legend Basil Hayden Sr., Old Grand-Dad is bottled in bond, which means it was produced by one distillery in one year. It had to be bottled at 100 proof (50 percent alcohol) and was aged for a minimum of four years at a government-bonded warehouse. Made with a higher rye content, it is smooth, rich and spicy, with flavours of vanilla, ginger, orange peel, pumpkin, coconut, caramel and all-spice. The higher alcohol adds some kick, but it's got the flavours and depth to smooth things out.

title: Aberlour 12 Year Old
bodyHtml: Aberlour is always a good choice - one of the best value Speyside malts around. This double matured version is a mix of traditional oak and sherry casks and is rich and fruity with delicious Christmas cake notes.

title: Highwood Pure Canadian Vodka - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Our flagship Vodka is tripled distilled resulting in a wonderfully pure classic vodka. What makes a crowd stand out is it is distilled from locally grown Canadian wheat then blended with pure natural Rocky Mountain water. Highwood is among the few who use wheat, instead of corn, for some of our vodkas. Resulting in a crisp, clean, soft, natural vodka of superb integrity.  Nothing beats classic Vodka. It is distilled through the most careful precision resulting in a fabulously clean product of heightened excellence. So, whatever direction your party is headed, with a bottle of this vodka, you'll have a versatile ingredient to keep things delicious.

title: Grey Goose Vodka - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Grey Goose Vodka is currently made in France, specifically in the Cognac region. This premium vodka is known for its smooth and refined flavour profile. It is crafted using high-quality French wheat and pure water sourced from the Gensac Springs. Grey Goose offers a clean and crisp taste, with subtle hints of citrus and a touch of sweetness. Critics consistently praise Grey Goose Vodka for its exceptional quality and craftsmanship. It has been lauded for its smoothness, purity, and versatility in cocktails. Vodka enthusiasts appreciate its elegance and consistently high standards, making it a preferred choice for those seeking a top-tier vodka experience.

title: Highland Park 18 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Highland Park's 18 Year Old enjoyed a redesign in 2017, receiving livery inspired by the wood carvings from Urnes Stave Church and a new sub-name, "Viking Pride". The Orkney single malt remains the same as before ... rich and complex and delicious!

Nose: A profusion of ripe floral notes and fresh blossom with a delectable fruit salad. Notes of honeyed exotic fruits with a little botrytis.

Palate: Creamy and full with fruit conserves and espresso. A creaminess with cinnamon and allspice. Notes of toffee with thick black forest honey with a touch more citrus.

Finish: Long and well sugared with a herbal edge.

title: Basil Hayden's Kentucky Bourbon
bodyHtml: Amber in colour. On the nose are notes of dried apricot, caramel, custard, green peppercorn and hay. It is medium-bodied and warming on the palate, with flavours of white pepper, burnt sugar, dried white flowers and vanilla that finishes with a lingering herbal spice.

title: Pendleton Director's Reserve
bodyHtml:
General Information

Director's Reserve is a blended Canadian whisky combined with glacier-fed spring water from Oregon's Mt. Hood. After aging for 20 years, it's bottled at a 40% ABV. The bottle is wrapped in a commemorative leather sleeve created by saddle-maker Randy Severe, whose family has been making saddles for almost 70 years.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Writers' Tears Copper Pot Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
Writers Tears is a light, sweet Irish whiskey made using a mix of single pot still and single malt whiskeys, resulting in oodles of honey and fruity notes. Wonderfully easy to drink, it would make for a great introduction to Irish whiskey for folks new to the spirit. No writers were harmed in the making of this whiskey.

See More Irish Whisky

title: Tomatin 18 Year Old Oloroso Sherry Cask
bodyHtml: The Tomatin 18 Year Old is a truly luxurious world class malt. Matured in traditional oak casks and first-fill Oloroso Sherry butts, dried apricot, nougat and distinctive nutty flavours develop into bursts of tropical fruit with mellow undertones and a rich, full bodied finish.

title: Jameson - 750 ml
bodyHtml:
A versatile and smooth blend of pot still and fine grain whiskeys. Bright pale amber in the glass, with subtle aromas of white flower, nectarine, ripe pear and clove. Mellow and approachable on the palate, with a gentle impression of alcohol and flavours that include spicy vanilla, wildflower honey and ginger.

See More Irish Whisky

title: Seagram VO - 1.75 Litre (Plastic Bottle)
bodyHtml:
The 'VO' stands for very own and was first released in 1913 to celebrate the marriage of Thomas Seagram. A blend of more than 20 whiskies, it pours a brilliant golden amber colour and offers aromas and flavours of dried apricot, hazelnut and a touch of vanilla. Balanced and smooth it finishes dry with delicate floral notes.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Absolut Vodka
bodyHtml: Clear and colourless; soft grain aroma; warmth of alcohol with hint of sweetness smooth and clean.

title: Espolon Blanco Tequila
bodyHtml: Crafted at their state of the art distillery from 100% blue agave this is crystal clear with delicate aromas of sweet agave, tropical fruit, citrus and hints of pepper. An inviting palate offers soft texture repeated flavours from the nose with the addition of vanilla bean and spice that persist onto a clean finish.

title: Oban 14 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Oban 14-Year-Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a distinguished expression from the Oban Distillery, one of Scotland's oldest and smallest distilleries, established in 1794. Situated in the coastal town of Oban, this distillery uniquely bridges the gap between the Western Highlands and the Islands, influencing the whisky's distinctive character.

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Rich amber hue.
  • Nose: A harmonious blend of sweet toffee, subtle smoke, and tropical fruits like caramelized pineapple and lychee.
  • Palate: Creamy texture with flavors of marmalade, toffee apples, and pear cider, complemented by a hint of cloves.
  • Finish: Long and malty, with notes of toasty oak and spice.

Production Details

Oban 14-Year-Old is crafted using traditional methods, including fermentation in small-batch wooden washbacks and distillation in lantern-shaped copper pot stills. The whisky matures for 14 years in oak casks, allowing it to develop its full-bodied, fruity character with a subtle hint of smoke.

Accolades

This expression has been recognized for its excellence, earning a Double Gold medal at the 2022 San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

title: Crown Royal - 750 ml
bodyHtml: A Canadian favourite! Aging in both new and seasoned white oak barrels gives Crown Royal its unique flavour profile that has garnered fans the world over. Light amber in colour the nose is lightly floral with corn, buttery vanilla and peach aromas.

title: Sobieski Vodka
bodyHtml:
General Information

Grains harvested from the rich Mazowse fields where the golden Dankowski rye is found are used to produce this authentic Polish vodka. Pouring crystal clear the nose is clean with subtle rye spice notes. The palate is quite refined and balanced in taste with a smooth/clean finish; ideal for mixing.

title: Jim Beam - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The name Jim Beam has become synonymous with Kentucky Straight Bourbon. The white label pours a golden amber colour and offers light floral, citrus, spice and creamed corn aromas. The palate is medium-bodied with flavours of vanilla and caramel, followed by a clean finish.

See More USA Whisky

title: Glen Garioch 12 Year Old
bodyHtml:
Introduced to Glen Garioch's standard range in late 2010, this is a mix of ex-bourbon and sherry casks, and like the other distillery bottlings since the revamp, has been bottled at a feisty 48%. A real charmer.

See More Scotch Whisky

title: Bruichladdich The Classic Laddie Scottish Barley
bodyHtml: Created by Jim McEwan from whisky matured in American oak casks alongside Lochindaal and chosen to represent the classic, unpeated distillery style. The signature bottling is made with 100% Scottish barley.

title: Gibson's Sterling
bodyHtml:
Blended for subtlety and smoothness, this pours a pale amber with gold highlights. The nose is subtle, with aromas of spicy rye, citrus, toasted oak, dried fruit and caramel. With an approachable and silky mouthfeel, medium-bodied flavours of toasted grains, citrus, spice and baked apple come together on an elegant finish.

See More Canadian Whisky

title: Royal Reserve - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
General Information

This classic brand rose to fame in the 60's and 70's when cocktails were all the rage; with a renewed interest, bartenders are once again turning to whiskies like this for their subtle character and mix-ability. Hints of honey, burnt almond and sweet caramel on the nose prepare you for a palate that is light and smooth.

title: Ketel One Vodka - 1.75 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Using carefully selected European wheat and a combination of modern and traditional distilling techniques, we produce an exceptional product, both crisp to taste and soft on finish. Here, the 4Fs – Fragrance, Flavour, Feel and Finish – help to define what makes Ketel One Vodka so unique.

title: Fireball Cinnamon Whisky - 750 ml
bodyHtml: The blending of smooth Canadian whisky and intense cinnamon flavour result in a bold shot that is fragrant with pronounced aromas of cinnamon and spice; on the palate the spicy flavours of cinnamon intermingle with caramel notes on a long, hot finish. Serve well chilled. Great on its own, use in cocktails or apple desserts.

title: Casamigos Anejo Tequila
bodyHtml:
Casamigos Añejo Tequila is an ultra-premium aged Mexican spirit produced in the Highlands (Los Altos) of Jalisco, Mexico. The brand was founded in 2013 by Hollywood actor George Clooney, nightlife entrepreneur Rande Gerber, and property developer Mike Meldman, originally created simply as a private house tequila for their personal collection of homes ("casa de amigos") in Mexico. Following explosive international growth, the brand was acquired by global spirits leader Diageo in 2017 in a landmark deal valued at up to $1 billion.

Spirit Description

Casamigos Añejo is crafted from 100% Blue Weber agaves grown in the mineral-rich red clay soil of the Jalisco Highlands. The agave piñas are slow-roasted in traditional brick ovens for 72 hours before undergoing an extended fermentation process utilizing a proprietary yeast blend. After double distillation in copper-lined pot stills, the liquid matures for 12 to 14 months in hand-selected American white oak barrels (NOM 1609 / formerly NOM 1416).

  • Colour: Warm, rich caramel gold with amber highlights.

  • Aroma: Soft, sweet, and complex, opening with dominant aromas of warm caramel, vanilla frosting, and butterscotch, layered alongside cooked agave, sweet cream, and subtle barrel oak.

  • Palate: Velvety, smooth, and approachable on the entry. Upfront flavours of agave syrup, vanilla sponge cake, and toffee blend gracefully into toasted oak wood, subtle baking spices, cinnamon, and a hint of dark chocolate.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a round, silky, and viscous mouthfeel that coats the palate without heavy alcohol heat.

  • Finish: Long, warming, and lingering, closing with persistent notes of sweet vanilla cream, soft oak spice, and mild black pepper.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Bushmills Black Bush Irish Whiskey
bodyHtml:
This renowned blended Irish whiskey originates from the village of Bushmills in County Antrim, Northern Ireland, produced at the historic Old Bushmills Distillery. Bushmills Black Bush Irish Whiskey is celebrated across the industry for breaking the traditional conventions of standard blended Irish whiskey: while typical commercial blends lean heavily on lighter column-still grain whiskey, Black Bush features an exceptionally high proportion—roughly 80%—of triple-distilled malted barley. The single malt component is aged for up to seven to eight years, matured predominantly in selected first-fill and second-fill Spanish Oloroso sherry casks, before being married with a small parcel of sweet, delicate grain whiskey aged in ex-bourbon barrels. It is bottled at 80 proof (40.0% ABV).

Spirit Description

This whiskey displays a radiant, deep copper-amber hue with dark golden reflections and smooth, coating tears along the glass. On the nose, it is notably rich, fruit-forward, and sweet, opening with concentrated notes of dark dried fruits, sultanas, prune compote, and baked apples, followed by layers of sweet toffee, vanilla fudge, toasted nuts, and seasoned Spanish oak spice. On the palate, the high-malt composition delivers an uncommonly silky, round, and creamy mouthfeel that far exceeds standard blended whiskeys in body. An initial wave of rich sherry sweetness, dark plums, and candied citrus peel gives way to rich mid-palate notes of milk chocolate, warm baking spices (nutmeg and cinnamon), and toasted hazelnuts, balanced by the light honeyed sweetness of the grain component. The finish is medium-to-long, warm, and lingering, leaving trailing impressions of dried dark fruits, sweet oak tannins, caramel, and a gentle spicy dryness.

title: Alberta Premium Rye - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml:
The authentic flavour of prairie rye and careful barrel ageing gives this whisky a golden amber colour and an aromatic sweet bouquet of banana, toffee, and light spice. The flavour is mellow and slightly smoky with a lively woody edge on a medium weight palate that finishes with a hint of hot cinnamon spice.

title: Basil Hayden's Dark Rye
bodyHtml: Two flavourful whiskies and a touch of port converge to create this flavourful rye. Aromas of sweet caramelized banana, stewed berry and oak spice greet your nose. The palate is complex, with toffee and dried fruit lifted by oak spice and a long finish with fruit and rye spice repeats.

title: Sailor Jerry Spiced Rum - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Medium amber colour with a medley of spice aromas, including subtle cinnamon and nutmeg, with hints of toasty oak, toffee, chocolate and vanilla. Dry, medium to full bodied, richly textured, with balanced flavours of warm sweet spiced fruit, oak, caramel and hints of nut and oak, leading to warm peppery note on the long finish.

title: Fireball - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
The blending of smooth Canadian whisky and intense cinnamon flavour results in a bold shot that is fragrant with pronounced aromas of cinnamon and spice. On the palate, the spicy flavours of cinnamon intermingle with caramel notes on a long, hot finish. Serve well chilled. Great on its own, use in cocktails or apple desserts.
