title: Jose Cuervo Especial Gold Tequila
bodyHtml: Jose Cuervo Gold is a joven tequila made from a blend of reposado (aged) and younger tequilas. Medium gold colour with aromas of freshly ground pepper, spice and orange. Flavours of black pepper and caramel, notes of toffee and vanilla on the finish. The perfect tequila for Margaritas!

title: Siempre Plata Tequila
bodyHtml:
General Information

An award-winning spirit, 100% agave tequila that's handcrafted in small batches. Crystal clear in appearance. Complex aromas and flavours of spice, herb, pepper, brine/sea salt and citrus with candied, floral notes and hints of caramel and sweet fruit. Exceptionally smooth, naturally sweet and made for sipping.

title: Prvijenac Grappa - 1 Litre
bodyHtml: Hard and harmonious, pure grape brandy of Montenegro. Grape brandy distilled of the best grape varieties from Adriatic Coast.

title: Marolo Grappa di Moscato
bodyHtml: A distinctive grappa, it retains the rich, fruity aromas and flavours of Moscato. Attractive orange and floral notes come together on the pretty and refreshing finish.

title: Marolo Grappa di Amarone
bodyHtml: This Amarone grappa features all excellent characteristics of the variety and the aging in barriques gives it the particular deep amber color. It has fruity cherry notes along with those of almonds, hazelnuts and at the end, mint and anise. Balsamic and herbal flavours are also perceptible.

title: Zenato Grappa Di Amarone - 500 ml
bodyHtml: The aroma is intense and penetrating, with notes of ripe fruit and spices, enhanced by the strength of the alcohol. The taste is dry, but not too clean, tasty and generous, with a remarkable persistence.

title: Marolo Grappa di Barbera
bodyHtml: Obtained from Barbera pomaces carefully selected in the Barbera d'Alba area. Amber-coloured grappa, with light red tints, taken from its aging in barriques previously used for alcoholic processed wines. Intense and delightful vanilla and fruit aroma. Supple but at the same time full and round taste.

title: Marolo 'Milla' Grappa and Camomile Liqueur
bodyHtml:
Milla is a liqueur made from the infusion of Camomile flowers in the grappa. The Camomile flowers are picked when fully ripened, then left to steep for eleven months in the grappa. This liqueur is obtained from a traditional and easy recipe, typical in the Langhe territory, the land of Barolo and Barbaresco.

Milla is the new Marolo brand that replaced the "Liquor of Grappa and Chamomile", completely renewed thanks to the precious work of famous international designers. During the previous years, the imitations attempts have been a lot; that's why Marolo created Milla, to protect the originality of the recipe and to go towards the taste of the young clients who are enthusiastically appreciating and consuming more and more this product. Milla is wonderful to be drunk chilly, or frozen.

title: Nonino Artigianale Grappa - 1 Litre
bodyHtml: White Grappa obtained from fresh and soft pomace of white and red grapes. Fragrance of grapes, elegant, fresh and crystalline.

title: Tignanello Grappa - 500 ml
bodyHtml: Grappa Tignanello is obtained by distilling the pomace of Cabernet and Sangiovese grapes harvested in the Tignanello vineyard, located in the Tignanello estate, in the heart of Chianti Classico. The fermented grapes are transferred to the distillery immediately after the fermenting vats (racking) and then pressed. This procedure guarantees that distillation is carried out using only the best quality skins, rich in alcohol and especially in aromatic substances. A very careful selection of the different ‘lots’ of grappa resulting from the distillation of the different ‘lots’ of marc, and the best ones, the most balanced and aromatic ones. Grappa Tignanello is available in limited quantities.

title: Poli Barrique Grappa - Solera di Famiglia
bodyHtml:
General Information

  • Distillation: artisanal, in small lots, with a discontinuous copper still provided with steam pots
  • Aroma: toasted wood, vanilla, cocoa, coffee
  • Taste: persistent, strong, harmonious
  • % alc - Content: 55% Alc./Vol - 700 ml
  • Service: at temperature of 18/20 °C - 65/68 °F in a tulip-shaped glass

title: Altesino Grappa di Brunello - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Distilled Sangiovese di Montalcino grape pomace refined in barriques. Grappa di Fattoria was created for the first time by Altesino in 1977 together with the master distiller Gioacchino Nannoni. The fresh pomace from the company is distilled a few hours after racking in a copper still, using a discontinuous method, with low degree columns.

The light yellow colour with golden hues is due to its short time in wooden barrels, which enables the distillate to acquire slight hints of vanilla and oak, without losing the fruity taste typical of a young grappa. Balanced, with a pleasant impact, it delivers all its flavor on the palate with beautiful persistence.

title: Poli 'Miele' Grappa Based Liqueur - 500 ml
bodyHtml: A liqueur based on Grappa and acacia honey, with essential oils from mugo pine, juniper, mint and lemon verbena to grant exquisite balsamic sensations.

title: Poli Grappa 'Sarpa di Poli'
bodyHtml:
“Sarpa” in Venetian dialect means “grape-pomace”, the raw material from which Grappa is made.  Sarpa di Poli is obtained from the pomace of grape varieties with floral and delicately herbaceous aromas, distilled by means of steam in a pot-still working in small batches.

  • Raw material: Merlot and Cabernet grapes
  • Distillation: artisanal, in small lots, with a discontinuous copper still provided with steam pots
  • Aroma: fresh herbs, mint, rose, geranium
  • Taste: rustic, sincere, generous and virile
  • % alc - Content: 40% Alc./Vol - 700 ml
  • Service: at temperature of 10/15 °C - 50/59 °F in a tulip-shaped glass

title: D'Usse XO Cognac
bodyHtml: D'Ussé XO Cognac is a blend of Cognacs with 10 to 30 years in oak. Deep copper in colour and showing a complex nose of dried apricot, butterscotch and orange zest. Flavours of blackberry, dark chocolate, toasted nut, apricot and honey are woven on a smooth and full-bodied palate. Earthy notes emerge on a lengthy finish.

title: D'Eaubonne VSOP Brandy
bodyHtml: Golden amber colour, citrus-orange and caramel nose with a hint of pineapple fruit. Delicate citrus and oak flavours with a warm, dry finish.

title: Chateau de Montifaud VS Cognac
bodyHtml: Chateau de Montifaud VS Cognac is a Petite Champagne blend that delights with its freshness and youth. On both the nose and palate, enjoy the combination of fruits and floral - pears, apples, and a hint of linden flowers. Enjoy on the rocks, with a mixer or as a base for a special cocktail.

title: Stara Sokolova Apricot Brandy
bodyHtml: Stara Sokolova Apricot Brandy is currently made in Serbia, where it is crafted with utmost precision and traditional methods. This exquisite brandy offers a distinct flavour profile that highlights the luscious sweetness and natural essence of apricots. The fruit is carefully selected, fermented, and aged to develop its rich character. Stara Sokolova Apricot Brandy boasts a smooth and velvety texture with vibrant apricot notes, hints of honey, and a touch of almond. Critics have praised its authenticity, craftsmanship, and the intense apricot flavour it delivers. It has been applauded for its exceptional quality and the ability to capture the essence of ripe apricots. Brandy enthusiasts appreciate its depth of flavour and the delightful balance between sweetness and subtle nuttiness. Stara Sokolova Apricot Brandy is a true testament to the art of Serbian brandy-making.

title: R. Jelinek Williams Pear Brandy
bodyHtml: Jelínek is a brand known for its slivovitz and other liqueurs. When they set out to make a Czech version of a pear brandy, they sourced high quality Williams pears from three different continents. The distillate is made under strict kosher production guidelines and is aged slightly before bottling.

title: Monte Sabotino 20 Year Old Brandy
bodyHtml: Brandy Stravecchio Grand Reserve 20 Years Monte Sabotino Selezione is a distillate with an intriguing personality as it combines elegance with the wealth of intoxicating scents of 20 years of "experience" that are evident from its mature character. It represents a further evolution of the Brandy Selezione Monte Sabotino line and the tradition of the aging process that distinguishes our products.

title: Castarede Armagnac 1996
bodyHtml:
Castarède Armagnac 1996 is a vintage brandy from the Bas Armagnac region of France. Founded in 1832, Maison Castarède is the oldest trading house in Armagnac and remains an independent, family-owned business currently led by Florence Castarède, a sixth-generation descendant. The family owns Château de Maniban, where they maintain control over production from the vineyard to the ageing process in local oak barrels. This 1996 vintage was distilled using a traditional alembic armagnacais (column still) from a blend of Baco, Colombard, and Ugni Blanc grapes.

Spirit Description

The 1996 vintage matured for approximately 24 years in a humid warehouse before being bottled in October 2021. It is presented at a drinking strength of 40% ABV.

  • Colour: While specific descriptions for 1996 vary, Castarède vintages typically feature coppery or amber robes with brilliant tints.

  • Aroma: The nose is typically complex and rich, characteristic of long-aged Bas Armagnacs; similar vintages from the house feature notes of dried prunes, spices, light oak, and orange bark.

  • Palate: It is described as smooth and rich, often exhibiting 'la queue de Paon' (peacock's tail)—a term used for a flavour that blossoms and lingers extensively on the palate.

  • Body: Voluptuous and unctuous with a well-balanced structure and soft, melted tannins.

  • Finish: A persistent finish that typically features echoes of pepper, vanilla, and concentrated fruit.

title: Martell XO Supreme Cognac
bodyHtml:
Martell XO Supreme Cognac is a luxurious spirit that originates from the esteemed Cognac region in France. Crafted by the renowned House of Martell, this XO expression showcases the mastery of their expert blenders.

Martell XO Supreme Cognac offers a complex and refined tasting profile, characterized by its velvety textures and rich flavours. It exudes enticing aromas of ripe fruits, candied oranges, and delicate spices, striking a harmonious balance between sweetness and depth. The cognac's extended aging in fine oak barrels contributes to its smoothness and enhances its intricate layers of flavour.

Critics have lauded Martell XO Supreme Cognac for its exceptional quality and craftsmanship. According to Drinks International, it is "an opulent and silky cognac, exuding elegance with its vibrant fruit notes and delightful warmth." Whisky Advocate praises it as "a benchmark for the art of cognac-making, with impeccable balance and remarkable depth."

Martell XO Supreme Cognac represents the pinnacle of Martell's expertise and proudly upholds their legacy of over three centuries. It is an exquisite choice for discerning connoisseurs, offering a captivating sensory experience that reveals the finesse and complexity of this exceptional cognac.

title: Martell Cordon Bleu XO Cognac
bodyHtml:
Martell XO Cordon Bleu is a distinguished cognac that hails from the prestigious Cognac region in France. Crafted by the esteemed House of Martell, this expression embodies the epitome of their blending mastery.

Martell XO Cordon Bleu captivates the senses with its exquisite flavours and sophisticated tasting profile. It entices with aromas of dried fruits, candied orange peel, and subtle spices, leading to a velvety and full-bodied palate. The cognac offers a harmonious balance of rich flavours, including notes of dark chocolate, roasted almonds, and a touch of honeyed sweetness.

Critics have recognized the exceptional quality of Martell XO Cordon Bleu. According to Wine Enthusiast, it is a "remarkable cognac with intense aromas of dried fruits and a complex palate that reveals layers of flavours." The Spirits Business praises it as "a benchmark in the world of cognac, showcasing impeccable craftsmanship and finesse."

Martell XO Cordon Bleu stands as a testament to Martell's heritage and commitment to excellence. It is an exquisite choice for discerning connoisseurs, delivering a memorable and luxurious cognac experience that embodies the timeless elegance of Martell.

title: Chateau Montifaud XO Cognac
bodyHtml:
Chateau de Montifaud XO Cognac is a light and smooth extra old cognac created solely from eaux-de-vie grown in Petite Champagne. A fresh, non-tannic cognac, mellow with hints of almonds and aromas of dried fruits. A cognac much appreciated by the ladies, thanks to its light, fresh taste.

  • Eye: Coppery with amber shades.
  • Nose: Very fruity aromas, dry and some toasted almonds and hazelnuts. Remarkable aromas of sweet spices reminiscent of nutmeg and saffron.
  • Palate: Fresh, very round and with a long finish.

title: Chateau Montifaud VSOP Cognac
bodyHtml: The Château de Montifaud VSOP is a stand-out effort from the Vallet family, with a Domaine and distillery covering more than 90 hectares of prime vineyard where the Grande and Petite Champagne meet in the Archiac. The soil there is teaming with active limestone, meaning the quality of the eau-de-vie is influenced by the chalky content. Plum and apricot, rich oak, floral aroma and vanilla with hints of spicy figs.

title: Courvoisier VSOP Cognac
bodyHtml: This skillfully crafted Cognac is a blend of several crus with a perfect balance between Fins Bois, Grande and Petite Champagnes at the peak of their aromatic potential. Reward yourself with aromas and flavours of luscious peach, toasted almond, and delicate jasmine on a medium-weight palate with an enduring finish.

title: Saint Vivant VSOP Armagnac
bodyHtml: Aromas of orange rind, sweet orange blossom, brown sugar and clover honey, patisserie, toffee, vanilla and caramel. Some baking spice accompanies the oak and a sandalwood perfume. Flavours of mandarin orange, citric zest, fig, oak, vanilla, caramel, clove and cinnamon. It has a long finish with complexity.

title: Tesseron XO Lot No. 76 Premier Cru Cognac
bodyHtml:
Tesseron XO Lot No. 76 Premier Cru is a high-end cognac exclusively sourced from the Grande Champagne region of France, which is legally designated as the 'Premier Cru'. The Tesseron family has a long heritage in the region, originally serving as a major supplier of aged 'eaux-de-vie' to large cognac houses before releasing spirits under their own name in 2003. Today, the house remains family-owned and is led by Alfred Tesseron, who also oversees the prestigious Bordeaux estate Château Pontet-Canet.

Spirit Description

This expression is a blend of reserve stocks crafted primarily from Ugni Blanc grapes, matured for more than a generation in Limousin oak casks within the distillery's thirteenth-century stone cellars. The lot number suggests that the oldest 'eaux-de-vie' in the blend was distilled in 1976.

  • Colour: The spirit is very clear and bright in the glass.

  • Aroma: The nose is alluring and expressive, presenting a sensation of fruit compote and caramelised peaches layered with hints of honey, leather, and almond, all lifted by elegant floral tones.

  • Palate: It is generous on attack with a spicy vitality and delicate flavours of nuts, dried fruits, ripe pear, and orange peel.

  • Body: The cognac is full-bodied and harmonious, exhibiting a supple and rounded style.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, satiny, and sweet finish.

  • ABV: Tesseron XO Lot No. 76 is bottled at 40%.

Accolades

Tesseron Lot No. 76 has received substantial recognition from major spirit critics and international competitions.

  • 90-95 Points: Rated as 'Superb' and 'Highly Recommended' by Wine Enthusiast.

  • Four Stars: Highly recommended by F. Paul Pacult's Spirit Journal.

  • Four and a Half Stars: Awarded by Wine Magazine.

title: Stara Sokolova Plum Brandy
bodyHtml:
General Information

Stara Sokolova means “Old Falcon” and is derived from the historical name of the Drina River’s watershed in Western Serbia. Stara Sokolova delivers a potent mix of Bogdanovic legendary production with flavour and smoothness that has been enjoyed by Serbians all over the world.

Distilled from traditional plum varieties, Stara Sokolova Slivovitz is uniquely smooth with vanilla, orange blossom and earthy notes on the nose. Stara Sokolova plum brandy is best enjoyed extremely cold as a digestif, or as a dessert on its own on a hot summer night.

title: Torres 10 Year Old Brandy
bodyHtml:
Torres 10 Gran Reserva Brandy originates from Spain, within the North region in the subregion of Penedes in Barcelona. The historic lineage of Juan Torres Master Distillers began in 1928 when Juan Torres Casals started distilling white wines from the region to produce premium aged brandies. Today, the multi generational family enterprise maintains its esteemed global standing, continuing to oversee production using time honoured regional practices.

Spirit Description

This spirit exhibits a dark topaz appearance with fine old gold and mahogany tints in the glass. The intense, warm sensory profile opens with an aromatic nose dominated by rich notes of cinnamon, creamy vanilla, and sweet butterscotch, underscored by hints of black cherry. On the palate, the body is round and remarkably rich in tannins, carrying strong sweet flavors of vanilla and cherry that overpower any bitter alcohol notes. The finish is complete, lush, and persistent, leaving lingering aromatic tones of toasted oak and soft winter spices. This Spanish brandy is traditionally bottled at an alcohol by volume of 38% to 40%.

title: Boulard Calvados Pays d'Auge Grand Solage Brandy - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
General Information

The blend of varieties aged 2 to 5 years from the Pays d'Auge provides this unique apple brandy with its aromatic and flavourful character. Baked and fresh apple aromas/flavours are the main calling cards with layers of pear, peach, and vanilla creating an elegant/flavourful experience. Delicious served neat.

title: D'Orignac Pineau Des Charentes Brandy
bodyHtml:
General Information

Beautiful amber colour with golden tints, it offers a powerful aromatic nose, with subtle hints of ripe yellow fruits like apricot, honey and raisins, spice and flowers, oranges! It is pleasantly sweet and refreshing with a great harmony between grape flavours and Cognac aromas. Intense, elegant and distinguished, this Pineau is the inimitable meeting of roundness and elegance that makes it one of the most famous ambassadors of its appellation. Always served chilled, the Pineau d’Orignac is not only delicious as an aperitif ; it is also excellent with meals, desserts and cheese. Will keep in fridge once opened as it is sweet with a high alcohol content of 18%.

title: D'Usse VSOP Cognac
bodyHtml: Naturally aged for at least four and a half years in the cellars of France's Château de Cognac, where some of the world's finest Cognacs have been made for over 200 years. This emerges as a bold, full-bodied blend that is uniquely powerful and has a pleasantly smooth and balanced finish.

title: St Remy Napoleon VSOP Brandy
bodyHtml: Say it big and bold with this pre-wrapped wonder that's spicy on the nose, fruity on the tongue and guaranteed to please.

title: Gautier VS Cognac
bodyHtml: A blend of eaux-de-vie aged a minimum of 2 years, this Cognac offers aromas of candied fruit, toffee, vanilla, and wood spice; the palate is full and warming with flavours of chocolate, orange, vanilla, and Christmas cake spices followed by a long and balanced finish.

title: Poli Elixir Camomilla Grappa
bodyHtml: Since the ancient times the properties of the Matricaria Chamomilla are known, those flower heads get put in an infusion of alcohol, Grappa and sugar. After about three months the essential oils of the flowers give a golden colour and an aroma of summer meadow to this liqueur, those tasting helps the relaxation.

title: Godet Gastronome XO Cognac
bodyHtml: The best description of Gastronome is that it’s an ultra-dry Cognac. It’s a wholly Fins Bois eau-de-vie created from start to finish without the use of chemicals, pesticides, or any artificial components. In this age of climate change and other environmental challenges, the choice to make Gastronome a completely organic product is both insightful and perceptive. It’s also an excellent example of how good such a Cognac can taste.

title: Courvoisier VS Cognac
bodyHtml:
Courvoisier VS Cognac is a blend of several crus aged between three and seven years, composed principally of Fins Bois with a balancing hand of Petite Champagne. An elegant and harmonious cognac with strong notes of fresh fruit and fresh oaky taste. The fusion of younger and older cognacs gives Courvoisier VS a fruity, delicate taste and a bouquet filled with ripe fruit and spring flowers.

  • Ripe Fruits: The chalky soil in Fins Bois delivers a hint of ripened fruits that is its signature aroma.
  • Spring Flowers: Inhale deeply for the bouquet of spring flowers, which is a hallmark of grapes harvested at their peak from the Fins Bois crus.
  • Fresh Oak: The rich, fresh oak bouquet is controlled throughout the aging process to make sure it doesn’t dominate the young cognac.

title: St George Botanivore Gin
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

Boasting a big, but balanced bunch of botanicals, the Botanivore is blooming brilliant. An American craft gin with 19 different botanicals, including angelica root, bay laurel, cilantro, Seville orange peel, star anise and juniper berries, among others. It's like a greenhouse in a bottle. The folks at St. George Spirits out in California ought to be proud of this bright, complex but very approachable gin.

title: Gordon's Gin - 1.75 Litre (Plastic Bottle)
bodyHtml: Almost 250 years ago, Alexander Gordon started his distillery in London and set about creating the recipe for a brilliant tasting gin. Gordon's high quality and distinctive juniper flavour has come to define the taste of the classic G&T.  Gordon's today is a gin that's enjoyed, not dissected. It's the perfect gin to start a Friday evening, or a Tuesday night catch up with friends, where we share a moment and have a laugh with people we love.

title: Sahara Dry Gin - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Sahara Dry Gin is produced in the London Dry style. It is produced from Canadian wheat and naturally sourced Rocky Mountain water. Juniper, Citrus of Lemon, and other botanicals are all added during the final distillation. The gin is as described, very dry; so dry in fact, that the folks at Highwood Distillers named it Sahara.

title: Gin Mare Mediterranean Gin
vendor: 300614 - Bf Canada - A Division Of The Hive
bodyHtml: Gin Mare was testing the boundaries of gin long before everyone else hopped on the bandwagon. With rosemary, thyme, olive and basil included in the botanical lineup, it’s savoury and unusual, balanced and complex. It’s also a Spanish gin made in Spain, something that should help it to establish itself firmly in one of the world’s biggest gin markets.

title: Brockmans Gin
bodyHtml:
Brockmans Gin is a premium, contemporary style gin produced in England. Launched in 2008 by a group of close friends Neil Everitt, Bob Fowkes, and their partners the brand was created to break away from traditional juniper-heavy London Dry gins and explore a softer, intensely fruit-forward flavour profile. It is distilled in the Black Country region of England at an independent distillery using a 100-year-old traditional copper pot still nicknamed "The Mariner".

Spirit Description

Brockmans is crafted from a unique recipe of 11 botanicals sourced globally, including Italian juniper, Spanish almond and citrus peels, and Chinese liquorice. Its defining characteristics, however, come from its signature post-distillation infusion of wild northern European blueberries and blackberries.

  • Colour: Crystal clear and transparent.

  • Aroma: Highly aromatic, lush, and perfume-like. The nose is overwhelmingly dominated by sweet, ripe berries, dark plum, and candied citrus, with a very subtle background hint of piney juniper and ginger spice.

  • Palate: Soft, smooth, and distinctly velvety on the tongue. The palate mirrors the nose, delivering intense flavors of sweet blueberry compote, jammy blackberries, and bright orange zest, supported by an earthy mid-palate of coriander seed and almond paste.

  • Body: Medium-bodied with a rounded, slightly creamy texture that minimizes any sharp alcohol bite.

  • Finish: Moderately long and smooth, trailing off with a gentle touch of dry wood spice, warm citrus oil, and a lingering, sweet berry sweetness.

  • ABV: Bottled at 40% (80 Proof).

title: Boodles British Gin
bodyHtml: Named after the famous private gentleman's club of London and true to British form this is proper gin that is rich in history. Distilled from British wheat and infused with a combination of traditional herbs and spices without the use of citrus. The palate is silky smooth, making it the ideal companion for lemon or lime.

title: Bols Genever Gin
bodyHtml: Before there was gin, there was genever. An incomparable grain spirit from Holland, made from long-fermented corn, rye, and wheat. Triple-distilled to create malt spirit, the heart of genever. Bols Original Genever blends our malt spirit with 22 botanicals ranging from juniper berries, hops and coriander, to cloves and ginger.

title: Martin Miller Gin
bodyHtml:
General Information

Martin Miller created this modern gin classic in 1998 upon finding he could not buy a decent gin and tonic. His gin is pot distilled, using the heart of the spirit only, and then enhanced with 10 select botanicals. Its aromatic notes of juniper and citrus carry on to the palate and end in a smooth finish. Pass the tonic!

title: Tanqueray Rangpur Lime Gin
bodyHtml: Tanqueray is one of our favourite gins, so any special variant is something to be happy about. This is brilliant stuff, flavoured with Rangpur limes – a zesty and very juicy Indian variety. The results are lip-smackingly delicious.

title: Plymouth Gin
bodyHtml: A higher-than-usual proportion of root ingredients is the source of Plymouth's distinctive earthy aromas. It has seven botanicals, juniper, coriander, sweet orange, cardamom, angelica and orris root, redistilled with pure grain spirit. Elegant in the mouth with luscious marshmallow and hints of sage and eucalyptus, it has a subtle, full-bodied flavour with no bitter botanicals and not nearly as much of a juniper hit as some gins. Sweet orange and cardamom impart a softly fruity, spicy finish. Pure water from Dartmoor contributes to Plymouth Gin's exceptionally clean and fresh flavour.

title: Park Distillery Alpine Gin
bodyHtml: Distilled with glacier fresh water right in Banff National Park, with hand-picked Canadian Spruce Tips defining this London dry style of Gin.

title: Poli Marconi 46 Gin
bodyHtml: Marconi 46 is an Italian gin artisanally distilled and obtained from a unique infusion of juniper berries, muscat grape, mountain pine, cembra pine, mint, cardamom and coriander reminding of the Asiago plateau in the north of the Veneto region, where the Poli family comes from.

title: Sahara Dry Gin - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml: Sahara Dry Gin is produced in the London Dry style. It is produced from Canadian wheat and naturally sourced Rocky Mountain water. Juniper, Citrus of Lemon, and other botanicals are all added during the final distillation. The gin is as described, very dry; so dry in fact, that the folks at Highwood Distillers named it Sahara.

title: Hayman's London Dry Gin
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hendrick's Gin is a super-premium spirit from Scotland, produced by William Grant & Sons at the Girvan distillery in South Ayrshire. Launched in 1999, the gin was created by Master Distiller Lesley Gracie, a chemist who sought to develop a distinct expression using two rare antique copper stills: an 1860 Bennett pot still and a 1948 Carter-Head still. The brand is known for its iconoclastic approach, packaged in a dark brown apothecary style bottle that reflects its 'oddly made' handcrafted nature.

Spirit Description

This gin is uniquely crafted using a symphony of 11 traditional botanicals, further enriched by unusual infusions of Bulgarian rose and specially selected cucumber. The combination of a robust spirit from the Bennett still and a delicate spirit from the Carter-Head still results in an impeccably balanced profile.

  • Colour: The spirit is perfectly clear and polished in the glass.

  • Aroma: The nose is bright and inviting, starting with mild citrus tones and herbal juniper, accented by floral scents of rose petal, violet, and a light cucumber influence.

  • Palate: It offers a silky entry with flavours of sweet elderberry, lime, and orange zest that intertwine with rose, lavender, and a burst of juniper pine.

  • Body: The gin possesses a medium to full body with a smooth, velvety, and well rounded texture.

  • Finish: It concludes with a lengthy and crisp finish, marked by a pleasant bitterness, dry spice, and a delicate fade of sweet citrus custard pastry.

  • ABV: In North America, the spirit is typically bottled at 44% alcohol by volume, while the European version is often 41.4%.

title: Potter's Gin - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Potter’s Dry Gin is produced in the London Dry Style by blending a light-bodied neutral spirit with juniper and Highwood’s own botanicals which have been selected from natural herbs, spices and citrus.

title: Citadelle Gin
bodyHtml:
94 Points - Wine Enthusiast

Brisk, clean, and citrusy enough to induce Martini-with-a-twist cravings. The aroma is mild, almost neutral. The palate opens with soft brushes of mint, juniper and citrus, growing more insistently citrusy, juniper-forward and drying with every sip.

title: Bombay Sapphire Gin - 1.75 Litre
bodyHtml: Clear water white. Complex mix of herbs and juniper on the nose with crisp lemon peel and citrus flavours. Smooth and refreshing.

title: Wild Life Distillery Gin
bodyHtml: Wild Life Gin embodies balance. Juniper and citrus notes on the nose: these pop right out of the glass. Fresh lemon and blood orange lead the way, with classic juniper and coriander close behind. Then the unmistakable texture of their grain base spirit shines through the middle palate. The finishing spices come through at the end in the back of the mouth completing the trio.

title: Bombay Sapphire East Gin
bodyHtml:
Bombay Sapphire East Gin originates from the United Kingdom. The gin is produced by Bacardi at the Laverstoke Mill distillery in Hampshire, England. The historic mill was converted into a state of the art distillery to craft the brand's world renowned spirits.

Spirit Description

This gin presents a crystal clear appearance in the glass. The aroma opens with vibrant Thai lemongrass and warm Vietnamese black peppercorn, layered over classic juniper and citrus. On the palate, it delivers a smooth, medium body with a crisp balance of subtle spice and lingering floral freshness. The finish is long, clean, and gently spicy with enduring botanical notes. It features an ABV of 42%.

title: Tanqueray Gin - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml:
This iconic London Dry gin originates from England, originally crafted in the Bloomsbury district of London. In 1830, founder Charles Tanqueray broke family tradition to establish his Vine Street distillery, where he experimented with over 300 recipes before perfecting his signature blend. Today, the brand is owned by Diageo and production has moved to the Cameronbridge Distillery in Fife, Scotland, though it still utilizes 'Old Tom'—a historic copper pot still that survived the Axis bombing of the original London distillery during World War II.

Gin Description

Tanqueray is widely considered the benchmark for the London Dry style, characterized by its purity and exceptional smoothness achieved through a quadruple-distillation process.

The aroma is vibrant and piney, dominated by juniper and complemented by peppery coriander, aromatic angelica, and the subtle sweetness of liquorice. On the palate, the gin is balanced and dry, delivering a rich juniper flavour with a satisfyingly smooth mouthfeel. The body is bold yet refined, leading to a long, full finish that lingers with hints of spice and warming citrus notes.

The botanical composition remains a closely guarded trade secret but is known to feature just four key ingredients: juniper, coriander seed, angelica root, and liquorice. Its optimal drinking window is now, as it is a non-vintage spirit intended for immediate enjoyment. The overall stylistic note is one of timeless elegance and reliability, making it a perennial favourite for bartenders worldwide..

title: Gordon's Gin - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Instant citrus aromas on the nose creating a very fresh experience. Quite dry on the palate however, with lots of citrus lemon flavors hitting first.

title: Saffron Boudier Gin
bodyHtml: The nose is surprisingly traditional, with juniper taking center stage and some citrus notes beneath that. But sipping is a different beast. The juniper fades away and the saffron becomes clearer. Yes, the fennel is also there, and together with the traditional gin notes it’s quite pleasant sipping on its own.

title: Victoria Empress Oaken Gin
bodyHtml: A rare item, aged in gin is a mixologist's treat. It can mix like a whisky or like a gin but to truly enjoy its complexity, we suggest serving it neat -- it has nothing to hide.

title: Old Raj Dry Gin
bodyHtml:
Tasting Notes

A premium strength Scottish gin flavoured with saffron, one of the world's most prized commodities. It has a gently spicy flavour and a faintly yellow hue.

title: Empress 1908 Gin
bodyHtml: Classic notes of juniper are balanced with pronounced grapefruit and hints of spice from ginger, cinnamon and rose. Butterfly pea flowers provide an earthy component and a vibrant indigo colour that changes to pink with the addition of tonic or citrus. Made in small batches on Vancouver Island, Empress 1908 Gin is the result of a collaboration between the iconic Empress Hotel and pioneering spirits makers, Victoria Distillers.

title: Beefeater Gin - 1.75 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: A quintessential London dry gin made with a significant juniper character and strong citrus notes, this is an authentic London dry for those who enjoy gin's natural taste. Still made in London to their founder James Burrough's original recipe of 9 botanicals featuring bold juniper, zesty Seville Orange and Lemon Peel, Desmond Payne. The world's most experienced master distiller oversees a bold and distinct gin that sets the standard for London Dry Gins and claims the title of The World's Most Awarded Gin.

title: No. 3 London Dry Gin
bodyHtml: No. 3 refers to the historic location of Berry Bros. & Rudd, fine wine and spirits providers to the crown and many other high society people. This is a classic London dry style gin with citrus peel, herbal and botanical aromas; the palate is smooth and dry with balancing herbal and citrus flavour followed by a crisp finish.

title: Hayman's Old Tom Gin
bodyHtml: Using old family recipes and a copper pot-still named Marjorie, after the current chairman's mother, the Hayman range captures the different and popular styles of gins throughout history. Distilled from 100% grain, steeped with botanicals before distillation and sweetened with sugar, their reproduction of the classic 18th century Old Tom Gin is no exception. The botanical blend includes juniper, coriander, lemon peel, orange peel, angelica root, cinnamon, cassia bark, orris root, liquorice and nutmeg. It's bottled at 40% ABV.

title: Magellan Gin
bodyHtml: This smooth, well-balanced gin is named for the 16th-century explorer whose remaining crew members returned with barrels of cloves, a key ingredient to this gin. Iris root and flower provide Magellan with its beautiful blue color while enhancing its crisp taste.

title: Bombay Sapphire Gin
bodyHtml:
Bombay Sapphire Gin is a globally iconic, premium London Dry-style gin produced at the historic Laverstoke Mill distillery in Hampshire, England. Created in 1987 by Master Distiller Carol Bond for International Distillers & Vintners (now under the ownership of Bacardi), the spirit was inspired by a 1761 recipe crafted by Thomas Dakin. Named after the famous 536-carat "Star of Bombay" sapphire mined in Sri Lanka, the brand revolutionized the modern gin category with its distinctive translucent blue bottle and innovative vapor-infusion production method.

Spirit Description

Unlike traditional gins that boil botanicals directly in the neutral spirit, Bombay Sapphire utilizes a specialized copper basket vapor-infusion process. Neutral grain spirit is heated in Carter-Head pot stills, and the rising vapors pass through a perforated basket containing 10 sustainably sourced botanicals: Tuscan juniper berries, Spanish lemon peel, coriander seeds, licorice root, Spanish almonds, angelica root, cubeb berries, cassia bark, grains of paradise, and orris root. Blended with pure water from the River Test, this technique yields a remarkably delicate, perfume-like, and balanced botanical profile.

  • Colour: Crystal clear, bright, and transparent.

  • Aroma: Delicate, fresh, and aromatic, opening with bright citrus peel, light juniper, and aromatic spice, followed by floral notes of iris, subtle coriander seed, and earthy angelica.

  • Palate: Exceptionally smooth, soft, and balanced on the entry. Upfront flavors of ripe lemon zest and piney juniper soften into subtle warmth from cubeb berries, grains of paradise, sweet licorice, and rounded nuttiness.

  • Body: Light-to-medium-bodied with a crisp, silky, and elegant mouthfeel.

  • Finish: Crisp, dry, and refreshing, with lingering citrus brightness, delicate pine, and a light, lingering pepper warmth.

  • ABV: Bottled at 47% ABV (94 Proof) in North America/travel retail; 40% ABV in select global markets.

title: Beefeater Gin - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Representing the modern, pulsating and energetic London, Beefeater London Dry has a remarkably clean flavour, with a bold juniper character that is balanced with strong citrus notes, making it the perfect gin to enjoy with the tonic of your choice.

title: Torres 30 Year Old 'Jaime 1' Brandy
bodyHtml:
Torres 30 Year Old Jaime I Brandy originates from Spain, within the North region in the subregion of Penedes in Catalonia. The historic house of Torres established its distilling lineage in 1928, crafting premium spirits that pay tribute to the founder of the house, Don Jaime Torres Vendrell. Today, the multi generational family enterprise maintains its esteemed global standing, blending exceptionally old reserves using the traditional solera method to produce this flagship expression.

Spirit Description

This ultra premium brandy displays a fine dark mahogany appearance with deep amber glows in the glass. The complex, majestic sensory profile opens with an expressive nose rich in caramel, toffee, toasted hazelnut, and vanilla, beautifully balanced by undertones of plum, cedar, and sandalwood. On the palate, the body is luxuriously smooth, velvety, and powerful, delivering an opulent combination of dark chocolate, walnut, dried figs, and juicy grape sweetness. The finish is remarkably long, warm, and structured, leaving a dry, dignified trail of oak spice, vanilla, and lingering caramel warmth. This spirit is bottled at an alcohol by volume ranging between 38% and 40% depending on the market distribution.

title: Luigi Bosca Malbec 2024
bodyHtml: Mendoza is one of the most important wine regions in Argentina and the place to be for New World Malbec. This example offers ripe red fruit tones with savoury, earthy and spice notes. Silky and juicy. Pair with steak.

title: Tanqueray Gin
bodyHtml: Tanqueray Gin is a Premium English Gin that delivers a clean, crisp taste. It is 47.3% alcohol by volume and is sold in a unique and distinctive green bottle, based on a cocktail shaker. Very fresh and smooth on the nose with slight hints of juniper and citrus coming through. A good hit of liquorice is present on the palate, with a slight spice that creates a long tingle.

title: Nonino Amaro
bodyHtml:
Amaro (plural "Amari") is Italian for "bitter", a type of drink the Italians didn't invent, but have made into an art form. Amari are commonly drunk as after-dinner digestifs and usually have a bitter-sweet flavor, sometimes syrupy, with an alcohol content between 16% and 40%.

Amari are typically made by macerating herbs, roots (often gentian), flowers, bark, and/or citrus peels in alcohol, either neutral spirits or wine, mixing the filtrate with sugar syrup, and allowing the mixture to age in casks or bottles. Many commercial bottlers trace their recipe or production to the 19th century. Recipes often originated in monasteries or pharmacies. Amari are typically drunk neat, sometimes with a citrus wedge, or, today, are used in cocktails. We are big fans.

The Nonino family have been one of the best producers of artisansal grappa in Italy for many years. They began to make a small amount of amaro in the 1930's, and in the 1990's decided to offer a variation on this amaro to the public, under the name Quintessentia.

Like all amaro, this is a distillation of alpine herbs, where bitter herbs (usually gentian root) take pride of place.   The original purpose of amari was as a digestif, to settle the stomach after dinner. One of us tends to suffer from heartburn after a large meal, and he has found that an amaro tends to alleviate that problem.

This amaro is, in our opinion, one of the best and one of the easier ones to approach. Frankly, this is terrific stuff, and we keep a bottle open at all times, and one in reserve, just in case Alberta doesn't get its next shipment on time.

title: Gautier VSOP Cognac
bodyHtml:
A subtle and well-balanced Cognac from one of the Cognac's oldest houses. As with all Gautier's spirits, this VSOP is aged in an 18th century water mill, giving it a distinctive flavour profile. 

Tasting Notes

Rush of dried fruit on the nose followed by lovely floral notes. Elegant entry into the mouth with fine display of flavours of biscuit, rich chocolate and warm spice. Warming flow where fruit is very evident as with sweet spice. Good balance and texture. Hints of old leather. Burst of warm spice leads into long, well fruited finish.

title: Hayman's Sloe Gin
bodyHtml:
Hayman's Sloe Gin is a traditional English liqueur made to a long standing family recipe. Wild hand picked sloe berries, a type of wild plum, are handpicked in the Autumn after the first frosts from the Blackthorn Tree. The early frosts lock in the vital sugary plum notes that define Hayman's Sloe Gin. The sloe berries are gently steeped for several months with Hayman's Gin before blended with natural sugars.

The final blend is a rich ruby red liqueur bursting with smooth and intense bitter sweet fruit flavours. Sloe Gin has been a popular drink from the 19th Century onwards as a digestive and winter warmer and was a required bar item during the first cocktail era in the 1880s.

title: Courvoisier XO Cognac
bodyHtml: This is an exotic feast for the senses. Intensely aromatic with vanilla and crème brûlée alongside candied orange, iris, and dried fruit. The palate is equally as complex, with layers upon layers of floral and fruit culminating in a long and thought-provoking finish.

title: Bombay Sapphire Gin - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: Clear water white. Complex mix of herbs and juniper on the nose with crisp lemon peel and citrus flavours. Smooth and refreshing.

title: Hendrick's Gin - 750 ml
bodyHtml: Hendrick's Gin is currently crafted in Girvan, Scotland. This iconic gin has gained worldwide recognition for its unique flavour profile. It offers a delicate and balanced combination of traditional botanicals like juniper, coriander, and citrus, along with the infusion of rose petals and cucumber, which lend a distinctive and refreshing twist. Critics often praise Hendrick's Gin for its smoothness and harmonious blend of flavours. The cucumber and rose notes add a refreshing and floral dimension, setting it apart from other gins on the market. With its exquisite taste and distinctive bottle design, Hendrick's Gin has become a beloved choice among gin connoisseurs and cocktail enthusiasts alike.

title: Eau Claire Parlour Gin
bodyHtml:
A London-dry style gin, it augments more traditional gin botanicals creating a juniper berry-induced dryness, but with unique hints of rosehip, Saskatoon berry, coriander, lemon, orange, mint and spice. A medium gin, it is dry with a smooth, harmonious texture and little harshness. Infused with a selection of special botanicals that give it its delicious, unique flavour notes, it is perfect for a relaxing libation, summer or winter.

They call it Parlour Gin to reflect the great history of prohibition-era gin parlours throughout the world, and to honour gin’s place in generating social conversation, friendship and pure, animal enjoyment. It can be enjoyed from parlour to patio, happy hour to the hopping bar. Enjoy yours by itself, in a martini, or with your favourite mix. Parlour Gin, like all of Eau Claire’s premium products, is made for social animals.

title: Beefeater Gin
bodyHtml:
The brand's history can be traced back to 1820 when the Chelsea Distillery opened, which was later purchased in 1863 by James Burrough. Burrough, a pharmacist by trade, used his skills to invent the recipe for this exceptional quality London dry gin. To this day, the gin is produced using Burrough's original 1863 recipe and process, which includes 'steeping' the nine botanicals for 24 hours prior to distillation.

The aroma presents a classic London Dry aroma that is pine-forward with juniper, balanced by spicy and fruity notes, along with a hint of light citrus zest. The palate is dry but ideally balanced with a herbal bouquet. It has a clean flavour with bold juniper character balanced by strong citrus notes. More orange notes may emerge on the palate as do subtle hints of parma violet and coriander. The body and finish is smooth and lingering, embodying the traditional London Dry gin profile, with a dry finish featuring citrus notes.

title: The Botanist Gin
bodyHtml:
The Botanist is a gin of layered complexity distilled using 22 local botanicals, a progressive exploration of the botanical heritage of the Scottish isle of Islay. Wild, foraged, distilled. The first and only Islay Dry Gin.

Character: The spirit is satin smooth gliding over the palate like no gin you have ever tried before. A totally seductive experience.

Colour: Quicksilver.

Nose: The aromas explode like an olfactory Aurora Borealis filling the senses with meteorites of smell sensations as they explode from the glass. Sweet delicate menthol, apple mint, spring woodlands, juniper, coriander with aniseed undertones, lemon and orange peel, a bouquet of summer flowers on the machir, honey from thistle, coconut from gorse, wild mint and summer meadows.

Palate: The taste is rich and mellow; cool on entry then as it reaches the back palate you can feel the warmth and absolute purity of slow unhurried distillation. This is a bewitching, delectable and luxurious gin; its citrus freshness excites and stimulates the taste buds allowing you to experience a starburst of flavours as they explode across the palate.

Finish: All this from a beaten up old pot still, operated by beaten up distillers on the coast of heaven.

title: Hennessy VSOP Cognac
bodyHtml:
A blend of over 60 eau-de-vie results in a harmonious experience, a testament to the enduring expertise of the master blenders. A natural balance of strength and smoothness with hallmarks of vanilla, clove, cinnamon and candied fruit melding together for a mind-bending experience. 

See More Cognac

title: St Remy VSOP Brandy - 1.14 Litre Bottle
bodyHtml: This versatile brandy is carefully aged in small French oak barrels, revealing an intense bouquet of exquisite fruity and floral aromas, accented with subtle tones of vanilla. This aromatic fruity and spicy brandy is perfect for mixing or sipping solo.

title: Stock 84 Brandy
bodyHtml:
General Information

Renowned for its mellow and spicy character, Stock 84 is fruity, smooth and sweet. It has lively top notes of ripe orchard and tropical fruit, over a foundation of oak and spice. The finish is warming and lengthy.

title: Ungava Gin
bodyHtml: The unique colour of this spirit comes from the mix of Arctic sourced botanicals that include cloudberry, labrador tea, rose hip and more. Medium lemon yellow in colour; aromas of juniper, herbal tea, spice and tart fruit; dry and medium-bodied followed by a warm and spicy finish.

title: Remy Martin Louis XIII Cognac - 700 ml Bottle
bodyHtml:
Louis XIII de Remy Martin is an exceptional blend of 1200 eaux-de-vie from Grand Champagne, aged from 40 up to 100 years through 4 generations of Cellar Masters, packaged in a gorgeous Baccarat decanter.

Delicate, Refined, & Complex ...

Louis XIII dates back to the 19th century, nurtured by generations devoted to the finest cognac ever produced. Each decanter is created as a unique expression of the traditional know-how of the House and is part of an iconic collection.

title: Poli Moscato Morbida Grappa
bodyHtml: This delightful Moscato grappa showcases aromas and flavours of lemon, Moscato grapes, orange blossom, grass, white flower and melon. It's full-bodied and spicy with a long-lasting, warm finish. Add a touch to coffee for an adult-inspired treat and pair it with chocolate-orange biscotti.

title: Jacopo Poli Vespaiolo Grappa - 500 ml
bodyHtml:
Introduction

Jacopo Poli Vespaiolo Grappa is a premium artisanal spirit from Italy, specifically produced in the Veneto region within the Breganze hills. The Poli Distillerie was founded in 1898 by GioBatta Poli in the village of Schiavon, near Bassano del Grappa. Still solely owned by the Poli family, the distillery is currently managed by the fourth generation, including Jacopo Poli and his siblings.

Spirit Description

This single vintage grappa is crafted from the fresh pomace of aromatic Vespaiolo grapes, which are grown in volcanic soils and distilled in antique copper steam boilers. The spirit is typically aged for at least six months in stainless steel tanks before bottling to maintain its youthful character.

  • Colour: The spirit is crystal clear with a glossy, silvery appearance.

  • Aroma: It features an intense floral and fruity bouquet with unique scents of wisteria blossom, lotus flower, and green apple, followed by notes of citrus oil, honey, and fresh figs.

  • Palate: The palate offers a silky, delicate entry with an incredible depth of rich flavours including honeycomb, sultana, and plum.

  • Body: This grappa is characterized by a medium body with a soft, round structure and 'ballerina like' poise.

  • Finish: It concludes with a long, fresh finish that evolves into a subtle aftertaste of toasted nuts, cocoa, and citrus peel.

  • ABV: While specific ABV can vary by batch, grappas of this type typically range between 35% and 60%, with this expression often bottled at 40%.

Food Pairing

The refined sweetness and aromatic intensity of this grappa make it an ideal choice for the end of a meal.

  • Savoury: It creates a fascinating contrast when served alongside aged cheeses such as Parmigiano Reggiano or sharp blue cheeses.

  • Sweet: The notes of honey and dried fruit pair perfectly with dark chocolate, hazelnut desserts, or artisanal cantucci biscuits.

  • Serving: For the best sensory experience, it should be served neat at a temperature between 10°C and 13°C in a tulip shaped glass.

title: Tanqueray 10 Gin
bodyHtml: Passion and attention to detail in perfect measure, is a recipe for exquisite results. Tanqueray Nº TEN, named after the stills of its origin, is small batch gin crafted using fresh citrus fruits. An exquisite citrus burst in every sip, best enjoyed with premium tonic water and a slice of pink grapefruit.
